Lza njengabaxhomekeke bakho banelungelo. Abafakizicelo abavulekile: Sicela ubonise umholo wakho wanyanga zonke. Uma ungumqondisi ophakathi noma ophezulu, sicela ubonise iphakheji yakho yanyanga zonke ngaphandle kokubekwa umkhawulo. Faka iphephandaba lakho lokugcina noma incwadi ethi uqashwe uma ungumsebenzi omusha. Abafakizicelo abathola umhlalaphansi: Sicela ubonise imali yakho yanyanga zonke yomhlalaphansi. Uma kunjalo, ungumfundi omkhulu noma ungumxhomekeki? Uma ungumfundi omkhulu/umxhomekeki, sicela uthumele isitifiketi sakho sokuhlangenwe nakho kwezokwelapha esidala ukuqinisekisa usuku lokugcina (amakhadi okuba yilungu awanele). Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ubudlelwano bakho nezokwelapha obudala buyapheliswa. Zonke izinkokhelo zabasebenzi zikhishwa ngokuzenzakalelayo emiholweni yabo lapho kudingeka. Uma ukhetha ukukhokha nge-debit order, udinga ukuqeda imininingwane yeBhange leLungu ngezansi (Isigaba H). Imininingwane ye-akhawunti yebhange: Idingeka ukuze kubuyiselwe imali yeLungu, nokukhokha okudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe kuHlelo. Abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zezempilo abanezinsiza bangase bangazivezi, njengoba kudingeka ukuze kubhaliswe futhi kubalwe, uma le mininingwane ibhekwa njengobumfihlo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka i-GEMS noma abasebenzi bayo imvume yokuxhumana nodokotela wakho, esibhedlela, noma kunoma iyiphi indawo enikeza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukunakekelwa okufanele. Ulwazi olukhona kule fomu luyiqiniso, luyalungile, futhi luqedile. Uma kukhona okungakwazi ukukukhombisa noma okungakahlukaniswa kahle, ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano bami bungase buphumelele futhi ngidinga ukubuyisela iHlelo nganoma iyiphi inzuzo engafanele ukhokhelwe egameni lami, ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokubizela. Ngikhetha lokho engikukhethile futhi ngiyaneliseka ngesimo sezinzuzo ngaphansi kwalokho engikukhethile. Ngiyavuma ukuhambisana nemithetho yeHlelo. Abaxhomekeki bami, ngaphandle kwalowo engishadile naye/umlingani wami, baphendukela kimi ngokuphelele noma ngaphezulu ngendlela yokuthi abatholi imali yonyaka edlula eyomhlalaphansi wombuso noma baqashwe ngokuphelele ngosuku lokusayina le fomu. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami nolwazi lwezokwelapha (olutholwe kubahlinzeki bezempilo ngemvume yami) kufanele lugcinwe luyimfihlo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami lwezempilo oluyimfihlo nolwabangxomekeki bami lungasetshenziswa ngezinhloso zokucwaninga, idatha yezibalo, ukuphathwa kwezempilo, kanye nezizathu zokubika, futhi noma iyiphi ukuphulwa kwalokhu kusho ukuphulwa kobumfihlo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi uma i-GEMS ifuna ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwami oluyimfihlo noma lwabangxomekeki bami ngezinhloso ezingakhulunywanga kulolu mvume, i-GEMS kufanele ithole imvume eyengeziwe kimi nabaxhomekeki bami. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami siqu nolwazi oluhlobene nezempilo ngeke lusetshenziswe ngezinhloso zebhizinisi noma lidayiswe ngezinhloso zebhizinisi. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS inikeze abantu abathile ngaphakathi kwenkampani kanye nezinkampani zangaphandle ezixhunywe nayo ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi oluhambelana namalungu nolwazi lwabo oluhlobene nezempilo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS kanye nezinkampani zangaphandle ezixhunywe nayo zizosebenzisa ulwazi lwezokwelapha/health oluhlinzekiwe/ukuhlolwa kwezifo/ukuhlinzwa ngezinhloso ezilandelayo - ukuze processing ifomu lesicelo sokuba yilungu, ukukhokha izicelo, ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka komlomo kokuthola izinzuzo, nokuphatha ingozi. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS ingene ezivumelwaneni zobumfihlo nazo zonke izinkampani zangaphandle ezixhunywe nayo ezinalo ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi lwamalungu ngenhloso yokudlulisela idatha nokuphatha, ukuphatha uhlelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa. Ngizokwazisa uHlelo nganoma yiziphi izinguquko empilweni yami naleso sikhathi sabasebenzi bami noma izimo ezihlobene nathi, njengoba kudingeka ngemicimbi yeHlelo, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokushintsha. Ngizokwazisa i-GEMS okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-48 ngaphambi kokungena esibhedlela okungelona udaba oluphuthumayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukuhamba kokungahambi kahle kuzoholela ekutheni ingxenye yemali ekhokhwayo ikhawulelwe kimi. Imigomo izohlala isebenza, futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi izincwadi, ama-newsletters angaphakathi, nezincwadi zokuqhuba azikhululi imithetho yeHlelo. Ulwazi lwamalungu (ulwazi siqu nolwazi lwezempilo) ngeke lusetshenziswe ngezinhloso zebhizinisi noma lidayiswe ngezinhloso zebhizinisi. Kukhona izindlela zokuhlola ulwazi olutholakalayo. Uhlelo kanye nezinkampani zangaphandle ezixhunywe nayo zizosebenzisa ulwazi lwezokwelapha/health oluhlinzekiwe/ukuhlolwa kwezifo/ukuhlinzwa ngezinhloso ezilandelayo - ukuze processing ifomu lesicelo sokuba yilungu, ukukhokha izicelo, ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka komlomo kokuthola izinzuzo, nokuphatha ingozi. Sicela ungathumeli lo mhlahlandlela ne fomu yakho egcwalisiwe. Ikhophi ye-ID yomfundi omkhulu. Iphephandaba lakho lokugcina/incwadi yokusebenza. Amafomu e-M2 ne-Z583, uma uthola umhlalaphansi/noma ubungumsebenzi wombuso. Kubalulekile ukuqeda yonke imininingwane kuSicaba A lapho kudingeka. Abahlali: Sicela uhlinzeke ngenombolo yakho yomhlalaphansi njengoba itholakala kumadokhumenti owabhalisile noma kuSertifika yeMhlalaphansi evela kuMnyango WezeMali. Sicela ubonise igama nekhodi yomqashi wakho wamanje. Ikhodi yenkampani ingatholakala kuphephandaba lakho uma ungumsebenzi wombuso. Sicela uqedele imininingwane yabaxhomekeki bakho kuSicaba B se fomu lesicelo. Akukho baxhomekeki ngaphandle kwalabo ababalwe etafuleni elingezansi abanelungelo lokuba yilungu. I-affidavit eqinisekisayo ukuthi umngani wakho uxhomekeke kwezezimali kumfundi. Isigaba esiqediwe sokuxhomekeka efomini lesicelo. Qaphela: Uma isibongo somntwana sahlukile kulowomfundi, i-affidavit eqinisekisayo ukuthi
Sesifikile ekupheleni kwezinsuku ezinde zebusika, futhi kulokhu, sithole ukuhlolwa ngezimo zezulu ezibandayo zeHighveld, imvula ethule eCape Town, kanye nezinhlobo ezintsha zeflu eziphumelelayo ezidale ukuthi abantu badinge ukwelashwa emhlabeni jikelele. Kusukela ekuqaleni kwayo, i-GEMS ibenze umsebenzi wayo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zempilo eziphezulu ezithengekayo futhi ezitholakala kalula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Amathiphu okuphila kahle: - Ukubhekana nokukhathala kwengqondo - Izindlela zokudla eziphilile - Thatha Isinyathelo! Kulobu busika, sithole futhi ugqozi ezindabeni ezithokozisayo ezivela kubalungu bethu ezweni lonke njengengxenye yokuncintisana kwe-GEMS Sisonke. Siyabonga ngalezi zindaba ezinhle eziningi enizabelane nathi. Izindaba ezithokozisayo ezivela kini ziwufakazi wokuthi i-GEMS idlala indima ebalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu nasempilweni yabalungu bayo. Kulungile ukwazi ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeka nokunakekela abalungu bayo lapho bedinga khona. Sizojabula ukwabelana ngalezi zindaba nani esikhathini esizayo emaphephandabeni afana ne-facets. Ubushushu buhlale buhamba nezinto ezintsha kanye nokuphila okulethwa yentwasahlobo! Phakathi kwalezi "zinto ezintsha zempilo," ngiyajabula ukulethela abalungu bethu iphephandaba lesithathu lesigaba se-facets. Ngiyethemba ukuthi nizojabulela ukwengeza kwe-facets. Usizo lwe-AIDS (AfA) yinkampani ephatha ukuxhumana kwe-HIV/AIDS esebenza ne-GEMS ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oluyimfihlo oludingayo ngenkathi uphila ne-HIV. Bangakusiza futhi uma udinga olunye ulwazi ngalesi sifo. Ngokubheka kubo ukuze uthole usizo, uyazisiza ngokukhipha umthwalo we-virus ezikhumbeni zakho bese ubuyisela esandleni sakho. EUnice, uthisha, uthole ukuthi uphila ne-virus eminyakeni eyisikhombisa edlule ngesikhathi ethatha isinqumo sokuhlolwa ngemva kokushona komunye umndeni. "Kunzima kakhulu ukwazi ukuthi unale virus. Ukubhalisela uhlelo lokuphatha isifo se-HIV lwe-GEMS, oluphathwa yi-AfA, kusho ukuthi ngizoholwa futhi ngaziswa ngodokotela abaqeqeshiwe futhi ngizokwazi ukuthola ukuphumula." Naphezu kwemiphumela yesifo, kukhona indlela yokusiza. "Ngabe ngikhathazekile futhi ngikhathazekile ngengqondo ngenxa yesifo," kusho uEunice, "ngangingakwazi nokulala ebusuku ngenxa yokukhathazeka. Ngesikhathi ngibhalisela uhlelo lwe-AfA, babenobubele futhi baqonda isimo sami. Bangenza ngazi ukuthi ukuba ne-HIV nokungathathi imithi lapho kudingeka njengokushiya amasango neminyango yendlu yakho ivulekile wazi ukuthi abaphangi bayafika. Ngijabule ukwenza isinqumo sokuzibophezela, nakuba ngazi kahle ukuthi akuwona umphumela wami ukuba ne-HIV." Baphinde banginika ulwazi olubalulekile engingase ngingazi ngalesi sifo. USifiso, ilungu, uthole ukuthi i-AfA imsize ukubuyisela impilo yakhe esimweni esihle. "Bangifundisa 'Ukuphila Ngokuhle,' okungifundisa ukuthi ngiphile impilo yami entsha. Kukho ulwazi lokugcina izinto zami zihlanzekile nokudla izithelo nemifino ukuze ngingatholi ukutheleleka. Baphinde bangitshele ukuthi yiziphi izidlo ezinhle engingazidla nokuthi kufanele ngisebenze kangakanani nokuthi kufanele ngilale isikhathi esingakanani. Impela, ngizizwa ngcono kakhulu manje. Ngempela, kubonakala sengathi ngiqala impilo kabusha." Uhlelo lokuphatha isifo se-HIV lwe-GEMS, oluphathwa yi-AfA, lwenza uEunice noSifiso bazifundise ngenkathi iScheme iphatha ezinye izici. Imithi ibhekwa ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe imiphumela efanele. Odokotela nabasebenzi bezinhlaka baqinisekisa ukuthi isiguli ngasinye sithatha imithi efanele ukuze impilo yabo iqhubeke ngokujwayelekile. Isiguli ngasinye sithola izeluleko zempilo yengqondo, njengoba impilo yabo yok emotional nepsychological ibalulekile hhayi kuphela kubo kodwa nakwabanye abaseduze nabo. "Ngaphambi kokuthi ngibhalisele uhlelo lwe-AfA, ngangingasokhathazekile ngoba ngazi ukuthi ngiphila ne-HIV, futhi umndeni wami wawubona ukuthi ngikhathazekile ngengqondo. Kwakufana nenhlwathi emnyama eyayiphakeme phezu kwendlu yami, futhi ngazizwa ngathi kwaba wumthwalo wami. Manje njengoba ngise-ART, izinto seziwubuyile ejimini. Impela, kufanele ngithi ukuthi ukushintsha impilo yami kancane kancane kuyinto enhle. Ngizama ukuthatha imithi yami ngesikhathi ngisho noma ngigqoke ijersey uma kubanda, kunokuba ngizilimaze," kusho uSifiso. Bhalisela i-AfA, ngokuqinisekile, ngokuxhumana nabo ku-0860 100 646 noma ngokuthumela ifomu lesicelo ku-website www.gems.gov.za. Ukuphoxeka akukaze kusize muntu! Kunalokho, kwenza isimo sithuthuke. Ukuxhumana akucacile, okusho ukuthi izincazelo ziyalahleka, futhi izinqumo ezingalungile zenziwa. Lokhu okwenzeka ezweni lethu njengamanje nakwamanye amazwe mayelana ne-"swine flu," noma "Mexican flu," noma i-H1N1 virus, nakuba empeleni kunemizamo ethile eyenziwa ngabasebenzi bezempilo ukwazisa umphakathi ngeqiniso. Uma ubheka izinga lokufa kanye nokungaqondakali kwalo, akuyona ingozi enkulu kuneflu ejwayelekile. Ngicabanga ukuthi kubalulekile kubantu ukwazi ukuthi i-flu ejwayelekile ingadala izifo ezinzima, njenge-pneumonia. I-flu ejwayelekile ingaba nzima kakhulu, futhi ibulala abantu njalo ngonyaka. Ngokwe-NICD, kunezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-flu virus ezivela ngezikhathi ezihlukahlukene uma kuqhathaniswa ne-swine flu ezweni kuleli sikhathi. Isizathu sokuthi i-swine flu ibangele ukukhathazeka ukuthi iyivirus entsha. Abantu abavikeleki kwi-swine flu virus njengoba benza kwezinye izinhlobo ze-flu virus, abake bahlaselwa. Nokho, njengokwe-flu yesizini, i-swine flu akufanele ithathwe kalula. I-swine flu ivele njenge-flu yesizini enezimpawu eziningi ezifana ne-fever, headache, ubuhlungu bezitho zomoya, ukuhuhuma, nokuba nenhliziyo ephumayo. I-swine flu iphinde ihluke kwi-flu yesizini kwezinye izimpawu; njengezimpawu zesisu, ukuhamba, nokushaywa kwenhliziyo okukhulunywe ngakho. Abanye abagulayo baphinde babe nezimpawu ezinzima, kuyilapho abaningi bahlongoza isifo esincane. Uma unalezi zimpawu ezingenhla, vakashela udokotela wakho ngaphambi kokuphuthuma esibhedlela noma ngaphambi kokuthenga i-oseltamivir (Tamiflu), imithi ye-swine flu. Nakuba abanye odokotela beqoka i-Tamiflu kubagulayo ngaphandle kokuvuma ukuthi umuntu uthintekile, abanye bavuma ukuthi ukuthatha imithi uma ungathintekile nge-swine flu kwenza kube lula ukuyithola esikhathini esizayo - uma ujwayele ukuthatha le mithi, i-virus ingase ibe ne-resistance kuyo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma uqobo uthola i-swine flu virus futhi udinga i-Tamiflu, ngeke isisebenze kahle. Ukuze isebenze kahle, ngokufanayo, udokotela onolwazi angaphakamisa ukuthi isiguli
U-GEMS uzinikele ekuhlinzekeni ngezempilo eduze kwakho. Senza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuhlinzeka wena nomndeni wakho ngezins benefits ezinhle zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngamanani aphumelelayo. Naphezu kokwehla komnotho, sijabule ukukwazisa ukuthi amazinga ethu okunikela ka-2010 akhuphukile cishe ngo-0.50% uma kuqhathaniswa nalawo ka-2009. Ukwanda okujwayelekile kokunikela ka-2010 kungu-10.8%, okuhambisana noluhlu lwezithuthukisi ezinhle. Kubalulekile, amazinga awazange aletheki ngokwehlukana kodwa ahambisana nokwanda okukhulu kwezins benefits. Iziphuzo zethu nezinkolelo zami zithi lezi zizoba KAHLE KAKHULU! Isimo sezulu sishisa, isimo sezulu sikhona iziphepho ezinzima, umnotho uyakhula, futhi sonke sisebenze kanzima ukuze siphumelele ngo-2009. Kudinga umkhosi ogcwele ukuhleka nenjabulo! Ngifisa konke okuhle kuNyaka Omusha futhi ngikhuthaza ukuba ubuyele emsebenzini uphumule kahle futhi uvuselelwe ngo-2010. Ekugcineni, ngiyabonga ngokuqhubeka kwakho nokuzinikela ku-GEMS kanye neziphakamiso ezinhle ozenzile ngo-2009. I-GEMS izinikele kubalaleli bayo, futhi laba balaleli benza i-GEMS ibe mkhulu! Njengoba wazi, yonke inketho ye-GEMS inezigaba zokunikela ezigxile emholweni ukuze abasebenzi abahlala emholweni ophansi abasebenza ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi bakwazi ukufinyelela inketho ethile yezins benefits. Umnikelo okhokhwayo ngokuqondile ngempela emholweni ngamunye wezigaba zonyaka owawubhalwe encwadini encane yamalungu ka-2009, eyatholwa amalungu ekuqaleni konyaka. Uma umholo wamalungu ukhuphuka ngonyaka, bangathola ukuthi isigaba sabo somholo sikhuphukile, futhi kuzodingeka bakhokhe umnikelo ophakeme, okukhuphuka esigabeni somholo, ukwanda kwezindleko zokuphila, ukwanda kwemiholo, kanye ne-OSD. Ukulungiswa kwemiholo kuholele ekwandeni kweminikelo kuhlelo lwezempilo kubalaleli abaningi, njengoba ukulungiswa kwemiholo kubabeke esigabeni esiphezulu somholo se-GEMS. Sicela usithinte ku-0860 00 4367 nganoma yimiphi imibuzo onayo. I-GEMS isungule isisekelo esiphelele sezins benefits esingeasy ukuthuthukisa kube yinto eyaziwayo yonke indawo njengephakheji ehamba phambili. Ngokuba neqiniso ekwaziseni ngalezi zinguquko nasekungeniseni kwezins benefits ezintsha kuHlelo, sithole izindlela eziningi zokuqhubeka siqinisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezins benefits ngo-2010. Bala iminikelo yakho ngokukhetha umholo wakho kanye nenani labantu abadala nezingane ezincike emndenini wakho. Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi udokotela wakho uhlala engumqondisi wakho wokunakekelwa futhi ukhiphe imithi efanele. Kunezinzuzo eziningi zokuvakasha kudokotela we-GEMS Network. Awukhokhi izinkokhelo ezihambisana nezindleko ezivela emphefumulweni wakho. Bonke odokotela be-GEMS Network bazinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imikhakha yabo iboniswa, futhi lapho kudingeka, bamukele izithunywa ezivela kubalingani (izithunywa ezivela kubangani) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlinzekwa kokunakekelwa okungabizi. Odokotela abanephrofayela nabangakazuzi isikhundla esiphakeme bathola umvuzo wokukhokha uma bebona udokotela okhokhwayo futhi okungafaki izindleko ezengeziwe. izinzuzo ezihlinzekwayo. baphumulelwe ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi; noma ukujoyina olunye uhlelo lwezempilo. Ngokomthetho, akekho ovunyelwe ukuba yilungu lwezinhlelo ezimbili zezempilo ngesikhathi esisodwa. Uma uqhubeka usebenzisa ikhadi lakho lamalungu ngemuva kokufaka isicelo nokukhokhelwa, kuzodingeka ubuyise le mali uma izinsuku zokufaka isicelo zikhonjiswa emarekhodini ethu. Kwenzekani kumarekhodi ami wemithi yezifo eziphindaphindayo uma ngifaka isicelo ku-GEMS? Ukwehla kwesisindo akusiyona nje isu elihle uma ufuna ukufaka ezindwangu ezincane, kodwa kubalulekile esimweni sakho sezempilo. Ukwehla kwesisindo, kudingeka ube nohlelo. Ukulwa nokukhuluphala kuhilela ukushintsha indlela yokuphila, ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo, nokuhlala usebenza njalo! Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukudla isidlo sasekuseni esiphelele kuyinto eyodwa yezinto ezinhle ongayenza uma ufuna ukulahlekelwa yizigidi ezimbalwa. Nansi eminye imihlahlandlela yokugwema ukwanda kwesisindo nokuhlala unempilo unyaka wonke, kodwa ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seholide. Nciphisa ukudla kwenkomo ebomvu futhi udle kakhulu inkukhu noma inhlanzi. Bhaka noma uphise ukudla kwakho. Phuza amanzi esikhundleni sokuphuza iziphuzo ezinoshukela. Futhi nciphisa ukusetshenziswa
Sizimisele ukuhlinzeka bonke ozakwethu nemindeni yabo ukufinyelela ezinzuzweni ezishibhile nezibanzi ezihlanganisa izinhlobo ezinhlanu zamaphakheji ezinzuzo. Kusukela lapho ilungu lokuqala, i-GEMS, langena ngo-2006, sihlangabezane nokukhula okungakaze kubonwe futhi saguqula konke kube uhlelo lwezempilo oluhamba phambili olusebenza kahle futhi olushibhile kubo bonke abasebenzi bethu bezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi. Noma iyiphi iqembu lomqashi elivunywa uHlelo lungangena. I-GEMS ihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezishibhile kubo bonke abantu! Wonke umuntu unethuba lokungena kwi-GEMS, njengoba inani olikhokhayo ukuze ube ilungu leHlelo incike emalini oyitholayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uzokhokha inani eliphansi ngaphakathi kwephakheji efanayo kunomuntu othola okuningi kunakho. Inani olikhokhayo liphinde lincike osayizi bemindeni yakho kanye nokuthi iyiphi yephakheji ezinhlanu oyikhethayo. Uhlelo lungathanda futhi lugxile ezidingweni zakho futhi lulalele uma amalungu ethu ekhuluma! Izinzuzo zempilo ezihamba phambili ngamanani asheshayo. Ukufihla ngokuphelele - ulwazi lwakho lwezokwelapha lugcinwa luqinisekisiwe ngaso sonke isikhathi - ngisho kumqashi wakho. Ukuxhumana namalungu ngezikhathi ezifanele. Insiza yamakhasimende enobungane futhi eqeqeshiwe ezikhungweni zokubiza nasezikhungweni zethu zendawo. Izikhungo zendawo ezweni lonke ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana uma udinga usizo nezinsizakalo. Isinyathelo 2: Gcwalisa ifomu - qiniseka ukuthi ugcwalisa zonke izingxenye ngokuphelele futhi uhlinzeka ngemibhalo esekelayo efunwayo. Bheka: Yimiphi imibhalo okudingeka uyithumele nencwadi yakho yesicelo? Uma ungathanda ukujoyina i-GEMS, kuzodingeka uhlinzeke ngezinkomba eziqinisekisiwe zemibhalo ethile, njengokukhomba wena nomndeni wakho, kanye nefomu lakho lesicelo. Xhumana newebhusayithi www.gems.gov.za ukuze uthole uhlu oluphelele lwemibhalo ongase uyidinge ukuthumela isicelo sakho, noma shayela iCall Centre yethu ku-0860 00 4367. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi uma ungathumelanga zonke izimfuno ezidingekayo, i-GEMS ngeke ikwazi ukukhipha isicelo sakho, futhi kuzoba nezikhathi zokulinda kuze kube zonke izimfuno zatholwa. Njengoba kuvamile, i-GEMS izama ukuk bringa izinzuzo zempilo ezinhle ezihambelana nephakheji yakho. Kuze kube manje, sikwazile ukugcina ukwanda kokuhlanganyela kwakho ngokuhambisana nokwanda kwezindleko zempilo. Ukuhlinzeka ngeminye imikhankaso kuyisibopho sethu kuwe. Kukho inketho yezinzuzo ehambelana nezidingo zempilo zomndeni wakho kanye nephakheji yakho! Lokhu kuyisibopho esiphelele sokuhlanganyela kubo bonke amalungu futhi akukhombisi isibopho somqashi. Uma umqashi elungele ukuthola isibopho somqashi, umqashi uzokhokha ingxenye yesibopho, kanti isiqeshana sizokhokhwa ngumsebenzi. Isibopho esiphezulu somqashi sincike osayizi bemindeni futhi siqediwe ku-75% yokuhlanganyela kwakho okuphelele, ngokuphakanyiswa kwe-R2,570. Ingabe udinga olunye ulwazi?
E-GEMS, silalela lapho amalungu ekhuluma khona. Sijabulela inani lokuxhumana okuhlanzekile futhi sizama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinzuzo zethu nezinsizakalo zihlangabezana nezidingo zamalungu ethu. Ngiyajabula ukwethula izinzuzo zika-2010 kini. Kule bhrosha, olunye ulwazi lunikezwa mayelana nok coverage okuthengekayo nokubanzi ongakuthola njengelungu le-GEMS ngo-2010. Siyanxusa ukuthi ukhethe inketho efanele izidingo zakho nezomndeni wakho. Ukuzibophezela kwethu ekuthuthukiseni kuyisibonakaliso sokuzinikela kwethu kuwe, ezidingweni zakho zempilo, kanye ne-CHOICE yakho. Kule mhlahlandlela, sikhombisa izinketho zethu ezinhlanu ezithengekayo - ukusiza ukuthi wenze ukukhetha okunolwazi mayelana nenketho yeziqu ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zomndeni wakho ngo-2010. Izinzuzo eziyisisekelo ezitholakala kumalungu ngo-2009 zigcinwe zikhona ngo-2010. Siphinde sakhulisa imikhawulo yezinzuzo ezitholakalayo futhi sangeza ezintsha, njengezinzuzo ezintsha zeBlock enkethweni ye-Emerald. Sijabulela ukwazi ukuthi noma ngabe isikhathi somnotho sikhulu, siqhubeka nokukunika ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuthengekayo nokwakhiwe kahle. Imali yokufaka ka-2010 iqala ku-R424, futhi siphumelele ukugcina ukukhuphuka kwemali yokufaka kuyo yonke inketho ku-10.8%. Amathebula emali yokufaka ka-2010 afakiwe kulomhlahlandlela, ukuze ubone ukuthi ukukhuphuka kuzothinta kanjani iphakheji yakho. Ngithanda ukubonga ngokuqhubeka kokwesekwa kwakho futhi ngikufisela impilo enhle ngo-2010. Khumbula ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsizwa yakho empilweni enhle. Ekupheleni konyaka ngamunye, sinika amalungu ethu ithuba lokushintsha ukuya kwenye inketho yeziqu. Ukuze ukhethe, kudingeka ucabange ngezidingo zakho zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, izinzuzo ezitholakalayo kuyo yonke inketho, kanye nemali yokufaka ngayinye. Sicela uthathe lokhu kubalulekile njengoba uvunyelwe ukushintsha inketho yakho kanye kuphela ngonyaka. Uma ufuna ukushintsha inketho yakho ngo-2010, sicela ulandele lezi zinyathelo ezintathu ezilula ngezansi. Khumbula ukuthi ifomu lakho le-"Khetha" kumele lifike kithi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kosuku lwe-30 Novemba 2009. Lolu mhlahlandlela luhlanganisa izici ezihlukahlukene ze-GEMS. Luhloselwe ukuba kube isikhumbuzo esisheshayo kuphela futhi aluhlanganisi imithetho yeSchem. Uma kwenzeka ukungavumelani, imithetho ebhalwe phansi izothatha indawo.
Funda kahle umhlahlandlela wesicelo sokungena, njengoba uqukethe ulwazi olubalulekile oluzokusiza uqedele ifomu lesicelo kahle. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo sokungena ngemuva futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthumela wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo kanye nesiginesha yakho lapho kudingeka. Izikhungo ongangena kuzo ziseduze nawe: Bheka umhlahlandlela wesicelo ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi. Isicelo sakho sizobambezeleka uma ungahlinzeki i-GEMS ngawo wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo. AWUKWAZI UKUPHINDE USEBENZE LO MHLALANDLELA KANYE NEFOMU LESICELO EQEDILE. SICELA UQEDILE YIZIGABA ZONKE EZIHLOBENE NGOKUCOPHELA NGENKATHI UZIBHALA. Qinisekisa ukuthi uhlinzeka ngawo wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo. Sicela ubheke isigaba B somhlahlandlela wesicelo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi abantu ofuna ukubabiza njengezincikile zakho bayafaneleka. Asizophumelela ngefomu lakho uma ulwazi lukaMazisi lungahlinzekwanga. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqedela lesi sigaba ngokuphelele. Abafakizicelo abavulekile: Sicela ukhombise umholo wakho wanyanga zonke. Uma ukwi sikhundla sokuphatha esiphakathi noma esiphezulu, sicela ukhombise iphakethe lakho lanyanga zonke ngaphandle kokubekwa emkhawulweni. Faka iphephandaba lakho lokugcina noma incwadi ekhombisa ukuthi uqashwe uma ungumsebenzi omusha. Abafakizicelo abathola umhlalaphansi: Sicela ukhombise imali yakho yomhla wanyanga zonke. Uma kunjalo, ungumsebenzi ophakeme noma ungumuntu oncikile? Uma ungumsebenzi ophakeme/oncikile, sicela uthumele isitifiketi sakho sokuhlanganyela emkhakheni wezokwelapha esidala siqinisekisa usuku lokugcina (amakhadi wokuhlanganyela awanele). Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ukuhamba kwakho emkhakheni wezokwelapha okudala kuyakhanselwa. Zonke izinkokhelo zabasebenzi zikhishwa ngokuzenzakalelayo emiholweni yabo lapho kudingeka. Uma ukhetha ukukhokha nge-oda lokudebit, udinga ukuqedela Imininingwane yeBhange yeNhlangano ngezansi (Isigaba H). Imininingwane ye-akhawunti yasebhange: Idingeka ukuze kubuyiselwe imali yamalungu, futhi ukuze kukhishwe izimali ezikhokhwayo kuHlelo. Asizophatha ukubuyiselwa uma singanawo ama-akhawunti asebhange. Abahlinzeki bezempilo abanolwazi bangakudalula, njengoba kudingeka ukuze kubhaliswe futhi kube nezizathu zokubala, uma lelo lwazi lithathwa njengokuyimfihlo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka i-GEMS noma abasebenzi bayo imvume yokuxhumana nodokotela wakho, esibhedlela, noma kunoma iyiphi indawo ehlinzeka ngempilo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukunakekelwa okukhanga. Ulwazi olukhona kule fomu lungempela, luyiqiniso, futhi luphelele. Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle noma ulwazi olungaqondakali, ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukuhamba kwami kungakhanselwa futhi ngingase ngidinge ukubuyisela iHlelo nganoma yimiphi imivuzo eyakhishwa ngokungafanele egameni lami, ngokuhambisana nezinyathelo zokubiza. Ngikhetha lokho engikukhethile futhi ngiyaneliseka ngesimo semivuzo ngaphansi kwalokho engikukhethile. Ngiyavuma ukuhambisana nemithetho yeHlelo. Abancikile bami, ngaphandle komkakho/umlingani, baphendukela kimi ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye ngendlela yokuthi abatholi umholo waminyaka yonke ophakeme kunoMhlalaphansi wombuso noma baqashwe ngokuphelele ngosuku lokusayina le fomu. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami nolwazi lokwelashwa (olutholwe kubahlinzeki bezempilo ngovuma lwami) kumele kugcinwe kuyimfihlo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami lwezempilo oluyimfihlo nolwabangane bami lungasetshenziswa ngezinjongo zocwaningo, idatha yezibalo, ukuphathwa kwezempilo, kanye nezinjongo zokubika, futhi noma iyiphi ukuphulwa kwalokhu kubhekwa njengokwephula imfihlo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi uma i-GEMS ifuna ukusebenzisa ulwazi lwami oluyimfihlo noma lwabangane bami ngezinjongo ezingashiwongo kulokhu kuvuma, i-GEMS kumele ithole imvume ehlukile kimi nabangane bami. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwami siqu nolwazi lwezempilo luzodingeka lungasetshenziswa ngezinjongo zebhizinisi noma kuthengiswe ngezinjongo zebhizinisi. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS inikeze abantu abathile ngaphakathi kwenkampani kanye nezithunywa ezixhunywe nayo ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi oluhlobene namalungu nolwazi lwabo lwezempilo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS kanye nezithunywa ezixhunywe nayo zizosebenzisa ulwazi lokwelashwa/ezempilo/ukuthola izifo/ukuhlinzwa oluhlinzekiwe ngezinjongo ezilandelayo - ukuze processing isicelo sokuhlanganyela, ukukhokha izicelo, ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka komlamuli kwemivuzo, nokuphatha ubungozi. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi i-GEMS ingene ezivumelwaneni zokugcina imfihlo nazo zonke izithunywa ezixhunywe nayo ezinomthetho wokufinyelela ulwazi lwamalungu ngenjongo yokudluliswa kwedatha nokuphathwa, ukuphatha uhlelo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa. Ngizokwazisa iHlelo nganoma yiziphi izinguquko empilweni yami noma yezehlakalo zami, njengoba kudingeka ngemithetho yeHlelo, ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokushintsha. Ngizokwazisa i-GEMS okungenani amahora angama-48 ngaphambi kokungena esibhedlela okungelona udaba oluphuthumayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukungakwenzi lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni ingxenye yemali ekhokhwayo ikhishelwe kimi. Imithetho izohlala isebenza njalo futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi ama-imeyili, izincwadi zangaphakathi, nezincwajana azikh substitute imithetho yeHlelo. Ulwazi lwamalungu (ulwazi lwakho siqu nolwazi lwezempilo) aluzosetshenziswa ngezinjongo zebhizinisi noma kuthengiswe ngezinjongo zebhizinisi. Kukhona izindlela zokuhlola ulwazi ezikhona. I-Hlelo nezithunywa ezixhunywe nayo zizosebenzisa ulwazi lokwelashwa/ezempilo/ukuthola izifo/ukuhlinzwa oluhlinzekiwe ngezinjongo ezilandelayo - ukuze processing isicelo sokuhlanganyela, ukukhokha izicelo, ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka komlamuli kwemivuzo, nokuphatha ubungozi. Sicela ungathumeli lo mhlahlandlela nefomu lakho eliqediwe. Ikhophi ye-ID yomlamuli ophakeme. Iphephandaba lakho lokugcina/incwadi yokusebenza. Amafomu M2 no-Z583, uma uthola umhlalaphansi/noma ubungumsebenzi wombuso. Kubalulekile ukuqedela lonke ulwazi esigabeni A, lapho kudingeka. Abathola umhlalaphansi: Sicela uhlinzeke ngenombolo yakho yomhlalaphansi etholakala kumadokhumenti owabhalisile noma kuSitifiketi somhlalaphansi esivela kwiMali Kazwelonke. Sicela ukhombise igama nekhodi yomqashi wakho wamanje. Ikhodi yenkampani ingatholakala kuphephandaba lakho uma ungumsebenzi wombuso. Sicela uqedele imininingwane yabancikile bakho esigabeni B sefomu lesicelo. Kubalulekile ukuqedela imininingwane kaMazisi yabancikile kule ndawo. Nakwezinga zonke zokukhulelwa kwakho, kusukela ekwamukelweni esibhedlela kuze kube sekuzalweni kwengane yakho, kuhlanganise nesikhathi sokuphuma esibhedlela. Inhloso ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo ngezinsiza nezincazelo ngesikhathi uthola ukuba ngumzali omusha. Incwadi ye-GEMS yokukhulelwa, yokuzala, kanye nezinsiza mayelana nezinzuzo ezizokhokhwa yi-GEMS ngesikhathi uthola ukuba ngumzali omusha uma ubhalisela uhlelo lokuzala kanye nezinye izinsiza ongase ube nazo. Ukufinyelela mahhala kuzo zonke izinsiza ezihlinzekwa uHlelo Lokukhulelwa. Izeluleko ezihlinzekwa yi-GEMS ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kwakho nangemva kokuzalwa uma ubhekana nezinkinga zokulethwa kwengane yakho. Ekwenyukeni kokuqala kokuba ngumzali omusha. Uhlelo Lokunakekela luhloselwe ukuphatha udokotela wakho mayelana nemithi edingekayo ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kwakho. QAPHELA: Ukuze ujabulele izinzuzo, kubalulekile ukubhalisela uhlelo. Izeluleko ngezindaba ezifana nokudla, ukuzivocavoca, ukungakhululeki okuncane ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ukuzalwa ekhaya, ukuziphatha ngemithi, kanye nokwesekwa kokudla kwengane. Ukukwazi ukuzinakekela ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa, ukuzalwa, nasekuphumuleni. Umphathi uzobe ekhona ukukusiza wena nengane yakho kuze kube uthola ukuhlolwa kokuphuma esibhedlela.
Emhlanganweni owenziwe kahle ukuze kuqhubeke kuxoxwa ngendaba esesimeni, uMongameli wemihlangano uqinisekisile ukuthi isaziso sokubiza umhlangano wesithathu weMihlangano Yonyaka yeziqubulo, kanye nohlelo lwezinhlelo zomhlangano, umbiko weBhodi Yabaphathi, izitatimende zezimali ezihlolwe nezifingqiwe zonyaka, kanye nombiko we-auditor, sathunyelwa kumalungu ngaphambi kokuphela kukaMeyi 2009 ngokuhambisana Nezikhumbuzo zeMihlangano. UMongameli wemihlangano uqinisekisile ukuthi amalungu awathumelanga iziphakamiso eziphakanyisiwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho 28.1.5 we-GEMS, okwakuphakamisa ukwamukelwa kohlelo olunikezwa amalungu etafuleni lokubhalisela. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi ezinye amalungu asetshenzisile amafomu okhetho ukuze athumele iziphakamiso zawo kwiMihlangano futhi lezi zindaba zizophakanyiswa ngesikhathi sokubuza nokuphendula. U-Mnu. Adriaan Van Wyk uphakamise ukuthi uhlelo lwamukelwe futhi lesi siphakamiso sathuthukiswa nguMnu. John Themba. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi izinhlinzeko zeMithetho yeMihlangano, iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kunoma yimuphi umhlangano wonyaka kufanele kube ngendlela yokuvota kwenani elikhulu lamalungu abukhoma futhi amelelwe ngu-proxy. UMongameli wazisa umhlangano ukuthi iMihlangano yamukela amafomu okhetho angama-207 asemthethweni avela kumalungu ngosuku lokugcina lukaJuni 19, 2009. Inani eliphelele lama-48 amafomu amelelayo adingeka ukuthi asuswe njengoba aqukethe izinombolo zokubhaliswa ezingalungile noma ezingafundeki noma abamenyiwe ngabantu abangamalungu eMihlangano njengabamele. Umhlangano uqaphele futhi ukuthi amalungu eMihlangano abamenye ezinye amalungu ukuze avote kubo bonke abaphathi nabalungu beQembu Eliphezulu leMihlangano. Abantu abakhethiweyo bakhombisa ngosuku lukaJuni 23, 2009, emhlanganweni weBhodi Yabaphathi ukuthi bafuna ukuvota kanjani kuzo zonke iziphakamiso ezethulwe emhlanganweni. Ngemuva kokwethulwa nokuxoxwa ngazo zonke iziphakamiso eziphakanyisiwe, uMongameli wazisa amalungu ukuthi abamele abathunywe bavote kanjani futhi wabe esethula iziphakamiso zokwamukelwa. UMongameli wethula imizuzu yokwamukelwa. Imizuzu yeMihlangano Yesibili Yonyaka yamukelwa ngemuva kokuthi uMnu. Manganyi Abraham uphakamise ukuthi umhlangano wamukele imizuzu, futhi lesi siphakamiso sathuthukiswa nguMnu. Nxumalo Themba. UMongameli wemihlangano wethula izitatimende zezimali zonyaka ophela ngoDisemba 31, 2008, zokwamukelwa futhi wazisa umhlangano ukuthi amalungu anikezwa izitatimende zezimali ezihlolwe nezifingqiwe ngaphambi komhlangano. UMongameli watshela amalungu abukhoma ukuthi ngokuhambisana namafomu amelelayo amukelwe, amalungu angama-205 avote ekwamukeleni izitatimende zezimali zonyaka ka-2008 ngenkathi kungekho ilungu elivote ngokumelene nokwamukelwa kwezitatimende zezimali. Amalungu amabili afuna ukuhamba phambili ekuvoteni. Umhlangano uqaphele ukuthi inqubo yokuvula izikhangiso ilandelwe ukuze kuqashwe inkampani ye-auditors yangaphandle ukuze iqashwe njengama-auditors angaphandle eMihlangano unyaka wezezimali ophela ngoDisemba 31, 2009. IMihlangano yaqhubeka nokukhula ngo-2009 nangaphezulu kwalokhu kukhula okuqhubekayo, usayizi jikelele webhizinisi nezinkinga ezavela, kube nempumelelo enkulu eyenzeka ngo-2009. IBhodi Yabaphathi ye-GEMS iyaziqhenya ngentuthuko eyenziwe yiMihlangano nokuthi izinkinga ezavela ngo-2009 zaphathwa kanjani nokuthi izindaba ezisemqoka zamalungu ngaphansi kwe-GEMS zivikela ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukuhlinzeka bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni ngamathuba alinganayo ukuze babe nezinzuzo zempilo ezibizayo. Uhlelo lokuphathwa kweMihlangano oluqinile ludinge ukusungulwa kohlelo lwecebo lesikhashana nelide oluhola futhi lukhombise ibhizinisi leMihlangano. Impumelelo ye-GEMS ikalwa ngamandla ezakhiwo zayo zokuphatha nokuphatha, kanye nezinqubo zayo zokuhlela amacebo - lezi zinto ziqinisekisa ukuthi i-GEMS inerekhodi yokuphumelelisa kahle amacebo ayo e-strategic wonyaka futhi ifinyelela izinhloso eziqukethwe kuyo. IBhodi yenza ukuhlela amacebo ka-2009 ngokuqonda ukuthi iMihlangano isibe inhlangano esezingeni eliphezulu esakhe indawo yokusebenza ephelele nezinhlelo zokuphatha zezimali eziqondile. Ukuhlela kwenziwa ngenhloso yokubeka i-GEMS njengemihlangano yokunakekelwa kwezempilo ehamba phambili, esebenzayo, futhi ephumelelayo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. IBhodi ibuyekeze ukwakheka kweKomidi okwakusungulwa yiBhodi ngo-2009 ngenhloso yokusebenzisa kahle amakhono nolwazi lwabaphathi kanye namalungu eKomidi ezimele. Ukuhlola kweBhodi kubuye kubheke ukufaneleka kwezimo zokubhekisela kumaKomidi futhi izinguquko ezincane zadingeka. Abaphathi basebenza kumaKomidi ngo-2009 njengoba kubikwe ezicini 7 no-8 zeMibiko yeBhodi. IBhodi yamukela ekuhlolweni kokusebenza kweBhodi yonyaka ukuthi amaKomidi asebenza kahle nokuthi ukubika kwiBhodi kuhle kakhulu. Amalungu eKomidi ezimele babambe iqhaza ekuhloleni kweMihlangano, amaKomidi e-Ex Gratia kanye ne-Emergency aqashwe yiBhodi ukuze asebenze ehhovisi isikhathi esingamashumi amathathu eminyaka futhi isikhathi samalungu siphela ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa. IBhodi iphinde yaqasha wonke la malungu eKomidi ngasikhathi sinye futhi isikhathi sokusebenza siphela ngo-2012. Ukuhlolwa kokuphatha okuhle okuwenziwe yiMihlangano kwathuthukiswa ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa nokwethulwa kwenqubo yokuhlola abaphathi, amalungu eKomidi ezimele, nabasebenzi. Inqubo yokuhlola iyingxenye ye-framework yokuphatha okuhle kweMihlangano ethinta izakhiwo zokuphatha nezenhlalakahle, Ukuphathwa Kokuhola Abasebenzi, Ukuphathwa Kwabaphakeli, Uhlelo lwezokuphepha kanye nezinhlelo zokuvikela ubugebengu. Ukuhlolwa Kokusebenza Konyaka kweBhodi yeMihlangano kwenziwa kusukela kuSepthemba kuya ku-Okthoba 2009. IBhodi yathola ukuhlola kokuzihlola okuqhutshwa yinkampani ezimele ehlole izincwadi nezokusebenza zeBhodi kanye namaKomidi atholakele ukuthi kulungile. Ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibhalwe phansi ze-GEMS, isikhathi sokusebenza samaphesenti angama-50 abaphathi abakhonza kwiBhodi Yabaphathi yamanje sizophela ngoJulayi 2010. IBhodi entsha izokwakhiwa ukuze iqale ukusebenza ngoJulayi 21, 2010. Kuze kube manje, amalungu amakhulu eMihlangano azokhetha abaphathi abasha abathathu kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezikhungo Zomphakathi Nezokuphathwa uzokwenza futhi abaphathi abasha bazokwakha amaphesenti angama-50 eBhodi. Uma iBhodi, ngemuva kokubuyekeza umbiko womuntu noma umzimba ozimele, ikholwa ukuthi ukhetho lwenzeka ngokuhambisana nenqubo eyasungulwa yiBhodi
Ukuba nomntwana kuzoba enye yezinto ezizwakalayo kodwa futhi ezinzima empilweni yakho. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ulindele ukwamukela injabulo yakho oyilindele isikhathi eside ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye. Nokho, ngakolunye uhlangothi, uzobe ucabanga ngendlela yokwenza ukuthi umntwana wakho angene kulo mhlaba ngokuphepha ngaphandle kokukhathazeka okukhulu. Ngokwazi izinketho zakho nokuxhumana nomhlinzeki wezempilo, ungakwenza isinqumo esihle kuwe nomntwana wakho. Impilo yakho jikelele kanye nezindlela zokuphila, kanye naleyo yomntwana ongakazalwa, kuzoba yizici ezibalulekile ezinqumweni zakho. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda okuzokwenzeka kanye nezinzuzo nezinkinga zezinketho zakho. Wena nomntwana wakho bazobhekwa kuyo yonke inqubo yokubeletha, futhi abasebenzi bezokwelapha abaqeqeshiwe bazotholakala uma ubhekana nanoma yiziphi izinkinga. Ukuhlola okweqile kungaholela ekutheni kube nezinyathelo zokwelapha ezingadingekile. Ungase udinge ukuthokoziswa izinto ezijwayelekile ngesikhathi lesi, futhi isibhedlela akusona njalo isikhala esishisayo nesithokozisayo. Ukubeletha ekhaya kuyinketho ephephile uma ukukhulelwa kwakho kujwayelekile, futhi umuntu obelethayo unokufinyelela ezinsizeni nasekusekeleni okufanele. Ukubeletha ekhaya kukwenza uzizwe ukhululekile endaweni ejwayelekile ngesikhathi ubeletha umntwana wakho. Uma ubhekana nezinkinga, usizo olutholayo luzoncika ekutheni umphakathi noma umuntu obelethayo unolwazi olufanele nokuthi bangakudlulisela kalula esibhedlela uma kudingeka. Lokhu kuwukubeletha emanzini okujwayelekile okungasetshenziswa njengendlela yokunciphisa ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ungahamba kalula emanzini. Kukhona ubungozi bokutheleleka kokubili wena nomntwana. Umntwana uzalwa ngokusika isisu nomphimbo. Lokhu kungathinta impilo yomntwana nomama, kodwa imiphumela yokuhlinzwa okukhulu kanye nokukhathazeka kungaholela ezinkingeni kumama. Ukulethwa kwe-cesarean okwenziwe ngokukhetha kuhlelwe ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa ngenxa yezinkinga zezempilo noma zokubeletha, lapho ukulethwa kubhekwa njengokungaphephile kumntwana noma kumama. Ukulethwa kwe-cesarean okuphuthumayo kwenziwa uma kwenzeka izinkinga ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ngezinye izikhathi, isidingo sokulethwa kwe-cesarean asicacile kuze kube sekuthathweni kokubeletha, futhi omama abahlose ukubeletha ngokujwayelekile bangase badinge ukulethwa kwe-cesarean. Ukulethwa kwakho kungahamba kabi. Izitho zakho zomzimba zingase zibe zincane kakhulu. Izinga lenhliziyo yomntwana, elizobhekwa ngedivayisi kagesi ngesikhathi sokulethwa kwakho, lingase libonise ukuthi umntwana uthola ubuhlungu ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ukuthwala izingane eziningi, ngokwesibonelo, kungase kudinge ukulethwa kwe-cesarean kwezinye izimo. Lokhu kuyisimo esingase sibe khona ezinsukwini ezine kuya kwezisixhenxe ngemuva kokuhlinzwa. Kunjalo ukuhlinzwa ngemedikwe elawula ukuthi umphimbo uvale futhi umise ukuvuza. Ukudluliswa kwegazi, ukuhlinzwa, kanye nasezikhathini ezithile, i-hysterectomy (ukuhlinzwa kokususa umphimbo) kungase kudingeke. Ukulimala kwe-bladder noma i-bowel kungase kwenzeke. Udinga ukubhalisela uHlelo lweMali Yezokubeletha ukuze ufinyelele ezinzuzweni zakho njengom member wezinye zezinketho ze-GEMS. Ukubeletha ekhaya kubiza u-R6,610 kumuntu ngamunye ngaphansi komuntu omkhulu.
Ukubuyiselwa kwesivumelwano sokusebenza: Qiniseka ukuthi ukubhalwa kwenziwa! Manje sesikwi nyaka ka-2009 futhi singene ebusika. Njengoba izinsuku ziba mfushane futhi zishisa, sethemba ukukulethela ukufudumala nenjabulo nalesi sahluko sesibili seFacet sika-2009. Ukubukeka okusha kweFacet kuthokoziswe kakhulu futhi kwathokozisa amalungu, futhi sethemba ukuthi uthola lezi zindaba zikhangayo, ziwusizo, futhi ziwuthokozisa. Uma umuntu ecabanga ukuthi imisebenzi ye-GEMS igxile ngokuphelele ekugcina amalungu angaphezu kuka-350,000 ejabulile futhi ephephile, kuyamangaza ukuthi sithola kanjani kancane ngendaba yokwabelana ngezindaba eziyiqiniso - ezinezimpumelelo - ezivela kumalungu ethu. Enye yalezi zindaba ikhuluma ngoMzimasi Ngqelu nokuthi wayiphila kanjani isimo esibulalayo, esanda kufika ezihlokweni zethu. Sithintekile kakhulu umthelela i-GEMS enawo empilweni yakhe. Angizukungena emikhakheni eminingi lapha; kodwa uma ujika ekhasini elilandelayo, ungafunda ngendaba yakhe ekhuthazayo. Kulesi sahluko, siphinde sikhulume ngomncintiswano wamalungu ethu, iSis-onke, eyakhanyiswa kakhulu nguMzimasi. Siyacela ukuthi ungene emncintiswaneni ngoba sithanda ukuzwa ukuthi i-GEMS ikwenze kanjani kube ngcono empilweni yakho. Siphinde singenise izinsuku zokuhlola impilo ze-GEMS, eziletha izinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo endaweni yokusebenza. Enye usizo olusha olwenziwe kulesi sahluko yisicelo sefonini esihlonishwayo esibizwa ngokuthi "SMS benefit lookup," sikhuthaza amalungu ukuba basisebenzise. Okudingayo ukwenza ukuze uthole ukuthi yiziphi izinzuzo ongazifaka ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo ukuthumela i-SMS kuhlelo lwakho lokuhlela, futhi sizophendula ngemizuzwana enolwazi oludingayo. Uhlelo ngalunye luchazwa ngemininingwane kulesi sikhangiso - ngakho qiniseka ukuthi ufunda ngakho konke. Ekulungiseleleni lesi sikhangiso, ngizame, njengokujwayelekile, ukukhumbuza amalungu ethu ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeka nokufuna ubungcweti. Amalungu aqhubeka nokwelashwa futhi abhekwa njengabantu abafanele izinzuzo ezinhle kakhulu. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uyawujabulela lo mqulu weFacet kuze kube isikhathi esilandelayo - hlala ufudumele futhi uphilile. Uhlelo lwezempilo lwezisebenzi zikahulumeni, elungu le-GEMS, alukaze luphuthelwe usuku aluthola ngalo i-voucher yokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngeposi. "Ngashesha ngaqonda ukuthi ngeke ngikwazi ukukhokhela i-R180,000 ye-bhili yesibhedlela esikhwameni sami," kuchaza uNgqelu. "Inani elikhulu elakhokhwa yi-GEMS ekuthengeni kwami kwesibhedlela liqinisekisile ukuthi ngithole ukwelashwa okuhle kakhulu." Wabe esedluliselwa endaweni yokubuyisela emuva eKensington, eJohannesburg, lapho athola khona ukwelashwa komzimba nokuhlolwa kwengqondo. Ngomhlaka 1 kuJanuwari 2009, wayelungele ukubuyela emsebenzini; into eyayicabanga odokotela abanye ukuthi ngeke kwenzeke. Impilo yakhe yaguquka yaba ngcono. Uhlala ethi, "Ngiyabonga impilo kakhulu futhi ngithole nomkakho." Washada noNqobile Mangena (manje nguNgqelu) ngoNovemba unyaka owedlule. Manje ujabulela impilo yakhe entsha futhi uzama ukukhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba babe amalungu e-GEMS. "Ngiyabonga futhi, GEMS," uphetha. "Ningakwenze kuphela umehluko empilweni yami kodwa niphinde nisisize ukuyisindisa." Ingabe ukuba ilungu le-GEMS kuthuthukisile impilo yakho kakhulu selokhu waba ilungu? Sifuna ukuzwa ngazo zonke izinto ezinhle ezenzekile kuwe njengelungu le-GEMS. Uma wabelana ngendaba yakho nathi njengoba uMzimasi Ngqelu enze, ungase ucatshangelwe emncintiswaneni! Awudingi ukuba umbhali ophakeme noma ukhulume ngendaba yakho kahle; udinga kuphela ukuba nendaba enhle yokwabelana. Kulula! Thumela umlayezo, i-imeyili, noma incwadi ngeposi lapho usitshela khona indaba yakho ekhuthazayo. Ungakwenza lokhu ngolimi olusemthethweni - sizofunda zonke. Khumbula ukufaka igama lakho, imininingwane yokuxhumana, kanye nenombolo yakho yokuba ilungu. Kuyajabulisa ukukwazisa ngomncintiswano owenza umehluko. Empeleni, umncintiswano owenziwe ngqo kuwe. Uma ungumuntu oyi-lungu le-GEMS, ungafaka isicelo sokungena. Uma ungumuntu oyi-lungu, unethuba lokuwina umklomelo othandwa abaningi. Umsebenzi wakho ukwabelana nabanye amalungu osebenza nabo ngendaba yakho, okubaluleke kakhulu - nathi. Ingabe ukuba ilungu le-GEMS kusindisile impilo yakho noma kuthuthukise impilo yakho? Uhlelo lwe-GEMS manje lunikeza omama abakhulelwe ukufinyelela ezinzuzweni zokukhulelwa ze-GEMS. Lolu hlelo lwethulwe ngomhla kaMeyi 1, 2009, futhi lunikeza omama abakhulelwe ukwesekwa, imfundo, kanye nezinsiza kuzo zonke izigaba zokukhulelwa nangemva kokubeletha. Lolu hlelo lusebenza kanjani? Lolu hlelo luphathwa ngababheki bezempilo abanolwazi olunzulu lokubeletha. Lezi z nurses zizokweseka ngezinqubo zokubhalisela futhi zingaxhumana nanoma yisiphi isinyathelo sokukhulelwa kwakho ukuze zikweluleke ngendlela yokuphatha ukukhulelwa kwakho. Uzothola ibhukwana le-GEMS elikhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokukhulelwa, linikeza ulwazi olubalulekile kubomama abakhulelwe. Omama bathola isipho esincane kwi-GEMS! Lesi sipho sithunyelwa kubomama ezigabeni ezintathu zokukhulelwa. Uzothola ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo oluzokusiza ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nempilo yakho nokuxoxisana nodokotela wakho noma umama ophilayo. Uxhaso lwezocingo nolwazi lutholakala uma unenkinga ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuba ngumzali. Sicela uqaphele: Lolu hlelo lukhululekile kumalungu futhi izinzuzo ezijwayelekile zokukhulelwa zisasebenza. Lolu hlelo lunikeza izinzuzo eziningi ezibalulekile kumalungu kodwa alufanisi ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha nodokotela. Ngiyabhalela kanjani kulolu hlelo? Kungakanani isikhathi okufanele uhlole izinzuzo zakho kuhlelo lwakho lokwelashwa kwezokwelapha? Siyazi ukuthi lokhu kungaba kubalulekile futhi sithola kaningi kunzima ukuthola isixazululo? Kulula, thumela i-SMS ngemininingwane elandelayo kulolu nombolo: 33489 (i-SMS ibiza u-R1.50): Isinyathelo 1: Uhlobo lwezinzuzo Isinyathelo 2: Bhala inombolo yakho yokuba ilungu ye-GEMS Isinyathelo 3: Khetha inzuzo ofuna ukuyihlola ohlwini olungezansi (Qaphela: uhlu ngalunye luhlolwa nge-SMS eyodwa). Isinyathelo 4: Bhala usebenzisa ikhodi emfushane ethathwe ohlwini olungezansi. Isinyathelo 5: Faka ikhodi yakho yokuxhaswa (ungayithola kule khadi yakho yokuba ilungu ngaphansi kwe "igama," isibonelo, 00, 01, njll.). Uma ungumuntu ongumgibeli ophakeme, bhala "00". Isinyathelo 6: Cindezela "thumela" efoni yakho. Uma i-SMS yakho ingathunyelwa, uzothola impendulo evela ku-GEMS
Umthetho 108 ka-1996 ngokweSigaba 152 ubopha uhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuluma ukuthi 'uhulumeni bendawo' kumele 'ukhuthaze ukubamba iqhaza kwemiphakathi nezinhlelo zomphakathi ezindabeni zohulumeni bendawo'. Lokhu kulandela umthetho owenziwe uhulumeni bendawo othi 'ukwakha uhulumeni obumbene endaweni kubalulekile kuhlelo lokuphatha bendawo futhi izindawo zidinga ukudala izindlela nezindlela zokugcina zixhumana nezakhamuzi, abantu bezebhizinisi, nezinhlelo zomphakathi'. Izinsiza zokufundisa ezamukelekayo zingasetshenziswa ukuqeqesha abamele izigaba nezithunywa zezigaba. Imihlangano yokufunda ephumelelayo futhi ebamba iqhaza. Abamele izigaba nezithunywa zezigaba bayakuqonda kahle ukuthi bayini emisebenzini yabo. Ukuhlinzeka abamele izigaba nezithunywa zezigaba ngamandla okuxhumana nomphakathi ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezifanele. Ukusungulwa kwezindlela zokukala ezamukelekayo ukuze kukhombise umnikelo wokufundisa. Lo mbhalo uhlelwe ngendlela efanayo naleyo indlela leli khasi lihlelwe ngayo. Le mifanekiso igqamisa okubaluleke kakhulu. Lapho ulwazi lokuxhumana lunikezwa, uzobona le mifanekiso. Uzobona le mifanekiso lapho kukhona izibonelo. Le mifanekiso isetshenziswa lapho unikezwa amanye amathiphu, amasu, noma imicabango. Imininingwane ngayinye imele uhlobo oluhlukile lolwazi. IPhalamende leZokuphatha Bendawo nezeMvelo. Yiziphi izisho esizisebenzisayo uma sikhuluma ngalo mthetho ophumile? Yiziphi izinqubomgomo ezikhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Yiziphi izindawo ezibalulekile ezidinga ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza kanjani kuhulumeni bendawo? Lapho kuthuthukiswa ngendlela ethile, yiziphi izidingo zokuthuthukiswa, labo abathintekayo ukuze baqinisekise ukufakwa kwezindlela ezizokwenziwa baveza ukuthi banethuba lokufaka okubalulekile emphakathini. Kubalulekile kuhulumeni bendawo nabathintekayo ukwazi ukuthi badinga ini kubamele iPhalamende, nokuthi benza kanjani uma kufanele baveze. Kuhlinzeka uhulumeni bendawo ngolwazi ngezimo zaleyo ndawo, izidingo, izifiso, nezimo, futhi kusiza uhulumeni bendawo ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezinhle. Umthethosisekelo unikeza umqondo wezindlela ezahlukene zomthetho ezenza impilo ngendlela esiyazi ngayo ibe khona. Isiphakamiso esakhiwe ngesisekelo somthetho kanye nomthethosisekelo sikhombisa ezinye izidingo noma amalungelo. Umthetho onamandla noma ovunyelwe umthetho ususelwa esiphakamisweni. Lo mthetho uhlose ukuba namandla kulowo mthetho okhethiwe. Indlela ekhethiwe yokuxazulula izinkinga yamukelwa ngokomthetho ePhalamende. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwezixazululo ezivela kwiKhansela yesifunda nangemva kokuhlangana kweKhansela likamasipala, kwaphinde kwashicilelwa njengomgomo obizwa ngokuthi umthetho. Kukhona imithetho eminingi ekhuthaza isisekelo sokubamba iqhaza komphakathi kuhulumeni bendawo. Bangakhetha ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokwaziswa komphakathi ezingeni eliphezulu - lokhu kudinga ukuthi lezi zidingo zibe khona. Ukuthuthukiswa kufaka phakathi nokwakha ulwazi phakathi kwabantu nokubavumela ukuba basebenzise ubuhlakani babo. Yini ukuphepha kokuthuthukiswa? Kugxilwe emcabangweni kuhulumeni bendawo, ukuthi izindawo kufanele zakhe ubumbano obubambekayo futhi zikhuthaze ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwedemokhrasi kube yimpumelelo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi enqubo efanele yokuthuthukiswa kwamadolobha nezithiyo ezivele zenzeka. Ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kuncike ekuthuthukisweni kuhulumeni bendawo. Umthetho ophumelele uphinde wabona ukuvuselelwa kwamandla omphakathi njengempumelelo yokuthuthukiswa kuhulumeni bendawo. Umthetho ophumelele weBatho Pele ubeka izimiso zokuhola, ukuvela komsebenzi kubasebenzi bomphakathi. Phakathi kwezimpawu kukhona umqondo wokubonisana nomphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngesigaba esifanele somsebenzi namandla phakathi kwezinhlobo zamadolobha. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezifanele ezihlobene nokuvota. Izinhlobo A zamadolobha ezihlobene namadolobha amakhulu, zinezimfanelo ngaphandle kokuphatha nokwenza izinqubomgomo ezindaweni zazo. Izinqumo zezinqubomgomo ezihlobene nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Umthetho wokuphatha ukhombisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo, ukwenziwa, nezinqubo azikwazi ukwethula incazelo entsha kuhulumeni bendawo. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwamadolobha kufanele kwakhiwe futhi kukhuthazwe ngesisekelo somthetho sokunikeza amandla kumadolobha, phakathi kwezinye izinto. Kwenzela kube lula ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela nokuxhumana phakathi kwezakhiwo zabo zezombusazwe, iziphathimandla zezombusazwe, nabaphathi nomphakathi wendawo. Umthetho wokusebenza kwamadolobha uqhubeka uvimbela amalungelo nemisebenzi yomphakathi nohulumeni bendawo obamba iqhaza. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba ngentando yabantu nokuzinikela kuhulumeni. Umthetho wamadolobha umthetho wentela yendawo. Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokuphikisana nokudlulisela. Lezi yizinhlelo ezisemthethweni ezihlelwe ukuveza lokho okunikezwa. Izigaba zokubuyekeza noma izithakazelo zithinteka ekwenzeni imithetho. Lezi yizigaba zabantu abangabamele izigaba abahlangana ukuze baxoxe nganoma iyiphi indaba engavela kwiKhansela eyaziwa. Lokhu kuvame ukusetshenziswa ukusiza abamele izigaba ukwazisa umphakathi ngezizathu ezithathwe yiMasipala ezingase zithinte amalungelo nezinsiza zabo; futhi/noma ukubika ngesimo sezindaba zomphakathi. Ungacabanga ngezinye izindlela umphakathi ongabamba iqhaza ezindaweni zomphakathi? Bhala uhlu lwezindlela abantu abakwi ward yakho abangabamba iqhaza ezindabeni zohulumeni bendawo. Yini ikomidi lezigaba? Yiziphi izinqubomgomo ezibalulekile nezikhombisi ezikwi komidi lezigaba? Yini indima nemisebenzi yamakomidi ezigaba? Iziphi izikhathi abamele ikomidi lezigaba bakhethwa ngazo? Abamele ikomidi lezigaba bakhokhelwa kanjani? Umthethosisekelo uveza ukuthi kuphela amalungu eKhansela angavota. Abaholi bendabuko bangabamba iqhaza ezindabeni zohulumeni bendawo ngokuhlinzeka ngemibono, ukwenza izicelo, nokubuza imibuzo. Abaholi bendabuko noma labo abamele bona kumele bameleke kwi komidi lezigaba. IKhansela kumele inikeze isaziso esifanele sokuthi ifuna ukuhoxisa ikomidi. Nansi uhlu lwezindlela zomthetho nezikhombisi ezizodingeka ukuze wazi ukuthi wenzeni njengomunye wamalungu e komidi lezigaba. Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika umthetho 109 ka-1996 isahluko 7 isigaba 154 - izinhloso zohulumeni bendawo. Umthetho wokuphatha izinhlekelele 57 ka-2002. Zonke izindawo kumele zibe nohlelo lokuphatha izinhlekelele. Lo msebenzi manje uhlelwa ngamasipala esifunda. Ngesikhathi senhlekelele, kuvame ukuba nokudideka, ukungakholwa, anger, ingcindezi yengqondo, nokulahlekelwa ukulawula. Ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi kube nendlela ehlelekile futhi eqondile yokuphend
Yiziphi izincwadi ezifanele ukweseka umhlangano rasmi? Yiziphi izinqumo okufanele zilandwe amaqembu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umhlangano uphumelele? Yiziphi imithetho noma iziqondiso ezilawula ukuziphatha komhlangano? Yiziphi izisho ezisetshenziswe emhlanganweni? Ingabe bonke amalungu aziswe ngomhla womhlangano ngaphambi kwesikhathi? Ingabe bonke amalungu athola ithuba lokuphendula kuhlelo? Ingabe imizuzu yomhlangano odlule itholakala ngaphambi kosuku lomhlangano? Ingabe imizuzu yomhlangano odlule ifundwa futhi izichibiyelo eziphakanyisiwe zilandelwa? Ingabe izincwadi noma imiyalezo zilungile ukuze zethulwe? Ingabe kukhona amalungu abebezophawula ngezindaba ezithile? Ingabe bayazi ukuthi kufanele baphawule nini futhi isikhathi sokuphendula? Ingabe umhlangano uqale ngesikhathi esifanele? Ingabe isikhathi sahlolwa ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi bekucacile ukuthi umhlangano uzophela nini? Ingabe bonke amalungu athola ithuba lokuphendula futhi banikeze imibono yabo ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana? Ingabe kwaba nokuphetha kokuxoxisana njengoba umhlangano uqhubeka futhi lapho uphela? Ingabe abantu banikezwa imisebenzi noma izibopho ngesikhathi somhlangano? Ingabe uMongameli ubheke ukuthi labo abanikwe imisebenzi emhlanganweni odlule bayiqedile? Ingabe izinhlelo zenziwe ngezivakashi noma abakhulumi? Bonke amalungu afanele ukuhamba emhlanganweni kufanele athole isaziso somhlangano ngaphambi kwesikhathi ukuze azilungiselele. Kuyisiko ukuthi uMphakathi akhiphe isaziso. Usuku, isikhathi, nendawo yomhlangano kufanele kuhanjiswe. Lokhu kunika amalungu isikhathi sokulungiselela izingxoxo ekhaya. Kubonisa isihloko esizoxoxwa ngaso. Kusiza ekubhaleni imizuzu. Izixolelo, ukungabi khona, kanye noluhlu lwabo bonke abakhona kufanele kubhalwe phansi. Amagama kaMongameli noMphakathi abhalile imizuzu kufanele abhalwe. Imizuzu yomhlangano odlule kufanele ivunyelwe, kanye nanoma yiziphi izichibiyelo ezenziwe. Idokhumenti kufanele ifake konke okubalulekile okukhulunywe ngakho, kanye nezinqumo ezenziwe ngaleso sihloko. Yini okufanele yenziwe, ngubani, futhi nini. Usuku lomhlangano olandelayo. Ngabe ngingabhala umlando noma ulwazi olungemuva? Impendulo: Cha. Yini okufanele uthethe ngalesi sihloko esikhuluma ngaso? Awukwazi ukungena empikiswaneni mayelana nokubhala kulabo abanga khona emhlanganweni. Uma ubhala konke okukhulunywe, uzogcina ubhala incwadi encane esikhundleni semizuzu. Impendulo: Cha. Kuyisiko ukuthi imizuzu ibonise lokho okukhulunywe, hhayi ukuthi ubani okukhulumayo. Umbuzo: Yisiphi isimo okufanele ngisisebenzise? Umbuzo: Yisiphi isikhathi okufanele sisetshenziswe? Impendulo: Lalela umyalezo noma iphuzu bese ubhala ngendlela yakho. Ukubhala imizuzu kuyikhono elihilela ukuhumusha, hhayi nje ukubhala ngokushesha. Qaphela ukuthi ungenele bese uyisebenzisa, noma ulandele labo abakukhulumayo ngokucacile - lokhu kuzokwenza imizuzu ibe neqiniso. Kubalulekile ukuthi imizuzu ibhalwe ngendlela engathathi hlangothi, ibonisa ingxoxo njengoba ixoxiwe, hhayi ukuthi ikhulunywe kanjani. Bheka i-Appendix 9 - okuyisibonelo semizuzu. Nazi iziqondiso ezilungiselelwe ukusiza ikomidi lomphakathi, eliyisihlalo sekhansela lomphakathi ekulungiseleleni umhlangano wokuqala. Uma ikomidi lihlangene futhi likhethe uMphakathi, lowo muntu uzosiza ikhansela ekuphatheni isikhundla sikaMongameli. Uma ikhansela ingumuntu ohlelekile njengomongameli, ingakwazi ukuhlela ukwabiwa kwemisebenzi kwabanye amalungu ekomidi, ngaleyo ndlela iqinisekise ukuthi umhlangano uhamba kahle. Ubuye ubonise futhi uchaze indawo lapho ikomidi lizohlangana njalo. - Khumbula lokhu kufanele kube endaweni yomphakathi, hhayi emzini wangasese. Lokhu kusiza ngoba ikomidi lomphakathi lingahlela isikhathi saso salolo nyaka. Ingabe ulungiselele uhlelo lomhlangano ozayo? Ingabe ucabangele usuku lomhlangano wokuhlela unyaka (Bheka Isahluko 10)? Lezi zindawo zisiza ikhansela kanye nekhabhinethi ukuqonda nokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi. Khetha abantu bezikhundla - kufanele ube noMphakathi ukuze ubone ukuthi mhlawumbe udinga ibhajethi. Emhlanganweni wokuqala, amalungu ekomidi kufanele ahlanganyele lokho abafuna ukukufeza njengamalungu ekhabhinethi yomphakathi. Cela uMphakathi ukuthi akhe uhlu lokuthi amalungu angatholakala kanjani bese wonke amalungu ekomidi athola ikhophi. Bheka i-Appendix 12 ukuze uthole isibonelo sohlaka lwamalungu ekhabhinethi yomphakathi. Kungavunywa ukuthi imihlangano ibanjwe. Hlela umhlangano wokuhlela unyaka. Lokhu kungaba umhlangano ophuthumayo noma kumkhankaso olandelayo. Izikhundla ezifana nezokwakha, ezempilo, ezokwelashwa, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, nezinye. Ukuthatha imizuzu yazo zonke izihlanganiso kuyisibopho sikaMongameli kanye nekhabhinethi yomphakathi. Abantu babuyela emizuzwini ukuze bahlaziye izinqumo ezenziwe emhlanganweni. Nikeza isaziso somhlangano. Nika isaziso ngaleso sikhathi nendawo ngenkathi kusasele isikhathi. Njengoba kushiwo, uMphakathi uyena ophatha lokhu. UMongameli uzovula umhlangano futhi afunde uhlelo ngendlela. Kufanele abhale phansi bonke abakhona. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokuba ne-rekhodi noma uhlu lwabavakashi. Bheka i-Appendix 13 ukuze uthole isibonelo se-rekhodi yokuhamba. Izincwadi: lezi yizincwadi ezithunyelwa ekomidini noma lezo ezithunyelwa ngekomidi. Le dokhumenti kufanele yaziwe ekomidini ngoba ithunyelwa ngaphansi kwamandla awo. Omunye ummember kufanele ethule futhi aqale ingxoxo ngendaba ethile. Lokhu kungaba ukusiza ukucacisa iphuzu elivele lukhulunywe mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwe nokuthi yini esele. Khumbula ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi bonke amalungu ekomidi babambe iqhaza emhlanganweni. UMongameli akakwazi ukuhola umhlangano. Indima kaMongameli ukuhola umhlangano ngokuhambisana nohlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okudingekayo kuyafezeka. UMongameli ufana nomqondisi weqembu, hhayi umculi odlalayo yedwa. Zama ungabi yedwa okhuluma kakhulu kodwa lalela lokho abanye abakukhulumayo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abanakwe emuhlanganweni. Bhala phansi amaphuzu abalulekile ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana. Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlangano uqhubeka ngendlela ehlelekile, okusho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abakhulumi bayahlonishwa, abantu abakhohliwe ukuhleka noma ukukhuluma emhlanganweni. Zama ukuqeda umhlangano ngesikhathi. Ikomidi lomphakathi kufanele lenze izinqumo ngokuvumelana. Imithetho eqinile ingase ichaze ukuthi amaqembu omphakathi kufanele ahambele zonke izihlanganiso zawo, futhi ilungu eliphuthelwa izihlanganiso ezingaphezu kwezintathu ezilandelanayo lingase likhishwe ekomidini lomphakathi. Imithetho eqinile ingase iphinde ichaze ukuthi amalungu angabeka kanjani imibuzo emhlanganweni noma ukuthi bangakhuluma kangakanani ngendaba ethile. Ikomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo: Ikomidi elincane, lesikhashana elakhiwe ngqo ukuze lenze umsebenzi othile. Imithetho eqinile: Imithetho elawula le nhlangano ethile. Isiphakamiso
Kungani amaqembu omphakathi kufanele axhumane? Yiziphi iziteshi amaqembu omphakathi okufanele alandele uma exhumana? Kungani ukukhuluma emphakathini kubalulekile? Kungani imiphakathi kufanele ibhiyozwe ngoxhumano? Amaqembu omphakathi angadlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi imiphakathi inezwi ezinqumweni zohulumeni. Ukukhuluma kuyindlela elula futhi engajwayelekile yokuxhumana. Izinzuzo zalesi sikhathi ukuthi iyashesha futhi impendulo iyatholakala ngokushesha. Kodwa-ke, ububi balesi sikhathi ukuthi umyalezo ungaba nengqondo ngenxa yenani labantu, umsindo, njll. Okunye okukhulu ukuthi akukho okurekhodiwe ngalokho okukhulunywe, okungaholela ekuqondeni okungafanele. Ukulalela akufani nokuzwa. Ukulalela kuyinto esiyifundayo kulokho esikuzwayo - ukwenza lokhu kusho ukuzibandakanya ngokusebenzayo. Ezikhungweni, ukubhala kubalulekile. Abantu bangase bangakukhumbuli lokho okukhulunywe uma ukhuluma nabo ngaphandle kokubhala, njengoba kunobufakazi bomyalezo wakho. Izibonelo zokuxhumana okubhalwe zifaka phakathi izinkumbulo zomhlangano, izincwadi, imibhalo yezomthetho, imibiko ebhaliwe ngezihloko, amabhodi ezaziso, izincwadi zezindaba, izincwadi ezichazayo, njll. Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi u-35% wezincwadi zokuxhumana zivela kumyalezo okhuluma kanti u-65% uvela ekuxhumaneni okungathintwa. Lokhu kukhombisa ukubaluleka kokufunda ukuxhumana ngolimi lomzimba. Kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izinkomba zokuxhumana ezingezona ezokukhuluma zihambisane nomyalezo okhuluma. Uma umyalezo okhuluma kanye nokuxhumana okungathintwa kungahambisani, kungaholela ekuqondeni okungafanele. Ukuxhumana okungathintwa kufaka phakathi ithoni yakho yomsindo, ukuveza ubuso, izimpawu zezingalo, kanye nezinyathelo zomzimba. Imvelo yemvelo ezungezile ingathinta indlela ophakamisa ngayo umyalezo ocacile; ngokwesibonelo, uma ubamba umhlangano endaweni engcolile, engathokozisi, noma enomsindo, kungase kube kusho ukuthi awunandaba nabantu abazobe bekhona. Ukuxhumana okuhle kungasiza kunoma iyiphi imizamo yokufinyelela noma umsebenzi. Nokho, ukuxhumana kungase kungasebenzi kahle ngezizathu ezithile. Uma kukhona umuntu phambi kwephepha lolwazi, noma uma ulwazi olukhona kuphepha luncane futhi lungafundeki ukusuka kude. Uma abantu beshisa, bangase bangafuni ukulalela inkulumo ende. Abantu abadala bangazizwa bengakhululekile ukulalela abantu abasha noma amadoda elalela abesifazane. Uma umkhulumeli enganiki abantu ithuba lokubuza imibuzo noma ukwabelana ngemibono yabo, abantu bangase baphume uma kukhulunywa kakhulu. Kukhona izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwenza ukuxhumana kube nempumelelo. Bheka ngqo kubantu uma ukhuluma nabo. Qonda kahle ukuthi ulwazi olufunayo abantu bakuthole ngaphambi kokuxhumana. Unganiki ulwazi oluningi ngasikhathi sinye. Bamba imihlangano ngenkathi abantu besabambekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi akukho umsindo ophakeme ozophazamisa abantu. Nika abantu ithuba lokubuza imibuzo nokwabelana ngemibono yabo. Buza imibuzo futhi uthole imicabango yabantu ngalokho abakukhulumayo. Gwema ukuhlinzeka ngamanothi amade ngalokho okukhulunywe. Sebenzisa imisho emifushane, amagama alula, nezibonelo abantu abazokwazi ukuzithola. Sebenzisa izindlela ezifanele zokuxhumana ezimweni ezahlukene. Sebenzisa izithombe ukuze udlulisele imiyalezo ngokucacile, njengokudweba ibhili yezezimali noma imephu ukuze ubonise ukuthi ifundwa kanjani. Sebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene ngezikhathi ezahlukene ukuze udlulisele umyalezo ofanayo. Gxila ekuthumeleni umyalezo wakho - uma uqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayakuqonda lokho okukhuluma, ngeke ube nesikhathi sokukhathazeka. Enye imisebenzi ebalulekile yeqembu lomphakathi ukukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi. Inkinga enkulu ekubambeni iqhaza komphakathi ukuntuleka kolwazi emphakathini. Abantu bomphakathi bangase bangazi ngamaqembu omphakathi noma uhulumeni bendawo nokuthi baphathelene kanjani njengomphakathi ukuze bakhe ukuzibandakanya emphakathini. Ngakho-ke, ukuze kwakhiwe ukuzibandakanya komphakathi, amaqembu omphakathi kufanele enze umphakathi uqaphele. Ukuqonda nolwazi kungase kuvuselele, futhi iqembu lomphakathi kufanele libe nenhloso yokwakha amandla emphakathini walo. Ngesikhathi esingakanani leli ulwazi lungaxhumana emphakathini? Yini edingekayo uma uxhumana ngalolu lwazi emphakathini? Ngokuvamile, uhulumeni udala uhlelo lwakhe lokuxhumana. Yiziphi izinkinga onazo ezaziwa umphakathi wakho? Yiziphi izici ezinhle zokuhola kanye namakhono adingekayo? Yini umehluko phakathi komholi nomphathi? Yiziphi izici okufanele umholi omuhle abe nazo? Okwamanje, uhulumeni bendawo ukulesi sikhathi lapho ukuhola kubaluleke kakhulu kunanini ngaphambili. Izinga likahulumeni bendawo ukuze kushintshwe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo emiphakathini kuzoncika kakhulu ekwethembekeni kwethu abaholi. Amalungu eqembu lomphakathi angabanye abaholi abanye abazothola ukuthi kusemthethweni kwabo ukulethela ushintsho esimweni sokuhulumeni bendawo. Ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuzoncika kakhulu kumakhono okuhola amalungu eqembu lomphakathi. Ukuhola kuyithuluzi elingasiza iqembu lomphakathi ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa umsebenzi walo ngendlela efanele ukuze likwazi ukufezekisa amasu alo. Kungasiza futhi ukukhuphula izinga lokubophela empumelelweni yeqembu, umphakathi, nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Izinhlelo zivame ukuncika ku-IDP. Ukuze noma yiziphi izinhlelo ziphumelele, kubalulekile ukuba kube nomuntu ongahola iqembu nomphakathi. Ukuhola kusho futhi ukudlulisa ulwazi kubantu, ukuveza izifiso, amaphupho, imigomo, nezinhlelo zamaqembu omphakathi, nokuhlinzeka ngemicimbi nemiyalezo, nokuthatha noma yiziphi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufezwe izinhloso nokubandakanya umphakathi. Ngokomthetho, ukuhola kumaqembu omphakathi kusho ukufaka umoya nokuhola izenzo zabantu eqenjini lomphakathi nasemphakathini ngendlela ezobenza bazame ukufezekisa imigomo kaMasipala. Ukuphatha iqembu labantu akusho ukuthi unazo zonke izimpendulo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uneqembu labantu abazokusiza ukuthola izimpendulo nokufeza imiphumela edingekayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izikhathi eziningi abaholi basazithola bephazamisekile! Abaholi baphazamiseka ukuhola nokulawula futhi banciphise izwi labantu kanye neqembu abahlanganyela nalo, noma bathathe enye indlela egxile ezikhungweni nasezinhlelweni begqoka ubuntu. Ngaphezu kokuhlakanipha okujwayelekile, ukuhola akukhona ngodlame. Ukuhola kuhlanganisa amakhono okusebenzisana kanye nekhono lokwenza abantu bazame ukufezekisa umsebenzi okudingeka ukwenza. Lawa makhono angafundwa. Umshini wezokuphatha kufanele udluliswe ukuze izinhlelo zabaphathi bomsebenzi zenzeke. Ukuhola kubeka inhlangano emgqeni. Umthwalo omkhulu wamakhono ezingeni lonke lenhlangano ukuhola nokukhuthaza abantu emsebenzini wokufinyelela. Ukuhola kufanele kuphendule kumasu
Namuhla sikhona eNseleni ukuze sithintane nani ngezindlela esingazisebenzisa ukuvimbela izifo ezingasithinta lapho kungekho isidingo. Le mkhankaso esiyingxenye yayo namuhla ibonisa kahle ukuthi abaholi baleli zwe bayakhathazeka ngokuqhubeka kokwanda kwe-TB kuleli. Le mkhankaso, esayiyinayo ngaphambili endaweni yaseMsinga ekuqaleni konyaka, iyalandelwa nathi emzini ophakathi kweDolobha laseThekwini, futhi iphelile ezindaweni zemidlalo zedolobha laseMpumalanga eHammarsdale ekuqaleni kukaAugust. Masicacise ukuthi abahlali balendawo banjengama-130,000, futhi okwamanje, kuphela abangu-700 kubo abavakashele ezikhungweni zethu zokuhlolwa kwe-TB. Njengomnyango, sinezinkinga ezincane zokwelapha bonke laba bantu abathintekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abakhona lapha bazi futhi bakhumbuze labo abangaphumelelanga ukuthi ukuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwe-TB kwenziwa mahhala. Ukwelapha lowo muntu kusiphatha ngaphezu kuka-R24,000, futhi umuntu ophakathi kwalolu suku angase athole ukuthi uchitha isikhathi eside esibhedlela, kude namalungu omndeni wakhe. Lezi zimpawu zidinga ukuthi uphuthume uye esikhungweni sezempilo ngoba ungakwazi ukusiza empini yokulwa ne-TB. Labo abahlala nomuntu onayo, labo abangakwazi ukunakekela izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu, abantu abahlala ne-HIV, abantu abaphuza utshwala, abantu abasebenzisa imishanguzo, abantu abakhathazekile, kanye nalabo abahlala ezindaweni ezingaventilated kahle baphakathi kwezingozi eziphezulu. Labo abathatha ama-ARVs kufanele bazi ukuthi imishanguzo ye-TB ayithinti amaphilisi abo. Ukuhluka ukuthi ukwelashwa kwe-TB kuhlala izinyanga eziyisithupha kanti ama-ARVs athathwa impilo yakho yonke. Khumbula, ungathola ne-TB uma uhlala nomuntu onayo, futhi ungakwazi ukunakekela. Njengomnyango wezempilo, siyazi ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi udle ukudla okunempilo ukuze uhlale unempilo. Sazi futhi ukuthi awukwazi ukumelana nemishanguzo ngaphandle kokudla okuthile esiswini sakho, yingakho sabelana ngezikhwama zokudla kulabo abathintekayo. Umphakathi usisekela ngokuphelele njengoba siphinde siye emhlabeni; yingakho nginazo lezi zinsiza zokulima. Impilo kufanele isetshenziswe.
Ukusebenza kahle kweMisebenzi Eyinhloko Yezwe (SOEs) kubalulekile kunoma iyiphi uhulumeni ophumelelayo. Ukungaqiniseki nokukhula komnotho womhlaba, amandla emakethe, kanye nokungena kwemithombo yezezimali zomhlaba kudala izinselelo kuzo zonke iziphathimandla njengoba ziqinisa izinqubo zazo zokuthuthukisa umnotho. Ngakho-ke, sithathe isinqumo sokusebenzisa amandla kaHulumeni ezindaweni ezibalulekile zomnotho ukuze siqinisekise izinjongo ezizinzile. Imisebenzi kahulumeni kumele ibe nokuzinza futhi ibe nezimali ezizimele ukuze ihlangabezane nazo zonke izidingo zemakethe yezezimali kazwelonke nezamazwe omhlaba. Nakuba uhulumeni engase usize lezi zinkampani ngezimali ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwazo nakwezinye izimo kamuva, kumele zikwazi ukukhula ngezimali zazo kanye nemakethe yezezimali. Ukusebenza kahle kuyisici esibalulekile kakhulu kumabhizinisi kaHulumeni. Lokhu ukusebenza kahle kudinga izinga lokuphathwa, abasebenzi, kanye nobuchwepheshe obuhambisana nezindlela ezinhle kakhulu. Ngokubambisana, lezi zinkampani zikahulumeni zingadlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni ngokusebenzisa ukuzinza kwazo kwezezimali, abasebenzi, ucwaningo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa. Njengoba uhulumeni efuna ukuthuthukisa imali ethathwa kumadijithi e-diamond eNingizimu Afrika, i-Alexkor iyimoto yokufeza lokhu. Nokho, kunezindima ezimbili ezingeziwe ezidinga uku fulfilled futhi ezibalulekile ngezizathu zokuthuthukiswa. Eyokuqala, njengemoto yokuhweba, kufanele ibandakanye umphakathi waseRichtersveld ekuthuthukisweni kwayo. Okwesibili, okwenziwe muva nje kodwa kunenjongo ehlanganisiwe, ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokwakha kabusha izindawo zedijithi eNamaqualand. Nokho, ukungaqiniseki komhlaba kubeke i-Alexkor esimweni esinzima kwezezimali nasekusebenzeni. I-Infraco isunguliwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi sithuthukisa izinsiza zokuxhumana ezibalulekile. Akulula ukuncintisana nolwazi lwezezimali zomhlaba ngaphandle kokuba ne-bandwidth ephansi, ethembekile, futhi ethengiswayo. Kukhona amabhizinisi angase aqhubeke nokuba khona emnothweni wethu kodwa ngeke akwazi ngoba amanani ethu e-bandwidth yokuxhumana awakwazi ukuwathwala. Ukukhula komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika kube nokuphazamiseka ngenxa yokungatholakali nokubiza kakhulu kwe-bandwidth yokuxhumana. Manje, kukhona ukugxila okuqinile ekuphothuleni izidingo zezimali nokwakha kabusha amasu e-SAA, okuzokwenza i-SAA ithembele kakhulu ezimalini zayo. Nokho, ukuhoxiswa nokwakhiwa kabusha kwezinye izingxenye kungase kudingeke. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha uhlelo lwabasebenzi, ukubandakanya ozakwethu, nokususa imisebenzi engadingekile. Ukuxoxisana kokubonisana nezinyunyana kuqhubeka. Nakuba le nkampani inengxenye enkulu engu-30% embonini yokulima, manje isiphinde isiza kuphela ngo-2.5% emnothweni jikelele wemboni, kanye no-3.5% wokemployment. Ngakho-ke, ikhabhinethi ivumile ukuthi ingxenye esele yeSafcol, izinkanyezi zeKomatiland, kufanele ithengiswe. Ngonyaka ka-2006/07, ibhodi labaphathi lavuma uhlelo lwezimali lweminyaka emihlanu olufinyelela ku-R64.5 billion. Lolu hlelo lweminyaka emihlanu lwabuyekezwa ngonyaka ka-2007/08 futhi manje lufinyelele ku-R78 billion. Lolu hlelo lwezimali lwaluhloselwe ukuqinisa nokwandisa ukusebenza ngokwandisa amandla okukhiqiza izinsimbi ezihlanganisiwe namalahle, kuthuthukiswa izinsiza zephothi, nokwandisa iphayiphi elivela eThekwini liya eGoli. Njengamanje, sibambisene nebhodi ohlelweni lokwakha kabusha ukuze kube nokubambisana ekusebenzeni ezikhungweni ezintsha zokuthutha ezakhiwa njengamanje eNgqura, futhi sizokwenza isaziso esinemininingwane ngalesi sikhathi. Sidinga ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwezinto ezibalulekile, ngakho-ke indlela engcono yokufeza lokhu ukuqinisa amandla ethu. Nokho, umkhiqizo wethu kumele uhambisane nezindinganiso zamazwe omhlaba mayelana nenani nekhwalithi. Imizamo yokubambisana phakathi kwe-JPF, uMnyango Wezemfundo, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, kanye neziqu ezihambelanayo ze-SETAs ne-SOEs iqhubeka igxile ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha, ezikoleni, nakubantu abanemfundo abangase bakwazi ukuqedela ukuqeqeshwa kwabo emisebenzini kahulumeni ngaphambi kokuhlolwa ukuze bathole imisebenzi efanele.
Ngiyavuma ukuthi ngalesi sikhathi seseshini yesithathu ephelele yephalamende, okuyisikhathi esilandelayo kwesokugcina, ngifuna ukuveza izifiso zami zokuthi unyaka omusha ube nemfudumalo nempumelelo kubalulekile bephalamende. Ngiyethemba ukuthi unyaka ka-2008 uzoba ngempela unyaka wezimanga kuhulumeni wethu wenhlangano njengoba sisebenza ndawonye ukuze sifinyelele amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Ngiyasho lokhu ngoba, njengoba sibonile, akuvamile ukuthi isizwe sikhuthazwe ukuba sibe nomzamo omkhulu ukuze siqinisekise amaphupho abantu. Umlando usibeke kule ndawo. Ngikhuluma kini namuhla, Nkosikazi, umongameli wephalamende, phambi kwenina engangithanda, u-Epainette Mbeki, uMaMofokeng, oze lapha nomyalezo ocacile ovela kubantu bezindawo ezisemaphandleni zeTranskei lapho ehlala khona iminyaka eminingi. Uthi laba bantu bafuna ukuthi sibe nesibopho sokubatshela njengabaholi bethu ukuthi ngabe sizimisele yini ukwenza ikusasa libe ngcono kunanamuhla. Ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalombili ezedlule, ngomhla kaFebhuwari 16, umama uzogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lwe-92. Iphuzu elilodwa esingamnika lona ngosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa yilezi: iqiniso. Ngiyabonga kuye ngokunginika ithuba lokuba nani namuhla, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi ngeke simdumele. Bonke laba bamakhosikazi abahlonishwayo abamele imikhumbulo ngethemba, ngokuba khona kwabo basikhumbuza ukuthi umsebenzi wethu ufana nomjaho ohlanganyelwe ukuze sifinyelele amaphupho okuphila kahle kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngempela, laba bagibeli bamele ukuzimisela okungaguquki ezithakazelweni zabantu bethu futhi banikeza nenselelo yokuziphatha ngendlela engaphuli noma engaphazamiseli izifiso zabantu bethu. Sesisondele ekuqaleni konyaka wokugcina wezimali yephalamende lesithathu kuhulumeni wenhlangano, ngemuva kwalokho sizohamba siye kwi zinkanyezi zokhetho lwezizwe ezine. Uhulumeni ubuyekeze indima engaphathwa kahle mayelana nomsebenzi obekulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe kusukela ngo-2004. Ngiyajabula ukusho ukuthi sithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni izithembiso esazenzile kubantu ngo-2004. Nokho, kubonakala ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi osele. Njengoba sesisondele ekupheleni kwesikhathi esinikeziwe kithi, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokubeka phambili Imisebenzi Ebalulekile edingekayo ukuthi yenziwe, eyahlelwa ngokubaluleka, okuzoholelwa uhulumeni ukuze kufezwe izinhloso abantu abakulindele kuHulumeni. Ngiyabonga ngoba isitatimende sokuhlala kwesizwe sinikeze ithuba lokubika ephalamende nasemphakathini ngalezi zenzakalo eziyi-24 ezihlelwe ukuba ziphumelele ngaphambi kwezinye, okungatholakala kubalulekile bephalamende kuwebhusayithi kahulumeni ngesonto elizayo. Ukukhomba lezi Zenzakalo Ebalulekile ezidinga ukuba zenziwe ngaphambi kwezinye kusho ukuthi zonke izigaba zohulumeni, ezizweni, ezifundazweni, nasezindaweni, kukhabhinethi nasemphakathini zikhuthazwa ukuthi ngesikhathi esifushane esisele zizokwenza umzamo ukuze zifeze umgomo obalulekile wokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke. Bonke ohulumeni bazoqinisekisa ukuthi esikhathini esizayo bazozama ukuhlinzeka kuzo zonke izindawo - Inqubo Engajwayelekile. Lapho sikhuluma ngeNqubo Engajwayelekile, asisho ukuthi izinqubomgomo zohulumeni zishintshile, kodwa sisho ngesivinini sokuthi zizophumeleliswa, kanye namandla nempumelelo okuzophumeleliswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphila kwabantu ngokushesha. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka, sithatha izinyathelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umgomo oholayo wokuthi izimali zisetshenziswe minyaka yonke uzokhishwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali ngaphambi kokuphela kwale nyanga, okuvumela ukuba sifinyelele lezi zenzakalo ezidinga ukuba zenziwe ngaphambi kwezinye. Sizokhulisa ukuvumelanisa nezindawo ezibalulekile ngokubambisana namanye amazwe, sigxile ezindabeni zase-Afrika nasemibhalweni enezinhloso ezilungile. Isimo esibhekene naso nomsebenzi esizibophezele ukwenza sidinga ukusiza abantu ukuba bahlangane njengokuhlanganyela ukuze sifeze zonke izinto ezidinga ukuba zenziwe, singakhohlwa ukuthi sonke sithwala ikusasa lethu ezandleni zethu! Njengoba sonke sisebenza ndawonye lapha ezweni lethu, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lokhu kuhlobene - neNqubo Engajwayelekile! Ngesikhathi ngilungiselela le nkulumo, omunye wethu wakhuluma kimi ngombono wokuthi izwe lethu lihlushwa umoya onamandla okwenza kube nzima ukubona ukuthi izwe lethu lizoba kuphi kusasa. Kube nezikhathi ezinhle nezimbi, izikhathi zokuhlakanipha nezikhathi zokuphoxeka, izikhathi zokukholwa okuqinile, izikhathi zokumangala okuqinile, izikhathi zokukhanya, izikhathi zobumnyama, izikhathi zethemba, izikhathi zokuphoxeka; sasinakho konke phambi kwethu, sasinganakho konke phambi kwethu, sonke sasingaya ezulwini, sonke sasingaya kwenye indlela - ngokufingqa, isikhathi sasiwufana nalesi esikuso manje, kangangokuthi abaholi abakhuluma kakhulu bathi akufanele samukele lesi sikhathi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuzoba kuhle noma kubi uma sikala ngokuphambene nakho konke. Impendulo yami ithi: Yebo! Njengohulumeni, ngikholelwa ukuthi isisekelo esakhe eminyakeni engu-14 edlule siqinile. Kumele siqhubeke nokusebenza kulolu sizo ukuze siqhubeke phambili futhi siqedele amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Ngakho-ke, kumele sonke sikhuthaze ukuthi sisendleleni yokuphumelela njengomphakathi. Nokho, njengokubona bonke abahlonishwayo, kubonakala kimi ukuthi abaningi emphakathini bayakhathazeka, bengenathemba lokuthi izwe lizoba kuphi kusasa. Bakhathazekile ngalokho okwenzeka emnothweni wethu, ikakhulukazi ukukhula kokwenyuka kwezindleko, ukudla, nezindleko zokuthenga uphethiloli, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abampofu ukuba baphile. Abanye bethu bakhathazekile ngalokho okuzokwenzeka emnothweni wethu uma ukwenyuka kwezindleko kuqhubeka (lesi yisikhathi lapho amandla omnotho ehla kakhulu, futhi umnotho ungase ungakhuli). Bakhathazekile ukuthi ngabe sinesikhala sokuvikela amalungelo obumbano, nomthetho wesichibiyelo osunguliwe ngokuzibophezela kwabantu abaningi ngezimpilo zabo. Lokhu kukhuthazwa ngezinkinga ezifana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabaphathi bamaphoyisa, ukuvalelwa komqondisi-jikelele ehhovisi lokuphikisa, ukwesaba ukuthi abahluleli abanaso isikhala sokwenza izinqumo ngokuzimela nokuphula umthetho, nokuthi abantu basebenzisa amandla omphakathi ukuze balwe nezimpi zabo zezombusazwe. Bayazi futhi bahlonipha ilungelo leqembu elibusayo lokwenza izinto ngendlela yabo, kodwa bafuna leli qembu liqhubeke nokudlala indima yalo njengelakhe elasungulwa nguNingizimu Afrika ophumelele ophathiswe ngenhloso yabantu, engahlukanisi ngohlanga noma ngobufazi. Kubonakala ukuthi asifanele sithathe lezi zinkinga kalula noma sizithathe njengabaprofethi abashumayela ukuwaph
Ukuphathwa kwemali okulindelekile, ngokwezimvo ezithile, unyaka nonyaka kulolu hlelo lwezimali oluhlelwe isikhathi esithile, kuhlukanisa imali etholakalayo naleyo esetshenziswe ngaleso sikhathi. Ungangitshela ngezinto ezibalulekile kuwe. Ngikhombise lapho uchitha khona imali yakho, bese ngikutshela ukuthi lezo zinto zingobani. Namuhla, sizobonisa amalungu anhloniphekile lapho sihlose ukusebenzisa khona imali yethu, bese usitshela ukuthi lokhu kuhambisana nezinto ezibalulekile esifundazweni sethu. Kodwa khumbula, "Imali iyinsiza kuphela. Ingakuthola lapho ofuna ukuya khona, kodwa ayikwazi ukuthatha indawo yakho njengomshayeli." Noma, ngamagama kaMadiba wethu othandekayo, "Imali ayikwazi ukudala impumelelo; kuyilungelo lokudala elizokwenza." Unyaka ka-2010 unyaka lapho sizokwenza izinto ngendlela ehlukile. Indlela entsha yokwenza izinto ibonisa umbono wethu wezwe lethu nesifunda sethu futhi iboniswa kahle ngama-12 imiphumela. Uhulumeni waseKwaZulu-Natal wenza lokhu ngokwethembeka, ngokushesha, nangokuzikhandla. Ukuze sifinyelele umbono wethu ophakathi kwalezi zimpumelelo, isifunda sihlinzeke ngohlelo lokuqoqa idatha oluholwa ihhovisi lePhini. Lolu hlelo lwenziwa ngokuhola abantu abazithandayo. Basebenza ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze benze ucwaningo futhi babhale izidingo zomphakathi wethu behamba emakhaya. Idatha ephelele yeziqalo izosivumela ukuthi sibone amazinga obubha, isimo sempilo, kanye nezinga lemfundo emphakathini.
