Lokhu kuzohlinzeka isifunda ngemininingwane eyanele ukuze kuqhamuke nezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo ezizoba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu bethu. Izindleko ezihambisana nokuhola abantu abazithandayo abaningi ukuze benze ucwaningo lwezindlu emiphakathini ziyaqoqwa, ngakho-ke imali yalolu hlelo izotholakala uma isabelomali sithathwa sika-2010/11. Okwamanje, iminyango kahulumeni ephethe lolu hlelo kufanele isebenzise imali etholakalayo ukuze iqhube lezi zinhlelo. Izinto ezibalulekile esifundeni ukuze sifinyelele lezi zimpumelelo eziyi-12 zisazothola ukwesekwa, futhi ozakwethu, oNgqongqoshe, bazochaza lokhu uma beveza izabelomali zabo. Ukwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuhlalisana kahle nokuziphatha okuhle emphakathini. Isimo somnotho esingesihle samanje sikhulise imibuzo mayelana nokuziphatha nokubaluleka, futhi kukhona umuzwa oqinile wokuthi umhlaba udinga umqondo omusha wezomnotho ozosibonisa intuthuko. Kumele sifunde eziphuthumayo esizenzile kanye nezokwenziwa emhlabeni jikelele. Sizokwenza le mkhankaso ngombhalo othi YENZA OKUNGEKHO KAHLE NGOKUNCANE. Asizukwehlisa izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu, kodwa sizogxila ekusebenzeni ngokuzikhandla, ngokucophelela, nangokuhlakanipha ukuze siphumelele kulolu simo somnotho esingesihle. Nokho, namuhla sihlangana emoyeni wokubheka impumelelo. Umnotho wethu awuhambi kahle njengamanje. Empeleni, sikhula ngesilinganiso esiphezulu kunalokho okulindelekile ngenxa yesinqubomgomo sethu somnotho. Njengoba unyaka odlule sahlulelwa ukuba ngu-15 emncintiswaneni wezomnotho emhlabeni, iNingizimu Afrika manje ibalwa ku-6 phakathi kwezizwe eziyi-133 "ngokubonga ukusebenza kahle kwamabhange." Umnotho womhlaba ukhula ngesivinini esikhulu kunalokho okwakucatshangwa ngaphambili. Njengoba umnotho womhlaba uzinzile kusukela ekwehlisweni komnotho kuka-2009, iMali Yomhlaba (IMF) iphoqelekile ukuba ibuyekeze ukubikezela kwayo kokukhula komnotho phezulu kuya ku-3.9% kulonyaka no-4.3% ku-2011. ENingizimu Afrika, iNhlangano Yezimali Yezwe ibikezela ukukhula kwe-GDP yangempela okungu-2.3% ku-2010 no-3.2% ku-2011. Ukubuyela ezingeni lokukhula elingu-5% nangaphezulu minyaka yonke kuzodinga ukuthi sisebenze kanzima. Sidinga ukuqinisa imizamo yethu, ikakhulukazi ekubandakanyeni intsha emnothweni, ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, nakubantu abaphucukile. Nokho, ngenkathi sinesithakazelo, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi asikaphumi emathafeni. Ngaphandle kokukhula komnotho okwenzeka esigabeni sokugcina sika-2009, kokubili umnotho wesizwe kanye nowesifunda kube nokuqina unyaka nonyaka. Ukwanda kwe-25% kwemali yokukhanyisa ngama-Eskom kuncane kunalokho okwakuphakanyisiwe. Imiphumela yale ngqungquthela yezomnotho ibalulekile futhi ihluke-hluke. Kube nentuthuko enkulu ekukhuleni komnotho nasezikhathini zomsebenzi kusukela ngo-2001-2008. I-International Labour Organization ibika ukuthi abantu abalinganiselwa ku-34 million balahlekelwe yimisebenzi emhlabeni jikelele ezinyangeni ezingu-18 ezedlule. IBhange Lomhlaba libikezela ukuthi abantu abangu-200 million bangase baphume emnothweni ngenxa yale ngqungquthela yezomnotho. ENingizimu Afrika, abantu abangu-870,000 balahlekelwe yimisebenzi, baqala le ngqungquthela. Esifundeni saseKwaZulu-Natal, abantu abangu-220,000 balahlekelwe yimisebenzi ngenyanga yesine ka-2009. Ngempela, lezi zimpumelelo ezimbi zivame ukuhlasela kakhulu labo abalready bephucukile. Ngokuvamile, ithinta intsha nabesifazane, abenza ingxenye enkulu yokuhlala okuphucukile. Lezi zibalo eziphansi zisihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokungabi nemisebenzi ngokwenhlangano yobudala. Kucacile ukuthi kumele sigxile kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba emisebenzi entsha. Uhulumeni unendlela ephindwe kabili yokubhekana nale nkinga - isixazululo sesikhashana esizobhekana nalabo abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi ngenxa ye ngqungquthela yezomnotho njengoba kuboniswe emgqeni wesivumelwano, bese kuba nezinhlelo ezizobhekana nalabo abangasebenzi nabantu abashiywe emuva ekufuneni umsebenzi. Ngalesi sizathu, ngifuna ukuphinda ngiphinde ngikhumbuze ngokubiza kwePhini okwenziwe ngesikhathi sikhuluma esifundeni sokuthi izinkampani kumele zithole ithuba lokuhola uhlelo lokuqeqesha oluhlinzekiwe. Ukwehla komnotho nakho kuyazwakala ezimali zikahulumeni. Ukuqoqwa kwemali ezingeni lesizwe akuzange kusebenze kahle ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2009/10, kwehla ngaphezu kwe-R69 billion. Kulindeleke ukuthi le ndlela izoqhubeka ngisho nasekukhuleni kwezezimali ka-2010/11 ngenxa yokwehla kokuhola kwemali. Ngenkathi iNingizimu Afrika ikwazile ukugcina igama elihle "lokuba namabhange asebenza kahle" ekubolekeni ngemali enenzuzo ephansi, sonke siyazi ukuthi imali iyimpahla ebizayo, futhi kumele siqaphele ukuthi singazifaka kanjani ezikweletini. Ngokuvamile, amazwe abolekayo kakhulu (iJapane, iGreece, ne-Italy) kulindeleke ukuthi akhule umnotho wawo kancane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kunamazwe anokweleta okuncane (iChina neChile). Ukwanda kwezinga lokubolekwa kwemali kuholele ekwandeni okukhulu kwezikweletu zesizwe, okwenza kube nom
INingizimu Afrika inezibopho zomhlaba ngaphansi kwezivumelwano ezibophezela kanye nemithetho elawula amalungelo abantu emhlabeni ekwenzeni amalungelo abantu aphakamisa ukufana futhi avimbela ukwehlukaniswa okungafanele. Lezi zibopho zifaka phakathi imiyalelo yeSivumelwano Sokukhansela Zonke Izinhlobo Zokwehlukaniswa Ngobuhlanga kanye neSivumelwano Sokukhansela Zonke Izinhlobo Zokwehlukaniswa Kwabesifazane, phakathi kokunye. Ukukhona kokwehlukaniswa okwenziwayo nokungafani, ikakhulukazi mayelana nobuhlanga, ubulili, kanye nokukhubazeka kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphila ngenxa yokwehlukaniswa okungafanele okwenzeka kokubili okwamanje nangokhistorical okwenziwa ngababusi ababephatha leli zwe bevela kwamanye amazwe, uhlelo lwe-apartheid kanye nesakhiwo sokuphatha esingabantu; kanye nesidingo sokuthatha izinyathelo kuzo zonke izigaba ukuze kususwe lezi zihlukaniso nokungafani. Le mthetho ibopha uhulumeni nabantu bonke. Le mthetho ayisebenzi kumuntu noma kunoma iyiphi indlela lapho iMthetho Wokulingana Emsebenzini, 1998 (Umthetho 55 ka-1998), isebenza kubo. Ngaphandle kokuthi uhulumeni noma yimuphi umuntu angakwenza lokho okungafanele kumuntu. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvinjwa kokufinyelela emathubeni, kufaka phakathi ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo noma amathuba okuthola izinkontileka zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhokhelwayo. Kukho ukungafani okwenziwayo ekufinyeleleni amathuba kwabesifazane ngenxa yokwabiwa kwemisebenzi okwenziwa ngokobulili. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuphoxisa izithiyo ezivimbela noma ezivimbela abantu abakhubazekile ekuthokoziseni amathuba alinganayo noma ukuphoxisa izinyathelo ezifanele zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu abanjalo. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni kube nokungathandi noma kukhuthaze ukungathandi. Ngaphandle kokulimaza noma yimaphi amakhambi nganoma iyiphi indlela yokwephula umthetho ngaphansi kwalemthetho, inkantolo, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 21(a) futhi lapho kufanele, ingathumela kumqondisi wezokuphikiswa noma yisiphi isimo esihlobene nokwaziswa, ukukhuthazwa, ukubamba iqhaza, noma ukuveza ukukhuluma okungathandi njengoba kuboniswe esigabeni, ukuze kuqale icala lokukhuluma okungathandi njengoba kuqondiswe nguMthethosisekelo, noma umthetho ofanele. Akekho ongafaka noma iyiphi indlela yokuhlukumeza kumuntu. Noma ubani angakwazi ukwazisa noma ukukhombisa noma iyiphi isikhangiso/ukuphakanyiswa noma isaziso, esingahunyushwa noma siqondwe njengokuba nenhloso ecacile yokwehlukanisa kumuntu: Kucatshangwa ukuthi ukungena emsebenzini wokwakha/ukwakha, ukucwaninga okukhuluma ngezindaba zesayensi, ukuveza kahle ngezindaba zomphakathi, noma ukuhlinzeka nganoma yiluphi ulwazi, isikhangiso/ukuphakanyiswa, noma isaziso ngokuhambisana nesigaba 16 seMthethosisekelo, akuvinjelwe yilesi sigaba. Uma enye noma eziningi zezimo ezibekwe esigabeni (b) sokuchazwa "izizathu ezivinjelwe" ziqiniswa; futhi ngaphandle kokuthi ophendulayo uqinisekise ukuthi ukwehlukaniswa akukhona okungafanele. Akukona ukwehlukaniswa okungafanele ukuthatha izinyathelo ezihlosiwe zokuvikela noma ukuphakamisa abantu noma amaqembu abantu abathintekile kabi ukwehlukaniswa okungafanele kanye/noma amalungu alezi ziqephu noma izigaba zabantu. Noma ukwehlukaniswa okuhlukanisayo kahle noma okuvunyelwe umthetho phakathi kwabantu ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezingase zingathonywa yisiphi esinye isizathu, esidingekayo kulokhu. Ngokuqondene nokukhuluma okungathandi nokuhlukumeza, isigaba 14 asisebenzi. Zonke Izinkantolo Eziphezulu zingamakantolo okulingana kulawa maphuzu ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwazo. Zingashintsha noma zikhansela noma iyiphi isaziso esikhishwe ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba. Umphakathi ophakanyisiwe esigabeni (c) kumele abhale incwadi uma ethatha umuntu noma abantu abaningana, abazobhekelela inkantolo yokulingana, futhi ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba 2. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuphela labo abathathwe njengokuchazwe esigabeni abangathatha zonke izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okungenani umuntu oyedwa ubhekelela inkantolo yokulingana endaweni ababephatha; futhi azise uMqondisi-Jikelele ngokushesha uma kukhona umgibeli, umphakathi, noma umphakathi owengeziwe ophakanyisiwe ukuze aqedele icala njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 31 noma noma yisiphi ophakanyisiwe ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba. Labo abaphethe ukuqeqeshwa okukhulunywe esigabeni 31 noma labo abaphakanyisiwe ukuba baphathe inkantolo yokulingana njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni. Umuntu ophakanyisiwe ukuba abhekele inkantolo yokulingana kumele enze imisebenzi futhi angasebenzisa amandla anikezwe yilomthetho noma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Abaphathi bezinkantolo zokulingana kanye noMqondisi-Jikelele weMnyango, ophathe izinhlinzeko zesigaba 2 kanye nemithetho elawula ukusebenza kweminyango kahulumeni, bangaphakanyisa umuntu noma abantu abaningana kulowo Mnyango, noma bangaphakanyisa umuntu noma abantu abaningana ngendlela ethile, abazoba abaphathi benkantolo yokulingana ukuze basize le nkantolo ukuba yenze imisebenzi yayo ebekwe. Ngaphambi kokuthi izinhlinzeko zesigaba 31 zisebenze; noma njengoba kubekwe esigabeni 31, futhi uma igama labo likhombisa ohlwini olukhulunywe esigabeni, abavunyelwe ukuphakanyiswa njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni (a). UMqondisi-Jikelele unelungelo lokudlulisela imisebenzi ethile noma amandla ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba kunoma iyiphi enye umsebenzi weMnyango ngaphansi kwezimo ezizobekwa ngu yena, kodwa lokhu akukhiphi izikhala zakhe zamandla anikezwe yilokhu, futhi unelungelo lokushintsha noma ukukhansela noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe ngalowo msebenzi ekusebenzeni kwalezi zikhala. Ukukhona kwabafakazi kanye nezinkokhelo zabafakazi ezimweni ezivela ekusebenzeni kwalomthetho kuzokwenziwa nguNgqongqoshe ngendlela ethile. Futhi isikhundla somthetho, ngokuhambisana nesigaba futhi njengoba kungekho enye imithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zesigaba 30 yalomthetho. Zonke izimo phambi kwenkantolo kumele ziqhutshelwe enkantolo evulekile, ngaphandle kokuthi inkantolo ingaqondisa ngokuhlukile ngenxa yemvelo yokuphathwa kobulungiswa. Ukusebenza kwesigaba (a), okuhlobene nokukhulisa umyalo, kuvinjelwe kuze kube yilapho noma yisiphi ukudluliswa okukhulunywe esigabeni 23 kuqedwa. Umuntu ofuna ukufaka isikhalazo njengoba kuchazwe ngalokhu noma ngaphansi kwalomthetho kumele azise umphakathi wenkantolo yokulingana, ngenhloso yokwenza lokhu, ngendlela ethile. Lokhu kuthathwa njengenkantolo ehlukile ngempumelelo yokuphatha kahle udaba njengoba kuchazwe ngamandla nemisebenzi yale nkantolo ehlukile. Uma umphakathi ophakanyisiwe unquma ukuthi udaba luzophenywa enkantolo yokulingana, umphakathi ophakanyisiwe kumele athumele udaba kumaphathi benkantolo yokulingana abathintekayo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe salokhu kuthunyelwa futhi
Noma ubani ngaphandle kwezinkampani nemibutho ebhaliswe ngokomthetho. Umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 kumele asizwe ngabayeni babo noma umgibeli wezomthetho. Ubani ongabizwa enkantolo? Ngaphandle kukahulumeni, noma ubani angabizwa enkantolo kuhlanganise nezinkampani, imibutho, izindawo zokuhlala, kanye nanoma yini enye esebenza endaweni ephethwe yilowo msebenzi. Ingakanani engenziwa? Uma isicelo sakho sidlula u-R7000, ungathumela izicelo zendawo eziphansi kwalokho ukuze isicelo sakho samukelwe enkantolo yeziqephu ezincane. Izicelo eziphezulu kuka-R7000. Izicelo ezibhekiswe kuhulumeni. Izicelo ezihlobene nesimo sengqondo somuntu. Izicelo ezicela isenzo esithile esingavumeli ukuxhaswa, ngaphandle kwezimo ezihilela ukudluliswa kwezinsiza noma impahla ezinzile noma ezihambayo ezidlula u-R7000 ngenani. Ingabe udinga ukuvusa icala enkantolo yeziqephu ezincane? Cha, ungakhetha ukuvusa icala enkantolo yeziqephu ezincane noma nganoma iyiphi enye inkantolo engathola icala lakho. Ukuthola ummeli kanye nosizo lwabo ekulungiseleleni isicelo. Awuvunyelwe ukuthi umeleke ngumemeli ojwayelekile noma omkhulu. Nokho, ngezindleko zakho, ungacela iseluleko kumemeli ngaphambi kokuthi uqale. Kufanele uhlele kusenesikhathi nomlobi wenkantolo ukuze uthole umhumushi uma ubufakazi buyethulwa ngolimi olungaqondakali kahle komunye wabantu abathintekayo. Wazisa umphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa nesicelo somthetho) noma ngokuqondile, ngefoni, noma ngobufakazi, ucelwa ukuba ahlangabezane nezicelo zakho. Uma umphikisi engaphenduli isicelo sakho, bhalela incwadi yokucela (echaza zonke izimo zaleso sicelo, kuhlanganise nenani lezicelo zakho) umnikeze izinsuku eziyi-14 kusukela ngosuku athola ngalo incwadi yokucela ukuze ahlangabezane nezicelo zakho. Thumela incwadi yokucela ngesandla noma ngeposi elibhalisiwe kumphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa nesicelo somthetho). Noma iyiphi incwadi yokuvumelana noma ukuqinisekisa izimo zezicelo zakho. Igama eliphelele kanye nekheli (ikheli lasekhaya, nekheli lempilo, uma kusebenza) kanye nenombolo yefoni yomphikisi. Bona kanye nosizo lwabo lwezomthetho bazobuyekeza imibhalo onayo futhi bakusize ubhale isikhumbuzo esilula. Bazobhala isikhumbuzo futhi bakunikeze sona. Ungakwazi ukusithumela isikhumbuzo kumphikisi. Ungakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngesikhumbuzo kumphakathi (umphakathi wezokuphepha) lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, ukuze amapolisa akwazi ukusithumela kumphikisi. Yini okufanele uyenze ngokulandelayo? Gcina incwadi yokuvumelana noma noma iyiphi incwadi eqinisekisa izimo zesikhumbuzo osithumelayo. Wazisa abafakazeli bakho ngomhla nesikhathi sokulalelwa kwecala futhi uhlele ukuba babe khona enkantolo ngaleso sikhathi esishiwo. Bangasiza ekuhlangabezaneni nezicelo zomfakazi. Bangathumela isitatimende esibhaliwe kumlobi wenkantolo, esiqukethe imininingwane nezimo zokuzivikela kwabo, bese bethumela kopi kumfakazi. Bangakwazi futhi ukufaka izicelo zabo ngokuphikisa kumfakazi ngokuletha isitatimende esiqukethe imininingwane edingekayo yesikhumbuzo kumlobi wenkantolo. Uma kuvela isicelo sokuphikisa noma izicelo, icala kufanele siqhubeke nokulalelwa. Yini okufanele uyenze uma umphikisi ehambisile nezicelo zakho? Wazise ngokushesha umlobi wenkantolo ukuthi izicelo zakho zihlangabezile futhi ukuthi ngeke uqhubeke nalesi cala. Yini okufanele uyenze ngosuku nesikhathi sokulalelwa kwecala? Kufanele ube khona enkantolo uqobo. Inqubo yokulalelwa kwecala ayinacala futhi ilula. Awuvunyelwe ukufaka imibuzo phakathi komfakazi nomphikisi. Nokho, ngemvume yeKomishini, ungabeka imibuzo embalwa kumphikisi. Lapho iKomishini isizwile lokho okukhuluma wena nomphikisi kanye nanoma yiziphi izifakazelo ezikhona, inkantolo izokhipha isinqumo. IKomishini ingase ibonise ukuthi izokwazi ukukwazisa ngombiko wabo ngobufakazi kamuva. Ukuphathwa kwecala kubalulekile kakhulu. Isinqumo senkantolo siyi-final, ngaphandle kokuba kube nesizathu esamukelekayo sokuphikisa. Uzoba nesibopho sokukhokha noma yiziphi izindleko ezibekwe yinkantolo. Izindleko ezingase zibe khona yilezo ezingenzeka kumfakazi ngokukhokha umphakathi. Landela isinqumo senkantolo. Umphikisi uzokhokha inani lesinqumo kuwe ngokushesha, uma enalo. Mnika ithikithi lelo nani ngokushesha. Uma umphikisi engakwazi ukuhambisana nesinqumo senkantolo ngaleso sikhathi, inkantolo izobuza ngesimo sabo sezezimali nokuthi bangakukhokhela yini mayelana nesinqumo nezindleko futhi izokhipha isinqumo ngalokho. Uma umuntu otholwe enecala ehluleka ukuhambisana nesinqumo noma isinqumo senkantolo yeziqephu ezincane futhi ufuna ukuqinisa leso siqumo, icala lizodluliselwa enkantolo yamaMagistrate, futhi lizolalelwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho WamaMagistrate, 1944 (Umthetho 32 wango-1944). Kunconywa ukuthola ummeli mayelana nokulalelwa kwalesi cala. Le pamphlet ikwazisa kuphela ngezinyathelo ezibalulekile okufanele zilandelwe mayelana nokufaka isicelo enkantolo yeziqephu ezincane. Uma udinga noma iyiphi usizo nganoma iyiphi indaba, ikheli nenombolo yefoni yomlobi wenkantolo yeziqephu ezincane zitholakala enkantolo yamaMagistrate endaweni yakho.
Umthetho Wokwandisa Amaphoyisa, ogxile kulabo ababe yizisulu zobugebengu, uwumqulu wolwazi obhalwe ukuze uchaze amalungelo akho njengokunjalo mayelana nenqubomgomo ethinta izisulu zobugebengu eNingizimu Afrika, ukuze lawa malungelo akwaziwa. Inqubomgomo ethinta izisulu zobugebengu, kanye nemithetho yokwandisa, ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebanzi ethinta ukuzibophezela kuk governo ekuthuthukiseni izinga losizo kulabo ababe yizisulu zobugebengu. Umthetho wokwandisa uhlose ukuchaza umnikelo okumele wenziwe ukusiza labo ababe yizisulu zobugebengu. Umthetho wokwandisa awugxili kuphela ekugcineni amalungelo nezimiso, kodwa futhi uhlinzeka ngemininingwane ejulile ezokusiza uqonde ukuthi ungawasebenzisa kanjani amalungelo akho futhi usize labo abathintekayo kulo msebenzi ukuze balandele kahle izimiso zamalungelo ezisulu njengoba kuchaziwe enqubomgomeni, ngokucacisa izimiso okufanele zilandelwe yilabo abathintekayo kulo msebenzi. Uma ubika ubugebengu futhi uhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo, unendima ebalulekile ekusizeni umnyango wezobulungiswa ukuze ubhekane nezidingo zomphakathi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abasolwa babhekana nemiphumela yezenzo zabo. Ngemuva kwalokho, umnyango wezobulungiswa kumele uphendule kuwe ngokushesha nangokuhlonipha ukuze uhambisane nezidingo zakho. Izimiso ezibekwe zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngokukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo akho agcinwa. Izimiso ezibekwe zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukuhlola ukuthi umsebenzi uhamba kahle ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibekwe uma kuqhathaniswa nokuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kanjani. Izikhungo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezizathu, iminyango ethile, izobheka ukusetyenziswa kwamalungelo nokuthi kusebenza kanjani njengoba kuchaziwe ezimisweni ezibekwe, futhi, njengengxenye yokubheka nokubonisana, lezi zinhlangano zingase zixhumane nawe. Omunye wemiphumela yokubheka nokubonisana kungase kukhishwe. Izinhlelo ezitholakala ezimisweni ezibekwe zikhuluma ngazo zonke izisulu ngaphandle kokukhetha, ngaphandle kokwehlukanisa nganoma iyiphi indlela ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ukujula kokuthandana, ukukhulelwa, isimo sokushada, imvelaphi yakho, umbala, ubulili obukhethwe, ubudala, ukungakwazi, umqondo, loyalty, ukholo, isiko, ulimi, nendawo yokuzalwa, njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 9 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (UMTHETHO 108 ka-1996). Uma umuntu ebanjwa, icala lidluliselwa enkantolo lapho umphakathi uzokwenza imisebenzi yabo yokudlulisa icala. Umphakathi uzohlola ngokucophelela imininingwane yecala. Umphakathi angakwenza okukodwa kwezinto ezintathu: Bangakhetha ukuthi kukhona ubufakazi obanele ukuze baqhubeke nokudlulisa icala. Bangakhetha ukuthi kudingeka olunye ulwazi ukuze benze isinqumo esifanele bese beqondisa umphenyi ukuthi aqhubeke efuna ubufakazi. Ngenxa yezizathu ezithile, njengentshisekelo yomphakathi, bangakhetha ukuwuphonsa icala. Ungalindela ukuthi umphakathi uzofuna ulwazi olufanele ukuze uthole inqubekelaphambili ekuphenyweni futhi uluhlonze enkantolo, uqinisekise ukuthi isinqumo sokuvumela noma sokwenqaba ukugcina umsolwa sithathwa sikhumbula izifiso zakho nemizwa yakho. Ngaphambi kokwamukela imvume yakho yokuthi ubekwe phansi, umphakathi uzocabangela izidingo zakho nezomndeni wakho. Amaphoyisa azokwazi ukukwazisa uma kudingeka ubonakale enkantolo. Izigameko eziningi zizwa enkantolo ye-magistrate, kanti lezo ezinzima kakhulu ziya enkantolo ephezulu. Ukufaka icala enkantolo kungaba nzima, ikakhulukazi uma kuhlobene nabantu abaningi. Labo abathintekayo kuleli cala bazokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze kuze kucace enkantolo ngokushesha okukhulu. Ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo kungaba yinkinga. Uma uthinteka, amapolisa, abaphakanyisi, nabasebenzi bekhaya bazokwazi ukukwazisa, bakulungele, futhi bakuhlinzeke ngemininingwane yonke mayelana nalokho okungenzeka. Uma ufika enkantolo, ungathola izimpawu ezizokwenza ukwazi indlela yakho. Uma lezi zimpawu zingacacile futhi ungazi ukuthi iyiphi inkantolo okufanele uye kuyo, uma ikhona, buza etafuleni lolwazi ukuze uthole umhlahlandlela wokuthi iyiphi inkantolo ubufakazi bakho buzokwenziwa khona noma kuphi izindaba ezifanele. Ungaqonda futhi eqenjini labaphakanyisi, abazokwazi ukuphendula noma yimiphi imibuzo yakho mayelana nenqubo. Umphakathi ophatha icala lakho uzokwazi ukukutshela ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuthi unikeze ubufakazi. Umphakathi uzokwenza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubizwa ukuba unikeze ubufakazi ngokushesha okukhulu. Umphakathi ohlangene necalalakho, lapho kudingeka, uzokhuluma nawe ngaphambi kokuthi ubizwe ukuba unikeze ubufakazi. Nokho, kwesinye isikhathi kungase kube nezikhathi zokulibazisa. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ukhona enkantolo ngesikhathi. Kufanele uqinisekise umphakathi uma uzobe ulahlekile noma uma ungakwazi ukuya enkantolo ngosuku lwecala. Uma kudingeka unikeze ubufakazi, kwesinye isikhathi cela umngane noma othile ophakathi kwecala ukuthi akuhambise enkantolo. Ngemuva kokunikeza ubufakazi bakho, uzokwazi ukukwazisa uma ungahamba. Ngokwesimo esithile, ungase unikeze ubufakazi wakho egumbini elivaliwe ngevidiyo (lokhu kusho ukuthi ngeke ube khona egumbini elifanayo nomsolwa, kodwa uzobe ungaphakathi kwezinye izindlu). Ungase futhi, uma ungaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 noma uma umuntu omele icala (kungaba ummagistrate noma ijaji) ekholelwa ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi kungase kubangele ukukhathazeka okungadingekile, kube nomuntu osekelayo (othile ozokhuluma ngokuqondile) uma unikeza ubufakazi ngevidiyo egumbini elivaliwe. Kumele kube nobufakazi obuqinile ngaphambi kokuthi umuntu atholakale enecala. Umphakathi kumele ukhombise ngaphandle kokungabaza ukuthi umsolwa unecala. Lokhu kungase kusho ukuthi umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi unecala utholakala engelona. Lokhu akusho ukuthi isinqumo sakho sikhulu, kodwa kukhombisa amandla wecala lokuphakanyiswa. Umphakathi ngezinye izikhathi uzobiza abaqinisekisi bakahulumeni ukuba bakuhambise kuleli cala elibhekiswe kumsolwa. Umhumushi uzobe ekhona uma kudingeka. Umphakathi uzonika ithuba lokubuza imibuzo, ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi, nokubiza abaqinisekisi. Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo izwile yonke imininingwane evela kumphakathi nakuye ophikayo, umsolwa nomphikisi bazothola ithuba lokukhuluma enkantolo ngaphambi kokuthi umphumela udlule. Ngaphambi kokukhuluma umphumela, ummeleli wecala, umphakathi, noma ophikayo bangacela ukuthi ummeleli wezisulu noma omunye umuntu onekhono avunyelwe ukuveza umthelela wobugebengu kuwe noma kumsolwa. Le mininingwane ingathathwa ezitatimendeni zakho ezenziwe kumaphoyisa, noma umphakathi angase akubuze ngqo noma akubize ukuba unikeze ubufakazi ngesikhathi sokwahlulela. Umnyango wezobulungiswa uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlulelwa kwenzeka ngendlela
Ukubona intuthuko esiyenzile mayelana nobuso bobuDemokhrasi, mayelana nezinguquko ezinhlelweni zokwahlulela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela kokwahlulela nokubekwa kwenkantolo kwazo zonke izinqubo, ngaphandle kokucwasa ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, isiko, noma isimo sakho. Unelungelo lokwelashwa ngokushesha nangokucophelela, ngenhlonipho yokuhlonipha isithunzi sakho nokugcina ubumfihlo phakathi kwazo zonke izisebenzi zedepartment, izikhungo, izindawo, noma izinhlangano ezihlobene noma ezinikeza usizo kuwe (ezizobizwa ngokuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo). Amaphoyisa, ngesikhathi sokuhlola; abameli bezokwahlulela noma osomthetho ngesikhathi sokulungiselela icala noma ngesikhathi sokuhlola; nabanye abahlinzeka ngosizo bazokwenza imizamo yokunciphisa noma yisiphi ukudideka okubangelwa, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngokubuza imibuzo ngolimi olwakho olukhethayo noma oluqondile uma kudingeka. Unelungelo lokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngesikhathi sokuhlola icala nasemva kokuhlolwa kwalo. Amaphoyisa, ummeli, kanye nomphakathi wezinsizakalo zokulungiswa bazothatha izinyathelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi noma yini ofuna ukuyifaka ekuhloleni, ekwahluleleni, nasekucatshangelweni kokuphikiswa kwesigwebo izokwenziwa futhi icatshangelwe uma kuhlolwa ukuthi kuqhubeke yini nokuhlola noma ukuhweba noma ekuphikisaneni kwesigwebo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uzoba nethuba lokwenza enye isitatimende kumaphoyisa uma uzwa ukuthi isitatimende sakho sokuqala asiphelele; ungakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka, lapho kudingeka, ngesitatimende enkantolo noma unikeze ubufakazi ngesikhathi sokuphikiswa ukuze ubonise umthelela obangelwe yicala enkantolo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ungabhalela uMongameli weBhodi Yokuphikisa isicelo sokuba khona emhlanganweni wokuphikisa isinqumo sokuphikiswa, kuhlanganise nemibono yakho ebhaliwe. Unelungelo lokwaziswa ngamalungelo akho nokuthi ungawasebenzisa kanjani. Njengengxenye yamalungelo akho, ungacela incazelo nganoma yini ongayiqondi kahle ngolimi olwaziwayo. Unelungelo lokuthola ulwazi nokwaziswa ngazo zonke izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ezihlinzekwa ngabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Uzokwaziswa ngendima ozoyidlala kuleli cala kanye nesikhathi esilinganiselwe esingathatha ukuze icala likhuliswe. Ungacela ulwazi mayelana nosuku lokukhuluma kwecala, izimali ezikhokhelwa kubafakazi, kanye noHlelo Lokuvikelwa Kwefakazi. Ungabuza ngesinqumo senkantolo mayelana necalakhe ukuthi sizokwenziwa noma cha. Unelungelo lokuthola izincwadi zomthetho ezikuvumela ukuba uzithole. Ungacela ukuthi uMnyango Wezinsizakalo Zokulungiswa ukukwazisa uma umsolwa ebalekela ejele noma edluliselwa kwenye jele. Unelungelo lokucela usizo futhi, uma kudingeka, ukuthola izeluleko zomphakathi, zezempilo, nezomthetho, kanye nosizo oluzobhekana nezidingo zakho. Umphakathi wezokwahlulela uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izidingo ezibalulekile zilandelwa uma kuziwa ekuhlukunyezweni ngokocansi, ekuhlukunyezweni kwasekhaya, ekunakekeleni izingane, noma okuhlobene nokunakekelwa, lapho-ke, uma kudingeka, lezi zindaba zikhuluma ezinkantolo ezibekiwe. Uma unazo izidingo ezithile, zonke izikhungo zokwesekwa zizozama, ngokwezisebenzi zazo, ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zakho, ziqinisekisa ukuthi uphathwa ngothando. Unelungelo lokubuyiselwa kwempahla yakho noma indawo yakho uma kuthathwe ngokungemthetho, noma uma impahla yakho noma indawo yakho damagewe ngokungemthetho. Ukubuyiselwa kubhekisela ezimweni lapho inkantolo, ngemva kokuthi umsolwa aboshwe, iyala umsolwa ukuba abuyisele impahla yakho noma indawo ethathwe ngokungemthetho, noma ukuba alungise impahla yakho noma indawo eyadliwe ngokungemthetho, ukuze ibuyiselwe esimweni esasikhona ngaphambi kokwenzeka kwalelo cala. Umphakathi wezokwahlulela uzokwazi ukukwazisa ukuthi ukubuyiselwa kuhlobene nani futhi umphakathi wenkantolo uzokusiza ukuqinisekisa leli lungelo. Uma wazi ukuthi unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo sakho, ungaxhumana nalolo mnyango wombuso noma isikhungo sosizo uma unokukhala mayelana nosizo olutholakele, noma uma amalungelo akho engahlinzekwanga. IKomidi Lokulingana Kwamabhizinisi kanye noMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo bhalisela wonke amaqembu angaphansi kukahulumeni kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ngokubonga ngokubamba iqhaza kwabo ekuphumeleleni kokuphumelelisa le Mthetho Wamalungelo Wabantu Abathintekayo.
Uma umphenduli ephula i-Protection Order ngokuphindaphindiwe ehlasela ngokomzimba noma ngokuqhuba ngendlela echazwe ekuqaleni kwalolu documet, ungafaka isikhalazo emaphoyiseni bese unikeza i-Warrant of Arrest emaphoyiseni azobamba umphenduli. Isinqumo sokusebenzisa i-Warrant of Arrest ngemuva kokuphulwa kwe-Order sisonke. Ungafaka isicelo sokuthi i-Order yakho ikhanselwe nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kodwa umphakathi ubonisa ukuthi i-Affidavit akufanele ikhanselwe noma cha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-Protection Order izobhekwa njengengasebenzi. Umthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwangaphakathi 116 ka-1998 uvumela umonakalo wokuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi ukuba ufune i-Protection Order eNkantolo yeMagistrate ngokumelene nomonakalo. Inhloso yale Mhlahlandlela ukuhlinzeka umonakalo ngemininingwane abayidingayo ukuze bafake isicelo se-Protection Order ngokuhambisana nomthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwangaphakathi. Bobabili abesifazane nabesilisa bangaba abahlukunyezwayo futhi bangaba nabahlaseli ezimweni zokuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi. Nokho, ngenhloso yale Mhlahlandlela, sikhombisa ukuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi okuhlobene nabesifazane ngoba lokhu kuyinto evamile kakhulu. Lokhu kusebenza kumuntu owabelana naye ngephromise yokushada, ubudlelwano bendabuko, noma ubudlelwano bokuphola, okubandakanya ubudlelwano bokuthandana obukhona noma obubonwa, okubandakanya umuntu owabelane naye ngendlu noma osanda kwabelana naye ngendawo yokuhlala. Le ndaba ingabambezeleka ngosuku oluthile lokubakhona enkantolo. Umqondisi weNkantolo uzokweseka noma akuholele kumuntu ozokwenza ukukubhalela impendulo. Ngosuku lokulalela, ummagistrate uzozama ukwenza isinqumo ngokusekelwe kuma-Affidavit afakwe yizigaba zombili. Umagistrate angacela omunye wenu noma bobabili ukuba baphendule ngezinkinga ezithile. Umagistrate angakwenza isinqumo sokuvuma i-Order futhi akhanselwe i-Order futhi aqinisekise ukuthi ubufakazi bukhulunywa. Ingabe umphenduli uzobanjwa ukuze i-Protection Order? Umphenduli ngeke abanjwe uma ethola i-Protection Order. Yini i-Contempt of Court? Lokhu kwenzeka uma umphenduli engahambisani ne-Order, noma ehluleka ukuvela eNkantolo yezeMpi ukuze aphendule ezinsolweni ezibhekiswe kuye. Uma ucabanga ukuthi ungaba umonakalo nganoma iyiphi indlela yokuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla, hamba uye eNkantolo yeMagistrate eduze bese ucela usizo lokuthi ufake isicelo se-Protection Order. Umqondisi weNkantolo uzokusiza ugcwalise amafomu adingekayo futhi akuthumele phambi kommagistrate ozokwenza isinqumo sokuthi ukukwenzela i-Order noma cha. Ulwazi ngababoneleli bezinsizakalo abangakweluleka ngalesi sihloko lunikezwa ekuqaleni kwalolu Mhlahlandlela. Umqondisi weNkantolo uzokusiza uqedele amafomu adingekayo futhi akuthumele phambi kommagistrate. Yikuphi ukwakha okufanele ngiye kuyo? Hamba uye enkantolo eduze lapho uhlala khona noma ubenza khona. Uma uphume emzini owuhlala ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa futhi uphila kwesinye isikhathi kwenye indawo, ungaya enkantolo eduze nalapho uphila khona kwesikhashana. I-Protection Order yesikhashana izocela umphenduli (uhlukunyezwayo) ukuthi angakuhlukumezi ngendlela echazwe kwi-Affidavit yakho. Ezimweni ezinzima kakhulu, ummagistrate angathola ukuthi kubalulekile ukuvumela umphenduli ukuba ahambe endlini ababelana ngayo nawe noma avimbele ukuba angene ezindaweni ezithile zendlu ababelana ngayo nawe. Uma izingane zihlukunyezwa, iNkantolo ingaqinisekisa ukuthi umphenduli akavumi ukubona izingane nhlobo noma abe nezikhathi ezithile zokubona. INkantolo ingakhupha i-oda yokusiza kwezimali ngokuphuthumayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma udinga ukufaka isicelo sokukhokha izindleko zezokwelapha noma izindleko zokuhlala ezivela ngokuqondile ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa, kufanele uhlinzeke ngobufakazi bezindleko ezitholakele bese uceli iNkantolo ukuthi icabangele lesi sicelo. INkantolo ingalayisha amaphoyisa ukuba athathe isibhamu somphenduli uma benze noma yiziphi izinsongo empilweni yakho. Ukuze kuphendulwe ngokugcwele uhlobo oluthile lokuhlukunyezwa okukhuluma ngalo, iNkantolo ithembele kwi-Affidavit owakwenze lapho ufaka isicelo. I-Protection Order yesikhashana kufanele ihanjiswe kumphenduli (uhlukunyezwayo) ngokushesha okukhulu. Awukwazi ukuya wedwa ukuhlinzeka umphenduli nge-Protection Order njengoba lokhu kungaba yindlela engafanele yokwenza lo msebenzi ngokomthetho, okusho ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe ngamaPhoyisa. Kufanele uhlinzeke i-Protection Order yesikhashana ehhovisi le-Sheriff noma endaweni yokuphumula eduze kwendlu yomphenduli noma endaweni yokusebenza. Emaphoyiseni, uyacelwa ukuthi ukhumbule ukubhala phansi igama kanye/noma inombolo ye-badge yomphakathi okukhombisa i-Order. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuba ulandele i-Order kalula esikhathini esizayo. Emaphoyiseni amaningi kukhona umphakathi oqokwe ukukhandlela izindaba zokuhlukunyezwa kwangaphakathi. Hlela namaphoyisa ukuqoqa i-Return of Service (Ubufakazi Bokuhlinzeka). Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi i-Protection Order ihanjiswe kumphenduli futhi ukuthi lowo muntu uyamukela ngokwakhe. Awukwazi kulindele ukuthi amaphoyisa athumele noma athumele i-Return of Service enkantolo njengoba lokhu kuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu futhi akufiki enkantolo ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyisela.
Umnyango wezeMthetho kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Ihhovisi leMenenja-Jikelele: Ukuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo amaqembu abuthakathaka. Ngizokwazi kanjani uma ukukhokha sekwenziwe? Qhubeka ucinga ngaphambi kokuhamba enkantolo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukukhokha sekwenziwe. Uma ukukhokha kungakwenziwanga, inkantolo izozama kuqala ukubona uma ukukhokha sekwenziwe, kodwa uma kungenjalo, izokutshela ukuthi kufanele wenze kanjani. Ngizolinda isikhathi esingakanani ukuze ngikhokhelwe? Usuku lokukhokha luncike kuMyalelo weNkantolo. Umuntu ophethe ukukhokha kumele akhokhe inkantolo ukuze akhokhelwe. Ukukhokha kungase kungatholakali ngenxa yokuhlinzeka ngenombolo yokubhekisela engalungile. Khumbula ukuthi uma ukukhokha kwenziwa NGEMALI YOKUHLAKAZA futhi kwafakwa kwi-akhawunti yakho yasebhange, imali IZOBHEKWA NGEMVA KWEZINSUKU EZI- SEVEN. Angizizwa kahle uma ngisebenzisa i-akhawunti yasebhange. Khumbula ukuthi kuphephe futhi kulula ukusebenzisa i-akhawunti yakho yasebhange kunokwenza ukukhokha ngomyalo wenkantolo. Cela isitatimende esinazo zonke izincazelo (hhayi isitatimende esingaphelele) se-akhawunti yakho yasebhange ehhovisi lakho lesikhwama sebhange noma kwi-ATM. Bring the bank statement and your identification document to court. Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma ngiyena umuntu okhokhayo imali yokugcinwa? Khipha imali ngqo kwi-akhawunti yasebhange - enza idiphozi kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yomuntu okumele athole le mali. Indlela okhokha ngayo kufanele ibhalwe kuMyalelo weNkantolo. Inombolo yokubhekisela ehlinzekwe yinkantolo kufanele ihlale inikezwa uma ukhokha ngqo kwi-akhawunti yasebhange noma ehhovisi. Kwenzekani uma i-akhawunti lapho imali kufanele ifakwe ivaliwe? Hlinzeka inkantolo ngemininingwane emisha yasebhange. Umphathi Wezimali Zokugcinwa uzokwazisa umuntu obhekene nezinsolo ngemininingwane yakho emisha yasebhange kanye nenani elikhokhwayo. Kwenzekani uma umuntu othola imali yokugcinwa engaphilile, engakwazi, eshonile, noma esendaweni yangaphandle? Umgibeli wengane uthola imvume yokuhola imali. Uma kukhona ukugula, ukungakwazi, noma uma umuntu ogunyaziwe esendaweni yangaphandle, kufanele kuthathwe omunye umuntu. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokukhishwa kweSikhumbuzo seMandla esinika omunye umuntu igunya lokuhola imali yokugcinwa. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ungaxhumana noMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ukuze uthole usizo. Ngiyaphi uma ngifuna ukwazi ngamalungelo okugcina ingane nokufinyelela? Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nokugcina ingane nokufinyelela, bheka ihhovisi leMphakathi. Nini inkantolo ivula? Ngiyaphi uma ngifika enkantolo? Qhubeka uqale ngokuqhubela kwiDesk yeMibiko ukuze bakukhombise endaweni efanele. Ngiyacela kanjani imali yokugcinwa? Yiziphi amalungelo ami? Umsebenzi womzali womabili ukuhlinzeka ngengane yabo ngokwezimali. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinkokhelo zokudla, izingubo, indawo yokuhlala, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, kanye nemfundo. Inani eliphelele lokugcinwa lizokwenziwa ngokuhlanganisa imali yomzali ngamunye. Umuntu ophethe ukukhokha imali yokugcinwa unelungelo lokuphikisa umyalelo wokugcinwa. Uma kwenzeka ukwehlukana, umngane owayengumlingani unelungelo lokuthola imali yokugcinwa uma lokhu kufakiwe njengengxenye yokwehlukana enkantolo. Nini engingavela khona eNkantolo Yokugcina? Uma othile engakuniki imali yokugcinwa yengane noma yomndeni. Uma kuwukuhlola kwakho okokuqala kokufaka isicelo semali yokugcinwa. Uma iNkantolo Yokwehlukana isiyalile ukuthi ifayela kufanele livulwe ukuze inkantolo ibike umuntu ophazamisekile ukuthi kanjani, nini, nokuthi yiziphi izinkokhelo ezizokwenziwa. Ngiwubeka kanjani umyalo wokwandisa noma wokwehlisa umyalelo wokugcinwa okhona. Yikuphi inkantolo engingaya kuyo ukuze ngifake isicelo semali yokugcinwa? Uyalulekwa ukuthi uxhumane nenkantolo eseduzane ngocingo njengoba zingakusiza ngemininingwane efanele. (I-inkantolo endaweni lapho ingane noma umuntu okumele agcinwe khona ehlala khona). Kungani ngidinga usuku lwenkantolo? Ukuze inkantho inikeze isikhathi sokubika omunye umuntu ukuthi kufanele abe khona ekulalelweni kwecala. Kungani kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu eze enkantolo? Lokhu kuzosiza ukuze ufinyelele esivumelwaneni sokuthi mangaki imali yokugcinwa edingekayo nokuthi mangaki umuntu ophazamisekile angakwazi ukukhokha. Yini okufanele ngiyisebenzise njengenombolo yokubhekisela? Inombolo iboniswa kwiKhadi lakho Lokugcinwa. Ngizolinda isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuthi umyalelo wenkantolo wenziwe? Lokhu kuncike ekutheni izigaba ezithintekayo zisebenza kanjani. Uma lezi zigaba zivumelana, ukukhokha kokuqala kufanele kwenziwe njengoba kuchaziwe kuMyalelo wenkantolo. Yiziphi izindlela ezahlukene engingazisebenzisa ukuhola imali yokugcinwa? Umyalelo wenkantolo wokukhokha - inkampani ikhipha imali ngqo emholweni womuntu ophathelene nokukhokha bese iyifaka kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yenkantolo. Ukukhokha ngemali - uthola imali ehhovisi lenkantolo. Indlela engcono yokuthola imali yokugcinwa ukuthi imali ikhokhwe ngqo kwi-akhawunti yakho yasebhange. Yini okufanele ngizilethe? Ngizitholela kanjani? Inqubo yonke yokufaka isicelo sokugcinwa ukuze uthole ukukhokha kokuqala ingathatha amasonto ambalwa, kuye ngokuthi izigaba zombili zisebenza kahle kangakanani. Inombolo ye-ID kanye nesithombe somzali / umuntu ophathelene nokukhokha imali yokugcinwa. Isitatimende sebhange uma unayo i-akhawunti yasebhange. Uhlu lwezindleko ezichaza izidingo zengane. Isikhumbuzo samanje semiholo yezigaba zombili ezithola umholo. Ikheli lesakhiwo, indawo yokuhlala, kanye nendawo yokusebenza yomndeni noma umndeni. Usuku lwenkantolo (uma luhlelwe). Inombolo yokubhekisela (uma ihlinzekiwe). Umyalelo wenkantolo (uma unawo). Isivumelwano sokwehlukana (uma kube nokwehlukana). Shayela inkantolo yasendaweni ukuze uthole ukuthi iyiphi inkantolo okufanele uhambe kuyo ukuze uthole imali yokugcinwa. Shayela leyo nkantolo yokugcinwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi yini okufanele ulethe ukuze ufake isicelo semali yokugcinwa. Woza enkantolo ukuze ugcwalise ifomu lesicelo. Inkantolo izokunikeza usuku lapho umuntu obhekene nezinsolo (omzali omunye) kufanele avele enkantolo. Inkantolo izobiza umuntu obhekene nezinsolo nomzali omunye ukuba avele enkantolo ngosuku oluthile. Yiziphi izindleko ezingabhekwa njengemali edingekayo yengane? Kuzodingeka uhlinzeke ngemibhalo esekela enye noma ngaphezulu kwezindleko ezingenhla; kungenjalo, INKANTLO AYIKWAZI UKUQALA UKULALWANA KWECASE, isibonelo, isikhumbuzo semiholo, ibhili ye-electrical, imali yesikole, nezinkokhelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ingabe kubalulekile ukuthi ngiye enkantolo? Uya enkantolo efanele.
Ikomidi elibhekiswe kumamele amaphathi ezombusazwe lizokwethulwa. Emhlanganweni wokuqala wale komidi, amalungu kumele akhethe uMongameli ozobhekelela yonke imihlangano ye komidi. Bazokwamukela zonke izicelo ezivunyelwe zokuxolelwa ezibuyela eMnyangweni wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Iziqu zizonke zizobhekwa futhi zidluliselwe kuMongameli ngenhloso yokusiza ekwenzeni isinqumo sokugcina. Le komidi izodinga ukusungula imithetho nezindlela zayo ezizosebenza ngaphansi kwayo uma ibheka isicelo ngasinye ukuze ihlinzeke ngombiko ofanele wesicelo ngasinye. Ikomidi kumele ibike uMnyango wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ngale mithetho nezindlela ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 zomhlangano wayo wokuqala. Zonke izinhlelo ezihlobene nomsebenzi we komidi zizokwenziwa ngumphathi ozokhethwa ngaphakathi koMnyango wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Le komidi izosebenza kusukela ngosuku lokuqala kuze kube usuku lokugcina lapho umsebenzi wayo uqedwa. Zombili lezi zinsuku zifakiwe, futhi usuku lokugcina alungaph surpass September 30, 2008. Uma isicelo sihambisana nezimo ezibekiwe efomini, umsolwa angathumela isicelo kuMongameli ngendlela ebekiwe. Icala elikhuluma ngalesi sahluko a kumele lenziwe ngaphambi kosuku lokunikezwa kukaMongameli ngomhla kaJuni 16, 1999; futhi c isicelo kumele sihambisane ne affidavit noma incwadi yokwaziswa evela emzini owabeka iphathi yezombusazwe noma enye inhlangano elwa namalungelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umfaki-sicelo wayengumuntu ophila ngaphansi kwemiyalo ethile. a uma icala libhekiswe: i. futhi c uma umfaki-sicelo engahambisani nezimo ezibekiwe ezinsukwini ezintathu ezibekwe kubafaki-sicelo. Izicelo ezizokwamukelwa yilezo ezigcwaliswe kahle futhi ezilandela zonke izimo ezibekiwe phakathi nesikhathi sokuhlola esingezinyanga ezintathu. Isicelo esithunyelwe ngumsolwa yiso esizobhekwa. Isicelo kumele sithunyelwe ngumsolwa njengoba kubekiwe uMnyango wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Iphathi yezombusazwe yomuntu osolwa nayo ingathumela isicelo egameni lesolwa kuMnyango wezobuGcisa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Kumele baqinisekise phansi kwesifungo ukuthi ukuboshwa komuntu wabo kuhambisana nezimo zezombusazwe lapho le phathi ibihileleke khona. Zonke iziphakamiso ezenziwe ngezicelo zokuxolelwa kumele zidluliselwe kuMongameli. Iziphakamiso ezivela kule komidi egxile kuzokwenziwa ngemva kwesicelo sokuxolelwa ngasinye. UMongameli unamandla namalungelo okwamukela noma ukuphika iziphakamiso ezenziwe le komidi egxile. Ngemuva kokubheka zonke iziphakamiso ezenziwe le komidi egxile, uMongameli unamandla namalungelo okunika noma ukuphika leyo sicelo sokuxolelwa. Akekho onelungelo lokwamukela ukuxolelwa kuMongameli.
Idokhumenti lichaza uhlaka lwezinhlelo zokuphatha izinhlelo zokwahlulela zendabuko ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Umbono nenjongo yalolu hlaka lwezinhlelo zifaka phakathi izimiso zokuziphatha kwamasiko ezikhuthaza ukuxhumana komphakathi, ukuthula, nokuhlalisana. Kugcizelelwa ukufaneleka kobuholi bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika nasemkhathini omusha wezokhetho, kuqinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwemithetho ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezomthetho bendabuko. Kuhlinzekwa ngezindlela ezifanele zokwenza kube lula imisebenzi nobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kokwahlulela. Umbiko ubhekisisa uguquko lwemithetho ezinkantolo zendabuko eNingizimu Afrika kanye nemisebenzi yobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Abaholi bendabuko kumele babe sobala emisebenzini yabo ephathelene nokuphathwa kwemithetho. Izinkantolo zendabuko zinegunya lokuzwa amacala ahlobene nezicelo ezisekelwe emthethweni wamasiko nakwezinye izimiso eziphathelene nezindaba zezinyama. Izinkantolo zendabuko ziqokwe ukubhekana nezindaba ezihlobene noguquko lwezokwahlulela. Ukukhishwa kwezaziso nezinhlelo zokusebenza kanye nokuqinisekiswa kokuphathwa kwezinqumo ezenziwe ezinkantolo zendabuko nakho kugcizelelwa. Ukukhishwa kwabamele ezinkantolo zendabuko kuqokwe. Izinqumo ezenziwe ezinkantolo zendabuko kumele zibe nezinga, futhi ukudluliswa kwamacala ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile kuyavunyelwa. Ukuhlolwa kwezinqumo ezivela ezinkantolo zendabuko nakho kuyakhuluma. Izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ukuze amacala aqhamuka ezinkantolo zendabuko athathwe ezinkantolo zomphakathi zikhuluma. Indima yezinkantolo zendabuko ohlelweni lokwahlulela kwezindaba zezinyama igcizelelwa. Abaholi bendabuko nezinkantolo zendabuko kumele zikhuthaze izimiso nezinhlelo ezisemthethweni kuMthethosisekelo. Kukho isidingo somthetho kazwelonke ukuqinisekisa ukulingana. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemithetho ezinkantolo zendabuko nakho kuyakhuluma. Ukubaluleka kwesikhungo ekugcineni ukuthula nokuxhumana emiphakathini yasemakhaya kugcizelelwa. Imiphakathi yasemakhaya idlala indima ebalulekile futhi enobunzima ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Ziyingxenye yefa lesiko labantu base-Afrika, futhi lokhu kuyavunywa nguMthethosisekelo. Umthetho ophathelene namasiko ubikhona kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo futhi uyavunywa uhlelo lwezomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi labantu abahlala emiphakathini yasemakhaya liphethwe yimithetho ephathelene namasiko kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokwahlulela zendabuko, besebenzisa le ndlela yomthetho. Abantu abalinganiselwa kumashumi amane emalini bazoba yingxenye yomphakathi wendabuko kuzo zonke izifunda zeNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle kweWestern Cape. Isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko sidlala indima ebalulekile ekwandiseni izinga lokuhlalisana komphakathi, ukuthula, nokuxhumana emphakathini. Kulolu suku lokuphathwa kwemithetho, abaholi bendabuko baxazulula izingxabano ezinkantolo zendabuko (Inkundla). Ukubaluleka kwezinkantolo zendabuko kuvela eduze kwemiphakathi nasekusebenziseni ulimi nezindlela ezilula umphakathi ozazi kahle, nezinhlelo ezisetshenziswa ezinkantolo zomphakathi. Abaholi bendabuko nezixhumanisi zabo basebenza ngokubambisana, bephulaphula ubufakazi bababhalisi kanye "nabaphikisi" ukuze baxazulule izingxabano ngokwemithetho yamasiko yalowo mphakathi. Izinkantolo zendabuko azinayo uhlu olubhaliwe lwemithetho ezilandelwayo. Ziqondiswa ngezifiso nezindlela zomphakathi abaphila kuwo. Ngale ndlela, ukuhlinzekwa kokwahlulela kwenziwa kalula nangokushesha. Ngemva kokhetho lwezokhetho lweDemokhrasi lwango-1994, lezi zinhlelo zobuholi zamukelwa. Ithebula elilandelayo libonisa ukusabalala ezifundeni kwezinga ezintathu zobuholi bendabuko kuleli. Ihhovisi likazwelonke labaholi bendabuko lasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokwakhiwa KweHhovisi Labaholi Bendabuko ka-1997 futhi lisebenza kazwelonke; ithebula elilandelayo libonisa isimo samanje esithinta izindlu zesifunda nezasekhaya ezifundeni. Emphakathini ngamunye ngaphansi kobuholi bendabuko, kufanele kusungulwe futhi kuqashelwe ikomidi lendabuko. Umbono walolu hlaka lwezinhlelo ugcizelela ukubaluleka kwesikhungo sobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho, okungafaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kokufinyelela kokwahlulela nokufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bonke. Inhloso eyinhloko yalolu dokhumenti lwezinhlelo ukuhlela uhlelo lwezomthetho lwezinkantolo zendabuko noMthethosisekelo. UMthetho Wokuphathwa KweMblack, njengokuphuma komthetho wokuqala wokwehlukaniswa kwezizinda, wawususiwe ngoNovemba 1995. Lokhu kugcizelela isidingo sokwethula umthetho kazwelonke ukuze kuqondiswe indima nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Idokhumenti yezinhlelo iyinhlanganisela yemiphumela ethathwe ekuhloleni kwemibhalo, ukufunda okuqhathanisayo kwezinye izindawo lapho umthetho kufanele usebenze, izingxoxo nabaholi bendabuko, kanye nezinsiza zikahulumeni ezibhekelele ezokwenziwa kwendabuko nezinye izithakazelo emkhakheni wezomthetho wamasiko. UNgqongqoshe nabanye osomabhizinisi bavakashele ukuze bafunde ngokwabo ukuthi izinto ziqhutshelwa kanjani eNdiya naseBotswana. Eminye imininingwane itholwe ezithombeni emhlanganweni wezikhungo zendabuko owawubanjelwe eThekwini ngoJulayi 2007, kanye nomhlangano olandelayo wezinkantolo zomphakathi owawubanjelwe eMidrand ngoAgasti 2007. Kulezi zinkulumo, indima yalezi zikhungo ekuphathweni kwemithetho yakhuluma. Ukhetho lweDemokhrasi lwango-1994 lwaholela enqubweni entsha. Le nqubo entsha yaba isisekelo sokuhlola imithetho nezindlela ezazikhona ngaphambi konyaka ka-1994. Le dokhumenti yezinhlelo igxile endimeni nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko phakathi nalesi sikhathi sokhetho, ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko sidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yesiko labantu base-Afrika, emlandweni, nasekutheni kwezwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Kubandakanya ukugcina isiko, izindlela, izimiso, nezindinganiso zabantu base-Afrika, ngenkathi ngesikhathi esifanayo temsilisa izigaba zomphakathi zangaphambili kanye nokuphathwa. Nokho, lapho iNingizimu Afrika yamukela uMthethosisekelo wesikhashana, kulandela uMthethosisekelo kazwelonke ka-1996, abantu bethu bachaza iNingizimu Afrika njengelizwe elizimele, eliphethwe yidemo, elisekelwe ezimisweni ezamukelwe ngabo bonke, lapho singafaka khona nokuvinjelwa kokwehlukaniswa kuMthethosisekelo. Lokhu kwakukhombisa ukuthi itshe lizokhuhla omunye ummbila. Ngemva kokhetho lwe-1994, uhulumeni omusha waqala isigaba sokwakha kabusha izwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izakhiwo zokuphatha ezazizohambisana nenqubo entsha yokhetho nezimiso zomthethosisekelo ezifana nokulingana
Chaza ukuthi ungayithuthukisa kanjani imithetho ekhona kulolu cwaningo mayelana nokuthengiswa kwezocansi ngabantu abadala? Chaza zonke iziphakamiso ezahlukene ezenziwe emphakathini? Okokuqala, ngaphansi komthetho wethu kazwelonke, ukuthengiswa kwezocansi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, kanye nokuthenga ucansi kumuntu omdala ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, kanye nezinye izenzo ezihlobene nokuthengiswa kwezocansi, akuvumelekile. Okwesibili, zonke iziphakamiso ezinemininingwane kulolu Bhuku Lokuxoxa zibheka njengobugebengu ukuthengisa ucansi ngabancane; ukuphonsa umuntu ukuthi athengise ucansi ngaphandle kwemvume; nokuhweba abantu ngenhloso yokuthengisa ucansi. IKomidi ibona ukuthi ukuphonsa umuntu ukuthi athengise ucansi akuvumelekile futhi le siphakamiso kufanele ifakwe embikweni wokugcina weziphakamiso zeKomidi. Isiphakamiso sesibili sithi izenzo zabantu abathintekayo ekuthengiseni ucansi, amabhizinisi wezocansi, kanye nabathengi bezocansi akufanele abhekwa njengobugebengu. Abantu abathengisa ucansi abaphuli umthetho ngoba babhekwa njengabantu okufanele bavikelwe. Isiphakamiso sesithathu sithi ukuthengiswa kwezocansi kufanele kulawulwe futhi kuvunyelwe ukuthi kuqhubeke ngendlela ethile, njengokukhishwa kwemvume yamabhizinisi wezocansi, ukubhaliswa kwabantu abathengisa ucansi, nokuhlonza izindawo eziyingozi lapho abathengisi bezocansi benza khona. Ngaphansi kwalesi siphakamiso, ukuthengiswa kwezocansi ngabantu abadala kuvunyelwe, kodwa kufanele kuqhubeke ngendlela echaziwe. Ukuthengiswa kwezocansi okungahambisani nendlela echaziwe akufanele kube ubugebengu. Isiphakamiso sesine sithi ukuthengisa ucansi akufanele kubhekwe njengesenzo esingekho emthethweni. Lokhu kuhambisana nombono wokuthi ukuthengisa ucansi kubhekwa njengendlela evumelekile yokusebenza - kodwa ukufakwa kwemithetho yokusebenza kulolu daba akusho ukuthi lokhu kuyimbangela yokuphula umthetho. Akufanele kuthathwe njengomgomo obekwe nguhulumeni. Chaza kafushane ukuthi kungani ungakwenzi umbono ngomdlalo weMidlalo yeHlabathi? Ucwaningo jikelele mayelana nezimo ezihlobene nocansi (okukhuluma ngePhrojekthi 107), eyasungulwa ngo-1998, inegunya elibanzi. Inhloso yalolu cwaningo ukuthuthukisa kakhulu ukuhlinzekwa kwezobulungiswa mayelana nazo zonke izimo ezihlobene nocansi nokuthengiswa kwezocansi ngabantu abadala, nokuhlola imithetho elawula lezi zimo ukuze kwenziwe iziphakamiso-nezincwadi ezihlosiwe zokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngobulungiswa ukuze kulwe nezinsolo zokuhlukumeza kwezocansi futhi lezi ziphakamiso-nezincwadi zilethe izinguquko.
ULombiko unama-plan ayishumi ezindaweni (njengoba kudingwa ihhovisi le-PIMSS) alungiselelwe isigaba sesine sohlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Inhloso yombiko ukuveza umbono wezindawo ngayinye nokukhombisa ukuthi kanjani imigomo ephumelele ezimphethweni ezisemqoka embikweni wesigaba sesibili ihambisana nalezi zindawo. Umthelela weHIV/AIDS ubuzwa kuyo yonke iPhondo naku-Okhahlamba. Ubuphofu, ukungasebenzi, ukusebenza kude nasesigodlweni, kanye nokwehla kwemikhuba emihle kwezempilo yomndeni nomphakathi kwenza kube nzima ukuvusa leli gciwane, futhi izixazululo zokwelapha zisakhuluma, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokudluliselwa phakathi komama nezingane. Le ndlala ingenye yezimbangela eziholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokufa. Ukukhula komphakathi wase-Okhahlamba kwehle ngenxa yale ndlala, kukhombisa ukuthi kudingeka ukunakwa okukhulu uma kuhlelwa ukwengeza izinsiza nezidingo ngenxa kokubaluleka kokuphila kwesistimu yokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Umbono wezindawo kanye nemigomo ehambisanayo kudingeka ihlaziywe ngokwezinga lokuxhaswa kwezimali nokuthi zifinyelelwa kanjani. Ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zokwazisa ngemicimbi yezomnotho kanye nokwakha izinsiza ezihlinzeka ngensiza yezobuchwepheshe kanye nezixazululo zokuthuthukiswa. Ngokwezibalo zokubalwa kwabantu zonyaka ka-1996, umphakathi wase-Okhahlamba ulinganiselwa ku-119,319, iningi labo bahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni ezibekwe. Kubikwa ukuthi umndeni ngamunye wase-Okhahlamba unamalungu angama-7. Inani elikhulu labantu lapha yintsha, ethole ukuthi izinga lemfundo liphansi futhi amathuba emisebenzi limited. Le simo sikhuthaza ubuphofu nezinga eliphansi lezempilo. Umbono wezindawo kanye nemigomo ehambisanayo. Ukubhekana nezimbangela zobuphofu ngokusondela amathuba wezomnotho emphakathini. Umkhandlu kufanele uhlole izinga lokuxhaswa kwezimali kwezokuhlaliswa komphakathi futhi wenze ulwazi mayelana nokutholakala kwabo lufinyeleleke. Izinsiza zifaka ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile kanye nalokho okuhlelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene, ukuhlinzeka, ukuthutha, ukuqoqa nokulahla udoti, ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi, nezinsiza zokuxhumana ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Kusukela ngo-1994, uhulumeni ufake imali enkulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza, futhi kutholakale ukuthi i-Okhahlamba inezindlela ezisebenzayo. Mhlawumbe uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe luzosiza ekwakheni umuzwa wokuthi kudingeka izinsiza. Uhlelo lokuhlela luhlose ukusungula amawebhusayithi. Amawebhusayithi achazwa ngaphansi kwesigaba sokuhlela izindawo. Ukuze kusebenza kancane izinsiza ezingenakufinyelelwa kalula kuzokwakha ukuqina ukuze izinga lezempilo liphumelele kubo bonke abahlali base-Okhahlamba. Ezolimo yindawo eqinile ekuthuthukiseni isimo sezomnotho kulomkhandlu. Kukhona umkhakha wezohwebo lwezolimo oqinile namathuba akhona okuthuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kule ndawo nokukhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwezindawo ezinhlelweni zokuhlelwa komhlaba nezindawo eziphathwa ngokwesiko lapho umhlaba utholakala khona ukuze ube nokulima. Ukuhweba kwezolimo kuthatha cishe u-70 emakhanda angu-100. Le ndawo iqinisekile ukuthi iyalima ngempumelelo. Imifino elandelayo ikhuliswa (ukudla, amabhontshisi, kanye nesorghum - ikhuliswa ngokunakekela, kanye nemifino eyomile), izitshalo eziluhlaza, kanye nokukhiqizwa kwezinkomo kanye nezinkomo. Ukuhweba kwezinkuni kwenzeka endaweni encane elinganiselwa ku-1.9 emakhanda angu-100. Indawo esele elinganiselwa ku-30 emakhanda angu-100, ngaphandle kwamadolobhana amancane, igcwele abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezibekwe nezindawo zokuphatha eziphathwa ngokwesiko lapho imikhiqizo yezolimo iyinsiza kuphela yokuphila komndeni. Ukuvulwa komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1994 kuphumelele ukuvimbela abalimi ngokumisa ukuxhaswa kwezimali, okwenze ukuthengwa kokudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe kube nezehlakalo eziphansi kunokudla kwendawo. Lokhu kwabangela izinguquko ezimfashini zokuphatha imikhiqizo, ukuguqulwa kwebhizinisi, nokwehla kwezindleko ezibuya ezindleleni zokulima ezinkulu. Izindleko zomhlaba ziqhubekile nokwehla, nakuba kubonakala sengathi lokhu kuyathuthuka. Ukukhiqizwa kwezinkomo kuyibhizinisi elibhekene nesidingo sokwehlisa izindleko, okuholela ekubuyeleni ezinkomeni ezidinga ukudla okuncane. Ngesikhathi lesi, izindleko zabasebenzi ezihambisana nale nyama zehle kakhulu. Kukhona umoya omubi phakathi kwabapheki bezolimo nabantu abasebenza ezindaweni zokulima kanye nabangane; futhi abalimi baphoqeleka ukukhokha izintela zomhlaba. Izindawo ezine-ownership ehlangene zibhekene nenkinga yokungabi nomnikazi oyedwa, okuholela kakhulu ekubeni abantu bahlale ezindaweni ezibekwe, bephuma kulezi zindawo ezibekwe zokuhlala. Izindawo zokulima zincane, inani lezinkomo alilinganisiwe, izinkomo zihlala zikhululeka zenza umonakalo emifino, futhi ukulima kwenziwa ukuze kudle imindeni ngaphandle kwemikhiqizo ethengiswayo. Imifino ekhuliswa ukuze kudle imindeni incane futhi ayithengiswa endaweni. Ukusungula ubudlelwano nomkhakha wezokuvakasha ukuze kudalwe izivumelwano zokuhweba ngemikhiqizo. Kukhona futhi ukuntuleka kwabasebenzi bezolimo emindenini. Lokhu kukhuphukile ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS, ebonakala iphula imindeni eminingi ngesikhathi zikhathazekile ngesimo sezomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wezolimo kuzofinyelela ezingeni lokuzinza kwezomnotho nezimo zendawo futhi kuzovuleka kulabo abangena kulesi sikhala ezindaweni zokuphatha ngokwesiko nasezindaweni ezibekwe. Ukulwa nokwakha ibhalansi phakathi kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Uhulumeni kazwelonke ubona umkhakha wezokuvakasha njengomkhakha odinga ukuthuthukiswa okukhulu. Lo mkhakha awukathuthukiswa kahle ezintabeni zase-Okhahlamba, futhi kukhona amathuba okuthuthukiswa kwawo. Ukuvula umkhakha wezokuvakasha ukuze kube nabantu bendawo abaninzi ukuba babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zomhlaba nezendawo. Ukulwa nokwakha ibhalansi phakathi kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Umnotho uwukuhlanganiswa kwemikhiqizo yonke yokuxhumana kwabantu nemvelo abahlala kuyo. Uhlobene namandla okwakha ingcebo nokuthi le ngcebo ihlukaniswa ngokulinganayo futhi iphathwe ngendlela eqinisekisa ukuqina. Uhlobene nokuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo ngenkathi kushiywa imikhakha yezokuvakasha nezolimo ukuba zibe nezimpendulo zazo. Ukuqinisa umnotho ukuze ukwazi ukubhekana nemakethe ezintsha namathuba ngendlela ezothuthukisa imikhiqizo yesifunda nezinga lokuphila kwabantu bayo bonke. Ukulwa nokwakha ibhalansi phakathi kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Ukwanelisa izidingo zemfundo zabantu bendawo ukuze kudalwe amathuba okukhula komnotho nokuzinza. Isimo sendawo kulo mbiko sikhuluma ngqo ngesimo sendawo mayelana nemvelo nezinsiza zendawo,
Ubudlelwano obuphephile kusho ukusebenzisa i-condom ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ubudlelwano obuphephile kusho ukuthi ithanga lendoda alikwazi ukungena emathangeni omfazi. Kubalulekile ukuba nobudlelwano obuphephile nomlingani oyedwa (ubudlelwano obuthembekile). Ubudlelwano obuphephile kusho ukuthi wena nomlingani wakho kufanele nihlolwe i-HIV ukuze nithole ukuthi anitholakali. Bobabili ningabamba iqhaza ebudlelwaneni. Lokhu kusabhekwa njengobudlelwano obuphephile. Umuntu one-HIV angaphila isikhathi eside uma ethatha ukunakekela. Phuza amanzi ahlanzekile. Faka ukudla ukuze izinyoni zingasabalalisi amagciwane. Geza izandla ngemva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Geza izandla ngaphambi kokudla. Phuma udoti ngendlela efanele. Gcina ikhaya lakho nendawo ophila kuyo ihlanzekile. Khuthaza ukusetshenziswa kweziqhamo. Khuthaza ubudlelwano obuphephile. Futhi uthi cha ebudlelwaneni. Abantu abane-HIV nabo banamalungelo afana nawo wonke umuntu. Ilungelo lokuhlonishwa. Ilungelo lokuba nekhaya. Ilungelo lokuvikelwa kolwazi lwabo. I-HIV yisifo esinciphisa uhlelo lokuzivikela, sishiya umuntu engatholakali ezifo. I-HIV ibangela uhlelo lokuzivikela ukuba luphume. Umuntu angaphila ne-HIV iminyaka eminingi ngaphandle kokukhombisa izimpawu. I-HIV noma i-AIDS isiphakathi kwethu, iyinto eqinile, futhi isabalala ngokushesha. Lesi sifo singanqotshwa kuphela uma sihlangana sisebenzisana ukuze salvise isizwe sethu. Ngalesi sikhathi sonke siye savalela amehlo ethu sithemba ukuthi i-HIV ayiyona into eqinile. Ngokwenza lokhu, sivumela ukusabalala kwe-HIV ukuqhubeka yonke le minyaka. Izwe lethu liqhubeka nalesi sifo. Usuku nosuku, cishe abantu abangu-1500 batholakale nalesi sifo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwabantu abathathu million baphila nalesi sifo. Njengabathintekayo empini yokulwa ne-HIV noma i-AIDS, kufanele sihlanganyele zonke izinzwa zethu, kanye namandla ethu nemibono yethu. Akukho enye indlela yokuvikela ukusabalala kwe-HIV ngaphandle kokuziphatha kahle. Kufanele sisebenze ndawonye futhi sixhase izikhungo zezempilo ekucwaningeni isixazululo se-HIV nezinkinga ezihlobene. Kufanele sithumele yonke imithombo kazwelonke ukuze sithumele imiyalezo yokuvikela i-HIV, sinikeze ukwesekwa kulabo abaphila nalesi sifo nabathandekayo babo. Kufanele sihlanganyele njengabathintekayo, sazi ukuthi ubumbano lwethu lungaholela emiphumeleni emihle. Kufanele sazi ukuthi lokho esikwenza namuhla kuhloswe ngathi nempilo yethu nalesi sikhathi. Ndawonye njengabathintekayo empini yokulwa ne-HIV ne-AIDS, singawina. I-virus ye-HIV ingena emzimbeni ngezindlela ezilandelayo: Ngokwenza ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokusebenzisa ukuvikela. Umama angadlulisa i-virus kumntwana wakhe ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma ngesikhathi sokubeletha. Ngokuxhumana negazi elitholakale. Ngokwesibonelo, igazi elihlangana nesikhumba esivulekile, noma isikhumba esiphukile, emlonyeni, ngaphansi kwenaili, noma ezilonda. Izilonda ezingapholi emlonyeni. Izimpawu ze-tuberculosis, ukukhwehlela, nokuphuma. Ukuphuma okungapheli okungase kuhlangane nokuphuma. Ukulahlekelwa yinkumbulo nokukhohlwa kalula. Kunezindlela eziningi zokuvikela i-HIV. Ngokuvamile, i-HIV idluliselwa ngokuxhumana ngokocansi. Kufanele ubambe iqhaza ebudlelwaneni obuphephile uma ufuna ukuphepha.
Izidingo ezengeziwe zokuhola ezikhundleni ezingenalutho zokufundisa zabaPhakathi kanye noMphakathi kufanele zibe kanje: "Amakhono okuhola, ukuphatha, nokuphathwa okuhlobene nezinhlobo ezithile zezikole." Ukungena kweSitatimende soMnyango Wezemfundo Kazwelonke sokufunda okujwayelekile nokuqeqeshwa (GET) (izikole, Iphasi yeSisekelo, Iphasi Ephakathi, kanye neSikole Esiphezulu) kuvumela ukukhangiswa kwezikhala zomsebenzi ezikoleni eziphakeme nezisezingeni eliphansi ngokwezidingo zohlelo lwezemfundo kanye neZakhono Zokuphila. Othisha bePhasi yeSisekelo kufanele, njengomthetho ojwayelekile, bakwazi ukufundisa zonke izinhlelo zokufunda ezintathu. Kule phasi, Izilimi neMathematics kufanele kube izinhlelo zokufunda ezihlukile. Ezinye izikole, uthisha oyedwa angafundisa zonke izinhlelo zokufunda, noma othisha bangafundisa izinhlelo zokufunda ezihambisanayo. EPhasini Eliphezulu, izindawo eziyisishiyagalombili zokufunda zihlelwe zibe izinhlelo zokufunda eziyisishiyagalombili. NjengasePhasini Ephakathi, kwezinye izikole, uthisha oyedwa angafundisa zonke izinhlelo zokufunda eziyisishiyagalombili, noma othisha bangafundisa uhlelo lokufunda oluhambisanayo. Izikole zinganquma inani nobunjalo bezinye izinhlelo zokufunda ngokuya ngezinto ezibalulekile ngaphakathi kwenhlangano yesikole. Njengomthetho ojwayelekile, isikhala esingenalutho kufanele sikhangiswe ngokwezinhlelo zokufunda ezilindelekile ukuze uthisha akwazi ukufundisa. Le fomu iqukethe ulwazi ngezidingo zezikhala zomsebenzi ezidalwe ezikoleni. Kufanele igcwaliswe nguMphakathi wesikole, iphume, futhi ithunyelwe ku-IDSO kanye noMqondisi Wesifunda.
Zonke izikole zikhishwe ngekhophi efanele, ifomu lokubala le-CD, kanye nediski. Izikole kulindeleke ukuthi zibuyise ifomu elisayiniwe, ukuhlolwa okubhalwe ngesandla okuphelele noma ifomu eliprintiwe, ikhophi yalo, kanye nediski (enolwazi olufakiwe). Izikole ezingakwazi ukufinyelela kumakhompyutha kufanele zibuyise ifomu lokuhlola elisayiniwe eligcwaliswe ngesandla kanye nekhophi yalo. Iphasi 1 isebenza kuzo zombili izikole ezijwayelekile nezikole ezikhethekile. Iphasi 2 isebenza kuphela ezikoleni ezijwayelekile. Iphasi 3 isebenza ezikoleni ezikhethekile (LSEN). QAPHELA: Lezi ziqondiso zisebenza ezikoleni ezigcwalisa ifomu ngesandla. Lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo kufanele zilandelwe lapho kugcwaliswa amafomu. Sicela usebenzise IZINHLOKO ZEZINHLOKO lapho ugcwalisa amafomu. Sicela ubhale ngendlela ecacile ngangokunokwenzeka. Signa kuphela endaweni enikeziwe yokusayina. Sicela ugcwalise enye ikhasi uma wenza amaphutha ekhasini. Sicela ufake inombolo ye-EMIS ekhasini ngalinye. Amakhasi efomu kufanele abuyiswe ngendlela efanele. Lonke ulwazi kufanele lunikezwe. Ikhasi le-"fomu yokuvuma" - ikhasi lesibili lefomu - kufanele ligcwaliswe ngesandla. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo owavumile akhona efomini yokuvuma ahlelwe kahle. Gcwalisa imininingwane yesikole sakho noma ngabe akushintshanga. Iyunithi ye-EMIS izohlinzeka ngolwazi olusha uma kuqhathaniswa nolwazi olushintshile ngaphandle kwegama lesikole. Ikheli leposi: 1. Ikhodi yeposi Ikheli lendawo: 1. Khombisa inani labafundi kuGrade 1 noGrade 2 esikoleni sakho ngokwezinsuku zabo zokuzalwa. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi inani eliphelele labafundi kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi ezigabeni ezifanayo kuTebula 3. Le tebula isetshenziselwa ukulandelela iminyaka yabafundi abangena ohlelweni. Khombisa inani labafundi kuzo zonke izigaba, inani lezigaba ekilasini (amaqembu abafundi ngokwezigaba), kanye nenani labaphindayo, okungukuthi, abaphindayo okokuqala, abaphindayo kwesibili, njll. Amakilasi okulungisa/ukwesekwa abhekisela kumakilasi abafundi abathola ukufundiswa okwakhe isikhathi esithile. Inani labafundi selivele lafakwa ezigabeni zezifundo. Khombisa inani abafundi okulindeleke ukuthi bakhokhe njengesikole kule nyaka. Ezimweni zezikhungo ezingenayo izinsizakalo ze-hostel, lokhu akuhlanganisi nezimali ze-hostel. Khombisa inani labafundi abakhululelwe ekukhokheni imali yokufunda ngonyaka ka-2008. Khombisa inani labafundi abathutheleka kwezinye izifunda noma amazwe ukuya eGauteng. Bala kuphela labo bafundi abajoyine isikole ngonyaka ka-2009. Khombisa inani labafundi ngokwezigaba abakhona esikoleni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abafundi ab placed in hostels. Inani eliphelele labafundi kule tebula kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi kuTebula 3 no-8. Le tebula isebenza kubazali/ab guardians abahlala nomfundi. Ungabala kabili uma abazali/ab guardians behlala futhi besebenza endaweni. Umfundi ngamunye kufanele uchazwe ngawe nakulet tebula. Tebula 9: Ulwazi Lokusebenza Tebula 9. Khombisa inani labasebenzi abaqashwe nguhulumeni esikoleni ngokobulili, izinga, nohlobo lomsebenzi. Izinga lesikhundla somphakathi kufanele likhombiswe. Khombisa inani labasebenzi abaqashwe ngababusi esikoleni ngokobulili, izinga, nohlobo lomsebenzi. Bheka isigaba 2 seTebula 1 ezikoleni ezijwayelekile ngenhla. Khombisa inani labafundi kuzo zonke izigaba/iphasi, ubulili, inani eliphelele lezigaba, kanye nenani labo ngokwezigaba/iphasi kwiqembu ngalinye labafundi ngokwezigaba/iphasi. Inani eliphelele labafundi kule tebula kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi kuTebula 2, 7, no-8. Tebula 6: Inani labafundi abahambe baya eGauteng ngonyaka ka-2009 (Bheka isigaba 2 seTebula 6 ezikoleni ezijwayelekile ngenhla). Khombisa inani labafundi ngokwezigaba abakhona esikoleni. Lokhu kuhlanganisa abafundi ab placed in hostels. Inani eliphelele labafundi kule tebula kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi kuTebula 2, 5, no-8. Le tebula isebenza kubazali/ab guardians babafundi abahlala nabo. Ungabala kabili uma umzali ehlala futhi esebenza endaweni. Umfundi ngamunye kufanele ubalwe ngawe nakulet tebula. Inani eliphelele labafundi kule tebula kufanele lihambisane nenani eliphelele labafundi kuTebula 2, 5, no-7. Khombisa inani labasebenzi abaqashwe nguhulumeni esikoleni ngokobulili, isikhundla, nohlobo lomsebenzi. Izinga lesikhundla somphakathi kufanele likhombiswe. Khombisa inani labasebenzi abaqashwe ngababusi esikoleni ngokobulili, izinga, nohlobo lomsebenzi.
Khetha isifunda lapho isikole sakho sitholakala khona, uhlu olungaphansi kokuthi "Isinyathelo 2: Bhala inombolo ye-EMIS noma ukhethe isikole kulolu hlu" luzovuselelwa, lukhombisa izikole ezisifundeni sakho. Phendulela kulolu hlu ukuze uthole isikole sakho ngqo noma inombolo ye-EMIS yesikole ebhokisini elincane elingezansi, lapho ukubhala inombolo kuzokhombisa igama lesikole kahle, cindezela ukhiye [Enter] kukhibhodi futhi imininingwane yesikole kufanele igqame kulolu hlu. Cindezela inkinobho ethi "Isinyathelo 3: Faka ulwazi lwesikole sakho" futhi ibhokisi lokuxoxa lizovela. Ngemva kokuthi uchofoze "OK", ikhasi 1 lefomu lokufaka ulwazi lizovela. Gcwalisa zonke izinkambu ezidingekayo njengoba ungakwenza kwi-hard copy yefomu lokuhlola. Umfanekiso 5: Ikhasi 1 lefomu lokufaka Zonke izifomu zibonakala futhi zisebenza ngendlela efanayo futhi zenziwe ukuhambisana ne-hard copy. Hamba uye ekhasini elilandelayo ngokuchofoza inkinobho ethi "ikhasi elilandelayo" kukhasi eliyinhloko. Qhubeka uye ekhasini elilandelayo kuphela uma uqinisekile ukuthi yonke imininingwane eqoqiwe yalelo khasi ethile ifakiwe, njengoba imininingwane kuthebula ngalinye izoqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokuthi ukwazi ukuyigcina nokuphrinta. Uma ufuna ukufaka ifomu lokuhlola ngesandla ngaphandle kwefomu elingenalutho, chofoza inkinobho ethi "ifomu elingenalutho" kukhasi eliyinhloko. Le nqubo izoprinta ifomu lokuhlola elingenalutho. Uma usuphelelisa ukuhlola, chofoza inkinobho ethi "Gcina futhi Phrinta ulwazi lwesikole" kukhasi eliyinhloko, uhlelo luzoprinta ifomu lokubala nolwazi olufakile. Uma uphendula "yebo" emcabangweni mayelana nokugcina imininingwane eqoqiwe kwiZikole kwenye ifomu ngendlela engasuswa, isibonelo, i-CD noma i-memory stick, uhlelo luzokhuthaza ukuthi ukhethe indawo. Ikhophi ephephile ingasayinwa kanye nendlela yokugcina ifayela lolwazi oluqoqiwe oluthunyelwe ehhovisi lesifunda. Izikole ezikhethekile: Amathebula 2, 5, 7, no-8 kumele abe nezinombolo eziphelele nolwazi lwezikole olugcwaliswe kuzo zonke izifundo lapho kubhaliswa khona. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi izinombolo kuthebula ngalinye ziqondile ukuze izinombolo eziphelele zihambisane. Izikole ezijwayelekile: Amathebula 3, 7, no-8 kumele abe nezinombolo eziphelele nolwazi lwezikole olugcwaliswe kuzo zonke izifundo lapho kubhaliswa khona. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi izinombolo kuthebula ngalinye ziqondile ukuze izinombolo eziphelele zihambisane. Uma udinga noma yiluphi uhlobo losizo noma ukwesekwa, sicela uqondise imibuzo yakho ehhovisi elifanele.
Abaphathi baphathiswe (ngokweSigaba 66 seCensus ka-2008 sabaphathi ka-2009) ukuba banikeze ulwazi oluqondile nolufanele njengoba kuthinta ukuvalwa nokuhlonza izidingo ezibalulekile zesikole. Ukwehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngalo ulwazi oluqondile nolufanele kuzoholela ekuhlukanisweni nasekuphazanyisweni kwemisebenzi yoMnyango futhi kuzobhekwa sengathi awuhloniphi umyalo osemthethweni. Mina, umphathi, ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwe lapha, ngokwazi kwami nangesithakazelo, luyiqiniso futhi lufanele. Mina, i-IDSO, ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi kule fomu, ngokwazi kwami nangesithakazelo, lufanele futhi lugcwele. Kuqinisekiswe nguMphathi Wesifunda: Mina, uMphathi Wesifunda, ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwe kule fomu, ngokwazi kwami nangesithakazelo, lufanele futhi lugcwele. Le ngxenye kumele igcwaliswe ngokuphelele futhi iqinisekiswe umphathi noma umphathi ophakeme noma omunye umuntu okhethwe esikoleni. Umphathi kumele assinwe futhi ashishe endaweni enikeziwe engezansi kwekhasi lokuqinisekisa ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ukuhlolwa kolwazi oluqoqiwe kwenziwe futhi wonke amaphutha alungisiwe kulolu hlu. Lolu hlu lokuqinisekisa kumele luthunyelwe emahhovisi esifunda/region futhi ikhophi igcinwe esikoleni ngenhloso yokuhlola. Uma ifomu litholakala lisuka esikoleni emahhovisi esifunda noma esifunda, umphathi wezeMfundo osethwe (UMphathi Wesifunda) kumele aqinisekise ulwazi oluqoqiwe ngemuva kwento ngayinye kulolu hlu. Isikhathi esigcwele = umqashi osebenza esikhundleni esigcwele esisebenza isonto eliphelele. Isikhashana = umqashi osebenza amahora ambalwa uma kuqhathaniswa nomqashi osebenza isikhathi esigcwele.
