Nikeza amagama ezibambiso ezimbili ezimele, umholi womphakathi, kanye nomuntu onolwazi olufanele emkhakheni wakho. Ucelwa ukuthi ulethwe ubufakazi obubhalwe phansi obusayinwe yizibambiso ezibhalwe. Ngiyavuma ukuthi ngokwazi kwami nokukholwa, yonke imininingwane enikeziwe kule fomu yesicelo iyiqiniso futhi ilungile. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi imininingwane eyengeziwe yokuxhasa ingadingeka nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngesikhathi sokubhekwa kwesicelo. Usihlalo, Usihlalo ophakeme, noma Umphakathi weQembu/Inhlangano/Isikhungo kumele basayine ngezansi. Umqondisi akavunyelwe ukusayina ngezansi. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi ngithole amandla okusayina le doko egameni (igama leqembu/inhlangano) futhi, ngokwazi kwami nokukholwa, yonke imininingwane enikeziwe iyiqiniso futhi ilungile. Isikhundla sakho eqenjini/inhlangano: Igama: Igama lokuqala nesibongo ... Ikheli lapho ungatholakala khona kuhlanganiswe nekheli leposi ... Ikhodi yeposi... Isicelo sakho sizobhekwa kuphela uma zonke imibuzo kule fomu iphenduliwe, amafomu nezivumelwano zisayinwe ngabantu abafanele, futhi wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo atholakala. Ucelwa ukuthi usebenzise leli bhokisi lokuhlola ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uletha amadokhumenti nemininingwane efanele ukuze kube lula ukucubungula isicelo sakho. Ikhophi yale fomu yesicelo kumele yenziwe futhi igcinwe njengobufakazi bakho. Uma usuhlole zonke lezi zikhala, isicelo sakho siqediwe.
Ukuthuthuka komnotho ezweni kube nehle, futhi kukhona okungaqinisekile mayelana nezimakethe zomhlaba. Kulindeleke ukuthi izinga lokukhula komnotho lizokwehla kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka kusukela ngo-2001. Nakuba umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika uzothinteka ukwehla komnotho kwezwe, isisekelo saso sihlala siqinile futhi izimali zezwe zisesimweni esihle. Ukutshalwa kwezimali kuyakhula, futhi kubonakala ukuthi umnotho uzophinde ukhule. Konke lokhu kunikeza ithemba lokuthi sizophumelela. Ukukhula komnotho wethu akukaze kubonwe eminyakeni engama-50 edlule. Eminyakeni emihlanu edlule, kulindeleke ukuthi izinga lokukhula kube cishe ngu-5%. Kusukela ngo-2001, cishe imisebenzi eyodwa yezigidi idalwe. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezivumela uhulumeni ukuba athuthukise impilo yabantu ezweni lethu: ukukhula komnotho nokuphathwa kahle kwezimali zezwe. Lokhu kuvumele uhulumeni ukuba unikeze abantu izinsiza zokufunda, ezempilo, emalini, ezokwakha, ezokuphepha, ezokuhamba, izinkundla, imigwaqo, neziboshwa. Njengoba umnotho ukhula ngale ndlela, kube nezinkinga esibhekene nazo. Kubonakala ukuthi awekho abaqeqeshiwe abaningi, futhi ugesi ne-cement akanele ukuhlangabezana nezinga lokukhula. Enye inkinga ukuhlinzekwa kwemigwaqo. Ukuze umnotho ukhule ngaphezu kwalokhu, sidinga ukutshalwa kwezimali ekuthuthukiseni amakhono, ezakhiwo, ekuthengeni imishini, imigwaqo, nasemsebenzini. Ngenxa yalezi zinkinga nokwehla komnotho kwezwe, kubonakala ukuthi izinga lokukhula komnotho wethu lizokwehla libe phakathi kuka-4% no-4.5% eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Nakuba lokhu kukhulu uma kuqhathaniswa neminyaka emihlanu edlule, kusengumsebenzi omuhle ezweni elinjengeNingizimu Afrika. Kubalulekile, sizophinde silungiselele ikusasa ngokutshalwa kwezimali. Ibhajethi ka-2008 izonikeza imali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bayazuza, ikakhulukazi amadoda athola emalini phakathi kweminyaka engu-60 no-64, ukuze kusekelwe uhlelo lokudla ezikoleni futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimo zezindawo zokufundela nezibhedlela zinhle. Enye inhloso yale bhajethi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi labo abangena emkhakheni wezokuhamba bathola lezi zinsizakalo, kanye nokutshala imali ezokuhamba zomphakathi kubantu abaningi, ukwandisa amaholo othisha nabahlengikazi, ukwandisa inani labaphoyisa nabagwebi, ukuvuselela iziboshwa, ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bagcine ugesi, nokukhuthaza ukuhweba nokuthekelisa. Sifuna futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni unikeza abantu kahle futhi ukuthi yonke imali echithwa inethonya elihle. Inselelo esibhekene nayo ibalulekile, kodwa uma sisebenza ngokuzikhandla, singathola imiphumela emihle ngokusebenzisa imali kahle nokutshalwa kwezimali ngokucophelela ukuze sikhulise umnotho waleli zwe ngo-6%. Nakuba isisekelo somnotho siqinile, sizobhekana nezinselelo eminyakeni emibili ezayo. Wonke umuntu eNingizimu Afrika kuzodingeka asebenze ngokuzikhandla, futhi labo abenza izinqubomgomo kufanele bacabange kahle. Ngakho-ke, izwe lizophumelela. Sizophumelela. Yini iBhajethi Kazwelonke? Unyaka nonyaka ngoFebhuwari, uNgqongqoshe WezeMali uveza izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokukhiqiza imali, ukuqoqa intela, nezindlela zokubolekwa kwemali eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Lokhu kubizwa ngeBhajethi Kazwelonke. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi uhulumeni uhlela kanjani ukuqoqa imali yentela nokubolekwa kwemali. Ibhajethi kazwelonke ihlukanisa izimali kumaphakheji kahulumeni kazwelonke, ezifundazweni, nasemaphandleni. Ukulungiselela iFIFA World Cup ka-2010 sekuyasebenza. Sakha izinkundla zemidlalo, izikhungo zokuzijabulisa, nezindawo lapho ababukeli bazohlangana khona ukuze babuke imidlalo. Siphucula izinhlelo zokuhamba zabantu abaningi. Konke okukhona mayelana nale midlalo kuyacatshangwa - ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi, ukusakazwa nokuxhumana, indawo yokuhlala yezivakashi, ukuhamba ukuze kuheha izivakashi emadolobheni, nokwenza amadolobha abe muhle. Kukhona futhi ukulungiselela izinsizakalo zezempilo nezinye izinkinga ezingase zivele. Kuzophinde kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphepha nokuqeqeshwa kwababambiqhaza, ukugcinwa kwemvelo, nokuphathwa kwemfucumfucu, kanye nolwazi mayelana nemidlalo nakho konke okukhona ngo-2010, kuhlelwe. Izimali ezengeziwe kufanele zihlukaniswe ukuze zilungiselele ukuhamba kwabantu abaningi abahlangene nemidlalo yeWorld Cup. Ukwanda kwemali yokuxhasa umphakathi engaphezu kuka-12 billion rand kuhlukaniswe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu abadinga usizo emphakathini - abadala, izingane, abakhubazekile, nabangakwazi ukuzisekela. Izimali zihlukaniswa ukuze zisetshenziswe emalini yabadala, izimali zabakhubazekile, izimali zezingane zabazali, nezimali zabantu abadinga usizo. Imali yabadala ibalulekile kakhulu ohlelweni lokuxhasa umphakathi. Kubantu abaningi abathola le mali, rely kuphela kuyo ukuze bathenge ukudla nezinye izinto ezisemqoka. Ngenxa yalokhu, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokwandisa le mali ngo-69 billion rand ukuze amadoda nawo akwazi ukuzuza kusukela eminyakeni engu-60, njengenjengabafazi. Ngo-2008/2009, izimali zezimali zabadala zizokhuphuka zibe ngu-9.6 billion rand, okuyi-10 percent yemali echithwa uhulumeni. Lokhu kwenza iNingizimu Afrika ibe enye yamazwe ahamba phambili ekubhekaneni nezidingo zabantu abadinga usizo. Kukhona nezinye izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisiza abadinga usizo. Izingane ezithola usizo lwezempilo azikhokhi imali yesikole. Izingane ezinezakwabo ezinzima nazo azikhokhi imali yesikole. Izingane zonke ezingaphansi kweminyaka emithathu azikhokhi ezikhungweni zokwelashwa noma ezibhedlela uma zikhuluma, futhi bonke abathola usizo lwezempilo basizwa ezibhedlela uma belimele futhi bengenayo inshurensi yezempilo.
Ukuhlinzeka ababhali bezinqubomgomo ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze bahlolisise ukusebenza kweMthetho Wenkqubo Yezobugebengu eNingizimu Afrika ngokusekelwe ezinzwaneni zesayensi. Izinguquko noma izichibiyelo ezidingekayo mayelana nezindlela nemithetho yokwethulwa kwezinsiza ezimfanele ezimweni zobugebengu, ibhayi nezindlela nemithetho yokwahlulela, iziboshwa ezilindele ukuhamba phambili, kanye nokugcwala eziboshweni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle nokusebenza kahle kohlelo lwezobulungiswa. Uma kudingeka, umhlangano wokuhlanganisa nokubambisana nabatholi bezinzuzo zeMthetho Wenkqubo Yezobugebengu, kufaka phakathi abamele iminyango kahulumeni, othisha ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, kanye nomphakathi wasemadolobheni. Ithimba lokubuyekeza ubulungiswa bezobugebengu (Ithimba Lokubuyekeza); kanye nethimba lokuphatha ubulungiswa bezobugebengu nocwaningo ngezindlela ezingasiza (Ithimba Locwaningo). Ukuqinisekisa ukusabalalisa imiphumela yokugcina kubo bonke ababambiqhaza abathintekayo. UNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo kumele abe uSihlalo weThimba Locwaningo. Ukukhulula yonke imiphumela ekhulumayo ngenhla. Ibhodi ehlinzeka ngosizo lwezomthetho; kanye nethimba labacwaningi abaqonda umsebenzi wabo, kuhlanganise neKomidi Lokulungisa Umthetho laseNingizimu Afrika. UMsunguli-Jikelele weMnyango wezeMthetho Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo kumele abe uSihlalo weThimba Locwaningo. Iofisi ye-secretariat kumele isungulwe ukuze ixhase amaThimba Ocwaningo Nokubuyekeza, futhi i-secretariat kumele ibekwe eMnyangweni wezeMthetho Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo. Umbiko wokugcina kumele uthunyelwe kuMongameli wezwe, unyaka owodwa kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lomhlangano weThimba, ngemibiko yesikhashana, uma kudingeka.
Uma ungavumelani, yiziphi izikhalazo onazo ngalolu hlelo? Ingabe umele inhlangano ethile? Lolu hlobo lokuhlola luqaliswe kuzo zonke izikole zikamasipala nezizimele, kanye nasezikoleni zikamasipala ezincane. Ulwazi oluqoqwe phakathi kwalesi senzo luhlanganisa idatha evela kubafundi kanye nenani labafundisi nabasebenzi kuleyo skholo. Ifomu elilungiselelwe ukuqoqa leli ulwazi kumele ligcwaliswe izikole ngosuku lweshumi ngemva kokuvulwa kwezikole, okusho ukuthi ngoJanuwari 24, 2000. Abaphathi bezikole bazonikezwa isaziso esanele esibazisa ngesikhathi inqubo izoqala. Abaphathiswa bazobamba izingxoxo nabafundisi nomphathi wesikole ukuze bazame ukucacisa iqiniso ngenani labafundi. Bazobuyekeza yonke imibhalo (amarejista ezifundo nezinhlu zezifundo) kanye nanoma yiziphi izincwadi noma amaphepha afanele, futhi benze ama-template ale mibhalo namaphepha uma kudingeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzoba nokuhlolwa nokubheka okuvele kwabafundi abakuleyo skholo ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokho okurekhodiwe, futhi inani lezifundo lizophinde libhekwe. Ukuvakashela izikole kuzothatha cishe amahora amabili kuya kwamathathu. Kuzokhethwa isampula engu-2% noma engu-3% yezikole ezikhona. Indlela yokukhetha izikole izokwenziwa ngokungahleliwe, kodwa kuzoqinisekiswa ukuthi zonke izingxenye nezinhlobo zezikole ziyavakashelwa.
Ukuze kuvinjelwe isimo lapho othisha bengatholakala bephikiswa ngokuziphatha okungafanele, kubalulekile ukuthi bazi ngezinga elisetshenziselwa ukunquma ukuthi yini ebhekwa njengokungafanele nokungamukeleki emsebenzini. a) baphikisa noma baphule imithetho yale mthetho noma eminye imithetho ethinta izindaba zemfundo; b) benza noma benze kwenziwe noma bavumele kwenziwe noma bafihle okuthile okungafanele okungadala ukuhlambalaza ekuziphatheni kwabo nasemkhakheni uMnyango owenza umsebenzi wawo emahhovisi nasemithonjeni; c) abalandeli imiyalelo, noma banqume ukuthi abazolandeli imiyalelo esemthethweni evela kumuntu onegunya, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngokuqhubekayo noma ngezinyathelo ezikhombisa ukungahloniphi; d) abaqhube imisebenzi yabo njengoba kuchaziwe yisikhundla abanakho kahle; e) baqhuba imisebenzi yabo yangaphandle ngaphandle kokuthola imvume kumqashi wabo, futhi uma le misebenzi ihlobene ngqo nomsebenzi wothisha; f) bazama ukufuna usizo kumuntu ongaphandle ongenamsebenzi kuhulumeni noma umuntu ongakhethiwe emkhandlwini mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabo kanye nesimo sabo sokusebenza; ngaphandle kokuthi le nsizakalo izosiza ekuletheni ukuvumelana kumuntu ohlelekile njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho Wokuxhumana Kwezabasebenzi noma ephalamende noma emthethweni wabo wesifunda; g) baziphatha ngendlela yokuhlambalaza, ngendlela engafanele, noma abakhombisi ukuhlonipha ngesikhathi somsebenzi noma bahlasela abanye ngokufuna izinzuzo zobulili nezinye izinhlobo zokuhlukumeza; h) baphuza utshwala noma ezinye izidakamizwa ngesikhathi somsebenzi; i) baxoxa ngezindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi ngendlela engafanele ngaphandle kwemvume yomqashi, noma basebenzise ulwazi lwabo ngalokhu ukwenza imisebenzi abangekho emsebenzini; j) abakhulumanga ngale mininingwane noma ngaphandle kwemvume yomqashi; k) bacele imali ngokwenza umsebenzi ongavunyelwe njengokufundisa, izihlobo zezimali kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngama-commissions, noma imivuzo nezinkokhelo zalolo msebenzi abawenzile abanalo ilungelo kulolo mali. Lezi zindaba zifaka nesimo lapho bengaphumeleli ukuveza kumqashi wabo ukuthi bathole le mali; l) basebenzisa izinsiza noma izikhungo zikahulumeni ngendlela engalungile; m) uma bengasebenzi emsebenzini ngaphandle kwesizathu esivumelekile; n) bakhuluma amanga noma benza izitatimende ezingamanga ngenhloso yokuthola amalungelo emisebenzi kanye nenhloso yokulimaza isithunzi nobungcweti kukahulumeni, noma uMnyango Wezemfundo noma noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi kahulumeni. A1. Uma umqashi ethola icala ngenkantolo noma ekhishwa, lokhu akusho ukuthi uMnyango awukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo zokudinga ngokomthetho kulokhu; futhi noma iyiphi ubufakazi obethulwe ngesikhathi sokuphikiswa, uma kutholakala kuyikho, abakhululi umqashi ekubeni nesibopho nguhulumeni ngokulandela izinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuxhumana Kwezabasebenzi. a) kumele babike ngesenzo esithathwe sokumisa umqashi ngummeli; b) kumele baziqinisekise uthisha ngezizathu ezaholela kulolo mkhuba; c) kumele banikeze uthisha ithuba lokukhombisa izizathu zokuthi kungani engafaneleki ukususwa, okumele kwenziwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kosuku olurekhodiwe edokhumenti.
IMIBUZO: Zonke imibuzo ephathelene nom contenido wale ndatshana kumele ithunyelwe ehhovisi lakho lesifunda. I-UGDE njengomqashi iyazi ukuthi ilungelo labasebenzi ukuhlinzekwa kahle njengoba kubhalwe kwiMthetho waseNingizimu Afrika nasemthethweni ophathelene nokwelashwa kwabasebenzi. Kungumthwalo womqashi nabasebenzi ukuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ze-LRA nokuhlonipha izibopho zabo kubaphathi babo ngalolu daba. Zonke lezi zikhwama zizoqala ngo-Okthoba 1, 1999. Amalungu ezinyunyana i-SAOU, i-NAPTOSA, i-PSA, i-PAWUSA, i-COSATU, nalabo beMnyango Wezemfundo ngaphansi kwe-COSATU, uma befisa ukuphikisa umqashi ngenxa yokuthi abathathanga ingxenye emhlanganweni, noma uma befisa ukusho ukuthi abahambelanga imibiko ethunyelwe ezinyunyeni zabo ngesikhathi beqondiswa ukwenza noma yini eyabavimbela ekwenzeni umsebenzi abaqashwe wona; kumele banikeze umqashi incwadi yokwazisa ethi abathathanga ingxenye emhlanganweni ngaphambi kosuku lukaSepthemba 15, 1999. Ehhovisi lesifunda, le ncwadi kumele inikezwe i-DEC, futhi kwezinye ehhovisi zendawo kanye nehhovisi elikhulu, kumele inikezwe abaphathi abaphezulu. [Funda okukhuluma kule ndatshana 30 no-130/1998 ukuze uthole amafomu adingekayo okugcwaliswa]. Izicelo zokuhamba ngezikweletu azizokwamukelwa umqashi ngesikhathi somhlanganweni, kuphela lezo ezenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi zamukelwe uma ziwukuhamba kwabantu abazoba nezingane, izicelo zokuhamba kokubeletha, nezicelo zabantu abagulayo uma umuntu egulile ngaphezu kwezinsuku eziyi-14, futhi uma lezi zicelo zokugula zikh accompanied by a letter or certificate from a doctor or other health provider. Labo basebenzi abenza kabi ngesikhathi somhlanganweni bazobhekana nezinyathelo zokuphatha. Noma yimuphi umsebenzi otholakala ethathwa engalungile emhlanganweni uzobhekana nezinyathelo zokuphatha futhi angase aphume emsebenzini wakhe. Inombolo ekhethekile yokuxhumana yezenzakalo nezicelo eziphathelene nalolu daba ngu-0800600933.
Okuqukethwe kwalolu documet kufanele kuqaliswe manje. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi phakathi konyaka ka-2000, kuzoba nezingezo noma izinguquko okuqukethwe kwalolu documet, futhi lezi zinguquko zizothunyelwa kuwe. Umphathi weSigaba seMfundo (HOD) unomsebenzi wokuphatha inqubo yokwamukela abafundi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwale nqubo kuhlanganisa izinto ezifana nokukhishwa kwamakhadi okudlulisela abafundi abahamba ezikoleni ezahlukene, ukuthunyelwa kolwazi lwabafundi esikoleni esisha, nokugcina irekhodi eliqukethe ulwazi mayelana nokwamukelwa kwabafundi esikoleni. U-HOD, ngalezi zisho, unika le msebenzi namandla kumphathi wesikole. Umphathi unikezwa ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi uzolandela izinqubo ezichazwe kulolu documet futhi aqhubeke nomsebenzi wokwamukela abafundi esikoleni, kodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi abeke phambili ukuthi bahloniphe izinqubomgomo eziphathelene nalokhu kanye namadokhumenti azothunyelwa esikhathini esizayo. QAPHELA: Akukhona umsebenzi noma indima yomphathi wesikole yokunquma ukuthi umfundi wamukelwa esikoleni noma cha. U-HOD unelungelo lokubopha umphathi otholakale engahambisanga nezinye izinto ezishiwo kulezi zinqubomgomo. Lokhu kuhambisana nokusungulwa kwezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kube lula ukufakwa kwabafundi ezingeni labantwana abancane. Lokhu kuhambisana nokubhaliswa kwabafundi uma isikhathi sokubhaliswa sesidlulile, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi laba bafundi bathola izindawo esikoleni ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambisana nokwabiwa kwezindawo zabafundi abanezinselelo zokungena ezikoleni zomphakathi noma ezimweni lapho uhlobo lesikole umfundi angangena kulo lushintshile. Hlola ukuthi abafundi bangaki abangafiki esikoleni uma laba bafundi besengaphansi kweminyaka okufanele bangene ngayo esikoleni. Bheka irekhodi lokubhaliswa kwabafundi, kanye ne rekhodi yokutholakala kwezindawo. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zokwamukela abafundi ezikhokhelwa abaphathi bezikole. Izinqumo kufanele zenziwe mayelana nokuthi kukhona yini isidingo sokuthi umfundi abhale ukuhlolwa ukusiza ekutholeni indawo esikoleni. I-SGB kufanele idale inqubomgomo ezosetshenziswa ekwamukeleni abafundi ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zomkhandlu kanye nezizwe mayelana nalolu daba. Le nqubo yokwakha le nqubomgomo kufanele ihambisane nezimiso ezichazwe kuMthetho Wezokufunda. Umzimba ophakamisayo kufanele unikeze umqondisi wesigaba inqubomgomo ebhaliwe yokwamukela abafundi ngaphambi kokuphela kukaApril ngonyaka, ukuze umqondisi akwazi ukuyibuyekeza futhi avume. Khuthaza abazali ukuthi bathumele izicelo zabantwana babo ukuze baqinisekise izindawo esikoleni ngaphambi kokuphela konyaka wesikole. Umfundi ofunda kulolo sikole futhi ehlose ukubuyela ngonyaka olandelayo kufanele azise isikole ngalokhu ngaphambi kokuphela kuka-October kulo nyaka, uma kusebenza. Isidingo salokhu asikwenzi ukuze kutholakale ukuthi bazokwamukelwa, kodwa kubalulekile njengoba kuzosisiza isikole mayelana nokuhlela inani lezifundo ezidingekayo kanye nenani labafundisi elidingekayo. Akukuvunyelwe ukukhokhisa imali ngalolu hlelo kubazali. Umfundi ofuna ukungena esikoleni okokuqala ekuqaleni konyaka wesikole kufanele abhaliswe kusukela ekuqaleni kuka-August kuze kube sekupheleni kukaSeptemba konyaka odlule ngaphambi konyaka wakhe wokuqala esikoleni. Abafundi abahlala ezindaweni ezingekho eduze nendawo lapho isikole sakhiwe khona bangabhaliswa, kodwa amagama abo azogcinwa ku-irekhodi labafundi abalindele ukutholakala; futhi bazokwaziswa ngaphambi kokuphela kuka-October kulo nyaka ababhaliswe ngawo ukuthi bayothola yini indawo esikoleni abahlanganyele khona. Umfundi ozothola ukwenqatshelwa kokwamukelwa esikoleni abahlanganyele khona uma leso sikole sesigcwele. Abazali kufanele banikezwe ifomu lokubhaliswa lapho bezohambisa amagama abantwana babo ukuze babhaliswe. Zonke izimali ezikhokhiswayo zokubhaliswa noma zokwamukela esikoleni kufanele zikhishwe kumamount okhokhwa abazali esikhathini esizayo. Uma umfundi engathathi indawo eyamukelwe esikoleni, izimali abakhokhile kufanele zibuyiselwe esikoleni. Imali yokubhaliswa akufanele idlule inani elikhokhwa ngenyanga kumamount okhokhwa. Akufanele kube khona umfundi ophuthumayo wesikole ongenqatshelwa ukufunda kulolo sikole ngenxa yokuthi abazali babo abakwazi ukukhokha imali yokubhaliswa noma idiphozi. Akufanele kube khona umfundi onqatshelwa indawo esikoleni ngenxa yokuthi abazali babo abahambisani nesitatimende somsebenzi wesikole, noma abahambisani nezixhumanisi zezimiso ezibhalwe ngesikole ezichaza umthetho wokuziphatha kwabafundi; noma banqatshelwe ukungena ngenxa yesivumelwano esithi abazali ngeke bakhokhe izindleko zesikole uma umonakalo wenzeka ngenxa yemfundo enikezelwe kumntwana wabo. QAPHELA: Umnyango uyazi ukuthi kunezikole ezisanda kuqala inqubo yokwamukela abafundi ngonyaka ka-2000, futhi ezinye zalezi zikole sezithumele imibiko emphakathini yokuthi azinazo izindawo zabafundi abafuna ukwamukelwa ngonyaka ka-2000. Le nqubo yalezi zikole iphula umthetho obekwe yile nqubomgomo. Nokho, uMphathi Wezemfundo (HOD) kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi inqubo yokwamukela abafundi yenziwa ngendlela efanele, futhi laba abazali ababhale izingane zabo esikoleni bazonikezwa izindawo abathole zona futhi ngeke kudingeke ukuthi baqale kabusha ngokubhaliswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, u-HOD usenelungelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi abahlala eduzane nendawo lapho isikole sakhiwe khona bangaba yilabo abathola izindawo esikoleni ngaphambi kokuthi abafundi abavela ezindaweni ezingaphandle kwendawo lapho isikole sakhiwe khona bamukelwe. Kufanele kucaciswe ukuthi umfundi wamukelwa emhlanganweni wezinto eziphelele ohlelweni lwesikole, futhi akufanele anqatshelwe ukufinyelela kwezinye izifundo zesikole, ukufinyelela emisebenzini kazwelonke, ezemidlalo, noma imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa esikoleni, futhi akufanele anqatshelwe umbiko wesikole noma amakhadi okudlulisela esikoleni esisha; noma aphathwe ngendlela ehlukile kulokho okubhalwe esigabeni 4. Ikhadi lokudlulisela litholwa esikoleni lapho umfundi efunda khona. Le khadi kufanele ithunyelwe ngeposi noma inikezwe umphathi wesikole esisha ngumuntu onegunya futhi ayikwazi ukunikezwa abazali noma umgibeli womfundi. Umphathi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinsiza ezisemthethweni zikhona ngempela. Uma ezinye zalezi zinsiza zingekho, kufanele kube nezingxoxo nomqondisi wesigaba; lapho-ke umfundi wamukelwa ngokwesikhashana izinyanga ezintathu ngesikhathi esikoleni. Ngesikhathi salokhu, isikole nomqondisi wesigaba kufanele babonise abazali indlela yokuthola lezi zinsiza ezidingekayo. Uma ekupheleni kwesikhathi sezinyanga ezintathu abazali bengakathumeli izinsiza ezidingekayo, umzimba ophakamisayo kufanele uxoxe nomqondisi wesigaba ukuze axazulule le nkinga. Kumele bathole okungenani "Kwenziwe Ngempela" emikhakheni emithathu esele yokufunda. Amamaki azogcwaliswa kumashidi wamamaki asebenzayo kuzo zonke izindawo zokufunda. Ukuhlola kuzokwenziwa. Izinhlelo zamamaki zizophathwa ekuqaleni konyaka omusha bese zisetshenziswa ukuqinisekisa ukuqhubeka ezikoleni. Kuzoba nesibopho sezinhlaka zokuhlola zesikole ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inqubo yokufaka amamaki esikoleni ihambisana nezindinganiso. Noma yini engaphandle kokukhethwa okudingekayo kanye nezabelo ezikhethekile ezisekelwe ezinhlotsheni zokuhlola zinganikezwa ezikoleni. Ukuqhubeka ngezikhala kuzosebenza ngokusekelwe ezimo ezibikiwe ezikoleni ezithintekayo. Isikole sidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezizathu ezichaza ubukhulu bokukhubazeka obuhambisana nezikhala. Bayakhululwa/benziwe bavumelekile emthethweni wezilimi ezimbili. Nokho, uma laba bafundi bethatha izilimi ezimbili, isigaba 3.4 sizosebenza. Uma umfundi ethatha kuphela ilimi elisemthethweni elilodwa, kumele athole okungenani "Kwenziwe Ngempela" ukuze ahlangabezane nezidingo zokuphakanyiswa kulolo limi lwezilimi ezimbili. Abafundi abanezinhlanga zokuzwa ezikhubazekile abathathi kuphela ilimi elisemthethweni elilodwa kumele futhi bathole okungenani "Kwenziwe Ngempela" ukuze bahlonishwe. Kumele bathole okungenani "Kwenziwe" kulolimi abathathayo kanye "Kwenziwe Ngempela" kokungenani kolunye (bona isigaba 2.3). I-Assembly Yezwe inezinhlaka eziningi zangaphakathi ezibhekene nokusebenza kwePhalamende. Izinhlelo ngokuvamile zinezakhamizi ezivele zikhona ePhalamende isikhathi eside. Ezinye izinhlelo zangaphakathi zifaka iKomidi Lokuhlela, elihlela umsebenzi we-Assembly Yezwe, iKomidi Lokubhekelela, kanye neKomidi Lezikhungo. I-National Council of Provinces nayo inezinhlelo zayo zangaphakathi. IKomidi Lezibopho kanye nezinhlelo zakhona zixoxa ngezinhlinzeko zokusebenza ze-NCOP, isabelomali se-NCOP, ukuvikelwa kwamalungu ePhalamende, ukuhlela kwangaphakathi, ezomhlaba jikelele, kanye nemithetho ethunyelwe. IKomidi Lokuhlela lihlela umsebenzi we-NCOP, kanti iKomidi Lezikhungo lenza izincomo mayelana nokusebenza kweZinhlelo kanye nezinye izinkundla ze-NCOP. Zihlinzeka ngePhalamende indawo yokuzwa ubufakazi nokuqoqa ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi wekomidi ethile. Ngokuvamile, izinhlelo zakhiwa ngokwezinga lokwakhiwa kwezikhala zamaphathi ePhalamende. Lokhu kuhloswe ukwethula uMthethosisekelo omusha weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nakho. Uhlu 6A, olwakhiwe ngaphambilini esigabeni 6 soMthethosisekelo, wakhanselwa ngesigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo sokulungiswa sika-2008. Uhlu 6B, olwakhiwe ngaphambilini kuHlu 6A, lufakiwe esigabeni 2 soMthethosisekelo sokulungiswa sika-2002, futhi lwaphinde lwabekwa inombolo yesigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo sokulungiswa sika-2003 futhi lwakhanselwa ngesigaba 5 soMthethosisekelo sokulungiswa sika-2008. Sikholelwa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyavuma kubo bonke abahlala kuyo, behlangene ekwehlukaneni kwethu. Sakha iNingizimu Afrika ehlangene ethuthukisa inqubo yokhetho futhi ithathe indawo yayo efanele njengombuso ozimele phakathi kwezizwe. UNkulunkulu abusise i-Afrika. UNkulunkulu abusise iNingizimu Afrika. Isithunzi somuntu, ukufinyelela ekuqondeni phakathi kwabantu, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo abantu kanye nezikhala. Ukuhlukaniswa okungafanele ngokobuzwe nangobulili. Ukubusa komthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho. Ilungelo lokuvota kubo bonke obalulekile, uhlu lwabo bonke abavoti, ukhetho okujwayelekile ngezikhathi ezibekwe, kanye nohlelo lukamasipala olusekelwe emandleni abantu oluvumela ukubamba iqhaza kwezepolitiki ezihlukene, ukuqinisekisa ukubekwa kwempumelelo, ukunakwa kwezidingo, kanye nensiza yomphakathi. Lo mthethosisekelo ungumthetho ophakeme weRiphabhulikhi; noma yimuphi umthetho noma ukuziphatha okungahambisani nawo awusebenzi, futhi izibopho ezibekwe ngawo kumele zifezwe. Kukhona ubuzwe obuvamile babantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Banelungelo elilinganayo lokubophela nezibopho ezihlobene nobuzwe. Umthetho kazwelonke kumele uhlinzeke ngokutholwa, ukulahleka, kanye nokubuyiselwa kobuzwe. I-anthem kazwelonke yeRiphabhulikhi inqunywa nguMongameli ngokwenza isikhumbuzo. Iflegi kazwelonke inemibala emnyama, igolide, eluhlaza, emhlophe, ebomvu, noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, njengoba kuchazwe futhi kuboniswe kuHlu 1. Izilimi zeVenda, Tsonga, Afrikaans, English, Ndebele, Xhosa, kanye neZulu. Ngokubheka ukwehla kokusetshenziswa kanye nesimo sezilimi zendabuko zabantu bethu, emlandweni, isimo kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezisebenzayo nezithuthukayo zokuphakamisa nokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi. (a) Uhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda bangasebenzisa noma yiziphi izilimi ezisemthethweni ezithile emsebenzini kahulumeni, bacabangela ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi, ukuvuma kwazo, izindleko, izimo zezifunda, kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezidingo nalokho okukhethiwe ngumphakathi jikelele noma esifundeni esithintekayo; kodwa uhulumeni kazwelonke noma uHulumeni bezifunda kumele basebenzise okungenani izilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni. Izindawo zamasipala kumele zihlinzeke ngezilimi ezisetshenziswa futhi zikhethwe ngabantu abahlala kuzo. Uhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda kumele baphathe futhi baphonsele inselelo ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ngokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye izinyathelo. Ngaphandle kokulimaza lokho okukhulunywe ngakho esigabeni (2), zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni kumele zihlonishwe ngokulinganayo futhi ziphathwe ngendlela efanele. kanye ne-Arabic, Hebrew, Sanskrit, nezinye izilimi ezisetshenziselwa izinjongo zenkolo eNingizimu Afrika. Le mthetho yamalungelo iyisisekelo senqubo yokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Igcizelela amalungelo abantu bonke ezweni lethu futhi iqinisa ukholo enhlanganweni yokhetho eqonda isithunzi somuntu, ukufana, kanye nenkululeko. Isimo kumele sihloniphe, sivikele, sikhuthaze, futhi siqedele amalungelo atholakala kuMthetho Wamalungelo. Amalungelo akhuluma kuMthetho Wamalungelo aphakanyiswa ezithintweni ezithile ezitholakala noma ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni 36, noma kwezinye izigaba zeMthetho. UMthetho Wamalungelo ubeka wonke umthetho futhi ubopha umthetho, umphakathi, umphakathi, kanye nazo zonke izikhungo zenkantolo. Umgomo kuMthetho Wamalungelo ubopha abantu abaphilayo kanye nalabo abaqashelwe ngumthetho njengabantu uma, futhi uma lokhu kungenzeka, kubhekwa ubunjalo balo mgomo kanye nanoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe ngalowo mgomo. bangathuthukisa amathuluzi omthetho asuselwa ezinqumweni nasezikhathini zokunciphisa ilungelo, kuze kube yilapho leyo mikhawulo ihambisana nesigaba 36(1). Labo abaqashelwe njengabantu ngumthetho banegunya lokuthola amalungelo kuMthetho Wamalungelo, ngendlela edingekayo ngohlobo lwamalungelo kanye nobunjalo balo msebenzi obhalwe ngumthetho. Wonke umuntu ufana phambi komthetho, futhi unelungelo lokuvikelwa okufanayo kanye nezinzuzo zomthetho. Ukulingana kufaka phakathi ukujabulela wonke amalungelo nezikhala ngokuphelele nangokulinganayo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukulingana, izinyathelo zingathathwa ukuze kudlule imithetho nezinye izinyathelo ezihlosiwe ukuvikela noma ukukhuthaza abantu noma amaqembu abantu abathintekile ngenxa yokuhlukumeza okungafanele. Isimo asikwazi ukuhlukumeza noma ubani ngendlela engafanele, ngokuqondile noma ngokuqondile, ngezizathu ezilodwa noma ngaphezulu, kuhlanganise ubuzwe, ubulili, ukukhulelwa, isimo somshado, imvelaphi yokwenziwa kwezinto, umbala, ukuhamba kwezocansi, ubudala, ukungakwazi, inkolo, umqondo, ukholo, isiko, ulimi, kanye nokuzalwa. Akekho umuntu ongahlukumeza omunye ngendlela engafanele ngezizathu ezilodwa noma ngaphezulu njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni (3). Umthetho kazwelonke kumele uphumelele ukuvimbela noma ukuvimbela ukuhlukumeza okungafanele. Ukuhlukumeza ngezizathu ezilodwa noma ngaphezulu ezishiwo esigabeni (3) akuvunyelwe ngaphandle kokukhombisa ukuthi leyo mikhawulo iyamukeleka. Wonke umuntu unokuhlukumezeka okujwayelekile nelungelo lokuthi isithunzi sabo sihlonishwe futhi sivikelwe. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila. futhi akufanele aphathwe noma aphunyuzwe ngendlela enobuhlungu, engabantu, noma ethusayo. futhi akufanele asetshenziswe ekwenzeni izivivinyo zezokwelapha noma zesayensi ngaphandle kwemvume yabo eyaziwayo. Akekho umuntu okufanele abhekwe njengomphakathi, aphathwe njengomphakathi, noma asetshenziswe ngokuphikisana nezifiso zabo. ukuphazamiseka kokuxhumana kwabo nabanye. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokukhululeka kwemizwa, inkolo, umcabango, ukholo, kanye nemibono. Ukusebenzisa lezi zikhala akufanele kuphuthunyiswe kodwa kufanele kube ngokuzithandela futhi kube mahhala. izinhlelo zomthetho zabantu nezizinda ngaphansi kwanoma yisiphi isiko noma ezikh
Sikholelwa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyabandakanya bonke abahlala kuyo, bahlangene nakuba sihluke. Sakhe iNingizimu Afrika ehlangene esebenza ngaphansi kwesigaba sokhetho esikhona sokuthola indawo yayo efanele njengelizwe elizimele phakathi kwemindeni yezizwe. Ngakhetha uNkulunkulu avikele abantu bethu. Nkosi, bless Afrika. UNkulunkulu abusise iNingizimu Afrika. Amaphupho abusise Afrika. Nkosi, busisa Afrika. Isithunzi somuntu, sisebenza ukuze kube nokulingana kwabantu nokuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo abantu kanye nenkululeko. Ukungakhethi ngokobuhlanga nangobulili. Ukuhlonishwa komthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho ophumelelayo. Ilungelo lokuvota kubo bonke abantu abadala, uhlu lwabo bonke abavoti, ukhetho ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile ezibekwe zokhetho kanye nohlelo lokuphatha olusebenza ngaphansi kwesigaba sokhetho esivumela ukubamba iqhaza kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ukuqinisekisa ukubhekelela, ukunakwa kwezidingo, kanye nensizakalo yomphakathi kuhulumeni. Lo Mthethosisekelo ungumthetho ophezulu weRiphabhulikhi; noma yimuphi umthetho noma isenzo esihambisana nawo awuvumelekile, futhi imiqathango ebekwe nguMthethosisekelo kufanele ilandelwe. Kukho ilungelo lokuba ngum citizen elilinganayo kubo bonke abakhokheli beNingizimu Afrika. Bakhokhelwa ngokufanayo ngokuqondene nezibopho nezibopho ezihambisana nokuba ngum citizen. Umthetho kazwelonke kufanele uhlinzeke ngokutholwa, ukulahleka, kanye nokubuyiselwa kokuba ngum citizen. I-anthem kazwelonke yeRiphabhulikhi izonqunywa nguMongameli ngokukhipha isikhumbuzo ku-Government Gazette. Iflegi kazwelonke inemibala emnyama, igolide, eluhlaza, emhlophe, ebomvu, kanye neblue, njengoba kuchazwe futhi kuboniswe ku-Schedule 1. Izilimi ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika yiSepedi, iSesotho, iSetswana, isiSwazi, isiVenda, isiTsonga, i-Afrikaans, isiNgisi, isiNdebele, isiXhosa, kanye nesiZulu. Ngokubheka ukwehla kwhistorical ekusetshenzisweni nasebuhleni bezilimi zendabuko zabantu bethu, isimo kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezisebenzayo nezithuthukayo zokuphakamisa isimo nokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi. Uhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda bangasebenzisa ezinye izilimi ezisemthethweni emsebenzini kahulumeni, ngokubheka ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi, ubunzima bokusebenzisa ezinye izilimi, izindleko, umongo wesifunda, kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwezidingo nezinketho zomphakathi jikelele noma esifundeni esithintekile; kodwa uhulumeni kazwelonke noma wesifunda kufanele usebenzise izilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni. Imiphakathi kufanele ibheke lezi zilimi ezisetshenziswe futhi zikhethwe ngababekhona emiphakathini ngayinye. Uhulumeni kazwelonke nohulumeni bezifunda kufanele baphathe futhi bahlola ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ngaphansi kwemigomo ye-subsection (2), zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni kufanele zihlonishwe ngokulinganayo futhi ziphathwe ngendlela efanele. Isi-Arabhu, isiHebheru, isiSanskrit, nezinye izilimi ezisetshenziswa ngezizathu zokholo ngokuvamile zisetshenziswa yimiphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Le Bill of Rights iyisisekelo sesimo sokhetho eNingizimu Afrika. Igcizelela amalungelo omuntu ngamunye ezweni lethu futhi iqinisa ukholo emsebenzini wokhetho obona isithunzi somuntu, ukulingana, kanye nenkululeko. Isimo kufanele sihloniphe, sivikele, sithuthukise, futhi sifeze amalungelo akwiBill of Rights. Amalungelo akwiBill of Rights angavinjwa ngokuhambisana nemigomo ethile noma ethintwa esigabeni 36, noma kwezinye izingxenye zeBill. I-Bill of Rights isebenza kuwo wonke umthetho futhi ibopha umthetho, umphakathi, umphakathi wezomthetho, kanye nazo zonke izingxenye zikaHulumeni. Imigomo kwiBill of Rights ibopha abantu bemvelo kanye nalabo abaqashelwa ngumlomo njengabantu uma, futhi uma lokhu kusebenza, kubhekwa ubunjalo balo lungelo nanoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe ngalolo lungelo. Uma izimiso zeBill of Rights zisebenza kubantu bemvelo nalabo abaqashelwa ngumlomo njengabantu, ngaphansi kwe-subsection (2), inkantolo ingathuthukisa umthetho ojwayelekile ukuze ivimbe ilungelo, kodwa lokho kuvimbela kufanele kuhambisane nesigaba 36(1). Labo abaqashelwe njengabantu ngumlomo banamalungelo kwiBill of Rights kuphela uma kudingeka ngokwemvelo yalolo lungelo nalolo msebenzi oqashelwe njengomuntu ngumlomo. Bonke balingana phambi komthetho, futhi banelungelo lokuvikelwa okufanayo kanye nezinzuzo zomthetho. Ukulingana kufaka phakathi ukujabulela wonke amalungelo kanye nezinkululeko ngokuphelele nangokulinganayo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufezwa kokulingana, izinyathelo zingathathwa ukuze kuqondiswe umthetho nezinye izinyathelo ezizwakalayo zokuvikela noma ukuthuthukisa abantu noma amaqembu abantu abathola ukungakhethi kahle. Isimo asikwazi ukungakhethi kahle kumuntu, ngqo noma ngokuqondile, ngezizathu ezimbalwa, kuhlanganise nobuhlanga, ubulili, ukukhulelwa, isimo somshado, ubuhlanga noma imvelaphi, umbala, ukujolisa kwezocansi, ubudala, ukungabi namandla, ukholo, umqondo, ukukholwa, isiko, ulimi, nokuzalwa. Akekho umuntu ongakhethi kahle omunye nganoma iyiphi indlela, ngqo noma ngokuqondile, ngezizathu ezimbalwa njengoba kuchazwe kwi-subsection (3). Umthetho kazwelonke kufanele udalwe ukuvimbela noma ukuvinjwa kokungakhethi kahle. Ukungakhethi kahle ngezizathu ezimbalwa ezibhalwe kwi-subsection (3) akuvumelekile ngaphandle kokuthi kuboniswe ukuthi lokho kungakhethi kahle kuyafaneleka. Bonke banesithunzi esisemqoka nelungelo lokuthi isithunzi sabo sihlonishwe futhi sivikelwe. Bonke banelungelo lokuphila. ukuba bangaphathwa noma bajeziswe ngendlela ebuhlungu, engabantu, noma ephansi. ukuba bangasetshenziswanga ezivivinyweni zezokwelapha noma zesayensi ngaphandle kwemvume yabo. Akekho umuntu ongabekwa ngaphansi kokukhululwa, umsebenzi, noma umsebenzi ophoqelelwe. ukuba bangaphazanyiswa ekuxhumaneni nabanye. Bonke banelungelo lokukhululeka kwemizwa, ukholo, umcabango, ukukholwa, kanye nemibono. ukuvakashela kulezo zinkonzo akufanele kuphoqwe kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokukhululeka nokukhetha. uhlaka oluthile lwezomthetho oluphatha abantu nemindeni kulezo zindawo ngaphansi kwanoma yisiphi isiko noma esihlonishwayo ngabantu abalandela ukholo oluthile. Ubudlelwano obuqashelwe noma umthetho womphakathi obamukelwe njengoba kuchazwe kwi-subsection (a), kufanele kuhambisane nezimiso zomthethosisekelo. inkululeko yemfundo kanye nenkululeko yokwenza ucwaningo. ukuvusa inzondo ngokobuhlanga, ubuhlanga, ubulili, noma ukholo okukhuthaza udlame. Bonke banelungelo lokuhlangana nabanye, ukuphikisa, ukuheha abanye ukuba basekele lokho kuphikiswa, nokwethula izicelo ezibhaliwe, kodwa uma lokho kwenziwa ngokuthula nangaphandle kwezikhali. Ngemva kweminyaka eyi-11 yokunqunywa eHhovisi leMphakathi (OPP) eMpumalanga Kapa, uMphakathi uNomsa Thomas usaqhubeka nokuthanda ukwenza okuthile ukuze aguqule izimpilo zomphakathi zibe ngcono. Ngakho-ke, uthando lukaMphakathi owenze umthelela, owazalwa futhi wakhulela eQueenstown, lungaka ukuthi uzokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ngisho nangaphandle kwezinsuku zokusebenza kulabo abadinga usizo. "Ngithola ugqozi lwami lapho ngishintsha indaba yobumpofu nokungathembeki ibe yimihla yokhope. Lokhu kunginika isizathu sokubheka phambili ngosuku olungcono kumuntu ojwayelekile emgwaqweni," kusho yena. "Imiphakathi yasemaphandleni esiyisebenzela ibona thina njengabavikeli ekulethweni kwezinsizakalo." Kusukela ebuncaneni, uMphakathi uThomas ubehlale ethanda ukubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umphakathi lapho abantu, kungakhathaliseki ngombala noma umbono, baphila mahhala, benethuba elilinganayo endaweni ephephile. Empeleni, kube yinye yezinkinga ezingalingani kuhulumeni wobandlululo eyamkhuthaza ukuba acabangele umsebenzi kwezomthetho. Ubelieve ukuthi iHhovisi leMphakathi liyisikhungo esibalulekile esinikezwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isifiso sezingxenye eziningi sithathwa phambili futhi sifezwe. Nakuba uMphakathi uThomas ekholelwa ukuthi isu lehhovisi lokwakha ubudlelwano nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni libalulekile, uyashesha ukuveza ukuthi ihhovisi kufanele, nokho, lihlale lizimele futhi lingavumi. "I-OPP kufanele ibe yisikhuthazi ekuphathweni komphakathi esinethonya elihle elenza isifiso sezingxenye eziningi sibe sobala kubantu abajwayelekile," kusho yena. Ngenkathi esendaweni enezinhlelo eziningi, uMphakathi uThomas akanasikhathi sokungasebenzi, nokho, uma ethola isikhathi sokuphumula, uvame ukufunda futhi "faka izandla emhlabathini." Unothando lokusebenza komphakathi futhi udlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni iqembu lokusekela i-HIV/AIDS, iVukume. Ezinye zezinto azithandayo zihlanganisa ukudlala i-squash, i-rugby, i-chess, nokuvakasha ejimini, lapho enza khona kahle emkhakheni wokuzivocavoca.
Uphiko lwe-SATI lubambe umhlangano walo wakamuva ngomhla kaFebhuwari 14, 2009. Nansi isifinyezo sezihloko ezisemqoka ezaxoxwa. Iningi lezingxoxo emhlanganweni belihlobene neMthethosisekelo kanye nohlaka (lwalolu hlangano) lokuhamba phambili. Amalungu azokwaziswa ngesikhathi esifanele mayelana nezichibiyelo eziphakanyisiwe kuMthethosisekelo, futhi isimemo sokunikezwa kwamagama abantu abazofakwa kuluphiko nasezinhlelweni eminyakeni emibili ezayo sizothunyelwa maduze. Izigaba nemithetho mayelana nale Mklomelo seziqediwe, futhi isimemo sokuhlonza lezi zigaba sizothunyelwa ngoMashi. Khumbula ukuthi umklomelo ojwayelekile usuphakanyisiwe, futhi manje imiklomelo yomuntu siqu izonikezwa kulezi zigaba: ukubhala izincwadi, okungelona iqiniso, izincwadi zezingane, ukuhumusha kwemisebenzi, nezichazamazwi. Amalungu akhuthazwa ukusabalalisa ulwazi ngalolu Mklomelo kanye nesimemo sokunikezwa kwamagama phakathi kwabathengi nabanye abangase babe nentshisekelo. Umcimbi wemiklomelo uzokwenzeka ngoSepthemba 2009 (cishe ngesikhathi esifanayo neSuku Lomhlaba Lokuhumusha). Imali yokufunda ye-SATI engama-R25,000 inikezwe abafundi abane kule nyanga yokufunda ka-2009. Imali ethunyelwa kumalungu angena kuMfundisi Wokuthuthukiswa isetshenziselwa ukusiza abafundi abangenayo enye indlela yok继续 ukufunda ukuhumusha. Kwavunyelwana ukuthi kusukela ngonyaka ozayo, izicelo zabafundi bonyaka wokuqala zizokwamukelwa. Amalungu akhunjuzwa ukuthi kukhona nezinto ezicabangwayo mayelana nezicelo zokufunda eziphathelene nezifundo ezimfishane. Ikhompiyutha yoktraining okwamanje iqhuba uphenyo lokuhlonza izidingo zokuqeqeshwa zamalungu, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezifundo ezimfishane ezihlobene nokuhumusha. Lokhu kuzothunyelwa kumalungu maduze. Ikhompiyutha yewebhusayithi ibike ukuthi inguqulo ephelele ye-Afrikaans yewebhusayithi ye-SATI kulindeleke ukuthi iqale ukusebenza maphakathi no-April. Ukuhumusha kuXhosa naseTswana kuzophinde kuqhubeke, nakuba kuhamba kancane. Amalungu akhuthazwa ukuba azinikele ukusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le webhusayithi temsilwe zonke izilimi ngokulinganayo. Ngaphandle kokuthi, sithathe isinqumo sokuphelisa isivumelwano i-SATI enaso ne-NAATI (i-Australian National Accreditation Authority for Translators and Interpreters), esivumele ukuvunywa kwemisebenzi yabahumushi abasebenza nezilimi ezisetshenziswa kancane kuleli, ngenxa yemithetho emisha e-NAATI kanye nezindleko zokuhlola eziphakeme kakhulu. Amalungu akhunjuzwa ukuthi kuzoba nephephabhuku elikhethekile kuwebhusayithi ye-SATI elizobala imininingwane yabahumushi abafuna ukwenza izinsizakalo zabo zitholakale kule Mqhudelwano Womhlaba. Uma ungakathumeli ulwazi lwakho futhi ufuna igama lakho libonakale kuleli phephabhuku, sicela uxhumane nehhovisi le-SATI ngokushesha okukhulu. Umhlangano olandelayo wobuholi uzoba ngoJuni 2009. Nansi thina, sesingene esikhathini sesibili sonyaka. Sithemba ukuthi kuzoba unyaka ojabulisayo, onempilo, futhi ophumelelayo kubo bonke amalungu. Ndawonye, kukhona okuningi esingakwenza ukuze sifinyelele emsebenzini wethu - asizweni uma unazo izimvo mayelana nezinsizakalo le Nhlangano okufanele iyinikeze. Khumbula ukuthi imali yokuba yilungu yale nyaka kumele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kokuphela kukaMashi. Amarekhodi athunyelwa ngoDisemba. Uma ungakawatholi, ucela ukuthi uxhumane nehhovisi le-SATI ukuze uthole ikhophi. Khumbula ukuthi ubulungu bezinkampani buyatholakala mayelana nezinsizakalo nezihhovisi. Siyabonga kulabo balungu abakhokhile. Ucelwa ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi uyazisa umregistrar ngokuqhubeka kokukhokha kwakho. Imiphumela yocwaningo lwamakhono olwakamuva iboniswe kuwebhusayithi ye-SATI. Amalungu ayakhumbulelwa ukuthi lezi azikho "ezisemthethweni" noma "ezibekiwe." Ngokomthetho, asivunyelwe ukusetha amanani. Lokho esikwenza ukuqoqa ulwazi lokuthi yini evame ukukhokhwa futhi senze lelo lwazi lutholakale. Ngakho-ke, sicela amalungu angasho ukuthi "i-SATI iphakamisa lezi zintengo." Amalungu nabanye bangazisebenzisa ukuze baqhathanise namazinga abo, kodwa kufanele bazi ukuthi kuzohlala kukhona abaqashi abakhokhayo ngaphezu noma ngaphansi kwalezi zintengo. Umfazi owayengumfelokazi owayesebenza eMali Yokubuyiselwa uthole inzuzo yephenshini yom husband wakhe emva kokungenelela kukaMphakathi Ovikela, uLawrence Mushwana. Ihhovisi likaMphakathi Ovikela (OPP) limemezele ukuqala kokuhlola ukulibaziseka okungafanele ekukhokheni izinzuzo yiHhovisi leMali Yabasebenzi (GEPF) kanye neMali Yokubuyiselwa kumlamuli, uNkk. M du Toit. Lokhu kwenzeka ngemva kokuthi i-OPP ifunde ukuthi uNkk. M du Toit, owayesebenza futhi eMali Yokubuyiselwa, wayesalindele izinzuzo okufanele azithole, ezinyangeni ezintathu emva kokushona komyeni wakhe. Izinzuzo zazingenakukhokhwa naphezu kokuthi ube esefake yonke imibhalo edingekayo njengoba kuchaziwe emthethweni weMali Yabasebenzi. Izinzuzo ezazifanele ukukhokhwa kuye zifaka phakathi ipenshini ye-GEPF kanye nezinsiza zokufa ezivela eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi, ngaphansi kwalokho iMali Yokubuyiselwa iphakathi. Phakathi kokuhlola, kwatholakala ukuthi ukulibaziseka kwakubangelwa ukuthi umufi wayengabhaliswanga njengomtaxi ngokuhambisana nomthetho we-Income Tax Act ka-1962. Umthetho ufunela ukuthi noma ubani othola imali engaphezu kuka-R120,000 ngonyaka kufanele akhokhe intela. Isikhundla somufi emsebenzini kanye nemholo yakhe kudlule lesi sikhawu. Ngalesi sizathu, imiyalelo yentela mayelana nezinsiza zokufa yanqatshelwa uma ifakwe kwiNhlangano Yezimali yaseNingizimu Afrika (SARS), nokho, umlamuli wathathwa njengokungatholanga noma iyiphi imiyalezo mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwe yi-GEPF. Mayelana nezinsiza zokufa, kutholakale ukuthi uMnyango Wezabasebenzi awulandanga lokho okukhulunywe ngakho kuMthetho 7 weKhansela Lezabasebenzi ka-2000. Umthetho uthi uma kwenzeka ukufa, izinsiza zokufa kufanele zikhokhwe kubantu abanikazi ababelwe, futhi uma kungekho abanikazi ababelwe, kufanele zikhokhwe kumakoti noma kumlingani womufi. Ngemva kokungenelela kwe-OPP, i-SARS yabeka usuku lokuhlangana noNkk. Du Toit. Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-24, uNkk. Du Toit nomyeni wakhe baphakanyiswa njengabathengi bentela, futhi amafomu okuhlola intela afakwe, ngaleyo ndlela kuqondiswa indlela yokukhokhwa kwezinzuzo okufanele azithole. Uphinde wagqugquzela uMnyango Wezabasebenzi ukuthi uqinisekise ukuthi izinhlinzeko zeMthetho 7 ka-2000 mayelana nokukhokhwa kwezinsiza zokufa zilandelwa.
Abahlali be-Unit R no-S eLebowakgomo township eLimpopo, abanye babo bebelinde izindlu ze-Reconstruction and Development Programme (RDP) kusukela ngo-1996, bangase bathole ukuthi ukulinda kwabo okude sekuphela. Lokhu kuza kulandela uphenyo lweHhovisi leMphakathi (OPP) mayelana nokwehluleka kweMnyango wezeMisebenzi yezeMvelo, Izindawo Zokuhlala kanye Nezindaba Zendabuko eLimpopo ukufeza umthwalo wawo wokwakha izindlu ze-RDP kulolu hlelo. Le ndaba yethulwe ku-OPP nguMphakathi wendawo, uMnu. Frans Letwaba, owethule le ndaba kubahlali. Abafakizicelo bathumele izicelo zabo zokwesekwa kwezezimali kusukela ngo-1996 kuya ku-2006. Izicelo zabo z processingwe nguMnyango ngaphansi kohlelo lokwesekwa kwezezimali olubizwa nge-Project Linked Subsidy. Lolu hlelo lwanikezwa inkampani ebizwa ngokuthi i-COMDEV, eyahluleka ukwakha izindlu noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinto zokwakha. Kwatholakala ukuthi ingxenye yezindlu ezakhiwe yayiyingxenye kuphela yezinto zokwakha ezazimele ukuhlinzekwa kwabanye ababehloswe ukuwuthola lo msebenzi. Umnyango utholakala unecala lokwehluleka ukwakha izindlu noma ukuhlinzeka ngezinto zokwakha kubabikeli ukuze bakhe izindlu zabo. Uphenyo lwe-OPP luthole ukuthi izicelo zezimali zababikeli z processingwe kusukela ngo-1997 kuya ku-2006. Abanye bababikeli bakhetha ukwakha izindlu zabo ngezinsiza zabo, kanti abanye bashiya ingxenye yezakhiwo zokuhlala besebenzisa izinto zabo. U-Mphakathi ulethe isiphakamiso sokuthi uMnyango kufanele wakhe izindlu kubo bonke abazuzi ababehloswe ukwakhiwa kwezicelo zabo z processingwe ngo-2006 noma ngaphambi kwalokho. UMnyango kufanele uqedele izindlu ezishiywe zingaphelile futhi uhlinzeke ngezinto zokwakha kubo bonke abazuzi ababehloswe ukwakhiwa kwezicelo zabo. Uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi uMnyango usize abafakizicelo abaqalile ukwakha ukuze baqedele izindlu zabo bona, kodwa behluleka ukwenza kanjalo futhi bahlawule bonke labo abake bakha izindlu zabo ngaphandle kosizo lwemnyango ngemuva kokuthi sebekhishwe njengabazuzi.
IKOMISHINI YOKWENZA KUPHUMELELA KWESIKHATHI SOKUFIKELA KULWAZI NENDAWO YEKOMISHINI YOKWENZA KUPHUMELELA KWESIKHATHI SOKUFIKELA KULWAZI. Ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokuphakanyiswa Kwefayela Lokufinyelela Kulwazi, uMthetho No. IKomishini Yezinsizakalo Zomphakathi (PSC) iyisikhungo somphakathi esizimele esisunguliwe ngokweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. I-PSC inenhloso yokuhlola, ukubheka, nokuhlola ukuhlela nokuphatha imisebenzi kahulumeni. Le mthethosisekelo ifaka phakathi ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle noma okungasebenzi kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni. Ngaphezu kwamandla akhuluma ngenhla, i-PSC inenhloso yokuphakanyiswa kwezindlela zokwenza imisebenzi yeHulumeni ibe nekhono nelungelo, nokuphakanyiswa kwemigomo nemigomo yokuphatha umphakathi njengoba ibhalwe kwiMthethosisekelo kuyo yonke imisebenzi kahulumeni. IKomishini ithola amandla ayo ezigabeni 195 no-196 zeMthethosisekelo ka-1996. Isigaba 195 sichaza izimiso nemigomo ephethe ukuphathwa komphakathi okumele iKomishini iphakamise. Izinga eliphakeme lezemfundo. Ukusetshenziswa kahle, okungabizi, nokusebenza kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuphathwa komphakathi okuhloswe ukuthuthukiswa. Izinsizakalo kumele zinikezwe ngendlela engakhethi, ngendlela efanele, ngendlela efanele, futhi ngaphandle kokwehluleka. Kumele ziphendule ezidingweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi kumele ukhuthazwe ukuba ube nengxenye ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kumele kube nekhono. Ukuveza kufanele kuphakanyiswe. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu okuhle kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi kumele kukhuthazwe. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kumele kuqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokusebenza futhi uphatha abasebenzi ngokwekhono, ukucabanga okuzimele, ubuqotho, nokulungisa ububi obudlule. Ukuphakanyiswa kwemigomo nemigomo yokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 95 soMthethosisekelo kuyo yonke imisebenzi yeHulumeni. Ukuhlola, ukubheka, nokuhlola ukuhlela, ukuphatha, nokusebenza kwabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ukulandela izimiso nemigomo echazwe esigabeni 195, kanye nasekusebenzeni kukahulumeni. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke nelasezindaweni mayelana nezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukuveza imiphumela nezincazelo okungenani minyaka yonke kwiZigaba Zikazwelonke noma kwiZigaba Zasezindaweni njengoba zenzeka. Ukuveza izindaba eziphuthumayo ezihlobene nomsebenzi kumaphoyisa afanele abhekelele. Ukuhlola izikhalazo zabasebenzi nokwenza iziphakamiso ezifanele zokulungisa. Ukwenza umsebenzi nokuqinisekisa izinga. Lezi zingxenye zihlelwe zibe yizinhlelo ezimbili, okungukuthi: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Okuxhumene Nabasebenzi; kanye Nokubheka Nokuhlola Umsebenzi Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Ezinye zezincwadi ezikhiqizwe yi-PSC zifaka phakathi, phakathi kokunye, Isimo Sezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, Ucwaningo Lokwaneliseka Kwabantu, Ukulinganisa Ukusebenza Kwe-National Anti-Corruption Hotline, kanye Nokuhlaziywa KweMikhankaso Yokuphatha i-HIV/AIDS ne-TB Ezinsizakalweni Zomphakathi. Uhlu oluhlanganisa zonke lezi zincwadi ezikhiqizwe yi-PSC lutholakala esigabeni 15 se-PSC/OPSC futhi lutholakala futhi kwi-website ye-PSC, www.psc.gov.za. IKomishini isunguliwe ngokweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. IMthethosisekelo ifuna iKomishini eyodwa yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enamalungu alishumi nane, amahlanu awo athunyelwe nguMongameli ngokuhlonishwa kweZigaba Zikazwelonke, kanti ilungu elilodwa elivela esifundazweni ngalinye lithunyelwa nguMphakathi wesifunda. IKomishini ibophelelwe kwiZigaba Zikazwelonke okufanele ibike okungenani minyaka yonke. Kumele futhi ibike ngemicimbi yayo ezindaweni kumazinga asezindaweni. Ngokuhambisana neMthethosisekelo njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, i-PSC inamalungu alishumi nane: amaKomishina amahlanu avela ePretoria kanye nelungu elilodwa elivela esifundazweni ngalinye. I-PSC ixhaswa yiHhovisi leKomishini Yezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, elikhokhelwa nguMqondisi-Jikelele (ongumsebenzi ophethe). Njengoba kudingeka, uMongameli uthumela amalungu alishumi nane. Isakhiwo sokuphatha se-PSC sihlela ukulandela izinhloso zayo ezicacile nezindawo zayo zokusebenza. Umsebenzi weKomishini uhlelwe ube yizigaba zayo eziyisithupha zokusebenza njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwenqaku 1 ngenhla. Isimo sakhe sathola ukunakwa kweHhovisi leMphakathi Ovikela (OPP) ngoMeyi 2009 ngemuva kokuthi iphephandaba lendawo eLimpopo, iCapricorn Voice, lishicilele indaba yakhe. I-OPP yashesha yangenelela futhi yaqala uphenyo ngalolu daba. Uphenyo lwathola ukuthi ukuziphatha kwe-SASSA akuhambisani nezidingo njengoba bekungekho sizathu sokumiswa kwe-grant yakhe njengomamukeli. Kuphinde kwatholakala ukuthi akuphumelelanga ukunikwa ezinye izindlela zokuziphilisa yena nomndeni wakhe ngenkathi i-grant yakhe imisiwe. Ngemuva kokutholakala kwephenyo, uMphakathi Ovikela wabhala kumphathi ophezulu we-SASSA, ephakamisa ukuthi i-grant yokuphila kaNkk. Mphephu ibuyiselwe futhi akhokhelwe izinkokhelo zeminyaka emithathu ezisemva kanye nezinsalo. "Umphathi wesifunda we-SASSA eLimpopo kufanele aqashe ithimba lokusebenza, njengoba kuthethiswa, ukuze lihlolisise ukumiswa kwezi-grant ngenxa yokusetshenziswa kwezibalo ze-ID ezifanayo ngabantu abaningi ngokushesha," kusho uMphakathi Ovikela. Uphinde waphakamisa ukuthi i-SASSA inikeze abamukeli abanezi-grant ezimisiwe amaphakheji okudla ngenkathi uphenyo lwenziwa ukuze ibasize baphile ngenkathi iSocial Security Agency ixazulula udaba oluholele ekumweni kwe-grant. U-Mphakathi Ovikela uphinde waphakamisa ukuthi i-SASSA ithole izindlela zokuphothula uphenyo lwayo phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu ngemuva kokumiswa kwe-grant.
Omphefumulo wesifazane ophakathi kwezobulungiswa uthole imali ephelele eyasuswa emalini yakhe yokuthola umhlalaphansi njengengxenye yokuhlanganiswa kwezikweletu zomnyango. Umprotector womphakathi uLawrence Mushwana uncome ukuthi ummangali abuyiselwe le mali kanye nenzalo, ebaliwe kusukela ngosuku lokuthi kwenziwa ukususa. Lokhu kwenzeka ngemuva kokuhlolwa kweHhovisi leMphakathi Protector kwatholakala ukuthi inqubo echazwe kuMqulu Womhlalaphansi Wabasebenzi Bakahulumeni (GEPF) yokuhlanganisa izikweletu zomnyango ngokweSahluko 21 soMthetho Womhlalaphansi Wabasebenzi Bakahulumeni ka-1996 (GEPF Act) ayilandeliwe. Kutholakala futhi ukuthi isinqumo sokubuyisela izimali zomnyango emalini yokuthola umhlalaphansi yommangali asihambisani nezidingo zeSahluko 3 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukuhlela Kwezokuphatha ka-2000 futhi ngakho "kwenziwe ngokuphambene nenqubo." Umkhulumeli weNdlu YezamaPhalamende wacelwa ukuba athathe izinyathelo ngokumelene noNgqongqoshe Osenhliziyweni Yezangaphakathi, uMalusi Gigaba, ngokungahambisani nezibopho zakhe zomthethosisekelo zokubambisana neHhovisi leMphakathi Protector. Lokhu kwenzeka ngemuva kokuthi uMnu. Gigaba ehluleka ukubambisana ne-OPP ekuhloleni izinsolo zokuthi uthumele izimbali kumkakhe ngezindleko zendawo futhi akhokhe amathikithi nezokuthutha kwabanye abantu ngezikhathi eziningi. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, uMprotector womphakathi uLawrence Mushwana uncome ukuthi umkhulumeli athathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwehluleka kukaMnu. Gigaba kulungiswa. Nakuba ukuhlola kuthole ukuthi izindleko ezithathwe ihhovisi likaMnu. Gigaba mayelana nezimbali ezithunyelwe kumkakhe zazingafaneleki, zange zibe nomphumela omuhle, futhi zaziphuma emalini, kutholakala futhi ukuthi izinsolo eziphathelene nezindleko zokuhamba ezithathwe ihhovisi likaNgqongqoshe zazingekho. U-Advocate Mushwana uphinde wancome ukuthi uMphakathi-Jikelele woMnyango, uMavuso Msimang, athuthukise izindlela zokuphatha ezimali ehhovisi likaMnu. Gigaba. IKomidi Lezabasebenzi lePhalamende elibhekelela amandla kufanele lilandele futhi libike njalo futhi libuyisele ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo eziphakanyisiwe yiNhlangano Yezamandla YaseNingizimu Afrika (NERSA) ngoMeyi 2008 ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwezinkinga zokushoda kukagesi. Uhlelo lokuphakamisa ukuthi kungabikho izinguquko ezenziwayo ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwangaphambilini okuqale iHhovisi mayelana nezimo zokushoda kukagesi nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ugesi ngumnikazi wombuso, u-Eskom, umprotector womphakathi wacela uMphakathi weNdlu YezamaPhalamende ukuba athathe izinyathelo mayelana nalokhu. Ingxenye enkulu yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekane nokushoda kukagesi nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ngenxa yokukhishwa kwezinsiza kusukela ngoJanuwari 2007 kuze kube nguFebhuwari 2008. "Imiphumela nezinsizakalo eziphakanyisiwe zalesi sihlolo zikhombisa ukuthi kube nokulibaziseka ngakolunye uhlangothi kukahulumeni ekuthuthukiseni amandla okukhiqiza ugesi kwe-Eskom ngenkathi futhi kunikezwa izixolelo zomphakathi mayelana nezinkinga ezidalwe ukukhishwa kwezinsiza," kusho u-Advocate Mushwana. Uthe i-NERSA, njengomphakathi ophathisa imithetho eqinile ethuthukiswe nguMthetho Wokulawula ugesi ka-2006, inamandla namandla okuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke iziphakamiso ezenziwe embikweni wayo zifezekiswa futhi ukuthi i-Eskom ihambisana nezimo zelayisensi yayo nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho.
Kuyiqiniso elaziwayo ukuthi izwe lethu, njengamanye amaningi emhlabeni, libhekene nokwehla komnotho. Igama elithi "ukwehla" sekuwumusho ojwayelekile futhi ngandlela thize, sonke sithinteka kulokhu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlangabezana nezinkinga zomnotho, ezidinga ukuba siqinisekise ukuthi sikhona ngokwezimali, ihhovisi lami liqhubeka nokusebenza ngezikhalazo eziphathelene nokumiswa kwemali yokuthola umhlalaphansi. Abatholi balemali bangabantu abadala, abavame ukuba phakathi kwemiphakathi ethwele kanzima ephila ngaphansi kwezinga lokuphila. Omunye umphumela wokumiswa kwemali yokuthola umhlalaphansi nguMnu. Mphephu ovela eLimpopo, oneminyaka engu-86, imihlalaphansi yakhe yemisiwe cishe eminyakeni emithathu ngenxa yokuthi kukhona okukhuluma ukuthi usebenzisa inombolo yokuhlonza yomunye umuntu evela esifundazweni saseFree State. Ngemva kokungenelela kwehhovisi lami, imihlalaphansi kaMnu. Mphephu yabuyiselwa futhi uthole izinkokhelo zakhe eziphakeme. Ngiyakhuthaza iNhlangano Yezokuphepha Komphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika eLimpopo ukuba ibize ithimba lokuhlola udaba lokumiswa kwemali yokuthola umhlalaphansi njengoba kubonakala kuyinkinga ejwayelekile. Ukwenziwa kwalezi ziphakamiso kuzoba usizo olukhulu. Ngenkathi uhulumeni eqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali oluncane lwezindlu kulabo abadingayo, izinselelo zisekhona kulowo mkhakha. Ihhovisi lami muva nje lihlola isikhalazo esivela kubantu base-Unit R nase-S eLebowakgomo mayelana nokwehluleka kokwakha noma ukuqedela izindlu ze-RDP zomphakathi nguMnyango Wezokubambisana Nezindaba Zamasiko eLimpopo. Iziphakamiso ezivela ehhovisi lami zazithi uMnyango kufanele wakhe futhi aqedele izindlu kubo bonke abatholi abavunyelwe izicelo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imali yokuxhaswa yamanje kufanele isetshenziswe ukusiza abakhala njengoba izindleko zokwakha zikhuphukile eminyakeni edlule. Ukubika ubugebengu kuqinise ngempela imiphakathi, ngakho-ke ihhovisi lami lihlola isikhalazo esivela kumuntu ophikisanayo mayelana neNhlangano Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS) ngokwehluleka kwabo ukugcwalisa promises yabo yokukhokha u-R75,000 njengemivuzo ngemuva kokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eholele ekubanjweni nasekugwetshweni kwenhlangano yokweba. Ngemva kokuhlola, ngiphakamise ukuthi i-SAPS ikhokhe umphikisi umvuzo ophelele njengoba bekupromisiwe futhi bagcine izithembiso zabo esikhathini esizayo. Sikhuthaza ukuba uveze izikhalazo zakho; ihhovisi lethu likhona ezindaweni ezahlukene ezweni futhi sinefoni yokuxhumana engenamali: 0800 11 20 40 ongayisebenzisa ukufaka isikhalazo. Sibheke phambili ekusebenzeni nawe ukuze siqinise isifiso sabantu njengomyalelo wombuso.
Ngokuhambisana nezinto ezintsha zobuchwepheshe, iMnyango Wezokumaketha weMnyango Wezolimo, Uhlanga Nezokudla (DAFF) wethule i-Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) yokuthola ulwazi lwemakethe ngonyaka odlule ngoSepthemba. Le program ihlose ukusiza abalimi nabanye abangenayo ukufinyelela ku-inthanethi ukuze bathole ulwazi lwemakethe. Phambilini, iAgricultural Market Information System (AMIS) etholakala ku-inthanethi yayiyinsiza kuphela yokuthola ulwazi lwemakethe eyayifinyelelwa abalimi abane-inthanethi. Manje, ulwazi olusetshenziswa abalimi olwalutholakala kuphela ku-inthanethi lungafinyelelwa ngefoni ephathekayo. Ngalesi siza, ngisho nabelimi basemaphandleni abangena-inthanethi bangakwazi ukuthola ukuthi imikhiqizo yabo ibiza malini uma kuqhathaniswa nezintengo ezifanayo emakethe. Ngezitshalo ezingu-157 nezintengo zezilwane ezimakethe eziyi-16, abalimi banokukhetha okuningi lapho benquma izintengo zemikhiqizo yabo. "Le nsizakalo ivumela abalimi ukuba benze izinqumo ezicacile zokuthengisa ngaphambi kokuthi baye emakethe futhi ayidingi ukuba bahlale endaweni ethile noma babe ne-inthanethi," kusho uBilly Morokolo, umphathi wesigaba sokumaketha, ekhuthaza abalimi ukuthi basebenzise le nsizakalo. Uqhubekile ekhuthaza ukuthi bangazizwa behlulekile ngenxa yezindleko eziphezulu ngoba ulwazi luyabiza ngempela. Le nsizakalo ibiza ama-senti angama-60 ngomzuzu, futhi ithatha ngaphansi kwemizuzu emibili ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ezwakalayo. Le nsizakalo iyatholakala kunoma iyiphi ifoni ephathekayo futhi iyatholakala kunoma yimuphi umhlinzeki wesevisi yefoni ephathekayo njenge-MTN, CellC, kanye neVodacom. Isebenza ngokuphelele ngezingcingo futhi ayifani ne-SMS. Le program iphendula ngesikhathi sangempela. Zonke iziqondiso zeprogram zizovela efoni yakho ephathekayo, futhi ilindele umsebenzisi ukuthi aphendule, okufana nemishini yokubhanga ye-ATM. Lezi zinyathelo ezilula zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi noma ubani ofuna ulwazi lwakamuva emakethe angaluthola ngokushesha. Umsebenzisi angakhetha inketho 1 yokukhiqiza bese ethumela, nezintengo ezahlukahlukene zemakethe zizovela. Ukuze ubone umkhiqizo, khetha inombolo edingekayo, njengokuthi ukuze uthole intengo yamapulangwe emakethe yaseBloemfontein, iBloemfontein (Bfn) inombolo 2. Cindezela impendulo 2 bese uthumela. Ngaphezu kwe-USSD, kukhona enye insiza ebizwa nge-SMS bulk ethulwe ngoApril futhi okwamanje iyahlolwa nabelimi abayi-10 abakhethiwe kuzo zonke izifunda. Ngokwehlukana kwe-USSD, i-SMS bulk ithumela ulwazi lwezintengo zemakethe zemikhiqizo yezolimo nge-SMS kubalimi abaqashile nabasebenzisi bedatha. U-Tlou Kabe ophuma esigabeni sokumaketha uthe abalimi kufanele babhalise ezindaweni zabo nasemiphakathini ukuze benze kahle kulolu sizo olunikeziwe. Umbono weNational Land Care Program (NLP) uwukuba nemiphakathi nabantu bezwe babe nobudlelwane obusimeme nemvelo yabo nezinsiza zemvelo eNingizimu Afrika ngenkathi bethuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu basebenzisa umhlaba, amanzi, nezinsiza zezitshalo ngendlela ethuthukisa izinga lempilo yabo futhi ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zingazisebenzisa ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukutshala, ukuhamba, nokuvuna izinsiza zemvelo kufanele kuphathwe ngendlela evimbela ukonakala (njengokuhlanza umhlabathi, ukuncipha kwezinto eziphilayo, ukushabalala kwezinhlobo zezimbali, izinguquko emanzini, njll). Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, iMnyango Wezolimo uhlose ukweseka ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zemvelo ngeNational Land Care Program. Ngale program, amaqembu omphakathi akhuthazwa ukuba aphathe ngokresponsibly futhi agcine umhlabathi, izitshalo, amanzi, kanye ne-biodiversity ezindaweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMnyango Wezolimo ifuna ukuthuthukisa umgomo wayo wokuphatha umhlaba nezinsiza zezolimo kuzo zonke izigaba zohulumeni kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza ngale program. Inhloso yeNational Land Care Program (NLP) ukusungula nokusebenzisa izindlela ezihlanganisayo zokuphatha kahle izinsiza zemvelo eNingizimu Afrika, ngokuzimela, ngokulinganayo, nangokuhambisana nezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa okusimeme. Lokhu kuhilela ukusungulwa kwezikhungo zokuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa imithetho, izinhlelo, nezinqubo ezizokhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okusimeme kwezinsiza zemvelo. Ihloswe ukudala amathuba okuthuthukisa izinhlangano zebhizinisi ezigxile ekuphathweni okusimeme kwezinsiza. Ihloswe ukuthuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwezinsiza zemvelo isikhathi eside. Lezi zikhwama, ezilingana no-R100,000, zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngensiza ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufezwa kwezinhloso ze-NLP. Kunokugxila okuqinile ekukhuthazeni izindlela ezinhle zokuphatha umhlaba. Imiphumela izokhulumelwa abanye ababambiqhaza nezikhungo ezithintekayo. Lezi zikhwama azihloselwe ukushintsha ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, kuhlanganise nemisebenzi yocwaningo, ezinye izigaba zohulumeni, noma abantu, kodwa zihloselwe ukusheshisa isenzo nokuzibophezela ekuphathweni kwezinsiza. Ukusekelwa kwesikhathi eside kwemisebenzi yokuphatha izinsiza akuhlanganiswe kuhlelo lweSmall Grants Program yeNational Land Care Program. Ukuxhaswa kwephrojekthi ngokuvamile akuhlinzekwa isikhathi eside esingaphezu kweminyaka emithathu (izinyanga eziyi-36). Lokhu kuvumela ukuthi imali ithunyelwe kumathuba amasha njengoba evele. Ukuxhaswa akuphakanyiswa lapho amaphrojekthi ephinda imisebenzi ethile eyenziwa kwenye indawo, noma lapho engasekela kahle ngezinye izinhlelo. Omunye wemigomo ebalulekile yesigaba sezolimo emlandweni bekungukuhlinzeka nokuqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ukudla okwanele emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wombuso weMnyango Wezolimo, Uhlanga Nezokudla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imindeni nezwe lithola ukudla kufanele kuphathwe ngokuqinile. Ukwanda kwezindleko zokudla nezindleko eziphakeme zokufaka kunomthelela omubi esigabeni futhi kubeka engcupheni ukutholakala kokudla ezweni. Ukutholakala kokudla kuholela ekulaleleni futhi kungaba nemiphumela emibi emphakathini. Ngenxa yokuthi izimakethe ezinkulu zomhlaba zihlupheka ngenxa yokwehla komnotho kusukela ekwehleni komnotho kwamuva (kuhlanganisa neNingizimu Afrika), inani elikhulu lemisebenzi losthwe ezimbonini ezinkulu zomnotho. Le simo nezinye zifaka ingcindezi esigabeni sezolimo ukuze kudalwe amathuba emisebenzi futhi kudlale indima ekwehliseni ubuphofu. Ukwazi ukuthuthukiswa kwasemaphandleni njengokwakhiwa okubalulekile ekulweni nezinga lokungasebenzi, ubuphofu, kanye nokungalingani, imizamo kufanele igxile ekuthuthukiseni ukunikezwa kwezinsiza emiphakathini yasemaphandleni. Ama-cooperatives ezolimo njengendlela yokuhweba ingasetshenziswa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izintshisekelo zikahulumeni ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi esigabeni semiphakathi yasemaphandleni. Ama-cooperatives ezolimo abe phakathi kwama-first okwakhiwa ngaphansi komthetho we-cooperative waseNingizimu Afrika futhi kusukela lapho aguquke waba inhlangano ebhalisiwe futhi ephumele
Izinsolo zokuthi imali yomphakathi isetshenziswe yiMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi eGauteng ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhloso zeqembu lezepolitiki azizange ziqinisekiswe, njengoba kuboniswe ucwaningo lweHhovisi Lomvikeli Womphakathi (OPP). I-OPP yacwaninga udaba lapho ilungu lePhalamende likhalela ukuthi i-African National Congress (ANC) ibikhona esikhundleni seMEC ngaleso sikhathi, sithi inkulumo ethula ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali nguKgaogelo Lekgoro ayifanele futhi ayilungile. Ukuhumusha okuhleliwe kwashicilelwa njengokukhangisa ephephandabeni. Umkhalazi uphikile wathi ukukhangisa kufana nokukhuthazwa kweqembu lezepolitiki okuxhaswe ngempahla yomphakathi. Nokho, ucwaningo lwathola ukuthi "akukwazanga ukuba okuthile okusha noma okungafanele" ukuthi "izikhulu zezombusazwe ezimnyangweni ziveze imibono yazo mayelana nokusebenza kweqembu lezepolitiki elibusayo uma zikhuluma nelegislature ngemicimbi ethinta umphakathi." Umnyango unikezwe amandla nguMthethosisekelo ukuze ubike umphakathi ngomsebenzi wawo kanye nezimali zomphakathi ezabelwe wona, kubika i-OPP ngemuva kocwaningo. Izindleko ezitholakele ekubekeni ukukhangisa ephephandabeni okukhuluma ngokuqukethwe kwenkulumo yeMEC azinakubhekwa njengokungagunyaziwe noma okungafanele. Umvikeli Womphakathi uthole ukuthi izindleko ezihlobene nokukhangisa azizange zikhokhelwe mahhala ngakho-ke azinakubhekwa njengokungadingekile noma ukuchitha.
Umphakathi UProtector Lawrence Mushwana ukhuthaze iSikhungo Sezokuphepha saseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS) ukuba ihlulele abanikazi bezindaba abasiza amaphoyisa kanye neNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA) ekuxazululeni amacala okweba, ngempumelelo ye-R75,000. Ngemva kokuhlola le ndaba, uMphakathi UProtector Mushwana ukhuthaze iSAPS ukuba iqhubeke nokwenza izithembiso ezingazifezeki kubanikazi bezindaba, njengoba lokhu kudala umonakalo emlandweni wabo. "Le ndlela yokuziphatha idala umonakalo emfanekisweni wabo (SAPS)," kusho yena. Umfakazi uthintane ne-OPP ngo-2007, futhi ngemva kweminyaka emithathu le ndaba yavulwa, kuthiwa iSAPS eGauteng yehlulekile ukumkhokhela impumelelo. Amaphoyisa abeke impumelelo kumuntu ongamsiza i-NPA ekubambeni abasolwa nasekuqinisekiseni ukuvuma emcimbini ophathelene nokweba imoto, ukubulala, nokuzama ukubulala. Umfakazi uphinde waphenya enkantolo ukuze lokhu kwenzeke. Impumelelo, ethiwa yakhishwa yinkampani yokuphepha iKhulani Security, yanikezwa iSAPS, nakuba benze izithembiso zokuyikhokhela amaphoyisa ngokwenza umsebenzi wenkampani yokuphepha. Umfakazi wabekwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokuvikela abafakizolo. Ngesikhathi sokuhlola, i-OPP yathola ukuthi umfakazi ngempela wanikeza iSAPS ulwazi olwaholela ekubambeni nasekugwetshweni kwabasolwa emcimbini wokweba. Kwatholakala ukuthi iSAPS yehlulekile ukumkhokhela umfakazi impumelelo eyathembisiwe. U-Advocate Mushwana wethula imiphumela yakhe kanye nemibiko yokunconywa kuNgqongqoshe uNathi Mthethwa wezokuphepha nokuphepha (manje obizwa ngokuthi amaphoyisa) kanye noMphathiswa wezamaPhoyisa eGauteng uPerumal Naidoo.
Abasebenzi kufanele bakhokhele abasebenzi esikhundleni sokubanika izinsuku zokuphumula uma beqeda ukusebenza. Uphenyo luyaqhubeka, futhi amafoni abanjwe kufanele abuyiswe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umgomo wokunciphisa akufanele uthathwe ngokucophelela uma kwenziwa isinqumo sokuhlukumeza. I-United Nations iyithuluzi elibalulekile eliqinisekisa ukuthi inqubo ehilela izingxoxo phakathi kukamasipala abaningi inikeza umnikelo oqondile ekuxazululeni izinkinga nezinkinga esibhekene nazo namuhla. I-Red Cross Children's Hospital Trust ifana nobuhle obukhulu bokucela ukwesekwa, izinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka, kanye nokubona. Angikaze ngizwe okubi ngawe, ngakho akukho lutho engingakusho, kodwa ngizame ukuhlela ngaphambi kokufika ngesikhathi. UPresident Comparore uthe izingxoxo ngezindaba zamanje zizoqhubeka ngaphansi kwe-African Union Peace and Security Council. Inhloso yalolu hambo ikakhulukazi ukukhuluma ngezindaba ezikhona eComoros futhi zilungiselele ukhetho lukamongameli. Sihambile emapulazini; sashintsha siye egumbini lami ngoba kwakungafanele ukuthi singene endlini enkulu esiyibiza ngokuthi iPhalamende. Ulwazi oluhlongozwayo lungahlelwa ukuze kukhiqizwe isethi yedatha enembile. Imibiko evela kwamanye amazwe ibonisa ukuthi i-ammonium sulfate ne-urea akuhambisani kahle nezindawo ezimanzi kakhulu noma ezinamanzi.
