Uma usunqume izinga lezingcuphe, kufanele uthathe izinyathelo zokuvikela izingozi ekwenzeni. Kukhona izindawo eziningi lapho ungathola khona izeluleko kulabo abanolwazi lokwenza lokhu uma uhlola ingcuphe; ungasebenzisa lezi zindlela ezinhlanu ezilandelayo ukukusiza. Bheka indawo yokusebenza futhi ubheke ukuthi abantu basebenza kanjani. Futhi, hlola amarekhodi ezigameko ezedlule, izingozi, noma izinkinga zempilo. Inhloso yalezi zihloko ukuhlole izingozi ezibalulekile ezingaholela ekulimazeni abantu abaningi. Hlonza abantu abangase babe sengozini bese ubala ukuthi bangaki. Uma ucabanga ukuthi uzokwenza lokhu, ungakhohlwa ukuhlela imisebenzi enobungozi. Bheka ukuthi izinto ezibucayi ziphathwa kanjani. Izindlela zokuhlola lezi zingozi zingaba ngokubheka noma ezinye izinyathelo ezidingekayo. Abasebenzi bavame ukuba nemibono ewusizo egxile ezinkingeni abahlangabezana nazo emsebenzini wabo wansuku zonke, ngakho kuhle ukubabandakanya ezinqumweni ozithathayo. Ngemuva kokuba usunqume ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe, kufanele uhlela ukuthi uzokwenza kanjani futhi nini. Ukubhalela phansi kuzokusiza ukufaka leli phrojekthi. Kufanele uhlolisise ukuhlola kwakho uma kukhona izinguquko ezinkulu endleleni ophila ngayo noma uma unamanxeba okukholelwa ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle. Ukusebenza endaweni enezimo zezulu ezishintshashintshayo, umsindo, noma ukuhamba. Ukuphakamisa imithwalo emikhulu nokusebenza ezikhundleni ezinzima kungadala ubuhlungu bemisipha. Lokhu kubuhlungu emalungeni, ezithweni, nasehliziyweni kungadala ukucindezeleka kwemisipha. Gwema ukuphakamisa imithwalo emikhulu noma ukusebenza ezikhundleni ezinzima lapho kungenzeka. Phakamisa izinto ngendlela efanele - gcina izinyawo zakho zihlukaniswe, gcina umhlane uqondile, futhi ugcine imithwalo oyiphakamisayo ibhande eduze komzimba wakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ihlelwe kahle ukuze amathuluzi nemikhiqizo kube lula ukufinyelela ngaphandle kokuphula imisipha futhi uzame ukujikeleza imisebenzi edinga ukwenza noma uhambise ukuze usebenze imisipha ehlukene emzimbeni. Izithuthi ezisebenza ngesandla, ukuhamba ibanga elide, nezitshalo kufanele kugwenywe uma kungenzeka ukuvikela impilo yabasebenzi. Izingozi eziningi ezisemafamu zihilela imishini. Ezinye zenzeka ngoba imishini isetshenziswa emsebenzini ongafanele, ezinye zenzeka ngoba izivikeli zokuphepha azikho noma zikhishwe. Kumele kube nohlelo lokuhlola ukuthi amathuluzi nemishini esingathembela kuyo iphephile ukuyisebenzisa. Uma amathuluzi esetshenziswa ezimeni ezingaphephile, kufanele ahlolwe njalo ukuze kubonakale ukuthi yini engaholela ezingozeni, ikakhulukazi uma kukhona isimo esingajwayelekile esingase senze amathuluzi angaphephile. Izivikeli zokuphepha zidingeka ngokomthetho. Amathuluzi okutshala izihlahla kumele aklanywe ngenhloso leyo. Amathuluzi ezolimo ngokuvamile awafaneleki ukutshala izihlahla. Izibambo zamathuluzi kumele ziqinisiwe ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala kwezandla uma ithuluzi lishaya itshe elingafihlekile noma imizi. Uma uthenga noma uqasha imishini, umthetho uthi umhlinzeki kufanele anikeze izivikeli zokuphepha ezifanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi wena nabasebenzi bakho uqeqeshwe ukuze usebenzise imishini ngokwezincwadi ezibhaliwe kuyo. Gcina izivikeli zokuphepha ezindaweni zazo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Hlola ukuthi amasondo okuma okuphuthumayo abhalwe kahle ukuze akhombise ukuthi enza ini nokuthi imishini ethinta ini, futhi aklanywe futhi abekwe ngendlela engavunyelwe ukuthi ivulwe ngengozi. Abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe ukuze basebenze ngokuphepha futhi banikezwe izingubo zokuvikela. Izigameko eziningi ezihilela imishini zenzeka ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwemishini. Abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe kahle ukuze benze imisebenzi yabo. Amathuluzi anele nezincwadi zokusebenzisa imishini kufanele anikezwe ukuze imishini iphathwe, ibonakale, futhi isetshenziswe ngokuphepha. Imithombo yamandla, ngokwesibonelo, kufanele ivela kumishini eqinisa izikhala noma amandla avela emanzini, futhi kufanele ibe endaweni ephephile ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umsebenzi. Imishini esebenzisa amandla emanzini kufanele ivinjelwe ukuwa ngokusebenzisa imishini yokuphakamisa efana nezivikeli nezijakethi uma abantu besebenza ngaphansi kwayo. Kumele bakwazi
Ukuphakamisa izinto, imisebenzi ephindaphindwayo, nokucindezela komzimba kuthinteka ngezinto ezithile ezilimazayo. Bahlaselwa yizinto ezilimazayo ezithinta imizimba yabo - baphinde bahlangabezane nezimo ezivumela amagciwane ukuthi angene emzimbeni wabo ngokuphefumula nasekufakeni izinto ezifana nothuli nokusebenza ezindaweni eziphakeme ezinezinga elikhulu lokushisa. Basebenza ezindaweni ezishisayo nezibanda. Le mboni ivame ukuba nezimo zokushisa ezihlukahlukene nezibanda ezindaweni zokusebenza njengoba imikhiqizo ihlale ishisa kanti eminye iyabanda. Abasebenzi bavame ukubekwa ezimeni ezinzima ngesikhathi besebenza nem food efakwa ezitsheni. Bangasebenza nasezindaweni ezincane. Ezinye zalezi zindawo zifaka: izikhungo zokugcina, amathangi nezitsheni, imayini nezikebhe ezinkulu, amathangi omoya, izitsheni zokukhipha uwoyela, amathangi okuvuthwa, nezinye izikebhe ezinkulu. Kumele kwenziwe amalungiselelo afanele ukuze lezi zindawo zifinyeleleke futhi izikhungo zokuhlanza kumele zigcinwe dry ngokususa zonke iziphuzo. Abasebenzi kumele baqeqeshwe ekuphakamiseni izinto futhi ezinye izindawo kumele zakhiwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi banendawo eyanele. Ezinye imisebenzi efana nokufaka imikhiqizo ezitsheni, ezibhotela, nokusebenzisa imishini ethutha imikhiqizo ngebelts ivame ukuveza abasebenzi ezingeni eliphezulu lokukhala. Kumele kube nezilawuli zobunjiniyela zokunciphisa umsindo, futhi abasebenzi kumele basizwe ekusebenziseni izinyathelo zokuvikela kulokhu. Abasebenzi kumele banikezwe imishini yokuvikela, izinsiza, nokuqeqeshwa kokuthi bangayisebenzisa kanjani. Ukuhlanzeka komuntu kufanele kugcizelelwe futhi kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uhlukaniswe nezimo zokuphepha. Abasebenzi kumele baqeqeshwe ngezici zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kufanele kufake izinyathelo zokuphuthumayo. Kumele kube nodokotela ofanelekayo noma umhlengikazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umsebenzi uphila kahle ukuze asebenze kule mboni. Abaphathi badinga ukusungula izindawo ezinezidingo ezihlukene endaweni yokusebenza. Uma zikhona, kumele kube nezimpawu ezikhombisa indlela yokufinyelela lezi zindawo ukuze zibe lula ukuzibonakalisa. Amalayisense alezi zindawo kumele abe khona futhi afanele imisebenzi ethile eyabelwe lezi zindawo. Abasebenzi kumele banikezwe usizo lokuphefumula olufanele uma besebenzisa lezi zindawo, futhi laba basebenzi kumele baqeqeshwe ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto ezigcinwe phezulu (njengalezo ezigcinwe ezitsheni zokugcina) azinakuphuma kalula ukuze kugwenywe ukuwa okungase kuholele eziphumeleni. Uma kupakishwa izinto, izinto ezinzima kufanele zibekwe phansi kanti ezilula zibekwe phezulu kwezinto ezinzima. Izindlela zokupakisha ezifanele kufanele zikhethwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinto azishintshi. Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi izinto eziphakanyisiwe (njengama-cylinders kagesi) noma izinto ezibekwe ngendlela engazinzile zingawa kalula noma ziqhume. Izitsheni zivame ukuba yimbangela yezingozi eziningi, ngakho kufanele zibekwe endaweni ephephile noma ziqiniswe ebhakedeni uma zingasetshenziswa. Amathuluzi wezandla kumele agcinwe engcono ukuze kugwenywe ukufaneleka okukhulu uma esetshenziswa. Izinto ezifana nezimoto zangaphakathi, ama-hoists ezinto, nemishini esetshenziswa ngabagibeli kumele zabelwe ukusetshenziswa ezindaweni ezingafinyeleleki kwabanye abasebenzi uma kuvunyelwe. Umuntu owonakele ngesikhathi edonsa enye yalezi zinto kumele aye endaweni lapho angabonakala kalula. Izinyathelo zokuphepha kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi izindawo ezilimazayo ziyaziwa (njengemishini enezingxenye ezihambayo, ama-hooks, nezinto ezingawa emishinini). Imboni yokudla nezokuphuza ivame ukuba nezinhlobo ezihlukahlukene ezedlula amathathu. Lokhu kufaka izinkomo, imishini yokwenza ushukela, nemishini yokwenza okusanhlamvu ehambisana nezikhungo zokukhiqiza kanye nalabo abakhiqiza iziphuzo ezithile. Idatha ephathelene nezingozi emikhakheni yokudla nezokuphuza ikhombisa ukuthi izinga liphezulu kakhulu lapha. Nokho, lezi zinga zihluka phakathi kwemikhakha ehlukene yale mikhiqizo. Kuwo wonke la, izimoto zivame ukuba yimbangela enkulu yezingozi endaweni yokusebenza, kuhlanganise nezindawo eziphakeme nokulimala okubangelwa imishini. Ukukhiqiza ukudla kunezinga ezintathu - izinga lempesheni, ukucubungula, nokuthengisa. Ukukhiqiza ukudla nezokuphuza kwenzeka ezinkampanini ezihluka ngosayizi kusuka kulabo abaqasha abantu abambalwa kuya kulabo abaqasha izinkulungwane. Kulezi zinkampani ezinkulu noma ezincane ezikhiqiza ukudla nezokuphuza, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zisebenza ezweni noma emhlabeni jikelele, ezinezikhungo eziningi zokulawula, zivame ukuqasha izinkulungwane zabantu. Umnyango Wezabasebenzi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokubheka izinga lokuqala lempesheni - izinga lomsebenzi wezolimo nokukhiqiza. Ukuthengisa nokusabalalisa imikhiqizo kuyimfanelo yohulumeni bendawo kanye neminyango yezempilo yomphakathi, nakuba Umnyango Wezabasebenzi ubambisana nalezi zinsiza ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho yezempilo nokuphepha. Ngokuvamile, kunzima ukuphatha impilo endaweni yokusebenza kunokuphepha kuphela. Izimbangela nemiphumela yezimo ezimbi zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza yizinto ezingaphathwa kalula. Lokhu okunzima ukukhipha kungase kungaveli njengokugula okubangelwa izimo zokusebenza. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kuthatha isikhathi ukuze lezi zifo ziveze izimpawu. Kuvame ukufaneleka ukuthi lezi zimpawu zivele ngaphambi kokuba zibhaliwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, izinyathelo zingabhalwa ukuze kuvinjwe lezi zifo. Izinkinga ezifana nezinkinga zomzimba ziba nzima ngoba zingase zingabi yizimbangela ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Abasebenzi bavame futhi ukuba nenkinga yokungafuni ukuveza ukuthi baphila kahle ngenxa yomsebenzi ngoba besaba ukuphuma emsebenzini. Lezi zinkinga ziveza isidingo sokulwa nokwanda kwezifo ezikhona endaweni yokusebenza. Naphezu kokuba nezixazululo ezikhona ezinkingeni zempilo endaweni yokusebenza, izixazululo ezaziwa kahle azitholakali kabanzi. Lokhu kungakho izinkampani ezinkulu seziqale ukuqasha abantu abagxile kuphela empilweni yabasebenzi. Izinkampani ezinganikezi lezi zinketho ngokuvamile zincane. Lapho abantu behlangabezana nalezi zinkinga ezixoxwe lapha, bavame ukuvakashela odokotela bomndeni babo, kodwa khona-ke kukhona inkinga yokuthi labo odokotela abaqeqeshwe ukuhlela izinkinga zempilo ezibangelwa izimo zokusebenza. Izinkampani eziningi azikhuthazwa ukuba zifune abantu abaqeqeshwe ukuvikela izifo zabasebenzi ezibangelwa izimo zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zifo phakathi kwabantu abasebenzayo aziningi ngaleyo ndlela. Lokhu kungakho abaninzi abasebenzi bengakwazi ukubambisana njengomphakathi ukuze balwe nalezi zifo. Iqiniso liwukuthi ukuthola abantu abaqeqeshwe kulolu hlobo lomsebenzi kuyaziwa ukuthi kulethe imiphumela engcono. Ukulimala kwesikhumba: okubangelwa ukugeza ngezandla, ukuthinta ukudla, njll. Ukulahlekelwa kokuzwa okubangelwa umsindo: kwenzeka uma amazinga omsindo ed
Le mhlahlandlela ubhalwe ukuze ubhekane nezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yalo ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo yeMthetho ngezindlela ezilula kubabambiqhaza emkhakheni wezempilo nokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika. Ichaza indima yabalawuli bezempilo nokuphepha (OHS) boMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Imisebenzi namalungelo abasebenzi, njengoba kuhlelwe nguMthetho, kuboniswa ngokuphelele. Imisebenzi nezibopho zabaphathi, abakhiqizi bezimpahla ezithile, abaklami, abangenisi bezimpahla ezivela kwamanye amazwe, abahlinzeki, nabathengisi kugcizelelwa. Ekugcineni, izindima zalabo abamele izempilo nokuphepha kanye nezinkomiti zicaciswa. Igunya ngalinye eliyinhloko lizokwenza, ngokwanele, ukuthi imisebenzi yabaphathi bayo, njengoba kuboniswe kulo Mthetho, yenziwe kahle. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993 udinga ukuthi umphathi aqinisekise futhi agcine, ngokwanele, indawo yokusebenza ephephile futhi engaphazamisi impilo yabasebenzi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umphathi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ikhululekile ezinsongweni, ezifana nezinto ezikhemikhali, i-chlorine, nezinto eziyingozi, izinto ezithile, imishini, izinqubo, njll., ezingadala ukulimala noma ukugula. Uma lokhu kungasebenzi, umphathi kufanele azise abasebenzi ngalezi zinsongo, ukuthi zingavikelwa kanjani, nokuthi bangasebenza kanjani ngokuphepha, futhi banikeze ezinye izindlela zokwakha indawo yokusebenza ephephile. Nokho, akulindelekile ukuthi umphathi abeke umthwalo wezempilo nokuphepha yedwa. Umthetho ususelwa emgomeni wokuthi izinsongo zendawo yokusebenza kufanele zibhekwane ngokuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi. Abasebenzi nabaphathi kufanele babelane ngomsindo wemithwalo wezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Bobabili kufanele balindele izinsongo futhi bakhe izinyathelo zokulawula ukuze benze indawo yokusebenza iphephile. Ngale ndlela, abaphathi nabasebenzi babandakanyeka ohlelweni lapho abamele izempilo nokuphepha bengabheka njalo indawo yokusebenza futhi babike enkomeni yezempilo nokuphepha, engase ibeke iziphakamiso kumphathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lolu hlelo lusebenza kahle, wonke umphakathi kufanele wazi amalungelo nezibopho zabo njengoba ziqukethwe emthethweni. Umthetho, owaziwa ngokuthi Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993 (Umthetho 85 ka-1993), uqukethe izingxenye eziyi-50 ezivunyelwe yiPhalamende. Inhloso yoMthetho ukuhlinzeka ngezempilo nokuphepha kwabantu emsebenzini noma mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwemishini. Iphinde ihlinzeke ngokuvikelwa kwabantu abangabantu abasebenzi ezinsongweni ezivela noma ezihlobene nezisebenzi. Imithetho ehlukene ephathelene nezihloko ezithile iyashicilelwa ngezikhathi ezithile nguMnyango Wezabasebenzi ngokuhambisana noMthetho. Umthetho kanye Nezikhumbuzo zingathengwa kwiHhovisi Lezokuphrinta Lezizwe ngendlela yeGazethi noma ngendlela ehlanganisiwe kubashicileli abahlukene. Umthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi uphethwe yiSikhungo Esiphezulu Sezempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi boMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi, amahhovisi ezifundazwe asekelwe kuzo zonke izifundazwe. Ukuze kube lula lokhu, abahloli bezempilo nokuphepha baphumelele ukuhlole nokuhlola ezindaweni zokusebenza. Umhloli ovela kuMnyango Wezabasebenzi, ngesikhathi sokuhlola, uthole isilinda segesi silengiswa phansi esikhundleni sokuba siqinisekiswe odongeni noma esikhwameni. Ukuhlolwa kuvame ukuhlela ngenxa yezizathu zezibalo mayelana nezinsongo, ubukhona bezinto eziyingozi, ezifana nokusetshenziswa kwezinto ezikhemikhali ezindaweni zokuwasha, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemishini eyingozi endaweni yokusebenza. Ukuhlolwa okwenziwayo kungase kube okungazisiwe, ngakolunye uhlangothi, kungase kube ngenxa yezicelo noma izikhalazo ezenziwe ngabasebenzi, abaphathi, noma amalungu omphakathi. Lezi zikhalazo noma izicelo zicutshungulwa njengezizimele. Uma kwenzeka insongo engase ibe khona, umhloli angavimbela isenzo esithile, inqubo, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemishini noma amathuluzi ngokukhishwa kwesaziso sokuvimbela. Akekho okufanele aphuthelwe okuqukethwe kwalesi saziso, futhi ukwenziwa kwaso kufanele kwenziwe ngaphandle kokulibazisa. Uma umthetho ophathelene nezimfuneko uphulwa, umhloli angakhishwa isaziso sokuphulwa kubasebenzi noma kumphathi. Ukuphulwa komthetho kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuhlasela okuphuthumayo, kodwa uma umthetho ophathelene nezimfuneko uphulwa, umphathi anganikezwa ithuba lokulungisa ukuphulwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile esivame ukusethwa ezinsukwini eziyi-60. Uma izinyathelo zezempilo nokuphepha ezibekwe ngumphathi zivikela kahle impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi, umhloli angacela umphathi ukuthi enze izinyathelo ezengeziwe ezisebenzayo. Umphathi uzothola isaziso sokuthuthukisa esichaza izinyathelo zokulungisa. Abahloli boMnyango bahlola ukuwa kwephondo leCoega lapho abantu ababili bafa futhi abangu-23 balimala. Ukuze kusizakale umhloli ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo, bangangena kunoma iyiphi indawo yokusebenza noma kunoma iyiphi indawo lapho imishini nezinto eziyingozi zisetshenziswa khona futhi bacele imibuzo noma balethe amasampula ukuze abantu bahlangane nabo. Umhloli angaphinde acela ukuthi noma yiziphi imibhalo ilethwe kubo, ahlole, enze amakhophi ale mibhalo, futhi afune ukucaciselwa nganoma yini ebhalwe kule mibhalo. Umhloli angahlola noma yisiphi isimo noma into futhi athathe amasampula, futhi angasebenza njengofakazi. Qaphela: Amandla abahloli akhulunywe ngenhla awaphelele. Noma ubani ophikisana nanoma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe ngumhloli angafaka isikhalazo ngalokho isinqumo ngokubhala kuMhloli Omkhulu, Izempilo Nokuphepha, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, Private Bag X117, Pretoria, 0001. Umphathi kufanele enze ini ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza iphephile futhi ayinayo insongo empilweni yabasebenzi bawo? Umphathi kufanele ahlinzeke futhi agcine kahle zonke izinto ezidingekayo ukuze enze umsebenzi, kanye nazo zonke izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ekwenzeni umsebenzi, ngendlela engathinti kabi impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ngaphambi kokuthi kusebenze imishini yokuvikela, umphathi kufanele kuqala azame ukususa noma ukunciphisa noma yisiphi isingo empilweni nokuphepha kwabasebenzi bawo. Imishini yokuvikela kufanele isetshenziswe uma ingenakugwenywa. Umphathi kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokuvikela impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi bawo ezinsongweni ezingase zivele ekukhiqizeni, ekusetshenzisweni, ekuphathweni, ekugcinweni, noma ekuthuthweni kwezinto ezithile, ngamagama, noma yini abangase bahlangabezane nayo emsebenzini. Kumele bahlinzeke ngemininingwane, imiyalelo, ukuqeqeshwa, nokubhekelela okudingekayo ngenkathi begcina engqondweni izinga lobuchwepheshe babasebenzi. Lo msebenzi kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izinyathelo zokuvikela zisebenza futhi zigcinwa. Izingubo zokuvikela zifakwa kuphela ngabantu ababili kanti omunye
Ukubambisana komphakathi; - Ukuthuthukisa nokuphromotha inhlalakahle yomphakathi kanye nentuthuko yezomnotho; - Ukuphepha, ukuvikeleka, nokulwa nokusabalala kwe-HIV/AIDS; - Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo eziphuthumayo; - Ukuphathwa kwezimali ngokwethembeka; - Ukuhola okwenziwa ngokuqonda; - Ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. i Ukulethela intuthuko ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni. ii Ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko kwezindawo ezihlelwe nezingeziwe, ezikhona nezindawo zokuhlala ezintsha. iii Ukuvimbela ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okungemthetho. iv Ukuphromotha intuthuko esheshayo yomhlaba. v Ukukhuthaza intuthuko efanele futhi ehlanganisiwe yomhlaba. Ukuphromotha intuthuko yomhlaba ehlanganisa ukuhlela kwezokuxhumana, ezomnotho, nezokwakha, kanye nokwakheka kwemvelo komhlaba, ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko ehlanganisayo ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni, ukukhuthaza ukuba khona kwezindawo zokuhlala namathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni eziseduze noma ukuhlanganisa lezi zindawo. Umkhakha okhona kufanele uhlanganise kahle imikhakha ethinta ezolimo, umhlaba, imayini, izinsiza, ukuthutha, nezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukuphromotha ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okuxubile, kungakhathaliseki kumhlaba owodwa noma emhlabeni ohlukanisiwe. Ukuvimbela ukuhamba phambili kwedolobha, ngenkathi kusekelwa intuthuko yezindawo ezihlanganisiwe zasemadolobheni. Ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo. Ukuphromotha ukulandela izinqubo nezindlela ezigxile kwemvelo. Le plan ibonisa izindawo ezidinga ukunakwa okuqondile, kanye nezindawo lapho izinhlelo eziphakeme seziqediwe noma lapho izinhlelo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa. Lezi zindawo zifaka phakathi izindawo ze-Edendale ne-Imbali, ingxenye enkulu yedolobha (Indawo Ephakathi), kanye nomhlaba ocebile ngezolimo engxenyeni esentshonalanga yomphakathi (Vulindlela). Le plan ifaka phakathi nezinhlelo zokwandisa imiphakathi, ukuvikela izakhiwo, nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa ezisebenzayo kwezinye izindawo. ii Ekuphumeleleni kokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zalemizindawo emine, izinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa libalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe intuthuko ephumelelayo. Umlando i Ukuhlonza izinkinga ezihlobene nesimo sedolobha, nokuhlela okudingeka kwenziwe ukuze kulungiswe lesi simo, kufanele kusikhumbuze ukuthi imingcele yomphakathi ivela kanjani. Njengoba kukhombisiwe kuTebhu 1, umphakathi waseMsunduzi uhlukaniswe ngamaqembu amathathu, okwakhiwe abantu abangu-200,000. iv Ngeminyaka yama-1970, indawo yase-Edendale yasungulwa njenge ndawo yokubhaliswa ehlukile ngaphansi kuk governo ye-apartheid. Ngasikhathi sinye, emizamweni yokususa abantu ezindaweni zokuhlala, okwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezindawo ezibizwa ngokuthi izindawo ezimhlophe, ukutshalwa kwezimali ezinsizeni kwakuncane, okuholele ekugcinweni kwezindawo ezifana ne-Sobantu zibe sezingeni eliphansi, okuholela ezindlini eziphansi. Nokho, lezi zindawo ezifanayo manje seziwumphakathi owodwa, nezinye zezindawo ezithuthukisiwe zisasebenza njengezindawo zokuhlala ezakha iPietermaritzburg, lapho ukuhweba kwenziwa kakhulu. Enye yezinjongo zale msebenzi wokuthuthukiswa kwesikhala (SDF) wukunciphisa ukuhlukaniswa kwemibala, intuthuko engalingani eyayidalwe ngaphambili ngenxa yokuphathwa komhlaba ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Ukwakhiwa kwe-N3 bypass kube lula ukufinyelela kwezinye izixeko ezinkulu nezifunda ezizungezile. Isimo samanje sentuthuko sifaka phakathi ukuhlanganiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala nezokusebenza, kanye nokuba khona kwezidingo eziphuthumayo emiphakathini. Izinga lezinsiza zokuthutha ligxile kakhulu endaweni ephakathi yomphakathi, ngenkathi izinga lokuxhumana ezindaweni ezisemaphethelweni omphakathi liphansi. Kukhona izinga eliphansi lokufinyelela kwezinsiza nezinye izidingo zomphakathi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Ubumpofu, ukungasebenzi, nezinga eliphansi lokubandakanywa kwezomnotho kubonisa imiphakathi ehamba phambili. Isingeniso i Izikhombisi-ndlela zokuhlela nezindlela ezilawula i-SDF zibalulekile futhi zisebenza, ikakhulukazi lezo ezihambisana nemithetho eyisisekelo, etholakala esigabeni sesibili ngenhla. iv Ekusebenzeni kwayo, le ndlela ikhuthaza ukufakwa kwezakhiwo ezihlukene kulezi zindlela. Akukaze kukhombiswe ukuthi le ndlela isekela lokho okwaziwa njenge "Ribbon Development" ekwakhiweni kwale ndlela. Le ndlela yokuhlela intuthuko ikhombisa ukuthi "ama-nodes" akufanele abe nezehlakalo ezifanayo futhi kufanele ahlukaniswe kahle, ngokuvamile ahlukaniswe ngezinga elingama-2km ukusuka komunye nomunye. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuvumela abantu abaningi ukuba bahambe bayofika kulezi zindawo. Kukhona kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethiwe, lapho i-cluster yokusetshenziswa komhlaba itholakala eduze kwalezi zindlela ezinkulu, okuthiwa "Mixed-use corridor." v Ngeshwa, le ndlela ye-corridor ixhumene nezindawo zokusetshenziswa okuxubile, okungesiyo inhloso noma into enhle nhlobo. Kukhona futhi umkhuba wokubeka "ama-nodes" noma kuphi kulezi zindlela. Ngokuqinisekile, kukhona amazinga ahlukene "ama-nodes" okuthengisa, njengoba ezindaweni ezinkulu kukhona "ama-nodes" ezingeni lokuba yisigaba sesihlanu kanye nokwengeza izinhlobo ezintsha ze-cluster zokuthengisa. Ezinye "ama-nodes" ezingaba khona zingaba amahhovisi, izibhedlela, noma ukubhaliswa kokuphatha okungase kube kude nalezi "ama-nodes" ezinye. Akufanele kube yindlela yokwenza izinto ukuzama ukufaka wonke la "ama-nodes" ezigabeni "Ezisemqoka, Ezisemqoka, Nezisebenzayo" ezinhlelweni ezakhiwayo, ikakhulukazi ezingeni le-SDF, lokhu akuyona indlela efanele. Ukwethulwa kwe "Mobility and Arterial roads" kuzokwenza lezi zindlela zisebenze kahle, ngokuba nezindlela eziningi zokuhamba. Kuphinde kuthuthukise ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezazidlelekile ngaphambili. Ukwakhiwa kwama "ama-nodes" amaningi ezindaweni zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni zasemaphandleni kufanele kube ezindaweni ezilula ukufinyelela ukuze abantu bathole izidingo eziphuthumayo ezitholakala kulezi "ama-nodes." Ukuhlinzekwa kwalezi zindlela eMsunduzi kuhlose ukuvimbela ukuxhumana, ekusebenzeni kwalezi zindlela, lezi zisho zizosebenza. Isithombe esikhona ngezansi sikhombisa izinto ezihlukene ezihlanganisa lezi zindlela zonke. "Arterial Roads" Lezi zindlela zizoba "ama-Nodes" ezihlangana nezindlela ezikahle. Kungenzeka ukuthi kungaba nezakhiwo ezithile eduze kwalezi "Spines" izindlela, njengezikhungo zemidlalo ezinkulu, izibhedlela, izikole eziphakeme, nezinye izakhiwo ezingafanele, ezingase zingabi yingxenye yale "Node." Lezi zindlela ezintsha eziphakanyisiwe ukuze kusekelwe ukuxhumana seziphinde zehlise izinga lokuhlala kwezimoto, okukhombiswa futhi ku-SDF. "Mixed-Use Corridors" Lokhu kuzoba kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethiwe, ngamagama, kulezi zindawo lapho "Arterial Road" idlula khona edolobheni (CBD) noma ed

Ngiyethemba sonke singabona ukuthi abantu bethu bayakhula ngokushesha kuyilapho isimo sethu sezomnotho sishoda kakhulu. Yingakho namuhla sizokwethula uhlelo lokufundisa abesifazane, ikakhulukazi intsha, ngendlela yokuzithuthukisa kwezomnotho. Ngiyajabula ukumemezela ukuthi lolu hlelo lokufundisa umphakathi luqale izolo, ngoMsombuluko, futhi ngiyethemba luzosiza kakhulu umphakathi wethu ekubhekaneni nesimo esinzima sezomnotho. Ngiyethemba niyazisa ukubaluleka kwenu njengoba lo mcimbi esifundazweni ukhethwe ukuba wenziwe lapha endaweni yenu. Olunye uhlelo wukwabiwa kokudla kulabo abadinga usizo olukhulu okungamaR140 million. Nokho, ngiyazi ukuthi lokhu kubambezelekile ngenxa yenani labantu abakhathazekile kangaka. Njengoba nazi, isifunda sethu sathinteka yizinhlekelele ngonyaka odlule kuhlanganisa izivunguvungu, izikhukhula, imililo, nezinye izinhlekelele ezivela eMolweni, KwaMakhutha, nakwezinye izindawo ezahlukene esifundazweni lapho kwalahleka khona izimpilo eziningi, futhi abantu abaningi bahlaselwe, abaningi bashiywa bengenas shelter. Umthwalo walolu hlelo ungena kule Ndaba ukunakekela labo bantu. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ngonyaka odlule izindleko esazithola ekuphathweni kwalezi zinhlekelele ezihlukahlukene esifundazweni zafinyelela ku-R6 million 800 thousand.
Namuhla kuyinsuku ebalulekile njengoba sibhiyozela usuku lwababekezeli bethu ngaphansi kwesiqu, "Sibhiyozela iminyaka eyishumi yabantu abadala ezweni elihlanganisa zonke izigaba." Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi nakuba kunezinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nathi njengeMnyango ekusizeni abadala, njengokuthi kwezinye izindawo basaboshwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Siyazi ukuthi ngenxa yokucindezelwa komsebenzi, omama nababamkhulu bagcina bethathwa ezikhungweni ezihlinzeka ngensizakalo kubadala ukuze baphathwe kulezi zindawo. Sithola imibiko yokuthi abanye bagcina bengavakashelwa noma bethathwa ukuze bavakashele emakhaya abo. Siphika lokho ngoba kuyinto embi kakhulu. Ngifuna futhi ukusho ukuthi asikhuthazi le ndlela yokubathatha ezikhungweni; kodwa uma kungekho okungcono okungaqhubeka, kungcono ukuthi bathathwe lapho kunokuthi baphathwe kabi. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uMnyango wami ukhathazekile kakhulu ngenhlalakahle yabadala. Yingakho lo Mnyango usungule izikhungo eziyi-461 ezihlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abadala abangu-25,215, kanti abangu-6,309 babamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuzivocavoca ezitholakala kulezi zikhungo. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi ukuzivocavoca kubalulekile ukuze ungaguli kalula. Ukuze kukhombise ukuthi uMnyango, ngisho nasezingeni lesizwe, ufuna ukukubona uphila kahle ngenxa yokuzivocavoca, imidlalo ihlelwe ukuthi ibanjwe ePort Elizabeth lapho omama nababamkhulu bazoqhudelana khona bezivela kuzo zonke izifundazwe, futhi imidlalo ehlukahlukene izodlalwa, ngikhuthaza ukuba ubambe iqhaza, mhlawumbe ungabuya neziqu. Angikholwa ukuthi uzonqotshwa ngabantu abadala abavela kwezinye izifundazwe. Lezi zimbangi zizobanjwa kusukela ngomhla ka-27 ku-Okthoba kuya ku-29 ku-Okthoba, 2009. Ngiyacela ungithethelele ukuthi uzofika futhi uwine. Ngaphandle kwezikhungo eziphansi kwethu, kunezikhungo eziyi-53 esizixhasa ngezimali ezihlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abadala abangu-3,534. Siphinde sikhokhele abasebenzi bezokuxhumana abangu-64 abasebenza kulezi zikhungo. Ngifuna ukusho ukuthi kusekhona izinkinga esibhekene nazo ekunikezeni usizo oluphelele kubadala, njengokuthi ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kunzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zeLuncheon Clubs ngoba awekho amakhaya okwenza lo msebenzi njengama-hall, amakholwa, futhi uthola ukuthi abantu abadala bakude kakhulu ukuze bahambe ngoba babona ibanga abadinga ukuhamba. Ngokufingqa, uma ngingafingqa lokho esikwenza kubadala kule ndawo kuphela, sinezindawo eziyi-50 ezihlinzeka ngosizo kubantu abadala abangu-2,292.
Umphakathi umphathi uhlezi lapha namuhla ukuze agubhe usuku olubalulekile lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengoba sonke sazi ukuthi lesi yinyanga yethu yokuthuthukisa umphakathi, nakuba kuyinto esiyenzayo nsuku zonke, kodwa le nyanga ikakhulukazi iwukukhombisa. Siqale le nyanga ngempumelelo njengoba ngosuku lokuqala sibe nomcimbi wozukulu eMnambithi; futhi ngaphambi kwalokho, sibathumele ePhalamende. Ngiyafuna ukusho, njengomphakathi umphathi, ukuthi njengomnyango sinesikhumbuzo esiningi esisisebenzisayo emiphakathini yethu. Bheka nje unyaka wezezimali ka-2009/10, sinesikhumbuzo esisethulile ukusiza izingane ezingenabazali ukufinyelela ezidingweni zezempilo njengabanye izingane emphakathini. Ngiyakwazi ukusho ngokuzethemba ukuthi umphakathi owakha izindawo eziphakathi nendawo esifundazweni (indawo yeMidlands) kanye nezindawo ezizungezile uthole kakhulu kuleli suku. R140 million. Nokho, ngiyazi ukuthi kusekhona ukuhamba kancane ngenxa yenani labantu abaphakathi kwalesi simo esinzima. Enye indlela esiyisebenzisayo ukuthuthukisa umphakathi ukuthi siqasha abasebenzi bezokuxhumana abanele futhi kulabo abasafunda, sinikeza izifundo ukuze babuyele bese besebenza ukuthuthukisa umphakathi wethu. Sikhishile izifundo eziyi-700.
Isifunda silindele ukuthi ibhajethi ehlongozwayo izodlula imali engenayo ngamaR783.8 million noma u-2.3 percent wemali engenayo yonke yezezimali zonyaka ka-2006/07. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi le mehluko izokhokhwa ngemali esele kwiPhondo leMali. Ukusetshenziswa kahle nokuphumelelayo kwebhajethi kuzoba yimbangela ebalulekile yokugwema izikweletu ezingenzeka kuhulumeni. Ngenxa yamandla omnotho aboniswe yiGauteng ngonyaka owedlule, kulindeleke ukuthi imali yeMTEF yesifunda izokhula. Kukholelwa ukuthi imali engenayo yesifunda izokhula ngama-10 percent phakathi nesikhathi seMTEF. Imali ethola intela (intela yokugembula nezimali zokugunyazwa kwemoto) ibamba u-80 percent wemali engenayo, kanti imali engatholi intela (ikakhulukazi izimali ezikhokhwa ngabaguli) ibamba u-19 percent wemali engenayo yesifunda, kanti iphesenti elisele livela kwezinye izinsiza. Imali kazwelonke, ethunyelwe kanye nezibonelelo ezibekwe phansi, ibheka isikhala sezimali zakamuva kanye nezinsizwa zomkhakha ezitholakele ngemuva kokwethulwa kweMiyalo yeBhajethi yePhondo yeSikhathi esiphakathi ngo-2005, isibonelo: othisha abaningi ukuze baphathe ukwanda kwenani labafundi, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuhola othisha kanye nezisebenzi zomphakathi, kanye nokuhola ochwepheshe bezempilo, ukusabalalisa uhlelo lokwelashwa kwe-HIV/AIDS, ukuvuselela nokugcina izikhungo zezempilo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zomgwaqo zesifunda, kanye nokwakha kabusha izindawo ezingekho emthethweni. Ukucubungula izibonelelo ezibekwe phansi kuholele ekuthuthukisweni kwezibonelelo ezintsha, ukuhlanganiswa kwezibonelelo ezikhona, kanye nokupheliswa kwezibonelelo ezithile. Le nkokhelo ihlose ukuxazulula izidingo zezakhiwo ukuze kusekelwe uhlelo lokufunda futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfundo ihambisana nezindinganiso zezimboni. Izindleko ezithwalwe kusuka esivumelwaneni somholo sika-2005 (ukukhuphuka kwemiholo kwabasizi nabaphathi, uhlelo lokuhola, ukuqashelwa kwemfundo yangaphambili, nokuthuthukiswa kwezimali nezibalo) ezivela kuMnyango Wezemfundo ziwumsebenzi obalulekile wokukhuphuka kwemali ezosetshenziswa kubasebenzi phakathi kweMTEF. Uhlelo lwezokwakha lwephondo luhlanganisa: uxhaso lwezindleko zokusebenza (ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezindleko zomnyango ezikhuluma ngenhla), ukudluliselwa kwemali kwephrojekthi zezimali (ikakhulukazi izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokwakha ezihloselwe ukukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho nokuthuthukiswa), ukugcinwa kwezimo ezifanele (ukulungiswa kwansuku zonke, okuhleliwe, nokulungiswa kwezimo eziphuthumayo), nezinye izinhlelo. Izinsiza zihlukaniswa kabusha ku-GFS classification njengokulandelayo: Iphrojekthi yokwakha entsha, Ukuvuselelwa / Ukulungiswa, Ukugcinwa, nezinye ezikwiTafela 11 ngezansi ukuze kuhlangabezane kangcono nokutshalwa kwemali kwephondo ezinsizeni. Ukwabelana kwezempilo okukhulisiwe kuzohamba kancane ekutholeni ochwepheshe bezempilo nasekudaleni izikhuthazo zokuhlala kubasebenzi emkhakheni wezempilo. Lokhu
Uhlelo lunikeza isikhathi esiphelele semizuzu engama-30 nezinsuku eziyisithupha zokuzilolonga. Izikhathi ezitholakalayo zisetshenziselwa ukusukela ngo-08:30 kuya ku-15:00, okuhlanganisa nemizuzu engama-30 yokuphuza itiye, imizuzu engama-30 yokudla, nemizuzu eyi-10 yokwethula nokuphetha. Lokhu kushiya amahora ama-5 nemizuzu engama-30 yokuzilolonga. Kubalulekile kumfundisi ukuba aqonde izikhathi zokuphuza itiye nokudla. Izikhathi ezitholakalayo zabelwa ngaphezulu, futhi abafundisi kumele bahlale beqaphela isikhathi sohlelo ngalunye ukuze bangaphuthelwa. Le mikhombandlela izokhombisa umfundi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda isigaba ngasinye sokuzilolonga. Ungazami ukusebenzisa amagama abhalwe njengoba kukhulunywa encwadini yokuzilolonga. Sebenzisa amagama akho. Le yindlela kuphela ongazwakala ngayo kahle futhi uqiniseke. Futhi, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka ngqo kubabambiqhaza ngesikhathi sokuzilolonga ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bayabambisana nalabo obasiza. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi kahle uhlelo lokuzilolonga nokuthi ufundile zonke izigaba zencwadi yokuzilolonga ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuzilolonga. Amalungu eqembu angakubuza imibuzo mayelana nezinkinga ezizobhekwa ezigabeni ezilandelayo zencwadi yokuzilolonga, futhi kuzongasiza isikhathi uma ungabatshela ukuthi imibuzo yabo izophendulwa njengoba ukuzilolonga kuqhubeka. Qaphela ukuthi ezinye imibuzo zingase zingaphendulwa kulezi zifundo kodwa zingase zibe nezincazelo ezizayo. Incwadi yokuzilolonga ibhalwe futhi ihlelwe ikakhulukazi njengethuluzi lokubuyisela emuva noma nini uma kudingeka ulwazi oluthile. Zama ukuthola abafundi kuzo zonke izigaba zencwadi yokuzilolonga ukuze ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo zokubuyela uma bedingeka emva kokuzilolonga. Ngamanye amazwi, umsebenzi obalulekile walezi zifundo ukwenza incwadi yokuzilolonga ibe lula ukuyisebenzisa futhi iqonde kahle ukuze ibe yisisekelo solwazi esingabuyiselwa emuva esikhathini esizayo. Qiniseka ukuthi abafundi baqonda ukuthi ngeke bavule ikhasi le ncwadi eliphezu - kunalokho, bazothunyelwa ezigabeni ezithile ezibalulekile. Yiba nomusa kulabo abangase babe nezinkinga zokufunda nokubhala. Nakuba imisebenzi kule ncwadi ilandela indawo yokubhala izimpendulo, kubalulekile ukugqamisa ukuthi kuncike kumuntu ngamunye ukuthi ufuna yini ukubhala encwadini yabo. Batshele ukuthi njengoba iningi lale misebenzi lizokwenziwa ngamaqembu, kulungile ukuthi abantu babambe iqhaza ngokuqhubekayo kuphela. Gqamisa ukuthi abantu akufanele bakhathazeke ngokubuza imibuzo. Batshele wonke umuntu ukuthi kungenzeka kube nabanye abanemibuzo efanayo kodwa besaba ukuyibuza. Uma abantu bebuza imibuzo, bakhombisa ukulangazelela ukufunda izinto ezintsha, okungukuhle - kumele bakhumbule, "ulwazi luwumsebenzi!" Chaza ukuthi ungubani. Khuluma ukuthi kunezigaba ezintathu zokuzilolonga ezihlanganisa izihloko ezahlukene eziphathelene nomsebenzi wezinkomidi zomphakathi. Uma unolwazi, batshele abafundi ukuthi uzilolonga nini futhi kuphi izifundo ezimbili ezilandelayo. Baphathe ngemininingwane yonke ephathelene nalokho okukhuluma ngakho. Kuphi izindawo zokuhlala ngesikhathi sokuphuza itiye nokudla, futhi nini ukufunda kuphetha? Yini ezikhulumayo ezihambelana nezinhlelo zokuhamba, njengoba kushiwo yilabo abathunyelwe yihhovisi elizokhokhela, hhayi uMnyango noma i-DBSA? Izikhathi zokubhema azikhuthazwa ngoba isikhathi sinqunyelwe futhi sibalwa. Amafoni kufanele apagwe. Khuluma kafushane ngendlela incwadi yokuzilolonga ehlelwe ngayo. Chaza ukuthi ulwazi olungeziwe lutholakala ngasohlangothini futhi ukuthi uphawu ngalunye lumele ulwazi oluthile oluhlukile. Khuluma kafushane ukuthi uphawu ngalunye lumele ini. Umhlahlandlela womfundisi wokusebenzisa incwadi yokuzilolonga. Kungani ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kubalulekile? Thola esigabeni a-d ngaphansi kokwethulwa ukuthi iyiphi imithetho ephethe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Yiziphi izindawo ezibalulekile zeMthetho Wezindleko Zempahla Zomkhandlu ezidinga ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi? Yenza lo msebenzi ngamaqembu ama-4 noma ama-5. Buza amaqembu ukuthi abhale izindlela umphakathi angabamba ngazo iqhaza ezindabeni zikamasipala. Batshele iqembu ukuthi lokhu kungenzeka kube isigaba esibaluleke kakhulu kule ncwadi yokuzilolonga. Yenza umsebenzi kuqala ukuze uthole ukuthi izindawo zabo zokukhathazeka zikhona kuphi. Baphe umsebenzi ngamaqembu ama-4 noma ama-5. Thola isigaba 7 - khombisa ukuthi imikhawulo yemikhombandlela kufanele ifakwe. Thola isigaba 2 - khombisa ukuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha kufanele ifakwe. Batshele iqembu ukuthi "ihhovisi lesikhulumi" kufanele likwazi ukubanika isibonakaliso sokuthi bangathola kuphi amakhophi emithetho efanele abadinga ukuyazi. Ngomkhandlu womkhandlu - bheka 6. Khansela umkhandlu - bheka 6. Amalungu omkhandlu - bheka 6.4 esigabeni. Yini indima yesikhulumi kulolu hlelo Inombolo 7.3 esigabeni ixoxa ngenkhetho yamalungu omkhandlu - chaza kafushane ukuthi umphakathi wesikhulumi nomkhulumeli kufanele benze ini kulolu hlelo lokhetho lwamalungu omkhandlu? Khumbuza iqembu ukuthi isigaba 6 singabatholela ulwazi olufingqiwe ngenketho nezindlela zokuvota. Yini ukwakhiwa kwamakhono? Ukukhuthaza amalungu ukuba bakwazi ukusebenzisa amandla abo, ukwenza imisebenzi yabo, nokudlala izindima zabo. Kungani kudingeka sakhe amakhono? Yenza lo msebenzi ngamaqembu ama-4 noma ama-5. Thola inombolo 5 yesigaba - khuluma kafushane ngezinto ezinemibhalo. Umkhandlu ungawuqinisekisa kanjani ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezithengekayo? Gqamisa ukuthi kubalulekile kumphakathi ukuba wazi ngezinsizakalo abazozithola. Ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ikakhulukazi, abantu bavame ukuqhathanisa izinsizakalo zabo nezasezindaweni ezincane nezinkulu, futhi ngalokho abaneliseki nhlobo. Batshele iqembu ukuthi kubalulekile kumkhandlu wabo ukuba acacise amazinga wezinsizakalo futhi abakhombise ithebula inombolo 4.1 nokuthi amazinga wezinsizakalo axhunyaniswe nalokho abantu abangakwazi ukukhokha. Ubani onesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo? Ikakhulu umkhandlu, kodwa kaningi umkhandlu awukwazi ukwenza lokhu ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zezimali/ukusebenza. Chaza kafushane ngakho konke okukhuluma ngenhla - bheka inombolo 3 yesigaba yiziphi indima yomkhandlu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo? Xoxa ngemithetho ehola umkhandlu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo. Chaza imithetho yokuphatha kahle - inombolo 8. Kungani imikhandlu inama-MSP? Ngesinye isikhathi imikhandlu ayinazo izinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Chaza iqembu ukuthi indima yabo njengomkhandlu inqubo ye-IDP! Umthetho Wamasistimu Omasipala 580 uthi imikhandlu kufanele isungule indlela nehlelo lokuxhumana nomphakathi nokusabalalisa ulwazi mayelana nezivumelwano zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Batshele iqembu ukuthi lezo zindlela. Yenza imisebenzi
Iyini le mbono? Le mbono ibeka abantu, izimpilo zabo, amandla abo, namathuba abo okuthuthuka njengesisekelo sokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ezosiza ekwehliseni ubumpofu. Ibonisa i-DWAF njengenhlangano ehamba phambili emkhakheni wezokusebenza ekwakheni indawo enezimo ezinhle zokukhula komnotho nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ngokusebenzisa izihlahla eziphathwayo kahle. Lokhu kubhekisisa labo abaqashwe ngqo emisebenzini yokulima izihlahla (ehhovisi elikhulu nasemazingeni enhlangano) kanye nabanye abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano ye-DWAF yonke abanezindima nemisebenzi ethinta izinto ezikhuthazayo zendawo. Kubheka ukuthi kuphi umthetho nemigomo okufanele kukhuthaze imiphumela emihle kubampofu, ukuthi izinhlelo zingatholakala kanjani futhi zibe nezincazelo ezithile ezihlobene nalokhu, nokuthi isakhiwo semakethe nendlela yokusebenza ivulekile kangakanani ezidingweni zabangenayo abasha nabakhiqizi abancane. Ihlanganisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuphatha izihlahla (ndawonye nezinhlelo ezihlanganisiwe ezihlobene) ezingathinta imizamo ehlukene yokuthuthukiswa komnotho nomphakathi njengengxenye yesu lokwehlisa ubumpofu. Lokhu kuhilela ukuqonda izindaba ezihlobene nokwenziwa kwemali nezinye izici zobumpofu bomphakathi kanye namathuba ezihlahla okuthuthukisa izimpilo. Kugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa indlela ye "forestry yabantu" ekwakheni, ukwesekwa kwezimali, nasekusebenzeni kokuqala kwezinhlangano ezisebenza emkhakheni wendawo.
Nansi engicela, ngithumele futhi ngikunika imvume yokukhupha imali yami yephenshini ku-akhawunti yasebhange eshiwo ngenhla. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi le mali evunyelwe izokwenziwa ngokuqhubekayo ngendlela ebizwa ngokuthi yi-EFT Magnetic Tape Service, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi akukho mbono wokukhokha ozonikezwa yibhange, kodwa imininingwane yokukhokha ngakunye izobhalwa ku-akhawunti yasebhange noma ku-voucher efanele. (Lokhu akwenzi uma ibhange lingakhishi izitatimende, isibonelo, ama-akhawunti okonga noma ama-akhawunti wokudlulisa). Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi amaphenshini akhokhwa ngosuku lwe-25 lwenyanga, noma uma usuku lwe-25 luhlangana nesonto, ngeSonto, noma ngempelasonto, ukukhokha kuzokwenziwa ngosuku olwandulela lokusebenza. Akukho bufakazi obubonakalayo bokuthi imali isifakiwe. Le mvume ingakhanselwa ngokukunika isaziso esibhaliwe sezinsuku eziyi-30, "ethunyelwe ngeposi elibhalisiwe." Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngiyafunga ukuthi le mininingwane eyengeziwe iyiqiniso futhi iphelele futhi ukuthi umphathiswa wezokukhokha ngeke abhekane nomthwalo wemfanelo nganoma yikuphi ukukhokha okungaholelwa ulwazi olungelona iqiniso noma olungaphelele oluthunyelwe ngami.
Bonke abaqashi abaqasha umuntu noma abaqasha mayelana nebhizinisi labo noma ezolimo badinga ukubhaliswa nokukhokha iminikelo yonyaka kuMfundisi Wokubuyiselwa. Lezi zinqwaba zingabuyiselwa kubaqashi. Ukubhaliswa kudingeka kunoma iyiphi igatsha lebhizinisi ngaphandle uma izivumelwano zenziwa zokubhaliswa ngokuhlanganyela. Imali engena kulolu mfundisi ikhiqizwa ikakhulu ngemali yokukhokha yonyaka evela kubaqashi ababhalisiwe ngokususelwa kumaphesenti noma esinqumweni somholo wanyaka okhokhelwa kubasebenzi babo. Nokho, umthetho unikeza ukuhlinzeka ngeminikelo engezansi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukukhokha akwehlisi ngaphansi kwezindleko zokuphatha. Ekupheleni kukaJanuwari unyaka ngamunye, amafomu athunyelwa kubo bonke abaqashi ababhalisiwe. La mafomu kumele agcwaliswe futhi abuyiswe ngaphambi kukaMashi 31. Unyaka wezezimali weMfundisi Wokubuyiselwa uqhubeka kusukela ngoMashi kuze kube sekupheleni kukaFebhuwari konyaka olandelayo. Lo Mfundisi uphinde uvikelwe ngezinhlinzeko ezivumela ukwehliswa kwezijeziso kubaqashi abahluleka ukukhokha, noma ukwenza ukubuyiselwa kwephesenti elingu-10 lenani lokukhokha. Ububanzi bokukhokha, okukhishwa kubaqashi, buxhomeke ohlotsheni lwezokusebenza zebhizinisi labaqashi. Ukuze kuhlukaniswe abaqashi, bahlukaniswa babe ngezigaba ezahlukene nezagatsha ngokususelwa ohlotsheni lwezenzo zabo. Ububanzi bokukhokha bu governed ngumthetho ophoqelela ukuthi imboni ngayinye kufanele ibeke izindleko zezingcuphe zayo futhi kubuyekezwa minyaka yonke. Noma yiziphi izinguquko zenziwa ngokususelwa endleleni ingcuphe ivela ngayo. Amaqashi aziswa minyaka yonke ngobubanzi besinqumo esisemthethweni mayelana nebhizinisi labo lezolimo. Umthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa abasebenzi bakho abalimala emsebenzini. Umqashi uvikelwe kuzo zonke izimo lapho abantu bengabhekisa kubo ngesikhathi senhlekelele eyenzeke emsebenzini, ngisho nasekuphakamiseni izinsolo zokungafaneleki. Umsebenzi owalimala emsebenzini unelungelo lokubuyiselwa ngaphansi kokukhubazeka kwesikhashana, ukukhubazeka okuqhubekayo (ngokwezinga lokukhubazeka), nokufa. Izindleko ezithintekayo zokwelashwa kwezempilo ezivela esenzakalweni esenzeke emsebenzini zikhokhelwa isikhathi esiyiminyaka emibili, noma isikhathi eside uma ukwelashwa kwezempilo kuzokwehlisa izinga lokukhubazeka. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi mayelana nokubika amacala, bheka iphephandaba W. Cl. 8. Ukulungiswa kubaqashi abakhipha inani elikhulu eminikelo ngaphandle kwezindleko zokuhlola ingcuphe, indlela yokunikeza izaphulelo, yasungulwa ngemuva kweminyaka emithathu. Iphesenti lesaphulelo liboniswa njengokwehluka phakathi kwezindleko zokufaka isicelo somqashi kanye nenani lemali yabo yokukhokha. Ukwanda noma ukwehla kwenani lomqashi kuxhomeke ekutheni ingcuphe yabo ihambisana noma ayihambisani nezindleko.
Ngikhuluma ngedokhumenti "enamanani alinganayo" futhi ngizojabula uma ngazi ukuthi impendulo ingalindelwa nini. Inani eliphelele lokudla okukhululekile kanye/noma indawo yokuhlala, uma lingafakiwe ku-2.2.1 noma ku-2.2. Inani eliphelele elilindeleke ukuthi likhokhwe kubo bonke abasebenzi ngaphandle kwabaphathi noma amalungu enkampani noma ikomidi limisiwe ku-R179,088 ngomuntu ngokwesikhathi esichaziwe ngenhla, bheka ku-3.2. Inani eliphelele lokudla okukhululekile - isigaba sesine, uma lingafakiwe ku-3.2.1 noma ku-3.2. Inani eliphelele 3.2.1 + 3.2.2 + 3.2. Qaphela: Uma abasebenzi abanye kanye/noma izimali zabo zihluka kakhulu kulabo bonyaka odlule, chaza kafushane izizathu zalo. Qaphela!! Izitatimende zezimali zingacelwa ngophenyo/ucwaningo lwezimali. Umsebenzi ubhekisela kumuntu oqashwe noma osebenza ngaphansi kwesivumelwano somsebenzi noma sokufunda nesisebenzi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi lesi sivumelwano sikhuluma ngokuqondile noma sithiwe ngokuqondile ngempela noma ngobufakazi, noma imali ikalwa ngaleso sikhathi noma ngokuqhuba umsebenzi, noma ngokukhokha noma ngentokozo, kuhlanganisa: umsebenzisi wesikhashana/owesivumelwano oqashwe ukwenza umsebenzi kumqashi, umphathi webhizinisi osebenza enkampanini, noma ilungu lenhlangano yabasebenzi elingene esivumelwaneni somsebenzi noma sokufunda nenhlangano yabaphethe, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi umsebenzisi akashiyi abanikazi bezabelo noma ozakwethu abakhokhelwa kuphela inzalo noma ingxenye yemali engenayo. Qaphela: Umnikazi oyedwa noma ozakwethu bezebhizinisi noma ozakwethu bezolimo abathathwa njengama "basebenzi" njengoba kuchazwe umthetho, ngakho-ke imali yabo yokukhokha akufanele ibonakale. Ukukhokha kuyizinkokhelo zonke ezenziwa njalo, ngaphambi kokuthi kube nezinkokhelo ezithile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziwumsebenzi noma ngokukhipha, kubasebenzi. Uhlu olulandelayo aluphelele kodwa luhloselwe ukukhombisa izinto ezingaba ukukhokha futhi zingadala ukudideka mayelana nokufakwa kwazo noma ukukhipha. Ikhomishini, noma inani lihluka inyanga nenyanga. Lilingana nenani lokudla kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwabasebenzi njengengxenye yemali. Izinkokhelo ezenziwa kubaphathi benkampani noma amalungu e-Close Corporation asebenza kufanele zivezwe ngendlela ehlukile esigabeni 2.2. Uma umsebenzi wakho uqediwe, chaza usuku lokupheliswa kwawo ekhasini elandulele bese uveza izinkokhelo zokugcina ezenziwe ngalolo suku. Izicelo ezithunyelwe ngababonisi noma abamele amaqashi kufanele zenziwe ebhalwe phansi futhi zibe neleta yokugunyazwa - iPower of Attorney. f Izicelo ezithunyelwe zamukelwa g Imizamo yokushintsha okukhulunywe kulezi zinkampani kuyiphutha elinzima.

Ukuhlawulwa kwe-akhawunti kuqinisekiswe ngo... Ukuhlawulwa kwe-akhawunti yakho kusemva kokwamukela... I-accident isaqhubeka nokuhlolwa uma icala lamukelwa, ukuhlawulwa kwe-akhawunti yakho kungalindelwa. I-akhawunti yakho kumele ibe ne-rekhodi kule ofisi. Sicela usithumele ikhophi efanele ye-akhawunti, ulandela inombolo yokubhekisela engenhla. Ikhophi/izinkophi zezimemezelo zempilo zokuqala nezokugcina nezithombe ze-x-ray nazo ziyadingeka. Uma kudingeka ukuxhumana okwengeziwe sicela ulandele inombolo yokubhekisela engenhla. Umphakathi wezokubuyiselwa Usuku:... Ifomu elihlukile, eligcwalisiwe njenge-duplicate, kumele lithunyelwe ne-akhawunti efanele, mayelana nanoma iyiphi i-akhawunti ethathé izinyanga ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ukuze ikhokhwe. Odokotela bezokwelapha noma izibhedlela eziphathelene nezingozi zomsebenzi kumele, ngaphezu kwe-akhawunti echaziwe kanye nefomu labo, bathumele uSectin B weMibiko yoMqashi kanye nekhophi yeMibiko Yokuqala Yokulimala W. Cl. Uma le ofisi ithola ukuthi umqashi akazange abike ingozi, uma imibhalo eshiwo ngenhla itholakala, uzoxhumana nawe ngokushesha. Ezimweni lapho ingozi incane futhi imibiko eshiwo ngenhla itholakala, kuzoba lula ukwamukela isicelo nokuphothula ukuhlawulwa kwe-akhawunti.
Chaza ngokubekezela ukuthi ungawuhlola kanjani umphumela wezimpilo zamehlo, ubonisa kahle ezithombeni ezilandelayo umphumela noma umphumela wokulimala mayelana nesimo samanje samehlo. Ngokuvota, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathatheka enhlanganweni yezenkolo yokukhetha uMongameli omusha. Manje njengoba sesazi imiphumela yokhetho, sekuyisikhathi sokufungisa uMongameli omusha. Kulolu suku, uMongameli omusha ufungiswa nguMphakathi Oyinhloko waseNingizimu Afrika. Oomongameli abavela kwamanye amazwe, izikhulu zikahulumeni, kanye nezithunywa ezivela kuhulumeni bamanye amazwe bayavakashela leli eventi elibalulekile. Kuzoba nomculo nemidlalo yendabuko ekugubheni leli suku. Ngabe ukufungiswa kukaMongameli kuzokwenzeka nini? Leli suku singahlangana njengomphakathi ukuze siqhubeke sakha iNingizimu Afrika esingayigqaja ngayo. Ungaba kanjani yingxenye yokugubha ukufungiswa kukaMongameli? Uma udinga ulwazi ngemicimbi endaweni yakho, shayela u-1020 (inombolo yokushayela engenamali uma ushayela kusuka kumakhalekhukhwini). Ndawonye sihlangene ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo!
Usuku Lokubamba iqhaza komphakathi luyinsiza yokukhuthaza ingxoxo nokuxhumana phakathi kuk政府 nomphakathi. Lunikeza ithuba kuk政府 ukuze lihlanganise uhlelo lwalo lokusebenza nentuthuko esivele yenziwe. Lukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi nokubambisana phakathi komphakathi kuk政府. Usuku Lokubamba iqhaza komphakathi lunikeza kuk政府 ithuba lokuxhumana nemiphakathi, ukuphendula ekwenzeni uhlelo lokusebenza. Ingxoxo ebusweni-bubuso phakathi kwezinga lezi zikhungo ezintathu zik政府 (ezwe, isifunda, kanye nendawo) nomphakathi iqinisekisa ukuthi kuk政府 uxhumana nabantu bayo. Ngesikhathi salolu suku, imiphakathi kanye kuk政府 izobamba iqhaza ezinkundleni ezisunguliwe ezifana nezinkomiti zezakhamizi nemihlangano yezikhungo ukuze kukhuphuke izinkinga futhi kuhlanganyelwe izixazululo. Ukugxila kuzoba ekwandiseni amandla emiphakathi njengababambiqhaza ekwenzeni izixazululo, ngokuxhaswa kokubambisana okuvela kuk政府. Ihhovisi likaMongameli liphinde lanikeza izinyathelo ezengeziwe zokuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kuk政府 nabantu, kanye nokusheshisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kubantu. Sihlinzeka ngezinkinga ezivele zaziwa ezingxoxweni ezahlukene nasocwaningweni. Sihambe kude kule minyaka engu-15 yokukhululeka, kodwa izinkinga eziningi zisasemhlabeni. Ithuba lezakhamizi ezinomsebenzi ophilayo lenyuke lisuka ku-61.7% ngo-1994 laya ku-91.8% ngoMashi 2009, kodwa kusekhona okuningi okudingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu abasenhla. Siseduze nokufeza umgomo wethu wokukhipha uhlelo lokuhlanzeka lwezimbiza ezakhiwe kuk政府, ngenhloso yokuthi lolu hlelo luphume ngokuphelele ezweni lonke ngaphambi kuka-2014. Sisenokukhathazeka ngezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ubumpofu, izikhungo zezempilo ezinganele, kanye nokungathuthuki, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni. Masisebenzise lezi zinkundla ukuze sixhumane nez representatives zomphakathi futhi sishintshe indlela yokulimaza impahla nezinsiza ezihloselwe ukusiza lezo zindawo. Sikhathazekile ngezikhathi zokulinda ezinsizakalweni ezithembisiwe kumiphakathi; siyazi ukuthi ngokubambisana nezicwangciso singafeza okuningi futhi ngokushesha.
Ngicela usizo lwakho nokubandakanyeka nehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana ne-Influenza A (H1N1) endaweni yakho yokufundisa. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni leli gciwane nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walonyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa njengokugula kwezinkomo ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi kuvela ezinkomeni. Manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi umthombo walo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, leli gciwane alihlangene nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sekubizwa ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngegama layo elisemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walonyaka, leli gciwane lisabalale ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalale ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane lihlasele abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekiswe yizikhungo zocwaningo lwesayensi) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. ENingizimu Afrika, siqinisekisile izigameko ezingu-2,844 zokufa phakathi kwabantu abangu-6 kuze kube manje. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwesine kweKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo okwenzeka ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi Lezempilo Lomhlaba (WHO) laphawula ukuthi izinqubo zokumemezela leli gciwane njengokuphakanyiswa komhlaba seziphumelele, futhi uMphathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, usememezele ngokusemthethweni le ndawo njengePandemic (izinga lesi-6). Lokhu kusho ukuthi leli gciwane lisabalale ezwenikazi zonke zeWHO futhi lenzeke ngokushesha. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi leli gciwane linamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi liyaqhubeka lisabalala yonke indawo. Ngomhla kaJulayi 6, iWHO ichaze isimo esiqhubekayo saleli gciwane ezweni ezithintekile nakwezinye izwe njengokungamukeleki nokungavinjwa. Ngempela, naphezu kwalokhu, iphinde yaphawula ukuthi abantu abaningi abane-gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasendaweni, sikhathazekile ngama-efekthini abekade kwenzeka kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye no-0.2% wabantu abane-gciwane eNingizimu Afrika). Leli gciwane liba nomthelela ikakhulukazi kubantu abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-29 - iningi labo ngababafundi noma labo abakwi-institutions eziphakeme. IWHO icele ukuthi amazwe athintekile agxile ekwehliseni umthelela waleli gciwane emiphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Leli gciwane lidluliselwa ngezinsalela zomoya, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu ophukile ekhwehlela noma ehlanza, uphonsa umoya owonakele noma owakhiphayo. Noma uma behlaza endaweni encane, ungase ube nokungena emoyeni lapho ungase ufezeke. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani onama-symptoms alula noma abukhali kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokunconywa udokotela. Abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kusuka esikhungweni socwaningo lwesayensi. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu okwenzeka okwamanje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukona okudinga iWHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe izimo eziphakeme ngokuya ngemininingwane yokusabalalisa (protocol) enikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela emiphumeleni engcono yokwelashwa uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangase baphile. Ulwazi lwemhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zokufunda nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwalesi sifo. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi onama-symptoms alula kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi futhi/noma othisha abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezobulungiswa, ozobambisana nezikhulu zezempilo ukuze kunikezwe umhlahlandlela ofanele. Uma unama-symptoms alula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabanye. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana neWHO ukuzama ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kukhona isidingo esikhulu sokuxazulula kanye nokukhiqiza okukhulu okunganele - isikali esikhona e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukukubonga ngalesi sikhathi osithathile ukufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubekayo ngokubandakanyeka kwakho ekusabalaliseni ulwazi nasekwehliseni umthelela waleli gciwane.

Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwesine kweKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo okwenzeka ngomhla ziyi-11 kuJuni 2009, iHhovisi leMhlaba (WHO) laphawula ukuthi izimfuneko zokubiza leli gciwane njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke seziphumelele, futhi uMphathiswa-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, useveze ngokusemthethweni le ndawo njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho nje ukuthi leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni kuzo zonke izifunda ze-WHO futhi lenzeke ngokushesha okukhulu. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukusho ukuthi leli gciwane liyi-pandemic akusho ukuthi linamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi liqhubeka lisabalala yonke indawo. Ngomhla ziyi-6 kuJulayi, i-WHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwaleli gciwane ezweni elithintekile nakwamanye amazwe njengokungapheli futhi okungavinjwa. Ngiyabonga, naphezu kwalokhu, iphinde yaphawula ukuthi abantu abaningi abathintekile ngale gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina sikhuluma njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasekhaya, sikhathazekile ngokuqhubeka kokufa okwenzekile kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abathintekile eNingizimu Afrika). Leli gciwane libhekana kakhulu nabantu abaneminyaka engu-10 kuya kwengu-29 - iningi labo ngababhalisile noma basemazingeni aphezulu ezemfundo. I-WHO iphakamisa ukuthi amazwe ahlobene agxile ekwehliseni umthelela wale gciwane emiphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Leli gciwane lidluliselwa ngezinsalela zomoya, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu othintekile ekhwehlela noma ekhala, uthatha lezi zinsalela abakhwehlela noma abakhale. Nokho, uma bekhwehlela endaweni evaliwe, ungase uthathe umoya lapho ungathinteka khona. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banemiphumela elula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani onemiphumela elula noma enzima kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule i-branch eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nesiphakamiso sikadokotela. Abaguli abadinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kusuka esikhungweni socwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu okwamanje kwenzeka emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukuhlosile i-WHO. Odokotela kufanele bakwelaphe amacala abekwe engcupheni ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokudluliselwa kolwazi (protocol) ezitholwe nguMnyango Wezempilo. Izinketho zokwelashwa zifaka iTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela emiphumeleni engcono yokwelashwa uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangase basindise izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi lomhlaba jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zokuthenga, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwalesi gciwane. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzisi onemiphumela elula kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi nabaqeqeshi abakhokhelwayo abakhoyo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozosebenza nezikhulu zezempilo ukuze banikeze izinyathelo ezifanele okufanele zithathwe. Uma unemiphumela elula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabantu. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuze bazame ukuthola isixazululo. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, isixazululo esinjalo singatholakala ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Nokho, kukhona isidingo esikhulu sesixazululo kanye namandla okukhiqiza anele - amandla angatholakali e-Afrika. Ngifuna ukubonga isikhathi osithathile sokufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubeka kwakho kokuba nendima yokusabalalisa ulwazi nokunciphisa imiphumela yale gciwane.
Ngicela usizo lwakho nokubandakanyeka kwakho kanye nehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana ne-pandemic influenza A (H1N1) 2009 ebhizinisini lakho nasemphakathini owusebenzela. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni leli gciwane nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa ngokuthi i-swine flu ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi ivela ezinkukhu. Manje sekuqondwa ukuthi imvelaphi yayo ivela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, leli gciwane alihlangene nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sekuhlonishwa ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngegama layo elisemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka, leli gciwane lisabalalise ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane selithinte abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekisiwe yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. eNingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 kanye nezingozi eziyisithupha. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lokuphendula Okusheshayo owawubanjwe ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi Lomhlaba Wezempilo (WHO) lathola ukuthi izinqubo zokumemezela leli gciwane njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke sezifeziwe, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, usememezele ngokusemthethweni lesi simo njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho ukuthi leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni zonke ezindaweni ze-WHO futhi lenze ngokushesha. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi leli gciwane linamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi liqhubeka lisabalala yonke indawo. NgoJulayi 6, i-WHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwale pandemic ezweni ezithintekile kanye nezwe ezintsha njengokungamukeleki nokungabambeki. Ngaphandle kwalokho, nakuba kunjalo, iphinde yathi abantu abaningi abathintekile ngaleli gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasekhaya, sikhathazekile ngalezi zingozi ezikhona kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abathintekile eNingizimu Afrika). Leli gciwane liba nomthelela ikakhulukazi kubantu abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-10 kuya kwengu-29 - iningi labo lingabafundi noma ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. I-WHO inikeze iseluleko ukuthi amazwe afanele agxile ekunciphiseni umthelela wale gciwane emphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Leli gciwane lisabalala ngeziphuzo zokuphefumula, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu othintekile ekhwehlela noma ekhala, uphonsa lezi ziphuzo ezikhiphayo noma ezingavikelwanga. Nakuba bengavikela umlomo wabo, ungase uphumelele umoya lapho bekhipha khona lezi ziphuzo. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani ongezimpawu ezilula noma ezinzima kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, esivule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngesiphakamiso sikadokotela. Abaguli abadinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo lukamasipala akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa ezikhungweni zocwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu kwenzekela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezizimele, kodwa akukhona okudingwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe amacala aphakanyisiwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokudluliswa kolwazi (protocol) ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela eziphethweni zokwelashwa ezingcono uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangase bafe. Ulwazi olutholakala emhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwale gciwane. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Sicebisa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umsebenzi ongezimpawu ezilula ahlale ekhaya. Uma kunezithombe eziningi zabafundi nabaqeqeshi abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozosebenza ngokubambisana nezikhulu zezempilo ukuhlinzeka ngamaqhaza afanele okuqhubeka. Uma ungezimpawu ezilula, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabanye. Ngifuna ukukwazisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemandleni emhlabeni jikelele ngokubambisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola isixazululo. Ngifuna ukubonga isikhathi osithathile sokufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuqhubekayo ngokubamba iqhaza kwakho ekusabalaliseni ulwazi nasekunciphiseni umthelela wale gciwane.

Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa njenge-swine flu ngoba kwakholelwa ukuthi kuvela ezinkukhu. Manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi umthombo walo uvela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, lesi sifo asinakho ukuxhumana nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sesibizwa nje ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngamagama ayo asemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka, leli gciwane lisabalalile ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalalile ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane lihlasele abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekiswe yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. ENingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile izimo ezingu-2,844 ezinezingozi eziyisithupha. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kwesine kweKomidi Lezimo Eziphuthumayo okwenzeka ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi leMvelo Yezempilo (WHO) lathola ukuthi izimfuneko zokumemezela lesi sifo njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke sezihlangatshezwa, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, usememezele ngokusemthethweni le ndaba njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho ukuthi lesi sifo sesisabalalile ezweni lonke ezindaweni zikaWHO futhi senzeke ngokushesha. Nokho, ngithanda ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi lesi sifo sinezinga eliphezulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi siqhubeka nokusabalala kuyo yonke indawo. Ngomhla kaJulayi 6, iWHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwe-pandemic kulezi zizwe ezithintekile kanye nezizwe ezintsha njengokungamukeleki nokungabambeki. Ngaphandle kwalokho, yaphinde yasho ukuthi abantu abaningi abahlaselwe yileli gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasekhaya, sikhathazekile ngempilo yokufa okwenzekile kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abahlaselwe eNingizimu Afrika). I-virus ithinta ikakhulukazi abantu abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-10 no-29 - abaningi babo bangabafundi noma baphakathi kwezemfundo ephakeme. IWHO icele ukuthi amazwe athintekayo agxile ekunciphiseni umthelela waleli sifo emphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Lesi sifo sithunyelwa ngeziphuzo zomoya, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu ophilayo ekhwehlela noma ethukile, uphuzisa lezi ziphuzo abezikhwethile noma abekwe ngaphandle. Noma uma bekhwehlela endaweni eqinile, ungase uphuzise umoya lapho ungahlaselwa khona. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banokuphazamiseka okuncane futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani onezimpawu ezilula noma ezinzima kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, evule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngokunconywa udokotela. Abaguli abafuna ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo yomphakathi akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa kusuka emlabasini ocwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu okwenzeka manje emkhakheni wezempilo yangasese, kodwa akukona okudingwa yiWHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe izimo ezithintekayo ngokwezimfuneko zokudlulisa ulwazi (ama-protocols) anikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela ekutholeni imiphumela engcono yokwelashwa uma lo muthi usebenza futhi kungavimbela labo abangakwazi ukusindisa izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi olukhona emhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwesifo. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini. Kunconywa ukuthi noma ubani umfundi, uthisha, noma umqashi onokuphazamiseka okuncane kufanele ahlale ekhaya. Uma kukhona abafundi abaningi kanye/noma othisha abangenayo, isikhungo esithintekile kufanele sixhumane noMnyango Wezemfundo, ozosebenza ndawonye nezikhungo zezempilo ukuze anikeze izeluleko ngezinyathelo ezifanele ezithathwayo. Uma unokuphazamiseka okuncane, hlala ekhaya futhi ugweme ukuxhumana nabantu. Ngithanda ukubonga isikhathi osithathile ukufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiyabonga futhi ngokuhlanganyela kwakho okulindelekile ekusakazeni ulwazi nasekunciphiseni umthelela waleli sifo.
Lapho umqondo weziningi uqala ngo-1994, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banikela uhulumeni wabo wokuqala wenkululeko ukuba babhekane nesikhumbuzo se-apartheid - ikakhulukazi ukungalingani, ubuphofu, nokucwaswa. Kwakufanele futhi ukubuyisela izwe emphakathini womhlaba owawukhishwa ngenxa ye-apartheid. Ngonyaka ka-2004, ngemuva kweminyaka eyishumi yenhlalakahle, kube nentuthuko enkulu, kodwa okuningi kusasele ukwenza. Nakuba sizame ukubhekana nesikhumbuzo se-apartheid, izinguquko emphakathini wethu zilethe izinselelo eziningi. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka eyisibili yokukhululeka, abaningi bahlala ngaphandle komnotho futhi bengakwazi ukujabulela ukuthuthukiswa. Nakuba kukhona okuthuthukile lapha, uhulumeni ubebambezeleka ezindaweni lapho kwakudingeka ukuba abambisane nabanye, njengokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Uhulumeni uqobo udinga ukusebenza ngokuqinile futhi ubhekane kangcono nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukhetho luka-2004 lwenze ukuthi uhulumeni uqale ukufaka izinhlelo ezizokwakha futhi zixhase - futhi futhi zisheshise - ukuthuthukiswa nokubhekana nezinkinga. Uhulumeni ubize ukubambisana nomphakathi, ubeka izinhloso zokunciphisa ubuphofu nokungasebenzi ngonyaka ka-2014. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kukahulumeni, izikhangiso ezivusa umqondo zokulwa nobugebengu kanye nobudlelwano beNingizimu Afrika namanye amazwe nazo ziqalile. Kwenzekeni ngemuva kweminyaka engu-15? Isisekelo esibekwe eminyakeni yokuqala yokuphatha ngenhlalakahle nezinhlelo ezintsha kusukela ngo-2004 sekwenze ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibe nendlela yokukhula okusheshayo. Ngasikhathi sinye, ezinye izinselelo ziqhubekile. Izinselelo ezintsha zivele nezinguquko emphakathini wethu nasemhlabeni esiwutholayo. Njengoba siqhubeka phambili, kudingeka sifunde esikhathini esidlule. Kulokhu kweminyaka engu-15 yokukhululeka, umthelela wezinhlelo zikahulumeni ububekwe kanjani ekusizeni iNingizimu Afrika ukuba ibe nomphakathi ogxile ekulinganeni, ukungacwaswa ngokobuhlanga, nokungacwaswa ngokobulili? Uhulumeni uphumelele kanjani kulokho abekwe khona, futhi lokhu kungenziwa kanjani kube ngcono? Ucwaningo lwenziwe ngaphakathi kukahulumeni nangaphandle. Imiphumela yaphuma njengombiko esizowuxoxa. Inhloso yalezi zindaba ukukhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuba axoxe ngalezi zindaba njengoba izwe lethu liqhubeka phambili ekwakheni umphakathi omusha. Yiziphi izindlela ezithuthukisile? Yiziphi izinto ezingashintshanga? Yisiphi isichasiso esenziwe ngumphakathi nabantu? Singaqinisekisa kanjani ukubambisana ukuze izinto ziqhubeke phambili? Lo mbhalo uyisifinyezo sokubuyekezwa kweminyaka engu-15. Umbiko ophelele utholakala ku-inthanethi yeHhovisi likaMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika (www.gov.za). Kusukela ngo-2004, kube nokugxila ekusebenzeni ngokuvumelana nomqondo weziningi nasekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kukahulumeni. I-democracy egxile emthethweni - ukuvezwa kwezikole eziphakeme kanye neziqu ezizimele sekubekwe. Abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa komphakathi - kukhona abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe abangaphezu kuka-3,000. Ukwazi kwabaholi bendabuko ku-democracy - imithetho neminyango emisha inikeza ubuholi bendabuko indima ohlelweni lwethu lwezombusazwe. Ukuguqulwa kokusebenza kukahulumeni - iminyaka eyishumi yokuqala ilethe intuthuko emangalisayo ekuhlanganiseni imisebenzi ehlukene ohlelweni oluhlangene lomphakathi. Ukusebenza kukahulumeni kuncike kakhulu emiphakathini. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1999 kanye noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomkhandlu, 2003 kuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuhlela, ukuqapha, nokuhlola kube kuqinisiwe. Kukhona izinhlelo zokuphatha ukusebenza kukahulumeni. Umkhankaso omkhulu wokuqeqesha waqala lapho kwavulwa isikhungo sokuqeqesha abasebenzi kukahulumeni ngo-Agasti 2008. Ukukhula kwezinkinga kukhombisa isidingo sokukhulisa iziteshi zokuxhumana phakathi kwezizalwane nalabo abaphethe. Umsebenzi womphakathi udinga ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni eziningi. Ukuqala ukusebenza kahle kwehlisa umthelela wezikhangiso zokulwa nobugebengu. Uhulumeni, ikakhulukazi ezingeni likamasipala, ubhekene nezinkinga zokuhola nokugcina abasebenzi abadingekayo. Izinhlelo zomphakathi zenzile okuningi ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, kodwa izixazululo zesikhathi eside zidingeka. Uhlelo lwezikhwama zokuxhaswa - lokhu kube yinto ebalulekile ekunciphiseni inani labantu abaphila ebuphofwini. Kwakukhona abantu abangu-2.5 million abawatholayo ngo-1999 - manje sekuhamba phambili ngaphezu kuka-12 million. Ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile, ezokuhlanzeka, kanye ne-electrification. Imindeni emisha ithola izidingo eziyisisekelo mahhala: amalitha angu-6,000 wamanzi kanye ne-50 kilowatts ye-electrification ngenyanga. Ikhwalithi yezinsizakalo zomphakathi idinga ukuthuthukiswa. Naphezu kwesabelomali esikhulu semfundo, leli hlelo likhiqiza imiphumela engaguquki. Imfundo - izindlela zokuthuthukisa imfundo zikhuphule izinga labafundi. Iningi lemali lisetshenziselwa ukufundisa ezikoleni zomphakathi, Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezingane Ezingakabi Nempilo, Imfundo Yabantu Abakhulile, kanye neMikhakha Yezemfundo Nezokuqeqesha. Izi-16 Zamahubo Zokulwa Nezokuhlukumeza Abesifazane Nezingane iyisikhangiso sezwe esenzeka minyaka yonke kusukela ngomhla ka-25 Novemba (Usuku Lomhlaba Lokulwa Nezokuhlukumeza Abesifazane) kuze kube ngomhla ka-10 December (Usuku Lwamalungelo Abantu). Phakathi nalesi sikhathi, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika uqhuba umkhankaso wezama-16 wokulwa nezokuhlukumeza okukhomba ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngempempe ethinta abesifazane nezingane. Lo mkhankaso uhlose ukuhlanganisa zonke izigaba zomphakathi ukuze kulwe nokuhlukumeza. Uhulumeni uzinikele ekwakheni umphakathi onakekela futhi ophumulelayo ovikela abesifazane nezingane ezinhlotsheni zonke zokuhlukumeza. Nakuba umkhankaso wezama-16 wokulwa nezokuhlukumeza uqhubeka minyaka yonke kusukela ngomhla ka-25 Novemba kuze kube ngomhla ka-10 December, imigomo yawo ivuselelwa ngohlelo lweminyaka elodwa olwaziwa ngokuthi uHlelo lwe-365 Days kanye noHlelo LwaseNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka nonyaka, uhulumeni, ngokubambisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi nezimboni, uqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe umthelela womkhankaso. Ngokweseka lo mkhankaso, izinkulungwane zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ziyasiza ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngokuqhuba nokwakha ukwesekwa kulabo abahlukunyezwayo nalabo abaphunyukile emiphumeleni yokuhlukumeza. Sekela umkhankaso ngokugqoka i-ribbon emhlophe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-16: I-ribbon emhlophe iyisikhumbuzo sokuthula esimele ukuzinikela komgibeli ekungayeki ukuhlukumeza okukhuluma ngakho abesifazane nezingane. Bamba iqhaza ezingxoxweni ezenzakalayo: Lezi zingxoxo ziqala ukuze kuqale izingxoxo phakathi kwabantu ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela: www.genderlinks.org.za noma uvakashele isikhungo seThusong sendawo yakho. Bamba iqhaza emicimbini ehlukahlukene phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-16 zokulwa nokuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane: Kukhona ikhalenda yemicimbi eyenzeka ezweni lonke kusukela ngomhla ka-25 Novemba kuze kube ngomhla ka-10 December. Ukuze ubone le micimbi, hlola le webhusayithi www.womensnet.org.za/calendar.shtml. Yiba umphakathi wokweseka izinhlelo ezizimele nemiphakathi esiza abesifazane nezingane abahlukunyezwayo: Izinhlelo eziningi ezisiza labo abahlukunyezwayo nabaphunyukile zidinga ukwesekwa komphakathi. Unganikeza isikhathi sakho ngokusiza ezikhungweni. Bheka isikhungo somphakathi eduze kwakho lapho ungakwazi khona ukusiza. Ungathola olunye ulwazi ngezinhlelo ongazisiza kule webhusayithi: www.csvr.org.za. Iminikelo: Unganikeza imali ezinhlelweni ezisebenzela ukuvimbela ukuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane ngokufaka imali kwiMali Yamalungelo Abantu. Akukhona okukhululekile okukhethiwe okumele kunikezwe - konke kuncike kuwe! Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, hlola le webhusayithi: www.fhr.org.za noma shayela le nombolo 012 440 1691. Khuluma ngokuhlukumeza abesifazane nezingane: Khuthaza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo abathule ukuba bakhulume. Bika ukuhlukumeza izingane emaphoyiseni. Joyina ama-forum okuphepha komphakathi noma ama-forum okuphepha komphakathi: Umphakathi neziteshi zamaphoyisa zisebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nomphakathi. Ngokujoyina lezi zinsiza, ungasiza ekulweni nobugebengu endaweni yakho. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi lokuthi ungajoyina kanjani, xhumana nesiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo yakho. Uma uhlukunyezwa nganoma iyiphi indlela noma uma wazi omunye umuntu ophoqelelwe, funa usizo - thola usizo.
Inhloso yewebhusayithi yezinsizakalo zikahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ukuhlinzeka ngendawo eyodwa yolwazi mayelana nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa nguhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso ukuvulela indlela phakathi kwabaphakeme nabaphansi, phakathi komnotho wokuqala nowesibili. Le webhusayithi iyazama ukuhlinzeka ngengxenye ebalulekile yokuxhumana nokusiza ngenhloso yokwenzela wonke umphakathi ithuba lokuxhumana nohulumeni. Abasebenzisi abaqondiwe ngababantu baseNingizimu Afrika bavelaphi emhlabeni jikelele, amabhizinisi akhona kanye namabhizinisi azayo eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezikhungo noma abantu bangaphandle abafuna izinsizakalo ezivela kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Le webhusayithi iqukethe ulwazi ngezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ezinikezwa nguhulumeni ezingeni lesizwe. Izinsizakalo zabantu bangaphandle: ulwazi oluthile lwabantu bangaphandle abafuna izinsizakalo ezihlobene nohulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Ngamunye walawa magatsha ahlelwe ngendlela ehambisana nezikhathi zokuphila komuntu noma ibhizinisi. Izikhathi zokuphila zihlukaniswe ngokulandela izigaba zokuphila. Ulwazi ngezinsizakalo nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo luhlelwe ngokwezindawo eziyisixhenxe ezibalulekile, okukhuluma ngazo: incazelo, izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe, imithetho nemigomo, amazinga okuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo nezikhathi, izindleko, amafomu okufanele agcwaliswe, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Njengoba ulwazi lwabhalwa kuqala ngesiNgisi bese luhunyushwa kwezinye izilimi, ulwazi ngezinsizakalo kwezinye izilimi lufakwa kwiwebhusayithi ngemuva kokuhunyushwa. Sebenzisa ikhasi lokuxhumana nathi ukuze uphawule noma ubuze ngalesi siza seZinsizakalo Zikahulumeni. Imephu yewebhusayithi ihlinzeka ngezithombe nezichazamazwi zokwakheka kwewebhusayithi. Ihlelwe ukusuka phansi kuya phezulu, okwenza ulwazi kwiwebhusayithi luhlelwe ngamagatsha nezihloko ezithile. Lokhu kusiza ukubona kahle nokuqonda ukuhlela nokuqukethwe okukhonjiswa yiwebhusayithi. Ikhasi eliyinhloko likhombisa izinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula. Lezi zindawo zokungena ziza ziwusizo ekutholeni izinsizakalo eziyishumi ezivakashelwe kakhulu ngabasebenzisi. Uhlu luhlelwe futhi luhlelwe ngokuhlinzeka ngamanani avakashi epage. Ibhokisi lokusesha likhona kuzo zonke amakhasi ewebhusayithi. Uma ufaka igama lokusesha, lizosesha kwiwebhusayithi yonke leyo mibhalo, likhethe izixhumanisi lapho kwenzeka khona ukufuna okuyinhloko. Umsebenzi wokusesha uwukufuna ulwazi kwezinye iziza zikahulumeni.
