Izixhumanisi kwezinye iziza zangaphandle zikhonjiswa futhi ngamazwi 'ixhumanisi langaphandle - livula efasiteleni elisha' ezovela ebhokisini uma ikhursi yakho ihambisana naleyo xhumanisi. Le webhusayithi izovuleka efasiteleni elisha ukuze uhlole ezinye iziza. Le webhusayithi izoqhubeka ibuyekezwa ngolwazi olusha. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi noma ngabe lukhona. Nokho, abaklami nabathuthukisi bewebhusayithi yeZinsizakalo Zikahulumeni abakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluvela kwezinye iziza esixhumanisa kuzo luzoba lunembile ngaleso sikhathi. Bheka Izimo Nezimo, isigaba 4.3. Ulwazi luhlelwe kakhulu kule webhusayithi ku-HTML format. Nokho, amanye amadokhumenti atholakala ku-PDF format, ahlinzekwe ngendlela yokuthi ahlale ku-format okufanele abe kuyo ukuze ahlelwe futhi atholakale. Kungathatha isikhathi eside ukuvula amadokhumenti e-PDF. Kulokhu, siphakamisa ukuthi ulande amadokhumenti kukhompyutha yakho bese uwavula lapho. Sebenzisa imouse yakho, u-right-click kumadokhumenti ofuna ukuwadlula. Ku-'Save as' window, khetha indawo ofuna ukuyigcina kumakhompyutha akho, bese uchofoza inkinobho ethi 'Save'. Ifayela lizogcinwa endaweni oyikhethile. Ingabe udinga usizo ngezinkinga ozihlangabezana nazo kule webhusayithi? Sicela uxhumane nathi ku-imeyili: uma unenkinga ngewebhusayithi.
Inhloso yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiMininingwane ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenzisa ilungelo labo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela imininingwane ephethwe uhulumeni, kanye nemininingwane ephethwe abanye abantu, edingekayo ukuze umuntu akwazi ukusebenzisa noma ukuvikela noma yiziphi izimfanelo. Umgomo ophambili wokwenza kube nokufinyelela imininingwane ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okucacisa nokubhekelela ohulumeni nasezinkampanini ezizimele, futhi ukuthuthukisa umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinyelela imininingwane ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa noma ukuvikela zonke izimfanelo zabo. Ingabe kukhona imininingwane equkethwe eMnyangweni Wezobulungiswa noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi engatholakala? Ungafinyelela wonke amadokhumenti kanye/noma amarekhodi avela eMnyangweni, kubasebenzi bawo, noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano kahulumeni. Akubalulekile ukuthi le mininingwane yafika nini. Amarekhodi omuntu siqu avela eMnyangweni noma enhlanganweni kahulumeni. Imininingwane mayelana nez parties ezithile noma amarekhodi kuphela ngevumelekile ye-party ethile, ikakhulukazi uma amadokhumenti aqukethe imininingwane eyimfihlo noma eyasendaweni. Imininingwane engavunyelwe ayitholakali ngokulandela iMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiMininingwane. Ukufinyelela imininingwane kuncike ezitheni ezithile, ngokwesibonelo, uma amarekhodi eceliwe asetshenziswa ezinqubweni zomthethosisekelo noma ezingezona ezomthethosisekelo noma uma izinqubo zomthethosisekelo noma ezingezona ezomthethosisekelo seziqale, lapho imininingwane ingase ingasetshenziswanga enkantolo, ikakhulukazi uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi kungalimaza ukuphathwa kwezobulungiswa. Amarekhodi ezikhwama noma amakomidi azo. Amarekhodi ahlobene nokusebenza kwezinkantolo nabaJaji. Imininingwane etholakala ezinkantolo ezikhethekile ezinquma izingxabano ezithile nezicelo, ezisungulwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Futhi imininingwane ephethwe ngumuntu oyilungu lephalamende noma lezakhamuzi zendawo. Qedela futhi uthumele Ifomu A: Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi kahulumeni. Ungakuthola ehhovisi leMnyango Wezobulungiswa. Uma imininingwane oyifunayo ingatholakali mahhala, kuzodingeka ukuthi uyikhokhele. Ungadinga ukukhokha imali yokucwaninga ukuze ufinyelele imininingwane. Umphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane, ongumuntu ophakanyisiwe wokufinyelela imininingwane, kumele aphendule phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo sakho. Uma umphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane enqaba isicelo sakho sokufinyelela imininingwane eceliwe, ungabhalela uNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa KweMthethosisekelo. Umphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane noma umphathiswa ophakanyisiwe wokufinyelela imininingwane uzokweseka ngalolu hlelo. Uma imininingwane eceliwe ingekho emnyangweni kahulumeni kodwa ikwi-inhlangano kahulumeni, umphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane uzodlulisela isicelo sakho kumphathiswa weMiyalo Yemininingwane waleyo nhlangano kahulumeni phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14. Inhlangano kahulumeni efanele kumele iphendule isicelo sakho ngesikhathi. Uzokwaziswa uma lokhu kwenzeka. Imali ekhokhwayo kumarekhodi enhlangano kahulumeni ibhalwe njengokukhulunywa ezimfuneko zamanje zeMthetho.
Bheka ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lwezokugunyazwa oludingekayo bese ugcwalisa ifomu elifanele. Izicelo zokukhululwa okukhulu kufanele zidluliselwe ngemicimbi ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokutshala. Izicelo zokuph continueda ngaphansi komsebenzi othile zizovunyelwa kuphela uma lowo msebenzi ugunyazwe esikhathini esedlule. Khokha imali echaziwe okufanele ikhokhwe. Thumela umbiko wezinto ezenziwe esikhathini esedlule. Thumela ubufakazi benkomba ejwayelekile. Ikhomidi yokweluleka ibuyekeza ulwazi lwezesayensi oluthunyelwe nezesicelo futhi yenze isiphakamiso mayelana nokuphepha komsebenzi ophakanyisiwe, bese iwethula kwiKhansela eliphezulu. Umqondisi wamukela imibono ejwayelekile ngesikhathi esivunyelwe. Ikhansela eliphezulu lenza isinqumo ngesicelo, ibheka isicelo, isiphakamiso sekhansela yokweluleka, imibono ejwayelekile, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona emikhakheni efana nezolimo, impilo, imvelo, umsebenzi, ukuhweba, kanye nentuthuko yesayensi nobuchwepheshe. Uma isinqumo seKhansela eliphezulu sihambisana nesicelo, umqondisi ugunyazwe ukuba akhiphe imvume. Umqondisi ukhipha imvume efanele. Zonke izimvume zisebenza ngaphansi kwezimo zokunciphisa. Ukuphikiswa okuvela kuMnyango Wezolimo kugadla ukuhambisana nezimo zemvume.
Inhlangano noma inhlangano yesikhashana, noma yiliphi ilungu lenhlangano noma umuntu omunye ophazamisekile, angafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuthi impahla yenhlangano noma inhlangano yesikhashana igcwaliswe nguMphathi-Jikelele noma ivaliwe futhi ithengiswe. Inkantolo ethula lesi sicelo kumele ibe yisigaba seNkantolo Ephakeme noma iNkantolo yeM magistrate enamalungelo okuphatha le ndaba endaweni lapho inhlangano itholakala khona noma isebenza. Izinkantolo zingakhupha lesi sikhungo uma kukhona okungcono kakhulu futhi okufanele kule ndaba. Isinqumo kumele sithathwe ngabaningi balabo abakhona noma abamele emhlanganweni; futhi zonke izinto ezihlobene okufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwesikhungo sokudilizwa, kuhlanganise nokuthi impahla nezikweletu zenhlangano zizophathwa kanjani, noma seziphathwe, kumele zicaciswe. Uma inkantolo inquma ukuvalela inhlangano noma inhlangano yesikhashana, izonquma ukuthi impahla yenhlangano noma inhlangano yesikhashana izophathwa kanjani ngendlela efanele futhi elungile. Inkantolo izobheka noma yiziphi iziphakamiso ezenziwe nguMphathi-Jikelele mayelana nokwabiwa kwempahla. Kumele ichaze isizathu sokuthi kungani inkampani noma i-CC ingafaka isicelo sokudilizwa. Uma kufanelekile, kumele ibonise inombolo yentela yenkampani noma ye-CC. Bonke abaphathi kanye nelungu lenkampani noma ye-CC kumele bsign le ncwadi uma kuyisicelo sokudilizwa abakwenza bona ngokuvuma kwabo ukuze inkampani idilizwe. Ukudilizwa kuthatha cishe izinyanga eziyisithupha. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa futhi akukho mafomu adingekayo ukuthi agcwaliswe.
Ukufakwa kwengane kusho ukwamukela ukuba umgadi wezomthetho wengane, kulandela inqubo yesiko neyomthetho yengane engengayakho ngokwenyama. Ingane engengayakho ngokwenyama oyithathayo ukuze uyinakekele ithathwa kubazali bayo bese ibekwa ngokomthetho kubazali abangabazali noma endaweni yokunakekelwa. Ingane ingafakwa uma ingengayakho ngokwenyama. Umuntu oshadile, umkakhe ongumzali wengane; noma ubaba ongowenyama wengane eyazalwa ngaphandle komshado. Kufanele ube nezinsiza zokunakekela nokukhokhela imfundo yengane. Kufanele ube negama elihle, ube umuntu omuhle, futhi ube nethemba lokunakekela ingane. Uma ungumuntu ongakaze abe yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika, kufanele ube neziqu zokuba yisakhamuzi noma ube ufake isicelo sokuba yisakhamuzi. Ukufaka ingane ngokufihlekile, lapho abazali bayo bengavunyelwe ukwazi ukuthi ubani abantu abathatha ingane ukuze bayinakekele, noma lapho abanikeli bezinsizakalo bezoshiyeka ngemva kokuthatha ingane, kulawulwa ngengxenye 18 yeMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezingane, 1983, futhi kungenzeka uma inkantolo yezingane ikwazi ukuthi lokhu kuzothuthukisa ingane futhi kuhlangabezane kakhulu nezidingo zengane. Uma inkantolo yezingane ithola ukuthi ingane noma izingane zidinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa, umgibeli wenkantolo yezingane uzobeka lezi zingane ekunakekelweni, endaweni yokuhlala yezingane, esikoleni sezimboni, noma endaweni ephephile. Nokho, ingane noma izingane zingabekwa ngaphansi kokunakekelwa komzali, umnikeli wezinsizakalo, noma umgadi, lapho zizoba ngaphansi kokubhekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Kulokhu, uMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uzohlinzeka umnikeli wezinsizakalo ngoxhaso lwezimali kubazali abanakekela ingane. Isiphakamiso sokufakwa kwengane kufanele sibe kusekelwe ezidingweni zengane futhi kube usizo empilweni yengane. Hamba kumlobi wenkantolo yezingane endaweni lapho ingane ihlala khona. Ingane uqobo, uma idlula eminyakeni eyishumi; futhi inkantolo kufanele ikwazi ukuthi ingane iyayiqonda imvelo nokubaluleka kokuvuma. Umzali owamukela ingane ukuze ayinakekele, enakekela leyo ngane, uma umzali engakafaki isicelo sokufakwa kwale ngane ukuze ayinakekele. Uma umzali owamukela ingane ukuze ayinakekele ehluleka ukuvuma ukufaka ingane phakathi kwenyanga ngemva kokucelwa ukuthi enze njalo ngumsebenzi wenkantolo, inqubo yokufaka ingane ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kokuvuma kwabo okudingekayo. Akukho mvume ebhaliwe edingekayo ngaphansi kwezimo ezilandelayo: uma umzali wengane, kulandela ingxenye 16, efakwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa komzali osemthethweni, noma uma ingane ifuna indawo esikoleni sezingane noma esikoleni sezimboni; noma uma bephika ukuhlinzeka ngemvume yabo ngenxa yesizathu esingafanele. Ukuvumela ukufakwa kwengane ngumuntu ongumzali kuvame ukuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kungathatha isikhathi eside uma udaba lukhona oluyinkimbinkimbi. Mayelana nezindleko zokuhlola, xhumana nezikhungo ezifanele zokuvumela ukufakwa kwezingane, izinkantolo zezingane, kanye namahhovisi eMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi.
Ukudoba ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, lapho abantu behamba khona ukuze bathole izinhlanzi emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuzithengisela, kulawulwa. Ukuze ulethe izinhlanzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kufanele ufake isicelo sesikhwama esikhishwe yisigaba esibhekelele ezokuhlalisana zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiwe. Izinhlanzi ezitholiwe kwamanye amazwe ezizothengiswa kufanele zisetshenziswe ngabantu uqobo. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulethe izinhlanzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngaphandle kwesikhwama. Faka isicelo esisha sesikhwama sokudoba ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika uma esikhona sesiphelelwe yisikhathi. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wesikhwama, isikhwama sakho singase sithathwe noma sikhanselwe. Abantu abavunyelwe ukuza nezilwane eziphilayo. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu uma wonke amadokhumenti egcwele. Imali yokufaka isicelo sesikhwama sokudoba ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ukuze kudliwe ngabantu uqobo ingu-R120. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kuthathwa umphakathi ophumelelayo wezokuhlalisana zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiwe ngokuxoxisana nomphakathi wezezimali.
Ukuhweba ngentlanzi kuhilela imisebenzi ephathelene nokuthumela intlanzi kwamanye amazwe ukuze uzuze. Ukuze uthumele intlanzi usuka eNingizimu Afrika uye kwamanye amazwe noma ngaphandle kwemingcele yaseNingizimu Afrika, kumele ufake isicelo sesikhwama sokuthumela esikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMnyango ophethe ezokuxhumana zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuthumela intlanzi ngaphandle kwalesi sikhwama. Faka isicelo sesikhwama esisha uma lesi onaso siphelelwe isikhathi ngemva kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wesikhwama, lesi sikhwama sakho singase sithathwe noma sikhanselwe. Faka isicelo sesikhwama sokuthumela. Funda ifomu futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uqedela zonke izidingo zenqubo yesicelo. Nikeza ubufakazi bokuthunyelwa kanye nekheli labo abazokunikeza intlanzi ofuna ukuyithumela, kuhlanganise namagama ajwayelekile nezesayensi zentlanzi kanye nenani lentlanzi ozoyithumela. Idokhumenti yakho yokuhlonza namadokhumenti okubhaliswa kwenkampani yakho, isikhwama sokuthumela esivumelekile esivela eMnyangweni Wezohwebo Nezimboni, noma isaziso sesitifiketi sesikhwama sokuthi awuphuthelwa ntela esikhishwe yiSikhungo Sezimali saseNingizimu Afrika kudingeka. Imali yesicelo ingama-R225. Qedela, sign, futhi uthumele ifomu lakho kanye namadokhumenti adingekayo kumaphoyisa aphethe amanzi kanye nezindawo ezisemaphandleni; kungenjalo, isikhwama ngeke sikhishwe. Amadokhumenti okuqala yilawo okumele uwathumele; ngaphandle kwabo, awuzotholi isikhwama. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma isikhathi eside uma wonke amadokhumenti ephelele. Imali yesicelo ingama-R225. Imali ingonyuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kucacisiwe nguNgqongqoshe weMnyango ophethe ezokuxhumana zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethwe ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali.
Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhalisiwe kuleli, abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano esemthethweni ebhalisiwe eNingizimu Afrika ezingafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. Ukuhlanganiswa kokubhaliswa okukhulunywe ngakho ngeke kuhluke kulwazi lokuhlanganiswa okubhalisiwe kanye namagama avunyelwe kumakhasimende noma ephaketheni futhi ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe yeMenenja. Imigomo ebekwe ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa kumele ilandelwe; ukubhaliswa okukhulunywe ngakho ngeke kudluliselwe kwezinye izilinganiso zamaphakheji noma iziqukathi futhi ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe yeMenenja. Isicelo sokudla kwezilwane kanye nokubhaliswa kumele sihlanganise incwadi ehambisana nesicelo esivela kumabhalisi noma kumuntu okhethwe temsilise umabhalisi. Igama lomkhiqizo, inombolo yokubhaliswa uma umkhiqizo ubhalisiwe, isizathu sokufaka isicelo, incwadi yokuvuma uma kudingeka evela kumabhalisi, inani elizokhokhwa, ama-check athunyelwa ngokwehlukana angahambisani nesicelo kumele ahambisane nencwadi yokuchaza kanye nephepha lokwakhiwa. Umuntu ophathiswe ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena ozokhuluma nenkampani kanye neMenenja, kumele assinwe amafomu wesicelo. Igama kanye nenombolo yokubhaliswa yomkhiqizo kumele kusetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-sertifika yokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi isinguquko, noma ngabe sikhulu kangakanani, sizobhekwa njengokuhlelwa kabusha. Thumela amafomu wesicelo ehhovisi lokuphatha. Ukuthumela amafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzophazamisa isikhathi sokuhamba kwenqubo. Kumele kubhalwe ngokucacile. Ungafaki izinombolo ezixwayisweni nasezixwayisweni zokuphepha. Lonke ulwazi kumakhasimende kumele luhambisane ngokexactly nalokho okunikezwa kufomu lesicelo. Ukubhaliswa kwesicelo kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine.
I-visa yebhizinisi iyimvume enikezwa umuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula noma ukufaka imali ebhizinisini eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo emahhovisi e-embassy noma emisebenzini yaseNingizimu Afrika noma ehhovisi lezangaphakathi eliseduzane lapho ibhizinisi lizokwakhiwa khona. Imali encane yokutshalwa kwemali ingu-R2.5 million ngempesheni noma okungenani u-R2 million ngempesheni no-R500,000 ngezimali. Le mali phezulu kumele ibe ivela ngaphandle, futhi kumele kube yimali esele engasetshenziswa njengengxenye yebhizinisi. Uhlelo lwebhizinisi kumele lukhombise izimo eziqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lizophumelela, kokubili esikhathini esifushane nangesikhathi eside, ngokufakazela ukuzibophezela ukuthi kuzoba nabantu abahlala njalo abahlala okungenani abahlanu noma izakhamizi ezizosebenza ngokuphelele. Kufanele kwenziwe isimemezelo sokuzibophezela ukuze ubhalise neNhlangano Yezimali yaseNingizimu Afrika ngezizathu zentela. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahlinzeke ngecebo lokuhlola elivela kuzo zonke izwe lapho umfaki-sicelo nabantu abaxhomekeke kuye bahlala khona eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, kusukela eminyakeni engu-18, kanye nezingane ezixhomekeke ezineminyaka engu-18 naphansi, ezizohamba nomfaki-sicelo kuleli. Isethulo sokuvakasha se-yellow fever sidingeka uma uhamba noma uhlela ukuhamba ezindaweni lapho i-yellow fever itholakala khona. Imali yokubuyiselwa ibalulekile ukuze ubuyisele emhlabeni wakho, efana nekhadi lokubuyela elilodwa lapho ubuya khona noma lapho unokuhlala okungapheli: Le mali izobuyiselwa ngemva kokuhamba noma ngemva kokuthola i-visa. Ukukhokha le mali kungakwenziwa ngecheki eqinisekisiwe yebhange noma ngekhadi lesikweletu ezindaweni lapho le nsiza ikhona. Imibiko yezokwelapha nezimiphumela ze-x-ray zidingeka kumfaki-sicelo ngamunye. Izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwengu-12 nezifazane abakhulelwe akudingeki ukuba nezimiphumela ze-x-ray. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezempilo eliseduzane.
Iphasiwedi lezingane liyidokhumenti elibalulekile ukuze ingane ikwazi ukuhamba iye kwelinye izwe. Iphasiwedi lezingane ikhishwa ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-16. Isebenza ukuhamba kuyo yonke imikhawulo ngaphandle uma kudingeka imibhalo ethile ekhombisa ukungavunyelwa. Isebenza iminyaka emihlanu kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa. Qedela amafomu B1-73 bese uwafaka ehhovisi leMnyango wezamaNdiya eliseduze. Faka ehhovisi lezithunywa noma emishinini yaseNingizimu Afrika uma uhamba phesheya. Nikeza isitifiketi sokuzalwa sengane. Faka izithombe ezimbili ezincane zephasiwedi zengane. Imvume yabazali ababili noma abaphethe imithwalo ibalulekile ngaphambi kokuthi ingane ikhishwe iphasiwedi. Nikeza ubufakazi besitifiketi sokufa uma omunye wabazali eshonile. Uma imvume inikezwa ngumgibeli, kufanele kuchazwe ukuthi umgibeli uthole kanjani ilungelo lokuba ngumgibeli. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile ezikhethekile, uma kungavunyelwa ukuthi lowo mzali anikeze imvume efomini lesicelo, imvume ebhaliwe kufanele itholakale encwadini ethile ephuma kumzali ongasekho. Endabeni lapho umzali engafuni ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, inkantolo enegunya phezu kwendaba kufanele yenze isinqumo ngendaba. Ikhophi ye-oda lenkantolo enegunya phezu kwendaba kufanele ihambisane nefomu lesicelo sephasiwedi. Uma abazali behlukanisiwe, bobabili abazali badinga ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ngaphandle uma i-oda lenkantolo lisho okunye. Iphasiwedi ingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili ukuze ikhishwe.
Ishadi lokushada lisetshenziselwa ukufakazela ukuthi ushade. Umshado kumele wenziwe phambi kwabantu abashadayo, abafakazi abaneziqinisekiso zokukhomba, kanye nomphakathi. Abantu abashadayo kumele babe neziqinisekiso zokukhomba futhi baqedele ifomu le-BI-31. Qedela ifomu lokufaka isicelo le-BI-130 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma emishinini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Umshado ungaphathwa ngumphakathi owukhethayo ovela eqenjini lezenkolo ethile, inhlangano, noma ummeleli weMnyango WezeMisebenzi. Umshado kumele wenziwe esontweni, endaweni esetshenziselwa kuphela izinhloso zenkolo, ehhovisi likamasipala, noma endlini yangasese. Uma omunye wabantu abashadayo elimele kakhulu noma ebanjwe yisifo esinzima, umshado ungaphathwa esibhedlela. Abantu abangaphandle abashadayo eNingizimu Afrika kumele babe namapasipoti futhi baqedele ifomu lokufaka isicelo le-BI-31. Abantu ababili abashadayo, abafakazi ababili, kanye nomphakathi kumele basayine iMarriage Register ngokushesha ngemva kokuphathwa komshado. Abancane, abachazwa njengabantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 abake bashada ngaphambili, kumele balandele umthetho. Abantu abake bashada esikhathini esedlule, lapho imishado yabo iphelelwe yimpilo noma yahlukaniswa, ngeke baphinde babhekelwe njengabancane ngaphansi komthetho. Kumele bathumele incwadi yokuvuma ebhaliwe evela kubazali bobabili kanye/noma umgibeli wezomthetho ngokugcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo le-BI-31. Ungafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa kumKomishana Wezingane uma abazali bakho bengatholakali noma uma kungenzeki kahle ukuthi wamukele ishadi. Ungafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa eNkantolo Ephakeme endaweni yakho uma abazali bakho kanye/noma uKomishana behluleka ukwamukela umshado. Abantu abahlukanisile abafuna ukushada kabusha kumele benze okulandelayo: bathole umyalo wokuhlukanisa eNkantolo. Kumele bathumele isitatimende esifungwayo ngendlela ye-affidavit uma kukhona isizathu esiqinile sokuthi abakwazi ukuthola umyalo wokuhlukanisa, noma uma behlukanisile kwelinye izwe, bangase bangakwazi ukuthola umyalo wokuhlukanisa. I-affidavit kumele ibonise ukuthi umfaki-sicelo uhlukanisiwe ngokomthetho, igama lenkantolo, kanye nosuku lokuhlukanisa. Abafazi abashadile noma abesilisa abafuna ukushada kabusha kumele benze okulandelayo: bathole ishadi lokufa lomshado wabo ofile. Kumele bathumele isitatimende esifungwayo ngendlela ye-affidavit uma ishadi lokufa lingatholakali. I-affidavit kumele iqinisekise igama nesibongo somuntu ofile, kanye nosuku lokufa. Ishadi lokushada elifushane: likhishwa ngokushesha. Ishadi elingaphelele: izicelo zingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweight.
Iphepha lephasiwedi elisemthethweni liyidokhumenti enamakhasi angama-64 eyenzelwe abahambi abavame ukuhamba. Iphepha lephasiwedi elisemthethweni lifana nephepha lephasiwedi labavakashi, ngaphandle kokuthi linamakhasi amabili ukuze kuvumeleke amakhasi amaningi e-visa. Likhishwe kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 naphezulu futhi lisebenza kuwo wonke amazwe ngaphandle kokuthi kushiwo okuphambene; lisebenza iminyaka eyi-10 kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa. Uma ufaka isicelo, kufanele ube nedokhumenti yokukhomba noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Qedela ifomu le-BI-73 bese ulithumela mathupha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle eliseduze. Lithumele kwi-Embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini uma ufaka isicelo usuka ngaphandle kwelizwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthathwa amafutha ezandla akho ukuze abhaliswe kwi-rejista yokuhlala kwabantu. Futhi, hlinzeka ngama-photos amabili anobukhulu bephepha lephasiwedi. Uma ungakabi nedokhumenti yokukhomba futhi isikhathi sisheshisa, ungafaka isicelo kokubili ngasikhathi sinye, iphepha lephasiwedi nedokhumenti yokukhomba. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekelela labo abazofaka isicelo sokuhlala ngokungapheli njengamalungu omndeni womuntu onobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika noma umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala ngokungapheli njengenyathelo lokuqala ebudlelwaneni. Ukuze uthole ilungelo lokuhlala ngokungapheli, amalungu omndeni njengenyathelo lokuqala ebudlelwaneni achazwa njengalabo abahlobene ngegazi noma izingane ezibekwe ngokomthetho ngaphansi kokuqondisa kwekhosi noma abazali abazothatha ngokomthetho ukunakekela zona noma abazali ngenxa yokufa noma ukuhlukaniswa kwabazali. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Umuntu onobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika noma umhlali ongapheli kumele athumele isitatimende sokuzibophezela mayelana nezimali, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, nokunakekela umfaki-sicelo. Nokho, uma umndeni ungumzali wezingane ezincane, akudingeki ukwenza isitatimende sokuzibophezela. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu shintsho.
Le nsiza isebenza kumuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika; noma kumuntu osevele enevumelekile yokusebenza ibhizinisi kuleli; noma kumuntu ofuna ukufaka imali ebhizinisini elikhona kuleli. Izicelo zingafakwa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle esifundazweni lapho ibhizinisi lihlelelwe ukuba lenziwe. Faka isicelo embikweni noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Umphakathi wezimali ophathiswe ngawe kufanele uthumele isiqinisekiso sokuthi inani elibekwe ngempela lilingana nenani elibekiwe kumadokhumenti ebhizinisi. Inani elibekwe lokufakwa lihlala ku-R2.5 million, futhi le mali ingabekelwa ngaphandle noma yehliswa uma izohlangabezana nezidingo zesizwe, noma uma iceliwe nguMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuba enze kanjalo. Uma ukuhlala okuphakade sekwanikeziwe, isiqinisekiso somphakathi wezimali kufanele sihlaziywe njalo eminyakeni emibili ngemuva kosuku lokukhishwa kwevumelekile yokuhlala okuphakade, futhi kweminyaka emithathu elandelayo. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nalokhu kuzoholela ekutheni ivumelekile yokuhlala okuphakade ikhanselwe. Akukho sikhathi esichaziwe salensiza.
Isitezi sokunakekela izingane siyindawo ebhalisiwe yokunakekela izingane. Izindawo zokunakekela izingane zingafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali njalo ngenyanga kuhulumeni ukuze zisize ngezindleko zokusebenza kwesitezi sokunakekela izingane. Inani lokwesekwa kwemali liyahluka futhi lincike ezindlekweni zokusebenza kwesitezi kanye nenani lezingane ezihlala lapho. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali? Izindawo zokunakekela izingane ezibhalisiwe. Qedela ifomu ehhovisi lezinsizakalo zomphakathi eliseduze. Ifomu eliqediwe kumele lisayinwe nguSihlalo weKomidi Lokuphatha kanye noMphathi weSikhungo Sokunakekela Izingane ofaka isicelo. Thumela isicelo kanye nesitifiketi sokubhaliswa njenge-NPO kanye nezitatimende zebhange kumnyango wezimali. Ukusekelwa kwemali kuyatholakala esikhungweni sezingane ezihlala lapho. Imali yokwesekwa ikhokhelwa esitezi, hhayi ezinganeni. Inqubo yesicelo izothatha ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma usuthumele isicelo sakho, ubuqotho bayo buzohlolwa. Uma uMnyango ujabule ngesicelo, uzonikezwa imali. Isinqumo sisisekela ekutholakaleni kwemali nasekudingekeni kwalesi sevisi. Umnyango wehulumeni unikeza imali yokwesekwa kwezinyanga ezintathu, kuye ngokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yesikhungo sokunakekela izingane. Le sevisi iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhiswa.
Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo sokwamukelwa njengomfuduki lwenziwa ngumfaki-sicelo ukuze amukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala phansi. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala phansi ungumuntu ophume ezweni lakhe ngenxa yokwesaba ukuphathwa kabi, futhi futhi ufuna ukwamukelwa njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala phansi kulolu suku eNingizimu Afrika. Umfaki-sicelo kumele afune ukuhlala phansi ngenkathi isicelo sakhe sisasebenza. Umfuna ukuhlala phansi uthola imvume engavuselelwa yokuhlala endaweni ethile eNingizimu Afrika. Imvume iyasebenza izinsuku eziyi-14 futhi ivumela umnikazi ukuba abike endaweni ethile yokwamukela abafuduki ebizwa ngeHhovisi Lokwamukela Abafuduki eduze ukuze afake isicelo sokuhlala phansi. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala phansi uthola isimo sokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi kanye nokuvikelwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nabafuna ukuhlala phansi, iMthetho Wabafuduki ka-1998. Imvume yomfuna ukuhlala phansi iphrintiwe, isayinwe, ibhampathwe, bese ikhishwa kumfuna ukuhlala phansi. Imvume iyasebenza izinsuku eziyi-30, ivumela umfuna ukuhlala phansi ukuba ahlale eNingizimu Afrika okwethuba elithile. Imvume ingavuselelwa kwezinye izinsuku eziyi-30 bese isivuselelwa izinyanga ezintathu. I-RSDO iqhubeka nokuhlola isicelo futhi yenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala phansi. Isimo sokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi siyasebenza iminyaka emibili, kodwa abafuna ukuhlala phansi kumele babhale incwadi ecela ukubuyekezwa noma ukuvuselelwa kwesimo sabo sokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemva kokuphela kwemvume yabo yokuba ngumfuna ukuhlala phansi. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukucubungulwa. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala futhi ayidingi ukukhokhwa.
Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-526E kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMali eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lembuso noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thola isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Uma kukhulunywa ngomuntu onengxenye ezimfihlo ezishintshile ngenxa yokuhlinzwa noma ukwelashwa ngama-hormone, bangathumela imibiko echaza uhlobo nemiphumela yokuhlinzwa okwenziwayo noma ukwelashwa okusetshenzisiwe noma okukhishwe odokotela abenzele le nqubo noma abaphatha lelo threatment. Uma kukhulunywa ngomuntu, hlinzeka ngembiko echaza ubulili bamanje bomuntu, ukuze kusekelwe isicelo. Le mibiko kumele yenziwe udokotela ophumelele ukuhlola ummangali ukuze aqinisekise ubulili abakhombisa. Thola umbiko owakhishwa udokotela wezingqondo owanikeze iseluleko ummangali, unikeza imininingwane ephelele ngalesi simo, ikakhulukazi umlando waso, kanye nesimo umuntu abukeka esikuso mayelana nemizwa nemicabango yabo mayelana nokuguquka kwabo. Uma ummangali uneminyaka engu-16 noma ngaphezulu, kufanele kwenziwe isicelo esihlukile sokunye idokhumenti yokuhlonza. Kufanele kuthathwe izithombe zezingalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngokomthetho, kanye nokuvuselela ulwazi kwi-database ye-HANIS. Le sevisi ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-8. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezempilo eliseduzane.
Noma ubani onenhlalakahle yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukufaka isicelo sokuba ngumCitizen waseNingizimu Afrika ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-naturalisation ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu yokuba ngumhlali ongenamkhawulo. Noma ubani oshadile nomCitizen waseNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukuba ngumCitizen wendawo ethile ngemuva kweminyaka emibili kulandela ukuhlinzekwa ngenhlalakahle yokuhlala eyakhishwa ngesikhathi sokushada. Ingane enonyaka engu-21 enenhlalakahle yokuhlala iyafaneleka ukuba ngumCitizen wendawo ethile, uma kwenzeka lokhu kuza ngokushesha ngemuva kokuhlinzekwa ngenhlalakahle. Gcwalisa amafomu wesicelo BI-63 kanye ne-BI-757 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma lemission uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thumela imvume yokuhlala enenhlalakahle noma ukwehliswa. Gcwalisa ifomu le-SAP kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe ukuze uthole isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka komphakathi. Thumela ifomu eliphelele le-BI-9 kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe nezithombe ezimbili ezine-ID uma unaphezu kweminyaka engu-15 ubudala. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthola ubunikazi ngemuva kokuthi isicelo sakho sokuba ngumCitizen wendawo ethile samukelwe. Umzali onengane angafaka isicelo egameni lengane encane nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho ingane encane ihlala ngokomthetho futhi ngempela eNingizimu Afrika. Ubufakazi bokuhlonza buzokhishwa futhi buthunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo. Abafaki-sicelo abathola izicelo zabo zingamukelwa bazokwaziswa ngokufanele. Izicelo zingathatha izinyanga ezi-2 kuya kwezi-4. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lakho eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Umnyango Wezolimo ugcina uhlu lwezinhlobo ezibalulekile zezitshalo ezihlukene nezithelo. Ukubika izinhlobo zezitshalo ngenjongo yokuhambisana nokufakwa kwazo ohlwini lwezinhlobo zezitshalo kwenziwa ngohlelo lokusebenza. Ukugxila kukhulu ekubalulekeni kwezimali kwezinhlobo zezitshalo emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Ifomu lokusebenza eliphelele kanye nephuzu lobuchwepheshe mayelana nezimali ezidingekayo kumele kuthunyelwe kanye nokuhlolwa kwezithombo noma izitshalo zokukhulisa, imvume ebhaliwe evela kumnikazi, uma ungumkhulisi, kanye nohlobo olukhethiwe noma olwakhiwe. Sicela uchaze emibuzweni ukuthi le ndlela kufanele iqhathaniswe nanoma yiziphi izinhlobo ezaziwayo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi izinhlobo ezintsha kufanele ziqhathaniswe ukuze kutholakale umehluko wazo. Uma ukuvikelwa kudingeka ngokulandela amalungelo abakhulisi bezitshalo, abafakizicelo bayelulekwa ukuthi bathumele izicelo ndawonye ukuze kugcinwe isikhathi nemali. Inqubo yokufakwa ohlwini lwezinhlobo izothatha okungenani isikhathi sokutshala nokukhula kwezitshalo.
Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhaliswe lapha ezweni, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano esemthethweni ebhaliswe eNingizimu Afrika angafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. Ukubhaliswa kwesicelo esishiwo ngeke kuhluke kulwazi nezinsuku ezamukelwe kumamaki noma kuphakeji futhi ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe evela kuMlawuli. Imigomo ebekwe ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa kumele ilandelwe; ukubhaliswa okukhulunywa ngakho ngeke kudluliselwe kwezinye usayizi lwezimpahla noma iziqukathi futhi ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe evela kuMlawuli. Isicelo sokubhaliswa kokudla kwezilwane kanye nefertilizer kumele sihlanganise incwadi ehambisana nesicelo esivela kumabhalisi noma kumuntu ophumelele ukumelwa kumabhalisi. Igama lomkhiqizo, inombolo yokubhaliswa uma umkhiqizo ubhalisiwe, isizathu sokufaka isicelo, incwadi yokuvuma uma imvume idingeka kumabhalisi, inani lemali okufanele likhokhwe, ama-check athunyelwe ngokwehlukana angahambisani nesicelo kumele ahambisane nencwadi yokuchaza, isitifiketi sokuhlaziywa, noma ishidi ledatha. Amafomu esicelo kumele athunyelwe ukuze kufakwe izicelo ezintsha kanye nezichibiyelo zokubhaliswa okukhona, kuhlanganise nezinguquko zokwakheka; thumela amafomu amabili, ugcwalise ifomu ngokuphelele, ngaphandle kokubhekisela ezicelweni zangaphambilini, inombolo yephasi, noma emikhiqizweni eminye. Omunye angaba ikhophi. Umuntu ophumelele ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena ophatha ubudlelwano nenkampani kanye noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu esicelo. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa yomkhiqizo kumele kusetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi ushintsho, noma ngabe luncane kangakanani, luzobhekwa njengokuchibiyela. Thumela amafomu esicelo ehhovisi lokuphatha. Ukuthumela amafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzophula isikhathi ngokulibazisa inqubo. Thumela kabili, bhala ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Akukho sidingo sokuba namamaki aphrintiwe ngalezi zilimi ezimbili. Kumele abhalwe kahle; kulandela ifomethi efanele, ungafaki izinombolo ezixwayisweni nasezikhombisweni zokuphepha; yonke imininingwane kumamaki kumele ihambisane ngokunembile nalokho okunikeziwe kufomu lesicelo. Ukubhaliswa kwefertilizer kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine.
Kubantu abanokwephuka, abathathwe, noma abahlukunyezwa. Kubantu abafaka isicelo sokushintsha ulwazi lwabo. Kubantu abashintshile isimo sabo sibe sabantu. Kubantu besifazane abangena emshadweni, noma labo abafuna ukushintsha amagama abo okuzalwa. Kubantu abahlala phesheya kwesikhathi esithile kodwa abanokwephuka. Kubantu ababuya phesheya nabaphethe imvume yokuhlala njalo evumelekile. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-9 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emisebenzini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thumela isitifiketi sokuzalwa noma ipasipoti endala ekhishwe ngaphambi kosuku lukaJulayi 1, 1986. Thumela izithombe ezimbili ezinomumo wepasipoti. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthathwa izithombe zezinzwane zakho ukuze zirekhodwe kwi-rejista yokuhlala kwabantu. Nikeza isitifiketi somshado uma ushade. Owesifazane ofaka isicelo sokwephula umthetho ofuna ukubuyela egameni lakhe lokuzalwa kumele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokusebenzisa lelo gama. Umuntu obuyela phesheya ofaka isicelo sokwephula umthetho kumele futhi athumele imvume yakhe yokuhlala njalo, noma isitifiketi sokwenziwa umphakathi noma isitifiketi sokukhululwa ngaphansi kwemibandela. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze leziphathimandla elikufanele.
Isitifiketi sokufa siyidokhumenti esemthethweni ekhishwe kumndeni womuntu ofile uma kubhaliswa ukufa komuntu. Uma umforeign (ongowasekhaya) efela eNingizimu Afrika, irekhodi liqedelwa futhi isitifiketi sokufa sikhishwa kumndeni. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini uma isicelo sifakwa phesheya. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Qedela ifomu le-BI-132. Bhala incwadi enemininingwane yomuntu ofile bese uyithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi eliseduze uma kungekho ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi endaweni yakho. Akukho ukungcwaba okuzokwenzeka ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesiyalezo sokungcwaba. Isiyalezo sokungcwaba siyisitifiketi esinika imvume yokungcwaba kanye nokuhanjiswa komzimba ukusuka endaweni lapho umuntu efile khona ukuya endaweni lapho bezokungcwaba khona. Kuphela abathengisi abhalisiwe banegunya lokukhishwa kwesiyalezo sokungcwaba. Isitifiketi sokufingqa: Sikhishwa lapho kubhaliswa ukufa. Isitifiketi esigcwele: Izicelo zingathatha phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kwezishiyagalolunye ukuze ziqedwe.
Lo msebenzi uhlose abantu noma izinhlangano ezithakazelayo ukubhalisela ikhaya labadala. Gcwalisa ifomu phambi kwabasebenzi bebhange. Thola i-receipt uma uthumela ifomu futhi uyigcine njengobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo. Uma isicelo sakho sikhanselwa, uzothola incwadi echaza izizathu zokukhanselwa kwesicelo sakho. Uma ungavumelani nesinqumo, thumela isicelo sokuphikisa kwiNgqongqoshe yoThuthukiswa Komphakathi noma kumuntu oyiMenenja ehhovisi lesigaba noma lesifunda echaza ukuthi kungani ungavumelani nesinqumo. Thumela isicelo sokuphikisa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 ukuze uthole impendulo yakho. Kungathatha izinsuku ezingu-4 ukuze processing yesicelo sakho iphumelele. Umsebenzi wezokwelapha uzomema abanye abantu abafana nezisebenzi zempilo nezikhulu zikamasipala ukuze bahlolisise le ndawo. Umuntu ngamunye owamukelwe uzobhala umbiko wakhe ngezinto abatholile ngesikhathi sokuhlola. Le mibiko izothunyelwa ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi eliseduze ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo sokugcina. Ukubhaliswa kuncike ekutheni isifunda sinamandla kangakanani futhi kuyahluka ngesifunda. Ukuhlolwa kwekhaya lokubhaliswa akukhokhiswa. Amafomu atholakala ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi eliseduze.
NgokweMthetho Wokukhokhela Abasebenzi Abalimala noma Isifo Somsebenzi sika-1993, abaqashi badingeka ukuthi babike zonke izifo noma izifo ezibangela umsebenzi emalini yokukhokhela. Abasebenzi kumele baqedele umbiko wesifo esihlobene nomsebenzi wabo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemva kokuba bazi ngalesi sifo. Umbiko wokuqala wesifo esihlobene nomsebenzi wabasebenzi uyisicelo sokukhokhela isifo esihlobene nomsebenzi, ifomu elibhalela ukusebenza endaweni ethile edale lesi sifo, libika ngesimo sesifo, futhi uma lesi sifo sithuthuke, umbiko wokugcina ngesimo sesifo esihlobene nomsebenzi. Uma lesi sifo sithuthuke, incwadi yokuhlolwa kwezindlebe ingase idingeke, ikakhulukazi uma umqashi ehlangabezana nokulahlekelwa ukuzwa ngenxa yokusebenza endaweni enomsindo omkhulu, okuyi mbiko okufanele ihambisane nencwadi yokuhlolwa kwezindlebe uma kudingeka, umbiko wokusebenza kwemiphunga uma lesi sifo sihlobene nemiphunga, umbiko wesikhumba uma lesi sifo sihlobene nesikhumba, umbiko wezinyembezi, umbiko wesitho somlomo, kanye nemibiko ethile ehlobene. Le nqubo ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-60.
Ishadi lokungenisa lemikhiqizo ye-alcohol ngaphakathi kwelizwe liyadingeka uma kuimportwa iziphuzo ezine-alcohol eNingizimu Afrika. Ishadi lokungenisa noma ikhophi lizodingeka ngaphambi kokukhululwa kwempahla ezosetshenziswa emnyango wokungena. Umthumeli kufanele afake isicelo se-shadi lokungenisa lemikhiqizo. Ngemuva kwalokho, ishadi lokungenisa lingasetshenziswa, uma kungekho shintsho ekwakhiweni, okuqukethwe ngaphakathi, usayizi webhodlela, kanye nelebula yaleyo mveliso. Ishadi lokungenisa lizodingeka kwemikhiqizo enokuqukethwe kwe-alcohol okungaphezu kwephesenti elilodwa, ethunyelwa ngenhloso yokuphuza, futhi iyingxenye yemithwalo yomuntu efika eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa uma leyo mveliso ingadluli ku-12 liters ngobuningi futhi ilethwa ukuze iphuzwe ngumuntu, umndeni wakhe, kanye nezivakashi zabo abangathengi leyo alcohol. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo. Uma kuimportwa amabhodlela, kufanele uthumele isampula ebhodlelweni elinlebelayo, njengoba ithengiswa. Thumela isampula ye-alcohol ethunyelwe ebhodlelweni elijwayelekile le-750ml. Ukuze uthumele imithwalo emikhulu, imikhiqizo engenayo izobhekwa. Ilebula ibhekwa uma ufaka isicelo se-ovisi yokuthengisa ye-shadi. Umnyango kufanele ukhishwe ngaphambi kokuthi bakhiphe ishadi lokungenisa ngaphakathi kwelizwe. Akukho sikhathi esinqunyiwe salolu sevisi.
Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhaliswe kuleli, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano esemthethweni ebhaliswe eNingizimu Afrika ezingafaka isicelo sokudla kwezilwane nezithako. Ukudla kwezilwane akuhlanganisi i-hay, straw, ne-chaff, utshani obuphansi, silage, nanoma yiziphi izinhlanga zokholo, noma enye ukudla kwezilwane okwenziwe umkhiqizi ukuze kusebenze nezilwane zakhe. Incwadi ehambisana nesicelo kumele ivela kumabhalisi noma kumuntu okhethwe ukuba ummele umabhalisi. Qedela ifomu ngokuphelele, ungabhekiseli ezicelweni ezedlule, ezinombolweni zamakhasi, noma kwezinye izinto. Kungaba ikhophi. Umuntu okhethwe ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena okhuluma nenkampani kanye noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu esicelo. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa komkhiqizo kumele kusetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-sertifiketi yokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi ushintsho, noma ngabe sikhulu kangakanani, kuzobhekwa njengokulungiswa. Thumela amafomu esicelo ehhovisi lokuphatha. Ukuhlinzeka ngamafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzokwehlisa inqubo. Izicelo kumele zibhale ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Akudingeki ukuthi amalebula aphrintwe ngalezi zilimi zombili; kumele abhalwe kahle; kulandela ifomethi efanele ungafaki izinombolo ezixwayisweni nasezixhumanisweni zokuphepha; yonke imininingwane kumalebula kumele ihambisane kahle naleyo enikezwe efomini lesicelo. Kungathatha cishe ezinyangeni ezintathu kuya kwezine ukuze ukudla kwezilwane nezokudla kwezilwane ezifuywayo kubhaliswe.
Imvume yokusebenza ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano iyidokhumenti enikezwa abantu ababuya ngaphandle ukuze bangene eNingizimu Afrika ukuze babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezivunyelwene phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezizwe ezithintekayo kulezi zivumelwano. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI - 1738 ehhovisi le-embassy laseNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni oseduze. Incwadi evela kwelinye lamagunya kahulumeni afanele kule sivumelwano, eqinisekisa uhlelo. Le ncwadi izoqinisekisa ukuvunyelwa kohlelo olusetshenziswayo, ukubamba iqhaza komfakisicelo okukhulunywa ngaye kuhlu, kanye nemisebenzi elindeleke ukuthi yenziwe ngumfakisicelo ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano. Isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka kukapolisa somfakisicelo esivela kuzo zonke izindawo lapho umfakisicelo kanye nezincikayo zabo behlale khona, ukusuka eminyakeni engu-18, kanye nezingane ezincikayo ezineminyaka engu-18 nangaphezulu, ezizohamba nomfakisicelo ziye eNingizimu Afrika. Incwadi yokuzibophezela evela kumqashi, lapho bevuma khona ukukhokhela izindleko zokubuyisela umfakisicelo, kanye nalabo abancike kubo uma kudingeka. Uma umqashi engumnyango kahulumeni futhi engakwazi ukukhipha le ncwadi yokuzibophezela, izwe elithumela lowo muntu lingakhipha le ncwadi yokuzibophezela.
Izingxenye zezihlahla ezisetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa ezingakaze zithengiswe eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Zikhona ngendlela yezinhlobo zezihlahla, noma amahlamvu, izingxenye ezisetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa, ezingatholakali kwenye izwe, ngokuhweba noma emiphakathini isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka eyisithupha, noma kunoma iyiphi indlela yezinhlobo zezihlahla, iminyaka emine. Kumele zihluke kwabanye ngendlela ecacile ehluke kwezinye izinhlobo ezisondelene nale, futhi kumele zibe nezinhlobo ezifanayo, okusho ukuthi zonke izihlahla ezitshaliwe ngesikhathi esifanayo kumele zifane futhi zibe nezinhlobo ezifanayo. Kumele zibe zizinzile, izihlahla zohlobo oluthile, emva kokutshala okuphindaphindiwe, kumele zihlale zifana nezihlahla ezindala. Kumele zibe uhlobo olwamukelekayo. Uma izinhlobo zezihlahla zingekho ohlwini, thumela isicelo sokwazisa nencwadi echaza isizathu esivumelekile kuMphathi weMikhakha Yokukhulisa Izitshalo. I-questionnaire yobuchwepheshe egcwele, izimali ezibekwe ukuthi zikhokhwe ngesicelo, kanye nokuhlolwa kwezimpande noma izitshalo ezisetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa izinhlobo zezihlahla, imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kumnikazi, uma ungusabalalisi, izinhlobo ezikhethiwe noma ezithuthukisiwe. Sicela uchaze kwi-questionnaire ukuthi iyiphi izinhlobo le kufanele iqhathaniswe nezinhlobo ezaziwa eNingizimu Afrika, izinhlobo ezintsha kumele ziqhathaniswe ukuze kubonakale umehluko wazo. Ungafaka isicelo sokuvikeleka kwesikhashana kwezinhlobo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlobo zivikelwe ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa. Kumele unikeze ukuzibophezela okubhalwe phansi ukuthi ngeke uthengise noma yiziphi izitshalo zezinhlobo ezihlolwayo kuze kube sekupheleni kokuhlolwa okuphelele futhi amalungelo okukhulisa izitshalo anikezwa. Kunconywa ukuba neziqinisekiso zesikhashana zezihlahla lapho kwenziwa ukuhlolwa kwezinhlobo ezithatha isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Uma uhlu lwezinhlobo lukhona lwezinhlobo zezihlahla ezicela amalungelo okukhulisa, thumela izicelo ndawonye ngezikhathi zonke nezindleko. Inqubo yokuhlola amalungelo okukhulisa isitshalo ithatha cishe isikhathi sesizini sokutshala esisodwa.
Le mthetho ikhishwa lapho kufakwa isicelo sokubeka inani eliqinile elizokwenziwa ekhokhweni komholo wombhaki. Umqashi kumele athumele lesi sicelo egameni lomsebenzi. Imiyalelo ayidluliselwa, futhi uma umsebenzi eshintsha isimo sokusebenza, kumele kufakwe isicelo esisha. Uma unamaqashi amaningi, isicelo semiyalelo kumele senziwe kumqashi ngamunye. Amakhophi wezinkontileka zomsebenzi, izivumelwano zomsebenzi, nezinye izincwadi ezihlobene ziyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe imigomo nemibandela yokusebenza. Imiyalelo yephesenti eliqinile izokwenziwa isikhathi esingama-12 months futhi kumele ivuselelwe ngemuva kwalokho. Qiniseka ukuthi izindaba zakho zezimali zisesimweni esifanele uma ufaka isicelo semiyalelo yezezimali. I-SARS ngeke ikhiphe imiyalelo yezezimali uma unokwehluleka ukukhokha izintela. Ikhophi yekhontileka yomsebenzi iyincwadi echaza kahle uma ungenayo inombolo ye-ID noma inombolo yokubhaliswa kwe-PAYE. Faka isicelo sakho semiyalelo yephesenti eliqinile mathupha ehhovisi le-SARS, njengoba umsebenzi kumele athumele isitatimende seziqu zomholo nezindleko. Uma isicelo samukelwa yi-SARS, uzothola ukuqinisekiswa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa. Nokho, imiyalelo yezezimali esemthethweni ingathatha cishe amasonto amane. Le sevisi iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhiswa.
Ngokwezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezentengiselwano Kwamazwe Ngamazwe, uMthetho 71 ka-2002, uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni angase, uma kubhekwa ukuthi kuyadingeka noma kuyinzuzo kulomphakathi, ngesenzo esithunyelwe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, akhombise ukuthi akukho goods ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuluma ngohlobo oluthile noma uhlobo oluthile olungangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika; noma lungangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika kuphela ngenkululeko yakhe noma ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe kumvume onikezwe yena noma ngumuntu onikezwe igunya nguye. Izicelo zemvume zokungenisa goods, goods eziphethwe ngaphansi kokulawulwa kwezimpahla kufanele zithunyelwe kufomu elibekiwe. Inhloso yalesi sevisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezisetshenzisiwe ezingenisiwe aziphuli umkhakha weSouthern African Customs Union. Le nqubo iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona ukulawulwa kwezempilo kwemvelo kanye nezizathu zokuphepha, ukuphepha, nokuhambisana nezindinganiso, kanye nokuphathwa ngenhloso yokuhambisana nezizathu zemvelo. Amafomu wezicelo kufanele agcwaliswe futhi athunyelwe. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahala.
Amaqhaza okudoba ahilela ukusebenzisa ilungelo lakho lokudoba. Le ngelosi kumele iceliwe ngumuntu oyinikezelwe ukuyisebenzisa, ukuze athole izinkanyezi olwandle noma azibandakanye emisebenzini ephathelene nokudoba ukuze athengise. Kubandakanya ukwenza imisebenzi ephathelene nokudoba kodwa kuvinjelwe ukudla izinkanyezi ezitholiwe. Ukuze usebenzise amalungelo akho okudoba, thumela isicelo sephermithi yokudoba esheshayo esinikezwa nguNgqongqoshe wezigaba eziphathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiweyo. Amalungelo aphelele noma alinganiselwe anikezwa ngezinyoni ezithile zezinhlanzi yi-department ye-DEA&T ngokususelwa kumkhawulo wokudoba ovunyelwe okwenziwa minyaka yonke nguNgqongqoshe wezigaba eziphathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha. Kumele ufake isicelo se-right yokudoba ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo se-permit yokudoba. Ngaphezu kwe-permit yokudoba, uzodinga iphepha lokuthutha izinkanyezi ukuze ukwazi ukuzithutha. Faka isicelo samalungelo akho okudoba uma umgovernment ikumema ukuthi wenze kanjalo, okuzobhalwa ezikhangisweni zikamasipala. Thola ifomu lesicelo emnyangweni ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma uye lapho kuzokutshelwa khona ukuthi ukhulume ne-DEA&T. Funda ifomu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyahlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zesicelo. Qedela, sign, futhi uthumele ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo edingekayo nezitifiketi, kanye nezimali ezidingekayo endaweni ethile noma ehhovisi le-DEA&T eliseduze. Ukuprocessing kwezicelo kuzokwenziwa ngemva kwesikhathi sokugcina sokufaka izicelo, futhi imiphumela izokhulumwa ngocingo ne-DEA&T. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinyanga eziyi-1 kuya kweziyi-3 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngempahla yokusebenza noma ukutholakala kwezinhlanzi. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngenani labafakizicelo.
Umbhalo uxoxa ngemicimbi yokungenisa inhlanzi evela kwamanye amazwe eNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuhweba. Ukuze ungenise inhlanzi, kumele ufake isicelo sephermithi esinikezwe umnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma igunya elikhethiwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungenisa inhlanzi zangaphandle ngaphandle kwalesi sithupha. Kumele kufakwe isicelo esisha sephermithi uma lesi sikhona sesiphelelwe yisikhathi. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nemithetho yephermithi kungaholela ekuphumisweni noma ekukhanselweni kwephermithi. Ukuthunyelwa okuphelele kwenhlanzi okukhuluma kuze kube ngama-600g ngasikhathi sinye noma umthwalo ophelele ongadluli ku-25 tons ngonyaka kuvunyelwe. Ukungeniswa kwenhlanzi eziphilayo akuvunyelwe. Ifomu lesicelo kumele liqedwe kahle, kuhlanganiswe nekheli lomthengisi ezweni lokwakheka, amagama ajwayelekile kanye nezobuchwepheshe zenhlanzi, kanye nenani elizongeniswa. Ikhophi ethunyelwe emaphoyiseni yokukhombisa ubunikazi bakho kanye nenombolo yokubhaliswa kwenkampani yakho, kanye nekhophi ethunyelwe emaphoyiseni yephermithi yokungenisa evela emnyangweni wezohwebo nezimboni noma isaziso sephermithi, kudingeka. Gcwalisa, sign, bese uthumela ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo edingekayo ezikhungweni ezibhekelele amanzi nezindawo ezisemaphandleni. Thumela imibhalo yokuqala; kungenjalo, ipheshithi ngeke likhishwe. Imali yesicelo ingu-R225. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu uma yonke imibhalo igcwele. Imali yesicelo ingu-R225. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kucacisiwe ngumenzi wezokuphatha ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma igunya elikhethiwe ngokuxoxisana nomphakathi wezomnotho.
Ukukhokha intela kuvamise ukuba kudingeke ngosuku olukhululiwe esikhangisweni sokuhlola intela noma yisiphi isikhangiso sokukhokha esikhishwe yiMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Uma le mali ingakhokhwa ngosuku olukhululiwe, uzothola izinzalo nezijeziso. Uma ungakwazi ukukhokha le mali edingekayo ngosuku olukhululiwe, ungafaka isicelo sokuhleleka kokukhokha ukuze ukhokhe le mali ngemuva kwesikhathi. Ukukhokha le mali ngemuva mayelana nebhala lakho kungavunywa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu, kuye ngezizathu zalesi sicelo. I-SARS izobheka isicelo sakho futhi yenze isinqumo sokuthi ivumele ukuhlela kokukhokha kamuva. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi i-SARS igcina ilungelo lokwenqaba isicelo sakho. Kufanele usayine isivumelwano sokuhlela ukukhokha ngaphambi kokuthi lezi zinhlelo ziqoshwe kwi-rekhodi yakho yentela. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wokukhokha intela owehlulekile ukukhokha ngemuva njengoba kuchaziwe esivumelwaneni osayine ne-SARS, izinhlelo zesivumelwano zizokhanselwa, futhi inqubo ejwayelekile yokubolekwa izimali izoqala. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahhala futhi ayidingi ukukhokhwa. Akudingeki ukuthi ugcwalise amafomu.
Umthetho Wobudlelwano Bezimali ka-1995 uvuma ilungelo lokuphikisana emsebenzini phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ibhande elibhalisiwe lingavuma ukuphikisana kwamalungu alo nabaxhasi ngenhloso yokubonisa ngokuthula. Ukuphikisana kungabanjwa noma kuphi lapho abantu benelungelo lokungena, kodwa hhayi ezindlini zomqashi, noma ngaphakathi kwezindlini zomqashi ngaphandle kwemvume yomqashi. Imigomo yemithetho ivumela abasebenzi ukuba baphikise ezindlini zomqashi uma i-CCMA ithola ukuthi umqashi uphumelele ngendlela engafanele ngokuvimbela ukuphikisana ngaphakathi kwezindlini zabo. Ibhande elibhalisiwe noma umqashi bangagcwalisa ifomu le-LRA 4.1 ukucela i-CCMA ukuba ithole ukuvumelana ngemigomo yemithetho yokuphikisana ngesikhathi sokuhlasela noma sokuvinjelwa. Nikeza iqembu elithintekayo kopi yale fomu. Uma kunezinkampani eziningi ezithintekayo kule ngxabano, noma uma le ngxabano ibandakanya amaqembu amaningi, bhala amagama nezinhlaka ezengeziwe ephepheni elihlukile bese uxhuma le mininingwane kufomu. Lokhu kuzoncika ekutheni kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukusombulula le ngxabano.
Izikhungo zokucubungula ubisi yizindawo lapho ubisi luphathwa futhi luhlanzekile. Isicelo secebo sokwamukela isikhungo sokucubungula ubisi kumele senziwe ngokubhalwe phansi. Isicelo kumele sihlanganise ulwazi olukhulunywe ngezansi. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela uMnyango Wezempilo. Thumela isicelo esibhaliwe kumaphoyisa endawo lapho ubisi luzocubungulwa khona noma lapho isikhungo sizokwakhiwa khona. Nikeza ulwazi olulandelayo: uhlelo lwesizinda nolwakhiwo lendawo ngesikali esingu-1:100 kuzo zonke izindawo zesikhungo sokucubungula ubisi, kanye nohlelo lwezitezi lendawo, ukubonakala kwesizinda, nokuphakama phezulu kwendawo. Yiba nesineke sokuhlinzeka nganoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi olungacelwa ngamasipala endawo. Amasipala endawo azokwenza ukuhlolwa kwesizinda. Umhloli uzothumela umbiko nokunconywa kumasipala endawo. Isephulelo sokwamukela sikhishwe uma umbiko womhloli ubonakala unenzuzo. Kuhluka ngesifunda ngebhande. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Isicelo secebo sokwamukela isikhungo sokucubungula ubisi. Le fomu itholakala emahhovisi omasipala noma eMnyangweni Wezempilo.
Amagama ezindawo amagama asebenza njengokukhombisa nezimpawu emhlabeni, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi natural noma abekwe abantu. Lezi zikhombisi nezimpawu zingahlanganyela nabantu noma zingahlanganyeli. Amagama ezindawo aphansi kwegunya lemiphakathi yendawo, okuhlanganisa imigwaqo, izakhiwo zomkhandlu nezikhala, amapaki endawo, nezinqaba, kanye nezakhiwo eziphathelene nabantu. Amagama ezindawo aphinde aphansi kwegunya likamasipala, okuhlanganisa amadolobha, izindawo zokuhlala edolobheni, izindawo zokuhlala abantu, amahhovisi eposi, iziteshi, izikhumulo zezindiza, izikhungo, imigwaqo emikhulu, nezimo zemvelo ezifana nezintaba, imifula, amanzi, ogwini, amaphuzu okungena olwandle, iziqhingi, izindawo ezinamahlathi, nezindawo zokuvakasha zizwe. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa kwegama: Zonke izigaba zikamasipala, uhulumeni bezifunda, imiphakathi yendawo, iSouth African Post Office, abakhi nabathuthukisi bezakhiwo, noma yinoma iyiphi enye inhlangano noma umuntu. Ulimi luwugama olusekelwe emgomeni wegama uma wazi uhlobo lwamagama oluphakanyisiwe, ngokwesibonelo, ihhovisi leposi noma isiteshi sebhayisikili esifundeni saseMantshi noma esifundeni lapho indawo itholakala khona, ukuthi ikude kangakanani noma indlela yayo, uhlobo oluhambelana nedolobha eliseduze noma indawo yendawo eduze. Faka imephu ngosayizi be-A4. Faka igama lomuntu ophakamisayo igama elisha. Kukhona isikhathi sokulinda esingama- four months. Le sevisi iyamahala.
Ishadi leMvume yokukhuluma komphakathi lihlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokukhuluma zomphakathi isikhathi esingamashumi amane. Lingavuselelwa, uma ufaka isicelo sokuvuselelwa kwemvume okungaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha futhi okungaphezulu kwezinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokuphela kwemvume ekhona. Lingavuselelwa kuphela uma abanikazi bemvume behlonipha imiqathango ebekwe yiziphathimandla zemvume. Imvume inikezwa emiphakathini efuna ukusungula inkampani yeSigaba 21, iTrust, inhlangano yokuzithandela, noma yimuphi omunye umzimba ovunyelwe umthetho ongasebenzi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo. Iphromotha ilungelo lokuxhumana kanye nenkululeko yokukhuluma imibono ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imikhakha ehlukahlukene yokukhuluma embonini, kubandakanya imiphakathi njengababproduci, abakhulumeli, nabalaleli ekwakheni ukuxhumana nokuxhumana ukuze kube nevoce yemiphakathi ekukhiqizeni izinhlelo ezikhombisa izintshisekelo ezikhethekile nezidingo ezithile zomphakathi, kuhlanganise namasiko, ulimi, inkolo, nezidingo zokuhlela imikhakha ehlukene yomphakathi. Imvume iyasebenza isikhathi esingamashumi amane. Umnyango wezokuxhumana uxhasa abanikazi bemvume iminyaka emine ngezinsiza zokukhuluma nokukhiqiza, kodwa kuphela uma behlonipha izidingo zomnyango. I-ICASA izokhipha isikhumbuzo sokufaka izicelo zezinsizakalo zokukhuluma komphakathi futhi ihlinzeke ngezinsiza ezikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene. Susa iqembu elisebenzayo elizophatha inqubo yokufaka izicelo futhi lisebenze njengomfaki-sicelo egameni lomphakathi. Qoqani izimpawu zomphakathi ukuze nibhale uhlelo lwebhizinisi lokuphromotha ukhetho lwamalungu eBhodi ngenqubo yokhetho olukhululekile ukuze kubhekwane nendawo yesiteshi sokukhuluma ezokwenziwa khona. Qedela ifomu lesicelo ngocingo, usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu. Thumela ifomu lesicelo sokuqala kanye nezincwadi eziyi-16 ezivunyiwe ku-ICASA kanye nemali yesicelo. Izicelo ezingaphelele zizobuyiselwa kumfaki-sicelo, futhi asizokwamukela noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungase kwenzeke. Kungathatha ezinyangeni ezi-3 kuya kwezi-4. Kuzokwenziwa imali engu-R250 yokukhipha imvume ngemva kokuvunywa kwayo. Ifomu lesicelo lizoba yingxenye yesikhawu seGovt Gazette.
Njengoba ukubhaliswa kwenkampani enenhlangano yokwabelana kungaba nzima, kunconywa ukuthi abafake izicelo bacele usizo lwezithunywa zomthetho. I-Memorandum kanye neziqondiso zenkampani kumele zilungiswe futhi zibe nohlaka lokuhambisana nenkampani engenashares, futhi lokhu kumele kuqinisekiswe ngu-notary public ochwepheshe. Inkampani yomphakathi ingamukela i-Table A yefomu lesicelo ngokuphelele noma njengoba kushintshiwe ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ze-memorandum, uma ihambisana neMthetho Wezinkampani, 1973. Inkampani yangasese ingamukela i-Table B yefomu lesicelo ngokuphelele noma njengoba kushintshiwe ukuze ihambisane nezidingo ze-memorandum ngokuphelele, uma ihambisana neMthetho Wezinkampani, 1973. Nikeza igunya elisemthethweni kummeleli wezomthetho, uveze ukuthi uyawavuma ukuba benze izenzo egameni lakho. CM2: I-Memorandum yokuvumelana nezinye - CM2A - CM2B - CM2C uma kukhona abanikazi abaningi, noma 2D uma kukhona umnikazi oyedwa. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-5 ukubhalisa inkampani enenhlangano yokwabelana ukuze iqale ukusebenza.
Ukufakwa kwengane kusho ukuvuma ukuba ngumgadi omthetho wengane, kulandela inqubo yesiko neyomthetho yengane engazalwanga kubazali abafaka. Ubaba wengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado. I-oda yokufakwa kwengane ikhipha yinkantolo yezingane esifundeni lapho ingane ikhona. Inkantolo yezingane ingakhipha i-oda ngemuva kokuthola umbiko owethulwe ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana ogunyaziwe. Isicelo se-oda yokufakwa kwengane kufanele senziwe enkantolo yezingane esifundeni lapho ingane okufanele ifakwe khona ikhona. Njengoba zonke izinkantolo zamagistrate zisebenza njengezinkantolo zezingane, ungafaka isicelo kumlawuli wenkantolo yezingane. Usizo lwenkantolo luzokwenza, uma lokhu kungakakwenziwanga, ukucela umsebenzi wezokuxhumana ogunyaziwe ukuba ahlole isicelo. Ekupheleni kokuhlola, umsebenzi wezokuxhumana uzothumela umbiko enkantolo yezingane lapho isicelo senziwe khona. Ngaphandle kokuthi inkantolo ifune, umbiko ngeke ubonise ukuthi ubani abazali bezinhliziyo futhi ukuthi bafuna ukufaka ingane ngokomthetho - noma ingane, uma sebesendaweni yabo - ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe. Uma inkantolo ikholwa umbiko, kanye nanoma iyiphi enye imininingwane mayelana nabazali abafuna ukufaka ingane ngokomthetho, ingase, ngokuthanda kwayo, ivume isicelo futhi ikhiphe i-oda yokufakwa ngaphandle kokulalela omunye umuntu. Nokho, ingakwenza kuphela uma kungekho muntu ophikisa isicelo. Uma isicelo singaqedwa, noma asikaphelwanga, kuzobekwa usuku lokulalela isicelo enkantolo yezingane. Umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane uzokhipha isaziso kuFomu 1A Isaziso kubazali abafuna ukufaka ukuze bazi abazali bezinhliziyo zengane mayelana nolalelo lwesicelo sokufakwa. Abazali bezinhliziyo zengane ngeke babe nelungelo lokuba khona enkantolo ngesikhathi sokulalela udaba lokufakwa kwengane yabo, ngaphandle kokuthi inkantolo, ngokuthanda kwayo, ivumele ukuba bakhona, uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi ukuba khona kwabo kuzohlangabezana nezidingo zengane. Inkantolo ingacela abazali noma umgadi wengane ukuba banikeze imvume ebhaliwe. Inkantolo ingase futhi icela imvume ebhaliwe enganeni uma seziphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi, futhi inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi ingane iyayiqonda indaba kanye nokubaluleka kwemvume. Uma kunoma yisiphi isikhawu sokulalela, uma inkantolo ithola ukuthi kunezizathu eziphakeme zokuthi imvume ebhaliwe engabazali bezinhliziyo zengane ingafunwa, inkantolo ingacela umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane ukuba ikhiphe isaziso noma iFomu 22 Isaziso kubazali ukuze bathumele izizathu ngokuhambisana nemigomo 21, 21 kulowo bazali. Isaziso sizocela abazali ukuba babe khona enkantolo yezingane uma befuna ukuveza izizathu zokuthi imvume yabo ingabekwa eceleni. Uma isaziso sithunyelwe kahle kubazali futhi akukho sizathu esiphakeme sokuthi abazali baphume enkantolo, inkantolo ingase iphendule ngokushesha udaba bese ikhipha isinqumo ngodaba. Uma isaziso singathunyelwa kahle kubazali, inkantolo ingase, ngokuthanda kwayo, ikhiphe isaziso kubazali futhi, uma ibona kudingeka, iphendule ngokushesha udaba bese ikhipha isinqumo ngodaba. Lapho inkantolo yezingane icabangela isicelo sokufakwa, ukuhlinzekwa kombiko obhaliwe owenziwe ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana ogunyaziwe, noma omunye umuntu ogunyaziwe, kuzoba ubufakazi obanele mayelana nokuqukethwe kombiko. Noma iyiphi i-parti ethintwa ngqo umbiko ingacela ukuthi okuqukethwe kombiko kukhishwe. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngesikhathi sokulalela udaba. Umphakathi ophathelene nodaba uzokhuluma ngokucacile kumuntu othintekayo ngemiphumela yokwehluleka ukuphikisa umbiko nokuphikisa izitatimende ezivela kumbiko. Ngesikhathi sokulalela isicelo, umfaki-sicelo kanye nomzali owathola isaziso bazoba namalungelo namandla afana ne-parti enenkantolo yezenzo, kulandela ukuhlolwa nokuphikiswa kwabafakizolo, ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi, nokukhuluma enkantolo. Isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngesicelo sincike ekwakhiweni kwesicelo. Isaziso kubazali bezinhliziyo zengane okufanele ifakwe abanye sizohlinzeka ngemininingwane eyanele noma izizathu zokungaceli imvume yabo ukuze ingane ifakwe abanye. Isaziso sizonikezwa okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-21 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela udaba. Uma unina wengane enqaba ukuhlinzeka ngemvume, isicelo sizokwenziwa enkantolo yezingane phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14. Ubaba bezinhliziyo zengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa zokukhishwa kwe-oda lenkantolo, afake isicelo sokushintsha imininingwane yakhe kumadokhumenti okubhaliswa kokuzalwa kwengane. Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo sokushintsha, ubaba bezinhliziyo zengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado kufanele azise umphakathi wenkantolo yezingane lapho isicelo sokufakwa senziwe khona. Kufanele akwenze lokhu ebhalwe phansi, echaza usuku nendawo lapho enze isicelo sokushintsha. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Uxhumana namalungu omndeni noma abangane eNingizimu Afrika egameni labantu baseMzansi abakwizinye izwe uma kukhona udaba oluthile. Ukuxhumana nezikhulu zendawo ukuze sithole usizo lokuthola abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abakwizinye izwe. Lokhu akuhlanganisi labo abafunwa ngenxa yezono abenze, abatholakala befuna ukujolwa. Ukusiza imindeni ngokwenza uqiniseke ukuthi imali abayithumelayo ifika kulabo abahluphekayo kwezinye izwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso kanye nezinsiza kubantu abathola sebephakathi kwezimo zokuphanga. Uhlobo lwezinkinga abantu ababhekana nazo kanye nokuvikelwa kwezisebenzi zik gouvernement kungavimbela ukuphendula kwethu okuphuthumayo ukusiza. Sihlanganyela nemindeni yalezi zinsizwa eziboshwe kwezinye izwe uma sicelwa ukwenza kanjalo. Siqinisekisa ukuthi imali abayithumelayo ifika kulabo abashiywe kwezinye izwe, ngenkathi sihlonipha imithetho yalezo zizwe, kanye nemithetho yaseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nezimali ezithunyelwa phesheya. Siqinisekisa ukuthi izincwadi abazihambisayo, kanye nemithi abayithumelayo, ifika kulabo abahluphekayo kwezinye izwe. Lokhu sikwenza ngokuhambisana nemithetho yephalamende yezangaphandle kanye nezindleko ezifanele uma sithumela izinto phesheya, ngenkathi sihlonipha imithetho yezwe eliboshwe lezi zinsizwa. Izindleko ezithintekayo uma sithumela izinto phesheya zingabuyekezwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ukusiza ekuthumeleni imibhalo esemthethweni kubaboshwe kwezinye izwe ngokulandela izinqubo zethu zenkantolo. Ukusiza uma abanye bethumela izicelo zokuthi ummangalelwa athunyelwe ezweni labo ukuze abhekane nezinsolo ezibhekiswe kuye, noma uma becela ulwazi oluthile mayelana nezimangalelo ezihilela abantu bethu kwezinye izwe, kanye nokushintshisana ngemithetho ethile ukusuka ezweni elilodwa ukuya kwelinye, ngokuhambisana nezinsiza ezidingekayo ngokulandela izinqubo zethu zenkantolo. Siphinde sithumele izitifiketi kanye nemibhalo ethile esemthethweni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngempela zikhona ezivela kuhulumeni. Sihlinzeka ngoxhaso lokuvikela ubugebengu ngezindlela ezahlukene ngaphandle kokuxhaswa kwezezimali. Sinikeza izeluleko, ubuholi, kanye nosizo kubazali abathola sebephakathi kwesimo esinzima sokuthi izingane zabo zithathwe ngamandla ngomunye wabazali bezingane abahamba nazo ziye kwezinye izwe ngokubambisana nehhovisi lemmeli yomndeni. Uma kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi impilo nokuphepha kwezingane zikhona engozini, le ndaba ibhekwa njengokuphuthumayo. Sinikeza uhlu lwemaleli kule ndawo. Singakunika imali encane yokuphuthuma. Sazisa imindeni uma othile eshonile kwezinye izwe, noma ebanjwe yisifo esinzima noma elimele. Sihlinzeka ngosizo kanye nezinsiza mayelana nezinsalela zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abashona phesheya, kodwa asihlinzeki ngosizo lwezezimali. Sifuna izikhulu zendawo zihlolisise uma umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika eshona ngaphansi kwezimo eziphawulekayo noma ebulawa. Sinikeza ubuholi kanye nezinsiza uma abantu befuna ukuthatha izingane ezingenamzali ngokubambisana nomnyango wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Sihlinzeka ngosizo kanye nobuholi kubantu bangaphandle mayelana nabantu babo eNingizimu Afrika. Siyasiza labo abafuna ulwazi noma sibakhombise ukuthi baphumephi ukuze bathole usizo abaludingayo. Yiziphi izinsizakalo noma usizo esingakwazi ukungahlinzeka njengabamele kuhulumeni? Asihlanganyeli ezindabeni zomthetho, asingangeni ezinqubweni zenkantolo zamanye amazwe, asihlinzeki ngeluleko lezomthetho, asingaphazamisi noma siqale izinqubo zenkantolo, asiceli izikhulu zendawo ukuba ziphathe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngendlela ethile, asihlanganisi nezinkinga zobugebengu noma izifo kwezinye izwe, asihlanganisi nezinkinga zobugebengu kwezinye izwe, asikhokhi izindleko zokubuyisela izinsalela, futhi asisizi ngokuhamba kwezinsalela zibuye eNingizimu Afrika, asithathi umthwalo wengane ethunjwe ngaphansi komthetho waseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokuthi ingane kufanele ibekwe kuphi enkantolo, futhi asiceli inkantolo kwezinye izwe ukuba ikhiphe isinqumo sokuthi ingane kufanele ibekwe kuphi, asikhokhi izindleko zehhotela, izimali zabeli, noma ezinye izindleko, asikhokhi izindleko zokuhamba ukuze sithumele noma izindiza, futhi asihlele indawo yokuhlala, umsebenzi, noma sithole umsebenzi, asigcini impahla noma sithole izinto ezilahlekile, asamukeli imiyalezo yakho, asihlinzeki ngezinsiza zakho zokuthola umhlalaphansi noma izabelo ezithile, asisizi abantu abanguye abavela ezweni elilodwa kwelinye. Xhumana ne-embassy yelizwe eliseduze nawe, noma ihhovisi leMenenja Jikelele, umnyango wezokuhweba emnyangweni wezangaphandle edolobheni elikhulu. Kuzoncika ohlotsheni losizo oludingayo, futhi kuzodingeka ukuthi ubonise ubunikazi bakho bokusebenza; uma ungathandeki, shayela ukuze ubuze. I-embassy isebenza amahora angama-24 ngosuku, izinsuku eziyi-7 ngesonto, kuhlanganise nezimpelasonto nezinsuku zokugcina, usizo lunikezwa ngokubambisana nehhovisi losizo lomnyango edolobheni elikhulu.
I-Crime Stop inezikhungo eziningi zokubiza ezikhethekile ekuqoqeni ulwazi emphakathini mayelana nezono kanye nemisebenzi yabo yokwenza izono. Amalungu omphakathi athola usizo kubasebenzi bezikhungo zokubiza abaqeqeshiwe ekuphatheni izingcingo nasekutholeni ulwazi olufanele. Lokhu kuvumela abantu ukuba baziwe iSikhungo Sezokuphepha SaseNingizimu Afrika ngemicimbi yokwenza izono ngendlela ephephile engabafaki engozini. Uma uthanda, ungakhetha ukuhlala ungaziwa. Abameli baphawula futhi banikeza ulwazi ngesikhathi izingcingo, futhi labo abashaya izingcingo akufuneki bakhombise ubunikazi babo kuCrime Stop, okuvumela abashaya izingcingo ukuba bahlale bengaziwa uma befisa. Ulwazi olunikeziwe luthunyelwa eziphathimandla. Qaphela: lokhu kwenziwa kuphela ngenhloso yakho. Umuntu oxhumana naye ezikhungweni zokubiza uzokubuza imibuzo, futhi uma ulwazi olunikezwayo lungasetshenziswa, bazokunikeza inombolo yakho eyingqayizivele. Uma ulwazi lungasetshenziswa, umuntu oxhumana naye uzokuchazela ukuthi kungani lungasetshenziswa futhi anikeze izeluleko zokuthi ungathola kanjani olunye ulwazi. Ulwazi olusetshenziswayo luhlotshaniswa nenombolo yekhodi oyitholile. Uzocelwa ukuthi ushaye iCrime Stop ngenombolo: 08600 10 111 ngesikhathi esithile ukuze uthole ukuthi ulwazi lwasetshenziswa yini futhi uthole umvuzo uma ufanelekela. Umuntu oxhumana naye ngefoni uzophuma uma engakholwa ukuthi ungumuntu ofanayo owashaya kuqala. Lokhu kuyisinyathelo sokuphepha esikhona futhi ngeke kuxoxwe ngakho. I-Crime Stop izothumela ulwazi olunikeziwe kwi-unit ethile yokuhlola ukuze ilandele leli cala futhi iphinde icela ukuthi babuyisele umbiko phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-24 mayelana nomphumela wokuhlola ngokushesha okukhulu. Uma ushaya ucingo ukuze ubike icala okufanele uthole umvuzo, umphakathi ophenyayo nguye okumele abhekane nendaba yomvuzo nokuthi ungawuthola kanjani, ngokulandela inqubo yomvuzo ye-NI2/2001. Akukho sidingo sokugcwalisa amafomu ngoba izono zibikwa ngefoni. Nokho, uma ubika icala usebenzisa iwebhusayithi ye-SAPS, gcwalisa ifomu lokubuyekezwa ngogesi.
Umthetho Wokwenziwa Kwezivumelwano Zomshado wathathwa njengomthetho ngomhla kaNovemba 15, 2000. Uma ubhenele emshadweni ngaphansi komthetho wesiko ngaphambi kwalolu suku, kusho ukuthi umshado wakho uyavunywa ngaphansi kwalomthetho omusha. Uma indoda isenayo omakoti abangaphezu koyedwa, bonke laba bashadile bayavunywa ngaphansi kwalomthetho omusha. Lo Mthetho uvuma imishado yamasiko eyenziwe ngemuva kwalolu suku, kanye nokubeka phambili izimfuneko okufanele abantu abashadayo ngaphansi komthetho wesiko balandele ukuze imishado yabo ivunywe. Qaphela ukuthi le mishado yamasiko ibivunywa njalo ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Kufanele ngibhalise umshado wami nini? Uma ubhenele emshadweni ngaphansi komthetho wesiko ngaphambi kukaNovemba 15, 2000, umshado wakho kufanele ubhaliswe kwiMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Uma ushade ngemuva kokuba umthetho udlulile, kufanele ubhalise umshado wakho phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu. Imishado yamasiko nokwabelana ngempahla Zonke imishado yamasiko eyenziwe ngaphambi kokuba lo mthetho ungene emsebenzini kusho ukuthi yenziwe ngaphansi kokwabelana ngempahla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umyeni nomkakhe banamalungelo alinganayo empahleni, imali, noma izimpahla, futhi lokhu kusho ukuthi babelana ngezinsizakalo. Uma bobabili bephakanyiswa ukuthi umshado wabo ungabi ngaphansi kokwabelana ngempahla, kufanele bangene esivumelwaneni ngaphambi kokushada esaziwa ngokuthi isivumelwano sokushada. Uma befisa ukushintsha lokhu ngemuva kokushada, kufanele bafake isicelo eNkantolo Ephakeme. Ngaphansi koMthetho Wokwenziwa Kwezivumelwano Zomshado, umkakhe unamalungelo alinganayo nesimo njengomyeni ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nokuthi kwenzekeni kuphahla. Umkakhe oshadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko unelungelo lokungena esivumelwaneni ngaphandle kokusiza komyeni wakhe. Kwenzekani uma umyeni wami efuna ukushada omunye umkakhe? Umyeni kufanele angene esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe, esizokhombisa ukuthi kwenzekeni kuphahla, futhi umyeni kufanele futhi afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze wamukelwe lesi sivumelwano esibhaliwe. I-ndlu yesigaba kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi amalungelo empahla wonke omakoti avikelwe. Kwenzekani uma sifuna ukungena emshadweni wezomthetho ngemuva kokuba seshadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko? Uma umyeni wakho engenayo eminye imakoti, ungashada ngaphansi komthetho wezomthetho kanye nasemthethweni wesiko. Nokho, noma wena noma yena ngeke nikwazi ukungena emshadweni wesiko nabanye abantu ngenkathi nisenemshado wezomthetho. Umyeni noma umkakhe bangabhalisa umshado ehhovisi eliseduze leMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Kunconywa ukuthi nobabili niye ndawonye ukubhalisa umshado ukuze kusheshiswe ukubhaliswa. Nokho, uma omunye wenu engavumi, ungabhalisa wedwa, kodwa ngokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi obudingekayo. Inombolo yakho yokukhomba, amagama, nezinsuku zokuzalwa, kanye namagama omyeni wakho namagama abazali bomyeni wakho kanye nabazali bomkakhe, kanye negama lomholi wesiko, imininingwane yesivumelwano se lobola, kanye nabantu ababili ababe ngofakazi bomshado, incwadi evela kumholi wesiko noma isitatimende esiqinisekisiwe esivela kumameleli bezomthetho. Umphathi wokubhaliswa, noma umuntu ogunyaziwe nguMphathi-Jikelele ukwenza lezi zisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko zomsebenzi, uzothumela isicelo ehhovisi eliseduze lesifunda noma lesifunda leMnyango ukuze ubhalise le mininingwane emgqeni wabantu bonke. Gcina isitifiketi endaweni ephephile, njengoba kubalulekile. Isitifiketi sesikhashana sikhishwa ngokushesha. Isitifiketi esiphelele sithatha izinsuku eziyisithupha kuya kwezingu-8. Umphathi wokubhaliswa uzokwazi ukukwazisa uma bephika ukubhalisa umshado wesiko njengoba kuchaziwe ngumthetho, bechaza izizathu zokuphika kwabo. Imali yokufaka isicelo nokuthola umgqigqo womshado wesiko noma eminye imibhalo esekela umgqigqo ingu-R53. Imali engu-R11 ikhokhwa yiphezu kumuntu ogunyaziwe mayelana nesicelo sokubhaliswa komshado wesiko, ethunyelwa kulowo muntu ogunyaziwe. Sicela ubuze umuntu oxhumana naye eMnyangweni Wezangaphakathi ukuze achaze izindleko ezikhona. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze leMnyango.
Ibhodi lezangaphandle libambisana namabhungane alo kwamanye amazwe ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lokuxhumana nokuhamba, kanye nemiyalelo emindenini yezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezifele ngaphandle. I-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika izosiza imindeni ekutholeni ukuthi kuzobiza malini ukuze bakwazi ukwenza isinqumo esifanele. Uma usebenzisa izinsizakalo zokubuyisela, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi kukhona izindleko ezihilelekile. Indlela yokwenza izinto iyahluka kusuka ezweni kuya ezweni, okungase kuthinte isivinini senqubo. I-embassy noma ibhodi lezangaphandle izohlinzeka ngesiqondiso. Uma umzimba ubuyiselwa, kunezinhlinzeko eziqinile mayelana nokuhamba okudingwa ngumphakathi wezempilo. Imindeni ingakhetha ukuhlabela umzimba uma ibuyisela uthuli. Insizakalo yokubuyisela kulelo zwe ingaqhuba lo msebenzi. I-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika kulelo zwe ingaba khona ngesikhathi sokuhlabela uma imindeni idinga ubufakazi, kodwa akuphakanyiswa ukuba ibe khona. Imindeni ingakhetha ukuhlabela umufi kulelo zwe. Uma imindeni yomufi ingatholakali noma ingenayo imali yokwenza le nqubo eyengeziwe, kungacelwa ukuthi umufi uhlabelwe njengomuntu ongenamali. Izikhulu kulelo zwe zinikeza imindeni ulwazi lokuthi umthandazo wabo ungahlabelwa kuphi. Uma usuthathe isinqumo ngendlela ofuna ngayo, signa isitatimende esifungwayo bese usithumela ehhovisi le-Director omkhulu: ingxenye ye-diplomatic ye-foreign affairs branch. Yonke imininingwane yokuxhumana nezikhodi zomhlaba ziyadingeka. Iphasiwedi ayidingeki uma ubuya ekhaya nethuli lomzimba ohlanjululiwe. Yonke imininingwane yokuxhumana nezikhodi zomhlaba ziyadingeka. Uma umngcwabo usesimweni sokuqala, incwadi yokuvuma evela kumphakathi ivuma ukungcwaba noma ukungcwaba komzimba iyadingeka. Ngaphandle kwalokho, imvume ingavela ezikhungweni zendawo ezifana nomphakathi wezokungcwaba, umkhandlu wendawo, noma izikhulu zezempilo. Uma umngcwabo usesimweni sokuqala, incwadi yokuvuma evela kumphakathi ivuma ukungcwaba komzimba iyadingeka. Yonke imininingwane yokuxhumana nezikhodi zomhlaba ziyadingeka. Amafomu adingekayo ukuthi agcwaliswe awanawo amafomu okufanele agcwaliswe.
Isitifiketi sokufa siyidokhumenti esemthethweni ekhishwa kumndeni wom deceased uma ukufa komuntu kubhaliswa. Uma umuntu ongaphandle efela eNingizimu Afrika, irekhodi liyagcwaliswa bese isitifiketi sokufa sikhishwa kumndeni. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo senziwa phesheya. Bhala incwadi enemininingwane yom deceased bese uyithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi eliseduze uma kungekho ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi endaweni yakho. Akukho ukungcwaba okuzokwenzeka ngaphandle kwe-oda yokungcwaba. I-oda yokungcwaba iyisitifiketi esivumela ukungcwaba nokuhanjiswa komzimba endaweni lapho umuntu efile khona ukuya endaweni lapho bezokungcwaba khona, ngabasebenzi beMnyango Wezangaphakathi, amalungu eNhlangano Yezokuphepha YaseNingizimu Afrika, noma abaphathiswa abavunyelwe abakhiqiza i-oda yokungcwaba. Isitifiketi sokufingqa: Sikhishwa uma ukufa kubhaliswa. Isitifiketi esigcwele: Izicelo zingathatha phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kwezingu-12 ukuze ziqedwe. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi leMnyango eliseduze.
Izikhala zomsebenzi emaphandleni nasemaphandleni zifakwe ngokufuna abasebenzi ngokumema abantu ukuthi bafake izicelo, kulabo abangasebenzi kuhulumeni. Izikhala zomsebenzi ezindaweni eziphezulu, emkhakheni wokuphathwa okuphezulu, kumele zikhangiswe ngokwezifunda kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweSevisi yoMphakathi. Izikhala zikhangiswa kwiSikhangiso seMisebenzi yoMphakathi, esihlanganiswa masonto onke nguMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi Nokuphathwa. Ngesikhathi sokufuna abantu abangasebenzi kuhulumeni, lowo mnyango kazwelonke noma wesifunda uzokhangisa lezi zikhala zomsebenzi ezimidiya. Iwebhusayithi ebizwa ngokuthi: Isikhangiso seMisebenzi yoMphakathi ibika abasebenzi bakahulumeni ngama-position atholakalayo ngaphakathi kweSevisi yokusebenza kukahulumeni. Abantu abangasebenzi kuhulumeni kodwa abanentshisekelo ezikhala ezikhangisiwe kufanele baphendule kuMnyango okhangisayo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo. Imininingwane yokuxhumana noMnyango okhangisayo inikezwa kwiSikhangiso. Ezinye izikhungo ezifana noMnyango Wezokuvikela zingase zidinge ukuthi udlule ekuhlolweni kwezempilo ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho sithathwe sibe sithathelwe phezulu. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela iwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi Nokuphathwa. Ungathola incwadi eqinisekisa ukufaka kwakho isicelo, kodwa lokhu kuncike kumnyango. Inqubo yokufuna abasebenzi nokukhetha iyahluka phakathi kweminyango kahulumeni futhi ingaqedwa ngesikhathi esifushane. Ifomu lesicelo alikhokhiswa.
Amalayisense okushayela angaphandle akhishwe kwamanye amazwe avunywa eNingizimu Afrika azoguqulwa abe amakhadi eNingizimu Afrika uma abanikazi bebuza amalayisense eNingizimu Afrika ngokuhambisana nomthetho weZokuhamba Emgwaqweni ka-1996. Isicelo sokuguqula ilayisense yangaphandle kumele sibe neleyisense yokushayela ekhishwe yilowo mhlaba.
