Ilayisense yangaphandle noma imvume ingaguqulwa ibe yelayisense yaseNingizimu Afrika uma umbuzi engum citizen waleli zwe noma unomvume yokuhlala unomphela. Ilayisense yangaphandle kumele ibe semthethweni ngosuku lokuguqulwa futhi kumele ibhalwe ngolimi olukhuluma ngokusemthethweni kuleli. Uma kungenjalo, isicelo kumele sibe nehumusho ovela kumhumushi oqinisekisiwe. Ukukhomba okwamukelekayo eNingizimu Afrika kufaka phakathi idokhumenti ye-ID, i-ID yesikhashana, iphasi leNingizimu Afrika, noma iphasi langaphandle elihambisana nemvume yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika, kanye neleta evela kumphakathi owamukelayo eqinisekisa ukuthi ilayisense yangaphandle iyasebenza; le leta kumele ichaze uhlobo lweleyisense yangaphandle, ifake nezithombe ezingemibala zedokhumenti ye-ID, futhi ikhokhe imali efanele. Uzodlula ukuhlolwa kwamehlo ngaphambi kokuthi ilayisense yakho iguqulwe. Qaphela: awudingi ukuthatha ukuhlolwa kwelayisense yokushayela. Uzothola ilayisense yokushayela yesikhashana ezophelelwa isikhathi ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha ngaphandle kokukhokha.
Iphasi lokushintshaniswa linganikezwa kumuntu ongaphandle ohlanganyela ohlelweni lokushintshaniswa emikhakheni yesiko, umnotho, kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, okukhuthazwa noma kuphathwa yinhlangano yangaphandle noma umnyango wezokuphatha, noma inyuvesi ephakeme ngokuhambisana nomnyango wezokuphatha wangaphandle. Faka isicelo sephasi lokushintshaniswa ehhovisi lezakhamuzi laseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini eseduze. Qedela ifomu le-BI-1738. Thumela ipasipoti yakho kanye nesicelo. Nikeza incwadi evela enhlanganweni, inhlangano, noma emndenini lapho uhlela khona ukuba nengxenye ohlelweni eNingizimu Afrika, iqinisekisa isimo noma ukuhlala kwalolo hlelo lokushintshaniswa. Le ncwadi kumele ibe ubufakazi bokuthi uyafaneleka ukubhalisela noma ukuhlanganyela ohlelweni, futhi kufanele iphinde ikhombise ukuthi inhlangano, inhlangano, noma umndeni uzokwamukela ngesikhathi ukhoyo eNingizimu Afrika. Thola incwadi evela kumnyango wezokuphatha ofanele noma enhlanganweni esekelayo ezweni lakho, eqinisekisa isimo noma ukuhlala kohlelo lokushintshaniswa neNingizimu Afrika kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi wamukelwe ukubhalisela uhlelo. Isicelo sithatha izinsuku eziyi-30 ukuze processing.

Isampula engama-2.25 liters kufanele ithathwe ephakheji ukuze ihlolwe. Izampula kumele zifike ehhovisi leMikhiqizo yeLiqour ngaphambi kwezinsuku ezine ngaphambi kosuku lweMsombuluko ukuze zihlolwe ngoLwesine, futhi kumele zifike ngaphambi kwesikhathi esingu-4:00 ngoLwesine ukuze zihlolwe ngosuku olwandulela uMsombuluko. I-Abe-EIMA inikeza usizo kubathumeli bezimpahla ngoxhaso lwezezimali ukuze bakwazi ukukhombisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zabo emazweni angaphandle futhi ibasize enqubweni yokuthola ukuthunyelwa kwezimpahla zokuthumela kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okuqondile ezweni. I-Abe-EIMA iphinde isize ngokunciphisa izindleko zokuthumela. Amafomu wokufaka izicelo kanye nemihlahlandlela yawo kumele afundwe ngokuhambisana nezakho. Isicelo sizophumelela kuphela uma sihlangabezana nezidingo ezibekwe ezincwadini zemihlahlandlela. Funda lezi zinkampani ngokucophelela ukuze uqonde imigomo nokuphathwa. Uhlu oluphelele lwezincwadi okufanele zifakwe kanye nesicelo lunikezwa. Izincwadi zemihlahlandlela zizokhombisa uma kukhona ezinye izincwadi ezidingekayo. Amabhizinisi avunyelwe ukufaka izicelo eziyisithupha ngonyaka, kodwa kuphela ezine zingafakwa ngaphansi kwescheme eyodwa. Noma yini ehlukile kulokhu kumele ivunywe ukuphathwa okuphakeme kwe-EMIA. Amafomu wokufaka izicelo kumele agcwaliswe kahle futhi afakwe phakathi nesikhathi esibekiwe kwi-EMIA. Izicelo eziphuthumayo ngeke zicatshangelwe. Uma isicelo sakho siqedile futhi sihlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zezincwadi ezisekelayo futhi silandela izinqubo zokwamukela, singabhekwa ukuze sivunywe. I-Abe-EMIA izokwazi ukukwazisa uma isicelo sakho sivunyiwe noma saphikiswa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-48 ngemva kokuthathwa kwesinqumo sokugcina. Izicelo ngeke zamukelwe ngokuqondile. Kumele uqinisekise ukuthi uthola ukuvunywa okubhalwe phansi kwesicelo sakho ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili. Ikhophi yesaziso sokuvuma kumele ihambisane nazo zonke izincwadi zokuxhumana noma/ukufakwa kwezinye izincwadi kwi-EMIA. Uma i-Abe-EMIA ithola noma yiziphi izincwadi noma imibhalo evela kuwe engafaki incwadi yokuvuma yesicelo, i-Abe-EMIA ngeke ibhekelele uma lezi zincwadi zilahlekile noma zifakwe kwenye indawo ngendlela engafanele. Uma lezi zincwadi zilahlekile noma zibekwe endaweni engafanele, lokhu kungaphazamisa noma kuvimbe inqubo ye-ofisi. Uma isicelo sosizo sivunywa, ifomu lesicelo se-EMIA kumele ligcwaliswe, kanye nezincwadi ezisekelayo kanye nohlu lwezinkinga okufanele zigcwaliswe, bese kufakwa kwi-EMIA phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu kusukela ngosuku okufanele ibuyiselwe endaweni yebhizinisi evunywe. Uma ifomu lesicelo noma izincwadi ezihlobene nesicelo zingafakiwe phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu, isicelo ngeke sisavunywa. Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngesevisi liyahluka kuye ngesevisi kanye nesevisi. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Izinkampani noma abanikazi bamabhizinisi ngabanye kumele bafake izitifiketi zokukhokha zentela ezisemthethweni ukuze bazuze kulolu hlelo. Sicela ubheke ku-website ye-dti. Le sevisi inefomu layo lokufaka izicelo nemihlahlandlela. Amafomu wesicelo atholakala futhi kwezinye izinsizakalo.
Thola ulwazi kumagunya afanele mayelana nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezivela phesheya noma kumamele umphakathi walowo mzansi ophatha izimpahla mayelana nezimo zokuhlolwa kwezifo zezilwane kulowo mzansi ophathwayo. I-NPPO yaseNingizimu Afrika ingakunika nolwazi. Ngokubambisana ne-NPPO yaseNingizimu Afrika, thola ukuthi ungakwazi yini noma ungakwazi yini ukuhambisana nezimo zokungenisa izimpahla ezivela ezweni ofuna ukungenisa kulo. I-NPPO yaseNingizimu Afrika ikhipha isitifiketi esivumela ukuthi izimpahla azinazo izifo uma izimpahla zihlangabezana nezidingo zokungenisa zezwe eziya kulo. Izimpahla kumele zithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kokuhlolwa kokugcina. Isitifiketi sokuqala esivumela ukuthi izimpahla azinazo izifo kumele sihambe nezimpahla. Uma izitshalo noma imikhiqizo yezitshalo ethunyelwa ifika endaweni yokungena yezwe eziya kulo, abahloli bezempilo yezitshalo be-NPPO yalowo mzansi bazobamba lezo zimpahla ukuze zihlolwe. Ummeleli noma umthumeli kumele abe nayo yonke imibhalo yokungenisa ukuze ayethule kubaphathi bezokuthunyelwa ezindaweni zokungena kwezimpahla kulowo mzansi. Isikhathi sokukhipha isitifiketi sokuvunywa sokuthi izimpahla azinazo izifo sincike kumkhiqizo othile kulowo mzansi; bheka ku-inthanethi: iphrothokholi yokuthumela.
Le nsizakalo itholakala kubantu abafuna ukuthola ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sabo sokubhaliswa kwezono, kungaba ngoba bafuna ukuhamba phesheya noma ngoba befuna ukusebenza phesheya isikhathi eside. Kuzokwenziwa isitifiketi esizokhombisa ukuthi kukhona yini amacala ezono abhaliswe ngokumelene nomfakisicelo. Hamba neminwe yakho yonke, ezothathwa esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduzane, eSAPS Criminal Record Centre. Qiniseka ukuthi amagama akho aphelele, isibongo, usuku lokuzalwa, indawo yokuzalwa, kanye nenombolo yokuhlonza kugcwaliswe efomini lokuthatha iminwe. Bring your identification to the police station as proof of identity will be required. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ezinye iziteshi zamaphoyisa zamukela izicelo kuphela phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlala ngaphandle kwelizwe bangafaka izicelo eziteshini zamaphoyisa kulezo zizwe noma ezikhungweni zeNingizimu Afrika. Iminwe ingathathwa efomini elivunyelwe lelo zwe. Ifomu lokuthatha iminwe kumele lisayinwe ngumuntu othatha iminwe. Zonke iminwe kanye kophi yokuhlonza yomfakisicelo noma ipasipoti kumele kuhambisane nesicelo. Isitifiketi sokukhululwa sizokwenziwa mahhala uma siceliwe phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela esicelweni sokuqala. Njengoba izitifiketi zigcinwa emarekhodini kuphela ezinyangeni eziyisishiyagalolunye, kufanele kufakwe isicelo esisha ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye. Ukuvuselelwa phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kwenziwa mahhala. Amafomu afanele okuthatha iminwe agcwaliswa ngophoyisa.
Zonke izinhlangano zokuvikela umlilo kumele zibhaliswe kwiMnyango Wezamanzi Nezihlahla. Abafakizicelo abafuna ukubhalisela ukuvuma kumele bahlangabezane nezimo ezithile ezingadingeka ngaphambi noma ngemva kokubhaliswa. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimo ezichazwe ekuguqulweni komthethosisekelo wezinhlelo. Gcwalisa ifomu bese ulithumela ehhovisi le-DWAF eliseduze. Isicelo sakho sizobuyekezwa, futhi uma samukelwa, umnyango uzocela ukuthi uqedele Ifomu 2: Isicelo sokubhaliswa kwezinhlangano zokuvikela umlilo. Isicelo sakho sizobuyekezwa futhi, uma samukelwa, umnyango uzokhipha isitifiketi sokubhaliswa. Ulwazi mayelana nenhlangano yokuvikela umlilo efaka isicelo luhlanganisa imininingwane yomuntu ophakamisa inqubo yokubhaliswa kwenhlangano yokuvikela umlilo, ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi akukho mnikazi okhishwe ngokuqondile emihlanganweni noma ezingxoxweni mayelana nolwazi lwezinhlangano zokuvikela umlilo, imininingwane mayelana nendawo yenhlangano yokuvikela umlilo efaka isicelo, ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi akukho enye inhlangano yokuvikela umlilo enenjongo yokwakha lapho noma ekhona kule ndawo lapho le nhlangano ifaka isicelo, ukuqinisekiswa komuntu osungula ukuhlinzekwa kwenhlangano yokuvikela umlilo, isiphakamiso esivela kummeleli ofanele kukamasipala, isiphakamiso esivela ehhovisi elihambelana nesifunda leMnyango Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, nokuqinisekiswa okuvela kumqondisi omkhulu wesifunda seMnyango Wezamanzi Nezihlahla. Kungenzeka ukuthi akuthathe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokusebenza ukuhlola isicelo nokubhalisa inhlangano uma yonke imininingwane edingekayo ihlinzekiwe.
Akukho mkhumbi wangaphandle ozokwenziwa imvume yokudoba eNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle kokuba ubambisane nomuntu onamalungelo aseNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokudoba. Kumele baxhumane ne-ofisi yezokuhlalisana nomnotho yendawo ngaphambi kokuba baqale ukudoba ukuze bazi ukuthi ukusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle kuvunyelwe yini emkhakheni othile wezinyoni nokuthi yimaphi amadokhumenti adingekayo ukuze imvume inikezwe. Uma kukhulunywa ngokuqondile ngokusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle, umfaki-sicelo kumele athole ifomu lokucela ukusetshenziswa komkhumbi wangaphandle ehhovisi le-DEA&T eliseduze. Igama lomkhumbi, igama nemininingwane yomnikazi womkhumbi, amandla omkhumbi, ubude, nenombolo yokubhaliswa yomkhumbi, izwe lapho umkhumbi ubhaliswe khona, kanye necebo lokuphepha elivela kulowo mzwe kumele kuhanjiswe. Bonke omkhumbi bangaphandle kumele babe nomshini osebenzayo obizwa nge-INMARSAT CVMS oxhumana nezinsizakalo zezimali. Kumele uqinisekiswe yilabo abaphatha amanzi olwandle. Ekuhlinzekeni kwakho, chaza ukuthi uzosebenza kuphi emkhakheni wezokudoba nokuthi uzodoba isikhathi esingakanani. Uma umkhumbi ungakhethwanga ngokwezimiso zamalungelo, umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu lokudlulisela umkhumbi kwenye indawo. Ukuze umkhumbi uthole amalungelo okudoba, umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu elihlobene nomkhakha wezokudoba womkhumbi azodoba kuwo. Ekugcineni, uma umfaki-sicelo ekholelwa ukuthi lo mkhumbi uzodoba ezindaweni ezinamaza aphezulu olwandle, kumele aqedele ifomu lokudoba lezo zindawo. Isicelo sokusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle singathatha izinsuku eziyi-14 uma wonke amadokhumenti ephelele.
Ubufakazi bokuzalwa kumele buhlinzekwe abazali noma umgadi ofanelekayo, futhi uma abazali bengakwazi ukwenza kanjalo, umuntu oceliwe ngomunye wabazali noma umgadi ofanelekayo angahlinzeka ngobufakazi. Thumela ubufakazi bokuzalwa nefomu le-BI-24 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Umuntu oceliwe ukuthi ahlinzeke ngobufakazi kumele abe ne-authorization ebhaliwe, okufanele ifake nezizathu zokuthi kungani abazali bengakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi ngokwabo. Uma ingane izalwa ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika futhi omunye wabazali engumcitshi waseNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokuzalwa kwengane, ubufakazi bangabhaliswa ngecebo lakho eMphakathini, eConsulate, noma kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Ubufakazi bokuzalwa obukhishwe ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyi-30 kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi ingane ifike eminyakeni emibili bufunwa abazali noma umgadi ofanelekayo ukuthi bahlinzeke ngezizathu zokuthi kungani bengabhalisanga phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 njengoba kudingwa umthetho. Uma abazali bengashadile futhi befisa ukubhalisela ingane ngaphansi kwegama likababa, ubaba kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ungubaba bengane endaweni enikeziwe kulokho efomini lokubhaliswa kokuzalwa. Ubaba kumele abe khona lapho kuzalwa kubhaliswa. Izicelo zingathatha phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kwezishiyagalombili ukuze ziqedwe. Le nsizakalo iyamahala. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lakho lesikhungo esiseduze.
Ukuze ufinyelele kulolu hlelo, kumele ube yilungu lemidlalo ethole ukwehluleka ngaphambili, ube neminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu, ube nenhloso yokusebenzisa umhlaba kuphela ngezizathu zokulima, ube nesibopho esiphelele ekulimaleni, ungabi esikhundleni sokuphatha, ube nesifiso sokubamba iqhaza ohlelweni lokuqeqeshwa ngemuva kokuthola umhlaba, ube sesimweni sokwengeza emsebenzini, futhi ube nezinhlaka ezinhle, ikakhulukazi uma ufaka isicelo njengeqembu futhi unebhange. Abalimi abaphumelelayo abafisa ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima bangafaka izicelo zezimali, kodwa inani eliphelele losizo ngeke lidlule ku-R100,000. Ezinye izimali zokuqala noma zokwandisa imisebenzi yokulima kumele ziceliwe ezibankini. Ukusekelwa kwehlelo lwe-LRAD akukhokhiswa njengemalimboleko. I-formula isetshenziselwa ukubala ukuthi umuntu uthola malini. Ukuze ufinyelele ku-grant ye-R20,000, kumele ube nesabelo se-R5,000. Lesi sabelo akudingi ukuba kube yimali; kungaba izinto zokulima, izinkomo, noma ezinye izimpahla zokulima. Ngisho nomsebenzi ungafakwa emsebenzini njengengxenye yesabelo sakho ohlelweni lokusekela ukulima. Thola umhlaba ofuna ukuwuthenga. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ungase ube nomhlaba, njengomhlaba owabelwana ngawo emphakathini. Xhumana neMnyango Wezolimo noma nomphakathi wezolimo wendawo ukuze ufake isicelo sosizo. Uhlelo lokuthi umhlaba uzosetshenziswa kanjani noma uhlelo lokulima luyadingeka, kanye nesivumelwano sokuthenga nokuxoxisana ngentengo, uma uqasha ngenhloso yokuthenga uhla lwamalungu omndeni noma eqenjini, uma uhlose ukuthola umhlaba njengamaqembu, ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi udokhumenti lwesikhumbuzo sikhona, akekho ofake isicelo sokuphikisa ukubuyiselwa kwalowo mhlaba, umhlaba ubhaliswe egameni lomthengisi, nokuthi intengo yomhlaba ayidluli inani lemakethe, ubufakazi bokuthi ibhalansi yemali edingekayo iyatholakala, kanye ne-report yokuhlola intengo. Le nqubo izothatha cishe ezinyangeni ezine, kodwa uma iphrojekthi yakho iyinkimbinkimbi, ingathatha isikhathi eside kunaleso. I-grant ye-R20,000 izodinga ukuthi ube nesabelo se-R5,000. Nokho, i-grant ephezulu ye-R100,000 izodinga ukuthi isabelo sakho sibe ngu-R400,000. Phakathi kwezinga elincane nelikhulu, kukhona nezinye izimali ezikhona, kuye ngokuthi yini efakwe ngabahlanganyeli. Uzohlinzekwa ngesimo okufanele ugcwalise, esivela ehhovisi lesifunda leMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba noma umphakathi wezolimo wendawo yakho.
I-document yokuhlonza yomuntu iyidokhumenti eqinisekisa ubunikazi bomuntu. Ama-document wokuhlonza akhishwa kubantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika noma kubantu abanamalungelo okuhlala aphakade abaneziminyaka eziyi-16 naphezulu. Lezi zedokhumenti zingakhishwa nakubanye abasebenza kuhulumeni noma enhlanganweni eyasungulwa ngokomthetho ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika, noma kumuntu ocela ukusebenza egameni likahulumeni kwelinye izwe. Lokhu kukhishwa kubandakanya nezihlobo zabo noma izingane. Faka isicelo ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi eliseduzane noma emisebenzini uma uphume eNingizimu Afrika. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-9. Thumela isithombe sokuzalwa noma ipasipoti endala ekhishwe ngaphambi kosuku lukaJulayi 1, 1986. Uma ukuzalwa komuntu kungabhalwanga futhi kungekho sithombe sokuzalwa, gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-24/15 bese uthumela lokhu kanye nenye yezincwadi ezisekelayo, njengesitifiketi sokubhapathizwa, incwadi yesikole, noma isitifiketi sokukhulelwa. Thumela izithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-pasipoti. Kuzothathwa izithombe zezingalo ukuze zengezwe kuluhlu lwezibalo zabantu. Abafaki izicelo abashadile kufanele futhi bathumele amakhophi ezitifiketi zomshado. Owesifazane ofaka isicelo se-document yokuhlonza ofuna ukusebenzisa esinye sezibongo azazi ngaso kufanele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokusebenzisa leso sithombe. Umuntu ophuma phesheya ofaka isicelo se-document yokuhlonza kufanele futhi athumele imvume yokuhlala ephakade, kanye nesitifiketi sokuba yisakhamuzi noma isitifiketi sokukhululeka, kanye nesitifiketi somshado ku-BI-529. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-8 ukuze ziqedwe. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Imvume kadokotela wezokwelapha izilwane iyadingeka ukuze kuthunyelwe izilwane nemikhiqizo yezilwane eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona inqubo yomthetho okufanele ilandelwe mayelana nezilwane nemikhiqizo yezilwane. Njengoba izidingo zempilo zihlala zishintsha, sicela uxhumane neDreykhthori yezeMpilo yezilwane ukuze uthole izidingo zakamuva. Sicela uqaphele: Umthumeli wemikhiqizo unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhokha izimali zebhange, futhi uMnyango ngeke unikeze imvume uma inani eliphelele le-ZAR110.00 lingakakhokhwa. Ezimweni lapho ufaka isicelo egameni lomunye, sicela uqinisekise ukuthi ukhokhela lowo muntu noma inkampani. Sicela ukhombise efomini ukuthi imvume izotholwa noma idingeka ukuthi ithunyelwe. Isiteshi sokuhlukaniswa kwezilwane singatholakala nezinye iziteshi zokuhlola, eThekwini, okwamanje engasebenzi, kodwa ulwazi lungatholwa ehhovisi enombolo: +27 31 368 6011 noma ngefeksi kule nombolo: +27 31 337 7469. Lapho uthumela izikhumba ezimanzi noma ezomile nezicoco, ifomu lesicelo kumele liqinisekiswe udokotela wezokwelapha izilwane ohambisana nendawo lapho isikhungo sitholakala khona. Ifomu lesicelo kumele futhi sigunyazwe omunye umuntu futhi sigunyazwe udokotela wezokwelapha izilwane, ozothumela ifomu ngefeksi. Lapho uthumela izilwane eziphilayo ezifana nezinkomo, izimvu, izinkukhu, nezihlahla, kufanele uthole imvume yokuthuthukiswa kwezilwane ngaphambi kokuthi imvume yokuthumela izilwane iphume. Lezi mvume zokuqala kufanele zinikezwe udokotela wezokwelapha izilwane endaweni yokungena, kanye nesitifiketi sempilo sezilwane, okuyisitifiketi sokuqala esinikezwa udokotela wezokwelapha izilwane ophumelelayo ezweni elithunyelwa khona imikhiqizo. Isicelo ngokuvamile sithatha izinsuku ezine zokusebenza ukuze kuqedwe udaba lwemvume, uma udokotela wezokwelapha ezilwane evumile isicelo.
Ukuze uthumele izivakashi zezimali ezibhalisiwe ukuze zisetshenziswe ezilwaneni, kufanele ube ne-permit yokungenisa evela kwi-Directorate Animal Health. Ama-permit okungenisa anesikhathi esinqunyiwe futhi asebenza kokubili ekungeniseni nasekuphumeni komkhiqizo uqobo. Udinga futhi i-permit yokungenisa evela kwi-Directorate Animal Health ukuze izivakashi zingene ezweni. Bayakunika le permit kuphela uma usuthole imvume evela kwi-Medicines Control Council futhi unikeze ubufakazi balokho kubo. Kulokhu, izivakashi ezingabhalisiwe zingathengiswa kuphela isikhathi esilinganiselwe kuze kube zibhalisiwe. Ubuningi, igama lomkhiqizo, inhlanganisela, noma ingxenye, kuhlanganise nokujula nokulinganiselwa kwalezo zingxenye, izwe umuthi uvela kulo, abakhiqizi bomuthi, inombolo ye-batch yomuthi osetshenzisiwe, ishidi ledatha lobuchwepheshe noma ilebula, enombolo yokubhaliswa yenhlangano evunyelwe ephathelene nalomuthi ezweni uvela kulo, lapho umkhiqizo obhalisiwe uthengiswa khona noma ungene, ukuthi umkhiqizo lowo uyadingeka, incazelo yokuthi lo muthi uzosetshenziswa kanjani ezivivinyweni ukuze ubhaliswe njengempahla yomuthi, isimo sokubhaliswa kwawo kwezinye izindawo, imininingwane ye-Trial Protocol, kuhlanganise nokuthi kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale nini, izinhlinzeko ezikhethekile mayelana nalokho okuzokwenzeka ngokudla okuvela ezilwaneni ezikhiqiza ukudla, nokuthi abanini bomuthi bahlongoza kahle umuthi. Sicela ufake isicelo se-permit yokungenisa yezilwane okungenani amasonto ayisithupha ngaphambi kokungeniswa okukhuluma ngakho. Uma udokotela wezilwane wesifunda esivumile isicelo, kuthatha ezinsukwini ezimbili kuya kwezintathu zokusebenza ukuze ihhovisi le-permit processing liphumelele isicelo futhi linikeze i-permit.
Iphasi lokwelashwa kwezilwane liyadingeka ukuze kuthunyelwe imikhiqizo yobisi eNingizimu Afrika noma ukuze kudluliselwe ngaphakathi kwelizwe. Lezi zikhwama zokuthumela zinesikhathi esinqunyiwe futhi zisebenza kokubili ukuthunyelwa nokudluliswa. Faka isicelo sephasi okungenani ezinsukwini eziyisithupha kodwa hhayi ngaphezulu kwezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili ngaphambi kokuthi wenze isenzo osihlosile. Uma imikhiqizo idluliselwa eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, kufanele kube nekhophi yephasi lokwelashwa kwezilwane elibuya ezweni lapho imikhiqizo ithunyelwa khona; le khophi yephasi kufanele ihlinzekwe kanye nesicelo sephasi sokudluliswa komkhiqizo, esithunyelwa kudokotela wezilwane waseNingizimu Afrika. Sicela uqaphele: Umthumeli womkhiqizo unesibopho sokukhokha izindleko zebhange, futhi uMnyango ngeke uphumeze iphasi uma inani eliphelele leziyisi-100 rand lingakakhokhiwe. Ukukhokha kungaphinde kwenziwe ehhovisi leMnyango Wezolimo, imininingwane yayo izonikezwa kamuva esigabeni: Indawo nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Uma ufaka isicelo egameni lomunye, sicela uqinisekise ukuthi ukhokha egameni lalo muntu noma inkampani. Akukho sicelo esizobhekwa ngaphandle kokukhombisa ukukhokha. Ubufakazi bokukhokha kufanele buthunyelwe ngefeksi enombolo: 012 329 8292, kubhekiswe ku: Ina Labuschagne. Bonisa kufomu lesicelo ukuthi uzothola iphasi noma uma kufanele ithunyelwe kuwe. Qinisekisa nehhovisi lephasi ngefoni ukuthi iphasi ilungile ngaphambi kokuthi uhambe ukuyithola. Izidingo zokuthumela imikhiqizo yenyama zingatholakala ehhovisi lephasi noma kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezolimo kukheli leMnyango Wezolimo. Kuthatha ezinsukwini ezimbili kuya kwezintathu zokusebenza ukuze kuqedwe isicelo sephasi uma abaphathi bezempilo yezilwane bekwamukela.
Uma ufuna ukungenisa izimoto ezisetshenzisiwe noma ezindala eNingizimu Afrika, udinga imvume ekhethekile evela kuNgqongqoshe wezeMali nezeMboni noma abamele wakhe. Ihhovisi leNgqongqoshe lizokwenza isinqumo sokuhlinzeka izwe ngezimoto ezindala noma ezisetshenzisiwe ezingangeniswa ezweni. Kufanele uthumele ifomu elichaziwe ukuze ufake isicelo semvume yokungenisa. Imvume yokungenisa iyadingeka kuyo yonke impahla engaphansi kokulawulwa kwemikhiqizo engenisiwe. Imvume ibalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impahla ezindala ezingeniswa aziphazamisi umkhakha weMali wezeMali waseNingizimu Afrika. Le nsizakalo ithuthukisa ukuhambisana nezinyathelo zokuphepha nezindinganiso. Nikeza ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yeMazisi yakho. Nikeza uMnyango ngekopyi eqinisekisiwe yecebo lokubhaliswa kwezimoto. Kungathatha izinsuku ezintathu ukuze processing yesicelo sakho. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa.
Umnikelo wezindlu kumuntu ngamunye uyisinyathelo sik government esinikezwa abantu abafuna ukuba nefa lendawo ethuthukisiwe noma impahla. Umnikelo uvumela abatholi ukuba babambisane nezinkampani zokwakha noma bathenge indlu esele engaphansi kwephrojekthi yomnikelo wezindlu esivele ivunyelwe. Lo mnikelo uphinde usize labo abafuna ukuthuthukisa amazinga abo okuxhaswa ngokuthola izikweletu, kanye nalabo abangakwazi ukuthola izikweletu. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika noma abantu abanokuhlala okungapheliyo abashadile noma abahlala nomunye umuntu isikhathi eside, abaphezulu kweminyaka engu-21 futhi abanabantu abaxhomekeke kubo, kanye nemali engenayo yomndeni engama-R3,500 noma ngaphansi, noma labo abangakaze babe nekhaya ngaphambi, bangafaka isicelo. Abafakizicelo abakhubazekile bangafaka isicelo sokushintshaniswa okuthile. Qedela ifomu lesicelo elitholakala kuphela eMnyangweni Wezindlu WasePhalamende, ezinkampanini zezimali, nasezindaweni zokwakha. Thumela ifomu kumamele umthetho ophathelene nokudluliswa kokuba nefa kusuka kumuntu oyedwa kuye komunye ukuze uqedele isigaba G. Thumela ifomu kumthengisi noma enhlanganweni yezezimali ukuze uqedele isigaba H uma isicelo sithinta ukuthola isikweletu. Thumela ifomu kumConveyancer ukuze uqedele isigaba I uma kuhlobene nendlu eyakhiwe muva. Futhi thumela yonke imibhalo esekelayo, njengemibhalo yokuhlonza, isitifiketi somshado, isitifiketi sokuzalwa, ubufakazi bemali engenayo, kanye nesitifiketi sokuba nefa. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala.
Umnikazi wempahla ebhalisiwe kumele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethinta leyo mpahla, izinqumo zenkantolo zokuvimbela ezinye izenzo mayelana nempahla, inani lemali emakethe lempahla, imigomo ye-title deed eyingxenye yempahla, ikhophi yesivumelwano esenziwe ngaphambi kwe-deed, ilungelo lokudlulisela impahla komunye umuntu, inani lesikweletu sokuthenga impahla, kanye neminye imibhalo efanele. Ikhophi ye-title plan eyingxenye yempahla, noma imigomo yokuphathwa kwe-Title Scheme eyingxenye yempahla, kodwa ikhophi yokuhloswe yokuthola ulwazi mayelana nokwakhiwa kwesigaba sokuhlala sabantu abaxhumene nempahla noma itayitile. Amagama aphelele noma inombolo yokukhomba yomnikazi wempahla, noma okungenani usuku lwabo lokuzalwa. Inombolo ye-erf kanye nenombolo ye-towship, noma igama lefamu nenombolo, kodwa hhayi ikheli lomgwaqo. Hamba kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lemidlalelo, uye ehhovisi lolwazi, lapho umphakathi ozosiza ekugcwaliseni ifomu elibekiwe futhi echaza inqubo. Cela umtapo wolwazi we-data ukuthi useshe ulwazi ngempahla, noma ukhokhe imali efanele ehhovisi lezezimali bese uthatha umphumela emuva kumphakathi ehhovisi lolwazi. Inombolo yomphumela izobanjwa nekhophi yakho ye-title. Ukusesha ulwazi kungathatha imizuzu engama-30 kuya kwengama-60. Ezinye ehhovisi ezinkulu, ikhophi ye-title ingathunyelwa ngeposi, noma kufanele iqoqwe ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile. Umphakathi ehhovisi leMidlalelo uzokunikeza ifomu okufanele ugcwalise.
I-ISS isiza abantu nemindeni abahlangabezana nezinkinga zomuntu siqu noma zomphakathi abadinga ukwesekwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwamazwe. Le nsiza itholakala kunoma ubani eNingizimu Afrika noma phesheya. Isifinyezo somcimbi kufanele silungiswe ngokulandela imihlahlandlela ebekwe yi-ISS. Isifinyezo somcimbi sizochaza izimo nezicelo zokwesekwa ezidingekayo phesheya. Ukudluliselwa kuzobhekwa kulandela ukuvunywa kwezicelo. Uma isicelo sokudluliselwa sitholakala kusuka kumnyango wesifunda, i-ISS SA izodlulisa isicelo sokwesekwa kwi-ISS Affiliated Bureau noma kummeleli wayo ezweni langaphandle. Impendulo izoncika ezimweni zendawo. Uma isicelo sokudluliselwa sivunywa phesheya, i-ISS SA izodlulisa icala kummeleli wesifunda wendawo ozokwenza amalungiselelo nezinsizakalo zomphakathi ukuze kuhlolwe udaba futhi kuhanjiswe umbiko kumnyango wesifunda. Uma umbiko uvunywa, uthunyelwa kwi-ISS SA, eyohlola futhi idlulise umbiko ezindaweni ezifanele, kanye nezinkulumo zazo, imibuzo, noma izicelo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, le nsizakalo inikezwa mahhala. Ezinye izinkanyezi, ungakhokha ngezinsizakalo ezithile. Lezi zindleko zihluka ukusuka ezweni ukuya ezweni. Akudingi ukufaka amafomu.
Ishadi lokuhambisana lenziwa lapho kuthathwa khona isampula ngokomthetho phakathi kokunye ukuze ihlolwe ngaphansi kobuholi besikhungo esisemthethweni esinikeze leyo sampula. Ishadi eliluhlaza lenziwa lapho kuthathwa khona isampula phakathi kokunye ngaphansi kobuholi besikhungo esisemthethweni, kodwa ukuhlolwa kwenziwa kwenye isikhungo esisemthethweni kwelinye izwe. Ishadi eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka lenziwa lapho isampula ingathathwa ngaphansi kwesikhungo esisemthethweni, kodwa isikhungo esisemthethweni sithinteka kuphela ekuhloleni kwesampula. Uma amaqoqo wezimpande eselungele ukuthathwa, babiza umhloli ukuze athathe amasampula. Amasampula anikezwa ku-OSTS bese ehlolwa ngekhwalithi ngaphambi kokuba ishadi lenziwe. Ukukhokha kungakwenziwa ngokuqondile noma ngediphozithi yasebhange, kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenombolo ye-invoyisi ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela ukukhokha okwenziwe nenombolo ye-invoyisi enikeziwe. Akukho umthetho ofanele. Isikhungo esisemthethweni sokuhlola imbewu yi-Official Seed Tasting Station, esihlinzeka kuqala ngokuqhuba ukuhlolwa kwamasampula embewu athunyelwa phesheya. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimbali zinezimo ezahlukene zokuhlola, futhi isikhathi sokuhlola singahluka ezinsukwini ezimbalwa kuya ezinsukwini eziningi. I-OSTS ikulungele ukuthatha amaqoqo wezimpande kumasampula noma ibhatchi eyodwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanayo zokuhlola. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iklayenti lingacela izinhlobo ezahlukene zokuhlola. Ulwazi mayelana nezindinganiso zokuhlola ngeke lunikezwe. Buza ngqo kulowo msebenzi.
Ubani ongafaka isicelo? Noma ubani ophethe izifundo, ikolishi, noma univesithi futhi okwamanje ungasebenzi. Abantu abangasebenzi kufanele babhalise njengabafuna umsebenzi eMnyangweni WezokuSebenza. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, hamba eMnyangweni WezokuSebenza. Cabanga ngohlelo lokuqeqeshwa kanye nomsebenzi ofuna ukuwuthola. Ngamanye amazwi, uma uthanda ukuba ngaphandle, ungafaki isicelo somsebenzi ehhovisi. Okuhlangenwe nakho emsebenzini, amagama abaqashi obebusebenza nabo, kanye nomsebenzi owawenza. Amakhono amanye onawo, njengamakhono wekhompyutha, uma unelayisensi yokushayela, nokunye. Bhalisela ukuba umfuna umsebenzi endaweni yokusebenza eseduze. Lokhu kuzomsiza abaqashi bakuthole uma befuna ukusungula ukufundiswa. Xhumana neSETAs ukuze uthole ukuthi yibaphi abaqashi abanokufundiswa. Buza abangane nomndeni ukuthi bakunikeze iziphakamiso lapho kukhona amathuba emisebenzi ezincwadini. Xhumana nesikhungo somsebenzi ukuze uvuselele ulwazi lwakho uma lungashintshile. Isikhathi sokufundiswa sihluka, kodwa ngokuvamile asingaphansi konyaka. Le nsizakalo iyamahala.
Izwe lesifunda kanye nezwe elinownedwa ngabantu ngabanye lingathathwa ngokungemthetho. Uhulumeni unomsebenzi wezomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi - lapho kudingeka, futhi lapho kukhona imithombo eyanele yokusiza - bonke obala bangathola amalungelo abo okuthola umhlaba kanye/noma izindlu. Ezimweni ezithile, njengokuthi uma iningi labantu lingena emhlabeni ngokungemthetho, uhulumeni unomsebenzi wokweseka umnikazi womhlaba ekuvikeleni umhlaba wabo. Abantu abanemhlaba wezolimo bangaxhumana neMnyango Wezolimo ukuze bathole usizo ekutholeni umhlaba wezolimo ofanele. Abantu abadinga izindlu bangaxhumana nomasipala wendawo noma, uma kudingeka, nomnyango wezindlu wombuso wesifunda noma umnyango wezindlu kazwelonke ukuze bathole usizo. Bangaxhumana neNkantolo ukuze bathole umyalo wokuxoshwa kulabo abathatha umhlaba wombuso ngokungemthetho ngaphansi kokulawula kwawo, uma amalungelo alabo abathatha ngokungemthetho engaphuliwe. Abantu abathatha umhlaba wombuso ngokungemthetho abadinga umhlaba wezolimo bangasizwa nganye ezinye iziphathimandla zikahulumeni ukuze bathole umhlaba ofanele ongabelwa kulabo abathatha ngokungemthetho, labo abadinga izindlu uma kudingeka, futhi ezimweni ezingajwayelekile, ukusiza abantu ngabanye abanjengomnikazi bomhlaba ongenwa ngokungemthetho ukuze bakhishwe kulabo abathatha ngokungemthetho abadinga umhlaba wezolimo ofanele ukuze baphume baye kwenye indawo efanele. Lapho umhlaba wangasese uthathwe ngokungemthetho, futhi kungekho zimo ezingajwayelekile, umnikazi womhlaba angaxhumana neMnyango Wezolimo ukuze athole usizo uma isidingo esibangelwa ukuthathwa ngokungemthetho sikhona sokufuna umhlaba wezolimo. Lapho umhlaba wangasese uthathwe ngokungemthetho futhi kunezimo ezingajwayelekile, umnikazi womhlaba angaxhumana nomasipala wendawo, noma uma kudingeka, nomnyango wesifunda noma umnyango wezindlu kazwelonke, ukuze athole usizo uma isidingo esibangelwa ukuthathwa ngokungemthetho sikhona sokufuna izindlu. Ekuqaleni, kungathatha i-Directorate: Support for People with Land izinsuku eziyi-14 ukuze ifune futhi ibekele omunye umhlaba ofanele. Nokho, ngenxa yesidingo sokubonisana nezithakazelo nokuthola imvume kumphathiswa, le nqubo ingathatha cishe izinyanga ezimbili kuya kwezintathu ukuze iphelelwe. Izindleko ezihilelekile ekutholeni omunye umhlaba ofanele zinciphisa esimweni nasemazingeni. Izinto ezifana nosayizi bomphakathi ofuna umhlaba, kanye nezindleko zomhlaba kule ndawo, nazo zicatshangelwa.
Ukuphatha imibhalo ukuze ibe semthethweni noma ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi bokuthi iyikho kuyinqubo yokuhlola ukuthi izimpawu ezikuyo ziyiqiniso. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imibhalo kahulumeni kumele iqinisekiswe, igcwaliswe, isayinwe, futhi ibe ne-Apostille certificate noma isitifiketi esiqinisekisa ubuqiniso bayo. Iphakela amakhasimende ngemininingwane ngefoni, incwadi, noma i-imeyili. Ama-embassy aseNingizimu Afrika kwamanye amazwe angakwenza imibhalo ibe semthethweni uma kuqala kwenziwa semthethweni ngabeziphathimandla zalelo zwe noma kwenziwa semthethweni ngumphakathi ofanele wezangaphandle. Ama-embassy aseNingizimu Afrika awanamalungelo okukhupha i-Apostille certificate kodwa anelungelo lokukhupha isitifiketi esiqinisekisa ubuqiniso. Qala ngokubona ukuthi iyiphi imibhalo ofuna ukuba yenzelwe ukuba semthethweni. Kumele wazise umnyango ofanele wezwe ofuna ukuba imibhalo yakho ibe semthethweni ukuze bakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isitifiketi sokuqinisekisa ubuqiniso noma i-Apostille certificate iyadingeka. Lokhu kwenziwa ngumbhali noma ummeleli wakhe noma inkantolo ephezulu eNingizimu Afrika. Uthumele - imibhalo ethunyelwe ngale ndlela ingaqoqwa uma unikeza ubufakazi bokuthi uyithumele. Uma uthumela imibhalo yakho ngesandla, uzothola i-receipt eqinisekisa ukuthi bathole imibhalo yakho. Nge-courier - kuzohlinzekwa nge-courier ukuze aqoqe imibhalo edingekayo ukuze ukwazi ukuyithola. I-courier ikhokhelwa nguwe. Nge-express mail - neziqu zakho, faka i-envelopu efanele usayizi wamagwebu ejwayelekile enezinombolo zakho ezikhokhelwe ngaphambi kokuthumela ukuze umnyango ofanele ubuyisele imibhalo yakho. Bhala incwadi echaza ukuthi zingaki imibhalo othumele yona ukuze iphathwe ngokusemthethweni, izwe ofuna ukuba khona, nolwazi lwakho lokuxhumana oluphelele. Thumela imibhalo yakho ku-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika kulolo zwe. Imibhalo kumele iqinisekiswe ngumgibeli othembekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubuqiniso bayo. Ummeleli ophathelene nezivumelwano zokucubungula ngu-owokufanele aqinisekise. Izitifiketi zokuzalwa, umshado, ukufa ezingaqinisekisiwe, kanye nencwadi eqinisekisa ubuzwe kumele zisayinwe futhi zifakwe uphawu ngommeli wezangaphakathi ogunyaziwe ukwenza njalo. Imibhalo yokwamukela kumele isayinwe futhi ifakwe uphawu ngumbhali wehhovisi lokwamukela emnyangweni wezomthetho. Imibhalo yokuthengisa impahla kwamanye amazwe kumele isayinwe futhi ifakwe uphawu ngommeli wezohwebo. Izitifiketi zemfundo kumele zisayinwe futhi zifakwe uphawu ngommeli wemfundo. Incwadi echaza ukuthi awekho amaphutha mayelana nomshado kumele isayinwe futhi ifakwe uphawu ngommeli wezangaphakathi ogunyaziwe ukwenza njalo. Imibhalo yokuhlola impilo kumele isayinwe futhi ifakwe uphawu ngommeli wecouncil ogunyaziwe ukwenza njalo. Izinsuku zokusebenza zomphakathi ziyiMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, 08:30 - 12:30. Umnyango ofanele uzokhipha isaziso sezinsuku eziyi-7 uma closed, okungafaki amaholide. Abantu abakhokhi lutho lapho imibhalo yabo icubungulwa. Ayikho ifomu okufanele igcwaliswe, kodwa qiniseka ukuthi uchaza izwe ofuna ukuba imibhalo yakho ibe semthethweni.
Kufanele uthathe incwadi yokugunyazwa uma ufuna ukwenza okulandelayo: ukuthenga imoto entsha noma esebenzisiwe ezweni elingaphandle, ukuthenga imoto yokuthutha impahla noma ithreyi edonswa enye imoto, noma ukwakha noma ukuguqula kancane imoto. Kufanele ube nencwadi yokugunyazwa noma imoto eyakhiwe kuleli noma eyakhiwe kwenye indawo. Izimoto, amabhasi, nezithuthuthu ezithwala impahla, ama-threyi adonswa ngemuva kwezithuthi, izimoto ezikhethekile kuphela zeJibha, izithuthi ezihambayo, nezithuthi zokuvuna. Zonke izimoto, noma zakhwe lapha eNingizimu Afrika noma phesheya, kufanele zihambisane nezindinganiso ezibekwe nguMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwenhlangano Yezokuthutha Kazwelonke ka-1996. Abathengi bezimoto ngaphandle kwaleli kufanele banikeze ubufakazi bokuthi bahambisana nezindinganiso ezibekwe nguMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwenhlangano Yezokuthutha Kazwelonke ka-1996 futhi kufanele zihlolwe yi-SABS, okuyinhlangano ephethe ukwakha izindinganiso zokukhiqiza eNingizimu Afrika. Isixwayiso: ifomu kufanele ligcwaliswe ngumuntu obhaliswe kuyo imoto. Ikhophi yesitifiketi sokukhomba, amandla okuphatha uma kuyinkampani noma inhlangano enkulu, kanye ne-affidavit evela emaphoyiseni aseNingizimu Afrika uma imoto ikhiqizwe kufanele ifakwe. Lokhu kufanele kufake nenombolo yejeneretha, inombolo ye-chassis, kanye nezinye zonke imininingwane yomsebenzi owenziwayo kanye nendawo lapho izingxenye zitholwe khona. Isitifiketi sokuhlola amaphoyisa kanye nesitifiketi sokuthi imoto iyasebenza, kanye nesitifiketi somthwalo wemoto, kanye nezithombe ezimbili zemoto. Khokha imali ethile. Le ncwadi yokugunyazwa izobe isilungile phakathi kwezinsuku ezine kuya kwezingu-6.
Ithuluzi lokudoba ngokuvamile lihlinzekwa ngezinto ezizosetshenziswa ekudobeni noma kwezinye izenzo ezihlobene. Ithuluzi liqukethe zonke izinto, imishini esetshenzisiwe, indawo yokugcina, impahla, kanye nefuels yokusebenza kwethuluzi. Ithuluzi langaphakathi lingabandakanya noma iyiphi enye ithuluzi, eyodwa noma ngaphezulu, olwandle elwenziwa emisebenzini ehambisana nokudoba. Akekho ovunyelwe ukusebenzisa ithuluzi lokudoba, noma iyiphi enye ithuluzi ukuze asebenzise ilungelo lokufinyelela ngaphandle kokuthi kube ne-licence ekhishwe, ngokuhambisana nevumelekile uma umnikazi wethuluzi enelungelo lokudoba. Uma umnikazi wethuluzi engenalungelo lokudoba, kufanele kube nekhontileka yokusebenzisa lelo thuluzi. Thola ifomu lesicelo kwiMnyango Wezinsiza Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha. Kufanele ube nelungelo lokudoba. Uma ungumnikazi welungelo lokudoba onethuluzi, kufanele uthumele, noma ufake ikhontileka, ozinayo nomnikazi wethuluzi ukuze usebenzise lelo thuluzi uma ufaka isicelo se-licence yethuluzi. Gcwalisa ifomu ngokuphrinta usebenzisa izincwadi ezinkulu kuphela, bese ubhala incazelo yalesi sicele lapho kudingeka. Khombisa isikhathi sokusebenza okuhlose futhi isicelo somkhakha wokudoba lapho lo mkhakha uhlose ukusebenza. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku ezintathu zokusebenza noma ngaphezulu, kuye ngokuthi isicelo sithunyelwa ngokuhambisana nenqubo efanele. Izindleko zihluka ngokwesikhathi sobude bethuluzi.
Ukwehluleka ukuhlinzeka nge-oda ebhalwe phansi kumlamuli ukuze avele enkantolo. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba noma ngokocansi, njengokushaya noma ukuhlukumeza. Ukuhlukunyezwa ngemicabango, ngokomzwelo nangokwengqondo, njengokuyesabisa, ukulawula ngendlela yokukhathazeka, noma ukuhamba ngokweqile. Ukuhlukunyezwa, njengokwenza izingcingo eziphazamisayo njalo, ukuthumela izincwadi ezisabisa, noma ukuvimbela ekwenzeni izinto, noma ukukulandela. Ukungena endaweni yakho ngaphandle kwemvume yakho. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezimali, njengokuthi umyeni noma umlingani ufuna ukwenza zonke izinqumo zezimali futhi wenqaba ukukhokhela ukudla noma izimali zesikole, phakathi kokunye. Ukuhlekwa, njengokwesabisa ukukubulala uma ufuna ukuya emaphoyiseni. Ukulimaza impahla yakho, njengokushisa izingubo zakho, ukuphula ifenisha yakho, noma ukushaya amatshe emotweni yakho. Ukuphula umyalo wamanje wenkantolo ukuze ukukuvikele. Ukuziphatha nganoma iyiphi indlela ethukisa, esabisa ukuphepha kwakho, impilo yakho, noma inhlalakahle yakho. Faka isikhalazo uqobo, ngokushaya ucingo, ubhale incwadi, noma uthumele i-imeyili kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi le-ICD eliseduzane. Ukuqinisekiswa okubhalwe phansi kwesikhalazo kungathatha cishe ezinsukwini eziyi-30. Le sevisi ikhululekile.
Inhloso yale nsizakalo ukusiza amalungu omphakathi ekubikeni izikhalazo kwiMnyango Wezokukhala Ozenzakalelayo. Uma uthumela isikhalazo ehhovisi likazwelonke le-ICD, udaba luzothunyelwa ehhovisi likamasipala ukuze luhlolwe. Isikhalazo seClass III yisikhumbuzo esithi uphiko lwezepolitiki noma amaphoyisa enze isenzo esiholele ekulimazeni okukhulu okudingayo umuntu ukuthi afune ukwelashwa esibhedlela. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke ngesikhathi umuntu esesandleni samaphoyisa noma uma ethunwa amaphoyisa. Ukusetshenziswa kabi kwamandla kunezimpempe emphakathini ngokulandela ukulimala okukhona; inani labantu abathintekayo; inani lemali elihilelekile; noma isikhathi lokhu kwenzeka. Izikhalazo ngezimo ezenzeka ngaphambi kokusungulwa kwe-ICD, ngokwesibonelo, yonke imicimbi eyenzeka ngaphambi kukaApril 1997. Futhi, izimo ezenzeka unyaka ngaphambi kokubikwa kwi-ICD, ngaphandle uma kukhona izimo ezikhethekile. Ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezokukhala Ozenzakalelayo. Thumela isikhalazo ngokwakho, ngefoni, ngeposi, noma nge-imeyili ehhovisi le-ICD eliseduze. Zonke izikhalazo kumele zithunyelwe phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza, phakathi kuka-8h00 no-16h30. I-ICD ingakucela ukuthi unikeze olunye ulwazi ngaphambi kokuhlola isikhalazo. Uma uvakashela mathupha, uzokhuluma nomphakathi wezokuhlola noma umhlaziyi. Ukuthola umvakashela kumakhasimende kungathatha cishe imizuzu emihlanu noma imizuzu emihlanu. Ukuthola isikhalazo esibhaliwe kungathatha cishe ezinsukwini eziyi-30. Le nsizakalo iyamahala.
Ukuvulela 'ukufinyelela' kwelungelo lokwazi ukuze kuhlanganiswe ukufinyelela okubanzi emkhakheni wokukhiqiza nokwakha kwezokuxhumana. Ilungelo lokukhululeka kwezintatheli kanye nezinye izinto zokuxhumana, ukukhululeka kokufinyelela nokusabalalisa ulwazi nezindaba nemibono, ukukhululeka emculweni nasekudlaleni; ukukhululeka emkhakheni wemfundo ephakeme kanye nokukhululeka kokucwaninga. Kusukela ekuthuthukisweni komqondo, udaba lenqubo yokulingana lubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi zonke izinto zisebenza ngokulinganayo nangokufanele embonini yokuxhumana ngokukhuthaza ukufinyelela nokwakhiwa kwamabhizinisi amasha kulomakethe yokuxhumana. Ukukhulumela iziteshi zomsakazo ezinezinga eliphansi - ezisebenza ukusakaza ezitolo/ezikhungweni, ezinkundleni zemidlalo, ezindaweni zokubonisa, nasezindaweni zokubuka amafilimu noma ezinye izinsizakalo ezifanayo, iziphathimandla zingase zingakuboni njengokufanele. Izinsizakalo zomsakazo womphakathi ezinezinga eliphansi - ezisebenza ezindaweni zokuhlala zabadala, zixhumanisa izindawo zezinkonzo, zixhumanisa izindawo zokukhulekela nezindlu, noma ezinye izindawo ezifanayo, iziphathimandla zingase zingakuboni njengokufanele. Umsakazo womphakathi kanye nokukhulumela iziteshi ezinezinga eliphansi kuzosebenza iminyaka emithathu, kanti ilayisensi yokukhulumela iziteshi ezinezinga eliphansi izosebenza ezinsukwini ezingamashumi amathathu. Ukuhlola ukuthi yiziphi izikhala ezifanele ukusetshenziswa okuphansi. Ukuhlola indawo yesiteshi sokukhulumela esizokwenza ukusakaza. Setha ithimba lokubambisana elizophatha inqubo yesicelo futhi libe ngumfakisicelo egameni labakhuthazi bezenzakalo. Qedela ifomu lesicelo ngokuphrinta, usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu. Thumela ifomu lokuqala lesicelo kanye nezincwadi eziyi-16 ezithunyelwe zefomu lesicelo kanye nezimali zesicelo. Izicelo ezingaphelele zizobuyiselwa kumfakisicelo futhi asizokwamukela noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungase kwenzeke. Ukuvunywa kweleyisensi kungathatha ezinyangeni ezi-2 kuya kwezi-3. Ifomu lesicelo lizoba yingxenye yezinhlu kuGov Gazette.
Imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa yiphepha elikhishwe nguMnyango WezamaNandi Nezamandla, elikuvumela ukuthi wenze imisebenzi yokumbiwa. Akekho ongenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa ngaphandle kokuthola imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa. Imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa ayikwazi ukudluliselwa komunye umuntu. Inhloso yemvume ukuhlela ukuhlolwa kwezinsiza zamaminerali kanye nokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa ngokuhlinzeka ngempilo nokuphepha, ukuphathwa kwemvelo, kanye nokukhipha kahle kwezinsiza zamaminerali. Imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa kumele isebenze ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo emvume, kodwa engadluli eminyakeni emibili. Ingavuselelwa kathathu, kodwa ukuvuselelwa ngakunye akukwazi ukudlula unyaka owodwa. Imineral ephathelene nayo ingambiwa isikhathi esingaminyaka emibili, futhi indawo yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa ayikwazi ukudlula 1.5 m². Akekho omunye umuntu onelungelo lokuhlola izinsiza zamaminerali, ilungelo lokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa, imvume yokwenza imisebenzi yokumbiwa, noma imvume yokukhipha izinsiza zamaminerali noma umhlaba. Faka isicelo kumphathi wesifunda woMnyango WezamaNandi Nezamandla endaweni lapho umhlaba utholakala khona. Qedela Ifomu F: Faka isicelo semvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa etholakala ehhovisi leMphathi Wesifunda. Ungathola le fomula nasewebhusayithi kuleli qophelo elingezansi. Thumela ifomu kanye nezindleko ezinqunyiwe ezingabuyiswanga ehhovisi leMphathi Wesifunda, lapho umhlaba utholakala khona. UMphathi Wesifunda uzokwamukela isicelo uma zonke izidingo zihlangatshezwana. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uMphathi Wesifunda uzocela ukuthi uthumele uhlelo lokuphathwa kwemvelo, kanye nokuxhumana nomnikazi womhlaba kanye nezithakazelo zomthetho, nezinye izinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Thumela umbiko wokuxhumana kumphathi wesifunda ezinsukwini eziyi-30. Umphakathi uzokhipha imvume uma zonke izidingo zihlangatshezwana. UMphathi Wesifunda uzokwazi ukukwazisa ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele, okusho ukuthi uhambisane nazo zonke izidingo. Umnyango uzobeka izindleko, futhi le mali ayibuyiswanga. Izinhlamvu zezindleko zihluka kuye ngemininingwane yeminerali ofuna ukuyisebenzisa.
Ilungelo lokwenza ibhizinisi lokumba liyavunywa nguhulumeni, lishiywe yiMnyango wezamaMinerali noMoya, elikunika igunya lokwenza ucwaningo lwezinto ezisemhlabeni endaweni ethile. Uhlelo lwezezimali luhambisana nomsebenzi wokucwaninga kanye nokwenzeka kwezezimali ngaleso sikhathi. Uma kungekho ukungcoliswa komoya nemvelo noma ukulimala kwesimo semvelo okuzokwenzeka ngenxa yomsebenzi wokucwaninga. Faka isicelo ehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wesifunda weMnyango wezamaMinerali noMoya endaweni lapho umhlaba utholakala khona. Qedela Ifomu D: Faka isicelo sephermiti yebhizinisi lokumba etholakala ehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wesifunda. Ifomu lingatholakala futhi kule webhusayithi, kuleli khasi. Ifomu kumele lihambisane nemali ekhokhelwayo yokufaka isicelo njengokubekwe nguMphathi wesifunda. Xhumana futhi uthumele izaziso kubo bonke abathintekayo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-180 kusukela ngosuku lokwaziswa. UMphathi wesifunda uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngokubhalwe phansi uma isicelo sakho sivunyiwe, okusho ukuthi isicelo sakho sihlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo, okuzokwenziwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kokuthola isicelo futhi ukulungele ukuxhumana nomnikazi womhlaba, ophatha lowo mhlaba ngokomthetho, nabanye abathintekayo. Uma ungeniswa isicelo sokumba izinto ezisemhlabeni, kumele bakwazise ngokubhalwe phansi, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30, bechaza izizathu zokwenqaba. Umnyango uzobeka izindleko, futhi le mali ayibuyiswanga. Inani lezindleko lihluka kuye ngento oyifunayo ukuyisebenzisa.
I-akhawunti yeMzansi iyinsizakalo enikezwa yi-SAPO eqondiswe kubantu ngabanye. Kuyindlela elula yokwamukela imali nokukhishwa kwemali noma ukwenza izinkokhelo. Ungaqiniseka ukuthi imali yakho iphephile ngoba awekho amaholo okwenyanga, futhi okusele kwi-akhawunti yakho kuzothola inzalo. Awekhona amakhokhelo abangelwa njalo; ukhokha kuphela ngalokho okusebenzisa. Awudingi iphepha lesikhwama semali ukuze uvule i-akhawunti yeMzansi. Noma ubani angavula i-akhawunti ngoba awekho imiqathango efana nokuba nenani elithile lemali yokuhola edingekayo ukuze uvule le akhawunti. Ungasebenzisa ibhange ezikhungweni ze-1300 ze-Post Office noma kumashini e-ATM angu-8000. Zonke izimali ezingenayo e-Post Office zenziwa mahhala. Qaphela: Abancane abafuna ukuvula le akhawunti kumele bahambe nomgibeli osemthethweni noma umzali. Yiya kwi-Post Office eduze kwakho eNingizimu Afrika futhi ucele umphakathi ukuba akunikeze ifomu lokufaka isicelo. Gcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo. Bonisa i-ID yakho. Nikeza ubufakazi bendawo ophila kuyo. Njengengxenye yeMthetho wezeMali, bonke abafaka izicelo kumele banikeze ubufakazi bendawo abahlala kuyo. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokukhombisa ibhili ye-utility egameni lakho. Uma uqasha, ikhophi yesivumelwano sokuqashisa iyadingeka. Uma uhlala nabazali bakho, kudingeka isitatimende esivumelwano esiqinisekisa lokhu. Abancane abafuna ukuvula le akhawunti kumele bahambe nomgibeli osemthethweni noma umzali. Amafomu okufaka izicelo atholakala ezikhungweni ze-Post Office kulo lonke izwe.
Ithenda yokucubungula inhlanzi ingaba yimoto, umkhumbi, isakhiwo, noma indawo lapho kukhiqizwa khona isithako noma into yehlanzi. Isithako singakhiqizwa nganoma iyiphi indlela efana nokusika, ukufilitha, ukuhlukanisa izingxenye, ukuhlanza, ukuqoqa nokuhlela ukusika, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokuvimbela ukuwohloka kwezinhlanzi. Ukwenza lo msebenzi kungase kubandakanye indawo lapho izinhluzi zibekwe ezitsheni, ziphakanyiswa, zomele, zikhishwe izinsipho nezinsalela, zifakwe usawoti, zifakwe iqhwa, zifakwe emathinini, zomele ngokubanda, noma zicubungulwa ukuze zithengiswe eNingizimu Afrika noma phesheya. Ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wokucubungula inhlanzi, umuntu kumele aqale afake isicelo sokuba ne-FPE/ilungelo lokubhaliswa bese kuthi kulandelwe ukuvunywa. Ukuze usebenzise ilungelo lokubhaliswa noma ilungelo lokwenza umsebenzi we-FPE, kufanele kufakwe isicelo sokuvuselela nsuku zonke, esikhishwe yiMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha. Labo abavunyelwe kufanele balandele imigomo nemibandela echazwe ku-permit. Ukwehluleka ukwenza kanjalo kungaholela ekulibazisweni noma ekukhanselweni kwe-permit noma ekukhanselweni kwelungelo. Faka isicelo selungelo lokubhaliswa kuphela uma kukhona isimemo somphakathi esishicilelwe kuGazethi yoHulumeni. Ukuze ufake isicelo, thola ifomu kwiMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha noma ezindaweni lapho amafomu atholakala khona noma anikezwa khona, okuyindawo ezokwenziwa yizinsiza ze-DEA&T. Funda ngokucophelela, uqonde, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uhambisana nezidingo nemibandela yesicelo. Qedela, signing, futhi uthumele ifomu lesicelo kanye nemibhalo esekelayo eqinisekisiwe kanye nezindleko zesicelo ezingabuyiswanga. Inqubo yokubuyekeza izoqala ngemuva kosuku lokuvala kwezicelo, futhi imiphumela izokhulumelwa ngokubhala yi-DEA&T. Uma ilungelo le-FPE livunywa, kufanele ufake isicelo sokwakhiwa kwe-FPE futhi uhambisane nezidingo zayo ngaphambi kokuvunywa. Isicelo selungelo le-FPE singathatha inyanga eyodwa kuya kwezintathu noma ngaphezulu ngenxa yenani lezicelo. Isicelo se-FPE permit singathatha usuku noma ngaphezulu, kuye ngokuthi isicelo silandela inqubo efanele. Imali ekhokhwayo ibuyekezwa minyaka yonke/ibekwe minyaka yonke nguNgqongqoshe noma umthunywa wokugunyazwa, ohlanganyela noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. R1,330 kanye nezindleko zesicelo ezingu-R125 - Isicelo sokubhaliswa: ukwenza umsebenzi wokucubungula inhlanzi.
Uma umuntu ethola imali ethintwa yintela kodwa engakhishwa kuyo intela ye-SITE noma ye-PAYE, kufanele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kulowo msebenzi. Intela yesikhashana ikhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Inhloso yentela yesikhashana ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zabo zentela ngokwenza ukukhokha kusenesikhathi kunokukhokha imali enkulu ekupheleni konyaka lapho kubalwa khona inani lentela elikhokhwayo. Intela yesikhashana izokwenyusa inani elikhokhwayo uma kuqhathaniswa nemali yonke umuntu okufanele akhokhe intela kuyo kulonyaka wezezimali ofanele. Umuntu okumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kufanele, ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngemuva kokuba esebenzela, athumele isicelo esibhalwe phansi sokubhaliswa ehhovisi le-South African Revenue Service. Ukwehluleka ukwenza lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni kube nezintshisekelo nezijeziso zokukhokha sekwedlule, kanye nentela eyengeziwe ehlobene nezinkokhelo eziphuthumayo. Usuku lokukhokha intela yesikhashana esikhathini sokuqala lukhona ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezisuka ekupheleni konyaka wentela. Intela yokuqala yesikhashana kufanele imele ingxenye yesibili yentela ephelele ekhokhwayo sonke unyaka, emva kokukhipha intela yabasebenzi ekhishwe ngaleso sikhathi kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izimali ezivunyelwe ngaphandle ngaleso sikhathi. Khipha le mali usebenzisa ifomu lokukhokha lentela elingu-IRP6, ngaphambi kosuku lokukhokha. I-SARS izothumela abakhokhi bentela yesikhashana ababhalisiwe amafomu afanele. Intela yesikhashana ingakhokhwa ehhovisi lesigaba sentela esiseduze kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu phakathi kwe-8:00 AM no-3:00 PM, ngaphandle kwezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi. Uma abantu bekhokha ngeposi noma beyifaka ebhange, kufanele bavumele isikhathi sokulethwa kweposi noma sokucubungula izinkokhelo zebhange. Uma ukukhokha kuthunyelwa ngocingo, abantu kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi ibhange linomkhawulo wesikhathi salolo suku futhi kudingeka isikhathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthumeli unama-funds anele, okungathatha izinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezintathu. Inombolo yentela kufanele ibe nezinombolo eziyishumi, kanti inombolo lapho imali izokwenziwa khona ibhekisela ku-akhawunti ezothola imali. Noma iyiphi inkokhelo eyenziwe engahambisani nalokho okubhalwe ngenhla, ngokuhambisana nenombolo yentela kanye nenombolo ye-akhawunti ethola, ngeke yamukelwe. Uma usuku lokugcina lokukhokha luhlangana nosuku lokuphumula noma iMgqibelo, abantu kufanele bakhokhe ngosuku lokugcina lokusebenza ngaphambi kosuku lokuphumula noma iMgqibelo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi olunembile, vakashela ku-website ye-SARS ku-www.sars.gov. Amafomu e-IRP 6 esikhathini sokuqala kufanele athunyelwe, noma uma ucabanga ukuthi akukho ntela yesikhashana okufanele ikhokhwe. Uma ukukhokha kwentela yesikhashana kwenziwa ngokusekelwe emalini ehleliwe engaphansi kwenani lokuqala, kufanele kwenziwe isicelo nencazelo. Ifomu lesicelo sentela le-IRP 6 lesikhathini sokuqala liqukethe incazelo yalelo sicelo. Uma i-SARS inganelisekile, kungacelwa ukuthunyelwa kabusha. Ukuze ugweme izijeziso nezintshisekelo, qinisekisa ukuthi amafomu e-IRP 6 athunyelwa ehhovisi le-SARS elihambelana ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina lokukhokha. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe futhi sithunyelwe kusenesikhathi. Manje ingxenye ye-akhawunti yokukhokha ifomu le-IRP 6 itholakala kwelinye ikhasi elikhaleni. Ifomu lakho lokukhokha lingathunyelwa lodwa ngaphandle kwenani lokukhokha. Isigaba sentela siqinisekisile izinga lesikhungo sokusebenza ezinyangeni ezizayo ezimbili. Uma ucela omunye umuntu ukuthi akusize ukuthumela isaziso sentela, kubalulekile ukwazisa ehhovisi lesigaba sentela. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe ubumfihlo bakho futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isigaba sentela asikhulumi ngemininingwane yakho yomuntu. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Uma umuntu ethola imali ethintwa yintela kodwa engaphansi kwemithetho yokukhipha intela ye-SITE ne-PAYE, kumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kulowo mholi. Intela yesikhashana ikhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Inhloso yentela yesikhashana ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zabo zentela, kunokuba balinde ukukhokha kanye ngonyaka lapho isimo sabo sentela sihlolwa. Intela yesikhashana, uma ikhokhwa, isiza ukunciphisa inani lentela eliphelele okumele likhokhwe ekupheleni konyaka wentela uma imali ihlolwa, okumele ikhokhwe ngumuntu kulowo nyaka. Umuntu okumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kumele athumele isicelo esibhaliwe sokubhalisela ukujolisa emnyangweni wezezimali waseNingizimu Afrika oseduze phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kokuba sekwenziwe isibopho sokukhokha. Ukwehluleka ukubhalisela ukujolisa kuzoholela ekutheni kubizwe izintshisekelo nezijeziso zokukhokha sekwedlule, kanye nentela eyengeziwe yokukhokha sekwedlule. Usuku lokugcina lokukhokha intela yesikhashana yesibili alukwazi ukuba sekwedlule ngosuku lokugcina lokwenza ukuhlolwa kwezimali noma ukuphela kwemali eyamukelekayo. Uma ukuphela konyaka wezezimali kuvela ngoFebhuwari, kuholela ezinkingeni zezimali, futhi imvume itholakala ku-SARS yokuthumela izitatimende zezimali ngosuku oluhlukile kunoFebhuwari, abantu abanjalo bangacela imvume yokuthumela izimpendulo zentela yesikhashana ngokuhambisana nokuphela kwemali eyamukelekayo. Yonke eminye imali kumele ithunyelwe ngaphambi kokuphela kokuhlolwa kwezimali okuphuma ngoFebhuwari 28/29. Inani lentela leminyaka ephelele likhishwa ngokukhipha intela ekhokhwe ngabasebenzi unyaka wonke kusuka kumkhawulo ovunyelwe wemali engenayo yonyaka ophelele, kuncishiswe nenani elikhokhiwe lesikhathi sokuqala sonyaka. Khipha ngokugcwalisa ifomu lesaziso sokukhokha i-IRP 6, ngaphambi noma ngosuku lokugcina. Izinkokhelo zingakwenziwa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi le-SARS, kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, phakathi kuka-08:00 ekuseni no-15:30 emini, ngaphandle kwezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi. Uma ukhokha ngeposi noma usebenzisa i-ATM, ukukhokha kumele kwenziwe ngesikhathi sokuthi ifomu lakho lifike kusenesikhathi ehhovisi le-SARS. Uma ukhokha ngedijithali, lokhu kumele kwenziwe ngesikhathi sokunikeza ibhange lakho ithuba lokucubungula ukukhokha ngokushesha, futhi uhlole ukuthi kukhona imali eyanele akhawuntini yakho, njengoba lokhu kungathatha phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezintathu. Inombolo yentela kumele ibe nezinombolo eziyishumi, futhi inombolo lapho imali izokwenziwa khona ibonisa i-akhawunti ezothola le mali. Noma iyiphi ukukhokha okwenziwayo akumele kuhambisane noma kuhlangane nalokho okubhalwe ngenhla, ngokuhambisana nenombolo yentela kanye nenombolo ye-akhawunti ethola, futhi ngeke yamukelwe. Uma usuku lokugcina lokukhokha lufika ezinsukwini zokuphumula noma ngempelasonto, abantu kumele bakhokhe ngosuku lokugcina lokusebenza ngaphambi kwezinsuku zokuphumula noma ngempelasonto. Ifomu le-IRP 6 lesibalo sesikhathi sesibili kumele lithunyelwe, noma ngabe ukubala kwakho kukhombisa ukuthi ngeke kudingeke ukukhokha intela yesikhashana. Ukuze ukhokhe intela yakho yesikhashana yesibili, kufanele uhlinzeke ngokuqagela kwemali engenayo okumele ukhokhe, okuhambisana nenani langempela noma ngokuhlinzeka ngemali ethile yonyaka okumele ukhokhe intela. Ungase udinge ukukhokha intela eyengeziwe uma ukuqagela kwakho kwemali engenayo kuncane kune-90% yemali yangempela, futhi kungase kube ngaphansi kwenani langempela. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafomu e-IRP6 athunyelwa ehhovisi le-SARS elifanele ngaphambi kokuthi wenze ukukhokha. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe ngesikhathi sokucubungula, futhi ngeke kudingeke izijeziso noma izintshisekelo. Imiyalelo yokukhokha ingxenye yentela efomini le-IRP6 manje itholakala kukhasi elihlukile. Ngakho-ke, ungathumela impendulo yakho yentela ngokuhlukile kulapho wenza khona ukukhokha. Umnyango wentela usungula izinga le-service elizokwenziwa eminyakeni emibili ezayo. Uma ucelwa omunye umuntu ukuba akusize ukuthumela impendulo yakho yentela, kubalulekile ukwazisa ihhovisi lezezimali likamasipala. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe ubumfihlo bakho futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnyango wentela awukhulumi ngemininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu. Le sevisi ayikhokhelwa. Isaziso sokukhokha sihambisana nefomu lezezimali le-IRP 6.
Inqubo yokwakha izindlu abantu iyisinyathelo sokuhlinzekwa nguhulumeni ukusiza ngezindlu ezisekela imindeni efuna ukuthuthukisa ukufaka kwabo izimali zokuqashwa ngokwakha izindlu zabo noma ngokuzikhuthaza ukuba zakhe izindlu zabo. Le nqubo isiza labo abafuna ukujabulela ukusungula inhlangano yokweseka izindlu ezizobasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngenkxaso ekubumbeni, ezobuchwepheshe, nasekuphathweni. Usizo luhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa nokwelulekwa kwabathola izinzuzo ukuze bakhe izindlu zabo. Le ndlela itholakala njengomsebenzi wababhekiwe, ngokuhlanganiswa, ukudala izikhungo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, itholakala nasezindaweni zasemaphandleni lapho abantu benelungelo lokusebenzisa nokuhlala emhlabeni abawuthathile. Le nqubo ikuvumela ukuba usebenzise usizo lwezikhwama ukuze wakhe indlu yakho. Njengoba usizo lobuchwepheshe lubalulekile kakhulu kule nqubo, wonke umuntu ophakathi kwenqubo kumele abe nenhlangano esekelayo. Le nhlangano isiza ngensiza yobuchwepheshe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indlu yakhiwa kahle. Abantu abakha izindlu zabo noma bakhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zabo bangakha izindlu ezinkulu ngezindleko ezincane, behlisa izindleko zomsebenzi ngokuba nabantu abakhe ezinye izinto bona noma ngokuthola usizo emindenini yabo, ozakwabo, abangane, nabanye abangabasiza ukuze bagweme ukukhokha izinzalo kumakhontileka okwakha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinqumo. Kumele ube shadile noma uhleli ndawonye, noma ube nezincwadi ezixhaswa ngokwezimali. Kumele ube ngumuntu omdala okwazi ukungena ekwenzeni isivumelwano. Kumele ube nemali engenayo yomndeni engaphansi kuka-R3,500. Akufanele ube uthole usizo lwezikhwama kuhulumeni ngaphambili ukuze uthenge indlu. Kumele ube ngumthengi wokuqala wezindlu. Qaphela ukuthi kumele ungene esivumelwaneni esisekelwa yinhlangano esemthethweni. Inhlangano esekelayo izohlinzeka ngemininingwane yobuchwepheshe kanye nolwazi lwezokuphatha. Izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe zifaka phakathi ukuxhumana neMnyango wezokwakha wesifunda, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho, yomkakho, nezingane zakho, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngekhophi ye payslip yakho njengobufakazi bemali engenayo. Izicelo zikhishwa yiMinyango yezokwakha zesifunda. Isikhathi esidingekayo sokuhambisa le nkonzo siyahluka kumacala. Le nkonzo iyamahhala futhi ayidingi ifomu.
Bangakwazi ukuqeqeshwa ukuze babe neqhaza lokweseka emaphoyiseni. Ukuze benze imisebenzi yokweseka emahhovisi kazwelonke, esifundazweni, endaweni, noma emahhovisi esiteshi, futhi ngeke benze imisebenzi ephelele yamaphoyisa, ngeke bagqoke ifomu lapho kudingeka khona, bangaqeqeshwa ezindaweni zomthetho, ezinqubomgomo, nezikhombisi ezisebenzayo emkhakheni abakhona noma ezihlobene nomsebenzi abawenzayo. Kumele babe nekhono elithile noma ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe olungasetshenziswa yinsizakalo yamaphoyisa, ngokwesibonelo, abaphayona, odokotela, abapholisa amanzi, abasebenzi bezokwelapha, noma abaphsychologists bazokwenza imisebenzi ethile endaweni yabo yolwazi lobuchwepheshe njengoba kuvunyelwe umphathi wabo, bagqoke ifomu lapho kudingeka khona, bangaqeqeshwa ezindaweni zomthetho, ezinqubomgomo, nezikhombisi ezisebenzayo emkhakheni abakhona noma ezihlobene nomsebenzi abawenzayo. Ukuze benze umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ophathelene nokupholisa ezindaweni zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni zasemakhaya emikhakheni ethile esiteshini, noma ukwenza imisebenzi echazwe emkhakheni wabo endaweni ethile njengoba kumisiwe umphathi, bangagqoka ifomu kuye ngokusetshenziswa kwabo, kumele baqeqeshwe emkhakheni ofanele wokupholisa noma/nomsebenzi wamaphoyisa ophathelene nemisebenzi yabo. Ukuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kungadingeka uma benza umsebenzi wamaphoyisa emikhakheni ehlukene yokupholisa. Umphakathi ophakathi nendawo uqokwa emkhakheni othile, futhi angadluliselwa kwenye emkhakheni ehambisanayo, ngokuhambisana nazo zonke izimfuneko zalowo mkhakha, futhi kumele adlule ekuqeqeshweni noma abe nesifiso sokuthola ukuqeqeshwa okudingekayo kulowo mkhakha. Kumele benze ukuhlolwa noma ukuhlola, okwenziwe nguMphathi Wezizwe Wamaphoyisa, ukuze babe neziqu zesikole esiphakeme noma ezilinganayo, futhi banikeze ubufakazi bokuthi bakwazi ukukhuluma, ukubhala, nokufunda isiNgisi, njengolimi olwamukelwe ngokomthetho, kumele bavume ukuba kuthathwe izithupha zabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe futhi kumele bangabi ne-rekhodi yobugebengu noma babe ngabantu abanecala elisavivinywa, kumele babe nesifiso sokudlula ekuqeqeshweni futhi bathathe isifungo sokusebenza, kumele bangabi namathattoo abonakalayo; futhi kumele babe nelayisensi yokushayela, nakuba lokhu kungesiyo imfuneko eyinhloko yokuba umphakathi ophakathi nendawo. Nikeza ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yomsebenzi wakho wokuzazisa. Ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yelayisensi yakho yokushayela, uma unayo, amakhophi aqinisekisiwe wezifundo zakho. Umuntu owake waxoshwa emsebenzini ngenxa yokugula kwengqondo ungum member weNhlangano Yezokuphepha YaseNingizimu Afrika ongeniswe isicelo sokubuyiselwa esiphumelele, umuntu ophakathi nendawo kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yezenkolo, umuntu ogcwele emsebenzini wezindaba noma omele izindaba, umfundi, umphakathi wezokuphepha, ummember wenhlangano yamaphoyisa omasipala. Uma utholakala ufanelekile, isicelo sakho sizovunywa nguMphathi Wendawo, futhi uzophinde uqinisekiswe. Awuvunyelwe ukwenza imisebenzi yamaphoyisa kuze kube sekupheleni kokuqeqeshwa kwakho. Ngemuva kwalokho, uzonikezwa isitifiketi esisemthethweni. Le nsizakalo iyamahala futhi ayikhokhelwa. Amafomu okucela awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lenkonzo eliseduze.
Imoto ethwele impahla eyingozi - iminyaka engu-25. Uma usuhambe le ndlela yemoto futhi uqinisekiswe njengokufanele ngorganisasi eqashelwe, awukaze ujezwe ngokushayela ungaphansi kwethonya, noma ngokushayela ngokungafanele, noma ube nezigwegwe ezihlobene nokulwa, ilayisensi yakho ayikaze iphazamiseke. Kukhona izinhlobo ezithile zezenzo ezingakuvimba ekutholeni imvume yokushayela yobungcweti. Izenzo ezenzeke ngaphezulu kweminyaka emihlanu ezedlule ngeke zicatshangelwe. Uzohlolwa ngejaji lokushayela elisebenzayo. Idokhumenti yokuzazisa esebenzayo, ilayisensi yokushayela, noma ipasipoti yaseNingizimu Afrika iyadingeka. Izithombe ezimbili ezinemibala zedokhumenti yokuzazisa, ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo, kanye nesitifiketi sokufunda uma kudingeka, isitifiketi sezempilo esingekho ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izimvume zokushayela onazo. Khokha imali echazwe. Uzokwaziswa uma ikhadi lakho lemvume yokushayela yobungcweti lilungile ukuze uthole. Kumele ukwazi ukuzazisa uma uthola ikhadi lakho. Amakhadi angatholwa kuze kube ezinsukwini eziyi-120 ngemuva kokukhishwa kwawo.
Ilungelo lokuhlola izinsiza zemaminerali liyavunyelwa, elivumela inkampani noma umuntu ukuba enze uphenyo noma ukuhlola indawo ethile ngenhloso yokuhlonza indawo ethile enezinsiza zemaminerali noma engase ibe nazo. Noma ubani ofisa ukufaka isicelo sokuthola ilungelo lokuhlola izinsiza zemaminerali kumele athumele isicelo ehhovisi leMenenja Yesifunda lapho le ndawo itholakala khona. Ilungelo lokuhlola izinsiza zemaminerali linamandla iminyaka emihlanu, kodwa ngemva kokuphela kweminyaka emihlanu, umfaki-sicelo angacela ukuvuselelwa kwalelo lungelo lokuhlola izinsiza zemaminerali isikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni emithathu. Uhlelo lwezezimali luhambisana nemisebenzi yokuhlola isikhathi sonke. Akufanele kube nokungcoliswa komoya noma kwemvelo noma umonakalo endaweni okungase kube khona ngenxa yokuhlola izinsiza zemaminerali. Uma kungekho omunye umuntu onelungelo lokuhlola izinsiza zemaminerali, ilungelo lokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa, imvume yokwenza ibhizinisi lokumbiwa, noma imvume yokukhipha leyo nsiza noma le ndawo iyatholakala. Faka isicelo ehhovisi leMnyango wezamaMinerali kanye Nezamandla esifundeni lapho le ndawo itholakala khona. Uma iMenenja Yesifunda ivuma isicelo sakho, izokucela ukuthi uthumele uhlelo lokubhekana nezinkinga zemvelo, kanye nokuxhumana nomninindlu, ophila kule ndawo ngokomthetho noma nabanye ababambiqhaza. Thumela umbiko wokuxhumana ehhovisi leMnyango phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30. Uma zonke lezi zidingo zifeziwe, iMenenja Yesifunda izothumela isicelo kumphathiswa ukuze ivunywe. Yini udlame lwasekhaya? Umdlalo wempilo yomuntu ophazamisa wena noma ongakwenza uphathwe kabi empilweni yakho, ukuphepha kwakho, noma impilo yakho. Uma lezi zinhlobo zokuhlukunyezwa zenzeka kuwe noma kumuntu owaziwayo, ungafaka isicelo sokuvikelwa ukuze uvimbele umhlukunyezwa ekungeni endaweni yokuhlala eyabelwe noma engxenye ethile ebekwe njengengxenye yendawo yokuhlala; noma ukuthatha noma iyiphi isinyathelo esifakiwe ohlelweni lwezokuvikela enkantolo. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokuvikelwa enkantolo? Noma ubani onakekela noma okhathazekile ngempilo yomfaki-sicelo. Abantu abalandelayo bangafaka isicelo ngovuma komlamuli ebhalwe phansi, ngaphandle uma umlamuli engumntwana, noma uma engumuntu onengqondo engalungile, okhishwe njengomuntu ongekho emthethweni, noma uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi leyo muntu ayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngovuma lwabo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo. Igama lesiteshi samaphoyisa lapho umlamuli angabika khona ukuphulwa kwesivumelwano sokuvikelwa asifakile. Umuntu okhishwe njengomuntu ongekho emthethweni noma ongumntwana angaba nomuntu ofaka isicelo ngaye uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi leyo muntu ayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngovuma lwabo noma ukuhlinzeka ngovuma oludingekayo. Qedela ifomu bese ulithumela kumqondisi wenkantolo. Uma ifomu lamukelwe, umqondisi uzothumela isicelo sakho kumjudge ozobeka usuku lokuthi ubuye enkantolo ukuze uxoxe ngesicelo sakho. Ujaji uzophinde alungise isaziso sokwazisa umhlukunyezwa ngokuqinile, kanye nokubazisa ngesikhathi sokufika enkantolo. Uma udaba lufika phambi kwenkantolo, ujaji angakhipha umyalo wokuvikela. Umyalo ungatholwa ngalolo suku, kodwa lokhu kuvame ukwenzeka kuye ngobunzima bedaba lakho. Umyalo uqhubeka usebenza kuze kube umphakathi ophazamiswe uyawukhansela. Uma umhlukunyezwa efaka isikhalazo, umyalo uqhubeka usebenza kuze kube ukhanselewa yiNkantolo Yokubuyisela. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Umshado wesiko kumele uqashelwe njengomshado ongokomthetho, futhi lo mshado wesiko kumele ube sewenziwe ngaphambi kosuku lukaNovemba 15, 2000. Umshado kumele wamukelwe noma ungene ngokwezomthetho wesiko. Abazali bomntwana kumele bavume umshado. Uma kungabazali, umgibeli wezomthetho kumele avume. Uma abazali noma umgibeli wezomthetho bengavumi, umkomishana wezokuphila kwezingane angaxhumana ukuze athole ukuvuma. Uma kungabavumi abazali, umgibeli wezomthetho, noma umkomishana wezokuphila kwezingane, nguMphakathi ophezulu ozoqinisekisa isicelo sokuvuma. Ngisho noma kungabikho inani elithile lomshado wesiko, umyeni angangena kuwo, kodwa ngeke kuvunyelwe ukuthi kube nomshado wesiko omunye ngaphandle kokuba kube nesinqumo senkantolo esilawula ikusasa lenqubo yezezimali yomshado wakhe. Qinisekisa isimo somshado wakho ngokuhlola ku-inthanethi. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-32 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emishinini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Isethaphu yomshado ephelele noma ukubhaliswa kanye nemibhalo ethintwayo ikhishwa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kolwazi oluvela kuluhlu lomshado. Isitifiketi somshado esifingqiwe sikhishwa, kodwa imali kumele ikhokhwe ukuze kukhishwe isitifiketi uma ukubhaliswa komshado kwenziwa. Isitifiketi somshado esifingqiwe sikhishwa ngaleso sikhathi. Ithuluzi lokudoba liyithuluzi elinikezelwe ukudoba, noma elinokwakhiwa kokudoba, noma lokuvuna izinhlanzi noma ukusiza emisebenzini ehlobene nokudoba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi noma iyiphi ithuluzi elisiza elinye noma ngaphezulu kwamathuluzi olwandle abamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokudoba evumelekile - lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlela izinhlanzi, ukuhamba kwazo, ukuzigcina, nokuzibeka eqandisini. Inhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika ephethe ukuphepha kolwandle, i-SAMSA, kanye nomnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha, kumele ikhiphe imvume yokuthi ithuluzi likwazi ukudoba. Akukho thuluzi elizobhaliswa ngaphandle kwesikhungo sokudoba kanye nemvume yokwenza imisebenzi ehlobene nokudoba. Hlela ukuthi ithuluzi lihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lilungele ukuhamba olwandle, emva kwalokho i-SAMSA izokhipha isitifiketi sokuphepha. Lesi sitifiketi sizohambisana nemibhalo yakho yokubhaliswa. Gcwalisa ifomu lakho ngesandla usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu futhi unikeze izizathu lapho kudingeka. Thumela isicelo sakho kanye nezikhungo zakho zokudoba noma isivumelwano sakho nomnikazi wethuluzi sokusebenzisa ithuluzi labo uma ungenazo izikhungo zokudoba. Isicelo sakho singathatha ezinsukwini ezintathu noma ngaphezulu kuye ngokuthi imibhalo igcwele.
Ilungelo lokukopela liyilungelo lokuvikela umsebenzi wakho okungabandakanya imibhalo nezincwadi, izinhlelo zekhompyutha, imisebenzi yobuciko, izinto ezithunyelwa, umculo, amafilimu, noma amavidiyo. Ukuvikelwa kusho ukuvimbela abanye ekukopeleni, noma ekukhiqizeni lowo msebenzi noma impahla, futhi beyisebenzisa ukuze bathole inzuzo yezezimali. Umthetho Wokukopela ka-1978 usungula ilungelo lokukopela. Uma unomqondo wokuqala, awukwazi ukuba nelungelo kulowo msebenzi ngaphandle kokuthi uqale ubonise lowo mbono ngendlela ethile efana nencwadi, ikhadi, i-CD, isithombe esiphekiwe, umdlalo odlalwa esiteji, noma ifilimu. Ngokuvamile, labo ababhala, baphrinta, baphuma, badlale, bakha isithombe esaziwa noma esithathwe, bapenda, benza ifilimu, noma baphawula lowo msebenzi bangabantu abaphethe ilungelo lokukopela kulowo msebenzi. Nokho, kwesinye isikhathi, uma umuntu enikezwa umyalo wokwenza lowo msebenzi futhi ekhokhelwa ukudala le ngxenye yomsebenzi, amalungelo aphuma kumqashi owamukelele ukuba akhe lowo msebenzi. Emisebenzini eminingi, akudingeki ukufaka isicelo sokukopela. Ukuba nelungelo lokukopela kunikeza "ubunikazi" kulowo msebenzi kanye nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwawo ukuze kutholakale inzuzo yezezimali. Uphawu lokukopela oluvame ukubonwa ngu: ©. Ngemuva kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka eyisithupha, kwenziwa ukuhlolwa kwesiko, bese ilungelo lokukopela linikezwa enyangeni yesixhenxe.
Empeleni, "ukwakha" kubhekisela emshape nasekubonakaliseni kwesikhumbuzo esithokozisayo. Ezinye izakhiwo ziqhutshwa umsebenzi wesikhumbuzo kanti ezinye ziqhutshwa ukuhweba okuhle. Ukuklama okuhle ngokubheka ukubonakala kwayo kufanele kube nesizotha futhi kube nekhono, kube nobuhle emshape yayo, ukuhlela kahle izingxenye ezahlukene; noma ukuhweba; futhi kufanele kube sobala ukuthi kukhiqizwe ngezinqubo zezimboni. Kufanele kube nesimo noma ukuhlela kwezingxenye okuqhutshwa umsebenzi wazo; futhi kufanele kube sobala ukuthi kukhiqizwe ngezinqubo zezimboni. Nakuba kungadingeki ukwenza ucwaningo ukuze kuhlolwe ubungcweti nokwakhiwa okusha, noma ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akukho ukuklama okufanayo noma okuphakathi kokufana okubhalisiwe ngaphambili, kungcono ukwenza njalo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. Ucwaningo lokwakha lungaqhutshwa ehhovisi le-Design Registry ePitoli. Kufanele kwenziwe ngumuntu noma ummeli, ofana nommeli we-patent. Uma ukuklama kabulwa njengokusha kokubhaliswa, uzonikezwa isitifiketi sokwakha. Ukuklama kuhlaziywa njalo eminyakeni emithathu. Nikeza ikhophi yesitifiketi sakho sokubhaliswa esiqinisekisiwe. Ngemva kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka eyisithupha, kuqhutshelwa ukuhlolwa kwesiko, bese kukhishwa ukubhaliswa kokwakha enyangeni yesixhenxe.
Ukubhaliswa kokuzalwa kwenzeka ngemva kwesikhathi uma ukubhaliswa kwenziwa ngemuva konyaka kulandela ukuzalwa kwengane. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-24/1 lokubhaliswa kokuzalwa ngemuva konyaka, kodwa kungadluli eminyakeni engu-15. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-24/15 lokubhaliswa kokuzalwa ngemuva kweminyaka engu-15. Thumela ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesazisi somama uma abazali bengashadile noma ikhophi yokuvuma kukababa ukuba ngumzali. Uma ubaba evuma ukuba ngumzali, thumela amakhophi aqinisekisiwe wezazisi zombabili abazali. Thumela isitifiketi esivela esibhedlela noma endaweni yokubeletha lapho ingane yazalwa khona. Isitifiketi kumele sibe sesigciniwe umuntu ophatha futhi kumele sibe negama elisemthethweni lesikhungo kanye ne-stamp. Thumela isitatimende ngemininingwane yengane njengoba kuboniswe ohlwini lwezikole noma esitifiketini sesikole lapho ingane iqale khona, esisayiniwe nguMphakathi. Isitatimende kumele sibe nenombolo yeMphakathi ephepheni elisemthethweni elinestamp yesikole nosuku. Futhi thumela isitifiketi sokubhapathizwa kwengane uma sikhishwe phakathi kweminyaka emihlanu yokuzalwa kwengane. Uma abazali bengabikho, kufanele kuthunyelwe isitatimende esiqinisekisiwe esivela kumndeni oseduze, kodwa okungenani oneminyaka engu-10 edlula ingane, futhi owazi imininingwane yokuzalwa kwengane, okumele kuhambisane nezazisi nesimo sengane. Yiziphi izimfuneko zokubhaliswa? Thumela imali efanele okufanele ikhokhwe ngokuhambisana nesicelo sakho. Ibhodi izokubhalisela bese ikhishwa isitifiketi sokubhaliswa uma uhambisana nezimfuno ezidingekayo nezifanele zemfundo kanye nolwazi olukhuluma ngakho iBhodi. Umphumela wokuhlola ngeke uthunyelwe kuze kube sekupheleni komhlangano weBhodi. Uma, ngemuva kokusungulwa koMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, umfakisicelo utholakala enecala eRiphabhulikhi noma kwenye indawo futhi unikezwa isigwebo esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu noma imali njengendlela yokuhlwithwa. Uma iNkantolo Ephakeme ithola ukuthi umfakisicelo unengqondo engalungile noma unezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, noma uma bephumelele endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo yengqondo ngaphansi koMthetho Wempilo Yengqondo, 1973. Uma ukubhaliswa komuntu kuvinjelwe ngenxa yephutha elingafunwanga ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uma umuntu esuswa endimeni yokwethembeka ngenxa yokuziphatha okungafanele. Uma umuntu etholwa yinkantolo engakakhokhi izikweletu futhi engakabuyiselwa esimweni esihle mayelana nezikweletu, futhi ukungakhokhi izikweletu kwakubangelwa ukungaziphathi kahle emsebenzini ophathelene nokufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. Ibhodi izokwazi ukukwazisa ngokubhala uma isicelo sokubhaliswa sakho sikhanseliwe. Ungaphikisa isinqumo seBhodi ezinsukwini ezingama-30. Kufanele ufake isicelo kuBhodi sokuvuselela ukubhaliswa okungenani ezinyangeni ezintathu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokubhaliswa kwakho. Ukuze ukhokhe ngedijithali nokuqondile: Sicela usebenzise iziqu zamagama akho nesibongo ukuze uqinisekise ukukhokha kwethu embikweni wethu webhange bese uthumela ubufakazi bokukhokha ngefeksi, kanye neKHASI LOKUQALA lesicelo, kule nombolo: 841 1057.
Ngakho-ke, igama lebrand liyigama noma ukuhlanganiswa kwamagama. Isiqubulo siyi-phrasi noma umusho omfushane kanye nesithombe esithile se-logo esihlukaniswe nezinye noma uphawu. Lokhu kukhombisa ubunikazi obuhlukile obuhlobene naleyo nkampani emakethe futhi kusebenza nakumikhiqizo nasezinkampanini. Uma uphawu lwasungulwa, akekho omunye ongasebenzisa lelo phawu noma elinye elifana nalo. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kungathathwa izinyathelo zomthetho. Kube nezimo ezidumile ezinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika, njengokuthi inkampani yeMcDonald's e-USA yaphosa icala enkampanini yaseNingizimu Afrika eyayisebenzisa uphawu olufana ne "M" yabo. Thola ifomu le-TM1 ulenze ngamasethi amathathu. Amakhophi amabili azosetshenziswa ehhovisi, kanti elinye kufanele uligcine njengobufakazi besicelo sakho. Khokha imali yokubhaliswa ngaphambi noma lapho uthumela isicelo sakho. Bhala phansi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ofuna ukuzenza usebenzisa uphawu emkhakheni 57 wefomu le-TM1. Qaphela kakhulu ungafaki imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ezivela kwezinye izigaba ngaphansi komkhiqizo owodwa esicelweni. Uma wenza njalo, uzonconywa ukuba uhlele incazelo ukuze ifake kuphela lezo zimpahla noma izinsizakalo ezichazwe kulowo mkhakha kuphela. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kuzodingeka ukuthi uthumele isicelo esihlukile futhi. Uma isicelo sakho sihlangabezana nazo zonke izimfuneko zokubhaliswa, uzonikezwa usuku lwesicelo sakho nenombolo. Zonke izingxoxo nehhavisi zizobhekisela kulenombolo yesicelo. Nakuba kungathatha kuze kube yizinyanga eziyi-18 ukubhaliswa komkhiqizo, ungakwazi ukuwusebenzisa njengoba uthola inombolo yesicelo sakho. Uma uphawu lwakho lwamukelwa ngaphandle kokuphikiswa, ungakwazi ukukhangisa ngalo kwi-Patent Journal, ephephandabeni elikhishwa ngenyanga nguMphakathi Wezokuphrinta.
