Isiteshi sokuhlola izimoto yindawo ehlola izimoto futhi ikhishwe isitifiketi sokufakazela ukuthi imoto inelungelo lokusebenzisa imigwaqo yomphakathi. Kukhona iziteshi ezizimele abantu abazakhele zona, futhi kukhona neziteshi ezilawulwa uhulumeni. Zonke iziteshi zokuhlola izimoto kumele zibhaliswe futhi zihlukaniswe ngaphambi kokuba zikwazi ukukhipha izitifiketi zokufakazela ukuthi izimoto zinegunya lokusebenzisa imigwaqo yomphakathi. Lapho bethola incwadi yesicelo sokubhaliswa, umnyango wezokuthutha wesifunda uzothumela abahloli ukuze bahlolisise indawo efuna ukubhaliswa ukuze bazi ukuthi iyahlangabezana nezindinganiso ezidingekayo ngokwezimiso ze-SABS. Izinga elidingekayo yizinsiza ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlola izimoto, kanye nezinga lemfundo labahloli bezimoto. Iziteshi zokuhlola izimoto zinegunya lokuhlola izimoto kuphela ngaphakathi kwesigaba esinikezwe zona. Ukuze ubhalise isiteshi sokuhlola izimoto esizimele, xhumana nehhovisi lesikhungo sokubhaliswa kwezimoto esiseduze nawe ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile. Qedela ifomu le-TS1, isicelo sokubhalisela isiteshi sokuhlola izimoto, ehhovisi lesikhungo sokubhaliswa kwezimoto esiseduze nawe. Thumela incwadi yakho yokukhomba kanye nokukhomba kwalabo abaphatha le ndawo oyibhalisayo. Ungacelwa ukuthi uthumele nemibhalo eyengeziwe njengoba kudingwa yilungu lekhansili. Khokha imali echazwe. Kungathatha izinyanga eziyisithupha ukubhalisela isiteshi sakho.
Izikhungo ezingekho phansi kwezomnotho ziyizinkampani eziqoshwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo noma ukuthuthukisa izidingo zomphakathi futhi azihlosile ukwenza inzuzo noma ukwenza imisebenzi yokwenza inzuzo. Izikhungo eziningi ezingaphansi kukahulumeni, ezifana nezinhlangano ezizimele, izikhungo zezinsizakalo, nezikhungo zokupha noma zokwelapha, zifaka kuleli qembu. Ngokuvamile, izikhungo ezingekho phansi kwezomnotho zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukene emiphakathini, njengezinhlelo zokudla zezingane, izikhungo ezibhekelela abantwana abanogogo ngenxa ye-AIDS, izikhungo zokholo, nezinye. Nakuba zingase zibe nemali ethile futhi zibe nezimali ngemva kokuhlanza izindleko zazo zokusebenza, lezi zisetshenziselwa ukwandisa nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zazo. Lezi zikhungo ngokuvamile zithola uxhaso oluvela eziphandleni nasezikhungweni zezimali zangaphandle futhi ziqoshwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 21 seMthetho Wokwakha, 1973. Inkampani ngaphansi kweSigaba 21 inamalungu angaphansi kwezimbili futhi okungenani abaphathi ababili (kuhlanganise nomgibeli). Qedela amafomu ahlukene atholakala eMnyangweni Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Uhlu lwamafomu adingekayo ukuthi aqedwe lunikezwa ngezansi. Kungathatha izinsuku ezinhlanu ukuze processing yesicelo sakho.
Noma ubani ofuna ukugcina ibhufalo kufanele aqale abhalise umhlaba neMnyango Wezolimo. Thola ifomu lesicelo ku-inthanethi, bese uligcwalisa ngokuliprinta. Lingatholakala nasehhovisi lezemfuyo likamasipala. Buza udokotela wezilwane wakamasipala oseduze ukuze ahlole umhlaba kanye nezingxenye, kanye nokwazisa ngesimo sempilo sebhufalo. Umphakathi wezinsizakalo zezilwane esifundazweni kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izinsiza ezifanele zokubheka isimo semfuyo njalo, nokuthi ukuhamba kwezinye ibhufalo emhlabeni nasemaphandleni kungaphathwa kahle nokuthi noma yiziphi izigameko ezingajwayelekile zingaxazululwa ngokushesha. Ubufakazi obugunyaziwe bokugcina kahle, obukhishwe yiziphathimandla zok conserving environmental, kanye nemephu ekhombisa imingcele yomhlaba wonke ofuna ukuwubhalisela. Isikhathi esithathwa ukuze processing isicelo kanye nokwamukelwa kwaso siyahluka ukusuka esifundazweni ukuya esifundazweni. Uma isicelo samukelwa, sithunyelwa kwiMnyango Wezolimo kazwelonke. Abasebenzi emnyangweni kazwelonke banikeza inombolo yokubhaliswa, bangeze ulwazi ku-register ye-bhufalo kazwelonke, futhi baprinta isitifiketi sokubhaliswa esikhishwe kumphakathi womhlaba. Le nqubo ingathatha izinsuku eziyishumi zokusebenza. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Bonke abasebenzisi bamanzi, abawatholi amanzi kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, uhulumeni bendawo, ibhodi yamanzi, ibhodi yokufafaza amanzi, uhlelo lukahulumeni lwamanzi, noma abanye abasebenzisi bamanzi abakhulu, kumele babhalise ukusetshenziswa kwabo kwamanzi kwiSikhungo Samanzi Nezinkuni. Ukukhishwa kwemfucumfucu noma amanzi angcolile aphambukisa imifula nemifula, noma aguqula ukuhamba kwemfula kanye nokungena emfuleni noma ezindaweni zokuhlangana kwemifula, noma ukubukeka kwemfula. Ukugcina amanzi - Noma ubani ogcina amanzi ngenjongo ethile, njengokwakha insimu ye-golf endaweni ethile, nezinye izenzo ezifanayo, kusuka endaweni yokubamba, amanzi aphansi, noma emthonjeni owahamba ngenani elingaphezu kwama-10,000 cubic meters, noma lapho amanzi esetshenziswa endaweni edlula ihektare elilodwa lokuba noma ukuhlala, noma inhlangano, umuthi noma imvume. Izenzo ezivimbela ukuhamba kwemifula - Noma iyiphi ukufafaza kwezihlahla ngenjongo yebhizinisi, kuhlanganisa nezihlahla zomphakathi ngenjongo yebhizinisi, ezenzeka ngaphambi konyaka ka-1972, kumele zibhaliswe. Abanikazi bezihlahla abanemvume eyakhishwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinkuni, 1998, abadingi ukubhaliswa, njengoba sizobathumela imibhalo yokubhaliswa ephelele, ukuze baphinde baphendule uma kudingeka, b signing futhi bayibuyisele kwiSikhungo. Ukusetshenziswa nguhulumeni bendawo kanye nabasebenzisi abakhulu bezinhlaka zabo zamazwe, kanye nezenzo zokuhlanza. Izenzo ezilawulwayo ezifana nokufafaza ngamanzi angcolile, ukukhiqiza ugesi emanzini, ukuguqula umoya, noma ukukhokha nokubamba endaweni ethola amanzi. Ukuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuthile. Ukuxhumana nehhovisi lesifunda leSikhungo Samanzi Nezinkuni. Ulwazi lomfakisicelo, indawo lapho amanzi azosetshenziswa khona, ulwazi lomnikazi wendawo, isaziso kumfakisicelo, isaziso kumnikazi wendawo, ulwazi lapho isitatimende se-akhawunti kufanele sithunyelwe, ukuhlinzeka ngekhophi eqinisekisiwe yencwadi yakho yokuphatha, ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesivumelwano sokuhlala, ukuze uhambisane nazo zonke izimo ezidingekayo zezinsizakalo ezihlukene ezihlobene nesicelo. Ukubhaliswa kuzothatha inyanga eyodwa. Kubiza u-R114.00. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela ezicelweni zemvume.
Ukuze wenze umsebenzi wobungcweti usebenzisa isihloko esisemthethweni sokuba ngumsunguli wemvelo, noma ukufaka isifinyezo ngemuva kwegama lakho, usebenza emkhakheni wezokubonisana ukuze ube nesimo sobungcweti futhi uthole inzuzo ethuthukiswa yizikhungo zezimali ukuze uthole ukwesekwa kwiKhansela kanye nokuqinisekisa okungaphazamisi ikhono lakho lokuvikela nokukhulisa lo msebenzi. Okungenani u-50% wezifundo ohlelweni kumele kube ngendlela yezifundo zesayensi yemvelo. Kumele ubonise ubufakazi bokuqeqeshwa kuSayensi yezeMpi noma uphenyo, ngokwesibonelo, ukuhlolwa kwemibhalo, uphenyo lwezangoma, ukuhlolwa kwemikhono yezinsimbi, ubuchwepheshe bezob crime, izinqubo zomthetho namacala, ubufakazi bobuchwepheshe, noma ezinye izifundo ezimfushane ezivunyiwe. Kumele ube nehistori yomsebenzi ehambisana nesayensi yezeMpi nocwaningo, uhlole futhi uxhume izikhali/izikhali ezihlobene nobugebengu, ugxile endaweni yobugebengu futhi uhlole ubufakazi bezeMpi. Ukusekela kwezobuchwepheshe ekuphenjeni kwezehlakalo zomgwaqo, ukuhlela ukuthi izenzakalo zakhokelela kanjani ekuphahlazweni, uphenyo olunembile lwezingxenye zezimoto, ulwazi oluthile mayelana nobuchwepheshe bezimoto lungaba usizo. Thumela imali ethile okufanele ikhokhwe ukuze ubhalise kanye nesicelo. IKhansela izokubhalisela futhi bese ikhishwa isitifiketi sokubhaliswa uma uhambisana nemfundo efanele kanye nesipiliyoni njengoba kubekwe yiKhansela. Umphumela wokuhlola ngeke uxoxwe kuze kube sekupheleni komhlangano weKhansela. Uma, ngemuva kokusungulwa kweMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, umfaki-sicelo utholakale enecala eRiphabhulikhi noma kwenye indawo futhi uthole isigwebo esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu noma ihlazo njengokunye kokuboshwa. Uma iNkantolo Ephakeme ithola ukuthi umfaki-sicelo akafaneleki emoyeni noma unokugula kwengqondo, noma uma efakwa endaweni yokunakekelwa kwengqondo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwengqondo, 2002. Uma ukubhaliswa komuntu kuvinjelwe ngenxa yephunga elingahlinzekwanga ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uma umuntu esuswa esikhundleni sokwethembeka ngenxa yokungafaneleki. Uma umuntu ethole ukuthi akakhokhi izikweletu futhi akakabuyiselwa esimweni esihle mayelana nezikweletu, futhi ukungakhokhi izikweletu kwakubangelwa ukunganaki kwakhe ekwenzeni umsebenzi ophakathi kwezigaba zokufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa. IKhansela izokunikeza izaziso ngokubhala uma isicelo sokubhaliswa kwakho sikhanseliwe. Ungafaka isikhalazo ngesinqumo seKhansela ezinsukwini ezingama-30. Kumele ufake isicelo kwiKhansela sokuvuselela ukubhaliswa okungenani ezinyangeni ezintathu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokubhaliswa kwakho. Ukuze uthumele imali nge-inthanethi futhi uthumele imali ngqo: Sicela usebenzise izincwadi zokuqala zamagama nezibongo ukuze uthole ukukhokha okwenziwe ngubani kwi-akhawunti yethu yasebhange bese uthumela ubufakazi bokukhokha nge-fax, kanye nephepha lokuqala lesicelo kumakheli: 841 1057.
Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhalisiwe kuleli, abantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano ebhalisiwe ngokofficial eNingizimu Afrika ezingafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa kwemithi yezolimo. Umphathi: Umthetho 36 ka-1947 kumele waziswe ngokubhalwe phansi ngenhloso yokwenza imisebenzi edingekayo yokuhlola ukuze kubhaliswe imithi yezolimo ukuze kuhlelwe ukusebenza kwazo. Umphathi angadinga ulwazi olungeziwe ukuze enze isinqumo sokuthi imithi iyamukeleka noma cha, ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zelizwe, ukufaneleka, kanye nokusebenza kwayo kwezemvelo. Thola ifomu lesicelo kuwebhusayithi, bese uligcwalisa ngokuphelele. Lapho kudingeka, ulwazi oluceliwe lungathunyelwa njengama-attachments eduze kwemibhalo enezinombolo. Iphothi noma indawo lapho ivolumu yenqubo izobhalwa khona ukuze kuhlolwe izivivinyo nokubuyekezwa kwemiphumela ngokwesayensi yindawo lapho ucwaningo luzokwenziwa ukuze kuhlolwe izinto ezikhona noma olunye ulwazi olungadingeka nguMphathi mayelana nenani lemithi ezothunyelwa kuleli. Izicelo ezingaphelele zizobuyiselwa kumfaki-sicelo, futhi asizokwamukela noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlolwa kwezingxenye ezisebenzayo kungathatha unyaka owodwa. Izicelo zokusetshenziswa kokugcina noma zokubhaliswa kabusha ngokuvamile zikhishwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu. Ihhovisi leMphathi lithumela izincwadi minyaka yonke mayelana nezibuyekezo zokubhaliswa nezifomu zokufaka izicelo kubo bonke ababhalisile.
Kufanele ubhalise ku-VAT uma imali yakho yokuthengisa izimpahla noma izinsizakalo idlula u-R300,000 ngonyaka noma kulindeleke ukuthi idlule le mali. Umuntu angazibhalisela ngokwakhe uma imali yakhe yenyanga yezi-12 idlula u-R20,000 noma kulindeleke ukuthi idlule u-R20,000. Izicelo zokubhaliswa okungokwenkolo noma okuzithandela kufanele zenziwe usebenzisa ifomu le-VAT 101, elitholakala ku-inthanethi esigabeni seziqu, noma litholwe ehhovisi lendawo lempahla. Ifomu kumele lithunyelwe ehhovisi le-SARS lendawo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-21 kusukela ngosuku okufanele ubhalise ngalo. Uma kuyibhizinisi langaphandle, imininingwane yomuntu okhethwe ukuba temsilise le bhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika iyadingeka. Isitatimende sebhange esisha, i-cheque ethulwe, noma incwadi evela ebhange eqinisekisa imininingwane yakho yokubhanga eNingizimu Afrika. Uma i-akhawunti yebhange ingekho egameni lesithengisi, ifomu le-VAT 119i kufanele liqedwe. Ikhadi lokusebenza lebhizinisi, uma likhombisa lelo bhizinisi, isibonelo, ikhadi lokuthengisa utshwala noma lokudlala. Uzokwazi uma isicelo sakho singavunywa. Linda okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-10 ukuze ihhovisi lendawo processing isicelo sakho. Isitifiketi sizothunyelwa kule ndawo oyinikezile esicelweni sokubhaliswa futhi sizotholakala phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili uma isicelo sakho sivunywa. Abasebenzi be-SARS abavunyelwe ukukwazisa ngokuqondile ngenombolo yakho ye-VAT. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa futhi ayikhokhiswa.
Izilwane nemikhiqizo yezilwane zingathunyelwa kuphela uma ziqhamuka endaweni ehambisana nezindinganiso zomhlaba jikelele ezibekiwe, noma lapho imithetho efanele yezwe elithumelayo ihambisana nalezo zezwe elitholayo. Le ndawo ingaba yindawo yokukhulisa nokuhlinzeka ngezilwane ezamukelekayo, isikhungo sokukhulisa, isikhungo sokuhlanganisa, umhlaba, indawo yokudla, ifektri yokucubungula ukudla, indawo yokugcina ukudla, nokunye. Xhumana nomhloli wezempilo yezilwane kahulumeni esifundeni sakho ukuze ufake isicelo sokuhlolwa ngenhloso yokuthumela. I-raphothi yokuhlolwa ithunyelwa kwiMnyango Wezolimo ukuze yamukelwe kanye nesizathu kanye nesiphakamiso sokugcina se-PSV. Uma isicelo samukelwa, le ndawo ibhaliswa, futhi kukhishwa isitifiketi sokubhaliswa kokuthumela kwezilwane. Isikhathi esithathwa ukuze processing isicelo siyahluka ukusuka esifundeni ukuya esifundeni. Lokhu kuncike esifundeni. Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Xhumana nomhloli wezempilo yezilwane kahulumeni esifundeni sakho noma iMnyango Wezolimo.
Umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu ubhekwa njengomuntu ongenamali mayelana nezimpahla zakhe. Uma ushade ngaphansi komshado wempahla yomphakathi, futhi umyeni wakho ubevele wakhululwa ngumlomo womthetho ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu ngaphansi koMthetho Wokungakhokhi Izikweletu ka-1936, nawe ubhekwa njengomuntu ongenamali (ongakhokhi). Uma umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu efuna ukubuyiselwa esimweni sokukhokha ngemva kweminyaka eyishumi kusukela ngosuku akhululwa ngalo, bangafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle? Umuntu okhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu, ummeli ogunyaziwe womuntu ongenamali, uma lowo muntu ongenamali engahlali eNingizimu Afrika, umfelokazi noma umfelokazi womuntu okhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu, uma behlale emshadweni wempahla yomphakathi nomuntu ongenamali, uma behlale emshadweni wempahla yomphakathi futhi benikezwe ukuba balandele impahla yomuntu osefile. Sekuyisikhathi esingakanani ngemva kokuthi impahla yomuntu ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa kokuphatha ukuthi umuntu angafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle? Kwenziwa ngokushesha ngemva kokuthi izikweletu zikhokhiwe ngokuphelele noma uma umuntu okhulunywa ngaye ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu efaka isicelo sokukhokha izikweletu ngokuphelele, futhi isicelo sakhe sivunywa abakhokhi abathathu, futhi umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu ukhokhe izikweletu noma wenze ukuhlela kokukhokha. Uma phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, kungakabi nempikiswano yezikweletu mayelana nempahla yomuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu, futhi futhi ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuthi lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala umuntu akhululwa ngaso ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu futhi ubekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa, futhi umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu akanazo ezinye izigameko ezimelene naye. Kusukela ngosuku uMphakathi eqinisekisa i-akhawunti yokuphathwa kwempahla yabo; futhi futhi ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuthi lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala umuntu akhululwa ngaso ukuthi akakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu futhi ubekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa, futhi umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu akanazo ezinye izigameko ezimelene naye. Kusukela ngosuku uMphakathi eqinisekisa i-akhawunti yokuphathwa kwempahla, futhi uma umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu esekhulume ngaphambili ukuthi unokufaka isicelo ezimweni ezithile, kodwa ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuthi umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu akakaze atholakale enesicelo ezimweni ezithile. Endabeni lapho umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu esekhulume ngaphambili ukuthi unokufaka isicelo ezimweni ezithile. Ngemva kweminyaka eyishumi, umuntu obhekwa njengongakhokhi izikweletu uzokwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle - ngaphandle uma inkantolo iyala ngenye indlela, lapho izingxenye ezithintekayo zifaka isicelo. Isicelo kumele senziwe phakathi kweminyaka eyishumi. Ungafaka isicelo sokubuyiselwa esimweni esihle uqobo, kodwa uzodinga usizo lwezomthetho. Xhumana nommeli noma ehhovisi likaMphakathi ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile nolwengeziwe. Xhumana nommeli wakho ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Xoxa ngezindleko nommeli wakho. Xhumana nommeli wakho noma neMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezimiso.
Izinsizakalo zokuhlenga zikhona kubantu abakhubazekile ukuze zibasize bafinyelele ezingeni lapho bengasebenza khona ngendlela efinyelelekayo. Izinsizakalo zokuhlela eziyisisekelo zingezokuvikela ezakhiwe ukuze zandise amandla omthengi ukuba azimele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokunakekela ekhaya, amaqembu okusekela, nokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuzimela, ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa, nokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokukhuthaza nokuphromotha. Ukuvuselelwa kwezinga lesibili kuwuhlelo lokungenelela oluyisisekelo oluhlanganisa imikhankaso yokwenza imali nezinhlelo ezihloselwe ukunciphisa ubuphofu, ukuthuthukisa izingane ezincane, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphumula ezikhathazweni. Vakashela endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eduze noma kwi-clinic yokuhlola, lapho uzothunyelwa khona endaweni yokuvuselela esibhedlela noma kwenye indawo yokuvuselela, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ikhethekile, izinga lesibili, noma izinga lesithathu. Kungathatha cishe ezinyangeni ezi-3 ukuxazulula isicelo sakho. Ezindaweni ezithile, abantu babekwa ohlwini lokulinda okungafika ezinyangeni ezi-6. Ezimweni ezithile, usizo luk government kubantu abakhubazekile, olungafika ku-75%, luthathwa njengengxenye yezindleko. Ezinye izindleko zanqunywa yizikhungo uqobo. Ezinye izikhungo zihlola izindleko ngokususelwa kulokho umndeni ongakukhokha. Zonke lezi zindleko zihluka ngempela ngempela. Amafomu okucela adinga ukufakwa anikezwa yisikhungo sokuvuselela noma isikhungo sokunakekelwa okuyisisekelo.
Izinsizakalo zokuhlenga zikhona ukuze zikusize abantu abakhubazekile bafinyelele ezingeni lapho bengasebenza khona ngendlela efinyelelekayo. Izinsizakalo zokuqala zokuhlela ziwusizo oluvimbela olwakha ikhono leklayenti lokuzimela. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokunakekela ekhaya, amaqembu okweseka, nokwenza abantu bakwazi ukuzimela, bakhuthaze, futhi babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuvikela nokukhuthaza. Ukuvuselelwa kwezinga lesibili kuyohlelo lokungenelela oluyisisekelo oluhlanganisa imikhankaso yokwenza imali nezinhlelo ezihloselwe ukunciphisa ubuphofu, ukuthuthukisa izingane ezincane, nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphumula ezikhathini zobunzima. Vakashela endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eduze noma esikhungweni sokuhlola, lapho uzothunyelwa khona endaweni yokuvuselela esibhedlela noma kwenye indawo yokuvuselela, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ikhethekile, yesibili, noma yesithathu. Kungathatha cishe izinyanga ezi-3 ukuxazulula isicelo sakho. Kwamanye amaphethelo, abantu baphakanyiswa ohlwini lokulinda okungafika ezinyangeni ezi-6. Kwamanye amacala, usizo luk 정부 lwabakhubazekile, olungafika ku-75%, luthathwa njengengxenye yezindleko. Ezinye izindleko zikhokhwa yizikhungo ngokwazo. Ezinye izikhungo zihlola izindleko ngokususelwa kulokho umndeni ongakukhokha. Zonke lezi zindleko zihluka ngephondo. Amafomu wesicelo adingeka ukuthi agcwaliswe ahlinzekwa yindawo yokuvuselela noma indawo yokunakekelwa kwezempilo yokuqala.
I-visa yomndeni inikezwa kumuntu wangaphandle ongumndeni oseduze wombuso noma umhlali ongenamkhawulo ophila eNingizimu Afrika. Umphakathi noma umhlali kufanele ahlinzeke ngezimali ezivikelekile. I-visa yomndeni iyasebenza isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emibili. Hlinzeka ngobufakazi bokuba umndeni oseduze kumphakathi osekelayo noma umhlali. Thumela isiqinisekiso esivela kumphakathi ophakanyisiwe noma imibhalo esekelayo eqinisa isicelo sokuthi umphakathi noma umhlali osekelayo unamandla ezimali noma inhlanganisela yezinsiza zezimali zokukweseka. Inani lokweseka akufanele lidlule ku-R5,000 ngenyanga kumuntu ngamunye ngesikhathi sokuvakasha, okungafaki umkakho noma izingane ezincane ezincike kuwe. I-visa esebenzayo idinga izitifiketi zezempilo eziphathelene nomfaki- sicelo nakubo bonke ozakwethu abahambisana naye. Isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka kwamaphoyisa sidingeka uma ungena eminyakeni engu-21 ubudala mayelana nawo wonke amazwe owahlala kuwo ngaphezu konyaka owodwa, ukuze sikhishwe ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-12, uma singakakwazi ukuhlinzekwa ngaleso sikhathi. Imibiko yezempilo nezimiphumela ze-X-ray zidingeka kumfaki-sicelo ngamunye. Imibiko ye-X-ray ayidingeki ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 noma kwabesifazane abakhulelwe. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-30.
Uma uthola imali yokusiza kuhulumeni engafanele ukuba uyithole, uzobhekana nesibopho sokuyibuyisela kuhulumeni ngaphandle kokuthi uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ube satisfied ukuthi awuzange wazi ukuthi bekungekho emthethweni ukuyithola. Kulokhu, imali yokusiza kuhulumeni kufanele ibhujiswe noma iphazanyiswe, njengoba izobhekwa njengohlelo lokukhwabanisa ukuze uthole inzuzo yomuntu siqu. Le nsizakalo ibhekelelwe abantu abathola izinxephezelo ezingafanele. Abantu abathola izinxephezelo ezingafanele bazothola sebephakathi kwalesi simo. Uma imali yokusiza ingafunwa ezinyangeni ezintathu ezilandelanayo. Uma umuntu engasekho eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyisithupha. Uma uthola ukuthi uthole imali yokusiza kuhulumeni engafanele ukuba uyithole, kufanele wazise ihhovisi eliseduze leMnyango Wezangaphakathi. Lo mnyango uzokhansela inani owedlula lona uma bejabulile ukuthi awuzange wazi ukuthi bekungekho emthethweni ukuyithola le mali. UMsunguli-Jikelele woMnyango angase, ngokuthanda kwakhe, afune ukubuyiselwa kwemali ngokusebenzisa izinqubo zomthetho kulowo muntu. UMsunguli-Jikelele woMnyango angavuma ukuqhubeka kokukhokhwa kwemali isikhathi esithile, kulandela izimo ezithile ezibekwe ngumuntu ofuna ukuqhubeka ethola le mali yokusiza. Isicelo kufanele senziwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-90 ngemuva kokuphazanyiswa kwemali yokusiza kuhulumeni. Uma umuntu efuna ukubuyekeza udaba lokuphazanyiswa kwemali yokusiza kuhulumeni, kufanele aveze imali yakhe ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kuzoba yisisekelo esizosebenza uMnyango uma enza isinqumo sokuthi ubuyekeze isimo sakho noma cha. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngemiphumela yesicelo phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyekezwa noma ngosuku lapho kukhishwa khona isitifiketi. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhelwa futhi ayihlawulwanga. Amafomu atholakala ehhovisi eliseduze leMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika.
Lo msebenzi uchaza inqubo yokuthatha izinyathelo nokwakha uhlelo lokukhuthaza noma ukuvikela ngokumelene nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu abadala. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zokuhlukunyezwa okungahlangabezana nabantu abadala. Ukuhlukunyezwa komzimba: Noma iyiphi isenzo esiholela ekulimaleni noma ekufeni komuntu omdala. Njengokubashaya, ukubashaya ngento, ukubaphusha, ukubaphatha ngokuqinile, ukubabhabhadisa ngenkemba, ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali noma izibopho ukuvimbela ukuba benze okuthile, ukusebenzisa imishanguzo engafanele noma ey excessive, noma noma iyiphi isenzo esiholela ekulimaleni, ukuphazamiseka komzimba, ukubaphoqa ukuba bathathe izidakamizwa ezithulisa noma izinto ezingaholela ekufeni. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezocansi: Noma iyiphi isenzo esiholela ekusebenzeni komuntu omdala njengomlisa wezocansi noma ukuthokozisa ngokocansi ngaphandle kokwazi kwabo, ukuqonda, noma imvume. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwengqondo, ukuhlaselwa kwemizwa, noma ukuhlukunyezwa kwamazwi: Umjikelezo ophindaphindiwe wokuhlukumeza umuntu omdala, okubangela ukuthi ingqondo yabo isebenze kahle futhi umoya wabo uphazamiseke. Njengokubakhumbuza ukuthi abavunyelwe, ukubahlukanisa, ukuvimbela izinto ezithile, ukubadela uthando, nokuthuthukiswa kwengqondo, ukubabiza ngamagama angajabulisi, ukwenza kube yisihloko sokuhlekisa, ukubabeka ezimeni eziphansi, nokubabheka njalo. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwezezimali noma ukuhweba ngokwezimali: Ukusebenzisa kabi imali yokubolekwa komuntu omdala, impahla, izinto, noma izimali ngaphandle kwemvume yabo noma ulwazi lokuthi kuzokwenzekani noma ngaphandle kokwaneliseka kwabo ngalokho. Ukunganaki: Ukwehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo ezisemqoka ezigcina umzimba nengqondo. Njengokugcina ukudla, ukwehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ephephile, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, noma ukungaqinisekisi ukuthi bajabule futhi banakekelwe. Ukuphikisa amalungelo abantu: Ukuthatha amalungelo omuntu omdala, njengokubapha ukuhlonishwa, isithunzi, ukuvumela ukuba babe nephutha lokucabanga ngalokho abakufunayo, bakholelwe kulokho abakufunayo, bakhulume ngemibono yabo, futhi bakhulume ngendlela abayithandayo mayelana nalapho abafuna ukuya khona. Lokhu kunganaki kungaholela ekubizweni kwabo njengemikhonyovu, ukwehlukaniswa, ukulimala, noma ukufa. Noma ubani obona ukunganaki komuntu omdala noma ukuhlukunyezwa kwabo, noma othile onenkinga yokusola ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa okukhulunywe ngenhla kuyenzeka noma sekukhona. Uma umxhumanisi engumsebenzi wezokuhlalisana ohlanganyela ngqo nalezi zindaba, kufanele aqhubeke nocwaningo futhi anikeze umbiko ophelele obhalwe phansi ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi phakathi kwezinsuku ezine. Uma umxhumanisi engumsebenzi wezokuhlalisana, kubalulekile kumsebenzi omdala wezokuhlalisana ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ukuba anikeze umuntu ofanele ukwenza lo msebenzi futhi alindele umbiko phakathi kwezinsuku ezine. Uma ukuhlukunyezwa kuhambisana nendlu yabantu abadala, noma inhlangano engakaze ibhekelele, noma inhlangano yomphakathi, umphakathi wezokuhlalisana ofanele kumele abhekane nalesi simo. Uma isimo singahambisani nencazelo engenhla, funa izifiso zomuntu ohlukunyezwayo. Umphathiswa wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, noma ilungu lekhansela kufanele avume omunye umuntu ukusiza. Amafomu atholakala ehhovisi lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi eliseduze.
Le nsizakalo itholakala kunoma ubani osebephathwe kabi. Uma othile esebenzisa ubugebengu, angaxhumana namaphoyisa ngokushaya inombolo: 10111 noma ngokuvakashela emaphoyiseni aseduzane ukuze abike ubugebengu. Uma uphoyisa efika endaweni lapho ubugebengu bwenziwe khona, uzothatha isitatimende kumlamli kanye nanoma ubani obonile uma ekhona. Umlamli kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ugcina inombolo ye-CAS eyanikezwa yona ukuze enze imibuzo yesikhathi esizayo mayelana necala lobugebengu. Umphoyisa uzokhuluma nabo bese ethatha isitatimende kumlamli futhi abhale phansi ubugebengu obubikiwe kwi-CAS. I-docket yecala ebhalisiwe inikezwa umphoyisa ophenya ozokuqhubeka nophenyo. Zonke izicelo kumele ziqondiswe kulomphenyi. Umphenyi ophathiswe leli cala uzophetha uphenyo bese ethumela i-docket enkantolo efanele ukuze abhekane necala. Umphenyi uzokwazisa umlamli uma kudingeka ukuthi aye enkantolo ukuze alalele leli cala. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa. Umphoyisa othatha isitatimende uzogcwalisa ifomu.
Ukudlulisela kwenzeka uma umuntu efela, eshiya impahla noma/nenkosi, noma ngenhloso yokuba nekhasi. Ukudlulisela kufanele kuphathwe futhi kwabiwe ngokwezifiso zomuntu ofile, futhi uma ofile engashiyanga ikhasi, ngokwezinhlinzeko ezibekwe emthethweni. Umthetho ophatha ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabafileyo, i-Administration of Estates Act, 1965, ubeka indlela okufanele ilandelwe ekuphathweni kwefa lomuntu ofile. Ifa lomuntu ofile kufanele libikwe emahhovisi kaMaster ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kosuku lokufa. Ukufa kungabikwa noma ubani ophatha noma obamba impahla yomuntu ofile, noma ophatha noma obamba ikhasi noma ikhodikili yomuntu ofile. Uma umuntu efela eNingizimu Afrika eshiya impahla noma/nenkosi noma ngenhloso yokuba nekhasi, noma uma umuntu efela ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika eshiya impahla noma/nenkosi noma ngenhloso yokuba nekhasi. Ifa lomuntu ofile kufanele libikwe kuphi? Nakuba wonke amahhovisi abameli esebenza kuMaster futhi ifa lomuntu ofile lingabikwa lapho, abameli banamandla alinganiselwe futhi bazodlulisa amafa anekhasi, kanti amafa adlula u-R50,000 azodluliselwa emahhovisi kaMaster wesifunda. Uma ufuna ukubika lefa, kungcono ukubika ngqo emahhovisi kaMaster. Uma ofile ehlala eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe, bika ifa kuMaster onegunya endaweni lapho ofile ehlala khona ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe. Uma ofile engahlali eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe, ungabika ifa kunoma yimuphi uMaster. Bika ifa ngokugcwalisa ifomu le-J294: Isaziso Sokufa nezinye izincwadi zokubika ezishiwo ngezansi. Usayizi wefa kanye nohlobo lokuqokwa kuzokwenza kube sobala ukuthi yiziphi izincwadi ezidinga ukugcwaliswa nokuhanjiswa. Uma umuntu efela ngaphandle kwekhasi noma uma ikhasi linganiki umuntu othile njengomphathi noma uma umphathi oqokwe efela, noma enqaba ukuba aqokwe. Isitifiketi somshado sokuqala noma ikhophi eqinisekisiwe - uma lokhu kufanelekile kuzo zonke izikhasi zokuqala noma izikhalazo noma izincwadi ezineleli - uma kukhona uhlu lwabantu abaphethe ofile - uma kukhona isitatimende siqinisekisa ukuthi ifa alikabikwa kwenye i-ofisi kaMaster noma kwezinye izikhungo ezisebenzela uMaster. Uma umuntu efela ngaphandle kwekhasi noma uma ikhasi linganiki umuntu othile njengomphathi noma uma umphathi oqokwe efela, noma enqaba ukuba aqokwe. Isitifiketi sokufa noma ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yaso, isitifiketi somshado sokuqala noma ikhophi eqinisekisiwe - uma lokhu kufanelekile kuzo zonke izikhasi zokuqala noma izikhalazo noma izincwadi ezineleli - uma zikhona. Amahhovisi asebenzela uMaster anegunya uma ofile engashiyanga ikhasi elisemthethweni, futhi uma usayizi wefa lomuntu ofile ungaphansi kuka-R50,000. Izincwadi zomthetho zivumela umuntu oqokiwe ukuphatha ifa ngaphandle kokulandela izinqubo ezibekwe kwi-Administration of Estates Act, 1965. Isikhathi esithathwa ukuqeda le nqubo sincike ekujuleleni kwendaba.
Uma umuntu ethola imali ethintwa intela kodwa engakhishwa ku-SITE noma ku-PAYE, kumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kulokho kuhlomula. Intela yesikhashana ikhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Inhloso yentela yesikhashana ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zabo zentela kancane kancane kunokukhokha inani elikhulu ekupheleni konyaka lapho umthwalo wentela uqashelwa. Intela yesikhashana izokhokhwa ukuze kuncishiswe inani elikhokhwayo uma kuqhathaniswa nemali yonke okufanele ikhokhwe ngumuntu kulonyaka wentela ofanele. Umuntu okumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kumele athumele isicelo esibhaliwe sokubhaliswa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezimali laseNingizimu Afrika phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemva kokuba sebecabanga ukukhokha. Ukwehluleka ukwenza lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni kube nezintshisekelo nezijeziso zokukhokha sekwedlule, kanye nentela eyengeziwe ehambisana nezinkokhelo eziphuthumayo. Inkokhelo yesithathu ibizwa nangokuthi "eyengeziwe" noma "ukwengeza" kwentela yesikhashana. Lapho le nkokhelo yenziwa, kumele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina. Usuku "lokusebenza" lubhekisela esikhathini lapho unyaka wentela uphela khona ngosuku lwe-28 noma lwe-29 kuFebhuwari, ezinyangeni eziyisixhenxe ngemva kokwamukelwa kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, ophela ngosuku olungelona lwe-28 noma lwe-29 kuFebhuwari, ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ngemva kwalokhu. Inkokhelo yesithathu yenziwa ngumuntu okhokha intela yesikhashana ngenhloso yokuba umkhokhi wentela. Abakhokhi bentela abanomthwalo wentela ophakeme kune-R50,000 noma amabhizinisi anomthwalo wentela ophakeme kune-R20,000 bangakwenza inkokhelo yesithathu ngenhloso yokugwema ukukhokhwa kwezintshisekelo zokungakhokhi kahle uma kuhlolwa umthwalo wentela. Inhloso yale nkokhelo ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukukhokha umehluko phakathi kwentela yabasebenzi nentela yesikhashana esivele ikhokhiwe kulonyaka kanye nomthwalo wentela ophelele wokuhlola unyaka. Inkokhelo yesithathu imele umthwalo wentela ophelele wonyaka, kuncishiswe intela yabasebenzi ekhokhiwe wonyaka noma enye intela evunyelwe yokuphuma wonyaka, ngokusekelwe ezimalini ezikhokhiwe phakathi nezikhathi zentela yesikhashana zokuqala nezesibili. Kusemthethweni kumkhokhi wentela nomuntu okhokha intela yesikhashana ukusetha isikhathi esifanele sokwenza inkokhelo yesithathu eyengeziwe. Thola ifomu lokukhokha elisha kwi-SARS noma ulilandele kwi-inthanethi, ugcwalise, bese ulithumela nekhokhelo oyenzayo. Njengoba isaziso sokukhokha sifana kubo bonke futhi singafaki imininingwane ethile yomkhokhi wentela, kubalulekile ukuthi abakhokhi bentela yesikhashana banikeze imininingwane efanele ye-akhawunti kulolu fomu. Uma imininingwane efanele inganikezwa, inkokhelo ngeke ihlale iqondile kumkhokhi wentela. Inombolo yokubhekisela kufanele ibhalwe ngokulandelayo: 1234567123P00032005. Izinkokhelo zentela yesikhashana zingakhokhwa ehhovisi lesigaba sentela eliseduzane kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu phakathi kwehora le-8:00 AM kuya ku-3:00 PM, ngaphandle kwezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi. Uma izinkokhelo zenziwa ngeposi noma zifakwa ebhange, abantu kufanele bavumele isikhathi sokulethwa kweposi noma sokucubungula izinkokhelo zebhange. Uma inkokhelo ithunyelwa ngocingo, abantu kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi ibhange linomkhawulo wesikhathi sokucubungula futhi liphinde lidinge isikhathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthumeli unama-akhawunti anele, okungathatha izinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezintathu. I-akhawunti lapho imali izofakwa ibizwa nge-akhawunti yokwamukela. Noma iyiphi inkokhelo eyenziwe ingahambisani noma ingahambisani nalokho okukhulunywa ngenhla, ngokwesibalo sentela kanye nenombolo ye-akhawunti yokwamukela, futhi ngeke yamukelwe. Uma usuku lokugcina lokukhokha luhlangana nosuku lokuphumula noma weviki, abantu kufanele bakhokhe inkokhelo ngosuku lokugcina lokusebenza ngaphambi kosuku lokuphumula noma weviki. Inkokhelo yesithathu kumele ibalwe ngaphezu kwenani langempela elikhokhwayo lentela, njengoba inhloso yale nkokhelo ukusiza ukukhokha umehluko phakathi kwentela yabasebenzi nentela yesikhashana ekhokhiwe kulonyaka kanye nomthwalo wentela ophelele walonyaka wentela. Akukho sikhathi esibekwe kulolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahala.
Uma umholo ophelele womsebenzi noma inani elifanayo ngonyaka lingaphansi kwe-R2,000, aludluli inani okumele lukhishwe ukuze kube nezinye izinkokhelo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ifomu le-IT3 kufanele likhishwe, kusekelwe enanini eliphelele elikhokhiwe lapho izinkokhelo zentela zingakhishwanga. Noma iyiphi inkokhelo eyenziwe kumuntu wokuhlinzeka ngesevisi ethile, noma okumele yenziwe, lapho izinkokhelo zentela zingakhishwanga. Izinkokhelo zezinye izinsizakalo zivame ukutholakala emsebenzini wobungcweti, njengodokotela, abameli, abavakashi, ababhali bezincwadi, nabahloli bezimali. Umholo noma inani elifanayo elingadluli kwe-R2,000 emnyakeni wentela. Inkokhelo eyenziwe ngelungelo lokusebenzisa impahla, izinkokhelo zezinye izinto ezakhiwe esikhathini esedlule ezifana nokubhaliswa kwezimali nezinye, noma izinkokhelo zokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani, ukwakhiwa, amalungelo emikhiqizo, amalungelo okwakha imibhalo noma ulwazi, noma yokudlulisela ulwazi oluhambisana nokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani bezinto ezithile ezakhiwe. Incazelo ye-uniti noma impahla yezezimali ingumkhiqizo wezinto noma impahla edliwayo, inani liyisilinganiso seziqu ezidliwayo, inani eliphelele elitholwe kulezi zimpahla ezidliwayo yinzuzo ngemuva kokukhishwa kwezindleko ezifanele noma ukulahleka okuhambisana nalezi zimpahla ezidliwayo. Zonke izitshalo zezimboni, izinkuni, izinkomo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, imayini, kanye nezinsimbi ezingezona ezibalulekile ezitholwe ngawe ngokuthenga noma ukushintshanisa ngezimpahla. Zonke izitshalo zezimboni, izinkuni, izinkomo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, imayini, kanye nezinsimbi ezingezona ezibalulekile zithengiswa ngawe njengomthengisi wombhali. Zonke izitshalo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, noma imayini, zethulwa ngawe njengomthengisi ophatha izimpahla zomkhiqizi ziye kubathengi ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe. Le nsizakalo iyatholakala mahhala futhi ayikhokhiswa.

Usizo lwabantu abahluphekayo, okwesikhashana, luhloselwe ukusiza abantu abasemazingeni anzima kakhulu okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezisemqoka zemindeni yabo. Ubani ongathola usizo kwabantu abahluphekayo kakhulu? Ungathola usizo lokuhlupheka okukhulu kuhulumeni uma usendaweni ebalulekile futhi ephuthumayo. Udinga usizo ngenkathi ulindele ukwesekwa kwezingane lapho uhulumeni ebhekene nesicelo esiphenduke umonakalo ophuthumayo, njengomlilo endlini; akufanele uthole ukwesekwa kuhulumeni kule ndawo uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngoba impilo yakho ayikuvumeli - lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungekho kahle isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, awukwazi ukuthola ukwesekwa kwezingane noma izingane zakho kumzali omunye uma umzali osiza umndeni eshonile noma esesigodlweni isikhathi esifushane ngenxa yomonakalo, kodwa indawo yakho noma umphakathi akukabikhulumi njengendawo yomonakalo. Usizo lwabantu abahluphekayo lunganikezwa ngendlela yephakethe lokudla noma ama-voucher okuthenga ukudla. Ezinye izifunda zikhokha lokhu ngempesheni. Usizo lwabantu abahluphekayo lunikezwa isikhathi esifushane kuphela - ngokuvamile izinyanga ezintathu, kwesinye isikhathi izinyanga eziyisithupha. Faka isicelo sosizo lwabantu abahluphekayo ehhovisi eliseduzane leMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Isitatimende kufanele siqinisekiswe umuntu ophakanyisiwe emphakathini owaziwa umfaki-sicelo. Lokhu kungaba yilungu lekhansili, umholi wesintu, umphakathi wezokuxhumana, noma umfundisi njengobufakazi bokuthi isicelo sokuthola isitifiketi sokuzalwa noma sokuhlonza sithunyelwe kwi-branch yendawo, idokhumenti yokuhlonza yesikhashana ethunyelwe yi-branch yendawo uma kudingeka, isitifiketi sokuzalwa, ikhadi lekliniki, noma umbiko wesikole. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa ngokushesha. Uma usuthumele isicelo, sizobhekwa ubuqiniso bayo, nokuthi ngempela udinga usizo. Noma ungabi nawo wonke amadokhumenti, uzonikezwa iphakeji yokudla, i-voucher, noma imali esikhathini sokuqala. Khumbula bringinga wonke amadokhumenti kumphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi uthole usizo esikhathini sesibili. Uma ungakwenzi lokhu, awuzotholi usizo lokudla, i-voucher, noma imali esikhathini sesibili nasesesithathu. Uma izinto zingathuthuki empilweni yakho, ngemuva kokuthola usizo izinyanga ezintathu, ungafaka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesinye isikhathi sezinyanga ezintathu zosizo. Le nkonzo ayikhokhelwa; iyamahala. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi leMnyango eliseduzane.
Ikhansela lezeMvelo laseNingizimu Afrika livuma ukuthi abanye abantu abatholanga ithuba lokufunda baphinde bafinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu elidingekayo yikhansela elibhalisela abantu emisebenzini ethile. Nokho, lezi zinsizwa zitholwe zidlala indima ebalulekile emphakathini wezobuchwepheshe eminyakeni edlule futhi zingaqhubeka nokwenza njalo eminyakeni ezayo. Ikhansela lenze isinqumo sokunikeza lezi zinsizwa ithuba lokufaka izicelo zokubhaliswa njengabaFundi Bezemvelo emsebenzini abazifundele ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Noma ubani ongenawo amaphepha emisebenzi noma owaziwa yikhansela angafaka isicelo. Bahlonishwa ngababambisene nabo ngolwazi abanalo emsebenzini abawukhethile kanye nendima ethile abayidlalile emphakathini wezobuchwepheshe, banolwazi abafundile okungaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi futhi abangabancane ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo somsebenzi abawufakayo. Isixwayiso: uma usushiyile umsebenzi owafundele eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, ngeke uvunyelwe ukubhaliswa ngaphansi kwalo hlelo. Gcwalisa ifomu lokubhaliswa elisemthethweni. Ubufakazi bokufunda esikoleni nasemakhaya - amakhophi ezitifiketi zokufunda ezibhalwe uphiko lwezepolitiki nazo zidingeka kanye nemininingwane efundwe esikoleni, amarekhodi ajulile olwazini oluhambisana nomsebenzi ofundwe, uhlu lwamaphepha noma izincwadi ozibhalele, ubufakazi bokuba yilungu ezinhlelweni zabantu abafundile ezifana neSouth African Food Science Association, noma iSouth African Chemical Society; iSouth African National and Mining Organization. Izibalo ezintathu ozibhalele noma lapho udlale indima ebalulekile ekubhaleni kwazo. Uma ungakwazi ukufaka ezinye izibalo ngenxa yokuthile okuphikisana, kuzodingeka ubufakazi bokuthi uzibhalele. Izifungo ezivela kubantu ababili abangakwazi ukufakazela kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi uyazi kahle lo msebenzi. Ukubhaliswa kungathatha amasonto angu-6 kuya kwangu-8 kuye ngokuthi imibhalo edingekayo igcwele. Abantu ababili abakhethwe yikomidi elinconyiwe kulowo msebenzi bazokubuza imibuzo ephathelene nesicelo sakho. Umphumela wokuhlola kwakho uzokwaziswa ngemuva komhlangano omkhulu wekhansela. Imininingwane yekhompyutha yeBhange nokufaka imali ebhange: Sicela usebenzise amahlamvu okuqala amagama akho nesibongo ukukhombisa ukukhokha kwethu kwi-akhawunti yethu yebhange futhi uhlanganise ubufakazi bokukhokha kanye nekhasi lokuqala lesicelo sakho ku-841 1057.
Ukudoba ukuze ube nokuphila kuyasetshenziswa emiphakathini eduze kolwandle ethembele ekudobeni ukuze kudliwe, noma inelungelo lokuthengisa noma ukushintshanisa lokho ngento ethile. Okwamanje, labo abawudobayo ukuze baphile badinga ukuthola imvume yokudoba kuze kube kube nezinqubomgomo zokudoba ezikhona. Ukuze umuntu adobe ukuze aphile, kumele afake isicelo semvume bese freed to fish for subsistence. Ukuze usebenzise ilungelo lakho lokudoba, faka isicelo sokukhululwa esizokwenziwa ngumenzi wezokuphatha ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi onelayisensi yokwenza lo msebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 18 soMthetho Wokuphila Kwezilwane Zomhlaba we-1998. Ukuze othile akhululwe, kumele athumele isicelo sakhe kwi komidi esiseduzane esibekwe ukwenza lo msebenzi futhi ahlangabezane nezidingo ezichaziwe. Ngokomthetho, akekho ongadoba ukuze aphile ngaphandle kwemvume. Imvume ivuselelwa minyaka yonke, futhi uma ungawuqondi imithetho yokukhululwa ukuze udobe, imvume yakho izophakanyiswa, iphume, noma ilungelo lakho lizokhanselwa. Faka isicelo sokukhululwa ukuze udobe kukomidi eliphethe lo msebenzi eduze kwakho uma imvume yakho iphelelwe isikhathi ekupheleni konyaka. Abafaki bezicelo zemvume kumele bahlangabezane nezidingo ezichaziwe zokudoba ukuze baphile ngaphambi kokuthi banikezwe imvume. Abafaki bezicelo kumele baveze ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lwezinhlanzi abazodoba. Isimo semvume yakho sizohlolwa ngaphambi kokuthi unikezwe imvume yonyaka ozayo; uma kukhona izidingo ezingahlangabezaniwe, uzosuswa ohlwini lwabantu abavunyelwe. Uhlelo kumele luthunyelwe uma umuntu efika eminyakeni yokuthatha umhlalaphansi futhi efuna ukusebenzisa izinzuzo ezihlanganisiwe ngokwezinhlinzeko zomthetho wokuthatha umhlalaphansi. Le ncwadi yokufaka ingathunyelwa yilungu elifuna ukudlulisa izinzuzo zakhona kusuka kufundeni yomhlalaphansi eyodwa iye kwenye. Igama lomfakisicelo, inombolo yezezimali, isitifiketi sokuzalwa, inombolo yokukhombisa, noma enye inombolo ehlukile, uhlobo lwe-oda oluceliwe, isizathu sokucela i-oda yezezimali, ikheli lokuhlala, kanye nekhowudi yeposi yomfakisicelo, kanye nekheli leposi kanye nekhowudi yeposi yomqashi, kanye nemali yonyaka yomfakisicelo kumele kuhanjiswe. Uma inombolo yokubhekisela kwezezimali inganikiwe, nikeza izizathu zokungabhaliswanga. Indlela elula yokufaka isicelo se-oda yezezimali ukwenza lokhu ku-inthanethi kwi-website ye-eFiling. Isicelo sakho se-oda yezezimali ngalendlela ngokuvamile siqinisekiswa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-48. Isicelo se-oda yezezimali ku-inthanethi ngokuvamile siyamukelwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-48. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa.
Noma ubani osebenzisa le webhusayithi kumele alandele futhi avume ukuhamba ngezimo nemigomo yokusebenzisa njengoba kuchaziwe kulokhu kuboniswa komthetho. Uma umsebenzisi engafuni ukuba neqhaza kulezi zimo nemigomo, umsebenzisi akufanele angene kuwebhusayithi, akhombise izinto kuyo, ayisebenzise, noma akhiphe izinto kuyo futhi/noma enze amakhophi noma ahlukanise okuqukethwe kule webhusayithi. Abasebenzisi bangabuka, benze amakhophi, baphonse kumakhompyutha abo, baprinte, futhi bahlukanise okuqukethwe kule webhusayithi, noma ingxenye yayo, ngenhloso yokusebenzisa ulwazi noma ukubhekisela lapho bakutholile kuphela, futhi abavumelekile ukukusebenzisa ukuze bathole inzuzo. Abasebenzisi abafuna ukusebenzisa okuqukethwe kule webhusayithi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo akufanele bakwenze ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe, etholakala kumphathi weWebhu ocingweni: +27 12 314 2140 noma ngokuthumela i-imeyili ku-electronic@gcis.gov.za. Ukukhiqiza nokwenza amakhophi okuqukethwe kuyo noma ingxenye yayo, ngenhloso yezimali kumele kuhambisane nalokhu kuboniswa kwe-copyright ngokuphelele. Wonke amalungelo okuba nefa nokuhlonipha kanye nanoma yimaphi amalungelo okuxhumana koMbuso noma ezinye izikhungo zomthetho mayelana nokuqukethwe kule webhusayithi agcinwe, okusho ukuthi avikelwe. Ulwazi kule webhusayithi luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqukethwe okufundisayo mayelana nesihloko esithile noma izihloko, futhi aluhlinzeki nganoma yiziphi iziqinisekiso mayelana nalesi sihloko. Kungumsebenzisi ukuthi azihlulele ngaphambi kokungena kule webhusayithi, noma le webhusayithi izohlangabezana nezidingo zabo siqu, kanye nokuhambisana nezinsiza zabo zokusebenza noma isoftware. Ulwazi, imibono, nemicabango kule webhusayithi akufanele kuthathwe njengokwelulekwa kochwepheshe, noma njengendawo esemthethweni ye-GCIS, noma nganoma iyiphi enye inhlangano ebhalisiwe ngokomthetho mayelana nolwazi, imibono, noma imicabango ethulwe kule webhusayithi. Abasebenzisi bayakhuthazwa ukuthi baxhumane nochwepheshe ngaphambi kokuthatha noma iyiphi isinyathelo mayelana nolwazi, imibono, noma imicabango ethulwe kule webhusayithi. I-GCIS ayinikezi noma yiziphi izethulo noma iziqinisekiso, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziqondile noma ezingaqondile, ukuthi phakathi kwezinye izinto, okuqukethwe okukhona lapha kanye nobuchwepheshe obutholakalayo kule webhusayithi akukhona amaphutha, kuyakhomba, noma ukuthi insizakalo izophazamiseka futhi itholakale ngo-100%, nokuthi ayinaphutha, noma izohlangabezana nanoma yiziphi izimo ezithile mayelana nokusebenza noma ikhwalithi. Le ndawo inikezwa njengoba ikhona ("as is"). I-GCIS iyakwenqaba wonke ama-akhawunti atholakalayo, kuhlanganise kodwa kungagcini lapho, ama-akhawunti okuthengiswa, ukufaneleka ngenhloso ethile, ukungaphuli amalungelo, ukuhambisana nezokuphepha, nokufaneleka okuqondile noma okungaqondile, futhi ayiqinisekisi okuqukethwe kwewebhusayithi, nokuthi le webhusayithi izohlelwa ngendlela ezohlangabezana nezidingo ezithile zomsebenzisi ngamunye. Umsebenzisi wewebhusayithi wenza lokhu engozini yakhe njengomsebenzisi. Umsebenzisi kumele athwale yonke imithwalo yemfanelo nganoma yiziphi izingozi noma ukulahlekelwa okungase kube khona ngenxa yokusebenzisa okuqukethwe okukhona kule webhusayithi. I-GCIS noma yinoma iyiphi inhlangano ebhalisiwe ngokomthetho mayelana nolwazi olukhona kule webhusayithi, noma abasebenzi be-GCIS noma yinoma iyiphi inhlangano efanayo, ngeke babe nemithwalo yemfanelo nganoma yiziphi izinkinga, ezingaqondile, noma eziphumelelayo, noma nganoma yiziphi ezinye izinkinga noma ezimangalisayo, noma ezinye izicelo ezihlobene nokusebenzisa lo mbhalo noma ulwazi. Uma kukhona umthetho otholakala ungasebenzi nganoma yisiphi isizathu, imithetho esele izoqhubeka isebenza. Ngokuhambisana nezigaba 43 no-43 zeMthetho Wokuxhumana Ngezokuxhumana Nezokuthengiselana 25 ka-2002 (umthetho wezokuxhumana nokusebenzisa izinqubo zedijithali), i-GCIS ngeke ibe nemithwalo yemfanelo nganoma yiziphi izinkinga, ukulahlekelwa, noma izicelo zokuhlukumeza ezivela ekusebenziseni noma ekungakwazi ukusebenzisa le webhusayithi, noma izinsizakalo (izinsizakalo), noma okuqukethwe kwewebhusayithi. I-GCIS igcina amazinga afanele obuchwepheshe nezinqubo zokuphepha ukuze ivikele yonke imininingwane enikezwe ngabasebenzisi ekulahlekelweni, ekusetshenzisweni kabi, ekuhlelweni kabusha, noma ekuchithweni. Zonke izinyathelo ezivumelekile zizothathwa ukuze kuvikelwe ulwazi lomsebenzisi. Abasebenzi abavunyelwe abaphatha ulwazi oluyimfihlo enikeziwe kumele bagcine imfihlo yalolo lwazi. Le nqubomgomo isebenza kubo bonke abasebenzi be-GCIS noma izikhungo zikamasipala ezithola ulwazi oluvela ku-GCIS. Kwenziwa umthetho ophikisana nalokho ukuthi noma ubani, ibhizinisi, inhlangano, akavunyelwe ukuthola noma ukuzama ukuthola ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe kunoma iyiphi ikhasi kule webhusayithi, noma ukufaka noma ukuzama ukufaka noma iyiphi ikhodi engagunyaziwe, eyingozi, noma enobungozi kule webhusayithi. Uma umuntu efaka noma ezama ukufaka ikhodi engagunyaziwe, eyingozi, noma enobungozi kule webhusayithi, noma ezama ukuthola ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe kunoma iyiphi ikhasi, lowo muntu uzoba nemithwalo yemfanelo yokwephula umthetho, futhi uma i-GCIS noma iyiphi ingxenye yomphakathi ibhujiswa nganoma iyiphi indlela, bazovula icala lokulahlekelwa. Siyacacisa ukuthi abanye abantu besithathu bangase baxhumanise nolwazi olunikeziwe kulezi zikhasi. Lokhu kungasiza ekuxhumaneni nezinye amawebhusayithi njengokuthokozisa, futhi noma yisiphi isixhumanisi esinjalo asisho ukuthi i-GCIS ivuma lezi zindawo zewebhu. Amawebhusayithi axhunyiwe noma amakhasi awaphansi kokulawulwa kwe-GCIS. I-GCIS ayinayo imithwalo yemfanelo noma imithwalo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi iqondile noma engaqondile, nganoma iyiphi indlela mayelana nokuqukethwe, ukusetshenziswa, noma ukungakwazi ukusebenzisa noma ukuthola noma amawebhusayithi axhunyiwe, noma noma yiziphi izixhumanisi ezitholakala kumawebhusayithi axhunyiwe. Isitatimende sokuvikela sihamba ne-GCIS nanoma iyiphi inhlangano ebhalisiwe ngokomthetho ethinta, iqinisekisa, noma isebenzisa ulwazi olungase luhlanganiswe kule webhusayithi. Noma i-GCIS ingase ihlinzeke ngemininingwane yomsebenzisi kulabo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezenzakalayo, ngeke ihlinzeke abantu besithathu ngemininingwane, noma ezinye izikhungo zikamasipala ukuze zisetshenziswe kwezinye izinjongo noma ezihlobene, ngaphandle kokuthi lokho kube kucacisiwe ngesikhathi sokuxhumana. Ulwazi lomuntu siqu lungadluliselwa ezikhungweni zomhlaba jikelele yi-GCIS noma kubantu besithathu ngenhloso ezingenhla. Lokhu ngeke kufake ukudluliselwa ezweni okungekho emthethweni okungakaze kube nemithetho yokuvikela idatha efanele efana naleyo ekhona ezweni lapho umsebenzisi ehlala khona. Ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ku-GCIS
UMnyango Wezolimo ubheka amasampula ezithombo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ahlanzekile, akhule kahle, futhi angakwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhula. Zonke izithombo, kokubili ezithengiswayo kanye neziqinisekiswe, zihlolwa. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokukhetha ngokucophelela noma yiziphi izithombo eziphawulwe njengezinkinga. Amasampula azohlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ahambisana noMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezitshalo, ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi izithombo zihlanzekile futhi ukuthi zizokhula kahle. Abahloli bayaziswa ngemiphumela. Uma imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi izithombo azihambisani nomthetho, zingasuswa emakethe ukuze zingathengiswa noma zifakwe uphawu. Njengoba le nqubo yokuhlola izithombo yenziwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho kazwelonke, ayikhokhiswa. Nokho, uma umuntu ophuma endaweni lapho kuthathwe khona isampula efuna imiphumela yokuhlola ngendlela yeSikhumbuzo Sokuhlola Izithombo, kufanele kube nesikhwama esiqinisekiswe nguMnyango Wezezimali okumele sikhokhwe. Kuzokwenziwa i-invoyisi. Khumbula ukufaka inombolo yokukhokha ukuze ihambisane ne-invoyisi ekhishwe. Isiteshi esisemthethweni sokuhlola izithombo sisebenzisa inqubo ehlinzeka ngezidingo ezibalulekile nezidingekayo zokuhlola. Njengoba izitshalo ezahlukene zinezimfuno ezahlukene zokuhlola, isikhathi sokuhlola singathatha ezinsukwini ezimbalwa kuya ezinsukwini eziningi. Uma unemibuzo mayelana nenqubo uqobo. Le nkonzo iyatholakala mahhala. Azikho ifomu okufanele zigcwaliswe.
Ungabika ezinye izikhalazo eziphathelene nokuhlolwa kwezimpande noma izingxabano ezihlobene nokwaziswa kwezimpande, kodwa kufanele uqale uxhumane ne-OSTS ukuze ubone ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obudingekayo bukhona yini ukuze uhlobo lokuhlolwa nolwabiwo lwezimpande. Le nsizakalo itholakala kumuntu, inhlangano, isikhungo, inkampani, noma umbulali. Uma ufuna ukufaka isikhalazo noma ingxabano mayelana nokwaziswa kwezimpande, thumela incwadi kanye nesampula yezimpande bese uchaza kahle lonke ulwazi oluphakathi kwesikhalazo noma ingxabano. Faka imininingwane yokuhlolwa okwenziwe ezinye izikhungo zokuhlola izimpande. Uma isikhalazo sikhombisa ukuba semthethweni, isibonelo, uma ukwaziwa kwezimpande kungahambisani nemigomo yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwez植物, 1976, akukho zindleko. Uma isikhalazo singekho emthethweni futhi singafaneleki, kuzodingeka ukukhokha imali yokuhlola izimpande eyabekwa yiMali Kazwelonke, futhi kuzokwenziwa i-invoyisi. Ukukhokha kungenziwa ngocingo noma ngokudlulisela emabhange, kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenombolo ye-invoyisi ukuze bakwazi ukuhambisa ukukhokha ne-invoyisi ekhishwe. I-OSTS ihlinzeka ngokuqhuba ukuhlolwa kokuqala kwezampula zezimpande lapho kukhona ingxabano noma izimo zomthetho zingalandelwanga. Ubukhulu bengxabano noma isikhalazo, isibonelo, inani lezampula, uhlobo lwezimbali, kanye nohlobo lokuhlolwa oludingekayo, kuthinta isikhathi esizothatha ukuhlola. Ulwazi mayelana nezindinganiso zokuhlola ngeke lunikezwe. Buza ngqo kule ndawo. Le nsizakalo iyamahala uma isikhalazo singekho emthethweni. Nokho, uma isikhalazo sithathwa njengesingafaneleki, kuzodingeka ukukhokha imali yokuhlola ezimpande efanele, ngokuhambisana nesimo nezimo.
Uhlelo Lokuphakamisa Ababhekene Nezingozi lukhuthaza ukusungulwa nokuhleleka kwezimiso kanye nokubambisana phakathi kweminyango ehlukene kahulumeni noma izinhlelo zezigaba ezahlukene kanye nezinqubomgomo zokweseka, ukuvikela nokuphakamisa ababhekene nezingozi zokudlwengulwa nokuhlukunyezwa. I-VEP igxile kakhulu kwabantu besifazane nasezinganeni. Ababhekene nokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya ezimeni eziphuthumayo bangahlala endaweni yokuhlala isikhathi esiphakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili nezinyanga eziyisithupha, kuye ngemicimbi yabo. Lolu hlelo lutholakala kubabhekene nezingozi zokudlwengulwa nokuhlukunyezwa. Xhumana nanoma yisiphi isikhungo sokweseka ababhekene nezingozi mayelana nendawo yokuhlala yabesifazane nezingane ezihlukunyezwayo, ukuze uthole abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zikahulumeni noma izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni (NGOs) ezibhekene nokunakekela ababhekene nokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya. Umeluleki ohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo, ilungu leMnyango Wezokuphepha Kwamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika (SAPS), noma uphoyisa, umphakathi, uthisha, noma omunye umuntu ophathelene nezidingo zababikeli angasiza ekufakeni isicelo sokuvikela. Qinisekisa ukuthi uma umuntu ongumbhikishi efaka isicelo sokuvikela, kukhona incwadi yokuvuma ebhalwe ngumshushisi ehambisana nesicelo. Ayikho ifomu ethile edingekayo ukuze uthole le mvume - incwadi ebhalwe ngumshushisi evuma imvume iyanele. Umntwana noma umuntu onengqondo engasebenzi kahle uyakhululeka noma uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi lowo muntu akakwazi ukuvuma ngokwabo noma ukuhlinzeka ngovume. Isikhathi esidingekayo sokulungiselela isicelo sokuvikela siyahluka kuye ngenkantolo kanye nenkantolo ethile kodwa sithinteka esikhathini sokuthi udaba lokuvikela luzokwenziwa nini enkantolo. Le nsizakalo iyamahala futhi ayikhokhiswa.
Umphakathi ungumuntu owawulwa empini yeMpi Yezwe Yokuqala noma yeMpi Yezwe Yesibili noma owawulwa empini yaseKorea. Labo abathola usizo lwezenhlalakahle, abangakwazi ukuzinakekela futhi badinga ukunakekelwa ngaso sonke isikhathi, bangafaka isicelo sosizo olungaphezu kwalolo lwezenhlalakahle. Imali yokusiza abadala abavela ku-2008 kuyi-R960 ngenyanga. Kufanele uhlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola isimo sezimali. Ukuhlola isimo sezimali kwabantu abahlala ekhaya kuwukuthi uhulumeni uhla izimo zezimali zalowo mndeni. Ukuze uthole usizo, imali yakho kufanele ibe phansi kwenani elithile. Ngo-2008, ukuhlola kwezimali kokusiza abadala abavela kumuntu ongashadile kwakhomba ukuthi uma impahla yakho ibalwe ngaphezulu kwe-R451,200, awuzotholi usizo. Umndeni ophila kuwo awubalwa uma kuhlolwa, futhi imali yakho kufanele ibe phansi kwe-R26,928 ngonyaka uma ungashadile. Uma ushade, awuzotholi usizo uma impahla yenu ihlanganiswe ibalwe ngaphezulu kwe-R902,400. Umndeni ophila kuwo awubalwa uma kuhlolwa. Imali yenu ehambisanayo kufanele ibe phansi kwe-R53,856 ngonyaka. Awukwazi ukuba omunye walabo abahlala ezindlini zikahulumeni futhi awukwazi ukuba omunye walabo abathola usizo lwezimali ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Icheki yenani elithile ngosuku oluthile efakwe ku-akhawunti yomuntu siqu ingatholakala ngeposi ezindaweni ezithile, njengasezindaweni lapho abantu abadala behlala khona. Uma ungasebenzi kahle noma ugula kakhulu futhi ungakwazi ukuhamba ehhovisi, cela omunye umuntu ukuba acela ukuthi ihhovisi likuvakashele. Lo muntu kufanele aze neposi elivela kuwe noma iposi elivela kudokotela elikhombisa ukuthi awukwazi ukuza ehhovisi ngoba ugula. Izinhlelo zingahlelwa ukuze bavakashele. Thumela ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo elandelayo: ubufakazi bokuthi wakhonza emkhosini bungaba isiqinisekiso somkhosi noma amarekhodi omkhosi. I-affidavit eqinisekiswe yilungu elihloniphekile lomphakathi elaziwa umfakisicelo. Uma ungashadile, isitatimende sokuthi ungashadile; uma ushade, isiqinisekiso somshado; uma uhlukaniswe nomkakho, isiqinisekiso sokuhlukaniswa; uma umkakho eshonile, isiqinisekiso sokufa. Uma usemsebenzini, iphephandaba; uma ungasebenzi, incwadi eluhlaza ekhombisa ukuthi awusebenzi noma isiqinisekiso sokupheliswa emsebenzini wakho wangaphambilini uma unepenshini yangasese, ubufakazi balo msebenzi; uma unayo i-akhawunti yasebhange, isitatimende seminyaka emithathu elandelanayo uma kukhona lapho ufake khona imali, ulwazi ngenzalo yakho ku-imeyili yakho noma isabelo sayo. Thola i-receipt futhi uyigcine njengobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo. Uzokwaziswa ngeposi ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele noma cha. Uma isicelo sakho sikhanseliwe, ihhovisi lezokuphepha kwezenhlalakahle izokubhalela incwadi echaza izizathu zokukhansela isicelo sakho. Uma ungavumelani nesinqumo sabo, ungafaka isikhalazo kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezokuhlala noma ilungu lekhansela echaza ukuthi kungani ungavumelani nesinqumo sabo. Isikhalazo kufanele sithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 ngemuva kokuthola impendulo yesicelo sakho. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-21 ukuze processing yesicelo sakho. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uzokhokhelwa kusukela ngosuku olufake isicelo. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhelwa.
Izinsizakalo zomphakathi yizinsizakalo eziyisisekelo ezikhululekile ezinikezwa uhulumeni ezindaweni ezihluphekayo ngaphandle kwentela. Lezi zinsizakalo zihlanganisa amanzi, ugesi, ukuhlinzekwa kwezokuhlanzeka, nokulahla udoti. Lezi zinsizakalo zinikezwa yizifunda futhi zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa okuyisisekelo kogesi, amanzi, nokuhlanzeka okwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo eziyisisekelo zezindlu ezihluphekayo. Nokho, imithetho elawula ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlanzeka nokulahla udoti ayikakagcwalisiwe yizigaba ezifanele zikahulumeni, okungukuthi uMnyango Wamanzi Nezinkuni, uMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha. Ukuhlinzekwa kwamahhala kwamanzi okuyisisekelo kuyi-volumu ye-6kl yamanzi ngenyanga ngendlu. Le volumu ingahluka ukusuka kwisifunda ukuya kwesifunda, futhi kufanele uxhumane nesifunda sakho ngqo ukuze uthole ukuthi yisiphi isikhungo samanzi samahhala esitholakalayo esifundeni sakho. Kufanele ukhokhe nganoma yisiphi amanzi owasebenzisayo ngaphezu kwe-volumu eyabelwe mahhala. Abasebenzisi bezikhala zogesi ezikhokhelwayo abangakasebenzisi ugesi wabo bazokwazi ukubona lapho ugesi usuphela, futhi kuzodingeka baxhumane nomunye umuntu. Abasebenzisi begesi abakhipha imali ekupheleni kwenyanga noma labo abasebenzisa okuthiwa ama-meter e-credits ngeke bakwazi ukubona lapho sebesebenzisile wonke amayunithi abo. Bakhokhelwa ngokusebenzisa okuningi ekupheleni kwenyanga ngayinye. Abasebenzisi begesi abangenayo amandla agridi bangahlinzekwa ngamandla angaphandle kwegridi yisifunda sabo. Kufanele uxhumane nesifunda sakho ukuze uthole ukuthi yisiphi ugesi osebenzisa. Ukuze uthole ukuhlinzekwa kogesi namanzi ekhaya lakho noma ebhizinisini, xhumana nesifunda sakho, lapho ikhaya lakho noma ibhizinisi lakho likhona. Ezindaweni ezithile, umhlinzeki wegesi kazwelonke, i-ESKOM, uhlinzeka ngogesi ngqo. Uhulumeni akak started ukuqaliswa kohlelo lokuhlanzeka mahhala. UMnyango Wamanzi usungule uhlaka lokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlanzeka zamahhala. Uma inqubomgomo igcwaliswa, ohulumeni bendawo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhlanzeka bazokwazi ukuqaliswa kwalolu hlelo. Uhulumeni akak started ukuqaliswa kohlelo lokulahla udoti mahhala. UMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha usungule uhlaka lokulahla udoti mahhala. Uma inqubomgomo igcwaliswa, ohulumeni bendawo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokulahla udoti bazokwazi ukuqaliswa kwalolu hlelo. Ukukhokha ama-akhawunti ngaphambi kokusebenzisa ugesi ukuthenga amayunithi ngemali yakho kusho ukuthi uzosebenzisa kuphela amayunithi owakhokhile noma owathengile. Uma ususebenzisile wonke amayunithi akho futhi usafuna amanye, kuzodingeka uthenge amanye. Ama-akhawunti athola izitatimende ngemuva kokusetshenziswa kusho ukuthi ungasebenzisa noma yiliphi inani legesi namanzi. Isifunda sakho sizokuthumelela isitatimende senyanga yonke esikhombisa inani legesi noma amanzi owasebenzisile kanye nenani okufanele ukhokhe. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo. Khokha imali yesicelo ebekiwe. Isicelo sakho sokwesekwa kwabantu abahluphekayo sizophathwa kusukela ngosuku olufaka isicelo sakho. Isicelo sakho sizohlolwa, futhi kuzokwenziwa isinqumo sokuthi uyafaneleka yini ngezinsizakalo eziyisisekelo zamahhala noma cha. Ngokusho kwemigomo yesifunda sakho, uzobhaliswa ukuze ufaneleke ngezinsizakalo zamahhala ngaphansi kohlelo olubizwa ngokuthi Izinsizakalo Eziyisisekelo Zamahhala, bese uthola ukwesekwa okufanele. Amanzi: Ama-6,000 amalitha wamanzi okuqala ngenyanga ngendlu ahlinzekwa mahhala, kanti noma yiziphi amalitha angeziwe ngaphezulu kwalokho akhokhelwa ngentengo ebekiwe yisifunda. Amafomu okweseka abantu abahluphekayo. Izifunda eziningi zinefomu lesicelo. Buza isifunda sakho ngohlelo lokwesekwa kwabantu abahluphekayo.
Le yindawo yokubika ubugebengu esebenza amahora angama-24, ebhekene nezikhalazo nezikhalazo ezivela emphakathini. Ungashaya ucingo usebenzisa umugqa we-Telkom noma ngefoni ephathekayo. Zonke izingcingo ezingenayo kule ndawo zirekhodwa. Qaphela: Shaya le nombolo kuphela uma kukhona isimo esiphuthumayo. Lokhu kuvimba izingcingo ezivela kubantu abaphakathi kwezimo ezingezinhle nezingozi, kanye nalabo abadinga usizo lwezepolitiki ngokuphuthumayo. Lokhu kuchitha isikhathi samaphoyisa ngoba abaphathi badinga ukuthatha imoto noma balinde endaweni lapho kubikwa ubugebengu, futhi lokhu kuholela nezindleko ngoba abaphathi bangathunyelwa endaweni lapho kungelona isimo esiphuthumayo. Uma unokukhala okungaphuthumayo noma ufuna nje ukubuza imibuzo ngendlela ejwayelekile, shaya isiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo yakho. Shaya inombolo: 10111 noma ngabe uphi eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi luqoqwa futhi unikezwa inombolo yokubhekisela njengobufakazi nokusetshenziswa kwesikhathi esizayo. Zonke izingcingo ziphendulwa ngokushesha njengoba zifika. Azikho ifomu okufanele ugcwalise.
Faka isicelo ngokwezidingo zakho! Ubani ongafaka isicelo sezidingo? Noma ubani ngaphandle kwezinkampani ezibhaliswe ngokuqondile emthethweni kanye nezinhlangano. Umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 kumele asizwe ngumzali wakhe noma umgibeli ofanele. Ubani ongafunwa ngezidingo? Ngaphandle kukahulumeni, noma ubani angafunwa kuhlanganise nezinkampani, izinhlangano, imiphakathi, kanye nanoma yini esebenza endaweni ephethwe yilelo qembu. Yimalini engaphezulu kokuthi ingafunwa? Imali engaphezu kuka-R7000. Uma izidingo zakho zidlula u-R7000, ungafaka izicelo zemali engaphansi kwalokho ukuze isicelo sakho samukelwe enkantolo yezicelo ezincane. Yiziphi izimangalo ezingathathwa kule nkantolo? Izicelo zemali ezidlula u-R7000. Izicelo eziphikisana nohulumeni. Izicelo ezihlobene nesimo sokucabanga somuntu. Izicelo ezicela isenzo esithile esingavumeli ukukhokhelwa, ngaphandle kwezimo ezihilela ukudluliswa kwezinsiza noma impahla ezinzile noma ezihambayo ezidlula u-R7000 ngenani. Ingabe udinga ukufaka enkantolo yezicelo ezincane? Cha, ungakhetha ukuthi ufuna ukufaka enkantolo yezicelo ezincane noma enye inkantolo engakwazi ukulalela icala lakho. Ukuze uthole ummeli kanye nosizo lwabo ekulungiseleleni isicelo. Awuvunyelwe ukuba umelwe ummeli ojwayelekile noma omdala. Nokho, ngentengo yakho, ungacela iseluleko kumemeli ngaphambi kokuthi uqhubeke. Abasebenzi benkantolo kanye nosizo lwezomthetho enkantolo yezicelo ezincane bangakusiza ngaphandle kokukhokha. Noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika lungasetshenziswa kule nkantolo. Kumele uhambisane kusenesikhathi nomlomo wenkantolo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona umhumushi uma ubufakazi buzokhulumelwa ngolimi olungaqondakali kahle komunye wabantu abathintekayo. Xwayisa umphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa naye isicelo) ngqo, ngocingo, noma ngencwadi, ubacela ukuthi banelise izidingo zakho. Uma umphikisi engaphenduli esicelweni sakho, bhala incwadi yokufunwa (echaza zonke izimo zokufunwa, kuhlanganise nenani lezidingo zakho) ubanikeze ezinsukwini eziyi-14 kusukela ngosuku abathola ngalo incwadi yokufunwa ukuze banelise izidingo zakho. Thumela incwadi yokufunwa kumphikisi (umuntu ophikiswa naye isicelo) ngesandla noma ngeposi ebhalisiwe. Ngemva kwezinsuku eziyi-14, kumele uye ngqo kumlomo wenkantolo ulethe ubufakazi bokuthi uthumele incwadi yokufunwa kumphikisi. Noma iyiphi incwadi yokuvumelana noma ukuqinisekiswa kwezimo zokufunwa kwakho. Igama eliphelele kanye nekheli (ikhaya, kanye nekheli lomsebenzi, uma likhona) kanye nenombolo yocingo yomphikisi. Bona kanye nosizo lwabo lwezomthetho bazobuyekeza imibhalo onayo futhi bakusize ekubhaleni isikhumbuzo esilula. Uzobhala isikhumbuzo abasinikezayo. Yini okufanele uyenze ngesikhumbuzo? Ungasithumela ngesandla kumphikisi. Ungaphinde unikeze isikhumbuzo kumshushisi (umuntu) lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, ukuze umshushisi akwazi ukusithumela kumphikisi. Yini okufanele uyenze ngokulandelayo? Uma usithumele kumshushisi, kumele uthole ubufakazi bokuthi wenze kanjalo ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela. Gcina incwadi yokuvumelana noma noma iyiphi incwadi eqinisekisa izimo zesikhumbuzo osenzayo. Xwayisa abafakizolo bakho ngalesi sikhathi nosuku lokulalela bese uhlela ukuba babe khona enkantolo ngaleso sikhathi esishiwo. Bangase basebenze ekwenzeni izidingo zomfaki-sicelo. Bangathumela isitatimende esibhalwe phansi kumlomo wenkantolo, esiqukethe imininingwane nezimo zokuzivikela kwabo, bese bethumela ikhophi kumfaki-sicelo. Bangafaka izicelo zabo zokuphikisa ngokuletha isitatimende esiqukethe imininingwane edingekayo yesikhumbuzo kumlomo wenkantolo. Uma kukhona izicelo zokuphikisa noma izicelo zokuphikisa, icala kufanele liqhubeke nokulalela. Yini okufanele uyenze uma umphikisi ebelise izidingo zakho? Xwayisa ummemezeli wenkantolo ngokushesha ukuthi izidingo zakho zanelisiwe futhi ukuthi awusoze uqhubeke nalesi sihloko. Yini okufanele uyenze ngosuku nosuku lokulalela? Kumele uvele enkantolo uqobo. Inqubo yokulalela ayisemthethweni futhi ilula. Umphakathi wenkantolo uzokubuza ukuthi uveze icala lakho. Bika icala ngamagama akho ngokucacile nangokunembile. Awuvunyelwe ukubuza imibuzo phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, ngemvume yomphakathi, ungabuza imibuzo embalwa kumphikisi. Lalela kahle umphikisi uma echaza, futhi uma ucabanga ukuthi abakhulumi kahle, qaphela noma yiziphi izingxenye ukuze uzilethele emqondweni womphakathi. Uma umphakathi esekhulume ngalokho okukhuluma wena nomphikisi kanye nabafakizolo abangase babe khona, inkantolo izokhipha isinqumo. Umphakathi angase akwazise ukuthi uzokuthumelela isinqumo sabo ngokubhala kamuva. Akekho ophikisa isinqumo noma umyalo wenkantolo. Ukuphathwa kwalolo cala kubalulekile kakhulu. Isinqumo senkantolo siyi-final, ngaphandle uma kukhona isizathu esivumelekile sokuphikisa. Khokha noma yiziphi izindleko ezibekwe yinkantolo kuwe. Izindleko ezingaba khona yilezo umphaki-sicelo angazithola ngokukhokha umshushisi. Landela isinqumo senkantolo. Umphikisi uzokhokha inani lesinqumo kuwe ngokushesha uma enalo. Mnika i-receipt yalolo nani ngokushesha. Uma umphikisi engakwazi ukuhambisana nesinqumo senkantolo ngokushesha, inkantolo izobuza ngesimo sabo sezimali nokuthi bangakukhokhela yini mayelana nesinqumo nezindleko futhi izokhipha isinqumo ngalokho. Uma umphikisi othole icala engahambisani nesinqumo noma isinqumo senkantolo yezicelo ezincane futhi ufuna ukuqhubekisela phambili leso sinqumo, icala lidluliselwa enkantolo ye-magistrate, futhi lizolalelwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wenkantolo YamaMagistrate, 1944 (Umthetho 32 ka-1944). Kubalulekile ukuthola ummeli ukuze ulalelwe kwalolu cala. Le pamphlet ikwazisa ngezinyathelo ezibalulekile okufanele zilandelwe mayelana nokufaka isicelo enkantolo yezicelo ezincane. Uma udinga usizo nganoma yini, ikheli nenombolo yocingo yomlomo wenkantolo yezicelo ezincane zitholakala enkantolo yakho yendawo ye-magistrate. Umnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo.
Yini eyenzeka uma kuphulwa i-Protection Order? Uma umphenduli ephula i-Protection Order ngokuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba noma ngemicabango njengoba kuchaziwe ekuqaleni kwalolu documet, ungafaka isikhalazo esiteshini samaphoyisa bese unikeza i-Warrant of Arrest kumaphoyisa azomgibisela umphenduli. Isinqumo sokusebenzisa i-Warrant of Arrest ngemuva kokuphulwa kwe-Order sikhulu sethu ngokuphelele. Ngemuva kokuboshwa, umphenduli uzobhekana nezinsolo zobugebengu futhi uzobekwa icala eNkantolo yezeMpi Yasekhaya ngokuphula i-Protection Order. Ungafaka isicelo sokuthi i-oda yakho ibuyiswe noma nini, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi ubonge ukuthi i-Order kufanele ibuyiswe noma cha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-Protection Order izobhekwa njengengasebenzi. Umthetho we-Domestic Violence Act 116 ka-1998 uvumela osizayo wezeMpi Yasekhaya noma ukuhlukunyezwa ukuthi afune i-Protection Order eNkantolo yeMagistrate ngokumelene nomhlukunyezwa. Inhloso yale Ndlela ukuhlinzeka osizayo ngemininingwane abayidingayo ukuze bafake isicelo se-Protection Order ngokuhambisana noMthetho wezeMpi Yasekhaya. Bobabili abesifazane nabesilisa bangaba osizayo futhi bangaba nabahlukunyezwa ezimweni zezeMpi Yasekhaya. Nokho, ngenhloso yale Ndlela, sigxile ekuhlukunyezweni kwabesifazane ngoba lokhu kuyinto evamile kakhulu. Umuntu obambisene nawe ngesithembiso somshado, ubudlelwano bendabuko, noma ubudlelwano obungajwayelekile, okubandakanya ubudlelwano bokuthandana obuqinile noma obungaqondakali, angaba ngumhlukunyezwa. Le ndaba ingabambezela kwenye usuku ukuze kubonakale enkantolo. Umphakathi uzokweseka noma ukukuhola kumuntu ozokwenza ukukubhalela impendulo. Ngosuku lokuhlolwa, umphakathi uzozama ukwenza isinqumo ngokusekelwe kuma-Affidavit abhalwe yizigaba zombili. Umphakathi ungacela omunye wenu noma bobabili ukuba bahlaziye ngezindaba ezithile. Umphakathi ungase uthathe isinqumo sokuvuma i-Order noma ukuyibuyisa futhi ungase ucele ukuthi ubufakazi bukhulunywe. Khumbula ukuthi ngokweMthetho, amaphoyisa kumele akusize nganoma iyiphi indlela echazwe kwi-Protection Order, ngokwesibonelo, ekutholeni izinto zakho, imibhalo yakho yokuzazisa, imibhalo yezingane noma izinto, njll. Uma uthola ukuthi amaphoyisa awasizi noma aphika ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwe-Order, ungabika lokhu kwi-Independent Police Investigative Directorate. Ingabe umphenduli uzoboshwa nge-Protection Order? Umphenduli ngeke aboshwe uma ethola i-Protection Order. Yini ukuphulwa kwe-Protection Order? Yini i-Contempt of Court? Lokhu kwenzeka uma umphenduli engahambisani ne-Order noma engaveli eNkantolo yezeMpi ukuze aphendule ezinsolweni ezimelene naye. Ungafaka kanjani isicelo se-Protection Order? Ikunikeza i-Order noma cha. Izinsiza abangakweluleka ngazo mayelana nalokhu zikhona ekuqaleni kwale Ndlela. Umphakathi uzokweseka ekugcwaliseni amafomu adingekayo nokuwafaka phambi komphakathi. Yikuphi ukwahlulela okufanele ngiye kukho? Yiya enkantolo eseduze nalapho uhlala noma usebenza khona. Uma uphumelelwe ukuba ushiye ikhaya lakho ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa futhi okwamanje uhlala kwenye indawo, ungaya enkantolo eseduze nalapho uhlala khona okwamanje. Yini ezokuthi i-Protection Order yesikhashana? I-Protection Order yesikhashana izocela umphenduli (umhlukunyezwa) ukuthi angakuhlukumezi ngendlela echazwe kwi-Affidavit yakho. Ezimweni ezinzima kakhulu, umphakathi ungathola ukuthi kubalulekile ukuvuma umphenduli ukuthi ahambe ekhaya ababelana ngalo noma ukuvikela ukuba angangeni ezindaweni ezithile zendawo ophila kuyo. Uma izingane zihlukunyezwa kulokhu, umphakathi ungase ube nesinqumo sokuthi umphenduli angaboni izingane nhlobo noma okwesikhashana kuphela. Umphakathi ungakwenza isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali oluphuthumayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma udinga ukufaka isicelo sezezimali zezokwelapha noma izindleko zokuhlala ezihlobene ngqo nokuhlukunyezwa, kufanele uhlinzeke ngobufakazi bezindleko ezitholiwe bese uceli umphakathi ukuthi ucabangele lesi sicelo. Ungase futhi ube nezinsolo zokuphila kwakho nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ukuze ucabange kahle ngohlobo oluthile lokuhlukunyezwa okwenziwa kuwe, umphakathi usebenzisa i-Affidavit owakwenze ngesikhathi ufaka isicelo sakho. Ngiyenzenjani nge-Temporary Protection Order? I-Temporary Protection Order kumele ihanjiswe kumphenduli (umhlukunyezwa) ngokushesha okukhulu. Awukwazi ukuya uqobo ukuhlinzeka umphenduli nge-Protection Order njengoba lokhu kungaba yindlela engalungile yokwenza inqubo yomthetho. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuhlinzeka nge-Temporary Protection Order kuyisibopho somunye umuntu esikhundleni sokuba kube umthetho othi amaphoyisa. Kumele uhlinzeke i-Temporary Protection Order ehhovisi le-Sheriff noma esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze nendlu noma indawo yokusebenza yomphenduli. Esiteshini samaphoyisa, uyacelwa ukuthi ukhumbule ukubhala phansi igama nokuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yomphakathi ophakamisa i-Order. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukulandela i-Order esikhathini esizayo. Iziteshi zamaphoyisa eziningi zine-ofisa ethile yokuphatha izindaba zezeMpi Yasekhaya. Hlela namaphoyisa ukuze uthole i-Return of Service (Ubufakazi bokuhlinzeka). Lokhu kuyobufakazi bokuthi i-Protection Order ihanjiswe kumphenduli futhi ukuthi umuntu wamukela yona uqobo. Awukwazi期待 amaphoyisa ukuba athumele noma athumele i-Return of Service enkantolo ngoba lokhu kuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu futhi akufiki enkantolo ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyisa.

Lo mbhalo uveza uhlaka lwezombusazwe lokuphathwa kwezinhlelo zokwahlulela zendabuko ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Ugwema umbono nezinhlelo zohlaka lwezombusazwe, kuhlanganisa ukukhuthazwa kwezindinganiso zamasiko ezikhuthaza ukuxhumana komphakathi, ukuthula, nokuphila ndawonye. Uxoxa ngendima yobuholi bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika kanye nesidingo sokuba nomfanekiso ofanele wobuholi ngesikhathi esisha sokudemokhrasi. Lo mbhalo ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuqinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwezindinganiso zomthetho ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezomthetho lwendabuko kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezifanele zokwenza kube lula izindima nemisebenzi yobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kokwahlulela.
Lo msebenzi wokukhwabanisa uqala ngumphefumulo ophula umthetho ngokuxhumana nenkampani ethile ngokuthumela ifeksi, incwadi, noma i-imeyili. Kwenziwa isiphakamiso sebusiness, esenziwa iqembu labakhwabanisi abenza sengathi bangabasebenzi bakamasipala. Abakhwabanisi benza amanga bethi banebhajethi enkulu kakhulu, ngokuvamile bethi ikhuluma ngamaRandi aseMelika. Isiphakamiso sebusiness ngokuvamile sichaza ukuthi banemali enkulu kakhulu abafuna ukuyithumela ngaphandle kwelizwe labo bese beyifaka kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yangaphandle. Umuntu othola le ncwadi uvame ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi uma esiza, uzothola ikhomishini engu-20% kuya ku-35% yemali ezothunyelwa ebhange ngokuvuma ukusebenzisa i-akhawunti yabo yasebhange. Labo abavuma ukuhwebelana nabo uvame ukufunwa ukuthi bafake imali kwi-akhawunti ethile yasebhange ukuze basize ukukhokhela izindleko zokuthumela le mali. Uma sebekhokhe le mali, uvame ukuvezwa ukuthi kukhona "ukuphazamiseka," ngakho-ke kumele bafake enye imali. Imihlangano ivame ukuhlelwa nalowo muntu kwezinye izindawo, futhi uma lowo muntu ese kulowo mhlaba, ipasipoti yakhe iyathathwa, futhi baphoselwa emaphoyiseni ukuze bahlele ukufaka enye imali kwi-akhawunti yabakhwabanisi. Amakhasi angamanga angasetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yasebhange, kuthunyelwa imali kwi-akhawunti yomuntu ophoswe emaphoyiseni iye kwi-akhawunti yabakhwabanisi. Ukukhwabanisa kokuziphindisela kuvame ukuqala ngumphefumulo ophula umthetho ngokuxhumana nabantu bonke, ngokuvamile besebenzisa i-imeyili. Umphakathi ophula umthetho uvame ukuveza ukuthi ungumsebenzi omele inkampani ye-Lottery, futhi ubonisa umuntu ukuthi uwine imali ye-lottery, noma ngabe lowo muntu akathenganga ithikithi le-lottery. Banikeza izinombolo eziphumelelayo ezincwadini abazibhala, noma ngabe inkampani ye-Lottery abakhwabanisi abathi basebenza kuyo iyatholakala, izinombolo abakhwabanisi abazinikeza ngempela yizibalo eziphumelelayo, lokhu kuyinkohlakalo yokuziphindisela. Lezi zindlela zokukhwabanisa zisetshenziswa kumakhwabanisi ka-419 ukuze zibe nomthelela emalini yabanjwa. Ukuze uthole eminye imininingwane ngale nkohlakalo yokuziphindisela, ungayithola kuwebhusayithi yePhoyisa laseNingizimu Afrika, futhi kukhona izindlela abakhwabanisi abenza ngazo, uhlelo lwabo, ukuze bakhweze abantu emalini yabo, nezindlela zokuvikela ezitholakalayo. Ukuze uthole imininingwane eningiliziwe, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yePhoyisa laseNingizimu Afrika. Uma uthola incwadi yokukhwabanisa, thumela incwadi, kanye nolwazi ku-Interpol. Nikeza imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana nezinsiza, noma lezo zomuntu ophakathi. Uma kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kohlelo lwe-"419" kanye neNingizimu Afrika, chaza lokhu ngokucacile ngemininingwane efanele. Nikeza imininingwane yakho yokuxhumana nezinsiza, noma lezo zomuntu ophakathi. Isevisi yePhoyisa laseNingizimu Afrika iyona ebeka isikhathi esizothathwa ekwenzeni umsebenzi, ukuze ikhiphe umbiko wokuthi umsebenzi uhamba kanjani. Imibiko ivame ukukhiphwa njalo ezinsukwini eziyi-14 kuye ngokwemvelo yecala. Imibiko yokuthi umsebenzi uhamba kanjani ngeke inikezwe abantu, uma kungakabi khona ukulahleka okwenziweyo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi iPhoyisa laseNingizimu Afrika ithole amakhophi ezincwadi zokukhwabanisa ezivela kuhlu lwe-"419", ukuze zifakwe kwi-database yabo. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Akukho, kodwa kubalulekile ukukhombisa emadokhumenti uma kukhona ukulahleka kwezimali okwenzekile.
Inhloso yale mthetho wokwabiwa kwempahla ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko nokuvula amathuba kubathengisi abasha ngendlela ezuzisayo ngaphandle kwemikhawulo emikhakheni yezezimali nezokuhlaliswa. Lokhu kungasiza kakhulu ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi nasekubandakanyeni abantu abaphucukile emnothweni phambili. Kuzosetshenziswa ngendlela yokwakha oxhumana nabo phakathi kwabantu abanamava kulomsebenzi wokuhweba nalabo abangenamava. 2.1 Ezindaweni ezibekelwe ukuhweba, kuzobekwa usuku lokwamukelwa ngokofficial kwabathengisi bonke kule ndawo. Ngemuva kwalokho, noma ubani ophula umthetho uzosuswa, futhi umnyango uzobika kwiKhansela njalo ngenyanga mayelana nokwamukelwa kwabathengisi ukuze basebenze ngokomthetho. 2.2 Kuzovunyelwa kuphela labo abakwi-level yokuqala yokungena ebhizinisini. 2.3 IKhansela izokhuthaza ukuphakanyiswa kwabathengisi ezindaweni ezibekelwe ukuze kube nokungena emakethe esemthethweni, ngokwakha amathuba okuthuthukisa abantu kanye namabhizinisi abo isikhathi esithile emva kwalokho umthengisi angabuyela ukufaka isicelo uma efuna ukusebenzisa le ndawo efanayo. Umnyango kufanele wenze izivumelwano zokuhweba ezindaweni zokuhweba zomphakathi, ezizoba yisivumelwano phakathi kweKhansela nabathengisi abaqoshwe ngesikhathi benikezwa lezi zindawo abazohweba kuzo. 2.4 Isicelo sokudluliselwa kwendawo yokuhweba uma kwenzeka isimo esinzima, ukugula, ukufa, noma ukungasebenzi kahle komnikazi kufanele sithunyelwe kwiKhansela ukuze processing. (Lokhu kubhekwa ngesimo ngasinye). 2.5 Umlando wendawo uzobuyekezwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona yini izimo ezikhethekile okufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphezu kwemigomo evunyelwene ngayo, noma ukuthi kufanele kusebenze imigomo ejwayelekile.
