Ukunakwa kuzonikezwa kwabesifazane, intsha (iminyaka engu-18-35), kanye nabantu abakhubazekile kanye nezakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. 3.4 Kumele kube umuntu ongasebenzi endaweni. 3.3.6 Izimpahla ezithengiswayo kumele zihambisane nombono wendawo, kodwa iKhansela izozama ukuthuthukisa amathuba ezomnotho/nemakethe kule ndawo. Ngokuphathelene nezindawo zokusebenza, iMasipala we eThekwini izozama ukufinyelela lezi zinhlelo ezilandelayo. IKhansela izosebenzisa ukwabiwa kwezindawo zokusebenza ukuze ibhekane nokuntuleka kwamathuba ezomnotho emiphakathini eyayiphucukile amathuba. Ekubeni kwezakhamizi ezindaweni zokusebenza, kuzobekwa ukugxila okukhulu kwabesifazane, intsha, kanye nabantu abakhubazekile njengoba kuchazwe umthetho kazwelonke. Abokufika abavumelekile abanamaphepha emisebenzi bazovunyelwa ukuhweba uma behlangabezana nezidingo ezivunyelwene ngazo. Ama-cooperatives aqoshiwe azocatshangelwa umnyango ofanele wombuso. Amaphuzu azonikezwa ngendlela ehambisana nezimfuneko ezibekiwe. Ukukhula kwezindawo zokuhweba ezingasetshenziswanga kuzobikwa kubalawuli ngenhloso yokubazisa ngezindawo ezitholakalayo. Noma iyiphi indawo yokuhweba engasetshenziswanga izokhankaselwa kubantu bendawo abakhe le ndawo. Izindawo zokuhweba ezingeni lemasipala ngokuvamile zizokhankaselwa kuyo yonke indawo yamasipala. Akuzukuba nohlaka lokulinda; labo asebekwiwo izikhundla ezinjalo bazokwaziswa ukuze bakwazi ukufaka izicelo kabusha uma izindawo zitholakala. Uma amaphuzu efana, indawo izonikezwa ngokudonswa. Abathengisi abakhona bangafaka izicelo zezindawo ezahlukene. Uma umuntu ethola indawo entsha, kuzodingeka aphume kuleyo ayesebenzisa ngaphambili. Umnyango uzohlinzeka ngombiko kubalawuli njalo ngenyanga mayelana nokwabiwa kwezindawo zokuhweba.
Inhloso yewebhusayithi yezinsizakalo zik 정부 yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyodwa mayelana nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso wukuxhumanisa phakathi kwabantu abanamandla nabangenamandla, phakathi komnotho wokuqala nowesibili. Le webhusayithi iyisimanga esibalulekile sokubandakanya nokusiza ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi bonke abantu bangaxhumana nohulumeni. Abasebenzisi abaqondile ngabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zezwe, amabhizinisi akhona kanye namabhizinisi azayo eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezikhungo nezakhamuzi noma izikhungo zangaphandle ezidinga izinsizakalo kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Abasebenzisi ababalulekile bahlanganisa izikhungo zokuxhumanisa umphakathi ezifana nezikhungo zomphakathi eziningi, abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa emiphakathini, nezikhungo zokuxhumana zikahulumeni ezifana nezikhungo zokushayela zeBatho Pele Gateway, ezizosisiza abantu ekusebenziseni le webhusayithi kulabo abangakwazi ukufinyelela i-inthanethi ngqo. Le webhusayithi innehla ngemininingwane mayelana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ezinikezwa uhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke. Izinsizakalo zabantu bangaphandle: imininingwane efanele abantu bangaphandle abadinga izinsizakalo ezithile kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Izigaba ngasinye kulolu hlelo nazo zihlelwe ngendlela ehambisana nezikhathi empilweni yomuntu noma ibhizinisi. Izikhathi zokuphila zihlelwa ngokulandela izigaba zokuphila. Imininingwane ngezinsizakalo nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo ihlelwe ngokwezindawo eziyisixhenxe ezibalulekile, ezihlanganisa: incazelo, izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe, imithetho nemigomo, amazinga okulethwa kwezinsizakalo nezikhathi zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo, izindleko, amafomu okufanele agcwaliswe, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Le ngxenye yewebhusayithi, ekhombisa isandla esikhaleni sokudla esiqondisa indlela okufanele uhambise ngayo, ixhumanisa nawe kwezinye amawebhusayithi ahlobene, mayelana nalokho okwenzekayo empilweni. Le webhusayithi ilungiselelwe ngolimi olukhuluma ngolimi olukhulu: isiNgisi, isiAfrikaans, isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, isiPedi, isiSotho, isiTsonga, isiVenda, isiSwati, kanye nesiTswana. Ngoba imininingwane ibhalwe kuqala ngesiNgisi bese ihunyushwa kwezinye izilimi. Imininingwane ngezinsizakalo kwezinye izilimi ifakwa kwiwebhusayithi ngemuva kokuhunyushwa. Sebenzisa ikhasi lokuxhumana nathi ukuze uphawule noma ubuze ngale webhusayithi yezinsizakalo zikahulumeni. Ikheli lewebhusayithi yokuxhumana nohulumeni ngu: www.gov.za elikuvumela ukuthi ufike futhi uxhumane nekhasi lokuthi ungene kwiwebhusayithi kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokungena, kanye newebhusayithi yolwazi lukahulumeni. Imame yewebhusayithi ihlinzeka ngezithombe nezithombe zendlela yewebhusayithi. Ihlelwe ukusuka phansi ukuya phezulu, ibeka imininingwane kwiwebhusayithi ngamasango nezihloko ezithile. Lokhu kukusiza ukuthi ubone kahle futhi uqonde ukuhleleka nokwenzeka okukhonjiswa yiwebhusayithi. Ikhasi lekhaya lihlanganisa izinsizakalo ezitholakala kalula. Lezi zindawo zokungena zikusiza ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezinhlanu ezivakashelwe kakhulu ngabasebenzisi. Uhlu luhlelwe futhi luhlelwe ngokuhlinzeka ngama-visit counts. Ibhokisi lokusesha litholakala kuwo wonke amakhasi ewebhusayithi. Uma ufaka igama lokusesha, izosesha yonke iwebhusayithi ngalezi zisho, ikhetha izixhumanisi lapho kukhona iPrimary Search. Umsebenzi wokusesha uwukusesha imininingwane kwezinye amawebhusayithi kahulumeni. Izixhumanisi kwezinye amawebhusayithi angaphandle nazo zikhonjiswa ngamagama athi 'external link - opens in a new window' ezovela ebhokisini uma ikhursi yakho ibhampa phezu kwaleyo nxazonke. Le webhusayithi izovuleka efasiteleni elisha ukuze uhambise kwezinye amawebhusayithi. Le webhusayithi izoqhubeka ibuyekezwa ngemininingwane emisha. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane noma nini lapho itholakala. Nokho, abaklami nabathuthukisi bewebhusayithi yezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane evela kwezinye amawebhusayithi esixhumanisa nazo ezishicilelwe lapha izoba neqiniso ngaleso sikhathi. Bheka Izimo Nezimo, isigaba 4.3. Iminyango kahulumeni iyabamba imininingwane yabo kwiwebhusayithi. Le nsizakalo ihlinzekwa kubasebenzi bokuxhumana bamanzi, abawuthintayo imininingwane eshicilelwe kule webhusayithi. Abasebenzi bokuxhumana kukahulumeni bangabantu abaphethe ukuphathwa kokuqukethwe nokuhlanganisa umqondo wokwenzeka okuqukethwe kwiwebhusayithi. Imininingwane ikakhulukazi ihlelwe kule webhusayithi ngefomethi ye-HTML. Nokho, ezinye izincwadi zitholakala ngefomethi ye-PDF, ezihlinzekwe ngendlela yokuthi zigcine uhlobo okumele zibe nalo ukuze zihlale zihlala. Ukuze uvule izincwadi ze-PDF udinga i-Adob Acrobat Reader 4, noma inguqulo ephezulu kukhompyutha yakho. Lokhu kuzokuvumela ukuthi uvule izincwadi ngqo kwi-browser yakho. Ngezinye izikhathi kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuvula izincwadi ze-PDF. Kulokhu, siphakamisa ukuthi ulandele izincwadi kukhompyutha yakho bese uzivula lapho. Sebenzisa umouse wakho, chofoza kwesokudla kudokhumenti ofuna ukuyilanda. Ku-menu yokwehla, khetha 'Save target as'. Ku-'Save as' iwindi, khetha indawo ofuna ukuyigcina kudokhumenti kukhompyutha yakho, bese uchofoza inkinobho ethi 'Save'. Ifayela lizogcinwa endaweni oyikhethile. Vula i-Acrobat Reader, bese uvula izincwadi ofuna ukuzilanda kukhompyutha yakho. Sebenzisa umouse wakho, gcina shift bese uchofoza ku-link yedokhumenti ofuna ukuyigcina. Ku-'Save as' iwindi, khetha indawo ofuna ukuyigcina kudokhumenti kukhompyutha yakho, bese uchofoza inkinobho ethi 'Save'. Ifayela lizogcinwa endaweni oyikhethile. Vula i-Acrobat Reader, bese uvula izincwadi ofuna ukuzilanda kukhompyutha yakho. Uthanda usizo ngezinkinga obhekana nazo kule webhusayithi? Sicela uxhumane nathi nge-imeyili: uma unenkinga ngewebhusayithi.
Inhloso yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso ukuqinisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenzisa ilungelo labo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela ulwazi oluphathwa nguhulumeni, kanye nolwazi oluphathwa abanye abantu, oludingekayo ukuze umuntu akwazi ukwenza noma ukuvikela ilungelo elithile. Umgomo ophambili wokwenza kube nokufinyelela kolwazi ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okucacisa ngendlela izinto ezenziwa ngayo nokuchaza izenzo zohulumeni nezizimele, kanye nokuthuthukisa umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinyelela ulwazi ukuze bakwazi ukwenza noma ukuvikela amalungelo abo onke. Ingabe kukhona ulwazi olukhona ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezobulungiswa noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi engatholakala? Ungafinyelela wonke amadokhumenti noma amarekhodi avela kwiMnyango, kubaphathi bawo, noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano kahulumeni. Akubalulekile ukuthi ulwazi lukhona nini. Amarekhodi omuntu kwiMnyango noma enhlangano kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngamaqembu wesithathu noma amarekhodi kuphela ngokuvuma kweqembu lesithathu elithintekayo, ikakhulukazi uma amadokhumenti aqukethe ulwazi oluyimfihlo noma ulwazi lomuntu siqu. Ulwazi olungavunyelwe lutholakala ngokulandela iMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso. Ukufinyelela kolwazi kuthintwa yizithiyo ezithile, ngokwesibonelo, uma irekhodi liceliwe ukuze lisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zomthetho eziphikisanayo noma ezingezona eziphikisanayo noma uma izinqubo zomthetho eziphikisanayo noma ezingezona eziphikisanayo seziqale, lapho ulwazi lungasetshenziswa khona enkantolo, ikakhulukazi uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi kungalimaza inqubo yobulungiswa. Amarekhodi wekhabhinethi noma amaqembu ayo. Amarekhodi ahlobene nokusebenza kwezinkantolo kanye nezijaji. Ulwazi olutholakala ezinkantolo ezikhethekile ezinquma izingxabano ezithile nezicelo, ezisungulwe ngokulandela umthetho. Futhi ulwazi oluphethwe ngumuntu ongumMember of Parliament noma umphakathi wesifunda. Nokho, iMthetho Wokufinyelela KwiNgcaciso idlula eminye imithetho engase ivimbe ukuthola noma yiluphi ulwazi. Cela usizo kumphathi weMibiko oPhakathi kwemnyango efanele ukuze akusize uthole ulwazi noma amadokhumenti owadingayo. Gcwalisa futhi uthumele Ifomu A: Isicelo Sokufinyelela KwiRekhodi Kahulumeni. Ungayithola ehhovisi leMnyango Wezobulungiswa. Uma ulwazi olufuna lungatholakali mahhala, kuzodingeka ukuthi ukhokhe. Ungase udinge ukukhokha imali yokusesha ukuze ufinyelele ulwazi. I-Mthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso, 2000 kanye Nezinhlinzeko ezihlobene. Umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi kumele aphendule ezinsukwini eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo sakho. Uma umphathi wolwazi ekwenqaba ukufinyelela kulwazi oluceliwe, ungafaka isikhalazo kumphathiswa wezobulungiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho. Uma unganelisekile ngemiphumela, ungafaka isikhalazo enkantolo. Umphathi wolwazi noma umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi uzokweseka kulolu hlelo. Uma ulwazi oluceliwe lungatholakali emnyangweni kahulumeni kodwa lukhona enhlangano kahulumeni, umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi uzothumela isicelo sakho kumphathi wolwazi waleyo nhlangano kahulumeni ezinsukwini eziyi-14. Inhlangano kahulumeni efanele kumele iphendule isicelo sakho ngesikhathi. Uzokwaziwa uma lokhu kwenzeka. Xhumana neNhlangano Yokufinyelela KwiNgcaciso yeMnyango Wezobulungiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho ngenombolo: 012 315 1715, ukuze uthole ukuthi izimali zishintshile yini. Izimali ezikhokhwayo kumarekhodi enhlangano kahulumeni zikhona njengoba kuchaziwe ezinhlinzekweni zamanje zomthetho.
UMnyango Wezolimo ubheka inqubo yeMthetho Wokuguqulwa Kwezinto, 1997, mayelana nezimo zamavume. Bheka ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lokugunyazwa oludingayo bese ugcwalisa ifomu elifanele. Izicelo zokuph continued under a specific activity zizovunywa kuphela uma lelo activity ivunyelwe esikhathini esedlule. Thumela isicelo kanye nenombolo ethile yezinkophi kumqondisi we-GMOs. Thumela enye ikhophi yesicelo, ehambisana nolwazi lwezohwebo olungayimfihlo kumqondisi we-GMOs. Khokha imali ethile okufanele ikhokhwe. Thumela umbiko wezinto ezenziwe esikhathini esedlule. Thumela ubufakazi bokwaziswa okujwayelekile. Inqubomgomo yokuhamba kwe-GMO. Umqondisi uhlole ukuthi isicelo sihambisana neMthetho Wokuguqulwa Kwezinto, 1997. Ikhono lokweluleka lihlole ulwazi lwezesayensi oluthunyelwe nesicelo bese lenza isiphakamiso mayelana nokuphepha komsebenzi ophakanyisiwe, okukhulunywa phambi komkhandlu ophakeme. Umqondisi uthola imibono yomphakathi ngesikhathi esivunyelwe. Umkhandlu ophakeme wenza isinqumo ngesicelo, ucabangela isicelo, isiphakamiso sekomidi lokweluleka, imibono yomphakathi, kanye nemiphumela engaba khona emikhakheni efana nezolimo, impilo, imvelo, umsebenzi, ukuhweba, kanye nentuthuko yesayensi nobuchwepheshe. Uma isinqumo somkhandlu ophakeme sihambisana nesicelo, umqondisi utholelwa igunya lokukhishwa kwemvume. Umqondisi ukhishwa imvume efanele. Zonke izimvume zihlala ngaphansi kwezimo zokukhawulelwa. Ukuphikiswa okuvela kuMnyango Wezolimo kuqapha ukuhambisana nezimo zemvume.
Uma inkampani noma inhlangano eduze ingakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zayo noma ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zayo, uMphakathi-Jikelele wezohwebo nezimboni angase aqale ukuhoxiswa nokuphulwa kwezimpahla zenkampani noma ukuvalwa kwebhizinisi kanye nokwabiwa nokuthengiswa kwezimpahla zayo. Inkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana, noma yiliphi ilunga lenhlangano noma umuntu ophazamisekile, bangafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuthi izimpahla zenkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana zikhishwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele noma zivalwe futhi izimpahla zayo zithengiswe. Inkantolo ethatha lesi sicelo kumele ibe yisigaba seNkantolo Ephakeme noma iNkantolo yeMagistrate enegunya endaweni lapho inkampani itholakala khona noma isebenza khona. Izinkantolo zingakhupha umyalo onjalo uma kuhlelekile futhi kufanelekile ezimweni. Zonke izindaba ezihambisanayo kumele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokukhishwa komyalo wokuhoxiswa, kuhlanganise nokuthi izimpahla nezikweletu zenkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana zizophathwa kanjani, noma seziphathwe kanjani. Uma inkantolo inquma ukuvala inkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana, izonquma ukuthi izimpahla zenkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana zizophathwa kanjani ngendlela efanele futhi elungile. Inkantolo izocabangela noma yiziphi iziphakamiso ezenziwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele mayelana nokwabiwa kwezimpahla. Uma uMphakathi-Jikelele noma inkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana, noma yiliphi ilunga lenhlangano noma omunye umuntu ophazamisekile, efaka isicelo sokuthi inkampani ikhishelwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele noma ivalwe, uNgqongqoshe angabeka inqubo yokuthi inkampani noma inhlangano yesikhashana ikhishelwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele noma ivalwe. UNgqongqoshe angaphinde abeke amandla nemisebenzi kaMphakathi-Jikelele, uMlawuli Wezinkampani, inhlangano, amalunga, noma ezinye izigaba ezithintekayo kulezi zimo. Uma kukhulunywa ngenkampani noma inhlangano eduze, noma yimuphi umuntu ophazamisekile, abaphathi, abahloli bezimali, noma wakhiwo lweMali yaseNingizimu Afrika noma uMlawuli Wezinkampani bangafaka isicelo sokuthi inkampani ikhishelwe ohlwini lwezinkampani noma ama-CC. Inkampani ebhalisiwe, inhlangano, noma i-CC kumele ibhale incwadi yokufaka isicelo sokuhoxiswa ohlwini. Kumele ichaze isizathu sokuthi kungani inkampani noma i-CC ifaka isicelo sokuhoxiswa ohlwini. Uma kunesidingo, kufanele ibonise inombolo yentela yenkampani noma ye-CC. Bonke abaphathi namalunga enkampani noma i-CC kumele besayine incwadi uma kuyisicelo sokuhoxiswa ohlwini abakwenzayo ngokuvuma kwabo ukuze inkampani ikhishelwe ohlwini. Ukuhoxiswa ohlwini kuthatha cishe izinyanga eziyisithupha. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa futhi akukho fomu okufanele kugcwaliswe.
I-Grade R iyisikhathi sokuqala sephasi eliyisisekelo emfundweni egxile eziphumeleni ezikoleni zikaHulumeni. Le mfundo iklanyelwe izingane ezineminyaka emine nephezulu kuya kwemihlanu nephezulu. Abazali nabagibeli kumele babhalise izingane zabo ezikoleni ngaphambi kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe phakathi kukaAgasti no-Okthoba kulo nyaka ngaphambi kokuthi izingane ziqale. Faka isicelo ngaphambi kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe phakathi kukaAgasti no-Okthoba. Bhalisela esikoleni esiseduzane nawe. Thumela isithombe sokuzalwa kwengane kanye nekhadi lokugonywa, kanye nobufakazi bokuthi ufake isicelo sokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Isicelo sakho singathatha isonto elilodwa kuya kwezingu-6 ukuze processing. Imali yesikole iyahluka phakathi kwezikole. Amafomu okumele agcwaliswe atholakala ezikoleni.
Ubani onelungelo lokufaka isicelo? Abantu abadala abangadingi ukunakekelwa njalo endaweni yokuhlala abantu asebekhulile. Abantu abathola usizo lwezezimali kwabakhulile. Abesifazane abaneminyaka engu-60 noma ngaphezulu, nabesilisa abaneminyaka engu-65 noma ngaphezulu. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo ehhovisi lezentlalo eliseduze nalapho uhlala khona. Khombisa i-ID yakho yaseNingizimu Afrika. Uzophenywa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uyafaneleka ukutholwa nokuthola usizo lwezezimali. Uma isicelo sakho siphumelele, uzocelwa ukuthi usayine isivumelwano nendawo yokuhlala abantu asebekhulile ngesikhathi sokwamukelwa. Uma isicelo sakho sikhanselwa, ungafaka isikhalazo sakho phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-90 kumphathiswa wezentlalo noma kumuntu ohlanganyela emkhandlwini. Kungathatha izinsuku eziyi-35 processing isicelo sakho. Kuzoncika kulokho okukhona kwabafake izicelo. Izindleko zinqunywa ukuphathwa kwendawo yokuhlala abantu asebekhulile. Ifomu lokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe uma umuntu efaneleka ukutholwa ngu-IDQ 98, elitholakala endaweni yokuhlala abantu asebekhulile.
Ukuthathwa kwezingane kusho ukwamukela ngokomthetho ukuba ngumgadi wengane, kulandela inqubo yamasiko kanye nomthetho yengane engazalwanga kubazali abathathayo. Ingane engakabi yakho ngokwenziwa oyithathayo ukuze uyinakekele ithathwa kubazali bayo ngokwenziwa futhi ibekwe ngokomthetho kubazali abathathayo noma endaweni yokunakekelwa. Ingane ingathathwa engakabi yakho ngokwenziwa. Ubaba ongena emshadweni ongumzali wengane ezalwe ngaphandle komshado kufanele abe nezinsiza zokunakekela nokukhokhela imfundo yayo. Kufanele ube negama elihle, ube umuntu omuhle, futhi ube nethemba futhi ukwazi ukunakekela ingane. Uma umzali wengane engum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika, kufanele futhi ube ngum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika futhi ubehlala eNingizimu Afrika. Uma ungum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika, kufanele ube neziqu zokuba ngum citizen noma ube ufake isicelo sokuba ngum citizen. Ukuthatha ingane ngokuqinisekile, lapho abazali bayo bengavunyelwe ukwazi ukuthi abazali abathathayo bangobani, noma lapho abanikazi bezingane bezozishiya ngemva kokuthatha ingane, kulawulwa nguMthetho 18 weMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezingane, 1983, futhi kungenzeka uma inkantolo yezingane ikholwa ukuthi lokhu kuzothuthukisa ingane futhi kuhambisane kakhulu nezidingo zengane. Uma inkantolo yezingane ithola ukuthi ingane noma izingane zidinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa, umgibeli wenkantolo yezingane uzobeka lezi zingane ekunakekelweni, endlini yezingane, esikoleni sezimboni, noma endaweni ephephile. Nokho, ingane noma izingane zingabekwa ngaphansi kokunakekelwa komzali, umnakekeli, noma umgadi, lapho zizobe ziphathwa khona ngummeli wezokuxhumana. Kulokhu, uMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uzohlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali kumzali onakekela ingane. Isiphakamiso sokuthatha ingane kufanele sibe sesisekelweni sezidingo zengane kanye nenzuzo empilweni yengane. Ukuze uthole eminye imininingwane, vakashela ku-inthanethi yeMnyango Wezemvelo Nezokuvakasha, uMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo. Hamba kumgibeli wenkantolo yezingane esifundazweni lapho ingane ihlala khona. Qedela Ifomu 11, Isicelo sokuthatha ingane, sengane ofuna ukuyithatha. Lapho Ifomu 12, Ukuvuma komzali noma umgadi sokuthatha ingane, ifanele, iqukethe ukuvuma okubhaliwe kwabazali sokuthathwa kwengane komunye, futhi Ifomu 13, Ukuvuma kwengane sokuthathwa, iqukethe ukuvuma okubhaliwe kwengane. Ingane uqobo, uma ineminyaka engaphezu kweyishumi, kufanele iqonde ubunjalo nobaluleka balo mvume. Umzali owamukele ingane ukuze ayinakekele, owayinakekela leyo ngane, kufanele afake isicelo sokuthatha leyo ngane. Uma umzali owamukele ingane ukuze ayinakekele ehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngovume lwezokuthatha ngaphakathi kwenyanga emva kokucelwa ukuba enze kanjalo ngumqondisi wenkantolo, inqubo yokuthatha ingane ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kwemvume yabo edingekayo. Akudingi ukuvuma okubhaliwe ngaphansi kwezimo ezilandelayo: uma behoxisa ukuvuma kwabo ngesizathu esingafanele. Ukuvuma ukuthathwa kwengane ngumuntu ongumzali kuvame ukuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kungathatha isikhathi eside uma udaba lukhona oluyinkimbinkimbi. Mayelana nezindleko zokuhlola, xhumana nezikhungo ezifanele zokuvuma ukuthathwa kwezingane, izinkantolo zezingane, kanye noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Ifomu 12A: Ukuhoxiswa kwemvume yokuthatha ingane ngumzali noma umgadi wengane.
Amakhansela okuxoxisana phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi abhekana nezivumelwano ezihlanganyelwe, ukuxazulula izingxabano ezikhungweni zokusebenza phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi, ukusungula izinhlelo ezahlukene, nokuphawula ngemigomo nemithetho yezabasebenzi. Izinyunyana nezinhlelo zabaphathi zingafaka isicelo sokusungula amakhansela okuxoxisana phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ikhansela elihlanganyelwe lingafaka isicelo kuMlawuli Wezabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi ukuze libhalise ikhansela elihlanganyelwe phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Noma yikuphi ikhansela lokuxoxisana phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi linganquma ukuhlanganisa nezinye noma amakhansela okuxoxisana phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Faka isicelo kuMlawuli Wezobudlelwano Babasebenzi ukuze ubhalise ikhansela elihlanganyelwe phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Kungathatha izinsuku ezingu-60 ukuze processing yesicelo iphumelele. Le sevisi ikhululekile. Isicelo sokubhaliswa kweKhansela elihlanganisiwe, Ifomu LRA3.
Ibhizinisi elifuna ukushintsha imininingwane yokubhaliswa kumele liqedele ifomu lesicelo njengoba kudingwa umthetho. Imininingwane encane kuphela ingashintshwa ngaphandle kokuhambisa ifomu. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela ku-website: I-Companies and Intellectual Property Registration Office. Shintsha imininingwane yebhizinisi ku-inthanethi. Ukuqedela ifomu lesicelo sokubhaliswa ku-inthanethi ngeke kukuvumele ukufinyelela endaweni yokusebenza evumela ukuthi wenze izinguquko eminininingwaneni yebhizinisi lakho. Ukuvunywa kokubhaliswa kuthatha usuku olulodwa noma ezimbili, futhi uzokwazi ukwenza izinguquko kuphela ngemuva kokuvunywa. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa. Shintsha imininingwane yebhizinisi ku-inthanethi.
Le nsizakalo itholakala amahora angama-24 ngosuku kumuntu noma ubani ofuna ukuveza imisebenzi yobugebengu ephawulekayo noma ubugebengu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane engasiza amaphoyisa ekuvimbeleni noma ekuhloleni lelo bugebengu. Umuntu ophendula angakhetha ukungazivezi igama lakhe. Inombolo yokuphuthuma yobugebengu ngu: 10111. Umuntu oqapha isikhungo semininingwane yobugebengu uzophendula ucingo futhi abhale leyo mininingwane. Ungakhetha ukungazivezi igama lakho. Umuntu oqapha imininingwane esikhungweni uzokunikeza ikhodi yokubhekisela eyimfihlo yokusetshenziswa kwesikhathi esizayo. Ucingo lukhokhelwa ngentengo ejwayelekile ye-landline futhi lukhokhelwa ngentengo ye-mobile. Akudingeki ukuthi kugcwaliswe amafomu.
Ukudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa kuvumela abantu ukuba bathole izinhlanzi emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle kokuhlosile ukuwathengisa. Ukuze uthumele izinhlanzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kufanele ufake isicelo semvume esinikezwa umnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiwe. Izinhlanzi ezitholwe kwamanye amazwe ezizothengiswa kufanele zisetshenziswe abantu abazitholile. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuthumela izinhlanzi ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngaphandle kwemvume efanele. Faka isicelo esisha semvume yokudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika uma eyakho yamanje iphelelwe isikhathi. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nemithetho yemvume kungaholela ekutheni imvume yakho suspenswe noma ikhanselwe. Qaphela: Imvume yokudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ayihlanganisi izinhlanzi ezitholwe emanzini ahlanzekile. Lezi zinhlanzi zilawulwa umnyango wezolimo. Izicelo zemvume zokuthumela izinhlanzi ezitholwe emanzini ahlanzekile zifakwa kumnyango wezolimo, okuyiwo kuphela umnyango ophathelene nokwethula lezi mvume. Izinhlanzi ezibhalwe kuMthetho Wokuhweba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe Ngemikhiqizo Ebulalayo (CITES) azivunyelwe ukutholwa nokulethwa eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi ngale nhlangano, vakashela ku-http://www.cites.org. Imvume yokudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika yokusetshenziswa komuntu iphelelwa isikhathi uma umuntu ebuyela ezweni lapho edobe khona. Abantu abavunyelwe ukulethela izinhlanzi eziphilayo. Awukwazi ukuzithengisa uqobo noma ukuthumela ngempahla. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu uma wonke amadokhumenti ephelele. Imali yesicelo semvume yokudoba ngenjongo yokuzijabulisa emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika yokusetshenziswa komuntu ingu-R120. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kuthathwa umphumela ngummeli womnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethiwe ngokuxhumana nomphumela wezomnotho. Amafomu wezicelo awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane ne-ofisi yakho eseduzane.
Ukuthengiswa kwezinhlanzi kubandakanya imisebenzi ehlobene nokuthumela izinhlanzi kwamanye amazwe ukuze uthole inzuzo. Ukuze uthumele izinhlanzi eNingizimu Afrika noma ukuze uzithumele ngaphandle kwemingcele yelizwe, kumele ufake isicelo sokuthumela esikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe weMnyango ophathe izenzo zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuthumela izinhlanzi ngaphandle kwalolu phiko. Faka isicelo sesikhumbuzo esisha uma lesi onaso siphelelwe yisikhathi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wesikhumbuzo, isikhumbuzo sakho singase sithathwe noma sikhanselwe. Qaphela: Isikhumbuzo sokuthumela izinhlanzi asifaki izinhlanzi ezitholakala emanzini angaphakathi. Lezi zinhlanzi zilawulwa umnyango wezolimo. Izicelo zesikhumbuzo sokuthumela izinhlanzi ezitholakala emanzini angaphakathi, kanye nezinye ezitholakala ezindaweni ezithile, zithunyelwa emnyangweni wezolimo. Lona umnyango ophumelelayo ekukhishweni kwesikhumbuzo. Izinhlanzi ezibhalwe esivumelwaneni sokuhweba ngezinhlobo eziyingozi azivunyelwe ukuthunyelwa. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi ngale nhlangano, vakashela ku-http://www.cites.org. Isikhumbuzo sokuthumela i-abalone kumele sibe ne-CITES certificate yokuthunyelwa ngakunye. Isikhumbuzo sokuthumela i-bigeye tuna, i-southern bluefin tuna, i-swordfish, i-Antarctic toothfish, kanye ne-Patagonian toothfish kumele sibe nedokhumenti echaza inani lazo ngakunye. Amadokhumenti enani lezinhlanzi atholakala emnyangweni ophathe izenzo zomphakathi zendawo nezokuvakasha, ehhovisi lephoyisa elibhekele izindaba zezimayini nezokwakhiwa, kanye nehhovisi likamqondisi omkhulu wezindaba zezimayini nezokwakhiwa. Faka isicelo sesikhumbuzo sokuthumela. Thola amafomu okuthumela kanye nama-CITES forms ehhovisi lezimayini nezokwakhiwa noma emnyangweni ophathe izenzo zomphakathi zendawo nezokuvakasha, noma uwathole ku-http://www.mcm-deat.gov.za. Gcwalisa ifomu uqinisekise ukuthi uqedile zonke izidingo zokufaka isicelo. Amakhophi amadokhumenti enani lezinhlanzi nawo adingeka kuzo zonke izinhlanzi ezifana ne-bigeye tuna, i-southern bluefin tuna, i-swordfish, i-Antarctic toothfish, kanye ne-Patagonian toothfish ezathunyelwa ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo sangaphambilini, kanye nenani lezinhlanzi ofuna ukulithumela. Isethifiketi esiqinisekisa ukuthi awunayo izikweletu zentela esikhishwe yiNhlangano Yezimali yaseNingizimu Afrika nayo iyadingeka. Bika ehhovisi le-South African Bureau of Standards eliseduze mayelana nokuthunyelwa kwakho uma izinhlanzi ozithumelayo zingaveli emanzini angaphakathi noma zingafaneleki ukudliwa ngabantu. Uma izinhlanzi zakho zivela emanzini angaphakathi futhi zizodliwa abantu, bika emnyangweni wezempilo. Imali yokufaka isicelo ingu-R225. Qedela, podpishe, futhi uthumele ifomu lakho kanye namadokhumenti adingekayo ehhovisi lezimayini nezokwakhiwa endaweni yakho; kungenjalo, isikhumbuzo ngeke sikhishwe. Amadokhumenti okuqala yilokho okufanele ufake; ngaphandle kwabo, ngeke uthole isikhumbuzo. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma isikhathi eside uma wonke amadokhumenti ephelele. Imali yokufaka isicelo ingu-R225. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kuthathwa nguNgqongqoshe weMnyango ophathe izenzo zomphakathi zendawo nezokuvakasha noma umphakathi okhethwe ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali.
Noma ubani onenhlalakahle engapheli eNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukufaka isicelo sokuba yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi ukujwayela emva kweminyaka emihlanu yokuba ngumhlali ongenamkhawulo. Noma ubani oshadile nesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukuba yisakhamuzi esivela kwezinye izwe ngemva kweminyaka emibili kulandela ukunikezwa kwesikhumbuzo sokuhlala esinokuphela kwalesi sikhathi sokushada. Ingane eneminyaka engu-21 enenhlalakahle engapheli iyafaneleka ukuba yisakhamuzi esivela kwezinye izwe, ngokushesha ngemva kokunikezwa kwesikhumbuzo sokuhlala. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, xhumana neMnyango Wezasekhaya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-63 ne-BI-757 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMvelo. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emishinini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Nikeza iphepha elisemthethweni lokuhlala elingapheli noma ukuhoxiswa. Qedela ifomu le-SAP kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe ukuze uthole isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka kwezokuphepha. Thumela ifomu le-BI-9 eliqediwe kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe nezithombe ezimbili ezinomumo we-ID uma ungena eminyakeni engu-15. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthola ub identification ngemva kokwamukelwa kwesicelo sakho sokuba yisakhamuzi esivela kwezinye izwe. Umdali onengane angafaka isicelo egameni lezingane nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho ingane isendaweni yokuhlala ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Abafakizicelo abamukeliwe bazoxwayiswa ngokufanele. Izicelo zingathatha izinyanga ezi-2 kuya kwezi-4. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa.
Uma iNhlangano Yezobuchwepheshe Bezesayensi Yezemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika inqaba ukubhalisela noma ikhubaze ukubhaliswa kwakho, ungabiza iNhlangano ngalolo shintsho ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30, kodwa ngokukhokha imali efanele okufanele ikhokhwe. Xhumana ne-SACNASP phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 kusukela ngosuku olwenqabe, futhi uzonikezwa izeluleko mayelana nalokho okudingeka ukwenze. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ungathumela incwadi yokubiza kwiNhlangano phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30. Le ncwadi kumele ihambisane nemali okufanele ikhokhwe kwiNhlangano. Phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 zokwamukela isicelo sakho sokubiza, iNhlangano izokwenza isinqumo ngesicelo sakho sokubiza futhi ikunikeze izizathu zesinqumo. Uma isicelo sakho sokubiza sikhuluma ngokwenqaba kwekomidi yokuvuselela ukubhaliswa kwakho njengomuntu obhalisiwe, ukubhaliswa kwakho ngeke kukhanselwe kuze kube senziwe isinqumo ngesicelo sokubiza. Ukuze ukhokhe ngedijithali nangokukhokha ngqo: Sicela usebenzise iziqu zeminwe namagama akho ukuze uqinisekise ukukhokha kwethu emalini yethu yasebhange bese uthumela ubufakazi bokukhokha ngefeksi, kanye nekhasi lokuqala lefomu lokufaka isicelo enombolweni: 841 1057.
Bonke amafutha okwenziwa, athunyelwe, noma athengiswa eNingizimu Afrika kumele abhaliswe ngaphansi koMlawuli weMthetho 36 ka-1947. Umfakisicelo kumele abe ngumuntu ongena emthethweni, ngokwesibonelo, uJohn Peter Citizen T/A owenza ibhizinisi ngaphansi kwegama: Diepsloot Stud. Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Kuphela izinkampani ezibhaliswe kuleli, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, noma isikhungo esisemthethweni esibhaliswe eNingizimu Afrika esingafaka isicelo samafutha. Amafutha eqembu 1 yilezo eziqukethe i-nitrogen, i-phosphorus, noma i-potassium njengengxenye eyinhloko, ezaziwa nangokuthi amafutha angaphandle. Usayizi bezikhwama noma iziqukathi abakwazi ukushintshwa ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe evela koMlawuli. Isicelo sokubhaliswa kokudla kwezilwane namafutha kumele sihlanganise incwadi ehambisana nesicelo esivela kumfakisicelo noma kumuntu ophakanyisiwe ukuba umele umfakisicelo. Thumela ifomu lesicelo lemibhalo emisha kanye nezichibiyelo ezibhalwe phansi, kuhlanganise nezinguquko ekwakhiweni. Thumela amafomu amabili, aphelele ngokuphelele, ngaphandle kokubhekisela ezicelweni zangaphambilini, izinombolo zamakhasi, noma emikhiqizweni eminye. Omunye ungaba ikhophi. Umuntu ophakanyisiwe ngokomthetho, okumele abe yilowo ofuna ukuxhumana nenkampani noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu wesicelo. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa komkhiqizo kumele isetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi isinguquko, noma ngabe sikhulu kangakanani, sizobhekwa njengokuchibiyela. Thumela amafomu wesicelo ehhovisi eliphethe. Ukuhlinzeka ngamaformu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzophazamisa isikhathi ngokubambezela inqubo. Bhala ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Akukho sidingo sokuphrinta amalebula ngalezi zilimi zombili; kumele abhalwe kahle. Ungafaki izinombolo ezixwayisweni nasezixwayisweni zokuphepha. Lonke ulwazi kumalebula kumele luhambisane ngqo nalokho okunikezwa kufomu lesicelo. Thumela isicelo sakho kanye nezimali kuMlawuli weMthetho 36 ka-1947. Ukubhaliswa kwamafutha kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine.
Iphasi leziqinisekiso ibhizinisi iyisiqinisekiso esinikezwa umuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula noma ukufaka imali ebhizinisini eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo kumabhange aseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini noma ehhovisi eliseduze lezeMisebenzi lapho ibhizinisi lizokwakhiwa khona. Isicelo sephasi lebhizinisi kumele sibe necebo elikhishwe ngengcweti yezezimali, ebhaliswe neNhlangano Yezingcweti Zama-Accounting eNingizimu Afrika. Imali encane yokutshalwa kwezimali ingama-R2.5 million ngempesheni noma okungenani ama-R2 million ngempesheni kanye nama-R500,000 ngempahla. I-deposit yokubuyiselwa, efana nekhadi lokubuyela elilodwa ezweni lokwakheka noma lapho umuntu enamalungelo okuhlala unomphela: Le deposit izobuyiselwa ngemva kokuhamba kwakho noma ngemva kokuthola iphasi. Izibalo zezempilo nemiphumela ye-x-ray ziyadingeka kumfakisicelo ngamunye. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 nabesifazane abakhulelwe akudingeki ukuba babe nemiphumela ye-x-ray. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezempilo eliseduze.
Iphasi yezingane iyidokhumenti ebalulekile ukuze ingane ikwazi ukuhamba iye kwelinye izwe. Iphasi yezingane inikezwa ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-16. Ivalidi ukuhamba kuyo yonke imikhakha ngaphandle uma kudingeka imibhalo ethile ekhombisa ukungavunyelwa. Ivalidi iminyaka emihlanu kusukela ngosuku olukhishwa ngalo. Qedela amafomu B1-73 bese uwafaka ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle eliseduze. Faka ezikhungweni noma emishinini yaseNingizimu Afrika uma uhamba phesheya. Nikeza isitifiketi sokuzalwa sengane. Faka izithombe ezimbili ezincane zephasi zengane. Imvume yomzali noma yomgibeli iyadingeka ngaphambi kokuthi ingane ithole iphasi. Nikeza ubufakazi besitifiketi sokufa uma omunye umzali eshonile. Uma imvume inikezwa ngumgibeli, kufanele kuchazwe ukuthi umgibeli uthole kanjani ilungelo lokuba ngumgibeli. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile ezikhethekile, uma kungenakwenzeka ukuthi lowo mzali anikeze imvume kumafomu okucela, imvume ebhaliwe kufanele itholwe encwadini ethunyelwe kumzali ongakabi khona. Endabeni lapho umzali engafuni ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, inkantolo enegunya phezu kwendaba kufanele yenze isinqumo ngalesi sihloko. Ikhophi ye-oda lenkantolo enegunya phezu kwendaba kufanele ihambisane nefomu lokucela iphasi. Uma abazali behlukanisiwe, bobabili abazali badingeka ukuba banikeze imvume ngaphandle uma i-oda lenkantolo ibonisa okunye. Iphasi ingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili ukuba ikhishwe.
Imvume yokusebenza yezikebhe inikezwa abantu bangaphandle abangamalungu eqembu elisebenzela ezikebheni. Imvume yokusebenza yezikebhe inganikezwa isikhathi esingafika ezinyangeni ezintathu ngasikhathi sinye. Izicelo zingafakwa ezindaweni zokungena eNingizimu Afrika. Thumela ipasipoti esebenzayo. Nikeza incwadi yesicelo evela kumphathi wezikebhe, kuhlanganiswe nemvume yabo yokuvumela lowo muntu ukuba ahambisane nemigomo yeMithetho Yokufuduka, 2002. Thumela ubufakazi obanele bokuba nemali eyanele kumphathi wezikebhe ukuze ahlangabezane nezindleko zokuphila zansuku zonke nezindleko zezokwelapha. Khokha idiphozi ethathwa njengokufanele nguMnyango Wezangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nemigomo nemibandela yemvume yokusebenza yezikebhe. Le diphozi izobuyiselwa kuwe ngemuva kokuhamba kwabo kokugcina noma ngemuva kokuthi imvume ikwenziwe. Idiphozi ingakhokhwa ngecheque eqinisekiswe yibhange noma ngekhadi lesikweletu ezindaweni lapho le nsiza itholakala khona. Nikeza ubufakazi bokukhokha noma noma iyiphi i-invoyisi engakhokhwa ngumthengisi. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku ezingu-30.
Iphasiwedi yokusebenza yeqembu elithile inikezwa umuntu ongaphandle uma lowo muntu efall under isigaba esithile esibekwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle ngonyaka, ngenothi kuGovement Gazette ngemva kokubonisana noNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuqashwa. Inani lezi zikhwama kuleli qembu alizokweqi inani elithile elibekwe enothini. Qedela ifomu le-BI-1738 ehhovisi le-embassy noma emnyangweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Umqashi kufanele azibophezele ekukhokheni amaphesenti amabili ezindleko zokuqeqesha. Qaphela: Ubufakazi bokukhokha kufanele buthunyelwe ezinsukwini ezintathu ngemuva kokwamukela iphasiwedi. Cela umqashi ofuna ukukuhola ukuthi aqedele ingxenye 13 yefomu le-BI-1738. Nikeza ubufakazi bokubhaliswa kanye nenhlangano yobungcweti noma ibhodi uma kusebenza. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-30.
Ubufakazi bomshado busebenza njengobufakazi bokuthi ushade. Umshado kumele wenziwe phambi kwabashadayo, abafakazi ababili abanama-ID, kanye nomphakathi. Qinisekisa isimo sakho somshado ngokuhlola le webhusayithi: online. Abashadayo kumele babe nama-ID futhi bagcwalise ifomu le-BI-31. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-130 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Umshado ungaphathwa ngumuntu okhethwe ngu-opharetha ophuma eqenjini lokholo, inhlangano, noma ummeleli weMnyango Wezasekhaya. Umshado kumele wenziwe ekhaya leziqu, endaweni esetshenziselwa kuphela izinjongo zokholo, ehhovisi likamasipala, noma endaweni yokuhlala yomuntu siqu. Uma umuntu ozoshada elimele kakhulu noma egula kakhulu, umshado ungaphathwa esibhedlela. Abantu bangaphandle abashadayo eNingizimu Afrika kumele babe namapasipoti futhi bagcwalise ifomu lesicelo: BI-31. Abashadayo ababili, abafakazi ababili, kanye nomphakathi kumele basayine iMbhalo Yomshado ngokushesha ngemva kokwenziwa komshado. Abancane, abachazwa njengabantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 abake bashade ngaphambili, kumele balandele umthetho. Ngokwemithetho, abantu abake bashada esikhathini esedlule, futhi imishado yabo iphelelwe ngenxa yokufa noma ukwehlukana, ngeke baphinde babhekeleke njengabancane ngokomthetho. Kumele bathumele incwadi yokuvuma ebhalwe phansi evela kubo bobabili abazali kanye/noma umgibeli wezomthetho ngokugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-31. Ungafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa eNkantolo Yezingane uma abazali bakho bengatholakali noma uma kungacacile ukuthi ungayithola kanjani incwadi yokuvuma. Ungafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa eNkantolo Ephakeme endaweni yakho uma abazali bakho kanye/noma uMphakathi bephika ukwamukela umshado. Abantu abahlukanisile abafuna ukujola kabusha kumele benze okulandelayo: bathole umyalo wokuhlukanisa eNkantolo. Kumele bathumele isitatimende esifungwayo ngendlela ye-affidavit uma kukhona isizathu esiqinile sokuthi abakwazi ukuthola umyalo wokuhlukanisa, noma uma behlukanisile kwelinye izwe, ngeke bakwazi ukuthola umyalo wokuhlukanisa. I-affidavit kumele ibonise ukuthi umceli uhlelwe ngokomthetho, igama lenkantolo, kanye nosuku lokuhlukanisa. Abafazi abashonile noma abesilisa abashonile abafuna ukujola kabusha kumele benze okulandelayo: bathole incwadi yokufa yomkakabo ophumile. Kumele bathumele isitatimende esifungwayo ngendlela ye-affidavit uma incwadi yokufa ingatholakali. I-affidavit kumele iqinisekise igama nesibongo somuntu oshonile, kanye nosuku lokufa. Incwadi yokushada efingqiwe: ikhiphwe ngokushesha. Incwadi engashintshwanga: izicelo zingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kw eight.
Iphasiwedi esemthethweni iyidokhumenti enamakhasi angama-64 elungiselelwe abahambi abavakashela kaningi. Iphasiwedi esemthethweni ifana nephasiwedi yoturisti, ngaphandle kokuthi inamakhasi amabili ukuze ivumele amakhasi amaningi e-visa. Isebenza iminyaka eyi-10 kusukela ngosuku olukhishwayo. Lapho ufaka isicelo, kufanele ube nekhadi lakho lokwaziswa noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Qedela ifomu le-BI-73 bese ulithumela mathupha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle eliseduzane. Letha kuMphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni uma ufaka isicelo usuka ngaphandle kwelizwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthathwa izithombe zakho ukuze zirekhodwe ohlwini lwezibalo zabantu. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezincane zepasipoti. Uma ungakabi nekhadi lokwaziswa, futhi isikhathi sisheshisa, ungafaka isicelo sobabili ngesikhathi esisodwa, iphasiwedi kanye nekhadi lokwaziswa. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing.
Imvume yokwelashwa inikezwa umuntu ongaphandle ngenhloso yokuthola ukwelashwa eNingizimu Afrika. Le mvume yokwelashwa iyasebenza isikhathi esingama-6 months ngasikhathi. Qedela ifomu lesicelo i-BI-1738. Thumela ipasipoti yakho okumele ibe valid okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-30 emva kokuphela kokuvakasha okuhlose. Nikeza ubufakazi bezimali ezanele zokukhokhela izindleko zansuku zonke zabantu bonke abahambisana nomnikazi wemvume ngokuthumela isitatimende sebhange, iphephandaba, noma ama-checks abavakashi. Thumela incwadi evela kudokotela noma endaweni yokwelapha ekhombisa izizathu noma isidingo sokwelashwa, isikhathi esilindelekile sokwelashwa, kanye nemininingwane yecebo lokwelashwa eNingizimu Afrika. Nikeza imininingwane yomuntu noma indawo ephathekayo yokukhokhela izindleko zokwelashwa nezindleko zehospitali zomnikazi wemvume uma kudingeka. Thumela ubufakazi bezimali zokukhokhela ukwelashwa noma umshwalense wakho wezempilo noma umqashi wakho ngeke akhokhe. Isetifiketi sokugomela, uma kudingeka. Isicelo sithatha izinsuku eziyi-30 ukuze processing.
Ipasipoti yesikhashana iyidokhumenti edingekayo ngokushesha uma uhlela ukuhamba ezweni elizungezile elingadingi ivisa. Ipasipoti yesikhashana ingasetshenziswa futhi ukuze ubuyekeze ngokushesha eNingizimu Afrika. Ivalidi ezinyangeni eziyishumi nanye kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa, kodwa iyahamba kuphela ngohambo olunye oluya ezweni ofuna ukuya kulo nokubuyela eNingizimu Afrika. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezithombe ezine zefomethi ye-pasipoti. Isicelo singathatha izinsuku eziyisihlanu zokusebenza ukuze processing.
Imvume yokusebenza yokuhlonza amakhono akhethekile inikezwa umuntu ongaphandle onamakhono noma iziqu ezikhethekile. Ingaphinde inikezwe amalungu omndeni walowo muntu. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi le-embassy noma emsebenzini waseNingizimu Afrika. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-1738. Faka ipasipoti yakho okumele ibe semthethweni okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngemva kokuphela kokuvakasha okuhlose. Faka i-curriculum vitae enemininingwane kanye neziqinisekiso ezivela kubaphathi bakho bangaphambilini. Ubufakazi bezimali ezanele ngokuhlinzeka ngamakhasi ebhange, ama-payslips, kanye neleta yokwesekwa evela kumamukeli wakho eNingizimu Afrika, izifundo, izimali zezokwelapha, noma imali uma ikhona, kuhlanganise namakhadi wesikweletu noma ama-checks okuhamba ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindleko zokuphila ngenkathi ungena eNingizimu Afrika. Isitifiketi sokuvakatshelwa, uma kudingeka. Thola incwadi evela kumnyango kahulumeni wangaphandle, noma kumnyango kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, noma esikhungweni semfundo eNingizimu Afrika noma inhlangano yamasiko noma yebhizinisi, eqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono noma iziqu zakho akhethekile. Hlinzeka nganoma iyiphi ubufakazi obukhombisa ukuthi amakhono noma iziqu akhethekile, njengamaphepha akhishwe noma iziqinisekiso. Cela umqashi ofuna ukukuhola ukuthi agcwalise isigaba sika-13 sefomu le-BI-1738. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku ezingu-30.
Imvume yokudlulisela yenkampani inikezwa umuntu ongaphandle odluliselwa inkampani yakhe ukuze asebenze kwi-affiliate yayo eNingizimu Afrika. Isikhathi semvume yokudlulisela yenkampani sithatha iminyaka emibili. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi lemboni noma emnyangweni waseNingizimu Afrika. Qedela ifomu le-BI-1738. Thola incwadi evela kwinkampani yomhlaba wonke eqinisekisa ukuthi uzodluliselwa kwi-branch yenkampani eNingizimu Afrika, noma kwi-affiliate yenkampani eNingizimu Afrika. Thola incwadi evela kwenkampani yaseNingizimu Afrika eqinisekisa ukuthi udluliselwa kuyo evela kwinkampani yayo enkulu noma kwi-affiliate yayo yangaphandle, kanye nokuchazwa kwezinhlobo zomsebenzi ozowenza kanye nezinga noma isikhundla ozosebenza kuso. Cela umqashi ofuna ukukuhola ukuthi aqedele ingxenye 13 yefomu le-BI-1738. Faka incwadi evela kumphakathi wezincwadi ezivunyelwe okhulumela umqashi echaza isidingo sokukuhola nokuchaza izinhlobo zomsebenzi ozowenza. Faka incwadi evela kumphakathi wezincwadi ezivunyelwe ethi awusoze waholwa ukuze usebenze ngaphansi kwezimo nezimo ezisebenzayo kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezakhamizi ezihlala njalo, nokuthi unazo iziqu ezidingekayo zomsebenzi. Nikeza ubufakazi bokubhaliswa nenhlangano yobungcweti noma ibhodi uma kudingeka. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-30.
Iphasiwedi yabasebenzi bakahulumeni ikhishwa kubasebenzi ezikhungweni zikahulumeni uma befisa ukuhamba phesheya ukuze benze imisebenzi kahulumeni. Iphasiwedi yabasebenzi bakahulumeni iyasebenza iminyaka emihlanu. Qiniseka ukuthi unokuhlonza noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa nawe ukuze wenze isicelo. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-73 bese ulithumela mathupha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle eliseduze. Letha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle noma emnyangweni wezwe laseNingizimu Afrika uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qiniseka ukuthi kuthathwa izithupha zakho ukuze zirekhodwe kwi-registri yokuhlala kwabantu. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezincane zephasiwedi. Faka isicelo sephasiwedi yabasebenzi bakahulumeni kanye nokuhlonza ngesikhathi esisodwa uma ungakwazi ukulinda. Faka incwadi evela kumqashi wakho echaza izizathu zokuthi kungani udinga iphasiwedi yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Le nsizakalo ingathatha kusukela kwesonto elilodwa kuya kwezinsuku eziyisithupha. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa.
Le nsizakalo itholakala kubalingani bangaphandle abangabantu bezwe laseNingizimu Afrika noma abanamalungelo okuphila njalo. Gcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Ubudlelwano obuqhubekayo phakathi kwabantu abashadile noma abaphakathi kobudlelwano bobulili obufanayo nabanye bezinhlobo ezahlukene zamadoda nabesifazane bwamukelwa, kodwa esikhundleni sesitifiketi sokushada, kumele banikeze ulwazi olunembile ngokuqhubeka kwabo, kanye nokwesekwa kwabo nokuxhaswa kwezimali ngokufaka isiqinisekiso esif sworn esivela kumphakathi wezomthetho. Ukuze uMnyango Wezangaphakathi unikeze amalungelo okuphila njalo kumlingani wangaphandle wesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma kumuntu onamalungelo okuphila njalo, kumele baneliseke ukuthi kukhona ubudlelwano obuqinile. Amalungelo okuphila njalo anikezwa ngaphansi kokuthi azophela uma kutholakala ukuthi ubudlelwano abukhona ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, ngaphandle uma omunye umphakathi eshonile. Kumele ushade nesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma nomuntu onamalungelo okuphila njalo ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezwe ongawumthetho wobugebengu noma umthetho wesiko, isikhathi esingama-5 iminyaka. Izicelo zingafakwa emahhovisi eMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emisebenzini uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le nsizakalo iyamahala.
Le nsizakalo ikakhulukazi ibhekene nezingane zabazali abathola ilungelo lokuba ngababambiqhaza ngemva kokuhlala iminyaka ethile, ibanika ilungelo lokuba ngababambiqhaza. Izingane zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuzalwa nangokuhlala zinegunya lokuba ngababambiqhaza baseNingizimu Afrika, futhi akudingeki ukuthi zifake isicelo sokuhlala njalo. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya noma ehhovisi lemboni yaseNingizimu Afrika uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Nikeza isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Ngokwesimo sakho sezimali, abazali bakho bangase badinge ukufaka i-affidavit yokuxhaswa kwezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi.
Lo mkhakha usebenza kumuntu ongaphandle oneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-21 oyiwumntwana wombuso waseNingizimu Afrika noma onamalungelo okuhlala permanently. Iphasi lempilo yokuhlala liyanikezwa ngezimo zokuthi lizophela eminyakeni emibili, kuqala ngosuku olufika khona eminyakeni engu-21, ngaphandle kokuthi kufakwe isicelo sokwandisa isimo sokuhlala. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi lemboni yaseNingizimu Afrika uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Abazali kumele banikeze ubufakazi bokuba ngababusi noma ukuba namalungelo okuhlala permanently eNingizimu Afrika ngokuhambisa imibhalo yokwaziswa noma amaphasi okuhlala permanently. Ukuze kukhombise ubufakazi bokuba ngumzali, hlanganisa isitifiketi sokuzalwa komntwana. Abazali kumele benze ukuzibophezela ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekelela labo abazoze babe nezindawo zokuhlala eziphakeme futhi abafuna ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala okuphakeme ngenxa yokuba yilunga lomndeni wesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala okuphakeme njengenyathelo lokuqala ebudlelwaneni. Ngokuhloswe ukuthola ilungelo lokuhlala okuphakeme, amalunga omndeni njengenyathelo lokuqala ebudlelwaneni achazwa njengalabo abangamalunga egazi noma izingane ezinikwe ngokomthetho ubuholi yinkantolo noma abazali abazothatha ngokomthetho ukunakekela zona noma abazali ngenxa yokufa noma ukuhlukana kwabazali. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya noma ehhovisi lesiNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Isakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma umhlali ophakeme kumele anikeze isitatimende sokuzibophezela mayelana nezimali, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, nokunakekela umfaki-sicelo. Nokho, uma umndeni ungumzali wezingane ezincane, akudingeki ukwenza isitatimende sokuzibophezela. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi.
Le nsizakalo isebenza kumuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika; noma kumuntu osevele enevumelekile yokusebenza ibhizinisi ezweni; noma kumuntu ofuna ukufaka imali ebhizinisini elikhona ezweni. Izicelo zingafakwa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi esifundazweni lapho ibhizinisi lihlelwe khona. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Umphakathi wezimali ophumelelayo okhulumela wena kufanele uthumele isiqinisekiso sokuthi inani elibekwe phansi lingempela lilingana nomkhawulo obekwe kumadokhumenti ebhizinisi. Umkhawulo wenani elizobekwa phansi ubekwe ku-R2.5 million, futhi le mali ingabekwa eceleni noma yehliswe kuphela uma izohlangabezana nezidingo zendawo, noma uma iceliwe yiMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuthi kwenziwe njalo. Uma ukuhlala okungapheli kunikezwa, isiqinisekiso somphakathi wezimali kufanele sihlaziywe njalo eminyakeni emibili ngemuva kosuku lokukhishwa kwemvume yokuhlala okungapheli, futhi eminyakeni emithathu elandelayo. Ukungahambisani nale mfuneko kuzoholela ekutheni imvume yakho yokuhlala okungapheli ibuyiswe. Umthetho Wokufuduka, 2002, njengoba ushintshiwe. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu service.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekiselwa kumuntu ongaphandle ofisa ukuhlala emuva eNingizimu Afrika. Akukho umkhawulo weminyaka obekiwe. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle noma ehhovisi lemboni laseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo sifakwa phesheya. Kufanele uhlinzeke ubufakazi kuMnyango Wezangaphandle bokuthi unelungelo lokuthola umhlalaphansi, umhlalaphansi ongeniswe emuva ngonyaka, noma i-akhawunti yokuhola umhlalaphansi ezokunikeza umkhawulo ophakanyisiwe we-R20,000 ngenyanga. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kufanele uhlinzeke ubufakazi kuMnyango Wezangaphandle bokuthi unempahla engahlanganiswa ukuze ikwazi ukukhiqiza imali engu-R20,000 ngenyanga. Akukho umkhawulo wesikhathi obekiwe kulolu sevisi.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekisela kumuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala okuphakade ngoba unikezwe umsebenzi ophakade eNingizimu Afrika. Isicelo kumele sibe ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ethile yonyaka ngezikhathi ezithile. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo senziwa ngaphandle. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29E, ukhombise isikhundla kanye description yomsebenzi njengoba kukhangiswe ngendlela echaziwe. Akufanele kubandakanye umuntu ongumCitizen waseNingizimu Afrika noma umphakathi ophakade owayezokwazi ukufaneleka kulolu sikhundla. UMnyango Wezabasebenzi kumele uqinisekise ukuthi imigomo nemibandela yomsebenzi ayiphakeme kunezikhungo ezikhona, futhi ukuthi zikhona kulolu hlobo lomsebenzi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nalabo abanamalungelo okuhlala okuphakade. Ngokwenza lokhu, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi kumele uhlinzeke ngama-akhawunti okuxoxisana phakathi kwabasebenzi nabaphathi kanye nezinye izigaba ezisebenza ezimbonini nasezindaweni. Akukho sikhathi esichaziwe salolu sevisi. Amandla okuphatha mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala kwesikhashana noma sokuhlala okuphakade, i-BI-29E.
Iphasi lemvume yokuthatha umhlalaphansi linikezwa umuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukuthatha umhlalaphansi eNingizimu Afrika. Nikeza ubufakazi bokuthi unengeniso engaphezulu kuka-R25,000 ngenyanga evela emalini yokuthatha umhlalaphansi noma emalini yokuthatha umhlalaphansi engabuyiswanga, noma ezimpahleni ezingaphansi kuka-R15 million. Uma ufuna ukusebenza, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi akekho umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika noma umhlali ongakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yendawo ofaka kuyo isicelo. Nikeza inkontileka yokusebenza evela enkampanini ozosebenza kuyo enemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana naleyo nhlangano. Isethaphu yokuvakasha yokugomela umkhuhlane wombala ophuzi iyadingeka uma uhamba noma uhlose ukuhamba endaweni eyaziwa ngokuba nomkhuhlane wombala ophuzi. Lesi sitifiketi asidingeki uma uhamba, noma uhlose ukuhamba kule ndawo, noma uma isicelo senziwa eNingizimu Afrika. Khokha idiphozi. Le diphozi ngeke ibuyiselwe kumfaki-sicelo ngemuva kokuhamba noma ngemuva kokukhishwa kwemvume yakho. Idiphozi ingakhokhwa ngekhadi lesikhwama eliqinisekisiwe noma ngekhadi lesikweletu ezindaweni lapho le nsiza itholakala khona. Nikeza isitifiketi sokuhlola kwezepolitiki, kanye nezincwadi zezempilo noma ama-x-ray. Akudingeki ukuthi izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-12 kanye nabesifazane abakhulelwe babe nezincwadi zama-x-ray. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyi-30.
Uhlelo lokushintshanisa abafundi luyavunywa njengemvume enikezwa umfundi ongaphandle ofuna ukuthatha ingxenye kuphrojekthi ethile noma uhlelo. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lezakhamuzi noma emnyangweni waseNingizimu Afrika, oqinisekisa ukuthi le ndawo izobhekana nazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nalowo mfundi ngenkathi ekhuluma eRiphabhulikhi futhi ukuthi umfundi uyamukelwa ukuze abhaliswe. Iqinisekisa usuku lapho uhlelo luzosungulwa eNingizimu Afrika. Isicelo singathatha izinsuku ezingu-30.
Ithuba lokunakekela izingane liyindawo ebhalisiwe yokunakekela izingane. Izikhungo zokunakekela izingane zingafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali yenyanga evela kuhulumeni ukuze zisize ngezindleko zokusebenza ezikhungweni zokunakekela izingane. Inani lesikhwama sokwesekwa lihluka futhi lincike ezindlekweni zokusebenza zesikhungo, kanye nenani lezingane ezihlala lapho. Ubani ongafaka isicelo sokwesekwa kwemali? Izikhungo zokunakekela izingane ezibhalisiwe. Qedela ifomu ehhovisi lezinsizakalo zomphakathi eliseduze. Ifomu eliqediwe kumele lisayinwe nguMongameli weKomidi Lokuphatha kanye noMqondisi weSikhungo Sokunakekela Izingane esifakayo. Thumela isicelo kanye neziqinisekiso zokubhaliswa njenge-NPO nezitatimende zebhange kumnyango wezimali. Ukuxhaswa kwemali kutholakala endaweni yokunakekela izingane ezihlala lapho. Imali yokuxhaswa ikhokhwa endaweni, hhayi ezinganeni. Inqubo yokufaka isicelo izothatha ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu. Uma usuhambisile isicelo sakho, ubuqotho bayo buzohlolwa. Uma uMnyango ujabule ngesicelo, uzonikezwa imali. Isinqumo sisisekelo ekutholakaleni kwemali nasekudingeni kwalolu sevisi. Umnyango wezimali unikeza izimali zokuxhaswa ezinyangeni ezintathu, kuye ngokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yalolu sikhungo sokunakekela izingane. Le sevisi iyamahala futhi ayikhokhiswa. Amafomu okufaka isicelo atholakala ehhovisi lezinsizakalo zomphakathi eliseduze kanye noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi.
Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo sokwamukelwa njengomfuduki lunikezwa umfaki-sicelo ukuze wamukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala ngu muntu ophume ezweni lakubo ngenxa yokwesaba ukucwaswa, futhi ufuna futhi wamukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala - kulokhu eNingizimu Afrika. Umfaki-sicelo kumele afune ukuhlala ngenkathi isicelo sakhe sisaphenywa. Umfuduki uthola imvume engavuselelwa yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Le mvume iyasebenza izinsuku eziyi-14 futhi ivumela umnikazi wayo ukuba abike endaweni ethile yokwamukela abafuduki ebizwa ngeHhovisi Lokwamukela Abafuduki eduze ukuze afake isicelo sokuhlala. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala uthola isimo sokuba umfuduki kanye nokuvikelwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nabafuduki njengoba kubhalwe kwiMthetho Wabafuduki, 1998. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi olunembile, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezangaphandle. Ingxoxo yokuqala nomuntu yenziwa ngommeli owaziwa ngokuthi uMphathi Wokwamukela Abafuduki, futhi ifomu le-BI-1590 liqedelwa. Imvume yomfuduki iphrintiwe, isayinwe, isetshenziswe, bese iphumelelwa kumfuduki. Le mvume iyasebenza izinsuku eziyi-30, ivumela umfuduki ukuba ahlale eNingizimu Afrika okwethulwa. Le mvume ingavuselelwa kwezinye izinsuku eziyi-30 bese ibe yisikhathi esithathu. Ngaphambi kokuphela kwemvume, umfuduki kumele abike kwi-RRO ukuze enze ingxoxo yesibili, eyenziwa ngommeli owaziwa ngokuthi uMphathi Wokunquma Isimo Somfuduki. U-RSDO uqhubeka nokuhlola isicelo futhi enze isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala. Uma kwenziwa isinqumo sokwamukela, umfuduki kumele afake isicelo sekhadi le-ID elihlakaniphile kunoma iyiphi i-RRO ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-15. Ngemva kokuthola le khadi, umfuduki angafaka isicelo seSivumelwano Sokuhamba seZizwe eziManyanayo kunoma iyiphi i-RRO. Isimo sokuba umfuduki siyasebenza iminyaka emibili, kodwa umfuduki kumele athumele incwadi efuna ukubuyekezwa noma ukuvuselelwa kwesimo sakhe somfuduki ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemva kokuphela kwemvume yomfuduki. Umthetho Wokufuduka, 2002 njengoba ushintshiwe. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze zicubungulwe. Le sevisi iyamahala.
Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo sokwamukelwa njengomfokazi lwenziwa ngumfaki-sicelo ukuze wamukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala ungumuntu ophume ekhaya ngenxa yokwesaba ukuphathwa kabi, futhi ofuna futhi wamukelwe njengomuntu ofuna ukuhlala kulokhu eNingizimu Afrika. Umfaki-sicelo kumele afune ukuhlala ngenkathi isicelo sakhe sisaphenywa. Umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala uthola imvume yesikhashana yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Le mvume iyasebenza ezinsukwini eziyi-14 futhi ivumela umnikazi wayo ukuba abike endaweni ethile yokwamukela abafokazi eyaziwa njengeHhovisi Lokwamukela Abafokazi eduze ukuze afake isicelo sokuhlala. Umuntu ofuna ukuhlala ophumelelwe isimo sokuba umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala kanye nokuvikelwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wabafokazi, 1998. Uxoxiswano lokuqala nomuntu lwenziwa ngomphakathi owaziwa njengeMenenja Yokwamukela Abafokazi, futhi ifomu le-BI-1590 ligcwaliswa. Imvume yomfokazi ofuna ukuhlala iphrintiwe, isayinwe, igcotshwe, bese iphumelelwa kumfokazi ofuna ukuhlala. Le mvume iyasebenza ezinsukwini eziyi-30, ivumela umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala ukuba ahlale eNingizimu Afrika okwesikhashana. Le mvume inganwetshwa ngenye inyanga engu-30 bese kuba yizinyanga ezintathu. Ngaphambi kokuphela kwemvume, umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala kumele abike e-RRO ukuze enze uxoxiswano lwesibili, olwenziwa ngomphakathi owaziwa njengeMenenja Yokunquma Isimo Somfokazi. I-RSDO iqhubeka nokuhlola isicelo bese yenze isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala. Uma kwenziwa isivumelwano sokuhlala, umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala kumele afake isicelo se-ID smart card sabafokazi kunoma iyiphi i-RRO phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-15. Ngemuva kokuthola ikhadi, umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala angafaka isicelo seSivumelwano Sokuhamba seZizwe eziManyeneyo kunoma iyiphi i-RRO. Isimo sokuba umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala sikhona iminyaka emibili, kodwa umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala kumele athumele incwadi ecela ukubuyekezwa noma ukwandiswa kwesimo sakhe sokuba umfokazi ofuna ukuhlala ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwaleyo mvume yokuhlala. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze ziqedwe. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa futhi ayikhokhiswa. Isicelo sokuhlala, amafomu e-BI-1590 awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Iphasiwedi yesikhashana ikhishwe kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abadinga ukuhamba ngokuphuthumayo futhi bengakwazi ukulinda ukuthi iphasiwedi ejwayelekile ikhishwe. Iphasiwedi yesikhashana iyasebenza isikhathi esingama-12 months. Uma ufaka isicelo sephasiwedi yesikhashana, kufanele futhi ufake isicelo sephasiwedi yesikhathi eside. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Isitatimende esifungwayo sidingeka uma iphasiwedi yakho yaseNingizimu Afrika ilahlekile noma ibhujiswe. Kungathatha ezinsukwini ezi-5 kuya kwezi-10 zebhizinisi.
Uhlelo lokufaka isicelo sepaspoti yokuvakasha luyidokhumenti edingekayo uma uvakashela kwelinye izwe noma ubuya eNingizimu Afrika. Ipasipoti yokuvakasha inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 nangaphezulu. Ivalidi ukuhamba kuwo wonke amazwe ngaphandle uma kukhona imibhalo ethile ekhombisa ukungavunyelwa. Ivalidi iminyaka eyishumi kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa. Kufanele ube ne-ID noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa ukuze ufake isicelo. Izicelo ze-paspoti yokuvakasha ne-ID zingafakwa ngesikhathi esisodwa ne-paspoti yokuvakasha uma ungakwazi ukulinda. Qedela ifomu le-BI-73 bese ulithumela mathupha ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Lethwa kwi-Embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emsebenzini uma ufaka isicelo ngaphandle kwelizwe. Izithombe zakho zeminwe zizothathwa ukuze kubhaliswe ulwazi lwakho kuM register wePopulashini. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-paspoti. Ipasipoti ingakhishwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisithupha.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika noma abahlali abaphakade abashintshile ubulili babo ngaphambi kokuthi umthetho weBhidi neMibhalo Yokufa, 1992, uqale ukusebenza, bangafaka isicelo sokushintsha ubulili babo. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-526E kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma emishinini uma ungekho ezweni. Thola isitifiketi sokuzalwa. Uma umuntu enezinhlangothi ezithile ezishintshiwe ngezinqubo zokuhlinzwa noma ukwelashwa kwehormone, bangathumela imibiko echaza uhlobo nemiphumela yenqubo eyenziwe noma ukwelashwa okusetshenziswe noma okukhishwe odokotela abahlinzile noma abaphatha lokho ukwelashwa. Kulolu hlobo, nikeza umbiko ochaza ubulili bamanje bomuntu, obuhambisana nesicelo. Lo mbiko kumele wenziwe udokotela ophenyile isicelo ukuze aqinisekise ubulili abavela kubo. Thola umbiko ophume ku-psychiatrist owanikeze iseluleko, unikeze ulwazi oluphelele ngalesi sihloko, ikakhulukazi umlando walo, kanye nesimo umuntu abukeka sikhona mayelana nemizwa yabo nemicabango mayelana nokushintsha. Uma isicelo sinesikhathi esingama-16 noma ngaphezulu, kufanele kufakwe isicelo sokuhlonza esihlukile. Izithombe zezimfanelo kumele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngokomthetho, futhi ulwazi olusha kumele lungene kwi-database ye-HANIS. Le sevisi ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-8. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lakho lezempilo eliseduze.
Umuntu ongumzali waseNingizimu Afrika ngokokhokho ungumuntu owazalwa ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika kumzali okungenani oyedwa owayengumzali waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuzalwa kwezingane kumele kubhaliswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwezokuzalwa Nezokufa, 1992. Qedela ifomu le-BI-24. Abazali abanguMazwe aseNingizimu Afrika kumele baqedele ifomu le-BI-529. Mayelana nokutholwa, kumele uhambisane nesinqumo sokutholwa. Thumela ikhophi yesitifiketi sokuzalwa sangaphandle. Thumela amakhophi ezitifiketi zomshado zomfakisicelo nabazali. Uma umfakisicelo ezalwa ngaphandle komshado, bobabili abazali kumele basayine ifomu lokubhaliswa kokuzalwa le-BI-24. Thumela ubufakazi uma umzali waseNingizimu Afrika ethole ubuzwe phesheya. Thumela ubufakazi bokuzalwa komzali waseNingizimu Afrika. Izicelo zingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane leziphathimandla.
Le nsizakalo ibheka ukuthi umfaki-sicelo ngempela ungum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika ngaphambi kokuthi anikezwe idokhumenti yokukhomba. Lokhu kusebenza kubantu abangu citizen baseNingizimu Afrika kuqala ngaphambi kokuhamba phesheya bese befisa ukuvuselela isimo sabo sokuba ngu citizen. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo sifakwa ngaphandle kwezwe. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-529. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-1664 ukuze ugweme ukulahlekelwa ilungelo lakho lokuba ngu citizen waseNingizimu Afrika. Imininingwane yomfaki-sicelo iqinisekiswa kuluhlu lwabantu abahlala ezweni. Izicelo zingathatha isikhathi sokucubungula esingamaviki ayeight kuya kweyishumi nambili.
Lo mbhalo uhlose abantu abafaka izicelo zokuhlala okuphakade abangakwazi ukuthola ipasipoti ezweni labo, noma abangenamhlaba noma ababaleki abafuna ukufuduka. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma emsebenzini uma uphOutside kwezwe. Nikeza ubufakazi bokuthi ungum resident ophakade lapho ufaka izicelo. Izingcwephe zakho azizothathwa ukuze zirekhodwe kwi-register yokuhlala kwabantu kazwelonke. Futhi thumela nezithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-pasipoti. Le sevisi ingathatha izinsuku eziyi-6 ukuze iphumelele.
Umuntu ongumZulu ofuna ukuba nesimo sokuba ngum citizen wezinye izwe kumele afake isicelo eMnyangweni Wezangaphakathi ukuze aqhubeke nokuba ngum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika ngenkathi ethola isimo sokuba ngum citizen wezinye izwe. Ukuba ne-citizenship ephindwe kabili kusho ukuthi umuntu ubhekwa njengom citizen wezizwe zombili. Isimo se-citizenship ephindwe kabili sinikezwa abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-21. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma le-mission uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-1664 kanye ne-BI-529 kunoma yisiphi isikhungo seMnyangweni Wezangaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Thumela idokhumenti yokuzazisa esebenzayo. Kungathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili ukuze kuqedwe.
Uhlelo lokungalahlekelwa ubuzwe bakho lungelakho, lwasiza abezwe laseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqhubeke nokuba ngabeziNtu zaseNingizimu Afrika noma ngabe baphendukela kubuzwe besinye isizwe. Uhlelo lungafakwa ehhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Faka uhlelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emsebenzini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Gcwalisa amafomu okusebenza ku-inthanethi: BI-1664 no-BI-529. Thumela ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesitifiketi sakho sokuzalwa saseNingizimu Afrika, kanye ne-affidavit eqinisekisiwe evela kummeli, ethi awunayo enye ubuzwe kwenye indawo. Zonke izinkampani zamadokhumenti kanye nesitatimende esiqinisekisiwe kufanele ziqinisekiswe umuntu ogunyaziwe ukwenza izinkontileka zomthetho, kungaba uMphakathi Oqinisekisiwe noma uMphakathi Wokufungisa. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abalahlekelwe amalungelo abo okubuzwe ngemuva kokuthola ubuzwe besinye isizwe, ngenkathi bengengabantu abancane ngokomthetho, futhi ngaphandle kokufaka isicelo sokulahlekelwa ubuzwe ngaphambi kokuba babe ngabeziNtu besinye isizwe, bangafaka isicelo sokukhululwa emthwalweni. Kumele bagcwalise amafomu okusebenza ku-inthanethi: BI-1666 no-BI-529. Kumele bathumele ikhophi yesitifiketi sobuzwe besinye isizwe. Thumela ikhophi eqinisekisiwe ye-ID yaseNingizimu Afrika noma ipasipoti, noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa saseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izinkampani zamadokhumenti kufanele ziqinisekiswe umuntu ogunyaziwe ukwenza izinkontileka zomthetho, kungaba uMphakathi Oqinisekisiwe noma uMphakathi Wokufungisa. Le sevisi ithatha izinsuku ezi-5 zokusebenza.
Ukwelashwa okuhlukile kokukhululwa kwentela kunikezwa ezinhlanganweni ezingekho phansi kwemali ezisungulwe ukuze zibe nezinzuzo zomphakathi. Nokho, lokhu kukhululwa kwentela kuzotholakala kuphela ezinhlanganweni ezihambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wezinhlangano Ezingezi Nenzuzo, 1997, kanye neminye imithetho ehlobene. Inkampani ngaphansi kweSigaba 21 seMthetho Wamakampani, 1973. Itrust enedokhumenti yokusungula kanye nedokhumenti ye-trust, ebhaliswe noMphakathi Wenkantolo Ephezulu. Okubizwa ngokuthi ukuhlangana kwabantu, okuqondiswa umthethosisekelo. Lapho idokhumenti yokusungula ingahambisani nezinhlinzeko zeSigaba 30 seMthetho Wezinhlangano Ezingezi Nenzuzo, 1997, isicelo kumele sihambisane neposi elibhalwe phansi lokuhlose elisayiniwe ngumfaki-sicelo. Ukukhululwa ngaphansi kwezibopho zangaphambili kuzophumelela kuze kube umfaki-sicelo unikeze isaziso kuMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokuhambisana nomthetho omusha. Ezinhlanganweni okwamanje ezingakhululeki enteleni yokwenzela imali zingathumela ifomu lesicelo eliphelele, kanye nemibhalo edingekayo yokwesekwa, kanye nephepha elibhalwe phansi lokuhlose lapho abantu bezimali bekulungele ukusebenza ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeSigaba 30 seMthetho Wezinhlangano Ezingezi Nenzuzo, 1997, ekuhlanganyeleni kwabantu: Thumela ikhophi yakamuva yomthethosisekelo. Ezinhlanganweni ezisungulwe ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngama-scholarship, ama-bursaries, nezindondo zokufunda, ucwaningo, kanye nokufundisa, ngaphezu kwemibhalo yokwesekwa okukhulunywe ngenhla, kumele futhi kuthunyelwe iphepha elibhalwe phansi lokuhlose le-EI 3 Written Undertaking. Yonke imibhalo ethunyelwe kuMnyango Wokukhululwa Kwentela enemininingwane efanele kanye nemibhalo edingekayo yokwesekwa izokwamukelwa ngerekhodi elikhishwe ikhompyutha phakathi kwezinsuku ezine ezivela ngosuku lokuthumela. Le sevisi ayikhokhiswa futhi ayidingi ukukhokhwa.
Umthwali wezintela angafaka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi sokuhambisa ifomu lakhe lokubuyisela izintela. Uma ikheli lomthwali wezintela lingaziwa yiMnyango Wezintela waseNingizimu Afrika. Uma irekhodi yomthwali wezintela ingakhombisi ukuthi ubhalisiwe. Uma inkampani noma ubudlelwano bungakhombisi ukuthi kusebenze. Uma umthwali wezintela eshintshe indawo. Uma irekhodi yomthwali wezintela ikhombisa ukuthi ushonile, noma usebenzisa zonke izimali zakhe. Uma imibhalo yezintela yale nyaka ingakatholwanga yiMnyango wezintela. Uma iMnyango wezintela ithumele incwadi ephuthumayo icela umthwali wezintela ukuthi ahambise imibhalo yakhe yezintela ngonyaka othile. Uma imibhalo yezintela ingakathunyelwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo sesidlule. Uma inani lezintela lingakakhokhwa futhi izinhlelo zokwandiswa kwesikhathi zingakwenziwanga. Uma imibhalo yezintela yale nyaka ingakakhishwa yiMnyango wezintela. Uma umthwali wezintela engabophelelwe ukukhokha izintela zonyaka lowo. Uma umuntu efaka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi ngaphezu kwesikhathi esibekiwe uma kubhekwa izimo zomthwali wezintela. Uma amarekhodi omthwali wezintela ehlonyiswe kwenye isigaba. Uma imibhalo yezintela noma inani le-VAT lingakakhokhwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo sesidlule noma engakaceli ukwandisa isikhathi sokuhambisa inani le-VAT. Uma isitatimende se-PAYE, noma imibhalo yezintela noma inani lezintela lingakathunyelwa futhi umthwali wezintela engakaxhumani neMnyango wezintela, futhi isikhathi sokuhambisa le mibhalo nezitatimende sesidlule noma engakaceli ukwandisa isikhathi sokuhambisa inani lezintela. Faka isicelo sokwandiswa kwesikhathi sokukhokha izintela ngokuvakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-SARS noma nge-imeyili. Bhala incwadi ecela ukwandiswa kwesikhathi esikhethekile sokukhokha izintela, uyithumele ehhovisi le-SARS eliseduzane. Uma isicelo sivunyiwe, uzothola isaziso nge-imeyili, usebenzisa ikheli le-imeyili olinikezile. Uma ungahlinzeki ngekheli le-imeyili, ungaxhumana nehhovisi le-SARS eliseduzane ngemva kosuku olunye lokusebenza. Le nsizakalo iyamahala. Bhalisela ku-inthanethi.
Le nsizakalo iyatholakala kulabo abazofaka isicelo sokuhlala ngokungapheli ngenxa yokuba yilunga lomndeni wesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala ngokungapheli njengenyathelo lokuqala loxhumano. Ukuze uthole ilungelo lokuhlala ngokungapheli, amalunga omndeni njengenyathelo lokuqala loxhumano achazwa njengalabo abangabazali bomzimba noma izingane ezibekwe ngokomthetho yinkantolo ukuze zikhululeke noma abazali abazothatha ngokomthetho ukunakekela noma abazali ngenxa yokufa noma ukuhlukaniswa kwabazali. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphakathi noma ehhovisi lesithunywa saseNingizimu Afrika uma ufaka isicelo usuka phesheya. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Isakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma umhlali ongapheli kumele athumele isitatimende sokuzibophezela mayelana nezimali, ukwelashwa kwezempilo, nokunakekela umfakisicelo. Nokho, uma umndeni ungumzali wengane encane, akudingeki ukwenza isitatimende sokuzibophezela. Akukho sikhathi esibekwe kulolu sevisi.
Ukugcinwa kuyisibopho sokunikeza omunye umuntu, njengabantwana, ngokuhlinzeka ngezindlu, ukudla, izingubo, imfundo, kanye nezokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngamakhemikhali, noma ngezindlela ezifanele zokuhlinzeka umuntu ngalezi zinto ezidingekayo. Le msebenzi yomthetho ibizwa ngokuthi 'isibopho sokugcinwa' noma 'isibopho sokuxhasa'. Ubani onesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso? Isibopho sokugcinwa sihlinzekwa ngoxhumano lwezitho zomndeni, ukuvuma ingane engazalwanga ngawe, noma ngoshadile. Abazali noma abaphethe baphinde bafakwe kulokhu, noma ngabe abazali bashadile noma bengashadile. Nokho, lokhu kuyahluka kumacala ngamunye. Isibopho sokugcinwa kwesitho somndeni asihambisani kuphela nokuxhasa ingane. Isitho somndeni esikwazi ukuzixhasa singaziphatha kahle. Isitho somndeni esifuna uxhaso singase sibe nesimo sokuzixhasa. Yiziphi izindleko ezingacelwa? Ungafuna uxhaso ngesizathu esifanele sokuhlinzeka ingane noma umuntu onelungelo lokugcinwa ngezimo ezifanele zokuphila nokukhula kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezidingekayo ezifana nokudla, izingubo, nezindawo zokuhlala, kanye nokukhokhela izindleko zemfundo. Ijaji lingakhupha umyalo wokuthi ubaba akhokhele izindleko zokugcinwa kwengane kusukela ngosuku lokuzalwa kwengane kuze kube ngosuku umyalo ukhishwa. Ijaji lingaphinde likhuphule umyalo wokukhokhela izindleko zokwelashwa, noma lingakhupha umyalo wokuthi ingane ibhaliswe ohlelweni lwezokwelapha lwezimbangi ezithintekayo. Ukuze ijaji likhuphule umyalo ofanele nowokulingana, bobabili abathintekayo kumele banikeze ubufakazi bezindleko zabo. Umbono wakho mayelana nesimo sokuziphatha komzali oyedwa awuthinti ilungelo lengane lokugcinwa. Omunye wabo bangase babe nezinye izingane. Isibopho sakho sokugcinwa kwengane asithinti ilungelo lakho lokubona ingane; lezi zinto zithathwa njengemisebenzi ehlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingane zodwa azithinti isibopho sokugcinwa. Nokho, inani lokugcinwa okukhokhelwayo lingashintshwa ijaji uma omunye wabathintekayo efaka isicelo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo. Faka isicelo sokugcinwa ejajini elikhulu endaweni yakho. Uma ungabaza, ijaji lendawo lizokwazi ukukwazisa ukuthi iyiphi ijaji okufanele ufake isicelo sokugcinwa. Yiya ejajini elifanele bese ugcwalisa futhi uthumele Ifomu A: Isicelo somyalo wokugcinwa. Ngaphandle kwefomu egcwalisiwe, hlinzeka ngobufakazi bemali yakho engenayo nangezindleko, ezifana nezinkokhelo zokudla, ugesi, kanye/noma izinkokhelo zokuqashisa. Ijaji lizobeka usuku lokuthi wena nomphenduli bavele ejajini. Umphathi wezokugcinwa kanye nomphenyi bazohlola isicelo sakho futhi bahlola izimo zakho. Ijaji lizokhipha izimemo kumphenduli ukuze avele ejajini ngosuku oluthile ukuze kuxoxwe ngalesi sihloko. Umphenduli angakhetha ukuvuma ukukhokha ukugcinwa okuceliwe noma aye ejajini ukuze aphikise lesi sihloko. Uma umphenduli evuma ukukhokha ukugcinwa okuceliwe, ummagistrate uzobuyekeza imibhalo efanele. Ngemuva kwalokho, umyalo uzokhishwa, futhi isinqumo singaphinde sithathwe ngaphandle kokuthi bobabili abathintekayo bavele ejajini. Uma umuntu ofanele ukukhokha ukugcinwa engavumi ukukhipha ukugcinwa, kumele avele ejajini, lapho kuzolalelwa ubufakazi bobabili abathintekayo. Uma ijaji lithola ukuthi ukugcinwa kumele kukhokhelwe, lizokhipha umyalo ochaza ukuthi mangaki okufanele akhokhwe. Ijaji lizophinde lichaze ukuthi nini nokuthi kanjani ukugcinwa kuzokhokhwa. Uzobhekwa ngokufana, ngedumela nokuqashelwa. Izikhalazo zizobhekwa ngokushesha ngendlela esebenzayo nebonakalayo. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Inqubo yonke, kusukela ekufakeni isicelo kuze kube sekutholeni izinkokhelo zokugcinwa, ingathatha amasonto ambalwa, kuye ngokubambisana kwababambiqhaza bobabili. Abafakizicelo abavela emhlanganweni, kuhlanganise nalabo abafuna ukugcinwa, bangathola inani elithile lokugcinwa nezindleko zokuhamba. Nokho, ijaji lizokwenza isinqumo ngokuhlonipha uma lezi zikhokhelo zizokhokhwa kumuntu owenze isicelo nokufaka isicelo somyalo. Umuntu ofuna ukugcinwa kumele afake isicelo kumphathi wezokugcinwa ngokukhokha izindleko zobufakazi. Le sevisi ayikhokhelwa futhi ayidingi ukukhokhwa.
Noma ubani onenhlalakahle engapheli eNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukufaka isicelo sokuba ngum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-naturalisation ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu yokuba ngum resident ophakeme. Noma ubani oshadile nom citizen waseNingizimu Afrika uyafaneleka ukuba ngum citizen wesinye isizwe ngemuva kweminyaka emibili kulandela ukuhanjiswa kwenhlalakahle engapheli etholelwe ngokushada. Izingane ezineminyaka engu-21 ezinokuhlala okuphakeme ziyafaneleka ukuba ngababusi besinye isizwe, uma ukuhlala kuphumelele ngokushesha ngemuva kokukhishwa. Qedela ifomu lokufaka isicelo le-BI-63 kanye ne-BI-757 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Faka isicelo ehhovisi le-embassy noma le-mission uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thumela imvume yokuhlala engapheli noma ukwehliswa. Qedela ifomu le-SAP kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe ukuze uthole isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka komphakathi. Thumela ifomu le-BI-9 eliqediwe kanye nesethi ephelele yokuthwebula izithombe zeminwe nezithombe ezimbili ezinomumo we-ID uma usukhulile kunezinyanga eziyi-15. Lokhu kuhloswe ukuthola ub identification ngemuva kokwamukelwa kwesicelo sakho sokuba ngum citizen wesinye isizwe. Umzali onengane angafaka isicelo egameni lezingane ezincane nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho ingane incane ihlala ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika. Abafakizicelo abamukelwe bazodingeka ukuthi basayine i-Declaration of Allegiance futhi bazonikezwa isitifiketi se-naturalisation, kanye nenombolo ye-R. Ubuqotho buzokwenziwa futhi buthunyelwe kumfakizicelo. Abafakizicelo abamukelwe bazokwaziwa ngokufanele. Izicelo zingathatha ezinyangeni ezi-2 kuya kwezi-4. Le sevisi iyamahala. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezeMisebenzi eliseduze.
Le nsizakalo itholakala kuphela kubantu abanamakhono noma iziqu ezivulekile.
