Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle noma ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo sifakwa ngaphandle kwelizwe. Akudingi ukubonisa ukuthi unikezwe umsebenzi kuleli. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Ukuze ubonise kwiMnyango ukuthi unamakhono noma iziqu ezivulekile, kufanele uthumele incwadi evela kumnyango wombuso wangaphandle noma waseNingizimu Afrika, noma esikhungweni semfundo esiqinisekisiwe nesezintsha eNingizimu Afrika, isikhungo somculo, noma inhlangano yebhizinisi eqinisekisa ukuthi unamakhono noma iziqu ezivulekile. Faka i-curriculum vitae nezinye iziqinisekiso zamakhono noma iziqu ezivulekile. Ukuze uqinise isicelo sakho, ungafaka nezitifiketi ezivela kubaphathi bakho bangaphambili. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevice. Amandla okuphatha mayelana nesicelo/sokwandiswa kwesivumelwano sokuhamba noma sokuhlala okwesikhashana mayelana nesicelo sokuhlala okwesikhashana noma okuphakade.
Le nsizakalo iyatholakala kumuntu osekwamukelwe njengomfuduki ofuna ukufuduka eNingizimu Afrika. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leziMisebenzi Zasendlini eliseduzane endaweni okukhona kuyo. Kufanele ube sebandleni labafuduki iminyaka emihlanu ukuze ufake isicelo. Thola ukuqinisekiswa okuvela kwiKomidi Elimisiwe Lezindaba Zobafuduki, okukhombisa ukuthi kubonakala ukuthi uzohlala unguMfuduki okudingayo ukufuduka. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29E. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi.
Le nsizakalo iyabhekelela umuntu ongaphandle ofuna ukusungula ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika; noma onenhlawulo yebhizinisi yokusebenza ebhizinisini kuleli; noma ofuna ukufaka imali ebhizinisini esivele ikhona kuleli. Izicelo zingafakwa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle ephakathi kwendawo lapho ibhizinisi lihlelelwe khona. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emishinini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Qedela ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 ne-BI-29. Umphakathi wezincwadi ozimele okhulumela wena kumele unikeze ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi inani elithunyelwe lilingana ngempela nenani elibekwe emibhalweni yebhizinisi. Inani elizothunyelwa libekwe ku-R2.5 million futhi le mali ingabekwa eceleni noma ikhululwe uma ihlangabezana nezidingo zelizwe, noma uma iceliwe nguMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Uma ukuhlala okungapheli kunikezwa, kumele uvuselele ukuqinisekiswa komphakathi wezincwadi njalo eminyakeni emibili ngemuva kosuku lokukhishwa kwephepha lokuhlala okungapheli, futhi kwezinye izinyanga ezintathu ngemuva kwalokho. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nale mfuneko kuzoholela ekutheni iphepha lakho lokuhlala okungapheli lihlukaniswe. Akukho sikhathi esibekwe kulolu sevisi. Amandla okuphatha mayelana nesicelo/sokwandisa iphepha lokufuduka noma ukuhlala okwesikhashana, i-BI-29.
Ngaphambi kokwenza izinto zokuphindaphinda izitshalo zohlobo oluthile, njengoba kuchazwe nguMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezithombo, 1976, okungathengiswa eNingizimu Afrika, ukuhlela kwezinhlobo ezinjalo kumele kufake phakathi okulandelayo okutholakala kuwebhusayithi: Uhlu lwezinhlobo. UMbutho Wezolimo ugcina uhlu lwezinhlobo ezibalulekile zezitshalo ezahlukene zokulima nezithelo. Ukubika izitshalo ngenhloso yokuhambisana nomthetho nokufakwa kwazo ohlelweni lwezinhlobo zezitshalo kwenziwa ngohlelo lokufaka isicelo. Okulandelayo kubalulekile ukuhweba kwezinhlobo zezitshalo emnothweni weNingizimu Afrika. Noma ubani noma inhlangano ingafaka isicelo sokwamukelwa kwenhlobo. Inhlobo iyamukeleka ukufakwa ohlelweni lwezinhlobo uma ihlangabezana nezidingo zendlela ye-DUS ehlanganisa okulandelayo futhi uma inhlobo inegama elamukelekayo - imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kumphakathi, uma ungungumthuthukisi, inhlobo ekhethiwe noma ethuthukisiwe. Sicela uchaze embuzweni ukuthi iyiphi inhlobo okufanele iqhathaniswe nanoma yiziphi izinhlobo ezaziwayo eNingizimu Afrika, izinhlobo ezintsha kumele ziqhathaniswe ukuze kubonakale umehluko wazo. Kukhona izinsuku ezibekiwe lapho imibhalo nezinto ezisetshenziselwa ukuphindaphinda kumele zithunyelwe kuMlawuli. Lezi zinsuku, izindleko zezinto zokwenza izinto zokuphindaphinda izitshalo, nendawo okufanele zithunyelwe khona zingatholakala uma ziceliwe kuMlawuli. Uma kuvunywa ukuvikelwa ngokulandela amalungelo abathuthukisi bezitshalo, abafaki izicelo baneliseka ukuthi bathumele izicelo ndawonye ukuze bagcine isikhathi nemali. Inqubo yokufakwa ohlelweni lwezinhlobo izothatha okungenani isikhathi sokutshala nokuqhakaza kwezithombo.
Le nsizakalo ihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungabhalisela ukuba umkhiqizi ngaphansi komthetho kanye nesivumelwano somthetho se-African Growth and Opportunity Act sase-United States of America kanye neSouth African Revenue Service. Umthetho uhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo ezithile ezizwakalayo ezizweni zase-Afrika ukuze ziqhubeke nomzamo wazo wokuvula umnotho wazo nokwakha emakethe ezikhululekile. Thola ifomu lesicelo ku-inthanethi noma ehhovisi lakho eliseduzane le-SARS. Ifomu lesicelo kumele liphothulwe ngumfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke processing. Sicela ubheke imihlahlandlela yesicelo ukuze ukukwazi ukusiza enqubweni yokuthola ilayisensi. Bheka umkhiqizi ebhokisini le-AGOA ngaphansi kokubhaliswa. Ikhodi yomgwaqo wesigaba lapho ibhizinisi likhona. Icala lokufaka isicelo kumele liphothulwe ngum owner yebhizinisi oyedwa, umqondisi, umlingani, ilungu, umtrustee, noma umphathi webhizinisi uma ufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa komkhiqizi okhethekile kwe-AGOA ukuze uthole izinkokhelo zokungenisa nezokuphuma. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ehambisa ibhizinisi, kumele kube yilo elivela kulolu hlobo. Lapho kukhona lesi simbolo (), susa okungafanele. Izifinyezo zamagama nesibongo somuntu ofaka isicelo se-layisensi. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Phetha ifomu lesicelo bese ulithumela ehhovisi lakho eliseduzane le-South African Revenue Service Customs and Excise. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwento yokuncishiswa 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10, kanye ne-607.04. Inkampani - bonke abaqondisi, kuhlanganise nomqondisi ongumphathi kanye nomqondisi wezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salensizakalo. Le nsizakalo itholakala mahhala. Uhlobo lweklayenti 4 - Umkhiqizi Ngaphansi kwe-AGOA, DA185. Imininingwane yokuphepha, DA185.
Zonke izihlanganisi ezingeniswe, ezakhiwe, noma ezithengiswa eNingizimu Afrika kumele zibhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokubhaliswa 36 ka-1947. Umfaki-sicelo kumele abe ngumuntu ongena emthethweni, isibonelo, uJohn Peter Citizen T/A owenza ibhizinisi ngaphansi kwegama: Diepsloot Stud. Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinkampani ezibhaliswe kuleli, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, noma inhlangano ebhaliswe ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika zingafaka isicelo sokuhlinzeka ngezihlanganisi. Izihlanganisi zeqembu lesi-2 ziqukethe ama-macro nama-micro organisms njengokwakhiwa okuyinhloko, okwaziwa nangokuthi izihlanganisi zemvelo. Usayizi wamabhakede noma ukupakisha ngeke kushintshwe ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe evela kuMlawuli. Isicelo sokudla kwezilwane nezihlanganisi kumele sihlanganise incwadi ehambisana nesicelo esivela kumfaki-sicelo noma kumuntu oqokwe ukuba amele umfaki-sicelo, isitifiketi sokuhlaziywa, noma ishidi ledatha. Amafomu okusebenza kumele athunyelwe ukuze kufakwe izicelo ezintsha kanye nezichibiyelo ezibhalwe phambilini, kuhlanganise nezinguquko ekwakhiweni; thumela amafomu amabili, ugcwalise kahle ifomu elilodwa ngaphandle kokubhekisela ezicelweni zangaphambilini, izinombolo zamakhasi, noma eminye imikhiqizo. Okwesibili kungaba ikhophi. Umuntu oqokwe ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena ophakathi kokuxhumana noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu okusebenza. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa komkhiqizo kumele kusetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi isinguquko, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sikhulu kangakanani, sizobhekwa njengokuchibiyela. Thumela amafomu okusebenza ehhovisi lokuphatha. Ukuthumela amafomu kubeluleki bezobuchwepheshe kuzod delay inqubo. Bhala ngesiNgisi noma ngesiAfrikaans. Akudingeki ukuba kube nezimpawu eziprintiwe ngalezi zilimi zombili. Lonke ulwazi kumasigni kumele luhambisane ngokexactly nalokho okunikezwe efomini lesicelo. Thumela isicelo sakho kanye nezinkokhelo kuMlawuli weMthetho 36 ka-1947. Ukubhaliswa kwezihlanganisi kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu kuya kwezine.
Le nsizakalo inikeza ulwazi lokuthi ungabhalisela ukuba ngumthumeli ngaphandle kwelizwe neMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Ifomu lokufaka isicelo kumele liqedwe ngumfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke samukelwe. Sicela ubheke imihlahlandlela yokufaka isicelo ukuze ukwazi ukusiza inqubo yokuthola ilayisensi. Bheka ibhokisi le-Importer ngaphansi kokubhaliswa bese ubonisa ukuthi uzobe uthumela izimpahla e-United States of America ngaphansi kwesivumelwano se-AGOA. Ingxenye yeMvume yokufaka isicelo kumele igcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo uma efaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengomsebenzisi we-rebate. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ethengisa ibhizinisi, kumele kube yilowo ophakathi kwalesi sigaba. Lapho kukhona lesi sikhombisi (), susa lokho okungafanele. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Gcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo bese ulithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika eliseduzane. Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi esikhishwe nguMlawuli Wezinkampani noma uMphakathi Wenkantolo uma kunguMtrust. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwento ye-rebate 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10, kanye no-607.04. Ibhizinisi - bonke abaphathi, kuhlanganise noMphathi Omkhulu noMphathi Wezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salensizakalo. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala. Uhlobo Lwabathengi Bokubhaliswa 4A2 - Umthumeli, DA 185.
Le nsizakalo ihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungabhalisela kanjani njengomthumeli wezimpahla ezivela phesheya neMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Ifomu lesicelo kumele liqedwe ngumfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke processing. Sicela ubheke iziqondiso zesicelo ukuze usize ekwenzeni izimvume. Bheka ibhokisi le-Importer ngaphansi kokubhaliswa nokuthi uzothumela imibhalo uqobo noma uqashe ummeli ukuze enze kanjalo. Ingxenye yeMvume Yokufaka isicelo kumele igcwaliswe ngumuntu ofaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengomthumeli wezimpahla ezivela phesheya. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ehlinzeka ngalo msebenzi, kumele kube igama elivela kule ngxenye. Uma kukhona uphawu (), susa noma yini engasebenzi. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama nesibongo somfaki-sicelo wesivumelwano. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyaziwe. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo bese ulithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika eliseduzane. Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi esikhishwe nguMlawuli Wezinkampani, noma uMphakathi Wenkantolo uma kuyisikhwama. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwesigaba sokwehliswa 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10 no-607.04. Inkampani - bonke abaphathi, kuhlanganise nomphathi ophakathi nendawo nomphathi wezomnotho. I-SARS isungule amazinga afanele okuphatha ibhizinisi azosungulwa eminyakeni emibili ezayo kusukela ngo-2004 kuya ku-2007. Uma ubhalisela noma ukhokha, i-SARS ihlose ukuphatha ukubhaliswa kwakho ngqo ezinsukwini eziyi-21 zokusebenza. Le nsizakalo iyatholakala mahhala. Uhlobo lweklayenti lokubhaliswa - Umthumeli, DA 185.
Le nsizakalo inikeza ulwazi lokuthi ungafaka kanjani isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwentela kanye nosizo lwezezimali oluvela kwiMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubuyiselwa kwentela kuyancipha enteleni ekhokhwayo ezimpahleni ezingenisiwe uma uthenga izimpahla. Umfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu, kumele aqedele ifomu lesicelo; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke processed. Esiqeshini sezinhlobo zamakhasimende, bhalisela ibhokisi lokubuyiselwa kwentela esigabeni sokubhaliswa. Ikhodi yomgwaqo wesigaba lapho ibhizinisi likhona. Esiqeshini seMvume yokufaka isicelo, kumele sigcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo uma efaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengomsebenzisi wokubuyiselwa. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ethengisa ibhizinisi, kumele kube igama elivela kulesi sigaba. Lapho kukhona le uphawu, susa okungafanele. Izimpahla ngaphansi kwezibalo zokubuyiselwa 3, 4. Incazelo yezimpahla ezingenisiwe. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Abatshalizimali, Izinkampani Ezinqunyiwe, kanye Neziqinisekiso - Bonke Ozakwethu/Abatshalizimali/Abaphathi. Inkampani - Bonke abaphathi, kuhlanganise noMphathi Omkhulu kanye noMphathi Wezezimali. Abasebenzi be-SARS banikeza izindinganiso nezikhathi zokulethwa kwesevisi ngokuhambisana neSivumelwano Sezesevisi ezizosebenza ngo-2007. Le nsizakalo iyamahala. Uhlobo lwamakhasimende lokubhaliswa - Umsebenzisi Wokubuyiselwa, DA185.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlose ukufaka isicelo sokuba ngababusi kwelinye izwe elingavumeli ubudlelwano bezwe obuphindwe kabili kufanele bafake isicelo sokukhansela ubuzwe babo baseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ngeke usabe ngumuntu waseNingizimu Afrika kusukela emmomentini isicelo sakho samukelwa. Izingane ezincane nazo ngeke zibe ngabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle uma abazali bazo babe ngabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Qedela amafomu BI-246, BI-529, kanye ne-BI-9 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emisebenzini uma uphume ezweni. Thumela wonke amadokhumenti okukhomba aseNingizimu Afrika ehhovisi lezeMisebenzi, emibhalweni, noma emisebenzini. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezinomumo wephasi. Le nsizakalo ingathatha amasonto angu-8 kuya kwangu-12. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Uma ulahlekelwe noma uthole iphasiport yakho, ungafaka isicelo sokuthi uthole entsha. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMali eNingizimu Afrika. Faka nezithombe ezimbili ezinesayizi sephasiport. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMali eNingizimu Afrika. Akudingeki ukuthi kuthathwe izithupha ezinganeni ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-16. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing. Phinda kabili intela yamanje yedokhumenti ethinta: Kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi lapho idokhumenti ilahlekile/itholiwe/ilimazekile ngaphandle kokunganaki komnikazi, kuzokwenziwa kuphela imali ejwayelekile.
Noma ubani oseke waba ngum citizen ngokuzalwa noma ngokuhlala, osevele waphuma emhlabeni wokuba ngum citizen noma osephumelele, angafaka isicelo sokubuyela futhi abe ngum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika. Qedela amafomu wesicelo BI-175 no-BI-529 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-9 futhi unikeze izithombe ezimbili ezincane ezifanele ipasipoti. Faka incwadi eqinisekisa ukuthi umfaki-sicelo uhlala eNingizimu Afrika. Faka ikhophi yesitifiketi sokuhlangana, uma sitholakala. Izicelo zingathatha amasonto ayisithupha kuya kweyisishiyagalombili. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lezeMisebenzi eliseduze.
Umhlaba wezolimo ongathengwa kuhulumeni uthengwa ngenhloso yokulima, futhi ungase ungabi nethuba lokuthengiswa, kuye ngaleso sikhathi somhlaba. Izivumelwano zokuhlala nezinketho zokuthenga zihlaziywa njalo eminyakeni emithathu. Iphondo Lezolimo linomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha kahle nokuthengisa umhlaba wezolimo kahulumeni, otholakala ngaphansi kweBhodi Yezikweletu Zolimo. Lapho umhlaba wezolimo kahulumeni utholakala ukuze uthenjwe, Iphondo Lezolimo lishicilela izikhangiso ngokufaka izaziso ezindaweni ezibalulekile endaweni, ezifana namahhovisi omasipala, iziteshi zamaphoyisa, nasemabhodini wezaziso. Izicelo zenziwa kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kuzaziso. Umphathi Omkhulu Wezokuhlala Kwabalimi ehhovisi likamasipala ubheka ukuhlinzekwa kwezindawo ze-FALA, uma lokhu sekuvunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezolimo Nezindaba Zomhlaba. Ukuhlinzekwa kwezindawo kwenziwa ngokulandela ifomula ehlinzeka ngentengo ephelele yomhlaba.
Idokhumenti yokuhlonza yomphakathi iyidokhumenti eqinisekisa ubuzwe bomuntu. Ikhishwe kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika noma kubahlali abaphelele abaneminyaka engu-16 nangaphezulu. Kubantu abalahlekelwe, abathathwe, noma abathintekayo ngempahla yabo. Kubantu abafaka isicelo sokushintsha imininingwane yabo. Kubantu abashintshile isimo sabo sibe sobuzwe. Kubafazi abangena emshadweni, noma labo abafisa ukubuyela ezibhengezo zabo zokuqala. Kubantu abahlala phesheya kwesigodi okwesikhashana kodwa abanedokhumenti yokuhlonza. Kubantu ababuya phesheya kwesigodi abanemvume yokuhlala engapheli evumelekile. Qedela ifomu lesicelo le-BI-9 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emnyangweni uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thumela isitifiketi sokuzalwa noma ipasipoti endala ekhishwe ngaphambi kosuku lukaJulayi 1, 1986. Thumela izithombe ezimbili ezincane ze-pasipoti. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuthathwa izithupha zakho ukuze zirekhodwe ku-rejista yokuhlala kwabantu. Nikeza isitifiketi somshado uma ushade. Owesifazane ofaka isicelo sedokhumenti yokuhlonza ofisa ukubuyela ezibhengezo zakhe zokuqala kumele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokusebenzisa lezo zibhengezo. Umuntu obuyela phesheya kwesigodi ofaka isicelo sedokhumenti yokuhlonza kumele futhi athumele imvume yakhe yokuhlala engapheli, noma isitifiketi sokwamukelwa, noma isitifiketi sokukhululwa ngaphansi kwemibandela. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze nomnyango oseduzane nawe.
Ukuzalwa kwengane eyazalwa ngaphandle komshado kubhalisela igama likababa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Qedela ifomu lokusebenza le-BI-193 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lezeMisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo ehhovisi lemboni noma emisebenzini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Thola imvume ebhalwe phansi kukababa ukuze ingane ithathe igama lakhe. Imvume ebhalwe phansi kubazali bobabili iyadingeka kanye nezizathu ezanele ezibhaliwe zokushintsha. Imvume kukababa ngesikhathi sokuzalwa iyadingeka, ngaphandle uma lokhu kukhanseliwe yinkantolo. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha.
Ukwenza umshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiko kulawulwa umthetho wesiko wombango. Uma umyeni eshintsha umthetho futhi efuna ukushada omunye umkakhe, abanye abashadile bazovunyelwa ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Umshado kumele uhlelwe, kumele kube nomcimbi, futhi kumele wenziwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesiko. Abafakizicelo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kumele bathole incwadi kumholi wesiko. Abafakizicelo abahlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kumele banikeze isitatimende esiqinisekisiwe ngendlela ye-affidavit. Ukuze umshado ube khona, bobabili abashadayo kanye nezithunywa ezivela emindenini yomabili kumele babe khona.
Ishadi lokufa liyidokhumenti esemthethweni elikhishwe kumndeni woshonile uma kubhaliswa ukufa komuntu. Uma umphakathi ongaphandle efela eNingizimu Afrika, irekhodi liphothulwa futhi ishadi lokufa likhishwa kumndeni. Izicelo zingafakwa ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya noma ehhovisi le-embassy noma umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika uma isicelo sithunyelwa phesheya. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezasekhaya. Qedela ifomu le-BI-132. Bhala incwadi enemininingwane yomuntu oshonile bese uyithumela ehhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya eliseduze uma kungekho ihhovisi leMnyango Wezasekhaya endaweni yakho. Akukho ukufakwa komhlaba okuzokwenzeka ngaphandle kwe-oda yokufaka umhlaba. I-oda yokufaka umhlaba iyisitifiketi esivumela ukufakwa komhlaba nokuhanjiswa komzimba ukusuka endaweni yokufa ukuya endaweni yokufaka umhlaba. Kuphela abaphathi abhalisiwe abanegunya lokukhupha i-oda yokufaka umhlaba. Isitifiketi sokufingqa: Sikhishwa uma kubhaliswa ukufa. Isitifiketi esigcwele: Izicelo zingathatha phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili kuya kwezishiyagalolunye ukuze processing.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika noma abantu abahlala njalo abafuna ukushintsha amakheli abo okuhlala noma amakheli abo eposi bangafaka isicelo eMnyangweni Wezangaphandle kuNombolo Yabantu Kazwelonke. Izicelo zingafakwa nasezikhungweni zezwe laseNingizimu Afrika noma emaphandleni uma ufaka isicelo usuka ngaphandle kwelizwe. Bhala incwadi, uyithumele ngefeksi noma nge-imeyili, bese uyithumela kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ungagcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-4 futhi ufake kopi yokukhombisa ubunikazi bakho. Nikeza i-ID yakho yaseNingizimu Afrika enebhakhodi noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa uma ufaka isicelo. Izicelo zingathatha izinsuku eziyisithupha ukuze processing. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Isaziso sokushintsha ikheli, BI-4. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduzane ukuze uthole usizo.
Abafakizicelo abaneziqu zabo zokuhlonza ezinephutha bangathumela izicelo zokulungisa kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Izicelo zingaphinde zenziwe emahhovisi noma emisebenzini yaseNingizimu Afrika uma umfakizicelo engaphandle kwelizwe. Qedela amafomu e-BI-9, e-BI-526, kanye ne-BI-309 kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Faka isicelo ehhovisi noma emisebenzini uma ungaphandle kwelizwe. Nikeza ubufakazi bolwazi, njengencwadi yokuzalwa, incwadi yokushada, incwadi yesikole, noma i-affidavit. Faka izithombe ezimbili ezinomumo wephasiwedi nesicelo sakho. Ishadi lokungenisa lemidlalosemhlabeni elitholakala ezweni lidingeka lapho kuhanjiswa iziphuzo ezine-alcohol eNingizimu Afrika. Ishadi lokungenisa noma ikhophi yalo kuzodingeka ngaphambi kokuthi umthwalo ukhululwe epulazini lokungena. Umthengisi kufanele afake isicelo se-shadi lokungenisa lempahla. Ngemuva kwalokho, ishadi lokungenisa lingasetshenziswa, uma kungabikho shintsho ekwakhiweni, ngaphakathi, usayizi wephetshana, kanye nelebuli yaleyo mveliso. Lihloselwe ukusetshenziswa komuntu siqu kulowo muntu, umndeni wabo, kanye nezivakashi zabo ezingathengi leyo alcohol. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo. Isicelo esisodwa kufanele sibe ne-sampuli ye-750ml yomkhiqizo okukhuluma ngawo. Uma kukhulunywa ngokungeniswa kwamabhodlela, kufanele uthumele isampuli ebhodleleni elinlebhuli, njengoba ithengiswa. Thumela isampuli ye-alcohol engenisiwe ebhodleleni ejwayelekile ye-750ml. Thumela isampuli ehhovisi leMikhiqizo yeziqhamo eStellenbosch. Thumela isitifiketi sokuhlaziywa esikhishwe yelabhorethri esemthethweni yaleso sizwe esitholakala khona i-alcohol. Uma lokhu kungatholakali, iMikhiqizo yeziqhamo izokwenza ukuhlaziywa kwekhemikhali ngesampuli. Mayelana ne-alcohol engenisiwe emabhodlelweni, ilebuli yebhodlela izohlolwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ihambisana nezidingo zomthetho weziqhamo, iMthetho weMikhiqizo yeziqhamo, 1989. Ngokungeniswa okukhulu, umkhiqizo ofikayo uzohlolwa. Ilebuli ibhekwa uma ufaka isicelo sesitifiketi sokuthengisa. Umnyango kufanele ukhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi bakhiphe ishadi lokungenisa ezweni. Ishadi lokungenisa lizokhishwa uma ngaphakathi kanye nelebuli, mayelana nokungeniswa kwamabhodlela, kanye ngaphakathi, uma kukhulunywa ngokungeniswa okukhulu, kuhambisana nezidingo zeMthetho weMikhiqizo yeziqhamo, 1989. Umthwalo wemikhiqizo ungangeniswa. I-Division Quality Audit kufanele ixwayiswe amahora angama-48 noma nini uma umthwalo oneshadi elikhiphayo ufikiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Lapho i-alcohol ifika eNingizimu Afrika, abangenisi kufanele bathole iphasela kwi-Division Quality Audit ukuze bakhiphe i-alcohol epulazini eyangena, noma esikhungweni, ukuya lapho befisa ukuyithatha. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevice.
Yonke imfuyo yokudla ethunyelwa, ikhiqizwe, ikhiqizwe, noma ithengiswa eNingizimu Afrika kumele ibhaliswe kuMlawuli, ngaphansi koMthetho 36 ka-1947. Umfakisicelo kumele abe ngumuntu onemithetho, isibonelo, uJohn Peter Citizen, ophatha ibhizinisi ngaphansi kwegama elithi Diepsloot Stud. Inkampani yangaphandle ngeke ikwazi ukufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa eNingizimu Afrika. Ukudla kwezilwane akuhlanganisi umquba, isikhumba, ne-chaff, utshani obuphansi, isilage, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinhlanga zokholo, noma ezinye izithako zokudla kwezilwane ezilungiselelwe umnini wezinkomo ukuze zisetshenziswe nezilwane zakhe. Cela iziqondiso mayelana nezidingo zokudla kwezilwane kuMlawuli, uMthetho 36 ka-1947. Incwadi ehambisana nesicelo kumele ivela kumuntu obhalisiwe noma kumuntu oqokwe ukuba umele umuntu obhalisiwe. Amacheki athunyelwa kuphela ngaphandle kwesicelo kumele ahambisane nencwadi yokuchaza. Amacheki nezimfuno zeposi kumele abhalwe kuMphakathi Jikelele: Ezolimo. Thumela ifomu lesicelo sokufaka izicelo ezintsha kanye nezichibiyelo zokubhaliswa okukhona, kuhlanganise nezinguquko zokwakheka. Qedela ifomu ngokuphelele, ngaphandle kokubhekisela ezicelweni zangaphambilini, izinombolo zamakhasi, noma eminye imikhiqizo. Omunye angaba yikhophi. Umuntu osethelekile ngokomthetho, okumele abe yena ophatha ukuxhumana noMlawuli, kumele asayine amafomu wesicelo. Igama nenombolo yokubhaliswa komkhiqizo kumele isetshenziswe njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-sertifika yokubhaliswa. Noma yisiphi isinguquko, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sikhulu kangakanani, sizobhekwa njengokuphuculwa. Thumela amafomu wesicelo ehhovisi eliphethe. Ishadi lokufunda liyidokhumenti elinika abantu abangaphandle amalungelo okwenza izifundo ezikhululiwe ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme eNingizimu Afrika. Faka isicelo sakho emahhovisi e-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma eMishini. Qedela isicelo ku-form BI-159. Isitifiketi sokuhlola kwezepolitiki esiqinisekisa ukuthi ummangali akanacala lobugebengu ezweni abahlala kulo isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Incwadi kadokotela njengobufakazi bokuthi ummangali uphilile kahle. Abammangali ngeke bakwazi ukungena eNingizimu Afrika kuze kube izicelo zabo zamukelwe. Abammangali abamukelwe bazonikezwa i-visa evumela ukuba bangene futhi baphume ezweni nge-visa yokungena kabusha kaningi. Abancane kufanele banikeze imininingwane yomuntu ongumZulu waseNingizimu Afrika ozoba ngumgibeli. Le mininingwane kumele ihambisane nencwadi yokuvuma, ubufakazi bokuhlala obukhona bobabili abazali, noma kubazali abanye kuphela ongumgibeli, kanye nobufakazi bokuthi ungumgibeli kuphela.
Imvume yokusebenza ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano iyidokhumenti enikezwa abantu ababuya ngaphandle kokungena eNingizimu Afrika ukuze babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezivumelwene phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezizwe ezithintekayo kulezi zivumelwano. Gcwalisa ifomu BI - 1738 ehhovisi le-embassy yaseNingizimu Afrika noma emnyangweni oseduze. Incwadi evela kwinhlangano kahulumeni efanele esivumelwaneni, eqinisekisa uhlelo. Le ncwadi izoqinisekisa ukuvumelana kohlelo olusetshenziswa, ukubamba iqhaza komfakisicelo okukhulunywa ngaye kuhlu, kanye nemisebenzi elindelekile ezokwenziwa ngumfakisicelo ngaphansi kwesivumelwano. Isitifiketi sokuhlanzeka komphakathi somfakisicelo esivela kuzo zonke izizwe lapho umfakisicelo nabantu abaxhomeke kuye bahlala khona, kusukela eminyakeni engu-18, kanye nezingane ezixhomeke kuye ezineminyaka engu-18 nangaphezulu, ezizohamba nomfakisicelo ziye eNingizimu Afrika. Imibiko yezempilo kanye nemibiko ye-x-ray. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-12 kanye nabesifazane abakhulelwe kumele zibe nemibiko ye-x-ray. Incwadi yokuzibophezela evela kumqashi, lapho bevuma ukukhokhela izindleko zokubuyisela umfakisicelo, kanye nalabo abaxhomeke kubo uma kudingeka. Uma umqashi engumnyango kahulumeni futhi engakwazi ukukhipha le ncwadi yokuzibophezela, izwe elithumele lowo muntu lingakhipha le ncwadi yokuzibophezela. Amadokhumenti ahlobene nesimo somshado, i-affidavit yabantu abaxhomeke kumfakisicelo noma izingane ezincane ezixhomeke kumfakisicelo azizokwenza kube khona abantu abaxhomeke kubo nezingane. Isitifiketi sokugomela i-yellow fever uma uhamba noma uhlela ukuhamba endaweni eyaziwa ngokuba ne-yellow fever.

Amalungelo abathuthukisi bezitshalo anikezwa kuphela ezitshalweni ezithile, ezimemezelwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wamalungelo Abathuthukisi Bezitshalo ka-1976. Kukhona cishe izitshalo eziyi-290 ezihlanganiswe ohlwini, bheka iwebhusayithi: lapho amalungelo abathuthukisi bezitshalo anganikezwa khona. Izingxenye zezitshalo ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka ezingenziwa zathengiswa eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Kumele zibe ngezinhlobo zezihlahla, noma izintambo, izingxenye ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka, ezingatholakali kwezinye izindawo, ngokuhweba noma emiphakathini isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka eyisithupha, noma uma kukhulunywa ngohlobo lwezitshalo, iminyaka emine. Kumele zibe nezinhlobo ezifanayo, okusho ukuthi zonke izitshalo ezitshalwe ngesikhathi esifanayo kumele zibe nezinhlobo ezifanayo. Kumele zibe zizinzile, izitshalo ezithile, emva kokuphindaphinda ukutshala, kumele zihlale zifana nezitshalo zakudala. Kumele zibe ngezinhlobo ezamukelekayo. Bheka itafula 1 loMthetho Wamalungelo Abathuthukisi Bezitshalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhlobo lwezitshalo oludinga ukuvikelwa lukhulunywe. Uma uhlobo lwezitshalo lungekho etafuleni, thumela isicelo sokumemezela nencwadi echaza isizathu esivumelekile kuMlawuli Wamalungelo Abathuthukisi Bezitshalo. Imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kumnikazi, uma ungumthuthukisi ophindaphindayo, wuhlobo olukhethiwe noma olwakhiwe. Sicela uchaze embuzweni ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ezaziwayo eNingizimu Afrika lezi zihlobo kufanele ziqhathaniswe nazo, izinhlobo ezintsha kumele ziqhathaniswe ukuze kubonakale umehluko wazo. Ungafaka isicelo sokuvikelwa okwesikhashana kwalezi zihlobo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi lezi zihlobo zivikela ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa. Kumele unikeze ukuzibophezela okubhalwe phansi kokungathengisi noma yimaphi amamathiriyali okuhlinzeka ngohlobo lwezitshalo oluhlolwayo kuze kube sekupheleni kokuhlolwa konke futhi amalungelo okuhlinzeka ngalezi zitshalo anikezwa. Kuhle ukuba nokuvikelwa okwesikhashana kwezitshalo lapho izinhlobo zihlolwa ezithatha isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka. Kukhona izinsuku ezibekiwe lapho imibhalo namathiriyali ezingxenye ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka kufanele athunyelwe kuMlawuli. Lezi zinsuku, inani lamathiriyali okwakha amamathiriyali okuhlinzeka ngama plants, nokuthi kufanele athunyelwe kuphi, zingatholakala uma ziceliwe kuMlawuli. Uma uhlu lwezinhlobo lukhona lwezihlobo lwezitshalo olwenziwa isicelo samalungelo okuhlinzeka, thumela izicelo ndawonye zonke izikhathi nezindleko. Inqubo yokuhlola amalungelo okuhlinzeka ngezithombo zezitshalo ithatha cishe isikhathi sokutshala esisodwa.

Le nqubo yokufaka isicelo sokukhokha intela ithunyelwa kwiMnyango Wezemali weSewula Afrika, icela ukuthi imali ethile ebekwe eceleni engashintshiwe ikhawulwe emalini engenayo ethola umkhokhi wentela noma ethola ngonyaka. Qiniseka ukuthi izindaba zakho zentela ziqondile ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo sokukhokha intela. IMnyango Wezemali ngeke ikhiphe isikhumbuzo sokukhokha intela uma kusekhona imibhalo yokukhokha intela engakafakwa kwiSARS noma uma kusekhona imali yentela engakakhokhwa umkhokhi wentela. Kudinga isitatimende esikhombisa imali engenayo nezindleko ngemininingwane. Indlela oyisebenzisile ukubala inani lentela okufanele ukhokhe. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwe, uzokwaziswa ezinsukwini ezimbalwa, kodwa isikhumbuzo esisemthethweni sokukhokha intela sizothatha amasonto amane ukufika kuwe. Indlela elula yokufaka isicelo sokukhokha intela ukwenza lokhu nge-eFiling. Uma wenza kanjalo, isicelo sakho sizokwamukelwa ezinsukwini ezingama-48, uma ihhovisi lingafuni ubufakazi bezindleko. Kuzothatha amasonto amane ukucubungula isicelo sakho. Gcwalisa futhi uthumele ifomu lakho ku-inthanethi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, download futhi uqedele ifomu le-IRP 3.
Le mthetho ikhishwa lapho kwenziwa isicelo sokubeka inani elithile elizokwenziwa emholweni womuntu okhokhayo. Umqashi kufanele uthumele lesi sicelo egameni labasebenzi. Lezi ziqondiso azidluliselwa, futhi uma umqashi eshintsha isimo sokusebenza, kufanele kwenziwe isicelo esisha. Uma unamaqashi amaningi, isicelo seziqondiso kufanele senziwe kumqashi ngamunye. Amakhophi wezivumelwano zomsebenzi, izivumelwano zomsebenzi, neminye imibhalo efanele iyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe imigomo nemibandela yokusebenza. Iziqondiso zephesenti elithile zizokwenziwa isikhathi esingama-12 months futhi kufanele zihlaziywe ngemuva kwalokho. Qiniseka ukuthi izindaba zakho zentela zisesimweni esihle uma ufaka isicelo seziqondiso zentela. I-SARS ngeke ikhiphe isiqondiso sentela uma unenkokhelo yentela. Inombolo yokubhekisela ye-PAYE yomqashi wakho iyadingeka. Incwadi echaza kahle iyadingeka uma ungenayo inombolo ye-ID noma inombolo yokubhekisela ye-PAYE. Faka isicelo sakho seziqondiso zephesenti elithile mathupha ehhovisi le-SARS, njengoba umqashi kufanele athumele isitatimende seziqondiso zemiholo nezindleko. Uma isicelo sakho samukelwa yi-SARS, uzothola ukuqinisekiswa phakathi nezinsuku ezimbalwa. Nokho, isiqondiso esisemthethweni sentela singathatha cishe amasonto amane. Le nsizakalo iyamahhala futhi ayikhokhelwa.
Le nqubo ithunyelwa kwiMisebenzi yeZimali yaseNingizimu Afrika uma kudingeka umyalo wentela mayelana nenani lemali elinikezwe ngendlela engajwayelekile ngumqashi. Qiniseka ukuthi izindaba zakho zentela zisesimweni esifanele uma ufaka isicelo somyalo wentela. I-SARS ngeke ikhiphe umyalo wentela uma ungakafaki amafomu wentela noma uma unedipho. Inombolo yokreference ye-PAYE yomqashi wakho iyadingeka. Uma i-SARS ivuma isicelo, uzothola ukuqinisekiswa phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, kodwa umyalo wentela rasmi ungathatha cishe amasonto amane. Indlela elula yokufaka isicelo somyalo wentela ukwenza lokhu ku-inthanethi kwiwebhusayithi ye-eFiling. Isicelo sakho somyalo wentela ngalendlela ngokuvamile sivunywa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-48. Le sevisi iyamahhala. Qedela futhi uthumele ifomu lakho ku-inthanethi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, layisha bese uqedela ifomu lesicelo somyalo wentela: Gratuities IRP3.
Ukungena eNingizimu Afrika kuvunyelwe ngaphandle kwemvume noma ngokulandela izimo ezibekwe kwiphepha lokuvuma elinikezwe yena noma ngumuntu omnikezeleyo. Izicelo zamaphepha okuvuma ukuhambisa impahla, impahla engaphansi kokulawulwa kwezifiso kufanele zithunyelwe kufomu elibekiwe. Inhloso yalesi sevisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impahla esebenzisiwe ethunyelwa ingaphazamisi imboni yeSouthern African Customs Union. Le nqubo iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona ukulawulwa kwezempilo kwemvelo kanye nezizathu zokuphepha, ukuphepha, nokuhambisana nezindinganiso, kanye nokuphathwa ngenhloso yokuhambisana nezizathu zemvelo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi: International Trade Administration Commission. Amafomu ezicelo kufanele agcwaliswe futhi athunyelwe. Amafomu kufanele athunyelwe kwi-Directorate of Import and Export Control, ITAC. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahhala.
Ilungelo lokudoba ukuze uthengise liyindlela yokusebenzisa ilungelo lakho lokudoba. Lokhu kulungelo kumele kufunwe ngumuntu okukhulunywe ngaye ukuze bakwazi ukukusebenzisa, ukuze badobe fish olwandle noma babambe iqhaza emisebenzini ethintana nokudoba ukuze bathengise. Kubandakanya ukwenza imisebenzi ethintana nokudoba kodwa awukwazi ukudla lezo zinyoni. Ukuze usebenzise ilungelo lakho lokudoba, thumela isicelo sokuthola imvume yokudoba ukuze uthengise eyakhishwa ngumenzi wezokuthutha ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma igunya elikhethiwe. Ilungelo eliphelele noma elilinganiselwe linikwe izinhlobo ezithile zezinhlanzi ngomholo we-DEA&T ngokusekelwe kumkhawulo wokudoba ovunyelwe okukhulunywe ngonyaka ngumenzi wezokuthutha ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha. Uqala ngokufaka isicelo selungelo lokudoba ukuze uthengise ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo semvume yokudoba ukuze uthengise. Ngaphezu kwemvume yokudoba ukuze uthengise, uzodinga imvume yokuhambisa izinyoni ukuze ukwazi ukuzithutha. Faka isicelo selungelo lokudoba uma umgovernment ikumema ukuthi wenze kanjalo njengoba kubhalwe encwadini yokwazisa kukahulumeni. Thola ifomu lesicelo emnyangweni ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma uya endaweni ozokhombiswa ukuyithola yi-DEA&T. Funda ifomu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uqedela zonke izidingo zenqubo yesicelo. Gcwalisa, podpis, bese uthumela ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo edingekayo nezitifiketi kanye ne-akhawunti yokubuyiselwa endaweni ozokhombiswa kuyo noma ehhovisi le-DEA&T eliseduze. Uku processing kwezicelo kuzokwenziwa ngemva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuthumela izicelo, futhi imiphumela izokhulumiswa ngokuxhumana ne-DEA&T. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-1 kuya kwezi-3 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngengcindezi yomsebenzi noma ukutholakala kwezinhlobo zezinhlanzi. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu kuye ngenani labantu abafake izicelo.
Imvume yokudoba ngenhloso yokuthengisa ivumela abantu ukuba baye kudoba fish emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ngenhloso yokuthengisa. Ukuze ulethe fish ezivela kwamanye amazwe ukuze uthengise, kufanele ufake isicelo semvume yokungenisa esinikezwa umnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma emnyangweni ophakanyisiwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungenisa fish ezivela kwamanye amazwe ngaphandle kwale mvume. Faka isicelo semvume entsha uma leyo onayo iphelelwe yisikhathi. Uma ungawuhloniphi umthetho wemvume, imvume yakho ingase ibhujiswe noma iqedwe. Qaphela: Imvume yokudoba emanzini angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika ayifaki fish edobekile emanzini ahlanzekile. Lezi fish zilawulwa umnyango wezolimo. Izicelo zemvume zokungenisa fish edobekile emanzini ahlanzekile zifakwa kumnyango wezolimo. Lo ngumnyango ophumelele ukunika lezi mvume. I-fish ebhalwe kuMthetho Wokuhweba Ngamazwe Ngamazwe Ngemfuyo Nezimbali Ezisengozini (CITES) ayivunyelwe ukudobeka futhi ilethwe eNingizimu Afrika. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi ngale nhlangano, vakashela ku-http://www.cites.org. Imvume yokungenisa i-abalone, i-rock lobster, kanye ne-fish njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho Wezinsiza Zokuphila Zomhlaba Wamanzi ka-1998 appendix 4, 5, & 12 izosebenza kuphela kumthwalo owodwa. Umthwalo ophelele we-squid ophilayo onesisindo esingu-600g ngasikhathi sinye noma umthwalo ongaphansi kwamathani angama-25 ngonyaka uvunyelwe. Abantu abavunyelwe ukungenisa i-squid ephilayo. Thola ifomu ngokuthumela isicelo ehhovisi eliphethe izindaba zezomhlaba nezokwakha noma ehhovisi lephakanyisiwe lomnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma ulayishe ku-http://www.mcm-deat.gov.za. Funda kahle ifomu ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uqedela zonke izidingo zenqubo yesicelo kanye nenani le-fish ozokungenisa. Ikhophi ethunyelwe uphiko lwezepolitiki yemvume yokungenisa evela kumnyango wezohwebo nezimboni noma isaziso semvume. Ikhophi ethunyelwe uphiko lwezepolitiki yesitifiketi sokuthi awunayo imali yokubolekwa ethunyelwe yiMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezimali ZaseNingizimu Afrika. Xhumana nebhange eliseduze leSouth African Bureau of Standards mayelana nomthwalo wakho uma i-fish oyingenisayo ingeyemanzini ahlanzekile noma ingeyokudla kwabantu. Qedela, sign, futhi uthumele ifomu lakho kanye nemibhalo edingekayo ehhovisi eliphethe izindaba zezomhlaba nezokwakha. Faka imibhalo yokuqala; kungenjalo, imvume ngeke ikhishwe. Imali yesicelo ingu-R225. Isicelo sakho sizophathwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-7 noma ngaphezulu uma yonke imibhalo iphelele. Imali yesicelo ingu-R225. Imali ingakhuphuka minyaka yonke noma njengoba kucatshangwa nguNgqongqoshe womnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi zendawo kanye nezokuvakasha noma umnyango ophakanyisiwe ngokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali. Izicelo zemvume yokungenisa azitholakali ku-inthanethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi lephakanyisiwe lomnyango.
Umvikeli womphakathi usebenza ngokwenza uphenyo oluzimele nolungakhethi ngemva kokuthola ukukhala noma ngokuqhubeka kokuzikhandla. Ukukhala okuhlobene nokuziphatha emsebenzini (ukwehlukanisa nalokho okuhlobene nezinkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa) kumele kuthunyelwe kumphakathi ophakanyisiwe, njengoba umnyango kufanele ube nethuba lokuphendula ekukhala. Uma ungakathumeli ukukhala kumnyango ofanele, uyacelwa ukuthi wenze njalo. Zonke iziteshi zangaphakathi ezikhona kumele zibe khona. Ingabe ufuna ukugcina igama lakho lihlelekile? Yini ukukhala kwakho? Ingabe ubike le ndaba kumunye umnyango noma kumuntu osebenza kwiMasipala? Uma kunjalo, sicela unikeze imininingwane. 2.2 Ingabe ubike umnyango ngokungamukeli isinqumo, ngokukhuphula udaba noma ngokuthatha izinyathelo zokubuyekeza isinqumo? 2.3 Uma impendulo ingu-yes kumanyuvesi aphezulu, sicela unikeze imininingwane. 3.1 Usuku lwezehlakalo. 3. Ingabe umnyango noma umqashi ophathelene nalezehlakalo? Chaza lezehlakalo futhi ufake yonke imininingwane ongayihlinzeka. Ingabe ufuna le ofisi iphenye? Chaza umphumela ofisa ukuwuthola. Ingabe unama-documents noma ubufakazi bokweseka ukukhala noma lokho okukhuluma? Uma impendulo ingu-yes, sicela unikeze amakhophi.
Umphakathi uvikela ngokwenza uphenyo oluzimele nolungakhethi emva kokuthola ukukhala noma ngokuqhubeka kwabo. Ukukhala okuhlobene nokusebenza kwemisebenzi (kungafaki lokho okuhlobene nezinkohlakalo nokukhwabanisa) kufanele kuthunyelwe kumphathi wesigaba esifanele, njengoba isigaba kufanele sinikezwe ithuba lokuphendula ekukhuleni. Uma ungekwazanga ukuthumela ukukhala esigabeni esifanele, ucela ukuthi wenze kanjalo. Zonke iziteshi zangaphakathi ezikhona kufanele zibe khona. Ingabe ufuna ukugcina igama lakho lihlelekile? 2.2 Ingabe usazise isigaba ngokungamukeli isinqumo, ngokuphakamisa udaba noma ngokuthatha izinyathelo ukuze isinqumo sibuye sahlaziywe? 2.3 Uma impendulo ingu-ye kunoma yimuphi wemibuzo engenhla, ucela ukuthi unikeze imininingwane. 3.1 Usuku lwezingozi 3. Ingabe wazisa uMnyango noma umphakathi ofanele ngalesi sikhathi?
UMphathiswa Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo usungule lezi ziqondiso ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ngemuva kokuxoxisana noMphathiswa Wezezimali, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 30 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukulingana Nokuvimbela Ukucwaswa Okungafanele ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 4 ka-2000). "UMthetho" ubhekisela kuMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukulingana Nokuvimbela Ukucwaswa Okungafanele ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 4 ka-2000). 2.(1) Isicelo sokunikezwa isikhundla sokuba umregistrar obhekiswe kuso esigabeni 17 soMthetho kumele sibe sibhaliwe kufomu efana neFomu 1 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure futhi sithunyelwe kuMphathi-Jikelele, kanye namagama, amakheli, nezinombolo zocingo zabantu ababili abangaxoxwa ngcharacter yakhe. Umuntu anganikezwa isikhundla nguMphathi-Jikelele ukuba abe umregistrar uma ehambisana nezidingo ezibekwe kuMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994 (Isikhumbuzo No. 103 ka-1994) futhi ahambisane nenqubomgomo yokunikezwa leso sikhundla sokuba umregistrar kule Ndawo. Ukunikezwa kwabaregistrars kuncike ekuphothulweni kwezifundo ezithile ezivunyelwe nguMphathi-Jikelele. UMphathi-Jikelele anganikezela umuntu ukuba abe umregistrar isikhathi esivumelwene nguMphathi-Jikelele nomfaki-sicelo; umfaki-sicelo uzoba nelungelo lokuthola umholo ophelele ofana nenani eliphelele elitholwe ngabaregistrars kule Ndawo. Izimo zokunikezwa umuntu isikhundla sokuba umregistrar njengoba kuqondiswe ngalesi sigaba (1) ngenhla zifana nezimo zokemployment ezisetshenziswa kumuntu onikezwa isikhundla sokuba umregistrar enkantolo ngaphansi koMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994 (Isikhumbuzo No. 103 ka-1994). Benza imisebenzi yomregistrar enkantolo ezimweni zomphakathi uma kudingeka ukuze kufezwe lokho okukhulunywe ngakho nguMthetho. Umuntu, inhlangano, noma ikhomishini ebhekiswe esigabeni 20 salo Mthetho, efuna ukulethela udaba enkantolo noma ukufaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ingakwenza lokhu ngokwazisa umregistrar wenkantolo ngentshisekelo yabo yokwenza lokhu besebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 2 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Kumele bacela umphenduli ukuba banikeze ulwazi olubhaliwe olukhulunywe esigabeni 3 seFomu 3 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 kusukela ngosuku lokwamukela leso sikhumbuzo. Umregistrar kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokwamukela impendulo evela kumphenduli obhekiswe esigabeni (2)(b) ngenhla, athumele ikhophi noma isithombe salo mpendulo kumfaki-sicelo noma kumuntu olethe udaba. Umregistrar kumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esibhekiswe esigabeni (2)(b) ngenhla, athumele udaba kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokwamukela wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nalolo daba, akhiphe isinqumo sokuthi udaba luzophakanyiswa enkantolo noma luthunyelwe kwenye iforamu. Uma umphathi ophakanyisiwe ethatha isinqumo sokuthi udaba kufanele luphakanyiswe enkantolo, kumele athumele udaba kumregistrar, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokwamukela lolo daba, abeke usuku lokulalelwa kwalolo daba. Umregistrar kumele, ngemuva kokubeka usuku lokulalelwa kwalolo daba, wazise umfaki-sicelo nomphenduli ngaleso sikhathi sokulalelwa besebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 4 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Bangase benze iziphakamiso noma imibono ebhaliwe abacabanga ukuthi ifanele ukuba icatshangelwe yile nkantolo besebenzisa ifomu efana nesigaba 2 seSigaba A seFomu 5 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Kumele bazise zonke izigaba ezithintekayo kulolu daba ngamadokhumenti athunyelwe kule nkantolo abhekiswe esigabeni (a). Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ezokulalela udaba itholile amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni (8)(a), le nkantolo kumele ikhiphe isikhumbuzo esibhaliwe esazisa zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ngalolu daba nomregistrar wenkantolo ngokuqinisekiswa kokwamukelwa kwalolu daba. I nkantolo ethunyelwe udaba kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokwamukela amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni (8), ithumele umbiko kumregistrar wenkantolo, ibika ngentuthuko eyenziwe kulolu daba. Uma udaba luphothuliwe yile nkantolo, le nkantolo kumele ngokushesha ibike umregistrar wenkantolo ngempumelelo yalolu daba. Uma le nkantolo ibuyisela udaba emuva enkantolo, le mbuyiselo yalo daba kumele ibe sibhaliwe kufomu efana nalokhu kuSigaba B seFomu 5 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure, inikeza izizathu zokuthi kungani udaba luphindiselwa. I nkantolo kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa kusukela ngosuku lokuthi udaba luphindiselwe emuva enkantolo, iqondise ukuthi udaba luzoxoxwa kanjani. Umregistrar kumele ngokushesha wazise labo abathintekayo kulolu daba ngosuku lokulalela ngemihlahlandlela ezolandela ngendlela ebhekiswe esigabeni (6). Ngemuva kokwenza isicelo esibhaliwe kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, uma udaba luphuthumayo, umphathi ophakanyisiwe angaqondisa ukuthi isikhathi esibekiwe ezinqubweni sikhululwe. Ngokuthumela nge-imeyili, uma ubufakazi bokuthi bathole i-imeyili ethunyelwe kubo bungaboniswa nguthumeli, ubufakazi bokuthumela kumele bugcina, futhi ifomu eliyinhloko kumele lithunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo ngokushesha ngeposi elibhalisiwe. Kumele lithunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo noma lifakwe enkantolo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela elawulwa umphathi ophakanyisiwe. Ngokuthumela nge-imeyili noma ngeposi, ubufakazi balokhu kumele bugcina, futhi ifomu eliyinhloko kumele lithunyelwe ngaphandle kokulibala kumfaki-sicelo ngeposi elibhalisiwe. Isikhumbuzo esibhekiswe esigabeni 6(6) kumele sinikezwe kumphakathi wenkantolo noma kumregistrar kuzo zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ngalolu daba mathupha. 8.(1)(a) Umuntu ofuna ukuthumela isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi ukuze bavele phambi kwenkantolo kumele, okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela udaba, acela umregistrar wenkantolo ukuba akhiphe futhi asebenze isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi ngokushesha. Isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi esikhiphwe kumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Ngubani omunye ongathunyelwa umregistrar ngokuphakamisa komphathi ophakanyisiwe? Umuntu othumela isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi kumele aqedele ingxenye B yesigaba sesibili seFomu 6 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. (a) Ukubakhona kobufakazi phambi kwenkantolo ngomyalo wenkantolo kwenziwa ngokuthumela leso sikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi, esikhishwe ngumregistrar, okumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Ulimi lomuntu ngandlela thile luyisikhumba sesibili, lukhombisa okuthile okukhona kumuntu ongokoqobo, lapho sikhombisa khona ithemba nezifiso, sikhuluma ngemicabango nemigomo yethu, sithola ulwazi nemikhuba yethu, futhi sakha umphakathi wethu nemithetho eyawulawula. Ngolimi, singasebenza njengabantu emhlabeni oshintshashintshayo. Ilungelo lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ozikhethayo liyavunywa nguMthetho Wamalungelo Nezivumelwano zethu, okukhombisa ukuthi izilimi zabantu bethu ziyinsiza okufanele isetshenziswe. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuthi, ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eqotho, ekugcineni sikwazi ukwethula uhlaka lwezinhlelo zolimi lweNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuwumphumela womsebenzi oqale ngo-1995, lapho ngibeka khona iQembu Lokuhlela Ulimi (LANGTAG) ukuze linikeze iseluleko ngohlaka oluphelele lwezinhlelo zolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sibalulekile ngenxa yokungabi khona kokuphikiswa kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi kanye nomphumela wokuthi "ukusebenza kokukhuluma ngolimi oluningi kuyindaba yokukhokha" njengoba kubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu, kanye nezikhalazo ezikhulayo ezivela kubanikazi bezilimi mayelana nokubusa kolimi olulodwa eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lweZinhlelo Zolimi Zesizwe lusekelwe emiphumeleni yokubambisana ngokubonisana, lusebenzisa kokubili iLANGTAG namandla eMnyango ngokuhlanganyela neQembu Lokweluleka Ngolimi. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo luyadingeka ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zethu ezahlukene zolimi kanye nokufinyelela kukahulumeni emgomeni wokukhuthaza ubulungiswa, ukulingana, kanye nenhlalakahle yombuso. Kulesi simo esihle, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zezwe lethu, njengoba kukhankanywe nguMthethosisekelo, kube nendawo ebonakalayo kulezi zinhlelo. Lezi zinhlelo ziqhakambisa futhi ukuthi ukubaluleka kwezilimi zethu kukhombisa kakhulu ngokusetshenziswa kwazo ezimeni zomnotho, zomphakathi, nezepolitiki. Uma ulimi lulahlekelwa ukubaluleka kwalo kulezi zimo, isimo salo siyancipha. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo luphinde lukhombise ukuthi sibhekene nenkinga yokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele futhi ukuthi izilimi zethu zendabuko kumele zibe yingxenye yephuzu elishintshashintshayo lobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi sizobuyisela isimo nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendabuko eNingizimu Afrika. Ngiyethemba ngokuhlonipha ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokwamukela lezi zinhlelo zesiZwe Zolimi njengezabo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ngokubambisana, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinhlelo ziba yiqiniso elibonakalayo ezimpilweni zethu, zenza sibe neqhaza lokuqhakambisa ubunikazi bethu obuhlukile baseNingizimu Afrika.

Ukuhlonishwa kokuba yiMvikeli Wabantu kanye noMphathi Wokuhlola kubonakala emcimbini nasemlandweni waleli thuluzi, okukhombisa ngokucacile ukuhlela kwezobulili kweMasipala eThekwini futhi kusekelwe ezimisweni eziyisisekelo zokulingana kobulili emthethweni wethu. Ngenxa yalokhu kanye nomsebenzi wethu njengomvikeli wabantu, kumele le ndawo ingavumi kuphela ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa kodwa futhi ivikele, ikhuthaze, futhi ibophezele ngokuphelele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo ayisisekelo abantu bonke eMasipala eThekwini ayafezekiswa. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi umphakathi waseThekwini uthokozisa kakhulu ngomsebenzi weMvikeli Wabantu kanye noMphathi Wokuhlola kanye nabasebenzi babo abazinikele abenza lo msebenzi onhlonipho wokuphila komuntu, hhayi kuphela ngokuhlola, ukuthola, nokunikeza izeluleko ngezindaba ezithinta iMasipala eThekwini, kodwa futhi ngokufundisa umphakathi ngamalungelo awo, ikakhulukazi ilungelo lokufinyelela enkantolo, ilungelo lokwazi, kanye nelungelo lokulingana. Ngakho-ke, ngokufingqa, lokhu kusho ukuthi iMvikeli Wabantu kanye noMphathi Wokuhlola, kanye nabalingani babo, bagcizelela izidingo zomphakathi, phezu kokuvikela amalungelo abhalwe emthethweni wabo, baqinisekisa ubuqotho emizameni yabo yokunciphisa noma iyiphi indlela yokuphazamiseka engase ingaphazamisa noma ithinte kabi ubudlelwano bendlela yokuphatha, kodwa futhi ingavimbela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, ukuphathwa kahle, nokubhekelela. © 2009 iMasipala eThekwini. Mphakathi ohloniphekile weKwaZulu-Natal, udokotela ophakeme, uS.J. Sihlalo, ngivuka lapha ukuze ngethule ibhajethi yonyaka wezezimali ka-2008/2009 yeVoti 8 (uMnyango Wezindlu) ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi: "Indlu ayikhethwa kuphela kodwa iyisisekelo sokushintsha." Lesi sihloko sihambisana nokugxila ekuhlanganiseni izindawo zokuhlala njengoba sisondela ekupheleni kohlelo lweminyaka emihlanu. Sisesimweni lapho kufanele sihlolisise ngokucophelela umnikelo wohlelo lwezindlu njengengxenye yokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza futhi sikhumbule nesimo sokuhlanganiswa kwezomnotho, kwezokuhlalisana, nezinhlelo zomhlaba. Njengoba siqala ukuhlola umthelela wohlelo lokwakha izindlu, siqonda ukuthi ukusebenza kwethu akukwazi ukukalwa kuphela ngenani lezindlu ezakhiwe. Siyaqonda ukuthi izindlu ziyisisekelo esibalulekile lapho ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, ukufinyelela ezidingweni eziyisisekelo, nokubuyiselwa kwesithunzi kubantu kwakhiwa khona. Kungalesi sizathu sathatha isihloko esihlanganisa lesi siqondiso se "kuhlanganiswa." Njengomnyango, siqonda kahle izinkinga ezikhona kwezindlu esifundazweni sethu. Siqhubeka nokuzibophezela esinqumweni sethu sokukhipha ukuhlinzekwa kwezakhamuzi, ukungaphephi kokuhlala, ukungazinzi kwezakhiwo, ukungafinyeleli ezinsizeni, izingozi zempilo nokuphepha, nezinye izimo ezikhona ezindaweni zokuhlala ezisemthethweni, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zethu zasemadolobheni nasezindaweni ezithuthukile. Ekufezeni izinhloso zethu, sithola umyalo wethu kwiFreedom Charter, umqondo wayo uqhubeka usinika ukuhlakanipha, nakuba sekwedlule iminyaka engamashumi amahlanu selokhu yamukelwa yizikhungo zethu zokulwa, futhi sizohlale sikwazisa ngakho. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, kwakubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume "ngemithwalo nezinsiza" lapho sethula ibhajethi yeVoti 8 eminyakeni yokuqala yalo msebenzi weminyaka emihlanu. Izinkinga zokuhlinzeka ngezidingo ngaleso sikhathi zazinzima, futhi umsebenzi omkhulu owayekhuluma phambili wawubuhlungu. Nokho, asizange sishintshe ukuzibophezela kwethu emthwalweni weqembu, njengoba kugcizelelwe nguMongameli uMandela mayelana nokubuyiselwa kwesithunzi kubantu nokukhuthaza umphakathi ohlanganisiwe njengesisekelo sokukhululeka kwethu. Ukuze siqinisekise ukufezeka kwalomyalo, besinokuhlangana okuningi ukuze sihlolisise izindlela zokusebenza, ngaphezu kwemihlangano yonyaka yokwakha izindlu eyath attended by many stakeholders in this province. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sithumele izwi lethu ngaphandle kwemingcele yethu ukuze sabelane ngolwazi nezinsizakalo zokwakha nezichwepheshe ezivela eCuba, eKenya, eCanada, nakwamanye amazwe esingazifanisa nawo. Siphinde sathatha ingxenye ezinhlelweni zokushintshanisa nezizwe ezifana neCuba. Ngokubambisana nokubambisana, sikwazile ukuhlaziya ukuqonda kwethu ngemiyalo yethu nokuphumelelisa izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu. Ngakho-ke, ngiyakhuluma ngokuqiniseka ukuthi samukela kokubili umyalo wethu wokwakha izindlu ngokuhambisana nohlelo lweminyaka emihlanu. Nokho, siqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi umqondo obalulekile wohlelo lwethu lwezindlu uwukuthi akufanele sishayele indiva umthelela obalulekile wokuhlanganiswa ezindleleni zokusebenza. Lokhu kuhambisana neziqondiso Zokuthuthukiswa, izinhloso zokuhlinzeka ngezidingo njengoba zamukelwa yiKomidi Lezangaphakathi Lezindlu (MINMEC) kanye noHlelo Lwezifunda lweKwaZulu-Natal lwezindaba ezibalulekile. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, le bhajethi ithulwe ngesikhathi lapho izindlela zethu zokuhlinzeka ngezindlu zithuthukiswe kakhulu. Izifunda zibalulekile emaphakathini ethu. Njengomphumela, uMnyango Wezindlu ubeke othisha abaqondile ukuze basize izifunda ekwenzeni ngcono izinhlelo zabo zokwakha izindlu. Lezi zinhlelo zokwakha izindlu ziwamukelekile kuphela uma zicatshangelwa ukuthi zihlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokuhlanganiswa. Siyajabula ukusho ukuthi ukuhlala kwabantu, okuqhubeka nakho, kusemsebenzini ongcono kunakuqala ukuze kufezwe ukuhlanganiswa komnotho, kwezokuhlalisana, nezomhlaba. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngezindlu eKwaZulu-Natal lukhona esimweni esihle sokuba sustainable. Le mpumelelo isisondeza eduze kokunqoba ngokuphelele izinhlelo ezaziyingxenye yepholisi ye-apartheid. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, njengoba sibhiyozela le mpumelelo, sithokozisa kakhulu imibono nezinkokhelo zababambiqhaza. Ngokuhambisana nalokhu, ibhajethi ethulwe namuhla ibonisa imibono ehlukene yababambiqhaza. Ezinye zezikhungo esixhumene nazo zihlanganisa izifunda, abaholi gelenkolo, ochwepheshe bezindlu, abakhi bezindlu, ososayensi, nezinye izikhungo esisebenze nazo mayelana nezidingo zezindlu. ngaphandle kwalabo abatholwe njengabangenamthelela omkhulu. Izinkinga zokwakha izindlu zibalulekile kakhulu. allocated to areas that are being redeveloped. related to housing. employment and other sustainability requirements. Ingabe izinga lempumelelo lingafezeka? kanye nokuphumelelisa izinhlelo zokwakha. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko ngenxa yokulibaziseka. Ukulahleka ngenxa yokunganeliseki kwezinga. Izithiyo ekuqaliseni kwephrojekthi. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, sithula le bhajethi yeVoti 8 siqonda ngokuphelele amaphuzu aphakanyisiwe. Siyaqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi ukuntuleka kwekhono kuthinta bonke ababambiqhaza. Uhulumeni nomkhakha ozimele bayavuma ukuthi kukhona ukuntuleka kwekhono. Njengoba sizama ukuxazulula ukuntuleka kwekhono ezingeni lesifunda nelokhu, siqonda ukuthi ozakwethu emkhakheni ozimele nabo babhekana nokuntuleka kwekhono. Isibonelo salokhu wukuthi kudingeka sande inani labafundi abhalisile nabakhiqizwayo emkhakheni wezobunjiniyela. Asikwazi ukususa ngokuphelele inkinga yokuntuleka kwamakhono obuchwepheshe uma izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme zingakwazi ukuheha nokuqeqesha inani elanele labafundi emikhakheni efanele. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, umbono omusha wezindlu, onikeza umqondo walebhajethi, ugcine umgomo wayo oyinhloko wokukhuthaza umphakathi ongabandakanyi futhi ongenamahluko ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezizinzile nezanele. Le bhajethi iyisibonakaliso sokuzibophezela kwethu ekusizeni ukunciphisa ukungalingani kwezomnotho nezobuhlanga ekuhlinzekeni ngezindlu. Ngamanye amazwi, sihlanganisile ibhajethi esamukela ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa komnotho kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlala. Nokho, lokhu akusho ukuthi siyayishiya izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu ezigxile kakhulu kulezi zindawo ezihamba phambili kwezomnotho. Empeleni, sikholelwa ukuthi ukungenelela kwethu kwezindlu kufanele kube umgqugquzeli, ngisho nasezindaweni ezibandlululayo ezindaweni ezithuthukile, ukuze kukhuthazwe ukukhula komnotho. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lwethu lwezindlu luzosiza kakhulu emaphrojekthini okuthuthukiswa komnotho kulezi
Ingxenye 10 yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kumininingwane (Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000), (okubizwa ngokuthi Umthetho lapha) waqala ukusebenza ngomhla ka-15 kuFebhuwari 2002. Le ngxenye ivumela iKomidi Lezokuhlalisana Nabantu, phakathi nezinyanga eziyishumi nambili ngemva kokuthi le ngxenye iqale ukusebenza, ukuba yenze lo mhlahlandlela wemininingwane utholakale ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ngendlela elula nephumelelayo, evumela wonke umuntu odinga ukujolisa amalungelo atholakala kulomthetho ukuba akwenze lokho. Imigomo eyenziwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 92 yalomthetho kumele ilandelwe. IKomidi Lezokuhlalisana Nabantu kumele, uma kudingeka, ibuyekeze, ithuthukise, futhi iphinde iphumeze lo mhlahlandlela njalo eminyakeni emibili. Ikhophi yalomhlahlandlela kumele itholakale ku-inthanethi yeKomidi Lezokuhlalisana Nabantu ku-http://www.sahrc.org.za. Okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yalomhlahlandlela, ebhalwe ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ezisetshenziselwa izidingo zohulumeni bezifunda, kumele itholakale kuZOZONKE IZINDAWO zeMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo. KuZOZONKE IZINDAWO ZOHULUMENI, kumele kube nekhophi eyodwa, ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ezisetshenziselwa izidingo zohulumeni bezifunda, lapho le ndawo ikhona. Noma yimuphi umnyango kahulumeni noma izikhungo zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke noma ezingeni lesifunda ngaphansi kukahulumeni noma kwidolobha, njengokuthi: Isevisi Yezokuphepha YaseNingizimu Afrika, Umnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, njll., ezisebenzisa amandla ayo noma zenza imisebenzi ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo noma ngaphansi kwemithetho yesifunda; noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwanoma yimuphi umthetho; isibonelo: Umphenyi Jikelele Wezincwadi, Umvikeli Wabantu, njll. UMGQIBI JIKELELE: UKUXHUMANA KuZOZONKE IZINDAWO ZAMAPOSI, kumele kube nekhophi eyodwa yalomhlahlandlela, ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni ezisetshenziselwa izidingo zohulumeni kulolo suku lapho le ndawo yeposi ikhona. Uma umuntu efuna ikhophi yengxenye ethile yedokhumenti ngaphandle kokufuna ukuhlola okuthile, phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza, bangakhokhiswa noma badinge ukukhokha imali ethile - lezi zinqwaba zikhuluma ngazo kumhlahlandlela wokuqala we-Annexure A yemigomo [njengoba kushicilelwe kuGazethi No. 23119 ngomhla ka-15 kuFebhuwari 2002 kuMthetho Wokubika No. R.187 owashicilelwa ngomhla ka-15 kuFebhuwari 2002]. 5.1 INHLANGANO YALOMTHETHO Inhloso yalomthetho ukuvumela ukufinyelela kwamalungelo ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo, ukuqinisekisa ukutholakala kwemibiko noma imininingwane, ethathwa noma ilawulwa nguHulumeni noma yimuphi umbiko othathwa noma ulawulwa omunye umuntu futhi odingekayo ukuqinisekisa noma ukuvikela noma yimaphi amalungelo. Inhloso ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okukhanya nokubambisana ezikhungweni zikahulumeni nakwezizimele, futhi ukukhuthaza kakhulu umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinyelela imibiko ukuze bavikele kahle amalungelo abo. Noma iyiphi imininingwane ebhaliwe ethokozisayo ingacelwa, noma ingabe yenziwe yiSevisi Yezokuphepha YaseNingizimu Afrika noma umnyango kahulumeni. Lo mthetho usebenza lapho eminye imithetho esunguliwe ingavimbela noma ivimbe ukukhululwa kwemibiko futhi ingaphikisi nemigomo ngaphansi kwalomthetho. IZIZATHU ZOKUPHIKA UKUFIKILELA KUMININGWANE EPHATHWE Ngaphakathi kweSahluko 4 salomthetho, "Izizathu zokuvimbela ukufinyelela kumarekhodi," kubekwe isimo sokuthi ngaphansi kwalomthetho, isicelo sokufinyelela kumamininingwane aphathwe singamukelwa noma singenakwamukelwa. IZINHLANGANO ZABASEBENZI Izinhlangano zabantu abasebenzi zinegunya lokufinyelela noma yimuphi umamininingwane ophathwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 16 yeMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi, 1995 (Umthetho No. 66 ka-1995). Lo mthetho awusebenzi uma inhlangano yabasebenzi icela imininingwane evikelwe ukuze isize umqashi mayelana nesikhalazo noma ukuqhubeka nokucubungula izinkinga (ukuthola leyo mininingwane evikelwe mahhala ngaphansi kweMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi, 1995 (Umthetho No. 66 ka-1995). Uma inhlangano yabasebenzi icela ukuthola imininingwane kodwa ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa ukusiza umqashi ngesikhathi sokucubungula izinkinga noma ukusiza umqashi ophakamise isikhalazo, isicelo sizothunyelwa kumnyango ofanele, ongase ube ezingeni likazwelonke noma lesifunda, ophatha izindaba zabasebenzi kulolo suku noma ezingeni likazwelonke. Lo mnyango uzokhombisa ukuthi leyo mininingwane evikelwe ihambisana nokuxoxisana okuqhubekayo nenhlangano yabasebenzi. Uma kunjalo, ikhophi yeminininingwane evikelwe izonikezwa enhlangano mahhala ngaphansi kwengxenye 16 yeMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi. Ukukhululwa nokutholakala kweminininingwane evikelwe ngenhloso echazwe engxenyeni (i) kuhlelwe ngaphansi kwanoma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Noma iyiphi imininingwane evikelwe etholelwe ngendlela ephikisana nengxenye (a) ngeke yamukelwe njengobufakazi enkantolo noma ekwenzeni izindaba zomphakathi ngaphandle kokuthi ukungasetshenziswa kwaleyo mininingwane, ngokwayo, kungalimaza ukuphathwa kwezobulungiswa ngandlela thize. Inqubo yokubanga iqala lapho icala libhaliswa encwadini yeMnyango Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi. Ukubanga kwezindaba zomphakathi kuqala ngemva kokukhishwa kwezikhumbuzo noma ezinye izincwadi, kuhlanganise ngemva kokwaziswa kwaleyo miphakathi ethile edlula ngaphansi kweMnyango Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi ngokuhambisana nengxenye 3(1) yoMthethosisekelo mayelana nokusebenza komthetho ophikisana neMithetho Yezakhiwo Zikahulumeni, 2002 (Umthetho No. 40 ka-2002) kutholakele. Indlela ejwayelekile yokuyithola kumele ilandelwe, noma uma izikhumbuzo zisetshenziselwa ukubiza enkantolo, ukuthola indlela yokuthola leyo mininingwane evikelwe kulolo cala. Kumele kuqapheleke ukuthi ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwezikhumbuzo nezinye izincwadi noma izikhumbuzo mayelana nalomthetho, lo mthetho uzosebenza kunoma isiphi isicelo sokufinyelela kumamininingwane evikelwe, noma ngabe isicelo senziwe ngenhloso yokubona umthetho ophatha izinqubo zomphakathi. IZINDAWO ZEVULANDLELA Qaphela ukuthi indlela yokuthola umbiko wezingozi ayifaki indlela yokuthola amarekhodi endaweni evulekile njengoba kuxoxwa kule ngxenye. Ukuthola umbiko wezingozi kuxoxwa ngasohlangothini lwengxenye 7. Lo mthetho awusebenzi. Isicelo sizovunywa futhi imvume izonikezwa mahhala (njengoba eminye imithetho ibhangele lokho). Lo mthetho awusebenzi uma sekuqalile ukubanga. Isicelo kumele senziwe ebhalwe phansi (incwadi) futhi yonke imininingwane yesicelo kumele icaciswe. Isicelo sizothunyelwa kumphakathi ophakanyisiwe kanye ne-rekh
Ukudla okuthengiswa ezimotweni zokudlela ezibekwe ezindaweni zomphakathi kumele kube nezaziso eziphambi kokuthengiswa emshinini ezikhombisa amagama ezinto zokudla, ngaphandle kwezimfanelo lapho ilebula (igama lokudla) livela emkhiqizweni wokudla uqobo. Uma umkhiqizo wokudla uthengiswa ngamasheya (okhululekile), umphakathi kumele ube nelebula (igama lokudla) ngokuhambisana nomkhiqizo wokudla othengiswa wedwa, futhi izinhlamvu zamagama kumele zibe nosayizi ofundekayo kumthengi. Izinto zokudla ezithile zikhululekile ngokuphelele ekubhalweni (igama lakho). Noma iyiphi i-beverage ekhankanywayo iphendukela kwiBeverage Products Act, 1989 (Act No. 60 of 1989). Kumele ifundeke futhi ibonakale futhi akufanele ibe ekushiseni okudlula u-500 C noma "Awukwazi ukuyiphula noma ukuyilimaza nganoma iyiphi indlela echazwe. Awukwazi ukuyishisa ngemuva kokuyisebenzisa." Ilebula (umbhalo) kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo inikeza ulwazi olubalulekile ngaleso sikhathi. I-Foodstuffs Hygiene Act, 1992 Act No. I-Agricultural Products Standards Act, 1990 Act No. I-Foodstuffs, Cosmetics and Disinfectants Act, 1972 Act No. I-Standards Act, 1993 Act No. I-Trade Marks Act, 1963 Act No. 1973 (Act No. 77 of 1973). Ulwazi lokudla luyadingeka kuphela ezimweni lapho izinhlamvu zembhalo zenziwa futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ilebula lombhalo basekelwe kulokho. Ukudla okuqukethe ama-additives, preservatives, kanye nezinsiza zokuqhakambisa kumele kubonise igama le-additive, i-preservative, kanye negama le-colorant esetshenzisiwe. Uhlobo lwe-Monosodium Glutamate (oluwuhlobo lwezithako ezithuthukisa ukunambitheka kokudla) kumele futhi lubhaliswe njengokwakhiwa uma kutholakala kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo wokudla. Imikhiqizo yokudla equkethe ama-preservatives kanye nezinsiza zokuqhakambisa zohlobo lwe-Tartrazine kumele ibonise igama le-preservative noma i-colorant, futhi uma kuziwa kuma-preservatives, igama elisebenzayo "preservative" kumele libonakale kanye nezinye izithako zokudla ezibhalwe ngohlobo lwazo. Isixwayiso Uma umkhiqizo, nakuba uhlose ukusetshenziswa, ungase ube sengozini yokuphepha kwabantu, amalebula okuxwayisa afanele kumele avele kumkhiqizo, isibonelo, Izitatimende Ezivimbela Akukho zinsolo zezempilo ezingaqhamuka. Izigaba "impilo" kanye "nezemidlalo" akufanele zifakwe kumalebula (incazelo yomkhiqizo) njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uqukethe izithako ezithuthukisa impilo. Uma kuziwa kokupheka okujwayelekile okuvela ezitshalweni, amagama athi "akubangeli isifo senhliziyo" angathathwa njengokuphikisana. Isitatimende esifana "siphakanyiswa odokotela" akufanele sisetshenziswe njengoba kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uphakamisiwe ngochwepheshe bezempilo (udokotela). Imikhiqizo eqandisiwe Imikhiqizo elawulwa ngokushisa nokufriza kumele ichaze izimo zokugcina. Kumele ibonise izindlela zokusebenzisa, ezifana nokushisa, ukupheka ukuze kudleke ukudla futhi kugcinwe izinga elifanele. Ukudla okuphila ngokushesha kuboniswa ekukhanyeni kwelanga ngokukhululeka kokushisa okuphansi ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yakho yokuvikela ngokubulala noma yiziphi izinhlayiya eziphilayo ezikhona. Ilungelo lomthengi ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi imikhiqizo ebhekene nokukhanya kwelanga, ngakho-ke igama "exhunywe" noma "exhunywe ekukhanyeni kwelanga ukuze kubulawwe amagciwane" kumele kubonakale kumalebula, kodwa uma kungenamaphesenti angaphansi kuka-10 athola ukukhanya kwelanga, akudingeki ukusho ukuthi umkhiqizo utholakala ekukhanyeni kwelanga.
Njengomphakathi wezinga/um resident/umsebenzi/umfundi endaweni engaphansi kokuphathwa kwe eThekwini Municipality, ngiyafaka isicelo sokuba ilungu lelibhary. Ngiyavuma ukuhambisana nemithetho yedolobha, imithetho, kanye nezinhlinzeko zezikole zeKwaZulu-Natal. Ngizibophezela ekubhekaneni nanoma yiziphi izinto ezitholwe ngilungu lelibhary yami kanye nelungu lelibhary yengane yami, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zitholwe ngami noma omunye umuntu, kanye nokukhokhela noma yiziphi izinxephezelo, izindleko zezinto ezilahlekile, nezindleko ezithathwe ngelibhary lapho kuthengwa lezo zinto noma ekukhokheni. Ngiyavuma ukuhambisana nazo zonke izidingo zomthetho ezibekwe kuMthetho Wokulondolozwa KweCopyright, 1978 (Umthetho No. 98 ka-1978) kanye nezichibiyelo zawo. Ngiphinde ngiyavuma ukukwazisa ngokushesha nganoma yiziphi izinguquko kwi-adresi yami, inombolo yefoni, noma yimuphi omunye ulwazi olukhulunywe ngenhla. Sicela usinikeze ubunikazi bazo zonke izingane noma isitifiketi sokuzalwa kanye nezinkomba esizogcina kumarekhodi ethu.
UMkhandlu weMthonjaneni, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 156 seMthethosisekelo, 1996 (Umthetho 108 ka-1996, ofundwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 11 nesigaba 98 soMthetho Wamasistimu Omkhandlu, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000), ofundwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 6A(1) soMthetho Wamabhizinisi, 1991 (Umthetho No. 71 ka-1991), wenze lezi zinhlinzeko ezilandelayo. "Uhlelo lokukhokha" lisho umyalelo wecala wokuthatha imali ethile emholweni wekhasimende. Imigomo esetshenziswe kulokhu izohlanganisa abantu, izinkampani, nezinhlelo, kanti ubulili buzohlanganisa bobabili abesifazane nabesilisa, futhi ubumbano buzobhekisela kokubili okukodwa nokubili. Ngaphambi kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi, amanzi, nezinye izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa kumakhasimende, wonke amakhasimende kufanele angene esivumelwaneni noMkhandlu lapho, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ikhasimende livuma ukuthi uhlelo lokukhokha kukagesi namanzi lungasetshenziswa ukuqoqa izimali ezikhokhwayo mayelana nezinsiza. Uma ikhasimende lingangeni esivumelwaneni noMkhandlu, amanzi nogesi angaphazanyiswa noma apheliswe ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile, njengoba kudingeka, kuze kube isivumelwano sokuhlinzekwa kwensiza singangenwa futhi imali efanele ikhokhwe. Lokhu ikhasimende kuzodingeka kukhokhe imali ethile. UMkhandlu uzokhokhisa abantu abahlala kule ndawo, kanye nabanikazi bezindawo nabahlala kulezi zindawo, imithwalo kanye nezinsizakalo zomkhandlu ezihlinzekwa nguMkhandlu ngezikhathi ezithile noma njengoba kunqunywa umthetho. Umenzi wezindawo kufanele akhokhe ukukhipha udoti nezinsizakalo zezingqimba. Ikhasimende ngalinye kufanele libe nokufinyelela kumakhasimende ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina olukhulunywe kwi-akhawunti. Noma yisiphi ushintsho lwesikhala luzothatha umthelela kuphela ngemva kokuthi isaziso sokushintsha samukelwe nguMkhandlu. Amakhasimende kufanele akhokhe, ngokuphelele, imali ebiliwe ngaphambi kosuku lokugcina. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nalolu hlaka kuzoholela ekutheni kube nokuhlawuliswa okukhokhwayo kumakhasimende, futhi inzalo njengoba kunqunywa nguMkhandlu izokhokhwa ngemuva kosuku lokukhokha noma lapho kungekho imali ethile, njengoba kunqunywa umthetho, kusukela ngosuku okwakufanele ikhokhwe. Izimali zokubolekwa zizokwenziwa nguMphathi Wezezimali, ezizokwenziwa kokubili njengengxenye nangokuphelele kwi-akhawunti yenyanga yezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa endaweni, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi iyimali ethile noma inani elibaliwe. Ekutheni imali yokubolekwa echazwe esigabeni 4(1), uMphathi Wezezimali uzohlukanisa phakathi kwezindawo ezizokhokhwa ngezinga lezinsiza ezihlukene nezinga lokusetshenziswa. UMsizi Wezezimali angaphinde abuyekeze izimali zokubolekwa zamakhasimende ezinyangeni ezintathu ngemuva kosuku lokubolekwa kokuqala, futhi angacela ngenxa yokubuyekezwa inani elengeziwe ngaphezu kwemali yokubolekwa kumakhasimende. UMsizi Wezezimali kufanele abuyekeze zonke izimali zokubolekwa njalo eminyakeni emibili noma uma izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa kumakhasimende ziphelisiwe noma zaphazanyiswa ngenxa yokungakhokhi. Umphumela walolu buyekezo uzokhulumelwa ikhasimende uma kukhona ushintsho emalini yokubolekwa futhi ezinye izivumelwano ezidingekayo zenziwa. Uma imali yokubolekwa ethintwa esigabeni 4(2) noma 4(3) itholakala inganele, ikhasimende linelungelo lokungena esivumelwaneni sokukhokha le mali eyengeziwe noMsizi Wezezimali. Izimali zokubolekwa zamakhasimende zezo zonke izinsizakalo ezibiliwe kufanele zikhokhwe. Izimali zokubolekwa kufanele zikhokhwe mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kukagesi namanzi kuphela. Izimali zokubolekwa kufanele zikhokhwe ngempahla noma ngekhadi. UMkhandlu uzokwamukela iziqinisekiso zebhange lapho imali yokubolekwa idlula izinkulungwane ezimbili rand (R2000.00). Iziqinisekiso zebhange kufanele zithunyelwe mathupha phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza ehhovisi likaMsizi Wezezimali eCivic Centre. Zonke izimali zokubolekwa kufanele zikhokhwe okungenani ezinsukwini ezimbili ngaphambi kokuhlala endaweni noma ngosuku lapho izinsizakalo zidingeka, uma zingadingeki ngosuku lokuqala lokuhlala. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nalolu hlelo lungaphazamisa ukuxhumana kwezinsizakalo, futhi uMkhandlu ngeke abe nesibopho nganoma yiziphi izingozi ezingase zenzeke. Akukho mali yokubolekwa edingekayo uma imitha ikhokhwa ngaphambi kokuhlinzekwa kwensiza ethile. Lapho izinhlobo ezintsha zemithombo kagesi namanzi zifakwa kumakhasimende akhona, la makhasimende kufanele angene esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe noMkhandlu sokukhokha izimali zokubolekwa phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha. Imali yokuxhumana izokhokhwa uma amakhasimende ahlinzekwa ngeminye imisebenzi yomkhandlu nganoma iyiphi indlela futhi labo abakhona ohlwini lwabakhokhi bezikweletu mayelana nalezi zinsizakalo futhi baphazanyiswa kukagesi namanzi. UMkhandlu, ngokuthanda kwawo, uzothumela izaziso nezinye izikhumbuzo kumakhasimende athola izikweletu ngaphambi kokuphazanyiswa kwezinsizakalo. UMkhandlu uzokhipha isicelo sokukhokha izimali ezikhokhwayo mayelana nazo zonke izikhwama ezikhombisa izimali ezikhokhwayo ezedlule ezinsukwini ezingama-30 (30), emva kwalokho i-akhawunti izothunyelwa kumakhompiyutha wezikhwama, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 10, ngaphezu kokuphazanyiswa kokuhlinzekwa kwensiza. UMkhandlu uzophazanyiswa kwezinsizakalo kumakhasimende anemithombo kagesi emisha mayelana neziqeshana ezikhokhwayo ezedlule ngemuva kosuku lokugcina lokukhokha. Uma la makhasimende efuna ukuxhumana kukagesi, azokhokhwa imali efanele yokuxhumana futhi insiza ngeke ibuyiselwe kuze kube i-akhawunti ikhokhwe ngokuphelele noma isivumelwano esanelisayo senziwa noMsizi Wezezimali ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7. UMkhandlu kufanele uphazamise ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi ngaphambi kwaleso sikhathi sokuqala (13:00) ngosuku lokuphazanyiswa. Ukuxhumana kuzokwenziwa ngokushesha, kodwa kuzokwenziwa kuphela phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Lapho izinsizakalo ziphazanyiswa ezindaweni eziningi, uMkhandlu akabopheleka ukuqala ukuxhumana ngesikhathi esifanayo. UMkhandlu akabopheleka ukuthengisa ugesi kumakhasimende anemitha ezikhokhwayo ngaphambi kokuthi basebenzise ngaphandle kokuthi i-akhawunti yomkhandlu yezinye izinsizakalo nemithwalo yendawo, uma kusebenza, ikhokhwe ngokuphelele noma isivumelwano esanelisayo senziwe noMsizi Wezezimali ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7 salolu hlelo, futhi sigcinwa. Zonke izinsiza zamamitha kagesi eziphazanyisiwe kufanele zibe nezimpawu ezicacile uma insiza iphazanyiswa ngenxa yokungakhokhi, ukuze kugwenywe ukuthi lezi zinsiza eziphazanyisiwe zibikwe njengokungasebenzi.
