Ithimba leMthonjaneni Municipal Council 156 yeMthethosisekelo yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 (Umthetho 108 ka-1996) ifundwa nezinhlu 11 no-98 zeMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000), lapha lenza lezi Zimiso. Zonke izingqungquthela zeCouncil, kanye nezingqungquthela zayo, zizovuleka emphakathini: Kukhona ukuthi le ngxenye ngeke isebenze uma kunesizathu sokwenza okuphambene, kubhekwa uhlobo lwezingqungquthela ezibanjwayo ngokuhambisana nengxenye 20(1)(a) yeMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000). Kulezi Zimiso, "izingqungquthela" zisho zonke izingqungquthela zeCouncil. I-Council izobamba ingqungquthela ejwayelekile ukuze iqhube ibhizinisi okungenani kanye njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu. Umkhulumeli noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ngokucela okubhalwe phansi okuvela enanini elikhulu lababambiqhaza bomkhandlu, angabiza ingqungquthela esheshayo yeCouncil. Okungenani amahora angamashumi ayisithupha nambili (72) ngaphambi kwengqungquthela ejwayelekile yeCouncil kanye okungenani amahora angamashumi amane n Eight (48) ngaphambi kwengqungquthela esheshayo yeCouncil, kuzoshiywa noma kuthunyelwa isaziso sokuba khona engqungqutheleni, esichaza okuzoxoxwa nokusayinwa nguMkhulumeli noma uMqondisi Wezokuxhumana, ukuze kushiywe endaweni lapho kungatholakala kalula khona ngamalungu eCouncil noma endaweni ethile eyaziwa ngumkhandlu. Ukwehluleka ukuthumela isaziso sengqungquthela ngempazamo kumkhandlu akuzokwenzi ukuthi izinqubo zaleso sikhathi zingasebenzi. Akukho okuzoxoxwa engqungqutheleni ngaphandle kwalokho okukhulunywe ezisazisweni zayo, ngaphandle kwezindaba umphakathi ozithola zibalulekile nezisheshayo, kanye nanoma iyiphi indaba iCouncil noma ikomidi elithola kufanele ixoxwe ngokushesha ngenxa yokuba inani lababambiqhaza lingama-2/3. I-Council noma ikomidi lingabambezela ingqungquthela kunoma yisiphi usuku noma isikhathi, kodwa akukho okuzoxoxwa engqungqutheleni ebambezelwe ngaphandle kwalokho okukhulunywe ezisazisweni zengqungquthela ebambezelwe. Uma ingqungquthela ibambezelwe, isaziso sokubambezela sizothunyelwa kumuntu ngamunye weCouncil noma ikomidi, sichaza isikhathi, usuku, nendawo yengqungquthela ebambezelwe. Inani elikhulu lababambiqhaza kumele libe khona engqungqutheleni yeCouncil ngaphambi kokuthi kuvote ngendaba. Zonke imibuzo ephathelene nezinhlinzeko zengxenye 160(2) yeMthethosisekelo izonqunywa yiCouncil ngokuvota kwenani elikhulu lababambiqhaza. Zonke ezinye imibuzo phambi kweCouncil izonqunywa ngenani elikhulu lokuvota ngokuhambisana nengxenye 34 yeMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu, 1998 (Umthetho No. 117 ka-1998) ephathelene nokuphulwa kwamakhansela. Uma kunokulingana kunoma yimuphi umbuzo, umkhandlu oyiChairperson uzovota okwakhe okungeziwe kokuvota njengomkhandlu. Umkhandlu kufanele akhulume neCouncil, noma kunoma ikomidi eliwum member, nganoma yiziphi izintshisekelo zebhizinisi abangase babe nazo ngaphambi kweCouncil noma Ikomidi. Umkhandlu kufanele ahlale angaphakathi ezinqubweni zeCouncil noma engqungqutheleni lapho indaba ixoxwa khona yiCouncil noma Ikomidi, ngaphandle uma iCouncil noma Ikomidi isinqume ukuthi intshisekelo yomkhandlu ngqo noma engaqondile kulowo mbuzo ayibalulekile noma ayifanele. Umkhandlu, yena uqobo, noma umkhandlu wakhe, noma noma yimuphi umuntu ohambisana naye noma omunye osondelene naye, uthola noma usemsebenzini wokuthola inzuzo ngokuqondile kusivumelwano somkhandlu, kufanele akhulume ngemininingwane ephelele yaleyo nzuzo ayazi ngayo engqungqutheleni yokuqala yeCouncil lapho kungenzeka khona ukuthi umkhandlu akhulume ngalokho. Le ngxenye ayisebenzi uma inzuzo itholakala kumkhandlu, noma kumkhandlu wakhe, noma kumuntu osondelene naye noma omunye osondelene naye, kanye nabanye abahlali bomkhandlu. Uma ekupheleni kwesikhathi semizuzu eyishumi ngemuva kwesikhathi lapho ingqungquthela yeCouncil noma Ikomidi ihlelelwe khona, uma kungekho inani elikhulu, ngeke kube khona ingqungquthela, ngaphandle uma kuhlelwe, ngokuvuma kwenani elikhulu lababambiqhaza, ukuthi isikhathi sande, esingeke sidlule imizuzu emihlanu, ukuze kube nenani elikhulu. Kodwa amalungu akhona ngenani elikhulu angase anqume ukubambezela ingqungquthela ngesikhathi esingcono. Uma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi iCouncil noma Ikomidi ihlangene, umphakathi uzokwazi ukuthi inani lababambiqhaza likhona, uzobala, futhi uma kutholakala ukuthi akukho inani elikhulu, iCouncil noma Ikomidi izobamba isikhathi sokuphumula esizothathwa ngamalungu akhona. Kuwo wonke amaqembu eCouncil, umkhulumeli, uma engakabi khona noma ebamba isikhundla somkhulumeli, uzoba nguMphakathi. UMayor uzoba nguMphakathi wezihlangano zeKhomidi, kodwa uma uMayor engakabi khona, uMphakathi Osebenzayo. Ezingqungquthelweni ezihlanganisiwe, inqubo izonqunywa nguMphakathi WaseMunicipal noma njengoba kwenziwa nguMkhulumeli mayelana nezihlangano zeCouncil. Umphakathi, ngokuthanda kwakhe, angangenisa noma iyiphi indaba ohlwini nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Umhumushi uzosetshenziswa ngaphandle uma inani elikhulu lababambiqhaza abakhona lingavumi. Kulindeleke ukuthi abamkhandlu bazosebenzisana nomhumushi ngaphansi kobuholi bukaMkhulumeli. Isicelo sokungahlanganyeli kunoma iyiphi ingqungquthela yeCouncil noma amaqembu kufanele sithunyelwe kuMqondisi Wezokusebenza ngokubhalwe phansi ngaphambi kokuba ingqungquthela ethile iqale. Uma umkhandlu ngenxa yezizathu ezivumelekile engakwazi ukuhambisana nomthetho (1), bangathumela isicelo sokukhululwa kumMqondisi Wezokusebenza, lesi sicelo sizobuyekezwa yiCouncil ngokuhambisana nesicelo esibhalwe phansi. Ngokuqondene nezinhlinzeko zezingxenye 3 no-4 (Ukuhamba kwezingqungquthela) zeKhodi Yokuziphatha kwababambiqhaza (Isheduli 1 yeMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu), inqubo yokwephula umthetho njengoba kubhalwe ezinhlinzekweni 66, 67, no-68 zalezi Zimiso izosebenza. Ababambiqhaza abadinga ukuphuma engqungqutheleni yeCouncil ngaphambi kokuba iphele kufanele bacela imvume kuMkhulumeli. Ngokuqondene noMthetho 6 ophathelene nokuhamba kwezingqungquthela, izingqungquthela zokuhlonza noma zokuthuthukiswa ezihlelwe noma ezivunyelwe yiCouncil zicatshangwa njengezingqungquthela. Imizuzu yezinqubo zezingqungquthela zonke izobhalwa ngezimoto ezizenzakalelayo noma ngenye indlela futhi igcinwe ngalokho nguMqondisi Wezokuxhumana. Umphakathi WaseMunicipal uzoba nesibopho salokho, futhi imizuzu yengqungquthela ngayinye iz
Uma ushiyela okhiye bakho bebukeka, qaphela okhiye be-ofisi obagcina endaweni ephephile. Nikeza okhiye kuphela kubantu abavunyelwe futhi uqinisekise ukuthi bayabuyisa. Ingabe ushiyela ibhange lakho noma ipuleti etafuleni? Gcina ibhange lakho noma ipuleti kanye nezinto ezibalulekile nawe ngaso sonke isikhathi noma zivalwe kudrowa noma ikhabhinethi. Ingabe ushiyela ifoni yakho engaphathwa etafuleni? Ingabe ushiyela imali etafuleni noma kudrowa? Ungakaze ushiyele imali noma ushintsho etafuleni noma kudrowa. Kunalokho, faka imali ephepheni bese uyibeka kudrowa evaliwe. Ingabe ushiyela umnyango we-ofisi uvulekile uma uhamba, noma ungowezinsuku ezimbalwa? Ingabe ushiyela ibhande lakho lingaphathwa? Uma ungowokuqala ukufika e-ofisini, hlola izimpawu zokungena. Uma ubona izimpawu zokungena, ungangenisi, shayela amaphoyisa, futhi wazise bonke abasebenzi abafika e-ofisini. Ingabe ubika ezokuphepha uma uqaphela abantu noma izimoto eziphazamisayo—ikakhulukazi ngemuva kwezinsuku zokusebenza—noma uthemba nje ukuthi othile uzokwenza lokhu? Kufanele ube nekhono elikhethekile emahhovisi atholakala ezakhiweni ezinkulu futhi ikakhulukazi uma sekuphelile isikhathi sokusebenza. Ingabe uhlale uqaphele kakhulu ezitebhisini, ezindaweni ezivulekile, noma ezindaweni ezikhanyisiwe kahle? Uma usebenzisa umshini wokuphakamisa, ingabe ume eduze lapho izinkinobho zicindezelwa, ubheke inkinobho yokuphuthumayo, futhi ungene uma kukhona umuntu ophazamisayo? Ingabe ubika kum maintenance yezakhiwo nasezokuphepha uma kukhona ukukhanya okuphukile noma okukhanyayo, iminyango engavuli noma evaliwe kahle, amafasitela aphukile, noma amafoni omphakathi angasebenzi? Uma usebenza e-ofisini noma esitolo ngemuva kwezinsuku zokusebenza, qiniseka ukuthi iminyango yangaphandle nezifundo zivalwe. Uma unohlelo lokwakha, ungawuphuli ukuze uthole ukuphepha okwengeziwe. Uma usebenza ngezikhathi ezingajwayelekile (njengokubizwa noma ukusebenza ngezikhathi ezihlukahlukene), hamba nabanye noma cela omunye umsebenzi ukuba akuhambise emotweni yakho. Okhiye bakho bemoto kufanele kube lula ukufinyelela, futhi hlola izihlalo zangemuva kuqala ngaphambi kokungena. Ingabe ushiyela izinto ezibalulekile emotweni yakho uma use-ofisini? Vala izinto ezibalulekile emgqonyeni ngaso sonke isikhathi, noma ingabe ushiyela ekhaya? Hamba njalo uqaphele. Ukutshela othile ocingweni ukuthi umngane uphakathi kokugeza kufana nokutshela umgibeli ukuthi leli yithuba elihle lokungena ezindlini zabo. Zama ukwazisa abashayela ukuthi umuntu abawufuna akatholakali ngaphandle kokukhuluma ngemininingwane eyengeziwe. Qiniseka ukuthi labo abafika emsebenzini e-ofisini yakho noma esakhiweni ukuze balungise okuthile baziveza futhi bahlale beqaphele kakhulu ngobukhona babo ngaleso sikhathi. Mnumzane ohola uhlelo, ngaphambi kokuthi ngiqhubeke nesikhulumi engizokwenza, ngithanda ukucela ukuthi sithathe umzuzu ukuze sithobe amakhanda ethu ngenhlonipho kubafowethu nodadewethu abangekho emhlabeni, abavela kwamanye amazwe esixhumene nawo lapha kwi kontinent yethu yase-Afrika, abashiywe yileli zwe ngenxa yezenzo zabantu abaphephethelwe umoya wothando nokungahloniphi amalungelo abanye. Ngiyabonga. Mnumzane ohola uhlelo, ngiyajabula ukuthi namuhla nguMgqibelo, usuku lokugcina lukaMeyi, sihlangene lapha eKwaDinane ukuze sethule uhlelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukudla okwanele emiphakathini yethu. Ngiyasho lokhu, mnumzane ohola uhlelo, ngoba udaba olukhuluma ngalo kulezi zinsuku emhlabeni jikelele ngempela yizindleko zokudla eziphakeme ezikhombisa ngokucacile ukuthi azikhombisi izimpawu zokwehla kodwa zizoqhubeka nokwenyuka. Ekuqaleni kwenyanga edlule, iZizwe Ezihlangene kanye nezinhlangano ezinkulu zokuboleka ezizimele ezweni elithuthukile njengeMali Yezwe kanye neBhange Lomhlaba zikhombisile ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngalesi simo sezindleko zokudla ezikhuphukayo, ikakhulukazi umthelela omubi lokhu okukhona kubantu abampofu ezweni elithuthukayo njengezethu. UNgqongqoshe wezeMali wezwe lethu, uMhlonishwa uTrevor Manuel, utshele umhlangano weMali Yezwe owawubanjelwe eMelika ezinyangeni ezimbili ezedlule ukuthi le nkulu yokwenyuka kwezindleko zokudla ibonisa into eyodwa: abantu nemiphakathi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezweni elithuthukayo, kumele babuyele emasimini ukuze baziphathe. Le ndaba yokwenyuka kwezindleko zokudla ibuhlungu kakhulu uma sithola ukuthi ezweni elithuthukile, abalimi khona bathola ukwesekwa okukhulu nguhulumeni wabo ngokwezimali ngezimikhiqizo ezisemazweni, kudala isimo esingalingani. Ngibone lokhu ngamehlo ami njengoba ngangikwiBelgium ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule eNtshonalanga Yurophu. Ngokwezazi emkhakheni wezolimo, isifunda sethu saseKwaZulu-Natal, uma siqhathaniswa nezinye eziyisishiyagalombili, sikhombisa ukuba phambili ngendawo enomhlaba ophilayo futhi siphinde sibe nenhlanhla yokukwazi ukuqoqa amanzi emvula ezindaweni ezahlukene zesifunda sethu. Le nhlanganisela (umhlaba ophilayo namanzi emvula) ibonisa ngokucacile ukuthi kumele sibe thina abapheka ukudla kwaleli zwe lethu eNingizimu Afrika. Nokho, ngenxa yokungazikhandli kanye nalolu hlobo olubi lokuthi abantu bathi bazolinda uhulumeni, sithola ukuthi sihlangabezana nenkinga uma sizama ukukhuthaza abantu bethu ukuthi basebenzise umhlaba ukuze baziphathe. Abafowethu nodadewethu, impilo iyanda ibe nzima. Namuhla, ibharelwe le-oyela ibiza cishe amadola ayikhulu namashumi amathathu, kuyilapho kungakabi kudlule isikhathi eside ibiza kuphela amadola amathathu. Le nkulu yokwenyuka kwezindleko ze-oyela ibe nomthelela omubi ezindlekweni zokudla nasekutholakaleni. Ukudla okufanele sikwazi ukukudla njalo ukuze sihlale siphilile (ukudla okuyisisekelo njenge-rice, ufulawa, kanye ne-maize) njengokudla okwenziwe ngogwava, ne-maize kubiza kakhulu. Akupheli lapho; ngisho ne-oyela yokupheka noma lokho esikubiza ngokuthi i-margarine namuhla kubiza okuthile okungakholakali. Iningi labomama esinabo lapha lizokwenza ubufakazi ngalokho engikushoyo njengoba bengabathengi bokudla ekhaya. Namuhla, i-1000 rand (R1000) ingathenga izinto ezimbalwa kuphela uma sithenga ukudla noma ukuthenga ukudla emndenini. Yingakho thina, njengohulumeni bezolimo nezindaba zemvelo eKwaZulu-Natal, sikhumbuza amazwi kaNgqongqoshe uManuel ukuthi abafowethu nodadewethu, isimo asizoshintshi kulokhu okwamanje, kodwa siba sibi kakhulu njengoba sonke sizwile ukuthi intengo ye-petrol izonyuka kule mpelasonto. Ukwengeza kulokhu, kukhona izingxoxo zokuthi iBhange leMali leli lungase lwenze ukwenyuka kwentela ngo-2% (ukwenyuka kwentela) uma ikomidi elibhekelele inqubomgomo yezezimali lihlangana ngenyanga ezayo. Lokhu kusho into eyodwa: abantu abanemizi abathengwe ngezikweletu noma izimoto ezisabuyiselwa kuzodingeka bahlupheke ukuze bagcine behlangabezana nezikweletu zabo njengoba abantu sebesingakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo njengoba kuvunyelwene. Ngiyasho lokhu ngoba kumuntu noma ngubani lapha emhlabeni, okokuqala abakucabangayo yizimali uma bebhekene nezimo ezingezinhle empilweni yabo uma kuziwa kwezezimali, ukuthi bathenge okuthile ukuze baphile (ukudla) ngaphambi kokubhekana nezinye izikweletu. Ngokocwaningo lwe-IMF, izindleko zokudla emhlabeni jikelele zikhuphukile cishe ngempela kokwakukhona ngo-2006. Izindleko zokudla emhlabeni zikhuphukile ngo-48% kusukela ngo-2006. Ukuze ngichaze lokho engikushoyo, uma ngo-2006 ibhagi ye-12.5kg yefulawa ibizelwa ku-R15, okwamanje ibhagi efanayo ingathengwa ngama-R28. Mnumzane ohola uhlelo, abaningi bazobuza kungani uNgqongqoshe uMthimkhulu ekhuluma ngento engasondelene nathi. Cha, abafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyasho lokhu ngoba nakwezwe lethu, udaba lwezindleko zokudla eziphakeme nokuthi luthinta kanjani abantu abampofu noma imiphakathi eqhume kakhulu kubonakala, futhi thina njengohulumeni, ikakhulukazi uMnyango wezolimo kuzo zonke izifunda nasemazweni, sikhathazekile kakhulu ngalolu daba. Ngokocwaningo kanye nezibalo zakamuva ezikhishwe yiNational Agricultural Marketing Council, kube nokwenyuka okukhulu kwezindleko zokudla eminyakeni edlule. Ucwaningo lweCouncil lukhombisa ngokucacile ukuthi ukudla okukhuphukile kakhulu kwezindleko yikhona okukhona emadleni abantu abaneholo eliphansi (Abathengi bokudla okuyisisekelo bahlupheke kakhulu). Mnumzane ohola uhlelo, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi thina njengemiphakathi sihlanganyele nohulumeni kanye nomnyango uma kukhona izinhlelo ezifana nalezi esizozethula lapha namuhla. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukusho ukuthi thina, njengomnyango wezolimo nezindaba zemvelo, sikwazile emnyakeni yezezimali ka-2007/2008 eyaphela ngoMashi kulo nyaka ukuba nezinhloso ezifana nalezi engizozethula namuhla lapha eKwaDinane. Lezi zinhlelo zokutshala ubhontshisi ne-maize ezindaweni ezimbili zeBaqulusini neDumbe zibe nezinzuzo ezingaphezu kwamakhulu amane (ngaphezu kwabantu abangu-4,200). Lapha endaweni yeThaka, satshala ubhontshisi endaweni engama-200 hectares, futhi thina njengomnyango sathola uxhaso lwezimali lwezinkulungwane eziyisithupha (R1.4 million). Njengoba ngishilo ngenhla mayelana nohlelo lokutshala ubhontshisi, abantu abazothola izinzuzo bangama-2,000 (abantu abangu-2,000). 10.1 Hlonipha amalungelo akho njengomnikazi wepulazi. Abantu abangaziwa nababambe umoya omubi kumele bathole imvume kuqala ngaphambi kokungena epulazini. Buza esiteshini samaphoyisa sendawo yakho ukuthi umthetho uthi ungakwenza kanjani nokuthi ungawusebenzisa kanjani amalungelo akho. Yakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi bepulazi. Khuthaza abasebenzi ukuba bazi ngokuqinisekile ngokuphepha nokuthi babike noma yiziphi izenzo ezimbi. Khuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baqaphele abantu abangaziwa endaweni futhi bakwazise ngabo. Reward abasebenzi uma behlinzeka ngama-tips noma ulwazi olusizo. Vikele kahle izindlu noma izindawo zokuhlala zabasebenzi nemindeni yabo. 10.3 Ungavumeli muntu ukuba angene epulazini noma endlini, ikakhulukazi ebusuku, ngaphambi kokuthi azive. 10.4 Kumele ugcine okungenani inja eyodwa ngaphakathi endlini. 10.5 Qinisekisa ukuthi amathuluzi anzima okusebenza afana nezikhukhula, ama-picks, ama-hoe, nezinye zivalwe kahle uma engasetshenziswa. Sebenzisa izivalo ezinemigqa noma uphinde ulabela okhiye. Zama ungathwali umjovo wezikhumbuzo. Sebenzisa okhiye abasebenza nezivalo ezinemigqa. Imigqa kufanele iguqulwe njalo. Susa okhiye ezimotweni uma engasadingeki. Guqula okhiye uma okhiye bakho bokuvula lost. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izicabha (kuhlanganise nezicabha ze-garage), amawindi, nezicabha zivalwe kahle uma engasetshenziswa. Ngaphambi kokuvula noma yini, qinisekisa ukuthi unokhiye wakho. Ungazami ukufihla okhiye ezindaweni ezilula ukufinyelela ezifana phansi kwemats noma ezitsheni. Uma ushiyela okhiye emgibeni ngaphakathi kwendlu, kufanele ujikele okhiye ukuze ugweme ukuvalwa ngaphandle. 10.7 Ngaso sonke isikhathi wazisa umndeni wakho lapho uya khona, ukuthi iyiphi indlela ozoyithatha, nokuthi uzobuya nini. 10.8 Hlola ifoni yakho njalo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi iyasebenza. Beka ifoni endaweni lapho ingafinyelelwa kalula, ikakhulukazi kude newindi lapho ingashaywa kalula. 10.9 Ngaso sonke isikhathi gcina isibani esikhaleni sakho ebusuku; uma usebenzisa isibani, yenza kanjalo ngendlela engakhombisi indawo yakho. 10.10 Zama ukudala izithiyo zokuvimbela ukuhlaselwa kwezilwane nezimpahla. 10.11 Ungawenzi umsebenzi ofanayo noma umsebenzi owodwa nsuku zonke. 10.12 Yenza kube umkhuba wokungahambi embhedeni ngokushesha ngemva kokucisha ukukhanya ebusuku. Hlala uqaphele okwesikhashana. Ungalali endaweni lapho ungabonwa khona umuntu ngaphandle kwendlu. 10.13 Ungami phambi kwewindi uma uvalela noma uvula ama-curtains. Vala ama-curtains ngendlela engakhombisi kalula. Ama-curtains akufanele abe sobala ngaphakathi. Ukunyakaza kwabantu noma imithunzi yabo akufanele kubonakale ngaphandle ngaphakathi kwemitha eyi-10 kwendlu. 10.14 Thatha izithombe nemigqa yeminwe yazo zonke izisebenzi ukuze uvimbele ukuba zifeze noma zibe nengxenye ezinhle. 10.15 Ukuqeqesha ukuhamba ngebhande epulazini (endaweni ephephile) kungavimbela nabafuna ukwenza izenzo ezimbi. 10.16 Izingane zakho kufanele zikwazi ukuphendula ifoni ngenhlonipho. Akufanele zikhulume nabantu abangaziwa noma zamukele izipho kubantu abangaziwa. Bonke abakhona ekhaya kufanele babe nengxenye yokuzivikela. 10.17 Ngaso sonke isikhathi gcina ikhamera endala emotweni. Thatha izithombe zabantu abangaziwa endaweni noma abavakashele epulazini lakho. 10.18 Uma ungazi ukuthi ungabuyela kanjani ekhaya ngokuphepha ngemva kohambo, xhumana nomakhelwane wakho ukuze akusize uhlole ikhaya lakho. Lokhu kungavimbela ukuba ube yisithiyo kwababi. 10.19 Chaza izindawo ezivame ukuba ziphephile, ezifana nezindawo zokuhlala, ama-shower, noma izindawo zokugcina. Kungcono ukuba nezicabha nezama-windows ezincane. 10.20 Ungagcini izinto ezingabamba ukunakwa ngaphakathi endlini. 10.21 Qonda indawo ukuze ukwazi ukuphuma, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. 10.22 Fika ekhaya ngenkathi kusemhlabeni noma phakathi nosuku. 10.23 Qonda noma yiziphi izinqubo ezihlobene nezivakashi zamaphoyisa, uMphathi, noma omakhelwane. 10.24 Ukuxhumana kubalulekile kakhulu ekuzivikeleni emaphandleni. Ngakho-ke, ipulazi ngalinye kufanele libe nendlela yokuxhumana namanye amapulazi endaweni, amaphoyisa, kanye neNhlangano Yokuphepha. 10.25 Kumele kube nezindlela ezimbili zokweseka noma ukusiza esimweni esiphuthumayo, ezifana nefoni noma iradiyo yomphakathi. Ifoni ephathekayo iyasiza kakhulu ngoba ayixhunyiwe emgibeni ongafinyelelwa. 10.26 Uhlelo lokuxhumana olusebenzisa ama-radios kufanele lwenziwe futhi luhlale lwenziwa njalo. Umuntu onokwethenjelwa kufanele aqokwe ukuphatha lo msebenzi. 10.27 Abasebenzi bepulazi nabo bangengxenye yale qembu futhi kufanele babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuphepha. 10.28 Abasebenzi bepulazi kufanele babambe iqhaza ngokulinganayo ekugcineni ukuphepha epulazini. 10.29 Abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe ukusebenzisa amagama akhodiwe ukuze baphakamise izimpawu ezithile uma kukhona ingozi noma isimo esiphuthumayo. 10.31 Bonisa futhi wazise bonke abakhona epulazini mayelana nezindlela zokuphuma nezicabha. 10.32 Izindlela zokuxhumana (kuhlanganise nezinye izinhlobo zokuxhumana) kufanele zihlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza. 10.33 Uma kukhona ukukhathazeka ngokuphepha phakathi kwabantu abasebenzi, kufanele kuphendulwe. 10.34 Zama izindlela ezahlukene. Thumela ulwazi kwabanye amalungu endaweni, uMphathi, noma iSikhungo Samaphoyisa ukuze kuhlolwe. 10.35 Ubudlelwano obuhle bokubambisana bubalulekile kakhulu.
2.1 Uhlelo lweMpi lunguhlelo oluzithandela oluhlangene neSikhungo seMpi saseNingizimu Afrika esisebenza ngokungaphelele. Umphathi ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuvikela nokuvikela umphakathi othile (ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma emadolobheni). Usizo abahlinzekayo ngokuvamile lubizwa ngokuthi usizo lendawo. Usizo lendawo luhlanganisa umphakathi wonke wendawo, ngakho-ke ngisho nomuntu ongowomphakathi ongum member wohlelo lweMpi uzothola ukuvikelwa ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo nakuba engatholi zonke izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuba yilungu lohlelo. 2.2 Labo abahlanganyela kulolu hlelo lweMpi abanakho umthwalo wemfanelo wokuvikela ngaphandle kwemingcele yezindawo abenza kuzo; banomthwalo wemfanelo kuphela wokuvikela nokuvikela imiphakathi yabo. 2.3 Lolu hlelo lungachazwa ngokufushane njengokuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zibe izifunda ezincane, izingxenye ezilawulwayo. Iziqukathi ezincane zinezinombolo ezithile zamafamu noma/nomakhaya, kuye ngesisindo sendawo kanye nokwabiwa kwezindawo lapho abantu behlala khona. Amalungu endawo axhumana ngefoni noma iradiyo esebenza njengohlelo lokweseka izindlela zokuxhumana uma imigqa yefoni iphuka. Ezinye izinhlelo zokuxhumana zibalulekile ohlelweni lokuvikela ezindaweni. Amalungu endaweni axhumana nomholi wabo (okhethwe ngamalungu) onendlela yokuxhumana nesiteshi samaphoyisa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuphendula okusheshayo kwabaphoyisa uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa. Umholi Wohlelo angazisa umphathi waleso sithangami uma kudingeka amandla amakhulu. 2.4 Inqubo yokuxhumana ingathatha isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke, amalungu endaweni kumele akwazi ukuzivikela futhi athembe usizo lwabangane nabanye amalungu endaweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula okusheshayo esimweni esiphuthumayo. Ngalesi sizathu, indawo kumele ihlele ukuze ibhekane nezimo ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke. Umphathi Wendawo uzosiza lolu hlelo lendawo uma luhlela uhlelo lokuphendula ezimweni eziphuthumayo. 2.5 Ukhiye wokusebenza kahle kwalolu hlelo ubambisene ngokulinganayo kwamalungu endaweni wonke. Joyina - kuzokusiza!
Abameli bafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamuzi zaleli zwe eziboshwe kwamanye amazwe ziphathwa ngendlela efanele ngesikhathi zisejele. Noma yiziphi izenzo ezihlobene nokuhlukunyezwa noma ukuphathwa okungahlonishwa noma ukuphathwa kabi kufanele kubikwe eziphathimandla zalelo ndawo. Imithetho yamazwe ngamazwe ephathelene nokuphathwa kweziboshwa iyasetshenziswa kulezi zimo. Yisiphi usizo olunikezwa abameli ezakhamuzini zaseNingizimu Afrika eziboshwe kwamanye amazwe? Banika iziboshwa ulwazi ngemicimbi yaleso sikhungo, okungase kufake phakathi imikhawulo yezomthetho yaleso sikhungo, indlela yokufinyelela ohlwini lwabameli uma sebuya ejele, izimo zokukhululwa, nendlela yokuphakamisa icala ukuze iziboshwa zazi amalungelo azo. Bagcina uxhumano olujwayelekile neziboshwa zaseNingizimu Afrika kulowo mhlaba ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bayahambisana nemithetho yaleso sikhungo. Uxhumano nomndeni nabangane luvunyelwe uma luceliwe yiziboshwa. Akukho xhumano noma ulwazi oluzokwabelwana ngaphandle kwemvume yesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika esiboshwe kwamanye amazwe. Baqinisekisa ukuthi uma udinga usizo lwezempilo, ubika eziphathimandla ejele. Iphondo lezeMisebenzi Yangaphandle kanye nabameli baseNingizimu Afrika kwamanye amazwe benza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimali, imibhalo nezinto zokufunda, kanye nemithi zifika eziboshweni ngokushesha. Nokho, imisebenzi ebalulekile ye-ofisi ye-embassy ibekwe phambili. Isimo salelo zwe singavimbela ukufika kwezinto eziboshwe. Ukugxila kubekwa ekuthuthukiseni izinkantolo zamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kutholwe ummeli noma ukunikeza izeluleko zomthetho ukuze kube lula ukukhululwa, noma imali yokukhululwa ezindaweni eziphephile noma ejele ukuze kuhlolwe icala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimo zokuphila ejele z better compared to others ngaphandle kokulandela imithetho yamazwe ngamazwe ephathelene nokuboshwa kweziboshwa. Abantu abakhuluma izilimi ezimbili bahlala ejele ezweni lesibili lapho futhi bengabakhulumi khona futhi abakwazi ukusizwa ngabameli baseNingizimu Afrika. Uma abantu abakhuluma izilimi ezimbili bahlala ejele kwamanye amazwe lapho bengabakhulumi khona, futhi bahambe ngepasipoti evela ezweni lesibili, kufanele baxhumane ne-embassy yalelo zwe abahambile ngale pasipoti. Izinga lokusebenza liyahluka ukusuka ezweni ukuya ezweni futhi lincike esimweni sezwe eliboshwe umuntu.
Thina, abasebenzi boMnyango Wezemfundo eKwaZulu-Natal, siqonda futhi sihlonipha ilungelo labantu abangasebenzisi izinsizakalo zethu lokuxhumana, ukuthola ukwelashwa okufanele kanye nensizakalo efanele, ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, ukwaziswa ngohlobo nangesigaba senkonzo abazoyithola, ukufaka izikhalazo uma bethola insizakalo engafanele ngesikhathi esifanele nangendlela ehlonipha ukubhekelela kwezimali nokubamba iqhaza ngokuphelele emisebenzini ngenhloso yokuvula nokukhanya. UMnyango Wezemfundo eKwaZulu-Natal unikezwe amandla nguMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuhlinzeka ngofundo lomphakathi kubo bonke abafundi esifundazweni saseKwaZulu-Natal, kungakhathaliseki kweminyaka. Ufundiswa ezingeni lezikole zezingane ezincane nezinkulu. Ufundiswa kubafundi abanezimfuno zokufunda ezahlukene. Ufundiswa ezikoleni zamakholeji ukuze kuqhubeke ukufunda nokuqeqeshwa. Izinhlelo zokweseka othisha nabafundi ezikoleni nasezikhungweni ezithuthukisa abasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi nezakhiwo zezimali nokwesekwa ngezinhlelo zomsebenzi. Siqonda futhi sihlonipha ilungelo labantu lokufaka izikhalazo uma izinsizakalo zingahlinzekwa ngendlela efanele noma eyanele. Ungasibhalela kuleli bhokisi elingezansi. Sizozama ukuxolisa nokulungisa uma sithola iphutha ngasohlangothini lwethu. Ungasebenzisa inombolo engakhokhiwe ukuze ubike ubugebengu, ukungathembeki, kanye nokuphathwa kabi. P.O. Idokhumenti losizo oluvela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nensiza yeMuni yaseThekwini lunikeza amakhasimende alo ulwazi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okulindelwe umphakathi mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekwe zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Umphakathi uyazi ukuthi angaxhumana kanjani neMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nensiza yeMuni yaseThekwini. Indlela yokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende ngenxa yokukhetha ukuhambisana nezindinganiso zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezishicilelwe ngenkathi kuhambisana namalungelo amakhasimende. Iziteshi ongazilandela njengomthengi uma ufuna ukuveza ukungajabuli kwakho ngezinga lethu lokuhlinzeka. "Zonke ofisi" ibhekisela lapho izinkinga ezihlobene namanzi ziphathwa khona. I-imeyili: eservices@dmws.durban.gov. Ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi anomfutho ngqo emakhaya kusuka kumapayipi omasipala. Ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi anomfutho ophansi kufika emakhaya ngezithombe eziphakeme. Ama-litre angama-200 wamanzi ngosuku atholakala kumathangi aphansi agcwaliswa nsuku zonke - kulingana nama-litre angama-6,000 wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga. Amathangi emigwaqo afakwe emiphakathini ethintwe okwamanje yindlala. Ama-tankers amanzi afinyelela lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okwandile. Odoti athuthwa ngama-pipes ajwayelekile asetshenziswa amanzi - axhunyiwe kwi-infrastructure yokulahla udoti. Odoti uhlinzekwa ngama-pipes asetshenziswa amanzi akhishwe kwi-sewer - ithangi elingaphansi komhlaba elihlobene nalo. Lapho amanzi esetshenziswa, akhishwa ethangini lapho itroli izokhipha khona futhi iyithumele kwenye indawo. Bonke amakhasimende athola ama-litre ayisithupha wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga, nezindleko zikhuphuka kulabo abak receiving amanzi anomfutho ophakeme noma amanzi anomfutho ophansi nezindleko ezimisiwe kulabo abak receiving amanzi anomfutho ophakeme abathola ngaphezu kwama-litre ayisithupha ngenyanga futhi bahlala ezindaweni zokuhlala ezibiza ngaphezu kuka-R40,000 ngokwezinhlelo zomkhandlu. Noma yimuphi umthengi onenani lempahla elingaphansi kuka-R36,000 ngokwezinhlelo zomkhandlu futhi ongakhokhi ukuthuthwa kodoti uthola le nsizakalo mahhala. Noma iyiphi ithoyilethi ye-VIP iyakhishwa mahhala njalo eminyakeni emihlanu. Izinkokhelo eziphakeme Ziphuma: Amakhasimende anconywa ukuthi ahlole le ndaba. Ukuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngemininingwane ye-GIS, izithombe zomoya, izigameko eziphakeme, nezinye izibalo. A4 standard - Ngaso sonke isikhathi mahhala. Ilayisensi ye-television inika umuntu igunya lokuthenga ithelevishini eyodwa ukuze abuke ithelevishini. Uma uthenga ilayisensi ye-television okokuqala, ukhokha imali ephelele yonyaka engu-R225. Imali ye-licence esheshayo kwabanye abantu ingu-R65 ngonyaka. Noma ubani oneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-70 noma odla izinsuku, ongahlali nabantu abasebenzayo noma ongancikile kubo, ukhululekile. Izinhlangano zidinga ilayisensi ye-television nganye ithelevishini abayithengile enhlanganweni. Imizi idinga ilayisensi eyodwa ukuze zonke ithelevishini ezikhona emzini. Umthengisi we-television kufanele azise amakhasimende ukuthi awakwazi ukuthenga ithelevishini ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi belayisensi ye-television. Abafuna ukuthenga ithelevishini bangafaka izicelo zelayisensi ehhovisi leposi eliseduzane, noma bacele umthengisi ukuthi abathengele ilayisensi. Ilayisensi ivuselelwa minyaka yonke. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela ku-website www.tvlic.co. Faka isicelo ehhovisi leposi eliseduzane noma nomthengisi ogunyaziwe ukukhipha ama-licences e-TV. Ungafaka isicelo ku-inthanethi endaweni: www.tvlic.co. Kungathatha amahora ambalwa.
IPhalamende idinga idokhumenti ezovumela imibono yomphakathi mayelana nezinsiza ezithile ukuba iphume ezincwadini zikamasipala ezinezikhangiso zomphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi lezi zinsiza zethulwe ePhalamende ngenhloso yokwenza kube umthetho obophelelayo owamukelwe yiPhalamende. Lokhu kuhambisana nemithetho kahulumeni eqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni angachaza ngemininingwane futhi azibophezele, aphendule ngendlela efanele, futhi abe sobala. Ekwenyukeni kokuqala kukaDisemba 2006, amalungu ePhalamende avumelene ekubhaleni umthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ezincwadini zikamasipala ezinezikhangiso zomphakathi, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. UNgqongqoshe wezokuphila kwemvelo nezokuhamba, uMarthinus Van Schalkwyk, wamemezela ngoDisemba 8, 2006, ukuthi lo mthetho uzobe utholakala ezincwadini zokukhuluma zomphakathi ngoDisemba 15, 2006. UNgqongqoshe wakhuluma ngokucacile ukuthi ngenxa yezakhi ezahlukene ezenza lo mthetho, umphakathi unikezwa izinsuku eziyi-90 zokukhuluma nokukhombisa imibono yabo ngalolu mthetho. Le dokhumenti itholakala kumapublishers wezincwadi zikamasipala (inombolo yocingo 012-334 4511 noma 012-465 7531) noma kuwebhusayithi kahulumeni http://www.deat.gov.za/. Inhloso yalezi zihloko ezitholakala lapha ukusiza umphakathi ekukhulumeni ngezindaba ezidala incazelo futhi zixhomeke kulwazi olwanele mayelana nalokho umphakathi ofuna ukukukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esinikeziwe sezi-90. Lezi zihloko zenzelwe ukuchaza umlando owaholela ekushicilelweni kombiko osemthethweni kahulumeni mayelana nokuphathwa nentuthuko yezilwandle eNingizimu Afrika (iWhite Paper on Sustainable Coastal Development in South Africa). Lo mbiko kahulumeni unikeze umgomo kazwelonke wokuphatha izilwandle zethu. Lapha kuqukethwe incazelo emfushane echaza umsebenzi wesigaba ngasinye esitholakala kulomthetho. Uma lo mthetho uba umthetho ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, kuzoba isikhathi sokuqala ukuthi lo mthetho ube nomthetho (Act) ophathelene nokuphathwa nentuthuko yezilwandle. Izilwandle ziyinsiza yezomnotho engakahlukaniswa. Ukushicilelwa komthetho ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukukhuluma ngawo kuletha ithuba elibalulekile kulabo abathintekayo ezilwandle, labo abafuna ukuxhumana nabathintekayo mayelana nezilwandle, kanye namalungu omphakathi afuna ukufaka isandla ekwakhiweni kwemithetho eyinhlanganisela yokuphathwa kwezilwandle. Imibuzo ebuzwa kakhulu - kungani kufanele kube nomthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ngqo - ingabe izilwandle azihlanganisiwe nemithetho eyamukelwe yokubheka imvelo? Imibuzo le izotholakala ngezansi. Izilwandle ziyingxenye ehlukile yemvelo. Yindawo lapho umhlaba uhlangana nolwandle, indawo engakhululekile kodwa ixhasa izidingo eziningi zabantu. Izilwandle ziyisistimu enezici eziningi esingazibala, isistimu yesayensi yezinhlanga eziphilayo zezilwandle, ukuvikelwa, ukuhamba, kanye nokuxhumana kwalezi zici okudinga ukubhekwa nokucatshangelwa mayelana nokuphathwa kwezilwandle. Izilwandle kufanele ziphathwe kahle ukuze kukhuphuke izinga lezinzuzo ezivela kuzo zonke amathuba atholakala ezilwandle. Nokho, le ndlela yokuphatha nokubhekwa ayikasebenzi kahle kuze kube manje ngoba izakhi ezahlukene zikahulumeni ziqhuba kuphela izinto eziphathelene nezindawo zabo ezithile ezifana nokusetshenziswa komhlaba, ezolimo, amanzi, ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, nezinye. Iphromotha indlela ebhekelela zonke izigaba ezithuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezilwandle. Le sistimu ibonisa izilwandle njengendawo okufanele ibonakale njengokubalulekile futhi kufanele iphathwe ngokufanele. Phambilini, ukubaluleka kwezilwane nemvelo endaweni yezilwandle njengokudingeka okubalulekile kokuthuthukiswa akukabhekwanga kahle ezinqumweni ezithathwe eNingizimu Afrika. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubona izinzuzo ezivela ezilwandle. Inani lezinsiza ezitholakala ezilwandle, ngonyaka ka-1998, lalilinganiselwa ku-R168 billion ngonyaka, okuyinzuzo elinganiselwa ku-35% yomkhiqizo kazwelonke wezomnotho wezilwandle. Umnotho obalulekile uxhumene nezilwandle futhi uqhubeka usebenzisa ngendlela engafanele, okungabandakanya ukwakhiwa nokuhamba. Amathuba okuthuthukiswa abalulekile noma kukhona inkinga yokuphuma kwawo, futhi ukuvumelana kwamathuba kubantu bonke kuyalahleka, futhi izilwane nemvelo yezilwandle nazo ziyaphazanyiswa. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ugcizelela futhi ukuphathwa kwemvelo okuzoqinisekisa ukuthi imvelo yezilwandle isetshenziswa ngendlela esheshayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi impilo yemvelo nezitshalo, ukuhamba kwenzeke ngendlela efanele. Ukuze impilo yezilwane nemvelo ibe nephephile ukuze isetshenziswe ngendlela esheshayo, akufanele kuholele ekuphileni kwezilwane nemvelo. Ukuze amathuba okuzijabulisa ezilwandle atholakale kubo bonke ngokulinganayo, umphakathi osebenzisa izilwandle kufanele ufundiswe ukuze ubambisane futhi unakekele, ikakhulukazi ukuvuselela abampofu kanye nemiphakathi abavela kuyo, kubandakanya abesifazane nezingane. Ukuze le sistimu isebenze, umphakathi kufanele ube namathuba angcono, imisebenzi, futhi ube neziqhamo ezizuzisayo. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni awuzange uveze kuphela umbono, imigomo, nezinhloso mayelana nokuphathwa okufanele kwezilwandle eNingizimu Afrika. Lo mbiko uthathile esinye isinyathelo mayelana nalokho okufanele kulandelwe lapho kuqala le sistimu yokuphatha izilwandle. Enye indlela kwakuwukuthuthukiswa kwesikhungo kanye nemithetho ephathelene nalesi sikhungo. Ngemuva kokuba amalungu ePhalamende avumelene ngalombiko, uhlaka lwezomthetho lwahlaziywa. Lokhu kwenziwe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi lo mbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ungavulwa ngokuhambisana nezimiso zomthetho ezivele zakhululwa. Ngemuva kwalolu hlolo, kwatholakala ukuthi kudingeka imithetho ephathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ukuze kuqale lo mbiko. Inhloso yalombiko kanye nokusebenza kwengqalasizinda yokuphatha izilwandle ephakanyisiwe kuxhomeke kumaphuzu akhulunywe ngemininingwane ngenhla. Lesi sigaba sichaza imigomo nezivumelwano, futhi siphinde sibe umthetho ozosiza ekuhumusheni kwalombiko, sikhanyisa indima kahulumeni ekuphathweni kwezilwandle, futhi sichaze ukuthi lo mbiko uhambelana nani futhi ubathinteka kanjani. Lo mthetho ophumelele kufanele ufundwe kanye nomthetho wezokuphatha imvelo kazwelonke, futhi lo mbiko uphinde uchaze ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe kanjani uma kungahambisani nalomthetho nakwezinye. Lo mthetho uhambelana nokusungulwa komthetho ophathelene nokusetshenziswa kwezilwandle ngumphakathi, kanye nemithetho ethinta izilwandle. Indawo yezilwandle ichazwa ngemininingwane ephathelene nendawo yokuqala (isigaba sokuqala), indawo esesigabeni sezilwandle esisetshenziswa umphakathi ukuze azijabulise futhi athole inzuzo ezilwandle (indawo yokuvikela yezilwandle). Kukhona nezindawo ezivikelwe ezilwandle. Phakathi nendawo yezilwandle, kukhona indawo eyinsundu nol

Ukungeniswa kweMali yeMinyaka Emithathu (MTEF) yoHulumeni wePhondo laseGauteng ka-2006/07 kubonisa isinyathelo esibalulekile emizamweni yethu eqhubekayo yokuhlangabezana nezifiso zabantu baseGauteng ngendlela enenjongo. Le MTEF ibonisa izinto ezibalulekile eziphakanyiswe uhulumeni wesifunda. Ngesikhathi salokhu kubusa, sikhombisile intuthuko ebonakalayo ekufezeni izinhloso esizibekile. Ibhajethi ka-2006/07 yakha phezu kwempumelelo le futhi ivumela ukuthi siqhubeke sihamba phambili ezinhlelweni zethu. Ibhajethi yalesi sikhathi iphinde ikhulise uxhaso lwezinkonzo zomphakathi, ithuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kanye nezindleko zokusebenza, ngaphandle kokuphuthelwa izinselelo ezikhona nezilindelekile. Ukwanda kokwabiwa kwezimali zokusebenza kuqinisa kakhulu ukuzibophezela kwethu ekukhuliseni umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokulwa nobuphofu. Lezi zimali zokusebenza zizodlulisela emisebenzini ephathelene nezinsiza ezizoba yisisekelo sokukhulisa umnotho nokudala imisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwemizamo yokukhuthaza umnotho, siphinde sizibophezele ekwandiseni uxhaso olunikezwa ezinkonzo zomphakathi ngokwenza kube nempumelelo ukuthi u-80% wephakethe lethu lezimali unikezelwe kulolu hlobo lomphakathi. Izimali ezinikwe kulesi sikhungo sezokuhlaliswa zizobhekana nezidingo eziphuthumayo ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo, kuhlanganise nokusabalalisa izinsiza ezihlinzeka ngophenyo lwe-HIV ne-AIDS kubaguli, kanye nokuqhubeka kohlelo lokuvimbela i-HIV ne-AIDS. Sithemba ukuthi uzothola le ndatshana iyasiza ekuqondeni nasekuhlaziyeni ibhajethi yoHulumeni wePhondo laseGauteng. Kungani sidinga ibhajethi? Ibhajethi iyithuluzi elikhombisa ukuthi izimali ezitholakalayo zizosebenza kanjani. Ibhajethi ivumela ukuthi sihlele ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ngendlela ezosivumela ukuba sifinyelele izinhloso esizibekile. Sinomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina umphakathi unolwazi ngezinyathelo zoHulumeni nokuthi izimali zisetshenziswa kanjani. Ngokwethula ibhajethi, sikhombisa futhi uhlaka lokwabiwa nokubhekwa kwezimali ezinyathelweni zoHulumeni. Yiziphi izinto ezibalulekile zephondo nezicwangciso ezilandelwa nguHulumeni wePhondo laseGauteng? Emikhakheni yezomnotho, sigxila ekudaleni imisebenzi nasekukhuleni emikhakheni ethuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Ezindaweni ezikhethiwe zelizwe, sikhangisa ukukhula komnotho okuhlanganisayo nokuthuthukiswa komnotho wesifunda. Sigcizelela iGauteng njengendawo yokutshalwa kwezimali, indawo yokuvakasha, indawo yokusebenza, kanye nendawo yokuncintisana kwezokungcebeleka. Sidlala indima ebalulekile njengabathengi bezimpahla nezinsizakalo ukuze sithuthukise izinhloso zethu zomnotho, kuhlanganise nokweseka abakhiqizi bendawo nokwakha amandla abantu abamnyama nabesifazane emnothweni. Sisebenzisa ngokuphelele umhlaba wezolimo futhi sixhasa abalimi abasha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ezinsizeni nasekufinyeleleni emakethe. Ukwenza iGauteng ibe yisifunda esihlangene futhi esinokuncintisana kakhulu ezweni, lapho imisebenzi yezomnotho ezindaweni ezahlukene zephetho ihambisana nokukhulisa iGauteng njengendawo yokusebenza emnothweni e-Afrika nasemadolobheni azwakalayo kulo lonke izwe. I-Strategy yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa kweGauteng (GDS) ihlose ukubhekana nezinguquko zomphakathi nezomnotho esifundeni, ukugcina ukuzinza kwezepolitiki, ukwakha izinsiza ezisebenzayo zoHulumeni, ukukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho wesifunda, nokunciphisa amazinga aphezulu wokungasebenzi kanye nobuphofu. Ngokwenza: - ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezimo zomphakathi nezomnotho esifundeni ngokusekelwe ekplanini ehlanganisiwe, esezingeni eliphezulu, nasekuthatheni ingxenye. - ukuhlinzeka ukukhula komnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokufeza umbono wesifunda ezinyangeni eziyishumi ezizayo zokubusa ngentando yeningi. - ukukhuthaza ukubambisana kanye nobudlelwano phakathi koHulumeni nezinye izigaba zomphakathi. - ukuthola amathuba kuwo wonke amakhaya nabantu ukuze babambe iqhaza ekwakheni nasekuthuthukiseni isifunda. Izindawo zokuhlala ezintsha zizoba nazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo umphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi noma ngabe ngemuva kokuthi abahlali bangenile ezindlini ezintsha. Izinsiza zomphakathi zingaguqulwa njengoba umphakathi uthuthuka. Isibonelo, izikole ezindaweni ezikhulayo zingaguqulwa zibe izindawo zokuhlangana zomphakathi; lezi zinsiza kufanele zigcinwe futhi zisetshenziswe ngokuphelele. UHulumeni angakha izinsiza ezindaweni ezingenazo izinsiza noma ezindaweni ezibekelwe ukuhlala kwabantu; kuhlanganise neziteshi zeGautrain ezihlelwe, ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela ezinsizweni nokukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo. Umphakathi uthola zonke izinhlelo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zabo, kuhlanganise nokufinyelela emanzini ayisisekelo namandla kagesi mahhala. Izenzo zokuqala ezibaluleke kakhulu zizoba ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi kanye nezokuhlanzeka, ezidlala indima ebalulekile ekukhuthazeni impilo enhle. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezahlukene ezindaweni ezihlelwe kahle kuzofezwa ngokubambisana nomkhakha ozimele nezinye izithakazelo. Ikusasa lezindawo zokuhlala ezisemadolobheni sizobhekana nakho. Ukuvuselelwa kwezindawo zokuhlala ezisemadolobheni kuzohilela ukubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zoHulumeni kanye nezitshalomali ezivela kokubili emkhakheni womphakathi nasemkhakheni ozimele ngendlela ethuthukisa izinzuzo. Ukugxila nasekuthuthukiseni imizamo yokukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho wendawo ukuze kuhanjiswe imisebenzi, kwakha izinsiza zomphakathi, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela kumathuba emiphakathini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziphuthumayo. UHulumeni uzogxila ekucwangcweni nasekuphatheni izitshalomali zawo ezindaweni ezithile ukuze wandise ukweseka kwawo. Ukwakhiwa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo ezophatha ukuphathwa kwezokuthutha zomphakathi kuzothuthukisa ukufinyelela kwezokuthutha okuphephile nokufaneleka, kunciphise isikhathi sokuhamba kwabantu nezimpahla esifundeni sethu nasemaphandleni, futhi kunciphise imiphumela emibi yokuphila kwezokuthutha. Ukwakha indawo yomphakathi ephephile nephilile ngokunciphisa ukuveliswa kwemfucumfucu, ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezivuselelekayo, nokubhekana nokungcoliswa komoya, amanzi, nomhlabathi. Ukubambisana nemiphakathi kanye nezokuphepha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha ezindaweni zomphakathi, ezindlini, ezindaweni zokusebenza, nasezikoleni, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane nezingane. Ukukhuthaza ukudla okunempilo nokuphila kahle. Izinhlelo zokuvikela nempilo zizokwakhiwa ukuvimbela izifo nokufa ngenxa yokuhlukumezeka, izingozi zomgwaqo, ingcindezi, i-HIV ne-AIDS, izindlela zokuphila ezingezinhle, nokuphuza utshwala ngokweqile. Uhlelo lwezimali lwezinga le-2005/06 leHhovisi lePhondo laseGauteng luhlangana nonyaka esiwugubha i-50th anniversary yeFreedom Charter. Njengoba sigubha lo mcimbi wonyaka, sithumele izimali kulesi sabelomali ukuze siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinhloso zeFreedom Charter futhi sikhulise izinzuzo esizitholile kuze kube manje ekwandiseni ukufinyelela ezempilo engcono. Kusukela ngo-1994, siphumelele ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile esivumela ukuba siqhubeke nokuqhubeka kwezinhloso zethu ezicacile. Imiphumela yomsebenzi wethu iqala ukuvelela kakhulu ngokwanda kokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi, ukuthuthukiswa kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, nokukhula komnotho. Siphumelele ekwakheni umphakathi ongcono osuselwe ekuqondeni nasekudumeni kwabantu bonke. Ukufeza ukukhula komnotho nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Lesi sabelomali sichaza ukuthi sizobhekana kanjani nezinto ezibalulekile ngezinhlelo ezahlukene kanye nemikhankaso yeHhovisi lePhondo laseGauteng eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Isu lokukhula nokuthuthukiswa kweGauteng lihambisana ngqo nezibopho zethu zokubeka umgomo emkhankasweni kazwelonke wokunciphisa ubuphofu nokungasebenzi ngokukhulisa umnotho ngendlela ehlangene. Sizogxila futhi ezinselelweni zesigaba sesibili somnotho wethu, esichazwa ngezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ukungabi namakhono, kanye nezinga eliphansi lokukhula ngokujwayelekile. Izinsizakalo zomphakathi zenza u-81% wesabelomali esiphelele, okukhombisa ngokusobala ukuzibophezela kwethu ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi ezingeni eliphezulu kubo bonke abahlali baseGauteng. Siphinde sithumele izimali ukuze sibhekane nemikhankaso yokwakha izinsiza kanye nezinhlelo ezihloselwe ukuvuselela umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokulwa nobuphofu ephondweni. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uzothola le dokhumenti iyasiza kakhulu ekuqondeni nasekuhlaziyeni isabelomali sePhondo laseGauteng sika-2005. Kungani sidinga isabelomali? Isabelomali isu elibonisa ukuthi izimali ezitholakalayo zizosebenza kanjani. Isabelomali lisivumela ukuba sihlela ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ngendlela ezothola khona izinhloso esizibekile phambili. Sinomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina umphakathi unolwazi ngesenzo sokuhulumeni nokuthi izimali zisetshenziswa kanjani. Ngokwethula isabelomali, sikhombisa isu lokwabelana nokuhlola izimali zokwenza izenzo zokuhulumeni. Ekusebenziseni kahle umhlaba wezolimo nasekusekeleni abalimi abasafufusa. Ukwethulwa kohlelo lwezokwakha oluhlanganisiwe nolwakhiwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi. Izinsiza zomphakathi zingaguqulwa njengoba umphakathi ushintsha. Isibonelo, izikole emiphakathini ekhula zingaguqulwa zibe izindawo zokuhlangana zomphakathi. Yiziphi izidingo ezisemqoka zephondo, izidingo ezibalulekile, kanye nezinhlelo ezivunyelwe yiHhovisi lePhondo laseGauteng? Ukukhuthaza ukusetyenziswa kokudla okunempilo nokuphila impilo enempilo futhi evumelekile. Yiziphi izidingo ezisemqoka zephondo, izidingo ezibalulekile, kanye nezinhlelo ezivunyelwe yiHhovisi lePhondo laseGauteng? Sithola kuphi izimali zethu? Sisebenzisa kanjani izimali zethu? Sisebenzisa kanjani izimali zethu? Siphinde sikhulise kanjani amandla okusebenzisa izimali?
Umthetho Wokulwa Nokukhwabanisa kanye Nokulwa Nokukhwabanisa wenza ukukhwabanisa kube yicala. Uqondisa kubo bonke abasebenza kuhulumeni (njengabaphathiswa, abasebenzi bezigaba, kanye namaphoyisa) kanye nabantu abangaphandle kukahulumeni (njengomuntu osebenza ebhizinisini). Ubuye ubhekane nezimo zokugembula nezemidlalo (njengokukhokhela umgibeli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi enye indaba iwina). Umthetho uchaza izinhlobo ezahlukene zokukhwabanisa, zonke ezifanayo - umuntu ophakamisayo (noma onikayo) okuthile komunye ukuze asebenzise amandla akhe, ngokungekho emthethweni nangokungathembeki, ukuze azuze yena - noma omunye umuntu. Umuntu owenza izithembiso njalo zokuhlinzeka ngento uhlala enecala lokukhwabanisa. Bobabili bazoba necala uma umnikelo wamukelwa. Icalo lokukhwabanisa ngokuvamile lihilela imali. Nokho, ezinye izinhlobo 'zokukhokha' nazo azivumelekile - njengokunikela, izipho, nokuhlinzeka umuntu ngendawo yokusebenza. Abantu abatholakala benecala lokukhwabanisa babhekana nezijeziso ezinzima noma izigwebo zentolongwane ezinde. Bangase baphinde banqatshelwe ukusebenza kuhulumeni esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abanegunya (njengomphakathi ophatha noma umphakathi webhange) kumele babike ukukhwabanisa nezinye izigebengu zezimali ezibhalwe emthethweni ezihilela u-R100,000 noma ngaphezulu kumaphoyisa. Uma behluleka ukubika, bazoba necala.
Kuyadingeka ukuthola nokusebenzisa izindlela ezizokwenziwa ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka kwemvelo yasolwandle. Izenzo zomnyango zokweseka ekukhishweni kwamalungelo. Izenzo noma ukuziphatha komfaki-sicelo: Umthetho nezinyathelo zomuntu onencwadi yokucela zizobuyekezwa. Ndawonye nalabo abazama ukwenza kahle bazobuyekezwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzobhalwa ukuthi izikhalazo zithunyelwa nge-imeyili. Ukukhishwa kwamafomu okucela kanye nezindlela zokukhokha. Umnyango awunankinga nokusebenzisa abameli, abeluleki, ngakho umnyango uzosebenzisa amafomu akhe okucela neminye imibhalo ukuze kugwenywe ukuhileleka kwabantu besithathu. Izimemo zokucela zizoshicilelwa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni. Umnyango uzokhetha ukuyibeka kwiwebhusayithi, ezincwadini, nasemaphandleni okudoba. Izimemo ngeke zifakwe kuMthetho Jikelele. Abafaki-sicelo bazonikezwa amakhophi uma becela. Nakuba umnyango ungenankinga nokusebenzisa abeluleki noma abameli, umnyango uzokwakha amafomu, imigomo, nemibhalo yakhe ukuze kuncishiswe ukuthembela kubantu besithathu. Umnyango uthanda ukuthi usizo lwabo lusetshenziswe ngaphambi kokuthi umuntu aqale ukusebenzisa abeluleki. Uhlu lwabathathi bezinqumo. Umnyango ulindele ukuthi kube nezicelo eziningi zokucela amalungelo. Ezinye zizophikiswa. Inqubo yokukhetha izobheka labo abanamaphuzu aphezulu. Lokhu akusho ukuthi labo abaphikisiwe abaqeqeshiwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu babe namaphuzu aphezulu. Okokuqala, isicelo sizobuyekezwa ngokuya ngokuthi sithunyelwe kanjani. Uma kutholakala ukuthi sithunyelwe sekwedlule isikhathi, uma umuntu engakhokhi izimali ezidingekayo, noma uma sithunyelwe ngendlela engalungile, njengokufakiswa ngefeksi noma usebenzisa ifomu elingalungile. Umthathi-zinqumo ngeke avume lokho ngenxa yokuthunyelwa okungafanele. Izicelo zabantu asebekhulile sezingaqhathaniswa nalabo abafuna ukujoyina. Abafaki-sicelo abakhona bazokwenziwa amaphuzu ngendlela efanayo kodwa izimfuneko ezifanayo zingasetshenziswa njengalabo abafaka izicelo ezintsha. Ukuphikiswa kuzobhekwa ngendlela ehlukile kubafaki-sicelo abasha. Bonke abanamaphuzu aphezulu bazophumelela. Kwamanye amalungelo okuthengisa, amalungelo azonikezwa isikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni engu-15, okukhona eziningi, izinga lokuguqulwa kwezinsiza zasolwandle, ulwazi lwezinto eziphilayo; nokuthuthukiswa kokudoba nokukhuthaza utshalomali nokuthuthukiswa komnotho; nokuziphatha kokudoba ikakhulukazi ezindabeni zomthetho. Kwamanye amasekthini, abanye bangadinga ukuthi izicelo zabo zibuyehlolwe nezindlela abazokhethwa ngazo ngemva kokukhishwa kwamalungelo. Labo abangenakuphumelela bazophumelela. Ukuqhubeka kwesikhathi samalungelo kulawulwa yimithetho yokudoba. Abathathi bezinqumo bazobuyekeza idatha yenkampani. Ulwazi ngeke luhlolwe. Ubunikazi obuyinzuzo bomfaki-sicelo bezinhlobo ezishiwo kuzobuyehlolwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphuzu engeziwe azobhekwa kulabo abafuna ukuphakamisa abantu abasebenza kulabo bahlala ngaphandle kwezinhlelo, kubonisa ukuthi abasebenzi bathola imivuzo ngendlela yokwabelana kulezi zinhlelo. Akukho izingcezu eziphethwe noma izingcezu ezinezimali ezizokwenziwa. Labo abanezingcezu, izinhlobo zizobuyekezwa. Isibonelo, uma inkampani inama-20% enkampanini B kanti inkampani A inama-10% ephethwe yizinhlobo ezithile, izingcezu zayo ziletha ama-2% ekuphathweni kwenkampani B. Abantu abaningi bezinhlobo ezithile nabesifazane abaqashwe ngumfaki-sicelo bangasetshenziswa njengokulinganisa. Amaphuzu amaningi azonikezwa kulabo abaqasha izinhlobo ezithile nabesifazane ezikhundleni eziphakeme kanye nemiholo yabo ephezulu. Isibonelo, abafaki-sicelo kumele bachaze abesifazane abangu-10% kulabo abaphakathi kokuhola, phakathi kuka-10% no-30% nakanjani, labo abaphansi kuka-50% naphakathi kuka-50%. Amaphuzu amaningi azonikezwa uma abantu bezinhlobo nabesifazane bethola imali ephezulu kunalokho okwenzeka ngaphambili. Umehluko emalini phakathi kwalabo abathola kakhulu nalabo abathola kancane nawo uzoba nomthelela. Phakathi kuka-1994 no-2004, abantu bempela baphumelele. Ukwanda kuvumele lezi zinto ukuba zifake le ndawo ukuze ziguquke. Umnyango ubona futhi ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi amalungelo anikeza izinsiza zokuzimela. Abafaki-sicelo kumele bakhombise ukuthi bakhokha izimali ngendlela efanele zezinhlobo ezitholiwe (ngakho kufanele bakhombise lokho abakutholile uma benza kahle) phakathi nesikhathi esiphakathi. Uma izimali zingakhokhiwe ngaphezulu kwezinsuku eziyi-60, umfaki-sicelo uzobanjwa. Uma amalungelo engakhiswanga, umnyango ngeke anikeze amalungelo aphelele kuze kube lezi zimali zikhokhiwe. Umnyango unama-rekhodi okwephula umthetho we-MLRA ozobuyekezwa ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwamalungelo. Bobabili abafaki-sicelo abasha nabakhona bacelwa ukuba baziveze ngendlela umnyango owazi ngayo, ophatha ngayo, futhi uthumele izicelo nokuthi amabhizinisi kufanele asebenze kanjani. Labo ozakwabo abangadobi izinkanyezi ngesikhathi sabo noma abangenayo imvume bazosuswa. Ukudoba okungaphansi kungase kusetshenziswe ngendlela engafanele. Umnyango uzokhipha izinombolo zokuthi zingaki ezitholakele ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwemvume. Umnyango uzokhipha futhi abantu ababa "phambili" ukuze benze kahle kwezinye izinto. Ukuba phambili kwenziwa uma umfaki-sicelo wokuguqulwa kwenzeka kwezinye izindawo noma uma beyi-HDP. Umthetho obizwa ngokuthi umthetho jikelele, umnyango ngeke uvumele abantu abanezimali zokudoba ukuthi bathengise noma bashiye ukudoba ukuze banikwe amalungelo futhi. Kwamasekthini C no-D, imihlangano eminingi noma efana naleyo eyenziwe ngababeluleki nezinkampani zokudoba izokhishwa eziphepheni zezimali. Akukho ngaphezu kokuthi amalungelo amanye azonikezwa kulowo mndeni. Labo abafaka izicelo kumele bakhombise ukuthi bahlobene kanjani nezinye izindawo. Uma umuntu oyedwa emndenini efuna ilungelo, bonke abanye emndenini ngeke bakwazi ukuhileleka, ngaphandle uma othile echaza ngokusobala ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni ezincane zokudoba. Ngokwenza uqiniseke ukuthi ungumuntu onemigomo eqinile yokuziphatha enezinga eliphezulu lokwethembeka nokuthembeka. Ngokukuqonda ukuthi unomthwalo wemfanelo wezinqumo zakho zonke nezenzo zakho futhi uzobe ulindelwe ukuthi uchaze izenzo zakho uma ucelwa. Ngokwenza uqiniseke ukuthi izinqumo ezenziwayo zicacile futhi zivulekile. I-Tip-offs Anonymous iyinsizakalo ye-hotline ezimele evumela ukuthi ubike noma yiziphi izenzakalo zokungalungile endaweni yokusebenza ngendlela engaziwa. I-Charta Yokumba yasungulwa ngokulandela isigaba 100 somthetho wezinsiza zemaminerali nezamafutha, Umthetho No. 28 ka-2002 (MPRDA). IPhiko Lezinsiza Zemaminerali lisanda kubuyekeza le Charta Yokumba. Le buyekezo ibheke ezicini ezihlukahlukene zecharta kuhlanganise nokuba nefa, ukuthengwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezohwebo, amandla abantu abathile, ukuqashwa okufanele, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi. Ngemuva kokuba inhloso eyinhloko yePhalamende ukukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi, iKomidi leNhlangano Yezinsiza Zemaminerali lizokwenza Ukuhlolwa Komphakathi ngemiphumela yokubuyekezwa kweCharta Yokumba endala kanye neziphakamiso zeCharta Yokumba entsha eCarltonville (indawo izoqinisekiswa), esifundazweni saseGauteng ngoMsombuluko, Mashi 30, 2011. Le komidi ifuna ukuxhumana ikakhulukazi nezinhlangano zokumba, abasebenzi bezimayini, izinhlangano zabasebenzi, kanye nemiphakathi ezungezile ezimayini.
