IPhalamende yaseNingizimu Afrika isungule uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinsalela njengohlelo oluhlangene lokuphatha kahle indawo yokusebenza ephephile. UMthethosisekelo uthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banelungelo lokuba nendawo ephephile ukuze baphile kahle. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvikelwa kwemvelo okuhlanganisa imithetho ecacile nezinhlelo zokuvimbela ukungcoliswa nokwehla kwemvelo, ukukhuthaza ukonga, nokugcina ukuthuthukiswa okungaguquki. Singashintsha omunye wemicimbi eyenzekayo ezungezile uma sonke senza okuthile ukuze sishintshe. IPhalamende izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni impilo nokuphepha kwawo wonke amalungu nezisebenzi zayo, kanye nazo zonke abantu abasebenza ngokomthetho noma abangena ezindaweni zayo. Isikhungo sizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izindawo zePhalamende zihlala zisesimweni esihle ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezimo zokusebenza eziphephile nezempilo, nokuphatha nokubhekana nezingozi endaweni yokusebenza. Umthetho Wempilo Nezokuphepha Emsebenzini (OHSA) uphoqa iPhalamende ukuba ihlinzeke futhi igcine indawo yokusebenza ephephile nephilile engabazisi ezempilo zabasebenzi bayo. Kunethemba lokuthi abasebenzi bazosebenzisana nomqashi ukuze baqinisekise ukuhambisana nezimfuneko zomthetho. IPhalamende isungule uhlelo oluhlangene lokuphatha kahle indawo yokusebenza ephephile nephilile, okuhlanganisa ukusungulwa komthetho wokuphathwa kwezinsalela. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esifanele esitholakalayo, nokwethula izinsizakalo zomphakathi ezizinzile endaweni yokusebenza nasemphakathini ezindaweni zePhalamende. Umthetho uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukususa izinsalela ngokuphepha ukuze kuncishiswe ukungcoliswa, kukhuphuke ukugaywa kabusha, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsalela ezikhiqizwa ePhalamende ziphathwa ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi ezikule mthetho. IPhalamende ithuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwamalambu anegunya lokonga amandla ukuze kuncishiswe ukungcoliswa, kugcinwe amandla, futhi kuncishiswe izindleko. "Izinsalela" zisho noma iyiphi into, kungaba igesi, liquid, noma solid, noma inhlanganisela yazo, njengoba kuchazwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha ngezikhathi ezithile, kuhlanganisa nezaziso kuGazethi Yomphakathi. Izinsalela ezomile ziqoqwa nsuku zonke ezitsheni zeplastiki ezibekwe endaweni ethile futhi zithunyelwa endaweni yokulahla izinsalela evunyelwe. Izinsalela zezempilo zifakwa ezitsheni zeplastiki ezibekwe (eziphuzi) futhi zikhishwa njalo ngumhlinzeki wesevisi oqashwe noma njengoba kudingeka. Zonke izibani ezingenamsebenzi zithunyelwa endaweni yokugaywa kabusha ukuze zikhishwe ngokuphepha. Izinsalela ezimanzi zifakwa ezitsheni/izikhwama ezibekwe futhi zikhishwa njalo. Imichiza igcinwa endaweni yokugcina imichiza evaliwe ukuze kuvinjelwe ukusetshenziswa okungagunyaziwe. Zonke imichiza kumele ifakwe ezitsheni ezinemibhalo, futhi inani elincane lemichiza eyingozi kumele libhalwe ngokufanele. Umhlinzeki wesevisi uthathe izinyathelo ngokushesha ukuze akhishwe ama-silinda angadingeki ezindaweni futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ama-silinda aphathwa ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko zomthetho, avimbela ukusetshenziswa okungafanele. IPhalamende isesimweni sokuthola izitsheni zokugaywa kabusha uwoyela wokupheka ongaguqulwa ube yi-biodiesel. Le ndlela yokulahla uwoyela wokupheka ezithombeni zomoya iyavinjwa. IPhalamende ifuna umhlinzeki wesevisi omusha ukuze akhishwe izinsalela zephepha ukuze zibe yizinsalela ezigaywayo. Zonke ofisi ePhalamende zizohlinzekwa ngezikhwama zekhadi ukuze ziqoqe izinsalela zephepha. Lezi zikhwama zizokhishwa ngesonto. Zonke izenzo ezenziwa zenzelwe ukuvikela imvelo, ukonga amandla, nokunciphisa izibalo zezinsalela. Kungumthwalo wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kuhlanganisa wonke amalungu nezisebenzi zePhalamende, ukuvikela imvelo yethu ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezizukulwane ezizayo nokukhuthaza isiko lokuthuthukiswa okungaguquki.
Iyini ibhajethi? Ibhajethi uhlelo lokukhombisa ukuthi malini imali engena njengemali engenayo nokuthi izosetshenziswa kanjani phakathi nesikhathi esithile. Thina njengabantu senza izinhlelo eziningi ezihlobene nemali engenayo nendlela esizoyisebenzisa. Ukwakha ibhajethi kubalulekile ngoba noma singafuna ukuthenga izinto eziningi, kakhulu kwesikhathi asinalo imali eyanele yokwenza kanjalo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sinezidingo ezinkulu kanti sinezinsiza ezilinganiselwe zokuthola lokho esikufunayo. Ukwakha ibhajethi kuyindlela ehlakaniphile yokukhetha indlela esisebenzisa ngayo imali yethu. Uma sithenga imali kwenye into, kungenzeka sibe nezinkinga zokuphila ngaphandle kokuthile. Uhulumeni uhlela kanjani ibhajethi yawo? Ngokufanayo, uhulumeni kufanele akhethe. Iminyango kahulumeni kufanele ihlaziye izinsiza ezitholakalayo nezidingo zabantu. Ibhajethi ikhishwa ngokusekelwe ezidingweni ezichaziwe ngonyaka lowo. Ibhajethi yesizwe ibonisa imali elindelwe kuhulumeni kanye nokusetshenziswa kwayo kulonyaka wezezimali, kusukela kuMfumfu 1 kuya kuNdasa 31 konyaka olandelayo. Ibhajethi yesizwe iyingqayizivele ngoba ikhombisa ukuthi imali izosetshenziswa kanjani futhi iphinde inikeze imininingwane yokuthi lezi zinsiza zizotholwa kanjani ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindleko zezwe. Uhulumeni udala kanjani umpoolo wakhe wezezimali? Umthombo omkhulu wemali kahulumeni uvela emalini yokuthola intela. Intela yimali okufanele ikhokhwe ngababambiqhaza, amabhizinisi, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izikhungo ezithintekayo, ethathwa nguMphakathi Wokuthola Imali. Isevisi Yentela yaseNingizimu Afrika (SARS) iphethe ukuqoqwa kwentela. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zentela. Uhulumeni uthola ingxenye enkulu yentela emalini engenayo yomuntu. Wonke umuntu ophuma ngenhla kwenani elithile kufanele akhokhe intela kuhulumeni. Le ntela ibizwa ngokuthi intela yemali engenayo. Ezinye izinhlobo zentela zifaka intela yokwengeza inani (VAT) kanye nezintela zokusetshenziswa ezimpahleni ezisetshenziswa ngaphakathi. Abantu abaningi bazi nge-VAT, futhi ukuthi ezinye izinto eziyisisekelo zikhululiwe kwi-VAT. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kwesinye isikhathi izintela zengezwa ezintweni ezithile zokunethezeka. Le ntela yokusetshenziswa kwezwe ibizwa ngokuthi "intela yokonakalisa." Umthethosisekelo uchaza ukuthi uMongameli kufanele aphathe kanjani imali. Noma iyiphi imali eyamukelwa yizwe ifakwa kwi-akhawunti esetshenziswa kuhulumeni ebizwa ngokuthi i-akhawunti ye-Exchequer. Umthetho wePhalamende usebenza lapho imali ikhishwa kule akhawunti. Noma iyiphi ibhajethi kufanele ibe nezindleko nezimali. Ibhajethi isebenza kanjani? Ibhajethi kahulumeni ihlukaniswe ibe yiMali Engenayo kanye Nezindleko, lapho kube khona ukungabikhona ngaphambi kokuthola izikweletu kanye neMali Yomphakathi. Imali engenayo nezindleko zaziwa nangokuthi i-Akhawunti Yezimali Zombuso. Ibhajethi kahulumeni iqala ngezindleko kanti ezinye ziqala ngemali engenayo. Umehluko phakathi kwemali engenayo nezindleko ubizwa ngokuthi ukungabikhona noma ukusinda. Ukungabikhona kwenzeka uma uhulumeni ehlela ukusho imali engaphezulu kwalokho angakuthola emalini yokuthola intela ejwayelekile. Imali yomphakathi yenzeka uma uhulumeni eboleka imali ngaphakathi noma evela kwamanye amazwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindleko zawo. Uma imali engenayo idlula izindleko, isibonelo, uma imali yokuthola intela eqoqiwe ingaphezu kwalokho okulindelekile, kukhona ukusinda. Kuthatha izinyanga eziyi-14 ukulungiselela ibhajethi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ibhajethi yonyaka wamanje ithunyelwa ePhalamende, ibhajethi yonyaka olandelayo isivele ikhulunywa izinyanga ezimbili. Kunezindawo ezahlukene ezithintekayo ekwakheni ibhajethi. Lezi zindawo zithumela iziphakamiso zabo ezihlobene nezidingo zazo emahhovisi aphakeme afanele. Ihhovisi eliphezulu lihlanganisa umbiko wesifinyezo ngalokhu futhi lilithumele kwiMnyango Wezezimali. IMnyango Wezezimali izokwakha umbiko wesifinyezo obonisa izindleko zeminyango ehlukene. Ihhovisi leMenenja yeMali Yezangaphakathi kanye neHhovisi leMali Yezokuhweba nokuThengiswa nazo zakha izinhlelo zabo zezimali futhi zithumele kwiMnyango Wezezimali. UMphathiswa Wezezimali kanye noMphathiswa Wezokuphatha bahlangana ukuze baxoxe ngeziphakamiso zezimali. Lezi zinkulumo zizothonywa yisimo sezombusazwe, sezezimali, kanye nezomnotho. UDirector-General Wezezimali ulungisa ibhajethi. Ngokuvamile, unyaka nonyaka ngoFebhuwari, uMphathiswa Wezezimali uthumela iBajethi Speech ePhalamende. Ngemuva kwalokho, ibhajethi ixoxwa ePhalamende. Abaphathiswa beMnyango ophakeme badingeka ukuhlinzeka ngezizathu zezimali zeminyango yabo. I-Budget Speech ngokuvamile ilandela ifomethi eyodwa. Iqala ngokubuyekeza imiphumela yezezimali yonyaka odlule, bese ibuyekeza isimo somnotho wezwe, futhi ihlola unyaka wezezimali ozayo. Ikhomba ukuthi imali engenayo nezindleko ezishiwo zizobonwa kanjani. Kuyisiko lomthethosisekelo ukuthi uhulumeni angasebenzisa imali kuphela uma kuvunyelwe yiPhalamende. Ibhajethi ibhekwa njengazo zonke izinqumo okufanele ziqinisekiswe yiPhalamende kuqala ngaphambi kokuba zibe nemiphumela. Ngemuva kokukhuluma komphathiswa, amalungu ePhalamende axoxa ibhajethi bese evota ngayo. Ngemuva kokuba ibhajethi ngayinye ixoxiwe, zombili izindlu zePhalamende kufanele zivote ngayo. Uma ibhajethi ivunywa, leyo Mnyango inganikezwa imvume yokuhamba phambili nohlelo lwayo lwezezimali. Ukuqoqwa kwentela nezindleko kufanele kuphathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imali isetshenziswa ngokuhambisana nenhloso ebekwe yiPhalamende. U-Auditor-General ubika ePhalamende ukuthi ngabe iziqondiso zokuchitha imali zilandelwa yini. Ibhajethi iyithuluzi elibalulekile lempumelelo kanye nesikhali esibalulekile sokubheka, kulandela umgomo wokuphendula kahulumeni mayelana nokuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kanjani.
IPhalamende likazwelonke lisebenze umphakathi wesikhashana ukuze lihlole imizamo yokubambisana ekulandeleni ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi "Sisebenza ndawonye ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezisezingeni eliphezulu emiphakathini." Inqubomgomo yale komidi iwukubuza ngentuthuko uma kubhekwa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi nokuhlola ukuthi yiziphi izinselelo ezikhona lapho kube nezimemezelo ukuze kuvezwe umbiko kuPhalamende likazwelonke ozofaka iziphakamiso ezicacile nezindlela ezisebenzisekayo. Kuze kube manje, le komidi ivakashele ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasemadolobheni, futhi ibambe imihlangano ePhalamende nasemaphandleni. Imihlangano yephalamende yenzeka kusukela ngomhlaka 2 kuya ku-4 kuFebhuwari 2010. Ngenkathi le komidi ivakashela emaphandleni, izohlola lezi zindawo futhi ihlangane namalungu omphakathi, osomabhizinisi bendawo, abaphathi bezifunda, abaphathi bezinsiza zomphakathi, amakomidi ezindawo, nezinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nezithunywa zomkhakha wezebhizinisi. Le mihlangano izobanjwa kusukela ngomhlaka 17 kuya ku-21 kuMeyi 2010, ezifundazweni ezintathu.
IPhalamende inezindlu ezimbili, okungukuthi iNdlu Yezwe (eyaziwa njenge-NA) neNdlu Yezinhlaka Zamasipala (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP). I-NA ivoteleka kabusha njalo eminyakeni emihlanu ngesikhathi sokhetho lwesizwe. Ngesikhathi sokhetho, abavoti bakhetha ukuthi yiziphi amaqembu abafuna ukuba temsilwe ngawo ngokuvota kumapolitiki abawathandayo. Enye yezinhloso ezisemqoka ze-NA ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi yokuphatha izwe. I-NA ithumela amaBill kumaKomidi ukuze ahlaziywe futhi ibamba izingxoxo ngalezi zamaBill. I-NA ingavuma, iphikise, noma ibuyisele amaBill kumaKomidi ukuze abuyekezwe. IPhalamende inesibopho sokuhlaziya, ukuhlola, nokubheka umsebenzi wombuso noma yiliphi ilungu leSifunda, mayelana nokuphathwa kwemithetho, ukusetshenziswa kwezimali, nokubheka uMthethosisekelo. IPhalamende iqinisekisa ukuthi iKomidi inemfanelo yokuvuma izabelomali, ngokubuza imibuzo yephalamende, ibamba izingxoxo zephalamende ngezindaba ezibalulekile, futhi iphakamisa futhi ivote ngeziphakamiso ezihlobene nomsebenzi wombuso. I-NA inegunya elivela kuMthethosisekelo lokukhetha uMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika phakathi kwamalungu ayo. I-NA inamalungu angama-400 ePhalamende (ama-MPs) akhethwe kuyo. Amalungu e-NA akhethwa ngohlelo olubizwa ngokuthi ukumela ngokufanele. Ngaphambi kokhetho, iqembu ngalinye lezepolitiki lidala uhlu lwabafakizicelo ukuze balwe ukhetho lokukhethwa. Lezi zifakizicelo zikhishwa ngokufanele ngenani lemivoto eqembu lezepolitiki elithole ngesikhathi sokhetho. Ngokwesibonelo, uma iqembu lithola isigamu semivoto, lizothola isigamu sezihlalo ku-NA. Emhlanganweni wokuqala we-NA, amalungu e-NA akhetha uMholi noMholi Osenkingeni, kanye nalokho okubizwa ngokuthi amaMandla ePhalamende eNdlu Yezwe. AmaMandla ePhalamende anesibopho sokuphatha izindaba ze-NA. UMholi noMholi Osenkingeni bePhalamende baphatha imihlangano ye-NA. Baqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ePhalamende akhuluma ngokukhululeka, kodwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho yeNdlu Yezwe. Imithetho yeNdlu ibeka ukuthi abaphathi beNdlu basiza amaMandla ePhalamende ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Abaphathi beNdlu bangadingeka futhi ukuba baphathe imihlangano yeNdlu Yezwe. Ukuze banikeze amaMandla ePhalamende ukwesekwa kwezepolitiki nokusebenza. Iqembu ngalinye lezepolitiki ku-NA likhetha uMphakathi omkhulu ukuphatha izindaba zalo. Abaphathi babhekelela amalungu abo ngokuhambisana nokuhlukahluka kwabo. UMongameli ukhetha uMholi Wokusebenza Kwezimali ozosebenza nabaholi bezindlu zombili zePhalamende. UMholi Wokusebenza Kwezimali kufanele acabangele izidingo zeNdlu kanye nezinhlelo zombuso ePhalamende. UMholi Wokusebenza Kwezimali uqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu eNdlu enza imisebenzi yawo yephalamende. Iningi lomsebenzi we-NA wenziwa kumaKomidi. AmaKomidi e-NA abizwa ngokuthi amaKomidi eNdlu Yezwe. Umsebenzi wekomidi ngalinye uhambisana nomnyango wombuso ohlobene nawo. Ngokwesibonelo, iKomidi Yezohwebo Nezimboni ibhekana nazo zonke izindaba eziphathelene noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Ikomidi ngalinye lineMphakathi walo ozokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle komsebenzi. AmaKomidi eNdlu Yezwe abhekana nokuxoxa, ukubamba izingxoxo, nokuhlela amaBill. AmaKomidi angabamba Ukuhlolwa KwePublic ngemicimbi yokwethulwa kwemithetho noma ngezindaba ezihlobene nemithetho. AmaKomidi abhekana nokubheka nokuhlola umsebenzi Womnyango wombuso. Ngokwemithetho, iPhalamende idinga ukufaka umphakathi enqubweni yokwethulwa kwemithetho nakwezinye izinhlelo zephalamende. AmaKomidi eNdlu Yezwe adinga ukuxhumana namalungu omphakathi ukuze athole iminikelo yabo ngamaBill noma ukuze azwe imibono yabo ngezindaba ezibalulekile zesizwe. Umphakathi uyakhuthazwa ukuba ube nengxenye ekuxoxeni uma amaKomidi ebamba Ukuhlolwa KwePublic. Abantu noma amaqembu akhuthazwa ukuba athumele izikhalazo ngomlomo noma ngobufakazi mayelana nezindaba ezithinta bona, ukuze afune ulwazi mayelana nomsebenzi wabo ePhalamende. AmaKomidi eNdlu Yezwe. INdlu Yezwe, ngokwesibonelo, iZabelomali. Chaza iPhalamende nganoma iyiphi indaba ethinta bona. Le bhukwana itholakala wezilimi ezisemthethweni zesiNingizimu Afrika.
Ibhodi Lesizwe Lezifunda (elaziwa nge-NCOP), elinamalungu angaphezu kwe-90. Umthethosisekelo uthi Ibhodi Lesizwe Lezifunda, i-NCOP, temsilisa izifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicwaningwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kwesizwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ikakhulu ngokubamba iqhaza enqubweni yokwenza umthetho kazwelonke nokuhlinzeka umphakathi ngenkundla kazwelonke yokuxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta izifunda. I-NCOP iqinisekisa futhi ukuthi izidingo zokuphatha zendawo ziyaqondwa ezingeni likamasipala. I-NCOP yakhiwe ngama-province ayisishiyagalolunye akhombisa abamele abavoti abavela ezikhungweni zomthetho zezifunda, kanye nabamele abavela kwi-South African Local Government Association (eyaziwa nge-SALGA). Abamele baqondiswa nguMphakathi wesifunda ngasinye, ongomunye wabamele abakhethekile. Uma kudingeka, uMphakathi angabeka omunye umuntu endaweni yakhe. Ikhono le-SALGA liphethe ukukhetha abamele be-SALGA abavela kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye kanye nababambisene ababili. Lezi zikhulu zenza umsebenzi we-NCOP futhi ziqondisa izingxoxo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi abamele bakhuluma ngokukhululeka uma behambisana nemithetho ebekwe yiNdlu. U-Phakade ofanayo ukhethwa isikhathi eside seminyaka emihlanu, kanti ama-Premiers ezifunda aphindaphinda njengababambisene minyaka yonke. Ngokubambisana nokubambisana, i-NCOP ihlose ukuveza ukubaluleka kokucabangela izidingo zokuphatha zendawo kanye nezifunda ezingeni likamasipala. I-NCOP ihlinzeka ngezwi lezi zifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi inikeza nohulumeni bendawo inkundla yokubamba iqhaza ekucubunguleni umthetho ezingeni likamasipala. Kumele icabangele yonke imithetho kazwelonke. Ingaphinde iphakamise noma ilungise umthetho ngaphansi kweSheduli 4 yomthethosisekelo (lezi zindaba lapho umthetho kazwelonke nezikhungo zomthetho zezifunda zinegunya elihambisanayo lokwenza umthetho) neminye imithetho ethinta izifunda. Iningi lale misebenzi yokwenza umthetho lenziwa ezikhaleni, kodwa yonke imithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwi-NCOP ukuze ixoxwe futhi ivote ukuthi le mithetho yamukelwa noma iyalaywa. Umthetho ongathinti izifunda ubandakanya imisebenzi kazwelonke; njengokuvikela, ezangaphandle, kanye nezenzo zobulungiswa. Uma le mithetho yamukelwa yiNdlu Yezwe, ithunyelwa kwi-NCOP ukuze ivote. Uma i-NCOP ifuna ukwenza izinguquko kumthetho, ithumela kumthetho kazwelonke, okuyisikhungo esisodwa esingamukela noma sikhansela lezi zinguquko. Izibonelo zemithetho ethinta izifunda zifaka phakathi imfundo, ukuthuthwa, inhlalakahle, kanye nezempilo. Iningi lale mithetho lingangeniswa kwi-NCOP nganoma iyiphi yalezi Ndlu; nokho, kukhona eminye imithetho okumele iqale kwiNdlu Yezwe. Lapho le mithetho ivotwa kwi-NCOP, isifunda ngasinye sinesikhumbuzo esisodwa esivotelelwa umholi wendawo yokuthumela izifunda. Amalunga omphakathi angadlala indima ebonakalayo ekuqapheleni izenzo zikamasipala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni uyaphendula ezidingweni zabantu. Ukubeka phambili kwiKomidi lePhalamende kuyindlela eyodwa yokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale ePhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokwabelana ngemibono yakho namalunga ekomidi ngenkathi behlanganyela futhi becubungula umthetho othile ngaphambi kokuba uqedwe ngabo. Ipetisheni iyindlela yokuletha ePhalamende izikhalazo noma izindaba ezithinta umphakathi ukuze ikwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngaphakathi kwamagunya ayo. Ilungelo lokupetisha iPhalamende liyilungelo labantu bonke baleli zwe futhi linikezwa nguMthethosisekelo wethu. Noma ubani, kungaba ngabantu noma amaqembu, unelungelo lokupetisha iPhalamende. Amalunga omphakathi angathintana namalunga ePhalamende emahhovisi abo ezindaweni ezikhethiwe kulo lonke elizwe noma ePhalamende uma befuna ukuthi basize ngendaba ephuthumayo abafuna ukuyixoxa noma uma bedinga usizo ngendaba ethile.
Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika uveza ukuthi iNhlangano Yezifunda (eyaziwa ngokuthi i-NCOP) kumele iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kombuso. Lokhu kufezwa ngokubamba iqhaza enqubweni yokuwina imithetho kazwelonke nokuhlinzeka ngendawo kazwelonke yokuthi umphakathi ubhekane nezindaba ezithinta izifunda. Umsebenzi oyinhloko we-NCOP ukuhlela izingxoxo, ukudlulisela imithetho, nokubheka (ukuhlola) izenzo zikamasipala. I-NCOP temsilisa izifunda ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kombuso. Indima ye-NCOP ukuveza imibono yokuphatha izifunda kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Yini iViki Yezifunda ye-NCOP? I-NCOP yasungula iViki Yezifunda ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izifunda zidlala indima ebalulekile emsebenzini wePhalamende likazwelonke. Ngalesi sikhathi, abamele izifunda kwi-NCOP kanye nabalingani babo ezifundeni bazovakashela imiphakathi emele uhulumeni ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bathola ulwazi ngqo ngezidingo nezinselelo zabantu. I-Viki Yezifunda iqala ukusebenza kwemigomo yomthethosisekelo wezwe, iphoqa i-NCOP ukuthi iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kombuso. I-Viki Yezifunda iqinisekisa ukuthi abamele izifunda kwi-NCOP bahlale beqaphele izinguquko, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nezifunda zabo. Iphakela abamele ithuba lokuxhumana nezifunda zabo nokubika emuva ngomsebenzi wabo kwi-NCOP ngenhloso yokuthola imandate emisha ngezindaba ezidinga ukufakwa ohlelweni lokusebenza lukazwelonke. I-Viki Yezifunda inikeza indawo yokwabelana nokushintshisana ngemicabango ngezindaba ezihlobene nokubhekana nezidingo, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nezifunda ukuze zifeze imandate zazo. Iphinde idale ithuba lePhalamende nezifunda ukuba zisebenze ndawonye ekutholeni izixazululo nasekuvezeni izindlela ezintsha zokubhekana nezidingo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Yini ezokwenzeka ngesikhathi seViki Yezifunda? Abanye ababambiqhaza; njengababusi bendabuko, izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezisekelwe emphakathini, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuphatha Yezindawo yaseNingizimu Afrika (eyaziwa ngokuthi i-SALGA). Abamele izifunda kwi-NCOP, kanye nabalingani babo ezifundeni, bazovakashela imiphakathi emele uhulumeni. Abamele bazophinde babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe nguHulumeni kazwelonke kanye nohulumeni bezifunda ezizifundeni zabo. I-Viki Yezifunda izothuthukisa kanjani isifunda sakho? Ngokuvakashela imiphakathi ngesikhathi seViki Yezifunda, abamele izifunda kwi-NCOP bazothola ulwazi ngqo ngezidingo zabantu ezifundeni. I-Viki Yezifunda ivumela i-NCOP ukuba ifake isandla ekusebenzeni kukamasipala ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izikhalazo zezifunda nezendawo zicatshangelwa ekwakhiweni kwenqubomgomo kazwelonke. Iphinde ivumele uhulumeni bezifunda, bendawo, kanye nohulumeni bezwe ukuba basebenze ndawonye ngempumelelo nangokulinganayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufezeka kwezidingo.
I-Charter Yokumba yasungulwa ngokulandela ingxenye 100 yeMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zomhlaba Nezokumbiwa, Umthetho No. 28 ka-2002 (MPRDA). Umnyango Wezinsiza Zomhlaba usanda kubuyekeza le Charter Yokumba. Le buyekezo ibheke ezicini ezahlukene ze-charter kufaka phakathi ubunikazi, ukuthengwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezohwebo, okuthokozisa abantu abathile, ukuqashwa okufanele, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Ngokulandela umgomo ophakeme wePhalamende wokukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi, iKomidi leZwe leZinsiza Zomhlaba lizokwenza iNdaba Yokufaka Umphakathi mayelana nemiphumela yokubuyekezwa kwe-Charter Yokumba endala kanye nezinhlinzeko ze-Charter Yokumba entsha eKlerksdorp (i-Anglo Ashanti no1 Shaft hall), esifundazweni seNyakatho Nentshonalanga ngoLwesine, uMashi 31, 2011. Le komidi ifuna ukuhlangana ikakhulukazi neZinhlangano Zokumba, abasebenzi bezimayini, izinhlangano zabasebenzi, kanye nemiphakathi ezungezile ezimayini. Imininingwane yokuxhumana: Ucingo (021) 403-3751, umakhalekhukhwini 083 709 8520 noma 083 966 7720, ikheli le-imeyili (nskaka@parliament.gov.za) noma (vmfuniselwa@parliament.gov.za); Ifeksi: 086 619 9194.
Ukubhekwa kweqiniso kwemiyalo yezenhlalo yindlela yePhalamende yokwenza ukuthi uhulumeni uhlale enezibopho kubantu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlala kuqapheka (ukulandela) izinhlelo zohulumeni. IPhalamende kanye neKomidi zinegunya lokubiza noma ubani noma isikhungo ukuze lunikeze ubufakazi noma lukhombise imibhalo ethile, bese libika kubo. Umthethosisekelo uthi iPhalamende inegunya lokuvakashela bonke ozakwethu bezwe, kuhlanganise nalabo abakwezifunda kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Yini ukubhekwa kokusebenza kohulumeni? Ukuvakashela kohulumeni emiphakathini kuyimsebenzi onikezwe iPhalamende nguMthethosisekelo ukuze kuqapheke futhi kulandwe ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsizakalo zohulumeni. Kungani indima yePhalamende yokubhekwa kohulumeni ibalulekile? Ngokuhlola izinhlelo zohulumeni, iPhalamende ingaqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu kuyenzeka, ukuze bonke abantu baphile impilo engcono futhi enhlonipho. Lokhu kwenza ukusebenza kohulumeni kube sobala futhi kukhuphule ukwethenjwa komphakathi kuhulumeni. kanye neNhlangano Yezifunda (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP). Iziqu zikaPhalamende zinegunya elithile lokubhekwa okufanele zibe nalo. Umthethosisekelo uthi iNhlangano Yezwe ikhethwe ukuze temsilise abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni onobungozi kubantu ngaphansi komthethosisekelo. futhi ukuze ibheke ukusebenza kohulumeni kazwelonke, kanye nokuphumeleliswa kwemithetho edlulisiwe yiPhalamende. I-NCOP temsilisa izifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zihlala zixazululwa ngaphakathi komkhakha kahulumeni kazwelonke. Indima ye-NCOP ukuhlole ukusebenza kohulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke lezifunda nohulumeni bendawo. I-NCOP ingacela ukuba ilungu leKhabhinethi, isisebenzi sikahulumeni kazwelonke, noma uNgqongqoshe wezifunda baye emhlanganweni weNdlu noma ikomidi. Amakomidi ePhalamende asungulwa njengamathuluzi omabili amaZwe ngaphansi komthethosisekelo ukuze aqaphe futhi alandele uhulumeni. La makomidi "awumshini onamandla" wePhalamende wokubhekwa kohulumeni nokwenza umsebenzi wezomthetho wePhalamende. Amakomidi ahlaziya imithetho, aqapha uhlelo lokusebenza kohulumeni, futhi axhumana nomphakathi. Ingxenye ebaluleke kakhulu yomsebenzi wokubhekwa kohulumeni emiphakathini ukuhlela imibiko yonyaka yezinhlangano zikaHulumeni ngamakomidi, kanye nemibiko ye-Auditor-General. Ngokwezinhloso zokuhlola ukusebenza kohulumeni, ikomidi lisemsebenzini wokucela umbiko omfishane kulungu leState noma lizovakashela le ndawo ukuze liqinisekise amaqiniso. UNgqongqoshe WezeMali umemezela iziphakamiso zebhajethi zonyaka wezezimali olandelayo, kanye nezivote zebhajethi zazo zonke izinsizakalo. IPhalamende kumele ivume iBhajethi. Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwezivote zebhajethi, ikomidi ngalinye linomhlangano neNhlangano ehambisanayo kahulumeni lapho lisebenzisa ukubhekwa komphakathi ngoba amalungu omphakathi abizelwe. Lokhu kusebenza njengokuhlola ukuthi ingabe iNhlangano igcine imisebenzi yayo yokusebenza kusukela konyaka odlule, futhi ingabe isebenzise imali yentela ngendlela efanele. Ukubuza imibuzo kuhulumeni kuyindlela eyodwa iPhalamende elawula ngayo uhulumeni. Imibuzo okufanele iphendulwe ngenkulumo noma ngokubhala ingaqondiswa kuMongameli, kuMongameli Osenyaweni, kanye noNgqongqoshe mayelana nezinkinga ababhekene nazo. Isikhathi semibuzo sinika amalungu ePhalamende ithuba lokubuza amalungu ohulumeni mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu, temsilisa amaqembu abo ezepolitiki noma abantu abavotele bona. Ngokusebenzisa le ndlela, amalungu ePhalamende angakwenza izitatimende endlini, nganoma iyiphi indaba. Ngokunikeza Isaziso Sokuhlangana, ilungu lanoma yisiphi isikhungo sepolitiki ingaletha izindaba noma izinkinga ukuze zixoxwe kwiPhalamende, ngaleyo ndlela kusiza ukuhlinzeka indima yabo yokubhekwa komphakathi njengohulumeni. Ukuxoxisana kwePhalamende kuyindlela ethile yokuletha ulwazi olubalulekile phambi kohulumeni ukuze kubhekwe izinhlelo ezithile zohulumeni noma imithetho edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu. Umsebenzi wehhovisi lezakhamuzi unikeza amalungu ePhalamende ithuba eliyingqayizivele lokubandakanyeka ekubhekweni komphakathi ngokwabo. Umsebenzi wehhovisi lezakhamuzi unikeza indlela eclose yokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu ePhalamende nomphakathi. Amalungu anomsebenzi wokwazisa iPhalamende nganoma yiziphi izinkinga abazitholayo ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana nomphakathi. Ukwenza isethulo kuKomidi lePhalamende kuyindlela ethile yokwenza izwi lakho libonakale kwiPhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokuthonya imibono yamalungu eKomidi axoxa ngengxenye ethile yephrojekthi ngaphambi kokuba ibe umthetho ophumelelayo. Wonke umuntu ophila eNingizimu Afrika unelungelo lokufaka isicelo kwiPhalamende, njengoba kubhalwe emthethosisekelweni. Noma ubani, iqembu labantu, noma inhlangano ingafaka isicelo kwiPhalamende. Isicelo singumbuzo osemthethweni kumagunya ukuthi athathe isinyathelo. Singathatha ifomu lokucela, isicelo sosizo, noma ukuphinda kuthunyelwe izikhalazo.
Inhloso yale ngxenye iwukuhlinzeka abaphathi ngencazelo emfushane ye-insurance yokuphila eyinhloko enikezwa ngaphansi kwe-Overview yezinto eziyisisekelo ze-insurance ezihlinzekwa ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo ye-Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA) ngaphansi kwenombolo yeGPA Policy FASA/1998-00426 ephethwe yiFASA (Abaphathi abavuma ukukhokha uma kwenzeka ingozi baphuma kwiHollard Insurance Company Ltd). Izinzuzo ezihlobene nokufa nokukhubazeka okungapheli kokuphila kwakho zikhokhelwa ngaphezu kwezinye izinzuzo ezikhokhelwa kwezinye izinsiza (isb., Group Life, Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases (COID), RAF). Izinzuzo zokukhubazeka okwesikhashana okuphelele zikhokhelwa kuphela kuze kube yilapho kuboniswa khona ngokwezimali yiPhalamende mayelana nokukhubazeka kwesikhashana komuntu ongena emshwalweni. Izinzuzo zezeMpilo zihlobene kuphela nokulimala komzimba okubangelwa yingozi. Izinzuzo zezeMpilo ezivela ezimweni ezihlobene nomsebenzi ez covered by COID kumele zifakwe kwi-COID claim. Ukuvikelwa ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo ye-Group Personal Accident Insurance kuzohlinzeka kuphela "ngokungezelela" uma inani elincane kakhulu likhokhelwa uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okudingekayo. (QAPHELA: Lokhu akuzokwenzeka njengoba i-COID ihlinzeka ngezindleko zezeMpilo ezingapheli zokulimala okuhlobene nomsebenzi). Izinzuzo zezeMpilo ezingakwazi ukufakwa ukuze zikhokhelwe ngaphansi kwe-COID kumele zifakwe ukuze zikhokhelwe ngaphansi kwale GPA policy. Ukufa ngengozi - 60% yeSalaries yonyaka ephindwe ngo-5 njengoba kuchaziwe. Ukukhubazeka Okuphelele - Iphesenti yeNzuzo Yokufa, kuye ngokuthi kukhona ukukhubazeka okungakanani, isb., ukuzibulala, ukuzilimaza ngenhloso, ukuzibeka engcupheni yengozi, noma ukulimala okucacile (ngaphandle kokuzama ukusindisa impilo yomuntu). Ukufa noma ukukhubazeka okubangelwa isimo somzimba esivele sikhona noma ubuthakathaka (QAPHELA: sicela wazise iGlenrand M·I·B uma unabasebenzi abakhubazekile ukuze sizame ukwandisa ukuvikelwa). Abantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-16 nabaphezulu kweminyaka engu-75 (kodwa abanye abantu abachazwe kahle bavikelwe kuze kube seminyakeni engu-85). Ukundiza ngaphandle kokuba ungumgibeli. Ukufa noma ukulimala lapho kutholakala ukuthi umuntu ongena emshwalweni ubengaphansi kwethonya likasawoti noma izidakamizwa noma lapho izinga likasawoti egazini lidlula umkhawulo wemithetho. Imidlalo ekhokhelwayo, ukugibela izindiza ezincane, noma ukugibela izindiza ezincane. Ukufa noma ukulimala okubangelwa ukuphula umthetho. Zonke izigameko ezingaholela ekufakweni kwesicelo ngaphansi kwale nqubomgomo kumele zibikwe kuGlenrand M·I·B (ngokusebenzisa uPam Hintsho kubasebenzi bePhalamende noma uLinda Harper kubalawuli bePhalamende) ngokushesha okukhulu kodwa ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezi-3. Zonke izicelo ezifakiwe zokufa kumele zibikwe ngaleso sikhathi ngaphandle kokulibazisa okungadingekile. Zonke izimali ezitholakele ngaphansi kwale nqubomgomo zizokhokhwa kuqala kwiPhalamende. Abameleli abalandelayo beGlenrand M·I·B bakhona ukusiza nganoma yini ehambelana nenqubomgomo yePhalamende eyaziwa njenge-GPA.
Ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu kuyisisekelo esibalulekile sokwakha idemokhrasi yethu; kuyindlela eyodwa yokwenza ukuthi uhulumeni uphendule kulokho abantu abakwenza. IPhalamende ibonise izindlela ezahlukene zokwandisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi enqubweni yokwazisa nokwandisa ukufinyelela ePhalamende labantu. Ukubamba iqhaza emsebenzini wePhalamende akukhathazi njengokubukeka. Enye indlela abantu abangasebenzisa ngayo ilungelo labo leziNhloso ngokusebenzisa isicelo. Isicelo siyisicelo esisemthethweni esiqondiswe eziphathimandla ezifanele ukuze zithathe isinyathelo. Kungaba, phakathi kwezinye izinto, isicelo sokuthi kwenziwe okuthile noma isidingo sokuxazulula ukukhathazeka. Ukuze isicelo sibe nesiphumo, kumele sichaze ukuthi sikhuluma kubani, ukuthi ukukhathazeka kukuphi, futhi sibe nezizathu ezisekelayo, kanye namagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabaceli. Izicelo zihlukaniswa zibe izigaba ezimbili, okuyizicelo ezikhethekile nezicelo zomphakathi noma izicelo ezijwayelekile. Isicelo esikhethekile siwukuthi umuntu wenza isicelo esithile noma ufune ukwesekwa kwezimali kuhulumeni, okungase kungavunyelwe umthetho, njengokucela ipenshini. Isicelo somphakathi siwukuthi iqembu lomphakathi elinokuhlosiwe okufanayo licela ukwesekwa, okungabandakanya noma yiluphi uhlobo lwesicelo. Kuyilungelo elivunywa amalungu omphakathi kuhulumeni odemokhrasi ukuhlela nokwethula izicelo noma nini uma kudingeka. NgokweSahluko 17 seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho 108 ka-1996), sithi: noma iyiphi iqembu labantu kanye nabantu bonke banelungelo lokuhlangana ngokuthula, ukuveza izinkinga zabo nganoma iyiphi indaba, nokwethula isicelo. Nokho, kunezindlela ezifanele okufanele abantu kanye/noma amaqembu azilandele ekuhlelweni kwezicelo zabo. Umuntu oyiNgxenye yePhalamende kuphela ongakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokusemthethweni isicelo ukuze processing sibe sePhalamende. Umuntu ophakathi komphakathi noma iqembu labantu kufanele lithumele izicelo zabo kumMember yePhalamende yabo becela ukuthi bazethule ePhalamende. Kumele ichaze uhlobo losizo oluceliwe kuPhalamende kodwa kufanele kube usizo olungase lutholakale kuPhalamende ngaphakathi kwemvume yalo. Ngoba isicelo kumele sithunyelwe ngokusemthethweni kuPhalamende, umceli noma abaceli kumele bathole ukwesekwa kumMember yePhalamende. Kunconywa ukuthi ngaphambi kokuthumela isicelo, uqale ukhulume noMphakathi wePhalamende ukuze uthole ukuthi bazokweseka yini futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ifomethi nokuqukethwe kwesicelo sakho kulungile. Uma kukhona amadokhumenti asekelayo mayelana nendaba ethunyelwe, kufanele afakwe nesicelo. UmMember wePhalamende uzothumela isicelo sakho kuNobhala wePhalamende ukuze kubuyekezwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ifomethi nokuqukethwe kulungile ngaphambi kokuthi kuvezwe kuMholi noma kuMongameli. Isicelo sizothunyelwa ePhalamende bese sithunyelwa kwiKomidi noma kumaKomidi abhekene nezindaba eziphakanyisiwe esicelweni sakho.
Ihhovisi leZwe liqhamuke iKomidi Lesikhashana ukuze lenze umsebenzi wokubhekelela ngokuhlanganyela ukuze kulawulwe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi ngaphansi kwesiqu esithi "Sisebenza ndawonye ukuze siqinisekise ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo eziphezulu emiphakathini." Amandla ale komidi ukuhlole intuthuko mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi nokukhomba noma yiziphi izithiyo ezivela ngesikhathi sokuhlasela ukuze kuhanjiswe umbiko ocacile, onokunconywa okusebenzayo kanye nohlelo oluphakanyisiwe lokusebenza phambi kweZwe. Njengomphumela, le komidi izokwenza uvakashi oluhlanganyelwe ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni ukuze ilalele imibono yomphakathi ePhalamende nasezintshonalanga. Ukulalela komphakathi ePhalamende kuzokwenzeka kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2 - 4, 2010. Uma le Komidi isivakashele izifundazwe, izohlola izakhiwo futhi ibambisane namalungu omphakathi, osomabhizinisi bendawo, abasebenzi bezigaba zikamasipala, amaqembu ezindawo, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye namalungu ezinhlangano zebhizinisi. Cape Town, Februwari 6, 2009. Nkosikazi uMholi weSishayamthetho Sezwe; uMholi ohloniphekile weBhunga Lezifundazwe; Nkosikazi uMphathiswa oPhakathi; Nkosikazi uMholi oPhakathi noNkosikazi uMholi weBhunga Lezifundazwe; uMphakathi omkhulu, uJaji Langa; uMphathiswa oPhakathi weNingizimu Afrika owayengaphambili kanye noMongameli wamanje we-ANC; oMongameli bezifundazwe; amalungu eKabineti kanye nabakhulumi bezifundazwe; uJaji owayengumholi kanye nalabo ababephakathi kwezikhala eziphezulu ePhalamende; abavakashi abahloniphekile, abameli abahloniphekile, kanye nabamele kwamanye amazwe kanye nezinhlelo zomhlaba jikelele; abaholi abahloniphekile bezepolitiki kanye namalungu ePhalamende, abaholi bomphakathi; uMholi oHloniphekile weCape Town; abaholi bezinkolo nabamele umphakathi; ozakwethu nabangane; abavakashi abakhethekile, ngiyajabula ukuthola leli thuba lokukhuluma phambi kwalezi zindlu zombili zePhalamende leRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ekuvuleni kweseshini yokugcina yePhalamende lesithathu leRiphabhulikhi. Ngimi lapha phambi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngenkululeko ngesikhathi engithole khona ithuba lokubamba isikhundla esiphezulu kuleli; ngenxa yokuthi kwenzeka umcimbi ongajwayelekile lapho iphathi ebusayo yanquma ukuhoxisa kumongameli owayedlule. Umsebenzi wami ezinyangeni ezizayo uwukuhola iKabineti ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiyalelo eyanikezwa i-ANC ezivotweni zika-2004 iyafezwa, futhi ngibeke isisekelo sokuthi umsebenzi olandelayo emva kokhetho uqhubeke kahle. Lokhu esikwazile ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni nokudlulela esikhathini esisha ngaphandle kwezinkinga ezivela ezinyangeni ezedlule, kufanele sibonge ukuzinikela ekusebenzeni kwezakhiwo zomthethosisekelo, okubonakaliswe ngokubambisana kwamalungu eKabineti, kokubili okudala nokusha, kanye nokuphathwa kahle kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ngibheka emuva eminyakeni eyi-15 edlule, ngifuna ukuqaphela ukuzinikela nokusebenza kanzima kukaMongameli uNelson Mandela noThabo Mbeki kanye nabantu abaningi abesifazane nabesilisa ababe nendima ebonakalayo ekuhlinzekeni ngalesi sihambi sikahulumeni ngaphansi kokuthula: eKabineti nasezikhungweni, eziphakanyisweni zokuhola ezihlanganisa izigaba ezintathu zikahulumeni kanye nezenzo zomthetho, okuhamba phambili ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ngimi lapha phambi kwenu ngokuqhakazile nangokuzethemba ngazi ukuthi le Ningizimu Afrika esiyijabulelayo namuhla - ehlukile kakhulu ekwahlukanisweni, empini, nasekucwasweni okwakukhona eminyakeni eyi-15 edlule - iyisithelo somsebenzi nezifungo zabesifazane nabesilisa baseNingizimu Afrika bazo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Laba bantu baseNingizimu Afrika babonisa ithemba nezifiso zabantu baleli. Emhlanganweni wabantu abavelele baseNingizimu Afrika kukhona amalungu ePhalamende lethu angasekho nathi kusukela ngoFebruwari wonyaka odlule. Phakathi kwabo, singabala uBrian Bunting, uBilly Nair, uNcumisa Kondlo, uJohn Gomomo, uJoe Nhlanhla, uCas Saloojee, uJohn Schippers, noJan van Eck. Phakathi kwabo, ngithanda ukukhumbula uNkk. Helen Suzman, umuntu ophawulekayo waseNingizimu Afrika, owamele izimiso zePhalamende lethu elisha ePhalamende elidala. Laba bangamaqhawe abafanele ukuhlonishwa lapho isikhathi sokwenza lokho sifika, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kube ngohlobo lwezikhukhula zezimali ezithinte uNingizimu Afrika, noma ngohlobo lwezinkinga zezombusazwe ezingase ziphazamise umsebenzi wethu wokubambisana kulolu hulumeni olusha, kodwa izwe lethu likhona esimweni esihle. Nokho, akufanele siwuhlulele phansi ubunzima esibhekene nabo. Isimo sezomnotho emhlabeni jikelele esibucayi sithinta umnotho wethu ngokulahlekelwa amathuba emisebenzi kanye nokwehla kwezinga lempilo yabantu bethu. Ngokufanayo, izinkinga zezombusazwe zingavusa imibuzo eminingi kakhulu kunempendulo ezikhona njengamanje. Ngakho-ke, abanye bethu bangase baphumelele em waves zesimo sezomnotho esibucayi okwenza kubonakale sengathi asazi ukuthi kwenzekani kulezi zikhathi ezinzima zokuhlupheka kwezomnotho nezimo zezombusazwe ezingazinzile. Nokho, sigxile ethembeni nasezifisweni. Singasho futhi ukuthi, ngendlela engajwayelekile, izakhiwo zomthethosisekelo zihlolwe ezikhathini ezedlule ezingekho kude, kodwa zonke zaphumelela kulokho ukuhlola, okukhombisa isifiso sangempela sabantu. Isifiso sabantu lapha sikhona esimweni esihle kakhulu. Siba namandla, sisekelwa umthethosisekelo onzima ukuwufanisa nanoma yimuphi omunye emhlabeni. Impela, sonke siyavuma ukuthi ukujula kwemikhankaso yokhetho yamanje, esivuma ukuthi kufanele iqhutshelwe phansi ngebhadi nangokuthula, kuyisithembiso esibonakalayo sokukhula nokujula kokuthula kwethu. Ngivumele, Nkosikazi uMholi kanye nawe Mholi, ukuba ngikhuthaze bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanephuzu lokuvota ukuba babhalise kulokhu kukhetho okuzayo kwaseNingizimu Afrika nasezifundazweni ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ikusasa lethu. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe nsuku zonke emahhovisi omasipala, ngaphambi kokuthi uhlu lwabavoti luvalwe. Kufanele futhi sithathe ithuba elinikezwe yiKomidi Lokhetho laseNingizimu Afrika, i-IEC, ngokuhlela impelasonto ekhethekile yokubhalisela ukuvota, kusasa nangeSonto, 7 no-8 kuFebruwari ngokwehlukana. Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ukumemezela ukuthi ezinsukwini ezizayo, ngizophothula umhlangano wokubonisana neKomidi Lokhetho kanye noMongameli bezifundazwe futhi ngimemezele usuku lokhetho. Amalungu ahloniphekile, sibonga abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuba isifiso sabantu, futhi ukuthi okokuqala, ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa 1994, bathatha ikusasa labo ezandleni zabo. Ngalesi senzo esilula kodwa esinempembelelo, isenzo sokuvota kuhulumeni wabantu bonke baleli, sikwazile ukufaka umkhondo emuva obekuphikisana nobuntu bethu. Ngakho-ke, kufanelekile ukuthi kulolu suku sibhiyozela iminyaka engama-20 yokwamukelwa kweCharta ye- African Union ezindabeni zezifundazwe zaseNingizimu Afrika nezamazwe ase-Afrika mayelana nendaba eyakhuluma eNingizimu Afrika futhi yavumelana ngayo ngoMgqibelo ka-1989 - eyaziwa ngokuthi iHarare Declaration. Lokhu kubekwe isisekelo sokuthi umhlaba uvumelane ukuba uholelwe yiZizwe Ezihlangene ngezingxoxo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngisho naseNingizimu Afrika, le Charta yalandelwa ngesikhathi seNgqungquthela yeDemocratic Future ka-1989 eyakwazi ukuhlanganisa cishe wonke umuntu owawuthanda leli zwe ngaleso sikhathi. Konke lokhu kuholele ezingxoxweni ezahole
Febhuwari iyinyanga ebalulekile ePhalamende nasemphakathini wonke eNingizimu Afrika. Yisikhathi sokucabangela okwakudlulelwe, ukubheka phambili, nokubhekana nezidingo eziphuthumayo zezwe lethu. Ukukhuluma kweMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe kwenzeka njalo ngoFebhuwari, lapho uMongameli ethula khona inkulumo kubantu njengomholi wezwe. Yini inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe? Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iyinkulumo ethulwayo nguMongameli weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kubantu ngesikhathi sokuvulwa kwePhalamende minyaka yonke. Le nkulumo ithulwe kwiHholo Elihlangene lePhalamende - okuyiNdlu Yezwe (eyaziwa kakhulu njenge-NA) kanye neNdlu Yezifunda (efushane njenge-NCOP). Igxile ezithuthukisweni zezombusazwe nezomnotho. Le mhlangano ibizwa nguMongameli futhi iphostelwa nguMsizi weNdlu Yezwe kanye noSihlalo we-NCOP. Lezi yizikhathi ezithile lapho zonke izigaba ezintathu zohulumeni zihlangana endaweni eyodwa ngasikhathi sinye: lapha sithola i-Executive, emelelwa nguMongameli, uMongameli Osenyukwini, kanye noNgqongqoshe; iJaji, emelelwa nguMphakathi Oholayo kanye noJaji; kanye neLegislature, emelelwa ngamalungu ePhalamende (afushane njenge-MPs). Amalungu omphakathi nawo amelelwa enkulumweni yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ukuze abambe iqhaza kulomcimbi obalulekile odlala indima ekwakheni isizwe. Kungani inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ibalulekile? Kule nkulumo, uMongameli ugcizelela impumelelo nezinkinga ezibhekene ne-nyanga edlule futhi uchaza indlela ezolandela ngonyaka lowo. Le nkulumo ibandakanya izindaba zezombusazwe, ezomnotho, nezokuxhumana, futhi ibonisa isimo jikelele sezwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Ikhuluma ngezindaba zangaphakathi zezwe kanye nezokuxhumana nezizwe zase-Afrika nakwamanye amazwe. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iyithuluzi elibalulekile lokuphendula ePhalamende nasemphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika mayelana nalokho okwenzekile ngonyaka odlule nokubandakanya abantu ezinqubweni zezombusazwe zonyaka lowo. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iphinde isetshenziswe ukuze kugujwe isizwe sethu futhi sakhiwe kabusha. Nini le nkulumo ithulwa? Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ivamise ukwenzeka ngoFebhuwari. Nokho, uma kukhona ukhetho lwesizwe, kuvame ukuba nezinkulumo ezimbili ngonyaka, eyodwa ibonisa iseshini yokugcina yePhalamende elandela, kanti enye iyenzeka ngemuva kokhetho lapho uMongameli omusha kanye nePhalamende elisha kumukelwa. NgoFebhuwari 2010, ukuphuma emkhubeni ojwayelekile, inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe yathulwa ntambama okokuqala, ivumela inani elikhulu labantu baseNingizimu Afrika ithuba lokubona izenzakalo nokulalela inkulumo kaMongameli. Le shintsho yaholela ekwandeni kokubukwa kukamabonakude kusuka kumamiliyoni amabili kuya phansi kwemamiliyoni emine. Ukubandakanyeka komphakathi kuyisici salomcimbi. Amalungu omphakathi ayamenywa ukuba abambe iqhaza njengabavakashi bePhalamende kulomcimbi. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bavelaphiwe baphumelele kwiCivil Guard of Honour kanye neJunior Guard of Honour. I-Civil Guard of Honour, emukela uMongameli ePhalamende, yakhiwe ngabantu abajwayelekile baseNingizimu Afrika. I-Junior Guard of Honour ihlanganisa izingane ezivela ezikoleni ezikhethiwe ezweni lonke futhi imele intsha, ebhekwa njengethemba nekusasa lesizwe. Kuyajwayeleka ukuthi abantu abavelele baseNingizimu Afrika bamenywe ukuba babe yingxenye yezenzakalo. Bakhishwa ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene futhi bangaba ngabantu abenze umthelela obonakalayo ezweni. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe iyingxenye yenqubo yokubheka nokubophela. IPhalamende ingahlola ukusebenza kukahulumeni ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uqhubeka nokuphendula kubantu. UMthethosisekelo unikeze iPhalamende umsebenzi wokuhlola ukuze ibheke futhi ilandele izenzo zikahulumeni. Lokhu kukhuphule izinga lokwethemba kuhulumeni phakathi kwabantu. Ingabe iminyango kahulumeni iphethwe kahle? Umsebenzi wokubheka uholela ekuphathweni kahle kweminyango kahulumeni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile futhi kuqinisekiswe izinga lempilo elingcono kubo bonke abantu. Inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe, uMongameli uphinde ahlole isimo sezwe futhi abeke imigomo yezenzo kanye nalokho kuzokwenziwa ngonyaka lowo. Lokhu kusekelwe kulezi zinto ezihlosiwe kanye nalokho okukhulunywa ngesikhathi uNgqongqoshe WezeMali ethula inkulumo yeBhajethi yonyaka, evamise ukwenzeka ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari. Imigomo yezenzo kanye nezinyathelo ezihlelwe ziba yisisekelo salokho okufanele kuhulumeni kukwenze ngonyaka lowo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iPhalamende kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni uphendula kubantu mayelana nalokho akwenzile nokuthi yini eyenziwe emphakathini, kanye nokuthi izimali ezichithwe zisetshenziswe kanjani. Kwenzekani ngemuva kokuthi inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ithuliwe? Ngemuva kokuthi inkulumo yeMongameli mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ithuliwe, kokubili izindlu zePhalamende kuvamise ukuba nengxoxo. Amaphathi ezombusazwe athola ithuba lokukhuluma imibono yabo nokubuza imibuzo ngezindaba eziphakanyisiwe kule nkulumo. Izinkinga zikhuluma, futhi izindaba ezibalulekile zizwe zikhonjiswa. Umphakathi uyamenywa ukuba ube khona futhi ulalele le ngxoxo njengoba kwenzeka kuyo yonke imihlangano yePhalamende. UMongameli uphinde aphendule ezindabeni eziphakanyisiwe nemibuzo ebuzwayo phakathi kwale ngxoxo. Yini isiqubulo sePhalamende salonyaka? Isiqubulo sePhalamende sika-2011 sithi "Siyagubha umnikelo wenkululeko ngokwakha ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi kwePhalamende nabantu." Ngonyaka wonke, iPhalamende iyamukela isiqubulo esiba yisikhumbuzo semigomo yayo ngaleso sikhathi. Uhulumeni weqiniso weDemokhrasi uthola amandla awo kubantu ngokubamba ukhetho ngezikhathi ezithile futhi ngempela umphakathi uqhubeka nokubamba iqhaza ezinqubweni zokuphatha. Isiqubulo sikhuthaza ubukhona benkululeko yokubamba iqhaza, obonakalayo, kanye nokubophela, lapho abantu bezwa izindaba zomthetho nezokubheka. Kuphikisana indima yePhalamende ekumelelayo abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni wabantu ophatha ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Umsebenzi wePhalamende kanye namalungu akhe kufanele ugxile ekwenzeni ubudlelwano bokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nabamele babo abakhethiweyo. Impumelelo yePhalamende itholakala ekubambeni okubonakalayo kwabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokubatshela abamele babo abakhethiweyo, abangaba ngamalungu ePhalamende (ama-MPs), kanye naleli zikhungo indlela yokusebenza okudingeka yenziwe. Ngiyabonga ngokubamba iqhaza ocwaningweni lwez youth lweBokamoso Ba Rona! Akuzothi isikhathi eside ukuqedela lolu cwaningo, futhi ngokuphendula le mibuzo ngeqiniso, uzobe usiza emsebenzini obalulekile kakhulu. Khumbula ukuthi izimpendulo zakho zizohlala zingaziwa; ngakho-ke, asizokwazi ukuthi ungubani. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi ufunde yonke imibuzo ngokucophelela futhi uphendule ngeqiniso. Lolu cwaningo luhloselwe abantu abaneminyaka engu-12 kuya ku-24. Le mininingwane ibalulekile kithi ukuze siqonde ukuthi abantu abasha abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene bazizwa kanjani ngezinkinga ezithile, ngakho-ke sicela uphendule yonke imibuzo kulesi sigaba. Yisiphi isifunda ophila kuso? Sicela uphendule yonke imibuzo kulesi sigaba socwaningo. Lapho kukhona uhlu lokukhetha, khetha okukhona kuwe. Ujabule yini ngokuba nguMphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika? Ezindaweni ezilandelayo, yiziphi izinselelo obhekana nazo empilweni yakho? Izinkinga zempilo, i-HIV/AIDS, imishanguzo, njll. E-Ningizimu Afrika jikelele, ucabangani ngezinkinga ezibaluleke kakhulu ezibhekene nabantu abasha? Ucabanga ukuthi ungaba nesandla ekwenzeni iNingizimu Afrika ibe indawo engcono? Ubani onenhloso yokwenza iNingizimu Afrika ibe indawo engcono? Uma unenkinga enkulu, ubani ozobheka usizo? Uma umuntu onethemba ekukhuthaza ukuthi uye emiphakathini esiza abantu ngezinkinga ezinjalo, uzoya? Unemininingwane ngemiphakathi esiza abantu ngezinkinga ezinjalo? Ngokwembono yakho, ngabe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayafunda ukuhamba ndawonye? Empilweni yakho, ingabe umbala wesikhumba unquma ukuthi ubani ongahamba naye? Ngokuvamile, eNingizimu Afrika, ucabangani ukuthi umbala wesikhumba ukhombisa ukuthi abantu bangahamba kanjani?
Wamkelekile ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, ePhalamende leminyaka eyikhulu nesishiyagalombili! Le Phalamende iyabantu! Umbono wethu uwukwakha iPhalamende eliphendulayo elihlangabezana nezidingo zabantu futhi eliqhutshwa umbono wokwakha izinga elingcono lokuphila kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Siqinisekisa ngezinhlelo zethu ukuthi imiphakathi eshaywayo ihlale ifakiwe. Indima edlalwa yiPhalamende kanye nemiphumela elindelekile ukuveza abantu futhi kuqinisekiswe uhulumeni wabantu osebenza ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokudlulisela kwemithetho, ukuqapha umsebenzi owenziwa uhulumeni, nokuhlanganisa abantu emisebenzini yephalamende. UMthethosisekelo uyimthetho ophezulu weRiphabhulikhi futhi ubeka isisekelo somphakathi ovulekile nowedemokhrasi lapho uhulumeni ephethe khona abantu futhi lapho umthetho uvikela bonke abantu ngokulinganayo. Uveza ukubaluleka nezindlela zokuphatha ngendlela yedemokhrasi enakekela abantu. IPhalamende lenziwe ngababonisi abangama-400 abakhethwe ngabantu ngokhetho olukhululekile nolufanele, kwakha iSishayamthetho SaseNingizimu Afrika. Izifundazwe zimelelwa yiNational Council of Provinces ePhalamende, eyakhiwe ngababonisi abayishumi besuka esifundazweni ngasinye. IPhalamende lethu ledemokhrasi linomlando omuhle mayelana nokumelwa kwabesifazane. Okwamanje, abesifazane benza u-43 percent wamalungu ePhalamende. Kusukela ngo-2009, sibe sesibekwe endaweni yesithathu emhlabeni mayelana nokumelwa kwabesifazane. Inhloso yokumelwa kwabesifazane ePhalamende ingu-50%. Futhi sinePhalamende elisebenzayo kakhulu! Into yokuqala eyenziwe yiPhalamende lethu lokuqala ledemokhrasi ngo-1994 wukukhetha uMongameli uNelson Mandela njengomholi wesifunda. Ngomhla kaMeyi 24, 1994, uMongameli uMandela wakhuluma iSimo Sezwe sokuqala ezindlini ezimbili zePhalamende ezikhethwe ngabantu. Kusukela lapho, iPhalamende lamukela uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1996 futhi ladlulisa imithetho engaphezu kwenkulungwane! Uyalungela ukuhlola izimanga zale Phalamende emangalisayo? Masiqhubeke nohambo lwethu lokubona iPhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika! Lolu hambo ngezithombe zekhompyutha lugxile ezintweni ezintathu zePhalamende, okungukuthi i-Old Assembly, i-National Assembly, kanye ne-NCOP. Thatha isikhathi sakho ukuze ubheke!... Le yisiqondiso sePhalamende. Izindlu, okuyiNational Assembly, iNational Council of Provinces, kanye neTuynhuys zisebenzisa le sikhiye lapho ofisi zohulumeni kanye neofisi zamaphathi ePhalamende zitholakala khona. UMongameli uhamba ePhalamende Street lapho ehamba ukuya eMnyango weNational Assembly ukuze akhulume iSimo Sezwe sonyaka ezindlini ezimbili zePhalamende. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma iSimo Sezwe, esivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "Ukuvulwa kwePhalamende," zombili izinhlangothi zePhalamende Street zigcwele amaCivil Guards of Honour. ISlave Lodge iyindawo yokukhumbula nokuhlonipha. Yakhiwe yinkampani yaseDutch East India Company ngo-1679. Yayisetshenziswa yiCouncil of Advice njenge ndawo yokuhlangana ngaphambi kokuthi iPhalamende leCape lisungulwe, futhi yayisetshenziswa futhi njengehhovisi likahulumeni, iHigh Court, iPost Office, futhi ekugcineni yaba yiMnyuziyamu Yomlando Wamasiko. Ngesikhathi sokukhuluma iSimo Sezwe, uMongameli kanye neqembu lakhe bahamba ezikhumbuzweni ezibomvu ukusuka eSlave Lodge baya kwiNational Assembly ngesikhathi sokuhlangana okukhona phakathi kwezindlu ezimbili zePhalamende. Isakhiwo seMarks sitholakala ngaphesheya kwesakhiwo seNational Council of Provinces ePhalamende Street. Sakhiwe ngo-1904, Isakhiwo seMarks sikhona njengamanje kusetshenziswa amaqembu aphikisanayo kanye nabasebenzi bawo. Phambilini, sasisetshenziswa ngamalungu eHouse of Delegates kwi-tri-cameral Parliament ngaphambi kuka-1987. I-tri-cameral Parliament ka-1985 yayinezigaba zamaBhulu, amaColoured, kanye namaNdiya, kanti abantu abamnyama bahlala bengekho. I-Afrika House itholakala endaweni ebalulekile endaweni yePhalamende ngaphesheya kweNational Assembly. Yayiyihhovisi leBritish High Commissioner, futhi manje isetshenziswa yiJoint Committee on Intelligence kanye nezinye ofisi zephalamende. Ngaphakathi kwe-Afrika House kukhona enye yezinto ezindala kakhulu zobuciko bephalamende ezenziwe lapha ekhaya: ibhokisi elakhiwe ng wood yeMimosa elineminyaka engaphezu kwengu-350 futhi washaywa ngamavuthondaba aqinile asuka empumalanga ngo-1892. Isethaphu yeSpeaker yayigcinwe kulesi bhokisi iminyaka eminingi. "Stal" ngesiNgisi kusho isikhala. Ekuqaleni, umnyango omkhulu weStalplein, owawuhlinzekwe ngezindawo zokuhlala zeCape Governor, wawuseCompany Gardens ngakolunye uhlangothi lweTuynhuys, owawuhlinzekwe njengendawo yokugcina amathuluzi e-VOC, eyaziwa nangokuthi iDutch East India Company, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi yayisetshenziswa futhi yizo zonke iziphathamandla zeCape. Izakhiwo zephalamende ezalandelayo zakhiwa kancane kancane ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwezindawo ezintsha, futhi ngo-1988 isakhiwo esaziwa njengeNew Wing, lapho iNational Assembly itholakala khona, sakhonkolo neTuynhuys. Ngesikhathi seseshini yephalamende, uMongameli usebenzisa iTuynhuys njengehhovisi likamongameli. ITuynhuys iphethwe ngokuzimela futhi ayabelani ukuphathwa nePhalamende. Kwesikhathi eside, iPhalamende imele izinto ezahlukene kubantu abahlukene. Lapho ungena ePhalamende ngeRoeland Street, isithombe sikaJan Louis Botha ophakanyisiwe sivame ukuveza umbuzo: Umbuzo uthi: Yini eyenziwa ngamaqhawe amasha omhlaba? Nokho, lesi sithombe siyimpahla yomkhandlu weDolobha laseKapa. Imingcele yePhalamende yenziwe ngogodo oluhamba ePleins Street, kanye neCompany Gardens eNtshonalanga. Umnyango ngeRoeland Street usetshenziswa ngamalungu ePhalamende kanye nokupaka kubo kanye nabasebenzi bephalamende. Ngesikhathi sokuvulwa kwePhalamende nezinye izenzakalo zeSimo, iMemorial Flame ivulwa ukuze ihloniphe bonke abashonile emabhubhane ahilela iNingizimu Afrika. UMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika ungumholi ophakeme wezikhali zalesi sizwe. Isikhungo sokuvakasha sitholakala esakhiweni esidala sePost Office, esingesinye sePhalamende. IPhalamende wamukela izivakashi ezivela kude nasezindaweni eziseduze, futhi abafundi bakwamukela ikakhulukazi. Ngaphezu kuka-25,000 izivakashi ziyavakashela iPhalamende minyaka yonke. Izivakashi zidinga ukuveza ubunikazi obusemthethweni ngaphambi kokuvunyelwa ukungena ePhalamende. Kuvame ukuba nokuhamba, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokukhuluma iSimo Sezwe (okubizwa nangokuthi ukuvulwa konyaka kwePhalamende) nakuba uNgqongqoshe wezeMali ekhuluma. IPoorthuis iyaziwa nangokuthi iGate House, umnyango wesakhiwo se-Old Assembly. Kumele uhlelwe ukuze uqinisekiswe ukuphepha uma ungene lapha. Uma ungene ngalendlela, kukhona amamitha angama-30 eKeiskamma Tapestry (buka iHotspot).
Abesifazane benza ingxenye enkulu yokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika, yingakho izwi labesifazane kufanele lifakwe ezinqumweni nasekudalweni kwemithetho. Le nhlanganisela yabesifazane ezinqumweni iyilungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Abesifazane kufanele babambe iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngoba ukwenziwa kwemithetho nezinhlelo zik 정부 kuthinta impilo yabo nsuku zonke. Kubalulekile, ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi lapho abesifazane bebamba iqhaza ezinqumweni, kuholela ekutheni kube nokunakwa okwengeziwe nokwabiwa kwezinsiza okwenza kube ngcono izinga lempilo kubantu bonke. Ukwanda kokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho kungaholela ekutholeni kalula kwezinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika uthi umphakathi kufanele wazi futhi ubambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende nasemisebenzini yalo. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Abesifazane bangabamba iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngokuvota iqembu lezepolitiki abakholwa ukuthi lizomeleza kangcono imibono nezinkathazo zabo kwiPhalamende. Bangaphinde babambe iqhaza ekuhlela nasekusebenzeni kweqembu abakhethe. Abesifazane baphumelele ezikhundleni eziphakeme ngalendlela. Amalungu omphakathi anelungelo lokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi futhi aphinde abambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ngezindaba ezithile. Uma kuwukuthi kuyindaba umphakathi ofisa ukuyizwa, iKomidi leZizwe noma iKhansela leNhlangano lingase lenze izinkulumo zomphakathi noma limemeze iziphakamiso. Umphakathi ungazisa iKomidi leZizwe noma iKhansela leNhlangano ngemibono yabo ngezindaba eziphikisayo. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana neMenenja yePhalamende ukuze baveze imibono yabo ngengxenye yemithetho. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukhuthaza ukufana kwezigaba nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho. Umthethosisekelo uqukethe izinhlinzeko ezithuthukisa ukufana kwezigaba. IBill of Rights iqinisekisa ukwelashwa okufanayo kwabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika. Iphika ukucwaswa okungadingekile okusekelwe kumrace nasemazingeni. IBill of Rights igcizelela ukuthi izinyathelo kufanele zithathwe ukuze kukhuthazwe ukufezeka kokulingana kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. Umthethosisekelo uhlinzeka ngezikhungo ezisekela ukumela kwenani elikhulu, kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane. Lezi zikhungo zifaka iKomidi Lokulingana Kwezigaba kanye neKomidi leMithetho Yamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwezinhlinzeko zomthethosisekelo, iNingizimu Afrika izibophezele ekufaneni kwezigaba ngokusebenzisa izivumelwano zomhlaba wonke ezifana neSivumelwano Sokukhansela Zonke Izinhlobo Zokucwaswa Kwabesifazane (CEDAW) kanye nePlatform for Action eyasungulwa yiBeijing Women's Conference. INingizimu Afrika iyingxenye yezinhlelo ezahlukene zase-Afrika zokusebenza nokuqhubekisela phambili abesifazane, isibonelo, iSouthern African Development Community (SADC) egxile ekufaneni kwezigaba nasekuthuthukiseni. Indlela eyinhloko futhi ebaluleke kakhulu yokuthi abesifazane babambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende ngesikhathi sokhetho. Indlela abantu abavota ngayo ngesikhathi sokhetho ibumba ukwakheka kweKomidi leZizwe kanye neKhansela leNhlangano. Ukhetho lwesizwe lunika bonke abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-18 ilungelo lokuvota iqembu abakuthandayo. Abesifazane benza inani elikhulu labavoti futhi bangasebenzisa amalungelo abo okuvota ukuze bathinte indlela iPhalamende lakhiwa ngayo nokuthi uhulumeni ubeka kanjani phambili ukuthuthukiswa. Umnyango omusha wabesifazane, izingane, nabantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile usunguliwe ukuze uqiniseke imizamo kahulumeni yokukhuthaza nokuvikela abantu abahluphekayo emphakathini wethu. Nakuba abesifazane bengama-majority kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, bahlala bengama-minority uma kuziwa ezinqumweni. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezivimbela abesifazane ekudlaleni indima ephelele nephawulekayo, kanti ubuphofu buyinsiza enkulu. Ubuphofu buwumsebenzi obhekene nabesifazane abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane basemaphandleni. Ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziyisisekelo ezifana nemfundo, amanzi, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kuvinjelwe ubulili, imrace, nezinga lokuphila. Ukuze abesifazane babambe iqhaza ngokuphelele ekudalweni kwemithetho, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni eziyisisekelo kwabesifazane kufanele kuthuthukiswe. Abesifazane abahluphekayo banokufinyelela okulinganiselwe ezikhungweni zokudala imithetho. Abaningi babesifazane babhekana nokungabi namandla kwezomnotho. Abesifazane ngokujwayelekile bangumkhakha ophuthumayo kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika futhi bavame ukuba nezinga eliphakeme lokungasebenzi noma ukungasebenzi kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-HIV/AIDS ithinta ingxenye enkulu yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasha eminyakeni yabo yokukhulelwa. Ubulwane obuphakathi kwabantu besifazane buhlala buphakathi kwezinsiza ezinkulu ezibhekene neNingizimu Afrika. UbuDemokhrasi bethu obukhulayo bukhulise ukufinyelela kwabantu besifazane kumandla ezepolitiki nasezinqwabelweni. INingizimu Afrika iphinde yamukela imithetho eqondile yokukhuthaza ukufana kwezigaba. Inselelo iwukwenza ukuthi amalungelo afinyeleleke kubo bonke abesifazane. Ukumela kwabesifazane kwiKomidi leZizwe sekukhule kakhulu kube ngu-45%. Amadoda adlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni ukufana kwezigaba emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Amadoda amaningi aqala ukuphikisa ubulwane obuphakathi kwabantu besifazane nezingane. Amadoda kufanele aguqule indlela ababona ngayo izinto futhi ahloniphe abesifazane. Bobabili amadoda nabesifazane banendima efanayo futhi ebalulekile ekuguquleni ubudlelwano bezigaba emphakathini. Akukho mphakathi ongaba khona ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokucindezelwa kuze kube abesifazane nabamadoda bekhululekile futhi belingana, futhi ngaphezu kwalokho, amadoda nabesifazane babelana ngenkululeko eyodwa.
Ngo-1974, uhulumeni we-apartheid wanquma ukubuyisela emuva umthetho owawuhlukanise uDr. HF Verwoerd ngesikhathi ezama ukuwusebenzisa ngo-1953, ngenkathi ephethe ikomidi lezemfundo. Uhulumeni ngaleso sikhathi wawuphumelele umthetho "50/50", owayetshela ukuthi isiAfrikaans kufanele sibe yindlela yokufundisa yezibalo, izifundo zomphakathi, kanye ne-arithmetic, ngenkathi isayensi, izifundo ezisebenzayo, ubuciko, nezandla kufanele kufundiswe ngesiNgisi. Isigameko sokuqala sokulwa saqala phakathi kwabafundisi nabazali. Ngo-1975, amabhodi ezikole ayalile abafundisi ukuthi bangafundisi ngesiAfrikaans, okwaholela ekutheni uMnyango Wezemfundo YamaBantu ukhishwe abaphathi abahlanu bamabhodi ezikole. Ngonyaka ka-1976, kwavela umuzwa omkhulu ophikisana nohlelo lwezemfundo lwamaBantu. Njengoba isikhathi sokuphikisana sisondele ngoJuni 16, abafundi baseSoweto bahlangana emnyango wesikole esisodwa, bephakamisa isiqubulo: Faka ukuze Ufundise, Phuma ukuze Usebenze. Ngemva kukaMashi walowo nyaka, kwaphoqeleka ukuba isiAfrikaans sibe yindlela yokufundisa kwezinye izikole eSoweto, okwaholela ekwandeni kokuphikisana nomthetho "50/50". Ngomhla kaMeyi 17, ezinye izikole zaqala ukukhuthaza iziteleka, zicela ukuvalwa kwesiAfrikaans njengendlela yokufundisa. Ngaphambi kukaJuni, ezinye izikole zanqaba ukubhala izivivinyo zezifundo zomphakathi ngesiAfrikaans futhi zath threat to boycott all June exams. Ngempelasonto, ngoJuni 13, kwaba nomhlangano lapho kwavumelana ukuthi ngoJuni 16 no-17 kuzoba nokuhamba kwazulu eSoweto, kuphumelele emhlanganweni ngoMgqibelo, ngoJuni 18. Kulowo mhlangano, kwasungulwa ikomidi elibizwa ngeSoweto Action Committee (SAC), elinamalungu amabili avela esikoleni ngasinye eSoweto. Le komidi yanikezwa umsebenzi wokuhlela ukuhamba kokuthula okuphakanyisiwe. I-SAC nabo bonke ababekhona kulowo mhlangano bathi bayavuma ukugcina konke okwenzeka ngoJuni 13 kuyimfihlo ukuze izinhlelo zingaphazamiseki ngabaphikisi. Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu, kwakhishwa isimemezelo nemiyalo mayelana nalokho okwakudingeka kwenziwe ngalolo suku. Ekuseni kosuku lwangoMgqibelo, ngoJuni 16, 1976, abafundi baseSoweto bahlangana ezindaweni ezingaphezu kwezingu-12 ukuze bahambe. Abaphathi bahlakulela amaphephandaba anemishwana ebhalwe ngesandla ethi: "Phansi nesiAfrikaans" kanye "NgesiAfrikaans kuyilimi lokucindezela." Lolu suku lwabhalwa njengendawo ephezulu empini yentsha eNingizimu Afrika, eyayiqale ngaphambi kwalokhu futhi yaqhubeka kuze kube ukhetho lwabantu abaningi ngo-1994. Ukuvuka kweSoweto, okwakuyisisekelo sokulwa kwentsha, kwavusa uchungechunge lweziteleka ezweni lonke kodwa kwacindezelwa yilabo ababephakeme ngaphansi kohulumeni we-apartheid. Abantu abaningi bafa, amahhashi amaningi aboshwa, futhi abaningi baphuma ezweni ukuze bajoyine izinyathelo zokulwa ezazithulisiwe. Ukubaluleka kosuku lukaJuni 16, 1976, kubonakala ngendlela abantu abazinikela ngayo ekuzibophezeleni kwenkululeko nasekuphindiseni isizwe sabo. Lokhu futhi kwaba nomthelela ekwakheni uhlelo lwezemfundo oluhlonipha ubuntu, ukuhlukahluka kwamasiko, inkululeko yokukhetha, futhi luzama ukuqinisekisa amathuba alinganayo. Izinyathelo zentsha yama-70 zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa lethu. Njengobuholi bezikhathi ezizayo, bakwazi ukubona ikusasa labo futhi baphinde bakhe indlela okufanele bayilandele. Ngemibono yabo, izinyathelo, nokuzinikela, bavusa umlilo wokulwa nohulumeni ocindezelayo, okwagcina kuholela ekunqobeni kwabantu abaningi. Abantu abasha baqhubeka nokudlala indima ebalulekile emphakathini, futhi uhulumeni wabantu abaningi uzinikele ekuthuthukiseni abantu abasha, abangu bobuholi bezikhathi ezizayo nabagadi benkululeko yethu eyatholakala ngempumelelo. Izintshisekelo zabantu abasha manje sezibhekwa yisikhungo esisha esibizwa nge-Youth Development Agency (YDA), esithathe indawo yeNational Youth Commission kanye neRed Youth Fund, njengestructure kahulumeni yokubhekana nezindaba zentsha. Abantu abasha babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nenani eliphezulu labangasebenzi, ubumpofu, kanye nobugebengu. Ukungasebenzi kubandakanya zonke izimo abantu abasha abathola kuzo, kusukela kulabo abanemfundo yeziqu ezingu-10 kuya kulabo abaneziqu zemfundo ephakeme. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abasha eNingizimu Afrika babhekene nenkinga yokuthinteka ngezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, kuhlanganise ne-HIV ne-AIDS. Imindeni ephethwe abantu abasha kanye naleyo ephethwe izingane iyanda ngenxa yokufa kwabazali ezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi ezihlobene ne-HIV ne-AIDS, njenge-tuberculosis (TB). Inkinga enkulu ebhekene nezwe lethu yikhono lokukhulisa ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabantu abasha mayelana nokwazi ukuthi bangobani, ukuqonda umlando wabo, nokufaka kubo uthando lokuthanda izwe labo. Lapho sibheka intshisekelo ekhombisa abantu abasha emavotelweni ombuso wesine, kubonisa ukuthi le mpi iyaphumelela. Uhulumeni wabantu abaningi usungule izikhungo ezifana neNational Youth Development Agency (NDA), enikezwe amandla okubhekana nazo zonke izindaba zentsha, kusukela kumgomo kuya ekuthuthukiseni. Le ndawo ibhekwa nguNgqongqoshe ehhovisi likaMongameli. I-NDA iyisikhungo sikahulumeni esakhiwe ukuze ibhekane ngqo nezinselelo zezezimali ezibhekene nabantu abasha futhi iphinde ibe yifundo yokuthuthukiswa eyenzelwe ukudala amathuba kubantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ukubaluleka kwezemfundo kugcizelelwa ngokuhlukaniswa kweminyango emibili yezemfundo: uMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo kanye noMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi yabo iyenziwa kahle. IPhalamende linezinkomidi ezifana neNational Assembly Committee on Women, Children, and Persons with Disabilities, ezidinga ukubhekana nezindaba zentsha. Kungumsebenzi walezi zinkomidi ukuqapha intuthuko yezindaba zentsha nokubhekana nemithetho ethinta abantu abasha, kuhlanganise ne-Employment Equity Act. Emsebenzini wayo wokubhekwa, iPhalamende iqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho eyamukelwe iyasetshenziswa, kuhlanganise naleyo eyenzelwe abantu abasha baleli zwe. Ngaphakathi kwe-"Member's Interface," abantu abasha bangahlangana noMphakathi ukuze baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile kubo. Bangaphinde bakhombise imibono yabo ngokukhuluma noma ngokwenza iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe. Abantu abasha baphinde babe yingxenye yebhodi yokubuka emihlanganweni yeKomidi lapho imisebenzi eminingi yephalamende yenzeka khona, futhi bangavakashela emihlanganweni yephalamende ukuze babone izinqubo ukuze bathole ulwazi futhi bazithuthukise. Isiqubulo: "IPhalamende enakekela ethuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha ukuze kufezwe inkululeko yezezimali." "Umlando wethu uhlale uphoqelela abantu abasebasha ukuba bakwazi ukubhekana nomsebenzi besesebasha. Bangabantu abalwa nenkululeko kanti kufanele baphume noma babe esikoleni. Manje intsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu ngenxa yokungabi namathuba kweminyaka eminingi, ngenxa yobudlova nokuphazamiseka kwezemfundo. Kuzodingeka abantu abanomoya wokukhuthazela futhi bazibophezele ukuze baphumelele ezitheni futhi ukuze abantu abasebasha bakwazi ukujabulela ngokuphelele izinzuzo ezilethwa yidemokhrasi ezinzile." Usuku lweNtsha ngoJuni 16 lwenziwe usuku lokuphumula emphakathini nguhulumeni odemokhrasi ngemuva konyaka ka-1994. Lokhu kuhlonishwa ukuphakama kwentsha okwenzeka ngoJuni ngo-1976. Unyaka wonke unikezelwe ekugubheni impi yentsha eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Kuyisithonjana sempilo yentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika, eqalwe ngo-1976 yaphumelela kuze kube idemokhrasi yafinyelelwa ngo-1994. Le mpilo yentsha yaholela ekuthuthukisweni kohlelo lwezemfundo oluhlonipha isithunzi, ukuhlukahluka kwezamasiko, kanye namandla okhetho, futhi ilwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufinyelela okufanayo. Intsha yase-70s yadlala indima ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe lethu. Iqhubeka nokudlala indima ebalulekile emphakathini, futhi uhulumeni odemokhrasi uphinde uzibophezele ekuthuthukiseni intsha njengabab领导 bezikhathi ezizayo nabavikeli benkululeko yethu esiyitholile kanzima. Izinselelo ezibhekene nentsha zifaka phakathi ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezisemqoka. Umthelela we-HIV/AIDS nomkhuhlane uqondile kakhulu kubantu abasebasha. Imindeni ephathwa abantu abasebasha nezingane ezincane iyanda ngenxa yokufa kwabazali okubangelwa yizifo ezithathelwana, njengokhuhlane lwezitho zomzimba, oluhlotshaniswa kakhulu ne-HIV ne-AIDS. Ekuhlangabezaneni kwesimo sezwe, uMongameli uJacob Zuma uthe unyaka ka-2011 unyaka wokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Uthe imisebenzi kufanele igxile ekuthuthukiseni intsha. Ukuze kubhekwane nokungabi namisebenzi, uhulumeni utshala imali ukuze akhokhele izindleko zokuhola abantu abasebasha ukuze akhuthaze abaqashi ezinkampanini ezizimele ukuba babaqashe noma bengakaze basebenze ngaphambili. Udaba lokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo, amakhono, kanye namabhizinisi amancane kudlalwe kakhulu engxoxweni yezezimali ethulwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali uPravin Gordhan ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2011/2012. UNgqongqoshe wezeMali ubonisile ukuthi usizo lwezezimali lwabafundi luzokwenyuka ukuze lunikeze abantu abasebasha ithuba lokuqhubeka nezifundo zabo nokuqeqeshwa ezikoleni, ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono abo. Imali eyengeziwe inikezwe iNational Skills Fund, okuyimali ebekwe eceleni ukuze iqeqeshe abafuna imisebenzi. Uhulumeni odemokhrasi usungule izinhlelo ezifana neNational Youth Development Agency (NYDA), enikezwe umthetho wokubhekana nazo zonke izindaba ezithinta intsha, kusukela kumgomo kuya ekuthuthukisweni. I-NYDA iyinhlangano esungulwe nguhulumeni ukuze iphendule ngqo ezinselelweni zezimali ezibhekene nabantu abasebasha, futhi iphinde ibe yindlunkulu yokuthuthukiswa kwemali, eyenzelwe ukusungula ipulatifomu yokwakha imisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, nokudluliswa kwamakhono kubantu abasebasha baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcina isiqubulo: "IPhalamende enakekela ethuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha ukuze kufezwe inkululeko yezezimali," iPhalamende isungule izinkundla eziningi ezibhekana nezindaba ezibhekene nentsha. Lezi zikhungo zinomsebenzi wokubheka yonke imisebenzi ehambisana nezindaba zentsha futhi kufanele ziphathe ukuphathwa kwemithetho ethinta abantu abasebasha. IPhalamende isungule izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezimbonini ezahlukene, ngokwesibonelo, iPhalamende leNtsha (elenzeka ngenyanga yentsha) lapho izindaba ezihlobene nentsha zixoxwa khona. Abantu okufanele babambe iqhaza bangabantu abasebasha, futhi imizamo eqhubekayo ibhekiswe kubo. Umthethosisekelo ubopha iPhalamende ukuba ibandakanye umphakathi emisebenzini yayo, ngakho-ke intsha njengengxenye yomphakathi ikhuthazwa ukuba ibambe iqhaza ezithangamini zephalamende, njengemihlangano yomphakathi, iNkulumompikiswano kaMongameli, nezinye izinhlelo zokufinyelela umphakathi. Bangaphinde baveze imibono yabo ngokwenza izethulo zomlomo noma ezibhaliwe. Intsha iphinde ibe yingxenye yomphakathi ozohlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi lapho imisebenzi eminingi yePhalamende yenziwa khona, futhi abantu abasebasha bangahamba ezihlanganweni zephalamende ukuze babone ngokwabo, bathole ulwazi, futhi bazithuthukise.
Isikhungo samanje sokusebenza ezindaweni zokudoba... Ukuhanjiswa kwabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane... Abantu abathintekayo emabhizinisini amancane, bedoba ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo ezisemqoka zempilo noma zokuphila noma kungenzeka babambe iqhaza emisebenzini yezezimali encane. Lezi zinduna zingase zisebenze eduze kwasolwandle noma eduze kwemithombo yamanzi futhi zingase zibe nesiko lokudoba. Ngokuvamile, bedoba ngezinsiza zabo zendabuko futhi/noma ngezinsiza eziphansi zobuchwepheshe futhi bazitholele izinhlanzi. Ngokuvamile, umuntu uqobo udoba izinhlanzi ukuze azisebenzise yena kanye nezitho zomndeni, kuhlanganise nomuntu othengisa izinhlanzi kubantu bendawo noma owenza ukuthengiselana ngento ethile esikhundleni sezinhlanzi, kodwa akuhlanganisi umuntu odoba ngokuhweba ngezinga elikhulu. Ukubambisana kubhekisela kubuhlakani phakathi kuk 정부, imiphakathi yasendaweni, abasebenzisi bezinsiza zemvelo, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni, nabanye ababambiqhaza ababelana ngamalungelo nomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha izinsiza zezimali. Ukubambisana kuyisihloko esisekelwe emphakathini esisungulwe ukuze kube nokubambisana nohulumeni futhi kusize ekuphathweni kwemvelo nasekubhekaneni nabasebenzisi bezinsiza zemvelo. Okwamanje, izinhlobo ezilodwa noma ngaphezulu zezinhlanzi noma yimaphi amaphrojekthi okudoba asekelwe kulezi zinhlobo zingabhekwa njengomkhakha othile wokuvikelwa nokuphathwa, kuthathwa kokuqonda isimo sezindawo, ulwazi lwesayensi, ubuchwepheshe, ukuhweba, ezomnotho, nezinye izinto ezihlobene. Abantu abake baphuthelwa ngenxa yokucwaswa okusekelwe kubuhlanga, ubulili, noma ukungakwazi. Umsebenzi omkhulu weMnyango uwukuvikelwa, ukuphathwa, nokusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo kwezinsiza zasolwandle. Le nqubomgomo ihlose ukuthuthukisa ukuphathwa nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza njengemihlahlandlela yokwabiwa kwamalungelo okudoba ezindaweni zokudoba ezincane, kuhlanganisa nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abodoba ukuze baphile kanye nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane, ngaphakathi kwesikhungo esifanele. Le nqubomgomo iletha izimiso, izinqubo, nezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ekuphathweni nasekwabiweni kwamalungelo okudoba. Ulwandle luthatha izigaba ezintathu ezibalulekile zabathwebuli bezinhlanzi noma ukudoba: abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abangekho emalini, nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi bezokungcebeleka. Kukhona futhi enye iqembu labathwebuli bezinhlanzi, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abangekho emalini, abangafaki kunoma yiziphi zezigaba ezishiwo ngenhla. Lokhu kudala isidingo sokuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo esemthethweni kanye nesistimu yokuphatha ezobandakanya laba bathwebuli bezinhlanzi. Ukuze kufakwe leli qembu, izinqubomgomo zokwabiwa kwamalungelo akhona ezikhona kufanele zihlolwe futhi izinguquko ezidingekayo ziqalwe ku-MLRA. Ukwabiwa nokuphathwa kwamalungelo okudoba ngezizathu zokuphila okwamanje akukwazanga ukuhlinzeka ngesikhungo esifanele senqubomgomo. Kuzoba udaba lokushintsha umthetho ukuze kuhlukaniswe ukwabiwa kwamalungelo okudoba phakathi kwabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo nalabo abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abahweba noma ukuhlinzeka amalungelo kuphela kubathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abangekho emalini. Ulwandle luhlinzeka uMnyango ngamalungelo phezu kokuphathwa kwezinsiza zasolwandle. Ngokwenzela ukwabiwa kwamalungelo okudoba, uNgqongqoshe uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo ngaphansi kwesikhungo somthetho ngaphakathi koMnyango ukuze anikeze amalungelo okudoba kubathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abangekho emalini ngaphansi komthetho wezokuphila ophatha izinsiza zasolwandle. Le nqubomgomo izosiza ekulawuleni amalungelo abhekelele ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamalungelo okudoba ezingeni elincane. Ngokomlando, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abahweba badoba izinhlanzi eduze kwasolwandle besebenzisa amathuluzi okudoba aphansi. Kubalulekile ukuqala inqubomgomo nesistimu yokuphatha kubathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane, kanye nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abakhulu. Nakuba ukusetha imingcele yalezi qembu kuyinselele eyinkimbinkimbi, kuboniswe futhi ukuthi kunezinkinga ekwehlukaniseni phakathi kwabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo, abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane, kanye nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abakhulu. Empeleni, kuhluka kusuka ezingeni lapho abathwebuli bezinhlanzi bedoba khona ukudla kuya kulabo abaphethe amabhizinisi amancane futhi ekugcineni kuya ezinkampanini ezincane nezaphakathi. Lokhu kuzohlolwa ukuze kuqashelwe isigaba esisha esibizwa ngokuthi abathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abahweba, echazwa njengabantu emabhizinisini amancane, nalabo abathintekayo ekudobeni ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo ezisemqoka zempilo noma abangase bathinteke ekudobeni ezingeni labathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane abahweba. Lesi sigaba sabathwebuli bezinhlanzi siqaphela futhi siqonda umehluko phakathi kwabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abaphilayo nabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane. Ngenxa yenhloso yale nqubomgomo kanye nesimo somthetho samanje, kubalulekile ukuhlela abathwebuli bezinhlanzi kanye nomkhakha njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla. Incazelo ingashintsha uma kwenziwa izinguquko ku-MLRA. Isikhungo samanje sabasebenzisi balolu hlelo lwezezimali ezindaweni zokudoba ezincane siyinkimbinkimbi. Izindawo zokudoba zinezinhlanzi, zisebenzisa amathuluzi okudoba ezendabuko futhi/noma ubuchwepheshe obuphansi, zithinteka ezimweni ezahlukene zokudoba ukuze zisebenzise izinsiza, ubuchwepheshe bokudoba nokuhambisa izinhlanzi obusetshenziselwa ukuhweba ezindaweni zokudoba zasolwandle ngempela, ngesikhathi esithile, noma ngezikhathi ezithile ikakhulukazi ukuze zisebenzise, emakethe yasendaweni noma yesifunda. Abathwebuli bezinhlanzi uqobo baphinde bathinteke kwezinye izenzo ezisebenzayo ezifana nokwakha izixhumi zabo, ukwakha izikebhe, ukulungisa amajini, nokulungisa izinto, okuvula amathuba emisebenzi ehlobene nokudoba kanye namathuba okwenza imali emiphakathini yokudoba. Lezi ziqephu aziphelele, futhi kuboniswe ukuthi hhayi yonke imiphakathi ingase ibhaliswe kulolu hlu. Isithombe semiphakathi yokudoba encane eduze kwasolwandle saseNingizimu Afrika. Lezi ziqephu aziphelele futhi zingase zingabandakanyi yonke imiphakathi. Lezi zihloko zikhonjisiwe zibhaliwe eduze kwenombolo efanele emmapheshini. Uhlu lwemiphakathi yokudoba efakiwe emdwebeni ophakanyisiwe ngenhla. Izinhlobo zezinhlanzi zasolwandle zibhujiswa ngabathwebuli bezinhlanzi abancane. Izindlela zokudoba nazo ziyahluka.
