Amakhophi ale ndatshana ephelile angatholakala ehhovisi leMenenja: Ukuxhumana Kwezwe Nezifunda, uMnyango Wezemfundo, ePitoli. UMnyango Wezemfundo uveza ngokuqhakazile lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo sezinga le-R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zeNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha kwalolu work akuzange kube umsebenzi olula. Izikhathi eziningi, labo ababephatha lo msebenzi wokuhumusha baphoqeleka ukudala amagama amasha ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene. Lezi zindatshana zathunyelwa kubachwepheshe bezilimi ukuze bahlolisise. UMnyango Wezemfundo ubheka lezi zindatshana njengesisekelo sokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufunda ukuthi asebenzise lezi zindatshana njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Yini umphumela wokufunda? Yini indlela yokuhlola? Indlela yokuhlola ihluke kanjani kumiphumela yokufunda? Ukuhlela kabusha umgomo wesifundo wesizwe kuyinselelo kokubili isizwe kanye nezwe. UMnyango Wethu Wezemfundo uphinde uveze umgomo wawo wesifundo ohlobene nombono esinawo kanye nendlela esibona ngayo umphakathi wethu, esiwubona ngokubheka izingane nabafundi esikhiqiza ngokuya kulolo mgomo esiwusebenzisa. Ngesikhathi sokukhetha okumele kufakwe emgomeni, ukunakwa kwanikezwa kulokho okubalulekile ekwakheni 'imfundo esezingeni eliphezulu'. Lo mgomo wabhala ngamaNingizimu Afrika, wenzelwe amaNingizimu Afrika, ugcizelela izimiso nezindinganiso zedemokhrasi. Lo mgomo uhlanganisa iphupho esinalo kubafundisi nabafundi. Sifuna ukuba nabafundisi nabafundi abaziqondayo izimo ezahlukene zokuphila. Kumele babe abantu abakhathazekile ngezindaba ezithinta indawo yabo futhi bazokwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo ezizobhekana neNingizimu Afrika eminyakeni engamashumi amabili nanye ezayo. Nokho, kumele sibhekane neqiniso lokuthi kunezici zomgomo wesifundo ezizophumelela nezizophumelela. Ukungalingani nobubha kuqhubeka nokuphazamiseka kwemfundo kwemindeni eminingi nezingane zethu ezweni lethu. Umgomo wesifundo uvame ukuhunyushwa ngezindlela ezahlukene ezimweni ezahlukahlukene. Nokho, sizokwenza umzamo wokuthuthukisa umgomo wethu wesifundo futhi siphinde silwe ukuze siwuphumeze ngempumelelo. Sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leli phupho lethu liyafezeka ngokubhekana nazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokufunda nokufundisa lapha ezweni lethu. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela okukhulu nokuthi wonke umuntu ophakathi kwemfundo udlale indima ebalulekile. Sidinga ukubambisana okuphelele phakathi kukamasipala, abazali, abafundisi, abafundi, nomphakathi wonke ngoba laba abathintekayo bangamaphakethe empumelelo yemfundo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo sizohlanganisa izifiso ezizokhuthaza ukubambisana okuhlanganisa wonke umuntu kuleli zwe laseNingizimu Afrika. Emhlanganweni ngoJuni 2000, iBhodi Labaphathi Bezemfundo yamukela ukuthi lo mgomo wesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 kufanele ubuyekezwe ngokuhambisana neziphakamiso zembiko yeqembu lokuhlola (enombolo ethi Meyi 31, 2000) mayelana nendlela nokuhlelwa kabusha komgomo wesifundo ka-2005. Ngemuva kwalokho, kwasungulwa ikomidi, elikhethwe ngababusi, ukuze lihlele futhi liqondise ukuhlela kabusha umgomo wesifundo ka-2005. Inqubo yokuhlola yaqala ngoJanuwari 2001 nabasunguli abayi-150 balolu mgomo bevela emkhakheni wezokufunda. NgoJulayi 31, umgomo wesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wathunyelwa emphakathini ukuze ube nemininingwane yabo isikhathi esingama-3. NgoNovemba, umphakathi wanikezwa enye ithuba lokuxoxa ngalolu mgomo. Ngemuva kokuthi umphakathi uthumele impendulo yabo neziphakamiso, lezi zahlaziywa ngamaqembu akhethiwe eqembu lokuhlola labaphathi futhi zaba yisichasiso ngoDisemba 2001 ukuze kufakwe izinguquko eziphakanyisiwe. Lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo siwumphumela womsebenzi okhuluma ngenhla. Le ndatshana kanye nezitatimende zezigaba eziyisishiyagalombili ezishicilelwe njengokungeziwe zisebenza njengesisekelo lapho lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 (ezikoleni) sakhiwe khona. Lesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 (ezikoleni) sizothatha indawo yesitatimende somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 esamukelwa ngo-1997 uma sekuqinisekiswe ngokomthetho njengomgomo wesifundo. Uhlelo oluhle lokusebenza luzosungulwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhunyushwa kwalesi sitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe kuphumelele. Umthetho wokuhlola okukhona odatshana ethi Disemba 23, 1998 (kwi-gazette yombuso inombolo 19640) kanye nomthetho wezilimi emfundweni odatshana ethi Julayi 14, 1997 (kwi-gazette yombuso inombolo 17997) kumele kufundwe ndawonye nesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe wezigaba ze-R-9 (ezikoleni). Umthetho wokuhlola kumele ufundwe ndawonye nesigaba esihlobene sesitatimende sesigaba ngasinye sokufunda. Umthetho ophathelene nokukhishwa kwezitifiketi uzohlala ungashintshi kuze kube unyaka ka-2008. Ngemuva kwalokho, isitifiketi semfundo nokuqeqeshwa esihlobene nesitatimende esihlelwe kabusha somgomo wesifundo wesizwe kanye nesigaba esihlobene sizoba yiso esizosebenza. Isitifiketi semfundo nokuqeqeshwa emfundweni ephoqelelwe sizoba yisithembiso esiphelele ezikoleni futhi sizoba yiso esizoholela ekufezeni imiphumela ngokusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezifanele ezingeni le-9. Uhulumeni wedemokhrasi waseNingizimu Afrika wamukela ohulumeni bangaphambili uhlelo lwezemfundo olwalungalingani. Ngaphansi kukahulumeni wobandlululo, iNingizimu Afrika yayinezigaba eziyi-19 ezihlukene zemfundo. Lezi zigaba zazihlukaniswe ngohlanga, ngezindawo lapho abantu bahlala khona, nangombono wezombusazwe waleso sikhathi. Lolu hlobo lwemfundo lwalulungiselela izingane ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene, kwezomnotho nangokwezombusazwe ngaphansi kobandlululo. Kuwo wonke lawa magunya, uhlelo lwezemfundo ludlale indima ebalulekile ekugcizeleleni ukungalingani phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kufundiswa ezikoleni, indlela okwakufundiswa ngayo izingane, noma ukuthi kwafundiswa yini kwahluka ngokuya ngezindima ababephoqelekile ukuba bazithathe emphakathini jikelele. Ukuhlaziywa kohlelo lwezemfundo eNingizimu Afrika ngemva kobandlululo kwaqala ngemuva kokhetho luka-1994 lapho iBhodi Lezemfundo Nezokuqeqesha (NETF) iqala u
Umphakathi Wokuphatha: Umnyango Wezangaphakathi Nezamasiko, Nkk. Ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukuba lapha nomphakathi waseNdaka kule m事件 ebalulekile yokwethulwa ngokofficial kohlelo lokubuyisela isithunzi kubantu balendawo. Kuyakhuthaza ukuba yingxenye yoHulumeni ogcwalisa izibopho zawo nemigomo, kuhlanganise nendlela ehlelekile esiyithathayo yokubambisana nabantu bethu empini yokulwa nobuphofu. Umphathi Wohlelo, namuhla uzokhunjulwa yizizukulwane ezikhona nezizayo njengosuku olukhombisa ukuthathwa kwesinyathelo esisodwa sokuthuthukisa impilo yomphakathi waseNdaka. Njengelizwe nendawo, sikhuluma ngembali lapho iningi labantu bethu belingakwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni zabo eziyisisekelo ngenxa kombala wesikhumba sabo, besebenzisa izinhlelo zokugeza ezisebenzisa ibhakede, okungasusi kuphela isithunzi sabo kodwa futhi kube nezingozi zezempilo. Sisaqhubeka sikhala kakhulu ekunikezeni abantu bethu ukuhlinzekwa kahle kwezempilo, futhi lokhu kubonakala kakhulu ezindaweni ezifana neNdaka lapho iningi labantu beliphathwa nguHulumeni wobandlululo njengabathakathi - bahlala lapha. UHulumeni wobandlululo wadala ukungalingani emphakathini, hhayi kuphela ngokobuhlanga kodwa futhi ekunikezeni izidingo eziyisisekelo zezempilo. Uzothola ukuthi umakhelwane oyedwa ophakathi komgwaqo unamanzi, ithoyilethi elihlanza, kanye nogesi, kanti omunye umakhelwane uhlala ngaphansi kwezimo eziphansi futhi engenayo imithombo yokuhlanza. Ngokucacile, le miphumela yokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo (ezinsizeni eziyisisekelo) ngendlela engalingani yadalwa ngenhloso nguHulumeni wobandlululo ukuze kuncishiswe isithunzi sabantu bethu. Njengoba singena ohlelweni lobumbano, sathi njengohulumeni bezakhamuzi sizibophezele ekulungiseni le miphumela. Umsebenzi wethu obalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izigidi zabantu ababeqedwa izidingo zabo bakwazi ukufinyelela kuzo futhi bazuze. Senze izinqumo eziningi kule ngqungquthela. Nokho, sonke savuma ukuthi indlela yokusebenza okufanele siyilandele njengohulumeni bendawo kufanele ibe yokubambisana ngqo. Lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sengqungquthela yethu. Siphinde savuma ukuthi lezi zinqumo zizolandela. Ngamanye amazwi, savuma ukuthi akufanele sibe nezingqungquthela nezinkulumo nje kuphela ukuze sikhulume futhi sikhulule imibiko. Savuma ukuthi sizolandela indlela yokusebenza eqondile emsebenzini wethu wokuhlinzeka ngezidingo njengohulumeni bendawo. Sihlangene lapha namuhla ukuze siqale olunye lwezinhlelo, olukhuthaza ukubambisana ngqo. Ngenkathi sixoxa ngendlela yokuhamba phambili mayelana nezinsizakalo ezibhekene nezinkinga njengoba kuboniswe engqungquthelweni, uhulumeni kazwelonke ubheke izindlela zokungenelela ezizokwenziwa esikhathini esifushane ukuze kusizakale izinsizakalo. Lapho kwavela khona iphrojekthi yokubambisana ngqo (Iphrojekthi Yokuhlanganisa). Iphrojekthi yokubambisana ngqo iyohlelo olubhekana nezinselelo ezibhekene nezinsizakalo ezweni lonke. Ngikhuluma ngama-136 ezinsizakalo ezitholakele ezweni jikelele ukuze zibambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo. Afrika idinga ngokuphuthumayo ukuthola izindlela ezintsha zokwenza kube nemiphumela ebonakalayo ezinhlelweni zohulumeni bendawo nokwandisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zohulumeni kazwelonke, zendawo, nezokuhlinzeka ezindaweni ezibalulekile zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo (nokubambisana nazo). Ngamafuphi, uhlelo lokubambisana ngqo lugxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lokuphila kwabantu ezingeni lendawo. Umkhandlu wendawo waseNdaka ungomunye wemikhakha etholekile ukuze ibambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo olubalulekile lokuqinisa izinsiza zethu zomkhandlu. Njengohulumeni, sanquma ukuthi sidinga ukubambisana nezinsizakalo ngokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olungeziwe ukuze sikwazi ukusheshisa ukususa izithiyo ekunikezeni izinsizakalo. Iqiniso esikubone ukuthi ukungabi nolwazi nezakhono zobuchwepheshe kuyisizathu esisodwa sokuhamba kancane kokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinsizakalweni zethu. Izinsizakalo ezifana neNdaka ziyizinsizakalo ezintsha ezibhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuhlangana nezinsizakalo ezidalwe nguHulumeni wobandlululo emiphakathini. Ngenkathi bezama ukulungisa umonakalo owadalwa nguHulumeni wobandlululo, babhekana nezinselelo zokusebenza ngokuphelele ngenxa yokungabi nezakhono ezidingekayo phakathi kwezinye izinsizakalo. UHulumeni uthuthukise uhlelo oluzothuthukisa nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwemikhakha futhi luphinde lusize ekudluliseni izakhono ukuze kuqinisekiswe abantu. Nakuba okwedlule kuyingxenye yomlando wethu, akufanele sihlale sikhuluma ngempela mayelana nazo zonke izinkinga esibhekene nazo. Iqiniso ukuthi ukuqhubeka kokuphila kwezinhlelo zokugeza ezisebenzisa ibhakede eNdaka nakwezinye izindawo kule ndawo kuyisiphumo sokungabi khona kwezinsiza zobuchwepheshe ezifanele. Ngenkathi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngoxhaso ngaphansi kohlelo lokuxhasa izinsizakalo ukuze ahlinzeke ngezidingo eziyisisekelo, ezinye izinsizakalo zithola isimo lapho zikhungathekile ngenxa yokungabi nolwazi lobuchwepheshe oludingekayo ukuze zenze lo msebenzi. Asikwazi ukuqhubeka sithola izaba; kumele sakhe amathuba okuthuthukisa izakhono ezidingekayo ukuze sihlinzeke ngezidingo ngokushesha emiphakathini yethu. Lezi zisengomunye wemikhakha esibhekene nayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuqhubeka kwethu emkhakheni wethu wesikhathi eside. Lokhu esikwenze namuhla lapha eNdaka kuyukungenelela ngqo ukuze kususwe zonke izithiyo zokugeza ezisebenzisa ibhakede ngokusebenzisa amathuba adalwe uhlelo lokubambisana ngqo. Lezi amathuba zifaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esengeziwe ezinsizakalweni esikhathini esifushane. Lolu hlelo lulethe ukubambisana okuqinile phakathi komkhandlu wendawo, umkhandlu wesifunda, nohulumeni wesifunda futhi lwenze kube nokukhululwa kwemali ngesikhathi esifushane. Konke lokhu kumela amasu amasha okufanele silandele futhi sifunde kuzo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi kuyagcinwa ekunikezeni izinsizakalo. Lokhu esikufundile kulolu hlelo lweNdaka kusinikeze isu lokusheshisa ukuxazulula izinsizakalo emiphakathini yethu. Ngamanye amazwi, ngilindele ukubona zonke izithiyo zokugeza ezisebenzisa ibhakede zisuswa emiphakathini kulandela lokho esikufundile lapha eNdaka. Lokhu esikwenze kulula kakhulu. Okokuqala, sahlinzeka ngezinkulumo phakathi kwezinsizakalo zendawo nezinsizakalo zesifunda mayelana nohlelo lokuhlanza amanzi olwakhiwe kulomphakathi lapha. Sonke siyazi ukuthi uhlelo lwezithiyo zokugeza ngebhakede aluhambisani nezindinganiso zezempilo nezokuphepha zabantu bethu. Akukho sizathu esinengqondo esinganikwa kulomphakathi sokuthi kungani bengakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini nasezitholeni zokugeza ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Lo mphakathi uyazi ngamakhelwane angama-200 amamitha kude abangakwazi ukufinyelela
Kuthunyelwe kubo. Abaphathi Bezifundo Bezifunda, Abadidiyeli Abaphezulu, kanye Nabaphathi ehhovisi elikhulu nasezikhungweni zendawo. Abaphathi bezikole kanye nabasebenzi babo bezikole zomphakathi ezijwayelekile. Izikole zabafundi abanezidingo ezikhethekile zemfundo. Amalungu ezikhungo zokuphatha izikole. Iphondo leGauteng lezeMfundo lenze izinhlelo eziningi zokweseka ukuhlinzekwa okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle kwemfundo esezingeni eliphezulu kule ndawo. Phakathi kwezinye izinto, lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukulungela ukuvakashela esikoleni. Ukulungiselela ukuvakashela esikoleni kuqala ngoMsombuluko wonyaka ophambi konyaka wesikole omusha. Le nqubo ibandakanya ukuhlela imisebenzi phakathi kwemisebenzi ethintana ngqo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlinzekwa okuphelele komsebenzi osebenzayo ezikoleni ukuze kuqale ukufundiswa nokufunda kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lonyaka wesikole omusha. Le nqubo iphetha ngezivakashi ezivakashela ezindaweni ezibanjwa ngabaphathi abaphezulu nabasebenzi bezigaba ezinsukwini ezimbili zokuqala zokuvulwa kwezikhungo zomphakathi. Umthetho Wezokufunda Kazwelonke No. 27 ka-1996. Umthetho Wokufunda Nokuhlinzeka Ngemfundo No. 98 ka-1996. Izindinganiso Nezindinganiso Zokuxhasa Izikole Kazwelonke njengoba zishintshiwe. Ukuvakashelwa kokuhlola kuyamenyezelwa futhi ZONKE Iziqu Zokuphatha Izikole kanye Nezikhungo Zokuphatha kumele zilungiselele lezi zivakashi kusenesikhathi.
Izisekelo zeMkhankaso Wokufunda (FFL) zigxile ekuthuthukiseni amakhono okufunda, ukubhala, nokubala kwabantwana bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Ihloswe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa nokukhuthaza kuzo zonke izigaba zohlelo lwezemfundo kanye nasezindlini nasezindaweni zomphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ngonyaka ka-2011, bonke abafundi bangakhombisa amazinga afanele okufunda nokubala ngokwezinga labo. Lo mkhankaso uphendula ocwaningweni olwenziwe ezweni, ezindaweni, nasezinhlelweni zomhlaba wonke ezikhombisile ukuthi eminyakeni eminingi, abantwana eNingizimu Afrika bebengakwazi ukufunda, ukubhala, nokubala ezingeni elilindelekile, futhi abakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ekhombisa amakhono abalulekile ahlobene nokufunda nokubala. Lo mkhankaso uzophothulwa ngokuqhuba ukuhlolwa kwezinga lesizwe ekupheleni konyaka ka-2011 ukuze kuhlolwe amazinga okufunda/izilimi nokubala/izibalo phakathi kwabafundi beGrade 3 neGrade 6 eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kutholakale ukuthi lokhu kuthinta kanjani. Izisekelo zeMkhankaso Wokufunda (Inombolo yeGazethi yoHulumeni 30880, Isaziso soHulumeni inombolo 306, 14 Mashi 2008). Inqubomgomo Yezwe Yokuhlola Nezinga Elincane Ezikoleni kuMkhakha Wokufunda Nokuthuthukiswa (Inombolo yeGazethi yoHulumeni 29626, 12 Febhuwari 2007). Inqubomgomo Yezwe Mayelana Nokuvunyelwa KweZinhlelo Zokufunda Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezemfundo Jikelele Yezinga R-9 (izikole) (Inombolo yeGazethi yoHulumeni 23406, 31 Meyi 2002). Ulimi kuInqubomgomo Yezemfundo (UMnyango Wezemfundo 1997). Isakhiwo Sokuhlola Ikhwalithi. Ukuhlola kudlala indima ebalulekile enqubweni yokufundisa nokuqonda. Isitatimende seNqubomgomo Yezwe, kanye neNqubomgomo Yezwe Yokuhlola Nezinga Elincane Ezikoleni kuMkhakha Wokufunda Nokuthuthukiswa (Gazethi 29626), kucacile ngenhloso yaso yokufaka ukuhlola ekwakhiweni, ekwenzeni, nasekuhloleni ohlelweni lwezemfundo. Izisekelo zeMkhankaso Wokufunda ziqhubeka ngalokhu futhi zifuna ukwandisa nokwakha ukuhlola okuphakeme ngenhloso yokwakha izindlela ezisekelwe ezifakazela nezithuthukisayo. Kubalulekile ukuqhakambisa ukuthi iFFL ingaphezu kokuhlola kuphela. Ihambisana nokuhlinzeka ngesakhiwo esigxile kuwo wonke amaphuzu abalulekile okwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokufunda, ikakhulukazi kumakhono ayinhloko okufunda nokubala. Nokho, ukuhlola kuzodlala indima ebalulekile ekwaziseni nasekukhombiseni izinyathelo zeMkhankaso. Eminyakeni edlule ku-2011, ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile kuzovumela izikole ukuthi zilinganise intuthuko yazo ngokumelene nemiphumela yokufunda eyisisekelo ehlose ukufezekisa imigomo ebekiwe yesikhashana nezikhathi ezide. Isibonelo, umgomo othile weFFL ukuthi akukho mfundi okufanele afinyelele ngaphansi kuka-50% ekuhlolweni kokufunda nokubala. Ukuze kufezwe lo mgomo, kufanele kube khona uhlelo lokuhlola oluqhubekayo nolokulandela. Lolu hlelo luzophothulwa ngokuqhuba ukuhlolwa kwezinga lesizwe ukuze kuhlolwe umthelela womkhankaso ka-2011. Ukukhiqiza ulwazi oluthembekile, oluhlanganisiwe olusekelwe ekuhlolweni okujwayelekile ukuze lusetshenziswe izikole, izifunda, nezifunda ukusetha imigomo nokulandela intuthuko yabo ukuze kufezwe ukuthuthukiswa ezinjengokuhlosiwe. Nakuba kunezizathu zendawo zokuhlola ezifanayo, kukhona umehluko omkhulu ezinhlotsheni nasezingeni zokuhlola ezwenziwa futhi ziphathwa yisikole ngasinye. Ukuhlinzeka izikole ngezibonelo zamathuluzi okuhlola njengokubalulekile. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikoleni ezisazothola amazinga afanele okufunda nokufundisa. Ukusiza othisha ekwakheni amathuluzi abo okuhlola aphezulu ezingeni lesikole. Ukuqeqeshwa nokuxoxisana okwengeziwe nothisha kuqhubeka kugcizelela ukuhlola njengendawo enzima ebhekene nokwenziwa kweNCS. Ukuhlolwa kwonyaka kuzoba nesandla ekuxazululeni le nkinga ngokusebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene nezicwangcisi zokuhlola amakhono ahlukahlukene. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi ezifundeni ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele noma/ukuhlanganyela ezikoleni ezimibandela ehlukene nasezingeni ezihlukene zokusebenza. Ukuhlolwa kwonyaka akufanele kusetshenziswe njengesisekelo sokuphakamisa abafundi; nokho, izikole zikhululekile ukusebenzisa ukuhlola njengengxenye yemisebenzi yokuhlola esemthethweni echazwe kuGazethi yoHulumeni 29626. Inqubomgomo yokuhlola okuqhubekayo nokuthi izinqumo kufanele zenziwe kanjani mayelana nokuhamba kwabafundi, njengoba kuchazwe kwiNqubomgomo Yezwe Yokuhlola Nezinga Elincane Ezikoleni kuMkhakha Wokufunda Nokuthuthukiswa, kusala kufana. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwonyaka akuzosetshenziswa ukwahlulela izikole noma/okanye othisha. Kunalokho, kuhlose ukusiza othisha nezifunda ekulandeleni isivinini sokuthuthukiswa kwamazinga kanye nezinga lemiphumela yokufunda. Lokhu kuhlola ngeke kuthinte noma yiziphi izinqumo ezihlobene nezinhlelo zokusebenza zothisha. Othisha kufanele babone izinzuzo zokuhlola njengezinsiza zokuhlola ukuze bathuthukise izicwangciso zabo zokufundisa nokusebenza kwabafundi ekufundeni, ekubhaleni, nasekubaleni. Ukuhlolwa kwonyaka kuzokwenziwa kubo bonke abafundi ukusuka kuGrade 1 kuya kuGrade 6 ezindaweni ezimbili zokufunda noma izifundo, okungukuthi, Ukufunda/Izilimi kanye Nokubala/Izibalo. Umgomo wakho uwukusiza wonke umfundi ukuthuthukisa imiphumela yabo yokufunda. UMnyango Wezemfundo (DoE) uhlinzeke ngesakhiwo sokuhlola ukufunda ezigabeni zeSisekelo neziPhakathi zeZindawo Zokufunda/Izilimi kanye Nokubala/Izibalo. Lesi Sakhiwo Sokuhlola sihlanganisa "izinyathelo" ezibalulekile ezisebenza njengesiqondiso sothisha ukuze bahlanganise ulwazi oluyisisekelo namakhono abafundi abadinga ukuwathola ezingeni ngalinye lesigaba unyaka wesikole. Ukuhlola kuzohambisana nezinyathelo futhi kugxile ekuhloleni amakhono ayinhloko okufunda nokubala. Kubalulekile ukuqhakambisa ukuthi kokubili izinyathelo kanye nokuhlola akuzona izinto ezengeziwe kulokho okuhlanganiswe yiNCS, kodwa kuhlose ukugxila ekucaciseni amakhono abalulekile nasekulungiseleleni izingane ukufunda kabanzi kuFunda/Izilimi kanye Nokubala/Izibalo. Isethi yokuqala yamathuluzi okuhlola kuFunda kanye Nokubala/Izibalo yathuthukiswa ngonyaka ka-2008, futhi konke lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngaphezulu ngesikhathi sokugcina somkhankaso. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iDoE izohlinzeka ngezibonelo zezikhungo zokwenza ukuhlola ezindaweni zokufunda ezahlukene. Ekugcineni, ukuthuthukiswa kufanele kwenzeke ezikoleni nasezifundeni. Izikole zikhululekile ukuhlinzekwa ngesakhiwo sokuhl
Sithole kahle, kodwa kusekhona okuningi okumele kwenziwe, njengokwandisa inani lezinkantolo nokuthuthukisa ezikhona ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhanjiswa kobulungiswa emiphakathini. Saqala ngezinkantolo ezincane futhi saziwandisa ukuze nalabo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma emadolobheni bakwazi ukufinyelela ubulungiswa ngokuphelele. Phambilini, abantu bekumele bahambe izikhawu ezinde ukuya emadolobheni noma ezindaweni ezinkulu ukuze bafinyelele izinsizakalo zikahulumeni ezifana nezinkokhelo zomphakathi nezinkantolo eziphathelene nodlame lwezindlu. Omunye wemisebenzi eqalwe kulo nyaka ukuhlinzeka ngempendulo kumkhankaso wezinkantolo, okuvumela ukuthi amacala azwakale ngolimi lwakubo. Ngokuvamile, amacala manje asethwa ngesiZulu, isiXhosa, isiTswana, nesiBhunu emiphakathini ekhuluma lawa malimi kuphela. Lokhu kube usizo olukhulu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini eyayinzima ukuqonda kahle lapho amacala axoxwa. I-Justice Today ilandele lo hlelo, ichaza ukuthi kungani kubalulekile kanye nemiphumela ezokwenza. Lezi zinkantolo eziyi-24 zizohlinzeka ngazo zonke izinsizakalo ezidingekayo, okusho ukuthi izinsizakalo zobulungiswa manje sezisondelene nezindlu zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ezikwazi ukuzimela. NgokweNgqongqoshe yezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo, u-Enver Surty, lesi sinyathelo sizokuqinisekisa ukuthi indlela abantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, abafinyelela ngayo izinsizakalo zobulungiswa ithuthukiswa. Lokhu kuhlelwa kabusha kusho ukuthi lezi zinkantolo eziyi-24 zizoguqulwa zibe izinkantolo eziphelele; zizobhekana nezindaba ezifana nokuhlukaniswa, ukwesekwa kwezingane, kanye nezinkinga zodlame lwezindlu ezisaphambili. Ekukhulumeni eNkantolo Ephakeme eBloemfontein ngonyaka owedlule, uNgqongqoshe uSurty uthe lezi zinkantolo ezihlelwe kabusha zizokwenza kube lula kakhulu kwabantu besifazane ngoba manje bazokwazi ukufinyelela izinkokhelo zabo zokwesekwa kwezingane eduze kwendawo abahlala kuyo. Sebenzisa umphakathi wase-Alexandra njengomfanekiso, uNgqongqoshe uchaze ukuthi le mpucuko enkulu bekumele ihambe ibanga elide ukuya eRandburg ukuze ifinyelele izinsizakalo zezakhamuzi. Ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo olusha olwakhiwe, manje bazokwazi ukusebenzisa inkantolo yase-Alexandra ukuze bafinyelele lezi zinsizakalo. Akukaze kube sekuyimfihlo ukuthi kwezinye izindawo, ukuhamba ukusuka ezindaweni zokuhlala ukuya emadolobheni lapho lezi zinkantolo zikhona kuyinkinga enkulu, okusho ukuthi abantu abaningi babhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu ukuze bafinyelele lezi zinsizakalo zomphakathi. Isibonelo, abahlali baseDeben eningizimu naseKapa kufanele bahambe ibanga elingu-11 kilometers ukuze bafike ePostmasburg, kanti labo abavela eBolotwa bahamba ibanga elingu-65 kilometers ukuze bafike eLady Frere. Ngakho-ke, ngalolu suku olwenziwe, kulindeleke ukuthi izinkinga ezinjalo zibe yinto yedlule. Ingxenye yemiphumela yale nyathelo ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izinsizakalo zezakhamuzi ngokwandisa zonke izinsizakalo ezinkantolo zendawo. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinsiza ezihlinzekwa emiphakathini. Umbono weMnyango uthi izinkantolo kufanele zisetshenziswe eduze nemiphakathi esanda kuvela. Izinkantolo zendawo zakhiwe ukuze zibhekane kuphela nezindaba zodlame lwezindlu. Ukusungulwa kwalezi zinkantolo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokuhlala, kwaveza umbono wokuthi udlame lwezindlu lukhona kuphela ezindaweni zokuhlala. Izinkantolo zesikhashana nazo zisebenze ngendlela efanayo. Njengoba lezi zinkantolo zazingakhelwanga ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zomphakathi ezinjengokwesekwa kwezingane nodlame lwezindlu, kwasho ukuthi usizo lokuqala alukhona kalula kulabo abaluqondile kakhulu. Abahlali bezindawo zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokuhlala bahamba ibanga elide ukuze bathole ukwesekwa kwezingane. Ngesikhathi senziwa amalungiselelo okudlulisela lezi zinsizakalo, kuzobhekwa ukuthi umsebenzi ezinkantolo zendawo ngayinye ungatholakala yini ngaphambi kokuthi lezi zinkantolo zisetshenziswe njengezinkantolo eziphelele. Ngo-2005, i-Twelfth Amendment to the Constitution yashicilelwa ukuze kuqedwe imingcele yokuhlangana, ikakhulukazi lapho imingcele ethile ihlangana nedolobha elithile. Kusukela lapho, imingcele yaqhubeka ihlukaniswa ukuze kusungulwe amamunicipality angu-187 akhona. Umkhulumeli kaNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa, uZolile Nqayi, uthe iMthethosisekelo kulindeleke ukuthi ibikwe ePhalamende ekuqaleni konyaka, njengoba iphelile ngo-2009. Nokho, le Mthethosisekelo, eyapheliswa nguPhalamende, ayisekelwa yizivumelwano ezidingekayo mayelana nezwe nemithetho ephathelene nezingane ezisemthethweni iNingizimu Afrika eyasayinile. Sekudlule isikhathi sokukhathazeka ukuthi imithetho ebhekana nobugebengu ayivumeli uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngenye indlela yokuhlala ngaphandle kokuboshwa. Akukho okunye okukhona - izingane zinikezwa izigwebo zentolongo noma izigwebo ezimisiwe. Zilethwa enkantolo njengabantu abadala, zidlula kuyo yonke imikhuba emibi nezinkinga zabantu abajolise, kuhlanganise nokuhlangana nabantu ababi. Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yale Mthethosisekelo ukuhamba okungafani kwemibono kanye nohlelo lwezobulungiswa mayelana namacala athile afanele. Okukhethekile ukuthi noma yisiphi ingane eyenza icala ingagwetshwa ukuba iboshwe kodwa ivunyelwe ukuba ibuyele emphakathini, ibanike ithuba lokufuna ukuvuselelwa, okubalulekile enganeni nasemphakathini jikelele. IMnyango iqinisekisile ukuthi kukhona izinsiza ezanele kulezi zindawo, okwenze iMnyango wezobuLungiswa kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo (DoJ&CD) ilungele ukuqhuba uhlelo olungaboshwa. Abaphula umthetho bazibona benesibopho samacala abawenzile, njengoba benza uma beqeda izigwebo zabo entolongweni. "Ngo-1994, sasiseduze neMpi Yezwe. Manje singadlala igalofu ndawonye. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba thina, njengombuso, sanquma ukuthi ngeke sikhethe indlela yempi," kuchaza uNgqongqoshe uDe Lange. KuNgqongqoshe wami, osephumile eminyakeni engu-15 njengomngane, ngithi masisebenze ndawonye. Ungumuntu omangalisayo. Sinethamsanqa ukuthi ukhethwe. Ulethe umusa kulolu work ngendlela abahlanganyela ngayo nabo bonke abathintekayo, kuchaza uNgqongqoshe uDe Lange. Sifuna ukumthankatha ngokuthonya okukhulu akwenze emndenini wezobulungiswa, eqhubeka nokusekela uNgqongqoshe, owamukelwa ngababukeli, okubandakanya osomabhizinisi bezobulungiswa, osomabhizinisi bezohwebo, kanye namalungu eMnyango wezobuLungiswa abebekhona. UNgqongqoshe uDe Lange wakhuthaza futhi wakhumbula abahluleli nabamagistrate abebekhona kulolu suku lwegalofu. "Kulabo bahluleli,
Nokho, ngithanda futhi ukugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubuyekezwa kwesu lesigaba okwenziwe ngoNovemba, lapho abaphathi abaphezulu behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga ezihlobene nokusebenza. Isigaba siqinisekisile izakhiwo eziningi zokuhlinzeka ngokomthetho ezivikela futhi zikhuthaze abesifazane. Uhlelo luhlola ukuthi iMthetho Wokwamukela Imishado Yendabuko u-120 ka-1998 uthuthukise kanjani impilo yabesifazane emishadweni yendabuko. I-Charta Yezisulu inamalungelo ayisixhenxe athinta abantu abaye baba yizisulu zobugebengu. Kubalulekile ukwazi la malungelo ukuze ukwazi ukuwabelana nabangane, kuzala, kanye namalungu omphakathi. Kwakuyonyaka omude, futhi abantu abaningi bathatha ikhefu. Ngiyethemba uzoba nesikhathi sokuphumula esithule. Hamba ngokuphepha. Masihlangane futhi kuNyaka Omusha. Ekhulumela emcimbini wokudla kwesigcawu, uMphakathi Ophakeme, uSandile Ngcobo, wazisa abamele ukuthi indima yeNhlangano Yokuphathwa Kwezikhalazo Entsha yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomthetho ezisezingeni eliphezulu kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika. UMphakathi Ophakeme wabonga abahleli bomcimbi ngokumema yena ukuba wabelane ngombono wakhe ngohlelo lwezinkantolo olusebenza kahle kakhulu. Wathi, "Umsebenzi wami emkhakheni wezobulungiswa ungitholele ithuba lokubheka izinkantolo nokuthi singathuthukisa kanjani ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo zethu zezinkantolo." Waphawula ukuthi wamemelwa nguMongameli uZuma ePhalamende ukuze amukele isikhundla sakhe esisha sokuba uMphakathi Ophakeme. UMphakathi Ophakeme wabelane ngombono wakhe ngekusasa lezinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika. Wachaza, "Namuhla ngithanda ukukwazisa ngombono wami ngohlelo lwezinkantolo lwesikhathi esizayo. Ngine mbono yohlelo lwezobulungiswa oluqinile, oluphila, olusebenza kahle, noluzimele. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkantolo zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Ngokwehlukile kumakhasimende ebhizinisi, amakhasimende ezinsizakalo zethu zezinkantolo awanendawo yokuphendukela. Abampofu bathembele kuHlelo Lwezobulungiswa Ukuze baphumelele ekutholeni ubulungiswa njengoba kungekho enye inhlangano engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi kubo. Okwamanje, kumele sizame ukugcina ukugxila ekusebenzeni kwamakhasimende. Kumele uqale ukubonisa indlela efanele yokuphatha izinkantolo." Ekhulumeni kwakhe okubalulekile, uNgqongqoshe uJeff Radebe wamukela uMphakathi Ophakeme futhi wagcizelela ukwesekwa kwesigaba kwiNhlangano Yokuphathwa Kwezikhalazo Entsha. Waqinisekisa uMphakathi Ophakeme ngenkxaso yesigaba emsebenzini wakhe njengomphakathi ophakeme. Ekwethuleni umbono wakhe wesu lesigaba, uNgqongqoshe uRadebe wathi isigaba manje sesiyinhlangano ehamba phambili yeHlelo Lwezobulungiswa, Ukuvimbela Ubugebengu, kanye neSikhungo Sokuphepha. Wathi, "Lokhu kusho umsebenzi owengeziwe kuNgqongqoshe nasemnyangweni. Manje sibhekene nomsebenzi wokuhola lesi sikhungo ukuze sifeze umgomo waso." UNgqongqoshe ukhuthaze abaphathi ukuba bafune izindlela ezithile zokwenza ukuthi isigaba siqinisekise ukuthi lesi sikhungo sisebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Kwamanye amahlandla, isigaba sithole umbiko ngokuqhuba izitatimende zezimali kusuka ehhovisi le-Auditor General. Ekukhulumeni ngalolu daba, uNgqongqoshe ukhuthaze abaphathi ukuba baphakamise uhlelo lokuphathwa kwezimali ngesigaba. "Sidinga uhlelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ngonyaka ozayo sithola isitatimende sezezimali esihlongozwayo esizoholela ekuhlolweni okuhlanzekile," kusho uNgqongqoshe uRadebe. NgokukaNgqongqoshe, isakhiwo sesigaba sidinga ukubuyekezwa. "Isigaba sibizwa ngokuthi uBulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KweMthethosisekelo. Sihlale sizwa ngengxenye yobulungiswa kodwa asizwanga ngengxenye yokuthuthukiswa komthethosisekelo. Isisekelo sedemokhrasi yethu nguMthethosisekelo wethu. Uma singekho isakhiwo esifanele sokuthuthukisa uMthethosisekelo wethu, ngicabanga ukuthi asiqhubele phambili emsebenzini ophusile kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika." UNgqongqoshe ubeke inselelo kubaphathi ukuba baphakamise uhlelo oluzokwazisa ingxenye yokuthuthukiswa komthethosisekelo yesigaba. UNgqongqoshe uphinde wagcizelela ukuzibophezela kuk governo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibamba iFIFA World Cup yokuqala emhlabeni wase-Afrika ngempumelelo nangokuziphatha. Isigaba sithole umsebenzi wokwenza ukuthi kube nezindlela ezifanele zokuphatha nokusebenza kweHlelo Elihlanganisiwe Lwezobulungiswa ukuze kubhekwe noma yiziphi izinkinga zomthetho ezivela ngesikhathi somcimbi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukwesekwa kwezinhlangano ezithuthukisa umthetho ekuphatheni kahle, ngendlela efanele, nangokuphuthumayo ngezinkinga zokuphathwa kobulungiswa. UNgqongqoshe uveze ukukhathazeka ngensizakalo yeHhovisi leMaster. "Sidinga ukubheka ukuthi iHhovisi leMaster lisebenza kanjani nokuthi lisiza kanjani abantu bethu. Sidinga ukulungisa okukhulu kwehhovisi." Wabe esecela abaphathi ukuba babe nohlelo lokuthi bazohlela kanjani ukuhlela ihhovisi ukuze lisebenze kahle nangempumelelo. IKomidi LeziNhlangano Zokwethembeka eNingizimu Afrika lasungulwa nguHulumeni weZizwe Zobumbano ukuze lisize ekubhekaneni nezimo ezazenzeka ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Ukungqubuzana ngaleso sikhathi kuholele ekuhlukunyezweni nasekwephulweni kwamalungelo abantu kuzo zonke izinhlangothi. Le komidi inefundisi ebhekiswe ekusizeni izisulu zohlelo lwe-apartheid. Le fundisi ayihloselwe ukwandisa amabhange. Ihloselwe ukusiza izisulu ze-apartheid. Ngakho-ke, kumele sithole uhlelo oluqinisekisa ukuthi imali isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kusho uNgqongqoshe uRadebe. Ekuphetheni, uNgqongqoshe ufisela abaphathi inhlanhla kulomcimbi wezinsuku ezimbili futhi ukhuthaze ukuba basebenze ndawonye ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banokufinyelela kalula kobulungiswa. "Ngalezi zindaba zonke, ngikholelwa ukuthi uma kwenziwa kahle, sizokwazi ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kobulungiswa kubantu bethu bonke." Umcimbi waxoxa ngezindlela zokwenza ukuthi izinhloso zesigaba zifezeke kahle nangempumelelo. Izinhlelo zaphakanyiswa kanje: UkuPhathwa, UkuSebenza Kwezinkantolo, Izinsizakalo Zomthetho ZikGovernment, Amandla Okuphakanyiswa Kwamazwe, kanye Nezinsizakalo Zokweseka nezisebenzi ezihlobene. Le nhlelo ibhekisela ezindleleni zokuphathwa kwesigaba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kahle nangempumelelo kokuphathwa kwesigaba, kuhlanganise nabasebenzi, izimali, impahla, nezidingo zezakhiwo, izinhlelo zolwazi nolwazi, izinhlelo, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuphathwa kwemigomo, izinhlelo, nezinhlelo. Unikezwa ukwamukela, ukukhipha, nokuhlelwa kabusha kwezinhlelo, ukuhlinzeka ngokuhlukaniswa komhlaba nokuhlanganiswa komhlaba; ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko yomhlaba engafakiwe ezinhlelweni; ukuhlinzeka ngokuhlukaniswa ngezigaba noma ukuhlela kabusha uhlelo olwamukelwe lokuhlukaniswa komhlaba noma intuthuko yomhlaba; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqalwa, ukugcinwa, nokususa kwemikhawulo ethintana nomhlaba; ukusungula imigomo yokuphothulwa okuphakade kwemigwaqo yomphakathi noma izindawo zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngokwamukela nokwazisa ngezinhlelo, ukuhlinzeka ngokukhokha okuhlobene nezindaba ezilawulwa umthetho; ukusungula iKwaZulu-Natal Planning and Development Appeals Board; ukuhlinzeka ngezinga nezindinganiso zokuhlela nokuthuthukisa esifundazweni; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. Umsebenzi wokuthola izilinganiso nezincazelo zobungcweti. Izinqubomgomo ezijwayelekile mayelana nokuphothulwa kwemigwaqo yomphakathi noma izindawo zomphakathi ziyadingeka ukuze kutholwe izilinganiso nezincazelo zobungcweti ezihlobene! Imali yokubuyiselwa ethintwa ukuphulwa kwemithetho kanye nezinyathelo ezizenzakalelayo noma ezingenabungozi zokuphatha iziqondiso zokuphuthumayo ukuvimbela inani lokubuyiselwa! Isicelo sokufaka isikhalazo sesidlulile. Amacala ahlobene nokuphuma phambi kweBhodi Yokufaka Izikhalazo! Umgibeli weBhodi Yokufaka Izikhalazo! Ukufaka izicelo zokuhlelwa kabusha kwezinhlelo zomphakathi, ukuhlukaniswa komhlaba noma ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba kanye nentuthuko yomhlaba ngaphandle kwendawo yohlelo, kanye nokuhlelwa kabusha, ukusungulwa, noma ukususwa kwemvume ethintana nomhlaba. Ilungelo lesicelo lokuphendula ku-O. Umthetho Wokuhlela Intuthuko ubonisa umthetho wokuhlela intuthuko, uMthetho No. 1995. UMdabuli Mhiaba ubonisa umuntu obhaliswe njengomhloli womhlaba ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wabahloli Bomhlaba ka-1984 uMthetho No. umnikazi ubonisa umnikazi obhalisiwe bomhlaba njengoba kuphakanyiswa esigabeni 102 soMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwezincwadi futhi kubandakanya umnikazi ongumqashi, idokhumenti yeshadi lesikhumbuzo noma umuntu onelungelo elifanayo kumgibeli wezincwadi zeshadi lesikhumbuzo, kodwa akuhlanganisi ilungelo noma inzuzo yomqashi, ukuqasha abasebenzi noma ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkontileka; noma ukusungula imigomo ejwayelekile yokulalela! Inhloso yohlelo ukuhlela ukusetshenziswa komhlaba nokukhuthaza izinhlelo zentuthuko ezihambisana nohlelo lwemunicipality oluhlobene nentuthuko. I-municipality kufanele, ngaphakathi kweminyaka emihlanu kusukela ekuqaleni kwalolu mthetho, yamukele uhlelo noma izinhlelo ezisemthethweni ezisebenzayo endaweni yonke, ngaphandle kokuthi ilungu lekhansela elibhekelela ukwandiswa kwesikhathi. I-municipality ingafaka isicelo kulowo mlungu wekhansela ophatha isikhathi sokwandisa ukuze yamukele uhlelo noma izinhlelo ezisemthethweni ezisebenzayo endaweni yonke. kanye neleta ephakamisa ukwandiswa kwesikhathi; futhi sizokhombisa isikhathi esidingekayo sokwandiswa. I-municipality ayikwazi ukwandisa isikhathi sokwamukela uhlelo noma izinhlelo ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kuGazethi. izokhombisa izindawo lapho ukuvunyelwa kwemunicipality kungadingeki ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho ukuze kuhlukaniswe umhlaba noma kuhlanganiswe umhlaba. Uhlelo lusebenza kumunicipality, kubantu bonke, kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni, ngaphandle kwecala lapho kukhona ukungqubuzana nemigomo yohlelo lokuthuthukiswa olwamukelwe ngaphambili noma ukuhlela kabusha kohlelo. Imigomo yohlelo olwamukelwe ngempumelelo iyisicwangciso sokuthuthukiswa esihlanganyelwe, uma kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi kwemigomo yesicwangciso sokuthuthukiswa esihlanganyelwe nohlu. I-municipality noma ezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni azikwazi ukwamukela isicelo sokuhlukaniswa komhlaba noma ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba okungqubuzana nemigomo yohlelo. Isicelo sokuhlukaniswa komhlaba noma ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba okungqubuzana nemigomo yohlelo asilawulwanga. Uhlelo lubuyisela zonke izinhlelo zokuhlela ezisemadolobheni endaweni engena kuyo. Isimo somthetho sokwakhiwa noma isakhiwo esakhiwe ngokomthetho ngaphambi kosuku lokwamukela, ukukhipha, noma ukuhlela kabusha kohlelo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 15 soMthetho Wokuphazamiseka kokwamukela, ukukhipha, noma ukuhlela kabusha kohlelo. Umhlaba owasetshenziswa ngokomthetho ngaphambi kosuku lokuqala kokwamukela, ukukhipha, noma ukuhlela kabusha kohlelo oluphakanyisiwe esigabeni 16, mayelana nenhloso engamukeleki ohlelweni, ungase uqhubeke usetshenziswa ngale njongo. Noma yisiphi ukwandiswa kwezakhiwo noma izakhiwo emhlabeni ophakanyisiwe kuSchemey kufanele kuhambisane nohlu. I-municipality kufanele ibonise uhlelo lwayo phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha ngemuva kokwamukela isicwangciso sokuthuthukiswa esihlanganyelwe sesikhathi esishiwo njengokuhlosiwe esigabeni 15 soMthetho Wokuhlela Kwamadolobha. ukwenza ikhophi yohlelo olukhona itholakale ukuze kuhlonishwe futhi kuqoshwe ngezikhathi ezifanele nganoma yimuphi umuntu. I-municipality ingaqala ukwamukela uhlelo, ukukhipha uhlelo, noma ukuhlela kabusha uhlelo. ngumlandeli womhlaba ozothinteka yohlelo oluhlelwe kabusha, kuhlanganiswe nezinsiza zikahulumeni; kanye nomuntu onemvume ebhalwe phansi evela kumlandeli womhlaba, ozothinteka yohlelo oluhlelwe kabusha. Ukukhala njalo, ukuhamba, ukwenza ezinye izwi, kuphazamisa ukuthula komphakathi noma kuphoxa ozakwethu, kuphula lezi zinhlinzeko zomphakathi uma ukuphazamiseka noma ukuphazamiseka kuqhubeka ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esifanele sokuhlinzekwa esibhalwe phansi nguMphathi Womphakathi noma ummeleli ogunyaziwe, uma sekwamukelwe isikhalazo esibhalwe phansi esisayinwe, sithunyelwe kulowo muntu, sicela ukuthi ukuphazamiseka noma ukuphazamiseka kuze kube sekupheleni; kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi ogunyaziwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphatha KwezeMpi, 1977 (Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977) ungakwenza noma yiziphi izimo lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okufanele kuqedwe ngokushesha, kudlule ekuphakamiseni kwesaziso njengoba kuchazwe lapha futhi uma sibona lezi zinto zikhona thina, sizokhipha isaziso ngokuhambisana nesigaba 341 soMthetho okukhulunywa ngawo ngaphambili kumnikazi waleyo nja noma siqhubeke sithathe izinyathelo zokuqala njengoba kuchazwe kulezi zinhlinzeko zomphakathi. Uma kukhona otholakale enecala lokwephula lo mthetho wesifunda okuphindaphindiwe mayelana naleyo zilwane, kuzoba kufanelekile enkantolo, ethola ukuthi baphula, ukuhlela ukuthi ngaphezu kwanoma yisiphi isijeziso esibekwe, kufanele bakhiphe leyo zilwane ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesifunda 5(a). Uma umnikazi wezindawo engahlali lapho, noma ubani oneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-21 ohlala kulezo zindawo uzobhekwa njengomgibeli waleyo nja kulezo zindawo. Uma kuxoshwa ngaphansi kwalezi zinhlinzeko zomphakathi, kuzoba kufanelekile ukuhlinzeka umnikazi wangempela waleyo nja kungenjalo, xosha umuntu ogcina inja noma obhekwa njengomgibeli waleyo nja. Ekwenzeni okungahambi kahle futhi ngaphandle komnikazi, ingasuswa noma igcinwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesifunda 5(a) noma (b) futhi, uma itholakala iyingozi, ibhite noma iguliswa, ingabulawa ngummeli ogunyaziwe. Ngenxa kokuhlinzekwa kwesigaba (b) lapha, akukho mithetho yasezindaweni ezosetshenziswa ukuze kuhlukaniswe abantu ngokobuhlanga, inkolo, ubulili, noma ukuze kuqinisekiswe leyo hlobo lokuhlukaniswa. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana ezichazweni, izichazamazwi ezihlinzekwa kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996) zizosebenza. "Umthetho" ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1996 Umthetho No. kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1996 Umthetho No. kuMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1996 Umthetho No. Umthetho Wezakhwo Zasemaphandleni, 1998 Umthetho No. ithikithi noma ibhasi lingase lisebenze ithikithi ethile noma ibhasi. noma ibhasi kusho imoto ethutha umphakathi eyenzelwe kuphela noma ikakhulukazi ukuthutha abagibeli abangaphezu kuka-15 esetshenziswa ngokuhambisana nesheduli futhi evunyelwe ukusebenza ezindleleni zomphakathi ezikhishwe yiBhodi Yezokuhamba Kwamazwe endaweni ethile ephelele noma engaphelele ethintwa yiBhodi. Le mithetho yasezindaweni izosebenza kuzo zonke izikhala zamathikithi namabhasi nezikhala, ezibekwe eceleni noma ezizobekwa eceleni yiBhodi ukuze zisetshenziswe njengezikhala zamathikithi noma amabhasi noma izikhala zamathikithi noma amabhasi avunyelwe ukusetshenziswa ngephasiwedi yokusebenza ethunyelwe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho yasezindaweni. Izikhala zamathikithi namabhasi noma izikhala zizoba lezo ezisungulwe ohlelweni oluhlelwe ngokuqondile yiwo ophumelele lowo msebenzi njengoba kuguqulwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Ukubekwa eceleni kwezikhala zamathikithi noma amabhasi nezikhala ukuze zisetshenziswe ngama-taxi namabhasi kuphela kuzokwenziwa futhi kuboniswe ngokuqhakambisa, ngokudweba izimpawu, noma ukufaka kulezo zindawo (noma ngabe kuthiwa kusemgwaqweni womphakathi noma cha), njengoba kunqunywe yiBhodi, izimpawu zomgwaqo ezifanele zifakwe ngokuqondile ngezimiso ezenziwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho. Ibhodi ingachaza izindawo ezithile noma izindawo ezithile, kuzo zonke izikhala ngezizathu noma izizathu ezithile, njengokuthuthukisa noma ukunciphisa abagibeli, indawo yokuma, noma abathengisi abangekho ohlelweni olusemthethweni. Izikhala ezisungulwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 zizosebenza kuphela ngama-taxi noma amabhasi akhangisa ngephasiwedi yokusebenza esemthethweni yalezi zikhala zamathikithi noma amabhasi (kuze kube yilapho le mikhawulo ingasebenzi kumathikithi noma amabhasi, kulokho okukhulwe noma okushintshaniswa futhi kuvunyelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 14). Izikhala ezisungulwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 zizoba ezifana kuzo zonke izithuthi noma amabhasi asebenza kulowo mgwaqo noma abekwe kumphakathi othile, umphakathi, umgwaqo, noma indawo njengoba kuchazwe izimpawu zomgwaqo ezifakwe kulezo zikhala. Ibhodi, ngephasiwedi efakwe esikhala noma eduze kwayo ingabonisa isikhathi esiphezulu esivunyelwe kumathikithi namabhasi ukuhamba kulezi zikhala. Akukho thikithi noma ibhasi elizovunyelwa ukuhamba esikhala samathikithi noma amabhasi isikhathi eside kunesidingo sokulayisha abagibeli. Akukho thikithi noma ibhasi elizovunyelwa ukuhamba ngesikhathi sokusebenza, ngaphandle kokuba esikhala esinikeziwe noma esikhala. Umshayeli wethikithi noma ibhasi ovunyelwe ukusebenzisa isikhala noma isikhala ngaphansi kwale mithetho yasezindaweni ungumuntu kuphela ongakha noma avumele le moto ukuthi isebenzise lesi sikhala noma isikhala nganoma yisiphi isikhathi (kuze kube yilapho le mikhawulo ingasebenzi kumathikithi noma amabhasi, kulokho okukhulwe noma okushintshaniswa futhi kuvunyelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 14). Uzoqhamuka leyo mthetho uma usebenza ithikithi noma ibhasi enikezwe iphasipoti yokusebenzisa isikhala samathikithi noma amabhasi ngaphansi kwale mithetho yasezindaweni, uma ukhona kunoma yisiphi isikhala noma isikhala ngaphandle kwalokho okukhulwe noma okukhulwe okukhethwe kuwe futhi kuchazwe kwi phasipoti yokusebenzisa isikhala esithile samathikithi noma amabhasi. Umshayeli wethikithi noma ibhasi uzoba yilo kuphela ozohlala eqhuba le moto ngenkathi ikulezi zikhala noma izikhala. Noma yisiphi ukulahleka noma umonakalo kunoma iyiphi moto, noma ingxenye yayo noma phakathi, eyayipakishwe noma ihlezi kunoma yisiphi isikhala noma eyayifaka, idlula, noma iphume kunoma yisiphi isikhala noma isikhala. Futhi ukufa, ukulimala, ukungasebenzi, noma ukulahleka (kuhlanganise nokulahleka okuzayo) kumuntu nganoma yisiphi isikhala noma isikhala. Ibhodi izoba nelungelo lokuvula noma ukuvala noma yisiphi isikhala esisunguliwe ngaphansi kwale mithetho futhi, uma kudingeka, inelungelo lokusungula esinye isikhala esiphuthumayo kwenye indawo esikhundleni salo. Ukuvalwa okuphuthumayo nokusungulwa kwenye indawo kuzothathwa njengokunjalo ngemuva kokufakwa kwezaziso lapho noma eduze kwalolo sikhala futhi futhi ngesikhathi sokuvulwa okuphuthumayo noma noma iyiphi iphasipoti yokusebenzisa isikhala samathikithi noma amabhasi eyakhishwa kulolo sikhala esivalwe izobhekwa njengemthethweni yokusebenzisa kulolo sikhala oluzoba esikhundleni sokunye. Akukho amalungelo omuntu onikezwe ukusebenzisa isikhala samathikithi noma amabhasi ngaphansi kwale mithetho azovimba ibhodi ekuthumeleni noma ekukhipheni noma yisiphi isikhala esisunguliwe lapha noma ngenkathi le mithetho iphumelelwe.
