UMkhandlu weBuhlebizwe wamukela lezi ziqondiso zomkhandlu emhlanganweni wawo ngomhla ka-10 kuNdasa 2008 ngokuhambisana nesigaba 156(2) seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) ofundwa ngokuhlanganyela nesigaba 31(2) seMthetho Wokuphatha Kwamakhaya: Umthetho Wamasu Womkhandlu, 1998 (Umthetho No. 117 ka-1998) futhi lapha kukhishwa lezi ziqondiso zomkhandlu ezihlobene ngokuhambisana nesigaba 13(a) seMthetho Wokuphatha Kwamakhaya: Izinhlelo Zomkhandlu, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000) futhi ubulili buhlanganisa womabili amantombazane namadoda futhi ubumbano buhlanganisa ukuhlukahluka kanti ukuhlukahluka kuhlanganisa ubumbano. Imisebenzi yokuthuthukisa isiza ekukhululeni umhlaba. Umphakathi wezindlela noma umphathi osethwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezindlela WaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996) njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 soMthetho Wesevisi Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1995 (Umthetho No. 68 ka-1995) ungumlawuli wezokuthula njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 34 soMthetho Wenkohlakalo, 1977 (Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977). "UMkhandlu" ubonisa iMuniBuhlebizwe noma abalandeli bayo besikhwama, futhi uhlanganisa umkhandlu waleyo muni noma iKomidi Eliphezulu noma noma iyiphi enye inhlangano esunguliwe ngumlomo nomuntu onikezwe amandla emisebenzi yeKomidi Eliphezulu mayelana nalezi ziqondiso zomkhandlu. Umuntu ungumnikazi walezi zindawo ezibhalwe egameni labo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwezinkontileka, 1937 (Umthetho No. 47 ka-1937) futhi umuntu obhaliswe egameni labo ungumqondisi wesitifiketi salo mhlaba ngaphansi koMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwamathikithi, 1986 (Umthetho No. 95 ka-1986) futhi futhi uhlanganisa umnikazi (njengoba kuchazwe kule mthetho), abaphathi bezindawo, kanye nabathuthukisi balo mhlaba. Uma umnikazi ochazwe lapha engasekho eRiphabhulikhi noma engaziwa, igama "umnikazi" lihlanganisa ummeleli walowo mnikazi noma noma iyiphi "iqembu" njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwamathikithi, 1986 (Umthetho No. 95 ka-1986). "Izindawo" zihlanganisa noma iyiphi indawo yomphakathi kanye nomhlaba womnikazi, zonke izakhiwo, amagumbi, izindlu zokuhlala, izikhala, izindlu zokhuni noma ezinye izakhiwo kanye nezindawo noma umhlaba oxhumene nazo futhi kuzohlanganisa noma iyiphi "ingxenye" njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokubhaliswa Kwamathikithi, 1986 (Umthetho No. 95 ka-1986). "Imoto" ibonisa noma iyiphi indlela yokuhamba engakwazi ukuthwala umuntu oyedwa noma abaningi, ngaphandle kokuhamba ngekhanda noma ikhithi efana naleyo esetshenziselwa ukuhamba umuntu onokukhubazeka. noma ukuhlekisa omunye umuntu ukuba enze isono esinjalo. udakiwe noma ngaphansi komthelela wewayini ngendlela yokuthi ngokombono weMlawuli Othunyelwe lowo muntu angase aphelelwe yisithukuthuku noma kuphi lapho lezi ziqondiso zomkhandlu zisebenza khona. udakiwe noma usebenzisa izidakamizwa njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokusebenzisa Izidakamizwa Nokuhweba Ngazo, 1992 (Umthetho No. 140 ka-1992) wenza noma iyiphi into yokuhlukumeza noma ukuziphatha okungamukeleki noma aziphatha ngendlela engafanele. Umuntu wenza isono uma esendleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi futhi ezwakala ngomunye umuntu esebenzisa ulimi oluphikisana noma amagama angcolile noma eculayo ingoma ethile engcolile noma equkethe imibhalo engcolile. Umuntu wenza isono uma esendleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi ephatha ngendlela engafanele ngenhloso yokuthengisa umzimba wakhe noma ukuhlekisa omunye umuntu ukuba enze kanjalo. ngaphandle kokuthi unikezwe amandla noma uvumelekile ngumlomo ukwenza kanjalo noma enze kanjalo ngokuvuma okubhaliwe kweMlawuli Othunyelwe futhi ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe ngabo. ukususa emathangeni anikezwe ukuhamba kwemfucumfucu noma noma iyiphi enye ibhagi yokuphuma kwemfucumfucu nokwenza kube khona ukususwa kwalokho. Umuntu ophikisa noma uhlekisa omunye umuntu ukuba enze noma iyiphi imisebenzi echazwe esigabeni (1) uzotholakala enecala. Noma iyiphi impahla eyashiywa ngumuntu noma evunyelwe ukuba yehliswe izothathwa njengokuthi iphume kulowo muntu ngokuhambisana nesigaba (1)(a). Noma iyiphi impahla noma into etholakale endleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi evusa ukungabaza kokuthi isono senziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba (1)(a) futhi inegama lomuntu noma inezinkomba eziqinile zokuthi iyakhe noma iphethwe ngabo ngaphansi kwesigaba (1)(a) izothathwa njengokuthi iphume kuze kube kubeqinisekiswa okuphambene. Umuntu ophosa imfucumfucu noma ephuma kwemfucumfucu nganoma iyiphi indlela endleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi uzothathwa njengokuthi uphosa imfucumfucu ngokuhambisana nesigaba (1)(a). Umuntu obonwa nguMlawuli Othunyelwe ephula izinhlinzeko zesigaba (1)(a) noma (b) uzothunyelwa ukuba asuse le mfucumfucu, le mpahla noma le nto noma ukuyibeka emathangeni anikezwe uMkhandlu futhi uma engakwenzi lokho uzoboshwa. Abahlali bezindawo ezichazwe esigabeni (3) noma izindawo lapho noma iyiphi ibhizinisi, umsebenzi noma ukuhweba kwenziwa kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi ngaso sonke isikhathi imisebenzi eyenziwa lapho ingaba ibhizinisi noma lezi zindawo zivuliwe ukuze zibhiziniswe noma zibe nebhizinisi ngesikhathi sokusebenza, kungakhathalekile noma yini ethintana nakho, bagcine indlela eduze kwendlela noma indlela exhumene nalezi zindawo, kuhlanganise nezindawo zokulima ngaphandle kwemfucumfucu futhi bagcine lokhu kukhanya futhi kulungile okusho ukususa yonke imfucumfucu lapho. Umhlali okukhulunywa ngaye esigabeni (1) kufanele aqinisekise ukususwa kwemfucumfucu yonke ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba ukuze ibekwe emathangeni anikezwe uMkhandlu noma ngomyalo obhaliwe weMlawuli Othunyelwe, iphume ngendlela evunyelwe ngabo ukuze imfucumfucu yonke isuswe ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba ibekwe emathangeni anikezwe uMkhandlu noma ngovuma okubhaliwe kweMlawuli Othunyelwe, iphume ngendlela evunyelwe ngabo. Ngokwalesi sigaba igama "ibhizinisi" linencazelo enikezwe nguMthetho Wokuphepha Nokuphila, 1993 kanye nezinhlinzeko ezenziwe ngaphansi kwawo. ukushiya noma yini engabhekiwe, kufanele kube lowo obeke khona bese kuba yisithiyo kubantu noma ezimotweni njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezindlela WaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996) noma kukhinyabeza uphawu lwendlela njengoba kuchazwe koMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezindlela WaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 (Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996). Uma kukhona okushiywe endleleni noma endaweni yomphakathi ngokuphikisana nesigaba 2.3.1(a), uMlawuli O
Ubani ozothola inzuzo kulolu bhukwana? Lolu bhukwana lunikeza uhlaka lokuthuthukisa amakhono abantu abathintekayo ohlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo (LED) emkhandlwini wase-AbaQulusi ngaphansi kweSifunda saseZululand ePhikweni laseKwaZulu-Natal (KZN). Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kubalulekile njengendlela yokuxhasa ukubambisana okuphumelelayo, ukuhlela, nokuphumelelisa uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo (LED) oluzoholela ekukhuleni komnotho okulinganiselwe nokusimeme e-AbaQulusi. Kulolu bhukwana, siphakamisa ukuthi kube nohlelo oluhleleka kahle lwezokusebenza olunemikhakha emine ukuze kuqinisekiswe umnotho wendawo e-AbaQulusi. Le ndlela ibandakanya ukusungulwa kwe-Provincial Project Management Unit (PMU), ehlanganisa ochwepheshe bokuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo isikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lukaNovemba 2011. I-PMU izosungula izinhlelo zesikhashana zokuxhasa i-LED, njengegatsha elibhekele ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa komnotho kwesikhathi eside okubandakanya ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, ukuthuthukiswa kwezimali, ucwaningo, ukuqapha, nokuhlola. Ngokudlulisela amakhono afanele nezinsiza kuMphakathi phakathi neminyaka emithathu yokwethulwa, umphakathi uzoba nekhono elanele lokuthuthukisa amasu okuthuthukiswa komnotho esikhathini esizayo. Kulindeleke ukuthi leli hlelo lihlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlala isikhathi eside kanye nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle okudingekayo ukuze kuphathwe ngempumelelo umnotho wendawo esikhathini esizayo. Lolu bhukwana lusekelwe embikweni oqoqwe ochwepheshe bokuthuthukiswa komnotho base-KZN, osekelwe yi-European Union egxile kumandla omnotho wendawo eVryheid (umkhandlu wase-AbaQulusi). Imiphumela yocwaningo ibisekelwe ekuhloleni izincwadi, ukufuna ku-inthanethi, ukuxhumana nabathintekayo ngocingo, izingxoxo zamehlo, izingxoxo ezihlelwe, ukudluliswa kwehlaka lemiphumela; kanye nokuphothulwa kwemibhalo equkethe imibono yabathintekayo. Abahlinzeki bolwazi ababalulekile esifundazweni baphinde babuzwa imibuzo ukuze kuthuthukiswe indlela efanele yesikhashana ye-PMU, okuyona ezothuthukisa amasu okusebenza kwesikhathi eside. Isinqumo esivumelekile sathathwa mayelana noHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe (IDP) lweMphakathi WaseVryheid kanye neSikhala Sokuthuthukiswa (SDF). Lolu bhukwana luhlaziya indlela yokuzinzisa umnotho wendawo e-AbaQulusi, ophoqelelwe. Uhlaka lwenziwa ngamasu akhombisa ukuthi i-LED ingaqalwa kanjani ngendlela ehlelekile nephumelelayo. Sikholelwa ukuthi kubalulekile kubo bonke abathintekayo be-LED ukuba babe nolwazi olunembile mayelana nokubaluleka kwezixhumanisi zokuxhumana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene zohlelo lwe-LED. Izimpilo zabantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya e-AbaQulusi zihlukaniswa yindlela yokuhamba kwabantu beshiya izindawo zasemakhaya ukuze basebenze emadolobheni, ukungabi khona kwezidingo eziyisisekelo nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanye nenani elikhulu labantu abangakaze bafundiswe. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nokuthuthukiswa kweMphakathi Wase-AbaQulusi, kubalulekile ukubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona ezidingweni zabahlali basemakhaya nabasemadolobheni ngokuqhamuka nezinhlelo ezizokhomba amathuba kubahlali basemakhaya. Isithombe sabahlali basemadolobheni sikhombisa ithemba kulandela amathuba akhona emkhakheni wezokumbiwa kwemalahle. Nokho, ukwehla kwemigodi yemalahle eminyakeni edlule kubeke umnotho engcupheni. Izinhlelo zokungenelela zisungulwa ukuze ziphinde ziqinise ezinye izinkalo zomnotho ukuze kudaleke amathuba emisebenzi nokukhuliswa kwemali. Le ngenelelo yokuguqula ilindeleke ukuthi ikhuthaze Ukuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo futhi idinga ubuholi obukhethekile obugxile ekwakheni isimo esizovumela umphakathi wendawo ukuba ube yisikhungo seZululand esifundeni saseKwaZulu-Natal. Izithombe zokuhlala kwabantu nezindawo zokusebenza endleleni ehlanganisa iMondlo-Vryheid-Hlobane-Coronation-Nyathi-Louwsberg ziveza bobabili ubunzima namathuba okukhomba izinhlelo zokungenelela eziguqulayo. Ukuqhamuka kombono wokuthi i-AbaQulusi ibe yisikhungo esiyinhloko sesifunda kuzodinga imiklamo eqinile nephumelelayo. Amasu akhethiweyo adinga okulandelayo: izinsiza zezezimali zokuthuthukisa konke okudingekayo kokwakhiwa nokwesekwa kwezobuchwepheshe; isikhathi esicacile nesithembekile sokuhlela nezinhlinzeko zokubhekwa; ukuziphendulela kokubika; nokuthi ubani ozothola inzuzo kulolu bhukwana? Lolu bhukwana luhloselwe ukwabelana ngolwazi olufanele nabantu abaningi abasebenza ku-LED nabathintekayo abahileleke e-AbaQulusi. Lolu lwazi luwusizo kakhulu kubasebenzi abasebenzela uhulumeni wendawo eVryheid. Kuzoba usizo nakubani osebenza emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nezomnotho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abasebenzi bakamasipala, abezwe, nabasendaweni, abaxhasi bendawo nabangaphandle, abahlanganyeli bezamabhizinisi, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukamasipala (NGOs). Umphakathi wendawo (Vryheid) ungumkhandlu ohlanganisiwe wokuthuthukiswa obhekane nezinkinga zokuphatha, okuthinteke emandleni awo okwenza imisebenzi yawo yomthetho. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga zokuphatha, umphakathi ukwazi ukwenza ukuhlolwa okufanele koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe (IDP) kanye neSikhala Sokuthuthukiswa (SDF). Ubuye waphinde waqoka ukuthuthukiswa kwamasu okuthuthukiswa komnotho wendawo. Ukwehla kwezinkalo zezimboni. Ukuntuleka kwamakhono ayisisekelo nezomnotho. Emkhakheni wesifunda, iZululand District Municipality (ZDM) isungule i-LED Unit ukuze ixhase amabhizinisi kuwo wonke amakhaya asezindaweni eziphansi ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwayo. Le ndawo isebenza ngokubambisana namakhaya asezindaweni eziphansi futhi inikeza uhlaka olubanzi lokuxhasa amabhizinisi emkhakheni wombuso. Ukuhlela kuhlanganyela nge-IDP phakathi kweZululand District Municipality kanye ne-AbaQulusi Municipality kusetshenziswa iPlanning Forum esunguliwe yiZululand District Municipality (ZDM). Le Forum ihlangana kabili ngenyanga futhi igxile ekuhleleni ngokuhola izindaba zamasu okusebenza, izinhlelo, nezinhlelo. Nokho, nakuba iForum isebenza, ukudluliswa kolwazi kuvame ukuphazamiseka ngenxa yezinkinga ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Kulindeleke ukuthi iProject Management Unit esanda kusungulwa, engaphansi kweSikhungo Sokuhlela Nokuxhumana se-AbaQulusi Municipality, iqale uhlelo lokuxhumana nokuphathwa okubhekana nezinkinga zokuxhumana okuphumelelayo phakathi kweZululand District Municipality kanye nayo. Ngaphansi kwe-LED, kunezinhlangano ezahlukene ezisebenza ngaphansi kwe-AbaQulusi, nakuba zikhululekile futhi zihambisana nezinqubo zazo eziyisisekelo. Ayikho inhlangano yebhizinisi egcwele emkhakheni wombuso. Inselelo enkulu kumphakathi ukuthi awunawo amandla anele ngaphakathi
Ihhovisi leMenenja yeMuni liphatha ngokubambisana neHhovisi leMeya kanye neHhovisi leSpeaker ukuze kulawulwe Izinhlelo Ezikhethekile. Lezi zihloko ezilandelayo zikhombisa isimo esingashintshi mayelana nokuphumeleliswa kwezinhlelo ezikhethekile. Le hhovisi iphinde ibhekele izinkinga zokuxhumana zomphakathi, okuyingxenye entsha eyasungulwa ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2006/7. Izindawo ezibalulekile zokugxila kule ngxenye zizoba ukuthuthukisa ukuxhumana phakathi kweBhodi, abathintekayo, nomphakathi. Idivayisi ye-Internal Financial Audit kanye ne-IDP/PMS ibhekwa ngqo yiHhovisi leMenenja yeMuni. Ngokufanayo, i-divisi yeM youths isunguliwe futhi ifakwe kule mnyango. Kubalulekile futhi ukukhumbula ukuthi zonke lezi zindawo ezingenhla nemisebenzi yazo zingaphansi kweMnyango Wezokusebenza njengoba kushiwo kuMqulu Wezokwakha, kodwa ngenxa yokungabi nesikhala sokuba uMphathi weMnyango, uMenenja weMuni ubhekele le Mnyango kuze kube isikhala sigcwaliswa. Ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo, iSisonke District Municipality iyaziqhenya ngokuba nezakhiwo ze-Intergovernmental Relations (IGR) ezihanjiswa ngempumelelo nezisebenzayo. Izakhiwo ze-IGR azikakabi zisebenza ngokuphelele eSisonke District Municipality. Kukho ukungabi nosizo oluvela kubasekeli, okwenza kube nokushoda kwezinsiza zezimali ukuze kusekelwe lezi zakhiwo. I-HIV/AIDS nezinkinga ezihlobene ne-AIDS zikhona emhlabeni jikelele, futhi izibalo zikhombisa kahle ukuthi e-republic, KwaZulu Natal iyisifunda esinabantu abaningi abathintekile futhi abathintekayo yi-HIV virus kanye ne-AIDS uqobo, futhi iSisonke District Municipality ayiyona eyokuhlukile. I-Sisonke District Municipality isiqalile ukuthatha izinyathelo ezisheshayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi leli zinga lokutheleleka elikhathazayo ligcinwa phansi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni, ama-CBO, izinsizakalo ezingekho kuhulumeni, nezinye izinhlangano kanye nezithakazelo. Lokhu kubambisana kuhlose ukusungula ngokusemthethweni iHhovisi leHIV/AIDS eliphelele lesifunda. Le Ndlu izoba yisakhiwo esihola izindaba ezihlobene ne-HIV/AIDS kanye ne-AIDS uqobo. Okwamanje, iMuni isebenza nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ukuze ihlele umkhankaso wokwazisa ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iMuni izobamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokusekela abantu abaphila ne-HIV/AIDS ngokwakha amaqembu okusekela, njengoba iMuni inezidingo eziningi ezivela emphakathini. Kuphinde kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bemuni bangase bathinteke nalesi sifo, yingakho inhloso iwukuba ne-divisi yezinhlelo ezikhethekile ezizogxila kulezi zindaba. I-Sisonke District Municipality iyimuni enezindawo eziningi ezisemakhaya enezinga eliphezulu lokungafundi, ukushoda kwamakhono, kanye nobuphofu. Abesifazane bayathinteka kakhulu kulokhu ngoba emlandweni bashiye ekhaya ukuze banakekele izingane futhi abahambi esikoleni noma emsebenzini. Ngakho-ke, iMuni inomthwalo omkhulu wokukhulula abesifazane emcabangweni wokuncika kwabanye nasebuphofini. Abesifazane abameleki kahle kuzo zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni nezinye izakhiwo ezingekho kuhulumeni ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Kukho ukungabi namandla kwezomnotho kwabesifazane. Ukuze kulwe nalezi zinkinga, iMuni ibambisana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ukuhlela imihlangano yokwabelana ngemininingwane ehlose ukuqinisekisa abesifazane lapho kudingeka, kucatshangelwa ubukhulu balolu bungozi. Phakathi kwezinye izinto, iMuni inezinyathelo ezibekwe ukuze ibhekane nalolu bungozi: uhlelo lokufunda olusebenzayo, isu lokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi, kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Imikhankaso yokwazisa ngezindaba zabesifazane nezobulili nayo iyingxenye ebalulekile yohlelo lwethu. Konke okukhuluma ngenhla kuhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuqashwa kwabesifazane nokusebenza kokwakha amandla. Kuhlezi, iSisonke District Municipality izosungula iWomen’s Forum yesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iSisonke District Municipality isekela imizamo yabesifazane ngokuxhasa lezi zinhlelo zezolimo: iphrojekthi yeSukume yeziqhamo eziluhlaza, nephrojekthi yeKraansdraai, njll. I-Sisonke District Municipality iyaziqhenya futhi ihlonipha amalungelo abantu abadala abahlangabezana nokuhlukunyezwa, ukungabi nokufinyelela osizini lwezimali, kanye nezimo zokuphila ezimbi ezindlini zabo. I-Muni ibamba imihlangano eqhubekayo yabantu abadala lapho lezi zinkinga zixoxwa khona. I-Muni ihlose ukuba nemihlangano ehlangene neMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi kanye neMnyango Wezangaphakathi ukuze ibhekane nezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu abadala. I-Sisonke District Municipality iyaziqhenya ngempumelelo yomphakathi wayo ehluke-hlukeneyo mayelana namasiko nolimi esifundeni; Nokho, izilimi zethu namasiko adinga ukuvuselelwa nokuvikelwa nganoma yiziphi izindleko. Ngokufanayo, iSisonke District Municipality ibamba imicimbi ehlukahlukene yamasiko/ukuncintisana ukuze ikhuthaze ukuhlukahluka kwamasiko endaweni. I-Mnyango Wezobuciko namasiko ungomunye wabathintekayo abahlanganyela neMuni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi namasiko. Kukhona imicimbi yamasiko nemikhankaso eqhubekayo yokwazisa nokuzinza kokuhlukahluka. I-Sisonke District Municipality iyaziqhenya futhi ihlonipha amalungelo abantu abaphila nezinkinga. Abantu abaphila nezinkinga banokuhlukumezeka; bahlukunyezwa futhi bahlonishwa, yingakho bengameleki kahle ezakhiweni zikahulumeni nasemphakathini. Abanye abakwazi ukufinyelela ezikoleni ngenxa yokushoda kwezikhungo ezikhethekile ngaphakathi kwesifunda. I-Muni ihlose ukulungisa lesi simo ngokubandakanya iMnyango Wezemfundo, ihhovisi leMphakathi, kanye neMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. I-Muni inezinqubomgomo zokuphatha ukuqashwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaphila nezinkinga bayathola imisebenzi. Imihlangano yokwabelana ngemininingwane yabantu abaphila nezinkinga nayo ibanjwa njalo esifundeni. I-Sisonke District Municipality isungule iforamu yabantu abaphila nezinkinga njengesenzo esifanele sokubhekana nalolu bungozi. Le foramu ihlangana kathathu ngonyaka ukuze ixoxe ngezindaba ezithinta abantu abaphila nezinkinga. I-Sisonke District Municipality, iMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, iMnyango Wezempilo, kanye neminyango yasendaweni baphumelele ukuhlela usuku lwabantu abaphila nezinkinga eVulekani Special School, lapho izithuthuthu zanikwa abantu abaphila nezinkinga abafunda kule sikole. I-Sisonke District Municipality izozama ukuhlinzeka le sikole esikhethekile ngensizakalo ezikhethekile ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2008/09 nakweminye iminyaka ezayo. Ihhovisi leMALUNGelo ABANTWANA (ORC) ngaphansi kweMnyango Wezamalungelo Abantu, elivikelwe yiHhovisi leMphakathi laseKwa
Ukwenza izilinganiso zokusebenza zonyaka: Ukwenza izilinganiso zokusebenza zonyaka njengengxenye yokuhlola umsebenzi kwenziwa ekupheleni komjikelezo wokusebenza. Imiphumela yalezi zilinganiso ifaka zonke izilinganiso zokusebenza zabasebenzi zonyaka phakathi komjikelezo wokusebenza. Ithuluzi lokuhlola: Ithuluzi lokuhlola lisetshenziselwa ukuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngamunye mayelana nokufeza izindawo ezibalulekile zokuphumelela kanye nomongo wezindlela zokuphatha ezihambisana nezithuluzi zokuhlola ezifanele njengoba ziqukethwe esivumelwaneni sokusebenza. Ukuqonda: Ukuqonda (njengengxenye yokusebenza) kuvame ukuchazwa njengokuba nezinhloso ezinhle, ubuntu, nokuzazi. Ukuze kube nekhono: kuhambisana nekhono lomsebenzi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomsebenzi (ukuba nekhono lomsebenzi). Ikhono lokusebenza: Ikhono lokusebenza kuyinhlanganisela yolwazi, amakhono, nokusebenza okudingekayo ukuze umuntu enze umsebenzi kahle. Isilinganiso sokuhlola esiqinisekisiwe: Ukuhlola okuphelele komsebenzi oqinisekiswe yiKomidi Lezokuphatha Eliphezulu (bona futhi izilinganiso eziqinisekisiwe nezihlinzekwayo). Amakhono Okuphatha Abalulekile (CMC): Ingxenye yolwazi, ikhono, noma amandla ku-SMS PMDS ahlobene ngqo nokusebenza emsebenzini, athinta amalungu e-SMS. Abathengi: Abantu bobabili ngaphakathi nangaphandle komnyango abaxhumana nabasebenzi bomnyango ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo. Umnyango: Umnyango njengoba uchazwe esigabeni 1 seMthetho Wezikhungo Zomphakathi, 1994. Ukuthuthukiswa: Imisebenzi yoktraining nokuthuthukiswa ehlose ukuthuthukisa ikhono lomsebenzi wabasebenzi nokuthuthukisa amazinga okusebenza. Igunya Eliphezulu: Ngokuqondene nomnyango, imisebenzi noma izinhlangano zikamasipala, uMongameli, uNdunankulu, noma ilungu leKhansela Eliphezulu/UMphathiswa. Impendulo: Ulwazi olunomgomo nolwakho olunikezwa nguMphathi/umqondisi mayelana nokusebenza komsebenzi mayelana nezilindelo nezindinganiso ezibekwe, eziqondwa ngabasebenzi, futhi ezihloselwe ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Isici Sokuhlola Esijwayelekile: Into esetshenziselwa ukuchaza nokuhlola izingxenye zokusebenza, ihlola ulwazi, amakhono, nezinga lomsebenzi. Izindlela zokubhekana nezikhalazo: Izindlela zokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzi kuMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi, ezashicilelwa yiKomidi Lezikhungo Zomphakathi kuGazethi Kahulumeni R 1012 elandela umhla zingu-25 kuJuni 2003, Gazethi Kahulumeni No. 25209. Uhlaka lweMithetho Yokuphakanyiswa: Izinga lempesheni 1 kuya ku-12: DPSA 1/7/1/4/1, elandela umhla zingu-27 kuJanuwari 2003: "Ukusebenza kohlelo lwezokuphakanyiswa oluhlobene nezinhlelo zokuphatha zokusebenza zomnyango ezikhona ezingeni lempesheni 1 kuya ku-12." Uhlelo Lokuphathwa Kokusebenza Nokuthuthukiswa (IPMDS): Uhlelo lokuphatha ukusebenza olwakhiwe yiDPSA ngo-2003 ukuze lusetshenziswe ngokukhululeka kuMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi. Indawo Yokuphumelela Ebalulekile (KRA): Ingxenye yomsebenzi lapho ukusebenza kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokusebenza zomnyango, izinhloso, nezinhloso. Ukulawula: Ukuhlola izilinganiso zokuhlola zabasebenzi okwenziwa yiKomidi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nokulingana phakathi kwezingxenye zomnyango ngokulandela ukuqonda okufanayo kwezinga lokusebenza elidingekayo kuzo zonke izigaba zokuhlola ukuze kusizakale ekuthobeleni isidingo sokuthi izindleko ze-bonus zingadluli ku-1.5 percent ye-bhajethi yemiholo. Uhlelo lomsebenzi (noma uhlelo lwebhizinisi): Uhlelo lweminyaka elandela futhi lwenza uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokusebenza lube sebenzayo ngokucacisa izinhloso zezinhlelo zokusebenza ezichazwe kuhlelo lokusebenza njengengxenye yeziphumo ezibalulekile nemisebenzi ebonakalayo, yonyaka othile womnyango, amaBranji, amaDirekhtha, namaDirektha. Umphumela: Isitatimende esibanzi mayelana nenhloso ethile, inhloso, noma umphumela ohlosiwe, odinga ukwenza okukodwa noma okuningi ukuze kuqedwe ngempumelelo. Ukufeza: Umphumela onejazi noma impumelelo (okungukuthi, umkhiqizo, izenzo, noma umsebenzi) ohlanganyela empumelelweni yendawo yokuphumelela ebalulekile. Okufanele kwenziwe. Izinga lokusebenza: Umsebenzi owenziwa ngabantu ufaka (1) izenzo zomsebenzi kanye (2) umphumela noma umthelela walezo zenzo. Ukusebenza kuyinqubo eqhubekayo lapho izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, ephumelelayo, futhi enenzuzo ukuze kukhiqizwe imiphumela ehambelana nezidingo zesikhathi, izinga, kanye nenani futhi ethinta noma ibangelwa yizenzo noma ukuziphatha komuntu osebenza enqubo yokusebenza eqhubekayo. Isivumelwano sokusebenza: Idokhumenti evunyelwene ngayo futhi eyasayinwa ngumsebenzi nomqondisi wabo, ifaka incazelo yomsebenzi, izindawo ezikhethiweyo ze-KRA, ne-GAF, uhlelo lomsebenzi, kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi. Izincomo/ukuhlola kwezinga lokusebenza: Ukulinganisa, ukuhlola, izilinganiso, noma izincomo mayelana nokusebenza komsebenzi. Inqubo yokuhlola yokusebenza yonyaka ivamise ukubizwa njengencazelo noma ukuhlola kokusebenza, kanti eyingxenye engazwakali ibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlolwa kokusebenza. Uhlelo lwezinga lokusebenza: Isikhathi esiyiminyaka eyi-12 esihlelwe sokusebenza, ukuphathwa, nokuhlola. Kumele kuhambisane nesikhathi esifanayo njengohlelo lokusebenza lweminyaka yomnyango, olusuka ku-1 kuMbasa kuya ku-31 kuNdasa wonyaka olandelayo. Izikhuthazo zokusebenza: Ukuhlangana (a) kwemiklomelo yezezimali ehambisana nemiphumela yokusebenza okuhlinzekwayo, kuhlanganisa nezinyuso zemiholo, ama-bonus wokusebenza, kanye (b) ezinye izikhuthazo ezahlukene ezingase zibe khona ohlelweni lwezikhuthazo zokusebenza zomnyango. Uhlelo lwezikhuthazo zokusebenza: Uhlelo lomnyango oluhlobene nokuphakanyiswa kokusebenza oluhambisana nohlelo lwakho lokuphatha ukusebenza, olwakhiwe ngokuhambisana ne-PSR 1/VIII F no-G. Isikhombisi sezinga lokusebenza: Isilinganiso esisetshenziselwa ukuhlola ukuthi impumelelo ingakanani efinyelelwe kulokho okufanele kwenziwe (ukwakhiwa kwemigomo, ukuhlinzeka ngethuba, ukusabalalisa imisebenzi). Ukuphathwa kokusebenza: Uhlelo olunomgomo, oluqhubekayo oluhlose ukuphatha nokuthuthukisa ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zezinhlelo zokusebenza; ukuthola imisebenzi efanele kanye nokuhlola nokubona ukuqala kwemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuphumelelayo nokufanele; futhi kuyindlela yokuthuthukisa imiphumela emnyangweni, emaqenjini, nakwabanye ngokuphatha ukusebenza ngokuhambisana nezinhloso, izinhloso, amazinga, nezikhuthazo ezivunyelwene ngazo. Uhlelo lokuphatha ukusebenza: Uhlaka oluvunywa lokuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, oluhlanganisa uhlelo lwezokuphatha kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene nazo zonke izici zomjikelezo wokusebenza, kuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukusebenza nezivumelwano, ukuqapha ukusebenza, ukuhlola, nokulawula; ukuhlinzeka ngezincazelo zokusebenza nokuphatha kanye nokuphatha imiphumela yezincazelo. Izinga Lokusebenza: Izindlela zokuvumelana ngezinga lokuchaza umsebenzi ngezikhathi, izindleko, nezinga
Ukuhlinzeka ngama-rating wokusebenza ngonyaka: Ukuhlinzeka ngama-rating wokusebenza emsebenzini wonyaka njengengxenye yokuhlola umsebenzi wosebenzi kwenziwa ekupheleni kwesikhawu sokusebenza. Imiphumela yale rating yokusebenza ifaka zonke izilinganiso zomsebenzi owenziwe ngosebenzi phakathi kwesikhawu sokusebenza. Ithuluzi lokuhlola: Ithuluzi lokuhlola lisetshenziswa ukuhlola ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngamunye mayelana nokufeza izindawo ezibalulekile zomphumela kanye nomongo wezindlela zokuphatha ezihambisana nezinsiza zokuhlola ezifanele njengoba ziqukethwe esivumelwaneni sokusebenza. Ubuchwepheshe: Ubuchwepheshe (njengengxenye yokukwazi ukwenza) ngokuvamile bukhuluma ngokuba nezinhloso ezinhle, ubuntu, nokuzazi. Ukuba nekhono: kuhlobene nokukwazi kwabasebenzi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomsebenzi (ukuba nekhono lomsebenzi). Ikhono lokwenza: Ikhono lokwenza kuyinhlanganisela yolwazi, amakhono, nobuchwepheshe obudingekayo ukuze umuntu enze umsebenzi kahle. Ukuhlola okuqinisekisiwe: Ukuhlola okuphelele kwabasebenzi okuqinisekiswe yiKomidi Eliphezulu Lokuphatha (bona futhi ukuhlola okuqinisekisiwe nokuthi yini ehlinzekwayo). Amakhono Okuphatha Abalulekile (CMC): Ingxenye yolwazi, ikhono, noma amandla e-SMS PMDS aqondile ahlobene nokusebenza ngendlela efanele emsebenzini, efaneleka kubalaleli be-SMS. Abathengi: Abantu bobabili ngaphakathi nangaphandle komnyango abaxhumana nabasebenzi bomnyango lapho behlinzeka ngezidingo. Umnyango: Umnyango njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1 seMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, 1994. Ukuthuthukiswa: Ukuqeqeshwa nezinto zokuthuthukiswa eziqondiswe ekwandiseni ikhono labasebenzi lokwenza nokuthuthukisa amazinga okusebenza. Igunya Eliphezulu: Mayelana noMnyango, imisebenzi kahulumeni noma izinhlangano, uMongameli, uNgqongqoshe, noma ilunga leKhansela Eliphezulu/Umphathiswa. Impendulo: Ulwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe olunikezwa nguMphathi/umqondisi mayelana nokusebenza kwabasebenzi mayelana nezilindelo nezindinganiso ezibekwe, eziqondwa ngabasebenzi, futhi ezihlosiwe ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza. Ithuluzi lokuhlola ukufaneleka: Into esetshenziselwa ukuchaza nokuhlola izici zokusebenza, ukuhlola ulwazi, amakhono, nezinga lomsebenzi. Izindlela zokubhekana nezikhalazo: Izindlela zokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzi kwiSevisi Yomphakathi, ezishicilelwe yiKomidi Lezisebenzi Zomphakathi kuMemezelo Kahulumeni R 1012 elandela 25 June 2003, uMqulu Wombuso No. 25209. Uhlaka lweMithetho Yokuphakanyiswa: Izinga lemali 1 kuya kwelama-12: Uhlaka lwe-DPSA 1/7/1/4/1, olwandulela 27 January 2003: "Ukwenziwa kohla lwezokuphakanyiswa oluhlobene nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukusebenza komnyango emisebenzini ezingeni lemali 1 kuya kwelama-12." Uhlelo Lokuphathwa Kokusebenza Nokuthuthukiswa (IPMDS): Uhlelo lokuphatha ukusebenza olwakhiwe yi-DPSA ngo-2003 ukuze lusetshenziswe ngenkuthalo kwiSevisi Yomphakathi. Izindawo Eziyinhloko Zomphumela (KRA): Ingxenye yomsebenzi lapho ukusebenza kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ukufezwa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zomnyango, izinhloso, nezinhloso. Ukulawula: Ukuhlola ama-rating wokuhlola abasebenzi okwenziwa yiKomidi ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nokungakhethi phakathi kwezingxenye zomnyango wonke ngokulandela indlela efanayo yokuqonda amazinga okusebenza adingekayo kuzo zonke izigaba zokulinganisa ukuze kusizakale ekuphumeleleni kokuthi izindleko ze-bonus zingadluli ku-1.5% yebhajethi yemali. Uhlelo Lokusebenza (noma uhlelo lwebhizinisi): Uhlelo lwesikhathi esiyonyaka olusekelwe futhi lwenza uhlelo lwezinhlelo zokusebenza luphile ngokucacisa izinhloso zohlelo lwezinhlelo zokusebenza olukhuluma ngezindawo ezibalulekile nezinto ezilinganisekayo, zonyaka othile woMnyango, Amagatsha, Ofisi zeSikhulu, kanye Nezikhungo. Umphumela: Isitatimende esibanzi mayelana nenjongo ethile, izinhloso, noma umphumela ohleliwe, odinga ukuthi kube khona okunye noma okunye okufanele kuphumelele. Impumelelo: Umphumela one-rating noma impumelelo (okungukuthi, umkhiqizo, izenzo, noma umsebenzi) ohlanganisa impumelelo yengxenye yezindawo ezibalulekile. Okudingekayo ukwenza. Izinga lokusebenza: Ukusebenza kwabantu kufaka (1) izenzo zabasebenzi kanye (2) umphumela noma umthelela waleyo zenzo. Ukusebenza kuyinqubo eqhubekayo lapho izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kahle, futhi eyinzuzo ukuze kukhiqizwe imiphumela ehambisana nezidingo zesikhathi, izinga, kanye nenani futhi umthelela noma umphumela waleso sikhathi uvela ezincwadini noma ezizindeni zomsebenzi. Isivumelwano sokusebenza: Idokhumenti evunyelwene futhi eyasayinwa ngosebenzi nomqondisi wabo, ehlanganisa incazelo yomsebenzi, izindawo ezikhethiwe ze-KRA nezama-GAF, uhlelo lokusebenza, kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Isiphakamiso/ukuhlola izinga lokusebenza: Ukulinganisa, ukuhlola, ama-rating, noma iziphakamiso mayelana nokusebenza kwabasebenzi. Inqubo yokuhlola yonyaka evamile ibizwa ngokuthi isiphakamiso noma ukuhlola ukusebenza, kuyilapho eyingxenye engafanele ibizwa ngokuthi ukuhlola ukusebenza. Uhlelo lwezinga lokusebenza: Isikhathi esiyimizuzu eyi-12 esihlelwe sokusebenza, ukuphatha, nokuhlola. Kumele kuhambisane nesikhathi esifanayo nesu lokusebenza lonyaka loMnyango, eliqala kusukela ku-1 Mashi kuya ku-31 February ngonyaka olandelayo. Izikhuthazo zokusebenza: Ukuqoqwa (a) kwemivuzo yezezimali ehambisana nemiphumela yeziphakamiso zokusebenza, kuhlanganisa ukwenyuka kwemali, ama-bonus okusebenza, kanye (b) ezinye izikhuthazo ezingezona ezemali ezingase zibe khona ohlelweni lokukhuthaza ukusebenza komnyango. Uhlelo lokukhuthaza ukusebenza: Uhlelo lomnyango oluhambisana nokuphakanyiswa kokusebenza okuhlobene nohlelo lwakhe lokuphatha ukusebenza, olwakhiwe ngokuhambisana ne-PSR 1/VIII F no-G. Isikhombisi sezinga lokusebenza: Isilinganiso esisetshenziselwa ukuhlola ukuthi impumelelo ingakanani efinyelelwe mayelana nokuthi okudingekayo ukwenza (ukusungulwa kwemigomo, ukuhlinzeka ngama-presentation, ukusungulwa kwemisebenzi). Ukuphathwa kokusebenza: Uhlelo oluqondile, oluqhubekayo olunhloso yokuphatha nokuthuthukisa ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zohlelo lokusebenza; ukuchaza imisebenzi efanele kanye nokuhlola nokuhlonipha ukuqala kwemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle nokufanele; futhi kuyindlela yokuthuthukisa imiphumela eMnyangweni, emaqenjini, nasemazingeni ngamanye ngokuphatha ukusebenza ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo, izinhloso, amazinga, nezikhuthazo ezivunyelwene. Uhlelo lokuphathwa kokusebenza: Uhlaka oluvunyelwe lokuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, oluhlanganisa uhlaka lwezomthetho kanye nezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene nazo zonke izici zesikhawu sokusebenza, kuhlanganisa ukuhlela ukusebenza nezivumelwano, ukuqapha ukusebenza, ukubuyekeza, nokulawula; ukuphakamisa ukusebenza nokuphatha kanye nokuphatha imiphumela yeziphakamiso. Izinga Lokusebenza: Izindlela zokuvuma isikali sokuchaza umsebenzi ngokuhambisana nesikhathi, izindleko, nez
Amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi kanye namancane (SMMEs) adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo eKwaZulu Natal. Uma izimali ezitshalwe emkhakheni we-SMME zihlonyiswe kahle, zingasiza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza komnotho wesifunda kanye nezakhamuzi. Nokho, ukufinyelela usizo lwezezimali kumabhizinisi ahlelwe kahle kuyinselelo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi izikhungo zezimali zibeka imiqathango eqinile yokuxhaswa kwezimali. Izicelo zokuxhaswa kwezimali zingaphumelela ngoba amaphrojekthi abhekwa njengokuphepha okukhulu noma ngoba izicelo zabo azihlangabezani nezidingo zesikhungo sezezimali. Le nselelo ibhekwa njengokukhuliswa ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinketho zokuxhaswa kulomkhakha. Le bhukwana ihlose ukukhombisa ezinye zezinselelo ezibhekene ne-SMMEs futhi inikeze ulwazi ngezinhlelo ezahlukene nemikhiqizo ethulwa izikhungo zezimali. Ulwazi olukhona kule bhukwana lukhombisa inqubo okufanele ilandelwe uma kufakwa isicelo sokuxhaswa kwezimali kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana yesikhungo sezezimali ngasinye. Sithemba ukuthi lokhu kuzohlinzeka abantu ngelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olungabasiza ekutholeni uxhaso lwezimali. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imali eyanele yokwakha ibhizinisi ngendlela efanele kubalulekile empumelelweni yebhizinisi. Abatshalizimali badinga ukuqonda kangcono imithombo ehlukahlukene yokuxhaswa etholakalayo yokwakha ibhizinisi nokuthi yini edingekayo ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kuyo. Kukhona imithombo emibili eyinhloko yokuxhaswa yokwakha ibhizinisi elisha. Eyokuqala yizimali zomtshali-zimali uqobo, kanti eyesibili yileyo lapho umtshali-zimali esebenzisa imali yabanye abantu. Nokho, iqiniso liwukuthi amazinga aphezulu okuhlupheka avimbela abantu ukuba babe nemali yabo yokwakha ibhizinisi, okubaphoqa ukuba baphande ezinye izinsiza zokuxhaswa ukuze basize amabhizinisi abo, kuhlanganise nezikweletu. Kukhona uxhaso oluncane lwezikhwama olukhona ukuze lusekela i-SMMEs noma ukukhuthaza umnotho wendawo. Iningi lezikhwama ezitholakalayo ligxile ekusizeni i-SMMEs ngokuqeqeshwa, izeluleko, kanye nokwesekwa kwemakethe. Izinhlelo ezimbalwa ziqondiswe ekusizeni i-SMMEs ngoxhaso lokuthenga izimpahla, imishini, noma izakhiwo, futhi lokhu kugxilwe kakhulu kumabhizinisi akhona adinga ukukhulisa. Ulwazi mayelana nezinhlelo ezahlukene ezitholakalayo akukatholakali kalula noma ukufinyeleleka. Kukhona ukuntuleka kwabasebenzi ezikhungweni zokuxhaswa kwezimali abangaphatha kahle futhi baphathe izimali ezithunyelwe kwi-SMMEs noma ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo. Izimali ezitholakalayo ziqondiswe kakhulu kumabhizinisi omphakathi afana nezinkampani zokubambisana, ama-trust, noma izinkampani zeSigaba 21. Amabhizinisi ngabanye, njengalezo ezinezingxenye ezingaphansi kwemibono eyishumi noma (PTY) LTD, awahlangabezani nezidingo. Izinqubo ezilandelwayo kanye nenqubo yokufaka isicelo sokuthola lezi zimali ngokuvamile zifaka izinqubo ezinde nezinzima ezingaqondakali kalula ku-SMMEs kanye nezithakazelo ezingenayo izinsiza ezanele. Izikhathi ezibekwe zokuhola abaphumelele ezicelweni ngokuvamile zide kakhulu. Izinqubo eziyinkimbinkimbi zokuthenga okufanele zilandelwe ngokuvamile azihambisani nezinhloso zebhizinisi. Ukuze kusizakale abatshalizimali, uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Nezokuvakasha usungule uhlu lwemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabaxhasi bezimali, okungatholakala ku: www.kznded.gov.za. Umehluko phakathi kwezikweletu (noma ikhredi) nezimali ezitholwe kubatshalizimali ukuthi izikweletu kufanele zikhokhwe ngenzalo, kanti izimali ezivela kubatshalizimali zitholakala ngokusekelwe ekwenzeni ibhizinisi. Nakuba lezi zimali ezivela kubatshalizimali zingesinye sezindlela ezingalandelwa, abatshalizimali abaningi bangenalo ulwazi lokuthi bangazithola kanjani futhi amakhono okudonsela nokugcina abatshalizimali ababalulekile. Abatshalizimali abakhokhwayo ngokuvamile banokukhathazeka okukhulu kunalabo abahlinzeka ngezikweletu. Ukutshalwa kwabo kwenziwa isikhathi esingachazwanga, futhi bangathola kuphela ukwabiwa kwenzuzo ngemva kokukhokha zonke izikweletu. Ukuxhaswa okungakhokhiwe kubatshalizimali kufanelekile kakhulu kumabhizinisi aphumayo angazi kahle ngokuqhubeka kwemali, okwenza bangenakulungela ukufuna uxhaso kubatshalizimali abanikela ngezinsiza. Ngokungafani nababolekisi, abathengisi abazimele abahlinzeka ngoxhaso olungakhokhiwe banganciphisa ezinye zezingcuphe ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezinkulu ezingase zibe nomthelela noma ziqhubele phambili utshalomali. Lokhu kungasiza ukudala izinhlelo zebhizinisi ezinhle nezisheshayo futhi kuthuthukise ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yebhizinisi ngenkathi kusungulwa nezindlela zokubambisana ezizinzile. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, ungavakashela kwi-South African Venture Capital and Private Equity Association (SAVCA) ku: www.savca.co.za. Izikweletu, ezikhokhwa ngenzalo, zitholakala ezibankini zokuthuthukiswa kanye nezibankini ezithengisayo. Inselelo enkulu ebhekene ne-SMMEs kanye nemiphakathi ehluphekayo ekutholeni izikweletu ukuthi lezi zikhungo zidinga ukuqinisekiswa okufanele. Ngenkathi izikhungo zezezimali zokuthuthukiswa zingaguqula izinqubo zazo, izibankini ezithengisayo zinezinqubomgomo eziqinile mayelana nezidingo zokuphepha. Izikhungo zezimali eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile zokuhlola ubungozi bekhredi lapho zisebenza ngesicelo. Ukuhlola izinkomba zokusebenza kwezimali kuboniswa kumadokhumenti wezabelomali nezokuhlela ezimali. Nansi uhlu lwamadokhumenti avame ukufunwa izikhungo zezimali lapho kufakwa isicelo sezikweletu. Umlando wokubhaliswa kwenkampani. Uhlaka lokuphatha nabasebenzi. Izitatimende zezimali zakamuva noma, uma kuyibhizinisi elilodwa, ukuqinisekiswa okubhaliwe okukhombisa imali engenayo okubhalwe ngungcweti wezimali. Izitatimende zebhange zomuntu siqu (ezeminyaka emithathu noma eyisithupha edlule, kuye ngokuthi ubani obolekayo). Izitatimende zebhange zebhizinisi (ezeminyaka emithathu noma eyisithupha edlule, kuye ngokuthi ubani obolekayo). Izitatimende zezimali zabantu bezinhlangano/zabaphathi/ezokuphatha zezimali. Ukuqinisekiswa okuvela kubahloli mayelana nababeli benkampani kanye nephethini yezabelo abaziphethe. Ukuhlaziywa kweminyaka yokubolekwa nokubolekisa. Incazelo enembile yokwakheka kanye nesitatimende sokuhamba kwemali esingama-6 ezinyangeni zalolo hlaka. Ukuveza noma yiziphi izikweletu, izikweletu ezithile, njll., nezinye izikhungo zezimali. Ukudingeka kokuhlinzeka ngohlelo lwebhizinisi olubonakala lusebenzayo, okungaba inselelo ukuyakha. I-SMMEs kulindeleke ukuthi ifake is

UMthetho weKwaZulu-Natal Business Rescue Fund, 1998 (UMthetho No. 13 ka-1998), kanye nokuhlelwa kabusha koMthetho weKwaZulu-Natal Business Rescue Fund, 2003 (UMthetho No. 2 ka-2003), kulokhu kuyakhanselwa. UMthetho No. 13 ka-1998 kulokhu uyahlakazwa futhi usatshalaliswa. Noma iyiphi impahla noma inzuzo etholekile kulowo mhlaba kumele idluliselwe kuHulumeni wePhondo leKwaZulu-Natal noma kumunye umphakathi njengokugunyazwa nguHulumeni wePhondo leKwaZulu-Natal, ngemuva kokukhokhwa kwemalimboleko yazo zonke zeFund uma isetshenzisiwe. Lo Mthetho ubizwa ngokuthi uMthetho Wokukhansela iKwaZulu-Natal Business Rescue Fund, 2008.
Ukuhlinzekwa kokwakhiwa kweMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ukuze kusekelwe isifiso sabantu, ukufundisa nokukhulisa ukuqwashisa kwezombusazwe phakathi kwabantu baseKwaZulu-Natal ngokusebenzisa imali efanele nephumelelayo kumaphathi ezombusazwe; ukuhlinzeka ngamaqhinga nemisebenzi yemali; ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezezimali kumali; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala kwemali kumaphathi ezombusazwe abhalisiwe kanye nokusetshenziswa kwaleyo mali; ukuhlinzeka ngencwadi yokukhishwa kwemali eyenziwe kumali; ukuhlinzeka ngembiko yokubhekelela yonke imiphakathi ngezokuphathwa kwemali etholelwe kumali; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuhoxiswa kwemali esetshenziswe kabi kumaphathi ezombusazwe; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala kwemali engasetshenziswanga; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba nokulawula imali; ukuhlinzeka ukuthi uMphakathi ubike kwiPhalamende lePhondo ngezindaba ezihlobene nemali kanye nembiko yayo yezezimali; ukuhlinzeka ngempahla engasetshenziswanga uma iPhalamende lePhondo liphume; ukuhlinzeka ngokwakhiwa kwemithetho; nokuhlinzeka ngeminye imibandela ehlobene. "Umthetho Wokhetho" ubonisa umthetho weKomishini Yokhetho, 1996 Umthetho No. "Iphathi" ibonisa noma iyiphi iphathi yezombusazwe ebhaliswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 15 somthetho weKomishini Yokhetho, 1996 Umthetho No. "lo Mthetho" uhlanganisa nemithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 15. ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba nokulawula kweMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe. IMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe isunguliwe ngenjongo yokuxhasa ngemali amaphathi abamba iqhaza kwiPhalamende lePhondo. nokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olungeziwe kumaphathi ezombusazwe ngendlela efanele nephumelelayo. nemali etholelwe noma eqoqwe yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kusukela kwenye imithombo. Zonke izimali ezitholakele noma eziphathelene neMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kumele zifakwe kwi-akhawunti yasebhange ehlukile evulwe nguMsecretary enhlanganweni ebhaliswe njengebhange ngokwemithetho yeBhange, 1990 (Umthetho No. 94 ka-1990). Izimali kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ezingadingeki ngokuphuthumayo ukuze zabelwe amaphathi ngaphansi kwesigaba 6 zingatshalwa neKomishini Yokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi okukhuthazwa kuMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1984 (Umthetho No. 45 ka-1984). Izimali zokonga nezokutshalwa zizovulwa ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba futhi noma yikuphi inzalo kulezo zikhwama kufanele kube ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa iMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe, futhi akufanele kuhlanganiswe noma kubekwe ngaphandle kwezinye izimali zePhalamende lePhondo. 6.(1) Zonke amaphathi anesibopho sokuthola izimali ezivela kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ngonyaka wezezimali owamukelwe yiPhalamende lePhondo. Ngokusekelwe esigabeni (7), izimali ezabelwe iPhathi kufanele zisetshenziswe ngezinjongo ezihlobene nokusebenza kwayo njengephathi yezombusazwe emoyeni wamanje wabantu. nokuqinisekisa ukuxhumana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwabantu nezakhiwo zikamasipala, futhi ikakhulukazi, phakathi kwabantu nePhalamende lePhondo. Ukubekwa kwemali kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kufanele kube ngokulinganayo futhi kwenziwe ngezikhathi ezithile, ngokuhleleka kokukhokha okukhulunywe ngakho, nangendlela ethile. futhi ngokwengxenye, ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo yokulingana, engase ibhekelwe, phakathi kokunye, inani eliqinile elitholwe yiPhathi ngayinye emelelwe kwiPhalamende noma isilinganiso noma ukumelwa okuzobekwa kwiPhathi ngayinye ebamba iqhaza kwiPhalamende lePhondo. Ulwazi nemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe uhlelo oluhleliwe kwiPhathi kufanele kuvezwe emphakathini kanye nezinye izimo nezimo ngesikhathi sokubekwa. noma iyiphi enye injongo engahambisani nokusebenza kwephathi yezombusazwe emoyeni wamanje wabantu, njengoba kungase kuhlongozwe. Ukubekwa kwemali kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kufanele kuphele uma iPhathi ingafanelekile ngaphansi kwesigaba (1), futhi ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-21 ngemuva kosuku lapho iPhathi ingafanelekile, kufanele ibuyise zonke izimali ezingasetshenziswanga zezimali ezabelwe yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe. 7.(1) Ngokushesha okukhulu ngemva kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, uMsecretary kufanele akhiphe isaziso kwiGazette esikhombisa ukubekwa kwemali okuhlelwe kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ngesikhathi salo msebenzi. kanye nezimali ezisele kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe ekupheleni kwalonyaka wezezimali. vula futhi usebenze i-akhawunti yasebhange ehlukile egameni lePhathi enhlanganweni ebhaliswe njengebhange ngokwemithetho yeBhange, 1990 Umthetho No. qoka umuntu ophumelelayo kule Phathi njengomphathi wezezimali mayelana nezimali ezabelwe le Phathi yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe. ikakhulukazi, umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi izimali ezabelwe azisetshenziswanga ngezinjongo ezingavunyelwe yalo Mthetho. Umphathi wezezimali kufanele agcine izincwadi ezihlukene nezibalo ze-akhawunti, ngendlela ethile, mayelana nezimali ezabelwe yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe, kanye nazo zonke izindleko ezithinta lezi zimali. echaza izinhloso zokusetshenziswa ngokuhlukile kulezo zilinganiso ezisetshenzisiwe. Izincwadi nezibalo ze-akhawunti eziphakanyisiwe esigabeni (3) kanye nembiko ephakanyisiwe esigabeni (4) kufanele zihlolwe nguMhloli-Jikelele kanye nabahloli abhalisiwe abasebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo yeMthetho Wokuhlola Umphakathi kanye neMthetho Wabahloli Bomphakathi, 1991 (Umthetho No. 80 ka-1991). Umhloli ophenya izincwadi njengoba kukhombisiwe esigabeni (5) kufanele, embikweni womhloli, akhulume ngombono wokuthi kungenzeka yini ukuthi izimali ezabelwe zisetshenziswe ngezinjongo ezingavunyelwe yalo Mthetho. Ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu emva kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, umphathi wezezimali kufanele athumele izincwadi, umbiko, nezitatimende ezihlolwe ngummeli, kuMsecretary. Ngaphandle kwesigaba (4) uMhloli-Jikelele, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, angahlola izincwadi nezibalo ze-akhawunti nezitatimende zezezimali eziphathelene nezimali ezabelwe kwiPhathi yiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe. angase aphelelwe yilelo hlolo uma ethokozile, ekucaciseni kokuziphatha okungcono kwePhathi, ukuthi lelo hlolo alisadingeki. biza iPhathi ukuze icacise izizathu, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile esikhunjulwe, kungani ukubekwa kwemali kwiMali yePhathi Yezombusazwe kungafanele kuphume. Isikhathi okukhulunywa ngaso esigabeni 10 akufanele sibe ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa kwesaziso. 9.(1) Uma izimali ezabelwe kwiPhathi ngaphansi kwesigaba 6 zingasetshenziswanga ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalesi Mthetho, umphathi wezezimali wale Phathi uzobhekana nokubuyiselwa
Utholelwa umsebenzi wokwakha inkampani eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Dube TradePort Corporation (Proprietary) Limited ezophatha futhi iqale amaphrojekthi aqashelwayo; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba izabelo zenkampani; ukuthola izinhloso zenkampani; ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali enkampanini; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqashwa komphathi omkhulu kanye nebhodi labaphathi; ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuphatha nokuphathwa kwenkampani ngebhodi labaphathi nomphathi omkhulu; ukuthola amandla, imisebenzi, izimali, nezibopho zokubika ezisebenzelweni zenkampani nasekuphathweni kwayo; ukuhlinzeka ngokwakhiwa kwemigomo; nokuhlinzeka ngeminye imibandela ephathelene. "Umthetho Wenkampani" ubhekisela kumthetho wezinkampani, No. "Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi" ubhekisela kumthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi, 1999 Umthetho No. "Umthetho" uhlanganisa nemithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalokhu. ukwakhiwa nokubhaliswa kwenkampani ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezinkampani, ozobhekelela ukuhlela, ukuklama, ukwakha, nokusebenza kwephrojekthi ye-Dube Tradeport nanoma yiziphi ezinye izinhlelo ezihlobene. ukuphathwa nokulawulwa kweKwaZulu-Natal Dube Tradeport Corporation. ukuhlela nokubhalisela inkampani, njengoba kuchazwe ngumthetho wezinkampani, 1973 Umthetho No. ukuba le nkampani ibhaliswe njengento kahulumeni ngaphansi kweSheduli 3 Ingxenye D yomthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho No.1 ka-1999) njengento yebhizinisi kahulumeni wesifunda. nokubhekana nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa kwabantu besifunda. ukusebenzisa izinsiza zayo ngokuhambisana nohlelo lwayo oluhlukile, nangaphansi kwesigaba somthetho kahulumeni wesifunda. Le nkampani inganikezwa imisebenzi nemisebenzi nguhulumeni wesifunda. ingaboleka noma ihlinzeke ngempahla yokubolekwa kwemali noma izinsiza ezingasuswa noma kumalungu noma eminye imali noma ingase iyeke imali ephathelene nalokho. 6.(1) Ibhodi labaphathi liyisakhiwo esibhekelele ukubika kwenkampani ngokuhambisana nesigaba 49(2)(a) somthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi. Le nkampani isebenza nebhodi labaphathi. UmMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha kufanele, ngomyalezo ophumile kwiGazethi nakuma-akhawunti amabili okukhishwa esifundeni, akhumbuze ukuthi abantu kufanele baphakanyiswe ukuze baqashwe ebhodini lenkampani okuzokwenziwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-21 zokushicilelwa komyalezo. nosuku lapho iziphakamiso kufanele zifike kuMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha. UmMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha kufanele acabangele zonke iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kuye njengokuphendula kumyalezo. UmMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha anganikeza ithimba elingabantu ababili (2) abaphathi bezigaba eziphakeme kanye nabantu ababili (2) abaphathi abaphezulu be-Dube Tradeport ukuze baphonsele phansi zonke iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe futhi benze iziphakamiso eziphathelene neziphakamiso kuMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha. ngemva kokucabangela iziphakamiso, uma zikhona, ezivela ethimbeni elikhuluma ngalesi sigaba 6(6), qasha inani elingaphansi kwezintathu (3) futhi elingaphezulu kwezintathu (8) abantu, njengabaphathi bebho. abantu abavela kwezinye izinkalo abavela kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuqhubeka kwezinhloso zenkampani. UmMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha kufanele, ngomyalezo ophumile kwiGazethi nakuma-akhawunti amabili okukhishwa esifundeni, abize imibono yomphakathi ohlwini oluqinisekisiwe lwabantu abaphakanyisiwe ukuze ithunyelwe phakathi nezinsuku ezingamashumi amabili nanye (21) kusukela ngosuku lokushicilelwa komyalezo. Ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuphawula komphakathi okukhuluma ngalesi sigaba (2) futhi noma yiziphi izicelo seziphumelele, UmMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha kufanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba (1)(a) aqashe inani elidingekayo labaphathi ebhodini. Ibhodi labaphathi, ngezikhathi ezithile, lingathola abanye abantu ukuze baphathe ebhodini ngokuhambisana nememorandum nezinhloso zenkampani futhi ngokufanele benze iziphakamiso kuMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha ukuze kwenziwe lezi ziqashwa. Zonke iziqashwa ezenziwa nguMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha kufanele zenziwe ngemuva kokubonisana nekhansela yezenhlalakahle kanye nekomidi elibhekelele imisebenzi ehambelana nePhalamende. Umphathi oqashwe ebhodini uzokhokhelwa le mali nezinsiza ezinqunywe nguMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha ngokubonisana noMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha ophathelene nezimali. Umphathi webhodi ongumsebenzi wezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ngeke akhokhelwe ngaphezulu kwemali yakhe, ngaphandle kwezindleko zokuhamba ezizokhokhwa ezinsizeni zakhe eziphathelene nomsebenzi noma imisebenzi eyenziwe yinkampani ngokuhambisana nezinsiza eziphathelene nezokuhamba nezokuphila zeMnyango. 8.(1) UmMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha kufanele aqashe umphathi kanye nomphathi ophakeme weBhodi. Abantu abaqashwe ngaphansi kwesigaba (1) akufanele babe ngamalungu akhethwe umphakathi ezingeni lesizwe, lesifunda, noma lesifunda. Uma isikhala somphathi singenalutho noma umphathi akatholakali, engakwazi noma enqaba noma ehluleka ukusebenza njengomphathi webhodi, umphathi ophakeme unikezwa amandla okusebenzisa amandla, amalungelo, nemisebenzi yomphathi ngesikhathi sokungabi khona, ukungatholakali, ukungakwazi, ukwenqaba, noma ukwehluleka. amalungu e-assembly kufanele akhethe omunye ilungu ukuze abambe isikhala somphathi okwamanje ngesikhathi sokungabi khona, ukungatholakali, ukungakwazi, ukwenqaba, noma ukwehluleka. 9.(1) Ilungu liqashwa ebhodini isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu noma ngaphansi njengoba UmMember weZinhlelo Zokuphatha angakuthola. (2). Izikhathi ezihlukene zingathathwa ukuze kuqashwe abaphathi abahlukene. Umphathi angaphinde aqashwe ebhodini isikhathi sesibili uma isikhathi sokusebenza sesiphelile, kodwa angasebenzi njengomphathi webhodi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezikhathi ezimbili. Umuntu oqashwe ukuze agcwalise isikhala ebhodini uthathwa njengokuthi usebenze iminyaka emihlanu (5) uma eqashwe. ngemuva kokuqala kwesigaba 106(1)(e) seMthethosisekelo, aboshwe noma aboshwe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyi-12 ngaphandle kokukhokhelwa, ngaphakathi kweRiphabhulikhi, noma ngaphandle uma ukuziphatha kwabo kulokhu kuzoba yicala eRiphabhulikhi: Kuncike ekutheni akekho ofanele ukubhekwa njengokuthi uboshwe kuze kube baphendula kuleli cala noma uma isijeziso sikhishwe, noma kuze kube isikhathi sokubukeka. wehluleka ukwenza imisebenzi ye-bhodi ngokuzinikela. ekwehlulekeni komphathi ukuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zalomthetho. UmMember yePhalamende ye-Executive ophathelene nezimali kumele agcine irekhodi elihle lezintshisekelo zezimali zamalungu eBhodhi njengoba zivezwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba. 8.(1) Ilungu leBhodhi elingaphumelelanga ukwenza isitatimende esichazwe esigabeni 7, ngaphansi kwesigaba (2) lingasuswa ekuqhubekeni nokusebenza ebhodini. UmMember yePhalamende ye-Executive ophathelene nezimali, uma ethola ukuthi ilungu leBhodhi lingaphumelelanga ukuhambisana nemigomo yesigaba 7, kumele uphenye le ndaba futhi athathe izinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa. Amalungu ebhodini abekwe asebenza isikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu noma ngaphansi njengoba umMember yePhalamende ye-Executive ophathelene nezimali angakuhlonza futhi, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 5, angabekwa kabusha ekupheleni kwalolo sikhathi: Kufanele ukuthi akukho muntu ongabekwa kabusha ngemuva kokusebenza ebhodini isikhathi esiyiminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ezihambelanayo. 10.(1) Ilungu leBhodhi kumele lishiye isikhundla saso uma lisuswa njengoba kuphakanyisiwe esigabeni 6. UmMember yePhalamende ye-Executive ophathelene nezimali, ngemva kokunikeza ilungu ithuba lokwethula icala lazo, angakhipha noma yisiphi isikhathi isikhathi sokusebenza salo lolu lungu uma, ngokubona kwabo, kukhona izizathu zokwenza kanjalo. Ilungu kumele lishiye isikhundla saso uma lingaphumelelanga ukwenza imisebenzi yalo, ngaphandle kokuthi linikezwe imvume yokungabi khona yiBhodhi, emihlanganweni emibili yeBhodhi ehambelanayo lapho kukhishwe isexwayiso kulolo lungu noma ngesiZulu noma ngokuqondile. Obeautiful one phezulu kwesihlangu uyisicoco sesifunda. Ingemuva kwesihlangu iyisibonakaliso sobukhosi namandla, isihlangu temsilayo ukuvikelwa kwethu kanye nesinqumo sethu sokuvikela isifiso sabantu abaningi. Idlala indima ebalulekile emasikweni, ibhubesi, inkosi yamaZulu ichazwa njengobhubesi. Ibhubesi futhi idlala indima ebalulekile emifanekisweni yezwe lamaZulu. Ibonisa ukuxhumana nokubambisana kwabantu bonke endaweni. Iyi mifanekiso yezintaba zeDrakensberg eziluhlaza ehlobo, ziphumula phansi kweqhwa ebusika. Le mfundiso iyakhumbuza ngemithetho yakudala yesifunda. Le ndaba sekuyisibonakaliso esidala sesifunda, iphinde imele ubuhle bemvelo beKwaZulu Natal. Masivuke sakhe lokhu njengomlomo wesifunda sethu. Itholakala kumfanekiso ophansi kwesibonakaliso sesifunda. Ukuveza isibonakaliso sesifunda kukhombisa isikhathi esisha kubantu beKwaZulu Natal. Manje sihlangene ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele athathe ingxenye emkhakheni wokuthuthukiswa, ekukhuleni komnotho wesifunda. Isibonakaliso sethu esisha sihlanganisa izici ezahlukene zesifunda sethu, sihlanganisa izinto zomlando nezamanje ezisiholela esikhathini esisha. Manje ngikhuthaza bonke abantu besifunda ukuba bathathe ingxenye, babambisane ukuze sikhule ndawonye ekwakheni ikusasa eliphumelelayo.
Umthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa, ukuvikela, nokuphatha izinsiza zomlando ezibonakalayo nezingenakubonwa ePhikweni leKwaZulu-Natal; ukusungulwa kweBhodi esemthethweni yokuphatha ukuvikelwa komlando ephikweni; ukunquma izinhloso, amandla, nemisebenzi yeBhodi; ukunquma ukuthi iBhodi izophathwa, ibuswe, futhi ixhaswe kanjani; ukusungulwa kwamakhomidi omlando ezingeni lendawo, isifunda, idolobha, kanye nephikweni ukusiza iBhodi ekuqinisekiseni ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuphathweni nasekuvikeleni komlando ephikweni; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngeminye imibandela ephathelene. Kulo mthetho, noma iyiphi igama noma ibinzana elinikezwe incazelo kuMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), ibhodi yendabuko esunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 6 soMthetho Wokuhola Nokuqondisa Kwendabuko, 2005 (Umthetho No. 5 ka-2005) ibhekisela kumasipala njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 155 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, futhi esunguliwe ngezizathu 11 no-12 kanye ngaphansi kwezizathu 11 no-12 zoMthetho Wokwakha Kwamamasipala, 1998 (Umthetho No. 117 ka-1998), kufundwa nezizathu 3, 4, no-5 zoMthetho Wezinhlelo Zamasipala, 2000 (Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000); "umfundaze wombuso wesifunda" ubonisa umfundaze osunguliwe kuPhikweni leKwaZulu-Natal ngesigaba 226 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996; "ibhange lesifunda" libonisa ibhange lesifunda elisunguliwe kuPhikweni leKwaZulu-Natal ngaphansi kwesigaba 17 soMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999); "imisebenzi yomphakathi" ibhekisela emisebenzini yomphakathi njengoba ichazwe esigabeni 8 soMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi, 1994 (Isikhangiso No. 103 sika-1994); "umphakathi wendabuko" ubonisa umphakathi wendabuko oqashelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 2 soMthetho Wokuhola Nokuqondisa Kwendabuko, 2005 (Umthetho No. 5 ka-2005). (2)(1) Izinqumo zalo mthetho zisebenza ezindabeni zomlando, kuhlanganise nezinsiza zomlando ezibonakalayo nezingenakubonwa ephikweni. Uma lo mthetho ungawulawuli udaba oluhambelana nokuvikela noma ukuphatha umhlaba ephikweni, izinqumo zoMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), kanye noMthetho weBhodi Yezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999), zizosebenza ephikweni futhi noma iyiphi isho "kuhulumeni wombuso wesifunda" kuMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999, kufanele, ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ukhombise okunye, kubhekwane njengokubhekisela kwiBhodi. UmMember weBhodi yePhakathi kanye neBhodi kufanele kusekele izimiso ezijwayelekile ezikhuluma esigabeni 1 seSahluko 1 soMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), ezisebenza ezinyathelweni zohulumeni wesifunda kanye nohulumeni bendawo mayelana nokuphathwa komlando ephikweni. Indima yeMember yeBhodi yePhakathi ephathelene nomlando (4)(1) Mayelana nendima yoHulumeni Kazwelonke emlandweni, iMember yeBhodi yePhakathi kufanele, ukuze ikhuthaze umoya wokubambisana okukhuluma esigabeni 3 soMthethosisekelo, ikhulise ukuphathwa komlando nezinsiza ephikweni ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo zikaHulumeni Kazwelonke nezinhlelo ezihambelana nomlando nezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwamandla anikezwe kuMember yeBhodi yePhakathi ngalolu mthetho, iMember yeBhodi yePhakathi kufanele, ngemva kokuxoxisana neBhodi, futhi ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zomlando kazwelonke, ichaze izinqubomgomo zomlando nezinhlelo zephikweni. Ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yomlando yeKwaZulu-Natal (5)(1) IBhodi ezobizwa ngokuthi iBhodi Yomlando yeKwaZulu-Natal isunguliwe. IBhodi iyisikhungo esisemthethweni. IBhodi iphethwe nguMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999). Izinsiza zomlando ezibonakalayo nezingenakubonwa ephikweni, futhi, ngokujwayelekile, ngokuhambisana nomthetho womlando kazwelonke nowesifunda, ukukhuthaza nokuhlela ukuvikelwa komlando ukuze kuzuze izizukulwane zamanje nezizayo. Amandla, imisebenzi, nemisebenzi yeBhodi (7) ingenza noma iyiphi enye umsebenzi noma igcine noma iyiphi umsebenzi onikezwe kwiBhodi nganoma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Ngokujwayelekile, ingenza zonke izinto ezidingekayo noma ezilungile ukuze ifinyelele izinhloso zayo ezikhuluma esigabeni 6 futhi yenze imisebenzi ekhulumayo esigabeni (1). (3)(a) IBhodi, ngenhloso yoMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999 (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), iyisikhungo somlando wesifunda seKwaZulu-Natal futhi noma iyiphi isho "kuhulumeni wombuso wesifunda" kuMthetho kufanele, ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ukhombise okunye, kubhekwane njengokubhekisela kwiBhodi. IBhodi kufanele, ngaphezu kwamandla, imisebenzi, nemisebenzi ekhulumayo esigabeni (1) no(2), yenze imisebenzi enikezwe esikhungweni somlando wesifunda ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke, 1999. Ukwakhiwa kweBhodi (8) kufanele ikhethe omunye wezithunywa zayo njengomholi noma njengomholi weBhodi ozophatha imihlangano yeBhodi futhi enze eminye imisebenzi ephathelene. Kufanele imele zonke izigaba ezihlobene futhi ifake abantu abavela ephikweni ngezizinda ezahlukene nezamasiko ahlukahlukene. Amalungu akhuluma esigabeni (1) kufanele abe abantu abafanele abangazimele, abangakhethiwe, futhi abafanelekile. Ukwehluleka ukuveza inzuzo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 11 noma ukubamba iqhaza noma ukuba yingxenye yezinkulumo zeBhodi ngenkathi uthola inzuzo njengoba kuchazwe kulolu sigaba. bangavakashela imihlangano yeBhodi futhi babambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni, kodwa abanalo ilungelo lokuvota lapho kuthathwa izinqumo kwiBhodi. Lolu sigaba luphansi kwezinhlinzeko zokudlulela ezikhuluma esigabeni 66. (9)(1) Ilunga leBhodi lingabamba isikhundla isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu, futhi lingabuyiselwa. Akekho ilunga ongabekwa ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezimbili ezilandelanayo. Lolu sigaba luphansi kwezinhlinzeko zokudlulela ezikhuluma esigabeni 66. Njengoba ngimi lapha, nginokuzwa injabulo nokudabuka; ngiyajabula ngoba namuhla sizogcwalisa iphupho lokuletha impilo engcono kubantu bethu eKwaNibela, kodwa ngidabukile kakhulu ngoba ezinsukwini ezedlule, sishonele emoyeni yabantu abahlanu abangenacala baleli zwe ngenxa yezikhukhula zakamuva ezishayile ezindaweni zethu eMshwathi, eMandeni, naseNdwedwe. Lezi zenzakalo zikhumbuza futhi ngempela ubuhlungu bokungabi nezimo zokuhlala ezanele abantu bethu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ekuqaleni kwesikhathi esifushane kusukela ngomhla ka-17 kuZibandlela 2004, kuze kube manje, sibe nezikhukhula eziyi-19 ezinzima, uma ngibala lezo ezivela kuleli Msombuluko esikwi, eziholele ekulimaleni ezindaweni eziningi zempumalanga yethu. Uma sibheka kuphela umonakalo owenziwe yilezi zikhukhula, kubonakala ukuthi abantu abaningi bathinteka, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Siyazi ukuthi akuwona umphumela wabantu bethu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, kodwa kungenxa pressure abathola kuyo, okuvela kuhulumeni ophatha ngokucindezela owawungalindele izidingo zokuhlala kwemiphakathi yethu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokuhlala. Ngenxa yomonakalo owenzeka ezindlini zabantu, sibe nezindleko ezingu-19.3 million rand ukusiza abantu abathintekile, futhi sizodinga nezinye izimali ukuze sixazulule izimo eziphuthumayo zakamuva. Lezi yizimali esizozisebenzisa ukwakha izindlu ezintsha ukuze sivalelise umgapho wezindlu ezikhona ngenxa ye-apartheid, kodwa manje kufanele sithuthukise izindlu ezilimele zabantu bethu ezingekho esimweni esifanele sokumelana nezikhukhula. Kubonakala kahle kimi, umphakathi waseKwaNibela, ukuthi uma sifuna ukususa ukungathuthuki ekuthuthukisweni kwezindawo zasemaphandleni okubangelwa yi-apartheid, kufanele sikhulume kahle futhi silwe. I-apartheid ithathe abantu bethu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokuhlala futhi yabasebenzisa; empeleni, lezi zindawo zaziyindawo lapho uhulumeni we-apartheid athola khona abasebenzi abacindezelwe futhi abakhokhelwa kancane. Namuhla sikhona lapha ezweni likaMnumzane Mdluli, ukuze sikhulume kahle futhi silwe nokungathuthuki kokuthuthukiswa okushiywe yi-apartheid ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Esontweni elidlulelwe, sasiMseleni, lapho saphinde saqala umkhankaso wokulwa nomonakalo oshiywe yi-apartheid ngokwethula izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu. Ngempelasonto ezayo sizobe siseKwaMnqobokazi. Sihamba ngesivinini esikhulu emkhankasweni wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bethu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Lezi zifiso ziqhubeka zikhuluma ukuthi uma intando yabantu ibusa kuleli zwe, abantu bazokwakhelwa izindlu, futhi kuzoba nokuphepha nokuphumelela. Ngempela, bathi bonke abantu kuleli zwe kufanele babe nokufinyelela ezindlini ezifanele; akekho okufanele aphile ezindlini eziphakeme ngenkathi kukhona abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikhululekile nezifanele. Lapho benza lesi sinqumo, kwaba sengathi kuyiphupho, kodwa namuhla le mbono isibe isisekelo senqubomgomo kahulumeni. Siyajabula ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisa umnyango wethu ukuze agcwalise umbono nephupho lokuthi abantu bethu kufanele bakhishwe izindlu ezisezingeni eliphakeme. Uhulumeni ophatha ngokucindezela akazange anakekele abantu bethu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Abantu abaningi baphoqwa ukuba bahlale ezimeni zokuhlala ezingafanele, emhlabeni owomile ongenamsebenzi futhi ongenzuzo. Ukususwa kwabantu ezindaweni zethu kube izilonda ezibuhlungu emandleni ethu. Abaningi benu bayazi ubuhlungu obuhambisana nokwehliswa kwesithunzi sabantu bethu. Imindeni yahlukaniswa, amasiko ethu aphukile kodwa awalahleki, futhi ithemba alizange lishiswe. Abaningi balaba bantu batholakala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni njengeKwaNibela, kanti abanye bakhishwa ezindlini ezizungezile emadolobheni, njengokuhlupheka okukhulu okubhekene neNingizimu Afrika ngemuva kokuhla kukahulumeni we-apartheid. Kulama-11 eminyaka kahulumeni we-democratic, sikwazile ukusebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezingeni lesifunda nezwe ukuze silungise le miphumela. Namuhla sijabule ukusho ukuthi sikwazile ukwakha izindlu eziyi-1,600 zabantu bethu ababe neziqu ezingenalutho, futhi eziningi ziqhubeka zakhiwa njengoba ngikhuluma. Sizibophezele ekwandiseni uhlelo lwezindlu unyaka nonyaka ukuze silwe nokuntuleka kwezindlu ngokushesha. Nakuba lolu hlelo luzothatha iminyaka, sijabule ukuthi izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa zethulwa ngokushesha, ubufakazi balesi sikhathi sikhona phambi kwenu namuhla. Sinethemba lokuthi sinesu eliphumelelayo. Izinqubomgomo zethu azikona nje izifiso zikaHulumeni. Kodwa lezi zinqubomgomo zimele ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ukuze kubhekwe ngqo ukuntuleka kwezindlu futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umphakathi walezi zizwe uphila endlini efudumele. Thina, njengomnyango, sikholelwa ukuthi ukwakha nokuthuthukisa izindlu kufanele kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Sikholelwa ukuthi abantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni nezinsiza, ezifana nezindlela, amanzi, ukuhlinzekwa ngempilo, kanye negesi. Indlu inika umuntu isithunzi nobuqotho; iyindawo ongayibiza ngokuthi ikhaya, ikuvikela ezikhukhuleni nasezimweni ezimbi, iyindawo yakho ephephile futhi ikunika ubunikazi. Namuhla imoto yethu yokuthuthukisa ifike eKwaNibela ukuze iphazamise imiphumela yokuhlupheka okukhishwe ukungabi nezindlu ezanele, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini yethu yasemaphandleni. Lolu hlelo lwezindlu esilwethulayo namuhla, Nkosikazi, uMnumzane Mdluli, kanye nonke abantu, lumele ukuqala okusha emphakathini lapha nasezindaweni zonke zasemaphandleni zempumalanga yethu. Lo msebenzi esiwethulayo namuhla uzoshintsha impilo yabantu abaningi abakhe le ndawo yaseKwaNibela. Le ngxenye yomlando iyisibonakaliso sokuthi sithathe isinyathelo esibalulekile sokufeza umbono wethu wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lolu hlelo luzophinde lwenze amathuba emisebenzi ahlukaniswe ezinkulungwaneni, futhi eziningi zizoze zibe khona okwesikhashana. Ngalesi sikhathi, sizokwenza abantu bakhishwe izindlu ezindaweni abahlala kuzo njengamanje futhi ngeke baphume ezindaweni ezahlukene. Iziqu zayo zizo-42 square meters, okuyindlu enkulu futhi eyakhiwe kahle. Enye into ejabulisayo ngalolu hlelo lapha eKwaNibela ukuthi amabhulokhi okwakha lezi zindlu azothengwa kini, umphakathi, ukuze nithole inzuzo futhi nithuthukise. Ngalesi sikhathi sokwakha izindlu, siqedela ukuzib
Ngonyaka owedlule, ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo mayelana Nesimo Sezwe, uMongameli uMbeki wathi, "Kucacile ukuthi izifiso zabantu bethu zikhombisa ukuthi izwe lethu selingene esigabeni esisha sethemba." Leli themba kube umbiko esiwamukele kubo bonke abantu bethu njengoba sahlala phakathi kwabo sixoxa ngezindaba zokwabiwa kwezimali. Ngesikhathi sihlanganisa le bhajethi, sahamba kuwo wonke amapulazi ale ndawo silalela izifiso zomphakathi ofuna ukubona lezi z allocation zezimali zethulwa namuhla zifeziwe. Abantu abaningi bakhathazekile kakhulu ngendlu, nezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezifana namanzi nempilo. Amazwe athuthukayo, kanye nalawo abamba iqhaza emphakathini womhlaba, awanazo izindlela zokwenza izinto zifinyeleleke kubantu ohlelweni lwezimali lapho kutholwa khona izikweletu. Umsebenzi wabantu abampofu ufana nezinkampani ezingakwazi ukukhipha amasheya ukuze zithole ezinye izimali zokusebenza. Ngaphandle kokukwazi ukwenza lokhu, umsebenzi wabo ufana nokuba dead. Abantu abaningi abahlala kulezi zizwe abanakho ukufinyelela izimpahla zabo ukuze zibe yisibambiso sezikweletu. Lokhu kwenza ukukhula komnotho kulezi zizwe kube nzima, nakuba abantu benza zonke izinto ezwenziwa amazwe aseNtshonalanga. Lokhu kuyimfihlo yezomnotho wezokuthengisa. Saqala le ndlela yokuthuthukiswa ngonyaka owedlule sazi kahle ukuthi le ndlela ibanzi futhi izothatha iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokufinyelela endaweni yethu. Saziswa ukuthi singaqala kahle. Asizukushintsha indlela esiqale ngayo. Sizokwenza njalo kulonyaka njengoba siqala. Umthetho Wokwabiwa Kwezimali Wabantu bethu udinga ukuthi silalele imizwa nemibono yabantu abahlukene. Senze kanjalo kulonyaka futhi. Sihlangane nezinkonzo ukuze sithole imibono yabo, sihlangane nezinhlangano zomsebenzi ukuze sithole imibono yabo; futhi sivakashele izindawo eziningi ukuze sixoxe nomphakathi ezindaweni zabo. Siyabonga kakhulu ukuthi umphakathi wethu usekela kakhulu leli hlelo. Umkhulumeli kanye Nezithunywa Ezihloniphekile, ulwazi esilutholayo kubantu emphakathini lunenani elikhulu. Sibone ukuthi izinga lemibono alihambisani nalokho esikukhona lapha eNdlu yenu Ehloniphekile. Uma ngingacaphuna eminye imibono, ngesikhathi sikhona eMandini naseBergville bekukhona imibono efanayo evela kuJabulisiwe Sithole noThabani Kubheka ukuthi kubonakala sengathi imali ebekwe kwiMnyango Wezokwakha iyancipha ngenkathi isidingo sendlu siqhubeka sikhula. Ngiyethemba bazokujabulela ukuzwa namuhla ukuthi ukwakhiwa kwemali kwiMnyango Wezokwakha kukhuphukile ngo-29%. UMnu. Thamsanqa Thwala waseThekwini uthe uma kuqhathaniswa nokwakhiwa kwemali kwiMnyango Wezemfundo kanye neMnyango Wezempilo, kukhona umehluko omkhulu. Ngokuvamile, iMnyango Wezempilo ibonakala ihluleka. Ngaleso sikhathi, eShowe, uMnu. Lucky Mkhize wabona ukuthi iMnyango Wezemfundo kungenzeka udinge uxhaso olungeziwe. Ngiyethemba impendulo ekhombisa ukuthi izabelo zalezi zMnyango ezimbili zikhuphukile izobajabulisa. Siphinde sithole abantu ezindaweni ezahlukene bekhalaza ngokungatholi usizo ngesikhathi soktraining nangaleso sikhathi beqinisekisa izinhlelo zabo zebhizinisi. Wezindawo zonke esivakashele, sathola izinkinga ezifanayo. Lokhu kubonakala nakwamanye amapulazi aleli zwe. Impendulo yami ithi SITHOLILE! Ukubekwa kwezimali kwabantu ngo-2006/07 lapha esifundazweni nasemhlabeni jikelele kubeka izindlela ezicacile ezihlinzeka ngempendulo kulezi zicelo zomphakathi. Ngonyaka ka-2007, akekho ozosisebenzisa amabhakede njengama-toilets. Lesi sifundazwe asizukuhluleka ekufezeni lezi zinhloso zokuthuthukiswa. Yingakho kule bhajethi yalo nyaka kukhona izimali ezengeziwe kuzo zonke izinketho, ikakhulukazi kugcizelelwa uxhaso lwezokwakha. Lokhu kubekwa kwezimali kuzokhombisa izimali ezibekwe eceleni zephrojekthi ezithathwe njengezibalulekile nguMongameli ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo mayelana Nesimo Sezifundazwe ngesonto eledlule. Uma impilo yethu ibiyinhle, sizokwenza siphezu kwani ngoba unyaka udlule? Sethule uhlelo lokuguqula umnotho walesi sifundazwe ngonyaka owedlule ngenkathi sithumela ukwakhiwa kwezimali kuka-2005/06. Njengoba singena esikhathini esisha seminyaka emithathu yokwabiwa kwezimali, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngombiko wokuthi senze kanjani kulezi zabelo ezivela ngonyaka owedlule. Sibe nemiphumela emihle kakhulu ngonyaka owedlule emizamweni yokukhulisa umnotho nokwandisa utshalomali. Inhloso yethu enkulu ukuhlela lesi sifundazwe sibe sendaweni ehamba phambili ekuxhumaneni namazwe angaphandle nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukuhlelwa kwalesi sikhwama kuphelile. Ngokufanayo, ibhodi ezobhekelela ukusebenza kwalesi sikhwama ngaphansi kukaThala isiqokonyiswe. Umkhulumeli, lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi siqale lesi sikhwama ukuze sithinte umehluko. Ngakho-ke, simema abatshalizimali abazimele ukuba bazise izinhlelo ezinjalo ezingaphathwa ngaphansi kwalesi sikhwama. Ngonyaka owedlule savakashela ezindaweni ezinhlanu ukuze sikhangise abatshalizimali bangaphandle. Lokhu kuyindlela ebalulekile yokwenza ukuthi lesi sifundazwe sithole izimali ezilethwa ngaphandle. Sihambe sazi eJalimane, e-Italy, eKorea, eJapane, naseNdiya ngonyaka owedlule. Ulwazi oluningi luzothunyelwa esikhathini esizayo mayelana nokusebenza kwalezi zinhlelo. Angidingi ukukukhumbuza ukuba izithunywa ezihloniphekile ukuthi ngonyaka owedlule sathumela ukwakhiwa kwezimali okwakuyisisekelo sokulwa nobuphofu nokwandisa amathuba abantu emnothweni. Ngiyajabula ukufingqa lokho esikutholile kulolu hlelo. Umkhulumeli, sanelisekile ngenqubekelaphambili eyenziwe ekwakhiweni nasekuxhasweni kwezinkampani. UMongameli ugcizelele ngesikhathi ethula inkulumo mayelana Nesimo Sezwe ukuthi ukwesekwa kwezinkampani ezincane nezinkampani zabelwana kubalulekile kakhulu ezwenikazi. Kulesi sifundazwe, uhulumeni ubona leli hlelo njengokhiye wokuvula amathuba ezinkulungwane zabantu bethu ukuba bangene emnothweni. Ngonyaka ozayo, sizongena ohlelweni lokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zabelwana zihlala ziqhubeka futhi zingasebenza kahle. UThala noHulumeni Wesifunda bavuma ukuthi le mfuneko yezezimali ayikwazi ukuhlangatshezwane nguThala kuphela. Ngonyaka wezimali ozayo, sizobe siqala uhlelo olusha lokweseka abaqalayo - ngizokhuluma ngemininingwane ngalokho masinyane. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi uhlelo lokukhokhela abaqalayo ngizikhungo zikaHulumeni aluhlelwanga kahle. Kuvame ukuvele ukuthi luhlinzekwa uma kukhokhwa, kodwa umsebenzi usuwenziwe.
