Umqondisi Wohlelo: uMnu. Sipho Sithole UMongameli weCongress: uMnu. Jacob Zuma Unobhala S.W. uMnu. S.M. Zondi uMnu. O.T. Zondi Induna N. Namuhla sihlangene lapha ukuze sikhumbule ngenhlonipho uNduna Mbongeleni Zondi, umzukulu kaNduna Bhambatha KaMancinza Zondi - igwala elahola ukuphikisana noHulumeni wezobukhosi ngo-1906, owafaka intela yeKhanda Pondwe kubo bonke abesilisa abahlala kule ndawo. UNduna Bhambatha Zondi wahlaselwa ngamasosha obukhosi eMome Gorge ngoJuni 1906. UNduna Mbongeleni Zondi naye wahlaselwa ngokuqinile edolobheni laseUmlazi, ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalolunye ezedlule, ngomhla ka-22 kuJanuwari. UNduna Mbongeleni Zondi waba nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kukahulumeni wesifunda saseKwaZulu-Natal nomphakathi wakwaZondi ngesikhathi sokukhumbula iminyaka eyikhulu yokuphikisana kweKhanda ngo-1906. Amaphoyisa asondela kulabo ababi njengoba elandela umkhondo ojulile. Izinsalela zobufakazi ziqoqwa ezizoholela ekuboshweni okusheshayo kwalaba badlali. Ububi nobugebengu kuyinkinga enkulu ekhathaza imiphakathi yethu. Abantu bethu baphila besaba ngenxa yalezi zinsizwa. Ngenkathi abaningi bezakhamuzi besebenza kanzima ukuze kulethwe ukuthula nokuzinza lapha eKwaZulu-Natal, lezi zinsizwa ezimbalwa zikhathalela isikhathi sazo zokuhlela ukuceba ukuphila kwabanye. Nokho, sinehope nokuqhakambisa ukuthi, uma sihlangana, singashintsha konke lokhu, silwe nobugebengu, futhi siphumelele emkhankasweni wethu. Omunye wemizamo ephakanyisiwe ukuvula ngokushesha iCentre for Reconciliation and Dialogue ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthula nokusiza intsha ukuthi ibhekane nodlame nobugebengu. Isifunda sethu sesidlulile esikhathini sodlame nokuphulwa kwegazi. Siphumelele lesi sahluko kulesi sifunda. Manje sikhuluma ngentuthuko nokuthula. Sifuna ukuphila impilo engenabubi. Uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ngosuku nosuku, ngaphandle kokuphumula, ukuze wehlise izinga lobugebengu. Ngaphezu kwamaphoyisa akhona, uhulumeni wesifunda useqhamuke nohlelo lwe-Volunteer Social Crime Prevention Programme. Lolu hlelo lwabavolontiya lugxile ekulweni nobugebengu emphakathini, luhlanganisa abavolontiya emphakathini ukuze kwehliswe izinga lobugebengu nezenzo eziphikisana nezenzo zokwahlulela. Laba bavolontiya basebenza ngokubambisana namaphoyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bavikelekile emphakathini yabo. Lolu hlelo lusiza ukuhlanganisa umgudu phakathi kobugebengu nokwesaba izenzo zobugebengu. Kuze kube manje, sinezivolontiya eziyi-1,200 ezamukelwe ziqeqeshwe ezinhlelweni zokuqala usizo nokuzivikela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, osomabhizinisi abavela eGreater Manchester Police (Scotland Yard) baqeqeshe abavolontiya abazokwenza ukuhamba ukuze bahlola ubugebengu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nomnyango wethu wamaphoyisa, iSouth African Police Service. Ukuthunyelwa kwalaba bavolontiya kuthunyelwa ezindaweni ezithile ezibekwe. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana okukhulu, uhlelo lwe-Volunteer Social Crime Prevention Programme luqale ukuhlolwa ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ezifana noGu, Uthukela, Amajuba, eThekwini, Umgungundlovu, kanye noMkhanyakude. Ezinye izifunda ezisele nazo zizothola lolu hlelo. Sizophinde silwe nobugebengu. UNduna Mbongeleni Zondi washona ngesikhathi lapho izinhlelo zikaHulumeni zokuthuthukisa ubuholi bendabuko esifundeni ziqala ukuvuna. Umthetho Wokuhola Nokuphatha, 2003 (Umthetho No. 41 ka-2003) kanye neKwaZulu-Natal Traditional Leadership and Governance Act, 2005 (Umthetho No. 05 ka-2005) kwazisa uhlelo olusha lokuphatha izikhungo zobuholi bendabuko. Ngo-2006, uhulumeni wasungula iHouse of Traditional Leaders kanye nezindlu eziyi-11 zeTraditional Council. Uhlelo lokulungisa ubuholi bendabuko luveze ukuthi ngaphezu kuka-90% kwezinduna ziguqulwa zaba ngababusi bendabuko. Lokhu kuhambisana noMthetho Wobuholi Bendabuko kanye neFramework yokuphatha lapha eKwaZulu-Natal, umthetho ka-2003 (Umthetho No.41 ka-2003) kanye neKwaZulu-Natal Traditional Leadership and Governance Act ka-2005 (Umthetho No. 5 ka-2005). Okwokuqala, abesifazane nentsha kulindeleke ukuthi babambe iqhaza ezindabeni ezihlobene nezikhungo zobuholi bendabuko. Ngo-2007, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi Nezindaba Zendabuko wanikela ngemiholo yama-Headmen abanguye amalungu ezikhungo zobuholi bendabuko. Ama-Headmen azothola izinsiza zezimali ezizosiza ukuthi basebenze kahle, ngokuphumelelayo, nangokwethembeka ezindabeni zezikole zobuholi bendabuko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngo-2008 kwanqunywa ukuthi zonke izindleko zokuhamba ezithathwe ngamalungu ezikhungo zobuholi bendabuko zizokhokhelwa uMnyango. Imiholo yama-Headmen yanda ukuze ihambisane naleyo ebekwe uMnyango Wezokuthutha. Ngo-2008, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi Nezindaba Zendabuko waqasha abaqondisi bazo zonke izikhungo zobuholi bendabuko nezindlu zendawo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zobuholi bendabuko nezindawo, uMnyango Wezangaphakathi Nezindaba Zendabuko ubambe umhlangano we-EXCO phakathi kwezindawo nezinduna. Ngo-1994, iNingizimu Afrika yasungulwa njengedemokhrasi. Namuhla siphila ngesikhathi sethemba, ukuhlonishwa kwesithunzi somuntu. Siphila ngesikhathi sethemba sokuthula, idemokhrasi, nentuthuko. Iningi lokuphila kukaNduna Bhambatha, futhi walwa ngalokhu kuze kufe, futhi manje sesikufeze. Iningi lokuphila kukaNduna Mbongeleni Zondi nakho kwaba yikho, wakholwa kulokhu, futhi namuhla sesikufeze. Ngakho-ke, uNduna Zondi ubuyiselwa endimeni yakhe efanele yokuhola, ngemuva kokushona, lokhu kunguhulumeni wethu onakekela. Ukuphumelela kokukhumbula kukaNduna Bhambatha ngo-2006 bekuyiqiniso nobuhlakani bukaNduna Mbongeleni Zondi ekubeni nombono obheke empilweni ngobuhlakani. Wayengumuntu ophakamisa igwala nobuciko futhi waguqula eminye imikhuba ukuze ihambisane nezikhathi zanamuhla. Waphakamisa iziphakamiso eziningi kuhulumeni ezihlose ukulethela abantu impilo engcono lapha eNgome. Walwa ngentuthuko nenkululeko kubantu abahluphekayo bomphakathi wakhe, abawathola kumkakhe, uNduna Bhambatha Zondi. UNduna Mbongeleni Zondi wayen gift enhle yokwakha ubudlelwano, okuyisibonakaliso esihle sokuthi induna kufanele ibe ngumuntu onakekela ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bakhe. Ngomhla ka-3 kuJanuwari 2009, uMongameli weCongress, uMnu. Jacob Zuma, nami sasi lapha eNgome simenywe yile nduna eshiywe, uNduna Mbongeleni Zondi, kanye nomphakathi wonke wakwaZondi. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakukhona kuphela indawo yokudoba i-tuna enezintambo ezinde ezisetshenziselwa indawo yokuhlola noma yokucwaninga le fish. Izindawo zokudoba ezihlola zikhombisa ukuthi abalobi bezinhlanzi baseNingizimu Afrika bangakwazi ukuhamba inqwaba ye-swordfish. Nokho, futhi kukhombisa ukuthi kukhona isidingo sokuthuthukisa ubuhlakani nomlando wezokusebenza mayelana nokudoba i-tuna. Inhloso kwakuwukwakha indawo enkulu yokudoba usebenzisa izintambo ezinde eNingizimu Afrika; kanye nokwakha umlando wezokudoba kanye nolwazi olugcinwe ngenani lezinhlanzi ezibanjwe endaweni yokudoba. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezindawo zokudoba i-tuna, i-swordfish, kanye ne-shark ezijulile akuphumelelanga enqubweni yokwabiwa kwamalungelo ngonyaka ka-2005. Izindawo zokudoba i-shark ezijulile zathuthukiswa ngomhla zingu-31 kuZibandlela, 205, kodwa amalungelo anikezwa kuphela kubantu abangu-9 ngaphansi kwe-MLRA ngenhloso yokudoba i-shark ezijulile usebenzisa izintambo ezinde. Kulaba bangu-9, amabili alezi zikhwama awaqinisekiswanga, kushiya abaninimandla abangu-7 okwamanje bedoba i-shark ngezintambo ezinde. I-quota yezenhlanzi evunyelwe ukubanjwa ezindaweni ezijulile usebenzisa izintambo ezinde ivumele ukwabiwa kwamalungelo okubamba i-20 swordfish kanye ne-30 tuna ngonyaka ka-2005. Amalungelo angama-17 anikezwe i-swordfish, kanye nelungelo elilodwa elengeziwe elinikezwe ngemuva kokuhlaziywa okwenziwe yinkantolo. I-total ye-tuna rights eyabiwe yaba ngu-26. Lokhu kusishiya namalungelo amabili e-swordfish kanye namalungelo amane e-tuna angakabiwa. Kubaninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana abanezikweletu eziyisikhombisa ezindaweni zokudoba i-shark ezijulile, amabili awo anikezwe amalungelo okudoba ezindaweni ezijulile usebenzisa izintambo ezinde ngonyaka ka-2005. Lokhu kushiya abaninimandla abahlanu bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana ngaphandle kwamalungelo abawabiwe okudoba ezindaweni ezijulile usebenzisa izintambo ezinde. Uma laba baninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana befaka izicelo futhi bengavinjwa ngokungahlangabezani nezimfuneko ezibekiwe, bazonikezwa amalungelo enqubweni entsha yokwabiwa kwamalungelo. Uma laba baninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana befaka izicelo, abasoze badinge "ukuncintisana" nabanye abafaka izicelo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abaninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana nabanye abafaka izicelo bazovunyelwa ukufaka izicelo zamalungelo okudoba i-tuna kanye ne-swordfish kufomu elilodwa lokufaka izicelo, bebonisa ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lokudoba abathanda. Ngemuva kokuthi izicelo zamukelwe, umphathi onegunya uzokwenza imizamo yokubheka inqwaba yabaninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana uma kudingeka ukuthi umphathi onegunya afake isicelo sokushintsha noma sokuguqula amalungelo e-tuna asekhona abe amalungelo e-swordfish noma ngokuphambene. Inhloso ebalulekile yale mthetho ukuhlanganisa izindawo zokudoba i-shark usebenzisa izintambo ezinde nezindawo zokudoba ezijulile zezinhlanzi ezinkulu kanye nokwabiwa kwamalungelo angakabiwa. Njengoba kushiwo, uma abaninimandla bamalungelo okudoba wesikhashana bengekho namalungelo okudoba ezindaweni ezijulile, bahlala behlangabezana nezimfuneko ezibekiwe kulomthetho, kufanele babekwe ohlwini labo abazodoba kulezi zindawo zokudoba. Noma yiziphi amalungelo angakabiwa azowabiwa ngokuhambisana nenqubo yokuncintisana, efana naleyo esebenziswe yiMnyango kule minyaka edlule mayelana nokwabiwa kwamalungelo. Nokho, abafaka izicelo abangaphumelelanga abahlangabezani nezimfuneko ezilindelekile ngeke baphoswe. Bazobekwa kwisikimu esithile futhi babekwe ohlwini "lokulinda" futhi banikezwe amalungelo uma amalungelo ethola ukutholakala, ngaleyo ndlela kuvumela iNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ithuthukise izinga lokubamba izinhlanzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inhloso yokwabiwa kwamalungelo okudoba ngezinhloso zokuhweba ezindaweni zokudoba ukuhlinzeka ngezindawo zokudoba ezizinzile emanzini ajulile eNingizimu Afrika usebenzisa izintambo ezinde ngezinhloso zokuhweba, kuhlanganise ne-sharks ezindaweni ezijulile ezidobayo ngezintambo ezinde nokufeza izinhloso ezishiwo ngezansi. Ukuguqula nokwakha kabusha imboni yokudoba kuyinjongo kahulumeni futhi inhloso yale mthetho ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokubhekana nale mfuneko ebalulekile. Amalungelo awabiwe ngokuhambisana nalomthetho azophela kanye namalungelo awabiwe okudoba ezindaweni zokudoba ngonyaka ka-2005. Ngamanye amazwi, wonke amalungelo okubamba izinhlanzi ezinkulu usebenzisa izintambo ezinde emanzini ajulile azophela ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari 2015. Kukhona isidingo sokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa umlando wezibalo zezinhlanzi eNingizimu Afrika emanzini ajulile, ikakhulukazi i-tuna; kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali okukhulu okudingekayo ukuze kufinyelelwe ezindaweni zokudoba ezinkulu zomhlaba. Zonke izicelo zizohlolwa ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko ezibekiwe "ezinezimfuneko." Abaninimandla bamanje bamalungelo okudoba i-shark ngezintambo ezinde abangekho namalungelo bazonikezwa amalungelo ngaphandle kokuphikiswa ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko ezinezimfuneko. Abanye abafaka izicelo abangakhethwanga bazohlolwa ngokwehlukana ngokuhambisana nezimfuneko "ezihambelanayo" ezisetshenziswe ekuhloleni. Isikali noma izimfuneko ezisetshenzisiwe zizokwenziwa ukukhetha abafaka izicelo abaphumelele mayelana nale qembu labafaka izicelo. Njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, lo Mnyango ngeke uqhubeke nenqubo yokwabiwa kwamalungelo kuze kube amalungelo akhona ephelelwa yisikhathi. Uma kukhona amalungelo atholakalayo ngaphambi kwalolo sikhathi ngenxa yokuhoxiswa noma ukwenqaba kwamanye amalungelo, isikali esisetshenzisiwe lapho kucaciswa le nqubo yokwabiwa kwamalungelo sizosetshenziswa ukuze kwabiwe amalungelo esikhathini esizayo, uma atholakala. Uhlu "lokulinda" luzophinde lwenziwe ukuze luhlinzeke ngalokhu. Ukufaka izicelo ngendlela engafanele: Isicelo sithathwa njengokufakwa ngendlela engafanele uma samukelwa sekwedlule; uma umfaki-sicelo engakhokhanga noma ekhokhe isilinganiso esiphakathi noma sekwedlule sokukhokha izimali zesicelo; noma uma sithunyelwa ngendlela engahambisani nemiyalelo, njengokusebenzisa umgudu, noma ngendlela ethile engabekiwe yokufaka izicelo. Umphathi onegunya kanye noNgqongqoshe abakwazi ukwephula umthetho mayelana nezimfuneko zokufaka izicelo. Iphutha kufomu lesicelo: Isicelo liqukethe iphutha uma umfaki-sicelo engasayinanga i-affidavit, noma uma i-affidavit yomfaki-sicelo ingaqinisekiswanga nguMphakathi Wokuhlola, noma uma izicelo ezingaphezu kwesisodwa zamukelwe kumfaki-sicelo
Lo mbhalo kufanele ufundwe njengengxenye yesitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo zezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni). Umnyango Wezemfundo uveza ngokuqhakazile lesi sitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo zezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha kwalesi work akukaze kube umsebenzi olula nhlobo. Izikhathi eziningi, abantu abake basebenza kule msebenzi yokuhumusha baphoqeleka ukuba benze amagama amasha ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Lezi zimpapasho zithunyelwe futhi kubachwepheshe kulezi zilimi ukuze zihlolwe. Umnyango Wezemfundo ubheka lezi zimpapasho njengesisekelo sokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufundisa ukuba asebenzise lezi zimpapasho njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Ukuhlola umfundi - lesi sahluko sinikeza umhlahlandlela wezinga lokuhlola lemfundo elisekelwe eziphumeleni, sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokuhlola, futhi siphinde sinikeze izibonelo zemikhuba yokugcina amarekhodi. Uhlu lwezinto okufanele zifundwe lunikeza uhlaka olujwayelekile lwezifundo kanye nohlu lokuhlola noluhlu oluhambisana ngqo nezifundo ezithile. Umzimba walencwadi uhlukaniswe ngezihloko eziningi. Isahluko ngasinye sithinta izinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa kwemfundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa okujwayelekile - izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, nezinga eliphakeme. Isahluko ngasinye kulezi zinga sihlanganisa ingxenye yokwethula eyamfushane, izindlela zokuhlola zezigaba ngazinye. Izindlela zokuhlola zezigaba ngazinye zethulwa ngendlela yokwenza intuthuko yokufunda ibonakale. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindlela zokuhlola ezifanayo zezigaba ngazinye ziqondiswa ukuze uthisha akwazi ukuqhathanisa intuthuko yokufunda eminyakeni. Lokhu kudala izikhala kwezinye izindawo, njengoba hhayi zonke izindlela zokuhlola zifana kuzo zonke izigaba. Imfundo esekelwe eziphumeleni 1 Isitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu: Izitatimende zezindawo zezifundo 2 Isitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu: Izinhlelo zezifundo. UMsunguli wezwe laseNingizimu Afrika, (Umthetho 108 ka-1996) unikeza isisekelo sokuguqulwa nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokufunda eNingizimu Afrika. Futhi ukuze kwakhiwe iNingizimu Afrika ephethwe ngentando yeningi nokuqhubeka, futhi ekwazi ukuthatha indawo yayo efanele njengendawo ezimele phakathi kwezizwe ezihlukahlukene zomhlaba. Imfundo kanye nohlelo lwezifundo kudlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso. Uhlelo lwezifundo luhloselwe ukuthuthukisa amandla omfundi ngamunye ukuba abe yisakhamuzi esigcwele saseNingizimu Afrika esephethwe ngentando yeningi. Imfundo esekelwe eziphumeleni. Imfundo esekelwe eziphumeleni iyisisekelo sohlelo lwezifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Ihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abafundi bangathola ulwazi ngokusemandleni abo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlela iziphumo okufanele umfundi ngamunye azifinyelele kanye nomfundi ekupheleni kwazo zonke lezi zenzo. Futhi ukwazi ukukhombisa ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba wakhiwe ngohlelo lwezingxenye ezihlukahlukene ngokukwazi ukubona ukuthi umqondo wokuxazulula izinkinga awukwazi ukuba uzimele. Bakwazi ukuzama izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda ngempumelelo. Bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza njengabantu abaphethe imithwalo yokubhekana nezimpilo zomphakathi abawuthandayo, ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bakwazi ukuba nezinhlonipho futhi bathinteke ngezamasiko nobuhle obukhona ezimweni ezihlukahlukene zomphakathi. Futhi ukudala amathuba ebhizinisi. Izinkinga ezihlobene nobubha, ukungalingani, ukucwaswa ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ubudala, ukukhubazeka, nezinkinga ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS kanye ne-AIDS uqobo zonke zinefuthe ezingeni nasekutheni abafundi bafunda esikoleni. Isitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo zezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni) sigcizelela indlela ebanzi ngokugqamisa izidingo ezincane zabafundi bonke. Zonke izitatimende zezindawo zezifundo zihlose ukuveza ubudlelwano obukhona phakathi kokuphila ngendlela efanele, amalungelo abantu, indawo ephephile nehlanzekile ezibambile, kanye nokufakwa kwabo bonke. Abafundi baphinde bakhuthazwe ukuba bazi futhi baqonde kabanzi ngohlobo lwezinto ezikhona ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngamasiko, inkolo, kanye nezwe, okuyizici ezibalulekile zalezi zihloko. Isitatimende ngasinye sezindawo zezifundo sikhombisa iziphumo zokufunda okufanele umfundi azifinyelele ekupheleni kwesigaba sika-9. Isitatimende ngasinye sezindawo zezifundo sichaza kahle indlela yokuhlola engafinyelela eziphumeleni zokufunda ezilindelekile. Izindlela zokuhlola zichazwa kahle ngesisekelo sezigaba nezinga, kanye nobubanzi nobukhulu bolwazi okufanele abafundi bazi nokuthi kufanele bakwazi ukwenza ini. Izindlela zokuhlola zalokho kanye nezitatimende zezindawo zezifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ulwazi namakhono angathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zindlela zokuhlola zingahlanganiswa ezigabeni ezifanayo noma zihlanganiswe ezigabeni ezingafani. Ikhono lokwakha ubudlelwano ngokukwazi ukuhlanganisa izigaba kanye nekhono lokuthuthukisa ulwazi kusuka kulesi zinga kuya kwenye kuyisisekelo salolu hlelo lwezifundo olusha. Isitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo sihlose ukukhulisa ukuzibophezela nolwazi phakathi kwabafundisi, abazoba yibo abahlanganyela ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zabo zezifundo. Ukuze kusekelwe leli hlelo, uMnyango Wezemfundo uzokwethula umhlahlandlela wezokuphatha osetshenziswe kuzo zonke izitatimende zezindawo zezifundo. Izifunda nazo zizoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imihlahlandlela yazo ukuze zibhekane nezihlukahluka ezikhona ukuze zicabangele ukuhlukahluka kwezifunda. Iziqondiso nezinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala esitatimendeni sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo nasemazingeni ezifundo zisisekelo sohlelo lokufunda. Njengoba izindawo zezifundo zigcizelela ukufinyelela kolwazi, amakhono, nezinto ezibalulekile zemfundo ngesisekelo sezigaba nezinga, izinhlelo zezifundo zigcizelela ukwakhiwa kwalokho okuzofundwa nokuthi umsebenzi uzohlolwa kanjani ezingeni ngalinye lemfundo. Izinhlelo zezifundo zifaka futhi uhlu lwezabelo okufanele ziqedwe lapho isivinini sokuthi kufanele ziqedwe kanjani nokuthi kufanele zilandela kanjani unyaka nonyaka kanye nezibonelo zehlelo lwezifundo okufanele zisetshenziswe phakathi nesikhathi esinikeziwe. Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, kunezinhlelo zezifundo ezintathu: ikhono lokufunda nokubhala, ikhono lokubala (ukusebenza ngezibalo), nolwazi lwezempilo. KuMasipala amalungelo awo ngaphansi koMthetho Wezindlu, 1997, sifunda konke ukuze sithole abanye futhi iMUNICIPALITY ingakha lezi zindlu shana 40.2 yesisombululo nesigaba 2. IMunicipality imema bonke abantu abangalungiswa amalungelo abo ngalesi sikhathi sokusetshenziswa komhlaba ukuhlela kuMasipala, izincwadi zabo kufanele ziqondiswe kuMphakathi weDolobha, zifike kungakapheli uNovemba 13, 2009 (ku-elinye lamakheli alandelayo), ukuze baveze imibono yabo nganoma yini ethinta bona mayelana nale ndlela esemthethweni yokusebenzisa umhlaba.
UMkhandlu we-eThekwini uhlela ukwakha izindlu ezibiza kancane endaweni yaseMawoti. Inani elihlosiwe lezindlu ezizokwakhiwa lingu-1,650, kanti abantu abangu-3,000 kulindeleke ukuthi bathole izinsizakalo. Ukuze uMkhandlu ukwazi ukwakha lezi zindlu, kudingeka uthenge umhlaba okukhuluma ngawo ngezansi. Njengoba uMkhandlu ungakwazi ukwenza izivumelwano zangasese nabanikazi balemiphakathi, kuphakamiswa ukuthi uMphakathi weDolobha asebenzise amandla akhe ngaphansi kwesigaba 40.2 somthetho weSishayamthetho sikaDisemba 10, 2007, ukuze lo mhlaba uthenjiswe uMkhandlu ngokukhishwa kwesaziso ngaphansi kwesigaba 9 somthetho kazwelonke ophathelene nezindlu, iHousing Act, 1997, efundwa ngezinsuku 2.4, 6 kuya ku-15 no-18 - 23 ze-Expropriation Act, 1975, kanye nesigaba 25 seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi. UMkhandlu uxhumene nabanikazi abaziwayo balemiphakathi nabanye abanamalungelo kuyo. Nakuba kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana nabanye nokuhlanganisa ulwazi ngabo, akukwaziwa ukuthi uMkhandlu unawo wonke ulwazi olufanele. Inhloso yale saziso ukwazisa abanye ababandakanyekayo ngenhloso kaMkhandlu yokuthola lo mhlaba ngokomthetho.
Umkhandlu wezindawo ubiza bonke abantu okungenzeka ukuthi amalungelo abo angathinteka kule msebenzi ophakanyisiwe wokuthengwa komhlaba ukuba babhale kumkhandlu, beqondisa izincwadi zabo kumphathi wezakhamuzi, ukuze zifike kungakapheli umhla ka-5 kuMfumfu 2009 (kanye nakwezinye zezikhungo ezishiwo ngezansi), ukuze baveze imibono yabo ngezindaba ezingabathinta mayelana nalokhu kuthengwa komhlaba okusemthethweni. ISIMEMO ukuba kube ngu-946 kanti bangu-1500 abanikazi ngabaphuma isaziso salokhu ngenkathi kuxoxwa nabanikazi abaziwayo - Inhloso yalesi saziso ukuwazisa IZINGA EZITHINTWE abahlelwe ukuba babe nalezi zindawo, eziphakanyiswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 9 salo mthetho mayelana nalezi zindawo kanye nezinye izingxenye ezithintekayo EZIHLELWE NOMKHANDLU zinikezwa ngezinsiza. Ukuze umkhandlu usebenzise amandla awo phezu kwezindlu, umthetho wezindlu uyasebenza. Nakuba lo mhlaba uzame ukuthengwa ngokomthetho. Umkhandlu ubiza bonke abantu okungenzeka ukuthi amalungelo abo angathinteka kule msebenzi ophakanyisiwe wokuthengwa komhlaba ukuba babhale kumkhandlu, beqondisa izincwadi zabo kumphathi wezakhamuzi, ukuze zifike kungakapheli umhla ka-13 Novemba 2009 (kanye nakwezinye zezikhungo ezishiwo ngezansi), ukuze baveze imibono yabo ngezindaba ezingabathinta mayelana nalokhu kuthengwa komhlaba okusemthethweni.
Umbiko onikeziwe kanye nazo zonke izimvo zomphakathi zizoba yingxenye yale mibiko. Iningi lomsebenzi we-NA lenziwa kumaKomidi. Umsebenzi wekomidi ngalinye uhambisana nomnyango wezokuphatha ofanele. Isibonelo, iKomidi Lezohwebo Nezimboni libhekana nazo zonke izindaba eziphathelene noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Ikomidi ngalinye linomholi ozokwenza uqinisekise ukuphathwa kahle komsebenzi. AmaKomidi ePhalamende azobhekelela ukuxoxa, ukuphatha izingxoxo, nokuhlela umthetho. AmaKomidi angabamba Ukuhlolwa Komphakathi kumthetho noma ezindabeni ezihlobene nomthetho. AmaKomidi futhi abheka futhi ahlola umsebenzi weminyango kahulumeni. NgokweMthethosisekelo, iPhalamende kudingeka ibandakanye umphakathi enqubweni yokwenza umthetho nakwezinye izinhlelo zePhalamende. AmaKomidi ePhalamende adingeka axhumane namalungu omphakathi ukuze athole iminikelo yabo kumthetho noma ukuze azwe imibono yabo ngezindaba ezibalulekile zizwe. Umphakathi ukhuthazwa ukuba ube neqhaza elivelele ezinkulumweni lapho amaKomidi ebamba Ukuhlolwa Komphakathi. Abantu noma amaqembu akhuthazwa ukuba athumele izikhalazo zomlomo noma ezibhaliwe ngezindaba ezithinta bona. Xhumana namalungu ePhalamende asebenza kwi-NA ukuze ubuze noma ucele ulwazi mayelana nomsebenzi wabo wePhalamende. Hamba ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ezibanjwa amaKomidi ePhalamende. IPhalamende inezindlu ezimbili, okungukuthi iNational Assembly (eyaziwa njenge-NA) kanye neNational Council of Provinces (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP). I-NA ivotelekwa kabusha njalo eminyakeni emihlanu ezivotelweni zikaZwelonke. Omunye wemisebenzi eyinhloko ye-NA ukuwuphasa umthetho okumele izwe liphathwe ngawo. I-NA ithumele amaBill kumaKomidi ukuze abhekwane nawo futhi kuphathwe izingxoxo ngalezi zBill. I-NA ingavuma, iphikise, noma ibuyisele amaBill kumaKomidi ukuze kuxoxwe ngaphezulu. IPhalamende inomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlaziya, ukuhlola, nokubheka umsebenzi kahulumeni noma noma yiliphi ilungu le-Executive, mayelana nokuphathwa kwemithetho, ukusetshenziswa kwezimali, nokubheka iMthethosisekelo. Izingxoxo zePhalamende ngezindaba ezibalulekile nokuphakanyiswa nokuvota ngeziphakamiso ezihlobene nomsebenzi kahulumeni. I-NA inegunya elivela kwiMthethosisekelo lokukhetha uMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika phakathi kwamalungu ayo. I-NA inamalungu angu-400 ePhalamende aziwa njenge-MPs. Amalungu e-NA akhethwa ngohlelo olubizwa ngokuthi ukuveza ngokulinganayo. Ngaphambi kokhetho, iqembu ngalinye lezepolitiki lidala uhlu lwabafakizicelo abazobamba iqhaza ekhethweni ukuze bakhethwe. Lezi zifakizicelo zikhuluma zikhuluma ngendlela elinganayo nenani lezivote iqembu lezepolitiki elithole ekhethweni. Isibonelo, uma iqembu lithola uhhafu lwezivote, lizothola uhhafu kwezihlalo kwi-NA. Umphakathi kanye noMphakathi wePhalamende baphatha imihlangano ye-NA. Baqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ePhalamende akhuluma ngokukhululeka kodwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho yeNational Assembly. Imithetho yeNdlu inikeza ukuthi abaholi beNdlu basize iziphathimandla zePhalamende ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Abaholi beNdlu bangase badingeke futhi ukuba baphathe izinqubo zeNational Assembly. Iqembu ngalinye lezepolitiki kwi-NA likhetha umphakathi omkhulu ozophatha izindaba zalo. UMongameli uqoka umholi wezebhizinisi zikahulumeni osebenza nabaholi bezindlu zombili zePhalamende. Umholi wezebhizinisi zikahulumeni kufanele acabangele izidingo zeBhodi kanye nezinhlelo zikahulumeni kwiPhalamende. Umholi wezebhizinisi zikahulumeni uqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu eBhodi enza imisebenzi yawo yePhalamende.
Lo mbhalo kufanele ufundwe njengengxenye yesitatimende esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke zamabanga R-9 (ezikoleni). UMbutho Wezemfundo uzithokozisa ngokwethula lesi sitatimende esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke zamabanga R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zeNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha lo msebenzi bekungelula neze. Izikhathi eziningi, abantu ababephatha lo msebenzi wokuhumusha bekudingeka ukuthi bakhe amagama amasha kwezinye izindawo. Le mibhalo ithunyelwe futhi kubachwepheshe kulezi zilimi ukuze bahlolisise. UMbutho Wezemfundo ubheka le mibhalo njengethuba lokuqala lokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufunda ukuthi asebenzise le mibhalo njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Ukuhlola umfundi - lesi sahluko sinikeza umhlahlandlela wezinga lokuhlola imfundo elisekelwe emiphumeleni, sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokuhlola, futhi siphinde sinikeze nezibonelo zezindlela zokugcina amarekhodi. Okuqukethwe kwencwadi le kubhalwe ngezahluko eziningi. Isahluko ngasinye sikhuluma ngezinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa kwemfundo nokuqeqeshwa okujwayelekile - izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, izinga eliphakeme. Isahluko ngasinye kulezi zinga sihlanganisa ingxenye yokwethula emfushane, izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izinga. Izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izinga zethulwa ngendlela ezokwenza kube lula ukubona intuthuko yokufunda. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindlela zokuhlola ezifanayo zazo zonke izinga ziqhubeka ngendlela yokuthi uthisha angakwazi ukuqhathanisa intuthuko yokufunda eminyakeni. Lokhu kudala izikhala kwezinye izindawo, njengoba hhayi zonke izindlela zokuhlola zifana kuzo zonke izigaba. Ngokuqondile kubhekiswe ku-11 Ukuqala - Izigaba R-1 11 Amakhono okuyifunda nokubhala ayisisekelo 11 Intuthuko yabafundi - Izigaba 2 12 Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono 12 Ukuqinisa Intuthuko - Izigaba 3 13 Ukuthuthukisa Ulwazi LwesiZulu - Uhlelo, amagama, kanye nokwakhiwa kwamagama. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho 108 ka-1996) unikeza isisekelo sokuguqulwa nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokufunda eNingizimu Afrika. Futhi wakha iNingizimu Afrika ephethwe ngedemokhrasi nokuhlanganyela futhi ekwazi ukudlala indima yayo efanele njengombuso ozimele phakathi kwezizwe ezihlukahlukene zomhlaba. Imfundo kanye nesifundo kudlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso. Isifundo sihlose ukuthuthukisa amandla okuthi umfundi ngamunye abe ngum citizen ophelele waseNingizimu Afrika ophathwa ngedemokhrasi. Imfundo esekelwe emiphumeleni. Imfundo esekelwe emiphumeleni iyisisekelo sesifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Ihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abafundi bangathola ulwazi ngokwezinga labo lokwazi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlela imiphumela okufanele abafundi bayifinyelele kanye nomfundi ekupheleni kwazo zonke izinto ezenziwayo. Futhi amandla okukhombisa ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba wenziwe ngokuqhamuka kwezingxenye ezihlukahlukene ngokukwazi ukubona ukuthi umqondo wokuxazulula izinkinga awukwazi ukuhlukaniswa. Bangazama izindlela ezahlukene zokufunda ngempumelelo. Bangabamba iqhaza njengabantu abaphethe izibopho ekuxazululeni izimpilo zomphakathi abawakhayo ezindaweni zabo, ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bangaba nobuhlakani futhi bathinteke ngamasiko nobuhle obukhona ezimweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Futhi bakhe amathuba ezamabhizinisi. Izinkinga ezihlobene nobuphofu, ukungalingani, ukuhlukumeza ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ubudala, ukukhubazeka, nezinkinga ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS kanye ne-AIDS uqobo zonke zithinta izinga nendlela abafundi abafunda ngayo esikoleni. Isitatimende esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke zamabanga R-9 (ezikoleni) sikhombisa isu eliphelele eligcizelela izidingo ezincane zabafundi bonke. Zonke izitatimende zezifundo zizamile ukukhombisa ubudlelwano obukhona phakathi kwendlela efanele yokuphila, amalungelo abantu, indawo ephephile nephilile ebazungezile, nokufaka wonke umuntu. Abafundi baphinde bakhuthazwe ukuba bazi futhi baqonde kabanzi ngohlukahluka kwezinto ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngamasiko, inkolo, kanye nezwe, okuyizici ezivelele zale nhlobo. Isitatimende ngasinye sezifundo sikhombisa imiphumela yokufunda elindelekile okufanele umfundi ayifinyelele ekupheleni kwesigaba sika-9. Isitatimende ngasinye sezifundo sichaza kahle izindlela zokuhlola ezingafinyelela imiphumela yokufunda elindelekile. Izindlela zokuhlola zichazwa kahle ngezigaba nezinga, kanye nobubanzi nob depth bolwazi okufanele abafundi bakhulelwe nokuthi kufanele bakwazi ukwenza ini. Izindlela zokuhlola zesitatimende salo msebenzi zikhombisa ukuthi ulwazi namakhono angathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zindlela zokuhlola zingahlanganiswa ezigabeni ezifanayo noma zixhunywe ezigabeni ezingafani. Amandla okwakha ubudlelwano ngokusebenzisa amandla okuhlanganisa izigaba kanye namandla okuthuthukisa ulwazi kusuka kwelinye izinga kuya kwelinye kuyisisekelo salo msebenzi omusha wesifundo. Isitatimende esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke sihlose ukukhulisa ukuzinikela nolwazi phakathi kwabafundisi, abazoba yibo abazobamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zabo zezifundo. Ukuze kusekelwe leli hlelo, uMbutho Wezemfundo uzokwethula umthetho oholayo osetshenziswe esitatimendeni ngasinye sezifundo. Izifunda nazo zizoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imihlahlandlela yazo ukuze zixazulule ukuhlukahluka okukhona ukuze zicabangele ukuhlukahluka kwezifunda. Iziqondiso nezinto ezisemqoka ezitholakala esitatimendeni esibuyekeziwe sezikole sezifundo zikazwelonke nasemazingeni ezifundo ziyisisekelo sezinhlelo zokufunda. Njengoba izindawo zezifundo zigcizelela ukufinyelela kolwazi, amakhono, nezinto ezisemqoka emfundweni ngezigaba nezinga, izinhlelo zezifundo zigcizelela ukuklama lokho kuzofundwa nokuthi umsebenzi uzohlolwa kanjani ezingeni ngalinye lemfundo. Izinhlelo zezifundo ziqukethe uhlu lwemisebenzi okufanele iqedwe lapho isivinini sokuphothulwa kwazo kufanele sibe khona kanye nesigaba sokulandela unyaka nonyaka, kanye nezibonelo zehlelo lesifundo okufanele lisetshenziswe phakathi nesikhathi esinikeziwe. Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, kunezinhlelo zezifundo ezintathu: Amakhono okuyifunda nokubhala ayisisekelo, ubuchwepheshe obuyisisekelo (ukusebenza ngezibalo), nolwazi lwezempilo. Ezingeni eliphakathi, Ulwazi LwesiZulu kanye nezibalo zihlala zihlukaniswe njengezinhlelo ezizimele zezifundo. Ezinye izinhlelo zezifundo kufanele zithuthukiswe ezikoleni ngemva kokuthi zithole imvume evela kuMbutho Wezemfundo wesifunda. Izifunda kufanele zenze izinqumo ngokuqhathaniswa kwezifundo ezingaqhathaniswa ezingeni eliphakathi. Ezingeni eliphakeme, kunezinhlelo eziyi-8 zezifundo ez
Umnyango Wezemfundo uveza ngokuqhakazile lesi simemezelo esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole sikazwelonke sezikole ezimaphakathi nezinga le-R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha kwalesi sikhathi akukaze kube umsebenzi olula. Kwesinye isikhathi, abantu ababephakathi kokuhumusha le misebenzi babephoqeleka ukuba bakhe amagama amasha kwezinye izindawo. Lezi zinkomba zithunyelwe kubachwepheshe bezilimi ukuze bahlolisise. Umnyango Wezemfundo ubheka lezi zinkomba njengesisekelo sokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufunda ukuba asebenzise lezi zinkomba njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Ukuhlolwa kwabafundi - lesi sahluko sinikeza umhlahlandlela kumigomo yokuhlola imfundo esekelwe kumiphumela, sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokuhlola, futhi siphinde sinikeze izibonelo zezindlela zokugcina amarekhodi. Okuqukethwe kwale ncwadi kuhlukaniswe ngezahluko eziningi. Isahluko ngasinye sikhuluma ngezinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa kwemfundo kanye noqeqesho jikelele - izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, kanye nezinga eliphezulu. Isahluko ngalinye kulezi zinga liqukethe ingxenye yokwethula okufushane, izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izinga. Izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izinga zethulwa ngendlela ezokwenza ukuthi inqubekela phambili yokufunda ibonakale. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindlela zokuhlola ezifanayo zazo zonke izinga ziqhathaniswa ukuze uthisha akwazi ukuqhathanisa inqubekela phambili yokufunda eminyakeni. Lokhu kudala izikhala kwezinye izindawo, njengoba hhayi zonke izindlela zokuhlola zifana kuzo zonke izigaba. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho 108 ka-1996) uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuguqulwa nokuthuthukiswa kohlelo lwezemfundo eNingizimu Afrika. Uhloswe ukwakha iNingizimu Afrika enobudlelwano nezwe elihlangene elingakwazi ukudlala indima yalo efanele njengombuso ozimele phakathi kwezizwe ezihlukahlukene zomhlaba. Imfundo nomgomo wesikole kudlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso. Umgomo wesikole uhlose ukuthuthukisa amandla abafundi bonke ukuba babe ngamalungu aphelele omphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enobudlelwano. Imfundo esekelwe kumiphumela iyisisekelo somgomo wesikole eNingizimu Afrika. Ihloswe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abafundi bangathola ulwazi ngokwezinga labo lokwazi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlela imiphumela okukhulunywa ngayo ukuthi abafundi kufanele bayifinyelele ekupheleni kwemisebenzi yonke. Lokhu kuvumela abafundi ukuba baveze ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba wenziwe ngempahla ehlukahlukene, futhi ukuthi isizathu sokuxazulula izinkinga asikwazi ukuhlukaniswa. Bakwazi ukuzama izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda ngempumelelo. Bangaqhuba njengamalungu aphumelelayo emiphakathini abahlala kuyo, kokubili endaweni nasemhlabeni jikelele. Bangaqonda futhi baphathwe yizinkolo nezimfashini ezikhona ezimweni ezihlukahlukene phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene. Futhi ukuze bakhe amathuba ebhizinisi. Izinkinga ezihlobene nobuphofu, ukungalingani, ukuhlukumeza ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ubudala, ukungakwazi, nezinkinga ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS kanye ne-AIDS uqobo zonke zithinta izinga nendlela abafundi abafunda ngayo esikoleni. Isimemezelo esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole sikazwelonke sezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni) sikhombisa isu eliphelele eligcizelela izidingo ezincane zabafundi bonke. Zonke izimemezelo zezifundo zihlokoma ubudlelwano phakathi kokuphila ngendlela efanele, amalungelo abantu, indawo ephephile nephilile ezibambile, kanye nokufakwa kwabo bonke. Abafundi baphinde bakhuthazwe ukuba bazi futhi baqonde ukuhlukahluka kwezinto ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngamasiko, inkolo, kanye nobuzwe, okuyizici ezivelele zalo ukuhlukahluka. Isimemezelo ngasinye se-subject sikhombisa imiphumela yokufunda okulindelekile okufanele umfundi ayifinyelele ekupheleni kwesigaba sika-9. Isimemezelo ngasinye se-subject sikhombisa kahle izindlela zokuhlola eziholela ekufezekiseni imiphumela yokufunda okulindelekile. Izindlela zokuhlola zichazwa kahle ngesisekelo nesigaba, kanye nobubanzi nobunzima bolwazi abafundi okufanele bakuthole nokuthi kufanele bakwazi ukukwenza. Izindlela zokuhlola zazo zonke izimemezelo zibonisa ukuthi ulwazi namakhono angathuthukiswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zindlela zokuhlola zingahlanganiswa ezigabeni ezifanayo noma zixubene ezigabeni ezingafani. Ikhono lokwakha ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganiswa kwezinga kanye nekhono lokuthuthukisa ulwazi ukusuka kwenye izinga kuya kwenye kuyisisekelo salo mgomo omusha wesikole. Isimemezelo esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole sikazwelonke sihlose ukwandisa ukuzinikela nolwazi phakathi kwabafundisi, abazoqhamuka ukuze babambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zabo zemfundo. Ukuze kusekelwe leli qophelo, Umnyango Wezemfundo uzokwethula umgomo oholayo okhishwe esimemezelweni ngasinye se-subject. Izifunda nazo zizoqhubeka nokuthuthukisa imihlahlandlela yazo ukuze zihlolisise ukuhlukahluka okukhona ukuze zicabangele umehluko phakathi kwezifunda. Imigomo nezinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala esimemezelweni esibuyekeziwe somgomo wesikole kanye nezimemezelo zezifundo ziyisisekelo sezinhlelo zokufunda. Njengoba izindawo zezifundo zigcizelela ukufezwa kolwazi, amakhono, nezinto ezibalulekile zemfundo ngesisekelo nesigaba, izinhlelo zomgomo ziqhakambisa ukwakheka kwalokho okuzofundwa nokuthi umsebenzi uzohlolwa kanjani ezingeni ngalinye lemfundo. Izinhlelo zomgomo zifaka uhlu lwezisebenzi okufanele ziqedwe, lapho isivinini sokuphela kwazo kufanele sibe khona kanye nesigaba sokulandela unyaka nonyaka, kanye nomgomo wesikole okufanele usebenze phakathi nesikhathi esishiwo. Ezingeni eliyisisekelo, kukhona izinhlelo zomgomo ezintathu: ikhono lokufunda nokubhala, ikhono lokubala (ukusebenza nezibalo), nolwazi lwezempilo. Ezingeni eliphakathi, ulwazi lwezilimi kanye nezeMthetho zihlala njengezinhlelo zomgomo ezizimele. Ezinye izinhlelo zomgomo kufanele zithuthukiswe yizikole ngemva kokuthola imvume kuMnyango Wezemfundo wesifunda. Izifunda ngokwazo kufanele zenze izinqumo mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwezifundo ezinganikezwa kuzo zonke izifunda eziphezulu ezingeni eliphakathi. Ezingeni eliphezulu, kukhona izinhlelo zomgomo eziyisishiyagalombili ezisekelwe ezindaweni zezifundo. Ukwabiwa kwesikhathi kwezifundo ngakunye kunqunywa kuzo zonke izigaba nezinga. Isimemezelo ngasinye se-subject sihlanganisa ingxenye yokuhlola ebanzi. Umgomo osekelwe kumiphumela usebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezingabhekana nezihloko ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlola kufanele kubonise kahle ukuthi umfundi ubonisa ulwazi kanjani ngempumelelo nangokufanele, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bayathatha futhi basebenzise amakhono abawaphe
Ukuhlolwa kwezimiso zomphakathi kuyindlela yePhalamende yokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni uhlala enesibopho kubantu. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuhlola njalo (ukulandela) izinhlelo zohulumeni. IPhalamende kanye neKomidi layo linamandla okukhanga noma ubani noma inhlangano ukuze ihlinzeke ngobufakazi noma ikhiphe imibhalo ethile, bese ibika kubo. Umthethosisekelo uthi iPhalamende inegunya lokuvakashela wonke amalungu ohulumeni, kuhlanganise nalabo abakwezifunda kanye nezinga likamasipala. Ukuvakashela kohulumeni ezindaweni zomphakathi kuyinselelo ebekwe kwiPhalamende nguMthethosisekelo ukuze kuhlolwe futhi kulandelwe uhulumeni. Ngokubhekelela izinhlelo zohulumeni, iPhalamende ingaqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu kuyenzeka, ukuze bonke abantu baphile impilo engcono futhi enhlonipho. IPhalamende ibheka uhulumeni ngezizathu ezilandelayo: ukubheka nokuvimbela ukuziphatha okungafanele ukuvimbela ukuziphatha okungemthetho nokungemthethweni okuvela kuhulumeni ukuvikela amalungelo nezikhala zabantu ukuwenza uhulumeni abe nesibopho ngendlela imali yokuhlawula izintela esetshenziswe ngayo ukuwenza ukusebenza kohulumeni kube sobala futhi kukhuphule ukwethenjwa komphakathi kuhulumeni. IPhalamende inezindlu ezimbili, okungukuthi: iNdlu yeSizwe (eyaziwa njenge-NA), kanye neNdlu yeZifunda (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP). Izinhlaka zineqhaza elithile ekuhloleni okufanele lidlale. Umthethosisekelo uthi iNdlu yeSizwe ikhethwe ukuze imele abantu futhi iqinisekise uhulumeni onenhlonipho kubantu ngaphansi komthethosisekelo. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokuthi: kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amalungu ohulumeni angakwiHulumeni kazwelonke angabekwa phansi kwesibopho sokuphatha kwawo, nokubheka ukusebenza kuhulumeni kazwelonke, kanye nokuphumeleliswa kwemithetho egcizelelwe yiPhalamende. I-NCOP imele izifunda ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zixazululwa ngaphakathi komkhakha wohulumeni kazwelonke. Iqhaza le-NCOP ukuhlole ukusebenza kuhulumeni ezingeni likamasipala nezifunda. I-NCOP ingacela ilungu leKhabhinethi, isisebenzi soHulumeni kazwelonke, noma umphakathi wombuso wezifunda ukuba baphumelele emhlanganweni weNdlu noma komidi. AmaKomidi ePhalamende asungulwa njengamathuluzi ezindlu zombili ngaphansi komthethosisekelo ukuze ahlole futhi alandele uhulumeni. La maKomidi "ayizinjini ezinamandla" zePhalamende zokuhlola uhulumeni nokwenza imisebenzi yePhalamende. AmaKomidi abheka imithetho, ahlole ukusebenza kohulumeni, futhi abambisane nomphakathi. Omunye wemibandela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuhlola uhulumeni ezindaweni zomphakathi ukuhlela imibiko yokuhlola yokuhamba kwemali yohulumeni ngamaKomidi, kanye nemibiko ye-Auditor-General. Ngokwezidingo zokuhlola ukusebenza kohulumeni, iKomidi ingacela umbiko omfushane kulungu lesimo noma ingavakashela le ndawo ukuze iqinisekise amaqiniso. UNgqongqoshe WezeMali umemezela izinhlelo zebhajethi zonyaka wezimali ozayo, kanye nezinsuku zebhajethi zazo zonke izigaba. Ngemva kokwethulwa kwezinsuku zebhajethi, iKomidi ngalinye libamba izinkulumo nezinsizakalo zohulumeni ezihlobene lapho lenza ukuhlola komphakathi ngoba amalungu omphakathi abizelwe. Lokhu kusebenza njengokuhlola ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iSigaba sigcine imisebenzi yaso evela eminyakeni edlule, nokuthi isebenzise imali yokuhlawula izintela ngendlela efanele. Ukubuza imibuzo kuhulumeni kuyindlela eyodwa iPhalamende ebamba ngayo uhulumeni esibopho. Imibuzo okufanele iphendulwe ngokuqondile noma ngokuqopha ingaqondiswa kumongameli, kumongameli ophakathi, kanye noNgqongqoshe mayelana nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo. Isikhathi semibuzo sinikeza Amalungu ePhalamende ithuba lokubuza amalungu ohulumeni mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu, imele amaqembu abo ezepolitiki noma abantu abavotele. Ngokusebenzisa le nqubo, Amalungu ePhalamende angakwenza izitatimende eNdlu nganoma iyiphi indaba. Ngokunikeza Isaziso seMoti, ilungu noma yimuphi umphakathi wezepolitiki lingathumela izinkinga noma ukukhathazeka ukuze kuxoxwe ePhalamende, ngaleyo ndlela kusiza ukuba kuqedwe imisebenzi yokuhlola komphakathi njengohulumeni. Ukuxoxisana kwePhalamende kuyindlela enye yokuletha ulwazi olubalulekile phambi kuhulumeni ukuze luhlolwe mayelana nezinhlelo zohulumeni ezithile noma imithetho edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kubantu. Umsebenzi wehhovisi lesifunda unikeza Amalungu ePhalamende ithuba elihlukile lokwenza ukuhlola komphakathi egameni kuhulumeni kuphela. Umsebenzi wehhovisi lesifunda unikeza indlela eduze yokuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu ePhalamende nomphakathi. Amalungu anomsebenzi wokwazisa iPhalamende nganoma yiziphi izinkinga abazithola ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana kokuhlola komphakathi. Ukwenza isethulo kwiKomidi yePhalamende kuyindlela enye yokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale ePhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokuthonya imibono yamalungu eKomidi axoxa ngengxenye ethile ye-bill ngaphambi kokuba ibe umthetho. Wonke umphakathi ophila lapha eNingizimu Afrika unelungelo lokufaka isicelo kuPhalamende, njengoba kubekwe emthethweni. Noma ubani, iqembu labantu, noma inhlangano ingafaka isicelo kuPhalamende. Isicelo siyisicelo esisemthethweni kumagunya ukuze sithathe isinyathelo. Singathatha ifomu lesikhalazo, isicelo sosizo, noma ukuphinda kuthunyelwe izikhalazo. Isimo somnotho womhlaba sisesimweni esinzima kakhulu uma siqhathaniswa neminyaka edlule. Inhlangano Yezabasebenzi Yezwe ibala ukuthi kungaba nabantu abangu-18 million abangase baphume emisebenzini yabo kulonyaka. Lesi simo singaba sibi kakhulu uma ukwehla komnotho kuqhubeka. Akukho sizwe esiphephile kulokhu kubi. Zonke izizwe, kuhlanganise nezithuthukile ezifana ne-United States, iBrithani, neFransi, azithembisi lutho uma kuziwa emnothweni. Nokho, isimo eNingizimu Afrika asibi sibi kangako, futhi sifuna ukusigcina njalo. Empeleni, sifuna umnotho wethu uqhubeke ukhula ukuze sikwazi ukuqhubeka sithuthukisa izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Sizodinga ukusebenzisa ikusasa ukuze sixazulule izinselelo esihlangabezana nazo. Njengoba kwenzeka kuzo zonke izizwe, izinga lokuthuthukiswa komnotho ezweni lethu lehle. Siphinde sihlangabezane nenkinga yokulahlekelwa kwemisebenzi, futhi abaningi bethu bazobhekana nezinkinga zokuhlangabezana nezindleko zethu. Ukwehla komnotho kuzoholela ekutheni uhulumeni uthole imali encane yokuhlawula izintela. Ngokuqinisekile, uhulumeni uzodinga ukuboleka imali ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo zakhe. Nokho, uhulumeni uzoqhubeka nokufaka izinsiza zezimali ukusiza labo abadinga usizo, futhi uzogcizelela izinhlelo ezidala imisebenzi. Ngaphezu kwe-780 billion rand izobhalwa ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza ezisemqoka eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Iziteshi zokukhiqiza amandla, imigwaqo,
Izikhulu zezempilo zingasebenza ukuvimbela lokhu. Ngakho-ke, vikela ekuxhumaneni nezilwane. Nakuba le ndlala inganqandwa, ibulalayo uma ingaphathwa ngesikhathi. Izilwanyana ezincane zingagwenywa futhi zixoshwe ngokwenza ukuthi zibe nendawo yazo kanye nokudla. Izinto ezincane zingasiza futhi zivikela le mfucumfucu engadini. Amamitha angamashumi amane. Hlola isakhiwo sakho ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi azikho izindawo zokungena noma izindawo ezamukela izilwanyana ezikhona. Imfucumfucu engafani nezincwadi eziphukile nezinsalela eziphukile nezinye izinsalela ezikona lapho zihlala khona nakwezinye izindawo. Izimpawu zokudla izithelo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezintathu zeplaki ezithinta abantu. Ubuhlungu bemisipha; ubuhlungu bekhanda; ubuhlungu nokukhuluphala kwezitho zomzimba, kanye nomphimbo, nomphakathi. Sithole ukuphathwa kusenesikhathi. Kulezi zindlela zokwelapha, kukhona ukucekelwa phansi kwezifo. Inhloso ukuvikela, ukunciphisa amathuba abantu ukuba baphukiswe izilwanyana ezincane noma baphathe izicubu zezinyama zezilwane. Susa izikhala, imfucumfucu, noma noma yini engase idliwe izilwanyana ezincane njengokudla kwezilwane zasekhaya nezilwane zasendle. Gqoka izigqoko uma uphatha isilwane esigulayo. Uma uhlala endaweni lapho kukhona ubhubhane bezilwanyana ezincane, gcina amakati akho nezinkunzi zihlanzekile, ukuze kungabi khona lezi zilwanyana futhi ungavumeli ukuba zibe yinkinga noma zihlale zikhona.

Ngithole umsebenzi ovela enhlangano yami/umsebenzi/umnyango/ukulwa nenkululeko ukwenza lo mbiko nokuhlinzeka ngalo msebenzi njengoba unikezwe kimi egameni lenhlangano. Uma ukhululiwe ejele futhi unecala elihlobene nezepolitiki elenzeka ngaphambi kosuku lwe-16 kuJuni 1999, noma uma usuphelelwe yisikhathi sokuhlala kwakho futhi unecala elihlobene nezepolitiki, ubheke kahle ukufaka isicelo sokuxolelwa kumongameli wezwe. Qaphela ukuthi uma icala olahlwe ngalo lingahlangene nezepolitiki, awukwazi ukufaka isicelo sokuxolelwa ngaphansi komthetho okhona. Nokho, ungafaka isicelo sokuxolelwa okujwayelekile ngaphansi kweSigaba 84 (j) seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, esinika amandla nomthetho kumongameli wokunikeza ukuxolelwa noma ukususa ezinye izigwebo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uqedele ifomu lesicelo ngokushesha. Emahofisini amakhulu nasezindaweni zomphakathi zeMnyango wezobuJustice kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KweMthethosisekelo www.gcis.gov. Uma udinga usizo ekuqedeni lawa mafomu, iphathi yakho yezepolitiki kufanele ikusize uqedele kahle. Ifomu lakho lesicelo kufanele lithunyelwe umuntu onegunya ophuma ephathini yakho yezepolitiki futhi kufanele lithunyelwe ngendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona i-affidavit noma ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi icala olahlwe ngalo bekungokwezepolitiki ngaleso sikhathi, nokuthi lokho okwenzile kwenziwa ngaphansi kwemiyalo yephathi yakho. Qaphela lapho uqedela ifomu lesicelo ngoba kuphela lawo aqediwe kahle azobhekwa. Kumele kube nomuntu oyedwa kufomu ngalinye. Lonke ulwazi kumele luqedwe kahle nangokwethembeka, futhi kumele luhambisane nawo wonke amadokhumenti asekelayo adingekayo. Iphathi yakho yezepolitiki ingathumela isicelo egameni lakho; kodwa uma benza kanjalo, kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi ifomu lesicelo liqediwe kahle. Kulindeleke ukuthi iphathi yakho iqinisekise ngaphansi kwefunga ukuthi icala olahlwe ngalo liyicala elihlobene nezepolitiki. Wonke amafomu ezicelo azobuyekezwa yiMnyango wezobuJustice. Ngemuva kwalokho, amafomu ezicelo azothunyelwa kwiKomidi okubizwa ngokuthi i-RG, ehlanganisa amalungu amaqembu ezepolitiki anendawo ePhalamende. Le komidi izobuyekeza isicelo ngasinye bese ithumela umbiko ophelele kumongameli wezwe ukusiza ekuthatheni isinqumo sokuthi akwenze noma awamukele isicelo sokuxolelwa. Le komidi izoqhubeka nomsebenzi wayo kuze kube uSepthemba 30, 2008. IMnyango wezobuJustice kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KweMthethosisekelo izohlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlobene nomsebenzi wehhovisi.
Mphakathi ophakeme, ngikhona namuhla ukuze ngethule iSikhumbuzo seBhajethi somnyaka wezezimali ka-2009/2010 weMnyango Wezokwakha, okuwumnyango onikezwe umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ezinye izigaba zikamasipala ngezinsizakalo zezakhiwo nokugcinwa kwezakhiwo. Ukuguqulwa kwezimpahla zikamasipala kanye nokuba nefa kubandakanya ukuthengisa, ukuhoxisa, ukushintshisana, nokupha. UMnyango Wezokwakha udlala indima ebalulekile kulolu suku esikuso. Siphakathi kwesikhathi lapho imali iphela emhlabeni jikelele. Umhlaba uhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zomnotho ezisekelwe kumkhuba owaziwa njengezomnotho zikaKeynes ukuze uzikhulule kulokhu kuhlupheka, njengoba kwenzeka ngeminyaka yama-1930. Le nkinga yahlulwa kuphela ngempela ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili lapho ukukhiqizwa kwezikhali kuhlinzeka ngemicimbi yokusebenza kubo bonke abangenamsebenzi. Nokho, kulezi zinsuku, asikwazi ukuthembela ekukhiqizeni izikhali ukuze sixazulule le nkinga ngoba imiphumela yalokho iyesabekayo. Ngakho-ke, sidinga uhlelo olusha lokuhlanganisa bonke abafuna imisebenzi kanye nalabo abangenamsebenzi ngenxa yokungabi nemisebenzi. Lapha eKwaZulu-Natal, silahlekelwe yimisebenzi eminingi yokukhiqiza kunoma iyiphi enye indawo. Kufanele singene esikhathini sethemba nokuvuselelwa, noma uma silahlekelwa ithemba, kufanele sivumele konke kuphume. Ngikholwa ukuthi lesi yisikhathi sokuvuselelwa nethemba lesikhathi esingcono. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi eKwaZulu-Natal, bafake ithemba labo nezifiso zabo kulolu hlelo lokuphatha lo mnyango. Ukuze sifeze lokhu, ngesikhathi sokuvuselelwa, uMnyango Wezokwakha uzibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi konke okwenziwe umnyango kuzobonwa ngokuqinile kokusebenza kanzima. Sizokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona indlela eyodwa yokubheka uhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nezifundazwe mayelana nalokho uhulumeni omusha akubona kubalulekile. Okubalulekile kithi kuzoba ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezakhiwo kanye nokuphathwa kwezakhiwo njengamathuluzi okuheha utshalomali futhi ngaleyo ndlela sakhe amathuba emisebenzi nezinkampani. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, isiko lokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izithakazelo ezithintekayo ekufezeni umsebenzi onikezwe lo mnyango kumele liqinisiwe. Nakuba kungelula, manje singasho ngokuzethemba ukuthi siqedile indima esinikezwe yona ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, futhi ngezinye izikhathi, kube nomuzwa wokungamukelwa. Naphezu kwalokhu, siqhubekile nokukhombisa ukuthuthuka ezingeni lomsebenzi wezinsizakalo zezakhiwo, isivinini sokuphothula umsebenzi, futhi kusenokuhlupheka ngalesi sikhathi. Umnyango ubheka ezinye izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi onikezwe wona nguhulumeni. Ezinye zazo zifaka ukulandela izinhlelo ezikhuthazwa abantu uqobo, zigxile kakhulu ekutholeni izinzuzo kubantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Siphakanyiswa ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zezigaba zethu zamakhasimende ngendlela ezohlangabezana nezinto ezibalulekile kuhulumeni. Ngakho-ke, sizosebenza ngendlela edala amathuba emisebenzi amaningi uma izinhlelo zikamasipala zisetshenziswa ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zamakhasimende ethu. Sizokwenza lokhu ngaphakathi kwebhajethi enikezwe kithi, ngokuya ngamanani adingekayo, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe nasemazingeni adingekayo omsebenzi. Umongameli weRiphabhulikhi, uMphakathi ophakeme uJacob Zuma, ukhulume ngohulumeni onakekela futhi osebenza kahle ophendula izidingo zabantu. Uthembise egameni lethu sonke njengesakhamuzi saleli zwe ukuthi "lo mnyango uzibophezele ekubekeni abantu phambili." Sizophumelela ekuxazululeni udaba lokuhamba kwabantu besuka ezindaweni zasemakhaya beya emadolobheni ngokukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezolimo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwasemakhaya kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abaningi bethu abalayishi. Lokhu kuthuthukiswa kwasemakhaya kufanele kuhambisane nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza futhi ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukise izinga lempilo. Ngalesi sikhathi, lapho kukhona ukuhlangana kokumbiwa nokukhiqizwa kwezinto, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya kuyisiphiwo esihle sokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu ngokuvumela ukuba babambe iqhaza ngqo. Lapho kukhishwa izikhangiso, kugxilwa kulokho uhulumeni akubona kubalulekile. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa okujwayelekile nokweseka uMnyango. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusiza uMnyango ngokuphathwa kobudlelwano bezabasebenzi, izindaba zomthetho, nokuphathwa kwezimali. Le ngxenye iyinhloko yomsebenzi walomnyango futhi ifaka konke okukhona kokuthengwa nokuhlala kwezakhiwo. Ngaphezu kokugcina uhlu lwezimpahla zikamasipala, uMnyango unomthwalo wokwenza uqinisekise ukuhambisana nomthetho owaziwa nge-GIAMA - okuma ku-Government Immovable Asset Management Act ka-2007. Inhloso eyinhloko yalolu hlelo ukuhlinzeka ngezakhiwo ngokuhambisana nohlelo lwezokwakha lomnyango kanye nebajethi ekhona. Le ngxenye iphinde ibheke ukugcinwa kwezakhiwo zikamasipala. Izwe lethu ligcwele ukushoda kwamakhono, futhi uhulumeni ubeke phambili ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono nokufundiswa. Kubalulekile ukuthi uxhaso lwenyuke ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono ngoba lokho kuzosisiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zemisebenzi. Ukushoda kwamakhono emkhakheni wokwakha nokuphathwa kwezimpahla kuphazamisa umsebenzi wethu. Lokhu kuphoqa uMnyango ukuthi uthembele kubasebenzi bangaphandle ukuze uqedele imisebenzi yawo, okwenziwa ngentengo ephezulu futhi akukwazi ukuqhubeka. Okwamanje, kunezithunywa eziyi-7 kulo Mnyango, kanti ababili babo abathole izifundo baphumelele ngokuphelele emisebenzini ngaphakathi koMnyango. Sizokuqhubeka nohlelo lwethu lokuqeqesha abantu bethu emnyakeni wezezimali ozayo, lapho sizophinde singenise uhlelo lokufunda lokuphathwa kwephrojekthi lapho umsebenzi wokwakha wenziwa khona. Ngokomlando, uMnyango Wezokwakha unabasebenzi besilisa abaningi kunezabasebenzi besifazane. Nokho, manje ngiyakwazi ukuveza ukuthi kube nokuthuthuka ekwakhiweni kwabantu besifazane. Kusukela emnyakeni wezezimali ka-2007/08, kube nokushintsha kuMnyango lapho iphesenti labesifazane, elangaphambili lalingama-25%, lenyuke laba ngu-35%. Nokho, siqonda ukuthi sisadinga ukwenza okuningi ukuze sifinyelele ku-51% yokwakhiwa kwabantu besifazane. Sizokuqhubeka ngonyaka lo ukubhekana nokwakhiwa kobulili endaweni yokusebenza ngokuba nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezibhekiswe ekulungiseleleni abesifazane ezingeni lokuphatha eliphakathi ukuze bathuthuke baye ezingeni eliphezulu. Asikafinyeleli umgomo we-2.6% wabantu abanokukhubazeka, kodwa kusekhona umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe ukuze kulungiswe lokhu. Ngifuna ukwenza kube sobala kulokhu okukhuluma okokuqala ukuthi ngizokwenza konke okusemandleni ami ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngaphansi kokuhola kwami, umnyango uzosebenza ngaphandle kokwenza noma yiziphi izenzo zokungathembeki ezifana nokukhwabanisa nokukhwabanisa.
