Isithombe 1: USamuel Moloi (Umfuyi Wonyaka ngo-2009) uthole u-3.5 tons we-wheat ngehektare kulonyaka. Isithombe 2: USamuel Moloi uthola i-wheat. Emazweni amaningi emhlabeni, abantu babheka ubhontshisi njengokudla okuyisisekelo kunokuthi kube yinto yokunethezeka. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, bekunjalo; iminyaka eminingi, abafuyi babeveza i-wheat eyanele ukuze bagcine ubhontshisi ezitobheni zethu. Eminyakeni emibili edlule, abafuyi babhekana nezinselelo ngoba babebhekene nobunzima bokukhiqiza i-wheat futhi benze inzuzo - izindleko zokuqala zokufuya zaziphezulu kakhulu futhi amanani emakethe ayephansi kakhulu. Abafuyi bezamabhizinisi, njengabanye abathengisi, kudingeka benze inzuzo uma befuna ukuphumelela. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla kufanele zibe phansi kunezinga lemali emakethe lokudla. Nokho, eminyakeni yamuva, izindleko zokuqala zokufuya zikhuphukile kakhulu; imishini yokufuya, i-diesel, umanyolo, imbewu, amakhemikhali, umshwalense, ukusika, kanye nokuhamba konke kukhuphukile. Nokho, amanani emakethe ayephansi. Abafuyi njengamanje babhekana nezinselelo ngoba kubonakala ukuthi abakwazi ukutshala i-wheat. Lapha, ngizohlola ukukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni zokufuya ezingenamanzi. Lokhu kuhlukile ezindaweni zokufuya ezinomjikelezo. Ezindaweni zokufuya ezinomjikelezo, ukutshala kwenzeka kabili ngonyaka futhi abafuyi bayazi ukuthi bazothola umkhiqizo ophakeme. Inzuzo ethola ezindaweni zokufuya ezingenamanzi ivame ukuba phezulu kunezindawo zokufuya ezinomjikelezo. Kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi asikwazi ukujikeleza zonke izindawo zokufuya ngoba izwe lethu alinamanzi anele. Futhi asikwazi ukucabanga ukuthi abafuyi bezindawo ezingenamanzi baphila kalula; akufanele sikhohlwe ukuthi basebenzisa ugesi ukuphumpa amanzi ezindaweni zabo zokufuya. Sonke siyazi ukuthi i-Eskom ifuna ukukhuphula amanani kagesi. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kuzokhuphula izindleko zokukhiqiza, mhlawumbe kuvinjeze abanye abafuyi ekukhiqizeni ukudla. Kungani abafuyi besaqhubeka nokutshala i-wheat? Abafuyi baqala ukutshala i-wheat ebusika eMpumalanga Free State ngenkathi ye-1950. Ngaleso sikhathi, izindleko zaziphakathi kuka-0.5 tons ngehektare, futhi ngokufuya okuhlakaniphile, bavame ukuvuna ithoni ephelele. Lokhu kungabhekwa njengomkhiqizo omncane, kodwa khumbula ukuthi ngaleso sikhathi, lezi zaziyizimbewu ezikhethekile futhi akukho umanyolo owawufakwe. Kodwa abafuyi benze inzuzo. Ezindaweni eziningi zeFree State, umhlabathi ungagcina amanzi. Imvula yasehlobo nemp autumn igcina emhlabathini, futhi i-wheat isebenzisa leyo mansi kuze kube imvula yasehlobo ifika. Abafuyi bebelokhu betshala i-wheat iminyaka eminingi, futhi ama-oats angaphandle angena ezindaweni. Lokhu kwaba inkinga ngoba le plant ifana kakhulu ne-wheat, okwenza kube nzima ukuyibulala ngaphandle kokulimaza i-wheat uqobo. Abafuyi baphushwa ukuba bafune ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo ezifana ne-maize ne-barley ukuze baphinde bazitshale ne-wheat. Ukujikeleza izithelo zonyaka obandayo nezinyanga ezishisayo kwasebenza kahle. Ikakhulukazi kusize ukubulala amahlamvu. Ama-oats angaphandle akhula ebusika angabulawe ezindaweni ngaphambi kokutshala izithelo zonyaka obandayo. Futhi amahlamvu asehlobo angabulawe kalula ezindaweni ze-wheat ngoba lezi zinhlobo zamahlamvu zineziqu ezibanzi, okwenza kube lula ukufaka amakhemikhali. Abafuyi baqala ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokujikeleza izithelo - olunye lungabukeka kanje: i-wheat ne-wheat, bese kuba ne-maize ne-maize, i-barley, bese kuphinde kube i-wheat. Umfuyi ngamunye ulandela uhlelo lwabo oluthandayo. Ngezinye izikhathi ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo - ngokuvamile izinhlobo ezinehlamvu. Manje abafuyi babhekana nenkinga - kudingeka bakhulise isithelo esikhula ebusika kodwa abakwazi ukutshala i-wheat ngoba i-wheat ayinikezi inzuzo. Bazokwenzenjani manje? Ingabe iNingizimu Afrika idinga abafuyi abakhiqiza i-wheat? Le yindaba enhle okufanele siyiqonde - ngisho nohulumeni kufanele abuze le mibuzo. Kungani kufanele sikhathazeke ngababuyayo? Ngubani ozonakekela uma beqeda ukukhiqiza i-wheat? Kuyiqiniso ukuthi umhlaba emhlabeni wonke uyancipha - izinto zithengwa futhi zidayiswa emakethe yomhlaba. Yebo, kungenzeka ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ingathenga yonke i-wheat edingekayo kwamanye amazwe, kanye ne-wheat edingekayo kwamanye amazwe afana neLesotho, eSwatini, naseBotswana. INingizimu Afrika inemali eyanele yokuthenga kwamanye amazwe. Khumbula ukuthi uma ufuna ukuthola imali yokukhokha kwamanye amazwe, kufanele ube nezimpahla zokuthengisa kwamanye amazwe ukuze uthole leyo mali? Amazwe angaphandle azoba ne-wheat eyanele edingekayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika unyaka nonyaka. Kuzokwenzekani uma bethatha i-wheat abanayo bese befuna ukwenza i-ethanol? Sizothola kuphi i-wheat? Ingabe kukhona imikhumbi ezoletha i-wheat lapha eNingizimu Afrika? Ingabe izikhumulo zethu zizokwazi ukuphatha yonke imikhiqizo yokudla edingekayo lapha nakwamanye amazwe asondelene? Ingabe imigwaqo yethu izokwazi ukuphatha ukuhamba kokudla konke okuvela olwandle? Sizothola kuphi abantu bonke abasebenza ezindaweni lapho i-wheat itholakala khona? Sizothola kuphi abantu bonke abasebenza ezinkampanini nasezindaweni zokugcina i-wheat? Kunabantu abaningi abampofu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni - kudingeka sakhe amathuba omnotho kulezi zindawo. Ukufuya kuyinto engcono engaholela ekukhuleni komnotho. Abafuyi bethu banelungelo lokwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nokukhiqiza. Kwenzekani kubafuyi abasha abamnyama? Sonke sisebenza kanzima ukuze sishintshe ukuhweba lapha eNingizimu Afrika - kunabafuyi abasha abamnyama abaningi abadinga ukutshala i-wheat ezinhlelweni zabo zokujikeleza izithelo. Njengamanje, sisaphumelela ekuxhaseni abafuyi abangena emkhakheni wezolimo ngoba banethuba lokuthola izibonelelo ezivela kuWinter Cereals Trust kanye neMnyango Wezolimo waseFree State. Uma sifuna ukuxhasa abafuyi abasha abamnyama emkhakheni wezolimo ongenamkhawulo, kudingeka sihlole kahle inzuzo yokutshala i-wheat. Yini isimo sokuthenga kwamanye amazwe? Kwamanye amazwe, isimo sezulu sikhona kahle sokutshala i-wheat - umhlabathi uyakhula futhi imvula iyanele (imvula iyawa njalo), futhi umswakama unikeza amanzi emhlabathini ngesikhathi sebusika (i-wheat encane ayibizi kakhulu uma kubanda). Izindleko zokukhiqiza kwamanye amazwe nazo ziphansi - intengo ye-diesel nomanyolo iphansi kunezaseNingizimu Afrika. La mazwe angakhiqiza i-wheat eningi bese ethengisa ngaphandle i-wheat eyengeziwe. Yebo, iNingizimu Afrika ingathenga i-wheat kwamanye amazwe - kodwa khumbula imibuzo esiyibuzile ngenhla. Sikholelwa ukuthi ingxenye yesixazululo salolu daba kungaba ukufaka umthetho wokuthenga i-wheat evela kwamanye amazwe. Uma i-wheat ifika evela kwamanye amazwe, umthengi walesi
Isithombe 1: Lokhu kuzokwenzeka uma ushaya ummbila ngamakhemikhali ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Isithombe 2: Qiniseka ukuthi ushaya amakhemikhali ngendlela efanele. Amakhemikhali asetshenziselwa ezolimo angalimaza kakhulu izitshalo zakho uma engafakwa ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nangokucophelela. Ukulandela izinyathelo ezifanele uma uthenga futhi ufaka amakhemikhali kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ukulimala kwezitshalo zakho. Ingabe kukhona ikhemikhali ethile ebhaliswe ukuze ifakwe emasimini athile (lapha eNingizimu Afrika) futhi ukuze ibulale izitshalo ezithile noma izifo ezithile? Ingabe ufake inani elifanele lekhemikhali ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo? Ingabe isimo sezulu ngesikhathi sokufaka nokuphuma kuhambisana nemiyalelo? Ingabe isikhathi sokufaka ikhemikhali sihamba kahle nemiyalelo, ngokwesibonelo: ekuseni noma ntambama? Ingabe isimo sehlathi lapho ifakwe sifeza izidingo zekhemikhali, ngokwesibonelo: umswakama nohlobo lomhlabathi? Ingabe ikhemikhali efakiwe ihambisana nemiyalelo mayelana nosayizi wezitshalo ofuna ukuzibulala? Imiphumela - ikhemikhali oyifakile akufanele ilimele ezinye izitshalo uma ushintsha izitshalo minyaka yonke - ingabe ngeke ibulale izitshalo zokudla ozohlela ukuzitshala unyaka ozayo? Ikhemikhali oyisebenzisayo ingahlanganiswa namanye amakhemikhali noma cha - ngokwesibonelo: ukuhlanganisa i-herbicide ethile namanye amakhemikhali abulala izinsongo nezifo? Imiyalelo yokufaka ikhemikhali kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi isayinwe ngumfaki. Abalimi kufanele babe nenhlonipho uma beshaya amakhemikhali ngoba amakhemikhali angahamba. Kungaba nesixwayiso esikhulu ezitshalo eziseduze ezingalimala ngamakhimikali. Kubalulekile ukuthi amakhemikhali angathinti ukudla. Ukufaka amakhemikhali ngendlela efanele nokugcina amarekhodi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukudla kuhlala kuphephile.
Ukuthuthukiswa kubalulekile abantu - kuhilela ukuxhumana nomuntu. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, kukhona abalimi abaningi abathintekayo emnothweni abanezinga lokwazi ukufaka umkhiqizo, abangakhiqiza noma iyiphi imbewu noma bakhule noma iyiphi impahla. Akukho ukuntuleka kolwazi - manje sekuyadingeka ukuthi leli nolwazi lidluliselwe kulabo balimi abamnyama ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuthola amandla okukhulisa ngokwabo ngokuqhubekayo. Iziqu zokuthuthukiswa eziqinile kanye nokuphila kwezindawo ezisemaphandleni okunempilo kuhilela ukubheka izinsiza/izimpahla ezikhona ezingasetshenziswa ngumuntu nokwandisa amandla alelo muntu okusebenzisa lezo zinsiza. Lezi zinsiza zihluka, zingaba abantu, ezomnotho, ezemvelo, njll. Uma sifuna ukuthuthukiswa kube namandla, kumele sisebenzise izinsiza ezikhona ezisetshenziswa abantu ukuze sithole ukudla nemali. Impilo engcono ibonisa ukuthola imali engcono, ukuphila kahle, ukudla kahle, nokusebenzisa izinsiza zemvelo ngendlela eqhubekayo. Umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa wakhe izisekelo namandla asetshenziswa abantu. Izimbangela zokuhlupheka zihluka, kodwa kunezinto ezivamile - imali ephansi, ukukhiqiza okuphansi, nokuntuleka kolwazi. Abantu abahluphekayo bavame ukungabandakanyi ubuchwepheshe obusha nezindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ukudla, baqhubeka nezindlela zakudala ngoba bengenalo ulwazi mayelana nezindlela zokulima ezintsha. Futhi abantu bavame ukwenqaba ukushintsha ngoba besaba okungaziwa. Bavame ukuhlala ezindleleni zakudala ngoba bayazi ukuthi zisebenza kahle. Khumbula ukuthi abazi ukuthi kunezindlela ezintsha ezinhle zokulima. Bavame ukukhetha izindlela ezinganqamuki. Abazozama ukufaka imbewu ehlukile ngoba besaba ukuthi umndeni wabo ungase ungabi nokudla kusasa. Ngezifundo zethu nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa, sivula umnyango kulaba balimi ukuze babandakanye nezindlela zokulima ezintsha, kodwa kumele siwavikele ekwehlulekeni, ngoba uma behluleka kungaholela ekuntulekeni kokudla ekhaya. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezigcina abantu behlupheka, ezifana: umswakama, izifo, izifo ezithathelwana emanzini, ukuhlaselwa yizilokazane, ukuwa komhlabathi, ukonakala komhlaba, nokuphakama kwenhlabathi. Uma uhluphekile, awukwazi ukuvikela ezinsongweni - mhlawumbe awazi ukuthi kukhona umshwalense nokuthi ungawuthola kanjani. Lapho umswakama uthinta imbewu yakho, uzophela ungena nokudla. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi umuntu ungumuntu ngokwakhe futhi ubamba ikusasa lakhe ezandleni zakhe. Kodwa imvamisa labo abaphatha umhlaba wethu banamandla okuzama ukulawula nokukhomba izimpilo zabantu abangaphansi kwabo. Ukuthuthukiswa kumele kuqale ezingeni eliphansi. Abantu abadinga usizo kumele baqonde kahle ukuthi usizo luzonikezwa kanjani bese bekhuphuka. Imvamisa izinhlelo ezibheka phansi labo abafuna usizo zenze laba balimi baziqhelanise nokwamukela usizo, abakwazi ukusiza ngokwabo. Lapho siqonda ukuthi umuntu ubamba ikusasa lakhe ezandleni zakhe, sizokwazi futhi ukuthi akusizi ukuhlinzeka umuntu ngentlanzi ngoba lokho akuthuthukisi, akufundisi ukuthi akhangele ngempela. Ukuthuthukiswa ngokwakha amandla kunika abantu amandla okusebenza ngokwabo. Ukunikeza kuphela ukudla kwenza abantu bahlale bephumule futhi bamukele kuphela, abakhuli ngokwabo, abafundi ukusebenza ngokwabo. Emphakathini wonke, kukhona abantu abaphatha umhlaba ngendlela engafanele futhi abahluphekayo bayahlupheka. Kukhona izici ezahlukahlukene zomnotho ezidalela ukuhlupheka, abantu abanemali yokonga, labo abakwazi ukuboleka, labo abangasebenzi ngokwabo, ukuntuleka kwezindawo zokugcina ukudla, ukuntuleka kwezinsiza nemishini, ukukhuphuka kwentengo, ukuthengisa, amanani aphansi, ukuntuleka kokuhamba, ukuxhumana, nokuguquguquka kwamanani. Kukhona izifunda ezibonisa ukuhlupheka lapha ezweni lethu. Abantu bayaphumelela, kodwa baqhubeka behlupheka, nakuba kunezinsiza zemvelo ezingasetshenziswa. Izindawo ezinkulu zinomhlabathi ojulile, onothe, kunezinga elanele lokushisa, kanye nezikhukhula ezanele zokukhulisa ukudla okuyisisekelo nezithelo zamafutha. Ukuhlupheka kuletha ukusaba kokuntuleka kokudla ekhaya. Abantu basaba ushintsho ngoba bezama ukuphumelela. Kukhona ukuntuleka kwezinsiza - ikakhulukazi imigwaqo, izikhungo, nezindawo zokomisa ukudla okuyisisekelo. Kukhona ukuntuleka kwemishini yokulima - ama-tractor, ama-ploughs, ama-planters, imishini yokufafaza, imishini yokuvuna, njll. Kukhona ukuntuleka kokwesekwa kwezinto eziyisisekelo zokulima. Kukhona ukuntuleka kokufinyelela emalini yokukhiqiza. Kukhona ukuntuleka kokungena emakethe. Kukhona ukuntuleka kokwesekwa okujolile ezikhungweni zikamasipala. Isimo sokuhlinzeka (sokuqala sathuthukiswa nguhulumeni wokuqala sakhula sibe yohlelo olukhulu lokuhlinzeka ng ukudla eMpumalanga Kapa). Kukhona ukuntuleka kolwazi namakhono. Kukhona ukuntuleka kwabantu abahola, abakhiqizi - bonke bephila ezindaweni ezincane futhi bekhulisa ukudla kuphela kubo. Ukuqasha abaqashi kwandisa ingozi yokuhlupheka ngoba basebenza kabi futhi izindleko zokukhiqiza zikhuphuka. Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni Zokudla lwe-Grain SA lugxile kakhulu ekukhiqizeni ufulawa. Singazibuza ukuthi kungani sigxila kakhulu kufulawa? Ufulawa uyinsiza yokudla, ngakho ukukhulisa ukukhiqizwa kwefulawa kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuzoba nokudla esikhathini esizayo futhi kukhona imakethe ekhona lapha (kusuka kufulawa oluhlaza (ama-cobs) kuya kumagilebhisi athuthukile). Ufulawa ukhiqizwa ngababalimi lapha, okusho ukuthi kukhona ulwazi olungasetshenziswa ukuze kuqhubeke. Iningi lefulawa lisetshenziswa lapha, futhi ligcinwa ngababalimi ekhaya - ngakho akudingeki ukuhamba, indawo yokomisa, nezindawo ezinkulu zokugcina. Ufulawa uyinsiza ekhula kalula futhi iningi lomsebenzi lingaqedwa ngesandla (lapho kungekho imishini). Lapho kukhona ufulawa oluningi, lungasetshenziswa umndeni wonke, abantu, izinkomo, izimvu, amahhashi, nezinkukhu, nezinkunzi. Ufulawa owanele wenza ukuphila kube ngcono kubo bonke. Kungani ukuthuthukiswa kwababalimi kuthatha isikhathi eside? Ukulima akusiyo into elula, ababalimi kumele bakwazi ukuphatha imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, futhi njalo kube nezinkinga nezingozi ezingavela. Izindleko zokuqala zokufaka ziphakeme futhi amanani okudla aphansi, ngakho kunzima lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukwenza inzuzo ezindaweni lapho kukhona kuphela ukulima okuncike emvula. Intengo yemishini iyamangaza. Ababalimi abanamava nalabo abaphakathi komnotho bayazama - singakuthi yini ngababali abathuthukayo abasaqhubeka nokukhula? Nabo bayazama kakhulu. Sikholelwa ukuthi yini esebenzayo uma sizama ukuphakamisa ababalimi? Wonke umuntu osebenza kulolu hlelo kumele asebenze ngokuzikhandla, ngokwethembeka - ukulima kuhlobene kakhulu nokuphakamisa umbulali, ngemuva kwalokho sizobheka umhlaba. Kumele siqale ngezimboni ezilula zokufaka, bese sihamba siye kwezinye izimboni eziyinkimbinkimbi. Nika umbulali ithuba lokuqala
Ngiyithola kanjani umhlaba? Kukho umbuzo ohlale ufika lapha kithi: "Ngifuna umhlaba (ifama). Ungangisiza?" Impendulo yethu njalo ithi "Cha, asikwazi." Sizama ukusiza abalimi ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lwe-Grain SA Farmer Development, kodwa asikwazi ukusiza abantu ukuthola umhlaba? Uma sizama ukwenza lokhu, ngeke kube nesikhathi sokuthuthukisa abalimi ngoba kukhona abantu abaningi abafuna ukuthola umhlaba nokuqala ukufama. Ohlelweni lwethu, sizama ukweseka labo abantu abanomhlaba nezinsiza. Ngemuva kuka-1994, kwasungulwa iMnyango omusha weZwe. Lo Mnyango waqala izinhlelo ezintsha zokushintsha ubunikazi bomhlaba. Lapha sizoxoxa kuphela ngokuqiniswa komhlaba, hhayi izimangalo zomhlaba nokushintsha kobunikazi. Khumbula ukuthi uhlelo lwethu luhlose ukuphakamisa abalimi bezomnotho, ngakho sizama ukusiza ukuthi basebenzise umhlaba wabo ngendlela efanele; asikwazi ukusiza abanye abafuna ukusungula amanye amabhizinisi. Uhlelo lokuqala lweMnyango weZwe kwakuyi-Settlement Land Acquisition Grant (SLAG). Lokhu kwakuhambisana kakhulu negranti enikezwa abantu ukuze bathenge indlu - R15,000. Nokho, akukho ifama engathengwa ngo-R15,000. Abantu baphinde bahlangana ukuze bathenge ifama. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani le nhlanganisela yokubamba umhlaba ingasebenzi kahle. Ngokuvamile, abaningi bacabanga ukuthi bangazuza ngokushesha ekufameni, kodwa babengenalo ulwazi lokufama futhi babengenakuphatha ibhizinisi. Kwakungekho mfuneko yokuthi labo abathola umhlaba bahlale efameni. IMnyango weZwe yashesha yaqaphela ukuthi 'SLAG' ayisebenzi kahle futhi yethula 'LRAD'. Kwakuyigranti enikezwa umuntu ngamunye (hhayi igalelo lomndeni). Umuntu onengcebo yakhe angathola igalelo elikhulu kunalesi (isibonelo: uma umuntu enama-R400,000, igalelo lakhe lingakhula laya ku-R100,000). Bawethula lokhu ukuze bakhange abantu abanokwazi abangaqinisekisa ibhizinisi. Kwakungekho mfuneko yokuthi labo abathola umhlaba bahlale efameni. IMnyango weZwe yabona ukuthi ngisho nalolu hlelo alusebenza kahle, ngakho baqala uhlelo olusha - iProactive Land Acquisition Scheme. Ekuqondeni kwabo, lokhu kuzokwenza labo abafuna ukufama bakwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi bangasebenzisa ifama ngaphambi kokuyinika. Uhlelo lwe-PLAS lusebenza kanje: Uhulumeni uthenga ifama ukuze anikeze abantu. Bese le ifama iyakhangiswa. Labo abafuna ukuyithola kufanele bakhombise (baveze) ngokucacile futhi banikeze izizathu ezichaza ukuthi bazofama kanjani. Isikhathi sokuphatha salo muntu ophatha ifama sithatha iminyaka emithathu, emva kwalokho bangathola ifama. Uma kuba sobala ukuthi bahluleka ukufama kahle, omunye "umphathi" ofuna ukufama uzobekwa endaweni yabo. Lolu hlelo lokushintsha ubunikazi bomhlaba lulethe nezinye izinkinga. Kwakungekho mfuneko yokuthi labo abathola umhlaba bahlale efameni. Lezi "zikhulu" zithola ifama esebenzayo ethola inzuzo, kodwa kaningi abazi lutho ngazo zonke izinto eziphathelene nokuphatha ifama. Kaningi izinsiza nezinsiza ezisemafamini zibhujiswa futhi azisebenzi kahle. Izindleko zokutshala ihektare eyodwa zingafinyelela ku-R5,000. Uma umlimi efuna ukutshala amahektare angu-200, okungesiyo indawo enkulu uma sikhuluma ngotshalo lwezomnotho, kusho ukuthi bazodinga ama-R1,000,000 kuphela ukuze babeke imbewu emhlabeni (lapho singakhulumi ngezindleko zokugcina nokulungisa ama-tractors nezinye izinsiza). Umlimi akasesona isikhulu sezinkambu futhi kaningi ubandakanyeka ulwazi oluhambisana nokufama. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi bazophoxa ukuza nemali edingekayo ukuze baqale ukukhiqiza. Ake sithi umlimi unayo imali edingekayo yokutshala nokulungisa izinsiza. Ucabanga ukuthi umuntu ohlakaniphile uzophonsa leyo mali yonke emapulazini kahulumeni nasezinsizeni ezingezakhe? Emafamini lapho kutholwa khona, kukhona imishini ehlukene - i-plough, i-disc, i-harrow, i-disc yokusika trasi, i-cultivator, i-rotovator, nezinye eziningi. Uma umlimi (ofuna ukufama) engakaze asebenze efamini, ngeke azi ukuthi iyiphi imishini enza umsebenzi muni - bazoyilungisa kanjani lezi zinto futhi bazisebenzise kahle? Umusho owodwa kule nkontileka phakathi komphathi kanye neMnyango weZwe uthi umphathi akavunyelwe ukuqasha lelo land noma ukubambisana nomlimi omunye ukuze afune lelo land. Ngaphandle kwezimali zokuqala zokutshala, ngaphandle kwemvume yokufama nomuntu onolwazi, umphathi uzofunda kanjani umsebenzi wokufama? Engxoxweni yethu lapha ngenhla, kubonakala ukuthi imizamo yethu yokushintsha ubunikazi bomhlaba ngendlela ezothokozisa wonke umhlaba wethu ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Izinselelo eziningi esingazazi ukuthi zizovela, kodwa abasebenzi abakhonza iMnyango wezolimo bazame ukucacisa lezi zinkinga. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sibe nesikhathi esinzima. Kodwa kumele sibhekane neqiniso lamanje. Esikhathini esedlule, ukufama kwakusezandleni zabantu abamhlophe (amaAfrikaner), ngakho kufanele sisekele ukuhlanganiswa kwabafama bezomnotho nalabo abafuna ukukhula emkhakheni wokufama. Imizamo kahulumeni kufanele ihlolwe futhi lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngesikhathi esifanele. Kukhona amaphrojekthi amaningi aphumelele ngenxa yezinhlelo esizixoxile lapha ngenhla. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi lokhu kwenzeke (buka ngenhla). Kubonakala ukuthi iMnyango omusha we-Rural Development and Land Reform uhlose ukuvivinya lezi zinhlelo ukuze umhlaba uqale ukukhiqiza ukudla ngaphambi kokuthi amaphrojekthi amasha aqale. Uma sifuna ukuvivinya lezi zinhlelo kube nomphumela omuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle ukuthi kwenzekeni ukuze zihluleke - ngisho noma izizathu zokuhluleka kwalezi nezi zingafani. Kulula ukuthi uhlelo oluthile luhluleke ngoba bekungekho mali. Yebo, ukungabi namali bekungumsebenzi, kodwa ukukhetha uhlelo oluthile bese kufakwa imali kuphela akuzukuvusa - kaningi kuzodala nezinye izinkinga ngoba labo abalahlekelwe imali ekuqaleni bazobuyela ngethemba lokubuyisela imali kulolu hlelo olusha. Siphakamisa kuphela "abaphathi" abazophila efamini. Ukufama akukuhle uma ungakaze ube khona efamini ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kufanele singenise "abaphathi" ohlelweni oluzobafundisa ukufama futhi bathuthukise amakhono abo. Lolu hlelo kufanele luphathwe ngombutho wabakhiqizi kule ndawo ophatha izinsiza ukuze abalimi abasha bakwazi ukuhlanganiswa nabafama bezomnotho ekuqaleni. Uma sifuna ukushintsha kwezolimo lapha eNingizimu Afrika kusebenze kahle, sidinga ukuhlanganisa izandla, sifunde ukuzethemba, futhi sihlanganise imikhakha yezolimo ukuze ukufama kube yisisekelo lapha ezindaweni zasemakhaya ezweni lethu.
Ukuthola imali - yini edingekayo futhi yini abayidingayo? Sonke sidinga ukweleta imali nganoma yisiphi isikhathi - ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezolimo wamanje. Empeleni, awukwazi ukuhweba ngaphandle kokusebenzisa imali eyalwe. Inkinga, nokho, ukuthi uma ulethela imali, ibhizinisi lakho lingase lingakwazi ukuyikhokha. Khumbula, inani lemali eliwelile kanye nesikhathi esithathwa ukukhokha le mali, intshiseko (izindleko) zalesi sikhwama ziya zanda ngaso sonke isikhathi. Intshiseko - Lezi yizindleko zokweleta le mali. Ngokuvamile, iyiphesenti ngonyaka lenani eliwelile. Izinga lentshiseko lishintsha njalo ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko noma izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni ezishintshayo. I-capital yokusebenza - Le yimali oyelile mayelana nohlelo lwakho lwezohwebo. Uma ulethela R100,000, imali yokubolekwa kweminyaka emihlanu izokwenza kube R130,000 kanti imali yokubolekwa kweminyaka eyishumi izokwenza kube R155,000. Kubonakala ukuthi le minyaka emihlanu ikhulisa izindleko ngama-R24,000 ukuze ulethele R100,000. Izinqubomgomo zebhizinisi zigxile kakhulu ekutholeni imali ukuze kuthuthukiswe ibhizinisi. Izinqubomgomo zakho kufanele zifake okulandelayo: imigomo yakho, izinto ezibalulekile, ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho lisebenza kanjani njengamanje nokuthi lizothola kanjani inzuzo esikhathini esizayo uma uthola imali ofuna ukuyelisa. Kufanele ukhombise kahle ukuthi uzophatha kanjani le bhizinisi elisha nokuthi unamandla okuphatha ibhizinisi. Ukuphuma kwemali kukhombisa ukuhamba kwemali ebhizinisini lakho. Lokhu kuzokhombisa umbolekisi ukuthi mangaki amaholo angena ngenyanga bese ubona ukuthi uzokwazi yini ukukhokha le mali ezinyangeni ezithile. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yonke mayelana nezimali zakho - noma iyiphi imali noma ukuthi ivela kuphi. Kuyiphutha uma ungahlinzeki ngemininingwane yonke mayelana nezindaba zakho zezimali uma ufaka isicelo semali. Ngokwalesi simiso, amabhange awavunyelwe ukuhlinzeka abantu ngemali uma kungenzeka ukuthi bazophumelela ukukhokha le mali. Lokhu kuvikela ibhange futhi kuvikela umbolekisi. Uma ungakwazi ukukhokha imali oyelile, ungabhaliswa njengomuntu ongakwazi ukweleta imali noma kuphi. Akekho ofuna igama lakhe kulolu hlu ngoba abazi ukuthi bangase badinge imali kusasa futhi ngeke bakwazi ukuyelisa. Lo mthetho usize amabhange ngesikhathi bekukhona ingozi enkulu ezindabeni zezimali ngo-2009 emhlabeni jikelele. Amabhange amaningi emhlabeni jikelele aphuka ngoba abolekisi abaningi bahluleka ukukhokha le mali. Umthetho wezeMali kazwelonke ukhona ukuvikela abantu namabhange ekukhokheni imali abengenayo. Usiza amabhange ngoba ngeke babe nemali eningi yokubolekwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abakhiqizi nezolimo baqashe uchwepheshe onolwazi ngezindaba zezimali emkhakheni wezolimo. Abalimi abakwazi ukwazi zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokuphatha izindaba zezimali ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi bonke abalimi, njengabaphathi bamabhizinisi abasebenza ngemali eyalwe, bakhombise ukuthi bayathembeka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Uma kukhona inkinga yokukhokha imali, kufanele ixoxwe kusenesikhathi ukuze bakwazi ukuvumelana ekugcineni. Zonke izinto ozithengayo ngemali oyelile zisho ukuthi unethemba lokuthi uzothola le mali emuva kusasa - ufuna ukuthi isebenze ngawe. Umfuyi kufanele azibuze ukuthi uqinisekile yini ukuthi uzothola le mali emuva. Ikakhulukazi njengamanje uma ubheka kahle emakethe, uma becabanga ngokutshala imali emkhenketheni, ngezintengo eziphansi nezindleko ezikhuphukayo, bazothola yini imali abayelile futhi kuzoba yini inzuzo? Sonke sibona ukuthi njengamanje, kukhona umkhenkethi omningi - kuzosisiza yini ukutshala imali emkhenketheni bese intengo yehlisa futhi uma kukhona umkhiqizo omuhle ngo-2010 - 2011? Ngokucabangela kahle, kungase kube ngcono ukungaboleki imali ukuze utshale emkhenketheni. Izindaba zezimali zihlupha futhi zihlale ziba yinkinga uma uphatha ibhizinisi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezolimo ngoba kunezingozi eziningi ezingavela. Umfuyi othile uzokhetha ukuba ngaphandle elungisa izinkuni, engahlali etafuleni elwa nephepha. Kodwa uma singanaki lezi zindaba zezimali, ngeke kube nezinkuni noma umhlaba ekugcineni! Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthola abantu abanolwazi abangakusiza.
Ibhakabhaka lekhanda lekhanda liyisithiyo esitholakala ezindaweni zonke lapho kukhula khona ummbila e-Afrika - lesi sithiyo sitholakala kuphela e-Afrika kanti nezinye izinhlobo zalo zihlala ezindaweni lapho ummbila ukhula khona. Ngokuvamile, singasho ukuthi lesi sithiyo sikhombisa ingozi efana no-10% yokukhiqizwa kommbila ngonyaka - kodwa singalimaza yonke imiphumela. Ama-larvae adla ezithelweni, ezitheni, nasezimbali zommbila. Ulwazi mayelana ne-biology nokuthi lesi sithiyo siphila kanjani kubalulekile uma sizama ukuqonda indlela yokulawula nokukhipha lesi sithiyo. Ama-larvae asemdala aphila ezitshalweni zommbila ezihlala ezindaweni ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngemuva kwalokho, isizukulwane sokuqala sezinambuzane sivele ukuze sibe neziqhamo ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-7 kuya kwezi-10. Ama-larvae aphumayo azodla amasonto ayisithupha bese eguquka abe ama-pupae ngaphakathi ezitheni zommbila. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu, ezinye izinambuzane zivele futhi ziqhube ingozi kuyo yonke indawo lapho zihlala khona. Ekuhlwanyeleni, kunezindlela eziningi zokulawula lesi sithiyo. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwemichiza, izinhlobo zezithombo, izindlela zemvelo, kanye nokulawulwa kwe-biological nezinye izithiyo. Lokhu ngeke kuqinisekise ukususa ngokuphelele kodwa kuzokusiza ukuphatha lesi sifo ngaphandle kokusabalala nokuthola umkhiqizo omuhle. Imichiza yokulawula ibhakabhaka lekhanda ibhaliswe njengezithiyo ezithinta noma izithiyo ezibulalayo uma zidliwa yilesi sithiyo. Kukhona abantu abacabanga ukuthi imichiza ebizayo ingcono, kodwa kukhona nezinye ezishibhile ezisebenza kahle. Kuthiwa ukuphatha lesi sithiyo ngemithi engabulali phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-6 kungase kube nokungabaza. Ngenxa kwezindleko zemichiza, abalimi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayisebenzisa ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuphalaza imichiza kusenesikhathi kubonakale kungasebenzi. Ukuphatha lesi sithiyo ngemichiza kufanele kwenzeke kuphela uma kubonwa ukuthi u-10% wezithombo ukhombisa izimpawu zengozi ngoba ama-larvae aqala ukudla ezithelweni. Ukuhlola ingozi ye-10% kungaba uphawu lokufaka imichiza ngesikhathi esifanele. Mhlawumbe ukuphalaza kuphela kungase kungabi yanele ngoba lesi sithiyo singavela futhi. Ngonyaka onjengalona, kungase kudingeke ukuhlola ngokucophelela ama-larvae uma ummbila uqala ukukhula. Uma ama-larvae amancane engabulawa ngokushesha ngaphambi kokulimaza okukhulu emasimini. Kufanele uzame ukususa lawa ma-larvae ngaphambi kokuthi ummbila ufinyelele cishe u-50% wokukhula. Ukwethulwa kwezinhlobo ze-Bt-maize kwehlelile ingozi yokungena kwezithiyo ngoba ngokuvamile azidliwa ibhakabhaka lekhanda. Lokhu kwenze imichiza ingadingeki kakhulu ngoba kukhona igene elibulalayo ama-larvae aleli sithiyo. Nokho, hhayi zonke izinhlobo ze-Bt-maize zisebenza kahle ngokufanayo nebhakabhaka lekhanda - ngakho-ke, abalimi kufanele bakhethe kahle ukuthi yisiphi isivuno okufanele bakhulise unyaka ozayo naphakade. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) kufanele bazi ukuthi kunezinsuku eziyishumi lapho ama-larvae ebhakabhaka lekhanda angadla ummbila. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba imichiza ixhumana nemvula etholakala esitsheni sommbila, ivumela ama-larvae ukuba aphile. Igozi elibangelwa yalesi sithiyo lizovela ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa ngeke kube yingozi enkulu. Lawa ma-larvae azokhiqiza izinambuzane ezizovunguza unyaka omusha. Uma ukhetha ukufaka imichiza noma ukutshala i-Bt-maize, kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi iyiphi inketho enezindleko eziphakeme ngoba i-Bt-maize ibiza kakhulu. Ukuhlwanyela ebusika kungasiza ngoba izithiyo ezihlala ezitshalweni zommbila emasimini zizobulawa futhi ngeke zibuye zivele unyaka olandelayo. Futhi, ubusika obubandayo buzobulala ezinye. Uma kutshalwa ebusika, kungaholela ekutheni ama-larvae aletheke emhlabathini, futhi izinambuzane azizukwazi ukuphuma futhi zibhakabhake unyaka omusha. Kukhona ezinye izibungu ezivamile ukudla amaqanda nama-larvae ezithiyo, kodwa azinciphisi kakhulu ingozi edalwayo. Abanye abalimi abangatshali izindawo ezinkulu bangazama ukutshala utshani obubizwa ngokuthi i-Napier - izithiyo zangenela emasimini futhi zishiya ummbila. Kodwa noma abanye abalimi abakhulu bangazama ukutshala lobu butshani ngoba buhle ukudla kwezinkomo. Izindlela zemvelo nokulawulwa kwe-biological nezinye izithiyo azisebenzi kahle - kungcono ukuzama imichiza noma ukutshala i-Bt-maize. Bonke abalimi bommbila bayazi kahle ukuthi ibhakabhaka lekhanda libeka ingozi enkulu. Kufanele kulawulwe kahle futhi ngendlela efanele.
Umsebenzi wezolimo awupheli. Lapho sicabanga ukuthi ukuvuna nokuthengisa isivuno kuphelile, umsebenzi wonyaka omkhulu omusha uqala. Manje yisikhathi esihle sokubheka okwenzekile ngonyaka odlule, ukuhlola izinqubo zokuphatha, nokubona ukuthi yiziphi izindlela ezisebenze kahle kakhulu. Uma ungakagcini amarekhodi wezinkambu ezithile eminyakeni edlule, kungaba kuhle ukuqala ngamarikhodi wonyaka odlule. Okulandelayo kufanele kufakwe kulawa marekhodi minyaka yonke: igama lephalamende, igama lesifunda, usayizi wephalamende, usayizi wezindawo ezilimiwe, ukujikeleza kwesivuno, izitshalo ezitshalwe, izindawo ezithola amanzi, izakhiwo, kanye konke okwakhiwe. Iphalamende ngalinye lingahlolwa mayelana nalokhu okulandelayo: indawo yalo (phezulu, eduze kwamanzi, njll.), ukujula komhlabathi, uhlobo lomhlabathi, umkhiqizo wombhali, nezinguquko ezimhlabathini ngokuhamba kwesikhathi (uma unama-result ezivivinyweni zomhlabathi), izinguquko ezitshalweni minyaka yonke, isivuno esatshalwe ngonyaka odlule (nangesikhathi sokutshala), ubunikazi besivuno, ukuqala kwemvula, inani lemvula ngaphambi kokutshala, inani lemvula ngesikhathi sokutshala, izindlela zokuphatha izihlahla (njengokusebenzisa amakhemikhali nokuthi zisebenza kanjani), ukulawulwa kwezinsongo, inani lesivuno, kanye quality. Izindleko zokufaka umanyolo zibalulekile kakhulu ohlelweni lwakho lwezolimo. Ukuthuthukisa isu elihle lokufaka umanyolo minyaka yonke kungaholela ezivunweni ezinhle. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi isimo sokukhiqiza somhlabathi sishintsha kanjani minyaka yonke. Ikakhulukazi, kufanele uhlolisise izimo zomhlabathi ngemuva konyaka omuhle. Isivuno esikhulu sithatha inqwaba yezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini, futhi uma kube nemvula eningi, izinto eziphilayo emhlabathini zingashintsha. Ngonyaka odlule, sabona ezindaweni eziningi ukuthi umumbu (nezinye izitshalo) ububomvu ngoba kube nokushoda kwe-nitrogen kanye ne-sulfur. Uma kube nesivuno esihle, kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ubuyisela zonke izinto eziphilayo ezithathwe izitshalo emhlabathini. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kubonakala ukuthi ama-samples kufanele athathwe njalo ezinkambini lapho izitshalo zikhula khona ehlobo. Imiphumela yalezi zivivinyo ingasetshenziswa ukukhetha isivuno ofuna ukusitshala - umumbu, ubhontshisi, i-soybeans, i-sorghum, ama-nuts, ama-patato, ama-peas, noma okunye konke - lezi zivivinyo zizokutshela ukuthi ungathola kanjani inzuzo enhle ngoba zonke lezi zitshalo zidinga izinto eziphilayo ezahlukene. Imakethe yezitshalo ezithile izosiza futhi ukukhetha ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo okufanele uzihlanganise. Kunendlela ehlukene okufanele ilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwezinga lezinto eziphilayo nomanyolo kulungile ngendlela yakho yokulima. Lokhu kufaka izinto ezifana nokuthatha nokuhlola ama-samples ngendlela efanele, izindlela zokuhlola ezifanele, kanye nemiyalezo efanele ezokusiza ekulimaleni kwakho manje nasekusaseni. Ukuhlolwa komhlaba kuhlose ukuthola amazinga ezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini ezizosiza izitshalo zikhule kahle. Kuhlose futhi ukuthola izinkinga ezingaba khona ezingavimbela izitshalo ekukhuleni kahle. Ukuhlola amazinga ezinto eziphilayo akusiza futhi lapho ufaka ama-herbicides. Kubalulekile ukuthatha isampula ezomela yonke inkambu. Esampula engu-0.5 kg, kuzohlolwa kuphela amagremu amabili noma amathathu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhetha izinkambu ezifanayo ngobukhulu nangohlobo lomhlabathi. Ukuhlola kuhlola kuphela isampula; akukwazi ukuhlola yonke inkambu. Ngisho naphakathi kwenkambu eyodwa, kunezindawo ezahlukene zomhlabathi. Esikhathini esedlule, sasinjengokuthatha isampula eyodwa endaweni efanayo nehektare eziyishumi. Okwamanje, kungcono ukuthatha ibhola bese uzigcwalisa kulo lonke ibanga, uthatha ama-samples kuyo yonke inkambu bese uwabeka ezikhwameni - ukujula kufanele kube phakathi kuka-15 no-20 cm, kodwa akufanele kudlule u-20 cm. Uma usebenzisa isikhwama somanyolo esidala, jikelezisa isikhwama ngoba umanyolo osele esikhwameni ungashintsha imiphumela yokuhlola yalowo mhlabathi. Ungathatha ama-samples amaningi, kodwa uma uzigcwalisa, ungathatha ama-samples njalo emamethri angama-100 kuya kwangama-200. Thatha ama-samples phakathi kwemigqa njengoba kungase kube nezindawo lapho bekungekho izitshalo eziningi ngonyaka odlule - lezi zindawo zingase zikhombise ukuthi kunezinto eziningi eziphilayo kuyo yonke inkambu. Zonke lezi zampula kufanele zihlanganiswe, bese uthatha isampula engu-500 gm bese uyibeka ezibhokisini ze-lab. Ibhokisi eline-samples kufanele libe nelebuli ekhombisa inombolo yenkambu, igama lephalamende, ikheli lomnikazi, izinombolo zocingo, kanye nesikhathi sokuthatha isampula. Lokhu kuzovimbela ama-samples ukuthi angahlanganiswa nezinye. Kungaba kuhle ukukwenza lokhu enkambeni lapho uhambisa khona ama-samples. Uma kunezindawo ezikhiqiza ukudla okuhle, kungaba kuhle ukuthatha isampula kule ndawo ethile. Lokhu kungasiza ukuqhathanisa le sampula nezinye, futhi kuzoba sobala ukuthi yiziphi izindawo ezikhiqiza kahle futhi yiziphi ezidinga umanyolo owengeziwe ukuze kukhuphuke ukukhiqiza kulezo zindawo. Ama-samples akufanele athathwe ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile - izindawo ezingavamile ukulima, ezifana eduze kweminyango, ezindaweni zokuphosa, nezindawo lapho umhlabathi uhlehlisiwe. Ubuchwepheshe besimanje busivumela ukuthi sisebenzise i-Global Positioning System (GPS) ukuze sakhe i-grid lapho izindawo enkambeni zingaphawulwa (0.5m kude). Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zindawo zingahlolwa ukuze kubonakale ukuthi umhlabathi kulezi zindawo ushintshile noma uhlala unjengoba unjalo. Imiphumela ingahlolwa ngokusebenzisa i-Ground Information System (GIS) ukuze kutholakale 'ichati' ekhombisa i-pH, i-calcium, i-magnesium, i-phosphorus, i-sulfur, i-nitrogen, nezinye izinkomba, zonke ezimele ngokuqondile. Isikhathi esihle sokuthatha ama-samples yileso lapho kungekho umsebenzi omningi epulazini, lapho ungabona khona kahle zonke izinkambu ukuze uzihlukanise kahle (izindawo ezifanayo) futhi ngasikhathi sinye minyaka yonke ngemuva kokuvuna. Kungasiza futhi ukuthumela ama-samples lapho ama-labs engabusi. Ngokuvamile, athokozisa kakhulu ngaphambi kwesizini yokutshala ngoSepthemba no-Okthoba. Hlangana nabathengisi ngokushesha ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi unalesi sikhathi somyalezo. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlolwa komhlaba - i-phosphorus (P), i-potassium (K), i-nitrogen, ne-pH, kufanele kuthathwe ngokuqina kuka-0 cm kuya ku-15 cm. Mhlawumbe isampula eyodwa ingathathwa ifike ku-20 cm. Qiniseka ukuthi isikhwama esine-mhlabathi sikhombisa kahle ukuthi iyiphi inkambu lapho isampula ithathwe khona futhi sibe nenombolo yaso. Vala kahle izikhwama, ubeke ezindaweni ezibandayo, bese uthumela ngokushesha ukuze kuhlolwe. Okulandelayo kudingeka: imephu yezinkambu, izinombolo zezinhlobo zomhlabathi, ama-GPS coordinates ebhola noma isikhwama, izikhwama ezinkulu
Ingabe abakhiqizi kufanele benze inzuzo kuphela? Abanye abalimi bazokhuluma ukuthi ukulima akusiyo nje umsebenzi wokwenza inzuzo. Kuneziningi ezithanda, zithanda umhlaba, zijabulela ukusebenza ngaphandle, futhi zithola injabulo ekungahlali njalo ehhovisi nasekulandeleni imithetho yenkampani ethile. Nokho, bazovuma futhi ukuthi abakwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo wokulima uma bengakwenzi inzuzo. Ukuqala kwenzuzo yebhizinisi kukhombisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lizophumelela noma cha. Inani lenzuzo lizokwenza ukuthi umlimi abheke phambili, akhule emsebenzini wakhe ukuze aphumelele esikhathini esizayo. Inzuzo iyinsiza yokusebenza kwabo. Uma umlimi engakwazi ukubala inzuzo yakhe enhle, uzobona ukuthi imali engena emasimini akhe inenhloso, bese ecabanga ngokutshala kabusha futhi efaka imali eningi emsebenzini wakhe wokulima. Bonke abalimi bayazi ukuthi kunezingozi eziningi ekulimeni. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, isimo sezulu sishintsha njalo, futhi imvula ewela ngesikhathi esifanayo ezindaweni ezifanayo yenza ukubala kube nzima. Lezi zingozi zizohlala zikhona, kodwa umlimi ophatha kahle umsebenzi wakhe uzolungiselela ukuphatha lezi zingozi uma zenzeka. Kukhona izinto ezithile umlimi engakwazi ukuzilawula, njengokuphatha kahle izindlela zokulima: ukulungiselela kahle umhlabathi nohlelo lokufaka izithako, ukuncibilikisa izinkambu lapho kungenzeka, ukuthenga imbewu efanele nezithako ezifanele, nokuphatha izifo nezihlahla kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ingxenye yalokho okungaphathwa iyaziwa yomlimi. Abanye abalimi baqala ngolwazi oluncane, kodwa bese befunda ezikoleni zokulima, kanti abanye bathola ulwazi kuhlelo lwe-Grain SA Farmer Development Program. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lokhu kuletha ubuchwepheshe ngoba umlimi ufunda njalo ngesikhathi esebenza emasimini akhe. Njengamanje, sonke siyazi ukuthi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kusemkhankasweni ngoba akukho inzuzo. Akukho mqondo wokutshala noma yini. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile manje ukuthi umlimi ngamunye aphathe ibhizinisi lakhe kahle ukuze afinyelele empumelelweni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi kumele abe nolwazi oluhle ngezindleko nezinsiza ezingaba khona kuzo zonke izenzo zakhe emasimini. Akusikho okwanele ukuba ngumkhiqizi ongakwazi ukulima, ukulungisa imishini, noma ukukhulisa izinkomo kuphela - kunezinye izinto ezibalulekile okufanele zenziwe! Thina, njengabalimi, ngabe sisebenza kuphela noma siphatha ibhizinisi eliletha inzuzo? Impumelelo ekulimeni iyinselelo enkulu ngoba kukhona okuthile okubizwa ngokuthi "ubukhazikhazi bokuphuthuma." Lokhu kusho ukuthi ekulimeni, njalo kukhona inkinga ephuthumayo edinga ukuxazululwa - ithrektha iyaphuka, izinkomo ziya zifela, njll. Lokhu kungasenza sikhumbule ukucabanga phambili nokuphatha ezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Ukuphatha ifamu kuhilela ukucabanga phambili nokuhlanganisa amasu okuthuthuka - kudinga isikhathi nomzamo, futhi akuhlali kujabulisa. Noma yimuphi umlimi uzobona injabulo enhliziyweni yakhe uma ebona ithrektha iqala ukulima insimu enomhlabathi ophumelelayo - kodwa mhlawumbe akukhona okwakufanele kulokho kwesikhathi. Isibonelo: ngo-2010 - 2011, abalimi bamaqanda kufanele bacabange ngokucophelela ukuthi kuzobabiza inzuzo yini ngoba osomabhizinisi be-Grain SA bekholelwa ukuthi ukuvuthwa kwamaqanda kuzokwehlisa amanani futhi ngaleyo ndlela inzuzo ngeke ifinyeleleke - mhlawumbe okuthile kuzoshintsha lokhu masinyane. Umlimi ngamunye kumele abheke ukuthi ifamu yakhe ingakhiqiza inani elithile. Kumele abheke izinkambu zakhe, abheke isimo sabo sezimali, acabange ngezingozi ezingaba khona, abasebenzi abadingekayo, futhi abheke amakhono nezinsiza zabo ukuze baphumelele. Lokhu kungabasiza ukuba babeke phambili izinto zezimali ukuze bathole inzuzo efanele. Khumbula, inzuzo yakha impumelelo! Yiziphi izinhlobo zezithelo engizotshala? Ngizohlanganisa nazo ezinye izinhlobo. Yiziphi izindawo efamu yami ezifanele ukutshala? Ngabe ngingakhulisa malini izinkomo? Ingabe kukhona okungangenzela kahle kule fomu ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngizothola inzuzo? Ngizotshala kanjani lezi zithelo? Ngifuna ukwesekwa kokuqala kokutshala. Ngizophatha kahle izincwadi zami. Lokhu kuzokhombisa labo abangangisiza ngezimali ukuthi ngiyinsiza ethembekile. Ngidinga ukuqasha ama-traktori nemishini eminye. Ingabe kukhona ezinye izinto ezizokwandisa izindleko zami zokuqala zokutshala? I-Grain SA inabahlaziyi bezomnotho abahlala behlola ukukhuphuka nokwehla kwam prices kanye nezinguquko zemakethe futhi baziqondise abalimi ngezinguquko ezingathinta ukusebenza kokulima. Abalimi kufanele bathole izindlela zokufinyelela kulolu lwazi njalo. Ngokuphathelene nolwazi oluvela ku-Central Energy Fund, intengo ye-petrol ingakhuphuka ngama-51.5 cents nge-litre ngo-April 7, kanti i-diesel ingakhuphuka ngama-54.5 cents nge-litre. Le nkuphuka ingase ibe ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwemali yokuhlala nezindleko ze-Road Accident Fund (RAF) ezizofika ngo-April, njengoba i-Central Energy Fund ilindele ukuthi imali izoba phansi. Intela ye-diesel izokhuphuka ngama-17.5 cents nge-litre, kanti i-RAF levy izokhuphuka ngama-8 cents nge-litre. Le nkuphuka izophinde ikhulise isaphulelo sabalimi, okusho ukuthi intengo ye-diesel izokhuphuka ngama-42.5 cents nge-litre. Kubalulekile ukuhlaziya ukuthi imakethe ifuna ini nokuthi bazokhokha malini ukuthenga umkhiqizo. Akulungile ukusebenza kanzima nokukhokha imali eningi ukuze utshale izithelo ezinhle kuphela ukuze uthole ukuthi lezi zithelo azidingeki, imakethe ayifuni. Kungase kwenzeke futhi ukuthi kukhona ukudla okungaphezu kokwanele futhi intengo yehlile, okusho ukuthi usebenza mahhala ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi awukwazi ukwenza inzuzo. Udinga ukuhlola ngokucophelela futhi uthole iqiniso lokuthi ukudla kwakho kudingeka nokuthi abathengi bazokwazi ukukuthenga ngentengo ezokwenza ukuthi uthole inzuzo. Abakhiqizi bamaqanda kufanele bacabange ngokucophelela ukuthi bazokwenza ini ngonyaka ozayo. Imakethe yamaqanda iphansi kakhulu futhi izohlala njalo isikhathi eside. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, kuthathwa ama-toni ayizigidi eziyi-9 zamaqanda ngonyaka, kodwa silindele ukuvuna ama-toni angama-12.8 ngonyaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sitshala amaqanda amaningi kakhulu, kukhona amaqanda amaningi emakethe, ngakho intengo izohlala iphansi kuze kube isidingo samaqanda sikhula. Masigxile ekuthengeni ubhontshisi, inkukhu, nezinkukhu ezivela phesheya futhi sikhulise ukukhiqizwa kwalokhu kudla lapha nathi. Kukhona abalimi abangu-1000 (abakhulu nabancane) kanye nezinkulungwane zamahhektare ezingasetshenziswa ukutshala amaqanda uma singakwazi ukukhulisa imakethe ezokwandisa isidingo. Abalimi abanebhizinisi badinga ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo.
Ukuhlanganisa inani - ingabe lokhu kungakhuphula inzuzo? Ukuhlanganisa inani kungaba yindlela esetshenziswa abalimi ukuze bakhuphule inzuzo abathola yona futhi bathuthukise imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Ngamafuphi, ukufaka inani, noma ukuthuthukisa inani kusho ukusebenza ngomkhiqizo wakho ngendlela ezokwandisa inani (imali) yalowo mkhiqizo. Yini ukufakwa kwenani? Ukwandisa inani lomkhiqizo kusho ukuthi umalimi kufanele aqale ukusebenzisa (ukuguqula) umkhiqizo wezolimo ngendlela ezokwenza kube nokwenzeka imali kulowo owenza ukufaka inani, nokunye. Lokhu kuzodinga utshalomali olungeziwe ngoba kuzodingeka ukuthi kube nomsebenzi owengeziwe, njengokuhola abasebenzi abasha noma ukuthenga imishini emisha, ngakho kufanele kubalwe ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kutshalwa kwezimali okungeziwe phezu kwezinye izindleko zokuguqula umkhiqizo kuzokhiqiza inzuzo ephezulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukubala izindleko ezintsha nokuthuthukisa amasu okucabangela izimakethe nezintengo kufanele kwenziwe njalo - izimakethe zomkhiqizo zihlala zishintsha futhi izimakethe zishintsha njalo - kwesinye isikhathi ukufaka inani kuzokbringela inzuzo, kwesinye isikhathi kungaba nje izindleko. Kungani kubalulekile kubalimi ukuba babambe iqhaza, basebenze ndawonye, futhi banakekele le misebenzi yokufaka inani? Njalo abakhangisi bavame ukuvumelana nenani lezimakethe abathola lona, abakwazi ukuhlela inani lezimakethe, lelo nani limiswa ngabathengi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abathengi bazokwenza isinqumo sokuthi bazokhokha malini ukuze bathenge into ethile, abalimi abanamandla okucela inani eliphakeme. Ngakho, abalimi kufanele bacabangele izindlela ezizobasiza ukuthi bathole inzuzo ephezulu uma umkhiqizo wabo uphume emasimini ngoba umsebenzi omkhulu wenziwa ukuze ulungiselele lezi zinto zokudla ukuze kufezwe inzuzo engcono esikhathini esizayo. Ukwengeza inani kumakhenikhazi. Inani lezimakethe kumakhenikhazi ngo-2010 laliphansi kakhulu, abalimi badinga ukuhlela ezinye izindlela zokukhuphula inzuzo yomkhiqizo wabo. Isibonelo: kungabalwa kalula ukuthi kuzoba nenzo engakanani uma amakhenikhazi ehlatshwe futhi athengiswe njengomgubo. Ake siqale ngokuthi singathengisa ithani lamakhenikhazi ngo-R1,000.00 kwi-cooperative. Kodwa umalimi angakwazi futhi ukuhluza amakhenikhazi akhe amhlophe futhi athengise umgubo ozodliwa abantu nasezinkampanini. Futhi angakwenza lokhu yena (ngomshini wakhe) noma angathatha amakhenikhazi akhe emshinini bese ehlatshwa khona bese ethengisa ezipakisheni. UMr. Farmer angase acabangele ukuhluza amakhenikhazi namuhla nangesonto elizayo nokuthi uzothola malini uma eba umhluzi futhi. Ingabe unendawo eyanele emasimini akhe ukuze enze lo msebenzi noma uzodinga ukuqasha enye indawo? Ingabe kukhona imithetho yezempilo okufanele ayilandele nokuthi lokhu kuzobiza malini? Yimuphi uhlobo lwemishini oludingekayo nokuthi kuzoba yini impumelelo yesikhathi eside? Lapha sikhuluma ngezinto ezifana nemishini yokuhluza, izikali, imishini yokupakisha, nezinye ezipakisha amabhakede/amaphakheji, njll.? Yimuphi uhlobo lwamaphakheji oludingekayo nokuthi uzowathola kuphi? Kuzobiza malini ukufaka amalebula, ama-logo (amagama ezimpahla), nezinye izinto? Uzodinga abasebenzi abengeziwe? Uzokhangisa kanjani lo mgubo? Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi lokhu kuyisibopho sesikhathi eside futhi uMr. Farmer uzobopha yena kulomsebenzi wokuhluza isikhathi eside. Enye inketho kaMr. Farmer ingu: Angathatha amakhenikhazi akhe amhlophe emshinini oseduze ukuze ahluzwe abe ngumgubo. Le yinketho ephumelelayo ngoba uzokhetha isikhathi lapho inani lezimakethe lamakhenikhazi liphansi kakhulu ukuze athengise ezimakethe, bese ehluzela emshinini ukuze athengise umgubo ukuze akwazi ukukhuphula inzuzo yomkhiqizo wakhe. Lokhu kumnika ithuba lokukhetha lapho ethengisa noma lapho ehluza. Akukwazeki ukutshalwa kwezimali okwengeziwe ukuze wandise ibhizinisi lakhe kodwa kuzoba nokwanda kwempahla. Umqali ngamunye kufanele acabangele zonke izindlela ezizosebenza kahle kuye endaweni ahlala kuyo. Kuzoba nokulahleka okungu-20% ngoba umhluzi uthatha izikhumba nezinsalela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ngizothola ama-800 kg omgubo kumakhenikhazi ami angu-1,000 kg. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umhluzi uthatha u-R320 ukuze ahluze amakhenikhazi. Amakhenikhazi: 1,000 kg - 20% yokulahleka (200 kg izikhumba) = 800 kg yomgubo kuphela. Kodwa: ama-800 kg omgubo adinga ukupakishwa ngumhluzi ezipakisheni ezifanele. Okwamanje, lowo mgubo ungathengiswa ngo-R2.20 ngekilogramu. Imisebenzi emisha iyadalwa. Kukhona izindlela eziningi zokuhlola uma ubheka ukuhlanganisa inani nokukhuphula inzuzo. Mhlawumbe kungakhiqiza inzuzo eningi uma uMr. Farmer esebenzisa amakhenikhazi akhe ukukhulisa izinkukhu, izinkomo, izimvu, noma izinkomo. Mhlawumbe inzuzo izokhula uma i-ethanol ikhiqizwa kumakhenikhazi. UMr. Farmer angase athole ukukhula kwenzuzo ngendlela akhetha ngayo ukusebenzisa amakhenikhazi akhe. Konke lokhu sizobuyela kukho futhi esikhathini esizayo.
Isithombe 1: Impumelelo yokucindezela umhlaba emapulazini. Isithombe 2: Imizi engakwesokunxele ibonisa indlela engaphazamiseki yokukhula, kuyilapho leyo engakwesokudla ibonisa ukukhula okuncane ngenxa yokucindezela umhlaba. Isithombe 1: Isithombe sikhombisa ukuthi indlela eyodwa yokuna ingadala umonakalo omkhulu emhlabeni. Isithombe 2: Lapho umhlaba uqala ukoma, kuvela isikhumba esivimba umoya ukuthi ungene noma uphume emhlabeni, futhi ivimba amanzi ukuthi angena noma aphume. Isithombe 3: Qinisekisa ukuthi amapulazi akho awanamanzi amaningi kakhulu futhi ususe izinkomo ukuze uzifake kwenye indawo. Lapho amapulazi eqala ukoma, ungabuyisela izinkomo. Ukucindezela umhlaba kwenzeka lapho amaqoqo omhlaba acindezelwa futhi izikhala ngaphakathi zivaliwe. Umhlaba ocindezelwe kakhulu unama pore amancane, avimbela ukungena kwamanzi, futhi uma kukhona amanzi amaningi, awakwazi ukuphuma kulolu cindezelo. Ukushintshana komoya okuqukethe i-oxygen, i-nitrogen, i-carbon dioxide, nezinye izinto ezibalulekile zokukhula kwemizi akwenzi kahle, futhi izitshalo azikhuli kahle. Yini edala ukucindezela komhlaba? Ukunyakaza kwezitrobhu nezinye izinto ezisebenza emhlabeni omanzi kungadala ukucindezela komhlaba. Ukuhlwanyela umhlaba kanye nokucindezela kwawo kuhambisana nazo zonke izenzo emapulazini: ukuhweba, ukujova, ukuvuna, njll. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bazame ukwakha izitrobhu ezinamandla kakhulu nezinsiza ezikwazi ukuphula leli cindezelo elakhiwe uma amaqoqo omhlaba ehlangana, evimba umoya namanzi ukuthi angena noma aphume. Ngeminyaka yama-1940, isisindo sezitrobhu sasivame ukuba amathani amathathu - namuhla, izimoto ezineziqhamo zidlula amathani angama-20. Ukucindezela okuvela ekunyakazeni kwezinsiza kunganciphisa ukuphakama komhlaba kube ngu-0.60 m. Ukuhlwanyela nokuhlanza kuvame ukuhlinzekwa uma umhlaba unamanzi, okungadala ingozi ngokushesha kumongo womhlaba. Umhlaba awukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngamakhemikhali anele ezitshalo. Ukuhlwanyela okuqhubekayo ngombhoxo ophula umhlaba kube ukuphakama okufanayo kungaholela ekucindezelweni okweqile phansi, okwenza kube nzima kumizi ukuba kungene. Emhlabeni lapho kukhona amanzi amaningi, umhlaba uthi uziphathe njengopulasitiki. Izinsiza ezinzima ezihamba lapho zingacindezela umhlaba ngaphezulu kwezinhlamvu ezihlanziwe. Lapho izizinda zezimoto zivele, kukhombisa ukuthi umhlaba umanzi kakhulu. Umhlaba omanzi uzokwakha futhi ugcine isakhiwo esihle. Isimo/sakhiwo somhlaba sizokutshela ukuthi umhlaba othile ungagcina futhi uthumele amanzi, amakhemikhali ezitshalo, nomoya odingekayo ukuze imizi ikhule kahle. Imizi ekhula kahle idinga ama pore amakhulu kune-0.1 mm ukuze iziphetho zomizi zingene futhi zibambe amaqoqo omhlaba ukuze iqhubeke ikhula. Uma umhlaba ucindezelwe kakhulu, imizi idinga amandla amaningi ukuze ingene. Umfarmu angakwenza kanjani ukuvimbela ukucindezela komhlaba? Ukuhlwanyela ngaphakathi kune-25 cm kuzosisiza ukuphula ama-pans anzima akhiwe uma izinsiza zinyakaza, kodwa lokhu akusebenza isikhathi eside uma ufuna umkhiqizo omuhle. Ezindaweni eziningi, ukuhlinzeka okujulile kudingeka kwenzeke unyaka nonyaka. Ukuphinda uhlinzeke leli pulazi elihlinzekiwe kungacindezela umhlaba ngama-80%. Ngakho-ke, ama-diesel amaningi nezinsiza zisetshenziswa. Indlela ophuma ngayo manje ingafana nendlela ejwayelekile: ukuhlinzeka ngemva kokuvuna, ukujova, ukuhlinzeka, njll., bese uhlwanyela, uhlinzeka, futhi ujova izihlahla nezifo. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi izinsiza zakho zisebenza kuleli pulazi mhlawumbe izikhathi eziyi-8 noma eziyi-9 phakathi nezikhathi zokuhlwanyela nokuvuna. Le ndlela yokulima inezindleko eziningi. Izindleko zezinsiza, isikhathi sokuphothula umsebenzi, umsebenzi, ama-diesel, nok maintenance kwezinsiza ziyaqhubeka zanda. Le ndlela yokulima yayihloselwe ikakhulukazi ukubulala izihlahla nokukhulula umhlaba ocindezelwe ngemuva kokuhlwanyela okweqile. Enye imvula ingagcinwa ukuze ikhulule ungqimba lomhlaba phezulu ukuvimbela ukulahleka kwamanzi emoyeni. Ukuhlinzeka okujulile kungaphula ungqimba lomhlaba ocindezelwe, okungadala enye ingozi kumongo womhlaba futhi ngeke kusebenze kahle uma umhlaba umanzi kakhulu. Ukulondolozwa komhlaba ngezinye izindlela ezifana nokunciphisa ukuhlinzeka nokungahlinzeki kungavimbela ukucindezela komhlaba futhi ekugcineni kunciphise izindleko. Izitshalo eziningi zihlala zicindezela kancane umhlaba ngaphezulu kwezinhlamvu ezihlanziwe. Lokhu kuvumela ukuxhumana okusheshayo phakathi komhlaba, amanzi, nezitshalo, okuholela ekukhuleni okusheshayo. Ukucindezela kancane kungavimbela ukulahleka kwamanzi, futhi umhlaba ophuma ezitshalweni awomisi ngokushesha. Lapho izitshalo zilinganiselwe, zivaliwe umhlaba omanzi, okhululekile. Lokhu kuzovimbela futhi ukulahleka kwamanzi. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi kokubili ungqimba lomhlaba ophakeme nolwangaphansi lungacindezelwe kakhulu. Umhlaba ocindezelwe kakhulu onokucindezela okungafani kungavimbela ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa kwemizi ngendlela efanele. Imizi ivame ukukhetha izindlela ezilula zokukhula, ngakho-ke ngeke izame ukungena ezindaweni ezicindezelwe lapho umhlaba unzima. Lapho ukucindezela kwenzeka, kunciphisa indawo lapho imizi ingakhula khona. Izitshalo zingakwazi ukukhipha amakhemikhali anele namanzi ukuze ziveze umkhiqizo omuhle. Eminyakeni lapho imvula inganele, izitshalo zihlupheka ngoba azitholi amakhemikhali kulomhlaba ocindezelwe. Eminyakeni lapho imvula ikahle, umhlaba ocindezelwe uvimbela umoya ukuthi ungene futhi uphume emhlabeni ngoba kukhona amanzi amaningi - futhi lezo zikhathi azikwazi ukuphuma. Lokhu kuholela ekulahlekelweni kwamakhemikhali nase-nitrogen emhlabeni. Isitshalo sidinga amandla ukuze sithole i-potassium emhlabeni. Njengoba kungekho moya, imizi ayinayo amandla anele ukuze ithole i-potassium ngokwanele. I-phosphorus ivamise ukungena ngokujulile emhlabeni; uma siphinda siyifake, imizi engenamoya iyahluleka ukuyithola leli khetho elibalulekile. Umhlaba onothuli unama-aggregates amancane futhi uvame ukuhlinzeka ngokushesha. Lezi zindawo zihlala zinezinsiza ezanele, kodwa uma kukhona ungqimba olucindezelwe, luzovimba imizi ukuthi ifinyelele kulawo manzi aphansi - ikakhulukazi uma imvula inganele. Sibonile ukuthi uma imizi ingena kulolu cindezelo (noma sivula indlela ngokuhlanza), ingakhula kahle ngoba uthuli ngaphansi kolungqimba olucindezelwe luthambile. Ngakho-ke, bathola amanzi anele namakhemikhali ukuze bahlale bephila kahle. Ukucindezela komhlaba kungavela ezindaweni ezimbili: ukucindezela komhlaba ophakeme nokucindezela okuphansi (hardpan). Imvula yehlobo ingadala umonakalo omkhulu emhlabeni ongavikelekile, njengokuguguleka okukhuhla umhlaba namakhemikhali. Emhlabeni lapho kungekho izinto eziningi zemvelo (izimpande ezindala, njll.) noma lapho kungekho mizi phezulu, ungq
Isithombe 1: Umhloli ohlola ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba ubonisa okwenziwa ngaphansi komhlaba. Ekubhaleni kwethu, sichaza ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba nokuthi kwenzeka kanjani. Lapha sizochaza ukuthi umhloli wokuhlanganiswa komhlaba usebenza kanjani nezindlela zokuphatha ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Idivayisi ehlola ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba izosibonisa okwenziwa ngaphakathi komhlaba, kodwa kukhona nezinye amathuluzi nezindlela zokuhlola ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Lo mhloli usiza ngoba usebenza njalo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umhlaba uphansi noma usetshenziswe. Uma ucabanga ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba kuvimbela izitshalo ekukhuleni kahle, ungasebenzisa kalula lo mhloli ukuze uthole inkinga. Inani lamanzi emhlabeni kufanele lihambisane nalolo mhlaba. Uma umhlaba umanzi kakhulu noma umanzi kakhulu, ukufundwa komhloli kungase kungathembekile njalo. Umhloli uyisikhonkwane sensimbi esisindayo esingu-30 grams, esinokhandla osiza ukufaka emhlabeni kanye ne-gauge ekhombisa ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Kukhona izikhonkwane ezisebenza emhlabeni othambile nezinye ezisebenza emhlabeni onzima. Imishini ibonisa ngekilopaskali ukuthi umhlaba uhambisana kangakanani. Iphinde ibonise ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kukhona kanjani ngaphansi komhlaba. Lokhu kungakusiza ukuthi ubone ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kukhona kanjani kuwo wonke amapulazi akho, kukuvumele ukuthi ulime ngendlela efanele ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ukuphatha ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Awufanele ulime kakhulu noma kaningi. Sebenza ngendlela egcina umhlaba kuze kube ufika endleleni ebizwa ngokuthi "ukulima okuncane." Sebenzisa umgibeli nezinye imishini kuphela uma umhlaba ungawumanzile kakhulu. Ungakuhlola kalula lokhu. Bamba umhole ufinyelele ku-15 cm ubukhulu bese uthatha isampula somhlaba. Zama ukwenza ibhola ngalowo mhlaba ngesandla. Uma ibhola lenziwa kalula (umhlaba uyabambeka), khona-ke umhlaba umanzi kakhulu. Uma ibhola lihlukaniswa kalula, khona-ke akufanele usebenzise imishini. Zama ukungasebenzisi ama-ploughs amadala aphazamisa umhlaba. Sebenzisa ama-ploughs anama-tines abukhali angakwazi ukungena ng глубины ukuze aphule izindawo ezihlanganisiwe. Uma usebenzisa lowo plough, qiniseka ukuthi awuphazamiseki umhlaba ophakeme kodwa ungene ngokwanele ukuze uphule ama-layer ahlanganisiwe. Uma uphonsa ngempempe engaphazamisi umhlaba ophakeme, kuzosisiza ukuphula ukuhlanganiswa okubangelwa ukuna kwemvula noma ukuhamba kwemishini esindayo. Qiniseka ukuthi imbewu ibekwe kahle ne-fertilizer emgibeni. Ukuhluza phakathi kwezitshalo kuzophula ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba ophakeme, kuvumele umoya ukuba ungene emhlabeni, futhi uma imvula iyawa, amanzi azongena kalula. Kubalulekile ukujikeleza izinhlobo zezitshalo njalo. Imizi yezitshalo ezahlukene ayifani futhi izosiza ukuvimbela ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Ukulima ama-legumes, amahlanga, kanye ne-soybeans kuzosisiza ukuvimbela ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba. Izitshalo ezifana namahlanga afana ne-forage zingalima ezindaweni lapho umlimi engafuni khona ukulima isitshalo esingaphindwanga. Lezi zitshalo zingaphinde zifakwe ukuze zihlale umhlaba ngoba imishini ayisebenzi lapho ngaleso sikhathi. Ukukhiqizwa kokudla okukhuliswa ngemuva kweminyaka emibili noma emithathu kule ndawo kuvame ukukhula. Zama ukugcina izindlela zezimoto zihlala zifanayo - imishini kufanele ihambe endaweni ethile. Ukuhlanganiswa komhlaba kulezi zindawo kuzokwenza umgibeli uhambisane kangcono futhi ungadli kakhulu i-diesel. Izigaba lapho izitshalo zikhuliswa khona azihlanganisiwe, futhi umhlaba lapho awuhlanganisiwe. Uma kukhona lezi zindlela ezihlanganisiwe, kuzosisiza uma imvula inyuka kakhulu. Qala ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezizogcina umhlaba futhi uzame ukufaka izinto eziningi eziphilayo (i-mulch) emhlabeni ezinyangeni ezizayo.
NgoMeyi 2010, ngesikhathi semvula, sahlinzeka ngohlu lwezinto okufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi. Itraktori iyadingeka epulazini; uma ungakwenzi lokho, uzobanga izindleko eziningi. Bheka amanzi uma injini isashisa. Uma kungekho ibhodlela lamanzi, i-radiator kufanele ibe ne-25mm ukusuka phezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona i-antifreeze. Qinisa ama-pins alinganayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi uxhumano lunamafutha futhi ukuthi kukhona ama-pins afanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-bolts aqinile. Qiniseka ukuthi uyazi izinyathelo zokuphepha zaleyo traktori. Ezinye izinhlobo zidinga ukuthi ufinyelele kwi-clutch bese uyikhipha ngaphambi kokuphakamisa. Phakamisa kancane futhi uhlole zonke izinkomba nezibani. Uma kukhona inkinga, yenza kube lula ngokushesha ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili. Ungayiqhumi kakhulu injini. Sebenzisa ithuluzi elifanele futhi uqinisekise ukuthi injini ayikhathazeki. Vumela injini igijime kancane ukuze ivumele i-turbo ipholile ngaphambi kokuyivala. Gcwalisa ithangi nge-diesel ngemuva kokusebenza - lokhu kuzovimbela umoya ekubanjweni nasekuguqukeni kube amanzi.
Isithombe 1: Imbila embi: bheka ukuthi imbila ikhula kanjani. Isithombe 2: Ukuphathwa kwemibila okungafanele: bheka ukuthi imbewu iphuzi, ibuthakathaka. Isithombe 3: Isorghum esivamile nesorghum esiqinile. Qaphela isorghum esimhlophe esivamile sidlula isorghum esibomvu esiqinile. Isithombe 4: I-Nut Sedge ephuzi etholakala emasimini ommbila. Ukulima kuqhubeka kube inselele, kodwa okwamanje, ngicabanga ukuthi bonke abalimi sebevele bezwe ukuthi imibila kufanele iphathwe kanjani, kodwa cha! Ezindaweni engivakashela kuzo, ngibona ukuthi lokhu kuseyinkinga enkulu, ikakhulukazi imibila efana neYellow Nut Sedge, Uintjies, neMonakaladi. Ngaphandle kokuphathwa kahle kwemibila, ngeke ukwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ezokwenza uzuze imali manje nakusasa. Imbila iyisitha sethu - imibila ibanga ukuncintisana nezitshalo zethu ngamanzi, izakhamzimba, isikhala, nokukhanya. Izindleko zokuhlanza imibila ziphansi; awukwazi ukuvumela imibila ukuthi idle umanyolo owenziwe ngezithombo. Indlela engcono yokuphatha imibila yile: qinisekisa ukuthi imibila ayiqali ukukhula. Uma ulinda isikhathi eside ukushaya imibila, uma ulinda kuze kube imibila ikhule ngaphambi kokuyishaya, izindleko nezingozi ezitshalweni nazo ziya zanda. Impumelelo ekulimaleni ixhunyaniswe nokuphathwa kahle kwemibila. Uma ungazi izitha zakho, ngeke ukwazi ukuzilwela. Uma uthola izinkambu ezintsha ongazazi, kungaba nzima ukusho ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zemibila ezizokhula. Kodwa ngemuva konyaka, kuzoba sobala ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo, futhi uzokwazi ukuzilawula ngaphambi kokukhula. Kufanele uqonde ukuthi imibila inezinhlaka ezibanzi noma izinhlaka ezifanayo nezitshalo. Kungaba usizo uma uthola amagama ezinhlobo zemibila ezikhona enkundleni ethile, bese uzokwazi ukuthola umlayezo ofanele ukuze uzisuse. Uma usebenzisa imishini yokuhlanza, qinisekisa njalo (kokubili emthonjeni nasemva) ukuthi uyashaya yonke imibila. Qaphela ukuthi imikhono ibukhali ukuze kungabi nendawo phakathi kwazo engashiya eminye imibila. Uma inkambu ibhaki kakhulu ngesikhathi sokuhlanza, khumbula ukuthi imibila oyisusa izophinde ikhule. Kufanele wazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi amakhemikhali ozowasebenzisa ngaphambi kokutshala. Qinisekisa ukuthi umshini wokuphalaza usemkhathini omuhle, i-PTO iyasebenza kahle, kukhona igauge elilinganisa ingcindezi, futhi ama-nozzles afanele. Kukho abantu abanolwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwemibila. Khumbula ukuthi indlela yokuphatha imibila enezindleko eziphezulu iyindlela engasebenzi. Ungase ungafuni ukukhokha imali, kodwa khumbula: uzolahlekelwa kakhulu. Amakhemikhali awahlukanisi uhlobo lwezithombo angasetshenziswa kuzo (njengeRoundup noma iGramoxone), noma ungahlanzisa ngemishe. Khumbula uma sikhuluma ngamakhemikhali angakhethi, azobulalela zonke izitshalo eziluhlaza kule nkambu. Qaphela uma usebenzisa lawa makhemikhali ngoba uma usuwasebenzisile, ngeke ukwazi ukuwasusa emhlabathini. Ngemuva kokutshala, amakhemikhali abhalisiwe angasetshenziswa ukubulala izinhlobo ezithile zemibila ezitshalweni ezithile ngaphambi kokuthi imibila iqale ukukhula. I-Nut grass ingaba yinkinga ngoba ayifile kalula. I-Yellow Nut Sedge ingaphathwa kahle emmbileni nasezibandleni ngokufaka iServian (amakhemikhali aziwa ngokuthi "Syngenta"). Izinsuku eziyisithupha zokukhula kwezithombo zibalulekile lapho siphatha imibila - ukuncintisana nemibila ngaleso sikhathi kuzokwenza umkhiqizo ube mubi. Imbila kufanele ibulawelwe uma isincane, uma isaqhubeka ikhula kakhulu, ngaphambi kokuthi iqale ukuncintisana nezitshalo. Futhi kufanele ibulawelwe ngaphambi kokuthi ikhiqize imbewu. Uma sekuvele imbewu, imbewu izophinde ikhule futhi ibangele izinkinga futhi. Ukulwa nemibila kuzokwenza umkhiqizo unciphe. Ngisho noma kungabikho izitshalo enkundleni, imibila kufanele ibulawelwe. Imbewu yemibila ingahlala emhlabathini isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi ikhule uma isimo sezulu sikhona. Umsebenzi wenziwa ngokushesha - kungcono kunokuhlanzisa ngemishe. Uma inkambu ibhaki, i-traktor ephethe umshini wokuphalaza ingangena kalula, kodwa i-traktor edonsela umgibeli izobhekana nezinkinga. Ukwazi ukuthi ungababulala kanjani imibila ngaphambi kokuthi iqale ukukhula kusho ukuthi ngeke bakwazi ukuncintisana nezitshalo. Uma uphalaza, ikhemikhali ifinyelela kuzo zonke izitshalo zemibila futhi ibulale, kodwa uma uhlanza ngemishe, izitshalo zemibila phakathi kwemigqa yommbila zihlala ziphilile. Akudingi abasebenzi abaningi - ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika, sisabamba imibila ngezandla. Lokhu kuyasebenza. Kunenkinga ethile: imibila ivame ukukhula kakhulu ngesikhathi seKhisimusi lapho abantu bengathandi ukusebenza. Uma amaholide sekwedlule, imibila isivele idalile ingozi. Ake sisebenze ndawonye ngo-2010, sikwazi ukwenza kube "Unyaka Wokungabi Nemibila." Uma sithatha le nkinga eyodwa ngamandla, ngikholelwa ukuthi sizophumelela.

Ngakwesokunxele kwakhe uJerry Mthombothi (umqondisi: Mpumalanga), kanti ngakwesokudla nguPat Shiba (umphathi we-Ndwandwa Trust). Isithombe 12: Amanye amalungu amathathu e-250 ton club nguDavid Maleleka, uThabo Macholo, noMaseli Letuka. E-Bloemfontein ngomhla zingu-26 kuNcwaba kulo nyaka, uhlelo lwe-Grain SA Farmer Development Program luphinde lwabonga labo balimi abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-250 tons ezitshalo ngonyaka. Abalimi abancane bonyaka nabo banikezwe udumo.
Yonke imfuyo ihlobene nokusetshenziswa komhlaba. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezikhathi ezahlukene zokuba nomhlaba. Akukhathazi kakhulu ukuthola uhlelo oluthile, kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi nokuqonda ukuthi yisiphi uhlelo olukhona endaweni okusebenza kuyo. Ingxenye yezinto ezibalulekile lokhu: thola imephu yephango lakho, ngoba uzoqala lapho uma ucabanga ukuthi ungaphumelela kanjani emsebenzini wakho wezolimo. Uma ungakwazi ukuthola imephu (kungase kube emhlabeni wonke umphakathi), zama ukuthola umuntu onenhloso ye-GPS ongakutshela ukuthi umhlaba wakho unjani. Khumbula, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umhlaba unjani ngoba zonke izibalo zezimali zihlobene nenani lamahhektare azokwenziwa. Inkinga enkulu ehambisana nokutholwa komhlaba nokuphathwa komhlaba yindaba yokubolekwa kwemali ngoba kudingeka ube nezehlakalo. Uma ungenayo imibhalo ekhombisa ukuthi ungumnikazi, awukwazi ukusebenzisa lowo mhlaba njengezehlakalo. Lokhu kungaba inkinga, kodwa uma usebenzisa le ndawo ukuthola imali ebolekiwe kulabo abolekayo, ungathola le mali. Uma ungakhiphi imali yakho, bazoba namandla okuthengisa konke okungelakho ukuze babuyise imali yabo. Lokhu kuyisimo esiqinile se "capitalism" (esisebenza emhlabeni jikelele). Kodwa wena, njengomqeqeshi, osaqala ukukhula kwezolimo, kufanele ufunde ukuthi ungangeni engozini yokulahlekelwa yizinto zakho zonke. Yingakho ngicabanga ukuthi kufanele uqale ngezinto ezincane, ungaboleki kakhulu - uma izinkinga zenzeka, ngeke ulahlekelwe yizinto zakho zonke. Uma usebenzisa umhlaba ophathelene nabantu bonke, ungakwazi ukuqala kule ndawo enikezwe umholi. Njengoba uqhubeka ubona ukuthi uzophumelela esikhathini esizayo, ungakwazi ukuqasha izindawo ezivela kumakhelwane abangazilimi. Khumbula, akekho ofuna ukuba umlimi; abathandi. Kukhona abalimi abanebhizinisi elihle kwezolimo kodwa balima emapulazini aphathelene nabantu bonke, bengenayo ngisho ihektare elilodwa elabo. Imvume yokulima umhlaba wesizwe? Imvume esemthethweni yokurenta? Ezinye izindawo kufanele zilimwe ngezindlela ezithile. Inani lokuna, isikhathi sokuqala nesokuphela sesizini yokukhula, kanye nobude bomhlabathi kuzokhombisa indlela yokulima. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi kukhona ithuba lokunisela le ndawo - ukunisela kudinga ukuphathwa njalo, kodwa akufanele ubhekane nenkinga yokushoda kwamanzi ngoba uzokwazi ukunisela uma kudingeka. Ezinye izindlela zokulima zidinga ugesi ukuze usebenzise imishini. Ukuvikelwa kubalulekile kakhulu; uma ungakwazi ukuvikela emapulazini akho, izinkomo zingangena, futhi ngeke uphumelele ekulimaleni kokudla. Kubalulekile ukusho izinombolo zamapulazi nezinkampanini. Thola usayizi wamapulazi nezinkampanini (uzodinga lokhu uma wakhe izinhlelo zomsebenzi wesikhathi esizayo nokubheka izindaba zezimali). Uma usayizi wendawo ungakhonjiswa kumamephu, kufanele uthole ulwazi ngenye indlela. Emhlabeni womphakathi, kuvame ukuthi amamephu angatholakali. Uzodinga imephu ye-GPS ezokunikeza ulwazi ngaleyo ndawo. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuthola usayizi wendawo ethile - ungahamba ulandele izinyathelo zakho, ungasebenzisa isondo elikhombisa ibanga, kodwa uma ufuna ukukala ngokunembile, sebenzisa i-GPS. Uhlobo lomhlabathi luhlobene nenani le-clay ne-sand ekhona emhlabathini. Ubude bomhlabathi bubheka ukuthi kukhona yini izingqimba ezizovimba izimpande ukuthi zikhule - sibona lokhu uma sigcwalisa umgodi ojulile. Kubalulekile ukuhlola isimo somhlabathi ngoba sizokhombisa ukuthi sizosetshenziswa kanjani njengamanje nangesikhathi esizayo. Kuzoba nezindawo lapho kungakabi khona okuzolima - imigwaqo nendawo lapho kuzokwakhiwa khona izindlu. Kubalulekile ukuthatha amasampula njalo eminyakeni emibili. Izindleko ze-fertilizer ziyisici esikhulu uma ulima ukudla, ngakho kufanele uqonde kahle ukuthi yisiphi isihlahla sokufaka kanye nenani elidingekayo emapulazini athile. Umfuyi uzodinga ukukhokha ukuthatha amasampula. Nokho, le mali izosebenza kuwe esikhathini esizayo; ngeke uyichithe. Landela indlela efanele uma uthatha amasampula. Thatha amasampula emhlabathini ophakeme nasezansi. Iphampu ngayinye kufanele ibe nelebula elinamagama kanye nekheli lomfuyi, igama lephango, kanye nenombolo yephampu. (Iphutha lapha lingadala ingozi enkulu.). Futhi, e-Omnia (nakwamanye amabhizinisi akhiqiza i-fertilizer). Khumbula ukubuza ukuze uthole inani le-clay emhlabathini. Buza ngomyalezo mayelana nohlobo lwe-fertilizer naleso sikhathi. Futhi nenani lokukhiqiza ofuna ukukufeza. Uthola malini amanzi okumele usebenzise?
Yiziphi izenzo zokulima ozama ukuzibandakanya kuzo? Kungase kube nezizathu eziningi ezikukhuthazayo ukuba ulime le ndawo ongayithola. Ukulima kuyindlela efanelekile. Ezolimo zithinta ukutholakala kokudla nokudla okunempilo. Ukuze umlimi aphumelele, kudingeka abe nolwazi ngezitshalo, izinkomo, izimbungulu, nokuphathwa. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezithombo zingakhula emasimini - okusanhlamvu (njenge maize), imifino (njenge spinach), izithelo (njenge peach), noma imbewu (njenge beans). Izitshalo zingakhuliswa abantu noma izinkomo ngendlela yazo yemvelo noma zingashintshwa ukuze ziveze izinhlobonhlobo ezahlukene. Izidingo eziyisisekelo zokuthi izitshalo zikhule zifaka umhlabathi, amanzi, izakhamzimba, ukukhanya kwelanga, nokunakekelwa. Lapho izitshalo zikhula, ziba nezinsalela, amahlamvu/izimpande, nemifino. Lezi zingxenye zingaqoqwa njengokuthi izithelo ezincane ezisiza ekukhiqizeni imbewu (ukuhlwanyela). Izinkomo (amahhashi, amadonkolo, nezinkunzi ezisiza ekulimaleni). Njengamanje, izinkomo zingaqoqwa njengokuthi izithelo ezincane eziguqulwa zibe izinhlobo ezahlukene (ezivame ukuqoqwa emasimini) ukuze kudalwe imikhiqizo ethengiswayo (inyama, ubisi, amaqanda, njll.). Ngakho-ke, iningi lezinto zokulima kufanele ligxile ekutholakaleni kokudla okuvela ezinkomoyeni (isibonelo, umlimi ophakamisa izinkomo ukuze athole inyama angabizwa ngokuthi umlimi wenyama, ngoba ngaphandle kwenyama abakwazi ukukhiqiza inyama abangayithengisa). Umlimi udinga ukukhetha izinkomo afuna ukuziphakamisa ngokusekelwe ezizathwini ezahlukene, njengohlobo lokulima, isimo sezulu, ukukhetha komlimi, nezimo zendawo, njll. Amahhashi namadonkolo - ikakhulukazi ngenhloso yokudonsa izinkomo. Ukuqedela zonke izabelo zokulima ngesandla kungathatha isikhathi futhi kungaba yinsiza enkulu. Inhloso yokulima izinkomo ukuhweba - ukuqedela imisebenzi kangcono nangokushesha. Umthombo wamandla odonsela izinkomo ungaba amahhashi, amadonkolo, noma ama-tractor. Izinto ezingasetshenziselwa ukudonsa izinkomo zifaka phakathi kokuhlwanyela, ukufaka izitshalo, ukususa izihlahla, ukuqoqa, nokuthutha. Indlela yokudonsa ekhethiwe izoncika ezinsizweni zomlimi futhi ingahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lomhlaba abawulimalayo. Ukuphathwa kungachazwa njengokuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke izici zokukhiqiza (umhlaba, izitshalo, izinkomo, imishini, nezimali) ukuze kufezwe izinjongo zokukhiqiza ukudla, ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo, noma ukusebenza kwezolimo. Ukuze ukusebenza kwezolimo kuphumelele, zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo kumele zisetshenziswe kahle - lokhu kufaka phakathi izimali, abantu, umhlaba, izitshalo, izinkomo, imishini, nemakethe. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza nokubhaliswa kwemibhalo kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimali futhi kufanele kwenziwe njalo nangokunakekela okukhulu. Uma ungenayo ifamu, awukwazi ukuzithemba ezizathwini zokungabi nengeniso ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezivela komunye umthombo ongasekela ukulima ngokwakho. Sicela ucabangele le mibuzo elandelayo - uzibuze imibuzo ngayinye futhi ucabange kahle ngempendulo yayo. Uma ungenalo ukuqonda kahle ngalokho ozama ukukufeza, kukhona ithuba elikhulu lokuthi ungaphumelelanga - uma ungeziqondi kahle lapho uya khona, kuzoba nzima ukufinyelela lapho uhlose khona! Le mibuzo elandelayo kufanele icatshangelwe ngaphambi kokuthi umlimi akhethe izitshalo afuna ukuzitshala, izinkomo afuna ukuziphakamisa, noma ukuhlanganisa okuthile. Kungani ngilima? Ingabe ifamu izoba umthombo wengeniso? Bangaki abantu abazothola inzuzo efamu? Ingabe uzokwenza zonke izabelo wedwa? Ingabe imikhiqizo izothengiswa efamini noma izothengiswa? Ingabe udinga noma iyiphi ukuqeqeshwa ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho namakhono mayelana nokulima? Kungani lezi zifundo ezithile zibalulekile? Ungakwazi ukufinyelela umhlaba ngokomthetho?
