Zonke izimpahla onazo kanye nezikweletu - ungumnikazi noma unedebhithi? Uma ungumsebenzi wezohwebo noma umkhiqizi, kufanele ube nesitatimende esicacile esibonisa zonke izimpahla onazo nezikweletu ozibophezela kuzo. Unazo ezingaki futhi iyini idebhithi yakho? Ukulima kuwuhwebo futhi ukutshalwa kwezimali kudinga imali eningi. Ngokuvamile, umfarmu udinga ukweleta okuthile noma konke okudingekayo ukuze aqale ukutshala (inzuzo). Ababolekisi badinga ukuthola lonke ulwazi mayelana nebhizinisi lomfarmu - badinga ukwazi konke okuhlobene nezimpahla nezikweletu. Njalo, abafarmi bavame ukwesaba ukuhlinzeka ngalo ulwazi, kodwa izikhungo zezimali zingaluthola (njengoba kushiwo kuMthetho Wokubolekwa Kwezimali), futhi uma ungeke uthethele kahle, bazokwazi futhi uzolahlekelwa ukwethembeka kwabo futhi ungaphumeleli ukuthola imali obufuna ukuyiboleka. Uma ufuna ukuba umkhiqizi ohlala phambili esikhathini esizayo, kufanele uvumele zonke izikweletu zakho - beka konke etafuleni futhi uvumele labo abanolwazi ngezindaba zezimali bakusize.
Iyiphi iqembu lesifundo elakha ibhena elihle kakhulu? Faka: Umncintiswano wezibhengezo zeqembu lesifundo ezihamba phambili! Ingxenye yalokho esifuna ukukwenza lapha ohlelweni lwethu lokuthuthukisa abalimi lokhu: sifuna ukwakha nokweseka amaqembu ezifundo. noPhillip Olivier eMpumalanga Kapa. Izinhloso zamaqembu ezifundo: Ukuqhakambisa abalimi abasafufusa abanezimila ukuze bakhe amaqembu ezifundo ahlangane njalo ukuze ahlaziye ukuqeqeshwa nokuthola ulwazi mayelana nokukhiqiza u-mazing. Kule nyanga uJohan Kriel uqale umncintiswano phakathi kwamaqembu ezifundo ukuze akhe izibhengezo futhi ibhena elihle kakhulu lizokhethwa kulawo wonke amanye. Lezi zibhengezo zizosebenza noma nini lapho kuhlangana khona futhi ezinsukwini zabalimi ukuze zikhombise ukuthi amalungu amaqembu ezifundo azithokozisa ngokuba yilungu. Le mifanekiso ikhombisa ubuhle bezibhengezo ezithile. Silindele ukubona imifanekiso evela kubaphathi bezifunda ukuze sikwazi ukukhetha ibhena elihle kakhulu!
Ngo-2010, kwaba unyaka odinga ukubekezela lapho kufezwa ukutshala ibhali kwiSikhungo Sokunisela eTaung. Kwakunezinkinga eziningi, ezifana nokutshala kokuqala uhlobo olubizwa ngokuthi 'cocktail', umoya opholile nokubanda okwahlala kuze kube nguSepthemba, imvula enamandla, ukuhlaselwa yizilokazane, nokusebenza okuncane. Ukuqala kokutshala uhlobo olusha lwezibhalibhalu olubizwa ngokuthi 'cocktail' kwiSikhungo Sokunisela eTaung kwalethe indaba enzima. Uhlobo lwe-'cocktail' lwabonisa ukuthi lungakwazi ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle ngehektare. Ngokubheka umlando wokutshala ibhali, sibona ukuthi u-'cocktail' uwuhlobo lokuqala ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo ehambisanayo eminyakeni emibili elandelanayo. Kwakunezinye izinkundla ezikhiqize ama-toni angu-7.9 ngehektare. Uma bekungekho zinkinga ezishiwo, u-'cocktail' ubengakubonisa ukuthi ungakhiqiza nakakhulu. Inkinga kwaba ukuthi amazinga e-nitrogen awahlangabezani namazinga abekwe yi-SABM. Nokho, lokhu sekuthuthuke, futhi imikhiqizo ngehektare ikhulile ngemuva kokutshala kokuqala le bhali ngo-1981 kwiSikhungo Sokunisela eTaung. Unyaka ka-2010 wawathinteka kakhulu ubanda nokufriza. Lokhu kwaqhubeka kuze kube ngu-Okthoba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukufriza kwaba nomthelela ebhalini phakathi nesikhathi sokukhula, kusukela ngesikhathi kuqala ukuvuthwa, kuze kube ngesikhathi kuqala ukuvuna, futhi kuze kube ngesikhathi okwakukhona khona okwakukhuluma kuze kube sekupheleni kokuvuthwa. Izimo zezulu zibalulekile kakhulu lapho kutshalwa ibhali. Ngonyaka odlule, ama-toni angu-1,129 akhishwe, kodwa ama-toni angu-1.35 abengaphansi kwestandadi ye-SABM, kanti amanye ama-toni angu-33 athengiswe ngemuva kokuhlolwa. Imvula eningi yadala izinkinga zekhwalithi ye-bhali. Ngesikhathi sokuvuna ngo-2010, imvula yasehlobo yayisanda kuqala. Ukuvuna kwaqala ngomhla kaNovemba 8, kodwa ngoNovemba 12, kwaqala ukuwa imvula. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavunwa kuphela inani elincane le-bhali. Izinkundla ezazingeziwunwanga zathinteka yilomvula, zakhokelela kulokhu okubizwa ngokuthi "ukuvuthwa kwangaphambi." Nokho, i-SABM yaqhubeka nokuhlola le nkinga futhi yasebenza nabakhiqizi (abalimi) ukuze bathole izindlela zokweseka nokusebenzisa le bhali ngendlela ezothokozisa bonke. Ukuhlaselwa izilokazane nakho kwanciphisa umkhiqizo. Ama-hektare angu-140 athinteka yizilokazane ngaleso sikhathi. Izilokazane zavele kathathu kulandela phakathi naleso sikhathi. Izinkampani ze-inshurensi zabalula ukuthi imikhiqizo yehlile ukusuka ku-45% kuya ku-47% ngaleso sikhathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kwakukhona ingozi enkulu ekukhiqizeni. Izinkundla ezivame ukukhiqiza phakathi kuka-6 no-7 ama-toni zathola kuphela ama-toni angu-4.9 ngehektare. Kwakubalulekile futhi ukuthola izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko zemishini. Ngakho-ke, kwakungcono ukusebenzisa ukusebenza okuncane. Le ndlela inciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwemishini eminingi - ukwenza imisebenzi ehlukene ngokuhambisa imshini kanye kuphela. Ngokufanayo, ungakha, utshale, futhi ufake umanyolo ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ngokusebenzisa le ndlela yokulima, umkhiqizo reached ama-toni angu-6.8 ngehektare lapho ama-hektare angu-120 atshalwe. Kulo nyaka, abakhiqizi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa bakhuthazekile futhi bafunda ezinye izindlela zokulima. Umkhiqizo ophumeleleka wama-toni angu-3,688 wasetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza ukudla kwezilwane kulo nyaka.
I-Bio-ethanol - kwenzekani mayelana nezombusazwe? Uma ufunda amaphephandaba, uzokwazi ukuthi kukhona ingxoxo enkulu mayelana nomthetho ozophatha ama-biofuels. Uzokwazi futhi ukuthi abalimi abaningi abakhiqiza ufulawa bahlupheka ngoba bacindezelwa ukuba bakhiqize ukudla okudingekayo, futhi manje baphakanyiswa ukuthi baphinde bakhiqize ufulawa ukuze bakhiqize uphethiloli noshukela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kukhona ochwepheshe abahola phambili abathi inqubo yokwenza i-ethanol izosiza ekukhiqizeni ukudla esikhathini esizayo. Abalimi abakhiqiza ufulawa bahlupheka ngoba imakethe yefulawa iyashintsha kakhulu, ikhuphuka kakhulu bese yehlisa kakhulu, okuhambisana nokuba khona kokuvuna okukhulu noma okuncane. Eminyakeni emibili edlule, kube nokuvuna okukhulu kakhulu kwefulawa, kodwa intengo yemakethe yehlile kakhulu - ngaleyo ndlela abalimi bahlupheka ekutholeni ezinye izindlela zokuthengisa ufulawa wabo. UWessel Lemmer, umnotho ophakeme e-Grain SA, uthe iNingizimu Afrika ikhiqiza ama-toni ayizigidi eziyi-8.6 zefulawa ngonyaka, kodwa inekhono lokukhiqiza ama-toni ayizigidi eziyi-12. Ngaphezu kwezigidi eziyodwa zehektare ezingasetshenziswa zilahlekile ngenxa yezintengo eziphansi zemakethe eminyakeni eyishumi edlule. Abalimi bahlupheka ukubhekana nezindleko ezikhulayo zokulima, futhi abazi ukuthi bangathola malini isidingo semakethe njengoba sishintsha. Konke lokhu kuholele abalimi ukuba baqale ukungabaza ukuthi ukukhiqiza ufulawa kuzobabazisa inzuzo ethembekile. Ngamazwi akhe: "Uma sinesikhala semakethe sema-toni amathathu ayizigidi, sithokozisa kakhulu ukukhula komnotho kuleli." Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma kukhona imakethe yalolu hlelo, izosiza ukukhula komnotho ezweni lethu ngendlela emangalisayo. Nokho, kukhona abanye abanezinkinga ngoba bakholelwa ukuthi uma ufulawa usetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amandla, kuzokwenyusa imakethe yefulawa ngendlela ezokwenza kube nzima kubantu ezweni elithembela kufulawa ukukwazi ukuthola ukudla. NgoJulayi 2007, uNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, uMosibudi Mangena, uthe iziphathimandla seziqale ukungabaza ukuthi ukusebenzisa ufulawa ukukhiqiza amandla akuwona umqondo omuhle. Baphakamisa le mibuzo elandelayo: Kuzokwenzekani ekukhiqizeni ukudla kwabantu uma sikhulisa i-ethanol kusukela kukashukela nofulawa ekugcineni? NgoAgasti 2007, umongameli webhange elikhulu laseNingizimu Afrika, uTito Mboweni, waphakamisa ukuthi ukukhiqiza i-ethanol kukhulu kakhulu emhlabeni, kukhuphule izindleko zokudla. Watshela uhulumeni ukuthi uyakuqonda ukuthi ama-biofuels adingeka ukukhiqizwa, kodwa ukhathazekile ukuthi ukusebenzisa ufulawa ukwenza i-ethanol kuzoba iphutha - ukholelwa ukuthi ukusebenzisa ushukela (i-cane) kuyindlela engcono. I-Grain SA, kanye ne-Agribusiness Chamber, i-National Agricultural Marketing Council, kanye nabaholi be-SA Biofuels Association (SABA) bahlangana noNkk. Mboweni ukuze banikeze umbiko ophawula izinzuzo ezingenzeka zokusebenzisa ufulawa ukukhiqiza i-ethanol kanye nosizo olungatholakala ekukhiqizeni ufulawa, phakathi kwezinye izinto. U-Andrew Makenete, umongameli we-SABA, ukholelwa ukuthi inqubo yokukhiqiza ama-biofuels ivula amathuba emisebenzi amasha ngezizathu ezahlukahlukene. Izosiza ukukhiqiza imali ezindaweni zasemaphandleni futhi umsebenzi wezolimo odingekayo uzothuthukiswa kulezo zindawo, usiza abalimi abasha ezweni lethu. I-SABA ifuna iNingizimu Afrika igxile ekukhiqizeni izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla ezifana nofulawa, ushukela, i-sugar beet, i-sorghum, nezinye ukuze kwenziwe ama-biofuels futhi kukhiqizwe ukudla. Omunye ophakamisa ukuhweba kwefulawa-ku-ethanol nguKobus Lindeque, i-MD ye-Monsanto yeSub-Saharan Africa. Ukholelwa ukuthi inqubo yokwenza i-ethanol kusukela kufulawa ibalulekile futhi izonikeza uhulumeni ithuba elihle lokunika abalimi abamnyama abasha ithuba lokubuyela emsebenzini wezolimo mayelana nenqubomgomo kahulumeni yokuhlinzeka ngendawo yokulima. Ngemva kwesikhathi eside, ngoDisemba 2007, uhulumeni wakhulula umbiko wabo nge-Biofuels Strategy. Okulandelayo yikho esikutholile kulowo mbiko. Sikubhala ngesiNgisi lapha, kodwa ekugcineni, sizozama ukuchaza lokho abakushilo ngamagama abo. Ukushintsha okukhulu kumkhankaso wombono wukwamukela ukugxila kwesikhashana (ukuhlola kweminyaka emihlanu) ukuze kufezwe izinga lokungena le-2% lama-biofuels ekunikezeni uphethiloli wesizwe, noma amalitha angama-400 million ngonyaka. Umgomo usuphendukile phansi kusuka kumgomo we-4.5% owawuphakanyisiwe ekuqaleni emibhalweni yombono. Lezi zitshalo ezilandelayo ziphakamisiwe ukuze kukhiqizwe ama-biofuels ezweni: ukuze i-bio-ethanol, ushukela noshukela beet, futhi ukuze i-biodiesel, i-sunflower, i-canola, kanye ne-soya beans. Ukuhlukana kwezinye izitshalo nezitshalo ezifana nofulawa ne-Jatropha kusekelwe ezinkathazweni zokuphepha kokudla. Ucwaningo olungeziwe lusemthethweni ukuze kuhlolwe ukusetshenziswa kwalezi ezweni. "Inani labatshalizimali abangenakuphika libonise intshisekelo ekuthuthukiseni ama-biofuels. Abanye abadlali embonini yeshukela sebekhiqiza i-bio-ethanol emakethe yotshwala yokuphuza nokuthunyelwa phesheya futhi bathuthukisa amandla e-ethanol yokuphepha ezweni elizungezile. Abanye abalimi befulawa, ngokubambisana nabatshalizimali abazimele, baveze inhloso yabo yokwakha amafektri amaningi efulawa-ku-ethanol. Lokhu kuphumelele ngenxa yokungaqiniseki ngokuqondiswa kanye nezikhuthazo kanye nokukhuphuka okukhulu kwezintengo zefulawa zendawo nezomhlaba. Ukukhuphuka kwentengo yefulawa kwenzekile kakhulu ngenxa ye-USA, ekhiqiza cishe u-50% wamafulawa athengiswa emhlabeni, idlulisa u-25% wezithombo zayo ekukhiqizeni i-ethanol, kanye nokwehliswa kokwesekwa kokuthunyelwa kwezolimo. Ukukhuphuka kwentengo yefulawa emhlabeni kanye nokushoda kokudla okuyisisekelo eMexico, okwakuxhunywe ngqo nezimali ze-biofuels, kube nomthelela eNingizimu Afrika ukuze ikhiphe ukusetshenziswa kwefulawa ezinyathelweni zayo zokuqala zokuthuthukiswa kwama-biofuels." Ngamafuphi, uhulumeni uthe kukhona inkinga mayelana nenani lokudla kwabantu ezizokhishwa esikhathini esizayo uma ufulawa ungasebenzisi ukukhiqiza ama-biofuels ekuqaleni, kodwa izinhlelo zabo ezihambisana nezikhathi ezizayo zithi kufanele kube khona umkhiqizo we-2% we-biofuels ngo-2013. UNgqongqoshe uLulu Xingwana wamema i-Grain SA, i-Agri SA, ne-NAFU ukuze baxoxe. Ingxoxo yayihloselwe ukuchaza isinqumo sikahulumeni sokukhipha ufulawa ekukhiqizeni ama-biofuels. Watshela umhlangano ukuthi isinqumo sikahulumeni sihlose ukuvimbela isimo lapho kungabi khona ukud
Kwenzeka ukuthi ukuhluza kube kuhambisana kuzo zonke izindawo futhi lapho zihlangana. Kwenzeka ukuthi imithi eminingi iphume futhi iphume kakhulu ngaphansi kwalowo nozzle. Abahluzi kahle - kwezinye izindawo ukuhluza akuhlangani, kwezinye kuhambisana kakhulu. Lapho ukudla kukhiqizwa, ukuhluza kusetshenziselwa ukubulala izihlahla, ukubulala izilokazane, noma ukufaka umanyolo ezithelweni (umanyolo uyagxilwa ezithelweni). Kule ndatshana, sizobheka izingxenye ze-sprayer nokuthi zisebenza kanjani. Ukuhluza izihlahla kungenzeka ngaphambi kokutshala (uku-hluza ngaphambi kokuphuma), noma ngesikhathi lapho isihlahla sikhula ezindaweni (ngemva kokuphuma). Ngokufanayo, izilokazane nezinyoni zihluzwa - kwesinye isikhathi uzohluza umhlabathi ngemva kokutshala ukuze ubulale izilokazane ezingaba khona emhlabathini; noma uhluze izilokazane uma seziqhakazile (lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuhluza kokuxhumana lapho izilokazane zifa ngokushesha), noma ungahluza izitshalo futhi izilokazane zifa uma zidla esitshalen (lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukufaka umanyolo - izilokazane zifa uma zidla esitshalen, hhayi uma zixhumana ne-pesticide). Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi i-pesticide kufanele ihluzwe ngempela ukuze isebenze kahle. Akulungile ukuhluza i-pesticide encane kakhulu ngoba ingase ingasebenzi kahle, futhi akusizi ukuhluza i-pesticide eningi kakhulu ngoba ingazama futhi ibangele umonakalo ezitshalweni nasemakhaleni. Ngesikhathi sokuhluza, ama-droplet angaba makhulu noma amancane. Uma uhluza ama-droplet amakhulu, awazukuhamba kalula emoyeni, kodwa azohamba ngokushesha ezithelweni. Ama-droplet amancane angase angahambi ezithelweni ngokushesha kodwa angahamba emoyeni. Ngesikhathi sokuhluza ama-droplet amancane, uzosebenzisa uketshezi okuncane - uma uhluza ama-droplet amakhulu uzosebenzisa uketshezi okuningi. Ngokuvamile, ukuhluza ngama-droplet amancane kuzokh covering the sprayed area ngokwanele, kodwa uma usebenzisa ama-droplet amakhulu, indawo lapho uhluza khona ingase ingagcwaliseki ngokuphelele. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuhluza i-pesticide ngesikhathi esifanele - lapho izihlahla ziqala ukukhula noma lapho izilokazane zizobeka ingozi. Kubalulekile futhi ukulandela imiyalelo mayelana nesikhathi sosuku sokuhluza i-pesticide, futhi uqaphele izimo zezulu ezifana nokoma kwezithombo. Akusizi nhlobo uma ufaka i-pesticide uma izihlahla seziqedile ukwehla kwezinhlamvu zazo, ngoba zihlala phansi futhi zizokhula ngonyaka ozayo - futhi akusizi ukufaka i-pesticide uma izihlahla seziqhakazile futhi ziphikisana nezitshalo zakho zokudla namanzi. Ngokufanayo, akusizi ukufaka i-pesticide ezilokazeni uma zingabonakali. Kodwa akusizi ukufaka i-pesticide uma izilokazane seziqala ukudla ingxenye yokuvuna kwakho. Iziphi izinto ezisebenza kanjani? Ama-nozzles ahlukene aklanyelwe ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezihlukene zokuhluza. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-nozzles futhi ziza ngezilinganiso ezahlukene. Ngokuvamile, iphethini efana ne-fan isetshenziswa lapho uhluza phezu komhlabathi, kuyilapho iphethini efana ne-cone isetshenziswa lapho uhluza phezu kwezithombo. Iphampu iyadingeka ukuze ikhiphe amanzi ethangini. Iphampu kumele ihlinzeke ngengcindezi ukuze i-nozzle ihlule kahle. Kukhona izingxenye ezahlukene lapho ama-sprayers axhunyiwe. Ama-sprayers angafakwa ezimotweni futhi angavulwa - lokhu kungaqhutshwa ngama-hydraulics noma ngesandla. Ekhanda le-sprayer, kukhona izingxenye ezingalungiswa ukuze zinciphise noma zikhuphuke ama-sprayers. Lokhu kulungiswa kuhluka kuma-sprayers ahlukene. Ezinye zingalungiswa ngama-hydraulics, kuyilapho ezinye zinezinqubo ze-bolt ezingashintsha isikhundla se-sprayer. Ama-tanks kufanele akhiwe ngezinto ezingaphuli, njenge-stainless steel, insimbi egaywe, noma i-fiberglass. Lezi zinto ngokuvamile aziphenduli ne-pesticide, ngakho-ke ngeke kube khona okushiywe ngemva kokusebenzisa ithangi. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi zonke izindawo lapho ithangi limbiwe zilungiswe ngokushesha ngoba lokhu kungadala ukuvuza futhi ithangi lizovunguza. Iphampu nazo zonke izingxenye zayo kufanele zisebenze kahle. Ngesikhathi kunezingxenye zokuhlanza (ama-gaskets, ama-O-rings, kanye nama-washers) akhiwe ngelastiki noma ngezinto ezenziwe, zingaguga noma zibe ne-deform uma iphampu ingasebenzi isikhathi eside noma uma ingabekwa kahle. Ezinye kemikhakha ethile ye-pesticides ingalimaza ama-seals, okwenza i-pesticide ivuze futhi iphampu ingasebenzi kahle. Ama-pumps amaningi ahlanzwa ngophethiloli, ngakho kubalulekile ukuhlola izinga le-oli njalo. Shintsha amabhayisikili amadala uma ubona ukuthi aphukile futhi avuza. Khumbula ukuthi amabhayisikili asetshenziselwa ukufaka i-pesticide yokulawulwa kwezilokazane awakwazi ukuhlanzwa ngokuphelele. Ingxenye yale pesticide izohlala ngaphakathi. Ngesikhathi sokulahla amabhayisikili amadala, qaphela ukuthi awaphindwanga ukuze asetshenziswe ngezinye izinjongo. Futhi, sebenzisa ama-filters uma usebenzisa i-sprayer. Lokhu kuzovimba uthuli nezinsalela ekungena kuma-nozzles, okungadala ukuthi i-sprayer ingasebenzi kahle. Ingcindezi yamanzi ohlelweni lokuhluza iboniswa kumagauge engcindezi. I-gauge ibonisa izinga lengcindezi ku-nozzle uma ixhunywe kumgibeli wengcindezi kanye nama-nozzles okuhluza. Ukushintsha ingcindezi kungadala ubungozi. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke ama-gauge asebenza kahle futhi alungiswe kahle. Kukhona ivali ohlelweni engakwazi ukunciphisa ingcindezi uma ufuna ukushintsha ingcindezi. Ingavulwa ukuze ilethe i-pesticide efanele kuma-nozzles athile, i-pesticide esele ibuyela ethangini, noma ivali ingavulwa ngokuphelele futhi i-pesticide ingena ohlelweni lonke lokuhluza. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuvimba ingxenye ye-pesticide ukuthi ihlale ezansi kwethangi uma imishini imisiwe. Kukhona futhi iphampu engakwazi ukuvala ezinye izindawo ze-sprayer uma ufuna ukuhluza indawo encane kakhulu noma ingavulwa ukuze ihluze indawo enkulu. Uma izindawo lapho amabhayisikili axhunyiwe zikhululekile noma ziphukiwe, zingadala ukuvuza kwe-pesticide. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izixhumi nezibambo ziqinile ngaphambi kokuqala ukwandisa ingcindezi nokuqala ukuphumpa. Uma uqala ukuphumpa (ukuhluza), hlola noma yiziphi ukuvuza. Hlola njalo ukuthi ama-nozzles avulekile. Ama-nozzles avinjiwe adala ukuhluza kwe-pesticide okweqile futhi iphethini yokuhluza ayihlanganisi zonke izindawo - lokhu kungadala ukuthi i-pesticide ingasebenzi kahle. Usayizi wezikhala zama-nozzles ungashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ikakhulukazi uma i-pesticide egxilile ixutshwa namanzi - lokhu kudala ukuthi ama-nozzles aphume ngokushesha. Shintsha i-nozzle uma uthola ukuthi i-nozzle endala ihlula ngaphezu kuka-5 - 10% uma iqhathaniswa neyesisha.
Yini edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ibhizinisi? Ukuhlanganisa uhlelo lwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshekwe ibhizinisi kahle kungaba umsebenzi obalulekile futhi ohlukile. Izidingo nezinsiza zingashintsha kuye ngohlobo lwebhizinisi, usayizi bayo, isikhathi esitholakalayo, njll. Ibhizinisi lezolimo lizoba nezidingo ezifana nomhlaba, amanzi, izinkomo, izakhiwo, indawo yokusebenza (iworkshop), indawo yokucubungula, imishini yokuphonsa, izimoto, imishini, ama-tractors, amathuluzi, abasebenzi, izimali, kanye nokuphathwa. Lezi zinsiza ezidingekayo zingahlukaniswa kanje: kukhona ukuphathwa, izindaba zomhlaba, izindaba zezimali, nezindaba zabasebenzi. Umhlaba - lokhu kungaba yifama noma izinkundla, izinkomo, izakhiwo, nezinye izakhiwo ezifana nezinsiza, izinqaba, izindawo zokuhlala izilwane, nezindonga. Imali yokusebenza - ibhekisela kumali uqobo nezinye izimpahla ezifana nama-tractors, izimoto, nezilwane. Abasebenzi - ibhekisela kubantu abasebenza efameni ngaphansi komninimfuyo noma umphathi. Ukuphathwa - umuntu noma abantu abaphatha ukusebenza kwebhizinisi. Ngaphandle kwezinto zokusebenza, konke okunye okuhlobene nokukhiqiza kungokwezimali zebhizinisi noma kukhishwe noma kuqashwe kwezinye izindawo. Uma umhlaba, imali yokusebenza, nokuphathwa kukhishwe noma kuqashwe, kubizwa ngokuthi izinsiza zangaphandle (ezivela kwezinye izindawo - omninimfuyo abanye). Lo mninimfuyo wangaphandle kufanele akhokhelwe ukusetshenziswa kwaleyo nsiza - okusho ukuthi kukhona izindleko ezihilelekile. Imiholo - ukukhokhelwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi/nabaphathi abavela kwezinye izindawo. Qaphela ukuthi abasebenzi abakwazi ukuba yimpahla yebhizinisi (ibhizinisi alikho emnini), kodwa akubizwa ngokuthi izinsiza zangaphandle. Ngakho-ke, zonke izindleko zabasebenzi - imiholo nezinye azibhekwa njengezindleko zangaphandle. Abasebenzi nezindleko zazo zibhekwa njengezindleko ezijwayelekile lapho kukhiqizwa khona goods. Umsebenzi unikeza ibhizinisi amandla noma ulwazi bese ethola umholo.
Yisiphi uhlobo lwebhizinisi okufanele ukhethe? Ukukhetha uhlobo lwebhizinisi kanye nesakhiwo sakhona kubalulekile. Isizathu salokhu sithi: kunomthelela omkhulu uma sikhuluma ngababusi, ubunjalo babanikazi, nabanye ababusi kanye nezindaba zezimali zebhizinisi elisha. Sizoxoxa ngohlobo lwezinkampani eziyisithupha ezibalulekile lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Ingxoxo izothinta izimo ezibalulekile zokwakheka. Lezi zinkampani zingaba: umnikazi oyedwa, ubambiswano nomunye noma abaningi, inkampani evaliwe (cc), ithemba lebhizinisi, noma ubambiswano. Izimo zokwakheka zihlobene nezinhlobo zebhizinisi ezifana nokuba khona kwabaphathi/abanikazi abathembekile, ukusungula izinqubo zokusebenza, ukuba nezibopho zokuphatha, ukusabalalisa inzuzo kanye nezintela ezihambisanayo, kanye namathuba okukhulisa imali ukuze kuqhubeke nokusebenza. Lapha asizoxoxi ngama-Companies kanye nezibambiso; sizokhuluma ngalokho kusasa ngoba lezi yizindaba ezibalulekile. Kubhizinisi obuncane, kubalulekile ngoba umnikazi oyedwa udinga imali encane futhi kulula ukuqala nokuphatha lelo bhizinisi. Nokho, ukusebenza kwalabo bhizinisi kuvame ukungakhuli futhi kungande. Ukuba umnikazi webhizinisi akusho ukuthi njalo kukhona ababusi, ngakho-ke ibhizinisi lithembele kumnikazi, impilo yabo, izimo zabo zokuphila, nezimali zabo. Lokhu kungadala nezingozi ezimpahleni zomnikazi. Uma ibhizinisi liphuka, kuzothinta nomnikazi. Ukusungulwa kwebhizinisi kulula ngoba umnikazi udinga ukubhalisela igama lebhizinisi nokuthola ilayisensi yokuhweba. Azikho ezinye izidingo ezisemqoka ngaphandle kwemithetho ekhona mayelana nalabo bhizinisi. Lokhu kungafaka nemithetho ephathelene nezempilo uma umnikazi enendawo efana ne-restaurants. Ukuba umnikazi webhizinisi kusho ukuthi uphatha ibhizinisi uqobo. Nokho, umnikazi angakhetha ukufaka umphathi ukuze aphathe ibhizinisi ngaye. Khumbula ukuthi noma ungum sahibi noma unomphathi, akukho thuba lokuthuthuka kulolo bhizinisi. Umphathi womnikazi oyedwa angashintsha ngokushesha indlela ibhizinisi elisebenza ngayo uma izimo zangaphandle zishintsha. Ukuba umnikazi oyedwa kwesinye isikhathi kungaba nzima ngoba umuntu oyedwa akanaso sonke ulwazi oluhambelana nokuphatha ibhizinisi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuphatha zonke izici ezifana nezimali, ukumaketha, ukusebenza, ukuthenga nokuthengisa, ukugcina amarekhodi, nokuphatha abasebenzi. Lapha akukhona ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwezimpahla zomnikazi nezindaba zabo zezimali ezihambelana naleli bhizinisi ngoba konke okwenziwayo kanye nenhlalakahle yebhizinisi kuyinzuzo yomnikazi. Ngakho-ke, zonke izintela ezingakaphumuli ebhizinisini zikhishwa kumnikazi. Nokho, umnikazi angathola ezinye izinzuzo njengomsebenzi. Ukuba umnikazi oyedwa akufani nokuba nebhrendi enabantu abaningi. Ngakho-ke, zonke izindaba zezimali zizovela ephaketheni lomnikazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi thuba lokwandisa ibhizinisi ngokuthola uxhaso lwangaphandle luzokhawulelwa ezimpahleni nasezimali umnikazi anazo - uma engenazo eziningi, imali etholakalayo yangaphandle nayo ngeke ibe mkhulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile kumnikazi oyedwa ukuthi aqhubeke efaka ingxenye yezinzuzo zakhe emuva ebhizinisini uma efuna ibhizinisi lakhe likhule. Ukuba umnikazi oyedwa kusho ukuthi ibhizinisi lonke lifana nesikhwama sakhe. Uma efela noma ibhizinisi liphuka ngenxa yezikweletu, lelo bhizinisi lizophela. Uma ibhizinisi lidayiswa, alisasebenzi egameni lomdayisi, kodwa egameni lomthengi. Uma umnikazi efuna ukudayisa ibhizinisi, izexwayiso kufanele zikhishwe ukuze kuvikelwe bonke abanye abakhokhi bezikweletu. Uma umnikazi efuna ukuvala ibhizinisi, akudingi izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Izindaba zezimali zihlala kumphakathi womnikazi; uma beqeda ukusebenza, kusho ukuthi ibhizinisi closed. Ubambiswano uvame ukwenzeka uma abantu abanebhizinisi elifanayo, njengodokotela noma abameli, befuna ukuhlanganisa. Ubambiswano lusebenza kahle uma inani elikhulu lemali lingadingeki ukuze kuqale noma uma amakhono athile omuntu odinga ukuphatha ibhizinisi. Ubambiswano kuyisivumelwano phakathi kwabantu ababili noma abaningi. Inani lababambisene akufanele lidlule ku-20. Ababambisene abakhulumi nabanye bahlala bekhona. Abantu bangaba amalungu obambiswano njengabantu bemvelo. Isibonelo: ezinye izinkampani zakha i-consortium futhi zingaba ababambisane. Ababambisane abavela emsebenzini bahlukaniswa ngesikhathi ababe khona kulolo ubambiswano kanye nenani lemali abahlinzeke ngalo. Ababambisane abavela emsebenzini babamba iqhaza ekuphatheni ubambiswano, kodwa labo abangasebenzi baphatha ibhizinisi. Ababambisane abakhulumi baziwa kwabanye abaneqhaza elithile kubambiswano kodwa abakwazi ukukhuluma egameni lobambiswano. Umphakathi ongaziwa ngaphandle kobambiswano. Ubambiswano uhlose ukwenza ibhizinisi elisemthethweni elizokwenza inzuzo. Ngaphandle kwalokhu kuhloswe, abantu abakwazi ukudala ubambiswano. Umuntu ngamunye ubophelelekile ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokubambisana. Lezi zikhungo zingaba imali, izinsizakalo, noma ezinye izimpahla. Ngenkathi ubambiswano bukhona, izindaba zezimali zihlala kumphakathi wabo bonke ababambisane. Nokho, uma ubambiswano buphuka, izimpahla zizohlukaniswa phakathi kwabobambisane bonke kanye nomuntu ngamunye. Ubambiswano lusungulwa/ngokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabobambisane. Isivumelwano sithi bonke bazokwenza umzamo wokuthola inzuzo yokubambisana. Izibopho nezibopho zababambisane zihlobene nesivumelwano sobambiswano. Lokhu kufanele kuchazwe kulolo hlelo lobambiswano. Uma kungekho ukucaciswa, umthetho uthi inzuzo kufanele ihlukaniswe ngokuya ngempahla ethile yomuntu ngamunye. Uma kunzima ukunquma ukuthi ubani ohlinzeke ngani, khona-ke bonke ababambisane bazothola inzuzo efanayo. Ubambiswano aludingi ukukhokha intela, kodwa ababambisane kufanele bakhokhe intela ezinzuzweni abathola. Izindaba zezimali zihlanganiswa uma ubambiswano busungulwa phakathi kwabantu ababili noma abaningi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola uxhaso oludingekayo uma kuqhathaniswa nomnikazi oyedwa. Ababolekisi bahlola izimo zabobambisane bonke, okwenza kube lula ukuthola izimali ezidingekayo. Izikweletu zesikhathi eside zingase zingatholakali kalula ngoba ubambiswano abuyona ibhizinisi njengenkampani; ayiqhubeki ngokungapheli. Ukuqhubeka kobambiswano kufana nokuba umnikazi oyedwa, futhi kungaphela uma omunye wabambisane efela noma omunye ehluleka ngokwezimali. Uma umthetho ophathelene nokusungulwa kobambiswano ushintsha, ubambiswano luyaphela. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubambiswano obusha kufanele busungulwe. Uma umphathi efela, isivumelwano phakathi kwabobambisane siba sephukile. Umthetho we-Close Corporation ka-1984 wadala uhlobo lwebhizinisi olunemvume yomthetho kodwa alunazo zonke izimiso nemithetho ehambelana nokusungulwa kwenkampani. Ngakho-ke, inkampani evaliwe iyis
Idokhumenti elivela enyangeni edlule laphawula ngokuhlelwa kokufafaza nokuthi kusebenze kanjani. Lapha, sizobhekisisa ngokukhethekile ukuthi leyo sprayer ingahlelwa kanjani. Yini ukuhlela? Inhloso yokuhlela i-sprayer ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ifafaza inani elifanele leli liquid (amanzi ne-chemical) endaweni ethile. Amanzi amaningi akhishwa. Umfutho we-sprayer uzokhombisa ukusebenza komshini. Lungisa inani le-chemical emanzini. Khulisa inani lamanzi afafazwayo. Gcwalisa ithangi le-sprayer. Linomthamo ongu-4 liters kanye nomfutho ongu-2,500 rpm. Linganisa ubude obungu-100 m. I-sprayer ihamba ibanga elilinganayo no-100 m (isibonelo: imizuzwana engu-21). Bheka ukuthi mangaki amafutha aphuma phansi. Setha umfutho ofunwa (isibonelo: 3 bar). Ukuze ufafaze, linganisa inani lamanzi aphuma kumphakamo owodwa (isibonelo: 1,200 ml / 1.2 liters). Sebenzisa inani lamanzi aphuma kumphakamo owodwa, isibonelo, phinda lokhu ngenani lezi zimpakamo. Linganisa ububanzi bokufafaza (4.7 m). Lokhu kububanzi bungakanani endaweni engu-100 m? Indawo efafazwe ngaphezu kuka-100 m: 100 m x 4.7 m = 470 square meters. Sebenzisa ama-14.4 liters kule ndawo. Indawo engu-1 hectare = 10,000 square meters (100 m x 100 m). Futhi inani lelitre le-chemical elidingekayo nge-hectare. Noma usayizi wezimpakamo. Lokhu kuzongena ethangini. Isibonelo, ithangi ligcina ama-500 liters. Ama-4 liters nge-hectare. Phindaphinda ngo-4 (amalitre e-chemical nge-hectare). Kufanele ungeze ama-6.5 liters e-chemical ethangini elingu-500-liter.
Uhlola kanjani ukuthi i-planter ilungiswe kahle ukuze ifeze ukutshala? Thola zonke izingxenye ze-planter ezingalungisa ukulungiswa (ama-sprockets, ama-gears, nezitsha). Qonda ukuthi i-planter ithengisa kanjani uma kuqhathaniswa nezimpande nez fertiliser ngamanani akhona. Linganisa ububanzi ngaphakathi kwezingxenye ze-planter ukuze unqume ububanzi bezigaba zokutshala - lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukala inani lezigaba ezizotshalwa ngaphezulu kwe-hectare (Isibonelo: ububanzi be-hectare bungama-100 meters, uma ububanzi ngaphakathi kwezigaba bungama-0.9 m, khona-ke 100 m / 0.9 m = 111 izigaba nge-hectare). Beka indawo endaweni engama-10 m. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezimpande nez fertiliser emabhokisini (ama-hoppers) - futhi uqinisekise ukuthi usayizi wezimpande uhambisana nezimbobo ezikuma-plates - kufanele kube ne-1 seed kuphela ehla ngesikhathi. Qinisa ipulasitiki emaphethelweni aphehla fertiliser ukuze ukwazi ukukala isisindo se-fertiliser ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Phusha i-planter kule ndawo engama-10 m (qinisekisa ukuthi amavili anokuxhumana okuhle nomhlabathi). Bala inani lezimpande eziphume kule ndawo engama-10 m. ku-100 m (khumbula ukuthi i-hectare iyalingana no-100 m x 100 m). uma ububanzi bethu bungama-0.9 m, kusho ukuthi kune-111 izigaba ku-100 m. Isibonelo: sithola ukuthi ama-30 seeds aphumelele kule ndawo engama-10 m. futhi ama-300 seeds ku-100 m. phinda: x 300 = 33,300 izitshalo nge-hectare. ama-sprockets ukuze i-planter ihambe ngokushesha. Thola isisindo se-fertiliser ephumelele kule ndawo engama-10 m. Manje phinda lowo nombolo ngenani lezigaba ezikhona ku-100 m (esibonelweni sethu, ububanzi ngaphakathi bube ngu-0.9 m okusho ukuthi kune-111 izigaba endaweni efanayo no-100 m). Isibonelo: kungaba nama-100 g (0.1 kg) kule ndawo engama-10 m. Lokhu kulingana nama-1,000 grams (1 kg) ku-100 m. Kune-111 izigaba nge-hectare, x 1000 = 111,000 grams, okusho ukuthi uzofaka ama-111 kg nge-hectare). Uma inani olitholayo lidlula lokho okufunayo, shintsha ama-sprockets e-planter ukuze iphumuzi eliphehla ama-plates lingahambi ngokushesha kakhulu (hamba kancane) (Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma inani le-fertiliser eliceliwe lincane, shintsha ama-sprockets ukuze iphumuzi ihambe ngokushesha). Phinda le nqubo kuze kube uthola inani elifanele le-fertiliser.

Ngomhla ziyi-29 kuSepthemba 2009, uhlelo lwe-Grain SA Farmer Development Program lwabamba umcimbi omkhulu - ukujabulisa amalungu e-250 Ton Club. Uhlelo lwe-Farmer Development Program lwezokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu eNingizimu Afrika luhlose ukuphakamisa abalimi abamnyama ngecala elikhulu e-Fanie Ferreira hall e-NAMPO ukuze wamukele futhi wabonga abalimi abafanelekayo ukuba bahlale emhlanganweni wabalimi abamnyama - labo abakhiqiza ngaphezu kwama-250 tons nge-hectare yokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu. Indlela yokuba umlimi omnyama wokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu ayilula, futhi awekho amakhono okuthola khona kalula. Ukulima kuyinselele enzima, futhi inzuzo ivame ukuba ncane. Lezi zinkampani zixhaswa abantu abasebenza kuhlelo lwe-Grain Producers Development Program eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa kukhona nabanye abaningi abahlinzeka ngosizo, njengamabhange, amabhizinisi ezolimo, izinkampani ezinikeza izinto zokulima, iziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi oluvela eMnyangweni Wezolimo, nabanye abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Ngonyaka owedlule saphinde savuselela i-250 Ton Club ukuze wamukele labo abalimi abakhiqiza ngaphezu kwama-250 tons njengamanje futhi abaseduze kokubizwa ngokuthi "abalimi bezomnotho." Abaningi balesi sigaba bazoba yingxenye yohlelo lwethu eminyakeni ezayo, ngakho sifuna ukuqaphela umsebenzi wabo omuhle. Amalungu e-250 Ton Club aqhubeka ekhula. Njengamanje sinezikhulu eziyisixhenxe ku-1,000 Ton Club, amalungu ayi-13 ku-500 Ton Club, kanye namalungu ayi-21 ku-250 Ton Club. Kulonyaka, amalungu ayisishiyagalombili angena kuleli Club. Emcimbini walonyaka, sethule okuthile okusha - i-Smallholder Farmer Competition yonyaka. E-Mpumalanga nase-Eastern Cape, kukhona abalimi abaningi abakha umhlaba owodwa noma owabili emphakathini. Lezi zabalimi zenze umsebenzi omuhle wokuletha ukudla emphakathini njalo. Ingxenye yale nhlangano ihlose ukuqeqesha nokuxhasa lezi zabalimi ezincane ukuze bakwazi ukuthuthukisa izindlela zabo zokulima. Ngakho-ke, saqala lo mqhudelwano ukuze siqaphele umsebenzi wabo omuhle. Kulonyaka, u-F.J. Mhlanga ophuma e-Mpumalanga no-S.E. Shabhu ophuma e-Eastern Cape bathuthuke. Nokho, lezi zabalimi zisebenzisa izindawo ezincane kahle, ziletha izinto ezinhle emphakathini wazo.
Ukuze ibhizinisi lezolimo libe nenzuzo, kumele likwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo efunwa ngabathengi. Ngemuva kwalokho, le nenzuzo kufanele iqhubeke ibe khona esikhathini esizayo, ngakho ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi lezolimo kufanele kukhule futhi kuthuthuke ngokuqhubekayo esikhathini esizayo. Ezinsukwini zokuqala zomuntu, umuntu wayedinga izinto ezizomsiza ukuze aphile. Ukudla kwakubalulekile, bese edinga nezingubo nezindawo zokuhlala. Ekuqaleni, abantu bathola izinto ezidingekayo ngok hunting, ukuqoqa ukudla ezitshalweni zemvelo, ukuhwebela izingubo zabo, nokuzivikela ezimeni. Njengoba umuntu eqhubeka phambili, izidingo zawo ziqhubeka zishintsha zibe sezingeni eliphezulu kunezamanje. Umuntu uphinde udlule ekuzimeleni ukuya endaweni lapho konke okudingekayo kuthengwa. Singasho ukuthi empilweni yezenhlalo yanamuhla, amabhizinisi ahlinzeka ngazo zonke izinto ezidingekayo, kodwa zikhokha imali. Ngakho, namuhla sidinga imali ukuze sithenge izinto ezibalulekile zokuphila. Njengoba singabantu abafuna ukuthenga lezi zinto, singathola imali kuphela ngokusebenza kuyo. Ungasebenza ngokwakho noma usebenze komunye umuntu ukuze uthole umholo. Uma ukhetha ukusebenza ngokwakho ngokuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo, leli bhizinisi kufanele likulethe inenzuzo - kumele uphumelele kwezezimali. Ekulimaleni, kungaba nempumelelo kuphela uma ibhizinisi lakho lihlinzeka abantu ngezinto abazidingayo - ngaleyo ndlela umnikazi wale bhizinisi uzokwenza inenzuzo. Uma ibhizinisi lenza inenzuzo, umnikazi uzokwazi ukukhipha umholo. Uma ibhizinisi lingakwenzi inenzuzo, umnikazi uthola lutho. Izinto ezidingekayo zikhona ezinkampanini, futhi abathengi bazithenga. Imali engenayo evela ekuthengiseni izinto ezidingekayo iyinenzuzo yebhizinisi. Uma ibhizinisi likhiqiza noma lihambisa izinto ezidingekayo, libhekana nezindleko ezithile. Izindleko zokukhiqiza - imbewu, amafutha, amakhemikhali ezifo, imithi, ukuvuna, nezindleko zokumaketha. Izindleko eziphezulu - izimali zebhange, izindleko zendawo yokusebenza, izindleko zokubhaliswa kwezimali, nezindleko zemoto nezithuthi. Izindleko eziyisisekelo - amalayisense ezimoto, amaholo çalışan abaqashiwe, ukuncipha kwezithuthi nezakhiwo, nezindleko ze-inshurensi. Izindleko zangaphandle - intshontsho yemali ebolekiwe, amaholo abaphathi, nokurenta izindlu noma umhlaba. Zonke izindleko zizofana nalokho okukhuluma ngenhla (uma sizihlanganisa zonke). Inenzuzo ifana nalokho okusele ngemuva kokukhipha zonke izindleko. Uma kukhiqizwa, abakhiqizi bangaba abathengi bezintengo (imali engenayo) nezindleko. Kokubili, amanani nezindleko, akhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kodwa ezingeni elihlukile. Isibonelo: ngoMashi 26, 2010, uJ Willemse wabhala kuLandbouweekblad ukuthi ngonyaka ka-2009, inenzuzo yamabhizinisi ezolimo emhlabeni jikelele yakhula ngo-2.6% kulonyaka, kodwa izindleko zakhula ngo-8%. Lezi zilinganiso zihluka minyaka yonke kodwa zakha okuthiwa "ukucindezela kwezindleko-nani." Uma sibheka iminyaka neminyaka, lokhu kungaboniswa njengokuhlelwa okulandelayo (Isithombe 1) (Uhlu lwezinsiza: Willemse, J. 2010, Ukwehla kwezimali kudlulela ezolimo. Landbouweekblad: Mashi 26, 2010). Uma umsebenzi epulazini uqhubeka ngendlela efanayo unyaka nonyaka, umgapho phakathi kwemali engenayo nezindleko zokuhlinzeka izindleko uzovalwa, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukufinyelela inenzuzo. Uma sibheka umsebenzi wethu sigxile ezindabeni zezimali, kubonakala ukuthi ukuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo kufanele kuthuthuke futhi kuqhubeke kukhula ngokuqhubekayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ibhizinisi lakho ngeke likwazi ukuqhubeka liphumelele esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kungenzeka uma siqhubeka nokunaka le ndaba ukuze ukuphathwa kwemikhakha yebhizinisi kuqhubeke kukhula ngaso sonke isikhathi. Inhloso kufanele kube ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali engenayo ihlale iphakeme kunezindleko (izindleko) ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kuboniswa ku-Isithombe 2 ngezansi. Lokhu akusiyo umsebenzi olula ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezingaphandle kokulawula komphathi wepulazi ezingashintsha umkhondo webhizinisi. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuyinselelo enkulu kumnikazi/umphathi webhizinisi lezolimo. Ngokwazi umsebenzi, kufanele uhlale ucabanga ngezindaba zezimali eziphathelene nemali engenayo nezindleko (izindleko) lapho wenza noma yini ebhizinisini lakho. Ekuphetheni, singasho ukuthi ukuze ibhizinisi lezolimo libe nenzuzo, kumele lihlinzeke abathengi ngezimpahla/imikhiqizo abayidingayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, abaphathi bamabhizinisi ezolimo kufanele baqinise imizamo yabo ukuze baqhubeke benza inenzuzo esikhathini esizayo, ukuze umsebenzi wabo uhlale uthuthuka.
Ngokuvamile, ukuhweba kwezolimo kuyinselele enzima. Futhi singasho ukuthi abalimi bethu abesabi ukusebenza kanzima. Nokho, okwamanje, ukuhweba kwezolimo kudinga okungaphezu kokusebenza kanzima. Kuyajwayeleka lapho uqala umsebenzi omusha ukuthi izinto zingahambi kahle, futhi ukuhweba kwezolimo akuhlukile. Amaphutha azokwenzeka. Okwamanje, izindleko zokuqala ziphakeme, futhi intengo emakethe yezitshalo iphansi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Abalimi abaphumelelayo benza inzuzo encane, futhi ngakho-ke abakwazi ukukhokhela ama-traktor nemishini emisha. Baqhubeka nokusebenza ngemali ebolekiwe. Lokhu kudala ingozi ngoba kuyabakhathaza. Ukuze uthole imali ebolekiwe, abalimi bahlukunyezwa ukuba bakhokhe umshwalense, okwehlisa inzuzo yabo. Ukuhweba kwezolimo kuwumsebenzi ophathelene nezinto eziningi; kufanele ukwazi ukuqonda izinto ezahlukene kakhulu. Ukuba nolwazi (imfundo) kuphela akukwanele - abalimi bafunda unyaka nonyaka kuze kube bathola ubuchule. ENingizimu Afrika, abalimi abasafufusa baqala ukungena emkhakheni wezolimo futhi bathola ukuthi ukuhweba kwezolimo kunzima - uma ufuna ukuphumelela, kufanele ube nomfutho oqinile! Ngalezi zinzuzo eziphansi, awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Uzothola kanjani ubuchule futhi ngubani ozokuphakamisa uma ufika ezingeni eliphansi? Abalimi abasafufusa bathola kunzima kakhulu ukuthola imali yokukhiqiza. Lokhu kusibonisile: inzuzo incane futhi izingozi ziningi. Siyazi ukuthi labo abahlinzeka ngemali ebolekiwe abafuni ukulahlekelwa yimali yabo. Okwamanje, sigxile ekutholeni ukwesekwa kwiBhange Lezindawo ukuze sikwazi ukukhiqiza - kuyisibopho sabo ukuhlinzeka ngemali ebolekiwe kubalimi abasafufusa - ngakho kufanele sisebenze kahle nabo kulolu hlelo. Kweminyaka, inzuzo ibiphansi, futhi impilo yemishini iphinde yehlise - udinga ukwenza inzuzo ukuze ukwazi ukugcina nokulungisa imishini yakho noma ukuthenga izinto ezintsha. Kukhona abalimi abanomhlaba lapho bengakwazi khona ukuhweba, kodwa okwamanje, abakwazi ukwenza inzuzo ekuhwebeni (ngenxa yezindleko zokuqala eziphakeme/intengo ephansi/umhlabathi omubi). Kukhona abanye abanomhlaba omuhle kodwa bengenamanzi, futhi abakwazi ukuhweba ngempumelelo. Abanye badinga inani elikhulu lempuphu neminingi yephosphate ukuze bathuthukise umhlabathi. Bese kuba abanye abanamakhono okuhweba kodwa bephazamiseka ukuthola umhlaba ngenxa yezinkinga neMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba (sizokhuluma ngalokhu futhi kwesinye isikhathi). Kucacile ukuthi kunezinkinga ezahlukene zomhlaba ezihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwabalamini abasafufusa ezibenza bahlupheke. Siphikisana nabo emsakazweni.
Izibulala-zinambuzane zisetshenziswa kakhulu ezinhlelweni ezilawula izihlahla ezimbi. Lezi zibulala-zinambuzane kufanele zisetshenziswe ukweseka ezinye izindlela ezikhona. Lezi zindlela zifaka phakathi izindlela zokulima ezinhle ezifana nokufaka umanyolo owanele kanye ne-mulch ukuze kuvumele izitshalo ukuba ziqinise kahle, ukujikeleza izinhlobo zezitshalo, kanye nokulima kahle. Konke lokhu kubalulekile lapho izihlahla ezimbi kufanele zilawulwe kahle. Izibulala-zinambuzane zifakwa ngemuva kokulima lapho kusasele isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokutshala. Izibulala-zinambuzane ngokuvamile zixutshwa nomhlabathi ophakeme usebenzisa umshini oxuba umhlabathi nezibulala-zinambuzane. Izibulala-zinambuzane zifakwa emhlabathini ngemuva kokulima kanye nokulungiselela umhlabathi wokutshala kodwa ngaphambi kokutshala. Ixhunywa nomhlabathi ophakeme futhi hhayi kakhulu; kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zemishini ezisebenza kule nqubo. Izibulala-zinambuzane zifakwa ezitshalweni ngemuva kokukhula kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele emhlabathini. Umoya emhlabathini, imvula encane, kanye nokunyakaza okuncane komhlabathi kungasiza ekusebenzeni kahle kwezibulala-zinambuzane ngaphambi kokukhula. Izibulala-zinambuzane zifakwa ezitshalweni ngemuva kokukhula. Le yisinyathelo esiphakathi esivumela izibulala-zinambuzane ukuba spread futhi zibe neqhaza elilinganayo uma zixhumana nezitsha noma nomhlabathi. Kunezisho eziningi ezichaza le nhlangano yezibulala-zinambuzane ezifana ne-adjuvant, i-detergent, i-emulsifier, i-spreader, i-sticker, kanye ne-wetting agent. Izinhlobo eziningi zezibulala-zinambuzane ezisetshenziswa kwezolimo zikh selectiv. Uma zisetshenziswa kahle, zizobulala noma zibe nomthelela kwezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo ezimbi kodwa azizukulimaza izitshalo ezikhulayo lapho. Uma usebenzisa izibulala-zinambuzane ezikhethiwe, kufanele ulandele imiyalelo yokufaka ngokucophelela ngoba uma uxuba izibulala-zinambuzane eziningi, ungabulala noma ulime izitshalo zakho. Umthwalo uzobe usezandleni zakho uma ungahambisani nemiyalelo esetikini. Funda itikiti futhi ulandele imiyalelo. Ukulinganisa kahle kubalulekile kakhulu uma ufaka izibulala-zinambuzane. Kunezinto ezintathu okufanele sizinakekele uma sithululela: usayizi wezimpaphe, usayizi wesiphumuli, kanye nesivinini sokuthululela. Imiyalelo ekhombisa inani lezibulala-zinambuzane okufanele zifakwe iyahluka ngokuya ngendawo yomhlabathi (umhlabathi ophakeme, umhlabathi ophakathi, umhlabathi we-clay) kanye nenani lempaphe zomhlabathi ezikhona. Inani lezibulala-zinambuzane ezifakwe emhlabathini ophakeme onempaphe eziningi ngokuvamile lincane; emhlabathini we-clay onempaphe eziningi, inani lezibulala-zinambuzane linyuka. Bheka itikiti ukuze uthole inani elifanele lezibulala-zinambuzane kanye nesimo somhlabathi wakho. Izinhlobo zezitshalo ezimbi ezingakwazi ukumelana nezibulala-zinambuzane zingavela uma izibulala-zinambuzane ezifanayo zifakwa kaningi nangendlela efanayo. Ukujikeleza izinhlobo zezitshalo ezitshaliwe, ukushintsha izinhlobo zezibulala-zinambuzane ezisebenza ngezindlela ezahlukene kungavimbela ukuvela kwezihlahla ezimbi ezingakwazi ukumelana nezibulala-zinambuzane. Isidingo semvula ngemuva kokufaka izibulala-zinambuzane ezifakwe ngemuva kokukhula kubalulekile. Khumbula ukuthi isikhathi esithile ngaphandle kwemvula sidingeka ngemuva kokufaka noma iyiphi izibulala-zinambuzane. Uma imvula iwela ngesikhathi, kungase kudingeke ukufaka kabusha izibulala-zinambuzane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisebenza kahle ukuvusa izihlahla ezimbi. Izibonelo: 2,4-D amine 6-8 amahora; 2,4-D ester 1-2 amahora; Atrazine 4 amahora; Basagran 8 amahora. Isikhathi esibalulekile sokulawula izihlahla ezimbi siyisici esibalulekile se-Integrated Weed Management (IWM). Lesi sikhathi sikhombisa lapho isivuno sokudla sisesimweni lapho singafanele sithinteke ezihlahleni ezimbi ngoba kungaholela ekunciphiseni kokukhiqiza. Le mbono isiza ukukhomba isikhathi esifanele sokufaka izibulala-zinambuzane ngemuva kokukhula okungahlali emhlabathini isikhathi eside, ivimbele futhi isebenzise izibulala-zinambuzane ezihlala isikhathi sonke sokukhula kwesitshalo futhi ifake kabusha izibulala-zinambuzane ngemuva kwesikhathi. Isikhathi esibalulekile sihambisana nosayizi besitshalo, isimo somhlabathi, isimo sezulu, kanye nesikhathi sokukhula esingase sahluke ezindaweni ezithile. Lesi sikhathi esibalulekile sihlose ukufinyelela ingozi yezihlahla ezimbi engaphansi kuka-5%. Isivuno akufanele sithinteke ezihlahleni ezimbi ngesikhathi lesi ukuze kuvinjelwe ingozi engaphezu kuka-5%. Uma izihlahla ezimbi zilawulwa kahle phakathi kwalesi sikhathi esibalulekile, izihlahla ezimbi ezivela ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi azizukulimaza isivuno. Isikhathi esibalulekile singahluka ngokuya ngezimo zezulu kanye nendawo lapho isivuno sikhula khona. Ukuhlola lokhu emasimeni nase-soybeans kukhombisa ukuthi isikhathi singahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lomhlabathi kanye nezindlela zokulima, isikhathi sikhula futhi uma kutshalwa emasimeni futhi uma kungenalutho okutholakalayo. Isikhathi esibalulekile sihamba phakathi kwezinyanga ezi-3 kuya kwezi-8 (nxa izinyanga ezingu-4-10 noma izigaba ze-V2-V6 zikhula). Izihlahla ezimbi kufanele zilawulwe kahle phakathi kwalesi sikhathi. Ummbila ongekho ngaphansi kwengcindezi yezihlahla ezimbi ezinsukwini ezi-34 ngemuva kokutshala noma lapho kunezinyanga ezi-6-8 (nxa izinyanga ezi-8-10 zibonakala) ukhombisa ingozi yokukhiqiza engama-0-5% futhi kukhona izihlahla ezimbi ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi. Izithiyo zezezimali zisiza ekukhombiseni ukuthi inani lezihlahla ezimbi likhombisa ingozi ethile futhi ukubona uma kuzosisiza ukubulala izihlahla ezimbi - lokhu kusho ukuthi kukhombisa ukuthi ingozi yezihlahla ezimbi izoba phezulu kunezindleko zokufaka izibulala-zinambuzane. Isikhathi lapho izihlahla ezimbi ziqala ukuvela sikhombisa kakhulu izinga lengozi. Izihlahla ezimbi ezivela ngokushesha eduze kwezivuno zenza ingozi enkulu kune-ingozi eyenzeka uma izihlahla ezimbi ziqala ukuvela kamuva uma isivuno sesiqinile. Ngokwesibonelo, ukuhlola izithiyo zezezimali uma 'pigweed', 'ragweed', kanye 'barnyard-grass' ziqala ukuvela kukhombisa ukuthi isikhathi sokuvuleka kwezihlahla ezimbi sibalulekile kakhulu sithola inani lezihlahla ezimbi ezivela kamuva uma kuqhathaniswa nezingozi. Ingozi nokulahleka kokukhiqiza kuhlobene nesikhathi lapho izihlahla ezimbi ziqala ukuvela. Ithebula 1 izama ukukhombisa izinga lengozi elingavela uma izihlahla ezimbi ezahlukene ziqala ukuvela emasimeni nase-soybeans. Iphesenti lokulahleka kokukhiqiza ngenxa yezihlahla ezimbi ezivela ngesikhathi esifanayo nezivuno zokudla lapho zingakaze zil
Kubhalwe njalo kubalulekile ukuhlola kahle ukuthi ingabe kukhona inkinga ethile yokukhula kwezihlahla emapulazini akho. Izindlela zokulima, izindlela zokulawula izihlahla ngezikhemikhali, kanye nokuphindaphinda izitshalo kuyahluka ezindaweni ezithile nasemapulazini athile. Kungenzeka ukuthi inkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla epulazini lakho ihluke ngokuphelele kunenkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla emapulazini asendaweni. Hlola njalo ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhona epulazini lakho bese uhlanganisa izikhemikhali ezifanele zokusebenzisa. Sicela ubheke ithebula elingezansi ukuze ubone ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ze-herbicides ezitholakalayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika ezilawula izihlahla emakhanda. Izikhemikhali ezitholakalayo kanye nohlu lwezikhemikhali zinezingxenye ezisebenzayo ezibulala izihlahla ezifana nezitshalo zonyaka noma izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. Ingxenye esebenzayo iyisikhemikhali esilawula izihlahla ngokuvimba ukufinyelela kwazo elangeni, okwenza izihlahla zingakwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhula. Lezi zikhemikhali zihlanganiswa lapho izinkambu zomkhiqizi zinezingqinamba ngezihlahla nezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi. Ezinye izindawo, ungaba nenhlanhla ngoba usebenzise uhlelo oluhle lokuphindaphinda izitshalo noma ulawule izihlahla kahle, futhi kuzoba nenkinga kuphela ngezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi emakhanda. Kulokhu, uzophosa imali uma uphonsa izitshalo. Ukuhlola ngqo inkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla kuzokusiza ngezindleko zakho uma ulawula izihlahla. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi i-pH yomhlabathi ikuphi kuyo yonke imikhakha epulazini lakho. Izinga lokusebenzisa izikhemikhali lihambisana ne-pH yomhlabathi - lapho i-pH ikhula, inani lezikhemikhali lenyuka. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba i-pH ithola ingxenye ye-ingxenye esebenzayo, futhi isitshalo sezihlahla asitholi i-herbicide eyanele yokubulala. Kuyiphutha ukufaka inani elinganele le-herbicide ngehektare ngoba ufuna ukunciphisa izindleko zamanje ngehektare. I-herbicide engasebenzi kahle izoholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu kokukhiqiza kulo nyaka. Uma i-herbicide enganele ifakwa, ezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla zingaphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zihlahlana zizodinga i-herbicide/ingxenye esebenzayo ezobe x 100 ukuze zibulale. Ngakho-ke, zonke izindlu zokulima (zonke izifunda) zizothola inzuzo uma umyalezo wokufaka i-herbicides ngendlela efanele ulandelwa. Kubiza imali eningi (nangesikhathi) ukuthola ama-herbicides amasha nezikhemikhali uma i-herbicide ethile ingasebenzi kahle. Isibonelo esilandelayo sikhombisa ukuthi inani le-herbicide lishintsha kanjani uma i-pH yomhlabathi ishintsha. Lapha sikhuluma nge-'acetochlor', i-herbicide elawula izitshalo ezifana nezitshalo. 'Acetochlor' ivamise ukusetshenziswa lapho ihlanganiswa ne-'safener'. Uma le nhlanganisela ne-'acetochlor' ifakwa, 'acetochlor' ingase ingabulali izitshalo zomkhiwane - khumbula: umkhiwane uyisitshalo esifana nezitshalo. Ukuze uqale, kusho ukufaka izikhemikhali emhlabathini noma lapho ungekhulumi kakhulu ngemuva kokutshala kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele emhlabathini. Uma kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhula minyaka yonke emikhakheni ethile, izikhemikhali eziningi zizofakwa. Izindleko zezikhemikhali ngehektare zingaqala ku-R97.50 emhlabathini (lapho i-pH ingu-0% - 10%) kuya ku-R150 emhlabathini one-pH ephezulu (41% - 55%). Umkhiqizo womkhiwane ongu-4.5 tons ngehektare ungakha ingcebo engafika ku-R7,200 ngehektare. Ngakho-ke, kungaba yiphutha ukufuna ukusindisa u-R60 ngehektare uma ucabangela ezinye izinkinga nezingozi ezingase zivele. Siphinda sithi: hlola kahle inkinga nawe nomphathi wezikhali ukuze uphathe konke kahle. Kubalulekile futhi ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ze-herbicides ozosebenzisa ukuze ukwazi ukuhlela umshini wokuphonsa kusenesikhathi kulonyaka. Ama-herbicides angafakwa ngemuva kokutshala kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele, futhi ungafaka ama-herbicides ngemuva kokuthi izitshalo zivele emhlabathini noma ngemuva kokutshala uma umhlabathi ulungiswe kahle. Umhlabathi olungisiwe kahle ubonisa umhlabathi omuhle onokwakhiwa okungathathi izikhemikhali. Uma ama-herbicides ephonswa ngesikhathi sokutshala noma ngokushesha ngemuva kokutshala, umkhiqizi angakhetha ukufaka i-herbicide kabanzi kuyo yonke imikhakha lapho zikhona noma endaweni encane ngaphezulu komugqa owodwa. Enye indlela yile: umshini ophonsa ungafakwa emkhakheni ngokushesha ngemuva kokutshala. Ngale ndlela, kuzoba nesikhathi esanele sokwenza umsebenzi wokuphonsa ngemuva kokuthi izihlahla zivele. Indlela yokusebenza izoncika kakhulu kumatshina kanye nezinye izinto umkhiqizi anazo noma azithengile. Uma uthuthukisa izinqubo zomsebenzi, kufanele kubhekwe izinto eziningi, njengokuthi kube nesikhathi esifushane sokuphothula ukuphonsa ngoba imvula enzima ilindelwe. Izibonelo zezinhlanganisela zezikhemikhali ezitholakalayo emakethe zikhonjiswa ngezansi. Uma ungumkhiqizi noma umphathi wepulazi, thola ulwazi mayelana nezikhemikhali ezibalulekile. Emakethe, kukhona ama-herbicides ahlukahlukene anamagama amahle amaningi, kodwa wonke anohlu olufanayo lwezingxenye ezisebenzayo. Uma uqhathanisa amanani ezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-herbicides, cabangela futhi ukusebenza kahle kwalawa mahlanganisela bese uthola intengo emakethe ukuze uqhathanise nayo ingxenye esebenzayo ukuze unqume izindleko ngehektare. Ikakhulukazi ngezihlahla zonyaka. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke kanye nezinye izinhlobo ezifana nezitshalo. Acetochlor/atrazine terbuthylazine (nange noma ngaphandle 'kwesafener'). Kukhona izixazululo eziningi. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Awukwazi ukulinda ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili. Izinhlobo eziningi zezihlahla zikhula minyaka yonke. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Awukwazi ukufaka emhlabathini one-pH engaphansi kuka-16%. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngemuva kokuphuma. Kuphela eKwaZulu-Natal. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Faka ezihlahleni eziphelele. Ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. Ngaphambi kokuphuma noma ngokushesha ngemuva kokuphuma. Ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. Faka lapho izihlahla ziphelele. Ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. F
Imichiza izonakalisa umkhiqizo wakho uma ungayiphathi ngendlela efanele ngokwemiyalelo nasemazwini. Uma ulandela imiyalelo ngendlela efanele, ungumlimi ongavimbela ukulimala okungenzeka ezitshalweni zakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi umthengisi wemithi ethile ubhaliswe lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukuze athengise le mithi ethembekile yokubulala izihlahla eziphikisanayo noma isifo esithile. Ingabe intengo yemithi ihambisana namazwi noma cha? Ingabe isimo sezulu ngesikhathi sokufaka imithi nangemva kokufaka kuhambisana namazwi? Ingabe isikhathi sokufaka imithi sihambisana nosayizi wesitshalo ukuvimbela isifo? Ngemuva kwalokho - ingabe imithi izoba yingozi uma kushintshwa izinhlobo zezithombo - ngamagama alula, ingabe izonakalisa izitshalo ezizofakwa ngemuva noma cha? Ingabe imithi ethile ingahlanganiswa nezinye izinhlobo - ngokwesibonelo: ingabe ingahlanganiswa nezinye izihlahla zokubulala noma nezinye izihlahla zokubulala izinyoni? Imiyalelo kufanele ibhalwe phansi, futhi umthengisi kufanele ayisayine. Abalimi kufanele baqaphele kakhulu ukuthi imithi iphephile ngesikhathi sokuphonsa, futhi kufanele bazame ukuvimbela lokhu. Ingcuphe enkulu ingavela uma imithi ingena kwamanye amapulazi lapho kukhona izitshalo ezingakwazi ukulimala kule mithi ethile. Ukuphepha kokudla kubaluleke kakhulu. Uma abalimi befaka imithi ngendlela efanele futhi begcina amarekhodi, bahlangabezana nezidingo zokuphathwa kokuphepha kokudla.

Ngomhla kaSepthemba 25, 2008, uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa KweFarmers lwe-Grain SA luzokhunjulwa njengoba bekungusuku olukhethekile, usuku lokukhumbula. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwefarmers luhlose ukusiza abalimi abamnyama. Iphathi eyayenzeka eNAMPO ngomhla kaSepthemba 25, 2008, yayihloselwe ukubonga labo abalimi abazokwazi ukufaka esikhundleni sabalimi bezomnotho ekulimaleni okujwayelekile. Indlela yokufaka esikhundleni sabalimi bezomnotho iyinselele; izinto azihambi kalula. Ukulima kuyinselele; kufana 'nokufaka umkhonto phansi,' futhi inzuzo ivame ukuba phansi. Laba balimi basizwe ngabasebenzi bohlelo lwe-GSA Farmer Development Programme kanye nabanye abaningi emkhakheni wezolimo - amabhange, amabhizinisi ezolimo, izinkampani ezithengisa izinto zokutshala, nabanye abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi sokweseka abalimi ngezigaba zokufunda, ngezinhlolovo ezinemfundiso, ezinsukwini zabalimi, ngeqhaza lempumelelo yabalimi yonyaka, ngezikole zokuqeqesha, ngokukhuluma nani emsakazweni, ngokushicilela i-"Pula/Imvula" isikhumbuzo njalo ngenyanga, sicabanga ukuqala okuthile okubizwa ngokuthi "Uhlelo Lwabalimi Abathuthukile" ukuze sinikeze isisekelo esikhethekile sabalimi abanobuchwepheshe abathanda ukulima futhi baveze ukuthi bafuna ukuthuthuka. Iningi labalimi abaqashelwe kule phathi bangamalungu e-"Advanced Farmer Programme." Nokho, kukhona abanye abake basebenza nathi kulolu hlelo isikhathi eside; asikwazi ukubasiza ngentuthuko eyengeziwe ngoba sebesefikile kulolo phuzu: bangabakhiqizi bezomnotho. Sicabanga ukuthi kungaba kuhle ukuvuselela okuthile okubizwa nge-250 Ton Club ukuze sikhumbuze labo abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-250 tons wezinkwa ngonyaka, futhi babizwa ngokuthi "abalimi bezomnotho." Iningi labalimi abanjalo lizoba amalungu ohlelweni lwethu unyaka owodwa kuphela, kodwa sifuna ukuqaphela intuthuko yabo. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwefarmers lusebenze eminyakeni eminingi, futhi amaGrain Trusts, ikakhulukazi iMaize Trust, afake imali eningi ukuze asize ukuthuthukiswa kwalaba balimi. Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi manje sekukhona abalimi abangu-8 abaphumelele ekubeni abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, bekukhona abanye abalimi abangu-28 abaveze ukuthi bahlose ukufinyelela kulolo phuzu. Sibabize ukuba babe amalungu e-250 Ton Club. Kukhona izigaba ezihlukene kwi-250 Ton Club, kodwa manje sekukhona abalimi abane abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-1,000 tons, abane abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-500 tons, nabanye abangu-21 abakhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-250 tons. Sihlela ukugcina le phathi njalo ngonyaka futhi silindele ukusho 'Hooray!' kwabanye abalimi ngonyaka ka-2009.

Isisho esiphawulekayo: "Akekho owazi ukuthi yini ezosihlanganisa kusasa. Okubalulekile ukuwusebenzisa kahle namuhla, nokubhekana nosuku lwesikhathi esizayo ngenhloso nokuqhakambisa, sazi ukuthi sizokwazi ukwamukela lokho usuku luzosilethela." Ngomhla zinguSepthemba 25, 2008, kwaba nomcimbi omkhulu eNAMPO Park eduze kweBothaville. Iphrogramu yethu yokuthuthukiswa kwezolimo ibhiyozela impumelelo emangalisayo - abalimi abangu-9 (abakhiqizi) baphumelele ekuthuthukiseni iphrogramu yethu. Ngokuvamile, lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kwakukhona abakhiqizi abamhlophe (bamaNgisi) kuphela emnothweni. Abalimi abamnyama babaziwa ngokuthi "basakhula," "basakhathazeka," "balima ngesikali esincane," "basathuthuka." Sacabanga ukuthi sekuyisikhathi sokuthi sithi, "Hooray!" kulabo balimi (abakhiqizi) abafike kulolo suku, singabathiya: abalimi bezomnotho abaqinile abahlangabezana nezinselele eziningi lapha eNingizimu Afrika ekukhuleni kwabo. Kuthiwa, 'Izinselele yizinto ezikhombisa ukuthi abantu bangobani.' Labo abaveze ukuthi bangamadoda aqinile sababonga ngomhla zinguSepthemba 25, 2008. Inzuzo encane etholakalayo ekukhiqizeni ukudla okwenziwe ngembewu. Izinkinga ezihlobene nokuthola umhlaba wokulima. Izinhlaka ezahlukene zokuba nefa ngaphandle kokubambisana. Ukuhlelwa kabusha komhlaba nokufaka izicelo zalowo mhlaba. Iphrogramu ezihlobene nomhlaba osebenziswayo umphakathi wonke kanye nezinkinga eziphathelene nalapho ummeli efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla ngokomnotho kulawo masimu. Izimo zomhlabathi eziphansi mayelana nesidingo sokufaka izithako nezinsiza. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko ezihlobene nemishini nokunakekelwa kwayo nokuphathwa kahle. Iphrogramu yokumaketha evulekile enezinselele eziningi. Ukuntuleka kokufinyelela ezikweletini nasekutholeni izimali zokukhiqiza. Ukubika okunganele, ulwazi, nokwesekwa okwanele. Labo abakhiqizi (abalimi) bazokutshela ukuthi abahambanga le ndlela yokuphumelela bodwa - banesekelo elivela kwabanye abaningi abasebenza emkhakheni wezolimo. Ibhizinisi lezolimo - ikakhulukazi iMGK, iNWK, iVKB, neOVK. Lapho sithi laba balimi sebefike endimeni ebizwa ngokuthi "Umkhiqizi Wezimali," bathole ini? Isikhathi esihle sokuthola umhlaba wokulima. Isikhathi esihle sokusebenzisa umhlaba. Ukufinyelela ezimali nakwezinye izinsiza zezimali. Ukuphatha ifamu nebhizinisi njalo. UKarabo Peele, uThando Lolwane, uPaul Morule, uJob Metswamere, uLabious Manoto, uBoy Mokoena, uLepati Macaphasa, uBasie Ntsimane, noMoss Malo. Baphumelele ngoba banamakhono, basebenze kanzima ngenhloso, bafune ulwazi njalo, futhi bazinikele empumelelweni - akekho indlela elula uma ufuna ukuphumelela njengabo, ungawuyeki noma uvimbe umkhawulo!
Uhlelo lweGrain SA Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhlala luzama ukuhlinzeka ngoxhumano nawe - umkhiqizi wezithako zokudla. Izindlela ezahlukene zisetshenziswa ukufinyelela kubakhiqizi, njengephephabhuku lePula Imvula, imisakazo ye-radio, ama-DVD, amabhroshya, amaposta, kanye namaphampu wolwazi. Sihlanganisa, sithumele amakhophi, futhi sabelane ngalesi sithangami kubalimi njalo ngenyanga (sinamakhasi angu-8 futhi siqukethe izithombe ezinemibala) ngalezi zilimi: isiNgisi, isiBhunu, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiNorther Sotho, isiXhosa, nesiZulu. Ukushicilelwa kwePula Imvula kwenzeka njalo ngenyanga - okuqukethwe okubhalwe phansi kulungiswa ngesiNgisi, bese kuthunyelwa ku-Infoworks lapho kulungiswa khona isampula yalokho ozokubona nokufunda ngesiNgisi. Okuqukethwe okubhalwe phansi kulungiswa ngendlela efanele ukuze kuhlolwe kahle, bese kuthunyelwa kubahumushi abaninzi. Lokhu kubuyiselwa ku-Infoworks ukuze kufakwe imibhalo ehunyushiwe ezindaweni ezifanele. Uma kutholakala ukuvunywa kokuthi konke kulungile, kuthunyelwa ukuphrinta bese kuthunyelwa kuwe. Konke lokhu kungathatha cishe izinyanga ezimbili. Kule nyanga sikhulise iPula Imvula, futhi manje sekukhona nezinye izigaba esikhuluma ngazo - kukhona amakhasi amane ngaphezulu kokujwayelekile ngoDisemba, uMashi, uJuni, noSepthemba okukhuluma Ngokukhiqizwa Kwe-Maize eFree State Province. Ukuxhaswa kwezimali kwalezi zikhasi kusekelwa yiWinter Cereals Trust. Amakhasi amane engeziwe ahlanganiswe noJanuwari, u- April, uJulayi, no-October okukhuluma ngokukhiqizwa kweSoybeans, kusekelwa yi-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane kubo bonke abafuna ukuthola ulwazi ngama-programs nalabo abasebenza kuma-programs - kunabalimi abaningi nezikhulu ababelana ngemininingwane okufanele bathole ulwazi ngama-programs, izinhlobo zama-programs, nokuthi ubani okukhulumayo uma befuna ulwazi oluningi (lamaphampu kufanele atholakale kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11). Lamaphampu wezaziso alungiswa futhi amakhophi enziwa ngolimi lwezingu-7 (isiNgisi, isiBhunu, isiXhosa, isiZulu, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, nesiNorther Sotho). Lamaphampu ayatholakala eNAMPO futhi azosetshenziswa njalo ngoJanuwari. I-DVD yemizuzu engu-8 ehlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nohlelo isetshenziswe kahle kule nyanga. Phakathi kweNAMPO, samema "abangane bohlelo" ukuze sibonise i-DVD, futhi bayithokozile. Sathumela amakhophi e-DVD kubaphathi bohlelo bezifunda kanye nabafundisi, abawasebenzisa njalo. Eqenjini lokufunda eFree State, uJohan Kriel wakhombisa i-DVD, futhi abalimi bacela ukuyibona kathathu - bajabule ukubona ukuthi uhlelo luhamba kanjani. Amabhroshya avulekile ayathuthukiswa futhi azosetshenziswa ngabaphathi bezifunda emihlanganweni yeqembu lokufunda nasezinsukwini zabakhiqizi. Siphinde sithumele imisakazo njalo ngesonto eziteshini ezine ze-radio ukuze sithumele ulwazi lokukhiqiza kubabukeli abaningi.
