Kwakukhona abaphakanyisi abahlanu kulezi zindawo futhi bahlolwa ngaleyo viki ngenkathi omunye umncintiswano uhloleke. Sesivele sabona ukuthi kukhona abalimi abaningi abahlala ezindaweni ezincane abafanele ukunikwa ukwesekwa nokwaziswa. Ngale ndlela, sizama ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale ukuhweba ngezolimo ngokukhuthaza ezindaweni ezincane, bese bebona ukuthi umsebenzi wabo uzokhula.
U-Mnu. Jan Botha ovela e-Thaba'Patchoa uveze ukukhathazeka okuningi mayelana nabalimi abasafufusa emhlanganweni waminyaka yonke we-Grain SA ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa, 2011. Ukhulume kakhulu ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye nokwehluleka kuk government ukubasiza. Ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka ngezibonelo zezinkinga ezibhekene nabalimi kanye nokwehluleka kuk government ukusiza, u-Jan wathi, "Thina, njengabakhiqizi abamnyama abasafufusa, sibhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo nezabathengisi bezolimo, kodwa kaningi izinkinga zethu zinkulu ngoba asinalo usizo lwezimali olwenziwe." Uqale ngokukhuluma ngezinga lokuphila komhlabathi. Uveze ukuthi ngonyaka odlule i-DAFF yapromisa abakhiqizi ukuthi izohlinzeka ngofulawa. Ngonyaka odlule, amaplanethi akhiwe asetshenziswa i-GPS, izibonelo zomhlabathi zithathwe, umyalezo wakhishwa, futhi kwaboniswa ukuthi kudingeka malini ofulawa, futhi bekukhona imali etholakalayo ebhajethi. Konke lokhu kwenzeka ngoMeyi 2010, kodwa okwamanje, ofulawa awakaze asetshenziswe emapulazini. U-Jan wathi, "Lokhu kuholele ekutheni umkhiqizo wesizini yelanga yonyaka odlule ube phansi, futhi kuzophinde kusho ukuthi kuzoba nomkhiqizo omncane kulonyaka." Isimo esibi semishini kanye nezithuthuthu kuyinkinga enkulu enye ku-Jan. Uthe i-Grain SA ihlole kahle isimo semishini yabalimi abangu-42 e-Free State. I-Grain SA icele i-DAFF ukusiza labo balimi ngama-R2.5 million ukuze balungise le mishini. Konke lokhu kwenziwe yi-Grain SA kwakulungiselelwa ngoMashi 12, 2010, kodwa okwamanje, i-DAFF ayikwenzi lutho. Enye ukukhathazeka yizijeziso zabakhiqizi emapulazini nasemaphandleni lapho amanzi flow. Uthe, "I-DAFF inhlelo ezinhle ze-Land Care ezisebenza kahle, kodwa ibhajethi yabo incane kakhulu; umhlaba uyashabalala ngaphambi kokuba bakwazi ukuwuvikela." U-Jan uphinde wakhuluma ngesimo sezindlela endaweni yethu, okwenza kube nzima kubakhiqizi ukuhamba kahle nemikhiqizo yabo - izindlela zindala futhi zingozi ngoba zibhujiswa izithuthuthu. Wabe esedlulela kwenye inkinga, inkinga yokweqisa. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezimbili ezikhathazayo ku-Jan. Okokuqala, uthi izindawo zikhathazeka ekuphathweni komhlaba womphakathi kahle. Okwesibili, uthe ukhulume ngezinkinga zabakhiqizi zokufinyelela imali yokuqala yokukhiqiza. U-Jan uchaze ukuthi ngonyaka odlule, abakhiqizi abamnyama bahlakulele kuphela u-25% wezindawo ngoba bahluleka ukuthola uxhaso lokuqala lokukhiqiza. Inzuzo incane kakhulu ukuze kutholakale uxhaso. I-Grain SA ithuthukise izinhlelo zebhizinisi zabakhiqizi abangu-152 kuleli hlelo ezizosiza abakhiqizi abafuna ukuhlinzeka ngemifino yesizini yelanga. Abakhiqizi badinga izibonelelo zesikhashana, kodwa uhulumeni akakaze athathe isinyathelo kulolu daba. "Izinkulungwane ezingama-27,000 zendawo azikhulwanga kulonyaka ngabakhiqizi abamnyama - izindawo ezinhle. Uhulumeni akakwenzi lutho ukusiza labo balimi, kodwa bahlale bephakamisa ukukhathazeka ngokuqhamuka kokuntuleka kokudla esikhathini esizayo." U-Jan uphinde wagcizelela ukuthi unenkinga ngokuthi iziphathimandla zabelana ngemininingwane ngoba zihluleka ukusiza abakhiqizi. "Bahluleka ulwazi nezakhono ngoba bangezange balime ngokwabo; abaningi abafinyeleli ngisho ezindaweni zokulima." Isibonelo sokugcina sokwehluleka kukahulumeni ukusiza abalimi abasafufusa yile: I-Department of Land Affairs inikeza umhlaba kubantu abangabalimi. "Abalimi abanolwazi baqhubeka nokuhlupheka ngoba bengenalo umhlaba wabo wokulima, kodwa abantu abangakwazi ukulima manje banikezwa umhlaba ongasebenzi." U-Mnu. Jan Botha uphethe ngokucela uMongameli weKomidi lePhothifoliyo ukuthi athumele le mibiko kuhulumeni. "Bahluleka ukusiza abalimi abamnyama futhi ngeke bakwazi ukushintsha le nkathi yokuphila uma bengahlinzeki abantu ngalokho okudingekayo."
Ukugcina umhlabathi wethu - singakwenza kanjani? Singasho ukuthi ukungabi nolwazi kuholele ekwehlisweni komhlaba onenani elikhulu ngokusetshenziswa okungafanele. Kubalulekile ukuthi abalimi baphathe umthwalo wabo emapulazini ukuze bafunde ukuthi ukwehla komhlabathi kwenzeka kanjani nokwamukela izindlela zokugcina umhlabathi ezizogcina umhlaba wonke. UProfesa N.S. Shaler waseHarvard University, ngo-1896, wathi: "Uma abantu behluleka ukuthola izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba ngendlela efanele, ngezindlela ezigcina umthombo wokuphila, kufanele sibheke phambili esikhathini - kungathatha isikhathi eside, kodwa kubonakala kahle, lapho sizobe sithulile ifa elikhulu, futhi lizonyamalala ngoba sidale ingozi enkulu." Lezi zisho zabhalwa ngo-1896; okwamanje, asikwazi ukwenqaba ukuthi le nkinga isekhona. UDalai Lama ubone ukuthi kukhona ukwehla okukhulu komhlabathi, kodwa kuza kancane kancane, futhi asikuboni njalo. UDalai Lama uphinde wathi: "Ingozi yezikhali ze-nuklear kanye nekhono lomuntu lokubhidliza imvelo kuyakhathaza kakhulu. Nokho, kukhona nezinye izinguquko ezizwakala kancane. Ngicabanga ngokukhathala kwezinsiza zethu zemvelo ikakhulukazi ukuguguleka komhlabathi futhi lezi mhlawumbe zikhona ezingaphezulu kwezingozi, ngoba uma sesiqala ukuzizwa imiphumela yazo kuzobe sekuphume isikhathi." (Ikhasi 144 leNcwadi encane kaDalai Lama yeNhlalakahle: 2002, Element Books, London). Ukwehla komhlabathi kuyenzeka njalo emhlabeni, kodwa inkinga ivela lapho thina, njengabantu, sithinta lokhu kwenzeke ngokushesha, sisheshisa ukwehla kwemvelo okujwayelekile. Uma umhlabathi uguguleka emapulazini, izakhamzimba, ukudla kwezitshalo, izinto zokulawula izifo, kanye nalokho okusele ngemva kokuvuna kuyalahleka. Abalimi abakwazi ukuphatha izindleko nezinye izingozi emvelweni yemvelo uma umhlabathi washiywa. Ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi unyaka nonyaka lapha eNingizimu Afrika, ukulahleka komhlabathi kufinyelela ezigidini zama-ton - ama-300 kuya kwama-400 ezigidi zama-ton, okuhunyushwa kube mhlawumbe ama-ton amathathu ngehektare. Inani lomhlabathi elilahlekile emifuleni engena olwandle unyaka nonyaka lifinyelela ezigidini zama-ton. Uma umkhiqizo owodwa wekhono ofana nokhukhamba, ummbila, ummbila, kanye noshukela ukhiqizwa, iNingizimu Afrika ilahlekelwa ama-ton amashumi amabili omhlabathi minyaka yonke. "Inhlangano Yezokudla Nezolimo yase-United States of America" ibala ukuthi ukwehla komhlaba emhlabeni lapho kukhula khona izitshalo kufinyelela ezigidini eziyisixhenxe zama-ton unyaka nonyaka. (Iziqinisekiso ze-Enviro, iNyuvesi yaseWestern Cape). INingizimu Afrika iyindawo evame ukuhlupheka ukushoda kwemvula - kwezinye izindawo, imvula ayiqhubeki. Amanzi emvelo ayisithiyo esibalulekile ekulimaleni. Ukufinyelela emanzini ngokwethembeka ezimweni zamanje nezangaphambili kuncike emkhathini, ezindleleni zokusebenzisa amanzi akhona, nasekulawuleni la manzi ngendlela efanele uma usebenzisa umhlabathi. Njengoba amanzi engatholakali kalula, kubalulekile ukuthi abalimi basebenzise amanzi atholakalayo ngezindlela ezigcina amanzi emhlabeni wethu. Uma imvula iphezulu, idala ukuhamba (okuhambisa umhlabathi emapulazini) bese umhlabathi uguguleka njengoba amanzi ehamba ngokushesha. Ukulima kwe-contour kuvame ukusetshenziswa lapho amapulazi enza izigaba. Umfuyi wakhe udala imithombo emapulazini ukuze aguqule indlela amanzi ahamba ngayo, evimbela amanzi ukuthi ahambe ngqo phansi; le mithombo (ama-contours) iyasiza ukuvimbela lokhu. Ama-contours asiza ukuhamba kwamandla amanzi, avimbela ukulahleka okusheshayo futhi avumela umhlabathi ukuthi wamukele amanzi. Lokhu kukhuphula ukufakwa kwamanzi emhlabathini. Ezinye izindlela zokugcina zinezindleko, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izithelo zizokhuphuka, futhi ama-contours azosiza ukugcina umhlabathi ophakeme nokugcina amanzi. Ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi ama-contours angakhuphula izithelo ngo-5 - 10%. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindleko ze-diesel nemishini ziye zancipha. Ochwepheshe bethi ukulima ngokwakha ama-contours kuvimbela ukwehla komhlabathi. Inani lomhlabathi elilahlekile lihambisana nokuthi ulima kanjani. Ukulima okungaphakanyiswa kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokuvimbela ukulahleka komhlabathi nokugcina amanzi. Uma umhlabathi ungaphakanyiswa, uhlala ungathinteki, futhi izitshalo ezintsha zifakwe ezinsalweni ezishiywe ngonyaka odlule. Kumele sikhumbule ukuthi izindlela zokulima kufanele zihambisane nezimo zamapulazi nezidingo zomfuyi. Izindlela zokugcina ezifana nokwakha ama-contours zilawula amanzi ngokuphepha futhi zivimbela izingozi ezidalwa umoya. Nokho, isu lokugcina kufanele lihambisane nokusetshenziswa kwezitshalo ezifanele, ukuphathwa ngokucophelela kwezibulala-zinambuzane, nokuphathwa kahle kwemifula. Ukugcina kuzovikela umhlaba futhi kukhuphule amandla omhlaba ukukhiqiza ukudla. Kuzokwandisa nenani lomhlaba. Ubuchwepheshe nolwazi lobunjiniyela kudingeka ukuze kuqale ukwakha ama-contours. Yini ezokwakhiwa eduze kwama-contours, njengezintaba noma ukutshala utshani? Sidinga ukuxhumana nezinhlelo ezisekelayo ngaphakathi kukahulumeni, ezifana noMnyango Wezolimo kanye nezikhungo ezabelana ngolwazi ukusiza abalimi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane namakhono okuphatha umhlaba ngendlela efanele. Thina, njengabangabalimi, kufanele samukele indima yethu ekuphatheni umhlaba wethu nezinsiza zethu zendawo. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi sithola ini emhlabeni nasekuthinteni lokhu emvelweni yemvelo. Omunye wabaqhamukeli bethu abaphumelelayo abakhiqiza imifino endaweni yaseRustenburg, uKarabo Phele, uthola imifino ngaphandle kwezitshalo ngoba umhlabathi wakhe unomhlabathi ophilayo. Uphendule umbuzo mayelana nekhono lakhe lokuthola izithelo ezinhle ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izitshalo: "Uma uthatha izakhamzimba emhlabathini unyaka nonyaka kodwa ungabuyiseli lutho, uzothola ukuthi umhlabathi uyancipha, futhi wena nalabo abakulandela uzothola ukuthi umhlabathi awukwazi ukusiza izakhamzimba njengoba wayejwayele." Amapulazi anomhlabathi ophilayo alahlekelwa umhlabathi ophakeme futhi ikhono lokukhiqiza ukudla liyanqotshwa, futhi umfuyi akasatholi izithelo ezanele noma inzuzo. Ukwehla nokulahleka komhlabathi kanye nokuncipha komhlabathi kubangela umhlabathi ukuthi ufile! Akusiyo imvelo kodwa abantu abadala inkinga. Ukugcina umhlabathi wethu namanzi kubalulekile uma thina, njengabantu, sifuna ukuqhubeka siphila!
Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi - kwenzekani uma kuqhutshwa ukutshala? Izindawo ezisebenzisa amanzi kanye nenani lawo amanzi kunikezwa nguMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka. Izibalo ezivela ku-2000 zizolandela. Inani lamanzi likalwa ngama miliyoni emitha cube asetshenziswe ngonyaka. Ngokubheka lokhu, kuyacaca ukuthi ukutshala ezolimo kudla uhhafu wamanzi atholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, singasho ukuthi isibalo sabantu ezweni lethu sizokhula sibe ngaphezulu kwezigidi eziyi-47. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sikhungo sezolimo sizobanjwa ngengcindezi yokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuhambisana nemithetho, futhi ukukhiqiza ukudla kuphela. Ochwepheshe bathi ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi lapha eNingizimu Afrika sekuhamba phambili - uma kudingeka ukuthuthuka okwengeziwe ngale ndlela, kuzobiza imali eningi. Kungenzeka kube nezinkambu ezithile ezingu-1.3 miliona zamafamu anokutshala eNingizimu Afrika okwamanje, kodwa kungenzeka kube nezinkambu ezingu-233,600 ezisasele ezingasetshenziswa ngale ndlela. Bakholwa ukuthi izinkambu ezingu-178,000 zizokwazi ukusetshenziswa esikhathini esizayo ngenxa yenkinga yokuntula amanzi okuthembekile, angase angatholakali.
Umkhiqizi (umlimi) oqasha wena njengomqashi ufuna ukuqonda kahle ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa kanjani. Wena, njengomqashi, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokusebenza kulowo mlili ngendlela efanele ngoba uthola umsebenzi kuye. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi wonke umsebenzi wokulima uhlose ukuhlela izinkambu zokutshala izitshalo zokudla. Uma isimo somhlabathi siba nzima kakhulu, kungcono kumqashi ukuthi abike ummili ukuthi ukulima akukwazi ukwenziwa kahle - akufanele aqhubeke nomsebenzi aphelelwe umphumela omubi ngenkathi efuna ukuphila. Uma umhlabathi ungakulungelanga kahle, kuzoholela ezindlekweni kumlili ezizomenza angaphumeleli ekulimaleni ngonyaka ozayo. Lapho ummili engakwenzi kahle, umqashi naye ngeke abe nomsebenzi. Ukulima okubucayi kulandela ukuvuna kwezitshalo ezitshaliwe. Ezindaweni lapho kunenhlama ehlobo kodwa izitshalo zezimvula zenyanga (njenge canola) zizotshalwa, kungcono ukulima ngokushesha ngemva kokuvuna. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi inhlama yehlobo ingena emhlabathini ngokushesha. Ngemva kokuvuna izitshalo zehlobo (njenge ummbila), kufanele kulimwe ngaphambi kokufika kwemvula yephunga ukuze imvula ingene emhlabathini kahle. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezithombo ezindaweni ezahlukene zidinga izikhathi ezahlukene zokutshala ezinhle. Ukutshala ngesikhathi esifanele kubalulekile uma ufuna ukufinyelela umphumela omuhle. Ukulima nokulungiselela izinkambu kufanele kwenzeke ngaphambi kokufika kwesikhathi sokutshala esinqunyiwe. Umqashi omuhle uzokwazi ukuthi kusebenza kanjani endaweni ethile futhi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwazisa ummili uma ecabanga ukuthi isikhathi sesidlule kakhulu noma ukuthi izimo zemvula nomhlabathi zibi kakhulu ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi othile. Akunamsebenzi wokutshala uma isikhathi sesidlule ngoba kungase kube nezingozi eziningi (njengokushoda kwamanzi nokuphuma kwezitshalo ngesikhathi sokukhula) futhi ummili ngeke enze inzuzo. Uma umqashi eqhubeka nokutshala ngemva kwesikhathi, uzophula umsebenzi wakhe kanye nebhizinisi lommili. Kunzima ukusungula izidingo zomsebenzi wonke ezindaweni zonke. Kufanele kube nesivumelwano phakathi kommili nomqashi ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi othile. Isibonelo, uma ummili efuna izinkambu ezithile zibe zikhululekile ku-dephth ethile, bobabili kufanele baqonde kahle lokhu futhi kufanele kubhalwe phansi - isibonelo, kufanele kulimwe i-30ha ku-dephth ye-300 mm. Ukutshala okwenziwayo kunezinga elithile. Ummmili uzodinga inani elithile lezitshalo nge-hectare kanye nenani elithile le-fertilizer nge-hectare. Kubalulekile kakhulu kumqashi ukuthi aqinise ukuhlangabezana nalezo zinga - umphumela omuhle ulandela ukuthi kuzotshalwa kanjani futhi nini. Umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi unekhono lokwenza umsebenzi odingekayo kahle. Lapho kukhishwa amakhemikhali ngumqashi, kubalulekile futhi ukuthi zonke izinto ezihlobene zilinganiswe kahle - inani lamakhemikhali akhishwayo kanye nenani lamanzi afanele okuzosetshenziswa nge-hectare. Ngokuvamile, abaqashi bavame ukuthatha umsebenzi ongaphezu kwamandla abo okwenza lowo msebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele nangendlela efanele. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba umqashi ufuna ukulima izinkambu eziningi ukuze enze inzuzo eningi. Kukhona ingozi lapha ngoba uma ummili (umqashi) engathandi indlela umqashi asebenza ngayo, angase angamqashi futhi esikhathini esizayo. Kukhona izimo ezivamile ezamukelekayo ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi zingaki ama-hectares umshini othile ungawulima ngosuku olunye (Ithebula 1). Ukuhlela izindleko zalokhu kusebenza kungaba yinkinga ngoba kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezindleko okufanele zifakwe kulokhu kuhlola. Imishini kufanele ithengwe kuqala (izindleko zokusebenza) bese kukhona nezindleko zokuyisebenzisa nokuyigcina. Umshini othile nemishini ethile inempilo ethile yokusebenza uma isetshenziswa kahle futhi igcinwe kahle, futhi kungase kudingeke ukuthenga imishini emisha noma ukuyilungisa. Lapho sikhuluma ngalokhu, singathi ngokuvamile kukhona umhlahlandlela walomsebenzi okhombisa ukuthi impilo yokusebenza komshini ingaba yiminyaka eyi-12 (ama-1,000 amahora ngonyaka, okusho: ama-12,000 amahora = iminyaka eyi-12). Impilo yokusebenza kwaleyo mshini ibonwa lapho umshini wakhiwa, futhi ngenkathi umshini usebenza kahle. Lapho kuhlelwa izindleko zokuthenga nokusebenza kwemishini, izindleko kufanele zihlukaniswe ngo-12 - bese izindleko zonyaka zingatholakala ngokuhambisana neminyaka umshini ongawusebenza. Ngakho-ke, singathi imali esetshenziselwa ukuthenga umshini ibolekiwe, futhi inzalo (izindleko) zokusebenza kwemishini kufanele ifakwe ekuhleleni izindleko zokulima i-hectare eyodwa. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini okumele wenziwe ngenyanga ethile. Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi umsebenzi wezolimo uhambisana nezimo zezulu - kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imvula ingaba nomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini womqashi. Izinsuku eziningi zokusebenza zingalahleka uma kunemvula futhi umhlabathi ungena kakhulu ukuze usebenze. Xoxa nesiteshi sezulu sendawo yakho (i-ARC yeMhlabathi, Isimo Nezamanzi ePitoli (012) 310-2500 xoxa noDerick Vermaak). Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu uma ungene ebhizinisini lokuqasha. Khumbula ukuthi uma imishini ingasebenzi, ayisebenzi, akukho okuzophuka - izinto zizophuka uma imishini isebenza ngokuphelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukwenza umsebenzi wokugcinwa (insizakalo) ngenkathi umsebenzi uthule. Uma wena, njengomqashi, uhlela ama-hectares, kufanele uhlole ukuwulima ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokutshala, khumbula ukushiya isikhala kulolo suku lapho ungasebenzi ngoba imishini iphukile. Akuvamile ukuthi abantu basayine isivumelwano esibhaliwe ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezingashintsha kulomsebenzi - isibonelo: ukuphuka kwemishini, isimo sezulu, nezinye. Izimo zesivumelwano kufanele zibekwe ngendlela efanele ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezingahamba kahle - ngakho-ke, lezi zinkinga esivumelwaneni zingadala umqashi nommili bobabili baphumelele kulolo hlelo. Izivumelwano ezifana nalezi zingaba yizivumelwano zomlomo noma izinhlelo zokuthi kwenzeke okuthile. Bobabili bazovuma ukuthi umsebenzi othile uzokwenziwa ngenani elithile. Ingxenye yezinkinga ezingadala izinkinga phakathi kommili nomqashi ubukhulu bezinkambu. Ummmili uzozama ukwenza izinkambu zibe zincane, umqashi uzokhetha ukuthi ama-hectares azolima amaningi. Ubukhulu bezinkambu kufanele kuqinisekiswe kahle ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga kamuva. Ukusebenzisa i-GPS kwenze kube lula futhi kucace kahle ukuthola ubukhulu bezinkambu. Nokho, abaningi abantu abanayo le teknoloji. Kukhona nezinye izindlela ezilula zokuthola ubukhulu bezinkambu. U-Mnu. JP le Roux ophuma ePitoli uhlolisise kahle udaba lwezindleko zemishini futhi uqoqe umhlahlandlela ophathelene nazo zonke izici ezihlobene nemishini. Lo mhlahlandlela (umhlahlandlela) ungakusiza uma ucabanga ngezindleko zalo msebenzi. Ungaxhumana noMnu. Koos le Roux lapha: (012) 998-2803, noma 082 828 9531, noma uthumele i-imeyili koosleroux@absamail.co.za. Ikhomishini eyaziwa ngokuthi "Ikhomishini Yezilinganiso Zezivuno Zesizwe" (NCEC) ibikezela inani lezivuno ezizokwenzeka ngesikhathi esithile, ngamagama amanye, ibika abalimi ukuthi kuzoba nezivuno ezingakanani ezindaweni zokulima ngesikhathi esithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba lezi zilinganiso zixhumene kakhulu nenani lemali abalimi abazolithola uma bethengisa isivuno esithile ngesikhathi esithile. Yini ukubikezela kwezivuno (ukulinganisa)? I-Grain SA iqonda ukuthi lokhu kuyindaba edidayo kakhulu. Kumele sithathe isikhathi sokucabangela kahle nangokucacile ngomsebenzi wale khomishini ngaphambi kokuphakamisa noma ukusikisela izinguquko ezingase zibeke abalimi engozini. Khumbula ukuthi i-NCEC ibikezela inani lezivuno zonke, hhayi kuphela lokho okuthengiswa emakethe yezezimali. Ngaphandle kwalokho, abakwazi ukusho ngokuqinisekile ukuthi zingaki izindawo ezilimiwe, futhi abakwazi ukusho ukuthi kuzoba yini izivuno - konke lokhu kuyisiphakamiso kuphela. Ikhwalithi yalolu hlobo lokulinganisa ingalinganiswa ngekhwalithi yalabo abahlinzeka ngemininingwane. Ekugcineni, inani elikhulu lemininingwane likhulu ezandleni zabakhiqizi. Ngubani amalungu ale khomishini ye-CEC? Kukhona cishe abakhiqizi abangu-3,000 abahlanganyela futhi bathumela imininingwane yabo kule khomishini njalo ngenyanga. Izinhlangano ezifana ne-Spatial Intel ne-Geoterra Image zikhomba izindawo lapho izivuno ezithile zikhuliswa khona zisebenzisa "ama-satellites". I-IARC plant institute kanye ne-Small Grains Institute zisebenza nabalimi ukuze zibale izibalo. Abamele uhulumeni abavela eMnyangweni Wezolimo ezindaweni ezithile banikeza imininingwane mayelana nezimo zokukhiqiza. I-Agri Businesses yenze izilinganiso zezivuno ezindaweni ezisebenza kuzo. Bahlinzeka ngale mininingwane ku-CEC, kodwa izilinganiso zabo zezindawo ezilimiwe azisetshenziswa yi-CEC ukuze kutholakale ukulinganisa kwayo. I-Directorate yeMnyangweni Wezolimo esebenza nezibalo ithatha yonke imininingwane futhi ihlanganise inani eliphelele bese ikhokha ukulinganisa ngokusekelwe kumandla endawo. Uma i-CEC ivimbela ukwenza ukulinganisa, ngeke kube khona ukulinganisa kwesizwe. Impendulo ithi: cha, ngoba kuzoba nezinye izinhlangano ezizokwenza izilinganiso zazo, futhi ngeke kube sobala ukuthi iyiphi isilinganiso esiqondile. Ingabe i-CEC iyazimela noma ikwiwo abanye kule mboni abacindezela ukuba yenze lokho abafuna? Asikwazi ukusho ukuthi kungaba nomuntu oyedwa ozokwenza noma yini afuna noma aguqule indlela i-CEC esebenza ngayo; kuzoba nzima kakhulu ngoba kukhona abanye abahlola njalo ukuthi imininingwane ephumayo iyinqaba. Yini i-Grain SA ithi? Kumele kube nokulinganisa kwezindawo ezilimiwe kanye nezivuno ezikhululiwe ngokusekelwe kumandla endaweni, okunembile, futhi ngesikhathi ukuze imakethe yokudla ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Abakhiqizi, i-CEC, nabanye kule mboni kumele bahlanganyele ukuze bakwazi lokhu. Amalungu e-Grain SA nabo bonke abakhiqizi nabanye abakule msebenzi kumele bacindezelwe ukuba bahlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile njalo manje nangesikhathi esizayo.
Kuthiwa umhlaba wethu lapha eNingizimu Afrika ungama-90% umhlaba omile noma ubhekene nezinsuku zokoma. Ukulima kwenziwa ngaphandle - ukukhiqizwa kokudla kuthinteka yizimo zezulu: imvula, ukukhanya kwelanga, umkhovu, izilokazane, ukoma, nemoya onamandla - kodwa ezindaweni ezithile, kungaba ngcono ngoba abalimisi abathile bangakwazi ukujova (ukuphonsa) izitshalo zabo. Kubalulekile kumlimi ukuthi acabangele izimo zezulu nezinye izinto ezingase zibe yingozi uma efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ukulima kuyibhizinisi, futhi ibhizinisi lingaphila kuphela isikhathi eside uma lenza inzuzo njalo ngonyaka. Nokho, akusiyo impumelelo ukuthi kuzokwenziwa inzuzo, ngakho zonke izingozi ezingaba khona kufanele zicatshangelwe uma efuna ukufaka imali ebhizinisini lokulima. Ukungalingani okungafani kokukwazi komlimi ukukhiqiza ngezinsiza abanazo (izinkambu, imali, umsebenzi, imishini) kwehlisa ithuba lokuba nezingcuphe. Lokhu kunciphisa kungafezwa ngokukhetha izitshalo ezihlukene, kungalimi konke ngesikhathi esisodwa endaweni eyodwa, futhi kungabheki kakhulu inani lemali yokuvuna ngasikhathi sinye. Zama ukudlulisa izingozi ngokuthola umshwalense nokuvikela izinkontileka kusenesikhathi. Zama ukunciphisa ithuba lokuba nezingcuphe ngokuzilungiselela uma ingozi ivela - faka ezinye zezinto zakho ezinamandla ukuze ukwazi ukuphatha izingozi ezintsha. Isimo sokwabelana ngengozi yomshwalense sithi: wamukela izinkokhelo ezivela kubalimisi abaningi ukuze inkampani yomshwalense ikwazi ukuhlanganisa imali engenayo ukuvikela ezingozeni ezingaba khona. Inkampani yomshwalense izosebenzisa ulwazi oluhambisana nenani lezindawo zokulima lapho ibeka khona inani lempahla ukuze ikwazi ukukhokhela izicelo futhi iqhubeke nemisebenzi yayo ngenzuzo. Ngamafuphi, inkampani yomshwalense ithatha izinkokhelo kubo bonke abalimisi abavikelekile ukuze ikwazi ukukhokhela izicelo endaweni ethile. Nokho, umshwalense uthokozisa kakhulu lapho ukukhiqizwa kuvame ukubhekana nengcuphe futhi lapho ingozi iphezulu, khona-ke umkhiqizi uzocabangela ukuthi zingaki izinkokhelo nezicelo ezizoba khona uma kuqhathaniswa nengcuphe engaba khona. Izingcuphe ezincane ngokuvamile azidingi umshwalense, kodwa uma kukhona ingozi engase ibulale yonke imisebenzi yokulima, khona-ke umshwalense uyadingeka. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zomshwalense ezivikela ezingozeni zonke ezingase zivele emisebenzini yokulima. Ukulahlekelwa kokuvuna ngenxa yokulimala okubonakalayo kwezitshalo - ukulimala kwengxenye yendawo yokulima noma zonke izitshalo. Izinto ezivikelekile zingabandakanya: izithelo eziwile ezilimazekile, izindawo zokulima lapho sizama khona, amaqabunga alimazekile noma awile, izimpande eziphukile noma ezilimazekile. Umshwalense ubalulekile lapho ulima imbewu nezitshalo ekuqaleni kwesizini yokukhula. Ukulimala okunjalo okubangelwa umkhovu: imbewu elahlekile, amaqabunga aphukile, nezimpande eziphukile. Njengokulimala okubangelwa umkhovu, umshwalense uvikela ekulimazeni ingxenye yezinto zokulima noma zonke izitshalo. Ukulahlekelwa kokuvuna uma kuthuthwa ngemuva kokuvuna ezinkampini ezivikelekile. Lokhu kungabangelwa ubungozi bomlilo, ukuhlinzeka kwezimoto, nokuphahlazeka kwezimoto. Umshwalense uvikela lokhu kuphela ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwama-100 km ukusuka epulazini. Izingxenye zezinto zokulima zingavikelwa: imbewu nezitshalo lapho kukhona ukulimala okubangelwa imvula eningi ngesikhathi ukudla kuqhakaza. Ukulimala kwezingxenye zezinto zokulima okubangelwa umlilo kungavikelwa. Umuntu othola umshwalense womlilo kufanele alandele imihlahlandlela ejwayelekile yelizwe mayelana nokwakha izikhala zomlilo (ukuvikela umlilo) ngaphambi kokuthola lo mshwalense. Ukulimala okuvikelekile kwenzeka uma amaqabunga, izimpande, nezinye zifa ngenxa yomkhovu. Ukulahlekelwa kokuvuna kuhlolwa ngalokhu kulimala okubonakalayo kwezitshalo. Ukulimala okungabonakali, njengokukhula okuphazamisekile ngenxa yokubanda, akuvikelwa. Kukhona izingxenye zezinto ezingabonakali, ezingakwazi ukuhlolelwa kahle, ezingavikelwa ngalo mshwalense. Lokhu kungaba ukoma okukhulu (ngaphandle kwezinkambu ezijovayo), ubungozi obukhulu bezilokazane, umkhovu, umoya, njll. Ngakho-ke, umkhiqizi uvikelwe ezimfanelweni zemvelo ezingaphathwa abantu. Ngaphi engingathola usizo? Amabhange amaningi nezinkampani zokulima zingabamele abathengisa umshwalense wezitshalo. QINISEKISA UKUTHI UFUNDA NGOKUCOPHELELAYO OKUTHI KUBHALWE NGEMISHAYO EMINCANE KULO MSHWALENSE BEFORE SIGNING - AWUFUNI UKUVUKA UTHOLE IZIPHUMO ZOKUMANGAZA NGEMVA KWESIKHATHI.
Umbhalo: Kubhalwe ngumkhiqizi ophumile emsebenzini. Ngesikhathi salo nyaka, imvula ihluka phakathi kuka-600 no-2,000 mm ezindaweni lapho kukhuliswe khona uhlobo lwezithombo, kanti kwezinye izindawo kube khona u-50 mm kuya ku-75 mm ngosuku. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umhlabathi uthole amanzi futhi ube nzima futhi ugcwele amanzi. Okwesibili okwenzeka lokhu: ukujula kwemishini yokuvuna, ama-traktor, nokuhamba kwezinsimbi ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nezinqola ezithutha uhlobo lwezithombo ngesikhathi sokuvuna kuzokwenza umhlabathi ube nzima kunezinye izinyanga lapho kunganeni kakhulu imvula. Izinkomo ezibekwe ezindaweni zokukhulisa uhlobo lwezithombo ukuze zidle izinsalela zempande nazo zizokwenze umhlabathi ube nzima uma kukhona amanzi amaningi. Uma kukhona amanzi amaningi ezindaweni, ungazama ukuhlinzeka ngaphambi kokutshala noma ngesikhathi sokutshala, mhlawumbe lokhu kungakusiza ukuthi utshale ngesikhathi esifanele. Kulonyaka bekubanda kakhulu ebusika futhi kwezinye izindawo kube nemvula, ngakho umhlabathi awukwazi ukuwomisa kahle. Kungasiza ukuhlola isimo sephansi lomhlabathi uma ufuna ukutshala uhlobo lwezithombo, bese ungasebenzisa umshini wokuhlinzeka ukuze uthole izindawo ezinzima ngaphansi komhlabathi ophakeme. Lo msebenzi uzosiza futhi ukuvuselela umhlabathi (lokhu kubalulekile). 'Amabhaktheriya' nom 'microbes' aphila kuphela ephepheni eliphezulu lomhlabathi, efika phezulu kuka-150 mm - 180 mm. Igama elithi 'aerobic' lisho ukuthi kukhona umoya ne-oyili, i-nitrogen, nomoya ongu 'carbon dioxide' uma umhlabathi uhlinzekwa. Inqubo yokuhlinzeka ibalulekile ngoba isiza amabhaktheriya ukuba aphule izinsalela zezitshalo zonyaka odlule ngaphambi kokutshala izitshalo ezintsha. Umsebenzi wamabhaktheriya uzokwenziwa uma izinga lokushisa lomhlabathi liqala ukukhuphuka kusukela ekupheleni kuka-Agasti kuya kuSepthemba kuze kube u-Okthoba. Siphinda sithi kubalulekile ukuthi ukuhlinzeka kwenziwe ngokushesha ngemva kokuthi umhlabathi ugcwele amanzi. Uma ukuhlinzeka kwenziwa ngesikhathi esifanele, kuzokwandisa ubukhali bomhlabathi, ngeke kunciphe. Umkhiqizi kufanele aguqule imishini yabo ukuze bayise ngendlela ezokhipha imiphumela emihle. Ukuphathwa nokulungiswa (mhlawumbe nokushintsha) kwezinsiza ezingakaze zenziwe kufanele kuqedwe ekuqaleni kuka-Okthoba.
Lapha e-Afrika, ukuqhubeka komsebenzi ophathelene ne-bio-fuel emhlabeni jikelele kusinikeza amathuba amahle okwandisa imizamo yethu yokuthuthukisa izimo zezezimali ezweni lethu. Esikhathini esizayo, labo abasebenza kulesi sikhala bazokwazi ukuhlangabezana nalezi zikhala zomsebenzi futhi bathole amandla okuphakamisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu ezikhathini ezizayo. Uma amazwe asempumalanga emhlabeni elungiselela ukusebenzisa ama-bio-fuels, kufanele abheke ukuthuthukisa lo msebenzi ezwenikazi eliseningizimu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubonakala ukuthi isidingo sembewu yokudla kanye nalabo abanamafutha sizokwandisa kabili eminyakeni engama-20 - 30 ezayo. Ngenxa yesidingo sokukhiqiza ukudla kwabantu kanye nezinsiza zokuhamba (ukudla), i-Yoruba kufanele ibheke izinsiza zemvelo ezitholakala emazweni aseningizimu kweSahara e-Afrika. Njengoba kunezinsiza zemvelo eziningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kungahlinzeka ngezindlela zokukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela eshibhile. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba kunezimo zezulu ezinhle kanye nezimo zomhlabathi ezindaweni ezifana ne-Angola, i-Mozambique, kanye ne-Zambia. Nokho, amazwe aseningizimu kweSahara kufanele ahloniphe izimiso zokuhweba okukhululekile uma efuna ukutshalwa kwezimali, ngokwesibonelo, ahloniphe amalungelo okuba nefa emhlabeni nasezimpahleni. Kumele sibe namandla okuthengisa izinsiza zethu ngenani eliphezulu emnothweni kazwelonke ukuze sikwazi ukusebenzisa umsebenzi wezomnotho ngendlela ephakeme. Ngale ndlela kuphela sizokwazi ukudala ukusebenza okudingekayo emnothweni wezindawo eziseningizimu kweSahara. I-South Africa ihola ezimweni zezimiso zokuhweba okukhululekile uma sibheka ezinye izindawo eziseningizimu kweSahara e-Afrika. I-South Africa iyadingeka ezindaweni eziseningizimu kweSahara e-Afrika ukuze ibonise umhlaba ukuthi singasekela ukugeleza kwezimali endaweni ephephile ezoletha ukukhula nokuthuthukiswa emnothweni. Uma i-South Africa ingakwazi ukubonisa amazwe asempumalanga ukuthi inekhono nezinsiza zokusebenzisa ingcebo kazwelonke ngendlela efanele, sizophumelela ukusiza ezinye izindawo eziseningizimu kweSahara ukuthola umnotho ozovela ekuthuthukiseni imisebenzi ephathelene ne-bio-fuel ngendlela enhle. Ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi ophathelene ne-bio-fuel emhlabeni jikelele kudala amathuba amahle okuthuthukisa umsebenzi wezomnotho. Abantu abafuna ukusebenza bangangena kulezi zikhala zomsebenzi futhi bakhuphule izinga labo lokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, bazokwazi ukuhweba ukuze bathole ukudla, bakhulise ukudla kwabo, futhi bathole inzuzo engathenga izinto ezinhle. Akufanele siphuthelwe leli thuba lokuthuthukiswa. I-South Africa inomthwalo wemfanelo wokusekela ukuthuthukiswa komnotho kwezinye izindawo lapha e-Afrika. Ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa komsebenzi we-bio-fuel lapha kuzosisiza ukukhiqiza ukudla okudingekayo. Abakhiqizi base-South Africa banolwazi nolwazi lokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi, kodwa akukho maphakathi lapho umkhiqizo ungathengiswa khona. Uma umsebenzi we-bio-fuel uqhubeka, imakethe enhle ingatholakala. Ngokufanayo, ulwazi oluningi luzokwakhiwa esingaludlulisela kwezinye izindawo e-Afrika. Izindleko zokwakha lo msebenzi emhlabeni jikelele ziyaqhubeka nokukhula, ngakho kufanele kwakhiwe izinsiza ezinhle ukuze kusekelwe ukuqhubeka kwalomsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umngcele udinga ukubheka ikusasa eliqhakazile ukuze uthole izikhuthazo ezifanele. Lokhu okukhuthazayo ukuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel e-USA kube inani elikhulu lokukhiqiza kanye nokushintshwa kwe-MTBE nge-bio-ethanol. Lokhu okukhuthazayo umsebenzi ophathelene ne-bio-fuel lapha e-South Africa ukuvumelanisa nokugcina izinsiza zemvelo noma ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwabantu basemaphandleni. Uma sibheka ukukhuphuka kwezintengo zokudla, sihlangana nesimo esishintshashintshayo emhlabeni jikelele, futhi lokhu akukhuphuki kakhulu emandleni ezimali. Lokhu kuyakhathaza ngoba sidinga imvume yoHulumeni ukuze siqhubeke phambili ngesikhathi esifanele ngokuvota nokunye. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi kuzokwenzekani ngoba abaholi abakhombisi kahle indlela yokuhamba phambili mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel e-Southern Sahara Africa. Kodwa kubalulekile ukucabangela lezi zinto ezingaba yingozi mayelana nekusasa elide - ingabe singacabanga kuphela ngezingozi ezingase zivele esikhathini esizayo esiseduze? I-Grain SA ibona ukuthuthukiswa kwe-bio-fuel njengethuba likahulumeni lokwakha umoya wokubambisana ekudonseni izimali ezweni, futhi kufanele bavunyelwe ukuba bashiye izimiso zokuhweba okukhululekile ukuze benze umsebenzi wabo ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nezinkinga ezifana nezitifiketi, imithetho, nezinye izithiyo ezivimbela izindlela zokusebenzisa umkhiqizo njengoba sifuna. Uma sibheka ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokutshala, siqaphela ukuthi ushukela akuwona kuphela umkhiqizo wokudla ongasebenzisa ukukhiqiza i-bio-fuel, futhi akufanele sizame ukuqhathanisa izimo zomhlabathi nezimo zezulu nezinye izindawo eziseningizimu. Kunezimakethe eziningi ze-bio-fuel eduze kwezindawo ezikhiqiza ummbila nezinsimbi ezweni lethu, nasezindaweni lapho kukhona ukudla njenge-barley, i-triticale, noma i-wheat ezingasekela ukuthuthukiswa kokukhiqiza i-bio-fuel. Ukuze sivalwe umgomo phakathi kokuhlinzekwa kokudla nokuthi yini ebiza kakhulu, kufanele sithole ukuqhubeka okuzoletha inzuzo enhle kubakhiqizi. Uma kuvunyelwe ukuba sithuthuke ngokukhululekile, sikholelwa ukuthi iminikelo ekukhiqizeni i-bio-fuel izovuselela ikhono lokukhulisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo. Lokhu kuzovimbela ukwehla kwenani lemikhiqizo yokudla kanye nezinsimbi zamafutha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzovuselela amathuba okuthuthukisa umsebenzi wezolimo ozosiza abantu bethu basemaphandleni. Umphakathi womhlaba kufanele ubone ukuthi i-South Africa ikwazi ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa kokukhiqiza i-bio-fuel e-Southern Sahara Africa. Lokhu akuzokweseka kuphela izimiso ze-ASGISA kodwa kuzosekela nezika-NEPAD ezizokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.
Umkhiqizi uhlanganyela njalo kodwa ngeke umbone esebenzisa umhlaba. Uhlola umhlaba ngaso sonke isikhathi kodwa akakaze abeke. Akafiki ekupheleni kwendawo lapho abeka khona zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo ezikwi ndawo zayo emasimini. Umkhiqizi uyazi kahle ukuthi kufanele enze ukuthini ngoba uNkulunkulu umenze wabona futhi waqonda. UMdali ungumfundisi omuhle onika umkhiqizi ukuhlakanipha. U-Isaya 28:23 - 29? Ukulima kwaba umsebenzi wokuqala emhlabeni futhi kwaba umyalezo ovela kuNkulunkulu. Kubalulekile empilweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi thina njengabakhiqizi sibheke emsebenzini wethu ngamehlo ahlukene futhi sibone ukuthi kubalulekile futhi kuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu. Akukwanele ukuthi siqonde nje ukuthi sidinga ukwenza inzuzo (imali) nokwandisa ukukhiqizwa; kungcono ukucabanga ngokukhiqiza izitshalo nokudla kwekhwalithi okuzohlinzeka abanye ukudla okuzondla imizimba yabo futhi kubasize baphile impilo enhle. Umkhiqizi ungena kanjani emnothweni wezwe? Banikeza kakhulu emnothweni wezwe nasebhajethi kazwelonke. Uma abakhiqizi behlangana, bahlinzeka ngemicimbi eminingi kwabantu abaningi ezweni elidinga izindawo zokusebenza ngoba kuneziningi abantu abangenamsebenzi. Abakhiqizi bakha ukudla kwekhwalithi okukhuthazayo futhi kusiza ukuqinisa ukudla kwezwe nakusasa. Ezindaweni eziningi zezwe, abakhiqizi banikeza emnothweni kulo lonke idolobha lapho behlala khona futhi badingeka ngempela empilweni yezezimali yamadolobha asondelene nabo nasemhlabeni jikelele. Abakhiqizi bangabavikeli bomhlaba wethu; bangabasebenzi abakhuthele kakhulu ukuvikela umhlaba, umoya, amanzi, nalapho lezi zinto zihlangana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bangakhiqiza ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. Umkhiqizi usebenza kanzima ukuze athole ukudla kwakhe, ukhiqiza ukudla kwabanye, usebenza yedwa ngaphandle kosizo kwabanye, usebenza ngokuzikhandla, usesimweni esiseduze nomhlaba lapho esebenza khona, futhi uhlale ethembekile. Umkhiqizi ukhula (wenza) ufulawa, amabele, noshukela esebenzisa kuphela ukukhanya kwelanga! Ngeshwa, abakhiqizi abaningi, njengamanye amabhizinisi, bazizwa bebuhlungu ngenxa yokwehla okukhulu kwemithombo yezezimali emhlabeni wethu nakwamanye amazwe. Uma sibona ukuthi okwamanje izindleko zokulima ziya zanda njalo futhi amanani okudla akhiqizwayo ekulimaleni ehla, siphinde sibone ukuthi abalimi abaningi bangase bangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhokha izikweletu zabo zokulima ngesikhathi. Ngakho-ke, okwamanje kuzoba nzima ukucela imali ukuze isetshenziswe isikhathi eside - lokhu kudala ezinye izinkinga lapho umkhiqizi ezama ukuqhubeka ngebhizinisi lakhe. Kuyiqiniso elidabukisayo, kodwa abakhiqizi bacindezelwa ukuba bacele imali ukuze baqhubeke - ukukhokhela imbewu, ukudla kwezilwane, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ukuze bangenise izitshalo emhlabeni ukuze zikhule. Ngenxa yokungazinzi kwamaholo emakethe nokuhlangana nezinkinga ezihlobene nezingozi zezulu, iqiniso lelo mali elitshalwe alinaso isiqinisekiso. Izinhlangano ezivame ukuhlinzeka abalimi ngemali manje zikhathazekile ukuhlinzeka abalimi ngemali futhi zibamba imali yabo ngokuqinile. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke sicele uhulumeni ukuthi asekele abakhiqizi ngemali ebolekiwe ngendlela eqinile, enhle, futhi esebenzayo lapho ukudla kukhiqizwa. Amanani emakethe emakethe ayengazinzi - ayanda futhi ehla - lapha sikhuluma ngamanani okudla nezindleko zokukhiqiza ezifana nezithako, imbewu, ukudla kwezilwane, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo emasimini, kubeka umkhiqizi esimweni esinzima sezezimali ngoba akanawo amandla okuphatha izindleko ezibonakalayo nezifihlekile zokudla okukhiqizwayo emasimini. Uma intengo yemakethe yokudla okukhiqizwayo ngumlimi yehlile, ngeke uyibone lokhu ezitolo - lokhu kukhuphula ukungabaza ukuthi kuphela abathengi bokudla nabanye abazuza, hhayi abakhiqizi nabathengi bokudla. Lokhu kuzothinta kanjani abantu baseNingizimu Afrika? Uma abakhiqizi behluleka amabhizinisi abo nezindlu futhi abakhiqizi abasha behluleka ukungena kulomsebenzi, kuzoba nomthelela omubi kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Abakhiqizi bangumgogodla wesizwe sethu futhi bangesinyathelo sokuqala ekukhuleni kwezezimali. Uma amabhizinisi okulima ehla, amabhizinisi amakhulu nawo azohla. Lokhu kuphikisana nakho kuyasebenza - uma amabhizinisi okulima akhula, amabhizinisi amakhulu akhula, futhi izindawo ezinezamabhizinisi zikhula. Abakhiqizi ngempela bakha ingcebo, inani langempela ngokusebenzisa imbewu nokukhanya kwelanga futhi basilethela izinto ezondla imizimba yethu (ukudla) nezempilo yethu kwezezimali. Le ndlu yemindeni yokulima ibalulekile uma sifuna izwe eliqinile elikhulayo. Uma silahlekelwa ngumkhiqizi oyedwa noma senze kube nzima kulabo abasha ekulimaleni, noma singasekeli labo abasanda kuqala ukulima, sithumele imvelo yethu, ukuphepha kwezwe lethu, nezimo zethu zezezimali engcupheni.
Kunabantu abakhulayo abakhiqizayo kahle kwezolimo kodwa abangafundile - bathola ulwazi ngokubuka nokuhlangenwe nakho ngoba bathanda ezolimo. Ezolimo kuyimpilo yabo. Ezolimo kuyubuciko, kuyisayensi, kuyindlela yokuphila. Ezolimo, kufanele kube nethemba nokukholwa - izinto eziningi azikho ezandleni zakho ngoba ulima ngaphandle futhi isimo sezulu asiqinisekile. Isayensi yezolimo ithuthuke - kukhona ulwazi oluningi ngemininingwane emincane yezindlela zokulima. Kufanele ufune usizo nolwazi kulabo abafundile ngoba ungumkhiqizi emapulazini. Ngokwesibonelo, ukuhlola amasampula omhlabathi kudinga ulwazi lobuchwepheshe. Awudingi ukwenza lowo msebenzi wokuhlola uqobo - udinga nje ukuthatha amasampula njalo, uwahlola, futhi ulalele lokho okukhuluma lowo muntu ofundile onokwethenjelwa. Sebenzisa umanyolo ngokuya ngomyalezo owutholayo mayelana nezitshalo zakho. Sicela uqiniseke futhi uthole umyalezo omuhle futhi usebenzise lowo myalezo ngendlela efanele - kodwa khumbula, amehlo akho nolwazi oluthola ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kuzokwazi ukukusiza ufinyelele umkhiqizo omuhle. Thatha wonke amathuba okufunda nokuzilolonga nalabo abafundile nabanolwazi. Awukwazi ukufunda ezolimo kuphela encwadini; thola umuntu onolwazi olugcwele. Kufanele uhlanganise ulwazi lwakho mayelana nokufunda ngenkathi usafuna ukuqhubeka nokufunda - sebenzisa amatafula alandelayo kodwa ungakhathazeki kakhulu uma ungahambanga esikoleni. Isifundo sesikole sodwa asizokwazi ukukusiza uphumelele kwezolimo.
Uma uqala ukulima, kusho ukuthi usenkampanini, ngakho kufanele uqoqe ulwazi mayelana nezinto ezichaza isimo sakho. Kuzofika isikhathi lapho uzodinga imali, bese uya ebhange noma kwenye indawo ukuyoboleka imali. Lezi zindawo zidinga ulwazi oluningi mayelana nesimo sakho kanye nesimo sebhizinisi lakho. Ngezansi kukhona amatafula anemininingwane yezinto ezizodingeka (kufanele kube nekhophi ye I.D. yakho kanye nekhophi ye I.D. yomkakho). Lokhu kubalulekile. Ngaso sonke isikhathi nikeza ulwazi mayelana nalezi zinto: lapho wazalwa khona, nini, lapho ukhulele khona, ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi uqale ukufisa ukulima. Lokhu kungasiza lapho uya ezifundweni ngoba bazokwazi ukukhuluma ulimi oluhambisana nawe. Khumbula ukuthi ukulima kudinga ukunakwa kwakho nsuku zonke nangasikhathi sonke. Uma unomfuno oqinile wokulima, kufanele ube khona epulazini lakho ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kuthiwa "amehlo omqashi akhuthaza isilwane," futhi "ukufaka okungcono kakhulu yizinyathelo zomkhiqizi emhlabeni." Ukulima kuhlobene nezinto eziphilayo, izitshalo - zidinga ukunakwa okuqhubekayo. Ingabe uhlala epulazini lapho ulima khona?
Ucwaningo olwenziwe uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luthole ukuthi kunezinto eziningi ezenza kube nzima kubalimi abasha ukufaka esikhundleni sabalimi bezinhlanzi. Ama-traktor nemishini esetshenziswa abalimi abasha awasebenzi kahle, futhi bangenamali yokuthenga imishini emisha noma engcono - inzuzo etholakala ekukhiqizeni okusanhlamvu incane, futhi abakwazi ukuphatha amaphutha. Abaningi babalimi abakwazi ukusebenzisa imishini emisha ngendlela efanele - isibonelo, uMnyango Wezolimo waseMpumalanga Kapa unikeze abanye abalimi ama-traktor nemishini emisha, kodwa bahluleka ukuyisebenzisa nokuyigcina. Abaningi babalimi badinga imishini ebalulekile efana ne-boom sprayer, futhi abakwazi ukuphatha izitshalo eziphilayo nezifo ngezikhemikhali. Akukho nezinhlangano ezithanda ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuthenga imishini endala, esasebenza, futhi imishini emisha ibiza kakhulu, okungakwazi ukukhokhwa ngababalimi. Okwamanje, izinga lenzalo liphezulu, futhi uma lihlanganiswa nezindleko zokukhiqiza, ukulima kwezinye izindawo akusasebenzi, okwenza kube nzima. Kuneziningi izimfuno zomhlaba ezitholwe ngaphansi komthetho wokwabiwa komhlaba, kodwa lowo mhlaba awuhambisani nokukhiqiza ukudla - labo balimi bafisa ukulima kodwa abakwazi ukuvezwa ukuthi balime emhlabeni ongena ngaphansi kuka-700 mm wezikhukhula - ingozi yokwehluleka iphezulu kakhulu. Enye inkinga okufanele ibhekwane nayo ukuthi: izindaba zomthetho ezihlobene nokwabiwa komhlaba aziphathwa kahle. Ngokuvamile, umhlaba wabiwa kubantu abaningi (iTrust) abangabalimi, kuvame ukufaka abantu abangaphezu kuka-30 abazuza. Ekuqaleni, bacabanga ukuthi bonke bazosebenzisana emasimini, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwavela izinkinga eziningi, kushiya kuphela abazuzi abambalwa abenza yonke imisebenzi, kodwa bangenakukwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bazokwazi ukuziphilisa esikhathini esizayo. Ukuqinisekisa imali yokuqala yokutshalwa kwezimali kuyinxenye yenkinga, kodwa kukhona abanye abazame futhi baphumelele, isibonelo: iphrojekthi yethu ivuselelwe noMnyango Wezolimo waseFree State kanye ne-OVK ukuze kusekelwe abalimi abakhethiwe - i-OVK ihlinzeke ngazo zonke izimali ukuze abalimi bakwazi ukufaka imbewu emhlabeni ngesikhathi esifanele, kanti uMnyango uthe uzobuyisela u-50% walezi zindleko ku-OVK ukuze labo balimi babe nezinzuzo. Konke lokhu kuhamba kahle, futhi bonke abalimi bakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo nokwenza inzuzo, kodwa lapho sifuna ukwandisa leli hlelo njengokuvumelana, uMnyango uphendule ukuthi awunayo ibhajethi yale mali! Lapho abalimi bephumelele ekubolekeni imali, izikhungo zokuxhasa azifuni ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyengeziwe yokulungisa nokugcina imishini - uma abalimi bengekho nemishini esebenzayo, abakwazi ukuba abalimi bezentengiselwano. Ezindaweni zeBronkhorstspruit neLichtenburg, i-AFGRI isekela abalimi abasha - basebenzisa abaqashi abamhlophe abakhulu, benza yonke imisebenzi yokulima (i-AFGRI ihlinzeka ngezindleko zokuqala futhi ithatha u-50% wenzuzo). Abalimi abafundi amakhono okulima futhi abatholi amakhono ezolimo. Akukho inzuzo ethola ngabalimi ngabanye - yonke imifula ilimwa ngokuhlanganyela, futhi bonke abakhiqizi bathola inzuzo ehambisana nosayizi bemifula yonke, hhayi umkhiqizo owenziwe emifuleni yabalimi abodwa. Uma sekungekho inzuzo kulolu work, i-AFGRI izokhawulela ukulima, futhi abakhiqizi bazobhekana nezinkinga ngoba abakwazi ukuziphilisa. Ukwanda kwezindleko ze-fertilizer kusho ukuthi abakhiqizi abasebenzisi inani elifanele le-fertilizer - kuholela ekutheni kube nezithelo eziphansi nemifula ebulalayo. I-Maize Trust ivuselele uhlelo oluhle lokuxhasa uxhaso lwezinto ezifana nokufaka imbewu, ukulima, imfundo, nokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa. Kodwa le misebenzi ihlinzekwa yizinkampani zezolimo. Ngokuvamile, umbulali akayena ilungu lenkampani yezolimo, noma bahluleka ukuboleka imali ezinkampanini zezolimo. Ngezinye izikhathi awekho amabhizinisi ezolimo (njengaseMpumalanga Kapa) - bese umkhiqizi engakwazi ukufinyelela usizo olunikezwa yi-Maize Trust. Ukwabelana ngolwazi oluvela kuMnyango Wezolimo akusebenza kahle - ngokuvamile, iziphathimandla zokwabelana ngolwazi zihluleka ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, futhi kuvame ukuba bengenandaba yokuxhasa abakhiqizi. Ukufinyelela emhlabeni wokulima kuyinkinga kwezinye izifundazwe - ikakhulukazi lapho kungekho mhlaba wombuso, njengaseFree State. UMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba awusebenzi kahle - bayawuphika ukukhokha izindleko eziphezulu uma umhlaba wezolimo omuhle uthengiswa, futhi uma bethenga umhlaba, abacabangi ukuthi abalimi banemishini yokulima - umbulali akadingi kuphela umhlaba onokukhiqiza, badinga nezinye izinto eziningi ukuze babe umkhiqizi ophumelelayo ekulimaleni.
I-Byline: Ulwazi lutholwe ocwaningweni olubizwa ngokuthi "Ukulinganisa Izinsiza Nokuhlela Ukulima." Ngokuvamile, inani lemakethe lephondo lilinganiswa ngamandla ale phondo okukhulisa ukudla. Ngisho nasemaphandleni, abakhiqizi basathenga amapulazi ngentengo ehambelana nenani lezomnotho lendawo ethile ezokhiqiza inzuzo ethile ekulimaleni. Inani lempahla ezikhokhwayo ezikhuphukayo liphinde libe nomthelela ngoba abakhiqizi abaningi basebenza ngemali ebolekiwe. Imali engena ekuthuthukiseni izinto ezithile epulazini ezizokwandisa inani lephondo iphinde ibeke umthunzi enanini lemakethe yezindawo ezilimiwe. Ungangena nenkontileka nabanye abalimi ukuze kube nokushintshaniswa. Inzuzo izotholakala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba inani lemakethe lendawo esebenzayo lizokhuphuka njalo. Lezi zinzuzo ezitholakala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi zixhumene nenani lenzuzo elikhuphukayo nelinciphayo mayelana nesistimu yezomnotho ngesikhathi esithile. Ngokuvamile, inani lemakethe lendawo elilimiwe likhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kodwa emhlabeni wonke le ndawo ayisagcinwa abantu abaningi; isezandleni zezithile. Ngakho-ke, kunzima kubantu abasha abafuna ukulima ukuba bangene ezolimo ngoba kunzima ukuthola ipulazi nokukhokhela ngempesheni yokuvuna ngesikhathi esifushane. Kodwa lokhu kuyashintsha uma umhlaba utholwa ngezinsiza (LRAD), noma ngokufaka, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngentengo yokukhokha etholelwe usizo (njengohlelo olusha lweMnyango Wezomhlaba olubizwa nge- Proactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS)). Ukuqashwa komhlaba nakho kushintshile; kwakuwumkhuba lapho abalimi abasha beqala khona ukulima, kodwa manje sekuyindlela yokwandisa ukusebenza kwabalimi abakhulu. Lokhu kufanele kuhlolwe ngokucophelela, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni osebenziselwa umphakathi wonke ngoba kukhona indawo enkulu lapho ukulima kungakwenziwanga - lezi zindawo zingalimiwe ngabalimi abanekhono lokwandisa ukulima ngendlela enenzuzo. Ukuqashwa komhlaba kusiza abalimi ukuba bandise ukusebenza kwabo ngaphandle kokubamba izinsizi ezihambisana nokuba ngabapulazi.
Abalimi baseMpumalanga abakhulisa ngezinga elincane bakhethwe. Ozakwaziyo ukuhamba phambili uzokhethwa emcimbini we-250 Ton Club ngomhla ka-26 Agasti 2010. U-Alpheos Masina wazalwa ngonyaka ka-1948 eBadplaas. Ushadile noChristina Ncongwane futhi banezingane eziyisithupha. Wakhulela eBadplaas futhi akazange aye esikoleni. Ngonyaka ka-1965, waqala ukusebenza epulazini lezitshalo zokwelapha eNew Town futhi wasebenza kuKruger Construction, akha umgwaqo oya eBhabthoni naseBadplaas. Ngonyaka ka-1968, waqala ukusebenza epulazini lapho kukhuliswe khona izitshalo zokudla. Okwamanje, ukhulisela u-mazey, ubhontshisi, nezitshalo eziluhlaza emakhathini amane. Wayengumfundi weNdwandwa Trust ethole ipulazi eBadplaas ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokubuyiselwa Komhlaba. Usasebenza kakhulu futhi unentshisekelo yokufunda. U-Commissioner Mhlongo wazalwa ngonyaka ka-1953 endaweni encane eNkomazi ebizwa ngeLangeloop. Wakhulela lapho futhi waqala esikoleni ngonyaka ka-1959 eDriekoppies LP School. Ngemuva kwalokho, waya eLomati Dry School esigabeni 1 (ibanga lesithathu) futhi waphasa isigaba 6 (ibanga lesishiyagalombili) ngonyaka ka-1971. Ngonyaka ka-1974, waqala ukuphatha ikhefi elincane labazali bakhe. Ushadile noNomasonto Ngwenya ngonyaka ka-1975, futhi banezingane eziyisixhenxe - abafana ababili namantombazane amahlanu. Ezinye zezingane zisebenza, kodwa eyincane isasebenza esikoleni. Ngemuva kokuba eqale ukuphatha ibhizinisi, wandisa ngonyaka ka-1975. Wathenga ama-lawnmowers amabili, wakha umgqomo, futhi waqala ukuthenga izinkomo. Okwamanje, unama-345 ezinkomo. Ngonyaka ka-1997, wabuyela emasimini ngoba abazali bakhe babalimi. Waqala ukutshala u-mazey, ubhontshisi, ushukela, nezinye izitshalo. Okwamanje, ukhulisela ushukela (amakhilomitha angama-7) nezinye izitshalo zokudla ezifana nobhontshisi, amaphuphu, i-okra, namagilebhisi - konke emathafeni angama-20. Umazey uthola amanzi (amakhilomitha angama-6). Kulonyaka, uthole u-40 tons we-mazey, u-15 tons wobhontshisi, kanye no-20 tons wamaphuphu. Okwamanje, uthola izinkukhu. UNyosi Mhlanga wazalwa eGutshwa ngonyaka ka-1941 futhi wakhulela lapho ngaphansi kobuholi bendabuko bukaKhumalo. Kuyidolobhana elincane eduze kweWhite River eMpumalanga. Waqala esikoleni eGutshwa School ngonyaka ka-1952. Waphuma esikoleni ngemuva kokuphasa isigaba 5 ngonyaka ka-1959. Waqala ukusebenza ngonyaka ka-1960 ePlaston. Wasebenza isikhathi eside ezihlalweni zokudlela enza ukupheka nokulinda. Ushadile noEvah Khumalo ngonyaka ka-1964, kodwa usushonile. Banezingane ezimbili, umfana nentombazane. U-evah washona ngonyaka ka-2009. Okwamanje, uhlala yedwa. Wakhulela endaweni lapho umphakathi wonke ubalimi. Bakha u-mazey, ubhontshisi, nezinkukhu (jugo beans). Waqhubeka nokunakekela izinkomo zabazali bakhe. Waqala ukulima yedwa ngonyaka ka-1978 kodwa wama ngonyaka ka-1982 ngenxa yokoma okukhulu. Wabe esebenza eNgodwana. Ngonyaka ka-2003, wabuyela emasimini, efaka izitshalo eziluhlaza, u-mazey, izinkukhu, kanye nobhontshisi. Emathafeni amane, ufaka izitshalo eziluhlaza, kanti emathafeni amane ufaka ezinye izitshalo. Eminyakeni edlule, uqale nokuzama izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-mazey. UVincent Mdluli wazalwa ngonyaka ka-1941 eMahukhube (Spelanyane), eduze kweNaspoti, ngaphansi kobuholi bendabuko bukaMpakeni. Kuyidolobhana elincane elingu-50 km ngaphandle kweNaspoti eMpumalanga. Ngonyaka ka-1949, waqala esikoleni eRoman Catholic Church School eDaantjie Trust. Waphuma esikoleni ngonyaka ka-1957 ngemuva kokuphasa isigaba 7. Ngonyaka ka-1960, waqala ukusebenza eNelspruit Sawmill. Ngonyaka ka-1964, wayengumlawuli, kodwa waphuma ngonyaka ka-1972. Ngonyaka ka-1976, wasebenza e-Ellerines Furniture Shop njengomthengisi futhi kamuva waba ngumlawuli ngonyaka ka-1980. Waphuma e-Ellerines ngonyaka ka-1999. Ushadile noJosphinah Mndawe ngonyaka ka-1964 - washona ngonyaka ka-2003. Banezingane eziyisithupha - abafana ababili namantombazane amane. Ingane endala yazalwa ngonyaka ka-1966 kanti eyincane yazalwa ngonyaka ka-1985. Ngonyaka ka-2007, ushade noNonhlanhla Mavuso, kodwa abanakho izingane. UVincent wakhulela epulazini ngoba abazali bakhe babalimi. Basebenzisa izinkomo ukuhlinza izinkambu. Uhlala ejabulela ukusebenza nezinkomo nasekulimeni. Ngonyaka ka-2003, waqala ukulima yedwa. Waqala ukutshala u-mazey, ubhontshisi, nezinkukhu ngonyaka ka-2003 emakhatheni angama-10 - 15. Okwamanje, ubambisana noMnz Eros Mazibuko, ongumrepresentative osekelayo, esebenzisa ipulazi lakhe ngendlela efanele. Okwamanje, bakhulisa u-mazey emakhatheni angama-30, amakhilomitha angama-6 wobhontshisi, kanye namakhilomitha angama-2 ezinkukhwini. Banezisebenzi eziyi-8 nabashayeli bezithuthuthu abathathu. Basebenza ngezithuthuthu ezine, umshini wokugaya, ama-trailer amathathu, ama-discs amabili, umplanter oyedwa, um-ripper oyedwa, kanye nezikhwama ezimbili. UVincent unama-11 ezinkomo kanye nama-15 ezinkukhu.
Izithombe: Bruce Nqezo, Simphiwe Tshabu, Leonard Nondonga, Colbert Timakhwe, noCaledon Quta. Abalimi abancane beMpumalanga bakhethwe. Umnqobi uzokhethwa emcimbini we-250 Ton Club ngomhla ka-26 kuNdasa, 2010. UBruce uneminyaka engu-56 futhi wazalwa eKwadike A/A eLusikisiki. Uqede uBanga lesi-12 wabe esebenza eGold Fields eVaal Reefs kusukela ngo-1974 kuya ku-1976. Ubuyele ekhaya waba umshayeli we-traktor eMnyangweni Wezolimo, futhi wasebenza njengomsebenzi "Wokuthuthukisa." Ugotshwe ngo-1984 futhi unabantwana abathathu nezingane ezimbili. Omunye unyana uphakathi kweyunivesithi, kanti abanye abantwana basafunda. UBruce walahlekelwa umsebenzi wakhe wokushayela ngo-2000 waqala ukutshala ujeqe emakhilomithri amabili. Okwamanje, ukhiqiza ujeqe, amabhontshisi, kanye nephepha emakhilomithri amahlanu. USimphiwe Elliot Tshabu wazalwa ngomhlaka 26 kuMeyi, 1956, endaweni yokuphatha iNtshiqo eTsolo. Uhambe esikoleni kuze kube uBanga lesi-6. Usebenze eCape Town iminyaka eyisithupha wabe esebenza kwaVandarly Esco iminyaka engama-20. Ngo-1997, ubuyele ekhaya waqala ukukhulisa izinkomo nezinkunzi. Ngaleso sikhathi, watshala ujeqe, amabhontshisi, kanye nephepha ekhaya. Ugotshwe ngo-1982 futhi unabantwana abane, abantwana abathathu nezingane ezintathu. Omunye unyana ususebenze, kodwa abanye abantwana basafunda. Ngenxa yokulahlekelwa kwemisebenzi emigodleni, uSimphiwe ucabange ukuthi kuzoba ngcono ukusebenzisa amasimu akhe ukukhiqiza ukudla nokwenza inzuzo. Okwamanje, utshala ujeqe emakhilomithri ayi-14. ULeonard Nondonga wazalwa ngomhlaka 27 ku-Okthoba, 1950, endaweni yokuphatha iNjezweni. Uhambe esikoleni kuze kube uBanga lesi-8. Usebenze emigodleni eRustenburg futhi wasebenza emigodleni yeplatinamu kusukela ngo-1981 kuya ku-1988. Ugotshwe ngo-1977 futhi unabantwana abane - ababili sebesebenza kanti abanye basafunda. Ngo-1989, walahlekelwa umsebenzi emigodleni. Ubuyele ekhaya waqala ukulima, watshala ujeqe namabhontshisi. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, wathenga i-traktor ukuze asebenze kangcono. Okwamanje, usaqhubeka nokulima kodwa wenza imisebenzi yokuhweba ukuze athole imali eyengeziwe. Unemakhilomithri amane emhlabathini jikelele. UColbert Timakhwe wazalwa ngomhlaka 5 kuZibandlela, 1944. Wakhulela abazali bakhe ezindaweni zokulima. Uhambe esikoleni wabe eseqeda uBanga lesi-7. Wabe esebenza emigodleni eLesley eMpumalanga iminyaka eyishumi. Walahla imisebenzi emigodleni ngo-1989 wabe eseya eCape Town ukuze asebenze kwaMurray Construction. Ngo-1991, ubuyele ekhaya waqala ukulima. Ugotshwe ngesikhathi esebenza eMpumalanga futhi unabantwana abane: abantwana abane nezingane ezimbili. Bonke abantwana basebenza, kanti omunye udadewabo usafunda. UColbert usebenze kumkhiqizi wezithelo iminyaka emithathu futhi wathola ulwazi ngolimo. Okwamanje, utshala ujeqe emakhilomithri amahlanu. UCaledon Qutha wazalwa ngomhlaka 30 kuJuni, 1959, endaweni yokuphatha iNjijini. Wakhulela lapho futhi uhambe esikoleni eNjijini. Ngemuva kwalokho, waya eMt Frere High School, waphumelela uBanga lesi-12, futhi wathola idiploma yokuba uthisha. Ngemuva kwalokho, waya eCape Town ukufundisa. Ugotshwe ngo-1983, yena nomkakhe banabantwana ababili: unyana nendodakazi. Ngo-1989, wavula isitolo sokuthengisa izithelo nezitshalo. Wabe eseqasha esinye isitolo ngo-2004 wabe esebuya eNjijini eMt Frere lapho engum owner wesitolo. UCaledon waqala ukubheka ukulima ujeqe ngoba wabona ukuthi abantu abaningi banokukhawulelwa ekutshaleni ujeqe. Kukhona futhi umhlaba omningi endaweni yonke ongasebenzisa. Wabona inani elikhulu lokukhiqiza ezindaweni zeKokstad. Okwamanje, uCaledon utshala ujeqe emakhilomithri angama-20.
Le ndatshana ibhalwe ngu-A.P.N. du Toit (ARC-Grain Crops Institute), S.J. Terrblanche (University of Pretoria), no-J. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, isikhathi sokuthi abalimi abasha bavele - kumele bavuke futhi babe nesibindi, kumele babe neqhaza ekufuneni usizo kuhulumeni nakwezinye izinhlangano, kumele bathathe izintambo ukuze baqinise ikusasa labo. Indlela yokuvusa ikhono lokuba nesibindi ilandelayo: abalimi kumele bahlangane futhi basebenzisane - lokhu kuzobavumela ukuba baqhubeke phambili. Abalimi kumele basebenze ngqo ukuze benze amaqembu abalimi aqinile, futhi ubunikazi bama qembu lawo kumele bube ezandleni zezakhamizi. Amaqembu abalimi avula indlela enhle yokuxhumana nokubambisana ukuze kufezwe uguquko emapulazini nasemkhakheni wezolimo jikelele. Kubonakala, nokho, ukuthi ukuhlanganisa abalimi ukuze benze amaqembu kuzothatha isikhathi. Le nhloso ihlose ukuvusa nokukhombisa abaholi emkhakheni wezolimo ukuba bazame ukwenza umsebenzi wokubambisana kwabalamuli kube yinto ezoba nemiphumela emihle. Kungani kufanele sakhe inhlangano yabalamuli emiphakathini yethu? Abalimi bangafunda komunye nomunye. Ngale ndlela, bathola ulwazi namakhono okusebenza. Ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, abalimi bazokwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezingcono. Uma kukhula ulwazi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, kuzobasiza abalimi ukuba bagweme ukwenza amaphutha: "Kuhle ukuhlanganisa izwi." Ezinhlakeni, abalimi bafunda ukucabanga ngezindlela ezintsha nokufuna izindlela ezintsha zokuhamba phambili. Amalungu eqembu akhuthazwa ukuba abheke futhi athole izindlela ezahlukene zokusebenza. Inhlangano inika abalimi amathuba okuhlangana nokufunda izindlela ezintsha ezingakhulisa ibhizinisi labo, izindlela zokuthola izinto zokulima, nezinhlelo zokumaketha. Inhlangano isiza abalimi ukukhulisa imbuyiselo emapulazini. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba ulwazi, amakhono, nokuxhumana kuhlanganiswe phakathi kwamalungu. Amaqembu anika abalimi amandla okuxoxisana ngamanani angcono. Abalimi abasha badinga ukukhuluma ngezwi eliqinile. Iqembu lokufunda elisebenzayo lizokhuthaza amalungu alo. Yiziphi izici zeqembu lokufunda elisebenzayo? Ukuhola okuqinile - "Abaholi kumele basebenze ngamalungu, hhayi amalungu ukuze abaholi." Iqembu aliholwa ngumholi noma ilungu elithile ngendlela yokubusa. Iqembu elihle linezibuko ezicacile zekusasa, linomgomo ocacile, futhi linendlela eqondile ekhombisa indlela yokusebenza ezoletha izinzuzo zezimali. Bonke amalungu balingana ngezinga lolwazi lwezolimo futhi badinga izinsiza ezifanayo. Uma wonke amalungu elingana, ukuxhumana kwabo nokubambisana kuhamba kahle. Ilungu kumele liqonde kahle indima yalo ngaphakathi kweqembu lokufunda. Iqembu kumele libe nefa nempumelelo yalo. Izindaba zezimali zivame ukuvela kumalungu futhi ziqhutshelwa ngabo. Amalungu anesibopho sokubheka imiphumela yezindlela zabo zokusebenza; banesibopho sokusebenza eqenjini futhi bazwe injabulo yokubambisana. Bonke amalungu banomfutho wokufunda nokwabelana ngolwazi lwabo namanye amalungu. Amalungu kumele azinikele uma ehlanganisa izindlela zabo zokuhamba phambili, aphathe imisebenzi yabo, futhi afune izindlela zokuthola usizo olufanele. Amalungu akumele abambe ngokuqinile ezindleleni zendabuko zokuphatha imisebenzi yabo uma efuna ukufezekisa umphumela othile. Kumele basebenzise amakhono ahlukahlukene amalungu ahlukene ngendlela efanele. Kumele kube nokuhlangana uma kukhuluma. Amalungu kumele akwazi ukuveza kalula ukuthi isimo sabo sikhona kanjani mayelana nomsebenzi nokuthi bacabangani ngendlela iqembu elisebenza ngayo. Amalungu kumele azihlolisise njalo. Ngokufanayo, ithimba kumele lihlolisise njalo ukuthi lisasebenza kahle futhi lize lizele ezinye izindlela ezingcono zokusebenza. Iqembu kumele likwazi ukuxhumana kalula nabaphathi bezolimo. Iqembu elinjalo livame ukuxhumana nezinye izinhlangano futhi lizokwazi temsilwa amalungu ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe. Iqembu kumele lihlole ngokucophelela ukuthi lisebenza kanjani, lingesabi ukusho nokuvuma ukuthi lenze amaphutha. Bese likwazi ukusebenza kangcono ngoba lizokwazi ukushintsha indlela yokusebenza edingekayo. Amaqembu anika amalungu amandla okuqhubeka. Ilungu ngalinye linomsebenzi wokusebenza eqenjini kodwa liyazi ukuthi ekugcineni lizothola inzuzo ngoba iqembu liqinile kunomuntu oyedwa. Ukwakha iqembu lokufunda. Amaqembu kumele akhiwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo ezikhona futhi mayelana nomphakathi wonke. Uma kudingeka, ukuxhumana nekhansela lendawo kubalulekile. Kumele kube nokwamukelwa kukhansela lendawo nezinye izinhlangano ukuthi kudingeka kwakhiwe iqembu labalimi. Abalimi kumele bakhethe amalungu amaqembu amasha. Iqembu lingaqala ngesakhiwo esingaqondile. Ngemuva kwalokhu, lingakhula libe ngesakhiwo esisemthethweni, kodwa ngesivinini saso. (Bheka umgomo obizwa ngokuthi: "Sebenza kuqala bese uhlela kamuva"). Lo mgomo ungcono ngoba awuqinile kakhulu, uvumela abalimi ukuba bakhule ngenqubo yokwakha inhlangano. Amaqembu akhona angaphinde abhekwe ukuze asebenze kangcono noma angavuselelwa. Nokho, kungcono ukuhoxisa amaqembu angasebenzi kahle. Uma kubonakala ukuthi abantu abamukelwa eqenjini ngendlela efanele, kuzodingeka ukuthi kutholakale abanye abangakwazi ukusiza emsebenzini wokuhlanganisa amalungu ukuze kwakhiwe iqembu eliphilayo. Uma abaphakeli/abaholi bengaveli kulolo mphakathi, zama ukuthola abantu abathembekile kulomphakathi wonke abangakwazi ukuhlanganisa futhi baxhumanise abalimi emsebenzini wezolimo. Kumele kube nokucaciswa njalo mayelana nomsebenzi wabaholi nalabo abasiza ekuhlanganiseni abalimi ngoba kubalulekile uma kwakhiwa iqembu elihle. Kumele kucaciswe ukuthi yiziphi izidingo nezinkinga zamalungu eqembu elithile ngoba lokhu kuqhubeka uma kulungiselelwa umsebenzi wesikhathi esizayo nokusetha izinhloso zeqembu. Lo mgomo (indlela yokusebenza) usiza abalimi ukuba baqale ukusebenza ngokushesha ukuze isikhathi singachithwa. Iqembu elincane elingaqondile lingaqala ngokubhekana nenkinga ethile bese amalungu engasizana omunye nomunye ekuxazululeni le nkinga. Ngokufanayo, amalungu aleli qembu azothola umfutho wokusebenza ukuze kuzuze umgomo weqembu. Ngemuva kwalokhu, ukuharmony phakathi kwamalungu kudala umoya oqinile phakathi kwabo, basondele njengoba besebenzisana. Kufana nezinto zemvelo eziphila ngogesi wangaphakathi. Izinhlangano zikhula zodwa, azivinjwa yizinto zangaphandle. Lokhu kudala umoya oqinile wokuhola ngoba abaholi bakhethwa phakathi kwamalungu eqembu. (ukulwa kwamandla) kwabaphathi noma ezinye izinhlangano zangaphandle. Ukwakha iqembu lokufunda elisebenzayo kudinga lokhu: kumele kube nomfutho phakathi kwabalamuli kule ndawo ukuba bahlangane ukuze basebenze ngenhloso yabo yokuxazulula izinkinga zabo nokukhiqiza imikhiqizo edingekayo. Akukho iqembu lokufunda labalimi elingaphoqwa abantu ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle ukuba lihlangane - kumele kube nomfutho phakathi kwamalungu. Kodwa asifanele sikhohlwe ukuthi izimo zezinto azifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Uma umfutho wokuba ne iqembu lokufunda labalimi uvuka emphakathini, abaholi bang
Isihloko 2: Neels Ferreira (GrainSA), Johan Kriel (umqondisi wesifunda), Labious Manoto, noTonie Loots (abaphathi besifunda). Umkhiqizi wezinkuni ophumelelayo konyaka, owenze kahle emncintiswaneni we-Grain SA Developing Producer of the Year, wakhethwa emcimbini omkhulu e-Theatre on the Track eKyalami ngomhla ka-17 kuMfumfu 2008. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-Grain SA ifuna ukuveza ukubonga okukhulu kwezolimo lwe-maize, ikakhulukazi kulabo abakhiqizi abasha abenze kahle kulo msebenzi wokukhiqiza ukudla. Bakhombisa indlela phambili kulabo abasanda kuqala kulesi sikhala. Abantu abayisithupha bakhethwe ukuba baphikise umklomelo we-2008 Developing Producer of the Year. Phakathi kwabo bekukhona u-Isaac Khuto ovela eFicksburg eFree State. Uphumelele lo mncintiswano we-Developing Grain Producer uLabious Manoto ovela eMooifontein esifundazweni saseNorth West. Sifuna ukusho 'Hooray!' kuLabious nakwabanye abanye abaphakanyisiwe ngomsebenzi wabo omuhle. Okulandelayo kuyisifinyezo esivela kubahloli ngemva kokubuyekeza umsebenzi kaLabious. Amandla - Usebenza ngokuzikhandla. Ungumsebenzi onobuchule. Unolwazi olufanele ngeshishini lakhe. Iziphakamiso - Sekuyisikhathi sokuba abe umkhiqizi wezohwebo. Amandla - Unemishini yokulima eyanele nemishini yokulima. Uyiqonda kahle, izitshalo zakhe zinhle, futhi imishini yakhe isesimweni esihle. Unemishayo emihle kanye ne-workshop. Amandla - Unendawo (amasimu), unemishini, unabasebenzi ababili, futhi unolwazi lweminyaka eminingi kwezolimo. Amandla - Ulimi ngezitshalo ezihlanganisiwe ezahlukene: maize, soybeans, izinkomo, nezinkomo. Ungumkhiqizi ozinikele onolwazi oluneminyaka eminingi. Unemishini yokulima eyanele, futhi unemisindo emihle kanye ne-workshop esebenza kahle. Unolwazi ngolimo futhi uyazi ukuthi wenza ini futhi uyakuqonda ukuthi kungani enza imisebenzi ethile. Usebenzisa ulwazi lwabo abahlinzeka ngempahla zokulima - imbewu, amafutha, nezinto zokwakha. Ubuthakathaka - Lo muntu usuwaphulile wonke ubuthakathaka, ulima ngendlela elethe inzuzo manje nangesikhathi esizayo. Iziphakamiso - Lo mkhiqizi wenza konke kahle futhi ufika lapho abakhiqizi bezomnotho bekhona. Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle ngolimo nolwazi oluhle ngolimo. Unamasimu amahle (umhlaba) asetshenziswa kahle futhi unemishini eyanele nemishini. Iziphakamiso - Qhubeka nalo msebenzi omuhle! Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle, umhlabathi onokuthola, imvula enhle, nemishini eyanele nemishini enempilo. Ubuthakathaka - Ukuphathwa kwezitshalo kufanele kuqashelwe - ikakhulukazi kweekgras. Ukumaketha kwakhe kungaba ngcono. Iziphakamiso - Qhubeka nokwandisa amandla emishini njengoba amasimu ekhula. Phenya ukuze uthole amasimu okuphonsa. Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle ngomsebenzi wakhe. Iziphakamiso - Kumele abambe iqhaza ezinsukwini zomkhiqizi nasemahhovisi ukuze athole ulwazi ngezindlela ezintsha ezinhle. Amandla - ungumuntu omkhulu - unamaqhawe amakhulu - izinyathelo ezilandelwayo. Ungumthombo wokuqwashisa ongakhuthaza abanye ukuba bamlandele - ikakhulukazi abafana bakhe. Uthumele iqiniso lokuthi ikusasa lezolimo ezandleni ezifana nezakhe lizokhanya futhi liqhubeke. Ubephumelela ngaphandle kokuhlupheka iminyaka eminingi ngaphandle kokuba nethuba lokuthuthuka. Ngiyamhlonipha, ungumuntu onobungcweti. Phambili nabantu. Usakhula ukuba abe umkhiqizi wezohwebo, kodwa akesabi ukubona izindawo lapho engakhululekile khona nokucela usizo - futhi uzimisele ukuthola lokho kusizo. Iziphakamiso - Umkhiqizi Wonyaka 2008!

Waya esikoleni epulazini kuze kube sefinyelela kuStandard 1. Ebusweni bakhe, wadlala nabafana bempesheni kuze kube seqala ukwenza imisebenzi ehlukahlukene epulazini. Waqala ukusebenza endaweni yokudayisa lapho behlaba izinkomo ezikhiqiza inyama nezinye izilwane. Ngemuva kwalokho, waqala ukushayela ithrekta nokusebenza ngemishini iminyaka emihlanu. UFrikkie wamsiza kakhulu ukuba akhule, eqala njengomsebenzi nje epulazini waba umkhiqizi wezomnotho ngokwakhe. Ufunde izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esebenza noFrikkie. UFrikkie futhi wamthengisela imishini ehlukahlukene, futhi uKoos wakhokha uFrikkie ngemali ayitholayo. Ngokusebenzisa imishini ayithengile kuFrikkie, waqala ukwenza umsebenzi wezinkontileka, esiza abalimi kwezinye izindawo zokukhula ezizungeze uSenekal. Ngonyaka ka-2007, wanikezwa isithembiso nguMnyango Wezolimo ukuba abe umkhiqizi ophathwayo epulazini laseAstoria lapho ekhuluma khona. UKoos ungumlimi onobuchule futhi uyawazisa usizo aluthola kuGrain SA kanye noMnyango Wezolimo, kodwa ubona ukuthi ukutshala izitshalo ezithengiswayo emapulazini ezomile akukwazi ukuqhubeka unomphela. Isivumelwano phakathi kwakhe noMnyango Wezolimo siba seminyakeni - saqala ngomhla ka-10 kuNovemba 2008, saphela ngoNovemba 2009. Ngaleso sikhathi, uKoos wayengacela ukuthi isivumelwano sihlaziywe ngonyaka olandelayo uma uMnyango ubona ukuthi ipulazi liphathwa kahle. Esikhathini esedlule, umkhiqizi wayengaba nendawo, futhi umlimi wayengathenga ipulazi ukuze libe lakhe, kodwa le mthetho ushintshile; akusacaci ukuthi uKoos uzoba ne-pulazi lelo noma cha. Okwamanje, uMnyango Wezolimo uthi umsebenzi kaKoos uyawajabulela, futhi isivumelwano sokuba umkhiqizi ophathwayo sizophinde sihlaziywe. UKoos ubona ukuthi kunenkinga yokwenza inzuzo ngokulima emhlabeni omile endaweni yaseSenekal; lokhu kuyamkhathaza, futhi manje ufuna ukwandisa ibhizinisi lakhe lokulima ngezinkontileka. Ubuye afune ukuthola umhlaba onokukhiqiza okuhle ukuze aqashe ukuze akhiqize ummbila nemifino. Ubuye ufuna ukwandisa inani lezinkomo epulazini. Enye inkinga mayelana nezinsizakalo ezimbi zikaMnyango Wezolimo ukuhlinzekwa kwemishini kubakhiqizi; uKoos ubuye afune ukuqhubeka ethuthukisa izinhlelo zokunisela kuwo wonke amapulazi epulazini, athenge izinkomo eziningi, futhi atshale izindawo ezintsha zokufuywa emhlabeni omile. UKoos ungumfanekiso omuhle womuntu oqale kwi-zero futhi wasebenza kanzima ukufinyelela lapho ekhona namuhla. Kulungile ukuvakashela kuye epulazini ngoba zonke izinto zakhe zigcinwe kahle efasiteleni lakhe. Zonke izinsiza zakhe zisebenza kahle futhi zigcinwe efasiteleni.
