Kungani kukhona izinsuku zabafuyi nezifundo zokubonisa? Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabafuyi luhloselwe ukuvuselela nokuphatha abafuyi abancane ukuze babe izibonelo neziboniso lapho abafuyi bengabona usizo olukhona uma umhlabathi ulungisiwe kahle, uma umanyolo ofanele ufakwa, uma uhlobo lwezithelo oluhambisana nomhlabathi nesimo sezulu saleyo ndawo kukhethwa, uma izilokazane nezifo ziphathwa kahle, futhi uma ukuvuna kwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Uma izindawo zokubonisa zisungulwa, kubalulekile ukuthi abakhiqizi abasha abasondelene naleyo ndawo bakwazi ukubona konke okukhona mayelana nokutshala nokubheka izitshalo ezizotshalwa kulezo zindawo. Izinsuku zabafuyi zinikeza abafuyi ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abafuyi, nezinkampani ezinikeza izinto zokutshala, kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza embonini - abafuyi bathola ulwazi oluningi kulezi zinsuku zabafuyi. ULawrence Luthango (oqale ukusebenza ngoMeyi 2008) eMpumalanga Kapa wayenazo izinsuku ezine zabafuyi abancane. Phakathi nalezi zinsuku zabafuyi, izihloko ezahlukene zaxoxwa. Umshuwalense wokuqala wokufuya. Kulolu hlelo, sizama ukubringela abantu abaningi abahlukene abasebenza ebhizinisini lezolimo ukuze basekele abakhiqizi - banezindawo zabo ezithile futhi banikeza ulwazi olunenzuzo. Kumele kube nokuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke lezi zenzo ukuze kuqinisekiswe intuthuko phambili kokwakha ikusasa elizinzile.
Kuyiqiniso ukusho ukuthi ekuqaleni kwesikhathi lapho umhlaba wokuqala, umhlaba ongavunwa okhona kule planethi unomkhawulo - akukho mhlaba omusha odalwa lapho izitshalo zingakhula khona. Kukhona izindlela zokukhiqiza ukudla ngaphandle kokusebenzisa umhlabathi (ukukhiqizwa kwe-hydroponic) lapho izitshalo zikhula, kodwa ngokuvamile umhlabathi uyasetshenziswa, futhi kumele siqonde ukuthi inani lomhlabathi linomkhawulo; kukhona kuphela inani elithile lomhlabathi, alikhuli. Ngokuvamile, ukuvuna kuhambisana nokukhiqizwa kokudla nokuphila. Indlela yokuvuna endaweni ethile noma ezweni ihlobene nezinto ezifana nesimo sezulu, uhlobo lomhlabathi, nezindlela ezijwayelekile. Abantu abancike emhlabeni bagcizelela ukudla kwemindeni yabo kuqala. Uma umndeni unokudla okwanele, umvuni angaqhubeka nokukhiqiza ukudla okwengeziwe ukuze athengise ukuze athole inzuzo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwacaca ukuthi amazwe aphumelelayo ezimweni ezinzima yilezo akhiqiza ukudla okwanele. Izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ukudla zikwazile ukuvumela amazwe amaningi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuningi kakhulu kunokuthi kudliwe ngabantu balowo mzansi. Amazwe amaningi athuthukile kwezomnotho akhiqiza ukudla okuningi kunokudingeka yizakhamuzi zawo. Lapho sikhuluma ngezimo zomnotho, lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kudlula isidingo. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi intengo yemakethe yalezo zimpahla kufanele yehlise, futhi abalimi abaningi bazokhawulela ukutshala izitshalo ezithile ezingakhiqizi inzuzo. Nokho, ezwenikazi eliningi, abalimi bathola izinxephezelo ukuze baqhubeke nokutshala lezo zitshalo ngoba uhulumeni walowo mzansi ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe labo alidingi ukuncika ekudleni kwezinye izindawo noma kwamanye amazwe. Amazwe akhiqiza ukudla ngaphezu kwezidingo zawo athumela lokhu kudla kwamanye amazwe. Njalo lokhu kudla kuthengiswa ngentengo ephansi kunezindleko zokukhiqizwa kokudla kulowo mzansi. Njengoba sishilo, inani lomhlabathi elitholakalayo lokukhiqiza ukudla linomkhawulo. Ukuze izwe elithile liqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazoba nokudla esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umhlabathi okhona uqhubeke usetshenziswa ukukhiqiza ukudla. Kodwa umhlabathi ungasebenzisa kuphela ukukhiqiza ukudla uma abanemhlaba benza inzuzo. Njengamanje, sikhona ezinkingeni ngoba izindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla njenge-maize, amabele, okusanhlamvu, kanye ne-soybeans zikhuphukile kakhulu kangangokuthi akukho inzuzo etholakalayo. Singakutshela ukuthini kubalimi abakhiqiza lokhu kudla? Ukukhiqiza leyo zitshalo. Sithi: uma uthanda ukukhiqiza kuphela emndenini wakho, lokho kuhle ngoba uzoba nokudla esikhathini esizayo. Bese uthengisa emakethe kuphela. Njengoba isikhathi sokutshala sisondele, sikufisela umvuno omuhle. Ukuthula, Imvula, kanye nenhlanhla.
Isithombe 1: Izitshalo zekhanda lekhanda zazinkulu kakhulu ukuze zifake ezikhungweni zokuhlwanyela - azizange zihlanyelwe. Isithombe 2: Imvula eningi ingaqinisa umhlabathi phezulu futhi ivimbele ukukhula kwezitshalo. Isithombe 3: Izitshalo zekhanda ezazihlanyelwe ngokujulile zazibhekene nezinkinga zokukhula kahle. Isithombe 4: Ingxenye yezinto ezivame ukudala ingozi ngemva kokukhula yizilokazane. Umsebenzi omningi okudingeka wenziwe ngesikhathi sokuhlwanyela ehlobo uvame ukuncipha ngalesi sikhathi - manje umnini wezolimo unethuba lokuhlola izitshalo zakhe ezikhulayo emapulazini akhe. Sikholelwa ukuthi konke kubukeka kahle: inani lezitshalo lihambisana nezintandokazi zakhe, umbala wezithombo ubumnyama obuhle, zikhula futhi akukho okuncintisana nezitshalo ukuze zibe nokudla namanzi - ngokufingqa, konke kukhombisa ukuthi kuzoba nokuvuna okuhle. Nokho, imvamisa izinto azihambi njengoba besicabanga ukuthi zizohamba, futhi umkhiqizo awuhambisani nezilindelo zethu. Ngalesi sikhathi, sidinga ukuhlala phansi futhi sihlolisise ukuthi kungani izinto ezingahambi kahle njengoba besifuna. Ingabe inani lezitshalo libalulekile noma cha? Lapho kuhlwanyelwa ukuze kuvinjwe, umnini wezolimo kufanele ahlaziye ukuthi mangaki izitshalo ahambisana nezincwadi zezazi zezolimo. Isitshalo esisodwa sinekhono lokukhiqiza inani elithile lokudla - izinto ezithinta ikhono lalo lokukhula kahle zifaka: inani lamanzi emhlabathini, izakhamzimba ezitholakalayo emhlabathini, ukukhanya (ukukhanya kwelanga), kanye noshukela. Ikakhulukazi, inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile lihambisana nomswakama emhlabathini. Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke kakhulu kunokuhlukaniswa kwemigqa lapho zihlanyelwe khona. Ukuhlukaniswa kwemigqa ezindaweni ezithola imvula kuphela kuhluka, kusuka ku-0.9 m kuya ku-2.1 m noma ku-2.3 m. Lokhu kuhlobene futhi nemishini esetshenziswayo noma indlela yokulima kule ndawo. Imigqa ebanzi ivame ukuhlanyelwa lapho umkhiqizo uphansi, lapho kunezinkinga zomhlabathi ngenxa komoya, lapho inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile kufanele libe phansi kunezinye izindawo, futhi lapho imishini isasetshenziswa ukuze ikhulise phakathi kwemigqa. Imigqa eduze ivame ukutholakala lapho kunemvula eyanele futhi lapho kunomswakama emapulazini ukuze kudluliselwe amanzi, futhi lapho izihlahla ziqondiswa ngezikhemikhali (kulula ukukhiqiza ngemishini uma imigqa ibhajwe kakhulu, futhi i-traktor ayikwazi ukuhamba phakathi kwemigqa). Umkhiqizo ofuna ukuwufinyelela uhambisana nenani lezitshalo ohlanyelwe. Uma uhlanyela inani eliphansi lezitshalo, ngeke ufinyelele umkhiqizo ofuna ukuwufinyelela, futhi uma uhlanyela inani eliphezulu, izitshalo zizoncintisana ukuze zikhule futhi umkhiqizo uzokwehla. Izitshalo eziseduze kakhulu zivame ukuthola izifo (njengokubola kwemizi) futhi ziba nezehlakalo. Ezinye izindawo nezitsha ezithile zinezinga elifanele. Uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela ubukhulu bezitshalo obufunwa, umkhiqizo ngeke ufinyelele umgomo ofunwa (ngokufingqa, ngeke kube nezitshalo ezanele ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo ofunwa). Kungani kunenani elinganele lezitshalo? Kunemibandela eminingi engadala inani eliphansi, futhi lokhu kuhlobene nesikhathi sokuhlwanyela nokukhula kwezitshalo. Lokhu kuyinto enkulu ekugcineni eholela enanini eliphansi. Kungenzeka ukuthi ubukhulu bokuhlwanyela ngesikhathi sokuhlwanyela abukuhle, kuholela enanini eliphansi lezitshalo ezihlanyelwe. Kungenzeka ukuthi izitshalo zazinkulu kakhulu futhi azizange zifake ezikhungweni zokuhlwanyela (bona Isithombe 1). Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi izitshalo (izinkwa) zazincane kakhulu futhi ezimbili zazizama ukufaka endaweni eyodwa, zivaliwe ngaphandle kokuthi kukhishwe okuthile. Kungenzeka ukuthi umshini wokuhlwanyela obizwa ngokuthi 'ticker' wawenokuhlukumezeka futhi wacindezela izitshalo. Emshinini wokuhlwanyela ophathwa ngumoya, kungenzeka ukuthi umoya wokukhwabanisa awunamandla anele ukuze ubambe isitshalo endaweni efanele kuze kube sekukhuleni. Ngokuvamile, imishini yokuhlwanyela engalungile ivame ukudala izinkinga ngoba ibhajwa izitshalo eduze kakhulu noma ibhajwa. Ikhwalithi yezitshalo ingase ibe phansi - izitshalo ezimbi, lezo ezineziqu ezimbi ezingakhuli kahle. Kungenzeka ukuthi isimo sezulu siwumswakama kakhulu futhi izitshalo zimanzi kakhulu, zingatholi umoya (okhanyayo) emhlabathini ukuze zikhule. Ngokufanayo, umswakama ungavimba izitshalo ekutholeni umswakama owanele ukuze ziqale ukukhula. Kungenzeka ukuthi kube nezikhemikhali ezisele emhlabathini ezivela konyaka odlule ezabulala izitshalo. Kungenzeka ukuthi zihlanyelwe masinyane konyaka lapho umhlabathi wawubanda kakhulu ukuze usize izitshalo zikhule. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi izitshalo zihlanyelwe ngokujulile futhi zaphumelela ukuphuma (bona Isithombe 3). Izilokazane, izinyoni, noma ezinye izilwane ezincane zingadla izitshalo ngaphambi kokuthi zikhule. Inkinga evamile ukuvama izilokazane ezilimaza izitshalo - ikakhulukazi i-cutworm edla isitshalo njengoba sikhula emhlabathini (bona Isithombe 4). Izinyoni zingadla izitshalo (kodwa lokhu akuyona inkinga enkulu). Emhlabathini owomile, umoya (ukuhlukumeza) ungafaka izitshalo ngempahla njengoba zizama ukukhula. Ukushisa okweqile kungadala izitshalo ukuba zome futhi zife. Iqhwa elisheshayo konyaka lingabulala izitshalo. Kungenzeka futhi emapulazini lapho isivuno sahlanyelwe bese imvula eningi iqinisa umhlabathi. Uma uzama ukukhiqiza umhlabathi onzima ngensimbi, ungalimaza izitshalo. Ukufa kwezitshalo ngesikhathi zisakhula. Izilwane ezidla izitshalo zingaba yinkinga ezindaweni eziningi. Ukukhiqiza ngemishini kungalimaza izitshalo - uma imigqa ingahlukaniswanga kahle, noma umshayeli engashayeli kahle (lapho imigqa yezitshalo ingahambisani kahle futhi ayishayeli kahle kungalimaza izitshalo). Izifo zingaba yingozi. Lapho izihlahla zikhula kakhulu, zingabulala izitshalo zakho. Singaphumelela kanjani kulolu daba lokuntuleka kwezitshalo? Uma kusenesikhathi, ungaphinde uhlanyele (kodwa lokhu kusho ukuthi kuzoba nezitshalo eziningi ezintsha). Uma kubonakala ukuthi kukhona umugqa owawungekahlanyelwa (ngoba umshini wokuhlwanyela wawungasebenzi kahle), lowo mugqa ungaphinde uhlanyelwe. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi izinkinga ezavela ngenxa yenani eliphansi lezitshalo zihlolwe futhi zilungiswe ukuze lezo ziphutha zingaphindi zenzeke ngonyaka ozayo.
Abalimi bayahlonishwa futhi sikwazi ukuqaphela abancintisana abathathu abaphumelela isicoco sikaMlimi Wonyaka wango-2009. Sifisela abancintisana abalandelayo: uSamuel Moloi, uWilliam Matasane, noPhillip Xaba - sithemba ukuthi omunye wabo uzowina lesi sicoco. Umnqobi uzomenyezelwa emcimbini ngomhla ka-9 kuMfumfu eMidrand. USamuel wazalwa epulazini elibizwa ngokuthi uMagdalena ngomhla ka-3 kuNdasa, ngonyaka ka-1969, lapho uyise ayebalima khona. USamuel wayengomunye wabantwana besizukulwane esisha. Uye wahamba esikoleni eMashaeng eduze kweFouriesburg lapho aqeda khona ibanga lesi-12. Njengomntwana, uSamuel waqala ukulima lapho ithuba livela futhi wayephupha ngokuqhubeka nokuba nepulazi lakhe. USamuel washada noDiane, uthisha ophuma eFouriesburg, futhi banezingane ezintathu. USamuel akanalokho akhuluma ngakho okwakhe, kodwa uthi uma abasebenzi beLand Development Agency yeGrain SA bengamkhuthazi, ngeke abe ngumlimi namuhla. Ube able ukufaka isivumelwano sokuhlala endaweni enkulu yokulima edolobheni laseFouriesburg iminyaka emihlanu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubeqashile enye indawo yokulima eqenjini labalimi ababelwe umhlaba ngokuhlelwa komhlaba, ababephoqeleka ukuba bangalimi kuleyo ndawo. Okwamanje, uSamuel ukhulisa izitshalo ezingu-375 hectares ngaphansi kwehlelo lokulima okuzinzile, kuhlanganisa ne-soybeans ne-maize. USamuel uyaziqonda ukubaluleka kokulima okuzinzile. Uhambe neqembu lakhe lokulima futhi uhlale efuna umhlaba ongcono angawuqasha. Njengoba uSamuel engenalo umhlaba awulima, akakwazi ukukhulisa izilwane ezizomsizele ukulinganisa izindleko zokulima. Nakuba efake isicelo sosizo kwiMnyango Wezolimo izikhathi eziningi, akakaze athole usizo. USamuel ungum member weDishweshwe Agricultural Group eFouriesburg, futhi uthathe ingxenye kuyo yonke imihlangano yokuqeqeshwa ethulwe yiGrain SA: Ukuqeqeshwa kokulima okuzinzile/soybeans/maize; Ukuqeqeshwa okujule kakhulu kokulima okuzinzile nokumaketha; Ukuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo kokuphatha ipulazi; kanye Nokuhlola izinsiza nokuhlela ipulazi. USamuel ungumuntu obona amathuba futhi uyakwazi ukudala amasu okuthuthukisa izivuno zakhe. Unenkampani eFouriesburg lapho aphatha futhi agcina imishini yakhe neyabanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, unenkampani yokurenta nokuthengisa ama-tractors. USamuel ugcine imali ngokuthenga ama-tractors nemishini, kodwa impahla yakhe enkulu kakhulu yikhono lakhe lokuxhumana nochwepheshe abakulungele ukusiza nokumeluleka. Akaphuthelwa ukufuna izeluleko futhi ufunda kuyo. Inhlangano ye-OVK isize uSamuel ngemali yokukhulisa izitshalo kulo nyaka kanti i-VKB imsekela ngemali yokukhulisa ama-maize. USamuel unabasebenzi ababili abaphephile futhi ubhaliswe kwi-UIF kanye ne-Workmen's Compensation. Ngaphezu kwalokho, unomeluleki ogama lakhe linguPiniki Hlaphu, omeluleka futhi omsize ngokuqinile. USamuel uyathembela kuMnu. Piniki futhi uthola inzuzo eminyakeni yakhe eminingi yokuhlangenwe nakho. Eminyakeni emibili edlule, ubevele ekhiqiza izivuno ezinhle eFree State-Bohlabela, kodwa akekho abalimi abaningi abangazigqaja ngokuthi bakhuphile ngaphezu kwamathani ayisithupha ngehektare eminyakeni emibili elandelanayo - lokho kuyimpumelelo umuntu angazigqaja ngayo! Inqubekela phambili yalo muntu ibonakala kahle - eminyakeni emithathu kuphela ushintshe waba ngumlimi ophumelelayo oqonda umhlaba nokulima okuzinzile futhi unomqondo obukhali wezokuhweba. UWilliam wazalwa endaweni yaseWinburg lapho afunda khona esikoleni samabanga aphansi epulazini futhi kamuva waya esikoleni samabanga aphezulu edolobheni laseWinburg. Ngemva kokuphothula isikole, waqala ukusebenza njengomsebenzi wezolimo e-Aventura Resort eAllemanskraal kuze kube ngu-2004. Njengomntwana, usiza uyise epulazini futhi waqala ukuthanda ukulima. Ugcine imali futhi ngosizo lwezikweletu azicelile kwiLand Bank, uWilliam waba nokuthenga ipulazi elibizwa ngokuthi uVerblyden, elitholakala eduze kweSenekal. UWilliam nomkakhe, uAlina, kanye nezingane zabo ezine bahlala kule pulazi. UWilliam ungum member weqembu labalimi laseSenekal futhi uthatha ingxenye ezinhlelweni ezahlukene zokuqeqeshwa ezithulwe yiGrain SA. Ube able ukukhokha le pulazi elingu-397 hectares ngokuphelele. Kulezi hectares, eziyi-253 ziwumhlaba ophumelelayo futhi uWilliam uqasha ama-hectares angu-380 lapho akhulisa khona izinkomo nezimvu. Uthemba ukuthi izindlela zokulima zizohlanganiswa ukuze kuncishiswe ubungozi. UWilliam ufake ama-hectares angu-84 e-maize ngesikhathi sika-2008, kodwa ngeshwa, kulonyaka ama-maize awaphumelelanga. Kulo nyaka unethemba njengoba isikhathi sezitshalo sikhona kahle futhi ama-maize nezitshalo ze-soybeans zakhe zikhula kahle. UWilliam uthi ufaka ama-maize ngoba kuyisithako esiyisisekelo kuzo zonke izinto - abantu, izinkomo, izimvu, nezilwane! UWilliam ube able ukuthola izeluleko zezezimali mayelana nokulima njengoba ipulazi lakhe likwi ndawo edinga izinsizakalo ezingcono kunezikhungo ezitholakalayo kumabhizinisi ezolimo. Uma ukhuluma noWilliam, uzokwazi ngokushesha ukuthi lo muntu unquma ukuphumelela. Akaphuthelwa ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obusha futhi uqale ukufaka ama-maize e-BT; ngaphezu kwalokho, usebenza kuphrojekthi yokwenza izinto zibe lula epulazini lakhe. Uphatha kahle futhi kubonakala ukuthi uWilliam uyazi kahle ukuthi kulima okuzinzile nokukhiqizayo kusho ukuthini. Uhlanganyela kahle nabanye abalimi abafana naye futhi uyabonga ochwepheshe bezamabhizinisi ezolimo abamsizile eminyakeni edlule epulazini lakhe. UPhilip ungumlimi ophumelelayo - wazalwa epulazini ngonyaka ka-1952 futhi okuhlangenwe nakho kwakhe kokuqala bekungokwezilwane nezitshalo. UPhilip waqala ukulima ngo-1973 njengomshayeli we-tractor futhi kamuva walima noSenwes iminyaka eyishumi. UPhilip washada noJulia futhi nakuba uJulia engumfundisi eKgotsong eduze kweBothaville, ubamba iqhaza elikhulu emisebenzini yokulima lapho esiza khona uPhilip kakhulu. UPhilip ungumnikazi wepulazi elibizwa ngokuthi uTweespruit elingamakhilomitha angama-5 ukusuka eKgotsong. Akahlali epulazini kodwa izilwane zakhe ziphathwa ngabasebenzi bakhe ababili abaphephile abahlala lapho. UPhilip uqede ibanga lesi-3 kuphela esikoleni, kodwa kubonakala kahle ukuthi lo muntu akavumi ukuncishiswa ukungabi neziqu eziphakeme - uyazi kahle ukuthi kulima kusho ukuthini futhi ulima ngempumelelo. Uthanda ama-tractors futhi ugcina zonke ama-tractors nemishini yakhe ngokuzikhandla. UPhilip ungum member weKgotsong agricultural group futhi uthatha ingxenye ezinhlelweni eziningi zokuqeqeshwa, njenge: Ukuqeqeshwa kokulima okuzinzile kanye ne-soybeans; Ukuphathwa kwe-tractor nemishini epulazini; Ukuqeqeshwa oku
Abakhiqizi abaningi bathole ukuthi izinkinga zenzeka lapho bezama ukuvula i-akhawunti yasebhange entsha. Lokhu kungenxa yomthetho ka-2001 owaziwa ngokuthi i-Financial Intelligence Centre Act of 2001 (FICA), odinga ukuthi amabhange nezinkampani ezithintekayo zithole ulwazi oluthile mayelana nesimo samakhasimende ukuze zikwazi ukuhlola kahle nokudlulisela ulwazi oluhlobene nezinkampani nezivumelwano ezingase zibe semthethweni noma inzuzo engase ivela kwi-ububi. Umhlaba kanye nokuphila kushintshile. Ukwanda kobugebengu nokukhwabanisa kube nomthelela omkhulu ekubambeni izwi eliningi ukuze kulwiswe leli banga. Ngenxa yalomthetho kanye nokubambisana kwamanye amazwe, iziphathimandla ziqinisa izinyathelo kubantu abenza ubugebengu lapho kubuhlungu kakhulu: emalini. Abantu abenza ubugebengu nabakhwabanisi badinga imali ukuze baphile. Baguqula imali "engcolile" etholelwe ngokwenza ubugebengu nokuhweba ngodlame, ukukhwabanisa, nokweba, bese "bahlanzisa" le mali besebenzisa i-ID yakho noma igama labantu abangenacala njenge wena. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlanza imali," okukhokhisa izigidigidi ezindleleni kumazwe emhlabeni wonke futhi kusiza ukukhula kobugebengu emhlabeni jikelele. Ngemizamo yokulwa nalolu hlobo lwezingozi, uhulumeni wethule umthetho obizwa ngokuthi i-Financial Intelligence Centre Act 38 ka-2001. Mayelana nalomthetho omusha, amabhange kumele enze izinyathelo eziqinile lapho evula ama-akhawunti amasha. Ukuze uhambisane nalomthetho, kumele unikeze ubufakazi obengeziwe ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungumuntu ophilayo. Lo mthetho uphinde ufunge ukuthi ibhange lithole ulwazi olusha njalo mayelana nesimo sakho. Lezi zinyathelo kufanele zisetshenziswe yizo zonke amabhange. Inombolo yakho ye-ID nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Incwadi yakho ye-ID eluhlaza enebhakhodi, noma, uma ilahlekile, idokhumenti ekhombisa ukuthi ufake isicelo se-ID entsha eMnyangweni Wezangaphakathi noma isitatimende se-affidavit noma isitatimende samaphoyisa siqinisekisa ukuthi i-ID ilahlekile. Ikhophi eqinisekisiwe ye-licence yakho yokushayela. Ukuze ibhange noma ibhizinisi elithintekayo liqinisekise indawo yokuhlala, kumele ubahlinzeke ngencwadi evunyelwe equkethe igama lakho kanye nekheli - lapho uhlala khona (izibalo ze-P.O. Box azamukelwa), noma inombolo yakho yomgwaqo kanye nedolobha okukhona.
Sithanda imali ukuze sihlangabezane nezidingo zezempilo nokuphepha. Izithombe: Isithombe 1. Yini ibhizinisi? Ibhizinisi liqala kanjani? Uma kuziwa ekuphatheni ibhizinisi, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le mibuzo ibaluleke kangakanani. Lo mbhalo uzokusiza uqonde ukuthi le mibuzo zikhuluma ngani. Kusukela ekuqaleni kokuphila kwabantu, umuntu uhlale enezidingo ezisiza ukuba aphile. Ukudla, indawo yokuhlala, nezimpahla zokugqoka zingezinye zalezi zidingo. Ekuqaleni, abantu bahlangabezana nalezi zidingo ngokuzingela, behlola ukudla ezitshalweni zasendle, nasekuhlaleni ezindlini. Njengoba abantu baqala ukuthuthuka, nezidingo zabo zathuthuka, ngakho ukukhiqiza, ukwakha, nokwenza izinto kwaba yinto ejwayelekile empilweni. Yini imali futhi ivela kuphi? Lapho kukhishwa noma yini, sisebenzisa imali. Imali iphepha nje; manje singacabanga futhi sibuze, "kungani ingxenye yephepha ingathenga into enenani?" Ekuqaleni, kwaba nokushintshisana (ukupha ingxenye yento ukuze uthole ezinye izinto ofuna zona uma inani lezo zinto lihambelana). Isibonelo: umuntu angase anikeze inkomo ukuze athole amabhakede amahlanu ommbila. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga ngoba uma unenkukhu kodwa ufuna ummbila, kufanele uthole umuntu onommbila ofuna inkomo. Mhlawumbe ungahamba emhlabeni wonke ngaphambi kokuthola umuntu onommbila ofuna inkomo? Lokhu kwakuyinselele enkulu. Abantu bakhumbula ukuthola into ezokwamukelwa ngabo bonke. Le nto kwakuyi-golide. Manje ungashintsha inkomo yakho ngama-30 grams egolide bese uthenga ummbila ngama-10 grams egolide. Nokho, abantu baqala ukwesaba ukuthi igolide labo lizotholwa. Baqala ukugcina igolide labo ezindaweni eziphephile (njengamabhange). Umphathi webhange uzokunikeza i-receipt ye-golide yakho ekhombisa ukuthi unegolide elingakanani. Lapho uveza le receipt, bazokunikeza igolide lakho. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, abantu baqeda ukuya ebhange uma befuna ukuthenga izinto; basebenzisa le receipt abathole kuyo ebhange. Umnikazi omusha wale receipt uzoya ebhange uma efuna igolide. Ngemuva kwalokho, abaqhubeki besebenzisa igolide nhlobo; bagcina besebenzisa le receipt kuphela ukuze bakhombise ukuthi banemali engakanani. Njengamanje, wonke umuntu usebenzisa lephepha. Abantu bathola kanjani imali? Umuntu angathola imali kuphela ngokusebenza ukuze athole umholo noma ukwenza inzuzo ebhizinisini eliphumelelayo. Emhlabeni omusha wanamuhla, amabhizinisi anika umuntu konke akudingayo. Umsebenzi owenziwayo nezimpahla ezithengiswayo zenza imali yamabhizinisi. Izibonelo zezimpahla ezikhiqizwayo zifaka: ukudla, izingubo, izimoto, ifenisha, nezindlu. Izibonelo zomsebenzi owenziwayo zifaka: umsebenzi wezempilo (odokotela nemithi), ukufundisa nokuqeqesha, kanye nomsebenzi wezokuxhumana. Lo mqondo mayelana nemali umuntu ayitholayo ubonisa ukuthi wonke umuntu udinga imali ukuze athole lezi zinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomuntu. Uma ibhizinisi likhiqiza izimpahla futhi lenza imisebenzi edingekayo, kukhona izindleko futhi kufanele kukhokhwe inani elilungile lemali. Izindleko eziguquguqukayo zisebenzisa izinto ezikhiqizwayo futhi zenzeka kuphela uma kukhona umkhiqizo. Ngakho-ke, kukhona ibhalansi phakathi kwenani lomkhiqizo nezindleko. Uma umbulali enza ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-10, izindleko eziguquguqukayo ezifana nemiholo, ukudla okugcwele, nezinye izindleko zokudla nezokuhamba zizoba phansi kunezindleko zomlimi owenza ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-50. Izibonelo zezindleko eziguquguqukayo zifaka: umanyolo, imbewu, ama-herbicides kanye ne-pesticides, umsebenzi wezinkontileka, imithi yezilwane, usawoti, ama-concentrates, i-diesel ne-petrol, abasebenzi besizini abawasebenzisayo, izinto zokupakisha ezimpahleni ezikhiqizwayo noma emikhiqizweni, nezindleko zokumaketha. Izindleko eziqinile yilezo ezingashintshi uma isu lokukhiqiza elithile limisiwe; azishintshi noma umkhiqizo omncane noma omkhulu ukhiqizwa. Esikhathini esifushane, izindleko eziqinile azishintshi. Lokhu kungashintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba isu lokukhiqiza lingashintsha. Uma umbulali enesicwangciso sokwenza ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-50 (isicwangciso sakhe sokukhiqiza), izindleko eziqinile ezifana nentela ye-capital ekhokhwayo kanye nokwehla kwezimpahla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi zihlala ziqinile, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umbulali ukhipha ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-10 noma eziyi-50. Nokho, uma umbulali eshintsha isu lokukhiqiza ukuze akhiphe ubisi ezinkomeni eziyi-80, izindleko eziqinile nazo zizoshintsha ngoba isu lokukhiqiza lishintshile. Izibonelo zezindleko eziqinile zifaka: ukwehla kwezimpahla (hhayi imali), izintela, umshwalense, irenti, nemiholo yabasebenzi abaqashwe ngokuqinile. Izindleko ziqinile kuphela uma zikhokhwa. Ngaphambi kokuthenga ithrekhtha, zonke izindleko ezihlobene ne-trekhtha zinguquguqukayo. Uma umbulali esethenge into efana nethrekhtha, izindleko zokwehla kwaleyo mshini, izintela, amalayisense, nomshwalense ziba ziqinile. Lezi zindleko azishintshi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umbulali ukhiqiza okuningi noma okuncane esikhathini esifushane. Izindleko zokwehla kwezimpahla. Lokhu kuyindleko engahambisani nemali, ehambisana nokwehla kwezimpahla ngoba zisetshenziswa futhi ziyaqhamuka. Izintshisakalo zikhona uma usebenzisa imali ebolekiwe noma imali ebolekiwe kwabanye. Izindleko eziphelele yilezi zindleko ezihlanganisa izindleko eziqinile nezindleko eziguquguqukayo, njengoba kukhonjisiwe esithombeni 1. Inzuzo ingalinganiswa ngenani eliphelele (imali) elidlula izindleko eziphelele - uma izindleko zidlula inzuzo, kwenzeka ukulahlekelwa. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uma ibhizinisi likhiqiza inzuzo, bonke abasebenzi nomnikazi bathola imali ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zabo. Ngakho-ke, inzuzo kufanele iqhubeke ibe khona esikhathini esizayo (esikhathini eside), ngaleyo ndlela ibonisa ukubaluleka kokulima ngendlela ebonisa ikusasa. Uma ibhizinisi lilahlekelwa, uhlelo lwalo lungashintsha. Abasebenzi bazothola imiholo yabo, kodwa umnikazi angase angabi nengeniso futhi uzodinga ukwenza izinguquko ukuze anciphise ukulahlekelwa. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukususa abanye abasebenzi (ukunciphisa). Ngemuva kwesikhathi, engeniso nezinga lezindleko emabhizinisini ezolimo zikhula ngenxa yokwanda kwenani lezimpahla ezithengiswayo (ukwenyuka kwentengo yemakethe) nezindleko ezikhulayo (ukwenyuka kwentengo). Nokho, ibhalansi yale nyuka ayifani, njengoba umkhawulo phakathi kwayo wehla. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela inzuzo. Abalimi baphushwa ukuthi bamukele intengo yemakethe esethwe; abakwazi ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yabo ngentengo ephezulu eyabelwe bona. Ingeniso ingakhuphuka ngokukhiqiza okuningi
Ubusuku buyafika emva kwesizini esomileyo esandulelayo nesizini yemvula. Njengoba isimo sezulu sihle kule nkathi, izindawo zokufuywa zihlala zikhona kahle, kodwa lokhu kusho nokuthi utshani obumile nezinkambu zingaba yingozi enkulu yomlilo kulo nyaka. Umlilo owodwa ungabhubhisa futhi ubulale izinkulungwane zamahhektare omhlaba ezindaweni zokufuya. Imililo ezinkambeni ivame ukwenzeka ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuvuna ngoba ngaleso sikhathi izitshalo zomile futhi izinkambu zihlanzekile. Izingane akufanele zidlale nomlilo. Ungaphoseli umnqamulajuqu ongenalutho noma isiqholo emalini eyomile, noma ezithelweni ezomile noma ezihlahleni. Ungaqali umlilo ongawulawuli ngaphandle ezinkambeni noma uma kunomoya onamandla. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imililo oyivulile iphelile ngokuphelele uma usuqedile. Uma ubona umlilo ezinkambeni noma ezitshalo, shesha wazise ozakwenu nomphathiswa wezomlilo kule ndawo. Batshele kahle ukuthi umlilo uphi. Shiya abanye abantu ekhaya ukuze banikeze ulwazi ngommilo kwabanye. Uma uneradiyo noma ifoni, ungayisebenzisa ukuze abanye bakwazi ukukuthinta uma kwenzeka kukhona olunye ulwazi ngommilo. Uma ungumnikazi wefamu, kufanele wazise umnikazi ngokushesha ngendawo yomlilo. Susa zonke izilwane nezinsiza endaweni ephephile. Izinto zokucisha umlilo - amanzi noma isand. Dala izithiyo zomlilo usebenzisa ama-rubber bands endala noma amabhakede amanzi. Uma udala izithiyo zomlilo ngeziqeshana noma amabhakede, ususa umoya (okhanyayo) odingekayo ukuze umlilo uphume. Ngaphandle kokhanyayo, umlilo uzokhanya kancane kancane kuze kufe. Sebenzisa amapompo aqinile ezansi ukuze umise utshani ezindaweni ez sides nasephakathini komlilo. La mapompo angasetshenziswa futhi uma ucabanga ukuthi umlilo usuphume kuzo zonke izindawo ngemva kokuzama ukucisha umlilo okukhulu. Sebenzisa izikhwama zamanzi namapompo ukuze unikeze amanzi anele. Izithiyo zomlilo nezithiyo zingasetshenziswa ukudala isithiyo somlilo utshani ukuze kuvinjelwe umlilo ukuthi ungadluli kwezinye izindawo. Ungakha nomlilo omusha oqala kulolu sithiyo somlilo lapho umoya uvuma khona. Isimo somlilo siwumkhakha ofana nomgwaqo lapho kungekho utshani ongabamba umlilo. Sebenzisa izithiyo zomlilo nezithiyo ukuze ucishe umlilo ngesand nesihlabathi. Futhi sebenzisa lezi zinto ukususa utshani obomile obungabamba umlilo kalula. Sebenzisa amathuluzi angathwalwa ngesandla ukusika utshani obomile ngaphambi kokufika komlilo. Ngena emlilweni ezindaweni ez sides noma ezimaphakathi lapho umlilo uphume ukuze unciphise ukuhamba komlilo. Uma kukhona isithiyo somlilo noma isithiyo semvelo efana nomfula, zama ukuphonsa umlilo kuleyo zindawo. Beka abantu ezindaweni lapho bengakwazi khona ukulwa nomlilo lapho umlilo ungase uqale khona. Umoya ungathwala imicibisholo yomlilo ibanga elingafika kumakilomitha amabili. Kubalulekile ukudala izithiyo zomlilo ezizobuyisela utshani obushisayo ngaphakathi komlilo ukuze imicibisholo ingaflanga utshani obomile lapho umlilo ungavutha khona. Hlola njalo indlela yomoya - ivela kuphi, iya kuphi? Qinisekisa ukuthi akukho bantu abalimele. Hamba kuwo wonke amakhaya lapho umlilo ubhujiswe khona isikhathi esingama-3 ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi akukho zindawo lapho umlilo uqale khona kabusha. Buyisela zonke izinsiza endaweni yazo. Phinda ugcwalise izikhwama zamanzi. Lungisa izinsiza eziphukile noma ezonakele. Bonke abanikazi bomhlaba noma abalimi lapho umlilo ungase uqale khona ongabamba leyo fomu noma udlule kwezinye izifundazwe kufanele bakhe isithiyo somlilo emingceleni ye-famu yabo nezinye izifundazwe. Kungumthwalo wakho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umlilo awuqali efamu yakho. Ukwakha izithiyo zomlilo efamu yakho kungasiza ekuvikeleni ngoba kungakuvikela wena nefamu yakho (ifamu, izakhiwo, izitshalo, izilwane) ezinsongweni. Ozakwenu bangavuma ukwakha nokugcina izithiyo zomlilo emingceleni ye-famu zabo. Akufanele sibe nezinto ezingabamba umlilo kalula futhi zidlule emkhakheni. Thola izindlela zokufinyelela nokufinyelela emlilweni.
Uhlaka: Kuthathwe ku-www.health24. Ukudla ukudla okungcolile nokuphuza amanzi angcolile kungadala izifo eziningi ezithathelwana. Izifo eziningi zingavela uma udla ukudla okungcolile. Isifo esithathelwana ukudla sichazwa ngokukhathala, ukuhamba, ukuhamba okungajwayelekile, kanye nobuhlungu besisu. Amabhaktheriya avame ukudala lesi sifo, kulandelwa amagciwane nezilokazane. Uma ubheka ukudla noma amanzi, akuvamile ukuba kube sobala ukuthi kunezinto ezingadala isifo. Landela umyalezo olandelayo ukusiza ukugwema ukudla ukudla okungcolile noma amanzi. Ngemva kokuphatha inyama eluhlaza noma inhlanzi, geza izandla noma izilonda zakho uma usebenza nokudla. Qinisekisa ukuthi ikhitshi lihlanzekile. Phosa amanzi okuphuza kuqala uma ucabanga ukuthi angcolile. Amanzi aphuma emgqonyeni avamise ukuba acwebile, kodwa amanye avela emifuleni noma emithonjeni angase abe nendle. Amanzi okuphuza ahlanzekile kufanele agcinwe ebhodweni elihlanzekile; uma unendawo yokupholisa, koyise lapho. Qinisekisa ukuthi amanzi asetshenziselwa ukwenza iziphuzo noma iqhwa ahlanzekile. Khumbula ukuthi ungawathathi amanzi angcolile ngesikhathi sokubhukuda noma sokugeza. Hlanza izindawo ezinjengamathafeni nezinsika ngaphambi nangemva kokusebenza nokudla. Hlanza izindawo lapho ukudla kubekwe khona (njengama-shelves namafriji). Hlanza iziphuzo ngokushesha. Sebenzisa ama-cloth ahlukene ekhitshini nakwezinye izindawo zekhaya. Sebenzisa ama-disinfectants (i-bleach) ukugeza ama-cloth, ama-sponge, nama-dishcloth bese uwabeka ngaphandle ukuze omiswe elangeni - lokhu kusiza ukubulala amagciwane. Uma unomikrowave, shisa ama-cloth imizuzwana engama-60. Hlanza phansi kwekhitshi ngama-cloth asetshenziselwa le njongo kuphela. Geza izitsha, ama-knife, ama-fork, kanye nama-cutting boards kahle emanzini ashisayo anensipho - geza ngamanzi amasha uma enezinkinga ezinkulu. Geza izitsha ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Thenga izinto ezintsha uma ezindala zikhubazekile kakhulu. Amagciwane aphila phakathi kwezikhala zezinto zokudlela, izinto ze-plastiki, kanye nama-cutting boards. Sebenzisa i-cutting board eyodwa yokudla okungcolile. Kungaba kuhle ukusebenzisa i-board eyodwa yokusika inyama nenhlanzi kanti enye yokusika ezinye izidlo. Ungaphindi usebenzise izinto zokudlela ezisikiwe inyama ngaphandle kokuzigeza ngemva kokusetshenziswa. Beka udoti ebhodweni elivulekile - phuma udoti njalo futhi ugeza ibhodwe. Umnyango wekhitshi nezinsika kufanele kuvulwe kaningi ukuze kuvumele umoya ohlanzekile, omile ungene ukuze kuvinjezelwe ukwakheka kwe-mold.
Izinsiza eziningi zisebenzisa ama-gear. Isibonelo esihle ngu-bhayisikili enama-gear okwenza kube lula ukuhamba, ikakhulukazi uma uhamba phezulu. Ngokuvamile, ibhayisikili inama-gear amakhulu lapho kukhona i-pedal, futhi kunezinga elihlukahlukene lama-gear emuva. Uma i-gear yangaphambili iphumelelwe, i-chains idonsa ama-gear emuva e-wheela, futhi ibhayisikili ihamba phambili. Bheka usayizi we-gear lapho i-pedal isetshenziswa futhi uqhathanise nosayizi lama-gear emuva. Yini oyibonayo? Abantu abaningi bahamba ngamabhayisikili uma kukhona ukuphakama. Uma ukuphakama kuphakamisa, ukuhamba kwe-pedal kuba nzima - ngokuvamile, umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili uzoshintsha ama-gear. Uma umgibeli eshintsha ama-gear, i-chain ihamba ivela ku-gear encane iye ku-gear enkulu enezinyo eziningi, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba. Uma kunezinyo eziningi ku-gear, kube lula ukuhamba, kodwa ibhayisikili ayihambi ngokushesha. Sifuna ukubuza lokhu: kwenzekani uma umgibeli ehamba phezulu futhi eshintsha ku-gear enkulu iye ku-gear encane? Kuzoba nzima noma kube lula ukuhamba ibhayisikili? Isizathu sokuthi kube lula ukukhuphuka intaba ukuthi ama-gear ashintshwa - ubudlelwano be-gear buyashintsha. Ubudlelwano be-gear bungatholakala ngokubala inani lezinyo ku-gear ethile - isakhiwo se-chain asibaliwe. Ngezansi, kuzachazwa ngesiNgisi ukuthi lelo nani lingatholakala kanjani. Uma i-gear enikeza amandla (i-pedal) ijika kanye, zingaki izikhathi i-sprocket gear izojika? Isibonelo esedlule sikhombisa ukuthi njalo uma i-pedal gear ijika kanye, i-sprocket gear emuva ijika kabili - lokhu kwenza kube lula ukukhuphuka intaba. Uma i-pedal gear ijika kanye, zingaki izikhathi i-sprocket izojika? Uma i-pedal gear ijika kanye, zingaki izikhathi i-sprocket izojika? Yini umphumela obudlelwano be-gear onokushesha kwemishini? Ubudlelwano be-gear busitshela ukuthi kanjani isivinini se-gear eyodwa siqhathaniswa nesivinini se-gear enye. Uma i-gear yethu yamandla (enama-10 teeth) ijika ngama-5 rpm, futhi ixhunywe ku-gear yamandla (enama-50 teeth), i-gear yamandla izojika ngama-1 rpm. Uma i-gear yethu encane ijika 1x, i-gear yethu enkulu ijika 1/5. Kuthatha ama-5 ajika e-gear encane ukuze kufane ne-1 ajika ye-gear yethu enkulu. Ngakho-ke, i-gear yethu enkulu ihamba ngesivinini se-1/5 sesivinini esilinganayo no-1 rpm. Kuzokwenzekani uma ubudlelwano bethu be-gear bungu-1:3? Lapha, usayizi we-gear yamandla ungama-3x mkhulu kunosayizi we-gear yamandla. Uma i-gear yamandla ijika ngama-20 rpm, i-1 ijika izokwenza i-gear yamandla ijike kathathu (3x). Amandla anikeziwe angama-60 rpm. Amandla okuhamba yile gear noma i-sprocket enezinhloso ezithile. Njengesibonelo se-bhayisikili, umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili uphakamisa i-pedal. I-sprocket enkulu lapho ama-pedals axhunywe khona iyisikhumbuzo, kuyilapho i-sprocket encane emuva ibizwa ngokuthi iyashintshwa. Akukhona njalo ukuthi i-gear enkulu ihambisa i-gear encane - usayizi awubalulekile. Okubalulekile lokhu: iyiphi ethola amandla kuqala? Uma sibheka ukuhlelwa kwama-gear lapho kuxhunywe khona nge-chain, kubalulekile ukuhlela usayizi walawa ma-gear. Ama-gear azokhombisa ukuthi mangaki ama-axle abhalwe kuwo ajika. Isivinini salo axle sizokhombisa ukuthi mangaki ama-seed-producing mechanism ahamba, okuphinde kushintshe inani leziqhamuka ezitshalwa. Uma i-axle ihamba ngokushesha, ama-seed amaningi azotshalwa. Uma ulinganisa umtshali bese uthola ukuthi ama-seed amaningi atshalwa, uzokwazi ukuthi i-axle ehambisa umshini wokutshala izitshalo ihamba ngokushesha kakhulu futhi isivinini salo axle kufanele sincishiswe. Enye indlela yokulungisa lokhu ukushintsha usayizi wama-gear noma ama-sprockets ahambisa le axle.
Sikhumbulile ukuthi ibhola lizongena kanjani enethini? Kunemali eningi ekhokhwa yiMnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe, iMnyango Wezolimo, ama-trusts ahlukene ezitshalo, amabhizinisi ezolimo, izinkampani ezithengisa izinto zokwakha, kanye nezinhlangano ezahlukene ezizama ukuthuthukisa ezolimo eNingizimu Afrika. Kodwa singabuza futhi: yisiphi isiphumo? Ukuthuthukisa nokukhulisa abalimi kuhambisana nokuthuthukisa abantu emhlabeni. Abantu, ikakhulukazi labo abafanele, kumele baphumelele, bakhule, bafunde, futhi bathole ulwazi. Lapho sibheka ukuthuthukisa abalimi, asibheki kuphela ukuthi ubani okhiqiza ukudla okuningi kunezinye; sigxila ekusizeni abanye abalimi ukuba bathole ulwazi oluzobasiza ukuba baqhubeke nokulima ngendlela esekela ukuphila kwabo futhi kulethe inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Uma sifuna ukwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu, kubalulekile ukubheka umuntu oyedwa ozama. Futhi kumele sibheke labo abasemaphandleni, umphakathi, futhi siqonde ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza zemvelo ezizobasiza - kumele sithuthukise lokhu. Kulula nje ukungena endaweni ethile bese ukhombisa izinto ezingadingekile, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi uzobasiza ukwenza konke abakuthandayo. Kuzokwenzeka ukuthini uma ungaphumeleli ukubasiza? Kumele sithathe izandla zabantu lapho bekhona manje futhi sibakhombise indlela phambili ngokucophelela, kancane, ukuze bajwayele ukuthi imithetho nokuphila kuyashintsha. Kumele sibathumele endaweni abazophila khona ngokuthula, endaweni abakhululekile kuyo (hhayi lapho sithanda khona ukuthi bame)? Inhloso yabantu abaningi ivame ukuba: "okuningi kungcono." Iqiniso, nokho, ukuthi umuntu othile kumele aqale endaweni ethile, noma ngabe kuwumsebenzi omncane. Kunabalimi abaningi abaqonda kuphela ezolimo njengendlela yokuphila - abanandaba nokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi ukuze kuthengiswe - futhi lokhu kulungile. Bese kuba nabanye abalimi abakhuluma kahle futhi bafisa ukuba abalimi abakhulu esikhathini esizayo. Bese kuba abalimi abakhulu abaqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele (kodwa nabo baqala ezingeni eliphansi futhi baqhubeka nokukhula). Uma imizamo yethu yokuthuthukisa abantu izoba namandla futhi ibe nezinzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kumele sithole labo bantu ezindaweni abakhona futhi siqale lapho - akukhathazi kakhulu (anginankathazo ngalokhu) ukubona abaqashi abakhulu abangena emhlabeni kodwa balima, babheke izitshalo, baphumelele, futhi baphinde baphawule ukuthi benza umsebenzi "wokuthuthukiswa kwabalamli" - cha! Lokhu akukhulisi; bangangena kuphela kulezo zindawo. Eqinisweni, abalimi bangase bahlale kulezo zindawo ngoba izindleko zamanje ziphezulu - bese abaqashi bethatha ingxenye yenhlalakahle (badla kabili kanti umalimi udla lutho). Ake sibuyisele ezibalulekile futhi siqonde ukuthi singawathuthukisa kanjani abantu. Uma izinkundla zakho zilimwa umqashi omkhulu, cabanga kahle ukuthi ufuna ukufika kuphi ekugcineni - ufuna ukuba umalimi noma ufuna ukuba umqashi wezolimo?
Abalimi abayisithupha baphakanyisiwe emncintiswaneni okhetha umlimi ophambili obizwa: Umlandeli Wokukhula Kwezimboni Zokudla Konyaka (2008). Umlandeli okhethiwe uzomenyezelwa ngo-Okthoba 17 emcimbini omuhle owenziwa yiGrain SA. U-Deliwe wazalwa ngo-1961 eKrugersdorp Kagiso, wayengumntwana kaMnz noNkz Ntebele ababevele kuqala. Ubaba wakhe wayengumlimi, kanti unina wayengumama ophumula emakhaya. U-Deliwe ushade noMnz Olebogeng Mutlwane futhi banezingane ezimbili. U-Deliwe uthola amandla nokwesekwa kubazali bakhe nenkosana yakhe. U-Deliwe wafunda e-Aobakwe Primary Itsoseng eNyakatho Nentshonalanga futhi waqeda iNdebe yeziNhlanu e-Reeitumetse Secondary. Waqhubeka nezifundo zakhe futhi wafundiswa ukuba uthisha e-Bethel Seminar futhi wafunda i-N6 ekwakheni (ukwakha izindlu). Ngemuva kwalokhu, wasebenza eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya. Ngo-1991, u-Deliwe washiywa emsebenzini wakhe futhi waqala ukulima kancane kancane waze waba umlimi ophakathi nendawo ngo-2002. Uthenga ifamu eMarotse (eduze kweDelareyville) futhi ulima nabazali bakhe. Ungum member weFrischgewaagd farmers' study group endaweni yeDelareyville; ubefunde izifundo ezimfishane (futhi usaqhubeka nokufunda) ezifana: Ukuphatha Nokugcina AmaTractor Nezinsiza Zokulima, Ukwethulwa Kwezokukhiqiza Uthuli, Izifundo Ezithuthukile Kwezokukhiqiza Uthuli Nokumaketha, Ukuphathwa Kwezimboni Zokulima Nokuphathwa Kwephrojekthi; lezi zifundo zixhaswa yiGrain SA, NWK, Promise Farmer, kanye neBusiness Today. U-Deliwe usemsebenzini wokulima okuzimele iminyaka emine - ukhiqiza uthuli nezinkukhu futhi uphila izinkomo, izimvu, izinkukhu, nezimbuzi. U-Isaac Khuto wazalwa ngo-1944 eBoksburg lapho ubaba wakhe ayengumsebenzi wesitolo. Ngesikhathi enezinyanga ezimbili, abazali bakhe bamthumela eFicksburg ukuba ahlale nonkosikazi wakhe nomalume wakhe futhi wakhula efameni. Ngisho namuhla remembers lapho enezinyanga eziyisixhenxe esebenza izimvu, futhi remembers iphunga elimnandi elivela ezindaweni ekuseni kanye nezulu elclear elamvumela ukuba abone izintaba zeLesotho kahle. Bavame ukubuka amaTractor elima ezindaweni zeLesotho futhi wacabanga ukuthi kuzoba kanjani ukushayela lelo tractor. U-Isaac waya esikoleni efameni futhi wabe eseya eSekondari eFicksburg lapho aqeda khona iNdebe yesi-8. Ngemuva kwalokhu, wasebenza eFraser eFicksburg iminyaka eyishumi nambili. Waziswa ngokuthenga nokuthengisa futhi waqala ukusebenza ngokwakhe ngokuthenga nokuthengisa imifino nezithelo. Njengoba ibhizinisi lakhe likhula, wathola nokuqonda kokuthenga itekisi - waqhubeka nokukhulisa leli bhizinisi kusukela ngo-1978 kuya ku-1998. Ngo-1983, u-Isaac wabona ithuba lokungena ebhizinisini lezokuvakasha wathenga ihhotela/ikhaya labavakashi. Usanalo lelo hhotela futhi unelayisense yokuthengisa utshwala. U-Isaac uthi, "emkhakheni wokubhokisa, ungowakho kuphela nesiphiwo sakho sokulwa," - wafunda ukunakekela yena khona. "Lapho kungekho ndawo yokuphunyuka, lapho ufunda khona ukubhekana nokuphila ngqo futhi uqhubeke wedwa." U-Isaac usaqeqesha iklabhu yokubhokisa eFicksburg futhi wayengumholi weFree State Boxing Federation. Ungumholi weGrain SA farmers' study group eFicksburg. Wayefuna ukuthenga ifamu yonke enezinkulungwane eziyi-460 kodwa wayesaba ukuthatha umthwalo omkhulu kangaka - ngakho bahlukanisa ifamu wathenga ingxenye. Ngeminyaka engu-2006 wayekwazi ukuqasha izinkulungwane eziyi-65 zomhlaba omuhle eduze. Ngo-2007/2008, u-Isaac wathola isivuno esijwayelekile se-3.5 tons/ha yothuli ezinkulungwaneni eziyi-79 kodwa wabhekana nesiphepho seqhwa kumathuli akhe, isivuno ezindaweni sisasebenza kahle. Babekhona izingane eziyisishiyagalombili - abafana ababili nezingane zesifazane eziyisithupha. U-Mapahle waya esikoleni eMashaeng Township ngaphandle kweFouriesburg, eqeda iNdebe yeziNhlanu. Ngamasonto, uvame ukuya efameni eduze kaMnz Linde du Plessis, lapho ashaya khona iTractor futhi asiza emsebenzini wefamu. U-Mapahle wasebenza eMnyangweni Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi eFouriesburg Border Post kusukela ngo-1993 - 2007. Ngo-1996 waqala ukukhulisa izinkomo nezimvu emhlabeni owawusetshenziswa umphakathi wonke eFouriesburg. Ngo-2004 waqasha izinkulungwane eziyi-30 zomhlaba kumlimi wezomnotho uMnz Osborne, efaka uthuli. Ngo-2006 waqasha izinkulungwane eziyi-4,179 zomhlaba kumasipala waseFouriesburg - usaqhubeka nokulima lapho okwamanje. U-Mapahle uthi, "Mhlawumbe ngizokwazi ukuqasha izinkundla ezinhle ezinezivuno ezingu-400 hectares kule nyanga, kodwa ngifuna iGrain SA ukuthi ifike kuqala ukuhlola umhlaba." U-Mapahle ushade noDianne futhi bahlala eMashaeng nezingane zabo ezintathu. U-Boy wazalwa efameni endaweni yeMiddelburg ngo-1948 lapho ubaba wakhe ayesebenza khona. Wayeya esikoleni efameni kule ndawo futhi waqeda iNdebe yesi-5. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubaba wakhe wayelima kancane emhlabeni owawusetshenziswa umphakathi wonke endaweni yeVlaklaagte. U-Boy uthi usakhumbula kahle ukuthi wayelima nobaba wakhe esebenzisa izinkomo ukuze aphume. Ngo-1981, u-Boy waqala ukulima izinkundla ezinqashwe kuhulumeni ezingu-10 hectares. Ngemuva kwalokhu, wanikezwa indawo engu-50 hectares endaweni yeVaalspruit (eduze kweBronkhorstspruit).
