Izithombe ozibona lapha zikhombisa okungase kwenzeke uma umlimi engakuvuni ngesikhathi. Lezi zithombe zithathwe ngoFebhuwari kulo nyaka eMpumalanga Kapa - umkhiqizo awuvunwanga, futhi ekugcineni izinkambu zashiswa! Kuyiphithizela ukubona umsebenzi owenziwe unyaka wonke ungakhiphi umkhiqizo - kumele sivimbe lokhu ukuba kwenzeke futhi. Kuyinkinga, kodwa kuyiqiniso ukuthi imikhiqizo ingavunwa kuphela ngemishini ukuze kutholakale umkhiqizo omuhle, futhi imishini yokuvuna ihamba ngokushesha, okwenza ukuvuna kube lula. Ibhande lempahla libalulekile uma uthengisa ngoba imikhiqizo ingalahlekelwa ibhande layo ngokushesha futhi kalula uma ingavunwanga ngesikhathi. Uma imikhiqizo isivuthiwe, kumele ivunwe ngokushesha ngoba noma imvula encane inganciphisa ibhande, futhi inzuzo ingase ingatholakali. Abalimi abasha abanokulima izindawo ezincane bethemba kubaphakeli abanemishini yokuvuna. Bavame ukungena ezivumelwaneni nabalimi ekuqaleni konyaka wokutshala. Bafuna ukungena ezivumelwaneni eziningi ukuze bakwazi ukuvuna amahektare amaningi ukuze bathole imali eningi. Abakwazi ukukhipha ukubikezela ukuthi kuzoshaya imvula nini noma ukuthi izimo zizovela ezizobangela ukuthi balahlekelwe isikhathi sokuvuna. Bathanda ukuvuna ezinkambini ezinkulu ngaphandle kwabaphakeli ngoba imishini yabo ingavuna amahektare amaningi ngosuku olulodwa ngaphandle kokudinga ukujika kaningi. Abafuni ukulinda amatekisi ukuze athwale imikhiqizo evunyiwe. Bakhokhelwa ngokuya ngamahektare abavunile, hhayi ngokuya ngebhande umlimi ozokwamukela. Bahlala bephakathi kwengozi yokuphuka kwemishini yabo - okuchitha isikhathi sabo sokusebenza - abazi ukuthi imishini izophuka nini. Konke lokhu kukhombisa isithombe esinzima, kodwa kumele sazi ukuthi kukhona izinkinga ezizovela, futhi kufanele sibheke phambili ezindleleni zokuzinqoba ngempumelelo. Kumele bazilungiselele ngokungena ezivumelwaneni nabaphakeli kusenesikhathi ngenkathi kusasele isikhathi. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi umphakeli akathathi umsebenzi ongaphezu kwamandla akhe. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi awekho amahlanga amaningi enkambini yabo angalimaza imishini yokuvuna. Kumele balungiselele amatekisi anele ukuze athwale umkhiqizo ukuze umsebenzi ungabambezeli isikhathi eside. Kumele balungiselele indawo lapho imikhiqizo izogcinwa uma bengakwazi ukufika ezilondolozweni ngesikhathi ngemuva kokushiya inkambu. Kumele bahlangane nabaphathi bezilondolozo ukuvumelana ngesikhathi imikhiqizo kufanele igcinwe uma kudingeka. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezithokozisa inhliziyo ngesikhathi sokuvuna - umsebenzi wokukhiqiza walo nyaka uphelile, futhi sesicabanga ngonyaka ozayo. Abalimi abakhiqiza imikhiqizo eFree State, konke okuhlobene nokugcina umswakama womhlabathi, kubalulekile uma ufuna ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo ehlobo. Ukubaluleka kokugcina umswakama womhlabathi kuyinto esizokhuluma ngayo njalo. Lo msebenzi kufanele uqale ngokushesha ngemva kokuvuna. Okwesibili ukuvuka kwamanzi emhlabathini nokuphuma komoya - lokhu kwenzeka uma umhlabathi uba hard futhi umanzi. Kumele uphathe izinkambu zakho kusukela ngesikhathi uphothula ukuvuna kuze kube ngesikhathi sokutshala kabusha izimpande ezintsha. Ukuvuna okuhle kusezandleni zakho kuphela!
Ukuthola: Ukuthuthukisa umhlabathi wakho ngamasimu okumboza kungaba yinto enkulu! Lapho sibheka izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuvuthwa komhlabathi eNingizimu Afrika kuye kwehla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi inani lezitshalo ezingakhula ezindaweni ezithola imvula liyasinciphisa, kunezizathu eziningi zokucabangela ukutshala isimu yokumboza, ikakhulukazi uma imvula ingaqinisekile futhi izindleko ezikhulayo zivame ukuvimbela abalimi ekutshaleni ufulawa. Ngokuvamile, amasimu okumboza atshalwa uma kushintshwa izinhlobo zezithelo, kodwa okwamanje, abalimi bakhetha ukusebenzisa amafutha nezinto zokwenziwa. Kucace bha ukuthi abakhiqizi abaningi manje sebethutheleka ekushintsheni izinhlobo zezithelo ukuze bagcine imvelo ngoba kuzosisiza esikhathini eside. Izimo zomhlabathi zingathuthuka uma isitshalo singaqala izimpande emhlabathini, kuvumela umhlabathi ukuthi uvuleke futhi wamukele umswakama. Uma insimu ishiywe ingatshalwanga isikhathi eside, umhlabathi ophakeme uba mncane, futhi amanzi awakwazi ukungena, kuholela ekulahlekelweni. Amasimu okumboza avikela umhlabathi emandleni elanga njengokhakhayi, avimbele ukuhlanganiswa komhlabathi, futhi asekele ezinye izinhlobo zokuphila ezifana nezintwala zomhlabathi ezisiza ukuhluza izinto eziphilayo zibe ukudla kwezithelo zesikhathi esizayo. Amasimu okumboza asiza ukuhlanganisa umhlabathi, ehla kakhulu ukulahleka komhlabathi ngenxa yokuphahlazeka ngamanzi noma umoya. Amasimu amaningi okumboza aphinde anikeze izinto eziphilayo emhlabathini - asebenza njengomanyolo ophilayo. Uma utshala ngezinto ezanele eziphilayo ngesikhathi esifanele, kungashiya inani elikhulu le-nitrogen emhlabathini ngoba kungase kube nezimo zokushoda kwemvula, futhi ungase ungatholi umkhiqizo omuhle; lezi zinto emhlabathini zingasetshenziswa nakusasa ngokutshala amasimu okumboza azosiza ngoba uzoba nohlelo olunokudla okuningi ukusekela isitshalo esifana nezitshalo ezitholakalayo, njengoba kuzoba ne-potassium ne-phosphorus eyanele. Inkinga evamile ekulimaleni yile: ukushoda kwezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini, ikakhulukazi i-nitrogen ne-phosphorus. Lokhu kungalungiswa kalula ngomyalo ofanele, kodwa kaningi umalimi endaweni encane akakwazi ukukhokhela lowo manyolo, futhi ukushintsha izinhlobo zezithelo ezitshalwayo nezinye amasimu okumboza kuzogcina ukuvuthwa komhlabathi futhi kube nezindleko ezincane. Sonke sivuma ukuthi ukutshala amaqanda ezinkomo ngokuhamba kwezimali nofulawa ehlobo kuzokwandisa imikhiqizo, kuthuthukise ukuvuthwa komhlabathi, futhi kwehlise izindleko zomanyolo. Ukukhula okuqinile kwamasi okumboza afana namaqanda ezinkomo noma i-teff kuvikela emandleni elanga futhi kuvimbele ukukhula kwezinhlamvu eziningi. Ngezinye izikhathi uma izitshalo ezifana namaqanda ezinkomo (akkersbonen) ne-teff (eragrostis tef) zitshalwa, lezi zitshalo zisiza isimo somhlabathi uma ezinye izitshalo zingase zikhule ngokushesha, kodwa zisiza umalimi ngokuhlinzeka ukudla kwezilwane zakhe ngesikhathi sokoma. Ngokuvamile, izitshalo eziningi zikhokha izindleko zokuhamba ukuze zidluliselwe lapho zikhuliswa khona ziye lapho zithengiswa khona, kodwa amasimu okumboza awakhokhi lezo zindleko ngoba asetshenziswa lapho atshalwe khona. Uhlobo lwamasimu okumboza kumele lukhethwe ngokususelwa endleleni umalimi athuthukisa ngayo. Yini okufanele yenziwe ngalowo mkhiqizo? Yiziphi izitshalo ezivame ukukhula kahle endaweni engithuthukisa kuyo? Yisiphi isitsha esidingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe umhlabathi kule nsimu? Khumbula ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo (izitshalo ezitholakalayo) zandisa umthamo we-nitrogen emhlabathini ngoba ziqinisa lokhu kusuka emoyeni, kodwa izitshalo ezingezona ezitholakalayo zizosebenzisa i-nitrogen esivele ikhona emhlabathini? Izitshalo ezitholakalayo zifana nezimbuzi, ama-soybeans, ama-lentils, ama-peas, njll. Izitshalo ezingezona ezitholakalayo zifana ne-teff, utshani, i-millet, amahlamvu, kanye ne-radishes. Amaqanda ezinkomo atshalwa ehlobo futhi aqinile ngokwanele ukuvikela ukoma nokushisa. Ayiminyaka futhi angakhula afinyelele ku-80 cm, anezimpande ezijulile. Asiza isimo somhlabathi ngoba angatshalwa emhlabathini anokushoda kwe-nitrogen futhi akhule kahle emhlabathini angatshalwanga nasemhlabathini esandleni. Awadingi umanyolo omningi, kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi akhiqiza ukudla okuhle okungadliwa abantu nezilwane ngoba amahlamvu, imbewu, nezikhumba zinohlanga oluningi. Le pea ingaphinde yome futhi igcinwe isikhathi eside. Le plant ikha umboza omuhle uma itshalwe, ikhula ngokushesha, ithatha cishe amasonto 8 - 12 ukuze iphume, kodwa iyiminyaka. Ikhula kahle ehlobo futhi ithanda umhlabathi omanzi. I-teff ithuthukisa umhlabathi kahle, futhi uma ikhula kahle, izovimbela ukukhula kwezinhlamvu. Isetshenziswa kakhulu njengokudla kwezilwane futhi ingatshalwa kabili ngonyaka. Kufanele ikhawulelwe ngaphambi kokuthi imbewu iphume. Kunamathuba amaningi avela uma kushintshwa izitshalo ngokutshala amasimu okumboza, futhi uma umalimi evinjelwe ekutshaleni izitshalo ezijwayelekile ukuze athole inzuzo ehlobo, izinzuzo zizobonakala esikhathini esizayo. Emhlabeni jikelele, abakhiqizi bathi ukutshala amasimu okumboza kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuvikela umhlabathi" ngoba kugcina ukuvuthwa komhlabathi. Kucace bha ukuthi ukuthuthukisa umhlabathi wakho kungaba yinto enkulu esikhathini eside!
I-Grain SA iphethe uhlelo lokuthuthukisa abalimi oluxhaswe yi-Maize Trust, Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust, Sorghum Trust, kanye ne-Winter Cereals Trust, oluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka abakhiqizi lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngolwazi ngokufundisa, ukwesekwa, nokusiza ngezindlela ezahlukene ezitholakala kalula kubo. Njengoba i-Grain SA inethimba lezingcweti (ochwepheshe) elihola ekuhlinzekeni ngemininingwane enembile kubalimi abasha lapha eNingizimu Afrika, manje seyiqashelwa ngokuba phambili ekuthuthukiseni abakhiqizi. Amalungu e-Grain SA akholelwa ukuthi lolu hlelo luzosiza ukuguqula umkhakha wezolimo ukuze labo abashiywe ngemuva esikhathini esedlule manje babe nethuba lokusebenza ngokulingana nabanye emkhakheni wokukhiqiza ukudla. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle ukuthi i-Grain SA iyini nokuthi iyiphi indima edlalayo kwezolimo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Ubani i-Grain SA? I-Grain SA iyinhlangano eyakhiwe ngokuqonda futhi igxile ekukhiqizeni okusanhlamvu ezweni lethu nakwamanye amazwe. Ihloselwe ukuthuthukisa bonke abakhiqizi bokusanhlamvu lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Bonke abakhiqizi abavulelekile abaxhasa izimiso ze-Grain SA bangangena kule nhlangano uma bekhokha imali edingekayo. Yimiphi imisebenzi eyenziwa yi-Grain SA kwezolimo lapha eNingizimu Afrika? I-Grain SA iyisikhungo esisemthethweni mayelana nezindaba zokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu kokubili kwendawo nakwamanye amazwe futhi ikhuluma egameni bonke abakhiqizi lapha eNingizimu Afrika ngendlela ezothuthukisa imisebenzi yabalimi lapha nakwamanye amazwe. I-Grain SA isebenza njengomgibeli emkhakheni wezolimo ukuze ibheke izinyathelo nemithetho elawula le misebenzi ukuze ivikele amalungu ayo. I-Grain SA iphinde ibekezelele ukukhathazeka kwamalungu ayo - nezindlela abacabanga ngazo bese ithumela lezi zinkinga kuhulumeni ukuze ixazulule izinkinga futhi iqinise imithetho emisha. Inhloso eyinhloko ye-Grain SA ukuhlinzeka ngokukhiqiza nokumaketha okuphezulu kokudla ngendlela ezuzisa bonke abalimi. Le nhlangano ivame ukusebenza ukuze ixhumane nabanye emkhakheni wezolimo ukuze bakwazi ukuncintisana nabakhiqizi abakhulu emhlabeni jikelele, njengezikhungo e-USA naseBrazil. Kulezi ziqephu, kukhona abantu abasebenza kwi-Grain SA, ochwepheshe, nabakhiqizi abawamalungu nabaphathi benhlangano. Bahlola isimo mayelana nokungena kwabalamli abasha futhi banweba amathuba abo okuzibandakanya ekukhiqizeni okusanhlamvu nasemazweni lapho ukudla kungathengiswa khona. Leqembu liphinde lilawule uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabalimi. Kubonakala ukuthi i-Grain SA ayixhasi ngokwezimali amalungu ayo, kodwa ihlinzeka ngesisekelo esidingekayo esizosiza wonke amalungu ngemininingwane lapha ezweni lethu. Umsebenzi wale nhlangano uvula iminyango yokuthi abakhiqizi bagxile kulokho abangakwenza kahle - ukutshala nokumaketha okusanhlamvu! Bonke abalimi kufanele bazi ukuthi i-Grain SA inikeza okuningi kakhulu kunokufundisa nokuqeqesha abalimi! Bonke abalimi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kufanele bafise ukuba amalungu aphelele e-Grain SA anamalungelo okhetho. I-Grain SA iyizinyembezi, izindlebe, kanye nezwi labakhiqizi bokusanhlamvu emkhakheni wezolimo, obhekene nezinselelo ezivela ezizindeni zangaphandle ezifana nokuncintisana nemakethe zangaphandle. Abalimi emnothweni bamanje babhekene nezinselelo ekuncintisaneni nasekuqiniseni izikhundla zabo kule makethe yamanje - ngakho-ke kunzima kakhulu kubalimi abasha ukuzibandakanya kulomkhakha wezolimo. Ngaphandle kokuxhaswa yinhlangano eqinile, enolwazi efana ne-Grain SA, ukuvikelwa, ukwesekwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwabalimi bokusanhlamvu ezweni lethu kusemngceleni.
Ngidinga usizo - ngifuna ukulima! Kukhona abantu abaningi abathi kithi ngalolu cela - "Ngidinga usizo, ngifuna ukulima." Abanye balaba bantu abanankanyezi, kanti abanye banomhlaba nezinsiza. Ukulima kuyibhizinisi futhi ukuphumelela ebhizinisini kunzima - udinga ukuba nezinsiza, ugqozi, nolwazi. Labo abafuna ukuba abakhiqizi bokudla kodwa bengenamhlaba nezinsiza babhekana nenkinga enkulu. Kodwa khumbula ukuthi awudingi njalo ukuba nomhlaba ngaphambi kokuba ube umkhiqizi. Ngempela, wonke umhlaba uwukubolekwa kuphela - thina singabapheki balo mhlaba, futhi uma sishiya, umhlaba uzohlala khona. Uma unomfuno onamandla wokulima, zama ukuthola umhlaba nganoma iyiphi indlela, noma ngabe kuyisicucu esincane ukuze uqale ukulima. Ungaqasha umhlaba (khumbula ukuthi ungakwazi ukuqasha amapulazi kwabanye abanomhlaba, futhi emakhaya amaningi kunezindawo zomhlaba ezizokwenziwa ziqashwe). Kufanele uqale phansi futhi uhlale ufunda - awukwazi nje ukuthola ulwazi ezincwadini, udinga ukufunda ngokusebenza ngezandla zakho, akulula. Manje udinga ukuthola ulwazi - ukulima umsebenzi ohlukahlukene. Ngokwesimo sokulima ofuna ukukwenza, kufanele uthole ulwazi oluhambelana nalokho ofuna ukukulima; uma ufuna ukutshala izitshalo, uzodinga ulwazi lokutshala (okudla, imbewu ye-oyela, imifino, izithelo, njll.), ulwazi lokulima izilwane (izinkomo ezinkulu nezincane, izinkukhu, imidlalo, nezinkabi), ulwazi lwemishini (amatraktori, ama-ploughs, ama-harrows, ama-hoes, nama-shovels), futhi kubalulekile, udinga ulwazi lokuphatha zonke ezinye izici ezihlobene nokulima (izindaba zezimali, abasebenzi, izinsiza, nezinto zonke ozosebenza nazo). Uma unelungelo lokusebenzisa indawo encane, mhlawumbe eyodwa hectare, qala ukusebenza! Uma usuqalile, uzobe usendleleni eholela phambili, uye kubalimi bezomnotho. Uzofunda ukuthi ungasebenza kanjani - yenza kahle. Njalo sithola ukuthi abantu bafundiswa ukusebenza kahle kodwa bese bephendukela ezindleleni ezindala. U-Oprah Winfrey uthi, "Uma abantu beqonda kangcono, benza kahle." Uma usufundile ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi ukuze unqume okuqukethwe kwezakhamzimba - thatha lawo masampula! Uma uthola ulwazi mayelana nohlobo olufanele lwezithako - sebenzisa lezo zithako (noma ngabe ulima kuphela ihektare eyodwa). Thenga imbewu efanele yokutshala, qinisekisa ukuthi utshala inani elifanele emgqeni othile. Phatha izitshalo eziphikisanayo - izitshalo eziphikisanayo zingumngani omkhulu uma utshala ukudla, ziba phanga ukudla kwakho! Ziphanga amanzi, izakhamzimba, ukukhanya kwelanga, nomoya - akekho ofuna izinto zakhe ziphangewe abanye, futhi nakho akufuneki kumitshalo yakho. Uma uqonda kahle ukuthi yiziphi izidingo zokulima, kuzobe sekuyisikhathi sokwandisa indawo okhulima kuyo. Njalo sithola abantu beklama ukuthi indawo abakhulima kuyo incane kakhulu - kodwa usebenzisa le ndawo kahle. Khumbula ukuthi njalo kukhona abanye abanolwazi oluningi kunalokho okukhona, futhi uzothola ukuthi bavame ukuthanda ukusiza abanye abalimi - funda kubo?
Umhlangano omusha obizwa ngokuthi iGrain Farmer Development Association (GFADA), umhlangano wokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi bokudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, obambisene neGrain Value Chain Network (GVCN), ukhathazekile ngesimo sezolimo esingasakhiqizi inzuzo eyanele ekukhiqizeni ukudla okwenziwe ngogwayi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukhathazekile ngempempe yokuthi lokhu kuzoba nomthelela kulabo abaqala embonini yokulima. Ukusungulwa kwalaba bafuyi abasha kubalulekile kuhulumeni, ngakho-ke iGFADA ifisa ukweseka zonke izinzame zabafuyi abasha. Nokho, ukuhlinzeka lezi zinsizwa ngempahla ngaphandle kokuzisekela ngendlela efanele kuyimanga ngoba babhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Amalungu eGVCN anolwazi nolwazi lokubathatha ngezandla nokubasekela, kodwa uhulumeni kumele ahlinzeke ngemali edingekayo ukuze anikeze abafuyi imishini abayidingayo ukuze baqhubeke nezinsiza zabo zokuphumelela esikhathini esizayo. Ngempela, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sicabange kabusha ngesimo somsebenzi sokukhiqiza ukudla okwenziwe ngogwayi. Isikhathi sishoda, futhi kungaba usuku olubi uma sivuka kusasa sithole ukuthi awekho ukudla. Manje sekuyisikhathi sethu sokubona ukuthi ngaphansi kwezimo zamanje, lokhu kungase kwenzeke kusasa. Amanani omkhiqizo ahlobene nezindleko zokuqala ezivela phesheya, kanti iNingizimu Afrika yaziwa ngokuba nezindleko eziphezulu kunezinye izinkanyezi emhlabeni. Ukwanda kwezindleko kukhula ngesivinini esiphakeme kunenani lomkhiqizo - lokhu kubeka ingcindezi enkulu kubafuyi ngoba kukhona ingozi phambili. Ukuvuna nokuba nekhono lokukhiqiza kungavimbela le nkinga. Ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile kubalulekile uma sifuna ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokukhiqiza. Kodwa sinezinkinga ngoba uhulumeni akahlinzeki ngemali eyanele ukuze kwenziwe lezi zihlolo futhi kuxazululwe le nkinga ngempumelelo. Inani lokwanda kwam价格 lifuna ukuthi inzuzo ngohlangothi ihambisane nalokho okukhiqizwayo, noma ukuthi lokho okukhiqizwayo kufanele kwandiswe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindawo lapho kukhula khona izitshalo kumele zande ukuze zihambisane nezidingo zenzuzo. Ngamanye amazwi, uma abafuyi abasha abangenela ezolimo befuna ukuphumelela, kumele basebenzise ubuchwepheshe obusha ngendlela efanele. Inhloso kufanele ihambisane nezimo zezimali. Abafuyi abasha bathembela kulabo abangahlinzeka ngolwazi nokwesekwa okuqhubekayo - lokhu kuyisisekelo seGFADA. Ukulima kuy umsebenzi onezinselelo nezingozi, ikakhulukazi uma sibhekene neminyaka emibi ezindaweni zethu. Uma sibheka imali engenayo, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi imakethe ihlobene nemakethe zangaphandle kanye nezinguquko zezimali lapha nasemhlabeni. Lokhu akusibo ezandleni zabafuyi. Imakethe iyahluka futhi iyalinganiswa naleyo evela phesheya naleyo esuka lapha. Imakethe yokudla okwenziwe ngogwayi ihambisana nalokho okubizwa ngokuthi izindlela zemakethe ezikhululekile, ezikhombisa ukubaluleka kwalokho okudingekayo nokutholakalayo. Ukukhiqiza lapha eNingizimu Afrika kudlula lokho okudingekayo, ngakho-ke ukuthengisa phesheya akukhiqizi inzuzo enhle. Ukukhiqizwa emhlabeni jikelele futhi kuphakeme kudala imakethe yehlise. Futhi imithetho kahulumeni ivimbela ukuthuthukiswa kwemakethe emisha efana nezibani ze-biofuels. Abafuyi baseNingizimu Afrika abatholi ukwesekwa okukhulu kuhulumeni, futhi manje baphumelela ukuhweba nezizwe lapho uhulumeni esekela abafuyi. Uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika kufanele acabangele ukushintsha ukulawulwa kwezimali ukuze ahlinzeke ngenkxaso engcono kubafuyi, bese abathengi bezokwazi ukuphila kangcono.
Isithombe 1: Umkhiqizo endaweni ephakathi (evamile) ngo-2008 nango-2009. Abalimi banikeza izizathu ezahlukene zokungasebenzisi ama-hybrids: imbewu ibiza kakhulu, ukuntuleka kwemali ngesikhathi sokutshala, ukungakwazi ukuthola imbewu ye-hybrid, ukuthenga umanyolo, umkhiqizo ophansi, ukungaphumeleli ukukhula ezindaweni zonke, ukufakwa kabi, ukuntuleka kwekhwalithi efanele. Lokhu okukhulunywe ngenhla kuphakamisa umbuzo wokuthi ama-hybrids angcono kunezinhlobo ezivulekile zokupollinate (OPV) kubalimi abaphumelelayo - lapho imbewu ingatholakali kalula, lapho izindleko zokufaka ziphansi, nalapho umkhiqizo uvame ukuba phansi. Umbuzo oqondile uzokhetha uhlobo lwemibewu: ama-hybrids noma ama-OPVs yizinkanyezi ezizokwazi ukweseka umlimi ukuba abe nokudla kwesikhathi esizayo futhi axhaswe ngenzuzo eqhubekayo. Imbewu enhle iyisihluthulelo sokutshala nokukhiqiza yonke imikhiqizo yokudla. Zivula umnyango wokukhiqiza yonke imikhiqizo yokudla. Zonke izenzo zokulima ziqondiswe ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo ezisemibewwini etshaliwe. Akukho zenzo zokulima (njengokulima kahle, ukulawula izihlahla, ukufaka umanyolo, nokuphatha izifo) ezingakhuphula umkhiqizo ngaphezu kwekhwalithi yemibewu. Ngakho-ke, yonke imisebenzi yokulima ezoba nomphumela omuhle noma ophansi ihlotshaniswa nemibewu etshaliwe. Ukuze ufinyelele umkhiqizo omuhle, kufanele utshale imbewu yekhwalithi enhle. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola imbewu yekhwalithi enhle, kufanele uthenge imbewu eqinisekisiwe - noma ngabe ama-hybrids noma ama-OPVs. Imbewu eqinisekisiwe inezinga lokukhula elingafika ku-98% (akukho okungahambi kahle) futhi umkhiqizo wayo ungafinyelela ku-90%. Izindleko zemibewu eqinisekisiwe akufanele zibe yinkinga ekugcineni ngoba uzothola umkhiqizo ophakeme. Abalimi abakhiqiza ezindaweni ezincane noma abalimi bokuphila bahlushwa izinselelo zezimali, bavame ukutshala ummbila osele unyaka owedlule. Uma benza lokhu ngemibewu eseleyo lapho ama-hybrids abekwe khona, umkhiqizo ungashintsha kakhulu (uphakeme kuze kube ngu-50% uma kuqhathaniswa nemibewu emisha). Nokho, uma betshala imbewu eseleyo lapho ama-OPVs abekwe khona, abalahlekelwa umkhiqizo omningi. Yini i-hybrid? I-hybrid ivela lapho izinto ezimbili ezihlukile ngokuphelele (njengabazali abahlukene), enye yowesifazane nenye yowesilisa, zixubana. Ukuvuleka kokupollinate kusho ukuthi isitshalo esisodwa sithatha ipholeni sithole imbewu yaso. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuzalanisa." Lapho ummbila uqhubeka usebenzisa ipholeni yawo, izitshalo nemibewu ekhiqizwayo - izizukulwane - iyalahlekelwa amandla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi - lokhu kubizwa ngama-line aphindwe kabili. Izitshalo ezivela kulezi zixhumanisi eziphindwe kabili zincane, zineziqu ezincane, futhi umkhiqizo wazo uphansi. Nokho, uma umgqa ophindwe kabili uxubana nomgqa ophindwe kabili, amandla abuyiselwa emibewwini ezokhula, futhi umkhiqizo waleyo mitshalo uzokhula. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuphila kwe-hybrid." Kwenzeka lapho ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo kwezi line kuhlanganiswa futhi kuhlanganyela. I-hybrid ethile ingakhethwa ngoba inokuqina ezifo, kanti enye ingaba nekhono lokubekezelela ukushoda kwamanzi. Ngokuvamile, ama-hybrids anemikhiqizo edlula leyo ye-OPVs. Ama-hybrids ayafana ngemibala, ukufinyelela, nezinye izici, avumela umlimi ukuthi enze imisebenzi eminingi ngasikhathi sinye (njengokufaka umanyolo, ukuwasha, nokuvuna). Ukuvumelana kwemigqomo evunyiwe kungaba usizo uma ummbila uthengiswa noma uthengiswa kubathengi abanezimfuneko ezithile zokuhlola. Ama-hybrids ngokuvamile akhiqiza umkhiqizo ophakeme ngama-18% uma kuqhathaniswa nama-OPVs. Umlimi kufanele avune ngaphezu kwamathani amabili ngehektare ukuze akwazi ukuthenga lezi zibhamu ezibizayo. Imbewu emisha kufanele ithengwe minyaka yonke. Imigqomo evunyiwe yonyaka odlule ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengemibewu yonyaka olandelayo. Kungenzeka ukuthi umlimi angatholi imbewu lapho kusasele isikhathi. Ama-hybrids avame ukuhamba kancane uma izimo zezulu nezinye izinto ziba nzima (ukuphuma kwe-tassel). Lapho ukukhiqiza nokulima kuphathwa kahle futhi izimo zezulu zibi, ama-hybrids awakhiqizi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nama-OPVs. Yini i-variety evulekile yokupollinate (OPV) efana? I-OPV ikhiqiza imbewu ngokuvuleka kokupollinate kuzo zonke izindawo, futhi izinhlobo zixubana (okukhuluma ukuthi ukuvuleka kokupollinate akuphathwa nganoma iyiphi indlela). Ipholeni yezitshalo endaweni ethile ayiphathwa, ngakho umkhiqizo / izitshalo azikwazi ukuba yizifanekiso; isibonelo: ukuphakama kwezitshalo akuzukuba yizifanekiso, umbala wecobho awuzukuba yizifanekiso, usayizi wezindlebe awuzukuba yizifanekiso, nezitshalo azizukufinyelela ngesikhathi esifanayo. Imbewu ibiza kancane noma ayidingi ukuthengwa. Umlimi angasebenzisa ezinye zezimveliso ezivunyiwe ukuze atshale unyaka olandelayo. Izindleko zokuthenga imbewu zingaba phansi kakhulu kunezindleko zokuthenga ama-hybrids. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi uzoba nemali yokukhokha umanyolo nokulawula izilokazane. Imbewu ingaphindwa. Imigqomo yonyaka wamanje ingatshalwa unyaka olandelayo. Akukho sidingo sokutshala ama-hybrids ezindaweni ezingenamandla. Ama-OPVs angaba nezakhi zofuzo ezihlukile, ngakho izikhathi zokutshala azihambisani. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuzoba nesikhathi sokutshala eside okuzokwenza ama-OPVs avuleke kokupollinate ngesikhathi esifushane uma kunezinto ezibangela izinkinga (amanzi amaningi, ukushisa okuningi, njll.). Lokhu kuhluka kungaholela kumkhiqizo ofanayo uma kuqhathaniswa nawo wonke ama-hybrids atshalwe ngasikhathi sinye. Kubalulekile ukuthenga imbewu eqinisekisiwe njalo eminyakeni emithathu ukuze kuvinjelwe ukulahleka kwamandla kwemvelo emibewwini. Umkhiqizo ungase ube phansi ngo-10 - 25%. Ezindaweni ezinomfertility ephezulu (umhlabathi), ama-OPVs azokwehlisa inzuzo. Izitshalo azizukuba yizifanekiso ngemibala, ukufinyelela, nezinye izici zezithombo. Lokhu kungathinta ukuthengiswa (ikhwalithi). Lapho kunezinto eziningi ezihlukene, kungaba nzima ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngasikhathi sinye, njengokuwasha izilokazane nokuvuna (ikakhulukazi uma usebenzisa umshini wokuvuna). Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi i-OPV ihlala inamandla, kufanele itshalwe okungenani emamitha angu-300 kude nezinye izinhlobo. Imbewu enekhwalithi ephansi (imibewu ehlelelwe ukutshala unyaka olandelayo kodwa ibekwe ezimeni ezimbi lapho kushisa kakhulu futhi lapho kunezilokazane nezifo) ingaholela ekukhuleni okuphansi futhi izitshalo zihl
Umhlaba ongathuthukisiwe (ongavakashi) awunani uma uqhathaniswa nomhlaba othuthukisiwe onempahla. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindlu, izithiyo, nezindlela ezisemaphandleni akho zihlala zisesimweni esihle. Izakhiwo ezisemaphandleni kufanele zigcinwe kahle ukuze zisetshenziswe njalo manje nakusasa - ukuze kuqoqwe, kusebenza ngemikhiqizo, kucutshungulwa izinkomo, njll. Kungcono ukugcina ama-traktor nezinye izinsiza ngaphansi kwes roof, njengoba zizonakala uma zishiywe ngaphandle. "Izithiyo ezinhle, eziphilile zidalela ozakwethu abahlanganyela nawe," izilwane zakho kufanele zihlale ngaphakathi kwempahla yakho. Lapho ufaka, kubalulekile ukuthi izilwane zingangeni kulawo makhaya. Uhlelo (istrateji) lokudla izilwane ezindaweni ezithile ngezikhathi ezithile luqinisekisa ukuthi utshani obuthandwayo buyavikelwa futhi bunokuthi bukhule kabusha. Izindawo ezineziqukathi nezindawo lapho amanzi engeziwe angaphuma khona zibalulekile ukuvimbela ukwehla komhlabathi - ukwehla komhlabathi kudala ingozi engalungiseki, futhi kuwumthwalo wethu wonke ukuvikela nokugcina umhlaba ukuze izingane zethu zikwazi ukusebenzisa lowo mhlaba esikhathini esizayo ukuze zibe nokuphila okuhle. Izindlela zibalulekile uma uphatha ezolimo ngokwezimali - izinto ezifana nefertilizer kufanele zifike kahle emaphandleni, futhi ukuvuna kwethu kufanele kukwazi ukuhamba kahle lapho kuzothengiswa khona. Ukuphatha izindlela emapulazini kubalulekile ekulimaleni.
Izindleko zokuqala zokuqashwa - kufanele uthole ukuqashwa kwemifino? Njengoba ukulima kwenziwa kakhulu ngaphandle, kunezingozi eziningi ezingavela, ngokuvamile izindleko zokutshala zidlula inani lokuthenga lezo zinkambu lapho imifino itholakala khona. Ngokuvamile, abalimi bacindezelwa ukuthi babole imali ezinkampanini zezimali noma ezolimo ukuze baqale ukutshala. Ukubolekwa nokuboleka imali kuyibhizinisi elinobunzima, ngoba labo ababelayo imali abafuni ukuyilahlekelwa. Ngokuvamile, umbolekisi kumele anikeze umphakathi wezimpahla zokuqashwa - ngamagama amanye, umbolekisi kumele akwazi ukubuyisa leyo mali uma kungekho ukunciphisa. Uma ungumnikazi wepulazi lapho ulima khona, umbolekisi uzodinga ukuthi ubhalise ibhondi kulolo pulazi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma ungakhokhi imali obolekisiwe, umbolekisi uzothengisa lelo pulazi ukuze abuyise imali ebolekiwe. Kubalimi abasafufusa, lokhu kungadala izinkinga eziningi - kuyoba yicala ukulahlekelwa yipulazi uma ungatholi umkhiqizo omuhle. Kukhona abalimi abaningi abasafufusa abangaboni amapulazi abo - abanye bahlola izinkambu, ngokuvamile lezo pulazi ziqashwa emzaneni wonke (umhlaba wombuso ophathiswa yikhandidethi yesifunda). Wena njengomlimi awukwazi ukuthola ibhondi kulolo mhlaba ngoba awunayo isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi ungumnikazi walelo zona. Esikhathini esedlule, abalimi ababephila ezinkambeni zomphakathi babengenakuboleka imali ngoba babengenayo impahla yokuboleka. Manje, ukuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala zokulima kuqala ukuvela - manje umlimi angathola ukuqashwa kwemifino ezinkambeni, uma kwenzeka ingozi engatholakala, inkampani yokuqashwa izokhokha imali ebolekiwe. Ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla ekulimaleni kanye nokwehla kokuboleka kwabagibeli, isidingo sokuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala sikhula njalo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Le nqola isungulwa ngokubheka umkhiqizo okhiqizwe ngumlimi othile isikhathi eside (isikhathi eside, umkhiqizo ojwayelekile (LAPY)) epulazini ethile. Indawo yephulazi. Iphulazi elihlonziwe nge-GPS elikhombisa zonke izinkambu, inani lezinkambu, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izindawo. Isimo sokuba ngum owner womhlaba - ingabe umlimi ungumnikazi, ingabe ipulazi liqashwe, ingabe umhlaba ungowomphakathi (womphakathi), njll.? Ubani ozohlinzeka umlimi ngemali yokuqala yokulima? Futhi umkhiqizo otholwe eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. Umphumela wocwaningo lwesimo somhlabathi phakathi neminyaka emibili ukhombisa isimo somhlabathi epulazini nasemakambeni. Ulwazi oluthile lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani umsebenzi epulazini ethile - izindlela zokulima izinkambu, imifino etshalwe, izithako ezisetshenzisiwe, izindlela zokuphatha izihlahla, izifo nezilokazane, njll. Ulwazi oluthile mayelana nomqashi ozokwenza umsebenzi. Izikhathi zokutshala nokukhula kokuqala - kunezikhathi ezithile ezivunyelwe, imifino etshalwe ngaphandle kwaleyo zikhathi ngeke iqashwe. Umhlaba uvikelwe kanjani ekubeni uphume? Imifino izovikelwa kanjani ekudliweni izilwane? Ukuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala ezindaweni lapho kunokushisa kuhambisana nokuqashwa kwehayi - inani leziqashwa lihambisana nomkhiqizo ojwayelekile otholakala isikhathi eside kulolo pulazi. Umlimi ukhetha inani leziqashwa zehayi. Ukuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala ezindaweni lapho kunokupholisa kuhlala yedwa, akuhambisani nokuqashwa kwehayi. Lapha ihayi ifana nezinye izingozi ezingavela futhi ukuqashwa kuzokhokha ngokuhambisana nezinye izingozi uma ihayi ivela. Izingcuphe ezivikelwe ukuqashwa ezinkambeni zingabandakanya: ihayi, umlilo, ukuthutha, ukushisa, umswakama omningi, imvula eningi, ukuwa komhlabathi ngenxa yamanzi, ukuwa, umoya, imimoya emikhulu, nezinye ukulahleka komkhiqizo ngenxa yezimo zezulu ezimbi, izifo zezihlahla ezingalawulwa, izilokazane, nezingozi zezilwane. Abalimi abathola ukuqashwa bazohlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi basebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezifanele. Izithako kufanele zisetshenziswe ngesikhathi esifanele. Izingcuphe ezivikelwe ukuqashwa uma ihayi ivela zifaka: ihayi, umlilo, ukuthutha, ukushisa, imvula eningi, ukuwa komhlabathi ngenxa yamanzi, ukuwa, umoya, imimoya emikhulu, nezinye ukulahleka komkhiqizo ngenxa yezimo zezulu ezimbi, izifo zezihlahla ezingalawulwa, izilokazane, nezingozi zezilwane. Ukushoda akuvikelwa. Ukuqashwa kwezindleko zokuqala kudinga imali eningi. Manje sibona ukuthi izindleko zokuqala ziya zikhula kodwa intengo yemakethe yomkhiqizo ivame ukuwa (okwakukhona okwamanje ngemifino eminingi). Kubalulekile ukuthola le nqola, kodwa ekugcineni, akusasele lutho oluzongena ephaketheni lomlimi ngemuva kokuvuna. Ungase ulahlekelwe leyo mali, futhi ungase ube nekhono lokukhokha lelo bhondi, kodwa kuzoba malini inzuzo yakho? Wena njengomlimi unethuba lokukhetha ukuthi uzokwenza kanjani. Empeleni, awukwazi ukukhetha - kuzodingeka ubeke ipulazi lakho njengomphakathi, noma uzocindezelwa ukuthi uthole ukuqashwa okuzovikela ibhondi lakho. Ekugcineni, ngeke ukwazi ukuthola imali yokuba uqale ukulima? Kodwa lokhu akukhona nje okubi ngoba: uma wenza yonke imisebenzi edingekayo yinkampani yokuqashwa kahle, uzolima kahle, uzosebenzisa izindlela zokukhiqiza ezintsha, futhi amathuba akho okuthola umkhiqizo omuhle azovela kahle.
Ishadi 1: Amanani okwenziwa kwemfertilizer emhlabeni jikelele. Ishadi 2: Amanani omkhiqizo weBrent International crude oil kanye namaholo ejenerali edizeli. Abakhiqizi bezitshalo zokudla nezinsalela zamafutha baccepta kuphela amanani abawatholayo. Ngamanye amazwi, abakwazi ukuhoxisa ukukhuphuka kwezindleko kumkhiqizo wabo. Ngakho-ke, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuqala kwenza ukuhweba kube yingozi ekukhiqizeni izitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha. Phakathi kukaMeyi 2007 noMeyi 2008, amanani wemfertilizer ezweni lethu akhuphukile kakhulu. Isizathu esiyinhloko salokhu ukukhuphuka kokufuna kwemfertilizer emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa ukukhiqiza nokuhlinzeka kwemfertilizer akukhuphukanga. Ikakhulukazi, ukufunwa kwemfertilizer ezindaweni ezifana neNdiya neChina kukhuthaza lokhu. EChina, bafake intela enkulu ekuthumeleni kwemfertilizer, okukhuphule amanani wemfertilizer. Ithebula 1: Ukuthengiswa komhlaba jikelele. Ishadi 1: Amanani okwenziwa kwemfertilizer emhlabeni jikelele. Amanani wemfertilizer ezweni lethu akhuphukile kakhulu kusukela ngoMeyi 2007. Lokhu kukhuphuka kuboniswa kuTebula 2. Tebula 2: Amanani avamile wemfertilizer ezweni lethu. Izindleko zemfertilizer zenze u-25% wezindleko zokuqala zokutshala izitshalo noma izinsalela zamafutha, ngakho lokhu kukhuphuka kubalulekile kithi lapha eGrain SA. Lokhu kukhuphuka kufaka phakathi ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha ngendlela ethola inzuzo engozini ephezulu. Imakethe ejwayelekile yezinto zokwakha ezisetshenziswa kwezolimo ikhuphukile kakhulu ngonyaka odlule. Ukufunwa (izindleko) zalawo maphilisi kudlule umthamo wokukhiqiza lezo zinto. Intela efakwe yiChina ekuthumeleni, kanye nenani eliphezulu le-crude oil, kunomthelela ekukhuphukeni kwamanani. Cishe u-99% wezinto ezidingekayo ukukhiqiza izinto zokwakha kwezolimo eNingizimu Afrika ziza phesheya, futhi isilinganiso esiphansi seRand uma siqhathaniswa nezinye izimali sikhuthaza ukukhuphuka kwamanani ezinto. Imakethe yezinto ezineGlyphosate (njengeRoundup) ikhuphukile ngo-150% kuya ku-240% ngonyaka odlule. Ngokuvamile, imakethe yalezi zinto ikhuphukile ngo-45%. Inani leBrent crude oil likhuphukile ngo-63.2% kusukela ngoMsombuluko 2007. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iRand yehlile ngo-9.6% uma siqhathaniswa nedola laseMelika. Imakethe ejwayelekile ye-diesel ezweni lethu ikhuphukile ngo-63% eGauteng - ukusuka ku-R6.21 nge-litre ngoMeyi 2007 kuya ku-R10.10 nge-litre ngoMeyi 2008 (Ishadi 2). Amanani aqhubeka ekhuphuka ngenyanga - uma sihlanganisa lokhu nezinye izindleko ezikhuphukayo, kusho ukuthi ukuhweba kube yingozi. Ishadi 2: Amanani omkhiqizo weBrent International crude oil kanye namaholo ejenerali edizeli. Iningi lemishini yezolimo esetshenziswa eNingizimu Afrika iza phesheya - futhi isilinganiso esiphansi seRand sinesithakazelo esikhulu uma kubhekwa ukukhuphuka kwamaholo nemishini. Tebula 3: Izinguquko zamaphesenti kumaholo emishini yezolimo unyaka nonyaka. Ubani ozothwala umthwalo wokukhuphuka kwamaholo okudla? Ingabe kuzofanele kube kubakhiqizi bezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha? Njengoba ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuqala zokutshala kuqhubeka, kuzoba nzima kubakhiqizi bezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha ukukhiqiza ukudla esikhathini esizayo - lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma imakethe yezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha ikhula ngokuhambisana nemakethe yezindleko. Uma sicabangela izindleko zokuqala zamanje kanye nemakethe yezitshalo nezinsalela zamafutha ezilindelekile, abalimi kuzodingeka baphathe kahle futhi bahlaziye ngaphambi kokuthi baqale ukutshala. Abalimi kufanele futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bakhokha intengo efanelekile yokuqala - bheka kwezinye izindawo, ungase uthole amanani aphansi kwenye indawo, futhi futhi uhlole ukuthi imakethe ithi ini. Xhumana neGrain SA ukuze uthole amanani amasha futhi uzokwazi ukuzama ukuthola amanani aphansi. Kuzodingeka uhlele kahle futhi uhlaziye ukuthi iyiphi uhlobo lwezithelo ozoyitshala - kubalulekile ukufinyelela inzuzo ekugcineni uma ufuna ukuba ummeli ophumelelayo. Futhi khumbula ukuthi izindleko zokuqala zokutshala zizokhuphuka futhi ngaphambi kokuthi kufike isikhathi sokutshala esisha.
Uma ufunda le ncwadi ebizwa ngokuthi Pula-Imvula, uzothola ukuthi kukhona uHlelo Lokuthuthukisa Abalimi nguGrain SA. Esikhathini esedlule, lolu hlelo lwathola uxhaso ikakhulu oluvela kuMaize Trust, ngakho-ke sasingakwazi ukubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezinhlanga. Ubonile futhi ukuthi muva nje saqala ukubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezithelo ze-oyela - lokhu kwenzeka ngoba manje sithola uxhaso oluvela ku-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust. Okwamanje, sijabule ukukwazisa ukuthi sithole ngempumelelo uxhaso oluvela kuWinter Cereals Trust. Ngakho, kusukela kule nyanga kaDisemba, sizophinde siqhubeke nokubhala izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni lapho ibhakiwa khona ngesikhathi sehlobo. Lezi zindaba zizofakwa kuPula-Imvula ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu. Okwamanje, izindaba ze-wheat zibhaliwe kuphela ngesiNgisi nangesiSesotho futhi zizohlukaniswa nePula-Imvula eFree State. Esicelweni sethu kuWinter Cereals Trust, sicele usizo ngomsebenzi esifuna ukuwenzela ukusiza abalimi abasha be-wheat e-Eastern Free State naseCentral Free State. Sizobeka izindawo ezimbili zokubonisa - eyodwa eModderpoort, eduze kweLadybrand, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentshonalanga, kanti enye eGlen, eduze kweBloemfontein, ezosiza abalimi endaweni esentral. Inhloso yokubeka lezi zindawo zokubonisa ukuveza nokufundisa abalimi ukuthi yiziphi izindlela zokulima ezinhle - ukulima ngendlela yokugcina umswakama emhlabathini phakathi nezinyanga zokuqala, ukukhetha izinhlobonhlobo ezifanele, inani leziphuzo ngehektare, inani lefertilizer, nokuphatha izitshalo nezifo - kuhle ukuva ngalezi zinto, kodwa kuhle kakhulu ukuzibona ukuze uqonde ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani kahle. Kukhona izincwadi eziningi ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwe-wheat ezindaweni lapho kunetha khona ngesikhathi sehlobo, kodwa sithathe umqondo wokuhlanganisa incwadi yokuhola (ikhasi lokuhola) ezobhekana ngqo nezinkinga zabafundi abasha kulezi zindawo. Le ncwadi izochaza kabanzi izindlela zokugcina umswakama emhlabathini - okubaluleke kakhulu kunanoma yini enye ekukhiqizeni kwe-wheat ezindaweni ezithola imvula yehlobo kuphela. Le ncwadi izoba nezahluko ezizoxoxa ngembewu, isimo sesitshalo se-wheat, izidingo zokudla kwe-wheat, izindlela zokubeka ezizohambelana nokukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo, inani leziphuzo nezikhathi zokubeka, izindlela zokulawula izitshalo ngesikhathi izitshalo zisakhula, ukuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuvuna, ukuhlukanisa, nokumaketha. Ngemuva kokuphothula le study, sizohlinzeka ngezifundo zoktraining kwabanye - iseshini eyodwa izogxila ekuqeqesheni abaholi ukuze babelane ngolwazi, kanti ezinye ezimbili zizogxila ekuqeqesheni abalimi - ekuseni sizobheka ulwazi ezincwadini futhi ntambama sizofundisa umsebenzi wezandla. Ukuze sisize abalimi ngendlela efanele, sizozama ukwenza amaqembu amane agxile ekukhiqizeni kwe-wheat. Lezi zifundo zizohlangana njalo ngenyanga, futhi konke okukhona okuhlobene nokulima kule nyanga kuzoxoxwa. Siyabonga kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi sokusiza abalimi be-wheat eFree State.
Irrigation - kuyini lokhu? Umhlaba wonke unenkinga ngamanzi ngoba inani labantu liqhubeka likhula, kodwa amanzi atholakalayo awakhuli. Imephu elandelayo ikhombisa izindawo lapho kukhona amanzi emhlabeni. Kunabantu abaningi emhlabeni abangakwazi ukufinyelela kokudla namanzi ahlanzekile, njalonjalo. Ukukhiqiza ukudla/izitshalo ngamanzi agcinwe ezindaweni lapho ukuna kwemvula kuncane noma akuzinzile. Ukusebenzisa amanzi agcinwe endaweni ethile kubalulekile. Ukunciphisa ingozi yokufa kwezitshalo ezitshalwe futhi kuvuselela ukuqhubeka kokukhiqizwa kokudla ezweni. Ukwandisa umkhiqizo ngaphezulu kwehektare. Ukukhiqiza ukudla phakathi nezikhathi ezomile nezimanzi. Ukukhiqiza ukudla kabili ngonyaka. Ukusebenzisa imali etholakale ebhizinisini ngendlela efanele. Ukuhlinzeka ngemakethe ekhula ngokwakha ukudla okwanele. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kanye nemikhiqizo. Ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemaphandleni. Ukukhiqiza izinhlobo ezikhethiwe zezithako ezindaweni ezomile (lapho imvula ingafiki ngezikhathi ezingafanele ezingenza umkhiqizo ube sengozini). Kunezindawo eziningi ezishisayo nezomile lapha eNingizimu Afrika, lapho kukhona ukwehla kwamanzi kakhulu futhi akuhlali kuthola imvula. Kulokhu, kunzima ukukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ejwayelekile ngaphandle kokungenisa amanzi endaweni ethile. Ukukhiqiza ukudla ngaphandle kokufaka amanzi kubizwa ngokuthi: ukuncika emvuleni kuphela, noma ukukhiqiza ezindaweni ezomile. Isimo sezulu esihlala sishisayo nesishisayo sikhuthaza ukukhula kwezithako ezithile, futhi eziningi zikhula kahle uma kukhona amanzi anele okokufaka. Ngokubheka kwethu, u-40% wezindawo ezinomjikelezo wamanzi zisetshenziswa ngabantu ngabanye, u-26% uphathiswa uhulumeni, kukhona u-4% abakhiqizi abancane, kanti u-30% osele uphathiswa uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi 'izinhlelo zokulima amanzi'.
U- Ms. Jane uthi... Njengomkhiqizi (noma njengomndeni), unani? Ungafinyelela yini emhlabeni, emakethe, emishini, noma ezinsizweni ohlelweni lwethu Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezolimo? Isisekelo sethu sibuza ukuthi unani, nokuthi singakusiza kanjani ukuba usebenzise kahle lokho? Uma unomhlaba ongawufinyelela, usebenzisa kanjani okwamanje? Ingabe ungasebenzisa kahle kunalokho okwamanje, futhi yini ekuvimbela ekwenzeni lokho? Sikholelwa ukuthi wonke umuntu angasizwa ukufinyelela imiphumela engcono ngokusebenzisa kahle izinsiza abangazithola. Ukuba umkhiqizi osebenza ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo kusho ukukhiqiza okungaphezu kwalokho okudingekayo kuwe nasemndenini wakho. Uma uthengisa ukudla okukhishwe, uphonsa itshe emfuleni ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kube khona ukudla njalo futhi ufanele ukwesekwa. NjengoGrain SA, sizibophezele ekutshaleni imali kuwe. Le mpelasonto ibiyinselele kakhulu. Okokuqala, amanani aphansi ezitshalo abangele ukufinyelela ezikweletini zokukhiqiza. Naphezu kwemizamo yethu emihle, uMnyango Wezolimo awukwazanga ukusiza abakhiqizi bethu. Kulabo abangakwazi ukutshala, ukuqala kwentwasahlobo kube nomswakama omncane futhi izimo zokulima zibe zimbi. Kuqale ukuwa imvula, kodwa akukapheli. Manje inselele iwukukhula okungaphathwa kanye nezitshalo eziphuma ngaphandle. Okungenani amanani ezitshalo zokudla kanye nezitshalo ze-oyili athuthuke, futhi labo abashadile kufanele bathole umvuzo wezizakhamuzi zabo. Intengo ye-maize nayo ithuthuke, futhi isikhathi esizayo sibonakala sinesithembiso esikhulu sokutshala i-maize (ezindaweni ezifanele). Sisebenza kanzima ukuze sakhe ubudlelwano obuhle noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezakhamuzi kanye Nezinguquko Zomhlaba. Sithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukubika ngalokhu emhlanganweni olandelayo wePula. Uma singasebenzisana nomnyango, singasiza abakhiqizi abaningi. Sifisela impumelelo yenu zonke ezinyangeni ezizayo - maye izitshalo zenu zikhule futhi nibe nethemba ngekusasa lezolimo eNingizimu Afrika.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhloselwe ukuphakamisa abalimi abamnyama ngokubaphelela amandla okukhulisa ukudla ngendlela ehlangene nezomnotho. Lolu hlelo luwuhambo lokugcina lokukhiqiza kwezomnotho. Wonke amaphrojekthi ahlukene ohlelweni lwethu ahlose ukufinyelela ukukhiqiza kwezomnotho - izifundo zoktraining zabalimi, ukuhlolwa kokubonisa, izinsuku zabalimi, ukwakha ubudlelwano, umncintiswano wabalimi boNyaka, uHlelo Lwabalimi Abasebenza Kahle, izifundo zoktraining, ukusakazwa kwezimvo, kanye nePula/Imvula. Umulimisi kufanele abe nezindawo ezivundlile ezingakhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo, futhi kufanele kube nezinye izindawo lapho efisa khona ukwandisa imisebenzi yakhe kuze kube sekukhiqizeni ama-ton angu-250. (Usayizi wezindawo kufanele uqinisekiswe, kodwa akukhathalekile ukuthi umulimisi uyazipha, uyazithenga, noma usebenzisa izindawo ezisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke). Uma kungenzeka, sifuna umulimisi asebenze njengomuntu oyedwa, hhayi njengeqembu. Sibone ukuthi uma abantu abaningi bephuma ndawonye, njengamaqembu, akusebenzi kahle ngoba abantu abahlangani. Bese bengaqhubeki nemisebenzi yokukhiqiza kahle. Kumele babe nezithuthuthu nezinsiza. Kunzima ukuba umulimisi wezomnotho ngaphandle kwezinsiza ezanele. (Ngezinye izikhathi kungaba kuhle ukuthola umthengisi wezolimo nokuvuna, kodwa kungcono ukwenza yonke imisebenzi uqobo). Umulimisi kufanele abe yilungu leqembu lokufunda futhi kufanele abekhona ezifundweni ezintathu noma ezine zeGrain SA. Amaqembu okufunda anikeza abalimi ulwazi mayelana nezolimo nokukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo. Izifundo zoktraining nazo ziyasiza ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi, bese kufanele baxhaswe epulazini ukuze basebenzise lolwazi. Umulimisi kufanele abe nenhloso yokulima, ukufunda, nokwamukela umyalezo. Ukuba umkhiqizi wokudla okuyisisekelo kudinga ugqozi oluqhubekayo; sibone ukuthi abalimi abaningi abangakhethi ukulima ngaso sonke isikhathi abaphumeleli. Ukuthuthukisa umulimisi ukuba abe umulimisi wezomnotho kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kudinga imali eningi - akusizi ukuchitha leyo mali kumulimisi ongenalo ugqozi mayelana nezolimo. Uma umulimisi engenayo imali eyanele yokulima ngaphandle kwesikweletu, kufanele abe nezimpahla ezingaqinisekisa isikweletu sokuqala ukulima (umthetho omusha wesikweletu (NCA) wenza kube nzima ukuthola isikweletu, bese abalimi bengakwazi ukuqhubeka nokulima). Kungaba kuhle ukuba nezinye izinkampani ezingakha imali, kodwa sifuna umulimisi abe njalo ekhona epulazini. Asisebenzi nomnikazi wepulazi ongakabi epulazini.
Ikhono lokwenza okulungile - ukwenza lokhu ngendlela efanele. Ukukhiqiza okuphumelelayo akuhambisani nomkhiqizo otholakalayo ekugcineni, kodwa kukhombisa ikhono lomlimi lokulinganisa okokufaka (izindleko) nokuthi yini etholwa (futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okokufaka kukhiqiza inzuzo ekugcineni). Lokhu kufanele kukalwa ngokukhula kokutholwayo (ukukhiqiza); kodwa kufanele kubhekelele zonke ezinye izici ezinganciphisa ukukhiqiza: indlela yokusebenza kahle, ukuphatha abasebenzi kahle, ukuthola ulwazi ngembewu, izimo zezulu, futhi ekugcineni: inhlanhla! Uma ubona ukuthi okokufaka (izindleko) ezifana ne-diesel, umanyolo, nemishini zikhuphukile kakhulu, kufanele usebenze ngokuhlakanipha ukuze ufinyelele inzuzo. Ukwanda kokukhiqiza okuphumelelayo kukhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buphambili futhi ukusebenza ngokuhlakanipha kuqhubeka - lokhu kuholela ezinzuzweni ezinhle kodwa hhayi okokufaka okweqile. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi kufanele usebenze ngokuhlakanipha, hhayi nje ukusebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukulinganisa konke lokhu kuyinselelo ngoba kufanele ubheke zonke okokufaka nezokukhipha (umkhiqizo) bese ulinganisa ukuze ubone ukuthi isimo sakho simele kuphi kulokhu. Kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi mangaki umsebenzi owenziwe ukukhiqiza ngonyaka odlule ngaphambi kokucabanga ukuthi yisiphi isisebenzi esifanele ukuba senzeke ngonyaka ozayo.
Yiziphi izindawo ezibalulekile? Njengoba ungumlimi, unezizathu zokwenza izinto eziningi. Uhlola futhi uhlela ngokuya ngezinhlobo zomhlabathi wakho, kungani? Ukuze ubone futhi uthole izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba ngendlela efanele. Uthatha amasampula omhlabathi futhi uwahlaziye, kungani? Ukuze uthole ulwazi lokufaka umanyolo ophakathi ukuze ufinyelele izithelo ezinhle. Uvuna noma uhlanganisa izinkambu zakho, kungani? Ukuze amanzi omvula angene emhlabathini. Uhlunga izinkambu ngesikhathi esifanele, kungani? Ukuze ubulale izihlahla ezisiza ukugcina amanzi emhlabathini. Uhlola emakethe ethile ukuze unqume ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo okufanele uzitshale, kungani? Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona indawo lapho uzothengisa khona imikhiqizo yakho. Uthumela isivumelwano sokuthengisa emakethe ethile, kungani? Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo kuzokwenza ukuthi ube nenzuzo. Uzenza indawo yokutshala, kungani? Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ngesikhathi sokutshala, umhlabathi unesimo esihle esizosisiza ukuthi imbewu ingene kahle futhi ixhumane kahle nomhlabathi ukuze ikwazi ukuvutha ngokushesha. Uplantsha inani elithile lezitshalo futhi ukhethe uhlobo olufanele, kungani? Ukuze uvune izithelo ezinhle. Uplantsha izitshalo ngomanyolo othile nangenani elithile, kungani? Ukuze uvune izithelo ezinhle. Uhlambele inkambu nge-herbicide ngaphambi kokutshala, kungani? Ukuze uvimbele izihlahla ukuthi zingancintisani nezitshalo ngamanzi, umanyolo, ukukhanya, nomoya. Uhlambele inkambu nge-pesticide ngemuva kokutshala, kungani? Ukuze izilokazane zingalimazi izitshalo zakho. Uthinta phakathi kwemigqa yezitshalo, kungani? Ukuze uqede izihlahla ezizoncintisana nezitshalo zakho. Ufaka umanyolo ophakeme ezitshalweni zakho, kungani? Ukuze unikeze izitshalo zakho izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze ufinyelele izithelo ezinhle. Uhlola njalo ngezifo futhi uhlambele i-pesticide uma kudingeka, kungani? Ukuze unikeze izitshalo zakho ithuba lokukhula kahle. Uvuna ngesikhathi esifanele, kungani? Ukuze uthole ibanga elihle uma uthengisa imikhiqizo yakho. Ungabhekana nazo zonke lezi zindaba ngokwakho - ungathatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngokuya ngemicabango yakho. Umbuzo olandelayo uwukuthi uzokwazi kanjani ukuthi wenze lezi zinto kahle? Kufanele uzihlolisise: yisiphi isiphumo ofuna ukusifinyelela? Ingabe ufike kulolo suphumo noma cha? Bheka emibuzweni eminingi: eminye ungaphendula ng 'yebo' noma 'cha' - isibonelo: umbuzo mayelana nokuthatha amasampula omhlabathi - ingabe uwathathile noma cha? Ngaleso sikhathi nangaphakathi kobubanzi obuthile. Ingabe ugcina umswakama owanele emhlabathini ukuze ube nokutshala ukuze izitshalo zikhule kuze kube imvula? Ngeziphi izithelo ezitholakalayo nangani? Ingabe ulungiselele kahle nangasikhathi ukuze ukwazi ukutshala ngesikhathi osikhethile? Ingabe uqonda ukuthi zingaki izitshalo okufanele uzitshale futhi uphumelele? Ingabe uqonda ukuthi zingaki amahektare okufanele uzitshale futhi uphumelele? Yiziphi izinhlobo ozisebenzisayo futhi uyazifaka ngendlela efanele? Ingabe uphumelele ekubulaleni izihlahla? Ingabe uqonda ukuthi yisiphi umanyolo okufanele ufake nokuthi yisiphi owawufakile? Uthole malini ezithelo ngehektare futhi uthole malini? Kukhona umshwalense wezindleko zokuqala zokutshala etholakalayo ku-ARS (namanje ezinye izinkampani) ukuvikela ezimeni ezinjengokushoda kwemvula, imvula eningi, isichotho, umoya, nomlilo. Kodwa akukho abakhiqizi abazohlinzeka ngeshwa yokuvikela ezimeni ezibangelwa ukuphathwa kwakho okungalungile. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuhlela kahle, ukusebenza kahle, nokusebenzisa izindlela zokuphatha eziphakeme.
Izitshalo zihlukaniswa zibe yizigaba ezimbili - lezo ezinezimpande ezibanzi (i-dicotyledonous) kanye lezo ezinezimpande ezincane (njengezihlahla). Izimpande ezincane zinezinhlaka ezihamba ngokuhambisana ukusuka emzimbeni ziye phezulu. Izimpande ezibanzi zinezinhlaka ezifana nezihlahla. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu ngoba amakhemikhali asebenza ngendlela ehlukile kulezi zimbili zezithombo. Izimpande zenzelwe ukuqinisa isitshalo emhlabathini zibe phezulu futhi ziwathathe amanzi nezinsiza emhlabeni. Isitshalo se-maize sinezimpande ezithambile. Lapho isimo sezulu silungile, isitshalo se-maize singaba nezimpande ezihamba ziye ku-1,500 m uma zihlanganiswa. Lapho izimpande zikhula kahle, zingafinyelela ubukhulu obungama-1.5 m ezindaweni zethambo futhi zingangena emhlabathini kuze kube ngu-2 m ubukhulu. Ngokuvamile, kunezinhlobo ezimbili zezimpande - impande eyodwa (impande eyodwa eqinile ethambile ekhula phansi, engase ibe nezimpande ezihambisana nayo) kanye nezimpande eziningi (uhlelo lwezimpande ezivela) (izimpande eziningi ezikhula ngasohlangothini, hhayi kuphela phansi). Isitshalo se-maize sinezimpande eziningi, futhi njengoba sikhula, sithuthukisa izimpande zokusekela, ezisiza ukusekela isitshalo ukuze singaweli. Lezi zimpande ziyi-adventitious futhi ziqala ukukhula ngaphezulu komhlaba. Ithambo lesitshalo se-maize lifana necilindeni. Kucacile ukuthi kunezikhala (lapho amahlamvu phuma khona) nezindawo phakathi kwezikhala. Ukuphakama kwethambo kuhluka ngohlobo lwe-maize kanye nezimo zezulu. I-cob ye-maize ingaba nezikhala eziphakathi kuka-8 no-21. Lezi zikhala azinobude obulinganayo. I-cob ye-maize ivamise ukuqala ukuthuthukiswa lapho kunezikhala eziyi-8. Amahlamvu amabili akhula ukusuka kwesikhala esisodwa. Umsebenzi wama-leaves uwukuthatha ukukhanya kwelanga futhi asebenza njengefektri yethambo ukukhiqiza ukudla. Amahlamvu akhula ngokuhambisana ethambeni. Ihlamvu imide, incane, futhi iphumelele phezulu. Ihlamvu ixhaswa yizinhlaka eziqinile ezihamba ukusuka emzimbeni ziye phezulu. Ihlamvu yethambo iphila ngezinhlaka ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-stomata. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ama-stomata." Ama-stomata atholakala ngaphansi kwehlamvu amaningi uma kuqhathaniswa nalawo phezulu. Lapho kushisa futhi kukhukhuleka, ama-stomata akhipha inani elincane lamanzi futhi ihlamvu iyacindezela. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi ihlamvu ivale futhi inciphise ukulahleka kwamanzi. Ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezishisayo kakhulu, ama-stomata abanga amahlamvu ukuba acindezele. Ngobusuku lapho kuqala ukupholisa, amahlamvu avula ukuze enze umsebenzi wawo. Lapho ukushisa nokukhukhuleka kuqhubeka isikhathi eside, ama-stomata awakwazi ukuvula amahlamvu futhi aphile - lokhu kuyisimo esiyingozi esingalungiswanga futhi umkhiqizo uzoncipha. Isitshalo se-maize sinezimbali zomfazi nezomfana - lokhu kusho ukuthi isitshalo se-maize singaziphendulela (ukukhulisa). Ingxenye yomfazi ithuthukiswa ibe yicob, kanti ibhande lomfana liyisicabha phezulu kwesitshalo. I-kernel encane ixhunywe ku-silk (ibhande lomfazi) phakathi kwe-cob. I-pollen (ibhande lomfana) iwela ku-silk futhi ikhulisa leli bhande kuze kufike ku-kernel encane. Ukukhulisa kwenzeka lapho i-pollen ifika kule kernel. Lapho kushisa kakhulu futhi kukhukhuleka, kungenzeka ukuthi i-pollen iyoma futhi ingafiki ku-kernel. Lokhu kuzobonakala ngama-kernel amancane ku-cob. Ibhande lomfazi lingamukela i-pollen phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-10 kuya kweziyi-14. Wonke umsebenzi wokutshala i-maize uhlose ukukhiqiza imbewu yokudla. Ubuningi kanye nekhwalithi ye-kernel kubalulekile uma sifuna ukuthola inzuzo emasimini ethu. Izinto ezingathinta umkhiqizo zifaka: izifo, izidingo zokudla zesitshalo, amanzi atholakalayo, izinga lokushisa ngesikhathi sokukhula, nokukhetha uhlobo olufanele lwe-maize. Ukubaluleka kwalokhu kuhlobene nohlobo lwamakhemikhali asetshenziswe ngoba amanye asetshenziswa ngaphambi kokuthi isitshalo sikhule kanti amanye asetshenziswa ngemuva kokuthi isitshalo sikhule. Le nkathi ivela ngesikhathi sokutshala kuze kube yisikhathi sokukhula kwesitshalo. Le nkathi ichaza isikhathi ngemuva kokuthi isitshalo sikhule emhlabathini. Singahlukanisa izigaba eziyi-10 zokukhula kwesitshalo se-maize. Isigaba 0 - ukusuka ngesikhathi sokutshala kuze kube ukukhula. I-maize itshalwa ngaphezu kuka-2.5 cm kuya ku-5 cm emhlabathini. Lapho kushisa futhi kukhona amanzi anele, imbewu ithatha izinsuku eziyi-6 kuya kweziyi-10 ukuze iqale ukukhula. Uma kubanda noma kukhukhuleka, imbewu ingathatha amasonto amabili ukuze ikhule. Izinga lokushisa elihamba phambili ukusiza imbewu ukuba ikhule liphakathi kuka-20°C kuya ku-30°C. Umoya emhlabathini kufanele ufike ku-60% (amanzi amaningi noma amancane kuzokwandisa isikhathi sokukhula). I-genetics yohlobo lwe-maize ichaza inani lama-leaves nama-ears azokhula. Ihlamvu entsha ivamise ukuvula njalo ezinsukwini ezintathu. Ngalesi sikhathi, indawo lapho isitshalo sikhula isaphansi komhlaba. Isicabha sikhula futhi. Ngalesi sikhathi, usayizi wama-leaves ukhula izikhathi ezinhlanu kuya kwezingu-10, futhi isisindo sethambo sikhula ngo-50x kuya ku-100x. Ukuvela kwesicabha kuqala manje. Izimpande eziphezulu ziqala ukukhula ubukhulu obungama-5 cm kuya ku-7.5 cm phezulu komhlaba. Isicabha siqala ukukhula ngokushesha. Izicabha ezine-silk ziqala ukuvela ngokushesha ezikhala eziyi-6 kuya kweziyi-8 phezulu komhlaba. Inani lemibewu ku-cob limisiwe. Ithambo likhula kakhulu ngobude futhi isicabha sikhule. Amahlamvu avulekile ngokuphelele futhi isicabha sibonakala ezinsukwini ezimbili noma ezintathu. Ithambo eline-sicabha esikhulu kanye nama-leaves esicabha cishe selikhule ngokuphelele. Ngalesi sikhathi, isitshalo sidinga izinsiza eziningi. Isicabha, ithambo, nama-leaves konke sekukhule ngokuphelele. Isisindo se-kernels siqhubeka nokukhula. Imbewu iqala ukuqina. Lapho i-kernel ifika ekupheleni kwesikhathi sokukhula, ama-husks amnyama akhula phezulu lapho i-kernel ihlezi phakathi kwesicabha. Imbewu isiphumelele ngokuphelele, futhi manje ilindele kuze kube yoma ngaphambi kokuvuna. Imbewu idinga ukunciphisa umswakama ukuze iphelelise. Ukuqanduka kwenzeka ku-5% ngeviki kuze kube kufike ku-20%, ngemuva kwalokho ngeke kuqande ngokushesha.
UDokotela Kobus Laubscher uqokwe njengomphakathi omusha weGrain SA oqala ngoJanuwari 1, 2008. Okwamanje, uDokotela Laubscher usebenza eNyuvesi yaseFree State. Unolwazi lwezinkambu ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi kwezomnotho wezolimo, futhi unolwazi olunzulu oluhambelana nezindawo zasemakhaya, izifundazwe, kanye nezwe ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zebhizinisi lezolimo; ungumhloli futhi uphinde afundise. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, uphinde usebenze namabhizinisi ezolimo eNamibia naseBotswana. UDokotela Laubscher ungum member we-International Food and Agriculture Management Association (IAMA). Unolwazi lokuphatha amabhizinisi omnotho. Muva nje, uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ukuphatha iNational Productivity Institute (NPI) yaseNingizimu Afrika, lapho engumsekeli wezolimo. Phambilini, ubeyilungu lebhodi yeNyuvesi yaseFree State njengommeleli okhethwe ngabaxhasi bokusiza. UDokotela Laubscher ushade noAnnemarie, futhi banamadodana amabili nendodana eyodwa.
I-Kweekgrass - ingabe kukhona indlela yokususa le mithi engafunwa kalula? I-Cynodon dactylon (i-quickgrass, i-couch grass) icatshangwa ukuthi ivela emiphakathini e-Afrika noma e-Asia. Le grass itholakala ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika futhi ibeka ingozi ezitshalweni zokudla nasemathafeni. I-Kweekgrass iyigrasu ephansi ekhula ngokushesha futhi isakazeka ngezinhlayiya nezimpande. Le grass ingakhuliswa ngezinsiza zokulima nezilwane. I-Kweekgrass ngokuvamile ayikhuli phezulu, ivamise ukungadluli ku-40 cm. Ihlamvu lesitshalo linemibono efana nezandla enezikhala ezi-3 kuya kwezi-7, futhi ubude bayo buphakathi kuka-3 cm kuya ku-6 cm. Izimpande zayo zinemibala emnyama kuya emnyama, shine, futhi zilingana no-1.1 mm ubude kuya ku-0.7 mm ububanzi. Iqala ukukhula ngokushesha futhi izinza kahle. I-Kweekgrass iyisiphikisi esiqinile, idala ingozi ezindaweni ze-concrete ne-asphalt. Njengoba i-kweekgrass iqala ukukhula ngokushesha, isetshenziswa ezindaweni ezinomhlabathi ophukile. Izinhlobo eziningi ze-kweekgrass zisetshenziswa ezindaweni ezine-lawn, lapho kukhona amanzi agijimayo (NK 37), emagcekeni, ezinkundleni zomjaho, nasemaphandleni okuzijabulisa. I-Kweekgrass iyaphikisana kakhulu nezitshalo zokudla ukuze ithole isikhala, ukukhanya (ilanga), amanzi, nezithako emhlabathini. Iphinde ibambe ezinsizeni zokulima, okungadala ingozi ethinta izindleko. Bonke bayabuza: Ingabe singaphatha/susa i-kweekgrass? Yebo, singaphatha i-kweekgrass, kodwa akukho isixazululo esisheshayo. Ukulima kuphela akususi ngokuphelele. Ngokuvamile, izinsiza zokulima ziphula izinzwa, okwenza le mithi ikhule ngokushesha futhi isakazeke endaweni enkulu. Ekwindla (uFebhuwari noMashi), indlela yokukhupha izithako kule grass iyashintsha ngoba ikhipha izithako ezivela ezimpandeni ukuze iphumelele ezinyangeni ezibandayo. Le nkathi iyona ehamba phambili yokuphuza i-kweekgrass. Izi-6 liters ze-glyphosate (Roundup) nge-hectare zanele ukuphatha i-kweekgrass. I-Glyphosate ingena ezimpandeni futhi ibulale isitshalo sonke. Uma kukhona izindawo lapho ibuyela khona, ungaphuza lezo zindawo futhi. Kubalulekile ukubulala i-kweekgrass ezindaweni zemifula nasemgwaqweni ngoba lezi zindawo zingaholela ekukhuleni okusha kwe-kweekgrass. Enye indlela yokubulala i-kweekgrass ukuhlinza izinzwa nezimpande ebusika usebenzisa imishini. Ngemuva kwalolu work lwebusika, izinzwa nezimpande zizobuyela, linda zikhule kahle bese uphuzisa izi-6 liters ze-glyphosate nge-hectare - linda amasonto amathathu ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukulungisa umhlabathi ukuze uphande ngempelasonto. Ukubulala izitshalo ezine-leaf broad ezindaweni lapho izitshalo zokudla ezine-leaf broad zikhuliswa (njengama-soybeans) nokubulala izitshalo ezifanayo ezindaweni lapho izitshalo ezine-leaf elincane zikhuliswa kuyinkinga njalo kubalimi. Ngakho-ke, kunzima ukubulala i-kweekgrass emkhakheni we-maize. Uma kungenzeka, zama ukutshala isitshalo esine-leaf broad ngonyaka ozayo (njengama-soybeans, ama-nuts, noma ama-sunflowers) bese ubulala i-kweekgrass ngaleso sikhathi. Xhumana nomphakathi wezokwelapha wezokwelapha ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ngemuva kokuvuna isitshalo esine-leaf broad, ungahlinza izinzwa nezimpande ebusika bese uphuzisa izi-6 liters ze-glyphosate nge-hectare. Phinda zonke izinyathelo ezishiwo ngenhla. Uzobona ukuthi ngemuva kweminyaka emibili, i-kweekgrass izoba lula ukuyiphatha. Ngaphambi kokuphuza i-glyphosate, i-kweekgrass kufanele ibe isiqinile futhi ibe nezinhlamvu eziningi ukuze ikwazi ukuthola i-herbicide. Awufanele uphuzise i-glyphosate uma i-kweekgrass ibhujiswa (ifakwe, umswakama, noma uma kukhona amanzi amaningi) ngoba izinhlamvu ngeke zikwazi ukuthola i-herbicide kahle. Landela imiyalelo ebhukwini le-herbicide ngokucophelela. Qaphela ukuthi i-herbicide ingahamba iye kwezinye izitshalo. Qaphela ukuthi izinga lamanzi ahlanganiswe ne-glyphosate lingathinta ukusebenza kwe-herbicide - sebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngezinye izikhathi kungadingeka ukuhlanganisa i-ammonium sulfate ne-glyphosate. Khumbula ukuthi ukukhokha inani elincane ngesikhathi esifushane kungaholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu esikhathini eside - sebenzisa i-herbicide ngendlela efanele ukuze uthole imiphumela emihle.
Ungayithola kanjani imvume yokufaka umhlaba? Uhlaka: Jane McPherson, umphathi wohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezivuno eGrain SA. Ngokuvamile, singasho ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zokulima zidinga umhlaba (izinkambu) - kungaba indawo encane lapho wakhe khona ingadi yezitshalo, noma kungaba izinkambu ezinkulu noma umhlaba omkhulu wokugaya ezindaweni lapho kuvame ukuba khona umswakama omncane. Nokho, uma umhlaba usetshenziswa ekulimaleni, kufanele ube nemvume esemthethweni yokungena nokulima le ndawo - lokhu kubopha isivumelwano phakathi komnini womhlaba nomuntu ozowulima (kungenzeka ukuthi umnini nomqashi bangumuntu oyedwa). Kunendlela ezahlukene zokuthola imvume yokulima endaweni ethile, futhi lezi zindlela zixhumene nezimo ezinhle nezimbi. Into ebalulekile okufanele uyikhumbule ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi: zonke izivumelwano ezihlobene nokulima endaweni ethile kufanele zibhale phansi uma ufuna ukuthi zamukelwe enkantolo - isivumelwano esenziwe ngenkulumo asivamile ukuba sibophe. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi uma isivumelwano sikhona, amaqembu abamba iqhaza avuma ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa kanjani futhi ahlale kahle. Nokho, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, bangase bangavumi futhi kungase kuphume enkantolo. Ngokuvamile, uma kube nezinkinga ezivela mayelana nokuba nomhlaba noma ukuqashwa komhlaba, kunezindleko eziningi ezihilelekile - ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izivumelwano zibhale phansi ngaphambi kokuthi uqale imisebenzi yokulima ukuze amaqembu abamba iqhaza kuleyo zivumelwano avikelwe uma kwenzeka izinkinga. Iphakethe lomhlaba eNingizimu Afrika, nakwamanye amazwe, linomqulu wesihloko ohlobene nalo ngokomthetho. Uma ungumnini walolo phakethe lomhlaba, kufanele ube nalo mqulu obonisa ukuthi ungumnini ofanele. Lo mqulu uchaza isimo salo phakethe lomhlaba. Umqulu wesihloko ungumqulu wezomthetho osetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi bokuba nomhlaba. Umqulu wesihloko waziwa kakhulu njengendlela yokudlulisela ubunikazi kumuntu oyedwa komunye. Ukudlulisela ubunikazi kubhaliswa ehhovisi leziqu ezibekwe ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika. Umqulu wesihloko usebenza njengobufakazi bokuba nomhlaba. Ngokuvamile, uma ufuna ukweleta imali, izakhiwo ezithengisiwe zidinga umshwalense ngendlela yokwakhiwa. Izakhiwo ezibolekayo, njengezibank, zivikela imali yamakhasimende azo ukuze ikhulise, ngakho-ke izibank zifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali ebolekiwe iphephile. Umnini wefamu (umnikazi womqulu wesihloko) angasebenzisa le fomu njengomshwalense wokweleta. Bese umshwalense ubhaliswa kulolo mqulu wesihloko futhi uchaza ukuthi zingaki imali ezibolekiwe. Isibonelo: ake sithi umnini wefamu ufuna ukweleta R100,000 ebhange. Ibhange lizobhalisela umshwalense we-R100,000 kulolo mqulu wesihloko. Uma umuntu obolekayo engakakwazi ukukhokha, umnikazi wombhiyozo (ibhange) angacindezela umnikazi womqulu wesihloko ukuba athengise le fomu ukuze umnikazi wombhiyozo akwazi ukuthola imali yakhe. Uma inani lemali le famu lifinyelela ku-R200,000 (isibonelo), khona-ke ibhange lingathatha inani lemali ebolekiwe. Uma umnikazi womqulu wesihloko ebolile R50,000, ibhange lingathatha R50,000 kuphela noma umshwalense ungama-R100,000. Uma umuntu efuna ukulima efamu yomunye, yena nomnini bangena esivumelwaneni sokuqasha. Kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukuqasha indawo ethile achaze kahle ukuthi ubani umnini waleyo fomu. Isivumelwano sokuqasha siyidokhumenti ebhaliwe echaza imininingwane mayelana nesimo sendawo eqashwe, isikhathi sokuqasha, inani lemali ezokhokhwa, nezikhathi lapho le mali izokhokhwa. Isibonelo: isivumelwano sokuqasha singaba phakathi kukaMnu. X (umnikazi - umnini wefamu) noMnu. Y (umqashi - umuntu ofuna ukusebenzisa ifamu) ukuze aqashe ifamu yaseDawn etholakala endaweni yaseTweespruit, ubukhulu bayo bungu-400 hectares, isikhathi sokuqasha sibe yiminyaka emithathu, izindleko zibe ngu-R150 ngehektare ngonyaka, futhi le mali izokhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezilandelayo (hhayi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezedlule). Kungase kube nezinye izinhlinzeko kuleso sivumelwano - isibonelo: izizathu zokungaqhubeki nalesi sivumelwano, imvume yokukhipha izitshalo, ukuhlola umhlaba, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nale fomu ethile. Umqashi akakwazi ukusebenzisa le fomu njengomshwalense wokweleta - lokhu kungenziwa kuphela ngumuntu onemfuyo. Kukhona futhi enye imfuneko ethi "ukuqasha kuqala kokuthengisa." Ake sithi isikhathi sokuqasha sithinta iminyaka emithathu kodwa umnini ufuna ukuthengisa ifamu ngaphambi kokuphela kwaleyo minyaka emithathu, umnini kufanele axoxe nomqashi ukuze bafeze isivumelwano - kungenzeka ukuthi umnini omusha uvuma ukuqhubeka nokuqasha le fomu kumqashi noma umnini angavuma ukukhokha umqashi inani elithile lemali bese isivumelwano sokuqasha siphela. Lapha emsebenzini wethu wokulima, izivumelwano zokuqasha zivame ukuba phakathi kwabantu ababili - omunye engumnini nomunye ofuna ukulima lapho; noma phakathi kwemiphakathi nomlimi (lapho ifamu ingase ibe endaweni ephethwe yimiphakathi); noma umnini angase abe uhulumeni (uhulumeni) - kunezindawo eziningi ezinkulu eziphethwe uhulumeni ezilimiwa ngabantu abangenela izivumelwano zokuqasha. U-13% womhlaba eNingizimu Afrika usezandleni zezikhalazo zendawo (izizwe) - lokhu kufinyelela ku-17 million hectares. Ngempela, uhulumeni ungumnini walomhlaba - ngokuvamile, uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo, uMnyango Wezomsebenzi Womphakathi kodwa uphethwe yizikhungo zezakhamuzi. Njengoba abanye abantu besho ukuthi awekho amarekhodi abhalwe phansi mayelana nokuba nomhlaba okusetshenziswa umphakathi wonke (izizwe), uhlelo nezindlela zokwabiwa komhlaba ziyaziwa kubo bonke abantu abahlala kulezo zindawo (lokhu kungadinga ukubhalwa phansi, kodwa mhlawumbe ehhovisi lapho kubhaliswa khona iziqu). Abafundi abaningi babhale amaphepha bezama ukuchaza udaba lokusebenzisa izindawo zomphakathi nezalokho ezaphathwa ngokomthetho wesikhumbuzo - ngoba kukhona uhlelo oluqondile olubhalwe phansi lapho abantu abamhlophe bathola ubunikazi bomhlaba othile, kodwa ezindaweni ezisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke, awekho amarekhodi abhalwe phansi. Uma umgomo wokuthola umhlaba uwukwakha umkhiqizo wokulima nokunciphisa ubuphofu, kufanele sithi sekuyisikhathi sokukhuthaza uhlelo lokusebenzisa izizwe, nezinye izindlela zokuphatha le ndaba yokweleta imali nokuqasha izindawo zomphakathi kufanele zitholakale. Siphinde sifise ukuthi indlela yokubhalisela ubunikazi bomhlaba okusetshenziswa umphakathi wonke ibuyekezwe - lokhu kuhlobene nokuhlolwa okuqhubekayo okukhuluma ngale ndaba yokwenza umhlaba ezindaweni zomphakathi ukwazi ukukhiqiza inzuzo yokulima. Kungani amahlamvu ommbila engaluhlaza? Kulokhu, izitshalo zommbila zikhule kakhulu kangangokuthi singabona uma kunokushoda kokudla emhlabathini noma cha. Le nkathi ikunika ithuba elihle lokuhamba emapulazini akho ukuze ubone uma kungase kube nezinkinga futhi ucabange ukuthi ungazivimbela kanjani lezi zinkinga (njengokushoda kwe-nitrogen okungalungiswa ngokufaka i-LAN phezulu) nezinye izindaba ezingalungiswa ngaphambi kokufika konyaka omusha. Lapho sibheka izitshalo, kuzoba sobala ngokushesha uma kunenani elanele le-nitrogen emhlabathini ngoba zizoba namahlamvu aluhlaza kakhulu. Ukushoda kwe-nitrogen kuyabonakala uma uthola izitshalo ezincane ezinomhlamvu omncane oluhlaza noma ophuzi. Lokhu kuphuzile kuvame ukwenzeka ekugcineni kwamahlamvu (lapho kukhulu) bese kuncipha phakathi kwamahlamvu. Uma lokhu kushoda kubi, lezo zindawo eziphuzile ziba mnyama futhi ihlamvu iyafa. Amahlamvu amadala avame ukukhombisa lokhu kushoda kuqala. Ukushoda kwalokhu kubonakala ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezinye zikhombisa ngamaqhwa amasha amhlophe. Ukuphuzile kuboniswa nasezindaweni ez sides phakathi kwamahlamvu. Lokhu kushoda kuyabonakala futhi uma amahlamvu aphezulu ephuza. Iz sides, maphakathi, nezikhala ngokuvamile zihlala ziluhlaza. Ngokuvamile, izitshalo azikhuli kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile phakathi kwe-amino acids kanye ne-proteins. Ngoba kudingeka ekukhuleni kwesitshalo, kuba ingxenye yesakhiwo sesitshalo. Ukushoda kwalokhu kuyabonakala uma amaqhwa amasha emhlophe, ngokuvamile wonke amahlamvu esitshalo avame ukuba nombala ophuzi oluhlaza - akukho mehluko omkhulu phakathi kwamahlamvu amasha namadala. Lokhu kungakwenza ukushoda kwe-sulfur (S) kube kufana kakhulu nokushoda kwe-nitrogen (N). Kodwa ukushoda kwe-nitrogen kubonakala kuqala kumahlamvu amadala. Ukushoda kwe-sulfur kungavela uma umanyolo ongena i-sulfur, njengalowo onophosphorus ophakeme, ufakwa isikhathi eside. Ukushoda kwe-potassium kuyabonakala uma izitshalo zingakhuli kahle futhi amahlamvu anemikhawulo ebonakala sengathi ashisiwe. Ngoba i-potassium ihamba ngaphakathi kwesitshalo, ukushiswa kuqala kubonakala kumahlamvu amadala. Enye indlela yokukhombisa ukushoda lokhu: izimpande ezithambile ziwela ngokushesha, izifo zifaka kalula izitshalo, futhi zikhula zibe namandla ngaphansi kokubanda ebusika. Ukuhlola inani le-potassium emhlabathini akuvamile ukuba kuqinisekiswe, ikakhulukazi emhlabathini ongena, ngoba ivame ukuhamba phansi futhi ifake emhlabathini ophansi. Umbala ophuzi ophuzi. Umbala ophuzi kwezinye izindawo zesitshalo. Ukuncipha kokwakhiwa kwezimbali nezithelo. Ukuthatha isikhathi sokuphuma.
"Namuhla ngiy umuntu ophakeme futhi ojabulisayo. Ngiyabonga uNkulunkulu ngoba yena ongiphe uthando lokulima." Lezi yizisho zikaLepati Macaphasa, umkhiqizi weNyanga yeGrain SA/Absa; kukhombisa ukuthi uthando lokulima lusiza umuntu ukuba aphumelele. ULepati wazalelwa efemini endaweni yaseFouriesburg futhi wathuthukisa uthando lokulima esebancane. Ngemva kokuhamba esikoleni iminyaka emithathu, uLepati waqala ukusebenza efemini eFouriesburg futhi wakhula ngokushesha waba umholi - usemhlabeni wokulima iminyaka engu-54. Ekugcineni, walandela inhliziyo yakhe wathenga efemini yakhe. Naphezu kokungabi nemfundo ephezulu, waguqula leyo femu yaba ibhizinisi eliphumelelayo ezinyangeni eziyi-14. "Ngiy umuntu owaziwa kahle othanda ukukhiqiza ukudla kwabanye. Lolu thando lungumsebenzi kaNkulunkulu enhliziyweni yami." "Ukuqala ukulima kwami bekulula ngoba bengisebenza efemini isikhathi eside," kusho uLepati. Okwamanje, unamahektare angu-506 futhi uqasha amahektare angu-200 endaweni yaseKestell. Ibhizinisi likaLepati liqukethe izingxenye ezimbili: ukukhiqiza okusanhlamvu kanye nokulima izilwane. ULepati ungum membro weqembu lezifundo labalimi abasha leGrain SA, futhi usebenza noJohan Kriel, umphakathi wohlelo lweGrain SA Emerging Farmers eFree State. UJohan uthi, "ULepati ungumuntu onezinga. Wonke umuntu ohlangana naye uyamhlonipha. Uphatha abanye ngenhlonipho futhi uthanda kakhulu ozakwabo." ULepati ulima amahektare angu-320 futhi unohlelo lokushintsha izitshalo ezihlukene ezifana ne-maize, ama-soybeans, kanye ne-sugar beans. Uthatha amasampula omhlabathi njalo eminyakeni emibili ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umanyolo osetshenzisiwe ufanele umhlabathi. Uqapha izilokazane ngezinto zokwakha kanye nokuhlwanyela. Ngonyaka owedlule, uLepati uphumelele ukufaka i-GM maize. Uthi, "Ngizophinde ngilime i-GM maize eminyakeni ezayo ngoba izifo ziba lula ukuphathwa." Uthatha kahle imishini yakhe, futhi kubonakala ukuthi zikhululekile kahle. Ngo-1974, umnotho wezolimo umnikeze iFord 5000. Le tractor isasebenza kahle - ayidli kakhulu uphethiloli! Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhizinisi likaLepati likhule; manje unamaMassey 188, iFord 66, iFord 7610, kanye neNew Holland 6640. Ama-tractors ayahlolwa njalo, futhi amarekhodi agcinwa. Abafana bakhe ababili nabo basebenza naye futhi baqhubeka ama-tractors. Kunabasebenzi ababili abaqashwe, kodwa uma kudingeka, uqasha abanye abasebenzi besizini. Akukho ibhizinisi lokulima elingenazinkinga zayo. ULepati ubhekene nenkinga yokuntuleka kukagesi. Uthumele isicelo ku-Escom sokufaka ugesi efemini yakhe, okuzomsiza kakhulu emsebenzini wakhe. ULepati uphakamisa izinkomo nezimvu. Izinkomo ziyiBonsmara ezixubene nezinye izinhlobo. Unenkomo eziyi-85 nezimvu eziyi-100. ULepati uthi izilwane zakhe zimlethela inzuzo enhle - uthengisa izimvu ezikhethiwe entwasahlobo emakethe eziseduze. Lezi zimvu zikhuliswa kahle, futhi kanye wanqoba umncintiswano wezimbuzi ezikhethiwe. Lo mcintiswano ubanjwa endaweni, futhi uphumelele ngokumelene nabalimi bezohwebo. Umhlaba wokufuywa kwezilwane ungamahektare angu-386. ULepati ukhetha ukuhlala nokusebenza ePhuthaditjhaba nomkakhe uNooi nabafana babo ababili. Ngezehlakalo zemali ayitholile emncintiswaneni weGrain SA/Absa, watshela uJohan: "UJohan, uyazi, manje ngingathenga imbewu eyengeziwe yokulima emapulazini ami." Sithi, baphile laba bakhiqizi abakhulu!
Isihloko 1: Le mfanekiso ikhombisa izingxenye zohlelo lokugaya ukudla kwephoyisa. Isihloko 3: Isithombe esiseduze se-stomach. Isihloko 4: I-stomach ye-stomach yesibili. Isihloko 5: Isithombe sezitho ngaphakathi kwe-stomach yesithathu. Njengoba sonke sazi, ukuhweba kwezolimo kuyibhizinisi futhi ukuze kuphumelele kufanele kube nenzuzo. Eminyakeni edlule, ubunzima bokwenza inzuzo kumikhiqizo ye-maize bukhule kakhulu. Izindleko zokufaka ziya zanda kanti intengo yezitshalo zezinhlamvu ayikhuphuki ngokufanele. Abakhiqizi namuhla bazama ngazo zonke izindlela ukukhulisa ikhono labo lokwenza inzuzo ekulimaleni kwe-maize. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokufeza lokhu, futhi enye yalezi zindlela ukufaka ukuhweba kwezilwane. Abakhiqizi abaningi bakhulisela izinkomo, izimvu, noma/ kanye nezinkukhu. Lezi zinkampani zingafinyelela emhlabeni wezolimo ovame ukuba wanele ngesikhathi sasehlobo, kodwa kaningi akukhona ukuhlela okwanele ukuze kudle izilwane ezinyangeni zenyanga. Uma ufuna, noma ucabanga ukuba umkhiqizi wezilwane, kufanele ucabangele ukuba umkhiqizi wokudla (forage); ekugcineni, ungakhulisa izilwane kuphela uma unokudla ukuze uzigcine. Ukuze uthuthukise umthelela wokuhweba kwezilwane, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi uhlelo lokugaya ukudla kwezilwane ezishisayo lusebenza kanjani. Ngamafuphi, kunezinhlobo ezimbili zokugaya ukudla ezilwaneni: monogastric, isibonelo, izinkukhu, amahhashi (nababantu), kanye ne-ruminants, isibonelo, izinkomo, izimvu, izinkukhu (nezinye izilwane ezidla izitshalo). I-ruminant inezinhliziyo ezine, ngayinye inomsebenzi wayo othile. Usuku olujwayelekile lwephoyisa, amahora ayisishiyagalombili azosetshenziselwa ukudla (ukudla), amahora ayisishiyagalombili ukuze ulale, kanti amahora ayisishiyagalombili asele azosetshenziselwa ukuhamba. Ngemuva kokudla utshani, iphoyisa iphuza amanzi bese iqala ukuhamba ukuze iqale inqubo yokugaya. Ubukhulu betshani obudliwayo bukhulu, ngakho ukuze iphoyisa ikwazi ukukhipha, utshani obuthile buyabuyiselwa ukuze kudliwe kabusha ukuze lezo ziqephu zibe zincane futhi zixube ne-saliva (okubalulekile ukuze kudliwe). Le mpumelelo yokuhlukanisa ukudla iyenza kube lula ukuze izilwane ezincane zikwazi ukudla le nkukhu (lokhu kuzoxoxwa ngakho kamuva kulolu doc). Ake siqale le ngxoxo ngokubheka uhlelo lokugaya ukudla kwezilwane ezishisayo. Umlomo uyisiqalo senqubo yonke njengoba ukudla kufanele kungene ngaphakathi. Umlomo uqukethe uphahla lomlomo, amazinyo (aphuma ngemva kokuzalwa), ulimi, kanye nezitho zokukhipha umswakama. Kulula ukubona ubudala bezilwane ezishisayo ngokubheka amazinyo azo, njengoba amazinyo athile ephuma ezingeni elithile lobudala. I-rumen iyitube elixhumanisa umlomo ne-stomach yokuqala (ebizwa nge-rumen). I-rumen noma i-stomach yokuqala isebenza njengendawo enkulu yokuphendula. Ayikho umoya noma umoya kule ndawo, yingakho ibizwa ngokuthi i-anaerobic. I-rumen iqukethe ukudla nokuphuma (izinto zezithako) ezidliwe yiphoyisa futhi ingabamba phakathi kuka-100 kuya ku-120 amalitha. Usuku nosuku, iphoyisa elikhulile lidinga ukudla cishe amakhilogremu ayishumi okudla okomile kanye namalitha angamashumi amahlanu wamanzi. Okuqukethwe kwe-rumen kuhlangene njalo. Ku-rumen, kukhona izilwane ezincane eziphula ukuphuma kube yifomu elingagayiwe yiphoyisa. Ngaphandle kwalezi zinsalela ze-rumen (ama-microbes) kanye ne-protozoa (izilwane ezincane), iphoyisa ngeke likwazi ukudla noma yini. Ama-bacteria e-rumen agaya ukuphuma ukuze akhiqize amafutha, amaprotheni, kanye namavithamini. Izilwane ezincane ku-rumen zisebenza ngezinhlobo ezithile zokuphuma; kukhona futhi ama-microorganisms ahlukene ezithelweni ezahlukene. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuthi ukudla kwephoyisa kuhlale kuqondile ngangokunokwenzeka futhi izinguquko zokudla kufanele zenziwe kancane kancane. Uma ukudla kushintshwa, kudingeka kube nezilwane ezahlukene ezincane ezikwazi ukuphatha ukudla okusha, okuthatha cishe ezinsukwini ezintathu. I-reticulum ibizwa ngokuthi i-stomach yesibili. Isebenza njengendlela ethile phakathi kwe-stomach yokuqala neyesithathu (i-stomach yesithathu lapho ukuhamba kwamanzi kwenzeka). I-stomach yesibili iphinde isebenze njengokuthola noma yiziphi izinto ezingagayiwe ezingeniswe yiphoyisa, isibonelo, ingxenye yensimbi, noma itshe, njll. I-omasum iyisitshalo sesithathu futhi yakhiwe ngama-fold amaningi. Umsebenzi wayo omkhulu uwukuhamba kwamanzi. I-abomasum iyisitshalo sesine nesokugcina lapho ukudla okudliwayo nokuphenduliwe kuhlangabezana nezinsiza ezivumela ukuba kudliwe yi-intestine encane. Ukuhamba kokudla kwenzeka kwi-intestine encane. Ekugcineni, ukudla kungena emathunjini ephoyisa ukuze kuthunyelwe ezindaweni ezahlukene zephoyisa lapho inqubo eqhubekayo iqhubeka. Ngalolu chungechunge olukhuluma ngenhla, uqala ukubona ukuthi kubaluleke kangakanani ukufaka ukudla kahle ezilwaneni zakho. Isizathu sokuhweba kungaba ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yezilwane (njengobisi, uboya, noma izinwele zezingulube), noma ukuthengisa abantwana bazo (amathole, izimvu, nezinkukhu), noma ukusebenzisa inyama yazo. Uma izilwane zifakwe kahle futhi zikhathalelwa, zizokwazi ukukhipha imikhiqizo kuwe futhi ngaleyo ndlela zibe nomthelela ekwenzeni inzuzo kwebhizinisi lakho lezolimo.
Ngesikhathi sokushisa okukhulu, njalo kube nesikhathi esinzima sokuphothula umsebenzi ngesikhathi esitholakalayo. Ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokushisa kwangonyaka odlule, imvula yafika sekwedlule, ngakho isikhathi esitholakalayo sasingaphezulu kokubaluleka kunanoma yisiphi isikhathi esedlule. Kuyajwayeleka ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwemishini namathuluzi akhishwe kuhlelo lwezinto ezibalulekile okufanele zenziwe. Njengoba isikhashana sesidlule, thola isikhathi sokunakekela amathuluzi akho.
