Ngesikhathi sasehlobo, kuvame ukuba nesidingo sokuphuthuma ukuze kuqedwe umsebenzi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esitholakalayo. Ikakhulukazi ngonyaka odlule, imvula yafika sekwedlule isikhathi, ngakho kwakungekho isikhathi esiningi. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlola nokugcina ama-tractors nemishini akubalulekile kakhulu ngoba umsebenzi kumele uqedwe ngokushesha. Kodwa manje njengoba konke sekwenzekile, sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola nokugcina imishini yakho. Hlanza umhlabathi, uthuli, kanye nokwakheka kwe-grease emshinini bese ususa noma yiziphi izinsalela. Lokhu kuzovimbela imishini ekukhuleni ubulukhuni futhi kuzosisiza ukuthi ihlale isikhathi eside. Faka ama-lubricants kuwo wonke amishini ngokwezincazelo ezihlinzekwe umkhiqizi walowo mshini. Uma ufuna ukugcina imishini ngokuphepha, qiniseka ukuthi uma kukhona izinto ezingakwazi ukuhlinzekwa, phonsa lezo zinto phansi. Gwema ukuvuvukala noma ukungena kwe-grease kulezo zinsiza zensimbi. Hlanganisa uhlu lwazo zonke izinto eziphukile noma ezidinga ukuvuselelwa. Thenga lezo manje; ungabambeleli kuze kube unyaka ozayo. Beka imishini endlini uma kungenzeka, futhi ungayibeki ezithelweni. Beka amabhokisi ezinkuni phansi ukuvimbela ukuxhumana nomhlabathi okungaholela ekukhuleni ubulukhuni. Susa ama-hydraulic cylinders noma hlola ukuthi abuyiselwa emuva ukuvimbela ama-rods ekukhuleni ubulukhuni. Ukuphatha kahle ukulima kuzoveza ukuthi uzothola umkhiqizo omuhle noma ulahlekelwe kakhulu. Ukukhetha izinhlobo zamakhowe, izindlela zokulima, ukuvulela, nokugcina amakhowe emhlabathini kubalulekile uma kukhiqizwa ukudla. Uma ukulima kungahambi kahle, umkhiqizo ngeke uhambisane nalokho okulindelekile. Susa zonke izinsalela ezivela ezibhokisini: umanyolo, ama-herbicides, nama-pesticides, kanye nezitsha zamakhowe ukuvimbela ukuvuvukala. Hlola noma yiziphi izingxenye ezonakele noma eziphukile bese uzifaka ngezintsha. Faka i-lubricant emshinini nasemakhanda apholile ngamanzi noma i-grease ukuvimbela ukuvuvukala. Faka i-lubricant kuwo wonke ama-bearings. Qinisekisa ukuthi izihlahla zifakwe ngendlela engazithinti umhlaba bese ubeka ukulima endlini. Beka ukulima ngendlela yokuthi amawheels angathinti umhlaba.
Yini eyenzeka ngokuphathwa nokugcinwa kwemishini? Lezi zithombe ze-traktor esebenza emapulazini kanye ne-toolbox enezingxenye zangaphakathi zikhuluma ngendaba yokuphatha nokugcina imishini. Le regression ayenzeki ngokushesha - kwenzeka ngesikhathi eside sokunganaki imishini yakho. Ukusebenzisa imishini kubalulekile kwezolimo okuletha inzuzo yezezimali - ngaphandle kwemishini, umsebenzi uzoba nokulinganiselwa kokwenziwa ngumuntu oyedwa kuphela. Ukuphatha imishini kahle kufanele kube into eyenziwa nsuku zonke - ukuhlola njalo nokuhlola kuzovimbela izingozi ezingaba khona. Imishini ivame ukuhamba phansi ngesikhathi leyo mishini isebenza - leyo yisikhathi esifanele sithanda le mishini kakhulu. Uma ulandela izinqubo zokuphatha imishini ezovimbela ukuhamba phansi kwayo, kuzokusiza ugweme izindleko eziphezulu nokuchitha isikhathi esiningi. Isikhathi esichithwa uma imishini ihamba phansi ngesikhathi somsebenzi obalulekile singaba yingozi enkulu kumlimi. Le pamphlet kaDisemba ibhalwe ngesikhathi lapho kunezinto eziningi eziphathelene nezolimo futhi abalimi banomsebenzi omningi - ukutshala izitshalo, ukuhluza, ukuhluza imithi yokubulala izimpukane, kanye nokuvuna. Ukuhlola njalo i-traktor yakho nsuku zonke kubalulekile, kodwa le misebenzi ivame ukungaqhubeki. I-air filter ingaba dirty futhi ingavala. Lokhu kuzokwenza i-traktor yakho idle kakhulu i-diesel futhi ilahlekelwe amandla. I-air filter ingawa futhi udoti lungangena emshinini, kudala ingozi enkulu ngokushesha. Izinga le-oyela lingawa, futhi umshini ungonakaliswa kakhulu ngenxa yokunganele ukuhlinzeka ngoyela. I-oyela ingaba dirty kakhulu, futhi izingxenye ngaphakathi komshini zingaguga ngokushesha. Uhlelo lokupholisa lungalahlekelwa yi-coolant, futhi umshini uzoshisa, unikeze umonakalo kuma-bearings, ama-pistons, kanye nezivalo. I-fuel filter engcolile ingavala futhi ibangele umshini ukuthi ungasebenzi kahle futhi ingabangele ukuthi ume. Izingxenye eziphukile noma ezingabhaliswanga kahle zingaphuka, zikhululeke, futhi zibangele umonakalo, futhi i-traktor ingaba yingozi kuwe. Gwema lezi zinkinga ezibizayo kumishini yakho ngokuthatha isikhathi esincane nsuku zonke ngaphambi kokuthi uqale umsebenzi. Hlola futhi uhlanze i-air filter. Hlola izinga le-oyela. Hlola i-coolant futhi uyigcwalise. Faka ama-grease kuwo wonke amaphuzu. Hlola i-fuel filter. Lokhu kungase kubonakale njengomsebenzi omningi othatha isikhathi eside, kodwa uma ulandela lezi zinyathelo nsuku zonke, i-traktor izoqhubeka isebenza isikhathi eside, futhi uzokwazi ukujabulisa imivuzo ekupheleni konyaka. Ekupheleni kwentwasahlobo, imishini eminingi igcinwa kuze kube yisikhathi sokutshala ngonyaka olandelayo. Susa yonke imfucumfucu, umhlabathi onamafutha, kanye ne-grease engcolile. Izindlela zokugcina nokugcina zikusiza ukuthi ulungiselele unyaka ozayo kalula, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umshini wakho wokufafaza usebenza kahle kokubili manje nangesikhathi esizayo. Uma amakhemikhali engena futhi aphuma emshinini wakho wokufafaza kaningi isikhathi eside, kungaholela ekuboleni kwezingxenye zomshini, ukwehla kwezinga, nokudliwa kombala kanye nezixhumanisi zikagesi. Izinto ezisele (amakhemikhali) zingaba yingozi kubantu abasebenza nalolo mshini noma eduze kwalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amakhemikhali asalele angadala ubungozi uma usebenzisa lowo mshini unyaka omusha. Ukuphepha kusho ukuthi kufanele uzinakekele, umndeni wakho, abasebenzi bakho, nezitshalo zakho, ngakho kubalulekile ukuhlanza umshini wokufafaza njalo ngesikhathi usebenzisa wona nangemva kokuwugcina. Khumbula ukuthi amakhemikhali amaningi asetshenziswa kwezolimo angaba yingozi ezitshalo nasemathunjini - qaphela indlela owasebenzisa ngayo ukuze ugweme noma yiziphi izingozi ezingase zenzeke. Indlela ephelele yokuphatha nokugcina umshini wokufafaza ihlanganisa izinyathelo ezinhlanu. Izokhombisa izinhlobo zezinto zokuvikela zomuntu (PPE) ezizokuvikela ezinhlelweni. Ukuhlanza kusho ukususa wonke amakhemikhali angaphezu kokuphuma noma ngaphakathi emshinini. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele udlule emanzini ahlanzekile kuwo wonke amagama omshini, futhi ilebula izokutshela ukuthi ungayilahla kuphi leyo mansi ukuze ugweme ukudala izingozi. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ithangi lihlanziwe, ligcwalise ngamanzi ahlanzekile kuze kube phakathi, uhambise umshini wokufafaza emgwaqweni omncane - lokhu kuzokwenza amanzi athokozise ethangini futhi ahlanze zonke izindawo. Ukuhlanza ngamafutha amancane (10% yethangi) kungcono kunokugcwalisa ithangi bese uhlanza kanye kuphela. Kufanele uhlanze kathathu noma ngaphezulu. Khetha indawo efanele yokulahla noma ukufafaza amanzi owahlanzile, indawo engasondelene nalapho amanzi ahlanzekile asetshenziswa khona, lapho kunezinye izitshalo, nendawo lapho amanzi azomisa khona isikhathi eside edala izingozi kubantu, izinto, nomhlaba. Ungawalahla eduze kwegadi noma emgwaqweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukhupha amanzi ethangini ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo ilebula yekhemikhali. Ungavuli nje ama-valve emanzini ukuze avumele ukuhamba phansi. Sebenzisa ama-nozzles amakhulu ukuze ukhiphe amanzi ngokushesha. Uhlaka lomshini wokufafaza kufanele luhlanzwe kahle. Siphinda: uma uhlanza umshini, qaphela ukuthi amanzi awagxili ezindaweni lapho izingane, izilwane, izinkomo, nezinye izilwane zingangena khona. Lahla amanzi owahlanzile ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo ilebula, ufafaze leyo mansi endaweni lapho wawufafaza khona ikhemikhali (izindawo zemifino lapho wawufafaza khona iyindawo efanele). Futhi, lahla amanzi ngemva kokuhlanzwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amanzi asuswe ethangini ngaphambi kokugcina umshini ngoba amanzi asalele angadala izingozi uma eba iqhwa. Ngemva kokuhlanzwa, ungabheka umshini ukuze ubone ukuthi kukhona yini izingxenye eziphukile futhi uhlole. Nokho, umshini ohlanzekile kufanele ugqoke izingubo zokuvikela. Kungase kube namakhemikhali asalele kwezinye izindawo. Isimo nokuhlala kwepampu kufanele kulungiswe uma ikhululekile. Uma umshini uhlanzekile futhi umisiwe, kufanele shine, futhi ungacabanga ukususa ezinye izingxenye ezingase zibe nomonakalo uma umshini ugcinwa. Susa ama-filters futhi uwashise ngesandla ngamanzi nesepha (khumbula ukugqoka amagilavu ukuze uvikele izandla zakho ekuthinteni amakhemikhali), bese uhlanza futhi ubeke endaweni ethile noma ubuyisele emshinini. Bheka isimo sama-nozzles nama-valve ngokucophelela. Kungase kube namakhemikhali asalele angase aqinise ebusika, futhi umshini ungase ungasebenzi unyaka ozayo. Susa ama-tips, ama-filters, nama-valve, uhlole kahle, bese ubuyisela. Washa wonke lawo owahlanzile. Gcina endaweni evaliwe - khumbula ukuhlabela ukuthi kukhona ini ngaphakathi. Beka ama-valve endaweni engasoze yahlala ibanda kakhulu ebusika njengoba angase abe nomonakalo. Susa wonke ama-pressure gauges futhi uvale izimbobo lapho usuwasuse khona. Gcina endaweni engasoze yahlala ibhujiswa futhi ingaliboni ubanda obukhulu. Ekugcineni, engeza i-antifreeze kuzo zonke izingxenye zomshini. Engeza i-antifreeze kumapayipi epampu. Lokhu kuzokwenza amapayipi avikeleke ukuze angabandi. Vala wonke ama-nozzles ukuze i-antifreeze ihlale ngaphakathi, uvule kancane ukuze i-antifreeze ikwazi ukuhamba kuyo yonke indawo. Vala uma ubona ukuthi umshini ugcwele. Inhloso yokwenza konke lokhu ukususa wonke amanzi asalele emshinini nokufaka i-antifreeze ezinhlelweni. Kufanele ushiywe i-antifreeze ngaphakathi emshinini ukuze uvikele ukuhamba okungase kwenzeke uma kusekhona umswakama ngaphakathi. Abanye abantu basusa ipampu ngaphambi kokugcina umshini, ungabeka ama-valve kule pampu evaliwe ukusiza ngalolu suku. I-antifreeze yezimoto zokuzijabulisa (RVs) ivamise ukusetshenziswa emishinini yokufafaza esebenza kwezolimo. Akuyona efana ne-antifreeze evamise ukusetshenziswa ezimotweni ngoba ayiqukethe amakhemikhali ayingozi angalimaza izilwane. Izinhlobo eziningi ze-RVs zizoba ziqinile ezimweni ezibandayo, kodwa ngokuvamile ziqinile njengeqhwa. Nokho, funda ngokucophelela ukuthi ilebula lithi ngalesi sikhathi ukuze ukhethe okukhona okufanele kuwe. Manje njengoba umshini wokufafaza uhlanzekile, ulungiselelwe ukugcina ebusika, kufanele ubekwe. Uma kungenzeka, gcina ngaphakathi lapho ungatholi khona umonakalo ngenxa yesimo sezulu. Kodwa le ndawo akufanele ibe seduze nalapho kukhona udaka. Noma yisiphi uthuli olungase lube khona luzobola umbala nezinsiza zensimbi zomshini. Uma ungafuni ukusebenzisa i-antifreeze uma ugcina umshini, kungaba kuhle ukususa ipampu bese uyibeka phezulu emgodini kuze kube unyaka omusha. Ngokuvamile, amanzi ahlala epampu, futhi ebusika, ukuhamba kungaholela ekutheni ipampu ingasebenzi.
Ukuphatha kahle ithuluzi lokutshala kungaholela ekukhiqizeni okukhulu noma ekuchithweni kwemali enkulu. Izinto ezibalulekile uma ufuna ukutshala zifaka: ukukhetha izinhlobo ezinhle zezinhlamvu, ukuzibeka kahle emhlabathini, ukuzifaka kahle emhlabathini, nokuzicindezela ngendlela eqinisekisa ukuthi kunezixhumanisi ezinhle phakathi kwezinhlamvu nomhlabathi. Uma ithuluzi lingasebenzi kahle ngenxa yokuphathwa kabi, ungase ungafinyeleli ekukhiqizeni okukhululekile. Ithuluzi lokutshala liyimishini eyenzelwe ukusebenza kahle, ngakho kufanele igcinwe ngokucophelela. Ake sibheke okumele sikwenze. Hlanza ithuluzi kahle kuzo zonke izindawo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awekho izinto ezingaphandle ezingavimba izingxenye zethuluzi ekusebenzeni kahle. Bheka ukuthi izingxenye ezifana nomunwe ohlanganisa izinhlamvu aziphukile noma zibhujiswe; lungisa noma shintsha izingxenye ezidala. Bheka umoya noma ithuluzi elisebenza ngempahla; futhi qinisekisa ukuthi ama-seal awavuzi, ikakhulukazi uma usebenza idiskhi noma idrum. Qinisekisa ukuthi ingaphansi kwamapulazi ebhakede isaqinile. Shintsha izingxenye ezidala, ezifana nezinsimbi zokusika, ama-opener, ama-spring, kanye nepulazi eliphansi lebhakede - zonke izinto eziphukile nezibhujiswe. Bheka zonke izikhonkwane ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ziqinile; futhi qinisekisa ukuthi ama-hoses awavuzi uma usebenzisa umanyolo wamanzi. Uma izingxenye zemishini ezikhipha umanyolo owomisiwe noma ama-herbicides zifakwe ngophethiloli noma uwoyela uma ithuluzi lisetshenziswe, susa lowo mphethu. Ngesikhathi sokutshala, kufanele ubeke ithuluzi endaweni yokugcina noma ulifake ebusuku ukuze uvimbele umswakama ukuthi ungene emabhakede. Lubricate ithuluzi lokutshala njalo ngokuhambisana nesheduli ekhombisa kwincwadi yokusebenza. Sebenzisa amafutha afanele. Ukuze uvimbele umswakama ukuthi ungene ezindaweni zokuhlanza, hlambulula njalo ngaphambi kokuhlobisa. Phuma kuyo yonke imikhiqizo ethunyelwa emabhokisini omanyolo kanye nama-herbicide futhi uwashe. Futhi, hlanza amapulazi ngaphansi kwamabhakede abamba izinhlamvu ukuze uvimbele ukuvimbela nokugqokwa. Bheka ukuthi awekho izingxenye zemishini eziphukile noma zibhujiswe futhi uzishintshe ngaphambi kwesizini entsha yokutshala. Lubricate izinsimbi zokuvula nezindawo ezithambile ezixhumana nomhlabathi ngophethiloli noma uwoyela ukuze uvimbele ukuvimbela. Lubricate zonke izindawo zokuhlanza. Phakamisa izingxenye futhi uqinisekise, bese ubeka ithuluzi endaweni yokugcina. Phakamisa ithuluzi bese ulifaka ezisekelweni ukuze amakhanda angahlali emhlabathini. ISIXWAYISO: Ungabeki ithuluzi uma kusasele ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesilinda se-hydraulic. Ukuze unciphise ingcindezi ye-hydraulic, vala itrekta bese ushintsha ama-levers phambili naphambili. Bese ungaxhuma ama-hoses e-hydraulic bese ususa isilinda uma uthanda. Iziqondiso ze-tractor kanye neziqondiso zethuluzi ziqukethe imiyalezo yokuphepha. Lapha sizoxoxa ngengxenye yale miyalezo. Lezi ezilandelayo ziyiziqondiso ezijwayelekile zokusebenzisa ithuluzi ngendlela evimbela izingozi ezifana nezilonda. Njalo phakamisa ithuluzi emhlabathini uma lingasetshenziswa. Uma kungenzeka, zama ukususa ithuluzi noma nini lapho kudingeka izilungiso noma ukulungiswa. Njalo qinisekisa ukuthi ubeka izisekelo uma udinga ukusebenza ngaphansi kwethuluzi ukuze uvimbele ukuthi lingawela kuwe. Vumela umuntu oyedwa kuphela, umsebenzisi, ukuba ku-tractor uma itrekta kanye nethuluzi kusebenze. Ukuhlanza, ukuhlinzeka, nokulungisa ngenkathi imishini isebenza kungadala ingozi yokulimala. Ukuma nokuhamba phezu kwethuluzi ngenkathi isebenza kungase kube yingozi ngoba ungawa. Phatha amakhemikhali ezolimo ngokucophelela futhi ugqoke izigqoko zokuvikela. Ukusebenzisa izinhlobo ezingafanele zamakhemikhali kungabeka abantu, impahla, izitshalo, nomhlabathi engcupheni. Landela iziqondiso zalabo abakhiqize amakhemikhali.
Uthatha kahle izinkomo zakho noma izinkomo zezimboni zakho zikhombisa ukuthi uzinika ukudla kahle. Uzwakala kanjani uma ubheka umkhiqizo wakho omuhle? Ubuye ubheke izinkambu zakho ngemuva kokuvuna? Yini eyenza umlimi oyedwa aphumelele kanti omunye ehluleka? Singaxoxa ngalesi sihloko isikhathi eside. Kodwa konke lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izizathu zalokhu zihlobene nokuthi ibhizinisi lezolimo liphathwa kanjani - indlela yokuphatha umhlaba nezolimo? Kunezincazelo eziningi zokuphathwa kwezimboni, kodwa uma sihlanganisa zonke, zisho into efana kakhulu, zithi ukuphathwa kwezimboni "kuwukusebenzisa nokuhlanganisa zonke izinsiza ngendlela ezokwenza umphumela omuhle ebhizinisini lezolimo." Abanye bangase bashiye ukuthi lokhu kungase kwenzeke, kuyisiphephelo nje, kodwa ake sibheke incazelo esiqale ngayo: inhloso nenhloso yebhizinisi lezolimo. Singasho ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko ngaphezu kwazo zonke ezinye wukwenza inzuzo, hhayi kuphela inzuzo yamanje kodwa nezinsiza ezizotholakala esikhathini esizayo. Yebo, kuzoba nezinye izinhloso ezifana nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yokuphila kwakho, ukukhiqiza okuthile okuzodingwa ngabathengi, nezinye izinhloso. Kodwa zonke lezi zinhloso zingafezeka kuphela uma kukhona inzuzo. Nokho, akusiyo ngempela inhloso; abakhiqizi abaningi bakhetha ukuhlala emasimini futhi baphathe ibhizinisi labo lezolimo ngoba kuyimpilo enhle nepholile. Kodwa uma inzuzo ingasekho, le mpilo epholile ayisapholile. Lapho sikhuluma ngezindaba zezimali, inhloso izoba lokhu: imali oyifakile kufanele ibuyisele kuwe futhi engeziwe, ngamagama amanye, sifuna ukwenza inzuzo. Ngamafuphi, singasho ukuthi inani lenzuzo (P) lizotholwa uma sithatha imali engenayo (I) bese sithatha izindleko (E): (P = I - E noma I - E = P). Incazelo engenhla ikhuluma ngezinsiza njengabantu nezinto zomzimba; singasho ukuthi zihlobene nokukhiqiza: njengokuphatha ibhizinisi, abasebenzi, umhlaba, nemali etholakalayo. I-labor ihlobene nabasebenzi obaqashile. Umhlaba uhambisana nomhlaba (umhlabathi (izinkambu), izinkomo (izindawo zokugaya), amanzi). Imali etholakalayo ibhekisela emalini esandleni nakwezinye izinto ezingasuswa zafakwa kwenye indawo, njengezakhiwo, izithiyo, izinkanyezi, nezindawo zokugcina, njll., nezinto ezingahanjiswa zafakwa kwenye indawo, njengezithuthuthu, imishini, izimoto, izinkomo, nemali ezokhiqizwa, njll. Umsebenzi wokuphatha uhambisana nemisebenzi emine: ukudala amasu, ukuhlanganisa la masu, ukuwaphumeza, nokuphatha le misebenzi. Ukudala amasu kusho ukuthi kuzokwenzekani, kanjani, nini. Ukuhlanganisa amasu kusho ukuthi ubani ozokwenza okuthile, nini, kuphi kuzokwenzeka (izinsiza zizoya kuphi). Ukuwaphumeza kusho lokho kuphela: ukwenza nokuhlanganisa le misebenzi ezinkambini. Ukuphatha kusho ukuhlola okwenzekile - mhlawumbe bekulungele, mhlawumbe bekubi - nokuthi kwaba khona ini ngesikhathi amasu adalwa futhi ahlanganiswa, bese sithola izizathu ezizochaza izinto ezingahambanga kahle ukuze amaphutha angaphindiwa esikhathini esizayo; konke kufanele kuhambisane kahle. Ngesikhathi umphathi esebenzisa imisebenzi ethile ehambisana nemisebenzi emine, kufanele aqhubeke futhi abambe izigubhu; yibo abakhombisa indlela phambili, yibo abathumelelayo ukuxhumana nabasebenzi babo kwezolimo nakwabanye ngaphandle, yibo ababelana imisebenzi ethile kumuntu, yibo abahlanganisa izingxenye zebhizinisi labo, yibo abakhuthaza abasebenzi babo ukuba basebenze kahle, futhi yibo abaphatha kahle ngoba kufanele balandele futhi balalele lokho abakukhulumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma ibhizinisi lezolimo lifuna ukwenza inzuzo njalo futhi lifinyelele zonke izinhloso ezibekiwe, leli bhizinisi kufanele likwazi ukukhiqiza nokuthengisa le mveliso - ngakho-ke umkhiqizo kufanele ube okuthile okuzodingwa ngabathengi. Lapho sikhuluma ngomkhiqizo ojwayelekile, singasho ngokujwayelekile ukuthi kungaba ukudla, umkhiqizo (ukhukhamba), izinkomo (izinkomo), noma inyama nezinye izilwane. Lapho sikhuluma ngezidingo zabathengi, sikhuluma futhi ngezinto ezifana nekhwalithi nentengo yomkhiqizo, isikhathi esizotholakala noma ukufinyeleleka, indawo ezotholakala kuyo, nokuthi iyiphi uhlobo lokupakisha ezoba nakho. Ake sibuyisele ekubalwa kwenzuzo: inzuzo - izindleko = inzuzo/ukulahleka (I - E = P/L). Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi konke esikwenzayo noma esingakwenzi lapho siphatha ibhizinisi lethu kuzoboniswa kulokhu kubalwa kwenzuzo. Inzuzo ingakhula futhi yehlise, futhi ngendlela efanayo, izindleko zingakhula futhi zehlise. Siyacabangela lokhu ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho sisebenzisa ifoni ngaso sonke isikhathi; kuyadingeka ngempela noma cha. Siyacabangela lokhu uma sihamba edolobheni kaningi. Ingabe sinika izinkomo zethu ukudla okukhuthazayo uma kudingeka? Ingabe izithuthuthu nemishini zihlolwa njalo, zilungiswa uma kusen isikhathi? Ngakho-ke, ukuphathwa kwezimboni kungachazwa kanje: ukudala amasu, ukuhlanganisa, ukuwaphumeza, ukuphatha abasebenzi bakho, umhlaba wakho, nezinto zonke ezingafakwa kwenye indawo, nokuphatha zonke izinto ezingafakwa kwenye indawo nemali yokukhiqiza. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke kuphela uma umlimi eqhubeka, ethatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo, exhumana nabasebenzi ukuze balalele, bese ekwazi ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo okudingwa ngabathengi futhi ezokwenza inzuzo. Imibuzo obuzile ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi ingabuye ibuzwe: ingabe udala amasu, ingabe uhambisana nawo, ingabe uwaphumeza, futhi ingabe uphatha kahle ukuze ube nempilo yezinkomo zakho? Ingabe udala amasu, ingabe uhambisana nawo, ingabe uwaphumeza, futhi ingabe uphatha kahle ukuze ube nezinkambu zakho? Ingabe udala amasu, ingabe uhambisana nawo, ingabe uwaphumeza, futhi ingabe uphatha kahle uma uqala ukukhiqiza ukudla - ingabe uthathile amasampula omhlabathi ukuze uhlole? Imisebenzi emine ingaqhathaniswa nezinqola zezimoto noma izithuthuthu. Iwashi ngalinye linomsebenzi walo; kumele likhishwe kahle ukuze imoto iqhubeke kahle. Uma iwashi elilodwa lingakhishwanga kahle noma linganawo umoya, imoto izokwazi ukuqhubeka kodwa ngezinselelo, ekugcineni, kuzokwenzeka ingozi, imoto izoma, futhi ngeke ikwazi ukuqhubeka. Lokhu kuyi-challenge (vuka!) esikhathini esizayo: uma indlela yakho yokuphatha ibhizinisi lakho ingathuthukisi unyaka nonyaka, ekugcineni ibhizinisi lakho lizoma, alizukuhamba, ngoba ngeke ukwazi ukwenza inzuzo. Awukwazi ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho ngendlela efanayo unyaka nonyaka; kumele uthuthukise ngokwandisa imali engenayo nokwehlisa izindleko. Inzuzo ingakhuliswa ngokuthuthukisa ukumaketha noma ngokwandisa umkhiqizo ngehektare (ukhukhamba - ama-ton/hektare) noma ngokulima ngendlela ehlukile, njengokwenza ngcono amasu athile okukhiqiza noma ungashintsha izitshalo ozivamile ukuhlinzeka ngazo noma uhlanganise nezozikhumbulayo. Izindleko zingancishiswa ngokuzama ukuthola isivumelwano esingcono sentengo uma ufuna imali yokuqala yokutshalwa, noma ngokusebenzisa amasu
Ukuthola isisho: Uma ungalinganisi zonke izinto, ngeke ukwazi ukuphatha (ukusebenza) ibhizinisi lakho. Sonke siyazi ukuthi ukuhweba kwezolimo kuyibhizinisi. Uma ufuna ukuba umphakathi wezolimo, kunezinto eziningi okufanele uqaphele uma ufuna ibhizinisi lakho likunikeze inzuzo. Inhloso eyinhloko iwukwenza inzuzo futhi uqhubeke uyithola esikhathini esizayo. Konke okwenziwayo epulazini kunomthelela ezinzuzweni ozitholayo. Inzuzo - Izindleko = Inzuzo noma Ukulahleka. Kukho umlayezo okhombisa ukuthi yini engaba khona futhi/noma ukuthi yini okufanele kwenzeke futhi/noma ukuthi yini edingekayo mayelana nezici zomthetho ezihlobene nokuphatha izinto ezihlukene ezihambisana nokusebenza kwebhizinisi lepulazi. Nokho, lo mlayezo ulandelwa umphathi wepulazi noma cha, usenkathini yephathi/umkhiqizi. Ulwazi - kokubili ngaphandle nangaphakathi (amarekhodi) kubalulekile kakhulu. Ibhizinisi lepulazi eNingizimu Afrika ingxenye yamabhizinisi omhlaba avulekile manje (idolobha lomhlaba), ngakho-ke kuzothinteka yilokho okwenzeka emhlabeni. Iphulazi lingabhekwa njengohlelo olungcwele oluthinta zonke ezinye izinhlelo zokulima - luhlobene nazo zonke izinto emhlabeni. Ngokuvamile sizwa okulandelayo: "Kungani abanye abalimi endaweni ethile bephumelela kanti abanye abalimayo endaweni efanayo ngezimo ezifanayo behluleka, noma kungani abanye abalimi bephumelela ezikhathini ezinzima kanti abanye ozakwabo behluleka?" Impendulo ithi: abanye abakhiqizi baphatha ibhizinisi labo lezolimo ngendlela efanele. Kodwa yini ukuphatha (ukusebenza), njengoba lapha, ukuphatha ipulazi? Ukuphatha ipulazi kungachazwa njengokwenza izinqumo ezifanele mayelana nezinsiza zabantu nezinsiza zezinto umlimi asebenza nazo ukuze afeze ngempumelelo izinhloso zaleso bhizinisi. Ukuze umkhiqizi aphumelele mayelana nalokho okukhulunywe ngenhla, kufanele asebenzise amasu amane okuphatha: amasu okuhlela kusenesikhathi, ukuhlanganisa lawo masu, ukuwasebenzisa, nokubheka lelo work ngendlela efanele. Singahlukanisa lezo zinhloso, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umsebenzi wokuphatha ibhizinisi ungumsebenzi oqhubekayo, umsebenzi awupheli. Inqubo yokuphatha, umkhiqizi kufanele ahlaziye izici ezihlobene nokuphatha ibhizinisi: ukwenza izinqumo, ukuhweba, ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba basebenze ngenhloso, ukukala zonke izenzo, ukuphatha abantu ngokuqinile, ukudlulisa eminye imisebenzi kubantu abanamakhono, nokuhamba phambili. Ukuphatha ipulazi kungachazwa njengokwenza izinqumo ezihlosiwe ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezibekwe ekuqaleni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nepulazi yilokho abaphatha. Ukuphathwa okujwayelekile - umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuphepha, ukuphatha ingozi yomlilo, ubugebengu, nokuphepha okuphelele kwepulazi. Ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yokuphatha lezo zinto ezishiwo ngenhla nokwandisa inzuzo esikhathini esizayo kuzoxoxwa kulolu shwankathelo (Pula/Imvula) ezinyangeni ezizayo. Imiyalezo engakusiza ukwandisa inzuzo esikhathini esizayo mayelana nohlelo lokuphatha izophakanyiswa. Izidingo zokuhambisana nomthetho nazo zizobekwa phansi. Kodwa kusezandleni zomlimi ngamunye ukusebenzisa lezo zindlela. Asikwazi ukuphonsa umphakathi ukwenza konke. Mayelana nezimo zomthetho, kusezandleni zomlimi, futhi uma bengahambisani nalezo zimo, icala lizobekwa kubo, futhi asizokwazi ukubasiza.
Byline: UF.B. Peairs, waseColorado State University Extension, ungumcwaningi ogxile ekuphathweni kwezinsongo futhi unguprofesa wezifundo zokulima nezokuphathwa kwezinsongo. Dala ibhokisi leziqiniso: Iziqiniseko ezisheshayo... I-Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) iyibhaktheriya yomhlabathi ekhiqiza i-toxin ebulala izinsongo. Izinhlobo zemvelo ezitholakala ku-Bt zingafakwa ezitshalweni zokudla, zinika amandla okukhulisa i-toxin ebulala ezinye izinsongo, ngakho azilimali yilezo zinsongo. Ama-hybrids e-corn aqukethe lezi zinhlobo ze-Bt awalimali izinsongo ezivame ukuba yingozi enkulu. I-Bt corn isebenza kahle ekunciphiseni izinsongo futhi iyindlela eshibhile yokuphikisa ama-pesticides emichiza. Le teknoloji entsha ivula indlela yokuthuthukisa izinhlobo ezintsha zezitshalo ngokufaka izinhlobo zemvelo kwezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo. Lokhu kuhle ngoba singashintsha ezinye izici zezithombo ukuze zikwazi ukuphikisa ezinye izinsongo - lokhu kulula ngoba akufani nokukhetha izitshalo ezinamandla ngendlela ejwayelekile. Enye indlela ephumelelayo yale teknoloji entsha ukuthi ama-hybrids e-corn angaphikisa izinsongo ezithile - efaka izinhlobo zemvelo ezivela kubhaktheriya zomhlabathi. Lezi hybrids zibizwa ngokuthi "transgenic," kodwa hhayi zonke zingaphikisa izinsongo. I-Bt imele ibhaktheriya yomhlabathi ebizwa nge-Bacillus thuringiensis. I-Bt iphinde ibhekisele kumkhiqizo we-pesticide owenziwe kulezi bhaktheriya. Yini indima ye-Bt mayelana nezifo zezinsongo? Ezinye izinhlobo ze-Bt zibulala izinsongo zisebenzisa ama-toxins az known as insecticidal crystal proteins noma delta endotoxins. Lezi toxins ngokuvamile azibeki engozini abantu noma ezinye izinhlanga ezingezona izinsongo. Yini i-Bt corn? Ukukhiqizwa kwe-delta endotoxins kulawulwa yizinhlobo zemvelo eyodwa phakathi kwalezi bhaktheriya. Izinhlobo ezishintshiwe zingafakwa ezitshalweni ze-corn. Isitshalo se-corn esinolezi zinhlobo zemvelo singakhiqiza ama-delta endotoxins azobulala izinsongo ezithambekele kulolo hlobo lwe-protein. Kungani sisebenzisa izinhlobo zemvelo ezifana ne-Bt ku-corn? Ama-delta endotoxins ashiswa ezitshalweni ngokuvamile alahlekelwa ukusebenza ngenxa yokukhanya okwaziwa njenge-UV light. Nokho, ama-delta endotoxins akhiqizwa ngaphakathi kwesitshalo awalimali ukukhanya kwe-UV. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifo eziningi ezidalwa izinsongo zihluke ukuphathwa, zidinga ukusetshenziswa okukhulu kwamapesticides ajwayelekile, kodwa zingabulawa ama-delta endotoxins akhiqizwa ngaphakathi kwesitshalo. Kukhona futhi teknoloji yokufaka le toxin edala lezi zinhlobo zemvelo. Ingabe wonke amasimu e-Bt corn anama-toxins? Kuya ngezimo. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezinqumayo ukuthi kuphumephi ama-delta endotoxins esitshalo: indlela akhiqizwa ngayo kanye nesimo esiqala inqubo yokukhiqiza. Izinkampani zezim seed zisebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene ukukhiqiza ama-delta endotoxins, ngakho izinhlobo zama-hybrids zizohluka. Okukhona kwenzeka lokhu: igene ye-Bt ifakwa ezinsizeni zemvelo (material genetic) zesitshalo. Lokhu kukhombisa indawo lapho igene ye-Bt ingena khona (yikuphi i-chromosome nokuthi ikuphi kulowo chromosome, njll.). Indawo lapho igene ifakwa khona esitshalo izokhombisa ukuthi kuphumephi ama-endotoxins nokuthi mangaki azokhiqizwa. Okwamanje, teknoloji ayivumeli ukuphathwa kwendawo lapho igene ye-Bt ingena khona, ngakho ukufakwa kwale gene kuyahluka futhi izitshalo ezahlukene zikhishwa ezikhiqiza ama-endotoxins ahlukene. Isimo esiqala le nqubo sifana neswishi esitshela igene ye-Bt ukuthi nini nendawo yokuthi iqale ukukhiqiza ama-endotoxins. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezingaqala le nqubo futhi zihluke ngendlela ezisebenza ngayo, ngakho isimo esithile sizokhiqiza ama-endotoxins endaweni ethile nangemali ethile, kuholele kuma-hybrids ahlukene. Zingaki izinhlobo ze-corn ezine-Bt? Kukhona ama-hybrids ahlukene ane-Bt, amanye angavimba izinsongo ezihlasela izithombo kanti amanye ahlasela imizi. Ingabe wonke ama-hybrids e-Bt asebenza ngendlela efanayo? Ukuphatha izinsongo ezithile kuhambisana nenani lezinto ezikhiqiza inqubo yokukhiqiza efakiwe kwi-hybrid ethile. Khetha i-hybrid enezinto ezikhiqiza inqubo yokukhiqiza efanelekile endaweni okhulima kuyo - buza ukuthi i-hybrid ethile izokwazi ukuphatha izinsongo ezinzima kakhulu endaweni yakho. Ingabe i-Bt corn izosebenza kahle endaweni yami yokulima? Izinto ze-Bt azizokwenzi zibe nzima ukukhula kwama-hybrids. Ingabe i-Bt iyinto eyodwa efakwe ezinsizeni zemvelo ze-corn (genetically engineered)? Kukhona ama-hybrids amaningi anezici ezengeziwe, njengokumelana ne-herbicides. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezisakhangiswa, ezingatholakala esikhathini esizayo. Ingabe i-corn iyona kuphela isitshalo esishintshiwe nge-Bt? Cha, kunezitshalo eziningi ezishintshiwe ukukhiqiza ama-endotoxins. Nokho, i-corn ne-cotton zisetshenziswa kakhulu ngalendlela. Ingabe kukhona enye inzuzo yokusebenzisa i-Bt ngaphandle kokuvimba izinsongo ezihlasela izithombo ze-corn? I-Bt corn ivimba izinsongo ezihlasela izithombo ze-corn kodwa ayibulali ezinye izinsongo ezisizayo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuphatha ezinye izifo ezifana ne-rootworms. Ingabe kukhona okubi ngokusebenzisa i-Bt corn uma kuqhathaniswa nokuphathwa kwezinsongo okujwayelekile kwezinsongo ezihlasela izithombo? Izimpande ze-Bt corn ngokuvamile zibiza kakhulu kunezinye. Ungazitshala ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi lezo zinsongo zikhona noma cha. Ukuphatha ngamakhemikhali kukunika isikhathi sokubona ukuthi lezo zinsongo zikhona, futhi uma zivele ungakhokha ukuze uzisuse. Futhi, ukulandela izidingo ze-refuge kungakwenza kube nzima ukukhetha nokuvuna. Ngingakwazi ukutshala i-Bt corn ngikhohlwe ngezinsongo nezinsongo? Cha, i-Bt corn ayikwazi ukukwenza ukhohlwe ngezinkinga zalezi zinsongo. Kukhona ezinye okufanele zihlolwe futhi ziphathwe njalo. Ingabe kukhona okubi ngokusebenzisa i-Bt corn uma kuqhathaniswa nokuphathwa kwezinsongo okujwayelekile? Kungase kube nezinkinga zokumaketha nge-Bt corn, ikakhulukazi i-corn ethengiswa phesheya. Nokho, imakethe yomhlaba iyashintsha njalo, futhi asazi ukuthi imiyalezo mayelana nama-hybrids izokhuluma ngani esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuyinkinga kuphela uma umkhiqizo omusha wethulwa owenza lo msebenzi esitshalo. Kuphi engingasebenzisa khona i-Bt corn ekulimaleni kwami? I-Bt corn kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela ezindaweni lapho ubungozi bezinsongo buphezulu. Yini eyenzeka ukuvimbela insongo ehlasela izithombo ze-corn ukuba ijwayele i-Bt corn futhi iphile? Abacwaningi emanyuvesi, izinkampani zezim seed, kanye ne-EPA bonke basebenza ndawonye ukuthola amasu okuvimbela lokhu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezidingo ze-refuge nezindlela zokusetshenziswa. Yini isu le-refuge? Uma indawo ethile (refuge) ifakwe i-corn engama-Bt, izinsongo ezivela kule ndawo zizofa uma
Inyanga kaMashi yisikhathi esingabizi kakhulu uma kuziwa ekutholeni umumbu, kodwa yisikhathi sokulungiselela umkhiqizi ophumelelayo. Kubalimi bomumbu, isikhathi sehlobo sokuvuna sesidlulile, futhi manje sekuyisikhathi sokuphumula emumbini. Nokho, abaningi abalimi bomumbu banokukhiqiza izinkomo ezidlala indima ekusetshenzisweni okuphelele kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo emvelweni futhi kunciphisa ubungozi obuhambisana nokuvuna. Kukhona amaphuzu ambalwa abalulekile ahlobene nokuba ngumlimi wezinkomo zenyama, okuyindlela evamile yokufuya izilwane ezisetshenziswa abalimi bezitshalo. Lawa maphuzu ahlobene kakhulu nesimo nempilo yezinkomo. Ukukhulisa izinkomo ukuze kwandiswe inani lezinkomo esikhathini esizayo kubiza kakhulu, njengoba kuze kube yilapho inkomo inezinkomo zayo zokuqala, ayikhiqizi imali. Abakhiqizi abavumelani ngempela ngesimo esifanele sokukhulelwa kwezinkomo zokuqala, kodwa kulungile ukusho ukuthi kufanele kwenzeke phakathi kweminyaka emibili kuya kwemithathu. Uma inhlanzi ingadli kahle, izoba ncane kakhulu (izoba neqholo) futhi lokhu kuzokwehlisa usuku lokukhulelwa kwayo kokuqala. Empilweni yenkukhu, inhloso ukuhlinzeka ngenkukhu njalo ezinsukwini eziyi-365 (kwesinye isikhathi ngonyaka enyangeni efanayo). Uma iminyaka yenkukhu idlule lapho ikhulelwa okokuqala, kusho ukuthi izoba nezinkomo eziningi kuyo yonke impilo yayo. Inkomo ingabhekwa njengefektri yokukhiqiza izinkomo. Isikhathi sokukhulelwa kwenkukhu sithatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye futhi isuswa emadodeni ezinyanga ezimbili ezilandelayo ukuze umzimba wayo uphumule ngenkathi ikhiqiza ubisi lwezinkomo (izinkomo ziphila ngobusisi kuphela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuphila kwazo). Ngokwenkolo esikhona, kuzoba kuhle ukuba inkomo ikhulule futhi phakathi kwezinyanga ezintathu ngemuva kokukhulelwa ukuze ikwazi ukuba nezinkomo enyangeni efanayo unyaka nonyaka. Lokhu kuyisimo esifisayo, sinikeza ithuba lokukhiqiza okuphelele kokukhula kwenkukhu unyaka nonyaka, ngaphandle kokuphazamisa impilo yenkukhu. Uma inkomo ingadli kahle, ngeke ikwazi ukukhulelwa futhi iphathe inhlanzi njalo ngonyaka. Njengoba inani lokukhulelwa kwezinkomo likhula, njalo izinkomo ezitholakalayo zokuthengisa ekupheleni kwalonyaka. Ngobuchwepheshe, kungenzeka ukuthi inkomo ikhulule inhlanzi njalo ngonyaka. Nokho, kunezimo eziningi ezithinta iphesenti lokukhulelwa kwezinkomo, kodwa isimo senkomo uqobo siyinto ebalulekile (eminye imingcele ingabandakanya impilo yeqembu, inani lezinkomo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkomo, ikhono lokufuya izinkomo, njll.). Izinkomo ezingakhuleli njalo ngonyaka akufanele zigcinwe eqenjini - ziyizivakashi kuphela futhi azinikele emalini yokufuya. Inhlanzi eshayiwe, esanda kuzalwa iyisiqalo esihle, kodwa ukuze le nhlanzi ikhiqize imali, kufanele ikhuliswe ibe semnyakeni lapho ingathengiswa khona. Inhlanzi kufanele ikhululwe ikhululekile futhi iqinile ukuze ikwazi ukuzimela ngokushesha emama wayo futhi iqale ukukhula. Isimo sokudla kw mama sibalulekile kakhulu. Uma inkomo isesimweni esihle futhi idliwa kahle, izoba nesimo esihle sokuphatha nokukhulisa inhlanzi enempilo. Izinkomo ezifa ngaphambi kokukhululwa zimele ukulahlekelwa kumlimi. Kufanele kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuze kukhululwe u-100% wezinkomo ezizalwayo. Izinkomo eziningi ezikhululiwe zithengiswa ngesisindo, ngakho uma isisindo somzimba sikhulu, intengo ezotholakala nayo izoba phezulu. Usayizi wezinkomo uvame ukuhlobana nesimo sokudla senkomo kanye naleyo nhlanzi ngonyaka kanye nohlobo lwenkukhu. Uma inhlanzi ekhulelwe ivela kuyo yonke inkomo ikhululekile, njalo izokwenza imali ethile ethuthukise le msebenzi. Njengoba kushiwo, abalimi abaningi abakhiqiza izitshalo baphinde babe nezingxenye zokufuya ezisebenzayo - izinkomo (noma ezinye izilwane) zisebenzisa amapulazi emvelo, izinkundla (ezibhalwe ezindaweni ezinezinga eliphansi lokufuya), nezindawo ezinezimfucuza zomumbu. Ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo wezilwane kuhlobene kakhulu nekhono lokuhlinzeka ukudla okwanele, okuphakeme ngonyaka. Phakathi nezinyanga zehlobo, abakhiqizi abaningi bangathembela kumapulazi nezinkundla ukuze badle izilwane zabo, kodwa abakhiqizi abahle balungiselela izilwane zabo ezinyangeni ezibandayo nezomile. Njengoba ukuphela kwehlobo kuza, abalimi abaningi baphonsa ukudla okuluhlaza (ngokuvamile bekuwumumbu wokudla (ama-oats) phakathi kwemigqa yomumbu). Ngemuva kokuvuna umumbu, izinkomo nezimvu zivunyelwe ukugaya ezinkundleni lapho zidla izimfucuza zomumbu, amahlamvu omumbu adilika, nokudla okuluhlaza. Abanye abalimi baphonsa i-seradella phakathi komumbu. I-seradella iyisitshalo esinothile ngemifino esinokudla okuhle, okungahlinzeki kuphela ukudla okuhle kodwa futhi kwakha i-nitrogen emhlabathini ukuze isetshenziswe emvuthwandaba elandelayo. Inyanga kaMashi ingemuva kwesikhathi sokuphonsa umumbu wokudla (ama-oats) kanye ne-seradella, kodwa kusasele isikhathi sokuphonsa uhlobo lwe-rye. Nokho, khumbula ukuthi le ndlela ye-rye akufanele iphonseke yonke ngesikhathi esisodwa ngoba ikhula ngokushesha kakhulu futhi endaweni ethile, uzoba nokudla kwezilwane okweqile, okuzolandela isikhathi sokuhlupheka lapho kungasatholakali ukudla okwanele kwezilwane. Le ndlela ye-rye ayinambitheki uma inezithelo njengoba imicu yayo iklwebha umlomo, izindlebe, nezinyembezi zezinyoni. Uma unamapulazi aphonswe nge-eragrostis, inyanga kaMashi yisikhathi esihle sokuwagawula okokugcina. Isimo sebhande ngeke sibe kuhle kulolu suku, ngaphandle kokuba ubenze kahle, kodwa okungenani uzoba nokudla okuhle okungasetshenziswa ezinyangeni ezibandayo. Khumbula ukuthi ungakwazi ukuqhubeka nokwengeza ukudla okuhle ukuze izinkomo zikwazi ukukusebenzisa kahle njengokudla okungesihle. Nokho, uma ungenakho ukudla okuhle, ngeke ukwazi ukunakekela kahle izilwane zakho ukuze zibe sesimweni esihle ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngokugawula utshani ngokuhambisana nemigqa, uzokwazi uku fertilize umhlabathi entwasahlobo futhi uthole izitshalo ezinhle zotshani esizeni esilandelayo. Uma kungenzeka, vikela imigqa yotshani ezimeni zezulu ngokuyigcina ngaphansi kwempahla, noma okungenani, kufanele uyifake ngendlela enciphisa ukuvezwa kwayo emvula. Ezinyangeni zebusika, ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi udla kuphela izilwane zakho. Awufuni izilwane ezidla ezinye izilwane ukuba zigeze eqenjini lakho. Lokhu kuyisikhathi esihle sokwelapha izilwane zakho ngokususa amagciwane angaphakathi nezilwane eziphilayo (ama-ticks). Uma udinga iseluleko ngalokhu, ukhuthazwa ukuba uxhumane nebhizinisi lakho lendawo lezolimo, i-cooperative yabalimi bendawo, noma udokotela wezilwane bendawo (bazoba nezindawo zokuhlola nezokwelapha ezitholakalayo). Uma usebenzisa amapulazi omphakathi, kuzoba kuhle kubo bonke abasebenzisi uma abanikazi bezilwane bel
Ukumaketha ukuze kube nomphumela omuhle kudinga ukuba nomkhiqizo ofanele ukuthengiswa, endaweni efanele, ngentengo efanele, nangaleso sikhathi esifanele. Akukho okukhishwa ukuze kugcinwe uma kungenziwa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi amandla okuthile awanani; lokho kufanele kuhambisane nezidingo zomuntu ofuna noma odinga ukukusebenzisa. Isibonelo: ubisi abukhiqizwa ukuze kugcinwe kuze kube sezingalweni zomuntu ophuza. Amaphunga awakhiqizwa ukuze agcinwe kuze kufike ekhishini lapho ephekwa khona. Ngokufanayo, ummbila awukhiqizwa ukuze ugcinwe kuze kube sezingalweni zomuntu ozowusebenzisa noma odlayo. Kuze kube khona, umkhiqizi ngeke athole inzuzo ngemali abethelelayo, ngakho ukumaketha kubalulekile okufanele kucatshangelwe kahle ngisho ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukutshalwa. Kunabantu abacabanga ukuthi ukukhiqiza nokumaketha izinto ezahlukene; kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo ehambisanayo, ethatha ukudla kwemvelo futhi ikuguqule ukuze kusebenze abantu. Kubonakala ukuthi akukho okufanele kukhiqizwe okungadingeki ngabantu. Hlanganisa umcabango wakho nemakethe! Umkhiqizo okhiqiziwe kufanele ube yinto abantu abayidingayo futhi kufanele uthengiswe ngentengo ezokwamukelwa yilabo abayidingayo. Ikhono lokuphatha izimo zebhizinisi mayelana nezindleko ezifanele umkhiqizi kufanele aphathe ibhizinisi lakhe ngokuhambisana nezimiso zezimali ezizompreparela ukuze umsebenzi uqhubeke unenzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Impela, zonke izinyathelo zokuthuthuka komkhiqizi zihambisana nalezi zinyathelo umkhiqizi azithathayo lapho eqala ukuhlela amasu okuthengisa ukudla kwakhe ekugcineni. Kukhona izinto eziningi umkhiqizi okufanele azicabangele uma efuna ukuthengisa ukudla kwakhe. Yini engifuna ukukhiqiza? Ngizokhiqiza ukudla okukhona ukufunwa? Ngizokuthengisela bani lokhu kudla? Ngizokhiqiza nini futhi ngizokuthengisa nini? Zingaki izindleko ezizoba kule bhizinisi lami futhi yisiphi isilinganiso engizokwamukela lapho ngifuna ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wami? Yikuphi ikhwalithi yalokho engizokhiqiza? Ngizokwazi ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wami kwi-cooperative eduze? Ngizokwazi ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wami ngenkontileka esheshayo? Ngizokwazi ukuvikelwa komkhiqizo wami futhi ngiwuthengise kamuva uma intengo ikhuphukile noma uma imakethe inezinhlobonhlobo zokudla? Ingabe kubalulekile ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wami ngokushesha noma kufanele ngiqale ngicabangele izindleko ezingaba khona? Imibuzo leyo izotholakala ezimisweni zezimali esizixoxile ngenhla: ukuhlinzeka nokufuna. Sifuna ukukhuthaza abalimi ukuthi bagxile ekumaketheni kahle lapho behlela amasu abo okukhiqiza ngonyaka omusha. Abakhiqizi abaningi manje bayazi ukuthi kufanele kuqala kucatshangelwe izimiso zezimali zokumaketha. Kodwa abaningi basakholelwa ukuthi ukumaketha kuza ngemuva kokutshala, bekholelwa ukuthi kufanele baqale bagxile ekulimaleni, futhi ukumaketha kuzolandela emva kwalokho, ngemuva kokuvuna. Yebo, ukukhiqiza ngendlela efanele kubalulekile futhi, kodwa umkhiqizi kufanele aqhubeke efunda ngakho okwenziwa emakethe emhlabeni jikelele, amathuba atholakalayo okuthenga nokuthengisa eSouth African Futures Exchange (SAFEX) kwiJohannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE), kubalulekile futhi kumkhiqizi ukuthola ulwazi ngama-opportunities wokumaketha nezimo zezimali ezikhona. I-SAFEX iyinsiza ethathwa njengendawo lapho abakhiqizi bengaphatha khona amathuba akhona emakethe kanye nezingozi ezikhona emakethe yezolimo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Abalimi manje bangabeka umkhiqizo wabo kwi-SAFEX ukuze bathole intengo efanele ngesikhathi esifanele esizayo. Lokhu kungasiza abalimi ngoba kuzobavikela uma amanani ehla ngesikhathi sokuvuna noma uma kukhona ukudla okuningi emakethe. Ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kubhekene nengcindezi lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Izindleko zokuqala zokutshala zikhuphuka, kunezingozi eziningi ezingaba khona, ukuhlinzeka kudlula ukufuna, lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuhlinzekwa okweqile kokudla futhi amanani ehla, ngakho umkhiqizi akasatholi inzuzo ezokhokhela izindleko zakhe nezingozi ezingaba khona. Ekugcineni, singathi abalimi okwamanje abakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo. Umkhiqizi ngamunye kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezicabangela isimo sabo ukuze ahlele amasu abalulekile ngesikhathi esifanele ukusiza ibhizinisi labo. Abanye bangakhetha ukungatshali ukudla okuningi okwamanje, mhlawumbe bafuna ukulinda kuze kube imakethe ikhuphuka. Abanye abalimi bakhethe ukubheka izindlela zokulima ezihlukile ezifana "nokungatshali" ezizokwehlisa izindleko zokulima. Ngokushiya umkhiqizi wokudla okuyisisekelo njengengxenye yomshini emakethe yomhlaba ophoqayo emakethe, ngakho umkhiqizi oyedwa ngeke akwazi ukushintsha imakethe yomkhiqizo wabo. Lokhu kubenza babonakale njengabathengi benani, hhayi abakhiqizi benani, ngakho isu lokumaketha elikhethwe umkhiqizi libalulekile, kufanele licatshangelwe kahle, lwenziwe ngolwazi, ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukutshala.
Kungcono ukuba ne makethe ngaphambi kokutshala ukudla ofuna ukukhiqiza, ngoba kunezivuno eziningi ezitshala ngokushesha, bese zithemba ukuthi zizothola imakethe enhle uma zikhululiwe. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuba necebo lokumaketha umkhiqizo wakho ngendlela ezokwenza uzuze inzuzo enhle. Izindlela zokumaketha ezifanele kufanele zihambisane nezinhlelo zokuqala zokutshala isivuno ofuna ukukhiqiza. Ikhono lomlimi lokumaketha ukudla kwabo lingalingana nekhono labo lokutshala nokukhiqiza ukudla okuthile. Kufanele uthuthukise amakhono akho okuthengisa, futhi wandise ulwazi lwakho ngezindlela zokumaketha. Icebo lokumaketha elilandelwa ngumlimi oyedwa noma inkampani yokulima liyingxenye yezinto ezidingekayo uma ufuna ukuphatha izindleko nezingozi ngendlela efanele ukuze uzuze inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Ukulima kunezingozi eziningi, futhi kwesinye isikhathi zingavela ngezindlela ongazilindele. Ukushintsha kwemakethe kwenza kube nzima ukubheka phambili, kodwa kubalulekile. Icebo lokumaketha elihle lingasiza umlimi ukuthi wehlise izindleko kanye nokuphuma kwezingozi ezihlobene nokushintsha kwemakethe komkhiqizo wabo. Isimo sakho mayelana nezingozi ezikhona sizokukhombisa ukuthi yisiphi isikhumbuzo sokumaketha okufanele sikhethe kumkhiqizo wakho. Eminyakeni edlule, bekukhona uhlelo lokubamba imakethe ngentengo ethile, kodwa abalimisi abaningi baphikisa ukuthi abatholanga inzuzo efanele kulowo mkhiqizo. Okwamanje, imakethe yentengo ethile ayisekho; manje kukhona uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi 'imakethe yamahhala,' kodwa manje abalimisi bayaphikisa ngoba abakwazi ukuphatha lezo makethe ezahlukene. Zonke izindlela zokumaketha zihlobene nezinto ezintsha nezinsiza ezilindele phambili, kodwa kubalulekile kumlimi ukuthi athathe ithuba elizayo ukuze alisebenzise ukuze athole inzuzo. Ukwenza amaphutha kuyinto evamile empilweni yethu - ukwenza amaphutha ekulimini nakho kuyenzeka. Nokho, uma siqhubeka saphinda lezo ziphutha, ngeke siqhubeke phambili, ngeke sithuthuke; akufanele siphinde amaphutha endala - kungcono ukubhekana nezingozi ezintsha ezingavela bese sikwazi ukuqhubeka, siqhubeke phambili. Ingabe imakethe obuyifinyelele eminyakeni edlule ikwanelisile noma cha? Yiziphi izindlela zokumaketha ezisebenze kahle? Kungani ucabanga ukuthi izinyathelo ozithathile zisebenze kahle? Ingabe imakethe oyitholile ibaluleke kangakanani uma uyihlola uma uyiqhathanisa nemakethe ephansi, ephezulu emaphandleni noma uma uyihlola uma uyihlanganisa nemakethe ejwayelekile emhlabeni jikelele? Yiziphi izindlela zokumaketha ezingasebenzi kahle? Kungani ezinye zezindlela zakho zokumaketha zingasebenzi kahle? Uhlosile ukuthatha kanjani isu lakho lokulima eminyakeni eyi-12 ezayo nasezinyangeni ezi-5 ezayo - yini umphumela ozoba nayo ezindleleni ofuna ukuzenza ukuze umakethe umkhiqizo wakho ngesikhathi esithile? Yisiphi isimo samanje sebhizinisi lakho lokulima? Kufanele ubheke ukulima kwakho njengokubheka ibhizinisi. Hlola isimo sezomnotho sebhizinisi lakho jikelele. Kubalulekile ukuthi izitatimende zihlobane nezimali zonyaka odlule - lokhu kufanele kufake konke: izitatimende zenzuzo, izitatimende zezimali, imali engenayo nezincwadi ezihambelanayo. Izincwadi ezikhombisa inzuzo yesikhathi esizayo, ukungena kwemali nokuphuma kwemali, nezincwadi ezihambelanayo zizokusiza ukuhlola ukuthi imakethe yenkukhu engahlali ndawonye izoba nempembelelo kanjani ebhizinisini lakho. Ngesinye isikhathi sonyaka lapho ingenamali kwi-akhawunti, kungasiza ukuthola enye indlela yokumaketha yomkhiqizo wakho. Ukuqashwa, ukukhiqiza, nokuba necebo lokumaketha kuhambisana nokuthi uphatha kanjani izimali zakho. Uma ungazi ukuthi izindleko zakho zokutshala zingaki, kuzoba nzima ukunquma ukuthi mangaki umkhiqizo (ngama-ton) okudingayo ukuze uzuze inzuzo. Bala zonke izindleko zakho zokukhiqiza zokudla okuthile ngehektare. Bala izindleko eziphuthumayo - imbewu, umanyolo, idizili, ama-pesticides, izindleko zokusebenza, kanye ne-insurance. Bala izindleko eziyisisekelo ezizokwenziwa ekukhiqizeni izinkukhu bese uqhathanisa nalokho nemakethe yokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi uzokwazi yini ukuhlinzeka ngezindleko futhi uphinde uzuze. Funa imakethe ezokwenza uzuze leyo nzuzo. Izindleko eziyisisekelo zifaka: ukuqasha, intela (uma uthole imali), amaholo abantu abasebenza kuwe, kanye negesi (lezi zindleko ziqhubeka noma uthshala noma ungatshali). "Breakeven" ingachazwa kanje: inani lokuthengisa elizokwenza izindleko eziyisisekelo zilingane nalolo nani, ngaphandle kokwenza inzuzo. Ukukhiqiza izinkukhu ngokuvamile kuyingxenye yezinto ezijwayelekile ezenziwa epulazini ethile. Ukukhulisa izilwane emathunjini noma emapulazini nokuhlanganisa izinkukhu nezinye izimpahla zezilwane kungaba isizathu sokukhiqiza izinkukhu. Futhi izinkukhu zingaba isivuno esibalulekile epulazini lapho izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo zishintshashintsha. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuhlola nokubala zonke lezi zinto uma ufuna ukuthola inani lemakethe elithi 'minimali' - khumbula ukubala lezo zinsiza ezihlobene nokukhiqiza isivuno esithile. Ubuye ube sebhizinisini, ngakho uma ufuna ukuqhubeka ngebhizinisi lakho, kufanele uhlale uthola inzuzo ezinhlelweni ozisebenzisayo epulazini lakho. Kubalulekile ukuba umlimi ukukhiqiza ukudla - kunezinto eziningi okufanele zihlolwe ngaphambi kokuthatha izinyathelo ezithile. Uma ushiyela ukumaketha umkhiqizo wakho kuze kube sekugcineni, futhi ungawuqondi kahle ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani, kungcono uvakashele ibhizinisi le-Agribusiness eliseduze nawe ukuze uthole iseluleko. Qaphela lapho uthola khona iseluleko; kukhona abantu abaqotho lapho abangakusiza - baphande kuze kube uthola!
uhulumeni uveze ukuthi umkhakha wezolimo ubalulekile ku-conomy kanye nokuhlinzekwa kokuphepha kokudla, kuqala ekukhiqizeni kuya ekumaketheni. Isu likahulumeni lihlose ukudala uhlelo oluhlanganyelwe oluhlanganisa imithombo, abathengisi abaphakathi, nezinsizakalo zezolimo ezithuthukisa ukukhiqiza, ukusabalalisa, nokushintshisana kwezimpahla zokudla. Lesi isu sibalulekile kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ezolimo ezikhethekile, ukwakha idolobha, nezinye izitayela zomnotho. Uhulumeni uhlose ukukhulisa inqubo yokukhiqiza ethuthukisa inani lemikhiqizo yezolimo, izindawo, isikhathi, kanye nekhwalithi yezimpahla zokulima. Lokhu kukhuphuka kwenani emkhakheni wezolimo kuhlanganisa nezinqubo zokukhiqiza emasimini. Isu likahulumeni lidala uxhumano olubalulekile phakathi kwabakhangisi bokudla nabathengi, oluxhaswe yizinsiza zendawo, ubuchwepheshe, nemithetho yomphakathi. Isu lezolimo lishintshile ngenxa yezidingo ezishintshayo zabakhiqizi nabathengi. Isu lezolimo lifaka imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eqala ezingeni lokuqala iye emkhiqizweni wokugcina, njengokuthandwa kwabathengi. Ulwazi lwemakethe, ukuthengisa, nokuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kwezolimo kuthinta ukwethemba emakethe, kuthinta amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kumfanelo raw noma enezinhlaka ezingeziwe. Ukuphathwa kokukhiqizwa kubalulekile, futhi ukusebenza kahle kwesu lezolimo kunomthelela omkhulu kumakethe evunyelwe abakhiqizi, ngaleyo ndlela kuthinta izinqumo zabo. Imakethe ichazwa njengendawo lapho abathengi (abathengi) nabathengisi (abakhiqizi) behlangana futhi bashintshisana ngezimpahla noma ngezinsizakalo ngentengo abavumelana ngayo. Ukuxhasa inqubo yokwenza izinqumo mayelana nokuphathwa kwezolimo kubalulekile, kuhlanganisa nokuqonda ukuthi nini nokuthi kuphi ukuthengisa. Ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kulwazi lwemakethe oluchanile kubalulekile. Amanani nezindleko kudlala indima enkulu ezinqumweni ezithinta ezolimo. Amanani nezindleko kuthinta ukusabalalisa nokwabiwa kwezinsiza zezolimo. Intengo evunyelwe ibonisa ukuthi uma kukhona ukuphazamiseka emakethe, amanani, izinga lokusetshenziswa, nezinga lokukhiqiza konke kulawulwa yisikhathi nezinsiza. Abathengi babhekana nenkinga yokwenza ukukhetha. Banemfuno ehlukahlukene, kuhlanganisa lezo ezidinga izinketho - okusho ukuthi ukuthandwa kwabo akukhawulelwe emikhiqizweni ethile. Bazama ukukhetha imikhiqizo ehambelana nezidingo zabo kangcono, ngaphandle kokukhawulelwa yizindleko zemikhiqizo abayithandayo. Ukunikezwa kungachazwa njengobudlelwano phakathi kwentengo nenani elinikeziwe. Uma intengo yemikhiqizo iphezulu, abathengi bangase bangayithengi ngama-quantities amakhulu, kanti uma intengo iphansi, abathengi bazothenga kakhulu. Uma amanani ephezulu, kungase kube nabathengi abambalwa abavuma ukuthenga, kanti uma amanani ephansi, abathengi abaningi bazothenga. Lokhu kubudlelwano kungabhekwa njengoxhumano phakathi kwentengo nenani eliceliwe emakethe. Umthetho wokunikezwa uthi njengoba amanani ekhuphuka, inani elinikeziwe lenyuka, futhi njengoba amanani ehla, inani elinikeziwe lehla. I-curve yokucela ibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwentengo nenani eliceliwe. I-curve yokunikezwa ibonisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwentengo nenani elinikeziwe. Ukuphuma kwalezi zikhala kubonisa ukulingana kwemakethe. Intengo yokulingana iyindawo lapho inani eliceliwe lingama-quantities anikeziwe, futhi inani lokulingana lingumthamo abathengi abazimisele ukuwuthenga ngale ntengo. Intengo yokulingana ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "intengo yokucacisa emakethe," njengoba ihlangabezana nabathengi nabathengisi emakethe - abathengi bangathenga konke abakufunayo, kanti abakhiqizi bangathengisa konke abakufunayo. Izici ezithinta ukunikezwa zifaka izindleko zokukhiqiza, izimo zezulu, izifo, nezinye izinto ezingathinta ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo. Izici zokucela zifaka ukuthandwa kwabathengi, amanani, kanye nokutholakala kwezinketho. Imakethe yezolimo ithonywa izindleko zokukhiqiza, amanani, kanye nokutholakala kwezinsiza. Imakethe yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika ithonywa izitayela zemakethe yomhlaba, njengoba leli lizwe linengxenye encane emakethe yezolimo yomhlaba. Amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika athonywa ukunikezwa kwendawo nokucela, kanye nezimo zemakethe zamazwe omhlaba. Kukhona ngezizathu ezihlukahlukene ezibangela ukushintsha kwamamanani ezolimo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinguquko ezinqumweni zabakhiqizi mayelana nokukhiqiza, izimo zezulu, izifo, nezinye izinto zingathinta imakethe. Abakhiqizi bangaphatha ezinye izici zokunikezwa, kodwa hhayi zonke. Ngenkathi abakhiqizi bezama ukuhlela ukunikezwa nokucela, isimo semakethe singaba nezimo ezingalindelekile. Abakhiqizi bangalungisa amanani ngokuya ngezindleko ezilindelekile noma izimo ezithinta ukukhiqizwa kwabo. Esikhathini esedlule, kwakuvame ukucabanga ukuthi ezolimo eNingizimu Afrika zanele futhi zingahlangabezana nezidingo zendawo ngaphandle kokuthembela kumalungelo. Nokho, lokhu akusasebenzi. Emnothweni wanamuhla ophakathi kwezwe, akukho mkhakha wezimali, kuhlanganisa nezolimo, ongazinzile ngokuphelele. Amanani emikhiqizo yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika athonywa ukunikezwa kwendawo nokucela, kanye nezimo zemakethe zamazwe omhlaba.
