Ezinsukwini ezindala, ngaphambi kokuthi ukulima kube yinto ethokozisayo futhi enenzuzo, abalimi babengekho kakhulu ekukaleni. Babesebenzisa umquba otholakalayo emapulazini abo - bephonsa umquba okhona ngaphambi kokuvuna. Babesebenzisa amahhashi, izinkomo, noma amajuba pulling a plow, futhi bakha umhlaba ubude obungaphathwa yilezo zinyamazane. Babefaka imbewu ngezandla - besebenzisa kuphela izandla zabo. Babekhulisa ngezandla futhi bazama ukuvimbela izifo ngezindlela ezitholakalayo futhi bavuna ngezandla - bengazi ukuthi bangaki amahektare abebefake imbewu futhi bengazi ukuthi bangakanani umkhiqizo abazovuna. Babekuhlosile kuphela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uzokwanela ukuhlinzeka ngokudla etafuleni nasokukhulisa izinkomo unyaka ozayo. Kodwa manje izinto seziye zashintsha... Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nokukala - ukwanda kokukala nokubala kusilethele ikhono lokuqondisa nokwandisa indlela esiphatha ngayo umsebenzi wethu wokulima. Kulesi sithombe, sizohlola, sixoxe, futhi sithinte izinto esidinga ukuzikala njengezabalimi. Sidinga ukwazi usayizi wezindawo esihlosile ukuzifaka. Zonke izibalo zomquba, inani le-diesel, inani lembewu, inani lomquba, kanye nezinto zokwakha kufanele zihambisane nosayizi bezindawo ezizofakwa. Umhlaba uhluka ngezindlela eziningi: njengokujula nesimo. Kumele sazi uhlobo lomhlaba kanye nokujula kwawo endaweni ngayinye lapho sifuna ukufaka - ungacabangi ukuthi umhlaba wakho ufana kuwo wonke amakhaya! Uhlobo nokujula komhlaba kubalulekile kakhulu lapho ukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo okufanele ufake - ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo azinakufakwa emhlabeni ophakathi. Uma unamahektare anomhlaba ophakathi, akusho ukuthi uphakathi kokuphila - kusho nje ukuthi kufanele uqaphele iqiniso mayelana nezithelo ongazifaka kulezo zindawo ukuze uthole inzuzo (ngamanye amazwi, uhlobo lwezinyosi ezingafakwa emhlabeni ongenamandla ukuze kudaleke izinkomo ezizokuletha inzuzo). Zonke izitshalo zithola izinto ezidingekayo emhlabeni ukuze zikwazi ukukhula. Ezinye izinto ezifana nezimvula nokunyakaza kwamanzi ngaphakathi komhlaba zingathinta ukutholakala kwezinto emhlabeni. Uma umalimi ethatha amasampula omhlaba, bazokwazi ukubona ukuthi isimo sezinto sihamba kanjani nokuthi izinga le-pH likuphi emhlabeni. Uma umhlaba unokushisa kakhulu kodwa kukhona izinto ezanele, isitshalo ngeke sikwazi ukuthola lezo zinto. Uma singazi ukuthi isimo somhlaba sikhona, asikwazi ukukala ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo nokuthi zingaki izinto ezidingekayo ukuze kukhule ukudla okuhle. Zonke izinhlobo zezithelo zinebhande lokushisa elingaphezu kwalokho okukhona, ziba nezinselelo zokukhula kahle. Sidinga ukwazi ukuthi izinga lokushisa nezinga lokubanda kuzoba kanjani unyaka wonke, nokuthi lapho kuzoqala khona ukushisa. Uma sesinayo yonke le mininingwane, singakhetha ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lwezithelo oluhambisana nesimo sezulu nobude besikhathi sokukhula endaweni esilima kuyo. (Khumbula ukuthi isikhathi sokukhula siqala ngesikhathi sokufaka imbewu futhi siqhubeke kuze kube yisikhathi sokuvuna - isikhathi lapho kuqala khona ukushisa sizokutshela ukuthi isikhathi sokukhula siphelile). Kubalulekile kakhulu ukwazi ukuthi imvula iyenzeka kangakanani unyaka nonyaka endaweni lapho ulima khona, nokwazi ukuthi yisiphi isikhathi esivame ukuba nomoya. Sonke siyazi ukuthi asikwazi ukusho isimo sezulu lapho kufanele kube nemvula, kodwa uma sibheka izindlela zemvula unyaka nonyaka, singacabanga ukuthi kufanele silime kanjani unyaka ozayo. Namuhla, ukubikezela kwesimo sezulu kuyaqhubeka nokuba ngokunembile futhi kusitshela ukuthi sizolindela izimo ezimanzi nezomoya ezinyangeni ezizayo - kufanele sisebenzise le mininingwane ngendlela efanele. Ukukala inani lemvula akukhathazi (izinsiza zokukala eziphathekayo zingatholakala kalula futhi kufanele zibekwe ezindaweni ezahlukene emapulazini akho). Ngemuva kokuba imvula, kufanele ukale futhi ubhale phansi inani. I-millimeter eyodwa yemvula engena emhlabeni ithambisa umhlaba kancane - kufanele ukale inani lemvula ukuze wazi ukuthi umhlaba uthambiswe kangakanani. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukufaka inani elifanele lembewu ngehektare ukuze uthole umkhiqizo ofanele. Inani elifanele lezitshalo lihlukile ezindaweni ezahlukene futhi lingahluka endaweni eyodwa ngoba kungase kube nezinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlaba. Isizathu sokubaluleka kwenani lezitshalo sithi: isitshalo esisodwa sidinga inani elithile lezinto ezidingekayo namanzi ukuze sikwazi ukukhula ngokuphelele - uma inani lezitshalo liphansi kakhulu, umkhiqizo uzoba phansi, futhi uma kukhona izitshalo eziningi kakhulu, zizokhuphukana ngamanzi nezinto ezidingekayo, futhi umkhiqizo uzophinde ube phansi. Umkhiqizi kumele azi kahle ukuthi ubude bokuhlukanisa phakathi kwemigqa kufanele kube kanjani nokuthi izitshalo kufanele zibe seduze kangakanani komunye nomunye emigqeni - lokhu kubalulekile ekukhiqizeni izithelo zokudla. Izitshalo zidinga izinto ezidingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukukhula nokukhiqiza izithelo zokudla. Inani lezinto ezidingekayo lihambisana nomkhiqizo olindelekile (inani elijwayelekile umkhiqizi angalithola endaweni ethile kanye nezithelo ezithile). Umphumela wamasampula omhlaba uzokhombisa isimo sezinto ezikhona emhlabeni ngesikhathi esithile. Mayelana nalokhu, inani lezinto ezidingekayo lingakalwa. Umquba ubalulekile kakhulu uma sifuna ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle, kodwa ubiza kakhulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukubala nokuthola inani eliqondile lomquba esizowufaka emhlabeni. Lokhu kuyindawo enye lapho ukukala kubalulekile kakhulu. Zonke lezi zinto zokwakha ziza nelebuli ekhombisa inani elifanele lokufaka. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu. Inani le-pesticide kumele libalwe ngokucophelela ukuze umkhiqizi athole umkhiqizo omuhle ngaphandle kokulimaza izitshalo zabo noma imvelo. Inani le-pesticide ngokuvamile litholakala ngokukala i-pesticide namanzi bese uxuba - isibonelo, ilitha elilodwa le-pesticide lixutshwa nezilitha eziyi-250 ukuze kuphonswe ihektare eyodwa (lokhu kukala nakho kubalulekile). Izinto zokwakha ezisetshenziswa ekulimaleni zingaba yingozi enkulu futhi zibhujiswa - ngakho-ke, kufanele zixuthelwe kahle. Ukulinganisa umshini wokuphoqa kuyinto ebalulekile kwenye indawo yokulima. Ngemuva kokwenza lo msebenzi wonke, usukalile ukuthi umkhiqizo ongawulindela ngehektare ungakanani. Kudinga umsebenzi omningi ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle, futhi ekugcineni, kufanele uqonde kahle ukuthi ube nempumelelo kangakanani. Uqala ngomhlaba - ufake futhi ukhethe uhlobo lwezithelo ofuna ukufaka, bese ukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo, ukhetha inani lomquba ofuna ukufaka, ukhetha izinto ozohlela ukuzisebenzisa, kanye nesikhathi salokho - konke lokhu kudinga isikhathi, amandla, kanye nemali eningi. Bese uthola ukudla ezindaweni ezidinga ukuvuna nokuthengisa - manje kufanele ubale kahle ukuthi izindleko nge-ton zikhona kanjani bese uthola ukuthi uthole inzuzo kangakanani. Ngale ndlela, kuzovela kahle ukuthi uthole imbuyiselo yomsebenzi wakho noma cha? Ohlelweni lwethu lokuthuthukisa abalimi, sithola abalimi abaningi abangazi ukuthi bangaki amahektare ezindawo zabo, abazi ukuthi umhlaba ujula kangakanani, abazi isimo sezinto zomhlaba, umquba abazowufaka, inani lezitshalo, njll. Zonke lezi zinto ziding
Izinhlamvu kanye ne-fertilizer - khumbula ukukala! Amathayi aphakanyisiwe asetshenziswa ukudlulisa amandla. Kunezindlela eziningi zokukala ukuhamba kwezindawo zokubeka izinhlamvu. Indlela evamile kakhulu iyona esebenzisa ipuleti elinamahole (eboniswe lapha ngezansi). Idiski yokukala inezikhala eziningi, usayizi walezi zikhala kufanele uvumele ukuthi inhlamvu eyodwa iwela ngesikhathi. Lapho idiski ijikeleza (iguquka), ihamba (ihamba) phezu kwepuleti elin hole elilodwa. Ingxenye ye-disk inenhlamvu esusa (esula) izinhlamvu eziphezulu kwalokho okukhona emhole lapho idiski iguquka. Phakathi kwalesi sula, kukhona nendawo enesiphethu esihamba phezu kwe-disk sicindezela inhlamvu ukuze iwela emholeni ephezu kwe-disk. Ukuklama nosayizi lwezikhala kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inhlamvu eyodwa kuphela ingena ngesikhathi futhi ayigcini emholeni, ingaphumeleli ukuwa noma ukungena kulowo mhole ephezu kwepuleti ukuze ifike emhlabathini. Kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-air planters - uhlobo olulodwa lusebenza ngengcindezi ethile (lokhu kusho ukuthi luphusha inhlamvu ukuba ingene emholeni), bese kuba nohlobo olusebenza ngengcindezi phambili (lokhu kusho ukuthi luphonsa inhlamvu ukuba ingene emholeni). Usayizi wezihlahla awubalulekile kakhulu kuma-air planters njengoba izihlahla ziphonswa emholeni, akubalulekile ukuthi zibe zinkulu kangakanani. Inani lezihlahla ezitshaliwe lihambisana nesivinini (isivinini) sepuleti elijikelezayo. Isakhiwo esivamile esiletha i-fertilizer sithiwa i-auger efana nesikhwama. Le screw ihlezi ngaphansi ngaphakathi kwe-hopper (ibhakede elibamba i-fertilizer). Ngokuvamile, le screw iqhutshwa yicheni evela kumathayi ahamba emhlabeni anikeza amandla. Lapho i-fertilizer ilethwa, ibanjwa ezindaweni ze-screw bese ithuthwa lapho iphuma khona. Indlela yokushintsha ukukala yile: shintsha ama-sprockets aqhuba icheni ngaphakathi kwe-bucket kanye nephayiphi yamandla. Isakhiwo se-disk esikala inani le-fertilizer sithandwa kakhulu kuma-planters angakakhiphi kakhulu. Idiski yokukala ayifani ne-screw ethumela i-fertilizer. Ikakhulukazi, i-fertilizer iyaphuma ebhakeni le-fertilizer futhi idiski yokukala isiza ukukhulula i-fertilizer. Isakhiwo esihamba i-fertilizer siyisithiyo (ridge) phezulu kwe-disk esiza ukuhambisa i-fertilizer ukuze ingene emhlabathini. Ukukala kungashintshwa ngokuvula noma ukuvala umhole noma isango lapho i-fertilizer iphuma. Isakhiwo sokukala esifana nesithwathwa sikhombisa uhlelo lokukala ngqo. I-star wheel ikhuluma ngaphakathi kwe-hopper (ibhakede) kodwa inezinhlamvu ezikhula (eziphuma) ngaphandle kwe-bucket. Phakathi kwe-bucket, i-fertilizer ibanjwa yizinhlamvu zaleyo wheel, lapho i-wheel ijikeleza, i-fertilizer ikhishwa ukuze iphume ebhakeni futhi iwela emathubeni. Shintsha ama-sprockets ajikelezayo ukuze ajikeze ngokushesha noma kancane. Shintsha i-star wheel ukuze ufake enye enezinhlamvu ezinde noma ezimfishane. Ezinye izinhlobo ze-star wheels zinegate efana nesakhiwo se-disk sokukala. Lapho uvula isango, i-fertilizer eningi izophuma. Sifunde ukuthi izakhiwo zama-planters ziwuphi futhi zingasetshenziswa kanjani ukukala inani lezihlahla ne-fertilizer - kodwa manje kufanele sibuze ukuthi lezi zakhiwo ziqhutshwa kanjani? Uhlelo lokukala luvame ukuthola amandla kumathayi asekelayo i-planter. Futhi amathayi aphakanyisiwe kwesinye isikhathi asetshenziswa ukudlulisa amandla nokusekela i-planter. Ngesinye isikhathi, ithayi elilodwa lixhunywe kwi-planter elenza lowo msebenzi. Leli thayi lingabamba isisindo esanele kodwa lingacindezelwa ngesiphethu ukuze libambe kahle ngaphandle kokushelela. Kukhona futhi ama-treads nezinye izinto ezingangezwa ukuvimbela ithayi ukuthi lingasheleli kakhulu. Isivinini se-thayi esiqhuba sitholakala ngesivinini se-tractor - uma i-tractor ihamba ngokushesha, leli thayi lizohamba ngokushesha. Uhlelo lwezinto, ama-sprockets, nezicheni lusetshenziswa ukukala isivinini sokuhamba kwezakhiwo ezikala inani lezihlahla, futhi kukhona olunye uhlelo lwezinto, ama-sprockets, nezicheni ukukala ukuhamba kwezakhiwo ze-fertilizer. Qaphela: ama-planters ahlukene anezakhiwo zokukala ezahlukene - isibonelo, ezinye izinhlobo zine-levers ezingavula noma zivalwe endaweni lapho izihlahla ne-fertilizer ziphuma. Ukushintsha isivinini sezakhiwo kusebenzisa ama-gear ratios - kufanele uqonde kahle ukuthi le mfundiso isebenza kanjani.
Imishini: uyazithenga, uyazirenta, noma uthola omunye umuntu ozosebenza ngawe? Umfuyi wamanje uhlale efuna inzuzo futhi unciphise izindleko mayelana nezindlela zokusebenzisa ama-tractors, ama-harvesters, neminye imishini. Lokhu kubalulekile uma ufuna ukuhweba. Imishini emisha ingabukwa njalo ngesikhathi se-NAMPO Harvest Day minyaka yonke, futhi kubonakala ukuthi yonke imishini isenamandla aphezulu (horsepower noma kilowatt). Lokhu kuhambisana nosayizi namandla emishini ekhula njalo - ama-tractors, imishini eyenza i-mulch, ama-ploughs, neminye imishini ethuthukisa izindawo ezinkulu kakhulu. Izindleko zokuthenga nokugcina imishini ziyaqhubeka nokukhula ngokushesha unyaka nonyaka. Futhi, qaphela ukuthi awukwazi ukuhweba ngezikhathi ezingafanele ngoba lokhu kuzokwehlisa umkhiqizo. Lapho ubeka izicwangciso zakho zokuthola umkhiqizo othile ekulimaleni kwakho ukuze uthole inzuzo, kubalulekile ukuhlela amandla emishini onayo. Ngemuva kokuhlola ukuthi imishini enjani ethile iyatholakala, umfuyi uzokwazi ukuthi i-tractor idinga amandla angakanani. Usayizi we-tractor namandla ayo okudonsa kufanele kuhambisane nosayizi wemishini edonswayo. Uma uqonda ukuthi le mizwa ibukeka kanjani, uzokwazi ukubona ukuthi isikhathi, amandla okuhweba, ukulima, ukutshala, nokunye kuyalinganiswa. Manje umfuyi kufanele acabange ukuthi unayo imishini eyanele yokwenza umsebenzi odingekayo. Mhlawumbe ungacabanga ukuthenga imishini eyengeziwe noma uqashe omunye umuntu ukuze enze umsebenzi othile. Isibonelo: ungakwazi ukuqasha umphakeli ukuze enze imisebenzi emikhulu efana nokulima, ukuvuna, nokunye. Ngemuva kwalokhu, umfuyi angaqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi osele nemishini anayo (sicela ubheke ibhrosha elibizwa nge-"Contractors Course" uma ufuna olunye ulwazi). Umfuyi kufanele aqonde ukuthi uzokwazi ukusebenzisa imishini yakhe ukuqeda umsebenzi wakhe ngesikhathi esithile, noma kungase kube ngcono ukuqasha imishini eyengeziwe noma ukuthola umphakeli ozosebenza ngawe. Kubalulekile futhi kumfuyi ukuthi aqonde kahle ukuthi izindleko eziphelele ezihilelekile ekuthengeni le mishini zikhona, inani lokwehla kwesikhathi, inani lezintela, izindleko zokusebenza, zokugcina, umshwalense, nokunye. Kufanele acabangele lezi zinto zonke. Izindleko ezitholakala uma umfuyi ezama ukukhokha imali ebolekiwe ukuze athenge imishini zingaholela ezinsongweni ekulimaleni kwabo. Nokho, uma ungenayo imishini efanele, ngeke ukwazi ukuhweba, ukutshala, nokuvuna ngezikhathi ezidingekayo.
Ubani ophatha imishini? Mhlawumbe babehamba kahle ukuthola ama-tractor nezinye izinto zokulima kwiMnyango Wezolimo noma kwenye inhlangano. Kungase kube ukuthi awuzange uthole lezi zinto ngokwakho, kodwa uzithole ukuze uzisebenzise nabanye abalimi. Lokhu kuyinkinga. Kodwa ungajabula ngoba kukhona abanye abalimi abaningi abangatholanga ama-tractor nezinsiza zokulima nhlobo. Imishini iyajabula, kodwa idinga ukuphathwa kahle. Kukho izibopho ezinkulu ezihambisana nalabo abasebenzisa imishini. Izindlela zokuphatha kahle imishini kufanele zixoxwe ngaphakathi kweqembu ngaphambi kokuthatha izinyathelo phambili - kufanele kube nesivumelwano phakathi kweqembu sokuthi kuzophathwa kanjani konke lokhu ukuze ukwazi ukuzenzakalelayo lezi zinyathelo esikhathini esizayo. Abantu abasebenzisa le mshini kufanele bakhokhe imali, akunjalo? Uma kunjalo, kungani? Ubani okufanele abantu abasebenzisa le mshini bakhokhe? Lapho kudingeka ukukhokha imali, le mali izobala kanjani - izobala ngehora noma ngehektare? Abantu abaningi bangase bafune ukusebenzisa imishini ngosuku oluthile - ngesikhathi esifanayo. Umfuyi angase abe nezinkambu eziningi futhi afune ukulima zonke izinkambu - kodwa abanye abalimi bangase babe nenkambu encane eyodwa. Ingabe imishini izosetshenziswa kuhektare eyodwa endaweni yomuntu? Abalimi bazothola kuphi idizili? Ingabe umuntu oyedwa kuzodingeka aye egcekeni ukuthenga ibhakede, noma kuzoba nephampu enkulu lapho bonke amalungu eqembu bengathola khona idizili? Uma idizili ithengwa ngempahla, ubani ozophatha ukusetshenziswa kwalesi dizili? Ingabe idizili izothengiswa ngentengo efanayo yokuthengwa, noma ingabe intengo izonyuka kancane ukuze iqembu likwazi ukwenza inzuzo encane yokuhlinzeka ngezindleko zokuphatha umhlaba? Uma kwenzeka okuthile okungalungile nge-tractor, ubani ozokwenza? Ngemuva kokusebenza nge-tractor, ingabe kufanele ibuyiselwe ngephampu egcwele noma nje njengoba ijwayelekile? Abashayeli be-tractor - ingabe noma ubani angayishayela, noma kufanele kube umshayeli okhethiwe, noma umuntu onelayisensi yokushayela i-tractor? Le mshini inikezwa ubani? "Abanikazi" balemishini bayaziwa ngamagama abo. Ingabe imishini izosetshenziswa ngabantu abakhethiwe noma ingabe ingasetshenziswa yibo bonke abantu bendawo? Ingabe abantu bayakuqonda ukuthi kufanele benzeni ngalemishini ikakhulu (Ingabe bafuna ukulima nokutshala noma bafuna ukuyisebenzisa ukuthutha impahla (ukuhamba))? Imishini izogcinwa kuphi - endaweni lapho bengayifinyelela khona lapho beyidinga noma ezindlini zabantu abakhethiwe? Ukusebenza kwe-tractor kuzokwenziwa kuphi? Ubani ozophatha amarekhodi ukuze kukhombise ukuthi imishini idinga ukusebenza? Ingabe abanikazi bayakuqonda ukuthi banesibopho mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwale mshini? Ingabe kukhona uhlelo lokukhombisa ukuthi imishini kufanele isetshenziswe kanjani? Ubani ongayisebenzisa imishini futhi ngezikhathi ziphi? Ubani ovunyelwe ukusebenzisa imishini? Ubani ozobuyisela izindleko? Ubani ozophatha futhi agcine imishini? Ingabe kukhona ukuqeqeshwa kulabo abazosebenzisa imishini? Ingabe kukhona izinyathelo ezizosisiza uma kwenzeka ingozi (ukugcinwa)? Ukufaka noma ukushintsha imishini engasasebenzi? Ukuhlola isimo semishini? Ingabe kukhona isivumelwano nalabo abasebenzayo? Ingabe umuntu oshayelayo uthola ukukhokhwa noma cha? Ingabe kukhona isivumelwano nomninimhlaba - lokhu kuzophathwa kanjani futhi kanjani? Isikhathi - bazoqala nini futhi bazophela nini? Izindlela zokukala imishini yokufafaza nezitshalo? Ukuphatha amarekhodi njalo ngemuva kokuphothula umsebenzi othile - isibonelo: ngemuva kokufafaza insimu ngezikhemikhali, ingabe kuzoba namarekhodi akhombisa ukuthi yiziphi izikhemikhali ezisetshenziswe kuphi? Ukuthola nokukhokha idizili? Ubani ongashayela i-tractor? Ubani ozobizwa ukuba ashaye ama-tractor? Ingabe kukhona ukuqeqeshwa kwabashayeli ngaphambi kokubagcina imishini? Ubani ozofundisa (aqeqeshe) umshayeli mayelana ne-manual yomshayeli? Ubani ophatha abashayeli? Ingabe kukhona umshayeli oyedwa oshayela i-tractor ethile noma kukhona abashayeli abanye abashayela i-tractor ngezikhathi ezahlukene? Uma kukhona abashayeli abaningi, ubani okhokhelayo ekugcineni i-tractor? Ubani ohlole i-tractor njalo ekuseni ngaphambi kokuhamba ezinkambeni? Ubani ozokuqinisekisa ukuthi isimo silungile, sikhululekile, njll? Ingabe kukhona amathuluzi okulungisa nokuhlanza imishini? Ubani ozobika noma yiziphi izinkinga ezivela? Yiziphi izinyathelo ezizothathwa uma izinto zidinga ukulungiswa?
Uma ufuna ukuba umphakathi wezolimo, akuzothi kudlule isikhathi eside ukuze ubone ukubaluleka kokusebenzisa imishini - okuhlanganisa yonke imishini yokulima. Ekuqaleni, lapho usalima endaweni encane, ungaphumelela ngokusebenza ngezandla noma usebenzisa amajuba noma amahhashi. Kodwa lapho uqala ukulima amahektha amaningi, kuzodingeka usebenzise imishini ukwenza umsebenzi omningi ngesikhathi esifushane. Sivame ukubona ukuthi abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuqhubeka ngoba abanayo imishini noma imishini yabo ayisebenzi kahle. Itraktori engakwazi ukusebenza ayisizi umbulali nhlobo. Bheka inani lamanzi nomoya. Thola irekhodi lesevisi lelo mshini. Bheka isimo samathayi. Bheka noma yikuphi ukuvuza kwe-oyili - akudingeki. Qala injini futhi ulalele ukuthi ikhuluma kanjani. Sebenzisa i-clutch namagiya - ingabe konke kusebenze kahle noma cha? Xhuma imishini (njenge-plow) futhi uyiphakamishe ukuze uhlole ukuthi uhlelo lwe-hydraulic lusebenza kahle. Ingabe i-PTO iyasebenza kahle? Ingabe wonke amagiya namaleveli asebenza kahle? Donsa imishini ukuze ubone ukuthi itraktori inamandla. Ingabe le traktori isasebenza kahle? Bheka ukuthi i-planter isebenza kanjani - ingabe inama-plates, ingabe isebenza nge-vacuum (umoya), noma ingabe isebenzisa iminwe? Ingabe i-planter ifaka imigqa emingaki? Xhuma i-planter ku-traktori. Faka imbewu ne-fertilizer kumahopper. Phusha itraktori endaweni eqondile engaba ngamamitha angama-10 bese uhlole ukuthi zonke imigqa zisebenza. Uma imbewu ne-fertilizer zingaphumi kahle, bheka izingxenye ezifanele futhi uthole ukuthi yini inkinga. Bheka uma kunezinye ama-plates (lapho isebenzisa ama-plates). Ngaphambi kokuxhuma imishini ku-traktori, bheka izinga le-oyili kuphampu. Xhuma i-sprayer ku-PTO. Phusha futhi uhlole ukuthi zonke izikhukhula zisebenza. Uma kukhona inkinga, bheka ukuthi ikuphi - kungaba kuphampu, ifilitha, noma izikhukhula. Uma imishini ingasebenzi kahle, ingabe uzokwazi ukuyilungisa noma cha? Bheka umzimba - ingabe ugebhezi noma uphukile (bheka izindawo lapho kubhontshwe khona)? Bheka wonke ama-bolts nezinye izindawo zokubopha. Bheka izingxenye ezingenela emhlabathini - ingabe zidinga ukuba ezintsha? Bheka amapayipi namaphampu - ingabe asebenza kahle futhi avuza? Bheka amavhili - bheka ingcindezi yomoya. Bheka ama-bearings - ingabe agcwele amafutha futhi ahamba kahle? Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlola kwakho itraktori nemishini kwenziwa kahle, qinisa konke, futhi imishini izokwazi ukusebenza kalula endaweni yakho - akusizi ukuthola imishini encane bese ufuna ukulima izinkundla ezinkulu. Kungcono ukwenza inzuzo endaweni encane kunokulahlekelwa imali endaweni enkulu. Sebenzisa kuphela izinkundla ezikufanele.
Ungaba kanjani ilungu leGrain SA? Bonke abantu abakhiqiza izitshalo zokudla bangaba amalungu eGrain South Africa. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zokuba amalungu, kodwa ngokujwayelekile, kunezithombe eziningi ezilungile ezikhona ezibandakanya abalimi bezomnotho kanye nalabo abangamalungu ezinhlelweni zokufunda. Ukuze ube ilungu eliphelele lezomnotho, kubiza u-R2 ngentoni yokudla ekhiqizwayo, kodwa akufanele kube ngaphansi kuka-R570 (i-VAT ifakiwe lapha). Kukhona nezinhlaka zokufunda ezibiza u-R10 kuphela ngonyaka. Uma kukhona abantu abafuna ukuhlela iqembu lokufunda futhi babe amalungu eGrain SA, xhumana noMphathi Wokuthuthukiswa endaweni yakho - ikheli nemininingwane yokuxhumana izotholakala ekupheleni kwedokhumenti le. Inhloso yalezi zinhlelo zokufunda ukuhlangana njalo ukuze kuxoxwe ngazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezithombo zokudla. Uma ungumuntu oyi ilungu leqembu, kusho ukuthi uzokwazi futhi ukuh attenda zonke (eziningi) izifundo zokuqeqesha ezitholakala yiGrain SA minyaka yonke. Sithemba ukuthi abalimi abaningi abasafufusa bazoba amalungu aphelele ezomnotho eGrain SA ngenkokhelo yabo ka-R2 ngentoni abavuna. IGrain SA idinga ubulungu bakho ukuze sikwazi ukumela nokulwa nawo wonke amalimi akhiqiza izitshalo zokudla lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
Thola: Kufanele ube nekhono, ithuba elihle lingavela nganoma isiphi isikhathi, kufanele ulibone! Thola: Zama ungazithwesi kakhulu ngezinto ezahlukene ngoba uzolahlekelwa ithuba elibalulekile elidingekayo ukuze ukhiqize kahle. Njengoba abakhiqizi bezinhlamvu bephupha njalo ukuthi unyaka ozayo uzoba ngcono, bakha umsebenzi wabo unyaka nonyaka. Ngesikhathi esifushane, kungenzeka kube nethuba lokuqhubeka mhlawumbe kanye ngonyaka. Abakhiqizi bavame ukuphuthelwa amathuba okunciphisa izindleko nokuvimbela ukulahleka kokukhiqiza ngoba baphuthelwa ithuba lapho kusen isikhathi. Amathuba amahle angavela ngesikhathi sokulungiselela ukutshala kanye nakuzo zonke izikhathi lapho izitshalo zikhula. Vula amehlo akho ukuze ubone izinto ezinhle ezithengiswa ngamanani aphansi. Qaphela kakhulu ngesikhathi sokukhula ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izinto ozisebenzisayo epulazini zisebenza kahle noma cha. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukukhetha izinto ezizokwenza kahle. Ikhadi lokuthengisa elinamanani aphansi lingaba usizo olukhulu kusasa. Lokhu kuyithuba elivame ukuphuthelwa yizinkulungwane zabafuyi. Ngokuvamile, imishini engalungiswanga kahle idala ukulahleka kwesikhathi, ivimbela ukutshala ngesikhathi. Ekupheleni kokutshala, isikhathi esihle sokuhlola nokulungisa imishini yakho. Ngemva kokulungisa nokuvimbela ukuwa, kufanele ibekwe endaweni ezoyivikela kwezinye izingozi. Ngokufanayo, akufanele kuthathe isikhathi ukulungisa imishini lapho isikhathi sokutshala sifika, futhi izindleko zizoba phansi. Lapho isikhathi sokutshala sifika, kufanele wazi ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle, uzokwazi ukuphatha umsebenzi wakho kahle. Uma kuvela imvula enamandla, kungaba yingozi enkulu ezitshalweni. Uma umhlabathi uphume, awukwazi ukuwubuyisela. Nokho, ukugcina umhlabathi kuyinto okufanele yenziwe njalo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ipulazi, futhi abafuyi kufanele baphinde babheke izindawo lapho ukuhuzuka komhlabathi kungase kube khona. Imvula ingavela ngezikhathi ezingalindelekile. Uma ubona ukuthi kukhona indawo ethambile emasimini, kufanele uyilungise ngokushesha. Lokhu kungaba ithuba lakho lokuvimbela ukuhuzuka komhlabathi wakho. Kukhona amakhemikhali amahle abulala izihlahla ezivela emakhanda, kodwa noma ngabe le herbicide isebenza kahle, kufanele ihambisane nezimo zezulu ezifanele. Thola ithuba lokufaka le herbicide ngosuku lapho kungekho umoya noma lapho kushisa kakhulu noma lapho kumanzi. Usayizi wezihlahla ubalulekile uma ufuna ukuzibulala kahle. Ngokuvamile, kungcono ukubulala izihlahla uma zisencane. Kubalulekile ukuhlola njalo ukuthi zingaki izitshalo - uhlobo lwezikhukhukazi nezihlahla. Kungcono ukubulala izihlahla ngokushesha. Izilokazane ezifana nalabo abahlala em wood zingaba yingozi enkulu uma kukhula uhlobo lwezikhukhukazi nezihlahla. Lokhu kungenzeka ngokushesha. Izilokazane eziningi zingabulawa ngokushesha ngamakhambi. Kodwa uma uthatha isikhathi eside ukufaka le herbicide, ingase ingasebenzi kahle. Uma ama-larvae (ama-caterpillar) ethola isikhathi sokukhula, le herbicide ayisasebenzi kahle. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola njalo izitshalo zakho ukuze ukhethe isikhathi esifanele sokufaka le herbicide ezosebenza kahle. Kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla okufanele zikhishwe ngesikhathi esithile esifanele. Isibonelo, ngeziqhamo, uma uthola ngaphambi kwesikhathi noma uthatha isikhathi eside ukuhluza, izinga lokudla lizoba phansi. Ukuqonda kahle ukuthi isikhathi esifanele sokuhluza sithi kufanele kuholele umfuyi ukuba acabangele izinto eziningi: umbala wezithombo, izimo zezulu, kanye nezifo ezingase zenzeke. Ngezinye izikhathi, ungathola ukuthi isivuno siba sibi emasimini njengoba sikhula. Uma umfuyi ethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuhluza, lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni ukudla okuningi. Ungaphuthelwa ithuba lokuqoqa zonke izikhukhukazi uma uhluza.
U- Ms. Jane uthi... Ngonyaka ongenhla sizame kakhulu ukuphatha izihlahla, kodwa sathola ukuthi abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuphatha izihlahla ngendlela efanele ngoba isimo sezulu sibe namanzi amaningi. Lo nyaka ubuyisibonelo esihle sokukhombisa ukuthi ukuphatha izihlahla ngamakhemikhali kuyindlela efanele! Ezindaweni eziningi kube namanzi amaningi kakhulu, abalimi bangenakukhulisa phakathi kwemigqa, futhi abaningi bahluleka ekugcineni ukulwa nezihlahla. Manje yisikhathi esifanele sokubheka izinkambu zakho ngoba ngaleyo ndlela uzobona ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ongahlangabezana nazo ngonyaka ozayo. Izihlahla akufanele zikukhathaze - kungaba nezihlahla ezikhula eminyakeni eminingi, uzobona nje ukuthi seziqala ukukhula, noma izihlahla ezizokhula ngonyaka ozayo zizokhula ezithombeni ezawela emhlabathini ngenkathi usebenza enkambini kulo nyaka. Kusasele isikhathi sokushintsha indlela osebenza ngayo ezinkambini zakho. Ungashiyi izindawo ezincane lapho izihlahla zikhula khona, phatha le ndawo kahle kakhulu. Bheka ukuthi lezi zihlobo zikhona - kufanele wazi isitha esifuna ukudala inkinga, sishaye masinyane. Ungavumeli isitshalo sehlahla sibe nezithombo, izitshalo eziningi zehlahla eziphila isikhathi eside zingakhula ezithombeni nasemagxeni. Phatha izihlahla ngendlela ejwayelekile uma uphonsa. Khumbula njalo ukufuna amakhemikhali amasha abulala izinhlobo ezahlukene zezihlahla. Uzovimbela izihlahla ekukhuleni emaphethelweni ezinkambu (wenakker). Ukwanda kwezihlahla lapha kungasakazeka emkhakheni wonke. Qiniseka ukuthi ulungiselela kahle inkambu ngaphambi kokuphonsa, akufanele kube khona izihlahla enkambini ngaphambi kokuphonsa. Lokhu kuzokunika ithuba lokukhula ngaphandle kokuncintisana nezihlahla zokudla. Uma kukhona izitshalo eziphila isikhathi eside ezikhulayo, cabanga ngokusebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi "ukungaphonsi" uma uphonsa. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukubulala izihlahla ngamakhemikhali. Khulisa izinkambu lapho kukhona izitshalo zehlahla eziphila isikhathi eside ezikhulayo. Ukukhulisa kulimaza lokhu kakhulu (Bheka 7 ngenhla, kwesinye isikhathi kungaba ngcono ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali ukuze ubulale). Qaphela ungakwandisi izihlahla ngemishini uma uya enkabeni entsha - amagxeni nezithombo zehlahla zingasala emshinini. Uma usuzobe uqala ukukhulisa inkambu entsha, ungakhohlwa ukuhlanza imishini yakho. Yenza imephu yephanga lakho futhi ukhombise lapho lezi zinhlobo zezihlahla zikhula khona, ukuze ukhumbule ukuphatha lezo zindawo ngonyaka ozayo. Sijabule ngoba kubonakala ukuthi imakethe yokudla iyakhula - ngikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzokuqhubekela phambili ukuze wena njengomkhiqizi ukwazi ukwenza inzuzo ngemva kokuvuna nokuthengisa imikhiqizo yakho. Khumbula ukuthi ukuhweba akukhona nje indlela yokuphila - kuyibhizinisi, ngakho kufanele uqonde ukusebenza ukuze wenze inzuzo ukuze ube umkhiqizi osiza leli bhizinisi manje nangesikhathi esizayo.
U-Aunt Jane uthi... Okwamanje, ezindaba (i-TV, iradiyo, kanye nezincwadi) zikhuluma kakhulu ngamacala nobugebengu. Kwenzekani kubantu bethu, umthetho wokukala ukuphila kwethu kanye nomgwaqo ofanele? Mhlawumbe kufanele sikhulume ngomgwaqo ofanele? Emgwaqweni ofanele emsebenzini, kukhona umoya wakho, indlela ophila ngayo, ukuxhumana, nokuhlanganyela - indlela esihlanganyela ngayo nabanye. Umbuzo omkhulu lapho sikhuluma ubandakanya lokho okufanele (ngqo) nokuthi yini efanele, sibuze ukuthi lokho kumelana kanjani nalokho okungalungile nokukhwabanisa. Esikhathini esedlule, kwakukhona izinkampani nabantu abangenamgwaqo omuhle, basebenza emnyama futhi babe nomthelela omubi kwabanye abantu. Labo bantu babengenakukuqonda le nkinga, ngenkathi abanye benza izinto ezinhle. Umgwaqo ofanele emsebenzini, njengokwethembeka, ukusebenza kahle, ukubaluleka komsebenzi wakho, ukwazi ukuthi ubani osebenza naye, konke lokhu kubalulekile. Kufanele sifune ukwenza izinto ezilungile. Imigudu emihle ivela enhliziyweni, ivela ngaphakathi. Ekwenzeni okungalungile, kukhona amathuba amaningi okukhuluma amanga nokwenza izinto ezimbi. Cabanga ngababolekayo imali kodwa bengenayo emuva kokuvuna; abanye batshala, bathengise umkhiqizo bese bephawula ukuthi abatholanga inzuzo; noma labo abathenga imali ukuze batshale inani elithile le-hectares, bese betshala kwezinye i-hectares (besebenzisa ezokuqala ukuhweba ngokuhlanganyela). Abantu abangakhokhi imali ngokuhlanganyela, abakhuluma amanga ngokungasebenzi kanzima, abantu abathengisa izinto ezingabapheki, abantu abathenga izinto ezibi, nokunye. Uma sifuna ukwakha nokukhulisa umkhakha wezolimo ezweni lethu, kufanele sihamba emuva, kufanele samukele futhi sigcine imithetho eqondile, izimo zokusebenza ngokukhuthaza nokuhlonipha. Bonke abantu, kuhlanganise nalabo abasebenza ezikhungweni zikamasipala, kufanele benze umsebenzi ofanele nsuku zonke. Lokhu kuyindlela eyodwa ezosiza siphumelele. Uma ufuna ukushintsha indlela izinto ezenziwa ngayo - kufanele ushintshe wena kuqala. Hambisa phambili, ube nethemba. Masibuyele endaweni lapho sizokwazi khona ukuthi ngokwokuqonda: amazwi ami aqondile, ngikhuluma iqiniso.
U- Ms. Jane uthi... Wow, bekumnandi ukuba yilungu leqembu elikhethe uMlimi Wonyaka kulolo mncintiswano! Imisebenzi eminingi ibihilelekile ethathwe iminyaka eminingi ukuze siqalisise uhlelo lwethu lokuthuthukisa abalimi, futhi bekumangalisa ukubona ukuthi abanye abakhiqizi bayephi. Ukukhetha labo abaphakanyisiwe bekunzima kakhulu ngoba bonke basebenze kanzima isikhathi eside futhi benze kahle. Nokho, kuyamangalisa futhi kujabulisa ukubona intuthuko yabanye abakhiqizi, kuyasiphoxa ukubona abanye abangaphumeleli nhlobo. Ngisho nakuze kube manje sisabona abalimi abangawenzi kahle izinto ezisemqoka - njengokulungisa umhlabathi kahle, ukusebenzisa umanyolo, ukukhetha izinhlobo ezinhle zezithombo, nokulawula izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Sibone izitshalo ezinhle kakhulu zikhula ngesandla - isiqeshana esincane somhlaba singakhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle uma ulungisa umhlabathi kahle, ufaka izithombo ezinhle, ufaka umanyolo ofanele, futhi ulawula izihlahla eziphikisanayo ngempumelelo. Uma usukwazi ukufaka kahle endaweni encane, ungakwazi ukuqala ukwandisa umsebenzi wakho wokufaka. Kunzima ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo, kodwa konke kusezandleni zakho - silapha ukukweseka futhi sikunikeze ukuqeqeshwa ngazo zonke izinsiza zethu, kodwa kufanele ushintshe izindlela zakho zokusebenza!
U-Jane uthi... Ngaphezu kwesikhathi kufanele simise futhi sizibuze ukuthi senzeni. Uma sifuna ukuthola impendulo ecacile, kufanele sisho nokuthi singakwenza kanjani. Asisebenzisi abaqashi abamhlophe emapulazini abantu abamnyama. Asizami ukuhlinzeka abantu abalimazekile ngezinsiza zokulima ngaphambi kokuthi kube namuhla. Asisazami ukwenza izinto ezikhangayo kuphela (ukuhlobisa amafasitela). Asizami ukuthola izitifiketi ze-BEE ngoba kukhona abantu abathengisa lezi zinto. Asizami ukuthola izitifiketi ze-BEE ngoba kukhona labo abahlinzeka ngezinto. Kodwa, senzeni? Sithuthukisa abakhiqizi abamnyama - abasebenza ngokwabo manje nakusasa. Siqeqesha abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuba baqonde futhi bathole ukuthi yiziphi izizathu zokwenza umsebenzi wezolimo. Siphakamisa abakhiqizi ukuba basebenzise kahle izinsiza zemvelo. Sibonisa abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuthi baphawule umhlaba abasebenzisa. Sisebenzela abantu ngalokho abanakho, sibasiza ukuthi bathole impilo futhi bakhiqize ukudla kwabo, ikhaya labo, nezwe labo. Siyasiza ukuguqula ubuso bokulima - sifuna ukuba baphume ebusweni lapho kukhona kuphela abalimi abamhlophe, sifuna bonke abantu lapha ezweni lethu bakhulume ndawonye. Sikusiza abantu abanomhlaba - umhlaba womphakathi wonke, umhlaba oqashisiwe, noma labo abanomhlaba wabo (emapulazini) ukuze basebenzise lowo mhlaba ngendlela ezoletha inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Sizama ukubambisana nazo zonke izigaba zikamasipala ukuze sihlanganise ukwesekwa okunikezwa abalimi. Sakha amasu ukuze abalimi bakwazi ukufinyelela kumishini. Sakha amasu ukuze sithole izibonelelo kulezo zigaba. Kunzima kimi lapho ngizwa ukuthi abantu balima ukuze abakhiqizi abamnyama. Kukho abantu nezinhlangano ezisebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama ukuze zenze inzuzo, bese zithi lokhu "ukuthuthukisa abakhiqizi abamnyama." Uma ungumkhiqizi omhlophe usebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama - qasha lowo mhlaba, khokha intengo efanelekile, qaphela ukuthi uqasha umhlaba futhi uthola inzuzo. Siyacela ukuthi ungazenzi sengathi usiza abanye abakhiqizi.
U-NaJane uthi... Ezindabeni (amaphephandaba, ithelevishini, umsakazo) zalesi sikhathi, kukhuluma okuningi i-ANC Youth League mayelana nendaba yomhlaba (nema bhange kanye nezimayini), futhi kukhuthaza kakhulu ukubona ukuthi abantu abahlukene bathini ngalesi sihloko somhlaba. Ngibona umhlaba njengomthombo okufanele siwusebenzise ukukhiqiza ukudla nobuhle. Izinto eziningi lapha emhlabeni ziya zanda njalo unyaka nonyaka - abantu, izinkomo, izimoto, njll. Kodwa umhlaba awukwazi ukwanda - unamkhawulo. Uma ucabanga ngempilo eyanda njalo, kodwa umhlaba okhiqizayo uyancipha (akukho okukhumbuleka ukuthi abantu badinga isikhala sokwakha izindlu zabo - amadolobha akhula ngokusebenzisa umhlaba), kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlaba wonke usebenza kahle. ENingizimu Afrika namuhla sinezimo eziyinkimbinkimbi ngoba iningi lomhlaba okhiqizayo liphethwe ngabantu abamhlophe. Manje kukhuluma ngokuthatha lowo mhlaba, hhayi ukuwuthenga, bese unika abantu abamnyama. Kukho futhi okunye okufanele kukhunjulwe, kunenani elikhulu lomhlaba elilawulwa uhulumeni (ngaphansi komthetho kazwelonke) kodwa izindawo eziningi zalowo mhlaba azisetshenziswa kahle. Kukho futhi izinkulungwane zehektare ezabelwe uMnyango Wezomhlaba ngohlelo lwawo. Lokhu kuhambisana nombala wesikhumba somuntu. Ngicabanga ukuthi ukuba umphakathi ophumelelayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uyazitholela, uphila endaweni encane, noma ungumlimi wezohwebo akusho lutho ngombala wesikhumba somuntu. Sonke siyazi ukuthi uma ufuna ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo, udinga ulwazi namakhono, imishini, imakethe, kanye ne-capital yokuqala yokutshala. Ukunika umuntu umhlaba akusho ukuthi ungumkhiqizi - nje ngoba uphakathi kwegaraji akusho ukuthi ungimoto! Ngokufanayo, nje ngoba unomhlaba akusho ukuthi ungumkhiqizi. Uma ufuna ukuqashelwa njengomkhiqizi, kumele usebenzise umhlaba wakho ngokuphelele - kumele ukhiqize ngendlela engcono kakhulu ongayenza kulowo mhlaba. Ngifisa ukuphakamisa ukuthi sixhase ngamandla ethu bonke labo abanomhlaba ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa wonke umhlaba okhiqizayo ukukhiqiza ukudla kwethu. Umhlaba uyigugu elikhulu; uma unomhlaba, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuwusebenzisa. Ake sibambisane njengabangakhiqizi ukuze sikwazi ukukhiqiza konke esingakwenza, sithule kulokho okukhuluma abezombusazwe abakhonza kuphela bona.
Bonke izitshalo zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule, futhi iphuzu elibaluleke kakhulu ekulimaleni kwezilimo ezithile emhlabeni owomileyo kube khona amanzi anele ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezitshalo zakho ze-maize. Ukuqala kule nyanga, i-bulletin ye-maize ye-Pula Imvula izothunyelwa kubafundi bonke, hhayi kuphela kubakhiqizi abakhuluma isiSisuthu eFree State. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iWestern Cape inezimo zokukhanya ezaziwa njengeMediterranean, okusho ukuthi ithola imvula yayo ebusika, isikhathi esifanele sokulima i-maize. Ukubaluleka kokugcina amanzi emhlabathini kubakhiqizi be-maize eCape akubalulekile njengokuphathelene neNingizimu Afrika yonke, lapho sidinga ukugcina imvula yasehlobo emhlabathini ukuze izitshalo zisebenzise ngesikhathi sebusika obomileyo. Ukulima kudinga amanzi. Izitshalo ezahlukene zinezimfuno ezahlukene okufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokuthi kunqunywe ukuthi iyiphi isitsha efanele ukulima. Amanzi adingeka futhi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuwohloka kwezinsalela zezithombo zangaphambili nokwandisa izakhamzimba ezitholakala emhlabathini, okuvumela izitshalo ukuthi zifinyelele ezakhamzimbini. Ungase ungakakwenzi isinqumo sokuthi uzolima i-maize noma cha; isinqumo sakho sincike ezinzuzweni ezitholakala ekulimaleni kwe-maize nasekuhlelweni kwakho kwesikhathi esizayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa komhlaba. Abakhiqizi abaningi benza izinqumo zokulima izitshalo ezithile ngokususelwa ezinguqukweni ezithile, ngaphandle kokugxila kumagugu entengo ahluka-hluka. Ukulima i-maize unyaka nonyaka kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi unokulima uma unyaka ubuhle, futhi ukuthi unama-maize okuthengisa uma amanani emakethe ephezulu (kodwa kungenzeka futhi ukuhweba ngalokhu - uzoba ne-maize ngisho nasezinyangeni ezimbi, futhi uzodinga ukuyithenga ngamanani aphansi uma itholakala). Kubalulekile ukuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo zakho zizokwazi ukufinyelela amanzi anele emhlabathini ngesikhathi sonke sokukhula kwazo. Bonke umhlaba ungagcina amanzi, kodwa abanye banamandla angcono okugcina amanzi emhlabathini. Umhlaba onesihlabathi unamandla aphansi okugcina amanzi njengoba amanzi angadonsa emhlabathini futhi alahleke, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nezendlalelo ezingenakudlula (njengokhuni noma i-clay, ngokwesibonelo) ezovimbela amanzi ekudlula nasekulahlweni. Umhlaba onama-layers angadluli (njenge-clay ngokwesibonelo) ezindaweni ezijulile ezingu-600 mm kuya ku-1 m ufaneleka ekugcineni amanzi emhlabathini nasekukhiqizeni izilimo zonyaka. Izinhlobonhlobo eziningi zomhlaba onesihlabathi eFree State empumalanga zifanele le mfanekiso, yingakho zifaneleka ekulimaleni kwe-maize ebusika nakuba kuyindawo ethola imvula yasehlobo. Ngaphandle kokuthi ube nenhlanhla yokuba namanzi anele okokufafaza, kuzodingeka uthembeke emvuleni ukuze umhlaba uthole amanzi. Iphansi lelo phansi elithambile livumela imvula ukuthi ingene emhlabathini. Kufanele ubone ukuthi imvula igijima kanjani emhlabathini onzima. Ukuvuthwa kwamanzi emhlabeni kusiza ekungeneleleni kwamanzi; kuphinde kunciphise ukuhamba kwamanzi futhi kunikeze isikhathi eside sokuthi amanzi angena. Amanzi agcinwa ezikhala phakathi kwezithako zomhlaba. Izihlabathi zingahluka phakathi kwezihlabathi ezilula nezimnyama bese ziba yi-clay, futhi uhlobo ngalunye lomhlaba lungagcina izinga elihlukile lamamitha amanzi. Umhlaba onesihlabathi, i-clay, kanye nomhlaba omnyama ungagcina ama-25 mm wamanzi emhlabathini angu-150 mm. (Umhlaba onjengokujulile okusebenzayo okungu-1 m wezimpande ungagcina ama-180 mm emvula). Ikhono lokugcina amanzi emhlabathini lincike ohlotsheni lomhlaba, isakhiwo somhlaba kanye nesikhala somhlaba. Amanzi emhlabathini angalahleka emhlabeni ngenxa yokukhanya kwelanga. Iphansi lomhlaba lingashisa, okwandisa ukuvuthwa, okubangela amanzi ukuthi ahlale phakathi kwezithako zomhlaba, afike phezulu emhlabathini lapho evutha emoyeni; asetshenziswa izitshalo ezikhulayo noma izitshalo ezithile ezingabhekwa njengezihlahla emasimini (lokhu kuyisizathu esikhulu sokulahleka kwamanzi emhlabathini). Singagcina kanjani amanzi kahle? Qinisekisa ukuthi imvula engena emhlabathini ingangena kulowo mhlaba; gcina iphansi lomhlaba lisesimweni esihle. Iphansi eliphezulu elingaphezulu komhlaba lisebenza njengezithiyo eziqinile ukuze amanzi emvula angagijimi kodwa agcine emhlabathini. Gcina izinsalela zezithombo zangaphambili ziningi ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze unciphise umthelela oqondile wezinyembezi zemvula emhlabathini futhi ngaleyo ndlela unciphise ukwakheka kwe-crust yomhlaba. Kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi izitshalo zingase zidinge ama-nitrogen fertilizers engeziwe ngenxa yokuncipha kwezinsiza ezivela ezinsaleni zezithombo zangaphambili, okuzoncika ekudluliseni kwezithombo ezindala ezisele. Ngemuva kwemvula enkulu, phula noma iyiphi i-crust engase ibe sekupheleni komhlaba. I-crust ayivimbi kuphela ukungena kweminye imvula kodwa iphinde ikhulise ukuvuthwa ukuze spread amanzi phakathi kwezithako zomhlaba, okubangela umhlaba ukuba umiswe. Gcina umhlaba ungenazihlahla kusukela ngesikhathi sokuvuna izilimo zangaphambili kuze kube sekulimaleni kwezilimo ezilandelayo. Ukwakhiwa kwesembozo esenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ukuze kugcinwe amanzi okwakhiwe ngothuli emhlabathini kuba yisithiyo sokuvutha kwamanzi phakathi kwezithako zomhlaba, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwamanzi emhlabathini emoyeni. Nakuba isembozo esenziwe ngezinto ezifana nothuli olomile sigcina amanzi ngokumunca ukushisa kokukhanya kwelanga, ukuvuthwa kungaqhubeka kodwa ngezinga eliphansi emhlabathini elomile elingu-5 cm. Isembozo esenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ukuze kugcinwe amanzi singaba yizinsalela zezithombo (uma kukhulunywa kabanzi) noma singaba yisembozo esenziwe ngezinto ezifana nothuli okufanele kugcinwe ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi akufanele kuphazanyiswe ngokulima komhlaba ngama-machinery. Ezinye izinto eziphathelene nokukhiqiza izilimo zibalulekile ukuze uphumelele. Udinga ukugcina amanzi ngangokunokwenzeka futhi ugcine umhlaba wakho ungenazihlahla ngaso sonke isikhathi. Amanzi kuyinto eyinhloko yokukhawulela ekukhiqizeni izilimo.
Umoya (amanzi) ubalulekile ngesikhathi sokutshala lapho izitshalo zikhula ezindaweni ezithola imvula kuphela. Ulwazi mayelana nenani lemvula elizokwanela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lungatholwa kuMnyango Wezolimo oseduze nawe. Lokhu kungasetshenziswa njengomhlahlandlela lapho sihlela izinqubo zethu zokukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani kufanele sigcine amanzi emhlabathini? Ukutshala kudinga amanzi - izinhlobo ezihlukene zezithombo zidinga izinga elihlukile lamanzi, ngakho kufanele sithathele phezulu lokhu ngaphambi kokukhetha isithombo esithile sokutshala. Imvula yemvelo ayivamile ukwenzeka ngesikhathi esifanele sesithombo esithile. Ngokuvamile, izindawo eNingizimu Afrika lapho kutshalwa khona izitshalo zokudla ezomile zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele emhlabathini ngesikhathi esifanele sokutshala ukuze imbewu ikwazi ukukhula kalula nezimpande zikhule kahle ekuqaleni. Isikhathi esifanele sokutshala sizobhekelela nezinye izikhathi ezibalulekile lapho isithombo sikhula (isibonelo: imvula ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwezithombo ze-maize kanye naleso sikhathi lapho izimbali ze-pumpkin zikhula). Ukuze izitshalo ezisele emathafeni ziqhubeke zishwabane ngokushesha futhi zandise inani le-'humus' emhlabathini, okwenza izitshalo zithole izakhamzimba. Ingabe zonke izinhlobo zomhlabathi zingagcina amanzi? Yebo, kodwa umhlabathi onodaka kanye nomhlabathi opholile uzokwenza amanzi amaningi aphume. Umhlabathi onamathafa aqinile (njengodaka) ezindaweni ezingu-600 mm kuya ku-1 meter ugcina amanzi kahle uma utshalwe. Singasiza kanjani umhlabathi ukuthi wamukele imvula? Umhlabathi ophakeme uphumelelayo, ungacindezelwanga, noma kokubili. Kukhona izitshalo ezishwabene phezulu komhlabathi. Amanzi agcinwa kanjani emhlabathini? Amanzi agcinwa ezikhungweni phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi. Izinhlobo zomhlabathi ziyahluka: kukhona udaka, isihlabathi, kanye nodaka. Inani lamanzi angagcinwa kulezi zinhlobo zomhlabathi nayo iyahluka. Lezi zinhlobo zomhlabathi ngokuvamile zingagcina ama-25 mm wamanzi emhlabathini ophakeme ongu-150 mm. (Emhlabathini lapho izimpande zingafinyelela ku-1 meter, ama-180 mm emvula angagcinwa). Yini ebangela ukuthi amanzi aphume emhlabathini? Ukukhanya kwelanga. Umhlabathi uyashisa futhi amanzi ayashwabana. Ukuphakama kwe-capillary emhlabathini. Amanzi ahamba phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi, aphakama, futhi aphinde ashwabane emoyeni. Izihlahla ezikhula nezinye izitshalo ezifana nograsi - amanzi aphuma ezithelweni (lokhu kuyimbangela enkulu yokulahleka kwamanzi). Yini esingayenza ukuze sigcine amanzi kahle? Qinisekisa ukuthi imvula ingangena emhlabathini. Uma kukhona ungqimba oluqinile phezulu, amanzi awakwazi ukungena, bese amanzi eqala ukuhamba phansi futhi awakwazi ukungena phansi. Zama ukushiya izinsalela eziningi zezithelo zonyaka odlule ukuze imvula ingashayi umhlabathi kanzima, ngaleyo ndlela ivimbele ukuvela kwegatsha eliqinile. Khumbula njalo ukuthi ukuhamba kwezinsalela kuthatha isikhathi, futhi umanyolo onothile ngenyukliya uzodingeka ngoba izinsalela ezishwabene aziniki umanyolo ngokushesha. Uma imvula iningi, phula ungqimba oluqinile phezulu komhlabathi. Ungqimba oluqinile luzovimba imvula eyengeziwe ukuthi ingangeni emhlabathini futhi lwenze ukushwabana kwamanzi kwandise, okwenza umhlabathi umiswe ngokushesha. Qinisekisa ukuthi insimu ihlanzekile futhi ingenazihlahla eziphikisanayo ngemva kokuvuna kuze kube sekufikeni kwesikhathi sokutshala esisha. Izinsalela zezithelo phezulu komhlabathi zivimba ukushwabana kwamanzi futhi azikwazi ukuhamba. Ilanga lishisa izinsalela, kodwa ukushwabana kwamanzi akwenzi ngokushesha. Izinsalela zingaba yizithelo ezisele noma zingaba yizinsalela ezivela lapho kusebenza njalo ngemishini. Ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezomile, qinisekisa njalo ukuthi kukhona izinsalela ukuze amanzi agcinwe emhlabathini ophakeme.
Kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi inhloso yokulima ukuhweba ekugcineni. Kudinga imali eningi ukuze uqale uk planting ummbila. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla zibalulekile kakhulu uma uphatha ibhizinisi lokulima. Sidinga ukuhlukanisa izindleko ngezindlela ezimbili - izindleko eziqondile nezindleko eziguqukayo. Lokhu kuhambisana nezindleko eziphelele zokuphatha ibhizinisi lokulima epulazini - lezi yizindleko ezingabangelwa uk planting kwesivuno esithile. Lokhu kungabandakanya izindleko zokuhlola amarekhodi ezimali, imali yasebhange, amaholo, ugesi, amalayisense, ukuphathwa nokulungiswa, inzalo emalini ebolekiwe, ukuphathwa kwemoto, izinto zokubhala, njll. Lezi zindleko zingahluka kumlimi nomlimi ngoba usayizi wezinkambu awufani, inani lesikweletu lihlukile, futhi abanye abalimi abaphathi ukulima ngendlela efanayo. Lezi zindleko zihambisana nohlobo lwesivuno esithile esikhuluma ngaso. Lokhu kubandakanya izindleko ezifana ne-diesel, umanyolo, imbewu (uk planting), amakhemikhali, ukuvuna, ukumaketha, kanye namaholo çalışan. Ngokuvamile lezi zindleko endaweni eyodwa zingahluka kakhulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ulima ngendlela ethile noma u planting isivuno esithile, zifana kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukucabangela kahle ngezimali ngaphambi kokuba uqale uk planting noma iyiphi imbewu. Kungcono kakhulu ukuhlela uk planting indawo enkulu kahle ukuze uqinisekise umkhiqizo omuhle.
UShakespeare uthe, "Ungabi ngumfundi noma umphakeli, ngoba ukwefa kuvame ukulahlekelwa yikho kanye nabangane." Lokhu kuyiqiniso. Nokho, uma ungumlimi okwamanje, uzobhekana nengcindezi yokwefa imali ukuze ungene ebhizinisini lokukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani abalimi bedinga ukwefa imali? Nokho ungumnikazi wendawo noma wazi indlela yokulima ngenye indlela, khumbula ukuthi ukulima kuwubuhlakani futhi uzodinga imali ukuze uphumelele ebhizinisini lakho. Akukhathalekile ukuthi uthola kanjani indawo yokulima. Mhlawumbe uthola indawo ngokuhlelwa komhlaba, noma mhlawumbe uyithenga ngemali oyitholile kwenye indawo - kodwa uma ufuna ukulima, uzodinga imali. Umhlaba ubiza kakhulu, ngakho abantu bahlala becabanga ngezindlela zokwandisa imali ukuze bathenge umhlaba. Kodwa umhlaba ungowesigaba esisodwa sobuhlakani bokulima. Uma ulima ngezilwane, uzodinga ukuthenga izilwane (izinkomo noma izimvu, izinkukhu, izinkabi, noma izinkukhu). Uma ufuna ukukhiqiza okusanhlamvu noma imifino, uzodinga ukuthenga ama-traktor nemishini yokulima umhlaba. Akupheli lapho; uzodinga ukuthenga nezinye izinto ngaphambi kokuthi uqale uk planting (izimpande, umanyolo, amakhemikhali, idizili, njll.). Kungenzeka ukuthi inani lezi zindleko lidlula inani lokuthenga umhlaba. Yini esivumelwaneni sokwefa? Ukwefa imali kuwubuhlakani - kukhona umuntu onemali ofuna ukwandisa le mali. Kodwa bafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngeke balahlekelwe le mali futhi kamuva bafuna ukwenza inzuzo engaphezulu kwalokho okwefayo. Abafuni ukuthatha izingozi. Lapho kukhona ingozi, bazokwandisa izinga lenzalo futhi uzokhokha inani eliphezulu ukuze ufele le mali ekuqaleni. Ngokuvamile, uma ufele imali, uzodinga ukuhlinzeka ngempahla njengempahla. Lokhu kuvikeleka kumphakeli ekulahlekelweni yimali yabo; bazothengisa lezi zimpahla uma ungakabuyisi imali yakho. Esikhathini esedlule, abantu bavame ukufela imali endaweni eyodwa, futhi uma behluleka ukukhokha le mali, babengeza kwenye indawo ukuze bakweze imali yokukhokha imali yokuqala. Abantu babephakanyiswa ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nazo zonke izikweletu zabo. I-NCA (Umthetho Wokukhokha Kwamazwe) ishintshe lokhu. Abantu abaphakela imali kumuntu bayazi ukuthi uma bengakwazi ukukhokha, bazobanjwa. Manje sekukhona imininingwane ngazo zonke izikweletu zabantu; uma inhlangano ephakela imali ingakwazi ukuthola konke kumlimi, bangabona ukuthi umlimi unazo izikweletu ezingaki futhi bangase banqume ukuthi bangamphakeli le mali entsha. Ngokuvamile, abalimi bayakhathazeka uma bengakwazi ukuthola imali, kodwa uma ungakakwazi ukukhokha le mali, kuzobhalwa ngokomthetho ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho liphumelele - bese kwenzeka izinto ezimbili ezimbi. Inhlangano ephakela imali izolahlekelwa le mali, futhi ngeke ukwazi ukufela imali futhi. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imali efelwayo kumele ibuyiswe - ufele imali, akusiyo nje isipho noma umnikelo. Kungani kunzima kubalimi abasha ukufela imali? Ikhono lakho lokukhokha imali kuxhomeke esimweni sezimali zakho nakusasa lakho. Umuntu ophakela imali kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uzokwazi ukukhokha le mali ngempela ekupheleni kwesikhathi esichaziwe. Uma sibheka uk planting izitshalo, sibona ukuthi uzodinga R5,000 ngehektare. Ngamanani wamanje (amanani eminyakeni edlule ayengaphansi kwe-R2,000 ngentoni), uzodinga ukuvuna ama-tonu angu-2.5 ngehektare ukuze ufinyelele izindleko. Khumbula ukuthi ngokuqhelekileyo ezindaweni eziningi, kuvunwa ngaphansi kwamatonu amabili ngehektare. Uma umlimi efuna ukufela imali ukuze abeke izitshalo, umphakeli uzobheka umkhiqizo ojwayelekile unyaka nonyaka, amanani azotholakala, kanye nezindleko zokubeka izitshalo. Ngakho-ke, okwamanje, akukhona abantu abavuma ukuphakela imali yokubeka izitshalo. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo akukwazisi. Umkhawulo wenzuzo ovela emalini oyifakayo uncane. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo kukhathazekile, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imisebenzi yokukhiqiza ukudla ivame ukuba ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Manje sekukhona ukuhlinzeka okweqile kokudla, amanani ehla, kodwa izindleko zokukhiqiza ziyaqhubeka nokwenyuka. Ngakho-ke, izinhlelo zokuphakela imali azisathandi ukuphakela ngoba umphakeli ngeke akwazi ukukhokhela umphakeli inzuzo eyanele. Ubuchwepheshe bomlimi. Uma uqala ibhizinisi elisha, awunalo ulwazi oluningi, ngakho uzokwenza amaphutha. Lokhu kuyiqiniso nakubalimii abasha - abakhombisanga ukuthi bangalima iminyaka eminingi. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukufela imali. Impahla yokwefa. Sishilo ukuthi umphakeli ufuna ukwazi ukuthi uma ungakabuyisi imali, bazokwazi ukuthengisa izimpahla zakho ukuze babuyise imali yabo. Ngokuvamile, umlimi ngeke akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokulima njengempahla (okujwayelekile ekulimaleni). Abalimi abaningi abawona abanikazi bezindawo zokulima (njengomhlaba womphakathi noma umhlaba uqashwe), noma umhlaba unebhondi eyinhloko esiza umlimi ukuthenga le ndawo. Uma umlimi engakakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempahla, umphakeli uzophika ukuphakela imali ngoba besaba ukulahlekelwa yimali yabo. Bangabalamini bamehluko ukuze bazame ukuthola imali yokubeka ngaphandle kwempahla? Imali edingekayo yokubeka ngokuvamile ifinyelela ku-R4,500 ngehektare (sithatha lokhu lapha njengomfanekiso). Uma umlimi efuna ukubeka amahektare angu-100, udinga ukufela R450,000. Lokhu kuyimali eningi. Ake sithi umlimi unama- fields amahle, anokuhlala okwaneleyo, umkhiqizo uvame ukuba muhle, futhi imakethe ivumela ukwenza inzuzo, khona-ke umlimi angaya eLand Bank, ezinkampanini zokulima, noma ezinkampanini zokubambisana ukuze athole imali yokubeka. Ake sithi umlimi ngeke akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokulima njengempahla, manje umlimi kufanele athole enye indlela yokuhlinzeka ngempahla. Lapha, ukuqinisekisa izitshalo kungase kube yindlela (ukuqinisekisa okokufaka). Le nqinisekiso ivikela "izenzakalo zikaNkulunkulu," hhayi ukulima okungafanele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi kufanele alime kahle, akhombise ukuthi uvame ukuthola umkhiqizo omuhle unyaka nonyaka, bese engazama ukuthola le nqinisekiso. Inkampani ye-inshurensi izobheka inqubekela phambili yomhlaba ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi ingaphika ukuqhubeka ne-inshurensi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi - bahlola uhlobo nobukhulu bomhlabathi, bahlola amasampula omhlabathi, bahlola indlela yokubeka, uhlobo lwezimpande, umanyolo osebenzisiwe, ukuphathwa kwezifo nezitshalo - uma konke lokhu kungahambisani nezidingo zabo, inkampani izophika ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa. "Izenzakalo zikaNkulunkulu" ezihlinzekwa ngokuqinisekisa zingafaka ukushoda, umoya, imvula eningi, ifiriji, kanye nomlilo. Khumbula ukuthi ukuqinisekisa akuvikeli ukuphathwa okungafanele. Uma umkhiqizo wakho uphansi ngoba awulimi kahle, ngeke ukwazi ukuthola ukuqinisekisa. Uma uvunyelwe ukuthola ukuqinisekisa ok

Ingxenye yalokho esifuna ukukufeza kulolu hlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi, olusekelwa yiMaize Trust, wukuthi: sifuna ukuqhubeka nokutshala nokuphatha izindawo zemfundo ezithile. Isizathu salokhu wukukhombisa izindlela ezinhle zokusebenza nokusebenzisa lezi zindawo lapho kunamathuba abalimi minyaka yonke. Isithombe sokuqala sikhombisa indawo yokufunda eMalekutu, ethola u-30 km enyakatho-mpumalanga kweNaspoti. Isithombe sesibili sikhombisa insimu eduze nendawo yokufunda. Kukhona okuningi okungaxoxwa ngalezi zithombe ezimbili - kuhlanganisa nokuhlukahluka komkhiqizo kwalezi zinsimu ezimbili. Ukuphakama komhlabathi (pH): ukuphakama kukalwa endaweni yokufunda. Umanyolo osetshenzisiwe: amasampula omhlabathi athathwe futhi umanyolo nokuphakama kwawuhanjiswa ngokuhambisana nezivivinyo zamasampula - bheka ukwehluka kombala phakathi kwalezi zinsimu ezimbili. Izinhlobo zezimbewu: endaweni yokufunda, izimbewu ze-hybrid (ezihlukile kulolu hlobo) zatshalwa, kanti kwenye insimu, izimbewu zomkhiqizo wonyaka odlule zatshalwa. Inani lezitshalo nokuhlelwa phakathi kwezithombo: esithombeni, akukhombisi kahle ukuthi kuhamba kanjani ukuhlela phakathi kwezithombo endaweni yokufunda, kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi kwenye insimu, izitshalo zikhona kakhulu. Isithombe sesithathu sikhombisa insimu yokufunda eMbuzini, ethola u-150 km eningizimu-ntshonalanga kweNaspoti iya eSwatini. Le maize ibukeka kahle kakhulu, ikakhulukazi uma sicabangela i-maize yabalimi abanye kule ndawo. Kubalulekile ukukhuluma kulezi zindawo ngezindaba ezihlobene nalezi ezilandelayo: ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi ukuze kuhlolwe, ukuphakama komhlabathi (pH), inani lezitshalo ngehektare, ukukhetha izinhlobo zezithombo, nokuphatha izitshalo eziphikisanayo nezifo. Izithombe 4, 5, no-6 zithathwe eMatibidi (enyakatho kweGraskop). Isithombe sesine sikhombisa abantu ezinsimini bebamba izambulela ngesikhathi socwaningo lokukhombisa. Izithombe 5 no-6 zikhombisa izinsimu zabanye abantu. Kucace bha ukuthi ama-tractors nezinye izinsiza zingaqashwa, kodwa uma kuziwa ekuphatheni nasekugcineni lezo zinsiza, asazi ukuthi ubani ozobhekana nalolo work. Izithombe 7 no-8 zikhombisa uMnu. Yini amafutha nezitshalo ezineprotheni? Ngokwewebhusayithi ye-SA Grains and Oilseeds, kuthiwa imikhiqizo engaphumeli emzimbeni ingokudla okungadliwa abantu. Amafutha angadliwa abantu, ikakhulukazi ngoba aqukethe amafutha abalulekile ekudleni. Izitshalo ezinefutha ezikhuliswa eNingizimu Afrika zifaka: amantongomane, ilanga, ikhonela, amabele, ikotoni, ummbila, kanye nesorghum. Amafutha akhuliswa ikakhulu ukuze akhishwe amafutha akhona. Okuqukethwe kwamafutha ezitshalo ezincane (njengekhonela) kungama-1% - 2%; okuqukethwe kwamafutha ezitshalo zamabele kufinyelela ku-20% futhi kudlula ku-40% ezitshalo zekotoni nasekhonelani. Amafutha angadliwa ngabantu atholakala kakhulu kumabele, ikotoni, ikhonela, i-linseed, kanye namantongomane. Amafutha afana ne-linseed kanye ne-castor oil asetshenziswa ezinhlelweni zezimboni. Uk formation of amafutha-aphakeme ezitshalo angadliwa ngabantu kufana nezinye ezidliwayo. Amafutha aqinile akhiqizwa uma engashisi kakhulu, kodwa amafutha ayisithako. Ikotoni, amantongomane, kanye namabele konke kufezwa ehlobo - kufezwa ekuqaleni kwehlobo ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuphazamiseka kweqhwa (kungalimala kalula yiqhwa), futhi kukhula ezinyangeni zokuqala zonyaka (ezindaweni lapho kunenhlanhla yokuna ehlobo). Izitshalo ziba sezinhlotsheni ezithile ekwindla futhi ngokuvamile ziqoqwa ngemuva kokufika kweqhwa. Ikhonela ifezwa ebusika - iyona kuphela i-oilseed engalimalwa yiqhwa. Izitshalo ezivunyiwe ziqhutshelwa, futhi amafutha akhishwa kuzo. Amafutha nemafutha abalulekile ekudleni, asetshenziswa njengefutha lokupheka, ifutha lesaladi, kanye nefutha lokufry, noma angabekwa ukuze kube ne-margarine nezinye izinhlobo zamafutha okCooking. Le mikhiqizo ingena emakethe yamafutha ivela ezinsizakalweni (njengebutter) ngoba la mafutha awanele ukudlisa abantu bonke emhlabeni ngenxa yokupholisa okusheshayo. Izinsalela ezisele ngemuva kokukhishwa kwamafutha ezitshalo zibalulekile ekufuyweni kwezilwane epulazini. I-meal ekhiqizwa kulokhu kusala ngemuva kokukhishwa kwamafutha kumabele, amantongomane, nezinye amafutha ixutshwa nezinye izinhlobo zamagugu ukuze kutholakale ukudla kwezilwane okuhle.
