Ukuze usebenzise kahle izicwangciso zakho zesikhathi esizayo futhi ufeze izinhloso zebhizinisi lakho, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izicwangciso zakho kusenesikhathi. Imvula kaJuni 2011 ixoxiwe mayelana nesicwangciso sokuphathwa kwebhizinisi. Sathi kungcono ukuba nesicwangciso esiphakathi kunokungabi nesicwangciso esijwayelekile, futhi sathi lokhu kuy umsebenzi obalulekile wokuphathwa kwebhizinisi. Umsebenzi wesibili wokuphathwa kwebhizinisi esizowuxoxa ngawo ukuhlanganisa kahle izicwangciso zakho zokusebenza. Lapho uhambisa izicwangciso, kusho ukuthi kudingeka ulungiselele ukuzenza lapho wenza imisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo. Nokho, kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi lapho sisebenza ekwakheni izicwangciso nasekuhlanganiseni izicwangciso, kwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye. Ukuhlanganiswa kusho ukukhetha ukuthi ubani ozokwenza umsebenzi onjani, nini, kuphi ngempela, nokuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezizodingeka ezifana nezinsiza, amathuluzi, izikhungo, nezimali ukuze ukwazi ukuqhuba lowo msebenzi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile kumkhiqizi ukuba azi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza abanazo - kokubili ezimali nakubantu abasebenza kubo. Kumele bazi amakhono, imfundo, ukuqeqeshwa, namakhono (amandla okwenza / ukusebenza, ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza imishini, amandla enhliziyo) abasebenzi babo. Abasebenzi kumele basebenze lapho benolwazi lokwenza lowo msebenzi, futhi kungabasiza ukwenza umsebenzi abawuthokozelayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlela ukuthutha, izinsiza, nemali yokuqala yokutshala ezindaweni ezifanele nangasikhathi esifanele. Ukuze ukwazi ukuhlanganisa izicwangciso, kudingeka ubheke yonke imisebenzi ekhona ngaphakathi kwalezo zicwangciso futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kuqhutshekwe nalezo zicwangciso ngesikhathi esifanele. Lapho sikhuluma ngokuhlanganisa izicwangciso, singasebenzisa izindlela zokwakha izicwangciso nokuhlanganisa lezo zicwangciso njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni 1. Lokhu kulandela isibonelo esisetshenziswe ngoJuni 2011. Bheka insimu 5. 3 - 10 hectares. Abasebenzi ababili (umsebenzi wesigaba). Amathrekhtha amabili namathreila amabili. Bheka ukudla kwezilwane nezokwenziwa. Susa esiswini, phawula, phatha imithi, ufinyelele izinga lokuphila lama-calves angama-100. Moloto, Abram, Kagiso, noHendrik. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Izinsiza zokuphatha izilwane, izinsiza zokushisa (zokuphawula), amathuluzi okuphakela, izincwadi zokurekhoda. Wakha indlu 3 (susa izinto zokulala ezindala). Imisebenzi evamile yansuku zonke. Izindlu 1 no 2. Johanna, Minah, noJohannes. Sarah, Monica, noDawid. Ukuhlanganisa izinto, amabhakede, namathreila. Amathuluzi akhe, njll. Sikholelwa ukuthi bonke abantu abasebenza kulolu hlobo oluphezulu banolwazi futhi bakwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi. Sikholelwa futhi ukuthi zonke ezinye izinsiza zikhona futhi zilungile ukuze zisebenze. Uma lokhu kungelona iqiniso, zonke izicwangciso zakho nokuhlanganiswa kwezicwangciso kuzodingeka kubekwe eceleni ngoba labo basebenzi kudingeka baqeqeshwe kuqala, nezinsiza kudingeka zibe khona futhi zilungiswe ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umsebenzi ofana nokutshala noma ukufaka imithi ezilwaneni. Lokhu kuyisibonelo nje sezindlela ezingasetshenziswa ukuhlanganisa izicwangciso; konke kungashintsha ukuze kuhlangane nohlobo lokulima lwemfuyo kanye nezidingo zomlimi othile. Sivame ukubona ukuthi kubalulekile ukubhala phansi lapho kwakhiwa izicwangciso nokuhlanganiswa kwezicwangciso emsebenzini onjengalolu. Njengokwakha izicwangciso, ukuhlanganiswa kwalezo zicwangciso kungabhalwa encwadini, ebhodi, kukhompyutha, noma kwezinye izindawo. Njengokwakha izicwangciso, ngaphakathi kokuhlanganiswa kwalezo zicwangciso, ummeli kufanele azibophezele ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwebhizinisi efana nokuhamba phambili, ukubamba izintambo, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi, ukuthola ugqozi lokusebenzisa abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa. Usayizi webhizinisi uzokutshela ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani konke lokhu. Kumele kube ummeli oqala ngokuqhuba ukuhlanganiswa, ozokwazisa abasebenzi ngalokho okuzohlanganiswa futhi athathe izinyathelo zokuhlanganisa umsebenzi othile (yikuphi ithrekhtha noma imishini ezosetshenziswa nokuthi yibaphi abasebenzi abazosebenza). Kumele futhi baphathe umsebenzi ngokuqinile ekuhlanganiseni kwezinyathelo zebhizinisi. Kumele bakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngomsebenzi othile kumsebenzi othile uma kudingeka; abakwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngokwabo. Khumbula, uma ingxenye yemisebenzi yakho yokuphatha ingaqhutsheki kahle okwamanje, ibhizinisi lakho lizokwenza inzuzo, kodwa ngemva kwesikhathi esithile - mhlawumbe ngemva kweminyaka emihlanu noma eyishumi noma ngemva kwalokhu - ibhizinisi lakho lizoma, lizofa ngoba ngeke kube khona inzuzo. Ikusasa lethu libhekene nalolu shintsho (kufanele sibheke phambili kulokho esizokudla kusasa) - uma ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi lakho kungaqhubeki nokukhula njalo ngonyaka - ekugcineni ibhizinisi lizoma ngoba ngeke kube khona inzuzo. Asikwazi ukuqhubeka sisebenza ngendlela efanayo njalo. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka uthuthukisa umsebenzi ngokukhulisa imali engenayo nokunciphisa nokuphatha izindleko. Ukuhlanganiswa kahle kwezicwangciso kuzokusiza uphumelele ngendlela esichaze ngenhla.
Siphindaphinda ukuthi ukuvuselela abalimi akuyona into elula futhi akwenziwa ngobusuku obubodwa - kukhona abantu abaningi abasebenza kulolu hlelo, kunezinto eziningi ezifundwayo futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside. Asikwazi ukwenza konke lokhu sodwa, ngakho sithokozisa kakhulu ngosizo nokwesekwa kwabanye abantu abaningi. Umkhandlu Wesifunda i-Amathole. Karel Taljaard - i-Lime ne-Gypsum yaseNingizimu Afrika. Khula - ukwesekwa ezinsukwini zabalimi. Cliffe Deacon, Agricol - imbewu.
UJane uthi... Ngaphezu kwesikhathi kufanele simise futhi sizibuze ukuthi senzeni. Uma sifuna ukuthola impendulo ecacile, kufanele sisho futhi ukuthi singakwenza kanjani. Asisebenzisi abaqashi abamhlophe emapulazini abantu abamnyama. Asizami ukuhlinzeka abantu abalimala ngezindlela zokulima futhi ngaphambi kokuthi kube nezinsuku ezedlule. Asisazami ukwenza izinto ezikhangayo kuphela (ukuhlobisa). Asizami ukuthola ama-BCP ngoba kukhona abantu abathengisa lezi zinto. Asizami ukuthola ama-BCP ngoba kukhona labo abahlinzeka ngezinto. Kodwa, senzeni? Siphucula abakhiqizi abamnyama - abasebenza ngokwabo manje nakusasa. Siqeqesha abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuze baqonde futhi bathole ukuthi yiziphi izizathu zokwenza umsebenzi wezolimo. Siphakamisa abakhiqizi ukuba basebenzise kahle izinsiza zemvelo. Sibonisa abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuthi bahloniphe umhlaba abawusebenzisa. Sisebenzisa abantu ngalokho abanakho, sibasiza ukuba bathole impilo futhi bakhiqize ukudla kwabo, ikhaya labo, kanye nezwe labo. Sikusiza ukuguqula ubuso bokulima - sifuna ukuba baphume ebusweni lapho kukhona kuphela abalimi abamhlophe, sifuna bonke abantu lapha ezweni lethu bakhulume ndawonye. Sikusiza abantu abanomhlaba - umhlaba womphakathi wonke, umhlaba oqashiweyo, noma labo abanomhlaba wabo (amapulazi) ukuze basebenzise lowo mhlaba ngendlela ezoletha inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Sizama ukubambisana nazo zonke izigaba zikamasipala ukuze sihlanganise ukwesekwa okunikezwa abalimi. Sakha amasu ukuze abalimi bakwazi ukufinyelela emishini. Sakha amasu ukuze sithole izibonelelo kulawo magunya. Kunzima kimi lapho ngizwa ukuthi abantu balima ukuze abakhiqizi abamnyama. Kukho abantu nezinhlelo ezisebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama ukuze benze inzuzo, bese bethi lokhu "ukuthuthukisa abakhiqizi abamnyama." Uma ungumkhiqizi omhlophe usebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama - qasha lowo mhlaba, khokha intengo efanele, uqaphele ukuthi uqasha umhlaba futhi uthola inzuzo. Siyacela ukuthi ungazenzi sengathi usiza abanye abakhiqizi.
U- Ms. Jane uthi... Ezindabeni (eziphephandabeni, ithelevishini, umsakazo) zalesi sikhathi samanje, kukhuluma okuningi i-ANC Youth League mayelana nendaba yomhlaba (nokubhanga nemigodi), futhi kukhuthaza kakhulu ukubona ukuthi abantu abahlukene bakhuluma kanjani ngalesi sihloko somhlaba. Ngibona umhlaba njengomthombo okufanele siwusebenzisa ukukhiqiza ukudla nokuhlomula. Izinto eziningi lapha emhlabeni ziya zanda njalo unyaka nonyaka - abantu, izinkomo, izimoto, njll. Kodwa umhlaba awukwazi ukukhula - unemikhawulo. Uma ucabanga ngempilo eyanda njalo, kodwa umhlaba okhiqizayo uyancipha (masikhumbule ukuthi abantu badinga indawo yokwakha izindlu zabo - amadolobha akhula ngokusebenzisa umhlaba), kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlaba wonke usetshenziswa ngokukhiqiza. ENingizimu Afrika namuhla sinesimo esinzima ngoba iningi lomhlaba okhiqizayo liphethwe ngabantu abamhlophe. Manje kukhuluma ngokuthatha lowo mhlaba, hhayi ukuwuthenga, bese unikezwa abantu abamnyama. Kukho nezinye izinto okufanele zikhunjulwe, kukhona inani elikhulu lomhlaba eliphethwe nguhulumeni (ngaphansi komthetho kazwelonke) kodwa izindawo eziningi zalo mhlaba azisetshenziswanga kahle. Kukhona futhi izinkulungwane zamahhektare ezabelwe uMnyango Wezomhlaba ngezinhlaka zawo. Lokhu kuhambisana nombala wesikhumba somuntu. Ngicabanga ukuthi ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo, noma ungazimela, uphila endaweni encane, noma ungumkhiqizi wezohwebo akusho lutho ngalokho umbala wesikhumba somuntu. Sonke siyazi ukuthi uma ufuna ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo, udinga ulwazi namakhono, imishini, imakethe, kanye ne-capital yokuqala yokutshala. Ukunikeza umuntu umhlaba akusho ukuthi ungumkhiqizi - nje ngoba uphakathi kwegaraji akusho ukuthi ungimoto! Ngokufanayo, nje ngoba unomhlaba akusho ukuthi ungumkhiqizi. Uma ufuna ukukhonjiswa njengomkhiqizi, kumele usebenzise umhlaba wakho ngokuphelele - kumele ukhiqize ngendlela engcono kakhulu ongayenza kulowo mhlaba. Ngifuna ukuphakamisa ukuthi sixhase ngamandla ethu bonke labo abanomhlaba ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa wonke umhlaba okhiqizayo ukukhiqiza ukudla kwethu. Umhlaba uyigugu elikhulu; uma unomhlaba, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuwusebenzisa. Masihlangane njengabantu abangakhiqizi ukuze sikhulise lokho esikwazi, sishiye izehlakalo ezikhuluma abapolitiki abakhonza kuphela bona.
Zonke izitshalo zidinga amanzi ukuze zikhule, futhi iphuzu elibaluleke kakhulu ekukhuleni izitshalo zembewu emhlabathini omanzi kumele kube khona umswakama owanele ngesikhathi sokukhula kwezitshalo zakho ze-maize. Ukuqala kule nyanga, ibhodi le-maize le-Pula Imvula lizothunyelwa kubafundi bonke, hhayi kuphela kubakhiqizi abakhuluma isiSisuthu eFree State. Ngakho-ke, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi iWestern Cape inezimo zokukhanya ezaziwa njengeMediterranean, okusho ukuthi ithola imvula yayo ebusika, isikhathi esifanele sokutshala i-maize. Ukubaluleka kokugcina umswakama emhlabathini kubakhiqizi be-maize eCape akubalulekile kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa neNingizimu Afrika yonke, lapho kudingeka khona ukuthi sigcine imvula yasehlobo emhlabathini ukuze izitshalo zisebenzise ngesikhathi sebusika obomile. Ukutshala kudinga umswakama. Izitshalo ezahlukene zinezimfuneko ezahlukene okumele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokuthi kunqunywe ukuthi iyiphi isitshalosuitable yokutshala. Umswakama uphinde ube nesidingo sokukhuthaza ukwehliswa kwezimfucuza zezithombo ezedlule futhi wandise izakhamzimba ezikhona emhlabathini, kuvumela izitshalo ukuba zifinyelele ezakhamzimbini. Ungase ungakakwenzi isinqumo sokuthi uzotshala i-maize noma cha; isinqumo sakho sincike ezinzuzweni ezitholakala ekulimaleni kwe-maize nasekuhleleni kwakho kwesikhathi esizayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa komhlabathi. Abakhiqizi abaningi benza izinqumo zokukhulisa izitshalo ezithile ngokusekelwe kuzinguquko ezithile, ngaphandle kokugxila kumaphuzu okushintsha amanani. Ukutshala i-maize njalo ngonyaka kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi unokulima uma unyaka ubalulekile, futhi ukuthi unama-maize okuthengisa uma amanani emakethe ephezulu (kodwa kungenzeka futhi ukuhweba ngalokhu - uzoba ne-maize nakweminye iminyaka emibi, futhi kuzomele uyithenge ngamanani aphansi uma ethola). Kubalulekile ukuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo zakho zizokwazi ukufinyelela umswakama owanele emhlabathini ngesikhathi sonke sokukhula kwazo. Zonke izindawo zingagcina amanzi, kodwa ezinye zinekhono elingcono lokugcina umswakama emhlabathini. Imhlabathi ye-sandy inekhono eliphansi lokugcina amanzi njengoba amanzi angagcwala emhlabathini futhi alahleke, ngaphandle uma kukhona izingqimba ezingangeni (njengamatshe noma i-clay, ngokwesibonelo) ezovimbela amanzi ukuthi angadluli futhi alahleke. Imhlabathi enezingqimba ezingangeni (njenge-clay ngokwesibonelo) ezindaweni ezingu-600 mm kuya ku-1 m ilungele ukugcina umswakama emhlabathini kanye nokukhiqiza izitshalo zonyaka. Imhlabathi eminingi ye-sandy eFree State empumalanga iyahambisana nalokhu, yingakho ilungele ukutshala i-maize ebusika nakuba kuyindawo ethola imvula yasehlobo. Ngaphandle kokuthi ube nenhlanhla yokuba namanzi anele okokunisela, kuzomele uthembeke emvuleni ukuze umhlabathi uthole umswakama. Izingqimba eziphezulu zomhlabathi ezithambile zivumela imvula ukuba ingene emhlabathini. Kufanele ubone ukuthi imvula igijima kanjani emhlabathini eliqinile. Umswakama ophakeme usiza ekungeneleleni kwamanzi; uphinde unciphise ukuhamba kwamanzi futhi unikeze isikhathi eside sokuthi amanzi angena. Amanzi agcinwa ezikhala phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi. Ama-sands angahluka kulawo anama-sandy kuya kulawo amnyama bese kuba kulawo anama-clay, futhi uhlobo ngalunye lomhlabathi lungagcina inani elihlukile lamanzi. Imhlabathi ye-sandy, i-clay, kanye nemhlabathi emnyama ingagcina ama-25 mm wamanzi emhlabathini angu-150 mm. (Imhlabathi enobukhulu obusebenzayo obungu-1 m bezimpande ingagcina ama-180 mm emvula). Ikhono lokugcina umswakama emhlabathini lincike ohlotsheni lomhlabathi, isakhiwo nomumo womhlabathi, kanye nobukhulu bomhlabathi. Umswakama emhlabathini ungalahleka emhlabeni ngenxa yokukhanya kwelanga. Umphetho womhlabathi ungashisa, okwandisa ukuvuthwa, okwenza amanzi ahlale emhlabathini (lokhu kuyukuhamba komswakama emhlabathini phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi), efika emaphethelweni omhlabathi lapho evuthwa emoyeni; kusetshenziswa izitshalo ezikhulayo noma ezinye izitshalo ezingathathwa njengezihlahla emkhakheni (lokhu kuyisizathu esikhulu sokulahleka komswakama emhlabathini). Singagcina kanjani umswakama ngempumelelo? Qinisekisa ukuthi imvula engena emhlabathini ingangena kulowo mhlaba; gcina umphezulu womhlabathi unempilo. Izingqimba eziphezulu zomhlabathi zisebenza njengovimbela oqinile ukuze amanzi emvula angena ahambe esikhundleni sokungena ngaphansi komhlabathi. Gcina izinsalela zezithombo ezedlule zikhona ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze unciphise umthelela oqondile wezimpukane emhlabathini futhi ngaleyo ndlela unciphise ukwakheka kwesikhumba somhlabathi. Kumele kukhunjulwe ukuthi izitshalo zingase zidinge amafutha e-nitrogen engeziwe ngenxa yokuncipha kwezinsiza ezivela ezinsaleni zezithombo ezedlule, okuzoncika ekwehlisweni kwezithombo ezindala ezisele. Ngemuva kwemvula enkulu, phula noma iyiphi isikhumba esingase sibe sekuvele emaphethelweni omhlabathi. Isikhumba asivimbi kuphela ukungena kweminye imvula kodwa futhi sikhuthaza ukuvuthwa ukuze spread amanzi phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi, okwenza umhlabathi ube nomswakama. Gcina umhlabathi ungenazihlahla kusukela ngesikhathi sokuvuna izitshalo ezedlule kuze kube sekuthaleni kwezinye izitshalo. Ukwakhiwa kwesembozo esenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ukuze kugcinwe umswakama okwakhiwe uthuli emaphethelweni omhlabathi kuba uvimbela ekuvuthweni kwamanzi phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi, kuholela ekulahlekelweni komswakama emhlabathini kuya emoyeni. Nakuba isembozo esenziwe ngezinto ezifana nothuli olomile sigcina umswakama ngokumunca ukushisa kokukhanya kwelanga, ukuvuthwa kungaqhubeka kodwa ngezinga eliphansi emhlabathini omile ogwini lwe-5 cm. Isembozo esenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo ukuze kugcinwe umswakama singaba yizinsalela zezithombo (uma kuxoxwa kabanzi) noma singaba yisembozo esenziwe ngezinto ezifana nothuli okufanele kugcinwe ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi kumele kungaphazanyiswa ngokulima umhlabathi ngama-machinery. Ezinye izindawo ezihlobene nokukhiqiza izitshalo zibalulekile empumelelweni. Udinga ukugcina umswakama ngendlela engcono kakhulu ongayenza futhi ugcine umhlaba wakho ungenazihlahla ngaso sonke isikhathi. Umswakama ungomunye wezinto ezinkulu ezivimbela ukukhiqizwa kwezithombo.
Umoya (amanzi) ubalulekile ngesikhathi sokutshala lapho izitshalo zikhula ezindaweni ezithola kuphela imvula. Ulwazi mayelana nenani lemvula elizokwanela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lungatholakala kuMnyango Wezolimo oseduzane nawe. Lokhu kungasetshenziswa njengemihlahlandlela lapho sihlela izindlela zethu zokukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani kufanele sigcine amanzi emhlabathini? Ukutshala kudinga amanzi - izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo zidinga izinga elihlukile lamahora, ngakho kufanele sicabangele lokhu ngaphambi kokukhetha isitshalo esithile sokulima. Imvula yemvelo ayivamile ukuvela ngesikhathi esifanele sesitshalo esithile. Ngokuvamile, izindawo eNingizimu Afrika lapho kukhula khona izitshalo zokudla ezomile zidinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunamanzi anele emhlabathini ngesikhathi esifanele sokutshala ukuze imbewu ikwazi ukuvuthwa kalula nemizi ikwazi ukukhula kahle ekuqaleni. Isikhathi esifanele sokutshala sizobhekelela nezinye izikhathi ezibalulekile lapho isitshalo sikhula (isibonelo: imvula ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwezinsika zembewu kanye naleso sikhathi lapho izimbali ze-pumpkin ziphuma). Ukuze izitshalo ezisele emathafeni zife ngokushesha futhi zandise inani le-'humus' emhlabathini, okwenza izitshalo zithole izakhamzimba. Ingabe zonke izinhlobo zomhlabathi zingagcina amanzi? Yebo, kodwa umhlabathi onoshukela nomhlabathi opholile uzokwenza amanzi amaningi alahleke. Umhlabathi onamathambo aqinile (njengekleyi) ezindaweni ezingu-600 mm kuya ku-1 m ugcina amanzi kahle uma usetshenziswa. Singasiza kanjani umhlabathi ukuthi wamukele imvula? Umhlabathi ophakeme uphumelelayo, awuqinile, noma kokubili. Kukhona izitshalo eziphuma phezulu komhlabathi. Amanzi agcinwa kanjani emhlabathini? Amanzi agcinwa ezikhala phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi. Izinhlobo zomhlabathi ziyahluka: kukhona usawoti, i-silt, ne-clay. Inani lamahora angagcinwa kulezi zinhlobo zomhlabathi lihluka futhi. Lezi zinhlobo zomhlabathi ngokuvamile zingagcina ama-25 mm wamazinga emanzini emhlabathini ongu-150 mm. (Emhlabathini lapho imizi ingafinyelela ku-1 m, ama-180 mm emvula angagcinwa). Yini edala ukuthi amanzi alahleke emhlabathini? Ukukhanya kwelanga. Umhlabathi uyashisa futhi amanzi ayaphuma. Ukukhuphuka kwe-capillary emhlabathini. Amanzi ahamba phakathi kwezithako zomhlabathi, akhuphuka, futhi aphume emoyeni. Izihlahla eziyizihlahla ezikhula nezinye izitshalo ezifana nograsi - amanzi alahleka ezithelweni (lokhu kuyimbangela enkulu yokulahleka kwamanzi). Yini esingayenza ukuze sigcine amanzi kahle? Qinisekisa ukuthi imvula ingangena emhlabathini. Uma kukhona ungqimba oluqinile phezulu, amanzi awakwazi ukungena, bese amanzi eqala ukuhamba kude futhi awakwazi ukungena phansi. Zama ukushiya izinsalela eziningi zezitshalo zonyaka odlule ukuze imvula ingagibeli emhlabathini kakhulu, ngaleyo ndlela ivimbela ukwakheka kwegatsha eliqinile. Khumbula njalo ukuthi ukuphuma kwezinsalela kudinga isikhathi, futhi umanyolo onothile ngenitrogen uzodingeka ngoba izinsalela eziphumayo azihlinzeki ngenitrogen ngokushesha. Uma imvula inezinga eliphezulu, phula ungqimba oluqinile phezulu komhlabathi. Ungqimba oluqinile luzovimba imvula eyengeziwe ukuthi ingangeni emhlabathini futhi lwenze amanzi aphume, okwenza umhlabathi ube namanzi ngokushesha. Qinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba uhlanzekile futhi ungabi nezihlahla ngemva kokuvuna kuze kube sekufikeni kwesizini entsha yokutshala. Izinsalela zezitshalo phezulu komhlabathi zivimba ukuhamba kwamanzi futhi azikwazi ukuphuma. Ilanga lishisa izinsalela, kodwa ukuhamba kwamanzi akwenzi ngokushesha. Izinsalela zingaba izitshalo ezisele noma zingaba izinsalela ezivela lapho ukulima kwenziwa njalo ngama-mishini. Ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezomile, qinisekisa njalo ukuthi kukhona izinsalela ukuze amanzi agcinwe emhlabathini ophakeme.
Kufanele sihlale sikhumbula ukuthi injongo yokulima ukuhweba ekugcineni. Kudinga imali eningi ukuze uqale ukutshala ummbila. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ukudla zibalulekile kakhulu uma uphatha ibhizinisi lokulima. Sidinga ukuhlela izindleko ngezindlela ezimbili - izindleko eziqondile nezindleko ezishintshashintshayo. Lokhu kuhlobene nezindleko eziphelele zokuphatha ibhizinisi lokulima epulazini - lezi yizindleko ezingabangelwa ukutshala isivuno esithile. Lokhu kungabandakanya izindleko zokuhlola amarekhodi ezimali, imali yasebhange, amaholo, ugesi, amalayisense, ukuphathwa nokulungiswa, inzalo yemali ebolekiwe, ukuphathwa kwemoto, izinto zokubhala, njll. Lezi zindleko zingahluka kumlimi nomlimi ngoba usayizi wezinkambu awufani, inani lesikweletu lihlukile, futhi abanye abalimi abaphathi ukulima ngendlela efanayo. Lezi zindleko zihambisana nohlobo lwesivuno esithile esitshaliwe. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindleko ezifana ne-diesel, umanyolo, imbewu (ukutshala), amakhemikhali, ukuvuna, ukuthengisa, kanye namaholo abasebenzi. Njalo lezi zindleko endaweni eyodwa yehektare zingahluka kakhulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ulima ngendlela ethile noma utshala isivuno esithile, zifana kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukucabanga kahle ngezimali ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukutshala noma yisiphi isivuno. Kungcono kakhulu ukuhlela ukutshala indawo enkulu kahle ukuze uqinisekise umkhiqizo omuhle.
UShakespeare uthe, "Ungabi mboleki noma umbolekisi, ngoba mboleko ivamise ukulahlekelwa yiyo kanye nabangane." Lokhu kuyiqiniso. Nokho, uma ungumlimi okwamanje, uzobhekana nengcindezi yokuboleka imali ukuze ungene ebhizinisini lokukhiqiza ukudla. Kungani abalimi befuna ukuboleka imali? Nokuthi ungumnikazi wezindawo noma wazi kanjani ukulima ngenye indlela, khumbula ukuthi ukulima kuyibhizinisi futhi uzodinga imali ukuze uqhube ibhizinisi lakho. Akukhathalekile ukuthi uthola kanjani umhlaba. Mhlawumbe uthola umhlaba ngokusebenzisa umthetho wokulungisa umhlaba, noma mhlawumbe uwuthenga ngemali yakho oyitholile kwenye indawo - kodwa uma ufuna ukulima, uzodinga imali. Umhlaba ubiza kakhulu, ngakho abantu bahlala becabanga ngezindlela zokwandisa imali yokuthenga umhlaba. Kodwa umhlaba ungowengxenye yebhizinisi lokulima. Uma ulima ngezinkomo, uzodinga ukuthenga izinkomo (izinkomo noma izimvu, izinkukhu, noma izinkabi). Uma ufuna ukukhiqiza okusanhlamvu noma imifino, uzodinga ukuthenga ama-traktor nemishini yokulima umhlaba. Akuqedi lapho; uzodinga ukuthenga nezinye izinto ngaphambi kokuthi uqale uk planting (izitshalo, umanyolo, amakhemikhali, i-diesel, njll.). Kungenzeka ukuthi inani lezi zindleko lidlula inani lokuthenga umhlaba. Yini esivumelwaneni sokuboleka? Ukuboleka imali kuyibhizinisi - kukhona umuntu onemali ofuna ukukhulisa leyo mali. Kodwa bafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngeke balahlekelwe le mali futhi kamuva bafuna ukuhola okuningi kunalokho okubolekiwe. Abafuni ukuthatha izingozi. Lapho kukhona ingozi, bazokwandisa izinga lenzalo futhi uzokwenza imali eningi ukuze uboleke le mali ekuqaleni. Njalo, uma uboleka imali, uzodinga ukuhlinzeka ngempahla njengempahla. Lokhu kuvikele umbolekisi ekulahlekelweni yimali yabo; bazothengisa lezo zimpahla uma ungabuyiseli mboleko yakho. Esikhathini esedlule, abantu bavame ukuboleka imali endaweni eyodwa, futhi uma behluleka ukukhokha le mboleko, babeyodlula kwenye indawo ukuze baboleke imali yokukhokha le mboleko yokuqala. Abantu babebanjwa ukuba bahlinzeke ngemininingwane mayelana nazo zonke izimbola zabo. I-NCA (Umthetho Wezokukhipha) ishintshe lokhu. Abantu abapheka imali kumuntu bazi ukuthi uma bengakwazi ukukhokha, bazobanjwa baphendule. Manje sekukhona imininingwane ngazo zonke izimbola zabantu; uma inhlangano yokubolekisa ingenakuthola konke kumlimi, bangabona ukuthi ummeli unazo ezingaki izimbola futhi bangase benze isinqumo sokungamukeli le mboleko entsha. Njalo, abalimi bayazithokozisa uma bengakwazi ukuthola mboleko, kodwa uma ungakwazi ukukhokha le mali, kuzobhalwa ngokomthetho ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho liphumelele - bese kwenzeka izinto ezimbili ezimbi. Inhlangano yokubolekisa izolahlekelwa le mali, futhi ngeke ukwazi ukuboleka imali futhi. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imali ebolekiwe kufanele ibuyiswe - uboleke imali, akusiyona nje isipho noma umnikelo. Kungani kunzima kubalimi abasha ukuboleka imali? Ikhono lakho lokukhokha mboleko lincike esimweni sezezimali zakho nasemhlabeni wakho. Umuntu ophakela imali kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uzokwazi ukukhokha le mali ekupheleni kwesikhathi esishiwo. Lapho sibheka uk planting izitshalo, sibona ukuthi uzodinga u-R5,000 ngehektare. Ngamanani wamanje (amanani angonyaka odlule ayengaphansi kuka-R2,000 ngotoni), uzodinga ukuvuna ama-ton angu-2.5 ngehektare ukuze uhlangabezane nezindleko. Khumbula ukuthi kaningi ezindaweni eziningi, kuvunwa ngaphansi kwamatonu amabili ngehektare. Uma umlimi efuna ukuboleka imali ukuze abeke izitshalo, umbolekisi uzobheka umkhiqizo ojwayelekile unyaka nonyaka, amanani azotholakala, kanye nezindleko zokubeka izitshalo. Ngakho-ke, okwamanje, akukho abantu abafuna ukuboleka imali yokubeka izitshalo. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo akuhlinzeki inzuzo. Umkhawulo wenzuzo evela emalini oyifakile ubuncane. Ukukhiqiza izitshalo kunenkinga, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kaningi yonke imisebenzi yokukhiqiza ukudla ibhujiswa. Manje sekukhona ukuhlinzekwa okweqile kokudla, amanani ehla, kodwa izindleko zokukhiqiza ziyaqhubeka nokukhula. Ngakho-ke, izinhlelo zokubolekisa azikathandi ukuboleka ngoba umbolekisi ngeke akwazi ukukhokhela umbolekisi inzuzo eyanele. Ubuchwepheshe bomlimi. Uma uqala umkhankaso omusha noma ibhizinisi, awunalo ulwazi oluningi, ngakho uzokwenza amaphutha. Lokhu kuyiqiniso nakwabanye abalimi abasha - abakhombisanga ukuthi bangalima iminyaka eminingi. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuboleka imali. I-collateral ye mboleko. Sishilo ukuthi umbolekisi ufuna ukwazi ukuthi uma ungakwazi ukukhokha le mboleko, bazokwazi ukuthengisa izimpahla zakho ukuze bazuze imali yabo. Njalo, umlimi ngeke akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngombuso njengempahla (okujwayelekile ekulimaleni). Abalimi abaningi abawona abanikazi bezindawo (njengomhlaba wombuso noma umhlaba uqashwe), noma umhlaba unebhondi eyinhloko esiza umlimi ukuthenga lowo mhlaba. Uma umlimi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempahla, umbolekisi uzophika ukuboleka imali ngoba besaba ukulahlekelwa yimali yabo. Bangakwenza kanjani abalimi ukuzama ukuthola mboleko yokubeka ngaphandle kwempahla? Imali edingekayo yokubeka ivamise ukufinyelela ku-R4,500 ngehektare (sithatha lokhu lapha njengomfanekiso). Uma umlimi efuna ukubeka ama-hectare angu-100, uzodinga ukuboleka u-R450,000. Lokhu kuyimali eningi. Ake sithi umlimi unendawo enhle, enomhlaba ophilile, indawo lapho kunenhlama eyanele, umkhiqizo uvamise ukuba muhle, futhi imakethe ivumela ukuba kube nenzuzo, khona-ke umlimi angaya eLand Bank, ezinkampanini zokulima, noma ezinkampanini zokubambisana ukuze athole mboleko yokubeka. Ake sithi umlimi akakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngombuso njengempahla, manje umlimi kufanele athole enye indlela yokuhlinzeka ngempahla. Lapha, umshwalense wezimpahla ungase ube nendima (umshwalense wokufaka). Lo mshwalense uvikeleka ezindleleni "zeZinkanyezi," hhayi ekulimaleni okungalungile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi kufanele alime kahle, akhombise ukuthi uvame ukuthola umkhiqizo omuhle unyaka nonyaka, bese angazama ukuthola lowo mshwalense. Inhlangano yomshwalense izobheka inqubekela phambili yomhlaba ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi ingaphika ukuqhubeka nomshwalense nganoma yisiphi isikhathi - bahlola uhlobo nobukhulu bomhlaba, bahlola amasampula omhlaba, bahlola indlela yokubeka, uhlobo lwezithelo, umanyolo osebenzisiwe, ukuphathwa kwezifo nezitshalo - uma konke lokhu kungahambisani nezidingo zabo, le nkampani izophika ukuhlinzeka ngomswalense. "Izinto zeZinkanyezi" ezihlinzekwa umshwalense zingabandakanya ukuntula, isichotho, imvula eningi, umkhovu, kanye nomlilo. Khumbula ukuthi umshwalense awuvikeleki ezindleleni zokulima ezimbi. Umanyolo osetshenzisiwe: izibonelo zomhlabathi zithathwe futhi umanyolo nokuphakama kwafakwa ngokuhambisana nezivivinyo zezibonelo - bheka umehluko wombala phakathi kwezi nsimu ezimbili. Yiziphi izitshalo ze-oyili nezitshalo zephrotheni? Ngokwekhasi le-SA Grains and Oilseeds, kuthiwa imikhiqizo engaphumeli emhlabeni ingukudla okungadliwa abantu. Izitshalo ze-oyili zingadliwa futhi abantu, ikakhulukazi ngoba ziqukethe amafutha adingekayo ekudleni. Izitshalo eziyi-oyili ezikhuliswa eNingizimu Afrika zifaka: amantongomane, ilanga, ikhanola, ubhontshisi, ikotoni, ummbila, kanye ne-sorghum. Izitshalo ze-oyili zikhuliswa ikakhulukazi ukuze kutholakale amafutha akhona. Okuqukethwe kwamafutha ezitshalo ezincane (njengekhanola) kufinyelela kuphela ku-1% - 2%; okuqukethwe kwamafutha ezitshalo zebhontshisi kufinyelela ku-20% futhi kudlula ku-40% ezitshalo zekotoni kanye nekhonola. Izitshalo ze-oyili ezingadliwa abantu zikhona kakhulu kubhontshisi, ikotoni, ikhanola, i-linseed, kanye namantongomane. Izitshalo ze-oyili ezifana ne-linseed kanye ne-castor oil zisetshenziswa ezinhlelweni zezimboni. Ukwakhiwa kwezitshalo ezinefutha elinothile ezingadliwa abantu kufana nezinye ezidliwayo. Amafutha aqinile akhiqizwa uma engashisi kakhulu, kodwa amafutha ayigazi. Ikotoni, amantongomane, kanye nobhontshisi konke kufezwa ehlobo - kufezwa ekuqaleni kohlobo lwehlobo ngemva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuphazamiseka kweqhwa (kungase kudinge ukulimala kalula yiqhwa), futhi kukhula ezinyangeni zohlobo lwehlobo (ezindaweni lapho kunenhlangano yokuna ehlobo). Izitshalo zikhula ekwindla futhi ngokuvamile ziqoqa ngemva kokufika kweqhwa. Ikhanola ifezwa ebusika - iyona kuphela isitsha se-oyili esingalimaliwe yiqhwa. Izitshalo ezivunyiwe ziqhunyiswa, futhi amafutha akhishwa kuzo. Amafutha kanye namafutha abalulekile ekudleni, asetshenziswa njenge-oyili yokupheka, i-oyili ye-salad, kanye ne-oyili yokufry, noma angabunjwa ukuze kwenziwe i-margarine nezinye amafutha okCooking. Le mikhiqizo ingena emakethe yamafutha ivela ezinsizakusebenza ezingasasebenzi (njengebutter) ngoba la mafutha awanele ukudlisa bonke abantu emhlabeni ngenxa yokushisa okusheshayo. Impahla esele ngemva kokukhishwa kwamafutha ezitshalo ibalulekile ekulimaleni kwezilwane epulazini. I-meal ekhiqizwa kule mpahla esele ngemva kokukhishwa kwamafutha kubhontshisi, amantongomane, nezinye izitshalo ze-oyili ixubene nezinye izinhlobo zezimila ukuze kutholakale ukudla kwezilwane okuhle. Ukuze usebenzise kahle amasu akho esikhathini esizayo futhi ufeze imigomo yebhizinisi lakho, kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa amasu akho kusenesikhathi. Imvula kaJuni 2011 ixoxe ngamasu okuphatha ibhizinisi. Sathi kungcono ukuba necebo eliphakathi kunokungabi necebo elijwayelekile, futhi sathi lokhu kuyisibopho esibalulekile sokuphatha ibhizinisi. Umsebenzi wesibili wokuphatha ibhizinisi esizowukhuluma ngawo ukuhlanganisa kahle amasu akho okusebenza. Uma uhambisa amasu, kusho ukuthi kudingeka ulungiselele ukusebenzisa amasu akho lapho wenza imisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo. Nokho, kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi lapho sisebenza ekwakheni amasu nasekuhlanganiseni amasu, kwenzeka ngasikhathi sinye. Ukuhlanganiswa kusho ukukhetha ukuthi ubani ozokwenza umsebenzi muni, ngesikhathi esithile, kuphi ngempela, nokuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza ezidingekayo ezifana nezinsiza, amathuluzi, izikhungo, nezimali ukuze ukwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile kumkhiqizi ukuthi azi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezinsiza anazo - kokubili ezimali nakwabanye abasebenzi. Kumele bazi amakhono, imfundo, ukuqeqeshwa, namakhono (amandla okwenza/ukusebenza, ikhono lokusebenza kwemishini, amandla enhliziyo) abasebenzi babo. Abasebenzi kumele basebenze lapho benolwazi lokwenza lowo msebenzi, futhi lokhu kungabasiza ukwenza umsebenzi abawuthokozelayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlela ukuthutha, izinsiza, nezimali zokuqala zokutshala endaweni efanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze ukwazi ukuhlanganisa amasu, kudingeka ubheke zonke izabelo ezikhona ngaphakathi kwalezi zamasu futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izinsiza ezitholakalayo zokusebenzisa lezi zamasu ngesikhathi esifanele. Lapho sikhuluma ngokuhlanganisa amasu, singasebenzisa amasu okwakha nokuhlanganisa njengoba kuboniswe etafuleni 1. Lokhu kulandela isibonelo esisetshenziswe ngoJuni 2011. Hlola insimu 5. 3 - 10 hectares. Abasebenzi ababili (umsebenzi ophathekayo). Amathrekhtha amabili namathreila amabili. Hlola ukudla kwezinkomo nokuthi yini edliwayo.
