Izinsiza zokuphatha izinkomo, izinsiza zokushisa (zokubhalela), amathuluzi okuphakela, izincwadi zokurekhoda. Yakha indlu 3 (susa izinto zokulala ezindala). Imisebenzi ejwayelekile yansuku zonke. Izindlu 1 no-2. Johanna, Minah, noJohannes. Sarah, Monica, noDawid. Ukuqoqwa kwezinto, amabhakede, namathreila. Amathuluzi akhe, njll. Sikholelwa ukuthi bonke abantu abasebenza kulesi sibonelo esiphakeme banolwazi futhi bakwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi. Sikholelwa futhi ukuthi zonke ezinye izinsiza zikhona futhi zilungele ukusebenza. Uma lokhu kungenjalo, zonke amasu akho kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwamasu kuzodingeka kubekwe eceleni ngoba labo basebenzi kudingeka baqeqeshwe kuqala, futhi izinsiza kudingeka zibe khona futhi zilungiswe ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umsebenzi ofana nokutshala noma ukufaka imishanguzo ezinkomeni. Lokhu kuyisibonelo nje sezindlela ezingasetshenziswa ukuhlanganisa amasu; konke kungashintsha ukuze kuhambisane nohlobo lokulima lwemfuyi kanye nezidingo zomfuyi othile. Sihlangabezane kaningi nokuthi kubalulekile ukubhala phansi lapho kwakhiwa amasu nokuhlanganiswa kwamasu emsebenzini onjengalona. Njengokwakha amasu, ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi zamasu kungabhalwa encwadini, ebhodini, kukhompyutha, noma kwenye indawo. Njengokwakha amasu, ngaphakathi kokuhlanganiswa kwalezi zamasu, umfuyi kufanele azibophezele ekwenzeni imisebenzi yokuphatha ibhizinisi efana nokuhamba phambili, ukubamba izintambo, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi, ukuthola ugqozi lokusebenzisa abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa. Usayizi webhizinisi uzokutshela ukuthi ungakwenza kanjani konke lokhu. Kufanele kube ngumfuyi oqala ngokuqhubeka, ozokwazisa abasebenzi ngalokho kuzohlanganiswa futhi athathe izinyathelo zokuhlanganisa umsebenzi othile (yikuphi ithrekhtha noma yimaphi imishini ezosetshenziswa nokuthi yibaphi abasebenzi abazosebenza). Kumele futhi baphathe umsebenzi ngokuqinile ekuhlanganiseni kwezinyathelo zebhizinisi. Kumele futhi bakwazi ukunikeza umsebenzi othile kumsebenzi othile uma kudingeka; abakwazi ukwenza wonke umsebenzi bodwa. Khumbula, uma ingxenye yemisebenzi yakho yokuphatha ingaqhubeki kahle okwamanje, ibhizinisi lakho lizokwenza inzuzo, kodwa ngemva kwesikhathi - mhlawumbe ngemva kweminyaka emi-5 noma emi-10 noma ngemva kwalokhu - ibhizinisi lakho lizoma, lizofa ngoba ngeke kube khona inzuzo. Ikusasa lethu libhekene nalolu shintsho (kufanele sibheke phambili kulokho esizokudla kusasa) - uma ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi lakho kungaqhubeki nokukhula unyaka nonyaka - ekugcineni ibhizinisi lizoma ngoba ngeke kube khona inzuzo. Asikwazi ukuqhubeka sisebenza ngendlela efanayo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuqhubeka uthuthukisa umsebenzi ngokwandisa imali engenayo nokunciphisa nokuphatha izindleko. Ukuhlanganiswa kahle kwamasu kuzokusiza ufeze impumelelo ngendlela esichaze ngayo ngenhla.
Siphinda sithi ukuvikela abalimi akusiyo into elula futhi akwenziwanga ngobusuku obubodwa - kunezinto eziningi ezahlukene abantu abasebenza kulolu hlelo, kunezinto eziningi ezifundwayo futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside. Asikwazi ukwenza konke lokhu sodwa, ngakho sithokozisa kakhulu ngosizo nokuqhubekisela phambili kwabanye abantu abaningi. iMasipala waseMathole. Karel Taljaard - iLime neGypsum yaseNingizimu Afrika. Khula - ukwesekwa ezinsukwini zabalimi. Cliffe Deacon, Agricol - imbewu.
Ibhola lekhanda yikhanda elitholakala kuyo yonke indawo lapho kukhuliswayo ummbila e-Afrika - leli bhola litholakala kuphela e-Afrika kanti ezinye izinhlobo zalo zihlala ezindaweni lapho ummbila ukhula khona. Ngokuvamile, singasho ukuthi leli bhola libangela ingozi efana no-10% wokukhiqizwa kommbila minyaka yonke - kodwa lingalimaza ukukhiqizwa okuphelele. Amagciwane adla ezithelweni, emithini, nasezimbali zommbila. Ulwazi mayelana ne-biological neendlela zokuphila kwalesi sikhala kubalulekile uma sizama ukuqonda indlela yokulawula nokulawula. Amagciwane agcwele aphila ezithelweni zommbila ezihlala ezindaweni ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngemuva kwalokhu, isizukulwane sokuqala sezinambuzane sikhuphuka ukuze sibe neziqhamo emva kwezinsuku eziyi-7 kuya kweziyi-10. Amagciwane akhuphukayo azodla amasonto ayisithupha ngaphambi kokuba aguquke abe yizigaxa ngaphakathi kwemithini yommbila. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu, ezinye izinambuzane zikhuphuka futhi zingasabalalisa leli bhola kuyo yonke indawo lapho zihlala khona. Ekuhlaleni, kunezindlela eziningi zokuphatha leli bhola. Lokhu kungafaka ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali, izinhlobo zezitshalo, izindlela zemvelo, kanye nokulawulwa kwe-biological nezinye izikhala. Lokhu ngeke kuqinisekise ukusulwa ngokuphelele kodwa kuzosisiza ukuphatha lesi sifo ngaphandle kokusabalala futhi sithole ukukhiqizwa okuhle. Amakhemikhali okuphatha ibhola lekhanda abhaliswe njengezibulala-zinambuzane zokuxhumana noma izibulala-zinambuzane ezidliwayo yileli bhola. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi amakhemikhali abiza kakhulu angcono, kodwa kukhona nezinye ezibiza kancane ezisebenza kahle. Kuthiwa ukuphatha leli bhola ngensipho engabulali phezu kwesikhathi esingama-6 weeks kungaba nezinkinga. Ngenxa kwezindleko zamakhemikhali, abalimi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi basebenzisa ukwelashwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuphalaza amakhemikhali masinyane kuboniswe ukuthi akusebenzi. Ukuphatha leli bhola ngamakhemikhali kufanele kwenzeke kuphela uma kubonakala ukuthi u-10% wezithombo zikhombisa izimpawu zengozi ngoba amagciwane aqala ukudla ezithelweni. Ukuhlola ingozi ye-10% kungaba uphawu lokufaka amakhemikhali ngesikhathi esifanele. Mhlawumbe ukuphalaza kuphela kungase kungabi yanele ngoba leli bhola lingavela futhi. Ngonyaka onjengalo, kungase kudingeke ukuhlola kahle ukuba khona kwamagciwane lapho ummbila uqala ukuvuthwa. Lapho amagciwane amancane engabulawa ngokushesha ngaphambi kokulimaza kakhulu ukuvuthwa kwesivuno. Uhlosile ukubulala lawa magciwane ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuthwa kufike cishe ku-50%. Ukufakwa kwezinhlobo ze-Bt-maize kwehlisile ingozi yokuhlaselwa yizikhala ngoba ngokuvamile azidliwa ibhola lekhanda. Lokhu kwenze amakhemikhali angabi namfuneko kakhulu ngoba kunejini elibulala amagciwane aleli bhola. Nokho, hhayi zonke izinhlobo ze-Bt-maize zisebenza kahle ngokumelene nebhola lekhanda - ngakho abalimi kufanele bakhethe kahle ukuthi yisiphi isivuno okufanele bakhule ngaso ngonyaka ozayo nangemva kwalokho. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) kufanele bazi ukuthi kukhona ezinsukwini eziyi-10 lapho amagciwane angase adle isivuno. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba amakhemikhali axhumana nomswakama okukhona ezithelweni zesivuno, avumela amagciwane ukuba aphile. Ingozi ethintwa yilezi zikhala izovela ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa ngeke ibe yingozi enkulu. Lawa magciwane akhiqiza izinambuzane ezizoya emoyeni ngonyaka omusha. Lapho ukhetha ukufaka amakhemikhali noma uk planting Bt-maize, kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi yikuphi okukhetha okunezindleko eziphezulu ngoba i-Bt-maize ibiza kakhulu. Ukukhulisa ebusika kungasiza ngoba izikhala ezihlala ezithelweni zommbila ezisemathafeni zizobulawa futhi azizoveli ngonyaka olandelayo. Futhi, ubusika obubandayo buzobulala ezinye. Lapho ukhulisa ebusika, kungase kube nomthelela wokuthi amagciwane afakwe emhlabathini, futhi izinambuzane azizukwazi ukuphuma nokundiza ngonyaka omusha. Kukhona abanye abahlaseli abavame ukudla amaqanda namagciwane ezikhala, kodwa abanciphisi kakhulu ingozi ethintwa. Abanye abalimi abangakhulisi ezindaweni ezinkulu bangazama uk planting utshani obubizwa ngokuthi i-Napier - izikhala zifaka emathafeni bese zishiya ummbila. Kodwa ngisho nabanye abalimi abakhulu bangazama uk planting lobu busika ngoba buhle ukudla kwezilwane. Izindlela zemvelo nokulawulwa kwe-biological nezinye izikhala azisebenzi kahle - kungcono ukuzama amakhemikhali noma uk planting i-Bt-maize. Bonke abalimi bommbila bayazi ukuthi ibhola lekhanda libangela ingozi enkulu. Kufanele liphathwe kahle futhi ngendlela efanele.
Isithombe 1: I-header ejikayo emaphakathi ikhombisa inani elikhulu lokufakwa kwamanzi okwenzeka ekugcineni lapho amanzi ehla khona. Khumbula ukuthi ingaphandle kwe-header ihamba ibanga elide ngaphambi kokufika lapho iqala khona, ngakho amanzi amaningi aphonswa ekugcineni kwezimpondo. I-sprinkler yokuqala eyayikwazi ukuhamba yona ngokwayo yatholwa ngo-1948 futhi yafakwa iphethini ngo-1952 nguFrank Zybach e-Eastern Colorado e-United States of America. Lokhu kwaba isisekelo semishini yamanje enama-header ajikayo nalawo ahamba ngokuqonda. Zingafaka amanzi ngendlela elawulwayo. Zisebenza ngamandla azo ngaphandle kokudinga abantu abaningi ukuze zisebenze. Zifaka amanzi ezindaweni ezinkulu ngendlela efanele. Zingafaka amanzi ngendlela eshibhile futhi zingafaka umanyolo ohlangene namanzi ukuze izinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlabathi zikwazi ukulinywa. I-header ejikayo inama-frames namapayipi axhaswe njalo ngemitha engama-50 nge-frame ehamba ezinyaweni ezimbili. Lokhu kuqinisa i-header endaweni eqinile ngoba zonke ezinye izingxenye ezihambayo zixhunywe kule header. I-header ikakhulu yakhiwe ngophahla olukhulu oluhambisa amanzi, i-frame exhasa le pipe, kanye nemishini ehambisa konke. Ubude be-span abudingi ukuba bufane ngoba kuzodingeka bube bufushane noma bube bukhulu kuye ngesisekelo sebhakabhaka noma isimo somhlabathi. Le pipe encane enama-sprinklers iqinisiwe ngama-cables athuthukayo ekugcineni kwe-span ukuze wandise indawo efakwe amanzi. Ama-sprinklers asebenza kahle kakhulu angabekwa nasekugcineni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufakwa kahle kwamanzi ngisho nasezindaweni ezikhaleni. Ama-header ajikayo angadlula imitha engama-1,000 ubude. Izinhlobo ezithile zamapayipi kanye nezindawo zingatholakala ngenombolo ethile yemishini. Lokhu kuyahluka uma imishini yakhiwa ngabakhiqizi abahlukene. Umkhiqizi we-header ethile uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokuphakama kwe-span kumshini othile. Ukuphakama kungahluka kusuka kumitha ezi-4 kuya kumitha ezi-0.3 kumshini othile. Umshini ongahanjiswa kuphela ungathengwa uma kukhona izindawo ezahlukene emasimini lapho i-header izobekwa - lokhu kungase kwenzeke uma kukhuliswe izitshalo ezahlukene emasimini awodwa. Isimo somhlabathi nesimo sebhakabhaka - kungaba umswakama noma umhlaba owomile - kungavimbela kalula ukuhamba kwe-header. Kunenani elilinganiselwe le-span ezingahanjiswa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umgwaqo ongamitha ezi-6 udingeka ezindaweni lapho ama-header ebekwe khona. Qaphela lapho uhamba lapho kukhona izithiyo nezimbobo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-span - kukhona izinhlobo ezingathuthwa. Khulula amandla ngaphambi kokuhambisa umshini. Ukugoba kwe-header. Iziphuzo eziqinisekisiwe ezingagoba kancane zizovumela umshini ukuba uhambise ezindaweni eziphakeme ezingu-14% - 30% kokubili phansi noma phezulu. Umshini onama-header ajikayo ngaphandle kwe-header eyakhiwe ngepipi ngaphakathi kwendawo yokufakelwa amanzi angafinyelela ku-360°, kodwa angavinjwa ezindaweni ezincane hhayi emjikelezweni wonke. Ungafaka amanzi ku-80-90% wendawo yebhakabhaka. Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi u-75% wezitshalo ukhula engxenyeni yangaphandle yomjikelezo, kanti ingxenye yangaphakathi yomjikelezo (50%) inezitshalo ezingu-25% zendawo yonke. Iconsume amanzi, amandla (ugesi), kanye nemali. Abakhiqizi abafaka amanzi abahlola njalo izinga lokumunca komhlabathi bavame ukugcina amanzi namandla, bakhulise umkhiqizo, bavimbele ukuwa komhlabathi, futhi banciphise ukungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ukuphathwa kahle kokufakwa kwamanzi kusho ukudala indawo lapho izitshalo zingakhula kahle, okusho ukuthi kubhekwa umhlabathi, akufanele kube umswakama kakhulu noma owomile kakhulu. Akekho omunye onolwazi olufana nolwakho ngamasimu akho, izitshalo zakho, kanye nokufakwa kwamanzi. I-header ejikayo iyimishini enhle yokufaka amanzi ezitshalweni, kodwa uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba yingozi, njengazo zonke izinsiza. Okulandelayo kuchaza ezinye izinto okufanele uzicabangele uma usebenza nalesi sikhali. Le mishini inikeza ithuba lokufaka amanzi ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze izitshalo zikhule, ukufaka ama-herbicides, ama-pesticides, kanye nezinye izifo, nokufaka umanyolo ofana ne-nitrogen kancane kancane ngokuya ngezidingo zezithombo. Le mishini ingafaka amanzi amancane njalo, kodwa lokhu kungaphindwa. Uma umlimi eqala ukufaka amanzi ngalesi sikhali, kufanele aguqule indlela yakhe yokufaka amanzi. Bangase babe used to ukufaka amanzi angu-30mm noma 50mm njalo, manje kufanele bafake leyo manzi kodwa hhayi konke ngasikhathi sinye - bangafaka leyo manzi ngokuphindaphinda noma ukuphindwe kathathu. Uma kufakwa amanzi amaningi ngasikhathi sinye, kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwamanzi futhi kwenze amawheels ahambe kanzima. Phinde ukhumbule ukuthi umlimi uphatha inani lamanzi ezimpandeni. Uma bethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi baqale ukufaka amanzi, kuzoba nzima ukuvimbela umonakalo ezitshalweni. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga kulabo abalimayo abasha abafaka amanzi ngalolu hlobo ngoba abazi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze i-arm ijike futhi ifike lapho iqala khona. Ungaphuthelwa ukuhamba i-header ejikayo, izokuletha inzuzo. Njengoba le ndlela ivame ukuhlinzeka ithuba lokugcina amanzi uma ifakwe kahle. Njengazo zonke izindlela zokufaka amanzi, lapha futhi izinga lokumunca komhlabathi kufanele lihlolwe njalo futhi kufanele ufake amanzi kuphela uma kudingeka. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukusindisa amanzi namandla ngenkathi izitshalo zikhula. I-header ejikayo ibiza kakhulu futhi ibekwe ngaphandle emasimini, ngakho-ke abalimayo abaningi bayakhohlwa ukuthi kunezinto ezidinga ukuhlolwa nokugcinwa njalo. Uma usebenza emshinini wakho, cabanga ngezinto ezibalulekile ezilandelayo. Khipha uwoyela kuzo zonke izigubhu zamagiya ezinyaweni nasezikhwameni ze-header bese ufaka uwoyela omusha. Sebenzisa uwoyela ophakanyiswa umkhiqizi womshini. Ngemuva kwalokhu, ungashintsha uwoyela njalo eminyakeni emithathu uma umshini usebenza kahle. Uma umshini usebenza ngaphezu kwamahora angama-1,000 ngonyaka, ungashintsha uwoyela minyaka yonke noma eminyakeni emibili. Hlola ibhodi eliqoqayo isihlabathi futhi uhlanze uma kukhona isihlabathi. Qiniseka ukuthi umshini ume ngokuqinile phansi. Khipha amanzi wonke ku-header nakumapayipi axhunywe ku-header. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi uma umshini uphuka ngesikhathi edingeka ukufakwa kwamanzi, kungadala ingozi enkulu.
Lokhu okukhuluma lapha kuhlose ukusekela bonke abalimi abazama ukuthola umhlaba/izindawo zokulima, kodwa kubalulekile futhi kulabo asebevele benazo izindawo zokulima ukuba bakwazi ukuhlola izimo zabo mayelana nokuphumelela kwezohwebo zabo kanye nekusasa. Ukuba ngum sahibi womhlaba sekuyindaba edinga ukunakwa futhi kuvame ukusetshenziswa ngababambisene nezepolitiki ukuze baphikise abanye. Nokho, umlimi ofisa ukuphumelela uma ethola umhlaba kufanele acabangele kahle zonke lezi zinto ezilandelayo. Kukhona ukulwa nezindaba ezingafanele mayelana nokuguqulwa kokuba ngum sahibi womhlaba; kunezindawo zokulima ezithengiswa ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi kumele kube nomuntu ofuna ukuthenga nomuntu ofuna ukuthengisa, kodwa izindawo zokulima eziningi azikafikanga kulabo okufanele bazuze ngokuthola indawo yokulima. Thina, abavela ngaphandle kwalesi senzo sokuguqulwa kokuba ngum sahibi womhlaba, siphonsa imibuzo ngendlela abatholwe ngayo abantu abathole izindawo zokulima. Kuvame ukuba sithole injabulo yabantu abathole izindawo zokulima, kodwa masinyane sithola ukuthi le phrojekthi yehlulekile, ifile, futhi ayilethi inzuzo! NgoMashi 2010, uNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya noMthetho Wokuguqulwa Komhlaba, uGugile Nkwinti, uvumile ukuthi izinhlelo zikamasipala zokuguqulwa komhlaba azizange zibe nempumelelo ngoba abaningi abathole umhlaba bahluleka ukuwusebenzisa ngendlela ethola inzuzo kanye nezinzuzo zezimali. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba kubeka engcupheni umgomo kahulumeni ophokophele ekuguquleni ukuba ngabantu abamnyama ngo-30% ngaphambi kuka-2014. Lokhu kuyicala! Bonke abantu abathintekayo kwezolimo eGrain South Africa nalabo abakwiGrain Value Chain bakholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela umhlaba kufanele kuqhubeke kahle ukuze ukukhiqiza kwezolimo ezweni lethu kuqinise ukutholakala kokudla esikhathini esizayo. Kunzima ukuqonda ukuthi abathintekayo ekukhetheni abantu abazozuza ngokuthola umhlaba basebenza kanjani. Kumele sikholwe ukuthi abakhangele abangane babo, ukuthi bahlolwe kahle ukuze inqubo yokuguqulwa kokuba ngum sahibi womhlaba iqhubeke ngendlela efanele ukuze kuzuze wonke amazwe ngezindlela ezinhle. Kulapho umlimi ofisa ukuba professional emsebenzini wakhe wokukhiqiza ukudla angathatha leli thuba lokuthuthukisa isimo sakhe. Abantu abacabanga futhi abafuna ukulima izinkundla zabo nokusekela umthetho wokuguqulwa kokuba ngum sahibi womhlaba kufanele bahlele izindlela zabo ngendlela efanele. Kumele baphakamise abalimi abasafufusa abazophumelela. Kuvame ukuba nabantu abathembela kuphela enhlanhleni kodwa bengenayo imfuno yokuzilungiselela ukuba babe ochwepheshe abazoba nezindawo zokulima zabo esikhathini esizayo. Zonke izinkampani ziqala ukukhula njengezimbewu - lokhu kuqala ngokwakha isu lebhizinisi. Akukho bhizinisi elingavuka emhlabeni ngaphandle kokusekelwa kwabanye abathintekayo kwezomnotho, ngakho-ke isu lebhizinisi liyithuluzi elichaza konke (inani, izindleko, njll.) ezizosiza ukuthi ubatshele ukuthi uzoba umlimi ozophumelela ekulimaleni. Le nqubo izokhombisa ukuthi unguchwepheshe ngoba izochaza izinyathelo ozothatha ukuze ufinyelele eziphumelweni ezinhle. Isu lakho lebhizinisi lizofaka lokho okulandelayo: imininingwane mayelana nezindlela zokuphatha ibhizinisi nezindlela zokwandisa umsebenzi wakho, futhi izokhombisa ukuthi uzofinyelela kulokho ezinsukwini ezimfushane nezide - futhi esikhathini esizayo. Isu lebhizinisi sizokhombisa futhi lapho ubona khona amathuba ebhizinisi nokuqonda ukuthi kwenzekani ezinsukwini ezimfushane nezide. Njengochwepheshe, isimo sakho sizokhombisa ukuthi uyazi ngemakethe namathuba nezingozi ezingase zibe khona. Ngoba ufuna ukukhombisa labo abazokusiza ukuthi unekhono namakhono okukhulisa, futhi ukuthi kukhona abanye abalimi nochwepheshe kwezolimo abazokweseka uhamba phambili. Zonke izinhlelo zebhizinisi zidinga ukuhlola konke emhlabeni. Kumele kube nemininingwane mayelana nezimali nezabelomali zesikhathi esizayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ebhizinisini lakho ngoba ukuhlela umhlaba akuhambi kahle, uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngendawo, kodwa kuvame ukuba nenkinga ngoba ngaleso sikhathi uhulumeni uyaphela, eshiya abatholi ngaphandle kwamandla nolwazi, ngaphandle kwemali yokuqala yebhizinisi, futhi bengasekelwa ekutholeni amakhono, ulwazi, nezikweletu. Kuyinto enhle ukuthola umhlaba, kodwa! Umuntu onengqondo ophupha ngokuhamba phambili uyazi ukuthi imali iyadingeka ukuze uqale ukuze iphupho libe yinto eqondile. Noma ubani angafaka imbewu emhlabeni, kodwa abanye abakwazi ukuyondla ukuze ikhule futhi ikhiqize ukudla. Kumele ufune usizo ukuze ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba zezimali ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi wakho wokulima uzoba kahle. Chaza lokho ofuna ukukwenza ekulimaleni kwakho. Khombisa ulwazi lwakho namakhono futhi unikeze izizathu zokukhanyisa ukuthi ungubani ofanele ukuthola umhlaba. Khombisa ukuthi ucabangele umhlaba ongawuthola, uyazi ukuthi izimo zezulu zimi kanjani kule ndawo lapho uzobe ufaka khona, uyazi futhi ukuthi imakethe izoba kanjani nokuthi yiziphi amathuba akhona. Qonda kahle imigomo yakho futhi ubheke izingozi ezingase zibe khona ezingenza umphumela wezohwebo khona. Lokhu kubalulekile kubo bonke abalimi ngezikhathi zethu zakhona ngoba kumele baphikise nabakhiqizi emhlabeni jikelele. Abakhiqizi kufanele babheke imakethe nsuku zonke ngoba bangase badinge ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wabo ngenkathi u-ukhukhamba usakhula! Isu elihle lokumaketha kufanele lihambisane nohlelo lokukhiqiza. Akusizi ukufaka ukudla abantu abazokudla kodwa kungabikho abathengi abazofuna ukukuthenga ngentengo ezoletha inzuzo efanele emsebenzini wakho. Izindleko zokuthenga imishini nokuyigcina njalo. Izindleko zokuqala zokufaka. Izindleko zokuhamba nezindleko ze-diesel. Izindleko zokuhola uma ukhetha ukungabi nazo zonke imishini ngokushesha. Isici esibalulekile secebo lakho sithi: isitatimende esikhombisa ukuhamba kwemali, esidinga usizo olungatholwa kumphakathi wezimali noma kumsebenzi wezezimali.
Ukuze ibhizinisi liphumelele, kumele liphathwe kahle. Ukuba nezicwangciso ezicacile kubalulekile ngoba ziyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zokuphatha ibhizinisi. Ukuphathwa kahle kusho ukuthi imisebenzi emine yokuphatha ibhalwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi liyaqhubeka nokukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lifinyelela ezinjongo ezifunwayo futhi lenze inzuzo. Imisebenzi yokuphatha ibandakanya: ukuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa isu, ukufaka isu emsebenzini, nokuhlola njalo ukusebenza (ukugcina ukulawula). Ukuhlela isu kuyisabelo esibalulekile kumkhiqizi ngoba kuyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zabo zokulima. Singathi ukuhlela isu kuzokhombisa indlela phambili nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezibekiwe ezinhlelweni zakho zokuhlanganisa lezi zenzo. Njalo sithi asikwazi ukuhlela izicwangciso ezicacile zokulima. Izizathu zalokhu zimi kanje: kunezinto eziningi ezingalawulwa, ezifana nezimo zezulu, izifo, ukuguquguquka kwemakethe, nezinguquko ezintengo zezimali nezokukhiqiza. Lezi zingozi zingavela ekulimaleni; zikhona, futhi sibhekana nazo lapho sizama ukwakha ibhizinisi lokulima. Nokho, siphinde sisho ukuthi isu elingaphelele lingcono kunokungabi naso nhlobo. Kungcono ukuhlela izicwangciso mayelana nonyaka ojwayelekile, bese sikwazi ukuhlela lezi zicwangciso uma izimo zishintsha phakathi kwalonyaka. Yini okufanele kwenzeke? Kuphi okufanele kwenzeke? Nini okufanele kwenzeke? Malini okufanele kwenzeke? Kanjani okufanele kwenzeke? Ukuba nekhono lokuhlela izicwangciso kudinga ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zibhalwe phansi futhi ziphathwe ngokuqinile. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kuyo yonke impilo yakho. Ungabhalela izicwangciso zakho encwadini, ebhodini, noma kukhompyutha, noma kuphi. Ngokwandisa ukubhalwa, lokhu kuzokusiza ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba uzoba nedatha yomlando yokukusiza uma ubheka phambili. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlela isu kwenzeka minyaka yonke - kuzokwenzeka ini ngonyaka ozayo epulazini. Kodwa kufanele kube nesu lesikhathi eside elibheka ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini epulazini esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuyisu elibanzi elikhombisa ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini esikhathini esizayo - leli thuba lingaba yiminyaka emihlanu noma ngaphezulu. Isibonelo: ukutshala izitshalo ezikhiqizayo kumahhektare angama-500, ukukhiqiza inyama emapulazini, nokukhulisa izinkukhu. Lokhu kuzokhombisa imisebenzi ejwayelekile okufanele yenziwe ngonyaka ozayo, njengokupenda indlu ethile, ukwakha ucingo oluthile, ukulungisa izakhiwo, ukuthenga imishini emisha, ukuya ezinsukwini zokuqeqesha abalimi, njll. Kuzokhiqizwa ini ngonyaka ozayo, malini kuzokhiqizwa, futhi kuzothengiswa kanjani? Tshalani amahektare angama-400 ommbila ukuze asetshenziswe epulazini, okusele kuzothengiswa ngenkontileka endaweni eseduze ekhiqiza ukudla kwezilwane. Tshalani amahektare angama-100 amabhontshisi ukuze athengiswe ngenkontileka. Khiqiza izinkomo ezingu-200 ezineminyaka engama-20 ezivela emapulazini ezizothengwa yiYYY Supermarket. Khiqiza izinkukhu ezingu-40,000 zenyama ngenyanga ezizothengwa yiXXX Chicken Wholesaler. Penda iworkshop ne-tractor shed. Wakha idamu endaweni enamahektare angama-9. Lungisa futhi uphathe zonke izakhiwo. Ngokusebenzisa isu lonyaka - elijwayelekile futhi elibheke ukukhiqiza - isu lwenyanga lungathuthukiswa. Ngokuvamile - penda iworkshop ne-tractor shed. Isu lokukhiqiza - ummbila: hlola zonke izinkambu; amabhontshisi: thina amahektare angama-100. Izinkomo - nikeza ukudla kwentwasahlobo kuzo zonke izilwane, nikeza izinkomo ezincane izithako, susa izinkomo ezindala, hlola isisindo sazo, uzibhalise, phatha izinkomo ezincane ngemithi, qapha isisindo sezo zonke izilwane. Izinkukhu - yenza zonke izinkonzo zansuku zonke, thengisa ezindlini ezimbili, lungisa izindlu ezintathu zezinhlobo ezintsha. Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, izicwangciso zamasonto zingathuthukiswa zalesi sikhathi. Isisekelo sezicwangciso zamasonto yizicwangciso zenyanga, izicwangciso ezivamile, nezicwangciso zokukhiqiza. Isu sokugcina singaba isu lwenyanga elenziwa ekupheleni kwesonto elidlule elichaza kahle konke okufanele kwenziwe esontweni elizayo. Isibonelo: Isonto lesi-9 - Meyi 13, 2011. (Isu lesonto nezicwangciso zalesi sikhathi zixubene kuTebula 1). Susa izinkomo ezingu-100 emapulazini, uzibhalise, phatha ngemithi, qapha isisindo sazo. Lapho sihlela izicwangciso zesikhathi esifushane, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane eminingi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi izicwangciso azikwazi ukuhlala ziqinile, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini zokulima epulazini. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezingalindelekile ezingavela, ezifana nezikhukhula ezinkambu, ukuwa kwezakhiwo, izifo ezilwaneni, njll. Ukuhlela isu kuyisabelo sokuphatha ngoba kuyisisekelo sokuphatha nokufaka emsebenzini okuzoxoxwa ngakho embhalweni olandelayo. Ngaphandle kokuhlela isu, akukwazi ukuba khona ukuphathwa okusebenzayo ngoba izicwangciso ziyi sabelo sokuqala sokuphatha; ngezicwangciso, singaphatha umsebenzi kahle. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa, ukufaka emsebenzini, nokulawula okuqinile, umphathi kumele abe nesibindi ekwenzeni eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha efana nokuhlela, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi bakhe, ukubakhuthaza ukuba basebenze kahle, ukubanika amandla, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha ngokuqinile. Ukunakwa kuyo yonke le misebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi.
Masixoxe ngemva kokuvuna izitshalo zakho ze-maize zonyaka ka-2010, ukuhlela okunembile kwesizini yonyaka olandelayo kuqala. Lesi yisikhathi esihle sokuhlaziya okwenzekile esikhathini esedlule nokuhlola izinto ezahlukene ezithinta ukuphathwa nokukhiqizwa kwezitshalo ezathuthukisa isimo nokukhiqizwa okutholakele ekupheleni kulezi zitshalo. Uma imibiko yomlando ingagcinwanga kuyo yonke imifula, manje yisikhathi esihle sokusebenzisa idatha yonyaka odlule ukuqala uhlelo lokugcina imibiko yomlando. Uma uhlelo lwebhizinisi lwenziwe oluhlanganisa ukuhlela lokho kuzosebenza kuyo yonke isitshalo ngonyaka olandelayo, izinga lokufaka kanye nezindleko ezitholakele kufanele ziqhathaniswe ngokucophelela nebhajethi eyabekwa ekuqaleni. Izinto ezithinta lezi zinputh ezimo zezimali kanye nezimo zezulu ezadlala indima empumelelweni noma ekwehlulekeni kwezithombo ezithile kufanele zicatshangelwe futhi zihlolwe ukuthi zishintshile noma zathuthuka. Imibiko eyisisekelo mayelana nezimo zomhlabathi kufanele igcinwe futhi ivuselelwe minyaka yonke: igama lefama, isifunda sefama, indawo ephelele, izindawo ezivunyiwe, izindawo zokulawula, izindawo ezithuthukisiwe, ukuhlinzwa, umuzi, izinqaba zefama, nezakhiwo. Iphakheji ngalinye lendawo kuyo yonke ifama ingaqhathaniswa mayelana nezinputh ezisetshenziswe lapho: indawo yomhlaba, ukujula komhlabathi, uhlobo lomhlabathi, ukuvuthwa komhlabathi, izinguquko zezulu eminyakeni eminingi. (Uma kutholakala kumphumela wokuhlola umhlabathi), ukujikeleza kwezitshalo nokuhlela ukujikeleza kwezitshalo kufanele kucatshangelwe, kuhlanganise nezinsuku zokutshala, izitshalo ezihlanganisiwe, izinga lokutshala imbewu, imvula ephakathi, imvula etholelwe phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kokuba isitshalo sithunyelwe, imvula etholelwe phakathi nesikhathi sokukhula kwesitshalo, ukulawula izihlahla ezisetshenzisiwe (kuhlanganise namakhemikhali nezinga lawo lokufaka), ama-pesticides asetshenzisiwe nemiphumela yawo, ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo okutholakele nesimo sawo. Izindleko ze-fertilizer zikhona phakathi kwezindleko ezinkulu ze-inputs ezisetshenziswa ngqo ohlelweni lokulima izitshalo. Ukusebenzisa kahle uhlelo lokufaka i-fertilizer njalo ngesizini kanye nesizini yokutshala ezayo kuzokhiqiza ukukhiqizwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Kubalulekile ukwazi isimo somhlabathi wakho ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokukhiqizwa okuphezulu kwezitshalo nangemva kwemvula eningi etholelwe ezindaweni ezithile, okungase kube sekwathulile izakhamzimba eziningi ezibalulekile ezitshalo. Ukuvela kokuphuma okuphuma ngenxa yokushoda kwe-nitrogen ne-sulfur kubonwe ezindaweni eziningi ezithintekile kule nkathi yakamuva. Uma kukhona izitshalo eziphakeme kunokujwayelekile, izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ezikhiphwe kufanele zibuye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitshalo ezilandelayo zingathola ukukhiqizwa okulindelekile. Ngokukhumbula lokhu, amasampula omhlabathi kufanele athathwe kuyo yonke imifula ye-maize ezokwenziwa futhi athunyelwe endaweni ezotholwa khona. Izinyathelo eziningana kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inqubo yokufaka i-fertilizer nokuhlola izokwenza umsebenzi wefama yakho. Lezi zinyathelo zihlanganisa ukuqoqa nokuphatha kahle amasampula omhlabathi, izinqubo ezifanele zokulandela, imihlahlandlela efundwe kahle yokuhumusha imiphumela, ukulandela iziphakamiso ezifanele zezingqimba zezithombo, nokuhlanganisa izidingo eziphakanyisiwe zezithombo ohlelweni oluhlanganisiwe lokuphatha izakhamzimba zezithombo. Inhloso yokuhlola umhlabathi ukuhlole ikhono lomhlabathi lokuhlinzeka ngezithako ezidingekayo ezitshalo ezikhulayo nokuhlaziya noma yiziphi izinkinga zomhlabathi ezingavimbela ukukhula nokuthuthuka kwezitshalo ngendlela efanele. Ngokuvamile, izitshalo zalezi zidinga kakhulu izithako ezihlinzekwa njenge-fertilizers zomhlabathi uma amazinga wokuhlola umhlabathi enyuka. Ukuhlolwa komhlabathi okuhlola ukujula kuvumela izinga elifanele le-herbicide ukuba lifakwe ohlelweni lokulawula izihlahla. Kubalulekile ukuthatha isampula kuyo yonke imifula. Isampula yomhlabathi ejulile engu-15 cm isisindo sithola cishe amakhilogremu angama-2,400 kuye ngokuthi umhlabathi uthambekela kangakanani, ukuhlanganiswa kwawo, nokujula. Isampula yokugcina ethunyelwe lab ingase isisindo sibe amakhilogremu angu-0.5, ezokwenziwa zibe ngamagramu amancane. Ngenxa yalokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwemithombo enejula nezinhlobo zomhlabathi ezahlukene nezindawo ngaphakathi kwemifula, ezingeyona ingxenye yendawo yonke evunyiwe. Kusengumkhuba kubalimi ukufaka ama-fertilizers ngokuya ngezinga elabelwe ku-block yonke yomhlaba, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nezindawo ezitholakala nge-satellite (GPS) nezindlela ezingaguqulwa zokufaka i-fertilizer, ezingaphrintiwe endaweni esetshenziselwa ukutshala. Akukhulunywa ukuthi lokhu kuhlola kungcono kunesampula eqoqwe kulolo mhlaba. Khumbula ukuthi kukhona umehluko omkhulu emhlabathini ezindaweni. Esikhathini esedlule, isampula eqoqwe kumahhactha ayishumi kuyo yonke i-block yomhlaba yayibhekwa njenganele. Nokho, kuyas recommended ukuthi uthenge noma uboleke ithuluzi lokumba (auger) ukuze wenze imihla ukusuka phezulu phansi kulolo mhlaba nabantu ababili, omunye ethwele ibhagi yesampula ngayinye futhi ethatha i-core yomhlabathi efika ejulile phakathi kuka-15 no-20 cm kodwa ingadluli ku-20 cm. Ibhokisi lesampula kufanele libe nelayisense ecacile enombolo yefield, igama, ikheli lefama, izinombolo zokuxhumana, nosuku lokuqoqwa kwesampula, ukuze kugwenywe noma yikuphi ukudideka e-lab. Kungcono ukwenza yonke le misebenzi kahle emhlabeni ukuze kugwenywe ukungqubuzana ezisampuleni eziqoqwe. Amasampula omhlabathi akufanele aqoqwe ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ezifana nomhlaba ophuma olwandle, imifula eyomile, izindawo ezigcina izihlahla ezindala ezindaweni, izintaba eziphansi, noma izindawo eziphukile. Manje sekukhona ithuba lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokubeka (Global Positioning System) ohlelweni lwe-grid ezindaweni ezikhethiwe eziphakathi kuka-0.5 no-4 meters, noma ukuhlela ukuqoqa amasampula ohlelweni lwe-grid. Amasampula azobe eqhathaniswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nezinguquko ezenzakalayo ezingeni lokuvuthwa komhlabathi zingatholakala kahle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Imiphumela yokuhlaziywa ingatholwa ngokusebenzisa i-Geographic Information System (GIS) ukuze kutholakale imephu enombala yefield ekhombisa i-pH, i-calcium, i-magnesium, i-phosphate, i-sulfur, i-nitrogen, ama-micronutrients, nezinye izinguquko zokuhlola umhlabathi zingaboniswa ukuze zikhombise umfanekiso ophawulekayo wokuhlukahluka noma ubukhulu benkinga ethile emhlabeni. Ezindaweni eziningi, izindawo eziphakathi zikhonjwa zisebenzisa indlela ye-grid ngokusekelwe kumahhactha e-block. Isikhathi esihle sokuthatha amasampula yileso lapho uzoba nethuba lokwenza umsebenzi kahle, lapho ungakwenza izinqumo ngokuhl
Awukwazi ukuvuka ekuseni uthi, 'Namuhla ngifuna ukuqala ukutshala ukudla.' Ukukhiqiza ukudla ngokwezimali kudinga ucwaningo oluningi ngaphambi kokwenza lokho. Yimuphi umkhiqizo ofuna ukuwutshala kulo nyaka? Kukhona izinto ezithile okufanele uzicabangele ngaphambi kokuphendula le mibuzo. Isikhathi esifanele singafika. Inani lokuna okungatholakala. Izinga le-pH nokushisa komhlabathi. Ukutholakala kwemali yokuqala yokukhiqiza. Uzothola kuphi le mali? Ukukhiqiza ukudla sekubize kakhulu, izindleko zokutshala izinkambu ezithola imvula kuphela seziphumelele ku-R 5,000 ngehektare. Uzoya kuphi ukuyocela imali? Ingabe intshisekelo yaleyo mali izoba malini? Ubufakazi bokukhokha imali buzozithola kanjani? Uma uthola imali, ingabe umkhiqizo wakho uzokwana ukukhokha leyo mali? Unayo yini impahla yokubolekwa? Khumbula ukuthi lokhu kuyibhizinisi labantu abanikela ngemali; bafuna ukwenza inzuzo. Benza inzuzo kulokho okutholayo. Akekho ofuna ukulahlekelwa yimali, ngakho umbolekisi ufisa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uzothola imali yakhe. Uzothola nini imali? Lokhu kungase kubonakale njengento encane, kodwa khumbula ukuthi lapho utshala, izinkambu zidinga ukulungiswa isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokutshala. Uma imali ifika sekwedlule isikhathi, izinkambu azikwazi ukulungiswa kahle futhi umthuthukisi angase abhekane nezingozi ekulimaleni? Uzokwenza kanjani ukumaketha umkhiqizo wakho? Uma uthengisa ukudla kuphela kuwe, ukumaketha akuyona inkinga. Kodwa uma uqala ukutshala ukudla okuzothengiswa, kudingeka ucabangele ukumaketha. Ubani ozothenga ukudla kwakho? Uzakuthola kanjani ukudla emakethe? Ubani ozohambisa ukudla? Ubani ozophatha izinhlelo? Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu futhi kufanele kwenzeke ngesikhathi esifanele. Yini le msebenzi yokulima efuna ukuyifeza? Uzokwenza nini? Yiziphi izinsiza ozosebenzisa? Uzolima kangakanani? Ingabe ithrekhtha yakho inamandla anele? Ingabe izinsiza zakho zisebenza kahle futhi zikwazi ukwenza le msebenzi? Yini le msebenzi yokulima efuna ukuyifeza? Uzokwenza nini? Yiziphi izinsiza ozosebenzisa? Ingabe izinsiza zakho zisebenza kahle futhi zikwazi ukwenza le msebenzi? Uzothenga kuphi imbewu yakho? Ubani ozokweluleka ngokuqhuba imbewu efanele? Ucabangele isikhathi esithathwa umkhiqizo othile ukuze ukhule ufinyelele ekupheleni? Zingaki izitshalo ezitshaliwe ngehektare? Uthathe amasampula omhlabathi? Uthole imiphumela yokuhlola umhlabathi? Uthole iziphakamiso mayelana ne-fertilizer efanele endaweni ethile nomkhiqizo? Ingabe isiphakamiso se-fertilizer sikhona ngokuhambisana nosayizi womkhiqizo ofuna ukuwuvuna? Yisiphi isithako se-fertilizer ozosisebenzisa? Zingaki amakhilogram ozowafaka ngehektare? Inqubo yokutshala ibaluleke kakhulu kunazo zonke uma ulima. Isitshalo singalinganiswa ukuze sisebenze kahle. Unama-plates, ama-gears, kanye nezinsiza zokuphalaza ezifanele? Yisiphi ububanzi bezigaba ozikhethayo? Kungani ukhethe le banga? Uma uzolima ngemva kokukhula kwezitshalo, uyazi yini ukuthi umphakeli wakho angasebenza kulowo banga? Zingaki izitshalo ozidingayo? Uyaqonda ukuthi zingaki izithako okufanele uzifake? Ungalinganisa isitshalo noma udinga usizo? Uyaqonda kanjani ukuphatha izihlahla ezisemqoka? Ingabe umphakeli ufanele ububanzi bezigaba? Ingabe ama-tines omphakeli alinganisiwe kahle? Unemishini yokuphalaza? Ingabe zonke izingxenye zemishini zisasebenza kahle? Ubani ozokwenza ukulinganisa kwemishini yokuphalaza? Yiziphi amakhemikhali ozowasebenzisa? Uyaqonda ukuthi mangaki amakhemikhali athile azofakwa? Kwenziwa kuphi esigabeni sokukhula kwesitshalo ukufaka amakhemikhali? Ingabe umhlabathi umanzi ngokwanele ukuze imbewu ikhulule? Uzolima kangakanani imbewu? Ucabangele inani elifanele lemibewu ngomjikelezo? Ufaka yini i-fertilizer kumakhilogram afanele ngehektare? Ufakile yini amakhemikhali abulala izilokazane nezihlahla? Ngemva kokuphothula ukutshala, ingabe isitshalo sihlanzekile futhi sikhona kahle? Ngemva kokuphalaza amakhemikhali, ingabe imishini ihlanzekile futhi ibekwe kahle? Yisiphi uhlobo lwe-fertilizer yokuphezulu ozoyifaka? Nini kufanele ifakwe? Uzofaka malini i-fertilizer? Uma ufuna ukuba umthuthukisi wezomnotho, kufanele usebenze ngokuzikhandla nangokuhlakanipha! Udinga ukuthuthukisa amasu ngokuqhubekayo futhi wenze le msebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele.
Uma izicwangciso zomsebenzi wesikhathi esizayo sezifakwe ngokuphelele, futhi izinsiza zabasebenzi nemishini zixubene, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukwenza imisebenzi nezicwangciso zisebenze kahle kusho ukufezekisa umgomo webhizinisi. Ngakho-ke, kungaba yiphutha ukuhlela izicwangciso nokuzihlanganisa kodwa bese forgeta ukuzisebenzisa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuvela komsebenzi ngqo kungavimbela uma ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwezicwangciso kungahambi kahle. Ake sibheke ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi, okuyimsebenzi wesithathu sokuphatha ibhizinisi. Lapho sifika ezindabeni ezisebenzisekayo, kufanele siqhubeke lapho sishiyile khona ngemibhalo yethu (Pula/Rain June) echaza ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwezicwangciso, bese kuba nguMeyi 9, 2011, lapho izicwangciso nokuhlanganiswa kusetshenziswa. Hlola insimu 5. Kuqediwe, bekungekho izifo. Thola insimu 3, amakhilomitha ayishumi. UPadiso, uVosloo, abasebenzi ababili (umsebenzi wesigaba). Amatraktori amabili namathreyi amabili. Amakhilomitha ayisishiyagalolunye aqediwe. Hlola okukhishiwe nokudla. Susa ensimini, bhalisela izimpawu, phatha imithi, thola izinga lokuphila le-100 lambs. UMoloto, uAbram, uKagiso, noHendrik. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Amathuluzi okuphatha izinkomo, amathuluzi okushisa izinkomo, amathuluzi okuphatha imithi, imithi, impahla, nencwadi yokurekhoda. Ukudla enkampanini 3 kugcwaliswe. Imisebenzi enama-lambs angu-100 iqediwe. Lungisa indlu 3 (susa ukulala okudala). Imisebenzi ejwayelekile yansuku zonke, izindlu 1 no-2. UJohanna, uMinah, uJohannes. USarah, uMonica, uDawid. Amathuluzi okuhlanganisa, amabhakede, ithreyi. Imisebenzi ejwayelekile yansuku zonke iqediwe. Amathuluzi amadala, njll. Umsebenzi uqhubeka ngendlela efanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi okufanele yenziwe iyaphothulwa, kufanele yenziwe ngabantu balo msebenzi; kumele bakwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi ngendlela efanele. Uma umsebenzi osebenzayo utholakala, kubalulekile kumphathi (umlimi) ukuba abe nomsebenzi omuhle kuzo zonke izici zebhizinisi lakhe, imisebenzi yakhe yokuphatha ifaka okulandelayo: ukuhola, ukubambisana nokuxhumana, ukuhlela abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi kahle, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela eqinile njalo. Ukuhola nokubamba izintambo ngaphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuthuthuke umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe, futhi kubalulekile ukuthola izindlela ezingcono zokuhlanganisa izicwangciso, njll. Abaphathi kufanele bahole lapho beqinisekisa ukuthi okumele kwenziwe; akufanele kube kuhle ukuthi benze lowo msebenzi bona; kufanele bakwazi ukuhlela abasebenzi babo ukuba bawenze kahle. Abaphathi kufanele bahlele abasebenzi ukuba baphathe umsebenzi. Kufanele bahlele abasebenzi ukuba benze umsebenzi abangawenza ngazo zonke izinsiza zabo. Ngesikhathi sokuphothulwa komsebenzi, abasebenzi kufanele bathole umlayezo kubaphathi ukuze bafunde; lokhu kusiza ekuhlinzekeni abantu. Ukuxhumana okuhlanzekile kubalulekile uma sifuna umphumela omuhle emsebenzini okufanele wenziwe ngezicwangciso ezibekiwe. Umlayezo kufanele ube sobala, ubonakale, futhi uqondile. Bonke abantu abasebenza emsebenzini okufanele wenziwe kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi ubani ozokwenza ini, nini, kanjani, futhi baqonde ukuthi lo msebenzi uhamba kuphi. Ngesikhathi sokuphothulwa komsebenzi, ukuhlela (ukwabelana ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi) umsebenzi othile kubalulekile. Umphathi akakwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yena. Lokhu kwabelana ngomsebenzi kubasebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi noma usayizi womsebenzi othile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaphathi bafuna ukuzibandakanya kulowo msebenzi okufanele wenziwe ngazo zonke izinsiza zabo noma bafuna ukuba ngasohlangothini futhi babe nomthelela kuphela ekuphatheni komsebenzi. Kubalulekile ukunaka ukuhlanganiswa okuhle phakathi kwezigaba zebhizinisi. Imisebenzi yebhizinisi kufanele iqhubeke kahle uma umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe uzoba nomphumela omuhle. Uma ukuhlanganiswa kuvimbela, kuzophula isikhathi nemali futhi. Khumbula imali engenayo - izindleko = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa. Isibonelo sethu ngenhla sikhombisa ukuthi uma imithi yokuphatha ama-lambs ingatholakali ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, ukusebenzisa umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe kuzomisa, futhi isikhathi sizophuma. Ngesikhathi sokusebenza, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bathathe isinyathelo esiphuthumayo ukuze umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe uhambe kahle. Uma itraktori inethayi eliphukile, kuzokwenzekani? Ingabe ithayi izolungiswa kuqala, noma kuzosebenza itraktori enye? Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngokuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi kubalulekile uma abaphathi befuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Kungase kwenzeke ukuthi umsebenzi ube khona kodwa ungawenzi kahle; abaphathi bazokwamukela lokho uma kungekho ukuphathwa okuqinile futhi abasebenzi bengahambisani nalokho ukuphathwa, kungase kube nomthelela omubi emsebenzini okufanele wenziwe. Umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe uvame ukufaka izinto eziningi ezihlukene; khumbula ukuthi imisebenzi engalindelekile ingavela - umlilo ezindaweni, ibhulu elihle elibanjwe emudini, njll. Ngokusebenza amahora amaningi, siyazi ukuthi awukwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngasikhathi sinye. Kufanele ukwazi ukukhetha umsebenzi okufanele wenziwe ngaleso sikhathi esithile - lokhu kuhlobene nokukhetha/ukuhlonza umsebenzi obalulekile. Umsebenzi ophatha kahle izinzuzo noma izindleko, noma ophatha abasebenzi bakho kahle njengokusebenza 'ngamahora angeziwe', kufanele ubhekwe ngokucophelela ngoba kubalulekile. Isisindo esiphansi/ukuphuthuma okuphansi. Umsebenzi onesisindo esikhulu ungumsebenzi ongenza kube nesidingo esikhulu. Ukuphuthuma okuphezulu kukhombisa ukuthi lezi zisebenzi zizothinta inzuzo - uma zenziwa ngokushesha, kuzokwandisa inzuzo - uma zingaqediwe ngokushesha, kuzokwehla inzuzo. Lokhu kuhlobene nezindleko - uma zingaqediwe ngokushesha, kuzokwandisa izindleko. Ukuphuthuma kuhlobene nesikhathi esitholakalayo sokwenza umsebenzi othile - kufanele kwenziwe manje/namuhla noma kwesinye isikhathi. Uma wenza umsebenzi wokuvuna futhi umshini uphuka, ukuwulungisa lowo mshini noma itraktori kuzoba yinto efanele ukwenza ngokuphuthuma okuphezulu - kubalulekile. Ngokufanayo, kuzoba njengekati elinokukhathazeka ekukhulelweni, ikakhulukazi uma kuyikati yakho 'yokuhlola'. Amafayela nomsebenzi we-ofisi azosetshenziswa ngoba akuwona umsebenzi ophuthumayo; ungakwenziwa kwesinye isikhathi. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda zonke izimo zebhizinisi lakho, futhi ukuba nesineke ekusebenziseni izicwangciso ukuze zihambisane nezindinganiso zebhizinisi.
Ubulunga bakho baziwa kangakanani ngezingxenye ze-planter? Funda lokho okukhuluma lapha ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho ngama-component e-planter. Zonke izingxenye zikhonjiswa futhi imisebenzi yazo ichaziwe. Le yindawo lapho ingxenye ye-planter ixhunywe khona, futhi ihluke kulapho i-planter izoxhunywa khona ku-tractor. Lezi yizinto ezibhekana nezitshalo nez fertiliser. Zenziwe ngopulasitiki oqinile noma zakhiwe ngensimbi. Lezi zingaba yizinyawo ezihamba phezu kwe-planter. Le nyawo iqhutshwa uma ixhumana nomhlaba njengoba i-planter idonswa. Le nyawo ihamba ngendlela efanayo ne-tractor. Umsebenzi wale nyawo uwukusebenzisa zonke ezinye izingxenye ze-planter - izinto ezithumele izinga lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Ukuze ukwazi ukukala isivinini sezingxenye ezithumele izitshalo nez fertiliser, kukhona uhlelo lweziqhumane nezikhala ezisebenzayo. Konke lokhu kungahlanganiswa ngendlela ehlinzeka ngenani elifanele lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Kukhona ama-plates ahlukene ahambelana nezinhlobo zezithombo nezilinganiso zazo (asikhulumi lapha ngama-planters asebenzisa umoya ukuhlinzeka ngezithombo). Lezi ngokuvamile zikhona phambili kwe-planter futhi zihlala zikhona kulawo ma-planters asetshenziswa ezimweni zokungafaki umhlabathi ngoba kunezinhlobo eziningi phezulu komhlabathi. Lezi zifaka izitshalo nez fertiliser emhlabathini. Lokhu kungaba yizinyawo ezincane ngemuva kwe-planter ezihamba emgudwini ukusiza ukuqinisa umhlabathi emgudwini ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi komhlaba nezitshalo. Lapha, ingcindezi ingaba phansi kakhulu noma phezulu kakhulu.
Umshini wokutshala udalwe ukuze ubeke imbewu kanye ne-fertilizer emhlabathini ngendlela eqondile ukuze imbewu ikwazi ukuvutha kahle futhi ingabi seduze kakhulu ngesikhathi ithola i-fertilizer efanele. Ububanzi phakathi kwemigqa. Ububanzi phakathi kwemibewu emgqeni. Ubude, inani, nendawo lapho i-fertilizer ibekwe khona. Ubude nendawo lapho imbewu ibekwe khona. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwemibewu nomhlabathi onomswakama. Umshini wokutshala udinga emhlabathini, uvule umhlabathi, ubeke imbewu kulowo mhlaba ovuliwe, uvale imbewu ngomhlabathi, futhi ucindezele kancane umhlabathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwembewu nomhlabathi onomswakama. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zomshini wokutshala, kodwa ekugcineni zenzelwe ukwenza umsebenzi ofanayo - kukhona ingxenye evula umhlabathi, indlela yokubeka i-fertilizer, nendlela yokuthatha imbewu nokuyibeka emhlabathini ngendlela efanele nangokunembile. Ngokuvamile, i-fertilizer ibekwe emhlabathini ngaphambi kwemibewu - lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imbewu ne-fertilizer azithintani ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi imbewu ingavuthi kahle. Ngakho-ke, i-fertilizer ibekwe ngaphansi kwemibewu. Ingxenye yokuvula umhlabathi lapho i-fertilizer ibekwe khona imide futhi ikha phezulu. Ingxenye ebeka imbewu ifushane futhi ibekwe ngasohlangothini, futhi imbewu ibekwe kancane ngaphezulu komhlabathi. Ingxenye yomhlabathi ingawa phezu kwembewu ngemuva kokutshala, kodwa kungase kube nezikhala phakathi kwemibewu nezicucu zomhlabathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imbewu nomhlabathi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle (okubalulekile ngoba imbewu idinga ukufaka umswakama ukuze iqale ukuvutha), kuzodingeka ucindezele kancane umhlabathi. Lokhu kucindezelwa kwenziwa ngalezi zinqola ezibizwa ngokuthi izinqola zokucindezela.
Ufundiswe ngemininingwane kuze kube ngu-Okthoba 2023. Do you do the things we taught you? Ungahola ihhashi emanzini, kodwa awukwazi ukusho ukuthi liphuze uma lingafuni! Ngonyaka owedlule, abantu abangaphezu kuka-2,000 babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha ezanikezwa uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi lweGrain SA. Mhlawumbe manje yisikhathi esihle sokuzibuza - yiziphi impumelelo zalesi sifundo uma sibheka izindlela zonke lezi zifundo ezilima ezindaweni zazo? Yisiphi isihlabathi engikhiqiza kuzo ukudla? Ngakanani amahektare engiwafaka? Ubude bami besihlabathi buphakeme kangakanani lapho izitshalo zingakhula khona? Yisiphi isimo se-pH sesihlabathi sami? Yisiphi isimo sokudla kwesihlabathi sami (N, P, noma K)? Ingakanani imvula ejwayelekile endaweni engilima kuyo? Ngokuvamile, ingakanani umkhiqizo engingalindela ngonyaka endaweni engilima kuyo? Ingabe kukhona isihlabathi esinzima ngaphansi kobude bokulima ezindaweni zami? Yisiphi isivuno engisithumelayo futhi ingabe bekuyisivuno esifanele ngaleso sikhathi? Yisiphi isikhathi esihle sokufaka? Kungani leso sikhathi sithathwa njengokuhle? Ngiyakwazi kanjani ukukhetha umanyolo othile nokuqonda ukuthi mangaki umanyolo okufanele ngiwufake? Yisiphi isivuno engisithumelayo futhi kungani ngikhethe leyo ndlela ethile? Ngifuna ukufaka inani elithile lezivuno ezinganele? Ekugcineni, zingaki izivuno ezimi? Ngihlose ukufaka malini umanyolo futhi kwaba yini umphumela? Yiziphi izinyathelo engizithathayo ukuphatha izilokazane nezifo ezindaweni zami? Ngibhekana kanjani nezihlahla ezingafuneki? Ngiyazi ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezingaba yingozi ezindaweni zami? Ngibeke malini ukuze ngifake lezi zikhukula? Ingakanani intengo yemakethe yokukhiqiza engiyitholile futhi ihluke kanjani nentengo ethola abanye abalimi? Ingakanani intengo yokukhiqiza ngamahektare? Ingakanani intengo yokukhiqiza ngempahla? Ngemuva kokuvuna lezi zikhukula, yisiphi isivuno engihlose ukusithumela kulowo mhlaba ngonyaka ozayo? Ngizothola kuphi imali yokufaka ukudla ngonyaka ozayo? Ingabe ama-tractors ami azokwazi ukulima lezi zindawo engihlose ukuzilima? Ingabe ngizoba nekhono lokwenza wonke umsebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele? Ngabe nginazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze ngikhiqize ukudla okuthile? Lapho ungaphendula le mibuzo kungakusiza ubuyele futhi uhlole umhlahlandlela wakho noma ungase udinge ukubuyela emsebenzini omusha. Konke lokhu kubalulekile, izinto okufanele uqale ngazo ekulimaleni uma uhlose ukuba ummeli wezomnotho - kufanele ukwazi ukuphendula yonke le mibuzo engenhla. Ubani olima lezo zindawo? Uhlosile ukuthini ngaleyo mhlaba kusasa? Sicela uzibuze le mibuzo ukuze uthole impendulo ecacile mayelana nentuthuko yakho njengomlimi ofuna ukukhula - ngempela, uyafuna ukuba ummeli noma ufuna nje ukuhlala phansi uzuze inzuzo ngoba ungumnikazi wendawo ongafinyeleli kulezo zindawo?
I-borer ye-corn iyisiphukuphuku esitholakala kuzo zonke izindawo lapho kukhuliswayo khona u-mazeyu e-Afrika - lesi siphukuphuku sitholakala kuphela e-Afrika kanti ezinye izinhlobo zaso zihlala ezindaweni lapho u-mazeyu ukhula khona. Ngokuvamile, singathi lesi siphukuphuku sikhona ingozi efana no-10% yokukhiqizwa kwe-mazeyu unyaka nonyaka - kodwa singalimaza yonke imiphumela. Ama-larvae adla ezihlahleni, ezitheni, nasezithombeni ze-mazeyu. Ulwazi mayelana ne-bioloji nokuthi lesi siphukuphuku siphila kanjani kubalulekile uma sizama ukuqonda indlela yokulawula nokulawula. Ama-larvae akhulelwe aphila ezitsheni ze-mazeyu ezisele ezindaweni ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngemuva kwalokhu, isizukulwane sokuqala sama-moths sikhululeka ukuze sibhale amaqanda ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyi-7 kuya kweziyi-10. Ama-larvae akhula azodla izinyanga eziyisithupha ngaphambi kokuba aguquke abe ama-pupae ngaphakathi kwezitho ze-mazeyu. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezintathu, ama-moths amanye akhululeka futhi angasabalalisa lesi siphukuphuku yonke indawo abakhona. Ekuhlakuleleni, kunezindlela eziningi zokulawula lesi siphukuphuku. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwemichiza, izinhlobo zezitshalo, izindlela zemvelo, nokulawulwa kwe-biological ngezinye iziphukuphuku. Lokhu ngeke kuqinisekise ukusulwa okuphelele kodwa kuzosisiza ukuphatha lesi sifo ngaphandle kokusabalala futhi kufinyelele umkhiqizo omuhle. Imichiza yokulawula i-corn borer ibhaliswe njengezithako zokuxhumana noma izithako ezidliwayo yilesi siphukuphuku. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi imichiza ebizayo ingcono, kodwa kukhona nezinye ezibiza kancane ezisebenza kahle. Kuthiwa ukuphatha lesi siphukuphuku ngemichiza engabulali ngenkathi ethile yamasonto ayisithupha kungaba yinkinga. Ngenxa kwezindleko zemichiza, abalimi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi basebenzisa ukwelashwa ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuhlanza imichiza kusenesikhathi kubonakale kungasebenzi. Ukuphatha lesi siphukuphuku ngemichiza kufanele kwenzeke kuphela uma kubonakala ukuthi u-10% wezitshalo ukhombisa izimpawu zengozi ngoba ama-larvae aqala ukudla ezihlahleni. Ukuhlola ingozi ye-10% kungaba uphawu lokufaneleka kokusetshenziswa kwemichiza ngesikhathi. Mhlawumbe ukuhluza kuphela kungase kungabi kuhle ngoba lesi siphukuphuku singavela futhi. Ngonyaka onjengalona, kungase kube nesidingo sokuhlola kahle ukutholakala kwama-larvae uma u-mazeyu uqala ukuvuthwa. Lapho ama-larvae amancane engabulawa ngokushesha ngaphambi kokulimaza kakhulu ukuvuthwa kwesivuno. Uhlosile ukubulala lawa ma-larvae ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuthwa kufinyelele cishe ku-50%. Ukungeniswa kwezinhlobo ze-Bt-maize kwehlisile ingozi yokuhlaselwa yiziphukuphuku ngoba azivamile ukudliwa yi-corn borer. Lokhu kukwenze kwadingeka imichiza kancane ngoba kukhona igene elibulala ama-larvae aleli siphukuphuku. Nokho, hhayi zonke izinhlobo ze-Bt-maize zisebenza kahle ngokumelene ne-corn borer - ngakho abalimi kufanele bakhethe kahle ukuthi yisiphi isivuno okufanele basitshale ngonyaka ozayo naphakade. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) kufanele bazi ukuthi kunezinsuku eziyi-10 lapho ama-larvae eziphukuphuku angadla khona isivuno. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba imichiza ixhumana nomswakama okukhona ezihlahleni, kuvumela ama-larvae eziphukuphuku ukuba aphile. Ingozi ehlinzekwa yilezi zimpukane izovela ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa ngeke ibe yingozi enkulu. Lawa ma-larvae akhiqiza ama-moths azovunguza ngonyaka omusha. Uma ukhetha ukufaka imichiza noma ukutshala i-Bt-maize, kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi iyiphi inketho enezindleko eziphezulu ngoba i-Bt-maize ibiza. Ukuhlakulela ebusika kungasiza ngoba iziphukuphuku ezihlala ezitsheni ze-mazeyu ezindaweni zizobulawa futhi ngeke ziphinde zivele ngonyaka olandelayo. Futhi, ubusika obubandayo buzobulala ezinye. Uma utshala ebusika, kungase kuholele ekutheni ama-larvae angene emhlabathini, futhi ama-moths azophumelela ukuvela nokuvunguza ngonyaka omusha. Kukhona ezinye izibungu ezivame ukudla amaqanda nama-larvae eziphukuphuku, kodwa azinciphisi kakhulu ingozi. Abanye abalimi abangatshali izinkambu ezinkulu bangazama ukutshala utshani obubizwa ngokuthi u-Napier - iziphukuphuku zingena enkambini futhi zishiya u-mazeyu. Kodwa noma abanye abalimi abakhulu bangazama ukutshala lobu butshani ngoba bungokudla okuhle kwezinkomo. Izindlela zemvelo nokulawulwa kwe-biological ngezinye iziphukuphuku azisebenzi kahle - kungcono ukuzama imichiza noma ukutshala i-Bt-maize. Bonke abalimi be-mazeyu bayazi ukuthi i-corn borer ibeka ingozi enkulu. Kufanele ilawulwe kahle futhi ngendlela efanele.
Isithombe 1: I-header ejikayo emaphakathi ibonisa ukuthi kukhona ukujikeleza okuningi okwenzeka ekugcineni lapho amanzi ehla khona. Khumbula ukuthi ingaphandle kwe-header ihamba ibanga elide ngaphambi kokufika lapho iqala khona, ngakho amanzi amaningi aphonswa ekugcineni kwezinsika. I-sprinkler yokuqala eyayikwazi ukuhamba yona ngokwayo yatholakala ngo-1948 futhi yapatentwa ngo-1952 nguFrank Zybach e-Eastern Colorado e-United States of America. Lokhu kwaba isisekelo semishini yamanje enama-header ajikayo nalawo ahamba ngokuqonda. Zingakwazi ukujikeleza amanzi ngendlela elawulwayo. Zisebenza ngamandla azo ngaphandle kokudinga abantu abaningi ukuba zisebenze. Zijikeleza izindawo ezinkulu kahle. Zingajikeleza ngendlela eshibhile futhi zingafaka umanyolo ohlangene namanzi ukuze izinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlabathi zikhululwe. I-header ejikayo inama-framing nezinsimbi ezisekelwa njalo emametheni angu-50 ngama-framing ahamba ezinsikeni ezimbili. Lokhu kuqinisa i-header endaweni ethile ngoba zonke ezinye izingxenye ezihambayo zixhunywe kule header. I-header ikakhulukazi yakhiwe ngensimbi enkulu ethumela amanzi, i-framing esekela insimbi, kanye nemishini ehambisa konke. Ubude be-span abudingi ukuba bube yinto efanayo ngoba kuzodingeka bube bufushane noma bube bukhulu kuye ngesisindo somhlaba noma isimo somhlabathi. Le nsimbi encane inama-sprinkler aqinile axhunywe ngamakhebuli athambile ekugcineni kwe-span ukuze kukhuphuke indawo ejikelezwayo. Ama-sprinkler aphumelela kakhulu angafakwa nasekugcineni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukujikeleza kahle ngisho nasezikhoneni. Ama-header ajikayo angadlula ubude obungama-1,000 metres. Izinhlobo ezithile zezinsimbi nezindawo zingatholakala ngenombolo ethile yemishini. Lokhu kuyahluka uma imishini yakhiwa ngabenzi abahlukene. Umkhiqizi we-header ethile uzohlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokuphakama kwe-span kumshini othile. Ukuphakama kungahluka kusuka kumamitha angu-4 kuya kumamitha angu-0.3 kumshini othile. Umshini ongahanjiswa ungathengwa kuphela uma kukhona izindawo ezahlukene emasimini lapho i-header izobekwa khona - lokhu kungase kwenzeke uma kukhula izitshalo ezahlukene emasimini afanayo. Isimo somhlaba nesimo semfuyo - noma ngabe umswakama noma umswakama - kungavimbela kalula ukuhamba kwe-header. Kunenani elilinganiselwe lezi zindawo ezingahanjiswa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umgwaqo ongamitha angu-6 udingeka ezindaweni lapho ama-header ebekwe khona. Qaphela lapho uhamba lapho kunezithiyo nezindonga. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zezi zindawo - kukhona izinhlobo ezingathuthwa. Khipha amandla ngaphambi kokuhambisa umshini. Ukugoba kwe-header. Iziqongo ezimisiwe ezingagoba kancane zizovumela umshini ukuthi uhambise ezindaweni eziphakeme ze-14% - 30% noma phansi noma phezulu. Umshini one-header ejikayo ngaphandle kwe-header eyakhiwe ngensimbi ngaphakathi kwemfuyo nezindawo ezijikeleziweyo ungafinyelela ku-360°, kodwa ungavinjwa ezindaweni ezincane hhayi emjikelezweni wonke. Ungakcovera u-80-90% wendawo yemfuyo. Kubalulekile njalo ukukhumbula ukuthi u-75% wezithombo ukhula engxenyeni yangaphandle yomjikelezo, kanti ingxenye yangaphakathi yomjikelezo (50%) inezithombo eziyi-25% zendawo yonke. Isebenzisa amanzi, amandla (ugesi), nemali. Abakhiqizi abajikeleza amanzi abahlola njalo izinga lokumuncwa komhlaba bavame ukugcina amanzi namandla, bakhulise umkhiqizo, bavimbele ukuhuzuka komhlaba, futhi banciphise ukungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ukuphathwa kahle kokujikeleza amanzi kusho ukudala indawo lapho izitshalo zingakhula kahle, okusho ukuthi kubhekwa umhlabathi, akufanele kube nomswakama kakhulu noma kube nomswakama omncane kakhulu. Akekho omunye onolwazi olungaka njengokuthi wena ngamasimu akho, izitshalo zakho, kanye nokujikeleza kwakho. I-header ejikayo iyimishini enhle yokujikeleza izitshalo, kodwa uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba yingozi, njengezinto zonke. Okulandelayo kuchaza ezinye izici okufanele uzicabangele uma usebenza ngalomshini. Lo mshini unikeza ithuba lokujikeleza ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze izitshalo zikhule, ukufaka ama-herbicides, ama-pesticides, nezinye izifo, kanye nokufaka umanyolo ofana ne-nitrogen kancane kancane ngokuya ngezidingo zezitshalo. Lo mshini ungafaka amanzi amancane njalo, kodwa lokhu kungaphindwaphindwa. Uma umlimi eqala ukujikeleza ngalomshini, kufanele ashintshe indlela yakhe yokujikeleza. Bangase babe neziqondiso zokufaka amanzi angu-30mm noma 50mm njalo, manje kufanele bafake lezo zinga kodwa hhayi konke ngesikhathi esisodwa - bangafaka amanzi ngokuphindwe kabili noma kathathu. Uma amanzi amaningi efakwa ngesikhathi esisodwa, kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwamanzi futhi kwenze izinsika zibe nzima. Futhi khumbula ukuthi umlimi uphatha inani lamanzi ezimpandeni. Uma bethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi baqale ukujikeleza, kuzoba nzima ukuvimbela umonakalo ezitshalo. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga kulabo abaqalayo abajikeleza ngalendlela ngoba abazi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze isandla sihambe sifikile lapho siqale khona. Ungazikhathazi ukuhamba i-header ejikayo, izokulethela inzuzo. Njengoba le ndlela ivame ukuhlinzeka ngethuba lokugcina amanzi uma ijikeleza kahle. Njengoba zonke izindlela zokujikeleza, lapha futhi izinga lokumuncwa komhlaba kufanele lihlolwe njalo futhi kufanele ujikeleze kuphela uma amanzi edingeka. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukugcina amanzi namandla ngesikhathi izitshalo zikhula. I-header ejikayo ibiza imali eningi futhi ibekwe ngaphandle emasimini, ngakho-ke abalimisi abaningi bayakhohlwa ukuthi kunezinto ezidinga ukuhlolwa njalo nokugcinwa. Uma uhlinzeka ngomshini wakho, cabanga ngezinto ezibalulekile ezilandelayo. Khipha uwoyela kuzo zonke izigubhu ezisebenzayo ezinsikeni nasemashalofini e-header bese ufaka uwoyela omusha. Sebenzisa uwoyela ophakanyiswe umkhiqizi womshini. Ngemuva kwalokhu, ungashintsha uwoyela njalo eminyakeni emithathu uma umshini usebenza kahle. Uma umshini usebenza ngaphezu kwamahora angu-1,000 ngonyaka, ungashintsha uwoyela njalo ngonyaka noma eminyakeni emibili. Hlola ibhodi eliqoqayo le-sand bese ulisula uma kukhona isihlabathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi umshini ume ngokuqinile emhlabeni. Khipha amanzi wonke ku-header nasemaphaketheni axhunywe ku-header. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi uma umshini uphuka ngesikhathi udingeka ukuze ujikeleze, kungadala ingozi enkulu.
Lokhu okukhuluma lapha kuhlose ukusekela bonke abalimi abazama ukuthola umhlaba/izindawo zokulima, kodwa kubalulekile futhi kulabo asebevele benazo izindawo zokulima ukuba bakwazi ukuhlola izimo zabo mayelana nokwakha amabhizinisi abo nempilo yabo. Ukuba ngumlandeli wombuso sekubekezelekile futhi kuvame ukusetshenziswa ngababusi ukuze balwe nabanye. Nokho, umalimi ofuna ukuphumelela lapho ethola umhlaba kufanele acabangele kahle zonke lezi zinto ezilandelayo. Kukhona ukungqubuzana ngezindaba ezingafanele mayelana nokuguqulwa kokuphathwa komhlaba; kukhona izindawo zokulima ezithengiswa ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi kumele kube nomuntu ofuna ukuthenga nomuntu ofuna ukuthengisa, kodwa izindawo zokulima eziningi azikafikanga kulabo okufanele bazuze ekutholeni indawo yokulima. Thina, ababheke ngaphandle kwalesi senzo sokuguqulwa kokuphathwa komhlaba, sibuza ukuthi abatholile izindawo zokulima bakhethwa kanjani. Kuvame ukusizwa injabulo yabantu abathole izindawo zokulima, kodwa masinyane sizwa ukuthi le phrojekthi yehlulekile, ifile, futhi ayilethi inzuzo! NgoMashi 2010, uNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya Nokuguqulwa Komhlaba, uGugile Nkwinti, wamukela ukuthi izinhlelo zokuguqulwa komhlaba zikamasipala azizange zibe nempumelelo ngoba abaningi abathole umhlaba bahluleka ukuwusebenzisa ngendlela elethe inzuzo nezinzuzo zezezimali. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba kubeka engcupheni umgomo kahulumeni ophakathi kokuguqula ukuphathwa komhlaba kwabantu abamnyama ngo-30% ngaphambi kuka-2014. Lokhu kuyicala! Bonke abantu abathintekayo kwezolimo eGrain South Africa nalabo abakwiGrain Value Chain bakholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela kabusha komhlaba kufanele kuqhubeke kahle ukuze ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo ezweni lethu kuqinise ukutholakala kokudla esikhathini esizayo. Kunzima ukuqonda ukuthi abathintekayo ekukhetheni abantu abazozuza ekutholeni umhlaba basebenza kanjani. Kumele sikholwe ukuthi abawukhethanga abangane babo, ukuthi bahlolwe kahle ukuze inqubo yokuguqulwa kokuphathwa komhlaba iqhubeke ngendlela efanele ukuze kuzuze izwe lonke ngezindlela ezinhle. Kulapho umalimi ofuna ukuba nguchwepheshe emsebenzini wakhe wokukhiqiza ukudla angathatha leli thuba ukuze athuthukise isimo sakhe. Abantu abacabanga futhi abafuna ukulima emathafeni abo nokusekela umthetho wokuhlela kabusha kokuphathwa komhlaba kufanele bahlele izinqubomgomo zabo ngendlela efanele. Kumele baphakamise abalimi abasafufusa abazophumelela. Kuvame ukuba nabantu abathembela kuphela enhlanhleni kodwa bengenalo isifiso sokuzilungiselela ukuba nguchwepheshe abazoba nezindawo zokulima zabo esikhathini esizayo. Bonke amabhizinisi aqala ukukhula njengezimpande - lokhu kuqala ngokwakha isu lebhizinisi. Akukho bhizinisi elingakhula emhlabathini ngaphandle kokusekelwa kwabanye abathintekayo kwezomnotho, ngakho-ke isu lebhizinisi liyithuluzi elichaza konke (inani, izindleko, njll.) ezizokusiza ukutshela ukuthi uzoba umalimi ozophumelela ekulimaleni. Le ndlela izokhombisa ukuthi unguchwepheshe ngoba izokhombisa izinyathelo ozothatha ukuze ufinyelele imiphumela emihle. Isu lakho lebhizinisi lizofaka okulandelayo: imininingwane mayelana nezindlela zokuphatha ibhizinisi nezindlela zokwandisa umsebenzi wakho, futhi lizokhombisa ukuthi uzofinyelela lezi zinto kanjani esikhathini esifushane nasemide. Isu lebhizinisi sizophinde sikhombise lapho ubona khona amathuba ebhizinisi futhi uqonde ukuthi kwenzekani esikhathini esifushane nasemide. Njengochwepheshe, isimo sakho sizokhombisa ukuthi uyazi ngemakethe namathuba kanye nezingozi. Ngoba ufuna ukukshowa kulabo abazokusiza ukuthi unamandla nezakhono zokukhiqiza, futhi ukuthi kukhona abanye abalimi nochwepheshe kwezolimo abazokusekela phambili. Zonke izinqubomgomo zebhizinisi zidinga ukuhlola konke emhlabeni. Kumele kube nemininingwane mayelana nezimali nezabelomali zesikhathi esizayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ebhizinisini lakho ngoba ukuhlela kabusha komhlaba akuhambi kahle, uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngendawo, kodwa kuvame ukuba nenkinga ngoba kulapho uhulumeni ehamba khona, eshiya abatholi ngaphandle kwamandla nolwazi, ngaphandle kwezimali zokuqala zebhizinisi, futhi bengenakusekelwa ekutholeni amakhono, ulwazi, nezikweletu. Kuyinto enhle ukuthola umhlaba, kodwa! Umuntu ohlakaniphile ophupha ngokuqhubeka uyazi ukuthi imali iyadingeka ukuze uqale ukuze iphupho lube yiqiniso elibonakalayo. Noma ubani angafaka isikhumba emhlabathini, kodwa abanye abakwazi ukusikhulisa ukuze sikhule futhi sikhulise ukudla. Kufanele ufune usizo ukuze ukwazi ukusiza ngezindaba zezimali ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wakho wokulima uzoba kahle. Chaza ukuthi ufuna ukwenzani ekulimaleni. Khombisa ulwazi lwakho nezakhono futhi unikeze izizathu zokukhanyisa ukuthi ungubani ofanele ukuthola umhlaba. Khombisa ukuthi ucabangele indawo yokulima ongayithola, uyazi ukuthi izimo zezulu zimi kanjani kulendawo ozokhulima kuyo, uyazi futhi ukuthi imakethe izoba kanjani nokuthi yiziphi amathuba akhona. Qonda kahle imigomo yakho futhi ubheke izingozi ezingase zibe khona ezingenza umphumela webhizinisi ungabi mnandi. Lokhu kubalulekile kubo bonke abalimi ezikhathini zamanje ngoba kumele baphikise nabakhiqizi emhlabeni jikelele. Abakhiqizi kufanele babheke imakethe nsuku zonke ngoba bangase badinge ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wabo ngenkathi u-mazambane usakhula! Isu elihle lokumaketha kufanele lihambisane nohlu lokukhiqiza. Akusizi ukufaka ukudla abantu abazokudla kodwa kungabikho abathengi abazofuna ukukuthenga ngentengo ezoletha inzuzo efanelekile emsebenzini wakho. Izindleko zokuthenga imishini nokuqhubeka nokuyigcina njalo. Izindleko zokuqala zokufaka. Izindleko zokuhamba nezindleko ze-diesel. Izindleko zokuhweba uma ukhetha ukungabi nayo yonke imishini ngokushesha. Indawo ebalulekile yesu lakho iyona: isitatimende esikhombisa ukuhamba kwemali, esidinga usizo olungatholakala kumphakathi wezomnotho noma kumuntu onolwazi lwezibalo.
Ukuze ibhizinisi liphumelele, kumele liphathwe kahle. Ukuba nezicwangciso ezicacile kubalulekile ngoba ziyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zokuphatha ibhizinisi. Ukuphathwa kahle kusho ukuthi imisebenzi emine yokuphatha ibalanced ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi liyaqhubeka nokuphumelela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lifinyelela ezinhlelweni zalo ezifunwayo futhi lenze inzuzo. Imisebenzi yokuphatha ibandakanya: ukuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa isu, ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo, nokuhlola ukusebenza okuqhubekayo (ukugcina ukulawula). Ukuhlela isu kuyinto ebalulekile kumkhiqizi ngoba kuyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zabo zokulima. Singathi ukuhlela isu kuzokhombisa indlela eya phambili nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezibekiwe ezinhlelweni zakho zokuhlanganisa lezi zenzo. Njalo sithi asikwazi ukuhlela izicwangciso ezicacile ekulimaleni. Izizathu zalokhu zimi kanje: kunezinto eziningi ezingalawulwa, ezifana nezimo zezulu, izifo, ukuguquguquka kwemakethe, nezinguquko ezintengo zokufaka nezokukhipha. Lezi zingozi zingavela ekulimaleni; zikhona, futhi sibhekana nazo lapho sizama ukwakha ibhizinisi lokulima. Nokho, siphinda sithi isu eliphukile lingcono kunokungabi naso nhlobo. Kungcono ukuhlela izicwangciso mayelana nonyaka ojwayelekile, bese singakwazi ukuhlela lezi zicwangciso uma izimo zishintsha phakathi kwalonyaka. Yini okufanele kwenzeke? Kuphi okufanele kwenzeke? Nini okufanele kwenzeke? Kanjani okufanele kwenzeke? Ukuba nekhono lokuhlela izicwangciso kudinga ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zibhaliwe futhi ziphathwe ngokuqinile. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kuyo yonke impilo yakho. Ungabhala izicwangciso zakho kwidiyari, ebhodini, noma kukhompyutha, noma kuphi. Ngokwandisa imibhalo, lokhu kuzokusiza esikhathini eside ngoba uzoba nedatha yomlando ezokusiza uma ubheka phambili. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlela isu kwenzeka minyaka yonke - kuzokwenzekani ngonyaka ozayo emasimini. Kodwa kufanele kube nesu lesikhathi eside elibheka ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini emasimini esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuyisu elibanzi elikhombisa ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini esikhathini esizayo - leso sikhathi singaba yiminyaka emihlanu noma ngaphezulu. Isibonelo: ukutshala izitshalo ezithengiswayo kumahhektare angu-500, ukukhiqiza inyama emasimini, nokukhulisa amaqanda. Lokhu kuzokhombisa imisebenzi ejwayelekile okufanele yenziwe ngonyaka ozayo, njengokupenda indlu ethile, ukwakha udonga oluthile, ukulungisa izakhiwo, ukuthenga imishini emisha, ukuya ezinsukwini zokuqeqesha abalimi, njll. Kuzokhiqizwa ini ngonyaka ozayo, kuzokhiqizwa kangakanani, futhi kuzothengiswa kanjani? Tshalani amahektare angu-400 ommbila ukuze asetshenziswe emasimini, okusele kuzothengiswa ngenkontileka endaweni eseduze ukukhiqiza ukudla kwezilwane. Tshalani amahektare angu-100 wezinhlanzi ukuze athengiswe ngenkontileka. Khiqiza ama-calves angu-200 aneminyaka engu-20 ezivandeni ezizothengwa yiYYY Supermarket. Khiqiza amaqanda angu-40,000 ngenyanga azothengwa yiXXX Chicken Wholesaler. Penda umgwaqo wokusebenza kanye nesikhala se-traktor. Yakha idamu emaplotini angu-9. Lungisa futhi uphathe zonke izakhiwo. Ngokusebenzisa isu lonyaka - elijwayelekile nelikhiqizayo - isu lenyanga lingathuthukiswa. Ngokuvamile - penda umgwaqo wokusebenza kanye nesikhala se-traktor. Isu lokukhiqiza - ummbila: hlola zonke izinkambu; amahlamvu: thina amahektare angu-100. Izinkomo - nikeza ukudla kwehlobo kuzo zonke izilwane, nikeza ama-calves izithako, susa izinkomo ezindala, hlola isisindo sazo, zibhalise, treat ama-calves ngomedicine, bheka isisindo sezo zonke izilwane. Amaqanda - phatha zonke izinsuku, thengisa ezindlini ezimbili, lungisa izindlu ezintathu zezikukhu ezintsha. Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, izicwangciso zamasonto zingathuthukiswa zaleyo nyanga. Isisekelo sezicwangciso zamasonto yizicwangciso zenyanga, izicwangciso ezivamile, nezicwangciso zokukhiqiza. Isu sokugcina singaba isu lwenyanga elenziwa ekupheleni kwesonto elidlule elichaza kahle konke okudingeka kwenziwe esontweni elizayo. Isibonelo: Isonto 9 - Meyi 13, 2011. (Isu lesonto nezicwangciso zalolo suku zixubene etafuleni 1). Susa ama-calves angu-100 ezivandeni, ubabhalise, ubaphathe ngomedicine, bheka isisindo sazo. Lapho sihlela izicwangciso zesikhathi esifushane, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane eminingi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi izicwangciso azinakuma, ikakhulukazi ezinkampanini zokulima emasimini. Kunezinto eziningi ezingalindelekile ezingavela, ezifana nezikhukhula ezinkampanini, ukuwa kwezakhiwo, izifo ezilwaneni, njll. Ukuhlela isu kuyinto yokuphatha ngoba kuyisisekelo sokuphatha nokuhlinzeka okuzoxoxwa ngakho emibhalweni ezayo. Ngaphandle kokuhlela isu, ngeke kube nokuphathwa kahle ngoba izicwangciso ziyiwo umsebenzi ophambili wokuphatha; ngezicwangciso, singaphatha umsebenzi kahle. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa, ukuhlinzeka, nokulawula okuqinile, umphathi kumele abe nezenzo eziphumelelayo ekwenzeni eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha efana nokuhlela, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi bakhe, ukubakhuthaza ukuba basebenze kahle, ukuwasekela, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha ngokuqinile. Ukunakwa kuyo yonke le misebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi.
Masixoxe ngemuva kokuvuna imbewu yakho ye-maize yonyaka ka-2010, ukuhlela okujulile kwesizini yonyaka olandelayo kuqala. Le yisikhathi esihle sokuhlaziya okwenzekile esikhathini esedlule nokuhlola izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukuphathwa nokukhiqizwa kwemifino eyasiza esimweni nasekutholeni okukhishwe ekupheleni kwaleyo mifino. Uma imibiko yomlando ingagcinwanga emasimini ngamunye, manje yisikhathi esihle sokusebenzisa idatha yonyaka odlule ukuze uqale uhlelo lokugcina imibiko yomlando. Uma uhlelo lwebhizinisi lwakhiwe oluhlanganisa ukuhlela lokho kuzosebenza kumfino ngamunye unyaka olandelayo, izinga lokufaka kanye nezindleko ezitholakele kufanele ziqhathaniswe ngokucophelela nebhajethi eyayibekwe ekuqaleni. Izici ezithinta lezi zifaka kanye nezimo zomnotho kanye nezimo zezulu ezadlala indima empumelelweni noma ekwehlulekeni kwemifino ethile kufanele zicatshangelwe futhi zihlolwe ukuthi zishintshile noma zathuthuka. Imibiko eyisisekelo ngezimo zomhlabathi kufanele igcinwe futhi ivuselelwe minyaka yonke: igama lefamu, isifunda sefamu, indawo ephelele, izindawo ezilimiwe, izindawo zokulima, izindawo ezithuthukisiwe, ukuhlinzwa, ikhaya, izindlu zezimboni, nezakhiwo. Iphuzu ngalinye lendawo efamu ngalinye lingahlolwa mayelana nezinto ezisetshenziswe lapho: indawo yomhlaba, ukujula komhlabathi, uhlobo lomhlabathi, umanyolo, izinguquko zezulu eminyakeni eminingi. (Uma kutholakala emiphumeleni yokuhlola umhlabathi), ukujikeleza kwemifino nokuhlela ukujikeleza kwemifino kufanele kucatshangelwe, kuhlanganise nezinsuku zokutshala, imifino ehlanganisiwe, izinga lokutshala imbewu, imvula ejwayelekile, imvula etholelwe phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kokuthi imifino ithunyelwe, imvula etholelwe ngesikhathi sokukhula kwemifino, ukulawulwa kwezithombo ezisetshenzisiwe (kuhlanganise nezinto ezikhemikhali nezinga lokusebenzisa), ama-pesticides asetshenzisiwe nemiphumela yawo, imiphumela etholelwe kanye nesimo sayo. Izindleko zomanyolo ziyi-ndleko ezinkulu kakhulu zokufaka ezisetshenziswe ngqo ohlelweni lokulima imifino. Ukusebenzisa kahle uhlelo lokufaka umanyolo njalo ngesizini nasemnyakeni olandelayo kuzokhiqiza ukukhiqizwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Kubalulekile ukwazi isimo somhlabathi wakho ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokuthola imiphumela ephezulu yemifino nangemva kwemvula eningi etholelwe ezindaweni ezithile, okungase kube sekwenzele ukulahlekelwa kwezinhlaka eziningi ezibalulekile zemifino. Ukubukeka kokuphuma kwesikhumba ngenxa yokuntuleka kwe-nitrogen kanye ne-sulfur kubonwe ezindaweni eziningi ezithintekile kule nkathi yakamuva. Uma kukhona imifino ethile ethile, izakhi ezidingekayo ezikhiphwe kufanele zibuye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imifino elandelayo ingathola imiphumela elindelekile. Ngokukhumbula lokhu, amasampula omhlaba kufanele athathwe emasimini ngasinye se-maize ezokwenziwa futhi athunyelwe lapho azohlolwa khona. Izinyathelo eziningi kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inqubo yokufaka umanyolo nokuhlola izokwenza kahle emsebenzini wakho. Lezi zinyathelo zihlanganisa ukuqoqa nokuphatha kahle amasampula omhlaba, izinqubo ezifanele zokulandela, imihlahlandlela ehlelekile yokuhumusha imiphumela, ukulandela izincomo ezifanele zamazinga ezakhi ezidingekayo kumifino, nokuhlanganisa izidingo ezincomekayo zemifino ohlelweni oluphelele lokuphathwa kwezinto ezidingekayo kumifino. Inhloso yokuhlola umhlaba ukuhlole ikhono lomhlaba lokuhlinzeka ngezinto ezidingekayo ezidingekayo kumifino ezikhulayo nokuhlola noma yiziphi izinkinga zomhlaba ezingavimbela ukukhula nokuthuthuka kwemifino ngendlela efanele. Ngokuvamile, imifino incike kakhulu ezitheni ezihlinzekwa njengomanyolo uma amazinga wokuhlola umhlaba enyuka. Ukuhlola umhlaba okuhlola ukujula kuvumela izinga elifanele le-herbicide ukuba lisetshenziswe ohlelweni lokulawulwa kwezithombo. Kubalulekile ukuthatha isampula emasimini ngasinye. Isampula yomhlaba ejulile engu-15 cm isisindo sithile sithi sithola cishe ama-kilogramu angu-2,400 kuye ngokuthi umhlaba ungakanani. Isampula yokugcina ethunyelwe kulabhorethri ingase isisindo sibe ama-kilogramu angu-0.5, ezokwenziwa ibe amagramu amancane. Ngenxa yalokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwemithombo enejula nezindawo ezahlukene zomhlaba ezisemasimini, ezingezona ingxenye yendawo ephelele elimiwe. Kusasebenza ukukhiqiza umanyolo ngokwezigaba ezibekwe kuzo zonke izindawo zomhlaba, ngaphandle uma kunezindawo ezitholakala nge-satellite (GPS) nezindlela ezilungiselelwe zokufaka umanyolo, ezingaphrintiwe endaweni esetshenziselwa ukutshala. Akusho ukuthi le ukuhlola kungcono kunesampula eqoqwe kulolo mhlaba. Khumbula ukuthi kukhona umehluko omkhulu emithonjeni emasimini. Esikhathini esedlule, isampula eqoqwe kumaholidi ayishumi emkhakheni ngamunye yayithathwa njengokwaneleyo. Nokho, kunconywa ukuthi uthenge noma uboleke ithuluzi lokubhoboza (auger) ukuze wenze imikhondo ukusuka phezulu phansi kulolo mhlaba nabantu ababili, omunye ephethe ibhagi ngayinye yesampula nethatha isampula yomhlaba efika ejulile phakathi kuka-15 no-20 cm kodwa ingadluli ku-20 cm. Ibhokisi lesampula kufanele libe nelayisense ecacile enenombolo yefele, igama, ikheli lefamu, izinombolo zokuxhumana, nosuku lokuqoqwa kwesampula, ukuze kugwenywe noma yisiphi isiphithiphithi kulabhorethri. Kungcono ukwenza lo msebenzi wonke ngokucophelela emasimini ukuze kugwenywe ukungafani ezisampuleni eziqoqiwe. Amasampula omhlaba akufanele aqoqwe ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ezifana nezindawo ezingenela olwandle, imifula eyomile, izindawo ezigcina izitshalo ezindala emasimini, izintaba eziphansi, noma izindawo eziphukile. Manje sekuyenzeka ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokubeka (Global Positioning System) ohlelweni lwezikhala eziphakathi kwamamitha angu-0.5 kuya ku-4, noma ukucabangela ukuqoqa amasampula ohlelweni lwezikhala. Amasampula azobe eqhathaniswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nezinguquko ezenzeka kumazinga okukhula komhlaba zingatholakala kahle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Imiphumela yokuhlola ingatholwa ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lweGeographic Information System (GIS) ukuze kutholwe imephu enombala yefele ebonisa i-pH, i-calcium, i-magnesium, i-phosphate, i-sulfur, i-nitrogen, i-micronutrients, nezinye izinguquko zokuhlola umhlaba zingaboniswa ukuze kuboniswe ukubonakaliswa kwemfanelo noma ubukhulu benkinga ethile emasimini. Ezindaweni eziningi, izindawo eziphakathi zikhonjwa zisebenzisa indlela ye-grid ngokusekelwe kumaholidi efamu. Isikhathi esihle sokuthatha amasampula yileso lapho uzoba nethuba lokwenza kahle lo msebenzi, lapho ungathatha izinqumo ngokuhlukanisa ngamehlo efamu ibe izindawo ezifanayo zokuthola amasampula futhi ngesikhathi esifanayo minyaka yonke ngemuva kokuvuna noma ngesikhathi esifanayo lapho imifino ijikeleza. Kuye kwaba us
Awukwazi ukuvuka ekuseni uthi, 'Namuhla ngifuna ukuqala ukutshala ukudla.' Ukukhiqiza ukudla ngokwezimali kudinga ucwaningo oluningi ngaphambi kokwenza lokho. Yisiphi isivuno ofuna ukusitshala kulonyaka? Kunamanye amaphuzu okudingeka ucabangele ngaphambi kokuphendula lo mbuzo. Isikhathi esifanele singafika. Inani lemvula elingatholakala. Izinga le-pH kanye nokunamathisela komhlabathi. Ukutholakala kwemali yokuqala yokukhiqiza. Uzothola kuphi le mali? Ukukhiqiza ukudla sekubize kakhulu, izindleko zokutshala izinkambu ezithola imvula kuphela seziye zafinyelela ku-R 5,000 ngehektari. Uzoya kuphi ukufaka isicelo sesikweletu? Umalini uzothola izintshisakalo kulolo mali? Ubulula bokukhokha isikweletu bujwayelekile? Uma uthola isikweletu, ingabe umkhiqizo wakho uzokwanela ukukhokha leso sikweletu? Unazo yini izimpahla zokubolekwa? Khumbula ukuthi lokhu kuyibhizinisi labantu abahlinzeka ngezinsiza; bafuna ukwenza inzuzo. Benza inzuzo ezintshisakalini zalolo mali. Akekho ofuna ukuphuthelwa imali, ngakho umbolekisi ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uzothola imali yabo. Uzothola nini le mali? Lokhu kungase kubonakale njengento encane, kodwa khumbula ukuthi lapho utshala, izinkambu zidinga ukulungiswa isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokutshala. Uma imali ifika sekwedlule isikhathi, izinkambu azikwazi ukulungiswa kahle futhi umnini wezolimo angase abhekane nezingozi ekulimaleni? Uzokwenza kanjani ukuthengisa umkhiqizo wakho? Uma uthengisa ukudla kuphela kuwe, ukuthengisa akusona isihloko. Kodwa uma uqala ukutshala ukudla okuzothengiswa, kudingeka ucabangele ukuthengisa. Ubani ozothenga ukudla kwakho? Uzakwenzani ukudla ukuze kufike emakethe? Ubani ozohambisa ukudla? Ubani ozobhekana nezokuthutha? Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu futhi kufanele kwenzeke ngesikhathi esifanele. Yini le msebenzi wezolimo ehlose ukuyifeza? Uzokwenza nini umsebenzi wezolimo? Yiziphi imishini ozoyisebenzisa? Uzolima kangakanani? Ingabe ithrekhtha yakho inamandla?
