Ngemva kokuphothula ukutshala, ingabe isitshalo sihlanzekile futhi sifakwe kahle? Ngemva kokuphalaza ikhemikhali, ingabe imishini ihlanzekile futhi ifakwe kahle? Yisiphi uhlobo lwe-fertilizer yokuphezulu ezofakwa? Nini kufanele ifakwe? Umalini uzofaka? Uma ufuna ukuba umnini wezolimo ophumelelayo, kufanele usebenze ngokuzikhandla nangokuhlakanipha! Udinga ukuthuthukisa amasu njalo futhi wenze lowo msebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele.
Uma izindlela zokwenza imisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo seziqaliswe ngokuphelele, futhi izinsiza zabasebenzi nemishini zihlanganiswe, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zindlela zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukwenza imisebenzi nezindlela zisebenze kahle kusho ukufezekisa umgomo webhizinisi. Ngakho-ke, kungaba yiphutha ukuhlela izindlela nokuhlanganisa kodwa bese unakhohlwa ukuzisebenzisa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuvela komsebenzi ngqo kungavinjwa uma ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwezindlela kungahambi kahle. Ake sibheke ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi, okuyimsebenzi wesithathu wokuphatha ibhizinisi. Lapho sifika ezindabeni ezingenzeka, kumele siqhubeke lapho sishiyile khona ngemibhalo yethu (Pula/Imvula kuJuni) echaza ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlanganiswa kwezindlela, bese kuba nguMeyi 9, 2011, lapho izindlela nokuhlanganiswa kusetshenziswa. Bheka insimu 5. Kuqediwe, bekungekho izifo. Thola insimu 3, amakhilomitha ayishumi. UPadiso, uVosloo, abasebenzi ababili (umsebenzi wengxenye). Amatraktori amabili namathreyi amabili. Amakhilomitha ayisishiyagalolunye aqediwe. Bheka okutholakele nokudla. Susa ensimini, bhalisela izimpawu, phatha imithi, thola izinga lokuphila lama-lambs angu-100. UMoloto, uAbram, uKagiso, noHendrik. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Ihhashi, incwadi yokurekhoda. Amathuluzi okuphatha izinkomo, amathuluzi okushisa izinkomo, amathuluzi okuphatha imithi, imithi, isikhali, nencwadi yokurekhoda. Ukudla enkampanini 3 kugcwele. Imisebenzi enama-lambs angu-100 iqediwe. Lungisa indlu 3 (susa ukhuluma okudala). Imisebenzi evamile yansuku zonke, izindlu 1 no-2. UJohanna, uMinah, uJohannes. USarah, uMonica, uDawid. Amathuluzi okuqoqa, amabhakede, ithreyi. Imisebenzi evamile yansuku zonke iqediwe. Amathuluzi amadala, njll. Umsebenzi uqhubeka ngendlela efanele. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umsebenzi okumele wenziwe uqhutshwa, kumele wenziwe ngabantu balo bhizinisi; kumele bakwazi ukwenza lowo msebenzi ngendlela efanele. Lapho umsebenzi osebenzayo utholakala, kubalulekile kumphathi (umlimi) ukuba abe nomsebenzi oncomekayo kuzo zonke izici zebhizinisi lakhe, imisebenzi yakhe yokuphatha ifaka phakathi okulandelayo: ukuhola, ukubambisana nokuxhumana, ukunikeza abasebenzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi kahle, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela eqinile njalo. Ukuhola nokubamba izintambo ngaphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuthuthuke umsebenzi okumele wenziwe, futhi kubalulekile ukuthola izindlela ezingcono zokuhlanganisa izindlela, njll. Abaphathi kufanele bahole lapho bephatha lokho okumele kwenziwe; akufanele kube kuhle ukuthi benze lowo msebenzi bona; kumele bakwazi ukunikeza abasebenzi babo ukwenza kahle. Abaphathi kufanele banikeze abasebenzi ukufuna umsebenzi. Kumele banikeze abasebenzi ukwenza umsebenzi abangawenza ngazo zonke amandla abo. Ngesikhathi sokwenziwa komsebenzi, abasebenzi kufanele bathole umlayezo kubaphathi ukuze bafunde; lokhu kusiza ekunikezeni abantu. Ukuxhumana okuhlanzekile kubalulekile uma sifuna umphumela omuhle emsebenzini okumele wenziwe ngezindlela ezibekwe. Umlayezo kufanele ube sobala, ubonakale, futhi uqondile. Bonke abantu abasebenza emsebenzini okumele wenziwe kufanele bazi kahle ukuthi ubani ozokwenza ini, nini, kanjani, futhi baqonde lapho lo msebenzi uya khona. Ngesikhathi sokwenziwa komsebenzi okumele wenziwe, ukunikeza (ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi) umsebenzi othile kubalulekile. Umphathi akakwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yena. Lokhu kunikezwa komsebenzi kubasebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi noma usayizi wemisebenzi ethile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abaphathi bafuna ukuzibandakanya kulowo msebenzi okumele wenziwe ngazo zonke amandla abo noma bafuna ukuba ngasohlangothini bese bebalulekile kuphela ekuphatheni umsebenzi. Kubalulekile ukunaka ukuhlanganiswa okuhle phakathi kwezicucu zebhizinisi. Imisebenzi yebhizinisi kufanele iqhube kahle uma umsebenzi okumele wenziwe uzoba nomphumela omuhle. Uma ukuhlanganiswa kuvinjwa, kuzophula isikhathi nemali futhi. Khumbula imali engenayo - izindleko = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa. Isibonelo sethu esingenhla sikhombisa ukuthi uma imithi yokuphatha ama-lambs ingatholakali ngoMsombuluko ekuseni, ukusebenzisa umsebenzi okumele wenziwe kuzomele kumiswe, futhi isikhathi sizophuma. Ngesikhathi sokusebenza, kubalulekile kubaphathi ukuba bathathe isinyathelo esiphuthumayo ukuze umsebenzi okumele wenziwe ube kahle. Uma itraktori inethayi eliphukile, kwenzekani? Ingabe ithayi izophulwa kuqala, noma kuzosebenza itraktori enye? Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngokuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi kubalulekile uma abaphathi befuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Kungase kwenzeke ukuthi umsebenzi uvele kodwa ungawenzi kahle; abaphathi bazokwamukela lokho uma kungekho ukuphatha okuqinile futhi abasebenzi bengawuhloniphi lowo ukuphatha, kungase kube nomthelela omubi emsebenzini okumele wenziwe. Umsebenzi okumele wenziwe uvame ukufaka izinto eziningi ezihlukene; khumbula ukuthi imisebenzi engalindelekile ingavela - umlilo ezindaweni, ibhulu elihle elingena emudeni, njll. Ngokusebenza amahora amaningi, siyazi ukuthi awukwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi ngasikhathi sinye. Kumele ukwazi ukukhetha umsebenzi okumele wenziwe ngaleso sikhathi esithile - lokhu kuhlobene nokukhetha/ukuhlonza umsebenzi obalulekile. Umsebenzi ophatha kahle izinzuzo noma izindleko, noma ophatha kahle abasebenzi bakho njengokusebenza 'ngamahora angeziwe', kufanele ubhekwe ngokucophelela ngoba kubalulekile. Isisindo esiphansi/ukuphuthuma okuphansi. Umsebenzi onesisindo esiphezulu ngumsebenzi onobukhulu obukhulu obunokuphuthuma. Ukuphuthuma okuphezulu kukhombisa ukuthi lezi zisebenzi zizothinta inzuzo - uma ziqhutshwa ngokushesha, kuzokwandisa inzuzo - uma zingaqhutshwa ngokushesha, kuzokwehlisa inzuzo. Lokhu kuhlobene nezindleko - uma zingaqhutshwa ngokushesha, kuzokwandisa izindleko. Ukuphuthuma kuhlobene nesikhathi esitholakalayo sokwenza umsebenzi othile - kumele kwenziwe manje/namuhla noma ngasikhathi esithile. Uma wenza umsebenzi wokuvuna futhi imishini iphuka, ukulungisa leyo mshini noma itraktori kuzoba yinto efanele ukwenza ngokuphuthuma okukhulu - kubalulekile. Ngokufanayo, kuzoba njengokuthi inkomo ibhekene nenkinga yokubeletha, ikakhulukazi uma iyinkomo yakho 'yokuhlola'. Amafayela nomsebenzi we-ofisi azobekwa eceleni ngoba akuwona umsebenzi ophuthumayo; ungawenza ngasikhathi esithile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda zonke izimo zebhizinisi lakho, futhi ukuba nesineke ekusebenziseni izindlela ukuze zihambisane nezindinganiso zebhizinisi.
Ubungako bokwazi kwakho ngemithombo yeplanter bujule kangakanani? Funda lokho okukhuluma lapha ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho ngemicimbi yeplanter. Zonke izingxenye zikhonjiswa futhi imisebenzi yazo ichazwa. Le yindawo lapho ingxenye yeplanter ixhunywa khona, futhi ihluke lapho i-planter izoxhunywa khona ku-traktor. Lezi yizinto eziphathelene nezitshalo nez fertiliser. Zenziwe ngeplastiki eqinile noma zakhiwe ngensimbi. Lezi zingaba yizinyawo ezihamba phezu kweplanter. Le nyawo ihanjiswa lapho ixhumana nomhlaba njengoba i-planter idonswa. Le nyawo ihamba ngendlela efanayo ne-traktor. Umsebenzi wale nyawo uwukusebenzisa zonke ezinye izingxenye ze-planter - izinto ezithumela inani lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Ukuze ukwazi ukukala ijubane lezingxenye ezithumela izitshalo nez fertiliser, kukhona uhlelo lwezigelekeqe nezinsimbi ezisebenzayo. Konke lokhu kungahlanganiswa ngendlela enikeza inani elifanele lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Kukho amabhodi ahlukene ahambelana nezinhlobo zezithombo kanye nosayizi bazo (asikhulumi lapha ngama-planters asebenzisa umoya ukufaka izitshalo). Lezi ngokuvamile zikhona phambi kweplanter futhi zihlala zikhona kulawa ma-planters asetshenziswa ezimweni zokungabikhona kokulima ngoba kunezinhlobo eziningi phezulu komhlaba. Lezi zifaka izitshalo nez fertiliser emhlabathini. Lokhu kungaba yizinyawo ezincane ngemuva kweplanter ezihamba emathafeni ukusiza ukuqinisa umhlaba emathafeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi komhlaba nezitshalo. Lapha, ingcindezi ingaba phansi kakhulu noma phezulu kakhulu.
Umphakathi uhlinzekwe ukuze ubeke izitshalo nezithako emhlabathini ngendlela eqondile ukuze izitshalo zikwazi ukuvuthwa kahle futhi zingabi seduze kakhulu ngesikhathi zithola izithako ezifanele. Ububanzi phakathi kwemigqa. Ububanzi phakathi kwezithako emgqeni. Ukujula, inani, nendawo lapho izithako zibekwe khona. Ukujula nendawo lapho izitshalo zibekwe khona. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezithako nomhlabathi onomswakama. Umphakathi uphonsa emhlabathini, uvule umhlabathi, ubeka isitshalo kulowo mhlaba ovuliwe, uvalele isitshalo ngomhlabathi, futhi ucindezela kancane umhlabathi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwesitshalo nomhlabathi onomswakama. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zomphakathi, kodwa ekugcineni zenzelwe ukwenza umsebenzi ofanayo - kukhona ingxenye evula umhlabathi, indlela yokubeka izithako, nendlela yokuthatha izitshalo nokuzibeka emhlabathini ngendlela efanele nangenani elifanele. Ngokuvamile, izithako zibekwe emhlabathini ngaphambi kwezithako - lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izitshalo nezithako azithintani ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi izitshalo zingavuthi kahle. Ngakho-ke, izithako zibekwe phansi kwezithako. Ingxenye yokuvula umhlabathi lapho izithako zibekwe khona ibanzi futhi igoba kakhulu. Ingxenye ebeka izitshalo ifushane futhi ibekwe ngasohlangothini, futhi isitshalo sibekwe kancane ngaphezu komhlabathi. Ingxenye yomhlabathi ingawa phezu kwesitshalo ngemuva kokutshala, kodwa kungase kube nezikhala phakathi kwezithako nezicucu zomhlabathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitshalo nomhlabathi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle (okubalulekile ngoba izitshalo zidinga ukufaka umswakama ukuze ziqale ukuvuthwa), kuzodingeka ucindezele umhlabathi kancane. Lokhu kucindezelwa kwenziwa ngalezi zinqola ezibizwa ngokuthi izinqola zokucindezela.

Lapho ungaphendula khona le mibuzo kungakusiza ubuyele futhi ubuyekeze umhlahlandlela wakho noma ungase udinge ukubuyela kwi-courses entsha zokuqeqeshwa. Konke lokhu kubalulekile, izinto okufanele uqale ngazo ekulimaleni uma uhlose ukuba ngumlimi wezomnotho - kufanele ukwazi ukuphendula yonke le mibuzo engenhla. Ubani olima lezi zindawo? Yini ofuna ukuyenza nalezi zindawo kusasa? Sicela uzibuze le mibuzo ukuze uthole impendulo ecacile mayelana nentuthuko yakho njengomlimi ofuna ukukhula - ngempela, uyafuna ukuba ngumlimi noma ufuna nje ukuhlala phansi uzuze inzuzo ngoba ungumnikazi wendawo ongafinyeleli kulezo zilimo?
Ezinye izindatshana ezibhaliwe lapha kuPula/Imvula zigcizelela izinto ezibalulekile uma kukhethwa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo zasehlobo ezizophumelela epulazini lakho, kubhekwa izinsiza zemvelo ezikhona, umkhiqizo womhlabathi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezicwangciso zokushintshaniswa kwezinhlobo zezitshalo, kanye nezintengo zazo emakethe esikhathini esizayo. Le Pula/Imvula yalesi sikhathi inezindatshana ezithile ezizoxhumana nalabo abakhiqizayo abakhulume ngama- maize emapulazini abo njengoba bekhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo ezizotshalwa ngonyaka ozayo. Izintengo zesikhathi esizayo zama-maize abomvu kanye nama-maize amhlophe zashintsha zaba ziqinile ngoAgasti 2011, zikhombisa ukuthi intengo yemakethe esikhathini esizayo izofinyelela ku-R1,840 (kwama-maize abomvu) kanye no-R1,815 (kwama-maize amhlophe) uma lawa ma-maize ethulwa ngoJulayi 2012. Singathi umkhiqizi uzokwazi ukuthola u-R1,615 ngentoni yama-maize emaphaketheni akhe ngemuva kokuncishiswa kwezindleko zokuhamba ezingenzeka zifinyelele ku-R215 noma ku-R225 ngentoni. Intengo yama-maize angathengiswa phesheya ingafinyelela ku-R1,717 ngentoni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi intengo ebonakalayo efanayo nentengo yokuthunyelwa phesheya. Ama-maize athengwa phesheya ukuze aze lapha eRandfontein abiza u-R2,894 ngentoni. Singavuma ukuthi izintengo zamanje nezizayo ezweni lethu zisekelwe entengo yokuthunyelwa phesheya. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kusekhona ama-maize amaningi atholakalayo emakethe yethu yasendaweni, futhi kukhona umbono omuhle ngoba kungase kube nokwanele ama-maize ngonyaka ozayo. Ukunqunywa kwentengo yemakethe kubheka zonke izinto ezihlobene nokukhiqiza ezifana nezimo zezulu, izimo zomhlabathi (ukukhiqiza), isidingo salokhu kudla ngabathengi, ukudla okukhona, kanye nama-maize azosatshalwa; ukuqhathaniswa kwezinga lokushintshisana phakathi kwe-rand ne-dollar, izimo zokukhiqiza phesheya, kanye nezindleko zemali ebolekiwe lapha konke kusiza ekunqumeni le ntengo. Ikhwalithi yama-maize ahanjiswa ezilweni ngabakhiqizi ingase ibe phansi ngenxa yemvula eningi ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa kungase kubangele ukuthi intengo emakethe yendawo ikhule uma ama-maize amahle ethola. Khumbula ukuthi konke lokhu kungashintsha uma ama-maize evunwa ngonyaka ozayo ngoJulayi 2012.
Ukukhula kwamanani okudla, ikakhulukazi kwezinto ezivame ukudliwa, kube nokukhathazeka kubathengi ezinyangeni ezedlule, futhi bakhathazekile ngokuqhubekayo kokwenyuka kwamanani kabhontshisi. Kuthiwa izizathu zokwenyuka kwamanani zidalwe ukukhula kwamamanani ezimpahla zokulima emhlabeni jikelele kanye nokushoda kwalezi zinto ezweni lethu. Uma siqhathanisa i-Safex price index kanye ne-bread price index ezinyangeni ezedlule, kubonakala ukuthi intengo ye-maize ikhule kakhulu kune-intengo kabhontshisi (I-Grafu 1). Kucacile ukuthi amanani okudla kungenzeka aqhubeke ekhula ezinyangeni ezizayo. Abathengi okwamanje bahlupheka, kodwa kubonakala sengathi bangase babhekane nezimo ezinzima kakhulu esikhathini esizayo. I-Grafu 1: I-bread price index kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye ne-Statistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi ye-Sagis). Ingxenye yamamanani okudla atholakala ezolimini iholele abantu abaningi abanolwazi ukuba bakholelwe ukuthi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kubiza kancane futhi kukhiqiza inzuzo enkulu. Labo balimi abaphumelele eminyakeni edlule ngokugcina ukulima ngesikhathi esinzima ngenxa yokwehla kwamanani kanye nezomiso, okwamanje baphumula kancane. Nokho, uma sicabangela ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima, ukwehla kwamamanani okudla kungaba iphupho kuphela. I-Grafu 2 ibonisa ukuthi phakathi nesikhathi esiphakathi kuka-2004 no-2007, intengo ye-maize ayizange ilingane nokukhula kwamanani we-diesel kanye ne-fertilizer - lokhu akukaze kube yinto ehlala njalo. Amanani aphansi akhuthazwa abakhiqizi kanye nezindleko ezikhulayo zokulima kube yimbangela yokuthi abalimi abaningi bame ukutshala ukudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu akukhona okuhle uma sicabangela ikusasa labalimi abasha - ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kufanele kube inzuzo ukuze abalimi abasha baqale futhi baqhubeke nokulima. Ukukhula kwamanani okudla okwamanje kube yinto ethokozisayo kubalimi, kodwa ukukhuphuka kwezindleko kube nomthelela omkhulu - abalimi bathola kunzima ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo uma befuna ukwenza inzuzo. I-Grafu 2: I-price index ye-fertilizer, diesel, kanye ne-maize kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye ne-Statistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi ye-Sagis). I-Grafu 3 ikala i-price index yezindleko zokufaka ezifana ne-diesel ne-fertilizer uma kuqhathaniswa nenani le-bread kanye ne-maize meal. Kucacile ukuthi abalimi bahlaselwa kakhulu yizindleko ezikhulayo zokulima uma kuqhathaniswa namamanani okudla akhathazayo abathengi. Intengo yokuthengisa yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele isebenze kahle ukuze kukhiqizwe ukudla okuningi ngokuhambisana nezindleko zokuqala zokufaka - ngaphandle kwalokhu, abathengi bazophoqwa ukuba bakhokhe kakhulu ukudla. I-Grafu 3: I-price index ye-white bread, maize meal, fertilizer, kanye ne-diesel kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye ne-Statistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi ye-Sagis). Impela, ukukhula okukhulu kwamanani okudla kwezinto ezivame ukudliwa kubangelwe ukukhalipha kukahulumeni ekuphumeleleni ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokulima ezifanele, futhi ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni uphumelele ekusetshenziseni lezi zinhlelo ezikhona isikhathi eside. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) abakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla ukuze kudle abantu emhlabeni wethu bodwa - badinga usizo olufanele kuhulumeni.
Ukukhwabanisa okukhuluma: Uma uvuka ekuseni, uthola ukudla kuqala. Abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuthatha ukulawulwa ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze banciphise izindleko, noma ukubona nokuthatha ithuba elivela ukuze bathole inzuzo enhle, ngoba abathathi izinyathelo ezidingekayo uma isikhathi esifanele sifika. Ngamanye amahlandla babhekana nezingozi ezidalwa yizimo zemvelo, ezifana nezomiso noma imvula enzima ethinta umhlabathi ngoba bayakhohlwa ukuthi "kuhle ukugwema isifo kunokuzama ukusipha." Ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela kusho ukuthi kufanele ube nezinhlelo ezibheke phambili futhi wenze lezo zinto ezizovikela izingozi ezingaba khona. Uma ufuna ukuphatha ukulima nokukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ehlala isikhathi eside, lokhu kubalulekile. Ikhalenda yomsebenzi wakho wezolimo (izikhathi zokwenza imisebenzi ethile) kufanele ibe umhlahlandlela wemisebenzi efanele okufanele yenziwe ebhizinisini lakho lezolimo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isikhathi esihle sokutshala (lokhu kuyimsebenzi enkulu epulazini lakho) singaba ekuqaleni kukaJuni uma uthengisa ummbila noma ekuqaleni kukaNovemba uma uthengisa izitshalo zonyaka. Zonke izinkomba nemisebenzi okufanele yenziwe ezinyangeni eziholela ekutshaliseni zizohambisana nalolo suku lokutshala. Cabanga phambili (lungiselela kusenesikhathi) njalo. Lokhu kuyimsebenzi oqhubekayo futhi obalulekile ngoba kusiza umlimi ukwenza izinto ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Lokhu okungakwenzi kule nyanga kungakusiza ugweme ukwenza amaphutha nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngonyaka ozayo. Isibonelo: izinhlobo zezithelo ozibona kule nyanga zizokusiza ukukhetha izinhlobo ezifanele zamakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Uma ungakwenzi kahle futhi ungaboni izinkinga kule nyanga, kungenzeka zibuyele ngonyaka ozayo. Phinda uhlole nokuhlola isivuno somhlabathi bese ubala kahle inani le-hectares ofuna ukulima. Bheka lokho emakethe ithi bese ukhetha izinhlobo zokutshala ezizokwenza inzuzo enhle. Hlanganisa noma ulungise isimo sakho sezimali (ibhajethi) futhi ubhale phansi uhlelo lokukhiqiza ephepheni. Ezikhathini zanamuhla, kubalulekile ukukhetha ibhizinisi elithembekile elisekelwe emakethe lapho usayina inkontileka. Inkontileka izokuvikela uma amanani okudla enyuka noma ehla. Qinisekisa inkontileka yezitshalo ezithile futhi zama ukuthola intengo enhle njalo. Uzodinga ukuthola uxhaso uma uhlela ukutshala indawo enkulu ngaphezu kwemali oyitholayo. Ungathatha isikhathi eside ukuya endaweni lapho imali ibolekwa khona, ngakho hamba ngokushesha ngemva kokulungiselela uhlelo lwakho lokukhiqiza. Inqubo yokuthola imali nokuthola imvume ivame ukuthatha isikhathi. Uma ungakwazi ukuzixhasa nokuzitshala, signa inkontileka masisha nomthengisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokulima (amatraktori nezinsiza) izotholakala ngesikhathi uma uhlela ukulima nokutshala. Ngaphambi kokusayina inkontileka, zama ukuhlola imishini yomthengisi ukuze ubone ukuthi isesimweni esihle noma cha. Khumbula, uma imishini iphuka ngesikhathi sokutshala nokulima, kungadala izingozi ngoba isikhathi sishesha. Isikhathi esihle sokuhlola nokulungisa imishini yakho yisikhathi osuphelile ukutshala nokulima. Uma ushiyela lokhu emuva, kungakubiza kakhulu ukukulungisa ngoba kuzodingeka kulungiswe ngokushesha njengoba isikhathi sokutshala esifanele sibalulekile. Uma ulungisa, gcina imishini ihlanzekile ngendlela ezovikela ukugqwala, futhi ngeke kuthathe isikhathi eside ukuyilungiselela ukutshala. Bheka zonke izakhiwo ezivimba amanzi ezifana nezikhukhula nezinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi. Thola isikhathi sokulungisa lezi zakhiwo ngaphambi kokubhekana nezingcuphe, ulahlekelwe umhlabathi omuhle uma kuqala ukuwa. Uma ufuna ukwakha izakhiwo ezintsha, qala ngokushesha ngomsebenzi. Izindlela zokugcina umhlabathi zidinga ukucabangela ngokucophelela futhi zithatha isikhathi. Sebenzisa isikhathi sakho kahle ukuze uthenge izinto ezidingekayo. Qhathanisa amanani ahlukene futhi zama ukuthola intengo ephansi ukuze izindleko zokutshala nge-hectare zinganyuki kakhulu. Futhi hlola ngesikhathi sokutshala ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezisebenza kahle bese ukhetha ezinhle ozosebenzisa ngonyaka ozayo. Ungaphuthelwa ukucindezela abathengisi ukuba banikeze konke okudingayo ngesikhathi njengoba kuvunyelwene. Khumbula, kukhona ochwepheshe abaningi nabantu abanolwazi abangakusiza ngalezi zinto zonke. Kodwa ungasheshisi kubo emuva kokuphela kwesikhathi. Lungiselela wena futhi uxhumane nabo NAMUHLA!
Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabalimi abasanda kuvela? Kubalulekile kakhulu emkhakheni wokukhiqiza ukudla ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezivimbela abalimi abasanda kuvela ekuthuthukiseni ukuba abalimi abakhokhelwayo. Uhlelo lokulungiswa komhlaba olwethulwe nguMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba lube yinkinga enkulu kubantu abaningi - imvamisa le nqubo ihamba kancane, ithatha isikhathi eside, futhi ngenxa yalokho, abalimi abasanda kuvela balahlekelwa amathuba amaningi okuthuthuka, kanti abalimi abamhlophe nabo bayakhathazeka futhi bagcina bethengisa amapulazi abo kwabanye ozakwabo abamhlophe ngoba uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba awuvumelani ngentengo nokumaketha. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuba umnikazi womhlaba - lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuba umnikazi wangempela wepulazi, ukuqasha umhlaba womunye, kuya emhlabeni osetshenziselwa umphakathi wonke - awekho amalungelo omthetho abopha abanikazi ("kuvunyelwe" kuphela ukuba abantu bahlale lapho). Umhlaba ophethwe ngabanye ungasebenzisa njengesiqinisekiso semalimboleko, kodwa umhlaba osetshenziselwa umphakathi wonke awukwazi ukusebenza njengesiqinisekiso sokuthola imali. Ezindaweni lapho umhlaba osetshenziselwa umphakathi wonke, kuvamile ukuthi umndeni othile ube nendawo ethile (lokhu kuyahluka ngendawo), bese umkhiqizi (umalimi) ofuna ukwandisa imisebenzi yokulima kufanele axhumane nabanye abantu balo mphakathi ukuze athole imvume yokulima endaweni yabo. Akukho mfuneko enikeza isiqinisekiso sokulima le ndawo etholelwe ngale ndlela esikhathini esizayo. Ukwenza ngcono impilo yomhlabathi kanye nezinga lephosphate kubiza kakhulu - izikhuthazo zidingeka ngoba abalimi abasanda kuvela abanamandla okukhokha lezi zindleko. Ikakhulukazi, umhlaba okhona ongasebenzisa abalimi abasanda kuvela awugcinwanga kahle, izinkambu azinayo imikhawulo, futhi awekho amabhande lapho amanzi angagijima khona. Nokho, uMnyango Wezolimo unegatsha leMisebenzi Yomhlaba, kodwa imali abanakho ibalulekile kakhulu ukuze kwenziwe lo msebenzi obalulekile. E-Ningizimu Afrika, umhlaba ongaphakanyiswa awukwazi ukulima, awukwazi ukutshala lapho futhi ulindele umkhiqizo omuhle. Kodwa ukuguqula umhlaba ongaphakanyiswa ube umhlaba wokugaya kuyinqubo ende futhi ebiza kakhulu. Abalimi abaningi abasanda kuvela abanamandla okuguqula futhi baqhubeke nokulima izinkambu ezingasebenzi, kanti abanye baphinde bayeke lezo zinkambu, beyeka ukulima. Konke lokhu akukuhle. Ukwakha izithiyo noma odongeni noma indlu yokuhlala kuyinkinga kubalimi abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho umhlaba osetshenziselwa umphakathi wonke ngoba izithiyo ziba nezinkinga futhi izilwane (izinkomo nezimvu) zigijima ezinkambini ngendlela efanelekile. Kukhona abalimi abaningi abasanda kuvela abane-access kumhlaba (noma nganoma yiziphi zezi zindlela ezichazwe ngenhla), kodwa abanamathuluzi adingekayo ukuze balime lowo mhlaba. Amathuluzi amasha abiza kakhulu, abalimi abasanda kuvela bahluleka ukufinyelela kuwo, futhi awekho amaningi amabhange noma ezinye izikhungo ezilungele ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuthenga amathuluzi esikhathini esedlule. Lapho kukhona amathuluzi angasetshenziswa, lawa mathuluzi imvamisa awasebenzi kahle. Imvamisa, isivumelwano sokuthenga umhlaba mayelana nokushintsha kobunikazi bomhlaba sithi umthengi kufanele athathe ipulazi lonke kanye namathuluzi (ukusebenza okuqhubekayo), bese umthengi uthola amathuluzi amadala aphukile. Inhlangano yabalimi ihlinzekwa ngamathuluzi kodwa akekho ozokwenza ukuzibophezela ekugcineni nasekulungiseni lawa mathuluzi. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo yokulima, ikakhulukazi ekukhiqizeni ukudla okubalulekile, ibibhekene nengcindezi. Unyaka odlule wawusengaphansi kokulawula ngoba izitshalo zatshalwa ngemali yokuqala yonyaka odlule, umkhiqizo wathengiswa emakethe yonyaka, futhi ezindaweni eziningi, imvula ibingaphezulu kwesisindo. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa abazokwazi ukutshala ngaphandle kokuthola imali. Uma izinzuzo zincipha, izinga lenzalo emalini ebolekiwe liyanda futhi kunezingozi ezingavela ekutshaliseni ukudla okubalulekile, akusasebenzi ukuhweba le mali edingekayo ukuze kuqaliswe imbewu emhlabathini. Izinhlangano eziningi zokuboleka (amabhange) zidinga 'ibond' emhlabeni othile ukuze kuqinisekiswe imali. Abalimi abaqashile izinkambu, noma labo abalima emhlabeni womphakathi, abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo nsizakalo ukuze baqinisekise imali, futhi izinhlangano ziyaphika ukuvuma izicelo zabo. Izinhlangano eziningi zokuboleka zidinga umshwalense ukuze le mali isetshenziswe ukuqala ukulima (okokufaka). Kodwa umshwalense wokuqala (naka uvunywa) uqala ukusebenza kuphela uma izitshalo ziqala ukukhula. Ngaleso sikhathi, umalimi usukhokhele zonke izindleko. Ezinye izinhlangano ziye zaphika ukuhlinzeka ngemali ngaphambi kokuvunywa komshwalense. Manje uzokwenzenjani? Umlilo uphumelela kokubili - akekho umgwaqo wokuphumelela. Enye inkinga yile: umshwalense uphinde uzibophezela ekukhokheni u-65% wezindleko - ubani ozokhokha izindleko ezisele? Ngaphandle kokuthi, kufanele sisho ukuthi kube khona abalimi abasanda kuvela abangenakukhokha imali yabo, ngakho labo abahlinzeka ngemali abasenakufuna ukuhlinzeka ngemali kalula. Ukulima kunzima kakhulu, futhi uma ungabi nolwazi nolwazi, uzobeka impilo yakho engcupheni. Uma izinzuzo zincane, awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Ngakho-ke, abalimi abasanda kuvela abasaqondi kahle umkhakha wokulima bathola kunzima ukuthola imali ngoba izinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngemali azithembi, ziwabeka icala. Abalimi abasanda kuvela "bafunda," badinga ukwesekwa, badinga ukuqeqeshwa, badinga ukufundiswa ngabantu abanolwazi. Abantu abasebenza kuMnyango Wezolimo noMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba imvamisa bahluleka ukwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esidingekayo. Abaningi abazi lutho ngokuqhubeka kokulima, abaqondi kahle, abaningi bazama ngoba bafundile kodwa bangenakufaka "umshayo emhlabathini." Ukuphakamisa abantu kubiza imali futhi kuthatha isikhathi. Izingxenye eziningi zomnyango zikahulumeni zinezinhlangothi eziningi ezisebenza lapho futhi zikhokhelwa kodwa azinayo isipiliyoni. Lapho abantu bangaphandle abafana namabhizinisi befuna ukuza ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo, kufanele kube nomthombo wemali - kodwa ekugcineni, ubani ozokhokha lezo zindleko? Imvamisa abalimi bathola isimo lapho bengazi ukuthi yimuphi umyalezo okufanele balandele - bazokholelwa ukuthi ubuholi obuhlinzeka ngolwazi bukhuluma iqiniso noma ukuthi ubuholi 'be agribusiness' obufuna ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, noma inhlangano ethi ibasekela, noma labo abazama ukufundisa ukulima (Ngaphezu kwalokho, bonke laba bantu bathi into efanayo)? Ukufunda ukulima kusho ukuthi kufanele uthathe izinyathelo ezingaholela ezinkingeni eziningi - uma abantu befuna ukuba abakhiqizi, kuzokwenzeka ukuthi benze amaphutha. Kunomneed enkulu yokusekela labo abazame kodwa bahl
Kunemibandela eminingi echaza intshisekelo evukile yokuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika, njengokuthi: umhlaba ophumelelayo utholakala, amanani okudla akhuphukile kakhulu, futhi kukhona ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngavailability yokudla ezweni lethu nasemhlabeni jikelele. Udaba lokuntuleka kokudla luhlala lukhuluma emhlabeni jikelele, mayelana nokugcina ukudla emhlabeni jikelele, ilungelo lokuba nokudla nendawo yokuhlala, ekugcineni, lokhu kudla kukhiqizwa umuntu othile endaweni ethile - kukhona umuntu osebenzayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule lowo muntu. Kukhona isidingo sokuthuthukisa lowo muntu nokumnika amandla ukuba abe umkhiqizi wezomnotho ozohlinzeka ukudla kwethu ezweni lapho kudingeka khona. Kungani abantu befuna ukwazi ukuthi abalimi abavela kuphi benza ini? Umkhakha wezolimo udinga ukuba nenkulumo eyodwa evumelanayo ekhulumela bona. Imikhiqizo yezolimo iyimpahla ethile enikeza ukudla emhlabeni jikelele futhi iyisisekelo somnotho sezizwe emhlabeni wonke. Imikhiqizo yezolimo inikeza umsebenzi obalulekile kubantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukukhula komnotho wendawo kwenza ingcebo yasemadolobheni ingabi nzima. Lapho u-1-30% wombuso ungena ezandleni zabantu abangakaze bathole ithuba lokuba abanikazi bomhlaba, sizobheka ukuthi u-30% wokukhiqiza kwezolimo uzovela kulabo bantu. Ngakho-ke, sicabanga ukuthi u-30% wezinto ezidingekayo kwezolimo zizothengwa kulabo abalimi. Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabakhiqizi abavela kuphi? Imikhawulo yokwenzela inzuzo ephansi yokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu uma ikhiqizwa kuphela ezimeni zokunisela, kanye nezinga lokwazisa elikhuphukayo. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo etholakala ekukhiqizeni okusanhlamvu ibihamba phansi. Izindleko zokuqala ziyaqhubeka nokukhuphuka, kodwa intengo yemakethe ayikhuphuki ngokufanele. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa abangakwazi ukuqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokuboleka imali. Lapho imikhawulo yokwenzela inzuzo ib tight futhi izinga lokwazisa lemali ebolekiwe liphansi, kuba nguyena umphumela omkhulu ukuboleka izimali ezinkulu ukuze ukwazi ukutshala imbewu emhlabeni. Abakhiqizi eNingizimu Afrika baphikisana emakethe yomhlaba, kodwa imithetho yokubambisana ayifani. Kukhona ukuntuleka kolwazi olufanele namakhono. Abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bangaba abafundi; badinga ukwesekwa, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nemfundo. Njalo, abantu abasebenza emaphandleni abaphathisa le misebenzi bangenalo ulwazi olufanele. Abaningi abake basebenze epulazini, abanye bayavuma ukusiza, kanti abanye bafundile kodwa abakwazi "ukufaka imbewu emhlabeni." Izinhlangano ezinikeza izinto zokulima zisebenza kahle, kodwa izindleko zazo ziphansi. Abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bahlala behlangabezana nezinselelo uma befuna uxhaso lokukhiqiza. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhaso idinga ukuzibophezela epulazini ngaphambi kokunikeza uxhaso. Abalimi abaqasha amapulazi noma abakhiqiza emhlabeni womphakathi abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo zibopho, ngakho-ke bahluleka ukuqinisekisa uxhaso. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhaso ehlinzeka ngezimali zokukhiqiza idinga umshwalense ukuze uqinisekise lezo zimali. Nokho, umshwalense wokukhiqiza usebenza kuphela uma izitshalo ziqala ukukhula, lapho zonke izindleko seziqoqiwe. Ezinye izindawo zifuna ukuvumela uxhaso ngaphambi kokuthola ukuvunywa komshwalense, kushiya umbulali engakwazi ukuqinisekisa uxhaso lokukhiqiza lokuqala. Enye inkinga ukuthi: umshwalense uvikela kuphela u-65% wezindleko - u-35% osele usengcupheni. Ukulima kunzima; ngaphandle kolwazi, uzobhekana nezinkinga. Lapho imikhawulo yokwenzela inzuzo incane, awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Abakhiqizi abavela kuphi basafunda, ngakho-ke ingozi yokubavulela uxhaso iphezulu kakhulu. Kukhona abalimi abaningi abanethuba lokuthola umhlaba noma izinkundla, kodwa abambalwa banezinto zokulima ezitholakalayo. Izinsiza ezintsha zikhokhiswa kakhulu, futhi abalimi abakwazi ukufinyelela kuzo, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ibhizinisi elizohlinzeka ngoxhaso lokuthenga izinsiza ezindala. Lapho kukhona imishini yokulima, ivame ukungasebenzi kahle. Inzuzo ephansi yokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu kusho ukuthi abalimi abanamali yokulungisa imishini yabo. Njalo, abalimi bangenalo ulwazi lokulungisa nokugcina imishini yabo. Njalo, ukudluliswa komhlaba kufaka zonke izinto ezikhona epulazini, futhi sithola ukuthi imishini ibikhubazekile futhi iphukile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umbulali omusha uqala endaweni ephansi kakhulu. Izigaba zinikezwa imishini esetshenziswa bonke ozakwethu, kodwa akekho ophatha kahle impilo yemishini. Uhlelo lokulungisa umhlaba lweMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba lube nenkinga kubantu abaningi. Ngokuvamile, ukusebenza kwalo kube kuhamba kancane; manje abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bahluleka amathuba okuqhubeka, kanti abalimi abamhlophe baqala ukujwayela futhi bathengise amapulazi abo kubangane abamhlophe ngoba uMnyango wehlulekile ukuqedela ukudluliswa. Futhi akukho zinkomba ezicacile ezikhombisa ukuthi ubani ozothola inzuzo kulolu shintsho lomhlaba. Ukubuyisela ibhalansi ye-PH emhlabathini kungaba yindleko enkulu ngoba kunezindawo ezidinga kuze kube yizinsuku eziyi-14 ze-lime nge-hectare. Njalo, abalimi abakwazi ukukhokhela lezo zindleko, futhi kubonakala sengathi akukho zindlela zomthetho ezikhombisa ukuthi abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bangafuna usizo kuhulumeni. Kube nezinhlelo kwezinye izifunda, kodwa akukho hlelo olufana nalolo. Izindlela zokulima ezingafanele eminyakeni edlule zibe nomthelela emithonjeni ye-phosphate kwezinye izindawo zafika ezingeni lokuthi zinciphe ngokuphelele. Njengokufaka i-lime, ukubuyisela lokhu kudinga imali eningi, futhi kubonakala sengathi akukho zixhaso. Njalo, amapulazi lapho abakhiqizi abavela kuphi bephila awasebenzelwanga kahle ngoba awekho ama-contours nezinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi. Nokho, uMnyango Wezolimo unohlelo lokunakekela umhlaba, isabelomali sabo sincane, futhi bahluleka ukubhekana nale nkinga enkulu futhi bahlangabezane nale mfuneko enkulu. Njalo, ukonakaliswa komhlaba ngenxa yomoya namanzi kube sekuqhubekile kuze kube sezingeni lokuthi akukwazi ukulungiswa. Abakhiqizi badinga ithuba lokuba abanikazi bomhlaba futhi babe nemishini ukuze bakhule babe abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Kwezinye izifunda, kukhona ukuntuleka okukhulu kwezinsiza zezolimo ezifana nezindlela, ama-silos, izindawo zokomisa ukudla, imishini yokuvuna, njll. Abalimi badinga ukuqeqeshwa, ukwesekwa, kanye nezikhulu ezabelana ngolwazi. Abantu badinga ukwenziwa bakwazi ukuzimela. Kumele bafunde ukusebenza ngokwabo. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni abangakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo baphumela abantu bahlale bephila ngaphansi (isibonelo, uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba wehlulekile ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yabo kanye noMnyango Wezolimo ongasekeli abantu kahle). Ingabe le ndaba izobekwa kubakhiqizi? Kuzo zonke izindaba, kukhona abahle nabangafaneleki - kodwa kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi wokudla ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ukudla kubantu ungumuntu ongafaneleki ekugcineni. Bayahlukunyezwa uma kungekho ukudla, bayahlukunyezwa uma ukudla kungekho okukhona noma izinga lokudla lingahlangabezani nezindinganiso zabo. Uma sibheka indlela, umsebenzi noma uhlelo lokubeka ukudla etafuleni kubantu benhlangano, sizobona ukuthi kunabantu abaningi abenza lo msebenzi futhi sizobona ukuthi kuwumsebenzi odinga isikhathi esiningi. Ingxenye yezinto kufanele ilandele. Kumele bakwazi ukufakwa kahle futhi bathuthwe kahle. Kufanele kudalwe umanyolo ukusiza izitshalo zikhule kahle. Umuthi wezitshalo, izibulali-zinambuzane, kanye nokulawulwa kwezifo kufanele kutholakale ngendlela evikela izitshalo ukuze zime kahle. Futhi konke lokhu kunikezelwa ezinkampanini zokulima. Futhi bathenga izinkwa zokudla. Futhi bathutha umkhiqizo baye ezitolo. Futhi bathengisa umkhiqizo kubakhiqizi (noma ezimakethe zangaphandle). Futhi bapakisha ukudla ngaphambi kokukuletha kubathengisi abakhulu. Bathengisa ukudla okwakhiwe kubathengisi abancane. Bathengisa ukudla kubathengi. Le ncazelo ayichazi kahle zonke izinyathelo ezenzakalayo ngoba izinhlobo zokudla zihluka. Isibonelo: ngemuva kokugaya ummbila, kufanele uphume (uphake) ngaphambi kokuthengiswa, uma ukudla kuyinkwa esetshenziselwa ukuvusa utshwala, kufanele kube nomsebenzi wokuqala ngaphambi kokuthengiswa. Kulomsebenzi wonke, kukhona abantu abaningi nemisebenzi eminingi eyakha uhlelo lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ngamunye wabo ufanele ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nezinkampani zabo. Manje singabuza futhi - ingabe le ndaba yokwenyuka kwem prices yokudla ingabekwa kuphela kumlimi (umkhiqizi)? Iyini intengo yotshwala (ubhiya) engaphansi kuka-3% wentengo yemakethe yommbila? Ukusebenzisa ibhizinisi kuhlobene nokungena engozini - zonke izinkampani zibhekana nezingozi ezithile. Abakhiqizi bahlaselwa nje ukuba bamukele intengo yemakethe - abakwazi ukucacisa ukuthi bafuna malini nge-ton yommbila ngoba yonke imikhiqizo yokudla ithengiswa emakethe - banikezwa intengo yosuku. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi uphushwa ukuba wamukele intengo yokuvuna engaphansi kwezindleko zokukhiqiza leyo mvuno. Isibonelo: unyaka odlule eFree State bekubi kakhulu futhi imvula ibingalungile. Ezindaweni eziningi, abalimi bahluleka ukuvuna ngisho ne-ton eyodwa yommbila nge-hectare. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ummbila zishintsha zibe ngu-R4,200 nge-hectare, kanti intengo yemakethe ngaleso sikhathi bekuyi-R3,000 nge-ton. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umlimi evuna i-ton eyodwa nge-hectare, ulahlekelwa (udliwa) ngu-R1,200 nge-hectare. Uma ungumthosi, uzothenga ufulawa bese unquma ukuthi uzothengisela malini imikhiqizo yakho ephekiwe. Uma umthengi engavumi ukukhokha lelo nani, uzokwehlisa intengo yefulawa kanye nokupheka kuze kube intengo yefulawa yehlile. Kodwa uma umlimi ethatha izinyathelo zokuqala zokutshala ukudla, abakwazi ukwehlisa ngaphakathi emsebenzini wabo bese belinda intengo inyuke - sebebhekene nezindleko manje kufanele baqhubeke nokuvuna nokuthengisa leyo mvuno. Abakhiqizi bethu bayinsiza enkulu kithi - basebenza kanzima, bathatha amathuba ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokudla nemisebenzi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi singathenga kuphela ngaphandle uma lezo zizwe zinezakhamizi eziningi zokudla, futhi uma izwe lethu linemali yokuthenga lokho. Uma izimo zezinye izizwe zibi, zizogcina ukudla kwazo, ngakho sizophumelela ukukwazi ukuthenga ngaphandle. Futhi uma intengo yokushintshisana ibangela ukuthi inani le-rand lehle, izwe lethu ngeke likwazi ukuthenga ukudla futhi abantu bazohlupheka, lokhu sibona ezindaweni eziningi e-Afrika. Ngaphambi kokubeka icala kulezo zizwe ngokukhokha izintengo eziphezulu, masibheke le ndaba ukuze sithole ukuthi yini imbangela yokwenyuka kwentengo. Uma singasekeli abakhiqizi bethu ukuze baqhubeke nokutshala ukudla ngokwenzuzo, ngisho lapha abantu bazohlupheka ngendlala.
UXolile Dasheka wazalwa efemini endaweni yasePetrusburg. Ubaba wakhe wayesebenza efemini kanti umama wakhe wayengumsebenzi wasekhaya. UXolile unedigri kuMphakathi kanye nezeMali kanye neDiploma kuMphakathi Wobudlelwano. Wathenga ifemu yakhe, iLemoenkloof, endaweni yaseJagersfontein ngo-2006 ngenkampani yeLand Bank. Ifemu yakhe inobukhulu obuyi-1,134 hectares, lapho u-145 hectares kuyindawo yokulima kanti u-989 hectares isetshenziselwa ukugaya izinkomo. UXolile uhlala ekhula ummbila, uphisa izinkomo zenyama, izinkukhu, nezinkuni, futhi uphinde akhule imifino. Uthola kanjani imali yokuphatha izitshalo zakho? Eminyakeni emibili edlule, angikathengisi izitshalo. Ngizisebenzisile ukudla izinkomo zami. Ngisebenzise enye ingxenye yokwenzayo ukuphatha umkhiqizo wonyaka ozayo. Ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko, ngizozama ukuthola imali ukuze ngisize ngempela kwiLand Bank. Yini imibono yakho ngezimo zezimali kwezolimo? Umkhiqizi kufanele abe yizinto eziningi; isibonelo, kufanele abe uchwepheshe kwezimali, umnotho, umthengisi, nokuningi. Izingxenye zenzuzo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zincane kakhulu. Sidinga umphakathi ukusiza abakhiqizi baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuthenga imikhiqizo yasendaweni. Sidinga ukuba kube nentela ezimpahleni ezithengiswa ezweni. Izindleko zokufaka njenge-diesel nezinsiza zokulima ziyasibulala. Ezolimo akuyona insimu ethokozisa intsha yabantu abamnyama; abawuboni umbono wesikhathi esizayo kuyo. Uma izindleko nezimpahla ezingenayo zingalawulwa, ukuncintisana okukhona ezimpahleni ezixhaswayo kuzobhubhisa umkhiqizi waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthola kuphi izinsiza zakho? Ngithenga kulabo abamele abahlinzeki bezinkampani ezinikeza lezo zinsiza, ngemuva kokuthola nokuhlonza amanani aphakanyisiwe nokucabangela ukwesekwa abakunikeza ukusiza ngezinkinga ezivela ngemuva kokuthenga kubo. Yini indima kahulumeni kwezolimo futhi ubani uyiqedela kanjani? Uhulumeni kufanele anakekele abakhiqizi. Abakhiqizi benza amathuba emisebenzi nokuzinza ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Kumele babheke umhlaba onikezwa abakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye nokwesekwa okunikezwa ukuze babasize baphumelele kwezimali nasemathulini okusebenza. Kumele kube nokukhuthazwa kulabo abakhuluma ngokwenza imali. Kumele kukhokhwe amanani afanelekile, futhi usizo kufanele lucelwe lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni uyazama, kodwa okwamanje akaphumelelanga. Yini obona njengokuthinta impumelelo yakho? Ikhono lami lokuphatha izinto eziningi lingenzele kahle. Izinkomo zikunikeza ukuzinza futhi zikusiza ngemali edingekayo. Ukuphisa izinkukhu nezinkomo zenyama kungisizile ukuhlangabezana nezindleko zami zenyanga. Nginephuzu elincane lomhlaba lokulima elingu-3 hectares engazi ukuthi ngingalima. Ngikhula imifino ukuze ngithole imali ngokushesha. Futhi, iqiniso lokuthi angigxile ngokuphelele kwezolimo, nginokunye umsebenzi ozinzile, kuyasiza. Uma ezolimo zingaba nezindleko ezinkulu, ngizoba umkhiqizi wesikhathi esigcwele. Yini obona njengengozi empumelelweni yakho? Ngikhathazekile ukuthi ukungabi nezinqubomgomo ezinzile, ukukopela, kanye nezindaba ezithokozisayo zingaphazamisa amathuba ami empumelelo. Ukuthola inzuzo kuyinto ebalulekile. Yiziphi izingxenye zokuhweba kwezolimo ofuna ukuzithuthukisa? Ngifuna ukuba nolwazi oluningi lwezobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuphathwa komhlaba, ukonga amanzi, nokunakekela izinkomo. Ngifuna futhi ukuthi abasebenzi bami bathole ukuqeqeshwa. Yisiphi isu ozophila ngaso kulo nyaka? Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwami lokwesekwa lukhona. I-Grain SA neqembu lami locwaningo kubalulekile ekunikezeni usizo. Ngifuna futhi ukwandisa ukulima izinkomo zami, okuyizinkomo zenyama. Uma ukukopela kungasuswa, ngifuna ukuqala ukuphisa izimvu.

UVictor akaboleki imali kumuntu noma kuphi; usebenzisa imali yakhe. Lokhu okwamanje kuyinkinga ngoba usebenzisa kakhulu yonke imifula yomndeni futhi uqasha amahektare angama-15 kumfarmers omkhiqizo. Uthola kuphi impahla yokutshala? Uthenga zonke izimpahla ezidingekayo zokutshala e-TWK eWinterton futhi uthenga imithi e-Farmers Agri-Care eWinterton. UVictor uthenga imbewu ePannar noma eMonsanto, futhi bammukela kahle. Yimuphi umsebenzi uhulumeni owenzayo ekulimaleni, futhi benza kanjani lowo msebenzi? UVictor ubona ukuthi uMnyango Wezolimo endaweni ayilima khona wenza umsebenzi wawo futhi umsekele ngezindlela eziningi. UMnyango Wezolimo kule ndawo usize abalimi bakhe imbewu ye-SAB red maize. Impumelelo yakhe ekulimaleni ivela ekuhlelweni okuhle nasekusebenzeni kanzima. Yini engaba yingozi engavimbela intuthuko yakhe nempumelelo? Ubona ukuthi inkinga enkulu evimbela intuthuko yakhe ukuthola imali eyanele yokuphatha kahle umkhiqizo wakhe kuze kube ukufika emakethe. Izindleko zomsebenzi nazo zikhathaza kakhulu. Yiziphi izithuthukisi azifuna ukuzifeza ekulimaleni? UVictor ungathanda ukuthuthukisa ukulima kwezinkomo nezinkunzi ngoba ubona ukuthi kuzosekela ukutshala kwakhe. Amasu akhe empumelelo kulo nyaka ahlanganisa ukulima ngezithako ezihlukahlukene; okwamanje, unenkontileka neNestle yokutshala ummbila, ubhontshisi omncane, nemifino ye-chicory.
Ezinye izindatshana ezibhaliwe lapha kuPula/Imvula zikhombisa izinto ezibalulekile uma kukhethwa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitshalo zentshonalanga ezizophumelela efemini yakho, kubhekwa izinsiza zemvelo ezikhona, ukwakhiwa kwezindlela zokushintshisana kwezinhlobo zezitshalo, kanye nezintengo zazo emakethe ezizayo. Le maphakathi noMgqibelo kuPula/Imvula inezindatshana ezithile ezihlobene nalabo abakhiqizayo abakhulume ngamaqhwa emasimini abo njengoba bekhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo ezizofakwa ngonyaka ozayo. Izintengo zesikhathi esizayo zamaqhwa abomvu kanye namaqhwa amhlophe zashintsha zaba ziqinile ngoAgasti 2011, zikhombisa ukuthi intengo yemakethe ezayo izofinyelela ku-R1,840 (kwamaqhwa abomvu) kanye no-R1,815 (kwamaqhwa amhlophe) uma lezi ziqhwa zikhonjiswa ngoJulayi 2012. Singathi umkhiqizi uzokwazi ukuthola u-R1,615 ngentoni yamaqhwa emaphaketheni akhe ngemuva kokukhipha izindleko zokuthutha ezingafinyelela ku-R215 noma ku-R225 ngentoni. Intengo yamaqhwa engathengiswa phesheya ingafinyelela ku-R1,717 ngentoni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi intengo ebonakalayo efana nentengo yokuthumela phesheya. Amaqhwa athengwa phesheya ukuze aze lapha eRandfontein abiza u-R2,894 ngentoni. Singavuma ukuthi izintengo zamanje nezizayo ezweni lethu zisuselwa entengo yokuthumela phesheya. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi kusekhona amaqhwa amaningi atholakalayo emakethe yethu yendawo, futhi kukhona umbono omuhle ngoba kungase kube namaqhwa anele ngonyaka ozayo. Ukunqunywa kwentengo yemakethe kubheka zonke izinto ezihlobene nokukhiqiza ezifana nezimo zezulu, izimo zomhlaba (ukuphuma), isidingo salokhu kudla ngabathengi, ukudla okukhona, kanye namaqhwa azosatshalaliswa; ukuqhathaniswa kwenani lokushintshisana phakathi kwe-rand ne-dollar, izimo zokukhiqiza phesheya, kanye nezindleko zemali ebolekiwe lapha konke kusiza ukunquma le ntengo. Ikhwalithi yamaqhwa athunyelwa ezikhungweni zokugcina ngababikazi ingase ibe phansi ngenxa yemvula eningi ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kodwa kungase kubangele ukuthi intengo emakethe ye-spot ikhule uma amaqhwa amahle atholakala. Khumbula ukuthi konke lokhu kungashintsha uma amaqhwa evunwa ngonyaka ozayo ngoJulayi 2012.
Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokudla, ikakhulukazi kwezinto ezivamile ukudliwa, kube nokukhathazeka kubathengi ezinyangeni ezedlule, futhi bakhathazekile ngokukhuphuka kwezindleko zebhodi. Kuthiwa izizathu zokukhuphuka kwentengo zidalwe ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zezimpahla zokulima emhlabeni jikelele kanye nokuntuleka kwalezi zinto ezweni lethu. Lapho kuqhathaniswa umkhawulo wentengo yeSafex kanye nomkhawulo wentengo yephansi ezinyangeni ezedlule, kubonakala ukuthi intengo yempuphu ikhuphukile kakhulu kunezindleko zebhodi (Ithrekhi 1). Kucacile ukuthi izindleko zokudla kungenzeka ziqhubeke nokukhuphuka ezinyangeni ezizayo. Abathengi njengamanje bahlupheka, kodwa kubonakala sengathi bangase babhekane nezimo ezimbi kakhulu esikhathini esizayo. Ithrekhi 1: Umkhawulo wentengo yephansi kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye neStatistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi yeSagis). Ingxenye yezindleko zokudla ezitholakala ezolimini ikwenze abaningi abanolwazi bakholelwe ukuthi ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kubiza kancane futhi kukhiqiza inzuzo enkulu. Abalimi abaphumelele eminyakeni edlule ngokugcina bephila emaphandleni ngesikhathi esinzima ngenxa yezindleko eziphansi nezomiso, njengamanje baphumula kancane. Nokho, uma sicabangela ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima, ukwehla kwezindleko zokudla kungase kube iphupho kuphela. Ithrekhi 2 ikhombisa ukuthi phakathi nesikhathi esiphakathi kuka-2004 no-2007, intengo yempuphu ayihambelani nokukhuphuka kwezindleko ze-diesel nezokufaka - lokhu akukaze kube yinto eqhubekayo. Izindleko eziphansi ezikhokhelwa abakhiqizi kanye nokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima kube nomthelela omkhulu kubalimi abaningi ukuba bayeke ukutshala ukudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu akusiyo isimo esihle uma sicabanga ngekusasa labalimi abasha - ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo kufanele kube nenzuzo ukuze abalimi abasha baqale futhi baqhubeke nokulima. Ukukhuphuka kwamanje kwezindleko zokudla kube nomthelela omubi kubalimi, kodwa ukukhuphuka kwezindleko kube nomfutho omkhulu kubo - abalimi bathola kunzima ukukhiqiza ukudla okuyisisekelo uma befuna ukwenza inzuzo. Ithrekhi 2: Umkhawulo wentengo yokufaka, i-diesel, kanye nempuphu kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye neStatistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi yeSagis). Ithrekhi 3 ikala umkhawulo wentengo wezindleko zokufaka ezifana ne-diesel nezokufaka uma kuqhathaniswa nentengo yephansi kanye nempuphu. Kucacile ukuthi abalimi bahlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokulima uma kuqhathaniswa nezindleko zokudla ezikhathazayo kubathengi. Intengo yokuthengisa yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele isebenze kahle ukuze kukhiqizwe ukudla okuningi ngokuhambisana nezindleko zokuqala zokufaka - ngaphandle kwalokhu, abathengi bazopresswa ukuba bakhokhe kakhulu ukudla. Ithrekhi 3: Umkhawulo wentengo yephansi emhlophe, impuphu, yokufaka, kanye ne-diesel kusukela ngoJanuwari 2000. Imithombo: Grain SA, Safex, kanye neStatistics South Africa (kukhishwe kuwebhusayithi yeSagis). Impela, ukukhuphuka okukhulu kwezindleko zokudla kwezinto ezivamile ukudliwa kudalwe ukwehluleka kuk gouvernement ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo ezifanele zokulima, futhi ngaphezu kwalokho, uhulumeni wehluleka ukusebenzisa lezi zinhlelo ezikhona isikhathi eside. Abakhiqizi (abalimi) abakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla ukuze kudle abantu emhlabeni wethu bodwa - badinga usizo olufanele kuhulumeni.
Ukukhuluma okuqhumayo: Uma uvuka ekuseni, uthola ukudla kuqala. Abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuthatha ukulawula ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze banciphise izindleko, noma ukubona nokubamba ithuba elivela lokwenza inzuzo enhle, ngoba abathathi izinyathelo ezidingekayo lapho isikhathi esifanele sifika. Ngezinye izikhathi babhekana nezingozi ezidalwe yimicimbi yemvelo, efana nezomiso noma imvula enzima ethululela umhlabathi ngoba bayakhohlwa ukuthi "kuhle ukugwema isiguli kunokuzama ukusiphilisa." Ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela kusho ukuthi kufanele ube nezicwangciso ezibheke phambili futhi wenze lezo zinto ezizovikela izingozi ezingaba khona. Uma ufuna ukuphatha ukufuywa nokukhiqiza ukudla ngendlela ehlala isikhathi eside, lokhu kubalulekile. Ikhalenda yomsebenzi wakho wezolimo (izikhathi zokwenza imisebenzi ethile) kufanele ibe yisikhumbuzo somsebenzi ofanele okufanele wenziwe ebhizinisini lakho lezolimo ngesikhathi esifanele. Isikhathi esihle sokutshala (lokhu kuyimsebenzi omkhulu efarmini yakho) singaba ekuqaleni kukaJuni uma utshala u-mazeyise noma ekuqaleni kukaNovemba uma utshala izitshalo zonyaka. Zonke izinkomba nemisebenzi okufanele yenziwe ezinyangeni eziholela ekutshaleni zizohambisana nalolo suku lokutshala. Cabanga phambili (lungiselela kusenesikhathi) njalo. Lokhu kuyimsebenzi oqhubekayo futhi obalulekile ngoba kusiza umulimisi ukwenza izinto ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Lokhu okungakwenzi kule nyanga kungakusiza ugweme ukwenza amaphutha nokuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngonyaka ozayo. Isibonelo: izinhlobo zezitshalo ozibona kule nyanga zizokusiza ukhethe izinhlobo ezifanele zezikhemikhali zonyaka ozayo. Uma ungakwenzi lokhu, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkinga ezivela kule nyanga zibuye zivele ngonyaka ozayo. Bheka futhi uhlaziye umhlabathi ukuze uqinisekise inani le-hectares ofuna ukulima. Bheka ukuthi imakethe ithi yini bese ukhetha izinhlobo zokutshala ezizokwenza inzuzo enhle. Hlanganisa noma ulungise isimo sakho sezimali (ibhajethi) futhi ubhale phansi uhlelo lokukhiqiza ephepheni. Ezikhathini zanamuhla, kubalulekile ukukhetha ibhizinisi elithembekile elisekelwe emakethe lapho usayina inkontileka. Inkontileka izokuvikela uma amanani okudla enyuka noma ehla. Qinisekisa inkontileka yeziqhamo ezithile bese uzama ukuthola intengo enhle njalo. Uzodinga ukuthola uxhaso uma uhlela ukutshala indawo enkulu ngaphesheya kwemali oyitholayo. Ungathatha isikhathi eside ukuya endaweni lapho imali ibolekwa khona, ngakho hamba ngokushesha ngemuva kokulungisa uhlelo lwakho lokukhiqiza. Inqubo yokuthola imali nokuthola imvume ivamise ukuthatha isikhathi. Uma ungabi namandla okuzifundela nokuzitshala, signa inkontileka kusenesikhathi nomthengisi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokulima (ama-tractor nezinsiza) izotholakala ngesikhathi lapho uhlela khona ukulima nokutshala. Ngaphambi kokusayina inkontileka, zama ukuhlola imishini yomthengisi ukuze ubone ukuthi isesimweni esihle noma cha. Khumbula, uma imishini iphuka ngesikhathi sokutshala nokulima, kungadala izingozi ngoba isikhathi sihamba. Isikhathi esihle sokuhlola nokulungisa imishini yakho siwukuthi usuphelelwe isikhathi sokutshala nokulima. Uma ushiya lokhu kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi, kungakubiza kakhulu ukukulungisa ngoba kuzodingeka kulungiswe ngokushesha njengoba isikhathi sokutshala esifanele sibalulekile. Ngesikhathi sokulungisa, gcina imishini ihlanzekile ngendlela ezovikela ukugqwala, futhi ngeke kuthathe isikhathi eside ukuyilungiselela ukutshala. Bheka zonke izakhiwo ezivimba amanzi ezifana nezihlahla nezinhlelo zokukhipha amanzi. Thola isikhathi sokulungisa lezi zakhiwo ngaphambi kokubhekana nezingcuphe, ulahlekelwe umhlabathi omuhle uma kuqala imvula. Uma ufuna ukwakha izakhiwo ezintsha, qala ngokushesha ngalo msebenzi. Izindlela zokugcina umhlabathi zidinga ukucabangela ngokucophelela futhi zithatha isikhathi. Sebenzisa isikhathi sakho kahle ukuthenga izinto ezidingekayo. Qhathanisa amanani ahlukene bese uzama ukuthola intengo ephansi ukuze izindleko zokutshala nge-hectare zinganyuki kakhulu. Futhi hlola ngesikhathi sokutshala ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezisebenza kahle bese ukhetha ezinhle ozosebenzisa ngonyaka ozayo. Ungaphuthelwa ukucindezela abathengisi ukuba bahlinzeke konke okudingayo ngesikhathi njengoba kuvunyelwene. Khumbula, kukhona ochwepheshe abaningi nabantu abanolwazi abangakusiza ngalezi zinto zonke. Kodwa ungasheshisi kubo sekupheleni kwesikhathi uma isikhathi siphume. Lungiselela wena futhi uxhumane nabo NAMUHLA!
Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabalimi abasha? Kubalulekile kakhulu emkhakheni wokukhiqiza ukudla ukuqonda ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezivimbela abalimi abasha ekwakheni ukuba abalimi abakhangayo. Uhlelo lokulungiswa komhlaba olwenziwe nguMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba lube nenkathazo enkulu kubantu abaningi - imvamisa le nqubo ihamba kancane, ithatha isikhathi eside, futhi ngenxa yalokho, abalimi abasha baphuthelwa amathuba amaningi okukhula, futhi abalimi abamhlophe nabo bayakhathazeka bese bethengisa amapulazi abo kwabanye ozakwabo abamhlophe ngoba uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba awuvumelani ngentengo nokumaketha. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuba umnikazi womhlaba - lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuba umnikazi wangempela wepulazi, ukuqasha umhlaba womunye, kuya emhlabeni osetshenziswa umphakathi wonke - awekho amavumelwano asemthethweni abopha abanikazi ("kukhona kuphela okuvunyelwe" kubantu ukuba bahlale lapho). Umhlaba ophethwe ngabantu ngabanye ungasetshenziswa njengokubambisana kwezimali, kodwa umhlaba osetshenziswa umphakathi wonke awukwazi ukusiza njengokubambisana ukuze uthole imali. Ezindaweni lapho umhlaba usetshenziswa umphakathi wonke, kuvamile ukuthi umndeni othile ube nendawo ethile (lokhu kuhluka ngendawo), bese umkhiqizi (umlimi) ofuna ukwandisa ukusebenza kwakhe kufanele axhumane nabanye abantu balo mphakathi ukuze athole imvume yokulima endaweni yabo. Akukho mthethosivivinywa ophakamisayo okwenza kube nokubambisana kokulima le ndawo etholeka ngale ndlela esikhathini esizayo. Ukwandisa impilo yomhlabathi kanye nezinga lephosphates kubiza kakhulu - izikhuthazo zidingeka ngoba abalimi abasha abanamandla okukhokha lezi zindleko. Ikakhulukazi, umhlaba okhona ongasebenzisa abalimi abasha awugcinwanga kahle, izinkambu azinakho ukwakheka, futhi awekho amapaki lapho amanzi angahamba khona. Nokho, uMnyango Wezolimo unegatsha leMisebenzi Yomhlaba, kodwa imali abayitholayo iyancipha kakhulu ukuze baqedele lo msebenzi obalulekile. E-Ningizimu Afrika, umhlaba okhula ungakhiqizi, awukwazi ukulima lapho futhi ulindele umkhiqizo omuhle. Kodwa ukuguqula umhlaba okhula ube umhlaba wokugaya kubiza isikhathi eside futhi kubiza kakhulu. Abalimi abasha abanamandla okuguqula futhi baqhubeke nokulima izinkambu ezingasebenzi, kanti abanye bayashiya lezi zinkambu, beyeka ukulima. Konke lokhu akukuhle. Ukwakha imigoqo noma odongeni noma ikhaya kuyinkinga kubalimi abaningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho umhlaba usetshenziswa umphakathi wonke ngoba imigoqo iyaboshwa futhi izinkomo (izinkomo nezinkunzi) zihlala ezinkambini ngendlela efanele. Kuneziningi abalimi abasha abathola ukufinyelela emhlabeni (noma kunoma yiziphi zezi zindlela ezichazwe ngenhla), kodwa abanakho imishini edingekayo yokulima lowo mhlaba. Imishini emisha ibiza kakhulu, abalimi abasha bahluleka ukuyifinyelela, futhi awekho amabhange noma ezinye izikhungo ezilungele ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokuthenga imishini esebenzisiwe. Lapho kukhona imishini engasetshenziswa, le mishini ivame ukuba isesimweni esingesihle. Imvamisa, isivumelwano sokuthenga umhlaba mayelana nokushintsha kobunikazi bomhlaba sithi umthengi kufanele athathe ipulazi lonke nemishini (ukusebenza okuqhubekayo), bese umthengi ethola imishini endala ephukile. Inhlangano yabafuyi ihlinzekwa ngemishini kodwa akekho ozobophela ekugcineni nasekulungiseni le mishini. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo yokulima, ikakhulukazi ekukhiqizeni ukudla okuyisisekelo, ibibhekene nengcindezi. Unyaka odlule wawuphathwa kahle ngoba izitshalo zafakwa ngemali yokuqala yonyaka odlule, umkhiqizo wathengiswa emakethe yalo nyaka, futhi ezindaweni eziningi, imvula ibiphakeme kunjalo. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa kuphela abazokwazi ukulima ngaphandle kokuthola imali. Lapho imikhawulo yenzuzo incipha, izinga lenzalo lemali ebolekiwe liyanda futhi kunezingozi ezingavela ekulimeni ukudla okuyisisekelo, akusasebenzi ukuhweba leyo mali edingekayo ukuze ufake imbewu emhlabathini. Izinhlangano eziningi zokuboleka (amabhange) zifuna 'ibond' emhlabeni othile ukuze kuqinisekiswe imali. Abalimi abaqasha izinkambu, noma labo abalima emhlabeni womphakathi, abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo miphumela ukuze baqinisekise imali, futhi izinhlangano zifuna ukwenqaba ukuvuma izicelo zabo. Izinhlangano eziningi zokuboleka zifuna umshwalense ukuze le mali isetshenziswe ukuze kuqale ukulima (okokufaka). Kodwa umshwalense wokuqala (nxa uvunywa) uqala ukusebenza kuphela lapho izitshalo ziqala ukukhula. Ngaleso sikhathi, umlimi usukhokhele zonke izindleko. Ezinye izinhlangano zifuna ukwenqaba ukuhlinzeka ngemali ngaphambi kokuvunywa komshwalense. Manje uzokwenzenjani? Umlilo ushisa kokubili - akukho ndlela yokuphumelela. Enye inkinga ukuthi: umshwalense uvuma ukukhokha kuphela u-65% wezindleko - ubani ozokhokhela izindleko ezisele? Ngaphandle kokukhathazeka, kufanele sithi kube khona abalimi abasha abangakakwazi ukukhokha izikweletu zabo, ngakho-ke labo abahlinzeka ngemali abasenamfanelo yokuboleka imali kalula. Ukulima kunzima kakhulu, futhi uma ungakabi nolwazi nolwazi, uzobeka engcupheni. Lapho imikhawulo yenzuzo incane, awukwazi ukuzivumela ukwenza amaphutha. Ngakho-ke, abalimi abasha abasafunda ubuchwepheshe bokulima bathola kunzima ukuthola izikweletu ngoba izinhlangano ezihlinzeka ngemali azithembi, ziwabeka icala. Abalimi abasha "bafundi," badinga ukwesekwa, badinga ukuqeqeshwa, badinga ukufundiswa ngabantu abanokwazi. Abantu abasebenza kuMnyango Wezolimo kanye noMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba imvamisa bangenalo ulwazi lokuhlinzeka ngaleso sesekelo esidingekayo. Abaningi abazi lutho ngokuqhubeka, abazi ngempela, abaningi bazama ngoba bafundile kodwa abake "bafake umgibeli emhlabathini." Ukuvuselela abantu kubiza imali futhi kuthatha isikhathi. Izigaba eziningi zomphakathi zinezinhlangano eziningi ezisebenza lapho futhi zikhokhelwa kodwa zingeziwanga. Lapho abantu bangaphandle njengezinkampani befuna ukuza ukuhlinzeka ngensiza, kufanele kube nomthombo wemali - kodwa ekugcineni, ubani ozokhokhela lezo zindleko? Imvamisa abalimi bathola isimo lapho bengazi ukuthi yimaphi imiyalezo okufanele bayilandele - bazokholelwa ukuthi uth authority ehlinzeka ngolwazi ikhuluma iqiniso noma ukuthi uth authority 'we agribusiness' ofuna ukwandisa ukukhiqiza imali noma inhlangano ethi ibasekela noma labo abazama ukufundisa ukulima (Ngokuphathelene, bonke laba bantu bathi into efanayo)? Ukufunda ukulima kusho ukuthi kufanele uthathe izinyathelo ezingenza kube nezinkinga eziningi - uma abantu befuna ukuba abakhiqizi, kuzokwenzeka ukuthi benze amaphutha. Kukhona isidingo esikhulu sokweseka labo abazame kodwa bahluleka. Okwamanje, kukhona abalimi abathile abanenhlanhla yokuthola uxhaso ngokuqhuba 'agribusiness', ngaleyo ndlela banethuba lokuqinisekisa izikwelet
Kunemibandela eminingi echaza intshisekelo evukile yokuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika, isibonelo: umhlaba ophumelelayo utholakala, amanani okudla akhuphukile kakhulu, futhi kukhona ukukhathazeka okukhulu ngavailability yokudla ezweni lethu nasemhlabeni jikelele. Udaba lokushoda kokudla luhlala lukhuluma emhlabeni jikelele, mayelana nokugcina ukudla emhlabeni, ilungelo lokuba nokudla nendawo yokuhlala, ekugcineni lokhu kudla kukhiqizwa umuntu othile endaweni ethile - kukhona umuntu osebenzayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule lowo muntu. Kunomneed yokuthuthukisa lowo muntu nokumnika amandla okuba umkhiqizi wezomnotho ozohlinzeka ukudla kwethu ezweni lapho kudingeka khona. Kungani abantu befuna ukwazi ukuthi abalimi abasha benza ini? Umkhakha wezolimo udinga ukuba nevoce eyodwa ekhulumela bona. Imikhiqizo yezolimo iyimpahla ethola ukudla emhlabeni jikelele futhi iyisisekelo somnotho wamazwe emhlabeni. Imikhiqizo yezolimo inikeza umsebenzi obalulekile kubantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukukhula komnotho wezindawo zasemakhaya kwenza ingcebo yasemadolobheni ingabi namandla. Lapho u-1-30% womhlaba usendleleni yabantu abangakaze bathole ithuba lokuba ngabapropathi, sizobheka ukuthi u-30% wokukhiqiza kwezolimo uzovela kulabo bantu. Ngakho-ke, sicabanga ukuthi u-30% wezinto ezidingekayo kwezolimo uzothengwa ngabalimi labo. Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabakhiqizi abasha? Ukuphuma okuphansi kwemali yokuthola izitshalo uma kukhula kuphela ezimweni zokunisela, kanye nezinga lokwaziswa elikhuphukayo. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo etholakalayo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo ibinokwehliswa. Izindleko zokuqala zikhuphuka njalo, kodwa intengo yemakethe ayikhuphuki ngokufanele. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa abangakwazi ukuqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokubolekwa imali. Lapho izinzuzo ziqinile futhi izinga lokwaziswa lemali ebolekiwe liphansi, kuba nguyena obalulekile ukuboleka izimali ezinkulu ukuze ukwazi ukutshala imbewu emhlabeni. Abakhiqizi eNingizimu Afrika balwela emakethe yomhlaba, kodwa imithetho yokubambisana ayifani. Kukhona ukungabi nalwazi olufanele namakhono. Abakhiqizi abasha bangaba abafundi; badinga ukwesekwa, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nemfundo. Ngokuvamile, abantu abasebenza emaphakathini abhandling le misebenzi bangenalwazi olufanele. Abaningi abake basebenze epulazini, abanye bayavuma ukusiza, abanye bafundile kodwa abakwazi "ukubeka imbewu emhlabeni." Izinhlangano ezinikeza izinto zokulima zisebenza kahle, kodwa izindleko zazo ziphakeme. Abakhiqizi abasha abaningi babhekana nezinselelo lapho befuna uxhaso lokukhiqiza. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhasa ifuna ukuzibophezela epulazini ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka uxhaso. Abalimi abaqashile amapulazi noma abakhiqiza emhlabeni wombuso abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo zibopho, ngaleyo ndlela behluleka ukuthola uxhaso. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhasa ehlinzeka ngoxhaso lokukhiqiza ifuna ukuqinisekiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe leyo mali. Nokho, ukuqinisekiswa kokukhiqiza kusebenza kuphela uma izitshalo ziqala ukukhula, lapho konke okukhona sekuvele kwenzekile. Ezinye izindawo ziyawuphika ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso ngaphambi kokuthola ukuqinisekiswa, okushiya umphakathi ungenalo uxhaso lokukhiqiza. Enye inkinga ukuthi: ukuqinisekiswa kuvikela kuphela u-65% wezindleko - u-35% osele usengcupheni. Ukulima kunzima; ngaphandle kolwazi, uzobhekana nezinkinga. Lapho izinzuzo zincipha, awukwazi ukukhokha amaphutha. Abakhiqizi abasha basafunda, ngakho-ke ingozi yokubaphelezela ngoxhaso iphakeme kakhulu. Kukhona abalimi abaningi abanethuba lokuthola umhlaba noma izinkundla, kodwa abambalwa banemishini yokulima lelohlaba. Imishini emisha ibiza kakhulu, futhi abalimi abakwazi ukuyifinyelela, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola ibhizinisi elizohlinzeka ngoxhaso lokuthenga imishini endala. Lapho kukhona imishini yokulima, ivamise ukuba ingasebenzi kahle. Ukuphuma okuphansi kokukhiqiza izitshalo kusho ukuthi abalimi abanemali yokulungisa imishini yabo. Ngokuvamile, abalimi bangenalwazi lokulungisa nokugcina imishini yabo. Ngokuvamile, ukuhweba komhlaba kufaka zonke izinto ezikhona epulazini, futhi sithola ukuthi imishini ibhujiswa futhi iphukile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umphakathi omusha uqala endaweni engathandeki. Izigaba zinikezwa imishini esetshenziswa ngamalungu wonke, kodwa akekho obheka impilo yemishini. Uhlelo lokulungisa umhlaba lweMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba lube yinkinga kubantu abaningi. Ngokuvamile, ukusebenza kwalo kuhamba kancane; manje abalimi abasha abaningi bayalahlekelwa amathuba okuqhubeka, futhi abalimi abamhlophe bayakhathele futhi bathengisa amapulazi abo kubangane abamhlophe ngoba uMnyango wehlulekile ukuqedela ukuhweba. Futhi akukho zinkomba ezicacile ezikhombisa ukuthi ubani ozothola inzuzo kulolu shintsho lomhlaba. Ukubuyisela ibhalansi ye-PH emhlabathini kungaba yindleko enkulu ngoba kunezindawo ezidinga kuze kube yizinkulungwane eziyi-14 ze-lime nge-hectare. Ngokuvamile, abalimi abakwazi ukukhokha lezo zindleko, futhi kubonakala sengathi akukho zindlela zomthetho ezikhombisa ukuthi abakhiqizi abasha bangafuna usizo kuhulumeni. Kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezindaweni ezithile, kodwa akukho uhlelo olufanayo. Izindlela ezingafanele zokulima eminyakeni edlule zibe nomthelela ekwehliseni izinsiza ze-phosphate kwezinye izindawo. Njengokufaka i-lime, ukubuyisela lokhu kubiza imali eningi, futhi kubonakala sengathi akukho zikhwama. Ngokuvamile, amapulazi lapho abakhiqizi abasha bekulima awasebenziswanga kahle ngoba awekho ama-contours nezinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi. Nokho, uMnyango Wezolimo unohlelo lokunakekela umhlaba, isabelomali saso sincane, futhi awakwazi ukubhekana nale nkinga enkulu futhi ahlangabezane nale mfuneko enkulu. Ngokuvamile, ukonakaliswa komhlaba ngenxa yomoya namanzi sekwenziwe kwaze kwaba sezingeni lokuthi akukwazi ukulungiswa. Abakhiqizi badinga ithuba lokuba ngabapropathi futhi babe nemishini ukuze bakhule babe abakhiqizi bezomnotho. Kwezinye izifunda, kukhona ukungabi khona kwezinsiza zezolimo ezifana nezindlela, ama-silos, izindawo zokomisa ukudla, imishini yokuvuna, njll. Abalimi badinga ukuqeqeshwa, ukwesekwa, kanye nezinsiza ezabelana ngolwazi. Abantu badinga ukwakhiwa ukuze baziqhenye. Kumele bafunde ukusebenza ngokwabo. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni abangakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo benza abantu bahlale bebuphofu (isibonelo, uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba wehlulekile ukuthuthukisa umsebenzi wabo kanye noMnyango Wezolimo ongasekeli abantu ngendlela efanele). Kulula ukuhlinzeka abantu abaphansi (bakhishwa). Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu abasebenza ukuthuthukisa abakhiqizi abasha basebenze ngokwethembeka nangokuhlonipha. Imithetho efanele nezimiso zokuhweba eziqondile ukuvikela amabhizinisi ezolimo ezweni. Nikeza usizo ngezindleko zokufaka i-lime. Nikeza

UDavid Maleleka wazalwa ngo-1954 epulazini endaweni yaseKroonstad. Wakhulela epulazini futhi wafunda khona kuze kube sephothuliwe ibanga lesi-5. Uqale ukusebenza epulazini likaMnz AJ Jonker, lapho athola khona uthando lokulima. UDavid ushade noEvelena omangalisayo - ugibisela ithrekhtha ezindaweni! Ngemva kweminyaka ethile, waya eWitsieshoek ukuze aphile. Usasebenza ngezikhathi ezithile njengomqashi emayini yeGoldfields. UThabo uphathe kahle izindaba zezimali futhi ubone ukuthi kungcono ukutshala izinkwa ezomile ngoba inzuzo iphakeme kunezinye izitshalo zokudla. Ushade noEvelyn, banezingane eziyisithupha, abafana ababili nabesifazane abane. Ngoba wayengumfana oyedwa, ubaba wakhe wamfundisa izindlela eziningi zokuphila. Ingabe icala lizobuyiselwa kubakhiqizi? Kuwo wonke ama-ndaba, kukhona abahle nabangafaneleki - kodwa kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi wokudla ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ukudla kubantu ungowokugcina ongafaneleki. Bahlukunyezwa lapho kungekho ukudla, bahlukunyezwa lapho ukudla kuncishisiwe noma ikhwalithi yokudla ingahlangabezani nezinga labo. Uma sibheka indlela, umsebenzi noma uhlelo lokubeka ukudla etafuleni labantu besizwe, sizobona ukuthi kukhona abantu abaningi benza lo msebenzi futhi sizobona ukuthi kuwumsebenzi odinga isikhathi esiningi. Ingxenye yezinto kufanele ilandele. Kumele bakwazi ukufakwa kahle futhi bathuthwe ngendlela efanele. Kufanele kudalwe umanyolo ukusiza izitshalo zikhule kahle. Kufanele kutholakale i-herbicide, ama-pesticides, kanye nokulawulwa kwezifo ngendlela evikela izitshalo ukuze zime kahle. Futhi konke lokhu kunikezelwa kumabhizinisi ezolimo. Futhi bathenga izinkanyezi zokudla. Futhi bathutha umkhiqizo baye ezinkampanini zokugcina. Futhi bathengisa umkhiqizo kubakhiqizi (noma ezimakethe zangaphandle). Futhi bapakisha ukudla ngaphambi kokukuletha kubathengisi abakhulu. Bathengisa ukudla okupakishwe kubathengisi abancane. Bathengisa ukudla kubathengi. Le ncazelo ayichazi kahle zonke izinyathelo ezenzakalayo ngoba izinhlobo zokudla zihluka. Isibonelo: ngemuva kokuphosa ummbila, kufanele uphise (upheke) ngaphambi kokuthengiswa, uma ukudla kuyisithako esisetshenziselwa ukuhluza utshwala, kufanele kukhishwe kuqala ngaphambi kokuthengiswa. Kulomsebenzi wonke, kukhona abantu abaningi nemisebenzi eminingi eyakha uhlelo lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ngumuntu ngamunye wabo ofanele ukwenza inzuzo ukuze baqhubeke nemisebenzi yabo. Manje singabuza futhi - ingabe icala lokwenyuka kwezindleko zokudla lingabekwa kuphela kumfuyi (umkhiqizi)? Yini intengo yotshwala (ibhiya) ingaphansi kuka-3% wentengo yemakethe yommbila? Ukusebenzisa ibhizinisi kuhambisana nokungena engozini - wonke amabhizinisi abhekana nezingozi ezithile. Abakhiqizi bahlushwa ukuba bamukele intengo yemakethe - abakwazi ukuhlela ukuthi bafuna malini ngethani lommbila ngoba yonke imikhiqizo yokudla ithengiswa emakethe - banikezwa intengo yosuku. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi umkhiqizi uphonswe ukuba wamukele intengo yomkhiqizo engaphansi kwezindleko zokukhiqiza lowo mkhiqizo. Isibonelo: unyaka owedlule eFree State wawubi kakhulu futhi imvula yayingelungile. Ezindaweni eziningi, abafuyi bahluleka ukuvuna ngisho nethani elilodwa lommbila ngehektare. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ummbila zishintsha zibe ngu-R4,200 ngehektare, kanti intengo yemakethe ngaleso sikhathi yayingu-R3,000 ngethani. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umfuyi evuna ithani elilodwa ngehektare, ulahlekelwa (udliwa) ngu-R1,200 ngehektare. Uma ungumthosi, uzothenga umgubo bese unquma ukuthi uzokhokha malini ngezinto ozibakele. Uma umthengi enqaba ukukhokha lelo nani, uzokwehlisa intengo yomgubo nokuqhuba kuze kube intengo yomgubo yehlile. Kodwa uma umfuyi ethatha izinyathelo zokuqala zokutshala ukudla, abakwazi ukususa ngaphakathi komsebenzi wabo futhi balinde intengo inyuke - sebesuke benze izindleko manje kumele baqhubeke nokuvuna nokuthengisa lowo mkhiqizo. Abakhiqizi bethu bayinsiza enkulu kithi - basebenza kanzima, bathatha amathuba ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ng ukudla nemisebenzi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi singathenga kuphela ngaphandle uma lezo zizwe zinezakhamuzi eziningi zokudla, futhi uma izwe lethu linemali yokuthenga lokho. Lapho izimo zezinye izizwe zibi, zizogcina ukudla kwazo, ngakho sizophumelela ukuthenga ngaphandle. Futhi uma umphumela wokushintsha kwemali ubangela ukuthi inani le-rand lehle, izwe lethu ngeke likwazi ukuthenga ukudla futhi abantu bazolamba, sibona lokhu ezindaweni eziningi e-Afrika. Ngaphambi kokubeka icala kulezo zizwe ngokukhokha izindleko eziphezulu, masibheke le ndaba ukuze sithole ukuthi yini imbangela yokwenyuka kwentengo. Uma singasekeli abakhiqizi bethu ukuze baqhubeke nokutshala ukudla ngendlela enenzuzo, ngisho lapha abantu bazohlupheka ngendlala.
UXolile Dasheka wazalwa efemini endaweni yasePetrusburg. Ubaba wakhe wayesebenza efemini kanti umama wakhe wayengumsebenzi wezindlu. UXolile unedigri kuMphakathi kanye neHhotela kanye neDiploma kuMphakathi Wobudlelwano. Wathenga ifemini yakhe, iLemoenkloof, endaweni yaseJagersfontein ngo-2006 ngezikweletu ezivela kuLand Bank. Ifemini yakhe inobukhulu obuyi-1,134 hectares, lapho u-145 hectares kuyindawo yokulima kanti u-989 hectares isetshenziselwa ukugaya izinkomo. UXolile ukhula ikakhulu ufulawa, uphakamisa izinkomo zenyama, amaphiko, izinkukhu, futhi uphinde akhulise nemifino. Uthola kanjani imali yokuphatha izitshalo zakho? Emuva kweminyaka emibili edlule, angikathengisi izitshalo. Ngizisebenzise ukudla izinkomo zami. Ngisebenzise ezinye zezinzuzo engizitholile ukuphatha umkhiqizo wonyaka ozayo. Ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko, ngizozama ukuthola isikweletu ukusiza kuLand Bank. Ucabanga ukuthini ngezimo zezimali kwezolimo? Umkhiqizi kumele abe yizinto eziningi; ngokwesibonelo, kumele abe uchwepheshe kwezezimali, umnotho, umthengisi, nokunye okuningi. Izinzuzo ezitholakala ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zincane kakhulu. Sidinga umphakathi ukusiza abakhiqizi baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuthenga imikhiqizo yasendaweni. Sidinga ukuba kube nokuthengiswa kwemali ethile ezitshalweni ezingenayo ezweni. Izinzuzo zokufaka njenge-diesel nezokwenziwa ziyasiphuca. Ezolimo akuyona insimu ethokozisa intsha yabantu abamnyama; ababona ikusasa kuyo. Uma izindleko nezimpahla ezingenayo zingalawulwa, ukuncintisana okukhona ezimpahleni ezixhaswayo kuzophula umkhiqizi waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthola kuphi izinto zakho zokufaka? Ngithenga kulabo abamele abahlinzeki bezinkampani ezihlinzeka lezo zinto, ngemuva kokuthola nokuhlanganisa amanani aphakanyisiwe futhi ngicabangele ukusiza abakuhlinzekayo ngezinkinga ezivela ngemuva kokuthenga kubo. Yini indima kahulumeni kwezolimo futhi uyayifeza kanjani? Uhulumeni kumele anakekele abakhiqizi. Abakhiqizi bakha amathuba emisebenzi nokuzinza ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Kumele babheke umhlaba onikezwa kubakhiqizi abasha kanye nosizo olunikezwa ukuze babasize baphumelele kwezezimali nasezinsizeni zokusebenza. Kumele kube nokukhuthazwa kulabo abakhiqizi abasebenzela ukwenza imali. Kumele kukhokhelwe amanani afanele, futhi ukusiza kumele kufunwe lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni uyazama, kodwa okwamanje akaphumelelanga. Ucabanga ukuthini okuthinta impumelelo yakho? Ikhono lami lokuphatha izinto eziningi lingenzele kahle. Izinkomo zikunikeza ukuzinza futhi zikusize ngemali oyidingayo. Ukuphakamisa amaphiko nezinkukhu kungisizile ukuhlangabezana nezindleko zami zenyanga. Nginephezi elincane lokulima elingu-3 hectares engazi ukuthi ngingalisebenzisa. Ngikhula imifino ukuze ngithole imali ngokushesha. Futhi, iqiniso lokuthi angigxilile ngokuphelele kwezolimo, nginokunye umsebenzi ongenakuphila, liyasiza. Uma ezolimo zingaba nemali eningi, ngizoba umkhiqizi wesikhathi esigcwele. Ucabanga ukuthini njengengozi empumelelweni yakho? Ngikhathazekile ukuthi ukungabi nobumbano kwezombusazwe, ukukhohlisana, nokukhuluma okukhanga izindaba kungaphazamisa amathuba ami empumelelo. Ukutholakala kwemali futhi kuyinkinga ebalulekile. Yiziphi izingxenye zokuhweba kwezolimo ofuna ukuzithuthukisa? Ngifuna ukuba nolwazi oluningi lobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuphathwa komhlaba, ukongiwa kwamanzi, nokunakekelwa kwezinkomo. Ngifuna futhi ukuthi abasebenzi bami bathole ukuqeqeshwa. Yisiphi isu ozophila ngaso kulo nyaka? Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwami lokusekela lukhona. I-Grain SA neqembu lami locwaningo kubalulekile ekunikezeni usizo. Ngifuna futhi ukukhulisa ukulima kwami kwezinkomo, okuyizinkomo zami zenyama. Uma ukukhohlisana kungasuswa, ngifuna ukuqala ukuphakamisa izimvu.
Usibongile Victor Michael Mahlinza wazalwa e-Estcourt ngomhla ziyi-14 kuJulayi 1961, futhi wakhulela endaweni yaseNtabamhlophe (White Mountain). Uqale ukuya esikoleni samabanga aphansi ngo-1968 eCornfield Primary School. Ngonyaka ka-1976, waqala ukuya eMtshezi High School futhi waphothula ibanga leshumi nanye ngo-1982. Ngonyaka ka-1983, wathuthela eJohannesburg futhi wasebenza kumuntu ophakathi njengomphakathi. Wasebenza lapho unyaka owodwa. Kusukela ngo-1987 kuya ku-1988, uVictor wayengumshayeli wezimoto eM & L Distributors. Kusukela ngo-1989 kuya ku-1995, wathumela izimpahla ze-AMCA Construction. Ngonyaka ka-1996, uVictor wayefuna ukuba umproduci futhi wabuyela ekhaya. Uqale ukulima futhi wakhulisa izinkomo. Wathenga ithrekhtha ngo-2003. Unombono wesikhathi esizayo nenkani yokubhekana nezinselelo ezingase zivele kumuntu ofuna ukuba umproduci wokudla. Uthola kanjani imali yokutshala ezitshalweni zakhe? ULawrence Luthango, umphakathi wezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi eGrain SA kule ndawo. UMonica Mathamba uhlala endaweni yaseMthatha Mbozisa lapho engum member weMbozisa Farmers' Association. UMonica uphumelele ekulimaleni izinkulungwane eziyi-6 futhi uphumelele ekulimaleni izinkundla zakhe lapho efaka khona amanzi. UMonica uhambele izifundo zokuqeqeshwa kweGrain SA zabafuyi, kuhlanganise nokwethulwa ekukhiqizeni ufulawa kanye nesifundo esiphakeme sokukhiqiza ufulawa. UMonica ukhuphule umkhiqizo wakhe usebenzisa ulwazi alutholile kwiGrain SA. Uvame ukukhiqiza amatonnes angu-3.5 ngehektare kodwa manje ukhiqiza amatonnes angu-4.5 ngehektare. UMonica uthola kanjani uxhaso lokutshala? Ukuze athole uxhaso lokuqala, UMonica usebenzisa imali engakhe ngoba umphathi wezezimali uvame ukuthola imali ebolekiwe ngemva kokuvuna. UMonica uthola kuphi izinto zokutshala? UMonica uthi uthenga izinto zokutshala zakhe zokuqala kwiMthiza Farmers Co-op nase-East Cape Co-op. Intengo ivame ukuba phezulu (zibiza kakhulu) futhi abafuyi banikezwa izeluleko mayelana nobuchwepheshe bezinto lezo.
