UMonica ubhekana nezinkinga ezidinga ukuthi abakhiqizi banikeze imibiko (izeluleko) nezakhono ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe, futhi kufanele banikeze izindlela namathuba okuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo (izakhiwo). UMonica uthi akabhekani nalezi zinkinga ngoba sebekhulume ngazo izinqubomgomo zabo lapho kudingeka. UMonica uthi uthini ngempumelelo yakhe eqhubekayo ekulimaleni? UMonica uthi impumelelo yakhe ivela othandweni lwakhe olukhulu lokulima kanye nomsebenzi wakhe oqhubekayo onzima. Ukholelwa ukuthi ukusebenzisa imbewu ye-hybrid (izinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene zembewu), umanyolo ofanele, nokuzama ukulawula izihlahla ezimbi ezinkundleni ngezinto zokwakha kuye kwamsiza ukukhuphula umkhiqizo wakhe. Ngonyaka ongenhla, UMonica ufuna ukuthenga imishini eminingi, ikakhulukazi imishini yokuphalaza.
Izithombe: Ukulondolozwa komhlabathi: Lokhu kuyinhlanganisela yemithi, amaqabunga, nomhlabathi othambile obekwe eduze kwezitshalo ukuvimbela ukugqwala (ukugqwala komoya), ukuvimbela ukujula okweqile kwemizi, nokuvimbela ukukhula kwezihlahla. Imvula ewela emhlabathini ongekho ngaphansi kokuvikelwa ingadala ubungozi uma imvula ikhulu. Kubalulekile kubalimi ukuzama ukunciphisa leli bungozi elenzeka emhlabathini uma imvula ikhulu. Incwadi yethu ethi "Imvula ngoFebhuwari" ixoxa ngokuqiniswa komhlabathi ophakeme, ikakhulukazi ibhekisela ezinsongweni zokugqwala komhlabathi kanye nezinhlobo zokugqwala. Lapha sizama ukuchaza ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zobungozi imvula engadala emhlabathini ongekho ngaphansi kokuvikelwa nokuthi singenza kanjani ukuze silondoloze umhlabathi. Ingxenye yamandla emvula isetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa amaqoqo omhlabathi kuyo yonke indawo. Uma umhlabathi uqiniswe, usabalalisa ngokulinganayo kuyo yonke indawo futhi umhlabathi omningi ngeke ulahleke, kodwa uma umhlabathi ungenamsebenzi, umhlabathi omningi uzoshesha. Ngakho-ke, umhlabathi ophumile uzoshesha kancane kancane futhi uzolahleka. Kukhona ibhalansi phakathi kwamandla emvula nokugqwala komhlabathi. Kaziwa kahle ukuthi ukugqwala komhlabathi okukhulu (50% - 80%) kuvame ukwenzeka uma imvula ikhulu ezindaweni lapho kuvame khona ngesikhathi sehlobo. Amaqoqo amaningi ahluleka emizimbeni ethambile. Amanzi amaningi azohamba phansi. Amanzi azohamba ngokushesha, eshaya. Ububanzi bokugqwala kanye nezindlela zokuphatha lokhu kuzovimbela izinhlobo eziningi zezimbali ukuba zifakwe kule ndawo uma ukugqwala komhlabathi kungaphathwa kahle. Lokhu kubhekisela ikakhulukazi kumandla amanzi okugqwala umhlabathi kanye nesimo somhlabathi kule ndawo - ezinye izinhlobo zomhlabathi ziqhume ngokushesha, ezinye kancane. Zonke izinkambu ezilimiwe ezine-erosion rate engaphezu kuka-3% kufanele zivikelwe ngokuhlelwa (lokhu kuyisakhiwo esakhiwe ukuze sikhuphule umhlabathi ukuze kudaleke udonga lapho amanzi amaningi angaphuma khona emkhakheni). Izitshalo ezilimiwe zingafakwa kuphela ezinkambini ezine-erosion rate engaphansi kuka-10%. Izitshalo ezineziqhamo ezincane zingafakwa kuphela ezinkambini ezine-erosion rate engaphansi kuka-15%. Izinkambo ezilimiwe zingafakwa kuphela lapho ukugqwala kungaphansi kuka-30%. Ukugqwala okungaphezu kuka-30% kungasetshenziswa kuphela ukufaka izihlahla noma ukugcina izinsiza zemvelo ezifana nezilwane. Ukuvikelwa kwemithi kuyinto ebalulekile evimbela ukugqwala komhlabathi ngenxa yemvula. Ikakhulukazi, ukuvikelwa kwemithi kudala isakhiwo esifana ne-umbrella - ivimba imvula ngaphambi kokufika emhlabathini. Amaqoqo emvula ewela emithini nasezinqolobaneni alahlekelwa amandla awo okudala ubungozi emhlabathini ngoba lawa maqoqo nawo ayahlakazeka futhi awanawo amandla okusabalalisa umhlabathi, amanzi ahamba ngemithi nasezinqolobaneni kuze kube ukufika kancane emhlabathini. Ukulondolozwa komhlabathi ngemicabango kusebenza kangcono ngokuvikelwa kwemithi okwakha i-umbrella. Ukulondolozwa kugcina amaqoqo eduze nomhlabathi, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa amandla amaqoqo ahamba phambili. Ngisho noma ukuvikelwa kwemithi kuhlanganisa zonke izindawo, ezinye izakhiwo zemithi ezakha i-umbrella zingasiza ukuvimbela ukugqwala komhlabathi. Ukulondolozwa kwemvelo kungabandakanya izimpande zezitshalo, amaqabunga, kanye nothuli olutholakala ngesikhathi kukhishwa izinkuni nezihlahla. Ekulimaleni, izinto ezisele emkhakheni ngemuva kokuvuna zisebenza kangcono. Umsebenzi wokuvimbela ukugqwala komhlabathi uxhumene ngqo nosayizi wokulondolozwa komhlabathi. Singasho futhi okuphambene - ububanzi bokugqwala komhlabathi buxhumene nezindawo lapho umhlabathi ungagcinwa khona. Izinsalela ngemuva kokuvuna kufanele zishiywe emhlabathini - kodwa kungase kube nezizathu zokuzisusa, isibonelo: izifo ezingenzeka ezitshalweni, i-nitrogen emhlabathini ingancipha ngenxa yokubola kwezinsalela zemithi, kungase kudingeke ukuhlinzeka ngokushesha noma kungase kudingeke ukubulala izihlahla, njll. Bese kuba umkhuba ojwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika ukusebenzisa izinsalela ukukhulisa izinkomo nezimvu. Uma sicabanga ngezindlela zokulima, kunezinto esingazisebenzisa ukuze silime ngaphandle kokulimaza ukulondolozwa komhlabathi. Uma sifaka emigqeni, ukuhlinzeka nokuhlanza kungenzeka kuphela emigqeni, futhi izindawo phakathi kwemigqa zingashiywa zigcinwe. Izihlahla zingalawulwa ngamakhemikhali.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni Lunikeza abalimi imibhalo eningiliziwe mayelana nezolimo njalo ngenyanga ngephephandaba lethu - iPula/Imvula. Izinkulungwane eziyi-18,000 ze-iPula/Imvula zabelwa abalimi ngolimi lwezizathu eziyi-7 njalo ngenyanga - isiNgisi, isiBhunu, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiNorthern Sotho, isiZulu, nesiXhosa. Njalo ngenyanga, iPula/Imvula iqukethe amakhasi ayisishiyagalombili asekelwe yiMaize Trust. Kukhona namakhasi amane aphelile ngesiSesotho ngoMashi, ngoJuni, ngoSepthemba, nangoDisemba asekelwe yiWinter Cereals Trust. IIOPOT nayo inamakhasi amane aphelile ngazo zonke izilimi (ngaphandle kwesiXhosa) ngoJanuwari, ngoAprili, ngoJulayi, nangoOkthoba. Sihlala sizama ukufaka imibhalo ezosiza abalimi kulonyaka. Le mibhalo ixoxa ngezindaba eziphathelene nezwe, ezolimo, izindlela zokukhiqiza, ukumaketha, imishini, nokuphathwa kwezindawo zokulima. Sifuna futhi ukubonga abaxhasi bohlelo lwethu ngokusinika ithuba lokufaka isandla emsebenzini wethu wokuthuthukisa nokuguqula ezolimo ezweni lethu.
IRadio iyasiza kakhulu ekulimaleni kubalimi abasha. Izinhlelo ezithunyelwa njalo ngesonto ziyasetshenziswa futhi zinikeza ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nokulima - abalimi bathola inzuzo ngalolu suku. IRadio Umhlobo Wenene (IsiXhosa eMpuma Koloni). Kungani siba nezinhlelo zokufunda futhi siqala kanjani ukwakha iqembu lokufunda? Imvula izofika. Sizoyisebenzisa kanjani le mvula? Yisiphi isikhathi esifanele sokuqalisa ukusebenza? Lapho inzuzo ihlale iphansi - kuphi abalimi abangatshala khona ezitshalweni ezisemqoka? Njalo ngosuku sikhubazeka umhlaba ngenxa yokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu, umhlaba ovame ukukhiqiza ukudla. Amanzi - ukuze sikwazi ukuhlela umhlabathi ngendlela egcina amanzi emhlabathini, amanzi atholakala ezulwini, noma uma unethuba, nge- irrigation. Ukudla - udinga umanyolo ukuze ukhule kahle. Amafutha - nini futhi kanjani okufanele uwasebenzise. Sihlangene sakhuluma ngezinto ezinhle nezimbi ezihlobene nokusebenzisa amafutha. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umsebenzi othile ubiza malini, akufanele ukhokhe kuphela intengo abayishoyo. Uma unemishini, kufanele uyisebenzise. Kungani umgudu ophakanyisiwe ungafani nombala nemigudu eminye - yisiphi isizathu? Ngisanda kuqala izinhlelo usebenzisa ulwazi olutholakele encwadini yethu ethi Pula/Imvula ebizwa: Ingabe udaba lokwenyuka kwamanani okudla luzophakanyiswa futhi kubalimi? Ungaphumelela kanjani ekukhiqizeni ukudla okuyisisekelo?
Izithombe: Isithombe 1.1: Ukuphuma kwemvula okujwayelekile: mm/ngonyaka. Isithombe 1.2: Ukuphuma kokupholisa okujwayelekile: mm/ngonyaka. Ukuhlanzeka kuyinto ebalulekile uma sibhakabhisa ukudla. Zonke izindawo zinezinombolo ezirekhodiwe zokuphuma kwemvula. Ukuphuma kwemvula okujwayelekile kuzokhombisa ukuthi iyiphi imbewu engabhalwa ezindaweni ezithile lapho ukutshala kwenziwa kuphela ngemvula. Ezindaweni lapho kunethuba lokunisela, kufanele sicabangele ezinye izimo zezulu ngoba amanzi atholakala ngokunisela. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uma imvula ingena enanini elithile, akusho ukuthi wonke la manzi azothathwa yisitshalo. Uma imvula ingena kakhulu, amanzi amaningi aphuma futhi alahleka. Uma insimu iphansi, ukuhamba kwamanzi kuyanda. Kuya ngokuthi insimu ikhululiwe kanjani, umhlabathi ophakeme ophakanyisiwe uzovimba amanzi ukuthi angangeni. Uma kungekho zimbali ensimini, ukuphuma kokupholisa kuyanda. Uhlobo lomhlabathi lukhombisa futhi ukuthi umhlabathi unekhono lokugcina amanzi, futhi kungase kube nezinhlamvu ezizovimba amanzi ukuthi afinyelele ezitshalweni. Ukuphuma kwemvula nokuphuma kokupholisa okujwayelekile kuboniswa ezithombeni 1.1 no 1.2 (DWAF, 1986). Ngaphansi kuka-20% wendawo lapha eNingizimu Afrika, okuyi-1.05 million square kilometers, kunezimo zezulu ezithola u-750 mm/ngonyaka futhi kunezinga elingaphansi kuka-1,400 mm/ngonyaka lokuphuma kwemvula - kulezi zindawo, isimo sezulu sifaneleka ekutshaliseni ukudla. Izindawo lapho inani lokuphuma kwemvula lidlula u-500 mm/ngonyaka futhi linezinga elingaphansi kuka-1,800 mm/ngonyaka lokuphuma kwemvula zifaka: iphilisi eliphakathi, izindawo ezisemaphandleni empumalanga, nezindawo eKapa lapho kunemvula yasebusika. Ukunisela nokulima okujwayelekile kwenzeka kulezi zindawo, lapho kukhishwa khona u-mazey, ushukela, nezitshalo. Ezinye izindawo zomhlaba zomile kancane kanti ezinye zomile kakhulu, kodwa imvula iyenzeka, nokho amanzi adingekayo angaphansi kuka-50%. Ngakho-ke, ukunisela kuyadingeka kulezi zindawo ukuze kugcinwe izitshalo zokudla.
Ingcebo - uyisebenzisa kanjani? Ingcebo ibhekisela kumithombo engasetshenziswa umbulali ukuze enze umsebenzi wakhe wezolimo. Ukuhlola nokusebenzisa kahle le mithombo kubalulekile uma umbulali efuna ukuphumelela kwezolimo nokuthola inzuzo enhle. Umhlaba kanye nefamu - lapha singahlanganisa indlela yokusebenzisa umhlaba, inani lezomnotho lomhlaba, ubunikazi bomhlaba, nezinhlelo zokuphatha ifamu. Amanzi nomhlaba ongeniswa - lapha singahlanganisa izindleko zokungenisa amanzi nezintengo zamandla, izinga lamanzi, isimo sezindawo ezimanzi, nezici zazo. Ulwazi nokuzikhandla ekukhiqizeni - lapha singahlanganisa ubuhlobo bezitshalo nezilwane, ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa, ubuchwepheshe bezolimo, nokukhula kokukhiqizwa kokudla. Ukuphatha ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo - lapha kukhona ukuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo, ukuphatha nokugcina umhlabathi, izindlela zokuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuphatha imithombo yokudla, izindlela zokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukuphathwa kwemvelo, ukuphatha amanzi okungeniswa, ukuphatha ulwazi oluvela kubuchwepheshe, nezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ezihlobene nezindlela zokugcina umhlaba. Enye indlela ehlobene nokuphatha le mithombo yonke ukumaketha - lapho kungekho emakethe umkhiqizo, ukukhiqizwa akusizi. Nokho, konke okukhulunywe ngenhla kubalulekile ekuphatheni ibhizinisi lezolimo eliphumelelayo; le ndatshana izogxila kakhulu ekuphatheni izimo zomhlaba kanye nokukhiqiza umhlabathi ngendlela enenzuzo ezohamba phambili. Kufanele ukhumbule konke okukhulunywe ngenhla uma uhlole izindlela zokukhiqiza ezizokukhombisa uhlelo lwamanje lwezindleko ezithile kanye naleyo edingekayo. Ngakho, uzokwazi ukuhlela ukuthi yiziphi izimali ezizongena ezindaweni ezithile zebhizinisi lakho lezolimo. Umhlaba uyisici esibalulekile sengcebo kunoma yiliphi izwe. Ukukhetha izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba kwenziwa nsuku zonke ngabaphathi bezifamu - bacabangela izimo zemakethe, balalele lokho uhulumeni akukhuluma ngakho mayelana nemithetho yokuphatha umhlaba, futhi bahlole isimo somhlaba othile. Phakathi kwalezi zindawo zomhlaba, kusenalo umhlaba osebenzisa le ndlela: imigwaqo yokuhamba, amapaki nezindawo zokuzijabulisa, izindawo zomnyango wezokuvikela, nezinye izimboni, izindlu zezimboni, imigwaqo yezifamu, nezindawo zasemaphandleni. Umhlaba osele usetshenziswa kanje: izindawo ezimanzi, izigodi, amachibi, imifula, amadamu, izindawo eziwumqansa, nezindawo lapho kungakhuli lutho. Zandisa ubuchwepheshe bokuphila. Abalimi eNingizimu Afrika bangasebenzisa le ngcebo ngezindlela ezingahlangene ngqo nokukhiqizwa kokudla; bangathola inzuzo ngokukhokhisa imali uma abantu befuna ukuhamba, ukuhamba, noma ukubuka izinyoni. Ingxenye yengcebo etholakala emhlabeni iyahluka ngokuya ngokuqina komhlabathi kanye nendawo yomhlaba. Umhlaba wezolimo onokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi ungachazwa kanje: ungumhlaba lapho izimo zomhlaba zemvelo zihlangana nezici zamakhemikhali ezikhona zokukhiqiza ukudla, izitshalo, kanye namafutha. Umhlaba onjalo kufanele ube khona lapho kukhona umhlabathi onokukhiqiza, lapho isikhathi esidingekayo sokukhula kwezitshalo sikhona, futhi lapho kukhona umswakama okwanele (amanzi). Lokhu kubalulekile ekukhiqizeni ukudla uma umhlaba uphathwa ngendlela efanele yezolimo, futhi uma imithombo yamanzi iphethwe kahle futhi umhlaba wemvelo ugcinwa ngendlela efanele. Ungangenisa amanzi nomoya. Awuvikelwe ekukhukhuleni kwamanzi. Izinhlobo zezithako ezingasetshenziswa emhlabeni wezolimo omuhle zifaka: ummbila, ufulawa, ibhali, ama-ot, isorghum, ikhenela, ama-soybeans, utshani, imifino, izimbali, ikotoni, kanye nemikhiqizo yezilwane ezifana nezinkomo, izinkomo zokukhiqiza ubisi, izimvu, izinkukhu, nezilwane zasendle. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zokukhiqiza konke lokhu zisetshenziswa ngabafuyi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukushintsha izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba kungaba nomthelela ezimweni zokwakheka kwesimo sezulu ekuphumeleleni kokukhiqiza ukudla, nokunye. Ngezinye izikhathi, ukwehla kwezimo zemvelo ezifana nokuhlanza umhlabathi, izinga lamanzi, nezindawo zokuhlala izilwane zasendle akuthathwa kakhulu ngoba abalimi baphakamisela inzuzo kuqala, ngaphandle kokucabangela ukusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo komhlaba. Ukusebenzisa umhlaba kungase kube usizo kumuntu ngesikhathi esifushane kodwa kungase kungasizi abantu emhlabeni jikelele esikhathini eside. Umnikazi womhlaba uzozama ukuwusebenzisa ngendlela ezokwenza inzuzo enhle.
Njengomnikazi wezinsiza nemishini, kufanele wazi ukuthi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokubheka abantu abasebenza nalezi zinto. Izimo ezinjengalezi zivame ukudala ubungozi. Ungasebenzisi imishini yokuvikela. Sebenzisa imishini ngenkathi isahamba. Sebenzisa amathuluzi afanele: ungasebenzisi amathuluzi amancane ukwenza umsebenzi wamathuluzi amakhulu. Gcina amathuluzi enempilo: qinisekisa ukuthi akhanya kahle, alinganisiwe futhi uwacwebezele njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-pins aqinile. Sebenzisa izing glasses zokuvikela uma usebenza. Sebenzisa umask uma kukhona uthuli oluningi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokuphepha iyasebenza kahle. Vimbela izingane ukuthi zingangeneli. Bonke abavakashi endaweni yokusebenza (isitolo) akufanele basondeze endaweni lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Gcina indawo yokusebenza ikhanya kahle. Izinto eziphukile yonke indawo zidalela ubungozi. Beka amathuluzi kude ngemva kokuwasebenzisa - awadingeki lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Vala wonke amathuluzi anogesi. Gqoka izingubo ezifanele. Izingubo ezikhululekile zingabamba emishini. Qinisa umsebenzi wakho: sebenzisa ama-clamps nezinsiza zamathuluzi owasebenzisayo. Kungcono ukubamba ngezandla ngoba manje uzokwazi ukusebenzisa zombili izandla uma usebenza. Ungazami ukwenza amathuluzi akho enze imisebenzi emikhulu kakhulu. Ungazami ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Qinisekisa ukuthi ume kahle njalo. Donsa i-lever - ungacindezeli. Uma kunzima ukudonsa, sebenzisa isikhumba sesandla sakho ukusunduza. Amathuluzi akhanyayo akufanele abhekiswe emzimbeni wakho. Lokhu kungavimbela izingozi uma ithuluzi lishayisa. Xhuma yonke imishini enogesi emhlabeni (umhlaba). Sebenzisa i-plug enezinhlangothi ezintathu kuphela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukukhanya okwanele nokuhamba komoya endaweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-bench akhanya kahle futhi umoya ongcolile uyakhishwa njalo eshopheni. Ngokufanayo, gcina ithuluzi lokwelashwa elibalulekile liseduze. Phendula noma yiziphi izingozi ezincane ngokushesha ukuze uvimbele ingozi enkulu ekwenzekeni.
Yini isimo (mhlawumbe singathi)! Ngesikhathi sikhula njengabantwana, sifundiswe ukuthi akufanele sibhale izinkukhu ngaphambi kokuba amaqanda aphume. Nokho, uma usuvunile, ubona ukuthi lokhu kuyinto oyitholile. Manje kufanele ucabange ukuthi uzokwenza ini ngalokhu kuvuna - uzokuthengisa ngokushesha noma uzokugcina ukuze ulinde intengo ikhule (noma yehlise uma ungaphumeleli). Lokhu kungenzeka uma ungenayo inkontileka yokumaketha - uma unayo, kufanele ulandele imigomo yayo. Yiziphi izinto okufanele ngicabangele uma ngifuna ukuqoqa ukuvuna kwami? Ngabe nginendawo epulazini yokuphatha, ukuhlanza, nokugcina lezi z food? Ngabe kufanele ngithuthe umkhiqizo ngiya emapulazini ukuze ngiwuhambise kumphathi wesilo ongumuntu ozimele, mhlawumbe kumfarmers omunye, noma emakethe noma kumuntu omunye osebenzisa ukudla okuvela emapulazini? Uma ufulawa kufanele ubekwe epulazini noma endaweni lapho kukhona isilo somuntu osebenza ngokwakhe, kuzobiza malini ithani? Qonda ukuthi izindleko zokuhlanganisa ufulawa endaweni ethile ngeke zidlule izindleko zentela nezinye izindleko ezihlobene nokubeka ukuvuna kwakho. Funda ngokucophelela lokho okukhuluma kulokhu kukontileka, ngesiNgisi baziwa ngokuthi "ukuphrinta okuncane" okuvame ukutholakala ekupheleni kwalokhu kukontileka - qaphela ukuthi bangakukhokhisa? Yisiphi isithembiso esinakho mayelana nentengo yokudla ehla futhi ikhula? Njalo ngesonto kufanele ushintshe amasu akho okuthengisa ngokuya ngezimo zezulu nezimakethe, kodwa kufanele ukhulume nomphathi wakho wezimali noma nesikhungo esabelana ngemininingwane endaweni yakho. Yini edala ukuthi intengo ye-fulawa eNingizimu Afrika yehlise futhi ikhule? Uma kukhona ukukhiqiza okukhulu kakhulu kwe-fulawa eNingizimu Afrika (njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2004 no-2005), intengo ye-fulawa ye-Safex ivame ukuthengiswa ngentengo esondele kwentengo ye-fulawa ethengiswa phesheya. Uma kubonakala ukuthi ufulawa kuzodingeka ukuthi ulethe phesheya kwezinye izindawo lapha eNingizimu Afrika (njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2006 no-2007), intengo ye-fulawa ye-Safex ivame ukuthengiswa ngentengo esondele kwentengo ekhokhelwa ukuthenga ufulawa phesheya. Intengo ye-fulawa yomhlaba ithonywa yizinto ezinkulu lapho intengo ye-fulawa ethengiswa phesheya noma ye-fulawa ethengwe phesheya ikalwa. Intengo ye-fulawa yomhlaba iyashintsha futhi iyashintsha nsuku zonke nangasikhathi. Ukushintsha kwentengo yomhlaba kuzoshintsha nentengo ye-fulawa ethengwe phesheya. Intengo ye-fulawa ethengwe e-USA nase-Argentina ivame ukukhombisa ukuthi intengo ye-fulawa eNingizimu Afrika izoba kanjani. Izindleko ezihlobene nentengo yokungenisa ukudla noma ukukuthutha phesheya (njengentengo yokuthenga ufulawa ezimakethe zomhlaba - noma ezindaweni ezithile) ikalwa ngokumelene nezindleko zokuthutha ukudla ngolwandle kanye nezinsizakalo ezihlobene nalokhu. Konke lokhu kubizwa futhi kukhokhelwa ngamaRandi aseMelika. Ukuhlela zonke lezi zindleko neRand yaseNingizimu Afrika kufanele kuhambisane nezinga lokushintshanisa leRand/amaRandi aseMelika. Ukushintsha kwansuku zonke kwezinga lokushintshanisa leRand/amaRandi aseMelika kuzoshintsha nentengo ye-fulawa ethengiswa kanye ne-fulawa ethengwe phesheya. Ufulawa waseNingizimu Afrika uthengiswa nsuku zonke ezimakethe zokudla ezikhiqizwayo kwezolimo eNingizimu Afrika e-Safex, okuyingxenye yeJohannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE). I-Safex ingachazwa njengohlelo lwe-elektroniki oluphatha futhi luhlola abathengi (njengabo abamila ufulawa ukuze benze ufulawa) kanye nalabo abathengisa (njengabakhulisa). Ngakho-ke, abathengi nabathengisi bangabeka intengo noma inani lemali ye-fulawa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi (ngokuvamile njalo ngenyanga). Ukuhamba kwe-Safex (ukuthenga nokuthengisa imikhiqizo yezolimo) kuqhubeka kusukela ngo-09:00 kuya ku-12:00 nsuku zonke. E-Randfontein (Gauteng), uzothola uphawu olukhombisa intengo ye-fulawa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi intengo ye-fulawa ye-Safex iyatholakala uma ufulawa ufika e-Randfontein. Uma ufulawa unikezwa kwezinye izindawo ngaphandle kwe-Randfontein, intengo kufanele ilungiswe ngokuya ngezindleko zokuthutha nezinye. Uma ungakwazi ukuhambisa ufulawa e-Randfontein, kufanele ucabangele izindleko ezizovela uma uhambisa ufulawa wakho kwezinye izindawo (izilo) ezibhaliswe ku-Safex. Kukhona izimali ezizokhokhiswa. Okokuqala, kukhona izindleko zokuthutha (kusukela endaweni yakho kuya kule silo e-Randfontein). Lezi zindleko zibhaliwe kahle emqulwini we-Safex ophumelele minyaka yonke. Uma ufulawa uhambiswa endaweni enesilo somnotho (um owner wesilo), kuzodingeka ukhokhe imali yokuphatha bese ubeka ufulawa wakho. Ngokuvamile, kuzoba nezindleko ezizokhokhiswa yinkampani ethengisa ufulawa wakho uma ungathengisi ukuvuna kwakho kumhlinzeki ngokushesha (isibonelo: ibhizinisi lezolimo lizokuthengisela ufulawa wakho futhi uzokhokha ngalokhu). Uma leyo fulawa ingathengiswa ngokushesha ngemva kokuhanjiswa (mhlawumbe kufanele igcinwe isikhathi esithile), kuzoba nezindleko ezengeziwe zokugcina leyo fulawa. Kubalulekile kumfarmers ukuqonda ukuthi inani lemali abazolithola kule silo ethile lingase libe phansi kunenani abangakuthola kwezinye izindawo. Ungazama futhi ukuxoxa ngqo nabaphathi bezimila, kanye nezinye izinkampani ezisebenza nemikhiqizo yezolimo nabanye abathengi nabathengisi bezinhlamvu zokudla ukuze uthole intengo engcono. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ungumnikazi kuphela walokhu kuvuna - kuyakho ukuyithengisa ngokuthanda kwakho - uma ungathandi intengo yokuthengisa, zama ukuthola intengo engcono. Intengo ekhombiswa yi-Safex iyona okufanele uzame ukuyithola.

Isithombe 1: Izimpawu zezitshalo ezithintekayo zikhombisa ukuhamba kwalolu bhubhane. Bheka ama-sclerotia amnyama kanye ne-mycelium emhlophe. Isitshalo esinempilo singase sibe ngakolunye uhlangothi. Isithombe 2: I-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ethishelweni lesitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 3: Ama-sclerotia ngaphakathi kwesitho sesitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 4: Ukuwa ngaphakathi komqolo. Isithombe 5: Ukuwa kwekhanda - lokhu kubonakala ngaphambi kokuba ikhanda lehle. Isithombe 6: Ukuhamba kwalolu bhubhane - ukuwa kwekhanda kanye naphakathi komqolo. Ama-sclerotia abuyiselwa emhlabathini ngesikhathi sokuvuna nasekulimeni. Kulesi sithombe, sizogxila kakhulu kulolu bhubhane olubalulekile oluthinta i-canola - Izifo ze-Sclerotinia. Kukhona izifo ezintathu, ukuwa (ukubola) okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia, ukuwa ngaphakathi komqolo, nokubola kwekhanda. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kubangelwa yifungus ehlala emhlabathini ebizwa nge-sclerotia, engena ezimpandeni ze-canola. Lokhu kubola kuhlukile ngoba kuqala ezimpandeni. I-Sclerotinia ebola ikhanda nomqolo ihamba emoyeni ngama-spores. Lezi yizifo ezibeka ingozi phezulu komhlaba kodwa zonke zifana engozini ezidalayo. Zonke ezintathu zibangelwa yisifo esisodwa esibizwa nge-Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, ifungus eliyingozi kakhulu elivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "i-mold emhlophe." Le fungus ifana naleyo ebangela i-mold emhlophe kuma-soybeans, ama-beans omisiwe, i-canola, nezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo ezivame ukuthinteka. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kwenzeka lapho i-canola ifakwe emhlabathini onama-Sclerotinia, kuholela engozini enkulu yokulimala. Kungenzeka ukuthi insimu yonke ithinteke kulolu bhubhane. Ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuhambisana nenani lezitshalo ezithintekayo kanye nesikhathi sokufika kololu bhubhane; uma inani lezitshalo ezithintekayo liphezulu futhi lolu bhubhane lungena ngokushesha, ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuzokwandisa. Ngokuvamile, isitshalo esithintekayo sinikeza kuphela u-50% wokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okuqukethwe kwe-oli kwehla uma isitshalo sikhuluma. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi ukuvela kwalolu bhubhane kukhuphula inani le-Sclerotinia emhlabathini. Lokhu kungakwenza kube nzima ukufaka i-canola ezindaweni ezine lolu bhubhane iminyaka eminingi. I-Sclerotinia yehlisa ukukhiqiza futhi ingavimba i-canola ekukhiqizeni esikhathini esizayo, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwemali okujwayelekile okuhlobene ne-canola. Ukuwa kwekhanda kanye naphakathi komqolo akuvamile ukwenzeka; kuvame ukuvela ngemuva kwemvula enkulu. Lezi zifo azivamile ukwenzeka ngezikhathi zomoya omile. Ukuwa kwekhanda kwehlisa ukuvuthwa kwembewu, inani lembewu, kanye nokuqukethwe kwe-oli. Uma kukhona ama-sclerotia embewini, kwehla isikhwama kanye nokuthengiswa kokukhiqiza. Amakhanda athintekayo avame ukuwa ensimini, futhi imbewu ilahleka emhlabathini. Futhi, uma umshini wokuvuna uthinta ikhanda, imbewu iyahlakazeka futhi ayingeni emshinini. Ukuwa kwekhanda kuyinkinga lapho kukhiqizwa imbewu emisha ezothengwa abalimi ukuze ifakwe ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba azivuthi kahle futhi spread the sclerotia disease, creating new work to clean the seeds before obtaining a certificate stating that the seeds are healthy. Azikho izithako ezikhiqizwa yi-Sclerotinia embewu ye-canola, kodwa uma kukhona ama-sclerotia amaningi, akufanele adliwe ngabantu noma izilwane. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi lolu bhubhane lungangena ezindaweni ezimpilweni futhi kudale ingozi esikhathini esizayo. Ngokuvamile, izimpawu ezivela ngokushesha ziwukubola kwemifanekiso, ukuwa kwezimpande, kanye nesitho somqolo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuwa kwezitshalo kuqala kubonakala ezindaweni ngaphambi kokuba izitshalo ziqhakaze, kodwa izitshalo ezine lolu bhubhane zingabonakala uma ziqala ukukhula. Ekuqaleni, isitshalo ngasinye sibonakala ngokuhlukile, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ziyaqhagamshelana. Lolu bhubhane luvame ukuvela ezindaweni ezithile zensimu. Ngoba izitshalo zingabola ngokushesha ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningi zokungena kololu bhubhane, izimpawu zingabonakala ngokushesha. I-lesion ethwele amanzi ikhula ethishelweni (ngaphansi) kwesitshalo. I-lesion inombala ophuzi-oluhlaza bese ibanjwa mnyama ifana nomqolo ophakathi komqolo. Uma ukuwa kuqhubeka, umqolo uba mhlophe futhi ungabonakala ungena. Ukuwa kungabonakala endaweni eyinhloko engaphezu kwezandla ezimbili ubude. Kukho ukuwa ngaphansi komqolo futhi izakhi eziqinile ezibizwa nge-sclerotia (ezilingana nosayizi ukusuka ku-1/8 kuya ku-1/4 inch ububanzi) zitholakala. Ama-sclerotia akhiqizwa yisifo futhi anikeza uphawu balolu bhubhane. Uma kuningi, i-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ikhula ethishelweni somqolo, ngakho ibizwa ngokuthi: "i-mold emhlophe." Ukuwa kwezimpande kubonakala ngokushesha ngoba imvamisa isitshalo siphuma emhlabathini kalula uma pulled. Isikhumba sezimpande sitholakala kalula, sikhombisa i-pith yangaphakathi. Ukuwa kuvame ukwenzeka emiqolweni futhi ama-sclerotia abonakala kuzo zonke izimpande. Ekugcineni, isitshalo esithintekayo sifa. Isitshalo singakhiqiza kuphela ukudla, okuhambisana nesikhathi sokungena kololu bhubhane esitshalo. Amakhanda ezitshalo ezithintekayo ancane kunezempilo. Ukuwa kwehlisa inani lembewu, ikakhulukazi ngoba imbewu ilula. Izitshalo ezithintekayo zehla kalula uma kunomoya omkhulu. Lokhu kuvame ukubonakala lapho izimbali ziqhamuka noma ngemuva kwalolo sikhathi, kubonakala ngaphakathi noma eduze komqolo. Kuqala kubonakala njengombala omnyama noma ophuzi-oluhlaza opholile. Bese umqolo ubamba ikhanda, izindawo ezithintekayo ziba namanzi futhi zibe nsoft. Umqolo uvame ukuphuka uma kukhona ukuwa, futhi konke okungaphezulu komqolo kufa. Imvamisa i-mycelium emhlophe kanye nama-sclerotia azovela ngaphandle nangaphakathi komqolo, ikakhulukazi uma kunemvula. Ekugcineni, izindawo ezithintekayo ziba mhlophe futhi ziyaqala. Ukuwa komqolo kungaqhubeka phansi ethishelweni noma kungakhuphuka phezulu kwekhanda. Ngezinye izikhathi leaf ingathola i-Sclerotinia futhi i-fungus izoqhubeka nokungena nokubola umqolo. Izimpawu zokuqala ezibonakalayo ziwukuthi: i-fungus emhlophe (mycelium) ibonakala ezitshalweni noma izindawo ezithwele amanzi ngaphansi kwekhanda. I-fungus ikhula ngokushesha kulowo mhlaba, ibola ikhanda bese i-mycelium emhlophe kanye nezindawo eziningi ze-sclerotia ezimnyama zivele. Ikhanda livame ukubonakala limhlophe, libonakala ngokushesha. Ikhanda lonke lingabola futhi indawo lapho kukhona imbewu yehla, ishiyela ikhanda elimhlophe elibolile eline-sclerotia. Lezi zikhanda ezim
ULawrence Luthango, umphakathi wezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi eGrain SA kule ndawo. UMonica Mathamba uhlala endaweni yeMthatha Mbozisa lapho engum member weMbozisa Farmers' Association. UMonica ulima indawo engama-6 hectares futhi uphumelele ekulimaleni izinkambu zakhe lapho efaka khona amanzi. UMonica uhambele izifundo zokuqeqeshwa zeGrain SA zabafuyi, kuhlanganise nokwethulwa ekukhiqizeni ujeqe kanye nezifundo ezithuthukile zokukhiqiza ujeqe. UMonica ukhuphule umkhiqizo wakhe usebenzisa ulwazi alutholile kwiGrain SA. Ujwayele ukukhiqiza ama-ton angu-3.5 nge-hectare kodwa manje ukukhiqiza ama-ton angu-4.5 nge-hectare. UMonica uthola kanjani uxhaso lokuhlwanyela? Ukuze athole uxhaso lokuqala, UMonica usebenzisa imali ephuma ephaketheni lakhe ngoba umphathi wezimali uvame ukuthola imali ebolekiwe ngemva kokuvuna. UMonica uthola kuphi izinto zokuhlwanyela? UMonica uthi uthenga izinto zokuhlwanyela zakhe zokuqala kwiMthiza Farmers Co-op nase-East Cape Co-op. Intengo ivame ukuba phezulu (zibiza kakhulu) futhi abafuyi banikezwa izeluleko mayelana nobuchwepheshe bezinto lezi. Yiziphi izinselelo ahlangabezana nazo ekulimaleni futhi uphumelelani kulolo work? Uhlangabezana nezinselelo ezidinga abakhiqizi ukuba banikeze imibiko (izeluleko) nezakhono ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe, futhi kufanele banikeze izindlela namathuba okuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo (izakhiwo). UMonica uthi akahlangabezani nalezi zinselelo ngoba sebezixazulule izinqubomgomo zabo lapho kudingeka. UMonica uthi uthini ngempumelelo yakhe eqhubekayo ekulimaleni? UMonica uthi impumelelo yakhe ivela othandweni lwakhe olukhulu lokulima kanye nomsebenzi wakhe oqhubekayo onzima. Uyakholwa ukuthi ukusebenzisa imbewu ye-hybrid (uhlobo lwezimbewu ezimbili ezihlukene), umanyolo ofanele, nokuzama ukulawula izitshalo eziphikisanayo ezinkambini ngekemikhali kuye kwamsiza ukukhuphula umkhiqizo wakhe. Kulonyaka, UMonica ufuna ukuthenga imishini eminingi, ikakhulukazi imishini yokuphonsa.
Izithombe: Ukugcina umhlabathi: Lokhu kuyinhlanganisela yezitshalo, amaqabunga, nomhlabathi othambile obekwe eduze kwezitshalo ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa (ukungcoliswa komoya), ukuvimbela ukuf freezing okweqile kwemizi, nokuvimba ukukhula kwezihlahla. Imvula ewela emhlabathini ongavikelwe ingadala ubungozi uma imvula imnandi. Kubalulekile kubalimi ukuzama ukunciphisa leli bungozi elenzeka emhlabathini uma imvula imnandi. Incwadi yethu ethi "Imvula ngoFebhuwari" ixoxa ngokuqiniswa komhlabathi, ikakhulukazi ibhekisela ezimeni zokungcoliswa komhlabathi kanye nezinhlobo zokungcoliswa. Lapha sizama ukuchaza ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zobungozi imvula engadala emhlabathini ongavikelwe kanye nosizo esingaluthola uma sigcina umhlabathi. Ingxenye yamandla emvula isetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa ama-particles omhlabathi kuyo yonke indawo. Uma umhlabathi uhlanganiswe, usabalala kahle kuyo yonke indawo futhi umhlabathi omningi ngeke ulahleke, kodwa uma umhlabathi ungenamsebenzi, umhlabathi omningi uzosheshe ulahleke. Ngakho-ke, umhlabathi opholile uzosheshe ulahleke ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kukhona ibhalansi phakathi kwamandla emvula nokungcoliswa komhlabathi. Kaziwa kahle ukuthi ukungcoliswa komhlabathi okukhulu (50% - 80%) kuqala kakhulu uma imvula imnandi ezindaweni lapho kuvamile khona ngesikhathi sehlobo. Ama-particles amaningi ahluleka emzimbeni opholile. Amanzi amaningi azogijima phansi. Amanzi azogijima ngokushesha, eshaya. Ububanzi bokungcoliswa kanye nezindlela zokuphatha lokhu kuzovimbela izinhlobo eziningi zezitshalo ukuba zifakwe kule ndawo uma ukungcoliswa komhlabathi kungaphathwa kahle. Lokhu kubhekisela kakhulu kumandla amanzi okungcolisa umhlabathi kanye nesimo somhlabathi kule ndawo - ezinye izinhlobo zomhlabathi zikhula ngokushesha, ezinye kancane. Zonke izinkundla ezilinywa ezine-erosion rate engaphezulu kuka-3% kufanele zivikelwe ngokwakha izindonga (lokhu kuyisakhiwo esakhiwe ukuphakamisa umhlabathi ukuze kudaleke udonga lapho amanzi amaningi angaphuma khona). Izitshalo ezibekwe emigqeni zingafakwa kuphela ezinkundleni ezine-erosion rate engaphansi kuka-10%. Izitshalo ezineziqhamo ezincane zingafakwa kuphela ezinkundleni ezine-erosion rate engaphansi kuka-15%. Izinkundla ezilinywa zingafakwa kuphela lapho ukungcoliswa kungaphansi kuka-30%. Ukungcoliswa okungaphezu kuka-30% kungasetshenziswa kuphela ukufaka izihlahla noma ukugcina izinsiza zemvelo ezifana nezilwane. Ukuvikelwa kwezitshalo kuyinto ebalulekile evimbela ukungcoliswa komhlabathi ngenxa yemvula. Ikakhulukazi, ukuvikelwa kwezitshalo kudala isakhiwo esifana ne-umbrella - kuvimbela imvula ngaphambi kokufika emhlabathini. Ama-particles emvula ewela ezitshalo naseqabungeni alahlekelwa amandla akhe okudala ubungozi emhlabathini ngoba lawa ma-particles aphinde ahlukaniswe futhi awanawo amandla okusabalalisa umhlabathi, amanzi ahamba ngezitshalo naseqabungeni kuze kube ukufika kancane emhlabathini. Ukugcina umhlabathi ngezitshalo kusebenza kangcono nge-cover ye-vegetative edala i-umbrella. Ukugcina kubamba ama-particles eduze nomhlabathi, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa amandla ama-particles ahamba phambili. Ngisho nasezindaweni lapho ukuvikelwa kwezitshalo kubamba zonke izindawo, ezinye izakhiwo zezitshalo ezidalayo i-umbrella zingasiza ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa komhlabathi. Ukugcina kwemvelo kungafaka izimpande zezingadi, amaqabunga, kanye nothuli olutholakala lapho kukhishwa khona ukhuni nezihlahla. Ekulimaleni, izinto ezisele emhlabeni ngemuva kokuvuna zisebenza kangcono. Umsebenzi wokuvimbela ukungcoliswa komhlabathi uxhumene ngqo nosayizi wokugcina umhlabathi. Singathi futhi okuphambene - ububanzi bokungcoliswa komhlabathi buhlobene nezindawo lapho umhlabathi ungagcinwa khona. Izinsalela ngemuva kokuvuna kufanele zishiywe emhlabathini - kodwa kungase kube nezizathu zokuzisusa, isibonelo: izifo ezingenzeka ezitshalo, i-nitrogen emhlabathini ingancipha ngenxa yokubola kwezinsalela zezithombo, kungase kudingeke ukuthi kuhlwanyelwe ngokushesha noma kungase kudingeke ukuthi kubulawwe izihlahla, njll. Ngakho-ke kukhona umkhuba ojwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika wokusebenzisa izinsalela ukuze kukhuliswe izinkomo nezinkunzi. Uma sicabanga ngezindlela zokulima, kukhona imishini esingayisebenzisa ukuze silime ngaphandle kokulimaza ukugcina umhlabathi. Uma sibhakabhaka emigqeni, ukulima nokuhlanza kungase kwenzeke kuphela emigqeni, futhi izindawo phakathi kwemigqeni zingashiywa zigcinwe. Izihlahla zingalawulwa ngamakhemikhali.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi lunikeza abalimi imibhalo enembile mayelana nokulima njalo ngenyanga ngephephandaba lethu - iPula/Imvula. Amakhophi angama-18,000 e-iPula/Imvula distributes to farmers in 7 languages every month - isiNgisi, isiBhunu, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiNorthern Sotho, isiZulu, nesiXhosa. Njalo ngenyanga, iPula/Imvula iqukethe amakhasi ayi-8 asekelwe yiMaize Trust. Kukhona namakhasi amane aphelile ngesiSesotho ngoMashi, ngoJuni, ngoSepthemba, nangoDisemba asekelwe yiWinter Cereals Trust. IIOPOT nayo inamakhasi amane aphelile kuzo zonke izilimi (ngaphandle kwesiXhosa) ngoJanuwari, ngoAprili, ngoJulayi, nangoOkthoba. Sihlala sizama ukufaka imibhalo ezosiza abalimi ngalolo suku. Le mibhalo ixoxa ngezindaba ezihlobene nezwe, ukulima, izindlela zokukhiqiza, ukumaketha, imishini, nokuphathwa kwezindawo zokulima. Sifuna futhi ukubonga abaxhasi bohlelo lwethu ngokusinika ithuba lokufaka isandla emsebenzini wethu wokuthuthukisa nokuguqula ukulima ezweni lethu.

I-Radio Umhlobo Wenene (IsiXhosa eMpuma Koloni). Kungani siba nezigaba zokufunda futhi siqala kanjani ukwakha iqembu lokufunda? Imvula izofika. Sizoyisebenzisa kanjani le mvula? Yisiphi isikhathi esifanele sokuqalisa ukusebenza? Lapho inzuzo ihlala iphansi - kuphi abalimi abangafaka khona imali ezitshalweni ezisemqoka? Njalo nsuku zonke silahlekelwa umhlaba ngenxa yokwakhiwa kwezindlu, umhlaba owenza ukudla. Amanzi - ukuze sikwazi ukulungisa umhlabathi ngendlela egcina amanzi emhlabathini, amanzi atholakala ezulwini, noma uma unethuba, nge- irrigation. Ukudla - udinga umanyolo ukuze kukhule kahle. Umanyolo - nini futhi kanjani okufanele uwusebenzisa. Sihlanganisile izici ezinhle nezimbi ezihlobene nokusebenzisa umanyolo. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umsebenzi othile ubiza malini, akufanele nje uhlawule intengo abayishoyo. Uma unemishini, kufanele uyisebenzise. Kungani umgodi ophakanyisiwe ungabukeki ngendlela efanayo nombala nemigodi eminye - iyini inkinga? Izithombe: Isithombe 1.1: Ukwehla kwemvula okuphakathi nendawo: mm/ngonyaka. Isithombe 1.2: Ukuphuma kokuphuma okuphakathi nendawo: mm/ngonyaka. Umoya uyinto ebalulekile uma sith planting ukudla. Zonke izindawo zinezinombolo ezirekhodiwe zokwehla kwemvula. Ukwehla kwemvula okuphakathi nendawo kuzokhombisa ukuthi yiziphi izitshalo ezingasetshenziswa ezindaweni ezithile lapho uk planting kwenziwa kuphela ngemvula. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona ithuba lokunisela, kufanele sithathele phezulu ezinye izimo zezulu ngoba amanzi atholakala ngokunisela. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi uma imvula ingena enanini elithile, akusho ukuthi wonke la manzi azothathwa isitshalo. Uma imvula ingena kakhulu, amanzi amaningi aphuma futhi alahleka. Uma insimu ikhululekile, ukuhamba kwamanzi kuyanda. Ngokwesimo sokuthi insimu isetshenziswa kanjani, umhlabathi ophakeme ophakeme uzovimba amanzi ekungeni. Uma kungekho zitshalo ensimini, ukuphuma kokuphuma kuyanda. Uhlobo lomhlabathi lukhombisa futhi ukuthi umhlabathi unekhono lokugcina amanzi, futhi kungase kube nezinambuzane ezizovimba amanzi ekufikeni ezitshalweni. Ukwehla kwemvula nokuphuma okuphakathi nendawo kuboniswa ezithombeni 1.1 no 1.2 (DWAF, 1986). Ngaphansi kuka-20% komhlaba lapha eNingizimu Afrika, okungama-1.05 million square kilometers, kunezimo zezulu ezithola u-750 mm/ngonyaka futhi kunezinga lokwehla kwemvula elingaphansi kuka-1,400 mm/ngonyaka - kulezi zindawo, isimo sezulu sifaneleka ek planting ukudla. Izindawo lapho inani lokwehla kwemvula lidlula u-500 mm/ngonyaka futhi linezinga lokwehla kwemvula elingaphansi kuka-1,800 mm/ngonyaka zifaka: iphakathi nendawo, izindawo ezisemazweni asentshonalanga, nezindawo eCape Town lapho kukhona imvula yehlobo. Ukunisela nokulima okujwayelekile kwenzeka kulezi zindawo, lapho kukhula khona ummbila, ushukela, nezitshalo. Ezinye izindawo zomhlaba zomile kancane kanti ezinye zomile kakhulu, kodwa imvula iyenzeka, nokho amanzi adingekayo angaphansi kuka-50%. Ngakho-ke, ukunisela kuyadingeka kulezi zindawo ukuze kugcinwe izitshalo zokudla.
Ingcebo - uyisebenzisa kanjani? Ingcebo ibhekisela kumithombo yokusebenza engasetshenziswa umbulali emsebenzini wakhe wezolimo. Ukuhlola nokusebenzisa kahle le mithombo kubalulekile uma umbulali efuna ukuphumelela ekulimaleni nasekutholeni inzuzo enhle. Umhlaba kanye nefarm - lapha singahlanganisa indlela yokusebenzisa umhlaba, inani lezomnotho lomhlaba, ubunikazi bomhlaba, nezinhlelo zokuphatha amafamu. Amanzi nomhlaba ohlwanyelwe - lapha singahlanganisa izindleko zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezintengo zamanzi, izinga lamanzi, isimo sezindawo ezimanzi, nezici zazo. Ulwazi nokuzikhandla ekukhiqizeni - lapha singahlanganisa i-genetics yezitshalo nezilwane, ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa, ubuchwepheshe bezolimo, nokukhula kokukhiqiza ukudla. Ukuphatha ukukhiqiza kwezolimo - lapha kukhona ukuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo, ukuphatha nokugcina umhlabathi, izindlela zokuphatha izifo nezilokazane, izindlela zokuphatha imithombo yokudla, izindlela zokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukuphathwa kwemvelo, ukuphatha amanzi okukhanyisa, ukuphatha ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe, nezinhlelo zokukhiqiza ezihlobene nezindlela zokugcina umhlaba. Enye ingxenye ehlobene nokuphatha le mithombo yonke yokusebenza ukumaketha - lapho kungekho emakethe yomkhiqizo, ukukhiqiza akuphumeleli. Nokho, konke okukhuluma ngenhla kubalulekile ekuphatheni ibhizinisi lezolimo eliphumelelayo; le dokhumenti izogxila kakhulu ekuphatheni izimo zomhlaba nokukhiqiza umhlabathi ngendlela enenzuzo ezokwenziwa esikhathini esizayo. Kufanele ukhumbule konke okukhuluma ngenhla uma uhlole izindlela zokukhiqiza ezizokukhombisa uhlelo lwamanje lokukhishwa kwemali nezidingo ezibalulekile. Ngakho-ke, uzokwazi ukuhlela ukuthi yimaphi imali ezongena ezindaweni ezithile zebhizinisi lakho lezolimo. Umhlaba uyisici esibalulekile sengcebo kunoma iyiphi izwe. Ukukhetha izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba kwenziwa nsuku zonke ngabaphathi befarms - bacabangela izimo zemakethe, balalele lokho uhulumeni akushoyo mayelana nemithetho yokuphatha umhlaba, futhi bahlola isimo somhlaba othile. Phakathi kwezi zindawo zomhlaba, kusekhona umhlaba osebenzisa le ndlela: imigwaqo yokuhamba, amapaki nezindawo zokuzijabulisa, izindawo zomnyango wezobunhloli, nezinye izimboni, izindlu zezimali, imigwaqo ye-farm, nezindawo zasemaphandleni. Umhlaba osele usetshenziswa kanje: izindawo ezimanzi, izindawo ezimanzi, amachibi, imifula, amadamu, izindawo eziwukuhlala, nezindawo lapho kungakhuli lutho. Zandisa ubuningi bezinhlobonhlobo. Abalimi eNingizimu Afrika bangasebenzisa le ngcebo ngezindlela ezingaxhunyiwe ngqo ekukhiqizeni ukudla; bangathola inzuzo ngokukhokhisa imali uma abantu befuna ukuhamba, ukuhamba, noma ukubuka izinyoni. Ingxenye yengcebo ethathwe emhlabeni iyahluka ngokuya ngokuqina komhlabathi kanye nendawo yomhlaba. Umhlaba wezolimo onokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi ungachazwa kanje: umhlaba lapho izimo zomhlaba zemvelo zihlangana nezici zamakhemikhali ezikhona zokukhiqiza ukudla, izitshalo, kanye ne-oyela. Umhlaba onjalo kufanele ube khona lapho kukhona umhlabathi onokukhiqiza, lapho isikhathi esidingekayo sokukhula kwezitshalo sikhona, futhi lapho kunamanzi anele (amanzi). Lokhu kubalulekile ekukhiqizeni ukudla uma umhlaba uphathwa ngendlela efanele yezolimo, futhi uma imithombo yamanzi iphethwe kahle futhi umhlaba wemvelo ugcinwa ngendlela efanele. Ungangenisa amanzi nomoya. Awuvikelwe ekukhukhulekeni ngamanzi. Izinhlobo zezithako ezingahlwanyelwa emhlabeni wezolimo omuhle zifaka: u-mazey, u-wheat, u-barley, u-oats, u-sorghum, u-canola, u-soybeans, u-tobacco, imifino, izimbali, u-cotton, nezinsiza zezilwane ezifana nezinkomo, izinkomo zokukhiqiza ubisi, izimvu, izinkukhu, nezilwane zasendle. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zokukhiqiza konke lokhu zisetshenziswa abalimi emhlabeni jikelele. Ukushintsha izindlela zokusebenzisa umhlaba kungathinta izimo zezulu ekuphumeleleni kokukhiqiza ukudla, nokunye. Ngezinye izikhathi, ukwehla kwezimo zemvelo ezifana nokuguguleka komhlabathi, izinga lamanzi, nezindawo zokuhlala zezilwane zasendle akuthathwa kakhulu ngoba abalimi bagxila ku-inzuzo kuqala, ngaphandle kokucabangela ukusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo komhlaba. Ukusebenzisa umhlaba kungasiza umuntu ngokushesha kodwa kungase kungasizi abantu emhlabeni jikelele kwesikhathi eside. Umnikazi womhlaba uzozama ukusebenzisa lowo mhlaba ngendlela ezokhiqiza inzuzo enhle.
Wena, njengomnikazi wemishini nezinsiza, kufanele wazi ukuthi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokubheka abantu abasebenza nalezi zinto. Izimo ezifana nalezi zivame ukudala ubungozi. Ukungasebenzisi imishini yokuvikela. Ukusebenza ngemishini ngesikhathi isahamba. Ukusebenzisa amathuluzi afanele: ungasebenzisi amathuluzi amancane ukwenza umsebenzi wamathuluzi amakhulu. Gcina amathuluzi esimweni esihle: qinisekisa ukuthi akhanyisiwe futhi alinganisiwe kahle futhi uwahlanzile njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-pins aqinile. Sebenzisa izing glasses zokuvikela uma usebenza. Sebenzisa umask uma kukhona uthuli oluningi. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini yokuphepha iyasebenza kahle. Vimba izingane ekungeni. Bonke abavakashi endaweni yokusebenza (isitolo) akufanele basondele endaweni lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Gcina indawo yokusebenza ikhazimula kahle. Izinto eziphukile yonke indawo zidalela ubungozi. Beka amathuluzi kude ngemva kokuwasebenzisa - awadingeki lapho umsebenzi wenziwa khona. Vala wonke amathuluzi aphethwe ngogesi. Gqoka izingubo ezifanele. Izingubo ezikhululekile zingabamba emishinini. Qinisa umsebenzi wakho: sebenzisa ama-clamps nezinsiza zamathuluzi owasebenzisayo. Kungcono ukubamba ngezandla zakho ngoba manje uzokwazi ukusebenzisa bobabili izandla uma usebenza. Ungazami ukwenza amathuluzi akho enze imisebenzi emikhulu kakhulu. Ungazami ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Qinisekisa ukuthi ume ngokuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Donsa i-lever - ungapushi. Uma kunzima ukudonsa, sebenzisa isikhumba sesandla sakho ukuphusha. Amathuluzi akhanyisiwe akufanele aqondiswe emzimbeni wakho. Lokhu kungavimbela izingozi uma ithuluzi lishayisa. Xhuma yonke imishini ephethwe ngogesi emhlabeni (umhlaba). Sebenzisa ipulaki enezinhlangothi ezintathu kuphela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukukhanya okwanele nokuhlinzekwa komoya endaweni yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-bench akhazimulayo futhi ukuthi umoya ongcolile uqhubeka uphume esitolo. Ngokufanayo, gcina ithuluzi lokwelapha elibalulekile liseduze. Bhekisisa noma yiziphi izingozi ezincane ngokushesha ukuze uvimbele ingozi enkulu ekwenzekeni.
Yini isimo (mhlawumbe singathi)! Ngesikhathi sikhula njengabantwana, sifundiswe ukuthi akufanele sikhombe izinkukhu ngaphambi kokuba amaqanda aphume. Nokho, uma usuphumelele, uyabona ukuthi lokhu kuyinto oyitholile. Manje kufanele ucabange ukuthi uzokwenzenjani ngalokhu kuphumelelanga - uzokuthengisa ngokushesha noma uzokugcina ukuze ulinde intengo inyuke (noma yehlise uma ungathokozile). Lokhu kungenzeka uma ungenayo inkontileka yokumaketha - uma unayo, kufanele ulandele imigomo yayo. Yiziphi izinto okufanele ngicabangele uma ngifuna ukuqoqa ukuhweba kwami? Ngabe nginendawo efanele epulazini yokuphatha, ukuhlanza, nokugcina lezi z food? Ngabe kufanele ngithumele umkhiqizo ezindaweni zokulima ukuze ngiwuhlinzeke kumninimandla wesilo ongumuntu siqu, mhlawumbe kumfarmela omunye, noma emakethe noma kumunye umuntu osebenzisa ukudla ezindaweni zokulima? Uma ummbila kufanele ubekwe epulazini noma endaweni lapho kukhona isilo somuntu osebenza ngokwakhe, kuzobiza malini ithani elilodwa? Qonda ukuthi izindleko zokuhlanganisa ummbila endaweni ethile ngeke zedlule izindleko zezintela nezinye izindleko ezihlobene nokubeka ukuhweba kwakho. Funda kahle lokho okukhuluma kule nkontileka, ngesiNgisi baphawula "ukuphrinta okuncane" okuvame ukutholakala ekupheleni kwale nkontileka - qaphela ukuthi bangakukhokhisa? Yisiphi isithembiso esinakho mayelana nentengo yokudla ehla futhi enyuka? Njalo ngesonto kufanele ushintshe amasu akho okuthengisa ngokwezimo zezulu nezimakethe, kodwa kufanele ukhulume nomphathi wakho wezimali noma nesiphathimandla esabelana ngemininingwane endaweni yakho. Yini edala intengo yommbila eNingizimu Afrika yehlise futhi inyuke? Uma kukhona ukukhiqizwa okukhulu kakhulu kommbila eNingizimu Afrika (njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2004 nango-2005), intengo yommbila ye-Safex ivame ukuthengiswa ngentengo eduze kwentengo yommbila ethengiswa phesheya. Uma kubonakala ukuthi ummbila kuzodingeka ukuthi ulethelwe kwabanye lapha eNingizimu Afrika (njengoba kwenzeka ngo-2006 nango-2007), intengo yommbila ye-Safex ivame ukuthengiswa ngentengo eduze kwentengo ekhokhelwa ukuthenga ummbila phesheya. Intengo yommbila emhlabeni jikelele ithonywa yizinto ezinkulu lapho intengo yommbila ethengiswa phesheya noma ummbila othengwe phesheya ikalwa. Intengo yommbila emhlabeni jikelele iyahluka futhi iyashintsha nsuku zonke nangasikhathi. Ukushintsha kwentengo yomhlaba jikelele kuzoshintsha nentengo yommbila othengwe phesheya. Intengo yommbila ethengwe e-USA nase-Argentina ivame ukukhombisa ukuthi intengo yommbila eNingizimu Afrika izoba kuphi. Izindleko ezihlobene nentengo yokungenisa ukudla noma ukuyithumela phesheya (njengentengo yokuthenga ummbila emakethe yomhlaba - noma ezindaweni ezithile) ikalwa ngokumelene nezindleko zokuthutha ukudla ngomkhumbi kanye ne-inshurensi ehambisana nalokhu. Konke lokhu kuphinde kubizwe futhi kukhokhisiwe ngama-dollar aseMelika. Ukuhlela zonke lezi zindleko ne-Rand yaseNingizimu Afrika kufanele kuhambisane nenani lokushintshanisa le-Rand/ama-dollar aseMelika. Ukushintsha nsuku zonke kwenani lokushintshanisa le-Rand/ama-dollar aseMelika kuzoshintsha nentengo yommbila ethengiswa kanye nommbila othengwe phesheya. Ummbila waseNingizimu Afrika uthengiswa nsuku zonke emakethe yokudla eyakhiqizwa ezolimo eNingizimu Afrika e-Safex, engxenye yeJohannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE). I-Safex ingachazwa njengohlelo lwe-elektroniki oluphatha futhi luhlola abathengi (njengoba abathengi abamila ummbila ukwenza ufulawa) kanye nalabo abathengisa (njengoba abakhiqizi bezolimo). Ngakho-ke, abathengi nabathengisi bangabeka intengo noma inani lemali yommbila nganoma yisiphi isikhathi (ngokuvamile njalo ngenyanga). Ukuhweba kwe-Safex (ukuthenga nokuthengisa imikhiqizo yezolimo) kuqhubeka kusukela ngo-09:00 kuya ku-12:00 ngosuku olusebenzayo. E-Randfontein (Gauteng), uzothola uphawu olukhombisa intengo yommbila. Lokhu kusho ukuthi intengo yommbila ye-Safex iyatholakala uma ummbila ufika e-Randfontein. Uma ummbila unikezwa kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwe-Randfontein, intengo kufanele ilungiswe ngokuya ngezindleko zokuthutha nezinye. Uma ungakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngombila e-Randfontein, kufanele ucabangele izindleko ezizovela uma uhlinzeka ngombila wakho kwezinye izindawo (izicelo) ezibhaliswe ku-Safex. Kukho izimali ezizokhokhiswa. Okokuqala, kukhona izindleko zokuthutha (kusuka endaweni yakho kuya kule silo e-Randfontein). Lezi zindleko zibhaliwe kahle emqulwini we-Safex ophumelele unyaka nonyaka. Uma ummbila uhlinzekwa endaweni enesilo somnotho (umninimandla wesilo), kuzodingeka ukhokhe imali yokuphatha bese ubeka ummbila wakho. Ngokuvamile, kuzoba nezindleko ezizokhokhiswa yinkampani ethengisa ummbila wakho uma ungawuthengisi ukuhweba kwakho ngokushesha (isibonelo: ibhizinisi lezolimo lizokuthengisela ummbila wakho futhi uzokhokha ngalokhu). Uma ummbila ungathengiswa ngokushesha ngemva kokuhlinzekwa (mhlawumbe kufanele ugcinwe isikhathi esithile), kuzoba nezindleko ezengeziwe zokugcina lowo mbila. Kubalulekile kumfarmela ukuqonda ukuthi inani lemali abazokwazi ukuyithola kulowo silo othile lingase libe phansi kunezinga abangathola khona kwezinye izindawo. Ungazama futhi ukukhuluma ngqo nabaphathi bemifino, kanye nezinye izinkampani ezisebenza ngemikhiqizo yezolimo nabanye abathengi nabathengisi bezinhlamvu zokudla ukuze uthole intengo engcono. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ungumnikazi kuphela walokhu kuphumelelanga - kukhona okwakho ukukuthengisa ngokuthanda kwakho - uma ungathandi intengo yokuthengisa, zama ukuthola intengo engcono. Intengo ekhombiswa yi-Safex iyona okufanele uzame ukuyithola.

Ithrekhi 3: Abafundi ababe khona ezifundweni esikhathini sokuqala. Ithrekhi 4: Izikole esazivakashele ezindaweni ezithile esikhathini sokuqala sika-2011. Ngonyaka ka-2010, iGrain SA yaqaliswa uhlelo ezikoleni olususelwa kuMaize Trust. Uhlelo lwalunomthelela omuhle. Ngesicelo sethu kuMaize Trust sokuxhaswa ngonyaka ka-2010/2011, saphinde sacela uxhaso ukuze kusekelwe impumelelo yalolu hlelo lwesikole. IMaize Trust ivumile ngokubekezela ukuhlinzeka ngama-R360,000 ukuze kudalwe lezi zinguqulo ezintathu ze-DVD. Samukela isithembiso sabo saqala ukukhetha abantu ukuze bakhiqize lezi zinguqulo ze-DVD. Ekugcineni, sakhetha uMartie Williamse ophuma kuNoline Productions ukwenza i-DVD yokuqala noPW van Wyk ophuma ku-AgriTV ukwenza i-DVD yesibili. Othisha bakhethwe ezindaweni eziyishumi: Free State, North West, North West/Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape, Northern Cape, kanye neMpumalanga. Esikhathini sokuqala, savakashela ezikoleni eziyi-180 futhi sakhombisa abafundi lezi zinguqulo ze-DVD. I-DVD yakhelwe ngendlela evumela uthisha ukuthi ayime ezindaweni ezintathu ukuze uthisha akwazi ukuxoxa ngalokho okukhonjiswe nabafundi. Ngemuva kokubuka i-DVD yokuqala, isikole sizothola iphosta yokukhumbuza abafundi lokho i-DVD abafundiswe khona - Ukudla, Ukudla Okunempilo, Impilo. Sabuza abanye abafundi kulezi zikole esahamba kuzo ukuthi lokho esizame ukukufundisa kubasizile yini. Ngikholelwa ukuthi kubalulekile ukutshala izitshalo futhi kakhulu ukuze sikwazi ukuphila kahle. Ngifundile futhi ukuthi ukuhweba akukhona nje umsebenzi wezolimo; thina abasha sidinga ukwazi okuningi okuhlobene nezolimo ukuze sikwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla kwabanye. Kusukela namuhla, ngizoqala ukutshala imifino ngoba ngifundile futhi ngingasiza futhi. Ngithumele izibusiso zami kuGrain SA. Ngabe uNkulunkulu ube nathi ukuze sibe nezinye izikhathi." "Sifunde izinto eziningi esazingazazi, ezifana: u-90% wezokudla emhlabeni ukhiqizwa abalimi. Sidinga abalimi abane ukwenza ibhaga elilodwa. Abanye lapha esikoleni sethu babengazi ukuthi izingubo zenziwa ngensimbi noma ngempahla yezilwane; babengazi ukuthi ukukhulisa izilwane (izinkomo) kuyindlela yokufunda. Kukho ukuxhumana okuqinile phakathi kwabalamile abakhiqiza ukudla ngokukhulisa izilwane nokutshala izitshalo. Isithombe 1: Izimpawu zezitshalo ezithintekayo zikhombisa ukuhamba kwalesi sifo. Bheka i-sclerotia emnyama kanye ne-mycelium emhlophe. Isitshalo esinempilo singase sibe eceleni. Isithombe 2: I-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ethishelwe esitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 3: I-sclerotia ngaphakathi kwesikhumba sesitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 4: Ukuhlakazeka ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Isithombe 5: Ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda - lokhu kubonakala ngaphambi kokuthi ikhanda lehlise. Isithombe 6: Ukuhamba kwesifo - ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda kanye naphakathi kwesigaba. I-sclerotia ibuyiselwa emhlabathini ngesikhathi sokuvuna nasekulimeni. Kulesi sithombe, sizogxila kakhulu esifweni esibalulekile esithinta i-canola - Izifo ze-Sclerotinia. Kukhona izifo ezintathu, ukuwa (ukuwohloka) okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia, ukuwohloka ngaphakathi kwesigaba, nokuhlakazeka kwekhanda. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kubangelwa i-fungus eqhubeka emhlabathini ebizwa nge-sclerotia, engena ezimpandeni ze-canola. Lokhu kuwa kuhlukile ngoba kuqala ezimpandeni. I-Sclerotinia ewohlokayo ikhanda nesigaba ihamba emoyeni ngezimpande. Lezi zifo zikhombisa ingozi phezulu komhlaba kodwa zonke zifana engozini ezidalayo. Zonke ezintathu zibangelwa yisitho esisodwa esibizwa nge-Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, i-fungus eyingozi kakhulu edume ngokuthi "i-mold emhlophe." Le fungus ifana naleyo edala i-mold emhlophe kuma-soybeans, ama-beans omisiwe, i-canola, nezinye izinhlobo zezithombo ezivame ukuthinteka. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kwenzeka lapho i-canola ifakwe emhlabathini one-Sclerotinia, okuholela engozini enkulu yokulimala. Kungenzeka ukuthi insimu yonke ithinteke yilesi sifo. Ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuhlobene nenani lezitshalo ezithintekayo kanye nesikhathi sokufika kwesifo; uma inani lezitshalo ezithintekayo liphakathi, futhi isifo singena ngokushesha, ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuzokhuphuka. Ngokuvamile, isitshalo esithintekayo sinikeza kuphela u-50% wokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okuqukethwe kwe-oyela kuyancipha uma isitshalo sinesifo. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi ukuvela kwalesi sifo kukhuphula inani le-Sclerotinia emhlabathini. Lokhu kungakwenza kube nzima ukufaka i-canola emasimini analesi sifo iminyaka eminingi. I-Sclerotinia yehlisa ukukhiqiza futhi ingavimbela i-canola ekukhiqizeni esikhathini esizayo, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwezinzuzo okujwayelekile okuhlotshaniswa ne-canola. Ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda kanye naphakathi kwesigaba akuvamile ukwenzeka; kuvame ukuvela ngemuva kwemvula enkulu. Lezi zifo azivamile ukwenzeka ezikhathini ezomile. Ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda kwehlisa ukuvuthwa kwezimpande, inani lezimpande, kanye nokuqukethwe kwe-oyela. Uma kune-sclerotia ezimpandeni, kwehla isikhala kanye nemakethe yokukhiqiza. Amakhanda athintekayo avame ukuwa ensimini, futhi izimpande zilahleka emhlabathini. Futhi, uma imishini yokuvuna ithinta ikhanda, izimpande zihlakazeka futhi azingeni emshinini. Ukuhlakazeka kwekhanda kuyinkinga lapho kukhiqizwa izimpande ezintsha ezizothengwa abalimi ukuze zifakwe ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba azivuthi kahle futhi spread the sclerotia disease, creating new work to clean the seeds before obtaining a certificate stating that the seeds are healthy. Azikho izinto eziyingozi ezikhiqizwa yi-Sclerotinia ezimpandeni ze-canola, kodwa uma kune-sclerotia eziningi, akufanele zisetshenziswe abantu noma izilwane. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi lesi sifo singangena ezimweni eziphilile futhi sidale ingozi esikhathini esizayo. Ngokuvamile, izimpawu ezivela ngokushesha ziyi-wilting kwezithombo, ukuwohloka kwezimpande, kanye nesikhumba sesigaba. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuwa kwezithombo kuqala kubonakala ezimeni ngaphambi kokuthi izithombo ziqhakaze, kodwa izithombo ezine-sifo zingase zibonakale lapho ziqala ukukhula. Ekuqaleni, isitshalo ngasinye sibonakala ngokwehlukana, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ziyaqhamuka. Lesi sifo sivame ukuvela ezindaweni ezithile zensimu. Ngoba izitshalo zingawa ngokushesha ngemuva kwezinyanga zesifo, izimpawu zingase zibonakale ngokushesha. I-lesion ethwele amanzi ikhula esikhumbeni (ngaphansi) sesitshalo. I-lesion inombala oluhlaza-ompunga bese iba mnyama ifana nesigaba esijikeleza isigaba. Uma ukuwohloka kuqhubeka, isigaba siba mncane futhi singase sibe sengathi sihlakazekile. Ukuwa kungabonakala endaweni ejolile engaphezu kwezandla ezimbili ubude. Kukhona ukuwohloka ngaphansi kwesigaba futhi izakhi eziqinile ezibizwa nge-sclerotia (ezinobukhulu obuphakathi kuka-1/8 kuya ku-1/4 inch) zitholakala. I-sclerotia ikhiqizwa yisitho futhi ibonisa leli sifo. Uma kuneziningi, i-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ikhula esikhumbeni sesigaba, ngakho ibizwa ngokuthi: "i-mold emhlophe." Ukuwohloka kwezimpande kubonakala ngokushesha ngoba imvamisa isitshalo siphuma emhlabathini kalula uma pulled. Isikhumba sezimpande siphuma kalula, sikhombisa i-pith yangaphakathi. Ukuwohloka kuvame ukwenzeka ezigabeni futhi i-sclerotia ibonakala kuzo zonke izimpande. Ekugcineni, isitshalo esithintekayo sifa. Isitshalo singakhiqiza kuphela ukudla, okuhlobene nesikhathi lapho isifo singena esitshalweni. Amakhanda ezitshalo ezithintekayo ancane kunezempilo. Ukuwa kwehlisa inani lezimpande, ikakhulukazi ngoba izimpande zikh light. Izitshalo ezithintekayo ziwela kalula uma kunomoya omkhulu. Lokhu kuvame ukubonakala lapho izimbali ziqhamuka noma ngemuva kwalokho, kubonakala ngaphakathi noma eduze kwesigaba. Kuqala kubonakala njengombala omnyama noma ophuzi obonakalisayo. Bese isigaba sithokozisa ikhanda, izindawo ezithintekayo nazo ziba namanzi futhi ziba buthaka. Isigaba sivame ukuphuka uma kukhona ukuwohloka, futhi konke okuphakeme kwesigaba kufa. Imvamisa i-mycelium emhlophe ne-sclerotia izovela ngaphandle nangaphakathi kwesigaba, ikakhulukazi uma kune mvula. Ekugcineni, izindawo ezithintekayo ziba mhlophe futhi ziqhume. Ukuwohloka kwesigaba kungaqhubeka phansi esikhumbeni noma kungakhuphuka phezulu kwekhanda. Ngezinye izikhathi, leaf ingathola i-Sclerotinia futhi i-fungus izoqhubeka nokungena nokuhlakazeka kwesigaba. Izimpawu zokuqala ezibonakalayo ziyi: i-fungus emhlophe (mycelium) ivela ezithombeni noma izindawo ezithwele amanzi ngaphansi kwekhanda. I-fungus ikhula ngokushesha kulowo mhlaba, ihlukanisa ikhanda bese i-mycelium emhlophe ne-sclerotia eziningi zivele. Ikhanda livame ukuvela mhlophe, libonakala ngokushesha. Ikhanda lonke lingahlakazeka futhi indawo lapho kukhona izimpande iyawa, ishiyela ikhanda elihlala mhlophe eline-scler
Isikhathi sokuvuna siseduze futhi kusekhona izinkambu eziningi ezigcwele izihlahla. Izingxoxo zethu zihlala zibuyela kulokhu: izihlahla ziyisitha esikhulu sokukhiqiza ukudla. Into ebaluleke kakhulu uma kukhiqizwa izitshalo zokudla ukuphatha nokususa izihlahla. Uma kukhona izihlahla, umkhiqizo uzobhekana nezinkinga ngezindlela eziningi, ikakhulukazi ukulahlekelwa okukhulu komkhiqizo futhi imbewu izonakala. Emhlabeni jikelele, kunokuntuleka kwembewu yokudla, ngakho asikwazi ukuvumelana nokuthi imbewu iphenywe ngoba ilimele ngenxa yezinhlamvu zezihlahla. Izinhlamvu zommbila azivunyelwe ukuba zibe phakathi kwemikhiqizo ngoba zineziphuzo ezilimazayo futhi ummbila awudliwa abantu noma izilwane. Mayelana nomthetho ophatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezitshalo kanye nokuhlanzeka kwezinhlamvu, kunezinhlobo zezihlahla ezingavunyelwe neze phakathi kwemikhiqizo. Ngokwesibonelo, ngokwezimiso zomthetho, akufanele kube khona imbewu eyodwa ye-thorn apple (datura). IDatura inenhlanzeko engalimaza umuntu kakhulu. Izinto ezibalulekile esizifundayo uma sibheka ukuphathwa kwezihlahla ukususa umonakalo wokuqala emibewwini. Ummbila ongenazo izihlahla futhi ongonakele uwumphumela wokuphatha kahle izitshalo zakho njalo, hhayi ukuzama lapha nalapho ukuwabulala izihlahla. Uma ukususa okusheshayo kwezihlahla ngesikhathi sokutshala kungasebenzi kahle, izihlahla kufanele zikhishwe emkhakheni ngaphambi kokuvuna. Uma izihlahla ezinkulu zisuswa emkhakheni ngemuva kokuba nezihloko, kuzoba ngcono ukuwasha lezo zihlahla ukuze kuvinjelwe ekuphakamiseni kwazo futhi ngonyaka ozayo. Khumbula, umkhiqizo omuhle ubonisa ukuthi kukhona izimbewu zommbila eziningi - izimbewu eziningi ezihlanzekile!
I-soybean - isitshalo esiyisimanga kanye nokudla okungajwayelekile! Kukho ingxoxo eningi mayelana ne-soybeans kanye nokubaluleka kwazo ekushintshaneni kwezitshalo kanye nommbila. Njengokunye ukudla okukhuliswa ekhaya, ubudlelwano be-soybeans besimanjemanje nezinye izinhlobo ezikhula ngokwemvelo abunakulandwa ngempela. Njengengxenye yeGrain SA Farmer Development Program, sithemba ukusungula uhlelo ne-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust ukuze sikhuthaze abalimi abasha ukuba bakhulise i-soybeans - njengokudla okuthengiswayo, futhi njengomthombo walolu hlobo lwepothini oluyinhloko kuleli. I-soybeans ihluka ekukhuleni nasekuziphatheni. Ukuphakama kwesitshalo kungafinyelela phansi kuka-20cm kuya ku-2 meters. Amakhanda, imithambo yesitshalo, nezinhlamvu zifakwe ngama-ukhuni amancane abomvu noma aphezulu. Izinhlamvu zinezinhlamvu ezintathu kuya kwezine, futhi lezi zinhlamvu zingaba ubude obuyi-6 kuya ku-15 centimeters, ngobubanzi obuyi-2 kuya ku-7 centimeters. Izinhlamvu ziwela phansi ngaphambi kokuthi imbewu iphume. Izimbali ezingabonakali, ezizithola zikhula ezindaweni zezinhlamvu futhi zingaba mhlophe, pinki, noma purple. Imikhiqizo yayo iyikhanda elinokhuni elikhula ezixubeni ezingu-3 kuya ku-5, ngalinye ikhanda liphakathi kuka-3 kuya ku-8 centimeters ubude futhi ngokuvamile liqukethe imbewu engu-2 kuya ku-4 (ngokwejwayelekile), imbewu ibalelwa ku-5 kuya ku-11 millimeters ububanzi. I-soybeans iza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene nosayizi bamakhanda, kuhlanganise nemibala emnyama, ebomvu, eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ophuzi, oluhlaza, nolumhlophe. Ikhanda le-soybean elithuthukile lihlala lihlala, alithathi amanzi, futhi livikela imbewu ekonakaleni okungenzeka. Uma ikhanda elihlanganisa imbewu liqhekeka, imbewu ngeke ikwazi ukuvuthwa. Okuqukethwe kwe-oyili kanye neprotein kubalwa cishe ku-60% wesisindo se-soybeans ezomile uma kuhlanganiswe, lapho i-protein ibamba u-40% ne-oyili u-20%. I-35% esele iyisitashi (ama-carbohydrates) kanye no-5% uyashisa. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-soybeans kuqukethe cishe u-8% wembewu ezihlanganisiwe, u-90% wezihlanu, no-2% wemithambo yezinhlamvu. Ukuze kudliwe ngabantu, i-soybeans kumele iphakwe emlilweni "omisiwe" ukuze ibhubhise ama-trypsin inhibitors (okuyizithiyo ze-serine protease). I-soybeans ezingashisiwe, kuhlanganise naleyo engakathuthukiswa ngokugcwele, iyingozi kubantu, izinkukhu, izinkomo, futhi ngempela kuyo yonke imfuyo enesisu esisodwa. Abathengisi abaningi bacabanga ukuthi i-soybeans iyinsiza ephelele yeprotein. I-protein ephelele iyona equkethe ama-amino acids abalulekile okumele atholakale emkhakheni wokudla kwabantu ngoba umzimba womuntu awukwazi ukuhlela lezi amino acids. Ngenxa yalokho, i-soy iyinsiza enhle yeprotein, phakathi kwezinhlobo eziningi zokudla, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangadli inyama kodwa badla kuphela imifino noma labo abafuna ukunciphisa ukudla kwabo kwenyama. I-proteins ye-soy empeleni ifana nembewu yezinye izitshalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-soybeans ingakhiqiza okungenani kabili i-protein ngaphezu kwe-hectare uma kuqhathaniswa nanoma iyiphi enye imifino noma isitshalo sezitshalo. Ngaphansi kwe-hectare, lezi protein zingaba phezulu kakhulu, zibe izikhathi eziyisihlanu kuya kwezishiyagalombili ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze zifuywe izilwane, futhi i-protein ngaphezulu kwe-hectare ingaba izikhathi eziyishumi nanhlanu phezulu ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze kukhiqizwe inyama. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-soy kunganciphisa nengozi yokuba ne-cancer ye-colon. I-soybeans iyisitshalo esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, inikeza i-oyili ne-protein. E-United States, ivolumu yalezi zitshalo iphathwa ngesisombululo esisebenzisa i-hexane, kanti i-soybean meal engafakiwe (i-50% protein) inikeza ithuba lokusetshenziswa ekukhuliseni izilwane (isb., izinkukhu, izinkomo, nezinkomo) ezingeni elikhulu lokuhweba. Ingxenye encane yalolu hlobo lokudla idliwa ngabantu. Imikhiqizo ye-soybeans itholakala ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokudla eziphathelene. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, i-soybeans yayibalulekile eNyakatho Melika naseYurophu, ikakhulukazi njengomthombo wokudla ongashintsha emithonjeni yeprotein futhi njengomthombo we-oyili ongadliwayo. I-soybeans yatholwa njengokudla ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili yiMnyango Wezolimo wase-United States. Iphumelela ezindaweni ezishisayo futhi ikhuliswa kahle ezishisayo phakathi kuka-20 kuya ku-30 °C; izinga lokushisa elingaphansi kuka-20 °C noma eliphezulu kuka-40 °C linciphisa kakhulu ukukhula kwayo. Ingakha ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene zomhlabathi, kodwa iphumelela kakhulu emhlabathini ongena i-organic matter. I-soybeans, njengama-legumes amaningi, isebenzisa i-nitrogen ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuhlanganyela ne-bacteria i-Bradyrhizobium japonicum. Nokho, ukuze kutholakale imiphumela engcono, i-strain efanele ye-bacteria kumele ixutshwe nembewu ye-soybeans (noma iyiphi i-legume) ngaphambi kokutshala. Izinhlobo zesitshalo zesimanjemanje ngokuvamile zifinyelela ukuphakama okungama-1 meter futhi zithatha izinsuku eziyi-80 kuya kweziyi-120 ukuze zikhule zisuka ekutshalisweni ziye ekuthunjweni. I-soybeans iyinsizwa eMpumalanga Asia, kodwa kuphela u-45% wemikhiqizo ye-soybeans ivela lapho. I-U.S. ikhiqize ama-tonu angama-75 million e-soybeans ngonyaka ka-2000, kanti ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu yathunyelwa phesheya. Abakhiqizi abahamba phambili baphinde bafake iBrazil, iArgentina, iParaguay, iChina, kanye ne-India. Izitshalo ze-soybeans zithinteka kalula yizifo ezithile ze-fungal, izifo ezibuhlungu, izifo ze-viral, nezilokazane ezidla izicubu zesitshalo. I-soybeans yayiyisitshalo esibalulekile eMpumalanga Asia ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bakwazi ukubhala. Ihlala iyisitshalo esihamba phambili eChina, eJapan, naseKorea. Ngaphambi kokuphuma kwemikhiqizo ephathwayo efana ne-soy sauce, tempeh, natto, kanye ne-miso, i-soy yayibhekwa njengesitshalo esingcwele ekushintshaneni kwayo nezinye izitshalo njengendlela yokubuyisela i-nitrogen. Izitshalo zazikhuliswa phansi ukuze kuvule indawo yezitshalo ezinikeza ukudla kwabantu. I-soy yethulwe eYurophu ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-18 futhi e-United States ngo-1765, lapho yaqala khona ukukhiqizwa njengezinkomo zokudla. I-soybeans azizange zibe zibalulekile e-Asia kuze kube ngu-1910. E-America, i-soy yayibhekwa njengomkhiqizo wezohwebo kuphela kodwa yaqala ukusetshenziswa njengokudla ngama-1920s. I-soy yafika e-Afrika ivela eChina cishe ngasekupheleni kwekhulu le-19 futhi manje isiyins
Esihlokweni mayelana nokulahla ngokuphepha izinsalela ze-pesticide ku-February 2008 Pula-Imvula, enye yezihloko ezingaxoxwa ngayo yisimo se-boom sprayer. Kungase kubonakale ukuthi lokhu kuyinkinga ebanzi - ngakho-ke lesi sihloko sikhona. Ukugcinwa kahle kanye nezindlela zokugcina akukhona okwanele ukuhamba phambili njengokulungiselela ngaphambi kwesizini yonyaka ozayo kuphela, kodwa kukhulisa ukusebenza kwe-sprayer njengoba kwengeza iminyaka empilweni yayo yokukhiqiza. Ukuba khona kwezinto eziningi eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kungalimaza ezinye izindawo ze-sprayer, uphahla, kanye nezixhumi zikagesi. Izinsalela zalezi zimpahla zingaba yingozi kunoma ubani osebenza nemishini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga elincane lezinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ezihlala ku-sprayer lingalimaza izitshalo njengoba zidluliselwa esizini yokuphalela esilandelayo. Ukuvikela ukuphepha kwakho siqu kanye nokuphepha komndeni wakho, abasebenzi, nezitshalo kubalulekile ukuhlanza kahle nokukhipha noma yikuphi ukungcoliswa ku-sprayer yakho ngesikhathi, phakathi kwezitshalo futhi ngaphambi kokuyigcina ngezikhathi zonyaka. Khumbula ukuthi izinsalela zamakhemikhali asetshenziswa kwezolimo ziyiingozi ezitshalweni nakuma- / izilwane, ngakho-ke zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqondwe ubungozi obuhambisana nalokhu ukuze isimo sibe phansi kokuphathwa kahle ngangokunokwenzeka. Inqubo ephelele yokugcinwa nokuhlanzwa ihlanganisa izinyathelo ezinhlanu. Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuhlanza i-sprayer yakho, qiniseka ukuthi ubheka ilebula lezi zinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ozisebenzisile. Iphakamisa indlela efanele yokulahla umkhiqizo osele. Iphinde inikeze imiyalelo ethile yokuhlanza engase ibe yadingeka. Iphakamisa ngemikhiqizo yokunciphisa ukungcoliswa. Iphinde ikunikeze amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana Nezokuphepha Zomuntu (PPE) okufanele uzigqoke ukuze uhlanze kahle i-sprayer yakho. Inhloso yokuhlanza ngamanzi ukuhoxisa noma yikuphi umkhiqizo osele noma izinqwaba ezinkulu ezingase zibe ku-sprayer. Imishini yokuhlanza i-sprayer ifaka ukujikeleza kwamanzi ngaphakathi kohlelo ngemva kokugcwalisa ngamanzi njengoba kukhombisa ilebula lezi zinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ozisebenzisile (ngamanye amazwi, ukuhoxisa ngamanzi / inhlanganisela yokuhlanza okuncishisiwe, manje ebizwa ngokuthi yi-rinsate, endaweni ephephile). Ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi uhlanza ne-tank kanye nezintambo nezizinda, gcwalisa amanzi ahlanzekile kuze kube uhhafu wetanki ukuze ugijime i-tractor kancane emgwaqweni ophakathi kwezimboni - ukujikeleza kuzohambisa amanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kuphonsa umphakathi wetanki wonke. Izinyathelo ezimbalwa zokuhlanza ngamanzi amancane (ukuze kufike ku-10% yendawo ye-tank ye-sprayer) kungcono kunokugcwalisa i-tank ye-sprayer ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Kunconywa ukuphinda inqubo yokuhlanza kathathu okungenani. Khetha indawo lapho i-rinsate ingakwazi ukungcolisa imithombo yamanzi, ukugeleza, izitshalo, noma ezinye izitshalo futhi lapho izingcezu ezincane zingakwazi ukuhlanganiswa, njengoba lokhu kungaba yingozi kubantu, izilwane, kanye nemvelo. Ungaphonsa emathafeni noma emgwaqweni wefarm. Qiniseka ukuthi ukhipha amanzi ku-tank ye-sprayer ngokuhambisana nelebula lezi zinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni. Ungavuli nje ama-valve njengoba lokhu kuzophonsa emhlabeni. Faka ezinye izizinda ezikwazi ukubamba okuningi ukuze udale indlela esheshayo futhi evumelekile yokulahla i-rinsate ku-sprayer. Izingxenye zangaphandle ze-sprayer nazo kufanele zihlanzwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lapho uhoxisa i-sprayer ngamanzi, ungakhethi amanzi angabamba abantwana, izilwane, izinkomo, noma izilwane zasendle. Lahla i-rinsate yezi zinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ngokuhambisana nemihlahlandlela kulebula, ufake i-rinsate endaweni lapho imikhiqizo izosetshenziswa khona ngokuhambisana nenhloso yayo (futhi, emathafeni lapho ikhemikhali iphonsiwe kubhekwa njengendawo efanele). Phinda inqubo yokukhupha ngaphakathi ngemuva kokukhipha ukungcoliswa nokuhlanza kabusha i-sprayer. Qiniseka ukuthi ukhipha noma yiziphi izitanki zamanzi ezisetshenziswe ekuhlanzeni ngaphambi kokugcinwa ukuze uvimbele ukulimala okubangelwa ukuhamba kwamanzi ngaphakathi. Ngemuva kokuhlanza kokugcina ngamanzi, ungabheka i-sprayer yakho futhi wenze izilungiselelo noma ukulungisa okudingekayo. Nakuba i-sprayer ihlanzekile, hlale ugqoke izinto zakho zokuvikela. Kukhona izinsalela ezithile ezingase zihlale ku-sprayer. Isakhiwo se-boom, esithola noma yiziphi izimbobo, kufanele silungiswe. Njengoba i-sprayer manje ihlanzekile, ungase ufise ukususa izingxenye ezilimele ngesikhathi sokugcina. Susa ama-filters futhi uhlanze ngesandla ngamanzi anomuthi (khumbula ukugqoka izigqoko ezivikelayo ezivumelana namakhemikhali), hlanza ngamanzi futhi mhlawumbe ugcine noma ubuyisele ku-sprayer. Bheka ngokuqhubekayo izizinda, ama-cap ezizinda, kanye nama-valve. Izinsalela zamakhemikhali zingaba khona kulezi zindawo futhi zibe nzima ebusika, ngaleyo ndlela zinciphisa ukusebenza kwe-sprayer esizini elandelayo. Susa ama-nozzle tips, ama-screens, bheka ama-valve, ama-cap, kanye nezizinda ze-nozzle ukuze ubone noma yiziphi izimpawu zokugqokwa. Qaphela ukufaka kabusha ama-plugs. Hlanza futhi uhlole izizinda, ama-cap ezizinda, futhi uhlole ama-valve. Gcina ezitsheni ezibhalwe phansi. Gcina ama-valve ekamelweni lokushisa ebusika ukuze uvimbele ukulimala okungase kubangelwe yizinga lokushisa elibandayo. Susa wonke ama-pressure gauges futhi ufake ama-cap ezindaweni ezivulekile ze-sprayer. Gcina ama-gauges lapho engakwazi ukubonakaliswa ekubandeni noma ukulimala. Ekugcineni, jikeleza i-antifreeze ku-sprayer, kuhlanganise ne-boom, ama-valve, imikhawulo, ama-pressure gauges, kanye nemigudu yokubuyisela. Vumela i-antifreeze ijikeleze phakathi kwezintambo ze-boom. Lokhu kuzovala ngaphakathi kwezintambo ukuvimbela ukuvuthwa nokuphuka. Ukufaka ama-caps kuzo zonke izizinda ze-boom kuzosisiza ukuvimbela i-antifreeze ohlelweni, kodwa kungase kudingeke ukuvula enye noma ngaphezulu kwezizinda ukuze ivumele i-antifreeze ijikeleze ngokuphelele phakathi kwe-boom. Vala lezi zizinda uma i-antifreeze isigcwalise ngokuphelele uhlelo. Lapho kugxilwa esigabeni sokugcina, i-antifreeze kufanele ikhiphe noma yikuphi amanzi asele angase abe ohlelweni futhi ivale zonke izingxenye ze-sprayer. Vumela i-antifreeze ihlale kupompo nasezivalvini ukuze uvimbele ukugqwala nokulimala okungase kubangelwe umswakama ovalwe ohlelweni. Njengoba ezinye zikhishwa ngaphambi kokugcina, ukufaka ama-valve okukhuphuka ngakolunye uhlangothi lwepompo kungasiza le nqubo. I-antifreeze eyenzelwe izimoto zokuzijabulisa (RVs) ifanele ukusetshenziswa ezimotweni zokuphalela ezol
Ukusiza nokufundisa abalimi ngabanye kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kubiza imali eningi. Kungcono ukuhlanganisa abalimi ndawonye, kwakha i-cooperative enamalungu anemibandela efanayo, bese bekwazi ukuthola usizo ngokuqhubekayo emihlanganweni evamile. Le phrojekthi iqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wayo - ikhuluma ngokuqeqesha, ulwazi, nolwazi kubo bonke abalimi ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwesikhathi, sibone ukuthi inani lamalungu kuma-cooperatives okufunda lehle, ngoba kuphela abalimi abaqotho abafuna ukukhula kwezomnotho bahlala. Lokhu kubonakala ikakhulukazi eNyakatho Ntshonalanga lapho le phrojekthi isiqhuba khona iminyaka eminingi. Ezindaweni lapho saqala khona ukusungula ama-cooperatives amasha, sibhekene nezinselelo ngoba kunezabalimi abaningi abafuna ukujoyina. Kukhona izindawo lapho kunezabalimi abasha abangafika ku-200 abafuna ukujoyina! Kule nyanga, sihlangane namalungu angu-128 alezi zifundo ze-cooperatives ezindaweni eziphethwe amahhovisi esifunda. Phakathi kwalezi zifundo, kukhona eziyi-8 ezilungu zephrojekthi yezenkolo eFree State Mpumalanga. Indlela yokuthuthukisa amasu ukuze kulungiselelwe ukulima ngonyaka ozayo uma uzwa ukuthi izimo zezulu zizoba nzima ekulimeni. Ezinyangeni ezedlule, sihlangane nawo wonke amalungu ama-cooperatives okufunda ukuze siqoqe ulwazi mayelana nenani le-hectares elimiwe, inani lemishini kanye nesimo sayo njengamatraktha, abakhangisi, imishini yokuphalaza, nezithuthi. Sikholelwa ukuthi sizothola uxhaso nokwesekwa kwephrojekthi ezozama ukuqapha nokulungisa le mishini - imishini enempilo ibalulekile uma ufuna ukulima ngokomnotho. Okwamanje, ukulima kukhishwa ingcindezi ngoba inzuzo iphansi, ngakho akukho mali yokubheka nokulungisa imishini. Le ndaba idinga ukuhlolwa kahle uma abakhiqizi abamnyama befuna ukuthola indawo yabo ekulimaleni kwezomnotho.
Iqembu Lokucwaninga i-Imperani (eFicksburg). Kunamahektare angama-1,510. Kungani umhlaba ophumelelayo ungakhuliswa? Futhi umhlaba ophathelene nezixuku zabantu, ngakho kungase kungabi lula ukuthola imali yokukhiqiza. Iqembu Lokucwaninga lihlangana kangaki? Iqembu lethu lokucwaninga lihlangana njalo ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngehlelo lezolimo, futhi futhi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili, mayelana nehlelo lokukhulisa ufulawa. Yini inzuzo yokuba yilungu leQembu Lokucwaninga? Manje sesiyazi ukuthi kwenzekani embonini yezinhlamvu futhi siphinde sazi ngamathuba atholakalayo kwezolimo. Sinehlelo lokweseka esingalithembela kukho uma kukhona inkinga. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweQembu Lokucwaninga nebhizinisi lezolimo? Ngezinye izikhathi sihlangana nabakhiqizi ngabanye abathengisa ukuze bathole inzuzo emakethe futhi sizizwa sengathi siyingxenye yomphakathi obanzi babalimi. Ingabe ufuna ukuhlangana neQembu Lokucwaninga labakhiqizi abafuna inzuzo, futhi kungani ucabanga ukuthi kubalulekile? Kubalulekile kithi njengabakhiqizi ukukhuluma ngolimi olulodwa. Umkhiqizi omncane usendleleni yokuba umkhiqizi ofuna inzuzo yokudla. Ukuqala ndawonye, ukuxhumana, nokwesekana kuzokwenza ukuthi bonke abakhiqizi babe namandla.
Iqembu libizwa ngokuthi Uphuzane. Le ndawo yePhuzane itholakala enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal uma uhamba amakhilomitha angama-25 usuka ePaulpietersburg, eduze komfula obizwa ngeBivane River. Abalimi nabo abanamakhono nolwazi lokulima bodwa. Kuleli qembu lokufunda, kukhona abakhiqizi besilisa nabesifazane abakhuthalele ukufunda nokwandisa inzuzo yabo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabo futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ezinsizeni zemvelo ezikhona. Okwamanje, abakhiqizi basebenzisa amahektare angama-70 angalimiwa, kodwa kusekhona izindawo eziningi ezingalimiwe ezingenza umkhiqizo. Kungani kukhona izinkundla ezingalimiwe? Izizathu zokungaklami kulezo zindawo zihlala zikhona ezomnotho, ngoba izinkundla eziningi zikhona ezwenikazi, futhi amabhange nabanye abanikazi bezikweletu bayazithoba ukunikela le mali ngoba abanakuqinisekisa ukuthi bazoyithola le mali emuva kokuphuma. Enye inkinga imishini; abalimi abanamatractor nezinye izinto. Iqembu lihlangana nini? Iqembu lihlangana kanye ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngezinkinga zamalungu nezindlela zokusebenzisa izinsiza zawo ezincane. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leli qembu lokufunda? Ngithole ukumangala okukhulu lapho ngiya ukubona lokho abakwenza; ngathola ukuthi basebenzisa izindlela zokulima zesimanje ukuze bakhiqize (ukulima ngaphandle kokulima) ngempumelelo ngo-2009/2010. Lo nyaka baqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokulima besebenzisa indlela yokulima ngaphandle kokulima futhi bathola umkhiqizo ophakeme kunowonyaka odlule. Ukuzimisela kwabo nokufuna ukushintsha, ukushiya izindlela zokutshala zendabuko, nokuzama izindlela ezintsha kukhombisa ukuthi abashiyi emuva ekushintsheni futhi babona ukuthi ukufunda kwabo nentuthuko kubanika impumelelo enkulu. Bayazi lokho okukhuluma abadala: 'Ulala uhlezi emuva' - labo abangahambi phambili bazoshiywa emuva. Abakhiqizi bathola ukuthi bathola ulwazi oluningi uma beyiwo amalungu eqembu lokufunda futhi behambele izinsuku zabakhiqizi lapho kukhona izifundo. Enye indlela yokuthola ulwazi ukusebenzisa izindawo zokubonisa, ezikhombisa abalimi indlela entsha eqondile yokutshala ufulawa. Ingabe kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwale qembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu eqembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho abaseduzane, kodwa abanye bahlala kude futhi abakwazi ukuhlangana nabo kalula - lokhu kuyinkinga. Iqembu lihamba kahle neMnyango Wezolimo kaHulumeni nabanye abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo.
Sebenzisa imephu yaseNingizimu Afrika ukukhombisa ukuthi kuphi iNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Isithombe 1: Iqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo emhlanganweni walo. Isithombe 2: Umongameli weqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo, uMnu. Magidela, phambi kwemifino yakhe. Le nqembu yokufunda itholakala kuphi? Le nqembu yokufunda itholakala endaweni yasemaphandleni lapho kungelamigwaqo emihle nezitolo. Itholakala cishe ngamakhilomitha angama-60 ukusuka eBizana eNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Kukhona amalungu angama-100 kule nqembu. Kukhona amahektare angama-100 angakhuliswa ukuze akhiqizwe. Yini eyenza kungakhuliswa yonke imhlaba engavunwa? Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokutshala. Ukuntuleka kwezinto zokwakha izithiyo. Izimo zezulu - ekuqaleni kwesizini yokutshala ngo-2010, imvula yayinzima kakhulu, yenza kube nzima ukutshala.
