Ubudlelwano obude bokuxhumana nalabo abanikeza izinsiza zokutshala, njengezithako, imbewu, nezinto zokwakha. Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kangakanani? Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kanye ngenyanga neGrain SA, futhi lihlangana njalo ngesonto ukuze lixoxe ngezindaba zokulima. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda? Ikakhulu, izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda zifaka ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukuxoxa namanye amalungu eqembu, nokuhlonza izindlela ezifanele zokusebenza ezifana nokuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukutshala, ukufaka izithako, nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha. Iqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo linethuba lokuh attend the First Training Session on Maize Planting. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweqembu lokufunda nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Okwamanje, akukho abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo! Iqembu lokufunda liphumelele kanjani ezinsizeni ezinikezwa yiGrain SA? Phakathi nemihlangano yabo, amalungu athola ulwazi nethuba lokuxoxa ngezindlela ezifanele zokutshala. Ukuhlola nokuhlola kuveze izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izinto zokwakha nezithako. Lapho amalungu ehlangana ukuze akhe iqembu lokufunda, iqembu lonke lingathenga izinto zokwakha nezithako, hhayi njengabantu ngabanye.
Kulendawo, kunezinkulungwane eziyi-2152 zamahhactha angavunyelwa ukuba abahlali beqembu lokufunda bawasebenzise. Lezi zindawo zisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke kodwa ziqashwe ngokofficial kumuntu ngamunye, futhi zilawulwa nje yikhandidethi lendawo. Umfuyi ngamunye unesivumelwano sokuhlala (PTO) salo mhlaba, esifana kakhulu nesivumelwano sokuqasha. Umfuyi akakwazi ukuba ngumnikazi walomhlaba, kodwa futhi akakwazi ukuxoshwa kule ndawo. Ngonyaka ongu-2023, abapheki bahluleka ukuhlinzeka ngamahektare angama-857. Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi lokhu kwenzeke, ikakhulukazi izindleko eziphezulu zokuqala zokulima nezindleko eziphezulu zokuqasha abaqashi. Abapheki bahluleka ukuthenga imishini yabo ngoba intengo yemakethe yezitshalo zokudla iphansi futhi inzuzo incane. Abapheki abaningi abasasebenzisa lo mhlaba sebesidala futhi baphila kakhulu ngezikhwama. Ngaphezu kwalokho, laba baphangi abadala abakwazi ukuxhaswa ngamabhange ngezikhwama, futhi abakwazi ukwandisa izinkundla abazilima ngemali abanayo. Izinkundla eziningi ezingalimi azinabafakazisi, futhi manje abapheki babhekana nezingozi ngoba izinkomo zikhululeka. Uhlelo lwe-CASP lweMnyango Wezolimo luhamba kancane, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokufaka izivikelo ezinkundleni. Uhlelo olukhulu lokukhiqiza ukudla luyancipha ngoba abapheki abaningi abasesitholanga ukwesekwa kulolu hlelo ukuze batshale ekukhiqizeni ukudla. Abapheki basemaphandleni bacele usizo kuhlelo lwe-ASGISA ukuze balime izinkundla zomphakathi wonke, kodwa lokhu akusizi abanikazi bomhlaba. Lokhu akusiyona isixazululo esiqinile ngoba siyazi ukuthi lapho i-ASGISA ingenzi izinkundla, lezi zinkundla zizoshiywa zingalimi ngoba ngeke kube nokuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane futhi abapheki ngeke babe namandla okuqhubeka bodwa. Amalungu eqembu lokufunda ahlangana njalo ngenyanga. Kukhona inzuzo enkulu ekubeni ilungu leqembu lokufunda ngoba abapheki bangabelana ngemibono yabo, bahlonze izidingo zabo mayelana nokuthola ulwazi, futhi basebenzisane. Abapheki basemaphandleni bahluleka, ngakho abapheki bezomnotho abaninzi abakhona. Intuthuko kulezi zindawo ihamba kancane, kodwa ngiyajabula ukuthi intuthuko ibonakala. Abapheki basebenzisa imbewu ye-hybrid (izinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene zembewu), izivandlakanyo ezifanele, futhi bazama ukususa izitshalo eziphikisanayo ezinkundleni lapho kukhula khona ufulawa.
Ithini inhloso yeqembu lokufunda? Umsebenzi obalulekile wohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabafama ukuheha nokuphatha amaqembu okufunda. Le phrojekthi ihlose ukukhuthaza abakhiqizi abasafufusa abangenasemaphandleni ukuba benze amaqembu okufunda ukuze bakwazi ukuhlangana njalo ukuze bahlaziye ukuqeqeshwa okukhona nolwazi oluhambisana nokukhiqizwa kweziphuzo. NoLawrence Luthango (oqale ukusebenza ngoMeyi 2008) eMpumalanga Kapa - banama-14. Ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukusebenzisa i-auger, ukujula komhlabathi, ubunzima bomhlabathi obudala ukuhweba, ukufaka umanyolo, umphumela wocwaningo lomhlabathi, ubuthi bomhlabathi, ukuvuthwa komhlabathi (amandla okukhiqiza), umquba, izidingo zokudla kwezitshalo, inani lokudla okukhona emhlabathini, izindlela zokulima, nokugcina amanzi emhlabathini. Imali engabolekwa abakhiqizi - konke okukhona okuhlobene nokubolekwa kwemali, izindlela zokuphatha ezimali, izindleko zokukhiqiza, ukubala inani lokukhiqiza, izikhathi zokutshala, ukujula kokutshala, izinhlobo zezithelo, inani lezitshalo ngehektare, umthelela wezimo zezulu ekukhiqizeni, ukukala imvula nezinga lokushisa, ukujikeleza kwezithelo, ukusebenzisa itrekta, ukuvuna, inani lokumuncwa kokudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, ukutshala ujeqe, izindleko zokuthutha, ukuthenga izinto ezidingekayo ukuze uqale ukulima ngokuhlakanipha, usizo ngezinto ezisele emasimini ngemuva kokuvuna, ukuthengisa ukudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, izibonelelo, nezisekelo ezivela kuhulumeni. Izindleko zokuzisebenzisa, inani le-kilowatts elidingekayo ukuze wenze umsebenzi othile, izindleko zokulungisa izinto eziphukile, inani le-kilowatts elidingekayo ngehektare, ukunciphisa ubunzima bokulima ukuze kwehliswe izindleko, nezivumelwano zokurenta imishini. Izindlela zokuthola umhlaba, ukukala nokunquma usayizi wendawo yokulima noma insimu, ukurenta insimu, izinhlobo zomhlabathi, nezindlela zokuphatha izihlahla ezindaweni zakho. Ukuphatha izibungu emasimini nasekuphatheni izifo ezithinta izithelo. Izinhlobo zezihlahla, ukuphatha izihlahla ngezinto zokwakha nezimishini, ukuphatha izihlahla ezifana nogwayi, ukufaka ama-herbicides ngaphambi nangemva kokutshala, nokufafaza emigqeni noma ensimini yonke. Ubungozi bezibungu, umshwalense wezibungu, umshwalense ojwayelekile, nezidingo zokuthola umshwalense.
Uma ufuna ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho lokulima ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukusetha imigomo nezifiso zakho. Awukwazi ukuhamba endleleni ungazi ukuthi uhamba kuphi. Ngokuvamile, abakhiqizi babizwa ngokuthi abakwazi noma abaphoxekile ngokungasethi imigomo yebhizinisi noma yezomuntu. Kunzima ukuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima ngoba izimo zalesi sisebenzi azilula; awazi ukuthi ikusasa lizokubamba ini. Kudinga isikhathi esiningi ukuhlanganisa imigomo ecacile yebhizinisi lokulima. Kokubili lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa izifiso kuyinto engafanele ishiywe emuva, nakuba kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi. Imigomo nezifiso (amasu) zikhombisa indlela phambili; ngaphandle kwazo, awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi uzophumelela noma uphumelele. Ngaphandle kwemigomo, awukwazi ukukala ukuthi usebenza kahle yini ngoba awunankanyezi ofuna ukuyifinyelela. Ukuhlanganisa inhloso nokusetha imigomo emsebenzini wokulima kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi, kodwa kubalulekile ukwenza lo msebenzi; kumele siwenze. Ukusetha nokuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima kuvame ukuza nezinkinga. Isizathu salokhu sitholakala lapha: ukulima kuyindlela yokusebenza komlimi futhi kuyindlela umlimi aphila ngayo (yimpilo yabo). Umndeni wabo ungowengxenye yezinto ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabo wokulima nempilo yabo. Ngokuvamile, siyazi ukuthi umgomo omkhulu webhizinisi ukuwenza inzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kodwa ekulimaleni, lokhu akuhambisani njalo ngoba ibhizinisi nempilo yokuphila kuhlangene. Singasho ukuthi imigomo yalolu sizo ingaba ukufinyelela inzuzo enhle, kodwa akufanele ilethe umlimi nomndeni wakhe ubunzima. Izifiso ezihlanganisiwe ngenhla azichazi kahle futhi zingabukwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kodwa uma zisetshenziswa, lezi zifiso zicacile ngoba awekho abantu ababili abacabanga ngokufanayo noma baphila ngendlela efanayo futhi abavumi umndeni omuhle ngendlela efanayo. Ngakho-ke, isifiso somlimi sokwenza inzuzo sizohluka ngoba omunye ngeke abuke lezi zinto ngendlela efanayo futhi ngeke alandele indlela efanayo yokwenza inzuzo. Nokho, kubalulekile kumlimi othile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi impilo enhle izobiza malini uma kuqhathaniswa nomsebenzi wabo wokwenza inzuzo, ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele kubo nasemaphusheni abo. Umphakathi udinga umkhakha wezolimo ukuze ukhiqize izinto ezithile - lokhu kuzohambisana namakhono ezwe elithile - ikakhulukazi ukudla nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ngentengo ephansi, futhi siqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngaleyo nto. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abalimi kufanele basebenzise izinsiza zemvelo ikakhulukazi isikhathi eside. Kodwa imigomo evamile kuphela ngeke ikwanele. Umsebenzi ngamunye udinga umgomo othile, kodwa lowo mgomo kufanele uhambisane nenhloso evamile. Isibonelo: umlimi ofuna ukukhiqiza ufulawa kufanele abe nomgomo othile mayelana nomsebenzi wokukhiqiza ufulawa, masithi uhlose ukulima amahektare angu-500 efulawa elibomvu ngonyaka. Kodwa akupheli lapho. Kumele bazi futhi ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo mayelana nemisebenzi edingekayo nezindleko ezizovela ngoba lokhu kuzobakhombisa ukuthi amasheya abo ahambelana kanjani nezidingo zamaseyidi nezimuncu. Um limi ngamunye kufanele uqonde ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo. Siphinda sithi kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izifiso; um limi kufanele aqonde kahle ukuthi ufuna ukuya kuphi ngebhizinisi lakhe lokulima. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kulezi zifiso, um limi kufanele ahlale phansi acabange ukukhetha imigomo efanele kubo, empilweni yabo, nasezidingweni zabo. Lapho beqala ukwakha amasheya amasha ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi othile uhambisana nezifiso ezivamile nezidingo zabo. Konke esikushilo mayelana nokuhlanganisa izifiso kungafingqwa kulezi zisho ezimbalwa: umgomo webhizinisi lokulima ukufuna ukufinyelela inzuzo enkulu ngangokunokwenzeka, kodwa ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza zemvelo (izimpahla) ezifana nomhlabathi, amanzi, izifunda, njll., ukuze zisetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezinhle isikhathi eside. Kumele baphathe izinhlelo zokubheka ukuze baqhubeke behlanganisa ulwazi oluzobavumela ukuba baphendule indlela yabo yokusebenza masinyane uma umonakalo utholakala. Ukuhlanganisa izifiso kufana nokubuza "lokhu kusho ukuthini" emsebenzini wokulima, okusho ukuthi sifuna impendulo embuzweni "Yini esifuna ukuyenza, yini esifuna ukuyifinyelela, kuphi esifuna ukufika?" Ezinye imigomo nezifiso zikhathaza. Kubalulekile ukusungula inani elithile lemikhiqizo ngehektare - lokhu kusho ukuthi inani lemikhiqizo elibekwe ebhajethi yonyaka kufanele likwazi ukufezeka. Lokhu kuhluka phakathi kwezindawo zokulima ezithile. Qinisekisa ukuthi umkhiqizo wakho uhambisana nezidingo zemakethe - umphathi womkhiqizo kufanele abeke phambili izifiso ezizohlangabezana nalezo zidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinto ezifana nosayizi, umbala, ikhwalithi yangaphakathi, njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo - lokhu kusho ukuthi izici zemvelo zingase zibe sengozini lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, njengezinto zokwakha ezibulala izilokazane, izimuncu, njll. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kule ndawo kuzokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi usebenza ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeZinhlelo Zokulima Ezinhle (GAP) - i-GAP ifuna ukuthi izinto zokwakha zisetshenziswe ngokucophelela ngoba zingaba sengozini kulabo abasebenza nazo. Izibulala-zilokazane, izibulala-zilokazane, nezimuncu kufanele zisetshenziswe ngokucophelela; amanzi akufanele angcoliswe, futhi izinyathelo kufanele zithathwe ukuvimbela ukulahleka, ukungcoliswa, nokugeleza. Kungase kube nezinye izifiso ezizosebenza ezindaweni zokulima ezithile, kodwa lezi ezichazwe lapha zizokwenza kube lula ukuthi umsebenzi wakho uphumelele.
Isikhathi sokuvuna sesisondele futhi kusekhona emapulazini amaningi agcwele izihlahla. Izingxoxo zethu zihlala zibuyela kulokhu: izihlahla ziyisitha esikhulu sokukhiqiza ukudla. Okubalulekile kakhulu lapho kukhiqizwa izitshalo zokudla ukuphatha nokususa izihlahla. Uma kukhona izihlahla, umkhiqizo uzobhekana nezinkinga ngezindlela eziningi, ikakhulukazi ukulahleka okukhulu komkhiqizo nezinkobe zizonakaliswa. Emhlabeni jikelele, kunokushoda kwezinkobe ezidliwayo, ngakho asikwazi ukumukela ukuthi izinkobe zikhishwa ngoba zibhujiswa yizihlahla. Izinkobe zentanga azivunyelwe ukuba zibe khona ezinkobeni ngoba zineziphuzo ezilimazayo futhi abantu noma izilwane azidli. Mayelana nomthetho ophatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezitshalo nokuhlanzeka kwezinkobe, kunezinhlobo zezimila ezingavunyelwe nhlobo ezinkobeni. Ngokwesibonelo, ngokwezimiso zomthetho, akufanele kube khona isikhumba esisodwa se-thorn apple (datura). I-datura inenhlanzi engalimaza kakhulu umuntu. Okubalulekile esikufundayo lapho sibheka ukuphathwa kwezihlahla ukususa umonakalo wokuqala ezinkobeni. Ibhontshisi elingenazo izihlahla futhi elinganqotshwa yizihlahla liyisiphumo sokuphatha kahle izitshalo zakho ngokuqhubekayo, hhayi ukuzama lapha nalapho ukuwabulala izihlahla. Uma ukususa okusheshayo kwezihlahla ngesikhathi sokutshala kungasebenzi kahle, izihlahla kufanele zikhishwe emapulazini ngaphambi kokuvuna. Uma izihlahla ezinkulu zisuswa emapulazini ngemuva kokuba nezinkobe, kuzoba ngcono ukuwasha lezo zihlahla ukuvimbela ukuthi ziqale ukuphuma futhi ngonyaka ozayo. Khumbula, umkhiqizo omuhle ubonisa ukuthi kunezinkobe eziningi - izinkobe eziningi ezihlanzekile!
I-soybean - isitshalo esiyisimangaliso kanye nokudla okungavamile! Kukhona ingxoxo enkulu mayelana ne-soybeans kanye nokubaluleka kwazo ekushintshaneni kwezolimo kanye ne-maize. Njengamanye amahlamvu adlalwa isikhathi eside ekhaya, ubudlelwano be-soybeans besimanjemanje nezinye izinhlobo ezikhula ngokungajwayelekile abunakulandwa nganoma iyiphi indlela eqinile. Njengengxenye ye-Grain SA Farmer Development Program, sithemba ukusungula uhlelo ne-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust ukuze sikhuthaze abalimi abasafufusa ukuba bakhulise i-soybeans - njengokudla okuthengiswayo, futhi njengomthombo walesi sizwe sezinhlobo ezisemqoka ze-protein. I-soybeans ihluka ekukhuleni nasekuziphatheni. Ukuphakama kwesitshalo kungahluka kusuka ngaphansi kuka-20cm kuya ku-2 meters. Amabhodlela, izimpande zesitshalo, kanye namahlamvu covered with fine brown or gray hairs. Amathambo anama-leaflets amathathu kuya kwane per leaf, futhi lawo ma-leaflets angaba ngu-6 kuya ku-15 centimeters ubude, enobubanzi obungu-2 kuya ku-7 centimeters. Amathambo awawa ngaphambi kokuthi izithelo zikhule. Izimbali ezingabonakali, ezizithokozisayo, zikhula ezindaweni zamathambo futhi zingaba mhlophe, pinki, noma purple. Imikhiqizo yayo iyibhodlela elihlotshiswe ngempahla ethile elikhula ezixubeni ezingu-3 kuya ku-5, ngalinye ibhodlela lingama-centimeters angu-3 kuya ku-8 ubude futhi ngokuvamile liqukethe izithelo ezi-2 kuya ku-4 (ngokwejwayelekile kuncane), nezithelo zilinganiselwa ku-5 kuya ku-11 millimeters ububanzi. I-soybeans iza ngezinhlobo ezahlukene nosayizi bamabhodlela, kuhlanganisa omnyama, ompunga, oluhlaza-oluhlaza, ophuzi, oluhlaza, kanye nomhlophe. Ibhodlela le-soybean elikhulile linzima, alithathi amanzi, futhi livikela izithelo ezivela ekulimazeni okungenzeka. Uma ibhodlela elihlotshiswe ngezithelo lihluka, izithelo ngeke zikwazi ukuvuthwa. Okuqukethwe kwe-oyela kanye ne-protein kubalelwa cishe ku-60% wesisindo se-soybeans ezomile uma kuhlanganiswe, ne-proteins zenze u-40% kanti i-oyela i-20%. I-35% esele iyisitashi (ama-carbohydrates) kanti i-5% iyinhlama. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-soybeans kuqukethe cishe u-8% ibhodlela elihlotshiswe ngezithelo, u-90% izindawo zamathambo, kanye no-2% izimpande zamathambo. Ukuze kudliwe ngabantu, i-soybeans kumele iphekwe emlilweni "omisiwe" ukuze kuqedwe ama-trypsin inhibitors (okuyizithiyo ze-serine protease). I-soybeans ezingashisayo, kuhlanganisa nezo ezingakakhuli ngokuphelele, ziyingozi kubantu, izinkomo, izinkukhu, futhi ngempela kuzo zonke izilwane ezine-stomach eyodwa. Abathengisi abaningi bacabanga ukuthi i-soybeans iyinsiza ye-protein ephelele. I-proteins ephelele yilezo eziqukethe ama-amino acids abalulekile okumele atholwe emkhakheni wokudla kwabantu ngoba umzimba womuntu awukwazi ukuhlanganisa lawa ma-amino acids. Njengoba kunjalo, i-soy iyinsiza enhle ye-protein, phakathi kwezindlela zokudla eziningi, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangadli inyama kodwa badla kuphela imifino noma labo abafuna ukunciphisa ukudla kwabo kwenyama. Ama-proteins e-soy empeleni afana nezithelo zezinye izilimo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-soybeans ingakhiqiza okungenani kabili kwe-protein nge-hectare uma kuqhathaniswa nanoma yisiphi isitshalo sombila noma esolimo. Nge-hectare, lezi proteins zingaba phezulu kwama-5 kuya kwama-10 izikhathi eziphezulu emhlabeni okukhuliswa izilwane, futhi i-protein nge-hectare ingaba phezulu kwama-15 izikhathi eziphezulu emhlabeni okukhuliswa inyama. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-soy kunganciphisa nengozi ye-cancer ye-colon. I-soybeans iyisitshalo esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, inikeza i-oyela kanye ne-protein. E-United States, ivolumu yalezi zitshalo iphumelelwa ngesisombululo esisebenzisa i-hexane, kanti i-soybean meal (i-50% protein) inikeza ithuba lokusetshenziswa ekukhuliseni izilwane (isb., izinkukhu, izinkomo, kanye nezinkomo) ezingeni lokuhweba elingakaze libonwe. Ingxenye encane yalezi zitshalo idliwa ngabantu. Imikhiqizo ye-soybeans itholakala ngezindlela ezahlukene zokudla eziphekiwe. Ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, i-soybeans yayibalulekile eNyakatho Melika naseYurophu, ikakhulukazi njengomthombo wokudla ongashintsha ezinye izinsiza ze-protein kanye njengomthombo we-oyela odliwayo. I-soybeans yaziwa njengomkhiqizo wezolimo ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili yiMnyango Wezolimo wase-United States. Iphumelela ezindaweni ezishisayo futhi ikhula kahle ezishisayo phakathi kuka-20 kuya ku-30 °C; izinga lokushisa elingaphansi kuka-20 °C noma elingaphezu kuka-40 °C linciphisa kakhulu ukukhula kwayo. Ingakhula ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlabathi, kodwa iphumelela emhlabathini onama-sandy loam anothile ngempahla ye-organic. I-soybeans, njengamanye ama-legumes, sebenzisa i-nitrogen ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle ne-bacterium Bradyrhizobium japonicum. Nokho, ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, kufanele kuhlanganiswe i-strain efanele ye-bacteria nezithelo ze-soybeans (noma yisiphi isilimo) ngaphambi kokutshala. Izinhlobo zesitshalo zesimanjemanje ngokuvamile zifinyelela ukuphakama okungama-1 meter futhi zithatha izinsuku ezingu-80 kuya ku-120 ukuze zikhule zisuka ekutshalisweni kuze kube sekutholeni. I-soybeans iyindawo yaseMpumalanga Asia, kodwa kuphela u-45% wemikhiqizo ye-soybeans ivela lapho. I-U.S. ikhiqize ama-ton angama-75 million e-soybeans ngonyaka ka-2000, lapho u-1/3 wathunyelwa phesheya. Abakhiqizi abahamba phambili baphinde baphakanyiswa eBrazil, e-Argentina, e-Paraguay, e-China, nase-India. Izitshalo ze-soybeans zihlala zithinteka kalula yizifo ezithile ze-fungal, izifo ezibulalayo, izifo ze-viral, kanye nezinsongo ezidla izicubu zesitshalo. I-soybeans yayiyisitshalo esibalulekile eMpumalanga Asia isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuba abantu bakwazi ukubhala. Ihlala iyisitshalo esihamba phambili eChina, eJapane, naseKorea. Ngaphambi kokuphuma kwemikhiqizo ephumelele njenge-soy sauce, tempeh, natto, kanye ne-miso, i-soy yayibhekwa njengomuthi ongcwele ekushintshaneni kwayo nezinye izitshalo njengendlela yokubuyisela i-nitrogen. Izitshalo zazikhuliswa ngezansi ukuze kuvuleke isikhala sezitshalo ezinikeza ukudla kwabantu. I-soy yethulwe eYurophu ekuqaleni kwekhulu le-18 futhi e-United States ngo-1765, lapho yaqala khona ukukhuliswa njengezithako zezinkomo. I-soybeans azizange zibe zibalulekile e-Asia kuze kube ngu-1910. E-America, i-soy ibhekwa njengomkhiqizo wezohwebo kuphela kodwa yaqala ukusetshenziswa njengokudla ngawo-1920. I-soy yafika e-Afrika ivela e-China cishe ekupheleni kwekhulu le-19 futhi
Esihlokweni mayelana nokulahla okuphephile kwe-residue ye-pesticide ku-Pula-Imvula kaFebhuwari 2008, enye yezihloko ezingaxoxwa ngayo yisimo se-boom sprayer. Kungase kubonakale ukuthi lokhu kuyinkinga evamile - ngakho-ke lesi sihloko sikhona. Ukugcinwa kahle nokugcina akukwanele ukulandela njengokulungiselela ngaphambi kwesizini yonyaka ozayo kuphela, kodwa kuqinisa ukusebenza kwe-sprayer njengoba kungeza iminyaka empilweni yayo yokukhiqiza. Ukuba khona kwezinto ezilimazayo ezitsheni isikhathi eside kungalimaza ezinye izindawo ze-sprayer, uphahla, kanye nezixhumi zikagesi. I-residue yalezi zinto ingaba yingozi kunoma ubani osebenza nemishini. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inani elincane kakhulu lezinto ezilimazayo ezitsheni ezisele ku-sprayer lingalimaza izitshalo njengoba zidluliselwa kwesizini yokufafaza elandelayo. Ukuvikela ukuphepha kwakho siqu kanye nalabo bakho, abasebenzi, nezitshalo kubalulekile ukuhlanza kahle nokukhipha noma yikuphi ukungcoliswa ku-sprayer yakho phakathi nesizini, phakathi kwezitshalo futhi ngaphambi kokuyigcina ebusika. Khumbula ukuthi i-residue yemichiza esetshenziswe kwezolimo iyingozi ezitshalweni nakuma-nyama, ngakho-ke zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqondwe ubungozi obuhambisana nalokhu ukuze lesi simo sikwazi ukuphathwa ngendlela efanele. Inqubo yokugcina nokuhlanza igcwele izinyathelo ezinhlanu. Ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukuhlanza i-sprayer yakho, qiniseka ukuthi uyabheka ilebula lezinto ezilimazayo ozisebenzisile. Iphakamisa indlela efanele yokulahla umkhiqizo osalayo. Iphinde inikeze imiyalelo ethile yokuhlanza engase ibaluleke. Iphakamisa ngemikhiqizo yokunciphisa ukungcoliswa. Iphinde ikunikeze amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana ne-Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) okufanele uyigqoke ukuze uhlanze kahle i-sprayer yakho. Inhloso yokuhlanza ngamanzi ukuhoxisa noma yikuphi umkhiqizo osele noma izinqwaba ezinkulu ezingase zibe ku-sprayer. Imishini yokuhlanza ye-sprayer ifaka ukujikeleza kwamanzi ngaphakathi kohlelo ngemuva kokugcwaliswa ngamanzi njengoba kukhonjisiwe ku-lebula lezinto ezilimazayo ozisebenzisile (ngamanye amazwi, ukuhlanza ngamanzi/ukuxuba kwemichiza encishisiwe, manje ebizwa ngokuthi yi-rinsate, endaweni ephephile). Ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi uhlanza ngethanki kanye nezintambo nezikhala, gcwalisa amanzi ahlanzekile uze ufinyelele uhhafu wethanki ukuze ugijime i-tractor kancane emzileni wepulazi - ukujikeleza kuzodlulisela amanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kufafaza umphakathi wethanki wonke. Ukuphinda izinyathelo zokuhlanza ngezinqwaba ezincane zamahhala (ukuze kuze kube ngu-10% wamandla wethanki le-sprayer) kungcono kunokugcwalisa nje ithanki le-sprayer ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Kunconywa ukuphinda inqubo yokuhlanza kathathu okungenani. Khetha indawo lapho i-rinsate ingakwazi khona ukungcolisa imithombo yamanzi, ukuchitheka, izitshalo, noma ezinye izitshalo futhi lapho izingcezu ezincane zingakwazi ukuhlanganiswa, njengoba lokhu kungaba yingozi kubantu, ezilwaneni, nasezindaweni eziphilayo. Ungafafaza emasimini noma emzileni wepulazi. Qiniseka ukuthi ukhipha amanzi ethankini ye-sprayer ngokuhambisana nelebula le-pesticide. Ungavuli nje ama-valve njengoba lokhu kuzokhipha emhlabeni. Faka izikhala ezengeziwe ezingenza ngaphezulu ukuze udale indlela esheshayo futhi evumelekile yokulahla i-rinsate ye-sprayer. Iph外e ye-sprayer nayo kufanele ihlanzeke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lapho uhamba i-sprayer ngamanzi, ungakwenzi amanzi angakha amanzi angavunyelwe ukufinyelelwa yizingane, izilwane, izinkomo, noma izilwane zasendle. Lahla i-rinsate ye-pesticide ngokuhambisana nemihlahlandlela ku-lebula, ubeka i-rinsate endaweni lapho imikhiqizo izosetshenziswa khona ngokuhambisana nenhloso yayo (futhi, emasimini lapho imichiza ifafazwe khona kubhekwa njengendawo efanele). Phinda inqubo yokukhipha ngaphakathi ngemuva kokukhipha ukungcoliswa nokuhlanza kabusha i-sprayer. Qiniseka ukuthi ukhipha noma yiziphi izithanki zamanzi ezisetshenziswe ekuhlanzeni ngaphambi kokugcinwa ukuze uvikele ukulimala okubangelwa ukuhamba kwamanzi ngaphakathi. Ngemuva kokuhlanza kokugcina ngamanzi, ungahlola i-sprayer yakho futhi wenze izilungiselelo noma ukulungisa okudingekayo. Nakuba i-sprayer ihlanzekile, qhubeka ugqoke imishini yakho yokuvikela. Kukhona okungase kusale ku-sprayer. Isakhiwo se-boom, esibonisa noma yiziphi izinkinga, kufanele silungiswe. Njengoba i-sprayer manje ihlanzekile, ungase ufise ukususa izingxenye zayo ezilimele ngesikhathi sokugcina. Susa ama-filters futhi uwahlanze ngesandla ngamanzi anesipuni (khumbula ukugqoka izigqoko ezivikelayo eziphikisa imichiza), hlanzisa ngamanzi futhi mhlawumbe ugcine noma ubuyisele kumasiphu. Hlola ngazinye izikhala, izikhala ze-nozzle, kanye nama-valve. I-residue yemichiza ingaqinisa kulezi zindawo futhi ibe nzima ebusika, ngaleyo ndlela yehlisa ukusebenza kwe-sprayer esizini elandelayo. Susa iziphetho ze-nozzle, ama-skrini, hlola ama-valve, izikhala, kanye nemizimba ye-nozzle ukuze ubone noma yiziphi izimpawu zokugqokwa. Qaphela ukufaka kabusha ama-plugs. Hlanza futhi uhlola izikhala, izikhala ze-nozzle, futhi uhlola ama-valve. Gcina ezikhwama ezibhalwe phansi. Gcina ama-valve ezingeni lokushisa endlini ebusika ukuze uvikele ukulimala okungase kubangele izinga lokushisa eliphansi. Susa wonke ama-pressure gauges futhi ufake izikhala ezindaweni ezivulekile ze-sprayer. Gcina ama-gauges lapho engakwazi khona ukuvulwa kokushisa noma ukulimala. Ekugcineni, jikeleza i-antifreeze ku-sprayer, kufaka phakathi i-boom, ama-valve, imiphetho, ama-pressure gauges, kanye nezintambo zokubuyisela. Vumela i-antifreeze ijikeleze phakathi kwezintambo ze-boom. Lokhu kuzofaka ngaphakathi kwezintambo ukuvimbela ukoma nokuphuka. Ukufaka izikhala kuzo zonke izikhala ze-boom kuzosisiza ukuvimbela i-antifreeze ohlelweni, kodwa kungase kudingeke ukuvula enye noma ngaphezulu kwezikhala ukuze uvumele i-antifreeze ijikeleze ngokuphelele phakathi kwe-boom. Vala lezi zikhala uma i-antifreeze igcwele ngokuphelele ohlelweni. Lapho ugxile esigabeni sokugcina, i-antifreeze kufanele ikhiphe noma yikuphi amanzi asale engase abe kuhlelo futhi ifake zonke izingxenye ze-sprayer. Vumela i-antifreeze ihlale kupompo nasezivalvini ukuvimbela ukugqwala nokulimala okungase kubangelwe ukuhamba kwamanzi okungaphakathi ohlelweni. Njengoba ezinye zisuswa ngaphambi kokugcina, ukufaka ama-valve okukhansela ngakolunye uhlangothi lwepompo kungasiza kule nqubo. I-antifreeze eyenzelwe izimoto zokuzijabulisa (RVs) ifanele ukusetshenziswa kumasiphu wezolimo. Akuyona efanayo ne-antifreeze yezimoto ezisebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo, ayinayo imiphumela emibi ezilwaneni. Nakuba imikhiqizo eminingi ye-antifreeze ibonakala ifana ne-gel ngaphansi
Ukusiza nokufundisa abalimi ngabanye kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi kubiza imali eningi. Kungcono ukuhlanganisa abalimi ndawonye, kwakha i-cooperative enamalungu anemisebenzi efanayo, bese bethola usizo ngokuqhubekayo emihlanganweni evamile. Lo msebenzi uqhubeka nokwenza umsebenzi wawo - uthumele ukuqeqeshwa, ulwazi, nolwazi kubo bonke abalimi ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sibone ukuthi inani lamalungu kuma-cooperatives okufunda lehle ngoba kuphela abalimi abaqinile abafuna ukukhula ngokwezimali bahlala. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu eNyakatho Nentshonalanga lapho leli hlelo lisebenza khona iminyaka eminingi. Ezindaweni lapho saqala khona ukusungula ama-cooperatives amasha, sibhekene nezinselelo ngoba kunezinkulungwane zababalimi abafuna ukujoyina. Kukhona izindawo lapho kunezabalimi abasha abangafika ku-200 abafuna ukujoyina! Ngalesi sikhathi, sihlangane namalungu angu-128 alezi zifundo ze-cooperatives ezindaweni eziphethwe amahhovisi omasipala. Phakathi kwalezi zifundo, kukhona eziyi-8 ezilungu zephrojekthi yesonto eFree State Mpumalanga. Indlela yokuthuthukisa amasu ukuze silungiselele ukulima ngonyaka ozayo uma uzwa ukuthi izimo zezulu zizoba nzima zokutshala. Ezinyangeni ezedlule, sihlangane nawo wonke amalungu ama-cooperatives okufunda ukuqoqa ulwazi mayelana nenani le-hectares elitshaliwe, inani lemishini kanye nesimo sayo njengezithuthuthu, abathungi, imishini yokufafaza, nezithuthi. Sikholelwa ukuthi sizothola uxhaso nolwazi lwephrojekthi ezozama ukuqapha nokuqeda le mishini - imishini enempilo ibalulekile uma ufuna ukulima ngokwezimali. Okwamanje, ukulima kusemthethweni ngoba inzuzo iphansi, ngakho akukho mali yokubheka nokulungisa imishini. Le nkinga idinga ukuhlolwa ngokucophelela uma abakhiqizi abamnyama befuna ukuthatha indawo yabo ekulimaleni kwezimali.
Iqembu Lophenyo iImperani (eFicksburg). Kukhona amahektare angama-1,510. Kungani umhlaba ophumelelayo ungakhuliswa? Futhi umhlaba owawubizwa ngamaqembu abantu, ngakho kungase kube nzima ukuthola imali yokukhiqiza. Iqembu Lophenyo lihlangana kangakanani? Iqembu lethu lihlangana njalo ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngohlelo lwezolimo, futhi futhi ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili, mayelana nohlelo lwezithombo. Yini inzuzo yokuba yilungu leQembu Lophenyo? Manje sesiyazi ukuthi kwenzekani embonini yokudla futhi siphinde sazi ngamathuba atholakalayo kwezolimo. Sinehlelo lokwesekwa esingalithembela kukho uma kunenkinga. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweQembu Lophenyo kanye nomkhakha wezohwebo lwezolimo? Ngezinye izikhathi sihlangana nabakhiqizi ngabanye abathengisa ukuze benze inzuzo emakethe futhi sizizwa sengathi siyingxenye yomphakathi obanzi babalimi. Ingabe ufuna ukuhlangana neQembu Lophenyo labakhiqizi abafuna inzuzo, futhi kungani ucabanga ukuthi kubalulekile? Kubalulekile kithi njengabakhiqizi ukukhuluma ngomsindo owodwa. Umkhiqizi osemncane usemkhakheni wokuba umkhiqizi ofuna inzuzo yokudla. Ukuqala ndawonye, ukuxhumana, nokwesekana kuzokwandisa bonke abakhiqizi.
Iqembu libizwa nge-Uphuzane. Le ndawo yePhuzane ingatholakala enyakatho KwaZulu-Natal uma uhamba amakhilomitha angama-25 usuka ePaulpietersburg, eduze komfula obizwa ngeBivane River. Lapha ngempela kusemaphandleni futhi akukho okukhuluma ngakho ngesiNgisi njengemikhiqizo yokwakha (izinsiza zokulima nezokutshala, ukuthuthwa, ukuthenga nokuthengisa, noma okuthile). Abalimi nabo abanamakhono nolwazi lokulima bodwa. Kuleli qembu lokufunda, kukhona abakhiqizi besilisa nabesifazane abakhuthazekile ukufunda nokwandisa inzuzo yabo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabo futhi kusebenze kangcono ngezinsiza zemvelo ezikhona. Okwamanje, abakhiqizi basebenzisa amahektare angama-70 angalimiwa, kodwa kusekhona izindawo eziningi ezingalimiwe ezingakhiqiza. Kungani kunezindawo ezingalimiwe? Izizathu zokungalimwa kulezo zindawo ikakhulukazi zisezingeni lezimali, ngoba izindawo eziningi ziyizinkambu zomhlaba jikelele, futhi amabhange nabanye abanikazi bezikweletu bayazithiba ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo mali ngoba abanalo uqinisekiso lokuthi bazothola le mali emuva. Enye inkinga imishini; abalimi abanamatractor nezinye izinto. Iqembu lihlangana nini? Iqembu lihlangana kanye ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngezinkinga zamalungu nezindlela zokusebenzisa izinsiza zabo ezincane. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leli qembu lokufunda? Ngithole isimanga esikhulu lapho ngiya ukubona lokho abakwenza; ngathola ukuthi basebenzisa izindlela zokulima zesimanje ukuze bakhiqize (ukulima ngaphandle kokulima) ngempumelelo ngo-2009/2010. Lo nyaka baqale ukutshala ngaphandle kokulima besebenzisa indlela yokulima ngaphandle kokulima futhi bathola umkhiqizo ophakeme kunowonyaka odlule. Ukuzimisela kwabo nokufisa ukushintsha, ukushiya izindlela zokutshala zendabuko, nokuzama izindlela ezintsha kukhombisa ukuthi abashiyi emuva ekushintsheni futhi babona ukuthi ukufunda kwabo nentuthuko kubanika impumelelo enkulu. Bayazi lokho okukhuluma abadala: 'Ulala futhi uhlale emuva' - labo abangahambi phambili bazoshiywa emuva. Abakhiqizi bathola ukuthi bathola ulwazi oluningi uma beyiye amalungu eqembu lokufunda futhi behambele ezinsukwini zabalimi lapho kukhona izifundo. Enye indlela yokuthola ulwazi ukusebenzisa izindawo zokubonisa, ezikhombisa abalimi indlela entsha eqondile yokutshala ummbila. Ingabe kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwale qembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Kukho ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu eqembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho abaseduzane, kodwa abanye bahlala kude futhi abakwazi ukuhlangana nabo kalula - lokhu kuyinkinga. Iqembu lihlangana kahle neMnyango Wezolimo kaHulumeni nabanye abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo.
Sebenzisa imephu yeNingizimu Afrika ukukhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape itholakala kuphi. Isithombe 1: Iqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo emhlanganweni walo. Isithombe 2: Umongameli weqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo, uMnu. Magidela, phambi kwemifino yakhe. Le nqola yokufunda itholakala kuphi? Le nqola yokufunda itholakala endaweni yasemaphandleni lapho kungekho izindlela ezinhle nezitolo. Itholakala cishe ngamakhilomitha angama-60 ukusuka eBizana eNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Kukhona amalungu angama-100 kule nqola. Kukhona amahektare angama-100 angavunwa. Yini imbangela yokungavuni yonke imhlaba engavunwa? Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokutshala. Ukuntuleka kwezinto zokwakha izithiyo. Izimo zezulu - ekuqaleni kwesizini yokutshala ngo-2010, imvula yayinzima kakhulu, yenza kube nzima ukuthumela. Ibanga elide lokuxhumana nalabo abahlinzeka ngezinsiza zokutshala, njengezithelo, imbewu, nezikhemikhali. Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kaninginingi? Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kanye ngenyanga neGrain SA, futhi lihlangana ngeviki ukuze lixoxe ngezindaba zokulima. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda? Ikakhulu, izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda zihlanganisa ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukuxoxa namanye amalungu eqembu, ukuthola izindlela ezifanele zokusebenza ezifana nokuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukutshala, ukufaka izibulala-zinambuzane, nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha. Iqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo lenze kahle ukuvakashela iSeshini Yokuqala Yokufundisa Ngokutshala Imifino. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweqembu lokufunda nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Okwamanje, awekho abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo! Iqembu lokufunda liphumelele kanjani ezinsizeni ezinikezwa yiGrain SA? Ngesikhathi semihlangano yabo, amalungu athola ulwazi nethuba lokuxoxa ngezindlela ezifanele zokutshala. Ukuhlola nokuhlola kuveze izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izikhemikhali nezithelo. Lapho amalungu ehlangana ukuze akhe iqembu lokufunda, iqembu lonke lingathenga izikhemikhali nezithelo, hhayi njengabantu ngabanye.
Kulendawo, kune-2152 hectares ezingakhuliswa ngamalungu ezigaba zokufunda. Lezi zindawo zisetshenziswa umphakathi wonke kodwa ziqashwe ngokusemthethweni ngumuntu ngamunye, futhi ziphathwa nje yikhandidethi lendawo. Umfuyi ngamunye unesivumelwano sokuhlala (PTO) salelo thafa, esifana kakhulu nesivumelwano sokuhlala. Umfuyi akakwazi ukuba ngum owner walelo thafa, kodwa futhi akakwazi ukuphuma kule ndawo. Ngonyaka ongenhla, abafuyi bahluleka ukukhulisa ama-hectare angu-857. Kunezizathu eziningi zokwenza lokhu, ikakhulukazi izindleko zokuqala eziphakeme zokufuya nezindleko eziphakeme zokuboleka abaqashi. Abafuyi bahlupheka ukuthenga imishini yabo ngoba intengo yemakethe yezitshalo zokudla iphansi futhi inzuzo incane. Abafuyi abaningi abasasebenzisa le ndawo sebekhulile futhi baphila kakhulu ngezikweletu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, laba bafuyi abadala abakwazi ukwesekwa ngamabhange ngama-loan, futhi abakwazi ukuvuselela izinkambu abazikhulisa ngemali abanayo. Izinhlaka eziningi ezingenziwa zikhulisiwe azihlanganisiwe, futhi manje abafuyi babhekana nezingozi ngoba izinkomo zikhuluma ngokukhululeka. Uhlelo lwe-CASP lweMnyango Wezolimo luhamba kancane, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwezinkambu. Uhlelo olukhulu lokukhiqiza ukudla luncipha ngoba abafuyi abaningi abakatholi ukwesekwa kulolu hlelo lokutshalwa kokukhiqiza ukudla. Abafuyi basemaphandleni bacela usizo kuhlelo lwe-ASGISA ukuze bakhulise izinkambu zomphakathi wonke, kodwa lokhu akusizi abanikazi bezwe. Lokhu akusona isixazululo esiqinile ngoba siyazi ukuthi lapho i-ASGISA ingakhulisi izinkambu, lezo zinkambu zizoshiywa zingakhuliswa ngoba ngeke kube khona ukuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane futhi abafuyi ngeke babe namandla okuqhubeka bodwa. Amalungu eqembu lokufunda ahlangana njalo ngenyanga. Kukhona inzuzo enkulu ekubeni yilungu leqembu lokufunda ngoba abafuyi bangabelana ngemicabango yabo, bakhomba izidingo zabo mayelana nokuthola ulwazi, futhi basekela omunye nomunye. Abafuyi basemaphandleni bahlupheka futhi abafuyi bezomnotho ngakho-ke abakho abafuyi abaningi abafuyayo ngezomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa kulezi zindawo kuhamba kancane, kodwa ngiyajabula ukuthi intuthuko iyabonakala. Abafuyi basebenzisa imbewu ye-hybrid (izinhlobo ezimbili ezahlukene zembewu), ama-fertilizer afanele, futhi bazama ukususa izitshalo ezingafuneki ezinkambini lapho kukhuliswe khona ummbila.
Ithini leli qembu lokufunda? Enye yezinto ezibalulekile zehlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabathengisi bezolimo ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuphatha amaqembu okufunda. Le phrojekthi ihlose ukukhuthaza abakhiqizi abasafufusa abangenasemafamu ukuba bakhe amaqembu okufunda ukuze bahlangane njalo ukuze baphinde bahlolisise ukuqeqeshwa okukhona nolwazi oluhambelana nokukhiqizwa kweziphuzo. NgeLawrence Luthango (oqale ukusebenza ngoMeyi 2008) eMpumalanga Kapa - kunabangu-14. Ukuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukusebenzisa i-auger, ukujula komhlabathi, ubunzima bomhlabathi obudala ngokulima, ukufaka umanyolo, umphumela wokuhlaziywa komhlabathi, ukuvuthwa komhlabathi, umkhiqizo wombhede, umanyolo, izidingo zokudla kwezitshalo, inani lokudla okukhona emhlabathini, izindlela zokulima, nokugcina amanzi omhlabathi. Imali engabolekwa abakhiqizi - konke okukhuluma ngokubolekwa kwemali, amasu okuphatha imali, izindleko zokukhiqiza, ukubala inani lokukhiqiza, izikhathi zokutshala, ukujula kokutshala, izinhlobo zezithelo, inani lezitshalo ngehektare, umthelela wezimo zezulu ekukhiqizeni, ukukala imvula nokushisa, ukujikeleza kwezithelo, ukusebenzisa ithrekhtha, ukuvuna, inani lokunwetshwa kokudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, ukutshala u-mazayi, izindleko zokuthutha, ukuthenga izinto ezidingekayo ukuze uqale ukulima kahle, usizo ngezinto ezisele emasimini ngemuva kokuvuna, ukuhweba ukudla okwenziwe ngogwayi, izikhwama, nezisekelo ezivela kuhulumeni. Izindleko zokuzisebenzisa, inani lamakilowathi adingekayo ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi othile, izindleko zokulungisa izinto eziphukile, inani lamakilowathi adingekayo ngehektare, ukunciphisa ubukhulu bokulima ukuze kwehliswe izindleko, kanye nezivumelwano zokurenta imishini. Izindlela zokuthola umhlaba, ukukala nokunquma usayizi wemfuyo noma insimu, ukurenta ifamu, izinhlobo zomhlabathi, nezindlela zokuphatha izitshalo ezingafuneki endaweni yakho. Ukuphatha izilokazane ezinsimeni nasekuphatheleni izifo ezithinta izithelo. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezingafuneki, ukuphatha izihlahla ezingafuneki ngezinto zokwakha nezinsiza, ukuphatha izihlahla ezingafuneki ezifana nezihlahla, ukufaka ama-herbicides ngaphambi nangemva kokutshala, nokuphonsa emigqeni noma ensimini yonke. Ubungozi bezilokazane, umshwalense wezilokazane, umshwalense jikelele, nezidingo zokuthola umshwalense.
Uma ufuna ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho lokulima ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukusetha imigomo nezinhlelo zakho. Awukwazi ukuhamba endleleni ungazi ukuthi uhamba kuphi. Ngokuvamile, abakhiqizi baziwa njengabangenakho noma abaphoxekile ngokungasethi imigomo yebhizinisi noma yokuphila. Kunzima ukuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima ngoba izimo zomsebenzi lo azilula; awazi ukuthi ikusasa lizoba kanjani. Kudinga isikhathi esiningi ukuhlanganisa imigomo ecacile yebhizinisi lokulima. Kokubili lokhu kuyiqiniso, kodwa ukubaluleka kokuhlanganisa izinjongo akufanele kushiywe ngemuva, nakuba kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi. Imigomo nezinhlelo (amasu) zikhombisa indlela phambili; ngaphandle kwazo, awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi uzophumelela noma uphumelele. Ngaphandle kwemigomo, awukwazi ukukala ukuthi usebenza kahle ngoba awunanto oyihlosile. Ukuhlanganisa inhloso nokusetha imigomo emsebenzini wokulima kunzima futhi kudinga isikhathi, kodwa kubalulekile ukwenza lo msebenzi; kumele siwenze. Ukusetha nokuhlanganisa imigomo yebhizinisi lokulima kuvame ukuza nezinkinga. Isizathu salokhu sitholakala lapha: ukulima kuyindlela yokusebenza komlimi futhi kuyindlela umlimi aphila ngayo (kuwukuphila kwabo). Umndeni wabo ungowengxenye yezinto ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabo wokulima kanye nokuphila kwabo. Ngokuvamile, siyazi ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yebhizinisi ukwenza inzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kodwa ekulimaleni, lokhu akuhambisani njalo ngoba ibhizinisi nempilo yokuphila kuhlangene. Singasho ukuthi imigomo yalomsebenzi ingaba ukwenza inzuzo enhle, kodwa akufanele ilethe umlimi nomndeni wakhe ubunzima. Izinjongo ezihlanganisiwe ngenhla azichaziwe kahle futhi zingabukwa ngezindlela ezahlukene. Kodwa uma zisetshenziswa, lezi zinjongo zicacile ngoba akukhona abantu ababili abacabanga ngendlela efanayo noma baphila ngendlela efanayo futhi abavumi umndeni omuhle ngendlela efanayo. Ngakho-ke, isifiso somlimi sokwenza inzuzo sizohluka ngoba omunye ngeke abuke lezi zinto ngendlela efanayo futhi ngeke alandele indlela efanayo yokwenza inzuzo. Nokho, kubalulekile kumlimi othile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi impilo enhle izobiza malini mayelana nomsebenzi wabo wokwenza inzuzo, ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele kubo kanye nezidingo zabo. Umphakathi udinga umkhakha wezolimo ukuze ukhiqize imikhiqizo ethile - lokhu kuzohambisana namakhono ezwe elithile - ikakhulukazi ukudla nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ngentengo ephansi, futhi siqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinto. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abalimi kumele basebenzise izinsiza zemvelo ikakhulukazi esikhathini eside. Kodwa izinhloso ezivamile zodwa azizukwanele. Iphrojekthi ngayinye idinga imigomo ethile, kodwa le migomo kufanele ihambisane nenhloso evamile. Isibonelo: umlimi ofuna ukukhiqiza ummbila kufanele abe nemigomo ethile yokukhiqiza ummbila, masithi uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngamahektare angu-500 ommbila obomvu ngonyaka. Kodwa akupheli lapho. Kumele bazi futhi ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo mayelana nemisebenzi edingekayo nezindleko ezizovela ngoba lokhu kuzobakhombisa ukuthi amasheya abo ahlobene kanjani nezidingo zamakhowe nezifuywa. Umlimi ngamunye kumele aqonde ukuthi yimaphi imigomo yabo. Siphinda sithi kubalulekile ukuhlanganisa izinhloso; umlimi kumele aqonde kahle ukuthi ufuna ukuya kuphi ngebhizinisi lakhe lokulima. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kulezi zinjongo, umlimi kumele ahlale phansi acabange ukukhetha imigomo efanele kubo, ukuphila kwabo, nezidingo zabo. Uma beqala ukwakha amasheya amasha ukuze baqhubeke nomsebenzi wabo, kumele baqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi othile uhambisana nezinjongo ezivamile nezidingo zabo. Konke esikushilo mayelana nokuhlanganisa izinhloso kungafingqwa kulezi zisho ezimbalwa: inhloso yebhizinisi lokulima ukufuna ukufinyelela inzuzo enkulu ngangokunokwenzeka, kodwa ngaphandle kokulimaza izinsiza zemvelo (izimpahla) ezifana nomhlabathi, amanzi, izindawo zokufuywa, njll., ukuze zisetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo futhi siqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempahla ezinhle esikhathini eside. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi bahlela izinhlelo zokubheka ukuze baqhubeke beqoqa ulwazi oluzobavumela ukuba baphendule indlela yabo yokusebenza ngokushesha uma kwenzeka umonakalo. Ukuhlanganisa izinhloso kufana nokubuza "lokhu kusho ukuthini" emsebenzini wokulima, okusho ukuthi sifuna impendulo emibuzweni ethi "Sifuna ukwenza ini, sifuna ukufinyelela ini, sifuna ukufika kuphi?" Ezinye izinhloso nezinhlelo zihlupha. Kubalulekile ukusetha inani elithile lemikhiqizo ngehektare - lokhu kusho ukuthi inani lemikhiqizo elibekwe ebhajethi yonyaka kufanele likwazi ukufezeka. Lokhu kuhluka phakathi kwezindawo zokulima ezithile. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yakho ihlangabezana nezidingo zemakethe - umphathi wemikhiqizo kufanele abeke phambili izinhloso ezizohlangabezana nalezi zidingo zemakethe. Lokhu kungafaka izinto ezifana nosayizi, umbala, ikhwalithi yangaphakathi, njll. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo - lokhu kusho ukuthi izici zemvelo zingase zibe sengozini lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, njengezinto ezikhipha izilokazane, izifuywa, njll. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhiqiza kule ndawo kuzokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi usebenza ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeZinhlelo Zokulima Ezinhle (GAP) - i-GAP ifuna ukuthi izinto zisetshenziswe ngokucophelela ngoba zingaba sengozini kulabo abasebenza nazo. Izinto zokubulala izilokazane, izithako, nezifuywa kufanele zisetshenziswe ngokucophelela; amanzi akufanele angcoliswe, futhi kufanele kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuvikela ukulahleka, ukungcoliswa, nokuhamba. Kungase kube nezinye izinhloso ezizosebenza ezindaweni zokulima ezithile, kodwa lezi ezichazwe lapha zizokwandisa ukuthi umsebenzi wakho uzophumelela.
Ulwazi luthathwe kuhlelo lwezemfundo ephakeme lokukhiqiza u-sorghum. Umkhiqizi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi kubalulekile lapho ethuthukisa isu futhi ngaphambi kokutshala, njengoba lokhu kuzokwandisa ithuba lokuthola umkhiqizo ophelele njengoba kuhlobene nazo zonke izenzo ezenziwa umphathi. Lezi ezilandelayo yizinto ezingathinta ikhwalithi yezitshalo ezivunyiwe (izinkwa): ukulungiswa komhlaba, ubukhulu bomhlaba, pH, ibhalansi yezimayini, ukugcina umswakama emhlabeni, uhlobo lwezithombo, umanyolo ofanele, ukuphathwa kwezihlahla nezifo, ukuvunwa ngesikhathi esifanele nokuphathwa, ukuhlanza izinkwa, ukuwasha izinkwa, nezindlela zokugcina (ukubeka) izinkwa. Ukuvunwa kuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu lapho kutshalwa u-sorghum. Siqala ukuvuna ngaphambi kokwenza ezinye izenzo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezinkwa ezifana nokucubungula, ukugcina, nokuvikela umkhiqizo. Nansi eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindawo lapho ukuvunwa, ukugcina, nokuvikela izenzo zihlukaniswe. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokusebenza ezifana nokuvuna ngezandla bese konke okukhishwayo kubekwe ukuze kuvunwe kamuva uma sekomile ezindaweni ezincane. Bese kuqhubeka ezindaweni zokulima ezinkulu lapho imishini isetshenziswa kuphela ukuvuna izinkwa. Ngokuvamile, u-sorghum uvunwa kanye no-maize futhi uvunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma usetshenziswe kusenesikhathi, kanti omunye uvunwa ngoMeyi uma usetshenziswe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvunwa kwe-maize kuqale. Lokhu kubalulekile ezindaweni ezincane lapho ama-combine angavuna u-sorghum no-maize. Umkhiqizi noma umuntu othile uzothola umqashi onemishini ekwazi ukuvuna u-sorghum no-maize. Isikhathi esisuka ekuthuthukisweni kwezinkwa kuya ekuvunweni kufanele sibe mfushane - lokhu kuzovimbela ubungozi obubangelwa izinyoni nokuphuka kwezinkwa nezifo ezahlukene. Izitshalo ze-sorghum zikhula kahle lapho umbala ngemuva kwezinkwa ushintsha, ekuqaleni umbala ubuhlalu bese ushintsha uba mnyama. Lokhu kushintsha kuvame ukwenzeka ngaphambi kokuthi izinkwa zome ukuze zivuziwe. U-sorghum otshalwe kamuva uzobe usulungile kuphela emva kokuhwa kokuqala ebusika. Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuvuna, sebenzisa umshini wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uhlole umswakama wezinkwa uma seziqala ukuvuthwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uzovuna ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma ungenayo imishini yokuhlola umswakama, thina izibonelo zezinkwa kumphathi wesilo eduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna. Ukuze unciphise ukulahleka kwezinkwa ngenxa yokuminyana ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nobungozi bezinyoni, u-sorghum ungavunwa uma umswakama usuka ku-20% kuya ku-25% bese umiswa emshinini wokumisa kuze kube sekufinyelele ku-9.5%. Lokhu kuminyana kuhle ukuze kubekwe (kugcinwe) u-sorghum ezibayeni. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, kungcono ukushiya u-sorghum emhlabeni ukuze umiswe kahle ngaphambi kokuvuna. Khumbula njalo ukuthi uma umswakama uphansi kuka-10%, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha umgubo. Isivinini se-combine kufanele sibe phakathi kuka-5 kuya ku-8 kilometers ngehora. Isivinini esiphezulu phambili sizohambisana nomswakama wezinkwa ze-sorghum nosayizi womkhiqizo. Isivinini kufanele sincishiswe uma umswakama uphansi ukuvimbela izinkwa ukuthi zibhujiswe uma zingena emshinini. Ungakwazi ukuhamba uma umswakama usuka ku-12% kuya ku-15%. Ukuhamba kungagcwalisa i-cylinder kanye ne-augers kakhulu, ngaphandle uma kukhona umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu. Izinkwa ezinomswakama ophakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15% zizobhubhisa kalula uma zingena kwi-cylinder. Izinkwa ezingabujwa ngokuphelele zihlala phansi. I-'concave' ivulekile kakhulu. Kunemathambo amaningi asala. Ukuphuma komoya okuphansi, ukonakala kwi-cylinder kwenzeka ngokushesha. Ukuvuleka kwe-'chaffer' kuncane kakhulu. Imfucumfucu eminingi iyashiywa kwi-'waste' bin. Ukonakala okuphezulu kakhulu, i-cylinder esheshayo, i-'concave' eqinile, umoya ophumayo uhamba kancane, ama-augers avulekile kakhulu. Izinkwa eziphukile zifihliwe. I-cylinder esheshayo, ukuvuleka okuncane kwe-'concave'. Izinkwa zifihliwe kodwa ngaphandle kusemoyeni. Ukuvuleka kwe-'concave' kuncane kakhulu. Izinkwa eziphukile nezihlahla ezikhululekile. Isivinini se-cylinder/rotary siphakeme kakhulu noma kukhona okuncane okusele. Izinkwa ezingabujwa ngokuphelele zihlala phansi. Amabhodi nekhanda akahambelani kahle. Izinkwa ziphuma ngemuva kwe-combine. Isivinini/ukuphuma komoya, hamba kancane emshinini futhi isivinini sokuphuma komoya. Ukulahleka komkhiqizo kungaba ngu-3% - 5% kodwa kungakhula kube ngu-10% - 15% ngezikhathi. Imishini yokuvuna kufanele ihlolwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isebenza kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuyihlola ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi mangaki alahlekile. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umkhiqizi angakwazi ukuqala ukuphatha ukuvunwa nomswakama kahle, kubalulekile ukuba nendlela yokuhlola izinkwa zakho. Uma umkhiqizo wakho muhle, thenga umshini wakho wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uvimbele ukuhamba kwezinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kubalulekile lapho kukhiqizwa nokumakethwa kwezinkwa zokudla. Ukonakala kwezinkwa uma zimanzi kakhulu bese zibekwe ezibayeni uma kubanda kakhulu noma ezibayeni ezisebenzisa umoya okhona kuphela. Izindleko zingavela uma izinkwa zivunwa uma zimanzi kakhulu. Ukukhula kwezinkwa nezindleko zokumisa lezo zinkwa. Ukulahleka kwenani lomkhiqizo. Ukuze wenze ukuhlolwa okuqondile, kufanele uqale uthole isampuli enhle ezokhombisa inani lemikhiqizo yonke. Nansi sithatha isampuli ezitshalo ezingakavunwa (emhlabeni) ukuze sithole ukuthi izinkwa zimanzi kakhulu, lokhu kungasiphazamisa, futhi sithola ukuvuna kube sekwedlule, hhayi ngesikhathi esifanele. Vuna ingxenye bese uyi-test. Hlanganisa amakhanda ezitshalo ozikhethile emhlabeni wonke, uziphumeze kuze kube izinkwa ziphuma. Thatha ukuhlolwa okuthathu kulezi zinkwa futhi uthole okungaphakathi. Thumela le sampuli kumphathi wesilo ukuze enze ukuhlolwa okuqondile. Yenza lokhu njalo uma amakhanda eshintsha abe mnyama ukuze izinkwa zivuziwe ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze kulethe umkhiqizo omuhle. Lokhu kungaba kuhle kumlimi osanda kufika kulabo abizwa ngokuthi abalimi bezohwebo. Kukhona izibaya ezenziwe ngesinyithi esigcwele ezisuka ku-10 kuya ku-30 tons. Uma kungekho mali eningi, izibaya ezincane (10 tons) zingasetshenziswa ekuqaleni, bese lokhu kungakhuliswa njengohlelo lwezibaya ezizokwenziwa njengoba ukulima kuqhubeka. Izinto ezihlobene nokuvuna nokugcina izinkwa zimi kanje: umlimi akanayo indawo yokugcina umkhiqizo wakhe, noma unendawo yokugcina ingxenye yomkhiqizo noma yonke imikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe. Abakhiqizi abakhulu nabo ngeke bakwazi ukuphatha yonke imikhiqizo yabo. Izindawo zabo zokulima zivame ukuba ezind
Isithombe 4: Ubungozi obukhulu buqhamuka ezilwaneni ezilimazayo emapulazini. Uma lezi zilwane ziningi kakhulu, ukukhiqiza izitshalo kungase kungabi nenzuzo. Kukhona izilwane ezilandelayo ezilimini ezingathi zikhathaza - eziningi azinabungozi ezitsholeni. Izilwane ezibangela ubungozi yilezo ezivame ukudla ngempela izitshalo ezikhulayo, izimpande, noma ukudla okukhulayo. Ukuphatha izilwane ezilimazayo kuhilela ukusebenzisa ama-pesticides (imikhiqizo emitholakala ngemithi ebulala izilwane ezilimazayo), ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi esifanele, kanye nenani elifanele le-pesticide - ikakhulukazi ukusebenzisa i-pesticide ethile eqondile ezilwaneni ezithile. Kukhona i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ebulala zonke izilwane ezilimazayo ezidla izitshalo. Uma usebenzisa le pesticide, uzothola imiphumela emihle. Kufanele uhlanganise izindlela ezahlukene ukuze ulawule izilwane ezilimazayo ngempumelelo. Le nhlanganisela izosiza ukuvimbela ukwanda kwezilwane ezithile ezivame ukubangela ubungozi ezitsholeni zakho. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane ezilimazayo ezidla izitshalo, njengokuthi: ama-cutworms, ama-beetles anemibala, nezinye. Lezi zilwane zinciphisa inani lezitshalo ezikhulayo - uma zingaphathwa kahle, kuzodingeka ukuphinda zifakwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi kemikhono kufanele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kulawulwe izilwane ezilimazayo ngempumelelo. Ukuphatha lezi zinkinga akubizi kakhulu kodwa kufanele uthathe isinyathelo ngokushesha ukuvimbela ukuthi zidalule ubungozi ezikhathini zokuqala zokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukulima ebusika kuzophinde kusize ukubulala izilwane eziningi ngoba ebusika zihlala ezinsalela zezinto ezishiwo ezisemathafeni. Uma zihlala ngaphandle kwezitshalo eziphilayo izinsuku ezingama-35, izinkinga eziningi ezidalwa lezi zilwane zizokwenyuka. Imbewu ezizofakwa ingaphathwa ngama-pesticides noma i-pesticide ingafakwa emhlabathini lapho kufakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokubeka i-bait emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Umhlabathi ungaphinde uphuziswe nge-pesticide efanele. I-corn earworm (astylus atromaculatus), i-cutworm (agrotis segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ifile (protostrophus sulcatifrons), kanye nama-harpalus beetles angabangela ubungozi obukhulu ezitsholeni, futhi inani lezitshalo ezinhle lingancipha ngaphandle kokuba nenzuzo. I-African bollworm (helicoverpa armigera) iyalimaza ikhanda lesitshalo futhi ingadala ukuvuleka kwe-fungus rhizopus microsporus. Izilwane ezinjenge-nysius nataensis zingaphinde zilimaze izitshalo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-pesticides abhalisiwe ukuze abulale izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane ezilimazayo. Kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezilwane ezibangela ubungozi. Ngaleso sikhathi uzokwazi ukukhetha i-pesticide efanele - qaphela ukufaka i-pesticide ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nasemazingeni afanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo kanye nosayizi wesitshalo. Ukufaka ama-pesticides kungavimbela ukuncipha kokukhiqiza, kodwa umbulali kufanele abe nekhono ngoba kuhilela izindleko. Kubalulekile ukuhlola kahle uma izilwane ezilimazayo zibangela ubungozi obukhulu, noma kungase kubize kakhulu ngaphandle kokusiza ngoba izindleko zizodlula inzuzo. Akukhuthazeki ukuphuzisa izitshalo uma izilwane ezilimazayo zingakabi nengozi enkulu. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi kukhona abaphangi bemvelo abawadla ezinye izilwane ezilimazayo. Uma uphuzisa kakhulu, lezi zilwane ezidla izilwane ezilimazayo zizobulawa, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi izilwane ezilimazayo zizokwazi ukujwayela i-pesticide uma ifakwa kaningi futhi ngeke zife. Imikhiqizo emitholakala ngemithi nayo iyingozi futhi iyalimaza umhlabathi, ngakho kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela uma kudingeka kakhulu. Ukulima ngaphambi kokufaka kusiza ukuvimbela ubungozi bezilwane ezilimazayo. Nokho, inani lezilwane ezilimazayo kufanele liqapheke njalo ukuze izindleko zikwazi ukuphathwa ngempumelelo. Ngokuvamile, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela ezihlanganisiwe zokuvikela ubungozi bezilwane ezilimazayo - sebenzisa indlela ehambisana nohlobo lwezilwane ezilimazayo ngesikhathi esifanele sesitshalo esithile. Ukuphatha izilwane ezilimazayo kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezitshalo ngoba kuzokhombisa ukuthi kuzoba nenzuzo ekulimaleni nasekukhiqizeni noma cha. Izifo zezihlahla zinciphisa inani kanye nekhwalithi yokukhiqiza futhi zingabangela ubungozi empilweni yezimpahla nasemphakathini uma zidliwa. Izifo zezihlahla zidalwa ikakhulukazi ama-fungi, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-virus. Lezi zingalimaza zonke izingxenye zesitshalo - izimpande, iziqu, amahlamvu, amafulegi, kanye nezimbewu ezidliwayo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezifo zidinga izimo ezahlukene ukuze zikhule. Isifo singakhula kuphela uma sithintana nezimo zezulu kanye nendawo, uma kukhona isitshalo esifanele futhi isifo sikhona. Lezi zinto ezintathu zingabhekwa njengesisekelo sokusabalala kwesifo. Uma enye ingekho, isifo ngeke sikhule futhi sithinte. Isifo esithile esingase sibe khona endaweni ethile kulonyaka singase singabi khona kule ndawo ngonyaka ozayo uma imvelo yendawo nezimo zezulu zihluka kulonyaka. Ngenxa yokulibaziseka okukhulu ekuqaleni kokufaka izitshalo, ngokuvamile akuvumelekile ukuphatha lezi zifo ngama-chemicals ngoba kubiza kakhulu. Ezinye izifo zihlala zikhona kodwa azikhuli ngoba azithintani nesitshalo noma nezimo zezulu. Izifo ziphathwa ngokuqinisekisa nokuvikela. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izifo ngokuvikela. Kukhona izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhuliswe ukuze zibe nokumelana nezinye izifo. Lokhu kumelana kwesitshalo kubhekisela ekulweni nesifo esithile; akusho ukuthi ezinye izifo azikwazi ukulimaza lelo sitshalo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi yisiphi isifo esivame ukubangela ubungozi endaweni yakho bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungakwazi ukumelana nalolo sifo. Ukuphatha ngama-chemicals kusho ukusebenzisa i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ukuze ubulale izifo ezithile ze-fungal kanye ne-bacterial ezimweni ezithile. Kufanele ucabange kahle izindleko zokuthenga i-pesticide - kungase kube kuhle ukufuna iseluleko kumeluleki wezokulima mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwemithi ethile. Ukulima umhlabathi kungaba yinto ebalulekile uma uzama ukuphatha izifo - ezinye izifo zihlala ezinsaleni ezishiwo ezisemathafeni, ngakho kufanele wazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona bese ukhetha indlela efanele yokulima umhlabathi. Ukushintsha izinhlobo zezihlahla kusho ukuhlinzeka isikhathi sokuthi izinsalela ezishiwo ezisemathafeni zife. Kubalulekile ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezithanda yiziphi izitshalo bese ubhekana nalolo daba ngokushintsha izinhlobo zezitshalo ozifakayo. Isikhathi sokufaka sithinta futhi ukukhula kwesifo esithile - ukufaka ngaphambi kwesikhathi noma emva kwesikhathi kungavimbela isifo esithile ekukhuleni nasekubangeleni ubungozi. Ingxenye yokudala ubunzima ekukhul
Akukwazi ukusho ukuthi zonke izilokazane ezivame ukutholakala ezitshalweni azinabungozi. Ziyingxenye yezilokazane eziletha izifo ezitshalweni. Lezo ezinobungozi zingadla imbewu efakwe, ezinye zidle isitshalo ngesikhathi sikhula, ezinye lapho isitshalo sesiqinile, ezinye zidle imizi kanti ezinye zidle amahlamvu uma seziphumelele. Ukuphatha izilokazane kuhlobene kakhulu nezinto zokwakha (izinto ezibulala izilokazane). Kukhona izinto zokwakha ezibhalisiwe zokubulala zonke izilokazane ezinobungozi ezitshalweni. Izindlela zokuphatha izilokazane ezihlanganisiwe zingaba nomthelela omuhle - izindlela ezihlukene zisetshenziselwa ukuvimbela ukukhula kwezilokazane nokunciphisa ubungozi obudala. Kukhona izilokazane ezihlukene ezidlayo imbewu nezitshalo ezisanda kuqala ukukhula, isibonelo: ama-wireworms, ama-beetle anemibala, ama-cutworms, njll. Lezi zilokazane zinciphisa inani lembewu efakwe futhi kuzodingeka ukuthi kufakwe kabusha. Ukuphatha kahle lezi zilokazane kuhlobene nokufaka umuthi wokubulala izilokazane ngendlela efanele, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokufaka. Ukuhlwanyela ebusika kuzosisiza ukuphatha eziningi zalezi zilokazane - kudinga izinsuku eziyi-35 noma ngaphezulu lapho zingatholi isitshalo sokudla futhi eziningi zizofa. Imbewu ezizofakwa ingaphathwa ngummuthi wokubulala izilokazane, noma umuthi wokubulala izilokazane ungafakwa emhlabathini lapho kuzofakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokubeka umthombo phezulu emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Insimu ye-maize ingaphuziswa nomuthi wokubulala izilokazane ofanele. I-beetle enkulu enombala edlayo i-maize (Astylus Atromaculatus), i-cutworm (Agrotis Segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ingalive "doodhouertjie" (Protostrophus Sulcatifrons) kanye ne-harpalus beetle kungadala ubungozi obukhulu futhi kunciphise inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile enhle. Ekugcineni, akukho inzuzo ezotholakala kule nsimu. I-African bollworm (Helicoverpa Armigera) ibhujisa isitshalo se-maize futhi ivula indlela yokungena kwezifo ezifana ne-Rhizopus Microsporus. Izilokazane ezithokozisayo ezifana ne-Nysius Nataensis nazo zingabhaqa imbewu ye-maize ekhula. Kukhona izinhlobo ezihlukene zezinto zokwakha ezibhalisiwe zokubulala izinhlobo ezihlukene zezilokazane ezihlasela isitshalo. Kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlonza ukuthi iyiphi izinhlobo zezilokazane ezinobungozi bese ukhetha umuthi wokubulala izilokazane ofanele ukufaka ngendlela efanele nangasikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kungahluka ngokuya ngohlobo lwezilokazane nokukhula kwesitshalo. Ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane ukuze kubulwe izilokazane kungasiza ukuvimbela ubungozi ezitshalweni, kodwa kubiza imali eningi - ngakho-ke umphakathi kufanele abalwe kahle ukuthi izindleko zizoba ziningi kangakanani. Kufanele kubhekwe kahle lapho kudingeka ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane - kuzofika isikhathi lapho umphakathi ubona ukuthi kubalulekile kakhulu ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane ngoba ubungozi ezitshalweni buzoba bukhulu kunenani lokufaka umuthi. Akukuhle ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane ezitshalweni uma izilokazane zingakakhethi ubungozi obukhulu. Isizathu salokhu: kukhona ezinye izidalwa zemvelo ezidlayo lezi zilokazane, kodwa nazo zibhujiswa umuthi wokubulala izilokazane kanti ezinye izilokazane zithola amandla okuphila emithini ethile yokubulala izilokazane. Ukuhlwanyela ngaphambi kokufaka imbewu kuyindlela enhle yokuvimbela ubungozi bezilokazane. Kodwa inani lezilokazane kufanele liqapheke njalo ukuze izindleko zokuvimbela zingakhuphuki kakhulu. Kukhona ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo eziqinile ngokumelene nezilokazane - lokhu kuzosisiza esikhathini esifushane ngoba ngeke kudingeke ukufaka imithi yokubulala izilokazane, futhi esikhathini eside kuzosisiza ngoba inani lezi zilokazane lizoncipha. Kungcono ukuhlela konke futhi usebenzise izindlela ezihlukene ukuphatha lezi zifo - sebenzisa indlela ethile ngesikhathi esifanele ezitshalweni ezithile. Ukuphatha izilokazane kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezolimo jikelele ngoba kunganciphisa noma kukhuphule umkhiqizo kanye nezindleko zokukhiqiza ekugcineni. Izifo zezithombo zinciphisa umkhiqizo kanye nekhwalithi yokudla futhi zingabangela ukuba imikhiqizo kanye nabantu abathokozela leyo ndawo bahlupheke. Ama-fungi, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-virus abanga izifo ezitshalweni. Lezi zingabhaqa isitshalo sonke - imizi, izimpande, amahlamvu, kanye nezithelo. Lezi zifo ezihlukene zidinga izimo ezihlukene ukuze zikhule futhi zandise. Isifo singakhula kuphela uma izimo zezulu zifanele, uma kukhona isitshalo lapho singakhula khona, futhi uma isifo sikhona. Lezi zinto ezintathu zingabizwa ngokuthi (i-triangular) i-triangle eyinhloko yesifo. Uma eyodwa ilahlekile, isifo asikwazi ukukhula. Isifo esingase sibe khona ngesikhathi esithile endaweni ethile singase singabi khona ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba izimo zezulu zingashintsha. Njengoba i-maize ibiza imali eningi ukufaka, kuvame ukuthatha umzamo omningi ukubulala nokuphatha izifo ngezinto zokwakha. Ezinye izifo zivame ukuba khona kodwa azikhuli ngoba eyodwa yezinto ze-triangle ilahlekile. Kungcono ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvimbela izifo futhi zizophathwa kangcono. Kukhona izinto ezihlukene ezingakusiza uvimbele izifo ukuthi ziqale ukukhula. Ezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo zithola amandla okulwa nezifo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zikhono zokulwa nezifo zivame ukuhamba kuphela nezifo ezithile, hhayi zonke. Kubalulekile ukuhlonza ukuthi iyiphi isifo esingase sikhule endaweni ethile bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungakwazi ukulwa naleyo zifo. Ukuphatha ngezinto zokwakha kusho ukusebenzisa umuthi wokubulala izilokazane obhalisiwe ukuze kubulwe ama-fungi namabhaktheriya ezimweni ezithile zezulu. Kufanele ucabangele kahle izindleko zomuthi wokubulala izilokazane ngaphambi kokuwathenga. Izindlela zokuhlwanyela zingaba yinto ebalulekile uma sifuna ukuphatha izifo - izimpande ezisele ensimini zigcina ezinye zalezi zifo. Indlela esihlwanyela ngayo kufanele ibhekane nalokhu futhi kufanele sazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona. Ukuphindaphinda izinhlobo zezitshalo ensimini eyodwa kuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngezimpande ezisele isikhathi esanele sokuphela nokuxhumana nomhlabathi. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezingenzeka ezitshalweni ezithile, ukuze izitshalo ezifanele zikwazi ukukhethwa lapho ziphindaphindwa. Isikhathi sokufaka imbewu singahlanganiswa nokuphuma kwesifo esithile - ukufaka imbewu masinyane noma sekuhleliwe kunganciphisa ukusabalala kwesifo esithile. Ingxenye yezinto ezidala ingcindezi ihlobene nezifo. Izinto ezidala ingcindezi ezitshalweni zifaka: umswakama (okuncane kakhulu noma okuningi), ukushisa, ubanda, ukungabi nezithako ezanele emhlabathini, ubisi, kanye nokulimala kwezilokazane. Lapho sifuna ukuphatha izifo ngendlela efanele, kufanele sizame ukususa eyodwa yezinto ze-triangle yalezi zifo. Lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma sisebenzisa uhlelo lokuphatha iz
I-sunflower iyinsimu ebalulekile yokukhiqiza uwoyela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, ngokwesiko ikhiqiza cishe ama-ton angama-650,000 ngonyaka. Imbewu ye-sunflower enokuqukethwe okuphezulu kwe-oyela - 44% - iyingxenye enkulu yokukhiqiza kwethu. Imbewu ye-sunflower enokuqukethwe okuphansi kwe-oyela - 25% kuya ku-38% - isetshenziswa ekubhakeni amakhekhe nasekudleni kwezinyoni. I-sunflower ingakhuliswa ezindaweni eziningi zelizwe lethu lapho imvula iphakathi kuka-475 mm no-675 mm ngonyaka. Nokho, kunoma iyiphi indawo, ukukhiqizwa kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela ezokwenza inzuzo. Intengo ye-sunflower ikhulile kakhulu muva nje, futhi sikholelwa ukuthi izohlala iphezulu unyaka wonke. Imbewu yekhwalithi ephezulu, efanayo ngaphandle kwembewu yezinambuzane kufanele icatshangelwe lapho kukhethwa izinhlobo zembewu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isivuno sakho asibanga sengozini. Imbewu yokukhiqiza ephezulu yalo nyaka ayikwazi ukufakwa kabusha ngonyaka ozayo. Le mibewu izokhiqiza amakhanda amaningi, okwenza ukuvuna ngezindlela zomshini kube nzima futhi kuzokhiqiza imbewu encane. Ukuqala kokushoda emanzini ezindaweni eziningi kusukela ekupheleni kukaDisemba kuya ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari kufanele kucatshangelwe ngokucophelela njengoba kubalulekile lapho kukhethwa isikhathi sokuf planting. Isikhathi sokuphuma kwe-sunflower sibalulekile ngoba ngesikhathi lesi izitshalo zidinga amanzi amaningi, futhi zingathinteka uma kushoda. Ngakho-ke, isikhathi sokuf planting kufanele sikhethwe ngokucophelela ukuze kuvinjelwe isikhathi sokushoda sibe ne-sunflower. Ingozi yokwehluleka kokuvuna iyanda uma i-sunflower ifakwe emhlabathini omanzi. Uma imvula ikuhle ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuf planting, futhi umhlabathi ungena, ama-sunflower afakwe kusenesikhathi anethuba elihle lokuphumelela. Isinqumo sokuf planting kusenesikhathi noma sekwephuzile sihambisana nenani lokungena elitholakala emhlabathini. Umlando wokushoda kokungena phakathi nezikhathi zonyaka kufanele futhi ucabangele. Nokho, awukwazi ukulinda isikhathi eside kakhulu ngoba ukwanda kokudla emibewwini kungase kwenzeke uma isimo sezulu sishisa, bese isivuno sincipha. Ngokuvamile, izikhathi zokuf planting zingalandela le mikhombandlela: ezindaweni ezibandayo empumalanga, ungafaka kusukela ekuqaleni kukaNovemba kuze kube ngesonto lokuqala likaDisemba; ezindaweni ezisemaphakathi nezwe lethu, ungakwazi ukuqala ukuf planting ngesonto lokugcina likaNovemba kuze kube sekupheleni kukaDisemba; ezindaweni ezomile empumalanga, ungafaka kusukela ekupheleni kukaDisemba kuze kube ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari. Khumbula ukuthi uma ufaka sekwephuzile, kunganciphisa isivuno. I-sunflower ingafakwa ezindaweni ezijulile ezivela ku-2.5 cm kuya ku-5 cm, kuye ngohlobo lomhlabathi nesikhathi sokuf planting. Ujule kufanele ube phezulu emhlabathini onzima (njengokhula) kodwa ungaba phezulu emhlabathini opholile. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi imbewu ifakwe emhlabathini ongena kahle ukuze isize ukuvutha. Kubalulekile ukuthi umhlabathi ube nokuxhumana okuhle nembewu. Sebenzisa indlela yokuf planting ethembekile. Imbewu kufanele ibekwe ngokulinganayo. Ukuphuma phakathi kwezitshalo kubalulekile ngoba izitshalo kufanele ziqhube ngokufanayo; akufanele kube khona ezinye eziseduze kakhulu ukuze ziqhube ukudla nokukhanya. Inani lezitshalo ezingaphumelela endaweni ethile lihambisana nenani lokungena elitholakala emhlabathini. Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke kakhulu kunezikhala phakathi kwemigqa. Izikhala phakathi kwemigqa ezindaweni ezithola kuphela imvula zingahluka ukusuka ku-0.91 m kuya ku-2.1 m noma ku-2.3 m. Lokhu kuzohambisana nohlobo lwemishini esetshenzisiwe kanye nendlela yokulima. Inani eliphansi kakhulu lezitshalo lizonciphisa isivuno esingaba khona, kodwa inani eliphezulu kakhulu lizokwenza izitshalo ziqhube, kuholele ekwehliseni isivuno. Izitshalo eziseduze kakhulu zihlala zithinteka ezilimini (njengokubola kwemizi) futhi zihlala ziwela phansi. Inani elinconyiwe lezitshalo (akufanele libe ngaphansi kwama-20,000 ezitshalo ngehektare kuzo zonke izindawo). (I-hektare ingama-100 amamitha ngama-100 amamitha). Kunconywa ukuthi ubungako bokuf planting bushintshwe ukuze ufake imbewu engama-10% engeziwe kunenani elinconyiwe ngoba ezinye zizophumelela ukuvutha ngenxa yokushoda, umonakalo wezilokazane, kanye nokucindezela komhlabathi ngemuva kwemvula enkulu ngesikhathi sokuqala sokuvutha. Ngempela, uma uthola ukuthi kunezitshalo ezingaphansi kwama-20,000 ngehektare, kufanele ucabangele ukufaka kabusha ngesikhathi kusasele isikhathi esanele sokuvutha okuhle.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhloselwe ukusiza labo balimi abaphumelele ekufundeni. Lezi zinkampani zidinga usizo ngabanye mayelana nokwakha isu lokukhiqiza, ukuphatha imisebenzi yokulima, ukuphatha izindaba zezimali, njll. Abalimi abakhethiwe bazothola ukwesekwa okukhulu unyaka wonke. Unyaka nonyaka, abalimi abasha bazokhethwa ukuze bathole le nsizakalo, emva kwalokho bazophila ngokuzimela kodwa bazothola usizo lwefoni kubaphathi ababelana ngolwazi ezindaweni zabo. Uma umbulimi ekhiqiza ngaphezu kwamathani angama-250 ngonyaka, bazokwethulwa kwabanye abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo - lokhu kuzosheshisa ukungena kwabamnyama ezimakethe zomnotho. Bonke abalimi abawamalungu ale nhlangano bathola ukwesekwa ekwakheni ipotfoliyo yabo, ehlanganisa isu lebhizinisi lonyaka. Ipotfoliyo izohlinzeka ngethuba lokufaka isicelo semali ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lezi zinkampani zizovakashelwa njalo ngababoni bezifunda abazozisiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo nokubheka imisebenzi yabo efana nokulungisa umhlabathi, ukuf planting, ukususa izitshalo, ukuchela, ukuvuna, nokumaketha. Sikholelwa ukuthi le nqubekela phambili kwezomnotho kufanele ibhekwe ngokucophelela futhi kufanele sithokozise labo abenza intuthuko. Sabe nesivumelwano sokumema abalimi abathile ukuba bajoyine i-250 Ton Club. Kukho izahluko ze-250 Ton, 500 Ton, kanye ne-1,000 Ton - siyabonga abalimi futhi sinikeze izimpawu ezikhombisa isimo sabo kulezi zinkundla. Sizama ukukhombisa ibhizinisi lokulima jikelele ukuthi kukhona inqubekela phambili emsebenzini wethu wokuhlanganisa abalimi nomnotho.
Sicela uthathe umzuzu ukuze uqedele le miphumela elandelayo. Zonke izincwadi ezigcwalisiwe zizohlanganiswa futhi kuzobanjwa umncintiswano kulabo abawina. Kuzoba nabawinile abangu-10, abazothola ibhaskithi yezitshalo - izitshalo ezanele zokutshala ihektare eyodwa. Uphi umphakathi kanye nesifunda lapho ulima khona? Usayizi wempesheni yakho ungakanani? Uthola imvula njalo ngenyanga? Bangaki abantu emndenini wakho abafunda iPula Imvula? Uthanda ukufunda izinto ezibhaliwe kangakanani? Ucabanga ukuthini ngokuqhuba kolimi kwiPula Imvula? Uzigcina yini izinkcazelo zePula Imvula? Ingabe ulwazi olukhona luyabaluleka kuwe? Ucabanga ukuthi isimo sePula Imvula sibhala kanjani? Yiziphi izihloko ofuna zixoxwe ezinyangeni ezizayo? Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise iPula Imvula?
Ukulima nekusasa: kungani kuthatha isikhathi eside? Sizama ukuvuselela abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono ukuze babe abalimi abakwazi ukuziphilisa ngokwabo esikhathini esizayo. Ngoba isimo sezimali samanje emhlabeni sikhulu, lokhu kuzoba nzima - nokho, ungumuntu ophumelelayo. Uma ukulima eNingizimu Afrika kuzothuthuka, sidinga ukufezekisa uguquko oluphelele emhlabeni wezolimo ukuze sikwazi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezivamile. Ukulima akulula; abalimi babhekana nezinto eziningi futhi kwesinye isikhathi bazibeka engozini. Amanani aphansi ezimpahla zokudla enza kube nzima kubalimi ukwenza inzuzo ezimpahleni zabo. Izinga lenzalo liphezulu futhi izindleko zemishini ziphakamisa. Abalimi abanamakhono kwezomnotho nabo babhekana nezinselelo (bakhathazekile!) - singakusho ukuthini ngalabo abasanda kuvela? Uhulumeni angabasiza kanjani? Njengamanje, ukukhiqiza izimpahla zokudla ukuze uthole inzuzo kunzima; abalimi abasanda kuvela kungenzeka bangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokulima esikhathini esizayo. Sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha; amanani ez food azophakama futhi. Kodwa okwamanje, sidinga ukweseka abalimi ngezimali, njengezikhwama - ukusiza ngezindleko zokuqala zokutshala noma ukuhlinzeka ngama-bonuses ezimpahleni ezikhiqiziwe. Le mikhankaso izoqinisekisa ukuthi labo abasebenza kanzima bazothola ama-bonuses - lokhu kuzosiza abalimi abanamakhono ukuba babe nezomnotho eziphumelelayo. Enye inkinga enkulu isimo semishini nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa abalimi abasanda kuvela - sidinga isisekelo sezimali ukusiza abalimi ukulungisa imishini yabo. Kunengxenye yezigaba zohulumeni ezihlinzeka ngempahla nemishini kubalimi. Lokhu kungasiza ngesikhathi esifushane, kodwa labo abalimi kudingeka baqeqeshwe ukuze baphathe le mishini kahle. Lapho imishini isetshenziswa ngamaqembu abantu, akekho ozothatha umthwalo wokuphatha - kaningi imishini iyashiywa inganakekelwa futhi ngokushesha iyaba unusable. Lo msebenzi awukwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Izikhungo ezabelana ngolwazi kufanele futhi ziqeqeshwe ukuze ziqhubeke nemisebenzi yazo ngempumelelo - kunezikhungo eziningi ezinjalo, futhi kufanele zikwazi ukusiza abalimi ezindaweni zokulima. Ingxenye yezinselelo abalimi abasanda kuvela abahlangabezana nazo ukufinyelela uxhaso lokuqala lokulima. Kuneziningi ezinomhlaba nezinsiza (mhlawumbe ezinye azisebenzi kahle), baqeqeshwe futhi baxhaswe, kodwa badinga imali. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphakamisa - kuthatha R4,000 kuya ku-R5,000 ukutshala ihektare eyodwa. Ekuqaleni, sathokoziswa ukubona amabhizinisi ezolimo esiza abalimi abasanda kuvela ngoxhaso lokuqala, futhi kusekhona amabhizinisi ezolimo axhasa abalimi ukuze babe nezomnotho eziphumelelayo. Baxhasa abalimi ekulungiseni nasekuqondiseni izinsiza nemishini yabo. Kanjani kufanele kusetshenziswe abaqashi bezolimo? Ingxenye yezindlela zokuqala zokulima umhlaba wukusebenzisa abaqashi abakhulu. Lokhu sekwenziwe izikhathi eziningi, futhi kuthiwa umqashi uzosetshenziswa kuphela ekuqaleni, ekugcineni umlimi uzosebenza ngokwabo. Umlimi akatholi inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza nemishini. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ziya zanda. Imali ekhokhwa ukuze uthole umqashi ingasetshenziswa ukulungisa nokugcina izinsiza nemishini. Abalimi abangasebenzi nomqashi, ngakho-ke, abafundi ukusebenza ngokwabo. Isimo sezulu esomile ezindaweni eziningi lapha senza isikhathi sokutshala, ukusika, nokuvuna sibe mfushane; kaningi umsebenzi awenziwa ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi umlimi ulahlekelwa umkhiqizo wabo (ukutshala nokufaka umanyolo sekwephuzile). Umqashi ukhokhelwa ngehektare elitshaliwe, hhayi ngokusekelwe kumgangatho womsebenzi wabo - noma umlimi enza inzuzo noma cha, umqashi uthola ukukhokhelwa kwabo. Kukhona abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakhiqiza futhi banemithombo. Laba abalimi kufanele bakwazi ukuqasha izinkambu kubanye abanikazi bomhlaba abangafuni noma abangakwazi ukulima. Njengamanje, izindawo eziningi zikhishwa ngama-agribusinesses, ngakho-ke abanye abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakwazi ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Lapho kukhona abalimi abangenazo izinsiza, kuthiwa bazokwazi ukwenza inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza. Kodwa lokhu akukwenzeka - inzuzo etholakalayo ekulimaleni kwezimpahla zokudla incane kakhulu, futhi abaqashi baphinde banciphise inzuzo. Bonke abasebenza ekulimaleni kufanele babe nesivumelwano sokuxhasa abalimi. Abalimi bafuna ukusebenza ngokwabo; abafuni ukuba balimwe abanye. Nika umlimi ithuba lokuqala ukulima ngalokho abanakho - ukuqala ngezimpahla ezincane endaweni encane akubeki ingozi enkulu. (Khumbula ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukulima emhlabeni wabo usuphila kule ndawo. Uma bengakwazi ukwenza inzuzo encane kuphela ngaphezu kwalokho ababephila kukho, kungabasiza kakhulu. Ngokusebenza kanzima, lowo mlimi uzokhula ekulimaleni). Ungacindezeli umlimi ukuba aqashe umqashi; kungcono ukusiza ukuwulungisa imishini yabo futhi balime ngokwabo ngalokho abanakho - mhlawumbe kungcono kubo ukuqasha izinkambu abangakwazi ukuziphatha. Ukusebenza nomuntu onolwazi (umqeqeshi) kuzosisiza kakhulu - kodwa umqeqeshi kufanele akhethwe ngokucophelela! Kumele kube umuntu ozinikele ofuna ukusiza umlimi akhule - ozothatha isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono futhi abaxhase. Kumele bahlangane futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye ngempumelelo. Hlinzeka abalimi ngemininingwane futhi ungathathi izinyathelo ngaphandle kokuhlangana nabo. Kuthiwa - asifuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu - futhi kufanele kube njalo lapha. Ukuxhasa abalimi ngokuhlola nokunquma zonke izimpahla zabo ezisemhlabeni, izinkambu, izinsiza, imishini, izinkomo, izitshalo, nezinye izinsiza, njll. Kumele baqonde kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani ekulimaleni. Isibonelo: bangaki kW (amandla) umlimi adinga ukuze alime izinkambu ezithile? Qinisekisa ukuthi umlimi ungene ohlelweni oluzomfundisa futhi luthuthukise. Ukuba umlimi ophumelelayo kwezomnotho kuthatha isikhathi, futhi kunezinhlangano eziningi ezingasiza ekuthuthukiseni abalimi. Hlola isimo sokuqeqeshwa esinikezwa. Kukhona abaqeqeshi abaqashwe abangenzi kahle ngoba nabo baphuthuma amakhono okusebenza (awukwazi ukufunda ukulima ngokufunda kuphela izincwadi!). Qinisekisa ukuthi ungasiqali ngephrojekthi enkulu kakhulu. Abalimi abasanda kuvela badinga isikhathi nokuxhaswa; uma iphrojekthi ikhula kakhulu, izinto ziba nzima, futhi konke kuwa. Kungaba kuhle ukuxhasa abalimi abangama-50 noma ngaphezulu (ekuqaleni), kodwa kaningi lokhu kuwa ngoba kungekho izandla ezanele zokwenza umsebenzi. Kungcono ukuqala ngabalimi abangama-15 - 20 bese wandisa inani ngonyaka.
Ukukhala kokukhuluma: "Umhlabathi uyifa labantu futhi bonke abantu abathokozile benhlangano: umhlaba ungowethu. Umhlabathi uyindawo yokukhula zonke izinhlobo zokudla futhi udala umsebenzi wezolimo. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakufaka esikhundleni. Ngakho, thina njengabantu sinezibopho zokugcina leli th Treasure lethu ngokukhuthaza njalo, silisebenzise ngendlela efanele, ukuze sakhe umhlaba onempilo ngoba umhlaba onempilo ungakha kuphela ezimpahleni zomhlabathi eziphilayo." - JC Ross. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakufaka esikhundleni. Ngaphakathi kwayo, akukho okushintshayo. Konke okwenzeka, njengokuphuma komhlabathi, kubangele umhlabathi ukuba wakhiwe ezitokisini. Nokho, kufanele sihlukanise phakathi kokushintsha kwemvelo nokushintsha okwenziwa abantu. Ukwakhiwa komhlabathi kwemvelo kuthatha izinkulungwane zeminyaka, kodwa umuntu angawuchitha konke lokhu ngosuku olulodwa uma engasebenzisi umhlabathi ngendlela efanele futhi ezolimo ngendlela engahambisani nezimiso zokulima eziqhubekayo. Ukuphatha kahle ukuhamba komhlabathi kuzuza umlimi kanye nabantu bonke emhlabeni - kusiza umnikazi ukugcina umhlabathi nomswakama (amanzi) ngaphakathi komhlabathi, kusiza abanye ukuvimbela imifula ukuthi ingawashiyi impahla yabo, kuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi emifula acacile futhi kuqinisekisa umhlaba emhlabeni jikelele. Ukulahleka komhlabathi nokukhiqiza kwawo. Ukulahleka kwamanzi agijimayo angasetshenziswa. Ukuwohloka kwezindawo zokulima nomhlabathi ongakhiqizi ukudla. Izikhukhula (zamanzi amaningi) kanye nezomiso ezinzima. Ukwehla kwenani lemakethe yomhlaba. Ukwehla kwemikhawulo yokwenza inzuzo kwezolimo. Izindawo zokulima azisakhiqizi, zishiywe. Izitshalo ezikhula kahle. Kukhona izinto ezintathu eziyinhloko ezibangela ukuhamba komhlabathi: amanzi, umoya, kanye neqhwa. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sibhekene kakhulu nokuhamba kwamanzi, bese sihamba sihlole ukuhamba komoya. Ukuhamba kwamanzi kwenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuhamba kwamanzi phezulu nokwakhiwa kwemifula.
