Ngokuvamile, umhlabathi lapho kuzolima khona ulungiselelwe kahle, uyakhululwa, uyathambile, uyazinzile. Okwamanje, sisebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi ukulima okuncane - umhlabathi awusulungiswanga ngendlela evamile ukuvimbela ukulahleka komhlabathi ophakeme. Isikhathi sokulima siphinde sibe yisikhathi sezikhukhula ezinzima. Lapho kuwa imvula enkulu kulomhlabathi olulungiselelwe, umhlabathi uvame ukujula, kodwa kuvame ukuba khona amakhompiyutha amancane omhlabathi azohamba namanzi. Ngemuva kwemvula yokuqala, amanzi amaningi aqala ukuhamba futhi agijime lapho kukhona ukwehla, ethwele umhlabathi nezinye izinto. Lokhu kungaqhubeka isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuba kubonakale kalula. Ekugcineni, umlimi uzobona ukuthi izinkulungwane zamathani omhlabathi zilahlekile ngonyaka. Ngokuvamile izindawo zokulima azihambisani, ezinye ziphakeme, ezinye zisezingeni eliphansi, futhi isimo somhlabathi asifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Amanzi avame ukuhamba ngaphansi kwezindawo eziphakeme, akha imifula emincane yokukhula. Lapho ukuhamba kwenzeka endaweni enokwehla, lezi zimpophoma zixubana ukuze zakhe imifula engavezwa ngamagatsha ezihlahla - bese kwakhiwa imifula emikhulu. Lapho amanzi eqala ukuhamba emifula ethile, amandla ale mfula ayanda futhi ukuhamba nakho kukhula kakhulu. Lapho ukuhamba okufana nezithupha kufika endaweni lapho imifula eyakhiwe ingasapholisa, kufika ezingeni lokuhamba okufana nezithupha. Lokhu kukhuphuka okusheshayo kwemifula kungalimaza izindawo ezinkulu zomhlaba futhi kuvimbe ukuqhubeka kokulima kulezo zindawo. Izizukulwane zethu ezizayo zinethemba lokuthi sizogcina umhlabathi ukuze bakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ngokuphatha umhlabathi kahle, singaqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba uzosasebenza kusasa nakusasa.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwefarmers luhloselwe ukusungula nokuphatha izindawo lapho kwenziwa khona izivivinyo ezizama ukukhombisa abalimi imiphumela yezindlela ezihlukene zokulima, njengokulungisa kahle umhlabathi, ukufaka ifertilizer efanele, ukukhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo, ukuphatha izihlahla nezifo, nokuvuna. Sikwazile ukuvula izindawo ezingu-46 zokuvivinya eziphathwa uhlelo lwethu. Lezi zivivinyo zihlose ukukhombisa izindlela ezifanele zokulima - noma ukufaka ifertilizer noma cha, inani leziqhamo: kakhulu noma kancane, noma ukuhlela izihlahla noma cha. Ikakhulukazi, kusiza abalimi ezindaweni ezithile nakwabantu abangafundile, njengoba lezi zivivinyo zikhombisa izindlela ezifanele zokulima ngesikhathi esifanele. Izinsuku zabafarmi zinikeza ithuba kubo bonke abathintekayo kwezolimo ukufundisa nokuxhumana nabalimi. Ngesikhathi lezi zinsuku zabafarmi, kukhona abasebenzi bethu, kanye nezithunywa ezivela ezinkampanini ezinikeza zawe zokulima, amabhizinisi ezolimo, umshwalense, abanikazi bezimali, njll. Ngonyaka owedlule sibe nezinsuku zabafarmi ezingu-65 - inani labalimi ababe khona kulezi zinsuku laqala ku-8 lafika ku-250!
Isizulu sokuqala sokusebenza kwehlobo sokukhiqiza sesiphelile ezindaweni eziningi, futhi abaphathi basebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uzothola umkhiqizo. Sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola lezo zinsiza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zizokwazi ukukusiza ngonyaka ozayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awekho ama-leak emaphaketheni nasendaweni yephampu. Hlola ukuthi amaphakethe amanzi asasebenza kahle ngoba avamise ukujula uma uwoyela ewela kuwo. Hlola ukuthi i-radiator cap isasebenza kahle. Uma ubona ukuthi amanzi aphansi kodwa ungatholi enye indawo evulekile, kungase kube le cap evulekile - shintsha ngayo entsha. Kubalulekile ukukhokhela wonke amanzi ezinhlelweni zokupholisa minyaka yonke futhi ufake i-anti-freeze entsha. Khumbula ukuthi ubusika bujwayelekile, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba ne-anti-freeze entsha. Qinisekisa ukuthi uthenga i-anti-freeze efanele, futhi ungahlanganisi izinhlobo ezahlukene ezinemibala ehlukile ngoba azifani. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-fan belts asasebenza kahle. Hlola futhi uqine ibhande. Uma kukhona ama-belts amabili futhi elilodwa likwi-risiko lokuphuka, kufanele ushintshe kokubili ngama-new ukuze asebenze ngokufanayo. Hlola ukuthi awekho ama-leak ukusuka ethankini kuze kube lapho i-diesel ingena khona kumajektha. Qinisekisa ukuthi ithanki likhanya, futhi hlola ukuthi i-internal filter isasebenza. Faka ama-diesel filters amasha kuzo zonke izindawo. Hlanza i-water trap. Kubalulekile ukuthi ithanki le-diesel lihlale ligcwele ngoba uma kukhona umoya ethankini, uyaguquka ube amanzi. Lawa manzi angalimaza ipump ye-injector. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi ukuthi umphathi wakho kufanele uthuthukiswe - kungase kube isikhathi sokushintsha uwoyela futhi ufake i-filter entsha. Uma sekuyisikhathi sokushintsha uwoyela we-differential kanye ne-gearbox, khumbula ukushintsha lezo filters futhi (khumbula ukuthi uhlelo lwe-hydraulic lusebenzisa lowo mwela futhi, ngakho hlola noma yiziphi ama-leak). Uma ubuyisela umphathi, hlola ukuthi awekho uwoyela ophukile lapho ufake khona i-filter noma ku-sump cap. Hlola zonke izindawo lapho uwoyela ungase uphume - faka ama-seals amasha uma kudingeka. Faka i-grease kuzo zonke izindawo (ku-drive shaft nakwezinye izixhumi). Hlola ama-air filters - ngabe asasebenza kahle futhi akhanya - faka amasha uma kudingeka. Hlola amaphakethe lapho umoya uphume, uqine zonke izixhumi. Ibhethri - ibhethri kufanele igcwale ngokuphelele. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele, uma ephansi, thela amanzi ebhethrini (ungawathola esitolo sebhethri). Khulula ama-cables ebhethri futhi uwahlanze. Xhuma ama-cables kabusha ngokuqinile futhi faka i-grease encane lapho exhunywe khona ukuze uvimbele ukugqwala kwe-asidi. Hlola ukuthi ikhebuli exhunywe kumshini kanye nekhabeli exhunywe ku-starter iqinile. Qinisekisa ukuthi ama-cables kagesi awanawo ama-grease nowoyela futhi ahlanzekile kuzo zonke izindawo (lokhu kuvimbela ukushisa, ukuvuvukala, nokumanzisa). Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izibani zokwazisa nezilinganiso zisebenza kahle - uma uthinta ukhiye wokuvula, konke kufanele kukhanye. (Izibani zok pressure yewoyela nezibani ze-alternator kufanele zikhanye uma uthinta ukhiye, kufanele zicime uma umshini uqala - ezinye izibani zizovuleka uma kukhona inkinga endaweni ethile). Hlola zonke ama-fuses njalo. Ama-tire kufanele abe sesimweni esihle njalo - akufanele kube neziphuka, izindawo ezilimazekile, noma ama-bulges. Hlola ukuthi ukujula kuhle futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ibhalansi yamanzi nomoya kumatire angemuva ilungile. Hlola izinyathelo zamathayi adlulisayo umshini - uma zikhululekile, azizokwazi ukubamba nokudonsa kahle. Hlola ukuthi izinyathelo zamathayi wonke ahlale ahlale phambili. Izingxenye zokuhamba zomphathi zineqhaza elikhulu, ngakho kunezinto eziningi ezingase zishiswe ngokushesha. Kubalulekile ukuthi ama-bushings, ama-bearings, kanye ne-gearbox kube sesimweni esihle. Uma kukhona izingxenye ezishisiwe, kungadala ukuthi umphathi ungasebenzi kahle endleleni - lokhu kungadala ingozi ngoba umshayeli akanawo amandla okulawula umphathi kahle, futhi kudala ukugqoka kwamathayi. Kukhona ama-plates akhethekile okuvikela kumphathi (umbala wawo uvamise ukufana nalowo womphathi). Inhloso yalezi ziplate ukuvikela umshayeli kanye nezingxenye ezihambayo. Njalo lezi ziplate zishiswa, futhi kwesinye isikhathi azisatholakali. Kubalulekile ukuzifaka kumphathi, shintsha lezo ezilahlekile, futhi hlola ukuthi ama-bolts abamba aqinile. Izingxenye lapho ezinye izinto zixhunywe futhi ziqinisiwe ngumphathi kufanele zihlale ziqinile. Sebenzisa ama-pins afanele usayizi uma uhudula ezinye izinto ngoba azikwazi ukuba nesisindo esifanayo - ama-pins amancane athwala isisindo sonke sokuhudula, futhi yibo kuphela abamba ibha yokuhudula. Iziphumo eziningi zenzeka uma lezi zingxenye zingahlolwanga kahle.
Uhlaka: Ulwazi luthathwe kuHlelo lweMfundo Ephakeme lokukhiqiza iSorghum. Umkhiqizi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuphathwa kokwakhiwa kwekhwalithi kubalulekile lapho kuthuthukiswa izinhlelo futhi ngaphambi kokutshala, njengoba lokhu kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthi kube nokukhiqiza okuphelele njengoba kuhilela zonke izenzo ezenziwa umphathi. Lezi ezilandelayo yizici ezingathinta ikhwalithi yezinsalela ezivunyiwe (okwakhiwa): ukulungiswa komhlabathi, ukujula komhlabathi, i-pH, ibhalansi yezimayini, ukugcina umswakama emhlabathini, uhlobo lwez plants, umanyolo ofanele, ukuphathwa kwezihlahla nezifo, ukuvuna ngesikhathi esifanele nokuphatha, ukuhlanza okwakhiwa, ukuwasha okwakhiwa, kanye nezindlela zokugcina (ukubeka) okwakhiwa. Ukuvuna kuyinselelo ebalulekile uma kutshalwa i-sorghum. Siqala ukuvuna ngaphambi kokwenza ezinye izenzo ezihlobene nokuphathwa kokwakhiwa njengokucubungula, ukugcina, nokugcina umkhiqizo. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kunezindawo lapho ukuvuna, ukugcina, nokugcina imisebenzi kuhlukaniswe. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokusebenza ezifana nokuvuna ngezandla bese yonke imikhiqizo ibekwe ukuvuna kamuva uma isomile emapulazini amancane. Bese kuqhubeka emapulazini ezohwebo lapho imishini isetshenziswa kuphela ukuvuna okwakhiwa. Ngokuvamile, i-sorghum ivunwa ndawonye ne-maize futhi ivunwa ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari uma itshalwe kusenesikhathi, kuyilapho enye ivunwa ngoMeyi uma itshalwe kamuva. Lokhu kuvuna ngokuvamile kuqedwa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuvuna kwe-maize kuqale. Lokhu kubalulekile emapulazini amancane lapho ama-combine angavuna i-sorghum ne-maize. Umkhiqizi noma umuntu othile uzothola umqashi onemishini ekwazi ukuvuna i-sorghum ne-maize. Isikhathi esivela ekuphumeleleni kokwakhiwa kuya ekuvuneni kufanele sibe mfushane - lokhu kuzovimbela izingozi ezidalwa yizinyoni nokonakala kokwakhiwa nakwezinye izifo. Izitshalo ze-sorghum ziba zikhulile lapho umbala ngemuva kokwakhiwa ushintsha, ekuqaleni umbala ubuhlalu bese ube mpunga. Lokhu kushintsha ngokuvamile kwenzeka ngaphambi kokuba okwakhiwa kumiswe ukuze kuvunwe. I-sorghum etshaliwe kamuva izoba ready kuphela emva kokufriza kokuqala ebusika. Ngaphambi kokuqala ukuvuna, sebenzisa umshini wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uhlole okuqukethwe komswakama kokwakhiwa uma kuqala ukuvuthwa ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uzovuna ngesikhathi esifanele. Uma ungenawo umshini wokuhlola umswakama, thola amasampula okwakhiwa kumphathi wesilo oseduze noma uqashe umqashi ukuze akusize uthole isikhathi esifanele sokuvuna. Ukuze unciphise ukulahleka kokwakhiwa ngenxa yomswakama ngesikhathi sokuvuna kanye nezingozi zezinyoni, i-sorghum ingavunwa ngesikhathi sokugcina umswakama esiphakathi kuka-20% kuya ku-25% bese yoma emshinini wokoma kuze kube kufinyelela ku-9.5%. Lokhu kuqukethwe komswakama kufanelekile ukuze kubekwe (kugcinwe) i-sorghum ezindongeni. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, kungcono ukushiya i-sorghum emhlabeni ukuze yomile kahle ngaphambi kokuvuna. Khumbula njalo ukuthi uma okuqukethwe komswakama kuphakeme kuka-10%, kuzodonsa kalula umswakama. Isivinini se-combine kufanele sibe phakathi kuka-5 kuya ku-8 kilometers ngehora. Isivinini esiphakeme phambili sizohambisana nokwakhiwa komswakama kwe-sorghum kanye nosayizi womkhiqizo. Isivinini kufanele sinciphise uma okuqukethwe komswakama kuphansi ukuvimbela okwakhiwa ekonakaleni uma kungena emshinini. Ungasisebenzisa uma okuqukethwe komswakama sishintsha sibe phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15%. Ukuhamba kungagcwalisa i-cylinder kanye ne-augers kakhulu, ngaphandle uma kukhona umkhiqizo omkhulu kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okwakhiwa okukhona phakathi kuka-12% kuya ku-15% kuzonakala kulula ukonakala uma kungena kwi-cylinder. Okukhishiwe okungekho ngokuphelele okonakaliswe kuhlala emhlabeni. I-'concave' ivulekile kakhulu. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezisele. Ukuphuma komoya okuphansi, ukonakala kwi-cylinder kwenzeka ngokushesha. Ukuvuleka kwe-'chaffer' kuncane kakhulu. Izinto eziningi eziphukile zikhishwa ebhakedeni 'lokulahleka'. Ukonakala okuphezulu kakhulu, i-cylinder esheshayo, i-'concave' eqinile, umoya ophumayo uhamba kancane, ama-augers avulekile kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okuphukile kufihlwe. I-cylinder esheshayo, ukuvuleka okuncane kwe-'concave'. Okukhishiwe kufihlwe kodwa ngaphandle kusempilweni. Ukuvuleka kwe-'concave' kuncane kakhulu. Okukhishiwe okuphukile kanye nezinsalela ezikhululekile. Isivinini se-cylinder/rotary siphakeme kakhulu noma kukhona okuncane okusele. Okukhishiwe okungekho ngokuphelele okonakaliswe kuhlala emhlabeni. Amabhodi nekhanda akahambisani kahle. Okukhishiwe kuphuma ngemuva kwe-combine. Isivinini/ukuphuma komoya, hamba kancane emshinini futhi isivinini sokuphuma komoya. Ukulahleka komkhiqizo kungaba ngu-3% - 5% kodwa kungakhula kube ngu-10% - 15% ngezikhathi ezithile. Imishini yokuvuna kufanele ihlolwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isebenza kahle ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuyihlola ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuvuna ukuze ubone ukuthi mangaki alahlekile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhiqizi angakwazi ukuqala ukuphatha ukuvuna nokwakhiwa komswakama ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela zokuhlola okwakhiwa kwakho. Uma umkhiqizo wakho uhamba kahle, thenga umshini wakho wokuhlola umswakama ukuze uvimbele ukuvuvukala esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kubalulekile lapho kukhiqizwa futhi kuthengiswa okwakhiwa kokudla. Ukonakala kokwakhiwa uma kuphumelelwe kakhulu bese kubekwe ezindongeni uma kubanda kakhulu noma ezindongeni ezisebenzisa umoya olemukelekayo kuphela. Izindleko zingavela uma okwakhiwa kuvunwa uma kuphumelelwe kakhulu. Ukukhula kokwakhiwa nezindleko zokomisa lezi zakhiwa. Ukulahleka kwenani lomkhiqizo. Ukuze wenze ukuhlola okuqondile, kufanele uqale uthole isampula enhle ezokhombisa inani lomkhiqizo wonke. Lapha sithatha isampula ezitshalo ezingakavunwanga (emaphandleni) ukuze sithole ukuthi okwakhiwa kuphumelelwe kakhulu, lokhu kungasiphazamisa, futhi sivame ukuvuna kamuva, hhayi ngesikhathi esifanele. Vuna ingxenye bese uhlola. Hlanganisa amakhanda ezitshalo ozithathile ngezandla emaphandleni, ucindezele kuze kube okwakhiwa kuphuma. Thatha ukuhlola okuthathu kulokhu okwakhiwa bese uthola ngaphakathi. Thumela le sampula kumphathi wesilo ukuze wenze ukuhlola okuqondile. Yenza lokhu njalo uma amakhanda eshintsha abe mpunga ukuze okwakhiwa kuvunwe ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa komswakama esifanele ukuze kulethe umkhiqizo omuhle. Lokhu kungaba yinto enhle kumfuyi osanda kufika kulokho okubizwa ngokuthi abapheki bezohwebo. Kukhona izindonga ezenziwe ngegalvanized steel ezisuka ku-10 kuya ku-30 tons. Uma kungekho imali eningi, izindonga ezincane (10 tons) zingasetshenziswa ekuqaleni, bese lokhu kungakhuliswa njeng
Isithombe 4: Ubulili obukhulu buqhamuka ngenxa yezinambuzane ezitsheni. Uma lezi zinambuzane ziningi kakhulu, ukukhiqiza izitshalo kungase kungabi nezinzuzo. Kukhona kuphela izinambuzane ezimbalwa ezitsheni esingathi zinkinga - eziningi azinabungozi ezitsheni. Izinambuzane ezingadala ubungozi yilezo ezivame ukudla okusanhlamvu okukhulisiwe, izitshalo ezincane, izithombo ezivela, izitshalo ezikhulayo, imizi, noma ukudla okukhulayo. Ukuphatha izinambuzane kuhilela ukusebenzisa ama-pesticides (imikhiqizo emibi ebulala izinambuzane), ukuyisebenzisa ngesikhathi esifanele, kanye nenani elifanele le-pesticide - ikakhulukazi ukufaka i-pesticide ethile eqondile ezinamabala athile. Kukhona i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ebulala zonke izinambuzane ezidla izitshalo. Uma usebenzisa le pesticide, uzothola imiphumela emihle. Kufanele uhlanganise izindlela ezahlukene ukuze ulawule izinambuzane ngempumelelo. Le nhlanganisela izosiza ukuvimbela ukukhula kwezinambuzane ezivame ukubangela ubungozi ezitsheni zakho. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinambuzane ezidla okusanhlamvu nezitshalo ezincane, njengokuthi: ama-cutworms, ama-beetles anemibala, nezinye. Lezi zinambuzane zinciphisa inani lezitshalo ezikhulayo - uma zingaphathwa kahle, kuzodingeka ukufaka kabusha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi kemikhali kufanele zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele ukuze kulawulwe izinambuzane ngempumelelo. Ukuphatha lezi zinkinga akubizi kakhulu kodwa kufanele uthathe isinyathelo ngokushesha ukuvimbela ukuthi zidalule ubungozi ezikhathini zokuqala zokukhula kwezitshalo. Ukulima ebusika kuzophinde kusize ukubulala izinambuzane eziningi ngoba ebusika zihlala ezinsalela zezithombo ezishiywe emasimini. Uma zihlala ngaphandle kwezitshalo eziphilayo izinsuku eziyi-35, izinkinga eziningi ezidalwa lezi zinambuzane zizokwenyuka. Izimpande ezizofakwa zingaphathwa ngama-pesticides noma i-pesticide ingafakwa emhlabathini lapho kufakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokufaka ibhodi emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Insimu ingaphinde iphonswe nge-pesticide efanele. I-corn earworm (astylus atromaculatus), i-cutworm (agrotis segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ifile (protostrophus sulcatifrons), kanye nama-harpalus beetles angadala ubungozi obukhulu ezitsheni, futhi inani lezitshalo ezinhle lingancipha ngaphandle kokuthola inzuzo. I-African bollworm (helicoverpa armigera) idala umonakalo emqondweni wezithombo futhi ingavula ithuba lokungena kwe-fungus rhizopus microsporus. Izinambuzane ezifana ne-nysius nataensis zingaphinde zidle okusanhlamvu kwezitshalo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zama-pesticides abhalisiwe ukuze abulale izinambuzane ezahlukene. Kodwa kubalulekile ukwazi kahle ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezinambuzane ezibanga ubungozi. Bese ukwazi ukukhetha i-pesticide efanele - qaphela ukufaka i-pesticide ngokwezincazelo nasemazweni afanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwezinambuzane kanye nosayizi bezitshalo. Ukufaka ama-pesticides kungavimbela ukwehla kokukhiqiza, kodwa umlimi kufanele abe nekhono ngoba kuhilela izindleko. Kufanele kuhlolwe kahle lapho izinambuzane zidalula ubungozi obukhulu, noma kungase kubize kakhulu ngaphandle kokusiza ngoba izindleko zizodlula inzuzo. Akukuhle ukuhluza izitshalo uma izinambuzane zingakabangi ubungozi obukhulu. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi kukhona abaphangi bemvelo abakhokhela ezinye izinambuzane. Uma uhluza kakhulu, lezi zinyoni ezidla izinambuzane zizobulawa, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi izinambuzane zizojwayela i-pesticide uma ifakwa njalo futhi ngeke zife. Imikhakha nayo iyingozi futhi ibulala umhlabathi, ngakho kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela uma kudingeka kakhulu. Ukulima ngaphambi kokufaka kusiza ukuvimbela ubungozi bezinambuzane. Nokho, inani lezinambuzane kufanele lilawulwe njalo ukuze izindleko zikwazi ukuphathwa ngempumelelo. Ngokuvamile, kubalulekile ukuba nezindlela ezihlanganisiwe zokuvikela ubungozi bezinambuzane - sebenzisa indlela ehambisana nohlobo lwezinambuzane ngesikhathi esifanele sezitshalo ezithile. Ukuphatha izinambuzane kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezitshalo ngoba kuzokhombisa ukuthi kuzoba khona inzuzo ekulimaleni nasekukhiqizeni noma cha. Izifo zezithombo zinciphisa inani kanye nekhwalithi yokukhiqiza futhi zingaba yingozi empilweni yezimpahla nasemakhosini uma zisetshenziswa. Izifo zezithombo zidalwa ikakhulukazi ama-fungi, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-virus. Lezi zingalimaza zonke izingxenye zesitshalo - imizi, iziqu, amahlamvu, izimbali, kanye nezimpande ezidliwayo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezifo zidinga izimo ezahlukene ukuze zikhule. Isifo singakhula kuphela uma sithintana nezimo zezulu kanye nendawo, uma kukhona isitshalo esifanele futhi isifo sikhona. Lezi zinto ezintathu zingathiwa ziwumgogodla wokuhlasela kwesifo. Uma eyodwa iphuthuma, isifo ngeke sikhule futhi sithinte. Isifo esithile esingase sibe khona endaweni ethile kulo nyaka singase singabi khona kule ndawo ngonyaka ozayo uma isimo sendawo nezimo zezulu zihluka kulonyaka. Ngenxa yokubambezeleka okukhulu ekuqaleni kokufaka izitshalo, kuvame ukuba kunzima ukuphatha lezi zifo ngamakhemikhali ngoba kubiza kakhulu. Ezinye izifo zihlala zikhona kodwa azikhuli ngoba azithintani nesitshalo noma nezimo zezulu. Izifo ziphathwa ngokuqapha nezindlela zokuvikela. Kukhona izindlela ezahlukene zokuphatha izifo ngokuqapha. Kukhona izinhlobo zezithombo ezikhuliswe ukuze zibe nekhono lokumelana nezifo ezithile. Le nselelo yesitshalo ibhekisela ekulweni nesifo esithile; akusho ukuthi ezinye izifo ngeke zilimaze lelo sitshalo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda kahle ukuthi iyiphi isifo evame ukubangela ubungozi endaweni yakho bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungamelana naleso sifo. Ukuphatha ngamakhemikhali kusho ukusebenzisa i-pesticide ebhalisiwe ukuze ubulale izifo ezithile ze-fungal nezamabhaktheriya ezimweni ezithile. Kufanele ucabange kahle ngentengo yokuthenga i-pesticide - kungase kube kuhle ukufuna iseluleko kumeluleki wezokulima ukuze uthole izeluleko mayelana nokusebenzisa amakhemikhali athile. Ukulima umhlabathi kungaba yinto ebalulekile uma uzama ukuphatha izifo - ezinye izifo zihlala ezinsaleni ezishiywe emasimini, ngakho kufanele wazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona futhi ukhethe indlela efanele yokulima umhlabathi. Ukuguqula izinhlobo zezithombo kusho ukuhlinzeka isikhathi sokuthi izinsalela ezishiywe emasimini ziqhume. Kubalulekile ukuthola ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezithanda yiziphi izitshalo bese ubhekana nalolu daba ngokushintsha izinhlobo zezithombo ozifakayo. Isikhathi sokufaka sithinta futhi ukukhula kwesifo esithile - ukufaka masinyane noma ngemuva kwesikhathi kungavimbela isifo esithile ekukhuleni nasekubangeleni ubungozi. Ingxenye ethile edala ubunzima ekukhuleni kwezithombo ingashintsha indlela izifo ezikhula ngayo. Izinto ezidalayo ubunzima ek
Akukwazi ukusho ukuthi wonke amaphutha atholakala ezitshalweni awanobungozi. Ayingxenye yamaphutha alethela izifo ezitshalweni. Labo abanenkinga bangadla imbewu efakwe, abanye badla isitshalo ngesikhathi sikhula, abanye uma isitshalo sesiqinile, abanye badla imizi kanti abanye badla amahlamvu uma esephumile. Ukuphatha amaphutha kuhlobene kakhulu nezinto zokwakha (izinto zokwakha ezibulalayo amaphutha). Kukhona izinto zokwakha ezibhalisiwe zokubulala wonke amaphutha abuhlungu ezitshalweni. Izindlela zokuphatha amaphutha ezihlanganisiwe zingaba nomthelela omuhle - izindlela ezihlukene zisetshenziselwa ukuvimbela ukukhula kwamaphutha nokunciphisa izingozi abakhayo. Kukhona amaphutha ahlukene adla imbewu nezitshalo ezisanda ukuqala ukukhula, isibonelo: ama-wireworms, ama-beetles anama-spots, ama-cutworms, njll. Lawa maphutha anciphisa inani lezi mbewu ezifakwe futhi kuzodingeka ukufaka kabusha. Ukuphatha kahle lawa maphutha kuhlobene nokufaka umuthi wokubulala amaphutha ngendlela efanele, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokufaka. Ukulima ebusika kuzosisiza ukuphatha amaningi ale maphutha - kudingeka ezinsukwini ezingu-35 noma ngaphezulu lapho engatholi isitshalo sokudla futhi abaningi bazofa. Imbewu ezizofakwa ingaphathwa ngombulala-maphutha, noma umuthi wokubulala amaphutha ungafakwa emhlabathini lapho kuzofakwa khona. Ama-cutworms angabulawa ngokubeka isithako phezulu emhlabathini endaweni yokufaka. Insimu ye-maize ingaphonswa nomuthi wokubulala amaphutha ofanele. I-beetle enkulu enama-spots edla i-maize (Astylus Atromaculatus), i-cutworm (Agrotis Segetum), i-beetle ebonakala ingalive "doodhouertjie" (Protostrophus Sulcatifrons) kanye ne-harpalus beetle kungadala ubungozi obukhulu futhi kunciphise inani lezitshalo ensimini ethile. Ekugcineni, ngeke kutholakale inzuzo kule nsimu. I-African bollworm (Helicoverpa Armigera) ibhujisa isitshalo se-maize futhi ivule indlela yokungena kwezifo ezifana ne-Rhizopus Microsporus. Amaphutha adlayo afana ne-Nysius Nataensis angaphinde abhubhise imbewu ye-maize ekhula. Kukhona izinhlobo ezihlukene zezinto zokwakha ezibhalisiwe zokubulala izinhlobo ezihlukene zamaphutha angena esitshalo. Kodwa kubalulekile ukuhlonza ukuthi iyiphi i-pest enobungozi bese ukhetha umuthi wokubulala amaphutha ofanele ukuze uwufake ngendlela efanele nangasikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kungahluka kuye ngohlobo lwamaphutha kanye nokukhula kwesitshalo. Ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha ukuze ubulale amaphutha kungasiza ukuvimbela izingozi ezitshalweni, kodwa kubiza imali eningi - ngakho umnini wezolimo kufanele abale kahle ukuthi izindleko zizoba ziningi kangakanani. Kubalulekile ukuthi kubhekwe kahle lapho kudingeka ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha - kuzofika isikhathi lapho umnini wezolimo ebona ukuthi kubalulekile ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha ngoba ingozi ezitshalweni izoba phezulu kunezindleko zokufaka umuthi. Akukhuthazwa ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha ezitshalweni lapho amaphutha engakakhethi ingozi enkulu. Isizathu salokhu: kukhona ezinye izinhlobo zemvelo ezidla lawa maphutha, kodwa nazo zibhujiswa umuthi wokubulala amaphutha futhi amanye amaphutha athola amandla okuphila emithini ethile yokubulala amaphutha. Ukulima ngaphambi kokufaka imbewu kuyindlela enhle yokuvimbela izingozi zamaphutha. Kodwa inani lamaphutha kufanele liqapheke njalo ukuze izindleko zokuvimbela zingakhuphuki kakhulu. Kukhona ezinye izinhlobo zezithombo eziqinile ngokumelene namaphutha - lokhu kuzosisiza esikhathini esifushane ngoba ngeke kudingeke ukufaka imithi yokubulala amaphutha, futhi esikhathini eside kuzosisiza ngoba inani lamaphutha azokwehla. Kungcono ukubheka konke bese usebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene ukuphatha lezi zifo - sebenzisa indlela ethile ngesikhathi esifanele esitshalo esithile. Ukuphatha amaphutha kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezolimo jikelele ngoba kunganciphisa noma kukhulise umkhiqizo kanye nezindleko zokukhiqiza ekugcineni. Izifo zezithombo zinciphisa umkhiqizo kanye nekhwalithi yokudla futhi zingadala izimpahla nabantu abathokozela leyo ndawo. Ama-fungi, amabhaktheriya, kanye nama-virus adala izifo ezitshalweni. Lezi zingalimaza isitshalo sonke - imizi, iziqu, amahlamvu, kanye nezithelo. Lezi zifo ezihlukene zidinga izimo ezihlukene ukuze zikhule futhi zisakazeke. Isifo singakhula kuphela uma izimo zezulu zifanele, uma kukhona isitshalo lapho singakhula khona, futhi uma isifo sikhona. Lezi zinto ezintathu zingabizwa ngokuthi (i-triangular) i-triangle eyinhloko yesifo. Uma eyodwa iphuthumile, isifo ngeke sikhule. Isifo esingase sibe khona ngesikhathi esithile endaweni ethile singase singabi khona ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba izimo zezulu zingashintsha. Njengoba i-maize ibiza kakhulu ukufaka, kuvame ukuthatha umzamo omningi ukubulala nokuphatha izifo ngezinto zokwakha. Ezinye izifo zivame ukuba khona kodwa azikhuli ngoba eyodwa yezinto ze-triangle iphuthumile. Kungcono ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela ezifo futhi zizophathwa kangcono. Kukhona izinto ezihlukene ezingakusiza ukuvimbela izifo ekukhuleni. Ezinye izinhlobo zezithombo zithola amandla okulwa nezifo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lezi zindlela zokulwa nezifo zivame ukulwa kuphela nesifo esithile, hhayi wonke. Kubalulekile ukuhlonza ukuthi iyiphi isifo esingase sikhule endaweni ethile bese ukhetha uhlobo lwesitshalo olungakwazi ukulwa naleso sifo. Ukuphatha ngezinto zokwakha kusho ukusebenzisa umuthi wokubulala amaphutha obhalisiwe ukuze ubulale ama-fungi namabhaktheriya ezimweni ezithile zezulu. Kufanele ucabangele kahle izindleko zomuthi ngaphambi kokuwathenga. Izindlela zokulima emhlabathini zingaba yinto ebalulekile lapho sifuna ukuphatha izifo - iziqu ezisele ensimini zigcina ezinye zalezi zifo. Indlela esilima ngayo kufanele ibhekane nalokhu futhi kufanele sazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezikhona. Ukushintsha izinhlobo zezithombo ensimini eyodwa kuhlose ukuhlinzeka ngezinsuku ezanele ukuze iziqu ezisele ziqhume futhi zisebenze nomhlabathi. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi izifo ezilindeleke ukuba zingene ezitshalweni, ukuze izitshalo ezifanele zikwazi ukukhethwa lapho zishintshwa. Isikhathi sokufaka imbewu singahambisana nokuphuma kwesifo esithile - ukufaka masinyane noma sekwephuzile kunganciphisa ukusakazeka kwesifo esithile. Ingxenye yezinto ezidalayo ingcindezi ihlobene nezifo. Izinto ezidalayo ingcindezi ezitshalweni zifaka: umswakama (ongaphezulu noma ongaphansi), ukushisa, ukubanda, ukungabi nezinto ezanele emhlabathini, ukungafaneleki, kanye nokulimala kwamaphutha. Uma sifuna ukuphatha izifo ngempumelelo, kufanele sizame ukususa eyodwa yezinto ze-triangle zalawo mazi. Lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma sisebenzisa uhlelo lokuphatha izifo oluhlanganisiwe (ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezihlukene). Amahlamvu anama-spots adalwa yi-Septoria. Isondlo se-sunflower siyinsimu ebaluleke kakhulu yokukhiqiza uwoyela lapha eNingizimu Afrika, ngokwesiko ikhiqiza cishe amathani angama-650,000 ngonyaka. Imbewu ye-sunflower enokuqukethwe uwoyela okuphezulu - 44% - iyingxenye ebalulekile yokukhiqiza kwethu. Imbewu ye-sunflower enokuqukethwe uwoyela okuphansi - 25% kuya ku-38% - isetshenziswa ekubhakeni amakhekhe nasekudleni kwezinyoni. Ama-sunflower angakhula ezindaweni eziningi zelizwe lethu lapho imvula iphakathi kuka-475 mm no-675 mm ngonyaka. Nokho, kunoma iyiphi indawo, ukukhiqiza kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela ezokwenza inzuzo. Intengo ye-sunflower ikhule kakhulu muva nje, futhi sikholelwa ukuthi izohlala iphezulu unyaka wonke. Imbewu yekhwalithi ephezulu, efanayo ngaphandle kwembewu yezinambuzane kufanele icatshangelwe lapho kukhethwa izinhlobo zembewu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isivuno sakho asibanga engozini. Imbewu yokukhiqiza ephezulu yalo nyaka ayikwazi ukutshala futhi ngonyaka ozayo. Le mibewu izokhiqiza amakhanda amaningi, okwenza ukuvuna ngemishini kube nzima futhi kuholele ekukhiqizeni imbewu encane. Ukuqala kokushoda ezindaweni eziningi kusukela ekupheleni kukaDisemba kuya ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari kufanele kucatshangelwe ngokucophelela njengoba kubalulekile uma kukhethwa isikhathi sokutshala. Isikhathi sokuphuma kwe-sunflower sibalulekile ngoba ngalesi sikhathi izitshalo zidinga amanzi amaningi, futhi zingathinteka uma kwenzeka ukushoda. Ngakho-ke, isikhathi sokutshala kufanele sikhethwe ngokucophelela ukuze kuvinjwe ukuthi isikhathi sokushoda sihambisane nesikhathi sokuphuma kwezitshalo. Ingozi yokwehluleka kwesivuno iyanda uma ama-sunflower etshalwa emhlabathini owomile. Uma imvula ikahle ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokutshala, futhi umhlabathi unomswakama, ama-sunflower atshalwe kusenesikhathi anethuba elihle lokuphumelela. Isinqumo sokutshala kusenesikhathi noma ngemuva kuhambisana nenani lokunisela elitholakalayo emhlabathini. Umlando wokwenzeka kokushoda ngesikhathi sasehlobo kufanele futhi ucabangele. Nokho, awukwazi ukulinda isikhathi eside kakhulu ngoba ukwanda kokudla emibewwini kungase kwenzeke uma isimo sezulu sishisa, bese isivuno sincipha. Ngokuvamile, izikhathi zokutshala zingalandela le mikhombandlela: ezindaweni ezibandayo empumalanga, ungatshala kusukela ekuqaleni kukaNovemba kuya kwiveki yokuqala kaDisemba; ezindaweni ezisemaphakathi nezwe lethu, ungath开始 ukutshala evikini yokugcina kaNovemba kuze kube sekupheleni kukaDisemba; ezindaweni ezomile empumalanga, ungatshala kusukela ekupheleni kukaDisemba kuya ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari. Khumbula ukuthi uma utshala kakhulu ngemuva, kunganciphisa isivuno. Ama-sunflower angatshalwa ezindaweni ezijulile ezivela ku-2.5 cm kuya ku-5 cm, kuye ngohlobo lomhlabathi nesikhathi sokutshala. Ubude kufanele bube phezulu emhlabathini onzima (njengokhonkolo) kodwa bungaba buphansi emhlabathini ongenamahluko. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi imbewu itshalwe emhlabathini onomswakama owanele ukuze isize ekukhuleni. Kubalulekile ukuthi umhlabathi ube nokuxhumana okuhle nembewu. Sebenzisa indlela ethembekile yokutshala. Imbewu kufanele ibekwe ngezikhala ezifanayo nobude. Isikhala phakathi kwezitshalo sibalulekile ngoba izitshalo kufanele ziqhudelane ngendlela efanayo; akufanele kube khona ezinye ezisondele kakhulu ukuze ziqhudelane ngokudla nokukhanya. Inani lezitshalo ezingaphumelela endaweni ethile lihambisana nenani lokunisela elitholakalayo emhlabathini. Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke kakhulu kunesikhala phakathi kwemigqa. Isikhala phakathi kwemigqa emapulazini athola imvula kuphela singaba phakathi kuka-0.91 m no-2.1 m noma 2.3 m. Lokhu kuzohambisana nohlobo lwemishini esetshenzisiwe kanye nendlela yokulima. Inani eliphansi kakhulu lezitshalo lizonciphisa ithuba lokukhiqiza, kodwa inani eliphezulu kakhulu lizokwenza izitshalo ziqhudelane, kuholele ekwehleni kwesivuno. Izitshalo ezisondele kakhulu zikhona amathuba amaningi okuthinteka yizifo (njengokubola kwemizi) futhi zikhona amathuba amaningi okwehla. Inani elinconyiwe lezitshalo (akufanele lingabi ngaphansi kwama-20,000 ezitshalo ngehektare kuzo zonke izindawo). (I-hektare ingama-100 amamitha ngo-100 amamitha). Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi ubungako bokutshala bulungiswe ukuze utshale ama-10% amaningi embewu kunenani elinconyiwe ngoba ezinye zizophumelela ukuvuna ngenxa yokushoda, umonakalo wezinsongo, nokucindezelwa komhlabathi ngemuva kwemvula enkulu ngesikhathi sokuqala sokuvuna. Ngempela, uma uthola ukuthi kunezitshalo ezingaphansi kwama-20,000 ngehektare, kufanele ucabangele ukutshala kabusha ngenkathi kusasele isikhathi esanele sokuvuna kahle.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhloselwe ukusiza labo balimi abaphumelele ekufundeni. Lezi zinkampani zidinga usizo ngabanye mayelana nokwakha isu lokukhiqiza, ukuphatha ukusebenza kwezolimo, ukuphatha izindaba zezimali, njll. Abalimi abakhethiweyo bazothola ukwesekwa okukhulu unyaka wonke. Unyaka nonyaka, abalimi abasha bazokhethwa ukuze bathole le nsizakalo, emva kwalokho bazophila ngokuzimela kodwa bazothola usizo lwefoni kubaphathi ababelana ngolwazi ezindaweni zabo. Uma umlimi ekhiqiza ngaphezulu kwama-250 tons ngonyaka, bazokwethulwa kwezinye izinkampani zezimali kule ndawo - lokhu kuzosheshisa ukungena kwabalamuli abamnyama emkhakheni wezomnotho. Bonke abalimi abanguye amalungu ale nhlangano bathola ukwesekwa ekwakheni ipotfoliyo yabo, ehlanganisa isu lebhizinisi lonyaka. Ipotfoliyo izohlinzeka ngethuba lokufaka isicelo sokuxhaswa ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lezi zinkampani zizovakashelwa njalo ngababoni bezifunda abazozisiza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela nokubheka umsebenzi wabo ofana nokulungiselela umhlabathi, ukutshala, ukususa, ukuhluza, ukuvuna, nokumaketha. Sikholelwa ukuthi le nqubekelaphambili yezomnotho kufanele ibhekwane ngokucophelela futhi kufanele sikwazise labo abenza intuthuko. Sinenkambo yokumema abanye abalimi ukuba bajoyine i-250 Ton Club. Kukhona izigaba ze-250 Ton, 500 Ton, kanye ne-1,000 Ton - sithokozisa abalimi futhi sabanika ama-badges akhombisa isimo sabo kulezi zinkundla. Sizama ukukhombisa ibhizinisi lezolimo jikelele ukuthi kukhona intuthuko emsebenzini wethu wokuhlanganisa abalimi emnothweni.
Sicela thatha umzuzu ukuze uqedele le survey elandelayo. Zonke ifomu ezigcwele zizohlanganiswa futhi kuzobanjwa umncintiswano kulabo abawina. Kuzoba nabawinile abayi-10, abazothola ibhaskithi yezitshalo - izitshalo ezanele zokutshala ihektha elilodwa. Uphi esifundazweni nasezindaweni ohlabayo? Iphakethe lakho linjani? Uthola imvula njalo ngenyanga? Bangaki abantu emndenini wakho abafunda iPula Imvula? Ujwayele ukufunda izinto ezibhaliwe kangakanani? Ucabanga ukuthini ngokuqhuba kolimi kuPula Imvula? Ugcina copies zePula Imvula? Ingabe ulwazi olukhona luyabaluleka kuwe? Ucabanga ukuthi isimo sePula Imvula sikhona kanjani? Yiziphi izihloko ofuna zixoxwe ezinyangeni ezizayo? Singakwenza ukuthini ukuze sithuthukise iPula Imvula?
Ukulima kanye nekusasa: kungani kuthatha isikhathi eside? Sizamile ukuvuselela abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono ukuze babe abalimi abakwazi ukuziphilisa ngokwabo esikhathini esizayo. Njengoba isimo sezimali samanje emhlabeni sikhathazekile, lokhu kuzoba nzima - nokho, ungumuntu ophawulekayo. Uma ukulima eNingizimu Afrika kufanele kuqhubeke, kudingeka sifeze uguquko olugcwele emhlabeni wezolimo ukuze sikwazi ukuxoxa ngezinkinga ezivamile. Ukulima akulula; abalimi babhekana nezinto eziningi futhi kwesinye isikhathi bazibeka engcupheni. Amanani aphansi wezimpahla zokudla enza kube nzima kubalimi ukuba bathole inzuzo ezimpahleni zabo. Izinga lenzalo liphansi kakhulu futhi izindleko zemishini ziphezulu kakhulu. Abalimi abanamakhono kwezomnotho nabo babhekana nezinselelo (bakhathazekile!) - singasho ukuthini ngabo abasha? Uhulumeni angabasiza kanjani? Okwamanje, ukukhiqiza izimpahla zokudla ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo kunzima; abalimi abasha bangase bangakwazi ukuqhubeka nokulima esikhathini esizayo. Sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha; amanani okudla azophakama futhi. Kodwa okwamanje, kudingeka sisekele abalimi ngezimali, njengokuxhaswa - ukusiza ngezindleko zokuqala zokutshala noma ukuhlinzeka ngama-bonuses ezimpahleni zokudla ezikhiqizwayo. Le mikhankaso izoqinisekisa ukuthi labo abasebenza kanzima bazothola ama-bonuses - lokhu kuzosisiza abalimi abanamakhono ukuba babe nenzuzo. Enye inkinga enkulu yisimo semishini nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa abalimi abasha - kudingeka sibe nesisekelo sezimali ukusiza abalimi ukuthi balungise imishini yabo. Kukho ingxenye yezigaba zikahulumeni ezihlinzeka ngempahla nemishini kubalimi. Lokhu kungasiza esikhathini esifushane, kodwa labo abalimi kudingeka baqeqeshelwe ukuphatha le mishini kahle. Uma imishini isetshenziswa ngamaqembu abantu, akekho ozothatha umthwalo wokuphatha - kaningi imishini iyashiywa inganakekelwa futhi ngokushesha iba ingasebenzi. Lo msebenzi awukwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Izikhungo ezabelana ngolwazi nazo kumele ziqeqeshelwe ukuze ziqhubeke nomsebenzi wazo kahle - kukhona izikhungo eziningi ezinjalo, futhi kufanele zikwazi ukusiza abalimi ezindaweni zokulima. Ingxenye yezinselelo abalimi abasha ababhekana nazo ukuthola uxhaso lwezimali zokuqala zokulima. Kukho abaningi abanomhlaba nezinsiza (mhlawumbe ezinye azisebenzi kahle), baqeqeshelwe futhi baxhaswe, kodwa badinga imali. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphezulu kakhulu - kudingeka R4,000 kuya ku-R5,000 ukuze utshale ihektare eyodwa. Ekuqaleni, sathokoziswa ukubona amabhizinisi ezolimo esiza abalimi abasha ngoxhaso lokuqala, futhi kusekhona amabhizinisi ezolimo axhasa abalimi ukuba babe nenzuzo. Asebenzisa abalimi ekulungiseni nasekuphatheleni izinsiza zabo nemishini. Kanjani kufanele kusetshenziswe abaqashi emkhakheni wezolimo? Ingxenye yezindlela zokuqala zokulima umhlaba iwukusebenzisa abaqashi abakhulu. Lokhu sekwenziwe izikhathi eziningi, futhi kuthiwa umqashi uzosetshenziswa kuphela ekuqaleni, ekugcineni umalimi uzosebenza ngokwakhe. Umalimi akatholi inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza nemishini. Izindleko zokukhiqiza ziya zanda. Imali ekhokhwayo ukuze uthole umqashi ingasetshenziswa ukulungisa nokugcina izinsiza nemishini. Abalimi abangasebenzi nomqashi, ngakho, abaqondi kahle ukuzenzela. Isimo sezulu esomile ezindaweni eziningi lapha senza isikhathi sokutshala, ukutshala, nokuvuna sibe mfushane; kaningi umsebenzi awuqhutshekanga ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi umalimi ulahlekelwa umkhiqizo wabo (ukutshala nokufaka umanyolo sekwephuzile). Umqashi ukhokhelwa ngehektare elitshaliwe, hhayi ngokusekelwe kwekhwalithi yomsebenzi wabo - noma umalimi enza inzuzo noma cha, umqashi uthola ukukhokhelwa kwakhe. Kukho abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abalimayo futhi banemithombo. Laba abalimi kufanele bakwazi ukuqasha amapulazi kwabanye abanikazi bomhlaba abangafuni noma abangakwazi ukulima. Okwamanje, amapulazi amaningi akhishwa ngamabhizinisi ezolimo, ngakho-ke abanye abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono abakwazi ukwandisa imisebenzi yabo yokulima. Lapho kukhona abalimi abangenazo izinsiza, kuthiwa bazokwazi ukwenza inzuzo eyanele yokuthenga izinsiza. Kodwa lokhu akuphumeleli - inzuzo etholakala ekulimaleni kwezimpahla zokudla incane kakhulu, futhi abaqashi baphinde baphinde banciphise inzuzo. Bonke abasebenza emkhakheni wezolimo kufanele basebenzisane ukuze basize abalimi. Abalimi bafuna ukusebenza ngokwabo; abafuni ukuba balimelwe ngabanye. Nika umalimi ithuba lokuqala ukulima ngalokho abanako - ukuqala ngezimpahla ezincane endaweni encane akubeki engcupheni enkulu. (Khumbula ukuthi umuntu ofuna ukulima emhlabeni wabo usuphila kule ndawo. Uma bengakwazi ukwenza inzuzo encane kuphela ngaphezu kwalokho ababephila ngakho, kungabasiza kakhulu. Ngokusebenza kanzima, umalimi uzokhula ekulimaleni). Ungacindezeli umalimi ukuba aqashe umqashi; kungcono ukusiza ukuhlinzeka ngempahla yabo nemishini ukuze balime ngokwabo ngalokho abanako - mhlawumbe kungcono kubo ukuqasha amapulazi abangawaphatha. Ukusebenza nomuntu onolwazi (umeluleki) kuzobasiza kakhulu - kodwa umeluleki kufanele akhethwe ngokucophelela! Kufanele kube umuntu ozinikele ofuna ukusiza umalimi akhule - ozothatha isikhathi sokuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono futhi abaxhase. Kufanele bahlangane futhi bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye kahle. Hlinzeka abalimi ngemininingwane futhi ungathathi izinyathelo ngaphandle kokuhlangana nabo. Kuthiwa - asifuni lutho ngaphandle kwethu - futhi kufanele kube njalo lapha. Ukuxhasa abalimi ngokuhlola nokunquma zonke izimpahla zabo epulazini, amapulazi, izinsiza, imishini, izinkomo, izitshalo, nezinye izinsiza, njll. Kufanele baqonde kahle ukuthi bangazisebenzisa kanjani ekulimaleni. Isibonelo: bangaki ama-kW (amandla) umalimi adingayo ukuze alime amapulazi athile? Qinisekisa ukuthi umalimi ungene ohlelweni oluzomfundisa futhi luthuthukise. Ukuba umalimi onguye osemthethweni kuthatha isikhathi, futhi kukhona izinhlangano eziningi ezingasiza ukuthuthukisa abalimi. Hlola isimo soqeqesho esinikezwayo. Kukho abaqeqeshi abaqoshiwe abangawenzi kahle umsebenzi ngoba nabo baphuthile amakhono okusebenza (awukwazi ukufunda ukulima ngokufunda kuphela izincwadi!). Qinisekisa ukuthi awuqali ngephrojekthi enkulu kakhulu. Abalimi abasha badinga isikhathi nokuxhaswa; uma iphrojekthi ikhuliswa kakhulu, izinto ziba nzima, futhi konke kuqhekeka. Kungase kube kuhle ukuxhasa abalimi abangama-50 noma ngaphezulu (kuqala), kodwa kaningi lokhu kuqhekeka ngoba kungekho izandla ezanele zokwenza umsebenzi. Kungcono ukuqala ngabalimi abangu-15 - 20 bese wandisa inani ngonyaka.
Iphuzu elivunguzayo: "Umhlabathi uyifa labantu bonke kanye nabantu abaphumelelayo benhlangano: umhlaba ungowethu. Umhlabathi ungumkhathi wezinhlobo zonke zokudla futhi udala umsebenzi wezolimo. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakuthatha indawo. Ngakho-ke, thina njengabantu sinomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina leli th treasure lethu ngokukhuthaza njalo, silisebenzise ngendlela efanele, ukuze sakhe umhlaba onempilo ngoba umhlaba onempilo ungakha kuphela ezimbonini zomhlabathi eziphilayo." - JC Ross. Umhlabathi wakhiwa kancane kancane eminyakeni eminingi, ungalahleka ngokushesha, futhi uma ulahlekile, akukho okungakuthatha indawo. Ngaphakathi kwawo, akukho okushintshayo. Konke okwenzeka, njengokuphuma komhlabathi, kudale umhlabathi uvelwe ezintweni ezinjengamatshe. Nokho, kumele sihlukanise phakathi kokushintsha kwemvelo nalokhu okwenziwa ngenxa yokungenelela kwabantu. Ukwakhiwa komhlabathi kwemvelo kuthatha izinkulungwane zeminyaka, kodwa umuntu angawuchitha konke lokhu ngosuku olulodwa uma engasebenzisi umhlabathi ngendlela efanele futhi engalimi ngendlela ehambisana nezimiso zokulima ezisindayo. Ukuphatha kahle ukuphuma komhlabathi kuzinzile kuzosiza umlimi nakwabanye abantu emhlabeni jikelele - kusiza umnikazi ukuthi agcine umhlabathi nomswakama (amanzi) ngaphakathi komhlabathi, kusiza abanye ukuvimbela imifula ukuthi ingawashiyi impahla yabo, kuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi emifula acacile futhi kuvikela umhlaba emhlabeni jikelele. Ukulahleka komhlabathi kanye nokukhiqiza kwawo. Ukulahleka kwamanzi agijimayo angasetshenziswa. Ukwehla kwemikhakha nezindawo ezingakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ukuqubuka (kwamanzi amaningi) nezomiso ezinzima. Ukwehla kwenani lemakethe yomhlaba. Ukwehla kwemikhakha yokwenza inzuzo ekulimalini. Izinkambu azikasebenzi, zishiywe. Izitshalo ezikhula kahle. Kukhona izinto ezintathu eziyinhloko ezibangela ukuphuma komhlabathi: amanzi, umoya, kanye neqhwa. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sithola ikakhulukazi ukuphuma kwamanzi, bese sibheka ukuphuma komoya. Ukuphuma kwamanzi kwenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuhamba kwamanzi phezulu kanye nokwakhiwa kwemithombo. Ngokuvamile, umhlabathi lapho kuzolima khona ulungiswe kahle, uvalwe, uhlelekile, uqinile. Okwamanje, sisebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi ukuguguleka okuncane - umhlabathi awusulungiswa ngendlela evamile ukuvimbela ukulahleka komhlabathi ophakeme. Isikhathi sokulima siphinde sibe yisikhathi sezikhukhula ezinzima. Lapho kunetha kakhulu kulomhlabathi olungisiwe, umhlabathi uvame ukuba buthakathaka, kodwa kuvame ukuba nezinsalela zomhlabathi ezincane ezizohamba namanzi. Ngemuva kokunetha kokuqala, amanzi amaningi aqala ukuhamba futhi agijime lapho kukhona ukwehla, ethwele umhlabathi nezinye izinto. Lokhu kungaqhubeka isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokubona kalula. Ekugcineni, umlimi uzobona ukuthi izinkulungwane zamathani omhlabathi zilahlekile unyaka nonyaka. Ngokuvamile izinkambu azilingani, ezinye ziphakeme, ezinye zisezingeni eliphansi, futhi isimo somhlabathi asifani kuzo zonke izindawo. Amanzi avame ukuhamba ngaphansi kwezindawo eziphakeme, akha imithombo emincane yokukhula. Lapho ukuphuma kwenzeka endaweni ethambile, lezi zinsizakusebenza zihlangana ukuze zakhe imithombo engameleke emagatsheni ezihlahla - bese kwakhiwa imithombo emikhulu. Lapho amanzi eqala ukuhamba emithonjeni ethile, amandla alezi zinsizakusebenza ayanda futhi ukuphuma kwanda kakhulu. Lapho ukuphuma okufana nezithupha kufika endaweni lapho imithombo eyakhiwe ingaphinde ilungiswe, kufika ezingeni lokuphuma okufana nezithupha. Le nqubekela phambili esheshayo yemithombo ingalimaza izindawo ezinkulu zomhlaba futhi ivimbele ukulima okwengeziwe kulezi zindawo. Izigaba zethu ezizayo zinethemba lokuthi sizogcina umhlabathi ukuze bakwazi ukukhiqiza ukudla. Ngokuphatha umhlabathi kahle, singaqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba uzosetshenziswa kusasa nakusasa.
Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi luhlose ukusungula nokuphatha izindawo lapho kukhona izivivinyo ezizama ukukhombisa abalimi imiphumela yezindlela ezahlukene zokulima, njengokulungisa kahle umhlabathi, ukufaka izivuno ezifanele, ukukhetha izinhlobo zezitshalo, ukuphatha izihlahla eziphilayo nezifo, nokuvuna. Sikwazile ukuvula izindawo ezingu-46 zokuvivinya eziphathwa uhlelo lwethu. Lezi zivivinyo zihlose ukukhombisa izindlela ezifanele zokulima - kungaba ukufaka izivuno noma cha, inani lezinhlamvu: kakhulu noma kancane, kungaba ukuwasha izihlahla eziphilayo noma cha. Ikakhulukazi, kusiza abalimi ezindaweni ezithile kanye nalabo abangafundile, njengoba lezi zivivinyo zibakhombisa izindlela ezifanele zokulima ngesikhathi esifanele. Izinsuku zabalimi zinikeza ithuba kubo bonke abathintekayo kwezolimo ukuba bafundise futhi baxhumane nabalimi. Ngesikhathi salezi zinsuku zabalimi, kukhona abasebenzi bethu, kanye nezithunywa ezivela ezinkampanini ezinikeza zawe zokulima, amabhizinisi ezolimo, umshwalense, abanikazi bezimali, njll. Ngonyaka ongenhla sibe nezinsuku zabalimi eziyi-65 - inani labalimi abavakasha lezi zinsuku laqala ku-8 lafika ku-250!
Isizinda sikahlobo lwehlobo sokukhiqiza sesisondele ekupheleni ezindaweni eziningi, futhi abaphathi basebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uzothola umkhiqizo. Sekuyisikhathi sokuhlola lezi zinsiza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi zizokwazi ukukusebenzela ngonyaka ozayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awekho amaphutha emaphaketheni nasezindaweni eziseduze nepompo. Hlola ukuthi amaphakethe amanzi asekhona futhi aqinile ngoba ajwayele ukujula uma uwoyela ewela kuwo. Hlola ukuthi ikhava ye-radiator isaqinile kahle. Uma ubona ukuthi amanzi aphansi kodwa ungatholi enye indawo evulekile, kungase kube ukuthi lekhava evulekile - shintsha ngayo entsha. Kubalulekile ukukhokha wonke amanzi ezinhlelweni zokupholisa minyaka yonke futhi uphumelele i-anti-freeze entsha. Khumbula ukuthi i-hlobo isondela, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba ne-anti-freeze entsha. Qinisekisa ukuthi uthenga i-anti-freeze efanele, futhi ungahlanganisi izinhlobo ezahlukene zemibala ngoba azifani. Qinisekisa ukuthi amafan belts asakhula kahle. Hlola futhi uqiniseke ibhande. Uma kukhona ama-belt amabili futhi elilodwa likhathazekile lokuphuka, kufanele ushintshe kokubili ngezintsha ukuze zisebenze kahle. Hlola ukuthi awekho amaphutha emathangeni kuze kube lapho i-diesel ingena khona ezinjini. Qinisekisa ukuthi ithangi likhanya, futhi hlola ukuthi i-filter yangaphakathi isasebenza. Faka ama-filter e-diesel amasha kuzo zonke izindawo. Hlanza umtrap we-manzi. Kubalulekile ukuthi ithangi le-diesel lihlale liphumelele ngoba uma kukhona umoya ethangini, iba amanzi. Lawa manzi angalimaza ipompo ye-injector. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyazi ukuthi isikhathi sokukh service abaphathi bakho - kungase kube isikhathi sokushintsha uwoyela nokufaka i-filter entsha. Uma sekuyisikhathi sokushintsha uwoyela we-differential kanye ne-gearbox, khumbula ukushintsha lezi zifilitha futhi (khumbula ukuthi uhlelo lwe-hydraulic lusebenzisa lo mwelo, ngakho hlola amaphutha). Uma ubuyekeza abaphathi, hlola ukuthi awekho uwoyela ow leaking lapho ufaka khona i-filter noma ku-sump cap. Hlola zonke izindawo lapho uwoyela ungavuleka khona - faka ama-seals amasha uma kudingeka. Faka i-grease kuzo zonke izindawo (ku-shaft yokuhamba nezinye izixhumi). Hlola ama-air filters - ingabe asasebenza futhi akhanya - faka amasha uma kudingeka. Hlola amaphakethe lapho umoya uphumelelwa khona, uqiniseke zonke izixhumi. Ibhethri - ibhethri kufanele ikhululeke ngokuphelele. Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele, uma ephansi, thela amanzi ebhethrini (ungawathola esitolo sebhathri). Khipha izintambo zebhethri futhi uhlanze. Buya izintambo kahle futhi faka i-grease encane lapho zixhunywe khona ukuvimbela ukugqwala kwe-asidi. Hlola ukuthi intambo exhunyiwe kumshini kanye nekhanda elixhunyiwe ku-starter iqinile. Qinisekisa ukuthi izintambo zikagesi azinayo i-grease noma uwoyela futhi ziqinile kahle kuzo zonke izindawo (lokhu kuvimbela ukushisa, ukuvibha, nokumanzisa). Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izibani zokuxwayisa nezilinganiso zisebenza kahle - uma uthinta ukhiye wokuvula, konke kufanele kukhanye. (Izibani zok pressure ye-oyela nezibani ze-alternator kufanele zikhanye uma uthinta ukhiye, kufanele zikhanye uma umshini uqala - ezinye izibani zizokhanya uma kukhona inkinga endaweni ethile). Hlola zonke ama-fuses njalo. Amathayi kufanele ahlale esesimweni esihle - akufanele kube nezikhala, izindawo ezilimazekile, noma ama-bulges. Hlola ukuthi ukujula kuhambisana kahle futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ibhalansi yamanzi nomoya kumathayi angemuva ilungile. Hlola izinyathelo zamathayi ahamba umshini - uma ziqinile, azikwazi ukubamba kahle. Hlola ukuthi izinyathelo zamathayi wonke ahlelekile ukuze ahambe phambili. Izinto ezihamba phambili zomphathi zineqhaza elibalulekile, ngakho kunezinto eziningi ezingaguga ngokushesha. Kubalulekile ukuthi ama-bushings, ama-bearings, kanye ne-gearbox konke kube sesimweni esihle. Uma kukhona izingxenye ezigugile, kungadala ukuthi umphathi ungaphatheki kahle endleleni - lokhu kungadala ingozi ngoba umshayeli akanawo amandla okulawula umphathi kahle, futhi kubangela ukuguga kwamathayi. Kukhona ama-plates akhethekile avikela umphathi (umbala wabo uvamise ukufana nalowo womphathi). Inhloso yalezi ziplate ukuvikela umshayeli nezinto ezihambayo. Njalo lezi ziplate ziya zikhula, futhi kwesinye isikhathi azikho. Kubalulekile ukuzigcina kumphathi, shintsha lezo ezingekho, futhi hlola ukuthi ama-bolts abamba aqinile kahle. Izingxenye lapho ezinye izinto zixhunywe futhi ziqinisiwe ngumphathi kufanele zihlale ziqinile. Sebenzisa ama-pins afanele usayizi uma udonsa ezinye izinto ngoba azinawo umthwalo ofanayo - ama-pins amancane athwala umthwalo wonke walokho okudonswayo, futhi yibo kuphela abamba ibhande lokudonsa. Iziphumo eziningi zenzeka uma lezi zingxenye zingahlolwanga kahle.
Ithini uhlobo lwezokuqeqesha olunikezwa yiGrain SA? Ubhala: Jane McPherson, Umphathi Wohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi beGrain SA. Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi beGrain SA luhloselwe ukuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama ngokuqeqesha amakhono okuba abalimi bezomnotho. Ukukhiqiza ukudla njengokhukhamba, ama-soybeans, ufulawa, kanye ne-barley kuhambisana nezindlela ezifanele zokukhiqiza, ukuthengisa, ukusetshenziswa kwemishini, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha amapulazi. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezwe kanye nokuba nendawo. Izihloko esizifakile kulolu hlelo zimi kanje: "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ubulukhuni," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ama-Soybean," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ufulawa," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza I-Barley." Njengomlimi othuthukayo, sikholelwa ukuthi kufanele uqale ngalezi zifundo ezihlobene nezitshalo ezikhuliswa endaweni yakho yokulima. Uma ungakhethi lezi zifundo, uzoba nezinkinga zokufunda izifundo ezinzima futhi uzobe uhamba ngemuva kwabanye abafundi. Ulwazi olukhona mayelana nezindlela zomnotho lujwayele ukuba lukhulu, ngakho kube inselelo ukukhetha lokho okufanele kufundiswe ngoba kunolwazi oluningi. Nokho, kukhona izihloko ezibalulekile esifuna ukuzifundisa kulolu hlelo. Ngakho, sikwazile ukufaka zonke izici ezibalulekile kulolu hlelo lokuqala oluhlobene nokukhiqiza nokuthengisa, bese sihlanganisa ne "Isifundo Esiphakeme Sokukhiqiza Ubulukhuni Nokuthengisa." Ukuqinisekiswa kwezitshalo kanye nokuphathwa kwezingozi kuyizinkinga ezingenzeka. Isifundo Esiphakeme Sokukhiqiza Ubulukhuni sihlobene nobuchwepheshe obuhambisana nokukhula komhlabathi kanye nokuphakama komhlabathi. Uma ufuna usizo ngalolu hlelo, kufanele uqale ube nesifundo sokwethulwa, futhi kufanele manje ukhiqize ukudla okuthengiswayo. Lolu hlelo lungase lungafaneleki kumlimi ophila ngezinga elincane. Kukhona iziphathimandla eziningi ezabelana ngolwazi ezisebenza emaphandleni ahlukene, futhi kufanele zibe nolwazi nokwesekwa kwabalamuli. Ngeshwa, iziphathimandla eziningi azikaze ziqeqeshwe kahle futhi zikhona ukungabi nolwazi ekukhiqizeni ukudla. Abanye baphendule (banama-cerificates) kodwa bangezange basebenze emapulazini - okuyinto ebalulekile ekulimaleni. Ngakho-ke, sihlanganisile lolu hlelo: "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ubulukhuni Kubaphathi Ababelana Ngolwazi." Sifundise leli zifundo izikhathi eziningi eziphathimandla futhi sizame ukubonisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kanjani epulazini - sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kusizile emsebenzini wabo. Isici esiyinhloko sokukhiqiza ubulukhuni esizokwenza inzuzo sihlobene nezithuthuthu nemishini. Sithole ukuthi isimo semishini kubalimi abathuthukayo sikhona kancane - ngakho-ke singenise leli zifundo. Lolu hlelo lubalulekile kulabo abafuna ukuba abalimi bezomnotho - kufanele uqonde ukuthi imishini yakhiwa kanjani, bese uzokwazi ukuyiphatha kahle. Ukuphatha kahle imishini kuyisikhumbuzo esizovula umnyango wokungena ekulimaleni kwezomnotho. Awukwazi ukuvula lowo mnyango uma ungaphathi izithuthuthu nemishini kahle. Sithole ukuthi kukhona abalimi abancane abaningi, ikakhulukazi eMpumalanga Kapa, abangenamishini nezithuthuthu (Uhlelo Olukhulu Lokudla lweMnyango Wezolimo eMpumalanga Kapa luhlanganise kakhulu abaqashi kodwa alusebenze kahle). Sibone ukuthi kuzosisiza abakhiqizi bobulukhuni ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluchaza umsebenzi wabakwaqashi, lokho okufanele kwenziwe, kanjani, nini, njll. Abakwaqashi bavame ukuba nezinselelo zokusebenza kahle. Nokho, kukhona izindawo lapho abalimi belima ezindaweni ezincane ukuze bathenge izithuthuthu nemishini, ngakho-ke kudingeka abaqashi. Sikholelwa ukuthi leli zifundo labakwaqashi lizobonisa abaqashi abasebenza ezolimo ukuthi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka kahle, ngezindinganiso ezifanele, ngesikhathi esifanele, futhi ngemali efanele. Lapho umlimi engatholi inzuzo, abaqashi ngeke babe nomsebenzi esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphambi kuka-1994, abalimi abaningi balima ezindaweni ezibizwa ngokuthi "izindawo zokuhlala." Eminyakeni edlule, abalimi abaningi abazi ukuthi kukhona izinkinga eziningi ekulimaleni nokuthi izinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlabathi nezimo zezulu azifaneleki ekutshaliseni ezinye izitshalo ezizokwenza inzuzo. Uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi: Ukusetshenziswa Kwepulazi Nokuhlola Izinsiza luhlanganiswe ukusiza abalimi baqonde ukuthi isimo sezinsiza zabo sikhona kanjani bese bezokwazi ukusisebenzisa ngezindlela ezizobabuyisela inzuzo esikhathini esizayo ekulimaleni. Ukusebenza nabalimi abanguye amalungu ezigaba zokufunda iminyaka kukhombisile ukuthi kudingeka olunye uhlelo. Siqale uhlelo olusha olubizwa ngokuthi "Uhlelo LweBalimi Oluphakeme," oluvumele abaqondisi bezifunda ukuba basondele kulabo abalimi abazama ukuthuthuka. Siphinde sabona ukuthi abalimi abaningi abawasebenzisi kahle amathuba akhona; badinga usizo lokubheka izici ezibalulekile ukuze baphumelele ekulimaleni. Izindawo nezinto ezibalulekile zok继续 umsebenzi. Iziphathimandla zezifunda zezolimo zineziphathimandla eziningi ezabelana ngolwazi ezifundile kodwa azinakho amandla okwenza umsebenzi emapulazini. Ngemisebenzi yethu yokuqeqesha nabalimi, sisebenze eduze kakhulu neMnyango Wezolimo futhi sifundise izifundo eziningi. Sikholelwa ukuthi uma singahlinzeka ngezifundo ezizokwenza iziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi zibe namandla okwenza umsebenzi, zizokwazi ukusiza abalimi abaningi ukuba bakhule ngokwezimali. Asihlanganisi abalimi neziphathimandla kulolu hlelo olulodwa ngoba iziphathimandla zikhathazekile ukubuza imibuzo phambi kwabalamuli - azifuni ukuhleka. Izifundo zethu zifaka abafundi nemishini, kodwa sithole ukuthi kuvame ukuba bahluleka ukukala imishini ngokwabo. Ukukala nokuphatha umshini wokuphonsa. Abalimi abaningi abahambile ezifundweni zokuphatha imishini nezithuthuthu bacela olunye uhlelo oluzobafundisa ukuthi injini isebenza kanjani nokuthi iyalungiswa kanjani. Abalimi abaningi bahluleka ngoba bangenalo ulwazi lokulungisa injini. Sifuna ukugcizelela lapha ukuthi leli zifundo alihloselwe ukuqeqesha (ukufundisa) abaphathi bezinjini. Lezi zifundo zihloselwe ukufundisa umlimi izingxenye zenjini nokuthi kufanele ziqhathaniswe kanjani. Ukulungisa injini kuyinto okufanele yenziwe nguchwepheshe. Ukulungisa injini noma ibhande lenjini kubiza kakhulu - uma ungenalo ulwazi, uzobe uchitha imali uzama ukulungisa lezo zinto. Lapho abantu behambela lezi zifundo, babona ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kanjani, kodwa bese beqonda ukuthi kukhona ezinye izidingo. Kukhona abakhiqizi ezindaweni ezifana neTaung/Hartswater abangakwazi ukuncibilikisa, nakwezinye izindawo eNyakatho-ntshonalanga naseFree State. Nokho, izindlela zokutshala ubulukhuni zifana, kunezinye izinto okufanele zicatshangelwe uma uncibilikisa. Ngakho-ke, sihlanganisile izifundo ezimbili: "Ukukhiqiza Ubulukhuni Ngokuncibilikisa," "Ukukhiqiza Ufulawa Ngokuncibilikisa." Ukukhiqiza ubul
Ulwazi lokusebenzisa amathayi akho efemini ngendlela efanele luzokusiza ukuba usebenze ngokuphepha futhi unciphise izindleko kanye nokulimala kwezitshalo nasemhlabathini. Ukuhamba efemini kusho ukusebenza ezindaweni eziningi ezihlukene - ukulima emapulazini nasekudonseni ithreyi emgwaqweni ophukile. Lokhu kuyahluka, kodwa kukhona umyalezo obalulekile okufanele ulandelwe njalo. Lapho sikhuluma ngamahayi, kunezinto ezibalulekile: hlanganisa uhlobo lwethayi nohlobo lomsebenzi (ukusebenza emhlabathini, sands ethambile, njll.), landela imihlahlandlela yomkhiqizi mayelana nosayizi nohlobo lwamahayi, ikakhulukazi hlanganisa ingcindezi yomoya nesisindo somthwalo nendawo lapho kusetshenziswa khona. Umoya kuphela ngaphakathi kwethayi ophatha umthwalo othile, futhi abakhiqizi bamathayi afana neGoodyear bakhombisa umthwalo wethayi ethile, ingcindezi, kanye nezinga lesivinini. Uma uthwala okuthile okukhulu kakhulu kodwa ungakhuphuli ingcindezi yomoya, kuzokwenza amathayi akhathale futhi aphume ngokushesha, okuzokwenza imishini ingasebenzi kahle futhi amathayi azokhathala ngokushesha. Uma umthwalo unheavy futhi amathayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele, ithayi izogoba ohlangothini futhi imiphetho yethayi ingase ikhathele futhi ithayi izophuka njengoba ihamba. Amathayi e-bias noma e-crossply ajwayele ukuhamba ohlangothini uma umthwalo unheavy futhi ingcindezi iphansi uma amawheels edonswa kanzima, umzimba wonke wethayi uzonakala. Ithayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele ingase igxume emgqeni futhi i-bead ingase iphuke, nendawo lapho ithayi ibamba khona emgqeni izonakala. Ngakolunye uhlangothi: uma ithayi inengcindezi ephezulu kakhulu, iba qinile kakhulu, okwenza ithayi ibambe kuphela emgwaqweni ngaphakathi futhi ikhathele lapho. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi ithayi lonke alibambisani nomhlaba, futhi alikwazi ukubamba kahle, lizogxuma futhi limilise umhlabathi. Uma kudingeka ukusebenza ngamahayi ezimo lapho kudingeka khona, amathayi azohamba kalula. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukulungisa ingcindezi ngokwezimo zokusebenza, njengokudonsela ithreyi noma emshinini omunye, noma ukuhamba emgwaqweni ophukile. Ubuningi bengingcindezi yethayi busemqoka, kodwa ukusebenzisa ithayi enengcindezi ehlukile kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubambeni kwamawheels kanye nengcindezi yayo emhlabathini. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona izitshalo nemithombo ngaphansi komhlaba, kungase kube ngcono ukusebenza ngethayi elibanzi elinengcindezi ephezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzovumela imishini ukuthwala umthwalo ofanayo njengethayi elincane ngobubanzi kodwa eliqinile emoyeni - le thayi izojwayela ukuhamba kalula emhlabathini futhi iqinise umhlabathi. Ngokufanayo, emsandleni, ithayi elibanzi elingaqinile kakhulu lizobamba kahle ngoba linendawo enkulu yokubamba - lihamba phezu komsand, lingagxili. Kungcono ukusebenzisa i-4 wheel drive uma umhlaba uhlehlela, kodwa ungasebenzisa lokhu emgwaqweni ophukile noma emigwaqweni eqinile ngoba kuholela ekukhathaleni okungalingani kumathayi aphambili, okwenza ukuhamba kube nzima nokusebenzisa ezinye izingxenye ngendlela ephunyukayo.
Amathayi asetshenziswa ezindaweni zokulima abiza kakhulu, kodwa kukhona imiyalezo ebalulekile ezokusiza ukuthi ulondoloze le mali oyichithile futhi uqinisekise ukuthi amathayi ahlala isikhathi eside. Uma ushintsha amathayi aphakeme kakhulu noma aphansi kakhulu, awaguga ngokushesha, umzimba wethayi ufinyelela kakhulu futhi uzoguga ngokushesha - into ethatha imali eningi! Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukulungisa ingcindezi yethayi ngokuya ngomsebenzi owenziwayo, futhi uhlole ingcindezi njalo. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kanye noma kabili ngesonto, futhi khumbula ukushintsha ingcindezi yethayi uma udonsa umthwalo onzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, hlola nesimo samathayi nokuthi aphelile kuphi. Uma kubonakala kunenkinga, kungase kube uphawu lokuthi ithayi likhukhuleka, noma ingcindezi ayifanele, noma izingxenye zokushayela azihambisani kahle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isondo lihamba ngegazi elifanele kuzokusiza ukuthi ithayi ibambe kahle phansi, izohlala isikhathi eside, futhi ngeke udle i-diesel eningi, okwenza kube lula ukubona lapho ingozi noma ukuvuza kungase kwenzeke. Khumbula ukuhlola ingcindezi uma ithayi ipholile, ngaphambi kokuthi ihanjiswe ngoba uma ihanjiswe iyashisa futhi ingcindezi iyanda. Ukulungisa amathayi - hamba kumuntu onolwazi! Umyalezo weGoodyear uthi amathayi kufanele afakwe noma alungiswe abantu abanolwazi ngoba lo msebenzi ungaba yingozi. Isibonelo: uma ithayi ingafakiwe kahle esondweni, uma iphakanyisiwe ingaphuka ngamandla amakhulu. Futhi ithayi ingashintsha esondweni uma idonswa kanzima, kudala ingozi kuthayi, emhlabeni, nasekhasini. Ithayi nesondo kufanele kubekwe endaweni ephephile uma kuhlangene. Uma ulungisa i-valve stem, khumbula ukuthi ingavula futhi kule ndawo. Uma ithayi ihanjiswa ngaphandle komoya noma ngegazi eliphansi, ungayiphakanyisa ngaphandle kokuyikhipha esondweni ukuze uhlole ukuthi ayilimazwanga - kungcono ukuba ihlolwe umuntu onolwazi. Okwesibili okumele kukhunjulwe: hlale usebenzisa ikhefu le-valve; ungashayi isondo noma ithayi ngensimbi uma iphakanyisiwe ngokuphelele; ungafaki i-valve stem engalingani; ungafaki i-valve stem egebhezi noma elimele; landela imiyalelo yomkhiqizi futhi ungafaki ithayi elikhulu kakhulu noma elincane kakhulu; qiniseka ukuthi ungazami ukulungisa isondo elilimazekile ngokuwelda noma ngokulilungisa ngezinye izindlela. Nokho, abantu beGoodyear bazama ukusebenzisa izinto ezizovimbela ukuguga kwamathayi, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi irhasi ithanda ukumunca uwoyela, i-grease, i-diesel, nezinye amakhemikhali, futhi ingalimala ukushisa naselanga. Ngakho-ke, amathayi afanele kufanele agcinwe endaweni epholile, emnyama, hhayi eduze kwemishini yokuwelda, ama-generator, noma eminye imishini ngoba lokhu kungadala ukulimala kwamathayi futhi azophuka uma esetshenziswa futhi. Ngokufanayo, geza zonke izinkemikhali kumathayi ngemuva kokuwaphonsa ngokwelashwa. Uma ubeka amathayi ezindaweni, wehlise ingcindezi ibe ngu-10 psi bese uwabeka phezulu. Amathayi akhishwe ezindaweni angabekwa phansi noma abekwe phezulu kodwa hhayi amaningi kakhulu ngoba uma engaphansi kwengcindezi azogcwala. Umshini onama-wheels kufanele uphakanyiswe ukuze ama-wheels angathintani nomhlaba. Uma umshini ubunzima kakhulu, phakanyisa ingcindezi yethayi ngo-25% futhi uhambise umshini kancane kancane ukuze amathayi angathintani nomhlaba endaweni eyodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Ngokuvamile nangokwemvelo, intengo yomhlaba ihambisana nekhono lalomhlaba lokukhiqiza ukudla kwezolimo. Ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, abalimi basagcina umqondo wokuthi uma umhlabathi unokukhiqiza futhi ukhiqiza ukudla okuningi, sizokhokha intengo ethile. Ukukhuphuka nokwehla kwezinga lenzalo nakho kunomthelela ngoba abalimi abaningi balima ngemali ebolekiwe. Ukungena kwemali yokwakha izindlu nezinye izinto epulazini nakho kubangela intengo yamapulazi ukuthi ishintshe. Ungangena ezivumelwaneni nabanye abalimi ukuze wabelane ngempahla. Inzuzo izotholakala ngemuva kwesikhathi eside ngoba ihambisana nokukhuphuka kwentengo yomhlaba ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Inzuzo ezotholakala ngemuva kwesikhathi eside ihambisana nenani lempahla engatholakala epulazini ethile, kodwa lokhu nakho kube nokushintsha ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngokuvamile, intengo yamapulazi ikhuphukile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi manje sekucacile ukuthi umhlaba onokukhiqiza kahle usendleleni yabantu abambalwa. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubalimi abasha abafuna ukungena kwezolimo ukuthola umhlaba wokulima ngokushesha futhi bakhokhe ngenzuzo engatholakala. Nokho, lokhu kuyahluka uma umhlaba ungatholakala ngezinhlawulo (LRAD), noma ifakwe, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngenzalo ephansi (njengoba kwenzeka njengamanje ngehlelo elisha elethulwe uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba elibizwa ngokuthi iProactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS)). Ukuqashwa komhlaba sekushintshile; kwakuwayindlela yokungena kwezolimo kubalimi abasafufusa, kodwa manje sekuphenduke indlela yokuthi abalimi bezomnotho bathole umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze bathuthukise ukulima kwabo. Sidinga ukucabanga kahle ngalokhu ngoba kukhona umhlaba owanele ezandleni zomphakathi wonke ongasebenzisa, futhi kukhona abalimi abaningi abanobuchwepheshe abadinga umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze balime ngendlela ezokhiqiza inzuzo. Ukuqashwa kunikeza abalimi ithuba lokwandisa umsebenzi wabo kodwa akudingi imali eningi ehambisana nokuthenga nokuba nomhlaba. Khumbula: Kukhona izindlela zokungena kwezolimo ngaphandle kokuba umnikazi wombuso; ungakwazi ukuqasha ipulazi, usebenzise umhlaba womphakathi, noma wabelane ngalowo mhlaba nabanye abalimi.
I-VAT, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-Value Added Tax - kufanele ubhalise? Eminyakeni emine edlule, sibhale kaningi ngalesi sihloko se-VAT. Kodwa manje sibona ukuthi abanye abalimi abambalwa baye babhalisela. Kuzosiza kanjani uma ngibhalisela? Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphakathi, ngakho abalimi kufanele bazame zonke izindlela zokunciphisa lezo zindleko. Ukubhalisela i-VAT kuyindlela eyodwa yokunciphisa izindleko. I-VAT isetshenziswa ezintweni ezidingekayo zokulima - imbewu, amafutha, amakhemikhali, ukulungiswa kwemishini, nokugcinwa, njll. Lokhu kufinyelela ku-14% wezindleko. Uma ukhokha u-R4,000 ngehektare oyilima, kusho ukuthi ukhokha u-R560 kwi-VAT. Uma ubhalisiwe, uzokwazi ukukhipha le mali emuva ku-SARS. Okwamanje, le mali ingaphezu kokuthola abalimi abakwenza ngehektare. Uma ungabhaliswanga, ngeke ukwazi ukukhipha le profiti yokulima kwakho. Kungani abalimi bengafuni ukubhalisela? Isidingo sokuphatha amarekhodi wemali engenayo nezindleko singesinye sezizathu zokuthi abalimi ababhali ngoba besaba ukuthi i-SARS izokwazi ukuthi bangakanani abathola futhi izokwazi ukuhlola amarekhodi abo. Uma ungena kokubhaliswa njengebalimi bezomnotho, kubalulekile ukugcina amarekhodi amahle. Kufanele wazi ukuthi izindleko zakho ziyi ziphi, ukuthi iphrofiti yakho iyini, nokuthi le mali iya kuphi. Njalo, abalimi baphuma emtaxini, bephika ukuthi abatholi okuningi. Basebenza ngempesheni futhi akukho bufakazi obubhaliwe. Lokhu akuyona indlela efanele yokusebenza. Kukhona izizathu ezimbili. Okokuqala, kuphikisana nomthetho ukungahlinzeki i-SARS ngemininingwane yakho yezezimali. Okwesibili, ngeke ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele mayelana neb business yakho yokulima uma ungenayo amarekhodi akhombisa imininingwane yakho yezezimali. Khumbula ukuthi sihlala sisebenzisa izinsiza ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni, ngakho-ke kuwumthwalo wethu ukuhlinzeka ngezimali ezidingekayo. Asikwazi ukuphuma kulomtaxi kodwa siphinde sithole inzuzo kulokhu. Khumbula ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisa le mali yokuthola izimali zokwakha imigwaqo, izikole, izibhedlela, amaphoyisa, njll. Uma ungena kokubhaliswa njengebalimi bezomnotho, bhalisela i-VAT ne-Income Tax.
I-Folio strap: Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa abalimi. Ngesikhathi se-NAMPO 2009, ingxenye yeziqu ze-250 Ton Club kanye nabanye abalimi abasha bamenywa emhlanganweni. Sikholelwa ukuthi isikhathi sesifikile sokuthi abakhiqizi abamnyama abasha bakhuphule izwi labo futhi baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile kubo. I-inshurensi yokuqala iwukulima. Kunombuzo obalulekile okufanele ubuziwe thina lapha eNingizimu Afrika - ingabe sifuna ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele lapha, noma ingabe sifuna ukubhekana nengcuphe yokuthola ukudla kwamanye amazwe? Ukwenza inzuzo ekulimeni ukudla okuyisisekelo kun压力 okukhulu kangangokuthi abalimi abaningi abakwazi ukuphumelela manje nakusasa? Abakhiqizi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bavame ukulima ezindaweni ezomile, futhi manje baphikisana nokudla okuyisisekelo okuvela kwamanye amazwe. Njalo lokhu kudla kukhula ezindaweni ezinokunethezeka, futhi abanye abalimi bathola ukwesekwa kuhulumeni wabo. INingizimu Afrika akufanele ivumele ukudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe athengiswe lapha. Ukuhamba ngemigwaqo kubi futhi uhlelo lwezitimela alusebenzi kahle. Uhlelo lokuhamba ngezitimela ludinga ukuvuselelwa. Azikho izintela zokudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe ezivikela abalimi bendawo. Izintela zokudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe kufanele zethulwe ukuze zivikela abalimi bethu. Eminyakeni emihle sibe neziphumo ezinkulu ze-maize, manje awekho amanye amaqhamuka angafakwa ukuze kulethwe inzuzo kubalimi - ama-grains, amabele, kanye ne-soybeans nakho kukhiqizwa ngezinga elikhulu, intengo yemakethe iphansi kakhulu, abalimi abakwazi ukufaka izitshalo uma amapulazi ebhekene kuphela nezimvula. Uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi "ukuguqulwa komhlaba" kufanele lwenziwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ezindaweni ezihluphekayo, ukudla akufanele kufakwe, utshani kufanele bufakwe ukuze kukhiqizwe inyama. Imakethe yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele yande. Izindlela zokulima ezintsha kanye nobuchwepheshe kuholele ekukhuleni kokukhiqizwa kokudla, manje sekukhona ukudla okuningi. Abalimi kufanele basebenzise izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko ezifana nokulima "okungagqokile". Kunokwehluka okukhulu phakathi kwentengo yemakethe ethola umalimi kanye nentengo ekhokhwa umthengi esitolo - uma othile phakathi ethatha inani elincane kokubili, bobabili umalimi nomthengi bazothola inzuzo. Ulwazi ngalokhu kufanele lutholakale kalula ukuze bonke ababamba iqhaza ohlelweni lokukhiqiza nokuthenga ukudla bazi. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphansi. Lapho kuba nesivumelwano sokwakha izinto ezimbi mayelana nemakethe, kufanele kuhlolwe kahle. Izindleko eziphezulu zokubolekwa kwemali. I-Land Bank kufanele ihlinzeke ngemalimboleko ngentela ephansi. Imakethe yokudla ingaba phansi kakhulu. Ibhonasi ingakhokhwa ngokusekelwe ekukhiqizweni kwabalamini abasha. Lokhu kungasiza labo abasebenza ngokuzikhandla. Izindawo eziningi ezibekwe zilahlekile, zingakhiqizi lutho - imizamo eminingi iphelelwe yisikhathi. Izindlela zokukhetha kufanele zifake ukuqeqeshwa ekulimeni komlimi othile nolwazi lwabo. Ubufakazi obudingekayo obukhombisa ulwazi lwabo abafuna ukuwina. Khuthaza (azise) indlela yezinhlangano ezithenga futhi zithengise izinto lapho kukhethwa abatholi kanye nokwesekwa abakhiqizi. Sekela labo abanikwe amathuba. Abasebenzi boMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba abazi lutho ngezindaba zokulima. Abapolitiki abaqondi kahle okwenzeka ekulimeni. Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela - izivumelwano eziningi zilahlekile. Izindlela zokuphatha lezi zindaba kufanele zithuthukiswe futhi ziphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi. Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthola uxhaso. Izindlela zokuphatha lezi zindaba kufanele zithuthukiswe futhi ziphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi. Imigomo ephethe lezi zindaba iyashintsha njalo. Lokhu okufundwayo kufanele kufakwe emsebenzini. Ukuba nomhlaba kuphela akusizi ekugcineni. Kukhona nezinye izidingo ezifana nezilwane, imishini, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ekuqaleni. Abakhiqizi banomfutho omkhulu wokuthola izimali futhi bayakhohlwa ukuthi abanamandla noma izinsiza zokulwa nezindleko zemalimboleko nezindleko zokuqala zokulima. I-Land Bank kufanele ihlinzeke abakhiqizi ngokuqonda ukuze bakwazi ukuvusa izindleko eziphezulu zemali. Abakhiqizi badinga ukwesekwa nokuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane mayelana nokumaketha ukudla kwabo okuyisisekelo. Abakhiqizi badinga imiyalezo eqondile mayelana nemakethe yokudla okuyisisekelo. Izinhlangano ezithole uxhaso oluvela kwi-Land Bank ne-IDC azitholi inzuzo ezingeni eliphansi. Kufanele kube nokwaziswa okungcono mayelana nezintela. Imalimboleko ivame ukuvunywa sekwedlule. Imalimboleko kufanele ivunywe ngokushesha ukuze abakhiqizi bakwazi ukuhlela ukufaka izitshalo ngonyaka ozayo. Izaphulelo ngenani lemali ekhokhwa yizinkampani ezinikeza izinsiza zokuqala zokulima azinikezwa kubalimi. Abalimi abasha badinga ukuwina kulezi zaphulelo zezimali. Uhulumeni kufanele enze ini? I-tariff yokungenisa ukudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe kufanele ivikele abakhiqizi bendawo. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko ezingu-35% ze-inshurensi yokuqala yokulima esingakavikelwanga. Kufanele kube nesisekelo kuhulumeni sokuguqula amapulazi ahluphekayo abe yizinkomo. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko zokuthuthukisa i-pH yomhlabathi ngokufaka i-lime lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko zokuthuthukisa amazinga e-phosphate lapho ehla kakhulu emhlabathini. Izinhlelo ezivela emaphandleni ahlukene asekelayo abakhiqizi kufanele zihlanganiswe. Izikhungo ezabelana ngemininingwane kufanele ziye ezinhlakeni ezinikeza izinsiza zokuthuthukisa lokhu kuhanjiswa. Kufanele kube nokugxila ekuthengeni kabusha kwezinto ezomnotho nokuvuselela imishini ekulimeni. Izigaba ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezokulima ophatha umhlaba nokulondolozwa komhlabathi kufanele ziqinisiwe ngababonisi bokwazi.
Umhlaba unamanzi athile, futhi la manzi ahamba - akhuphuka abuyele phansi. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi umjikelezo wamanzi (umjikelezo wezamanzi). Ukuhlangana kwenzeka lapho ilanga likhanyisa amanzi emifuleni nasezikhukhuleni, futhi amanzi aguquka abe yivapour noma ugesi. La manzi manje akhuphukela emifuleni nasezikhukhuleni emoyeni. Lokhu kuyimsebenzi wezitshalo ezikhulula amanzi ngamaqabunga azo. I-vapour nokuhlangana yizinqubo ezivumela amanzi ukuthi abuyele emoyeni. Lapha, i-vapour (ubushushu) emoyeni ibanda futhi iguquke ibe yiziphu, yakha amafu. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho amanzi amaningi emoyeni eqoqana futhi engasakwazi ukuhlala emoyeni. Bese amafu eqala ukuba nzima, futhi amanzi aqala ukuwa phansi - imvula, ukungena, umoya. Lapho amanzi ewa phansi ngoba aphelele, ahamba aye olwandle, emifuleni, ezikhukhuleni, noma emhlabathini. Lapho amanzi ehlangana nomhlabathi, ayawathola futhi sithi kuyamanzi aphansi azosetshenziswa izitshalo, izilwane, nabantu. Okusele kuzohamba emifuleni, ezikhukhuleni, nolwandle - bese umjikelezo uqala futhi. Kungani izitshalo zidinga amanzi? Amanzi asekelwa kahle isakhiwo sezitshalo. Amangqamuzana ezitshalo aqukethe ama-90% amanzi. Lezi zicubu ezineamanzi zisekela isitshalo. Lapho amangqamuzana ezitshalo ehluleka amanzi, isitshalo siyawubamba futhi sishaywa. Uma amanzi aphelelwa ngokuphelele, sonke sizofa. Amanzi asiza isitshalo ukuba baphole uma kushisa (ukuhlangana). Amanzi asiza futhi ekwakheni isitshalo, ehambisana ne-carbon dioxide ukuze akhe ama-carbohydrates. Amanzi ayahlula imithombo futhi athutha le mfoodi ukusuka emhlabathini aye ezimpandeni bese efika esitshalo.
Izimo zezulu zango-2007/2008 - yini abakuhlanganyelayo? Inani lemvula elirekhodiwe ngonyaka odlule, ikakhulukazi phakathi nesikhathi esibalulekile sikaJanuwari 2007 kuya kuMashi 2007, belingaphansi kwezinga elibi lika-1992. Kwakunezindawo ezifana neGauteng nezingxenye zeMpumalanga esentshonalanga ezathola umswakama ofana nowango-1912. NgokukaMnu. Johan van den Berg ovela ku-ARS, kukhona izimpawu ezikhombisa umphumela onamandla weLa Nina. Kungenzeka ukuthi lo mphumela weLa Nina uzoqhubeka kuze kube kwentwasahlobo ka-2008. Umphumela walokhu ungaba ukuwa kwemvula okukhulu okuvela ngoDisemba 2007 kuya kuMashi 2008. Izibalo 1 - 3 zikhombisa amathuba okuthola izinga lemvula elijwayelekile. Izindawo eziphuma phambili zikhombisa izinga lemvula elijwayelekile, izindawo eziluhlaza zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphakeme kunjengokujwayelekile, kanti izindawo ezinsundu zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphansi kunjengokujwayelekile. Ukuhlela kukhombisa inani elijwayelekile (okuphuzi) eliphakeme kunjengokujwayelekile (okuluhlaza) ezinyangeni ezizayo. Amathuba okuthola imvula enkulu alungile kakhulu ngoDisemba 2007 noJanuwari 2008. Izibalo 1 - 3: Amathuba okuthola izinga elijwayelekile (%). Ezibalo 4 - 7, amathuba okuthola ngaphansi kuka-20 mm yemvula ezinsukwini ezithile akhombiswa. Izilinganiso zesikhathi eside zikhombiswa ngombala obomvu, kanti amathuba akhona (2007/2008) akhombiswa ngombala oluhlaza. Umbala oluhlaza ukhombisa izikhathi ezinomsebenzi omuhle wokuthola imvula ephakeme kunjengokujwayelekile. Ngokubheka ukuqhubeka kweLa Nina, imvula enhle ilindeleke ngoDisemba, ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari, nasekuqaleni kukaFebruwari 2008 naseMashi 2008. Ulwazi oluningi luqoqwe nguMnu. Johan van den Berg ovela ku-ARS. Ulwazi olungeziwe lungatholakala ku-website yeGrain SA (www.graansa.co.za).
Ngemuva kokutshala kusukela ngo-Okthoba kuya kuDisemba 2010, izindawo eziningi lapho kukhuliswe khona ufulawa zathola imvula enkulu. Ezindaweni eziningi zokulima, lokhu kube nomthelela ekutheni abalimi bangakwazi ukulawula izihlahla eziphilayo phakathi kwemigqa ye-maize. Abalimi abangakaze basebenzise amakhemikhali ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele ukuze bafeze izihlahla eziphilayo, nabangakaze baphonse amakhambi ngemuva kokuthi izitshalo zivele bazobhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu ngonyaka ozayo nezihlahla eziphilayo. Izitshalo eziphilayo ezisunguliwe ezivele zikhulule izithelo zizokhuphuka lezi zithelo emapulazini ngesikhathi esizayo. Abakhiqizi abangasebenzisi imishini kakhulu ngesikhathi sokutshala (ukunciphisa ukulima) nabo babhekane nezinselelo eziningi emapulazini lapho imishini ingasebenzi khona ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokutshala. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola ngokucophelela amapulazi lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukutshala ukuze kutholakale ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla eziphilayo ezizokhula ezindaweni ezithile. Amakhemikhali afanele nezibulala-zinambuzane angathengwa - xhumana nomphathi walezi zimpahla ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ezindaweni eziningi, imvula yafika nango-Agasti, okuzophinde kube nomthelela ekutheni abalimi bangakwazi ukulawula izihlahla eziphilayo ngemishini emapulazini noma basebenzise amakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, uma ubungasebenzisa imishini kuphela ukuze ube neziqholo (ukulima) izihlahla eziphilayo, kungcono ukucabanga ngokuthenga imishini yokuphonsa (spray rig). Imishini ehlukene ingatholakala emakethe - kunezimoto ezixhunywe kulawa ma-hitch amathathu anama-tank aphakathi kuka-600 liters kuya ku-1,000 liters anama-booms (izandla) aphakathi kuka-12 m kuya ku-16 m. Imishini enama-tank angabamba u-1,000 liters kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela kumatraktha angakwazi ukuthwala u-1.5 tons noma ngaphezulu. Imishini eyakhiwe lapha ezweni lethu ayibizi kakhulu, futhi izingxenye ezithuthukile zitholakala kalula ngesikhathi sokutshala. Uma uthenga imishini ngaphandle, qiniseka ukuthi umthengisi angakuqinisekisa ukuthi uzokwazi ukuthola amapompo amasha, amafremu, nezibulala-zinambuzane noma nini lapho udinga khona. Indlela eyodwa yokuphonsa amakhemikhali idinga izibulala-zinambuzane ezifanele le ndlela - umkhuba wokuphonsa kanye nokuvula kwezibulala-zinambuzane. Ukulungiswa kwengcindezi kwelinye ibhande kubalulekile ngoba kufanele kukhiqize i-cone ethile ehambelana nohlobo lwezihlahla eziphilayo kanye nohlobo lwamakhemikhali.
