Uma ungathenga imishini ethwalayo, izokunikeza izinzuzo ezihlukene uma uziqhathanisa nemishini exhunywe kumahitch amathathu. Amatraktha anedrayivu ye-hydraulic yehlile en price, futhi amatraktha asebenza kangcono ngoba awanalo umthwalo ophoqayo umhlabathi. Izibulala-zinambuzane ezikwazi ukuthatha u-2,000 liters zikuvumela ukuthi uphonse indawo enkulu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise nokuhlanganisa amakhemikhali. Khumbula ukulungisa ububanzi bezinhlamvu zemishini ukuze kuhambisane nokuhlukaniswa kwemigqa yokutshala ukuze wena, ophatha, ukwazi ukulungisa indlela imishini esebenza ngayo. Ngokuvamile, ithangi elinokwakhiwa okungama-200 liters lisetshenziswa ukuphonsa i-hectare eyodwa. Ngokufanayo, ithangi le-hitch elinokwakhiwa okungama-600 liters lizophonsa ama-hectare amathathu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise futhi uqhubeke nokuphonsa. Lapho ucabanga ukuphonsa i-herbicide, kufanele ucabangele okulandelayo: ukuthi mangaki amapulazi adingeka ukuphonswa, ukuthi ungasithola isikhathi esingakanani sokuphonsa, ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele ukuze uhlanganise amakhemikhali, amandla omatraktha nemishini - kanye ne-trailer enethangi elingabamba u-5,000 liters. Kuzosiza futhi ukufaka ipompo kulolo thangi ukuze ugcwalise ngokushesha amanye amathangi. Kufanele ulungiselele kahle ngaphambi kwesikhathi futhi uphathe kahle yonke imishini yakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga emapulazini ngesikhathi sokutshala. Namuhla, kunzima ukwenza inzuzo ekulimaleni uma ungakaze ube nolwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwezihlahla eziphilayo ngamakhambi, ukuphonsa lelo khemi kahle, nokusebenzisa imishini efanele. Ngaso sonke isikhathi funa usizo kulabo abanamava kanye nochwepheshe ukuze bakusize ngokuqhuba nokuphonsa ama-herbicides. Uma ungenayo imishini enamandla noma ungenayo imali yokuthenga le mishini, cabanga ngokukhokhela umphakeli onemishini yokuphonsa enkulu. Labo bantu bavame ukukhokha phakathi kuka-R65 no-R100 nge-hectare, kanye nezindleko ze-diesel. Amapulazi amakhulu angaphonswa phakathi nosuku nangezikhathi zokulala usebenzisa uhlelo lwe-GPS. Nokho, ngaphambi kokungena esivumelwaneni, qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli angafika ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi uzofika ngesikhathi esifanele uma kudingeka futhi yimaphi imishini ezodingeka ukuthi iphathwe ngumlimi noma umphakeli. Khumbula, abanye abaphakeli abanethangi lamanzi noma amabhasi. Uma ungakwazi ukukala amanzi adingekayo ngamakhambi afanele okufanele aphonswe, uzobhekana nezinkinga nomphakeli, futhi umsebenzi uzoma. Kufanele uhlaziye izindleko zokuthenga imishini yakho, ukuba namandla okuphonsa i-hectare ethile ngesikhathi esifanele, nezindleko zokukhokhela umphakeli ukuze enze lelo thasku lokuphonsa. Okwesibili, okungakusiza ukuthi abaphakeli abaningi banolwazi mayelana nezinhlobo nezifomula zamakhemikhali okwamanje asetshenziswa. Kuzokusiza ukuhlola ukuthi ukuphonsa kwenziwa kanjani ngezikhathi zonke. Kungasiza futhi ukukhuluma nochwepheshe abasebenza kumafemu ahlukene athengisa amakhemikhali, bese uzokwazi ukuhlola izindleko zamakhemikhali nge-hectare kanye nosizo oluvela kulawo mafemu athengisa amakhemikhali. Khumbula ukuthi abahlinzeki bamakhambi bahlala bephithizela ngesikhathi sokutshala futhi bangase bangakwazi ukusiza bonke abalimi ngokuhlanganisa amakhemikhali ethangini. Uma ungakabi nolwazi, ungase uphonse amakhemikhali kancane noma kakhulu.
Isithombe 1: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa engakaze iphuzwe nge-herbicide, ngakho-ke izitshalo eziphukile. Isithombe 2: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa ephuzwe nge-herbicide ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala. Isithombe 3: Zama ukuthola isitshalo se-maize kulesi sithombe! Isithombe 4: I-filter ye-nozzle yokuphuzisa igcwele. Isithombe 5: Izikhala zomshini ophuzisa zivalekile. Isithombe 6: Ukuvaleka kwezi zikhala kungenzeka uma umshini ungcolile futhi ungagcinwanga kahle. Izithombe 1 no-2 zithathwe ensimini efanayo eMpumalanga Kapa - isithombe 1 sikhombisa lapho i-herbicide ingafakwanga - isithombe 2 sikhombisa lapho iphuziswe khona ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala - umehluko ubonakala kahle! Singasho ukuthi zonke izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni lapho zingafuneki khona ziwukuhlanya. Ukuhlanya kuyinkinga uma kukhuliswa izitshalo zokudla ngoba zikh competition nezinye izitshalo zokudla ngamanzi nezakhi, okwenza kube nezinkinga ngesikhathi sokuvuna, z contaminating izitshalo zokudla, imbewu yazo ingafaka ama-toxins ekudleni, futhi zingagcina izilokazane nezifo ezibeka ubungozi. Ukuhlanya kukhula ngokushesha futhi kuqina kalula. Zivame ukuba nezimpande eziqinile futhi zikhula kahle ezimeni zezulu ezahlukene. Kubalulekile ukuzisusa; ziqinile futhi zikh competition ngokuqinile nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi nezakhi. Ukuhlanya kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuphindaphinda, ngakho kufanele siqaphele ngalokhu uma sizama ukuzisusa. Ukuhlanya kungakhiqiza imbewu (ngokuvamile ngokushesha nangokulula), ezinye izinhlobo zine-rhizomes phansi, ezinye zine-stolons phezulu, ezinye zine-tubers, kanti ezinye zineziphuzo ezinkulu. Omunye umhlobo, njenge "nut grass," unazo zonke lezi - ukhiqiza imbewu, unama-tubers, futhi unama-rhizomes phansi - lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuzisusa. Imbewu yokuhlanya ivame ukuhlala iphila futhi ingaphila emhlabathini isikhathi eside kuze kube izimo zifanele ukuvuthwa. Imbewu yokuhlanya nayo ayivuthi ngasikhathi sinye - ezinye zizovutha ngokushesha, kanti ezinye zizolinda. Ngokuvamile, ziqala ukuvutha uma umhlabathi uphazamisekile. Izimpande zokuhlanya zivame ukungena phansi emhlabathini, zidlula izimpande zezithako zokudla, zivumela ukuhlanya ukuba kukhule ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ukuhlanya okukhula unyaka nonyaka kugcina izakhi ezimpandeni zazo ngaphansi komhlabathi - ngesikhathi sokukhula okunzima, zingaphumelela. Ukuhlanya kungaba yonyaka (kukhiqiza unyaka owodwa), ezinye izinhlobo ziyi-biennial (kukhiqiza iminyaka emibili), kanti ezinye ziyi-perennial (kukhiqiza iminyaka eminingi). Kungani kubalulekile ukulawula ukuhlanya ezitshalo zokudla? Ukuhlanya kukh competition nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi emhlabathini, ngezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini, nendawo yokukhula, nangokukhanya (ilanga). Le competition ibangela ukuthi izitshalo zingakhuli kahle, futhi umkhiqizo wehla. Kungase futhi ku contaminating imbewu futhi kwehlise izinga lezi zimbewu. Le competition iyahluka - ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlanya azibeki ubungozi obukhulu kwezinye izitshalo - ubungozi bungaba buphansi, njenge 10%, kodwa bungakhuphuka bube ngu 98%. Ukuhlanya kuqala ukukh competition nezinye izitshalo uma seziqinisekisile izimpande eziqinile - ngemva kokuvuthwa. Ukulawula ukuhlanya kusho ukuvimbela le competition, nokuvimbela ukuhlanya ekukhiqizeni imbewu ezovutha futhi zikh competition nezitshalo ezizotshalwa ngonyaka ozayo. Bonke abalimi abafuna ukuphumelela ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zokudla kumele balwe nezinye izitshalo ngaso sonke isikhathi - ukuhlanya kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlanya kulawulwa kusetshenziswa imishini ngokuhlanza noma ngamakhemikhali - kuvame ukuthi zombili lezi zindlela zisetshenziswe. Uma umalimi elawula kahle ukuhlanya, insimu izoveza kuphela izitshalo ezitshalwe - akukho ukuhlanya! Kodwa kuvame ukuthi lokhu kungahambi kalula, futhi ukuhlanya kuqhubeka. Kungani ukuhlanya kungase kulawulwe kahle? Kukhona izinto ezintathu ezingaholela ekulawulweni okungasebenzi kahle - eyokuqala ingaba indlela yokuhlanza kanye nomshini osetshenziswayo, eyesibili ingaba i-herbicide efakwe, futhi yokugcina ingaba izimo zezulu. Izilungiselelo zomshini zingase zingabi seduze, futhi kungase kube nezikhala, okuvumela umhlabathi phakathi kwezithako ukuthi ungahlanzi kahle (uma ziqinile, azizokwazi ukusebenza kahle). Ubude bokuhlanza bungase bungefiki kahle - izimpande zokuhlanya eziphakeme zihlala ziqinile emhlabathini, futhi ukuhlanya kungase kuqale kabusha. Isivinini somshini singase sibe siphansi kakhulu - kufanele run ngokushesha ukuze uphazamise umhlabathi kahle. Umhlabathi ungase ube manzi kakhulu - izitshalo ezihlanziwe zihlala zisebenza nomhlabathi ongenamanzi futhi zingase ziqale kabusha. Ukulungiswa komshini kungase kube okungafanele. Isikhathi sokuphuzisa ukuhlanya singase singabi sesimweni esifanele. I-herbicide esetshenziswayo ingase ingasebenzi kahle ngokumelene nohlobo oluthile lokuhlanya. I-filter ye-nozzle yokuphuzisa igcwele (isithombe 4). Izikhala zomshini ophuzisa zivalekile (isithombe 5). Izinsiza ezingafanele zisetshenziswa (khumbula ukusebenzisa i-nozzle enobumba uma uphuzisa phezu kwezithako, futhi i-nozzle ye-fan elula uma uphuzisa phezu komhlabathi). Umshini ungase ungakahlanzwa kahle ngonyaka odlule - izinto eziningi zingavala, futhi ngeke usebenze kahle uma kukhona okushiywe okungahlanzwanga. Ingxenye yekhemikhali idinga imvula emva kokuphuzisa ukuze isebenze kahle - uma kunganaki, i-herbicide ayikwazi ukuqala ukusebenza. Izimo zezulu ezishisayo kakhulu nezomile zingase futhi zivimbe i-herbicide ekusebenzeni kahle. Imvula eningi ngemva kokuhlanza ingabangela ukuhlanya 'ukuqala kabusha.' Ukuphatha nokulawula ukuhlanya kubaluleke kakhulu - uma singakwenzi kahle, asizukuzuza umkhiqizo omuhle. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokungaphathi ukuhlanya kahle esikhulume ngazo ngenhla - kodwa ekugcineni, kubonakala ukuthi ukuphatha yonke imisebenzi yakho yokulima ngaphambi kokuba kube khona izinkinga kubalulekile. Lo nyaka ububhalwe kakhulu ekulungiseni lezi zinkinga, kodwa lokho esikufundile kungasisiza siqhubeke ngonyaka ozayo. Iziphakamiso ezindala esizenzile esikhathini esedlule kufanele zifundise ukuthi singaziphindi emhlabeni; kungcono ukwenza amaphutha amasha!
Yini uGrain SA ethumele? Umqondisi: Jane McPherson, Umphathi Wohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi beGrain SA. Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi beGrain SA luhloselwe ukuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama ngezakhono zokuba abalimi bezomnotho. Ukukhiqiza ukudla okufana ne-maize, i-soybeans, i-wheat, kanye ne-barley kuhambisana nokukhiqiza okufanele, ukumaketha, ukusebenzisa imishini, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha umhlaba. Izinkinga ezihlobene nomhlaba nokuba nomhlaba. Izihloko esizifakile kulolu hlelo ziyi: "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Maize," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Soybean," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Wheat," "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Barley." Njengomlimi othuthukayo, sikholelwa ukuthi kufanele uqale ngalezi zifundo ezihlobene nezitshalo ezikhuliswa endaweni yakho yokulima. Uma ungakabi nalesi sikhathi, uzobhekana nezinkinga zokufunda izifundo ezinzima futhi uzobe uhamba ngemuva kwabanye abafundi. Ulwazi olukhona mayelana nezindlela zomnotho ngokuvamile lukhathaza, ngakho kube inselele ukukhetha lokho okufanele kufundiswe ngoba kunolwazi oluningi. Nokho, kunezihloko ezibalulekile esifuna ukuzifundisa kulolu hlelo. Ngakho, sikwazile ukufaka zonke izici ezibalulekile kulolu hlelo lokwethulwa oluhlobene nokukhiqiza nokumaketha, bese sihlanganisa no "Isifundo Esiphakeme Sokukhiqiza i-Maize Nokumaketha." Ukuqinisekisa izitshalo nokuphathwa kwezingozi kuyizinkinga ezingaba khona. Isifundo Esiphakeme Sokukhiqiza i-Maize sihamba nezobuchwepheshe ezihlobene nokukhiqiza umhlabathi kanye nokuphakama komhlabathi. Uma ufuna usizo ngalolu hlelo, kufanele uqale uye esifundweni sokwethulwa, futhi kufanele manje ukhiqize ukudla okuthengiswayo. Lolu hlelo lungase lungafaneleki kumlimi ophila phansi. Kukhona iziphathimandla eziningi ezabelana ngolwazi ezisebenza emnyangweni wezolimo ohlukene, futhi kufanele zinikeze ulwazi nosizo kubalimi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, iziphathimandla eziningi azifundisiwe kahle futhi zihluleka ukuba nekhono lokukhiqiza ukudla. Abanye baphendule (banama-certificate) kodwa bangezange basebenze ezindaweni zokulima - okuyinto ebalulekile ekulimaleni. Ngakho, sihlanganisile lolu hlelo: "Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza i-Maize Kubaphathimandla Ababelana Ngolwazi." Sifundise lezi zifundo kaningi eziphathimandla futhi sizame ukubonisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kanjani emasimini - sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kusize emsebenzini wabo. Isici esiyinhloko sokukhiqiza i-maize esizokwenza inzuzo sihamba nezithuthuthu nemishini. Sithole ukuthi isimo semishini kubalimi abathuthukayo sibhujiswa kakhulu - ngakho singenise leli hlelo. Lolu hlelo luyadingeka kubo bonke abafuna ukuba abalimi bezomnotho - kufanele uqonde ukuthi imishini yakhiwe kanjani, bese uzokwazi ukuyiphatha kahle. Ukuphatha kahle imishini kuyisihluthulelo esizovula umnyango wokungena ekulimaleni kwezomnotho. Awukwazi ukuvula lowo mnyango uma ungaphathi kahle izithuthuthu nemishini. Sithole ukuthi kukhona abalimi abaningi abancane, ikakhulukazi eMpumalanga Kapa, abangenamishini nezithuthuthu (Uhlelo Olukhulu Lokudla lweMnyango Wezolimo eMpumalanga Kapa lujwayele ukusebenzisa abakhiqizi kodwa alusebenze kahle). Sibone ukuthi kuzoba usizo kubakhiqizi be-maize ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sifundo esichaza umsebenzi wabakhiqizi, ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe kanjani, nini, njll. Abakhiqizi bavame ukungasebenzi kahle. Nokho, kunezindawo lapho abalimi balima ezindaweni ezincane ukuze bathenge izithuthuthu nemishini, ngakho-ke kudingeka abakhiqizi. Sikholelwa ukuthi lesi sifundo sabakhiqizi sizokhombisa abakhiqizi abasebenza kwezolimo ukuthi kubalulekile ukulima kahle, ngezindlela ezifanele, ngesikhathi esifanele, kanye nemali efanele. Uma umlimi engakwenzi inzuzo, abakhiqizi ngeke babe nomsebenzi esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphambi kuka-1994, abalimi abaningi balima ezindaweni ezibizwa ngokuthi "izindawo zokuhlala." Eminyakeni edlule, abalimi abaningi abazi ukuthi kunezinkinga eziningi ekulimaleni nokuthi izinhlobo zomhlabathi ezahlukene nezimo zezulu azifaneleki ekutshaleni ezinye izitshalo ezizokwenza inzuzo. Isifundo esibizwa ngokuthi: Ukusetshenziswa Kwezimali Nokuhlola Izinsiza sihlanganiswe ukusiza abalimi baqonde ukuthi isimo sezinsiza zabo sikhona kanjani bese bezokwazi ukusisebenzisa ngezindlela ezizobenza benze inzuzo esikhathini esizayo ekulimaleni. Ukusebenza nabalimi abanguye amalungu ezigabeni zokufunda iminyaka kube kukhombisa ukuthi kudingeka esinye isifundo. Siqale uhlelo olusha olubizwa ngokuthi "Uhlelo Lwabalimi Oluphakeme," oluvumele abaholi bezifunda ukuba basondeze kulabo abalimi abazama ukuthuthuka. Sikhongele futhi ukuthi abalimi abaningi abawasebenzisi kahle kahle izinsiza ezikhona; badinga usizo lokubheka izici ezibalulekile ukuze baphumelele ekulimaleni. Izindawo nezinto ezibalulekile ukuze kuqhubeke nomsebenzi. Imnyango Yezolimo yezifunda ineziphathimandla eziningi ezabelana ngolwazi ezifundile kodwa azinakho amandla okwenza umsebenzi emasimini. Ngokuqhubeka komsebenzi wethu woktraining nabalimi, sisebenze eduze kakhulu neMnyango Wezolimo futhi sifundise izifundo eziningi. Sikholelwa ukuthi uma singahlinzeka iziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi ngezifundo ezizobasiza bathole amandla okwenza umsebenzi, bazokwazi ukusiza abalimi abaningi bakhule ngokwezomnotho. Asihlanganisi abalimi neziphathimandla esifundweni esisodwa ngoba iziphathimandla zikhathazekile ukubuza imibuzo phambi kwabafundi - azifuni ukuhleka. Izifundo zethu zifaka abafundi nemishini, kodwa sithole ukuthi ngokuvamile bahluleka ukukala imishini ngokwabo. Ukukala nokuphatha umshini wokuphonsa. Abalimi abaningi abahambile esifundweni sokuphatha imishini nezithuthuthu bacela esinye isifundo esizobafundisa ukuthi injini isebenza kanjani nokuthi kufanele bayilungise kanjani. Abalimi abaningi banokukhathazeka ngoba bangenalo ulwazi lokulungisa injini. Sifuna ukukhombisa lapha ukuthi lesi sifundo asihlosile ukufundisa (ukufundisa) abahloli. Lesi sifundo sihlose ukufundisa umlimi izingxenye zenjini nokuthi kufanele ziqhathaniswe kanjani. Ukulungisa injini yinto okufanele yenziwe ochwepheshe. Ukulungisa injini noma ibhande lenjini kubiza kakhulu - uma ungenalo ulwazi, uzobe uphonsa imali uzama ukulungisa lezo zinto. Lapho abantu behambela lezi zifundo, babona ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kanjani, kodwa bese beqonda ukuthi kunezinye izidingo. Kukho abakhiqizi ezindaweni ezifana neTaung/Hartswater abangakwazi ukungena, nakwezinye izindawo eNyakatho NgesiNdebele naseFree State. Nokho, izindlela zokutshalwa kwe-maize ziyafana, kunezinye izinto okufanele zicatshangelwe uma kukhuluma ngokuqhuba. Ngakho-ke, sihlanganisile izifundo ezimbili: "Ukukhiqiza i-Maize Ngokuhlinzwa," "Ukukhiqiza i-Wheat Ngokuhlinzwa." Ukukhiqiza i-maize/i-wheat ehlinziwe. Njengomlimi eqhubeka nokuthuthuka ngokwezimali, ukubal
Ulwazi lokusebenzisa amathayi akho efemini ngendlela efanele luzokusiza ukuthi usebenze ngokuphepha futhi unciphise izindleko kanye nok damage kumasimu nasemhlabathini. Ukushayela efemini kusho ukusebenza ezindaweni eziningi ezahlukene - ukulima emasimini nokuhambisa ithreyi emgwaqweni ophukile. Lokhu kuyahluka, kodwa kukhona umlayezo obalulekile okufanele ulandelwe njalo. Lapho sikhuluma ngamatayi, kunezinto ezibalulekile: hlanganisa uhlobo lwamathayi nohlobo lomsebenzi (ukusebenza emanzini, isihlabathi esithambile, njll.), landela imihlahlandlela yomkhiqizi mayelana nosayizi nolwazi lwamathayi, ikakhulukazi hlanganisa ingcindezi yomoya nesisindo somthwalo nendawo lapho kusetshenziswa khona. Umoya kuphela ngaphakathi kwethayi ophatha umthwalo othile, futhi abakhiqizi bamathayi abafana neGoodyear bakhombisa umthwalo wethayi ethile, ingcindezi, kanye nezinga lesivinini. Uma uthwala okuthile okukhulu kakhulu kodwa ungakhuphuli ingcindezi yomoya, kuzokwenza amathayi aguge futhi aphume ngokushesha, okuzokwenza imishini ingasebenzi kahle futhi amathayi azoguga ngokushesha. Uma umthwalo unheavy futhi amathayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele, ithayi izophenduka ohlangothini futhi imiphetho yethayi ingaguga futhi ithayi izophuka njengoba ihamba. Amathayi e-bias noma e-crossply ajwayele ukuphenduka ohlangothini uma umthwalo unheavy kakhulu futhi ingcindezi iphansi uma amavhili edonswa kanzima, umzimba wonke wethayi uzonakaliswa. Ithayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele ingaphuma emgqonyeni futhi i-bead ingaphuka, futhi lapho ithayi ibamba khona emgqonyeni kuzonakaliswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi: uma ithayi inengcindezi eningi kakhulu, iba qinile kakhulu, okwenza ithayi lithinte kuphela umgwaqo ngaphakathi futhi liguge lapho. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi ithayi lonke alithinti umhlaba, futhi alikwazi ukubamba kahle, lizophuma futhi lihlasele umhlabathi. Uma kudingeka ukusebenza ngamathayi ezimo lapho kudingeka khona, amathayi azohamba kalula. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukulungisa ingcindezi ngokuya ngezimo zokusebenza, njengokuhambisa ithreyi noma emshinini, noma ukushayela emgwaqweni ophukile. Inani lengcindezi yamathayi libalulekile, kodwa ukusebenzisa ithayi enengcindezi ehlukile kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubambeni kwamavhili nasecingweni sayo emhlabeni. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona izitshalo nezimpande ngaphansi komhlaba, kungaba kuhle ukusebenza ngethayi elibanzi elinengcindezi ephezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzovumela imishini ukuthi ithwale umthwalo ofanayo njengethayi elincane ngobubanzi kodwa eliqinile emoyeni - leli thayi lizojwayela ukunyakaza kalula emhlabeni futhi liqinise umhlabathi. Ngokufanayo, esihlabathini, ithayi elibanzi elingaqinile kakhulu lizobamba kangcono ngoba linendawo enkulu yokubamba - lihamba phezu kwesihlabathi, lingadli. Kungcono ukusebenzisa ukudlula kwemoto ezimeni lapho umhlaba ungaphatheki kahle, kodwa ungasebenzisa lokhu emgwaqweni ophukile noma emgwaqweni eqinile ngoba kudala ukuguga okungalingani kumathayi aphambili, okwenza ukushayela kube nzima nokusebenzisa ezinye izingxenye ngendlela elahlekile amandla.
Amathayi asetshenziswa ezindaweni zokulima abiza kakhulu, kodwa kukhona imiyalezo ebalulekile ezokusiza ukuthi ulondoloze le mali oyichithile futhi uqinisekise ukuthi amathayi ahlala isikhathi eside. Uma ushintsha amathayi aphakanyisiwe kakhulu noma aphansi, awagcini isikhathi eside, umzimba wethayi uyacindezelwa kakhulu futhi uzogcina ushonile - okuthinta kakhulu imali! Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlela ingcindezi yamathayi ngokwezinto ezenziwayo, futhi uhlole ingcindezi njalo. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kanye noma kabili ngesonto, futhi khumbula ukushintsha ingcindezi yamathayi uma udonsa umthwalo onzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, hlola nesimo samathayi nokuthi kuphi okukhathazayo. Uma kubonakala inkinga, kungase kube uphawu lokuthi ithayi likhukhulile, noma ingcindezi ayifanele, noma izingxenye zokuhamba azihambelani kahle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isondo lisebenza ngengcindezi efanele kuzokusiza ukuthi ithayi libambe kahle emhlabathini, lizohlala isikhathi eside, futhi awuzokwenza umoya omningi, okwenza kube lula ukubona ukuthi kuphi okungase kube yingozi noma okukhukhulayo. Khumbula ukuhlola ingcindezi uma ithayi lipholile, ngaphambi kokuthi liqhutshwe ngoba uma liqhutshelwa, liyashisa futhi ingcindezi iyanda. Ukulungisa amathayi - hamba kumuntu onolwazi! Umyalezo weGoodyear uthi amathayi kufanele afakwe noma alungiswe ngabantu abanolwazi ngoba lo msebenzi ungaba yingozi. Isibonelo: uma ithayi lingafakwa kahle esondweni, uma liphakanyisiwe kakhulu lingaphuka ngamandla amakhulu. Futhi ithayi lingase lishayeke esondweni uma lidonswa kanzima, kudala ingozi kumathayi, emhlabathini, nasemshinini. Ithayi nesondo kufanele kubekwe endaweni ephephile uma liphakanyiswa. Uma ulungisa i-valve stem, khumbula ukuthi ingase ikhukhule futhi kule ndawo. Uma ithayi liqhutshelwa ngaphandle komoya noma ngengcindezi ephansi, ungayiphakanyisa ngaphandle kokuyikhipha esondweni ukuze uhlole ukuthi ayilimazekile - kungcono ukuyihlola umuntu onolwazi. Okwesibili okufanele ukhumbule: njalo sebenzisa ikhava ye-valve; ungashayi isondo noma ithayi ngensimbi uma liphakanyisiwe ngokuphelele; ungafaki i-valve stem engalingani; ungafaki i-valve stem eguqukile noma elimele; landela imiyalelo yomkhiqizi futhi ungafaki ithayi elikhulu kakhulu noma elincane kakhulu; ngempela ungazami ukulungisa isondo elimele ngokuwelding noma ngenye indlela. Nokho, abantu beGoodyear bazama ukusebenzisa izinto ezizovimbela ukugqoka kwamathayi, kufanele siqaphele ukuthi irabha ithanda ukuabsorba uwoyela, i-grease, i-diesel, nezinye amakhemikhali, futhi ingalimala ukushisa nasezithunzini. Ngakho-ke, amathayi afanele kufanele agcinwe endaweni epholile, emnyama, hhayi eduze kwemishini yokuwelding, ama-generator, noma enye imishini ngoba lokhu kungadala ukulimala kwamathayi futhi azophuka uma esetshenziswa futhi. Ngokufanayo, geza zonke izinkinga kumathayi ngemuva kokuwaphonsa ngokuqhubekayo. Uma ubeka amathayi ezindaweni, yehlisa ingcindezi ibe ngu-10 psi bese uwabeka phezulu. Amathayi akhishwe ezindaweni angabekwa phansi noma abekwe phezulu kodwa hhayi amaningi kakhulu ngoba uma engcindezelwe azocindezelwa. Umshini onezindandatho kufanele uphakamiswe ukuze izindandatho zingathintani nomhlabathi. Uma umshini ubunzima kakhulu, khulisa ingcindezi yamathayi ngo-25% futhi uhambise umshini kancane kancane ukuze amathayi angathintani nomhlabathi endaweni eyodwa ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Ngokuvamile nangokwemvelo, intengo yezwe ihambisana namandla ale ndawo okukhulisa ukudla kwezolimo. Ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, abalimi basalandela umqondo wokuthi uma umhlabathi unomkhiqizo futhi ukh produce ukudla okuningi, sizokhokha intengo ethile. Ukukhuphuka nokwehla kwezinga lenzalo nakho kuneqhaza ngoba abalimi abaningi balima ngemali ebolekiwe. Ukungena kwemali yokwakha izindlu nezinye izinto epulazini nakho kubangela intengo yamapulazi ukuthi ishintshe. Ungangena ezivumelwaneni nabanye abalimi ukuze wabelane ngempahla. Inzuzo izotholakala ngemva kwesikhathi eside ngoba ihambisana nokukhuphuka kwentengo yezwe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Inzuzo ezotholakala ngemva kwesikhathi eside ixhumene nenani lemikhiqizo engatholwa epulazini ethile, kodwa lokhu nakho kube nokuguquguquka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngokuvamile, intengo yamapulazi ikhuphukile ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, futhi manje sekucacile ukuthi umhlaba onomkhiqizo ophumelelayo usezandleni zabantu abambalwa. Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubalimi abasha abafuna ukungena kwezolimo ukuthola umhlaba wokulima masinyane futhi bakhokhe ngenzuzo engatholwa. Nokho, lokhu kuyahluka uma umhlaba ungatholwa ngephakheji (LRAD), noma uwedwa, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngenzalo ephansi (njengoba kwenzeka njengamanje ngohlelo olusha olwethulwe yiMnyango Wezokuphathwa Komhlaba olubizwa ngokuthi iProactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS)). Ukuqashwa komhlaba sekushintshile; kwakuwumkhuba wabalimi abasafufusa ukungena kwezolimo, kodwa manje sekuwumkhuba wabalimi bezomnotho ukuthola umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze bathuthukise ukulima kwabo. Sidinga ukucabanga kahle ngalokhu ngoba kukhona umhlaba omningi ezandleni zomphakathi wonke ongasebenzisa, futhi kukhona abalimi abanekhono abadinga umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze balime ngendlela ezokhipha inzuzo. Ukuqashwa kunika abalimi ithuba lokwandisa umsebenzi wabo kodwa akudingi imali eningi ehambisana nokuthenga nokuba nomhlaba. Khumbula: Kukhona izindlela zokungena kwezolimo ngaphandle kokuba umnikazi womhlaba; ungakwazi ukuqasha ipulazi, usebenzise umhlaba womphakathi, noma wabelane ngalowo mhlaba nabanye abalimi.
I-VAT, eyaziwa nangokuthi i-Value Added Tax - kufanele ubhalise? Eminyakeni emine edlule, sibhale kaningi ngalesi sihloko se-VAT. Kodwa manje sibona ukuthi akukhona kakhulu abalimi ababhaliwe. Kuzosiza kanjani uma ngibhalisa? Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphakathi, ngakho abalimi kufanele bazame zonke izindlela zokunciphisa lezo zindleko. Ukubhalisela i-VAT kuyindlela eyodwa yokunciphisa izindleko. I-VAT isetshenziswa kuyo yonke imikhiqizo edingekayo yokulima - imbewu, amafutha, amakhemikhali, ukulungiswa kwemishini, nokugcinwa, njll. Lokhu kufaka u-14% wezindleko. Uma ukhokha u-R4,000 ngehektare olima, kusho ukuthi ukhokha u-R560 nge-VAT. Uma ubhalisiwe, uzokwazi ukufaka le mali emuva kwi-SARS. Okwamanje, le mali ingaphezu kwenzuzo abalimi abayithola ngehektare. Uma ungabhaliswanga, ngeke ukwazi ukufaka le nzuzo yokulima. Kungani abalimi bengafuni ukubhalisa? Isidingo sokuphatha amarekhodi wemali engenayo nezindleko siyingxenye yezizathu abalimi abangabhalisi ngoba besaba ukuthi i-SARS izokwazi ukuthi bangakanani abathola futhi izokwazi ukuhlola amarekhodi abo. Uma uqotho ngokuqhubeka njengomlimi wezomnotho, kubalulekile ukugcina amarekhodi amahle. Kufanele wazi ukuthi izindleko zakho ziyi-ziphi, ukuthi inzuzo yakho ingakanani, nokuthi le mali iya kuphi. Ngokuvamile, abalimi bayakugwema ukukhokha intela, bephikisa ukuthi abatholi kakhulu. Basebenza ngemali futhi akukho bufakazi obubhaliwe. Lokhu akuyona indlela efanele yokusebenza. Kukhona izizathu ezimbili. Okokuqala, akuvumelekile ngokomthetho ukungahlinzeki i-SARS ngemininingwane yakho yezezimali. Okwesibili, ngeke ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele mayelana nebhizinisi lakho lokulima uma ungenayo amarekhodi akhombisa imininingwane yakho yezezimali. Khumbula ukuthi sihlala sisebenzisa izinsiza ezihlinzekwa uhulumeni, ngakho-ke kuyisibopho sethu ukuhlinzeka ngezimali ezidingekayo. Asikwazi ukugwema le ntela kodwa siphinde sithole inzuzo kuyo. Khumbula ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisa le ntela ukukhokhela ukwakha imigwaqo, izikole, izibhedlela, amaphoyisa, njll. Uma uqotho ngokuqhubeka njengomlimi wezomnotho, bhalisela i-VAT ne-Intela Yengeniso.
I-Folio strap: Uhlelo lokuthuthukisa abalimi. Ngesikhathi se-NAMPO 2009, ingxenye yamalungu e-250 Ton Club nabanye abalimi abasha bamenywa emhlanganweni. Sikholelwa ukuthi isikhathi sesifikile sokuthi abakhiqizi abamnyama abasha bavumelele izwi labo futhi baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile kubo. Ukuqinisekisa kokuqala kukhulu kakhulu. Kukho umbuzo obalulekile okumele siwubuze lapha eNingizimu Afrika - ingabe sifuna ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele lapha, noma sifuna ukubhekana nengcuphe yokuthola ukudla ngaphandle? Ukwenza inzuzo ekulimeni ukudla okuyisisekelo kubangelwa ingcindezi enkulu kangangokuthi abalimi abaningi abakwazi ukuphumelela manje nakusasa? Abakhiqizi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bavame ukulima ezindaweni ezomile, futhi manje baphikisana nokudla okuyisisekelo okuvela phesheya. Njalo lokhu kudla kukhula ezindaweni ezinomoya omuhle, futhi abanye abalimi bathola ukwesekwa kuhulumeni wabo. INingizimu Afrika akufanele ivumele ukudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe athuthukile "ukuphonswa" lapha. Ukuthutha emgwaqweni kubi kakhulu futhi uhlelo lokuthutha ngezimoto alusebenza kahle. Uhlelo lokuthutha ngezimoto ludinga ukuvuselelwa. Azikho izintela zokudla okuvela phesheya ezivikelayo abalimi bendawo. Izintela zokudla okuvela phesheya kufanele zethulwe ukuze zivikela abalimi bethu. Eminyakeni emihle sithola imbewu enkulu ye-maize, manje akukho ezinye izitshalo ezingatshalwa ezizoletha inzuzo kubalimi - ama-grains, ama-beans, nama-soybeans nawo akhiqizwa ngamanani amakhulu, intengo yemakethe iphansi kakhulu, abalimi abakwazi ukutshala izitshalo uma amapulazi ebhekene kuphela nezimvula. Uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi "ukuguqulwa komhlaba" kufanele lunikezwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ezindaweni ezilimalayo, ukudla akufanele kutshalwe, utshani kufanele lutshalwe ukuze kukhiqizwe inyama. Imakethe yokudla okuyisisekelo kufanele ikhuliswe. Izindlela ezintsha zokulima nobuchwepheshe kuholele ekwandeni kokukhiqizwa kokudla, manje sekukhona ukudla okuningi. Abalimi kufanele basebenzise izindlela zokunciphisa izindleko ezifana nokulima "okungatshalwanga". Kukho umehluko omkhulu phakathi kwentengo yemakethe ethola umalimi nentengo ekhokhwa umthengi esitolo - uma othile phakathi ethatha imali encane kokubili, bobabili umalimi nomthengi bazothola inzuzo. Ulwazi ngalokhu kufanele lutholakale kalula ukuze bonke ababambiqhaza enqubweni yokukhiqiza nokuthenga ukudla bazi. Izindleko zokuqala zokulima ziphakeme. Lapho kunesivumelwano sokwakha izinto ezimbi mayelana nemakethe, kufanele kuhlolwe kahle. Izindleko eziphezulu zokubolekwa kwemali. IBhange Lezindawo kufanele linikeze imali ebolekiwe ngentengo yokwazisa ephansi. Imakethe yokudla ingaba phansi kakhulu. Ibhonasi ingakhokhwa ngokusekelwe embewu yabalimi abasha. Lokhu kungasiza labo abasebenza ngokuzikhandla. Izindawo eziningi ezibekwe zilahlekile, zingakhiqizi lutho - imizamo eminingi iphelelwe yisikhathi. Izindlela zokukhetha kufanele zifake ukuqeqeshwa kokulima komlimi othile nolwazi lwabo. Ubufakazi obudingekayo obukhombisa ulwazi lwabo abafuna ukuwina. Khuthaza (tshela) indlela yezinhlangano ezithenga futhi zithengise izinto lapho kukhethwa abatholi kanye nokwesekwa abakhiqizi. Sekela labo abanikwe amathuba. Abasebenzi boMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba abazi lutho ngezindaba zokulima. Abaphathi bezombusazwe abaqondi kahle ukuthi kwenzekani ekulimeni. Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela - izivumelwano eziningi zilahlekile. Izindlela zokuphatha lezi zindaba kufanele zithuthukiswe futhi ziphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi. Kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthola uxhaso. Izindlela zokuphatha lezi zindaba kufanele zithuthukiswe futhi ziphathwe ngabantu abanolwazi. Imigomo ephethe lezi zindaba iyashintsha njalo. Lokhu okufundwayo kufanele kufakwe ekusebenzeni. Ukuba nomhlaba kuphela akusizi ekugcineni. Kukho ezinye izidingo ezifana nezilwane, imishini, kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ekuqaleni. Abakhiqizi bayafisa ukuthola imali ebolekiwe futhi bayakhohlwa ukuthi abanamandla noma izinsiza zokulwa nezindleko zokubolekwa kwemali nezindleko zokuqala zokulima. IBhange Lezindawo kufanele linikeze abakhiqizi ukuqonda ukuze bakwazi ukuphikisa izindleko eziphezulu zemali. Abakhiqizi badinga ukwesekwa nokuhlinzekwa ngolwazi mayelana nokumaketha ukudla kwabo okuyisisekelo. Abakhiqizi badinga imiyalezo eqondile mayelana nemakethe yokudla okuyisisekelo. Izinhlangano ezithole uxhaso kuBhange Lezindawo ne-IDC azitholi inzuzo ezingeni eliphansi. Kufanele kube nokucaca okungcono mayelana nezinga lokwazisa. Imali ebolekiwe ivame ukuvunywa sekwedlule. Imali ebolekiwe kufanele ivunywe ngokushesha ukuze abakhiqizi bakwazi ukuzilungiselela ukutshala ngonyaka ozayo. Izaphulelo kumali ekhokhwa yizinkampani ezinikeza izinsiza zokuqala zokulima azinikezwa kubalimi. Abalimi abasha badinga ukuwina kulezi zaphulelo zentengo. Yini okufanele uhulumeni ayenze? Intela yokungenisa ukudla okuvela phesheya kufanele ivikele abakhiqizi bendawo. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko ezingu-35% ze-inshurensi yokuqala yokulima engakavikelwa. Kufanele kube nesisekelo kuhulumeni sokuguqula amapulazi alimalayo abe yizinkomo. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko zokuthuthukisa i-pH yomhlabathi ngokufaka i-lime lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni kufanele akhokhe izindleko zokuthuthukisa amazinga e-phosphate lapho ehla kakhulu emhlabathini. Izinhlelo ezivela emaphandleni ahlukene asekelayo abakhiqizi kufanele zihlanganiswe. Izikhulu ezabelana ngolwazi kufanele ziye ezinhlakeni ezinikeza izinsiza zokuthuthukisa le miphumela. Kufanele kube nokugxila ekubuyiseni "izinto zokufaka ezomnotho nokuvuselela" imishini ekulimeni. Izigaba ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezolimo ophatha umhlaba nokuvikelwa komhlabathi kufanele ziqiniswe ngabantu abanolwazi.
Umhlaba unamanzi athile, futhi lawa manzi ahamba - akhuphuka abe phezulu bese ebuyela phansi. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi umjikelezo wamanzi (umjikelezo wezamanzi). Ukuhlangana kwenzeka lapho ilanga likhanyisa amanzi emifuleni nasemachibini, futhi amanzi aguquka abe yiphunga noma umusi. Lawa manzi manje akhuphuka emifuleni nasemachibini aye emoyeni. Lokhu kuyimisebenzi yezitshalo ezikhipha amanzi ngeziphumo zazo. Iphunga nokuhlangana yizinqubo ezivumela amanzi ukuba abuyele emoyeni. Lapha, iphunga (ukukhanya) emoyeni kupholisa futhi kuhluka kube yizigaxa, kudala amafu. Lokhu kwenzeka uma amaningi amanzi emoyeni eqoqana futhi engasakwazi ukuhlala emoyeni. Bese amafu eqala ukuba nzima, futhi amanzi aqala ukuwa phansi - imvula, umoya, umswakama. Uma amanzi ewa phansi ngenxa yokuthi agcwele, ahamba aye olwandle, emifuleni, emachibini, noma emhlabathini. Uma amanzi ehlangana nomhlabathi, ayawathola futhi sithi yamanzi aphansi azosetshenziswa izitshalo, izilwane, nabantu. Okusele kuzohamba emifuleni, emachibini, nolwandle - bese umjikelezo uqala futhi. Kungani izitshalo zidinga amanzi? Amanzi asekelwa kahle isakhiwo sezitshalo. Amangqamuzana ezitshalo aqukethe kuze kufike ku-90% amanzi. Lawa mangqamuzana aqukethe amanzi asekelwa isitshalo. Uma amangqamuzana ezitshalo ephelelwa ngamanzi, isitshalo siba mncane futhi sithambekele. Uma amanzi ephelelwa ngokuphelele, sonke sizofa. Amanzi asiza isitshalo ukuba sipholile uma sishisa (ukuhlangana). Amanzi asiza futhi ekwakheni isitshalo, ehlanganisa ne-carbon dioxide ukuze kudaleke ama-carbohydrates. Amanzi ayawuhlanza amaminerali futhi athumele le miphako emhlabathini aye ezimpandeni bese efika esitshalo.
Izimo zezulu zango-2007/2008 - yini ababelana ngemininingwane abayishoyo? Inani lemvula elibhalwe ngonyaka owedlule, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi esibalulekile kusukela ngoJanuwari 2007 kuya kuMashi 2007, belingaphansi kwezinga elibi lika-1992. Kube nezindawo ezifana neGauteng nezingxenye zeMpumalanga ezisentshonalanga ezihlangabezane nezomiso ezifana nalena ka-1912. NgokukaMnu. Johan van den Berg ophuma ku-ARS, kukhona izimpawu ezikhombisa umphumela omkhulu weLa Nina. Kungenzeka ukuthi lo mphumela weLa Nina uzoph持续 kuze kube kwenkanyezi ka-2008. Umphumela walokhu kungaba ukuwa kwemvula okukhulu kusukela ngoDisemba 2007 kuya kuMashi 2008. Izithombe 1 - 3 zikhombisa ithuba lokuthola izinga lemvula ejwayelekile. Izindawo eziphuzi zikhombisa izinga lemvula ejwayelekile, izindawo eziluhlaza zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphezulu kunejwayelekile, kanti izindawo ezinsomi zikhombisa izinga lemvula eliphansi kunejwayelekile. Izibikezelo zikhombisa inani elijwayelekile (eliphuzi) elikhuphuka ngaphezu kwejwayelekile (eliluhlaza) ezinyangeni ezizayo. Amathuba okuthola imvula enkulu awamukelekile kahle ngoDisemba 2007 naseJanuwari 2008. Izithombe 1 - 3: Ithuba lokuthola izinga elijwayelekile (%). Ezithombeni 4 - 7, amathuba okuthola ngaphansi kuka-20 mm yemvula ezinsukwini ezithile akhombiswa. Izilinganiso zesikhathi eside zikhonjiswa ngombala obomvu, kanti amathuba wamanje (2007/2008) akhombiswa ngombala oluhlaza. Oluhlaza ukhombisa izikhathi ezinomsebenzi omuhle wokuthola imvula engaphezulu kwejwayelekile. Ngokubheka ukuqhubeka kweLa Nina, imvula enhle ilindeleke ngoDisemba, ekuqaleni kukaJanuwari, nasekuqaleni kukaFebhuwari 2008 naseMashi 2008. Ulwazi oluningi luqoqwe nguMnu. Johan van den Berg ophuma ku-ARS. Ulwazi olungeziwe lungatholakala ku-website yeGrain SA (www.graansa.co.za).
Ngemuva kokutshala kusukela ngo-Okthoba kuya kuDisemba 2010, izindawo eziningi lapho kukhuliswe khona ujeqe zathola imvula eningi. Ezindaweni eziningi zokufuya, lokhu kube yinkinga kubalimi ekulawuleni izitshalo eziphikisanayo phakathi kwemigqa yejeqe. Abalimi abangakaze basebenzise amakhemikhali ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele ukuze baphule izitshalo eziphikisanayo, kanye nalabo abangakaze baphonse ngemva kokuthi izitshalo zivele, bazobhekana nezinkinga ezinkulu ngonyaka ozayo nezitshalo eziphikisanayo. Izitshalo eziphikisanayo ezisunguliwe ezivele zikhule zivele zikhule zizoqhubeka zikwazi ukusabalalisa imbewu zazo emapulazini esizayo. Abakhiqizi abangasebenzisi imishini kakhulu ngesikhathi sokutshala (ukuhlwanyela okuncane) nabo babhekane nezinselelo eziningi ezindaweni lapho imishini ingasebenzi khona ngaphambi noma ngemva kokutshala. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola ngokucophelela amapulazi lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukutshala ukuze kutholakale ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezithombo eziphikisanayo ezizokhula ezindaweni ezithile. Amakhemikhali afanele nezibulala-zinambuzane angathengwa - xhumana nomphathi walawa makhompiyutha ukuze uthole izeluleko. Ezindaweni eziningi, imvula ifike nango-Agasti, okuzophinde kuvimbe abalimi ekulawuleni izitshalo eziphikisanayo ngemishini emapulazini noma ekusebenziseni amakhemikhali ngonyaka ozayo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, uma ubesebenzisa imishini kuphela ukuze uthuthukise (ukuhlwanyela) izitshalo eziphikisanayo, kungase kube ngcono ukuhlela ukuthenga umshini ophonsa (spray rig). Imishini ehlukene ingatholakala emakethe - kukhona imishini exhunywe kulawa ma-hitch amathathu anama-tank aphakathi kuka-600 liters no-1,000 liters anama-boom (izandla) aphakathi kuka-12 m no-16 m. Imishini enama-tank angakwazi ukuthwala u-1,000 liters kufanele isetshenziswe kuphela kumatraktori akwazi ukuphatha u-1.5 tons noma ngaphezulu. Imishini eyakhiwe lapha ezweni lethu ayibizi kakhulu, futhi izingxenye ezithile zitholakala kalula ngesikhathi sokutshala. Uma uthenga umshini ngaphandle, qiniseka ukuthi umthengisi angaqinisekisa ukuthi uzokwazi ukuthola amapompo amasha, amafremu, nezibulala-zinambuzane noma nini lapho udinga khona. Indlela eyodwa yokuphonsa amakhemikhali idinga izibulala-zinambuzane ezifanele le ndlela - umumo wokuphonsa kanye nokuvula kwezibulala-zinambuzane. Ukuhlola ingcindezi kwelinye ibhande kubalulekile ngoba kufanele kukhiqize i-cone ethile ehambisana nohlobo lwezitshalo eziphikisanayo kanye nohlobo lwekhemikhali. Uma ungathenga umshini ophonsayo, uzokunikeza izinzuzo ezahlukene uma uqhathanisa nomshini oxhunywe kumahitch amathathu. Amatraktori anedrayivu ye-hydraulic yehlile ngentengo, futhi amatraktori asebenza kangcono ngoba awanalo umthwalo ophucukayo umhlabathi. Izibulala-zinambuzane ezikwazi ukuthatha u-2,000 liters zikuvumela ukuba uphonse indawo enkulu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise futhi uhlanganise ikhemikhali. Khumbula ukuhlola ububanzi bezinyawo zomshini ukuze kuhlangane nezikhala zemigqa yokutshala ukuze wena, opharetha, ukwazi ukuhlela indlela umshini osebenza ngayo. Ngokuvamile, itanki enomthamo we-200 liters isetshenziselwa ukuphonsa ihektare eyodwa. Ngokufanayo, itanki ye-hitch ethathu ethwala u-600 liters izophonsa amahektare amathathu ngaphambi kokuphinda ugcwalise futhi uqhubeke uphonse. Uma ucabanga ukuphonsa i-herbicide, kufanele ucabangele okulandelayo: ukuthi yisiphi isikhala esidinga ukuphonswa, isikhathi onaso sokuphonsa, ukuthi kukhona amanzi anele ukuze uhlanganise ikhemikhali, umthamo we-traktor kanye nemishini - kanye ne-trailer enetanki engakwazi ukuthwala u-5,000 liters. Kuzosiza futhi ukufaka ipompo kule tank ukuze ugcwalise amanye ama-tank ngokushesha. Kufanele ulungiselele kahle kusenesikhathi futhi uphathe kahle yonke imishini yakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga emapulazini ngesikhathi sokutshala. Namuhla, kunzima ukwenza inzuzo ekulimaleni uma ungakabi nolwazi olunzulu mayelana nokuphathwa kwezitshalo eziphikisanayo ngamakhemikhali, ukuphonsa leyo khemikhali ngendlela efanele, nokusebenzisa imishini efanele. Ngaso sonke isikhathi funa usizo kulabo abanokuhlangenwe nakho kanye nochwepheshe ukuze bakusize ngokuqhuba nokuphonsa ama-herbicides. Uma ungakabi ne-traktor enamandla noma ungabi nemali yokuthenga le mishini, cabanga ngokuqasha umphakeli onemishini enkulu yokuphonsa. Labo bantu bavame ukukhokha phakathi kuka-R65 no-R100 ngehektare, kuhlanganiswe nezindleko ze-diesel. Amapulazi amakhulu angaphonswa phakathi nosuku nangezinyanga usebenzisa uhlelo lwe-GPS. Nokho, ngaphambi kokungena esivumelwaneni, qiniseka ukuthi umphakeli angafika ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi uzofika ngesikhathi esifanele uma kudingeka nokuthi iyiphi imishini ezodingeka ukuhlinzekwa umphakeli noma umphakeli. Khumbula, abanye abaphakeli abanakho itanki yamanzi noma amabhokisi. Uma ungakwazi ukukala amanzi adingekayo ngekhemikhali efanele okufanele uphonse, uzobhekana nezinkinga nomphakeli, futhi umsebenzi uzomisa. Kufanele uhlolisise izindleko zokuthenga imishini yakho, ukuba nekhono lokuphonsa ihektare ethile ngesikhathi esifanele, nezindleko zokuhola umphakeli ukuze enze lo msebenzi wokuphonsa. Enye into engakusiza ukuthi abaphakeli abaningi banolwazi mayelana nezinhlobo nezifomulamu zamakhemikhali asebenzisa njengamanje. Kuzokusiza ukuhlola ukuthi ukuphonsa kwenziwa kanjani ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kungase kube kuhle futhi ukukhuluma nabeluleki abasebenza kumafemu ahlukene athengisa amakhemikhali, bese uzokwazi ukuhlola izindleko zamakhemikhali ngehektare kanye nokwesekwa kulawa mafemu athengisa amakhemikhali. Khumbula ukuthi abahlinzeki bekhemikhali bahlala bejabulile ngesikhathi sokutshala futhi bangase bangakwazi ukweseka bonke abalimi ngokuhlanganisa amakhemikhali etankini. Uma ungenalo ulwazi, ungase uphonse amakhemikhali kancane kakhulu noma kakhulu.
Isithombe 1: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa engakaze ifafazwe ngempushana, ngakho izihlahla zibhakabhaka. Isithombe 2: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa efafazwe ngempushana ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala. Isithombe 3: Zama ukuthola isitshalo seziphuzo kulesi sithombe! Isithombe 4: I-filter ye-nozzle yokufafaza igcwele. Isithombe 5: Imikhono yomshini wokufafaza igcwele. Isithombe 6: Ukuvimbela kwale mikhono kungenzeka uma umshini ungcolile futhi ungagcinwanga kahle. Izithombe 1 no-2 zithathwe ensimini efanayo eMpumalanga Kapa - isithombe 1 sikhombisa lapho impushana ingafakwanga - isithombe 2 sikhombisa lapho ifafazwe khona ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala - umehluko ubonakala kahle! Singasho ukuthi zonke izitshalo ezikhulayo ezindaweni lapho zingadingeki khona zingama-weed. Ama-weed ayinkinga uma kukhuliswa izitshalo zokudla ngoba ancintisana nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi nezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini, kuholela ezinkingeni ngesikhathi sokuvuna, kucasula izitshalo zokudla, imbewu yazo ingangenisa ama-toxins ekudleni, futhi zingaba nezilokazane nezifo ezibangela ubungozi. Ama-weed akhula ngokushesha futhi akha kalula. Ahlala enezimpande eziqinile futhi akwazi ukuzivumelanisa kahle nezimo zezulu ezahlukene. Kunzima ukuwakhupha; aqinile futhi ancintisana ngokushelela nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi nezinto ezidingekayo. Ama-weed anendlela ezahlukene zokuphindisela, ngakho kufanele siqaphele ngalokhu uma sizama ukuwakhupha. Ama-weed angakhiqiza imbewu (ngokuvamile ngokushesha nangokulula), ezinye izinhlobo zine-rhizomes phansi komhlaba, ezinye zine-stolons phezulu komhlaba, ezinye zine-tubers, kanti ezinye zineziphuzo ezinkulu. Omunye umkhiqizo, ofana ne "nut grass," unakho konke lokhu - ukhiqiza imbewu, unama-tubers, futhi unama-rhizomes phansi komhlaba - lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuwakhupha. Imbewu ye-weed ivamise ukuhlala isebenziseka futhi ingaphila emhlabathini isikhathi eside kuze kube nezimo ezifanele zokukhula. Imbewu ye-weed nayo ayikhuli ngasikhathi sinye - ezinye zizokhula ngokushesha, kanti ezinye zizolinda. Ngokuvamile, ziqala ukukhula uma umhlaba uphazamisekile. Izimpande ze-weed zivame ukungena kakhulu emhlabathini, zidlula izimpande zezithako zokudla, zivumela ama-weed ukuba aphumelele ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ama-weed akhulayo unyaka nonyaka agcina izinto ezidingekayo ezimpandeni zawo phansi komhlaba - ngesikhathi sezikhathi ezinzima zokukhula, angaphumelela. Ama-weed angaba yonyaka (akhula unyaka owodwa), ezinye izinhlobo ziba yizinyanga ezimbili (akhula iminyaka emibili), kanti ezinye ziba yizinyanga eziningi (akhula iminyaka eminingi). Kungani kubalulekile ukulawula ama-weed ezitshalo zokudla? Ama-weed ancintisana nezitshalo ngamanzi emhlabathini, ngezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini, nendawo yokukhula, kanye nokukhanya (ilanga). Le mncintiswano ibangela ukuthi izitshalo zingakhuli kahle, futhi umkhiqizo unciphe. Kungase futhi kucasule imbewu futhi kwehlise izinga lempilo yembewu. Le mncintiswano iyahluka - ezinye izinhlobo zama-weed azibeki ingozi enkulu ezitshalo ezithile - ingozi ingaba phansi, njenge 10%, kodwa ingakhuphuka ibe ngu-98%. Ama-weed aqala ukuncintisana nezitshalo uma sekuqinisekisiwe izimpande eziqinile - ngemva kokukhula. Ukulawula ama-weed kusho ukuvimbela le mncintiswano, nokuvimbela ama-weed ekukhiqizeni imbewu ezokhula futhi ancintisane nezitshalo ezizotshalwa ngonyaka olandelayo. Bonke abalimi abafuna ukuphumelela ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zokudla kufanele balwe nama-weed ngaso sonke isikhathi - ama-weed ayinkinga enkulu. Ngokuvamile, ama-weed alawulwa usebenzisa imishini ngokusebenzisa umhlaba noma ngekemikhali - kaningi lezi zindlela zombili zisetshenziswa. Uma umlimi ephumelela ekulawuleni ama-weed, insimu izoveza kuphela izitshalo ezitshaliwe - akukho ma-weed! Kodwa kaningi lokhu akwenzi kalula, futhi ama-weed aqhubeka. Kungani ama-weed engase alawulwe kahle? Kukhona izinto ezintathu ezingenza ukulawulwa kwama-weed kungaphumeleli - okokuqala kungaba indlela yokulima kanye nomshini osebenzisayo, okwesibili kungaba impushana efakwe, futhi okokugcina kungaba izimo zezulu. Izilungiselelo zomshini zingase zingabi seduze, futhi kungase kube nezikhala, kuvumela umhlaba phakathi kwezihlahla ukuthi ungafakwa kahle (uma ziqinile, azizosebenzi kahle). Ukuphakama kokulima kungase kungafiki kahle - izimpande zama-weed ezihlala isikhathi eside zihlala ziqinile emhlabathini, futhi ama-weed angaphinda akhule. Isivinini somshini singase sibe siphansi kakhulu - kufanele sisebenze ngokushesha ukuze siphazamise umhlaba kahle. Umhlaba ungase ube manzi kakhulu - ama-weed afakwe asaqhubeka nokuxhumana nomhlaba ongena manzi futhi angaphinda akhule. Ukulungiswa komshini kungase kube phambene. Isikhathi sokufafaza ama-weed singase singabi sesimweni esifanele. Impushana esetshenziswayo ingase ingasebenzi kahle kulolu hlobo lwe-weed. I-filter ye-nozzle yokufafaza igcwele (isithombe 4). Imikhono yomshini wokufafaza igcwele (isithombe 5). Ama-nozzles angafaneleka asetshenziswa (khumbula ukusebenzisa i-nozzle enesimo se-cone uma ufafaza phezu kwezihlahla, futhi i-flat fan nozzle uma ufafaza phezu komhlaba). Umshini ungase ungakahlanzwa kahle ngonyaka odlule - izinto eziningi zingavimba, futhi ngeke usebenze kahle uma kukhona okushiywe okungcolile. Ingxenye yekhemikhali idinga imvula ngemva kokufafaza ukuze isebenze kahle - uma kunganaki, impushana ayikwazi ukuqala ukusebenza. Izimo zezulu ezishisayo kakhulu nezomile zingavimbela impushana ekusebenzeni kahle. Imvula eningi ngemva kokulima ingabangela ama-weed ukuba 'aphinde akhule.' Ukuphatha nokulawula ama-weed kubalulekile kakhulu - uma singakwenzi kahle, ngeke sithole umkhiqizo omuhle. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokungaphathi ama-weed kahle esikhulume ngazo ngenhla - kodwa ekugcineni kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphatha yonke imisebenzi yakho yokulima kusenesikhathi kubalulekile. Lo nyaka ububalulekile ekulungiseni lezi zinkinga, kodwa lokho esikufundile kungasiza ekuthuthumeleni phambili konyaka olandelayo. Iphutha elidala esalenzile esikhathini esedlule kufanele lisifundise ukuthi singaliphindi esikhathini esizayo; kungcono ukwenza amaphutha amasha!
Isitha esikhulu esinengxaki enkulu kubalimi abasafufusa izitshalo - ngakho-ke sihlose ukulwa nale ngxaki ngazo zonke amandla ethu kulo nyaka ozayo ukuze siyisuse! Ezindaweni eziningi lapho izitshalo zikhuliswa khona ehlobo, kube nokukhiqiza okuhle kulo nyaka. Kodwa lokhu kusho ukuthi ukukhula kwezihlahla ezimbi kuyanda. Kube nezinkundla kulo nyaka lapho kungabonakali khona ukuthi izitshalo zokudla zakhuliswa noma ukuthi izihlahla ezimbi zafakwa. Izindleko eziphakeme nokulahleka kokukhiqiza akusikho okuthanda ukukucabanga. Eminyakeni edlule, kube kunzima ukuhweba ukuze uthole inzuzo - manje asikwazi ukukwazi kahle ukulahlekelwa izitshalo zokudla ezidingekayo. Ungazibuza ukuthi kungani sikhathazekile ngale ngxaki yezihlahla ezimbi ngoMsombuluko. Okwamanje, akusizo ukusiza ukuzama ukubulala izihlahla ezimbi ngoba ingozi isivele isunguliwe (ngaphandle kokuthi uvimbele izihlahla ezimbi ekukhuleni kwembewu zazo ezizokhula kulo nyaka ozayo). Nokho, uma sifuna ukulwa nesitha, kumele sazi ukuthi yisiphi isitha - awukwazi ukulwa nento ongayazi noma ongakaze uyibone. Le yisikhathi esihle sokuhamba ezinkundleni zakho futhi ubone ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezimbi ezikhona - izinhlobo zezihlahla ezimbi ezikhona njengamanje kungenzeka zibe khona kulo nyaka ozayo (mhlawumbe nasezinyangeni ezizayo uma ungathathi izinyathelo eziqinile zokuzisusa manje). Zithumele kanjani - zikhula embewini, ezimpandeni, ezikhwameni, noma ngenye indlela? Yisiphi isindlela esingakhetha ukusisebenzisa ukuphatha izihlahla ezimbi ezitshalo zethu (ukushintsha izinhlobo zez plants, ukulima ngamakhenikhali, noma ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali)? Nini kufanele silwe nalezi zinhlobo zezihlahla ezimbi (kungenzeka kube ebusika ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukufaka izitshalo zonyaka ozayo)? Yiziphi amakhemikhali abhaliswe ukubulala izinhlobo ezithile zezihlahla ezimbi? Nini kufanele amakhemikhali afakwe emhlabathini noma ezihlahleni ezimbi? Uma uqoqe yonke imininingwane mayelana nezinhlobo zezihlahla ezimbi ezibeka ingozi kuwe, uzimisele ukuziphatha ngendlela efanele kulo nyaka ozayo - zilungiselele ukuphumelela kulolu banga lokulwa nale sitha sezihlahla ezimbi!
Uhlaka: Ulwazi luthathwe encwadinini ebizwa ngokuthi, Isingeniso Ekukhiqizeni KweMabele. Zonke izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni lapho zingafaneleki khona zingabizwa ngokuthi "izihlahla eziphikisanayo." Izihlahla eziphikisanayo zingabaphikisi bokukhiqiza ukudla - ziphikisana nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi, ukukhanya kwelanga, nezithako, zenze izinkinga ngesikhathi sokuvuna, zingangcolisa imbewu noma zishintshe umbala wembewu, imbewu yazo ingaba yingozi futhi ilethe ezinye izifo ezibeka ubungozi ezitshalweni zokudla. Ngokuvamile, izihlahla eziphikisanayo zikhula ngokushesha futhi zikhulisa imbewu eningi, zisasazeka kalula futhi zikhula ngokushesha. Zivame ukuba nezimpande eziqinile futhi zingakhula ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ziyinselele ukuyiphatha, ziqhathanisa, futhi ziphikisana ngokukhuthazayo nezinye izitshalo. Zivame ukuvutha ngokushesha, ngakho-ke zikhula ngokushesha. Izimpande zezihlahla eziphikisanayo zivame ukungena phansi emhlabathini, zivumela ukuba zihlale ziphila ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ezikhula minyaka yonke zivame ukufaka ukudla kwazo ngaphansi komhlabathi - ngaleyo ndlela zingahlala ziphila ngesikhathi esinzima. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo zingama ngokushesha eminyakeni eyodwa, noma zingakhula iminyaka emibili, noma zingakhula minyaka yonke futhi zikhulise imbewu unyaka nonyaka. Kungani kubalulekile ukuphatha (ukubulala) izihlahla eziphikisanayo? Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ziphikisana nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi, izithako, isikhala, nokukhanya kwelanga. Lokhu kudala ubungozi ezitshalo zokudla ngoba kuvinjwa ukukhula okufanele kwezitshalo futhi kunciphisa umkhiqizo. Lokhu kuphikisana kungangcolisa imbewu yokudla, kunciphise umkhiqizo, futhi kuthinte ikhwalithi yembewu yokudla. Ukuphikisana nezihlahla eziphikisanayo kuhluka phakathi kwezitshalo ezahlukene - kungadala ubungozi obuphakathi kuka-10% kuya phezulu kuka-98%. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ziqala ukuphikisana nezinye izitshalo uma izimpande zazo seziqhakazile. Ukuphatha izihlahla eziphikisanayo kuhlose ukuvimbela lokhu kuphikisana ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke, futhi ukuvimbela izihlahla eziphikisanayo ekukhuleni nasekuphuma kwemibewu yazo ezizovutha uma ezinye izitshalo zifakwe. Kukhona izindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokuphatha izihlahla eziphikisanayo - ngokwenziwa (ukuhlanza) nangokwenziwa kwemichiza. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlinzwa kuphela, noma inhlanganisela yokuhlanza nokufaka imichiza kungaba indlela eshibhile. Ukukhetha indlela kusezandleni zomlimi, izintandokazi zabo, ulwazi, kanye namandla okuthola abasebenzi, imishini, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokufaka nokuhamba. Ukuphathwa kwezihlahla eziphikisanayo kufanele kwenziwe njalo lapho kuqala ukulima, lapho kulungiswa izinkambu zokufaka, ngesikhathi sokufaka, nasekukhuleni kwezitshalo. Ngale ndlela, izihlahla eziphikisanayo zihlanzwa ngokwenziwa ukuze kuvinjwe imbewu yazo ekufakweni. Lokhu kungenzeka ngaphambi kokufaka (inkambu kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile) nasekuqaleni kokukhula kwezitshalo. Kubalulekile ukubulala izitshalo eziphikisanayo lapho zincane ukuze zingaphikisi nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi, futhi izimpande zezithako zokudla azizukulimala kalula uma nazo zincane. Uma izitshalo eziphikisanayo zineziqhamo eziqinile, ukuhlinza kuzo kungalimaza nezimpande zezithako zokudla. Kukhona imichiza ethambekileyo emanzini, emigqonyeni, kanye nezinye imichiza engagciniwe esetshenziselwa ukubulala izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi inani lemichiza efakiwe libe nekhono futhi isikhathi sokufaka sibalulekile. Le mikhakha ingahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ezimbili: ukukhetha nokungakhethi. Lezo ezingakhethi zibulala zonke izitshalo ezihlangabezana nazo, kanti lezo ezikhethiweyo zibulala kuphela izihlahla ezithile, zishiya izitshalo zokudla zingalimali. Lezo ezingakhethi zingafakwa phakathi kwemigqa yezitshalo ukuze zibulale izihlahla eziphikisanayo lapho kodwa azithinti izitshalo zokudla. Imichiza isebenza ngezindlela ezimbili - eyodwa isebenza ngokuxhumana nezihlahla eziphikisanayo, enye isebenza ngokungena ohlelweni lokukhula kwezitshalo. Imichiza yokuxhumana ibulala amahlamvu, ngakho-ke isihlahla kumele sibe sihlanzekile kahle ngemichiza. Le mikhakha ivame ukusebenza kahle uma izitshalo zincane. Le mikhakha yokwakha ihamba ngaphakathi kwezitshalo, ingafakwa kumahlamvu kodwa izobulalayo nezimpande. Kukhona nezinye izinhlobo zemichiza - imichiza yokwakha ngaphambi kokuvuthwa (efakwa ngaphambi kokuthi isitshalo sikhule) kanye nemichiza yokwakha ngemuva kokuvuthwa (efakwa ngemuva kokuthi isitshalo sikhule). Imichiza yokwakha ngaphambi kokuvuthwa ihlala emhlabathini futhi ithathwa ngezimpande uma isitshalo siqala ukukhula; imichiza yokwakha ngemuva kokuvuthwa ithathwa ngama-leaves nezinsika zezithako. Ukufaka imichiza kuyashesha uma sihlanganisa nokuhlanza. Ezinye izinhlobo zemichiza zisebenza isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke akudingeki ukubuyela futhi ubulale izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Uma kunenhlabathi enkulu futhi izinkambu zimanzi kakhulu, kungaba nzima ukungena enkambini nge-tractor edonsela umshini wokuhlanza, kodwa ungakwazi ukungena ngomshini ophonsa imichiza. Ukufaka imichiza kuzosebenza kangcono ngaleso sikhathi.
Kunzima ukukholwa ukuthi intengo ye-maize ku-Safex ngoFebhuwari 2007 yayiphansi kuka-R1880 ngentoni uma sicabanga ukuthi yafinyelela ku-R3,460 ngentoni ngoSepthemba 18. Ukukhuphuka kwamanani kwalethe ukukhanya kubakhiqizi be-maize, kodwa iqiniso ukuthi labo abathole inzuzo babebanemali ethile yokugcina umkhiqizo wabo ophume ku-2006/2007, noma labo abangenile ezivumelwaneni zesikhathi eside ne-Safex. Ngaphandle kokuthi, akukho abakhiqizi abangagcina futhi babambe imikhiqizo yabo isikhathi eside ngemuva kokuvuna, ngakho-ke kukhona ingozi yokungatholi intengo enhle. Abakhiqizi bangazibuza ukuthi kuphi ochwepheshe abafanele ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nale ndaba. Kungani abalimi (abakhiqizi) bengatholi imiyalezo eqondile? Lokhu kuyalimaza, kodwa ulwazi olukhona ngesikhathi esithile akusona isici esingakusiza ukwenza isinqumo esiqondile mayelana nokumaketha umkhiqizo wakho. Kukho nezinye izici ezingaba nomthelela, mhlawumbe isimo sezulu singaba yinto enkulu, esingabangela ukukhuphuka kwamanani. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukusho ngokwethembeka ukuthi kuzokwenzekani esikhathini esizayo. Ithebula 1 likhombisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni jikelele kusukela ngo-2005, futhi kukhona umbono ongajwayelekile ngamanani e-maize emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2007 owawuncishiswe ngokusekelwe ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari, konke kuhambisana nezibalo ezivela esikhathini esifushane edlule. Ukuhlola okuhamba phambili kwe-maize emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2007 kukhombisa inani elingafinyelela ku-623.7 million tons, njengoba bekukholelwa ukuthi kunezindawo eziningi ezintsha ezilinywe. Uma lezi zibalo ziqinile, kuzoba khona ama-ton angu-33.5 million (6.7%) e-maize athengiswa ngo-2006. Emhlabeni jikelele, ukusetshenziswa kwe-maize kungaba cishe ku-620 million tons, okusho ukuthi kuzoba ne-maize eyanele kuzo zonke izindawo ezidingayo. Ithebula 1: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni (million tons). Umthombo: International Grain Board. Ngenxa yezimo zezulu ezingalindelekile, amazwe ahlukene akhiqiza i-maize anciphise izibalo zawo zokukhiqiza phakathi kuka-2007 kaningi, futhi ekupheleni kukaSepthemba 07, isibalo sokukhiqiza safinyelela ku-601.4 million tons. Lokhu kwaba ukuncipha kwama-ton angu-22.3 million kusukela ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari 2007 - lokhu kwabangela ukukhuphuka okungajwayelekile kwamanani e-maize emhlabeni. Umthombo (lapho sithole khona: International Grain Board, Safex kanye nedatha ye-Grain SA). Intengo ye-maize e-Argentina yayingu-$177/ton ngoFebhuwari 07 yabe isinyuka yaya ku-$355/ton (I-Graph 1). Lokhu kusho ukuthi yanda ngo-$158/ton noma ngo-89%. Lokhu kwenzeka ngaphandle kokukhuphuka kokukhiqizwa okwakudlula ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari. Intengo ethi "free-on-board" ye-USA Hard Red evela eGulf nayo yenza okufanayo ngaphandle kokukhuphuka kokukhiqizwa kwe-maize okungama-1.5 tons eMelika kusukela ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari (Ithebula 1). Ngenxa yesimo sezulu esibi e-Australia, eCanada, nase-European Union, ukukhiqizwa kwehla kakhulu - lokhu kwabangela ukuthi intengo ye-maize emhlabeni yehlise ngo-2007 - futhi lokhu kwacindezela amanani e-maize emhlabeni ukuba akhuphuke. I-Graph 1 ikhombisa intengo ye-Safex (ngenyanga esondelene), ku-$ /ton kulandela intengo yomhlaba ngo-2007. Kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2007, intengo ye-Safex ikhulile ngo-$200/ton, uma kuqhathaniswa nokukhuphuka kwentengo ka-$158/ton e-Argentina, nokukhuphuka kwentengo ka-$143/ton ye-USA Hard Red. Ukukhuphuka okukhulu kwamanani e-maize lapha uma kuqhathaniswa nemakethe yomhlaba kwenzeka kakhulu ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuhambisa i-maize lapha ngempahla. NgoFebhuwari 2007, kwakhokhwa $43/ton ukuhambisa i-maize evela e-Argentina, kanye no-$48/ton ukuhambisa evela eGulf. Kwakukhona futhi isidingo esikhulu semikhumbi ehambisa i-maize, okwakwenza izindleko zokuhamba zibe kabili. Njengamanje, kwakhokhwa $73/ton ukuhambisa i-maize evela e-Argentina, kanye no-$88/ton ukuhambisa i-maize evela ezikhumulweni zeGulf kuya lapha (I-Graph 2). Ngentengo yokushintshaniswa ka-R6.85/$, lokhu kusho ukuthi ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuhambisa kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2007 sekuhamba ku-R219/ton. Umthombo: International Grain Board. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni kulindeleke ukuthi kwehle, okwenze amanani e-maize emhlabeni akhuphuke, futhi ngenxa yesidingo lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sidinga ukungenisa ingxenye yesithathu ye-maize edliwayo/eyidingekayo, ukukhuphuka kwamanani emhlabeni kuphinde kwabangela ukuthi amanani lapha akhuphuke. Ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuhambisa i-maize ezivela phesheya nakho kuhlanganise ukucindezela amanani endawo. Ukukhuphuka kwamanani e-maize emhlabeni kuphinde kukhombise ukuthi izimo zezulu zinegalelo elikhulu uma sibheka imakethe yokudla evela kwezolimo. Siyazi kahle ukuthi asikwazi ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo noma isimo sezulu sizokwenza ukuthini.
Isithombe: U-Hlangabeza kanye neqembu elivela eBothaville nehlelo le-Grain SA lokuthuthukisa abalimi: Kusukela kwesobunxele kuya kwesokudla ngu-Jane McPherson (umphathi wohlelo), u-Willie Kotzé (umqondisi wezokufundisa nolwazi), u-Debbie Nel (ukwesekwa kwehhovisi), u-Jenny Mathews (ikomidi eliphathisa: Grain SA), no-Nico Vermaak (umphathi: Isevisi Zenkampani, Grain SA). Sifinyelele ekupheleni konyaka omunye wokuxhaswa kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho kohlelo lokuthuthukisa abalimi. Njengoba kwenzeka kwezinye izindawo ezithuthukayo, intuthuko kwesinye isikhathi ibonakala ihamba kancane - abanye abantu bafunda ngokushesha kodwa abanye bathatha isikhathi ukuze baphenduke ezindleleni ezintsha zokusebenza ukuze sifinyelele endaweni lapho singasho khona ukuthi sithuthuka. Kulo hlelo, sisebenza kanzima ukuthatha abalimi abakhona manje esimweni (okungafani nakwabanye) bese sibabeka esimweni esidingekayo lapho bengasho khona ngiyabalimi bezomnotho, ngimi ngiqinile futhi ngizophinda ngiqhubeke nomsebenzi wami wokulima. Imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwalolu hlelo ihlose ukubhekana nezidingo zabahlali abahlukene. Lolu hlelo lusaqhutshwa eBothaville. Ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somsebenzi se-Grain SA, uhlelo luhlelwa ngaphansi kwesigaba seSevisi Zenkampani esiphathiswa nguMnu. Nico Vermaak. Ihlobo elidlule belinzima kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwamanzi ezindaweni eziningi ngesikhathi sehlobo - kukhona abalimi abangenakutshala, abanye batshala kodwa abangenakuthola umkhiqizo, kanti ezinye izindawo zithole imvula ejwayelekile. Ngokuvamile abalimi batshala ngemali ebolekiwe - baboleka ezibankini noma ezinkampanini ezibolekayo imali yokulima (noma ama-Co-op amadala) - futhi abambalwa bathatha umshwalense ukuze bavikele inani lemali abawutshala ukuze baqale ngoba inzuzo iphansi futhi abafuni ukungena ezindlekweni ezengeziwe. Ngonyaka onjengalona, kukhona abalimi abathile abangenakukhokha izindleko zabo zokukhiqiza, ngakho-ke bahlupheka ukuthola imali yokutshala kabusha. Lapho sisebenza nabalimi abasafufusa abangenamali ethile, unyaka odlule ubeka ingozi enkulu engavimbela intuthuko yesikhathi esizayo ekwakheni abalimi bezomnotho. Uhlelo lwethu lwezinga eliphezulu lwabalimi luhamba kahle futhi sesethule abalimi abakhethiwe kuhlu lwethu lweMfundo yeAgribusiness. Sibona ukwethulwa kwalolu suku kanye nomsebenzi olandelayo njengokuphela kohlelo oluzosiza umulimisi ukuba abe umulimisi ongenayo. Lolu suku luhlanganisa lonke ulwazi olukhona oluvela kwezinye izifundo futhi luhlose ukukhombisa umulimisi izindawo okufanele agxile ekuthuthukiseni, izinto ezibalulekile uma efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla ngempumelelo ngesikhathi esifanele nangendlela efanele. Uhlelo lwethu lokuqeqesha abalimi belugcwele eminyakeni eminingana - ngaphezu kwezifundo ezingama-80 kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2006 kuya kuSepthemba 30, 2007. Lezi zifundo zamukelwa kahle, abalimi babuyela futhi bacela ezinye izifundo. Lezi zifundo ziqhutshelwa kusukela kuFebhuwari kuya kuNovemba ngonyaka - kwesinye isikhathi abalimi baphithizela ezindaweni zabo zokulima futhi abanakho isikhathi sokuhambele izifundo. Ngesikhathi sehlobo, sizama ukubring abalimi iziboniso lapho bezama futhi ukwenza umsebenzi wokulima, futhi simema amalungu ezigaba zokufunda ukuba bahlangane, futhi sizama ukusiza umulimisi ngamunye ngokwehlukana. Siphinde sathola impendulo enhle evela kumagunya ababelana ngolwazi besebenza nezikhungo zezolimo futhi silindele ukusiza bona emnyakeni emisha yezezimali lapho kuzoba nezifundo ezengeziwe ezifundisa umsebenzi ophathekayo - ukusebenza emhlabeni ngezandla kube inselelo enkulu kulawa magunya, engakaze ibonise abalimi ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kahle. Siyaqhubeka nokusabalalisa ulwazi ku-Radio ezindaweni ezine: Lesedi, Motsweding, Ligwalagwala, kanye ne-Umhlobo Wenene - lokhu kuyindlela enhle yokuxhumana nabalimi - hhayi nje ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi mayelana nobuchwepheshe kodwa futhi ukwazisa abalimi ngemicimbi yalolu hlelo. I-Pula-Imvula iyaqhubeka - sekuwumsebenzi obalulekile walolu hlelo - ngakho-ke sithokozisa le miphumela uma siyibona iphrintiwe. Kukhona abantu abaningi abasebenza ukuze baqedele lo msebenzi - abanye basebenza ku-GSA, abanye bavela ku-ARC-GCI ePotchefstroom, abahleli bahlala bejolise ekuphothuleni umsebenzi wabo ngesikhathi, abanye basebenza ku-Infoworks (labo abahlola ukubhala kwethu nalabo abakhiqiza incwadi yezindaba oyifundayo), abahleli baqhubeka nokusebenza kulokho esikubhalayo nalabo abakhulisa izincwadi zezindaba - bonke basebenza ukuze bakhiqize incwadi yethu yezindaba nyanga zonke! I-Pula-Imvula iyamukelwa kahle kakhulu futhi labo abafunda ngayo bayanda - sesifinyelele ezinkopweni eziyi-16,500 ngenyanga, futhi lokhu kuyaqhubeka kukhula. Siphinde sibonge iMaize Trust ngokuxhasa uhlelo lwethu.
Thina, abasebenzi lapha eGrain SA ngohlelo lweMfundo Yabalimi, sijabule futhi sinesibusiso ngoba sikholwa ukuthi lolu hlelo luzoletha ushintsho ekulimaleni eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lweGrain SA Farmer Development lugxile ekuthuthukiseni abalimi abamnyama ukuze bakhule babe abalimi abakhokhelwayo, abanamakhono abazokwazi ukuqhubeka esikhathini esizayo. Umsebenzi wokukhiqiza ukudla okwenziwe ngembewu, ikakhulukazi kubalimi, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi njengamanje nasekusaseni. Sibhekene nokwabiwa komhlaba, izinguquko emthethweni wokuphathwa komhlaba, kumele silwe nezimpahla zokudla zangaphandle, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuqala zokulima, silima ezindaweni eziningi ezingatholi imvula, futhi kukhona okuthiwa "ukushisa komhlaba" okuphinde kushintshe isimo sezulu. Ngamafuphi, kunezinkinga eziningi, asinaso isifiso sokuthi zibe khona - njengamanje, sifuna izixazululo, asinazo! Kumele siqhubeke sikhumbula izibusiso zethu kulolu hlelo, sinesibusiso - sinethimba elinabantu abahamba phambili. Kufanele siqale ngamalungu eGrain SA Executive (ukuphatha okuphakeme). Siphinde sisondele ekupheleni konyaka ophumelelayo kuhlelo lweGrain SA Farmer Development Programme. Yonke imisebenzi esiyenzile ngalesi sikhathi kuleli hlelo ibingavela kuphela ngosizo olukhulu oluvela kuMaize Trust. UJane McPherson noWillie Kotzé, bobabili lapha ehhovisi elikhulu leGrain SA eBothaville, baphatha uhlelo lweFarmer Development Programme. Isikhundla esisha esibizwa ngokuthi "Specialist: Field Services" sidalwe, futhi uDanie van den Berg uthathe le ndima. U-Danie uyazi kahle leli hlelo futhi uqeqeshe abaningi ngendlela ephezulu eminyakeni emithathu edlule. U-Danie ubheka labo basebenzi emasimini - abakhiqizi bezifunda abasebenza ekuthuthukiseni abalimi. E-Table 1, kukhona amagama abo bonke abasebenza kulolu hlelo. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona abalimi abaninzi bezomnotho, sigxila kakhulu kulabo abakhiqizi abathuthuke, ngoba Sikholelwa ukuthi ukuze sifinyelele inhloso yethu yokuthi "Sithuthukise abalimi abamnyama abanamakhono ukuba babe abakhiqizi bezomnotho," kumele sixhase umkhiqizi ngamunye njengoba eqhubeka nalesi sikhumbuzo sokuba nomnotho. Ezindaweni ezineziqhamo ezikhulayo, sisengxenyeni enkulu nezifundo ngoba kuyindlela engcono yokuxhumana nabakhiqizi abaningi. Uhlelo lokuqeqesha luqhubeka nokukhula - kunezifundo eziningi ezitholakalayo futhi inani labalimi abafuna ukuya kulezi zifundo liqhubeka likhula. Siphinda sikhumbuze ukubonga kwethu ngosizo oluvela kuMaize Trust, oluqhubeka nokusekela leli hlelo - sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuphatha leli hlelo ngendlela efanele futhi sixhase abalimi ngendlela efanele. Thina, ithimba lokuthuthukisa, siyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokusebenza nabalimi abasha.
Kungani izitshalo ziba nombala ophuzi ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezimanzi zonyaka? Isithombe: Izimo zokuphuma kwamanzi zithinta inqubo yokukhula kwezitshalo eziningi. Umlando wesiNgisi u-H.G. Willis wathi umlando wabantu ungumbono phakathi kokufunda nokuphazamiseka. Mayelana nabakhiqizi bezitshalo ezindaweni ezithola imvula yasehlobo eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi lezo ezindaweni ezinomhlabathi owomile, le miphumela iyinto evamile nsuku zonke. Izindlela zokukhiqiza izitshalo ezindaweni ezingomile zishintshile ukuze kuvinjwe umonakalo ongenakubuyiselwa ngenxa yokushoda kwemvula. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokulungisa ubuningi bezitshalo, ukusebenzisa amafutha afanele ngokusekelwe emiphumeleni esunguliwe, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulima ezonga amanzi ukuze kwandiswe kancane ukufakwa kwamanzi, ukusebenzisa izinsuku ezifanele zokuhlwanyela, nokukhetha ukuhlanganiswa kwezithombo ezingakwazi ukujwayela ukushoda kwemvula, njll. Lezi zinhlelo zezithombo zifaka phakathi iqembu lezitshalo elaziwa ngokuthi ama-mesophytes, aphumelela emhlabathini omanzi kodwa opholile. Imizi yazo ilungiswe kahle ukuze ifune amanzi nezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini; isibonelo, imizi ye-maize ingangena emhlabathini ngesivinini esingu-24 mm ngosuku, ifinyelela ubukhulu obungama-2 kuya kuma-2.4 metres, kuye ngalesi simo somhlabathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemizi kungavinjwa kakhulu noma kuphazamiseke ngenxa yemvula eningi, njengoba kwenzeka ngesikhathi salo nyaka lapho izitshalo zihlanyelwa ngoDisemba noJanuwari. Imvula eningi emhlabathini owomile izoholela ekutheni amanzi agcwalise izinga lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukuhamba komoya okukhona. Inqubo yokuqala ebalulekile yokuphila ezothinteka kabi ukungena komoya emizini; izitshalo zidinga amazinga athile omoya (okhiye) emizini yazo. Abacwaningi bakhombisile ezihlolweni zabo ukuthi ngaphansi kwezimo zokuphuma kwamanzi ngokuphelele, ukukhula kwemizi kungama kancane ngemizuzu. Nokho, izitshalo zihluka ekubekezeleni kwazo ukuhamba kwamanzi endaweni eyodwa. Isibonelo, izitshalo ezithanda amanzi ezaziwa ngokuthi ama-hydrophytes (njenge-rice) zikhululekile ukuphila ezimeni zomhlabathi ezimanzi. Nokho, lezi zitshalo zingafa emhlabathini onokuhamba komoya okwanele. Imizi yezitshalo ezingakwazi ukuhamba kwamanzi, njenge-legumes (ama-beans omile, ama-soybeans, njll.), izofa emva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuphuma kwamanzi. Izimpawu zokuqala zokulimala kokuphuma kwamanzi zingavela ngemva kwamahora amabili, kuyilapho umonakalo ongabuyiselwa ungavela ngemva kwamahora angama-24, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezishisayo nezinyakazayo. Uma ukungena komoya emizini kuphazamisekile, ezinye izisebenzi ezibalulekile zezitshalo ezifana nokukhula, ukutholwa kwamanzi, nokumuncwa kwezinto eziphilayo nazo ziya kuphazamiseka. Naphezu kokuba namanzi amaningi, izitshalo azikwazi ukuwathola amanzi nezinto eziphilayo. Ezinye izimpawu zokukhathazeka kwezithombo ziba sobala, kuye ngokuthi zikhula kanjani. Isibonelo, uma ukungena komoya emizini kuncishisiwe ngesikhathi sokukhula kwe-maize, ukutholwa kwamanzi nakho kuyancipha ngokufanayo, okuzothinta ukumuncwa kwezinto eziphilayo. Isibonakaliso esibonakalayo yikhala lokuphuma kwezithombo (chlorosis) ngenxa yokuncipha kwamazinga e-chlorophyll. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwe-nitrogen ezitshalweni, nakuba i-phosphorus, i-potassium, nezinye izinto eziphilayo zingase zibe nokuntuleka. Kulesi sikhathi, isitshalo sithumele i-nitrogen ezitshalweni ezintsha ezivela ezindala ukuze siqhubeke sikhula. Ukuqhubeka kokuphuma kwamanzi kuzoholela ekunciphiseni ukukhula kwezithombo zezitshalo nokulahlekelwa kokukhiqiza.
