Umphikisi omkhulu onezinkinga ezinkulu kubalimi abasha yizihlahla - ngakho-ke sihlose ukuwulwa nale nkinga ngazo zonke izindlela zethu kulo nyaka ozayo! Ezindaweni eziningi lapho izitshalo zikhula khona ehlobo, kube nokukhiqiza okuhle kulo nyaka. Kodwa lokhu kusho ukuthi ukukhula kwezihlahla kuyanda. Kube nezinkundla kulo nyaka lapho kungabonakali khona ukuthi izitshalo zokudla zifakwe noma ukuthi izihlahla zifakwe. Izindleko eziphezulu nokulahleka kokukhiqiza akusikho okuthanda ukukucabangela. Eminyakeni edlule, kube nzima ukuf farming ukuze uthole inzuzo - manje asikwazi ukuhamba kalula nokulahlekelwa izitshalo zokudla ezidingekayo. Ungase uzibuze ukuthi kungani sikhathazekile ngale nkinga yezihlahla ngoMsombuluko. Okwamanje, akusizi ukuzama ukubulala izihlahla ngoba ingozi isivele ibekwe (ngaphandle kokuthi uvimbe izihlahla ekukhuleni kwezim seed ezizokhula kulo nyaka ozayo). Nokho, uma sifuna ukuwulwa nomphikisi, kumele sazi ukuthi iyiphi uhlobo lomphikisi - awukwazi ukuwulwa nento ongayazi noma ongakaze uyibone. Le yisikhathi esihle sokuhamba ezinkundleni zakho futhi ubone ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhona - izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhona njengamanje zifanele ukuba khona kulo nyaka ozayo (mhlawumbe nasezinyangeni ezizayo uma ungathathi izinyathelo eziqinile zokuzisusa manje). Zisabalala kanjani - zikhula kusuka ezitsheni, emithini, emithanjeni, noma ngenye indlela? Yisiphi isindlela esingakhetha ukusiza ukuphatha izihlahla ezitsheni zethu (ukushintsha izinhlobo zezitshalo, ukulima ngezinsiza, noma ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali)? Nini kufanele siwule izihlahla ezinjalo (kungenzeka kube ebusika ngaphambi kokuthi uqale ukufaka izitshalo zonyaka ozayo)? Yiziphi amakhemikhali abhaliswe ukubulala izinhlobo ezithile zezihlahla? Nini kufanele amakhemikhali afakwe emhlabathini noma ezihlahleni? Uma uqoqe lonke ulwazi mayelana nezinhlobo zezihlahla ezibeka ingozi kuwe, uzimisele ukuziphatha kahle kulo nyaka ozayo - zilungiselele ukuphumelela kule mpi ngokumelene nalomphikisi wezihlahla!
Ulwazi luthathwe encwadini ebizwa ngokuthi, Isingeniso Sokukhiqiza Ubhontshisi. Zonke izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni lapho zingafaneleki khona zingabizwa ngokuthi "izihlahla eziphikisanayo." Izihlahla eziphikisanayo zingumphikisi wabakhiqizi bokudla - ziqhathanisa nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi, ukukhanya kwelanga, nezithako, zenze izinkinga ngesikhathi sokuvuna, zingangcolisa imbewu noma zishintshe umbala wembewu, imbewu yazo ingaba yingozi futhi ilethe ezinye izifo ezibeka ubungozi ezitshalweni ezikhulisiwe. Ngokujwayelekile, izihlahla eziphikisanayo zikhula ngokushesha futhi zikhulisa imbewu eningi, zikwazi ukusabalala kalula futhi zikhule ngokushesha. Njengomthetho, ziba nezimpande eziqinile futhi zingakhula ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ziyinkinga ukuyilawula, ziqhathanisa ngokuqinile nezinye izitshalo. Zivame ukuvuthwa ngokushesha, ngakho-ke zikhula ngokushesha. Izimpande zeziqholo eziphikisanayo zivame ukungena phansi emhlabathini, zivumela ukuthi zihlale zikhona ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ezikhula minyaka yonke zifaka ukudla kwazo phansi komhlabathi - ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukuhlala zikhona ngesikhathi esinzima. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo zingama ngokushesha phakathi konyaka, noma zingakhula iminyaka emibili, noma zingakhula minyaka yonke futhi zikhulise imbewu minyaka yonke. Kungani kubalulekile ukuphatha (ukubulala) izihlahla eziphikisanayo? Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ziqhathanisa nezitshalo zokudla ngamanzi, izithako, isikhala, nokukhanya kwelanga. Lokhu kudala ubungozi ezitshalo zokudla ngoba kuvimba ukukhula okufanele kwezitshalo futhi kunciphisa umkhiqizo. Lokhu kuqhathanisa kungangcolisa imbewu yokudla, kunciphise umkhiqizo, futhi kuthinte ikhwalithi yembewu yokudla. Ukuncintisana nezihlahla eziphikisanayo kuhluka phakathi kwezitshalo ezahlukene - kungadala ubungozi obuphakathi kuka-10% kuya phezulu kuka-98%. Izihlahla eziphikisanayo ziqala ukuqhathanisa nezinye izitshalo uma izimpande zazo seziqhakazile. Ukuphatha izihlahla eziphikisanayo kuhlose ukuvimbela le mqhudelwano ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke, futhi ukuvimbela izihlahla eziphikisanayo ekukhuleni nasekuphuleni imbewu yazo ezizovuthwa uma ezinye izitshalo zifakwe. Kukhona izindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokuphatha izihlahla eziphikisanayo - ngokomshini (ukuvuna) nangokwenziwa kwezinto. Njengomthetho, ukuvuna kuphela, noma inhlanganisela yokuvuna nokufaka ama-herbicides kungaba yindlela eshibhile. Ukukhetha indlela kusezandleni zomlimi, ukukhetha kwabo, ulwazi, kanye namandla okuthola abasebenzi, imishini, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokufaka nokuphuma. Ukuphathwa kwezihlahla eziphikisanayo kufanele kwenzeke njalo uma kuqala ukulima, uma prepariwa izinkambu zokufaka, ngesikhathi sokufaka, nangesikhathi izitshalo zikhula. Ngale ndlela, izihlahla eziphikisanayo zihlala zisetshenziswa ngokomshini ukuvimbela imbewu yazo ekufakweni. Lokhu kungenzeka ngaphambi kokufaka (inkambu kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile) futhi ekuqaleni kokukhula kwezitshalo. Kubalulekile ukubulala izitshalo eziphikisanayo uma zincane ukuze zingakwazi ukuqhathanisa nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi, futhi izimpande zezithako zokudla azizukulimala kalula uma nazo zincane. Uma izitshalo eziphikisanayo zinezimpande eziqinile, ukuvuna kuzokwazi futhi ukulimaza izimpande zezithako zokudla. Kukhona amakhemikhali ahlukaniseka ngamanzi, ama-granular, kanye nezinye izihlahla eziphikisanayo ezingekho emoyeni ezisetshenziselwa ukubulala izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi inani le-herbicide elisetshenzisiwe libe nekhwalithi futhi isikhathi sokufaka sibalulekile. Lezi zinto zingahlukaniswa ngezinhlobo ezimbili: ukukhetha nokungakhethi. Lezo ezingakhethi zibulala zonke izitshalo ezithintana nazo, kanti lezo ezikhethiweyo zibulala kuphela izihlahla ezithile, zishiya izitshalo zokudla zingalimali. Lezo ezingakhethi zingafakwa phakathi kwemigqa yezitshalo ukuze zibulale izihlahla eziphikisanayo lapho kodwa azithinti izitshalo zokudla. Ama-herbicides asebenza ngezindlela ezimbili - eyodwa isebenza ngokuxhumana nezihlahla eziphikisanayo, enye isebenza ngokungena ohlelweni lokukhula kwezitshalo. I-herbicide yokuxhumana ibulala amaqabunga, ngakho-ke izihlahla eziphikisanayo kufanele zibe namanzi amahle nge-herbicide. Le herbicide ivame ukusebenza kahle uma izitshalo zincane. I-systemic iyahamba ngaphakathi kwezitshalo, ingafakwa kumaqabunga kodwa izobulala nezimpande. Kukhona nezinye izinhlobo zama-herbicides - ama-herbicides aphambi kokuvuthwa (afakwa ngaphambi kokuthi isitshalo sikhule) kanye nama-herbicides emva kokuvuthwa (afakwa ngemva kokuthi isitshalo sikhule). Ama-herbicides aphambi kokuvuthwa ahlala emhlabathini futhi athathwa ngezimpande uma isitshalo siqala ukukhula; ama-herbicides emva kokuvuthwa athathwa ngamaqabunga nezitho zezithombo. Ukufaka ama-herbicides kuyashesha uma siwuhlanganisa nokuvuna. Ezinye izinhlobo zama-herbicides zisebenza isikhathi eside, ngakho akudingeki ukuthi ubuyele futhi ubulale izihlahla eziphikisanayo. Uma kunenhlama enkulu futhi izinkambu zimanzi kakhulu, kungaba nzima ukungena enkambini ngetraktori edonsela umshini wokuvuna, kodwa ungakwazi ukungena ngomshini ophonsa i-herbicide. Ukufaka ama-herbicides kuzosebenza kangcono ngaleso sikhathi.
Kunzima ukukholwa ukuthi intengo ye-maize ku-Safex ngoFebhuwari 2007 yayiphansi kuka-R1880 ngotoni uma sicabangela ukuthi yafinyelela ku-R3,460 ngotoni ngoSepthemba 18. Ukuhamba phambili kwentengo kw brought ukukhanya kumakhiqizi be-maize, kodwa iqiniso ukuthi labo abathole inzuzo babe yibo ababe nesigamu sokuvuna sabo sika-2006/2007, noma labo ababe sebenze izivumelwano zesikhathi eside ne-Safex. Ngeshwa, akukho abakhiqizi abakwazi ukugcina futhi bagcine izivuno zabo isikhathi eside emva kokuvuna, ngakho-ke kukhona ingozi yokungatholi intengo enhle. Abakhiqizi bangazibuza ukuthi kuphi ochwepheshe abafanele ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nalolu daba. Kungani abalimi (abakhiqizi) bengatholi imiyalezo eqondile? Lokhu kuyalimaza, kodwa imininingwane etholakalayo ngesikhathi esithile akusiyo into engakusiza ukwenza isinqumo esiqondile mayelana nokumaketha izivuno zakho. Kukhona nezinye izinto ezingaba nomthelela, mhlawumbe isimo sezulu singaba yinto enkulu, esingaholela ekwandeni kwentengo. Ngakho-ke, asikwazi ukusho ngokuqiniseka ukuthi kuzokwenzekani esikhathini esizayo. Ithebula 1 libonisa ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni jikelele kusukela ngo-2005, futhi kukhona umbono ongazelelwe wezintengo ze-maize emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2007 okwehlisiwe ngokusekelwe ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari, konke kuhambisana nezibikezelo ezivela esikhathini esifushane edlule. Ukubikezela okujolile kwe-maize emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2007 kubonisa inani elingafinyelela ku-623.7 million tons, njengoba bekukholelwa ukuthi kunezindawo eziningi ezintsha ezitshalwe. Uma le mibono iqinile, lokho kuzophakamisa ukuthi kuzoba ne-33.5 million tons (6.7%) ye-maize ethengisiwe ngo-2006. Emhlabeni jikelele, ukusetshenziswa kwe-maize kungaba cishe ku-620 million tons, okusho ukuthi kuzoba ne-maize eyanele kuzo zonke izindawo ezidingayo. Ithebula 1: Ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni (million tons). Umthombo: International Grain Board. Ngenxa yezimo zezulu ezingalindelekile, amazwe ahlukene akhiqiza i-maize wehlise izibikezelo zawo mayelana nenani lokukhiqiza ngonyaka ka-2007 njalo, futhi ekupheleni kukaSepthemba 07, ukubikezela kokukhiqiza kufinyelele ku-601.4 million tons. Lokhu kube ukwehla kwe-22.3 million tons kusukela ezibalweni zangoFebhuwari 2007 - lokhu kuholele ekwandeni okungazelelwe kwezintengo ze-maize emhlabeni. Umthombo (lapho sithole khona: International Grain Board, Safex kanye nedatha ye-Grain SA). Intengo ye-maize e-Argentina yayingu-$177/ton ngoFebhuwari 07 yabe isanda kwanda yaba ngu-$355/ton (I-Grafu 1). Lokhu kusho ukuthi yanda ngo-$158/ton noma u-89%. Lokhu kwenzeka ngaphandle kokwanda kokukhiqiza okwakuphakeme kunezibalo zangoFebhuwari. Intengo ebizwa ngokuthi "free-on-board" ye-USA Hard Red evela eGulf nayo yenza okufanayo ngaphandle kokwanda kokukhiqiza kwe-maize okungama-1.5 tons eMelika kusukela ekupheleni kukaFebhuwari (Ithebula 1). Ngenxa yesimo sezulu esibi e-Australia, eCanada, nase-European Union, izivuno zehla kakhulu - lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kwentengo ye-maize emhlabeni ngo-2007 - futhi lokhu kuphakamisa izintengo ze-maize emhlabeni. I-Grafu 1 ibonisa intengo ye-Safex (ngenyanga eseduze), ku-$ / ton kulandela intengo yomhlaba ngo-2007. Kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2007, intengo ye-Safex yanda ngo-$200/ton, uma kuqhathaniswa nokwanda kwentengo ka-$158/ton e-Argentina, kanye nokwanda kwentengo ka-$143/ton ye-USA Hard Red. Ukwanda okukhulu kwentengo ye-maize lapha uma kuqhathaniswa nemakethe yomhlaba kwenzeka ikakhulu ngenxa yokwanda kwezindleko zokuhamba i-maize lapha ngempahla. NgoFebhuwari 2007, bekukhokhwa u-$43/ton ukuze kuthunyelwe i-maize e-Argentina, futhi u-$48/ton ukuze kuthunyelwe eGulf. Kwakukhona futhi isidingo esikhulu sezikebhe ezithutha i-maize, okwaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko zokuhamba kabili. Okwamanje, kukhokhwa u-$73/ton ukuthumela i-maize e-Argentina, kanye no-$88/ton ukuthumela i-maize ezikhumulweni zeGulf ukuya lapha (I-Grafu 2). Ngentengo yokushintshanisa ka-R6.85/$, lokhu kusho ukuthi ukwanda kwezindleko zokuhamba kusukela ngoFebhuwari 2007 sekuhlinzeke u-R219/ton. Umthombo: International Grain Board. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-maize emhlabeni kulindeleke ukuthi kwehle, okwaholela ekwandeni kwezintengo ze-maize emhlabeni, futhi ngenxa yesidingo lapha eNingizimu Afrika, sidinga ukungenisa ingxenye yesithathu ye-maize edliwayo/eyidingekayo, ukwanda kwezintengo zomhlaba kuphinde kwaholela ekwandeni kwezintengo lapha. Ukwanda kwezindleko zokuhamba i-maize evela phesheya kuphinde kwapressha izintengo zendawo. Ukwanda kwezintengo ze-maize emhlabeni kuphinde kwaveza ukuthi izimo zezulu zinefuthe elikhulu uma sibheka imakethe yokudla evela kwezolimo. Siyazi kahle ukuthi asikwazi ukuqonda ukuthi imvelo noma isimo sezulu sizokwenzenjani.
Isithombe: U-Hlangabeza kanye neqembu elivela eBothaville nehlelo leGrain SA lokuthuthukisa abalimi: Kusukela kwesokunxele kuya kwesokudla uJane McPherson (umphathi wohlelo), uWillie Kotzé (umqondisi wezoktraining nolwazi), uDebbie Nel (ukwesekwa ehhovisi), uJenny Mathews (ikomidi lokuphatha: Grain SA), noNico Vermaak (umphathi: Izinsizakalo Zenkampani, Grain SA). Sifinyelele ekupheleni konyaka omunye wokuxhaswa kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho kohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa KweBalimi. Njengoba kwenzeka kwenye indawo ethuthukayo, intuthuko kwesinye isikhathi ibonakala ihamba kancane - abanye abantu bafunda ngokushesha kodwa abanye bathatha isikhathi ukuze bajolise ezintweni ezintsha zokusebenza ukuze sifinyelele endaweni lapho singathi sithuthuka. Kulo hlelo, sisebenza kanzima ukuthatha abalimi abakhona okwamanje esimweni (esingafani kubo bonke) bese sibabeka esimweni esidingekayo lapho bengathi ngiyabalimi bezomnotho, ngimiqondiso futhi ngizokwenza umsebenzi wami wezolimo. Imisebenzi ngaphakathi kwalolu hlelo ihlose ukuxazulula izidingo zabalingani abahlukene. Lolu hlelo lusaphathwa eBothaville. Ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo somsebenzi seGrain SA, uhlelo luhlanganiswa ngaphansi kwesigaba seZinsizakalo Zenkampani esiphethwe nguMnu. Nico Vermaak. Ihlobo elidlule lidlule kube nzima kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemvula ezindaweni eziningi ngesikhathi sehlobo - kukhona abalimi abahluleka ukutshala, abanye batshala kodwa bangatholi umkhiqizo, kanti ezinye izindawo zithole imvula ejwayelekile. Njalo abalimi batshala ngemali ebolekiwe - baphokophela ezibankini noma emabhizinisini aboleka imali yokulima (noma ama-Co-ops amadala) - futhi abambalwa bathatha umshwalense ukuvikela inani lemali abakhokhela ukuze baqale ngoba inzuzo iphansi futhi abafuni ukufaka izindleko ezengeziwe. Ngonyaka onjengalowo, kukhona abalimi abathile abahluleka ukukhokha izindleko zabo zokukhiqiza, ngalokho bahluleka ukuthola imali yokutshalwa kabusha. Uma sisebenza nabalimi abasha abangenayo imali ebekiwe, unyaka odlule ubeka ingozi enkulu engavimbela intuthuko yesikhathi esizayo ekwakheni abalimi bezomnotho. Uhlelo lwethu lwezinga eliphezulu lwebalimi luhamba kahle futhi sesethule abalimi abakhethiwe kuhlu lwethu lweMfundo Yezolimo. Sibona ukwethulwa kwalolu suku nomsebenzi olandelayo njengokuphetha kohlelo oluzosiza umbalimi ukuba abe umbalimi ongenza imali. Le nkambo ihlanganisa lonke ulwazi olukhona oluvela kwezinye izifundo futhi ihlose ukukhombisa umbalimi izindawo okufanele agxile ekuthuthukiseni, izici ezibalulekile uma efuna ukukhiqiza ukudla ngempumelelo ngesikhathi esifanele nangemikhuba efanele. Uhlelo lwethu lokuqeqesha abalimi lugcwele eminyakeni eminingi - ngezikole ezingaphezu kuka-80 kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2006 kuya kuSepthemba 30, 2007. Lezi zikole zamukelwa kahle, abalimi babuyela futhi bacela ezinye izikole. Lezi zikole ziqhutshelwa kusukela kuFebhuwari kuya kuNovemba ngonyaka - kwesinye isikhathi abalimi babephakathi emasimini abo futhi bengenayo isikhathi sokuhambela izifundo. Ngesikhathi sehlobo, sizama ukuhlela iziboniso zabalimi lapho bezama khona ukwenza umsebenzi wezolimo, futhi simema amalungu ezigaba zokufunda ukuba bahlangane, futhi sizama ukusiza umbalimi ngamunye ngokwehlukana. Siphinde sathola impendulo enhle evela eziphathimandla ezabelana ngolwazi ngokusebenza nezinsizakalo zezolimo futhi silindele ukusiza bona ngonyaka omusha wezomnotho lapho kuzoba nezikole ezengeziwe ezifundisa umsebenzi ophathekayo - ukusebenza emhlabeni ngezandla kube inselelo enkulu kulezi ziphathimandla, behluleka ukukhombisa abalimi ukuthi umsebenzi kufanele wenziwe kahle. Siqhubeka nokusabalalisa ulwazi kuRadio ezindaweni ezine: Lesedi, Motsweding, Ligwalagwala, noUmhlobo Wenene - lokhu kuyindlela enhle yokuxhumana nabalimi - hhayi nje ukudlulisa ulwazi mayelana nobuchwepheshe kodwa futhi ukwazisa abalimi ngemicimbi yalolu hlelo. Pula-Imvula iyaqhubeka - kube yingxenye ebalulekile yalolu hlelo - ngakho sithokozisa le miphumela lapho siyibona iphrintiwe. Kukho abantu abahlukene abasebenza ukuze baqedele lo msebenzi - abanye basebenza ku-GSA, abanye baphuma ku-ARC-GCI ePotchefstroom, abahleli bahlala bejolise ekupheleni komsebenzi wabo ngesikhathi, abanye basebenza ku-Infoworks (labo abahlola ukubhala kwethu nalabo abakhiqiza i-newsletter oyifundayo), abahleli baqhubeka nokusebenza kulokho esikubhalayo nalabo abakhulisa ama-newsletters - bonke basebenza ukuze bakhiqize i-newsletter yethu njalo ngenyanga! Pula-Imvula iyamukelwa kahle kakhulu futhi labo abafunda ngayo bayanda - sesifinyelele ezinkopweni eziyi-16,500 ngenyanga, futhi lokhu kuyakhula. Siphinde sibhale ukubonga kuMaize Trust ngokuxhasa uhlelo lwethu.
Thina, abasebenzi lapha eGrain SA ngohlelo lweMphakathi Wabafuyi, sijabule futhi sinenhlanhla ngoba sikholwa ukuthi lolu hlelo luzoletha ushintsho ekulimaleni eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lweGrain SA Farmer Development lugxile ekuthuthukiseni abafuyi abamnyama ukuze bakhule babe abafuyi abahlakaniphile, abakwazi ukuzimela ngokwezimali, abazophinde baqhubeke esikhathini esizayo. Umsebenzi wokukhiqiza okusanhlamvu, ikakhulukazi kubafuyi, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi njengamanje nasemva. Sibhekene nokwabiwa komhlaba, izinguquko emthethweni wokuba nomhlaba, kumele silwe nokungeniswa kokudla okuvela kwamanye amazwe, ukukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuqala zokulima, silima ezindaweni eziningi ezingatholi imvula, futhi kukhona okukhuluma ngakho okubizwa ngokuthi "ukushisa komhlaba" okuphinde kushintshe isimo sezulu. Ngamafuphi, kunezinkinga eziningi, asikashodi ngazo - njengamanje, sifuna izixazululo, sizidinga! Siphinde sisondele ekupheleni konyaka ophumelelayo kuhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabafama lwe-Grain SA. UJane McPherson noWillie Kotzé, bobabili lapha ehhovisi elikhulu le-Grain SA eBothaville, baphatha uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwabafama. Ezindaweni ezikhulayo lapho kukhona abafama abasha, sisengxenyeni enkulu nezifundo ngoba kuyindlela engcono yokuxhumana nabakhiqizi abaningi. Siphinda sikhumbuze ukubonga kwethu ngesehlakalo esivela kuMaize Trust, esiqhubeka sikhuthaza lolu hlelo - sizozama ngazo zonke izindlela ukuphatha uhlelo ngendlela efanele futhi sixhase abafama ngendlela efanele. Thina, ithimba lokuthuthukiswa, siyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokusebenza nabafama abasha.
Kungani izitshalo ziba nombala ophuzi ngesikhathi sezinsuku ezimanzi zonyaka? Isithombe: Izimo zokuhamba kwamanzi zithinta inqubo yokukhula kwezitshalo eziningi. Umlando wezazi zesiNgisi u-H.G. Willis washilo ukuthi umlando wabantu ungumbono phakathi kokufunda nokuphazamiseka. Mayelana nabakhiqizi bezitshalo ezindaweni ezithola imvula yasehlobo eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi kulabo abasemazweni anomhlabathi owomile, le miphumela iyinto ejwayelekile nsuku zonke. Izindlela zokukhiqiza izitshalo ezindaweni ezingawomile zishintshile ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala okungapheli ngenxa yokushoda kwamanzi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokulungisa ubukhulu bezitshalo, kusetshenziswa amafutha afanele ngokusekelwe ezivunweni ezikhona, kusetshenziswa izindlela zokulima ezigcina amanzi ukuze konyuswe ukungena kwamanzi kancane kancane, kusetshenziswa izinsuku ezifanele zokutshala, nokukhetha ukuhlanganiswa kwezithombo ezingakwazi ukujwayela ukushoda kwamanzi, njll. Lezi zikhumba zifaka ngaphakathi kwethimba lezitshalo ezaziwa njenge-mesophytes, eziphumelela emhlabathini omanzi kodwa opholile. Imizi yazo ilungiswe kahle ukuze ifune amanzi nezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini; isibonelo, imizi yommbila ingangena emhlabathini ngesivinini esingu-24 mm ngosuku, ifinyelela ubukhulu obungama-2 kuya kwama-2.4 amamitha, kuye ngendawo yomhlabathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemizi kungavinjwa kakhulu noma kuphazamiseke ngenxa yemvula eningi, njengoba kwenzeka ngesikhathi salonyaka lapho izitshalo zisetshenziswa ngoDisemba noJanuwari. Imvula eningi emhlabathini owomile izoholela ekutheni amanzi agcwalise ezingeni lapho kuzokwenziwa khona umoya okhona. Inqubo yokuqala ebalulekile yokuphila ezothinteka kabi ukrespiration yemizi; izitshalo zidinga amazinga athile omoya (oksyjeni) emizini yazo. Abacwaningi bakhombisile ezihlolweni zabo ukuthi ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhamba kwamanzi ngokuphelele, ukukhula kwemizi kungama kancane ngemizuzu. Nokho, izitshalo zihluka ekubeni nezinga lokubekezelela ukugcwala kwamanzi endaweni eyodwa. Isibonelo, izitshalo ezithandayo amanzi ezaziwa njenge-hydrophytes (njengommbila) ziqhelile ukuhlala ezimeni zomhlabathi ezimanzi. Nokho, lezi zitshalo zingafa emhlabathini anomoya owanele. Imizi yezitshalo ezingakwazi ukubekezelela izimo zokuhamba kwamanzi, njenge-legumes (izinkwa ezomile, ama-soybeans, njll.), izofa ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuhamba kwamanzi. Izimpawu zokuqala zokulimala kokuhamba kwamanzi zingavela ngemva kwamahora amabili, kuyilapho ukulimala okungaguquki kungavela ngemva kwamahora angama-24, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini ezishisayo. Lapho ukrespiration kwemizi kuphazamisekile, ezinye izisebenzi ezibalulekile zezithombo ezifana nokukhula, ukutholwa kwamanzi, nokumuncwa kwezinto ezidingekayo nazo ziphazamiseka. Naphezu kokuba namanzi amaningi, izitshalo azikwazi ukumunca amanzi nezinto ezidingekayo. Ezinye izimpawu zokukhathazeka kwezithombo ziba sobala, kuye ngezinga lokukhula kwazo. Isibonelo, lapho ukrespiration kwemizi kwehla ngesikhathi sokukhula kommbila, ukutholwa kwamanzi nakho kwehla ngokufanele, okuzothinta ukumuncwa kwezinto ezidingekayo. Isibonakaliso esibonakalayo yisimo sokuphuma kweziphuzo (chlorosis) ngenxa yokwehla kwamazinga e-chlorophyll. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwe-nitrogen ezitshalweni, nakuba i-phosphorus, i-potassium, nezinye izinto zingase zibe nokuntuleka. Kulolu suku, isitshalo sithumele i-nitrogen eziphuzeni ezintsha ezivela ezindala ukuze siqhubeke nokukhula kwaso. Ukuqhubeka kokuhamba kwamanzi kuzoholela ekunciphiseni ukukhula kwezithombo nezokulahlekelwa kokuvuna.

Ngaphezu kwabantu abachazwe kwiMthetho, "umnikazi" ubhekisela kumuntu onomhlaba, ohlelweni lokubambisana, ngaphandle kwendlu enegalari, indawo yokupaka, indlu yokuhlala eyindlala enezidingo zokuhlala, noma isikhala sokugcina, enomnikazi wayo, ibhekwa njengomnikazi wempahla KUPHELA ngokuya ngezicwangciso 7.3 lapha; b umnikazi wezimpahla ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ubhekwa njengomnikazi wempahla KUPHELA ngokuya ngezicwangciso 7.2 no-7. Indlu yokuhlala iyindlu eyingxenye yempahla yokuhlala esetshenziselwa abantu, noma izindlu eziningi ezinjalo endaweni lapha ayikhulumi indawo lapho okungaphezu kwesithathu sebenzisa okuthile ngaphandle kokuhlala, noma ihhotela, indawo yokuhlala, B&B, i-guest house, noma efanayo eqashwa nsuku zonke. Impahla ekhokha izilinganiso ezikhethekile iyindawo ehleliwe lapho abanikazi bezimpahla ngaphakathi kwayo bevuma ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo ezengeziwe ngaphandle kwalokho okunikezwa yiMasipala. INANI LEZILINGANISO OKUFANELE UKUKHOKHWA IMasipala izonquma ububanzi bezilinganiso kuzo zonke izigaba zomhlaba ngokwesivumelwano njengengxenye ye-bhajethi yonyaka. IMasipala kumele iqoqe izilinganiso ngezinkokhelo ezifanayo zenyanga zenyanga ezingu-12 kanye nanoma yiziphi ezingeziwe. IMasipala ingaqoqe izilinganiso minyaka yonke kubanikazi abanama-akhawunti ezilinganiso angama-50 noma ngaphezulu uma bephakamisile. IMasipala ingakhokhisa minyaka yonke izilinganiso emhlabeni wombuso kanye nomhlaba wesifunda. IMasipala ingashicilela izinguquko eziningi ohlwini lwezilinganiso ezengeziwe phakathi nonyaka ngokweSigaba 78 se-MPRA. Izilinganiso zizokhokhwa ngokusekelwe ohlwini olushintshiwe lwezilinganiso ezengeziwe. Izigaba zezimali zihlukaniswa ngokuya ngokuthi le mpahla isetshenziswa kanjani, futhi izilinganiso zinqunywa ngokuthi le mpahla isetshenziswa kanjani. IMasipala ingase iphazamise umthwalo wokukhokha, inciphise noma yehlise inani elikhokhiswa ngezizathu ezithile zabanikazi, ngokuya ngesimo sendawo. IMasipala ingase futhi yehlise ngelinye izilinganiso ezengeziwe inani lendawo ngokuya ngesinqumo seBhodi kwi-bhajethi yalo yonyaka. Le nqubo yokwehliswa ibhekwa ikakhulu kulabo abantu abanempahla enenani eliphansi futhi iyingxenye yesu leMasipala lokunciphisa umthwalo kubantu abampofu. Inhloso yale nqubo yokukhululeka ekukhokheni ukunciphisa umthwalo kubantu abadala abakhungathekile ngokwezimali futhi kungenzeka bangabi namandla. Eminyakeni emibili edlule, bonke abantu abadala bakhululwe emthwalweni wokukhokha ukuze babasize ekubhekaneni nomthwalo wentela odalwe yi-MPRA. Ngokwezibalo ezitholakele, kubonakala ukuthi abantu abadala abanempahla enenani elingaphansi kwezigidi eziyisithupha rand banesidingo esikhulu sokusizwa. ISIGABA 7: UKUQEDILELA AMAFAKU WOKUBHALISWA INGCEBO 2 Ingxenye 2 yamaFomu... Isigaba 2 Ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi Inqubo yokubhaliswa: Kungani, ubani, kanjani, nini. Ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi kucaciswa nguSigaba 26 © noSigaba 34 weMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi abasebenzisi bamanzi badinga ukubhalisela ukusebenzisa amanzi kule Ndaba. Ukuze kulawulwe futhi kulawulwe izinsiza zamanzi ukuze kuhlelwe kahle futhi kuthuthukiswe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kwamanzi kubasebenzisi bamanzi. Ukubhaliswa kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuthola izindleko ezifanele nezichanekile zokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele. Imali eqoqwe lapha izosetshenziselwa ukufezekisa lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukubhaliswa akusizi kuphela abasebenzisi bamanzi kodwa kuzophinde kusebenzele izwe lonke. iNingizimu Afrika ingelinye lamazwe anezinsiza zamanzi ezinganele. Siseduze kokubizwa emhlabeni jikelele ngokuthi "izwe elinamanzi anqabile." Ukuhlola kukhombisa ukuthi zonke izinsiza zamanzi ezintsha zizokwenziwa phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 kuya kwengu-30 ezayo, kuye ngokukhula komnotho. Ukuhlukumezeka kwezinsiza zamanzi ezintsha ngenxa yokungcoliswa kunganciphisa inani lamanzi angasetshenziswa. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo kanye nokonakaliswa kwemvelo. Ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza zamanzi nokuhlinzeka ngekusasa kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi sinamanzi amangaki okwamanje, ubani osebenzisa wona, nokuthi kuphi. Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kubhalwe kuSheduli 1 yeMthetho (buka Isigaba 4). Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kungahlanganisiwe ezidingweni zokubhaliswa ngokuhambisana nesaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kweNqubomgomo Yokubhaliswa noma ngaphansi kweMvume Ejwayelekile (buka Isigaba 4). Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kungxenye yosizo olunikezwa yilabo abahlinzeka ngamanzi njengohulumeni bendawo (Izindawo) noma iBhodi Yamanzi. Isibonelo salokhu yamanzi nokuphuma kwamanzi ezindaweni zokuhlala eziphathwa nguMphakathi. Akudingekile ukuthi umndeni ngamunye ubhalise, nokho, uMphakathi kumele ubhalise ukusetshenziswa kwawo kwamanzi. Umuntu ngamunye - njengabalimi, abanikazi bezindawo, noma abaqashi. Imiphakathi - njengamabhizinisi omphakathi, izinhlelo zababalimi bendabuko. Izinkampani namabhizinisi - kuhlanganisa ubudlelwano, izinkampani zomphakathi, izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, izinkampani zangaphandle, ubambiswano, kanye nezinkampani zokubambisana. Abahlinzeki bamanzi, kuhlanganisa iBhodi Yamanzi kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Kusukela ngo-October 8, 1999, bonke abasebenzisi bamanzi abasha kumele babhalise njengoba kuchaziwe kwiMvume Ejwayelekile (buka Isigaba 4). Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le Ndaba izoshicilela Izaziso kuGazethi yoHulumeni enemininingwane yezimo zokuhamba kwemifula nezinqwaba zamanzi noma izindawo zokuhlola amanzi, ibize abasebenzisi bamanzi ukuthi babhalise ukusetshenziswa kwamanje kwamanzi. Lezi Zaziso zizokwenza kube sobala isikhathi lapho abasebenzisi bamanzi kumele babhaliswe. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sitholakala cishe ezinsukwini eziyi-60 kusukela ngosuku lokushicilelwa kweZaziso. Ngemuva kokukhishwa kweZaziso, abasebenzisi bamanzi bazokwaziswa nangeminye imigudu ukuthi kumele babhalise, njengokushicilela izaziso eziphephandabeni noma ukuveza emsakazweni. Ungabaza emahhovisi Amanzi endaweni yakho uma iZaziso yokubhaliswa yale ndawo ikhishwe. Amafomu okubhaliswa atholakala kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi le Ndaba (buka Isigaba 8). Ukuze ubhalise ukusetshenziswa kwakho kwamanzi, thumela ifomu eliphelele kule Ndaba. Ukubhaliswa akungaphikiswa noma kuphumelelwe uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuhlosiwe kufanelekile. Amafomu angaphelele angabuyiselwa kubasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukubhaliswa kuzophakanyiswa kuze kube ifomu libuyiselwa ngemininingwane edingekayo yonke. Lapha uthola incazelo yezisho (nezisho) ezivame ukusetshenziswa kule nqubo yokubhaliswa ukusiza umsebenzisi wamanzi lapho egcwalisa ifomu. Uthola futhi amagama ezobuchwepheshe asetshenziswa engxenyeni 2 yamaFomu. noma ukonakaliswa kwemvelo njengensimbi noma udoti omkhulu ongekho maphakathi. Ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kokuphuma kwamanzi ezinsizeni zamanzi ngenxa yezinqubo zokumbiwa. Noma iyiphi imayini enezinqubo zokukhishwa kwensimbi kuhlanganisa nokuphuma kwedoti. Zonke ezinye izimayini, kuhlanganisa izimayini ezinkulu ezinezingcuphe ezincane ezinsizeni zamanzi, nezimayini ezinezingcuphe eziphansi nezinqubo zokumbiwa ngaphansi. IMIFULA EYINQABA Ukugcina amanzi kuyindlela yokusebenzisa amanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuSigaba 21(b) ngezansi. Ukuphepha emifuleni kulawulwa futhi kuyisahluko 12 seMthetho kanye neNqubomgomo Yokuphepha KweMifula (kuGazethi yoHulumeni No. R1560 edlule ngoJulayi 25, 1986). Ukubhaliswa kwemifula eyinqaba kucaciswa nguSigaba 120 seMthetho. Lezi yimifula enekhono lokugcina ngaphezu kwe-50,000 cubic meters wamanzi enobude bezindonga obungaphezulu kwe-5 meters noma eyamukelwe nguNgqongqoshe njengohlobo lomfula oluyingozi. Umfula noma noma iyiphi isakhiwo esingagcina noma sithwale noma sibe nezinhlaka zamanzi. Imifula yakhiwa emifuleni noma ngabe ayakhiwe ukuze igcine amanzi (ama-weirs). Amanzi anokungcoliswa kwasekhaya avela emathunjini omndeni abangelwa uma kuhlanzwa izingubo, kuhlanzwa imizimba, nasemathoyilethi. IMITHOMBO YOKUNGCOLISA Ukuphuma kwedoti ngendlela engaphazamisa insiza yamanzi kuyindlela yokusebenzisa amanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuSigaba 21(g) ngaphansi kwezincazelo zokusebenzisa amanzi ngezansi. Izindawo lapho kudotiwe khona kufanele futhi zibhaliswe ngaphansi kweSigaba 20 seMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kwezemvelo. Izinhlobo zokungcoliswa ezingekho emthethweni azidingi ukubhaliswa njengama-sitsha edoti nezindawo lapho izimayini zikhupha khona udoti. Lezi zinhlobo azidingi ukubhaliswa
Abameleli kumele balandele imithetho nemigomo kanye nemithetho yeziqu zedolobha futhi bahloniphe umthetho njalo. Ukusungulwa nokubambezeleka kuncike ekungahlangabezweni nezidingo ezidingekayo. Umphakathi ophumayo ubonisa noma yimuphi umuntu oqokwe njengomphakathi ophumayo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokusebenza Kwecala, 1977 Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977, okuhlanganisa imidiya futhi kubhekisela kunoma yimuphi umuntu ophila eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Umthetho Wezakhiwo Zedolobha uhlanganisa noma umphakathi omunye oqokwe ukwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi. Umthetho Wezakhiwo ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezakhiwo Zedolobha ka-1998 Umthetho No. 117 ka-1998. Umthetho Wezinhlelo ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezinhlelo Zedolobha ka-2000 Umthetho No. 32 ka-2000. Ubulili nenombolo - Kunoma yimuphi umthetho, ngaphandle kokuba kube nenhloso ephikisanayo, amagama akhombisa ubulili besilisa ahlanganisa nobulili besifazane, futhi amagama akhombisa inani elilodwa ahlanganisa inani eliningi, futhi amagama akhombisa inani eliningi ahlanganisa inani elilodwa. Noma yisiphi isimemo sokukhuluma nebhodi noma ikomidi lebhodi; kanye nanoma yimuphi umphakathi wedolobha. Noma yisiphi ukuhumusha kwale mithetho nemigomo kumele kwenziwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesiNtu, umthetho kazwelonke, wesifunda, kanye nomthetho wedolobha, kanye nomthetho nokuqonda. Isinqumo somphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nokuhumusha kwale mithetho nemigomo emhlanganweni wekhansela noma ikomidi, ngokusekelwe ezicini 35 no-36, sizoba yisinqumo sokugcina. Ukuhumusha nokunquma komphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nanoma yile mithetho nemigomo kumele kubhalwe emaminitheni emhlanganweni wekhansela noma ikomidi. Umphakathi wedolobha kumele ugcine uhlu lwezinqumo nemibono yezomthetho. Noma yimuphi umphakathi ungacela umphakathi wedolobha, ngokubhala phakathi nezinsuku ezinhlanu zesenzo esithathwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo mayelana nokuhumusha nesinqumo kanye ne-rapothi ye khansela noma ikomidi. Ibhodi noma ikomidi, ngemva kokubheka i-rapothi ngaphansi kwesigaba 3, kumele iqinisekise, ilungise, noma ishintshe isinqumo somphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme mayelana nanoma yiziphi izimfanelo ezingase zithinte noma yiliphi ithathu ngenxa yesinqumo, futhi zonke izinqumo ezithinta amalungelo abanye kumele zibhalwe, futhi izizathu zalezi zinqumo kumele zibhale. Ibhodi kumele libe nemihlangano yebhodi ejwayelekile okungenani kanye njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu. Zonke imihlangano yebhodi kanye naleyo yeziqu kumele ivulelwe umphakathi, futhi ibhodi noma ikomidi lingakhipha umphakathi emhlanganweni, ngaphandle kokuthi ibhodi noma ikomidi, ngenxa yokuthi umqondo ophathelene nendaba ekhuluma ngayo noma uma ukuvezwa kwanoma iyiphi indaba kungaphazamisa izinhloso zedolobha, ibone isizathu esifanele sokwenza njalo ngokuhambisana nezimiso zokuphatha okuvulekile kanye nedemokhrasi. Isinqumo sokungena esivumelwaneni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Noma iyiphi enye indaba ehlinzekwe ngumthetho. Umphakathi wedolobha kumele unikeze isaziso somphakathi, ngendlela evunyelwe yibhodi, ekhombisa isikhathi, usuku, nendawo yazo zonke imihlangano ejwayelekile yebhodi noma ikomidi kanye nanoma yimuphi umhlangano wesikhashana noma ophuthumayo, ngaphandle kokuthi isikhathi asivumeli ukuba kwenzeke njalo. Umphakathi kumele abize imihlangano yebhodi, okungenani izikhathi ezine ngonyaka, "ngokubhalwa kwemihlangano yebhodi" esayiniwe, ekhombisa usuku, indawo, nesikhathi somhlangano kanye noma i-akhawunti yaleso sikhathi esiphakanyisiwe. Futhi ezinsukwini ezimbili zezikhalazo ngaphambi kosuku lomhlangano ophuthumayo, kumele abize umhlangano ophuthumayo. Futhi umthetho 7 (ii) phakathi nesikhathi esingadluli ezinsukwini ezine kusukela ngosuku lapho isicelo samukelwe. Futhi isaziso senzo esisayiniwe; futhi ii isitatimende esibhaliwe ngumphakathi osayine isaziso senzo esinikeza izizathu zokuthi kungani indaba ehleliwe yokukhuluma kulomhlangano ophuthumayo ibalulekile futhi ayikwazi ukulinda umhlangano ojwayelekile. c Ukuhlonishwa okuphelele komthetho 7 3a no-7 3b kuthi umphakathi akavunyelwe ukusebenzisa amandla akhe kodwa kumele abize umhlangano. Kuncike ekutheni leyo mininingwane yokuxhumana kumele ithunyelwe ngumphakathi ngamunye kumphakathi wedolobha phakathi nezinsuku ezimbili ngemuva kokhetho lwabameleli futhi, emva kwalokho, noma nini umphakathi efuna ukushintsha noma iyiphi ikheli futhi lelo kheli kumele kube lapho umphakathi uthola khona imiyalezo futhi ungathola noma yisiphi isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni kanye nanoma iyiphi imihlangano esemthethweni yebhodi. Zonke imibhalo ephathelene nanoma yimuphi umhlangano wekhansela noma ikomidi kumele ihlinzekwe kubo bonke abameleli okungenani ezinsukwini ezinhlanu zikalenda ngaphambi komhlangano ojwayelekile wekhansela noma ikomidi futhi ezinsukwini ezimbili zikalenda ngaphambi komhlangano ophuthumayo wekhansela noma ikomidi ophuthumayo. Bonke abameleli kumele bazi umphakathi nganoma yiziphi izinguquko ezikhelini zabo phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu zokushintsha. Ngokusho komthetho 5 3, isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni kumele sithunyelwe ebhodini lesaziso somphakathi sedolobha. Umphakathi angacela uphenyo mayelana nokungatholi isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni. Ukungatholi isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni ngeke kuphazamise ubungako boma mhlangano noma izinqubo zebhodi noma noma yiziphi zeziqu zayo. b Ngaphansi kwezidingo ezidingekayo zokubamba umhlangano, ukungaphumeleli komphakathi ukuvota ngeke kuvimbe ukuqhubeka komhlangano wekhansela. b Ngaphansi kwezidingo ezidingekayo, ukungaphumeleli komphakathi ukuvota ngeke kuvimbe ukuqhubeka komhlangano wekomidi. Akukho mhlangano ozoba khona uma izidingo ezidingekayo zingekho phakathi kwemizuzu eyishumi nambili yesikhathi esibekwe sokuthi umhlangano uqale, ngaphandle kokuthi abameleli abakhona bavumelane ngokubambisana ukuthi isikhathi kufanele sandiswe kodwa hhayi sibe sikhulu kunezikhathi ezingu-15; uma izidingo ezidingekayo zingahlangabezani, umhlangano kumele uphume. d Uma izidingo ezidingekayo zingahlangabezani ngemuva kokuphuma, umphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme kufanele ngakho-ke uphume umhlangano. Uma umhlangano uphume ngenxa yokungahlangabezani nezidingo ezidingekayo, umhlangano kumele uphinde uqale phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisixhenxe. a uvunyelwe ukuba ungabi khona ngaphansi komthetho 13; noma b lowo mphakathi ucelwa ukuba withdraw ngaphansi komthetho 462; noma c ngokuvuma komphakathi noma umphakathi ophakeme. Umphakathi ngamunye obambe umhlangano wekhansela noma ikomidi kumele signing the attendance register eyenzelwe le njongo. U
Ulimi lwabantu ngandlela-thile "luyisikhumba sesibili," lumele okuthile okungokwemvelo kwabantu, ngalo sikhombisa ithemba nezifiso, sikhuluma ngemibono nemigomo yethu, sihlola ulwazi lwethu namasiko, futhi sakhe imiphakathi yethu nemithetho yokuphatha. Ngolimi, singasebenza njengabantu emhlabeni oshintsha njalo. Ilungelo lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ozikhethayo liyaqashelwa yiBill of Rights kanye neSikhumbuzo sethu, esiqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi zabantu bethu ziyinsiza okufanele isetshenziswe. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuthi, ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eqotho, ekugcineni sikwazi ukwethula uhlaka lwezinhlelo zolimi lweNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuwukuphela komsebenzi oqale ngo-1995, lapho ngathumela iLanguage Planning Working Group (LANGTAG) ukuba iphakamise uhlaka oluhlangene lwezinhlelo zolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sasisibalulekile ngenxa yokungabi khona kokuphikiswa kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi kanye nomphumela wokuthi "ukusebenza kwe-multilingualism kuyindaba yokukhokha" njengoba kubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu, kanye nezikhalazo ezikhulayo ezivela kubanikazi bezilimi mayelana nokubusa kolimi olulodwa eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lweZinhlelo Zolimi Zesizwe lusekelwe emiphumeleni yezindlela zokubambisana ngokubonisana, lusebenzisa kokubili iLANGTAG kanye nezinsiza zeMnyango ngokuhlanganyela neLanguage Policy Advisory Group. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo luyadingeka ekuphatheni izinsiza zethu ezihlukahlukene zolimi nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kukahulumeni ezinjongo zokukhuthaza ubulungiswa, ubulungiswa, ukulingana, kanye nokuhlangana kwesizwe. Kungalesi simo esihle ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zelizwe lethu, njengoba kuhlelwe nguMthethosisekelo, kube nendawo ebonakalayo kulolu hlelo. Lolu Hlelo lweZinhlelo luphinde luphakamise ukuthi ukubaluleka kwezilimi zethu kubonakala kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwazo komnotho, kwezokuxhumana, nasezombusazwe. Uma ulimi lulahlekelwa ukubaluleka kulezi zimo, isimo salo siyehla. Uhlaka lwezinhlelo luphinde lukhombise ukuthi sibhekene nezinselelo zokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele nokuthi izilimi zethu zomdabu kumele zibe yingxenye ye-technology eshintshashintshayo. Ngakho-ke, kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi sizobuyisela isimo nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngiyethemba ngokuhlonipha ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokwamukela lolu Hlelo lweZinhlelo Zolimi Zesizwe njengelabo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ngokubambisana, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi lolu hlelo luba yimpumelelo ezimpilweni zethu, futhi lusenze siqhenye ngempilo yethu ehlukile yaseNingizimu Afrika. SAQA Ibhodi Yezifundo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona cishe izilimi eziyi-25 ezahlukene ezikhuluma eNingizimu Afrika, ezifaka phakathi izilimi eziyi-11 ezinikwa isimo esisemthethweni ngokulandela isigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996), ngokusekelwe kumfuneko yokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwazo kufanele kube ngu-98% wabantu bonke. Izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni ziyi-isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, kanye ne-siSwati (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeNguni); Sesotho, Sepedi, kanye neSetswana (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeSotho); isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiNgisi, kanye ne-Afrikaans. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinokwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi. Isici esivelele sokwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izilimi eziningi zomdabu zidlula imingcele yezifunda, zikhuluma phakathi kwemiphakathi yalolu limi ezindaweni ezahlukene, okukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezazihlonishwayo ngaphambili futhi kukhuthaza ukwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi, uma nje abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bekhululekile ukusekela izilimi ezingezona ezomdabu njengokubalulekile, okuyizilimi ezisemthethweni zalesi sikhungo. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi eNingizimu Afrika bekukade kunzima ngenxa yokungabi khona kohlelo olucacile lwezilimi, okuholele ekusetshenzisweni kwesiNgisi nesi-Afrikaans njengezilimi ezibusayo ezithinta izici zokuxhumana, umnotho, nezombusazwe zomphakathi wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili kuhulumeni wenhlalakahle, INingizimu Afrika ifinyelele endaweni ebalulekile emlandweni wayo. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baphendule ekwehlukeni kwabo kolimi nasemasikweni kanye nezinselelo zokwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi, yingakho uHlelo lweZinhlelo Zolimi Zesizwe lwenziwa. Lolu Hlelo lweZinhlelo aluqali nje indlela entsha yokubhekana nezilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika kodwa futhi lukhuthaza kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu njengezilimi ezisemthethweni ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuqhubeke nokwakha ubunye bezwe. Luhlinzeka ngokuqashelwa okubanzi kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi, ubulungiswa bezokuxhumana, ukufinyelela okufanele ezinhlelweni nasemithonjeni yomphakathi, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Le ndatshana ibeka uhlaka olungasetshenziswa yinhlangano ehlangene yokwenziwa kwezilimi ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeMthethosisekelo. Kusukela ekuqaleni kokuhlala kwabantu baseDutch eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1652, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kwezimpi zokubusa kweBrithani, i-Union of South Africa, kanye nohulumeni wobandlululo, kuze kube sekuphumeleleni kukahulumeni wenhlalakahle ngo-1994 nokufakwa kokwenziwa kwezilimi eziningi emthethweni, uhlelo lwezilimi lukahulumeni kanye namandla eziphathimandla alwehluleka ukuqashelwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela wale simo kube ukungalingani, lapho ukuphathwa kwesiNgisi nesi-Afrikaans kudala ubudlelwano obungalingani phakathi kwezilimi zabo zomdabu kanye nalezi zilimi. Ngakho-ke, izinqubomgomo zolimi zobandlululo nezobandlululo, ezihlanganiswe nezinqubomgomo zomphakathi, umnotho, nezombusazwe, zaveza ubusuku bezilimi, ukungalingani okukhombisa izakhiwo zobuhlanga nezokuhlukaniswa okwakha umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke lezi zimo zehlisa isimo sezilimi zomdabu nezinhlelo zezilimi zabantu bomdabu nezinye izigaba ezaziphikisiwe, kuhlanganisa neKhoi neSan - kuqhubeka nemibono emibi ngezilimi ezimnyama, okungagwenywa kuphela ngabakhuluma isi-Afrikaans nesiNgisi, kodwa futhi ngabanye abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu uqobo. Lesi simo siba sibi kakhulu ngenxa yokuthi, ngenxa yezizathu ezingacacile nezimpi zamandla eziphikisa ukufakwa kwezilimi eziningi, uhulumeni nezikhungo ezizimele zine ndlela ethile yokwenza izinqumo zolimi eziphikisana nezingxenye zomthethosisekelo kanye nezidingo ezihambisana nezilimi. Isigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo sinikeza uhlaka olusemthethweni oluphezulu lwezilimi eziningi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuhlonishwa nokubekezela kwezinhlobonhlobo zolimi eNingizimu Afrika. Idokhumenti losizo elivela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini linikeza amakhasimende awo ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi okulindelwe umphakathi mayelana nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo kuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Umphakathi uyazi ukuthi angaxhumana kanjani neMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini. Indlela yokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende isekelwe ekukhetheni ukuhambisana nezindinganiso zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo ezishicilelwe ngenkathi kuhambisana namalungelo amakhasimende. IMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini izokweseka futhi ikusize njengamakhasimende ethu, izinga lenkonzo ongakulindela njengamakhasimende ethu, indlela ongasisiza ngayo ukuthi sikuhlinzekele kangcono, nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani iziphakamiso zokuthuthukiswa, kanye neziteshi ongazilandela njengamakhasimende uma ufisa ukuveza ukwaneliseka kwakho ngezinga lethu lenkonzo. Zonke ofisi zikhomba lapho izindaba ezihlobene namanzi ziphathwa khona. Ukulethwa kwamanzi aphakanyisiwe kuza ngqo emakhaya ukusuka kumapayipi omasipala. Amalitri angama-200 wamanzi ngosuku atholakala emtankini ophansi ogcwalisa nsuku zonke - kulingana namalitri angama-6,000 wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga. Amathaphu emigwaqo afakwe ezindaweni zomphakathi ezithintekile okwethula isikhathi esithile. Amathangi amanzi afinyelela lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okukhulu. Uhlanga lwezinkalanga luthuthwa ngepayipi ejwayelekile usebenzisa amanzi - xhumana nezinsiza zokuhlanza. Ukulethwa kwezingcindezi ngepayipi usebenzisa amanzi kudluliselwa emgqonyeni - ithangi elingaphansi komhlaba elihlobene nalo. Lapho amanzi esetshenziswa, kudluliselwa emgqonyeni lapho imoto izofika khona ukuze igcwalise ithangi layo futhi ithwale izingcindezi kwenye indawo. Bonke amakhasimende athola ama-kilolitri ayisithupha okuqala kwamanzi mahhala ngenyanga, nezindleko zikhula kulabo abakhasimende abathola amanzi aphakanyisiwe noma aphansi, nezindleko eziyisisekelo kulabo abakhasimende abathola amanzi aphakanyisiwe abasebenzisa ngaphezu kwama-kilolitri ayisithupha ngenyanga futhi behlala ezindaweni ezibiza ngaphezu kwe-R40,000 ngokwezinhlelo zomphakathi. Noma yimuphi umthengi onenani lempahla elingaphansi kwe-R36,000 ngokwezinhlelo zomphakathi futhi ongakhokhi ukuthuthwa kwezingcindezi uzothola le sevisi mahhala. Noma iyiphi ithoyilethi ye-VIP ihlinzekwa mahhala iminyaka emihlanu. Ukuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngemininingwane ye-GIS, izithombe zomoya, izikhalazo, nezinye izibalo... I-A4 nayo iyamahhala. Ukwamukela/Ukudlulisela kwezinhlelo zokwakha mayelana nokuthuthwa kwezingcindezi. Izindaba eziphuthumayo zixazululwa phakathi kwamahora amane.
Mphakathi weGu District Municipality, uMphakathi S.B. Kuyajabula kakhulu ukuba sithintane nomphakathi wethu lapha eSimahla, ngesikhathi lesi senzakalo esibalulekile esihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu ngokwakha izindlu. NgokweZulu, sithi akukho mthunzi wesihlahla, okukhombisa kahle ukubaluleka nokubaluleka kokuba nekhaya. Ungaya noma kuphi, kodwa ekugcineni kufanele ubuyele ekhaya. Ikhaya liyisisekelo sempilo yomuntu. Namuhla sikhona ukuze sithathe umsebenzi obalulekile wokuhlinzeka umphakathi wethu ngezindlu ezizoba yisisekelo sezindlu zabantu bethu lapha. Lapho umuntu esekhaya, kufanele azizwe ephephile futhi ekhululekile, hhayi esaba. Inkinga emiphakathini yethu ekhaya yisimo sezindlu lapho abantu bethu bahlala khona. Ngenxa yokunganaki kukahulumeni we-apartheid, abantu bethu ekhaya baye bazama ukwakha izindlu zabo, eziningi zazo zingezingeni eliphansi. Inselelo ebhekene nemiphakathi yethu ekhaya ukuthi ngesikhathi sezimo ezimbi, izindlu ezikhona zihluleka ukumelana nezimo ezinzima. Njengoba kunjalo, imiphakathi yethu ishiywe ibuthakathaka, isaba ukuphila kwabo. Ikhaya liyikhaya uma kukhona indlu ephephile; asifuni abantu bethu bahlale besaba ngalokho okungase kwenzeke noma nini uma izimo zishintsha ngoba bahlala ezindlini ezinganele. Umphakathi wephrojekthi, umnyango wethu uqale umkhankaso wokubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekile kakhulu nguhulumeni we-apartheid ngokubahlinzeka ngezindlu. Namuhla sijabule kakhulu ukuthi umkhankaso wethu wokwakha izindlu zomphakathi wethu ekhaya ufike kule ndawo lapha eSimahla. Sisebenza kanzima ukuze sisheshise ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlu zabantu bethu ekhaya ngoba sifuna ukubuyisela isithunzi sabo esathathwa nguhulumeni we-apartheid. Ukubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bethu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele abe nendlu esimweni efanele. Akekho okufanele aphile esaba ngesikhathi esekhaya. Ngaphambi kokuthi uhulumeni wethu wamanje we-democratic ufinyelele emandleni, bekungathi kuyiphupho kubantu ukuba bakhiwe izindlu ekhaya. Umbono wethu njengohulumeni uwukubona yonke imiphakathi iphila izimpilo ezingcono ngendlela efanele. Sigcizelela ezinhlelweni zethu ukuthi abantu bethu kufanele bakhiwe izindlu ezindaweni eziseduze namadolobha, kanye nasezindaweni zasemaphandleni; sifuna abantu bethu baphile izimpilo ezifanayo nezabanye abantu, ngezindlu ezinhle, ugesi, nezindlela. Njengohulumeni wabantu, asikholelwa ukuthi ukuze abantu bethu bafeze ukuthuthukiswa, kufanele baphume emadolobheni; sifuna abantu bethu bafeze ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni abahlala kuzo ngaphandle kokuphazamisa indlela yabo yokuphila. Ukuhamba kancane kokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kule municipality kusemthethweni ngenxa yokuthi izindawo eziningi lapho abantu bethu bahlala khona lapha zashiywa ngaphandle kohlelo lokuthuthukiswa. Inselelo yethu njengomnyango wukushintsha lesi simo. Isivinini esihlinzekwa imiphakathi yethu ekhaya ngezindlu senze uhulumeni kumazinga omhlaba wonke nendawo uqaphele ukuthi imali esetshenziswa umnyango wethu ekwakheni izindlu zabantu bethu kufanele wandiswe. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukufinyelela ngokushesha kwezinye izindawo esingakazifinyeleli. Manje sizokwazi ukusheshisa uhlelo lwethu ukuze sithinte ngqo ukususa izindawo eziphithizelayo nokwakha izindlu zabantu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ezifana nalezi, sibuye sithuthukise isithunzi sabantu bethu ezindlini zokuhlala. Umnyango wezokwakha uyazi ukuthi umsebenzi obhekene ne-municipality ukuze usheshise ukuthuthukiswa ubunzima. Nokho, sikhuthaza ama-municipalities ukuthi afake izicelo kumnyango ukuze lezi zinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo kwezinye izindawo. Abantu ezindaweni zasemaphandleni bangabantu abahlala kancane ekuthuthukisweni. Sifuna abantu bethu eThoyana, eMaphumulo, nakwezinye izindawo nabo benze izinzuzo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu; ngiyazi ukuthi kunezinye izinhlelo umnyango owenza ukuze uqhakambise umphakathi kulezi zindawo. Njengomnyango, sihamba yonke iKwaZulu-Natal ukuze sikhombise amaphrojekthi ezindaweni ezifana nalezi. Lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi uhulumeni wamanje uzibophezele ekuthinteni ngqo izidingo zabantu. Izindlu esizethulayo namuhla zizohlangabezana nesivumelwano phakathi kukahulumeni nabantu sokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, futhi sizibophezele kulokhu. Njengohulumeni wabantu, sizigqaja ngokuba uhulumeni wokuqala kuleli elingakwazi ukwakha izindlu emiphakathini eyakhelwe oMnumzane. Izinhlanga ezahlukene ngaleso sikhathi zazisebenzisa umthetho ukuze zakhe izindlu zomphakathi wazo. Kwakungekho msebenzi wokwakha izindlu zomphakathi eyakhelwe oMnumzane. Abaningi baye bavuma ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa ngeke kufike kulezi zindawo. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi abantu basemaphandleni babone izindlu ezinhle zihlala ezinye izinhlanga abahlala nazo. Umlando ukhombisa kahle ukuthi ngisho nabathuthukisi abakhulu ababephakathi kukahulumeni bangaphambilini bavuma ukuthi izindlu zasemaphandleni azikwazi ukwenza lutho. Kubalulekile ukuthi sazi lo mlando ngoba ukuze siqonde lapho siya khona, kufanele sazi lapho sihamba khona futhi siqonde izinselelo esibhekene nazo njengohulumeni wabantu. Ngenxa yokunganaki izidingo zabantu bethu, kudingeka siqale kabusha ngokwakha imithetho emisha nemigomo emisha ukuze sikwazi ukwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabantu bethu. Kukhona izinhlelo eziningi esihlela ukuhlinzeka imiphakathi ngentuthuko yezindlu kule ndawo. Kubalulekile kimi ukuchaza emphakathini izinyathelo esizithathayo uma sithumele uhlelo olukhulu kangaka njengalolu lwamuhla. Siyazi ukuthi izinkinga esinazo ekuthuthukisweni ziwumphumela wemithetho ye-apartheid. Ngamanye amazwi, umphakathi wonke lapha awunalo ilungelo lokuba ezindaweni ezithuthukisiwe. Imigomo nemithetho emisha esiyenzile njengohulumeni wabantu iphelisile lokho. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lokhu akuphindi kwenzeke, sisebenza nama-municipalities ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha zibe ngaphansi kohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwe-municipal. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sifuna ukubona yonke intuthuko ehleliwe. Ngamanye amazwi, sifuna ukubona izindlu kanye nohlu lonke lokuthuthukiswa oludingekayo ngabantu abazokwakha lezi zindlu, kuhlanganise nezinye izidingo zomphakathi. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazothola ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuphila. Uma izindlu zakhiwe ngaphandle kokucabangela ezinye izigaba nezinye izindawo zokuthuthukiswa, lezi zindlu ngeke zibe yizindlu ezifudumele. Ikhaya liyikhaya uma izidingo zabantu abahlala kuyo zicatshangelwa. Umuntu ongakaze azwe ubuhlungu bokungabi nekhaya angase athathe kalula ukubaluleka kosuku olunjengalolu. Kodwa thina esazi usizi nobuhlungu bokungabi nezindlu sizokwazi ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwalesi sikhathi ezimpilweni zabantu bethu lapha eSimahla namuhla. Umphakathi wephrojekthi, izindawo zasemaphandleni ziseduze kakhulu enhliziyweni yami. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ngiyaphikisa kakhulu ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa
Ngesikhathi esashona, sazi ukuthi uMama Adelaide Tambo usanda kukhishwa esibhedlela. Nokho, saphinda sagcizelela ukuthi wayenomphefumulo wokubekezela kanye nesifiso esiqinile sokuphila phakathi kwethu. Sihlose ukumamukela yena nomndeni wakhe njengabavakashi emcimbini ngenyanga kaFebhuwari, kodwa lokho akwenziwanga. Kusasa sizokwenza ukuhlonipha kokugcina njengoba simfaka phansi. Ngakho, uzobe ekhona nathi emoyeni ngenyanga kaOkthoba kulo nyaka njengoba sibhiyozela usuku lokuzalwa kukababa wakhe, owayezobe eshaya iminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye, ubaba wezingane zakhe, umngane wakhe, umlingani wakhe, kanye nezingane ezidumile zethu, uOliver Reginald Tambo. Sizophinde sikhulumele umndeni kaTambo. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukumukela uMama ophakanyisiwe uAlbertina Luthuli, okhona phakathi kwethu namuhla ekuseni. Ungdaughter kaChief Albert Luthuli, owayengowokuqala ukuthola iNobel Peace Prize emhlabeni. Ukufa okubuhlungu kukaChief Luthuli, eminyakeni engamashumi amane edlule, kukhunjulwa kulo nyaka, futhi usizi lwaleso sikhathi lwaziswa lapho sathola ukuthi ushaye isitimela emasimini eshukela eKwaDukuza. Ukufa kwakhe bekuyimfihlo futhi kwashaqisa nomzimba, kodwa impilo yakhe ibingumfanekiso omuhle osiholela enkululekweni esiyibhiyozelayo namuhla. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ezimele inombono ocacile wokubonga ngalokho uAlbert Luthuli noOliver Tambo abakwenze ezweni lethu ngokusungula izimiso ezimbili zomphakathi ukuze kuhlonishwe amaqhawe - isimiso sikaLuthuli kanye nesimiso sabangane bakaO. R. Tambo. Ngiyaziqhenya futhi ngalabo abamukelwe kulezi zimiso zomphakathi ezihloniphekile. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukumukela ezindlini zephalamende labo ababe nomsebenzi ngonyaka ka-1956 ngesikhathi omama bephikisa imithetho yokupasa, nalabo ababe khona ngesikhathi uhlelo lwe-apartheid luphikiswa ngonyaka ka-1976, behlezi endaweni elungiselelwe umongameli. Angikhohlwa izindaba ezibuhlungu ezivela ezweni lethu ezivela kuzo zonke izifunda, ezikhethwe ngabakhulumeli bezifunda ukuze zabelane nabavakashi ababalulekile phakathi kwethu. Uhulumeni wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika engikhuluma nabo lapha namuhla, njengoba ngibe nebhadi lokwenza kanjalo eminyakeni edlule, wasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2004 ngemuva kokhetho olwenziwe ngalolo nyaka. Emhlanganweni wonyaka, ngenyanga kaJanuwari, umkhandlu wombuso kazwelonke, ophakeme kakhulu esifundazweni, wathola isikhathi sokucabangela ukuthi imihlangano yawo ibhalile ukuthi manje isesikhathini sokuphathwa kukahulumeni okhethwe ngonyaka ka-2004. Angikhulumi kini ukuthi sithola inhlanhla yokuhola lo mkhandlu. Ekuboniseni lokhu, kubonakala kufanelekile ukuthi sibuze lo mbuzo - ingabe kukhona intuthuko esiyenzile ekulimaleni ukuze sifinyelele imigomo esakhuluma ngayo emphakathini ukuthi sizoyifinyelela ngezithembiso esizenzile, ukuthi abantu bethu basinikeze igunya lokuphatha izwe lethu kusukela ngonyaka ka-2004 kuze kube sekukhethweni okulandelayo ngonyaka ka-2009? Ngemvume yenu, ngithanda ukubuyela emuva futhi ngikhumbuze lokho esikukhulumile ngonyaka ka-2004, njengabaholi benkolo, nangaphambi kwabodadewethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, sahlanganiswa endaweni yokuhlangana kukahulumeni e-Union Building eTshwane ngosuku lokukhululwa, usuku esikhumbula inkululeko yethu eminyakeni eyishumi, futhi saphinde sajoyina isizwe ekubekeni umongameli wokuqala wombuso wokhetho, owasungulwa nguphalamende lwethu, ukuze kuhlonishwe izinterest zomphakathi ezikhonjiswe ekhethweni langonyaka ka-2004. Sekuphele isikhathi eside iNingizimu Afrika yethu ibinayo, futhi iphinde yakhombisa ukuphathwa kabi nangokucindezelayo emphakathini. Iyindawo lapho uthola khona ukuthi uma uzalwa omnyama, uthola isiqalekiso sonke impilo yakho, uma uzalwa omhlophe, uphatha ukwesaba nokuthukuthela okufihlekile... Iyindawo lapho udoti, iphunga lobubha, udoti uhamba ezitaladini, ukuguguleka kwemfucumfucu, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, umhlaba omkhulu ogcwele udoti, le ndawo ibheka phambili futhi ifaka ubuhle kwenye indawo enezindlela eziphambene, nezimbali ezivuthayo ziphazamisa ubuhlalu bokhula obuhlaza, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezifanele amakhosi namakhosikazi, nomculo omuhle nothando. Iyindawo lapho ukuhlala endaweni ethile kuyindlela yokubiza abanye ukuba bakucindezele, noma ukuphendula kumakhelwane, lapho amakhelwane ezocindezelwa ngotshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze bangazweli ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu bayazi ukuthi impilo yabo ngeke ibe yinhle uma kungekho ukubulawa phakathi kwabo, ukuthukwa nempi ezingenangqondo phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo. Iyindawo lapho ibonisa ukuthi uma uhlala ezindaweni ezithile, kuyindlela yokuphila ngokuphepha, ngoba ukuphepha kusho ukuba nezingxenye eziphakeme, izithiyo zikagesi, izinja zokuvikela, amapolisa aqaphelayo, nezinsizwa ezilungele ukuvikela labo ababa bethu nezibhamu, nezibhamu ezifihliwe emathuneni, nezindiza ezizokwehla zifeze labo abaphazamisa abazali... Ikuvuselela ukuthi ukhetho lwethu olwenziwe ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule lunikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuzimisela kwabantu bethu, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, kanye nohlobo lomuntu ukuze basebenzisane ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labantu bonke abafana. Izinkinga eziphuthumayo zokuphila kwabantu ngeke zixazululwe uma singakhethi amathuba emisebenzi, kanye nokunciphisa noma ukususa ubuphofu phakathi kwethu. Lokhu kuhlangana nokuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zabantu, ukunciphisa izinga lobugebengu, ukufundisa abantu ukufunda nokubhala, kanye nokuvula iminyango yokufunda nezindlela zamasiko... sithi kuzo zonke ezinkulu zethu nezingane ezazinikela ekufinyeleleni inkululeko, kanye nabangane bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, ngeke sikhokhele ithemba elibekwe kithi ngenkathi nisekela ukusiguqula iNingizimu Afrika ibe yidemo, umhlaba wokuthula, lapho kungabikho ukuhlukumeza ngokobuhlanga, noma ngokobulili, umhlaba ophumelelayo, ohlangene nezinterest zomphakathi. "Umsebenzi wokwakha le Ningizimu Afrika uqale. Lo msebenzi uzophinde uqhubeke kulesi sikhathi sesibili sokukhululeka kwethu." Emashumini eminyaka angama-50 edlule, ngenkathi silungiselela umhlangano omkhulu wabantu owamukela umqulu wenkululeko, izindaba ezibuhlungu zalolo suku zathi Masikhulume sonke ndawonye, ama-Afrika, labo abavela eYurophu, amaNdiya nabamnyama, bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, masikhulume sonke ndawonye ukuze sikhulume ngenhlalakahle, masikhulume ngenjabulo evela kubantu abaphila ezweni elikhululekile. Namuhla kufanele sikhumbuze isithembiso sethu, kufanele sikhulume ndawonye ngenhlalakahle, kufanele sisebenze emishinini ukuze
Ngiyavuma ngesikhathi sokuhlangana kokugcina kwezomthetho, okukhuluma ngesimo sezwe, ngifisa ukuhamba phambili ngithumele imiyalezo emihle kubalulekile bezomthetho ngonyaka omusha ophumelelayo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi unyaka ka-2008 uzoba yisikhathi esibalulekile kuhulumeni wethu wezwe uma sisebenza ndawonye ukuze sifeze amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Ngiyakhuluma lokhu ngoba, ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwethu, akuvamile ukuthi izwe libizwe ukuthi lidlule emizamweni emikhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe amaphupho abantu. Umlando usibeke kuleli qophelo. Ngikhuluma kini namuhla, Mnumzane Ohloniphekile, phambi kukamama wami owangithola, u-Epainette Mbeki, uMaMofokeng, okhona lapha enomlayezo ocacile wabantu basezindaweni ezisemaphandleni eTranskei lapho ahlala khona iminyaka eminingi. Uthi laba bantu bafuna ukuthi sibeze njengabaholi babo ukuthi ngabe sizimisele yini ukwenza ikusasa libe ngcono kunanamuhla. Ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalombili ezedlule, ngomhla kaFebhuwari 16, umama wami uzogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-92. Iphuzu elilodwa esingamnika lona ngosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa yiqiniso. Ngiyabonga kuye ngokunginika ithuba lokuba nani namuhla, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi ngeke simdumele. Ngithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ukuze ngibingelele uMongameli uNelson Mandela, omunye wabakhi abavelele kuhulumeni wethu wezwe ozogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-90 ngomhla kaJulayi 18 kulo nyaka. Namuhla samukela uMnu. Arthur Margeman omele abakhankaseli bokukhululeka ababe khona ngesikhathi ama-bhasi eqalwa e-Alexandra eminyakeni engu-50 edlule, futhi uNelson Mandela wayekhona kulolo suku. Sibusisiwe ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uMiss Jann Turner, indodakazi kaRick Turner owabulawa ngababambiqhaza kuhulumeni wobandlululo eminyakeni engama-30 edlule. Sijabule kakhulu ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uMnu. Dinilesizwe Sobukwe, indodana yeqhawe elalilwela izwe lethu, uRobert Sobukwe, owasishiya eminyakeni engu-30 edlule ngemuva kokubekelwa icala lokuhlala ejele iminyaka eminingi, ebanjwa, nakwezinye izindlela zokucindezelwa. Sikhumbula abasunguli be-United Democratic Front, abanye babo siwabonga phakathi kwethu. Bonke laba bahlonishwa bamele inkumbulo nethemba, futhi ubu presence babo busikhumbuza ukuthi umsebenzi wethu ufana nomjaho wokudlulisela phambili amaphupho okuphila kahle kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngempela, laba baqhawe bamele ukukhumbuza ngesithakazelo esiqinile sabantu bethu futhi banika nethuba lokuziphatha ngendlela engaphuli noma engaboni izifiso zabantu bethu. Silungiselela ukuqala unyaka wezimali wokugcina weseshini yesithathu yohulumeni wezokhetho, ngemuva kwalokho sizoya kokhetho lwesine lwezwe. Uhulumeni ubuyekeze indima ayidlalile mayelana nomsebenzi obekulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe kusukela ngo-2004. Ngiyajabula ukusho ukuthi sithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni izithembiso esazenzile kubantu ngo-2004. Nokho, kubonakala ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi osele. Njengoba sisondele ekupheleni kwesikhathi esinikeziwe, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokubeka phambili Imisebenzi Ebalulekile edinga ukwenziwa, ehleliwe ngokubaluleka, okuzokwenziwa uhulumeni ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezilindelwe abantu kuhulumeni. Ngiyabonga ngoba inkulumo yesimo sezwe inginike ithuba lokubika kubo bonke abamele uhulumeni nabezizwe ngalezi zenzakalo eziyi-24 ezihleliwe ukuze ziqedwe ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke kwiwebhusayithi kahulumeni ngesonto elizayo. Ukukhomba lezi Zenzakalo Ebalulekile ezidinga ukwenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke kusho ukuthi zonke izigaba zohulumeni, ezwe, izifunda, nezindawo, eziphethwe nokuphathwa, zizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ngesikhathi esifushane esisele, zizokwenza umzamo ukuze zifeze umgomo obalulekile wokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke. Zonke izinhlelo zikahulumeni zizinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi esikhathini esizayo zizozama ukufezekisa kuzo zonke izindawo ukuze zifeze imiphumela elindelekile - Inqubo Engajwayelekile. Lapho sikhuluma nge-Inqubo Engajwayelekile, asikhulumi ngokuthi izinqubomgomo zikahulumeni zishintshile, kodwa sikhuluma ngesivinini sokuthi zizophumeleliswa, amandla nokusebenza okuzophumelelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphila kwabantu kuthuthuka ngokushesha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka, sithathe izinyathelo zokwenza kube nokuhleleka kokuthi izimali zisetshenziswe minyaka yonke, ezizokhishwa nguNgqongqoshe WezeMali ngaphambi kokuphela kwale nyanga, kuvumeleke ukuthi sifeze lezi zenzakalo ezidinga ukwenziwa ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifumaneke. Sizokwandisa ukuvumelanisa nezindawo ezibalulekile ekubambisaneni namanye amazwe, sigxile ezindabeni zase-Afrika nasezikhathini eziphathelene neNingizimu. Isimo esibhekene naso nomsebenzi esizibophezela kuwo sidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlangane njengomuntu oyedwa ukuze sifeze zonke izabelo ezidingekayo, singakukhohlwa ukuthi sonke siphethe ikusasa lethu ezandleni zethu! Njengoba sonke sisebenza ndawonye lapha ezweni lethu, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lokhu kuhlobene ne-Inqubo Engajwayelekile! Ngesikhathi ngilungiselela le nkulumo, omunye wethu wakhuluma kimi umbono wokuthi izwe lethu likhathazekile ngezivunguvungu ezinamandla okwenza kube nzima ukubona ukuthi izwe lethu lizoba kuphi kusasa. Uthe namuhla ekuseni, njengoba ngibhekene nezinselelo esinazo, ngikhumbule amazwi adumile kaCharles Dickens aqala incwadi yakhe ethi A Tale of Two Cities. "Kwabe kuyizikhathi ezinhle, kwabe kuyizikhathi ezimbi, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokuhlakanipha, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokuphoxeka, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokukholwa, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokungakholwa, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokukhanya, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokumnyama, kwabe kuyisikhathi sephupho, kwabe kuyisikhathi sokudabuka, sasinakho konke phambi kwethu, sonke sasiya ngqo eMhlabeni, sonke sasiya ngqo kwenye indlela - ngokufingqa, lesi sikhathi sasingafani kakhulu nesikhathi samanje, ukuthi abanye bayo baphakamisela ukuba sithathe, noma ngabe kahle noma kabi, ngokweqile." Ungabuza ukuthi ngiyavuma yini ngalolu hlobo, futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi sikhona ngesikhathi sokuphazamiseka lapho sonke singalahleka ekungaqiniseni kwezinyathelo zethu, izinyawo zethu zingaphazamiseka, sikhathazekile ngekusasa lethu! Impendulo yami yebo! Njengohulumeni, ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi isisekelo esakhe eminyakeni eyi-14 edlule siqinile. Kufanele siqhubeke nokusebenza kulolu sizo ukuze siqhubeke phambili futhi sifeze amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Nokho, kufanele sonke sikhuthaze ukuzibophezela ukuze sihlale endleleni eholela empumelelweni njengomphakathi. Nokho, njengabo
Ngiyajabula ukukhuluma ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, elihlangene ukuze lenze iseshini yokugcina yePhalamende lethu lesithathu, eliphethwe ngumbono wabantu. Ngimi phambi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngenkonzo ngesikhathi lapho nginethuba lokuba ehhovisi eliphezulu kuleli, ngenxa yesimo esikhethekile esavela esinqumweni seqembu elibusayo sokukhipha uMongameli owayekhona ehhovisi. Umsebenzi wami ezinyangeni ezedlule kube ukuhola iNational Executive ekufezeni umyalo onikezwe iAfrican National Congress emavotelini ka-2004 nokulungiselela ukuvota okuzayo. Lokhu sikwenze ngempumelelo, siqinisekisile ukudlula okungafanele eminyakeni emihlanu edlule futhi siqhubeke nezinhlelo zikahulumeni, kubonga ukuvuthwa kwendlela yethu yokuphatha, ingxenye yayo ibonakala ekubambisaneni kwamalungu amasha namadala eNational Executive kanye nokwesekwa okuqinile kwababonisi bakahulumeni bethu. Ngokubheka emuva eminyakeni eyishumi nanhlanu edlule, ngifuna ukubonga ukuzinikela nomsebenzi onzima kaMongameli uNelson Mandela noThabo Mbeki, kanye nabesifazane nabantu abaningi ababe nomsebenzi wokuhola leli bhasi likahulumeni ngaphansi kokubusa kwabantu: ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha, emthethweni phakathi kwezindawo ezintathu zokuphatha, nasemthethweni; bephushwa umnqweno wokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ngimi phambi kwenu ngokuqhakambisa nokholo lokuthi le Ningizimu Afrika esiyigubha namuhla, enezindawo ezihlukahlukene nezihlukaniso, izingxabano, nokukhishwa kweminyaka eyishumi nanhlanu edlule, kuyimiphumela yomsebenzi nokuzinikela kwabantu besifazane nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abavela kuzo zonke izimpilo. Laba bantu baseNingizimu Afrika bamele ithemba nokubekezela, bebonisa isizwe sethu. Phakathi kwabo kukhona abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlonishwa kakhulu ababezingxenye zePhalamende lethu ngaphansi kokubusa kwabantu, esikhathini esidabukisayo sokulahlekelwa kwabo emavotelini edlule. Lokhu kufaka phakathi uBrian Bunting, uBilly Nair, uNcumisa Kondlo, uJohn Gomomo, uJoe Nhlanhla, uCas Saloojee, uJohn Schippers, noJan van Eck. Ngithanda futhi ukufaka uNkk. Helen Suzman, umuntu ophawulekayo ongumZulu owamele izindinganiso zePhalamende lethu elisha ePhalamende elidala. Laba bantu nabanye abavela ezweni lethu bafanele ingxenye enkulu yomvuzo uma sikhuluma ukuthi, naphezu kwanoma yiziphi izivunguvungu zezimali esibhekene nazo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinkinga zezimali ezingasiphazamisa, sihlangene ekuguquleni isizwe sethu sibe sesimweni esingcono. Nokho, akufanele sithukutheze izinselelo esibhekene nazo. Ukwehla kwamandla ezomnotho emhlabeni kubeka umnotho wethu engcupheni enkulu ngenxa yokulahleka kwemisebenzi nezinga lokuphila kwabantu bethu. Ngokuvamile, ukungaqiniseki mayelana nezinguquko zezombusazwe kungase kube nemibuzo eminingi kunalokho esinazo izimpendulo okwamanje. Ngenxa yalokhu, abanye bethu bahlushwa ukungakhululeki okwethulwe yilezi zimo zezimali nezombusazwe. Kodwa thina sithatha uhambo lwethemba nokubekezela. Singasho nokuthi, ngenhlanhla engajwayelekile, izici eziningi zokuphatha kwethu kwezimali zihlolwe phakathi nalesi sikhathi esedlule; futhi zonke zidlule esivivinyweni ukuze zikhombise idemokhrasi ethuthukayo. Uhulumeni wethu wedemokhrasi uyaphila. Kancane kancane, uyakhula, uqinisekiswe nguMthethosisekelo ongafani emhlabeni. Ngempela, amandla ethu okuzibandakanya kwezombusazwe kuleli sikhathi sokhetho azodinga ukuba ahlonipheke futhi aphumule njengesiqinisekiso sokuphila okuqhubekayo nokujulile kukahulumeni wethu wedemokhrasi. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baqinisekise intuthuko yayo; bona futhi bangabavikeli uhulumeni wethu wedemokhrasi eminyakeni ezayo. Ngivumele, uMhlonishwa noSihlalo, kulokhu ngifuna ukuhlinzeka bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abavumelekile ukuba babhalise futhi bavote emavotelini kazwelonke nasezindaweni, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha isimo sethu lapho sifuna ukufinyelela khona. Kumele sikwenze lokhu ezinsukwini zokusebenza eziphelele emahhovisi omasipala, ngaphambi kokuba uhlu lokubhalisela ukuvota luvalwe. Kumele futhi sisebenzise le mpelasonto ekhethekile yokubhaliswa ehlelwe yiKomidi Lokhetho kusasa nangeSonto, mhlaka 7 no-8 kuMfumfu. Kumele ngithathe leli thuba ukukwazisa ukuthi ezinsukwini ezizayo ngizophothula izingxoxo neKomidi Lokhetho kanye nabaphathiswa bezifunda bese ngimemezela usuku lokhetho. Siphila lokho njengohulumeni wedemokhrasi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, mhlaka 27 kuMbasa 1994, okokuqala ngqa sithatha ikusasa labo ezandleni zabo. Ngaleso senzo esilula kodwa esiphelele sokuvota kuhulumeni wabantu bonke bezwe lethu ngekhadi, saphendukela emuva esikhathini esabheka phansi isithunzi sethu njengabantu. Ngakho-ke, kuyafaneleka ukuthi kulolu suku sigubhe iminyaka engama-20 yokwamukelwa kwesitatimende seKomidi Lezomthetho le-OAU eNingizimu Afrika eMbuzweni, eNingizimu Afrika, esamukelwa ngoJuni 1989, esaziwa kakhulu njengeHarare Declaration. Lokhu kwazama kwakha isisekelo soxolo emhlabeni, ngokusebenzisa iZizwe Ezihlangene, ohlelweni lokuxoxisana eNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, kwaba yisikhuthazo sokwakhiwa kweMibono yeDemokhrasi ka-1989, okuhlanganisa abantu bezwe bonke abavela kuzo zonke izimpilo. Konke lokhu kuholele ohlelweni lokuxoxisana olwakha emavotelini ethu okuqala wedemokhrasi ngo-1994. Kulokhu, kumele sibonge uMongameli we-African National Congress, uOliver Reginald Tambo, ngokusungula nokuhlola ukuthi kuzosebenza kanjani kubantu besifunda nasemphakathini jikelele njengesiqondiso sokuxazulula ngokuthula ukungqubuzana ezweni lethu. Lesi sinyathelo esinamandla sokwakha isikhala esizophushana nokuthula nokuhlangana, esikhundleni sokulwa nokungqubuzana, sithathe isikhathi eside ukulinda okungelona iqiniso iminyaka eyikhulu: umphumela weMibono Yezwe ka-1909 eyayiyisikhumbuzo sokwakhiwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Ngaleso sikhathi, le Mibono yachaza isithombe seNingizimu Afrika njengoba siyazi namuhla, njengoba sasiqinisekiswe ngokucindezelwa kwezenhlalo nokukhishwa. Ngakho-ke, eminyakeni eyishumi nanhlanu yokubusa kwethu wedemokhrasi, singenza sithi ukwesaba, ukungaqiniseki, nokuzonda kweminyaka eyikhulu edlule kwenze ukuthula kube yinto eyahlukanisayo futhi engaphelele kubaholi bezwe ababephakathi; kwakungekho nje kuphela okungafanele kodwa kwangempela kwakukhona endaweni engalungile. Lokhu kwesaba nokungaqiniseki kuholele ezinkathazweni zeminyaka eminingi. Kulokhu, sikhumbula indodana enethemba yabantu bethu,

Indlu yokuhlala iyindlu eyingxenye yempahla yokuhlala esetshenziselwa ukuhlala abantu, noma izindlu eziningi ezifana nalokhu endaweni lapha akukhulumi ngendawo lapho okungaphezu kokuthathu kwabelwana ngayo okuthile ngaphandle kokuhlala, noma ihhotela, indawo yokuhlala, B&B, indlu yokwamukela izivakashi, noma efana naleyo eqashiswa nsuku zonke. IMALI YEZINTELA OKUFANELE IKHOKHEKE I-Muniisipali izonquma ubukhulu bezintela kuzo zonke izigaba zomhlaba ngokuvumelana nesivumelwano njengengxenye yesabelomali sonyaka. I-Muniisipali kufanele iqoqe izintela ngezinkokhelo ezilinganayo zanyanga zonke ezinyangeni eziyi-12 kanye nanoma yiziphi ezingeziwe. I-Muniisipali ingaqoqe izintela minyaka yonke kubanikazi abanama-akhawunti ezintela angama-50 noma ngaphezulu uma bephakamisile. I-Muniisipali ingakhokha minyaka yonke izintela emhlabeni kaHulumeni kanye nomhlaba wesifunda. I-Muniisipali ingashicilela izinguquko eziningi ohlwini lwezintela ezengeziwe zempahla phakathi nonyaka ngokuhambisana nesigaba 78 se-MPRA. Izintela zizokhokhwa ngokususelwa ohlwini olushintshile lwezintela ezengeziwe zempahla. Izigaba zezimali zihlukaniswa ngokuya ngokuthi le mpahla isetshenziswa kanjani, futhi izintela zinqunywa ngokuthi le mpahla isetshenziswa kanjani. I-Muniisipali ingase iphazamise isibopho sokukhokha, yehlise noma yehlise inani elikhokhiswa ngamasigaba athile abanikazi, kuye ngaleso sikhathi sendawo. ISIGABA 7: UKUQEDILELA AMAFAKSI WOKUBHALISWA INGQIKITHI 2 Ingxenye 2 yamafomu... Isigaba 2 Ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi Inqubo yokubhaliswa: Kungani, ubani, kanjani, nini. Ukubhaliswa kokusebenzisa amanzi kuqondiswa nguSigaba 26 © noSigaba 34 weMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi abasebenzisi bamanzi badinga ukubhalisela ukusebenzisa amanzi kule Ndaba. Ukuze kulawulwe futhi kulungiswe izinsiza zamanzi ukuze kuhlelwe kahle nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kwamani kubasebenzisi bamanzi. Ukubhaliswa kuyisinyathelo sokuqala sokuthola izindleko ezifanele nezichanekile zokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele. Imali eqoqwe lapha izosetshenziswa ukuze kufezwe lezi zinjongo ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukubhaliswa akusizi kuphela abasebenzisi bamanzi kodwa kuzophinde kusebenze kuzo zonke izwe. INingizimu Afrika ingelinye lamazwe anezinsiza zamanzi ezinganele. Siseduze kokubizwa emhlabeni jikelele njenge "izwe elinamanzi ambalwa." Ukuhlola kukhombisa ukuthi zonke izinsiza zamanzi ezintsha zizokhishwa phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 kuya kwengu-30 ezayo, kuye ngentuthuko yezezimali. Ukuhlukumezeka kwezinsiza zamanzi ezintsha ngenxa yokungcoliswa kunganciphisa inani lamanzi angasetshenziswa. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo nokungcoliswa kwemvelo. Ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza zamanzi nokuhlinzekwa kwesikhathi esizayo kubalulekile eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kufezwe lokhu, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi sinesikhathi esingakanani samanzi, ubani osisebenzisayo, nokuthi kuphi. Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kubhalwe kuSheduli 1 yeMthetho (bona Isigaba 4). Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kungafakiwe ezidingweni zokubhaliswa njengoba kuchazwe ngaphansi kweSaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kweNqubomgomo Yokubhaliswa noma ngaphansi kweZimvume Jikelele (bona Isigaba 4). Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kungxenye yosizo olunikezwa labo abahlinzeka ngamanzi njengohulumeni bendawo (Izindawo) noma iBhodi Yamanzi. Isibonelo salokhu yamanzi nokulahla udoti ezindaweni zokuhlala ezilawulwa yiMuniisipali. Akudingeki ukuthi wonke umndeni ubhalise, kodwa iMuniisipali kufanele ibhalise ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi. Umuntu ngamunye - njengabalimi, abanikazi bezindawo, noma abaqashi. Imiphakathi - njengamabhizinisi omphakathi, izinhlangano zabafuyi bendabuko. Izinkampani Nezohwebo - kufaka phakathi ubudlelwano, izinkampani zomphakathi, izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, izinkampani zangaphandle, imishado, nezikole. Abahlinzeki bamanzi, kuhlanganise neBhodi Yamanzi kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Kusukela ngo-Okthoba 8, 1999, bonke abasebenzisi bamanzi abasha kufanele babhalise njengoba kuchaziwe kwiZimvume Jikelele (bona Isigaba 4). Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, le Ndaba izokhipha Izaziso kuGazethi yoHulumeni enemininingwane yezimo zokugeleza kwemifula nezinqolobane noma izindawo zokuhlola amanzi nezinsiza zamanzi, ibize abasebenzisi bamanzi ukuba babhalise ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okwamanje. Lezi Zaziso zizokwenza kube sobala isikhathi lapho abasebenzisi bamanzi kufanele babhaliswe. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sitholakala cishe ezinsukwini eziyi-60 kusukela ngosuku lokushicilelwa kweZaziso. Ngemuva kokukhishwa kweZaziso, abasebenzisi bamanzi bazophinde baziwe ngezinye izindlela ukuthi kufanele babhalise, njengokushicilela izaziso eziphephandabeni noma ukumemezela emsakazweni. Ungabaza emahhovisi amanzi endaweni yakho uma iZaziso yokubhaliswa yale ndawo ikhishwe. Amafomu okubhaliswa atholakala kunoma yisiphi ihhovisi leNdaba (bona Isigaba 8). Amafomu angaphelele angabuyiselwa kubasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukubhaliswa kuzophakanyiswa kuze kube ifomu libuyiselwa lonke ulwazi oludingekayo. Lapha unikezwa incazelo yezisho (nezisho) ezivame ukusetshenziswa kule nqubo yokubhaliswa ukusiza umsebenzisi wamanzi lapho egcwalisa ifomu. Zonke ezinye izimayini, kuhlanganise nezimayini ezinkulu ezinezingcuphe ezincane ezinsizeni zamanzi, nezimayini ezinezingcuphe eziphansi nezinqubo zokumba ezingaphansi.
