Abameleli kufanele balandele imithetho nemigomo kanye nemithetho yephalamende futhi kufanele bahloniphe njalo umthetho. Ukusungulwa nokubambezeleka kuncike ekwehlulekeni ukuhlangabezana ne-quorum edingekayo. Umphakathi ophumayo ubonisa noma ubani okhethwe njengomphakathi ophumayo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Ocriminal, uMthetho No. 51 ka-1977, okuhlanganisa imidiya futhi kubhekisela kunoma ubani ohlala eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika. UMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomphakathi uhlanganisa noma ubani omunye osethiwe ukwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi. UMthetho Wezakhiwo ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomphakathi ka-1998 uMthetho No. 117 ka-1998. UMthetho Wezinhlelo ubhekisela kuMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi ka-2000 uMthetho No. 32 ka-2000. Ubulili nenombolo - Kunoma imithetho, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nenjongo ephikisanayo, amagama akhombisa ubulili besilisa ahlanganisa ubulili besifazane futhi amagama akhombisa ubunye ahlanganisa inani, futhi amagama akhombisa inani ahlanganisa ubunye. Noma iyiphi isimemo sokukhuluma nephalamende noma ikomidi lephalamende; kanye nanoma yimuphi umphakathi wezomthetho. Noma iyiphi ukuhumusha kwale mithetho nemigomo kufanele kwenziwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthethosisekelo, umthetho kazwelonke, wesifunda, kanye nomthetho wezakhamuzi, kanye nomthetho nokulungiswa. Isinqumo somphakathi noma umholi mayelana nokuhumusha kwale mithetho nemigomo emhlanganweni wephalamende noma ikomidi, ngokusekelwe ezicini 35 no-36, sizoba yisinqumo esiphelele. Ukuhumusha nokunquma komphakathi noma umholi mayelana nanoma iyiphi yale mithetho nemigomo kufanele kubhaliswe emaminitheni emhlanganweni wephalamende noma ikomidi. Umphakathi wezomthetho kufanele ugcine irejista yezinqumo nemibono yezomthetho. Noma yimuphi ummeleli angacela umphakathi wezomthetho, ngokubhala phakathi nezinsuku ezinhlanu zesinqumo esithathwe ngaphansi kwesiqondiso 3, ukuba anikeze incazelo mayelana nokuhumusha nesinqumo kanye nemibiko yephalamende noma ikomidi. Iphalamende noma ikomidi, ngemuva kokubheka umbiko ngaphansi kwesiqondiso 3, kufanele iqinisekise, ilungise, noma iguqule isinqumo somphakathi noma umholi mayelana nanoma yimiphi amalungelo angathinta noma iyiphi enye iphathi ngenxa yesinqumo, futhi zonke izinqumo ezithinta amalungelo abanye kufanele zibhaliswe, futhi izizathu zalezi zinqumo kufanele zibhale. Iphalamende kufanele libe nemihlangano ejwayelekile yephalamende okungenani kanye njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu. Zonke imihlangano yephalamende kanye nezika komidi kufanele zibe zivulekile emphakathini, futhi iphalamende noma ikomidi lingakhipha umphakathi emhlanganweni, ngaphandle kokuthi iphalamende noma ikomidi, ngenxa yemvelo yendaba ekhuluma ngayo noma uma ukuveza noma iyiphi indaba kungaphula izinhloso zomphakathi, ibone isizathu esifanele sokwenza njalo ngokuhambisana nezimiso zokuphathwa okuvulekile kanye nedemokhrasi. Isinqumo sokungena esivumelwaneni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emphakathini. Noma iyiphi enye indaba enikezwe ngummthetho. Umphakathi wezomthetho kufanele unikeze isaziso somphakathi, ngendlela evunyelwe yiphalamende, ekhombisa isikhathi, usuku, nendawo yanoma iyiphi imihlangano ejwayelekile yephalamende noma ikomidi kanye nanoma iyiphi imihlangano yephalamende noma ikomidi ephuthumayo, ngaphandle kokuthi isikhathi singavumeli ukuba kwenzeke njalo. Umphakathi kufanele abize imihlangano yephalamende, okungenani izikhathi ezine ngonyaka, "ngesaziso somhlangano wephalamende" esisayiniwe, ekhombisa usuku, indawo, nesikhathi somhlangano kanye noma okuqukethe uhlu lwezinto ezizokwenziwa kulolo mhlangano ophakanyisiwe. Futhi ezinsukwini ezimbili zezikhalazo ngaphambi kosuku lomhlangano ophuthumayo, kufanele abize umhlangano ophuthumayo wephalamende. Futhi umthetho 7 (ii) phakathi nesikhathi esingadluli ezinsukwini ezine kusukela ngosuku lapho isicelo samukelwe. Futhi isaziso senqubo esisayiniwe; futhi ii isitatimende esibhaliwe ngummeleli osayine isaziso senqubo esinikeza izizathu zokuthi kungani indaba ehleliwe yokukhuluma kulolo mhlangano ophuthumayo ibalulekile futhi ingalindi umhlangano wephalamende ojwayelekile. c Ukuhambisana ngokuphelele nomthetho 7 3a no-7 3b uthi umphakathi akavunyelwe ukusebenzisa amandla akhe kodwa kufanele abize umhlangano. Kuncike ekutheni leyo mininingwane yokuxhumana kufanele ithunyelwe ngummeli ngamunye kumphakathi wezomthetho phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili ngemuva kokhetho lwabameleli futhi, emva kwalokho, noma nini ummeleli efuna ukuguqula noma iyiphi ikheli futhi lelo kheli kufanele kube lapho ummeleli ethola khona imiyalezo futhi angathola noma iyiphi isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni nasemihlanganweni esemthethweni yephalamende. Zonke imibhalo ehlobene nanoma imihlangano yephalamende noma ikomidi kufanele inikezwe kubo bonke abameleli okungenani ezinsukwini ezinhlanu zezikhalazo ngaphambi kwemihlangano ejwayelekile yephalamende noma ezinsukwini ezimbili zezikhalazo ngaphambi kwemihlangano yephalamende noma ikomidi ephuthumayo. Bonke abameleli kufanele bazi umphakathi nganoma yiziphi izinguquko ezikhelini zabo phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu zokushintsha. Ngokwemthetho 5 3, isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni kufanele sithunyelwe ebhodini lesaziso somphakathi. Ummeleli angacela uphenyo mayelana nehluleka lokuthola isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni. Ukuhluleka ukuthola isaziso sokuba khona emhlanganweni akuzokwenza kube khona umthelela kunoma iyiphi imihlangano noma izinqubo zephalamende noma nanoma yiziphi zezikomidi zayo. b Ngokwezidingo ze-quorum zokubamba umhlangano, ukuhluleka kommeleli ukuvota akuzokwenza kube khona ukuqhubeka komhlangano wephalamende. b Ngokwezidingo ze-quorum, ukuhluleka kommeleli ukuvota akuzokwenza kube khona ukuqhubeka komhlangano wekomidi. Akukho mhlangano ozoba khona uma i-quorum edingekayo ingekho phakathi kwemizuzu eyishumi n5 yokwakhiwa komhlangano, ngaphandle kokuthi abameleli abakhona bavuma ngokuhlanganyela ukuthi isikhathi kufanele sandiswe kodwa kungadluli emizuzwini eyishumi; uma i-quorum edingekayo ingahlangabezani, umhlangano kufanele uphume. d Uma i-quorum edingekayo ingahlangabezani ngemuva kokuphuma, umphakathi noma umholi kufanele ngaleyo ndlela aphume umhlangano. Uma umhlangano uphume ngenxa yokuthi i-quorum edingekayo ayihlangabezani, umhlangano kufanele uphinde uqale phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisixhenxe. a uvunyelwe ukuba ungabi khona ngaphansi komthetho 13; noma b lowo mameleli uceliwe ukuba withdraw ngaphansi komthetho 462; noma c ngokuvuma komphakathi noma umholi. Ulimi lwabantu ngandlela-thile luyisiqinisekiso "sesibili," lumele okuthile okungokwemvelo kwabantu, lapho sikhuluma khona ngezithemba nezifiso, sibhala imicabango yethu nemigomo, sihlola ulwazi lwethu namasiko, futhi sakhe imiphakathi yethu nemithetho yokubusa. Ngolimi, singasebenza njengabantu emhlabeni ohlanganyela njalo. Ilungelo lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ozikhethayo liqinisekiswe yiBill of Rights kanye neSisekelo sethu, esiqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi zabantu bethu ziyinsiza okufanele zisetshenziswe. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuthi, ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eqotho, sikwazi ekugcineni ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo senqubomgomo yolimi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuwukuphetha komsebenzi oqale ngo-1995, lapho ngithumele khona iLanguage Planning Working Group (LANGTAG) ukuba inikeze izeluleko ngesakhiwo esihambisanayo senqubomgomo yolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sibalulekile ngokombono wokungabi khona kokuphikiswa ekuhlukahlukaneni kwezilimi kanye nemiphumela yokuthi "ukusebenza kwezilimi eziningi kuyindaba yokukhokha" njengoba kubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu, kanye nezikhalazo ezikhulayo ezivela kubanikazi bezilimi mayelana nokubusa kolimi olulodwa eNingizimu Afrika. I-National Language Policy Framework isekelwe emiphumeleni yokubambisana ngokubonisana, isebenzisa kokubili iLANGTAG nezinsiza zeMnyango ngokuhlanganyela neLanguage Policy Advisory Group. Lesi sikhungo senqubomgomo sibalulekile ekuphatheni izinsiza zethu ezihlukahlukene zolimi nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kukahulumeni ezinjongo zokukhuthaza ubud democracy, ubulungiswa, ukulingana, kanye nobunye bezwe. Kulesi simo esihle, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zelizwe lethu, njengoba kuvezwe yiSisekelo, kube nendawo ebalulekile kule nqubomgomo. Le Nqubomgomo futhi igcizelela ukuthi ukubaluleka kwezilimi zethu kubonakala kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwazo kwezomnotho, kwezokuxhumana, nasezombusazwe. Lapho ulimi lungalahlekelwa ukubaluleka kulezi zimo, isimo sawo siyancipha. I-nqubomgomo iphinde ibonise ukuthi sibhekene nezinselelo zokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele futhi ukuthi izilimi zethu zomdabu kumele zibe yingxenye yeziqubu ezishintshashintshayo zobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, kuzobhekelelwa ukusimama kwesimo nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngithemba ngenhlonipho ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokwamukela le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe Yolimi njengabo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ngokubambisana, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi le nqubomgomo iba yimpumelelo ezimpilweni zethu, futhi isenze siqhenye ngempilo yethu ehlukile yaseNingizimu Afrika. SAQA Ibhodi leziqu laseNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona cishe izilimi eziyi-25 ezahlukene ezikhuluma eNingizimu Afrika, kanti eziyi-11 zikhishwa isimo esisemthethweni ngokuhambisana neSigaba 6 seSisekelo sika-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996), ngokusekelwe esidingweni sokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwazo kufanele kube ngu-98% wabantu bonke. Izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni yizona isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, kanye ne-siSwati (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeNguni); isiSesotho, isiSepedi, kanye neSetswana (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeSotho); isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiNgisi, kanye ne-Afrikaans. ENingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinokukhuluma izilimi eziningi. Isici esivelele sokukhuluma izilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izilimi eziningi zomdabu zidlula imingcele yezifunda, zikhuluma phakathi kwemiphakathi yaleso silimi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphikisiwe ngaphambili futhi kukhuthaze ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi, uma kuphela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bekhululekile ukweseka izilimi ezingezona ezomdabu njengokubalulekile, okuyizilimi ezisemthethweni zalesi sikhungo. Ukuphathwa kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika bekukhona izinkinga emlandweni ngenxa yokungabi khona kwenqubomgomo yolimi echazwe kahle, okuholele ekusetshenzisweni kwe-English kanye ne-Afrikaans njengamazwi aphakeme athonya izici zomphakathi, zomnotho, nezombusazwe zomphakathi wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili kuhulumeni wenkululeko, eNingizimu Afrika ifike endaweni ebalulekile emlandweni wayo. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baphendule ekuhlukahlukaneni kwabo kolimi namasiko kanye nezinselelo zokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, yingakho le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe Yolimi ithuthukiswa. Le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe ayiqali nje indlela entsha yokubhekana nokukhuluma izilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika kodwa futhi ikhulisa kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu njengezilimi ezisemthethweni ukuze kukhuthazwe futhi kuthuthukiswe ubunye bezwe. Iphakela ukuqashelwa okubanzi kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi, ubulungiswa bezokuxhumana, ukufinyelela okufanele ezinhlelweni nasemithonjeni yomphakathi, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Leli documet linikeza isikhungo esingasetshenziswa yibhodi yokukhuluma izilimi eziningi ehlanganisiwe ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeSisekelo. Kusukela ekusungulweni kokuqala kwabantu baseDashi eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1652, ngezikhathi ezilandelanayo zokubusa kweNgilandi, i-Union of South Africa, kanye nohulumeni we-apartheid, kuze kube sekupheleni kokwakhiwa kukahulumeni wenkululeko ngo-1994 nokuhlanganiswa kokukhuluma izilimi eziningi emthethweni, inqubomgomo yolimi kahulumeni nezikhungo zokuqondisa azikaze ziqaphele ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela walolu simo kube ukungalingani, lapho ubuholi be-English kanye ne-Afrikaans kudala ubudlelwano obungalingani phakathi kwezilimi zabo zomdabu nalezi zilimi. Ngakho-ke, inqubomgomo yolimi yeziqhingi kanye ne-apartheid, ezihlanganiswe nezinhlelo zomphakathi, zomnotho, nezombusazwe, zaveza ubuholi bezilimi, ukungalingani okukhonjiswe ezakhiweni zobuhlanga nezamakhono ezakha umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke lezi zimo zehlisa isimo sezilimi zomdabu kanye nezinhlobo zezizilimi zabantu bomdabu nezinye izigaba ezaziphikisiwe, kuhlanganisa neKhoi kanye neSan - okuqhubeka nokwakha umbono omubi wezilimi ezimnyama, okungabangelwa kuphela ngababhalisi be-Afrikaans kanye ne-English, kodwa futhi nabanye abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu uqobo. Isimo siba sibi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngenxa yezizathu ezingacacile nezimpi zamandla eziphikisana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi, uhulumeni nezikhungo ezizimele zine ndlela ethile yokwenza izinqumo zolimi eziphikisana nezingxenye zeSisekelo kanye nezidingo ezihambisana nezilimi. Isigaba 6 seSisekelo sinikeza isikhungo esiphezulu esisemthethweni sokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuhlonishwa nokubekezela kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika. Idokhumenti losizo oluvela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini linikeza amakhasimende alo ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi okulindelwe umphakathi mayelana nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo kuhambisana nezinga elibekwe lokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Umphakathi uyazi ukuthi angaxhumana kanjani neMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini. Ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende kusekelwe ekukhetheni ukuhambisana nezinga lokulethwa kwezinsizakalo elishicilelwe ngenkathi kuhambisana nokuhlonipha amalungelo amakhasimende. IMnyango Wezamanzi Nezokuhlanzeka weMasipala waseThekwini izokweseka futhi ikusekele njengamakhasimende ethu, izinga lenkonzo ongakulindela njengamakhasimende ethu, indlela ongasisiza ngayo ukuthi sikusebenzele kangcono, nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani iziphakamiso zokuthuthukisa, kanye neziteshi ongazilandela njengamakhasimende uma ufuna ukuveza ukwaneliseka kwakho ngezinga lethu lenkonzo. Zonke ofisi zikhomba lapho izindaba ezihlobene namanzi ziphathwa khona. Ukulethwa kwamanzi aphehlwa ngokpressure kuza ngqo emakhaya kusuka kumapayipi omasipala. Amalitri angama-200 wamanzi ngosuku atholakala kumathangi aphansi agcwaliswa nsuku zonke - alingana namalitri angama-6,000 wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga. Amathangi emigwaqo afakwe emiphakathini ethintwe okwethulwa kwesikhashana. Amathangi amanzi afinyelela lapho kukhona ukuphazamiseka okwandile. Isewage ithuthwa ngepiphu ezingeni elijwayelekile isebenzisa amanzi - ixhunywe kumasistimu e-sewage. Ukulethwa kwe-sewage ngepiphu esebenzisa amanzi kudluliselwa emgibeni - ithangi elingaphansi komhlaba elihlobene nakho. Lapho amanzi esetshenziswa, kudluliselwa emgibeni lapho ithrekhi izofika khona ukuze igcwalishe ithangi layo futhi ithwale i-sewage iye kwenye indawo. Wonke amakhasimende athola ama-kilolitri ayisithupha wamanzi mahhala ngenyanga, nezindleko zikhuphuka kulabo abakhasimende abathola amanzi aphehlwa ngokpressure noma aphansi, nezindleko eziyisisekelo kulabo abakhasimende abane amanzi aphehlwa ngokpressure asebenzisa ngaphezulu kwama-kilolitri ayisithupha ngenyanga futhi bahlala ezindaweni ezibiza ngaphezulu kwe-R40,000 ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Noma yimuphi umthengi onenani lempahla elingaphansi kwe-R36,000 ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo zomphakathi futhi ongakhokhi ukuthuthwa kwe-sewage uzothola le nsizakalo mahhala. Noma iyiphi ithoyilethi ye-VIP ihlinzekwa mahhala iminyaka emihlanu. Ukuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngemininingwane ye-GIS, izithombe zomoya, izikhalazo, nezinye izibalo... I-A4 nayo iyamahhala. Ukwamukela/Ukudlulisela kwezinhlelo zokwakha mayelana nokuthuthwa kwe-sewage. Izindaba eziphuthumayo zixazululwa phakathi kwamahora amane.
Mphakathi ophakeme weDolobha leGu, uMphakathi S.B. Kuyajabula kakhulu ukuba sikhulume nomphakathi wethu lapha eSimahla, ngesikhathi lesi somcimbi esibalulekile esihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu ngokwakha izindlu. Ngolimi lwesiZulu, sithi akekho umthunzi wesigodlo, okukhombisa kahle ukubaluleka nokubaluleka kokuba nekhaya. Ungaya noma kuphi, kodwa ekugcineni kufanele ubuyele ekhaya. Ikhaya liyisisekelo sokuphila komuntu. Namuhla sikhona ukuze sithathe umsebenzi obalulekile wokuhlinzeka umphakathi wethu ngezindlu ezizoba yisisekelo sezindlu zabantu bethu lapha. Lapho umuntu ekhaya, kufanele azizwe ephephile futhi ekhululekile, hhayi esaba. Inkinga emphakathini wethu ekhaya isimo sezindlu lapho abantu bethu bahlala khona. Ngenxa yokunganakwa nguhulumeni we-apartheid, abantu bethu ekhaya baye bazama ukwakha izindlu zabo, eziningi zazo zingezingeni eliphansi. Inselelo ephakathi kwemiphakathi yethu ekhaya ukuthi ngesikhathi sezimo ezimbi, izindlu ezikhona zihluleka ukumelana nezimo ezinzima. Njengomphumela, imiphakathi yethu ishiywe ibuthakathaka, isaba ukuphila kwabo. Ikhaya liyikhaya kuphela uma kukhona indlu ephephile; asifuni abantu bethu bahlale besaba ngalokho okungase kwenzeke noma nini uma isimo sezulu sishintsha ngoba bahlala ezindlini ezinganele. Umphathi wohlelo, umnyango wethu uqale umkhankaso wokubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo kakhulu nguhulumeni we-apartheid ngokubahlinzeka ngezindlu. Namuhla sijabule kakhulu ukuthi umkhankaso wethu wokwakha izindlu zomphakathi wethu ekhaya ufike kule ndawo lapha eSimahla. Sisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze sisheshise ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlu zabantu bethu ekhaya ngoba sifuna ukubuyisela isithunzi sabo esathathwa nguhulumeni we-apartheid. Ukubuyisela isithunzi sabantu bethu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu kufanele abe nendlu esimweni efanele. Akekho okufanele aphile esabayo lapho ekhaya. Ngaphambi kokuthi uhulumeni wethu wamanje we-democratic ufinyelele emandleni, bekungathi kuyiphupho kubantu ukuba bakhiwe izindlu ekhaya. Umbono wethu njengoHulumeni ukwazi ukubona wonke imiphakathi iphila izimpilo ezingcono ngendlela efanele. Sigcizelela ezinhlelweni zethu ukuthi abantu bethu kufanele bakhiwe izindlu ezindaweni eziseduze namadolobha, kanye nasezindaweni zasemakhaya; sifuna abantu bethu baphile izimpilo ezifanayo nezabanye abantu, benazo izindlu ezinhle, ugesi, nezindlela. NjengoHulumeni wabantu, asikholwa ukuthi ukuze abantu bethu bafeze ukuthuthukiswa, kufanele baphume emadolobheni; sifuna abantu bethu bafeze ukuthuthukiswa ezindaweni abahlala kuzo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka kwendlela yabo yokuphila. Ukuhamba kancane ekuthuthukiseni izindlu kule miphakathi kusekelwe kakhulu eqinisweni lokuthi izindawo eziningi lapho abantu bethu bahlala khona lapha zashiywa ngaphandle kohlelo lokuthuthukiswa. Inselelo yethu njengoMnyango ukuguqula lesi simo. Isivinini esihlinzekwayo emiphakathini yethu ekhaya ngezindlu senze uhulumeni ezingeni lesizwe nasemaphandleni aqaphele ukuthi uxhaso olusetshenziswa umnyango wethu ekwakheni izindlu zabantu bethu kumele lwenyuswe. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthi sisheshise ukufinyelela kwezinye izindawo esingakazifinyeleli. Manje sizokwazi ukusiza ngokushesha uhlelo lwethu ukuze sithinte ngqo ukususa izindawo ezibucayi nokwakha izindlu zabantu ezindaweni zasemakhaya njengezindawo ezinjalo, sibuyele isithunzi sabantu bethu ezindlini zokuhlala. Umnyango Wezindlu uyazi ukuthi umsebenzi ophakathi kwezakhamizi ukuze sisheshise ukuthuthukiswa ubunzima. Nokho, sikhuthaza izindawo ukuba zifake izicelo kumnyango ukuze lezi zinhlelo zibe nezinzuzo kwezinye izindawo. Abantu ezindaweni zasemakhaya bangabantu abahamba kancane kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni. Sifuna abantu bethu eThoyana, eMaphumulo, nakwezinye izindawo baphinde benze izinzuzo ekuthuthukisweni kwezindlu; ngiyazi ukuthi kunezinye izinhlelo umnyango ozithathayo ukuze uthuthukise umphakathi kulezi zindawo. NjengoMnyango, sihamba yonke iKwaZulu-Natal ukuze sikhombise izinhlelo ezindaweni ezifana nalezi. Lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi uhulumeni wamanje uzinikele ekuthatheni izidingo zabantu ngqo. Izindlu esizethulayo namuhla zizogcwalisa isivumelwano phakathi kukahulumeni nabantu sokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabo, futhi sizinikele kulokho. NjengoHulumeni wabantu, siyaziqhenya ngokuba yihulumeni wokuqala kuleli elingakha izindlu emiphakathini eyakhiwe ukuze kube nezikhulu. Ezinye izizinda ngaleso sikhathi zisebenzisa umthetho ukuze zakhe izindlu zomphakathi wazo. Kwakungekho msebenzi wokwakha izindlu zomphakathi eyakhiwe ukuze kube nezikhulu. Abaningi bakwamukela ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa ngeke kufike kulezi zindawo. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi abantu basemakhaya babone izindlu ezinhle zihlala kwezinye izizinda abahlala nazo. Umlando ukhombisa kahle ukuthi ngisho nabakhi bezindlu abakhulu ababebambe iqhaza kuhulumeni bangaphambili bavuma ukuthi izindlu zasemakhaya azikwazi ukwenza lutho. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba sazi lo mlando ngoba ukuze siqonde lapho siya khona, kumele sazi lapho siphuma khona futhi siqonde izinselelo esibhekene nazo njengoHulumeni wabantu. Ngenxa yokunganakwa kwezidingo zabantu bethu, kudingeka siqale kabusha ngokwakha imithetho emisha nezinhlelo ezintsha ukuze sikwazi ukwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabantu bethu. Kunemikhankaso eminingi esihlela ukuyihlinzeka ngemiphakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kule ndawo. Kubalulekile kimi ukuchaza emphakathini izinyathelo esizithathayo lapho sithumele uhlelo olukhulu njengalolu lwamanje. Siyazi ukuthi izinkinga esinazo ekuthuthukisweni zenzeka ngenxa yemithetho ye-apartheid. Ngamanye amazwi, umphakathi wonke lapha awunalo ilungelo lokuba ezindaweni ezithuthukisiwe. Imithetho emisha nezinhlelo esizenzile njengoHulumeni wabantu iphelisile lokho. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi lokhu akuphinde kwenzeke, sisebenza nezindawo ukuze izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zibe ngaphansi kohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezakhamizi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sifuna ukubona wonke ukuthuthukiswa okuhleliwe. Ngamanye amazwi, sifuna ukubona izindlu kanye nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuphelele oludingekayo abantu abazokwakha lezi zindlu, kuhlanganise nezinye izidingo zomphakathi. Kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazothola ukuthuthukiswa ezicini ezahlukene zokuphila. Uma izindlu zakhiwe ngaphandle kokucabangela ezinye izindawo nezinye izici zokuthuthukiswa, lezi zindlu ngeke zibe yizindlu ezifudumele. Ikhaya liyikhaya kuphela uma izidingo zabantu abahlala kuyo zicatshangelwa. Umuntu ongakaze azwe ubuhlungu bokungabi nendlu angase athathe kalula ukubaluleka kosuku olunjalo. Kodwa thina esazi ubuhlungu nobuhlungu bokungabi nezindlu sizokwazi ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwalesi sikhathi ezimpilweni zabantu bethu lapha eSimahla namuhla. Umphathi Wohlelo, izindawo zasemakhaya ziseduze kakhulu enhliziyweni yami. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ngiyavuma kakhulu ukuhlin
Lapho efile, sazi ukuthi uMama Adelaide Tambo usanda kukhishwa esibhedlela. Nokho, saphinda sagcizelela ukuthi wayenomphefumulo wokubekezela nokufuna okuqinile ukuqhubeka nokuphila phakathi kwethu. Sihlose ukumamukela yena kanye namalungu omndeni wakhe njengababukeli emcimbini ngenyanga kaFebhuwari, kodwa lokho akuphumelelanga. Kusasa sizokwenza ukuhlonipha okokugcina njengoba simfaka emathuneni. Ngakho, uzobe ekhona nathi emoyeni ngenyanga ka-Okthoba kulo nyaka njengoba sibhiyozela usuku lokuzalwa kukayise, owayezobe eshaya iminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye, ubaba bezingane zakhe, umngane wakhe, umlingani wakhe, kanye nezingane ezidumile zethu, u-Oliver Reginald Tambo. Sizophinde sikhulumele umndeni wakwaTambo. Ngiyajabula futhi ukumukela uMama ophakanyisiwe u-Albertina Luthuli, okhona phakathi kwethu namuhla ekuseni. Ung daughter kaChief Albert Luthuli, owawuqala ukuthola iNobel Peace Prize emhlabeni. Ukufa okudabukisayo kukaChief Luthuli, eminyakeni engamashumi amane edlule, kukhunjulwa kulo nyaka, futhi usizi lwaleso sikhathi lwazwakala lapho sathola ukuthi ushaye umshini ophumayo emapulazini esukari eKwaDukuza. Ukufa kwakhe bekuyimfihlo futhi kwashaqisa nomzimba, kodwa impilo yakhe bekuyisibonelo esikhulu esasisiholela enkululekweni esibhiyozela namuhla. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ekhululekile inombono ocacile wokubonga ngalokho uAlbert Luthuli noOliver Tambo abakwenze ezweni lethu ngokusungula izimiso ezimbili zendawo ukuze kuhlonishwe amaqhawe - isimiso sikaLuthuli kanye nesimiso sabangane bakaO.R. Tambo. Ngiyaziqhenya futhi kulabo abamukelwe kulezi zimiso ezihloniphekile zendawo. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukumukela ezindlini zephalamende labo ababe nomsebenzi ngonyaka ka-1956 lapho omama bephikisana nemithetho yokuphasa, nalabo ababe khona ngesikhathi uhlelo lwe-apartheid luphikiswa ngonyaka ka-1976, behlezi endaweni elungiselelwe umongameli. Angikhohlwa izindaba eziphonsa inhliziyo ezivela ezweni lethu ezivela kuzo zonke izifunda, ezikhethwe ngabakhulumeli bezifunda ukuze zabelane nezivakashi ezibalulekile phakathi kwethu. Uhulumeni wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika engikhuluma nawo lapha namuhla, njengoba ngibe nenhlanhla yokwenza kanjalo eminyakeni edlule, wasungulwa ngo-2004 ngemuva kokhetho olwenziwa ngalolo nyaka. Emhlanganweni wonyaka, ngenyanga kaJanuwari, umkhandlu wombuso kazwelonke, ophakeme kakhulu esifundazweni, uthole isikhathi sokucabanga ukuthi imihlangano yawo ibonisa ukuthi manje isendimeni yombuso okhethwe ngo-2004. Angithi ngithi kini ukuthi sithole inhlanhla yokuhola lo mkhandlu. Ekuzwiseni lokhu, kubonakala kufanelekile ukuthi sibuze lo mbuzo - ingabe kukhona intuthuko esiyenzile ekutshaliseni ukuze sifeze izinhloso esakhuluma ngazo emphakathini ukuthi sizofezani ngezithembiso esizenzile, ukuthi abantu bethu basinikeze amandla okuphatha izwe lethu kusukela ngo-2004 kuze kube sekukhethweni okulandelayo ngo-2009? Ngemvume yenu, ngithanda ukubuyela emuva futhi ngikhumbuze lokho esakukhuluma ngo-2004, njengabaholi benhlangano, phambi kwabokufika bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, sabuthana endaweni yokuhlangana kukahulumeni e-Union Building eTshwane ngosuku lokukhululeka, usuku esikhumbula ngalo inkululeko yethu eminyakeni eyishumi, futhi saphinde sajoyina isizwe ekubekeni umongameli wokuqala wombuso wentando yeningi, owakhethwe yiphalamende lethu, ukuze kuhlonishwe iz interests zesizwe ezikhonjiswe kokhetho luka-2004. Sekuphele isikhathi eside iNingizimu Afrika yethu ibe nekhaya elinokuphila, futhi iphinde yakhombisa kahle futhi ibhujiswe emphakathini. Iphakathi lapho uthola khona ukuthi uma uzalwa omnyama, uthola isiqalekiso sonke isikhathi sokuphila kwakho, uma uzalwa omhlophe, uthwala ukwesaba nokucasuka okufihlekile... Iphakathi lapho udoti, iphunga lobubha, udoti uhamba ezitaladini, ukuguguleka kwemfucumfucu, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, umhlaba omkhulu ogcwele udoti, le ndawo ibheka phansi futhi ifaka ubuhle komunye umhlaba onemigwaqo ehlanganayo, nezimbali ezivuthayo ziphazamisa ubuhlalu bokhula obuhlaza, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezifanele amakhosi namakhosikazi, nomculo opholile nothando. Iphakathi lapho ukuphila endaweni ethile kuyindlela yokubiza abanye ukuze bakuphathise, noma ukuphendula kumakhelwane, lapho amakhelwane ezophathwa ngotshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze bangazweli ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu bayazi ukuthi ukuphila kwabo ngeke kube kuhle uma kungekho ukubulawa phakathi kwabo, ukuhlinzwa nokulwa okungenasizathu phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo. Iphakathi lapho kukhombisa ukuthi uma uhlala ezindaweni ezithile, kuyindlela yokuphila ngokuphepha, ngoba ukuphepha kusho ukuba nezingadi eziphakeme, imigoqo kagesi, izinja zokuvikela, amaphoyisa aqaphelayo, nezinsizwa ezilungele ukuvikela labo abawubaba bethu ngezikhali, nezikhali ezifihliwe ezihlahleni, kanye namahhelikopta azoshaya ukufa kulabo abaphazamisa ubaba... Kusikhuthaza ukuthi ukhetho lwethu olwenziwe ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule lunikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuzimisela kwabantu bethu, kungakhathaliseki ngesizathu, nendlela yomuntu yokubambisana ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labantu bonke abafanayo. Izinkinga eziphuthumayo zokuphila kwabantu ngeke zixazululwe uma singakhethi amathuba emisebenzi, nokunciphisa noma ukususa ubuphofu phakathi kwethu. Lokhu kuhlangana nokuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zabantu, ukunciphisa izinga lobugebengu, ukufundisa abantu ukufunda nokubhala, nokuvula amathuba okufunda nezindlela zamasiko... sithi kuzo zonke iziqhawe zethu nezifazane ezithobekile ezazinikele ekufezeni inkululeko, kanye nawe bangane bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, ngeke sikhokhele ithemba elibekwe kithi ngenkathi nisekela ukusiguqula iNingizimu Afrika ibe yintando yeningi, umhlaba wokuthula, lapho kungabikho ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga, noma ngohlobo, umhlaba ophumelelayo, ozinikele ezithakazelweni zokuhlanganiswa kwabantu. "Umsebenzi wokwakha le Ningizimu Afrika uqale. Lo msebenzi uzoqhubeka kulesi sikhathi sesibili sokukhululeka kwethu." Emashumini eminyaka adlule, ngenkathi silungiselela umhlangano omkhulu wabantu owawamukela i-charter yokukhululeka, izindaba eziphonsa inhliziyo zalolo suku zathi Masikhulume sonke, ama-Afrika, labo abavela eYurophu, amaNdiya kanye nabantu abamnyama, bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, masikhulume sonke ngokukhululeka, masikhulume ngenjabulo evela kubantu abaphila ezweni elikhululekile. Namuhla kufanele sibuye sithumele isithembiso sethu, kufanele sikhulume sonke ngokukhululeka, kufanele sisebenze ezikhulumweni ukuze
Ngiyavuma ngesikhathi sokuhlangana kwesithathu sokwahlulela, esilandelayo esedlule, ukuze ngikhulume ngesimo sezwe, ngifisa ukuhamba phambili ngiyifisela amalungu ahloniphekile ePhalamende unyaka omusha ojabulisayo nowempumelelo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi unyaka ka-2008 uzoba yisikhathi esibalulekile kuhulumeni wethu wezenhlalo uma sisebenza ndawonye ukuze sifinyelele amaphupho ethu okuphila kahle kubo bonke. Ngiyasho lokhu ngoba, ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwethu, akuvamile ukuthi izwe libizwe ukuba lidlule emizamweni emikhulu ukuze kufezwe amaphupho abantu. Umlando usibeke kulolu suku. Ngikhuluma kini namuhla, Nkosikazi uMthethwa, phambi kukamama wami ongithumele, uEpainette Mbeki, uMaMofokeng, okhona lapha nomyalezo ocacile wabantu basemaphandleni eTranskei abahlala khona iminyaka eminingi. Uthi laba bantu bafuna ukuthi sikhulume nabo njengabaholi babo ukuthi ngabe sizimisele yini ukwenza ikusasa libe ngcono kunanamuhla. Ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalombili ezedlule, ngomhla kaFebhuwari 16, umama wami uzogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-92. Iph gift kuphela esingamnika ngosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa yiqiniso. Ngiyabonga kuye ngokunginika ithuba lokuba nani namuhla, futhi ngiyethemba ukuthi ngeke simdumele. Ngifuna ukuthatha leli thuba ukuze ngibingelele uMongameli uNelson Mandela, omunye wabakhi abavelele bohulumeni bethu wezenhlalo ozogubha usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-90 ngomhla kaJulayi 18 kulo nyaka. Namuhla samukela uMnu. Arthur Margeman orepresenta abavikeli bekhulu ababe khona ngesikhathi izinqola zethulwa e-Alexandra eminyakeni engama-50 edlule, futhi uNelson Mandela naye wayekhona kulolo mcimbi. Sibusisiwe ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uNkk. Jann Turner, indodakazi kaRick Turner owabulawa ngababambiqhaza bohulumeni be-apartheid eminyakeni engama-30 edlule. Siyajabula kakhulu ukuthi phakathi kwethu kukhona uMnu. Dinilesizwe Sobukwe, indodana yeqhawe elalilwela izwe lethu, uRobert Sobukwe, owashiya thina eminyakeni engama-30 edlule ngemuva kokubekelwa icala lokuhlala ejele iminyaka eminingi, ebanjwa, kanye nezinye izinhlobo zokucindezelwa. Sikhumbula abasunguli be-United Democratic Front, abanye babo sibhiyozela phakathi kwethu. Bonke laba bahloniphekile bamele inkumbulo nethemba, futhi ukuhamba kwabo kusikhumbuza ukuthi umsebenzi wethu ufana nomjaho wokudlulisela phambili amaphupho okuphila kahle kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngempela, laba baqhawe bamele ukukhumbuza ngesithakazelo esingaguquki sabantu bethu futhi basinika inselelo yokuziphatha ngendlela engaphuli noma engabazi amaphupho abantu bethu. Sesisondele ekuqaleni konyaka wezezimali wokugcina weseshini yesithathu yePhalamende kuhulumeni wezenhlalo, ngemuva kwalokho sizohamba siye emavotelweni kazwelonke wesine. Uhulumeni ubuyekeze indima ayidlalile mayelana nomsebenzi obekulindeleke ukuthi wenziwe kusukela ngo-2004. Ngiyajabula ukusho ukuthi senze intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni izithembiso esazenzile kubantu ngo-2004. Nokho, kubonakala ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi osele. Njengoba sesisondele ekupheleni kwesikhathi esinikeziwe, uhulumeni uthathe isinqumo sokubeka phambili Imisebenzi Ebalulekile okufanele yenziwe, ehlelwe ngokubaluleka, okuzoholelwa emizamweni yohulumeni, ukuze kufezwe izinhloso abantu abakulindele kuhurumeni. Ngiyabonga ngoba isimo sezwe sikhulume ngithole ithuba lokubika ePhalamende nasezweni ngalezi zenzakalo eziyi-24 ezihlelwe ukuze ziphumelele ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zifakwe kuwebhusayithi kaHulumeni ngesonto elizayo. Ukukhomba lezi Zenzakalo Ebalulekile okufanele zenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye zisho ukuthi zonke izigaba zohulumeni, ezingeni lesizwe, ezasezindaweni, nakwezokuphatha, ziqinisekisiwe ukuthi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi ngesikhathi esifushane esisele, zizokwenza umzamo ukuze zifeze umgomo obalulekile wokuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke. Zonke izinhlelo zohulumeni ziqinisekisiwe ukuthi emhlabeni ozayo zizozama ukuhlinzeka kuzo zonke izindawo ukuze zifeze imiphumela elindelekile - Inqubo Engajwayelekile. Lapho sikhuluma nge-Inqubo Engajwayelekile, asisho ukuthi izinqubomgomo zohulumeni zishintshile, kodwa sisho isivinini sokuthi zizophumeleliswa, amandla nokusebenza okuzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphila kwabantu kuthuthuka ngokushesha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka, sithathe izinyathelo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umgomo oholela ekusetshenzisweni kwemali minyaka yonke, ozokhishwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ngaphambi kokuphela kwale nyanga, usivumela ukuthi sifeze lezi zenzakalo okufanele zenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye. Sizokwandisa ukuvumelanisa nezindawo ezibalulekile ngokubambisana namanye amazwe, sigxile ezindabeni zase-Afrika nasemibhalweni neNingizimu. Isimo esibhekene naso nomsebenzi esizibophezele ukuba siwenzile sidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba bahlangane njengomunye ukuze sifeze zonke izabelo ezidingekayo, singakukhohlwa ukuthi sonke siphethe ikusasa lethu ezandleni zethu! Njengoba sonke sisebenza ndawonye lapha ezweni lethu, kufanele siqonde ukuthi lokhu kuhlobene - ne-Inqubo Engajwayelekile! Ngesikhathi ngilungiselela le nkulumo, omunye wethu wakhuluma kimi ngombono wokuthi izwe lethu liphakathi komoya onamandla okwenza kube nzima ukubona ukuthi izwe lethu lizoba kuphi kusasa. Uthe namuhla ekuseni, njengoba ngibhekene nezinselelo esinazo, ngikhumbule amagama adumile kaCharles Dickens aqala incwadi yakhe ethi A Tale of Two Cities. "Kwake kwaba yizikhathi ezinhle, kwake kwaba yizikhathi ezimbi, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlakanipha, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokuphuthuma, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokukholwa, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokungakholwa, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokukhanya, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokumnyama, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokwethemba, kwake kwaba yisikhathi sokudabuka, sasinakho konke phambi kwethu, sonke sasiya phezulu, sonke sasiya phansi - ngokufingqa, lesi sikhathi sasiwufana kakhulu nesikhathi samanje, ukuthi abanye babaphathi bayo bephakamisa ukuthi kufanele yamukelwe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuhle noma kubi, ngendlela ephezulu yokuhlola kuphela." Ungase ubuze ukuthi ngiyavuma yini ngalolu hlobo, futhi ngiyavuma ukuthi sikhona ngesikhathi sokuphazamiseka lapho sonke singalahleka ebunzimeni bezinyathelo zethu, izinyawo zethu zingaphazamiseka, sikhathazekile ngekusasa lethu! Ngiyajabula ukukhuluma ePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, elihlangana sesikhulumi sokugcina sePhalamende lethu lesithathu, elibusa ngenhloso yabantu. Ngimi phambi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlonipha ngalesi sikhathi lapho ngithola ithuba lokuba ehhovisi eliphezulu elizweni ngenxa yesimo esikhethekile esavela esinqumweni seqembu elibusayo sokukhipha uMongameli owayekhona ehhovisi. Umsebenzi wami ezinyangeni ezedlule bekungukuhola iZikhulu zezwe ekufezeni umyalo onikezwe iAfrican National Congress ezivotelweni zika-2004 nokulungiselela izivoti ezizayo. Lokhu siqinisekisile ukuguqulwa okungaphazamiseki ezinyangeni eziyisihlanu ezedlule futhi siqhubeka nezinhlelo zikahulumeni, kubonga ukukhula kwendlela yethu yokwakha umthethonqubo, okubonakala ngokubambisana kwamalungu amasha namadala eZikhulu zezwe kanye nokwesekwa okuqinile kwabaphathiswa bethu. Ngokubheka emuva ezinyangeni eziyishumi nanhlanu ezedlule, ngifisa ukubonga ukuzinikela nomsebenzi onzima kaMongameli uNelson Mandela noThabo Mbeki, kanye nabesifazane nabantu abaningi ababe nendima ekuphatheni le ndiza kahulumeni ngaphansi kokubusa kwabantu: ezingeni eliphezulu lokuphatha, emthethweni ezindaweni ezintathu zikahulumeni, nasezinkantolo; beqhuba ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abanye baseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ngimi phambi kwenu ngokuqhakazile nangokholo lokuthi le Ningizimu Afrika esiyigubha namuhla, enezindawo ezihlukahlukene nezihlukaniso, izingxabano, nezikhalazo ezedlule ezinyangeni eziyishumi nanhlanu, kuyimiphumela yomsebenzi nokuzinikela kwabantu besifazane nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Laba baseNingizimu Afrika bamele ithemba nokubekezela, bebonisa isizwe sethu. Phakathi kwabo kukhona abanye baseNingizimu Afrika abahloniphekile abangabe ngamalungu ePhalamende lethu ngaphansi kokubusa kwabantu, esibahluleka kakhulu ngesikhathi sezivoti zonyaka odlule. Lokhu kufaka phakathi uBrian Bunting, uBilly Nair, uNcumisa Kondlo, uJohn Gomomo, uJoe Nhlanhla, uCas Saloojee, uJohn Schippers, noJan van Eck. Ngithanda futhi ukufaka uNkk. Helen Suzman, ongumuntu ophawulekayo waseNingizimu Afrika owamele izindinganiso zePhalamende lethu elisha ePhalamende elidala. Laba bantu nabanye abavela ezweni lethu bafanele ingxenye enkulu yomvuzo uma sikhuluma ukuthi, naphezu kwanoma yiziphi izikhukhula zezimali esibhekene nazo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinkinga zezimali ezingasithinta, sihlangene ekuguquleni isizwe sethu sibe sesimweni esingcono. Nokho, akufanele sikhulume kancane ngezinselelo esibhekene nazo. Ukuwohloka kwamandla omnotho emhlabeni kubeka umnotho wethu engcupheni enkulu ngenxa yokulahlekelwa kwemisebenzi nezinga lokuphila kwabantu bethu. Ngokuvamile, ukungaqiniseki mayelana nezinguquko zezombusazwe kungaphakamisa imibuzo eminingi kunalokho esinazo izimpendulo okwamanje. Ngenxa yalokhu, abanye bethu bahlushwa ukukhathazeka okwesikhashana kulolu shintsho lwezomnotho nokungaqondi kwezombusazwe. Kodwa thina sihamba ngendlela yethemba nokubekezela. Singasho nokuthi, ngethuba elikhethekile, izinto eziningi zohlelo lwethu lokwakha umthethonqubo zihlolwe phakathi nalesi sikhathi esedlule; futhi zonke zidlule ekuhlolweni ukuze zikhombise ubudlelwano obuphakeme bokhetho. Uhulumeni wethu weDemokhrasi uphila. Kancane kancane, ukhula uqine, uqinisekiswe yiMthethonqubo engafani nezinye emhlabeni. Ngempela, amandla okuzibandakanya kwezombusazwe kule nkathi yokhetho azodinga ukuba ahlonipheke futhi athule njengesiqinisekiso sokuphila okuqhubekayo nokujulile kukahulumeni wethu weDemokhrasi. Siphila ngokwakho njengohulumeni weDemokhrasi kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa 1994, okokuqala ngokubambisana ukuthatha ikusasa labo ezandleni zabo. Ngaleso senzo esilula kodwa esiphelele sokuvota kuhulumeni wabantu bonke bezwe lethu ngembobo, saguqa emuva esikhathini esabukeka sengathi sithukutheleyo njengabantu. Ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika, kwaba yinsika yokwakha iSivumelwano sika-1989 Sokwakha Isimo SeDemokhrasi, okuhlanganisa abantu bezwe bazo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Leso sinyathelo esinobuqhawe sokwakha uhlaka oluzofuna ukuthula nokubumbana, esikhundleni sokulwa nokungqubuzana, sithathe isikhathi eside sithathe okwakungelona iqiniso eminyakeni eyikhulu: umphumela weSivumelwano seSizwe sika-1909 esaba uphawu lokwakhiwa kweSewula Afrika. Ngaleso sikhathi, leyo Ndaba yachaza isithombe seNingizimu Afrika njengoba siyazi namuhla, njengoba sasinokucindezelwa ngokobuhlanga nokuhlukaniswa. Ngokwemigomo yephakheji yomhlalaphansi, wonke umhlalaphansi kumele unikeze abaphathi bephakheji ubufakazi bokuthi basaphila. Amafomu abizwa ngokuthi "Isitifiketi Sokuphumelela Komhlalaphansi" athunyelwe kubo bonke abathola umhlalaphansi, kanye ne-envelopu ekhokhelwe ngaphambi kokubuyisela lawa mafomu mahhala. IPhalamende leNingizimu Afrika linezindlu ezimbili: iNational Assembly (eyaziwa njenge-NA), enamalungu angama-400, kanye neNational Council of Provinces (eyaziwa njenge-NCOP), enamalungu angama-90 okungenani. Umthethosisekelo uthi i-NCOP temsilisela izifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kohlelo lukazwelonke. Lokhu kwenziwa ikakhulukazi ngokubamba iqhaza enqubweni yokuwina imithetho kazwelonke nokunikeza umphakathi ipulatifomu kazwelonke yokubamba izingxoxo ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta izifunda. I-NCOP iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zokuphatha zendawo zicatshangelwa ezingeni likazwelonke. Abameleli baholwa nguMphakathi wezifunda ngasinye, ongomunye wababambiqhaza abakhethekile. Uma kudingeka, uMphakathi angabeka omunye umuntu endaweni yakhe. Umphakathi, kanye nababambiqhaza ababili, ubheka umsebenzi we-NCOP futhi uphatha izingxoxo, uqinisekisa ukuthi abameleli bakhuluma ngokukhululeka uma behambisana nemithetho ebekwe yiNdlu. Ubabambiqhaza ukhethwa ukuze asebenze isikhathi esigcwele seminyaka emihlanu, kanti oMphakathi bezifunda bayashintshashintsha njengababambiqhaza isikhathi esiyisithupha. I-NCOP kufanele ibonwe njengendawo engasiza ekuphathweni kokubambisana kanye nenhloso enkulu yokubambisana, futhi ikhuthaza ukucatshangelwa kwezidingo zokuphatha zendawo kanye nezifunda ezingeni likazwelonke. I-NCOP inikeza izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zeNingizimu Afrika izwi futhi inikeza nohulumeni bendawo ipulatifomu yokubamba iqhaza ekuhlinzekeni kwemithetho ezingeni likazwelonke. Kumele icabangele yonke imithetho kazwelonke. Iphinde ikwazi ukuhlinzeka noma ukulungisa imithetho ephansi kuSheduli 4 yomthethosisekelo (lezi zindaba lapho kokubili imithetho kazwelonke nezifunda zinamandla okwenza imithetho ndawonye) nezinye izinqubo ezithinta izifunda. Iningi lale misebenzi yokuwina imithetho yenziwa emaqenjini, kodwa yonke imithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwi-NCOP ukuze ixoxwe futhi ivote ukuthi le mithetho yamukelwa noma iyalahlwa. Imithetho engathinti izifunda iphathelene nemisebenzi kazwelonke; njengezokuphepha, ezangaphandle, kanye nezenzo zomthetho. Uma le mithetho yamukelwa yiNational Legislature, ithunyelwa kwi-NCOP ukuze ivotwe. Izibonelo zemithetho ethinta izifunda zifaka phakathi imfundo, ukuthuthwa, inhlalakahle, kanye nezempilo. Iningi lemithetho lingangeniswa kwi-NCOP nganoma iyiphi yalezi zindlu; nokho, kukhona ezinye izinqubo ezidinga ukuqala kwiNational Legislature. Uma kukhona ukungavumelani phakathi kwe-NA ne-NCOP ngemithetho ethinta izifunda, le mithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwiKomidi Lokuxazulula. Uma umthetho owenza ushintsho kumthethosisekelo uthinta ngqo izifunda, okungenani eziyisithupha zezifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye kwi-NCOP kumele zivume. Uma umthetho owenza ushintsho kumthethosisekelo ungathinti ngqo izifunda, umthethosisekelo uthi i-NCOP kumele ibe nengxoxo ngalolo mthetho (ngaphandle kokuvotwa) ngaphambi kokuba ithunyelwe kwi-NA ukuze ivotwe. Ukuhlola okwenziwa uhulumeni njengoba kukhishwa umthethosisekelo kuhlanganisa ukuthi amaLungelo Ezifunda alandele futhi ahlaziye izenzo zohulumeni. I-NCOP yenza ukuhlola kwezindaba zikazwelonke ezivela ezifundeni nasemaphandleni. I-NCOP ingacela ilungu leKhabhinethi, osomabhizinisi bakazwelonke, noma osomabhizinisi bezifunda ukuba baphathe umhlangano wayo noma umhlangano wekomidi. I-NCOP noma noma yisiphi sezikomidi zayo zingamukela izicelo, izethulo, noma izincwadi ezibhaliwe ezivela kubantu noma izinhlangano ezinomdlandla. I-NCOP iphinde ibambisane nemiphakathi ukuze ihlole izenzo zohulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iqoqe ulwazi ngezidingo nezinkinga abantu ababhekana nazo. Ikomidi ngalinye lihlola umsebenzi wesigaba ngasinye soHulumeni. Ikomidi iprocessa futhi ilungisa imithetho, futhi ikhuthaza ama-foramu omphakathi uma kukhona udaba olubalulekile lokwazisa umphakathi. AmaKomidi angamema noma ubani ukuba ahlinzeke ubufakazi noma athumele imibhalo, futhi angacela noma ubani noma inhlangano ukuthi ibike kubo ngezindaba ezithile. Abameleli bezifunda ngasinye banokhetho oluthile oluphakanyiswa ngumholi wokuqhamuka kwezifunda egameni lesifunda. Amalungu omphakathi angadlala indima ebonakalayo ekuhloleni okwenziwa uhulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni uphendula ezidingweni zabantu. Ukuphakela kumakomidi ephalamende kuyindlela eyodwa yokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale ePhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokwabelana ngemibono yakho namalungu ekomidi ngenkathi bexoxa futhi beprocessa umthetho othile ngaphambi kokuba uqedwe. Isicelo siyindlela yokuletha ePhalamende izikhalazo noma izindaba ezithinta umphakathi ukuze ikwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngaphakathi kwamandla ayo. Ilungelo lokuphakela ePhalamende liyilungelo labantu bonke baleli zwe futhi linikezwa umthethosisekelo wethu. Noma ubani, noma amaqembu abantu noma noma iyiphi inhlangano inelungelo lokuphakela ePhalamende. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana namalungu ePhalamende emahhovisi abo ezokwakha ezweni lonke noma ePhalamende uma befuna ukuthi babasekele ngodaba olushisayo abafuna ukuxoxwa ngalo noma uma bedinga usizo ngendaba ethile.
Inhloso yale ncwadi ukusiza othisha nabafundi abaphakathi kwezinga le-10 - 12 engozini yokufunda nokufundisa ngezinye zezindlela zokubhala ezikhiqiza imiyalezo ngezindaba nezikhumbuzo. Le ncwadi izosiza kakhulu abafundi ukuba baphumelele ekufinyeleleni Umphumela Wokufunda 3 nasekulungiseleleni izivivinyo zabo. Ibhalwe futhi ihlukaniswe ngezindawo ezintathu. Kukhona imibhalo eyakhelwe yona, imibhalo emide nemifushane. Ngaphansi kwesigaba ngasinye, izinhlobo zemibhalo zikhona, uhlobo ngalunye luchazwa futhi izibonelo zinikezwa. Ukubhala nokwakha imibhalo kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uthisha anike abafundi ithuba elanele lokuzijwayeza ukubhala okuqhubekayo. Bavame ukunikezwa amathuba okubhala ngokukhululeka ngaphandle kokuhlolwa. Ekubhaleni okusekelwe kakhulu ezinjongo ezithile, othisha banconywa ukuba bahlolisise ikhono elithile noma amandla athile asetshenziswayo ngaleso sikhathi sokubhala. Ngokwesibonelo, zonke izakhono zolimi kufanele zikhulunywe ngaleso sikhathi sokubhala, okuyindlela othisha abayisebenzisile esikhathini esedlule. Ngenxa yalokhu, ukubhala njengokwazi kuvame ukungabhekwa ngoba kuhlale kudinga ukuhlolwa okukhulu. Abafundi kufanele bafunde ukuhlela umsebenzi wabanye ngoba lokhu kubalulekile enhlanganweni yokubhala futhi kukhuthaza ukuqashelwa kwenqubo yomfundi kanye neyabanye. Isici esibalulekile salolu phiko ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ebhaliwe. Kungabelana nabanye, othisha, esikoleni sonke, abazali, noma abanye abathintekayo. Umfundi uzothokozisa umkhiqizo ophelele nowokwenziwa. Abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukuchaza ngokufushane izinhlobo zemibhalo eyakhelwe yona njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Le yindaba lapho umbhali noma umxoxi echaza umcimbi othile owawenzeka kuye, noma ungabonwa uphila kumuntu omunye noma ukhuluma ngakho. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi umbhali akhe indaba evela emicabangweni yakhe. Lokhu kuvame ukutholakala phakathi kwabafundi (esikoleni). Kubalulekile ukuthi noma ngabe umfundi udala indaba yakhe emicabangweni yakhe, kufanele kube indaba ethembekile. Ngokuvamile, umbhali walesi sihloko usebenzisa isikhathi esedlule, umuntu okhuluma noma okukhuluma ngaye, ukuze axoxe indaba yakhe. Isigaba sokwethulwa kufanele sithokozise umfundi wendaba. Indaba yokuxoxa kufanele ibe nethembekile noma ngabe iyefikile. Indaba yokuxoxa ivame ukubhalwa ngesikhathi esedlule. Umuntu ofunda le ndaba kufanele njalo alinde ukuzwa okwenzekayo okuzayo kuze kube sekupheleni. Ukuxoxa okuphumelelayo kukhombisa kahle imizwa, njengokubona, ukuzwa, ukunambitha, ukunuka, nokuthinta. Isibonelo sesihloko sendaba yokuxoxa: Usuku Esithole Ngalo Ibhokisi Lezinkomo eBhange Elidumile Enhliziyweni YeDolobha Lethu. Kwakuyimpelasonto yeLwesihlanu ekupheleni kukaJuni. Ubanda wawuthinta isikhumba ezweni laseKwaZulu-Natal. Nakuba ubanda wawuthinta isikhumba, abantu babephuma inani elikhulu ukwenza izidingo zabo edolobheni laseMnambithi. Kwakungabonakala izinhlobo ezahlukene zezingubo, amabhulukwe, amahembe, amajakhethi abizayo, futhi ngisho nezindwangu ezinemibala. Amadoda nabafazi abaningi babephathe izigubhu ze-wool ezimboza izindlebe zabo. Abafazi, ngakolunye uhlangothi, babengathembisa ukuthi babezifaka izindwangu ezikhaleni zabo. I-ABSA ibhange elivame ukuba nabantu abaningi kunabanye. Kwakunjalo ngalolu suku. Kwakukhona umgibeli njengokujwayelekile holding ibhande lakhe kanye nesikhumbuzo esincane esiphonswa emzimbeni uma ungena ebhange. Bonke abangenayo emnyango babengadlula futhi bathole izibusiso kulolo bhande. Nami ngasondela futhi nganika umgibeli ithuba lokwenza umsebenzi wakhe. Ngemva kwesikhashana, ngase ngaphakathi ebhange. Ngabe ngibona indawo lapho kuhlanganyelwa khona imali. Ngakuqonda ukuthi kufanele ngisheshe ngiyise kumshini wokuhoxisa imali futhi ngiqale ukugcwalisa imininingwane edingekayo. Njengoba ngisondela, ngavela nabantu ababeqoqana. Kwathatha isikhathi eside njengoba sisondele kancane. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abasebenzi bebha ngathi bephithizela, bekhuluma ngento ethile kubantu ababe sebhange. Owayesondela kithi wahlukanisa abantu babeziqoqe kabili - umugqa wabo abahoxisa imali kanye nalabo abahambisa. Futhi ngakho, kwavela imigqa emibili. Ngabe ngisemugqa wabo abahoxisa imali. Isizathu sokuthi ngiye kuhoxisa imali ngaphakathi ebhange kwaba ukuthi ngifuna amaRandi ayisithupha. Umugqa wabo abahoxisa imali kumshini nalabo abahambisa wawusheshisa kuneyethu. Ngabe ngiqhubeka ngibona bengenela futhi baphuma emigqeni yokuhoxisa nokuhambisa imali. Kwakuyilapho ngathola umqondo wokuthi ngingahoxisa kuphela amaRandi amabili, kodwa ngaziphindisela ngathi kufanele ngibe nesineke kuze kube sekufikeni kwami. Esikhundleni sokwandisa inani labamukeli nabakhokhi, banciphisa. Ngemva kwesikhashana, izindawo abazisebenzisayo zazivele zihlukaniswe uphawu oluthi 'kuvalwe'. Sahlala ngoba sasingadinga imali. Kwakufana nokuthi ngiphupha ngesikhathi sekufika kwami kumthengisi kanye nomphakathi. Uthole ngokushesha uhlelo lwekhompyutha izikhathi ezimbili noma ezintathu ngomzuzu, wabalela imali, waphinde wayinika mina. Ngiyithathe futhi ngambonga ngenkathi ngimthokozisa. Ngesikhathi ngibheka emnyango, ngibona umgibeli evala umnyango kubo abangenayo nabaphuma. Sashangiseka ukubona abavikeli ngaphakathi ebhange bephethe amabhokisi emali. Ababili basondeza kumshini wokuhoxisa nokuhambisa imali, bavula, futhi baqala ukufaka imali. Bonke amehlo abavakashi ababephendukela kulabo bavikeli. Ngabe ngizibiza ukuthi ngeke baphume uma sikhona emnyango wokuphuma ebhange. Noma ngabe umuntu akakaze abambe isibhamu kodwa unomsindo wesibhamu okulungiselelwe ukuhlasela. Lokhu kwaba njalo ngenkathi sisenza uhlelo lokushaywa ngababheki ababephuma imali kumshini. Ngabe sishintsha amakhanda ethu, amehlo ethu abheka lapho izinsimbi ezahlukene zesibhamu ziqhuba ukuhlasela, umuntu owayekhona wabona omunye elele phansi ngesifuba. Ngabe ngibona futhi ngilele phansi ngaphezu kwalokho. Ngenkathi abanye abantu befaka imali kumashini, abanye behoxisa lokho okwakufakiwe ngababheki, kanti abanye behoxisa imali ezikhwameni zethu. Okukhona lapho kwenzeka ngamehlo. Ngemva kwesikhashana, kwavuka udlame. Lokhu akusizanga nhlobo ngoba bekusemva kwendaba. Imali yethu ithathwe. Akekho ofa ngokushaywa ngoba angizange ngife ngaleso sikhathi ngishaywa ngemuva kwalolo mcimbi. Ngisho namuhla, ngiyathola ukushisa uma ngicabanga ngalolo mcimbi. Le yindaba lapho umbhali kufanele achaze isimo esithile, umuntu othile, noma indawo ethile. Njengoba isihloko sisho, umbhali walesi sihloko kufanele asebenzise amagama achaz
Sebenzisa ipeni emnyama noma eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuze ugcwalise ifomu lempahla futhi ugcine ukubhala kwakho ngaphakathi kwezikhala ezitholakalayo. Sicela usebenzise izinhlamvu ezinkulu uma ugcwalisa le phepha. UNGASHIYI izikhala ezingenalutho ongazidingi. Sicela ungasebenzisi umoya wokulungisa uma wenza iphutha. Siphinde sicele ukuthi ungayigubungeli ifomu lakho lempahla njengoba lokhu kuzodlula isikhathi sokucubungula. Kufanele uqedele zonke izingxenye ezihlobene nephepha lempahla. Noma yisiphi ifomu lempahla elingagcwaliswanga ngokuphelele lizobuyiselwa kuwe libhalwe "alingathunyelwanga" kuze kube ubuyisela ngokuphelele. Lokhu kungaholela ezijezweni zokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngokweqile. Ukusayina: ifomu lempahla liyisitatimende esisemthethweni esidinga ukuthi uveze yonke imali engenayo, intela, nezikhala unyaka wonke. Ngaphandle kokusayina kwakho, akusho lutho. Imali etholelwe uma ungazange uthole imali engenayo unyaka wonke kufanele igcwaliswe kule ngxenye ngokufaka zero (0). AZIKHO izingxenye okufanele uziqhamukele efomini lakho uma uthumela ku-SARS. Nokho, wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene kufanele agcinwe iminyaka emihlanu uma i-SARS icela. Ukuze kube lula, kulo nyaka i-SARS ithumele ifomu lempahla elisha elingu-IT12C kwabantu. Uma uthole ifomu le-IT12C kodwa uzwa ukuthi ungaphansi kwesigaba se-IT12S, kufanele ugcwalise futhi uthumele lelo fomu le-IT12C; ungaceli ifomu le-IT12S. Ngesikhathi sokucubungula, i-SARS izoshintsha uhlobo lwefomu ngokusekelwe kulwazi olunikeziwe efomini lakho lamanje futhi izoshintsha uhlelo ngokufanele ukuze ikhiphe ifomu elilungile ngonyaka olandelayo. Qinisekisa ukunembile kolwazi olushicilelwe futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho kulolu lwazi olushicilelwe ukuze ufake imininingwane enembile. Isimo somshado njengoba sikhona ngoFebhuwari 28, 2007: Beka ibhlogo efanele nge "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) usebenzisa "X" futhi uma ushade, khombisa nge "X" ukuthi umshado usemphakathini wezimpahla noma cha. Qinisekisa ukunembile kolwazi olushicilelwe futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho kulolu lwazi olushicilelwe ukuze uhlinzeke imininingwane enembile. Sicela ugcwalise imininingwane yekheli lomqashi wakho wamanje. Uma usebenze endaweni engaphezu kweyodwa phakathi nesikhathi sikaMashi 1, 2006, kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2007, gcwalisa imininingwane yekheli lomqashi wakho omkhulu - lapho usebenze khona amahora amaningi. Uma ungasebenzi, shiya le ndawo ingenalutho. Ukuhanjiswa kwezimali ezibuyiswayo kwenziwa kusetshenziswa ikhodi yephoyisa, hhayi igama lebhange. Ngakho-ke, akudingeki ukuhlinzeka ngegama lebhange olisebenzisayo. Qaphela: i-SARS ikhipha ama-cheque kuphela ezimweni ezikhethekile, ngakho kufanele uhlinzeke ngemininingwane yebhange ukuze uthole ukubuyiselwa. Akukho ukubuyiselwa okuzobekwa kwi-akhawunti yebhange yomuntu wesithathu. Khombisa indlela yakho yokuxhumana oyithandayo ngokubeka ibhlogo efanele usebenzisa izinombolo 1 kuya ku-5. Inombolo 1 ibonisa ukukhetha okuthandwayo kanti 5 ibonisa ukukhetha okungathandwa. Uma usebenzisa umhlinzeki wentela ukuze ugcwalise iphepha lakho lempahla, lowo mhlinzeki uzogcwalisa ulwazi. Uma uthola imali eboniswe kumasertifiketi IRP5/IT3(a), kufanele uyilawule njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi. Ikhodi kukholomu yokuqala ibonisa umthombo wemali yakho kanti ikholomu yokugcina ibonisa inani olitholile. Lezi yizinkanyezi kuphela ozodinga ukuzigcwalisa kule ngxenye yefomu. Uma uthola kuphela i-IRP5/IT3(a) eyodwa, uzogcwalisa inani bese ufaka ikhodi yomthombo efanele kule ngxenye yefomu njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi. Uma unezigaba ezingaphezu kwezishiyagalombili ezahlukene, kufanele uxhumane neCall Centre ku-0860 12 12 18 ukuze uthole usizo ekuqedeni ifomu lakho lempahla. Izimali zitholakala engxenyeni yeziqhamo eziphelele ze-IRP5. Sebenzisa inani eliboniswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 ukuze ugcwalise le ngxenye - uma uthole ama-IRP5/IT3(a) amaningi, zonke izimali eziboniswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 kufanele zengezwe ndawonye futhi inani eliphelele lifakwe efomini njengekhodi 2697. Ngemigomo yentela, imali yokutshalwa kwezimali ifakwa emalini engenayo njengenzalo yasendaweni, inzalo yangaphandle, kanye nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle. Inzalo yasendaweni iboniswa ekhasini lesibili lempahla yakho futhi amalungiselelo enziwa ekhasini lesithathu lempahla yakho yokukhombisa imali etholelwe ezinsalweni zangaphandle nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle kanye nanoma yimaphi amakhredithi entela yangaphandle, uma kudingeka. Hlanganisa izimali ezihlobene nezinsalo zasendaweni eziboniswe kumasertifiketi atholwe ngawe nomkakho. Gcwalisa izimali eziphelele zezinsalo ezitholwe nguwe nomkakho - ingxenye engathathi hlangothi izobalwa yi-SARS. Phinda le nqubo ngezinsalo zangaphandle nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle. Khumbula futhi ukuhlanganisa noma yimaphi amakhredithi entela ahlobene ngawe nomkakho bese ugcwalisa inani eliphelele eduze kwekhodi efanele ekhasini lesithathu lempahla yakho. Amalungiselelo enziwe efomini ukuze akhombise ngokwehlukana amakhredithi entela ahlobene nezinsalo zangaphandle nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle. Hlanganisa izimali eziboniswe njengenzalo yasendaweni kumasertifiketi owatholile. Gcwalisa izimali zamakhredithi entela ezingathathi hlangothi - ingxenye engathathi hlangothi izobalwa yi-SARS. Phinda le nqubo ngezinsalo zangaphandle nezikhwama zezimali zangaphandle futhi ubonise izimali eziphelele ekhasini lesithathu lempahla yakho ezikhala ezifanele. Qaphela: Le yindawo kuphela yephapha lempahla lapho i-RAND NE CENTS isetshenziswa. Ukuze ugcwalise le ngxenye, usadinga ama-IRP5/IT3(a) akho. Ifomu lempahla livumela ama-sertifiketi amathathu futhi ngaleyo ndlela lihlukaniswe ngezindawo ezintathu. Khombisa inani labantu abancike kulabo abahlinzekwa ngemali. Ulwazi oludingekayo lubhekisela kumali oyikhokhele emfundweni yezokwelapha kuze kube nguFebhuwari 28, 2007, mayelana nawe nabanye abantu abaregistered kulolo mfundo. Le mininingwane ivame ukuboniswa kumazwi owatholayo kumfundisi wakho wezokwelapha. Ingabe inani lehlukile phakathi nonyaka wokuhlola? Beka ibhlogo "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) nge "X". Uma impendulo ingeyebo, khombisa inani labantu abancike ngenyanga. Uma wena, umkakho, noma ingane unokukhubazeka, inani lezindleko ezihlobene nalokhu kufanele lifakwe lapha uma lingakafakwa emfundweni yezokwelapha. Khombisa iminikelo kuPension Fund yakho. Sebenzisa ipeni emnyama noma eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuze ugcwalise ifomu lethenda futhi ugcine ukubhala kwakho ngaphakathi kwezikhala ezinikeziwe. Sicela usebenzise izinhlamvu ezinkulu lapho ugcwalisa leli phepha. UNGASHIYI izikhala ezingenalutho ongazidingi. Sicela ungasebenzisi umoya wokulungisa uma wenza iphutha. Siphinde sicele ukuthi ungayigobi ifomu lakho njengoba lokhu kuzodlula isikhathi sokucubungula. KUFANELE ugcwalise zonke izingxenye ezihambelanayo zefomu. Noma iyiphi ifomu engagcwaliswanga ngokuphelele izobuyiselwa kuwe ibhalwe "ingathunyelwa" kuze kube uyibuyisela igcwaliswe ngokuphelele. Lokhu kungaholela ezijezweni zokuhamba kancane kokuthunyelwa kwefomu lakho. Ukusayina: Ifomu lethenda liyisivumelwano esibophelelayo esidinga ukuthi uvule zonke izimali, ithenda, nezikhala throughout unyaka. Imali etholelwe uma ungazange uthole imali phakathi nonyaka kufanele ikhonjiswe ngokufaka zero (0). Ukuze kube lula kuwe, kulo nyaka i-SARS ilethe ifomu lethenda labantu ababili abasha. I-IT12S iyifomu lethenda labantu. Ikhonzwe ukuba igcwaliswe ngabasebenzi abathola umholo futhi bathola izinzuzo zokuhamba nezikhala zezindleko zezokwelapha kanye nezinkokhelo zokuthatha umhlalaphansi. Banikeza ulwazi lokubala izindleko zokuhamba. Uma ukhetha ukubala usebenzisa izindleko zangempela, kuzodingeka ukuthi unikeze ulwazi oluhambelanayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izindleko ezimisiwe zizosebenza. I-ITC12C iyifomu eyinkimbinkimbi yabantu abanemali efana nemali yokurenta, imali yangaphandle, imali yebhizinisi, imali yokulima, kanye nezindleko/ukulahlekelwa kwebhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwe-IT12S njengoba kuxoxiwe ngenhla, ifomu linikeza abathengi ithuba lokuvula noma iyiphi enye imali engafakwanga kwi-IT12S. Isimo somshado kusukela ngoFebhuwari 28, 2007: Sicela uphakamise ibhokisi elifanele nge "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) nge "X" futhi uma ushadile, khombisa nge "X" ukuthi umshado wabelana ngempahla noma cha. Qinisekisa ukunemba kolwazi oluphrintiwe, futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezimhlophe ezingenalutho kolwazi oluphrintiwe ukuze unikeze imininingwane enembile. Sicela ugcwalise imininingwane ye-akhawunti yomqashi wakho wamanje. Uma usebenze endaweni engaphezu kweyodwa phakathi nesikhathi esivela kuMashi 1, 2006, kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2007, gcwalisa imininingwane ye-akhawunti yomqashi wakho omkhulu - lapho usebenze khona amahora amaningi. Ukuhanjiswa kwezimali ezibuyiswayo kwenziwa kusetshenziswa inombolo yephoyinti, hhayi igama lebhange. Ngakho-ke, akudingeki ugcwalise igama lephoyinti olisebenzisayo. Qaphela: I-SARS ikhishwe ama-check kuphela ezimweni ezingajwayelekile, ngakho kufanele unikeze imininingwane yebhange ukuze uthole ukubuyiselwa. Akukho ukubuyiselwa okuzobekwa ku-akhawunti yebhange yomuntu wesithathu noma ku-akhawunti yomunye umuntu. Khombisa indlela yakho oyithandayo yokuxhumana ngokuphakamisa ibhokisi elifanele usebenzisa izinombolo 1 kuya ku-5. Inombolo 1 ikhombisa inketho oyithandayo kanti 5 ikhombisa inketho engathandwa kakhulu. Uma usebenzisa umxhumanisi wezintela ukuzeugcwalise ukubuyiselwa kwemali yakho, kuzogcwaliswa yilowo mxhumanisi wezintela. Ikhodi esigabeni sokuqala ikhombisa umthombo wemali yakho kanti isigaba sokugcina sikhombisa inani olitholile. Lezi yizigaba kuphela ozodinga ukuzigcwalisa kule ndawo yokubuyiselwa kwemali. Uma uthola kuphela i-IRP5/IT3(a) eyodwa, uzogcwalisa inani kanye nekhodi yomthombo efanele esigabeni sokubuyiselwa kwemali njengoba kukhonjisiwe ngezansi. Umsebenzi ofanayo kufanele ulandelwe uma uthola izitifiketi ezintathu ze-IRP5/IT3(a). Izimali zitholakala esigabeni semali ephelele ye-IRP5. Sebenzisa inani elikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 ukuze ugcwalise le ndawo - uma uthola ngaphezulu kwe-IRP5/IT3(a) eyodwa, zonke izimali ezikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 kufanele zengezwe ndawonye bese inani eliphelele lifakwa esigabeni sokubuyiselwa kwemali. Hlanganisa zonke izitifiketi ezitholwe ezivela emabhange noma kwezinye izikhungo zezezimali lapho ufake khona imali. Khombisa ukuthi lezi zitifiketi zikhombisa noma iyiphi inzalo yangaphandle noma ama-dividends angaphandle njengemali. Uma kunjalo, kufanele ugcwalise i-IT12C yemali. Hlanganisa izimali ezikhonjiswe njengenzalo yendawo ezitifiketini ozitholile mathupha nangokwakho. Kufanele ugcwalise inani lemali elingasetshenziswa njengezindleko ezitholakele nguwe nomkakho - noma iyiphi imali engasetshenziswa izobala i-SARS. Hlanganisa izimali ezikhonjiswe njengenzalo yendawo ezitifiketini ozitholile. Sebenzisa ithebula elingezansi, khetha umkhakha wezomnotho lapho imali itholakele. Uma ulwazi lungahambisani nalezi zikhala, kufanele luvele emthonjeni wakho wemali ikakhulu. Faka izinombolo ezimbili zokugcina ezishiywe zingenalutho esibuyiselweni semali. Khombisa inani labaxhasi nezinkokhelo ezenziwe ngabo. Ulwazi oludingekayo lubhekisela ezinkokhelweni ozihlinzeke kwi-fund yezokwelapha kuze kube nguFebhuwari 28, 2007, mayelana nawe nakwabanye abantu abaqashwe kulowo mfundo wezokwelapha. Le mininingwane ivame ukukhonjiswa kumyalezo otholayo kwi-fund yakho yezokwelapha. Ingabe inani lishintshile phakathi nonyaka wezintela? Phakamisa ibhokisi "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) nge "X". Uma impendulo ingeyebo, khombisa inani labaxhasi ngenyanga. Ukuze uqedele le ndawo, usadinga izitifiketi zakho ze-IRP5/IT3(a). Lokhu kubuyiselwa kwemali kuvumela izitifiketi ezintathu, ngakho-ke (ukukhubazeka) inani lezindleko ezihlobene nalokho ukukhubazeka kufanele kuhlukaniswe ngezigaba ezintathu. Izindleko zomzimba kufanele zifakwe lapha uma zingakhokhelwanga yi-Fund Yezokwelapha. Khombisa izinkokhelo zakho kwi-Fund yakho yePension. Uma ugcwalisa ukubuyiselwa kwemali, sebenzisa isitifiketi ositholile enhlanganweni owenze izinkokhelo kuyo. Abesifazane benza ingxenye enkulu yokuhlala kwabantu eNingizimu Afrika, yingakho izwi labesifazane kufanele lifakwe ezinqumweni nasekudalweni kwemithetho. Le nkwakha yabesifazane ezinqumweni iyilungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Abesifazane kumele babambe iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngoba ukuhlinzekwa kwemithetho nezinhlelo zik gouvernement kuthinta izimpilo zabo nsuku zonke. Kubalulekile, ucwaningo luveze ukuthi uma abesifazane bebamba iqhaza ezinqumweni, kuholela ekwandeni kokunakwa nokwabiwa kwezinsiza ezithuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu. Ukwanda kokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho kungaholela ekutholeni kalula izinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. UMsunguli weNingizimu Afrika uthi umphakathi kumele wazi futhi ubambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende nasemisebenzini yalo. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Abesifazane bangabamba iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngokuvota iqembu lezepolitiki abakholwa ukuthi lizobonisa kangcono imibono nezinkathazo zabo kwiPhalamende. Bangase futhi babambe iqhaza ekuhleleni nasekusebenzeni kweqembu abakhethile futhi ngokukhethwa ezakhiweni zalo. Abesifazane baphakame ezikhundleni eziphakeme ngalendlela. Amalungu omphakathi anelungelo lokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi futhi abambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ngezindaba ezithile. Uma kuyindaba umphakathi ofuna ukuyizwa, iKomidi leSishayamthetho noma iBhunga leSifunda lingase linqume ukuhlela izinkulumo zomphakathi noma limemeze ukufakwa kwemibono. Umphakathi ungazisa iKomidi leSishayamthetho noma iBhunga leSifunda ngemibono yabo ngezindaba eziphikisanayo. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana neMenenja yePhalamende ukuze aveze umbono wabo ngendaba ethile yemithetho. UMsunguli weNingizimu Afrika unikeza uhlaka lokukhuthaza ukulingana kobulili nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho. UMsunguli uqukethe izinhlinzeko ezikhuthaza ukulingana kobulili. IBill of Rights iqinisekisa ukwelashwa okufanayo kwabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika. Ivinjwa ukucwaswa okungadingekile ngokobuhlanga nobulili. IBill of Rights igcizelela ukuthi izinyathelo kumele zithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufezwa kokulingana kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. UMsunguli unikeza izikhungo ezisekela ukufakwa kwabantu abaningi nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane. Lezi zikhungo zifaka iKomidi Lokulingana Kobulili neKomidi Lezobuntu laseNingizimu Afrika. Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane kwiPhalamende yizikhathi zokhetho. Indlela abantu abavota ngayo ngesikhathi sokhetho ibumba ukwakheka kweSishayamthetho neBhunga leSifunda. Ukhetho lwesizwe lunika bonke abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-18 ilungelo lokuvota iqembu abakuthandayo. Abesifazane benza inani elikhulu labavoti futhi bangasebenzisa amalungelo abo okuvota ukuze bathinte indlela iPhalamende lakhiwa ngayo nokuthi ibeka kanjani phambili ukuthuthukiswa. Umgwaqo omusha weZinsiza Zabesifazane, Izingane, nabantu abaneZinkinga Zokusebenza usunguliwe ukuze uqinise imizamo yohulumeni yokukhuthaza nokuvikela abantu abahluphekayo emphakathini wethu. Nakuba abesifazane bebaningi kubantu eNingizimu Afrika, bahlala bengabantu abancane uma kuziwa ezinqumweni. Kunezinkinga eziningi ezivimbela abesifazane ekudlaleni indima ephelele futhi ebonakalayo, kanti eyodwa enkulu yilezi ubumpofu. Ubumpoor buwumsebenzi obhekene nabesifazane abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane basemaphandleni. Ukuthola izinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nemfundo, amanzi, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kuvinjwa ubulili, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga zomphakathi. Ukuze abesifazane babambe iqhaza ngokuphelele ekudalweni kwemithetho, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezibalulekile kubabesifazane kumele kuthuthukiswe. Abesifazane abahluphekayo banokufinyelela okulinganiselwe ezikhungweni zokudala imithetho. Abaningi babesifazane babhekene nezinselelo zokwakha umnotho. Abesifazane ngokujwayelekile bangumphakathi ophakeme kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi bangase babe ngaphansi kokusebenza noma bengenamsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS luthinta kakhulu ingxenye enkulu yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasha eminyakeni yabo yokukhulelwa.
Emsebenzini wayo wokubhekelela, iPhalamende iqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho ethathwe iyasetshenziswa, kuhlanganise nezo eziklanyelwe intsha yaleli zwe. Ukuze iPhalamende ibe lula ukufinyelela, kwasungulwa uhlelo olubizwa ngokuthi "Interface yeNgxenye" lapho intsha ingahlangana khona neNgxenye yePhalamende ukuze ixoxe ngezindaba ezithinta bona. Bangaphinde bakhombise imibono yabo ngokukhuluma noma ngokwenza izethulo ezibhaliwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, intsha ibamba iqhaza ezithangamini zeMihlangano yeKomidi lapho imisebenzi eminingi yePhalamende yenzeka khona, futhi bangavakashela ezihlanganisweni zephalamende ukuze babone lokho okwenzekayo ukuze bathole ulwazi futhi bazikhulise. IPhalamende inezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihloselwe imikhakha ehlukene, isibonelo: iPhalamende leNtsha (elenzeka ngenyanga yeNtsha) lapho izindaba eziphathelene nentsha zixoxwa khona futhi lapho kuphela bona bavunyelwe ukuba babambe iqhaza, futhi okwenziwayo lapho kuhlose ukuhlonipha bona. Umthethosisekelo uyalalela iPhalamende ukuba ibandakanye abantu emisebenzini yayo nasemikhubeni yokwenza ibhizinisi, ngakho-ke intsha njengengxenye yomphakathi ivame ukumema ukuba ibe yingxenye yezinhlelo zephalamende, njengeZwi Lomphakathi, Ukwethulwa Kwendaba Yezwe, ezinye izinhlelo zokubambisana zomphakathi, nezinye izinhlelo zokubamba iqhaza komphakathi.
Ibhande lesizwe liyisithombe esibonakalayo, esikhulu kunezinye zonke izithombe ezisemhlabeni. Ibhande lesizwe liyingxenye ebalulekile ye-emblem enkulu, evame ukubhekwa njengophawu oluphezulu kunezinye zonke ezweni. Ibhande elinophawu oluphezulu linikezwa amandla amakhulu ngoba libonisa ukuthi livunyelwe nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika. Ibhande lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika lanikelwa ezweni ngosuku lokukhululeka, ngoMsombuluko 27, 2000. Lokhu kukhombisa umgomo wombuso wokugqamisa ushintsho lwezokhetho eNingizimu Afrika kanye nothando olusha lwezwe lethu. Ibhande lesizwe ingxenye yochungechunge lwezinto ezihlelwe ukuze zenze isimo se-oval esibekwe ngendlela yokuthi ingxenye eyodwa iphakama phezulu kwezinye. Isinqumo sokuqala siyi-motto esiyingxenye ephakathi kwedolobha eliluhlaza. Ibekwa ngendlela efanele, enezinhlangothi ezimbili zezilwane ezibheke phezulu, ukuze igcwalise le dolobha. Emfanekisweni ongafani nowe-egg owenziwe ngezinsingo zezilwane, kukhona izindlebe ezimbili zekhabe ezakha umqhele wegolide ophakathi. Umfanekiso womqhele uhlobene nedrum futhi ubonisa abantu ababili abenziwe ngobuciko bevumelana, bephakathi kwabantu baseKhoisan. Laba bantu baveza ubuso obubheke komunye, bejabulisa ngokuhlanganyela. Phezulu komqhele, kukhona umkhonto nesihlangu ehleliwe ukuze kudaleke isithombe se-cross. Lezi zinto zihlelwe ukuze zihambisane nomqhele ukuze kuqedwe isithombe sesisekelo esingaphansi esifana ne-egg. Inhlanga enezinyawo ezinde ibekwe phezulu kwehlathi eliluhlaza, nezimbali zakha isifuba senhlanga. Inhlanga enezinyawo ezinde ibamba amaphiko ayo ngendlela yehlonipho. Izithombe ezibonakalayo zalena nhlangana zihlobisa ikhanda layo ngokuqinile njengokuthi ibeyimqhele. Ilanga eliphakeme phezulu kwezulu libekwe phakathi kwamaphiko enhlanga enezinyawo ezinde ukuze kuqedwe isithombe se-egg sokuphakama. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezithombe ezifana ne-egg phezulu naphansi kuhlanganisa ukudala indlela ende, engenamkhawulo, futhi ukuhlela kahle phakathi kwezinto kudala umklamo onamandla, omuhle ongafani nanoma iyiphi enye. Ngakho-ke, igcina ukuzinza, isithunzi, namandla adingekayo ibhande lesizwe. I-motto - !ke e: /xarra //ke, ibhalwe ngolimi lwabantu baseKhoisan olubizwa ngokuthi /Xam. Le motto ichaza: ubunye babantu abahlukene. Lokhu kuyimizamo yomuntu ngamunye yokuhlanganisa isenzo nemicabango kube munye. Kubiza izwe ukuba lihlangane ukuze lihlomule ngokuqonda okujwayelekile kokuhlangana futhi lithokozise ngezwe labo. - ubunye emiphakathini yethu ehlukahlukene. Uphawu luhlanganisa ukuvuthwa, ukukhula, nokuthuthukiswa okungenzeka, ukudla kwabantu, nezinye izinto ezihlobene nezolimo. Luhlanganisa ukuhlakanipha, amandla, ubumnene, nokuphila okuphakade. Lunezisebenzi ezimbili: ukubonisa ubunikazi nokuvikela ngomphefumulo. Luhlanganisa uphawu olukhulu lwezwe. Kokubili kufanele kuqinisekise ukuphepha namandla. Futhi kufanele kube nezinyawo eziqinile ezingafani nezinyoni. Umkhonto nesihlangu baphansi, okumele kubonise ukuthula. Emsakazweni - okukhumbuza ngokukhula nokushesha. Le nhlangana inamandla kakhulu enezinyawo zayo - iboniswa nomkhonto nesihlangu - esiza kakhulu ekudlwenguleni nasekuvikeleni. Iyisithunywa esivela ezulwini futhi iletha ubumnene bayo phansi emhlabeni, ngakho ibonisa ubukhosi bezulu. Amathuba ayo aphezulu amelela ukuphakama kwezizwe zethu, okusinika ukuphepha. Uphawu lokuphakama nobuhle. Iyisithombe sesithembiso sokuphinduka, amandla okucabanga okujulile, ulwazi, ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, kanye nokuzimisela okukhulu. Iyisithombe somthombo wokuphila, ukukhanya, nokupheleliswa kobuntu bempela. Isakhiwo esiphelele sebhande lesizwe sihlanganisa izingxenye zaso eziphezulu nezisezansi zibe sesimweni se-oval esimele ukuphila okuphakade. Ukuhlanganiswa kombhalo ophansi, izinsingo zezilwane, nomkhawulo lapho ilanga liphuma kudala isimo se-egg lapho izwe livela. Lesi sithombe sinezincazelo ezibonisa ukuphinduka komoya kwezwe lethu elikhulu nelihloniphekile. Igama elithi Batho Pele yisisho sesiSotho elisho "Abantu kuqala," elibophezela abasebenzi bakamasipala ukuba baphathe bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubaluleka nemigomo yeBatho Pele kuyisisekelo sebhande lesizwe. Ngomhla ka-Okthoba 1, 1997, abasebenzi bakamasipala baqala umkhankaso weBatho Pele ophokophele ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo abazihlinzekayo emphakathini. Ukwenza umsebenzi omuhle ngemali nezinsiza ezikhokhelwayo ukuze amakhasimende akwazi ukubona ukuthi imali yabo yokuthenga isetshenziswa kahle nangempumelelo. I-Batho Pele iphathelene nokuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezisebenzayo nezisebenza kahle ezingabeki izidingo zabantu kuqala. Iphinde ihlobene nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imali kukamasipala zihambisana nezidingo zabantu nalokho okudingekayo ngokuphuthumayo. Iningi lokuthuthukiswa okufuna abantu alidingi imali ukuze kube khona, njengokuhlonipha abantu, ukuba neqiniso uma uhlinzeka ngemininingwane, nokuxolisa uma kwenziwa amaphutha. Lezi zinto azidingi imali - zidinga ukushintsha indlela abantu abenza ngayo. Ukwenza ngcono izinsizakalo zabantu kuphathelene nokuhlela kabusha indlela ophatha ngayo abantu. Ukufeza uhlelo lweBatho Pele akusikho umsebenzi owodwa ophuma, kodwa uhlelo oluqhubekayo, olunamandla oluzoqhubeka eminyakeni eminingi, luthola amandla njalo.
