IPhalamende yaseNingizimu Afrika inezindlu ezimbili: iNhlangano Yezwe (eyaziwa ngokuthi i-NA), enamalungu angu-400, kanye neNhlangano Yezwe Yezifunda (eyaziwa ngokuthi i-NCOP), enamalungu angama-90 okungenani. Umthethosisekelo uthi i-NCOP temsilisa izifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zezifunda zicatshangelwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuphatha kwesizwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ikakhulukazi ngokubamba iqhaza enqubweni yokwazisa yesizwe futhi kuhanjiswa umphakathi ipulatifomu yesizwe yokuxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezithinta izifunda. I-NCOP iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zokuphatha zendawo zicatshangelwa ezingeni likamasipala. Abameleli baphathiswa nguMphakathi wezifunda ngasinye, ongomunye wabameleli abakhethekile. Uma kudingeka, uMphakathi angabiza omunye umuntu endaweni yakhe. Umholi, kanye noMholi oMabili, babheke umsebenzi we-NCOP futhi baphatha izingxoxo, beqinisekisa ukuthi abameleli bakhuluma ngokukhululeka uma behambisana nemithetho ebekwe yiNdlu. UMholi oMabili ukhethwa ukuba asebenze isikhathi esigcwele seminyaka emihlanu, kanti oMphakathi bezifunda baphindaphinda njengamaMholi oMabili isikhathi seminyaka eyodwa. I-NCOP kufanele ibonwe njengendawo engasiza ekuphathweni kokubambisana kanye nenhloso enkulu yokubamba iqhaza, futhi ukuthi ikhuthaza ukucatshangelwa kwezidingo zokuphatha zendawo kanye nezifunda ezingeni lesizwe. I-NCOP inikeza izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zaseNingizimu Afrika izwi futhi iphinde inikeze iziphathimandla zendawo ipulatifomu yokubamba iqhaza ekucubunguleni umthetho ezingeni lesizwe. Kumele icabangele yonke imithetho yesizwe. Iphinde ikwazi ukuhlinzeka noma ukulungisa imithetho ephansi kweSheduli 4 yomthethosisekelo (lezi zindaba lapho bobabili abenzi bomthetho bezwe nezifunda banegunya lokwenza umthetho ndawonye) neminye imithetho ethinta izifunda. Iningi lemisebenzi yokwazisa lenziwa emakhomithini, kodwa yonke imithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwi-NCOP ukuze ixoxwe futhi ivote ukuthi leyo mithetho yamukelwa noma iyalahlwa. Imithetho engathinti izifunda iphathelene nemisebenzi yesizwe; efana nokuvikela, ezokuhweba, kanye nezobulungiswa. Uma le mithetho yamukelwa yiNhlangano Yezwe, ithunyelwa kwi-NCOP ukuze ivote. Izibonelo zemithetho ethinta izifunda zifaka phakathi imfundo, ukuthutha, usizo lwezenhlalakahle, kanye nempilo. Iningi lemithetho lingangeniswa kwi-NCOP nganoma iyiphi yalezi zindlu; nokho, kukhona imithetho ethile okufanele iqale kwiNhlangano Yezwe. Uma kukhona ukungavumelani phakathi kwe-NA ne-NCOP ngemithetho ethinta izifunda, le mithetho kumele ithunyelwe kwiKomidi Lokuxazulula. Uma umthetho ophushelwa noma ushintsha umthethosisekelo uthinta ngqo izifunda, okungenani eziyisithupha zezifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye kwi-NCOP kumele zivume. Uma umthetho ophushelwa umthethosisekelo ungathinti ngqo izifunda, umthethosisekelo uthi i-NCOP kumele ibe nengxoxo ngalowo mthetho (ngaphandle kokuthi uvotwe) ngaphambi kokuthi uthunyelwe kwi-NA ukuze uvotwe. Ukubhekwa okwenziwa nguhulumeni njengoba kuphathiswe ngumthethosisekelo kuhlanganisa amaNhlangano Ezifunda aqapha futhi ahlola izenzo zohulumeni. I-NCOP ikwenza ukubhekwa kwezindaba zesizwe ezivela ezifundeni nasezikhungweni zendawo. I-NCOP ingacela ilungu leKabinet, isikhulu sikamasipala, noma isikhulu sikamasipala wesifunda ukuba sibe khona emhlanganweni wayo noma emhlanganweni wekomidi. I-NCOP noma noma yiziphi zezikomidi zayo zingamukela izicelo, izethulo, noma izincwadi ezibhaliwe ezivela kunoma ubani noma izinhlangano ezinomdla. I-NCOP iphinde ibambisane nemiphakathi ukuze ihlole izenzo zohulumeni ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi iqoqe ulwazi ngezidingo nezinkinga abantu ababhekana nazo. Ikomidi ngalinye lihlola umsebenzi wesigaba ngasinye sohulumeni. Ikomidi icubungula futhi ilungisa imithetho, futhi ikhuthaza ama-foramu omphakathi uma kukhona udaba olubalulekile lokuthakazelelwa komphakathi. Amakhomidi angamenya noma ubani ukuze ahlinzeke ubufakazi noma athumele imibhalo, futhi angacela noma ubani noma inhlangano ukuthi ibike kubo ngezindaba ezithile. Abameleli besifunda ngasinye banokhetho olulodwa oluphakanyiswa ngumholi wendawo yokumelwa kwesifunda egameni lesifunda. Amalungu omphakathi angadlala indima ebonakalayo ekuhloleni okwenziwa nguhulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhulumeni uphendula izidingo zabantu. Ukuveza kumkhankaso wephalamende kuyindlela eyodwa yokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale ePhalamende. Ngokwenza isethulo, unethuba lokwabelana ngemibono yakho namalungu ekhomidi ngenkathi bexoxa futhi becubungula umthetho othile ngaphambi kokuba uqedwe. Isicelo siyindlela yokuletha ePhalamende izikhalazo noma izindaba ezithakazelelayo zomphakathi ukuze ikwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngaphakathi kwamandla ayo. Ilungelo lokufaka isicelo ePhalamende liyilungelo labantu bonke baleli zwe futhi linikezwa umthethosisekelo wethu. Noma ubani, noma amaqembu abantu noma noma iyiphi inhlangano inelungelo lokufaka isicelo ePhalamende. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana namalungu ePhalamende emahhovisi abo ezinkundleni zomphakathi ezweni lonke noma ePhalamende uma befuna ukuthi babasekele endabeni eshisa izikhotha abafuna ukuyixoxa noma uma befuna usizo ngendaba ethile.
Inhloso yale ncwadi ukusiza othisha nabafundi bezigaba zika-10 kuya ku-12 enqubweni yokufunda nokufundisa ngokuqamba okudala okudlulisa imiyalezo ngama-ndaba nezinkanyezi. Le ncwadi izosiza kakhulu abafundi ukuphumelela ekufezeni Umphumela Wokufunda 3 nasekulungiseleleni izivivinyo zabo. Ibhalwe futhi ihlukaniswe ngezindawo ezintathu. Kukhona imibhalo eyakhelwe yona, imibhalo emide nemifushane. Ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, izinhlobo zemibhalo zikhona, zonke izinhlobo zichazwa futhi izibonelo zinikezwa. Ukubhala nokwakha imibhalo kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uthisha anike abafundi ithuba elanele lokuzijwayeza ukubhala okuqhubekayo. Bavame ukunikezwa amathuba okubhala ngokukhululeka ngaphandle kokuhlolwa. Ekubhaleni okusekelwe kakhulu ezinjongo ezithile, othisha baphakanyiswa ukuba bahlola ikhono elithile noma amandla athile asetshenziswayo ngesikhathi esithile senqubo yokubhala. Ngokwesibonelo, zonke izakhono zolimi kumele zikhulunywe ngaleso sikhathi senqubo yokubhala, okuyindlela othisha abayisebenzisile esikhathini esedlule. Ngenxa yalokhu, ukubhala njengokhono kuvame ukunganakwa ngoba kuhlale kudinga ukuhlolwa okukhulu. Abafundi kufanele bafunde ukuhlela umsebenzi wabanye ngoba lokhu kubalulekile engxenyeni yokubhala futhi kuthuthukisa ukuqashelwa kwenqubo yomfundi kanye neyabanye. Isici esibalulekile salolu mphumela ukuveza umsebenzi obhaliwe. Kungabelana nabanye, othisha, esikoleni sonke, abazali, noma abanye ababambiqhaza. Umfundi uzothokozisa ngemikhiqizo ephelele nepholile. Abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukuchaza kafushane izinhlobo zemibhalo eyakhelwe yona njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Le yindaba lapho umbhali noma umnqobi echaza umcimbi othile owenzekile kuye, noma ungabonwa ukwenzeka kumuntu omunye noma ukuxoxwa ngakho. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi umbhali akhe indaba kusuka emicabangweni yakhe. Lokhu kuvame ukutholakala phakathi kwabafundi (ezikoleni). Kubalulekile ukuthi noma ngabe umfundi udala indaba yakhe emicabangweni yakhe, kufanele kube indaba ethembekile. Ngokuvamile, umbhali walesi saga usebenzisa isikhathi esedlule, umuntu okhuluma noma okukhulunywa ngaye, ukuze axoxe ngendaba yakhe. Ingxenye yokwethulwa kufanele ibandakanye umfundi wendaba. Indaba yokuxoxa kufanele ibe nethembekile noma ngabe iyamanga. Indaba yokuxoxa ivame ukubhalwa ngesiqalo esedlule. Umuntu ofundayo le ndaba kufanele njalo alindele ukuzwa okwenzekayo okulandelayo kuze kube sekupheleni. Ukuxoxa ngempumelelo kukhombisa kahle izinzwa, ezifana nokubona, ukuzwa, ukunambitha, ukunuka, nokuthinta. Isibonelo sesihloko sendaba yokuxoxa: Usuku Esithole Ngalo Ibhubesi Ebhange Elidumile Emkhakheni Wethu. Kwakuyisikhathi seMgqibelo ntambama ekupheleni kukaJuni. Ubanda wawukhukhula isikhumba ezweni laseKwaZulu-Natal. Nakuba ubanda wawukhukhula isikhumba, abantu babephuma ngenani elikhulu ukuze benze izidingo zabo edolobheni laseMnambithi. Kwakungabonakala izinhlobo ezahlukene zezingubo, amabhulukwe, amahembe, amajakhethi, futhi ngisho nemishayo eminingi. Abantu abaningi besilisa nabesifazane babegqoke amahhashi enza izindlebe zabo zihlale zikhululekile. Abesifazane, ngakolunye uhlangothi, babengaqinisekisa ukuthi baphuma bexoxa ukuthi bahlonishwa ngama-scarves ezindololwane zabo. I-ABSA ibhange elivame ukuba nabantu abaningi kunezinye. Kwakunjalo nalesi sikhathi. Kwakukhona umgibeli njengokujwayelekile holding ibhande lakhe kanye ne-stick encane ethunywa emzimbeni uma ungene ebhange. Wonke umuntu ongene emnyango wayedlula futhi ethola izibusiso kulowo stick. Nami ngasondela futhi nganika umgibeli ithuba lokwenza umsebenzi wakhe. Ngemuva kwesikhashana, ngabe sengaphakathi ebhange. Ngabe sengibona indawo lapho kuhlawulwa khona imali nokuhlawulwa. Ngakuqonda ukuthi kufanele ngisheshe ngiyokhipha imali kumshini wokukhipha imali futhi ngiqale ukufaka imininingwane edingekayo. Njengoba ngiqeda, ngangihlangana nabantu ababejolile. Kwathatha isikhathi eside njengoba sasondele kancane kancane. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, abasebenzi bebha ngabe bezama ukukhuluma ngento ethile nabantu ababephakathi ebhange. Owayeduze kithi wahlukana abantu babeziqoqela ezigabeni ezimbili - umugqa wabantu abakhipha imali kanye nalabo abahlawula. Futhi, kwavela imigqa emibili. Ngabe ngisemugqa wabantu abakhipha imali. Isizathu sokuthi ngihambe ngiyokhipha imali ngaphakathi ebhange kwaba ukuthi ngifuna ama-randi ayisithupha. Umugqa wabantu abakhipha imali kumshini kanye nalabo abahlawula wawuphuthuma kunathi. Ngabe ngiqhubeka ngibona abantu bephuma naphakathi kwemigqa yokukhipha nokuhlawula imali. Kwakungaleso sikhathi enganginombono wokuthi ngingakhipha ama-randi amabili kuphela, kodwa ngiphinde ngiziphinde ngithi kufanele ngibe nesineke kuze kube sekufikeni kwami. Esikhundleni sokwandisa inani labatholi nabakhiphi, banciphisa. Ngemuva kwesikhashana, izindawo abazisebenzisayo zazivele zihlukaniswe nezimpawu ezithi 'zivalwe'. Sasinokubekezela ngoba sasidinga imali. Kwakuzwakala sengathi ngiphupha lapho sekufikile isikhathi sokuhamba phambili kumthengisi kanye nomphakathi. Washesha wacindezela ikhompyutha kathathu noma kathathu ngomzuzu, wabalela imali, wayinika mina. Ngiyithathe futhi ngambonga ngenkathi ngimfisela uhambo oluhle. Ngesikhathi ngibheka emnyango, ngabona umgibeli evala umnyango kulabo abangenayo nalabo abaphuma. Saphazamiseka ukubona abavikeli ngaphakathi ebhange bephatha amabhokisi emali. Bobabili basondeza kumshini wokukhipha nokuhlawula imali, bavula, futhi baqala ukufaka imali. Zonke izinyembezi zaguquka zaba kubo labo bavikeli. Ngabe ngikhuluma nami ukuthi ngeke baphume, kungani sithola ithuba lokuphuma emnyango ukuze siphume ebhange. Noma ngabe umuntu akakaze abambe umkhonto kodwa unomsindo womkhonto olungiselelwe ukuhlela. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenkathi sisathokozisa ngababheki ababephatha imali kumshini. Ngesikhathi siphendukela ezindaweni zethu, amehlo ethu abheka lapho imisindo ehlukahlukene yemikhonto ilungiselelwe ukuhlela, umuntu owayekhona wabona omunye elele phansi enhliziyweni. Ngabe ngibona nami ngilele phansi ngaphezu kwalokho. Ngesikhathi abanye abantu bephatha imali kumashini, abanye bekwamukela lokho okwakuhlawulwe ngabavikeli, kanti abanye bekhipha imali ezikhwameni zethu. Okukhona lapho kwenzeka ngempela. Ngomzuzu, kwavela udlame. Lokhu akusizanga nhlobo ngoba sekukade kudlule emkhakheni. Imali yethu yathathwa. Akukho muntu ofa ngokuphazamiseka ngoba angizange ngithinteka ngalolo suku lapho ngashaywa ngemuva kwalokho. Ngisho namuhla, ngisathola umoya opholile uma ngicabanga ngalolo suku. Le indaba lapho umbhali kufanele achaze isimo esithile, umuntu othile, noma indawo ethile. Njengoba
Sebenzisa ipeni emnyama noma eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ukuze ugcwalise ifomu lezintela futhi ugcine ukubhala kwakho ngaphakathi kwezikhala ezitholakalayo. Sicela usebenzise izinhlamvu ezinkulu lapho ugcwalisa le phepha. UNGASHIYI izikhala ezingenalutho ezingadingeki. Sicela ungasebenzisi ukulungisa umswakamo uma wenza iphutha. Siphinde sicele ukuthi ungayigudluki ifomu lakho lezintela njengoba lokhu kuzobambezela ukuhlela kwalo. Kufanele uqedele zonke izingxenye ezihlobene nephepha lezintela. Noma yisiphi ifomu lezintela elingagcwaliswanga ngokuphelele lizobuyiselwa kuwe libhalwe "alithunyelwanga" kuze kube ubuyisela ngokuphelele. Lokhu kungaholela ezijezweni zokuthunyelwa kwezimali ezibambezelekile. Ukusayina: ifomu lezintela liyisivumelwano esisemthethweni esidinga ukuthi udalule yonke imali engenayo, intela, nezikhala unyaka wonke. Ngaphandle kokusayina kwakho, akusho lutho. Imali etholelwe uma ungazange uthole imali engenayo unyaka wonke kufanele igcwaliswe kulolu hlobo ngokufaka zero (0). AZIKHO izingxenye okufanele uzihlanganise nefomu lakho uma uthumela ku-SARS. Nokho, zonke imibhalo ehambisanayo kufanele igcinwe iminyaka emihlanu uma i-SARS ifuna lezi zinto. Ukuze kube lula, kulonyaka i-SARS isethule amafomu amabili amasha ezintela zabantu. Uma uthole ifomu IT12C kodwa uzwa ukuthi ungaphansi kwesigaba se-IT12S, kufanele ugcwalise futhi uthumele lelo fomu le-IT12C; ungaceli ifomu lezintela le-IT12S. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela, i-SARS izoshintsha uhlobo lwefomu ngokususelwa kulwazi olunikeziwe kufomu lakho lamanje futhi izolungisa uhlelo ngokufanele ukuze ikhiphe ifomu elilungile ngonyaka olandelayo. Qinisekisa ubuqiniso bolwazi olushicilelwe futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho kulolu lwazi olushicilelwe ukuze ufake imininingwane efanele. Isimo somshado njengoba sikhona ngoFebhuwari 28, 2007: Beka ibhlogo efanele nge "Y" (yebo) noma "N" (cha) usebenzisa "X" futhi uma ushade, khombisa nge "X" ukuthi umshado ungaphansi komphakathi wezimpahla noma cha. Qinisekisa ubuqiniso bolwazi olushicilelwe futhi uma lungalungile, sebenzisa izikhala ezingenalutho kulolu lwazi olushicilelwe ukuze unikeze imininingwane efanele. Sicela ugcwalise imininingwane ye-akhawunti yomqashi wakho wamanje. Uma usebenze endaweni engaphezu kweyodwa phakathi kwesikhathi sikaMashi 1, 2006, kuya kuFebhuwari 28, 2007, gcwalisa imininingwane ye-akhawunti yomqashi wakho omkhulu - lapho usebenze khona amahora amaningi. Uma ungasebenzi, shiya lesi sikhala singalungile. Ukuhanjiswa kwezimali ezibuyiswayo kwenziwa kusetshenziswa ikhodi yephoyinti, hhayi igama lebhange. Ngakho-ke, akudingeki ukuthi unikeze igama lebhange olisebenzisayo. Qaphela: i-SARS ikhipha ama-cheque kuphela ezimweni ezikhethekile, ngakho kufanele unikeze imininingwane zebhange ukuze uthole ukubuyiselwa. Akukho ukubuyiselwa okuzobekwa kwi-akhawunti yebhange yomuntu wesithathu. Khombisa indlela yakho yokuxhumana oyikhethayo ngokubeka ibhlogo efanele usebenzisa izinombolo 1 kuya ku-5. Inombolo 1 ibonisa ukukhetha okuthandwa kakhulu kanti 5 ibonisa ukukhetha okuncane. Uma usebenzisa umthengisi wezintela ukuze ugcwalise iphepha lakho lezintela, lowo mthengisi uzogcwalisa ulwazi. Uma uthola imali ekhombisa kumasertifika IRP5/IT3(a), udinga ukuyiphatha njengoba kukhombisiwe ngezansi. Ikhodi esigabeni sokuqala ikhombisa umthombo wemali yakho kanti isigaba sokugcina sikhombisa inani olitholile. Lezi yizigaba kuphela ozodinga ukuzigcwalisa kulolu hlobo lwefomu. Uma uthola kuphela i-IRP5/IT3(a) eyodwa, uzogcwalisa inani bese ufaka ikhodi yomthombo efanele esigabeni se-fomu njengoba kukhombisiwe ngezansi. Uma unezigaba eziningi ezingaphezu kwezishiyagalombili, udinga ukuxhumana neCall Centre ku-0860 12 12 18 ukuze uthole usizo ekuqedeni ifomu lakho lezintela. Izimali zitholakala esigabeni semali engenayo ye-IRP5. Sebenzisa inani elikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 ukuze ugcwalise lesi sigaba - uma uthole ama-IRP5/IT3(a) amaningi, zonke izimali ezikhonjiswe eduze kwekhodi 3697 kufanele zengezwe ndawonye bese inani eliphelele lifakwa kufomu njengekhodi 2697. Ngokwezimali zezintela, imali yokutshala ibalwa njengemali engenayo njengezintshisekelo zendawo, izintshisekelo zangaphandle, nezinsizakalo zangaphandle. Izintshisekelo zendawo zikhonjiswa ekhasini lesibili lephepha lakho lezintela futhi izinhlelo zenziwa ekhasini lesithathu lephepha lakho lezintela ukuze kudalulwe imali etholelwe ezintshisekelweni zangaphandle nezinsizakalo zangaphandle kanye nanoma yiziphi izikhala zezintela zangaphandle, uma zikhona. Hlanganisa izimali ezihlobene nezintshisekelo zendawo ezikhonjiswe kumasertifika atholwe mayelana nawe nomkakho. Gcwalisa inani eliphelele lezintshisekelo ezitholwe ngu wena nomkakho - ingxenye engakhokhiswa izintela izobalwa yi-SARS. Phinda le nqubo ngezintshisekelo zangaphandle nezinsizakalo zangaphandle. Khumbula futhi ukuhlanganisa noma yiziphi izikhala zezintela ezihlobene nawe nomkakho futhi ugcwalise inani eliphelele eduze kwekhodi efanele ekhasini lesithathu lefomu lakho. Izinhlelo zenziwe kufomu ukuze kudalulwe izikhala zezintela ezihlobene nezintshisekelo zangaphandle nezinsizakalo zangaphandle. Hlanganisa izimali ezikhonjiswe njengezintshisekelo zendawo kumasertifika owatholile. Gcwalisa izimali zezikhala zezintela ezingakhokhiswa - ingxenye engakhokhiswa izintela izobalwa yi-SARS. Phinda le nqubo ngezintshisekelo zangaphandle nezinsizakalo zangaphandle futhi udalule izimali eziphelele ekhasini lesithathu lefomu lakho ezikhala ezifanele. Ifomu lezintela livumela ama-sertifika amathathu ngakho-ke lihlukaniswe ngezindawo ezintathu. Khombisa inani labaxhasi abakhokhelwayo. Ukusayina: Ifomu lezi zinsiza liyisitatimende esibophelelayo ngokomthetho esidinga ukuthi uvumele yonke imali, intela, nezikhala zonyaka. I-IT12S iyifomu lezi zinsiza zomuntu. Liyakhiwa ukuze igcwaliswe ngabasebenzi abathola umholo futhi bathola izikhala zokuhamba nezikhala zezindleko zezokwelapha kanye nezinkokhelo zokuthatha umhlalaphansi. Banikeza ulwazi lokubala izindleko zokuhamba. Uma ukhetha ukubala usebenzisa izindleko zangempela, kuzodingeka ukuthi unikeze ulwazi oluhambisanayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, izindleko ezimisiwe zizosebenza. I-ITC12C iyifomu elinzima labantu abanemali efana nemali yokurenta, imali yangaphandle, imali yebhizinisi, imali yokulima, kanye nezindleko/ukulahleka kwebhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwe-IT12S njengoba kuxoxiwe ngenhla, ifomu linikeza abatshali bemali ithuba lokukhombisa noma iyiphi enye imali engafakwanga kwi-IT12S. Abesifazane benza ingxenye enkulu yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika, yingakho izwi labesifazane kufanele lifakwe ezinqumweni nasekudalweni kwemithetho. Lokhu kufakwa kwabesifazane ezinqumweni kuyilungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Abesifazane kumele babambe iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngoba ukwenziwa kwemithetho nemigomo yohulumeni kuthinta impilo yabo nsuku zonke. Kubalulekile, ucwaningo luveze ukuthi lapho abesifazane bebamba iqhaza ezinqumweni, kuholela ekutheni kube nokunakwa okwengeziwe nokwabiwa kwezinsiza okuthuthukisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu. Ukwanda kokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho kungaholela ekutholeni kalula kwezinsiza ezibalulekile ezifana nezindlu, imfundo, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. UMsunguli waseNingizimu Afrika uthi umphakathi kumele wazi futhi ubambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende nasemigomeni yalo. Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokwenza lokhu. Abesifazane bangabamba iqhaza ekudalweni kwemithetho ngokuvota iqembu lezepolitiki abakholelwa ukuthi lizomela kangcono imibono nezinkathazo zabo kwiPhalamende. Bangaphinde babambe iqhaza ekuhlela nasekusebenzeni kweqembu abakhethe. Abesifazane baphumelele ezikhundleni eziphezulu ngalendlela. Amalungu omphakathi anelungelo lokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeKomidi futhi abambe iqhaza ezinkulumweni zomphakathi ngezindaba ezithile. Uma kuwukuthi umphakathi unentshisekelo yokuzwa ngendaba ethile, iKomidi leNdlu Yezinhlaka noma iBhodi Yezifunda lingase lenze izinkulumo zomphakathi noma limemeze iziphakamiso. Umphakathi ungazisa iKomidi leNdlu Yezinhlaka noma iBhodi Yezifunda ngemibono yabo ngezindaba eziphikisanayo. Amalungu omphakathi angaxhumana neMenenja yePhalamende ukuze aveze umbono wabo ngengxenye ethile yemithetho. UMsunguli waseNingizimu Afrika uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukhuthaza ukuvumelana kwezobulili nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane ekudalweni kwemithetho. UMsunguli uqukethe izinhlinzeko ezithuthukisa ukuvumelana kwezobulili. IBill of Rights iqinisekisa ukwelashwa okufanayo kwabesifazane eNingizimu Afrika. Ibanqanda ukwehlukaniswa okungadingekile ngokobuhlanga nangobulili. IBill of Rights igcizelela ukuthi izinyathelo kumele zithathwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufezwa kokulingana kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi. UMsunguli uhlinzeka ngezikhungo ezisekela ukuveza kwabantu abaningi nokubamba iqhaza kwabesifazane. Lezi zikhungo zifaka iKomidi Lokulingana Kwezinhlanga kanye neKomidi Lezobulungiswa Lwabasebenzi BaseNingizimu Afrika. Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuthi abesifazane babambe iqhaza kwiPhalamende ngesikhathi sokhetho. Indlela abantu abavota ngayo ngesikhathi sokhetho ibumba ukwakheka kweNdlu Yezinhlaka kanye neBhodi Yezifunda. Ukhetho lwezizwe lunika bonke abantu abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-18 ilungelo lokuvota iqembu abalikhethayo. Abesifazane benza inani elikhulu labavoti futhi bangasebenzisa amalungelo abo okuvota ukuze bathinte indlela iPhalamende lakhiwa ngayo nokuthi ibeka kanjani phambili ukuthuthukiswa. Umnyango omusha wabesifazane, izingane, nabantu abanokukhubazeka usunguliwe ukuze uqinise imizamo kahulumeni yokukhuthaza nokuvikela abantu abahluphekayo emphakathini wethu. Nakuba abesifazane beningi emiphakathini yaseNingizimu Afrika, bahlala bengabantu abancane uma kuziwa ezinqumweni. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezivimbela abesifazane ukuba badlale indima ephelele nefanele, futhi eyodwa enkulu yalezi ubumpofu. Ubumfucu buwumsebenzi obhekene nabesifazane abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane basemaphandleni. Ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezibalulekile ezifana nemfundo, amanzi, nezinsizakalo zomphakathi kuvinjwa ubulili, ubuhlanga, nezifundo. Ukuze abesifazane bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ngokuphelele ekudalweni kwemithetho, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezibalulekile kwabesifazane kumele kuthuthukiswe. Abesifazane abampofu banokufinyelela okulinganiselwe ezikhungweni zokudala imithetho. Abaningi babesifazane babhekene nezinselelo zokukhulisa umnotho. Abesifazane ngokujwayelekile bangumphakathi ongenamathuba kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi bangase babe ngaphansi kokusebenza noma bangenamsebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS luthinta kakhulu ingxenye enkulu yabesifazane, ikakhulukazi abesifazane abasha eminyakeni yabo yokubeletha.
Emsebenzini wayo wokubhekelela, iPhalamende iqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho ethathwe iyasetshenziswa, kuhlanganise leyo eyenzelwe intsha yaleli zwe. Ukuze iPhalamende ibe lula ukufinyelela, kwasungulwa uhlelo olwaziwa ngokuthi "Interface yeNhlangano" lapho abantu abasha bengahlangana khona neNhlangano yePhalamende ukuze baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile kubo. Bangaphinde bakhombise imibono yabo ngokukhuluma noma ngokwenza izethulo ezibhaliwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abasha babamba iqhaza ezithangamini zeMihlangano yeKomidi lapho umsebenzi omningi wePhalamende wenziwa khona, futhi bangavakashela ezihlanganweni zephalamende ukuze babone okwenziwayo ukuze bathole ulwazi futhi bazithuthukise. IPhalamende inezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezihloselwe imikhakha ehlukene, njengokuthi: iPhalamende leNtsha (eyenzeka ngesikhathi seNyanga yeNtsha) lapho izindaba eziphathelene nabantu abasha zixoxwa khona futhi lapho kuphela bona bevunyelwe ukuba babe khona, futhi okwenziwayo lapho kuhlose ukuhlonipha bona. Umthethosisekelo uyalela iPhalamende ukuba ibandakanye abantu emisebenzini yayo nasemikhakheni eyenziwa ngayo, ngakho-ke abantu abasha njengengxenye yomphakathi bamenywa njalo ukuba babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zephalamende, njengokuhlola umphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngenkulumo yeSimo seSizwe, nezinye izinhlelo zokubandakanya umphakathi, kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokubamba iqhaza komphakathi.
Ibhande Lesizwe liyisithombe esibonakalayo, esikhulu kunazo zonke ezinye izithombe ezisemhlabeni. Ibhande Lesizwe liyingxenye ebalulekile ye-emblem enkulu, evame ukubhekwa njengophawu oluphakeme kunezinye zonke ezweni. Ibhande elinophawu oluphakeme linikezwa amandla amakhulu ngoba libonisa ukuthi livunyelwe nguMongameli weNingizimu Afrika. Ibhande Lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika lanikelwa ezwenikazi ngosuku lweMphakathi, ngoMsombuluko 27, 2000. Lokhu kukhombisa umgomo lukamasipala wokugqamisa ushintsho lwezokhetho eNingizimu Afrika kanye nothando olusha lwezwe lethu. Ibhande Lesizwe ingxenye yochungechunge lwezinto ezihlelwe ukuze zenze isimo se-oval esibekwe ngendlela yokuthi ingxenye eyodwa iphakama phezulu kwelinye. Isinqumo sokuqala siyi-motto eyingxenye ebalulekile ngaphakathi kwesigubhu esiluhlaza. Ibekwa ngendlela efanayo, enezinhlangothi ezimbili zezilwane ezibheke phezulu, ukuze igcwalise isigubhu. Emfanekisweni ongafani ne-egg eyakhiwe ngezinsingo zezilwane, kukhona izindlebe ezimbili ze-corn zakha umqhele wegolide ophakathi. Umfanekiso womqhele uhambisana nedrum futhi ubonisa abantu ababili abenziwe ngobuciko besikhumba bamele abantu baseKhoisan. Laba bantu baveza ubuso obubheke komunye nomunye, bejabulela ngokuhlanganyela. Phezulu komqhele, kukhona umkhonto nesihlangu ahlelwe ukuze akhe isiphambano. Lezi zinto zihlelwe ukuze zihambisane nomqhele ukuze kuqedwe umfanekiso wesisekelo esingaphansi esifana ne-egg. Inhlanzi enezinyawo ezinde ibekwe phezulu kwehlathi eliluhlaza, nezimbali zakha isifuba senhlanzi. Inhlanzi enezinyawo ezinde ibamba amaphiko ayo ngendlela yokuhlonipha. Izithombe ezibonakalayo zalenhlanzi zihloba ikhanda layo ngokuqinile njengokuthi iyinqaba. Ilanga eliphakamisayo phezulu kwesibhakabhaka libekwe phakathi kwamaphiko enhlanzi enezinyawo ezinde ukuze kuqedwe umfanekiso ofana ne-egg wokuphakama. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezithombe ezifana ne-egg phezulu naphansi kuhlanganisa ukudala indlela ende, engapheli, futhi ukuhlela kahle phakathi kwezinto kudala umklamo onamandla, omuhle ongafani nanoma iyiphi enye. Ngakho-ke, igcina ukuzinza, ubungcweti, namandla adingekayo ibhande lesizwe. Imoto - !ke e: /xarra //ke, ibhalwe ngolimi lwabantu baseKhoisan olubizwa nge-/Xam. Le motto ichaza: ubunye babantu abahlukene. Lokhu kuyizifiso zomuntu ngamunye zokuhlanganisa isenzo nemicabango kube munye. Kukhuthaza izwe ukuba lihlangane ukuze labelane ngokuqonda okujwayelekile kokuhlanganyela futhi lithokozise ngobuzwe bazo. - ubunye emiphakathini yethu ehlukahlukene. Uphawu lumele ukuvuthwa, ukukhula, nokuthuthukiswa okungenzeka, ukudla kwabantu, nezinye izinto ezihlobene nezolimo. Lumele ukuhlakanipha, amandla, ubumnene, nokuphila okungapheli. Inezinhloso ezimbili: ukukhombisa ubunikazi nokuvikela ngokomoya. Iphakamisa uphawu olukhulu lwezwe. Bobabili kumele baqinisekise ukuphepha namandla. Futhi kumele kube nezinyawo ezinamandla ezingafani nezinhlanzi. Umkhonto nesihlangu baphansi, okumele kukhombise ukuthula. Emaphuzwini - kukhumbuza ngokukhula nokushesha. Le yinhla enkulu enamandla ngezinyawo zayo - iboniswe nomkhonto nesihlangu - eyasiza kakhulu ekudlweni nasekuvikeleni. Iyi-messenger evela ezulwini futhi iletha ubumnene bayo phansi emhlabeni, ngakho ibonisa ubukhosi bezulu. Amaphiko ayo aphezulu amelela ukuphakama kwezwe lethu, elisinika ukuphepha. Uphawu lokuphakama nobukhazikhazi. Iphakamisa umfanekiso wesithembiso sokuzalwa kabusha, amandla okucabanga okujulile, ulwazi, ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, nokuzimisela okukhulu. Iphawu losuku lokuphila, ukukhanya, nokupheleliswa kobuntu bokwenyani. Isakhiwo esiphelele seBhande Lesizwe sihlanganisa izingxenye zaso eziphezulu nezisezansi zibe sesimweni se-oval esimele ukuphila okungapheli. Ukuhlanganiswa kombhalo ophansi, izinsingo zezilwane, kanye ne-horizon lapho ilanga liphakama kudala isimo esifana ne-egg esivela kulo izwe. Lo mfanekiso unencazelo ekhombisa ukuvuselelwa komoya kwezwe lethu elikhulu nelihle. Igama Batho Pele liyifreyimu yeSesotho elisho "Abantu kuqala," ekwenza kube ngumsebenzi wabasebenzi bakamasipala ukuba baphathe bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubaluleka nezimiso zeBatho Pele zisisekelo seBhande Lesizwe. Ngomhla ka-Okthoba 1, 1997, abasebenzi bakamasipala baqala umkhankaso weBatho Pele ogxile ekuthuthukiseni izinsizakalo abazinikezayo emphakathini. Ukuze benze umsebenzi omuhle ngemali nezinsiza ezikhokhelwayo ukuze amakhasimende akwazi ukubona ukuthi imali yabo yokuthenga isetshenziswa kahle nangempumelelo. I-Batho Pele ihlobene nokuhlinzeka ngezindlela ezisebenza kahle nezisebenzayo ezingabeki izidingo zabantu kuqala. Iphinde ihlobene nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenzisa imali zikamasipala zihambisana nezidingo zabantu nokuthi yini edingekayo ngokushesha. Iningi lokuthuthukiswa okufuna abantu aludingi imali ukuze lukhona, njengokuhlonipha abantu, ukuba neqiniso lapho uhlinzeka ngemininingwane, nokuxolisa uma kwenziwa amaphutha. Lezi zinto azidingi imali - zidinga ukuguqula indlela abantu abaphila ngayo. Ukuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zabantu kuhilela ukuhlela kabusha indlela ophatha ngayo abantu. Ukufeza uhlelo lweBatho Pele akusikho umsebenzi owodwa ophelayo, kodwa uhlelo oluqhubekayo, olunamandla oluzoqhubeka iminyaka eminingi, luthola umkhankaso njalo.
Umphakathi omusha weMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal, uDkt. Busi Nyembezi, uqinisekisile ukuthi uzokwethula izinguquko ezintsha ezizoholela ekuthuthukiseni indlela umnyango owahlinzeka ngayo usizo emphakathini. Ekhuluma noNwele Olude ekuqaleni kwale nyanga, ngemva kokuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uNkk. Neliswa Peggy ekhombise isifiso sokusebenza ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, uDkt. Nyembezi uchaze ukuthi baphazamisekile ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokwenza umsebenzi wabo nokunye. Uqhubekile wathi umnyango uthuthuke kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zezempilo, kodwa okudingekayo ngokuphuthumayo yizindlu zabasebenzi bezempilo ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, okuyisidingo esiphuthumayo. Kukhona isidingo sezikhungo zezempilo ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nokwandiswa kwenani lezibhedlela, kodwa kudingeka sithuthukise indlela usizo oluhlinzekwa ngayo emphakathini, washilo. Ubuye waqinisekisa ukuthi uzokwakha izinhlelo zokulwa nokwanda kwe-HIV/AIDS. Uhlele ukwenza lokhu ngokwakha izinhlelo zokubambisana nezinye izigaba zikamasipala kanye nabantu besebhizinisi abaseduze nomnyango wethu. Ukubakhona kwakhe kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi siqhubeka nokuqhubeka kokwakha izikhungo ezintsha ezifana nezikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, kusho uNgqongqoshe. Umnyango wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo esifundazweni manje usendleleni yokufaka abantu ukuze abhekane nezimo eziphuthumayo emigwaqweni. Lokhu kuyingxenye yohlelo olwaqala ngonyaka odlule lapho abantu abangu-50 baqeqeshwa futhi manje sebebenza emnyangweni. U-Ntsobi uthe iningi labantu abazobanjwa kuzobekwa ezindaweni zasemaphandleni uma beqeda izifundo zabo, ezilindelekile ukuthi zithathe izinyanga ezintathu. Manje siqala isigaba sesibili sokwandisa izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kulandela impumelelo yesigaba sokuqala ngonyaka odlule lapho sathola nabantu abangu-50, kuchaza uNtsobi. Umphathi walesi sikhungo uthe ngaphezu kwe-90% yalabo abaqeqeshwayo bazoba ngabesifazane. Sibone ukuthi kungcono ukuthatha abesifazane abaningi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi nabo bayanda kulo mkhakha wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. Eminyakeni edlule, umsebenzi wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo wawaziwa ngokuba namadoda. Sibone ukuthi abesifazane bangakwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi kahle njengabantu besilisa, kusho uNtsobi. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo kuyingxenye yohlelo lukamasipala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izindawo kulesi sifundazwe zithola usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo uma kudingeka. Sizokuqinisekisa futhi ukuthi imiphakathi enezinketho ezilinganiselwe ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ibhekwa kuhlelo. Umnyango uqinisekisile ukuthi izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo zikhanga ngokwakha izikhungo zezempilo nezibhedlela ezisezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kuvinjwe ukufa okungadingekile okubangelwa ukulibaziseka kwabantu ukuthola usizo, kuchaza uNtsobi. Uthe labo abazotholwa emsebenzini ngeke babe bonke abavela esifundazweni sonke. Kudingeka kube nabantu abangakaze bathole ithuba lokufunda ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. Uqhubekile wathi kumele babe nematriki, izitifiketi zokushayela (ikhowudi 10), kanye nezitifiketi zokushayela zomphakathi (PDP). Labo abaqeda izifundo zabo bazoba namathuba okuqhubeka nezifundo zabo kulo mkhakha lapho ekugcineni bazothola khona izikhungo nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme. Sifundisa ukuzimisela, ukuhlela, ukusebenza kanzima, ukuzibophezela, nokuzinikela njengokhiye wokuphumelela. URonald Green-Thompson, lapho sibuyela, sifunda kuye ukuze sibe abantu abangcono. Usifundisile ukuthi kumele sikhule ngokwanele ukuze sikwazi ukusiza imiphakathi yethu. UGreen-Thompson uthe uyajabula ngentuthuko yezibhedlela ezintsha ezimbili, ezilindeleke ukuvulwa maduze, futhi njengoba waziwa ngokusebenza nabo emkhakheni Wezempilo Kazwelonke kanye nazo zonke izimpumelelo zezibhedlela zeMahatma Gandhi, sivuma lapho sikhuluma ngalokho, nalabo asebenza nabo kanye neBhodi, ngidlulisa amazwi kaMnyango ngesikhathi seMnyango Wezempilo onezibhedlela ezingu-340, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, abasebenzi kulo mnyango abanjalo abawazisa kakhulu uProfesa osanda kuba yisikhulu. Lezi zibhedlela ezingu-340 noKing Albert zikhona kukho konke esikwenzayo, wamiswa njengesikhulu sikaGreen-Thompson ngenxa yokufaka kwakhe. "Noma kukhona okuningi okusele ukwenza, iLuthuli Central Hospital kumele ifune okungcono, kodwa umnyango ngonyaka ka-1995. kulo mnyango. Sibonga wonke umuntu ngalokho okwenzekile, kodwa ezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu nakubantu esisebenzisana nabo." UGreen-Thompson ungumphathi wezobuchwepheshe osinikeze ithuba lokusiza labo abaneziguli ezingu-840," kusho yena. Umnyango Wezempilo uqaphele ukuthi uProfesa Green-Thompson ukwazi ukufaka izinzuzo ezivela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezingu-122. Umcimbi wokuhamba kwenhlonipho kaProfesa wabanjwa ngenhlonipho owakhiwe ngo-2003. Ngemuva kokuba uGreen-Thompson ebambe iqhaza emcimbini wokuhamba kwenhlonipho kaProfesa Green-nokuzinikela nokuzinikela kulokhu kuphinde kwathengwa umnyango izinto eziningi eminyakeni eminingi njengomphathi uThompson. Ukuphakela inkulumo yakhe, umsebenzi wakhe njengomphathi ube yimpumelelo kanye nemiklomelo yoMnyango Wezempilo. Lo mcimbi wawuhanjelwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uNkk. woMnyango. onezikhungo zezempilo ezingu-56. wawubanjwe yalo mnyango. Wawubanjwe eThekwini, e-ICC. Lapho umcimbi uphela, uProfesa wanikezwa izipho zakhe kanye neposi eliqukethe imiyalezo evela kubasebenzi balo mnyango. Njengoba sonke sazi, umcimbi awuwona umcimbi ngaphandle kwegayi, wonke umuntu ujabule ngegayi eyenziwe kulomcimbi omkhulu wokuhamba kwenhlonipho kaProfesa Green-Thompson. Uma uhamba ukuya kubona udadewenu noma udokotela wakho, chaza ukuthi uhlela ukuba nomntwana, ikakhulukazi uma unesimo esithinta wena njenge-diabetes, epilepsy, noma isifo senhliziyo. Uma wena nom partner wakho nithintana, gwema ukuthatha imishanguzo ngaphandle kokuba ibhalwe udadewenu noma udokotela. Yenza kube yisiko ukuya esibhedlela sabesifazane abakhulelwe noma kudokotela wakho. Uma kukhona umuntu emndenini wakho noma emndenini womlingani wakho owazalwa enenkinga ethile yokukhubazeka noma enezinkinga zengqondo, zokubona, noma zokuzwa, cela udadewenu noma udokotela ukuba akuthumele esibhedlela sokwelashwa kwezakhamuzi ezikhethekile eduze kwakho. Thola ukuphumula okwanele futhi unakekele umzimba wakho ngokucophelela. Thola ulwazi ngokuqhuba. Xhumana nesibhedlela noma nodokotela wakho ngokushesha uma uhlangabezana nokopha ezindaweni zakho eziz private noma uma unezimpawu ezilandelayo: ukushisa okungapheli, ukuhamba, izinhlungu ezinzima, ukuvuvukala kwezinyawo noma imilenze, ukukhula kwesisindo ngokushesha, izinhlungu zesisu, ukuncipha kokukhipha amanzi, noma ukukhipha amanzi ngokweqile ezindaweni zakho eziz private. Vakashela esibhedlela noma kudokotela wakho cishe ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngemuva kokuba umntwana wakho uzalwe ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa okuphelele kokuphuma. Yenza kube yisiko ukuthatha ingane yakho esibhedlela sezingane ukuze kwenziwe ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile kanye nezivivinyo ezidingekayo. Xhumana nesibhedlela sokuhlela umndeni ukuze uthole ukuthi kufanele usebenzise ini ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa.

Nanku, uMnumzane, umthetho osebenzayo uveza ngokusobala ukuthi ukufakwa kwezinkosi kwiRoyal House kungenziwa kuphela ngokuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko. Le ndawo, isivinini esihamba ngaso sikhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubukhosi busebenza njengephuzu elibalulekile lokuhola ngaphansi kukahulumeni onobulungiswa. Umthetho WamaBlack Authorities ka-1951 wawuhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuholi bendabuko buba ithuluzi elilula labacindezeli. Umsebenzi wezinkosi wokubika kwiRoyal House ungumkhuba wendabuko oneminyaka eminingi futhi uyisisekelo sokubusa. Uhulumeni esinawo njengamanje esifundazweni uqale uhlelo lwezomthetho oluhloselwe ukubuyisela isithunzi nesikhundla sobuholi bendabuko ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zokubusa eziphathwe nguMthethosisekelo. Njengohulumeni, siyazi ngomonakalo owenziwe yimithetho edlule emqondweni wobuholi bendabuko. Siyaqonda, Mhlaba Womhlabathi, ukuthi uthole ukuthi ungabhekiwe emicimbini yokufakwa kwezinkosi nakwezinye ezaziphethwe abaholi bendabuko kodwa zaphathwa osomabhizinisi. Nokho, namuhla siqinisekisa wena, Mhlaba Womphakathi, ukuthi ukufakwa kwezinkosi ngeke kusetshenziswe njengemivuzo noma ukuheha ukwesekwa kweziphathimandla zezombusazwe. Ubukhosi buwumsebenzi ophakanyisiwe emthethweni wethu. Yingakho uhulumeni ephakamisa izinhlelo zomthetho ezifanele zokubambisana (IGR) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinkosi nezinye izigaba zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Ngikhuluma lapha namuhla ngoba uhulumeni wethu wesifunda saseKwaZulu-Natal uqale isifundo sokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kukahulumeni, ubuholi bendabuko kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Ngifuna ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ukuthi izinkosi nonke sikhishwe emthethweni wamaHulumeni adlule ekubambeni iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Kodwa kusukela manje, le nhlobo ingumlando. Kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa "ukubuyiselwa" kwesithunzi sobukhosi njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuphathwa. Nokho, kuyadabukisa ukuthi abanye bethu sebebhekene nokusebenzisa ubuholi bendabuko ngezizathu zezombusazwe nangokuzuza kwabo siqu. Esikhathini esedlule, abezombusazwe nabaphathi bakhuphula ezinye izinkosi phezulu kwezinye. Lo hulumeni wamanje uzokwamukela kuphela ukuphakanyiswa okuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko futhi kuqinisekiswe yiRoyal House. Ekupheleni konyaka odlule, ngihambele umhlangano wokuthuthukisa amasu okusebenza kwemnyango wami. Kumele ngithi le njongo ihlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha isikhungo sobukhosi ukuze sisebenze ngaphandle kokungabaza. Kungalesi sizathu nakwezinye engikhuluma ngazo ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuphathwa okuhle, kuhlanganisa ukuhlela kabusha kwezintela ezikhokhwayo ezindaweni zobukhosi. Ngakho-ke, Mhlaba Womphakathi, ngikhona namuhla ukuze ngiqinisekise neRoyal House ukuthi ukuhlonishwa kwezinkosi ohulumeni ophathayo esifundazweni kuyisiko elihle elilandelwa emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kugcinwa ngezindinganiso ezahlukene kanye nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezahlukene okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe lesi sithunzi; akufanele kusetshenziswe ukukala izikhundla zabaholi bendabuko uma kuqhathaniswa nezikhundla ezahlukene zikahulumeni. Izikhundla zabaholi bendabuko ngaphansi kwesakhiwo sobukhosi ziyingxenye yalowo mphakathi ngaphansi kwenkosi. Ngaphezu kokusiza imiphakathi ezindaweni zobukhosi kanye nabaholi bendabuko ukuze bathole ukuhlonishwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona, imnyango yami isebenza ngokwakha kabusha izikhungo zokuphatha zendabuko. Lokhu kuhilela ukuguqula lezi "zinkantolo zobukhosi" ezazaziwa ngaphambili zibe izakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukusungula ubudlelwano nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza abaholi bethu bendabuko nezakhiwo zabo ukuba bathathe ithuba lezi zinhlelo ezichazwe emthethweni kazwelonke mayelana nokuphathwa kwezendabuko (njengokuphakanyiswa nguMthethosisekelo waseKwaZulu-Natal). Enye yalezi zithuba ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni zokubambisana nezinsiza zikahulumeni ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi ethile lapho isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sinokwakha ukwenza kanjalo. Ngokwesibonelo, mhlawumbe isakhiwo sokuphatha senkosi singasiza umphakathi ngezincwadi zokufaka izicelo zomsebenzi, ukuqeqesha abantu ngamakhono amasha e-computer. Izinkosi zingamalungu ohulumeni abekwe phambili. Ngakho-ke, kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuze sihambisane nezakhiwo zabo nezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezimisiwe. Kumele ngiqinisekise namuhla ukuthi le nhlangano ihloselwe kuphela izinjongo zokusebenza. Kuyinhloso yokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza nokuthuthukiswa. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkosi noMeya abukhombisi ukufana ezikhundleni. Kungaba yiphutha ukususa inkosi ezindabeni zendawo ngenxa yokuthi, emicabangweni yethu, kufanele ikhulume nomlingani wayo eKapa noma ePitoli. Singase sibe nalolo cabango olukhuluma ngempela. Nokho, sikhumbuza namuhla ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu, obuhlanganisa izakhiwo ezahlukene zikahulumeni, bugxile kakhulu ekusebenzeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kuhanjiswa ngokushesha ezizweni zobukhosi. Zonke izinkosi ziyazi ukuthi sikhona kude ekuthumeleni izinsiza ezindaweni zabo, futhi sidinga ukuba baxhumane nathi njengohulumeni ekuhlinzekeni ngokushesha kwalezi zidingo. Inkosi Hlongwane nomphakathi, njengendawo yaseKwaZulu-Natal, sibhiyozela intuthuko esiyenzayo ekubuyiseni isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko, ukuguqulwa kwaso, kanye nokuhambisana nezinye izakhiwo zokuphathwa, ikakhulukazi ezingeni likamasipala. Ngithatha leli thuba ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ngezinto ezibalulekile ezihlobene nesiko lokufakwa kwezinkosi ngokusemthethweni. IZINSUKU ZOKUVAKASHA Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abaguli bathola usizo oluphakeme, sicela ukuthi izikhathi zokuvakasha zilandwe. Uma uvakashela isiguli, sicela uqinisekise ukuthi awudluli inani ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo. Uma uthola phakathi kuka-R1,000 no-R36,000 ngonyaka noma uma umndeni uhola ndawonye phakathi kuka-R1,000 no-R50,000, kulindeleke ukuthi ukhokhe u-R30 esibhedlela. Le mali ikhokhwa uma uhlale ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyi-30; uma udlula ezinsukwini eziyi-30, ukhokha u-R30 olwengeziwe ngosuku ngalunye olwandulela. Abesifazane abakhulelwe bavunyelwe ukuhlala kuze kube yizinsuku eziyi-42 ngemuva kokubeletha.

Uma ukhetha ukugcina izinto zakho nawe, qinisekisa ukuthi uzinakekela. Isibhedlela sizobe singaphenduli uma zilahlekile. Cela izinto zakho uma usushiya. IZINHLOKO ZOKUKHOKHA Izindleko zesibhedlela zingakhokhwa ngemali noma ngekhadi lezokwelapha. Uma isiguli singanemali, kukhona indlela enikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Yiba neqiniso lapho unikeza ulwazi lwezempilo. Buza uma kukhona okungaqondi. Buza uma kukhona ofuna ukwazi ngakho okwengeziwe. Gwema izenzo ezingamukeleki nezingafanele. Zama ukuqonda inkinga yakho. Yazi abasebenzi abakwelapha. Hlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli. Landela imithetho, imihlahlandlela, nemigomo yesibhedlela. Khokha izindleko zesibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela iziqondiso ezinikezwe abakhiqizi bezempilo. Bika kubakhiqizi bezempilo uma amalungelo akho ephulwa. Qinisekisa ukugcina izimfihlo zabasebenzi. Cela noma yini oyidingayo mayelana nokwelashwa kwakho kumphakathi noma kudokotela.
Nkosikazi ophakeme; uMphakathi noMphakathi oPhakeme bePhalamende; Ozakwethu abahloniphekile bePhalamende; uMongameli nozakwethu abahloniphekile beKomidi Lezempilo. Abaphathiswa kanye nabavoti; Oholayo bendabuko phakathi kwethu; uMphathi weSikhungo, uDkt. Busi Nyembezi; Abaphathi bezigaba ezahlukene kuhlanganise nabaphathi bezempilo bezifunda, abaphathi bezibhedlela, amalungu ebhodi lezibhedlela, amalungu eBhodi Yokubuyekezwa Kwezingqondo, Amakhomidi Ezempilo, Abadokotela bendabuko, kanye nazo zonke izigaba ezibandakanyekayo eMnyangweni Wezempilo. Abanye abahloniphekile abakhona lapha engingabakhumbuli; Bafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Izinselelo ezimangalisayo esibhekene nazo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, sizama ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo obekwe ezikhwameni zethu ngenxa yokwehla okukhulu kwezinga lobubha okwenza umsebenzi wethu ube nzima kakhulu. Masihlangane njengabantu baleli gumbi elihle kulolu hlelo lokulwa nobubha, ukwephulwa kwamalungelo abesifazane nezingane, izifo, nokukhombisa ukuzibophezela kwethu ekunakekeleni amalungelo abantu kanye nobuntu bomuntu ngamunye. Izindaba zezempilo kanye namalungu abahloniphekile yizihloko eziyinhloko ezixoxwa ezinkundleni ezibhekana nokuthuthukiswa kokuphila komphakathi kanye nomnotho. I-International Rural Women's Conference ibanjwe eThekwini njengoba sikhuluma. Siyazi ukuthi kuleli gumbi, abesifazane benza u-53% wabantu bonke futhi iningi labo bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, izifo, ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukuhlanzeka, nokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Kukhona amazwe athuthukayo athole umehluko omkhulu kulezi zinselelo esibhekene nazo. Sithemba ukuthi le nkulumo izohlinzeka ngethuba lokwabelana ngemicabango yokuthi singabhekana kanjani nalezi zindaba ezibhekene nabesifazane kuleli sikhathi. Umsebenzi wethu njengomnyango wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngokulandela umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kusukela ezingeni eliphansi, sigxile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kubantu bonke ngokulinganayo, sithinta umphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo futhi sibambisane nazo zonke izigaba ezikhona kuleli. Isikhungo sokuqala sokunakekelwa kwezempilo sasungulwa endaweni yasePholela lapha eKwaZulu-Natal ngo-1948, iminyaka engamashumi amathathu ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwe-Alma Ata Declaration ngonyaka ka-1978, njengendlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu. Umndeni wezempilo emhlabeni, ikakhulukazi ezweni elithuthukayo, uyavuma ukuthi kufanele siqinise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo uma sifuna ukubhekana kahle nomthwalo wokulwa nezifo. Sibe nemicimbi ehlukahlukene ngonyaka odlule lapho sakhuluma ngezaziso ezihlukahlukene zezempilo kumiphakathi. Kulonyaka sizokwakha kulokho njengesisekelo sigxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunomthelela ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi sisebenze ndawonye ekuxoxeni ngezihloko noma izindaba ezihlobene nezempilo, futhi ngaleyo ndlela sizokhula ndawonye. Ngithemba ukuthi ngalokhu sizobona intuthuko nezinkomba zokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo. Sibhekene nezinga lobubha elingu-54.3% kuleli, kanti kwezinye izindawo zasemaphandleni izinga lobubha lilinganiselwa ku-80%. Sake sakhuluma ukuthi izinga lokungabi nokudla linamandla kakhulu ku-70%. Kuleli, kuphela u-32% wabantu abathola amanzi ahlanzekile (kwezizwe kucatshangwa ukuthi u-79% futhi u-24% wezindlu unazo izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kuleli kanti kwezizwe kucatshangwa ukuthi u-62%). Lezi yizinselelo ezifanayo ezithinta izindawo zasemaphandleni ezizungeze amadolobha lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni zezempilo ezanele, kanye nezifo ezihlukahlukene. Izifunda ze-Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Umzinyathi, Zululand, nezinye izingxenye zendawo ye-Ilembe zineziqinisekiso ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobubha elikhonjiswa ngezinkomba zomnotho. Izifunda ze-Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Umzinyathi, ingxenye esentshonalanga ye-Uthukela, ne-Zululand, ingxenye enyakatho ye-Umkhanyakude zineziqinisekiso ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobubha kanye nokuntuleka kokuphila komphakathi (kuhlanganisa nezinga eliphansi lemfundo, ubuningi babantu, iningi labantu liyi- youth, abantu abadala, nabantu abaneziphene). Izindawo zasemaphandleni e-Umzinyathi, Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Zululand, Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Isisonke zineziqinisekiso ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokuntuleka kokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo ezibalulekile kuhlanganisa amanzi, ukuhlanzeka, nokuntuleka kwesistimu yokuphathwa kwemfucumfucu okudala inkinga enkulu kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ngaphansi kwegama le-Alma Ata, kufanele sisebenze ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba ezikhona ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa ukuze sithathe izinselelo eziphazamisa impilo yomphakathi futhi zehlise ukuzinza komnotho. Njengengxenye yalolu hlelo, sifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo yomphakathi eduze komphakathi futhi futhi sikhuthaze imikhankaso yokuphila kahle nezinhlelo zokufundisa ngezempilo ezihloselwe ukwazisa, ukufundisa, nokukhulisa ukuqwashisa kumiphakathi ngempilo. Abasebenzi bethu bezempilo bazoba nendima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi lolu hlelo luphumelele. Iyunithi egxile ezinkampanini ezincane, i-Targeted Enterprises Unit, yasungulwa kulo mnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amabhizinisi abanikazi abamnyama adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthengweni kukamasipala ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobubha kuleli futhi kuthuthukiswe izimo zezempilo nokwakha ikusasa eliphephile neliphumelelayo. Okwamanje, kugxilwe ezinkampanini ezibambisene, ezincane, eziphakathi, nezinkulu (SMMEs) ikakhulukazi lezo ezake zaba ngaphansi. Kukhona izinhlelo ezihloselwe ngqo abesifazane, intsha, nezinkampani eziphethwe abantu abaneziphene. Inani le-R81 million linikezwe ngaphansi kohlelo lokunikeza amabhizinisi ithuba lokuncintisana kunokuthumela izimemo kumabhizinisi athile ukuze ancintisane ngamanani abekwe emsebenzini odingekayo. Lolu hlelo luveze intuthuko ekwazini ukuphatha umkhankaso wezisebenzi emkhakheni wezokubambisana. Lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuzibophezela komnyango ekulweni nezifo, ukulwa nobubha, nokunikeza ithemba kubantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Kunobufakazi obucacile bokuthi uma ubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni impilo nemfundo yabesifazane, uthuthukisa isimo sempilo yezingane zabo okuyisisekelo senhlangano enempilo enekusasa elikhanyayo. Umkhakha ophathelene nesimo sabesifazane ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa udlala indima ebalulekile kwezempilo, okuyiyo ethola
Mphakathi ohloniphekile, uMphakathi wePhondo, uMphakathi ohloniphekile uDkt. Sibusiso Ndebele, oMphakathi ohloniphekile beMemeber bePhalamende, oMphakathi ohloniphekile beMemeber bePhalamende yePhondo, uMphakathi ohloniphekile, uMphakathi weKomidi Lezempilo, uMphakathi ohloniphekile uMeya kanye nabakhethi, oBuholi bendabuko, uMphakathi oHoli beMnyango uDkt. Yolisa Mbele, abasebenzi beMnyango wezempilo, izivakashi zethu ezahlukene, izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, abafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, ngizizwa ngihloniphekile ukuhlala phambi kwenu nalesi sikhungo namuhla njengom member ohloniphekile nowaziyo we-African National Congress, lapho sibhiyozela iminyaka emihlanu zobuqotho balolu hlangano ekusebenzeni kwabantu, njengoba kushiwo nguMongameli wethu, oMphakathi ohloniphekile uMnu. Thabo Mbeki, ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngenkonzo yokusebenza kwabantu ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobuphofu. Siqhubeka nalolu zobuqotho, futhi ngikholelwa ukuthi senze okungcono kakhulu ukuze sakhe amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobuphofu. Lokhu kuveza isiqubulo sethu eMnyangweni wezempilo, "Ukulwa Nezifo, Ukulwa Nobuphofu, Ukunikeza Ithemba" kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-10 esifundeni sethu esihle eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. Siphinde sahamba ibanga elide ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinhloso zokuphucula umnotho wabantu abamnyama. Kaningi, izinselelo esibhekene nazo njengombuso kanye nezwe lethu, kanye nomsebenzi esizibekele wona, zidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu, sibahlanganise bonke ukwenza lokho okudingekayo, futhi siqonde ukuthi ikusasa lomuntu ngamunye sikhona ezandleni zethu! Mphakathi ohloniphekile, uMongameli uthi kufanele sihlolisise lapho siphumelele noma siphumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, ngithanda ukuthi sibheke izinselelo esihlangabezane nazo kule minyaka emihlanu yokuzinikela kubantu, njengoba uMongameli eshilo ukuzinikela kubantu baleli zwe nakubantu basemphakathini. Okokuqala, phakathi kwezinkinga ezinkulu esihlangabezane nazo mayelana nezinkulumo ngemiholo yabasebenzi bakamasipala. Lapho lezi zinkulumo zifika endaweni yokungavumelani, kuholele ekutheni abasebenzi baphume emsebenzini ngomhla ziyi-1 kuJuni, 2007. Lokhu akukhange kube ngaphandle kwabasebenzi beMnyango wezempilo. Ukungenelela okuhle kweMnyango kwakwazi ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo ngesikhathi esinzima. Nakuba bekukhona lezi zifiso, izikhungo zethu zezempilo zazihluleka kakhulu futhi izimali ezinkulu zathengiswa ukuqasha abasebenzi bangaphandle, ikakhulukazi abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuze basize umphakathi odinga usizo. Siphinde saphoqeleka ukuba sithenge imibhede ezibhedlela ezizimele futhi sathola izindleko ezinkulu. Enye inkinga esibhekene nayo yisifo seKlebsiella esifundeni. Amalungu azokhumbula icala elibi esibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial lapho izingane zafa ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa ngenxa yeKlebsiella virus. Ucwaningo lwethu luveze ukuthi le nkinga ivame ukubangelwa; (i) indlela izibhedlela zethu ezakhiwe ngayo, ikakhulukazi izigaba; (ii) izimo zomnotho nezokuhlalisana zabesifazane abasha abadinga ukuthembela kumadoda abo futhi abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba ezihlobene nokuziphatha kwezocansi; (iii) ukudluliswa kwezifo ngenxa yokuthi izindlu zakhiwe kanjani, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zokuhlala ezingekho emthethweni; kanye (iv) indlela imindeni ehlelwe ngayo engasizi empilweni yentsha. Isibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial siwumfanekiso omuhle wokubhekana nalezi zinkinga engizichazile. Okokuqala, idolobha laseUmlazi linabantu abaningi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izindawo ezisemphakathini, kodwa alinazo izinsiza zezempilo ezanele, okwenza isibhedlela iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial sibe nomthwalo omkhulu wokuletha abesifazane abaningi. Lesi sibhedlela sithola abesifazane abangu-1,000 ngenyanga, futhi kulaba bantwana, cishe abangu-525 bagcinwa kwi-neonatal unit besesimweni esibucayi. Isikhala esitholakalayo sikhulu kakhulu sokwamukela izingane eziningi, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi zidlulisele ezinye izifo. Okwesibili, ukungabi nezinsiza kule ndawo kwenza kube nzima kumphakathi ukuhlela imindeni, ikakhulukazi kwabesifazane abasha abavame ukutholakala bephumile. Lokhu kunezixhumanisi ezithile nokudluliswa kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, kuhlanganise ne-HIV nezinye izifo ezifana ne-tuberculosis ne-Gonorrhea. Lokhu kuphinde kubonise kahle ukuthi intsha yethu ayifuni ukuzibandakanya ocansini oluphephile noluvikelekile! Ngalesi sizathu, ngihlala ngikhuthaza ukuthi kufanele siqale ukusebenza kanzima futhi sithathe indima ehamba phambili ekulweni nokwanda kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi (kuhlanganise ne-HIV) nokushintsha imicabango uma kuziwa empilweni yezocansi. Ngenkathi uMnyango uzosebenzisa yonke imizamo ukuvimbela ukufa kwezingane ezizalwayo; sidinga futhi wonke umuntu ukusiza ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanzeka ekhaya, kanye nokufundisa bobabili amantombazane namadoda ngokuvimbela ukukhulelwa okungafunwa kanye nezingozi zezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Sonke sidlala indima ebalulekile ekufundiseni izingane zethu zamantombazane ukuba babe yibo abathatha izikhala zabo zezeMpilo. Sizodinga futhi ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba ukuze sinciphise ukusabalala kwezifo ngenxa yezimo zomphakathi. Isibonelo esihle nguMnyango Wezokuhlala emizamweni yawo yokususa izindawo zokuhlala ezingekho emthethweni ngo-2014, isenzo esifanele ukuhalaliswa. Njengomnyango, emalini edlule, senze imikhankaso yezempilo engama-45, okuyimizamo yokufundisa imiphakathi ngempilo engcono, sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzokwehlisa umthwalo ezikhungweni zethu ezithola iziguli ezineziguli ezivimbela. Mphakathi ohloniphekile, kube nezikhathi eziningi lapho sithinteka kakhulu ukulahleka kwabasebenzi abanekhono nokwehluleka kwethu ukuheha ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Lokhu kungenxa yokungabi nezindlu kanye nezimali ezanele zokwakha izindlu, futhi lokhu kuseyiphupho njengoba silwa nokwakha izikhungo zezempilo. Sisaphuma kude nokumisa ukusebenzisa abasebenzi besikhashana eMnyangweni wethu. Kunezikhungo eziningi eziqhubeka nokuhola abasebenzi besikhashana ukuze ziqinise izibhedlela nezinye izingxenye zeMnyango. Sihlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke lokhu kuphela ngokushesha futhi bonke labo basebenzi baqashwa ngokuphelele nguMnyango. Siqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izikhala ezibalulekile zizogcwaliswa ngaphambi kukaJuni futhi sisesikhathini sokwenza lokhu kwenzeke. UMongameli wezwe ngesikhathi esikhuluma wathi "Ngizokwenza izinto ngendlela engaj
Kukhona nodokotela omunye onolwazi lokuthi uthole kanjani i-MDR-TB emsebenzini wakhe wezokwelapha noma ezibhedlela zethu, okwaholela ekutheni abone ukulahlekelwa ukuzwa. Lokhu kungenxa kaDkt. Thabiso Thusi ovela ePort Shepstone. Ngiyabonga bonke abasebenzi bezempilo abaqhubeka nokuthatha izifungo zokwenza imisebenzi yabo ngenhlonipho ngenkathi bebhekene nezinselelo nezithiyo kulolu work. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyishumi, ngibuyela phambi kwenu ngenkulu ukuzithoba ngemuva kokhetho luka-2009 lapho i-African National Congress (ANC) iphinde yakhethwa, okwaholela ekutheni inikezwe ithuba elisha lokuphatha zonke izakhiwo zikamasipala. Kungalesi sukela sokuphumelela ukuthi kwi-Election Manifesto, i-ANC ibekezelele impilo njengenye yezinhlaka ezine eziphezulu ezidinga ukunakwa. Abantu bethu bavote i-ANC ngoba inhlangano yethu ibambelela kakhulu ezindabeni zempilo ezweni futhi lezi ngempela ziyamalungelo abantu. Lokhu kugcizelelwa ngumthethosisekelo wezwe lethu, ikakhulukazi iBill of Rights. Njengoba amanzi ewumsebenzi obalulekile kubo bonke, ukuphila kahle kuyinto ethinta wonke umuntu ophilayo. Ngesikhathi sikhulula ibhajethi ngo-2009, isiqubulo sethu sasingukuthi: "Sisalela ukuphila. Ake senze izinsiza zempilo zifinyeleleke kubantu." Ukuthuthukiswa kokufinyelela ekwelashweni kwababhekelelwa i-tuberculosis kuyisixhumanisi sokuhlaselwa kwabo yi-HIV. Ukwandiswa kwezinsiza zabantu abalele emakhaya nakwabanye abasebenza ezempilo yomphakathi. Ukusindiswa ngendlela efanele. Njengoba sibeka ibhajethi ka-2010, umqondo wethu uthi Impilo Engcono Kubantu Bonke. Lokhu kwakwakhiwe phezu kokuzinikela emsebenzini engiwethulile ngo-2009. Kulolu work, uMnyango wakhetha izibhedlela eziyishumi nanye esisebenzisana nazo ukuze noma ubani ofaka izicabha zazo azizwe sengathi ukhuluma endaweni yokwelashwa. Sikholelwa ukuthi lezi zinto ezishiwo zingenzeka uma siqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi basebenza ngokuzikhandla ngokuhlala bebheka ukuthi kwenzekani ezibhedlela abaphatha, bezwa izikhalazo zabaguli, bephendula izinkinga ezingahambi kahle ekwethulweni kwezinsizakalo zezibhedlela, futhi bejikeleza abasebenzi ukuze bagcine bephila kahle emsebenzini. Ngicela ngichaze lokhu: Abaguli balindele ukwelashwa okuhle nakuba kunezinselelo esibhekene nazo. Ekupheleni kwale nyanga, sizokhipha isaziso sokuthi yiziphi ezinye izibhedlela eziyishumi nanye nezikhungo ezizobandakanywa kulolu hlelo njengoba sizibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi phakathi neminyaka emihlanu zonke izibhedlela zethu zifakwa kulolu hlelo. Ngifuna ukuqokomisa ukuthi izibhedlela zasemaphandleni ziwumfanekiso esingazigqaja ngawo ngezindlela eziningi. Lapha singakhuluma ngeMnyango uMzinyathi, okukhombisa ukuthi uyasebenza kahle kulolu siko. Ngiyacela ungivumele ngifunde le ncwadi ethunyelwe ngomunye wabaguli echaza i-COSH. Ezinye izibalo zikhuluma ngezici zokuphumelela kwe-MDGs. Lokhu kugcizelela nezinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Nakuba lezi zibalo zikhombisa ukuthi kukhona intuthuko ezindaweni eziningi, le ntuthuko ibonakala ingalingani. Asikafiki ezingeni lapho singathi sikwazi ukwenza okwanele ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi omama nezingane zabo ezizalwayo. I-HIV ne-TB: abantu abangu-304,000 (kuhlanganisa nezingane eziyi-22,000, abesifazane abangu-140,000, nabantu besilisa abangu-66,000) babekwe ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa. I-Tuberculosis: Ithuba labantu abane-tuberculosis abathola ukwesekwa nge-DOTS lehle laya ku-80% ngo-2005/6 laya ku-72% ngo-2008/09. Isizathu salokhu wukuthi kunzima ukugcina labo abavuma ukusiza labo abaphakathi kwezinhlelo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungenxa yokwehluleka ukugcina labo abamsiza labo abaphakathi kwezinhlelo ze-DOTS. Ithuba labaguli abangapheli uhlelo lwabo lwezidakamizwa lehle laya ku-14% ngo-2005/6 laya ku-8.7% ngo-2009/10. Ukulethwa kwezokwelapha kuthuthuke kusuka ku-15% ngo-2005/6 kuya ku-53.15% ngo-2009/10. Impumelelo yokwelashwa ithuthuke kusuka ku-35% ngo-2005/6 kuya ku-58.15% ngo-2009/10. Ukuvela komdlavuza wombungu: Isifunda sikhombise ukwehla okungu-90% emdlavuzweni wombungu. Izibalo zikhombisa ukwehla okuvela ezimweni eziyi-606 ngo-2007/8 zaya ku-429 ngo-2008/9 phakathi kwalabo abathintekayo kulolu bhubhane. Kukhona intuthuko enhle wezi zindawo zonke. Kufanele sibhiyozela le mpumelelo esiyifinyelele ekwenzeni ukuthi umdlavuza wombungu unqotshwe. Kufanele sonke sibe nokuqhakambisa ngentuthuko eyenziwa emhlabeni jikelele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi impilo ibhekwa njengokubaluleke kakhulu, ngisho nasezikhathini lapho kunezinkinga ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba. Ngemuva kweminyaka engaphezu kweshumi nanhlanu selokhu sathola uhulumeni wenkululeko, kukhona izinkomba zokuthi ngokwandisa ibhajethi yomnyango wezempilo, singathola imiphumela ebonakalayo. Sibonga uNdunankulu wethu ophakeme - uDkt. Zweli Mkhize ngendima yakhe kulolu siko. Sibonga futhi uNgqongqoshe wezeMali - uNkk. Ina Cronje ngokuqhuba impilo, okuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu. Umkhulumeli uyavuma ukuthi kukhona indima edlalwa umnyango ekuhlinzekeni isifunda ngombono wezezimali omuhle. Ngakho-ke, ngo-2009, sakha ithimba labaphathi esalibiza ngokuthi i-Joint Management Team eliholwa yiKZN Treasury. Le thimba isebenza ngokulandela uhlelo lweminyaka emithathu oluhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isimo sezezimali sitholakala endaweni efanele yezezimali ka-2011/2012. Saphazamiseka ukuba sisebenzise amasu ezimali ngasikhathi sinye sithuthukisa indlela esiphatha ngayo amakhasimende ethu. Sizame konke okusemandleni ethu ukususa ukuchitha, ubugebengu, ubugebengu, ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokuhlanganisa imali, nokwakha ukuphathwa kwangaphakathi. Ngiyajabula ukwazisa ukuthi sihlele ukuphathwa kwezimali nokuphepha kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zokusebenza zabaphathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho kuchitha, ubugebengu, nobugebengu. Ekwenzeni kwangaphambili kokuhlelwa kwalolu hlelo, sikwazile ukusindisa u-R400 million ngo-2009 ngenhloso yokusindisa u-R600 million ekupheleni konyaka wezezimali. Umnyango wethu ukwazi ngokuphelele ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondile ekuphathweni nasekubhekeni izindleko ezibekwe nguMkhandlu kanye nasekuthumeleni imibiko ngalokho okudingekayo ukuze kuvinjelwe ukudlula izindleko ezibekwe. Umkhulumeli, ngithanda ukuvumelana nomngane wami uNkk. Ina Cronje lapho ekhomba uNgqongqoshe wezeMali uPravin Gordhan lapho ethi: "Indawo enezinkinga
Isivumelwano seKhartoum sika-1988 sathi: "Ngoba umuntu uyisisekelo sokuthuthuka konke, isimo somphakathi somuntu yiso kuphela esingalinganiswa ukuthuthuka. Ukuthuthukiswa kwalolo simo somphakathi sabantu kubalulekile kakhulu kulabo abampofu nabasengozini, abawumsebenzi omkhulu e-Afrika. Okwamabhulu nabesifazane base-Afrika bangabantu okufanele baqinisekise futhi bathuthukiswe yisiphi na uhlelo lokuthuthuka." Sekuphele iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili selokhu lesi sivumelwano sasiqinisekiswe ngabantu besilisa nabesifazane abathwele umthwalo wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, kodwa kuze kube manje umsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlonipha isithunzi sabantu ngokubaphelezela usizo lwezempilo awukaphelelanga. Mphakathi ophakeme, ngicela ngithumele umcabango kancane. Ngiyashoda ngamazwi okukhombisa ukubonga ngezwi elikhuthazayo nelisekelayo engilitholile kubalimi baleli zinga kanye nabantu abaningi esifundazweni sethu nakwezinye izindawo ngenkathi ngigcwele amafu amnyama. Ngonyaka odlule, umnqobi wami engimthandayo, engimsebenzelayo, washona engozini yemoto, kwalandela ubaba bami ezinyangeni ezimbalwa kamuva. Ukushona kwabo kuthathe uthando nokwesekwa okwakuyisisekelo sempilo yami. NgoJanuwari walonyaka, indodana yami uMonde washona engalindelekile. Ukushona kwakhe kwangithinta kakhulu. UMonde wayengowafunwa yizwe lethu, isizukulwane esisha sabaholi abazosisiza kulonyaka nakweminye iminyaka ezayo. Ukusekela kwenu nokukhuthaza kwenu kwangisiza ngaleso sikhathi esinzima. Angazi ukuthi ngabe ngingubani ngaphandle kwenu. Niyakhumbuza sonke ukuthi noma ngabe imizuzu ikhululekile ezimpilweni zethu, niyohlale nikhona ukusisekela, okuyinto esenza sikhumbule ubuntu. Ngiyabonga nonke kakhulu. Mphakathi ophakeme, madoda namakhosikazi, ngicela ngithumele le nkulumo egameni labantu abathathu engibasebenzelayo. Ngifisa futhi ukuthumela le nkulumo egameni labasebenzi bonke bezempilo abashiya kithi ngonyaka odlule nalo nyaka kuze kube namuhla. Ngifuna ukuthatha leli thuba ukuletha izinhlelo zami zokudabuka emindenini nasemnganweni abashiywe. Njengomnyango, kuyasijabulisa kakhulu ukusala kwabasebenzi, ikakhulukazi ngoba sidinga ithimba eliqinile ukuze silwe nezifo nobuphofu. Ngomhla ziyi-7 kuMbasa, sakhumbula Usuku Lomhlaba lweZempilo. Isihloko salonyaka sithi "Sisebenzisana ukuze sithuthukise impilo." Ngalesi sikhathi, sahlonipha iminikelo yabasebenzi bezempilo, futhi saphinde sakhumbula izinselelo ezibhekene nabasebenzi bezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Lo msebenzi ungumsebenzi odinga abantu abaningi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinhlelo, hhayi nje zokuhola abasebenzi, kodwa nokugcina labo basebenzi bejabule, bethuthukiswa, futhi besekelwa emsebenzini wabo. Kulo nyaka sizokwandisa uhlelo lwethu lokunakekela impilo yabasebenzi siqala ngezinhlelo ezizokwenza ukuthi abasebenzi bomnyango wethu baqhubeke befunda njalo ukuze lo mnyango ube yindawo yokufunda okuqhubekayo nokuthuthukiswa. Njengengxenye yohlelo olwaqala ngonyaka odlule lokuhlela kabusha umnyango wethu, ekuqaleni konyaka, kwanikezwa ithimba labaphathi abaphezulu eliholwa nguDkt. Busi Nyembezi, elathatha esikhundleni sikaProfesa Green-Thompson, owahola lo mnyango iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili. Sifuna ukubonga uProfesa Green-Thompson ngendima ayidlalile ekuletheni usizo lwezempilo esifundazweni sethu. Simfisela kahle endimeni yakhe entsha njengomeluleki kuNgqongqoshe weZempilo kazwelonke. Ithimba elisha labaphathi lizosebenza phezu kwesisekelo esisunguliwe ukuze liphakamise umsebenzi wezempilo ezingeni eliphezulu ngokulwa nezifo, ukulwa nobuphofu, nokunikeza ithemba kubantu. Kulo nyaka sizokwakha uhlelo lokuguqula izinsizakalo zezempilo, iHealth Service Transformation Plan, esizosebenza kuyo kuze kube unyaka ka-2014. Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zezempilo zifinyelela ngokulinganayo ezindaweni ezahlukene nasemaphandleni. Ngalesi sikhathi, usizo lwezempilo kumele luhambisane nezidingo zabantu, lube nekhwalithi ephezulu, futhi lube nezindleko eziphusile. Lolu hlelo kumele luphinde luhlolisise udaba lokushoda kwabasebenzi bezempilo ngohlelo lwabasebenzi bezempilo lwamazwe olwenziwe ngokusemthethweni ngosuku lweZempilo Lomhlaba. Lolu hlelo lubalulekile kakhulu ngoba ukushoda kwabasebenzi kuvimba ukufezekisa izinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kweMillennium nokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu ezingeni eliphansi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lolu hlelo lwenziwa. Njengomnyango kulo nyaka, sizophinde sihlolisise izindlela ezintsha zokuhola, ukuthuthukisa, nokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Umbiko owaziwa ngokuthi iWealth Report 2006 ubonisa ukuthi isifunda saseMelika seHhovisi leMhlaba leZempilo, esinama-10% ezifo, sinama-37% abasebenzi bezempilo emhlabeni futhi sisebenzisa ama-50% wonke uxhaso lwezempilo emhlabeni, ngenkathi isifunda sase-Afrika, esinama-24% ezifo, sinama-3% abasebenzi futhi sisebenzisa ama-1% uxhaso lwezempilo emhlabeni. Lo mbiko uqhubeka uthi ukuhamba kwabantu abaqeqeshiwe bezempilo abanezidingo eziphuthumayo kwenza i-Afrika ibe yindawo ethinteka kakhulu ukushoda kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ukuze sifinyelele umgomo womnyango wethu - okuwukwethula uhlelo lwezempilo oluhlanganisiwe, oluhlangene nolwakhiwo olusebenzisa indlela yokunakekela impilo eyisisekelo kuzo zonke izifunda - sizosiza imiphakathi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ngokuthenga ama-75 ama-clinic aphathekayo, sakhe ama-30 ama-clinic, kanye nezibhedlela ezintathu ezinkulu kulo nyaka wezezimali. Ukuze sithuthukise ukunakekelwa kwezeMpilo eyisisekelo, odokotela bezempilo bazophinde baqeqeshwe futhi bandiswe ukuze sikwazi ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo. Ukuphathwa kokunakekelwa kwezeMpilo eyisisekelo kuzobuyekezwa futhi kuqiniswe. Sizophinde sihlole izinqubomgomo zethu zokwabiwa kwabasebenzi abasha abaphumelele ezinhlelweni zokusebenza komphakathi, kanye nalabo abake bafunda ngaphansi kwezibonelelo zomnyango wethu. Sihlose ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa kulokhu kwabiwa nokuthi wonke umphakathi uthole inzuzo. Izibonelelo zethu zinikezwa kubafundi abampofu okwenza umehluko omkhulu, futhi sizoqhubeka ngalokhu. Mphakathi ophakeme, sizophinde sikhombise ukuzibophezela kwethu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abantu bafinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ngokuqhubeka sithuthukisa uhlelo lwethu lokuhambisa iziguli, oluhambisa iziguli ukusuka ezibhedlela ziye kwezinye izikhungo noma ukusuka kuma-clinic ziye ezibhedlela. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuthandekayo nokunomusa kubaguli abaphethwe ezibhedlela nakwabanye abangenazo izibhedlela kusekelwe ohlelweni lwezempilo oluthuthukisiwe, futhi kusiza ekufundiseni, ukubhalisa, ukuhlola, ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko, nokudlulisela abaguli abadinga ukwelashwa okudlula amandla ezibhedlela zethu. Ukulethela izinguquko nezindlela ezintsha zokusebenza. Ukukhuthaza umsebenzi onikeziwe nezikhwama kuholele empumelelweni yabo. Ungathola izinsizakalo ngokulandela imithetho nemigomo ebekwe uHulumeni kazwelonke yokusebenza kwezibhedlela zendawo. Akudingeki ukuthi uze ezibhedlela uma wena noma ilunga lomndeni wakho engaphilile. Kungcono ukuqala kwiklinikhi eseduze; uma udinga usizo oluthe xaxa, iklinikhi izokudlulisela kithi. Uma udinga usizo olungaphansi kwenani lethu noma oluncane, sizokudlulisela kuklinikhi uma kutholakala ukuthi awukwazi ukwelashwa kuklinikhi ngemuva kokuhlolwa. Umphakathi omusha weMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal, uDkt. Busi Nyembezi, uqinisekisile ukuthi uzokwethula izinguquko ezintsha ezizoholela ekuthuthukiseni indlela umnyango owahlinzeka ngayo usizo emphakathini. Ekhuluma noNwele Olude ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi, ngemva kokuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uNks. Neliswa Peggy ekhombise isifiso sokusebenza ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, uDkt. Nyembezi uchaze ukuthi baphazamiswe ukungabi nezinsiza zokwenza umsebenzi wabo nokunye. Uqhubekile wathi umnyango uthuthuke kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zezempilo, kodwa okudingekayo ngokuphuthumayo yizindlu zabasebenzi bezempilo ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, okuyisidingo esiphuthumayo. Kukhona isidingo sezikhungo zezempilo ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nokwandiswa kwenani lezibhedlela, kodwa kudingeka sithuthukise indlela usizo oluhlinzekwa ngayo emphakathini, washilo. Ubuye waphinda wathembisa ukuqinisekisa izinhlelo zokulwa nokw spreading kwe-HIV/AIDS. Uhlele ukwenza lokhu ngokwakha izinhlelo zokubambisana nezinye izigaba zikamasipala kanye nabantu bezamabhizinisi abakwiMnyango wethu. Ukubakhona kwakhe kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi siqhubeka nokwakha izikhungo ezintsha ezifana nezikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi, kusho uNgqongqoshe. Umnyango wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo esifundazweni njengamanje uphakathi kokuhola ukufuna abasebenzi ukuze abhekane nezimo eziphuthumayo ezisemgwaqweni. Lokhu kuyingxenye yephrojekthi eqale ngonyaka odlule lapho abantu abangu-50 baqeqeshwa futhi manje sebebhizinisi emnyangweni. UNtsobi uthe iningi labantu abazobanjwa kuzofakwa ezindaweni zasemaphandleni uma beqedile izifundo zabo, ezilindeleke ukuthi zithathe izinyanga ezintathu. Siphinde saqala isigaba sesibili sokwandisa izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kulandela impumelelo yesigaba sokuqala ngonyaka odlule lapho sathola khona abantu abangu-50, kuchaza uNtsobi. Umphakathi uthe ngaphezu kuka-90% walabo abaqeqeshwayo bazoba ngabesifazane. Sibone ukuthi kungcono ukuthatha abesifazane abaningi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi nabo bahlala bebaningi kulomkhakha wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo. Eminyakeni edlule, umsebenzi wezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo wawaziwa ngokuba ubhekelelwe kakhulu amadoda. Sibone ukuthi abesifazane bangakwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi kahle njengabantu besilisa, kusho uNtsobi. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezinsizakalo eziphuthumayo kuyingxenye yephrojekthi kahulumeni wesifundazwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izindawo kulesi sifundazwe zithola usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo uma zidinga. Sizokuqinisekisa futhi ukuthi imiphakathi enezinkinga ezilinganiselwe ezindaweni zasemaphandleni ibhekwa phambili kulolu hlelo. Umnyango uqinisekisile ukuthi izinsizakalo eziphuthumayo zikhanga ngokwakha izikhungo zezempilo nezibhedlela ezisezingeni eliphezulu ukuze kuvinjwe ukufa okungadingekile okubangelwa ukulibaziseka kwabantu ukuthola usizo, kuchaza uNtsobi. Uthe labo abazothola umsebenzi ngeke bavele baphume kulesi sifundazwe. Kumele kube nabantu abangakaze bathole ithuba lokufunda ezikhungweni zokufunda eziphakeme. Uqhubekile wathi kumele babe ne-matriculation, amalayisense okushayela (ikhodi 10), kanye nezimvume zokushayela zomphakathi (PDP). Labo abaqedile izifundo zabo bazoba namathuba okuqhubeka nezifundo zabo kulo mkhakha lapho ekugcineni bazothola khona ezikoleni nasemanyuvesi. Sifundisa ukuzimisela, ukuhlonipha, umsebenzi onzima, ukuzinikela, nokuzinikela njengokhiye ophumelelayo. URonald Green-Thompson, uma sibuyela, sifunda kuye ukuze sibe ngcono. Usifundisile ukuthi kumele sikhule ngokwanele ukuze sikwazi ukusiza imiphakathi yethu. UGreen-Thompson uthe uyajabula ngentuthuko yezibhedlela ezintsha ezimbili, ezilindeleke ukuthi zivulwe maduze, futhi njengoba waziwa ngokusebenza nabo emkhakheni wezempilo kazwelonke nakuzo zonke izimpumelelo zezibhedlela zeMahatma Gandhi, sivuma lapho sikhuluma ngalesi siphakamiso, nalabo abahlanganyela naye kanye neBhodi, ngithumele amazwi eMnyango ngesikhathi seMnyango Wezempilo ngeziBhedlela zayo ezineziBhedlela ezingu-340, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, abasebenzi kulo mnyango abanjalo abawazisa kakhulu uProfesa osephakathi. Lezi zibhedlela ezingu-340 noKing Albert yizinto ezithinta konke esikwenzayo, wamenywa njengomphakathi kaGreen-Thompson ngenxa yokwakha. "Noma kukhona okuningi okufanele kwenziwe, iLuthuli Central Hospital kufanele ifune okungcono, kodwa umnyango ngonyaka ka-1995. kulo mnyango. Sibonga wonke umuntu ngalokho okwenzekile, kodwa ezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu nakubantu esisebenza nabo." UGreen-Thompson ungumholi wezobuchwepheshe osinikeze ithuba lokusiza labo abanemibhede engu-840," kusho yena. UMnyango Wezempilo uqaphele ukuthi uProfesa Green-Thompson ukwazi ukufaka izinzuzo ezivela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezingu-122. Umcimbi wokuhamba kwabo uProfesa wabanjwa ngothando olwakhiwe ngonyaka ka-2003. Ngemva kokuba ethole uGreen-Thompson obebandakanyeka ekuhambeni kukaProfesa Green-nokuzinikela nokuzinikela kulokho kuphinde kwathengwa umnyango izinto eziningi eminyakeni eminingi njengomholi uThompson. Ekhuluma, umsebenzi wakhe njengomholi ube yimpumelelo futhi imiklomelo yeMnyango Wezempilo. Lo mcimbi wahlanganyelwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uNks. weMnyango. onezikhungo zezempilo ezingu-56. wahlelwa ngalo mnyango. Wabanjwa eThekwini, e-ICC. Lapho umcimbi uphothulwa, uProfesa wanikezwa izipho zakhe kanye nephepha eliqukethe imiyalezo evela kubasebenzi balo mnyango. Njengoba sonke sazi, umcimbi awuyona umcimbi ngaphandle kwekhekhe, wonke umuntu ujabule ngekhekhe elenziwe kulo mcimbi omkhulu wokuhamba kukaProfesa Green-Thompson.
