Uma uhamba ukuyobona udadewenu noma udokotela wakho, chaza ukuthi uhlela ukuba nengane, ikakhulukazi uma unesimo esithinta wena njenge-diabetes, epilepsy, noma isifo senhliziyo. Uma wena nomlingani wakho nindodana, gwema ukuthatha noma iyiphi imithi ngaphandle kokuphakanyiswa udadewenu noma udokotela. Yenza kube yijwayelelo ukuvakashela iklinikhi yabesifazane abakhulelwe noma udokotela wakho. Uma kukhona othile emndenini wakho noma emndenini womlingani wakho owazalwa enesimo esithile sokukhubazeka noma onokukhubazeka kwengqondo, kokubona, noma kokuzwa, cela udadewenu noma udokotela ukuthi akudlulisela iklinikhi yokwelulekwa kwezakhi zofuzo eduze kwakho. Thola ukuphumula okwanele futhi unakekele umzimba wakho ngokucophelela. Thola ulwazi mayelana nokuncelisa. Xhumana neklinikhi noma nodokotela wakho ngokushesha uma uhlangabezana nokopha ezindlini zakho zangasese noma unezimpawu ezilandelayo: ukushisa kwenhliziyo okuqhubekayo, ukuhlinzwa, izinhlungu ezinzima, ukuvuvukala kwezinyawo noma imilenze, ukwanda kwesisindo ngokushesha, izinhlungu zesisu, ukuncipha kokukhipha umchamo, noma ukuhamba kwamanzi amaningi ezindlini zakho zangasese. Vakashela iklinikhi noma udokotela wakho cishe ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngemuva kokuba ingane yakho izalwe ukuze uhlole kahle ngemva kokubeletha. Yenza kube yijwayelelo ukuthatha ingane yakho uye eklinikhi yezingane ukuze uhlole njalo futhi uthole ukuvaccine okudingekayo. Xhumana neklinikhi yokuhlela umndeni ukuze uthole ukuthi yini okufanele uyisebenzise ukuvimbela ukukhulelwa.
Namuhla sikhona lapha njengenhlangano yoMnyango Wezobuholi Nezamasiko ukusiza nokuxhasa iNdlu Yobukhosi ekufezeni imisebenzi yayo, efaka phakathi ukufakwa ngokusemthethweni kwabamakhosi ngokwenkolo nangokuhambisana nomthetho. Nkulunkulu, umthetho osekelwe kahle uveza ukuthi ukufakwa ngokusemthethweni kwabamakhosi endlini yobukhosi kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngokuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko. Lo mthetho esiwakhe esifundazweni uveza ukuthi kuphela iNdlu Yobukhosi enegunya lokufaka abakhosi; ngaphandle kwalokho, uNgqongqoshe angasebenza kuphela ngalolu hlelo ngemvume yeNdlu Yobukhosi, uma singakwazi ukuba khona mathupha. UMbusi Hlongwane ungumkhosi wesithupha okufakwe ngokusemthethweni esikhathini esifushane kusukela le nhlangano yamanje esifundazweni sethu yaqala umkhankaso wokubuyisela isithunzi sobukhosi endaweni yaso efanele. Le ndawo, isivinini esihamba ngaso sikhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubukhosi busebenza njengendima ebalulekile njengesisekelo sobuholi ngaphansi kukahulumeni obusisekayo. Abaholi bendabuko ezikhathini zokucindezelwa bavame ukungabhekwa kule msebenzi obalulekile wokufaka abakhosi. Ngesikhathi se-apartheid, lo msebenzi obalulekile wokufaka abakhosi wanikezwa kumakhosi nabanye ozakwethu boMnyango. Umthetho WamaMandla Amnyama ka-1951 wawuhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ubuholi bendabuko buba ithuluzi kuphela labacindezeli. Umsebenzi wabakhosi wokubika kwiNdlu Yobukhosi uyinsakavukela yamasiko futhi uyisisekelo sobukhosi. Uhulumeni esinawo njengamanje esifundazweni uqale uhlelo lwezomthetho oluhloselwe ukubuyisela isithunzi nesikhundla sobuholi bendabuko ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zedemokhrasi njengoba kulawulwa nguMthethosisekelo. Njengohulumeni, siyazi ngomonakalo owawwenziwe yizimiso zangaphambilini kumkhiqizo wobuholi bendabuko. Siqonda, Mhlaba Womhlabathi, ukuthi uthole ukuthi ungabhekwa ngaphandle ezimweni zokufakwa kwabamakhosi nakwezinye ezaziholwa abaholi bendabuko kodwa zenziwa ngozakwethu boMnyango. Nokho, namuhla siqinisekisa wena, Mhlaba Wombuso, ukuthi ukufakwa kwabamakhosi ngeke kusetshenziswe njengemivuzo noma ukuheha ukwesekwa kwezimboni zezepolitiki. Ubukhosi buyisikhungo esihloniphekile kuMthethosisekelo wethu. Yingakho uhulumeni uphakamise izimiso ezifanele zomthetho zokubambisana (IGR) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabamakhosi nezinye izigaba zokuphathwa kukahulumeni. Ngikhuluma lapha namuhla ngoba uhulumeni wethu wesifundazwe saseKwaZulu-Natal uqale ucwaningo lokuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni wesifundazwe, ezendabuko nezikahulumeni. Ngifuna ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ukuthi abakhosi kanye nonke sikhishwe ezimweni zomthetho zohulumeni bangaphambilini ekubambeni iqhaza ezinhlelweni zikahulumeni. Kodwa kusukela manje, le mikhawulo iyinto yesikhathi esedlule. Kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuqinisekisa "ukubuyiselwa" kwesithunzi sobukhosi njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuphatha. Nokho, kuyadabukisa ukuthi abanye bethu sebebambelela ekusebenziseni ubuholi bendabuko ngezinhloso zezepolitiki nasemphakathini. Esikhathini esedlule, abepolitiki nabaphathi baphakamisa abanye abakhosi phezu kwabanye. Lo hulumeni wamanje uzokwamukela kuphela ukuphakanyiswa okuhambisana nemikhuba yamasiko futhi okuvunyelwe yiNdlu Yobukhosi. Ekupheleni konyaka odlule, ngihambele emhlanganweni wokuthuthukisa amasu okusebenza komnyango wami. Kumele ngithi le njongo ifaka phakathi ukuhlela kabusha isikhungo sobukhosi ukuze sisebenze ngaphandle kokungabaza. Kungalesi sizathu nakwezinye ukuthi ngikhuluma ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuphatha kahle, kuhlanganise nokuhlela kabusha kwezintela ezikhokhiswa ezindaweni zobukhosi. Ngakho-ke, Mhlaba Wombuso, ngikhona namuhla ukuze ngiqinisekise neNdlu Yobukhosi ukuthi ukuhlonishwa kwabamakhosi nguhulumeni ophathayo esifundazweni kuyisiko elihle elilandelwa emhlabeni jikelele. Lokhu kuhlonishwa kugcinwa ngezinga elihlukahlukene nokuphathwa kwezinhlelo ezahlukene okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe leli sithunzi; akufanele kusetshenziswe ukukala izikhundla zabaholi bendabuko ngokumelene nezikhundla ezahlukene zikahulumeni. Izikhundla zendabuko ngaphansi kwesakhiwo sobukhosi zingxenye yaleyo miphakathi ngaphansi kukabukhosi. Ngaphezu kokusiza imiphakathi ezindaweni zobukhosi nabaholi bendabuko ukuze bathole ukuhlonishwa ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezikhona, umnyango wami usebenza ngokwakha kabusha izikhungo zokuphatha zendabuko. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuguqula "izinkantolo zobukhosi" ezaziwa ngaphambili zibe izakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenza ngezisebenzi ezahlukene, ngaleyo ndlela zikwazi ukusungula ubudlelwano nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza abaholi bethu bendabuko nezakhiwo zabo ukuba bathathe ithuba lezi thuba ezichazwe emthethweni kazwelonke mayelana nokuphathwa kwendabuko (njengokukhulunywa nguMthethosisekelo waseKwaZulu-Natal). Omunye walezi thuba ukufinyelela ezivumelwaneni zokubambisana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ukuze zenze imisebenzi ethile lapho isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sinokwakhiwa ukuze kwenziwe njalo. Ngokwesibonelo, mhlawumbe isakhiwo sokuphatha sobukhosi singasiza umphakathi ngezincwadi zokufaka izicelo zomsebenzi, uqeqeshe abantu ngamakhono amanje e-computer. Abakhosi bangengxenye yoHulumeni obukhona bokuphatha. Ngakho-ke, kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuhambisa izakhiwo zabo nezakhiwo zikahulumeni ezibekiwe. Kumele ngiqhakambisa namuhla ukuthi le nhlanganisela ihloselwe kuphela izinjongo zokusebenza. Ihloselwe ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo nokuthuthukiswa. Ubudlelwano phakathi kukabukhosi noMeya abukhombisi ukufana ezikhundleni. Kungaba yiphutha ukukhipha umkhosi ezindabeni zomphakathi ngenxa yokuthi, emicabangweni yethu, kufanele akhulume nomlingani wakhe eKapa noma ePitoli. Singase sibe nomqondo onjalo ovela esikhathini esedlule. Nokho, sigcizelela namuhla ukuthi ubudlelwano bethu, obuhlukahlukene ezakhiweni zikahulumeni, bugxile kakhulu ekusebenzeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kuhanjiswa ngokushesha ezizweni zobukhosi. Bonke abakhosi bayazi ukuthi siphuma phi ekuthumeleni izinsizakalo ezindaweni zabo, futhi sidinga ukuba baxhase nathi njengohulumeni ekuthumeleni lezi zidingo ngokushesha. UMbusi Hlongwane kanye nesizwe, njengendawo yaseKwaZulu-Natal, siyajabula ngentuthuko esiyenzayo ekubuyiseni isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko, ukuguqulwa kwaso, nokuhambisana nezinye izakhiwo zokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lezikahulumeni. Ngithatha leli thuba ukukhumbuza bonke abakhona lapha namuhla ngezinto ezibalulekile ezihlobene nesiko mayelana nokufakwa ngokusemthethweni kukabukhosi. Kukhona umthetho oselindelekile esifundazweni onikeza ulwazi olunembile ngalesi sihloko. Nam
Siyaziqhenya ngokudla esikuphekayo ngokulandela iziqondiso zokudla ezihlinzekwe kubaguli abafakwe esibhedlela. Njalo ngosuku ngo-30 ntambama kulabo abafuna ukuthenga okunye. Uma udokotela eqinisekisile ukukhishwa kwakho, lungela ukuya ekhaya. Isikhathi sokukhishwa sokuhamba ekhaya sikhona ngo-10:30 ekuseni, okukunikeza ithuba lokuthola imishanguzo noma amaphilisi nokuthola okuthile okufanele uthathe ekhaya ngesikhathi. Sizama ngazo zonke izindlela ukuhlinzeka ngothando nokunakekelwa okudingwa ngabaguli, siqinisekisa ukuthi sivikela amalungelo abaguli ngokulandela izinqubo ezichazwe kumagugu amalungelo abaguli. Abasebenzi bethu abaqeqeshiwe banelisa futhi bazinikele ekuhlinzekeni ngempilo ephephile kubo bonke abaguli. Uma unazo iziphakamiso, izikhalazo, noma izincomo, sinezikhwama zeziphakamiso kulo lonke isibhedlela, futhi ikomidi elibhekelelayo lizobuyekeza futhi liphendule lapho kudingeka. IZINSUKU ZOKUVAKASHA Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abaguli bathola usizo oluphakeme, sicela ukuthi izikhathi zokuvakasha zilandwe. Uma uvakashela isiguli, sicela uqinisekise ukuthi awudluli inani ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo. Uma uthola phakathi kuka-R1,000 no-R36,000 ngonyaka noma uma umndeni uhola phakathi kuka-R1,000 no-R50,000, kulindeleke ukuthi ukhokhe u-R30 esibhedlela. Le mali ikhokhwa uma uhlale ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyi-30; uma udlula ezinsukwini eziyi-30, ukhokha u-R30 olwengeziwe ngosuku ngalunye. Abesifazane abakhulelwe bavunyelwa ukuhlala kuze kube ezinsukwini eziyi-42 emva kokubeletha.
Uhlelo lokuphuthumayo. IZIMPahla Izinto zakho zizogcinwa egumbini lokugcina ukuze ziphephe. Izinto ezifana nemali, okhiye bezimoto, namafoni eselula. Uma ukhetha ukugcina izinto zakho nawe, qaphela ngazo. Isibhedlela asizukuba nesibopho sokulahleka kwazo. Cela izinto zakho uma ushiya. IZINHLOKO ZOKUKHOKHA Izindleko zesibhedlela zingakhokhwa ngempahla noma ngekhadi lezokwelapha. Uma isiguli singanemali, kukhona indlela enikezwa uMnyango Wezempilo. Yiba neqiniso uma uhlinzeka ngemininingwane yezempilo. Buza uma kukhona okungaqondi. Buza uma kukhona ofuna ukukwazi okwengeziwe. Gwema izenzo ezingamukeleki nezingeziwe. Zama ukuqonda inkinga yakho. Yazi abasebenzi abakwelapha. Hlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli. Landela imithetho, imithetho, nemigomo yesibhedlela. Khokha izindleko zesibhedlela. Qiniseka ukuthi ulandela imihlahlandlela enikezwe abakhiqizi bezempilo. Bika kubakhiqizi bezempilo uma amalungelo akho ephulwa. Qinisekisa ukugcina izimfihlo zabasebenzi. Cela noma yini oyidingayo mayelana nokwelashwa kwakho kumphakathi noma kudokotela.
Mhlonishwa uMphathiswa; uMkhulumeli kanye noMkhulumeli oPhakeme boMphakathi; Amalungu anhloniphekile ePhalamende leSifunda; uSihlalo kanye nawo wonke amalungu anhloniphekile weKomidi Lezempilo. Abaphathiswa kanye Nezikhulu; Abaholi bendabuko phakathi kwethu; uMphathi weSigaba, uDkt. Busi Nyembezi; Abaphathi bezigaba kuzo zonke izigaba kuhlanganise nabaphathi bezempilo bezifunda, abaphathi bezibhedlela, amalungu ebhodi lezibhedlela, amalungu eBhodi Yokuhlola Ngengqondo, Amakomidi Ezempilo, Abaphilayo bendabuko, kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo kuMnyango Wezempilo. Abanye abahloniphekile abakhona lapha engingabakhumbuzi; Bafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Izinselelo ezimangalisayo esibhekene nazo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezempilo, sizama ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo obekwe ezikhwameni zethu ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lobubha elenza umsebenzi wethu ube nzima kakhulu. Masihlangane njengabantu baleli sifunda elimangalisayo emkhankasweni wokulwa nobubha, ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane, izifo, nokukhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ekunakekeleni amalungelo abantu kanye nobuhlakani bomuntu ngamunye. Izindaba zezempilo kanye namalungu anhloniphekile yizihloko eziyisisekelo ezixoxwa ezinkundleni ezibhekana nokuthuthukiswa kokuphila komphakathi kanye nomnotho. I-International Rural Women's Conference ibanjwa eThekwini njengoba sikhuluma. Siyazi ukuthi eSifundeni sethu, abesifazane benza u-53% wabantu bonke futhi iningi labo lihlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, izifo, ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukuhlinzekwa ngempilo, nokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Kukhona amazwe athuthukayo asebenze kakhulu kulezi zinselelo esibhekene nazo. Sithemba ukuthi le ngqungquthela izonikeza ithuba lokwabelana ngemicabango yokuthi singabhekana kanjani nalezi zindaba ezibhekene nabesifazane ngesikhathi esithile. Umsebenzi wethu njengomnyango wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngokulandela umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo kusukela ezingeni eliphansi, sigxile ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zezempilo kumuntu ngamunye ngokulinganayo, sithinte umphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo futhi sisebenzisane nazo zonke izigaba ezikhona esifundeni. Isikhungo sokuqala sokunakekelwa kwezempilo sakhiwe endaweni yePholela lapha eKwaZulu-Natal ngo-1948, eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwe-Alma Ata Declaration mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuqala ngo-1978, njengendlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphakeme. Umndeni wezempilo emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithuthukayo, uyavuma ukuthi kumele siqinise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuqala uma sifuna ukubhekana kahle nomthwalo wokulwa nezifo. Sibe nezikhathi eziningi ngonyaka odlule lapho sakhuluma ngezaziso ezihlukahlukene zezempilo emiphakathini. Kulonyaka sizokwakha kulokho njengesisekelo sigxile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obunomthelela ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi sisebenze ndawonye ekuxoxeni ngezihloko noma izindaba ezihlobene nezempilo, futhi ngaleyo ndlela sizokhula ndawonye. Ngithemba ukuthi ngalokhu sizobona intuthuko nezinkomba zokuthuthukiswa kwezempilo. Sibhekene nezinga lobubha elingu-54.3% kulesi sifunda, kanti kwezinye izindawo zasemakhaya izinga lobubha likhulu kakhulu elilinganiselwa ku-80%. Sake sathi izinga lokungabi nokudla liphakeme kakhulu ku-70%. Kulesi sifunda, kuphela u-32% wabantu abanokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile (kwezizwe kubalwa ku-79% kanti u-24% wezindlu unazo izinsiza zokuhlanza ezanele kulesi sifunda kanti kwezizwe kubalwa ku-62%). Lezi yizinselelo ezifanayo ezithinta izindawo zasemakhaya ezizungeze amadolobha lapho kukhona izinga eliphezulu lobubha, ukungakwazi ukufinyelela ezidingweni zezempilo ezanele, kanye nechungechunge lezifo. Izifunda ze-Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Umzinyathi, Zululand, nezinye izingxenye zendawo ye-Ilembe zinezinga eliphezulu lobubha elikhonjiswa yizinkomba zomnotho. Izifunda ze-Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Umzinyathi, ingxenye esentshonalanga ye-Uthukela, ne-Zululand, ingxenye eningizimu ye-Umkhanyakude zinezinkomba ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lobubha kanye nokuntuleka kokuphila komphakathi (kuhlanganisa nezinga eliphansi lemfundo, ubukhulu bezakhamuzi, iningi labantu libantu abasha, abantu abadala, nabantu abakhubazekile). Izindawo zasemakhaya e-Umzinyathi, Uthungulu, Uthukela, Umkhanyakude, Zululand, Ugu, Ilembe, ne-Isisonke zinezinkomba ezikhombisa izinga eliphezulu lokungahlinzekwa kwezidingo ezibalulekile kuhlanganisa amanzi, ukuhlinzekwa ngempilo, nokuntuleka kohlelo lokuphatha udoti okudala inkinga enkulu kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ngenhlonipho ye-Alma Ata, kumele sisebenze ndawonye nezinye izigaba ezikwi zinhlelo zokuthuthukisa ukuze sibhekane nezinkinga eziphazamisa impilo yomphakathi futhi zinciphise ukuzinza komnotho. Njengengxenye yale mizamoyethu, sifuna ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuhlola impilo zomphakathi eduze komphakathi futhi siphinde sikhuthaze imikhankaso yokuphila kahle nezinhlelo zemfundo yezempilo ezihloselwe ukwazisa, ukufundisa, nokukhuthaza imiphakathi mayelana nezempilo. Abasebenzi bezempilo bazoqinisekisa ukuthi leli hlelo liphumelele. Iyunithi egxile emabhizinisini amancane, i-Targeted Enterprises Unit, yasungulwa kulo mnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amabhizinisi owned by black abantu adlala indima ebalulekile ekuthengiseni kukahulumeni ukuze kuncishiswe izinga lobubha kulesi sifunda futhi kuthuthukiswe izimo zezempilo futhi kwakhiwe ikusasa eliphephile neliphumelelayo. Okwamanje, ugxile kuma-cooperatives, amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, namakhulu (SMMEs) ikakhulukazi lawo asevele ehlukunyezwa. Kukhona izinhlelo ezihloselwe ngqo abesifazane, intsha, kanye nezinkampani eziphethwe abantu abakhubazekile. Imali engama-R81 million ihlinzekwe ngaphansi kohlelo ukuze inikeze amabhizinisi ithuba lokuncintisana esikhundleni sokuthumela izimemo kumabhizinisi athile ukuze ancintisane ngezintengo ezibekwe emsebenzini odingekayo. Le msebenzi ibonise intuthuko ekwazini ukuphatha umkhankaso wezokusebenza emkhakheni wamabhizinisi ama-cooperative. Lokhu kubonisa ngokucacile ukuzinikela komnyango ekulweni nezifo, ekulweni nobubha, nasekunikeni ithemba kubantu baseKwaZulu-Natal. Kukhona ubufakazi obucacile bokuthi uma ubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni impilo nemfundo yabesifazane, uthuthukisa isimo sempilo yezingane zabo okuyisisekelo senhlangano enempilo enekhono elikhanyayo. Umkhakha ophathelene nesimo sabesifazane ngesikhathi
Mnumzane ohloniphekile, uMphakathi wePhondo, uDkt. Sibusiso Ndebele, ohloniphekile, amalungu eKhansela, amalungu ePhalamende lePhondo, uMnumzane ohloniphekile nozakwethu beKomidi Lezempilo, uMeya ohloniphekile kanye namakholwa, oBaNtu bendabuko, uMphakathi weMnyango, uDkt. Yolisa Mbele, abasebenzi beMnyango wezempilo, izivakashi zethu ezahlukene, izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, abafowethu nodadewethu, ngiyanibingelela. Mnumzane ohloniphekile, ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukuhlala phambi kwenu nalesi sikhungo namuhla njengomuntu onenhlonipho futhi ozinikele kwiAfrican National Congress, lapho sibhiyozela iminyaka emihlanu yokuzinikela kwalesi sikhungo ekusebenzeleni abantu, njengoba kuchaziwe nguMongameli wethu, uMnumzane ohloniphekile uThabo Mbeki, ngesikhathi ekhuluma ngenkonzo yokusebenza kwabantu ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokulwa nobuphofu. Siqhubeka nalesi sizathu, futhi ngikholelwa ukuthi senze okungcono kakhulu ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi nasekulweleni ubuphofu. Lokhu kuboniswa yisisho sethu eMnyangweni wezempilo, "Ukulwa Nezifo, Ukulwa Nobuphofu, Ukunikeza Ithemba" kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi eziyishumi ePhondweni lethu elihle eminyakeni emihlanu edlule. Siphinde safika kude ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinhloso ze-Black Economic Empowerment. Izikhathi eziningi, izinselelo esihlangabezana nazo njengombuso nasemhlabeni wethu, kanye nomsebenzi esizibekele wona, zidinga ukuthi sikhuthaze abantu, sibahlanganise bonke ukwenza okudingekayo, futhi siqonde ukuthi ikusasa lomuntu ngamunye sikhona ezandleni zethu! Mnumzane ohloniphekile, uMongameli uthi kufanele sikhumbule lapho siphumelele noma siphumelele. Ngakho-ke, ngithanda ukuthi sibheke izinselelo esihlangabezana nazo kule minyaka emihlanu yokuzinikela kwabantu, njengoba uMongameli esebenzisa ukuzinikela kwabantu baleli zwe nalesi sikhungo. Okokuqala, phakathi kwezinkinga ezinkulu esihlangabezana nazo mayelana nezinkulumo ngemiholo yabasebenzi bakamasipala. Lapho lezi zinkulumo zifika endaweni engatholakali, kubangele ukuthi abasebenzi baphume emsebenzini ngoJuni 1, 2007. Lokhu akukhange kulahlekelwe abasebenzi beMnyango wezempilo. Ukungenelela okuhle kweMnyango kwakwazi ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zempilo ngesikhathi lesi sikhathi esinzima. Nakuba bekukhona lezi zifiso, izikhungo zethu zezempilo zazithinteka kakhulu futhi izimali ezinkulu zatholakala zikhokhela abasebenzi bangaphandle, ikakhulukazi abantu bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuze basize umphakathi odinga usizo. Siphinde sathola ukuthi kufanele sithenge amabhentshisi ezibhedlela ezizimele futhi sathola izindleko ezinkulu. Enye inselelo esihlangabezana nayo yisifo seKlebsiella ephondweni. Amalungu azokhumbula icala elibi ePrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital lapho izingane zafa ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa ngenxa yeKlebsiella virus. Ucwaningo lwethu lukhombisile ukuthi le nkinga ivamise ukuvela ngenxa; (i) indlela izibhedlela zethu ezakhiwe ngayo, ikakhulukazi amakamelo; (ii) izimo zomnotho zabesifazane abasha abapheka abadinga ukuthembela kubodadewabo futhi bengakwazi ukulawula izindaba eziphathelene nokusebenza kwezocansi; (iii) ukudluliswa kwezifo ngenxa yokuthi izindlu zenzelwe kanjani, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni; kanye (iv) indlela imindeni ehlelwe ngayo engasizi empilweni yentsha. IPrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital iyisibonelo esihle sokuhlangabezana nalezi zinkinga engizichaze. Okokuqala, idolobha laseUmlazi linabantu abaningi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amadolobha ephondweni, kodwa alinalo usizo lwezempilo olufanele, okwenza iPrince Mshiyeni Memorial Hospital ibeke umthwalo omkhulu wokuletha abesifazane abaningi. Le nqubo ikhipha cishe abesifazane abangu-1,000 ngenyanga, futhi kulezi zingane, cishe abangu-525 bagcinwa kwiyunithi ye-neonatal besesimweni esibucayi. Isikhala esitholakalayo sincane kakhulu sokwamukela izingane eziningi, futhi kunezikhathi eziningi zokuthi zidlulisele izifo ezahlukene. Okwesibili, ukungabi nezinsiza kuleli dolobha kwenza kube nzima kumphakathi ukuhlela imindeni, ikakhulukazi kubesifazane abasha abavame ukutholakala bephakathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuxhumana okuqondile nokudluliswa kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, kuhlanganise ne-HIV nezinye izifo ezifana ne-tuberculosis ne-Gonorrhea. Lokhu futhi kukhombisa kahle ukuthi intsha yethu ayifuni ukuzibandakanya ocansini oluphephile noluvikelekile! Ngalesi sizathu, ngihlala ngikhuthaza ukuthi kufanele siqale ukusebenza kanzima futhi sibe nendima ehamba phambili ekulweleni ukusabalala kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi (kuhlanganise ne-HIV) nokushintsha imicabango uma kuziwa empilweni yocansi. Ngenkathi iMnyango izosebenzisa konke okusemandleni ukuvimbela ukufa kwezingane ezizalwayo; sidinga futhi wonke umuntu ukusiza ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanzeka ekhaya, nokuqeqesha bobabili amantombazane namadoda ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi akukhona okungafunwa kokukhulelwa nokuphazamiseka kwezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Sonke sinesibopho esibalulekile sokufundisa izingane zethu ukuba babe yibo abazothatha ukunakekela amalungelo abo ocansi. Sizodinga futhi ukusebenza ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba ukuze sinciphise ukusabalala kwezifo ngenxa yezimo zomphakathi. Isibonelo esihle nguMnyango Wezokwakha emizamweni yawo yokuhlukanisa izindawo ezingekho emthethweni ngo-2014, isenzo esifanele ukuhalaliswa. Njengomnyango, emalini edlule, senze imikhankaso engu-45 yezempilo, okuyimizamo yokufundisa imiphakathi ngempilo engcono, sikholwa ukuthi lokhu kuzonciphisa umthwalo ezikhungweni zethu ezithola abathintekayo bezifo ezingavimbekile. Mnumzane ohloniphekile, kube nezikhathi eziningi lapho sithinteka kakhulu ukulahlekelwa ngabasebenzi abanekhono nokwehluleka kwethu ukuheha ukuba basebenze ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Lokhu kungenxa yokuntuleka kwezindlu nezimali ezanele zokwakha izindlu, futhi lokhu kusemiphakathini njengoba silwa nokwakha izikhungo zezempilo. Sisesekude kakhulu ukuvimbela ukusetshenziswa kwabasebenzi besikhashana eMnyangweni wethu. Kunezikhungo eziningi eziqhubeka nokuhola abasebenzi besikhashana ukuze ziqinise izibhedlela nezinye izingxenye zeMnyango. Sihlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke lokhu kuvalwa masinyane nokuthi bonke labo basebenzi baqashwa ngokuphelele nguMnyango. Siqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izikhala ezibalulekile zizogcwaliswa ngoJuni futhi sisesimweni sokwenza lokhu kwenzeke. UMongameli wezwe ngesikhathi esikhuluma wathi "Ngizokwenza izinto ngendlela engajwayelekile" futhi sihlela ukwenza noma yini edingekayo ukuze sifinyelele leli phupho - noma ngabe kanjani okungajwayelekile. Mnumzane
Kukhona nodokotela omunye onolwazi lokuthi wathola kanjani i-MDR-TB emsebenzini wakhe wezokwelapha noma ezibhedlela zethu, okwaholela ekutheni abone ukulahlekelwa ukuzwa. Lokhu nguDkt. Thabiso Thusi ovela ePort Shepstone. Ngiyabonga bonke abasebenzi bezempilo abaqhubeka nokuthatha izifungo zokwenza imisebenzi yabo ngokuqotho ngenkathi bebhekene nezinselelo nezithiyo kulolu work. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyishumi, ngibuyela phambili phambi kwenu ngemuva kokhetho lwango-2009 lapho i-African National Congress (ANC) ibuyiselwa emandleni, okwaholela ekutheni inikezwe ithuba elisha lokuphatha zonke izakhiwo zikamasipala. Kungalesi success ukuthi ku-Manifesto Yokhetho, i-ANC ibeke impilo phambili njengomunye wezindawo ezinhlanu ezidinga ukunakwa. Abantu bethu bavote i-ANC ngoba inhlangano yethu izimisele kakhulu ezindabeni zempilo ezweni futhi ukuthi ngempela ziyamalungelo abantu. Lokhu kugcizelelwa umthethosisekelo wethu, ikakhulukazi iBill of Rights. Njengoba amanzi ewumsebenzi obalulekile kubo bonke, njalo njalo, ukuba esimweni esiphilile kuyinto ethinta wonke umuntu ophilayo. Ngesikhathi sikhulula ibhajethi ngo-2009, isiqubulo sethu sasi: "Siyagcina izimpilo. Ake sithuthukise izinsiza zempilo zibe zifinyeleleka kubantu." Ukuthuthukiswa kokufinyelela ekwelashweni kwabagulayo be-TB kuyisixhumanisi sokuhlaselwa kwabo yi-HIV. Ukwandiswa kwezinsiza kulabo abaphethekile emakhaya nakwabanye abasebenza kwezempilo yomphakathi. Ukusizwa ngendlela efanele. Njengoba sethula ibhajethi ka-2010, umqondo wethu uthi Impilo Engcono Kubo Bonke. Lokhu kwakwakhiwe phezu kokuzinikela emsebenzini engiwethulile ngo-2009. Kulolu work, uMnyango ukhethe izibhedlela eziyishumi nanye esisebenzisana nazo ukuze noma ubani ongene emnyango wabo azizwe sengathi ukhuluma endaweni yokwelashwa. Sikholelwa ukuthi lezi zinto ezishiwo zingenzeka uma siqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi basebenza ngokuzikhandla ngokuhlala bebheka ukuthi kwenzekani ezibhedlela abaphatha, belalela izikhalazo zabaguli, bephendula izinkinga ezingahambi kahle ekunikezeni izinsizakalo zehospitals, futhi bejolise abasebenzi ukuze bagcine besebenza ngokuqhubekayo. Ngiyafuna ukucacisa lokhu: Abaguli balindele ukwelashwa okuhle nakuba kunezinselelo esibhekene nazo. Ekupheleni kwalesi sikhathi, sizokhipha isaziso sokuthi yiziphi ezinye izibhedlela eziyishumi nanye nezikhungo ezizobandakanywa kulolu hlelo njengoba sizimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi phakathi kweminyaka emihlanu zonke izibhedlela zethu zifakwa kulolu hlelo. Kumele ngiqhakambise ukuthi izibhedlela zasemaphandleni ziwumfanekiso esingaziqhenya ngawo ngezindlela eziningi. Lapha singakhuluma ngeSifunda sase uMzinyathi, esibonakala sithola kahle kulolu mkhakha. Ngiyacela ungivumele ngifunde le ncwadi evela kumguli oyedwa echaza i-COSH. Ezinye izibalo zikhuluma ngezici zempumelelo ye-MDGs. Iphinde igcizelele izinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Nakuba lezi zibalo zikhombisa ukuthi kukhona intuthuko ezindaweni eziningi, le ntuthuko ibonakala ingalingani. Asikafiki ezingeni lapho singenza khona isiqiniseko sokuthi sikhona okwanele ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu abathintekayo, ikakhulukazi omama nezingane zabo ezisanda kuzalwa. I-HIV ne-TB: abantu abangu-304,000 (kuhlanganise nezingane eziyi-22,000, abesifazane abangu-140,000, nabantu besilisa abangu-66,000) babekwe ezinhlelweni zokwelashwa. I-TB: Isibalo sabantu abane-TB abathola ukwesekwa nge-DOTS sehlele kusuka ku-80% ngo-2005/6 sibe ngu-72% ngo-2008/09. Isizathu salokhu kube nzima ukugcina labo abanesifiso sokusiza labo abaphakathi kwezinhlelo zokwelashwa. Lokhu kungenxa yokwehluleka ukugcina labo abahlinzeka ngensizakalo ku-DOTS. Isibalo sabaguli abangapheli ohlelweni lwabo lwezidakamizwa sehlele kusuka ku-14% ngo-2005/6 sibe ngu-8.7% ngo-2009/10. Ukulethwa kwesikhathi sokwelashwa kuthuthuke kusuka ku-15% ngo-2005/6 sibe ngu-53.15% ngo-2009/10. Impumelelo yokwelashwa yanda kusuka ku-35% ngo-2005/6 sibe ngu-58.15% ngo-2009/10. Ukuvela komdlavuza we-cervical: Isifunda sikhulume ngokwehla okungu-90% emdlavuzweni we-cervical. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuhla kusuka ezimweni eziyi-606 ngo-2007/8 ziye ku-429 ngo-2008/9 phakathi kwalabo abathintekile ngalolu sifo. Kukhona intuthuko enhle kuzo zonke lezi zindawo. Kufanele sibhiyozela le mpumelelo esiyitholile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi umdlavuza we-cervical uyahlulwa. Kufanele sonke siqhenye ngentuthuko eyenziwa emhlabeni jikelele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi impilo ibhekwa phambili, ngisho nasezikhathini lapho kunezinkinga ezindaweni eziningi zomhlaba. Ngemuva kweminyaka engaphezu kwe-15 sithole uhulumeni wenhlangano, kukhona izinkomba zokuthi ngokwandisa ibhajethi yomnyango wezempilo, singathola imiphumela ebonakalayo. Ngakho, ngo-2009, sakha ithimba labaphathi esalibiza nge-Joint Management Team eliholwa yiKZN Treasury. Leli thimba lisebenza ngokulandela uhlelo lweminyaka emithathu oluhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isimo sezimali sitholakala endaweni efanele yezezimali zonyaka ka-2011/2012. Sabe sikhuluma ngezindlela zezezimali ngenkathi siphucula indlela esiphatha ngayo amakhasimende ethu. Sizame konke okusemandleni ethu ukususa ukusetshenziswa okungafanele, ubugebengu, ububi, ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokuhlanganisa imali, nokwakha ukuphathwa kwangaphakathi. Ngiyajabula ukukwazisa ukuthi sihlele ukuphathwa kwezimali nokuphepha nokulethwa kwezidingo zokusebenza zabaphathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho ukuchitha, ubugebengu, nokuphanga. Esigabeni sokuqala sokuhlelwa kwalesi hlelo, sikwazile ukusindisa u-R400 million ngo-2009 ngenhloso yokusindisa u-R600 million ekupheleni konyaka wezezimali. Isivumelwano seKhartoum sika-1988 sathi: "Ngoba umuntu uyisisekelo sokuthuthukiswa konke, isimo sokuphila komuntu yiso kuphela esingalinganiswa ukuthuthukiswa. Ukuthuthukiswa kwalolo sikhathi sokuphila kwabantu kubalulekile kakhulu kulabo abampofu nabasengozini, abawumjikelezo omkhulu e-Afrika. Abesilisa nabesifazane base-Afrika bangabantu okufanele baqinisekise futhi baqiniswa yisiphi uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa." Sekudlule iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili selokhu lesi sivumelwano sasayinwa ngabesilisa nabesifazane abathwele umthwalo wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu, kodwa kuze kube manje umsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlonipha isithunzi sabantu ngokubaphelezela ngosizo lwezempilo awukaphelelanga. Ngonyaka owedlule, umzukulu wami engimthandayo, engimsebenzelayo, washona engozini yemoto, kwalandela ubaba wami ezinyangeni ezimbalwa kamuva. Ngiyabonga nonke kakhulu. Mnumzane ophakeme, madoda nabesifazane, ngicela ngethule le nkulumo egameni labantu abathathu engibasebenzelayo kakhulu. Ngesikhathi lesi, sahlonipha iminikelo yabasebenzi bezempilo, futhi saphinde saphawula ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabasebenzi bezempilo emhlabeni jikelele. Lo msebenzi ungumsebenzi odinga abantu abaningi, ngakho kubalulekile ukuba necebo, hhayi nje lokuqasha abasebenzi, kodwa nokugcina labo abasebenzi bejabulile, bethuthukisiwe, futhi besekelwa emsebenzini wabo. Kulonyaka sizokwenza ngcono uhlelo lwethu lokunakekela abasebenzi, siqala ngamaqhinga azokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bethu baqhubeka befunda njalo ukuze le Ndawo ibe yindawo yokufunda nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Njengengxenye yecebo elaqalwa ngonyaka owedlule lokuhlela kabusha le Ndawo, ekuqaleni kwalonyaka kwanikezwa ithimba labaphathi abaphezulu eliholwa nguDkt. Ithimba elisha labaphathi lizosebenza phezu kwesisekelo esakhiwe ukuze liphakamise umsebenzi wezempilo ezingeni eliphezulu ngokulwa nezifo, ukulwa nobuphofu, nokunikeza ithemba kubantu. Kulonyaka sizokwakha uhlelo lokuguqula insizakalo yezempilo, i-Health Service Transformation Plan, esizosebenza kuyo kuze kube unyaka ka-2014. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zezempilo zikhishwa ngendlela efanele ezindaweni ezihlukene nasemaphandleni. Ngalolu hlelo, usizo lwezempilo kumele luhambisane nezidingo zabantu, lube nekhwalithi ephezulu, futhi lube nezezimali eziphumelelayo. Lolu hlelo kufanele luphinde luhlolisise udaba lokushoda kwabasebenzi bezempilo ngohlelo lwabasebenzi bezempilo kazwelonke olwenziwe ngokofficial ngosuku lweMhlaba Lokunakekelwa Kwezempilo nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Lolu hlelo lubalulekile kakhulu ngoba ukushoda kwabasebenzi kuvimba ukufezekisa Izinhloso Zokuthuthukiswa KweMillennium nokuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu ezingeni eliphansi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lolu hlelo lwenziwa. NjengeSikhungo kulonyaka, sizosungula izindlela ezintsha zokuqasha, ukuthuthukisa, nokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Umbiko owaziwa njenge- Wealth Report 2006 ubonisa ukuthi isifunda saseMelika seMnyango Wezempilo Womhlaba, esinama-10% ezifo, sinama-37% abasebenzi bezempilo emhlabeni futhi sisebenzisa ama-50% ezimali zonke zezempilo emhlabeni, kuyilapho isifunda sase-Afrika, esinama-24% ezifo, sinama-3% abasebenzi futhi sisebenzisa ama-1% ezimali zomhlaba wezempilo. Lo mbiko uqhubeka uthi ukuhamba kwabantu abaqeqeshiwe bezempilo abanezidingo eziphuthumayo kwenza i-Afrika ibhekane kakhulu nokushoda kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo kubalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Ukuze sifeze umgomo wesikhungo sethu - okuwukwethula uhlelo lwezempilo oluhlanganisiwe, oluhlanganisiwe nolubhekelela izidingo zempilo eziphakeme ezindaweni zonke - sizosiza imiphakathi ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ngokuthenga ama-75 amakhilikhini aphumayo, sakhe amakhilikhini angu-30, nezibhedlela ezintathu ezinkulu kulonyaka wezimali. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo, odokotela bezempilo bazophinde baqeqeshwe futhi bakhuphuke ukuze sikwazi ukubhekana nomthwalo wezifo. Ukuphathwa kokunakekelwa kwezempilo okuyisisekelo kuzobuyekezwa futhi kuqiniswe. Sihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukulingana kulokhu kwabiwa nokuthi yonke imiphakathi iyazuza. Izifundo zethu zinikezwa kubafundi abampofu okwenza umehluko omkhulu, futhi sizophinde siqhubeke nalokhu. Sithatha isinyathelo endleleni eya esikhathini esizayo. Yebo, uhulumeni kanye nasemkhakheni wezokuzimela. 1. Sigxila empilweni yethu futhi siphila ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, umgomo wethu ukuveza izimanga ukuze sibe isibonelo kubalingani bethu. 2. Siphatha kahle futhi sivikela imvelo nendawo esikuyo, okungavela ekubhekeni phambili ngokuqonda. 3. Sihlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli nabapheki ngokuphelele. Siphikisa ukuphila kahle ngoba sigcizelela ukuthi amathuluzi okusebenza awaphelele. Ukufisa ngaphakathi kwethu ukufisa. 4. Sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza zempilo ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokuchitha noma ukungabaza ukuze siphumelele ngaphezu kokulinganiswa, njengamaphiko asenza sibhakabhake njengezinyoni. Ukufisa kwethu ukuthuthukisa. 5. Siqinisekisa ukuthi siyazi ngezinhlelo zempilo eziseduze nezempilo, ngolwazi, futhi ngokufundisa umphakathi esikuyo, futhi ukuthi basiphathe kahle ngendlela ephelele, lokhu kuhambisana. 6. Sinikeza abasebenzi bezempilo ulwazi olufanele nokwesekwa komzimba, kwemizwa, nasengqondweni. Sizinikele ukusiza ocwaningweni, ekwelashweni, nasekuphathweni komuntu ngamunye ngendlela eqotho, ekuhloleni, ekwelashweni, ekubuyiseni, nasezingeni eliphezulu lobuchwepheshe obunolwazi. 7. Sazisa abapheki bezempilo ngentshisekelo yethu yokwenza okudingekayo kumuntu ngamunye, sigxile esimweni sabo kanye nokufa komuntu ngamunye, ubulili babo, iminyaka, nokukholwa kwabo. Ukukholwa okujwayelekile ukuthi. 8. Silandela imithetho yokwelashwa nesikhathi esithi "wenza kwabanye njengoba ungathanda ukuba benze kuwe" okuhlobene nokubuyiselwa. Sizoletha induduzo kulabo. 9. Sibuza ukuthi izindlela zokwelashwa noma zokubuyiselwa zibhujiswe noma zaphukile. Zimi kanjani? Sihlela indlela yokukhokha. Usizo lwezinga eliphezulu. Ukwelapha wonke umuntu ngendlela. Uhlanga noma umxube. Lokhu kunikezwa umuntu onesifo se-cholera: Faka amathisipuni ayisishiyagalombili kashukela engilazini yamanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nethisipuni elilodwa lesawoti. Hlanganisa bese unika umuntu ophuma emathunjini futhi onenhliziyo yokuphuma, njengoba lokhu kubuyisela amanzi emzimbeni. Ukuvuselela amanzi emzimbeni kubalulekile; zonke izinkomba ze-cholera zidinga ukuthi umuntu abuyiselwe amanzi ngokushesha. Ungawashisi izingubo ezingcolile noma uvumele abantu badlale, baqhamuke emanzini omphakathi afana nezinsimu. Uma beshonile, kufanele babekwe ebhokisini elivulekile lapho bephuma endaweni eyodwa beyisa kwenye. Batha emanzini afudumele aneshampu bese umisa elangeni. Izimpawu zivele phakathi kwamahora ambalwa kuya ezinsukwini ezinhlanu. Ukulimala kwemithambo, kulandela ukulahleka kwegazi okuholela ekufeni. Abantu abangenamanzi ahlanzekile afana nalawo asuka emtapweni. Abantu abasebenzisa amanzi atholakala emifuleni, emadams, noma emifuleni. Uma uthatha amanzi emfuleni, kufanele uwahlanze kuqala ngaphambi kokuwasebenzisa. Hlanza imifino ngamanzi ahlanzekile noma amanzi aphekiwe. Hlanza izandla ngaphambi nangemva kokudla. Hlanza izitsha ngamanzi ahlanzekile noma amanzi aphekiwe. Hlanza izandla njalo uma ubuya esikhathini. Gcina ukudla endaweni ehlelekile. Ukudla kufanele kuphakelwe ngamanzi ahlanzekile futhi kudliwe ngesikhathi esishisayo. Gwema umkhuba wokudla esitsheni esisodwa ngasikhathi sinye. Ukudla okuphekiwe akufanele kuhlangane nokudla okungaphekiwe ukuze kugwenywe ukuhlanganiswa. Ukulahla udoti kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela engaphuli amanzi emithonjeni efana nemifuleni. Gwema ukuheha izinyoni. Gwema noma iyiphi ukudla okungcolile, ikakhulukazi inhlanzi engaphekiwe noma engaphekiwe. Imifino kufanele ihlanzwe. Kub dangerous kakhulu ukudla ukudla okungaphekiwe. Enye indlela yokwenza amanzi ahlanzekile wukwengeza ithisipuni eliphelele le-chlorine kumalitha angama-20-25 wamanzi. Linda okungenani amahora amabili ngaphambi kokuphuza amanzi. Xwayisa abapheki bokudla ukuthi: - Akufanele babambe ukudla uma begula. Kufanele bahlanze imifino nezithelo ngamanzi ahlanzekile ngaphambi kokuzisebenzisa. Gcina ukudla endaweni ehlelekile. Pheka ukudla kahle ngamanzi ahlanzekile futhi kudliwe ngesikhathi esishisayo. Gwema ukuhlanganiswa kokudla okuphekiwe nokudla okungaphekiwe. Hlanza izandla ngeshampu namanzi ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese/naphambi nangemva kokulungisa ukudla. Gwema umkhuba wabantu ukudla esitsheni esisodwa. Khumbula ukufudumeza ukudla okuvela izolo ngaphambi kokudla. Khuthaza abantu ukuthi basebenzise izipuni lapho bedla. Indlela ephephile yokulungiselela ukudla.
Ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo (CASS) kumele kube ingxenye yokufundisa nokufunda futhi kumele kusetshenziswe ezindaweni zokufunda. Umfundi ngeke anikezwe umphumela uma uphawu lwakhe lwe-CASS lungekho. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ifomu lokumemezela (Appendix A) kumele liphothulwe futhi lisayinwe ngombili umfundi kanye neNhloko yeSikhungo. INhloko yeSikhungo kumele iqinisekise ukuthi bonke abafundi banephuzu le-CASS eduze kwamagama abo kumakhasi wezimpawu, noma incwadi echazayo uma kungekho uphawu olubhalwe, ngaphambi kokuthumela ama-portfolio ku-ABET District Support. Abaphathi be-ABET Centre bazohlangana njalo ngenyanga ukuze basebenzisane futhi babelane ngemininingwane mayelana nekhuluma kanye nokuhlola. INhloko yeSikhungo kuyo yonke imikhakha kulindeleke ukuthi ihlanganise umbiko wokuthi i-ICASS iyaphumelela kanjani ezindaweni zokufunda zonke futhi ithumele lo mbiko ku-ABET District Support njalo ngenyanga. Abasebenzi be-ABET District Support kumele bahlanganise umbiko we-CASS besebenzisa imibiko efinyeziwe evela kubaphathi beSikhungo kanye nemibiko yokwesekwa nokuhlola kwezindawo zokufunda njengesisekelo. Umbiko we-CASS ohlanganisiwe kumele uthunyelwe ku-ABET District Support njengoba kukhombisiwe kuhlu lokuphathwa. Abafundi abangakapheli zonke izidingo mayelana ne-CASS kumele banikezwe uphawu. Ukuhanjiswa kwezimpawu kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imibhalo ibhalwe kahle. INhloko yeSikhungo kanye ne-ABET District Support kumele iqinisekise ukuthi ukucubungula ezingeni lesikhungo kwenzeka okungenani kanye nangesikhathi sokufunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindinganiso zokucubungula zesizwe nezwe zigcinwa. Abaphathi beSikhungo kumele bathumele amakhophi emakhasi wezimpawu asebenzayo ukuze baveze intuthuko eyenziwe ezindaweni zokufunda ezithuthukiswa ezikhungweni zabo ku-ABET District Support ngaphambi kosuku lwama-25 kuJulayi 2003. Uhlu lwamagama akhethiwe luzothunyelwa ezikhungweni ngomhla ka-14 kuAgasti 2003. Kuphela amakhasi wezimpawu anemibhalo eguquliwe azobuyiselwa ezikhungweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe. Isikhalazo kumele sithunyelwe ku-ABET District Support phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili zokuthola ama-portfolio. Ukuhlola kuzohambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zomphakathi. Izikhungo zedolobha zinesibopho ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zedolobha ukuqapha le misebenzi yolimi nezinketho zabantu abakhonza lapho bexhumana nabantu, kufaka phakathi izidingo ezikhethekile zabantu abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala. I-Framework yeNqubomgomo Yezilimi Zesizwe inikeza ukuthi uma iMiphakathi ikhetha izilimi ezizokwenziwa ezikhethwe ngamasiko, kufanele ithuthukise, iphumeze, futhi ilandele inqubomgomo ephethe ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi. Iphromotha ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni ezikhuluma ngabaningi eThekwini, okuyi-isiZulu ne-English. Iphucula ukufinyelela kulwazi nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa uhulumeni. Ikhuthaza futhi isekela abantu ukuba bafunde izilimi ezisemthethweni ngaphezu kolimi lwabo lokuqala, okuzosiza ekwakheni nasekugcineni ubumbano njengelizwe nasekugcineni ubuhlanga obuhlukahlukene obunothile bezwe. Iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi ngokugxila ekuphathweni kahle kwezilimi. Iphumeza futhi ilandele izinhlinzeko zeSigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo kanye nezimiso ze-Batho Pele nezinye izimo ezifanayo zokusebenza. Ukukhethwa kwalabo abazokwenziwa yiMiphakathi. Ukususwa kwazo zonke izithiyo ekusetshenzisweni kolimi ngaleyo ndlela kukhuthaza ukufinyelela okufanele kumaphrojekthi nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa yimiphakathi. Iqinisekisa ukuthi akekho ophoqelelwa noma ovinjelwe ekusetshenzisweni kolimi abalukhethayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ingabe iyinye yalezo ezizokwenziwa noma cha. Inika isiZulu ne-English isimo esifanayo nokwelashwa. Izinhlinzeko zalolu hlelo zizosebenza kuzo zonke izakhiwo zomphakathi. Noma yiluphi ulimi phakathi kwalezi ezimbili olungasetshenziswa yiMiphakathi lungasetshenziswa kunoma yisiphi isimo noma umhlangano weBhodi yayo noma amaKhomidi. Emihlanganweni yeBhodi kanye namaKhomidi ayo, kumele kube nabahumushi bezilimi ezilodwa kulezi ezimbili ezingasetshenziswa. Uma noma yiliphi ilungu lifuna ukuthi okwenzeka kuhunyushwe kolunye ulimi olungelona olunye lwezilimi ezizokwenziwa, lelo lungelo kufanele libike kuMongameli weBhodi noma lelo Khomidi kusenesikhathi ukuze kudingeke ukuhumusha. Ulimi lwezandla kumele lutholakale futhi uma kudingeka. Noma yimiphi imihlangano yomphakathi noma imicimbi yomphakathi kumele ihlelwe ngolimi olungasetshenziswa ngokwezinketho zababekhona. Uma kukhona ababekhona abangakwazi ukuqonda ulimi olukhulunywayo, kumele kuhunyushwe. Zonke izinqubomgomo, imithetho, nezinqumo zeBhodi kanye namaKhomidi ayo kumele zibhalwe ngazo zombili izilimi zomphakathi ezisetshenziswayo. Zonke izaziso ezisemthethweni nezikhangiso ezikhishwe ukuze zikwazise umphakathi kumele zishicilelwe ngesiZulu nangesiNgisi. IsiZulu noma isiNgisi singasetshenziswa ukuze kube nokuxhumana okubhaliwe ngaphakathi. Uma umuntu obhalelwa engakwazi ukuqonda ulimi olusetshenziswayo, bangacela ukuba babhalelwe ngolimi abalukhethayo. Izikhumbuzo kumele zikhishwe ngazo zombili izilimi ezisetshenziswayo. Ukuxhumana okukhuluma ngaphakathi kungaba ngesiNgisi noma ngesiZulu kuye ngababonayo. Ukuxhumana nabantu bangaphandle kumele kube ngolunye lwezilimi ezisetshenziswayo, kucatshangelwa ukuthi yiluphi ulimi olukhethwe umamukeli. Uma incwadi ibuyiselwa ngaphandle, impendulo kumele ibe ngolimi lapho leyo ncwadi ibhalwe khona. Ukuphuma kokuxhumana kumele kukhombise ukuthi uma umamukeli efuna ukubhalelwa ngolunye ulimi phakathi kwalawo angasetshenziswa, lokho kuzokwenzeka uma bekucela. Abantu banelungelo lokusebenzisa ulimi abalukhethayo. Izibonakaliso ezikhombisa izikhungo noma amahhovisi omphakathi kumele zibe ngazo zombili izilimi ezisetshenziswayo. Zonke amakhasimende kumele asizwe ngolimi abalukhethayo, ngosizo lomhumushi, uma kudingeka. IMiphakathi kumele iqinisekise ukuthi abamele izigcawu nezisebenzi bayakuqonda ukubaluleka kwezilimi ezahlukene futhi bakhuthazwe ukuba bamukele ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezikhethwe ngababhalayo/amakhasimende, abanye abamele izigcawu, nezisebenzi. Ukuhumusha nokuhumusha kwiMiphakathi kufanele kwenziwe ngabantu abanamakhono aqeqeshiwe abaqeqeshwe ngalolu work abaqashwe ngumnyango wezilimi zomphakathi. IMiphakathi kumele iphromothe futhi isekele ukuthuthukiswa kwezakhono zolimi phakathi kwezisebenzi nabamele izigcawu. Izisebenzi nabamele izigcawu kufanele bakhuthazwe ukufunda ezinye izilimi ezingezona ezabo njengoba lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuqonda kwezilimi ezahlukene, ukuhlonipha amasiko ahlukahlukene, nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo. Uma iminyango yomphakathi iqasha izisebenzi ezintsha, kumele bagcine le nqubomgomo yolimi engqondweni. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma kule nqubomgomo noma isinqumo seBhodi, le nqubomgomo izothatha isikhala kusukela ngosuku lokwamukelwa yiBhodi. Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha zokwamukelwa kwale nqubomgomo, uMphakathi kufanele ubeke izinsuku zokuphumeza izimo zalesi siqondiso.
Njengoba siphakathi kwephondo leKwaZulu-Natal, sijabule ukubona intuthuko esiyenzile emizamweni yokubuyisela isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko kanye nokubamba kwabo iqhaza kuzo zonke izici zokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lezakhamuzi. Umphathi wohlelo, ovela emphakathini waseMalangeni, ubonisa ukuthi ukuba lapha kusinika injabulo enkulu ngoba indawo yaseMalangeni inembali ejulile. Le ndawo iyindawo yokuzalwa kweNkosi uShaka ka Senzangakhona. Sazi futhi ukuthi amaqhawe amaningi aphumelele eEmalangeni. Futhi kule ndawo, emindenini eminingi, abantu baphunyukile ezweni labo elicebile. Nakuba kukhona izahluko ezingezinhle emlandweni wale ndawo, ilanga liqhubeka likhanya eEmalangeni. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa kwenkosi yethu lapha kwenzeka emuva kwesizinda esikhulu somlando ngesikhathi esibalulekile lapho ubuholi bendabuko buhamba phambili, buya phambili kunakuqala. Lezi zinguquko zifaka phakathi ukubuyiselwa kobuholi bendabuko kanye nokuphatha kwabo ezimpandeni zabo, ngokwemikhuba yendabuko. Siphakathi lapha namuhla sinesiqiniseko sokuthi nakuba ukuhlongozwa kwenkosi yethu kuwumcimbi obalulekile ohambisana nenjabulo nokuqhakambisa isiko, kuhlanganisa nomthetho, ukuphatha ngendlela efanele, kanye nokubaluleka kokugcina isiko. Isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sikhishwe kakhulu yizimiso ezahlukene zik government ezazikhona ngaphambili. Kodwa manje lesi simo siyashintsha. Uhulumeni wesizwe omusha uhlose ukuhlinzeka abaholi bendabuko ngamathuba okwakha uhlelo lokususa umthelela wezinhlelo eziphazamisa nezokucwasa esakhiweni sobuholi bendabuko. Ndawonye sisebenza kanzima ukufinyelela lapho sikhona namuhla. Okwamanje, siphakathi kwenqubo yokwakha umthetho ozotholwa ezingeni lephondo mayelana nabaholi bendabuko nokuphatha, futhi uzobhekana nezindaba ezithinta thina ngqo njengesifunda. Nokho, lokhu ngeke kube ukwephula umthethosisekelo kazwelonke. Ezimweni ezifana nalezi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume kahle izinto. Ngivumele ukuthatha leli thuba ukuqala ngokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile zamasiko mayelana nomcimbi wokuhlonishwa kwenkosi. Nakuba kuzobe kusekhona umthetho ophakanyisiwe ephondweni ozohlinzeka ngemininingwane ngalokhu. Kodwa ngifingqa, ngingasho lapha ukuthi umndeni wezakhamuzi uhlangabezane nomsebenzi wawo ngokukhetha uNkosi uNgcobo njengenkosi yesizwe saseMalangeni. Okwazozayo ukuthi indlela yendabuko izophelelwa uIsilo SamaBandla, lapho kuzoba khona nendlela yethu endala yokuhlanganyela amanzi. Le mikhuba ibalulekile kakhulu ngoba inkosi iyona ekhonzayo amakhosi, futhi amakhosi nawo akhonza inkosi. Le mikhuba sifisa ukuba ihlonishwe, futhi sikhuthaza wonke amakhosi ukuba ahloniphe le mikhuba. Angazi ukuthi bangaki bethu abazi noma basakhumbula lezi zinkolelo, njengoba ingxenye enkulu yesiko lethu lendabuko ilahlekile eminyakeni edlule. Ngiyakwazi ukusho ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile ekuvuselelweni kwesithunzi samakhosi. Ngiveze izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye esizithathile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sithola indawo yaso efanele. Le mizamoyihlanganisa ukuthi ekugcineni, indima yamakhosi ekuletheni intuthuko iyahlonishwa. Sazi ukuthi uNkosi uNgcobo kanye nekhansela lakhe, kanye namanye amakhosi, njengengxenye yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko, sebesebenzile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa, ngakho manje iOndabezitha iyamenywa ukuphatha ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ukuze baxhumane futhi basebenzisane nezakhiwo zikamasipala ukuze kube nezinqumo ezisheshayo zokuletha intuthuko emiphakathini yamakhosi. Uhulumeni ukholelwa ukuthi intuthuko nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kungasheshiswa ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yamakhosi kanye nezikhulumeli ezikhethwe. Imizamo kaNkosi uNgcobo ekuletheni intuthuko kule ndawo, ngiyakholelwa nonke niyazi. Akukho shwa ngokuqinisekile ngokuqhubeka kwenkosi ekuletheni intuthuko. I-IDP, sibona izoba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu ngokusheshisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Sonke sibona ukuthi nakuba inkosi izama, isikhundla senkosi, njengezinye eziningi, sishayeke emsebenzini wokulethwa kwezinsiza zentuthuko. Lesi simo asivumelekile. Njengohulumeni, sikholelwa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uthuthuke ngokulinganayo; akufanele kube nezinsimu zecala phakathi kokuhlupheka nokungabi nalutho. Futhi akufanele kube nabantu abaphila kahle kakhulu kanti abanye bahlupheka kakhulu. Lesi simo umasipala kufanele asicwaninge futhi alungise ngokubambisana namakhosi kanye nekhansela zabo. Ngiveze indima yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko ekuletheni intuthuko; kufanele sibe nesithunzi semisebenzi yabo emicimbini yomlando esilethele lapho sikhona namuhla. Umlando usitshela ukuthi ekuvikeleni abantu babo, amasiko, nezwe, amakhosi amaningi, kuhlanganise nalabo abavela kulezi zintaba nezindunduma, bathatha izikhali ukuze balwe nokucwaswa. Ezimweni ezifana nalezi, asikwazi ukukhohlwa ubuholi bukaBhambatha kaMancinza, owayenqotshwa yizikhali zesimanje zabahlaseli, kodwa waphonsa isisekelo sokukhululeka nentando yeningi esiyijabulelayo namuhla. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa kwenkosi uNgcobo namuhla kuqinisa ukuqhubeka kwesikhumbuzo sobuholi obuhlala buhamba nezinye izinkosi eziningi kule phondo kanye nezifiso zabo zokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu. Umphathi Wohlelo, uhulumeni wethu ubaluleka kakhulu kumakhosi, hhayi ngoba bangabaphethe bamasiko nemikhuba yendabuko kuphela, kodwa futhi ngoba bamele ingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kwentando yeningi esekelwe kumthethosisekelo. Kuye kwaba yinto ebalulekile kuhulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko ziqiniswa. Uhulumeni weKwaZulu-Natal ukholelwa ukuthi kudingeka ukuvikelwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuthuthukiswa kokuba khona kwabaphathi bendabuko kanye nezikhulumeli ezikhethwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu bethu. Iqiniso ukuthi njengelizwe kanye nephondo, sithola izinguquko ezinkulu kwezomnotho nasemphakathini. Siphila eNingizimu Afrika lapho intando yeningi nentuthuko manje seziqhulwini. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ungumholi wendabuko, umphakathi, noma uMphakathi wePhalamende, unendima ebalulekile futhi edingekayo ekufezeni umgomo wethu wokukhulula abantu emsebenzini, endlaleni, nasekuphatheni. Ukuhlongozwa kweOndabezitha uMapholoba namuhla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uhulumeni egxile kakhulu ekubuyiseleni ithemba kubantu bethu emiphakathini. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusungulwa kweziteshi zokuxhumana phakathi kukamasipala nezakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko. Akukho shwa ukuthi ukusungulwa kwempumelelo kweziteshi zokubambisana phakathi kwezinga lempilo yomphakathi kuzoholela ekulethweni kwezidingo ezisemqoka futhi kuzosheshisa ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi yokuphila kwabantu basemaphandleni. Lokhu kusikhuthaza ukuba sibe sobala kwiZahluko 211 no-212 zomthethosisekelo wethu,
UMphakathi wezobulungiswa kanye nentuthuko yeMithetho usungule lezi ziqondiso ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ngemuva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 30 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukulingana Nokuvikela Ukwehlukaniswa Okungafanele ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 4 ka-2000). Isicelo sokubekwa njengomqondisi obhekiswe kuso esigabeni 17 soMthetho kumele sibe sobala ngokubhalwe phezu kwefomu efana neFomu 1 enamathelwe ku-Anexure bese sithunyelwa kuMphathi-Jikelele. Ubufakazi bezincwadi zomsebenzi ezivela kubasebenzi babafakizicelo, uma zikhona; kanye namagama, amakheli, nezibalo zocingo zabantu ababili abangaxhumana nabo mayelana nesimo somfakizicelo. Ukubekwa kwabamqondisi kuncike ekuphothulweni kwemfundo ethile evunywe nguMphathi-Jikelele. UMphathi-Jikelele angabeka umuntu ukuba abe ngumqondisi isikhathi esivumelwano phakathi kukaMphathi-Jikelele nomfakizicelo, futhi umfakizicelo uzoba nelungelo lokuthola inani eliphelele lemali elilinganayo nenani eliphelele elamukelwe ngabamqondisi ngezizathu zokuphatha eMnyangweni. Imigomo yokubekwa komuntu njengomqondisi njengoba kuqondiswe esigabeni 1 ngenhla ifana nemigomo yokusebenza efanele umuntu obekwe njengomqondisi wecala ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuxhumana Kwabasebenzi BezeMisebenzi ka-1994, Isaziso No. 103 ka-1994. Xwayisa abafakizicelo ukuthi banelungelo lokuthola imali yokufakiza futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umfakizicelo uyasizwa ngalokhu, uma kudingeka; futhi ukuthi benza imisebenzi yomqondisi wecala ezimweni zomphakathi uma kudingeka ukuze kufezwe okukhulunywe ngakho ngumthetho. Umuntu, inhlangano, noma ikhomishini ebhekiswe esigabeni 20 salo Mthetho, efuna ukulethela udaba phambi kwenkantolo noma ukufaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ingakwenza lokho ngokwazisa umqondisi wecala ngenhloso yabo yokwenza lokho usebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 2 enamathelwe ku-Anexure. Xwayisa umphikisi usebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 3 enamathelwe ku-Anexure, ukuthi baphikiswa; futhi ucele umphikisi ukuba ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ebhaliwe ebhekiswe esigabeni 3 seFomu 3 enamathelwe ku-Anexure phakathi nezinsuku eziyishumi kusukela ngosuku abathola ngalo lesi sikhumbuzo. Umqondisi kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokuthola impendulo evela kumphikisi obhekiswe esigabeni 2(b) ngenhla, athumele ikhophi noma ikhophi yalolu phendulo kumfakizicelo noma kumuntu owafaka udaba. Umqondisi kumele, phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esibhekiswe esigabeni 2(b) ngenhla, athumele udaba kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, okumele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokuthola wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nodaba, akhiphe isinqumo sokuthi udaba luzokwenziwa enkantolo noma ludluliselwe kwenye inkantolo. Uma umphathi ophakanyisiwe ethatha isinqumo sokuthi udaba kumele lwenziwe enkantolo, kumele adlulisele udaba kumqondisi, okumele, phakathi kwezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuthola udaba, abeke usuku lokwenziwa kodaba. Umqondisi kumele, ngemuva kokubeka usuku lokwenziwa kodaba, wazise umfakizicelo nomphikisi ngaleso sikhathi sokwenziwa kodaba usebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 4 enamathelwe ku-Anexure. Kumele bathumele ikhophi yesinqumo senkantolo kuzo zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kudaba; futhi bazise/benze bonke abantu abathintekayo kudaba ngezincwadi ezithunyelwe kule nkantolo ebhekiswe esigabeni a. Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ezokwenza udaba ithole amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni 8(a), le nkantolo kumele ikhiphe isikhumbuzo esibhalwe esazisa zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kudaba nomqondisi wecala ngokwamukelwa kodaba. Le nkantolo ethunyelwe udaba kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni 8, ithumele umbiko kumqondisi wecala, ibika ngentuthuko eyenziwe kulolo daba. Uma le nkantolo ibuyisela udaba emuva enkantolo, le mbuyiselo kumele ibe sobala phezu kwefomu efana naleyo engxenyeni B yeFomu 5 enamathelwe ku-Anexure, ichaza izizathu zokuthi kungani udaba buyiselwa emuva. Inkantolo kumele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisixhenxe kusukela ngosuku udaba lubuyiselwa emuva enkantolo, iqondise ukuthi udaba luzoxoxwa kanjani. Umqondisi kumele asheshise ukuwazisa labo abathintekayo kudaba ngosuku lokwenziwa kodaba ngemihlahlandlela ngaphansi kwalezi ziqondiso ezibhekiswe esigabeni 6. Kuthunyelwa kumphikisi noma kufakwe enkantolo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela engaphathwa umphathi ophakanyisiwe. Isikhumbuzo esibhekiswe kuMthetho 66 kumele sinikezwe kumsebenzi wenkantolo noma kumqondisi kuzo zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kudaba ngokwakhe. Umuntu ofuna ukuthumela isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo ukuze avele phambi kwenkantolo kumele akwenze okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ngaphambi kosuku lokwenziwa kodaba, ecela umqondisi wecala ukuba alungise futhi akhiphe isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo ngokushesha. Isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo esikhiphwayo kumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 ku-Anexure. Lokhu kuyindleko yomsebenzi wenkantolo; noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ongabekwa umphathi ophakanyisiwe. Umuntu ohambisa isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo kumele aqedele ingxenye B yesigaba sesibili seFomu 6 enamathelwe ku-Anexure. Ukubakhona komfakizicelo phambi kwenkantolo ngokuyalelwa kwenkantolo kwenziwa ngokuthumela leso sikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo, esikhiphwayo ngumqondisi, okumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 enamathelwe ku-Anexure. Isikhumbuzo kumfakizicelo esibhekiswe esigabeni a kumele sithunyelwe kumfakizicelo ngumsebenzi wenkantolo ngezindleko zik 정부. Umuntu obizwayo ukuba avele phambi kwenkantolo njengomfakizicelo angacelwa ukuba akhiphe amadokhumenti athile noma amaphepha noma isitatimende noma noma yini enye ehambelana nalolo daba. Wonke umfakizicelo, ngaphandle komsebenzi wombuso ophelele, obizwayo ukuba avele phambi kwenkantolo unelungelo lokukhokhelwa imali ebekwe esigabeni c ngezansi ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe esigabeni b. Umphathi ophakanyisiwe angathatha isinqumo sokuthi umfakizicelo angakhokhelwa noma angakhokhelwa inani elithile lemali. R100 ngosuku noma ingxenye yosuku lapho umfakizicelo edingeka ukuba abe enkantolo; nezindleko abangazichaza kahle zokufika enkantolo nezindleko zokuthenga ukudla ezitholwe ngumfakizicelo ngenxa yokufika enkantolo. Umbuso uyakhipha uma umfakizicelo ebizwayo enkantolo ngokuyalelwa kwenkantolo noma ebizwayo yinkantolo; noma umuntu ocela ukuthi umfakizicelo abizwe noma akhokhelwe ngokuyalelwa komph
Qaphela: 1. Izincwadi ezithunyelwe ngabanye abantu noma eminye imibhalo yokweseka leli cala kumele ifakwe kule fomu. Uyanqotshwa ukuthi inkantolo ye-equity ingadlulisela le ndaba kwenye inkantolo noma itiriyoni. Uma le ndaba ibuyiselwa enkantolo ye-equity, umgibeli wenkantolo uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngalokho. Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singanele, thumela imininingwane bese uyifaka kule fomu, ubhalela zonke amakhasi. Engxenyeni C: IMINININGWANE YE-PLAINTIFF/DEFENDANTS imininingwane elandelayo kumele ihlinzekwe kumuntu ngamunye owayebanga. Uhlobo lokuphikisa: ucela ukuthi unikeze imininingwane ephelele, usuku lapho kwenzeka khona izehlakalo, kanye nemininingwane yabo bonke abangaba ngofakazi. Imibhalo: Ingabe bekukhona imibhalo noma amaphepha angase asekele ukuphikisa kwakho, isibonelo, incwadi yesipho, ithikithi lezimpahla, imibhalo ephathelene, noma ukurekhodwa kwezingxoxo? Ukubuyiselwa okucela: Sitshele ukuthi ufunani ngosizo. I-inkantolo ingakhupha umyalo wesikhashana, noma inqume ukuthi kuhlawulwe inhlawulo, noma inqume ukuthi umphikisi kufanele axolise ngaphandle kwezimo noma noma yisiphi isinqumo esinye. Imibuzo noma usizo olukhona mayelana nalabo abakhuluma ngenhla. Ungakwazi futhi ukuqonda okuqukethwe kwalesi sikhumbuzo esibhaliwe? Uphikisa ukuthatha isifungo/ukuvuma njengoba kuchaziwe? Uthatha isitatimende esifungiweyo njengokubophezela enhliziyweni yakho? Ngiyavuma ukuthi umuntu othatha isifungo uvumile ukuthi bangakwazi futhi baqonde okuqukethwe kwalesi sikhumbuzo esibhaliwe. Mnumzane Ohloniphekile, uMeya weGu District, uNgqongqoshe S. Mphathi, umnyango wami ugcizelela ukubaluleka kwekhaya nokulethwa kokuthuthukiswa ezweni. Yingakho noma kuphi sihamba khona, sikhombisa ukuthi "umuntu ungumuntu ngenxa yekhaya." Ikhaya lingachazwa njengesisekelo somuntu wonke. Ikhaya yindawo lapho izingane zikhuliswa khona ngokuphepha, zithola zonke izinto ezidingekayo ezizovumela ukuba zakhe izwe lesikhathi esizayo. Kukhona ubudlelwano obubalulekile phakathi kwekhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nezwe elinempilo. Ngamanye amazwi, uma singakheki izindlu, asizukuba nezwe. Kukho okuningi okwakha ikhaya, kodwa iphuzu lokuqala lokwakha ikhaya "yindlu." Ubuqotho bomuntu kanye nazo zonke izinto azidingayo ukuze aphumelele buphazamiseka kakhulu uma engenayo indlu yokuhlala ngaphansi. UManzankosi uhlolile izinga lokushoda kwezindlu emindenini ukuze kuncishiswe ngokushesha ubuphakathi bezindlu kule ndawo. Ngemva kokubuyekeza imiphumela, kwavela ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi okufanele wenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bethu babe nezindawo abangazibiza ngekhaya futhi baphile izimpilo ezingcono. Thina, njengohulumeni onothando, sathatha isinqumo sokusebenza kanzima ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola izindlu, okuyilungelo labo ngokomthethosisekelo. Ngamanye amazwi, lo mnyango uzinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi wonke umuntu unendawo enobuqotho yokuhlala, kungakhathaliseki ngesimo sabo somnotho. Leli lungelo liphakathi kwabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala emadolobheni noma ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi kule ndawo, sinezinkulungwane zabantu abahluphekayo. Kukhona inani eliphezulu labantu abangenamsebenzi kule ndawo, futhi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abantu bethu akukabhekiwe. Ukuphazamiseka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo kukhombisa kahle ukunganaki kukahulumeni we-apartheid, owangazange unake ukuphuculwa kwezimpilo zabantu bethu lapha. Akumangalisi ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinga elingu-61% labantu abangenamsebenzi. Ngisho nalabo esithi bayasebenza bathola imali encane kakhulu. R800.00 ngenyanga. Lokhu kukhombisa kahle ukuthi lo mphakathi udinga usizo lukahulumeni ngezindlu nokuthuthukiswa kwezinye izinsiza, ngoba uma kungenjalo, ngeke bakwazi ukuzisiza ngenxa yesimo sabo somnotho esiphansi. Njengoba ngishilo, konke kuqala ngekhaya. Nakuba umcimbi wethu ungase ungahlangene ngqo nokwethulwa kwezinye izinsizakalo zomphakathi, kufanele ngikhulume ngalokho okubalulekile ukwenza ikhaya libe nolwazi futhi lizinze ezimpilweni zabantu. Enye yezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi kule ndawo wamanzi. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zalokhu, kuhlanganise nezomiso ezivame ukuhlasela le ndawo. Kodwa kuze kube namuhla, uhulumeni wethu usebenza noMkhandlu weGu ukuze kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu lapha banokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile. Umnqopho wethu njengohulumeni uwukuthi wonke umuntu abe nendawo ephephile yokuhlala. Njengohulumeni, sisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze sakhe izindlu zabantu bethu ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuzigqaja ngokuba nezindlu ezisemqoka futhi babuyisele ubuqotho babo. Umsebenzi esiwethulayo namuhla uhlanganisa nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kuhambisana kahle nenhloso kahulumeni yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Inani labantu abadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kule ndawo liphansi kakhulu, liphakathi kuka-73% wezindlu zonke lapha. Njengoba ngichazile, ikhaya kumele libe nolwazi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kubeka ezimpilweni zabantu engcupheni futhi kunciphisa ubuqotho babantu bethu. Ngalesi sizathu, sithathe izinyathelo ezibanzi ukusiza wonke amakhaya ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola ngokushesha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisa izindlu, amanzi, ugesi, nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka eziphephile. Njengoba sifeza lo msebenzi wokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu lapha, lo msebenzi uzophinde ube nezinye izidingo zomphakathi ezibalulekile. Siyajabula ukubona ukuthi uMkhandlu weGu usuhambe phambili ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela komphakathi ezinsizeni zokuhlanzeka ezifanele. R4.6 million ukusiza umphakathi wethu lapha eZinqoleni ukuze uthole izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanzekile. Njengomphakathi, kuyajabulisa ukubona isivinini sokuthi umsebenzi wenziwa sikhula ngoba abantu bethu baphinde balinde lezi zinto isikhathi eside. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, enye inselelo esibhekene nayo ekushiseni izindlu wukuntuleka kukagesi. Ngizokhuluma kancane ngalokhu ngoba umsebenzi usuqalile. Sineziindlu eziyi-1789 esidinga ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kulo nyaka njengengxenye yomkhankaso wethu wokuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani wonke umuntu unogesi ngonyaka ka-2012. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, simi lapha namuhla ngenjabulo enkulu. Siyajabula ngoba imindeni eyayingenazo izindlu izothola izindlu ezakhiwe ngazo namuhla. Namuhla le miphakathi izothola izinzuzo zedemokhrasi njengoba siqala uhlelo lokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu kule ndawo. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu lapha kusho ukuthi izingane zethu zizokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wesikole endaweni ephephile nephucukile, okuzothuthukisa nezinga lokusebenza kwazo. Impela, manje singasho ngokuzethemba ukuthi impilo engcono ifikile lapha eZinqoleni. Thina, njengomnyango wezindlu, sikholwa ukuthi ukwakhiwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kufanele kusebenzele wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya noma emadolobheni. Sikholwa ukuthi abantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya, kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni nezinsiza, ezifana nezindlela, amanzi, nogesi. Indlu inika umuntu ubuqotho, iyindawo abizwa ngayo ngekhaya, indawo yokuphepha, futhi imnika ubunikazi. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, oNgqongqoshe, kanye noBuholi Bendabuko, ikhaya yindawo esivela kuyo, lapho sisebenza khona, futhi lapho sibuyela khona ntambama. Izindlela ezivela ezindlini zixhumanisa nathi ezindaweni eziningi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zokuthenga, lapho sisebenza khona, emithini, nakwezinye izinsiza esizidingayo. Ngibone ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinkinga zokulungiswa kwezindlela, ikakhulukazi eziholela ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko. Ohlelweni lomnyango wethu lokwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko, ngishilo ukuthi kumele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi komkhandlu nezindlu zabaholi bethu bendabuko. Abaholi bendabuko babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlelekile kubantu babo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uma lezi zindlu seziqediwe, akukho okuzosivimbela ekuletheni ukuthuthukiswa ngoba wonke umuntu uzoba yingxenye yezakhiwo zikahulumeni zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa kubantu. Njengoba ngichazile ngenkathi ngethula inkulumo yami, izikhumbuzo zethu zigcizelela ikhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nezwe. Ngichazile ukuthi indlu iyisisekelo sokwakha
Gwema ukusondela eduze kwabantu abangase babe noshukela. Nciphisa isikhathi osichitha ezindaweni ezigcwele abantu. Zilungiselele izindlela zokuphila ezinhle ezihlanganisa ukuthola ukulala okwanele, ukudla ukudla okunempilo, nokugcina umzimba wakho uhlelekile. Awukwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kokubanda okujwayelekile ne-Influenza A (H1N1) ngaphandle kosizo lukadokotela. Izimpawu ongazibona zifana nezokubanda okujwayelekile, kufaka phakathi umkhuhlane, ukukhwehlela, isikhala, ubuhlungu bomzimba, ubuhlungu besitho, kanye nokukhathala enhliziyweni. Kuphela udokotela wakho (noma um nurse) kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala esibhedlela sakho ezizokwazi ukukusiza uqinisekise ukuthi unayo i-Influenza A (H1N1). Hlala ekhaya, ungayi emsebenzini, esikoleni, noma uqoqe nabantu abaningi. Faka isikhumba nomlomo wakho uma ukhwehlela noma uthululela, futhi uma usebenzisa ama-tissue ukuze usule umunwe, qiniseka ukuthi uwafaka endaweni efanele. Cha, akufanele uyeke ngaphandle uma umuntu okhipha imithi yakho ekutshela njalo. Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngeminye imikhuhlane ye-flu lubonisa ukuthi ukuncelisa kuvikele izingane ngokudlulisela ama-antibodies omama avikela ingane ezimweni zokugula futhi kunciphisa inani lezifo ezingadluliselwa ezinganeni. Ukuncelisa kuhlinzeka izingane ngempilo ephelele futhi kukhuphula ikhono lazo lokulwa nezifo. Umuntu kufanele afune usizo lwezempilo uma engaphefumuli kahle noma uphuphuma kakhulu, noma uma enomkhuhlane ophakeme okhula ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezintathu. Abazali abanabantwana abancane abagulayo kufanele bafune usizo uma ingane iphefumula ngokushesha noma kakhulu, inomkhuhlane oqhubekayo, noma inezinkinga zokulawulwa. Lezi zixwayiso zingavikela ozakwethu emsebenzini nakwabanye. Uma ungazizwa kahle noma unezimpawu ze-flu (influenza), akufanele uvakashele. Uma unokungabaza ngempilo yakho, kufanele uhlole isimo sakho sezempilo ngumnikazi wezempilo. Geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi, bese uzomile kahle. Sebenzisa i-hand sanitizer enokhilimu uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini nasensipho.
Sithatha isinyathelo endleleni eya esikhathini esizayo. Yebo, uhulumeni kanye nasemkhakheni wokuzimela. 1. Sigxila empilweni yethu futhi siphila ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, umgomo wethu ukuveza izimanga kubalingani bethu. 2. Sifaka isandla ekunakekeleni nasekuvikeleni imvelo nendawo esikuyo, okungavela ekubhekeni phambili ngokuqonda. 3. Sihlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli nabapheki ngokuphelele. Siphikisa ukuphila kahle ngoba sigcizelela ukuthi amathuluzi okusebenza awaphelele. Ukufisa ngaphakathi kwethu ukuhamba phambili. 4. Sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza zempilo ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokuchitha noma ukungabaza ukuze siphumelele ngaphezu kokulinganiswa, njengamaphiko asenza sibhakabhake njengenkanyezi. Ukufisa kwethu ukuthuthukisa. 5. Siqinisekisa ukuthi siyazi ngezinhlelo zempilo eziseduze nempilo, ngolwazi, nangokufundisa umphakathi esikuyo, futhi ukuthi banakekela thina ngendlela ephelele, lokhu kuhambisana. 6. Sinikeza abasebenzi bezempilo ulwazi olufanele kanye nokwesekwa komzimba, kokomoya, nakokwengqondo. Sizibophezele ekusizeni ocwaningweni, ekwelapheni, nasekuthuthukiseni umuntu ngamunye ngendlela eqotho, ekuhloleni, ekwelapheni, ekubuyiseleni, nasezingeni eliphezulu lokwazi. 7. Sazisa abapheki bezempilo ngenkani yethu yokwenza okudingekayo kumuntu ngamunye, sigxila esimweni sabo nasekufeni komuntu ngamunye, ubulili babo, ubudala, kanye nokukholwa kwabo. Ukukholwa okujwayelekile ukuthi. 8. Sihambisana nemithetho yokwelapha nangesikhathi esithi "wenza kwabanye njengoba ungathanda ukuthi benze kuwe" okuhlobene nokubuyiselwa. Sizoletha induduzo kulabo. 9. Sibuza ukuthi izindlela zokwelapha noma zokubuyiselwa zibhujiswe noma zaphukile. Zimi kanjani? Sihlela indlela yokukhokha. Usizo lwezinga eliphezulu. Uhlanga noma inhlanganisela. Lokhu kunikezwa umuntu onezimpawu zecholera: Faka amathisipuni ayisishiyagalombili kwegilasi yamanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nethisipuni elilodwa lesawoti. Hlanganisa bese unika lowo muntu ophukile futhi onenhliziyo efana nalena, njengoba lokhu kubuyisela amanzi emzimbeni. Ukuvuselela amanzi emzimbeni kubalulekile; zonke izinkomba zecholera zidinga ukuthi umuntu abuyiselwe amanzi ngokushesha. Ungawashisi izingubo ezingcolile noma uvumele abantu badlale, bahambe emanzini omphakathi afana nemifula. Uma befile, kufanele babekwe ebhokisini elivaliwe uma bephuma endaweni eyodwa baye kwenye. Gcoba emanzini ashisayo anoshokoledi bese uyomisa elangeni. Izimpawu zivele phakathi kwamahora ambalwa kuya ezinsukwini ezinhlanu kamuva. Ukulimala kwemithambo, kulandela ukulahleka kwegazi okuholela ekufeni. Abantu abangenamanzi ahlanzekile afana nalawo avela ethapheni. Abantu abasebenzisa amanzi avela emifuleni, emifuleni, noma emapulazini. Uma uthatha amanzi emfuleni, kufanele uwahlanze kuqala ngaphambi kokuwasebenzisa. Hlanza imifino ngamanzi ahlanzekile noma aphekiwe. Hlanza izandla ngaphambi nangemva kokudla. Hlanza izitsha ngamanzi ahlanzekile noma aphekiwe. Hlanza izandla njalo uma ubuya esikhathini. Gcina ukudla endaweni ehlelekile. Ukudla kufanele kuphakelwe ngamanzi ahlanzekile futhi kudliwe ngesikhathi esishisayo. Gwema umkhuba wokudla esitsheni esisodwa ngasikhathi sinye. Ukudla okuphekiwe akufanele kuhlangane nokudla okungaphekiwe ukuze kugwenywe ukungcoliswa. Ukuphathwa kwemfucumfucu kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela engakwenzi amanzi angcoliswe njengemifula. Gwema ukuheha izinyoni. Gwema noma yisiphi ukudla okungcolile, ikakhulukazi inhlanzi engaphekiwe noma engaphekiwe. Imifino kufanele ihlanzwe. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukudla ukudla okungaphekiwe. Enye indlela yokwenza amanzi ahlanzekile ukufaka ithisipuni eliphelele le-chlorine kumalitha angama-20-25 wamanzi. Linda okungenani amahora amabili ngaphambi kokuphuza amanzi. Xwayisa abapheki bokudla ukuthi: - Akufanele baphathe ukudla uma begula. Kufanele bahlanze imifino nezithelo ngamanzi ahlanzekile ngaphambi kokuzisebenzisa. Gcina ukudla endaweni ehlelekile. Pheka ukudla ngokwanele ngamanzi ahlanzekile futhi kudliwe ngesikhathi esishisayo. Gwema ukungcoliswa kokuhlanganisa ukudla okuphekiwe nokudla okungaphekiwe. Hlanza izandla ngeshokoledi namanzi ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese/naphambi nangemva kokulungisa ukudla. Gwema umkhuba wabantu abadla esitsheni esisodwa. Khumbula ukufudumeza ukudla kusukela izolo ngaphambi kokudla. Khuthaza abantu ukuba basebenzise izipuni uma bedla. Indlela ephephile yokulungisa ukudla.
Ukuhlola okuqhubekayo (CASS) kumele kube yingxenye yokufundisa nokufunda futhi kumele kusetshenziswe ezindaweni zokufunda. Umfundi ngeke anikezwe umphumela uma uphawu lwakhe lwe-CASS lungekho. Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi ifomu lokumemezela (Appendix A) kumele liqedwe futhi lisayinwe yibo bobabili umfundi nomphathi wesikhungo. Umphathi wesikhungo kumele aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abafundi banephuzu le-CASS eduze kwamagama abo kumashidi ophawu, noma incwadi echaza uma kungekho uphawu olubhaliwe, ngaphambi kokuhambisa amaphothifoliyo ku-ABET District Support. Abaphathi be-ABET Centre bazohlangana njalo ngenyanga ukuze basebenzisane futhi babelane ngemininingwane mayelana nohlelo lokufunda nokuhlola. Umphathi wesikhungo kuzo zonke izikhungo kulindeleke ukuthi aqoqe umbiko wokuthi i-ICASS ihamba kanjani ezindaweni zokufunda zonke futhi athumele lo mbiko ku-ABET District Support njalo ngenyanga. Abasebenzi be-ABET District Support kumele baqoqe umbiko we-CASS besebenzisa imibiko efingqiwe evela kubaphathi bezikhungo kanye nemibiko yokwesekwa nokuqapha ezindaweni zokufunda njengesisekelo. Umbiko we-CASS ohlanganisiwe kumele uthunyelwe ngu-ABET District Support njengoba kukhombisa kuphrojekthi yokuphatha. Abafundi abangakawuqedi wonke amafaneleko mayelana ne-CASS kumele banikezwe uphawu. Ukuhanjiswa kwamaphuzu kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imibhalo ibhalwe kahle. Umphathi wesikhungo kanye ne-ABET District Support kumele baqinisekise ukuthi ukucubungula ezingeni lesikhungo kwenzeka okungenani kanye ngeviki ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izindinganiso zokucubungula zizwe nezifunda zigcinwa. Abaphathi bezikhungo kumele bathumele amakhophi wamashidi ophawu asebenzayo ukuze baveze inqubekela phambili eyenziwe ezindaweni zokufunda ezibanjwa ezikhungweni zabo ku-ABET District Support ngomhla kaJulayi 25, 2003. Uhlu lwamagama akhethiwe luzothunyelwa ezikhungweni ngomhla kaAgasti 14, 2003. Amashidi ophawu anophawu olushintshiwe azobuyiselwa ezikhungweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe. Izikhungo zingafaka izikhalazo uma zinganelisekile ngamaphuzu atholakele uma sekuqedile ngokugcwalisa ifomu lesikhalazo (Appendix D). Isikhalazo kumele sihunyushwe ku-ABET District Support phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-2 zokuthola amaphothifoliyo. Ukuhlola kuzohambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zesifunda. Umhloli omkhulu kanye nokwesekwa kwezindawo zokufunda kuzokwazisa abacwaningi ngezindinganiso zokuhlola ezivumelanisiwe emhlanganweni wokuhlola. Uma kukhona ukungafani kokuhumusha phakathi kwalesi sihumusho esihunyushwe kanye nesiginali, isiginali izosihola.
