Ngokungivumela ukuba ngidale lezi zithombe, kube nokuhlonipha okukhulu kwelizwe elinikeze lokho. U-Mametja usebenza njengoMklami wezimboni e-CSIR ePitoli. Uhlala eKempton Park nomkakhe nezingane ezimbili. U-Gareth Smart usebenze kahle njengomklami ezintweni eziningi kusukela eqeda i-BA yakhe yokuklama e-Midrand Graduate Institute of Higher Education. Izifundo azigxile kuzo zikhombisa ubude, ububanzi, nob depth bezithombe. Iphothifoliyo yakhe ikhombisa uhlu olunembile lwezinkampani azisebenzelayo ngesikhathi esifushane. Kaye, 'kwakuyithuba eliyingqayizivele' lokukhethwa ukuba aklame uphawu olusha lwezwe. Uhlala ePitoli lapho ebhekana nezidingo zamakhasimende njengomklami, umenzi wemodeli, nokukhombisa umqondo ophathelene nokuthile okuzimele. Uqinisekisa ukuthi noma ubani unelungelo lokusebenzisa ulimi lwabo nokubandakanyeka empilweni yamasiko abakhethayo (I-Clause 30). Izikhungo zomphakathi zinesibopho ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi ukuqapha le misebenzi yolimi nezinketho zabantu abakhonzayo lapho bexhumana nabantu, kuhlanganise nezidingo ezikhethekile zalabo abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Uhlelo lweNqubomgomo Yolimi Yezwe luhlinzeka ukuthi lapho isikhungo somphakathi sikhetha izilimi ezizosebenza ezikhethwe yimiphakathi, ngokuxhumana nabo, kumele sithuthukise, sishicilele, futhi silandele inqubomgomo ephethe ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi. Iphromotha ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi zombili ezisemthethweni ezikhuluma ngabaningi eThekwini, okuyi-isiZulu nesiNgisi. Iphucula ukufinyelela kulwazi nezinsizakalo ezihlinzekwa uhulumeni. Ikhuthaza futhi isekela izakhamuzi ukuthi zifunde izilimi ezisemthethweni ngaphezu kolimi lwazo lokuzalwa, okuzosiza ekwakheni nasekugcineni ubunye njengombuso nasekuqinisekiseni ubuhlakani obuhlukahlukene benhlangano. Iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi ngokugxila ekuphathweni okufanele kwezilimi. Isebenzisa futhi ilandele izinhlinzeko zeSigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo kanye nezimiso ze-Batho Pele nezinye izimo ezifanayo zokusebenza. Ukukhethwa kwalabo abazosebenza esikhungweni somphakathi. Ukususwa kwezithiyo zokusebenzisa ulimi ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukisa ukufinyelela okufanele kuzinhlelo nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa isikhungo somphakathi. Iqinisekisa ukuthi akukho muntu ophoqelelwa noma ovinjelwe ekusebenziseni ulimi abalukhethayo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ingabe yinye yezilimi ezizosebenza noma cha. Ikhipha isikhundla esifanayo phakathi kwe-isiZulu nesiNgisi. Izinqubomgomo zalesi sihloko zizosebenza kuzo zonke izakhiwo zomphakathi. Noma yiliphi ulimi phakathi kwalezi ezimbili olungasetshenziswa esikhungweni somphakathi lungasetshenziswa kunoma yisiphi isithangami noma umhlangano weBhodi noma amaKomidi. Emihlanganweni yeBhodi kanye namaKomidi, kumele kube nabahumushi bezilimi ezilodwa kulezi ezimbili ezingasetshenziswa. Uma noma yiliphi ilungu lithanda ukuthi okukhuluma kwenziwe kuhumushelwe kwenye ulimi engelona olunye lwezilimi ezizosebenza, leli lungu kumele libike uMongameli weBhodi noma leli Komidi kusenesikhathi ukuze kudingeke ukuhumusha. Ulimi lokukhuluma kumele lutholakale uma kudingeka. Noma yimiphi imihlangano yomphakathi noma imicimbi yomphakathi kumele yenziwe ngolimi olungasetshenziswa ngokwezinketho zababekhona. Uma kukhona abavakashi abangakwazi ukuqonda ulimi olukhethiwe, kumele kuhumushelwe. Zonke izimiso, imithetho, nezinqumo zeBhodi kanye namaKomidi kumele zibhale ngazo zombili izilimi zomphakathi ezizosebenza. Zonke izaziso ezisemthethweni nezikhangiso ezikhishwe ukuze zikwazise umphakathi kumele zishicilelwe ngesiZulu nesiNgisi. I-isiZulu noma isiNgisi kungenziwa ukusho okwenziwayo kwangaphakathi. Uma umuntu obhalelwa engakwazi ukuqonda ulimi olusetshenziswayo, bangacela ukuthi babhalelwe ngolimi abaluqondayo. Imizuzu kumele ikhishwe ngazo zombili izilimi ezisetshenziswayo. Ukukhulumisana kwangaphakathi kungenziwa ngesiNgisi noma ngesiZulu kuye ngababonayo. Ukuxhumana nabantu bangaphandle kumele kube ngolunye lwezilimi ezizosebenza, kucatshangelwa ukuthi yiluphi ulimi umamukeli akhetha. Uma incwadi iphendulwa ngaphandle, impendulo kumele ibe ngolimi lapho leyo ncwadi ibhalwe khona. Ukuphuma kwencwadi kumele kubonise ukuthi uma umamukeli efuna ukubhalelwa ngolunye ulimi phakathi kwezilimi ezisetshenziswayo, lokho kuzokwenziwa uma bekucela. Izakhamuzi zinegunya lokusebenzisa ulimi abalukhethayo. Izimpawu ezikhombisa izikhungo noma amahhovisi omphakathi kumele zibe ngazo zombili izilimi ezizosebenza. Bonke abathengi kumele basizwe ngolimi abalukhethayo, ngosizo lomhumushi, uma kudingeka. Isikhungo somphakathi kumele siqinisekise ukuthi abamele izigcawu nezisebenzi bayakuqonda ukubaluleka kwezilimi ezahlukene futhi bakhuthazwe ukuba bamukele ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezikhethwe ngababekhona/abathengi, abanye abamele izigcawu, nezisebenzi. Ukuhumusha nokuhumusha esikhungweni somphakathi kufanele kwenziwe ngabantu abanekhono abaqeqeshiwe kulolu work abaqashwe ngemuva kwemnyango wolimi wesikhungo somphakathi. Isikhungo somphakathi kumele sikhuthaze futhi sisekele ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono olimi phakathi kwezisebenzi nabamele izigcawu. Izisebenzi nabamele izigcawu kufanele bakhuthazwe ukufunda ezinye izilimi ezingezona ezabo njengoba lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthokoziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene, ukuhlonishwa kwezamasiko ahlukahlukene, nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo. Lapho iminyango yomphakathi iqasha izisebenzi ezintsha, kumele bagcine le nqubomgomo yolimi engqondweni. Ngaphandle kokuthi kuchazwe kule nqubomgomo noma isinqumo seBhodi, le nqubomgomo izothatha umphumela kusukela ngosuku lokuthi kabulwe yiBhodi. Kumele kuqondwe ukuthi phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha zokuthi le nqubomgomo kabulwe, uMphakathi weDolobha kumele ubeke izinsuku zokusebenza zokuphumelelisa izimo zalesi sihloko.
Njengoba siphakathi kwephondo leKwaZulu-Natal, sijabule ukubona intuthuko esiyenzile emizamweni yokubuyisela isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko kanye nokubamba kwabo iqhaza kuzo zonke izici zokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lezakhamuzi. Umphathi wohlelo, ovela emphakathini waseMalangeni, ubonisa ukuthi ukuba lapha kusinika injabulo enkulu ngoba indawo yaseMalangeni inenhlonipho enkulu emlandweni. Le ndawo iyindawo yokuzalwa kweNkosi uShaka kaSenzangakhona. Sazi futhi ukuthi amaqhawe amaningi avela eMalangeni. Futhi le ndawo yindawo lapho imindeni eminingi ibhujiswa emhlabeni wabo ocebile. Nakuba kunezihloko ezingezinhle emlandweni wale ndawo, ilanga liqhubeka likhanya eMalangeni. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa kwenkosi yethu lapha kwenzeka ngaphansi komlando omkhulu futhi ngesikhathi esibalulekile lapho ubuholi bendabuko bushintsha, buhamba phambili kunangaphambili. Lezi zinguquko zifaka phakathi ukubuyiselwa kobuholi bendabuko kanye nokuphatha kwabo ezimpandeni zabo, ngokwezifiso zendabuko. Siphakathi lapha namuhla siqonda kahle ukuthi nakuba ukujabuliswa kwenkosi yethu kuyisigameko esibalulekile esihlobene nenjabulo nokuqhakambisa isiko, kuhlanganisa nomthetho, ukuphatha ngendlela efanele, kanye nokubaluleka kokugcina isiko. Isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sikhishwe kakhulu yimithetho ehlukene kahulumeni eyayikhona ngaphambili. Kodwa manje lesi simo sishintsha. Uhulumeni wesifunda omusha uhlose ukuhlinzeka abaholi bendabuko ngamathuba okwakha uhlelo lokukhulula umthelela wemigomo yokucindezela nokwahlukanisa esakhiweni sobuholi bendabuko. Sisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze sifinyelele lapho sikhona namuhla. Okwamanje, siphakathi kwenqubo yokwakha umthetho ozophonswa ezingeni lesifunda mayelana nabaholi bendabuko nokuphatha, futhi uzobhekana nezinkinga ezithinta thina ngqo njengephondo. Nokho, lokhu ngeke kube ukuphambuka kuMthethosisekelo weSizwe. Ezimweni ezifana nalezi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume kahle. Ngivumele ukusebenzisa leli thuba ukuqala ngokugqamisa amaphuzu abalulekile esiko mayelana nesigameko sokugcotshwa kwenkosi. Nakuba kuzobe kusekhona umthetho esifundazweni ozohlinzeka ngemininingwane ngalokhu. Kodwa ngokufingqa, ngingasho lapha ukuthi umndeni wesigodlo usuphumelele indima yawo ngokukhetha uNkosi uNgcobo njengenkosi yesizwe saseMalangeni. Okuzolandela ukuthi indlela yendabuko izophelelwa nguIsilo SamaBandla, lapho kuzobe kukhona nendlela yethu endala yokuthola amanzi. Le mikhuba ibalulekile kakhulu ngoba inkosi iyona ethulisa amakhosi, futhi amakhosi aphinde asebenze nenkosi. Le mikhuba sifisa ukuthi ihlonishwe, futhi sikhuthaza wonke amakhosi ukuba agcotshwe ukuthi alandele le mikhuba. Angazi ukuthi bangaki bethu abazi noma basakhumbula lezi zifiso, njengoba ingxenye enkulu yesiko lethu lendabuko ilahlekile eminyakeni edlule yohulumeni. Ngiyakwazi ukusho ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile ekubuyiseni isithunzi samakhosi. Ngibhalile izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye esizithathile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi isakhiwo sethu sobuholi bendabuko sithola indawo yaso efanele. Le mizamoyo ifaka phakathi ukuthi ekugcineni indima yamakhosi ekuletheni intuthuko ihlonishwe. Siyazi ukuthi uNkosi uNgcobo kanye nekhansela lakhe, kanye namanye amakhosi, njengengxenye yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko, sevele baqale imizamo yokuthuthukisa, ngakho manje iOndabezitha iyamenywa ukuphatha ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ukuhlela nokubambisana nezakhiwo zezakhamuzi ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwentuthuko ezindaweni zokuhlala zamakhosi. Uhulumeni ukholelwa ukuthi intuthuko nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kungasheshiswa ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yamakhosi kanye nezikhulu ezikhethwe. Imizamo kaNkosi uNgcobo ekuletheni intuthuko kule ndawo, ngiyakholelwa nonke niyazi. Akukho shwa ngokuqinisekile ngokuqhubeka kukaNkosi ekuthuthukiseni. I-IDP, sibona izoba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu ngokusheshisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Bonke sibona ukuthi nakuba inkosi izama, isikhundla senkosi, njengabanye abaningi, sishiywe ngemuva uma kuziwa ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsiza zentuthuko. Lesi simo asivumelekile. Njengohulumeni, sikholwa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uthuthuke ngokulinganayo; akufanele kube nezilwandle zempumelelo phakathi kobumpofu nokuhlupheka. Futhi akufanele kube nabantu abaphila kahle kakhulu kanti abanye bahlupheka kakhulu. Lesi simo umasipala kufanele sihlole futhi silungise ngokubambisana namakhosi kanye nekhansela labo. Ngibhalile indima yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko ekuletheni intuthuko; kufanele sihlole futhi indima yabo emlandweni eyasilethela lapho sikhona namuhla. Umlando usitshela ukuthi ekuvikeleni abantu babo, amasiko, nezwe labo, amakhosi amaningi, kuhlanganise nalawo avela kulezi zintaba nezilwandle, athatha izikhali ukuze alwe nokucindezelwa nokwahlukaniswa. Ezimweni ezifana nalezi, asikwazi ukukhohlwa ubuhlakani bukaBhambatha kaMancinza, owahlulwa yizikhali zesimanje zabahlaseli, waphonsa isisekelo senkululeko nodemokhrasi esijabulela namuhla. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa okusemthethweni kukaNkosi uNgcobo namuhla kuqinisa ukuqhubeka kwesikhumbuzo sobuhlakani obuhlale buyingxenye yamakhosi amaningi kulesi sifunda kanye nokuzinikela kwabo ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu. Umphathi Wohlelo, uhulumeni wethu ubaluleka kakhulu kumakhosi, hhayi ngoba bangabaphethe bezamasiko nezindlela zendabuko, kodwa futhi ngoba bamele ingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kwethu kokhetho olusemthethweni olususelwa kumthethosisekelo. Kuye kwaba njalo kubalulekile kuhulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko ziqiniswa. Uhulumeni weKwaZulu-Natal ukholelwa ukuthi kudingeka ukuvikelwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuthuthukiswa kokuba khona kwabaphathi bendabuko kanye nezikhulumi ezikhethwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu bethu. Iqiniso ukuthi njengelizwe kanye nephondo, sithwele izinguquko ezinkulu kwezomnotho nasemphakathini. Siphila eNingizimu Afrika lapho idemokhrasi nentuthuko seziqhubeka phambili. Noma ungumholi bendabuko, umphakathi, noma ilungu lePhalamende, unendima ebalulekile futhi edingekayo ekufezeni umgomo wethu wokuphula bezokuphepha, ukungabi namsebenzi, nendlala. Ukugcotshwa kwamaOndabezitha uMapholoba namuhla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uhulumeni egxile kakhulu ekubuyiseleni ithemba kubantu bethu ezikhungweni zezakhamuzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusungulwa kweziteshi zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zezakhamuzi nezakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko. Akukho shwa ukuthi ukusungulwa ngempumelelo kweziteshi zokubambisana phakathi kwezinga lempilo yomphakathi kuzoholela ekuhlinzekweni kwezidingo ezibalulekile futhi kuzosheshisa ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi yokuphila kwabantu basemakhaya. Lokhu kusikhuthaza ukuba sibe sobala kwiSigaba 211 no-212 soMtheth
UMphathiswa weZobulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo usungule lezi ziqondiso ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ngemuva kokuxoxisana noMphathiswa wezeMali, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 30 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukulingana Nokuvikela Ukwehlukaniswa Okungafanele ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 4 ka-2000). Isicelo sokubekwa njengomlobi obhekiswe esigabeni 17 soMthetho kumele sibe sobala ngesimo esifanayo neFomu 1 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo futhi sithunyelwe kuMphathi-Jikelele. Ubufakazi bezincwadi zomsebenzi ezivela kubaphathi besicelo, uma zikhona; kanye namagama, amakheli, nezinombolo zocingo zabantu ababili abangaxhumana nabo mayelana nesimo somfaki-sicelo. Ukubekwa kwababhali kuhlobene nokuphothulwa kweziqu ezithile ezivunyelwe nguMphathi-Jikelele. UMphathi-Jikelele angabeka umuntu njengomlobi isikhathi esivunyelwene ngazo zombili uMphathi-Jikelele nomfaki-sicelo, futhi umfaki-sicelo uzoba nelungelo lokuthola inani eliphelele lemali efanelekile neyezokuphatha eyamukelwe ngababhali ezinhlelweni zeMnyango. Izimo zokubekwa komuntu njengomlobi njengoba kuqondiswe esigabeni 1 ngenhla zifana nezimo zomsebenzi ezisebenzayo kumuntu obekwe njengomlobi wenkantolo ngaphansi koMthetho Wezabasebenzi BezeMphakathi ka-1994, Isikhumbuzo No. 103 ka-1994. Xwayisa abafakizolo ukuthi banelungelo lokuthola imali yokufakaza futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umfakizolo uyasizwa ngalokhu, uma kudingeka; futhi baphathe izibopho zomlobi wenkantolo ezimweni zomphakathi uma kudingeka ukuze kufezwe lokho okukhulunywa ngumthetho. Umuntu, inhlangano, noma ikomidi elikhuluma ngalesi sigaba 20 soMthetho, ofuna ukulethela udaba phambi kwenkantolo noma ukufaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi, angakwenza lokhu ngokwazisa umlobi wenkantolo ngenhloso yabo yokwenza lokho besebenzisa ifomu elifanayo neFomu 2 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Wazise umphikisi usebenzisa ifomu elifanayo neFomu 3 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo, ukuthi baphikiswa; futhi ucele umphikisi ukuthi ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ebhaliwe ebhekiswe esigabeni 3 seFomu 3 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo phakathi nezinsuku eziyishumi kusukela ngosuku athola ngalo lesi saziso. Umlobi kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokuthola impendulo evela kumphikisi obhekiswe esigabeni 2(b) ngenhla, athumele ikhophi noma ikhophi yale mpendulo kumfaki-sicelo noma kumuntu olethe udaba. Umlobi kumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esibhekiswe esigabeni 2(b) ngenhla, athumele udaba kumphathi ophakeme, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe ngemuva kokuthola wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nodaba, akhiphe isinqumo sokuthi udaba luzolalelwa yinkantolo noma ludluliselwe kwenye inkantolo. Uma umphathi ophakeme ethatha isinqumo sokuthi udaba kufanele lulalelwe enkantolo, kumele adlulisele udaba kumlobi, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuthola udaba, abeke usuku lokulalelwa kwalo. Umlobi kumele, ngemuva kokubeka usuku lokulalelwa kwalo, wazise umfaki-sicelo nomphikisi ngaleso sikhathi sokulalelwa besebenzisa ifomu elifanayo neFomu 4 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Kumele bathumele ikhophi yesinqumo senkantolo kubo bonke ababambiqhaza nodaba; futhi bazise/benze bonke ababambiqhaza nodaba ngezincwadi ezithunyelwe kule nkantolo ebhekiswe esigabeni a. Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ezokhuluma ngodaba ithole amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni 8(a), le nkantolo kumele ikhiphe isaziso esibhaliwe esazisa bonke ababambiqhaza nodaba kanye nomlobi wenkantolo ngokuthola kwabo udaba. I-inkantolo lapho udaba ludluliselwa khona kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni 8, ithumele umbiko kumlobi wenkantolo, ibika ngentuthuko eyenziwe kulolo daba. Uma le nkantolo ibuyisela udaba emuva enkantolo, le mbuyiselo kumele ibe sobala ngesimo esifanayo neFomu 5 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo, ichaza izizathu zokuthi kungani udaba buyehliswa. I-inkantolo kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe kusukela ngosuku udaba luphindiselwe emuva enkantolo, iqondise indlela udaba luzoxoxwa ngayo. Umlobi kumele ngokushesha azise labo abathintekayo nodaba ngosuku lokulalelwa kwemigomo ngaphansi kwalezi ziqondiso ezibhekiswe esigabeni 6. Kuthunyelwa kumphikisi noma kufakwe enkantolo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela engaphathwa umphathi ophakeme. Isaziso esibhekiswe esigabeni 66 kumele sinikezwe kumuntu osebenza enkantolo noma kumlobi kubo bonke ababambiqhaza nodaba ngokuqondile. Umuntu ofuna ukuthumela isaziso kumfakizolo sokuthi avele phambi kwenkantolo kumele akwenze okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalelwa kwalo, ecela umlobi wenkantolo ukuba alungise futhi akhiphe leso saziso kumfakizolo ngokushesha. Isaziso kumfakizolo esikhiphwayo kumele sibe sesimo esifanayo neFomu 6 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Izindleko zokusebenza komuntu osebenza enkantolo; noma noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ongabekwa umphathi ophakeme. Umuntu othumela isaziso kumfakizolo kumele aqedele ingxenye B yesigaba sesibili seFomu 6 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Ukubakhona komfakizolo phambi kwenkantolo ngokuyalelwa kwenkantolo kwenziwa ngokuthumela leso saziso kumfakizolo, esikhiphwe ngumlobi, okumele sibe sesimo esifanayo neFomu 6 ehlotshaniswa neSithasiselo. Isaziso kumfakizolo esibhekiswe esigabeni a kumele sithunyelwe kumfakizolo ngumuntu osebenza enkantolo ngezimali zikamasipala. Umuntu obizwayo ukuba avele phambi kwenkantolo njengomfakizolo angacelwa ukuba akhiphe amadokhumenti athile noma amaphepha noma isitatimende noma noma yini enye ehlobene nalolo daba. Wonke umfakizolo, ngaphandle komsebenzi wombuso ophelele, obizwayo ukuba avele phambi kwenkantolo unelungelo lokukhokhelwa imali ebekwe esigabeni c ngezansi ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywa esigabeni b. Umphathi ophakeme angathatha isinqumo sokuthi umfakizolo kungenzeka angakhokhelwa noma angakhokhelwa inani elithile lemali. R100 ngosuku noma ingxenye yosuku lapho umfakizolo efanele ukuba enkantolo; nezindleko abangazichaza kahle zokufika enkantolo nezindleko zokuthenga ukudla ezitholwe ngumfakizolo ngenxa yokufika enkantolo. Umbuso ukhokhela uma umfakizolo ebizwayo enkantolo ngokuyalelwa kwenkantolo noma ebizwayo yinkantolo; noma umuntu ocela ukuthi umfakizolo abizwe noma akhokhelwe ngokuyalelwa komphathi ophakeme. Lesi sinqumo sizoth
Qaphela: 1. Ama-affidavit enziwe ngabanye abantu noma eminye imibhalo yokweseka leli cala kumele ahlanganiswe nale fomu. Uyanqotshwa ukuthi inkantolo ye-equity ingadlulisa le ndaba kwenye inkantolo noma ithimba. Uma le ndaba ibuyiselwa enkantolo ye-equity, umphakathi wezinkantolo uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngalokho. Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singanele, thumela imininingwane bese uyihlanganisa nale fomu, ubhalela zonke amakhasi. Esiqeshini C: IMINININGWANE YOMFAKAZI/ABABHUNGA imininingwane elandelayo kumele ihlinzekwe kumfakazi ngamunye. Uhlobo lokukhala: ucela ukuba uhlinzeke ngemininingwane ephelele, usuku lapho kwenzeka khona lesi senzo, kanye nemininingwane yabantu bonke abangaba abafakazi. Imibhalo: Ingabe bekukhona imibhalo noma amaphepha angase asekele ukukhala kwakho, ngokwesibonelo, incwadi yesipho, ithikithi lezimpahla, ukuxhumana okuhlobene, noma ukuqoshwa kwezinkulumo? Ukubuyiselwa okufuna: Sitshele ukuthi ufunani ngosizo. Inkantolo ingakhishwa umyalo wesikhashana, noma inqume ukuthi kuhlawulwe imali, noma inqume ukuthi umbhunguka kufanele axolise ngaphandle kwemigomo noma noma iyiphi enye isinqumo. Imibuzo noma usizo olukhona mayelana nalabo abakhuluma ngenhla. Ingabe ungakwazi futhi ukuqonda okuqukethwe kwalokhu kubhalwe phansi? Ingabe uyaphikisa ukuthatha isifungo/ukuphikisa njengoba kuchaziwe? Ingabe uthatha lesi sisho esifungwayo njengokubophezela enhliziyweni yakho? Ngiyavuma ukuthi umuntu othatha isifungo uvumile ukuthi bangakwazi futhi baqonde okuqukethwe kwalokhu kubhalwe phansi. Umuntu othatha isifungo uthi lezi zisho ezilandelayo: "Ngiyafunga ukuthi okuqukethwe kwalokhu kubhalwe phansi kuyikho, uNkulunkulu angisize"/ "Ngiyavuma ukuthi okuqukethwe kwalokhu kubhalwe phansi kuyikho." Umuntu othatha isifungo usayine/wenza uphawu phambi kwami ngenkathi ngikhona. Igama eliphelele nesibongo...
Mphathi ohloniphekile weDolobha laseGu, uMphakathi S. Mphathi, umnyango wami ugcizelela ukubaluleka kwasekhaya kanye nokulethwa kokuthuthukiswa ezweni. Yingakho noma kuphi lapho sihamba khona, sikhumbuza ukuthi "umuntu ungumuntu ngenxa yasekhaya." Ikhaya lingachazwa njengesisekelo somuntu wonke. Ikhaya yindawo lapho izingane zikhuliswe khona ngokuphepha, zithola zonke izidingo ezizovumela ukuba zakhe isizwe sesikhathi esizayo. Kukhona ubudlelwano obubalulekile phakathi kwasekhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, nesizwe esinempilo elandelayo. Ngamanye amazwi, uma singakhethi izindlu, asizukuba nesizwe. Kukhona okuningi okwakha ikhaya, kodwa iphuzu lokuqala lokwakha ikhaya "yindlu." Isithunzi somuntu kanye nazo zonke izinto abazidingayo ukuze baphumelele ziqhutshelwa phansi uma bengekho phansi komoya. UManzankosi ubheke izinga lokushoda kwezindlu emindenini ukuze kuncishiswe ngokushesha ukushoda kwezindlu kule ndawo. Ngemva kokubuyekeza imiphumela, kwaba sobala ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi okufanele wenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bethu babe nezindawo abangazibiza ngokuthi ikhaya futhi baphile kahle. Thina, njengoHulumeni onakekela, sathatha isinqumo sokusebenza kanzima ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola izindlu, okuyilungelo labo lokwenyama. Ngamanye amazwi, lo hulumeni uzinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi wonke umuntu unendawo enokuthula yokuhlala, kungakhathaliseki ngesimo sabo sezomnotho. Lolu lungelo lungokwakho wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni noma ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Umphakathi, ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi kule ndawo, sinezinkulungwane zabantu abahluphekayo. Kukhona inani elikhulu labantu abangasebenzi kule ndawo, futhi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abantu bethu akukavunywanga. Ukuphazamiseka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuhamba phambili kukahulumeni we-apartheid, owawungakhathaleli ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu lapha. Akumangalisi ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinga elingu-61% labantu abangasebenzi. Ngisho nalabo esithi bayasebenza bathola imiholo ephansi kakhulu. R800.00 ngenyanga. Lokhu kukhombisa ngokusobala ukuthi le ndawo idinga uhulumeni ukuthi asize ngezindlu nezinye izinsiza zokuthuthukiswa, ngoba kungenjalo, ngeke bakwazi ukuzisiza ngenxa yesimo sabo sezomnotho esiphansi. Njengoba ngishilo, konke kuqala ngasekhaya. Nakuba umcimbi wethu ungase ungahlangene ngqo nokwethulwa kwezinye izinsiza zomphakathi, kufanele ngithinte kulokho okudingekayo ukuze kwenziwe ikhaya lishise futhi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimpilo zabantu zihlala ziqinile. Enye yezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi kule ndawo yamanzi. Kukhona izimbangela eziningi zalesi simo, okuhlanganisa nezomiso ezivame ukuhlasela le ndawo. Kodwa kuze kube namuhla, uhulumeni wethu usebenza nekhansela laseGu ukwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu lapha banokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile. Isifiso sikaHulumeni wethu siwukuthi wonke umuntu abe nendawo ephephile yokuhlala. NjengoHulumeni, sisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze sakhe izindlu zabantu bethu ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuzigqaja ngokuba nezindlu ezisemqoka futhi babuyisele isithunzi sabo. Umsebenzi esiwethulayo namuhla uhilela nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kuhambisana kahle nezinhloso zikaHulumeni zokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Inani labantu abadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele liphakathi nendawo eliphezulu kule ndawo, lihlala ku-73% yemindeni lapha. Njengoba ngichazile, ikhaya kufanele libe shisa. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kubeka izimpilo zabantu engozini futhi kunciphisa isithunzi sabantu bethu. Ngalesi sizathu, sithathe izinyathelo ezibanzi ukusiza wonke amakhansela ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola ngokushesha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisa izindlu, amanzi, ugesi, nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka eziphephile. Njengoba siqhubeka nalesi sihlelo sokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu lapha, lesi sihlelo sizobhekana nezinye izidingo zomphakathi ezibalulekile. Siyajabula ukubona ukuthi ikhansela laseGu selivele lenze intuthuko ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela komphakathi ezinsizeni zokuhlanzeka ezifanele. R4.6 million ukusiza umphakathi wethu lapha eZinqoleni ukuze uthole izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanzekile. NjengoNgqongqoshe, kuyajabulisa ukubona isivinini sokuthi umsebenzi wenziwa sikhula ngoba abantu bethu bahlale belinde lezi zinto isikhathi eside. Umphakathi, enye inselelo esibhekene nayo ekushiseni izindlu yikuntuleka kukagesi. Ngizogxila kakhulu kulokhu ngoba umsebenzi usuqalile. Sineziindlu eziyi-1789 esidinga ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kulo nyaka njengengxenye yomkhankaso wethu wokuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani wonke umuntu unogesi ngonyaka ka-2012. Umphakathi, simi lapha namuhla ngenjabulo enkulu. Siyajabula ngoba imindeni eyayingenazo izindlu izothola izindlu ezakhiwe zona. Namuhla lezi zimindeni zizovuna izinzuzo zokuthula njengoba siqala uhlelo lokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu kule ndawo. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu lapha kusho ukuthi izingane zethu zizokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wesikole endaweni ephephile futhi engcono, okuzothuthukisa nezinga labo lokusebenza. Ngempela, manje singathi ngokuzethemba ukuthi impilo engcono ifikile lapha eZinqoleni. Thina, njengoMnyango wezokwakha, sikholwa ukuthi ukwakhiwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kufanele kuzuze wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Sikholwa ukuthi abantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni nezinsiza, ezifana nezindlela, amanzi, nogesi. Indlu inika umuntu isithunzi, iyindawo abizwa ngayo ekhaya, indawo yokuphepha, futhi inika umuntu ubunikazi. Umphakathi, Amakhandidethi, kanye Nabaholi Bendabuko, ikhaya yindawo esivela kuyo, lapho sisebenza khona, futhi lapho sibuya khona ntambama. Izindlela ezivela ezindlini zixhumanisa thina nezindawo eziningi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zokuthenga, lapho sisebenza khona, izikhungo zezempilo, nezinye izinsiza esizidingayo. Ngibone ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinkinga zokulungisa izindlela, ikakhulukazi lezo eziholela ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko. Ohlelweni lwemnyango wethu lokwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko, ngiveze ukuthi kufanele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi kwekhansela nezi zindlu zabaholi bethu bendabuko. Abaholi bendabuko babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlelekile kubantu babo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uma lezi zindlu seziqediwe, akukho okuzosivimba ekuletheni ukuthuthukiswa ngoba wonke umuntu uzoba yingxenye yezakhiwo zohulumeni zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa kubantu. Njengoba ngichazile ngesikhathi ngethula inkulumo yami, izikhumbuzo zethu zigcizelela ikhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, nesizwe. Ngichazile ukuthi indlu iyisisekelo sokwakha ikh
Gwema ukusondela eduze kwabantu abangase babe nesifo. Nciphisa isikhathi osichitha ezindaweni ezinamahlalakhona. Zilungiselele imikhuba emihle yokuphila ehlanganisa ukuthola ubuthongo obanele, ukudla ukudla okunempilo, nokugcina umzimba wakho uhlelekile. Awuzokwazi ukusho umehluko phakathi kokubanda okujwayelekile ne-Influenza A (H1N1) ngaphandle kosizo lwekhemisi. Izimpawu ongazibona zifana nezokubanda okujwayelekile, kuhlanganise nomkhuhlane, umphimbo ophukile, headache, ubuhlungu bomzimba, umphimbo ophukile, nokukhululeka emathunjini. Kuphela udokotela wakho (noma um nurse) kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala eklinikini yakho ezingakusiza uqinisekise ukuthi unayo i-Influenza A (H1N1). Hlala ekhaya, ungahambi emsebenzini, esikoleni, noma uhambisane nabantu abaningi. Faka isambulela emlonyeni nasemakhaleni uma ukhwehlela noma uhleka, futhi uma usebenzisa ama-tissues ukuhlanza umoya, qiniseka ukuthi uwaphosa endaweni efanele. Cha, akufanele uyeke ngaphandle uma umuntu okunikezayo imithi esho njalo. Ucwaningo olwenziwe ngeminye imikhuhlane lukhombisa ukuthi ukuphuza ubisi lwebele kuvikeleka izingane ngokudlulisa ama-antibodies omama avikela ingane ezifo futhi kunciphisa inani lezifo ezingadluliselwa ezinganeni. Ukuphuza ubisi lwebele kunikeza izingane ukudla okuphelele futhi kukhulisa ikhono lazo lokulwa nezifo. Umuntu kufanele afune usizo lwezempilo uma engasatholi umoya noma ephefumula kanzima, noma uma enomkhuhlane ophakeme odlula ezinsukwini ezintathu. Abazali abanezingane ezincane ezinesifo kufanele bafune usizo uma ingane iphefumula ngokushesha noma kanzima, inomkhuhlane oqhubekayo, noma inezinkinga zokulawula. Le mikhuba ingavikela ozakwethu emsebenzini nakwabanye. Uma ungazizwa kahle noma unezimpawu ze-flu (influenza), akufanele uvakashele. Uma unokungabaza mayelana nesimo sakho sempilo, kufanele uhlole isimo sakho sempilo ngodokotela wakho. Geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi, bese uzomisa kahle. Sebenzisa i-hand sanitizer enosawoti uma ungakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini nasensipho.
Ukuzalwa kokhetho olungacwasi futhi olungahloniphi ubulili eNingizimu Afrika kudinge ukuhlolwa okuphelele kwezimpawu zethu zesiqhelo. Uhlelo lwangaphambili lwaluhlanganisa ukuqashelwa okukodwa nezikhumbuzo ezine, ezamehlo esikhathini esedlule. Sifuna ukuphuma esikhathini esedlule; ngoMeyi 1998, iKhansela leziMvo leMphakathi elisha lasungulwa ukuze liphathise ukuhlola izimpawu zesiqhelo nezikhumbuzo. Njengengxenye yohlelo, uMnyango wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi nobuchwepheshe, ngokubambisana noMnyango wezokuxhumana kanye neMithetho Yolwazi, wenza ucwaningo olunzulu ngezimpawu nokuthi zimele ini ngenhloso yokuthola ubuhle obusha obubonisa umoya weNingizimu Afrika entsha. Kwacelwa ithimba labafundisi nabachwepheshe abanolwazi olunzulu ngezimpawu zomdabu kanye nemiqondo yazo ukuba bacabangele izinto ezimele ubumbano, umlando wonke, kanye nesipiliyoni samaAfrika, ikakhulukazi egxile eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela jikelele walolu hlelo waholela ekwakhiweni nasekudizayineni kwezimpawu zesiqhelo ezintsha. INingizimu Afrika iqale uhambo olude lokuzihlukanisa nomlando wokucwasa okususelwa kubulili, umbala, kanye nenkolelo. Izwe lethu liyaqhubeka ngokuzinzile endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu kanye nobungcweti bawo wonke abantu. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu bawo wonke abantu, kukhona isiko elisha lamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonishwa kobungcweti bomoya womuntu, okuyinto echaza ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Omunye wemizuzu engasoze ilibaleke yokuhlukanisa nesikhathi sethu esedlule kwaba ukuphakanyiswa kwefulegi elisha ngo-1994. Le mizwa yakhulisa ukuzigqaja kwethu nobungcweti besizwe esijabulela ubungcweti bawo wonke abantu. Okwesibili kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwezikhumbuzo zesiqhelo ezintsha, ezikhumbuza umlando wabo bonke abantu besizwe, ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa 2000. Ngokwenza lokhu, lokhu kukhombisa ubuhle be-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuvuselelwa nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Izikhumbuzo zesiqhelo ezintsha ziqinile emoyeni walolo vuselelo lwesizwe.
Ngempela kuyinjabulo enkulu kithi ukuhlanganyela nomphakathi waseHlabisa namuhla kulolu suku oluyingqopha-mlando lokwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa le ndawo. Le ndawo ingesinye sezindawo ezithintekile kakhulu ukungabheki kahle kuk government ye-apartheid, enenjongo eyodwa yokucindezela abantu bethu njengababukeli futhi ibavimbele ekuthuthukiseni. Sihlangene namuhla njengohulumeni babantu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi indawo yaseHlabisa iyakhuliswa futhi ithathe indawo yayo efanele ngokudlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wethu wesifunda. I-Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs imemezele izinhlelo ezibalulekile ezihloselwe ukuvuselela nokwakha amandla okusebenza kwamamaskandi esifundeni sethu, ukuze kusheshiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zomphakathi abakhonza. Senza lesi sithembiso ngoba njengohulumeni, siqonda kahle ukuthi ohulumeni bendawo basondelene kakhulu nabantu futhi kumele babe nesandla esibonakalayo ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bethu. Njengohulumeni, sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile empini yokulwa nobuphofu nasekuletheni izinsizakalo ezisemqoka kubantu bethu. Naphezu kokuthuthuka esikwenze, siyazi kahle ukuthi kusekhona izinkinga ezithile ezisemqoka ezithinta izimpilo zabantu bethu nsuku zonke. Siyazi ukuthi kwezinye zamamaskandi ethu, njengakuleli eHlabisa, abantu bethu basadinga ugesi, izindlu zangasese ezihlanzekile, namanzi ahlanzekile. Emizamweni yethu yokwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu bethu, sethule uhlelo olusha lokweseka amamaskandi olwaziwa ngokuthi i-Project Consolidate, oluhloselwe ukusiza amamaskandi afana neHlabisa ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi ezisemqoka. Ngesikhathi senza uhlolo nocwaningo ngalesi maskandi lapha, iHlabisa municipality yatholakala njengomaskandi odinga ukwesekwa okukhulu kuhulumeni ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi. Sihlangene namuhla eHlabisa ukuze sethule izinhlelo ezihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu kule ndawo. Ukuba lapha namuhla ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zabantu kubonisa ukubaluleka nokubaluleka kwale ndawo kuhulumeni wethu futhi kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kufinyelela kubo bonke ababambiqhaza bomphakathi wethu. Sihlangene namuhla ukuze siqale ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lokweseka ngqo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwalesi maskandi lapha, futhi sizovula ngokusemthethweni ofisi ezintsha zamamaskandi eHlabisa. Sikholelwa ukuthi ukuvulwa kweofisi ezintsha zamamaskandi eHlabisa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuletha ushintsho kule ndawo ukuze ikwazi ukudlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni isifunda sethu. Sibone kulo lonke izwe ukuthi abantu abaningi baveze ukukhala ngokuqhubeka kwezinsizakalo. Njengoba kuvamile, amamaskandi ethu yiyo eyabhekwa kabi ngalokhu. Nokho, kufanele kuthiwe amamaskandi ethu abenokuntuleka okukhulu kwezinsiza zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. Kungathiwa futhi amamaskandi ethu awanazo ngisho neofisi ezisebenzayo, futhi ngisho lapho kukhona ofisi, azinayo imishini yokusebenza efana namakhompyutha nezinye. Amamaskandi ethu awakwazi ukusebenza kahle ukwenza lokho abanikwe khona ngoba awanazo izinsiza ezanele nezakhiwo zokwenza imisebenzi yabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, thina njengomnyango wesifunda we-Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, ngokuhambisana nomsebenzi wethu wokweseka, sithuthukisile futhi sizobheka ukusebenza kwamamaskandi ethu, futhi sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngoxhaso ukuze amamaskandi akhe ofisi ezifanele ezifana nalokho okukhona lapha eHlabisa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kubantu. Umbono wombuso wesifunda ophathiswe nguMholi ohloniphekile uDkt. S.J. Ndebele uwukubona le ndawo ithuthuka ibe yidolobha eliphelele. Ngakho-ke, ukuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kweofisi zamamaskandi kanye nokwethulwa kwezinhlelo eziningi esizokwethula lapha namuhla kuyisinyathelo esihle sokufeza lo mbono. Ukuvulwa kweofisi zamamaskandi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile emphakathini wale ndawo. Abantu bethu ngeke baphinde babe ngabantu abahluphekayo ngenxa yokuntuleka kweofisi ezifanele zokubasiza ngezidingo zabo noma ngenxa yokuthi ofisi zikhona kude futhi zikhala izakhiwo zokuhlangabezana nezinselelo zabo. Lezi zikhungo zizoba izikhungo zokuthuthukiswa kwalesi maskandi. Kumele zibe njengomlilo opholile obamba ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Lezi zikhungo kumele zisebenze kubo bonke abantu baseHlabisa kungakhathalekile ukuthi bangobani emkhakheni wabo wezinkolo noma izepolitiki. Kumele kube njalo ngoba ubuphofu, indlala, nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa akukhethile futhi akubuzi ukuthi umuntu usebenza kuphi. Ngesikhathi sithule uhlelo lwe-Project Consolidate, sakhumbuza ukuthi sizovakashela amamaskandi abamba iqhaza ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo ngenhloso yokwethula izinsizakalo zokweseka. Njengoba abantu lapha bedinga usizo kakhulu, sathi nakuba kunesidingo kwezinye izindawo, sizokwenza ukuqala konyaka omusha ngokuqala okusha ezimpilweni zabantu bethu lapha eHlabisa. Sihlonze izinhlelo ezisheshayo ezizovumela le ndawo ukuba ibe nesandla esibalulekile emnothweni wesifunda nasemhlabeni. Siyazi kahle ukuthi uma izwe lethu linquma ukukhulisa umnotho walo ngo-6 percent, indawo yaseHlabisa nayo kumele ibe nesandla. Indawo yaseHlabisa ikakhulukazi iyindawo yasemakhaya. Ngakho-ke, akumangalisi ukuthi sinezinga eliphezulu lobuphofu nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo ngenxa yesikhathi se-apartheid lapho ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yethu kwashiywa. Akumangalisi futhi ukuthi isisekelo somnotho wale ndawo asikathuthukiswa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sonke kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuze sakhe idolobha elinokwakhiwa kahle kokuphatha nezohwebo. Njengoba ezinye izindawo zasemakhaya, indawo yaseHlabisa inezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ubuphofu, nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa. Kule ndawo, iningi labantu bethu, okufanele baphathe umnotho, alikho emsebenzini ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuthuthukiswa. Imisebenzi yezolimo okwamanje ikhona kuphela ezingeni lokuphila. Kunezinto eziningi ezisafanele zenziwe ukuze kudaleke amathuba kulesi sikhungo sezolimo. Omunye wezinkinga ezinkulu okufanele zibhekwane nazo ukuntuleka kwamakhono okufunda kanye nezobuchwepheshe phakathi kwabantu abasha kule ndawo. Lokhu kuphazamiseka kukhulu ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezikhungo zokufunda kanye nezokufundisa. Izindaba ezinhle ukuthi uhulumeni ukhuluma phambili ekwakheni izinhlelo zokufunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le ndawo ithuthuka. Mphakathi ophakeme weSisonke District Municipality, uMphakathi J.P. Omunye wababhali abahlonishwayo emhlabeni wakho uthe la mazwi: "izimo nezindlela umuntu akhulela ngazo zinefuthe esikhathini esizayo salowo muntu." Umthethosisekelo wezwe lethu uveza ngokucacile ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhlala endaweni ephephile nephakeme. Leli lungelo lifaka bonke, kuhlanganise nezingane, ngoba intsha iyisikhathi esizayo sezwe lethu. IBill of Rights iphinde iveze ngokucacile ukuthi akekho okufanele aphathwe kabi mayelana nosizo lokuthola izindlu. Simi lapha eKokstad namuhla ukuze siqedele lezi zinhloso ezishicilelwe emthethosisekelweni wezwe lethu. Simi lapha namuhla ukuze sakhe ukuqala okusha ezimpilweni zabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi lezo zomphakathi ezisemazingeni aphansi, okuhlanganisa izingane nabesifazane. Simi lapha namuhla ekhaya lehope ukuze sinikeze ithemba futhi sakhe ikusasa el mejor for our children. Umphakathi Wokuphatha, siphila ngesikhathi lapho sibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Phakathi kwezinselelo esibhekene nazo kukhona ukususa ubuphofu nokuqinisekisa inhlalakahle emiphakathini yethu. Kuyiqiniso elingaphikiswa ukuthi iHIV/AIDS iyisithiyo esikhulu esibhekene nabantu bethu. Ezinye izimuli, izindlu zivaliwe, zishiya izingane zihlala zodwa ngenxa yale mpandana. Kusemva kwethu njengomphakathi nakuHulumeni ukuvimbela le mpi ekubhubhiseni ikusasa lesizwe lethu, okuyizingane zethu. Umnyango wethu ukhona lapha namuhla ukuze ubeke itshe esisekelweni sokugcina ikusasa lethu ngokunakekela izingane ezibe yizintandane, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yale HIV/AIDS. Namuhla sizovula ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esikholwa ukuthi siyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokulwa nale mpandana. Lesi sakhiwo sizoba yindawo yokuphepha yezingane zethu ezingenabantu ngenxa yale disease. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezikhathalela izingane, njengekhaya leComfort, kuyindlela eyodwa uHulumeni akholelwa ukuthi angabhekana nayo nalesi sifo sezingane ezizintandane ukuze nazo zikhule ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele futhi zibe nekusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu akusho ukuthi sikhuthaza izingane ukuba zifakwe ezindlini zentandane. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi izingane zethu ziphumeza ezitaladini ngenkathi thina, njengomphakathi, sikhaba ukunakekela. Ubuphofu kanye neHIV/AIDS kunezimpempe ezimbi ezicindezela izici zomphakathi nezomnotho. Lokhu kudala inani elikhulu labantu bomphakathi abangasekela. Uhulumeni onakekela, njengathi, ngeke uhlezi phansi ubuke isizukulwane sifa ezitaladini. Njengomhulumeni, sikholelwa ukuthi isifunda sethu kufanele sibe yisifunda esinakekela izingane kahle. Sikholelwa ukuthi akekho umntwana okufanele aye embhedeni engekho ukudla futhi akafanele aye esikoleni ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza. Sikholelwa ukuthi amalungelo ezingane zethu kufanele ahlonishwe njengamalungelo omuntu wonke. Simi lapha namuhla ukuze sivule ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esizoba yisibani sethemba ezinganeni zethu ezingenabantu ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS. Kulesi sakhiwo, izingane zizothola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo ukuze zikhule kahle futhi zijabulele ubuntwana bazo. Ukukhula ngaphandle kwabazali akuyona into ejabulisayo nhlobo, kodwa ngalezi zinyathelo, uhulumeni wethu uyasiza ekunciphiseni ubuhlungu obuhlangabezana nezingane zethu ezilahlekelwe abazali bazo ngesikhathi esincane. Njengomhulumeni, sikhathazekile kakhulu ngeHIV/AIDS kanye nemiphumela yayo. Izinga lokukhula kwezingane ezizintandane liyashaqisa. Inani lezindlu eziholwa izingane liyanda. Njengomnyango wezokwakha, sithole umgomo wokubamba iqhaza ekunikezeni izindlu kulabo abathintekile kakhulu yiHIV/AIDS. Umthethosisekelo wethu kanye neBill of Rights kungenzele kube lula ukuhlola imithetho ukuze ukwesekwa kwezindlu kufike kulabo abathintekile ngalesi sifo. Kukhona izinhlelo ezifana nalezi esisanda kuqala esifundeni sethu. Ngikhuluma ngezinhlelo ezifanayo eHlabisa, eManguzi, naseThekwini. Inhloso yethu ukuqhubeka nalesi sihloko, sigxile ezindaweni zethu ezisemazingeni aphansi njengezindlu zasemaphandleni. Kule msebenzi, sisebenzisana nezinye izinyunyana zikaHulumeni kuzo zonke izigaba. Sisebenzisana ngokusondelene noMnyango Wezempilo kanye noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Kuyaqondakala kumnyango wethu ukuthi maduze ngizobuyela eHlabisa naseManguzi ngohlelo olunembile lokwakha ezingeni lezingane ezithintekile ngalesi sifo. Umphakathi Wokuphatha, ngalolu hlelo esizolwakha lapha namuhla, sizokuqinisekisa inhlalakahle kanye neqholo lezingane zethu. Siyanxusa iMuniipality lapha eKokstad kanye nabaphathi beKhaya leComfort ngokuba phakathi kwabathola izinzuzo zalo mgomo osinika amandla lokutshala imali ekwakheni nasekukhuleni izikhungo ezifana nalezi. Kulolu hlelo, ngifuna ukubonga zonke izinyunyana ezisebenze kanzima ukuhlaziya imithetho yazo ukuze sikwazi ukubambisana. Ngivumele ngichaze kafushane izinyathelo ezibalulekile kumgomo wethu ezilethele lapha namuhla. Okokuqala, samukela wonke umuntu njengomuntu onamalungelo alinganayo kungakhathalekile isimo sabo sempilo kanye nesimo somnotho. Okwesibili, sihlaziye izidingo zalabo abaphila nalesi sifo futhi sabeka imigomo ecacile yokwakha izindlu zabo ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo kanye noMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Okwesithathu, sibuyele emuva ukuhlaziya ukuthi ubani abathola izinzuzo. Phambilini, sakhuluma ngezizinda eziphila ngaphansi komholo othile. Ukuze sakhe lezi zikhungo, sahlola umgomo ukuze sihlanganise labo abangasebenzi kodwa bangazuza uma bephakathi kwezikhungo ezifanele. Bacela ukuthi umnyango wethu usize ngama-57 embhede. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwazisa ukuthi umnyango wami uphumelele ekwakheni isikhungo esingu-362 square meters. Izindlu ezakhiwe zinkulu ngesisindo. Zifaka izindawo zokulala, amabhavu, amahhovisi, indawo yokuwasha, kanye nendawo yokulinda abagulayo. Lesi sakhiwo sakhiwe ngendlela efanele yokwamukela izinguquko zesikhathi esizayo njengoba isikhungo sikhula futhi inani labantu lenyuka. Ngifuna ukuvuma izinkampani ezizimele ukuba zibambisane nathi njengomhulumeni ekunakekeleni nasekukhuleni impilo engcono yezingane zethu. Siyazi ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukunqoba iHIV/AIDS ngokushesha, kodwa uma sihlala sithobekile, sikhathalela, futhi sisebenza kanzima, ngosuku oluthile sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ithemba kulabo abathintekile yiHIV/AIDS. Ngiyanxusa umphakathi wethu ukuba ubhekane nokukhula kwalesi sifo ngokuqondile. Kuyadabukisa ukuzwa ukuthi naphezu kolwazi oluningi ngalesi sifo, izibalo zakamuva zikhombisa ukukhula okwesabekayo kokwenzeka kwalesi sifo. Sidinga ukuvuka futhi sithathe isinyathelo. Le mklomelo inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaveze ubuchule obuphakeme emikhakheni yobuciko, isiko, ubhalomfundo, umculo, ezokungcebeleka, nezemidlalo. Izigaba zesithathu = Uxube lwezinsimbi. Isithelo se-gourd (iPumpkin) simela ubuhle obukhulu bokuphumelela kwabantu abesilisa nabesifazane abaphakamisa iNingizimu Afrika emikhakheni yokwakha, ubuciko, isiko, umculo, ezokungcebeleka, nezemidlalo. Izinhloko zeLydenburg - ubuciko - izinhloko ze-terracotta zimelela ubuciko bokubona kanye nekhono lokudala ngokuhamba phambili phambi kwabantu. Idrum yase-Afrika - ihambisana nazo zonke izinkolo nemizamo yobuciko. Imela isipho esikhulu ekuxoxeni izindaba nasekugubheni amasiko ethu. Iphakethe / Ilanga - umqhele umele ikhanda elikhanyisiwe ngama-feather agqokwa ngabaculi nobukhosi kanye nabantu abahlonishwa. Imisebe yelanga ichaza amandla amakhulu, udumo, nokukhanya, konke okumele kube yimpumelelo yabaculi emikhakheni ehlukene. Isisho sokuthi asifani neqanda ngaphakathi - (Udlame emidlalweni) simela ukuqaphela ukuthi abantu baphumelele kakhulu emikhakheni yezemidlalo nesiko. Izindlela - (Impumelelo nokuthokozisa) - zimelela zonke izindlela eziya e-Afrika lapho abantu bevela khona, zimelela indlela ende yokuphumelela nokubekezela.
Abavakashi emnyangweni wezokubeletha bazovunyelwa ukufika kusukela ngo-09H00 - 10H00, emva kwalokho bazongena ngezikhathi ezichaziwe zokuvakasha. Abavakashi emnyangweni wezifo ezinzima bazovunyelwa ukufika kusukela ngo-09H00 kuze kube ngu-08H00 ebusuku, kodwa isikhathi abangahlala kuso sizokwenziwa ngabasebenzi bomnyango. Abavakashi emnyangweni wezifo ze-tuberculosis kanye nalabo abanezingqondo eziphukile bazongena ngezikhathi ezichaziwe zokuvakasha. Abathengisi abavunyelwe emhlabeni wesibhedlela. Zonke izikhungo zik government zikhishwe njengendawo lapho izivakashi zingavakashela khona, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bendawo bahloniphe le mthetho. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha azivunyelwe ukuvakashela esibhedlela. IMISEBENZI. Isibhedlela sinezinhlelo nemigomo ethinta ukukhangiswa nokuholwa kwabasebenzi. Izikhala ezitholakalayo zikhangiswa ezincwadini zendawo nezizimele, kuye ngendawo yesikhala somsebenzi. Bonke abathanda lo msebenzi kufanele bathumele izicelo zabo kule ndawo ethile. NB. Zonke izicelo kufanele zithunyelwe ngeposi njengoba kuchaziwe kukhangiso. Izicelo ezithunyelwe ngesandla azizokwenziwa. Labo abavunyelwe kuzokhishwa uhlu bazomenywa ezivivinyweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abahlangabezana nezimfuneko ezidingekayo bayaqashwa. IBHODI YESIBHEDLA. Laba ngabantu bomphakathi abaqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Bakhonza njengoxhumana phakathi kwesibhedlela nomphakathi. Banikeza izeluleko kubaphathi besibhedlela ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi kanye nezidingo ezingasiza umphakathi njengoba behlela isibhedlela. Baphakamisa ulwazi mayelana nesibhedlela, besebenzisa izakhiwo zomphakathi, futhi besebenzisa ulwazi abaluqoqayo kubaphathi besibhedlela; njengoba ibhodi iyisakhiwo esisemthethweni esixhumana nabaphathi besibhedlela. Uma umphakathi udinga ukucaciselwa ngezindaba ezithile ezithinta isibhedlela, lesi yisakhiwo esiqondile esizokwenza izincazelo njengoba sithola iningi lolwazi lwethu emihlanganweni eyenziwa njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu nabaphathi besibhedlela... Baphinde bahlangabezane nezidingo zezempilo ngaphansi kwemigomo yombuso nezifundazwe, bephakamisa ukubambisana kwezempilo nomphakathi. Qeqesha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi. Thuthukisa, uthuthukise izinga lethu, futhi uhlaziye njalo. Qinisekisa indawo ephephile kubo bonke. Igumbi lokuhlola nokweluleka kulabo abahamba ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV. Igumbi labanye amadoda. Igumbi lokugcina igazi. Omunye wemigomo nezinhlelo zomnyango wezempilo ukubring izinsizakalo zezempilo zibe seduze nomphakathi. Lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi uhulumeni uqeqeshe odokotela abahlinzeka ezikhungweni, ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nezinkinga zezempilo ezilethwa abantu ezikhungweni; ikakhulukazi njengoba inqubo yamanje ibalula ukuthi umuntu kufanele aqale aye ezikhungweni ngaphambi kokuthi aye esibhedlela. Umdokotela osezikhungweni ngu-oyokhombisa umuntu esibhedlela uma ebona ukuthi udinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Umthengi ukhumbuleka ukuthi kufanele anikeze incwadi yokudluliselwa evela ezikhungweni ezimthumelayo esibhedlela. Izimo eziphuthumayo azifakiwe kulolu hlelo; ngaphandle kwalokho, umphakathi kufanele usebenzise izikhungo njengoba ziseduze futhi insizakalo iyamahhala. Izincwadi zokudluliselwa uma uya esibhedlela 2..1. Abathola umhlalaphansi. Labo abangenamsebenzi kodwa baye basebenza ngaphambili kufanele bathwale iphasela kanye nebhukwana eliluhlaza. Labo abangenamsebenzi futhi abanasibhamu esiluhlaza kufanele bathwale amaphasela bese besayina isiqinisekiso ehhovisi lababhalisi noma ehhovisi lamaphoyisa ukuze bathole usizo. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha kufanele zibe namakhadi ezinqubomgomo. Uma usufika esibhedlela.
Uma kwenzeka izinto ezivamile empilweni yakho, ungase ube nesifo noma ulimele, ngakho-ke uzodinga ikhefu lesifo ukuze uphumelele esifweni noma kulimala. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ukulimala lapha akukhulumi ngokulimala emsebenzini. Izinsuku ezijwayelekile zokusebenza zezikhefu zesifo zingama-36 (36) ezihambisana nemiholo ephelele, okuyilokho okuvumelekile kwezikhawu zesifo. Ukuvumelekile kwezikhawu zesifo yisikhathi seminyaka emithathu elandelanayo. Uma wazi kusengaphambili ukuthi uzodinga ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini othile noma ungene esibhedlela uma kufanele ube sebenza, thumela isicelo futhi uqedele ifomu lakho lesicelo kusengaphambili. Nokho, uma uthola isifo ngokungazelelwe noma ulimele, xhumana nomphathi wakho ngokushesha uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yesifo noma ukulimala. Umlayezo othunyelwe ngomlomo ngozakwethu, umngane, noma omunye umuntu uyamukeleka kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sesifo/ukulimala sikuvimbela ekubikeni kumphathi wakho uqobo. Thumela isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi ubesebenzile izinsuku ezintathu noma ngaphezulu FUTHI uma usebenzise izikhawu zesifo ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezimbili phakathi nesikhathi semaviki ayisishiyagalombili, kuzokwenziwa ukunakwa ngesikhathi sokuphuma emsebenzini. Futhi, bheka isigaba sokuvunywa kwezitifiketi zesikhawu sesifo ngezansi. Sebenzisa futhi uthumele izikhawu zesifo ngokresponsibly nangokuhlakanipha. Gwema ukusebenzisa izikhawu zesifo ngenjongo ezingezona izifo nokulimala, njengoba ungase uthole ukuthi ubhekene nesimo esizayo mayelana nezikhawu zakho zesifo. Bheka futhi unikeze izikhawu zesifo ngokwezicelo zakho. Phenya futhi uhlole amacala athile afanayo okusebenzisa okungafanele izikhawu zesifo ezijwayelekile. Bese uthatha isinyathelo uma kudingeka. Umqashi angase, kwezinye izimo, acela isitifiketi sezokwelapha sokungabikhona okwesikhashana okungaphansi kwezinsuku ezintathu uma kutholakala ezinye izimo ezifanayo. Qondisa abasebenzi ngendlela efanele yokusebenzisa izikhawu zesifo ngokuhlakanipha. Hlanganisa izidingo zomsebenzi noma zokuqashwa noma funa umsebenzi omunye, ikakhulukazi ezimeni ezidinga lokhu. Izikhawu zesifo ezinganele ziwumvuzo ongafaka isicelo sazo uma izinsuku zakho ezijwayelekile zesikhawu sesifo seziphelile, okuyilokho okuvumelekile kwezikhawu zesifo zeminyaka emithathu (3). Faka isicelo usebenzisa amafomu afanele. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi kufanele ufake isicelo usebenzisa amafomu abekwe phansi ukuze uthole izikhawu zesifo ezinganele ngokufanele. Awusazodingeki ukusebenzisa ifomu le-Z1 ngenjongo le. Uma wazi kusengaphambili ukuthi uzodinga ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini othile noma ungene esibhedlela uma kufanele ube sebenza, thumela isicelo futhi uthumele ifomu lakho lesicelo kusengaphambili. Nokho, uma uthola isifo ngokungazelelwe noma ulimele, xhumana nomphathi wakho ngokushesha uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yesifo noma ukulimala. Umlayezo othunyelwe ngomlomo ngozakwethu, umngane, noma omunye umuntu uyamukeleka kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sesifo/ukulimala sikuvimbela ekubikeni kumphathi wakho uqobo. Ngaso sonke isikhathi thumela isitifiketi sesifo uma ufaka isicelo. Ungathumela imibhalo esekelayo yezicelo zokwelashwa nolwazi nemibono eyengeziwe ehambisana nesicelo sakho sezikhawu zesifo ezinganele. Gwema ukusebenzisa izikhawu zesifo ezinganele ngendlela engafanele. Lokhu kungumphathi wezempilo nokuphepha. emva kosuku lokuqala lokungabikhona emsebenzini. Umqashi uzokunikeza izikhawu zesifo ezinganele ngokususelwa kumphumela wokuphenya mayelana nohlobo nesimo sezikhawu zesifo ezinganele. Inqubomgomo nezindlela zokuphatha izikhawu zesifo ezinganele kanye nokuhamba kwezempilo yi-PILIR. Umqashi uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngemiphumela futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele ngokususelwa kumiphumela. Lokhu kungaba umqashi wakho noma wena uqobo uqala ukuhamba kwezempilo uma kukhona ukungabaza ukuthi ungasebenzi futhi. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke, ngokwesibonelo, ngemuva kokuhlaselwa kwemoto okukhulu. Uma ufaka isicelo sezikhawu zesifo ezinganele zesikhathi eside futhi uphenyo lomqashi lukhombisa ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukusebenza futhi, bangase baphakamise isicelo sakho sezikhawu zesifo ezinganele sibe isicelo sokuhamba kwezempilo. Ungase ucelwe ukuthi uqedele amafomu acacile wezicelo zokuhamba kwezempilo. Thumela izitifiketi zesifo nanoma yiziphi imibiko yezokwelapha nolwazi nezinye izicelo. Izindlela ezengeziwe zokuhlola zingase zidingeke njengengxenye yokuphenya ukuze umqashi enze isinqumo esiqondile mayelana nokuphumelela kwezikhawu zesifo ezinganele noma okunye. Umqashi uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngemiphumela futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele ngokususelwa kumiphumela. Ngokuqondene nezikhawu zesifo ezinganele, umqashi uzokwamukela kuphela izitifiketi ezikhishwe ngodokotela abhalisiwe kwiNhlangano Yezempilo YaseNingizimu Afrika futhi abaneziqu ezisemthethweni zokuxilonga nokwelapha iziguli. Isitifiketi sezokwelapha kufanele, ngovuma lwakho, sichaze uhlobo nobubanzi besifo/ukulimala. Igama, ikheli, nezifundo zodokotela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi udokotela unikeza isitifiketi ngokususelwa kumphumela wokuhlola, noma ngenxa yolwazi olutholwe kumguli futhi olwamukelwe njengokwelashwa kwezokwelapha okusekela. Isikhathi esinconyiwe sezikhawu zesifo kanye nosuku lokukhishwa kwesitifiketi sesifo. Isaziso sodokotela uma usebenzisa izitifiketi eziphrintiwe, noma yiluphi ulwazi olungahlangene nomguli kufanele lususwe. Umqashi ungase uqale futhi uphenye isicelo sakho kuphela ngemva kokuthi usuthumele ifomu lesicelo kanye nawo wonke amadokhumenti adingekayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubuyela kudokotela wakho ukuze uqedele umbiko odingekayo oyingxenye yamafomu wezicelo. Ifomu lesicelo lingase libe yingozi ekufinyeleleni kwakho ezikhawu zesifo ezinganele noma ekuhambeni kwezempilo. Umqashi uzokunikeza isikhathi sokuphumula ngalokhu. Umqashi uzogcina amarekhodi ngezikhathi ezisetshenziswe njengokuphumula kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku olulodwa. Lokhu kuzoboniswa kumarekhodi akho ezikhawu zesifo. Kulindeleke ukuthi kulokhu uzogcwalisa irekhodi lesikhathi esingasetshenziswanga ukuze kugcinwe amarekhodi. Ubufakazi bezimo ezinjalo buzodingeka njengoba kudingeka. KuMnyango Wezikhungo, phatha ngaso sonke isikhathi noma yiluphi ulwazi mayelana nesimo sezempilo sozakwethu nganokuhlonipha nangokufihlekile.

Sifuna ukuphuma esikhathini esedlule; ngoMeyi 1998, iPhalamende elisha leZeluleko leMphakathi mayelana Nezimpawu Zikazwelonke lenziwa ukuba lilawule umsebenzi wokuhlola izimpawu zikazwelonke nezindondo. Njengengxenye yohlelo, uMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe, ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezokuxhumana kanye Nezokuphepha Kolwazi, wenza ucwaningo olunzulu ngezimpawu nokuthi zimelela ini ngenhloso yokuthola ubuhle obusha obubonisa umoya weNingizimu Afrika entsha. Kwacelwa ithimba labafundisi nabachwepheshe abanokwazi okujulile ngezimpawu zomdabu kanye nezincazelo zazo ukuba bacabangele izinto ezimelela ubunye, umlando wonke, kanye nolwazi lwase-Afrika, ngokukhethekile begxile eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela jikelele walolu hlelo waholela ekwakhiweni nasekudizayineni kwezimpawu zikazwelonke ezintsha. INingizimu Afrika iqale uhambo olude lokuzihlukanisa nomlando wokucwasa ngokobulili, umbala, kanye nokukholwa. Izwe lethu liqhubeka kahle endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu kanye nobuqotho bonke abantu. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu bonke abantu, kukhona isiko elisha lamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonipha ubuqotho bomoya womuntu, okuyinto echaza ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Omunye wemizuzu engasoze yalibaleka yokuhlukanisa nesikhathi sethu esedlule kwaba ukuphakanyiswa kwefulegi elisha ngo-1994. Le mizwa yaqina ukuzigqaja kwethu kanye nobuqotho benhlangano ehlabela ubuqotho bonke abantu. Okwesibili kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwezindondo zikazwelonke ezintsha, ezikhumbula umlando wabo bonke abantu benhlangano, ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa 2000. Ngokwenza kanjalo, lokhu kuveza ubuhle base-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuphinda kuvuswe nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Izindondo zikazwelonke ezintsha ziqinile emoyeni walolo vuselelo lukazwelonke.
Ngempela kuyajabulisa kakhulu ukuba sithinte umphakathi waseHlabisa namuhla kulolu suku olubalulekile lokwethulwa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa lesi sikhala. Le ndawo ingesinye sezindawo ezithinteke kakhulu ukungabheki kahle kuk gouvernement ye-apartheid, enenjongo eyodwa yokucindezela abantu bethu njengobugqila nokubanqanda ekuthuthukiseni. Sihamba lapha namuhla njengohulumeni wabantu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi indawo yaseHlabisa iyaphakanyiswa futhi ithathe indawo yayo efanele ngokudlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni wethu wesifunda. Umnyango Wezokubambisana Kokuphathwa Nokuphila Kwamasiko umemezele izinhlelo ezibalulekile eziqondiswe ekubuyiseni nasekuqinisiseni ukusebenza kwemiphakathi esifundeni sethu, ukuze kusheshiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zomphakathi abakhonza zona. Senza lesi sithembiso ngoba njengohulumeni, siqonda kahle ukuthi ohulumeni bendawo basondelene kakhulu nabantu futhi kumele babe nesandla esibonakalayo ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu bethu. Njengohulumeni, sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile empini yokulwa nobuphofu nasekuletheleni izinsizakalo ezibalulekile kubantu bethu. Naphezu kokuthuthuka esikwenze, siyazi kahle ukuthi kusekhona ukungaphumeleli kwezinsiza ezithile ezithinta izimpilo zabantu bethu nsuku zonke. Siyazi ukuthi kwezinye zezimiphakathi zethu, njenge lapha eHlabisa, abantu bethu basadinga ugesi, amathoyilethi ahlanzekile, namanzi anempilo. Emzamweni wethu wokwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu bethu, siwethule uhlelo olusha lokwesekwa kwemiphakathi olwaziwa ngokuthi iProject Consolidate, oluhloselwe ukusiza imiphakathi efana neHlabisa ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi ezibalulekile. Ngesikhathi senza ukuhlaziywa nocwaningo ngemiphakathi lapha, umphakathi waseHlabisa watholakala njengomunye wemiphakathi edinga ukwesekwa okukhulu kuhulumeni ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi. Sihamba lapha eHlabisa namuhla ukwethula izinhlelo eziqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu baleli sikhala. Ukuba lapha namuhla ukwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu kukhombisa ukubaluleka nokubaluleka kwalesi sikhala kuhulumeni wethu futhi kukhombisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kufinyelela kubo bonke amalungu omphakathi wethu. Sihamba lapha namuhla ukuze siqale ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lokwesekwa okuqondile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza komphakathi lapha, futhi sizovula futhi emahhovisi amasha omphakathi weHlabisa. Sikholelwa ukuthi ukuvulwa kwamahhovisi amasha omphakathi eHlabisa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuletha ushintsho kule ndawo ukuze ikwazi ukudlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni isifunda sethu. Sibone kulo lonke izwe ukuthi abantu abaningi baphakamisa izikhalazo mayelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Ngokuvamile, imiphakathi yethu iyona ehluleka kakhulu kulokhu. Nokho, kufanele kuthiwe imiphakathi yethu iside isikhathi ingenazo izinsiza ezanele zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. Kungaphinde kuthiwe imiphakathi yethu ayinayo ngisho nezikhungo zokusebenza, futhi ngisho lapho zikhona, azinazo izinsiza ezisebenzayo ezifana namakhompyutha nezinye. Imiphakathi yethu ayikwazi ukusebenza kahle ukwenza lokho okukhona emandleni ayo ngoba ayinazo izinsiza ezanele nezakhiwo zokwenza imisebenzi yayo. Ngalesi sizathu, thina njengoMnyango wesifunda Wezokubambisana Kokuphathwa Nokuphila Kwamasiko, ngokuhambisana nendima yethu yokusiza, sithuthukisile futhi sizobheka ukusebenza kwemiphakathi yethu, futhi sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngemali ukuze kusizwe imiphakathi yakhe izikhungo ezinhle ezifana nalezo onazo lapha eHlabisa, ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisheshayo kubantu. Umbono wohulumeni wesifunda ophathiswa nguMholi ohloniphekile uDkt. S.J. Ndebele uwukubona le ndawo ithuthuka ibe idolobha eliphelele. Ngakho-ke, ukuvulwa ngokusemthethweni kwamahhovisi omphakathi nokuqaliswa kwezinhlelo eziningi esizethulayo lapha namuhla kuyisinyathelo esihle sokufeza lo mbono. Ukuvulwa kwamahhovisi omphakathi kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile emphakathini walesi sikhala. Abantu bethu ngeke babe ngabantu abahluphekayo ngenxa yokuntuleka kwamahhovisi afanele ukuze basize ngezidingo zabo noma ngoba amahhovisi akude futhi anokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuhlangabezana nezinkinga zabo. Lawa mahhovisi azoba izikhungo zokuthuthukiswa kwalomphakathi. Kumele abe njengomlilo ophakamisayo uthuthukise nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Lawa mahhovisi kumele asize bonke abantu baseHlabisa kungakhathalekile ukuthi bangobani ngokwenkolo noma ngokobuzwe. Kumele kube njalo ngoba ubuphofu, indlala, nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa akukhethwa futhi akubuzi ukuthi umuntu usemsebenzini muni. Ngesikhathi siqaliswa ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lweProject Consolidate, saphakamisa ukuthi sizovakashela imiphakathi ethokozisayo ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo ngenhloso yokwethula izinsizakalo zokweseka. Sihlonze izinhlelo ezisheshayo ezizovumela le ndawo ukuba ibe nesandla esibalulekile emnothweni wesifunda nasezweni. Siyazi kahle ukuthi uma izwe lethu linquma ukukhulisa umnotho walo ngo-6% , indawo yaseHlabisa nayo kumele ibe nesandla. Indawo yaseHlabisa ikakhulukazi iyindawo yokuhlala. Ngakho-ke, akumangazi ukuthi sinesimo esiphezulu sobuphofu nokuntuleka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo ngenxa yesikhathi se-apartheid lapho ukuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yethu kwashiywa. Futhi akumangazi ukuthi isisekelo somnotho wale ndawo asikathuthukiswa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sonke kumele sisebenze kanzima ukuze sakhe idolobha elinokuphathwa kahle kwezokuphatha nezokuhweba. Njengamanye amaholo, indawo yaseHlabisa inezinga eliphezulu lokungasebenzi, ubuphofu, nokungathuthukiswa. Kule ndawo, iningi labantu bethu, okumele babe yizikhungo zomnotho, abanakho ukwenza lutho ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuthuthukiswa. Imisebenzi yokulima okwamanje ikhona kuphela ezingeni lokuphila. Kuningi okumele kwenziwe ukuze kudaleke amathuba kulolu hlobo lwezomnotho. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ezidinga ukubhekelwa yikuntuleka kwamakhono ezemfundo nezobuchwepheshe phakathi kwabantu abasha kule ndawo. Lokhu kukhuphuka ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezikhungo zemfundo nezokufundisa. Izindaba ezinhle ukuthi uhulumeni usemkhankasweni wokuqala wezinhlelo zemfundo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le ndawo iyathuthuka. Umphathi wePhrojekthi, ezokuvakasha, ungomunye wezinhlelo zethu ezibalulekile emkhankasweni wethu wokwandisa amathuba okutshala imali kulesi sifunda. Njengoba ngishilo, indawo yaseHlabisa ibusisiwe ngobuhle bemvelo obumangalisayo, obuhlotshiswe ngezintaba, izigodi, nemifula. Inokukhula kwemvelo okuhle kakhulu. Mphakathi ohloniphekile weSisonke District Municipality, uMphakathi J.P. Omunye wababhali abahloniphekile emhlabeni wakho uthe la mazwi: "izimo nokuthi umuntu ukhula kanjani kunomthelela esikhathini esizayo salo muntu." Umthethosisekelo wezwe lethu uveza kahle ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhlala endaweni ephephile futhi enhlonipho. Leli lungelo lifaka wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nezingane, ngoba intsha iyisikhathi esizayo sezwe lethu. IBill of Rights nayo iveza kahle ukuthi akekho okufanele akwenze ukuhlukumezeka mayelana nosizo lokuthola izindlu. Simi lapha eKokstad namuhla ukuze sifinyelele lezi zinhloso ezishicilelwe emthethosisekelweni wezwe lethu. Simi lapha namuhla ukuze sakhe ukuqala okusha ezimpilweni zabantu bethu, ikakhulukazi lezi zomphakathi ezisemathubeni aphansi, okuhlanganisa izingane nabesifazane. Simi lapha namuhla ekhaya lehope ukuze sinikeze ithemba futhi sakhe ikusasa elingcono ezinganeni zethu. Umphakathi Wokuphatha, siphila ngesikhathi lapho sibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Phakathi kwezinselelo esibhekene nazo kukhona ukususa ubumpofu nokwenza kube nokuphila kahle emiphakathini yethu. Kuyiqiniso elingaphikiswa ukuthi ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS lungesinye sezinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nabantu bethu. Emakhaya ambalwa, izindlu zivalwe, zishiya izingane zibe yizintandane ngenxa yale mpilo. Kukhona emathunjini ethu njengomphakathi nakuhulumeni ukuvimbela le mpi ekubhubhiseni ikusasa lesizwe lethu, okuyizingane zethu. Umnyango wethu ukhona lapha namuhla ukuze ubeke itshe esisekelweni sokugcina ikusasa lethu ngokunakekela izingane ezibe yizintandane, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yale HIV/AIDS. Namuhla sizovula ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esikholwa ukuthi siyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekulweni nale mpilo. Lesi sakhiwo sizoba yindawo yokuphepha ezinganeni zethu ezinganawo umuntu ngenxa yale ntshontsho. Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ezihlinzeka ngezingane, njengale Ndlu Yokunethezeka, kuyindlela eyodwa uhulumeni akholelwa ukuthi angabhekana nayo inkinga yezingane ezibe yizintandane ukuze nazo zikhule ngaphansi kwezimo ezifanele futhi zibe nekusasa eliqhakazile. Lokhu akusho ukuthi sikhuthaza izingane ukuba zifakwe ezindlini zentandane. Kodwa iqiniso ukuthi izingane zethu ziphume emigwaqweni ngenkathi thina, njengomphakathi, sithanda ukungazikhathazi ngazo. Ubumfucu kanye nobhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS kunezimpempe ezimbi ezithinta izici zomphakathi nezomnotho. Lokhu kudala inani elikhulu labantu bomphakathi abangasekela ngokwabo. Uhulumeni onakekelayo, njengethu, ngeke uhlezi phansi ubheke indlela yokuthi isizukulwane sibhujiswe emigwaqweni. Njengohulumeni, sikholwa ukuthi isifundazwe sethu kufanele sibe yisifundazwe esinakekela kahle izingane. Sikholwa ukuthi akekho umntwana okufanele aye embhedeni engekho ukudla futhi akafanele aye esikoleni ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Sikholwa ukuthi amalungelo ezingane zethu kufanele ahlonishwe njengamalungelo omuntu wonke. Simi lapha namuhla ukuze sivule ngokusemthethweni isakhiwo esizoba yisibani sethemba ezinganeni zethu ezinganawo ikhaya ngenxa yobhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS. Kulesi sakhiwo, izingane zizothola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo ukuze zikhule kahle futhi zijabulele ubuntwana bazo. Ukukhula ngaphandle kwabazali akuyona into ejabulisayo neze, kodwa ngalezi zifiso, uhulumeni wethu uyanciphisa ubuhlungu obubhekene nezingane zethu ezilahlekelwe abazali bazo besencane. Njengohulumeni, sikhathazekile kakhulu nge-HIV/AIDS kanye nemiphumela yayo. Izinga lokwanda kwezintandane liyashaqisa. Inani lezindlu eziholwa izingane liyakhula. Njengomnyango wezokwakha, sithole umthetho wokubamba iqhaza ekunikezeni izindlu kulabo abathintekile kakhulu ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS. Umthethosisekelo wethu kanye neBill of Rights kube lula kithi ukuhlola imithetho ukuze usizo lwezindlu lufinyelele kulabo abathintekile kule mpilo. Kukhona izinhlelo ezifana nalezi esisanda kuziqala esifundazweni sethu. Ngikhuluma ngezinhlelo ezifanayo eHlabisa, eManguzi, naseThekwini. Inhloso yethu ukuqhubeka nalesi sikhathi, sigxile ezindaweni zethu ezisemathubeni aphansi njengemakhaya asendaweni ezisemaphandleni. Kulomsebenzi, sibambisene nezinye izigaba zohulumeni kuzo zonke izigaba. Sisebenza ngokubambisana eduze neMnyango Wezempilo kanye neMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Inhloso yomnyango wethu ukuthi maduze ngizobuyela eHlabisa naseManguzi ngohlelo oluphelele lokwakha ezingeni lezingane ezithintekile ngalesi sifo. Umphakathi Wokuphatha, ngalesi sikhathi esizokhombisa lapha namuhla, sizokuqinisekisa ukuphila kahle nokuhlonipha izingane zethu. Siyanihalalisela iMunicipality lapha eKokstad kanye nabaphathi beNdlu Yokunethezeka ngokuba phakathi kwabatholi balolu hlelo olusivumela ukuba sifake imali ekwakheni nasekukhuleni izinsiza ezifana nalezi. Kulesi sigaba, ngifuna ukubonga zonke izigaba ezisebenze kanzima ukuhlaziya imithetho yazo ukuze sikwazi ukubambisana. Ngivumele ngichaze kafushane izinyathelo ezisemqoka emthethweni wethu ezisilethele lapha namuhla. Okokuqala, samukela wonke umuntu njengomuntu onezizathu ezilinganayo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi isimo sabo sempilo kanye nesimo somnotho. Okwesibili, sihlole izidingo zabaphila nalesi sifo futhi sabeka imigomo ecacile yokwakha izindlu zabo ngokubambisana neMnyango Wezempilo kanye neMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi. Okwesithathu, sabuyela emuva ukuhlaziya ukuthi ngubani abatholi. Phambilini, sakhuluma ngama-families aphila ngaphansi komholo othile. Ukuze sakhe lezi zinsiza, saguqula umthetho ukuze kufakwe labo abangasebenzi kodwa bangazuza uma bekwi-sakhiwo esifanele. Bacela ukuthi umnyango wethu usize ngama-57 amabhentshi. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukuveza ukuthi umnyango wami uphumelele ukweseka ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo esingu-362 square meter. Izindlu ezakhiwe zinkulu ngesisindo. Zihlanganisa izindawo zokulala, izindlu zangasese, amahhovisi, indawo yokuwasha, kanye nendawo yokulinda abagulayo. Lesi sakhiwo sakhiwe ngendlela evumela izinguquko zesikhathi esizayo njengoba lesi sikhungo sikhula futhi inani labantu likhula. Ngithanda ukumema izinkampani ezizimele ukuba zibe nobambiswano nathi njengohulumeni ekunakekeleni nasekukhuleni impilo engcono yezingane zethu. Siyazi ukuthi ngeke sikwazi ukunqoba ubhubhane lwe-HIV/AIDS ngesikhathi esifushane, kodwa uma sihlala sithembekile, sinakekela, futhi sisebenza kanzima, ngosuku oluthile sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngithemba kulabo abathintekile ngale HIV/AIDS.
