Le mklomelo inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaveze ubuchwepheshe obukhulu emikhakheni yobuciko, isiko, izincwadi zemfundo, umculo, ezokubika, nezemidlalo. Ikhathagori yesithathu = Uhlanganiso lwezinsimbi. Uthuli lwe-pumpkin lumele ubuhle obukhulu bokuphumelela kwabantu abesilisa nabesifazane abaphakamisela iNingizimu Afrika emikhakheni yokwakha, ubuciko, isiko, umculo, ezokubika, nezemidlalo. Amakhanda eLydenburg - ubuciko - amakhanda e-teracotta amele ubuciko bokubona kanye nomsebenzi wokwakha ubuciko kanye nekhono lokwenza esiteji phambi kwabantu. Idrum yase-Afrika - ihambisana nazo zonke izinkolo nezifiso zobuciko. Imela isipho esikhulu ekuxoxeni izindaba nasekugubheni amasiko ethu. Iphakade / Ilanga - umqhele umele ikhanda elihlotshiswe ngama-feather agqokwe abaculi nobukhosi kanye nabantu abahlonishwa. Imisebe yelanga ichaza amandla amakhulu, udumo, nokukhanya, konke okumele kube yimpumelelo yabaculi emikhakheni ehlukene. Isisho sokuthi asifani neqanda ngaphakathi - (Udlame emidlalweni) simele ukuqashelwa kokuthi abantu baphumelele kakhulu emikhakheni yezemidlalo nezamasiko. Izindlela - (Impumelelo nentshisekelo) - zimele zonke izindlela eziya e-Afrika lapho abantu bevela khona, zimele indlela ende yokuphumelela nokubekezela.
Izivakashi ezikwiwadi ye-maternity zizovunyelwa ukungena kusukela ngo-09H00 - 10H00, emva kwalokho zizongena ngesikhathi esithile sokuvakasha. Izivakashi ezikwiwadi ezibuhlungu kakhulu zizovunyelwa ukungena kusukela ngo-09H00 kuze kube ngu-08H00 ebusuku, kodwa isikhathi abazokwazi ukusihlala sizokwenziwa ngabasebenzi bewadi. Izivakashi ezikwiwadi ye-tuberculosis kanye nalabo abanezingqondo eziphukile zizongena ngesikhathi esishiwo phambilini sokuvakasha. Abathengisi abavunyelwe emhlabeni wesibhedlela. Zonke izikhungo zik government zikhulunywe njengendawo lapho izivakashi zingavakashela khona, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bendawo bahloniphe le mthetho. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha azivunyelwe ukuvakashela esibhedlela. IMISEBENZI YEBHIZINISI. Isibhedlela sinezinqubomgomo nemigomo elawula ukumaketha nokuqasha abasebenzi. Izikhala ezitholakalayo zikhangiswa ezincwadini zendawo nezasezweni, kuye ngendawo yomsebenzi evulekile. Bonke abathanda umsebenzi kumele bathumele izicelo zabo endaweni eyinhloko. NB. Zonke izicelo kumele zithunyelwe ngeposi njengoba kuchaziwe kokukhangiswa. Izicelo ezithunyelwe ngesandla azizokwenziwa. Labo abahlongozwayo bazomenywa ezivivinyweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abahlangabezana nezidingo ezidingekayo bayaqashwa. IBHODI YESIBHEDLA. Laba ngamalungu omphakathi abekwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Baphatha njengoxhumana phakathi kwesibhedlela nomphakathi. Bacebisa ukuphathwa kwesibhedlela ngezindaba ezithinta umphakathi kanye nezidingo ezingase zibe usizo emphakathini njengoba bephethe isibhedlela. Baphinde balethe ulwazi mayelana nesibhedlela, besebenzisa izakhiwo zomphakathi, futhi bejolise kulwazi abaluqoqayo kuziphathimandla zesibhedlela; njengoba ibhodi iyisakhiwo esisemthethweni esixhumana nokuphathwa kwesibhedlela. Uma umphakathi udinga ukucaciselwa ngezindaba ezithile ezithinta isibhedlela, leli yisakhiwo esiqondile esizokwenza izincazelo njengoba sithola iningi lolwazi lwethu emihlanganweni eyenziwa njalo ezinyangeni ezintathu nabaphathi besibhedlela... Baphinde bahlangabezane nezidingo zempilo ngaphansi kwemigomo yephalamende neyesifunda, beqhakambisa ukubambisana kwezempilo nomphakathi. Qeqesha futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi. Thuthukisa, uthuthukise izinga lethu, futhi uhlaziye njalo. Qinisekisa indawo ephephile kubo bonke. Igumbi lokuhlola nokweluleka kulabo abahamba ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV. Igumbi labanye amadoda. Igumbi lokugcina igazi. Omunye wemigomo nezinhlelo zomnyango wezempilo ukubring izinsiza zempilo zibe seduze nemiphakathi. Lokhu kuyisizathu sokuthi uhulumeni aqeqeshe odokotela abenza emakhlinikini, ukuze bakwazi ukuphatha nokuxazulula izinkinga zempilo ezilethwa abantu emakhlinikini; ikakhulukazi njengoba inqubo yamanje ibalula ukuthi umuntu kumele aqale aye emkhlinikini ngaphambi kokuthi aye esibhedlela. Umdokotela emkhlinikini nguye ozothumela umuntu esibhedlela uma ebona ukuthi udinga usizo oluphuthumayo. Ikhasimende likhumbuza ukuthi lidinga ukuhambisa incwadi yokuthunyelwa evela emkhlinikini ethumele ukuba iye esibhedlela. Izimo eziphuthumayo azifakiwe kulolu hlelo; ngaphandle kwalokho, umphakathi kumele usebenzise emakhlinikini njengoba eduze futhi insizakalo iyamahhala. Izincwadi zokuthunyelwa uma uya esibhedlela 2..1. Abathola umhlalaphansi. Labo abangenamsebenzi kodwa baye basebenza ngaphambili kumele baphathe iphasipoti kanye nebhukwana eliluhlaza. Labo abangenamsebenzi futhi bengenayo ibhukwana eliluhlaza kumele baphathe amaphasi bese besayina i-affidavit ehhovisi lababhalisi noma emaphoyiseni ukuze bathole usizo. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha kumele ziphathe amakhadi ezinqubomgomo. Uma usufika esibhedlela.
Uma kwenzeka izinto ezivamile empilweni yakho, ungase ube nesifo noma ube nolaka, ngakho-ke uzodinga ukuhamba emsebenzini ukuze uphumelele esifweni noma kulaka. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ulaka lapha alukhulumi ngolaka emsebenzini. Izinsuku ezijwayelekile zokuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yesifo zingama-36 (36) ezihambisana nemiholo ephelele, okuyilokho okukhokhelwe ukuhamba emsebenzini. Ukukhokhelwa ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yesifo isikhathi esingama-3 eminyakeni elandelanayo. Uma wazi kusenesikhathi ukuthi uzodinga ukuhamba emsebenzini ukuze wenze inqubo ethile noma ungagula uma kufanele ube sebhulohweni, thumela isicelo bese uqedela ifomu lakho lesicelo kusenesikhathi. Nokho, uma uthola isifo ngokungazelelwe noma uthola ulaka, xhumana nomphathi wakho ngokushesha uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yesifo noma ulaka. Umyalezo othunyelwe ngomlomo ngamalunga, ozakwethu, noma umngane wamukeleka kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sesifo/ulaka sithinta ukukwazi kwakho ukuveza kumphathi wakho. Thumela isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuthi ubesebenzisa isifo izinsuku ezintathu noma ngaphezulu FUTHI uma usebenzisa ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yesifo ngaphezu kokuphindwe kabili phakathi nesikhathi esingamasonto ayisishiyagalombili, kuzokwenziwa ukuthi kube nokunakwa ngesikhathi sokungasebenzi. Futhi, bheka isigaba sokuvunywa KweziTifiketi Zokuhamba Emsebenzini Ngesifo ngezansi. Sebenzisa futhi uthumele ukuhamba emsebenzini ngokresponsibly nangokuhlakanipha. Gwema ukusebenzisa ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yesifo ngezinye izinjongo ngaphandle kwesifo nolaka, njengoba ungase uzithole ungaphakathi kwesimo esizayo mayelana nokukhokhelwa kwakho ukuhamba emsebenzini. Bheka futhi unikeze ukuhamba emsebenzini njengoba uceliwe. Phenya futhi uhlole amacala athile afana nokusetshenziswa okungafanele kokuhamba emsebenzini okujwayelekile. Bese uthatha isinyathelo uma kudingeka. Umqashi angase, kwezinye izimo, acela isitifiketi sezokwelapha sokungabikhona okwesikhashana okungaphansi kwezinsuku ezintathu uma kutholakala ezinye izimo ezifanayo. Qondisa abasebenzi ngokusetshenziswa okufanele kokuhamba emsebenzini ngokuhlakanipha. Hlinzeka ngezidingo zomsebenzi noma funa umsebenzi omusha, ikakhulukazi ezimweni ezidinga lokhu. Ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezinsuku ezinganele kuyinzuzo ongayicela uma izinsuku zakho zokuhamba emsebenzini ziqediwe, okuyikhokhelo kwezi-3 zeminyaka zokuhamba emsebenzini. Cela usebenzisa amafomu wesicelo adingekayo. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi kufanele ucele usebenzisa amafomu abekiwe ukuze uthole ukuhamba emsebenzini okunganele ngokufanele. Awukwazi ukusetha ifomu le-Z1 ngalokhu. Uma wazi kusenesikhathi ukuthi uzodinga ukuhamba emsebenzini ukuze wenze inqubo ethile noma ungagula uma kufanele ube sebhulohweni, thumela isicelo bese uthumela ifomu lakho lesicelo kusenesikhathi. Nokho, uma uthola isifo ngokungazelelwe noma uthola ulaka, xhumana nomphathi wakho ngokushesha uma ungakwazi ukusebenza ngenxa yesifo noma ulaka. Umyalezo othunyelwe ngomlomo ngamalunga, ozakwethu, noma umngane wamukeleka kuphela uma uhlobo noma isimo sesifo/ulaka sithinta ukukwazi kwakho ukuveza kumphathi wakho. Ngaso sonke isikhathi thumela isitifiketi sokugula uma uceliwe. Ungathumela imibhalo esekelayo yezicelo zokwelashwa nolwazi nemibono eyengeziwe ehambisana nesicelo sakho sokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele. Gwema ukusebenzisa ukuhamba emsebenzini okunganele ngendlela engafanele. Lokhu kuyimenenja yeZempilo Nezokuphepha. ngemuva kosuku lokuqala lokungabikhona emsebenzini. Umqashi uzokunikeza ukuhamba emsebenzini okunganele ngokuya ngemiphumela yokuhlola mayelana nohlobo nesimo sokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele. Inqubomgomo nezinyathelo zokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele kanye nokuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yokuhamba kwezempilo yi-PILIR. Umqashi uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngemiphumela futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele ngokuya ngemiphumela. Lokhu kungaba umqashi wakho noma wena uqobo uqala ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezempilo uma kukhona ukungabaza ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukusebenza futhi. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke, ngokwesibonelo, ngemuva kokuhlaselwa kwemoto okukhulu. Uma ufaka isicelo sokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele kwesikhathi eside futhi uphenyo lomqashi lukhombisa ukuthi ngeke ukwazi ukusebenza futhi, bangase baphakamisela isicelo sakho sokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele ukuba kube isicelo sokuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezempilo. Ungacelwa ukuthi uqedele amafomu wesicelo acacile sokuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezempilo. Thumela izitifiketi zokugula nanoma yiziphi imibiko yezokwelapha nolwazi nesicelo. Izinyathelo ezingeziwe zokuhlola zingadingeka njengengxenye yokuhlola ukuze umqashi enze isinqumo esinembile mayelana nokuqhubeka kokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele noma okunye. Umqashi uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngemiphumela futhi athathe isinyathelo esifanele ngokuya ngemiphumela. Ngokwenzela ukuhamba emsebenzini okunganele, umqashi uzokwamukela kuphela izitifiketi ezikhishwe ngodokotela abhalisiwe kwiNhlangano Yezempilo YaseNingizimu Afrika futhi abanamalungelo okuxilonga nokwelapha iziguli. Isitifiketi sezokwelapha kufanele, ngovuma lwakho, sichaze uhlobo nobukhulu besifo/ulaka. Igama, ikheli, kanye nezifundo zodokotela. Lokhu kusho ukuthi udokotela uhlinzeka ngesitifiketi ngokuya ngemiphumela yokuhlola, noma ngenxa yolwazi olutholakele kumguli futhi lwamukelwa njengokwelashwa kwezokwelapha okusekela. Isikhathi esiphakanyisiwe sokuhamba emsebenzini kanye nosuku lokukhishwa kwesitifiketi sokugula. Isaziso sodokotela uma usebenzisa izitifiketi eziphrintiwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi, noma yiluphi ulwazi olungahlangene nomguli kumele lususwe. Umqashi ungabheka kuphela futhi aqale uphenyo lwesicelo sakho ngemuva kokuthi usuthumele ifomu lesicelo kanye nazo zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubuyela kudokotela wakho ukuze uqedele umbiko odingekayo oyingxenye yamafomu wesicelo. Ifomu lesicelo lingase libe yingozi ekufinyeleleni kwakho kokuhamba emsebenzini okunganele noma ukuhamba emsebenzini ngenxa yezempilo. Umqashi uzokunikeza isikhathi sokuphumula ngalokhu. Umqashi uzogcina amarekhodi ezikhathi ezinjalo ezisetshenziswe njengezikhathi zokuphumula kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku olunye. Lokhu kuzoboniswa kumarekhodi akho okuhamba emsebenzini. Kulindeleke ukuthi kulokhu uzogcwalisa irekhodi lesikhathi esingasetshenziswanga ukuze kuqoqwe amarekhodi. Ubufakazi bezimo ezinjalo kuzodingeka njengoba kudingeka. KuMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi, phatha ngaso sonke isikhathi noma yiluphi ulwazi mayelana nesimo sezempilo somsebenzi nganhlonipho nangokufihlekile.

Ukudla okudayiswa ezikhwameni zokudla ezibekwe ezindaweni zomphakathi kumele kube nenothi ngaphambi kokuthi kudayiswe, okukhombisa amagama ezinto zokudla, ngaphandle kwezimo lapho ilebula (igama lokudla) likhona emkhiqizweni wokudla uqobo. Uma umkhiqizo wokudla uthengiswa ngobuningi (ungabhalwanga), umphakeli kumele ube nelebula (igama lokudla) ngokuhambisana nomkhiqizo wokudla odayiswayo, futhi izinhlamvu zamagama kumele zibe nosayizi ofundekayo kumthengi. Izinhlobo ezithile zokudla zikhululekile ngokuphelele ekubhalweni (igama lakho). Noma iyiphi into yokuphuza ekhulumayo iphethwe nguMthetho Womkhiqizo Wokuphuza, 1989 (Umthetho No. 60 ka-1989). Ilebula (umbhalo) kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo linikeza ulwazi olubalulekile ngaleso sikhathi. Ngakho-ke, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo ezifanele zilandelwa, kukhona izidingo ezahlukene zomthetho eziphathelene nokubhalwa kokudla njengalezi: Ulwazi lokudla luyadingeka kuphela ezimweni lapho izinhlamvu zembhalo ziqoqa ndawonye futhi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ifomethi yombhalo ibhalwe kahle. Ilebula legama lomkhiqizo kumele libhalwe ngolimi olunye lwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Kumele ifundeke futhi ibonakale futhi akufanele ifihlwe nganoma yini eboniswe. Ukudla okuqukethe ama-additives, ama-preservatives, kanye nezinhlobo zokufaka imibala kumele kubhale igama le-additive, i-preservative, kanye negama le-colorant esetshenzisiwe. Uhlobo lweMonosodium Glutamate (oluyinhlobo yokwakhiwa ethuthukisa ukunambitheka kokudla) kumele lufakwe njengengxenye uma lukhona kunoma yimuphi umkhiqizo wokudla. Imikhiqizo yokudla equkethe ama-preservatives kanye nezinhlobo zokufaka imibala zeTartrazine kumele ibhale igama le-preservative noma i-colorant futhi uma kuziwa kuma-preservatives, igama elisebenzayo "i-preservative" kumele libonakale kanye nezinye izithako zokudla ezibhalwe ngohlobo lwazo. Uma umkhiqizo, nakuba uhlose ukusetshenziswa, ungase ube sengozini empilweni yomuntu, izimpawu ezifanele zokuxwayisa kumele zivele kumkhiqizo, isibonelo, emkhakheni one-pressure "umkhakha unengcindezi" kanye "gcinani phansi -50 degrees" noma "Ungawugobi noma uwushise ngemva kokusetshenziswa." Akukho okukhuluma ngempilo okungaqinisekiswa. Amagama "impilo" kanye "nenhlanzeko" akufanele afakwe kumalebula (incazelo yomkhiqizo) njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uqukethe izithako ezinikeza impilo. Uma kuziwa ekuphekeni okujwayelekile okuvela ezitshalweni, amagama "akwenzi umkhuhlane wezinhliziyo" azothathwa njengokukhuluma ngempilo okungafanele. Isitatimende esifana "siphakanyiswa odokotela" akufanele sisetshenziswe njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhiqizo waphakanyiswa nguchwepheshe wezempilo (udokotela). Imikhiqizo ephethwe ngokuqinile ngezinga lokushisa nokupholisa kumele ichaze izimo zokugcina. Kumele ibhale izindlela zokusetshenziswa, njengokuncibilikisa, ukufudumeza, ukupheka ukuze ukudla kube usable futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinga elifanele ligcinwa. Ukudla okunezinga eliphezulu lokuphuka kuboniswa elangeni elinokukhululwa kwezinga lokushisa eliphansi ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yakho yokuvikela ngokubulala noma yiziphi izidalwa eziphilayo ezikhona.

Yingakho sibona ukuthi lokhu kufanele kube yingxenye yomlando wesibhedlela. Lapho siqhathanisa ukuthi sasi kanjani ngaphambili nalesi sikhathi, kukhona umehluko omkhulu. Sikhule kakhulu futhi siqinisekile ukuthi sizophumelela kuze kube yilapho siba yisibhedlela esikhulu ezweni. Lokhu kuyifiso yethu esikhalela. Lokhu kuyisisho sethu nenhloso yethu yesikhathi esizayo. Imibala esiyisebenzisayo imele impilo, imishanguzo, nekusasa eliqhakazile. Abantu bethu, igumbi elikhipha liyiwo ophumelela. Umqondo wabo unikeze isibhedlela ukukhanya okukhulu. Izinto ezinjalo zibalulekile kakhulu ngoba lapho sithola khona ukuthi abasebenzi bathi kanjani futhi bazizwa kanjani, futhi ngisho nokusebenza ndawonye. Ukufunda ukusebenza njengethimba kuyakhuthazwa kakhulu. Lapho sabelana khona ngolwazi nezifiso mayelana nendawo yethu. Bheka thina, manje sesinophawu lwethu olwakhiwe. Le thokozo iyikho impela! Udokotela noma um nurse ngaphansi kwesibhedlela sizothumela Umphumulo, ngaleyo ndlela iziguli esibhedlela uma zingasetshenziswa. Sidinga ukubona ukuthi umuntu ocebisa umphakathi kufanele kube phakathi kwethu ngosizo angakunika. Ikliniki ngayinye ivakashelwa udokotela masonto onke. Ab nurse nodokotela eziklinikini kumele bahlale bebhalela kahle, ngakho sidinga ukwazi ukuthi umphathi ucabangani. Kukhona phakathi lapho uyazi. Sibone isidingo sokwakha imihlangano efana nale ukuze abaphathi bazi ukuthi abasebenzi bathi kanjani futhi bazwe imibuzo abasebenzi abanayo bese bephendula. Umhlangano wawuphumelele kakhulu! Kube nokudideka okuningi mayelana namagama wemithi, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini zakamuva, ikakhulukazi mayelana namagama ezinto ezisebenzayo kule mithi. Ngiyethemba ukuthi namuhla ngizokwenza kube sobala kubantu. Ngamanye amazwi, umkhiqizi wemithi nguwo ophawula le mithi ngamagama abawanikayo. Manje ngiyakholelwa ukuthi ungabona ukuhlukaniswa kwamagama ezinkampani ezikhiqiza imithi efanayo kodwa ibizwa ngegama elihlukile. Ngakho-ke, kufanele uqaphele ngezinguquko zamagama ngoba kuvame ukushintshwa ngababhalisi abahlukene. Kubalulekile ukwazi ngemithi oyisebenzisayo. Ukuba nesisindo esikhulu kakhulu uma uqhathaniswa nekhanda lakho kungaba yingozi kakhulu empilweni yakho, kukubeka engcupheni yezifo ezinzima ezifana nokukhuluphala, isifo sikashukela, nezifo zenhliziyo. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukwazi isisindo sakho ukuze ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngaphambi kokuthi uzisize. Odokotela bathanda ukusiza bonke abantu abakhuthazekile ukuba banakekele impilo yabo ngokwethula le program yokwehlisa isisindo. Bazohlola isisindo sakho, ukuphakama kwakho, bese bebona ukuthi isimo sakho sempilo sikhona noma uma ungase ube sengcupheni yokuthola lezi zifo ezishiwo ngaphambili ngokususelwa endleleni ophila ngayo. Uzothola inzuzo ngokuthola uhlu lwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla okufanele ulandele nokuthi ungawalahla kanjani isisindo uma kudingeka. Uzodingeka ubuye ngemva kokuvakasha kwakho kokuqala, bese kubonwa ukuthi kukhona yini umehluko. Le program izobanjwa kanye ngeviki, kuphela ngoMsombuluko. (Kubalulekile ukubhalisela kuqala). Kubukeka sengathi uyabona izinselelo zokwakhiwa lapha esibhedlela. Sizama ngakho konke okusemandleni ethu ukugcina isibhedlela sibukeka kahle. Kukho ihhovisi elisha eliqediwe ngoMashi, futhi manje selisebenza. Igumbi lokusebenza liphinde lilungiswe, futhi sithemba ukuthi lizobe selilungele ukusetshenziswa masinyane. Ngiyacela ukhumbule, ozakwethu, ukuthi emhlanganweni wabasebenzi sichaze ukuthi thina, njengabaphathi besibhedlela, asinaso isikhwama noma amandla okwakha izakhiwo zesibhedlela. Umnyango Wokwakha unomthwalo walolo msebenzi, hhayi thina siqu. Lo muntu kufanele aqhubeke efundisa abanye egumbini lakhe nasezithweni ezibhedlela ezinyangeni ezizayo. Inhloso yethu ukuhlela izinga lethu lokusiza libe phezulu. Ukubambisana kwethu kuzokhuthazwa kakhulu. Le mali iyasiza kakhulu emphakathini ngalesi sikhathi esiphila kuso. Kumele sizame ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakholelwe kubo futhi ukuthi akukho okungatholakali kumuntu uqobo. Abantu bangakwazi, kodwa uma bebhekene nezinkinga, bavame ukuphonsa ithemba bese befuna omunye ukwenza izinto zabo. Njengoba ngibona ukuthi umncintiswano wekwaya usondela, ngiye kubabukeli bebhayisikobho, futhi ngazizwa ngidinga ukubhala ngokucophelela ngomsindo wakho nowami njengomuntu ophathekayo ezindabeni ezihlobene nokukhuluma. Lokhu kuzosisiza hhayi kuphela abaculi kodwa bonke jikelele bazothola inzuzo, ikakhulukazi labo abakhuluma emphakathini nsuku zonke njengothisha, abapristi, abezombusazwe, abameli, njll. KUTHENI KUKHONA ESIHLANGENI NGENXA YOKUQHUMISA NOMA UKUKHULUMA Uma ujwayele ukuqhuba lapho ukhuluma, lapha esithweni sokukhuluma kuzonakele; kuphi umsindo wakho? Uma uqhuma lapha lapho umsindo wakho uvela khona, imisipha nezicubu zizokhathazeka, futhi lapho inkinga iqala khona. Uma ungakwazi ukukhipha lokhu, kungaba yingozi edala umonakalo omkhulu kumsindo wakho. KUNGANI NGINGAZIVIKELA Kukhona izindlela ongazisebenzisa uma ukhuluma endaweni enomsindo ngaphandle kokuphakamisa umsindo wakho? Sebenzisa izinkomba noma okuthile ukuze uthole ukunakwa. Othisha bangasebenzisa umoya opholile ukubiza izingane uma zidlala, noma baphakamise izandla ukuze babonise ukuthi baphinde babuyela ekilasini. Phakamisa umsindo ngemuva kwakho. Uma ukhuluma nomuntu, phakamisa ivolumu ye-radio noma ithelevishini uma ukhuluma nomuntu; zama ukusebenzisa into eyodwa ngesikhathi uma kunomsindo. Khuluma nomuntu okhulu njengokuthi ungene esikhundleni sakho bese ugcina ibanga elingama-3 kuya kwama-5 uma ukhuluma nomuntu. Funda ukulalela. Uma ubuza omunye ukuthi aphinde akhulume lokho akushilo, noma ukuthi lowo muntu uzophakamisa umsindo wakhe, ngaleyo ndlela bangase baphule umsindo wabo. Asikwazi期待 abantu ukwenza izinto zethu ngoba thina siphila njengabantu, noma ngabe ngiyazi isimo engikuso noma cha. Imicabango yethu isebenza njengabantu abangenavayirasi, futhi kwesinye isikhathi sithanda ukucabanga ngcono kunabo. Abantu abanavayirasi bangazithanda ukuze bagcine impilo yabo. Abangabheki nje ukwesekwa kwabanye uma sevele bakhombisile isimo sabo. Masixhase ozakwethu, sibathande, nabantu emindenini yethu abangenaso lesi sifo futhi sikholelwe kubo. Khuluma ngokuqonda. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa umthwalo kumsindo wakho futhi abanye bazolandela indlela okhuluma ngayo. Utshwala, ukuhamba, nezinye izinto zingadambisa isitho sokukhuluma, futhi sizisebenzisa emsebenzini nasemakhaya, futhi emithini ethile ingase iphinde ibe nomthelela omubi kumthondo wakho. KUFANELE NGIKWENZE NINI UMA NGINEZINKINGA ZOMSINDO Uma ubona ushintsho endleleni abanye nabanye babona ngayo umsindo wakho, mhlawumbe ushintsha ube mnyama, ufinyelela, noma ube mncane lapho uwukhiqiza, xhumana nodokotela. Umdokotela uzokuthumele kumkhakha ophathelene nokukhuluma nomthondo kuphela. Uma lokhu kushintsha kuqhubeka ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili noma ezintathu noma umsindo wakho uphaphama ngokushesha, xhumana nalabo abaphatha lezi zindaba. Ngesikhathi esithile lokhu kungalungiswa kalula, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi kungaba yinto ebaluleke kakhulu? Isiko lethu njengabantu abamnyama lidlala indima enkulu emicabangweni yethu. Uma ingane ikhuliswa ngalezi zinkolelo, ukuziphatha, nemigomo yomphakathi abakukhulisayo, lokhu kuyakha ukuziphatha komuntu nemicabango mayelana nokuphila. Uma owesifazane ekhuliswa efundiswa ukuthi owesifazane kufanele aziphathe ngendlela ethile, azithibe, futhi alalele lokho akukhuluma, noma angavumelani nakho, ngeke akhulume lokho; uzokugcina ngaphakathi. Manje uzibuze ukuthi yiziphi izinkantolo ezikhona eziboshwe ezinsukwini ezingama-20 zokubulala abashadile babo. Konke kuvela emvelweni yethu yamasiko, ukuthula nokuthula mayelana nezinto ezithile ezibaholele ekulimaleni isikhathi eside, futhi lokhu kuyakha ababulali. Iningi labesifazane abaphakathi kwezinkantolo bahluphekiwe isikhathi eside nangendlela eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuhlukunyezwa, ngokomzimba, ngokwengqondo, nangokwezimali ngabalingani babo. Umthetho uyazi lokhu. Bangakugwema lezi zimo, kodwa hhayi isikhathi eside. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi baphenduke benze okuthile abangakwazi ukukwenqaba, njengokubulala. Lokhu kubakhulula ekutheni ukuhlupheka kwabo sekuphelile. Bacela ukuba bashiye izingane zabo ukuze ziboshwe. Kuyamangalisa ukuthi lezi zihlukunyezwayo aziboni ukuthi zihlukunyezwa; zicabanga ukuthi amasiko ayasagcinwa, kodwa ngakolunye uhlangothi, zithola amandla okuhlala. Ngesikhathi ubuholi bezwe bukhishwa ngo-1994 ngaphansi kukaCyril Ramaphosa, amalungelo abesifazane ayebaluleke kakhulu. Sivumele ukuba bathathe amalungelo abo abangenamsindo isikhathi eside. Kumele manje sivuke sikhombise, sakhe ikusasa elisha labesifazane, noma sihloniphe amasiko ethu, kodwa akukho okukhuthaza ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane. Ngicela imibono, izindaba noma yiziphi, ofuna ukuba zishicilelwe ephephandabeni lethu. Ungesabi, noma uma ungafuni ukuveza igama lakho, lokho kulungile. Khumbula ukuthi senza kangcono ngalokho esinakho.
Le mhedi inikezwa kubantu bangaphandle (abaqondisi bezwe kanye nohulumeni) nabanye abantu abahloniphekile abavela phesheya. Inikezwa ngenxa yobudlelwano obukhonjiswe eNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho iyimhedi yokuthula, ukubambisana, kanye nesithombe sobunye nokwesekwa. Imhedi iyisithonjana esibalulekile sobudlelwano bamazwe. Ingxenye 3 = UThusi. Umajola (isicabucabu esincane) - Isicabucabu esivakashela izingane ezizalwayo. Asilimazi ingane noma amalungu omndeni, futhi indlela yokususa sona wukuthi umama wengane akhiphe ubisi lwebele. Sivakashela ingane ukuze siyilungiselele ikusasa eliqhakazile neliphephile ebuncaneni bayo. Siza njengomngane nomvikeli. Ubudlelwano obumele, obusekelwe ekuthandeni, busekelwe emoyeni wokubonisa ukwesekwa kanye nesifiso sokuphakamisa nokukhuthaza impumelelo yeqhawe labantu abasha kanye namalungu omphakathi okhula. Lesi sicabucabu bekusoloko singxenye yomlando wabantu ngenxa yesinganekwane esidumile esibhaliwe kudala esibizwa ngokuthi: Uthukuthelo Lwabokhokho, obhalwe ngu-AC Jordan. Le ndaba ibhidliza umqondo wokuthi isicabucabu yisilwane esiyingozi nesinobuthi, kodwa ibonisa umbono ophumelelayo we-Afrika, iqonda isicabucabu njengomngane kanye nelungu lezwe lemvelo okufanele liphile ndawonye. Istick yokuhamba - ehlotshiswe ngezithombe zendabuko ezimnyama, iyisithombe sokubonga ngokwesekwa nokubekezela okukhonjisiwe, futhi iphinde ibonise ukuzibophezela kokweseka nokuma nabantu abasisekelayo.
Le bhukwana lenzelwe njengomhlahlandlela wokuthi amalunga omphakathi angafinyelela kanjani ulwazi olugcinwe yi-GCIS. Ichaza ukuthi yikuphi ulwazi olukhona kule ndawo futhi ikutshela ukuthi ungafinyelela kanjani kulolo lwazi. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi, 2000, uthi inhlangano ngayinye kumele ibize uMphakathi Wokulawula Ulwazi kanye noMphakathi/Abaphakeli boMphakathi Wokulawula Ulwazi abazobhekana nezicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi futhi basize abaceli ekuthumeleni izicelo zabo. Umbono we-GCIS usiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuxhumana nolwazi lukamasipala nomphakathi, uqinisekisa impilo engcono kubantu bonke. Inhloso ye-GCIS ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa ekuxhumaneni kukamasipala futhi iqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uyazi ngokuqhuba kwezimali zalesi sikhungo. Izinhloso ezisemqoka ze-GCIS ukuqinisa uhlelo lokuxhumana kukamasipala nemisebenzi yalo ngezindlela ezithuthukisa ukuhlanganiswa okuqhubekayo kokuphathwa kwethu ngokwemfanelo futhi kubeke izwe endleleni yokukhula nokuthuthuka okuphezulu. Ukwakha isikhala sokuxhumana sokubambisana esihlinzeka ngolwazi olunombono ophelele mayelana nezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa jikelele. Ukuxhumana kukamasipala nokuxhumana kwezindaba kukhuthaza (G&ML) ukuxhumana nokusebenzisana kokuxhumana kukamasipala kuzo zonke izigaba, futhi kuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zobungcweti ekubambisaneni kwezindaba. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi izigaba, amaqembu, nezifunda zithuthukisa izinhlelo zazo zokuxhumana ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sokuxhumana sokuhlanganyela, kanti izindaba zomphakathi nezamazwe zithola ulwazi lukamasipala ngendlela efanele. I-P&LL isekela ukuhlinzekwa kokuxhumana kokuthuthukiswa futhi yandisa izakhiwo zolwazi lukamasipala ngokubambisana nohulumeni bezifunda nezendawo. Iphinde isize ekwakheni amaKhaya Ezenzo Amaphakathi ukuze kwenziwe izinsizakalo nolwazi lufinyeleleke kabanzi emphakathini, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahluphekayo. I-CSA ihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile zokuxhumana ku-GCIS nakwezinye izigaba zikamasipala, ngaphakathi nangokucela izinkampani zangaphandle ukuba zenze umsebenzi. Ikhiqiza futhi ihlukanisa ulwazi isebenzisa amapulatifomu nezindlela ezifanele ukufinyelela emphakathini ophakanyisiwe. Inezigaba ezintathu zomnyango: Ukuthuthukiswa Komkhiqizo; Ukuthuthukiswa Kokuqukethwe; kanye Nokumaketha, Ukukhangisa, Nokuhanjiswa. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, kanye Nokuxhaswa kudlula ekuphathweni kwezimali jikelele e-GCIS futhi kubheke ukuhambisana nomthetho wezezimali zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999). Umceli kumele akhombise ukuthi ufuna ikhophi yerekhodi noma ufuna ukuza ku-GCIS ukuyibona ehhovisi le-GCIS. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma irekhodi ingeyona idokhumenti yephepha, ingabukwa ngendlela eceliwe, lapho kungenzeka. C. Uma umceli efuna ukufinyelela ngendlela ethile (isb., ikhophi yephepha, ikhophi ye-elektroniki, njll.), kumele ihlinzekwe ngaleyo ndlela. Lokhu kungenziwa ngaphandle kokuthi kuzophazamiseka kakhulu ukusebenza kwenhlangano kahulumeni ethile, noma kubangele umonakalo ku-rekhodi, noma kuphule ilungelo lokushicilela elingelikaHulumeni. Uma, ngezizathu ezisebenzayo, ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngendlela ehlukile, imali kumele ibalwe ngokwezinga umceli aqale ayicela. Uma, ngaphezu kokuphendula okubhaliwe esicelweni sabo, umceli efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela, isb., ngefoni, lokhu kumele kukhombiswe. Uma umuntu ocela ulwazi enza lokhu egameni lomunye umuntu, kumele akhombise igunya aphakanyiswe ngalo. Uma um
Imininingwane yomuntu ofuna ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi kumele ibhalwe ngezansi. Nikeza ikheli kanye/noma inombolo ye-fax eNingizimu Afrika lapho ulwazi kufanele luthunyelwe khona. Ubufakazi besikhundla esithathwe kuso lesi sicelo, uma kusebenza, kumele kufakwe. Le ngxenye kumele igcwaliswe kuphela uma isicelo sithathwa egameni lomunye umuntu. Nikeza imininingwane ephelele ye-rekhodi ofuna ukufinyelela kuyo, kufaka phakathi inombolo yokubhekisela uma uyazi, ukuze irekhodi likhunjulwe lapho likhona. Uma kukhona isikhala esanele, sicela uqhubeke kwezinye amakhasi eduze futhi ufake lokhu kufomu. Umuntu ophakamisa isicelo kumele asayine wonke amakhasi engeziwe. Isicelo sokufinyelela kulolu lwazi, ngaphandle kwe-rekhodi equkethe ulwazi ngawe, sizophathwa kuphela uma imali yesicelo ikhokhiwe. Uzokwaziswa ngenani lemali elidingekayo ukukhokhwa njengezindleko zesicelo. Imali ekhokhwayo yokufinyelela kulolu lwazi incike ezimeni zokufinyelela ezidingekayo nasemalini efanele edingekayo ukuze kufundwe futhi kulungiswe irekhodi. Uma ungafaneleki ukuba nezinye izindleko, sicela uchaze isizathu. Uma uvimbekile ekufundeni, ukubona, noma ukuzwa irekhodi ezimeni zokufinyelela ezihlinzekwe ku-1 kuya ku-4 ngezansi, khombisa ukungakwazi kwakho futhi uchaze ngezimo ezithile lapho irekhodi lidingeka. Beka uphawu ebhokisini elifanele nge-X. IZAZISO: (a) Ukukhombisa kwakho izimo ezidingekayo zokufinyelela kulolu lwazi kuncike ezimeni lapho irekhodi litholakala khona. (b) Ukufinyelela ezimeni eziceliwe kungavinjwa kwezinye izimo. Kulokhu, uzokwaziswa uma ukufinyelela kuzokwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezihlukile. (c) Imali ethathwayo yokufinyelela kulolu lwazi, uma ikhona, izokwenziwa ngokwezimo zokufinyelela eziceliwe. Uma irekhodi liqukethe izithombe ezibonakalayo, lokhu kufaka phakathi izithombe, ama-slide, ukuqoshwa kwevidiyo, izithombe ezikhiqizwe ngamakompyutha, imidwebo, njll. Uma ucela ikhophi noma idokhumenti ye-rekhodi (ngaphezulu), ingabe ufuna ikhophi noma idokhumenti ithunyelwe kuwe? Ingabe kukhona imali yokuthumela? Qaphela ukuthi uma irekhodi ingatholakali ngolimi oluthandayo, ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngolimi lapho irekhodi litholakala khona. Uphi ulimi ofuna ukufinyelela ngalo irekhodi? Uzokwaziswa ngembhalo uma isicelo sakho sivunyiwe/siqedwe noma cha. Uma ungathanda ukwaziswa ngenye indlela, sicela uchaze ukuthi kanjani futhi unikeze noma yiziphi imininingwane edingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukuhambisana nesicelo sakho. Ungathanda ukwaziswa kanjani ngesinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho sokufinyelela kulolu lwazi?

Hamba kumxhumanisi osebenzayo. IBHOKISI LOKUPHIKISA - libekwe ezindaweni ezithile, sicela ulisebenzise ukuze ubhale iziphakamiso nezokwelashwa kwethu. Lapho sibheka lokhu, sigxila kumsebenzi wezinsizakalo kumakhasimende ngaphakathi nangaphandle komsebenzi. Lokhu kusiza ekusebenzisaneni kokusebenzisa izimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye. Lezi zimiso zisebenza njengophawu lokuthi amakhasimende ayaneliseka ngosizo abawatholayo noma ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kusadingeka. Konke lokhu kuyazama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhasimende ayazi futhi aqonde ukuthi angazisebenzisa ngokukhululeka amalungelo awo njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwezindlela ze-Batho Pele.
Thola ukudla okunempilo nezidingo zezempilo. Izidingo zokuphepha nezokuxhumana. Ukunakekela abasebenzi bezempilo. Ulwazi mayelana nokwelashwa nokunakekelwa ngendlela umntwana angayiqonda kalula uma kufanelekile. Ukuhlonipha ubuntu, ubumfihlo, ubumqoka, isithunzi, ukuphila okukholelwa, nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ngokuvuma komguli, ukuthola ulwazi ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokwelashwa komguli kusukela kuzihlobo zabo. Ukwelapha lokhu ngenhlonipho nangesithunzi ngokubheka izidingo zomoya nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ukuveza ukukhathazeka nokuthola izincazelo ngokuphuthumayo. Ukuqinisekiswa ngemicimbi engajwayelekile eyenzeka ngesikhathi umguli elashwa, njengokwehla embhedeni nokunye. Ilungelo lokungena ukuze ubone umguli ngezikhathi ezingezona ezokuvakasha uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sihamba kahle. Ukusekelwa kokomoya, nolwazi uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sihamba kahle. Ukusekelwa kokomoya, nolwazi lokuthi kuphi ukusiza okungatholakala ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwesibhedlela. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele mayelana nempilo yomguli nokwelashwa ngaleso sikhathi uma kudingeka. Ngemva kokukhishwa komguli esibhedlela, umndeni ubamba iqhaza, uqinisekisa ukuthi bathatha imithi, futhi babuyele ngendlela efanele ukuze baqhubeke nohlu lokwelashwa njengoba kuzohlelwa. Ukuhlonipha abanye abaguli, izivakashi, nabasebenzi besibhedlela. Ukuqonda ukuthi izidingo zabanye abaguli nemindeni zingase zibe ziphuthumayo kunezidingo zabo. Ukuqinisekisa nokuhlonipha izinsiza, imishini, nokuhambisana nemigomo. Ukuqinisekisa isibhedlela ngezinguquko kulwazi lomguli njengokuthi ikheli, inombolo yocingo, nezinye. Ukuhlinzeka ngemali yokwelashwa komguli njengoba kulindelekile.
Izilwane nezitshalo eziyingozi zingancishiswa ngokuhlanza. Ngokuwasha nokuhlunga: Hlanza izithelo nezitshalo uma kungenzeka ukuze unciphise uthuli, amabhaktheriya, nezibulala-zinambuzane. Phonsa phansi amaqabunga angaphandle ezithelo aneziqabunga. Hlanza amafutha enyama kanye nesikhumba sezinhlanzi ngoba ezinye izinsalela zezinambuzane nezinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalo ziqoqeka lapho nasemafutheni. Ukuhlunga kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi ezingase zibe zidle. Ukupheka kusiza: Ukupheka kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezinsalela zezinambuzane ekudleni ngokuhlanza nokuhlunga. Uhlobo lokudla: Dla uhlobo lokudla oluhlukahlukene oluvela emithonjeni ehlukene. Ezinye izinsalela zezinambuzane nezinto eziyingozi zisetshenziswa ezitshalweni ezithile. Ukudla uhlobo lokudla oluhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, kanye nezinye izinhlobo zokudla kuyindlela enempilo. Lokhu kuvikela ukudla ekubeni nezinto eziyingozi zohlobo oluthile noma izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi ezingase zibe khona. Inani lezinsalela zezinambuzane ezisetshenziswa ekudleni kanye nezinsalela zazo ezidingekayo ukuba zibe khona emikhiqizweni emakethe kulawulwa yizimiso ezahlukene futhi kulawulwa yiMnyango Wezempilo kanye neMnyango Wezolimo ngokwehlukana. Imikhiqizo eminingi yasekhaya iqukethe izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi. Amafungicides; izibulala-zinambuzane ezithile nezibulala-zinambuzane, njengokubulala izihlahla; kemikhakha ethile esetshenziswa emanzini okubhukuda. Izinsalela zezinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi ezihloselwe izinto eziphilayo, njengokukhiqizwa kwezinambuzane zokubulala izilwane noma izitshalo eziyingozi, ziyaqapheleka kakhulu futhi zivame ukuba ziphephile kunezinsalela zezinambuzane ezijwayelekile noma izitshalo eziyingozi. Izinsalela zezinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi ekudleni. Yini izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi? Izinsalela zezinambuzane, izinyoni, nezitshalo eziyingozi yizinto ezihloselwe ukuvikela, ukubulala, ukuheha, ukuvimbela, noma ukulawula noma yiziphi izinhlobo zezinambuzane ezilimazayo, kuhlanganise nezinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane ezingase zingabi khona ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza; ukuze zisetshenziswe ekuthumeleni; ukuze zisetshenziswe ekwabeleni nasekudleni; ukuze zisetshenziswe emikhiqizweni yezolimo; noma ukuze zisetshenziswe ekudleni kwezilwane noma noma yini enikezwa ezilwaneni ukuvimbela izinto eziyingozi ekungeni kwezinye izinto eziphilayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezinto ezihloselwe ukusetshenziswa njengokulawula ukukhula kwezilwane; njengokubulala amaqabunga; njengokuthambisa; njengokunciphisa izithelo noma njengokuvimbela ukukhula nezinye izinto ezisetshenziswa ezitshalweni ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuvuna ukuvikela umkhiqizo ekuphukeni ngesikhathi sokugcina noma sokuhamba. Yini izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi? Lokhu kuyinto ethile ekudleni; emikhiqizweni yezolimo noma ekudleni kwezilwane okuvela ekusetshenzisweni kwezinsalela zezinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi. Le misho iphinde ifake noma yiziphi izinto ezivela ezinsaleni zezinambuzane kanye nokungcoliswa kwezinto eziyingozi nokungcoliswa okucatshangwa ukuthi kubalulekile ocwaningweni lwezinto eziyingozi. Zingena kanjani izinsalela zezinambuzane, izinyoni, nezitshalo eziyingozi ekudleni? Kukho ukungabazeki kokubuyiselwa kokuhlola izinsalela zezinambuzane eziyingozi ezisetshenziswa ekukhiqizeni ukudla ukuthi lezi zinto zingahlala emikhiqizweni efana nezithelo nezitshalo ngisho nangemva kokucutshungulwa. Zisetshenziswa kanjani izinsalela zezinambuzane? Zisetshenziswa ngoba zinezinzuzo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo nasekudleni kwazo. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zinto, abalimi bangakhulisa imizamo yabo ezindaweni zokulima ngenkathi behlisa izindleko zokukhiqiza kumthengi. Ubudlelwano bokudla bunokuxhumana okuningi futhi buhlanganisa zonke izigaba zenqubo yokukhiqiza, kusukela ekusebenziseni izikhuthazi zemikhiqizo yezolimo nezinga eliphansi lokukhiqiza kuya ekusebenziseni lokho kudla. Ukudla kungaba umphakeli obalulekile wezinto ezibangela izifo, njengamazinyoni amancane abanga nezifo kanye nezinto ezibangela izifo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla kudinga ukuhlela nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bonke kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokunciphisa ubungozi obuhambisana nokudla. Ukuphepha kokudla kuqala kubahlinzeki bezikhuthazi zemikhiqizo yezolimo kubalimi nakubantu abathintekayo ekukhiqizeni ukudla, njengoba izinto ezifana nezinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi nezinto eziphilayo (ezokwelapha) zinezingozi ezahlukene, ngakho-ke kudinga ukunakwa okucophelela. Ukudla kwezilwane okuqukethe (okubangela) izifo, kuhlanganise namabhaktheriya nezinto eziyingozi, kungase kube nezingozi ezithile. Njengoba izinsalela zezinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi zinezinhloso eziningi, zingavulwa ngezindlela eziningi.
Wonke umuntu unomngane, ilunga lomndeni, noma isihlobo esiphila ne-HIV virus kanye nezinhlamvu zayo. Ukuze sikhombise uthando, ukunakekela, nokukhumbula, sikhanyisa amakhandlela ukuze bring ithemba ezimpilweni zabo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthemba uMdali ngoba Uyiqonda ukuqala kwethu nokuphela kwethu, kusho uMnu. Motsa ophuma emkhankasweni weSheshi eMzimvubu. Uphayini uMthethwa, ophatha ithimba elikhuthaza ukuqwashisa nge-HIV esifundazweni, uphumelele kulabo abanendlebe zokuzwa. Le nkqubo izovumela abashayeli bezimoto ezinkulu ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezempilo kalula, futhi kubonakala ukuthi izinsizakalo zezempilo zifika kubashayeli bezimoto ezinkulu. Iklinikhi yaqala ukusebenza ngoJuni 2006, ngenhloso eyinhloko yokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo kubashayeli bezimoto ezinkulu kanye nabalingani babo besilisa abaseduze. Cishe abagulayo abangu-40 bavakashela le klinikhi nsuku zonke. Lokhu kuyakhuthaza futhi kukhombisa ukuthi uMnyango Wezempilo uyaphumelela empini yokulwa ne-HIV kanye nezinhlamvu zayo, kanye nezifo ezihlobene. Kunzima kithi ukuya eklinikhi ejwayelekile ngoba izimoto zethu azivunyelwe. Le klinikhi izosisiza kakhulu ngoba sizofunda ukuthi singazithathela kanjani, futhi sithole ulwazi nge-HIV kanye nezinhlamvu zayo, kanye nezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi, bese sithumela le mininingwane kubalingani bethu esisebenza nabo futhi sihlekisa nabo, kusho uMnu. Unyaka ka-2004 usondela ekupheleni. Sonke siyazibuza ukuthi izinsuku, amasonto, nezinyanga zonyaka ziyephi! Isikhathi sishesha impela! Isizathu sokuthi sibuze konke lokhu kungenzeka ukuthi asizange senze konke esikufisayo ekuqaleni konyaka. Kube nezinhliziyo eziningi ezibuhlungu kubaningi bethu ngenxa yokungatholi izinga lokwenza umsebenzi wethu futhi labo abahlala ngaphakathi kungenzeka bangajabuli ngezinga lezimo zokuphila ababezinazo. Konke lokhu kunezimpempe ezinhle ngoba sikwazile ukuhlela nokuphuma nezinyathelo esingazithatha ukuze sithuthukise isimo. Konke lokhu kusiphakamisile kakhulu. Sibe nezindaba ezinhle zokushiya ozakwethu ngosuku lwalesi sikhathi, nalabo abashiya imindeni yabo, ngifisela nonke ukuthula. Ngakho ngalokhu, ngithi kuwo wonke amaqembu esibhedlela, umsebenzi wenu uyamangalisa, qhubekani njalo. Ngabe unyaka uphela sonke siphephile. Banikezwa izitifiketi zokwesekwa kwabo ngenyanga edlule. Bakhushuliwe ezikhundleni eziphezulu njengoba sishicilele ngenyanga edlule. Udokotela (ekhoneni lekhishi elingaphansi) umele bonke ab nurses nodokotela abaphezulu esinabo nalabo esithemba ukuthi sizoba nabo esikhathini esizayo. Ukhozi (ekhoneni lendawo yokulinda elingaphansi) umele amandla esibhedlela - lapho esibhedlela sifisa ukufinyelela khona - esibhedlela esincane nesithobekile esiya ezingeni elisha neliphezulu kakhulu. Okusele ukuthi le ndawo iyabantu baseZulu futhi sithokozisa ngamasiko ethu nezinkolelo zethu. Ukuqala kokholo olukhulu. Abantu abakha bangabakholelwa. Yingakho sibona kufanelekile ukuthi lokhu kufanele kube yingxenye yomlando wesibhedlela. Lapho siqhathanisa ukuthi sasiqhamuka kuphi ngaphambi nangalesi sikhathi, kube nehlukano olukhulu. Sikhule kakhulu futhi siqinisekile ukuthi sizophinde sikhule kuze kube yilapho siba yisibhedlela esikhulu ezweni. Lokhu kuyifiso yethu esiyifisayo. Lona umgomo wethu nezinhloso zethu zesikhathi esizayo. Imibala esiyisebenzisayo imele ukuphila, imithi, kanye nekusasa elikhanyayo. Abantu bethu, igumbi elikhiphayo yilona eliwina. Umqondo wabo unikeze isibhedlela ukukhanya okukhulu. Izinto ezifana nalezi zibaluleke kakhulu ngoba lapho sithola khona lokho abasebenzi abakukhuluma nokuthi bazizwa kanjani, futhi ngisho nokusebenza ndawonye. Ukufunda ukuhlela njengethimu kuyakhuthazwa kakhulu. Lapha sabelana ngolwazi nezifiso mayelana nesikhungo sethu. Bheka thina, manje sesinophawu lwethu olwakha. Le thokozi iyiyona! Udokotela noma um nurse ngaphansi kwesibhedlela sizothumela uUmphumulo, ngaleyo ndlela iziguli esibhedlela uma zingasetshenziswa. Sidinga ukubona ukuthi umuntu okhuthaza umphakathi kufanele abe phakathi kwethu ngosizo angakwenza. Ikliniki ngayinye ivakashelwa udokotela njalo ngesonto. Ab nurses nodokotela eziklinikini kufanele bahlale bebhalela kahle, ngakho sidinga ukwazi ukuthi umphathi ucabangani. Kukho phakathi lapho wazi khona. Sibone isidingo sokuhlela imihlangano enjengale ukuze abaphathi bazi ukuthi abasebenzi bakhuluma kanjani futhi bazwe imibuzo abasebenzi abanayo bese bephendula.
Kube nokudideka okuningi mayelana namagama wemithi, ikakhulukazi ezinsukwini zakamuva, ikakhulukazi mayelana namagama ezinto ezisebenza kule mithi. Ngiyethemba ukuthi namuhla ngizokwenza kube sobala lokhu kudideka kubantu. Ngamanye amazwi, umkhiqizi wemithi nguye ophakamisa igama lemithi ngalokho ayikhiphayo. Manje ngikholelwa ukuthi ungabona umehluko emagameni ezinkampani ezikhiqiza imithi efanayo kodwa eyibiza ngamagama ahlukene. Ngakho-ke, kufanele uqaphele izinguquko emagameni ngoba zivame ukushintshwa ngabakhiqizi abahlukene. Kubalulekile ukwazi ngemithi oyisebenzisayo. Ukuba nesisindo esikhulu kakhulu sokuphakama kwakho kungaba yingozi enkulu empilweni yakho, kukubeka engcupheni yezifo ezinzima ezifana nokukhuluphala, isifo sikashukela, kanye nesifo senhliziyo. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukwazi isisindo sakho ukuze ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ezidingekayo ngaphambi kokuthi uzisize. Odokotela bathanda ukusiza bonke abantu abakhuthazekile ukuba banakekele impilo yabo ngokwethula le phrojekthi yokwehlisa isisindo. Bazobheka isisindo sakho, ukuphakama kwakho, bese bebona ukuthi isimo sakho sempilo sikhona noma uma ungase ube sengcupheni yokuba nezifo ezishiwo ngenhla ngokuya ngendlela ophila ngayo. Uzothola inzuzo ngokuthola uhlu lwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla okufanele ulandele nokuthi ungawwehlisa kanjani isisindo uma kudingeka. Kuzodingeka ubuye ngemva kokuvakasha kwakho kokuqala, bese kubonakala uma kukhona umehluko. Le phrojekthi izophathwa kanye ngeviki, kuphela ngoMsombuluko. (Kubalulekile ukubhalisela kuqala). Obhala: T.C.
Kubukeka sengathi uyabona izinselelo ezikhona ngempahla yokwakha lapha esibhedlela. Sizama ngakho konke okusemandleni ethu ukugcina isibhedlela sibukeka kahle. Kunomnyango omusha owenziwe ngempela ngoMashi, futhi manje ususebenza. Igumbi lokusebenza liphinde lilungiswe, futhi sithemba ukuthi lizobe selilungele ukusetshenziswa masinyane. Sicela ukhumbule, bangani bethu, ukuthi emhlanganweni wezisebenzi sakhanyisa ukuthi thina, njengokuphathwa kwesibhedlela, asinaso isikhwama noma amandla okwakha impahla yesibhedlela. Umnyango Wokwakha unendaba nalokhu, hhayi thina siqu. Lo muntu kufanele aqhubeke efundisa abanye egumbini lakhe nasebantwini ezinyangeni ezizayo. Inhloso yethu ukuvuselela amazinga ethu okuphuma phezulu. Ukubambisana kwethu kuzobongwa kakhulu. Le mali iyasiza emphakathini ngalesi sikhathi esiphila kuso. Kumele sizame ukukhuthaza abantu ukuba bakholelwe kubo futhi ukuthi akukho okungafinyelelwa umuntu ngaphandle kokwenza. Abantu bangakwenza, kodwa uma bebhekene nezinkinga, bavame ukuphoxeka futhi bafune omunye umuntu ukuba enze izinto zabo. Njengoba ngibona ukuthi umncintiswano wekhorasi usondela, ngiye ngibavakashele eChapel bephakathi kokuzilolonga, futhi ngazizwa ngidinga ukubhala ngokucophelela ngomsindo wakho nowami njengomuntu ophathelene nezindaba ezihlobene nokukhuluma. Lokhu kuzosisiza hhayi kuphela abaculi kodwa wonke umuntu jikelele, ikakhulukazi labo abakhipha izwi emphakathini nsuku zonke njengezithunywa, abapristi, abezombusazwe, abameli, njll. KUTHENI KUKHONA EMPHUMENI NGENXA YOKUQHUMISA NOMA UKUKHULUMA Uma ujwayele ukuqhuba uma ukhuluma, lapha emaphumeleni kuzonakala; kuphi lapho umsindo wakho uvela khona? Uma uqhuma lapha lapho umsindo wakho uvela khona, imisipha nemithambo izobamba, futhi lapho kuqala khona inkinga. Uma ungakwazi ukukwenza lokhu, kungaba yingozi ethinta kakhulu umsindo wakho. KUNGANI NGINGAZIVIKELA Kukhona izindlela ongazisebenzisa uma ukhuluma endaweni enomsindo ngaphandle kokuphakamisa umsindo wakho? Sebenzisa izimpawu noma okuthile ukuze uthole ukunakwa. Othisha bangasebenzisa umphimbo ukuze babize izingane uma zidlala, noma bakhuphule izandla zabo ukuze babonise ukuthi baphinde babuyele ekilasini. Nciphisa umsindo ngemuva kwakho. Uma usekhaya, phakamisa ivolumu ye-radio noma ithelevishini uma ukhuluma nomuntu; zama ukusebenzisa into eyodwa ngesikhathi uma kunomsindo. Khuluma nomuntu osembonini efanayo nawe futhi ugcine ibanga elingama-3 kuya kwama-5 uma ukhuluma nomuntu. Funda ukulalela. Uma ubuza umuntu ukuthi aphinde akhulume okukhuluma, noma ukuthi lowo muntu uzophakamisa umsindo wakhe, ngaleyo ndlela bangase babangele umonakalo kumphimbo wabo. Asikwazi ukulindela abantu ukuthi benze izinto zethu ngoba thina siphinde sibe ngabantu, noma ngabe ngiyazi isimo engikuso noma cha. Imicabango yethu isebenza njengabantu abangenaso isifo, futhi kwesinye isikhathi sithanda ukucabanga ngcono kunabo. Abantu abane-virus bangakwazi ukuzinakekela ukuze bagcine impilo yabo. Abangasebenzi kuphela ekusekelweni kwabanye uma sebethole isimo sabo. Masisekele abangani bethu, sibathande, kanye nalabo emindenini yethu abangenayo i-virus futhi bakholelwe kubo. Khuluma ngothando. Lokhu kuzosisiza ukunciphisa umthwalo kumphimbo wakho futhi abanye bazolandela indlela okukhuluma ngayo. I-alcohol, ukuphuza, nezinto eziningi zingomisa umphimbo wakho, futhi sizisebenzisa emsebenzini nasemakhaya, futhi ezinye izidakamizwa zingase zibe nomthelela omubi kumphimbo wakho. KUFANELE NGIKWENZE NINI UMA NGINE-VOICE DISORDER Uma ubona ushintsho ekutheni abanye nabanye baziqonda kanjani umsindo wakho, mhlawumbe ushintsha ube nekhanda, ube nekhanda, noma ube thin uma ukhiqiza, xhumana nodokotela. Udokotela uzokuthumele kumuntu okhethekile ophathelene nokukhuluma kanye nomsindo kuphela. Uma lo shintsho uqhubeka ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili noma ezintathu noma umsindo wakho uphaphama ngokushesha, xhumana nalabo abaphathelene nalezi zindaba. Ngezinye izikhathi lokhu kungalungiswa kalula, kodwa kwesinye isikhathi kungaba into ebaluleke kakhulu? Isiko lethu njengabantu abamnyama lidlala indima enkulu emicabangweni yethu. Uma ingane ikhula ifundiswa lezi zinkolelo, izenzo, nemigomo yomphakathi ekhula nayo, lokhu kuyakha ukuziphatha komuntu nokucabanga ngempilo. Uma owesifazane ekhula efundiswa ukuthi owesifazane kufanele aziphathe ngendlela ethile, azithibe, futhi alalele lokho akukhuluma, noma angavumelani nakho, ngeke akwazi ukukhipha lokho; uzokugcina ngaphakathi kwakhe. Manje ubuze ukuthi yiziphi izinkantolo eziboshwa abesifazane abamnyama abathola izigwebo zeminyaka engamashumi amabili zokubulala abagibeli babo. Konke kuvela emvelweni yethu yamasiko, ukuthula nokuthula mayelana nezinto ezithinte abantu isikhathi eside, futhi lokhu okugcina kubenza babe ngababulali. Iningi labesifazane abaphakathi kwezinkantolo lidlulelwe isikhathi eside futhi ngezindlela eziningi, kuhlanganise nokweqisa, ngokomzimba, ngokomqondo, nangokwezimali ngabalingani babo. Umthetho uyazi lokhu. Bangakwazi ukuvikela lezi zehlakalo, kodwa hhayi isikhathi eside. Kuvame ukwenzeka ukuthi baphenduke benze okuthile abangakwenzi, njengokubulala. Lokhu kubakhulula ukuthi ekugcineni ukuhlupheka kwabo sekuphelile. Baphika ukuba bashiye izingane zabo ukuze baphoswe. Kuyamangaza ukuthi lezi zihlukunyezwayo aziboni ukuthi zihlukunyezwa; zicabanga ukuthi amasiko asaqhubeka, kodwa ngakolunye uhlangothi, zithola amandla okukhuthazela. Ngesikhathi ubuholi bezwe bukhishwa ngo-1994 ngaphansi kukaCyril Ramaphosa, amalungelo abesifazane ayewabhekwa kakhulu. Sivumele ukuba bathathe amalungelo abo labo abangenamphimbo isikhathi eside. Manje kumele siphakame futhi sibonise, sakhe ikusasa elisha labesifazane, noma sihloniphe amasiko ethu, kodwa akukho okukhuthaza ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane. Ngicela imibono, izindaba ezinhlobonhlobo, ofuna ukuba zishicilelwe ephephandabeni lethu. Ungesabi, noma uma ungafuni ukukhombisa igama lakho, kulungile. Khumbula ukuthi sikhuluma kahle ngalokho esinakho.
Le mhedi inikezwa kubantu bezwe langaphandle (abaqondisi bezwe kanye nohulumeni) nabanye abantu abahloniphekile abavela phesheya. Inikezwa ngenxa yobudlelwano obuboniswe eNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho iyimhedi yokuthula, ukubambisana, kanye nesithombe sobumbano nokwesekwa. Imhedi iyisithonjana esibalulekile sobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. Ingxenye 3 = I-Thusi. Umajola (isikhwama esincane) - Isikhwama esivakashela izingane ezizalwayo. Asilimazi ingane noma amalunga omndeni, futhi indlela yokuyisusa ukuthi umama wengane ayisiphakame ngobisi lwebele. Iza engane ukuze iyilungiselele ikusasa elikhanyayo neliphephile ebuncaneni bayo. Iza njengomngane nomvikeli. Ubungane obumele, obusekelwe ekuthandeni, busekelwe emoyeni wokukhombisa ukwesekwa kanye nenhloso yokuphakamisa nokukhuthaza impumelelo yesikhathi esizayo sabantu abasha kanye namalunga omphakathi okhulayo. Lesi sikhwama sibe yingxenye yomlando wabantu ngenxa yesikhathi esidumile esabhala kudala esibizwa ngokuthi: Uthukuthelo Lwabokhokho, obhalwe ngu-AC Jordan. Le ndaba iphikisa umqondo wokuthi isikhwama siyisidalwa esiyingozi nesinobuthi, kodwa ibonisa umbono ophambene we-Afrika, iqonda isikhwama njengomngane kanye nelunga lezwe lemvelo okufanele liphile ndawonye. Isixhumi sokuhamba - esihlotshiswe ngezimilo zendabuko ezimnyama, siyisithombe sokubonga ngokwesekwa nokubekezela okukhonjisiwe, futhi siphinde sikhombise ukuzibophezela ekusekeleni nasekuma nabantu abasisekelayo.
Le bhukwana lenzelwe njengesiqondiso sokuthi amalunga omphakathi angafinyelela kanjani ulwazi olugcinwe yi-GCIS. Ichaza ukuthi yisiphi ulwazi olukhona kule ndawo futhi ikutshela ukuthi ungafinyelela kanjani kulolo lwazi. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi, 2000, uthi yonke inhlangano kumele ibize uMphakathi Wokwazi nolwazi kanye noMphakathi Wokwazi ozokwenza izicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi futhi asize abaceli ekufakeni izicelo zabo. Umbono we-GCIS usiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuxhumana nolwazi lukamasipala nomphakathi, uqinisekisa ukuphila okungcono kubantu bonke. Inhloso ye-GCIS ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa ekuxhumaneni kukamasipala futhi iqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uyazi ngokuqhuba kwalolu phiko. Inhloso yesu ye-GCIS ukuqinisa uhlelo lokuxhumana kukamasipala nemisebenzi yalo ngezindlela ezithuthukisa ukuhlanganiswa okuqhubekayo kokuphathwa kwethu ngokwenkolo futhi ibeke izwe endleleni yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa okuphezulu. Ukwakha isakhiwo sokuxhumana ngokubambisana okukhombisa ulwazi olunombono ophelele mayelana nezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa jikelele. Ukuxhumana kukamasipala nobudlelwano bezindaba kukhuthaza (G&ML) ukuxhumana nokuxhumana kokuxhumana kukamasipala kuzo zonke izigaba, futhi kuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zobungcweti ekubambeni izindaba. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi iminyango, amaqoqo, nezifunda zithuthukisa amasu azo okuxhumana ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokuxhumana sikazwelonke, ngenkathi izindaba zendawo nezamazwe omhlaba zithola ulwazi lukamasipala ngendlela efanele. I-P&LL isekela ukuhlinzekwa kokuxhumana kokuthuthukiswa futhi yandisa izakhiwo zolwazi lukamasipala ngokubambisana nohulumeni bezifunda nezendawo. Iphinde isize ekwakheni Izikhungo Zesevisi ze-Thusong ukuze izinsizakalo nolwazi kube lula ukufinyelela umphakathi, ikakhulukazi abampofu. I-CSA ihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuxhumana ezibalulekile ku-GCIS nakwamanye amaminya kahulumeni, kokubili ngaphakathi nangokucela izinkampani zangaphandle ukuba zenze umsebenzi. Ikhiqiza futhi isabalalise ulwazi isebenzisa amapulatifomu nezindlela ezifanele ukuze ifinyelele umphakathi okukhuluma nawo. Inezindawo ezintathu ze-Directorate: Ukuthuthukiswa KweMikhiqizo; Ukuthuthukiswa Kokuqukethwe; kanye Nezokukhangisa, Ukukhangisa, kanye Nokwabiwa. Vuk'uzenzele igxile ekukhiqizeni iphephandaba likamasipala elikhululekile elikhombisa amathuba ezomnotho nezinye ezidalwe nguhulumeni wethu wenkolo nokuthi lezi zinsiza kufanele zifinyelelwe kanjani. Le ngxenye inezinhlelo ezincane ezilandelayo: Ukusekela Inethiwekhi neSiphakeli, Ukusekela Kwendawo kanye Nokuqeqeshwa, Ukuthuthukiswa Kwephrojekthi, kanye Nezidingo Zolwazi Olwakhiwe. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali, Ukuphathwa Kwezimpahla, kanye Nokusekela kudlula ekuphathweni kwezimali okujwayelekile ku-GCIS futhi kugadwe ukuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zomphakathi, 1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999). I-Directorate inezinhlelo ezincane ezilandelayo: Izinsizakalo Zokusekela, Ukuphathwa Kwezimpahla, Ihhovisi Lezabelomali, kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezimali.
