Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma irekodi ingeyona imibhalo, ingabukwa ngendlela eceliwe, lapho kungenzeka. C. Uma umceli ecela ukufinyelela ngendlela ethile (isb., ikhophi ephepheni, ikhophi ye-elektroniki, njll.), kumele ihlinzekwe ngaleyo ndlela. Lokhu kungafezeka ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka okungafanele ekusebenzeni kwenhlangano kahulumeni ethile, noma kubangele umonakalo kurekodi, noma kuphula ilungelo lokushicilela elingelona lelikamasipala. Uma, ngezizathu zokusebenza, ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngendlela ehlukile, imali kumele ibalwe ngokuhambisana nezindlela umceli azicelile ekuqaleni. Uma, ngaphezu kokuphendula okubhaliwe kwesicelo sabo sokufinyelela, umceli efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela, isb., ngocingo, lokhu kumele kukhombiswe. Uma umuntu ocela ulwazi enza lokhu egameni lomunye umuntu, kumele akhomb
Imininingwane yomuntu ofuna ukufinyelela kwi-rekhodi kumele ibhalwe ngezansi. Nikeza ikheli kanye/noma inombolo ye-fax eNingizimu Afrika lapho ulwazi kufanele luthunyelwe khona. Ubufakazi besikhundla esivela kuso isicelo, uma kunesidingo, kumele kufakwe. Le ngxenye kufanele igcwaliswe kuphela uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye umuntu. Nikeza imininingwane ephelele ye-rekhodi ofuna ukufinyelela kuyo, kuhlanganise nenombolo yokubhekisela uma uyazi, ukuze irekhodi itholakale lapho ikhona. Uma kukhona isikhala esanele, sicela uqhubeke kwelinye iphepha elilandelayo futhi ufake lelo phepha kufomu. Umuntu owenza isicelo kumele assinwe kuyo yonke imiqulu eyengeziwe. Isicelo sokufinyelela kwi-rekhodi, ngaphandle kwe-rekhodi equkethe ulwazi ngawe, sizophathwa kuphela ngemva kokukhokha imali yesicelo. Uzokwaziswa ngemali edingekayo ukukhokhwa njengezimali zesicelo. Imali ekhokhelwayo yokufinyelela kwi-rekhodi incike ezimweni zokufinyelela ezidingekayo kanye nesikhathi esifanele sokucwaninga nokulungiselela irekhodi. Uma ungafaneleki ukuba ne-waiver yezimali, sicela uchaze isizathu. Uma uvimbekile ekufundeni, ukubona, noma ukuzwa irekhodi ezimweni zokufinyelela ezihlinzekwe ku-1 kuya ku-4 ngezansi, khombisa ukungabi namandla kwakho futhi uchaze ngaphansi kwezimo ziphi irekhodi idingeka. Beka uphawu ebhokisini elifanele nge-X. IZAZISO: (a) Ukukhombisa kwakho izimo ezidingekayo zokufinyelela kwi-rekhodi kuncike ezimweni lapho irekhodi litholakala khona. (b) Ukufinyelela ezimweni eziceliwe kungavinjwa kwezinye izimo. Kulokhu, uzokwaziswa uma ukufinyelela kuzovunywa ngaphansi kwezimo ezihlukile. (c) Imali ekhokhwayo yokufinyelela kwi-rekhodi, uma ikhona, izokhombiswa ngokwezimo zokufinyelela eziceliwe. Uma irekhodi liqukethe izithombe ezibonakalayo, lokhu kufaka phakathi izithombe, ama-slide, ukuqoshwa kwevidiyo, izithombe ezenziwe ngekhompyutha, imidwebo, njll. Uma ucela ikhophi noma idokhumenti ye-rekhodi (ngaphezulu), ingabe ufuna ikhophi noma idokhumenti ithunyelwe kuwe? Ingabe kukhona imali yokuthumela? Qaphela ukuthi uma irekhodi ingatholakali ngolimi oluthandayo, ukufinyelela kungahlinzekwa ngolimi lapho irekhodi litholakala khona. Uphi ulimi ofuna ukufinyelela ngalo kwi-rekhodi? Uzokwaziswa ngombhalo ukuthi isicelo sakho sivunyelwe/siwenqabile noma cha. Uma ungathanda ukwaziswa ngenye indlela, sicela uchaze ukuthi kanjani futhi unikeze noma yiziphi imininingwane edingekayo ukuze sikwazi ukuhambisana nesicelo sakho. Ungathanda ukwaziswa kanjani ngesinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho sokufinyelela kulwazi?
Ukuhlinzeka umphakathi ngempilo esezingeni eliphezulu, umusa, nokubekezela esifundazweni sethu. Indawo ephephile nephilile. Ilungelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukufihla ngempela mayelana nesifo sakho. Ukunikeza imvume yokuhlola. Ukufinyelela embonini yesibili. Ukukhetha ukwelashwa kwezempilo. Ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa okuhle. Ukumangala/ukugxeka. Ukusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukwelashwa endaweni yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eqinisekisiwe. Ukwenqaba ukwelashwa. Ulwazi mayelana ne-inshurensi yezempilo. Ukwelapha abasebenzi bezempilo ngenhlonipho nokuthobeka. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile futhi ebalulekile yokwelashwa. Ukuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zokwelashwa. Ukubuza ngokuqashwa nezindlela zokukhokha. Ukuphatha kahle amarekhodi esibhedlela uma ekhona. Ukuvikela nokuphatha kahle indawo yesibhedlela. Ukusiza ekugcineni isibhedlela sicocekile. Izigameko eziphuthumayo nezibucayi - amahora angama-24. Abaguli abangangenisiwe - uMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu 08:00-16:00. Abaguli abaphakathi. Iklinikhi yokunakekelwa kokuqala. Ukuzibophezela ekuhlolweni kwegazi nasekufundiseni. Iklinikhi ye-HIV ne-AIDS. Ukwelashwa kwe-AIDS. Ukuvimbela ukudluliselwa kokukhulelwa. Iklinikhi yezingane. Iklinikhi yezempilo yengqondo. Endaweni yokulinda. Ukukhomba/pass. Ubufakazi bokuhlala obufana nebhili yensiza. Ubufakazi bemali engenayo. Imininingwane yakho ye-inshurensi yezempilo. Phatha ukukhomba/pass yakho. Susa zonke izinsimbi ezindala. Ungathwali imali, amakhadi ebhange, noma amafoni eselula. Uzodinga ukuvuma ukuhlinzwa eklinikhi noma lapho. Bhalisela encwadini yokugqoka yeziguli, uyigcine iphephile ehhovisi lokubhalisela iziguli. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi uthatha lezi zinto uma ushiya. Izinto zakho zibekwe ebhakedeni leziguli. Isibhedlela asikhokhi ngezinto ezilahlekile. Uma izinto zakho zibekwe esibhedlela zilahlekile ngenxa yomlilo noma ukuhweba, isibhedlela sizokhokha u-R50 noma ngaphansi. Ngesikhathi sokuvakasha, kuvunyelwe izivakashi ezigulini ezibucayi. Izingane zivunyelwe emva kwesikhathi sesine uma isiguli sibhujiswa kakhulu noma sizohlala isikhathi eside esibhedlela, ngemvume yom nurse ophethe. Ungaphalazi, sebenzisa izikhwama zokuphatha ezibekwe. Ungasebenzisi izikhwama ezinephepha elibomvu. Gcina indawo icocekile, sebenzisa. Abazali bazokwaziswa uma isiguli sikhululwa esibhedlela. Uma kukhululwa, iziqondiso zokukhokha zizochazwa. Izinto ezibekwe kufanele zisayineke, phatha i-pass yakho ukuze uzithole. Amalungu omndeni azokwaziswa nganoma yiziphi izinguquko eziphathelene nesiguli nokudluliselwa esibhedlela esinye. Phakathi kuka-10:00-22:00. Kuzonikezwa kuphela isimo esijwayelekile sesiguli. Izingubo zakho azivunyelwe. Labo abanemibuzo ngesiguli kufanele bahlele isikhathi sokubuza nodokotela noma un nurse ophethe. Izindawo zokulimala 10:30-15:30 - Izindawo ezigulayo 10:00. Kufanele unikeze un nurse inombolo yefoni yomndeni wakho noma yomakhelwane wakho. Izindawo zomphakathi zokwenza izingcingo. Ishopu itholakala esibhedlela. Abaguli kufanele bacela un nurse ophethe imvume yokuhamba bayoshophela. Abazali noma abapheki kufanele bahambisane nezinqubo zokwamukela izingane zesibhedlela. Abazali kuphela nabapheki bavunyelwe ukungena endaweni yezingane ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kokusabalalisa izifo. Ungashiyi imali, ama-chips, ijusi, noma ushokoledi nezingane. Odokotela bafika kusukela ngo-08:00-10:00. Uma uhlangabezana nezinkinga, wazisa un nurse ophethe endaweni yokugula noma kule ndawo noma umphakathi wezok complaint of available here. Ihhovisi litholakala enombolweni 1 ehhovisi lokubhalisela iziguli. Kusukela uMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-07:45 -16:00. Ngemva kwamahora noma ezinsukwini zokuphumula nezinsuku zeviki. Hamba kumphakathi osebenzayo. IBHOKISI LEZIPHUMO - libekwe ezindaweni ezithile, sicela ulisebenzise ukuze ubhale iziphakamiso nezokwelashwa kwethu. Lapho sibheka lokhu, sigxila kumasevisi amakhasimende ngaphakathi nangaphandle komsebenzi. Lokhu kusiza ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana ukufaka izimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye. Lezi zimiso zisebenza njengophawu lokuthi amakhasimende anelisekile ngosizo abawatholayo noma ukuthi kuthuthukiswa okusemthethweni. Konke lokhu kuyazama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhasimende ayazi futhi aqonde ukuthi angazisebenzisa ngokukhululeka amalungelo awo njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwezinsizakalo zeBatho Pele.
Thola ukudla okunempilo nezidingo zempilo. Izidingo zokuphepha nezokuxhumana. Ukunakekela abasebenzi bezempilo. Ulwazi ngempilo nokunakekelwa ngendlela umntwana angayiqonda kalula uma kufanelekile. Ukuhlonipha ubuntu, ubumfihlo, ukuthembeka, isithunzi, ukuphila ngokomoya, nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ngemvume yomguli, thola ulwazi ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokwelashwa komguli kusuka kuzihlobo zabo. Ukwelapha lokhu ngokuhlonipha nangokuthobeka ngokucabangela izidingo zomoya nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ukukhombisa ukukhathazeka nokuthola izincazelo ngokuphuthumayo. Ukuqonda ngezehlakalo ezingajwayelekile ezenzeka ngenkathi umguli elashwa, njengokwehla embhedeni nokunye. Ilungelo lokungena ukuze ubone umguli ngezikhathi ezingekho ezokuvakasha uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sikhulu. Ukusekelwa ngokomoya, nolwazi uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sikhulu. Ukusekelwa ngokomoya, nolwazi lokuthi ungathola kanjani usizo ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwesibhedlela. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele mayelana nempilo nokwelashwa komguli ngaleso sikhathi uma kudingeka. Ngemuva kokukhishwa komguli esibhedlela, umndeni ubandakanyeka, uqinisekisa ukuthi bathatha imithi, futhi babuyele ngendlela efanele ukuze baqhubeke nohlelo lokwelashwa njengoba kuzobe kuhlelwe. Ukuhlonipha abanye abaguli, izivakashi, nabasebenzi besibhedlela. Ukuqonda ukuthi izidingo zabanye abaguli nemindeni zingase zibe ziphuthumayo kunalezo zabo. Ukuqonda nokuhlonipha izinsiza, imishini, nokuhambisana nemithetho. Ukuqonda isibhedlela ngezinguquko kulwazi lomguli njengokuhamba, inombolo yocingo, nezinye. Ukuhlinzeka ngezimali zokwelashwa komguli njengoba kulindelekile.
Izilwane nezitshalo eziyingozi zingancishiswa ngokuhlanza. Ngokuwasha nokuhlanza: Hlanza izithelo nezitshalo uma kungenzeka ukuze unciphise uthuli, amabhaktheriya, nezibulala-zinambuzane. Phonsa ngaphandle amashidi angaphandle ezithelo aneziqhamo. Hlanza amafutha enhliziyo kanye nesikhumba sezinhlanzi nezinkukhu ngoba ezinye izinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nezinto eziyingozi ezivela ezitshalweni ziqoqwa lapho nasemafutheni. Ukuhlanza kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi ezingase zabe zidle. Ukupheka kusiza: Ukupheka kungasiza ekunciphiseni inani lezinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane kokudla ngokuhlanza nokuhlanza. Uhlanga lwezokudla: Dla uhlanga lwezokudla oluvela emithonjeni ehlukene. Ezinye zezibulala-zinambuzane nezinto eziyingozi zisetshenziselwa izitshalo ezithile. Ukudla uhlobo lokudla oluhlanganisa izithelo, imifino, kanye nezinye izinhlobo zokudla kuyindlela enempilo. Lokhu futhi kuvikela ukudla ekubeni nezinhlayiya eziyingozi zohlobo oluthile noma izinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi ezingase zibe khona. Inani lezibulala-zinambuzane ezisetshenziswa kokudla kanye nezinsalela zazo ezidinga ukuba zibe khona emikhiqizweni ezingeni lemakethe kulawulwa yimithetho ehlukene futhi kubhekwa yiMnyango Wezempilo kanye neMnyango Wezolimo ngokwehlukana. Imikhiqizo eminingi yasekhaya iqukethe izibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi. Amafungicides; izibulala-zinambuzane ezithile nezibulala-ziqhamo, njengezibulala-zinambuzane; kemikhali ethile esetshenziswa emanzini okubhukuda. Izibulala-zinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi ezibhekiswe ezilwaneni, njengezibulala-zinambuzane ezikhiqizwa ezilwaneni zokubulala izilwane noma izitshalo eziyingozi, ziya zaziwa kakhulu futhi zivame ukuba ziphephe kunezibulala-zinambuzane ezijwayelekile noma izitshalo eziyingozi. Izibulala-zinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi kokudla. Yini izinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi? Izibulala-zinambuzane, izinyoni, nezitshalo eziyingozi yizinto ezihloselwe ukuvikela, ukubulala, ukuheha, ukwehlisa, noma ukulawula noma yiziphi izinhlayiya eziyingozi, kuhlanganisa izinhlobo zezitshalo nezilwane ezingase zingadingeki ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza; ukuze zisetshenziswe ekuthumeleni; ukuze zabelwe nokulungiswa kokudla; ukuze zibe imikhiqizo yezolimo; noma ukuze zisetshenziswe njengokudla kwezilwane noma noma yini enikezwa ezilwaneni ukuvimbela izinto eziyingozi ekungeni kwezinye izinhlayiya. Lokhu futhi kuhlanganisa izinto ezihloselwe ukusetshenziswa njengokulawula ukukhula kwezilwane; njengokubulala amashidi; njengokuwomisa; njengokunciphisa izithelo noma njengokuvimbela ukukhula nezinye izinto ezisetshenziswa ezitshalweni ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuvuna ukuvikela umkhiqizo ekubeni ungathinteki ngesikhathi sokugcina noma sokuthutha. Yini izinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi? Lokhu kuyinto ethile kokudla; imikhiqizo yezolimo noma ukudla kwezilwane okuvela ekusetshenzisweni kwezibulala-zinambuzane noma izitshalo eziyingozi. Le misho iphinde ifake noma yiziphi izinto ezivela kuzinsalela zezibulala-zinambuzane nokungcoliswa kwezinto eziyingozi nokungcoliswa okucatshangelwa njengokubalulekile ocwaningweni lwezinto eziyingozi. Zingena kanjani izibulala-zinambuzane, izinyoni, nezitshalo eziyingozi kokudla? Kukhona ukucwaninga okungaqinisekisiwe okuhlola izibulala-zinambuzane eziyingozi ezisetshenziswa ekukhiqizeni kokudla ukuthi lezi zinto zingahlala emikhiqizweni efana nezithelo nezitshalo ngisho nangemva kokuba zisetshenziswe. Zisetshenziswa kanjani izibulala-zinambuzane? Zisetshenziswa ngoba zinezinzuzo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo nasekudleni kwazo. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zinto, abalimi bangakhulisa imizamo yabo emapulazini ngenkathi behlisa izindleko zokukhiqiza kumthengi. Ubudlelwano bokudla bunokuxhumana okuningi futhi buhlanganisa zonke izigaba zenqubo yokukhiqiza, kusukela ekusebenziseni izikhuthazi zemikhiqizo yezolimo nezinga eliphansi lokukhiqiza kuze kube sekusetshenzisweni kwalokho kudla. Ukudla kungaba umthwali obalulekile wezinto ezibangela izifo, njengezilwane ezincane ezibangela izifo nezinto eziyingozi zazo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla kudinga ukuhlela nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bonke nohulumeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokunciphisa ubungozi obuhambisana nokudla. Ukuphepha kokudla kuqala kubanikezeli bezikhuthazi zemikhiqizo yezolimo kubalimi nakubantu abathintekayo ekukhiqizeni kokudla, njengoba izinto ezifana nezibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi nezinto (ezokwelapha) ezilwaneni zinezinselelo ezahlukahlukene, ngakho kudinga ukunakwa okucophelela. Ukudla kwezilwane okuqukethe (okubangela) izifo, kuhlanganisa amabhaktheriya nezinto eziyingozi, kungase kube nezinselelo ezithile. Njengoba izibulala-zinambuzane nezitshalo eziyingozi zinezinhloso eziningi, zingavulwa ngezindlela eziningi.
Ithimba ngalinye linikezwa ngezithombe ukuze libheke bese livuma lokho abakubona. Umphakathi uhlukanisa izithombe ngezindlela ezintathu: "ezinhle," "ezimbi," kanye "neziqondile." Iziqondile - ukungaqiniseki ukuthi kuhle noma kubi. Le shadi iyasiza ngoba ivumela umphakathi ukuba uhlolisise, ahlaziye, futhi abheke isimo. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuqonda ukuthi izifo zidluliselwa kanjani kumuntu oyedwa komunye nokuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zokuvikela ezingavikela ukudluliswa kwezifo. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba xoxa ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zokuvikela ezilula ukuzisebenzisa. Inqubo yokuchaza ngokobulili: Le thuluzi isebenzisa izithombe ezintathu zabesifazane nabesilisa, kanye nabesifazane nabesilisa ndawonye. Izithombe zabesifazane zikhona ezisebenzini ezahlukene. Enye imfuneko uk counting beans. Le thuluzi ihlose ukuba abantu bazi ngobulili babo emphakathini. Bangabona ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga ababhekana nazo emihlanganweni yabo yezempilo futhi baphinde bacabange ukuthi lezi zinkinga zingavimbela kanjani ukuthuthukiswa kwabo. Kukhona izithombe eziyi-20-25 zezindlela ezahlukene zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza, njengokusebenzisa izihlahla ukuze kube nezindawo zokuhlambela ezisebenzisa amanzi kanye nokusebenzisa amanzi avela emifuleni ukuze kube nezitsha ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba abheke izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi avela emifuleni ukuze kube nezitsha ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba ibone izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza emphakathini. Ibhokisi lemibuzo: Le thuluzi isebenzisa ibhokisi elilodwa elinovuli ukuze umphakathi uthumele imibuzo yabo. Umphakathi unethuba lokubuza imibuzo ngendlela engabaphoqi ukuba bakhulume ngezinkinga zabo emphakathini. Lokhu kusiza umphakathi ukuba ubuze imibuzo ngendlela engabonakali, engabashiyi bephoxekile noma ibangele ukungqubuzana. Le thuluzi isebenzisa izithombe ezahlukene zezenzakalo ezedlule nezamanje ukuze ibonise umehluko phakathi kokuthile okuphukile nokuthile okuphucukile. Uhlelo lwe-PHAST lwakhiwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ushintsho lwezenzo oluqhubekayo mayelana nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela ezifanele zokulahla udoti. Lwakhiwe ukuze kube nokulahla udoti okufanele, ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile, kanye nempilo yemvelo, njengoba lokhu kwaziwa njengamanye wezinkinga ezihlobene nalokhu. Le ndlela isebenzisa izithombe ezivumela abantu ukuba babone ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza emphakathini ngendlela ebonakalayo. Le ndlela isebenzisa izindlela nezinto ezikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu, abesifazane, nabantwana. Ukuphakamisa ukuqwashisa, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza, nokulahla udoti ngendlela efanele. Ukuvumela abantu ukuba babhekane nezinkinga ezihlobene noshintsho lwezenzo. Ngokuhlola ulwazi lwabantu. Ukuhlola izimo abantu abahlala kuzo. Ngokubheka izimo ezingase zenzeke esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlaziya izinkinga ezingavimbela ushintsho. Ukulungiselela ushintsho. Ekugcineni, ukwenza ushintsho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokubambisana. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungaxazulula kanjani izinkinga. Ukuvumela abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ngokusekelwe kulwazi abanakho. Ukwamukela izindlela ezahlukene emphakathini ngokuqonda ukusabalala nokuvikela kwezifo. Ukubonakala kwezinkinga: Umphakathi uxoxa ngezinkinga zempilo ezikhona emphakathini. Ukuhlaziywa kwezinkinga Uma sibheka izinkinga, asicabangi ngesimo samanzi nokulahla udoti emphakathini kodwa siza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi umphakathi ushintsha uhambo lwawo lube ngcono ezindleleni zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Kubhekwa futhi ucwaningo lwezenzo zomphakathi futhi kubonwa ukuthi izifo ziwela kanjani. Ukuhlela izixazululo Ngesikhathi umphakathi uthole ukuthi kuphi inkinga, kufanele baphume nezindlela zokuvikela ukusabalala kwezifo. Ukukhethwa kwezindlela. Lapha umphakathi uveza izindlela ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza emphakathini futhi ukhethe izindlela ezinhle zokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza njengoba behlola izindlela ezinhle nezimbi. Ukuhlela ushintsho lwezenzo nezinsiza ezintsha. Lapha umphakathi uhlunga abantu ukuze bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ezinyathelweni ezizoletha ushintsho. Umphakathi uphinde ubheke ukuthi yini engase iphumelele emihlanganweni yabo. Lezi yizithombe eziyi-15 ezisetshenziswe ezinhlelweni ezimbili zikhombisa izindawo ezinezimfanelo ezahlukene. Umphakathi uhlukaniswe ngezigaba ezincane ukuze udale ithimba ngalinye elinikezwa ngezithombe ezikhuluma ngezindaba ezigcwele. Bese amaqembu axoxa ngezindaba zabo. Ngesikhathi usebenzisa le thuluzi, kunenjongo yokucwaninga ngezinkinga zomphakathi nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nalolo suku.
Bika ochwepheshe bezilwane mayelana nezilwane eziphatha ngendlela engajwayelekile, futhi kuthathwa ukuthi kunokhukhula. Abantu abathintekayo ekutholeni ukhukhula kufanele bavaccine ngaphambi kokungena kulezi zimo. Izikhungo zezempilo, odokotela, amaZikhungo Okulawulwa Kweziguli Nokuvikelwa (CDC), kanye nabahloli bezempilo kufanele baziwe ngokushesha. Abahloli bezempilo bahlola isimo, baphenya, futhi banikeze izeluleko (bacele). Abahloli bezempilo bahlanganyela nochwepheshe bezilwane emikhankasweni yokuvikela izilwane (eziphilayo) futhi bakhuthaze ukuqwashisa. Iqembu elibhekele ukhukhula liqinise ukufinyelela emphakathini. Isilwane esigulayo sithathwa sibe yisidumbu, bese sithathwa. Kumuntu ogulayo, umswakama uthathwa ukuze uhlole. Isilwane esithathwa ukuthi sinokhukhula siba ngaphakathi kokuhlala imihla eyishumi ukuze kubonakale ukuthi sishintsha yini. Uma sikhombisa izimpawu zokukhukhula, sithathwa sibe yisidumbu ukuze ubuchopho buphathwe. Uma umuntu owashwe uphathwa ngokushesha, ngeke agule noma afe. Umuntu owashwe akufanele washise indawo ewashwe ngamanzi kanye nomuthi opholisayo imizuzu emihlanu ngaphambi kokuhamba esibhedlela. Hamba esibhedlela esiseduzane. Udokotela noma um nurse uzosungula uhlelo lokuvikela ukhukhula, oluhilela ukubulala i-virus yokukhukhula emzimbeni. Kubalulekile ukulandela zonke izilinganiso kuze kube sekupheleni. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi, xhumana nez authorities zezempilo noma isikhungo sezempilo. Uhlobo lokukhukhula luyisifo esithathelwana esibangelwa yi-virus (germ) esinazo izilwane. Lesi sifo sithathelwana kusuka esilwaneni esinombono ne-gazi elishisayo siye kwenye. Uhlobo lokukhukhula luvela ezilwaneni ezifana nezinja, amahlosi, amakati, izinyoni, kanye nezinyoka. I-virus itholakala emswakamswakama lapho lesi sifo siqala. Umswakama onale virus ungene kumuntu ngokuqhanyelwa noma ngokuqhumisa, inqobo nje uma isikhumba sishabalele. Le germ ihamba ngezinzwa kuze kufike ebuchosheni. Izilwane eziphukile ezinekhukhula zingaba yingozi uma ziphathwa, zithinte ubuchopho, umswakama, noma uma zicutshwa ngensimbi. Qaphela ukuthi ukhukhula uthinta izinhliziyo nezimo zengqondo, kubonakala njengokuphatha izilwane ngendlela engajwayelekile. Izinguquko zokuziphatha (ukuhlukumeza), ukuwasha noma yini, ukungaphumuli, ukwesaba, umswakama omningi, ukuhlasela okungazelelwe, ukuzilimaza, ukuqubuka, nokufa kungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlasela, amehlo avulekile, ukudideka, ukwenza sounds ezihlukile, ukungawuqondi umnikazi, ukuhlasela okungazelelwe, ukuqubuka, nokufa kungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlasela izinto ezingaphili kanye nabantu, ukuhlala ezikhaleni, umswakama, ukuwasha, umswakama omningi, kanye namahlo avulekile kungase kwenzeke. Umsebenzi omningi, ukukhala okukhulu, ukuhlasela, ukuhamba okungadingekile, nokugaya amazinyo kungase kwenzeke. Baphenduka bangesabi abantu, bengena ezindlini nasemafamu, behlasela abantu nezilwane ngaphandle kwesixwayiso, futhi befa ngokuzumayo. Kuthatha amasonto amabili kuya kumasonto ayishumi noma ngaphezulu ukuze umuntu owashwe yisilwane esinekhukhula akhombise izimpawu zokukhukhula ezibangelwa yiso. Izimpawu zokuqala: umkhuhlane, ikhanda, ukukhathazeka, ukuqunjelwa, ukwesaba amanzi, ubuhlungu bempumulo, ukulahlekelwa yisifiso, ukuphazamiseka, ukungaphumuli, ukuqubuka, bese kuba nokufa. Imigomo iphephile; ayenzi izilwane zakho zibe nogu. Ungathinti noma ungasondeli esilwaneni ongasisazi, noma esibonakala singenamuntu, futhi ungakwenzi ukudlwengula.
Kukhishwe nguMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo weZizwe Ezihlangene. Pheka ukudla okwemvelo noma okukhuliswe kahle emasimini. Ukudla kwemvelo njengokudla kwenhlanzi, izithelo, nezitshalo nakho kung carrying i-cholera virus, kodwa le virus ingafa uma ukudla kuphikwa, ngakho qiniseka ukuthi awudli ukudla okungaphekiwe, futhi kufanele uhlanze izandla zakho ngemva kokudla. Uma ukudla kuphakathi, i-virus iyakhula. Ngakho, dlani ukudla okushisayo noma kuphinde kuphikiswe ngemva kokudla. Gwema ukuxhumana phakathi kokudla kwemvelo nokudla okukhishiwe. Ukudla okuphekiwe okuphephile nakho kung carrying i-cholera virus ngenxa yokuxhumana okuncane nokudla kwemvelo. Lokhu kuxhumana kungenzeka uma usika inhlanzi engaphekiwe ngenkathi usika ukudla okukhishiwe ngaphandle kokuhlanzisa izandla zakho. Ezindaweni ezithintekile yi-cholera, ukudla okufana nezithelo nezitshalo akuphephile ngaphandle kokupheka, njalonjalo. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokuqala ukupheka ukudla nangaphambi kwanoma yiziphi iziphazamiso, njengokushintsha noma ukugeza ingane, ukusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Hlanza izandla zakho futhi ngemva kokuphothula ukupheka ukudla okufana nenhlanzi nezitshalo ngemva kokuthinta ezinye izidlo. Indawo lapho upheka khona kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile; cabanga ukudla okungeke kudliwe noma indawo engahlanzekile njengoba ikhipha i-virus. I-cloth yokuhlanza izitsha kufanele ishintshwe nsuku zonke noma iphume emanzini emva kokusetshenziswa. Hlukanisa i-cloth yokuphuza okufanele futhi ihlanziswe njalo. Ukusebenzisa amanzi aphephile ukupheka kubalulekile njengokuwasebenzisa ukuphuza. Phika amanzi ngemva kokupheka ukudla kwengane. I-bleach noma i-iodine ingasetshenziswa esikhundleni samanzi aphekiwe. Faka isipuni esisodwa se-bleach noma i-iodine kumalitha angama-25 wamanzi, bese ulinda amahora amabili noma ubusuku obuphelele ngemva kokuyisebenzisa. II. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe ukudla okuphakela kuphephile? Pheka kahle zonke izidlo ezifana nezinkukhu, inhlanzi, nezitshalo. Dla ukudla okukhishiwe ngenkathi kusemva. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokupheka ukudla. Hlanza izitsha ngamanzi nesepha. Hlanza indawo lapho usika khona inhlanzi nezitshalo, njalonjalo, ngamanzi nesepha. Dla izithelo ezisikiwe ezifana nezorhwe noma amabanana. Gcina ihlanzekile - pheka, hlanza, nezinye izinto ukuze umise! Pheka ukudla kwakho. Phika ukudla kwakho. Hlanza ukudla kwakho. Ingabe amanzi akho aphekiwe noma aphephile? Ingabe amanzi akho agcinwe endaweni ephephile? Amanzi ahlanzekile ang carrying i-virus uma engagcinwanga endaweni ephephile. Gcina amanzi endaweni ehlelekile enevulandi. Sebenzisa amanzi agciniwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-24. Thela amanzi ebhodweni noma sebenzisa ikomishi ukuyiphakela. Gcina ihlanzekile - gcina amanzi akho ephephile. VI. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe uhlanza izandla zakho? Ukungcola okuningi ezandleni zakho kungakwenza uthole i-cholera ngaphandle kokwazi? Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ukugeza ingane. Ngemva kokupheka ukudla. Ngemva kokudla. Ngemva kokunikeza ingane yakho ukudla. Yini indlela engcono yokuhlanzisa izandla zakho? Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa isipele. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile. Hlanza izandla zakho njalo ngemva nangaphambi, phakathi kwezitho zakho, nasemanzini aphansi. Gcina ihlanzekile - hlanzisa izandla zakho? VII. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe usebenzisa indlu yangasese? Umuntu ohlanzekile angathola i-cholera esikhathini. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa indlu yangasese? Phuma udoti lwezingane endaweni yangasese noma ulifake phansi. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nesepha ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina ihlanzekile - sebenzisa indlu yangasese. Phuza amanzi avela emthonjeni ophephile noma ovikelekile. Pheka ukudla noma kuphinde kuphikiswe, bese kudliwa ngenkathi kusemva. Hlanza izandla zakho ngaphambi kokuthinta udoti noma ukuhamba, ngemva kokupheka ukudla. I-cholera ngeke ikubulale uma iphathwa kahle. Phuthuma isiguli esigulayo esikhungweni sezempilo ukuze sithole ukwelashwa. Phuza isiguli ngamanzi.
Unyaka ungaphezu kweminyaka eyisithupha. Bafaka umuthi emzimbeni wonke kusukela emathangeni kuya ezindleleni. Linda umuthi owomile. Shiya umuthi emzimbeni usuku oluphelele (24 amahora) bese uwageza ngemuva kwalolo suku. Phinda ngosuku olulandelayo. Kubantwana abangaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha, landela inqubo efanayo njengokwenziwa kwabantu abadala. Kungase kudingeke ukuphinda ngemuva kwesonto, qhubeka usebenzisa umuthi. Omisa elangeni. Geza umzimba ngamanzi afudumele nesepha, uqhubeke ugeza izindawo ezithintekayo ngombhoxo noma ithawula lokugeza. Hlanza indawo ethintekayo ngendwangu bese uyomisa ngethawula elihlanzekile. Umuzi wonke kumele uhlanzwe ngempahla yokuhlambulula. Ukutheleleka kuhanjiswa kakhulu ngenxa yokuntuleka kokuhlanzeka, ukugcina umuntu ehlanzekile kuzovikela ezilimazweni, ngakho-ke geza umzimba njalo, futhi ugcine izingubo nemibhaco ihlanzekile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Noma ngabe ukudla kuphisiwe, izivakashi kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi kuphisiwe kahle futhi kusemisha. Ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka, izinhlanzi ezahlukene nezilwane zasemanzini zingaba ne-toxins eziyingozi ezingathinta impilo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziphisiwe kahle. Kumele kufunwe iseluleko ezikhungweni zezempilo zendawo mayelana nalezi zilwane eziyingozi. Ngaphandle kokuthi, ukubukeka kokudla akukhombisi ukuphepha kwako, futhi ukudla okune-toxin kungaba mnandi. Uma kukhona indlela yokugwema ukudla okungaphephile, izinga elincane lokudla linganciphisa ingozi yokuphefumula. Izivakashi zingakhetha ukuphuthelwa ukudla. ENingizimu Afrika, amanzi e-tap ngokuvamile aphephile ukuphuza. Nokho, uma othile evakashela ezindaweni zasemaphandleni isikhathi eside, kubalulekile ukuthwala amanzi abotshiwe ezitsheni ezivaliwe. Amathablethi okucwenga amanzi atholakala ezitolo zokwelapha futhi kumele asetshenziswe ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo. Uma amanzi engase abe nezinhlayiya, izivakashi kufanele zixwayiswe ukuthi noma amanzi abotshiwe kumele abhekwane njengokungcolile futhi angasetshenziswanga ukuphuza. Gwema ukuxhumana kwezocansi nabanye abangabalingani abajwayelekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba. I-virus ye-HIV iyinkinga enkulu njengamanje ngenxa yesikhathi esihlala egazini, okuholela ekudlulisweni okungathandeki nemiphumela yayo eyingozi. Izivakashi zikhuthazwa ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezikhwama zokuvikela ngaphambi kokuhamba uma kudingeka. Uma ukuvaccine kudingeka, izivakashi kufanele zizamile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-vaccine nemithi kuvela ezipakisheni ezivaliwe zemithi ezihlanzekile. Abanokukhuluphala kufanele bathwale izikhali ezihlanzekile (ezihlanzekile) ngesikhathi sokuhamba futhi babe ne-authorization kadokotela yokuzisebenzisa. Ukuhlanzwa kwegazi kwenziwa ngokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika futhi akubeki ingozi ezivakashi. Akudingeki ukugcizelela izinguquko zokuziphatha nezinyathelo zokuphepha. Ukusebenzisa isikhwama sokuvikela kuyindlela enye yokuzivikela. I-malaria ingenye yezifo ezivamile ezibangelwa yiphilisi edluliselwa kumuntu ngomuntu ngokugwaza kwesikhukhukazi sohlobo lwe-Aedes Aegypti, oluhamba ne-malaria. Nakuba kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi ukudluliswa kwe-malaria kwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika, isikhukhukazi esithwala lesi sifo sitholakala lapha. I-malaria ibonakala e-Afrika eningizimu-ntshonalanga, emaphakathi, nasempumalanga naseNingizimu Melika. Ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi yokutheleleka ngalolu sifo, izivakashi kufanele zibe nenhlonipho kakhulu ngalokho abakudlayo nakokho abakuphuza. Izivakashi zikhuthazwa ukuba zigweme ukuphuza amanzi angalungiswanga. Amanzi agcinwe ezitsha abotshiwe ayanconywa. I-blood flukes itholakala emhlabeni wonke futhi ibangelwa yizinyoka ezidla igazi labantu, impilo yazo iyinkimbinkimbi futhi ihlanganisa ezinye izinhlobo zezilwane zasemanzini ezibamba. Lezi zikhumbuzo zithola ukutheleleka ngalolu parasite ngenkathi umchamo nezinkanyezi zabantu abatholekile kulezi zinyoka zenza amanzi ahlanzekile angcoliswe. Lezi zikhumbuzo ezithintekile ngalolu parasite zenza ama-larvae amancane ahamba kalula futhi angangena emzimbeni ongekho evikelekile (ovulekile) womuntu emanzini angashisayo. Gcina indlu yangasese ihlanzekile. Phuma udoti lwezingane endlini yangasese noma uwubulale. Geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi ahlanzekile ngemva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina indlu yangasese ihlanzekile. Ngokuthatha amasampula kule ndawo okukholelwa ukuthi kunezifo, kungaba ukudla, amanzi, noma umoya, kungahlolwa elabhorethri. Khuthaza umphakathi ukuthi usebenzise izindlu zangasese. Dala uhlelo lwamanzi ahlanzekile lwesikhashana kuze kube yisikhathi lapho abantu bezoba namanzi okusebenzisa njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi udoti uphume endaweni efanele. Khumbula ukuthi amanzi angcolile yindawo evamile lapho kutholakala khona iTyphoid. Ekugcineni, iTyphoid iyisifo esingavinjwa. Uma umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhambisana nezixwayiso ezishiwo ngenhla, lesi sifo singavinjwa. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi lezi zifo azikwazi ukubonwa ngamehlo alula. Ngakho-ke, uma ubona izandla zakho zingcolile, akusho ukuthi uphephile; noma zibonakala zihlanzekile, kufanele uzigeze ngaphambi kokuthinta ukudla. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kufanele baqaphele kakhulu. Lezi zindawo zivame ukungabi namanzi ahlanzekile nezindlu zangasese. Le miphumela ikhulisa ukusabalala kwesifo. Uma umuntu eba nekhanda, ubuhlungu besisu, efuna ukuhamba, noma enezinkinga zokugaya, kufanele asheshiswe aye kudokotela noma esibhedlela. Khumbula, impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Lesi sifo sikhonjwa yisifo esibizwa ngokuthi iSalmonella typhi futhi sitholakala ngokuphuza amanzi, ubisi, noma ukudla okungcolile ngalesi sifo seSalmonella. Phosa noma uhlunge amanzi owaphuzayo. Geza izandla zakho. Izindlela zokulungisa ukudla. Ukupheka kahle kubulala iTyphoid; pheka inyama, inhlanzi, nezithelo ngaphambi kokudla. Ukuhlanza kuvimba iTyphoid - geza izandla zakho ngaphambi kokulungisa ukudla. Hlanza izitsha zakho ngensipho namanzi. Geza izithelo nemifino edliwayo ingashisiwe. Ukudla izithelo ezihlanzekile, ezifana namagilebhisi namabanana, kuvikela iTyphoid. Gcina ihlanzekile futhi upheke noma uyigeze. Amathilidi angama-25 wamanzi. Vala usuku lonke bese uphuza ngosuku olulandelayo. Ingabe amanzi owaphuzayo agcinwe endaweni efanele? Amanzi ahlanzekile angaba nezifo uma engagcinwanga kahle. Gcina amanzi owaphuzayo ezitsheni ezihlanzekile ezinomlomo omncane noma ezivaliwe. Sebenzisa isitsha esinokubamba sokuphosa. Kungase kube ezandleni zakho ngaphandle kokubona ngaphambi kokudla noma ukudla izingane zakho. Yini indlela efanele yokugeza izandla zakho? Njalo sebenzisa insipho. Sebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile anele. Geza izandla zakho yonke indawo naphakathi kwezithupha nezinzipho.
Mhlonishwa Ilunga yePhalamende, uDkt. S.C. Ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukuba yingxenye yomphakathi owakha iMuziwabantu Municipality, engxenye ye-uGu municipality, kulolu suku oluyhistorical olugubha omunye wemigqa ebalulekile yomsebenzi omuhle kahulumeni wethu wokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu. Njengoba siqala unyaka omusha, izifiso nezithemba zabantu abaningi ziwukuthi izimpilo zabo, inhlalakahle, nezimo zabo zomuntu siqu zithuthuke. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuvakashela kwethu kule ndawo ukuze sikhombise lezi zinhlelo ezimbili kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokufeza leli phupho. Simi lapha namuhla, sihlonipha ukuba yingxenye kahulumeni ophendula izidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphansi kukahulumeni ophoqayo, abantu basemaphandleni baphumelele ithemba lokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi bamukele njengokuthi bazophinde bahambe izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bathole amanzi ngezikhathi lapho futhi bedinga khona ukuze baphile izinkomo zabo. Abantu bethu basemaphandleni bamukele ukuthi izakhiwo zesimanje njengalesi sikhala esisha esakhiwe emphakathini waseCingweni kuyinto ethokozisayo. Uhulumeni wethu uqhubeka nokusebenza ngokungapheli ukuze alungise umonakalo owadalwa uhulumeni wobandlululo. Ukuthuthukiswa nezimo zokuphila ezingcono kubo bonke. Kule ndawo, u-84 percent wezizinda zihlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, kanti u-16 percent uhlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Njengoba ezinye izifunda zinezinsizakalo ezisemqoka, u-uGu unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsizakalo. Ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka emphakathini kubhekana nezinselelo ngenxa yokungafani phakathi kwezindawo zasemadolobheni nezasemaphandleni, kanye nokubambezeleka kwezinsizakalo okubangelwa ukuntuleka kwemali nezakhono. Ngalesi sizathu, ngonyaka ka-2000, i-uGu municipality, kanye nezinye izifunda ezintathu esifundazweni, okungukuthi, uMkhanyakude, uZululand, noMzimvubu, zabelwa uhulumeni njengezindawo ezamukelekayo zokuthuthukiswa okuhlangene okungaguquki. Lokhu kusho ukuthi lezi zindawo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngaphezulu kwezinsiza kunezinye izindawo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezisemqoka ezibhekene ne-uGu district municipality, ezinye zazo zihlobene namanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kanye nogesi. Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, u-74 percent wempilo ephelele ehlala kule ndawo, ikakhulukazi labo basemaphandleni, abanakho ugesi. Cishe ingxenye yesibili yabantu abahlala kule ndawo idinga amanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuphela u-50 percent wezizinda ezithola ukufinyelela kumanzi ahlanzekile kokupheka nokuphuza, kanti u-58 percent usadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanza. Imali ibekwe eceleni ukuze isize i-uGu District Municipality ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezihlobene nezomiso. E-Fodo, KwaMbotho, KwaShaweni, Dumisa, naseKwaJali. Le nqubo izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu baphinde bathole isithunzi sabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu bethu ngeke baphoqwe ukuba bahambe izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bathole amanzi. Le nqubo yamanzi esiyethulayo lapha namuhla izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu abatholi izifo ezihlobene nokuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le nqubo izokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emphakathini wendawo futhi ithuthukise amakhono. Njengohulumeni, sikhathazekile ngaso sonke isikhathi ngezindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile ngokushesha kanye nezakhiwo ezizothuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bethu. Emizamweni yethu yokubhekana nalezi zinkinga ezihlobene nokubambezeleka ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza, uhulumeni usungule indlela yokuxhasa ebizwa ngokuthi iMunicipal Infrastructure Grant. Sizosebenza ngokubambisana ne-municipality, siqinisekisa ukuthi iRand ngayinye ibalulekile emsebenzini eyenzelwa wona. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza ama-municipalities kulesi sifundazwe ukuba asebenze ndawonye,abelane ngemininingwane, futhi basebenzise indlela yokubambisana ukuze bafeze izidingo zomphakathi kahle. Umsebenzi owenziwe yi-uGu municipality ngonyaka ka-2004/2005 ubonisile ukuthi i-district municipality inekhono lokwenza ngcono ama-municipalities ayisebenzisayo. Ukuqaliswa kwesikhala esisha somphakathi eCingweni kuzohlanganiswa nezakhiwo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ama-MPCCs. Lokhu kusho ukuthi le ndawo ngeke isetshenziswe kuphela ezinhlelweni zomphakathi kodwa izosetshenziswa futhi ngeminye iminyango kahulumeni ukuze izinsizakalo zisondele kubantu. Kulesi sifundazwe, sizibophezele ukuba ne-MPCC kuzo zonke izifunda. Le njongo seyifeziwe, futhi lapha e-uGu, sesikhethiwe ama-MPCC eDududu naseBhomela. Ukuqaliswa kwama-MPCC kuyinxenye yezinjongo zikahulumeni zokuphelisa ubuphofu ngokuletha izinsizakalo eduze nomphakathi. Ngiyajabula futhi ukuzwa ukuthi kunezikhulu ezingama-52 zomphakathi ezithole izinzuzo emsebenzini nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwalesi sikhala. Ngizwe ukuthi izinhlelo zisesimweni sokuhlelwa phakathi kwe-uGu municipality neMuziwabantu ukuze kudluliselwe le ndawo ukusuka e-uGu iye eMuziwabantu; futhi izoxhunyaniswa nezinye iziminyango ezibalulekile ukuze le ndawo isetshenziswe nguhulumeni ukuze ilethe izinsizakalo kubantu empini yokulwa nobuphofu. Namuhla sibhiyozela imiphumela yomsebenzi wokubambisana. Ngokuvulwa kwalesi sikhala, siqinisekisa ukufezeka kwephupho lokuthi abantu bethu ngeke baphinde bahambe izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zabo ezisemqoka. Sizama ukulwa nomonakalo owadalwa ubuhlanga obuholele kulolu hlobo. Ngiyabiza bonke bethu njengamalunga omphakathi ukuba bathathe lesi sikhala njengempahla ebalulekile, futhi futhi banakekele kahle izakhiwo ezizoletha amanzi esizowasebenzisa. Thina lapha kule ndawo siyazi kahle ukuthi kuyini ukuntuleka kwamanzi. Ngakho-ke, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi lapho sinesi sikhala, asishiyi amanzi esiwashisayo. Asivumeli izingane ukuba zidlale ngezinsiza ezisemqoka. Kumele sigcine yonke i-drop yamanzi. Njengohulumeni, sizibophezele ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana ne-municipality ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zabantu bethu. Ngabe ukwethulwa kwalesi sikhala samanzi nokuvulwa kwalesi sikhala kube ukuqala kwesikhathi esikhanyayo nesithemba kubantu abakhe le municipality. Nakuba unyaka usanda kuqala, ngifisela unyaka omusha ogcwele izibusiso. Yinsiza ezimele esunguliwe ngemuva koMthetho Wokulungiswa Kwezinsizakalo, uMthetho inombolo 111 ka-1998, ophathwa nguJaji Ohlola. Izinjongo zabaJaji Ohlola ukuhlela ukuhlola iziboshwa ukuze uJaji Ohlola akwazi ukuveza umbiko ngokuqhuba iziboshwa eziboshwe nasemazingeni eziboshwa. Ithimba labahloli liqukethe amaqembu amane, abahloli abaphatha ukuhlola nokuhlola, iyunithi yezinsizakalo zomthetho ebhekene nezikhalazo zeziboshwa, iy
Akukho ingxenye yale mibhalo engaphindwa noma idluliselwe nganoma iyiphi enye indlela noma ifomu ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe efanele. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kumuntu ofisa ukuba uchwepheshe kwezomthetho futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukuze usebenzise le thuluzi ngempumelelo nangokwanelisayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu abe nolwazi lwamagama athile abalulekile asetshenziswa njalo ngababhalayo bezincwadi ezahlukene zomthetho mayelana noMthetho Wobufakazi. Inhloso yalolu suku iwukulungiselela nokufundisa abantu ukuze bakwazi ukuvuma nokujwayela la magama abalulekile asetshenziswa kuMthetho Wobufakazi futhi banikeze ulwazi olufushane oluwasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene noMthetho Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olukhulunywe phambi kwenkantolo ngenhloso yokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi inkantolo yenze isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi obubonakalayo buhlanganisa yonke imininingwane nezinto ezingasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. UMthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimfanelo kanye nomthetho wokuthi izimfanelo zethulwa kanjani ngokwethembeka. Izimfanelo zingethulwa kusetshenziswa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto ezibonakalayo. Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezigaba zomthetho; ubonisa ukuthi uMthetho Wobufakazi ufaka kuphi isigaba, incazelo kaMthetho Wobufakazi, kanye nokukhombisa ukuthi yini eyakha ubufakazi obubonakalayo nokuthi yini equkethe. Ukuphikisana okukhulunywe nguhulumeni nethimba lokuvikela akubufakazi kodwa kuyisithasiselo esiwusizo esikhuthaza isinqumo. Le mpikiswano yakhiwe ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihlosiwe ukugcizelela isimo somthetho noma izimfanelo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukuze kushintshwe ukuqonda kwenkantolo lapho kwenziwa isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi isinqumo sithathwe, izinhlangothi zinezikhathi zokwethula impikiswano yokugcina ephathelene nobufakazi obukhulunywe encazelweni eqhubekayo. Izimfanelo zecala yilezo ezethulwa yinqwaba ngenhloso yokufakazela icala labo. Izimfanelo zivame ukulethela ubufakazi noma ziwuphikise. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihilela ubudlelwano bobaba, isimo sobaba sizobe sikhulunywa, futhi ubudlelwano nobaba kuzoba yiphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobaba. Ubufakazi obuqinile buhlinzeka ngobufakazi obuqinile noma obungcono kunobufakazi obunye obukhona. Ubufakazi obuphindwe kabili buhlinzeka ngobufakazi obukhona noma obungase bavele. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ibhekwa njengobufakazi obuqinile, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti abhekwa njengobufakazi obuphindwe kabili. Igama elithi "prima facie," elihumusha ngokuthi "bufakazi obubonakala buqondile," lichaza ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe phambi kwenkantolo bufanele ukusungula isimo noma icala ngaphandle kokuba kube nobufakazi obuphikisanayo. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo, ubufakazi obubonakalayo luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Ubufakazi obuqondile buhlinzeka ngobufakazi lapho umshushisi ebone ngqo isenzo. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, uC uthembisa ukuthi wayemi ngaphandle kwendlu kaB ngesikhathi ebona uA eqhuba uB. Ukwamukela kubhekisela kubufakazi obuvunyelwe, futhi akukho mthetho osetshenziselwa ukukala izinga lokuvunyelwa kobufakazi. Ubufakazi bungamukelwa noma buphikiswa. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi wamukelwa noma buphikiswa sincike kumphakathi wokuvunyelwa kwabo nokuthi ukwemukela lokho kubufakazi ngeke kubangele ingozi kumshushisi. Ukwamukela ubufakazi okwesikhashana ngaphansi kwesimo esizogcwaliswa ekupheleni kwecala kuchazwa. Uma isimo sigcwaliswa, ubufakazi buzosuswa. Inkantolo yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzeni umshushisi nakuba ubuqiniso bedokhumenti buphikiswa yithimba lokuvikela. Kuzoba ngemuva kokuphela kwecala lapho umshushisi ezothola ithuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo nobuqiniso bedokhumenti, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi obuvele ngemuva kokubuza kuzobhekwa ngenkantolo. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi obufanele, inkantolo izobheka ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe buhlobene nezimfanelo zecala. Igunya liyilungelo noma umthwalo odingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu lapho leli qembu likhombisa ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zegunya. Igunya lomuntu siqu kanye negunya likamasipala. Ukukhuluma ngokuvulekile kuyinto eyenziwa enkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqondile futhi obungaphikiswa ngaphandle kokuba izidingo zomthetho ezithile zifeziwe. Ukwamukela okungaqondile kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo edinga ukucaciswa noma ephikisanayo. Ukuphuma kweqiniso kuwumsebenzi lapho umshushisi evuma ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokuphikiswa, njengoba uma kwenziwa phambi kwenkantolo, kuthathwa njengokuvuma icala. Isaziso senkantolo sichaza lapho inkantolo yamukela izimfanelo ezaziwayo nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa lungakaziswa njengokweqiniso ngesikhathi sokubuza. Umthwalo wokufakazela ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emsebenzini weqembu lapho kufanele kube khona ubufakazi obanele. Umthwalo wezomthetho wokufakazela uphakathi komshushisi. Umthwalo wokukhiqiza ubufakazi obubonakalayo ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emsebenzini wokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze inkantolo ibize umshushisi ukuba aphendule ezinsolweni futhi ithole ubufakazi obanele ukuze iphikise lokho kubonakala kubufakazi obukhulunywe yinqwaba evula icala.
Akukho ingxenye yale ndatshana engaphindwa noma idluliselwe nganoma iyiphi indlela noma ngabe iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhalwe phansi efanele. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kunoma ubani ofisa ukuba uchwepheshe bezomthetho futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukusebenzisa leli thuluzi kahle nangokwaneliseka, kubalulekile kumuntu ukuba nolwazi ngezisho ezithile ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa njalo ngababhali bezomthetho eMthethweni Wobufakazi. Inhloso yalolu shwankathelo ukuhlela nokufundisa abantu ukuze bakwazi ukubona nokujwayela lezi zisho ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa eMthethweni Wobufakazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emifushane ebasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene neMthethweni Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olukhonjiswe phambi kwecala ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi ikomidi lenze isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi obubalulekile bukhuluma ngawo wonke ulwazi nezinto ezingasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. UMthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimfanelo nokulawulwa kokuthi izimfanelo zethulwa kanjani ngokwethembeka. Izimfanelo zingathulwa zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto ezibonakalayo. Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezikhala zomthetho; ubonisa ukuthi uMthetho Wobufakazi uhamba kuphi, incazelo yeMthethweni Wobufakazi, kanye nophawu lokuthi yini eyenza ubufakazi obubalulekile nokuthi yini equkethwe. Impikiswano ethulwe ngombuso kanye neqembu lokuvikela ayithathwa njengobufakazi kodwa iyisithako esisiza enqubweni yokwenza izinqumo. Le mpikiswano yakhiwa ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihlosiwe ukugqamisa isimo somthetho noma izimfanelo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukuze ithonya ukucabangela kwekhamphani lapho ikhipha isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi isinqumo sithathwe, izinhlangothi zinekhono lokwethula impikiswano yokugcina ephathelene nobufakazi obukhulunywe ngempela. Izimfanelo zecala yilezo ezethulwe yiphathi ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi ukuze iwine leli cala. Izimfanelo zivame ukulethela ubufakazi noma ziqhubele phambili. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihlobene nobudlelwane bomzali, ubuhlanga bababa kuzoba yindaba ezoxoxwa, futhi ubudlelwane bezocansi nobaba kuzoba iphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobudlelwane bomzali. Ubufakazi obuqinile buchaza ubufakazi obunamandla noma ukuthi akukho olunye ubufakazi olungcono kunalokho okukhona. Ubufakazi obungaphikiswa buchaza ukuthi kukhona olunye ubufakazi olungcono noma ukuthi bekukhona. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ithathwa njengobufakazi obuqinile, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti athathwa njengobufakazi obungaphikiswa. Igama elithi "prima facie" liyisisho sesiLatini esisho "ngokokuqala." Isisho sobufakazi obucacile ezimweni zomthetho sisho ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe phambi kwekhamphani bufanele ukusungula iqiniso noma icala ngaphandle kokuthi kube nobufakazi obuphikisanayo. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo, ubufakazi obucacile luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, ubufakazi bungase bukhombise ukuthi u-A wayenomgomo wokubulala u-B futhi wabonwa eqhuba ephuma endlini ka-B enokhuni olugcwele igazi. U-X uyafakaza ukuthi wezwa ingilazi iphuka futhi waphendukela ukubona u-Y emi phambi kwefasitela eliphukile lika-Z, lapho u-Y ebamba itshe esandleni sakhe. Ubufakazi obuqondile buyilokho okufakazelwe um witness. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, u-C ufakaza ukuthi wayemi phandle kwendlu ka-B ngesikhathi ebona u-A ehlula u-B. Ukuvunyelwa kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi, futhi akukho standard yokulinganisa izinga lokuvunyelwa kobufakazi. Ubufakazi buvunyelwe noma abuvunyelwe. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi buvunyelwe noma abuvunyelwe sincike ekutheni buhambisana yini noma ukuthi ukuvunyelwa kwabo kuzobeka umsolwa engozini. Kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi ngokusekelwe ezimweni ezizokweneliseka ekupheleni kwecala. Uma isimo singanelisi, lelo bufakazi alithathwa njengelungile. Ikhampasi yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzweni komsolwa nakuba ubuqiniso bedokhumenti buphikiswa yiqembu lokuvikela. Ngemuva kokuphela kwecala, umsolwa uzoba nethuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo nobuqiniso bedokhumenti, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi obuphuma ngemuva kokubuzwa kuzobekwa eceleni yikhamphani. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi obufanele, ikhamphani izocabanga ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe buhambisana nezimfanelo zecala. Amandla kuyilungelo noma isibopho esidingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu lapho kuthulwa ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zamandla. Amandla abantu kanye namandla ombuso. Ukungena kwenkantolo kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphakathi kwenkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqinile futhi obungaphikiswa noma bukhishwe ngaphandle kokuthi izimfuneko zomthetho ezithile zifezekiswe. Ukungena kwangaphandle kubhekisela ekungeni okwenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo okuthintekayo ekuphikisaneni noma empikiswaneni. Ukuvuma kweqiniso kuwumsebenzi lapho umsolwa evuma ngokuphelele futhi ngaphandle kokungabaza emsebenzini, okungaba uma kwenziwa phambi kwenkantolo kuzothathwa njengokuvuma ukuvuma. Isaziso senkantolo sikhombisa ukuthi ikhamphani yamukela izimfanelo ezaziwa kanye nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa alukwazanga ukufakazelwa ngobufakazi ngesikhathi sokubuzwa. Isinqumo sokukholwa siwukwenza isinqumo esisekelwe ezimfanelweni ezithile ezisunguliwe ngumthetho. Umthwalo wobufakazi ubhekisela emsebenzini noma isibopho sephathi sokwethula ubufakazi obuqinile, emthethweni wobugebengu lo mthwalo ubekwe ezindleleni zabaphenyi. Umthwalo wobufakazi obubalulekile ubhekisela emsebenzini noma isibopho sokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze ikhamphani ibize umsolwa ukuthi aphendule ezinsolweni futhi ithole ubufakazi obanele ukuze iphikise lelo bufakazi elicacile elikhulunywe yiphathi evula leli cala.
Ithuba ngalinye linikezwa ngezithombe ukuze zihlolwe bese kuvunyelwana ngalokho okubukwayo. Umphakathi uhlukanisa izithombe ngezindlela ezintathu: "ezinhle," "ezimbi," kanye "nezingathathi hlangothi." Izingathathi hlangothi - ukungaqiniseki mayelana nokuthi kuhle noma kubi. Le chati iyasiza ngoba ivumela umphakathi ukuba uphenye, uhlaziye, futhi ubheke isimo. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuqonda ukuthi izifo zidluliselwa kanjani komunye umuntu, nokuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zokuvikela ezingavikela ukusabalala kwezifo. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba xoxa ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo zokuvikela ezilula ukuzisebenzisa. Inqubo yokuchaza ngokobulili: Le thuluzi isebenzisa izithombe ezintathu zabesifazane nabesilisa, kanye nabesifazane nabesilisa ndawonye. Izithombe zabesifazane zihlala zisebenza emisebenzini ehlukahlukene. Enye imfuneko uk counting beans. Le thuluzi ihlose ukwenza abantu bazi ngobulili babo emphakathini. Bangabona ukuthi yiziphi izinkinga abahlangabezana nazo emihlanganweni yabo yezempilo futhi baphinde bacabange ukuthi lezi zinkinga zingavimbela kanjani ukuthuthuka kwabo. Kukhona izithombe eziyi-20-25 zezindlela ezahlukene zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kanye nezokuhlanzeka, njenge ukusetshenziswa kwezihlahla ukuze kube nezindlu zangasese ezisebenzisa amanzi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamanzi avela emifuleni kuya ezitophini ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukuba abheke izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi avela emifuleni kuya ezitophini ngaphakathi kwezindlu. Le thuluzi isiza umphakathi ukubona izindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezokuhlanzeka emphakathini. Ibhokisi lemibuzo: Le thuluzi isebenzisa ibhokisi elilodwa elinovimba ukuze umphakathi uthumele imibuzo yabo. Umphakathi unethuba lokubuza imibuzo ngendlela engabafaka engcupheni yokukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo emphakathini. Lokhu kusiza umphakathi ukuba ubuze imibuzo ngendlela engathinti ubuhlungu, okungabavimbi noma kubangele ukungqubuzana. Le thuluzi isebenzisa izithombe ezahlukene zezenzakalo ezedlule nezamanje ukuze ibonise umehluko phakathi kokuthile okuphukile nokuthile okulungisiwe. Uhlelo lwe-PHAST lwakhiwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ushintsho lwesimo sokuziphatha mayelana nezokuhlanzeka kanye nentuthuko yezindlela ezifanele zokulahla udoti. Lwakhiwe ukuze kuhlanzwe udoti kahle, kube nokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile, kanye nempilo yemvelo, njengoba lezi zaziwa njengezinye zezinkinga ezihlobene nalokhu. Le ndlela isebenzisa izithombe ezivumela abantu ukuba babone ukuhlinzekwa kwamanzi nezokuhlanzeka emphakathini ngendlela ebonakalayo. Le ndlela isebenzisa izindlela nezinto ezikhuthaza ukubambisana phakathi kwabesilisa, abesifazane, nezingane. Ukwandisa ukuqwashisa, ukukhuthaza ukubambisana kwezokuhlanzeka, nokulahla udoti ngendlela efanele. Ukuvumela abantu ukuba babhekane nezinkinga ezihlobene nokushintsha kokuziphatha. Ngokuhlola ulwazi lwabantu. Ukuhlola izimo abantu abaphila kuzo. Ngokubheka izimo ezingaba khona esikhathini esizayo. Ukuhlaziya izinkinga ezingavimbela ushintsho. Ukulungiselela ushintsho. Ekugcineni, ukwenza ushintsho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokubambisana. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungaxazulula kanjani izinkinga. Ukuvumela abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ngokusekelwe kulwazi abanalo. Ukwamukela izindlela ezahlukene emphakathini ngokwokuqonda ukusabalala nokuvikela kwezifo. Ukubona izinkinga: Umphakathi uxoxa ngezinkinga zezempilo ezikhona emphakathini. Ukuhlaziywa kwezinkinga Uma sibheka izinkinga, asicabangi ngesimo samanzi nokulahla udoti emphakathini kodwa esikhundleni salokho sisiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi ushintshela ezindleleni zokuhlanzeka ezingcono. Kubheka futhi ucwaningo lokwenza umphakathi futhi kubona ukuthi izifo zisabalala kanjani. Ukuhlela izixazululo Ngenkathi umphakathi uthola ukuthi kuphi inkinga, kumele baphakamise izindlela zokuvikela ukusabalala kwezifo. Ukukhetha izindlela. Lapha umphakathi uphakamisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwedoti emphakathini futhi ukhethe izindlela zokuhlanzeka ezingcono njengoba behlola izindlela ezinhle nezimbi. Ukuhlela ushintsho lokuziphatha nezinsiza ezintsha. Lapha umphakathi uhlunga abantu ukuze bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ezinyathelweni ezizoletha ushintsho. Umphakathi uphinde ubheke ukuthi yini engahamba kahle ezinhlelweni zabo. Lezi yizithombe eziyi-15 ezisetshenziswe ezinhlelweni ezimbili ezibonisa izindawo ezinezimo ezahlukene. Umphakathi uhlukaniswe ngamaqembu amancane ukuze akhe ithimba ngalinye elinikezwa izithombe ezikhuluma ngezindaba eziphelele. Bese amaqembu axoxa ngezindaba zabo. Ngesikhathi sokusebenzisa le thuluzi, kukhona inhloso yokucwaninga ngezinkinga zomphakathi nezinye izindaba ezihlobene naleso sikhala.
Bika ochwepheshe bezilwane mayelana nezilwane eziphatha ngendlela engajwayelekile, futhi kuthathwa ukuthi kune-rabies. Abantu abathinteka ekutholeni i-rabies kufanele bavaccine ngaphambi kokungena kulezi zimo. Izikhungo zezempilo, odokotela, ama-Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), kanye nabahloli bezempilo kufanele baziwe ngokushesha. Abahloli bezempilo bahlola isimo, baphenya, futhi banikeza izeluleko (baphakamisa). Abahloli bezempilo baxhumana nochwepheshe bezilwane emikhankasweni yokuvaccine izilwane (ezisemakhaya) futhi bakhuthaze ukuqwashisa. I-rabies task force ikhulise ukufinyelela emphakathini. Isilwane esigulayo sishaywa, bese sithathwa. Kumuntu ogulayo, umusi uqoqwa ukuze uhlole. Isilwane es suspected ukuba ne-rabies siqedwa izinsuku eziyishumi ukuze kubonakale ukuthi sishintsha yini. Uma sikhombisa izimpawu ze-rabies, sihlinzwa ukuze ubuchopho buphathwe. Uma umuntu owashwe treated ngokushesha, ngeke agule noma afe. Umuntu owashwe akufanele ahlale umonakalo ngamanzi kanye ne-disinfectant imizuzu emihlanu ngaphambi kokuvakashela esibhedlela. Hamba esibhedlela esiseduzane. Udokotela noma um nurse uzosungula uhlelo lokuvikela i-rabies, oluhilela ukubulala i-rabies virus emzimbeni. Kubalulekile ukulandela zonke izithako kuze kube sekupheleni. Uma ufuna olunye ulwazi, xhumana nez authorities zezempilo noma isikhungo sezempilo. I-rabies yisifo esithathelwana esibangelwa yi-virus (germ) esinazo izilwane. Yisifo esidluliselwa esilwaneni esinombono ne-gazi elishisayo ukuya kwenye. I-rabies ivela ezilwaneni ezifana nezinja, amafene, amakati, ama-bats, kanye nama-raccoons. I-virus ikhona emusini lapho lesi sifo siqala. Umusi ongu-virus ungena kumuntu ngokushaywa noma ukugwaza, uma nje isikhumba sikhishwe. Le germ ihamba ngezinzwa kuze kube ifika ebuchopheni. Izilwane ezifele ne-rabies zingaba yingozi uma ziphathwa, zithinta ubuchopho, umusi, noma uma zicutshungulwa ngensimbi. Qaphela ukuthi i-rabies ithinta izinhliziyo nezimo, ibonakaliswa njengokuphatha kwezilwane okungajwayelekile. Izinguquko zokuziphatha (ukuhlukumeza), ukugwaza noma yini, ukungazinzi, ukwesaba, umusi omningi, ukuhlasela okungazelelwe, ukuzilimaza, ukuqubuka, nokufa kungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlasela, amehlo agcwele, ukudideka, ukwenza izwi elingajwayelekile, ukungawuhloniphi umnikazi, ukuhlasela okungazelelwe, ukuqubuka, nokufa kungase kwenzeke. Ukuhlasela izinto ezingaliveki kanye nabantu, ukuzihlukanisa ezikhaleni, umusi omningi, ukugwaza, umusi omningi, kanye namahlo agcwele kungase kwenzeke. Umusi omningi, ukukhala okunamandla, ukuhlasela, ukuhamba okungadingekile, nokugaya amazinyo kungase kwenzeke. Baphenduka bangesabi abantu, bangena ezindlini nasemaphandleni, behlasela abantu nezilwane ngaphandle kokuxwayisa, futhi bafa ngokuzumayo. Kuthatha amasonto amabili kuya kumasonto ayishumi noma ngaphezulu ukuze umuntu owashwe isilwane esine-rabies akhombise izimpawu ze-rabies ezibangelwe yiso. Izimpawu zokuqala: umkhuhlane, headache, ukukhathazeka, ukuhamba, ukwesaba amanzi, ubuhlungu besikhathi, ukulahlekelwa isifiso sokudla, ukucasuka, ukungazinzi, ukuqubuka, bese kufa. Imigomo iphephile; ayizukwenza isilwane sakho sibe nesifo. Ungathinti noma ungasondeli esilwaneni ongasilazi, noma esibonakala singenamuntu, futhi ungakuphazamisi.
Kukhishwe nguMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal ngokubambisana noMnyango Wezempilo weZizwe Ezihlangene. Pheka ukudla okungokwemvelo noma okukhuliswe kahle emasimini. Ukudla okungokwemvelo okufana nezinhlanzi, izithelo, nezitshalo kungathwala nomkhuhlane wecholera, kodwa lo mkhuhlane ungafa uma ukudla kuphisiwe, ngakho qiniseka ukuthi awudli ukudla okungaphekwanga, futhi kufanele uhlanze izandla zakho ngemva kokudla. Uma ukudla kuphakathi, umkhuhlane uyakhula. Ngakho, dlani ukudla okushisayo noma kuphise kabusha ngemva kokudla. Gwema ukuxhumana phakathi kokudla okungokwemvelo nokudla okuphisiwe. Ukudla okuphekiwe okuphephile nakho kungathwala umkhuhlane wecholera ngenxa yokuxhumana okuncane nokudla okungokwemvelo. Lokhu kuxhumana kungenzeka uma usika izinhlanzi eziphilile ngenkathi usika ukudla okuphisiwe ngaphandle kokuhlanza izandla. Ezindaweni ezithintekile yi-cholera, ukudla okufana nezithelo nezitshalo akuphephile ngaphandle kokuphekwa, njalonjalo. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokuqala ukulungisa ukudla nangaphambi kwanoma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka, njengokushintsha noma ukuhlanza ingane, ukusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Hlanza izandla zakho futhi ngemva kokuphothula ukulungisa ukudla okufana nezinhlanzi nezitshalo ngemva kokuthinta ezinye ukudla. Indawo lapho ulungisa khona ukudla kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile; cabanga ukudla okungadliwa noma indawo engahlanzekile njengoba ikhipha umkhuhlane. I-cloth yokuhlanza izitsha kufanele ishintshwe nsuku zonke noma iphisiwe ngemva kokusetshenziswa. Hlukanisa i-cloth yokusula okufanele ihlanzwe njalo. Ukusebenzisa amanzi aphephile kokupheka kubalulekile njengokuwasebenzisa kokuphuza. Phisa amanzi ngemva kokulungisa ukudla kwengane. I-bleach noma i-iodine ingasetshenziswa esikhundleni samanzi aphisiwe. Faka isipuni esisodwa se-bleach noma i-iodine kumalitha angama-25 wamanzi, bese ulinda amahora amabili noma ubusuku bonke ngemva kokuyisebenzisa. II. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe ukudla okulungisayo kuphephile? Pheka kahle zonke izidlo ezifana nenyama, izinhlanzi, nezitshalo. Dla ukudla okuphekiwe ngesikhathi kuse-hot. Hlanza izandla zakho ngemva kokulungisa ukudla. Hlanza izitsha ngamanzi nosawoti. Hlanza indawo lapho usika khona izinhlanzi nezitshalo, njll., ngamanzi nosawoti. Dla izithelo ezisikiwe ezifana nezorhwe, noma amabanana. Gcina ihlanzekile - pheka, hlanzisa, nezinye izinto ukuze umise! Pheka ukudla kwakho. Phisa ukudla kwakho. Hlanza ukudla kwakho. Ingabe amanzi akho aphisiwe noma aphephile? Ingabe amanzi akho agcinwe endaweni ephephile? Amanzi ahlanzekile angathwala umkhuhlane uma engagcinwanga endaweni ephephile. Gcina amanzi ebhodweni elihlanzekile elinovolo. Sebenzisa amanzi agciniwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-24. Thela amanzi ebhodweni noma sebenzisa ikomishi ukuyiphakela. Gcina ihlanzekile - gcina amanzi akho ephephile. VI. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe uhlanza izandla zakho? Ukungcola okuningi ezandleni zakho kungakwenza uthole i-cholera ngaphandle kokwazi? Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ukuhlanza ingane. Ngemva kokulungisa ukudla. Ngemva kokudla. Ngemva kokunikeza ingane yakho ukudla. Yini indlela engcono yokuhlanza izandla zakho? Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa usawoti njalo. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile njalo. Hlanza izandla zakho njalo ngemva nangaphambi, phakathi kwezitho zakho, nasemathanjeni. Gcina zihlanzekile - hlanza izandla zakho? VII. Ingabe uphephile kwi-cholera? Ingabe usebenzisa indlu yangasese? Umuntu ohlanzekile angathola i-cholera endlini yangasese. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa indlu yangasese njalo? Phumula udoti lwengane endlini yangasese noma ulufake phansi. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nosawoti ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina ihlanzekile - sebenzisa indlu yangasese. Phuza amanzi avela emthonjeni ophephile noma ovikelwe. Pheka ukudla noma kuphise kabusha, bese udla ngesikhathi kuse-hot. Hlanza izandla zakho ngaphambi kokuthinta udoti noma ukuchama, ngemva kokulungisa ukudla. I-cholera ayizokubulali uma iphathwa kahle. Shesha umguli ophukile uye esibhedlela ukuze uphathwe. Unyaka unaphezu kweminyaka eyisithupha. Bafaka imithi emzimbeni wonke kusukela emathangeni kuze kube ezindlebeni. Linda imithi yomile. Shiya imithi emzimbeni usuku oluphelele (24 hrs) bese uyihlanza emva kwalolo suku. Phinda ngosuku olulandelayo. Kubantwana abangaphansi kweminyaka eyisithupha, landela inqubo efanayo njengabantu abadala. Kungase kudingeke ukuphinda ngemuva kwesonto, qhubeka usebenzisa imithi. Gqoka izingubo ezihlanzekile ngemuva kokusebenzisa imithi. Bonke amalungu omndeni kumele ahlolwe. Gcoba izipikili futhi ugcine zihlanzekile. Hlanza zonke izindwangu zokulala nezembatho ngamanzi ashisa. Omile elangeni. Hlanza umzimba ngamanzi warms ne sabuni, uhlole izindawo ezithintekile ngombhoxo noma ithawula lokuhlamba. Sula indawo ethintekile ngendwangu bese uyomisa ngethawula elihlanzekile. Indlu yonke kumele ihlanzwe ngempahla yokuhlambulula. Ukutheleleka kusabalala kakhulu ngenxa yokungabi nehlanzeko, ukugcina umuntu ehlanzekile kuzovikela ezimeni zokugula, ngakho hlanza umzimba njalo, futhi ugcine izingubo nezindwangu zokulala zihlanzekile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Abantu abanezikhalazo kumele basheshe baye esibhedlela ngokushesha futhi balandele konke abakutshelwa ngababheki. Abazali kumele bakhuthaze izingane ukuba zihlale zihlanzekile. Ukuhlanza kuvela ezindaweni ezifudumele zomzimba (emathangeni nasemgudwini), ukungakhululeki kubi kakhulu ebusuku. Isikhumba singase sibe nezinhlungu. Inhliziyo nezitho zomzimba zingase zingasebenzi kahle. Isinyathelo esilandelayo wukufa uma kungaphathwa. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, izilonda ezingapholi zingase zivele. Ukutheleleka kusabalala kanjani? Kwenziwa kanjani ukuvimbela? Ukutheleleka kungathinta izinyoni ezincane. 1. Ukuhlanzeka komuntu: - kulabo abathintekile (kufana nezinyoni kodwa zincane kakhulu). Uma lezi zinyoni zikhona, zingadala ukungakhululeki esikhumbeni futhi ziholele ekuhlanzeni nasekufakeni izingubo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi zibeka amaqanda. Ngokuxhumana nomuntu onakho, umuntu angase ahlanze izingubo noma izindwangu zokulala, beqaphela elangeni ukuze bafe amaqanda. Kubantu abake babe nokutheleleka, izimpawu zingavela ezinsukwini eziyodwa kuya kwezine kamuva. Izingane akufanele zidlale nezilwane uma zixhumana nomuntu noma isilwane (njengamakhaya) esinokutheleleka. 6. Abantu abakha amanzi ezindaweni kufanele baqaphele. Ubani ongathinteka ekuthelekeni? Ukutheleleka kungathinta abantu bezizukulwane zonke, kungakhathalekile iminyaka, ubulili, ubuhlanga, noma izinga lokuhlanzeka. Kusabalala ngegciwane.
