Noma ngabe ukudla kuphisiwe, izivakashi kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi kuphisiwe kahle futhi kusemisha. Ngezikhathi ezithile zonyaka, izinhlanzi ezahlukene nezilwane zasemanzini zingaba ne-toxins eziyingozi ezingathinta impilo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ziphisiwe kahle. Kubalulekile ukufuna iseluleko ezikhungweni zezempilo zendawo mayelana nalezi zilwane eziyingozi. Ng unfortunately, ukubukeka kokudla akukhombisi ukuphepha kwako, futhi ukudla okunobuthi kungaba nephunga elimnandi. Uma kukhona indlela yokugwema ukudla okungaphephile, izinga elincane lokudla linganciphisa ingozi yokuphathwa ubuthi. Izivakashi zingakhetha ukungadli ukudla. ENingizimu Afrika, amanzi aphuma emathubeni ngokuvamile aphephile ukuphuza. Nokho, uma othile evakashela ezindaweni zasemaphandleni isikhathi eside, kubalulekile ukuthwala amanzi abotshiwe ezitsheni ezivalekile. Amathablethi okuhlunga amanzi atholakala ezitolo zezidakamizwa futhi kufanele asetshenziswe ngokuhambisana nezincazelo. Uma amanzi engase abe nezinye izinto, izivakashi kufanele zixwayiswe ukuthi noma amanzi abotshiwe kufanele athathwe njengokungaphephile futhi angasetshenziswa ukuphuza. Gwema ukuxhumana kwezocansi nabanye abangabalingani abajwayelekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba. I-HIV iyinkinga enkulu okwamanje ngenxa yesikhathi esihlala egazini, okuholela ekudlulisweni okungathandeki nasezimpilweni zayo ezimbi. Izivakashi zicebiswa ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezimpahla zokuvikela ngaphambi kokuhamba uma kudingeka. Uma ukuvaccine kudingeka, izivakashi kufanele zizame ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-vaccine nemithi kuvela ezipakishweni ezivalekile zemithi ehlanzekile. Labo abane-diabetes kufanele bathwale izinsimbi ezihlanzekile (ezihlanziwe) ngesikhathi sokuhamba futhi babe ne-authorization kadokotela yokuzisebenzisa. Ukuhlukaniswa kwegazi kwenziwa ngokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika futhi akubeki ingozi ezivakashini. Akukho mfuneko yokugxila ezishintsheni zokuziphatha nasezinyathelweni zokuphepha. Ukusebenzisa ikhondomu kuyindlela enye yokuvikela. I-malaria ingenye yezifo ezivamile ezidalwa yiphilisi edluliselwa kumuntu ngomuntu ngempukane ye-Aedes Aegypti, ethwele isifo se-malaria. Nakuba kube nebufakazi bokuthi ukudluliswa kwe-malaria kwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika, impukane ethwele lesi sifo itholakala lapha. I-malaria ibonakala e-Afrika ezindaweni eziseningizimu, eziphakathi, naseMpumalanga naseNingizimu Melika. Ingozi yokuthola lesi sifo ingancishiswa ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezijwayelekile zokuvikela noma ukunciphisa ukuhlinzwa kwemikhono. Ukuvaccine: Ngokwezimiso zeMnyango Wezempilo Womhlaba, i-International Certificate of Vaccination against Yellow Fever iyisithombe esisodwa esidingekayo sokuhamba emhlabeni jikelele. I-International Certificate of Vaccination against Yellow Fever iyasebenza iminyaka eyishumi, iqala ezinsukwini eziyishumi ngemuva kokuvaccine. Ibalulekile kubo bonke abahambi abangaphezu kweminyaka eyodwa ubudala. Umuntu ophuma endaweni lapho lesi sifo sikhona ongakazivakali angavinjwa ekungeneni ezweni noma agcinwe ngaphansi kokubhekwa okungaphansi kwezinsuku eziyisithupha uma ethuthela khona kungaholela ekubhekaneni nezithiyo. Izikhungo zokuhamba zizohlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe ngalolu sifo nokuvaccine ngokulandelana. Lesi sifo esibulalayo esidalwa amagciwane esiswini. Ukutheleleka ngalesi sifo kudalwa ngokuphuza amanzi nokudla okungcolile. Ukulawulwa kwaso kusasele kuyinkinga yezempilo. Ukuze kuncishiswe ingozi yokutheleleka ngalesi sifo, izivakashi kufanele zibe neqhaza elikhulu ngalokho abakudlayo nakokho abakuphuza. Izivakashi zikhuthazwa ukuba zigweme ukuphuza amanzi angahlanzwanga. Amanzi agcinwe ezitsha kuyas rekomendwa. I-blood flukes zenzeka emhlabeni jikelele futhi zidalwa ngamagciwane adla igazi lomuntu, impilo yazo iyinkimbinkimbi futhi ifaka ezinye izinhlobo zezilwane zasemanzini ezibamba. Lezi zikhungo ziyaqhamuka ngalesi sifo lapho uhlobo lwemithambo nemfucumfucu yabantu abathintekayo igcwalisa amanzi ahlanzekile. Lezi zikhungo ezithintekayo ngalolu bhubhane zikhulisa ama-larvae amancane ahamba kalula futhi angangena emzimbeni ongavikelekile (ovulekile) womuntu emanzini angashisayo. Ukubhukuda emanzini angcolile kufanele kugwenywe. Ukubhukuda emanzini ahlanzekile kuvame ukuba kuphephile ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Gcina indlu yangasese ihlanzekile. Phuma udoti wezinsana endlini yangasese noma uwufake phansi. Geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi ahlanzekile ngemva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese. Gcina indlu yangasese ihlanzekile. Ngokuthatha amasampula kule ndawo okukholelwa ukuthi kunamagciwane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kukfood, amanzi, noma umoya, kungahlolwa elabhorethri. Khuthaza umphakathi ukuthi usebenzise izindlu zangasese. Dala uhlelo lwamanzi ahlanzekile lwesikhashana kuze kube isikhathi lapho abantu bezoba namanzi okusebenzisa njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi udoti uphume endaweni efanele. Khumbula ukuthi amanzi angcolile yindawo evamile lapho kutholakala khona iTyphoid. Ekuphetheni, iTyphoid yisifo esingavinjwa. Uma umphakathi ungakwazi ukuhambisana nezixwayiso ezishiwo ngenhla, lesi sifo singavinjwa. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi lo mgci awuboniwe ngamehlo alula. Ngakho-ke, uma ubona izandla zakho zingcolile, akusho ukuthi uphephile; noma zibonakala zihlanzekile, kufanele uzigeze ngaphambi kokuthinta ukudla. Abantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kufanele baqaphele kakhulu. Lezi zindawo ngokuvamile azinamanzi ahlanzekile nezindlu zangasese. Le simo sithuthukisa ukusabalala kwesifo. Uma umuntu ethola umkhuhlane, headache, ubuhlungu besisu, efuna ukuhlabela, noma enokuhlushwa, kufanele asheshiswe aye kudokotela noma esibhedlela. Khumbula, impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Lesi sifo sikhishwa ngumgci obizwa ngeSalmonella typhi futhi sitholakala ngokuphuza amanzi, ubisi, noma ukudla okungcoliswe ngalo mgci weSalmonella. Kukhona izinhlobo eziyi-107 zalo mgci. Izimpawu zifaka phakathi inhliziyo encane noma ukulahlekelwa isifiso sokudla, ukuhlushwa, noma ukuhamba kancane. Pheka ukudla kwakho. Bhaka noma uhlunge amanzi owaphuzayo. Geza izandla zakho. Izindlela zokulungisa ukudla. Ukupheka kahle kuqeda iTyphoid; pheka inyama, inhlanzi, nezithelo ngaphambi kokudla. Ukuhlanza kuvimba iTyphoid - geza izandla zakho ngaphambi kokulungisa ukudla. Hlanza izitsha zakho ngensipho namanzi. Geza izithelo nemifino edliwayo ngempela. Ukudla izithelo ezihlanzekile, ezifana nezithelo ze-oranges nezibhanana, kuvikela iTyphoid. Gcina ihlanzekile futhi upheke noma uhlanze. Ama-litre angama-25 wamanzi. Uvule konke ngosuku lonke bese uphuza ngosuku olulandelayo. Ingabe amanzi owaphuzayo agcinwe endaweni efanele? Amanzi ahlanzekile angabamba amagciwane uma engagcinwanga kahle. Gcina amanzi owaphuzayo ezitsheni ezihlanzekile ezinomlomo omncane noma ezivalekile. Sebenzisa isitsha esinokubamba sokuphuza. Kungase kube ezandleni zakho ngaphandle kokubona ngaphambi kokudla noma ukuphuzisa izingane zakho. Yini indlela efanele yokugeza izandla zakho? Njalo sebenzisa insipho. Sebenzisa amanzi ahlanzekile anele. Geza izandla zakho yonke indawo naphakathi kwezithupha nezinzipho.
Ongqongqoshe, uMphakathi, uDr. S.C. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuba yingxenye yomphakathi owakha iMuziwabantu Municipality, eyingxenye ye-uGu municipality, kulolu suku lomlando olugubha omunye wemigqa ebalulekile yomsebenzi omuhle kahulumeni wethu wokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu bethu. Njengoba siqala unyaka omusha, izifiso nezithemba zabantu abaningi ziwukuthi impilo yabo, inhlalakahle, nezimo zabo zibe ngcono. Ngamanye amazwi, ukuvakashela kwethu kule ndawo ukuze sikhombise lezi zinhlelo ezimbili kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokufeza leli phupho. Simi lapha namuhla, siqhenya ukuba yingxenye kahulumeni ophendula izidingo zomphakathi. Phansi kukahulumeni ophoqelelayo, abantu basemaphandleni baphumelele ithemba lokuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi bamukela njengokuphila kwabo ukuthi bazoqhubeka behamba izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bathole amanzi ngezikhathi lapho badinga khona nakwempilo yabo. Abantu bethu basemaphandleni bamukele ukuthi izakhiwo zesimanje ezifana nale ndlu entsha eyakhiwe yomphakathi waseCingweni yinkanyezi. Uhulumeni wethu uqhubeka nokusebenza ngokungapheli ukuze alungise umonakalo owenziwe nguhulumeni wobandlululo. Ukuthuthukiswa nezimo zokuphila ezingcono kubo bonke. Kulolu hlobo, u-84 percent wezikhungo zihlala emaphandleni, kuyilapho u-16 percent zihlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Njengemunye yezikhungo zomphakathi, uGu unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile emphakathini. Ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezibalulekile emphakathini kubhekana nezinselelo ngenxa yokungafani phakathi kwezindawo zasemadolobheni nezasemaphandleni, kanye ne-backlog yezinsizakalo ezidalwe ukungabi nokuxhaswa nemakhono. Ngalesi sizathu, ngonyaka ka-2000, i-uGu municipality, kanye nezinye izikhungo ezintathu zalesi sifunda, okungukuthi, iMkhanyakude, iZululand, kanye ne-Umzinyathi, zabelwa uhulumeni njengezindawo ezamukelwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe okuzinzile kwasemaphandleni. Lokhu kusho ukuthi lezi zindawo zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza eziningi kunezinye izindawo. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile ezibhekene ne-uGu district municipality, ezinye zazo zixhumene namanzi, inhlanzeko, kanye nogesi. Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, u-74 percent wabantu abahlala kule ndawo, ikakhulukazi labo basemaphandleni, abanakho ugesi. Cishe u-50 percent wabantu abahlala kule ndawo badinga kakhulu ukuhlinzekwa ngamanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi u-50 percent kuphela wezikhungo zine-access kumanzi ahlanzekile okuphisa nokuphuza, kuyilapho u-58 percent besadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanzekile. Imali ibekwe eceleni ukuze kusizakale i-uGu District Municipality ekubhekaneni nezinkinga ezihlobene nezomiso. E-Fodo, KwaMbotho, KwaShaweni, Dumisa, kanye neKwaJali. Le nkqubo izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu babuyisela isithunzi sabo. Ngalesi sikhathi, abantu bethu ngeke baphoqeleke ukuhamba izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bathole amanzi. Le nkqubo yamanzi esiyethulayo lapha namuhla izoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu abatholi izifo ezihlobene nokungabi namanzi ahlanzekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le nkqubo izokwakha amathuba emisebenzi emphakathini wendawo futhi ithuthukise amakhono. Njengohulumeni, sihlala sikhathazekile ngezindlela zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ahlanzekile ngokushesha kanye nezakhiwo ezizothuthukisa impilo yabantu bethu. Emizamweni yethu yokubhekana nalezi zinkinga ezihlobene ne-backlog ekunikezeni izinsizakalo kanye nokungabi nezakhiwo, uhulumeni usungule indlela yokuxhasa ebizwa ngokuthi iMunicipal Infrastructure Grant. Sizosebenzisana ngokubambisana ne-municipality, siqinisekisa ukuthi iRand ngayinye ibalulekile emsebenzini eyenzelwe. Ngithanda ukukhuthaza izikhungo zalesi sifunda ukuba zisebenze ndawonye, zabelane ngemininingwane, futhi zisebenzise indlela yokubambisana ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi. Umsebenzi owenziwe yi-uGu municipality ngonyaka ka-2004/2005 ubonisile ukuthi i-district municipality inekhono lokuthuthukisa izikhungo ezikhonza. Ukuqaliswa kwendlu entsha yomphakathi eCingweni kuzohlanganiswa nezakhiwo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ama-MPCCs. Lokhu kusho ukuthi le ndlu ngeke isetshenziswe kuphela ezimeni zomphakathi kodwa izosetshenziswa futhi ezinye izigaba zikahulumeni ukuze zisondeze izinsizakalo kubantu. Kulesi sifunda, sizibophezele ukuba ne-MPCC kuzo zonke izikhungo zomphakathi. Le njongo seyifeziwe, futhi lapha e-uGu, sesivele sakhe ama-MPCC eDududu naseBhomela. Ukwakhiwa kwama-MPCC kuyinsiza yezinjongo zikahulumeni zokuphula ubuphofu ngokusondela kwezinsizakalo emphakathini. Ngiyajabula futhi ukuva ukuthi kukhona amalungu angama-52 omphakathi abathole izinzuzo emsebenzini nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwendlu. Ngizwe ukuthi izinhlelo zisasebenza phakathi kwe-uGu municipality neMuziwabantu ukuze kudluliselwe le ndawo ukusuka e-uGu iye eMuziwabantu; futhi izoxhunywa nezinye izigaba ezibalulekile ukuze le ndawo isetshenziswe ukuze uhulumeni ulethwe izinsizakalo kubantu empini yokulwa nobuphofu. Namuhla sibhiyozela izithelo zomsebenzi wokubambisana. Ngokuvulwa kwale ndlu, siqinisekisa ukufezeka kwephupho lokuthi abantu bethu ngeke baphinde bahambe izinyathelo ezinde ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zabo ezibalulekile. Sizama ukuvimbela umonakalo owenziwe ubuhlanga obuholele kulolu hlobo. Ngiyakhuthaza thina sonke njengamalungu omphakathi ukuba sithathe le ndlu njengomthombo obalulekile, futhi sithathe kahle izakhiwo ezizoletha amanzi esizowasebenzisa. Thina lapha kule ndawo siyazi kahle ukuthi kuyini ukungabi namanzi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi uma sinesikhathi samanzi, asishiyi ama-tap evulekile. Akufanele sivumele izingane ukudlala ngezinsiza ezibalulekile. Kumele sigcine yonke ithontsi lamanzi. Njengohulumeni, sizibophezele ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana ne-municipality ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu bethu. Ngabe ukwethulwa kwale nkqubo yamanzi nokuvulwa kwale ndlu kube ukuqala kwesikhathi esikhanyayo nesithembisayo kubantu abakhe le municipality. Nakuba unyaka usanda kuqala, ngifisela unyaka omusha ogcwele izibusiso. I-office ezimele esunguliwe ngokuhambisana ne-Correctional Services Act, uMthetho inombolo 111 ka-1998, ephethwe nguMphakathi oMhloli. Izinjongo zeMphakathi oMhloli ukuhlela ukuhlolwa kweziboshwa ukuze uMphakathi oMhloli akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngombiko mayelana nokuphathwa kweziboshwa eziboshwe nasemazingeni eziboshwa. Ithimba labahloli liqukethe amaqembu amane, abahloli abaphatha ukuhlolwa nokuhlola, iyunithi yezinsizakalo zomthetho ephatha izikhalazo zeziboshwa, iyunithi ye-Independent Prison Visitor (IPV) ephatha ukuqashwa nokuphathwa okujwayelekile kwe-IPVs, kanye neyodwa yokuphatha ephatha ukuph
Akukho ingxenye yalolu bhali engaphindwa noma idluliselwe ngenye indlela noma ifomu ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe efanele. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kunoma ubani ofisa ukuba uchwepheshe bezomthetho futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukuze usebenzise le thuluzi kahle futhi ngokwanelisayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu abe nolwazi ngezisho ezithile ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa njalo ngababhalayo bezincwadi ezahlukene zomthetho mayelana noMthetho Wobufakazi. Inhloso yalolu suku ukuhlela nokufundisa abantu ukuba baqonde futhi bazijwayeze nalezi zisho ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa kuMthetho Wobufakazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emifushane ebasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene noMthetho Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olukhulunywa phambi kwenkantolo ngenhloso yokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi inkantolo ithathe isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi bomzimba bukhuluma ngazo zonke izindaba nemikhiqizo engasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. UMthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimo kanye nokulawulwa kokuthi izimo zethulwa kanjani ngendlela ethembekile. Izimo zingethulwa zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto zomzimba. Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezicathulo zomthetho; ubonisa ukuthi uMthetho Wobufakazi uhambisana nani, incazelo kaMthetho Wobufakazi, kanye nophawu lokuthi yini eyakha ubufakazi bomzimba nokuthi yini equkethe. Impikiswano ethulwa yisimo kanye neqembu lokuvikela ayisebenzi njengobufakazi kodwa iyinhloso ewusizo ekhuthaza isinqumo. Le mpikiswano yakhiwa ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihloselwe ukugqamisa isimo somthetho noma izimo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukususa ukuqonda kwenkantolo lapho kuthathwa isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi kuthathwe isinqumo, amaqembu anethuba lokwethula impikiswano yokugcina ephathelene nobufakazi obethulwe eceleni. Izimo zecala yilezo ezethulwa yiphathi enenjongo yokufakazela icala labo. Izimo zivame ukuhambisa ubufakazi noma ukuwuphikisa. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihilela ubudlelwano bobaba, isimo sobaba sizoba yindaba ezoxoxwa, futhi ubudlelwano nobaba kuzoba iphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobaba. Ubufakazi obuqinile bukhuluma ngobufakazi obuqinile noma obungcono kunezinye ubufakazi ezitholakalayo. Ubufakazi besibili bukhuluma ngobufakazi obukhona noma obungavela. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ibhekwa njengobufakazi obuqinile, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti abhekwa njengobufakazi besibili. Igama elithi "prima facie," elihumusha ngokuthi "bufakazi obubonakala buqondile," lichaza ukuthi ubufakazi obethulwe phambi kwenkantolo bufanelekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe isimo noma icala ngaphandle kokuba kube nobufakazi obuphikisanayo. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo, ubufakazi obubonakalayo luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Ubufakazi obuqondile bukhuluma ngobufakazi lapho umshushisi ebone ngqo isenzo. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, uC uveza ukuthi wayemi ngaphandle kwendlu kaB ngesikhathi ebona uA eqhuba uB. Ukwamukela kubhekisela kubufakazi obuvumelekile, futhi akukho standard yokulinganisa izinga lokuvunyelwa kobufakazi. Ubufakazi bungamukelwa noma buphikiswa. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi wamukelwa noma buphikiswa sincike kumphumela wokuvunyelwa kwabo nokuthi ukwamukela lelo bufakazi ngeke kube yingozi kumshushisi. Ukwamukela kobufakazi okwamanje ngaphansi kwemigomo ezogcwaliseka ekupheleni kwecala kuchazwa. Uma imigomo igcwaliseka, ubufakazi buphuma. Inkantolo yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzeni umshushisi nakuba ubuqiniso bedokhumenti buphikiswa neqembu lokuvikela. Kuzoba ngemva kokuphela kwecala lapho umshushisi ezothola ithuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi esivela ngemva kokubuza kuzobekwa eceleni yinkantolo. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi obufanele, inkantolo izocabanga ukuthi ubufakazi obethulwe buhlobene nezimo zecala. Igunya liyilungelo noma umthwalo odingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu lapho bethula ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zegunya. Igunya lomuntu siqu kanye negunya lesimo. Ukukhuluma ngokukhululeka kuyinto eyenziwa enkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqondile futhi obungaphikiswa ngaphandle kokuba izidingo zomthetho ezithile zifeziwe. Ukwamukela okungaqondile kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo edinga ukucaciswa noma iyaphikisana. Ukuphuma kweqiniso kuyisenzo lapho umshushisi evuma ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokungabaza, njengoba uma kwenziwa phambi kwenkantolo, kuthathwa njengokuphika kokuhluleka. Isaziso senkantolo sichaza lapho inkantolo yamukela izimo ezaziwayo nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa lungakaziswa njengokweqiniso ngesikhathi sokubuza. Umthwalo wokufakazela ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emthwalweni weqembu lapho kufanele baphakamise ubufakazi obanele. Umthwalo wezomthetho wokufakazela utholakala kumshushisi. Umthwalo wokukhiqiza ubufakazi bomzimba ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emthwalweni wokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze inkantolo ibize umshushisi ukuphendula ezimangweni nasekutholeni ubufakazi obanele ukuze uphikise lelo bufakazi elibonakalayo elithulwe yiphathi evula icala.
Akukho ingxenye yale ndatshana engaphindwa noma idluliselwe nganoma iyiphi indlela noma ngaphezu kwemithombo ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhalwe kahle. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kunoma ubani ofuna ukuba nguchwepheshe bezomthetho futhi ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukuze usebenzise le thuluzi kahle nangokwanelisayo, kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu abe nolwazi ngamagama athile abalulekile asetshenziswa njalo ngababhali bezomthetho eMthethweni Wobufakazi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuhlela nokufundisa abantu ukuze bakwazi ukuqaphela nokuzijwayeza nale magama abalulekile asetshenziswa eMthethweni Wobufakazi futhi ukubanika ulwazi olufushane oluwasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene neMthethweni Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olunikezwa phambi kwenkantolo ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi inkantolo ikwazi ukwenza isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi obubalulekile buhlinzeka ngazo zonke izinkcukacha nezinto ezingasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. Umthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimo kanye nokulawulwa kokuthi izimo zethulwa kanjani ngendlela ethembekile. Iziqephu zingethulwa zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto ezibalulekile. Umfanekiso olandelayo ukhombisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezigaba zomthetho; ukhombisa ukuthi iMthethweni Wobufakazi ihlangana kanjani nezigaba, incazelo yeMthethweni Wobufakazi, kanye nophawu lokuthi yini eyakha ubufakazi obubalulekile nokuthi yini equkethwe. Iphikiso elethulwa yisimo kanye neqembu lokuvikela alibhekwa njengobufakazi kodwa liyisithako esisiza enqubweni yokwenza isinqumo. Le mbono yakhiwa ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihloselwe ukugcizelela isimo somthetho noma izimo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukuze ithonya ukucabangela kwenkantolo uma ikhipha isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi isinqumo sithathwe, amaqembu anethuba lokwethula iphikiso lokugcina elihlobene nobufakazi obunikezwe kuleli cala eliqhubekayo. Iziqephu zecala yilezo ezethulwe yiphathi ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi ukuze winwe leli cala. Iziqephu zivame ukuhambisa ubufakazi noma ukuziphikisa. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihlobene nobudlelwano bobaba, ubuhlanga bababa buzoba yindaba ezoxoxwa, futhi ubudlelwano bezocansi nobaba kuzoba iphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobudlelwano bobaba. Ubufakazi obuqinisekisayo buchaza ubufakazi obuqinile noma ukuthi akukho okungcono kunobufakazi obukhona. Ubufakazi obuphikiswa buchaza ukuthi kukhona okungcono noma ukuthi bekukhona. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ibhekwa njengobufakazi obuqinisekisayo, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti athathwa njengobufakazi obuphikiswa. Igama elithi "prima facie" liyisisho sesiLatini esisho "ngokokuqala." Isisho esithi ubufakazi obucacile emthethweni sisho ukuthi ubufakazi obunikezwe phambi kwenkantolo bufanele ukusungula isimo noma icala ngaphandle kokuthi kube nobufakazi obuphikisana. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisana, ubufakazi obucacile luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, ubufakazi bungakhombisa ukuthi u-A wayenombono wokubulala u-B futhi wabonwa ephuma endlini ka-B enekhefu elibomvu. U-X ubonisa ukuthi wezwa ingilazi iphuka futhi waphendukela ukubona u-Y emi phambi kwefasitela eliphukile lika-Z, lapho u-Y ebambe itshe esandleni sakhe. Ubufakazi obuqondile buyilokho okubonwe umshushisi. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, u-C ubonisa ukuthi wayemi ngaphandle kwendlu ka-B ngesikhathi ebona u-A emshaya u-B. Ukufaneleka kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi, futhi akukho mthetho wokukala izinga lokufaneleka kobufakazi. Ubufakazi bungamukeleka noma bungamukeleki. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi bumukeleka noma bungamukeleki sincike ekutheni bukhona obuhambelana nezimo zecala noma ukuthi ukwamukelwa kwabo kuzobeka umsolwa engcupheni. Kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi ngokusekelwe ezimweni ezizokwenelisa ekupheleni kwecala. Uma isimo singanelisi, lelo bufakazi alithathwa njengelungile. Inkantolo yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzweni komsolwa nakuba ukuvuma kwephepha kwaphikiswa iqembu lokuvikela. Ngemuva kokuthi icala liphothuliwe, umsolwa uzoba nethuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nokuvuma kwephepha. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisana nokuvuma kwephepha, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi esivela ngemuva kokubuzwa sizosuswa yinkantolo. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi okufanele, inkantolo izocabanga ukuthi ubufakazi obunikezwe buhamba kanjani nezimo zecala. Igunya liyilungelo noma umthwalo odingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu uma bethula ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zegunya. Igunya lomuntu siqu kanye negunya lesimo. Ukwamukelwa kwenkantolo kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphakathi kwenkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqinisekisayo futhi engakwazi ukuphikiswa noma ukuhoxiswa ngaphandle kokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho ezithile. Ukwamukelwa kwangaphandle kubhekisela ekwamukelweni okwenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo okuthintwa ukuphikiswa noma ukungqubuzana. Ukuphika kweqiniso kuwumsebenzi lapho umsolwa evuma ngokuphelele nangaphandle kokungabaza ukwenza lesi senzo, okungathi uma senziwa phambi kwenkantolo kuzobhekwa njengokuvuma icala. Isaziso senkantolo sikhombisa lapho inkantolo yamukela izimo ezaziwayo nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa lungakagcwaliswa ngobufakazi ngesikhathi sokubuzwa. Isinqumo sokukholwa siwukwenza isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni ezithile ezisunguliwe ngumthetho. Umthwalo wobufakazi ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emthwalweni weqembu ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi obuqinisekisayo, emthethweni wobugebengu lo mthwalo ubekwa ezandleni zabameli bezokuhlola. Umthwalo wobufakazi obubalulekile ubhekisela emthwalweni noma emthwalweni wokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze inkantolo ibize umsolwa ukuba aphendule ezinsolweni futhi ithole ubufakazi obanele ukuze iphikise lelo bufakazi elicacile elithulwe yiphathi evula leli cala.
Umnyango wezobulungiswa ungowesigaba sokuphepha lapho indawo yokusebenza kweziteshi zamaphoyisa ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezincane, ezilawulwayo ezaziwa njengamasektha. I-SAPS izothumela uphoyisa, owaziwa njengomphathi wesigaba, kuzo zonke izigaba. Imiphakathi nabaphathi bezigaba bazoba ngababambiqhaza abenza okuthile ukuze baqinisekise ukuphepha nokuvikeleka endaweni abahlala kuyo. Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela umphakathi esigabeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo zokulwa nobugebengu bendawo njengokuhlanganyela. Ukuze kube nesixhumanisi phakathi komphakathi wesigaba kanye nesiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo. Ukuze usebenze njengomphakathi ophumelelayo, ophatha zonke izinhlelo nezinhlelo ezibhekene nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze uxoxe ngezinhlelo zokusebenza nomphathi wesigaba ukuze ubhekane nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze uqinisekise futhi ubambe iqhaza emicimbini yasendaweni ukuze ugcine indawo abahlala kuyo iphephile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nezicebiso zokuvikela ubugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze usekele ngempela umnyango wezobulungiswa wezivolontiya ezindaweni. Ukuze uxhumane nomphathi wesigaba wakho ukuze wenze indawo ophila kuyo iphephile. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi bendawo, amaqembu omphakathi, izinhlangano zabahlali, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi bencitshwa ukuba babambe iqhaza emizamweni yokubhekana nezinkinga eziholela ebubini esigabeni sakho. I-NAFVSA inengxenye yokweseka umphakathi, ehlinzeka zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo ababuya emiphakathini eyayithintekile ngodlame, ngemininingwane nezidingo. Ngokwakha ubudlelwano nezinye izikhungo ezikhiqiza amafilimu, le ndawo ihlose ukufinyelela kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. I-archive kazwelonke egcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nolwazi olurekhodiwe lwezwi ibamba iqhaza emikhankasweni ehlukene. Izikhungo zemfundo zimenyiwe ukuba zibuke amafilimu futhi zixoxe nganoma yimaphi amagatsha abona kufanele abhekwe. Lokhu kwenziwe ngokuxhumana nothisha nabafundisi. Inhloso enkulu yale ngxenye yokweseka umphakathi ukulethela "izindawo zokubuka amafilimu kubantu," okuzoletha inzuzo emiphakathini. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinye izikhungo ezifana nezikole, imikhakha efanele, amaqembu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukufinyelela emiphakathini yasemakhaya engazi ukuthi le archive ingakwenza kanjani njengoba nayo inamalungelo okuthola ulwazi. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukusebenzisa Izikhungo Zobuciko Bomphakathi, ezisungulwe nguMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, ukuze ifinyelele le njongo. Izikhala zomphakathi, izikole, nezindawo zomphakathi nazo zizosebenza. Siphakamisa umphakathi nanoma ubani ofisa ukwazi ngomlando kanye nomlando waleli zwe ukuthi axhumane nathi uma efisa ukucela ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zalesi sikhungo sokugcina, i-NAFVSA. I-NAFVSA inengxenye egxile ekuqinisekiseni umlando orekhodwe osevele ugcwalise izikhala endabeni yethu yomlando. Kuxoxiswane nabantu abanolwazi ngezihloko ezihlukene ezihlobene namasiko, ubuciko, umlando, kanye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuqoqwa, ukugcina, nokusabalalisa umculo wendabuko kuyakhuthazwa ngohlelo lwethu olubizwa ngokuthi i-Traditional Musical Instrument Exhibition. Ukuqoqwa kwezinto ezirekhodiwe ze-audio nezibukwayo (zomphakathi nezingezona zomphakathi) nezinye izenzo ezihlobene ezikhiqizwe noma ezihlobene neNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika zifinyelela kulezi zirekhodi futhi zikhuthazwe ukuthi zisetshenziswe nguwo wonke umuntu. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezigcina lezi zirekhodi. I-NAFVSA inegumbi lokucwaninga lapho abacwaningi bengathola usizo lwezinhlobo zonke uma befuna ulwazi, futhi bangakwazi futhi ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe kumakhompyutha mahhala. Ukubuka nokulalela izinto ezishicilelwe kumele kuhlelwe kusenesikhathi. Udinga ukwazisa isikhungo okungenani ezinsukwini ezintathu ngaphambi kokulungiselela lokho ofuna ukukusebenzisa futhi ufake kumishini efanele. Lezi zinto zingasetshenziswa kuphela ezindaweni ze-NAFVSA futhi kuzokwenziwa imali ethile ethathwe nguMnyango Wezezimali. Abafundi nabafundi bangasebenzisa lezi zinto mahhala, kodwa badinga futhi ukuhlela ngaphambi kokulalela nokubuka. Imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kubadali iyadingeka uma othile efuna ukukopisha into ethile. Ibhuku lethu linamabhuku angama-3000 ayinqaba ahlobene nomkhakha wefilimu, oqalwe kudala ngesikhathi seNational Film Board, futhi izinto ezingahlangene azikhiphwayo nhlobo ngenxa yokubaluleka kwazo. Nokho, wonke amabhuku ebhuku angabukwa ku-Archive yeNational Heritage, futhi amakhophi angakhiqizwa ngentengo ephansi. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo lamaphosta amafilimu ahlukaniswe cishe ayizinkulungwane, aqala ngesikhathi sikaDe Voortrekkers, okuyifilimu endala eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi lamaphosta lawo ngempela alingabazekayo futhi ahlobene nawo wonke amakhono amafilimu akhiqizwe ezweni lethu. Inhloso ye-archive ngala maphosta ukuwurekhoda ngokuqondile futhi uwagcine eqoqweni lapho angasetshenziswa khona ngaphandle kokuthathwa. Njengokuqoqwa kwamaphosta, i-Archive ineqoqo lezithombe ezihlobene namafilimu kuleli zwe. Izithombe zezifilimu ezingama-1916 ezikhiqizwe kuleli zwe zingatholakala lapha. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo leziqu zezifilimu ezedlule cishe eziyi-1200 ezikhiqizwe kuleli zwe. Iningi leziqu lisesigabeni sokukhiqiza, ngaleyo ndlela lihluke kakhulu kumkhiqizo ophelile olungile ukubukwa. I-NAFVSA iphinde ibe umgcinimafa wezirekhodi zamaphephandaba, okuhlanganisa imibhalo, iziqeshana ezikhethiwe ezivela kumaphephandaba, izithombe, izinhlelo, nezikhumbuzo ezihlobene nezindawo zokusebenza, umculo, ubuciko, nezandla. Iningi lezi zinto kulesi sigaba laqala ngokuqhamuka kwabantu kanye nezikhungo ezizimele ezinomsebenzi wezobuciko nezandla. I-NAFVSA iyingqayizivele ngoba ingesinye sezikhungo ezincane emhlabeni ezigcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nezirekhodi ezilalelwayo ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa. Ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lolwazi olukhombisa umlando wesizwe sethu eNingizimu Afrika ngezithombe kube usizo futhi kuzokwenza kube umthombo omkhulu wezizukulwane ezizayo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Baphinde bakwazi ukubheka kalula emuva kulokho okwenzeka esikhathini esedlule, futhi lokhu kungab placing them in a position to speculate on what the film and tape industry will look like in the future. Ngenxa yokushintsha okusheshayo kwezobuchwepheshe, imishini esetshenziswe eminyakeni engama-20 edlule manje isiphukile, kodwa ingasetshenziswa ukuze ihlinzeke ngolwazi lomlando, kanye nokubonisa ukuthuthuka nezinguquko embonini ye-filimu, ividiyo, kanye ne-tape.
MANJE, ngokulandela isigaba 14 seMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000, uSihlalo weBhodi Yamanzi, njengomsebenzi wombuso weBhodi Yamanzi, kumele abhale incwadi ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi oluhambisana neBhodi Yamanzi. NGAKWAZI, MANJE uSihlalo weBhodi Yamanzi uletha lokhu, emphakathini, incwadi yeBhodi Yamanzi ngenhloso yokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe yiBhodi Yamanzi, njengoba kuchazwe ngaphansi komthetho. Ukulalelwa kwezicelo zokukhokhelwa njengoba kuchazwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Isicelo sokukhokhelwa kumele sithunyelwe kwiBhodi Yamanzi phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela esinqumweni esithathwe yiziphathimandla ezibhekelelayo. IBhodi Yamanzi inegunya lokunquma inani lokukhokhelwa kanye nenani elizokhokhwa kulandela lesi sigaba. Azikho izinsiza ezikhona. Izinsiza zizolandela umsebenzi. Uma ummangali enganelisekile nganoma yisiphi isinqumo mayelana nolwazi, ummangali angafaka isikhalazo kuNgqongqoshe Wamanzi Nezihlahla kulandela isigaba 74 seMthetho. Uma ummangali (ummangali) enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe Wamanzi Nezihlahla, angaphikisa leso sinqumo enkantolo kulandela izigaba 79 kuya ku-82 zeMthetho. Ummangali noma noma ubani omunye angafaka icala emaphoyiseni kulandela isigaba 90 seMthetho.
Ikomishana yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithole igunya ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo ka-1996 ukuze ikhuthaze futhi iqinisekise amazinga aphezulu okuziphatha kwabantu abaphakathi kwezikhundla ezisebenzela isizwe. Ngonyaka ka-1997, ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi kwamenyezelwa futhi kwathuthukiswa ngokubizelwa kwemifundaze kanye nezomthetho ezingeni lesizwe nelokishi. Kwakubalulekile ukuthuthukisa incwadi yokuhola mayelana nokuziphatha ukuze kusizakale abantu ukuba baqonde kahle futhi basebenzise lokhu. Ngalesi sikhathi seKomishana esisebenzela isizwe, ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukwethula incwadi echaza ukuziphatha okufanele kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyisisekelo esiyisisekelo sokuphatha kanye nezindlela ezifanele zokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Lokhu kuziphatha futhi kuveza izindaba ezifana nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, umthetho, ukuzinikela, ukuvuleka kukahulumeni, ukuziphatha komuntu siqu, nokujabulela okukhethekile. IKomishana yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi icela bonke abasebenzi, kusukela kulabo abaphansi kakhulu kuya kulabo abaphezulu, ukuba baveze ukuqonda okubonakalayo kwenqubo, imigomo, nemiyalo equkethwe ekuziphatheni okufanele. Lokhu akusizi kuphela kodwa kungasivumela ukuba sihlangabezane nezidingo ezifanele zabantu bethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi labo abaphakathi kwezikhundla benze izinto ngokomthetho, baphumelele ekwamukeleni amathuba nezipho, njengoba lokhu kungabonwa njengokukhwabanisa. Sifuna ukuhlabela bonke abaphathi nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla abahileleke ekukhuthazeni ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Ngiyakhuthaza ukuthi niqhubeke nisebenza kahle ngaphandle kokuphenduka ezinselelweni zokuthuthukisa ikhodi yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. IKomishana yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithemba ukuthi le ncwadi echazayo izoba yisikhombandlela esifanele ekukhuthazeni ubuqotho nokwethembeka endaweni yokusebenza futhi futhi idale amathuba amahle kithi sonke ukuze sifinyelele isiko lokungabekezelelani nokukhwabanisa eNingizimu Afrika. Ekugcineni, ngifisa bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi baqinisekise ukuthi ukuziphatha okufanele kuhambisana nendlela evumelekile yokuphatha nokuphatha umphakathi futhi bazi kahle ukuziphatha okufanele kanye nale ncwadi echazayo. Umphathi: IKomishana yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Iminyango kazwelonke kanye nezifunda iyasekela ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi echazayo futhi iphinde ibe negalelo elibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni kwayo. Ihhovisi leMphakathi elivikelayo liphinde lenze igalelo ekuthuthukisweni kwalolu documet ngemicabango ebalulekile. Izinhlangano nezinyunyana zabasebenzi bomphakathi zibe nezinhlangano eziningi nemifundaze futhi zenze iziphakamiso ezibalulekile. Ekugcineni, siyabonga ukwesekwa kukahulumeni waseBrithani ekuthuthukiseni izizwe zangaphandle ngokuhlinzeka ngemali yokushicilela le ncwadi echazayo mayelana nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuveza kahle okuqukethwe kokuziphatha okufanele. Ukusungula ukuziphatha okufanele ngokomthetho kudinga isibindi, ukuqonda, kanye nohlelo lwezaga ezisemthethweni. Le ncwadi ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bomphakathi baqonda kahle lokhu kuziphatha. Le ncwadi ayethuli imithetho emisha noma ilandele isakhiwo nemithetho efana nedokhumenti ephathelene nokuziphatha, ukuze kube lula ukuhlukanisa. Lapho usebenzisa le ncwadi, iminyango kumele izame ukufaka izibonelo zabo ezihambisana nomongo wabo wendawo. Kubalulekile ukuthi kuthathwe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi kuyinqubo ebalulekile futhi kuzodingeka ukuthi kuhlolwe njalo, njengokukhodi yokuziphatha. Ekukhuthazeni amazinga aphezulu okuziphatha okufanele endaweni yokusebenza, abasebenzi kumele bakhuthazwe ukuba bacabange futhi baziphathe kahle. Ngakho-ke, le ncwadi kufanele ibonwe njengethuluzi ekuthuthukiseni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono okufundisa kubo bonke abasebenzi. Le ncwadi iphinde iqukate izibonelo ezikhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele endaweni yokusebenza okufanele kuthathwe njengesisekelo sokufundisa nezifundo eziphumelele. Njengomngane wokuziphatha, le ncwadi izosiza ukuqinisekisa ukuzethemba okuqotho nokungakhethi phakathi kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuncane kokuziphatha okuvumelekile nokubonakalayo. Kuyinto evunyelwe ukuthi umuntu ufunda ngokwazi nokwenza. Umsebenzi obalulekile ubekwa kumqashi, ikakhulukazi labo abanamandla okwenza (Abaqondisi kanye neMECs) ezingeni lezombusazwe, kanye nabaphathi ezingeni lonke lezinsizakalo zomphakathi, ukuze kudaleke indawo lapho indlela efanele yokuziphatha ingaboniswa khona futhi isibonelo esihle sithathwe kubo bonke abasebenzi. Isigaba 195 (a) soMthethosisekelo sidinga ukuthi kuthuthukiswe futhi kugcinwe amazinga aphezulu okuziphatha. Mayelana nesivumelwano esivamile (Isixazululo sePublic Service Coordinating Bargaining Council 2 sika-1999), bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi banendima yokudlala ekulandeleni izimiso ezichazwe ekuziphatheni okufanele. Njengoba lokhu kuyisisekelo esibalulekile esakhiwe ekwenzeni kahle nasekuziphatheni kahle, umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi kahle ukuziphatha okufanele. Kubalulekile ukugcizelela ukuthi umgomo oyinhloko wokuziphatha ukuthi okwamukelekayo, okungukuthi ukukhuthaza isibonelo esihle sokuziphatha. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, umqashi angase azithole noma abhekane nezinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele mayelana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo, bese ethola icala ngaphansi kwezindawo ezingu-18 kuya ku-27 eziphakanyiswe ekuziphatheni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi zika-1997, uma umuntu engalandeli ukuziphatha okufanele okwakhiwe. Umqashi kumele abe nesithakazelo kwiRiphabhulikhi futhi ahloniphe noMthethosisekelo ngenkathi egcina noma ewamukela imisebenzi abekwe kuyo nsuku zonke. Lokhu kuhambisana neRiphabhulikhi kumele kubonakale njengokuhambisana ne "zinsizakalo zomphakathi" eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisidingo esiyinhloko esiveza ubuqotho bonke abasebenzi. UMthethosisekelo uhambisana nalezi zindaba eziphathelene namalungelo nezinto ezanelisayo kubo bonke obala. Lezi zinkomba zokuziphatha zidinga kuphela ubuqotho babantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi enhlanganweni yokuphatha ngaphansi kohlelo lwezombusazwe. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuthi umthethosisekelo wamukelwe futhi uhlonishwe bonke. Okwesithathu, bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi kumele baqonde kahle okuqukethwe nenhloso yoMthethosisekelo njengendlela yokuvikela nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle. Isibonelo 1: Abasebenzi bomphakathi ezingeni elihlukene bavunyelwe ukuhwebelana futhi benze iziphakamiso mayelana nezinqubomgomo. Lezi ziphakamiso kumele zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphikisi umoya noma izinhlinzeko ezithile zoMthethosisekelo. UMthethosisekelo mayelana nokuhwebelana nomphakathi nokuvuleka ezisebenzelweni kumele kulandelwe kahle ekwakhiweni okuqhubekayo kwezinqubomgomo. Isibonelo 2: Is
