Amalungu omphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele ayamenywa ukuba aphakamise amalungu eNational Heritage Council (NHC). Inhloso ye-NHC ukuhlinzeka, ukuthuthukisa, nokuvikela ifa lemvelo laseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuletha ukulingana ekuphathweni kwefa lemvelo. Izothola ukuvunywa kwephalamende kwiMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko futhi izohlinzeka, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngoxhaso lwezimali ngezimali ezithunyelwa ngababhalisi ezikhungweni nakumaphrojekthi/imisebenzi ngaphansi kwazo ezithunyelwe. I-NHC yasungulwa njengomzimba wezomthetho ngaphansi kweNational Heritage Council Act ka-1999 (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999). Amalungu e-NHC azoba nesibopho sokuphumeza izinhlinzeko zalesi simiso futhi kulindeleke ukuthi azijwayeze ukuphathwa kwe-NHC ngokuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999). Abaphakanyisiwe kumele babe nolwazi emkhakheni wefa lemvelo, amasiko okukhuluma, umlando, nokuvikelwa, kumele bahlonishwe ngalesi sikhungo emkhakheni wefa lemvelo, kumele baziwe njengabantu abanesithunzi abazinikele ekuvikeleni nasekuvikelweni kwefa lethu eliyingqayizivele lemvelo, futhi akumele babe nesikhundla kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yezepolitiki. Amalungu e-NHC awazotholi umholo wanyanga zonke kodwa azokhokhelwa izindleko ezithathwe emsebenzini wabo ne-NHC. Amalungu azothola futhi uphawu lokubonga ngempumelelo yabo. Ikhompuyutha yokukhetha izosungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze idale uhlu lweziphakanyisiwe zayo yonke indawo, kulandelwe izingxoxo zomphakathi nezasezifundazweni. Incazelo yeKomidi esunguliwe izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kuhlanganisa wakhiwo ezivela kuzo zonke izigaba ze-heritage kazwelonke, zonke izindawo, nobulili bobabili, nokuthi ukukhethwa okuphelele kusezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu. Ikhompuyutha yokukhetha izozisa uhlu lwezithakazelo ezingu-15 kuNgqongqoshe, ozokwenza ukukhethwa kokugcina kwe-NHC kulolu hlu. Okungenani amalungu amahlanu e-NHC angakhethwa ngale ndlela, futhi i-MEC enesibopho sefa lemvelo nokuvikelwa kwazo zonke izifundazwe kumele ikhethe ummeleli oyedwa kulowo mhlaba. a Incwadi equkethe amagama aphelele, ikheli, izinombolo zocingo, nezifakazelo zabaphakanyisiwe, kanye nezizathu zokuphakanyiswa kwabo. b I-curriculum vitae noma umlando ophathelene nezimpilo zomphakanyisi ochaza iziqu zabo zokubekwa. c Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe, esibonisa ukuvuma kokuphakanyiswa. d Amagama nezixhumanisi zababoni ababili. Akukho ukuphakanyiswa okuzokwamukelwa uma konke okukhulunywe ngenhla kungafakiwe. Ukuphakanyiswa kumele kufike kuMphakathi Osebenzayo, uMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, ngaphambi kosuku lwe-14 kuFebhuwari 2003.
Ukutholakala kolwazi eState kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umphakathi wenza izinqumo ezicacile, okukh leads to a responsive and satisfying Government. I-Department of Labour, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 14 se-Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (Act 2 of 2000) ("umthetho"), idale le bhukwana elichazayo ukusiza amalungu omphakathi athintekayo ukufinyelela ulwazi oluvela kwi-Department abaludinga. I-Department of Labour iholwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMisebenzi oqokwe nguMongameli ngokuhambisana nesigaba 912 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 Act -108 yeMthethosisekelo. Ngokuvamile, uMongameli uqoka ngokuhambisana nesigaba 12 sePublic Service Act, 1994 kanye neMthethosisekelo. UDirector-General unabasebenzi abane abaxhasi abaphatha uMthetho Wezabasebenzi kanye noMkhiqizo Wezabasebenzi, Ukulethwa Kwezinsizakalo, Izinsizakalo Ehlanganisiwe, kanye Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Nokuqashwa ngokulandelana. Ngokuvamile, ungumHead of the Office of Information osunguliwe. Imininingwane esekela lo Head of the Office of Information itholakala esigabeni C ngezansi. Futhi isikhala sezomnotho sokuthuthukiswa komkhiqizo. UDirector-General uqokwa njengomhead we-ofisi yolwazi, njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 1(a)(ii) somthetho. Abaphathi abaphakeme bangabasebenzi abaxhasi bomhead we-ofisi yolwazi osunguliwe, njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 17 somthetho. Abasebenzi abaphezulu basungulwa ukuba babe abasebenzi abaxhasi boMhead we-ofisi yolwazi njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 17 somthetho. Futhi iNational Economic Development and Labour Council Act, 1994 (Act 35 of 1994). Ikhuthaza amalungelo emthethweni ukuze kuphathwe kahle emsebenzini njengoba kutholakala esigabeni 23 seMthethosisekelo, nemithetho ephethe izindinganiso ezincane zomsebenzi, ukuvimbela nokuxazulula izingxabano. Isethula isikhala sokutshalwa kwezimali ezindaweni zendawo nezinhlelo zokusebenza ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa nokwandisa amakhono abasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika. Iphatha zonke izinguquko ezibalulekile ezenzeka emnothweni nasemthethweni wezomnotho ngaphambi kokutshalwa kwezimali noma ukwethulwa kwiPhalamende; futhi ikhuthaza futhi ivikela ukusungulwa kwesikhala somthetho esihlangene ezindabeni zokuhlalisana komphakathi nezomnotho. I-Commission on Human Rights yaseNingizimu Afrika idingeka ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa wezilimi ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika ukusiza bonke abantu abafuna ukusebenzisa amalungelo abo ukufinyelela ulwazi, labo abangase badinge lokho ekusebenziseni amalungelo abo. Noma ubani ofuna ukufinyelela ulwazi olutholakala kwi-Department angaxhumana noMhead we-ofisi yolwazi noma noMphathi we-ofisi yolwazi. Ulwazi ngababengabantu ababakhokhele. Imibiko yokuhlola izingozi emsebenzini. Futhi uhlelo lokuxhaswa oluvela kuNational Skills Fund. Ulwazi ngohlelo lweNhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. Futhi izivumelwano zesizwe ezibanjwe yiNingizimu Afrika nezinye izizwe kanye/noma izinhlangano. Futhi ama-brochure, ama-pamphlet, kanye namabhukwana akhishwe yi-Department. Iziqinisekiso zebhajethi, izindleko, kanye nezicabangela ze-Department. Ukufinyelela, ukuthenga; kanye nezenzo zemakethe yezabasebenzi. Imibiko ngeMakethe Yezabasebenzi. Lezi zinsizakalo zitholakala kuzo zonke izikhungo ze-Department ezisemaphandleni, ezikhona kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye. Futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezindinganiso ezincane zomsebenzi, ezempilo, kanye nemithetho yokuphepha. Lezi zinsizakalo zinikezwa ehhovisi elikhulu le-Department ePitoli nasezikhungweni zamasipala. Futhi ukuqapha ukusebenza kweMnyango Wezemfundo Nezokuthuthukiswa. Izinkantolo zomsebenzi zinikeza izinsizakalo zokukhishwa kwezinsizakalo. Ulwazi ngama-ofisi e-CCMA nezinkantolo zomsebenzi lutholakala kunoma iyiphi ye-Department's Offices ezisemaphandleni noma ehhovisi layo elikhulu. Ulwazi oluvela kwi-Department lungatholwa ngokwenza isicelo ngendlela efanele, etholakala kuzo zonke izikhungo ze-Department ezisemaphandleni, futhi kufanele kuthunyelwe kuMhead we-ofisi yolwazi noma kuMphathi we-ofisi yolwazi kuleli khetho elishiwo esigabeni C ngenhla. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele aqedele yonke imininingwane efomini ukuze uMhead we-ofisi yolwazi akwazi ukubona ulwazi oluceliwe. Iziqinisekiso ezihlobene nempilo yomfaki-sicelo nokuthi umfaki-sicelo uyasizwa noma ucela usizo komunye umuntu. Futhi ukuveza umbono ngomthetho ophakanyisiwe, okhuthaza ukubhaliswa kwezinyunyana nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ngokuvumelana nemininingwane yokuxhumana enikeziwe, thumela ukukhala kuPublic Protector. Noma ubani ongachazwa kahle nganoma iyiphi okuqukethwe lapha angaxhumana noMhead we-ofisi yolwazi noma osizayo bakhe kunoma iyiphi ye-Department's Provincial Offices ukuze athole usizo.
Yini inhloso yokubamba umuntu? Inhloso yokubamba umuntu ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsolwa ubonakala enkantolo. Umuntu obanjwe ubhekwa njengomuntu ongenacala kuze kube kufakazelwa ukuthi unecala. Ngalesi sizathu, wonke umuntu obanjwe kufanele aphathwe kahle futhi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Kukhona amaposta azisa ngamalungelo abantu ababanjwe. Iposi kufanele ibekwe odongeni ngaphambi kokuqala kwalesi sikhathi. Inhloso yalolu suku ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezihlosiwe zalesi sikhathi. Lesi sigaba 38 seMthetho Wokuhamba Kwezigwegwe siphinde sinikeze ezinye izindlela ezingcono zokubamba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvela enkantolo. Lezi zindlela kufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokukhetha ukubamba ngoba isigaba 36 (e) seMthethosisekelo sikhombisa ukuthi umuntu kumele acabangele izindlela ezingaphazamisi kakhulu ukuze afinyelele inhloso (kulokhu, ukuqinisekisa ukuvela komuntu enkantolo). Ukubamba kufanele kube yindlela yokugcina. Ukubamba akusiyo indlela yokukhipha umuntu emphakathini okwethula isikhala, futhi akusiyo indlela yokujezisa. Umuntu angabanjwa ngokwephephandaba noma ngaphandle kwephephandaba. Khumbula ukuthi kuhle kakhulu ukuthola iphepha lokubamba. Okuhle ngakho ukuthi kuvikela amapolisa ekubanjweni icala futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukubamba nokuthola ubufakazi kusemthethweni. Iphepha lokubamba lingatholwa kumgibeli noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukugcina ukuthula, okungabandakanya uphiko lwezokuphepha oluphakeme. Inhloso yalolu suku ukuhamba phambili ngenkulumo mayelana nenhloso yokubamba umuntu nezinye izindlela zokwenza ukuthi bavele enkantolo. Yini inhloso yokubamba umuntu? Yini okusho ukuthi umuntu ubhekwa njengomuntu ongenacala? Yiziphi ezinye izindlela, ngaphandle kokubamba, ezingaqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu obhekene necala ubonakala enkantolo? Cela abafundi ukuthi baphendule umbiko ngalokho abaxoxile. Phatha ingxoxo bese uqedela. Izinto ezidingekayo ngesikhathi sokuphetha. Akukho mfuneko yokuxhumana nomuntu ovuma ngesikhathi ebambwa. Uma umuntu ephikisa ukubamba, kungasetshenziswa amandla afanele (amandla amancane) ukuze kwenziwe ukubamba. Umphakathi obamba kufanele, ngokushesha okukhulu, azise umuntu obanjwe ngesizathu sokubamba. Uma umuntu ebambwa ngaphansi kwephephandaba, ikhophi kufanele inikezwe uma iceliwe. Umuntu obanjwe kufanele aziswe ngamalungelo akhe ngokushesha okukhulu (njengoba kungenzeka kahle kulolu simo) njengoba kuqinisekiswe esigabeni 35 seMthethosisekelo. Amapolisa kumele azise futhi achaze la malungelo wonke kumuntu obanjwe futhi aqinisekise ukuthi uyawuqonda ngokuhambisana nesigaba 35 seMthethosisekelo. Ukubhekwa njengomuntu ongenacala kuhambisana nelungelo lokungazibandakanyi futhi nelungelo lokuhlala silent. Umuntu obhekene necala akaphoqwa ukusiza isimo kulolu daba. Uma isimo sishaya umuntu, kufanele sithole ubufakazi obuqinile bokuthi umuntu unecala. Inhloso yalolu suku iwukuthi amapolisa acabangele amalungelo abantu abanjwe kanye nezibopho abahlangabezana nazo mayelana nalabo abanjwe. Yini indlela efanele yokubamba umuntu? Yiziphi amalungelo nezibopho zomuntu obanjwe? Yini indima yamapolisa lapho bebamba umuntu? Yini okufanele amapolisa azise umuntu obanjwe ngesikhathi sokubamba? Nini futhi kuphi umuntu obanjwe angafaka isicelo sokukhululwa? Yiziphi amalungelo omuntu obanjwe angaphulwa? Lezi z права zingaphulwa kanjani? Phatha ingxoxo ejwayelekile mayelana nezinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubamba, uqale ngamandla amancane angasetshenziswa. Nini amapolisa angashaya umuntu ophumayo? Ingabe amandla angasetshenziswa uma kuseshwa umuntu obanjwe? Uma umuntu engavumi, amapolisa kufanele kuqala ashaye phezulu ukuze abambelele, kodwa lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngaphandle kokubeka muntu engcupheni. Uma umuntu eqhubeka nokuphuma, khona-ke bangashaywa. Kufanele uzame ukuhlela ngendlela engakubulali, njengokushaya emlenzeni. Inhloso yalolu suku ukuhamba phambili ngenkulumo mayelana nezinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubamba. Cela abafundi ukuthi baxoxe ngezinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa lapho bebamba umuntu, uqale ngamandla amancane. Sebenzisa amandla afanele. Sebenzisa leyo mandla kuphela edingekayo ukuvikela wena kanye nabantu ongenacala abakuzungezile futhi ukuze uthole impumelelo yokubamba umuntu. Kufanele usebenzise amandla kuphela adingekayo ukuze ugweme ingozi, ukuphikisana, nokuvikela wena. Izinga lamandla lihluka ngokwezigameko zengozi, ukuphikisana, nokuhlasela. Uma umuntu ephikisa ukubamba, izinga lokungabaza lingaba nendima enkulu ekunqumeni ukuthi yikuphi izinga lamandla okusetshenziswa. Kukhona izinhlobo zamandla ezingafanele ukusetshenziswa uma kuwukwephula okuncane. Sebenzisa kuphela amandla amancane. Uma umuntu engaphikisi ukubamba, ngisho namandla amancane akufanele asetshenziswe. Lezi zindlela ezilandelayo zichaza umgomo wesidingo futhi zikhombisa izinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubamba. Uma umuntu echaza ukuthi ungumgibeli ngokubona noma ngokukhuluma, noma ngokuhola noma ngokukhuthaza. Uma amapolisa eyala noma etshela umuntu ukuthi enze okuthile. (Isibonelo: uma umsolwa ebaleka futhi amapolisa eqhwaga ukuthi umume). Izindlela ezinezingcuphe ezincane zokulimala. Isibonelo: Uma amapolisa efaka isandla esifubeni somuntu futhi emtshela ukuthi angahambi. Izindlela ezingase zibe nomthelela. Ukusebenzisa amandla, ubuhlungu ukuze umuntu avume, ukuhudula nezindlela zokucindezela, nezindlela zokuphatha ezinzima lapho kuxoxwa ngezitho zomzimba. Ukubamba umuntu ngemuva kwekhanda uma ungumgibeli oqeqeshiwe, noma enye ingxenye/ukwehla/ukuphuma kwempilo okwenziwa ngendlela edinga ingcindezi ezindaweni ezibucayi ukuze kuvinjelwe leyo ngxenye yesikhathi esithile ngenkathi ngesikhathi esifanayo kuthinta ingqondo okwesikhashana. Ezinye izindlela zikhubaza ukuhamba okwesikhashana noma zilawule ukusebenza. Amabhola e-rubber/izikhali ezithinta njengokugunyazwa ngalesi sikhathi asetshenziswa ngababheki abaqeqeshiwe. Ukucindezela ngamandla/izikhali noma izindlela zokuphila ezingase ziphelelwe "ekufeni noma ekulimazeni okukhulu". Sebenzisa kuphela amandla adingekayo ukuvikela wena kanye nalabo ongenacala abakuzungezile ngesikhathi sokubamba. Ngesikhathi sokubamba, kungase kwenzeke ukuthi amapolisa azithole edinga ukuvikela. Khumbula ukuthi usebenzisa kuphela amandla adingekayo ukuvikela wena nabantu ongenacala abakuzungezile. Ingabe ukusetshenziswa kwamandla bekufanele kulolu simo? Ingabe bekukhona ukuvumelana phakathi kwesidingo samandla nenani lamandla asetshenziswe? Umphikisi wathola kanjani? Ingabe amandla asetshenziswe ngendlela efanele futhi enengqondo noma kwasetshenziswa ngokweqile, ngaphandle kwesidingo, noma ngenkani? Lokhu kuyindaba ebucayi. Isigaba 49 se-CPA sisaphenywa. Okuqukethwe kwalokhu kuphendula kungashintsha. UMthethosisekelo (isigaba 11) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila. Ngakho-ke, amapolisa angashaya umphikisi kuphela ezimweni ezikhethekile kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umthetho uvumela ini mayelana nokushaya umuntu ophum
Lo mbhalo ochazayo ushintshwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("Lo Mthetho"). Uqukethe ulwazi mayelana ne-SAMSA nenqubo yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umthetho Wokuphepha Kwezokuthutha Kolwandle ka-1998 wasungula i-SAMSA ngo-April 1998. Sinomthwalo wokubika kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, osethula ibhodi yethu futhi uvuma uhlelo lwethu lwebhizinisi lweminyaka. Ibhodi ibeka uMphathi Omkhulu (CEO) wethu, onemfanelo yokuphatha nezinhlelo. Inhloso yethu ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabantu nezimpahla olwandle, ukuvikela nokuvimbela imvelo yasolwandle ukuthi ingcoliswe ngamahhashi, nokukhuthaza uthando lwezokuthutha kolwandle eRiphabhulikhi. Imisebenzi yethu yokusebenza ifaka: ukubhalisela nokukhishwa kwemvume yamahhashi; ukuhlola amahhashi nokukhishwa kwezitifiketi; ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bezokuthutha kolwandle nokubakhishwa kwezitifiketi; nokuvimbela ukungcoliswa kolwandle. Isigaba 10 soMthetho sidinga ukuthi iKomidi Lezokuphila Kwabantu laseNingizimu Afrika likhiphe imigomo equkethe ulwazi oludingekayo umuntu ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiluphi ilungelo ngaphansi koMthetho. Uma ufuna ukubona irekhodi elihlobene nanoma yiziphi zalezi zigaba, kufanele uqedele ifomu lesicelo elihlanganisiwe nalolu mbhalo ochazayo (kodwa bheka isigaba 7 salolu mbhalo ochazayo). Kufanele uthumele ifomu lakho eliqediwe, kanye ne-akhawunti yesicelo kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhwama (uma kudingekile), ehhovisi lolwazi kule ndawo yeposi, ngefeksi, noma kule imeyili ekhishwe esigabeni 2 salolu mbhalo ochazayo. Futhi ikheli lakho leposi noma inombolo ye-fax. Uma isicelo osithumelayo sikhuluma ngempela ngomunye umuntu, kufanele unikeze ubufakazi obanele futhi obanelisayo ukuze ubonise ukuthi unegunya lokufaka isicelo ngabo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufinyelela kumarekhodi akuyona into eyenzekayo ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi kubalulekile ukuhlangabezana nazo zonke izimfuneko zoMthetho ezihlobene nesicelo sakho. Uzokwaziswa ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele noma cha ngendlela obukhombisa ngayo efomini lakho. Noma ubani angafaka isicelo mathupha uma engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma uma engakhubazekile ngendlela yokuthi angakwazi ukuqedela ifomu. Kulokhu, abasebenzi behhovisi bazoqedela ifomu futhi banikeze usizo oludingekayo. Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi ibalwa ngokuya ngezindleko zokukhiqiza, ucwaningo, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zokuthumela. Lapho umphathi wethu ehhovisi ethola isicelo sakho sokufinyelela irekhodi, uzocela (uma ungumfaki-sicelo) ukuthi ukhokhe imali yesicelo efanele ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho processing. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uzocelwa ukuthi ukhokhe imali yokuthola irekhodi: le mali ibandakanya izindleko zokuhlola, ukukhiqiza, nezinhlelo, kanye nesikhathi esidingekayo ngaphezu kwamahora akhethiwe ukuze ucele futhi ulungiselele irekhodi ukuze kukhishwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthi kube khona ngendlela oyifunayo. Ungacelwa ukuthi ukhokhe isikhwama ngaphambi kokuthi uthole irekhodi: lesi sikhwama siyingxenye yemali ephelele yokucela irekhodi futhi siyabuyiselwa uma isicelo singaphumelelanga. Lezi zigaba zolwazi zitholakala kalula ukuze zihlolwe, zithengwe, noma zikhishwe, noma zitholakala mahhala. Asinazo izinhlelo ezisunguliwe ze-SAMSA zokubandakanya umphakathi ukuze umphakathi ube nomthelela lapho izinqubomgomo zisungulwa, noma lapho imisebenzi yenziwa. Nokho, isigaba 11 soMthetho Wokuphepha Kwezokuthutha Kolwandle saseNingizimu Afrika No. 5 ka-1998 sisho ukuthi i-SAMSA kufanele ibonane nalabo abathintekayo uma kudingeka, lapho ikwenza imisebenzi yayo. Lokhu sikwenza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, njengokulandela izaziso ezifanele nezibuyekezo zomphakathi lapho umthetho ophakanyisiwe wephalamende wethulwa. Uma kukhona imibuzo mayelana nesimo esithile, wamukelekile ukuba uxhumane nehhovisi elikhulu noma nayiphi enye ihhovisi eseduze. Asinayo inqubo yokufaka izikhalazo ngaphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umphathi wethu ehhovisi ephika isicelo sakho, futhi unekhalazo ngaleyo mkhuba, kuzodingeka ulandele inqubo yokufaka izikhalazo yangaphandle. Uma unekhalazo mayelana nokuphikiswa kwesicelo sakho ngumphathi wethu ehhovisi, unelungelo lokufaka isicelo enkantolo ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30. Noma ubani othintekayo angakwenza lokhu. Isicelo samukelwa ngu: (bhala isikhundla, igama, nesibongo somphathi wehhovisi/noma umphathi wakhe) ngomhla... Imali yesicelo (uma kudingekile): R... Isikhwama (uma kudingekile): R... Imali yokuhlola: R... B. Ulwazi oluceliwe ukuze ufinyelele irekhodi a Ulwazi oluceliwe ukuze ufinyelele irekhodi kufanele lunikezwe ngezansi. b Ikheli/inombolo ye-fax eRiphabhulikhi lapho ulwazi kufanele luthunyelwe kufanele lunikezwe. c Ubufakazi begunya lokufaka isicelo, uma kudingeka, kufanele buhlanganiswe. Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... Igunya lokufaka isicelo, uma kudingeka ngomyeni:... Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... D. Ulwazi lwekhoshi a Nikeza imininingwane ephelele ye-rekhodi eceliwe, kuhlanganise nenombolo yokubhekisela uma iyaziwa, ukuze irekhodi likhishwe. b Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singanele, qhubeka kwenye ikhasi ozolithumela nalolu fomu. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele asayine wonke amakhasi anikeziwe. Incazelo ye-rekhodi noma ingxenye yayo:... Inombolo yokubhekisela, uma itholakala:... Noma yiluphi olunye ulwazi mayelana ne-rekhodi:... E. Izimali ezikhokhwayo a Isicelo sokufinyelela irekhodi ngaphandle kwalelo rekodi eliqukethe ulwazi lwakho sizobhekwa kuphela ngemva kokukhokha imali yesicelo. b Uzokwaziswa ngemali okufanele uyikhokhe. c Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi izoncika endleleni okudingeka ngayo kanye nesikhathi esidingekayo ukuze ucele futhi ulungiselele irekhodi. d Uma ukhululekile ekukhokheni noma yiziphi izimali, chaza izizathu zokukhululwa kwakho. Uma ungakwazi ukufunda ngenxa yokukhubazeka, sicela ukhombise noma uchaze ukuthi ungathanda kanjani ukuthola irekhodi njengoba kuchazwe ku-1 kuya ku-4 ngezansi, ubonise ukukhubazeka kwakho nokuthi ungathanda kanjani ukuthola irekhodi ngaphansi kwanoma yiziphi izimo. a Ukugcina isicelo sakho sokufinyelela irekhodi ngendlela oyicelile kuzoncika ekutheni le rekodi iyatholakala ngaleyo ndlela. b Ukuthola irekhodi ngendlela eceliwe kungase kube nezithiyo ezithile. Uma kunjalo, uzokwaziswa uma irekhodi izokhishwa kuwe ngenye indlela. c Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi, uma kudingeka, kanye nendlela okudingeka ngayo kuzoba nomthelela. Uma uceli ikhophi noma irekhodi elirekhodiwe (ngaphezulu), ingabe ufuna le khophi ithunyelwe kuwe ngeposi? Sicela uqaphele ukuthi uma irekhodi ingatholakali ngolimi olukhethiwe, ingase ikhish
I-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi (PSC) iyisikhungo somphakathi esizimele esakhelwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. I-PSC inezibopho nezimvume, phakathi kokunye, zokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuhlela nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi kahulumeni. Le mvume ifaka phakathi ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle noma okungasebenzi kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni. Ehlanganiswe nalezi zikhala, i-PSC inezibopho zokukhuthaza izindlela zokwenza kube nokusebenza kahle nokusebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni nokukhuthaza izindinganiso nezimiso zokuphatha umphakathi njengoba kubhalwe kwiMthethosisekelo kuzo zonke izisebenzi zikahulumeni. I-Commission ithola amandla ayo ezigabeni 195 no-196 zoMthethosisekelo, 1996. Isigaba 195 sichaza izindinganiso nezimiso eziphathelene nokuphathwa komphakathi okufanele i-Commission ikhulume ngakho. Izinga eliphezulu lezimiso zobungcweti. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kusekelwe ekuthuthukiseni. Izinsizakalo kufanele zinikezwe ngendlela engakhethi, ngokulinganayo, ngokufanele, futhi ngaphandle kokuphambuka. Kumele ziphendule ezidingweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi kufanele ukhuthazwe ukuba ubambe iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kube nesibopho. Ukuveza kufanele kukhuthazwe. Ukusungulwa kokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu okuhle nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kube yindlela ethatha wonke umuntu ngokusekelwe kumakhono abo, ukucabanga okuzimele, ubuqotho, nokulungisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili. Ukukhuthaza izindinganiso nezimiso zokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 195 soMthethosisekelo, 1996 kuzo zonke izisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ukuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuhlela, ukuphathwa, nokusebenza kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni, ikakhulukazi ukuhambisana nezindinganiso nezimiso ezishiwo esigabeni 195, kanye nasekusebenzeni kwezisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke nasezindaweni mayelana nezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukuveza imiphumela neziphakamiso okungenani minyaka yonke kwiZikhulu Zikazwelonke noma ezikhungweni zendawo njengoba zenzeka. Ukuveza izindaba eziphuthumayo eziphathelene nomsebenzi ezikhungweni ezifanele. Ukuhlola izikhalazo zabasebenzi nokwenza iziphakamiso ezifanele zokulungisa. Ukuhlela nokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa nokusebenza komsebenzi. I-Commission isunguliwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. UMthethosisekelo udinga i-Commission eyodwa yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enamalungu alishumi nane, amahlanu kubo aqokwa nguMongameli ngokuhlonza kweZikhulu Zikazwelonke, kanti ilungu elilodwa lisuka kuzo zonke izifunda likhethwa nguMphakathi weSifunda. I-Commission ibophelelekile kwiZikhulu Zikazwelonke okufanele ibike okungenani minyaka yonke. Kumele futhi ibike ngemicimbi yayo ezikhungweni zendawo. Ngokwemithetho yeMthethosisekelo njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, i-PSC inamalungu alishumi nane: amalungu amahlanu akwiPretoria nolunye olwakho zonke izifunda. I-PSC isekelwa yiHhovisi le-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, eliholwa nguMphakathi-Jikelele (ongumphakathi ophakeme), enehhovisi elikhulu ePretoria kanye nehhovisi lesifunda esisodwa kuzo zonke izifunda. Lezi zikhungo zisebenza njengesisekelo samalungu eCommission ezifundeni futhi ziphathwa ngabaqondisi bezifunda, ngosizo lwamalungu ambalwa abasebenzi. Imisebenzi ethile nezisebenzi ezibalulekile zikhuluma ezikhungweni zendawo. Amalungu eCommission aqokwa nguMongameli, aqala ukusebenza kusukela ngoJanuwari 1, 1999. Nokho, ukuqala ngokusemthethweni kwemisebenzi yeCommission kwabambezela kuze kube nguJulayi 1999 ngenxa yezinkinga zomthetho phakathi kwezinye izindaba zeMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997. NgoJulayi 1, 1999, uMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997 kanye nemigomo yeMthetho weCommission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997, kanye nokuphulwa kweCommission yeZokuphatha Komphakathi, 1984, kwaba nomthelela, kwavumela i-Commission ukuba isebenze ngokuphelele. UCommisioner Mgijima wathatha indawo kaCommisioner Vusi Mavuso owashiya isikhundla sakhe. Uhlaka lwezokuphatha lwe-PSC lwasungulwa ukuze luhambisane nezinhloso zayo zamasu futhi kamuva nemikhakha yayo yokusebenza. Umsebenzi weCommission uhlelwe ngezikhala zayo eziyisithupha zokusebenza kanye nezindawo ezimbili ezengeziwe ezikhuluma ngazo njengokukhuluma kwenombolo 1 ngenhla. Ukuphathwa - kubhekisela kokubili ukuphathwa jikelele nokuphathwa kwezimali; ukuphatha abasebenzi nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza kubasebenzi; nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomthetho nezinye ezisizayo ezisetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa inqubomgomo. Ibhulokhi: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu Nezobudlelwano Bomsebenzi - Le bhulokhi ivumela i-Commission ukuba iqhube imisebenzi yayo mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu; ukuqapha ubudlelwano bomsebenzi; nemithetho yomsebenzi kahle. Ibhulokhi: Ukuphathwa Okuhle Nokuhlinzekwa Kwezinsizakalo - Le bhulokhi iyasebenza amandla eCommission ngokubhekelela nokuhlola; ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo; ukuziphatha kobuchwepheshe kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni nezinhlelo zokubhekana nezingozi emsebenzini kahulumeni. I-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi: Amadokhumenti akhishwe ngamalungu eCommission nezincwadi zemihlangano nezinkulumo abebekhona. Imizuzu yemihlangano yokuphatha yonke. Amadokhumenti wezinsizakalo ezivela kubahlinzeki. Izivumelwano nabahlinzeki. nokuhlola izikhalazo nezikhalazo ezithunyelwe ngabasebenzi bakahulumeni neziphakamiso ezifanele zokulungisa ezikhungweni zikazwelonke nasezindaweni. nokuhlola izikhalazo eziphathelene nezicelo ezithunyelwe ngabasebenzi kanye nokuphathwa komphakathi. Futhi ucwaningo ngezindaba eziphathelene nomsebenzi wabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi. nokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola izinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. ukuqapha nokuhlola izimo zokusebenza nokuphathwa kokusebenza ngabaphathi bezigaba. kanye nokuhlola nokubika ngezinkinga zokuthanda kumphathi nokugcina isikhala sokwazisa kwezimali; nokukhuthaza nokuhlola ukusebenza kahle ekubhekaneni nezingozi. nokulwa nokukhwabanisa emsebenzini kahulumeni ngokuhlola okuqondile; nokufaka isandla empini yokulwa nokukhwabanisa ezweni. Ukuthuthukisa Ukuphathwa Nokuhlinzekwa Kwezinsizakalo: izindaba eziphathelene nokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuphathwa nezisebenzi zokuhlinzeka kwezinsizakalo emsebenzini kahulumeni. ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo, okusebenzayo, nokonga kwezinsiza; nokuhambisana nezinqubo ezifanele emsebenzini weZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Futhi ucwaningo ngezindaba eziphathelene
Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuhola abaholi bendabuko emsebenzini wabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphathwa kokwahlulela kufezwa kahle kakhulu lapho bephatha njengezikhulu ezifungile futhi basungula izinqubo ezidingekayo ezimele zilandelwe ekuphathweni kwemifungo noma ukuqinisekiswa, ukuthathwa kwemifungo esemthethweni noma eqinisekisiwe, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo. a Amandla okugebenga ngaphandle kwesikhwama: umuntu ophula umthetho noma ozama ukuphula umthetho; umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi uzophuma ekuboshweni okusemthethweni; umuntu otholakale enezinsiza zokweba noma/nomathuluzi okweba imoto; umuntu otholakale enezinto ezikholakala ukuthi zibe zebiwe noma otholakale ezimweni eziphazamisa; umuntu otholakale ebusuku ezimweni ezikhuphula ukungabaza ukuthi uphule umthetho noma uzophula umthetho; umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi ubevele ebanga izinkomo, njll. b Amandla okusebenzisa isikhwama sokubamba. Bonke abaholi bendabuko bangabaphathi bezokuthula, ngakho-ke ngenxa yezikhundla zabo (ex officio) - bangizikhulu ezifungile. Ngenxa yesikhundla sabo - isikhulu esifungile ngumuntu, ngenxa yesikhundla sabo noma isikhundla, okwenza kube isikhulu esifungile ngokuzenzakalelayo. Lapho abanye abantu kufanele bafake isicelo kuNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo ukuze baphathwe njengezikhulu ezifungile, lo muntu akafaki isicelo. Uma izikhulu ezifungile zikhishwa ngamakhasi okuphathwa, ngenxa yesikhundla sabo isikhulu esifungile asidingi iphepha, njengoba sinesitifiketi sesikhundla noma isikhundla. Isikhulu esifungile sithunyelwa endaweni ethile futhi sisebenza kule ndawo lapho sithunyelwe khona. Indima yesikhulu esifungile ukusiza amalungu omphakathi wendawo ngokuphatha imifungo noma ukuqinisekiswa noma ukwenza isimemezelo esifungile kumuntu ongena. Enye imisebenzi yesikhulu esifungile ukuqinisekisa amakhophi emibhalo njengamakhophi aqinile wemibhalo yokuqala. Akukho imali ekhokhwayo yokuphatha imifungo noma ukuqinisekiswa, ukuqinisekisa isimemezelo, noma ukuqinisekisa imibhalo. Isikhulu esifungile asivunyelwe ukuphatha imfuno noma ukuqinisekiswa okuhlobene nendaba enomsebenzi wabo. Isizathu ukuthi umuntu oqinisekisa i-affidavit kumele abe ngumuntu ongahlangene futhi ongenawo umqondo endabeni equkethwe kwi-affidavit ukuze umuntu oqinisekisa akwazi ukuba free kunoma yisiphi umthelela wendaba equkethwe kwi-affidavit. Lo msebenzi owenziwa yisikhulu esifungile unciphisa isidingo sokuthi abantu bahambe ngezindawo ezinde ukuya eziteshini zamaphoyisa eziseduze noma ezikhungweni zezimali ukuze bafune usizo. Uma umholi bendabuko, ngenxa yemisebenzi okufanele ayenze noma ezinye izizathu, engakwazi ukusebenza njengezikhulu ezifungile, umphakathi noma noma yimuphi umholi womphakathi ogunyaziwe umholi bendabuko angaba isikhulu esifungile kule ndawo, kuphela ngokuphathwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo. Amafomu wesicelo (J5) atholakala ehhovisi lemagistrate. Le fomu inamakhasi ayisithupha. Amakhasi amahlanu okuqala kumele agcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo, kanti ikhasi lokugcina lidinga ummagistrate ukuthi agcwalisise iziphakamiso mayelana nesicelo. Ngokomthetho, lokhu kusho ukuthi umfaki-sicelo uzoba nezingxoxo zemibuzo nommagistrate, ezihlelwe nguMphakathi Wenkantolo Yomphakathi. Lapho kukhona umphakathi wombhali wezimali noma omunye umholi womphakathi ogunyaziwe umholi bendabuko, kubalulekile ukuba kube nephepha lokuphakamisa elibhalwe ngumholi bendabuko ukuze lihambisane nesicelo. Umagistrate uzothumela ifomu lesicelo kanye nephepha lokuphakamisa kwiMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo. Abasebenzi beMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo bazobheka isicelo kuze kube isikhathi sokubonisana sitholakala nguNgqongqoshe/Ngqongqoshe noma abameli babo, okujwayelekile kubandakanya amalungu eMnyango ezikhundleni eziphakeme. Isitifiketi sizothunyelwa emuva kumagistrate ozosithumela kumfaki-sicelo. Umuntu oqinisekisa (umuntu owenze i-affidavit) angaya esikhungweni esifungile ne-affidavit ukuze afunge noma aqinisekise. Nokho, uma kukhona ukungabaza mayelana nemfuno njengoba kutholwe ngumthetho; futhi iii Uma imfuno ethathwe ngumthetho ibonwa njengokubopha enhliziyweni yabo. Imfuno ethathwe ngokomthetho yenziwa ngumuntu ofungayo ethi lezi zisho ezilandelayo: "Ngifunga ukuthi okuqukethwe kule affidavit kuyikho, uNkulunkulu angisize." Umuntu ofungayo uzocelwa ukuba uphakamise isandla sakhe sokunene ukuze afunge. Uma umuntu ofungayo evuma ukuthi uqonda okuqukethwe kulokho afungayo futhi utshele isikhulu esifungile ukuthi baphikisa imfuno noma ukuthi ababona imfuno njengokubopha enhliziyweni yabo, isikhulu esifungile sizokwenza ukuqinisekiswa. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenziwa ngumuntu ofungayo ethi lezi zisho ezilandelayo: "Ngiyiqiniso ngiqinisekisa ukuthi okukhuluma kuyikho." Umuntu ofungayo kumele asayine lokho akufungayo phambi kwesikhulu esifungile. Uma umuntu ofungayo engakwazi ukubhala, kumele abeke uphawu ekupheleni kwezwi afungayo. Uma isikhulu esifungile siba nezehlakalo zokungakwazi komuntu ofungayo ukubhala, kuzodingeka lokhu kuqinisekiswe ngaphansi kwezwi ofungayo ngomunye umuntu onokwethenjelwa. Ngemuva kokuthi umuntu ofungayo esayine noma abeke uphawu, isikhulu esifungile sizokwenza ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi umuntu ofungayo uvumile ukuthi bangakwazi futhi baqonde okuqukethwe kwezwi ofungayo futhi bazokhuluma indawo, indawo, nosuku lokwenza imfuno. Isikhulu esifungile sizosayina imfuno futhi sibhale igama lazo eliphelele kanye ne-adresi yomsebenzi phansi kokusayina kwabo, futhi sisho nesikhundla sabo nendawo lapho bekwazi khona noma ihhovisi abakhona. "Adresi yomsebenzi" ibonisa ikheli langempela hhayi ikheli leposi. Izikhwama ezifanele zikhona ukuze zisize izikhulu ezifungile ekwenzeni imfuno noma ukuqinisekiswa ngaphandle kokulibazisa. Ikhophi yemibhalo okufanele iqinisekiswe njengekhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala kumele iqhathaniswe nemibhalo yokuqala futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le mibhalo emibili iyafana. Uma isikhulu esifungile saneliseka ukuthi ikhophi iyikhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala futhi akukho okukhombisa ukuthi imibhalo yokuqala ishintshiwe ngabantu abangagunyaziwe, isikhulu esifungile kumele libhale ukuthi liqinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo iyikhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala futhi akukho okukhombisa ukuthi imibhalo yokuqala ishintshiwe ngabantu abangagunyaziwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, isikhulu esifungile kumele sibhale futhi sibhale igama labo, isikhundla, imininingwane yokuxhumana, nosuku. Izikhwama ezifanele zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe imibhalo. Uma imfuno noma ukuqinisekiswa kungenziwa kahle njengoba kutholwe ngumthetho, khona-ke le ndaba iyothunyelwa enkantolo, i-affidavit izobhekwa njengeyinqaba futhi ingaba nemiphumela emibi, njengokuthi ezimweni zobugebengu, kuholele ekukhululweni komsolwa. Uma isikhulu esifungile sibona ukuthi
Umnyango wezobulungiswa ungowesigaba sokupholisa lapho indawo yokusebenza kwamaphoyisa ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezincane, ezilawulwayo ezaziwa ngokuthi izigaba. I-SAPS izokhetha uphoyisa, owaziwa ngokuthi umphathi wesigaba, kuyo yonke isigaba. Imiphakathi kanye nabaphathi bezigaba bazoba ababambiqhaza abenza okuthile ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha nokuvikeleka endaweni abahlala kuyo. Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela umphakathi esigabeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ngokumelene nobugebengu bendawo njengokubambisana. Ukuze kube nesixhumanisi phakathi komphakathi wesigaba kanye nesiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo. Ukuze kusebenze njengomphakathi wokuvikela ubugebengu, ophatha zonke izinhlelo nezinhlelo ezibhekana nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze kuxoxwe ngezinhlelo zokwenza nezomphakathi wesigaba ukuze kubhekwane nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze kusungulwe futhi kubambe iqhaza emicimbini yasendaweni ukuze kugcinwe indawo abahlala kuyo iphephile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane neziphakamiso zokuvikela ubugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze kusekelwe ngempela umnyango wezobulungiswa wezivakashi ezindaweni. Ukuze uxhumane nomphathi wakho wesigaba ukuze wenze indawo ophila kuyo iphephile. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi bendawo, amaqembu omphakathi, izinhlangano zabahlali, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi bamenywa ukuba babambe iqhaza emizamweni yokubhekana nezinkinga eziholela kubugebengu esigabeni sakho. I-NAFVSA inengxenye yokweseka umphakathi, ehlinzeka bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo ababuya emiphakathini eyayithintekile ngodlame, ngemininingwane nezidingo. Ngokwakha ubudlelwano nezinye izikhungo ezikhiqiza amafilimu, le ndawo ihlose ukufinyelela kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. I-archive kazwelonke egcina amafilimu, ividiyo, kanye nolwazi olurekhodiwe lwezwi ibamba iqhaza emikhankasweni ehlukene. Izikhungo zemfundo zimenyiwe ukuba zibheke amafilimu futhi zixoxe ngezihloko ezithile ezidinga ukubhekwa. Lokhu kwenziwe ngokuxhumana nabafundisi nabafundisi. Inhloso enkulu yale ngxenye yokweseka umphakathi ukulethela "izindawo zokubuka amafilimu abantu," ezizothokozisa imiphakathi. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinye izikhungo ezifana nezikole, imboni efanele, amaqembu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukufinyelela emiphakathini yasemaphandleni engazi ukuthi le archive ingakwenza kanjani njengoba nayo inamalungelo okufinyelela ulwazi. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukusebenzisa Izikhungo Zezobuciko Zomphakathi, ezisunguliwe nguMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, ukuze kufezwe le njongo. Izindawo zezakhamuzi, izikole, nezindawo zomphakathi nazo zizosebenza. Siphakamisa umphakathi kanye nanoma ubani ofisa ukuxhumana nomlando nempilo yaleli zwe ukuthi axhumane nathi uma efuna ukufaka isicelo sokusebenzisa izinsizakalo ze-archive kazwelonke, i-NAFVSA. I-NAFVSA inengxenye egxile ekuvikelweni komlando orekhodwe ogcwalise izikhala endabeni yethu yomlando. Kuxoxiswane nabantu abanolwazi ngezihloko ezihlukahlukene ezihlobene namasiko, ubuciko, umlando, kanye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuqoqwa, ukuvikelwa, nokusatshalaliswa komculo wendabuko kukhuthazwa ngohlelo lwethu olubizwa ngokuthi i-Traditional Musical Instrument Exhibition. Ukuqoqwa kwezinto ezirekhodiwe ze-audio nezomfanekiso (kokubili komphakathi kanye nokungakhethi) nezinye izenzo ezihlobene ezikhiqizwe noma ezihlobene neNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bangafinyelela kulezi ziqophi futhi bakhuthazwe ukuthi zisetshenziswe ngabo bonke. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezigcina lezi ziqophi. I-NAFVSA inendawo yokucwaninga lapho abacwaningi bengathola usizo lwezinhlobo zonke uma befuna ulwazi, futhi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe kumakhompyutha mahhala. Ukubuka nokulalela izinto ezishicilelwe kufanele kuhlelwe kusenesikhathi. Udinga ukwazisa isikhungo okungenani ezinsukwini ezintathu ngaphambi kokulungiselela okuthandayo nokukufaka kumishini efanele. Lezi zinto zingasetshenziswa kuphela ezindaweni ze-NAFVSA futhi kuzokwenziwa imali ethile ethathwe nguMnyango Wezezimali. Abafundi nabafundi bangasebenzisa lezi zinto mahhala, kodwa badinga futhi ukuhlela ngaphambi kokulalela nokubuka. Imvume ebhaliwe evela kubadali iyadingeka uma othile efuna amakhophi ento ethile. Ibhuku lethu linezincwadi eziyi-3000 ezikhethekile ezihlobene nomkhakha wefilimu, oqale kudala ngesikhathi seBhodi LezamaFilimu, futhi izinto ezingahlangene azikahlinzekwa nhlobo ngenxa yokubaluleka kwazo. Nokho, zonke izincwadi zebhuku zingabukwa ku-Archive Yezomlando Kazwelonke, futhi amakhophi angakhiqizwa ngentengo ephansi. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo leziqeshana zamafilimu ezikhethekile ezilinganiselwa ku-1000, ezibuyela emuva ngesikhathi seDe Voortrekkers, okuyifilimu endala kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi leziqeshana lingempela lihluke kakhulu futhi lihlobene nazo zonke izinhlobo zamafilimu ezikhiqizwe ezweni lethu. Inhloso ye-archive ngalezi ziqeshana ukuzenza zirekhodiwe ngokuqondile futhi zigcinwe eqoqweni lapho zingasetshenziswa ngaphandle kokuphuma. Njengokuqoqwa kweziqeshana, i-Archive ineqoqo lezithombe ezihlobene namafilimu kuleli. Izithombe zamafilimu cishe zonke ezikhiqizwe kuleli kusukela ngonyaka ka-1916 zingatholakala lapha. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo leziqeshana zamafilimu ezilinganiselwa ku-1200 ezikhiqizwe kuleli. Iningi leziqeshana lisesigabeni sokulungiselela, ngakho-ke lihlukile kakhulu kumkhiqizo ophelile olungiselelwe ukubukwa. I-NAFVSA iphinde ibe umgcinimafa wezincwadi zezindaba, ezihlanganisa imibhalo, iziqeshana ezikhethiwe zezindaba ezivela ezincwadini, izithombe, izinhlelo, kanye nezikhangiso ezihlobene nezindawo zokusebenza, umculo, ubuciko, kanye nezandla. Iningi lezi zinto kulesi sigaba laqala ngeminikelo evela kubantu kanye nezikhungo ezizimele ezinomdlandla kwezobuciko nezandla. I-NAFVSA ikhethekile ngoba iyingxenye yezinqolobane ezimbalwa emhlabeni ezigcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nezinto ezirekhodiwe ezingenziwa zaba yizinto ezilalelwayo ngaphansi komoya owodwa. Ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lolwazi olukhombisa umlando wezwe lethu eNingizimu Afrika ngemicabango kube usizo futhi kuzokwenza kube umthombo omkhulu wezizukulwane ezizayo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Bangakwazi futhi ukubheka kalula okwenzekile esikhathini esedlule, futhi lokhu kungabeka abantu endaweni yokucabanga ukuthi umkhakha wefilimu nezinsiza zokurekhoda zizobukeka kanjani esikhathini esizayo. Ngenxa yokushintsha kwezobuchwepheshe okusheshayo, imishini esetshenziswe eminyakeni engama-20 edlule manje isiphukile, kodwa ingasetshenziswa ukuze ihlinzeke ngolwazi lomlando, kanye nokubon
MANJE, ngokulandela isigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000, uSihlalo weBhodi Yamanzi, njengomsebenzi womphakathi weBhodi Yamanzi, kumele abhale incwadi ukuze wonke umuntu akwazi ukufinyelela ulwazi oluhambelana neBhodi Yamanzi. NGAKHOKE, MANJE uSihlalo weBhodi Yamanzi uletha lokhu, emphakathini, incwadi yeBhodi Yamanzi ngenhloso yokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe yiBhodi Yamanzi, njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi komthetho. Ukuzwa izicelo zokukhokhelwa njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 soMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Isicelo sokukhokhelwa kumele sithunyelwe kwiBhodi Yamanzi phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela esinqumweni esithathwe yiziphathimandla eziphethe. Ibhodi Yamanzi inegunya lokunquma inani lokukhokhelwa kanye nenani elizokhokhwa kulandela lesi sigaba. Azikho izinsiza ezikhona. Izinsiza zizolandela umsebenzi. Uma umfaki-sicelo enganelisekile nganoma yisiphi isinqumo mayelana nolwazi, umfaki-sicelo angafaka ukukhala kuNgqongqoshe Wezamanzi Nezihlahla ngokulandela isigaba 74 soMthetho. Uma umfaki-sicelo (owokukhala) enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, angaphikisa lesi sinqumo enkantolo ngokulandela izigaba 79 kuya ku-82 zoMthetho. Umfaki-sicelo noma umuntu omunye angafaka icala emaphoyiseni ngokulandela isigaba 90 soMthetho.
Ikomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithole igunya ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo ka-1996 ukuze ikhulise futhi iqinisekise izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha kwabantu abaphakathi kwezikhundla ezisebenzela isizwe. Ngo-1997, ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi kwamenyezelwa futhi kwathuthukiswa ngokubizelwa kwemihlangano kanye nochwepheshe bezomthetho ezingeni likazwelonke nelokuhlala. Kwakubalulekile ukuthuthukisa incwadi yokuhola mayelana nokuziphatha ukuze kusizwe abantu baqonde kahle futhi basebenzise lokho. Engxenyeni yeKomishini esebenza isizwe, ngiyazizwa ngihloniphekile ukwethula incwadi echaza ukuziphatha okufanele kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyisisekelo esibalulekile sokuphatha nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Lokhu kuziphatha futhi kukhuphula izindaba ezifana nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo abantu, umthetho, ukuzinikela, ukuveza uhulumeni, ukuziphatha komuntu siqu, nokujabulela okwakhe. IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi icela bonke abasebenzi, kusukela kulabo abasezingeni eliphansi kuya kwezinga eliphezulu, ukuba baveze ukuqonda okubonakalayo kwenqubo, iziqondiso, nezincwadi ezitholakala ekuziphatheni okufanele. Lokhu akukhona nje kuphela okubalulekile kodwa kungasivumela ukuba sihlangabezane nezidingo ezifanele zabantu bethu. Kubalulekile ukuthi labo abaphakathi kwezikhundla benze izinto ngokomthetho, bagweme ukwamukela amathuba nezipho, njengoba lokhu kungabhekwa njengenkohlakalo. Sifisa ukuhlabela izinkanyezi bonke abaphathi nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla abathintekayo ekukhuliseni ukuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Ngiyakhuthaza ukuba niqhubeke nokwenza umsebenzi omuhle ngaphandle kokuphenduka ezinselelweni zokuthuthukisa ikhodi yokuziphatha kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ithemba ukuthi le ncwadi echazayo izoba yisikhombandlela esifanele ekukhuliseni ubuqotho nokwethembeka endaweni yokusebenza futhi futhi idale amathuba amakhulu kithi sonke ukuze sifeze isiko lokungamukeli inkohlakalo eNingizimu Afrika. Ekugcineni, ngifisa bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi baqinisekise ukuthi ukuziphatha okufanele kuhambisana nendlela evumelekile yokuphatha nokuphatha umphakathi futhi baziqhelanise nokuziphatha okufanele kanye nale ncwadi echazayo. Umphathi: IKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Iminyango kazwelonke neyomphakathi iyawusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi echazayo futhi iphinde ifake imibono ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni kwayo. Ihhovisi leMphakathi elivikela liphinde lafaka umnikelo ekuthuthukiseni le ndatshana ngemibono ebalulekile. Izinhlangano nezinyunyana zabasebenzi bomphakathi zibe nezingxoxo eziningi nemihlangano futhi zenze iziphakamiso ezibalulekile. Ekugcineni, siyabonga ukwesekwa kukahulumeni waseBrithani ekuthuthukiseni amazwe angaphandle ngokuhlinzeka ngemali yokushicilela le ncwadi echazayo mayelana nokuziphatha okufanele kwabasebenzi bomphakathi. Inhloso yale ncwadi ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ephelele yokuqukethwe kokuziphatha okufanele. Ukumisa ngokomthetho ukuziphatha okufanele kudinga isibindi, ukuqonda, kanye nohlelo lwezichazamazwi ezisemthethweni. Le ncwadi ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bomphakathi baqonda kahle lokhu kuziphatha. Le ncwadi ayethuli imithetho emisha noma ilandele isakhiwo nemithetho njengemibhalo ephathelene nokuziphatha, ukuze kube lula ukuhlukanisa. Lapho usebenzisa le ncwadi, iminyango kumele izame ukufaka izibonelo zabo ezihambisana nomongo wabo wendawo. Kumele kugcizelelwe ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwale ncwadi kuyinqubo ebalulekile futhi kuzodingeka ukuhlolwa njalo, njengokuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha. Ekukhuliseni izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha okufanele endaweni yokusebenza, abasebenzi kumele bakhuthazwe ukuba bacabange futhi baziphathe kahle. Ngakho-ke, le ncwadi kufanele ibonwe njengethuluzi ekuthuthukiseni nasekuthuthukiseni amakhono okufundisa kubo bonke abasebenzi. Le ncwadi iphinde iqukate izibonelo ezikhombisa ukuziphatha okungafanele endaweni yokusebenza okufanele kuthathwe njengesisekelo sokufundisa nezifundo ezenzakalayo. Njengomngane wale kuziphatha, le ncwadi izosiza ukuqinisa ukuzethemba okwangempela nokungakhethi phakathi kwabantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okuncane kokuziphatha okufanele nokubonakalayo. Kuyinto evunyelwe ukuthi umuntu ufunda ngokuqwashisa nangesenzo. Indima ebalulekile ibekwe kumqashi, ikakhulukazi labo abanamandla okusebenza (Omakhulu kanye noMECs) ezingeni lezepolitiki, kanye nabaphathi kuzo zonke izinga zezinsizakalo zomphakathi, ukuze bakhe indawo lapho indlela efanele yokuziphatha ingaboniswa futhi isibonelo esihle sikhonjiswe kubo bonke abasebenzi. Ingxenye 195 (a) yoMthethosisekelo ifuna ukuthi izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha likhuthazwe futhi ligcinwe. Mayelana nesivumelwano esivamile (Isixazululo sePublic Service Coordinating Bargaining Council 2 ka-1999), bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi banendima yokudlala ekulandeleni izimiso ezichazwe ekuziphatheni okufanele. Njengoba lokhu kuyisisekelo esibalulekile esakhiwe ekwenzeni kahle nasekuziphatheni kahle, umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi ngokuqondile ukuziphatha okufanele. Kubalulekile ukugcizelela ukuthi umgomo oyinhloko wokuziphatha ukuthi okwamukelekayo, okuwukukhuthaza isibonelo esihle sokuziphatha. Ngaphandle kwalokhu, umphakathi angase azithole noma abhekane nezinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele mayelana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo ngenhla, bese ebhekiswa ngaphansi kweZigaba 18 kuya ku-27 eziphakanyiswe ekuziphatheni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi zika-1997, uma umuntu engalandeli ukuziphatha okufanele okumiswe. Umsebenzi kumele ube nethembekile kuMbuso futhi ahloniphe noMthethosisekelo ngenkathi egcina noma emukela imisebenzi abekwe kuyo nsuku zonke. Okuhambisana noMbuso kumele kubonakale njengokuhambisana ne "zinsizakalo zomphakathi" eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisidingo esiyinhloko esikhombisa ubuqotho bonke abasebenzi. UMthethosisekelo uthinta lezi zindaba eziphathelene namalungelo nezinto ezanelisayo kubo bonke obala. Lezi zinkomba zokuziphatha zidinga nje ubuqotho babantu abakhonza izinsizakalo zomphakathi enqubweni yokuphatha ngaphansi kohlelo lwezombusazwe. Okwesibili, ukubaluleka koMthethosisekelo kumele kwamukelwe futhi kuhlinzekwe ngabo bonke. Okwesithathu, bonke abasebenzi bomphakathi kumele baqonde kahle okuqukethwe nenhloso yoMthethosisekelo njengendlela yokuvikela nokukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle. Isibonelo 1: Abasebenzi bomphakathi ezingeni elihlukahlukene bavunyelwe ukuhlela futhi benze iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo. Lezi ziphakamiso kumele zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi aziphikisi umoya noma izigaba ezithile zoMthethosisekelo. UMthethosisekelo mayelana nokubambisana nomphakathi nokuvuleka ezisebenzelaneni kufanele kulandelwe kahle ekwakhiweni okuqhubekayo kwezinhlelo. Isibonelo 2: Ingxenye 33 yoMthethosisekelo iv
Umphakathi uyaziswa ukuthi umongameli uvumile umthetho olandelayo ophumelele ukufakwa ukuze wazise umphakathi wonke ngawo:... Umthetho Wokwenziwa Kwezishado Zendabuko inombolo 120 ka-1998. Izisho eziphakanyisiwe zichaza izichibiyelo kumthetho osekhona. Umbhalo wesiNgisi usayinwe umongameli. Mayelana nokwamukelwa kwezishado zendabuko; Ukucacisa izidingo zokuba nesishado sendabuko esiphilayo; ukuphatha ukubhaliswa kwezishado zendabuko; ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana kwesimo namandla kwabafazi kulezi zishado; ukuphatha ukusulwa kwezishado zendabuko; ukubhekelela ukuhlinzekwa kwemithetho; ukususa ezinye izigaba zemithetho; nokubhekana nezindaba ezihlobene. Kulomthetho, ngaphandle kokuthi incazelo ebhaliwe ihluke... isishado sendabuko sisho isishado esenziwa ngokwezomthetho wesiko. Lobola kusho impahla noma imali eyaziwa ngokuthi lobola, nanoma iyiphi enye igama umlandeli noma umphakathi wekhaya ahlela ukuyinika umndeni wesifazane ngokwezifiso zendabuko. Umqoqi wama-akhawunti kusho noma ubani ophakanyiswe nguNgqongqoshe ukuze abhalise ngenhloso yalomthetho kanye nanoma yimuphi osomabhizinisi osebenza ngaphansi kokuphathwa nguNgqongqoshe. Isishado sendabuko esingenele ngemva kokuqala kwalomthetho ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalo umthetho sikhonjwa njengokuthi isishado sonke. Uma umuntu engumshado emishadweni eminingi yendabuko, zonke izishado ezingenile ngaphambi kokuqala kwalomthetho, futhi ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalo umthetho, zikhonjwa njengokuthi izishado sonke. Ngokusho kwesishado sendabuko esingenele ngaphambi kokuqala kwalomthetho, kubhekwa njengokuphila... Njengokuchazwe esigabeni 10I. Akukho mpahla esishadweni sendabuko ezokwazi ukungena esishadweni ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushada inombolo 25 ka-1961, ngenkathi leso sishado sendabuko sisasebenza. a Uma omunye wabantu engena esishadweni ngenkathi esencane kakhulu, bobabili abazali babo noma uma bengekhona abazali, umgadi wabo wezomthetho kumele avume leso sishado. b Uma ukuvuma kwabazali noma ukuvuma komgadi kungatholakala, isigaba 25 soMthetho Wokushada ka-1961 siyasebenza. Ngaphandle kwesigaba (a), uNgqongqoshe noma noma yimuphi osomabhizinisi ophakathi kwezinsizakalo zoHulumeni ogunyaziwe nguye anganika imvume kumuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ukuba angene esishadweni sendabuko uma uNgqongqoshe noma lowo osomabhizinisi ogunyaziwe ebona ukuthi kubalulekile kulabo abathintekayo. d uma leso sishado sikhona, futhi futhi uthola ukuthi zonke ezinye izindaba ezihlobene naleso sishado ziqhutshelwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zalo mthetho, kufanele abhalise ngokofficial njengokuthi isishado sendabuko. Ngemuva kwesigaba, isigaba 24 soMthetho Wokushada ka-1961, sisebenza esishadweni sendabuko somuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ongenele ngaphandle kokuvuma kwabazali noma umgadi. Ukuvinjelwa kwesishado sendabuko phakathi kwabantu ngenxa yokuhlobana kwabo kwegazi kulawulwa ngumthetho wesiko. Ukubhaliswa kwezishado zendabuko. Izingxenye ezingenela isishado sendabuko zinesibopho sokubhalisa isishado sabo. Noma ubani wabashadile angafaka isicelo kumqoqi wama-akhawunti ngendlela esemthethweni ukuze abhalise isishado sabo sendabuko futhi kumele anikeze umqoqi wama-akhawunti ulwazi oludingekayo kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi olungase lufunwe umqoqi wama-akhawunti ukuze akwazi ukuqhubeka nokubhaliswa kwesishado ukuze kube semthethweni. a esingenile ngaphambi kokuthi lo mthetho uqale, futhi engakabhaliswa ngaphansi komunye umthetho, kumele ibhaliswe phakathi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili ngemva kokuthi iqale, noma phakathi nesikhathi eside njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakhipha umyalo ngezikhathi ezithile ngokwaziswa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni. (a) Umqoqi wama-akhawunti, uma eqiniseka ukuthi abashadile balandele indlela esemthethweni esishadweni sabo sendabuko, kumele abhalise isishado ngokurekhoda izinombolo zokuhlonza zabashadile, usuku abashade ngalo, lobola ovumelanayo, nezinye imininingwane esemthethweni. b Umqoqi wama-akhawunti kumele anikeze abashadile isitifiketi sokubhaliswa esikhombisa imininingwane esemthethweni. (a) Uma isishado sendabuko singabhaliswa nganoma yisiphi isizathu, noma ubani ongakwazi ukujabulisa umqoqi wama-akhawunti ukuthi unelungelo lokungena kwalesi simo angafaka isicelo ngokubhala kumqoqi wama-akhawunti ngendlela esemthethweni yokuhlola ukuhlala kwesishado. b Uma umqoqi wama-akhawunti eqiniseka ukuthi kukhona noma bekukhona isishado sendabuko phakathi kwalabo bashadile, kufanele abhalise leso sishado futhi anikeze isitifiketi sokubhaliswa njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 4. Uma umqoqi wama-akhawunti engakwenzi kahle ukuthi labo bashadile bangene esishadweni sendabuko esiphilayo, kufanele aphikelele ukubhaliswa kwalolo sishado. Ijezi lingase, uma lithola isicelo esithunyelwe kulo futhi ngemuva kokuhlola, likhiphe umyalo wokuthi... a noma yisiphi isishado sendabuko sibhaliswe; noma b sikhanselwe noma sishintshwe noma iyiphi ukubhaliswa kwesishado sendabuko okwenziwe ngumqoqi wama-akhawunti. Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa kwesishado sendabuko esikhishwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba nanoma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophathelene nokubhaliswa kwezishado zendabuko sikhombisa ngokuphelele ukuhlala kwesishado sendabuko kanye nemininingwane equkethwe kulolo sitifiketi. Ukwehluleka ukubhalisa isishado sendabuko akuphazamisi ubuqiniso nobulungiswa balolo sishado. Umqoqi wama-akhawunti angamukela isitifiketi somuntu okukhuluma ngaye ukuthi usencane kakhulu futhi ubunikazi bakhe, isitatimende esifungwayo sokuvuma komzali noma komndeni, nanoma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi umqoqi wama-akhawunti angacela njengobufakazi bokuthi lelo qiniso. Uma ubudala bomuntu okukhuluma ngaye ukuthi usencane kakhulu bungacacile noma buphikiswa, noma ubudala balo muntu buhambisana nezidingo zomthetho, umqoqi wama-akhawunti angadlulisa lesi simo kwiNkantolo yeMagistrate esunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinkantolo zeMagistrate inombolo 32 ka-1944, okumele ibone ubudala balo muntu futhi ikhiphe isitifiketi mayelana nalokhu esizoba ubufakazi bobudala balo muntu. Mayelana nokufana esishadweni sendabuko, kuye ngokuthi izinhlelo eziphathelene nempahla zimi kanjani kulolo sishado, umkakhe unendawo efanayo namalungelo nomyeni wakhe kuhlanganisa nelungelo lokwamukela nokuphatha impahla, ukungena ezivumelwaneni, nanoma yimiphi eminye amalungelo akhona esishadweni sendabuko. Amalungu omphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele ayamenywa ukuthi anikeze amagama amalungu eNational Heritage Council (NHC). Inhloso ye-NHC ukuhlinzeka, ukuthuthukisa, nokuvikela ifa lemvelo laseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuletha ukufana ekuphathweni kwefa lemvelo. Izothola ukuvunywa kwephalamende kusuka kuMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko futhi izohlinzeka, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ngoxhaso lwezimali ngediphozi zebhange ezikhungweni nasezinhlelweni/imisebenzi ezithunyelwe. I-NHC yasungulwa njengomzimba ophakanyisiwe ngaphansi komthetho weNational Heritage Council Act ka-1999 (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999). Amalungu e-NHC azoba nesibopho sokwenza izinhlinzeko zalo mthetho futhi kulindeleke ukuthi azijwayeze ukuphathwa okuphezulu kwe-NHC ngokulandela umthetho wePublic Finance Management Act, 1999 (Umthetho No. 1 ka-1999). Ababiziwe kumele babe nolwazi emkhakheni wefa lemvelo, amasiko aphilayo, umlando, nokuvikelwa, kumele bahlonishwe ngalesi sikhungo kuzo zonke izigaba ze-fa lemvelo, kumele baziwe njengabantu abanokwethembeka abazibophezele ekuvikeleni nasekuthuthukiseni ifa lethu lemvelo eliyingqayizivele, futhi akumele babe nesikhundla kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yezombusazwe. Amalungu e-NHC azothola umholo wanyanga zonke kodwa azokhokhelwa izindleko ezitholakele emsebenzini wabo ne-NHC. Amalungu azothola futhi uphawu lokwazisa ngezabelo zabo. Ikomidi lokukhetha lizokwakhiwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze lenze uhlu lwababiziwe bazo zonke izifundazwe, kulandelwe izingxoxo zomphakathi nezifundazwe. Incazelo ye komidi elisunguliwe izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kufaka phakathi wakhiwo ezivela kuzo zonke izigaba ze-heritage kazwelonke, zonke izindawo, nobulili bobabili, futhi ukuthi ukukhethwa konke kuhlangabezana nezinga eliphezulu kakhulu. Ikomidi lokukhetha lizokwethula uhlu lwamalungu angama-15 kuNgqongqoshe, ozokwenza ukukhethwa kokugcina kwe-NHC kulolu hlu. Okungenani amalungu amahlanu e-NHC angakhethwa ngalendlela, kanti uMEC ophatha ifa lemvelo nokuvikelwa ezweni ngalinye kufanele akhethe omunye ummeleli kuleyo ndawo. a Incwadi equkethe amagama aphelele, ikheli, izinombolo zocingo, kanye nezifakazelo zababiziwe, kanye nezizathu zokubizwa kwabo. b I-curriculum vitae noma umlando ophathelene nezimpilo zababiziwe ohlola iziqu zabo zokuhlonishwa. c Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngababiziwe, sikhombisa ukuvuma kokubizwa. d Amagama nezindawo zokuxhumana zababoni ababili. Akekho okubizwa ozokwamukelwa uma konke okukhuluma ngenhla kungafakiwe. Ukubizwa kufanele kufike kuMphathiswa oPhakathi, uMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, ngaphambi kosuku lwe-14 kuFebhuwari 2003.
Ukutholakala kolwazi eState kuyisihluthulelo sokwenza ukuthi umphakathi wenze izinqumo ezicacile, okuholela kuhulumeni ophendulayo futhi ojabulisayo. IPhakathi leMisebenzi, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000 (Umthetho 2 ka-2000) ("umthetho"), kudalwe le bhukwana echazayo ukusiza amalungu omphakathi athintekayo ukufinyelela ulwazi oluvela kwiPhakathi leMisebenzi olungase lube usizo. IPhakathi leMisebenzi iholwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi oqokwe nguMongameli ngokuhambisana nesigaba 912 seMthethosisekelo saseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 Umthetho -108 ka-1996. Ngokuvamile, uMongameli uqoka ngokuhambisana nesigaba 12 seMthetho Wezikhungo Zomphakathi, 1994 kanye neMthethosisekelo. UMsunguli Jikelele unabasebenzi abane abaxhasi abaphatha uMthetho Wezabasebenzi kanye nohlelo lweMakethe Yezabasebenzi, Ukuhlinzekwa Kwezinsizakalo, Izinsizakalo Zokuhlanganisa, kanye Nokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono Nokuqashwa ngokulandelana. Ngokuvamile, ungumHead weHhovisi Lezokwazi elisunguliwe. Imininingwane esekela lo Mphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi itholakala esigabeni C ngezansi. Futhi isakhiwo sikazwelonke sokuthuthukiswa komkhiqizo. UMsunguli Jikelele uqokwe njengomphathi wehhovisi lolwazi, njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 1(a)(ii) somthetho. Abaphathi Abasiza uMsunguli Jikelele bangabasebenzi abaxhasi bomphathi wehhovisi lolwazi olusunguliwe, njengoba kukhombisiwe esigabeni 17 somthetho. Abasebenzi abaphezulu basungulwa ukuze babe abasebenzi abaxhasi bomphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi njengoba kukhombisiwe esigabeni 17 somthetho. Futhi iMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Kazwelonke kanye Nezokusebenza, 1994 (Umthetho 35 ka-1994). Ukugxila kumalungelo emthethweni ukuze kube nokuphathwa kahle emsebenzini njengoba kutholakala esigabeni 23 seMthethosisekelo, nemithetho elawula amazinga amancane emsebenzini, ukuvimbela nokuxazulula izingxabano. Kusungulwa isakhiwo sokutshalwa kwezimali ezindaweni zikazwelonke kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa nokuqinisa amakhono abasebenzi baseNingizimu Afrika. Iphatha zonke izinguquko ezibalulekile ezenzeka emnothweni nasemthethweni wezokuhlalisana ngaphambi kokutshalwa kwezimali noma ukwethulwa kwiPhalamende; futhi ikhuthaza futhi iphakamisa ukusungulwa kwesakhiwo sezinqubomgomo esihlanganisiwe ezindabeni zokuhlalisana komphakathi nasekonomini. IKomidi Lezokuhlukunyezwa Kwamalungelo Okwaziwa Kwamalungelo Abantu laseNingizimu Afrika kudingeka ukuthi linikeze umhlahlandlela ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika ukusiza bonke abantu abafuna ukusebenzisa amalungelo abo okufinyelela kolwazi, labo abangase badinge lokho ekusebenziseni amalungelo abo. Noma ubani ofuna ukufinyelela ulwazi olutholakala kwiPhakathi angaxhumana noMphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi noma noMphathi Osenkingeni weHhovisi Lezokwazi. Ulwazi ngababhalisile. Imibiko yokuhlola izingozi ezindaweni zokusebenza. Futhi uhlelo lokuxhaswa oluvela kwiNational Skills Fund. Ulwazi ngohlelo lweNational Skills Development Strategy. Futhi nezivumelwano zikazwelonke ezibanjwe yiNingizimu Afrika nezinye izizwe kanye/noma izinhlangano. Futhi ama-brochure, ama-pamphlet, kanye namabhukwana akhishwe yiPhakathi. Iziqinisekiso zebhajethi, izindleko, kanye nezicabangela zePhakathi. Ukufinyelela, ukuthenga; kanye nezenzo zemakethe yezabasebenzi. Imibiko ngamaMakethe Ezemisebenzi. Lezi zinsizakalo zitholakala kuzo zonke Ofisi ZePhakathi ezikazwelonke, ezikhona kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye. Futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwamazinga amancane emsebenzini, impilo, nemithetho yokuphepha. Lezi zinsizakalo zinikezwa ehhovisi elikhulu lePhakathi ePitoli nasezikhungweni zikazwelonke. Futhi ukuqapha ukusebenza kweMnyango Wezemfundo Nokuthuthukiswa. Izinkantolo zabasebenzi zinikeza izinsizakalo zokukhishwa kwezinqumo. Ulwazi ngama-ofisi e-CCMA nezinkantolo zabasebenzi lutholakala kunoma iyiphi yeOfisi zePhakathi ezikazwelonke noma ehhovisi elikhulu. Ulwazi oluvela kwiPhakathi lungatholwa ngokwenza isicelo ngendlela echazwe, etholakala kuzo zonke Ofisi zePhakathi ezikazwelonke, futhi kufanele kuthunyelwe kumphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi noma kumphathi osenkingeni weHhovisi Lezokwazi kule ndawo ekhombisiwe esigabeni C ngenhla. Umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele yonke imininingwane efomini ukuze umphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi akwazi ukubona ukuthi yikuphi ulwazi oluceliwe. Iziqinisekiso ezihlobene nempilo yomfaki-sicelo nokuthi umfaki-sicelo uyasizwa noma ucela usizo komunye umuntu. Futhi ukucacisa umbono ngomyalo ophakanyisiwe, ukulethela ukubhaliswa kwezinyunyana nezinhlelo zabaqashi. Ngokuhambisana nemininingwane yokuxhumana enikeziwe, thumela ukukhala kuMvikeli Womphakathi. Noma ubani ongachazwanga kahle nganoma yisiphi isiqubulo lapha angaxhumana nomphathi weHhovisi Lezokwazi noma osiza wakhe kunoma iyiphi yeOfisi zePhakathi ezikazwelonke ukuze athole usizo.
Yini inhloso yokubamba umuntu? Inhloso yokubamba umuntu ibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi othweswe icala ubonakala enkantolo. Umuntu obanjwe ubhekwa njengomuntu ongaphikiswa kuze kube sekukhululiwe icala. Ngalesi sizathu, wonke umuntu obanjwe kufanele aphathwe kahle futhi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Kukhona amaposta akhombisa amalungelo abantu abanjwe. Iposi kufanele ibekwe odongeni ngaphambi kokuqala kwalesi sikhathi. Inhloso yalesi sabelo ukuhlinzeka ngamaqhinga alolu suku. Le ngxenye yeMthetho Wokuphatha Icalo ibuye ihlinzeke ngama-alternatives angcono kokubamba ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba khona enkantolo. Lezi zinketho kufanele zicatshangelwe ngaphambi kokukhetha ukubamba ngoba ingxenye 36 (e) yeMthethosisekelo ibonisa ukuthi umuntu kufanele acabangele izindlela ezincane zokunciphisa ukuze afinyelele inhloso (kulesi simo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu ubonakala enkantolo). Ukubamba kufanele kube yindlela yokugcina. Ukubamba akuyona indlela yokukhipha umuntu emphakathini okwesikhashana ukuze kuhlanzeke le ndawo, futhi akuyona indlela yokujezisa. Umuntu angabanjwa ngewaranti noma ngaphandle kwayo. Khumbula ukuthi kuhle kakhulu ukuthola iwaranti. Into enhle ngayo ukuthi ivikela uphiko lwezepolitiki ekubanjweni icala futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi ukubamba nokuthola ubufakazi kuhlelekile. Iwaranti yokubamba ingatholwa kumagistrate noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukuvikela ukuthula, okungabandakanya uphiko lwezepolitiki olwenziwe umphakathi. Inhloso yalesi sabelo ukuhlela inhloso yokubamba umuntu nezinye izindlela zokwenza ukuthi ubonakale enkantolo. Yini inhloso yokubamba umuntu? Yini okusho ukuthi umuntu ubhekwa njengomuntu ongaphikiswa? Yiziphi ezinye izindlela, ngaphandle kokubamba, ezingaqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu othweswe icala ubonakala enkantolo? Buza abafundi ukuba baphendule umbiko ngalokho abakukhulumile. Phatha ingxoxo bese uhlela. Izinto okufanele zisetshenziswe ngesikhathi sokuhlanganisa. Akudingekile ukuxhumana nomuntu ovuma ngesikhathi eboshwa. Uma umuntu ephikisa ukubamba, kungasetshenziswa amandla afanele (amandla amancane) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubamba. Umphakathi obamba kufanele, ngokushesha okukhulu, azise umuntu obanjwe ngesizathu sokubamba. Uma umuntu eboshwa ngaphansi kwewaranti, ikhophi kufanele inikezwe uma iceliwe. Umuntu obanjwe kufanele aziswe ngamalungelo akhe ngokushesha okukhulu (njengoba kungenzeka ngokwezimo) njengoba kuqinisekisiwe engxenyeni 35 yeMthethosisekelo. Uphiko lwezepolitiki kufanele lukhumbuze futhi luchaze la malungelo wonke kumuntu obanjwe futhi luqinisekise ukuthi uyawuqonda ngokuhambisana nengxenye 35 yeMthethosisekelo. Ukubhekwa njengomuntu ongaphikiswa kuhambisana nelungelo lokungaziphikisi nokulunga kokuhlala silent. Umuntu othweswe icala akaphoqwa ukusiza uhulumeni kuleli cala. Uma uhulumeni ebanjwa umuntu, kufanele athole ubufakazi obuqinile bokuthi lowo muntu unecala. Inhloso yalesi sabelo iwukuthi uphiko lwezepolitiki lucabangele amalungelo abantu abanjwe kanye nezibopho abahlangabezana nazo mayelana nalabo abanjwe. Yini indlela efanele yokubamba umuntu? Yiziphi amalungelo nezibopho zomuntu obanjwe? Yini indima yephiko lwezepolitiki lapho kubanjwa umuntu? Yini okufanele uphiko lwezepolitiki lukhumbuze umuntu obanjwe ngesikhathi sokubamba? Nini futhi kuphi umuntu obanjwe angafaka isicelo sokukhululwa? Yiziphi amalungelo omuntu obanjwe angaphulwa? Lezi z права zingaphulwa kanjani? Phatha ingxoxo ejwayelekile mayelana nezinga elihlukene lamandla angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokubamba, uqala ngamandla amancane angasetshenziswa. Nini uphiko lwezepolitiki lungashaya umuntu ophunyukayo? Ingabe amandla angasetshenziswa uma kuseshwa umuntu obanjwe? Yiziphi izimiso ezisebenzayo uma kuseshwa nokutholwa kwezimpahla? Amalungelo omuntu ongena izimpahla ezithathwa ngenhloso yokuhlola, ngokuhambisana neMthethosisekelo; kanye nemikhawulo efanele yalezi zinkulumo, ngokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo nezikhombisi ezizothunyelwa kulesi sikhathi ngendlela ehambisana nezimiso zamalungelo; kanye nemiphumela yokusesha ngendlela engahambisani neMthethosisekelo. Ukusesha nokuthola izimpahla kuyisiphazamiso esikhulu samalungelo omuntu. I-Mthethosisekelo iqinisekisa ilungelo lokuba nemfihlo (ingxenye 14 yeMthethosisekelo) kanye nelungelo lokukhululeka nokuphepha (ingxenye 12 yeMthethosisekelo). Lezi zinkulumo zisho ukuthi uMbuso (uphiko lwezepolitiki) awukwazi nje ukusho ukuthi ubheka indlu yomuntu, indawo yabo, noma umzimba wabo futhi awukwazi ukuthatha impahla yakho, ukuvula imiyalezo yakho, noma ukufaka ucingo lwakho ngaphandle kokugunyazwa komthetho. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi la malungelo awagciniwe njengoba angancishiswa. Umthetho ka-1977 uvumela lokhu. Lokhu kungenzeka, ngokwesibonelo, lapho umuntu ehlolwa, lapho indlu yomuntu ihlolwa, noma lapho okuthile kuthathwa kumuntu ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Khumbula ukuthi uphiko lwezepolitiki lungasesha futhi luthathe izimpahla uma kugunyazwe umthetho ukwenza kanjalo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uphiko lwezepolitiki lusebenzisa lezi zikhwama ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo efanele yezenzo zomthetho futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungelo alowo muntu awaphulwa. Uma uphiko lwezepolitiki lwenza izibopho zawo ngokuhambisana nomthetho, le mpazamo yamalungelo omuntu izoba semthethweni (ngesizathu). Umuntu unamalungelo aqinisekisiwe yiMthethosisekelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yena noma impahla yakhe ibhekwa noma ithathwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi izenzo zephiko lwezepolitiki zihlale zisebenza ngokomthetho. Uma amalungelo omuntu ephulwa ngesikhathi sokusesha nokuthola, le mpazamo kufanele igcinwe ibe phansi. Inhloso yalesi sabelo iwukukhuthaza abafundi ukuba bacabangele imiphumela yokusesha nokuthola izimpahla engase ibe nomthelela kumalungelo omuntu. Buza abafundi ukuba benze amaqembu ukuze baxoxe ngezinto ezilandelayo. Hlinzeka ngezibonelo zamalungelo angaphulwa ngesikhathi sokusesha nokuthola. Bakhumbuze ukuthi babheke ingxenye yokuphulwa ekhasini 6 yamabhuku okusebenza futhi bahlolisise ukuthi ukusesha nokuthola izimpahla kungabhekwa njengokuphula amalungelo omuntu ngesizathu. Buza abafundi ukuba bahlinzeke ngezibonelo zomthetho (umthetho ojwayelekile) ophathelene nokusesha nokuthola izimpahla. Thola umbiko kumaqembu ngalokho abakukhulumile: iqembu ngalinye kufanele libhale amalungelo angaphulwa ku-flip chart noma ibhodi ngenkathi amaqembu ebika ngalokho abakukhulumile. Xoxa ngokusebenza kwengxenye yokuphulwa. Qeda ngezingxoxo ezijwayelekile. Uma kukhona amalungelo ngaphansi kweBill of Rights aphulwa, njengokusesha nokuthola izimpahla, ukuphulwa kufanele kuhlolwe ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zengxenye yokuphulwa. Amalungelo angaphulwa ukuze kube nokuqondanisa okukhona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuphulwa kufanele kube nokuhambisana okukhona emkhakheni wokusesha. Amanothi kufanele asebenzise le ndlela. Izinhloso yilezo ezizokweseka ukusesha. Ngakho-ke, ukuphulwa kuzoba nokuhambisana. Uphiko lwezepolitiki al
Lo mbhalo ochazayo ushintshwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("UMthetho"). Uqukethe ulwazi nge-SAMSA kanye nenqubo yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umthetho Wokuphepha Kwamanzini ka-1998 wasungula i-SAMSA ngoMsombuluko ka-1998. Sinomsebenzi wokubika kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha, ophakamisa ibhodi yethu futhi uvuma uhlelo lwethu lonyaka lwezohwebo. Ibhodi iphakamisa uMphathi Omkhulu (CEO) wethu, onomthwalo wemfanelo wezokuphatha nezokuhlela. Inhloso yethu ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokuphila nezimpahla olwandle, ukuvikela nokuvimbela imvelo yasemanzini ukuba ingcoliswe yizikebhe, nokukhuthaza uthando lwemikhumbi eNingizimu Afrika. Imisebenzi yethu yokusebenza ihlanganisa: ukubhalisela nokukhishwa kwamalayisense ezikebhe; ukuhlola izikebhe nokukhishwa kwamacertificates; ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bezokuthutha emanzini nokubakhishwa amacertificates; nokuvimbela ukungcoliswa kwemvelo yasemanzini. Isigaba 10 soMthetho sidinga ukuthi iKomidi Lezokuphila Lwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika likhiphe imigomo equkethe ulwazi oludingekayo umuntu adinge ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiluphi ilungelo ngaphansi koMthetho. Uma ufuna ukubona irekhodi elihlobene nanoma yiziphi zalezi zigaba, kufanele uqedele ifomu lesicelo elihlanganiswe nalolu mbhalo ochazayo (kodwa bheka isigaba 7 salolu mbhalo ochazayo). Kufanele uthumele ifomu lakho eliqediwe, kanye nemali yesicelo kanye nanoma iyiphi idiphozi (uma kudingeka), ehhovisi lolwazi kule ndawo yeposi, ngefeksi, noma kule imeyili ekhishwe esigabeni 2 salolu mbhalo ochazayo. Futhi ikheli lakho leposi noma inombolo yefeksi. Uma isicelo osithumelayo siwukwakhiwa komunye umuntu, kufanele unikeze ubufakazi obanele nobufanele ukuze ubonise ukuthi unegunya lokufaka isicelo ngabo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufinyelela kumarekhodi akusikho okwenziwa ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi kubalulekile ukuhlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zoMthetho ezihlobene nesicelo sakho. Uzokwaziswa ukuthi isicelo sakho siphumelele noma cha ngendlela obukhombisile efomini lakho. Noma ubani angafaka isicelo mathupha uma engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma uma engakhubazekile ngendlela yokuthi angakwazi ukuqedela ifomu. Kulokhu, abasebenzi behhovisi bazoqedela ifomu futhi banikeze usizo oludingekayo. Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi ibalwa ngokususelwa ezindlekweni zokukhiqiza, ucwaningo, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zokuthumela. Lapho umphathi wehhovisi wethu ethola isicelo sakho sokufinyelela kumarekhodi, uzocela (uma ungumfaki-sicelo) ukuthi ukhokhe imali yesicelo efanele ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho processing. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma isicelo sakho samukelwa, uzocelwa ukuthi ukhokhe imali yokuthola irekhodi: le mali ihlanganisa izindleko zokuhlola, ukukhiqiza, nezinhlelo, kanye nesikhathi esidingekayo ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezibekwe zokucela nokulungiselela irekhodi ukuze likhishwe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthi likhishwe ngendlela oyifunayo. Ungacelwa ukuthi ukhokhe idiphozi ngaphambi kokuthi uthole irekhodi: le diphozi iyingxenye yenani eliphelele lemali yokucela irekhodi futhi ibuyiselwa uma isicelo singaphumelelanga. Lezi zigaba zolwazi zitholakala kalula ukuze zihlolwe, zithengwe, noma zikhishwe, noma zitholakala mahhala. Asinazo izinhlelo ezibekwe ze-SAMSA zokubandakanya umphakathi ukuze umphakathi uthinteke lapho izinqubomgomo zisungulwa, noma lapho imisebenzi yenziwa. Nokho, isigaba 11 soMthetho Wokuphepha Kwamanzini waseNingizimu Afrika No. 5 ka-1998 sisho ukuthi i-SAMSA kufanele ixhumane nalabo abathintekayo uma kudingeka, lapho kwenziwa imisebenzi yayo. Senza lokhu ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene, njengokulandela izaziso ezifanele nezimvo zomphakathi uma umthetho ophakanyisiwe wephalamende wethulwa. Uma kukhona imibuzo mayelana nesimo esithile, wamukelekile ukuxhumana nehhovisi elikhulu noma ehhovisi eliseduze. Asinayo inqubo yokufaka izikhalazo ngaphakathi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umphathi wehhovisi wethu ehluleka isicelo sakho, futhi unekhalazo ngalolo shintsho, kuzodingeka ulandele inqubo yokufaka izikhalazo yangaphandle. Uma unekhalazo mayelana nokwenqaba kwesicelo sakho ngumphathi wehhovisi, unelungelo lokufaka isicelo enkantolo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30. Noma ubani othintekayo angakwenza lokho. Isicelo samukelwa ngu: (bhala isikhundla, igama, nesibongo somphathi wehhovisi/noma umphakathi wabo) ng... Imali yesicelo (uma kudingeka): R... Idiphozi (uma kudingeka): R... Imali yokuhlola: R... B. Ulwazi oluceliwe ukuze ufinyelele irekhodi a Ulwazi oluceliwe ukuze ufinyelele irekhodi kumele lunikezwe ngezansi. b Ikheli/inombolo yefeksi eNingizimu Afrika lapho ulwazi kumele luthunyelwe khona kumele lunikezwe. c Ubufakazi begunya lokufaka isicelo, uma kudingeka, kumele bungezwe. Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... Igunya lokufaka isicelo, uma kudingeka komunye umuntu:... Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... D. Ulwazi lwekhosombe a Nikeza imininingwane ephelele ye-ikhodi eceliwe, kuhlanganise nenombolo yokubhekisela uma iyaziwa, ukuze irekhodi litholakale. b Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singanele, qhubeka kwelinye ikhasi ozolithumela kule fomu. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele asayine wonke amakhasi anikeziwe. Incazelo ye-ikhodi noma ingxenye yayo:... Inombolo yokubhekisela, uma itholakala:... Noma yiluphi olunye ulwazi mayelana ne-ikhodi:... E. Imali ekhokhwayo a Isicelo sokufinyelela irekhodi ngaphandle kwalelo rekodi eliqukethe ulwazi lwakho sizobhekwa kuphela ngemva kokukhokha imali yesicelo. b Uzokwaziswa ngenani okufanele ukhokhe. c Inani elikhokhwayo lokuthola irekhodi lizoncika endleleni okudingeka ngayo nokuthi isikhathi esidingekayo sokucela nokulungiselela irekhodi. d Uma ukhululekile ekukhokheni noma yiziphi izimali, chaza izizathu zokukhululeka kwakho. Uma ungakwazi ukufunda ngenxa yokukhubazeka, sicela ukhombise noma uchaze ukuthi ungathanda kanjani ukuthola irekhodi njengoba kunikezwe ku-1 kuya ku-4 ngezansi, ubonise ukukhubazeka kwakho nokuthi ungathanda kanjani ukuthola irekhodi ngaphansi kwanoma yiziphi izimo. a Ukugcina isicelo sakho sokufinyelela irekhodi ngendlela oyicelile kuzoncika ekutheni le rekodi iyatholakala ngale ndlela. b Ukuthola irekhodi ngendlela eceliwe kungase kube nezithiyo kwezinye izimo. Uma kunjalo, uzokwaziswa uma irekhodi izokhishwa kuwe ngenye indlela. c Imali ekhokhwayo yokuthola irekhodi, uma kudingeka, kanye nendlela okudingeka ngayo kuzoba nomthelela. Uma ufaka isicelo sokukopisha noma irekhodi elirekhodiwe (ngaphezulu), ingabe ufuna le kopishi ithunyelwe kuwe ngeposi?
