I-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi (PSC) iyisikhungo somphakathi esizimele esisungulwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. I-PSC inemithwalo yemfanelo namandla, phakathi kwezinye izinto, yokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuhlela nokuphathwa kwemisebenzi kahulumeni. Le mmandla ifaka phakathi ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle noma okungasebenzi kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni. Ehlotshaniswa nalemithwalo, i-PSC inemithwalo yokukhuthaza izindlela zokwenza kube nokusebenza kahle nokusebenza kahle kwezinsizakalo zikahulumeni nokukhuthaza izindinganiso nezimiso zokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kubhalwe emthethosisekelweni kuzo zonke izisebenzi zikahulumeni. I-Commission ithola amandla ayo kwiSigaba 195 no-196 soMthethosisekelo, 1996. ISigaba 195 sichaza izindinganiso nezimiso ezilawula ukuphathwa komphakathi okufanele i-Commission ikhuthaze. Izinga eliphezulu le-ethics yobungcweti. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kusekelwe ekuthuthukiseni. Izinsizakalo kufanele zibe nezinga eliphezulu, zifanelekile, zibe nezehlakalo, futhi zingabi nenkohlakalo. Kumele ziphendule ezidingweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi kufanele ukhuthazwe ukuba ube nengxenye ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kube nekhono. Ukuveza kufanele kukhuthazwe. Ukusungulwa kokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu okuhle nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kufanele kube yindawo ethokozisa wonke umuntu ngokusekelwe kumakhono abo, ukucabanga ngokuzimela, ubuqotho, nokulungisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili. Ukukhuthaza izindinganiso nezimiso zokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe kwiSigaba 195 soMthethosisekelo, 1996 kuzo zonke izisebenzi zikahulumeni. Ukuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukuhlela, ukuphathwa, nokusebenza kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni, ikakhulukazi ukuhambisana nezindinganiso nezimiso ezishiwo kwiSigaba 195, kanye nezinqubo zokuqashwa kukahulumeni. Ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni lesizwe nasezindaweni mayelana nezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukuveza imiphumela nezincomo okungenani minyaka yonke kwiZikhulu Zesizwe noma kwiZikhulu zendawo njengoba zenzeka. Ukuveza izindaba eziphuthumayo ezihlobene nomsebenzi ezikhungweni ezifanele. Ukuhlola izikhalazo zabasebenzi nokwenza izincomo ezifanele zokulungisa. Ukuthuthukisa ukuphathwa nokusebenza komsebenzi. I-Commission isunguliwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. Umthetho ufuneka i-Commission eyodwa yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enamalungu alishumi nane, amahlanu awo aqokwa nguMongameli ngokuphakanyiswa kweZikhulu Zesizwe, kanti elinye ilungu lisuka esifundazweni ngalinye liqokwa nguMongameli wesifunda. I-Commission ibophezelekile kwiZikhulu Zesizwe okufanele ibike okungenani minyaka yonke. Kumele futhi ibike ngemicimbi yayo kwiZikhulu zendawo. Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla, i-PSC inamalungu alishumi nane: amalungu amahlanu asendaweni yasePretoria kanye nelinye esifundeni ngasinye. I-PSC ixhaswa yiHhovisi le-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, eliholwa nguMphathi-Jikelele (ongumphathi ophakeme), enehhovisi elikhulu ePretoria kanye nehhovisi lesifunda esisodwa esifundeni ngasinye. Lezi zikhungo zisebenza njengesisekelo samalungu eCommission ezifundazweni futhi ziphathwa ngabaqondisi bamasifunda, ngosizo lwamalungu ambalwa abasebenzi. Imisebenzi ethile nezisebenzi ezibalulekile zikhuluma ngazo ehhovisi lesifunda. Amalungu eCommission aqokwa nguMongameli, aqala ukusebenza kusukela ngoJanuwari 1, 1999. Nokho, ukuqala ngokusemthethweni kwemisebenzi yeCommission kwabambezela kuze kube nguJulayi 1999 ngenxa yezinkinga zomthetho phakathi kwezinye izindaba zeMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997. NgoJulayi 1, 1999, uMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997 kanye nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho weCommission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, 1997, kanye nokuphulwa kweCommission yeZokuphathwa Komphakathi, 1984, kwaba nomthelela, kuvumela i-Commission ukuthi isebenze ngokuphelele. Umkomishana uMgijima waphumelela uKomishana uVusi Mavuso owashiya esikhundleni sakhe. Ukwakhiwa kwenhlangano ye-PSC kwasungulwa ukuze kulandele imigomo yayo yecebo bese kuthi kamuva izigaba zayo zokusebenza. Umsebenzi weCommission uhlelwe ube yizigaba zayo eziyisithupha zokusebenza kanye nezindawo ezimbili ezikhuluma ngazo njengoba kushiwo endaweni 1 ngenhla. Ukuphathwa - kubhekisela ekuphathweni okuphelele nasezimali; ukuphatha abasebenzi nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza kubasebenzi; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomthetho nezinye izinsiza ezisetshenziselwa ukuthuthukisa inqubomgomo. Ibhange: Ukuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu Nezobudlelwano Bomsebenzi - Le bhange ivumela i-Commission ukuba iqhube imisebenzi yayo mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu; ukuqapha ubudlelwano bomsebenzi; kanye nemithetho yomsebenzi ngempumelelo. Ibhange: Ukuphathwa Okuhle Nokulethwa Kwezinsizakalo - Le bhange isebenzisa amandla eCommission ngokubhekelela nokuhlola; ukuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo; ukuziphatha okuhle kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni nezicwangciso zokubhekana nezingozi emsebenzini kahulumeni. I-Commission yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi: Amadokhumenti ahanjiswe ngamalungu eCommission kanye nemibhalo yemihlangano nezinkundla abebekhona. Imizuzu yemihlangano yokuphatha yonke. Amadokhumenti wokunikezwa kwemali evela kubahlinzeki. Izivumelwano nabahlinzeki. nokuhlola izikhalazo nezikhalazo ezibekwe ngabasebenzi bakahulumeni kanye nezincazelo ezifanele zokulungisa. nokuhlola izikhalazo ezihlobene nezicelo ezibekwe ngabasebenzi kanye nokuphathwa komphakathi. Futhi ucwaningo ngezindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi. nokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola izinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. ukuqapha nokuhlola izimo zomsebenzi nokuphathwa kokusebenza ngabaphathi bezigaba. kanye nokuhlola nokubika ngezinkinga zokuthanda kumaphathi nokugcina uhlaka lokwembula kwezimali; nokukhuthaza nokuhlola ukusebenza kahle ekubhekaneni nezingozi. nokulwa nokukhwabanisa emsebenzini kahulumeni ngokuhlola okuqondile; nokufaka isandla ekulweleni ukukhwabanisa ezwenikazi. Ukuthuthukisa Ukuphathwa Nokulethwa Kwezinsizakalo: izindaba ezihlobene nokuhlola, ukuqapha, nokuhlola imisebenzi yokuphatha nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo emsebenzini kahulumeni. ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kahle, okusebenzayo, nokonga kwezinsiza; nokuhambisana nezinqubo ezifanele emsebenzini weZinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Futhi ucwaningo ngezindaba ezihlobene nomsebenzi wabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Akukho sikhumbuzo esikhishwe mayelana nezigaba zezimali ze-PSC/OPSC, ezitholakalayo ngaphandle kokuthi umuntu ucele
Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuhola abakhandi bendabuko emsebenzini wabo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuphathwa kokwahlulelwa kwenziwa kahle kakhulu lapho bephatha njengababusi abaqinisekisiwe futhi basungula izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ekuphathweni kwemishado noma ukuqinisekiswa, ukuthathwa kwemishado esemthethweni noma eqinisekisiwe, kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo. a Amandla okubamba ngaphandle kwesimemezelo: umuntu ophula noma ozama ukuphula umthetho; umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi uzophuma ekubambeni okusemthethweni; umuntu otholakala enezinsiza zokweba noma/ kanye nezinsiza zokuphula imoto; umuntu otholakala enezinto okukholelwa ukuthi zibe zebiwe noma otholakala ezimeni eziphawulekayo; umuntu otholakala ebusuku ezimeni ezikhombisa ukuthi uphule noma uzophula umthetho; umuntu okukholelwa ukuthi ubevele waba nemfuyo, njll. kanye b Amandla okusebenzisa isiqinisekiso sokubamba. Bonke abakhandi bendabuko bangabaphathi bokuthula, ngakho-ke ngenxa yezikhundla zabo (ex officio) - bangababusi abaqinisekisiwe. Ngenxa yesikhundla sabo - umphathi oqinisekisiwe ungumuntu, ngenxa yesikhundla noma isikhundla sabo, okwenza kube umphathi oqinisekisiwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Lapho abanye abantu kufanele bafake isicelo kuNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ukuze baphathwe njengababusi abaqinisekisiwe, lo muntu akafaki isicelo. Uma abaphathwa abaqinisekisiwe bethola izitifiketi zokuphathwa, ngenxa yesikhundla sabo umphathi oqinisekisiwe akadingi isitifiketi, njengoba benesitifiketi sesikhundla noma isikhundla. Umphathi oqinisekisiwe uphathwa endaweni ethile futhi usebenza kule ndawo abaphathwe kuyo. Indima yomphathi oqinisekisiwe ukusiza amalungu omphakathi wendawo ngokuphatha imishado noma ukuqinisekiswa noma ukwenza isitatimende esiqinisekisiwe kumuntu. Enye imisebenzi yomphathi oqinisekisiwe ukuqinisekisa amakhophi wemibhalo njengamakhophi aqinile wemibhalo yokuqala. Akukho imali ethathwa ekuphathweni kwemishado noma ukuqinisekiswa, ekuqinisekiseni isitatimende, noma ekuqinisekiseni imibhalo. Umphathi oqinisekisiwe akavunyelwe ukuphatha imishado noma ukuqinisekiswa okuhlobene nendaba enomsebenzi wabo. Isizathu sithi umuntu oqinisekisa i-affidavit kufanele abe ngumuntu ongahlobene futhi ongenalo uhlelo oluthile endabeni equkethwe kwi-affidavit ukuze umuntu oqinisekisa akhululeke kunoma iyiphi ingcindezi yendaba ethile kwi-affidavit. Lo msebenzi owenziwa umphathi oqinisekisiwe unciphisa isidingo sokuthi abantu bahambe izindawo ezide ukuya ezikhungweni zamaphoyisa eziseduzane noma emahhovisi kaMagistrate ukuze bafune usizo. Uma umholi bendabuko, ngenxa yemisebenzi okufanele bayenze noma ngezizathu ezahlukene, engakwazi ukusebenza njengomphathi oqinisekisiwe, umphathi noma noma yimuphi umholi womphakathi ogunyaziwe ngumholi bendabuko angaba umphathi oqinisekisiwe kule ndawo, kuphela ngokuphathwa nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Amafomu esicelo (J5) atholakala emahhovisi kaMagistrate. Le fomu inamakhasi ayisithupha. Amakhasi amahlanu okuqala kufanele agcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo, kanti ikhasi lokugcina lidinga ukuthi uMagistrate agcwalisise iziphakamiso mayelana nesicelo. Ngokomthetho, lokhu kusho ukuthi umfaki-sicelo uzoba nezingxoxo zemibuzo noMagistrate, ezihlelwe nguMphathi weNkantolo yoMphakathi. Lapho kukhona umphathi womholi bendabuko noma omunye umholi womphakathi ogunyaziwe ngumholi bendabuko, kubalulekile ukuba kube nephepha lokuphawula elibhaliwe ngumholi bendabuko ukuze lihambisane nesicelo. UMagistrate uzothumela ifomu lesicelo kanye nephepha lokuphawula kuMnyango wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Abasebenzi boMnyango wezeMthetho kanye nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo bazobheka isicelo kuze kube isikhathi sokuxoxisana sitholakala nguNgqongqoshe/Ngqongqoshe noma abamele babo, okujwayelekile okuqukethe amalungu omnyango ezikhundleni eziphezulu. Isitifiketi sizothunyelwa emuva kuMagistrate ozosithumela kumfaki-sicelo. Umuntu oqinisekisa (umuntu owenze i-affidavit) angaya kumphathi oqinisekisiwe ne-affidavit ukuze aqinisekise noma aqinisekise. Nokho, uma kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye mayelana nemishado njengoba kucacisiwe ngumlomo; kanye iii Uma imishado eqinisekisiwe ngumlomo ibonwa njengokubopheleka enhliziyweni yabo. Imishado eqinisekisiwe ngumlomo yenziwa ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe ethi: "Ngiyafunga ukuthi okuqukethwe kule affidavit kuyiqiniso, uNkulunkulu angisize." Umuntu ophakanyisiwe uzocelwa ukuthi uphakamise isandla sokunene ukuze afunge. Uma umuntu ophakanyisiwe evuma ukuthi uyazi okuqukethwe kwalokho afungayo futhi utshele umphathi oqinisekisiwe ukuthi baphikisa imishado noma ukuthi ababona imishado njengokubopheleka enhliziyweni yabo, umphathi oqinisekisiwe uzokwenza ukuqinisekiswa. Ukuqinisekiswa kwenziwa ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe ethi: "Ngiyiqiniso ukuthi okukhuluma kuyiqiniso." Umuntu ophakanyisiwe kufanele asayine lokho akufungayo phambi komphathi oqinisekisiwe. Uma umuntu ophakanyisiwe engakwazi ukubhala, kufanele abeke uphawu ekugcineni kwamagama aphakanyisiwe. Uma umphathi oqinisekisiwe engaboni ukuthi umuntu ophakanyisiwe akakwazi ukubhala, kuzodingeka ukuthi lokhu kuqinisekiswe ngaphansi kwamagama aphakanyisiwe ngabanye abantu abathembekile. Ngemuva kokuba umuntu ophakanyisiwe esayine noma ebeke uphawu, umphathi oqinisekisiwe uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi umuntu ophakanyisiwe uvumile ukuthi bangakwazi futhi bayazi okuqukethwe kwamagama aphakanyisiwe futhi bazokhuluma indawo, indawo, nosuku lokwenza imishado. Umphathi oqinisekisiwe uzosayina imishado futhi abhale igama lakhe eliphelele kanye nekheli lomsebenzi ngaphansi kokusayina kwakhe, futhi futhi akhulume ngesikhundla sabo kanye nendawo lapho babebonile noma ihhovisi abakhona. "Ikheli lomsebenzi" lisho ikheli langempela hhayi ikheli leposi. Izikhwama ezifanele zitholakala ukusiza abaphathi abaqinisekisiwe ekwenzeni umsebenzi wemishado noma ukuqinisekiswa ngaphandle kokulibaziseka. Ikhophi yemibhalo okufanele iqinisekiswe njengekhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala kufanele iqhathaniswe nemibhalo yokuqala futhi kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le mibhalo emibili iyefana. Uma umphathi oqinisekisiwe ejabulela ukuthi ikhophi iyikhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala futhi akukho shintsho olungagunyaziwe olwenziwayo, umphathi oqinisekisiwe kufanele abhale ukuthi uqinisekisa ukuthi le mibhalo iyikhophi eqinile yemibhalo yokuqala futhi ukuthi akukho zinkomba zokuthi imibhalo yokuqala ishintshiwe ngabantu abangagunyaziwe. Ngemuva kwalokho, umphathi oqinisekisiwe kufanele asayine futhi abhale igama lakhe, isikhundla, imininingwane yokuxhumana, nosuku. Izikhwama ezifanele zitholakala ukuze kuqinisekiswe imibhalo. Uma imishado noma ukuqinisekiswa kungenziwa kahle njengoba kucacisiwe ngumlomo, khona-ke udaba luthunyelwa enkantolo, i-affidavit izobhekwa njengengamanga futhi ingaba nemiphumela emibi, njengokuholela ekukhululweni komsolwa ezimweni zezenzo ezimbi. Uma umphathi oqinisekisiwe ebona ukuthi umuntu ophakamisa is
Eminyakeni yethu yokuqala eyishumi njengohulumeni obusayo, siqondise amandla ethu nemizamo yethu ekushintsheni kusukela ekunakekeleni komphakathi kuya ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi ngokuhlela kahle ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza nemigomo. Njengomphakathi omusha, sithuthukise imigomo nezinsiza zomthetho ezivule indlela yokuthi singanikeza kanjani izinsiza kubantu abampofu nabasengcupheni njengoba bekulindeleke ngamalungelo abo. Umnyango eminyakeni eyishumi edlule ugxile ikakhulu ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ekubhekaneni nezidingo zezinsiza zomphakathi. Ukubaluleka kwesabelomali sokuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuholele ekwehliseni nasekuphuthumeni kwezinye izinsiza. Lokhu kuphinde kwanda ngenxa yokuthi izinsiza zokuvikela umphakathi zithuthukiswa ezingeni eliphansi kakhulu, izinsiza ezinganele zokuhlinzeka ngeminye imisebenzi yomphakathi kubantu abadingayo, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono phakathi kwabachwepheshe ababalulekile, kanye nokubhekelelwa kwemibutho yomphakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezinsiza. Lokhu kuholele nasekuphuthumeni kwemibutho enjalo nokulahlekelwa ngabasebenzi bakahulumeni, okuthinte kabi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga, uMnyango Kazwelonke Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uqale inqubo yokuthuthukisa uMthetho Wezimali Zokukhuthaza abahlinzeki bezinsiza. Izimo zangempela zezwe zidinga uhulumeni ukuthi abuyekeze indlela ahlukanisa ngayo izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kulabo ababe baphucwa. Ukuze kuhanjiswe imigomo, kwathuthukiswa nezifanekiso zezindleko ukuze kubhekwe izinkinga ezibanzi ezizothathwa. I-PFA ingenye yezinsiza ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqhutshekwe nezinguquko kokubili ekwethulweni kwezinsiza nasekusekeleni kwezimali kubahlinzeki bezinsiza. Uhulumeni, ngokuqhuba uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, kumele wethule le mvume, futhi siyazi ukuthi asikakwazi ukufezekisa lezi zinhloso nemigomo sodwa. Ngakho-ke, siwavule amaphiko ethu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukubambisana, ukusebenzisana, nokubandakanywa nemibutho Engahulumeni (NGOs), Imibutho Ekholelwayo (FBOs), Imibutho Ebasemphakathini (CBOs), imibutho ehambisana nohulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Kumele zixhaswe kahle futhi kumele kube nezindinganiso ezibekwe ngendlela ezixhaswa ngayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe izifunda. Izifanekiso Zezindleko Zohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ziqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukusethwa kwezindinganiso nokulingana ekuhlinzekeni kwezinsiza. Iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhaswa, njengoba kuchazwe ku-PFA, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ziqondiswa emiphakathini nasezikhungweni ezidinga kakhulu futhi ukuthi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithengekayo. Ngemuva kwalokhu, uhulumeni uthuthukise futhi wavuma amathuluzi okuphatha nezikhombisi-ndlela, ezihlanganisa ingxenye yesikhungo esibanzi sokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza okumele kuhlanganiswe noMthetho Wezimali Zokukhuthaza kanye neSifanekiso Sokwethulwa Kwezinsiza. Njengohulumeni, ngeke sikhohlwe ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nemiphakathi ekuhlinzekeni kwezinsiza. Sibone amaphrojekthi afana nezinhlelo Zomsebenzi Womphakathi Ewandisiwe (EPWP), Izinhlelo Zokunciphisa Ubumpofu (ukubala ezimbalwa), ezihlanganisa umphakathi nohulumeni ekuhlinzekeni kwezinsiza. Yile moya yokubambisana ezosisiza sibone imiphumela engcono nokubandakanywa kwabantu bethu kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Izinsiza nezinsizakalo ezenziwe ngababambiqhaza, abahlinzeki bezinsiza ezizimele, kanye namalungu omphakathi zibalulekile kakhulu. Ngempela, ngempumelelo yeqembu singenza sithi isisekelo sesakhiwe, nakuba kunobunzima obuningi esibhekene nabo ekwenzeni izinkokhelo ezibalulekile kubantu abangujwayelekile abangujwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika abalahlekelwa ithemba ezinsizeni zethu. Umnyango uphinde ufise ukuqaphela abantu nezikhungo ezisizile ekuthuthukiseni le mthetho, iminyango ezingeni lesifunda, amalungu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi ngeziphakamiso zabo nemibono. Ukubambisana komnyango nomphakathi kuhlala kuyisici esiyinhloko sezinhloso zokweseka ukusebenza kahle nokufeza umgomo wethu. Uhulumeni namuhla ubhekene nezinkinga ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza ezinhle kakhulu kubantu abakhathazekile nabaphucwa emphakathini. Emlandweni, izinsiza zokunakekela umphakathi zaziyimfuno yokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni nemibutho yomphakathi, lapho uhulumeni ayengumxhaso ophambili wemibutho ngokwesekwa kwawo. Izimo zangempela zidinga uhulumeni ukuthi abuyekeze indlela ahlukanisa ngayo izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kulabo ababe baphucwa. Izinyathelo zithathwe esikhathini esedlule ukuze kuthuthukiswe umthetho wezikhuthazo zezimali ze-NPOs. Nokho, lo mthetho awukakafiki ezidingweni zombili zikahulumeni kanye nomkhakha we-NPO. Manje sekukhona isidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthuthukisa umthetho ozokuqinisekisa ukuthi umnyango ungahlinzeka ngezinsiza ukuze uthembise ukuphila okungcono kubantu bonke. Umthetho wezikhuthazo zezimali uhlose ukuhlela ukuxhaswa kwezimali zezwe kubahlinzeki bezinsiza emkhakheni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, usheshise ukuletha izinguquko nokuhlela izinsiza nezimali, futhi uqinisekise izinsiza ezisebenzayo nezisebenzayo emiphakathini ebuthakathaka nabampofu. Lo mthetho uzinikele ekuqedeni ukufinyelela kwezinsiza kubampofu nabaphucwa ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila okungcono kubo, ngokubambisana nalabo abafuna ukwakha umphakathi onakekelayo. Umthetho nezinsiza zomthetho zezwe zenza indawo efanele yokuthi umnyango ufeze izinhloso zawo, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokusatshalaliswa okufanele kwezinsiza. Igunya eliphethwe umkhakha we-NPO ekuhlinzekeni kwezinsiza liyavuma. Ezinye ze-NPOs ziye zenza izinguquko ezibalulekile mayelana nezidingo zokunakekelwa komphakathi zezwe. Nokho, ukuguqulwa okudingekayo kuseyinkinga enkulu kuhulumeni. Ukufinyelela kulokhu kanye nokwethulwa kwemvume yakho, umnyango udinga ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izinhloso okufanele zifezekiswe, ukuthi zizofezekiswa kanjani, nokuthi zingakhalipha kanjani ukusebenza kohlelo. Umthetho ubeka phambili izinselelo nezindawo ezibhekiswe kuzo, ezizokwenza ukuthi kuqondiswe kanjani izinsiza, kuphi, futhi ngubani, nokuthi zixhaswe kanjani nguhulumeni. Uveza izindinganiso zokukhethwa kokuxhaswa. Izindinganiso zokufaneleka, kanye nezindlela zokukhokha nezidingo zokuxhaswa. Njengoba kwenziwa emhlabeni jikelele, abaxhasi bomphakathi nabazimele bafuna ukubhekelelwa kwezimali abazixhasayo, kuhlanganise nokukhalipha ukusebenza kahle. Umnyango uzongena ezivumelwaneni nabahlinzeki bezinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza okulindelekile kuyafezekiswa nok
Okwamanje, kukhona impumelelo yezomnotho, umgomo kahulumeni obanzi wokuhlukahluka okukhulu, izinhlelo zamasu, nezinye izinhlelo, lapho ukuhlukahluka komlando kuqhubeka nokuba ingxenye yomnotho wezolimo, kuqhuba njengokulinganisa ukukhula, kuthuthukisa umnotho, kudala imisebenzi, futhi kwehlisa ubuphofu. Ukungalingani okukhulu ngemibala kanye nobulili ekufinyeleleni emnothweni, imali, amakhono, kanye nemisebenzi kuqhubeka. Njengomphumela, lesi sikhungo siqhubeka sisebenza ngaphansi kwamathuba awo. Le dokhumenti esemthethweni ye-NAMC ihloselwe ukwazisa bonke ababambiqhaza emkhakheni wezolimo mayelana namandla e-NAMC kanye nezinhlelo zayo ezihlukahlukene ezihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lesi sikhungo sikhona futhi sishintshile. Ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana, sinikeza amatafula anemininingwane yokuxhumana ngezikhungo ezihlukahlukene zezolimo kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni. Ukunikeza iseluleko kuNgqongqoshe Wezolimo kanye namathimba afanele ngqo ngezindaba zonke ezihlobene nokumaketha kwezolimo embonini yokudla nezolimo, ngenkathi sihlinzeka ngezidingo zababambiqhaza. Ukuba ngumeluleki obalulekile kuNgqongqoshe, i-DoA, kanye nomkhakha wokumaketha kwezolimo kanye nemikhiqizo. I-NAMC iqhuba imisebenzi yayo ngezinhlelo ezine zobuchwepheshe kanye nohlelo lokweseka olusebenza ngokuhambisana. Izindawo ezibalulekile zokusebenza ze-unit zifaka phakathi Izinhlelo Zokumaketha/AgriBEE, Ukumaketha, kanye Nokuncintisana. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ziyizinhlelo ezisemqoka ezitholwe yi-NAMC ezihloselwe ukukhuthaza nokwenza kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwabafama abasanda kuvela emkhakheni wezolimo nokumaketha, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhweba kwemikhiqizo evela kubafama abamnyama emkhakheni. Imboni yenyama ebomvu kanye nezimboni zezitshalo zikhonjiswe njengemikhakha ebalulekile kulolu hlelo lwesikhashana. Lesi sikhungo siphinde sibe nesibopho sokunikeza iseluleko kwiKhansela ngezindaba ezihlobene nezintela nokumaketha nokwenza ucwaningo olufanele kule ndawo. Ekugcineni, umkhakha Wokumaketha Nokuthengisa uzobamba amandla abalulekile ekuxhumaneni nocwaningo nokuxoxisana mayelana nezimo zokuncintisana emkhakheni wezolimo, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wokumaketha kwezolimo. I-NAMC okwamanje ikhulisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ezihloselwe ukusiza umnotho wezolimo. Inhloso eyinhloko yezi zinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ukuhlinzeka ngama-incentive emakethe ukuze kuthengwe kubakhiqizi abasanda kuvela. Inhloso ukuhlela nokusebenzisa okungenani lezi zinhlelo ezintathu ngonyaka. Lokhu kubhekwa njengomsebenzi obalulekile osekelayo kumakethe yezolimo ye-DoA kanye necebo lokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi kanye necebo lokumaketha kwezolimo ukuze kusungulwe izinhlelo ezine Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe ngaphambi kukaMashi 2006. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwamakethe zizohlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlanganisa abafama abamnyama ngaphakathi kwezi zinhlelo. Umgomo wezintela ubandakanya ukufaka izintela noma ukuhoxisa izintela noma ukulungisa amazinga ezintela akhona ekuthengiseni kwamazwe ngamazwe ngenhloso yokufeza izinhloso zokuthuthukiswa kukahulumeni. Inhloso eyinhloko yomgomo wezintela, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuvikela imboni yasekhaya, ukuthuthukisa isimo sokuncintisana kwabakhangisi bendawo, nokuhlanganisa izintela zokungenisa nezimikhiqizo ezifanayo zendawo. I-NAMC, ngeMkhakha Wayo Wokumaketha Nokuthengisa, izozama ukuqhubeka nobudlelwano bokubambisana ne-ITAC futhi iqale ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ezingxoxweni zomgomo wezintela ezihlobene nezolimo. Iphuzu lokuqala kuzoba ukwakha amandla ethu angaphakathi okuthi sizokwazi ukufinyelela ngokuqasha abantu abasebenza kwezomnotho wokumaketha kwezolimo ngesikhathi sokwethulwa kwalesi sibalo. Umgomo wesikhungo ukuhlela nokubhalisela, sisebenzisa izibonelo zezifundo, izindlela ezinhle zokusekela abafama. Lesi sikhungo sizothuthukisa futhi sikwazise ama-template azoholela ekuxhumaneni kokumaketha okuzofaka Amabhizinisi Aphathwe Ngaphambili emnothweni wezolimo wesibili (umnotho oyinhloko). Ibhizinisi kumele likwazi futhi likwazi ukungena esivumelwaneni sokwabelana ngezindleko ngesixhaso esidingekayo ngesisekelo sokuthola i-NAMC. I-NAMC ihlose ukusungula ifa elihloselwe ukusiza lezi zibhanqa ukufinyelela kwi-database yabahlinzeki ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kwabo emakethe futhi ngaleyo ndlela bakhule futhi baqinise amabhizinisi abo. Usizo luzobhekana ngqo nezindaba ezifana nokuqeqeshwa, ukuthuthukiswa kwecebo lebhizinisi, izinhlelo ezifanele zokufakazela, ukuhola, njll. Lokhu kuzohlinzekwa ngababoneleli bezinsizakalo abanezikhwama zokwethula iziqu. Umgomo ophawulekayo mayelana nokusetshenziswa nokuphathwa kwezimali uzothuthukiswa. I-ATAF ayikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali (ukwakhiwa noma izikhwama) noma ukuthenga izimpahla zohlobo oluthile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimoto, izakhiwo, imishini, nezakhiwo zomzimba. I-ATAF futhi ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengefa lokubolekwa noma nganoma iyiphi enye injongo. Ifa le-DoA AgriBEE lizokwakhiwa maduze ukuze liqashe lezi zenzo ezifanele ezithuthukiswe ngokuqhuba i-ATAF. Ukwakha i-database yabahlinzeki bamabhizinisi aphathwe ngaphambili eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhuma labo abakwi-database nezimakethe ezifanele. Qhubeka Nokuthuthukiswa Kokuthekelisa. Umsebenzi obalulekile weMkhakha Wokuthuthukiswa Kwebhizinisi (ED Sector) ukuhlela izivakashi eziphumelelayo ezikhangisweni zamakethe zababhizinisi abakwi-database yabahlinzeki. Lezi zivakashi zizosebenza ukusiza lezi zibhanqa ezaphathwa ngaphambili abakwi-database yabahlinzeki ukuze ziveze ukuncintisana emakethe yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze zifinyelele emakethe yokuthekelisa enenzuzo. Ukuxhumana kwabahlinzeki kuqala ngokukhiqiza ngemboni yezolimo noma ngezinga layo lokukhiqiza. Imakethe kumele ibe khona ukuze kukhiqizwe. Umkhakha we-ED uzosebenzisa i-ATAF lapho kudingeka ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana kokuhlinzeka. Ukuxhumana kokudinga kuqala ngokudinga kwemakethe. Amabhizinisi amakhulu wezolimo adinga abakhiqizi abancane ukuze babahlinzeke ngempahla ukuze bahlangabezane nezintengo ezibekwe ngaphakathi kwemakethe noma izivumelwano zokuhlinzeka nabathengisi kanye nabathengisi. Umkhakha we-ED uzosebenzisa i-ATAF ukweseka lezi zinkampani zezomnotho ezikwazi ukusebenzisa ukuxhumana okwakhiwe kabi. Lesi sikhungo sihlela zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokuhambisana nemithetho. Ububanzi obujwayelekile bezindlela zomphakathi, izindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi, nezindlela ezincane. Izakhiwo nezinye izisebenzi phezulu noma phansi kwezindlela zomphakathi noma izindlela zokuthutha zomphakathi noma ezinye izindawo. Umkhakha wezokumbiwa eNingizimu Afrika udlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni womhlaba. Ngo-2001, ukumbiwa kwaba negalelo elingaphezu kuka-6% ku-Gross Domestic Product (GDP) yelizwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhiqizwa kwekhabhoni kuyinsiza eyinhloko yokusebenza yamandla kubakhiqizi bamakhaya eNingizimu Afrika, abaphinde bayithumele kwamanye amazwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imikhiqizo yensimbi kanye nemikhiqizo engeyona insimbi ibalulekile emkhakheni wokwakha futhi isekela ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwezinsiza zomphakathi zezwe. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) ibheka ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi bemigodi nabanye abathintekayo emisebenzini yokumbiwa. Iphokophele ukunciphisa izigameko zokulimala nezifo, ngaleyo ndlela ibonise izinselelo ezibhekene nomkhakha wezokumbiwa. Impilo yomsebenzi kunzima ukuyilinganisa nokuyiphatha, njengoba imiphumela yomsebenzi empilweni yomuntu ingase ingaveli ngokushesha. Izifo zamaphaphu nokulahleka kokuzwa ngenxa yomnoise kuyizinkinga ezinkulu zempilo emkhakheni wezokumbiwa, ezibangelwa ukusebenza ezindaweni ezinezinkanyezi nezimnandi isikhathi eside. Imigodi yegolide ithola abasebenzi abaningi emkhakheni wezokumbiwa uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izimboni; ngakho-ke, abasebenzi bayo bahlala besengozini enkulu yezifo zokuphefumula uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abakwi-migodi eminye. Isifo samaphaphu esikhathazayo kakhulu emigodini yegolide yi-silicosis, etholakale kuwo wonke imigodi ye-hard rock, ngesikhathi sokumbiwa nokuphola kwe-ore, lapho ama-particles e-silica angaba phezulu. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezibeka abasebenzi engcupheni ye-silica kanye nesifo se-silicosis kudala ingozi yokuthola i-tuberculosis. I-silicosis nayo iyinkinga enkulu emigodini ye-khabhoni. Kukhona ukuqaphela okukhulayo komnoise njengengozi yempilo kubasebenzi abangaphansi komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika. Umkhakha wethule izinhlelo zokuvikela ukuzwa (HCPs) ngo-1988, njengoba imisebenzi eminingi eyenziwa ekukhishweni kwemaminerali ibangele inani elikhulu labantu abathintekayo kumazinga omsindo aphakeme kunezinga elamukelekayo neliphephile elingu-85 dB. Nakuba izinyathelo zithathwe ukuze kulawulwe izingozi zomnoise, le nkinga isaqhubeka. Kubhekwa ukuthi phakathi kuka-68% no-80% babasebenzi bemigodi basebenza ngaphansi kwamazinga omsindo angu-85 dB noma ngaphezulu, okukhombisa ukuthi iningi labantu laba bahlala besengozini yokulahlekelwa ukuzwa. Imigodi ebhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu mayelana nokuphepha emsebenzini yilezo zegolide ne-platinum. Eminyakeni yamuva, ukukhiqizwa kwe-platinum kukhule, kuholela emisebenzini eminingi. Ngeshwa, lokhu kuphinde kwaholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokulimala. Kutholakale ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa nokuqwashisa emkhakheni we-platinum kuphansi kulokhu kukhula. Umkhakha wezokumbiwa kwegolide uhola ezimeni zokulimala ngenxa yokujula kokusebenza nokwehla kwezindonga. Nakuba imisebenzi yokumbiwa kwegolide yehlile kakhulu eminyakeni yamuva, le nhlobo ayibonisi ukuthuthuka ezingeni lokuphepha ngesikhathi esifanayo. Ngenkathi kungase kube nezinguquko ngenxa yezinhlobo zomsebenzi wokumbiwa ongaphansi komhlaba nezinga elihlukile lezingcuphe ezimweni zokumbiwa, lezi zingozi zomsebenzi zidinga ukuphathwa kahle. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuwa komhlaba kuhlala kuyinto evamile futhi ebanga impilo emigodini yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukulahlekelwa impilo kanye nenani lokulimala okwenza abasebenzi bangakwazi ukusebenza kulo mkhakha kungancishiswa ngokukhetha nokusebenzisa izinyathelo zokulawula ezifanele nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinga eliphezulu lokuhambisana nemithetho ligcinwa. Ukuphepha emigodini emincane nakho kuyakhathaza ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokulimala okukhona lapho. Kutholakale ukuthi imbangela yalesi simo ukuqeqeshwa okulinganiselwe kanye nezinsiza ezinganele. Abasebenzi kulo mkhakha badinga usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwemigodi, futhi imikhankaso ehlukene isiqalile ukuhlinzeka ngensiza edingekayo. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) isekela imikhankaso ebanzi, efana nokukhuthaza imigodi emincane. Ekugcineni, le ofisi iyingxenye yokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS. Isekela imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi kanye nezinhlelo ezihloselwe ukunciphisa ukuvela kwe-HIV/AIDS emkhakheni wezokumbiwa. Iphinde yasungula ikomidi le-tripartite elibhekelela i-HIV/AIDS emkhakheni wezokumbiwa. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi nezibanzi ezibhekene nomkhakha wezokumbiwa, uhlelo oluqinile lokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izithakazelo, kuhlanganise nabaqashi nohulumeni, lungahlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. I-Department of Mineral Resources and Energy (DME) ibhekelela kahle imikhakha yemaminerali namandla eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhula komnotho nokuthuthukiswa. Omunye wemigomo yayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinkampani ziphephile futhi zisebenza kahle. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) iyakwenza lokhu emuva kwe-DME, futhi le ndatshana igxile kakhulu kuyo. I-MHSI yasungulwa ukuze ivikele ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi nabanye emigodini. Umbono wayo uwukubhekana nezibopho zayo ngokuqinile nangendlela ekhombisa ubuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nemiphumela emihle ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekwe kuleli kanye nakwamanye amazwe mayelana nempilo nokuphepha emkhakheni wezokumbiwa. Imisebenzi ehamba phambili ye-MHSI ifaka phakathi ukuhlola imigodi, ukuhlola nokuphenya izingozi nezinye izigameko ezihlobene nempilo nokuphepha, nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana neMine Health and Safety Act (MHSA) ka-1996, okuyiwo umthetho we-ofisi yokuhlola. Amandla e-MHSI okuqinisekisa umthetho afaka phakathi ukukhipha izaziso zokuhambisana kanye nokuvalela imigodi, ukufaka izijeziso, nokwenza iziphakamiso mayelana nokuphikiswa kwabaphula umthetho. I-MHSI ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukukhipha okuphephile kwemaminerali nokuthi imisebenzi yenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo eziphilile. Ukulawulwa okungcono kuqhamuka ngemva kokuxoxisana okuningi nazo zonke izithakazelo emkhakheni. Ubudlelwano be-tripartite, ukuhlola izingozi, ukucubungula izinhlelo ezihlelwe, ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kanye nezibuyekezo ezivamile, ucwaningo, nokuphenya konke kubalulekile emisebenzini ye-MHSI ukuze kutholakale imiphumela. Nokho, i-ofisi yokuhlola idinga ukwesekwa kuwo wonke umphakathi wezokumbiwa ukuze ifinyelele lezi zinjongo, njengoba wonke umuntu uzothola inzuzo. Abasebenzi bemigodi basebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile ezibeka engcupheni ngenxa yomnoise, ukunyakaza, ukushisa nokubanda, umsebenzi ophindaphindiwe onzima, amakhemikhali ayingozi, uthuli, namagasi ane-levels aphezulu yokutoxicity. Bahlupheka ngokulahlekelwa kokuzwa, i-silicosis, i-pneumoconiosis, i-tuberculosis, isifo samatshe, kanye ne

Amalungu eKomidi aqokwe yiNhlangano Kazwelonke yeZifunda asebenza kuze kube sebekhishwe ngokuhlanganyela noma uma kwenzeka enye isikhala emgqeni owakhiwe. Amanye amalungu aqokwe noma akhethwe yiKomidi asebenza kuze kube sebekhishwe yilabo abawathumile noma abawakhulume. Ilungu leKomidi eliqokwe ngale ndlela ngaphansi kwesigaba-178 1 e, f, g, h, kanye i yeMithetho lizoshiywa isikhundla sazo ngokushesha uma iziqu zayo zemfundo zingasavumeli isikhundla esaqokwa. USekela, uNkk. I Greenstein ungumholi wesekheti. Umhlahlandlela uzotholakala kwiKomidi Yezobulungiswa Yabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kungakapheli umhla ka-31 December 2003. Isaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba-15 sichaza izigaba zamadokhumenti ezikhungweni ezikhona ezingadingi umuntu ukuthi athumele isicelo esivunyelwe ngumthetho. Ulwazi ngesaziso seKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa elibhalwe esigabeni-15 alutholakali njengamanje. Umbiko wonyaka obhekiswe kwiPhalamende. Ukuhlola indawo egcina amadokhumenti agciniwe. Iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kuMongameli. ukufinyelela kumadokhumenti akwenqabiwe ngenxa yezizathu ezishiwo emthethweni. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni [Isaziso soHulumeni R187-15 sikaDecember 2002] (Ifomu-A). Umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhombise uma isicelo singekho ikhophi yedokhumenti noma uma umfaki-sicelo efisa ukungena kudokhumenti ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma idokhumenti ingeyona incwadi, ingafundwa ngendlela efunwayo, uma kukhona indlela esigabeni -292. uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela kuhlobo oluthile lwefomu, umfaki-sicelo uzofinyelela ulwazi ngendlela abacela ngayo. Ngaphandle kwesimo lapho imvume ingaphazamisa ukusebenza kahle kwenhlangano yomphakathi ethintekayo, umonakalo kudokhumenti noma ukuphazamiseka kwamalungelo akhethekile okuphathwa kwedokhumenti kahulumeni. Uma kunezizathu ezinkulu zokungamukeli isicelo ngendlela efunwayo kodwa kukhona indlela ehlukile, izindleko zokuhambisana nesicelo zizokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nesicelo sokuqala esenziwe ngumuntu ngaphansi kwesigaba -293 no-4. uma kunezimp responses ezibhaliwe eziphendula isicelo, umfaki-sicelo ofuna ulwazi ngesinqumo ngenye indlela, ngokwesibonelo; ngefoni, kufanele akhombise lesi sigaba -182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, kufanele kuchazwe ukuthi baphakanyiswa ngelinye futhi kufanele kube neziqinisekiso ezisekelayo ezihambisana nesicelo esigabeni -182f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala noma unokukhubazeka, bangathumela isicelo sedokhumenti ngokukhuluma. Umphakathi wezokwazi kufanele aqedele ifomu egameni lomfaki-sicelo futhi anikeze umfaki-sicelo leyo doko/ikhophi esigabeni-183. Umfaki-sicelo ofuna ukufinyelela kumadokhumenti aqukethe ulwazi lomuntu mayelana nomfaki-sicelo akadingi ukukhokha imali yesicelo. Umphakathi wezokwazi kufanele wazise umfaki-sicelo (ukuhlukanisa umuntu ofuna ulwazi ngaye) uma umfaki-sicelo edinga ukukhokha imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nesicelo. Imali ethile engu-R35 ikhokhwa ngokuthenga izimpawu zentela ezitholakala ehhovisi leposi. Inani elifanele lezimpawu kufanele lifakwe efomini lesicelo (Ifomu A). Uma izimpawu zingafakwanga, isicelo ngeke processing kuze kube sekukhokhwa imali ethile noma ethile. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka isicelo enkantolo ephikisana nokuhanjiswa noma ukukhokha imali yesicelo. Ngemva kokuthi umphakathi wezokwazi wenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela efunwayo ngumfaki-sicelo. Uma umfaki-sicelo ethola imvume, kukhona enye imali yokufinyelela kudokhumenti okufanele ikhokhwe ukuze kufunwe, kulungiswe, kuphinde kuphumelele, futhi kukhokhwe isikhathi esengeziwe sokufuna nokuhlelwa kwamadokh
Kunomehluko phakathi kokwahlulela uma kukhona impikiswano nokusiza amaqembu abandakanyekayo empikiswaneni ukuba ayixazulule. Ekwahluleleni, umuntu ongengowempikiswano uthatha isinqumo mayelana nempikiswano, futhi leso sinqumo kumele sibe sihlose amaqembu abandakanyekayo. Uma umuntu ongengowempikiswano esiza lawa maqembu ekuxazululeni impikiswano, sithi lokho kungukuhlanganyela noma ukuvuselela. Uma amaqembu abandakanyekayo exazulula izinkinga zawo ngaphandle kokungenelela komuntu wesithathu, lokhu kuyimiphumela yenqubo yokuxoxisana phakathi kwamaqabunga amabili. Abaphathi bezomthetho ezinkantolo bathola amandla abo okwahlulela ngokuba baqokwe ngezinhlinzeko zomthetho. Futhi kungenzeka ukuthi amaqembu abandakanyekayo empikiswaneni azoletha impikiswano zawo ukuze zihlulelwe ngumuntu abavumelana naye ukuba abe yisikhulu sokwahlulela. Ezivumelwaneni eziningi, amaqembu afaka isigaba esivuma ukuthi noma iyiphi impikiswano ephuma phakathi kwabo ezivumelwaneni zabo izothunyelwa kumhlinzeki. Umhlinzeki angabizwa noma isigaba singachaza ukuthi umhlinzeki uzokhethwa kanjani, ngokwesibonelo, ummeli okhethwe yiBar Association. Isivumelwano sokuhlanganyela asidingi ukuba sibhale. Emiphakathini ethile noma emindenini, kungenzeka kube nesivumelwano sokuthi impikiswano izothunyelwa kumholi womphakathi noma kumholi wemindeni ngoba lokho kuyisiko elalandelwa isikhathi eside. Impikiswano ichazwa ngumuntu ophathiswe umthetho owenziwe nguhulumeni. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo awakwazi ukukhetha ukuthi ubani umuntu ophathiswe umthetho. Le nqubo ilawulwa yimithetho, izinqubomgomo, noma amasiko ezinkantolo. Kungaba nzima kumaqembu abandakanyekayo ukuqhubeka ngaphandle kokwethulwa komthetho. Isinqumo kumele sihlale sihambisana nesibonelo esifanele. Isinqumo siqinisekiswa ngenqubo esemthethweni noma engemthethweni. Isinqumo singavame ukuthathwa ngokufaka isicelo ezinkantolo eziphakeme. Izinqumo ezinkantolo eziphansi zingathathwa ngokuphathwa. Kuvamile ukuba kube nemiphumela yokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Umuntu otholwe enecala ukhokha izindleko ezitholakele zokusebenzisa abameli. Azikho izindleko zokwenziwa kwezinkantolo ezikhokhelwa kusenesikhathi ngaphandle kwamastamp. Qaphela: inkantolo ephansi ihluke ngokuthi inqubo iyinqubo yokuhlola futhi amaqembu abandakanyekayo awadingeki ukuba amelelwe ngababonisi. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo akhetha umhlinzeki (umhlinzeki). Umhlinzeki angaba ngumuntu onolwazi olunzulu kulolo mkhakha. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo anenkululeko yokukhetha inqubo yabo. Isidingo sokwethulwa komthetho sizoncika enhlanganweni ekhethiwe. Isinqumo kumele sithathwe njengomyalelo wenkantolo ukuze sisebenze kahle. Akukho isicelo esizofakwa ezinkantolo—kungavunyelwana ukuthi isicelo sithathwe ngababonisi abanye. Isinqumo singathathwa ngokuphathwa yiNkantolo Ephakeme. Kuvamile ukuba kube nemiphumela yokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Umuntu otholwe enecala ukhokha izindleko ezitholakele zokusebenzisa abameli. Ukukhokha kwabameli kuzokwenziwa ngamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Akukho ukusiza ekuxazululeni udaba oluvela kumuntu wesithathu. Le nqubo ilawulwa ngamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Iqembu ngalinye elibandakanyekayo lingasebenzisa abeluleki bezomthetho, kodwa lokho akudingekile. Umphumela uncike kumandla nobuchule bamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Azikho izindleko zomthetho ngaphandle kwezindleko zabeluleki bezomthetho uma zisetshenzisiwe. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Umuntu wesithathu angasiza ekuxazululeni udaba. Le nqubo ilawulwa ngumhlinzeki ophatha izeluleko kumamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Abeluleki bezomthetho beqembu ngalinye abadingeki uma le nqubo ithathwa. Umphumela ungaba yifiso yomhlinzeki kodwa abenzi izinqumo. Umphumela uvame ukuba yisimo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo akhokha izindleko zomhlinzeki uma zikhona. Lokhu kuyindlela lapho umuntu wesithathu, umhlinzeki/umuntu olethe ukuthula, edingeka ukusiza amaqembu abandakanyekayo axazulule izinkinga zabo. Kungachazwa njengokuxoxisana okusekelayo. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi ukulethela udaba kumhlinzeki ngamaqembu abandakanyekayo kuyazithandela, kodwa ngokomthetho, isiko noma isivumelwano singadinga ukuthi amaqembu abandakanyekayo alethe udaba lwabo kumhlinzeki. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi umhlinzeki abe ngumuntu owamukelekayo kokubili amaqembu abandakanyekayo, umuntu ongaxhunyiwe nganoma iyiphi indlela kumqembu ongena noma kudaba. Umhlinzeki akufanele athathe izinhlangothi. Umhlinzeki akawenzi izinqumo zamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Indima yomhlinzeki ukusiza amaqembu abandakanyekayo axazulule izinkinga zabo. Umhlinzeki kumele azame ukuthi kokubili amaqembu abandakanyekayo awine ukuze kungabi khona iqembu elishiywe likwahlulelwe. Lokhu kubalulekile uma amaqembu abandakanyekayo enobudlelwano obuqhubekayo ngoba ubuhlungu obungazwakali kumqembu okwahlulelwe bungaholela ekuqhekekeni kobudlelwano obuhle. Akukho umthetho ophatha ukuhlinzekwa, kodwa ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlinzekwa ziyaqhubeka zikhishwa umthetho, ngokwesibonelo, impikiswano zabasebenzi zikhishwa nguMthetho Wokuxhumana Kwezimali, kanti impikiswano phakathi kwezikhungo zikaHulumeni zikhishwa nguMthetho WamaMasipala ka-1998. Uma kungekho umthetho othile ophatha lokhu, inqubo nokukhethwa komhlinzeki kusezandleni zamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Isivumelwano sokuhlinzekwa singakhethwa uma kukhona impikiswano, noma amaqembu abandakanyekayo uma bebona ukuthi kungenzeka kube nempikiswano phakathi kwabo esikhathini esizayo, bangavuma ukuthi le mpikiswano kufanele ibhekwane ngokufuna umhlinzeki. Isivumelwano sokuthumela udaba kumhlinzeki asidingi ukuba sibhale, kodwa isivumelwano esibhaliwe singasiza njengoba sisiza ukucacisa inqubo yonke elandelwayo ngababandakanyekayo. Umhlinzeki unomsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi ugcina ubumfihlo bamaqembu abandakanyekayo. Ngeshwa, umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika awunikezi abahlinzeki ilungelo lokwenqaba ukuveza ubufakazi ezinkantolo ngokusekelwe kulwazi olutholakele ngesikhathi sokuhlinzekwa. Uma izindaba zomphakathi ziphathwa, ilungelo elisebenzayo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezisetshenziselwa ukuxazulula impikiswano lingasetshenziswa. Amaqembu abandakanyekayo angasebenzisa lokhu ngokuvuma ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezihlangene nenqubo yokuhlinzekwa zingasetshenziswa. Uma ucabanga ngobufihlo, ilungelo elinjalo alizosebenza uma umhlinzeki ebizelwa ukuveza ubufakazi. Ngokuvamile, ngokomthetho, umhlinzeki akadingeki ukuba abe neziqu ezithile zemfundo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umhlinzeki uqonde izimiso ezihlobene nokuhlinzekwa kanye nemithetho elawula ukuziphatha njengom
Abaholi bendabuko banamandla okwenza izinqumo zomthetho kanye nezinqumo zokuphatha. Kubalulekile ukuqonda umehluko phakathi kwalezi zisebenzi ngoba imithetho ebaholelayo ihluke. Izinqumo zomthetho zenzeka uma umholi wendabuko ebizwa ukuze axazulule ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi noma ukuze abhekane nezikhalazo ezenziwe yilungu lomphakathi elilodwa ngokumelene nelinye. Uma amalungu amabili omphakathi ekholelwa ukuthi banelungelo lokuvumela izinkomo zabo ukuba zidle endaweni ethile, umholi wendabuko ubizwa ukuze acacise ukuthi ubani phakathi kwabo onelungelo lokusebenzisa leyo ndawo. Lezi zinqumo zomthetho ngoba inhloso yazo ukuvuselela ukungaboni ngaso linye. Uma ilungu lomphakathi likhalaza elinye ngokweba izinkukhu zawo futhi le ndaba ilethwa kumholi wendabuko, kusho ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe isinqumo somthetho. Uma ilungu lomphakathi lithumela isicelo kumholi wendabuko sokuthola indawo yokuvuna izinkomo zawo noma ilungelo lokwakha indlu yalo endaweni ethile, umholi wendabuko uzokwenza isinqumo sokuphatha mayelana nokuthi leli lungu kufanele livunyelwe yini. Ukwenziwa kwezinqamuleli zokuphatha kulawulwa isigaba 33 seMthethosisekelo kanye neMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha, 2000. Ngokusho kwale mthetho, zonke izinqumo noma izenzo zokuphatha ezithathwa umholi wendabuko kufanele zihambisane nomthetho, zibe neqiniso, futhi zilandele indlela efanele. Umholi wendabuko owenza isinqumo sokuphatha noma othatha isenzo sokuphatha kufanele, uma eceliwe, anikeze izizathu zaleso sinqumo noma isenzo kubo bonke abathintekayo. Uma umholi wendabuko ehluleka ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zizathu, umceli angafaka isicelo enkantolo sokubacela ukuba bahlinzeke ngalezi zizathu. Uma izizathu zikhona futhi iphathi ethintekayo ikholelwa ukuthi azilungile futhi azilandelani ngendlela efanele futhi evumelekile, le phathi ethintekayo kufanele ifake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi leso sinqumo sibuye sithathwe kabusha. Umthetho ophathelene nokwenza izinqumo zokuphatha uvela emthethweni ojwayelekile, kodwa manje usuphakathi komthetho ophathelene Nokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha. Ikhophi ye-boeklet enesihloko esithi 'Umhlahlandlela Osebenzayo Wokuphatha Ubulungiswa' izonikezwa bonke abahlanganyeli kulolu cwaningo. Le booklet inikeza uhlaka lwezinyathelo ezihilelekile ekwenzeni izinqumo zokuphatha, lapho isinyathelo sokuqala siba ukucabangela isizathu esenza umuntu athole amandla okwenza isinqumo noma ukuthatha isenzo. Uma abaholi bendabuko benza izinqumo zomthetho, kufanele bahambisane neMthethosisekelo, izimiso zomthetho ojwayelekile mayelana nokwenza izinqumo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izimo zokuthuthukiswa komthetho. Iningi lezi zihloko ezizoxoxwa kulolu cwaningo zizohambisana nokwenza izinqumo zomthetho. Izinqumo zomthetho kufanele zenziwe uma isicelo sithunyelwa noma uma izinqumo zihlolwa.
Kukhona ingxenye yale ncwadi engakwazi ukukhishwa noma ukudluliselwa nganoma iyiphi indlela noma ngabe yisiphi isizathu ngaphandle kokuthola imvume edingekayo ngokuhambisa isicelo esibhaliwe. Umthetho - 3: Umngane noma abalingani, kanye nezizukulwane.. Ngemuva kokungabi khona kwesivumelwano sokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika, umthetho we-Intestate Succession Act No. 81, owawusungulwa ngoMashi 18, 1988, ulawula ukusabalalisa impahla (ngokugcwele noma ngengxenye) ngalolo suku noma ngemuva kosuku oluhambelanayo. a Uma umufi engakakhombisi ukuthi impahla yakhe kufanele ihlukaniswe kanjani ngesiqinisekiso noma ngesivumelwano esenziwe ngaphambi komshado; noma b Lapho kungenzeka ukufezekisa izifiso zomufi ngoba abaphumelelayo, ngokwesibonelo, bahluleka ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala noma abakhombisi isifiso sokuhlala noma bafa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Kungenzeka ukuthi umuntu afe ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye engafunwa. Isibonelo salokhu yileso lapho umtshali wezimali ethula ingxenye ethile yephahla esivumelwaneni esiqinisekisiwe kodwa engakhulumi ngempahla esele. Kulokhu, ingxenye enikezwe isivumelwano izohlukanisa impahla ngokuhambisana nokucabangela noma yiziphi izimo ezitholakala esivumelwaneni, kanti impahla esele izohlukaniswa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ze-Intestate Succession Act. Ngaphambi kokwenziwa kwesinqumo ku-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, I-Case No. 49/03, eyethulwe kwiNkantolo yeZomthetho ngo-Okthoba 15, 2004, izinhlinzeko ze-Intestate Succession Act zazingenakufaneleka kubantu abamnyama abafa ngaphandle kwesivumelwano futhi bashadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Isinqumo ku-Bhe saguqula lokhu; manje impahla yabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma isiko, abafa ngaphandle kwesivumelwano, izophathwa yi-Intestate Succession Act njengoba kuhlelwe ku-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. Ngaphambi kokukhuluma ngezinhlinzeko ze-Intestate Succession Act, kubalulekile ukuchaza ezinye izimiso ezibalulekile ukuze kuqondwe izinhlinzeko. Ngokuqondene nezincazelo ezilandelayo, "stirpes" kusho ingane ephilayo yomufi noma ingane eyafela phambilini emelelwa yizizukulwane. Ingane eyafela phambilini yomufi enezizukulwane eziphilayo eyodwa noma ngaphezulu ibonisa kuphela i-stirpes eyodwa. Ukumeleka kwenzeka uma umphakathi ofanele engakwazi noma engafuni ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala, kuthathwa ngelinye noma ngaphezulu kwezizukulwane. Esibonelweni esingenhla, u-D no-F bazomela ingane eyafela phambilini yomufi. Ngemuva kwesigaba (f) se-Intestate Succession Act ka-1987 njengoba kuguqulwe ngesinqumo ku-Bhe, ingxenye yengane ibalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani eliphelele lempahla ngenani le-stirpes zomufi (okukhuluma ngenani lezingane eziphilayo zomufi noma lezo ezafela ngaphambi kwakhe ezisaphila ezizukulwaneni) kanye nenani labashadikazi abaphilayo bomufi. Ake sithi inani eliphelele lempahla yomufi ngu-R500,000 futhi unezingane ezimbili eziphilayo nezifuba ezimbili zomthetho. R100,000. Ngakho-ke, ingxenye yengane izoba ngu-R100,000. Ngokwesigaba 1(d) se-Intestate Succession Act, izinga lobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bomndeni bomufi kanye nomufi lingahlukaniswa laba ngamaphuzu amabili, okungukuthi izinga lobudlelwano ekwehlukaneni okuqondile kanye nezinga lobudlelwano ekwehlukaneni okungaqondile. Ekwehlukaneni okuqondile, izinga lobudlelwano lilingana nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kwabazali nomufi noma isizukulwane nomufi (njengoba kumile). Ekwehlukaneni okungaqondile, izinga lobudlelwano lilingana nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kobudlelwano bobulili kanye nezizukulwane eziseduze ezihlobene nazo zonke, kanye nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kwabazali bomufi. Ukwabiwa kwempahla ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987 kungafingqwa emigomeni eyisishiyagalolunye. Uma umufi eshiya umngane noma abalingani, kodwa engenazizukulwane - umngane noma abalingani bangabaphumelelayo kuphela. Endabeni lapho umufi engumfazi emshadweni wesiko onabafazi abaningi, abalingani abaphilayo bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo. Umngane ophilayo ungumphumelelayo kuphela ngaphansi kwe-Intestate Succession Act, kungakhathaliseki inani lempahla. Uma abalingani bashadile emphakathini wezimpahla, umngane ophilayo uzothola ingxenye eyodwa ngokuhambisana nomshado wabo emphakathini wezimpahla kanye nenye ingxenye ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. Uma abalingani bashadile ngaphandle kwemiphakathi yezimpahla, umngane ophilayo uzothola yonke impahla ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. A & B = abazali bomufi; E = umufi; C no-D = abalingani emshadweni wesiko womufi. Ngokwesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987, njengoba kaguqulwa yiNkantolo yeZomthetho esinqumweni se-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, abalingani ababili bomufi (C no-D) bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo, ngaphandle kokubandakanya omunye umndeni. Uma umufi ethokoziswa ngababazi abangaphezu kwababili ngaphansi komthetho wesiko futhi engashiyi izizukulwane, khona-ke bonke abashadikazi bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo. Uma umufi engashiyi umngane kodwa eshiya izizukulwane - izizukulwane zifaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla njenge-stirpes futhi ukumeleka kuyavunyelwa. Izingane zomufi, u-D, E, no-F bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo. Njengoba u-E efa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, izizukulwane zakhe, u-J no-K bazomela yena futhi bafake isicelo sokuhlala impahla yakhe ngokulinganayo. Zonke izingane zomufi zinegunya lokuhlala. Akukhathalekile ukuthi zikhule emshadweni wezimali, wesiko, noma ukuthi zikhule ngaphandle komshado. Ngokwesigaba 1 se-Intestate Succession Act, abaphumelelayo be-intestate abalahlekelwa amalungelo abo okuhlala empahleni yomufi ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esivela ebudlelwaneni bobulili. Uma umufi eshiya umngane noma abalingani nezizukulwane - umngane noma abalingani bazothola ingxenye enkulu ka-R125,000 ngayinye noma ingxenye yezingane, kanti izizukulwane zizothola impahla esele, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi noma yiziphi izizukulwane zikhona. Uma inani eliphelele lingaphansi kuka-R125,000, umngane ophilayo, esibonelweni esingenhla, (S) uzothola yonke impahla, kuhlanganise nezingane nabanye abomndeni. Uma umufi engumfazi oshadile nabafazi abaningi futhi kukhona abanye abafazi abaphilayo, futhi inani lempahla lingaphansi kuka-R125,000, khona-ke abalingani abaphilayo bazokwabiwa inani elisele ngokulinganayo phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezingane nabanye abomndeni. Uma inani elisele lempahla lidlula u-R125,000, umngane uzothola u-R125
Ikomishini Yokuhlanganyela, Ukuxazulula Nokuhlonza (CCMA) iyisisekelo sokuxazulula izingxabano esisungulwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezemisebenzi, Umthetho No. 66 ka-1995. Le komishini iyazimela kwiSifunda, ezombusazwe, amaqembu ezombusazwe, izinyunyana, abaqashi, izinhlangano zabakwaqashi, kanye nobuholi bezinyunyana noma izinhlangano zabakwaqashi. Umqondisi we-CCMA unomthwalo wemfanelo oqondile wokusungula izinqubo nemigomo kwi-CCMA. I-CCMA ihlose ukukhuthaza ubulungiswa besocial kanye nentuthuko yezomnotho, ngokubambisana nezithakazelo zomphakathi, ngokuguqula ubudlelwano endaweni yokusebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka uma kwethulwa uhlelo lokuxazulula nokuvimbela izingxabano olungakhethi. Kithi, ubuchwepheshe, ubuqotho, kanye nokwethulwa kwezinsiza nokwabelana ngobudlelwano obususelwa ethembeni kubalulekile. Emphakathini, sizibophezele ekwenzeni izinguquko kubudlelwano bendawo yokusebenza ngokuxazulula ukungavumelani ngendlela efanele nokwabelana ngolwazi lwethu kabanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukucubungula izicelo zokwamukelwa nokwesekwa ezethulwe ngamaBhodi Okuxoxisana kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele. I-CCMA inikeza ukuqeqeshwa nokwelulekwa mayelana: ukusungulwa kwezakhiwo zokuxoxisana ezihlanganyelwe; izinguquko ezimweni zokusebenza; izinqubo zokubonisana; ukuvalwa kwemisebenzi; ukuhlolwa kwendawo yokusebenza nokuvimbela ukungavumelani. I-CCMA inehhovisi likazwelonke eliseGauteng, kanye nohlu lwezihhovisi eziyi-9 zomphakathi. Ihhovisi ngalinye lesifunda lineKomishini ethile yokuhlanganyela imihlangano nokubheka leso sifunda, kanye neRegistrar enesibopho semisebenzi yokuphatha. Iphinde ibe nekomishini ebhekelela ukuhlela nokuhlola lapho kukhona ukungavumelani. Umphakathi uvunyelwe ukusebenzisa ilebhu kodwa awukwazi ukuhweba ngezinto. Umfaki-sicelo kumele akhombise uma efuna ikhophi ye-rekhodi noma efuna ukubona irekhodi mathupha ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Uma irekhodi ingabhalwanga ephepheni noma encwadini, ingabukwa ngaphansi kwezimo eziceliwe, njengokuhambisana nesigaba 292. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela irekhodi ngaphansi kwezimo ezingajwayelekile, umfaki-sicelo kumele athole leyo rekodi ngaphansi kwezimo abaceliwe. Nokho, lokhu kungase kungabi khona uma kuholela ekuphazamiseni ukusebenza kwaleyo nhlangano, kudalule irekhodi, noma kuphikisana nomthetho ovikela amarekhodi abhalwe angawomphakathi. Uma kungabi khona ithuba lokuthi umfaki-sicelo athole ikhophi ngezimo eziceliwe, ukukhokha kufanele kubhekelwe ukuthi kungadluli kulokho okudingekayo ukukhokhwa esicelweni sabo. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukuphendulwa ngokubhala noma ngefoni mayelana nesicelo sabo, kumele akhombise lokhu njengokuhambisana nesigaba 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna olunye ulwazi, kumele achaze ukuthi yisiphi isicelo abahambisa njengokuhambisana nesigaba 182f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma enezinkinga, angacela irekhodi ngokuqhubekayo. I-Information Authority kufanele iphelele ifomu lesicelo ngaye futhi inikeze ikhophi yefomu njengokuhambisana nesigaba 183. Umfaki-sicelo ocela ukubona irekhodi eliqukethe ulwazi lwakhe akakhokhiswa. I-Information Authority kufanele ibike umfaki-sicelo (ngaphandle kwalabo abafuna ulwazi ngabo) ngesenzo, icela ukukhokha okufanele ngaphambi kokuthi iqhubeke nalesi sikhathi. Imali yesicelo sezakhiwo zikGovernment ingama-R35. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokuhambisa isikhalazo sangaphakathi, uma kudingekile futhi kufanelekile, noma ukuyithumela enkantolo ukuze acela ukuthi bangakhokhi imali edingekayo. Ngemuva kokuthi i-Information Authority yenze isinqumo mayelana nesicelo, umfaki-sicelo kufanele waziswa ngalowo mkhuba ngendlela abaceliwe. Uma isicelo samukelwa, umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhokhe imali yokucubungula nokusesha ulwazi kwi-rekhodi, ukuhlela, nokwenza amakhophi, kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze leyo rekodi ilungiswe ukuze ithunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo. Ukuze uthole imininingwane yokuxhumana, bheka Isigaba 14 1 b ukuze uthole amakheli emahhovisi e-CCMA ezindaweni. Uma amalungu omphakathi enezinkinga mayelana ne-CCMA futhi efuna ukuba neqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zezimiso, kufanele bacela kuMqondisi noma baxhumane nanoma yiliphi ilungu lenhlangano yomphakathi esebenza ne-CCMA eduze. Ngokwesibonelo, uma ilungu lomphakathi ingxenye ye-nyunyana, kufanele ixhumane nehhovisi elimele abasebenzi. Inhlangano ingaphika ukuhlinzeka ngerekhodi ngendlela eceliwe. Uma umfaki-sicelo eseqedile lelo fomu, kufanele alithumele kwi-Information Authority. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokucela ulwazi mayelana nemiphumela ngendlela engafani nokubhala, njengokufonela noma nge-imeyili. Umuntu ophakamisayo udinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuxhumana futhi angacelwa ukukhokha imali yokuhambisa udaba. I-Information Authority kufanele iphendule isicelo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 zokusebenza, futhi uma isicelo sitholakale singenamsebenzi, i-Information Authority kufanele inikeze izizathu zalokho njengoba kushiwo umthetho. Akukho okukhuluma ngqo kumphakathi weMphakathi Wobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwemithetho okukhuluma lapha, njengokuhambisana nesigaba 92. Isakhiwo seHhovisi leZwe kufanele, uma kudingeka, sithuthukise futhi sishicilele umhlahlandlela ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14, izikhawu ezingadluli unyaka owodwa. Amakhophi amathathu abhalwe ngolimi lwezofficial ezintathu kufanele atholakale ezikhungweni zokwabelana ngolwazi ezichazwe ngummthetho njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 6 soMthetho Wokufaka Izincwadi ka-1997; iKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika; kanye nazo zonke izikhungo zayo. Lo mhlahlandlela kufanele uphume ngolimi lwezofficial ezintathu kwiGazethi yeHhovisi leZwe. Uma imisebenzi yezakhiwo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu zikGovernment ibonakala ingahlangene, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha, ngokwakhe noma ngokucela, ukuthi umhlahlandlela owodwa kuphela kufanele ukhishwe. Lezi zakhiwo kufanele zabelane ngezindleko zokubhala nokushicilela lowo mhlahlandlela ngokuhambisana nesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe. Ngezizathu zokuphepha, zezimali, noma ezihlobene nomsebenzi, uNgqongqoshe angakhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yeHhovisi leZwe, ekhupha izakhiwo ezithile ezivela ezinhlinzekweni zalesi sigaba somthetho isikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Imali ekhokhwayo yekhophi yomhlahlandlela ngokuhambisana nezimiso ingama-R0.60 ngephepha le-A-4 noma ingxenye yalo. Imali ekhokhwayo yesicelo, ngaphandle kokuthi umuntu ucele ulwazi oluthile ngaye, ngokuhambisana nezimiso ingama-R35.00. Ukuze useshe futhi ulungise irekhodi ukuze ikhishwe, kungakhokhiswa u-R15.00 ngehora noma ingxenye yalo, kanti ihora lokuqala
I- National Electronic Media Institute of South Africa (NEMISA) yasungulwa ngaphansi kwegama le-South African Broadcasting School; inhlangano eyasungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 21, futhi yashintsha igama yayo ngomhla ka-8 kuJuni 1999. Ngokwehlelo 3 ingxenye A yePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA) ka-1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999), njengoba kuguqulwe, futhi ngenxa yomthetho ophakanyisiwe, i-NEMISA inesibopho sokubhala le mmanual ezosetshenziswa njengedokhumenti yomphakathi ngendlela yokuthi umphakathi ukwazi ukufinyelela kumarekhodi ethu. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhlela inani labathuthukisi be-ICT abanolwazi kanye nezinsizakusebenza ezivela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo, nokwandisa amakhono emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana. I-NEMISA ihlose ukugcina abafundi abahlukene enanini elikhulu labesifazane. Umbono we-NEMISA uwukuba ibe yisikhungo semfundo esilandela izindlela ezintsha ezigxile ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana. Sihlose ukuba amandla aphambili ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakamiseni izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihlinzeka ngezidingo zezimboni emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngempahla egxile kubantu, eshibhile, futhi efanele imboni ngokudlulisa ulwazi nobudlelwano. Isu le-NEMISA ukuhlela nokukhiqiza abafundi abanolwazi oluphakeme abazoba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana nezokukhuluma ngohlelo oluhlukahlukene, izifundo, nezinto ezintsha. IBhodi Yabaphathi ibophelelekile kubanikazi bezabelo ngokulandela izimiso ezibekwe yi-PFMA. Umphathi Omkhulu, ongumuntu ophakeme kwiBhodi, uqokwa ngokuhambisana ne-memorandum kanye nemibhalo yenhlangano ye-NEMISA. IBhodi Yabaphathi ibheka izindaba ze-NEMISA futhi iqinisekisa ukufezeka kwezinhlelo ze-NEMISA, kanye nokuhola, ukuqondisa, nokulawula izenzo ze-NEMISA. I-NEMISA igcizelela indlela yokuphatha yokubambisana kanye nokuziphatha okuhle, njengoba kuchazwe kwi-King Report mayelana nokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nePublic Finance Management Act. Ikomidi le-Audit liqokwa yiBhodi ngokuhambisana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo ngenhla. Ikomidi le-Audit lisunguliwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-NEMISA igcina isimo sezezimali esiqinile, esiphelele, nesicacile, kanye nezingozi, kanye nezokulawula ngaphakathi. Okwamanje, linamalungu eBhodi kuphela, kodwa le komidi linokhetho lokuqoka amalungu angeziwe. Le komidi ibika kwiBhodi ye-NEMISA ngemiphumela ye-audit nangokwethembeka nokuba khona kokuphila okukhulunywe ngakho. I-NEMISA, ngokubambisana neNational Services Commission (USA), ikwi ndlela yokusungula ikomidi le-audit langaphakathi elinamalungu amathathu, elilodwa elivela kwelinye isikhungo kanye nelinye elizimele. Le komidi izosebenza ngokuzimela kokuphatha, iBhodi ye-NEMISA, kanye nekomidi le-audit. Inhloso eyinhloko yale komidi ukusungula izinqubomgomo nezindlela mayelana nokuphathwa kwangaphakathi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Le komidi izobika kokubili ukuphatha kanye neKomidi le-Audit le-NEMISA. I-NEMISA ikhuthaza ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi bayo ngezinhlelo zokubambisana ezihlobene nezindaba zabasebenzi, ukuqeqeshwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwabelana ngolwazi. I-NEMISA ibheka isenzo sokuphakanyiswa njengokubalulekile ezinqubweni zayo zokuhweba, igxile kakhulu ekusebenzeni kwabesifazane. Le nkampani izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni indawo yokusebenza ephephile. IKomidi Lezempilo Nokuphepha linikezwe amandla ukuze kufezwe lokhu. Ikheli lewebhusayithi: www.nemisa.co. Ngokwezigaba 10 ze-Promotion of Access to Information Act, "Umphakathi Wamalungelo Abantu kufanele, ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-18 zokwenzeka kwalesi sigaba, aqoqe imanuwali equkethe ulwazi ngolimi olusemthethweni ngalunye, ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda, ngendlela engacelwa ngumuntu ofuna ukusebenzisa noma yisiphi isithakazelo njengoba kuchazwe kulo Mthetho." Umbiko wonyaka we-NEMISA. Umfakisicelo kufanele achaze ukuthi ufuna ikhophi ye-rekhodi noma ufuna ukuyibona emahhovisi e-NEMISA. Isigaba 292. Umfakisicelo uzoyithola ngendlela abacela ngayo. Nokho, ukutholakala kolwazi kuzoncika ekutheni isicelo asiphazamisanga izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza ze-NEMISA, noma kuthinte irekhodi, noma kuphazamise idokhumenti engelona idokhumenti yesifunda. Isigaba 293. Uma, ngezizathu ezithile, ulwazi lungakhululwa ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngendlela ehlukile, imali izobala ngokuya ngendlela umfakisicelo akhethe ngayo. Isigaba 294. Uma, ngaphezu kokuphendula okubhaliwe kwesicelo sabo se-rekhodi, umfakisicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela ehlukile, isibonelo, ngefoni, lokhu kufanele kuchazwe kuSigaba 182e. Uma umfakisicelo efaka isicelo ngombono womunye umuntu, kufanele abonise ukuthi unegunya lokwenza leso sicelo. Isigaba 182f. Uma abafakisicelo bengakwazi ukubhala noma ukufunda, noma benokukhubazeka okuthile, bangacela irekhodi ngokuqhubekayo. Umphathi wehhovisi kufanele aqedele ifomu labo futhi abahlinzeke ngekopya. Isigaba 183. Umphakathi wolwazi uzobhekana nesicelo solwazi ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kokusithola noma njengoba kungenzeka. [Isigaba 25]. Kwezinye izimo, le nqubo yezinsuku eziyi-30 ingandisiwe ngenye yezinsuku eziyi-30. [Isigaba 26]. Umfakisicelo uzokwaziswa nganoma yiziphi izimali ezikhokhwayo ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo solwazi processed. [Isigaba 22]. Umfakisicelo angafaka isikhalazo mayelana nokukhokhwa kwezimali ngaphakathi kwaleyo nkathi. [Izigaba 74 no-75] noma afake isicelo enkantolo sokuthola usizo olufanele ngemuva kokuphothulwa kwenqubo okukhulunywe ngayo ngenhla. [Isigaba 78]. Umfakisicelo uzokwaziswa ukuthi uzothola ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. [Isigaba 25]. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kwamakhono, ukuxhumana kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokukhuluma ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngababhalisile ngamakhono okusebenza okuphumelelayo ezingeni le-strategic lemisebenzi. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zitholakala emikhakheni ehlukahlukene yokukhuluma, umsakazo kanye ne-television, futhi zifaka izifundo ezimfishane, izifundo zomphakathi, izifundo eziphelele, kanye nemikhankaso edumile. Uhlelo lunemakethe ethile eqondiwe. Abantu abavela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo. Thumela isikhalazo sakho kwiKomidi Lezikhalazo mayelana nesinqumo somphakathi wolwazi. Uma umfakisicelo enganelisekile ngesinqumo seBhodi, bangafaka isicelo sosizo olufanele enkantolo. Lolu lwazi luzotholakala kuphela uma luceliwe.
Eminyakeni yethu yokuqala eyishumi njengohulumeni obusayo, siqondise amandla ethu nemizamo yethu ekushintsheni kusukela ekunakekeleni komphakathi kuya ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi ngokwenza kube lula ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza nezikhombisi-zinqumo. Njengombuso omusha, sithuthukise izinqubomgomo nezisekelo zomthetho eziholele ekutheni sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu abampofu nabasengozini njengoba bekulindelekile ngamalungelo abo. Umnyango eminyakeni eyishumi edlule ugxile ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ekubhekaneni nezidingo zezinye izinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ukuhlonishwa kwezimali zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuholele ekunciphiseni nasekwehliseni ezinye izinsizakalo. Lokhu kuphinde kwakhula ngenxa yokuthi izinsiza zokuvikela umphakathi zathuthukiswa ezingeni eliphansi kakhulu, izinsiza ezinganele zokuhlinzeka ngeminye imisebenzi yomphakathi kubantu abadinga usizo, ukuphakanyiswa kwamakhono phakathi kwabachwepheshe ababalulekile, kanye nokubophezeleka kwezikhungo zomphakathi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ngenxa yokushoda kwezinsiza. Lokhu kuholele nasekuphuleni kwezikhungo ezinjalo nasekulahlweni kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni, okuthinte kabi ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo. Ekubhekaneni nalezi zinkinga, uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi weSizwe uqale inqubo yokuthuthukisa uMthetho Wokukhuthaza Izehlakalo Zezimali zabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Izenzakalo zangempela zelizwe zidinga uhulumeni ukuthi abuyekeze indlela ahlukanisa ngayo izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kulabo ababephakanyiswe ngaphambili. Ukuze kuhanjiswe izikhombisi-zinqumo, izifanekiso zezindleko zathuthukiswa ukuze kubhekwane nezinkinga ezibanzi zamasu ezizosebenzisa. I-PFA ingesinye sezinsiza ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kuqhutshwe ushintsho kokubili ekwethulweni kwezinsizakalo nasekusekeleni kwezimali zabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Uhulumeni, ngomnyango wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, kufanele wethule le mvume, futhi siyazi ukuthi asikaze sikwazi ukufezekisa lezi zinhloso nezifiso sodwa. Ngakho-ke, savula amaphiko ethu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukubambisana, ukusebenzisana, nokuhlanganyela nezikhungo ezingekho kuhulumeni (NGOs), izikhungo ezisekelwe emkhulekweni (FBOs), izikhungo ezisekelwe emphakathini (CBOs), izikhungo ezihlobene nohulumeni, nezimboni. Kumele zixhaswe kahle futhi kufanele kube nezindinganiso ezibekwe ngendlela ezixhaswa ngayo ukuze kuhlanganiswe izifunda. Izifanekiso Zezindleko Zohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ziqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukusethwa kwezindinganiso nokulingana ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsiza. Iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhasa, njengoba kuchazwe ku-PFA, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ziqondiswe emphakathini nasezikhungweni ezidinga kakhulu, nokuthi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithengekayo. Ngemuva kwalokhu, uhulumeni uthuthukise futhi wavuma amathuluzi okuphatha nezikhombisi-zinqumo, ezihlanganisa ingxenye yesikhala esibanzi sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo okumele kuhlanganiswe noMthetho Wokukhuthaza Izehlakalo Zezimali kanye neSifanekiso Sokwethulwa Kwezinsiza. Njengomhla, asizokhumbula ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla nemiphakathi ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsizakalo. Sibone amaphrojekthi afana noHlelo Lokwandisa Imisebenzi Yomphakathi (EPWP), Nezinhlelo Zokunciphisa Ubumpofu (ukubala ezimbalwa), ezihlanganisa umphakathi nohulumeni ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza. Le moya yokubambisana izosiza sibe nemiphumela engcono nokubamba iqhaza kwabantu bethu kuzo zonke izigaba zokuphila. Izinsiza nezinhlinzeko ezenziwe ngabazithandayo, abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo ezizimele, kanye namalungu omphakathi zibalulekile kakhulu. Ngaphandle kwemizamo yeqembu, singakwenza ngokwengeziwe ukuthi isisekelo sehlelwe, nakuba kunezinkinga eziningi esibhekene nazo ekwenzeni iminikelo ebalulekile kumalunga ayizigidi zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abadinga usizo abalahlekelwa ithemba ezinsizeni zethu. Umnyango uphinde ufise ukuqaphela abantu nezikhungo ezisizile ekuthuthukiseni le mthetho, iminyango ezingeni lezifunda, amalungu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi ngeziphakamiso zabo nemibono. Ukubambisana komnyango nomphakathi kuhlala kuyisici esiyinhloko semizamo yokweseka ukusebenza kahle nokufeza umgomo wethu. Uhulumeni namuhla ubhekene nezinselelo ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza ezinhle kakhulu kubantu abaphansi kakhulu nabaphakanyisiwe emphakathini. Ngokomlando, izinsiza zokunakekelwa komphakathi zaziyimfanelo yokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni nezikhungo zomphakathi, lapho uhulumeni abe yisikhungo esiyinhloko sokuxhasa izikhungo ngokusekela kwawo. Izenzakalo zangempela zidinga uhulumeni ukuthi abuyekeze indlela ahlukanisa ngayo izinsiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona ukusatshalaliswa okufanele kulabo ababephakanyiswe ngaphambili. Imizamo yenziwa esikhathini esedlule yokuthuthukisa umthetho wokukhuthaza izimali ze-NPOs. Nokho, le mthetho ayikakafinyeleli ezidingweni zombili zikahulumeni kanye ne-NPO. Manje sekukhona isidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthuthukisa umthetho ozokuqinisekisa ukuthi umnyango ungahlinzeka ngezinsiza ukuze uthembise ukuphila okungcono kubantu bonke. Umthetho wokukhuthaza izimali uhlose ukuhlela ukuxhaswa kwezimali zezwe kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo emkhakheni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngokushesha ushintsho nokuhlela kabusha izinsiza nezimali, nokuqinisekisa izinsizakalo ezisebenzayo nezisebenzayo kubantu abampofu nabasengozini. Umthetho uzibophezela ekubhekaneni nokufinyelela ezinsizeni zabampofu nabaphakanyisiwe ngaphakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphila okungcono kubo, ngokubambisana nalabo abazimisele ukwakha umphakathi onakekelayo. Umthetho nezisekelo zomthetho zelizwe zinikeza indawo efanele umnyango ukuze ufeze izinhloso zawo, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokusatshalaliswa okufanele kwezinsiza. Igunya eliphethwe umkhakha we-NPO ekunikezeni izinsiza liyavunywa. Ezinye ze-NPO ziye zenza izinguquko ezibalulekile mayelana nezidingo zokunakekelwa komphakathi zelizwe. Nokho, ushintsho oludingekayo luhlala luyinselelo enkulu kuhulumeni. Ukufinyelela kulokhu nokwethulwa kwemvume yakho, umnyango udinga ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izinhloso okufanele zifezekiswe, ukuthi zizofezekiswa kanjani, nokuthi zingakhalipha kanjani ukusebenza kwehlelo. Umthetho ugxila ezinselelweni nasezinhlelweni zokushintsha, ezizokwenza kube sobala ukuthi izinsizakalo zizonikezwa kanjani, kuphi, futhi ngubani, nokuthi zixhaswa kanjani nguhulumeni. Uveza izinqubo zokukhetha zokuxhaswa. Izimfuneko zokufaneleka, kanye nezindlela zokukhokha nezidingo zokuxhaswa.
