Imboni yokumbiwa kwamaminerali eNingizimu Afrika idlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni womhlaba. Ngo-2001, ukumbiwa kwamaminerali kwaba nesandla esingaphezu kuka-6% ku-Gross Domestic Product (GDP) yelizwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhiqizwa kwekholi kuyinsiza eyinhloko yokusebenza kwamandla kubakhiqizi bokukhanyisa eNingizimu Afrika, abaphinde bayithumele kwamanye amazwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imikhiqizo yensimbi nemikhiqizo engeyona insimbi ibalulekile embonini yokwakha futhi isekela ukuthuthukiswa nokugcinwa kwengqalasizinda yelizwe. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) ibheka ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi bemigodi nabanye abathintekayo ezindleleni zokumba. Iphokophela ekwehliseni izigameko zokulimala nezifo, ngaleyo ndlela ibonisa izinselelo ezibhekene nomkhakha wokumbiwa kwamaminerali. Impilo yomsebenzi iyinselele ukuyilinganisa nokuyilawula, njengoba imiphumela yomsebenzi empilweni yomuntu ingase ingabi sobala ngokushesha. Izifo zamaphaphu nokulahleka kokuzwa ngenxa yezwi yizinkinga ezinkulu zempilo emkhakheni wokumbiwa kwamaminerali, ezidalwa ukusebenza ezindaweni ezinothuli nezinyembezi isikhathi eside. Imigodi yegolide ithola abasebenzi abaningi kakhulu emkhakheni wokumbiwa kwamaminerali uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izimboni; ngakho-ke, abasebenzi bayo bahlala besengozini enkulu yezifo zokuphefumula uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abakwiwezinye imigodi. Isifo samaphaphu esikhathazayo kakhulu emigodini yegolide yi-silicosis, etholakale kuwo wonke amagodi aqinile, ngesikhathi sokumba nokugaya imayini, lapho izingcezu ze-silica zingaba phezulu komoya. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezibeka abasebenzi engozini ye-silica nesifo se-silicosis kudala ingozi yokuthola i-tuberculosis. I-silicosis iphinde ibe yinkinga enkulu emigodini yekholi. Kukhona ukuqaphela okukhulayo kwezwi njengengozi yempilo kubasebenzi abangaphansi komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika. Imboni yethule uhlelo lokuvikela ukuzwa (HCPs) ngo-1988, njengoba imisebenzi eminingi eyenziwa ekukhishweni kwemaminerali yaholela enanini elikhulu labasebenzi abavulelekile ezingeni lokuzwa eliphakeme kakhulu elamukelekile futhi eliphephile elingu-85 dB. Nakuba izinyathelo zithathwe ukuze kulawulwe izingozi zezwi, le nkinga isaqhubeka. Kubalwa ukuthi phakathi kuka-68% no-80% babasebenzi bemigodi basebenza ezingeni lokuzwa elingu-85 dB noma ngaphezulu, okukhombisa ukuthi iningi labasebenzi laba bahlala besengozini yokulahlekelwa ukuzwa. Imigodi ebhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu mayelana nokuphepha emsebenzini iyimigodi yegolide neplatinamu. Eminyakeni yakamuva, ukumbiwa kweplatinamu kukhule, kuholela emisebenzini eminingi. Ngeshwa, lokhu kuphinde kuholele ekwandeni kwezinga lokulimala. Kutholakale ukuthi ukuqeqeshwa nokwaziswa emkhakheni weplatinamu kuphansi kulokhu kukhula. Imboni yokumbiwa kwamaminerali yegolide ihola ezimeni zokulimala ngenxa yokujula kokusebenza nokwehla kwezinsimbi. Nakuba ukusebenza kwemigodi yegolide kwehle kakhulu eminyakeni edlule, le nqubo ayibonisi ukuthuthuka kwezinga lokuphepha ngesikhathi esifanayo. Nakuba kungase kube nokuhluka ngenxa yezinhlobo zomsebenzi wokumbiwa ngaphansi komhlaba nezinga leengozi ezimeni zokumbiwa, lezi zingozi zomsebenzi zidinga ukuphathwa kahle okwandisiwe. Izibalo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuwa komhlaba kuhlala kuyindlela evamile futhi ebangela ukufa emigodini yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukulahleka kokuphila kanye nenani lokulimala okwenza abasebenzi bahluleke emsebenzini kule mboni kungancishiswa ngokukhetha nokusebenzisa izinyathelo zokulawula ezifanele nokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izinga eliphezulu lokuhambisana nemithetho lihlala ligcinwa. Ukuphepha emigodini emincane nakho kuyakhathaza ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokulimala okukhona lapho. Kutholakale ukuthi imbangela yale nkinga ukuqeqeshwa okulinganiselwe nezinsiza ezinganele. Abasebenzi kulomkhakha badinga usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwemigodi, futhi imikhankaso ehlukahlukene iqalile ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oludingekayo. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) isekela imikhankaso ebanzi, njengokukhuthaza imigodi emincane. Ekugcineni, le ofisi iyingxenye yokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS. Isekela imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi nezinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokwehlisa ukuvela kwe-HIV/AIDS emkhakheni wokumbiwa. Iphinde yasungula ikomidi le-tripartite elibhekelela i-HIV/AIDS emkhakheni wokumbiwa. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi nezibanzi ezibhekene nomkhakha wokumbiwa, uhlelo oluqinile lokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izithakazelo, kuhlanganise nabaqashi nohulumeni, lungahlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokubhekana nalezi zinkinga. UMbutho wezinsiza zamaminerali namandla (DME) ubheka kahle imikhakha yamaminerali namandla eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhula komnotho nokuthuthukiswa. Omunye wemigomo yawo ukuqinisa ukuthi lezi zinkampani zibe nezindawo zokusebenza eziphephile nezempilo. I-Mine Health and Safety Inspectorate (MHSI) ikwenza lokhu egameni le-DME, futhi lo mbhalo ugxile kakhulu kuyo. I-MHSI yasungulwa ukuvikela ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi nabanye emigodini. Umbono wayo uwukubhekana nezibopho zayo ngokuqinile nangendlela ekhombisa ubuchwepheshe, ukusebenza kahle, nemiphumela emihle ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekwe kuleli kanye nakwamanye amazwe zokuphepha nempilo emkhakheni wokumbiwa. Izenzo eziholayo ze-MHSI zifaka phakathi ukuhlola imigodi, ukuhlola nokuhlola izingozi nezinye izigameko ezihlobene nokuphepha nempilo, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana noMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwamaminerali (MHSA) ka-1996, okuwumgomo walolu hlelo lokuhlola. Amandla e-MHSI okuqhuba umthetho afaka phakathi ukukhipha izaziso zokuhambisana kanye nokuvalela imigodi, ukufaka izijeziso, nokwenza izincomo mayelana nokudluliswa kwabaphula umthetho. I-MHSI ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukukhipha okuphephile kwamaminerali nokuthi ukusebenza kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo eziphilayo. Ukulawulwa okungcono kusungulwa ngemva kokuxoxisana okuningi nazo zonke izithakazelo embonini. Ubudlelwano be-tripartite, ukuhlola izingozi, ukucubungula izinhlelo ezihlelwe, ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kanye nezibalo ezijwayelekile, ucwaningo, nokuhlola konke kubalulekile emisebenzini ye-MHSI ukuze kufezwe imiphumela. Nokho, ihhovisi lokuhlola lidinga ukwesekwa komphakathi wonke wokumbiwa ukuze kufezwe lezi zinjongo, njengoba bonke bazothola inzuzo. Abasebenzi bemigodi basebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezingaba yingozi ngenxa yezwi, ukunyakaza, ukushisa nokubanda, umsebenzi ophindaphindiwe onzima, amakhemikhali ayingozi, uthuli, namagesi anama-toxicity aphezulu. Bahlupheka ngokulahlekelwa ukuzwa, i-silicosis, i-pneumoconiosis, i-tuberculosis, isifo sezinhlayiya
Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondiswa kuhulumeni kazwelonke nasezindabeni eziphathelene nenhlonipho noma ekuxosheni kwabo, okungabandakanya imfundo noktraining yamaJaji amasha kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphakathi kwamaJaji amadala, izimo zokusebenza nezimo zesevisi zamaJaji, ukuhlelwa kabusha kwemingcele yeZigaba Eziphezulu, nokunye. Ukuhlanganisa uhlu lwabafakizicelo bokunikezwa izikhundla zamaJaji eNkantolo yeMthethosisekelo, oluthunyelwe ngemigqa emithathu yokukhetha futhi lwethulwa kuMongameli, uma kukhona abafakizicelo abangamukeleki kuMongameli, amagama engeziwe kufanele engezwe. Ukuhamba phambili ekuxoxeni ngezinsolo zokuziphatha kabi noma ukungafaneleki ukuba uJaji, ukuthola umphumela mayelana nocwaningo nokwazisa iNhlangano Yezwe ngempumelelo uma kutholakala ukuthi uJaji unenkinga yokwenza imisebenzi yabo, uyaphumelela emisebenzini yabo noma uxoshwa ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi. Ukuhlinzeka iPhalamende ngombiko obhaliwe wonyaka mayelana nemisebenzi eyenziwe ngaleso sikhathi. IKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa liqukethe amaKomishina angama-25 (kuhlanganisa noMongameli noMphakathi) kanye noSekela. Uma udaba oluthinta iZigaba Eziphezulu luphathwa, uJaji Omkhulu waleyo Nkantolo kanye noMphakathi ofanelekile noma abathunyelwe babo bayabandakanywa. Uma inani labantu abafakizicelo besuka ezikhungweni zokwakha umthetho noma emkhakheni wezomthetho ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1 e noma f lingama-vacancies okufanele zigcwaliswe, uMongameli kufanele abakhethe. Uma inani labafakizicelo lidlula ama-vacancies okufanele zigcwaliswe, uMongameli, ngokuxhumana nomkhakha ofanele, uzokhetha inani elifanele lamagama aphakanyiswe ukuze agcwaliswe ama-vacancies ngemuva kokucabangela isimo sokuthi wonke imikhakha ibonakale. Amalungu eKomidi athunywe nguMphakathi Wasezindaweni Zikazwelonke asebenza kuze kube baphathwa ndawonye noma uma kwenzeka enye i-vacancy emkhakheni ophakanyisiwe. Amanye amalungu athunywe noma akhethwe yiKomidi asebenza kuze kube baphathwa yilabo abababekela noma abababekela. Isikhathi sokusebenza kwamanye amalungu eKomidi, uMphakathi, kanye nama-vacancies. Uma ilunga elithile lishiya isikhundla sawo ngokuhambisa isicelo esibhaliwe sokwazisa ngenyanga eyodwa kuMongameli. Ilunga leKomidi elithunywe ngale ndlela ngaphansi kwesigaba-178 1 e, f, g, h, kanye i yeMthethosisekelo lizoshiywa isikhundla sawo ngokushesha uma iziqu zawo zemfundo zingasasebenzi ukufakazela isikhundla ababeqashwe kuso. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezibekwe esigabeni-178 1 yeMthethosisekelo, noma ilunga eliphelelwe isikhathi singabuyiselwa ukuze siqhubeke nokusebenza. IKomidi izokhetha amalungu ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuhambisana nesigaba-105 1 b, c, e, f, g, kanye i yeMthethosisekelo njengoba uMphakathi engakatholakali, uMphakathi uzothatha indawo kaMongameli. I-vacancy ekhona kwiKomidi a ngeke iphazamise izinqubo eziphakathi noma izinqumo ezenziwe yiKomidi ngenkathi ihleli; b izogcwaliswa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba-178 1 yeMthethosisekelo, ilunga elithunywe ngale ndlela lihlala esikhundleni isikhathi esithile esisele salowo ophume esikhundleni esandulele. Ngenxa yokungabi khona komuntu osebenza ngokuphelele kwiKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa, umsebenzi ophawulekayo ophazamisa iKomidi wenziwa ngabasebenzi boMnyango Wezobulungiswa abaqashwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele: uMnyango Wezobulungiswa. UMs. I Greenstein ungumholi we-secretariat. Umhlahlandlela uzotholakala kwiKomidi Yezimfanelo Zomuntu waseNingizimu Afrika kungakapheli umhla ka-31 December 2003. Isaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba-15 sichaza izinhlobo zamadokhumenti ezikhungo ezikhona ezingadingi umuntu ukuthi athumele isicelo esivunyelwe ngumthetho. Ulwazi mayelana nesaziso seKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa esikhaleni-15 asitholakali okwamanje. Umbiko wonyaka oqondiswe kuPhalamende. Ukuhlola indawo egcina amadokhumenti agcinwe. Iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kuMongameli. Ukufinyelela kumadokhumenti akwenqabiwe ngenxa yezizathu ezishiwo emthethweni. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe kwiGazethi Yombuso [Isaziso SoMnyango R187-15 sikaDisemba 2002] (Ifomu-A). Umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhombise uma isicelo singekho isithombe sedokhumenti noma uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukufaka idokhumenti ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma idokhumenti ingeyona incwadi, ingafundwa ngendlela efunwayo, uma kukhona indlela esigabeni -292. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela kuhlobo oluthile lwefomu, umfaki-sicelo uzofinyelela ulwazi ngendlela abacela ngayo. Ngaphandle kwesimo lapho imvume ingaphazamisa ukusebenza kahle kwenhlangano yomphakathi ethintwayo, ukonakala kwedokhumenti noma ukuphazamiseka kwezinto ezikhethekile zokuphathwa kwedokhumenti yoMnyango. Uma kukhona izizathu ezinkulu zokungamukeli isicelo ngendlela efunwayo kodwa kukhona enye indlela, izindleko zokuhambisana nesicelo zizobalwa ngokuhambisana nesicelo sokuqala esenziwe ngumuntu ngaphansi kwesigaba -293 kanye 4. Uma kunempendulo ebhaliwe engaphezu kweyodwa esicelweni, umfaki-sicelo ofuna ulwazi mayelana nesinqumo ngenye indlela, isibonelo; ngocingo, kufanele achaze lesi sigaba -182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, kufanele kucaciswe ukuthi bacela egameni lomunye futhi kufanele kube nobufakazi obusekela isicelo esigabeni -182f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala noma unokukhubazeka, bangathumela isicelo sedokhumenti ngokuqhubekayo. Umphakathi wezokwazi kufanele aqedele ifomu egameni lomfaki-sicelo futhi anikeze umfaki-sicelo leyo dokhumenti efanayo/ikhophi esigabeni-183. Umfaki-sicelo ofuna ukufinyelela kudokhumenti equkethe ulwazi lomuntu mayelana nomfaki-sicelo akadingi ukukhokha imali yesicelo. Umphakathi wezokwazi kufanele wazise umfaki-sicelo (ukuhlukanisa umuntu ofuna ulwazi mayelana naye) uma umfaki-sicelo kudingeka akhokhe imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuhamba phambili nesicelo. Imali ethile ye-R35 ikhokhwa ngokuthenga izimpawu zentela ezitholakala ehhovisi leposi. Inani elifanele lezimpawu kufanele lifakwe kufomu lesicelo (Ifomu A). Uma izimpawu zingafakwanga, isicelo ngeke sithathwe kuze kube imali ethile noma ethile yokufaka izimpawu ikhokhwa. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka isicelo enkantolo ephikisana nokuhanjiswa noma ukukhokhwa kwemali yesicelo. Ngemuva kokuthi umphakathi wezokwazi wenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela efunwayo ngumfaki-sicelo. Uma umfaki-sicelo evunyelwe, kukhona enye imali yokufinyelela kudokhumenti okufanele ikhokhwe ukuze kufunwe, kulungiswe, kuph
Kunokwehluka phakathi kokwahlulela uma kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye nokusiza amaqembu athintekayo ekuxazululeni. Ekwahluleleni, umuntu ongengxenye yokungaboni ngaso linye uthatha isinqumo mayelana nokungaboni ngaso linye, futhi leso sinqumo kumele sibe sihlose amaqembu athintekayo. Uma umuntu ongengxenye yokungaboni ngaso linye esiza la maqembu ekuxazululeni, sithi lokho kuyisixazululo noma ukuvuselela. Uma amaqembu athintekayo exazulula izinkinga zawo ngaphandle kokungenelela komuntu wesithathu, lokhu kuyisiphumo senqubo yokuxoxisana phakathi kwamaqarhu amabili. Abaphathi bezomthetho ezinkantolo bathola amandla abo okwahlulela ngokuba baqokwe ngokwezimiso zomthetho. Kuphinde kube nokwenzeka ukuthi amaqembu athintekayo alethe izinkinga zawo ukuze zihlulelwe ngumuntu abavuma ukuba kube umlandeli. Ezivumelwaneni eziningi, amaqembu afaka isigaba esivuma ukuthi noma iyiphi ingxabano ephuma phakathi kwabo ezivumelwaneni zawo izodluliselwa kumxhumanisi. Umxhumanisi angabizwa noma isigaba singachaza ukuthi umxhumanisi uzokhethwa kanjani, njengomthetho okhethwe yiBar Association. Isivumelwano sokuhamba kumxhumanisi asidingi ukuba sibhale. Emiphakathini ethile noma emindenini, kungase kube nesivumelwano sokuthi ingxabano izodluliselwa kumholi womphakathi noma kumholi wemindeni ngoba lokho kuyisiko elalandelwa isikhathi eside. Ingxabano ithathwa njengokwenziwa ngumuntu ophathiswe nguhulumeni. Amaqembu athintekayo awakwazi ukukhetha ukuthi ubani umuntu ophathiswe. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngemicimbi, imithetho, noma izivumelwano zenkantolo. Kungaba nzima kumaqembu athintekayo ukuqhubeka ngaphandle kokwethulwa komthetho. Isinqumo kumele sibe sihambisana nesibonelo esisebenzayo. Isinqumo siqinisekiswa ngenqubo esemthethweni noma engasebenzi. Isinqumo singathathwa ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo ephezulu. Izinqumo ezinkantolo eziphansi zingathathwa ngokucubungula. Kuyejwayelekile ukuba kube nesiphumo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Umuntu otholwe enecala ukhokha izindleko ezithintekayo zokusebenzisa abameli. Azikho izindleko zenkantolo ezikhokhwa ngaphambi kokuba kube nezimpawu. Qaphela: inkantolo ephansi ihluke ngoba inqubo iyahlola futhi amaqembu athintekayo awadingi ukuba amelelwe ngabameli. Amaqembu athintekayo akhetha umxhumanisi (umxhumanisi). Umxhumanisi angaba ngumuntu onolwazi olunzulu kulolo mkhakha. Amaqembu athintekayo anenkululeko yokukhetha inqubo yabo. Isidingo sokwethulwa komthetho sizoncika kulokho okhethwe. Isinqumo kumele sithathwe njengomyalo wenkantolo ukuze sisebenze kahle. Akukho sicelo esizofakwa enkantolo—kungavunyelwana ukuthi isicelo sithathwe ngababonisi abanye. Isinqumo singathathwa ngokucubungula yiNkantolo Ephakeme. Kuyejwayelekile ukuba kube nesiphumo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Umuntu otholwe enecala ukhokha izindleko ezithintekayo zokusebenzisa abameli. Ukukhokhwa kwabaxhumanisi kuzokwenziwa ngamaqembu athintekayo. Amaqembu athintekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Akukho ukusiza ekuxazululeni udaba oluvela kumuntu wesithathu. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngamaqembu athintekayo. Iqembu ngalinye elithintekayo lingasebenzisa abeluleki bezomthetho, kodwa lokho akudingekile. Umphumela uncike kumandla nobuchule bamaqembu athintekayo. Azikho izindleko zomthetho ngaphandle kwezindleko zomeluleki wezomthetho uma zisetshenziswe. Amaqembu athintekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Umuntu wesithathu angasiza ekuxazululeni udaba. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngumxhumanisi ophendula kumqondisi. Abeluleki bezomthetho bamaqembu athintekayo abadingeki uma le nqubo yenziwa. Umphumela ungaba yifiso yomxhumanisi kodwa abenzi izinqumo. Umphumela uvame ukuba yisimo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Amaqembu athintekayo akhokha izindleko zomxhumanisi uma zikhona. Le ndlela ibonisa ukuthi umuntu wesithathu, umxhumanisi/umuntu olethe ukuthula, udingeka ukusiza amaqembu athintekayo axazulule izinkinga zawo. Kungachazwa njengokuxoxisana okusekelayo. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi ukulethela udaba kumxhumanisi ngamaqembu athintekayo kwenziwa ngenhloso, kodwa ngokomthetho, isiko noma isivumelwano kungadinga ukuthi amaqembu athintekayo alethe udaba lwabo kumxhumanisi. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi umxhumanisi abe ngumuntu owamukelekayo kumqondisi womabili amaqembu athintekayo, umuntu ongaxhunywanga nganoma iyiphi indlela kumqondisi noma udaba. Umxhumanisi akumele athathe izinkanyezi. Umxhumanisi akwenzi izinqumo kumqondisi athintekayo. Indima yomxhumanisi ukusiza amaqembu athintekayo axazulule izinkinga zabo. Umxhumanisi kumele azame ukwenza amaqembu womabili athintekayo awine ukuze kungabi khona iqembu elishiywe lihlulelwe. Lokhu kubalulekile uma amaqembu athintekayo enobudlelwano obuqhubekayo ngoba ubuhlungu obungazwanga iqembu elihlulelwe bungaholela ekuphukeni kobudlelwano obuhle. Akukho mthetho ophatha umxhumanisi, kodwa ezinye izinhlobo zomxhumanisi ziyaqhubeka zikhishwa umthetho, njengokuthi izinkinga zabasebenzi zikhishwa nguMthetho Wokubambisana Kwezamabhizinisi, kuyilapho izinkinga phakathi kwezikhungo zikahulumeni zikhishwa nguMthetho Wamasipala Wokusebenza ka-1998. Uma kungekho umthetho othile ophatha, inqubo nokukhethwa komxhumanisi kusezandleni zamaqembu athintekayo. Isivumelwano sokuxhumana singakhethwa uma kukhona ingxabano, noma amaqembu athintekayo uma ebona ukuthi kungase kube nengxabano phakathi kwabo esikhathini esizayo, angavuma ukuthi le ngxabano kumele ixazululwe ngokufuna umxhumanisi. Isivumelwano sokudlulisela udaba kumxhumanisi asidingi ukuba sibhale, kodwa isivumelwano esibhaliwe singasiza njengoba sisiza ukuhlela inqubo yonke elandelwayo ngababonisi. Umxhumanisi unomthwalo wokugcina ubumfihlo bamaqembu athintekayo. Ngaphandle kokuthi, umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika awunikezi abaxhumanisi ilungelo lokwenqaba ukuveza ubufakazi enkantolo ngokusekelwe kulwazi olutholwe ngesikhathi sokuxhumana. Uma izindaba zomphakathi ziqhutshwa, ilungelo elisebenzayo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezisetshenziselwa ukuxazulula izinkinga lingasetshenziswa. Amaqembu athintekayo angasebenzisa lokhu ngokuvuma ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezihlanganisiwe nenqubo yokuxhumana zingasetshenziswa. Uma kubhekwa ubumfihlo, ilungelo elinjalo alizokwenziwa uma umxhumanisi ebizwa ukuveza ubufakazi. Ngokuvamile, ngokomthetho, umxhumanisi akadingeki ukuba neziqu ezithile zemfundo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umxhumanisi aqonde izimiso ezihlobene nomxhumanisi kanye nemithetho ephatha ukuziphatha njengomthetho owaziwa ngokuthi 'audi alterem partem'.
Abaholi bendabuko banamandla okwenza izinqumo zomthetho kanye nezinqumo zokuphatha. Kubalulekile ukuqonda umehluko phakathi kwalezi zisebenzi ngoba imithetho elawula lezi zisebenzi ihluke. Izinqumo zomthetho zenzeka lapho umholi wendabuko ebizwa ukuze axazulule ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi noma ukuze abhekane nezikhalazo ezenziwa yilungu lomphakathi elilodwa ngokumelene nelinye. Uma amalungu amabili omphakathi ecabanga ukuthi banelungelo lokuvumela izinkomo zabo ukuba zidle endaweni ethile, umholi wendabuko ubizwa ukuze acacise ukuthi ubani phakathi kwabo onelungelo lokusebenzisa le ndawo. Lezi zinqumo zomthetho ngoba inhloso yazo ukuhlela ukungaboni ngaso linye. Uma ilungu lomphakathi likhalaza elinye ngokweba izinkukhu zalo futhi le ndaba ilethwa kumholi wendabuko, kusho ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe isinqumo somthetho. Uma ilungu lomphakathi lithumela isicelo kumholi wendabuko sokuthola indawo yokudla izinkomo zakhona noma ilungelo lokwakha indlu yakhona endaweni ethile, umholi wendabuko uzokwenza isinqumo sokuphatha mayelana nokuthi leli lungu kufanele linikezwe imvume. Ukwenza izinqumo zokuphatha kulawulwa isigaba 33 seMthethosisekelo kanye neMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha, 2000. Ngokusho kwale mthetho, zonke izinqumo noma izenzo zokuphatha ezenziwa umholi wendabuko kumele zihambisane nomthetho, zibe neqiniso, futhi zilandele inqubo efanele. Umholi wendabuko owenza isinqumo sokuphatha noma othatha isenzo sokuphatha kufanele, uma eceliwe, anikeze izizathu zaleso sinqumo noma isenzo kubo bonke abathintekayo. Uma umholi wendabuko enqaba ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zizathu, umceli angafaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze baphoqelelwe ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zizathu. Uma izizathu zinikezwa futhi iqembu elithintekayo likholelwa ukuthi azilungile futhi azilandeli inqubo efanele nephephile, leli qembu elithintekayo kufanele lifake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi leso sinqumo sibuye sibuyehlulelwe. Umthetho ophathelene nokwenza izinqumo zokuphatha uvela emthethweni ojwayelekile, kodwa manje usuphakanyiswa umthetho ophathelene Nokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha. Ikhophi ye- booklet ebizwa ngokuthi 'Umhlahlandlela Osebenzayo Wokuphatha Ubulungiswa' izonikezwa bonke abakhona kulolu cwaningo. Le booklet inikeza uhlaka lwezinyathelo ezihilelekile ekwenzeni izinqumo zokuphatha, kanti isinyathelo sokuqala siwukucabangela isizathu esenza umuntu anikezwe amandla okwenza isinqumo noma ukuthatha isenzo. Lapho abaholi bendabuko benza izinqumo zomthetho, kumele bahambisane neMthethosisekelo, imithetho ejwayelekile ephathelene nokwenza izinqumo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izimo zokuthuthukiswa komthetho. Iningi lezi zihloko ezizoxoxwa kulolu cwaningo zizohambisana nokwenza izinqumo zomthetho. Izinqumo zomthetho kumele zenziwe uma isicelo senziwe noma uma izinqumo zihlolwa.
Kukhona ingxenye yalesi sikhumbuzo engakwazi ukukhishwa noma ukudluliselwa nganoma iyiphi indlela noma ngasiphi isikhathi ngaphandle kokuthola imvume edingekayo ngokuhambisa isicelo esibhaliwe. Umthetho - 3: Umlandeli noma abalandeli, kanye nezizukulwane.. Ngemuva kokungabi khona kwesivumelwano sokuhlomula eNingizimu Afrika, umthetho we-Intestate Succession Act No. 81, owawusebenza kusukela ngoMashi 18, 1988, ulawula ukusabalalisa kwempahla (ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye) ngalolo suku noma ngemuva kosuku olufanele. a Uma umufi engakakhombisi ukuthi impahla yakhe kufanele ihlukaniswe kanjani ngencwadi yokuhlomula noma ngesivumelwano esenziwe ngaphambi komshado; noma b Lapho kungenzeka ukufeza izifiso zomufi ngoba abalandeli, ngokwesibonelo, bahluleka ukufaka isicelo sokuhlomula noma abakhombisi isifiso sokuhlomula noma bafa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Kungenzeka ukuthi umuntu afe ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye ngaphandle kwesivumelwano. Isibonelo salokhu yileso esikhombisa umtshali-mali unikeza ingxenye ethile yemali empahleni encwadini eqinisekisiwe kodwa engakhulumi ngempahla esele. Kulokhu, ingxenye enikezwe incwadi izohlukanisa impahla ngokuhambisana nezimo ezitholakala encwadini, kanti impahla esele izohlukaniswa ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-Intestate Succession Act. Ngaphambi kwesinqumo se-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, Icala No. 49/03, elethwe kwiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ngo-Okthoba 15, 2004, imithetho ye-Intestate Succession Act ayizange isetshenziswe kubantu abamnyama abafa ngaphandle kwesivumelwano futhi bashadile ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Isinqumo se-Bhe saguqula lokhu; manje impahla yabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma isiko, abafayo ngaphandle kwesivumelwano, izophathwa yi-Intestate Succession Act njengoba kubhalwe kwi-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. Ngaphambi kokukhuluma ngemigomo ye-Intestate Succession Act, kubalulekile ukuchaza ezinye izimiso ezisemqoka ukuze kuqondwe imithetho. Ngokuqondene nezincazelo ezilandelayo, "stirpes" kusho ingane ephilayo yomufi noma ingane eyafa ngaphambili emelelwa yizizukulwane. Ingane eyafa ngaphambili yomufi enezizukulwane eziphilayo eyakha kuphela i-stirpes eyodwa. Ukumeleka kwenzeka lapho umnqobi ofanele engakwazi noma engafuni ukuhlomula, kuthathwa ngabanye bezizukulwane. Esibonelweni esingenhla, u-D no-F bazomela ingane eyafa ngaphambili yomufi. Ngemuva kwesigaba (f) se-Intestate Succession Act ka-1987 njengoba kuguqulwe ngesinqumo se-Bhe, ingxenye yengane ibalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani eliphelele lempahla ngenani le-stirpes zomufi (okukhuluma ngenani lezingane eziphilayo zomufi noma lezo ezafa ngaphambi kwakhe ezisaphila ezizukulwaneni) kanye nenani labashadile abaphilayo bomufi. Ake sithi inani eliphelele lempahla yomufi ngu-R500,000 futhi unezingane ezimbili eziphilayo kanye nezingane ezimbili ezisemthethweni. R100,000. Ngakho-ke, ingxenye yengane izoba ngu-R100,000. Ngokwesigaba 1(d) se-Intestate Succession Act, izinga lobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abahlobene ngegazi nomufi lungahlukaniswa laba ngamaphuzu amabili, okungukuthi izinga lobudlelwano ekuhlomuleni okuqondile kanye nezinga lobudlelwano ekuhlomuleni okuphambene. Ekuhlomuleni okuqondile, izinga lobudlelwano lingalingana nenani lezigaba phakathi kwezizukulwane kanye nomufi noma isizukulwane nomufi (njengoba kumile). Ekuhlomuleni okuphambene, izinga lobudlelwano lingalingana nenani lezigaba phakathi kobudlelwano begazi kanye nezizukulwane eziseduze ezihlobene nazo zonke, kanye nenani lezigaba phakathi kwezizukulwane zomufi. Ukusabalalisa kwempahla ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987 kungafingqwa kube yimithetho eyisishiyagalolunye. Uma umufi eshiya umlingani noma abalingani, kodwa enganazo izizukulwane - umlingani noma abalingani bangabalandeli kuphela. Endabeni lapho umufi engumkakhe emshadweni wesiko onabafazi abaningana, abalingani abaphilayo bazohlomula impahla ngokulingana. Umlingani ophilayo ungumlandeli kuphela ngaphansi kwe-Intestate Succession Act, kungakhathaliseki inani lempahla. Uma abalingani bashadile emiphakathini yezezimali, umlingani ophilayo uzothola ingxenye eyodwa ngokuhambisana nomshado wabo emiphakathini yezezimali nengenye ingxenye ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. Uma abalingani bashadile ngaphandle kwemiphakathi yezezimali, umlingani ophilayo uzothola yonke impahla ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987. A & B = abazali bomufi; E = umufi; C no-D = abalingani emshadweni wesiko bomufi. Ngokwesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987, njengoba kaguqulwa yiNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo esinqumweni se-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, abalingani ababili bomufi (C no-D) bazohlomula impahla ngokulingana, ngaphandle kokubandakanya omunye umuntu emndenini. Uma umufi ehlonishwa ngaphezu kwabafazi ababili ngaphansi komthetho wesiko futhi engashiyi izizukulwane, khona-ke bonke abafazi bazohlomula impahla ngokulingana. Uma umufi engashiyi umlingani kodwa eshiya izizukulwane - izizukulwane zihlomula impahla njenge-stirpes futhi ukumeleka kuvunyelwe. Izingane zomufi, D, E, no-F zizohlomula impahla ngokulingana. Njengoba u-E efa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, izizukulwane zakhe, J no-K zizomela yena futhi zihlomule impahla yakhe ngokulingana. Zonke izingane zomufi zinegunya lokuhlomula. Akukhathaliseki ukuthi zabe zikhuluma emshadweni wezomthetho, wesiko, noma zabe zikhuluma ngaphandle komshado. Ngokwesigaba 1 se-Intestate Succession Act, abalandeli abangenayo imvume yokuhlomula empahleni yomufi ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esivela kubudlelwano begazi. Uma umufi eshiya umlingani noma abalingani kanye nezizukulwane - umlingani noma abalingani bazothola ingxenye enkulu engu-R125,000 ngayinye noma ingxenye yezingane, kanti izizukulwane zizothola impahla esele, uma kukhona noma yiziphi izizukulwane ezikhuluma. Uma inani eliphelele lingaphansi kuka-R125,000, umlingani ophilayo, esibonelweni esingenhla, (S) uzothola yonke impahla, kuhlanganise nezingane nezinye izihlobo. Uma umufi engumkakhe oshadile nabafazi abaningi futhi kunezintombi eziningi eziphilayo, futhi inani lempahla lingaphansi kuka-R125,000, khona-ke abalingani abaphilayo bazohlukanisa inani elisele ngokulingana phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezingane nezinye izihlobo. Uma inani elisele lempahla lidlula u-R125,000, umlingani uzothola u-R125,000 noma ingxenye yengane, noma yikuphi okukhulu, kanti inani elisele lizohlukaniswa phakathi kwezizukulwane zomufi nge-stirpes futhi ukumeleka kuvunyelwe. Ikomishini Yokuxazulula, Ukuhweba Nokuhlonza (CCMA) iyisakhiwo sokuxazulula izingxabano esisungulwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezobudlelwano bezabasebenzi, Umthetho No. 66 ka-1995. Le komishini iyazimela kwiSikhungo, emaqenjini ezombusazwe, ezinyunyana, abaqashi, izinhlangano zabakwaqashi, kanye nobuholi bezinyunyana noma izinhlangano zabakwaqashi. Umqondisi we-CCMA unomthwalo oqondile wokwakha izinqubo nemigomo kwi-CCMA. I-CCMA ihlose ukukhuthaza ubulungiswa bomphakathi nokuthuthukiswa komnotho, ngokubambisana nezithakazelo zomphakathi, ngokuguqula ubudlelwano endaweni yokusebenza. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka uma kwethulwa uhlelo lokuxazulula nokuvimbela izingxabano olungakhethi. Kithi, ubuchwepheshe, ubuqotho, kanye nokwethulwa kwezinsiza nokwabelana ngobudlelwano obusekelwe ethembeni kubalulekile. Emphakathini, sizibophezele ekwenzeni izinguquko kubudlelwano bendawo yokusebenza ngokuxazulula izingxabano ngendlela efanele nokwabelana ngolwazi lwethu kabanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukucubungula izicelo zokwamukelwa nokwesekwa ezithunyelwe ngamaBargaining Councils nezinkampani ezizimele. Kuhlinzekwa ukuqeqeshwa nokuqondisa mayelana: ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zokuhweba ezihlanganyelwayo; izinguquko ezimweni zokusebenza; izinqubo zokubonisana; ukuvalwa kwemisebenzi; ukuhlolwa kwendawo yokusebenza nokuvimbela izingxabano. I-CCMA inehhovisi likazwelonke eliseGauteng, kanye nehhovisi leziphathamandla eziyi-9. Ihhovisi ngalinye leziphathamandla linomkomishana okhethekile ophatha imihlangano futhi aqondise le ndawo, kanye nomlobi ophatha imisebenzi yokuphatha. Iphakathi nendawo inamakomishana aphatha ukuhweba nokwahlulela lapho kukhona izingxabano. Umphakathi uvunyelwe ukusebenzisa ilabhulali kodwa awukwazi ukuboleka izinto. Umfaki-sicelo kumele akhombise uma efuna ikhophi yerekhodi noma efuna ukubona irekhodi mathupha ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Uma irekhodi ingabhalwanga ephepheni noma encwadini, ingabukwa ngaphansi kwezimo eziceliwe, njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 292. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela irekhodi ngaphansi kwezimo ezingajwayelekile, umfaki-sicelo kumele athole leyo rekodi ngaphansi kwezimo abacelwayo. Nokho, lokhu kungase kungabi khona uma kuphazamisa ukusebenza kwaleyo nhlangano, kuphazamisa irekhodi, noma kuphikisana nomthetho ovikela amarekhodi abhalwe angawomphakathi. Uma kungabi khona ithuba lokuthi umfaki-sicelo athole ikhophi ngaphansi kwezimo eziceliwe, ukukhokha kumele kubhekwane nokuthi kungadluli kulokho okudingekayo ukukhokhwa esicelweni sabo. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukuphendulwa ngokubhala noma ngefoni mayelana nesicelo sabo, kumele akhombise lokhu njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna olunye ulwazi, kumele achaze ukuthi iyiphi isicelo abathumele njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 182f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma enezinkinga, angacela irekhodi ngokuqonda. I-Information Authority kumele iphelele ifomu lesicelo kubo futhi inikeze ikhophi yefomu njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 183. Umfaki-sicelo ofuna ukubona irekhodi eliqukethe ulwazi lwabo akakhokhiswa. I-Information Authority kumele ikwazise umfaki-sicelo (ngaphandle kwalabo abafuna ulwazi ngabo) ngesenzo, icela ukukhokha okufanele ngaphambi kokuthi kuqhubeke nalesi simo. Imali yesicelo sezikhungo zikamasipala ingama-R35. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi, uma kudingeka futhi kufanelekile, noma ukufaka enkantolo ukuze acela ukuthi bangakhokhi imali edingekayo. Ngemuva kokuthi i-Information Authority yenze isinqumo mayelana nesicelo, umfaki-sicelo kumele waziswe ngalokho kwenziwe ngendlela abacelwayo. Uma isicelo samukelwa, umfaki-sicelo kumele akhokhe imali yokucubungula nokufuna ulwazi kwi rekodi, amalungiselelo, kanye nokwenza amakhophi, kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhathi esidingekayo ukuze le rekodi ilungiswe ukuze ibonwe. Ukuze uthole imininingwane yokuxhumana, bheka Isigaba 14 1 b ukuze uthole amakheli emahhovisi e-CCMA ezindaweni. Uma amalunga omphakathi enezinkinga mayelana ne-CCMA futhi efuna ukuba nengxenye ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo zokuphatha, kufanele bafake isicelo kumqondisi noma baxhumane nanoma yiliphi ilunga lenhlangano yomphakathi esebenza ne-CCMA eduze. Ngokwesibonelo, uma ilunga lomphakathi lingowesinyunyana, kufanele lixhumane nehhovisi elimele abasebenzi. Inhlangano ingaphika ukuhlinzeka irekhodi ngendlela eceliwe. Uma umfaki-sicelo sekuqedile lelo fomu, kumele lilithumele kwi-Information Authority. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokucela ulwazi mayelana nemiphumela ngendlela engafani nokubhala, njengokufonela noma nge-imeyili. Umuntu ophakamisayo udinga ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuxhumana futhi angacelwa ukukhokha imali yokuhambisa udaba. I-Information Authority kumele iphendule ngesicelo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 zokusebenza, futhi uma isicelo sikhanseliwe, i-Information Authority kumele ihlinzeke ngezizathu zalokho njengoba kuchaziwe ngumthetho. Isakhiwo sikamasipala kumele, uma kudingeka, sihlaziye futhi sishicilele incwadi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14, izikhathi ezingadluli unyaka owodwa. Uma imisebenzi yezakhiwo ezimbili noma ngaphezulu zikamasipala ibonakala ingaxhunyiwe, iNgqongqoshe ingakhetha, ngokwakhe noma ngokwesicelo, ukuthi kube ne ncwadi eyodwa kuphela ezokhishwa. I- National Electronic Media Institute of South Africa (NEMISA) yasungulwa ngaphansi kwegama leSouth African Broadcasting School; inhlangano eyasungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 21, futhi yashintsha igama yayo ngomhla ziyi-8 kuJuni 1999. Ngokusho kwesheduli 3 ingxenye A yePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA) ka-1999 (Umthetho 1 ka-1999), njengoba kuguqulwe, futhi ngenxa yalomthetho ophakanyisiwe, i-NEMISA inezibopho zokubhala le manuwali ezosiza njengedokhumenti yomphakathi ngendlela yokuthi umphakathi ungafinyelela emarekhodi ethu. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhambahamba inani labathuthukisi be-ICT abanolwazi kanye nabasebenzisi abavela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo, kanye nokwandisa amakhono emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe nezokuxhumana. I-NEMISA ihlose ukugcina umzimba wabafundi obuhlukahlukene onenani elikhulu labesifazane. Umbono we-NEMISA uwukuba ibe yisikhungo semfundo esilandela izindlela ezintsha ezigxile ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Sihlose ukuba yisikhungo esihamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphatheni izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihlinzeka ngezidingo zezimboni emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngempahla egxile kubantu, eshibhile, ethinta izimboni ngokudlulisa ulwazi nobudlelwano. Isu le-NEMISA ukuhlinzeka nokuqeqesha abaphothuli abanolwazi oluphakeme abazoba ngabahlanganyeli abavelele emikhakheni yokusakaza nezokuxhumana ngohlelo oluhlukahlukene, izifundo, nezinto ezintsha. IBhodi Yabaqondisi ibophezelekile kubanikazi bezabelo ngokulandela izimiso ezibekwe yi-PFMA. Umphathi Omkhulu, ongumuntu omdala kwiBhodi, uqokwa ngokuhambisana nememorandum kanye nemibhalo yenhlangano ye-NEMISA. IBhodi Yabaqondisi ibheka izindaba ze-NEMISA futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo ze-NEMISA zisebenza, kanye nokuhola, ukuqondisa, nokulawula izenzo ze-NEMISA. I-NEMISA igcizelela indlela yokuphatha ebambisanayo kanye nokuziphatha okuhle, njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-King Report ngokuqondisa kwezinkampani kanye nePublic Finance Management Act. Ikomidi le-Audit liqokwa yiBhodi ngokuhambisana nomthetho okukhulunywe ngawo ngenhla. Ikomidi le-Audit lisungulwa ukuze liqinisekise ukuthi i-NEMISA igcina indawo yezezimali, yokubhekelela izingozi, kanye nokulawula ngaphakathi eqinile, ebanzi, futhi ecacile. Okwamanje, linamalunga kuphela eBhodi, kodwa le komidi linokhetho lokuqoka amalunga angeziwe. Le komidi ibika kwiBhodi ye-NEMISA ngemiphumela ye-audit kanye nokwethembeka nokuba khona kokuphila okukhulunywe ngakho. I-NEMISA, ngokubambisana neNational Services Commission (USA), ikwi ndlela yokusungula ikomidi le-audit langaphakathi elinamalunga amathathu, elilodwa lisuka enhlanganweni ngayinye kanye nomuntu ozimele. Le komidi izosebenza ngokuzimela kokuphathwa, kwiBhodi ye-NEMISA, kanye nekomidi le-audit. Inhloso enkulu yale komidi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango nezindlela eziphathelene nokuphathwa kwangaphakathi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Le komidi izobika kokubili ukuphathwa kanye nekomidi le-Audit ye-NEMISA. I-NEMISA ikhuthaza ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi bayo ngezinhlelo zokubambisana eziphathelene nezindaba zabasebenzi, ukuqeqeshwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwabelana ngolwazi. I-NEMISA ibheka isenzo esiqinisekisayo njengokubalulekile ezinqubweni zayo zokuhola, igxile kakhulu ekuthengeni abesifazane. Le nkampani izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni indawo yokusebenza ephephile. Umbiko wonyaka we-NEMISA. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele achaze ukuthi ufuna ikhophi yesi rekhodi noma ufuna ukuyibona ehhovisi le-NEMISA. Isigaba 292. Umfaki-sicelo uzoyithola ngendlela abacelile ngayo. Nokho, ukufinyelela kolwazi kuzoncika ekutheni isicelo asiphazamisi izinqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile ze-NEMISA, noma kudale umonakalo rekhodi, noma kuphazamise idokhumenti engelona idokhumenti yesimo. Isigaba 293. Uma, ngezizathu ezithile, ulwazi lungakhululwa ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngendlela ehlukile, imali izobala ngokuhambisana nendlela umfaki-sicelo akhethe ngayo. Isigaba 294. Uma, ngaphezu kokuphendula okubhaliwe esicelweni sabo sesi rekhodi, umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela ehlukile, isibonelo, ngefoni, lokhu kufanele kuchazwe esigabeni 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efaka isicelo egameni lomunye umuntu, kufanele akhombise ukuthi unegunya lokwenza leso sicelo. Isigaba 182f. Uma abafaki-sicelo bengakwazi ukubhala noma ukufunda, noma banezinkinga ezithile, bangacela rekhodi ngenkulumo. Umphathi wehhovisi kufanele aqedele ifomu labo futhi abahlinzeke ngekhophi. Isigaba 183. Umphakathi wolwazi uzobhekana nesicelo solwazi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kokulithola noma ngokushesha okukhulu. [Isigaba 25]. Kwezinye izimo, le nqubo yezi-30 zinganda ngenye izinsuku eziyi-30. [Isigaba 26]. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwazi ukuvezwa nganoma yiziphi izimali ezikhokhwayo ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo solwazi processing. [Isigaba 22]. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka ukukhala mayelana nokukhokha izimali phakathi naleso sikhathi. [Izigaba 74 no-75] noma afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze athole usizo olufanele ngemuva kokuphothulwa kwenqubo eshiwo ngenhla. [Isigaba 78]. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwazi ukwaziswa ukuthi bazokwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi. [Isigaba 25]. Inhloso ye-NEMISA ukuhlinzeka ngamakhono, ukusakaza kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokusakaza ezizokwenza abaphothuli babe namakhono okusebenza kwezobuchwepheshe ezingeni le-strategic. Izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zitholakala emikhakheni ehlukahlukene yokusakaza, umsakazo kanye ne-TV, futhi zifaka izifundo ezimfishane, izifundo zomphakathi, izifundo eziphelele, kanye nemikhankaso ebonakalayo. Uhlelo lunemakethe ethile eqondiwe. Abantu abavela emiphakathini eyayihlonishwayo. Thumela ukukhala kwakho kwiBhodi Yokukhala mayelana nesinqumo somphakathi wolwazi. Uma umfaki-sicelo enganelisekile ngesinqumo seBhodi, bangafaka isicelo sosizo olufanele enkantolo. Le ngolwazi izotholakala kuphela uma iceliwe.
UMnyango wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi nobuchwepheshe wasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1994 wabe usahlukaniswa uMnyango wezobuciko nesiko noMnyango wesayensi nobuchwepheshe ngonyaka ka-2002. Inhloso yalolu suku iwukuchaza izakhiwo nemisebenzi yoMnyango nokuchaza izinhlelo zokugcina amarekhodi ukuze kuhambisane nezinhloso ze-PAIA. Kubandakanya izaziso ezihlinzekwe ngokuhambisana nezinsika ezingu-22 no-54 mayelana nezindleko okufanele zikhokhwe mayelana nezicelo zokufinyelela; kanye nezinhlinzeko ezenziwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba sika-92 soMthetho. Umhlahlandlela ungatholakala eKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu. Ukufinyelela kumarekhodi athile agcinwe ngummnyango kufanele kucelwe kumphathi wezokwazi ngokulandela izinqubo ezichazwe ezinsikeni ezingu-17 kuya ku-32 zoMthetho. Bheka ulwazi lokuxhumana nomphathi wezokwazi esigabeni sika-3. Amafomu okucela abekwe kufanele atholwe ehhovisi leMphathi wezokwazi loMnyango wezobuciko nesiko. Bheka esigabeni sika-3. Ukufinyelela kumarekhodi angahlolwa kunikezwa ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ezifana nezikhungo zokufunda ngaphansi kokuhlola kwamalungu abasebenzi, angahlinzeka ngokuqondisa ekukhululeni nasekufakeni ulwazi kumarekhodi nasekuvikelweni kokuqukethwe komlando. Inhloso yoMnyango iwukukhuthaza nokugcina amasiko aseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubumbano nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe nokwandiswe ubuciko nesiko eNingizimu Afrika nokuhola igunya layo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ukuze kukhuthazwe futhi kwandiswe izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseNingizimu Afrika nokwandiswa kwezinhlobonhlobo zezilimi zezwe. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe amathuba omnotho nezinye izinkambo ezihlobene nobuciko nesiko laseNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlanganyela kanye nobudlelwano obunenzuzo, ngaleyo ndlela kuqinisekiswe ukwesekwa komkhakha. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe nokubhekwa kokusetshenziswa kwemigomo, imithetho, nezinhlelo ezicacile zokukhombisa, ukuvikela, nokukhuthaza ifa lesizwe. Ukuze kugcinwe, kusekelwe, futhi kuthuthukiswe izinsiza zezakhiwo zomlando, kanye nezihlobene nomsebenzi nolwazi lwezwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bangafinyelela kulezi zinsiza ngokuphelele nangokukhululekile. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekutholeni nasezincwadini ezihlobene nezakhiwo zomlando mayelana nezindleko ezibekwe ohlwini lwamanani olushicilelwe. Ezinye izinsiza zinikezwa ngummnyango wezokuphatha kuphela, isibonelo, izinsiza zokuphatha amarekhodi, ukuqeqeshwa kwabaphathi bamarekhodi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezakhiwo zomlando. Amarekhodi omphakathi agcinwe ngababheki isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka engama-20. Amarekhodi omphakathi aqhubekayo kanye namarekhodi okungcwaba kwabashonile. Izibalo zonyaka zoMnyango unyaka nonyaka. Amadokhumenti okuphatha amarekhodi atholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NARS.
Uhlelo lwebhizinisi kanye nesu lokusebenza kwemisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo lunikezwa kuNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha futhi luvunywa nguye minyaka yonke, ngendlela yesicelo (uhlelo lwebhizinisi) oluhlanganisa nolwazi olunembile. I-SAMSA ibamba imisebenzi yezomthetho nezok regulation, egameni loNgqongqoshe wezokuThutha kanye neNhlangano Yezokuthutha Kazwelonke (NDOT). I-SAMSA ngakho-ke ibamba imisebenzi ethile ezingeni lokusebenza, kanti i-NDOT isebenza ezingeni lesu, lapho ithuthukisa khona imigomo yokuthutha nemihlahlandlela yesu yezinsizakalo. I-SAMSA iqhubeka nokuxhumana nezithakazelo emikhakheni yamanzi, ngokusebenzisa amaKomidi ahlukahlukene ezokuthutha olwandle nokubamba imihlangano yokuxhumana nezinye izindlela ezingezona ezisemthethweni. Inhloso ye-SAMSA ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwempahla nokuphila olwandle, ukuvikela nokulwa nokungcoliswa okuphazamisa imvelo yolwandle yezikebhe, nokukhulisa izinzuzo zezimali zeRiphabhulikhi. Phakathi kwezinye izenzo, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulezi, kukhona ukuhlolwa kwezikebhe, imishini, nezimpahla, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isikebhe nezikebhe zifakwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe. I-SAMSA iphinde ikhishwe futhi inikeze izitifiketi okufanele abantu babe nazo uma besebenza ezikebheni. IKomidi leMithetho Yamalungelo Abantu laseNingizimu Afrika kumele lithuthukise umhlahlandlela oqukethe ulwazi olufanele ukuhlinzekwa kunoma yimuphi umuntu ofisa ukusebenzisa noma yiluphi ilungelo elicacisiwe nguMthetho. Izimemo ezitholiwe zokuhamba/ukuxhumana nezinye izizwe/izinhlangano/okungase kufake amaklayenti nomphakathi. Akukho sikhumbuzo esishicilelwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho. I-SAMSA iphethe ukuvikelwa kokungcoliswa kanye nekhono lokuphendula, ngokubambisana neMnyango Wezokuphila Nokuhamba. Ukwethulwa kwanoma iyiphi indaba kufanele kuqondiswe ku-CEO we-SAMSA. Uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sikhanselwa noma sithathwa ngokuhambisana Nezinhlu 22, 26, noma 29 zoMthetho, umceli angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo soMphakathi Wolwazi. Omunye umuntu angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo soMphakathi Wolwazi, ukuze afune ukufinyelela kulwazi. Isikhalazo kufanele sithunyelwe ngendlela ebekiwe ku-2, bese sithunyelwa kuMphakathi Wolwazi endaweni yeposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhulunywe ku-2 ngenhla, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola isikhumbuzo sokwenqaba. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yesikhalazo. Uma umceli engakakhokhi imali yesikhalazo (uma kufanele), isinqumo ngesikhalazo sangaphakathi singabambezela, kuze kube yilapho imali ikhokhiwe. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isikhalazo, ukuthi ingaqinisekisa yini isikhalazo noma yenze isinqumo esisha esikhundleni salo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Uma i-SAMSA ingahlinzeki umceli ngesikhumbuzo sesinqumo ngesikhalazo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokufaka isicelo, i-SAMSA izobhekwa njengokwenqaba isikhalazo sangaphakathi. Umceli noma omunye umuntu angasondela enkantolo ukuze athole usizo olufanele kuphela ngemuva kokuthi umceli noma omunye umuntu esebenzise zonke izinqubo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi mayelana nesinqumo soMphakathi Wolwazi. Uma umceli noma omunye umuntu ehlupheke ngesinqumo soMphakathi Wolwazi noma izicelo zabo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi zehlulekile, bangafaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze bathole usizo olufanele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kwesinqumo ngesikhalazo. Ikhaya elinokuthula kulolu suku yikhaya eliphezulu noma enye inkantolo enendawo efanayo yokuphatha. Umceli kumele ahambisane nezidingo zokusebenza ezitholakala kuMthetho, ezihlobene nesicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umceli kumele agcwalise ifomu elibekiwe ku-1, bese elithumela, kanye nemali yesicelo kanye nediphozi (uma kufanele), kuMphakathi Wolwazi endaweni yeposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhulunywe ku-2 ngenhla. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yomceli. Uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye umuntu, khona-ke umceli kumele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthunyelwa ukwenza lesi sicelo egameni labo. Umceli uzokwaziswa ngokubhalwe phansi ukuthi ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe noma kuyakwenqaba. Uma umceli edinga izizathu zesinqumo ngenye indlela, kumele akhombise indlela nemininingwane edingekayo. Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuqedela ifomu ngoba engafundile noma engakhululekile, lowo muntu angafaka isicelo ngomlomo. Umceli kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ngaphambi kokuba kwenzeke inqubo. Futhi imali yokufinyelela, ibalwa ngokubheka izindleko zokuphrinta kabusha, ukufuna, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zesicelo kanye nezokuthumela. Uma isicelo sitholiwe nguMphakathi Wolwazi, lowo mphakathi uzodinga isikhumbuzo sokuthi umceli, ngaphandle kokufaka isicelo, kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ebekiwe ngaphambi kokuba aqhubeke nokucubungula isicelo. Umceli onikezwe ukufinyelela kumarekhodi kumele akhokhe imali yokufinyelela yesicelo, kanye nokuphrinta kabusha, ukulungiselela, kanye nesikhathi esidingekayo sokufinyelela ezinsukwini ezichaziwe zesicelo nokulungiselela kwamarekhodi okuzokhishwa, kuhlanganisa nokwenza amalungiselelo ukuze kube khona ngendlela efunwayo. Uma isicelo sokurekhodi senziwe futhi irekhodi ilungisiwe ukuze ikhishwe, kuhlanganisa noma yiziphi izinhlelo zokuthi kube khona ngendlela efunwayo, kudinga amahora adlula lawo abekiwe emthethweni ngenhloso, uMphakathi Wolwazi uzokwazisa umceli ukuthi akhokhe, njengediphozi, ingxenye ebekiwe yemali yokufinyelela ezodingeka ukukhokhwa uma isicelo sivunywa. UMphakathi Wolwazi uzobambezela irekhodi kuze kube isikhathi lapho umceli ekhokha izimali ezibekiwe. Uma idiphozi ikhokhiwe mayelana nesicelo sokufinyelela esinquelekile, khona-ke uMphakathi Wolwazi ophumelelayo uzobuyisela idiphozi kumceli. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo, ukuthi ivume noma inqabe isicelo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Isikhathi esingu-30 sezinqumo lapho i-SAMSA kumele ithathe isinqumo sokuvuma noma sokwenqaba isicelo singandiswe sibe isikhathi esengeziwe ngokuhambisana Nezinhlu 26 zoMthetho.
Ngemuva kwalokhu, okubizwa ngokuthi isivumelwano somphakeli ngakolunye uhlangothi, ngemuva kwalokhu baziwa njengezinqwaba. I-SAPS ingena esivumelwaneni nomPHAKELI ngokwezimo nemigomo echazwe esivumelwaneni, futhi umPHAKELI uyavuma ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwakhe ngqo kwi-SAPS ngokwezimo nemigomo echazwe kulesi SIVUMELWANO, okuzobizwa ngokuthi UMSEBENZI: Uma umPHAKELI engaziswa yi-SAPS ukuthi asebenze kwi-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma iyiphi indawo eyisakhiwo se-SAPS engakabi kuMSEBENZI, kuzoba isikhathi esilinganiselwe. UmPHAKELI, ngenxa yesiSIVUMELWANO, ngeke abe noma abe ngaphansi kokulindela ukuthi lesi SIVUMELWANO sizovuselelwa, futhi ngeke aqashwe kunoma iyiphi isikhundla njengomsebenzi we-SAPS. Kuvunyelwene phakathi kweZINQWABA ukuthi isivumelwano somPHAKELI esenziwe naye njengomsebenzi ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kukhona ubudlelwano bokusebenza phakathi komPHAKELI ne-SAPS. UmPHAKELI kumele, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-clauses 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo ye-clauses 5 no-9 ngezansi, ahlinzeke i-SAPS ngezinsizakalo njengoba kudingeka futhi ngokwezimo ezibekwe yi-SAPS, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lokuqala kwalesi SIVUMELWANO, bheka i-clause 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene nomPHAKELI izohlanganisa noma iyiphi imisebenzi yezandla engxenye, futhi ehambisana nomsebenzi womPHAKELI. UmPHAKELI uzokwenza umsebenzi wakhe (bheka i-clauses 3.1 - 3.2 ngenhla) kwi-SAPS ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngesonto: Uma umPHAKELI engasebenzi kwi-SAPS ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto, noma ezinsukwini zomkhosi. UmPHAKELI uzokwenza umsebenzi wakhe ngokohlelo oluhlanganisiwe lapha njengeSheduli A. UmPHAKELI ngeke abe nelungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma ezinsukwini ayengabakhona ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. UmPHAKELI ngeke abe nelungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-SAPS izoba nesibopho sokuhlinzeka umPHAKELI ngezokuthutha ukuya nokubuya kuMSEBENZI ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe, bheka i-clauses 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-SAPS izokhokhela umPHAKELI ngokuba khona kwakhe nomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yesivumelwano ye-R - ...rand ngehora kubandakanya i-VAT: Uma i-SAPS ingakhuphula le mali yesivumelwano ngehora ngokuthanda kwayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Le mali izokhokhwa ngenyanga ngemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yesivumelwano (bheka i-clause 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo ophelele kanye nazo zonke izinzuzo ezihambisana nomsebenzi womPHAKELI, uma le mali ikhokhwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho othile, izofakwa emholweni womPHAKELI. UmPHAKELI uyavikela i-SAPS ngokumelene nanoma iyiphi ukulimala noma ukulahleka okubangelwa ukulimala komzimba, ukulahleka kokuphila, ukulahleka noma uk damage to property whether caused by SAPS or another person or whether caused or due to negligence existing at the time he is a member of SAPS maintaining an order, and indemnifies SAPS against any loss, damage, expense or amount payable in relation to ongoing court proceedings concerning the CONTRACTOR and that may relate to claims for money or arrest in any manner. Lesi SIVUMELWANO sizoqala futhi sibe nezibopho kusukela ngosuku olusayinwe yizigaba zombili zalesi SIVUMELWANO: Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO singasayinwa ngasikhathi sinye yiZINQWABA, usuku lokugcina lokusayinwa komunye wemigomo luzothathwa njengosuku lokuqala lokuqala kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. Lesi SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisana ne-clauses 13.2 no-14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizophumelela isikhathi esichaziwe (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngezansi), esizoqala ngosuku lokuqala lapho lesi SIVUMELWANO siqala (bheka i-clause 12.1 ngezansi). Lesi SIVUMELWANO singavuselelwa ngokuthanda kwe-SAPS ngokubhalwa phansi ngokuvuma komPHAKELI isikhathi esichaziwe: Uma i-SAPS ifuna ukwazisa umPHAKELI ukuthi ifuna ukuvuselela lesi SIVUMELWANO, kumele inikeze isaziso esibhaliwe njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-clause 13.2 ngenhla, ngaphambi kokuphela kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla). Okuqukethwe kwalesi SIVUMELWANO kuzoba yisisekelo sesivumelwano, esivuselelwe ngokuhambisana ne-clause 13.2 ngenhla. Lesi SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisana ne-clauses 13.2 no-14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizophela ngokuzenzakalelayo ekupheleni kwesikhathi esichaziwe (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngezansi). Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili ezibala usuku nosuku (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sosuku olunye. Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili ezibala usuku nosuku (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kodwa ngaphambi kokuphela kwesinyanga esisodwa kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sezinsuku ezimbili ezibala usuku nosuku. Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela ngemuva kwesinyanga esisodwa ibala usuku nosuku kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sesinyanga. Uma i-SAPS ingavuma, ngezimo ezamukelekayo, isaziso esifushane. Noma iyiphi iphathi yalesi SIVUMELWANO ingaqeda lesi SIVUMELWANO uma omunye wabo ephula noma iyiphi ingxenye yalesi SIVUMELWANO: Uma iphathi ekhuluma ngokuqala inikeze omunye iphathi isaziso esibhaliwe mayelana nalokhu kuphula futhi lokho kuphula akukalwe phakathi kwezinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela ngosuku lokuthola leso saziso. Izihloko ze-clauses kulesi SIVUMELWANO zenzelwe ukubhekisela kuphela, ngakho-ke azingxenye futhi azihlobene nokuhumusha kwe-clause nganoma iyiphi indlela. Ngaphandle kokuthi kubonakale ukuthi kukhona ukungqubuzana noma ukungahambisani nokwenzeka, okwakodwa kuzohlanganisa okwakubili futhi ubulili besilisa kuzohlanganisa ubulili besifazane, futhi kuphinde kube njalo. Lesi SIVUMELWANO siyisivumelwano esiphelele phakathi kweZINQWABA futhi sikhansela noma yisiphi esinye isivumelwano esingase sibe khona phakathi kweZINQWABA mayelana nokwenzeka lapha. I-ZINQWABA ivuma ukuthi ngeke kube nezinguquko, ukwengeza, noma izivumelwano zokukhansela noma yini eyakha lesi SIVUMELWANO ngokuphelele noma ngengxenye noma noma iyiphi iphuzu noma isimo salo futhi ukuthi ngeke kube nomthelela ek
Umthetho uhlose ukusungula uhlaka lokuphumeza imithetho nemigomo ezohambelana nomkhakha wezempilo kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze izinsizakalo zempilo zixazululwe kahle, umthetho ufisa ukuba kube nokulingana ekunikezeni izinsizakalo ngokusungula izinqubo nezindinganiso, izinhlelo, nemigomo kazwelonke. Isahluko sokuqala siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nezinhloso zomthetho, imithwalo yemfanelo yoMnyango wezempilo, kanye nelungelo lokufinyelela ukwelashwa okukhululekile. Sihlanganisa isicelo nencazelo yomqondo womthetho. Umthetho uhlose ukufakwa ezingeni likazwelonke futhi udlule eminye imithetho ehambelana nezempilo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 146 seMthethosisekelo, uma kwenzeka ukungqubuzana phakathi komthetho neminye imithetho yezempilo. Izinhloso zangempela zomthetho ukuhlinzeka ngezibopho zik governo ngaphansi kweMthethosisekelo mayelana namalungelo ahambelana nezinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, kanye nokusungula uhlelo lwezempilo lwesizwe oluhloswe kubo bobabili abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo zomphakathi nezabPrivate, futhi luzohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezingathengiswa ngemali etholakalayo. Lesi sahluko sizama ukuhlukanisa imithwalo yemfanelo kaNgqongqoshe wezempilo (uNgqongqoshe) kulabo bomnyango ezingeni likazwelonke, izifunda, nezikhashana. Lesi sahluko siphinde sifune ukunika uNgqongqoshe amandla okuphumeza imithetho ehambelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo ezikhululekile ezindaweni ezithile zabantu. Isahluko sesibili siqukethe imithetho ehambelana namalungelo nemithwalo yemfanelo yalabo abasebenzisa izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Amalungelo abasebenzisi mayelana nolwazi ngezinsizakalo zempilo, izinsizakalo zokwelashwa eziphuthumayo, kanye nokubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni mayelana nezempilo zabo nokwelashwa kwabo ayavunywa, njengoba nelungelo lomsebenzisi lokuhlinzekwa ngolwazi oluhambelana nezempilo zabo nokwelashwa kwabo. Siphinde sithinte ukukhipha imibiko yokuthi umuntu uphume ohlelweni lokwelashwa nokuhlinzekwa kwemvume eqondile. Kukhona imithetho ethinta ukuhlela ukwelashwa ngenhloso yokucwaninga nokugcina amarekhodi ezikhungo zezempilo. Lesi sahluko siphinde sithinte ukufakwa kwezikhalazo ngabasebenzisi nabanye mayelana nezikhungo zezempilo nezilindelo zabasebenzisi mayelana nezempilo zabo, ukusetshenziswa kwezikhungo zezempilo, kanye nobudlelwano babo nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zempilo. Isahluko sesithathu siqukethe imithetho ehambelana noMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Siphatha ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yezempilo Kazwelonke lapho uNgqongqoshe ezosebenzisana namalungu eBhunga Lezempilo Kazwelonke (okuhlanganisa oNgqongqoshe bezifunda), ibhodi yedolobha emelela uhulumeni bendawo, umphathi woMnyango Wezempilo kuMnyango Wezempilo Wamasosha eNingizimu Afrika (SAMHS), kanye nezinye iziphathimandla eminyangweni yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke nezifunda. Lesi sahluko sichaza imisebenzi namandla eBhodi Yezempilo Kazwelonke, okuyi ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuNgqongqoshe. Lesi sahluko siphinde sisungule iKomidi Lezempilo Kazwelonke. Amalungu wale komidi angababusi beminyango yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke nezifunda, umphathi woMnyango Wezempilo kuMnyango Wezempilo Wamasosha eNingizimu Afrika (SAMHS), kanye nezimeya zohulumeni bendawo. Lesi sahluko siphinde sinikeze uMphathi-Jikelele woMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke amandla okuthuthukisa amasu wezempilo kazwelonke. Siphinde sithinte ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokubonisana Ngezempilo Kazwelonke ezosebenza ukuze kuhlanganiswe imikhakha ehlukene yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke. Isahluko sesine siqukethe imithetho ehambelana neminyango yezempilo yezifunda. Lesi sahluko beka umthwalo kule minyango ukuze isebenze ngokuhambisana nemigomo yezempilo kazwelonke ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Siphatha ukusungulwa kwamabhodi wezempilo ezifundeni okuzosebenza ngendlela efanayo neBhodi Kazwelonke, kodwa kuzokwenziwa ezingeni lesifunda. Amakomidi Okubonisana Ngezempilo Ezifundeni azosungulwa, azosebenza imisebenzi efanayo neyeBhodi Kazwelonke, kodwa kuzokwenziwa ezingeni lesifunda. Lesi sahluko siphinde sinikeze amandla okuthuthukisa amasu wezempilo ezifundeni ukuze athunyelwe kuMphathi-Jikelele. Siphinde sithinte isidingo sokuthi oNgqongqoshe bezifunda basungule Amabhodi Okubonisana Ngezempilo Ezifundeni ukuze babelane ngolwazi futhi baxhumane ngezindaba ezihambelana nezempilo nababambiqhaza abahlukene. Isahluko sesihlanu sisungula uhlelo lwezempilo ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika, okwenziwa ngokulandela izimiso ezithile. Siphinde sithinte ukuklanywa kwezindawo zezempilo, okwenziwa ngokucabangela imingcele ebekwe ezindaweni zedolobha kanye nokuhlanganiswa nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo. Siphatha ukufakwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo zedolobha futhi sinikezela ngokuqaliswa nokuhlelwa kwamasu wezempilo ezindaweni ezithile. Siphinde sithinte izinhlelo zesikhashana ezihambelana nezinsizakalo zempilo zedolobha. Isahluko sesithupha siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nezikhungo zezempilo. Le mithetho ilawula ukuhlukaniswa kwezinhlobo, ukusungulwa, nokusebenza kwezikhungo zezempilo futhi ifaka imithetho elawula izitifiketi zokudinga. Ngokwaleli sahluko, akekho ongakha, akhe, aguqule, noma athole isikhungo sezempilo noma ihhovisi lezempilo ngaphandle kwesitifiketi sokudinga. Siphatha ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo, izimvume, nezixazululo mayelana nokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe ngezitifiketi zokudinga, kanye nezimo ezithile ezihambelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo ezikhungweni zikahulumeni, okunika uNgqongqoshe amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaleyo mikhawulo. Siphinde sithinte ukuhlinzekwa kwamabhodi ezibhedlela nguNgqongqoshe kanye noNgqongqoshe bezifunda (MECs). Ukufakwa kwezinsizakalo zempilo ezikhungweni ezingezona ezempilo, njengamashu neminye imikhakha yomphakathi, kuyakhulunywa kulokhu. UNgqongqoshe unikezwa amandla okwenza izinqumo zokwelashwa kwabaphilayo abavela ezindaweni zomdabu. Imithetho elawula ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni nezizimele ifakiwe kulokhu. Izikhungo ezizimele zinesibopho sokuthola umshwalense ukuze zivikela abasebenzisi ezinkingeni ezingase zenzeke. Isahluko sesixhenxe siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nokuhlela izinsiza zabantu nezikhungo zezempilo ezihlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezempilo. Kukhona imithwalo eminingi ebekwe kuBhodi Yezempilo Kazwelon
Emathilini, udoti obizwa nge-octane udingeka ukuvikela injini ekushayweni noma ekuphazamisekeni. Ukushaywa kwenjini kwenzeka uma kukhona ukushiswa okungaphathwa kahle kokuhlanganiswa komoya-njengoba emathilini, okungalimaza injini. I-octane etholakala kumafutha iyisilinganiso esivimbela injini ekushayweni - uma ibanga le-octane liphakeme, amathuba okuthi amafutha abangele ukushaywa ancipha. Ukwengeza ama-complexes e-lead emathilini kwakuyindlela evamile yokuthuthukisa izinga le-octane. I-lead yayisetshenziswa kakhulu njengokungezelelwa emathilini kusukela ngeminyaka yawo-1920. Nokho, amathilini awazange asetshenziswe ezimotweni ezihlanganiswe ne-catalytic converter ukuze kuncishiswe ukukhishwa, ngoba i-lead ivula ngokushesha le ngxenye. Lokhu, kanye nokutholakala kokuthi ukukhishwa kwe-lead kungalimaza impilo yomuntu, kuholele ekutheni kuncishiswe kancane, kuqala eNyakatho Melika, kwalandelwa yiYurophu, bese kusakazeka kwamanye amazwe emhlabeni. Kusukela ngosuku luni i-petrol enelead izophelelwa yisikhathi eNingizimu Afrika? Uhulumeni ubeke phansi ukuthi kuzoba nezinhlobo ezintathu zamafutha anebanga le-octane ngaphandle kwe-lead (ULP) ezovunyelwe eNingizimu Afrika (ezindaweni ezisemanzini nasemakhaya) ngemva kokuphela kukaJanuwari 1, 2006, okuyi-91, 93, kanye ne-95 Research Octane Number (RON). Ukudinga lezi zinhlobo kuzokhombisa ukuthi iyiphi efunwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe. Abanikazi bezimoto kufanele balindele ukuthi ngeke bathole zonke izinhlobo zonke, kodwa bangalindela ukuthola uhlobo oluhambelana noma olufanele ezimotweni zabo noma kuphi abahamba khona eNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izimboni zokucubungula uwoyela eNingizimu Afrika zifake imali noma zifaka imali kumishini noma ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikhulise ama-additives e-octane ngobuningi. I-octane additive ibaluleke kakhulu kunomkhiqizo okhiqizwa izimboni zokucubungula zendawo, ezizothenga izingxenye zokuhlanganisa eziphakeme ze-octane noma amafutha e-octane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kudingeka. Izindleko zezinhlobo ezahlukene zamafutha zizokwenziwa kanjani? Izindleko ezilawulwayo zizokwenziwa usebenzisa indlela efana nale esebenzayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindleko zezinhlobo ezikhona ezingenalead (95 octane emanzini kanye ne-93 emakhaya) zizohlala zifana. Izindleko zezinhlobo ezinelead zizofana nezindleko zamafutha angenelead anebanga le-octane elifanayo. Ezindaweni ezisemakhaya lapho uhlobo lwe-95 olungenalead luzoqala ukuba khona, kuzokwenziwa imali noma "intela yokudinga", ezokwenza izindleko zikhule phakathi kwalo no-93, kuqala ngophawu lwe-10 cents nge-litre. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi izimoto eziningi ezisemakhaya zaneliseka ngama-fuel e-93 octane, okuyi-highest etholakalayo, empeleni, iyona kuphela etholakalayo. Ama-fuel e-95 octane azokwenziwa atholakale emakhaya ukuze anele izimoto zobuchwepheshe besimanje ezethulwe embonini yezimoto. Njengoba abanikazi bezimoto bezokwazi ukukhetha phakathi kwezinhlobo ukuze bavimbele ukusetshenziswa kabi kwe-octane additives, kulindeleke ukuthi labo abadinga i-95 octane bayisebenzise - intela ekhokhwayo emakhaya ihloselwe ukuheha abanikazi bezimoto ukuba bacabange ngezinketho zabo. Emathilini, lapho ama-fuel aphezulu noma amaningi e-octane evame ukufunwa (ngokuvamile eduze nemanzini kukhombisa ukudinga okukhulu kwe-octane ezimotweni), i-95 octane engenelead iyona kuphela etholakalayo, futhi ngeke kube nenye intela kulolu hlobo. Ngizokwazi kanjani ukuthi iyiphi i-petrol efanele imoto yami? Kuzokwakhiwa idatha yolwazi ezokhombisa cishe zonke izinhlobo ezitholakalayo emigwaqweni yethu. Lokhu kuzotholakala yonke indawo, kuhlanganise nedatha yolwazi yeNational Association of Automotive Manufacturers (NAAMSA - www.naamsa.co.za) kanye neSouth African Petroleum Industry Association (SAPIA - www.sapia.co.za). Kulolu dbhuku, uhlobo lwamafutha olufanele ezindaweni ezisemanzini nasemakhaya luzokhombiswa ngokwehlukana (ukuze umkhiqizi asebenze kahle) nokuthi yiziphi ezinye izinhlobo ezingahambisana (lezo ezingenza imoto ihambe kahle ngaphandle kokulimaza injini, nakuba ingase ingasebenzi ngempumelelo ephelele kwezinye izimoto). Abanikazi bezimoto bangakhetha ukusebenzisa noma iyiphi uhlobo olukhombisiwe njengokunconywa noma okufanele kumoto yabo. Abanikazi bezimoto kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi isitayela sabo sokushayela singathinta ukuthi iyiphi i-octane additive abayithola iyahlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Kuzoba nomhlahlandlela okhombisa ama-fuel afanele ukusetshenziswa kulolu dbhuku nolwakho emastation okugcwalisa amafutha. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimoto zidinga ama-octane additives ahlukene. Ukusebenzisa amathilini anebanga le-octane eliphezulu kunalokho imoto yakho edinga akukhona okudingekayo futhi kuyiphutha lemali, ikakhulukazi njengoba kungathuthukisi ukusebenza kwenjini. Ukusebenzisa amathilini anebanga le-octane eliphansi kunalokho imoto yakho edinga kunciphisa ukusebenza kwenjini, okungaholela ekushayweni noma ekulimaleni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi isidingo se-octane semoto ethile sincike kwezinye izinto, kuhlanganise nokusetshenziswa nesitayela sokushayela, izidingo ze-octane zemoto eyalelwe kakhulu, ukuphakama okuphezulu, nezimo zezulu. Kungani ngingafanele ngisebenzise ibanga le-octane eliphezulu kunalokho imoto yami edinga? Amathilini anebanga le-octane eliphezulu adinga ukucubungula okuningi futhi asebenzisa amandla amaningi lapho kukhiqizwa. Uma la mandla engasetshenziswa kahle noma engasetshenziswa kahle yimoto yakho, kusho ukuthi amandla aphezulu abekwe khona ayaphuma noma alahleka. Lokhu kuphutha kuholela ekukhishweni kwe-hydrocarbons ezingashiswa noma i-carbon dioxide, okulimaza imvelo yethu. Ukusebenzisa uhlobo lwe-octane additive oluphakeme kunalokho imoto yakho edinga kuzokwenza noma kuphule umnikazi imali eningi, futhi kunomthelela omubi emvelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngeke kube nezinzuzo ekusebenzeni noma ekushayeleni. Ingabe amathilini angaphandle anelele ezimotweni, emathilini, nasezindaweni zokuhamba? Amathilini angaphandle ngokuvamile anelele ezimotweni, emathilini, nasezindaweni zokuhamba ngaphandle kokuthi amancane asebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obudala. Bheka noma ubuze umthengisi wemishini uma unombuzo. Ingabe izimoto ezidumile nezokuhamba ezindala zingasebenzisa amathilini angaphandle? Ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga, lezi zimoto kufanele ngokuvamile zisebenzise amathilini anelele, nakuba ezinye zingasebenzisa amathilini angaphandle. Uma ufuna ukusebenzisa amathilini angaphandle, xhumana nomkhiqizi waleyo moto. Uma ngisebenzisa amathilini angaphandle, ingabe ipayipi lokuphuma kwemoto yami lizoshintsha libe mhlophe njengoba kwenzeka uma ngisebenzisa amathilini anelele? Cha, lokhu akukhombisi ukwehla kokusebenza kwenjini. Ipayipi elisha liba mhlophe uma usebenzisa amathilini anelele ngenxa yokwakheka kwe-lead emaphumeleni uma imoto idla noma ishisa amafutha. Uma lokhu kususwa,
Umgwaqo ohlanganisa indlu onamathuluzi avulekile angcono kunezindonga eziphakeme ngoba umgwaqo uyabonakala. Ucingo lokusika, ucingo olunemibimbi, izinkomishi ezingenalutho noma amahhashi angaxhunywa emgwaqweni ukuze kubonakale ngokushesha uma kukhona umgibeli. Khumbula ukuthi iminyango kufanele ihlale ivaliwe. Izing doors zokuphepha emnyango ngamunye kufanele zibe nezivalo eziqinile phambi kwawo wonke umnyango kanye nasezindongeni, nezinsiza zokuvimbela ukungena. Izing doors zokuphepha kufanele zihlale zivaliwe. I-door yokuphepha ngaphakathi kwendlu ehlukanisa indawo yokulala nezinye izingxenye zendlu ingasiza kakhulu uma kukhona abavakashi bendlu. Kungaba kuhle futhi uma indlela yokuxhumana yokuphuthumayo ingafakwa kule ndlu. Izikhali kufanele zihlale zitholakala kalula futhi, uma kungenzeka, zigcinwe kumuntu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhali zihlale zigcinwa kahle futhi ukuthi umuntu ozisebenzisayo uqeqeshwe ukuze azisebenzise. Umsindo we-alamu ophakeme ophakeme phezulu kwendlu onezindawo lapho ungafaka khona ngaphakathi kwendlu ungatholakala kude uma ezinye izindlela zokuxhumana ziqhume. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinto zihlale zihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zingatholakala noma uma umuntu ekude nendlu. Izinja nezinkunzi ziwusizo kakhulu ekwaziseni uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Lezi zinyoni kufanele zigcinwe eduze kwendlu ukuze izivakashi ezingaziwa zingakwazi ukufika kalula. Abantu abangaziwa endaweni, bephuma bengenhla, kungenzeka bangabonakali kulokho abakwenzenayo. Izimoto ezingaziwa ezihamba emgwaqweni wezolimo kwesinye isikhathi zihlala endaweni. Qaphela amawheels ongawazi. Izinguquko endleleni umqashi enza izinto. Ukuthenga noma ukusebenzisa kakhulu ukudla ngasohlangothini lwabasebenzi. Izinguquko ekuziphatheni kwabasebenzi abadala ngemva kokuba beqashwe emsebenzini omusha. Ukufa kwekhaya lezinja ngendlela engacacile. Hlala uqaphele izimpawu zabantu abangaziwa abafika endaweni, njengezimbiza noma izinkomishi ezingenalutho, amaqanda, izicubu zephepha, izingubo ezikhaliphile, izinyathelo noma izicathulo, indawo esanda kuphazamiseka, izikhwama zokudla, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka. Ukuhlukumeza kokudla, uphethiloli, izinkomo, nezilwane. Abantu abangaziwa befika endaweni yakho bephakamisa izizathu ezivumayo kodwa kungenzeka babephakathi. Sebenzisa amalungelo akho njengomnikazi wepulazi. Abantu abangaziwa abafika epulazini noma bevakashela abasebenzi kufanele bathole imvume yakho kuqala. Xhumana nezomthetho zendawo ukuze uthole ukuthi yini ongenza ngayo ngokomthetho nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani lokho epulazini lakho. Yakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi bakho. Gcina amakhophi wezikhwama zabasebenzi bonke. Khuthaza bonke abasebenzi ukuba bahlale beqaphele ngokuphepha futhi babike noma iyiphi imisebenzi ephawulekayo. Khokha abasebenzi bakho ngazo zonke izinzuzo zabo futhi ubagcine bekwazisa. Ungavumeli muntu ukuba angene endaweni yakho noma epulazini ngaphandle kokubona kahle ukuthi bangobani, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. Zonke amathuluzi angasetshenziswa njengezikhali kufanele zihlale zivalwe lapho engasetshenziswa. Uma uhambe endlini, yenza kube isiko ukusazisa umndeni wakho ukuthi uhamba kuphi, indlela ozoyithatha, nokuthi uzobuyela nini. Hlala uhlole njalo ukuthi ifoni yakho iyasebenza. Beka ifoni endaweni elula ukufinyelela kuyo endlini, futhi kude nezindawo ezingashotwa kalula noma amawindi. Qaphela ngama-keys ukuze angacwengeki. Hlala unomoya eduze futhi uma uyisebenzisa, ungavezi ukuthi ungubani noma ukuthi uphi. Qaphela ukuthi uphethiloli nezimpahla zingaba nezinsongo. Ungahlali wenza izinto ngendlela efanayo nsuku zonke. Thuthukisa isiko lokungaphumuli endaweni ebonakalayo kumuntu ophumayo. Ungamile eduze kwamawindi uma uvula noma uvalela ama-curtains. Hamba ne-curtain ukuze ungabonakali kalula ngaphandle. Thatha izithombe nezinyathelo zabasebenzi bonke. Ngisho noma ungakwazi ukwenza lutho, kungaba yingozi. Ukuzijwayeza njalo izikhali zokudubula epulazini (endaweni ephephile) nakho kusiza ukuhlinzeka nokuvimbela izinsongo ezingaba khona. Fundisa izingane zakho indlela efanele yokuphendula uma zicela usizo futhi zigweme ukukhuluma nabantu abangaziwa noma ukuthola izipho kubantu abangaziwa. Cabanga - ungaphazamiseki. Ukungabonakali kahle kuyindlela yakho yokuqala yokuvikela. Hlola isimo - ingabe kukhona othile eduze? Khala phezulu? Uyalelwa ukuba ungabhekani nomgibeli ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi ungaphuma ngaleso sikhathi. Uma ubhekana ngaphandle kokucabanga, ungaboshwa. Phula umgibeli. Sebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela kuze kube yilapho ungathola usizo noma uphume. Uma ungakwazi ukubhekana, qaphela izimpawu zokuhlonza. Qaphela iminyaka yabo, ukuphakama, umbala wezinwele, izilonda, izingubo, ukukhuluma, nezindlela. Zama ukushiya ubufakazi obuningi ngangokunokwenzeka mayelana nendawo okwenzeka kuyo. Izinyathelo, izinyathelo, nezinto ezingasiza ukuhlole ukuthi ungubani kamuva. Abantu abahlukunyezwayo baphume ngempumelelo ngokuxhumana kahle nabagibeli babo (ukukhuluma ngokwakho).
Isimo ngalendlela asikwazi ukusebenzisa isivumelwano sokwenqabela abantu amalungelo abo noma labo abafuna ukufinyelela empahleni. Abasebenzi nabantu abafuna ukufinyelela empahleni kumele bakhombise ukuqonda isimo esibucayi samanje emapulazini futhi akufanele bazizwe benecala ngokuziphatha ngendlela yokwesaba noma yokuphikisana, futhi akufanele baphakamisela imikhawulo ezicelweni zokuvunyelwa ukuba bangene emapulazini ukuze bavakashele okubalulekile noma okufanele. Sifuna ukubonga lezi zikhungo ezilandelayo ngempumelelo yazo nokusiza ekwenzeni le ndatshana ibe khona. Uma umphakathi wehluleka ukuthola isikhathi ngoba engakwazi ukuxhumana nomnikazi noma umuntu ophethe umhlaba, noma ngoba isicelo sokufinyelela siyenqatshelwa, kufanele baxhumane nensizakalo yezolimo noma inhlangano yezolimo yasendaweni noma i-SAPS ukuze bathole usizo kulolu daba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abantu abanephuzu lokuvakashela abantu emapulazini ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikela Ukusetshenziswa Komhlaba, ngokwesibonelo. Kuphela uma kuhlelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi/ngezikhathi ezibekiwe nomnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophethe umhlaba. Umvakasheli kufanele asebenzise indlela eshiwo ngaphambili ukuze aye ezindlini zabasebenzi epulazini noma emathuneni okhokho babo. Kumele kube nesivumelwano esicacile ngesikhathi sokuvakasha. Umvakasheli akufanele abambe iqhaza kunoma yiziphi ezinye izinto ngaphandle kwalokho abavunyelwe. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abacwaningi, abahleli bezepolitiki, abahlela imicimbi, abasebenzi bezinkolo, njll. Abalimi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi babo bayahlanganyela kulezi zinkomfa futhi, lapho kungenzeka, banikeze ukuhamba kulezo zindawo. Ezimweni ezikhethekile lapho abantu kumele bangavunyelwa ukuba bangene epulazini, kufanele kube kuphela uma kuhlelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngokucacile nomnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophethe, futhi kuncike ezimweni ezishiwo nomnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophethe. Uhlelo lwezinhlelo zezolimo kanye nomphakathi wezolimo jikelele kufanele kube ukuvuselela ukuphepha esimweni esijwayelekile. Ngo-2002, Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha zamukela Isivumelwano Sokusebenza ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi akufanele sithinte noma yiziphi izenzo zabo ezisemthethweni. (Bheka inothi elingezansi). 1 Ngasikhathi sinye, Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha zizobe ziqaphele ukukhathazeka komphakathi wezolimo futhi zizolandela Isivumelwano Sokusebenza ngangokunokwenzeka. Abanikazi bomhlaba bazibophezela ekubambisaneni ngokuphelele nezikhungo zokuvikela ekwenzeni izenzo zabo. Le qembu lifaka phakathi abahloli abavela emnyangweni wezempilo, ezokuphathwa kwasekhaya, ezemisebenzi, ezolimo, njll. Kuphela uma kuhlelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi/ngezikhathi ezibekiwe nomnikazi noma omunye umuntu ophethe umhlaba. Uma uthola ilungelo lokungena noma ukungena emhlabeni noma ezindlini, bika ngokushesha kumnikazi noma kumuntu ophethe umhlaba. Umsebenzi okukhulunywa ngaye kufanele azive kahle, achaze uhlobo lomsebenzi wakhe, futhi akhulume isikhathi esilindelekile sokuhlala kulowo mhlaba. Umsebenzi akufanele enze noma yisiphi umsebenzi noma izenzo abengenalo ilungelo lokwenza. a. Ukwephula umthetho ngazo zonke izigameko - Ukuhlasela, ukubulala, ukushisa, ukulimaza ngokuqondile impahla, noma noma yiziphi izizathu zokwenza lokho. Kuwo wonke amacala lapho ukungena kuvinjelwe ngamandla emhlabeni oqashwayo, amarekhodi kufanele agcinwe kahle njengobufakazi. Ngo-2001, ngenxa yokubulawa okukhulu kanye nenani eliphezulu lezi zinsongo emapulazini, kanye nenani elikhulu labantu ababulawa noma abalimazwayo, i-Agri SA yenza isivumelwano sokusebenza ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphathwa kwabantu abahamba noma abahamba emhlabeni wepulazi. Ezinye zalezi zinsongo zenzeka ngeshwa ngabantu abenza sengathi bangamalungu ezinsizakalo zokuphepha futhi begqoke izingubo zazo. Isivumelwano Sokusebenza sakhuluma ngezinsizakalo zokuphepha (i-SAPS ne-SANDF) kanye nezinsizakalo zabo zomthetho. Izichibiyelo ezithile zenziwe nguMsizi wecala ngoMeyi, ozosungula ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlinzeko zokuxoshwa ezindaweni ezithile. Ezinye izimo lapho kukhona ulwazi olwaneleyo olukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi nomsebenzi wakhe bangase babe sengozini yokulimala, ukufa, noma ukulimala kwempahla, i-South African Police Service izophula umthetho futhi ikhiphe izinhlinzeko, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Abangena ngokungekho emthethweni kufanele baboshwe ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka futhi baphonswe phambi kwecala. Umnikazi noma umuntu ophethe umhlaba kufanele afake isikhalazo esisemthethweni ngokushesha kwi-South African Police Service. Uma kucace bha ukuthi umsuspect uhlala kulowo mhlaba isikhathi eside, umnikazi kufanele axwayise ukuthi umgibeli ongavumelekile kufanele axoshwe ngomyalo wecala. c. Ukuthi umnikazi, umphakathi onemvume, noma umuntu ophethe akavumelanga; futhi d. U- suspect akanalo ilungelo elisemthethweni lokungena emhlabeni, ngokwesibonelo. Uma uphoyisa waziswa ngokuqhamuka komhlaba endaweni enkulu, kubalulekile ukuthi kwenziwe ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka. Ukuhlasela komhlaba kuvame ukuhlobene nokuhlala okungekho emthethweni emhlabeni. Umnikazi angathola umyalo wokuxoshwa ngokushesha ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlalwa Okungekho Emthethweni (PIE). Abasebenzi abavumelekile bangaxoshwa kuphela ngomyalo wecala ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Umhlaba (isigaba 5 se-LTA). Lo myalo utholwa umnikazi ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo. Abahlali abavumelekile bangaxoshwa kuphela ngomyalo wesigungu somasipala noma wecala eliphezulu. b. Uthola umyalo wecala uma umhlali engashiyi umhlaba ngesikhathi esibekiwe; futhi c. Futhi ukusetshenziswa komyalo wokuxoshwa. Abahlali abangenamvume bangaxoshwa kuphela ngomyalo wesigungu somasipala noma wecala eliphezulu. Lo myalo utholwa umnikazi ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo. Kuyicala elibi ukuthola ngqo noma ngokuqondile noma ukufuna ukukhokha noma yimuphi imali noma noma yini ebhekwa njengokukhokha noma ukuhlela noma ukuvumela umuntu ukuba ahlale emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi noma umuntu ophethe lowo mhlaba. Umhlali ongavumelekile ungumuntu ophatha umhlaba ngaphandle kwemvume eshiwo ngumkhiqizi ngokuqondile. Abahlali ngaphansi ko-ESTA abavumelekile. Amalungelo abahlali abangenamvume avikelwe nguMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlalwa Okungekho Emthethweni kanye Nokuhlala Okungekho Emthethweni, 1998. Le ngxenye yabahlali izoba kakhulu labo abaziwa njenge "squatters" abahlala ezindaweni ngaphandle kwemvume. Umthetho we-PIE uhlanganisa umthetho wokuvikela ukuhlala okungekho emthethweni we-1951. Umuntu ongavunyelwe ukungena ungumuntu ongena emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi, futhi uphoyisa angababamba. Uma umuntu ongene ngaphandle kwemvume "uhlala" emhlabeni womnikazi, kufanele abhekwane njengomhlali ongavumelekile. "Uhlala" kusho ukuthi umuntu unendawo yokuhlala noma uhlala khona okungapheli. I- court ithola umuntu ongene ngaphandle kwemvume enecala ngaphansi kwesig
