Noma yisiphi isikhumbuzo kule mithetho esiqondiswe eqenjini okufanele sigcine idokhumenti sizothathwa njengokuhlanganiswa kokumela kwalelo qembu kanye nemibhalo ethunyelwe kuNksz. kanye nokuhilela umsebenzi welinye iqembu nokuhambisa amakhophi angama-25 wezimali ezihambelanayo kuhlanganisa ngezindlela zedijithali ngendlela ehambisana nezinsiza zenkantolo kanye noNksz. Izaziso, ama-oda, nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana ngaphansi kwale mithetho zingakhishwa noma zithunyelwe ngeposi ebhalwe noma ngezindlela zedijithali noma nganoma iyiphi enye indlela esebenzayo ngezindlela zedijithali. Uma isaziso noma ukuxhumana kufakwe ngendlela yedijithali noma ngekhompyutha, iqembu elithumela leso saziso noma ukuxhumana kufanele likhiphe kuNksz. ikhophi yomzimba wesaziso noma ukuxhumana kanye necebo elisayinwe yilowo mqondisi elikhombisa usuku lwesaziso noma idokhumenti. UNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa angandisa noma yisiphi isikhathi esibekwe kule mithetho. Iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe, izimpendulo, nezinye izibalo ezithunyelwe enkantolo kufanele zicace futhi zihlukaniswe. Izicelo kufanele zibhale kahle zishiye izikhala ezimbili phakathi kwemigqa, zibhaliwe ephepheni le-A4. Ngokuhambisana nomthetho 5, izinhlinzeko zomthetho 4 weMithetho Ejwayelekile zizosebenza kanye nezichibiyelo ezidingekayo uma kwenziwa noma iyiphi inqubo yenkantolo. Lokhu kuza kuze kube uNovemba 30. Isicelo singaphakanyiswa ngaphandle kokulandela isikhathi sonyaka uma uNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa ethatha leso sinqumo. Uma usuku oluhlongozwayo lokuqala kwesikhathi lungelona usuku lwenkantolo, lesi sikhathi sizophakanyiswa ngosuku olulandelayo lwenkantolo, uma usuku oluhlongozwayo lokuphela kwesikhathi sonyaka lungelona usuku lwenkantolo, lesi sikhathi sonyaka sizophela ngosuku lwenkantolo olwandulela leso suku. Ihhovisi likaNksz. lizovulwa kusukela ngo-08:30 kuya ku-13:00 futhi lizovulwa futhi kusukela ngo-14:00 kuze kube ngu-15:30 ezinsukwini zenkantolo. Ezimo ezikhethekile, uNksz. angamukela imibhalo ngemuva kwezinsuku zokusebenza, ezokwenziwa uma eqondiswa nguMjudge. Isaziso sokudluliselwa kwezimangalo, isinqumo senkantolo sokudluliselwa noma noma yini enkantolo ivela kwenye idokhumenti eqale izingxoxo enkantolo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zale mithetho izonombolo nguNksz, ngokulandelana kusukela konyaka owagcinwa. Zonke imibhalo ethunyelwe kamuva kulowo msebenzi noma enye ingxenye eqhubekayo izobanjwa ngaleyo nombolo nguNksz. futhi uNksz. ngeke azamukele uma zingakabhalwanga ngaleyo msebenzi noma inombolo. Zonke imibhalo ezithunyelwe kuNksz. ukuze zigcinwe efayilini lesicelo zizogcinwa nguNksz. efayilini lesicelo, ngaphansi kwenombolo efanele yalowo msebenzi. Zonke imibhalo ezithathwe kusukela ku-schedule -1 zizohambisana nezimali zenkantolo ezingu-R75.00, le mali ikhokhwa ngephosta: Uma iqembu likwazisa uNksz. ngaphansi kwesheduli -5 ukuthi bahluphekile, imali yenkantolo ingakhanselwa nguNksz. ozobhala le simo ekhasini lokuqala ledokhumenti ethile. Iqembu elifuna ukuqala noma ukuphikisa udaba ku-schedule yenkantolo futhi elikholwa ukuthi bahluphekile noma umuntu osebenza egameni lelo qembu kufanele akwazise uNksz. ukuthi ngaphandle kwezimpahla zomndeni, izingubo, nezinsiza zokusebenza, lelo qembu alinayo impahla engaphezulu kwe-R20,000 futhi ngeke likwazi ukuthola le mali masinyane emholweni wabo. Lapho amakhophi enziwa, imali ethile eshiwo ku-schedule -6a izokhokhwa. Thina, njengabasebenzi boMnyango wezobuciko namasiko, sithole izinsiza ezahlukene zik government ezibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwethu ukuze sizibhekele. Ngokwesiqondiso seMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zomphakathi, izinsiza zik government kufanele zihlale zibalwa; ngakho-ke, kufanele sisebenzise imithetho yokuphatha futhi siqinisekise izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze sigweme ukulahlekelwa okuhambisanayo. Enye yale mithetho yokuphatha wukusebenzisa imithetho yokuphepha efana nokuhlola zonke izinto zomuntu ezithwalwa ngesandla, izimoto, noma izinto ezithwalwayo. Umthetho Wokufinyelela Ezindaweni Zomphakathi kanye noMthetho Wezimoto, No. 53 ka-1985, unikeza abasebenzi bezokuphepha amandla okwenza ezinye izenzo ngokuhambisana neSigaba 2 soMthetho Wezimoto ka-1985 (njengokwenza ukuhlola, ukuvimbela ukungena noma ukuphuma, njll.). [Uceliwe ukuthi uhlole izaziso ezikhangisiwe ezindaweni zethu]. Kuyiqiniso futhi ukuthi le ndlela yokuphepha ingaba nzima kubasebenzisi ukuba babe nesipiliyoni esihle. Ukufika kule ndawo kudinga ukubambisana nokuqonda kubasebenzi. Uyanxuswa ukuba uzizwe ukhululekile ukuxhumana noMnu. Van Rooyen uma kukhona okungacacile mayelana nemithetho yethu yokuphepha nezinhlelo.
Bafowethu, umnyango ubize umhlangano okhethekile ukuze sixoxe ngombiko wezinhlelo ze-workshop ezabanjwa ngonyaka ka-2000 kulo lonke izwe. Lezi zinhlelo ze-workshop zazihloselwe ukubuyekeza intuthuko yokuguqulwa kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo. Sifunde ngokucophelela yonke imibhalo ethulwe, sihlole izinkinga ezikhulunywe kanye nemibono ewusizo kanye nenhloso ehlelekile yokwakha indlela enhle nephumelelayo. Okokuqala, sifuna ukubonga ngenhliziyo yethu ngempumelelo nezimpendulo ezisheshayo eziphathelene nalezi zinhlelo ze-workshop. Ukuhlola intuthuko eyenziwe mayelana nezinguquko, sikhumbula ubuhlakani bezicwangciso, izinhlelo, nezinqubo ezisetshenziswe ukuhlela isiphakamiso sokuguqulwa, ukusetha imigomo ngokusekelwe ekuhloleni intuthuko noma ukuwina kwayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ama-workshop aphumelele ekubandakanyeni nasekutholeni ukwesekwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuguqulwa, njengoba kuhloswe nguhulumeni, kubonakala kuyinto ebalulekile emehlweni abasebenzi. Sigcizelela ubudlelwano phakathi kwalabo abaphethe noma abaphatha nezisebenzi ezisebenzela bona, sithole ngenjabulo ukuthi ama-workshop abhekwa njengethuluzi eliwusizo kanye nepulatifomu yokuxoxa ngezindaba ezihlobene nokuguqulwa ngamalungu onke abasebenzi, okukhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi bayakufuna ukuba yingxenye yalesi senzo futhi bazibophezele ekuhlinzekeni ngoguquko kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo, nakuba bekukhona abanye abaphikisa uguquko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sijabule ukuthi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abaningi sebeqonde imigomo ye-workshop, njengokuxoxa ngezaba zokwesaba ezikhona phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinkinga eziphathelene nokuguqulwa kanye nezinselelo zedemokhrasi, ukuxoxisana nokuxoxa ngesithombe esiphelele sokuguqulwa njengoba kuboniswe ezishintshweni zomthethosisekelo nakwezinye izinqubo. Umphumela wama-workshop obhekwa phezulu njengethuluzi eliwusizo ubonisa ukuthi abasebenzi badinga leli thuba, indawo ephephile yokuxhumana kangcono nabangane babo ngokujulile kwezihlukahlukene zabo, okuhlangenwe nakho, namasiko, hhayi njengabantu abodwa abasebenza enhlanganweni eyodwa. Nokho, izinkinga eziphathelene nokungaboni ngaso linye ngokobuhlanga noma ukungahloniphi izihlukano zamasiko zihlala zikhona futhi zidinga ukulungiswa, futhi sizokwenza lokhu masinyane. Kucace bha ukuthi kukhona ukuvumelana phakathi kwabasebenzi bonke mayelana nesidingo sokuguquka enhlanganweni yethu. Lo mphumela ubonisa izinto ezahlukene kubasebenzi abahlukene. Kubasebenzi abathile, isiko elikhona kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo alikaguquki ngendlela eyanele ukuze babone izifiso zabo zohulumeni baseNingizimu Afrika zedemokhrasi zifeziwe, ikakhulukazi endaweni yokusebenza. Izinga lokuphatha eliphakathi lisagcwele kakhulu ngabantu abamhlophe, kuyilapho iningi lomsebenzi wesekelo lenziwa ngabantu abamnyama. Nakuba kukhona izinqubomgomo ezikhona mayelana nokuqashwa kwabantu ababephakanyiswa ngaphambili, amathuba okuthi abantu abamnyama bathole izikhundla zokuphatha awabonakali, njengoba kuqokonyiswa ngesikhathi sama-workshop. Bonke abasebenzi bazizwa ukuthi umoya, noma ukuqeqeshwa kokuguquka, akutholanga ukubaluleka okudingekayo. Abanye abasebenzi abamhlophe baphinde bathi akukwanele ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bavume uguquko njengomgomo, kodwa kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okubavumela ukuthi basebenze njengabaphathi noma njengalabo abaguqukile ngempela. Ngaphansi kwezimo zokungaqondi izindlela zokuphatha kule nkathi entsha yokuguqulwa, kungenzeka ukuthi abaphathi babonwa njengabantu abaphikisa uguquko, ngenxa yokungazi ukuthi bangasebenza kanjani ngendlela ehlukile. Kukhona izinkomba eziqinile phakathi kwabantu abamhlophe zokuthi uguquko luyinqubo eyodwa. Kubonakala sengathi abanye abasebenzi abamnyama bacabanga ukuthi kuphela abantu abamhlophe abadinga uguquko, hhayi bona. Abasebenzi abamhlophe bazizwa ukuthi abanye abasebenzi abamnyama abahloniphi imizamo yabo yokwenza izinto ngendlela ehlukile. Thina, emnyangweni, siyawuqaphela lo mzwa. Ngokuhlanganisa isakhiwo sokuphatha abasebenzi endaweni eyodwa, izinkinga nezinkathazo eziphathelene nenqubo yokuqasha engathathi hlangothi zingaxazululwa kalula kunakuqala lapha kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo. Umnyango usemsebenzini wokuphromotha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zabaphathi abaqavile, izinhlelo eziqeqesha ngoguquko nezizokhuluma ngezinkinga ezikhulunywe ngabantu. Indima yethu izoba ukuhlanganisa lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Sizophinde sithinte isakhiwo sokuqeqesha somnyango ukuze sithuthukise izakhiwo zokweluleka ezithembekile ezizohambisana nenqubo yokuqasha engathathi hlangothi futhi ehlose labo ababephakanyiswa ngaphambili. Sizosebenzisa isu lokweluleka, elichazwe kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo, njengesisekelo sokwenza iziphakamiso. Siphinde saqaphela ukuthi izinkinga zokuguqulwa eziphathelene nezokusebenza emkhakheni womphakathi wezincwadi nezikhumbuzo zathathwa ngababambiqhaza abaningi ema-workshop. Izinkinga eziphathelene nezindawo ezithile zokuguqulwa, njengokushintsha ekubhekeni ukukhiqizwa kwabasebenzi, ukuthengwa nokutholwa kwezimpahla, ukuhlela nencazelo yayo, azizange ziphikwe ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuthazwe yilabo abaphatha uhlelo. Abasebenzi abakhulume ngemibono yokuthi bangayisheshisa kanjani izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze bahlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Sifuna ukubona ama-workshop exoxa ngezindaba ezihlobene ngqo nemisebenzi emisha nezinselelo zayo ezivela ekuguquleni, lapho singakwazi khona ukuveza inqubo yedemokhrasi yokuphatha abantu, isiko elisha lokubhekelela, ukusebenza kahle kweqembu nokuvuselelwa, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezidingo zomphakathi. Izinkinga zomsebenzi wobungcweti azidingi ukubhekwa ngokufana nezinguquko eziphathelene nabasebenzi, futhi sicela abasebenzi baqonde ukuthi izinguquko emikhakheni yomsebenzi njengoba kubhalwe emthethweni zizosekela isizinda nemisebenzi yeMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo ngokugqamisa indlela ebonakalayo nezinikela yokusebenza. Sizobhekana nalezi zinkinga njengengxenye yesu elisha lokwenza izinto nokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babambe iqhaza. Umnyango uqaphela ngenhlonipho nangokujabula ukuthi izinqubo eziningi nezicwangciso zokuguqulwa seziqale ukusebenza kuMnyango Wezizwe Wezincwadi Nezikhumbuzo. Umnyango wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi nobuchwepheshe wasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1994 wabe usahlukaniswa waba umnyango wezobuciko nesiko kanye nomnyango wesayensi nobuchwepheshe ngonyaka ka-2002. Inhloso yalolu suku lokwazisa ukuhlela izakhiwo nemisebenzi yoMnyango nokuchaza izinhlelo zawo zokugcina amarekhodi ukuze kuhambisane nezinhloso ze-PAIA. Kubandakanya izaziso ezinikezwa ngokuhambisana nezinsika ezingu-22 no-54 mayelana nezindleko okufanele zikhokhwe mayelana nezicelo zokufinyelela; kanye nezinhlinzeko ezenziwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 92 soMthetho. Umhlahlandlela ungatholakala kwiKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu. Ukufinyelela kumarekhodi athile agcinwe ngomnyango kufanele kufunwe kwiOfisi YeNhlangano Yolwazi kulandela izinqubo ezichazwe ezinsikeni ezingu-17 kuya ku-32 zoMthetho. Bheka ulwazi lokuxhumana lweNhlangano Yolwazi esigabeni 3. Amafomu okucela abekwe kahle angatholwa kwiHhovisi leNhlangano Yolwazi yoMnyango wezobuciko nesiko. Bheka esigabeni 3. Ukufinyelela kumarekhodi angahlolwa kunikezwa ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ezifana nezikhungo zokufunda ngaphansi kokuhlolwa kwabasebenzi, abangahlinzeka ngesiqondiso sokukhululwa nokufakwa kolwazi kumarekhodi kanye nokugcina okuqukethwe komlando. Inhloso yoMnyango ukuhweba nokugcina izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubumbano nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuthuthukiswe ubuciko nesiko eNingizimu Afrika nokuhola amandla akhe ukuze kuthuthukiswe ngokomphakathi. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuthuthukiswe izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseNingizimu Afrika nokwandisa ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi zelizwe. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe amathuba omnotho nezinye izinkambo ezihlobene nobuciko nesiko laseNingizimu Afrika kwazulu nakwamanye amazwe ngokubambisana nezokusebenzisana, ngaleyo ndlela kuvumeleke ukwesekwa komkhakha. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuqondiswe ukwethulwa kwemigomo, umthetho, nezinhlelo eziyisisekelo zokukhombisa, ukugcina, nokukhuthaza ifa lesizwe. Ukuze kugcinwe, kusekelwe, futhi kuthuthukiswe izinsiza zezakhiwo zomlando, futhi ezihlobene nomsebenzi nolwazi lwesizwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zifinyelela kulezi zinsiza ngokuphelele nangokukhululekile. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekutholeni nasemadokhumenti ahlobene nezakhiwo zomlando mayelana nezindleko ezibekwe ohlwini lwamanani olushicilelwe. Ezinye izinsiza zinikezwa kuphela nguhulumeni, isibonelo, izinsiza zokuphatha amarekhodi, ukuqeqeshwa kwabaphathi bamarekhodi, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezikhumbuzo zomlando. Amarekhodi omphakathi agcinwe ngabaphethe iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-20. Amarekhodi aqhubekayo enkantolo kanye namarekhodi okungcwaba kwabafileyo. Izibalo zonyaka zoMnyango unyaka nonyaka. Amadokhumenti okuphatha amarekhodi atholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NARS.
Uhlelo lwezohwebo kanye nesu lokusebenza kwemisebenzi yesikhathi esizayo lukhonjiswa kuNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha futhi luvunywa ngaye minyaka yonke, ngendlela yesicelo (uhlelo lwezohwebo) oluhlanganisa nolwazi olunembile. I-SAMSA yenza imisebenzi yezomthetho nezok regulation, egameni likaNgqongqoshe Wezokuthutha kanye neMnyango Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke (NDOT). Ngakho-ke, i-SAMSA yenza imisebenzi ekhethiwe ezingeni lokusebenza, kanti i-NDOT isebenza ezingeni lesu, lapho ithuthukisa khona izinqubomgomo zokuthutha nezikhombisi-ndlela ezibalulekile kumaphrojekthi. I-SAMSA iqhubeka nokuxhumana nabathintekayo emikhakheni yezokuthutha, ngamakomidi ahlukahlukene ezokuthutha nangokubamba imihlangano yokuxhumana nezinye izindlela ezingezona ezisemthethweni. Inhloso ye-SAMSA ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezimpahla nokuphila olwandle, ukuvikela nokulwa nokungcoliswa okuthinta imvelo yolwandle yezikebhe, nokukhulisa izintshisekelo zezimali zeRiphabhulikhi. Phakathi kwezinye izenzo, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulezi, kukhona ukuhlolwa kwezikebhe, imishini, kanye nezimpahla, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isikebhe nezikebhe zifakwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezibekiwe. I-SAMSA iphinde ikhiphe futhi inikeze izitifiketi okufanele zibe nazo abantu uma besebenza ezikebheni. IKomidi leMithetho Yamalungelo Abantu laseNingizimu Afrika kumele lithuthukise isikhombimsebenzisi esiqukethe ulwazi olufanele ukuhlinzekwa kunoma ubani ofuna ukusebenzisa noma yiluphi ilungelo elicatshangelwayo nguMthetho. Izimemo ezitholiwe zokuhamba/nokuxhumana namanye amazwe/izinhlangano/okungabandakanya amaklayenti nomphakathi. Akukho sikhumbuzo esishicilelwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho. I-SAMSA iphethe ukuvikelwa kokungcoliswa kanye nekhono lokuphendula, ngokubambisana neMnyango Wezokuphila Nendawo. Ukwethulwa kwanoma iyiphi indaba kumele kuthunyelwe ku-CEO we-SAMSA. Uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sikhanselwa noma sithathwa ngokuhambisana Nezikhala 22, 26, noma 29 zoMthetho, umceli angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi. Omnye umuntu angafaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi ngokumelene nesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi, ukuze afune ukufinyelela kulwazi. Isikhalazo kumele sithunyelwe ngendlela ebekiwe ku-2, bese sithunyelwa kuMenenja Yolwazi kwikheli leposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhonjiswe ku-2 ngenhla, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokuthola isikhumbuzo sokwenqaba. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yesikhalazo. Uma umceli engakakhokhi imali yesikhalazo (uma kudingeka), isinqumo ngesikhalazo sangaphakathi singabambezela, kuze kube yilapho imali ikhokhiwe. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isikhalazo, ukuthi ingaqinisekisa yini isikhalazo noma yenze isinqumo esisha esikhundleni sayo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Uma i-SAMSA ingahlinzeki umceli ngesikhumbuzo ngesinqumo sokusikhalazo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokufaka isicelo, i-SAMSA izobhekwa njengokwenqaba isikhalazo sangaphakathi. Umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu angasondela enkantolo ukuze athole usizo olufanele kuphela ngemva kokuthi umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu esebenzisile zonke izinqubo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi mayelana nesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi. Uma umfaki-sicelo noma omunye umuntu ehluphekile ngesinqumo seMenenja Yolwazi noma izicelo zabo zesikhalazo sangaphakathi ziye zaphumelela, bangafaka isicelo enkantolo ukuze bathole usizo olufanele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 ngemuva kwesinqumo sokusikhalazo. Ikhaya elinethuba lokufaka lesi sicelo yikhaya eliphezulu noma enye inkantolo enezimfanelo ezifanayo. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahambisane nezimfuneko zokusebenza ezitholakala kuMthetho, eziphathelene nesicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi. Umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu elibekiwe ku-1, bese elithumela, kanye nemali yesicelo kanye ne-deposit (uma kudingeka), kuMenenja Yolwazi kwikheli leposi, inombolo ye-fax, noma ikheli le-imeyili elikhonjiswe ku-2 ngenhla. Futhi ikheli leposi noma inombolo ye-fax yomfaki-sicelo. Uma isicelo sithunyelwa egameni lomunye umuntu, khona-ke umfaki-sicelo kumele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthi unegunya lokwenza lesi sicelo egameni labo. Umfaki-sicelo uzokwaziswa ngokubhala ukuthi ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe noma kuhanjiswa. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna izizathu zesinqumo ngenye indlela, kumele akhombise indlela nemininingwane ezodingeka. Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuqedela ifomu ngenxa yokuthi akakwazi ukufunda noma ubuthakathaka, lowo muntu angafaka isicelo ngenkulumo. Umceli kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ngaphambi kokuthi kwenzeke noma yisiphi isenzo. Futhi imali yokufinyelela, ebaliwe ngokubheka izindleko zokuphrinta kabusha, ukukhangwa, nesikhathi sokulungiselela, kanye nezindleko zesicelo kanye neposi. Uma isicelo sitholiwe nguMenenja Yolwazi, lowo msebenzi uzodinga isikhumbuzo sokuthi umfaki-sicelo, ngaphandle kokufaka isicelo, kumele akhokhe imali yesicelo ebekiwe ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nokucubungula isicelo. Umfaki-sicelo onikezwe ukufinyelela kumarekhodi kumele akhokhe imali yokufinyelela yesicelo, kanye nokuphinda kukhishwe, ukulungiselela, nesikhathi esidingekayo sokufinyelela ezikhathini ezithile zesicelo nokulungiselela kwamarekhodi okuzokhishwa, kuhlanganise nokwenza amalungiselelo ukuze kube khona ngendlela efunwayo. Uma isicelo sokurekhoda senziwe futhi irekhodi silungisiwe ukuze sikhishwe, kuhlanganise nanoma yiziphi amalungiselelo ukuze kube khona ngendlela efunwayo, kudinga amahora ngaphezu kwalawo abekiwe emthethweni ngenhloso, uMenenja Yolwazi uzokwazisa umfaki-sicelo ukuthi akhokhe, njengediphozi, ingxenye ebekiwe yemali yokufinyelela okudingeka ikhokhwe uma isicelo sivunywa. UMenenja Yolwazi uzogcina irekhodi kuze kube isikhathi lapho umfaki-sicelo ekhokha izimali ezibekiwe. Uma idiphozi ikhokhiwe mayelana nesicelo sokufinyelela esinquelekile, khona-ke uMenenja Yolwazi ophathwayo uzobuyisela idiphozi kumfaki-sicelo. I-SAMSA izokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo, ukuthi ivume noma inqabe isicelo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho. Isikhathi esingu-30 sezinsuku lapho i-SAMSA kumele yenze isinqumo sokuvuma noma sokwenqaba isicelo singandiswe sibe esinye isikhathi ngokuhambisana noMthetho 26.
Ngokulandela lokhu, kubizwa ngokuthi isivumelwano somphakathi ngapha, emva kwalokhu babizwa ngamaqembu. I-SAPS ingena esivumelwaneni ne-CONTRACTOR ngokuhambisana nezimo nemigomo ebekiwe esivumelwaneni, futhi i-CONTRACTOR ivuma ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwakhe ngqo kwi-SAPS ngokuhambisana nezimo nemigomo ebekiwe kulesi SIVUMELWANO, esizobizwa ngokuthi WORK: Kwaphela uma i-CONTRACTOR ingaziswa yi-SAPS ukuthi asebenze kwi-SAPS kwenye indawo, kunoma iyiphi indawo eyi-SAPS engaphansi kwe-WORK, kuzoba isikhathi esilinganiselwe. I-CONTRACTOR, ngenxa yesi sivumelwano, ngeke ibe noma ibe ngaphansi kokulindela ukuthi lesi sivumelwano sizovuselelwa, futhi ngeke ibekwe emsebenzini njengesisebenzi se-SAPS. Kuvunyelwene phakathi kweZIGABA ukuthi isivumelwano se-CONTRACTOR esenziwe naye njengomsebenzi ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO asisho ukuthi kukhona ubudlelwano bokusebenza phakathi kwe-CONTRACTOR ne-SAPS. I-CONTRACTOR kumele, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-clause 1.1 ngenhla nangaphansi kwemigomo ye-clause 5 no-9 ngezansi, ihlinzeke i-SAPS ngezinsizakalo njengoba kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe yi-SAPS, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe, kusukela ngosuku lokuqala lokuqala kulesi SIVUMELWANO, bheka i-clause 12. Imisebenzi ebhekene ne-CONTRACTOR izofaka noma iyiphi imisebenzi yezandla eyingxenye, futhi ehambisana, nomsebenzi we-CONTRACTOR. I-CONTRACTOR izokwenza umsebenzi wakhe (bheka i-clause 3.1 - 3.2 ngenhla) kwi-SAPS ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngesonto: Kwaphela uma i-CONTRACTOR ingasebenzi kwi-SAPS ngoMgqibelo nangeSonto, noma ezinsukwini zomkhosi. I-CONTRACTOR izokwenza umsebenzi wakhe ngokuhambisana nohlelo oluhlanganiswe lapha njengeSheduli A. I-CONTRACTOR ngeke ibe nelungelo lokukhokhelwa ikhefu noma ezinsukwini ayengakabi khona ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-CONTRACTOR ngeke ibe nelungelo lokuthatha ikhefu ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-SAPS izoba nesibopho sokuhlinzeka i-CONTRACTOR ngezokuthutha ukuya nokubuya kwi-WORK ukuze akwazi ukugcina umsebenzi wakhe, bheka i-clause 3.1-3.2 ngenhla ngaphansi kwalesi SIVUMELWANO. I-SAPS izokhokhela i-CONTRACTOR ngokuba khona kwakhe nomsebenzi awenzayo, imali yesivumelwano ye-R - ...rand ngehora kuhlanganiswe ne-VAT: Kwaphela uma i-SAPS ingakhulisa le mali yesivumelwano yehora ngokuthanda kwayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Le mali izokhokhwa ngenyanga ngemali yaseNingizimu Afrika. Le mali yesivumelwano (bheka i-clause 10.1 ngezansi) imele umholo ophelele kanye nezinsizakalo zonke ezihambisana nomsebenzi we-CONTRACTOR, kwaphela uma le mali ikhokhwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho othile, izofakwa emholweni we-CONTRACTOR. I-CONTRACTOR ivikela i-SAPS kukho konke ukulimala noma ukulahleka okubangelwa ukulimala komzimba, ukulahleka kokuphila, ukulahleka noma ukulimala kwempahla kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kubangelwa yi-SAPS noma omunye umuntu noma kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kubangelwa noma ngenxa yokungakhathali okukhona ngesikhathi engumsebenzi we-SAPS ogcina ukuhleleka, futhi ivikela i-SAPS kukho konke ukulahleka, ukulimala, izindleko noma imali ekhokhelwayo mayelana nezinqubo zomthetho ezikhona eziphathelene ne-CONTRACTOR futhi ezingase zibe nezicelo zemali noma ukuboshwa nganoma iyiphi indlela. Lesi SIVUMELWANO sizoqala futhi sibe nesibopho kusukela ngosuku olusayinwe yizigaba zombili kulesi SIVUMELWANO: Kwaphela uma lesi SIVUMELWANO singasayinwa ngesikhathi esifanayo yiZIGABA, usuku lokugcina lokusayinwa kwelinye lamaqembu luzothathwa njengosuku lokuqala kulesi SIVUMELWANO. Lesi SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-clause 13.2 no-14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizoqhubeka isikhathi esichaziwe (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngezansi), esizoqala ngosuku lokuqala lapho lesi SIVUMELWANO siqala (bheka i-clause 12.1 ngezansi). Lesi SIVUMELWANO singavuselelwa ngokuthanda kwe-SAPS ngokubhalwa phansi ngokuvuma kwe-CONTRACTOR isikhathi esichaziwe: Kwaphela uma i-SAPS ifuna ukwazisa i-CONTRACTOR ukuthi ifuna ukuvuselela lesi SIVUMELWANO, kumele inikeze isaziso esibhaliwe njengoba kuchaziwe ku-clause 13.2 ngenhla, ngaphambi kokuphela kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla). Okuqukethwe kwalesi SIVUMELWANO kuzoba yisisekelo sesivumelwano, esivuselelwe ngokuhambisana ne-clause 13.2 ngenhla. Lesi SIVUMELWANO, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-clause 13.2 no-14.2 - 14.3 ngezansi, sizophela ngokuzenzakalelayo ekupheleni kwesikhathi esichaziwe (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngezansi). Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili zokuqhathanisa usuku nosuku (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sosuku olulodwa. Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili zokuqhathanisa usuku nosuku (bheka i-clause 3.1 ngenhla) kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kodwa ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso sezinsuku ezimbili zokuqhathanisa usuku nosuku. Uma lesi SIVUMELWANO siphela ngemuva kwenyanga zokuqhathanisa usuku nosuku kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi SIVUMELWANO (bheka i-clause 12 ngenhla), kuzosebenza isaziso senyanga. Kwaphela uma i-SAPS ingakwamukela, ngezimo ezithile ezamukelekayo, isaziso esifushane. Noma iyiphi iqembu kulesi SIVUMELWANO ingaqeda lesi SIVUMELWANO uma omunye wabo ephula noma iyiphi ingxenye yalesi SIVUMELWANO: Kwaphela uma iqembu lokuqala elishiwo linikeze elinye iqembu isaziso esibhaliwe mayelana nale mpahla futhi le mpahla ayilungiswanga phakathi kwezinsuku ezinhlanu kusukela ngosuku ayitholile leso saziso. Izihloko zemigomo kulesi SIVUMELWANO zikhona kuphela ukuze zisetshenziswe njengokubhekisela, ngakho-ke azikho ingxenye futhi azihlobene nokuchazwa kwemigomo nganoma iyiphi indlela. Ngaphandle kokuthi kubonakale ukuthi kukhona ukungqubuzana noma ukungahambisani nokuhlangenwe nakho, okwakodwa kuzofaka okwakubili futhi ubulili besilisa kuzofaka ubulili besifazane, futhi kuphinde kube njalo. Lesi SIVUMELWANO siyisivumelwano esiphelele phakathi kweZIGABA futhi sikhansela noma yisiphi esinye isivumelwano esingase sibe khona phakathi kweZIGABA mayelana nokuhlangenwe nakho lapha. I-ZIGABA ivuma ukuthi ngeke kube nezinguquko, ukwengeza, noma izivumelwano zokukhansela noma noma yini edala kab
I-Bhili ihlose ukusungula uhlaka lokuphumeza imithetho nemigomo ezohambelana nomkhakha wezempilo kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze izinsizakalo zezempilo zixazululwe kahle, iBhili ifuna ukuba kube nokulingana ekunikezeni izinsizakalo ngokusungula izinqubo nezindinganiso, izinhlelo, nemigomo kazwelonke. Isahluko sokuqala siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nezinhloso zeBhili, imithwalo yemfanelo yomnyango wezempilo, kanye nelungelo lokufinyelela ukwelashwa okukhululekile. Ikhuluma ngokusebenza nokuchazwa komqondo weBhili. I-Bhili ihloselwe ukusetshenziswa ezingeni likazwelonke futhi idlule emithethweni ethile ehambelana nezempilo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 146 seMthethosisekelo, uma kwenzeka ukungqubuzana phakathi kweBhili neminye imithetho yezempilo. Izinhloso zangempela zeBhili ukuhlinzeka ngemithwalo kahulumeni ngaphansi kweMthethosisekelo mayelana nelungelo elihambelana nezinsizakalo zokwelapha, kanye nokusungula uhlelo lwezempilo lwesizwe oluhlose ababambiqhaza bezinsizakalo zezempilo zomphakathi kanye nezizimele futhi oluzohlinzeka abahlali beRiphabhulikhi ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezingathengiswa ngemali etholakalayo. Lesi sahluko sizama ukusho imithwalo yemfanelo kaNgqongqoshe wezempilo (uNgqongqoshe) uma kuqhathaniswa neminyango ezingeni likazwelonke, esifundazweni, nasemaphandleni. Lesi sahluko siphinde sihlose ukuvuselela uNgqongqoshe ukuba aphumeze imithetho ehambelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezempilo okukhululekile ezigabeni ezithile zabantu. Isahluko sesibili siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nelungelo nemithwalo yemfanelo yalabo abasebenzisa izinhlelo zezempilo. Amalungelo abasebenzisi mayelana nolwazi ngezinsizakalo zezempilo, izinsizakalo zokwelashwa eziphuthumayo, kanye nokubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni mayelana nezempilo zabo nokwelashwa kwabo ayavunywa, njengoba nelungelo lomsebenzisi lokuhlinzekwa ngolwazi oluhambelana nezempilo zabo nokwelashwa kwabo. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekukhishweni kwemibiko yokuthi umuntu uphume ohlelweni lokwelashwa kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwemvume enolwazi. Kukhona imithetho ebhekisela ekulawuleni ukwelashwa ngenhloso yokucwaninga kanye nokugcina amarekhodi ezikhungo zezempilo. Lesi sahluko siphinde sibheke ukwethulwa kwezikhalazo ngabantu abasebenzisi nabanye mayelana nezikhungo zezempilo kanye nezilindelo zabantu abasebenzisi mayelana nezempilo zabo, ukusetshenziswa kwabo kwezikhungo zezempilo, kanye nobudlelwano babo nabahlinzeki bezempilo. Isahluko sesithathu siqukethe imithetho ehambelana noMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke. Kubhekiswe ekusunguleni iNhlangano Yezempilo Kazwelonke lapho uNgqongqoshe azobambisana khona namalungu eNhlangano Yezempilo Kazwelonke (okuhlanganisa oNgqongqoshe bezifundazwe), ikomidi lezakhamizi elimele uhulumeni bendawo, umphathi woMnyango Wezempilo kuMnyango Wezempilo Wamasosha aseNingizimu Afrika (SAMHS), kanye nezinye iziphathimandla eminyangweni yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke nasemazweni. Lesi sahluko sichaza imisebenzi namandla eNhlangano Yezempilo Kazwelonke, okuyi-ukwazisa uNgqongqoshe. Lesi sahluko siphinde sisungule iKomidi Lokweluleka Lezempilo Kazwelonke. Amalungu ale komidi angabaphathi beminyango yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke nasemazweni, umphathi woMnyango Wezempilo kuMnyango Wezempilo Wamasosha aseNingizimu Afrika (SAMHS), kanye nezimele zikamasipala. Lesi sahluko siphinde sikhuthaze uMphakathi Jikelele woMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke ukuba athuthukise izinqubomgomo zezempilo kazwelonke. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekusunguleni iKomidi Lokubonisana Ngempilo Kazwelonke ezosebenza ukuze kuhlanganiswe imikhakha ehlukene yezempilo ezingeni likazwelonke. Isahluko sesine siqukethe imithetho ehambelana neMinyango YezeMpilo Yezifundazwe. Lesi sahluko s placing an obligation on these departments to operate in accordance with the national health policy under specific conditions. It addresses the establishment of health councils in provinces whose operations will mirror those of the National Council, but will be conducted at the provincial level. Provincial Health Advisory Committees will be established, which will perform similar functions to those of the National Council, but will be conducted at the provincial level. This chapter also authorizes the development of health strategies in provinces to be presented to the Director-General. It also addresses the requirement for provincial ministers to establish Provincial Health Consultation Forums to share information and connect on health-related issues with various stakeholders. Isahluko sesihlanu sisungula uhlelo lwezempilo ezindaweni ezithile eRiphabhulikhi, okwenziwa ngokulandela izimiso ezithile. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekwakhiweni kwezindawo zezempilo, okwenziwa ngokubheka imingcele ebekwe ezindaweni zamamunicipal kanye nokuhlanganiswa nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo. Ikhuluma ngokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo zamamunicipal futhi ivumela ukwethulwa nokuhlelwa kwezinhlelo zezempilo zezakhamuzi. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ezinhlelweni zesikhashana ezihambelana nezinsizakalo zezempilo zamamunicipal. Isahluko sesithupha siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nezikhungo zezempilo. Le mithetho ilawula ukuhlukaniswa ngokuhlukana, ukusungulwa, nokusebenza kwezikhungo zezempilo futhi ifaka imithetho elawula izitifiketi zokudinga. Ngokusho kwalesi sahluko, akekho ongakha, akhe, aguqule, noma athole isikhungo sezempilo noma ihhovisi lezempilo ngaphandle kwesitifiketi sokudinga. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekufezeni izidingo, izimvume, nezixazululo mayelana nokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe ngezitifiketi zokudinga, kanye nezimo ezithile ezihambelana nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezikhungweni zikahulumeni, okunika uNgqongqoshe amandla okwenza izinqumo ngalezo zimo. Kuphinde kubhekiswe ekukhetheni kwamabhodi ezibhedlela nguNgqongqoshe kanye noNgqongqoshe bezifundazwe (amaMEC). Ukwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezikhungweni ezingezona ezempilo, njengemikhakha yezemfundo nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi, kuyakhuluma kulesi sahluko. UNgqongqoshe unikezwa amandla okwenza izinqumo mayelana nokwelashwa kwabathandazeli bamasiko nabanye abezinhloso zamasiko nokwenzeka ezindaweni zamasiko zokukhulisa abafana. Imithetho elawula ubudlelwano phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni nezizimele ifakiwe kulesi sahluko. Izikhungo ezizimele zinesibopho sokuthola umshwalense ukuze zivikele abasebenzisi ekulimazeni okungenzeka. Isahluko sesixhenxe siqukethe imithetho ehambelana nokuhlelwa kwezinsiza zabantu kanye nezikhungo zezempilo ezihlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa kwezisebenzi zezempilo. Kukhona imithwalo eminingi ebekwe kwiNhlangano Yezempilo Kazwelonke mayelana nokuhlinzeka nokuhlela izinsiza zabantu, futhi kukhona imithetho ebhekisela ekusunguleni izindlela ezifanele zokw
Kuphethwe, ingxenye ebizwa nge-octane iyadingeka ukuvikela injini ekuphazamisekeni noma ekukhulumeni. Ukuqhamuka kokuphazamiseka kwenjini kwenzeka lapho kukhona ukushiswa okungalawulwa kokuhlanganiswa komoya ne-fuel esilindeni, okungalimaza injini. Ingxenye ye-octane etholakala ezimotweni iyisilinganiso esivimbela injini ekuphazamisekeni - uma ibanga le-octane liphakeme, amathuba okuthi i-fuel ibangele ukuphazamiseka ancipha. Ukwengeza izixazululo ze-lead ku-petrol bekuyindlela ejwayelekile yokuthuthukisa amabanga e-octane. I-lead yayisetshenziswa kabanzi njengokungezelela ku-petrol kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1920. Nokho, i-petrol ayizange isetshenziswe ezimotweni ezihlanganiswe ne-catalytic converter ukuze kuncishiswe ukukhishwa, ngoba i-lead isheshisa ukuvimbela lezi zengezo. Lokhu, kanye nokutholakala kokuthi ukukhishwa kwe-lead kungalimaza impilo yomuntu, kuholele ekutheni kuncishiswe kancane, kuqala eNyakatho Melika, kulandela iYurophu, bese kusakazeka kwezinye izizwe emhlabeni. Kusukela nini i-petrol enelead izobe ingatholakali eNingizimu Afrika? Uhulumeni ubeke ukuthi kuzoba nezinhlobo ezintathu ze-petrol ezine-octane rating ngaphandle kwe-lead (ULP) ezizovunyelwa eNingizimu Afrika (ezindaweni ezisemanzini nasezindaweni ezisemakhaya) ngemuva kosuku lukaJanuwari 1, 2006, ezingu-91, 93, kanye ne-95 Research Octane Number (RON). Ukucelwa kwalezi zinhlobo kuzokhombisa ukuthi iyiphi efunwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe. Abanikazi bezimoto kufanele balindele ukuthi ngeke bathole zonke izinhlobo yonke indawo, kodwa bangalindela ukuthola uhlobo oluhambelana noma olufanele ezimotweni zabo noma kuphi abahamba khona eNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izimboni zokucubungula uphethiloli eNingizimu Afrika zifake imali noma zifaka imali kumishini noma ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze zikhiqize izengezo ze-octane ngempumelelo. I-octane additive ibaluleke kakhulu kunomkhiqizo okhiqizwa yizimboni zokucubungula zendawo, ezizothenga izingxenye zokuhlanganisa eziphezulu ze-octane noma i-petrol ye-octane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi icelwa kwenziwa. Iziphi izindleko ezizobekwa ezinhlelweni ezahlukene ze-petrol? Izindleko ezilawulwa zizobekwa kusetshenziswa indlela efanayo naleyo esebenzayo njengamanje. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izindleko zezinhlobo ezikhona ezingenalead (95 octane emanzini kanye ne-93 emakhaya) zizohlala njengoba zikhona. Izindleko zezinhlobo ezinelead zizoba ezifana nezindleko ze-petrol ezingenalead ezine-octane efanayo. Ezindaweni ezisemakhaya lapho uhlobo lwe-95 olungenalead luzoqala ukutholakala, kuzokwenziwa imali noma "intela yokucelwa," ezokwenza ukuthi intengo ikhuphuke phakathi kwayo ne-93, iqala ngophawu lwe-10 cents nge-litre. Isizathu salokhu ukuthi izimoto eziningi ezisemakhaya zaneliseka nge-fuel ye-93 octane, okuyiyo ephezulu etholakalayo, empeleni, iyona kuphela etholakalayo. I-fuel ye-95 octane izotholakala emakhaya ukuze ihlangabezane nezimoto zobuchwepheshe besimanje ezethulwe embonini yezimoto. Ngoba abanikazi bezimoto bazokwazi ukukhetha phakathi kwezinhlobo ukuvimbela ukusetshenziswa kabi kwe-octane additives, kulindeleke ukuthi labo abadinga i-95 octane bayisebenzise - intela ekhokhwayo emakhaya ihloselwe ukukhuthaza abanikazi bezimoto ukuthi bacabange ngezinketho zabo. Emhlabeni, lapho i-fuel ye-octane ephezulu noma eyengeziwe ivame ukufunwa (ngokuvamile eduze nolwandle kukhombisa ukucelwa okuphezulu kwe-octane ezimotweni), i-95 octane unleaded iyona kuphela etholakalayo, futhi ngeke kube nenye intela kulolu hlobo. Ngizokwazi kanjani ukuthi iyiphi i-petrol efanele imoto yami? Kuzokwenziwa idatha yolwazi ukuze kuboniswe cishe zonke izinhlobo ezitholakalayo ezindaweni zethu. Lokhu kuzotholakala yonke indawo, kuhlanganise nedatha yolwazi yeNational Association of Automotive Manufacturers (NAAMSA - www.naamsa.co.za) kanye neSouth African Petroleum Industry Association (SAPIA - www.sapia.co.za). Kulolu dbhasi, uhlobo lwe-fuel efanele izindawo ezisemanzini nasezindaweni ezisemakhaya luzokhombiswa ngokwehlukana (ukuze umkhiqizi asebenze kahle) nokuthi yiziphi ezinye izinhlobo ezingahambisana (lezo ezingakwenza imoto ihambe kahle ngaphandle kokulimaza injini, nakuba ingase ingasebenzi ngempumelelo ephelele kwezinye izimoto). Abanikazi bezimoto bangakhetha ukusebenzisa noma iyiphi uhlobo olukhombiswe njengokunconywa noma olufanele imoto yabo. Abanikazi bezimoto kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi isitayela sabo sokushayela singathinta ukuthi iyiphi i-octane additive abayithola ihlangabezana kangcono nezidingo zabo. Kuzoba nomhlahlandlela okhombisa ama-fuel afanele ukusetshenziswa kulolu dbhasi nolwakho emastations aphethiloli. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimoto zidinga izengezo ezahlukene ze-octane. Ukusebenzisa i-petrol enebanga le-octane eliphezulu kunalokho imoto yakho edinga akudingekile futhi kuyinkohlakalo yemali, ikakhulukazi ngoba akuthuthukisi ukusebenza kwenjini. Ukusebenzisa i-petrol enebanga le-octane eliphansi kunalokho imoto yakho edinga kunciphisa ukusebenza kwenjini, okungaholela ekuphazamisekeni noma ekulimazeni ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi isidingo se-octane semoto ethile sincike kwezinye izinto, kuhlanganise nokusetshenziswa nendlela yokushayela, izidingo ze-octane zemoto ethwele umthwalo omkhulu, ukuphakama okuphezulu, nezimo zezulu. Kungani kumele ngingasebenzisi ibanga le-octane eliphezulu kunalokho imoto yami edinga? I-petrol enebanga le-octane eliphezulu idinga ukucutshungulwa okuningi futhi isebenzisa amandla amaningi lapho ikhiqizwa. Uma la mandla engasetshenziswa kahle noma engasetshenziswa kahle yimoto yakho, kusho ukuthi amandla ayengeziwe abekwe phansi ayaphuma noma alahleka. Le nkohlakalo iholela ekukhishweni kwe-hydrocarbons ezingashiswa noma i-carbon dioxide, okulimaza imvelo yethu. Ukusebenzisa uhlobo lwe-octane additive oluphakeme kunalokho imoto yakho edinga kuzokwenza noma kuhlasele umnikazi kakhulu, futhi kunomthelela omubi emvelweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngeke kube nezinzuzo ekusebenzeni noma ekushayeleni. Ingabe i-petrol engenalead ifanele ama-motorcycles, ama-lawnmowers, kanye nezinjini zemikhumbi? I-petrol engenalead ivamise ukufaneleka kuma-motorcycles, ama-lawnmowers, kanye nezinjini zemikhumbi ngaphandle kwezinye ezincane ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obudala. Hlola noma ubuze umthengisi wemishini uma unemibuzo. Ingabe izimoto ezidala nezimodeli ezindala zingasebenzisa i-petrol engenalead? Ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga, lezi zimoto kufanele zisebenzise i-petrol enelead, nakuba ezinye zingasebenzisa i-petrol engenalead. Uma ufuna ukusebenzisa i-petrol engenalead, xhumana nomkhiqizi wale moto. Uma ngisebenzisa i-petrol engenalead, ingabe ipayipi lokuphuma kwemoto yami lizoshintsha libe mhlophe njengoba kwenzeka lapho ngisebenzisa i-petrol enelead? Cha, lokhu akukhombisi ukwehla kokusebenza kwenjini. Ipheya elisha liba mhlophe uma use
Umgwaqo ohlanganisa indlu onezicabha ezivaliwe ungcono kunodonga oluphakeme ngoba umgwaqo uyabonakala. Uthango lokusika, uthango olunemibambo, amaqanda amancane noma ama-bell angaxhunywa emgwaqweni ukuze akhumbuze ngokushesha uma kukhona umphangi. Khumbula ukuthi izicabha kufanele zihlale zivaliwe. Iziphuzo zokuphepha ezingeni ngalinye kufanele zibe nezivalo eziqinile phambi kwesicabha ngasinye kanye nasezindongeni, nezinsiza zokuvikela ukuhlinzekwa. Iziphuzo zokuphepha kufanele zihlale zivaliwe. Isiphuzo sokuphepha ngaphakathi kwendlu esihlukanisa indawo yokulala nezinye izingxenye zendlu singasiza kakhulu uma kukhona abahlaseli endlini. Kungcono futhi uma indlela yokuxhumana yokuphuthumayo ingafakwa kule ngxenye yendlu. Izikhali kufanele zihlale zifinyeleleka kalula futhi, uma kungenzeka, zigcinwe kumuntu. Qiniseka ukuthi izikhali zihlale zigcinwa kahle futhi ukuthi umuntu ozisebenzisayo uqeqeshiwe. Umsindo wesixwayiso ophakanyiswe phezu kwendlu onendawo lapho ungafakwa khona ngaphakathi kwendlu ungatholakala kude uma ezinye izindlela zokuxhumana zifanele ziphume. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinto zihlale zihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zingatholakala noma ngabe umuntu ukude nendlu. Izinja nezinkunzi ziyasiza kakhulu ekwaziseni uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Lezi zinyoni kufanele zigcinwe eduze kwendlu ukuze izivakashi ezingaziwa zingakwazi ukufinyelela kalula. Abantu abangaziwa endaweni, bephuma nokungena, bangase bangabonakali kulokho abakwenza. Izimoto ezingaziwa ezihamba emgwaqweni wepulazi kwesinye isikhathi zihlala endaweni. Qaphela ngezinyawo ongazazi. Izinguquko endleleni umqashi enza ngayo izinto. Ukuthenga noma ukusebenzisa ukudla ngokweqile ngasohlangothini lwemisebenzi. Izinguquko emikhubeni yabasebenzi abadala ngemva kokuqashwa emsebenzini omusha. Ukufa kwenja yokuvikela ngendlela engacacile. Hlale uqaphele ngezimpawu zabantu abangaziwa entering endaweni, njengezimbiza noma amaqanda amancane, izikhwama zezigareti, amaphepha, izingubo eziphukile, izinyathelo noma izicathulo, indawo esanda kuphazamiseka, izikhwama zokudla, nezinye izinto ezitholakalayo. Ukuhlukunyezwa kokudla, uphethiloli, izinkomo, nezilwane. Abantu abangaziwa befika endaweni yakho bephakamisa izizathu ezizwakalayo kodwa bangase babe nezinhlelo ezimbi. Sebenzisa amalungelo akho njengomnikazi wepulazi. Abantu abangaziwa entering epulazini noma uvakashela abasebenzi kufanele kuqala bathole imvume yakho. Xhumana namaphoyisa endawo ukuze uthole ukuthi yini oyivunyelwe ukwenza ngokomthetho nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani lokho epulazini lakho. Yakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi bakho. Gcina amakhophi wezikhwama zabasebenzi bonke. Khuthaza bonke abasebenzi ukuba bahlale beqaphele ngezokuphepha futhi babike noma yisiphi isenzo esingajwayelekile. Khokha abasebenzi bakho ngazo zonke izifiso zabo futhi ubazise. Ungavumeli muntu ukuthi engena emapulazini akho noma epulazini ngaphandle kokubona kahle ukuthi bangobani, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. Zonke amathuluzi angasetshenziswa njengezikhali kufanele zihlale zivaliwe uma engasetshenziswa. Uma uhambe endlini, yenza kube umkhuba ukwazisa umndeni wakho ukuthi uyaphi, indlela ozoyithatha, nokuthi uzobuyela nini. Hlale uhlole njalo ukuthi ifoni yakho iyasebenza. Beka ifoni endaweni elula ukufinyelela kuyo endlini, futhi kude nezindawo ezingabhekwa kalula noma amawindi. Qaphela ngezikhwama ukuze zingasikhiwe. Hlale ugcina umoya eduze futhi uma uyisebenzisa, ungavezi ukuthi uphi noma ukuthi utholakala kuphi. Qaphela ukuthi uphethiloli nezimpahla zingaba yizigebengu. Ungahlali wenza izinto ngendlela efanayo nsuku zonke. Thuthukisa umkhuba wokungaphumuli endaweni ebonakalayo kumuntu ophumayo. Ungavumi ukuhlala eduze kwamawindi uma uvula noma uvala amajazi. Hambisa neja ukuze ungabonakali kalula ngaphandle. Thatha izithombe nezinyathelo zabasebenzi bonke. Noma ungakwazi ukwenza noma yini, kungaba yingozi. Ukujolisa okwenziwayo kwezokuphepha epulazini (endaweni ephephile) futhi kusiza ukuvusa nokuvikela izinsongo ezingase zibe khona. Fundisa izingane zakho indlela efanele yokuphendula uma kudingeka usizo nokugwema ukukhuluma nabantu abangaziwa noma ukuthola izipho kubantu abangaziwa. Cabanga - ungaphuthelwa. Ukungabonakali kahle kuyindlela yakho yokuqala yokuvikela. Bheka isimo - ingabe kukhona umuntu oseduze? Khala kakhulu? Uyalelwa ukuthi ungabhekani nomhlaseli ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi ungaphuma kulolo suku. Uma ubhekana ngaphandle kokucabanga, ungase uboshwe. Phula umhlaseli. Sebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela kuze kube yilapho ungathola usizo noma uphume. Uma ungakwazi ukubhekana, qaphela izimpawu zokukhomba. Qaphela iminyaka yabo, ukuphakama, umbala wezinwele, izibazi, izingubo, ukukhuluma, nezindlela. Zama ukushiya ubufakazi obuningi ngangokunokwenzeka mayelana nendawo okwenzeka kuyo. Izinyathelo, izinyathelo, nezinto ezithile ezingasiza ukukukhomba kamuva. Abantu abahlukunyezwe baphume ngempumelelo ngokuxhumana kahle nabahlaseli babo (ukukhuluma).
Isimo ngalesi sikhathi asikwazi ukusebenzisa isivumelwano sokwenqaba abantu amalungelo abo noma labo abafuna ukufinyelela emhlabeni. Abasebenzi nabantu abafuna ukufinyelela emhlabeni kufanele bakhombise ukuqonda isimo esibucayi samanje emapulazini futhi akufanele bazizwe bephoxekile ngokuziphatha ngendlela yokwesaba noma yokuphikisana, futhi akufanele baphakamisela imikhawulo ezicelweni zokuvuma ukufinyelela emapulazini ukuze bavakashele ngezizathu ezibalulekile noma ezisemthethweni. Sifuna ukubonga lezi zikhungo ezilandelayo ngempumelelo yazo nokusiza ekwenzeni leli documeti likhulu. Uma umsebenzi engakwazi ukuhlela isikhathi ngoba engakutholi ukuxhumana nomnikazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba, noma ngoba isicelo sokufinyelela siphikisiwe, kufanele axhumane nenhlangano yabafuyi noma i-union yezolimo yendawo noma i-SAPS ukuze athole usizo ngalolu daba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abantu abanamalungelo okuvakashela abantu emapulazini ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikela Ukusetshenziswa Komhlaba, ngokwesibonelo. Kuphela uma izivumelwano/zikhathi zenzelwe umnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba. Umvakashelayo kufanele asebenzise indlela eshiwo ngaphambili ukuya ezindlini zabasebenzi epulazini noma ezindaweni zokungcwaba zabokhokho babo. Kumele kube nesivumelwano esicacile ngesikhathi sokuvakasha. Umvakashelayo akufanele abambe iqhaza kunoma yiziphi ezinye izenzo ngaphandle kwalokho abavunyelwe. Lokhu kufaka phakathi abacwaningi, abahlanganyeli bezombusazwe, abahleli bezenzakalo, abasebenzi bezinkolo, njll. Abafuyi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi babo bayahlanganyela kulawa mhlangano futhi, lapho kungenzeka, banikeze ukuhamba kulawa madolobha. Ezimweni ezikhethekile lapho abantu kufanele bangavunyelwa ukufinyelela epulazini, kufanele kube kuphela ngemva kokuhlelwa kwangaphambili okucacile nezinqumo ezithathwe nomnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba, futhi kuncike ezimweni ezishiwo ngumnikazi wepulazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba. Ukubhekwa kwemibono yezenhlalakahle kanye nomphakathi wezolimo jikelele kufanele kube ukuvuselela ukuphepha esimweni esijwayelekile. Ngo-2002, Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha zamukela Isivumelwano Sokusebenza ngaphansi kwesimo sokuthi asizukuphazamiseka ngokuqondile emisebenzini yabo efanele. (Bheka inothi elingezansi). 1 Ngasikhathi sinye, Izinsizakalo Zokuphepha zizoba nesithakazelo ezinkathazweni zomphakathi wezolimo futhi zizolandela Isivumelwano Sokusebenza ngangokunokwenzeka. Abanikazi bomhlaba bazibophezela ekubambisaneni ngokuphelele nezikhungo zokuvikela ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Leqembu lifaka abahloli abavela emaphandleni ezeMpilo, Ezokuphatha, Ezomsebenzi, Ezolimo, njll. Kuphela uma izivumelwano/zikhathi zenzelwe umnikazi noma omunye umuntu ophatha umhlaba. Uma uthola ilungelo lokungena noma ukufinyelela emhlabeni noma ezindlini, bika ngokushesha kumnikazi noma kumuntu ophatha umhlaba. Umsebenzi okukhulunywa ngaye kufanele azichaze kahle, achaze uhlobo lomsebenzi wakhe, futhi aveze isikhathi asithanda ukuba khona kulowo mhlaba. Umsebenzi akufanele enze noma iyiphi imisebenzi noma izenzo abengenayo ilungelo lokwenza. a. Ukuphulwa komthetho ngabo bonke abantu - Ukuhlasela, ukubulala, ukuhlinzwa, ukulimaza okungamanga empahleni, noma noma yiziphi izizathu ezinjalo. Kuwo wonke amacala lapho ukufinyelela kuphikisiwe ngokuqinile emhlabeni oqashiweyo, amarekhodi kufanele agcinwe kahle ukuze kube nobufakazi. Ngo-2001, ngenxa yokukhathazeka nokwanda kweziqhumane emapulazini, kanye nenani elikhulu labantu ababulawa noma abalimala, i-Agri SA yenze isivumelwano sokusebenza sokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwabantu abahamba noma abahamba emhlabeni wepulazi. Ezinye zalezi ziqhumane zenzeka ngokudabukisayo ngabantu abenza sengathi bangamalungu ezinsizakalo zokuphepha futhi begqoke izikhwama. Isivumelwano Sokusebenza sakhulunywa neziMali Zokuphepha (i-SAPS ne-SANDF) kanye nezinsizakalo zabo zomthetho. Izichibiyelo ezithile zenziwa ngu-sheriff wamacala ngoMeyi, ozokwenza imiyalo yokukhishwa ezindaweni ezithile. Ezinye izimo lapho kukhona ulwazi oluningi olukhombisa ukuthi u-sheriff kanye nabasebenzi bakhe bangase babe sengozini yokulimala, ukufa, noma ukulimala kwemali, iSouth African Police Service izophatha umthetho futhi ikhiphe imiyalo, kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela. Abangena ngokungemthetho kufanele baboshwe ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka futhi baphakanyiswe phambi kwenkantolo. Umnikazi noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba kufanele afake isikhalazo esisemthethweni ngokushesha kwiSouth African Police Service. Uma kuvela ukuthi umsolwa uhlala kulowo mhlaba isikhathi eside, umnikazi kufanele axwayiswe ukuthi umngeni ongavunyelwe kufanele akhishwe ngomyalo wenkantolo. c. Lokhu umnikazi, umhlali onemvume, noma umuntu ophatha umhlaba akavumelanga; futhi d. Umngeni akanaso isizathu esisemthethweni sokungena emhlabeni, ngokwesibonelo. Uma iphoyisa ibikwe ngokuqhamuka komhlaba endaweni enkulu, kubalulekile ukuthi kwenziwe isenzo ngesikhathi esifushane kakhulu. Ukuhlasela emhlabeni kuvame ukuhlobana nokuhlala ngokungemthetho emhlabeni. Umnikazi angathola umyalo wokukhishwa ngokushesha ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlala Ngokungemthetho Emhlabeni (PIE). Abasebenzi abavulekile bangakhishwa kuphela ngomyalo wenkantolo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphathwa Komhlaba (isigaba 5 se-LTA). Lo myalo utholwa ngumuntu onikezayo ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo. Abahlali abavunyelwe bangakhishwa kuphela ngomyalo wenkantolo yedolobha noma yenkantolo ephakeme. b. Uthola umyalo wenkantolo uma umhlali engashiyi umhlaba ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe; futhi c. Futhi ukusetshenziswa komyalo wokukhishwa. Abahlali abavunyelwe bangakhishwa kuphela ngomyalo wenkantolo yedolobha noma yenkantolo ephakeme. Lo myalo utholwa ngumuntu onikezayo ngokufaka isicelo enkantolo. Kuyiphutha elibuhlungu ukwamukela ngqo noma ngokuqondile noma ukufuna ukukhokhwa kwanoma yimaphi imali noma noma yini ebhekwa njengokubuyiselwa noma ukuhlela noma ukuvumela umuntu ukuba ahlale emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi noma umuntu ophatha lowo mhlaba. Umhlali ongavunyelwe ungumuntu ophatha umhlaba ngaphandle kwemvume echazwe ngumuntu onikezayo ngokuqondile. Abahlali ngaphansi ko-ESTA abavunyelwe. Amalungelo abahlali abavunyelwe avikelwe nguMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlala Ngokungemthetho Nokuhlala Ngokungemthetho Emhlabeni, 1998. Le ngxenye yabahlali izoba ikakhulu laba abaziwa njenge "squatters" abahlala ezindaweni ngaphandle kwemvume. Umthetho we-PIE uthatha indawo yoMthetho Wokuvikela Ukuhlala Ngokungemthetho ka-1951. Umuntu ongenayo imvume yokungena ungumuntu ongena emhlabeni ngaphandle kwemvume yomnikazi, futhi amaphoyisa angamthumba. Uma umuntu ongene ngaphandle kwemvume "uhlala" emhlabeni womnikazi, kufanele abhekwane njengomhlali ongavunyelwe. Thina, njengabasebenzi boMnyango wezobuciko namasiko, sithole izinsiza ezahlukene zik government ezibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwethu ukuze sizibhekele. Ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, izinsiza zik government kumele zihlale zibhalwe; ngakho-ke, kumele sisebenzise imithetho yokuphatha futhi siqambe izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze sigweme ukulahleka okuhambisanayo. Enye yale mithetho yokuphatha wukusebenzisa imithetho yokuphepha efana nokuhlola zonke izinto zomuntu ezithwalwa ngesandla, izimoto, noma izinto ezithwalwayo. UMthetho Wokufinyelela Ezindaweni Zomphakathi kanye noMthetho Wezimoto, Inombolo 53 ka-1985, unika abasebenzi bezokuphepha amandla okwenza izenzo ezithile ngokuhambisana neSigaba 2 soMthetho Wezimoto ka-1985 (njengokwenza ukuhlola, ukuvimbela ukufika noma ukuhamba, njll.). [Ucelwa ukuthi uhlole izaziso ezikhangisiwe ezindaweni zethu]. Kuyiqiniso futhi ukuthi le ndlela yokuphepha ingaba nzima kubasebenzisi ukuba babe nesipiliyoni esihle. Van Rooyen uma kukhona okungacacile mayelana nemithetho yethu yokuphepha nezindlela.
Bazalwane, umnyango ubize umhlangano okhethekile ukuze kuxoxwe ngembiko mayelana nezinhlelo zamaworkshop ezabanjwa ngonyaka ka-2000 ezweni lonke. Lezi zinhlelo zamaworkshop zazihloselwe ukuhlola intuthuko yokuguqulwa kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi. Sihlole ngokucophelela wonke amadokhumenti akhishwe, sihlole izinkinga eziphakanyisiwe kanye nemibono ewusizo kanye nenhloso ehlelekile yokwakha indlela enhle nebalulekile. Okokuqala, sifuna ukubonga ngenhlonipho ngempela ngokuphendula ngokushesha nangokwethembeka mayelana nalezi zinhlelo zamaworkshop. Ukuhlola intuthuko eyenziwe mayelana nezinguquko, kubhekwa ubuhlakani bezicwangciso, izinhlelo, nezinqubo ezisetshenziswe ekubhaleni isiphakamiso sokuguqulwa, ukusetha imigomo ngokusekelwe ekuhloleni intuthuko noma ukuwohloka kwayo ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi amaworkshop aphumelele yini ekubandakanyeni nasekutholeni ukwesekwa ezindaweni ezahlukene zokuguqulwa, njengoba kuhlose izinqubomgomo nemithetho kahulumeni, kubonakala kuyinto ebalulekile emehlweni abasebenzi. Ukugxila ebudlelwaneni phakathi kwalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla zokuhola noma zokuphatha nalabo abasebenza ngaphansi kwabo, siqaphele ngenjabulo ukuthi amaworkshop abhekwa njengethuluzi eliwusizo kanye nepulatifomu yokuxoxa ngezinkinga ezihlobene noguquko ngamalungu wonke abasebenzi, okukhombisa nokuthi abasebenzi bayavuma ukuba yingxenye yenqubo futhi bazibophezele ekuguquleni uMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi, nakuba bekukhona abaphikisana noguquko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sijabule ukuthi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abaningi sebezokwazi ukujula izinjongo zama-workshop, njengokukhuluma ngezinkathazo ezikhona phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinkinga ezihlobene noguquko nezinselelo zedemokhrasi, ukuxoxisana nokukhuluma ngombono ophelele woguquko njengoba kuboniswe ezishintshweni zomthethosisekelo nakwezinye izinqubo. Umphumela wama-workshop obhekwa phezulu njengethuluzi eliwusizo ukhombisa ukuthi abasebenzi badinga leli thuba, indawo ephephile yokuxhumana kangcono nabanye babo ngokujula kokwehlukana kwabo, okuhlangenwe nakho, namasiko, hhayi nje njengabantu abathile abasebenza enhlanganweni eyodwa. Nokho, izinkinga ezihlobene nokungaboni ngasolinye noma ukungahloniphi umehluko wezamasiko zikhona futhi zidinga ukuxazululwa, futhi sizokwenza lokhu masisha. Kubonakala kucacile ukuthi kukhona ukuvumelana phakathi kwabasebenzi bonke mayelana nesidingo sokuguquka enhlanganweni yethu. Lo mphumela ubonisa izinto ezihlukene kubasebenzi abahlukene. Kubasebenzi abanye, isiko elikhona kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi alikaguquki ngokwanele ukuze babone izifiso zabo zokuba nohulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wedemokhrasi zifeziwe, ikakhulukazi endaweni yokusebenza. Izinga eliphakathi lokuphatha lisagcwele kakhulu ngabantu abamhlophe, kanti umsebenzi owengeziwe wenziwa abantu abamnyama. Nakuba kukhona izinqubomgomo ezikhona mayelana nokusebenza kwabantu ababephansi ngaphambili, amathuba abantu abamnyama ukuba aphakanyiswe ezikhundleni zokuphatha awabonakali, njengoba kuqokonyiswa phakathi kwama-workshop. Bonke abasebenzi bazizwa ukuthi umoya, noma ukuqeqeshwa kokuguquka, awukwazanga ukuhlinzekwa ngokubaluleka okudingekayo. Abanye abasebenzi abamhlophe baphinde bathi akukwanele ukuqeqeshwa ukuze bamukele uguquko njengomgomo, kodwa kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okubavumela ukuba basebenze njengabaphathi noma njengalabo abaguqukile ngempela. Ngaphansi kwezimo zokungaqondi izindlela zokuphatha kule nkathi entsha yokuguquka, kungenzeka ukuthi abaphathi babonwa njengabantu abaphikisana noguquko, ngenxa yokungazi ukuthi bangasebenza kanjani ngokwehlukile. Kukhona izinkomba ezinamandla phakathi kwabantu abamhlophe zokuthi uguquko yinqubo yokubambisana. Kubonakala sengathi abanye abasebenzi abamnyama bacabanga ukuthi abantu abamhlophe kuphela abadinga uguquko, hhayi bona. Abasebenzi abamhlophe bazizwa ukuthi abanye abasebenzi abamnyama abawuhloniphi umzamo wabo wokwenza izinto ngokwehlukile. Thina, emnyangweni, siqaphele le mizwa. Ngokuhlanganisa isakhiwo sokuphatha abasebenzi endaweni eyodwa, izinkinga nezinkathazo ezihlobene nenqubo yokuqasha engaphazamisi muntu zingaxazululwa kalula kakhulu kunakuqala lapha kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi. Umnyango usemsebenzini wokuphromotha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha zabaphathi abahlose, izinhlelo eziqeqesha ngoguquko nezizobhekana nezinkinga eziphakanyisiwe ngabantu abasebenzi. Indima yethu izoba ukuhlanganisa lezi zinhlelo zokuqeqesha. Sizophinde sixhumane nesakhiwo sokuqeqesha somnyango ukuze sithuthukise izikhala zokweluleka ezithembekile ezizohambisana nenqubo yokuqasha engaphazamisi muntu futhi ehlose labo ababephansi ngaphambili. Sizosebenzisa isu lokweluleka, elichazwe kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi, njengesisekelo sokwenza iziphakamiso. Siphinde saqaphela ukuthi izinkinga zokuguquka ezihlobene nezisebenzi zomphakathi kwezincwadi nezincwadi zathathwa ngababambiqhaza abaningi ema-workshop. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezindawo ezithile zokuguquka, njengokushintsha ekubhekaneni nokusebenza kwabasebenzi, ukuthengwa nokutholwa kwezimpahla, ukuhlela nokuchazwa kwayo, azizange zaphikiswa ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuthazwe yilabo abaphatha uhlelo. Abasebenzi abakhulumi ngama-suggestions mayelana nokuthi bangasheshisa kanjani uguquko oludingekayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Sifuna ukubona ama-workshop exoxa ngezinkinga ezihlobene ngqo nemisebenzi emisha nezinselelo zayo ezivela ku-guquko, lapho singachaza khona inqubo yedemokhrasi yokuphatha abantu, isiko elisha lokubheka, umsebenzi omuhle wokubambisana nokuvuselelwa, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo zomphakathi. Izinkinga zomsebenzi wobuchwepheshe azidingi ukubhekwa ngokufana nezinguquko ezihlobene nezisebenzi, futhi sicela abasebenzi baqonde ukuthi izinguquko ezindaweni zomsebenzi njengoba zirekhodiwe emthethweni zizokweseka isisekelo nemisebenzi yeMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi ngokugqamisa indlela ecacile nezinikela yokusebenza. Sizobhekana nalezi zinkinga njengengxenye yesu elisha lokwenza izinto nokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babambe iqhaza. Umnyango uqaphele ngenhlonipho nenjabulo ukuthi izinqubo eziningi nezicwangciso zokuguquka seziqalile ukusebenza kuMnyango weZizwe weZincwadi neZincwadi. Isibonelo salokhu kungaba ukufezwa kwenqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa nokusebenza kwabo ababephansi ngaphambili kanye nokuqashwa okungahlukanisi. Ngesikhathi sokukhetha umphathi weGuquko, kwavela isithombe sabasebenzi emnyangweni esinokukhombisa izinkomba zezinhlelo ezindala zokuhlukanisa. Imvume noma ilayisense ayinakudluliselwa futhi kumele ikhishwe uma iceliwe ngumsebenzi wezihlahla, isiphathimandla esihloniphekile, uphiko lwezepolitiki, noma umsebenzi ogunyaziwe. Imisebenzi ephathelene nokuzijabulisa, imfundo, isiko, noma ukufezekisa izinhloso zokomoya ingaqhutshelwa ezindaweni ezibekelwe (emamephini, ezindaweni ezichaziwe, ezindleleni ezibhalwe lapho ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe, nezinye izimpawu). Ukungena ezihlahleni zikamasipala kungavinjwa ngaphandle kokuchaza isizathu, futhi izicelo zokubhukha zingakhanselwa noma ziqedwe yiMnyango. Ukuqoqwa kokhuni akuvunyelwe ngaphandle kwezindawo ezibekelwe. Akekho onelungelo lokuphazamisa imisebenzi yabaphathi bezihlahla noma ezindaweni zikamasipala. Noma yimuphi umonakalo owenzeka emithonjeni yezihlahla noma kunoma iyiphi impahla kahulumeni ngenxa zenzo zomnikazi welayisense uzokhokhelwa yilo mnikazi welayisense. Ukusiza uhlelo lokuzinza nokuthuthukiswa kwabafuyi. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokubambisana zabafuyi nokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ukuthuthukisa nokugcina ukuphepha kokudla ezingeni likazwelonke nokusiza ukwesekwa kokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yasemakhaya. Ukusiza ekuhloleni izingozi nezimo zokuphahlazeka kwezolimo. Ukukhuthaza ukusungulwa, ukubhaliswa, nokwaziswa kwezinhlelo zokubambisana kwezolimo (Lo msebenzi uzodluliselwa kuMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni). Ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zebhizinisi lezolimo ezikhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza okufanele nokwabiwa okufanele kwezinsiza nokukhula kwebhizinisi. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezinhlelo zomnotho nokunikeza izeluleko mayelana nemikhiqizo yezolimo, izinsiza, nezisebenzi zomkhakha othintekayo. Ukusungula nokuphatha uhlelo lwezibalo lwezomhlaba. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukuhweba, ukulima izilwane, nokuphathwa kwezilwane. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo nokulawulwa kwezinsongo. Ukusetshenziswa kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezilimo ezisimeme, nokuthuthukisa imigomo nezindinganiso zokusetshenziswa kahle komhlaba namanzi, nokuvikela umhlaba. Ukunciphisa izinga lezingcuphe kwezolimo, imikhiqizo yezolimo, nezinye izindawo ezilawulwa. Ukunciphisa izinga lezingcuphe ezidalwa yizinsongo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho elawula umkhakha wezolimo nokuhlola izimo zezingcuphe emikhiqizweni yezolimo. Ukusiza, ukuhlela, nokweseka ubudlelwano bamazwe ngamazwe kwezolimo eNingizimu Afrika kugxile ekuthengiseni, ukwabelana ngetekhnoloji/izeluleko, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nezombusazwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela yokuqeqesha nokufundisa kwezolimo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza zabantu emkhakheni. Ukusiza ekusunguleni nasekusebenziseni uhlelo lokuhlela, lokubheka, nokuhlola ukusebenza kwenhlangano nokubona ukuthi iyafeza yini imigomo yayo. Ukukhuthaza umkhakha wezolimo onamandla okudala ingcebo ngokukhiqiza izinkunzi nezinkomo e-RSA. Ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu; intuthuko yenhlangano nokuqeqeshwa okusebenzayo kwangaphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo yezomthetho. Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluxhasa amaqembu kanye nohlelo oluphatha imibhalo. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphatha nokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Ukuhlinzeka nge-NGO yezezimali. Okukhuluma lapha akuhlosile ukuba kube umhlahlandlela ophelele ngezincwadi zokugcina nezokuhlala. Incwadi yokugcina iyidokhumenti ekhethekile esincoma ukuthi ibhalwe ngumuntu onolwazi njengomthetho, inkampani eyasungulwa ukuphatha izindlu, noma abanye. Le mininingwane ihloselwe ukwazisa umfundi ngemininingwane ethile ye incwadi yokugcina. Bonke abantu abaneminyaka engu-16 noma ngaphezulu, ngaphandle kokuthi ngesikhathi sokwenza incwadi yokugcina babe nesimo sokungakwazi, bangakha incwadi yokugcina. (Umuntu owenza incwadi yokugcina ubizwa nge-testator uma engumfana noma i-testatrix uma engumfazi). Bonke abantu abaneminyaka engu-14 noma ngaphezulu, abababonile incwadi yokugcina, kufanele bakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo. Kusukela ngoJanuwari 1, 1954, incwadi yokugcina kufanele ibe ebhalwe. Ingabhalwa ngesandla, ibhalwe ngekhompyutha, noma ikhiqizwe ngekhompyutha. I-testator kufanele imsign incwadi yokugcina ekugcineni noma ekupheleni kwayo. Uma incwadi yokugcina inamakhasi amaningi, i-testator kufanele imsign ikhasi ngalinye ngaphandle kwekhasi lokugcina (Noma i-testator kufanele imsign wonke amakhasi ababonile, kufanele futhi imsign ikhasi lokugcina futhi imsign ekupheleni kwedokhumenti). Umphakathi wenkantolo kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi uyaneliseka ngubani i-testator futhi ukuthi incwadi yokugcina imsignwe ngu-testator wabo. Umphakathi wenkantolo kufanele imsign isiqinisekiso kanye nekhasi ngalinye le incwadi yokugcina. Umphakathi wenkantolo kufanele ube khona lapho incwadi yokugcina imsignwa futhi kufanele enze isiqinisekiso sakhe ngokushesha ngemva kokuba incwadi yokugcina imsignwe noma ngabe i-testator ifa ngokushesha ngemva kokusayinwa. I-addendum noma isixhumanisi se incwadi yokugcina esivele sikhona, esihloselwe ukwengeza noma ukulungisa incwadi yokugcina, kufanele sihlangabezane nazo zonke izidingo ze incwadi yokugcina. I-addendum ayidingi ukusayinwa ngababoni ababesayine incwadi yokugcina yokuqala. Izinguquko ku incwadi yokugcina zingaqalwa ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwayo noma ngemva kokwenziwa kwayo. Izinguquko ku incwadi yokugcina kufanele zihlangabezane nezidingo zokwenza incwadi yokugcina futhi uma ungakwazi ukusayinwa, kufanele futhi zihlangabezane nezidingo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalolo hlobo. Ngesikhathi sokulungisa incwadi yokugcina, akudingeki ukuthi ababonile ababesayine incwadi yakho yokugcina yokuqala basayine izinguquko. Iphakheji noma isipho esinikezwe kumkakho encwadini yakho yokugcina, esenziwe ngaphambi kokuphulwa komshado wakho, sizokuqhubeka njengaleso ngisho nangemva kokuhlukaniswa. Umthetho ophathelene nezincwadi zokugcina uthi ngaphandle kokuthi ucacise okunye ebhalwe phansi, isipho esinikezwe kumkakho ophumelele kuzobhekwa njengokukhanselwa uma ufela ezinyangeni ezintathu kusukela ngosuku lokuhlukaniswa. Le mfuneko yomthetho inikeza umuntu ohlukanisiwe izinyanga ezintathu zokulungisa incwadi yakhe yokugcina ngemva kokuhlukana. Nokho, uma ungakwenzi lokhu, umkakho ohlukanisiwe uzothola leso sipho njengoba kuchaziwe encwadini yokugcina. Umuntu noma umyeni noma unkosikazi obhala incwadi yokugcina noma ingxenye yayo ubhala nge-testator. Umuntu noma umyeni noma unkosikazi obonile incwadi yokugcina uyakwenza lokho egameni le-testator noma njengom witness. Xhumana nommeli wakho ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi.
b Thuthukisa ukuvikelwa nokufinyelela ekuqinisekiseni ubulili obulinganayo; futhi c ukuqapha, ukuhlola nokuhlonza ukuhlonishwa kokulingana kobulili namalungelo abesifazane lapha eRiphabhulikhi. I-Sekretariyethi ibandakanyeka nasezinhlelweni ezahlukene zomnyango futhi iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu, uNkk. Chana Majake. Imiphumela ebhaliwe mayelana nezindaba ibibe yisihloko sokuhlola nokuphenya. Amadokhumenti okukhala aqediwe ahlobene nezinsongo ezahlukene eziphathelene nokucwaswa ngokobulili. Umfakisicelo kumele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe ku-Government Gazette [Isaziso soMnyango inombolo R187- edlulelwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuFebhuwari 2002] (ifomu A). Umfakisicelo kumele futhi akhombise ukuthi uyacela yini ikhophi yedokhumenti noma ufuna ukuyibona mathupha ehhovisi leKomishini. Uma umuntu ecela ukuthi akhombiswe amadokhumenti ngendlela ethile, kumele akhombiswe ngendlela ayicelile. Ngaphandle kokuthi ukwenza kanjalo kuzophazamisa ngokungadingekile ukusebenza kwaleyo miphakathi yomphakathi noma kudale umonakalo kudokhumenti, noma kuphule ilungelo ledokhumenti elingelona idokhumenti yomphakathi. Uma ngenxa yezizathu ezithile idokhumenti ingakhombiswa ngendlela eceliwe, ingakhombiswa ngenye indlela, futhi imali ekhokhwayo kumele ibalwe ngokwesimo lapho idokhumenti izokhombiswa. Uma umfakisicelo ecela ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, kumele akhombise isikhundla lapho isicelo senziwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 182f. Uma umfakisicelo engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma engasebenzi kahle, angafaka isicelo ngomlomo. Umfakisicelo ocela idokhumenti equkethe ulwazi lwakhe siqu akadingi ukukhokha imali. Umphathi wolwazi kumele azise umfakisicelo (ngaphandle kwalowo ocela ulwazi lwakhe) ngokuthumela isaziso sokuthi kumele akhokhe imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo siqhubeke. Imali yesicelo ekhokhwayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi ingama-R35. Umfakisicelo angafaka ukukhala ngaphakathi, uma kudingeka, noma afake icala enkantolo uma ephikisa ukukhokha imali yesicelo. Ngemuva kokuthi umphathi wolwazi enze isinqumo mayelana naleso sicelo, umfakisicelo kumele aziswe ngaleso sinqumo ngendlela ayicelile ukuba aziswe. Uma isicelo samukelwa, imali eyengeziwe yokufuna, yokuhlela, noma yokuphinda ikhokhiswa, kanye nesikhathi esichithwa sokuqhubeka nedokhumenti kumele ikhokhwe uma sidlula isikhathi esichaziwe sokufuna nokuhlela amadokhumenti okufanele akhishwe. Usizo lweKomishini luwumsebenzi phakathi kwezinhlelo noma iminyango eyenziwa yiKomishini ukuze igcwalise umthwalo wayo. Kungase kube nezinye izinhlelo ezihlukene ezihlanganisiwe ngaphansi kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ezichaza umsebenzi weKomishini: isibonelo, uMnyango Wezobulungiswa, Ucwaningo, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola, Imfundo Yomphakathi, nolwazi. Izinhlelo eziphakathi kweUcwaningo, ukuqapha, nokuhlola zingaba yisisekelo solwazi. Umthetho weKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili inombolo 39 ka-1996 yinto esungula umsebenzi weKomishini okungukuthi ukuvikela, ukukhuthaza, nokuthuthukisa ukuvumelana kobulili nokuthuthukisa isimo sabesifazane kuhulumeni, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, ebhizinisini, nasemkhakheni ongezansi. Ukuqapha nokuhlola noma yisiphi Isinqumo sePhalamende noma noma yimuphi omunye umthetho noma isivumelwano sokuhlola izikhalazo ezivela noma ngemuva kokuthola isikhalazo bese kuzama ukuxazulula noma yisiphi isimo noma ukulungisa isenzo noma ukwehluleka ukwenza okuthile. Izinqubomgomo zokuhlola nokuhlola, izinhlelo zokusebenza zikahulumeni, abamele uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nomkhakha ongezansi. Ukuze uthole usizo kwiKomishini, isicelo kumele senziwe sithunyelwe kumphathi omkhulu weKomishini usebenzisa ulwazi olunikeziwe ku-B ngenhla. Amakhomidi ngokuya ngesigaba -5 - seMthetho weKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili mayelana nalabo okufanele baphakanyiswe kulawo makhomidi. Izinhlelo zokuzithandela kanye nomsebenzi wesikhashana - kunenqubomgomo yokusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze kuqashwe abantu bendawo ukuze bagcwalise lezi zikhala. Abacwaningi besikhashana - kunenqubomgomo mayelana nokuphakanyiswa kwabacwaningi. IKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili nezinye izikhungo ezisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesahluko sesishiyagalolunye (seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho inombolo 108 ka-1996) azinayo inqubo yangaphakathi yokudlulisa izikhalazo njengamanye amahhovisi omphakathi. Umuntu onenkinga kumele asondele enkantolo uma kukhona isikhalazo mayelana nokungahambisani nomthetho yiKomishini. IKomishini izobuyekeza le dokhumenti ngokuya ngesigaba 14, phakathi nesikhathi esingadluli unyaka owodwa. Ukumelwa ngolimi ezintathu olukhuluma kule ndawo yokugcina idokhumenti okukhulunywa ngayo kuMthetho Wokugcina Amadokhumenti ka-1997; zonke izikhungo zeKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili kanye neKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu.
Mayelana neMining Qualifications Authority (MQA), iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu (CEO). Umphathi wolwazi anganikeza amandla noma imisebenzi ebekwe kuMphathi Wolwazi ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi kumphathi oPhakathi. U-CEO kumele aqashe umuntu ukuba abe nguMphathi oPhakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-MQA iyatholakala kulabo abafuna ukufaka izicelo zolwazi olutholakalayo kulabo abafuna amarekhodi. Umphathi Wolwazi nguye ongakwazi ukuhola nokubheka uMphathi oPhakathi we-MQA. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi aqukethe ulwazi ngabo, imibono, nemibono yomunye umuntu mayelana nesipho, ithokheni, noma umklomelo onikezwe lowo muntu lapho imibono noma imibono yomunye umuntu ivela; kanye negama lalo muntu uma livela kanye nolwazi lwabo noma luhambisana nalowo muntu noma lapho ukuvezwa kwegama kungaveza ulwazi ngomuntu osefile isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka engama-20. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi ku-MQA. Noma ubani (kuhlanganise noma kungagcini lapho), uhulumeni wangaphandle, inhlangano yomhlaba wonke ngaphandle komfaki-sicelo, futhi futhi ngenhloso yesigaba 34 salolu shintsho, uma kukhulunywa ngencazelo ethi "umuntu" ezigabeni (a) kanye (b) kufanele ihunyushwe njengokukhuluma ngempela "umuntu ophilayo." IKomidi Lokukhuthaza Amalungelo Abantu elikhulunywa ngesigaba 181 (b) seMthethosisekelo. Mayelana ne-MQA, irekhodi libhekisela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olurekhodiwe noma kunoma iyiphi ifomu elingaphansi kokuphathwa noma elilawulwa yisikhungo somphakathi noma elibanjwe yilolo sikhungo somphakathi. Libhekisela kunoma yiluphi usuku ngaphandle kosuku lwesonto, uMsombuluko, nezinsuku zomphakathi, njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 seMthethosisekelo Wezinsuku Zomphakathi ka-1994 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1994). Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi (PAIA), Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000 (lapha okuzobizwa ngokuthi Umthetho) waqala ukusebenza ngoMashi 2, 2001, njengesisekelo sokubaluleka kokufinyelela kolwazi emphakathini, okukhululekile, okukhuthaza ukuveza, futhi kwenza konke kube sobala. Lo mthetho uhambisana nelungelo leMthethosisekelo elikhulunywa esigabeni 32 seBill of Rights seMthethosisekelo futhi kumele uhunyushwe njengomthetho owenza ilungelo elisemthethweni. Noma yiluphi ulwazi oluphathwa uhulumeni; kanye nolwazi oluphathwa omunye umuntu noludingekayo ekusebenzeni kwanoma yiluphi ilungelo. Umthetho kazwelonke kumele ube khona ukuze uphumelele lokhu kulungelo futhi ungase ube nemikhawulo evumelekile yokunciphisa umthwalo wokuphatha nezimali zikahulumeni. Ukwandisa abantu ngolwazi nokufundisa bonke abantu ukuze baqonde amalungelo abo ngaphansi kwalolu shintsho, baqonde imisebenzi nezinsiza zokuphatha zomphakathi, futhi bahlolisise futhi babambe iqhaza ezinqumweni zokwenza izinqumo zezikhungo zomphakathi ezithinta amalungelo abo. Umgomo ophelele wezokuphatha uyatholakala uma ucelwa. Ukuqasha abasebenzi abadingekayo noma abaneziqu ezanele ukuze baqedele imisebenzi yabo; nokwenza noma yimiphi imisebenzi ebekwe kubo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono kanye noMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono noma ehambisana nezinhloso yale mithetho. I-MQA inawo wonke amandla adingekayo ukuze iqedele imisebenzi yayo njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla kanye nanoma yimiphi imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. Umbono we-MQA uwukuba nolwazi olwaneleyo nolufanele namakhono ukuze kusizakale umkhiqizo, impilo, nokuphepha kwabasebenzi kanye nezinguquko emkhakheni Wokumba Nezinto. Umsebenzi oyinhloko we-MQA ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko yamakhono emkhakheni wokumba nezinto ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998. Amalungu omphakathi angathola usizo ehhovisi likaMphathi oPhakathi. Zonke izicelo zamarekhodi kumele ziqondiswe kuMphathi oPhakathi usebenzisa ifomu elibekwe. Ifomu elibekwe, uma seliqediwe ngokuphelele, lingathunyelwa, lithunyelwe ngekhoriyeri, noma lithunyelwe nge-imeyili kuMphathi oPhakathi usebenzisa imininingwane yokuxhumana enikezwe ngenhla. UMphathi oPhakathi kumele, uma ethola isicelo solwazi, enze isinqumo phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 sokuthi avumele ukufinyelela kumarekhodi aceliwe noma cha. UMphathi oPhakathi okuthunyelwe isicelo samarekhodi angakwazi ukwandisa noma ukulibazisa isikhathi esingu-30 esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 25 ngenye isikhathi esingu-30 uma isicelo sikhuluma ngenani elikhulu lamarekhodi noma uma kudingeka ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezikhungo ukuze kutholwe amarekhodi. Umfaki-sicelo kumele aziswe ngezizathu zokwandiswa kwesikhathi. Uma isicelo samukelwa, uMphathi oPhakathi kumele azise umfaki-sicelo ngezindleko ezikhokhwayo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 10.4 salolu shintsho ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nesicelo. Uma uMphathi oPhakathi ethola ukuthi isicelo sidinga ukucatshangelwa yisikhungo somphakathi, uMphathi Wolwazi kumele, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14, akhulule kumkhakha ofanele futhi azise umfaki-sicelo ngokuqondisa. Inqubo yokuxoxisana ixhaswa yizakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo ezifana neBhodi, iKomidi Eliphezulu (EXCO), nezinye izinkomidi ezahlukene. Amarekhodi atholakala lapha yilawo okumele acelwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Lamarekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi oPhakathi ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo. Izinhlobo zamarekhodi zihlukaniswe zibe yilezo ezitholakala ngokushesha nezilezo ezitholakala ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo njengoba kuchazwe ngumthetho. Isigaba 5 soMthetho sikhombisa ukuthi i-PAIA isebenza ngaphandle kokubheka eminye imithetho engase ivimbele noma icindezele ukuvezwa kolwazi futhi engahambisani nezinhloso noma izinhlinzeko ze-PAIA. Isigaba 55. Amarekhodi akhishwa lapha atholakala kuphela uma ecela ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Angathintwa ngeMphathi oPhakathi ukuze athole lawa marekhodi, atholakala ukuze ahlolwe, athengwe, noma athathwe izithombe uma izindleko ezibekwe esigabeni 11.4 ngezansi zikhokhelwe. Amarekhodi akhishwa ngezansi atholakala uma ecela ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Lamarekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi oPhakathi ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo. Imali yokufaka isicelo iyimali ebekwe engu-R35.00. Le mali kumele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sikwazi обработка, futhi uMphathi oPhakathi kumele azise umfaki-sicelo ukuthi kumele akhokhe le mali, ngaphandle uma umfaki-sicelo efaka isicelo solwazi ngaye. Imali yokuhlinzeka ngolwazi ifaka izindleko zokwenza kopi, ukufuna, ukulungisa, nezindleko zokuthumela uma kudingeka. Uma isikhathi sokulungisa sithatha isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku eziyisithupha, umfaki-sicelo kumele akhokhe imali yokuboleka engu-onyaka wesithathu wemali ephelele, ngaphandle uma kungumuntu ofaka isicelo solwazi ngaye.
