Iyini iWater Users Association (WUA)? I-WUA iyinhlangano esemthethweni eyasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. I-WUA iyiqembu labasebenzisi bamanzi ngabanye abahlanganyela ukwenza imisebenzi ephathelene namanzi ukuze benze kahle. Ikhompiyutha yokuphatha inezibopho ze-WUA. Inhloso ye-WUA ukuvumela abantu emiphakathini ukuba bahlele izinsiza zabo (imali, abantu, kanye nobuchwepheshe) ukuze benze kahle imisebenzi ephathelene namanzi. Ngaphakathi kwe-WUA, amalungu angabhekana nezidingo zendawo futhi abeke phambili kulolu hlu. I-WUA isebenza ezingeni lendawo enomkhawulo ochaziwe. I-WUA ingahlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuphatha izinsiza zomfula ezingeni lendawo. Ama-WUA adlala indima ebalulekile ekunciphiseni indlala nasekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha kokudla. I-WUA iyisikhungo esisemthethweni esinokwakhiwa okuphelele, futhi lezo zikhono zinganikezwa kuphela kumuntu noma isikhungo esisemthethweni ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-WUA ingenza zonke izenzo umuntu angazenza, njengokuvula i-akhawunti yasebhange, ukungena ezivumelwaneni nabahlinzeki nababolekisi. I-WUA ingabamba icala noma ibanjwe icala yinhlangano ethile. UMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke kanye nomthethosivivinywa we-WUA kulawula ukuphathwa nokusebenza kwale nhlangano. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokusungulwa kwe-WUA kunoma yisiphi isimo sokusetshenziswa kwamanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho. Nokho, kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-WUA ezingasungulwa, i-WUA yomsebenzisi oyedwa kanye ne-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi. I-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi ihlinzeka ngezidingo zabantu abahlukene abasebenzisa amanzi, njengokulima, ukuhweba, ukukhiqiza, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwasekhaya. I-WUA isungulwa nguNgqongqoshe kulandela izinqubo ezichazwe kuMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe angafuna ukuhlinzeka ngezisebenzi, ukuphatha, nokubhekelela uhlelo lukamasipala emphakathini wendawo. Lokhu kungenzeka uma uhlelo luhlelwe ukusiza leyo miphakathi futhi lungaphathwa kahle yi-WUA efanele. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukweseka imizamo yezinye izigaba zikamasipala ngokuzinzisa abalimi abasha noma ngokuthuthukisa amaphrojekthi okutshala ukudla. Lapho kukhona ukuthuthukiswa okungahambisani, uNgqongqoshe angase anqume ukuthi i-WUA isebenze njengendlela yokuphatha engcono futhi igweme izingxabano ezingase zibe khona. I-WUA isungulwa ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi. Uma uNgqongqoshe exhumana nomphakathi, izindleko zokuxhumana zingabuyiselwa uma i-WUA isunguliwe. I-WUA eyasungulwa ngenhloso ethile ivamise ukusungulwa ngemva kokuthi kube nephakamiso elenziwe kuNgqongqoshe ngababhekene nakho. UNgqongqoshe angase afune umuntu noma inhlangano ukuthi ithumele iphakamiso lokuhlinzeka ngezindleko zokuxhumana nomphakathi ngaphambi. Noma iyiphi uhlobo noma iqembu labasebenzisi bamanzi lingathumela iphakamiso kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kusungulwe i-WUA. UMsunguli-Jikelele weMnyango Wezamanzi Nezihlahla angasiza abasebenzisi bamanzi ekubhaleni iphakamiso. Yini okufanele ifakwe ephakamisweni? Incazelo yokuthi yisiphi isixhumanisi esithathwe ukuze kudalwe iphakamiso kanye nemiphumela yalokho. Yisiphi isixhumanisi esitholakele? Yini eyatholakala? Nini uNgqongqoshe azovuma ukusungulwa kwe-WUA? UNgqongqoshe uzovuma ukusungulwa kwe-WUA uma ikhulisa izinhloso ezibekiwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. Futhi ukuvikela indawo yokuhlala kwezilwane zasemanzini. Iphakamiso yokusungula i-WUA kufanele ihambisane neMisebenzi Yokuphatha Izinsiza Zomfula ye-CMA. Enye indaba okufanele ifakwe yisivumelwano esiphakanyisiwe se-WUA. UMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke uchaza zonke izindaba okufanele zixazululwe esivumelwaneni se-WUA. Lo Mthetho (Isheduli 5) uphinde uhlanganise imodeli yesivumelwano esingasetshenziswa njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa isisekelo somthetho. Nakuba isisekelo somthetho se-WUA singabandakanya imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, lokhu akusho ukuthi i-WUA izoba nazo zonke lezi zisebenzi uma isunguliwe. Abafaka isicelo sokusungula i-WUA kufanele, njengengxenye yenqubo yokusungula, bacela ngokusemthethweni ukuba bathunyelwe ku-WUA. Lokhu kungafakwa emqulwini ohambisana nephakamiso uma ithunyelwa. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukuthi izindaba ezengeziwe zibe khona esivumelwaneni se-WUA. Lezi zindaba kufanele zamukelwe ngamalungu enhlangano futhi ziqinisekiswe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphambi kokuthi i-WUA ikwazi ukusebenzisa noma yiziphi izikhono noma ukwenza noma yiziphi izisebenzi. ngokuchaza indawo yokusebenza ngokuya ngesimo nenani lamanzi okufanele aphathwe, kanye nezikhono nemisebenzi ezodingeka ukuthi zidluliselwe ku-WUA. Emiphakathini engekho namandla okuhlela nokwenza amalungiselelo adingekayo enhlangano. Ikakhulukazi, usizo lungahlinzekwa lapho ukuthuthukiswa kudingeka ukukhuthazwa ngokusungula i-WUA (njengoba kwenzelwa abalimi abasha). Zonke izikhungo zokulima namabhodi amanzi abekade ekhona ngaphambi kokuqala komthetho kufanele aguqulwe zibe yi-WUA. Amabhodi amanzi athile asunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi ukuze akwazi ukulima nawo azoguqulwa abe yi-WUA. Ukuhunyushwa kwamabhodi amanzi kusho ukuthi kufanele baphinde basungule izindawo zabo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukuze bamele kahle ukuhlukahluka kwabantu kuleyo ndawo, ngokwezizinda nezobulili. INingizimu Afrika inembali yokufinyelela ezinsizeni ngokungafani. Ukuguqulwa kuyindlela eyodwa yokufeza ubulungiswa. UNgqongqoshe uphumelele imihlahlandlela yokusungula ikomidi lokuphatha le bhodi yokulima eguquliwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi i-WUA ibe nezezimali ezizimele ukuze iphumelele. Ukusungulwa kwe-WUA kungenzeka kuphela uma amalungu ekwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokusungula i-WUA kanye nezindleko zokusebenza nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi emikhulu ephathelene ne-WUA. Ngakho-ke, i-WUA ivamise ukuxhaswa ngezimali ezikhokhwa kumalungu ezaziwa ngokuthi "izindleko zokusetshenziswa kwamanzi." Ezinye izinsiza ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zosizo nokuxhaswa kwezimali okuvela kubaxhasi. I-WUA ingabuyekeza izindleko ezikhokhwa minyaka yonke kumalungu ayo uma isivumelwano sayo sinikeza lokhu. Lezi zindleko kufanele zihambisane nesu lokubiza lokusetshenziswa kwamanzi elibekwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angahlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ku-WUA ukuze afinyelele izinhloso zomthetho wezamanzi kazwelonke (ngokuhambisana nezimiso zomthetho ezibekwe ngaphansi komthetho). Umnyango uthuthukise inqubomgomo yokuhlinzeka ngosizo ezinhlelweni ezikhona noma ezintsha zezigaba ezithintekayo zomlando ezilungiselelwe abanye abahlali be-WUA. Isidingo sokuv
Ihhovisi leMibiko Yezobuchwepheshe, iMeta-information, ngaphansi koMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, iqala futhi ixhasa ngezomnotho ucwaningo lwezinhlelo zeMisebenzi Yezincwadi Nezokwazi (LIS) ezingeni likazwelonke. Zonke lezi zenzo ziqondiswe ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala ezingeni likazwelonke. Ihhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano yolwazi kazwelonke liyinhliziyo yoHulumeni kazwelonke ophatha imigomo ethile mayelana nemisebenzi yezincwadi nezokwazi (LIS) ezingeni likazwelonke. Ulwazi lukhuluma ngolwazi oluhlobene nolwazi. Umbono wehhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano kazwelonke uwukwakha nokugcina uhlelo lolwazi oluphumelelayo oluzokhuthaza ukufinyelela kolwazi, luqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izindawo zibhakabhise kwiSizwe Solwazi, okuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni izwe. Umsebenzi walo uwukwazisa uNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlela, nokugcina isikhala semigomo nezinsiza zolwazi ezingeni likazwelonke. Lezi zikhungo zifaka isandla ekwakheni isikhungo sikazwelonke seMisebenzi Yezincwadi Nezokwazi, esiphinde sasisize nezinye izinhlobo zezincwadi ukuhlinzeka ngensiza yolwazi ezindaweni zazo. Ihhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano kazwelonke lisebenza njengeSikhumbuzo seKomidi esisemthethweni sokugcina amarekhodi nolwazi kanye neBhodi Yezemisebenzi Yezincwadi Nezokwazi esisemthethweni. Ihhovisi lolwazi liphinde lilawule ukuhlelwa kabusha kwekomidi nebhodi.
Izimo ezisemqoka zomthetho zivezwe kule mthetho. b 'Bid' ibhekisela esicelweni esibhaliwe ngendlela ethile noma esivezwe ngokuphendula isimemo esivela enhlanganweni kahulumeni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo, imisebenzi, noma izinto. m 'Abasebenzi BeSupply Chain Management' baphinde babhekisele kuMphathi Wezezimali, uMphathi Wezikhwama: Izimpahla, Ababhalisi Bezikweletu, nababhalisi bezitolo kanye noMphathi Wezezimali; futhi 'Tender' esetshenziswe enqubweni yokuthengwa kusho 'bid' emkhakheni wenqubo yokubhida kanye 'nencazelo' elandela inqubo yokuthengwa kwezimpahla noma izinsizakalo ukuze kutholakale izindleko ze-R100,000. Ingxenye yokuthengwa ibhekelele ukulungiselela umsebenzi wezokuphatha ongazelelwe. Umphathi nguMphathi Wezezimali obika kuMphathi Wezezimali wombuso. Amanzi avela kwiMnyango Wezamanzi noma enhlanganweni yomphakathi, emnyangweni omunye, noma enhlanganweni yomphakathi; kanti ugesi uvela ku-Eskom noma enhlanganweni yomphakathi, emnyangweni omunye, noma enhlanganweni yomphakathi. ngokubhala, kuchaza kahle uhlobo nenani/isikhathi lezimpahla nezinsizakalo ezidingekayo. Ukulungiselela imininingwane ethile okuhloswe ngayo ukuthenga izimpahla noma izinsizakalo ezivela kubanikezeli abathile kanye/noma amagama ezigaba akufanele asetshenziswe. Kuqinisekiswe ngokuphelele nguMphathi wesigaba esifanele, noma umuntu ogunyaziwe, ukuthi isimo esanele senziwe ebhajethi yokuthengwa. UMphathi Wezezimali uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona uhlelo lokuphatha olufanele lwezidingo, olunikeza izidingo zokuthengwa kumasipala. Lezi zidingo zizofaka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla zifinyelelwa nezinsizakalo zinikezwa ngesikhathi, endaweni efanele, ngentengo eyavunyelwene, nasemazingeni afanele nenani. Uma ukuthengwa kunezimo zebhajethi ezizayo, isigaba 33 se-MFMA mayelana nezinkontileka sizolandelwa. Ngemuva kokuthengwa kwalomthetho, isigaba 33 ngeke sibe khona ezinkontilekayo ezinomsebenzi ongaphansi kwe-R1 million noma njengoba kubekwe yiMali Yezwe. Ukwengeza okulandelayo kufaka phakathi izingxenye 19 no-33 ze-MFMA. b Isicelomali esibhaliwe esinokulinganiselwa phakathi kwe-R5,000 no-R100,000; kanye c Inqubo yokubhida yokuncintisana enokulinganiselwa okudlula ku-R100,000. Izimpahla nezinsizakalo ngeke zihlukaniswe zibe izingxenye noma ziqoqwe njengemali encane ukuze kugwenywe izidingo zomthetho. Izimpahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiswe ezindlekweni eziphakathi kwe-R5,000 no-R100,000 zingathengwa ngokuthola okungenani izincwadi ezintathu zokubhala ezivela ohlwini lwabanikezeli abavunyelwe. Zonke izincwadi zokubhala zizofaka izindleko zokuhamba. Abanikezeli bazohlinzeka ngamanani aqinisekisiwe ngokubhala kanye nokutholakala kwesitokwe ngaphambi kokufaka i-oda. Igama labanikezeli kanye namanani abawabhalile azogcinwa ngumuntu ophumelele ngaphakathi kwengxenye yokuthengwa, njengoba kugunyazwe nguMphathi Wezezimali. Uma kungenakwenzeka ukuthola okungenani izincwadi ezintathu zokubhala, isizathu salokhu sizogcinwa nguMphathi Wezezimali, futhi lezi zizathu zizobikiswa kuMphathi Wezezimali okungenani njalo ezinyangeni. Izimpahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiselwa ezindlekweni eziphakathi kwe-R5,000 no-R100,000 zingathengwa ngokumema izincwadi zokubhala ezivela kubanikezeli abavunyelwe abangu-3 okungenani. Isicelo sezincwadi zokubhala sizokwenziwa yiNgxenye Yokuthengwa yeMnyango Wezezezimali. Ngempahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiselwa ezindlekweni ezedlula ku-R30,000, izikhumbuzo zokubhala zizoboniswa ebhodini lesaziso lesifunda elinikezwe umgomo wokubonisa izincwadi zokubhala nezinsizakalo, kuwebhusayithi yesifunda, futhi zingakhangiswa nganoma iyiphi indlela efaneleka nguMphathi Wezezimali. Lezi zikhumbuzo zizoboniswa okungenani izinsuku eziyi-7 kusukela ngosuku zishicilelwe futhi zizokhombisa usuku lokugcina lokufaka, ngaphandle uma izimo zesigaba 10 zisebenza. Uma kungenakwenzeka ukuthola izincwadi ezintathu zokubhala, izizathu zalokhu kuzokwenziwa nguMphathi Wezezimali futhi kuzovunywa nguMphathi Wezezimali futhi kuzovunywa nguMphathi Wezezimali ngaphambi kokwamukela incwadi yokubhala. Kumele ihambisane nanoma iyiphi imibhalo edingekayo nguMphathi Wezezimali (CFO). Uma nganoma yisiphi isizathu, le nqubo ayilandeli, izizathu zalokhu kuzogcinwa nguMphathi Wezezimali futhi kuvunywe nguMphathi Wezezimali. Izincazelo zokubhida zizokwenziwa ngokukhethekile ngezinto ezikhonjiswe esigabeni 7. Ukuze i-bid ibhekwe, kumele ihlangabezane nazo zonke izidingo zemibhalo yokubhida (njengokuchazwe esigabeni 5.1) futhi ibekwe ebhokisini le-bid elisemthethweni elinikezwe njengokukhangiswa. Ibhodi izodinga idiphozi engabuyiselwa emuva yokufaka imibhalo yokubhida. Inani lediphozi lizobuyekezwa minyaka yonke. UMphathi Wezezimali noma umuntu ogunyaziwe uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhokisi okubhida avaliwe kuze kube sekuvuliwe ngokusemthethweni futhi aqinisekiswe kahle. Ngesikhathi sokukhangiswa, ibhokisi lokubhida lizovulwa futhi livalwe ngabasebenzi ababili: omunye ovela eMnyangweni Wezezimali nomunye ovela eMnyangweni Wokubambisana, lapho kufanele khona, isisebenzi esivela emnyangweni lapho i-bid ihlosiwe. Ibhokisi lizovulwa emphakathini, okusho ukuthi kukhona izibhedlela kanye nezithakazelo ezikhona. Umphathi WeSupply Chain Management uzovula imibhalo yokubhida (endaweni echazwe embhalweni wokubhida) nomuntu ovela eMnyangweni Wokubambisana, emnyangweni ofanele, kanye nanoma yimuphi omunye ozithakazelayo. Njengoba isikhathi nendawo yokukhangiswa efanele ilandelwa, ibhokisi lokubhida lingavulwa noma ngabe amalungu omphakathi awatholakali. Amagama ababhidayo kanye nezimali zokubhida zizofundwa futhi zigcinwe kwi-rejista yokubhida, ezotholakala ukuze ibonwe emphakathini uma kucelwa. Irekhodi lokuqala lizogcinwa ehhovisi likaMphathi Wezezimali, futhi ikhophi yerekhodi kumele ihlinzekwe kumphathi wesigaba ofanele. Ezimweni zezenzakalo ezinkulu zokubhida ezithatha isikhathi eside ukufundwa, kuphela ababhidayo abaceliwe bazofundwa, futhi uhlu oluphelele luzohlinzekwa ngokushesha okukhulu. Imiphumela ye-bid izoshicilelwa kuwebhusayithi noma ebhodini lesaziso lesifunda. Ezinhlelweni ezinkulu eziyinkimbinkimbi noma ezinhlelweni ezikhethekile, lapho kungadingeki futhi kungabizi ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango yezobuchwepheshe ngaphambi, ukubhida kungaqhutshelwa ezigabeni ezimbili. Isigaba sokuqala ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango yezobuchwepheshe ngaphandle kokulinganiselwa kwentengo ngokusekelwe ezithombeni zomqondo noma ezichazayo zokuphumelela. Lezi zicebiso zizoba ngaphansi kokulungiswa nokucaciswa kanye nezilungiso zob
UMnyango wezobuciko namasiko, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezindaba zikazwelonke kanye namaMEC anegunya lamakultura, ukhethe ithimu ethi "Ukwazisa Izelamani Eziphilayo ('Izinto Esiphila Nazo') ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili wethu wokuthula" ngesikhathi somhlangano wabo we-MINMEC ngoMashi 2004. Le thimu izosetshenziswa eminyakeni emithathu ezayo, iphelelwa nguSepthemba 2007. UMnyango uhlose ukusebenzisa inyanga yeZelamani njengendlela yokukhuthaza umbono wesikhathi eside sokuhlanganisa, ukugcina, ukuvikela, ukuthuthukisa, nokwabelana ngamasiko aphilayo/amasiko kazwelonke angathinteki. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba imibhalo yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika nemithetho ivame ukubhekisela ezamasikweni aphilayo, emhlabeni jikelele (e-UNESCO) ibizwa ngokuthi amasiko angathinteki. Le ndlela entsha iyathandwa ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo esanda kusungulwa yiMibandela Yomhlaba Yokuvikela Amasiko Angathinteki, lapho abaqhuba nezisebenzi ezisebenzisana namasiko baqala ukusebenzisa Amasiko Aphilayo kanye neMisebenzi Yamasiko Angathinteki ngokufanayo. Uma othile ekhuluma ngamasiko aphilayo, kuqondwa ukuthi ingxoxo ibhekisela kumasiko angathinteki kanye nokukhula kwawo. Incazelo, njengoba iboniswe kwiMthetho Wezinsiza Zamasiko Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999) kanye neMthetho Wezinsiza Zamasiko Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), ifaka inqubo ephelele yemvelo, umphakathi, kanye nobudlelwano bomphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi seMibandela, "Amasiko Angathinteki" abhekisela ezimisweni, izithombe, ukuveza, ulwazi, amakhono - kanye nezinsiza, izinto, nezindawo ezihlobene nazo - ezikhumbulelwe, amaqembu, nabantu abaziwa njengengxenye yamasiko abo, edluliselwa ezizukulwaneni, eqhubeka nokwakhiwa ngamaqembu nomphakathi ngokuhambisana nemvelo yabo, ukuxhumana kwabo nemvelo, kanye nomlando wabo, futhi ibanika umqondo wokuhlonipha nokuhlala, ngaleyo ndlela ikhuthaza ukuhlonishwa kokwehlukahlukana kwamasiko nokudala kwabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi seMibandela, ukuqashelwa kuzokwenziwa kuphela kumasiko angathinteki ahambisana nezimiso zezimfanelo zabantu njengemfuneko yokuhlonipha phakathi kwemiphakathi, amaqembu, nabantu, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okusekelwe. Izinkolelo zomsindo nezokukhuluma, ezihlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwamasiko angathinteki, nazo zifakiwe. Lezi zincazelo ezandulelelayo (kokubili ngokwezimiso zomthetho waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nomthetho wamazwe omhlaba) zibhekisela kumqondo oxhumene kakhulu. Umkhuba ojwayelekile ufaka izinkolelo zomsindo, imisebenzi, imikhuba yokuxhumana, nolwazi lwezinto, umphakathi, kanye nobudlelwano bomphakathi. Uma othile engabona umehluko, akuwumehluko ngokwakhiwa kodwa ngokuchazwa kwamagama. Ngakho-ke, ukusebenzisa lezi zinkolelo ngokufanayo, njengoba abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika benza, akuhambisani nokwephula noma iyiphi imithetho kodwa kunalokho kukhona ukukhetha. Amasiko aphilayo afana nanoma iyiphi into yomuntu ehlobene nesikhathi sokwakha ubukhosi bamazwe omhlaba kanye nabakhi benhlangano engayiyo. Kuyisakhiwo futhi kuhlala kuyisakhiwo solwazi oluphilayo lwemiphakathi ehlukene ezimweni zomlando ezithile. Lolu lwazi oluphilayo balunayo; indlela abaphatha ngayo ukuzalwa, ukukhula, ukuhlala, umshado, nokufa; indlela abakhumbula ngayo lezi zinyathelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu, indlela abaphatha ngayo ubumpofu nokushoda, indlela abakha ngayo umnotho wabo, nokuthi baphila kanjani nemiphakathi eminye kanye nemvelo yabo, indlela abachaza ngayo izindaba zabo, indlela abakhuluma futhi badansa, njll. Uhlobo lwamasiko aphilayo esinalo namuhla luyingxenye yamasiko avela ebantwini abavela ezikhathini ezingakhumbuleki. Amasiko aphilayo aqhamuka ezinkolelweni zomsindo, umlando owethulwe ngomsindo, imikhuba yokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi ezijwayelekile ezithuthukile futhi ziqhubekile noma zathathwa noma zengezwa ngezici ezintsha ngenxa yokuxhumana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene yomhlaba eyayihlukene ekuqaleni ngenxa yesikhala nesikhathi. Lokhu kuxhumana kuqhubekisela phambili ukuhlanganiswa kwezamasiko zomhlaba okuvele ngenxa yokuphuma kobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ukukhuphuka kokuhamba nokuvakasha, nokuncipha kwesikhala phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. INingizimu Afrika imele isithombe esiphelele senhlangano eyisithombe samazwe akhiwe phezu kwamasiko anothile futhi ahlukene - ngakho-ke umqondo weRainbow Nation. Ngakho-ke, kufanelekile ukuthi uhulumeni wakhe indawo yokwethula nokubonisa Amasiko Aphilayo ahlukene wezigaba zonke zabantu. Lokhu kufanele kwenzeke ngendlela esekela izimiso zenhlangano engahlukanisi ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, kanye nokukhubazeka, futhi ngendlela ehlanganisayo. Kufanele futhi kwenzeke ngaphakathi komqondo wokuzama ukuthuthukisa ukwabelana ngolwazi lwamasiko aphilayo phakathi kwemiphakathi ngoba kuyasiza ngalokhu ukwabelana nokwazisa okufanayo nokwehlukile kwamasiko angathinteki ukuthi sizofinyelela ekuxolelweni kwenhlangano, ekwakheni isizwe, nasekuhlanganiseni komphakathi. Kuzofundisa zonke izindawo ukwabelana ngolwazi ngendlela ethokozisayo, njengoba kuboniswe ngamasiko abo aphilayo. Lokhu kungathatha ifomu lokuqashelwa kokubili umehluko nokufana. Kuzoba kubalulekile ukufunda ukuthi lezi zamasiko ezihlangene zakha amasiko akhula ezivela ezizindeni ezahlukahlukene ezinekhono elihlukile laseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyajabulisa kakhulu ukuthi izinqubomgomo nemithetho esunguliwe kusukela ngo-1994 ikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa nokugcina amasiko abantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamasiko amaqembu onke emphakathini wethu. UMsunguli ophathelene nezobuciko, amasiko, kanye nezinsiza zamasiko kanye nemigomo yayo uthi iMthetho Wezinsiza Zamasiko Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999) kanye neMthetho Wezinsiza Zamasiko Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999) uqukethe ubufakazi bomqondo owakhiwe ukuze ufinyelele le njongo. Iminyango kahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezisekelwa umphakathi, kanye nabantu bakhe izakhiwo zokwenza kube lula ukugcina nokukhuthaza amasiko aphilayo. Nakuba lezi zikhumbuleka futhi zikhunjulwa, inqubo ehlanganisayo ephethwe nguhulumeni kanye nezinhlelo eziholwa umphakathi zidingeka ukuze kuthuthukiswe uhlelo olubanzi oluhlanganisa imicabango yazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo kumele luthinte ukuhlanganiswa kwezici zamasiko aphilayo futhi luqedeleke ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo nemithetho edingekayo ukuze kuvikelwe (njengesibonakaliso sokuhweba/nokufaneleka). Abameli/baphakanyisi bamasiko aphilayo abangakwazi noma abathola kunzima ukugcina ulwazi oluwusizo kumele baziwe futhi banikezwe ulwazi olufanele. Ukwazisa iminyaka eyi-10 yamasiko aphilayo enhlalweni. Ukwakha isikhala sok
Isikhathi esibalulekile sempilo ye-piglet siqala ekuthwaleni kuze kube yilapho ifika ekwakheni. Ngokuvamile, ama-piglet amabili azalwa ngalesi sikhathi. Isizathu esikhulu esithinta lokhu ukuphathwa okungafanele, noma isizathu singaba ukuhlanganiswa, ukuhamba kwegazi kusuka emathanjeni, i-anemia, ukungondleki, noma isifo. I-sow kumele ihlanzwe futhi iphathwe ngemedikali ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa endaweni yokuzala (okungenani ezinsukwini ezingu-4 kuya kwezi-5 ngaphambi kokuzala). I-sow eduze kokuzala akufanele ihanjiswe endaweni yokuzala kuze kube sekwindla yokuzala, ukuze ivumeleke ukuba ijwayele indawo yokuzala futhi yehlise ingcindezi. Indawo kumele ihlolwe kahle ukuze ibonakale izindawo eziqinile noma ama-lumps. Ama-lumps angaphathwa ngensipho yokuhlanzeka. Indawo yokuzala kumele yakhiwe kude nezinye izindawo. Ukuhlanzeka kumele kugcinwe ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuhlanza indawo yokuzala kahle ngemva kokususa i-sow kanye nama-piglet ayo. Zonke izinto eziphumayo kumele zisuswe zisebenzisa umoya onamandla, ibhulashi lokuhlanzeka, noma isikhuhlu esinamandla. Indawo kumele ihlanzwe ngesisombululo sokuhlanzeka esifana nesixazululo se-4% formalin. Kumele ishiywe ingenalutho izinsuku ezi-2 kuya kwezi-3. Izikhwama ezingcolile nezimanzi kumele zisuswe nsuku zonke futhi zishintshwe ngezikhwama ezomile. I-sow kumele ibe nokukhiqizwa kwe-milk okwanele; ukungabi namanzi kungaholela ekufeni kwama-piglet ngenxa yokungondleki. Ama-piglet kanye nomama wabo kumele bahlolwe futhi banikezwe ukwelashwa okukhethekile, futhi udokotela wezilwane kumele abizwe ngokushesha. Ubude be-umbilical cord bungaba cishe ama-centimeter angu-12, kanti ingxenye engu-2 centimeters kumele ishiywe. Lokhu kuvikela ekulimazeni phakathi kwama-piglet ngesikhathi seziphakathi futhi kuphinde kuvikele ekugibeleni nasekudonseni izitho ze-sow. Qaphela lapho usika amazinyo ungakalimazi imilomo. Kuhle futhi kuyasiza ukushiya ucezu lwezinyawo. Kunconywa ukusika amazinyo usebenzisa umshini ofanele wokusika. Ama-piglet azalwa enezinhlamvu zensimbi, futhi ubisi lwe-sow aluhlinzeki ngezidingo zensimbi zama-piglet akhuliswe ezindaweni zekhonkolo. Ukwengeza insimbi kumele kuqinisekiswe ngokushesha ngemuva kokuzalwa (ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezi-3 kuya kwezi-7) ngezinhlamvu emathangeni. Ama-piglet kumele ahlukaniswe ezindlebeni ukuze kube nokuhlonza. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezitikha ezingenziwa ezindlebeni. Izinhlelo zokubhalisa zezinombolo zezinhlamvu kumele zisetshenziswe ne-South African Pedigree Association ukuze zisetshenziswe ezokwelapha.
Iphasi noma ilayisensi ayikwazi ukudluliselwa futhi kumele ihlinzekwe uma iceliwe ngumsebenzi wezinkanyezi, umphakathi ophakeme, iphoyisa, noma umsebenzi ogunyaziwe. Imisebenzi ethinta ukuzijabulisa, imfundo, isiko, noma ukufezekisa izinhloso zokomoya ingaqhutshelwa ezindaweni ezibekwe phambili (emamephini, ezindaweni ezichaziwe, ezindaweni ezibhalwe phansi lapho ukufinyelela kuvunyelwe, nezinye izimpawu). Ukungena ezinkalweni zikamasipala kungavinjwa ngaphandle kokuchaza isizathu, futhi izicelo zokubhukha zingakhanselwa noma ziphumelelwe yiMnyango. Ukuqoqwa kwezinkuni akuvunyelwe ngaphandle kwezindawo ezibekwe phambili. Akekho onelungelo lokuphazamisa imisebenzi yomphakathi wezinkanyezi noma ezindaweni zikamasipala. Noma yimuphi umonakalo owenziwe emithonjeni yezinkanyezi noma kunoma iyiphi impahla kahulumeni ngenxa zenzo zomnikazi welayisensi uzobuyiselwa kulowo mnikazi welayisensi. Bheka uhlu lwezenzakalo kuMthetho Wokuhlanganiswa A. Ngokwezinga 19 noma 20 loMthetho Wezinkanyezi Kazwelonke ka-1998 (UMthetho Wezinkanyezi Kazwelonke, 1998 - Umthetho 84 ka-1998), ilungelo lokungena ezinkalweni zikamasipala limi ezindaweni ezikhonjiswe emamephini anexhunywe (noma lezo ezichaziwe) futhi kumele kulandelwe imithetho esunguliwe. Qaphela ukuthi imithetho eyengeziwe evimbela ukufinyelela kwezinye izinkanyezi njengoba kuchaziwe ezimpawu, emamephini, kumabhroshwe, nakwezinye izindlela ibhekwa njengokuhlonishwa. Lolu hlobo lweleyisensi lusebenza kulokho okukhuluma ngakho umceli, bese kuthi kuncike ezimweni ezithile nasezinhlelweni ezitholakalayo noma ohlwini lwezenzakalo ezivunyelwe.

UMnyango Wezolimo uzama ukuhola ukuthuthukiswa kwezolimo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlala nokukhula komnotho eNingizimu Afrika futhi udlale indima ewusizo ekuthuthukisweni kwezolimo e-Afrika. Ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nezolimo noMnu. M.M. Mbongwa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezimpahla Zezolimo noNkk. N. Abasizi kaMphathiswa-Jikelele Wokuhlela Ukuxhumana noMnu. Z. Pinda kanye noMphathiswa Wokuphatha Ulwazi uMnu. L. Ukusiza uhlelo lokuzinza nokuthuthukiswa kwezimboni zabalimi. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokubambisana zabalimi nokuxhaswa kwezimali. Ukwenza ngcono nokugcina ukuphepha kokudla ezingeni likazwelonke nokusiza ukwesekwa kokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi yasemakhaya. Ukusiza ekuqapheleni izingozi nezimo zokuphazamiseka kwezolimo. Ukuhlinzeka ngokusiza ekwakhiweni, kubhaliswa, nasekuqinisekiseni izinhlelo zokulima ezibambisene (Lo msebenzi uzodluliselwa kuMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni). Ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zebhizinisi lezolimo ezikhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza okufanayo nokwabiwa okufanayo kwamalungelo nokukhula kwebhizinisi. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezicwangciso zomnotho kanye nezinsiza mayelana nezimpahla zezolimo, izinsiza, kanye nezinsiza zomkhakha ophazanyisiwe. Ukusungula nokuphatha uhlelo lwezibalo lwezolimo lwezwe. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukutshala izitshalo, ukulima izilwane, kanye nokuphathwa kwezilwane. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo nokulawulwa kwezilwane. Ukusebenzisa kahle izinsiza. Ukuhlela, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokulima ezisimeme, nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo nezindinganiso zokusebenzisa kahle umhlabathi namanzi, kanye nokuvikela umhlaba. Ukunciphisa izinga lezingcuphe kwezolimo, ezimpahleni zezolimo, kanye nezinye izindawo ezilawulwa. Ukunciphisa izinga lezingcuphe ezibangelwa izilwane ezilimazayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho elawula umkhakha wezolimo nokubheka izimo zezingcuphe ezimpahleni zezolimo. Ukusiza, ukuhlela, nokweseka ubudlelwano bamazwe ngamazwe kwezolimo eNingizimu Afrika obhekiswe ekuhwebeni, ukwabelana ngetekhnoloji/izeluleko, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nezombusazwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-guidelines okuqeqesha nokufundisa kwezolimo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kwezimali kwabantu okuphumelelayo emkhakheni. Ukusiza ekwakhiweni nasekuphumeleleni kohlelo lokuhlela, ukuqapha, nokuhlola ukusebenza kwenhlangano nokuhlola ukuthi iyafeza yini imigomo yayo. Ukukhuthaza umkhakha wezolimo onamandla okwakha ingcebo ngokukhiqiza izinkomo nezinkunzi e-RSA. Ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu; intuthuko yenhlangano kanye noqeqesho oluphumelelayo ngaphakathi. Ukuhlinzeka ngensiza yokusekela kwezomthetho. Ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo oluxhasa izinhlangothi kanye nohlelo oluphatha imibhalo. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuphatha nokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Ukuhlinzeka nge-NGO yezezimali. Ukubuyisa izikweletu zezolimo, ukuphatha imali efakwe, nokukhokha izikweletu. Umhlahlandlela uzotholakala eKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika ngaphambi kuka-Agasti 2003. Okukhuluma lapha akuhloselwe ukuba kube umhlahlandlela ophelele ngama-wills kanye nezifundo. I-will iyidokhumenti ekhethekile esiyincomayo ukuthi ibhalwe ngumuntu onolwazi njengommeli, inkampani esunguliwe yokuphatha izindlu, noma abanye. Le mininingwane ihloselwe ukwazisa umfundi ngezinto ezisemqoka ze-will. Bonke abantu abaneziminyaka ezingu-16 noma ngaphezulu, ngaphandle kokuthi ngaleso sikhathi sokwenza i-will babe nesimo sokungakwazi, bangakha i-will. (Umuntu owenza i-will ubizwa ngokuthi u-testator uma engumfana noma u-testatrix uma engumfazi). Bonke abantu abaneziminyaka ezingu-14 noma ngaphezulu, abaqapheli i-will, kumele bakwazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi enkantolo. Kusukela ngomhla ziyi-1 kuJanuwari 1954, i-will kumele ibe ebhalwe phansi. Ingabhalwa ngesandla, ibhalwe ngekhompyutha, noma ikhiqizwe ngekhompyutha. U-testator kumele asayine i-will ekugcineni noma ekupheleni kwayo. Uma i-will inamakhasi amaningi, u-testator kumele asayine ikhasi ngalinye ngaphandle kwekhasi lokugcina (Noma u-testator kumele asayine wonke amakhasi abaqapheli, kumele futhi basayine ikhasi lokugcina bese besayina ekupheleni kwedokhumenti). Umphakathi wenkantolo kumele aqinisekise ukuthi uyaneliseka ngubani u-testator futhi ukuthi i-will isayinwe ngu-testator wabo. Umphakathi wenkantolo kumele asayine isitifiketi nakuwo wonke amakhasi e-will. Umphakathi wenkantolo kumele abe khona lapho i-will isayinwa futhi kumele anexhume isitifiketi sakhe ngokushesha ngemva kokuthi i-will isayinwe noma ngabe u-testator ufela masinyane ngemva kokusayina. I-addendum noma ukuxhumana ne-will esivele ikhona, eyenzelwe ukwengeza noma ukulungisa i-will, kumele ihambisane nazo zonke izidingo ze-will. I-addendum ayidingi ukusayinwa ngababukeli ababesayine i-will yokuqala. Izinguquko kwi-will zingaqhutshelwa ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kwayo noma ngemuva kokuyenza. Izinguquko kwi-will kumele zihambisane nezidingo zokwenza i-will futhi uma ungakwazi ukusayina, kumele futhi zihambisane nezidingo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalolo hlobo. Ngesikhathi sokulungisa i-will, akudingeki ukuthi abaqapheli abasayine i-will yakho yokuqala basayine izinguquko. Isipho noma umnikelo owenziwe kumkakho kwi-will yakho, owenziwe ngaphambi kokuphulwa komshado, sizophumelela njengesipho noma umnikelo ngisho nangemva kokuhlukana. Umthetho ophathelene nama-wills uthi ngaphandle kokuthi uchaze okunye ngokubhala, isipho esinikezwe kumkakho owahlukana naye sizobhekwa njengokukhanselwa uma ufela ezinyangeni ezintathu kusukela ngosuku lokuhlukana. Le mfuneko yomthetho inika umuntu ohlukanisile izinyanga ezintathu zokulungisa i-will yakhe ngemuva kokuhlukana. Nokho, uma ungakwenza lokhu, umkakho ohlukanisile uzothola leso sipho njengoba kuchaziwe kwi-will. Umuntu noma umyeni noma unkosikazi obhala i-will noma ingxenye yayo ubhala ngegama lika-testator. Umuntu noma umyeni noma unkosikazi obona i-will uyenze lokho egameni lika-testator noma njengomqapheli. Xhumana nommeli wakho ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi.
b Thuthukisa ukuvikelwa nokufinyelela ekuqinisekisweni kobulili; futhi c ukubheka, ukuhlola nokuhlonza ukuhlonishwa kokulingana kobulili namalungelo abesifazane lapha eRiphabhulikhi. I-Secretariat nayo ibamba iqhaza emisebenzini ehlukene yehhovisi futhi iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu, uNkk. Chana Majake. Imiphumela ebhaliwe mayelana nezindaba ibe yinkinga yokuhlola nokubheka. Amadokhumenti okukhala aqediwe ahlobene nezinsongo ezihlukene zokucwaswa ngokobulili. Umfakisicelo kumele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe ku-Government Gazette [Inombolo Yesaziso Sokuhulumeni R187- edlulelwa ngomhla ka-15 kuFebhuwari 2002] (ifomu A). Umfakisicelo kumele futhi akhombise ukuthi uyacela yini ikhophi yedokhumenti noma ufuna ukuyibona mathupha ehhovisi leKomishini. Uma umuntu efuna ukuboniswa amadokhumenti ngendlela ethile, kumele aboniswe ngendlela ayicelile. Ngaphandle kokuthi ukwenza kanjalo kuzophazamisela ukusebenza kwalolo hulumeni noma kubangele umonakalo kudokhumenti, noma kuphule ilungelo ledokhumenti elingelona idokhumenti yomphakathi. Uma ngezizathu ezithile idokhumenti ingaboniswa ngendlela eceliwe, ingaboniswa ngenye indlela, futhi imali ekhokhwayo kumele ibalwe ngokwejwayelekile ngendlela edokhumenti ezoboniswa ngayo. Uma umfakisicelo efuna ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, kumele akhombise isikhundla lapho ukufaka isicelo kwenziwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 182f. Uma umfakisicelo engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma engakhubazekile, angafaka isicelo ngokuqhubekayo. Umfakisicelo ofuna idokhumenti equkethe ulwazi lwakhe siqu akadingi ukukhokha imali. Umphathi wolwazi kumele azise umfakisicelo (ngaphandle kwalowo ocela ulwazi lwakhe) ngokuthumela isaziso sokuthi kumele akhokhe imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuthi ukufaka isicelo kuqhubeke. Imali yokufaka isicelo ekhokhwayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi ingama-R35. Umfakisicelo angafaka isikhalazo ngaphakathi, uma kudingeka, noma afake isicelo enkantolo uma ephikisa ukukhokha imali yokufaka isicelo. Ngemva kokuba umphathi wolwazi enze isinqumo mayelana nalolo suku, umfakisicelo kumele aziswe ngaleso sinqumo ngendlela ayicelile ukuba aziswe. Uma ukufaka isicelo kabulwa, imali eyengeziwe yokufuna, yokuhlela, noma yokukhiqiza kanye nesikhathi esichithwa sokulungiselela idokhumenti kumele ikhokhwe uma exceeds isikhathi esibekiwe sokufuna nokuhlela amadokhumenti okukhululwa. Usizo lweKomishini luwumsebenzi phakathi kwezinhlelo noma emaphakathini aqhutshelwa yiKomishini ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zayo. Kungase kube nezinye izinhlelo ezihlukene ezixhumene ngaphansi kwezinhlelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinhlelo ezichaza umsebenzi weKomishini: isibonelo, uMnyango wezobugebengu, Ucwaningo, Ukuhlola nokuhlola, Imfundo yomphakathi, nolwazi. Izinhlelo ngaphansi koCwaningo, ukuhlola, nokuhlola zingaba yisisekelo solwazi. Umthetho weKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili inombolo 39 ka-1996 yinto esungula umsebenzi weKomishini okuwukuvikela, ukukhuthaza, nokuthuthukisa ukuvumelana kobulili nokuqinisa isimo sabesifazane kuhulumeni, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, ebhizinisini, nasemkhakheni ongemthetho. Ukuhlola nokuhlola noma yisiphi Isinqumo sePhalamende noma noma yimuphi omunye umthetho noma isivumelwano sokuhlola izikhalazo ezivela noma ngemva kokwamukela isikhalazo bese uzama ukuxazulula noma iyiphi inkinga noma ukulungisa isenzo noma ukungasebenzi. Izinqubomgomo zokuhlola nokuhlola, izinhlelo zokusebenza kuhulumeni, abamele uhulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nomkhakha ongemthetho. Ukuze uthole usizo lweKomishini, kufanele kufakwe isicelo esibhalwe kuMphathi Omkhulu weKomishini usebenzisa ulwazi olunikeziwe ku-B ngenhla. Amakhomidi ngokwesigaba -5 - seMthetho weKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili mayelana nalabo okufanele bamenywe kulawo makhomidi. Izinhlelo zokuzithandela kanye nemisebenzi yesikhashana - kukhona inqubomgomo yokusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze bamenye abantu emphakathini ukuze bagcwalise lezi zikhala. Abacwaningi besikhashana - kukhona inqubomgomo mayelana nokumiswa kwabacwaningi. IKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili nezinye izikhungo ezisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesahluko sesishiyagalolunye (somthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho inombolo 108 ka-1996) azinayo inqubo yangaphakathi yokudlulisa izikhalazo njengokwenziwe kwezinye izikhungo zomphakathi. Umuntu onenkinga kufanele asondele enkantolo uma kukhona isikhalazo mayelana nokungahambisani nomthetho yiKomishini. IKomishini izobuyekeza le dokhumenti ngokwesigaba 14, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingadluli unyaka. Ukumelwa kwezilimi ezintathu ezikhuluma kulolo suku lokugcina idokhumenti okukhulunywa ngalo kuMthetho Wokugcina Amadokhumenti ka-1997; zonke izikhungo zeKomishini Yokulingana Kobulili kanye neKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu.
Mayelana ne-Mining Qualifications Authority (MQA), iholwa nguMphathi Omkhulu (CEO). Umphathi wezokuxhumana anganikeza amandla noma imisebenzi enikezwe kuMphathi Wemininingwane ngaphansi kwalesi sikhungo kumphathi wezokuxhumana ophakeme. I-CEO kumele iqashe umuntu ukuze abe nguMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-MQA iyatholakala kulabo abafuna ukufaka isicelo sokuthola ulwazi olukhona kulabo abafuna amarekhodi. Umphathi Wemininingwane ungumuntu ongakwazi ukuhlela nokubhekelela uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme we-MQA. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi aqukethe ulwazi ngabo, imibono, nemibono yomunye umuntu mayelana nesipho, ithokheni, noma umklomelo onikezwe kulowo muntu lapho imibono noma imibono yomunye umuntu ivela; kanye negama lalowo muntu lapho livela kanye nolwazi lwabo noma luhambisana nalowo muntu noma lapho ukuveza kwegama kuzokhombisa ulwazi ngomuntu osefile isikhathi eside kuneminyaka engama-20. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo samarekhodi ku-MQA. Noma ubani (kubandakanya noma ongagciniwe), uhulumeni wangaphandle, inhlangano yomhlaba wonke engaphezu komfaki-sicelo, futhi futhi ngenhloso yesigaba 34 salolu shintsho, uma kukhulunywa ngencazelo ethi "umuntu" ezigabeni (a) no (b) kufanele ihunyushwe njengokukhuluma ng "umuntu ophilayo." IKomidi Lokukhuthaza Amalungelo Abantu elikhulunywa esigabeni 181 (b) seMthethosisekelo. Mayelana ne-MQA, irekhodi libhekisela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olurekhodiwe noma nganoma iyiphi ifomu elitholakala noma eliphethwe yisikhungo soHulumeni noma eliphethwe yisikhungo soHulumeni. Libhekisela kunoma yisiphi esinye isikhathi ngaphandle kosuku lwesonto, uMsombuluko, nezinsuku zokuphumula, njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 seMthetho Wokuphumula Kwezinsuku ka-1994 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1994). I-Mthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi (PAIA), Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000 (lapha okuzobizwa ngokuthi Umthetho) waqala ukusebenza ngomhla kaMashi 2, 2001, njengesisekelo sokubaluleka kokufinyelela kulwazi emphakathini, okuvulekile, kukhuthaza ubungcweti, futhi kwenza konke kube sobala. Lo Mthetho uhambisana nelungelo leMthethosisekelo elikhulunywa esigabeni 32 seBill of Rights seMthethosisekelo futhi kufanele ihunyushwe njengomthetho owenziwa ukuze uqinisekise ilungelo elisemthethweni. Noma yiluphi ulwazi oluphethwe yizwe; naluphi ulwazi oluphethwe omunye umuntu noludingekayo ukuze kwenziwe noma yiluphi ilungelo. Umthetho kazwelonke kumele udalwe ukuze kusebenze leli lungelo futhi ungase ube nemikhawulo evunyelwe ukuze kuncishiswe umthwalo wezokuphatha nezimali zohulumeni. Ukwenza abantu babe namandla ngolwazi nokufundisa bonke abantu ukuze baqonde amalungelo abo ngaphansi kwalolu shintsho, baqonde imisebenzi nemisebenzi yezikhungo zomphakathi, futhi bahlolisise futhi babambe iqhaza ezinqumweni ezithinta amalungelo abo. Isakhiwo esiphelele senhlangano sitholakala uma siceliwe. Ukuqasha abasebenzi abadingekayo noma abanele ukuze benze imisebenzi yabo; nokwenza noma yiziphi imisebenzi enikezwe yona ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono kanye noMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono noma ehambisana nezinhloso zale mithetho. I-MQA inawo wonke amandla adingekayo ukuze iqhube imisebenzi yayo njengokuchazwe ngenhla kanye nanoma yiziphi amandla anikezwe yona ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. Umbono we-MQA uwukuba nolwazi olwaneleyo nolufanele ukuze kusizakale umkhiqizo, impilo, nokuphepha kwabasebenzi kanye nezinguquko emkhakheni Wokumbiwa Kwezinsimbi Nezinto. Umsebenzi oyinhloko we-MQA uwukwenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono emkhakheni wokumbiwa kwezinsimbi ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998. Amalungu omphakathi angathola usizo ehhovisi likaMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme. Wonke ama-oda wemarekhodi kumele athunyelwe kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme usebenzisa ifomu elibekiwe. Ifomu elibekiwe, uma seliqediwe ngokuphelele, lingathunyelwa, lithunyelwe ngekhoriyela, noma lithunyelwe nge-imeyili kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme usebenzisa imininingwane yokuxhumana enikeziwe ngenhla. UMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme, uma esethole isicelo solwazi, kufanele enze isinqumo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 sokuthi anikeze ukufinyelela kumarekhodi afunwayo noma cha. UMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme okuthunyelwe isicelo samarekhodi kuye angakhulisa noma alibambezelele lezi zinsuku eziyi-30 ezikhulunywa esigabeni 25 ngenye iminyaka engama-30 uma isicelo sikhuluma ngenani elikhulu lamarekhodi noma uma kudingeka ukuxoxisana phakathi kwezakhiwo ukuze kutholakale amarekhodi. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele aziswe ngezizathu zokwandiswa kwesikhathi. Uma isicelo samukelwa, uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ngemali ekhokhwayo ngokwesigaba 10.4 salolu shintsho ngaphambi kokuthi aqhubeke nesicelo. Uma uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ethola ukuthi isicelo sidinga ukubhekwa yisikhungo somphakathi, uMphathi Wemininingwane kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14, asithumele esikhungweni esifanele futhi azise umfaki-sicelo ngaleso sithunywa. Inqubo yokuxoxisana ixhaswa yizakhiwo zokuphatha ezisebenzayo ezifana neBhodi, Ikhansela Eliphezulu (EXCO), nezinye izinkomidi ezahlukene. Amarekhodi atholakala lapha yilezi okufanele afakwe isicelo ngokwezomthetho. La marekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo. Izinhlobo zamarekhodi zihlukaniswe zibe yilezo ezitholakala ngokushesha kanye neze ezitholakala ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo njengoba kutholakala emthethweni. Isigaba 5 soMthetho sikhombisa ukuthi i-PAIA isebenza ngaphandle kokuthi kukhona eminye imithetho engase ivimbe noma icishe ukuveza ulwazi futhi engahambisani nezinhloso noma nezinhlinzeko ze-PAIA. Isigaba 55. Amarekhodi akhishwa lapha atholakala kuphela uma efakwe isicelo ngokwezomthetho. Angaxhumana noMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ukuze athole la marekhodi, atholakala ukuze abhekwe, athengwe, noma athathwe izithombe uma imali ethile enikeziwe esigabeni 11.4 ngezansi ikhokhwe. Amarekhodi akhishwa ngezansi atholakala uma efakwe isicelo ngokwezomthetho. La marekhodi angacelwa kuMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme ngokulandela inqubo yokufaka isicelo. Imali yokufaka isicelo iyimali ebekiwe engu-R35.00. Le mali kumele ikhokhwe ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sikwazi processing, futhi uMphathi Wemininingwane Ophakeme kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ukuthi kumele akhokhe le mali, ngaphandle uma umfaki-sicelo efaka isicelo solwazi ngaye. Yini iWater Users Association (WUA)? I-WUA iyinhlangano esemthethweni eyasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. I-WUA iyiqembu labasebenzisi bamanzi ngabanye abahlanganyela ukwenza imisebenzi ephathelene namanzi ukuze kuzuzwe izinzuzo ezivumelana. Ikhono eliphethe imisebenzi ye-WUA. Inhloso ye-WUA ukuvumela abantu emiphakathini ukuthi bahlanganyele ukuhlela izinsiza zabo (imali, abantu, nobuchwepheshe) ukuze benze imisebenzi ephathelene namanzi ngempumelelo. Ngaphakathi kwe-WUA, amalungu angabhekana nezidingo zendawo futhi abeke phambili lezi zidingo ohlwini lwezinto ezibalulekile. I-WUA isebenza ezingeni lendawo enezikhala ezichaziwe. I-WUA inganikeza uhlaka lokuphatha izinsiza zomfula ezingeni lendawo. Ama-WUA adlala indima ebalulekile ekwehliseni indlala nasekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha kokudla. I-WUA iyisikhungo somthetho esinokuphathwa okuphelele, futhi lezo zikhono zinganikezwa kuphela kumuntu noma isikhungo esisemthethweni ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Lokhu kusho ukuthi i-WUA ingenza zonke izenzo umuntu angazenza, njengokuvula i-akhawunti yasebhange, ukungena ezivumelwaneni nabahlinzeki nababolekisi. I-WUA ingafaka icala noma ifakwe icala enye inhlangano. UMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye nemigomo ye-WUA kulawula ukuphathwa nokusebenza kwenhlangano. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokusungulwa kwe-WUA kunoma yisiphi isimo sokusetshenziswa kwamanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho. Nokho, kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-WUA ezingasungulwa, i-WUA yomsebenzisi oyedwa kanye ne-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi. I-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi ihlinzeka ngezidingo zabantu abahlukene abasebenzisa amanzi, njengokulima, ukwakha, ukuhweba, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwasekhaya. I-WUA yasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe kulandela izinqubo ezichazwe kuMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe angafuna ukudlulisa imisebenzi, ukuphathwa, nokubhekelela uhlelo lukamasipala emphakathini wendawo. Lokhu kungenzeka uma uhlelo luhloselwe ukusiza lowo mphakathi futhi lungaphathwa ngempumelelo yi-WUA efanele. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukweseka imizamo yezinye izigaba zikamasipala ngokuzinza kwabafuyi abasha noma ngokuthuthukisa amaphrojekthi okulima okuncane. Lapho kukhona ukuthuthukiswa okungahambisani, uNgqongqoshe angase anqume ukuthi i-WUA isebenze njengendlela yokuphatha engcono futhi igweme ukungqubuzana okungenzeka. I-WUA yasungulwa ngemva kokuxoxisana nomphakathi. Uma uNgqongqoshe exoxisana nomphakathi, izindleko zokuxoxisana zingabuyiselwa uma i-WUA isunguliwe. I-WUA eyasungulwa ngenhloso ethile ivamise ukusungulwa ngemva kokuthi kube nephakamiso elenziwe kuNgqongqoshe yilabo abafuna yona. UNgqongqoshe angase afune umuntu noma inhlangano ukuthi ithumele iphakamiso ukuze ibhange izindleko zokuxoxisana nomphakathi ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Noma iyiphi uhlobo noma iqembu labasebenzisi bamanzi lingathumela iphakamiso kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kusungulwe i-WUA. UMsunguli-Jikelele woMnyango Wamanzi Nezinkuni angasiza abasebenzisi bamanzi ekubhaleni iphakamiso. Yini okufanele ifakwe ephakamisweni? Incazelo yokuthi yiziphi izixoxiswano ezenziwe ukuze kudalwe iphakamiso kanye nemiphumela yalezi zixoxiswano. Yiziphi izixoxiswano ezenzekile? Yini eyatholakala? Nini uNgqongqoshe azovuma ukusungulwa kwe-WUA? UNgqongqoshe uzovuma ukusungulwa kwe-WUA uma ikhuthaza izinhloso ezibekwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Futhi ukuvikela indawo yokuhlala kwezilwane zasemanzini. Iphakamiso yokusungula i-WUA kufanele ihambisane noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinsiza Zomfula ze-CMA. Enye indaba okufanele ifakwe yimithetho ephakanyisiwe ye-WUA. UMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke uchaza zonke izindaba okufanele zixoxwe kumthetho we-WUA. Lo Mthetho (Isheduli 5) uphinde uhlanganise imodeli yomthetho engasetshenziswa njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa uhlaka lwezomthetho. Nakuba uhlaka lwezomthetho lwe-WUA lungabandakanya imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, lokho akusho ukuthi i-WUA izoba nazo zonke lezi zisebenzi uma isunguliwe. Abafuna ukusungula i-WUA kufanele, njengengxenye yenqubo yokusungula, baphakamise ngokusemthethweni ukuze baphakanyiswe kwi-WUA. Lokhu kungaqhutshekiswa emqulwini olandelayo iphakamiso lapho ithunyelwa. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukuthi izindaba ezengeziwe zibe khona kumthetho we-WUA. Lezi zindaba kufanele zamukelwe ngamalungu enhlangano futhi ziqinisekiswe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphambi kokuba i-WUA ikwazi ukusebenzisa noma yiziphi izikhono noma ukwenza noma yiziphi imisebenzi. ngokuchaza indawo yokusebenza ngokuya ngesimo nenani lamanzi okufanele aphathwe, kanye nezikhono nemisebenzi ezizodingeka ukuthi kudluliselwe kwi-WUA. Emiphakathini engekho namandla okuhlela nokwenza izinhlelo ezidingekayo zenhlangano. Ikakhulukazi, ukusiza kunganikezwa lapho ukuthuthukiswa kudingeka ukukhuthazwa ngokusungulwa kwe-WUA (njengoba kwenzeka kubafuyi abasha). Zonke izikhungo zokulima namabhodi amanzi abekhona ngaphambi kokuba kuqale lo Mthetho kufanele aguqulwe zibe yi-WUA. Amabhodi amanzi athile asunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi ukuze akwazi ukulima nawo azoguqulwa abe yi-WUA. Ukuhunyushwa kwamabhodi amanzi kusho ukuthi kufanele baphinde basungule izindawo zabo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukuze zimele kahle ukuhlukahluka kwabantu kule ndawo, ngokobuzwe nangokobulili. INingizimu Afrika inembali yokufinyelela ezinsizeni ngokungalingani. Ukuguqulwa kuyindlela eyodwa yokufeza ubulungiswa. UNgqongqoshe uphumelele iziqondiso zokusungula ikomidi eliphethe ukuphathwa kwebhodi lokulima eliguquliwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi i-WUA ibe nokuzimela kwezezimali ukuze iphumelele. Ukusungulwa kwe-WUA kungenzeka kuphela uma amalungu ekwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokusungula i-WUA kanye nezindleko zokusebenza nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi emikhulu ephathelene ne-WUA. Ngakho-ke, i-WUA ivamise ukuxhaswa ngemali ngezimali ezikhokhiswa kumalungu ezaziwa ngokuthi "izimali zokusetshenziswa kwamanzi." Ezinye izinsiza ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho zifaka izinhlelo zosizo nokuxhaswa kwezezimali okuvela kubanikezeli. I-WUA ingabuyekeza izimali ezikhokhiswa minyaka yonke kumalungu ayo uma umthetho wayo uhlinzeka ngalesi sici. Lezi zimali kufanele zihambisane nesu lokubiza amanzi elibekwe nguNgqongqoshe. Zonke lezi zenzo ziqondiswe ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala ezingeni lesizwe. Ihhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano yolwazi yesizwe liyinhliziyo yoHulumeni wesizwe ophathelene nezinqubomgomo ezithile mayelana nemithombo yeMibiko nezeMisebenzi (LIS) ezingeni lesizwe. Ulwazi lukhuluma ngokuqonda okuhlobene nolwazi. Umbono wehhovisi eliphansi kwenhlangano yesizwe uwukwakha nokugcina uhlelo lolwazi oluphumelelayo oluzokhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi, luqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izindawo zikhona emiphakathini yeNhlangano yeMibiko, ezokwenza kube nempumelelo ekuthuthukiseni izwe. Ihhovisi lolwazi liphinde lilawule ukuhlela kabusha kwekomidi nebhodi.
Izimo ezibalulekile zomthetho zichazwe kule mthetho. b 'Ukubhida' kubhekisela esicelweni esibhaliwe ngendlela ethile noma esikhuluma ngokuphendula isimemo esivela enhlanganweni kahulumeni sokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo, imisebenzi, noma impahla. m 'Abasebenzi Be- Supply Chain Management' baphinde babhekisele kuMphathi Wezimali, uMphathi Wezokuphathwa: Izinsiza, Abaphathi Bezikweletu, kanye Nabaphathi Bezitolo kanye noMphathi Wezimali; futhi 'Tender' esetshenziswe enqubweni yokuthenga ibhekisela ku 'bid' emkhakheni wokubhida kanye 'nencazelo' elandela inqubo yokuthenga ukuze kutholakale izindleko ze-R100,000. Ingxenye yokuthengwa izobhekelela ukuhlela umsebenzi wokuphathwa ongazelelwe. Umphathi nguMphathi Wezimali obika kuMphathi Wezimali wezakhamuzi. Kuqinisekiswe ngokuphelele ngumphathi wesigaba esifanele, noma umuntu ogunyaziwe, ukuthi isimo esanele senziwe ebhajethi yokuthenga. UMphathi Wezimali uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona uhlelo lokuphatha olufanele lwezidingo, lunikeza izidingo zokuthenga zamasipala. Lezi zidingo zizofaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impahla ilethwa nezinsizakalo zinikezwa ngesikhathi, endaweni efanele, ngentengo eyavumelaniswa, nasemazingeni afanele nenani. Uma ukuthengwa kukhona izimo zebhajethi ezizayo, isigaba 33 se-MFMA mayelana nezinkontileka sizolandelwa. Ngemuva kokuthengwa kwalesi siqubulo, isigaba 33 ngeke sibe sebenza ezinkontilekayo ezinegugu elingaphansi kwe-R1 million noma njengoba kumisiwe yiMali Yezwe. Lezi zengezo zihlanganisa izigaba 19 no-33 ze-MFMA. b Isikhumbuzo esibhaliwe senani elilinganisiwe phakathi kwe-R5,000 no-R100,000; futhi c Inqubo yokubhida yokuncintisana enenani elilinganisiwe elingaphezu kwe-R100,000. Impahla nezinsizakalo ngeke zihlukaniswe zibe izingxenye noma ziqoqwe njengezinto ezinegugu eliphansi ukuze kugwenywe izidingo zomthetho. Impahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiselwa ezindlekweni ezingama-R5,000 zingathengwa ngokuthola okungenani izikhumbuzo ezintathu ezikhuluma ngokukhuluma ezivela ohlwini lwabanikezeli abavunyelwe. Zonke izikhumbuzo zizofaka izindleko zokuthutha. Abanikezeli bazohlinzeka ngamanani aqinisekisiwe ngokubhala kanye nokutholakala kwesitoko ngaphambi kokufaka i-oda. Igama lomenzi kanye namanani abawacelile azobhalwa ngumuntu ohlonishwayo ngaphakathi kwengxenye yokuthenga, njengoba kugunyaziwe nguMphathi Wezimali. Uma kungatholakali okungenani izikhumbuzo ezintathu, isizathu salokhu sizobhalwa nguMphathi Wezimali, futhi lezi zizathu zizobikwa kuMphathi Wezimali okungenani njalo ngenyanga. Impahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiselwa ezindlekweni phakathi kwe-R5,000 no-R100,000 zingathengwa ngokumema izikhumbuzo ezibhaliwe ezivela kubanikezeli abavunyelwe abathathu okungenani. Isicelo sezikhumbuzo sizolungiselelwa yiNgxenye Yokuthengwa yeMnyango Wezinsizakalo Zezimali. Ngempahla nezinsizakalo ezilinganiselwa ezindlekweni ezedlula ku-R30,000, izikhumbuzo zizoboniswa ebhodini lesaziso lesifunda elibekelwe inhloso yokubonisa izikhumbuzo nezibhedlela, kuwebhusayithi yesifunda, futhi zingakhangiswa nganoma iyiphi enye indlela ethathwa njengokufanele nguMphathi Wezimali. Lezi zikhumbuzo zizoboniswa okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-7 kusukela ngosuku zikhishwe ngalo futhi zizokhombisa usuku lokuphela kokufakwa, ngaphandle uma izimo zesigaba 10 zisebenza. Uma kungatholakali izikhumbuzo ezintathu, izizathu zalokhu kuzokwenziwa zibhale nguMphathi Wezimali futhi kuzovunywa nguMphathi Wezimali futhi kuzovunywa nguMphathi Wezimali ngaphambi kokwamukela isikhumbuzo. Kumele kuhambisane nanoma yisiphi isichasiso esidingekayo nguMphathi Wezimali (CFO). Uma ngabe nganoma yisiphi isizathu, le nqubo ayilandelwa, izizathu zalokhu kuzobhalwa nguMphathi Wezimali futhi kuvunywe nguMphathi Wezimali. Ukuze ukubhida kuthathwe, kumele kuhlangabezane nazo zonke izidingo zedokhumenti zokubhida (njengokuchazwe esigabeni 5.1) futhi kubekwe ebhokisini lokubhida elisemthethweni elibekwe njengokukhangisiwe. Ikhansela izodinga idiphozi engabuyiselwa emuva yokufaka imibhalo yokubhida. Inani lediphozi lizobuyekezwa minyaka yonke. UMphathi Wezimali noma umuntu ogunyaziwe uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhokisi okubhida avaliwe kuze kube kuvulwa ngokusemthethweni futhi ukuthi aqinisekiswe ngendlela efanele. Ngesikhathi sokukhangiswa, ibhokisi lokubhida lizovulwa futhi livalwe ngabasebenzi ababili: omunye ovela eMnyangweni Wezinsizakalo Zezimali nomunye ovela eMnyangweni Wezokuphathwa Kwezokubambisana, lapho kufanele, umphathi ovela emnyangweni lapho kubhidwa khona. Ibhokisi lizovulwa emphakathini, okusho ukuthi kukhona imibhede kanye nezithakazelo ezikhona. Umphathi Wezokuphathwa Kwezokubambisana uzovula imibhalo yokubhida (endaweni echazwe emibhalweni yokubhida) nomphathi ovela eMnyangweni Wezokuphathwa Kwezokubambisana, umnyango ofanele, kanye nanoma yiziphi izithakazelo ezikhona. Njengoba isikhathi nendawo yokukhangiswa kulandelwa kahle, ibhokisi lokubhida lingavulwa noma ngabe amalungu omphakathi awatholakali. Amagama abhidhi kanye nezindleko zokubhida zizofundwa futhi zibhale kwi-rejista yokubhida, ezotholakala ukuze kuhlolwe umphakathi uma kucelwa. Ezimweni zezinhlelo ezinkulu zokubhida ezithatha isikhathi eside ukufunda, kuphela labo abhidhi abaceliwe bazofundwa, futhi uhlu oluphelele luzonikezwa ngokushesha okukhulu. Imiphumela yokubhida izophrintwa kuwebhusayithi noma ebhodini lesaziso lesifunda. Ezinhlelweni ezinkulu ezinzima noma ezinhlelweni ezikhethekile, lapho kungadingeki futhi kungabizi kahle ukuhlela izincazelo zobuchwepheshe kusenesikhathi, ukubhida kungaqhutshelwa ezigabeni ezimbili. Isigaba sokuqala ukuhlinzeka ngeziphakamiso zobuchwepheshe ngaphandle kwezilinganiso zentengo ezisekelwe ezithombeni ezicacile noma izincazelo zokusebenza kahle. UMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zasembusweni kanye namaMEC anegunya lezamasiko, ukhethe isihloko esithi "Ukugubha Ifa Eliphilayo ('Izinto Esiphila Nazo') Ngonyaka Wesishiyagalombili Wezokhetho Lwethu" ngesikhathi somhlangano wabo we-MINMEC ngoMgqibelo 2004. Lesi sihloko sizosetshenziswa eminyakeni emithathu ezayo, kuzoqedwa ngoSepthemba 2007. Umnyango uhlose ukusebenzisa inyanga ye-Heritage njengendlela yokukhuthaza umbono wesikhathi eside wokuhlanganisa, ukugcina, ukuvikela, ukuthuthukisa, nokusabalalisa ifa eliphilayo/ifa lesizwe elingathinteki. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba imibhalo yepholisi yaseNingizimu Afrika nemithetho ivame ukubhekisela efeni eliphilayo, emhlabeni jikelele (e-UNESCO) ibizwa ngokuthi ifa lesiko elingathinteki. Le ndlela entsha iyathandwa ngaphakathi komgomo osanda kusungulwa yi-International Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, lapho abaqeqeshi nabasebenza nefa lesiko sebegqoke ukufaka ifa eliphilayo nefa lesiko elingathinteki ngokufanayo. Lapho othile ekhuluma ngefa eliphilayo, kuqondwa ukuthi ingxoxo ibhekisela efeni lesiko elingathinteki kanye nokukhula kwalo. Incazelo, njengoba iboniswe kwi-National Heritage Resources Act (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999) kanye ne-National Heritage Resources Act (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999), ifaka inqubo ephelele yemvelo, umphakathi, kanye nobudlelwano bomphakathi. Ngalesi sikhathi seMemezelo, "Ifa Lesiko Elingathinteki" libhekisela ezindleleni, emifanekisweni, ezikhombisweni, ulwazi, amakhono - kanye nezinsiza, izinto, nezindawo ezihlobene nazo - ezihlonishwa yimiphakathi, amaqembu, nabantu njengengxenye yeifa labo lesiko, edluliselwa kusuka kwesizukulwane ukuya kwesizukulwane, eqhubeka ikhiqizwa yimiphakathi namaqembu mayelana nemvelo yabo, ukuxhumana kwabo nemvelo, kanye nomlando wabo, futhi ibanika umqondo wokuhlonipha nokuphila, ngaleyo ndlela ikhuthaza ukuhlonishwa kwehlukahluka kwezamasiko kanye nokudala kwabantu. Ngalesi sikhathi seMemezelo, ukuvuma kuzokwenziwa kuphela kwifa lesiko elingathinteki elihambisana nezimiso zeziqinisekiso zomuntu njengokufunwa kokuhlonipha phakathi kwemiphakathi, amaqembu, nabantu, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okuxhaswayo. Iziqondiso zomlomo nezikhombisi, ezihlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwefa lesiko elingathinteki, nazo zifakiwe. Lezi zichazamazwi ezandulele (kokubili ngokomthetho waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nomthetho wamazwe omhlaba) zibhekisela kumqondo oxhumene kakhulu. Umkhuba ojwayelekile ufaka izinkolelo zomlomo, imiphumela, imikhuba yomphakathi, nolwazi lwemvelo, umphakathi, kanye nobudlelwano bomphakathi. Lapho othile ekwazi ukubona umehluko, akuwona umehluko ngokwakhiwa kodwa ngokuchazwa kwamagama. Ngakho-ke, ukusebenzisa lezi ziqondiso ngokufanayo, njengoba abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika benza, akuhambisani nokwephula noma iyiphi imithetho kodwa kunalokho kubonisa ukuhamba kokukhetha. Ifa eliphilayo lifana nanoma yimuphi umphumela womuntu ophathelene nesikhathi sokusungulwa kobukhosi bamazwe omhlaba kanye nabakhi benhlangano engeyabo. Kuyisakhiwo futhi kuhlala kuyisakhiwo solwazi oluphilayo lwemiphakathi ehlukene ezimweni zomlando ezithile. Kuyilokho ulwazi oluphilayo abanalo; indlela abaphatha ngayo ukuzalwa, ukukhula, ukuguga, umshado, nokufa; indlela abakhumbula ngayo lezi zinyathelo zokuthuthukiswa komuntu, indlela abaphatha ngayo ubumpofu nokushoda, indlela abakha ngayo umnotho wabo, nokuthi bangakha kanjani ukuqhubeka, indlela abaphila ngayo nabanye imiphakathi kanye nemvelo yabo, indlela abakhuluma ngayo izindaba zabo, indlela abacule ngayo futhi badanse, njll. Uhlobo lwefa eliphilayo esinalo namuhla luyingxenye yeifa elivela ebantwini abahlanganyela kusukela ezikhathini ezingakhumbuleki. Ifa eliphilayo livela ezinkolelweni zomlomo, umlando owethulwayo ngomlomo, imikhuba yomphakathi, kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi ezivumelanayo ezikhule futhi zathathelwa indawo noma zengezwa ngezilinganiso ezintsha ngenxa yokuxhumana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene yomhlaba eyayihlukene ekuqaleni ngendawo nasemhlabeni. Lokhu kuxhumana kuqhutshekiswa kakhulu ngokuhlanganiswa kwezamasiko zomhlaba okuvele ngenxa yokuphuma kobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, ukwanda kokuhamba nokuvakasha, kanye nokunciphisa ibanga phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukene. INingizimu Afrika imele isithombe esiphelele somphakathi esiyisithombe sezinhlanga ezakhiwe phezu kwefa elicebile nelihlukahlukene lesiko - ngakho-ke umqondo we-Rainbow Nation. Ngakho-ke, kufanelekile ukuthi uhulumeni wakhe indawo yokwethulwa nokuboniswa kwefa eliphilayo elihlukene lamaqembu abahlali. Lokhu kumele kwenzeke ngendlela esekela izimiso zomphakathi ongakhethi, ezisekelwe ebuhleni, ubulili, kanye nokukhubazeka, futhi ngendlela efaka bonke. Kumele futhi kwenzeke ngaphakathi komqondo wokuzama ukuthuthukisa ukwabelana kolwazi lwefa eliphilayo phakathi kwemiphakathi ngoba kungokwakho ukwabelana nokuhlonipha okufanayo nokuhlukile kwefa lesiko elingathinteki lapho sizothola khona ukuvumelana kwesizwe, ukwakha isizwe, kanye nokuhlangana komphakathi. Kuzofundisa zonke izindawo ukwabelana ngolwazi ngendlela eguquguqukayo, njengoba kuboniswe ngefa labo eliphilayo. Lokhu kungathatha ifomu lokuhlonipha kokubili umehluko nokufana. Kuzodingeka ukufunda ukuthi lezi zamasiko ezihlangene zidalela kanjani amasiko aphuma kumaqembu ahlukene anobuntu obuhlukile baseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyakhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi izinqubomgomo nemithetho esunguliwe kusukela ngo-1994 zikhuthaza ukuvuselelwa nokugcina ifa lesiko labantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezamasiko zamaqembu onke emphakathini wethu. UMthethosisekelo ophathelene nezobuciko, amasiko, kanye nefa kanye nezinhlinzeko zawo uthi i-National Heritage Resources Act (Umthetho No. 11 ka-1999) kanye ne-National Heritage Resources Act (Umthetho No. 25 ka-1999) ziqukethe ubufakazi bombono owakhiwe ukuze kufezwe le njongo. Iminyango kahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezisekelwa umphakathi, kanye nabantu bakhe izinhlelo zokwenza kube lula ukugcina nokukhuthaza ifa eliphilayo. Nakuba lezi zikhumbuleka futhi zigubha, inqubo efaka bonke eholelwa nguhulumeni kanye nezindlela eziholwa umphakathi iyadingeka ukuze kuthuthukiswe uhlelo olubanzi oluhlanganisa imicabango yazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo kumele luthinte ukuhlanganiswa kwezici zeifa eliphilayo futhi luqedele ekuthuthukisweni kwemigomo nemithetho edingekayo yokuvikela (njengesibonakaliso sokuhweba/ukufaneleka). Isikhathi esibalulekile sempilo ye-piglet siqala ekuzalweni kuze kube sekuvunyelweni. Ngokuvamile, ama-piglets amabili azalwa ngalesi sikhathi. Isizathu esikhulu esithinta lokhu ukuphathwa okungafanele, noma isizathu singaba ukuhlinzekwa ngokweqile, ukuvuza kokhuni, i-anemia, ukungondleki, noma isifo. I-sow kumele ihlanzwe futhi iphathwe ngemithi ngaphambi kokuyiswa endaweni yokuzala (okungenani ezinsukwini ezingu-4 kuya kwezi-5 ngaphambi kokuzala). I-sow esondelene nokuzala akufanele ihanjiswe endaweni yokuzala kuze kube ngesonto lokuzala, ukuze ivumeleke ukuthi ijwayele indawo yokuzala futhi yehlise ingcindezi. Indawo kumele ihlolwe kahle ukuze ibonakale izindawo eziqinile noma ama-lumps. Ama-lumps angaphathwa ngempahla yokuhlanzeka. Indawo yokuzala kumele yakhiwe kude nezinye izindawo. Ukuhlanzeka kumele kugcinwe ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuhlanza indawo yokuzala kahle ngemva kokususa i-sow kanye nama-piglets ayo. Zonke izinto eziphumile kumele zisuswe kusetshenziswa umoya ophakeme, ibhulashi lokuhlanzeka, noma isikhuhli esiqinile. Indawo kumele ihlanzwe kusetshenziswa isixazululo sokuhlanzeka esifana nesixazululo se-4% formalin. Kumele ishiywe ingenalutho ezinsukwini ezi-2 kuya kwezi-3. Ukhuni olungcolile noluwetshisiwe kumele lususwe nsuku zonke futhi lufakwe ukhuni olomile. I-sow kumele ibe nokukhiqiza ubisi okwanele; ukuntuleka kobisi kungaholela ekufeni kwama-piglets ngenxa yokungondleki. Ama-piglets kanye nomama wabo kumele aqashelwe futhi anikezwe ukunakekelwa okukhethekile, futhi udokotela wezilwane kumele abizwe ngokushesha. Ubude bokhuni lwe-umbilical bungaba cishe amacentimeter angama-12, kanti ingxenye engama-2 centimeters kumele ishiywe. Lokhu kuvikela ekulimazeni phakathi kwama-piglets ngesikhathi seziqhudelana futhi kuvikela ekubeni nokugwaza nokudonsa izindebe ze-sow. Qaphela lapho usika amazinyo ungalimazi izigaxa. Kuhle futhi kuyasiza ukushiya inyo elingama-50. Kunconywa ukusika amazinyo usebenzisa umshini ofanele wokusika amazinyo. Ama-piglets azalwa enezinsiza ze-iron, futhi ubisi lwe-sow aluhlinzeki ngezidingo ze-iron zama-piglets akhuliswe ezindlini ze-concrete. Ukuhlinzekwa nge-iron kumele kwenziwe ngokushesha ngemva kokuzalwa (ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezi-3 kuya kwezi-7) ngama-injection emzimbeni. Ama-piglets kumele abhalwe ezindlebeni ukuze kube lula ukuwazisa. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-ear tags ezingafakwa ezindlebeni. Izinhlelo zokubhaliswa kwezibalo ze-ear kumele zisetshenziswe ne-South African Pedigree Association ngezinjongo zokufuya.

Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokuguqula izindawo ezingenamibandela luhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa futhi luwumsebenzi obalulekile ekusizeni uhulumeni bendawo ukuba babambe iqhaza ngempumelelo ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinhlelo ezisekelayo ngokusebenzisa iMthetho Wokuphathwa KweZindawo Zasemakhaya kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kokwakhiwa komthetho omusha kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wokwakhiwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kanye neMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kubalulekile. Ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngomhla ziyi-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siqediwe, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesizinda esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zohulumeni bendawo zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba neqhaza lokuhlela okwakhiwe ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengomsebenzi wokuphathwa kwamamunicipality kanye nengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukufinyelela izinqumo ezimayelana nezindaba ezifana nezabelomali zamamunicipality, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngokuqonda, okuhlelekile, nendlela ebonakalayo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwamamunicipality kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma izigaba eziseduze nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamamunicipality. Esikhathini esedlule, amamunicipality avame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu ngenqubo yokuhlela i-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho uhlaka lomthetho. Amamunicipality amaningi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okudlulela Phambili) abengenazo izinsiza nezakhono zokuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe kulezi zimo, noma izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinselelo, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima bazuze kakhulu kulwazi abaluqoqile. Kukhona amamunicipality ambalwa athole inqubekela phambili enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Izincwadi zokuhola i-IDP, ezakhelwe ithimba elinobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene kusuka ku-DPLG esekelwa yi-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo elula yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukhona uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwezizwe lwezikhulu zamamunicipality, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke ababamba iqhaza kusuka kumamunicipality. Uhlelo lwezizwe lokweseka izinhlelo zamamunicipality (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zamamunicipality. Inani elikhulu lamamunicipality, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yohulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango eminingi yemboni yohulumeni ezweni iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele kulolu hlelo olusha lwezincwadi ze-IDP. Nginehope enkulu yokuthi le miphakathi yezincwadi ezishicilelwe izoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela ku-IDP nokuqhubeka kwenu ukwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ebonakalayo. Umhlahlandlela VI: Ukuphatha umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokukhuthaza izidingo ezithile kulolu hlelo lwecebo lokusebenza, ngaleyo ndlela kucaciswe kahle phakathi kwalokho okufanele kwenzeke njengoba kudingwa umthetho kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza neziphakamiso ezingekho emthethweni kulabo abafuna izeluleko ezithile ezimfunweni zokuhlela. a. Kungani kwenziwa? b. Yini elindelwe ephumeleni lenqubo yokuhlela? c. Uhlelo noma uhlelo kufanele lubukeke kanjani ukuze kufezwe umphumela ofunwayo? e. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani? Incazelo ejwayelekile yokuhlanganiswa kwezincwadi ze-IDP. Ukwazisa amaqembu abamba iqhaza ngama-oda alindelekile nezibopho ezidingekayo kule nqubo. Lokhu kubandakanya iminyango yesifunda kanye nezwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ejwayelekile kanye nekhanda elisheshayo lenqubo ye-IDP kulabo abaphethe ukuphatha inqubo. Indaba efingqiwe ihloselwe ukusiza abantu baqonde imvelaphi nenqubo ye-Integrated Development Plan ngaphandle kokugxila kakhulu ezincwadini. Uma ababamba iqhaza befuna ulwazi olunembile, kufanele babheke ezihlalweni abazithakaselayo. I-Integrated Development Plan iyinqubo lapho amamunicipality alungiselela isu lokuthuthukiswa leminyaka emihlanu. I-IDP iyithuluzi eliyinhloko lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa. I-IDP iyisikhumbuzo sokuqala sokuhlela inqubomgomo futhi ibonisa indlela phambili futhi ihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile yokuhlela, ukuhlukaniswa kwezabelomali, ukuphathwa, kanye nezinqumo ezithathwa kumakhansela noma kumamunicipality. Yini isimo somthetho se-IDPs? NgokweMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya ka-2000, wonke amamunicipality (lezo zedolobha ezinkulu, amamunicipality endawo, kanye nezifunda) kumele alandele inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ukuze akhe ama-IDPs. Njengoba i-IDP iyimfuneko yomthetho, inegunya lomthetho futhi idlula ezinye izindlela ezihola ukuthuthukiswa ezingeni lohulumeni bendawo. NgokweMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya, wonke amaKhansela amasha kanye nalabo abavula amahhovisi ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala kumele alungiselele i-IDP ezothatha iminyaka emihlanu. Ngakho-ke, i-IDP ixhunywe nesikhathi sokusebenza kwamakhansela. IKhansela elisha lingakhetha ukwamukela i-IDP eyakhelwe yibo abaphuma ezikhundleni uma ibona ifanele noma ingaqala i-IDP entsha kodwa kufanele icabangele imibhalo yezinhlelo ezikhona. iv. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda inqubo? Inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ibandakanya ukubambisana nokuxhumana futhi ifaka izakhiwo eziningi ezibamba iqhaza. Ngenxa yesidingo sokubambisana, kuthatha isikhathi esilinganiselwa ezinyangeni eziyisithupha kuya kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili ukuqeda i-IDP, futhi lesi sikhathi sihambisana kakhulu nesikhathi sokuhlela sezabelomali zamamunicipality. Kubalulekile, ngesikhathi salo, ukwethulwa kwemisebenzi yomphakathi nokuthuthukiswa akumisiwe kodwa kuyaqhubeka. I-IDP ibuyekezwa minyaka yonke, kuholela ezinguqukweni zamasu uma kudingeka. v. Yiziphi izici ezibalulekile noma izimo ze-IDPs? Ukuhlola isimo samanje sokuthuthukiswa, okubandakanya ukukhombisa imiphakathi engekho nezinsiza ezibalulekile zezempilo. Ngamafuphi, i-Integrated Development Plan ibhekana namamunicipality lapho ahlaziya khona izidingo/izinkinga eziphuthumayo, imigomo, nezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kubhekwe lezi zinselelo.
