Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokwakha imiphakathi engakhethi phakathi kwamahemuhemu luhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, luwumsebenzi obalulekile ekusizeni ohulumeni bendawo ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinhlelo ezisekelayo ngokusebenzisa umthetho weZinhlelo Zikamasipala kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa komthetho omusha wezomthetho wezokuphatha izindawo zomphakathi ngokukhuthaza umthetho wezakhiwo zamakhaya kanye nomthetho wezinhlelo zamakhaya kubalulekile. Ngemuva kokhetho lwezokuphatha bendawo olwenziwe ngomhla ka-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lokuphatha bendawo lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zokuphatha bendawo ukuze ibhekane nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokubhekelela indima yokuhlela eyakhelwe ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengomsebenzi wokuphatha emiphakathini futhi njengengxenye yesu lezinhlelo ezihlanganisiwe nezinsiza zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukubhekana nezinqumo mayelana nezabelomali zamakhaya, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxhumana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwamasipala kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma izigaba eziseduze nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamakhaya. Esikhathini esedlule, amakhaya avame ukuhamba kanzima ukuhlela izinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, bekungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. Amakhaya amaningi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Ashintshayo) ayenokuntuleka kwezinsiza kanye namandla okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, bekungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe ngalesi sikhathi, futhi akukho zinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezakhelwe futhi ezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga zonke, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima bathole inzuzo enkulu kulwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona amakhaya ambalwa athole intuthuko enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezikhona. Imibhalo ye-IDP yokuhola, eyakhelwe ithimba elihlukile le-DPLG ngokwesekwa kwe-GTZ, iphakamisa inqubo elula yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwesizwe lwabaphathi bamakhaya, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke abamele amakhaya. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokweseka izinhlelo zamakhaya (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zamakhaya. Iningi lamakhaya, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yokuphatha bendawo, kanye neminyango eminingi yezimboni zikahulumeni ezweni lethu bangengxenye yalolu hlelo futhi baphumelelisile ekwakheni le miphumela emisha ye-IDP. Nginethemba elikhulu lokuthi le miphumela yedokhumenti eprintiwe izoba yinsiza ewusizo kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enqubweni ye-IDP kanye nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ebheke phambili. Yini ebalulekile mayelana neziqondiso ze-Integrated Development Planning? Lezi ziqondiso ziphendula umbuzo OYINI? Uma ama-Integrated Development Plans (IDPs) enziwa umthetho wezomthetho wamakhaya ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Bendawo (LGTA), njengoba kuguqulwe, kusho ukuthi ngesikhathi salolu hlelo awuzona izithiyo ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe zibhekisela ezimweni zeZinjongo Zokuthuthukiswa Komhlaba (LDO) njengoba zisunguliwe kuMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa (DFA) ka-1995. I-DFA inikeza uhlaka lwezomthetho oluwusizo mayelana nezici zokuhlela nokuthuthukiswa komhlaba. Izimo ezibalulekile zezinqubomgomo, izinhlelo zomthetho, kanye nezindlela ze-IDP zasungulwa ngemuva kokuthi inqubo ye-IDP isiqalile. Uhlu lweziqondiso zezindlela lubandakanya ukuhlela, ukugxila ezindabeni ezibalulekile, isinyathelo esibheke phambili, uhlelo lwesikhathi esizayo, kanye nokubambisana nezinye izigaba. Lo mthetho ubhekisela endimeni yokuhlela emiphakathini yokubambisana. Kukhona eminye imibhalo emibili eyavela kwi-WPLG ebalulekile ekuhlelweni kokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kokusebenzisa Umhlaba uqale inqubo eholele ekunciphiseni inani lamakhaya. Lezi zindawo zikhule futhi zinekhono lokushintsha izakhiwo zezikhungo. Idokhumenti ye-Integrated Development Plan izama ukwethula uhlaka lwezamasu kulabo ababandakanyekayo engejwayelekile yokuthuthukiswa. Inhloso wukubasiza ukuthi benze umsebenzi wabo ngempumelelo. Kukhona imiyalelo nezindlela ezichaza izinyathelo ezithile okufanele zilandelwe. Lezi ziqondiso azifani nemibhalo yezomthetho edingekayo kodwa zisebenza njengemihlahlandlela ewusizo. Lezi ziqondiso ziyisisekelo sokuqeqesha, ulwazi, kanye nezinsiza. Njengoba inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe iqale ngaphambi kokuphuma kwalesi sikhala esisha, izinga lenqubo yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nemiphumela yayo kube nomthelela omkhulu kulolu hlelo. Kwamanye amakhaya, inqubo yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nemiphumela yayo, imibhalo yokuhlela ibingaphansi kokuhlanganiswa kwezidingo ezilula zesisekelo sokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Le nqubo yadala ukudideka okukhulu nokudumazeka kulabo ababandakanyekayo. Esikhundleni sokuthi isetshenziswe njengethuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zangempela zabantu kanye nemiphakathi ngendlela ekhombisa imiphumela futhi ibheka ikusasa, amakhaya amaningi akhethe ukulandela kuphela izidingo zomthetho ezincane ngosizo lwabacebisi. Ngalesi sizathu, imiphumela ibingekho ngempela ephumelelayo futhi ibingafani nomdlalo wokuthenga izinhlelo ezikhona. Ingxenye yalezi zinkinga yikhono elilinganiselwe lehulumeni bendawo, ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezinzima nezibucayi enqubo engcono nephumelelayo, kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuzisekela. Lesi simo siholela ekuthembekeni okukhulu kubakhiqizi abangabacebisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inqubo nezinhlelo zokuphatha zamakhaya zazingakabi zintsha. Izinselelo eziningi zixhomeke ekuntulekeni kokuhlelwa okucacile kwezomthetho. Ezinye izinselelo ezichazwe ngezansi zisafuna ukuxazululwa. Inhloso yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ibingacacile ngokwanele kumakhaya ambalwa ngenxa yokusondela kwayo kuma-LDOs. Ngamanye amahora, ibibhekwa njengendlela yokubamba iqhaza ekutholeni uhlu lwezinhlelo zezakhiwo ezidinga uxhaso lwangaphandle. Ngalesi sizathu, imiphumela ye-IDPs ivamise ukuba yizihloko ezilula zezimali ngaphandle kokuchaza kahle izimo zokwakhiwa kwazo nezindlela zokusebenza uma seziqalile. Bekunge
Uhulumeni wendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokwakha imiphakathi engakhethi phakathi kuhloswe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokusiza uhulumeni bendawo ukuba benze umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lokukhuthaza inqubomgomo ngokusebenzisa iMthetho Wokuhulumeni Wendawo kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kohla olusha lwezomthetho kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomphakathi kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi kubalulekile. Ngemva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngoDisemba 5, 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zohulumeni bendawo zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba indima yokuhlela edlule, i-IDP ivele njengezinsiza zokuphatha ezimiphakathini futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukubhekana nezinqumo ngezindaba ezifana nokwabiwa kwezimali zomphakathi, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxoxisana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwemiphakathi kuphela kodwa kufanele ziqondise kahle uhlaka lokusebenza kwezikhungo noma ezimbonini eziseduzane nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingekho emthethweni, ukwesekwa kwemboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zomphakathi. Esikhathini esedlule, imiphakathi kwesinye isikhathi ibihlangabezana nezinkinga zokulungiselela izinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, bekungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. Izinhlaka eziningi zomphakathi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Oguquko) zazingenazo izinsiza nezikhono zokuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, bekungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe kule ndawo, futhi bekungekho izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezibekiwe nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinselelo, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima benze kahle kakhulu ngolwazi abaluqoqe. Kunemiphakathi embalwa esithole intuthuko enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezikhona. Izikhombisi ze-IDP, ezakhelwe ithimba elihlukile le-DPLG ngoxhaso lwe-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula yokuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha olwakhiwe kubaphathi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kuhlanganisa bonke ababamba iqhaza abavela emiphakathini. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokuxhasa izinhlelo zomphakathi (PIMSS) luyakhiwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zokuhulumeni bendawo. Inani elikhulu lemiphakathi, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yohulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango ehlukene yezimboni kuhulumeni ezweni lethu iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele ekwakhekeni kwale mikhombandlela ye-IDP. Nginezithemba eziphezulu zokuthi le mikhombandlela ehlanganisiwe ezishicilelwe izoba umhlahlandlela useful futhi umthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enhlanganweni ye-IDP nezizathu zenu zokwenza i-IDP ibe ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ehlobisa ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isikhombisi sesibili sisiza ekwenzeni imiphakathi iphumelele ezinhlelweni zayo ze-IDP. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuhlobene nezinto ezenzeka lapho kulungiselelwa isigaba sokuhlela. Ngamafuphi, umqondo wenqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlela, incazelo yokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe, kanye nezizathu zakho (1.1) Ukwethula nokuchaza izidingo ezibekwe emthethweni ngokusebenzisa ukuhlela (1. Amadokhumenti ahlaziywe (nokuqukethwe) okufanele akhiwe ngenxa yesigaba sokulungiselela ukuhlela (1.3) ekugcineni, ukuveza umfanekiso obanzi wokuqukethwe kwalesi sikhombisi (isikhombisi sesibili siqukethe izinkomba kuzo zonke lezi zinyathelo zenqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlela nezinyathelo ezidingekayo). Yini okufanele ilungiswe? Ukudweba i-Integrated Development Plan kuthatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye, kuhilela abantu abahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle komphakathi. Le nqubo idinga ukuhlela ngokucophelela nokuqonda. Idinga uhlelo lwezebhizinisi. Ukuhlela ngaphakathi kwenhlangano kufanele kuqale kanye nezinqumo mayelana namalunga eqembu, amaKhansela, nezakhiwo ezizobe zikhona. Uhlelo olwakhiwe kufanele lwenziwe lucacise imisebenzi ehleliwe, isikhathi sokuphothulwa, nezinsiza ezidingekayo zokwenza ukuhlela. Le nqubo yokuhlela ibaluleke kakhulu ekulandeleni nasekuxhumaneni nabanye ababambiqhaza (ikakhulukazi phakathi kwemiphakathi yendawo nezikhulu zesifunda). Kubalulekile ukuba neqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana nezindima nezimo zokubambisana ezizobanjwa umphakathi nabanye ababambiqhaza ngesikhathi sokulungiselela. Ubani okufanele abambe iqhaza kule nqubo, ubani ozothinteka, futhi bazokwaziswa kanjani ngesikhathi sokuqhubeka kwenqubo? Lezi zonke yizinkinga okufanele ziphendulwe ukuze kwaziswe abantu ngesikhathi futhi kuphathwe kahle izinsiza ezidingekayo. Izinhlelo ezifanayo zingahlelwa ngezindima nezimo ezizobekwa kulabo abavela ngaphandle komphakathi, njengemiphakathi eminye, izifunda, kanye nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni. Le misebenzi yokubambisana kufanele ibekwe ngendlela ebindayo kumphakathi ngokusebenzisa uhlaka lokuhlela oluhlanganyelwe oludingeka ukuthi lwenziwe kahle ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amadokhumenti adinga ukucatshangelwa ngaphambi kokuthi uhlelo luqale ayaziwa futhi atholakale. Umsebenzi wokulungiselela i-IDP awuyona imfanelo yezikhulu zamakhansela. Inqubo yokulungiselela kufanele ibe nomthelela ekuzilungiseleleni komphakathi ngokusebenzisa inqubo ye-IDP. Ngakho-ke, akekho ozokwenza isinqumo somphakathi ngaphandle komphakathi uqobo. Isikhombisi sesibili sihlose ukusiza umphathi womphakathi ekwenzeni umsebenzi wokulungiselela ngendlela elula futhi eqondile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nezidingo ezibalulekile ezilindelekile ezingeni lomphakathi uma kudalwa inqubo ye-IDP kanye nokuxhumana okufanele nezakhiwo zikahulumeni, izinhlelo zenqubo kufanele ziphathwe nguMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi ka-2000. Lo Mthetho awubeki lutho oluhlukile mayelana nezimo ezijwayelekile zokwenza izinhlelo. a Ukwamukela uhlelo olubhalwe yimikhiqizo yendawo noma yesifunda futhi luphakanyisiwe ukuze kuhlolwe inqubo yokuhlela, ukuhlela, ukwamukela, nokubuyekeza i-IDP. Lo mbhalo obhalwe nge-IDP uzobizwa ngokufushane ngokuthi "Uhlaka Lwenqubo" lwesikhombisi. Izimo, izindima, nezinhlelo zokuxhumana nokubambisana okufanele kwenziwe nomphakathi, izakhiwo zikahulumeni, amaKhansela endabuko, kanye nabanye ababamba iqhaza enhlanganweni ye-ID
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokuguqula ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amaMasipala awahlukanisi, oluhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, luwumsebenzi obalulekile ekusizeni uhulumeni bendawo ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinqubomgomo ezisekelayo ngokwethula iBhili Yezokuhulumeni Bendawo. Ukuveza uhlaka olusha lwezomthetho kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho WamaMasipala kanye neMthetho Wamasistimu AmaMasipala. Ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngomhla ziyi-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesizinda esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingelinye lamathuluzi ohulumeni bendawo ahloselwe ukubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba nendima yokuhlela eyasungulwa ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengethuluzi lokuphatha amaMasipala futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nezindaba ezifana nokwabiwa kwezimali zamamasipala, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxhumana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa azizokusiza kuphela ukuphathwa kwamamasipala kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma imikhakha eduze kukahulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe kuhulumeni, ukwesekwa kwemboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamamasipala. Esikhathini esedlule, amaMasipala avame ukuba angakulungelanga ekuhlinzekeni ngezinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, bekungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. AmaMasipala amaningi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okuguqula) ayenokuntuleka kwezinsiza kanye namakhono okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, bekungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe kahle ngalokhu, futhi bekungekho izinhlelo zoktraining eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinkinga, bonke ababambiqhaza kule ndima benze kahle kakhulu ngolwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona amaMasipala ambalwa athole intuthuko enkulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezivele zikhona. Izincwadi Zezikhumbuzo ze-IDP, ezasungulwa yiqembu elihlukile le-DPLG elisekelwa yi-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukhona uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwesizwe lwabaphathi bamamasipala, abasebenzi bezobuchwepheshe, amakhandidethi, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke ababambiqhaza abakwi-masipala. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokuxhasa izinhlelo zikamasipala (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala. Inani elikhulu lamamasipala, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yokuhulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango eminingi kahulumeni embonini ezweni, iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele kule ngqophamlando ye-IDP. Ngibheke phambili kakhulu ukuthi le ngqophamlando yeziqu ezishicilelwe izoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela kwi-IDP nezinselelo zenu zokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ebonisa ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kukhona ukuvumelana ngesidingo sokuba nezikhombisi ezicacile, eziqondile, nezilula zokusebenzisa kanye nesidingo sesu lokuhlela elinikeza indawo yokuxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile, okungabhekwa kuphela ngochwepheshe bokuhlela abakhiqiza imibhalo nomsebenzi wamahhovisi. Inselelo yesu elilula ayilula neze. Inqubo yokuxhumana idinga ukubamba iqhaza okubonakalayo emikhakheni ehlukene yomphakathi ngokwezihlungi ezihlukene zokuhlaziya nokuthi izinqumo zenziwe. Ukubandakanya wonke umuntu kusho ithuba lokubamba iqhaza kulokho okukhuluma ngakho nezinkulumo ngesikhathi esifanele ebhodini, futhi akulula futhi ukuqhuba lo msebenzi. Inqubo yokuqala yesu idinga umqondo ocacile, ukuhlaziywa okuhlelekile ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezifanele, kubhekwa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, nokucabanga ngama-oda nezikhombisi ezisunguliwe. Lokhu kudlula nje ekwakheni uhlu lwezinto ezithuthukisiwe nokukuhumusha kube iziphakamiso zezimali. Inqubo ehlanganisiwe idinga ukucabanga nokubheka izinto ngokubanzi futhi ukusabalalisa kwezinye izikhala zemboni. Uhlelo oluhlanganisiwe oluqinile oluqhuba umsebenzi futhi lufuna ukuchaza kahle izindleko, isikhathi, ubuningi, izibopho, indawo, izinga lomsebenzi, kanye nendawo lapho umsebenzi uzolethwa khona. Lokhu kudlula nje ohlwini lwezikhundla zomsebenzi ezizokwenziwa. Inselelo yokuhlela i-IDP ukuhlanganisa lezi zidingo ezintathu ngenhloso yokufinyelela inqubo yokwenza izinqumo ngendlela yokuxhumana, ucabanga ngokujulile ngesimo, futhi uqhubekisela phambili impumelelo yomsebenzi uma usuqalile. Kubandakanya inqubo ekhombisa umcimbi lapho i-IDP ihlelwa, hhayi ukukhombisa ithuluzi noma isu. Ukucabanga ngohlelo njengochungechunge lwezikhathi kulula kunokucabanga ngochungechunge lwezithuluzi zokuhlela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhuthaza inqubo yokuxhumana nokucabanga phambili ngezinto ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kuhlukanisa kahle phakathi kweGeneral IDP Process (Guideline III) esebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamamasipala kanye nezindlela zokuhlela ezithile kanye nezithuluzi (Guideline IV) ezingase zihluke kakhulu kumasipala owodwa kuya kwelinye. Ihloselwe ukusebenzisa ulimi olulula ngokugwema amagama anzima nezinkinga ezinzima ezisetshenziswa ngabalungisi. Imicimbi yokuhlela ivame ukuba yizihlanganiso noma ama-workshop wesakhiwo sokuhlela esilawula inqubo ye-IDP (Community Representative Council, IDP Steering Committee, Working Group) futhi kwezinye izikhathi, kungabandakanya imisebenzi eyenziwa ngabantu (njengokuhlanganiswa kolwazi, ucwaningo, njll). Umcimbi ngamunye kufanele ube nomphumela othile. Le mpumelelo ingaba uhlobo oluthile lolwazi noma isinqumo. Eminye imiphumela incike ezidingweni zomthetho, ezinye ziwumthelela wezinto ezijwayelekile futhi zisiza ekulandeleni inqubo enephetho. Kuwo wonke umcimbi wokuhlela, kunikezwa iziphakamiso mayelana nohlobo lwezinhlelo kanye nabantu okufanele babambe iqhaza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lubandakanya zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo futhi luhlanganyela. Indlela yokuhlela ayisho okuningi ngama-thuluzi athile okukhona okufanele asetshenziswe kuwo wonke umcimbi. Lezi zithuluzi zihluka kumasipala kuya kumasipala. Amakhansela amamasipala angasebenzisa izindlela zokuhlela ezithuthukile ezinekhompyutha. AmaMasipala eSigaba B angase enze inqubo yokuhlela efanayo kodwa asebenzise indlela ecacile. Lapha, umthetho ka-1998 mayelana nokulawulwa kwezinsolo zokuhamba emgwaqweni uguqulwa ukuze kulawulwe ukwakheka kweBhodi; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqokwa nguNgqongqoshe kwabantu abaphethe ukuqhuba umthetho (ama-sheriffs); ukuthola nokwandisa isikhathi sokukhokha izijeziso zokwephula umthetho wezokuhamba emgwaqweni nokubhekana nezinye izindaba ezihlobene, ukuhlela lokho okubhalwe; nokuhlinzeka ngeminye imibandela ehlobene. a ukukhuthaza ukuhlonishwa kwemithetho kazwelonke [nokuh] imithetho yesifunda nemunicipal ehlobene nemigwaqo nokukhuthaza ukuphepha emigwaqweni; futhi b ukususa isigaba f. UNgqongqoshe kufanele, ngaphambi kokuba aqoke amalungu akhuluma ngawo esigabeni 1a, aphumelele amagama abantu abaphakanyisiwe ukuze baqokwe njengamalungu ku-Government Gazette futhi acela impendulo yomphakathi mayelana nokuqokwa kwalezi zinsizwa. a phumeza isaziso ku-Government Gazette sikhombisa ukuthi uhlose ukuqoka lowo muntu, umema umphakathi ukuba uthumele imibono yabo noma izikhalazo mayelana nokuqokwa, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo esazisweni; futhi b cabanga ngamakhasimende nezikhalazo ezitholiwe njengempendulo kulowo mzamo. ngizokhokha kwiKhansela isijeziso, izimali ezichaziwe zokwakhiwa, kanye nezindleko zencwadi ebhalwe noma ngizohlela neKhansela ngendlela echaziwe yokukhokha kancane, ngaphakathi [28] 32 izinsuku ngemuva kokukhishwa kwesaziso esibika ukwephula umthetho; futhi ii ukuthi ukungakhokhi isijeziso nezimali ezidingekayo noma ukungahleleli ukukhokha kancane kuzoholela ekukhishweni kwesaziso sokumangalela lowo ophule umthetho, futhi kuzokwenza ophule umthetho abhekane nokukhokha isijeziso, ezinye izimali ezidingekayo, kanye nanoma yiziphi izimali ezinqunywe yokuqhubeka komthetho. c uma ophule umthetho ekhetha ukuvela enkantolo, okungenzeka kuphela uma kucelwa ummeleli, izinhlinzeko zesigaba 22 zizosebenza. b ukukhishwa kwesaziso sokuthi ophule umthetho kufanele, ngaphakathi [28] 32 izinsuku ngemuva kosuku aluthola ngalo isaziso sokwephula umthetho --. a ithuba lokukhokha isijeziso nezimali ezidingekayo uma zikhona, noma ukuhlela ukukhokha kancane, le ndaba kufanele ibhekwane ngaphandle kokuthi ezinye izinyathelo zicatshangelwe; futhi b kwezinye izimo ezihilela isinyathelo sokuthi le ndaba iyokwenziwa enkantolo, le nyathelo akufanele lisetshenziswe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nale ndaba ngaphandle kokuthi ithathwe enkantolo ngokulandela inqubo yokubhekwa echaziwe kulo mthetho. a ukuthi inani eliphelele elikweletwayo, kuhlanganise nenani elichaziwe lesaziso, kumele likhokhwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-32 ngemuva kokuthola isaziso, futhi b ukuthi ukungahambisani nesaziso esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni a kungaholela ekukhishweni kwesaziso sokumangalela kuye ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 21. a kwiKhansela ephethe ukubhaliswa; noma b emsakazweni ophatha izitifiketi zokushayela. kwiKhansela yendawo ephethe ukubhaliswa noma emsakazweni wendawo ophatha izitifiketi zokushayela. IKhansela yendawo ephethe ukubhaliswa noma emsakazweni ophatha izitifiketi zokushayela kufanele ibuyekeze njalo irekhodi lesizwe labaphula umthetho, futhi ibike iKhansela ngendlela echaziwe uma kukhona izimali ezikhokhwayo futhi ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni futhi idlulisele le mali ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo futhi uma lokho kungasebenzi, iKhansela kufanele ifune inzalo ebaliwe ngezinga elichaziwe. Uma umyalo wokuphathwa uphumelelwa, imiphumela ehilelekile kufanele ibuyiselwe, futhi uma ihilela ukusula kwesitifiketi sokushayela somuntu noma ukusetshenziswa kwemoto, irekhodi lesizwe labaphula umthetho kufanele lifake le mininingwane b ophule umthetho kufanele abike ngendlela echaziwe ukuthi isitifiketi sakhe sokushayela noma imvume noma ikhadi lokushayela kuzobuyiselwa kuye noma ukuthi ukuvinjelwa kwesitifiketi kuzokhishwa ngaphandle kokuthi ukuvinjelwa kwenziwe ngezimo ezihlukile. b ukuguqulwa esigabeni I sesigaba esilandelayo. b ukukhishwa kwesaziso sokumangalela ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 211 akukhombisi impahla engathathwa noma ethengiswa noma ophule umthetho engahambisani nomyalo wokuphathwa ngemuva kokukhishwa komyalo, iKhansela kufanele ibike iziphathimandla ezikhishile isaziso, ezidinga ukusula isaziso sokwephula umthetho futhi iziphathimandla ezikhishile isaziso kufanele [kukhishwe] kulungiswe amarekhodi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho ka-1977 mayelana nenqubo yezindaba Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977. a ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1 a nokungaveli noma ukufika, inkantolo akufanele ikhishwe umyalelo wokubamba nakuba izinhlinzeko zesigaba 55 zomthetho wezindaba zikhuluma ngalokho kodwa umgibeli wenkantolo kufanele abike iziphathimandla ezikhishile isaziso, ezidinga ukuhlinzeka iKhansela futhi umgibeli kufanele aqhubeke nokukhishwa komyalo wokuphathwa ophule umthetho okukhuluma ngaso esigabeni 201; futhi b ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1 b le ndaba kufanele ibhekwane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho ka-1977 mayelana nenqubo yezindaba. Nakuba kungase kube nomthetho omunye, ophule umthetho [obhekwana] mayelana neye ndaba yakhe ngaphansi kwaleli sahluko akavunyelwe ukuba abhekane nezindaba ezindala futhi akukho futhi ukuhlinzekwa kokuthi abanjwe ngezizathu ezifanayo. A Ukuqoshwa kwamaphuzu ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi okukhuluma ngamasigaba 3 no-4, umgibeli wenkantolo kufanele abike iKhansela ngemiphumela yalokho kanye naleyo sikhathi senkantolo noma ukudluliselwa kwayo. Uma umuntu ethola amaphuzu ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi, lapho ehambisana nalawo maphuzu lowo muntu unawo kwi-rekhodi lesizwe labaphula umthetho futhi le mali isuswa njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 28 inani [lidlula] inani elikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 29d, lowo muntu uzokwenqaba ukuba ashaye noma asebenzise imoto [ngokulandela inqubo echaziwe] lokhu kuzothatha umphumela ezinsukwini eziyi-32 ngemuva kokuthi unikezwe lawo maphuzu adlula inani. Noma ubani ongahambisani nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 3 a noma oshayela noma asebenzisa imoto ngesikhathi sokuvinjelwa kwakhe uphula umthetho futhi lokho kungaholela ekubeni akhokhelwe isijeziso noma aboshwe isikhathi esingadluli unyaka noma abanjwe kokubili isijeziso nokuvalelwa. Uma isikhathi sokuvinjelwa siphelelwe, umuntu okukhuluma ngaye esigabeni 3 angafaka isicelo ngendlela echaziwe eziphathimandleni ezikhishile isaziso ukuze abuyiselwe isitifiketi sokushayela, imvume, noma ikhadi. Isaziso esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 1 kumele sithunyelwe kwiKhansela, okufanele ibike iziphathimandla ezikhishile isaziso, kanye neziphathimandla zendawo lapho umuntu okukhuluma ngaye ehlala khona. a Umuntu othole amaphuzu ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi futhi uvinyelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 25 sokushayela nokusebenzisa
Ukusungula uhlaka olulodwa lokulawula ukudluliswa kukagesi, igesi emaphethelweni, kanye nezimboni zegesi zezimoto zokukhanyisa; nokuhlinzeka ngemicimbi nezindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wezokuphakelwa Kwamandla Waziswa njengento enomthetho. Umthetho Wezokuphakelwa Kwamandla uqukethe amalungu amathathu aphezulu kanye namalungu amahlanu wesikhashana aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhethe elinye lamalungu aqokwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 njengomholi woMthetho Wezokuphakelwa Kwamandla. UNgqongqoshe kumele aqokwe omunye wamalungu aphezulu ukuze abhekane ngqo nokulawula ugesi, omunye wokulawula igesi, kanti omunye wokulawula amaphethini. Uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe nganoma iyiphi indlela, amalungu amanye kumele akhethe omunye phakathi kwabo ukuze abe umholi kuze kube umholi angabuyela emisebenzini yakhe noma omunye umholi aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angakwazi futhi ukuqoka ilungu; futhi uma ilungu lesikhashana noma eliphelele leMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla linqamuka emsebenzini nganoma iyiphi indlela, uNgqongqoshe angakwazi ukuqoka omunye umuntu endaweni yalo isikhathi esingadluli ezinyangeni eziyishumi nambili ngokuhambisana nesigaba 67. Amalungu eMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele akhokhelwe ngemiholo nezinzuzo njengoba kunqunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezithakazelo mayelana nalolu daba. Ngendlela eqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanele phakathi kokuphindaphinda nokukwazi ukwakha. Ilungu kumele lingabi khona nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ezingxoxweni, ekwenzeni izinqumo, noma lithathe ingxenye kunoma iyiphi indaba phambi kweMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla lapho ilungu noma umkakhe, umlingani, ingane, noma umuntu abambisene naye ngothando ngqo noma ngokuqondile kubandakanyeka. Uma ilungu lithola noma likholelwa ukuthi lingase libe nentshisekelo yezezimali esigabeni 3 b, lelo lungelo kumele lishaywe uNgqongqoshe kanye neMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ngokubhalwe phansi. Uma beshadile noma behlala nomuntu impilo yabo yonke othola noma okholelwa ukuthi ungase ube nentshisekelo yezezimali esigabeni 3 b, lelo lungelo kumele lishaywe uNgqongqoshe kanye neMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ngokubhalwe phansi. Ngaphambi kokuba uNgqongqoshe aqoke ilungu leMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla, uNgqongqoshe kumele, ngokuqaphela kwiGazethi, acela ukuthi abanguqobo bakhethwe phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Isaziso esishicilelwe ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale lo Mthetho, sicela ukukhethwa kwabantu bokuqala abazokwakhiwa kuMthetho Wezokuphakelwa Kwamandla, kufanele sithathwe njengokushicilelwa ngempela ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7. Lokhu kuphula isivumelwano sokwenza umsebenzi ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho noma uMthetho Wegesi noma uMthetho Wamaphethini ukuze kukhanyiswe; noma kukhishwa ekubeni ilungu nganoma yiziphi zezizathu ezikhuluma esigabeni 6 1. UNgqongqoshe angakwazi ukuvalela umsebenzi walungu leMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla uma lelo lungelo lenza ngendlela ephikisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 9. Imihlangano yeMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla a Imithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele ihlangane ngezikhathi nezindawo ezinqunywe ngumholi. b Umholi uzobiza imihlangano yeMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuqhutshekwe kahle nemisebenzi yayo. Umholi, uma esethole isicelo esibhaliwe esivela kumphathi ophakeme noma kumalungu amabili, uzobiza umhlangano okhethekile ozobanjwa phakathi nezinsuku ezimbili zokuthola leso sicelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi ezinye izinqubo zisetshenziswe, umholi wanoma yimuphi umhlangano weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele uphakamise izinqubo ezizolandela kulawo mahlangano. I-quorum yomhlangano weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ibandakanya iningi lamalungu akhona noma amalungu amane, noma yikuphi okukhulu. a Isinqumo seningi lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni simele isinqumo seMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla. b Uma ukuvota kuhlangana kunoma iyiphi indaba, umuntu ophatha umhlangano unelungelo lokuvota elengeziwe ngaphandle kokuba nelungelo lokuvota. Akukho isinqumo esenziwe yiMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla esizoba sephukile ngenxa yokuba khona kwesikhala kuMthetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla noma ngenxa yokuthi omunye umuntu onelungelo lokuhlala njengelungu ubekhona njengelungu ngesikhathi isinqumo sithathwa uma wonke amalungu amanye abekhona emhlanganweni futhi enelungelo lokuhlala njengamalungu emhlanganweni, ngaleyo ndlela kwakha i-quorum futhi isinqumo sathathwa ngaphezulu kwamalungu akhona futhi anelungelo lokuvota. Umphathi ophakeme noma, uma engatholakali, umsebenzi weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla oqokwe umphathi ophakeme, kumele abe khona kuwo wonke imihlangano yeMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla futhi kumele abe nelungelo lokukhuluma kodwa angavoti kulawo mahlangano. a Noma yimuphi umhlangano weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele uvumele umphakathi ukuba ube khona ngaphandle uma umhlangano unquma ukuthi indaba ezoxoxwa iyimfihlo, noma ulwazi olunobungozi mayelana nokubambisana, lapho-ke umuntu othintekayo kumele azise iMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ukuthi ulwazi olunjalo lungafanele lukhululwe emphakathini. b Uma iMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla ithatha isinqumo nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle komhlangano osemthethweni, leso sinqumo sithatha umthelela ngokushesha kodwa kumele sibhale, sigcwaliswe ngamalungu amaningi, futhi sithunyelwe ukuze siqinisekiswe emhlanganweni wokuqala osemthethweni weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kulandela leso sinqumo. c I-Mithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele ibe nesizathu sokugcina amarekhodi wonke emisebenzi yayo. Uhlelo lwegesi; kanye iii Akukho Mthetho Wamaphethini wokukhanyisa. e abangenakufinyelela noma ukuhoxisa ekuvoteni noma ekuxoxeni nganoma iyiphi indaba ethinta iMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla abanakho ukungenelela ngqo noma ngokuqondile; futhi f ukwenza njengoba kudingeka futhi kulindeleke kubabambisene bezikhundla zomphakathi. t ngokubhalwe phansi; futhi g ngokuchaza kahle ukuze kusekelwe kuMthetho kanye nezinto nezizathu zalokho. Noma yisiphi isinqumo seMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kanye nezizathu zaso kumele zivezwe emphakathini ngaphandle uma iMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla inquma ukuthi imfihlo, iyabucayi, iyathengiswa, noma iyimakethe. Noma ubani othintekile ngempela ngezinsizakalo zeMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla angakwazi ukulethela lezi zinqumo ukuze zihlolwe eNkantolo Ephakeme. I-Mithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla kumele iqoke umphathi ophakeme weMithetho Yokuphakelwa Kwamandla. b Ukuze uqashe abasebenzi noma ungene ezivumel

Uma kwenzeka ukungqubuzana phakathi kwalemthetho nezinye izinqumo ezisemthethweni ngaphandle koMthethosisekelo ezazisebenza ngesikhathi le mthetho waqala, le mthetho izobusa. Ngokwezinsika 202 no-204 zoMthethosisekelo, amandla anikezwe uNobhala Wezokuvikela kanye noMholi weMpi ngaphansi kwalemthetho kufanele asebenze ngokuhambisana nezinqumo zikaNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngokwemithetho ephethe izisebenzi zomphakathi, anikeze inani elidingekayo labantu ukuze bagcwalise izikhala ezikhona koMnyango Wezokuvikela njengoba kudingeka. Nakuba kukhona isigaba 2, uma amalungu eMpi efisa, angabekwa ezandleni zikaNobhala Wezokuvikela ukuze angene ezikhundleni koMnyango Wezokuvikela. Amalungu eMpi ezikhundleni koMnyango Wezokuvikela kufanele ahlale ehambisana nazo zonke izinqumo ezisebenzayo kubo koMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezikhungo eziphezulu. UPresident kufanele, ngokuhambisana nemithetho ephethe izisebenzi zomphakathi, anikeze umuntu ukuze athathe isikhundla sikaNobhala. UNobhala Wezokuvikela uhlala kulesi sikhundla isikhathi esifanayo nalabo bonke abaphathi bezigaba kanye nemithetho abahamba ngayo, umholo wabo namalungelo afana nalabo baphathi bezigaba. UNobhala Wezokuvikela kufanele abe yisakhamuzi futhi akavunyelwe ukuba ilungu leMpi. a Kufanele abhekwane njengomsebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 1; futhi b Qhubeka nokusebenza kulesi sikhundla ngaphansi kwemithetho efanele, kuze kube isikhathi sokusebenza kulesi sikhundla siphele. Amakomidi ePhalamende aqapha ukuthi iminyango iyayilandela yini imithetho ebekwe. e Kufanele anikeze uMholi weMpi imiyalelo eningiliziwe edingekayo ukuze akwazi ukuhlela amalungu emisebenzi efanele nezikhungo zokwenza imisebenzi ethile enikezwe yena nguNobhala Wezokuvikela njengomholi nomphathi wezomnotho koMnyango Wezokuvikela. f Kufanele aqinisekise ukuhambisana nemithetho ethunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe edluliselwa kuMholi weMpi owenza umbiko ngalokho kuNgqongqoshe; futhi g Unesibopho sokuhola izinqubo zokuziphatha kanye nokuphathwa kwezisebenzi, kuhlanganisa nokusetshenziswa kwazo kahle nokuqeqeshwa. Leli thuba lokudlulisa noma ukudlulisa amandla njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 alivimbeli uNobhala Wezokuvikela ekuphatheni izindaba zakhe. Noma ukuphatha noma ukuhlela ngokuhambisana nomthetho; noma d Qhuba uphenyo olwamukelekayo futhi nemithetho engalandelwa. ekupheleni kwezivumelwano zokuqashwa kwabo; noma iii khululwa ezinye izindlela kwiMpi ngokuhambisana noMthetho; futhi b Akukho Msebenzi Wezinqola ongaba namalungu akhe asebenza okwamanje ngaphansi kwezivumelwano ngaphandle uma imisebenzi yabo iphelile ngemuva kwemithetho. i emsebenzini; futhi ii neMpi Esemthethweni noma iMpi yeZinqola noma zombili; futhi b UMholi weMpi angasungula umkhakha wesikhashana, iqembu, ingxenye noma iyunithi njengoba kudingwa yiMpi, futhi izisekelo zesikhashana zingasungulwa njengoba kudingeka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezikhona. UMholi weMpi kufanele abe yisakhamuzi futhi abe ilungu leMpi Esemthethweni. a kufanele abhekwane njengomsebenzi wesikhashana ngaphansi kwesigaba 1; futhi b qhubeka nokusebenza kulesi sikhundla ngaphansi kwemithetho yokusebenza ayisebenzayo kuze kube isikhathi sokusebenza kulesi sikhundla siphele. Noma ubani oqashwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi ka-1994, Isikhangiso No. 103 ka-1994, osebenza ngaphansi kweMpi; futhi c Noma emsebenzini uma kuvunyelwe nguNobhala Wezokuvikela. Uxoxa ngezici ezahlukene zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zezimbiwa nezamafutha, kuhlanganise namalungelo okucwaninga nokumba, imithwalo yemfanelo kahulumeni kanye nezinkampani zokumba, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola izimvume nezitifiketi. Uveza ukubaluleka kokuvikelwa kwemvelo kanye nesidingo sokuhambisana nezindinganiso zomthetho. Umbhalo uveza izindima zababambiqhaza abahlukene, kuhlanganise noNgqongqoshe, uMnyango Wezimbiwa, kanye nomphakathi, ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zezimbiwa. Ubuye uphinde uqhubele phambili izindaba eziphathelene nokukhokhelwa kwabanikazi bezindawo kanye nomthethonqubo ophatha imisebenzi yokumba.

Ngemibuzo evulekile ethinta amagama ezindawo zokuhlala, umsebenzi, imboni, umxoxisi kufanele abhale impendulo ecacile endaweni ethile. Zama ukuvimbela ukubhala endaweni yomunye umuntu womndeni. Ungabhalela "akuhambisani" uma kudingeka, ngaphandle uma impendulo icacile futhi ifanele kahle kule kolomu. Sebenzisa ipeni eliyindilinga; uma wenza iphutha, sebenzisa i-eraser ukulungisa lelo phutha bese ubhala impendulo efanele futhi. Ukusebenzisa ipeni eliyindilinga kusiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ungakwazi ukulungisa amaphutha, kusiza emsebenzini wokubhalwa, futhi kunciphisa amaphutha okubhala abonakalayo. Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokuguqulwa kwemiphakathi engakhethi, oluhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, luhamba phambili ekusizeni uhulumeni bendawo ukuba banikele ngempumelelo ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lokuphakela umthetho ngokusebenzisa iMthethosisekelo Wabaholi Bendawo kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kwehlaka elisha lezomthetho kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomkhandlu kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomkhandlu kubalulekile. Ngemva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngoDisemba 5, 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zikamasipala zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba neqhaza lokuhlela okwakukhona, i-IDP ivele njengomsebenzi wokuphatha umkhandlu futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukufinyelela ezinqumweni ezimayelana nezabelo zebhajethi yomkhandlu, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, kanye nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxoxisana, ehlelekile, futhi eqondile. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza kuphela ukuphathwa komkhandlu kodwa kufanele futhi ziqhube ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma imikhakha eduze kukahulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zomkhandlu. Esikhathini esedlule, imiphakathi ivame ukuba nezinselelo ezinkulu ngenqubo yokuhlela i-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho hlelo lwezomthetho. Imiphakathi eminingi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okudlula) yayingenazo izinsiza kanye namakhono okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezivivinyiwe kulolu suku, noma izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinkinga, bonke ababambiqhaza kulolu hlelo bathole inzuzo enkulu kulwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona imiphakathi embalwa ethole intuthuko enkulu ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezisebenzayo. Izincwadi zokuhola ze-IDP, ezakhelwe ithimba elinobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene oluvela kwi-DPLG olusekelwe yi-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula. Kukhona uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwesizwe lwabaphathi bomkhandlu, abasebenzi abachwepheshile, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kufaka bonke ababambiqhaza abavela kumasipala. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokuxhasa izinhlelo zikamasipala (PIMSS) luyakhiwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala. Inani elikhulu lemiphakathi, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda kahulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango eminingi yezezimboni zikahulumeni ezweni lethu ingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele kuleli qoqo elisha lezincwadi ze-IDP. Nginehope enkulu yokuthi leli qoqo lezincwadi ezishicilelwe lizoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enhlanganweni ye-IDP nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela eyakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umhlahlandlela VI: Ukuphatha umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokukhuthaza izidingo ezithile kulolu suku lwecebo lokusebenza, ngaleyo ndlela kucacisa phakathi kokuthi yini okufanele kwenzeke njengoba kudingeka umthetho kanye nenqubomgomo neziphakamiso ezingadingeki kulabo abafuna izeluleko ezithile emisebenzini yokuhlela. a. Kungani kwenziwa? b. Yini elindelekile emiphumeleni yokuhlela? c. Yini okufanele inqubo noma uhlelo lubukeke ukuze kufezwe umphumela ofunwayo? e. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani? Incazelo ejwayelekile ye-IDP guideline booklet collection. Ukubika amaqembu abamba iqhaza ngemicimbi elindelekile kanye nezibopho ezidingekayo kule nqubo. Lokhu kufaka iminyango yesifunda kanye nesizwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo ejwayelekile kanye nokubuka okusheshayo kwe-IDP ukuze kulabo abaphethe ukuphatha inqubo. Indaba efingqiwe ihlelwe ukusiza abantu baqonde imvelaphi nenqubo ye-Integrated Development Plan ngaphandle kokugxila kakhulu encwadini. Uma ababambiqhaza befuna ulwazi olunembile, kufanele babheke ezikhombisweni abazithakaselayo. I-Integrated Development Plan inqubo lapho imiphakathi ilungiselela isu lokuthuthukiswa leminyaka emihlanu. I-IDP iyithuluzi eliyinhloko lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa. I-IDP iyindawo yokuqala yokuhlela umthetho futhi ibonisa indlela phambili futhi ihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile yokuhlela, ukusabalalisa ibhajethi, ukuphathwa, kanye nokwenza izinqumo kumaKhansela noma kumasipala. Yini isimo somthetho se-IDPs? Ngokusho kweMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomkhandlu ka-2000, zonke izindawo (lezo zamadolobha amakhulu, izindawo zomphakathi, kanye nezifunda) kumele zilandele inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ukuze zikhulise i-IDPs. Njengoba i-IDP iyimfuneko yomthetho, inegunya lomthetho futhi idlula ezinye izindlela ezihola ukuthuthukiswa ezingeni likamasipala. Ngokusho kweMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomkhandlu, wonke umkhandlu omusha kanye nalabo abavula amahhovisi ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala kumele balungiselele i-IDP ezothatha iminyaka emihlanu. Ngakho-ke, i-IDP ixhunyaniswe nesikhathi sokusebenza kwamaKhansela. Umkhandlu omusha ungakhetha ukuthatha i-IDP eyasungulwa yilabo abahamba ezikhundleni uma ubona kufanelekile noma ungase ube ne-IDP entsha kodwa kufanele ucabangele imibhalo yezinhlelo ezikhona. iv. Kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuqeda inqubo? Inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ifaka ukubambisana nokuxhumana futhi ibandakanya izakhiwo eziningi ezibamba iqhaza. Ngenxa yesidingo sokubambisana, kuthatha cishe izinyanga eziyisithupha kuya kweziyisishiyagalombili ukuqeda i-IDP, futhi lesi sikhathi sihambisana kakhulu nesikhathi sebhajethi yomkhandlu. Kubalulekile, ngesikhathi lesi, ukwethulwa kwemisebenzi yomphakathi nokuthuthukiswa akusimeme kodwa kuqhubeka. I-IDP ibuyekezwa minyaka yonke, kuholela ezinguqukweni zamasu uma kudingeka. v. Yiziphi izingxenye ezisemqoka noma izimo ze-IDPs? Ukuhlola isimo samanje sokuthuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa nokugqamisa imiphakathi engenazo izinsiza ezibalulekile zezempilo. Ngamafuphi, i-Integrated Development Plan ibhekana nemiphakathi lapho ihlaziya izidingo eziphuthumayo/izinkinga, izinhloso, nezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kubhekwe lezi zinkinga. Isigaba esibaluleke kakhulu se-IDPs ukuhlanganisa uhlelo nebhajethi yomkhandlu (ukuhlukanisa izimali ezitholwe ngaphakathi nezitholwe ngaphandle kwezinto ezivumelwene ngazo) ngoba impumelelo yezinhlelo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kuxhunywe ku-IDP. vi. Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokusungulwa kwemiphakathi engakhethi phakathi kwabantu luhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa futhi luwumkhankaso obalulekile ukusiza uhulumeni bendawo ukuba benze umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukisweni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinqubomgomo ezisekelayo ngokusebenzisa umthetho Wokuhulumeni Bendawo kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kwesigaba esisha somthetho wokuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza umthetho wezakhiwo zemiphakathi kanye nomthetho wezinhlelo zemiphakathi kubalulekile. Ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngomhla ziyi-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe (IDP) lungesinye sezinsiza zokuhulumeni bendawo zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba neqhaza lokuhlela elasunguliwe, i-IDP ivela njengomsebenzi wokuphatha emiphakathini futhi njengengxenye yesu lezinhlelo ezihlanganisiwe kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukubhekana nezinqumo eziphathelene nezabelomali zomphakathi, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, kanye nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxhumana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa azizokwazi ukusiza kuphela ukuphathwa kwemiphakathi kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinise ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma imikhakha eduze nohulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho phansi, ukwesekwa kwezimboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zomphakathi. Esikhathini esedlule, imiphakathi ivame ukuba nezinselelo zokuhlela izinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, bekungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. Izinhlangano eziningi zomphakathi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okudlula) zazingenazo izinsiza kanye namandla okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, bekungekho izinqubomgomo zokuhlela ezihlolwe ngalokhu, futhi bekungekho izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezisunguliwe nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga, bonke ababambiqhaza kule ndima bathole inzuzo enkulu kulwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona imiphakathi embalwa esithole intuthuko enkulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ukuphatha ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezikhona. Imibhalo ye-IDP yokuhola, esunguliwe yiqembu le-DPLG elihlukile elisekelwa yi-GTZ, iphakamisa inqubo elula yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha olwesizwe lwabaphathi bamaphakathi, abasebenzi abangochwepheshe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke abamele imiphakathi. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokusekela izinhlelo zamaphakathi endaweni (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zomphakathi. Iningi lempumalanga, i-SALGA, izigaba zikamasipala zendawo, kanye nezinkampani eziningi zikahulumeni ezweni ziyiingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi ziye zaba nomthelela kulolu hlelo olusha lwe-IDP. Nginehope enkulu yokuthi lezi ziqoqo zemibhalo ezishicilelwe zizoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enqubo ye-IDP kanye nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ehlose ikusasa eliqhakazile. Yini ebalulekile ngamaGuidelines we-Integrated Development Planning? Lezi ziqondiso ziphendula umbuzo OJANI? Uma ama-Integrated Development Plans (IDPs) enziwa umthetho ophoqelelwe kumaphakathi ngaphansi komthetho Wokuhulumeni Bendawo (LGTA), njengoba kuguqulwe, kusho ukuthi ngesikhathi salolu hlelo awukwazi ukuvinjwa kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe zikhuluma ngezimo zezinhloso zokuthuthukiswa komhlaba (LDO) njengoba zisunguliwe kuMthetho Wokuphucula Ukuthuthukiswa (DFA) ka-1995. I-DFA inikeza uhlaka lwezinqubomgomo oluwusizo mayelana nezici zokuhlela nokuthuthukiswa komhlaba. Izimo ezibalulekile zezinqubomgomo, izakhiwo zomthetho, kanye nezinhlelo ze-IDP zasungulwa ngemuva kokuthi inqubo ye-IDP isiqalile. Uhlu lweziqondiso zezinhlelo lubandakanya ukuhlinzeka, ukugxila ezindabeni ezibalulekile, isinyathelo esibheke phambili, uhlelo lwesikhathi esizayo, kanye nokubambisana nezinye izikhungo. Lo mthetho ukhomba indima yokuhlela kumasipala ahlanganyelayo. Kukhona eminye imibhalo emibili ephuma ku-WPLG ebalulekile ekuhlelweni kokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Umthetho Wokuphathwa Kokusebenzisa Umhlaba uqale inqubo eholele ekunciphiseni inani lemiphakathi. Le miphakathi ikhule futhi inamandla okuguqula izakhiwo zezinhlangano. Imibhalo ye-Integrated Development Plan izama ukwethula uhlaka lwecebo kulabo abahlanganyela enhlanganweni yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Injongo wukubasiza ukuthi benze umsebenzi wabo kahle. Kukhona imiyalo nezinhlelo ezichaza izinyathelo ezithile okufanele zilandelwe. Le miyalo ayifani nemibhalo esemthethweni ephoqelelwe kodwa isebenza njengeziqondiso ezisizayo. Lezi ziqondiso ziyisisekelo sokuqeqesha, ulwazi, kanye nezinsizakalo. Njengoba inqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe yaqala ngaphambi kokuvela kwalolu hlelo olusha, izinga lenqubo yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nemiphumela yayo ithonywe kakhulu yilolu hlelo. Kwamanye amaphakathi, inqubo yokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe kanye nemiphumela yayo, imibhalo yokuhlela yahluleka ukuba ibonakale ngempela ngenxa yezidingo ezilula zesu lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. Le nqubo yadala ukudideka okukhulu nokudumazeka kulabo abahlanganyela. Esikhundleni sokuthi isetshenziswe njengethuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zangempela zabantu kanye nemiphakathi ngendlela ekhombisa imiphumela futhi icabangele ikusasa, imiphakathi eminingi ikhethe ukulandela kuphela izidingo zomthetho ezincane ngosizo lwabacwaningi. Ngalesi sizathu, imiphumela ayizange ibe nomthelela oqinile futhi yafana nomdlalo wokuthenga izinhlelo ezikhona. Ingxenye yalezi zinkinga yikhono elilinganiselwe lamaphakathi, ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi nezibucayi enqubo engcono futhi eshesha, kanye nokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuzisekela. Lesi simo siholela ekuthembeleni okukhulu kubakhiqizi abangekho abacwaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, inqubo nezinhlelo zezinhlangano zomphakathi bezisanda kuvela. Izinselelo eziningi zixhomeke ekuntulekeni kokuhlelwa kwezomthetho okucacile. Ezinye izinselelo ezishiwo ngezansi zisafuna ukuxazululwa. Injongo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe ayicacanga ngokwanele kumaphakathi athile ngenxa yokusondela kwayo kuma-LDOs. Ngezinye izikhathi, ibonwa njengendlela yokubamba iqhaza ekutholeni uhlu lwezinhlelo zokwakha ezidinga uxhaso lwangaphandle. Ngalesi sizathu, imiphumela ye-IDPs ivame ukuba yizihloko ezilula zezimali ngaphandle kokuchaza kahle izimo zokwakhiwa kwazo nezinhlelo zokusebenza uma
Uhulumeni bendawo udlala indima ebalulekile ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukiswa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lokwakha imiphakathi engakhethi abantu luhloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, kuyinsiza ebalulekile ukusiza uhulumeni bendawo ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukisweni. Ukwethulwa kwesakhiwo esicacile sokukhuthaza inqubomgomo ngokuqhuba iMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi kubalulekile. Ukwethulwa kwesakhiwo esisha somthetho kuhulumeni bendawo ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wokwakhiwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi kanye neMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zomphakathi kubalulekile. Ngemuva kokhetho lwabaholi bendawo olwenziwe ngomhla ziyi-5 kuZibandlela 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zohulumeni bendawo zokubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokusebenza kokuhlela kwangaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengensiza yokuphatha imiphakathi futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukubhekana nezinqumo ngezindaba ezifana nokwabiwa kwezimali zomphakathi, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, kanye nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokuxoxisana, ehlelekile, futhi ebheke phambili. Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwemiphakathi kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi isakhiwo sokusebenza kwezikhungo noma izigaba eziseduze nohulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zomphakathi. Esikhathini esedlule, imiphakathi kwesinye isikhathi yahluleka ukuhlela izinhlelo ze-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho sikhungo somthetho. Izinhlangano eziningi zomphakathi (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Wokushintsha) zazinganazo izinsiza kanye namakhono okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho zinhlelo zokuhlela ezihlolwe kulezi zimo, futhi kwakungekho nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezisunguliwe nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwalezi zinkinga, bonke ababambiqhaza kule ndima benze kahle kakhulu ngolwazi abaluqoqe. Kukhona imiphakathi embalwa esebenze kahle ekwakheni izinhlelo ezisiza ekuphatheni ukusebenza nezinhlelo ezikhona. Iziqondiso ze-IDP, ezasungulwa yiqembu elihlukile le-DPLG ngoxhaso lwe-GTZ, ziphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha olwakhelwe abaphathi bezemiphakathi, abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke ababambiqhaza abavela emiphakathini. Uhlelo lwesizwe lokuxhasa izinhlelo zomphakathi (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zokuphatha zomphakathi. Inani elikhulu lemiphakathi, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yohulumeni bendawo, kanye neminyango ehlukene kahulumeni embonini ezweni iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele ekwakhiweni kwalezi ziqondiso ezintsha ze-IDP. Ngibheke phambili kakhulu ukuthi lezi ziqondiso ezishicilelwe zizoba umhlahlandlela useful kanye nomthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enqubweni ye-IDP kanye nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi zethu ngendlela ehlanganisa ikusasa elikhanyayo. Iziqondiso zesibili zisiza ekwakheni amandla emiphakathini ukuze iphumelele ezinhlelweni zayo ze-IDP. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuhlobene nezinto ezenzeka lapho kulungiselelwa isigaba sokuhlela. Ngamafuphi, umqondo wenqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlela, incazelo yokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe, kanye nomqondo wakho (1.1) Ukwethula nokuchaza izidingo ezibekwe emthethweni ngokuqhuba (1. Izincwadi ezihlanganisiwe (nokuhlangenwe nakho) okufanele zibe nezakhiwo ngenxa yesigaba sokulungiselela ukuhlela (1.3) ekugcineni, ukuveza umfanekiso obanzi wokuqukethwe kwalezi ziqondiso (iziqondiso zesibili ziqukethe izinkomba kuzo zonke lezi zinyathelo zenqubo yokulungiselela ukuhlela kanye nemisebenzi edingekayo). Yini okufanele ilungiswe? Ukuhlela i-Integrated Development Plan kuthatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye, kuhilela abantu abahlukene ngaphakathi nangaphandle komphakathi. Le nqubo idinga ukuhlela ngokucophelela nokucabangela. Idinga uhlelo lwezebhizinisi. Izinhlelo zangaphakathi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano kufanele nazo ziqalwe kanye nezinqumo mayelana namalungu eqembu, amakomidi, nezakhiwo ezizobe zikhona. Uhlelo olwakhiwe kufanele lwenziwe luveze imisebenzi ehleliwe, isikhathi sokuphothulwa, nezinsiza ezidingekayo zokwenza amalungiselelo. Le nqubo yokuhlela ibalulekile ekulandeleni nasekuxhumaneni nabanye ababambiqhaza (ikakhulukazi phakathi kwemiphakathi yendawo kanye nezikhulu zesifunda). Kubalulekile ukuqaphela lapho kuthathwa izinqumo mayelana nezindima nezimo zokubambisana ezizobanjwa umphakathi nabanye ababambiqhaza ngesikhathi sokulungiselela. Obani okufanele babandakanyeke kule nqubo, obani abazothinteka, futhi bazokwaziswa kanjani ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwenqubo? Lezi zonke yizindaba ezidinga ukuphendulwa ukuze kuboniswe abantu ngesikhathi esifanele futhi ukuphatha izinsiza ezidingekayo kahle. Izinhlelo ezifanayo zingahlelwa ngezindima nezimo ezizobekwa kulabo abavela ngaphandle komphakathi, njengemiphakathi eminye, izifunda, kanye nezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni. Lo msebenzi wokubambisana kufanele unqunywe ngendlela ebindayo umphakathi usebenzisa isakhiwo sokuhlela esabelwe esidinga ukulungiswa kusenesikhathi. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izincwadi ezidinga ukucatshangelwa ngaphambi kokuthi uhlelo luqale zaziwa futhi zifinyeleleka. Umsebenzi wokulungiselela i-IDP akuwona umthwalo wezikhulu zamakhansela. Inqubo yokulungiselela kufanele ibe nesandla ekulungiseleleni umphakathi ngokusebenzisa inqubo ye-IDP. Ngakho-ke, akekho ozokwenza isinqumo somphakathi ngaphandle komphakathi uqobo. Iziqondiso zesibili zenzelwe ukusiza umphathi wombuso ekuphatheni umsebenzi wokulungiselela ngendlela elula futhi eqondile. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nezidingo ezibalulekile ezilindelekile ezingeni lomphakathi lapho kuhlelwa inqubo ye-IDP nokuxhumana okufanele nezakhiwo zikahulumeni, izinhlelo zenqubo kufanele ziphathwe nguMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zomphakathi ka-2000. Lo Mthetho awuchazi lutho oluhlukile mayelana nezimo ezijwayelekile zokwenza amalungiselelo. a Ukwamukela uhlelo olwenziwe ngunoma yimuphi umphakathi wendawo noma wesifunda futhi oluphakanyiswe ukuze kuhlolwe inqubo yokuhlela, ukuhlela, ukwamukelwa, nokubuyekezwa kwe-IDP. Le ncwadi ebhaliwe ngenqubo ye-IDP izobizwa ngokufushane ngokuthi "Isakhiwo Senqubo" seziqondiso. Uhlelo lokushintsha okujwayelekile ukuze kuqaliswe imiphakathi engakhethi, okuhloswe ngalo ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa, kuyinto ebalulekile ekusizeni ohulumeni bendawo ukwenza umnikelo onenhloso ekuthuthukiseni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwezinqubomgomo ezisekelayo ngokwethula iMthethosisekelo Wokuphatha Kwamakhaya. Ukuveza uhlaka olusha lwezomthetho lokuphathwa kwamakhaya ngokukhuthaza iMthetho Wamasipala kanye neMthetho Wamasistimu Wamasipala. Ngemuva kokhetho lukamasipala olwenziwe ngoDisemba 5, 2000, isigaba sokuguqulwa siphelile, futhi uhlelo lukamasipala manje lungaqala ukusebenza phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile. I-Integrated Development Plan (IDP) ingesinye sezinsiza zokuphatha kwamakhaya ezihloselwe ukubhekana nendima yokuletha ukuthuthukiswa. Ngaphezu kokuba nesikhundla sokuhlela esasunguliwe ngaphambili, i-IDP ivele njengensiza yokuphatha yamamasipala futhi njengengxenye yesu lokuhlela okuhlanganisiwe kanye nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. I-IDP ihlose ukwenza izinqumo mayelana nezindaba ezinjengokwabiwa kwezimali zamamasipala, ukuphathwa komhlaba, ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho ezindaweni, nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokubonisana, ehlelekile, futhi ehambisana nekusasa. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa azizokwazi ukusiza ukuphathwa kwamamasipala kuphela kodwa kufanele futhi ziqhube ukusebenza kwezikhungo noma imikhakha eduze kukahulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhunyiwe kukahulumeni, ukwesekwa kwemboni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele ezindaweni zamamasipala. Esikhathini esedlule, amamasipala wayevame ukuba nezinhlelo ze-IDP ezihlelwe kahle. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho uhlaka lwezomthetho. Amanye amamasipala (ikakhulukazi amaKhansela Okuguqula) ayenqaba izinsiza namandla okuphatha inqubo yokuhlela. Ngasikhathi sinye, kwakungekho izindlela zokuhlela ezihlolwe ngalesi sikhathi, futhi kwakungekho izinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphelele nezihlolwe. Naphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinkinga, bonke ababamba iqhaza kule ndima bahlomule kakhulu ngolwazi abaluqoqe. Kunamamasipala ambalwa athole intuthuko enkulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ekuphathweni kokusebenza nezinhlelo ezivele zikhona. I-IDP Reference Books, esungulwe yiqembu elihlukile le-DPLG ngosizo lwe-GTZ, iphakamisa inqubo ehlelekile yokuhlela nokuphatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukuyisebenzisa. Kukho uhlelo lokuqeqesha lwezizwe lwabaphathi bamamasipala, abasebenzi bezobuchwepheshe, amaKhansela, kanye nochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lokhu kuqeqeshwa kubandakanya bonke ababamba iqhaza abavela kumamasipala. Uhlelo lwezizwe lokweseka izinhlelo zikamasipala (PIMSS) luyasungulwa futhi luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala. Inani elikhulu lamamasipala, i-SALGA, iminyango yesifunda yokuphatha kwamakhaya, kanye neminyango eminingi yokuhweba kukahulumeni ezweni, iyingxenye yalolu hlelo futhi kuholele kulolu hlelo olusha lwe-IDP Reference Book. Nginezithemba ezinkulu zokuthi le ndaba yokuhlanganisa izincwadi ezishicilelwe izokwenza kube lula futhi kube umthombo wolwazi ozokhuthaza nonke abahlanganyela enqubweni ye-IDP kanye nemizamo yenu yokwenza i-IDP ibe ithuluzi lokubhekana nezidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ngendlela ekhombisa ikusasa eliqhakazile. Kukhona ukuvumelana ngesidingo sokuba nezikhombisi ezicacile, ezisobala, nezilula ukusebenzisa kanye nesidingo sesu lokuhlela elinika indawo yokuxoxisana ngezindaba ezibalulekile, ezingenziwa kuphela ngochwepheshe bokuhlela abaphatha imibhalo nomsebenzi ofisi. Inselelo yesu elilula ayilula neze. Inqubo yokubonisana idinga ukubamba iqhaza okubonakalayo emikhakheni ehlukene yomphakathi ngokuya ngezinhlu ezahlukene zokuhlaziya nendawo lapho izinqumo zenziwa khona. Ukubandakanya wonke umuntu kusho ithuba lokubamba iqhaza kulokho okukhuluma ngakho nezinkulumo ngesikhathi esifanele ebhodini, futhi akulula nokwenza lo msebenzi. Inqubo yokuqala yesu idinga umcabango ocacile, ukuhlaziywa okuhlelekile ukuze kutholakale izixazululo ezifanele, kubhekwa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi kucatshangelwe imigomo nezinqubomgomo ezisunguliwe. Lokhu kudlula nje ekudwebeni uhlu lwezinto ezibekwe phambili nokuhumusha lezi zinto zibe iziphakamiso zezimali. Inqubo ehlanganisiwe idinga ukucabanga nokubuka izinto ngokubanzi futhi isakaze emakhawulweni ezezimboni. Uhlelo oluhlanganisiwe oluqinile oluqhuba umsebenzi futhi luzama ukusho kahle izindleko, isikhathi, inani, izibopho, indawo, izinga lomsebenzi, kanye nendawo lapho umsebenzi uzolethwa khona. Lokhu kudlula nje uhlu lwezikhundla zomsebenzi ezizokwenziwa. Inselelo yokuhlela i-IDP ukuhlanganisa lezi zidingo ezintathu ngenhloso yokufinyelela inqubo yokwenza izinqumo ngendlela yokubonisana, ucabange kahle ngalesi sihloko, futhi uqhubeke ngempumelelo yomsebenzi uma usuqale. Kubandakanya inqubo ekhombisa umcimbi lapho i-IDP ihlelwa, hhayi ukukhombisa ithuluzi noma isu. Ukucabanga ngohlelo njengemicimbi eyisixhumanisi kulula kunokucabanga ngochungechunge lwezithuluzi zokuhlela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhuthaza inqubo yokubonisana nokucabanga phambili ngezinto ezibekwe phambili. Lokhu kuhlukanisa ngokucacile phakathi kweGeneral IDP Process (Guideline III) esebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamamasipala kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlela ezithile nezithuluzi (Guideline IV) ezingase zihluke kakhulu kumasipala owodwa kuya kumasipala omunye. Ihloswe ukusebenzisa ulimi oluhlelekile ngokugwema amagama ayinkimbinkimbi nezinsizwa ezinzima ezisetshenziswa abaklami. Imicimbi yokuhlela ivame ukuba yizinkulumo noma ama-workshops ezakhiwo zokuphatha ezilawula inqubo ye-IDP (Community Representative Council, IDP Steering Committee, Working Group) futhi kwezinye izimo, kungabandakanya imisebenzi eyenziwa ngabantu (njengokuhlanganiswa kolwazi, ucwaningo, njll.). Umcimbi ngamunye kumele ube nemiphumela ethile. Le miphumela ingaba uhlobo oluthile lolwazi noma isinqumo. Eminye imiphumela incike ezimfuneko zomthetho, ezinye zikhona ngenxa yokuhlakanipha okujwayelekile futhi zisiza ekulandeleni inqubo enephetho. Kuwo wonke umcimbi wokuhlela, kunikezwa izincomo mayelana nohlobo lwezinhlelo kanye nabantu okufanele babambe iqhaza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlelo lubandakanya zonke izingxenye ezithintekayo futhi lukhuluma. Indlela yokuhlela ayisho okuningi ngezithuluzi zokuhlela ezithile okufanele zisetshenziswe kuwo wonke umcimbi. Lezi zinsiza zihluka kumasipala kuya kumasipala. AmaKhansela amakhulu angasebenzisa izindlela zokuhlela ezithuthukisiwe ezinekhompyutha. Amamasipala kuCategory B angase enze inqubo yokuhlela efanayo kodwa asebenzise indlela ebonakalayo. Ukuze kusungulwe uhlaka oluhlangene lokulawula ukudluliswa kukagesi, igesi emaphaketheni, kanye nezimboni zegesi zamalambu; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi nezindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho wezeMali wezwe usunguliwe njengomthetho. Umthetho wezeMali uqukethe amalungu amathathu aphethe ngokuphelele kanye namalungu amahlanu alungiselelwe ngokwesikhashana abekwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe kufanele akhethe elinye lamalungu abekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 njengomholi woMthetho wezeMali. UNgqongqoshe kufanele abeke elinye lamalungu aphethe ngokuphelele ukuze abhekane ngqo nokulawula ugesi, elinye lokulawula igesi, kanti elinye lokulawula amaphakethe. Uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe nganoma yisiphi isizathu, amalungu amanye kufanele akhethe omunye phakathi kwabo ukuba aphathe njengomholi kuze kube umholi engakwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe noma omunye umholi abekwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe angase abeke nelinye ilungu; futhi uma ilungu elingapheli noma eliphelele leMithetho yezeMali linqamuka emsebenzini nganoma yisiphi isizathu, UNgqongqoshe angase abeke omunye umuntu endaweni yabo isikhathi esingadluli ezinyangeni eziyishumi nambili ngokuhambisana nesigaba 67. Amalungu eMithetho yezeMali kufanele akhokhelwe ngomsebenzi wabo ngeziholo nezinzuzo ezithathwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali. Kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezithakazelo mayelana nalolu daba. Ngendlela eqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanele phakathi kokuhlala nokwazi ukuhlela. Ilungu akufanele libe khona nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ezingxoxweni, ekwenzeni izinqumo, noma participation in any matter before the Energy Policy where the member or their spouse, partner, child, or someone they have a direct or indirect romantic relationship with is involved. Uma ilungu lithola noma likholelwa ukuthi lingase libe nentshisekelo yezezimali esigabeni 3 b, lelo lungu kufanele lishayele uNgqongqoshe neMithetho yezeMali ngokubhalwe phansi. Uma bejolile noma behlala nomuntu impilo yabo yonke othola noma okholelwa ukuthi ungase ube nentshisekelo yezezimali esigabeni 3 b, lelo lungu kufanele lishayele uNgqongqoshe neMithetho yezeMali ngokubhalwe phansi. Ngaphambi kokubeka ilungu leMithetho yezeMali, uNgqongqoshe kufanele, ngokuqaphela kwiGazethi, acela ukuthi abangu-ukhuluma bakhethwe phakathi kwamalungu omphakathi. Isaziso esishicilelwe ngaphambi kokuthi le mthetho uqale, sicela ukukhethwa kwabantu bokuqala abazakhethwa kuMthetho wezeMali, kufanele sithathwe njengokushicilelwe ngempela ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7. Lokhu kuphula isivumelwano sokwenza umsebenzi ngaphansi kwale mthetho noma iGas Act noma iPipeline Act yokukhanyisa; noma kukhishwa njengelungu ngenxa yanoma yisiphi sezizathu ezikhuluma esigabeni 6 1. Umholi, uma ethole isicelo esibhaliwe kusuka kumphathi ophakeme noma kumalungu amabili, uzobiza umhlangano okhethekile ozobanjwa phakathi nezinsuku ezimbili zokuthola isicelo esinjalo. Umbhalo ubonakala ungumbhalo wezomthetho onzima ophathelene namalungelo okumba, imithetho, nemigomo eNingizimu Afrika. Uxoxa ngezici ezahlukene zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamaminerali nezamafutha, kuhlanganise namalungelo okucwaninga nokumba, imithwalo yemfanelo kahulumeni kanye nezinkampani zokumba, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola izimvume nezitifiketi. Uqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokuvikelwa kwemvelo kanye nesidingo sokuhambisana nezindinganiso zomthetho. Umbhalo uveza izindima zababambiqhaza abahlukene, kuhlanganise noNgqongqoshe, uMnyango Wezinsiza Zomhlaba, kanye nomphakathi, ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamaminerali. Ubuye ubhekane nezindaba eziphathelene nezinkokhelo zabaphethe izindawo kanye nomthethonqubo ophatha imisebenzi yokumba.

Abanakho ukuba nekhono lokuba yisikhungo, njengendawo yokugcina amathuluzi okuhweba, indlu ebhalisiwe yokuhweba ngamasheya, ukuthola noma ukuvunyelwa ukwenza le msebenzi ngokuhambisana nesimo esivele, noma ukuziphatha ngendlela, sebenzisa igama noma incazelo ekhombisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabo nesikhungo, indawo yokugcina amathuluzi okuhweba emakethe, indlu ebhalisiwe yokuhweba ngamasheya, ukuthola noma ukuvunyelwa ukusebenza, ngokuhambisana nesimo njengoba sekuvele. Umthetho Olawulayo Wemakethe Yezezimali ka-1989 (Umthetho No. 55 ka-1989) usasebenza nakuba lo mthetho usususiwe ngengxenye 117. b namanye amalungu, kuhlanganise nezikhulumeli zezimboni kanye namakhasimende aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokubonisana neBhodi. Umphathi ungum member weBhodi Yokweluleka ngenxa yesikhundla sabo emsebenzini kodwa abakwazi ukuvota ngezindaba lapho kudingeka khona iseluleko seBhodi Yokweluleka.
