Umbhalo wesiNgisi ungumbhalo osemthethweni weGas Policy Framework... Ukuze kuthuthukiswe kahle inkampani ye-gas pipeline; ukusungula isakhiwo sezwe; ukugunyaza uMphathi weGas Policy ezingeni likazwelonke njengomgibeli wenqubomgomo ye-infrastructure ezingeni likazwelonke; nokubheka ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Amandla angabekwa lapha abhekisela kulawo mandla akhethwe nguMphathi weGas Policy mayelana nokuguqulwa kube igesi, ukusindiswa kwegesi, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusatshalaliswa okungadingi ukuhambisana nezidingo ezisemqoka zalesi sivumelwano. Futhi ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokutholakala kwegesi ngendlela elula nephumelelayo. Ukusatshalaliswa, ukucutshungulwa kwegesi, nokusindiswa kwegesi; kanye nokuhweba ngegesi. UMphathi weGas Policy unabasebenzi abahlanu abaqashwe nguNgqongqoshe. Umongameli ukhethwa phakathi kwabaphathi be-gas ngokuhambisana nesigaba. Uma ngasiphi isizathu umongameli engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe, abanye amalungu kumele akhethe omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo ukuba aphathe isikhundla somongameli kuze kube umongameli ekwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe noma kuze kube nguNgqongqoshe eqasha omunye umongameli. Ilungu leMphakathi yeGas Policy lenza isikhathi seminyaka emine. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda aqashe ilungu. Amalungu eMphakathi yeGas Policy kumele akhokhelwe ngezinsizakalo zawo futhi athole izinzuzo njengabaphathi be-gas ngokuvuma kukaNgqongqoshe ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Ngaphambi kokuba aqashe amalungu kuMphakathi weGas Policy, uNgqongqoshe kumele, ngomyalezo kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, acela amagama kubalungu bomphakathi. Ukusatshalaliswa, ukugcinwa, ukuthuthwa, ukucutshungulwa kwegesi, noma ukuhweba ngegesi, noma ukuba nentshisekelo ethile kunoma iyiphi inkampani; futhi kumele azise uNgqongqoshe noMphathi weGas Policy uma le ntshisekelo ishintsha. Ilungu akumele likhanye nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho izindaba zixoxwa, noma izinqumo zenziwa, noma libe nengxenye kunoma iyiphi indaba yeMphakathi yeGas Policy lapho leli lungu noma umngani walo, ingane, umngane wezohwebo, noma umqashi, ngaphandle koMbuso, enentshisekelo. Noma kungenzeka kube nesizathu sokungavunyelwa ukuba lihlale njengelungu ngenxa yezizathu ezishiwo esigabeni 6 seGas Policy uma lenza okuphikisana nesigaba 9. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele abe nemihlangano ngezikhathi ezibekwe ngumongameli. UMphathi weGas Policy njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsebenzi ofanele wenziwa. Ukuze uthole lesi sicelo. Ngaphandle kokuba kube nenqubo ethile ebekiwe, umongameli wanoma yisiphi umhlangano weMphakathi weGas Policy kumele abeke inqubo ezolandelwa kulolo suku. UMphakathi weGas Policy uqukethe amalungu amaningi. Isinqumo sebhola labalungu abakhona emhlanganweni yisinqumo seMphakathi weGas Policy. Kuyinhlangano elula phezulu kwalokho okujwayelekile. Isinqumo uma abanye amalungu bekhona emhlanganweni futhi benelungelo lokuhlanganyela nokuvota, futhi isinqumo kumele sithathwe futhi ngempela ngamalungu abukhona anelungelo lokuvota. Umongameli kumele abe khona emihlanganweni yonke yeMphakathi weGas Policy futhi unelungelo lokuphendula, kodwa hhayi ukuvota, kulawo mhlangano. I-Gas Policy ivulekile emphakathini ngaphandle kokuba kube nolwazi oluyimfihlo, olunamalungelo obunikazi mayelana nezohwebo, lowo muntu ophakathi kufanele akhombise uMphathi weGas Policy ukuthi kungani lelo lwazi lungafanele lwenziwe emphakathini. UMphathi weGas Policy wokuqala ngemuva kokuba eqashwe. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele aqinisekise ukuthi irekhodi lezo zinqubo ezikhona zigcinwa. Ngokuqondile noma ngokuqondile; futhi abaphethe izikhundla zomphakathi kumele baziphathise kahle futhi njengoba kulindelekile. Kumele kubhalwe; futhi kuchazwe kahle nangokunembile, ngomthetho nezizathu zawo. Noma yisiphi isinqumo seMphakathi weGas Policy nezizathu zaso kumele zifinyeleleke emphakathini. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele aqashe umphathi omkhulu weMphakathi weGas Policy. Ukuze aphathe izindaba zeMphakathi weGas Policy; futhi aphathe ukuphathwa kwabo bonke abasebenzi abaqashwe ngalesi sikhathi esikahle. Obani, ukuze basize ezisebenzelweni zeMphakathi weGas Policy. Nakuba kukhona izigaba 1 no-3, uNgqongqoshe angase anqume ukuthi uMphathi weGas Policy angaqasha noma asebenzise abasebenzi ngokuvumelana nezinye iziphathimandla zokuhweba ngaphansi kwamandla kaNgqongqoshe. Isigaba 9 sithinta noma yiliphi ilungu labasebenzi beMphakathi weGas Policy, ushintsho lusekelwe esimweni esikhona. Izincwadi zezezimali zeMphakathi weGas Policy kumele zihlolwe nguMphakathi Wezokuhlola. Mayelana nempilo nokuphepha embonini; kanye nezinye izindaba uMphathi weGas Policy abona ukuthi zidingeka. Obani abangase basebenze ekuthuthweni, ukugcinwa, ukusatshalaliswa kwegesi, ukuyicubungula, nokusindiswa kwegesi; noma ukuhweba ngegesi. Noma yimuphi umsebenzi okukhulunywa ngawo kwiSheduli 1 awudingi ukufaka isicelo sokungena kulowo msebenzi, kodwa umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okukhulunywa ezigabeni 1 no-2 yale Sheduli kumele abhalise umsebenzi wabo njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 28. Bangazisa umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okudinga ilayisense ngaphansi kwesigaba sokuthi kufanele bame umsebenzi lowo. Akukho lutho kule Mthetho olivimba noma ubani ekwenzeni izivumelwano ngenjongo yokwakha, ukuguqula i-infrastructure ye, umsebenzi wegesi, ukuyisebenzisa, noma ukuhweba okuhlosiwe ukuze kuxoxwe noMphathi weGas Policy ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo se-layisense. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 29, anikeze umuntu obhekwa ngesigaba (a) ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze afake isicelo. Noma ubani ofanele ukufaka isicelo se-layisense ngaphansi kwesigaba 10 kuya ku-15 kumele ayifake ngendlela ebekiwe nangendlela. Ngalolu lwazi oludingekayo mayelana negesi ezoba yohwebo ngaphansi kwelayisense; kanye nolwazi olunye olungase ludingeke. Umfaki-sicelo angacela ukuthi ulwazi luphathwe ngokuyimfihlo mayelana nokuthinteka kwezezimali esicelweni futhi, ngokuvumelana nezivumelwano noMphathi weGas Policy, lelo lwazi lingadalulwa ezikopini zesicelo ezisakazwayo emphakathini. Umuntu kumele uphume umyalezo wesicelo sakhe ezincwadini ezimbili okungenani endaweni afuna ukusebenza kuyo, ezilimini ezimbili ezisemthethweni (eyodwa kufanele ibe isiNgisi). Ikheli leMphakathi weGas Policy lapho okungabekwa khona izikhalazo ngesicelo; futhi ukuthi izikhalazo ngesicelo kumele zisebenze ngezinto eziphakanyisiwe noma isitatimende esiphakanyisiwe. Uma kungekho zinkinga ezitholakele ngesicelo; noma ngemuva kokuthola impendulo kumfaki-sicelo mayelana nezikhalazo ezishiwo esigabeni 18c. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo; noma nganoma iyiphi injongo yomphakathi
Lo mthetho uhlanganisa umthetho wesakhiwo. Uthuthukisa ulwazi nokuqonda ngezindaba zase-Afrika ngokusebenzisa ososayensi bezokuxhumana abaziwayo ngokuvumelana nabo bonke abalandela lezi zindaba nangokusebenzisa ukuqeqeshwa nemfundo ngezindaba zase-Afrika; kanye nokuhlanganisa, ukuhlela, nokusabalalisa ulwazi mayelana nezindaba zase-Afrika, ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko elifanele nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele mayelana nezidingo zazo zonke abantu, amathuba, nezinkinga ezibhekene nazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ibhodi isungulwa ukuze ibheke, iphathe, futhi iqondise izindaba zeZikhungo. Amalungu akufanele adlule kwababili futhi azobekwa yiBhodi ngokubonisana noNgqongqoshe; kanti uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi, ozoba ilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla sakhe, akasoze abe namandla okvotelela. Ekusungulweni kweBhodi, kumele kube nokrepresenta efanele yobulili, ulimi, kanye nokwehluka kwemiphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ilungu leBhodi elikhuluma ngalesi sihloko kumele libe neziqu ezihambisana nezimiso zokucacisa nokwethula. Okungenani elinye lamalungu abekwe yiBhodi kumele libe nolwazi lokuphathwa kwezimali. Bazokwenza umsebenzi noma babe ilungu iminyaka emithathu, ngaphandle uma isikhathi esifushane sithathwa; futhi ilungu eliphelelwe isikhathi singabekwa kabusha. Uma ilungu leBhodi lifa noma lishiya isikhundla sazo ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esibekwe, elinye ilungu lingabekwa ukuze lithathe leso sikhundla ngesikhathi esisele esishiywe yilungu elibekwe. Ilungu leBhodi elingabekwa ngokuphelele nguMbuso lingakhokhelwa yiBhodi ngemisebenzi abawenzayo njengamalungu, nalokho okukhokhelwayo kuzodinga ukuba kucaciswe nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokubonisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali. Akukho ilungu leBhodi elingabamba isikhundla eqenjini lezepolitiki noma enhlanganweni yezepolitiki. Umuntu ongakabi nezezimali, ophumelele icala eNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kwecala elenziwe ngaphambi kosuku lwe-27 kuMbasa, 1994, elihlobene nezinhloso zezepolitiki futhi ohlawulwe ejele ngaphandle kokukhetha inhlawulo, noma uma bekungumkhonyovu, uma behlawulwe ukuba bakhokhe inhlawulo noma ejele noma kokubili; noma ngaphandle uma engum citizen waseNingizimu Afrika noma enephepha lokuhlala okuphakade eNingizimu Afrika. Umuntu ophuthelwe yimihlangano emibili noma ngaphezulu yeBhodi ngokuqhubekayo ngaphandle kokuthola imvume yeBhodi. Kumele bathumele incwadi yokuhoxa kuNgqongqoshe. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zeZikhungo, iBhodi ingaba... neziqu noma amandla abona efanele noma adingekayo. Bangaqasha, baphathe amaholo, noma baphume abantu bezikhungo; futhi benze noma yini eholela ekufezeni izinhloso, futhi kumele bahlaziye njalo isakhiwo, inhlangano, nezinhlelo zeZikhungo. Bangasebenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi obekwe nguNgqongqoshe; futhi benze uphenyo noma ucwaningo mayelana nezinhloso zeBhodi uma kubekwe nguNgqongqoshe. IBhodi ayikwazi ukusungula, ukuthola, noma ukusebenzisa inhlangano noma isikhungo esihlobene nezindaba zase-Afrika, kodwa ingaqala noma iphakamise izinhlelo ezibona ezifanele ukuze kuqhutshwe izinhloso zeZikhungo: Kuze kube yilapho lezi zinhlelo zenzeka ngokubambisana nezinhlelo ezikhona noma izikhungo ezikwazi ukuzenza. Ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zeZikhungo, iBhodi ingahlinzeka ngosizo kunoma yimuphi umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ophila kwelinye izwe ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi. IBhodi kumele ihlangane noma ibambe imihlangano okungenani kathathu ngonyaka, futhi imihlangano izobanjwa ngesikhathi nendawo ezobekwa nguMongameli ngokwazisa amalungu amanye. UMongameli angabiza umhlangano okhethekile weBhodi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, okumele ubanjwe ngesikhathi nendawo ezobekwa nguMongameli. Inani lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni angakwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano nokwenza izinqumo kumele kube iningi lamalungu eBhodi. Noma yiziphi izinqumo zeBhodi kumele zenziwe ngokusekelwa kwenani elikhulu lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni weBhodi, futhi uma kube nokuhlangana kwenkinga ethile, umuntu ophatha umhlangano uzoba ne-vote yokugcina ngaphezu kokuvota kwakhe njengelungu leBhodi. Ilungu leBhodi lingavota noma lithathe ingxenye ekwenzeni umhlangano weBhodi noma libe khona endaweni lapho umhlangano ubanjwa khona uma likhona izithakazelo ezithinta le ndaba ngaphambi noma ephakanyisiwe yiBhodi ezivimbela ukuba likwenze kahle izibopho zalo njengelungu leBhodi, futhi ngaphandle kokubandlulula futhi ngendlela efanele. UPhakathi koMongameli; kanye namanye amalungu eBhodi, angadluli kwabahlanu, njengoba kubekwe yiBhodi. Ikomidi eliphethe elisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 kumele lenze imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo yiBhodi. UMongameli weBhodi kumele abe nguMongameli wekomidi eliphethe. Ikomidi eliphethe kumele lihlangane ngezikhathi nendawo ezibekwe nguMongameli wale komidi, futhi inani labantu abakhona abakwazi ukwenza izinqumo kumele kube iningi lamalungu wekomidi eliphethe. IBhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwamakomidi, lapho ingase ibeke khona amandla noma imisebenzi ethile ebekwe noma enikezwe iBhodi ngalo Mthetho. Ikomidi elikhuluma ngalesi sihloko kumele libe neziqu ezithile zamalungu eBhodi nabasebenzi beBhodi, uma bekhona, abona iBhodi ifanele, futhi iBhodi ingakhipha noma ibuyise noma yikuphi ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanelekile. Uma ikomidi linezithakazelo zamalungu eBhodi ezingaphezu kwelungu elilodwa, iBhodi kumele ibeke elinye lamalungu abo ukuba kube nguMongameli wale komidi. IBhodi ayinakubanjwa icala lokwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi obekwe kunoma yikuphi ikomidi leBhodi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba. Le msebenzi yokudlulisa amandla noma imisebenzi kumele kube kuxhumene ngencwadi kumamukeli. IBhodi ingasungula ithimba labeluleki kunoma iyiphi indawo yesayensi yokuxhumana uma ibona ifanele. Noma iyiphi ithimba labeluleki kumele libe nabantu abahlanu abaphumelelayo abaneziqu noma ulwazi oluthile noma okuhlangenwe nakho endaweni yezindaba zase-Afrika okukhuluma ngayo, futhi abangamalungu eBhodi. Noma iyiphi ithimba labeluleki kumele ibeluleka iBhodi nganoma iyiphi indaba ephathelene nezindaba zase-Afrika ezazisunguliwe. Ilungu lethimba labeluleki kumele libe neziqu ezithile, kuhlanganise nezimo zokuhola, ukuhamba emihlanganweni, nokuhlinzekwa kosizo, okuzobekwa nguNgqongqoshe ngokubonisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali. IBhodi ingasusa noma iphelelise ubulungu bokuqashwa kwanoma ilungu lethimba labeluleki nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma kukhona izizathu ezanele zokwenza njalo. Amalungu ethimba labeluleki awazotholi ukwesekwa kwezimali kwiBhodi ngenkathi bebamba lezi zikhundla. IBhodi kumele, ngemuva kokubonisana noNgqongqoshe, ibeke uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi. Lo Mphathi Omkhulu
Ukwakhiwa kweBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kanye neBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle; kulungiselelwe ukuphathwa kwezikhungo ezithile yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe; kanye nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umkhumbi ubhekisela kunoma iyiphi isakhiwo esivunguza emanzini, kuhlanganise nezindiza. Ukuze kube lula ukudluliswa kwamakhono nolwazi, ulwazi, nokuphathwa ngokubambisana nomkhakha ozimele ongaphansi kokulawulwa kuk gouvernement. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa nguNgqongqoshe onenhloso, kuzokwakhiwa inkampani yeBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe ezoba nefa, izomela, futhi iphathe izikhungo egameni leHhovisi. Le Bhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe izophathwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA). UNgqongqoshe onenhloso kumele athathe izinyathelo zokwakha nokubhalisa iBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe njengenkampani yomphakathi engathengisa amasheya noma izitokwe futhi ikhishwe isitifiketi sokwakha futhi ilandele lokho okukhulunywa nguMthetho Wamakampani. IHhovisi izoba yilungu elilodwa kuphela kanye nomnikazi walesi sikhungo seBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe. Amalungelo eHhovisi ukuba ibe yilungu elinamasheya kule Bhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe azophathwa nguNgqongqoshe onenhloso. Uma kutholakala ukuthi lezi zifundo zokubhaliswa azihambisani nalokho okukhulunywa ngumthetho, lowo mthetho uzothathwa njengowokuqala noma uzosetshenziswa; futhi lokho okukhulunywa ngalezi zifundo zokubhaliswa kuzoba namandla kuphela uma lo mthetho ushintshwa ukuze ususe lokho okuphikisanayo. UNgqongqoshe onenhloso, ngokusekelwe eziphakamiso ezenziwe yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe, angacela uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha ukuba akhumbuze ukuthi ezinye izinhlinzeko noma izingxenye zomthetho wamakampani azisebenziseki kule Bhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe. UMsizi Wamakampani kumele aveze leyo mininingwane mayelana nokusebenza kwayo nokwesekwa kwayo ngokuhambisana nengxenye, ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yomphakathi. Kulokhu kwesaziso, uMsizi Wamakampani kumele ameme abantu ukuba bathumele izikhalazo zabo neziphakamiso kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kulokhu kwesaziso ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esikhulunywa kulokhu kwesaziso. Ngemuva kokubheka lezi zikhalazo neziphakamiso uma kukhona ezitholakele ngokuhambisana nengxenye 2, uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha, ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yomphakathi, angakhipha isinqumo sokuthi le ngxenye yezinhlinzeko ezithile noma zonke izinhlinzeko noma lezi zingxenye ezithintekayo nguMthetho Wamakampani, azisebenziseki kule Bhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywa kulokhu kwesaziso. Lokhu ngeke kunciphise noma kwehlise amandla eBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe ukuveza njengobuhlakani bomphakathi noma kwehlise ukuvuleka kokusebenza nokusetshenziswa; futhi ngeke kuphule amalungelo, inzuzo, noma izimangalo zalabo abakhokhelwa yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe noma abasebenzi noma ilungelo lokuzuza kwanoma ubani. Unyaka wezimali weBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe uzohamba kusukela kuMsombuluko 1 kuya kuMgqibelo 31 wonyaka olandelayo, kokubili izinsuku zifakiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywa nganoma yimuphi umthetho, iBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe ngeke ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu ophakanyisiwe yinkantolo noma ngaphansi kohlelo lokwehliswa kwenkampani olwehluleka ukukhokha izikweletu, ngaphandle kokuthi kuvunyelwe nguMthetho ofanele okukhulunywa ngawo ngqo ngalokho. Zonke izikhungo eziphansi kweBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe yeTransnet ngaphambi kokuthi lo mthetho uqale uzobuyela kwiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywa ngokuhambisana nengxenye 27. Ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yomphakathi, uNgqongqoshe uzokhipha isaziso sokuthi yiziphi ezinye izikhungo ezizongena ngaphansi kweBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe ngaphandle kwalokho okukhulunywa nengxenye 1. UNgqongqoshe angaphinde abuyekeze, ashintshe noma andise imingcele yezikhungo futhi kumele axhumane nezindawo ezihlobene uma lokho kubuyekezwa, kushintshwa noma kwandiswe kuzothinta imingcele yezindawo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle, ukwethembeka, kanye nezindleko zalesi sikhungo, ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezamukelekayo zomhlaba nezidingo zomphakathi. IBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kumele yenze konke okudingekayo ukuphatha izikhungo ngempumelelo nangokuphumelelayo, ukuhlela nokuqhubekisela phambili izikhungo. Ukuze kulungiselelwe ukwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi ukuze kuncishiswe ukuphindaphinda kwezenzo nezinqubo eziphathelene nokwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi. UNgqongqoshe kumele azise umphakathi ngalesi sikhumbuzo sokuxhumana esikhulunywa ngengxenye 2, ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yomphakathi. Ibhodi izoba nelungu elingaphansi kweyisi-7 futhi lingaphezulu kweyisi-13, elizokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe onenhloso. UNgqongqoshe onenhloso kumele aqoke ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe nguMongameli weBhodi. IBhodi kumele ikhethe uMongameli Osenhliziyweni phakathi kwamalungu ayo. Amalungu eBhodi kumele angamele izintshisekelo zeqembu elithile, kodwa kumele akhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke abasebenzisi bezikhungo. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe isaziso ngokwenza isitatimende kwiGazethi Yomphakathi nakumaphephandaba ngenhloso yakhe yokukhetha lowo muntu futhi ameme umphakathi ukuba athumele imibono yabo noma aphikise ukukhethwa kwalowo muntu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esikhulunywa kulokhu kwesaziso; futhi abheke eziphakamiso noma izikhalazo ezitholakele ngenxa yalokho kwesaziso. UNgqongqoshe onenhloso angakhetha amalungu okuqala eBhodi ngaphambi kokubhaliswa kweBhodi. Lezi zinketho zizothatha umthelela ngosuku lokubhaliswa. IBhodi izomela iBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe kuyo yonke imisebenzi ezokwenziwa yiBhodi ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho futhi ezizovunyelwa zizothathwa njengokwenziwa yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe. Ukuze kuvumeleke ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi abanye abaphathiswa yiBhodi Yezikhungo Zasolwandle Zesizwe; futhi kulandele inqubomgomo yeHhovisi mayelana nezohwebo zezikhungo zomphakathi. Akukho okukhulunywa nengxenye 1 kuzovimba iBhodi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yayo efanele ngempumelelo ukuphatha ngokwezimali, ukuhlela, ukwenza nokulawula izikhungo futhi lokho akuphikisi nomthetho. IBhodi kumele iqinisekise ukuthi ngaphansi kwez
Ukwakhiwa kweMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo; ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali kubantu abathile abangenamsebenzi kulolu Fund, nokukhokhela labo abasebenzi abagulayo, abakhulelwe, noma abanezingane, noma labo ababe sebenza ngaphambili uma sebedinga; ukuhlela ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo, imisebenzi yale Bhodi kanye nokungethula komphakathi weMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo; nokuhlela ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umbiko womphakathi, ukudluliswa kwamandla okuzonikezwa, amandla, nemisebenzi. Umphakathi angase abheke ukuthi umuntu ubeyisithunywa kuMali. Izingane zisho umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye esigabeni 30 ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 futhi kufaka phakathi umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-25 ongumfundi futhi ohlangene nazo zonke izidingo zezezimali zomuntu obekade esebenza. Umuntu osebenza emndenini njengomshayeli; nomuntu onakekela noma ubani kulelo khaya; kodwa akuhlanganisi umsebenzi wezolimo. Inhloso yale Mthetho ukuhlinzeka ngeMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo lapho izithunywa zizokwenziwa ngabapheki nabasebenzi ukuze uma abanye abasebenzi bephuma emsebenzini noma labo abaxhasayo, bakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ukuze banciphise imiphumela yezezimali nezenhlalo yokungasebenzi kwabantu. Abantu abafika eRiphabhulikhi ngenhloso yokwenza isivumelwano esithile, nalabo abasafunda ukuze basebenze, befunda lapha eRiphabhulikhi uma ekupheleni kwalolo sivumelwano umqashi ebophekile ngokomthetho noma ngokwenkonzo ukubuyisela lowo muntu ezweni lakhe, noma lowo muntu kufanele ahambe eRiphabhulikhi, kanye nabapheki babo. Ngaphandle kwesigaba 1, lo Mthetho ubeka emsebenzini kubasebenzi bendlu, abasebenzi besizini, nabapheki babo isikhathi esingama-12 ezinyangeni kusukela ekuqaleni kwalolu Mthetho. Umphathiswa kufanele, ngokushesha ngemva kokuthi lo Mthetho uqale ukusebenza, akhethe noma abeke umphakathi ukuze ahlole futhi enze izincomo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwalolu mthetho kubasebenzi bendlu nalabo abasebenza ngesizini. Umphathiswa kufanele axoxe neBhodi mayelana nemiphumela yokuhlola. Noma yiziphi izimali ezisele kulolu Fund kusukela ekusatshalalisweni komhlaba noma noma yiziphi izipho ezenziwe kuMali noma ezinye izimali ezingatholakala kulolu Fund. Ukukhokha - kwemiholo nezinsizakalo zamalungu eBhodi Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemisebenzi Engenayo kanye nekomidi yayo; nezinye izindleko ezingase zenzeke ngokuhambisana nokusebenza kwalolu Mthetho. Noma yimuphi umuntu, isikhungo, inkampani, noma isikhungo sezezimali singanikeza kulolu Fund noma sinikeze kulolu Fund njengomhlaba. Umqondisi-Jikelele angamukela izimali noma umhlaba owenziwe kuMali esikhundleni seMali. Ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezimbili ngemva kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, umphakathi kufanele ahlole isimo sezezimali sonke seMali salo nyaka wezezimali bese ekhishwa umbiko wesimo sezezimali kumqondisi-jikelele. Noma yiziphi izinguquko ekusetshenzisweni kwesizathu nezindlela zokukala umbiko wezezimali wonyaka odlule; kanye nezici ezithile noma izithiyo umqondisi-jikelele angase abe nazo ngokusebenzisa umphakathi noma ezisetshenziswa umphakathi ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba sombiko ukuze kuvele izinkinga ezibalulekile ukuze kutholwe umbono oqotho wesimo sezezimali seMali. Izincomo mayelana nokugcina noma ukuthuthukisa impilo yezezimali yeMali. Uma inani elidingekayo ukukhokha izinzuzo likhulu noma lincane kunalokho okudingekayo ukukhokhela izinzuzo ezilindelekile. Noma yiziphi izimali ezibuyisiwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 588; kanye nanoma yiziphi izindaba ezinqunywe umphathiswa. Futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezidingekayo; nokulandela inqubo echazwe esigabeni 55 nganoma yiziphi izinguquko uma kudingeka. Uma imiholo yehliswa kakhulu ngesikhathi esithile, ukubalwa kufanele kusekelwe enanini ejwayelekile yalowo msebenzi owathumele kuMali. Usuku lapho umsebenzi owathumele kuMali waqala khona kuze kube usuku lapho lowo msebenzi uphelile; nanoma yisiphi isikhathi - umsebenzi wakhokhelwa umholo esikhundleni sokwaziswa. Izinsuku lapho umuntu owathumele kuMali kufanele athole izinzuzo njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 3 ngeke zinciphise ukukhokhwa kwezinzuzo zokukhulelwa ngokuhambisana nengxenye D yale sahluko. Isinyathelo 3 - susa kulolu nani izinsuku lapho izinzuzo zitholakele (ukuhlukanisa izinzuzo zokukhulelwa) eminyakeni emine elandela usuku lokufaka isicelo sezinsiza ngokuhambisana nalesi sahluko. Isinyathelo 4 - Inani elisele yilo elinikeza izinsuku zokuthola izinzuzo umuntu owathumele kuMali kufanele athole. Uhluleka ukuhlangabezana nezimo zalo Mthetho noma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophathelene nokungasebenzi; noma ubephula imithetho yokuthola izinzuzo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 361. Ngalesi sikhathi, isikhathi sokungasebenzi kufanele sibilwe kusukela ngosuku lokuphela komsebenzi, noma usuku lokugcina lokusebenza. Usuku okukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 1 lungandiswanga lube usuku ngaphambi kosuku lokufaka isicelo uma umphakathi ophatha izicelo ekholwa ukuthi isizathu sokulibaziseka kokufaka isicelo sasinjengokungaphatheki kahle komuntu owathumele kuMali. Umuntu owathumele kuMali kufanele abhalise njengomfuna umsebenzi nezinsizakalo zokusebenza ezakhiwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998 uMthetho No. 97 ka-1998; futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 3, umuntu owathumele kuMali kufanele ulungele futhi akwazi ukusebenza. Umuntu owathumele kuMali uhluleka ukuveza phakathi kwezinsuku nezikhathi ezibekwe umphakathi ophatha izicelo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 174d; noma umuntu owathumele kuMali uphika noma uphika ukuqeqeshwa noma ukwelashwa ngezizathu ezithathwa njengezingafanele ngaphansi kwanoma yisiphi uhlelo olwamukelwe umqondisi-jikelele ngokuhambisana nalolu Mthetho noma yimuphi omunye Umthetho. Ngaphezu kwesigaba 1d futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 201a, umuntu owathumele kuMali ophazamisekile yisifo esithole izinzuzo zokungasebenzi uzophinde athole izinzuzo zokungasebenzi isikhathi eside umphakathi ophatha izicelo ekholwa ukuthi lesi sifo ngeke sithinte amathuba alowo muntu owathumele kuMali ukuthola umsebenzi. Isicelo sezinsizakalo zokungasebenzi kufanele senziwe ngokugcwalisa ifomu elakhiwe ngenhloso. Isicelo kufanele senziwe phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ngosuku lokuphela komsebenzi, kodwa umphakathi angase wamukele izicelo ezithunyelwe ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi uma kukhona izizathu ezisemthethweni. Umphakathi ophatha izicelo kufanele ahlole isicelo uma kudingeka futhi angacela olunye ulwazi mayelana nokuqhubeka kokungasebenzi komfaki-sicelo. Umqondisi-Jikelele kufanele akhokhele umuntu owathumele kuMali izinzuzo zokungasebenzi ehhovisi lokusebenza lapho isicelo sithunyelwe noma ehhovisi elinye elibekwe ngumfaki-sicelo ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Uma umfaki-sicelo ethola izinzuzo zokungasebenzi futhi ephika noma uphika ukuthola umsebenzi ofanele ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele noma uphika ukuq
Lo mthetho uhlanganisa umthethosisekelo. I-Centre isunguliwe njengomuntu ophakathi kwezomthetho okuzobizwa ngokuthi i-South African Science Centre. Iphakamisa ngokuphelele ubuhlakani babantu bonke; futhi inikeza izeluleko ezinhle futhi ikhulisa izenzo mayelana nezidingo zokubambisana, amathuba, kanye nezinselelo ezibhekene nabo bonke abakha iNingizimu Afrika. Le Centre iyona kuphela i-science centre eyamukelwa nguHulumeni. UNgqongqoshe angayala le Centre ukuba iqhube imisebenzi ethile ehambisana nezinhloso zayo. Kunohlobo olulodwa lokubhaliswa kule Centre, kodwa amalungu angaba amalungu anenhlonipho (labo abahoxile kodwa basahlonishwa) kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka wabo wokusebenza obubanjwe iminyaka engama-70. Ilungu leCentre kulindeleke ukuthi lisize le Centre ukufezekisa izinhloso zayo. Inqubo ezolandela uma kukhethwa amalungu eCentre izoba yimpumelelo enkulu ekuthuthukiseni noma ekusebenziseni isayensi. Abantu abaphakanyiswa ukuba babe amalungu amasha eCentre bazophakanyiswa futhi banikezwe isitifiketi esinqunywe ngamalungu okungenani amane, okungenani amabili kufanele abe nolwazi lomuntu siqu ngomsebenzi wesayensi kanye nendima ebonakalayo edlalwe yilowo muntu esayensi. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sihlanganise incazelo echaza ukuthi ukhetho kwalowo muntu njengelungu leCentre kuzothuthukisa kanjani izinhloso zeCentre. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele sibe nekhasi elichaza ukuzibophezela kwalowo muntu ukuba aqashwe njengelungu leCentre, futhi kufanele sibe ne dokhumenti echaza umlando wabo wezokufunda nezokusebenza (curriculum vitae). IBhodi leCentre kufanele ibuyekeze minyaka yonke zonke izicelo ezintsha ezithunyelwe ngonyaka odlule, kulandela inqubo esunguliwe yokufaneleka. Bonke abakhona njengamalungu eCentre kuzodingeka bavote, ngovoti olufihlekile, baveze ukuthi bayamukela noma abamukeli umuntu othile ophakanyiswe yiBhodi noma baveze uma besendaweni yokungavoti noma bephakathi. Amalungu eCentre angavoti azobhekwa njengokuthi abavoti. Umuntu othola okungenani amavoti amathathu uzobhekwa njengokhetho njengelungu leCentre, uma okungenani ingxenye yamavoti imamukele. a "Mina, egameni eliphelele, ngiyafunga ukuthi ngizothuthukisa isimo eNingizimu Afrika ngokucabanga kwesayensi futhi ngiphakamise izinhloso ze-South African Science Centre ngokusemandleni ami; futhi b Ngizohlonipha umthethosisekelo osunguliwe kanye nezikhombandlela ezisunguliwe zeCentre njengoba ngisahlala ngilungu leCentre." Noma ilungu leCentre linomsebenzi, ngaphandle kwemigomo ye-subsection 9, yokubamba iqhaza ekhetho lamalungu amasha eCentre kanye namalungu eBhodi. ICentre izophathwa futhi ibusiswe yiBhodi ngokweMthetho. IBhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinhloso zeCentre zifezwa ngokuzikhandla futhi kufanele ibheke ukuhlinzekwa kwemisebenzi yeCentre. e kanye namalungu ayisixhenxe; kanye f ilungu elilodwa leBhodi yeZeluleko Kazwelonke ku-Innovation ezokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe. Amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwalawo malungu akhuluma ngawo ku-subsection 3 f, azokhethwa ngamalungu eCentre phakathi kwabo bese ekhethwa nguNgqongqoshe. IBhodi izosebenzisa amandla anikezwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho futhi iqhube imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngumlomo. a IBhodi izobamba imihlangano yayo ngezikhathi nezindawo ezizokwenziwa nguMongameli. b Amalungu akhona emhlanganweni azokwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano futhi enze izinqumo uma iningi lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni. b umuntu ophukile ezinkingeni zezimali futhi ongakabuyiselwa ngokomthetho. g ophume emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha okungafanele ngemva kokulalela mayelana nesenzo esingase sibe nomthelela omubi kwiCentre, kodwa leli lungu lingase likhanselwe kuze kube emhlanganweni wonyaka olandelayo lapho leli khanselo kumele libe kubhalwe emaminithini ezinqumo. h ngokuhambisana nemigomo yale ngxenye, umuntu ophakamisile isaziso esibhaliwe noma incwadi yokukhansela kufanele ayithumele kuMongameli futhi iBhodi izomukela le khanselo uma zonke izikweletu zikhokhiwe. Noma ilungu leBhodi elifuna ukukhansela ubulungu balo kufanele lithumele isaziso esibhaliwe sokukhansela esibhalwe kuMongameli, futhi iBhodi kufanele yamukele lesi saziso uma zonke izikweletu ezidingekayo zikhokhiwe. Uma isikhala selungu leBhodi siba singenalutho ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi salo lungu, uNgqongqoshe, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-subsection 1, kufanele aqashe umuntu ophakanyiswe yiBhodi ukuze agcwalise leso sikhala phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 zokungabi nalutho. IBhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwezinhlelo, ingasebenzisa amandla noma iqhube noma iyiphi imisebenzi yeCentre ebekwe kuyo yiBhodi. Ikomidi elikhuluma ngalo ku-subsection 1 lizoba nezinye amalungu eCentre kanye nabasebenzi beCentre abathathwa njengabafanele yiBhodi, uma kukhona, iBhodi ingase isuse noma ibuyisele ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanele. Uma ikomidi linamalungu angaphezu kwelilodwa, iBhodi kufanele iqashe ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe ngumholi walelo komidi. IBhodi ayinakubhekelela ukwenza noma iyiphi imisebenzi ebekwe kunoma ikuphi ikomidi leBhodi ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi. Ngaphezu kwemisebenzi ethile ebekwe kumongameli ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho, kuzoba ngummeli ophathelene nokuhlola izimali ezitholakele nokusetshenziswa kwazo futhi kuzoba nomthwalo wokubheka impahla yeCentre. i ingase ikhiphe kumunye ilungu leBhodi amandla anikezwe kumongameli ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho noma kulolu mthetho; noma ii ivumele lowo muntu ukuba aqhube imisebenzi ebekwe kumongameli ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. b Ukuhlinzekwa kwamandla ngaphansi kwe-subsection a akuvimbele ukuhlinzeka ngalawo mandla noma ukwenza leyo msebenzi kumongameli. ICentre ingaqasha abasebenzi ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile uma ibona kufanele ukuze iCentre iqhube imisebenzi yayo, ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-subsection (b). b ICentre kufanele ikhokhe amaholo, izinzuzo, kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezizokwenziwa yiBhodi ezivela ezimali zayo. c ICentre ingase, uma ibona kufanele ngemuva kokuvuma ngomsebenzi, idlulisele noma isekele lowo msebenzi ukuze iqhube imisebenzi ethile noma isikhathi esithile kwiMnyango Wezokuphatha, inhlangano, noma isikhungo eRiphabhulikhi ngaphansi kwezimo ezinjengokuthi amalungelo nezinsizakalo zalowo msebenzi azingalimaliwe ngokusekelwa kwawo. b singase sikhokhe izimali zomsebenzi ukuze sisize lowo msebenzi ukuze ube ilungu noma ubambe iqhaza emfundweni yokuthola umhlalaphansi okukhulunywe yiCentre noma singacela ukuyeka ukusebenza ngovuma ukuthola inzuzo yokuthola umhlalaphansi ebhekwa njengokwesekwa komhlalaphansi. ICentre kufanele isetshenzise iminikelo nokwesekwa okukhulunywe ku-subsection 1b ngenhla ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe yilabo abanikela le mali. ICentre ingase ikhokhe izimali zokusebenza noma yenze ezinye izinhlelo zezimali ezibona ezifanele. Isitatimende sezimali kufanele sinikezwe amalungu phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha ngemuva kokuphela konyaka wezimali. k qasha, enze izinqumo
UMphathiswa Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, emva kokuxoxisana noMphathiswa Wezindaba Zasemasikweni mayelana nezindaba zokuphatha kahulumeni ekhaya, wenza lokhu ngokuhambisana nesigaba 19 soMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1997) ngokukhishwa kwemiyalelo equkethwe kulolu hlu. a ukuhlinzeka noma ukwamukela noma yisiphi isikhwama esingafanele, ukungena, isipho, noma enye inzuzo engafanele eyenzeka ngoba kufanele noma akufanele uthathe isinyathelo esithile esithinta isivumelwano; b ukufuna, ukuhlinzeka, ukubamba iqhaza, ukudala umjikelezo, nokuzama ukudala izimo ezichazwe emiyalelweni a. e Umthetho Wokulingana Kwezemployment ungumthetho No. 75 ka-1997 futhi f Umthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ungumthetho No. 97 ka-1998. a ucabangela ulimi abathanda noma olusebenzisa endaweni futhi b ucabangela izidingo ezihlukene zabantu abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala nalabo ababe nezinselelo esikhathini esedlule. c chaza izimo nemigomo ngaphansi kwazo abanye abahlinzeki bezamanzi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwendawo ephethwe yikhabhinethi yamanzi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ingxenye yephrogram yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. d isivumelwano kumele sichaze ububanzi bomsebenzi nezinga lomsebenzi okufanele lenziwe, futhi sizokhomba ukuthi uma kushintsha, kuzoshintsha ngokuya ngezimo zendawo zesivumelwano nezidingo ezithile, kuhlanganise nesikhathi esichaziwe futhi kubalulekile ukuba kuhambisane nohlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwezezimali ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinga lomsebenzi elibekiwe; futhi e chaza lezo zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezizoba yingxenye yesivumelwano kanye nohlelo ukuze umhlinzeki wamanzi akwazi ukufinyelela lezo zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Isivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zazo zonke izinhlangothi ekutholeni noma yiziphi izimvume ezidingekayo, ukuze usebenzise amanzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 soMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). b Isivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokuqhathaniswa kwesikhathi somsebenzi owenziwayo; kufanele futhi c ivumele ithuba lokuphinda kuxoxwe ngezinga lomsebenzi nezinkomba ezihilela labo abasebenzisa amanzi. Isivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezimo ezibalulekile okufanele umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi ahlangabezane nazo mayelana nokwenza umsebenzi. Isivumelwano kumele sihlanganise umthetho ozovimbela umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi ekudluliseni amalungelo akhe noma yiziphi zezibopho zakhe zesivumelwano kumuntu nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba athole imvume yekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Isivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuhlela kwabasebenzi abakule khabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi abahilelekile ekuhlinzekeni ngamanzi nalabo abathintekile ngesivumelwano mayelana nokuthi bazokhokhelwa kanjani ngokwezomthetho wezabasebenzi. i futhi kuzoletha izinguquko kumali ezikhokhwayo, amaholo, noma kuzoletha izinguquko ezingeni noma izinga lokusebenza ii lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuveza ulwazi emphakathini mayelana nezichibiyelo nezinguquko eziphakanyisiwe ku-I ngenhla; futhi h noma yiziphi izijeziso ezingafanele zikhokhwe nganoma ubani onenhlangano yokungaphumeleli ukwenza umsebenzi. Isivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi noma iyiphi uhlelo olubhaliwe, incwadi yemiyalelo, isizinda solwazi, uhlu olunembile, amarekhodi ezimali, kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluqoqwe ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano kuzohlala kuyimpahla yekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. a ivimbela ukuthengiswa, ukudluliswa kwamalungelo okuphatha, noma ukungabazi kwanoma iyiphi impahla engumhlaba kanye nezakhiwo ezikhona noma ezizayo futhi engelona impahla yekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, kuhlanganise nanoma iyiphi ingxenye yezenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ngaphandle kokuthi ukuthengiswa, noma ukudluliswa kwamalungelo noma ukungabazi kuhlelwe ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi noma ii kuqinisekiswe ngesisekelo sokuxazulula se kaphalamende yekhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. b isivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokuqhubeka kokungabazi kwezakhiwo futhi sichaze amasu okugcina impahla isesimweni esisebenzayo ukuze kukhombise ukuthi umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ugcinwa esimweni esifanele; bese c sichaza inqubo yokuthola impahla, ukuthengisa, ukudlulisa amalungelo okuphatha, nokulahla impahla engabazekile. c kumele ihlinzeke ngokuqhathaniswa kwezimali ngezikhathi ezichaziwe mayelana nendlela esetshenziswe; futhi d ihlinzeke ngokwabelana ngezinzuzo zezimali ezizotholakala ngokwenza umsebenzi ngendlela efanele nasezingeni lomhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi. ukuba nohlelo lokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzisi bamanzi iii chaza ilungelo lomsebenzisi wamanzi lokuthi kube nezinkinga ezilungisiwe b qapha ukuhlala kwenqubo ezovumela abasebenzisi bamanzi endaweni lapho isivumelwano sisebenza khona ukuba babambe iqhaza ekubhaleni idokhumenti yamalungelo abasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kumele kuhlelwe ukuthi i kube nemihlangano nemiphakathi lapho, uma ibanjwe, kuhlonishwa ulimi oluthandwa nolukhuluma abantu bendawo lapho isivumelwano sisebenza khona; bese ii kube nendlela yokwamukela, ukuhlaziya, nokucabangela imibono neziphakamiso zabantu abasebenzisa amanzi ezethulwe mayelana nedokhumenti yamalungelo ephakanyisiwe. Isivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi ikhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi izobheka kanjani ukusebenza komhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi ukuze ihambisane nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 27 soMthetho. Isivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi uhlinzeka ngolwazi olungase ludingeke yikhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuze iqaphe ukuhambisana nesivumelwano ukuze ikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zayo zokubika kuMphathiswa kanye nohulumeni wesifunda ukuthi umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi uyahambisana nomthetho nalesi sikhombandlela. a lungisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi nezitatimende zezimali ngokulandela incwadi yemithetho ethathwa njengelungelo kwezomnotho futhi yamukelwe Njengoba Yamukelwe Izindlela Zokubala Ezivamile eNingizimu Afrika noma uma kukhulunywa ngezinga elithile likahulumeni, landela umthetho ofanele wokubika kwezezimali; futhi b ivumele ikhabhinethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuthola wonke amarekhodi nezitatimende zezimali adingekayo ukuze ahlolwe futhi abhaliswe ngaphansi kwesivumelwano. a qopha bonke abantu abasebenzisa amanzi nalabo abake bawasebenzisa ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano b uhlu lwezimpahla nezakhiwo zezinsizakalo zamanzi kuhlanganise nezimo zazo nezindawo zazo futhi c qopha imisebenzi, ukugcinwa kwemishini nezinsiza, ukuhlolwa, nokucubungula izimo zemishini. Umhlinzeki wesevisi yamanzi kumele ngaphansi kwesivumelwano aqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo ngabantu abasebenzisa amanzi kanye nalabo abangase bawasebenzise esikhathini esizayo lukhona. e izimali ezikhokhwayo nezinhlelo. Kubuhlungu kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azi ukuthi iKomishini yeSevisi Yomphakathi ngaphansi kweSigaba 11 seMthetho weKomishini yeSevisi Yomphakathi ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 46 ka-1997) ifundwa ndawonye neSigaba 196 (f) (ii) soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhliki yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) isungule imithetho ebhalwe kuSheduli 1 lapha. Kubalulekile ukuthi kucatshangelwe ukuthi omunye umqashi, ummeleli noma usemthethweni wenhlangano evunywayo ubamba iqhaza. Ukuphathwa noma ukuphathwa kwezikhalazo kufanele kube ngokushesha, kungakhethi, futhi kube nokulingana, kube nezixhumanisi eziqinile emsebenzini, kanye nokuxazululwa kwezikhalazo zomuntu ngamunye ezingeni eliphansi lelo department. Isikhalazo kufanele sixazululwe ngumqashi lapho sivelayo noma ezingeni eliseduzane. Umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izikhalazo zixazululwa ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokukhetha, futhi ukuthi izimiso zokulunga zilandelwa. Le nqubo kufanele isize futhi ivumele umqashi nomqashi ukuthi baxazulule ukunganeliseki. Akekho umqashi okufanele aphathwe kabi noma akhethwe ngqo noma ngokuqondile ngenxa yokuthi ubeke isikhalazo. Uma umqashi ethola isinyathelo sokubopha, ukusebenzisa le nqubo ngumqashi ukuze abhekane nalesi simo esihlobene nesinyathelo sokubopha ngeke kube yinqubo yokubopha. Isikhalazo kufanele sibhaliwe lapho sithunyelwa, futhi zonke izinqumo ezenziwe kule nqubo kufanele zibhaliwe. Uma ucabanga ngezikhathi ezinqunyiwe, lokhu kufanele kubalwe ngokukhipha usuku lokuqala bese kubalwa usuku lokugcina. Ababandakanyekayo kufanele balandele isikhathi esibekwe kule nqubo, ngaphandle uma bevuma ukwandisa isikhathi. Isikhalazo kufanele sithunyelwe kumqashi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-90 kusukela ngosuku umqashi ethole ngalo isenzo esamphoxile noma ukungasebenzi. Umqashi angacela ukuthi isikhalazo sakhe sithunyelwe kuKomishini phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 ngemuva kokuthola isinqumo kusuka kumphakathi ofanele. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umqashi ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze abeke futhi aqhubeke nesikhalazo, uma kuceliwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kwalolo lwazi kuncike ezithintweni zomthetho. Umqashi kufanele aziswe ngesimo sesikhalazo sakhe nokuthi sithuthuke kangakanani ekuxazululweni ngosuku oluhlongozwayo. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umqashi ikhophi yefomu lesikhalazo ngemuva kwezinga ngalinye lapho isikhalazo sithathwa khona ngempahla. Umqashi angathumela isikhalazo sakhe kumqashi oqokwe noma kumqondisi enqubweni yokuxazulula izikhalazo kulolo department. Ifomu elibekiwe i-Annexure A kufanele lisetshenziswe lapho kuthunyelwa isikhalazo. Umqashi oqokwe kufanele axhumane nomphakathi ofanele kulolo department ukuze azame ukuxazulula isikhalazo. Isikhalazo singaxazululwa nganoma yimuphi umuntu kulolo mkhakha ofanele onegunya lokwenza njalo. Umqashi obeke isikhalazo uzokhunjulwa ngumqashi oqokwe ngesimo nangesinyathelo esithathwe ekuxazululeni isikhalazo. Uma isikhalazo sixazululwa ngendlela efanele, umqashi obeke isikhalazo uzothola ukuqinisekiswa okubhaliwe ngalokhu kumqashi oqokwe. Uma isikhalazo singaxazululwa, umphakathi ofanele kufanele wazise umqashi obeke isikhalazo. Idepartment (kuhlanganise nomphakathi ofanele) inezinsuku eziyi-30 zokubhekana nesikhalazo. Le nkathi ingandiswiswa ngenkontileka ebhaliwe. Umphakathi kufanele, ngokwemigomo yeSigaba 35 (1) seMthetho weSevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994, uthumele isikhalazo nemibhalo efanele kuKomishini yeSevisi Yomphakathi ukuze yenze izincomo phakathi nezinsuku ezi-5 zokwaziswa ngumqashi onesikhalazo. Uma isikhalazo sihilela ukuvuma kokungafaneleka kwezokusebenza njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi ka-1995, umqashi angazisa umphakathi ofanele ukuthi ufuna ukusebenzisa inqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano esunguliwe kuMthethosisekelo weBhodi yeZokuxhumana zeSevisi Yomphakathi, noma iyiphi ibhodi efanele (noma iyiphi imbody efanele) futhi ukuthi iKomishini yeSevisi Yomphakathi ayikwazi ukucabangela leli sikhalazo. a ngqo kuKomishini; noma b uma kuwukuxabana kwezokusebenza nebhodi yeZokuxhumana zeSevisi Yomphakathi noma iyiphi ibhodi efanele noma imbody efanele mayelana nenqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano. Uma iKomishini isitholile yonke imininingwane evela kumphakathi ofanele, kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku ezi-30, icabangele leli sikhalazo futhi ibhale kumphakathi ofanele ngezincazelo zayo nezizathu zesinqumo sayo. Ngemuva kokuthola izincomo zeKomishini, umphakathi ofanele kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku ezi-5, ubhale kumqashi kanye neKomishini ngesinqumo sawo. a thumele isikhalazo sakhe kuMongameli uma kuyinhloko yephalamende lesizwe; noma b thumele isikhalazo sakhe kumphakathi ofanele uma kuyinhloko yephalamende lesifunda. UMongameli noma uMphakathi unezinsuku eziyi-30 zokubhekana nesikhalazo. Le nkathi ingandiswiswa ngokuvumelana. Imithetho F9 no-F10 ifundwa nemishwana edingekayo futhi izosebenza kuzo zonke izikhalazo zezinhloko zezigaba. Inhloko ye department kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi ukuxazululwa kwezikhalazo kuqoshwa ngokugcina amarekhodi enani lezikhalazo ezixazululiwe kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka ngamunye futhi ibike kuKomishini ngalokhu njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. IKomishini kufanele ibike ePhalamende okungenani kanye ngonyaka mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinkinga nezindlela zokuphumelela zenqubo yokuxazulula izikhalazo kanye nezisebenzi zayo, esifundazweni kuMphakathi wesifunda. Uma isikhalazo sithunyelwa ngaphansi kwale nqubo, umqashi obeke isikhalazo kufanele avule uma ethanda ukusebenzisa ezinye izinqubo. Isikhalazo esibekwe ngaphambi kokukhululwa kweMithetho Yesikhashana, ngaphambi kosuku luka-1 kuJulayi 1999, sizophathwa futhi siqedwe ngokuhambisana neMithetho Yesikhalazo Yesikhashana ekhishwe ngaphansi kokukhululwa kuGazethi yoHulumeni No. 20231 ka-1999. Usuku lokusebenza kwale mithetho ngu-19 kuZibandlela 2003, ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe kuMthetho K. Le fomu kufanele isetshenziswe ukuze kubekwe isikhalazo (ukukhishwa kokuphuma okungalungile) uma unganelisekile ngesenzo noma ukungasebenzi futhi ungakaze uxazulule le ndaba ngezingxoxo ezingekho emthethweni ngokomthetho. Ungase uthole usizo noma umeleke omunye umqashi noma ummeleli noma usemthethweni wenhlangano evunywayo. Kubalulekile ukuba ugcwalise yonke imininingwane ngokunembile. Uma ifomu igcwaliswe, kufanele inikezwe kumqashi oqokwe ukuze alungiselele noma abe umxhumanisi enqubweni yokuxazulula izikhalazo kule ndawo. Idepartment izobophela le fomu kumanye amadokhumenti ezikhalazo futhi izosetshenziswa kuzo zonke izigaba zenqubo yokuxazulula izikhalazo. UMphathiswa Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, ngaphansi kwamandla anikezwe yizigaba 26 (a) no (g), kanye nesigaba 116 esifundwa ndawonye nesigaba 21(k) seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke, 1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998), uhlose ukwenza imithetho kuSheduli. Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kuhambisana nesu elivunyelwe lokusebenzisa amanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa, okuyisu lokwenza imisebenzi ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo 5 lapho kufanelekile; futhi futhi kuhambisana nezidingo zanyanyathiselwe noma yisiphi isizathu esamukelekayo sokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, lapho kudingeka. Futhi izindlela ezifanele zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; kanye nendawo lapho kukhona izindawo ezibucayi noma ezivikelwe uma kungekho isu elivunyelwe lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi. Umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngendlela enomthelela omkhulu noma ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa eziholela enprofit kufanele afake isicelo sokuvunyelwa kwesu lokwenza imisebenzi mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamanzi enomthelela omkhulu noma ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 zokuthola isaziso ngendlela efanele ukuze enze kanjalo. Ngokuhambisana nanoma yiziphi iziqondiso ezilawula udoti nezindawo noma izinqubo; futhi ukuvikela nokuthuthukisa amanani namasiko mayelana nomthombo wamanzi. Lokhu kuhambisana nezidingo zezinqubomgomo 2; futhi noma yimuphi umfaki-sicelo ovezile ukuthi angakwazi, noma uzokwazi ukuphatha nokulawula imithelela emibi kumthombo wamanzi njengoba kuboniswe kuzinqubomgomo 2g. Izinqubomgomo zokulawula zingase zicela olunye ulwazi kumuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa, njengokuthi umyalezo wezinhlinzeko zezinqubomgomo 2 futhi zingase zisho ukuthi isu eliphakanyisiwe lokwenza imisebenzi lishintshiwe njengoba kudingekile yizinqubomgomo zokulawula. Uma izinqubomgomo zokulawula zikhululekile isizathu sokwenza imisebenzi, umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa kufanele ahambisane nezinhlinzeko zesu elivunyelwe lokwenza imisebenzi. Isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi kufanele lithuthukiswe yizinhlinzeko ezifanele futhi liboniswe yizinqubomgomo zokulawula ukuze kuvunyelwe ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kulowo mthombo wamanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa, kuhlanganise namanzi angaphezulu emisebenzi kahulumeni, ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-180 kusukela ngosuku lapho izinhlinzeko ezifanele zaziswa yizinqubomgomo zokulawula ukuze zenze kanjalo. Isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, njengoba kuchazwe kuzinqubomgomo 1, kufanele libhalwe ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zeMnyango mayelana ne-Integrated Water Resource Management Strategy, mayelana Nokusetshenziswa Kwamazwe Ngezizathu Zokuzijabulisa, ephepheni ngoMsombuluko 2005. Kufanele kusungulwe isikhala sokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; futhi kufanele kuvumeleke imibono ebhaliwe ukuba ithunyelwe ngesizathu esiphakanyisiwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokushicilelwa kwesaziso; futhi kufanele kubhekwane nazo zonke imibono eyamukelekayo. Kungashintshwa isikhala sokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; futhi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zezinqubomgomo 3, kushicilelwe isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi ezincwadini nasemithonjeni ethile ephathelene nomthombo wamanzi ophazamisekile. Noma yimuphi umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa kufanele akhuthazwe ukugcina amarekhodi okusetshenziswa kwamanzi afanele futhi anikeze izinhlinzeko zokulawula ngalolo lwazi. Akekho omunye umuntu, ngaphandle kokuba nenhloso ebhaliwe kaMphathiswa, ongafinyelela noma iyiphi ingxenye yemisebenzi kahulumeni yamanzi, lapho kungekho indawo yokufinyelela esemthethweni. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ngezinjongo zokuzijabulisa akuvunyelwe kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yemisebenzi kahulumeni yamanzi ngaphandle kokuthi uMphathiswa uyivumele ebhaliwe. Akukho imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa ezindaweni zokuphepha zomjovo wezimpahla kanye nomlomo wemisebenzi noma ekukhishweni kwayo ngaphandle kokuthi uMphathiswa akhiphe imvume ebhaliwe; futhi kuphela izimoto ezihamba ngesivinini esingaphazamisi kuphela ezivunyelwe ezindaweni ezibekiwe ezingezona zokuzijabulisa. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophula noma ongahambisani nezinhlinzeko zalezi Ziqondiso ubhekwa njengomsolwa, futhi, uma ebanjwa, ubhekene nehlawulo noma ukujolwa isikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni emihlanu. Lezi Ziqondiso zingabizwa ngokuthi Iziqondiso Zokusebenzisa Amanzi Ngezizathu Zokuzijabulisa. Ingxenye yokuqala ibeka izimo nezinqubo ezizolandela ngesikhathi sokuqala sokwenza umsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process ngaphakathi kweminyango yamasipala. Ingxenye yesibili ibeka izimo ezizokwenziwa ekupheleni kwesigaba sokuhlola ukuze kugcinwe le nqubo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lokhu kunikeza abasebenzi amandla okwenza isicelo sokubuyekezwa kokusebenza kwabo ngenkathi ngakolunye uhlangothi, kuqinisekisa ukuphathwa nokubuyekezwa kwezinqubo ezibekwe kanye nokwethembeka kwazo. Inqubo yokuhlola iyinhloso yokuvumelana kweSouth African Local Government Bargaining Council (SALGBC) ukuthi kunesidingo sokuba nendlela efanayo yokuhlola ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweminyango yohulumeni bendawo. Kunombono wonke amaqembu ukuthi le uniformity ibalulekile ezicini ezahlukene zokusebenza ezifana nezinkulumo zokuhola, ukuqonda okufanele kwezikhala zabasebenzi kanye nezimo zenhlangano, ukuhlela kwezobuchwepheshe kweminyango, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa nokuthuthukisa. Lo mbhalo wezinyathelo kufanele ufundwe ngokuhlanganyela nomsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process, ama-Job Evaluation Training Manuals, kanye nezincwadi zeMnyango Wamasipala mayelana nomsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process. Uhloswe ukuhola inqubo ukuze kugwenywe ukubambezeleka ekwenzeni ukuhlola ngenxa yokungavumelani okungadingekile nezinkinga. Kuqondene nokuphothula isigaba sokuqala senqubo yokuhlola ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingafinyelela ezinyangeni eziyi-18. Kubalulekile ukuthi le nqubo ibe nomphakathi ophumelelayo ngangokunokwenzeka futhi yamukelekile kubasebenzi. Akukho umsebenzi ozosala esimweni sokusebenza esiphansi kunalokho okwamanje okwenelisayo ngenxa yokuhlolwa kokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasebenzi akufanele balindele ukuthi isigaba sokuhlola sizohlinzeka nganeliseko kubo bonke. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ukuxoxisana ngokwenyusa amaholo nezihlolo ezintsha akusho nje ukuthi kukhona ukwenyusa amaholo kubo bonke abasebenzi kodwa kuyashintsha inqubo yokuhlola esivele ikhona ibe yindlela eyodwa. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le ndlela iyasetshenziswa. Ngemuva kwalokho, wonke umuntu uzoba nethuba lokwenza isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwesikhundla sabo uma bezwa ukuthi isigaba sabo asikhombisi kahle ubunjalo bomsebenzi wabo noma uma bezwa ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ushintshile ngemuva kokuhlolwa kokuqala kwezikhundla. Izindawo zokuhlola zisezindaweni ezisemthethweni ezibekwe ukuze kusungulwe amaKomidi Wokuhlola Imisebenzi (PJECs) kuze kube yilapho inqubo yokuhlola iphelile. Zonke izigungu zamasipala zizoba Izindawo Zokuhlola Imisebenzi. Ezinye Izindawo Zokuhlola Imisebenzi zizokwenziwa yiKomidi Eliphezulu le-SALGBC ngokusekelwe eziphakamiso ezenziwe yiMnyango Wamasipala we-SALGBC. Lezi ziph
Ngokuhambisana neMigomo Emisha Yokuphatha Nokuthuthukisa, phakathi neminyaka eyi-12 yokuqala kuhulumeni wenkululeko, sigxile emizamweni yethu yokwenza ushintsho emphakathini. Sifake ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengomgomo ophambili wenqubo yokuphatha kanye nomgomo wokunciphisa amazinga obuphofu, kanye nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuphila emphakathini wethu kubantu abampofu nabakhelwe ngaphandle. Ngenxa yokuzinikela kweSikhungo sethu kuThuthukiswa Komphakathi, eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, kube nesigxile esibalulekile ezinsizakalweni zokuphila, kanye nemizamo eqhubekayo yokulinganisa izinzuzo nokufinyelela kwabantu ezinsizakalweni zokuphila. Izidingo ezibekwe ebhajethi yezinsizakalo zokuphila zikhombisile ukuthi sekwenziwe izinyathelo zokuxhasa izidingo eziyisisekelo, njengokuvikelwa kwezinsizakalo zokuphila, ukugcina amakhono abalulekile ezisebenzi zokuphila, kanye nokubandakanywa komphakathi kwezinhlangano zokuphila. Ngenxa yalokho, kwasungulwa iHhovisi Lezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, futhi iMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ube nesigxile esibalulekile kulezi zidingo ezibalulekile. Isibonelo, eminyakeni yamuva, iMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi waqala umgomo ophathelene neMali Yabakhi (PFA). Uhlobo lwezwe lufuneke ukuthi uhulumeni abuyekeze indlela asebenzisa ngayo izinsiza zawo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zabelwa ngokulinganayo kulabo abake bakhishwa ngaphandle emphakathini wethu. I-PFA iyisicwangciso esibalulekile sokusiza ushintsho emphakathini nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ngokuxhasa ngokwezimali abakhangisi. Njengoba kuvunyelwene ngazo zonke izithakazelo emphakathini eMhlanganweni Wokukhula Nokuthuthukiswa, zonke izithakazelo kulindeleke ukuthi zisebenze ndawonye ekuxazululeni izinselelo zomnotho emphakathini wethu. Uhulumeni kuphela akakwazi ukunqoba lezi zinselelo. Ngakho-ke, iMnyango uqhubeka nokuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukubambisana okukhulayo phakathi kweZinhlangano Ezingenzi Nzuzo (NGOs), Izinhlangano Ezisekelwe Kwenkolo (FBOs), Izinhlangano Ezisekelwe Emphakathini (CBOs), kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ukuze siphumelele kulesi simiso, izicwangciso zathuthukiswa ukuze kubalwe izindleko zokubhekana nakho konke okuhlobene nokuphumeleliswa kwalesi simiso. Ukuze abakhangisi basebenze, kumele baxhaswe kahle, futhi izindinganiso zokukhokha zabakhangisi kumele zibekwe kuwo wonke amaphondo. Ngokufanayo, izicwangciso zokubala izindleko zohlelo lwezinsizakalo zokuphila zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izindinganiso ezibekiwe nezinsiza zabelwa ngokulinganayo. Iziphakamiso eziphathelene nokuxhaswa kwezimali kwezimiso ezichazwe ku-PFA zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zifinyelela kulabo emphakathini nasezinhlangano ezidinga kakhulu, futhi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezingezona ezokwenziwa. IMnyango iphinde ithuthukise Imihlahlandlela yeMigomo Nezindlela Ezivunyelwe, okufanele zifundwe kanye nomgomo ophathelene neMali Yabakhi. Uhulumeni uyawazisa umsebenzi onzima nezifundo zababandakanyekayo emphakathini ekuletheni izinsizakalo zokuphila. Imisebenzi efana noHlelo Lokusebenza Olwandisiwe (EPWP) iyizibonelo zokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bethu nohulumeni. Ngenxa yalolu hlobo lokubambisana, simema bonke abantu bethu ukuba baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke. Siphinde sithokozise futhi sikwazise umsebenzi nezifundo zabazithandayo, abakhangisi abazimele, kanye nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi. Ndawonye, sakha umphakathi kanye nezwe elihloniphekile ezinganeni zethu nakubo bonke abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika. Inqubo yokuthuthukisa umgomo wokuxhaswa kwezimali yaqala ngo-1996 kodwa yaphazanyiswa ngo-2000. UNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi wasungula iKomidi lokwenza uphenyo ngezinkinga eziphathelene nomgomo, wabe esethula iziphakamiso kuMbuthano Wengqalasizinda Yezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi (MINMEC). I-MINMEC yanquma ukuthi umgomo wokuxhaswa kwezimali kumele ubuyekezwe. Lokhu kwenziwa yiqembu elisebenzayo, futhi umphumela walolu work, iMigomo Yokukhokha Yabakhi, wamukelwa futhi wavunywa ngo-2004 ngemva kokwethulwa kwiHhovisi Lezinsizakalo Zokuphila (HSWS), iKomidi Eliphezulu (EXCO), kanye ne-MINMEC. IMnyango iphinde ifune ukuhlabela umoya kulabo bantu nezikhungo ezafaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni le migomo, iminyango yasemaphandleni, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nomphakathi uqobo ngezibopho zabo nezifundo zabo. Ukubambisana phakathi kweMnyango nezinhlangano zomphakathi kuzohlala kuyisici esibalulekile emizamweni yokufeza impumelelo nokugcwalisa izibopho.
Ushintsho kumgomo 1.00, kusukela ekuqaleni, uma kuqondwa emkhakheni wokufundiswa kokundiza, kuchaza ukuqeqeshwa okuyisisekelo okudingekayo ukuze kufakwe isicelo seziqu zomshayeli wezindiza ezizimele kumuntu ofuna ukundiza indiza noma ngezizathu zokuzijabulisa ezikhishwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 61 noma 62 salezi ziqondiso noma ngenhloso yokwengeza isigaba esithile kule ndiza, kuyilapho ngenhloso yomgomo 91.02, 'uhlelo lokugcinwa olwamukelwe' luchaza incwadi yokugcina egcinwe ngumnikazi noma umphathi ngokuhambisana nezimo zalezi Ziqondiso futhi yamukelwe yiKomishini ngaphansi kwemigomo yomgomo 43.02. 'Umuntu ogunyaziwe' uchaza umuntu ophilayo ogunyaziwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 66 yiKomishini noma inhlangano egunyaziwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 149, kuye ngokuthi kungenzeka yini ukuphatha indiza ngaphandle kwecebo lokundiza ngendlela ehambisana nale ndiza futhi ichaza umnikazi wendiza yokusetshenziswa komuntu siqu noma eyakhelwe yile ndoda ngokuhambisana nemigomo yeSigaba 24; 'umgibeli wendiza' uchaza indiza engasebenzi, ethuswa umoya futhi enezigubhu ezihambayo ezixhunywe ezinyaweni zayo; incwadi yokulawula yokugcinwa ichaza incwadi egcinwe ngumnikazi noma umphathi wendiza ngokuhambisana nezimo zalezi Ziqondiso ezamukelwe yiKomishini ngaphansi komgomo 43.02. 'Ukuhlolwa okuphindaphindiwe' kuchaza ukuhlolwa okwenziwe ngokwemigomo yomgomo 43.02. 'Izindiza ezilula' zichaza indiza enomkhawulo ngesivinini nesisindo sokuphuma. 'Izindiza zokuzijabulisa' zichaza indiza enesisindo esingaphansi kwama-850 kilograms, ethuswa ngogesi futhi enama-indikator okundiza asebenza ngaphandle kogesi uma kuvalwe; b Phakamisa umgomo ophakanyisiwe noma isitatimende somsebenzi, ushintsho noma ukususa ngendlela evunyelwe yikomidi kulandela imizamo yayo echazwe esigabeni 3 njengoba iphakamisa ukuhlela ngokwaziswa kwiGazethi uma kuhlobene nezilawuli noma ngokwaziswa kwiwebhusayithi yeCAA uma kuhlobene nezitatimende zomsebenzi. Ushintsho kumgomo 11.03. Ngakho-ke umgomo olandelayo ushintshiwe ngemuva komgomo 11.03. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe inqubo yokubonisana, iKomishini izokwakha iphothali yokubhalisela ulwazi ngemithetho esunguliwe kwiwebhusayithi yeCAA lapho abantu bengabhalisela futhi bakhansela mahhala futhi lapho bezokwazi ukwaziswa nge-imeyili ngale mthetho, ushintsho noma ukusula kwemithetho ephakanyisiwe noma udaba oluhlobene, kanye neziphakamiso ezihambisana nomgomo 11.03.2 (b) ngenhla. Noma yisiphi isitatimende somsebenzi esikhishwe sizoshicilelwa kwiwebhusayithi yeCAA ukuze sitholakale futhi singacelwa kwiCAA lapho sizotholakala khona ngephepha eliqinile noma ngendlela egcinwe ngetekhnoloji yekhompyutha, etholakala ngentengo ethile. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.01. a lusebenza ezindizeni eziphakanyisiwe, ezithuswa ngogesi nezindiza zokuzijabulisa;". futhi b uhlelo lwenziwa luphinde luthathe indawo yegama j lesigaba 1 ngale j ukuphazamiseka okungakwazi ukulawulwa ngumuntu;". Ushintsho kumgomo 21.06. b Ngaphandle kokugunyazwa yiKomishini, uzokwakha futhi agcine uhlelo lokuhlola imikhiqizo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ngemuva kosuku lapho incwadi yokugunyazwa ikhishwe ngenhloso yokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zimpahla zihambisana nohlobo olubhalisiwe nezimo zokusebenza eziphephile, umbiko kumele uthunyelwe kwiKomishini; futhi c Ngemuva kokuphothulwa kohlelo lokuhlola imikhiqizo echazwe esigabeni b ethunyelwe kwiKomishini, incwadi echaza uhlelo olunjalo nenqubo lapho izinqumo ezihambisana nomgomo 21.06.22 zathathwa. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.08. b Ngemuva kokusetshenziswa ngaphansi kweSigaba 137, kuncike ekudlulisweni komunye umsebenzi ngaphansi kwemigomo yeSigaba 43, noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma indiza iguqulwa ibe uhlobo oluvumela ukuhamba kwabantu ngaphansi kwemigomo yeSigaba 121, Sigaba 127, Sigaba 135 noma Sigaba 138, ngaphandle uma iKomishini ingatholi isizathu sokuphepha, esimweni ethile. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.08. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.08. lusekela izinguquko ezibalulekile ezitayeleni; futhi v ukuhamba ngenhloso yokukhombisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza nokwethembeka ezidingekayo ngalezi Ziqondiso; noma b ucwaningo nokuthuthukiswa okuhlobene nokuhlolwa kwezinhlobo ezintsha zezimoto, amasistimu amasha ezindiza, izinsiza nezobuchwepheshe obusha, amasu amasha okusebenza noma izindlela ezintsha zokusebenza kwezindiza. Incwadi yokuhlola uhlobo ekhishwe njengomkhandlu oqinisekisa igunya lokundiza ngendlela echazwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 24 yeziQondiso. h olunye ulwazi olungacelwa yiKomishini ngenhloso yokwenza uqinisekise ukuphepha komphakathi. Isicelo sokukhishwa kwencwadi yokukhombisa igunya lokundiza yohlobo lwezindiza olukhishwe ohlotsheni oluthile noma lokushintsha kumele senziwe ngokuhambisana nezimo zeSigaba 24. Incwadi yokuhlola ekhishwe ngaphansi kweSigaba izoba semthethweni kuphela ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeNingizimu Afrika nasemanzini ezwe. Ukuphuma kwelinye izwe noma ngaphesheya kwemingcele yezinye izwe kuzodinga imvume ye-aviation authority kulelo zwe. Ushintsho kumgomo 21.08. d ukuphatha indiza noma izindiza eziningi ukuze usebenzise indiza ngenkathi ungahambisani nezidingo zomsebenzi ezichazwe kumgomo 21.02.3; noma e ukuphatha indiza enesisindo esidlula umkhawulo ovunyelwe wendiza ephuma ngaphandle komkhawulo ojwayelekile noma endaweni yokuhamba ngaphandle kwezidingo ezifanele noma indawo yokugcwalisa uphethiloli yendiza. Isisindo esiphakeme esingagunyazwa ngaphansi kwaleli gama sithathwa kuphela ngesisindo esengeziwe sefu, indawo yokugcwalisa uphethiloli kanye nemishini yokuphuthumayo nezihlolo ezifanele isimo sokundiza. Imvume yokundiza ekhethekile yohlobo olungabhalwanga ingakhishwa njengogunyaziwe lokundiza ngendlela echazwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 24 yeziQondiso. c ulwazi lokungahambisani nezimo zokulungela ukuhamba nokuhambisana nezidingo ezichaziwe zokundiza ezichazwe kumgomo 21.02. d noma noma iyiphi imfuneko yesimo ebhekwa njengendlela efanele yokuphepha yokusebenzisa indiza; futhi e olunye ulwazi olungacelwa yiKomishini ngenhloso yokuhlonza izimo zokusebenza kwendiza. IKomishini inegunya lokwenza noma icela kumfaki-sicelo ukuqinisekiswa kokuhlola noma izivivinyo zokuhlola isimo sokuphepha. Isicelo esichazwe esigabeni 3 kumele sibe nesikhwama esifanele esinqunywe nguSigaba 187. Isicelo sokukhishwa kwegunya lokundiza kwendiza noma ushintsho kumele kuhambisane nezimo zeSigaba 24. Imvume yokundiza ekhethekile ekhishwe ngaphansi kwalesi Sigaba izohlala isebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeNingizimu Afrika nasemanzini ezwe. Uma indiza yeqembu elithile elisezinye izwe noma emngceleni wezinye izwe ifuna ukufuna imvume kumagunya
Umbhalo wesiNgisi uyisiqondiso esisemthethweni seGas Policy Framework... Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa okuhlelekile kwenkampani ye-gas pipeline; ukusungula isakhiwo sikazwelonke; ukuqoka uMphathi weGas Policy ezingeni likazwelonke njengesikhumbuzo somthetho wezokwakha ezingeni likazwelonke; nokubheka ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Amandla angabekwa lapha ahlobene nalawo mandla akhonjiswe nguMphathi weGas Policy mayelana nokuguqulwa kube igesi, ukuvuselelwa kwegesi, ukuhamba, ukugcina, noma ukusabalalisa okungadingi ukuhambisana nezidingo ezisemqoka zalesi sivumelwano. Futhi ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kwegesi ngendlela elula nephumelelayo. Ukusabalalisa, ukucubungula igesi, nokuvuselela igesi; kanye nokuhweba ngegesi. UMphathi weGas Policy unabasebenzi abahlanu abaqokwe nguNgqongqoshe. Umongameli ukhethwa phakathi kwabaphathi be-gas ngokuhambisana nesigaba. Uma ngasiphi isizathu umongameli engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe, abanye amalungu kumele akhethe omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo ukuze asebenze esikhundleni somongameli kuze kube umongameli ekwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe noma kuze kube nguNgqongqoshe eqoka omunye umongameli. Ilungu leGas Policy Director lisebenza isikhathi esiyiminyaka emine. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda aqoke ilungu. Amalungu eGas Policy Director kumele akhokhelwe ngezinsizakalo zawo futhi athole izikhwama njengabaphathi be-gas ngokuvuma kukaNgqongqoshe ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Ngaphambi kokuba aqoke amalungu kuGas Policy Director, uNgqongqoshe kumele, ngokuqwashisa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, acela amagama kubalungu bomphakathi. Ukusabalalisa, ukugcina, ukuhamba, ukucubungula igesi, noma ukuhweba ngegesi, noma ukuba nentshisekelo ethile kunoma iyiphi inkampani; futhi kumele azise uNgqongqoshe kanye noMphathi weGas Policy uma le ntshisekelo ishintsha. Ilungu akumele libe khona nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho izindaba zixoxwa, noma izinqumo zenziwa, noma libe neqhaza kunoma yisiphi isimo seGas Policy Directorate lapho leli lungu noma umlingani walo, ingane, umlingani wezohwebo, noma umqashi, ngaphandle kweState, enentshisekelo. Noma kungase kudingeke ukuthi kuxoshwe ilungu ngenxa yezizathu ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni 6 seGas Policy uma benza okuphikisana nesigaba 9. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele abe nemihlangano ngezikhathi ezibekwe ngumongameli. UMphathi weGas Policy njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umsebenzi ofanele wenziwa. Ukuze uthole lesi sicelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi kube nenqubo ebekiwe, umongameli wanoma imihlangano yeGas Policy Director kumele abeke inqubo ezolandelwa kulolo suku. I-Gas Policy Director ihlanganisa amalungu amaningi. Isinqumo senqwaba yamalungu akhona emhlanganweni yisinqumo seGas Policy Director. Kuyinqwaba elula phezulu kwalokho okujwayelekile. Isinqumo uma abanye amalungu bekhona emhlanganweni futhi benelungelo lokuhlanganyela nokuvota, futhi isinqumo kumele sithathwe futhi ngaphezu kwenqwaba yamalungu akhona anelungelo lokuvota. Umongameli kumele abe khona kuwo wonke emihlanganweni yeGas Policy Director futhi unelungelo lokuphendula, kodwa hhayi lokuvota, kulawo mhlanganweni. I-Gas Policy ivulelekile emphakathini ngaphandle kokuthi kube nolwazi oluyimfihlo, olunamalungelo okuphatha mayelana nezohwebo, lowo muntu ophakathi kumele akhombise uMphathi weGas Policy ukuthi kungani lelo lwazi lungafanele lwenziwe emphakathini. UMphathi weGas Policy wokuqala ngemuva kokuba eqokwe. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele aqinisekise ukuthi irekhodi lezo zonke izinqubo ezikhona ligcinwa. Ngokuqondile noma ngokuqondile; futhi abaphathi bezikhungo zomphakathi kumele baziphathe ngendlela efanele futhi njengoba kulindelekile. Kumele kubhalwe phansi; futhi kuchazwe kahle nangokunembile, nomthetho nezizathu zawo. Noma yisiphi isinqumo seGas Policy Director nezizathu zaso kumele zifinyeleleke emphakathini. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele aqoke umphathi omkhulu weGas Policy Director. Ukuze aphathe izindaba zeGas Policy Director; futhi aphathe ukuphathwa kwabo bonke abasebenzi abaqashwe ngasikhathi. Obani, ukuze basize ekusebenzeni kweGas Policy Director. Nakuba kunezihloko 1 no-3, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha ukuthi uMphathi weGas Policy angaqasha noma asebenzise abasebenzi ngokuvumelana nezinye iziphathimandla zokwazisa ngaphansi kwamandla kaNgqongqoshe. Isigaba 9 sithinta noma iliphi ilungu lezakhamuzi zeGas Policy Director, ushintsho lusekelwe esimweni esikhona. Imibhalo yezezimali yeGas Policy Director kumele ihlolwe nguMphakathi wezeMali. Mayelana nezempilo nokuphepha embonini; kanye nezinye izindaba ezithathwa nguMphathi weGas Policy njengokubalulekile. Obani abangase basebenze ekuhambahambeni, ukugcina, ukusabalalisa igesi, ukuyicubungula, kanye nokuvuselela igesi; noma ukuhweba ngegesi. Noma yimuphi umsebenzi okukhulunywe ngawo kuSheduli 1 awudingi isicelo sokungena kulowo msebenzi, kodwa umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okukhulunywe ngakho ezihlokweni 1 no-2 zalesi Sheduli kumele abhalise umsebenzi wabo njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 28. Bangazisa umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okudinga ilayisensi ngaphansi kwesigaba ukuthi kumele stop ukwenziwa kwalowo msebenzi. Akukho lutho kule Mthetho olivimba umuntu ukuthi axoxisane ngenhloso yokwakha, ukuguqula izakhiwo, umsebenzi wegesi, ukuwusebenzisa, noma ukuhweba okuhlosiwe ukuze axoxisane noMphathi weGas Policy ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo se-licence. UMphathi weGas Policy kumele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 29, anikeze umuntu obhekwa ngesigaba (a) ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze afake isicelo. Noma ubani ofanele ukufaka isicelo se-licence ngaphansi kwesigaba 10 kuya ku-15 kumele ayifake ngendlela ebekiwe nangendlela. Ngalolu lwazi oludingekayo mayelana negesi ezobe ihweba ngaphansi kwelayisensi; kanye nolunye ulwazi olungase ludingeke. Umfaki-sicelo angacela ukuthi ulwazi luphathwe ngasese mayelana nokuthinteka kwezomnotho esicelweni futhi, ngokuvumelana nezivumelwano noMphathi weGas Policy, lelo lwazi lingakhululwa ezikopini zesicelo ezithunyelwa emphakathini. Umuntu kumele uphume isikhumbuzo sokufaka isicelo kwabo okungenani ezincwadini ezimbili endaweni abafuna ukusebenza kuyo, ezilimini ezimbili ezisemthethweni (eyodwa yazo kumele ibe isiNgisi). Ikheli leGas Policy Director lapho izikhalazo zokufaka isicelo zingathunyelwa; futhi ukuthi izikhalazo zokufaka isicelo kumele zibe neziqu eziphakanyisiwe noma isitatimende esiphakanyisiwe. Uma kungatholakali zikhala zokufaka isicelo; noma ngemuva kokuthola impendulo kumfaki-sicelo mayelana nezikhalazo ezikhulunywe esigabeni 18c. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuthuthukiswa kwesifunda; noma nganoma iyiphi inhloso yomphakathi. Ukuze kusebenze ekuthuthumeni kwegesi, ukugcina, nokusabalalisa; futhi ukuhweba ngegesi. Noma nini lapho inkampani ephethwe yisimo esil
Lo mthetho ufaka phakathi umthetho wesakhiwo. Uthuthukisa ulwazi nokuqonda kwezindaba zase-Afrika ngokusebenzisa ososayensi bezokuxhumana abaziwayo ngokuvumelana nabo bonke abalandela lezi zindaba nangokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuqondisa ngezindaba zase-Afrika; kanye nokuhlanganisa, ukuqhuba, nokusabalalisa ulwazi mayelana nezindaba zase-Afrika, ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko elifanele nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele mayelana nezidingo zabantu bonke, amathuba, nezinselelo ezibhekene nazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ibhodi isungulwa ukuze ibheke, iphathe, futhi iqondise izindaba zeMnyango. Amalungu akufanele adlule kwababili futhi azokhethwa yiBhodi ngokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe; kanti noMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi, ozoba yilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla sabo, akasoze abe namandla okvotelela. Ekusungulweni kweBhodi, kumele kube nokwakhiwa okufanele kobulili, ulimi, nokuhlukahluka kwemiphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. Ilungu leBhodi elikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi kumele likhethwe ngokuhambisana nezimiso zokucacisa nokwakhiwa. Okungenani elinye lamalungu akhethwe yiBhodi kumele libe nolwazi lokuphatha kwezimali. Bazokwenza noma babe yilungu iminyaka emithathu, ngaphandle uma isikhathi esifushane sithathwa; futhi ilungu eliphelelwe isikhathi singenziwa kabusha. Uma ilungu leBhodi lifa noma lishiya isikhundla sakhona ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esikhethwe, elinye ilungu linganikezwa ukuba lithathe leso sikhundla esisele. Ilungu leBhodi elingakhethwanga ngokuphelele nguMbuso lingakhokhelwa yiBhodi ngemisebenzi abayenzayo njengamalungu, naleyo nkokhelo izonqunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Akukho ilungu leBhodi elingagcini isikhundla kwi-political party noma inhlangano yezepolitiki. Umuntu ongakhokhiwe, ophumelele icala eNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kwezono ezenziwe ngaphambi kosuku luka-27 kuMbasa 1994, ezihlobene nezinhloso zezombusazwe futhi ohlawulwe ukujola ngaphandle kokukhetha imali, noma uma bekungumsebenzi wobuqhophololo, uma behlawulwe ukuba bakhokhe imali noma bahlawulwe noma bobabili; noma ngaphandle kokuba yisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika noma abe ne-permit yokuhlala okungapheli eNingizimu Afrika. Umuntu ophuthelwe imihlangano emibili noma ngaphezulu yeBhodi ngokuqhubekayo ngaphandle kokuthola imvume kwiBhodi. Kumele athumele incwadi yokuhoxa kuNgqongqoshe. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zeMnyango, iBhodi ingaba... noma ithole noma yiziphi izimfanelo namandla abona kufanele noma adingekayo. Bangaqasha, banqume amaholo, noma baphumeze abasebenzi beMnyango; futhi benze noma yini eholela ekufezeni izinhloso, futhi kumele bahlola njalo isakhiwo, inhlangano, nezinhlelo zeMnyango. Bangakwazi ukwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi onikezwe nguNgqongqoshe; futhi baqhube uphenyo noma ucwaningo mayelana nezinhloso zeBhodi uma kunikezwe nguNgqongqoshe. Ibhodi ayikwazi ukusungula, ukuthola, noma ukusebenzisa inhlangano noma umnyango ophathelene nezindaba zase-Afrika, kodwa ingaqala noma iphakamise izinhlelo ezibona kufanele ukuze kuqedwe izinhloso zeMnyango: Kuze kube yilapho lezi zinhlelo zenziwa ngokubambisana nezinhlelo ezikhona noma iminyango ekwazi ukwenza lezi zinhlelo. Ukuze kuqedwe izinhloso zeMnyango, iBhodi inganikeza usizo kunoma yisiphi isakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika esihlala kwezinye izindawo ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi. Ibhodi kumele ihlangane noma ibambe imihlangano okungenani kathathu ngonyaka, futhi imihlangano izobanjwa ngesikhathi nendawo ezinqunywe nguMongameli ngokwazisa abanye amalungu. UMongameli angabiza umhlangano okhethekile weBhodi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, okumele bube ngesikhathi nendawo ezinqunywe nguMongameli. Inani lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni angakwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano nokwenza izinqumo kumele kube iningi lamalungu eBhodi. Noma yiziphi izinqumo zeBhodi zizokwenziwa ngokusekelwa kwenani elikhulu lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni weBhodi, futhi uma kukhona ukuhamba phambili kwendaba ethile, umuntu ophatha umhlangano uzoba ne-vote yokugcina ngaphezu kokuvota kwabo njengelungu leBhodi. Ilungu leBhodi lingavota noma lithathe ingxenye ekuphathweni komhlangano weBhodi noma libe khona endaweni lapho umhlangano ubanjwa khona uma linomsebenzi ophathelene nendaba engaphambi noma ekhuluma ngayo iBhodi evimbela ukuba lenze imisebenzi yabo njengelungu leBhodi ngokwethembeka, futhi ngaphandle kokubandlulula nangendlela efanele. UPhakathi; kanye namanye amalungu eBhodi, angadluli kwabahlanu, njengoba kuhlelwe yiBhodi. Ikomidi eliphakanyisiwe ngaphansi kwesigaba sokuqala kumele lenze imisebenzi enikezwe yona yiBhodi. UMongameli weBhodi kumele abe nguMongameli wekomidi eliphakanyisiwe. Ikomidi eliphakanyisiwe kumele lihlangane ngezikhathi nendawo ezinqunywe nguMongameli walelo komidi, futhi inani labantu abakhona abakwazi ukwenza izinqumo kumele kube iningi lamalungu ekomidi eliphakanyisiwe. Ibhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwamakomidi, lapho inganikeza khona amandla noma imisebenzi ethile enikezwe noma enikwe iBhodi ngalo Mthetho. Ikomidi elikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi kumele libe nezinye amalungu eBhodi nabasebenzi beBhodi, uma bekhona, abona iBhodi ibona kufanele, futhi iBhodi ingase iyeke noma ibuyisele noma yikuphi ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanelekile. Uma ikomidi linezithombe zeBhodi eziningi kunelungu elilodwa, iBhodi kumele ikhethe elinye lalawo malungu ukuba kube nguMongameli wale komidi. Ibhodi ngeke ibhekane nokwenza noma yimuphi umsebenzi onikezwe noma yikuphi ikomidi leBhodi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba. Le mfuneko yokunikezwa kwamandla noma imisebenzi kumele ixhunyaniswe ngokubhalwe phansi kumamukeli. Ibhodi ingasungula ithimba labeluleki kunoma yisiphi isimo soxhumano uma ibona kufanele. Noma iyiphi ithimba labeluleki kumele libe nezingane ezingenakuphuma kwabahlanu abaphumelelayo abaneziqu noma ulwazi olukhethekile noma okuhlangenwe nakho emkhakheni wezindaba zase-Afrika okukhuluma ngawo, futhi abangamalungu eBhodi. Noma iyiphi ithimba labeluleki kumele ibeluleke iBhodi nganoma iyiphi indaba ephathelene nezindaba zase-Afrika ezakhayo. Ilungu lethimba labeluleki kumele likhethwe ngaphansi kwezimo, kuhlanganise nezimo zokukhokhela, ukuthola imihlangano, nokuhlinzekwa kosizo, okuzonqunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Ibhodi ingasusa noma iphelelise ubulungu bayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma kukhona izizathu ezanele zokwenza kanjalo. Amalungu ethimba labeluleki ngeke athole ukwesekwa kwezimali kwiBhodi ngenkathi ebamba lezi zikhundla. Ibhodi kumele, ngemuva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe, ikhethe uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi.
