Ukwakhiwa kweSikhungo seZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kanye neBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi; kulungiselelwe ukuphathwa kwezikhumulo ezithile nguMnyango wezikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke; kanye nezinye izinto ezihlobene. Isikebhe sisho noma iyiphi isakhiwo esiwela emanzini, kuhlanganise nezindiza. Ukuze kube lula ukudluliswa kwamakhono nokwazi, ulwazi, nokuphathwa ngokubambisana nomkhakha ozimele ongaphansi kokulawulwa kuk governo. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa nguNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi, kuzokwakhiwa inkampani yeSikhungo seZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke ezoba nefa, imele, futhi iphathise izikhumulo egameni leHhovisi. Le Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke izophathwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA). UNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokwakha nokubhalisa iBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke njengenkampani yomphakathi engathengisa amasheya noma izitokwe futhi ikhiphe isitifiketi sokubhaliswa futhi ilandele lokho okukhuluma nguMthetho Wamakampani. UHhovisi uzoba yilona kuphela ilungu nomnikazi kule Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke. Amalungelo eHhovisi ukuba ube ilungu onezabelo kule Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke azophathwa nguNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi. Uma kutholakala ukuthi lezi zimpapasho zokubhaliswa azihambisani nalokho okukhuluma ngomthetho, lowo mthetho uzothathwa njengowokuqala noma uzosetshenziswa; futhi lokho okukhuluma ngalezi zimpapasho zokubhaliswa kuzoba namandla kuphela uma lo mthetho ushintshwa ukuze ususe lokho okuphikisanayo. UNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi, ngokusekelwe eziphakamisweni ezenziwe yiBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke, angacela uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuba akhombise ukuthi ezinye izinhlinzeko noma izingxenye zeMthetho Wamakampani azisebenziseki kule Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke. UMsizi Wamakampani kufanele akhombise leyo mininingwane mayelana nokusebenza kwayo nokwesekwa kwayo ngokuhambisana nalesi sahluko, ngokukhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoMphakathi. Kuleso saziso, uMsizi Wamakampani kufanele abize abantu ukuba bathumele iziphikiso zabo neziphakamiso kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kuleso saziso ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esichaziwe kuleso saziso. Ngemuva kokucabanga ngalezi ziphikiso neziphakamiso uma kukhona ezitholakala ngokuhambisana nesahluko 2, uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni, ngokukhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoMphakathi, angakhombisa le ngxenye yezenhloso ezithile noma zonke izinhlinzeko noma lezi zingxenye ezithintekayo nguMthetho Wamakampani, azisebenziseki kule Bhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kusukela ngosuku oluchaziwe kuleso saziso. Lokhu ngeke kunciphise noma kwehlise amandla eBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke ukuveza njengobuholi bomphakathi noma kwehlise ukuvuleka kokusebenza nokusetshenziswa; futhi ngeke kuphule amalungelo, inzuzo, noma izicelo zalabo abathola imali yiBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke noma abasebenzi noma ilungelo lokuzuza komunye umuntu. Unyaka wezimali weBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke uzohamba kusukela kuMfumfu 1 kuya kuNdasa 31 wonyaka olandelayo, kokubili ezinsukwini zifakiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma nganoma yimuphi umthetho, iBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke ngeke ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu ophakanyiswe yinkantolo noma ngaphansi kohlelo lokuphuma kwezimali olwehluleka ukukhokha izikweletu, ngaphandle uma kuvunyelwe ngemicimbi ethile ethile eyenzelwe le njongo. Zonke izikhumulo ngaphansi kweBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke yeTransnet ngaphambi kokuqala kwalomthetho zizobuyiselwa kuBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kusukela ngosuku oluchaziwe ngokuhambisana nesahluko 27. Ngokukhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoMphakathi, uNgqongqoshe uzokhombisa ukuthi yiziphi ezinye izikhumulo ezizongena ngaphansi kweBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke ngaphandle kwalabo okukhulunywa ngabo esahluko 1. UNgqongqoshe angaphinde abuyekeze, ashintshe noma enze ngaphezulu kwemikhawulo yezikhumulo futhi kufanele axhumane nezindawo ezihambelana nalokhu uma leyo mikhawulo, ukushintsha noma ukwandisa kuzothinta imikhawulo yezindawo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle, ukwethembeka, kanye nezindleko zabelungu abaneziqinisekiso, ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zomhlaba ezamukelekayo nezidingo zomphakathi. IBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kufanele yenze konke okudingekayo ukuze iphathise izikhumulo kahle nangempumelelo, ihlele futhi ithuthukise izikhumulo. Ukuze ilungiselele ukwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi ukuze kuncishiswe ukuphindaphinda kwalezi zisebenzi nezinqubo mayelana nokwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi. UNgqongqoshe kufanele azise umphakathi ngalesi sithangami sokubonisana esikhuluma ngaso esahluko 2, ngokukhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoMphakathi. Ibhodi izoba nelungu elingaphansi kwezingu-7 futhi lingaphezu kwezingu-13, ezizokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi. UNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi kufanele aqoke ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe nguMongameli weBhodi. IBhodi kufanele ikhethe uMongameli Osenhliziyweni phakathi kwamalungu ayo. Amalungu eBhodi akufanele amezele izithakazelo zeqembu elithile, kodwa kufanele aphakamise ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhumulo ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke abasebenzisi bezikhumulo. UNgqongqoshe kufanele akhiphe isaziso ngokwenza isimemezelo kwiGazethi yoMphakathi nangemidiya ngenzondo yakhe yokukhetha lowo muntu futhi abize umphakathi ukuba uthumele imibono yabo noma aphikise ukukhethwa kwalowo muntu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi esichaziwe kuleso saziso; futhi abheke eziphakamisweni noma iziphikiso ezitholwe ngenxa yaleso saziso. UNgqongqoshe onomsebenzi angakhetha amalungu okuqala eBhodi ngaphambi kokuba iBhodi ibhaliswe. Lezi zikhundla zizothatha umphumela ngosuku lokubhaliswa. IBhodi izomele iBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke kuzo zonke izenzo ezizokwenziwa yiBhodi ngaphansi kwalomthetho futhi ezizovunyelwa zizobhekwa njengokwenziwa yiBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke. Ukuze kuvumeleke ukuqashwa kwezinye izisebenzi ezisemthethweni zeBhodi yeZikhumulo zeMisebenzi Kazwelonke; futhi kulandele umgomo weHhovisi mayelana nezohwebo zezikhumulo kazwelonke. Nothile okukhuluma ngalesi sahluko 1 ngeke kuvinjeze iBhodi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yayo efanele kahle ukuphatha, ukuhlela, ukwenza nokulawula izikhumulo futhi lokho akuphikisi umthetho. IBhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi ngaphansi kwanoma yiziphi izimo, umhlaba ophethwe yiBhodi awudayiswa. Umuntu
Ukwakhiwa kweMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi; ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali kubantu abathile abangasebenzi kule Mali, nokukhokhela labo abasebenzi abagulayo, abakhulelwe, noma abanabantu abaxhomekeke kubo, nezingane noma labo ababeqashwe ngaphambili uma bengasebenzi; ukulungiselela ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi, imisebenzi yale Bhodi kanye nokunikezwa komphakathi weMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi; nokulungiselela ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umbiko wombhishobhi, ukudluliswa kwamandla okuzonikezwa, amandla, nemisebenzi. Umphakathi angabheka ukuthi umuntu ubengumfakisicelo kule Mali. Izingane zisho umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye esigabeni 30 ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 futhi zifaka umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-25 ongumfundi futhi oxhomekeke kuzo zonke izidingo zezezimali zomuntu obeqashwe. Umuntu oqashwe umndeni njengomshayeli; nomuntu ophatha noma ubani kule ndlu; kodwa akuhlanganisi umsebenzi wezolimo. Inhloso yalomthetho ukusungula iMali Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi lapho iminikelo izokwenziwa ngababusi nabasebenzi ukuze uma abasebenzi abathile behluleka emsebenzini noma labo abaxhomekeke kubo, bakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezomnotho nezokuhlalisana kwabantu. Abantu abangena eRiphabhulikhi ngenhloso yokwenza isivumelwano esithile, nalabo abasafunda ukuze basebenze, befunda lapha eRiphabhulikhi uma ekupheleni kwaleso sivumelwano umqashi enesibopho ngokomthetho noma ngokwenkontileka sokubuyisela lowo muntu ezweni lakubo, noma lowo muntu kufanele ahambe eRiphabhulikhi, kanye nabamqashi babo. Ngaphandle kwesigaba 1, lo mthetho ubhekelela abasebenzi bendlu, abasebenzi besizini, kanye nababusi babo iminyaka engu-12 kusukela ekuqaleni kwalomthetho. UNgqongqoshe kufanele, ngokushesha ngemva kokuqala kwalomthetho, aqashe noma abeke umphakathi ukuze ahlole futhi enze izincomo mayelana nokusebenza kwalomthetho kubasebenzi bendlu nalabo abasebenza ngesizini. UNgqongqoshe kufanele axhumane neBhodi mayelana nemiphumela yokuhlola. Noma yiziphi izimali ezisele kule Mali ezivela ekwabelweni kwempahla noma noma yiziphi izipho ezenziwe kule Mali noma ezinye izimali ezingatholakala kule Mali. Ukukhokha - kwemiholo nezinzuzo zamalungu eBhodi Yokuhlinzekwa Ngemali Yokungasebenzi kanye nekomidi layo; nezinye izindleko ezingase zenzeke ngokuhambisana nokusebenza kwalomthetho. Noma yimuphi umuntu, isikhungo, inkampani, noma ibhange lezezimali lingafaka imali kule Mali noma linikeze kule Mali njengempahla. UMsizi-Jikelele angamukela izimali noma impahla eyabelwe kule Mali esikhundleni seMali. Ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezimbili ngemva kokuphela konyaka wezezimali, umphakathi kufanele abuyekeze isimo sezezimali sonke seMali salo nyaka wezezimali bese ethumela umbiko wesimo sezezimali kuMsizi-Jikelele. Noma yiziphi izinguquko ekusebenzeni kwemigomo nezindlela zokukala umbiko wezezimali wonyaka owedlule; kanye nezici ezithile noma izithiyo umphakathi angase abe nazo ngokusebenzisa umphakathi noma ezisetshenziswa umphakathi ekwenzeni umsebenzi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba sombiko ukuze kuvele izinkinga ezibalulekile ukuze kutholakale umfanekiso oqotho wesimo sezezimali seMali. Izincomo mayelana nokugcina noma ukuthuthukisa impilo yezezimali yeMali. Uma inani elidingekayo ukukhokhela izinzuzo likhulu noma lincane kunalokho okudingekayo ukukhokhela izinzuzo ezilindelekile. Noma yiziphi izimali ezibuyiselwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 588; kanye nanoma yiziphi izindaba ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezimali ezidingekayo; futhi kulandela inqubo echazwe esigabeni 55 yokwenza noma yiziphi izinguquko uma kudingeka. Uma umholo wehla kakhulu ngezikhathi ezithile, ukubalwa kufanele kusekelwe enanini ejwayelekile yalolo msebenzi olufake imali kule Mali. Usuku lapho umsebenzi ofake imali kule Mali waqala khona kuze kube usuku lapho lowo msebenzi uphelelwe; nanoma yisiphi isikhathi - umsebenzi wakhokhelwa umholo esikhundleni sokwaziswa. Izinsuku lapho umuntu ofake imali kule Mali kufanele athole izinzuzo njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 3 ngeke zinciphise ukukhokhelwa kwezinzuzo zokukhulelwa ngokuhambisana nengxenye D yale sahluko. Isinyathelo 3 - susa kule mali izinsuku lapho izinzuzo zitholiwe (ukuhlukanisa izinzuzo zokukhulelwa) eminyakeni emine elandela usuku lokufaka isicelo sezinzuzo ngokuhambisana naleli sahluko. Isinyathelo 4 - Inani elisele liyilona elihlinzeka ngezinsuku zokuthola izinzuzo umuntu ofake imali kule Mali okufanele athole. Ukwehluleka ukuhambisana nezimo zalomthetho noma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophathelene nokungasebenzi; noma ukungafaneleki ukuthola izinzuzo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 361. Ngaphandle kwesigaba 1, isikhathi sokungasebenzi kufanele sibilwe kusukela ngosuku lokuphela komsebenzi, noma usuku lokugcina lomsebenzi. Usuku okukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 1 lunganda lube usuku olwandulela usuku lokufaka isicelo uma umphakathi ophatha izicelo eqinisekile ukuthi isizathu sokulibaziseka kokufaka sikhona ngaphandle kokulawula komuntu ofake imali kule Mali. Umuntu ofake imali kule Mali kufanele abhalise njengomfuna umsebenzi nezinsizakalo zokusebenza ezisunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998 Umthetho No. 97 ka-1998; futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 3, umuntu ofake imali kule Mali kufanele ulungele futhi akwazi ukusebenza. Umuntu ofake imali kule Mali wehluleka ukuveza phakathi nezinsuku nezikhathi ezibekwe umphakathi ophatha izicelo ngokuhambisana nesigaba 174d; noma umuntu ofake imali kule Mali uyakwenqaba noma uyakwenqaba ukuqeqeshwa noma ukwelashwa ngezizathu ezithathwa njengokungafaneleki ngaphansi kwanoma yisiphi uhlelo olwamukelwe nguMsizi-Jikelele ngokuhambisana nalomthetho noma yimuphi omunye umthetho. Ngaphezu kwesigaba 1d futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 201a, umuntu ofake imali kule Mali ophazamisekile yisifo esithole izinzuzo zokungasebenzi uzophinde athole izinzuzo zokungasebenzi inqobo nje uma umphakathi ophatha izicelo eqinisekile ukuthi leso sifo ngeke sithinte amathuba alowo muntu ofake imali kule Mali ukuthola umsebenzi. Isicelo sezinzuzo zokungasebenzi kufanele senziwe ngokugcwalisa ifomu elakhiwe ngalokhu. Isicelo kufanele senziwe phakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ngosuku lokuphela komsebenzi, kodwa umphakathi angamukela izicelo ezithunyelwe ngemuva kwalolu suku inqobo nje uma kukhona izizathu ezisemthethweni. Umphakathi ophatha izicelo kufanele ahlole isicelo uma kudingeka futhi angacela olunye ulwazi mayelana nokuqhubeka kokungasebenzi komfaki-sicelo. UMsizi-Jikelele kufanele akhokhele umuntu ofake imali kule Mali izinzuzo zokungasebenzi ehhovisi lokusebenza lapho isicelo sithunyelwe noma ehhovisi elinye elinikezwe umfaki-sicelo ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Uma umfaki-sicelo ethola izinzuzo zokungasebenzi futhi enqaba noma enqaba ukuthatha umsebenzi ofanele ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele noma enqaba ukuhamba noma uk
Lo mthetho uhlanganisa umthethosisekelo. I-Centre isunguliwe njengomuntu ophakathi kwezomthetho ezobizwa ngeSouth African Science Centre. Iphakamisa ngokuphelele ubuhlakani babantu bonke; futhi inikeza izeluleko ezinhle futhi ikhulisa izenzo eziphathelene nezidingo zokubambisana, amathuba, nezinselelo ezibhekene nabo bonke abakha iNingizimu Afrika. Le Centre iyona kuphela i-centre yesayensi eqashelwa nguhulumeni. Umphathiswa angayala le Centre ukuba iqhube imisebenzi ethile ehambisana nezinhloso zayo. Kukho uhlobo olulodwa lokubhaliswa kule Centre, kodwa amalungu angaba amalungu ehloniphekile (labo abahambile emsebenzini kodwa basahlonishwa) kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka wabo wokusebenza okuthatha iminyaka engama-70. Ilungu leCentre kulindeleke ukuthi lisize leCentre ukufinyelela izinhloso zayo. Inqubo ezolandela uma kukhethwa amalungu eCentre izoba yimpumelelo enkulu ekuthuthukiseni noma ekusebenziseni isayensi. Abantu abaphakanyisiwe ukuba babe amalungu amasha eCentre bazophakanyiswa futhi banikezwe isitifiketi esinqunywe ngamalungu okungenani amane, okungenani amabili kufanele abe nolwazi lomuntu siqu ngomsebenzi wesayensi kanye nendima ebonakalayo edlalwe yilowo muntu esayensini. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele sihlanganise isitatimende esichazayo esichaza ukuthi kanjani ukuhunyushwa kwalowo muntu njengelungu leCentre kuzothuthukisa izinhloso zeCentre. Isitifiketi kufanele sibe nesitatimende esiqinile kulowo muntu esikhombisa ukuzibophezela kwabo ukuba baqashwe njengelungu leCentre, futhi kufanele sibe nesibopho esichaza umlando wabo wezokufunda nezobuchwepheshe (curriculum vitae). IBhodi leCentre kufanele ibuyekeze unyaka nonyaka zonke izicelo ezintsha ezithunyelwe ngonyaka odlule, kulandela inqubo ethile yokuhlola. Zonke izilungu ezikhona zeCentre zizodingeka ukuba zivote, ngemuva kokuvota okuthuli, zikhombise ukuthi ziyamukela noma azamukeli umuntu othile ophakanyiswe yiBhodi noma zikhombise uma zisesimweni sokungavoti noma zikhona phakathi. Amalungu eCentre angavota noma angavoti kuzothathwa njengokungavoti. Umuntu othola okungenani amavoti amathathu uzobhekwa njengokhethwe njengelungu leCentre, uma okungenani ingxenye yamavoti emamukele. a "Mina, ngigcwele igama, ngiyafunga ukuthi ngizothuthukisa isimo eNingizimu Afrika ngemicabango yesayensi futhi ngikhuthaze izinhloso zeSouth African Science Centre ngokusemandleni ami; futhi b Ngizohlonipha umthethosisekelo osekelwe kanye nemiyalo esunguliwe yeCentre njengoba ngihlala ngilungu leCentre." Noma yiliphi ilungu leCentre kumele, ngaphandle kokubheka izinhlinzeko ze-subsection 9, libe nesibopho sokubamba iqhaza ekhethweni lamalungu amasha eCentre kanye namalungu eBhodi. ICentre izophathwa futhi ibusiswe yiBhodi ngokuhambisana nalomthetho. Ibhodi kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izinhloso zeCentre zifinyelelwa ngokucophelela futhi kufanele ibheke ukuqhuba yonke imisebenzi yeCentre. e kanye namalungu ayisikhombisa; futhi f ilungu elilodwa leBhodi yeZokweluleka Kazwelonke Ngobuchwepheshe ezokhethwa ngumphathiswa. Amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwalabo abakhulunywe ngabo ku-subsection 3 f, azokhethwa ngamalungu eCentre phakathi kwabo bese ekhethwa ngumphathiswa. Ibhodi izosebenzisa amandla anikezwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalomthetho futhi iqhube imisebenzi eyabelwe yona ngumlomo. a Ibhodi izobamba imihlangano yayo ngezikhathi nezindawo ezizokwenziwa umongameli. b Amalungu akhona emhlanganweni azokwazi ukuqhubeka nomhlangano nokwenza izinqumo uma iningi lamalungu akhona emhlanganweni. b umuntu ophukile ezinkingeni zezimali futhi engakabuyiselwa ngokomthetho. g ophume emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha okungalungile ngemuva kokulalelwa mayelana nesenzo esingangcolisa iCentre, kodwa leli lungu lingase lishiya emsebenzini kuze kube emhlanganweni wonyaka olandelayo lapho le miphumela kufanele ibhalwe emaminithini ezinqumo. h ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zaleli gumbi, umuntu ophakamisile isaziso esibhaliwe noma incwadi yokuhamba kufanele ayithumele kumongameli futhi iBhodi izokwamukela le miphumela uma zonke izikweletu zikhokhiwe. Noma yiliphi ilungu leBhodi elifuna ukuhamba emsebenzini kumele lithumele isaziso esibhaliwe sokuhamba esibhekiswe kumongameli, futhi iBhodi kumele yamukele lesi saziso uma zonke izikweletu ezidingekayo zikhokhiwe. Uma isikhala selungu leBhodi siba singenalutho ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi salo lungu, umphathiswa, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ze-subsection 1, kufanele aqashe umuntu ophakanyiswe yiBhodi ukuze agcwalise lesi sikhala ezinsukwini eziyi-60 zokungabi nalutho. Ibhodi ingasungula eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwamakomidi, ingasebenzisa amandla noma iqhube noma imisebenzi yeCentre eyabelwe yona yiBhodi. Ikhodi ethile eyaziwa ku-subsection 1 izoba nezinye izilungu zeCentre kanye nabasebenzi beCentre abathathwa njengabafanele yiBhodi, uma kukhona, iBhodi ingase iphume noma ibuyisele umqondo noma ikomidi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi uma ibona kufanele. Uma ikomidi linamalungu angaphezu kwelilodwa, iBhodi kufanele iqashe ilungu elilodwa ukuba libe ngumholi walelo komidi. Ibhodi ayinakubhekelela ukwenza noma iyiphi imisebenzi eyabelwe noma ikomidi leBhodi ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba. Ngaphezu kwemisebenzi eminye eyabelwe kumongameli ngaphansi kwalomthetho, uzoba ngumhloli ophathiswe ukuqapha izimali ezitholakele kanye nokusetshenziswa kwazo futhi uzoba nesibopho sokubheka impahla yeCentre. i ingase ikhiphe kumunye ilungu leBhodi amandla anikezwe kumhloli ngaphansi kwalomthetho noma kulomthetho; noma ii ivumele lowo muntu ukuba aqhube imisebenzi eyabelwe kumhloli ngaphansi kwalomthetho. b Ukudluliswa kwamandla ngaphansi kwe-subsection a akuvimbeli ukusebenzisa la mandla noma ukuqhuba le misebenzi kumhloli. ICentre ingaqasha abasebenzi ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile uma ibona kufanele ukuze iCentre iqhube imisebenzi yayo, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ze-subsection (b). b ICentre kufanele ikhokhe amaholo, izinzuzo, neminye imisebenzi engase ibekwe yiBhodi ezimali zayo. c ICentre ingase, uma ibona kufanele ngemuva kokuvumelana ngemisebenzi, idlulise noma isekele le misebenzi ukuze iqhube imisebenzi ethile noma isikhathi esithile kwiMnyango, inhlangano, noma isikhungo eNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwezimo zokuthi amalungelo nezinsizakalo zaleyo misebenzi azingcoliswa ukusekelwa kwayo. b singase sithumele izimali zomsebenzi ukuze sisize le misebenzi ukuze sibe yilungu noma sibe nesibopho sokubamba umhlomulo wepension ophakanyiswe yiCentre noma singacela ukuba sithathe umhlalaphansi ngemvume yokuthola umhlomulo ophakanyiswe njengosizo lwepension. ICentre kufanele isebenzise izinkokhelo nezisekelo ezikhulunywe ku-subsection 1b ngenhla ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe yilabo abahlinzeke le mali. ICentre ingase ikhokhe imali yokusebenza nganoma iyiphi imisebenzi eyenzayo ngaphansi kwalomthetho, noma yenze ezinye izinhlelo zezimali ezithathwa njengokufanele. Isitatimende sezezimali kufanele sinikezwe amalungu phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha
UMphathiswa Wezamanzi Nezihlahla, emva kokubonisana noMphathiswa Wezindaba Zasendaweni mayelana nezindaba zikahulumeni ekhaya, wenza lokhu ngokuhambisana nesigaba 19 seMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zamanzi (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1997) ngokukhishwa kwemiyalo equkethwe kulolu hlu. a ukuhlinzeka noma ukwamukela noma iyiphi imali engafanele, ukungena, isipho, noma enye inzuzo engafanele eyenzeka ngoba kufanele noma akufanele uthathe isinyathelo esithile esithinta lesi sivumelwano; b ukufuna, ukuhlinzeka, ukubamba iqhaza, ukudala umjikelezo, nokuzama ukudala izimo ezichazwe kumyalo a. e Umthetho Wokulingana Kwezemployment ungumthetho No. 75 ka-1997 futhi f Umthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ungumthetho No. 97 ka-1998. a ucabangela ulimi abathanda noma olusebenzisa endaweni futhi b ucabangela izidingo ezihlukene zabantu abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala nabathintekile esikhathini esedlule. c chaza izimo nemigomo ngaphansi kwazo abanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwendawo ephethwe yikhandidethi yamanzi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ingxenye yephrojekthi yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. d lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ububanzi bomsebenzi nezindinganiso zomsebenzi okufanele zenziwe, futhi sizokhombisa ukuthi uma kuguquka, kuzoguquka ngokuhambisana nezimo zendawo zesivumelwano nezidingo ezithile, kuhlanganise nesikhathi esichaziwe futhi kubalulekile ukuba kube nohlu lwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa zezimali ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindinganiso zomsebenzi ezibekwe; futhi e chaza lezi zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezizoba yingxenye yesivumelwano nephrojekthi ukuze umhlinzeki wamanzi akwazi ukufinyelela lezi zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zazo zonke izinhlangothi ekutholeni noma yiziphi izimvume ezidingekayo, ukuze usebenzise amanzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). b Lesi sivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokubuyekezwa okuphindaphindiwe komsebenzi owenziwayo; kufanele futhi c kuvumele ithuba lokuphinda kuxoxiswane ngezindinganiso zomsebenzi nezinkomba ezihilela labo abangabasebenzisi bamanzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezimo ezisemqoka okufanele umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi ahlangabezane nazo mayelana nokusebenza komsebenzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sihlanganise umthetho ozovimbela umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi ekudluliseleni amalungelo akhe noma noma yiziphi izibopho zakhe zesivumelwano kumuntu noma ngaphambi kokuba avunyelwe yikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuhlela kwabasebenzi abakule khandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi abahilelekile ekuhlinzekeni ngamanzi nalabo abathintekile ngesivumelwano mayelana nokuthi bazokhokhwa kanjani ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezabasebenzi. i futhi kuzoletha izinguquko ezimamounts ezikhokhwayo, amaholo, noma kuzoletha izinguquko ezindinganisweni noma ezingeni lokusebenza ii lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuveza ulwazi emphakathini mayelana nezinguquko nezichibiyelo eziphakanyisiwe ku-I ngenhla; futhi h noma yiziphi izijeziso ezingafanele zikhokhwe noma yimuphi umuntu onenhlangano yokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi noma iyiphi uhlelo olubhalwe phansi, incwadi yemiyalo, isizinda solwazi, uhlu olunembile, amarekhodi ezimali, kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluqoqwe ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano kuzohlala kungokwakhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. a ivimbela ukuthengiswa, ukudluliswa kwamalungelo okuphatha, noma ukucindezelwa kwanoma iyiphi impahla eyindawo kanye nezakhiwo ezikhona noma ezizayo futhi engelona impahla yekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, kuhlanganise noma iyiphi ingxenye yezinsizakalo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ngaphandle kokuthi ukuthengiswa, noma ukudluliswa kwamalungelo noma ukucindezelwa kuhlelwe ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi noma ii kuvunywe ngesisekelo senhlangano yekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. b Lesi sivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokuqhuba ukucindezelwa kwempahla futhi sichaze amasu okugcina impahla isesimweni esisebenzayo ukuze kukhombise ukuthi umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ugcinwa esimweni esifanele; bese c sichaza inqubo yokuthola impahla, ukuthengisa, ukudlulisa amalungelo okuphatha, nokulahla impahla ecindezelwe. c kumele kuhlangabezane nokubuyekezwa kwezimali ezikhathini ezichaziwe mayelana nendlela esetshenzisiwe; futhi d hlinzeka ngokwabelana ngezinzuzo zezimali ezizotholwa ngokwenza umsebenzi kahle nangaphakathi kwezinga lomhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi. banohlelo lokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzisi bamanzi iii chaza ilungelo lomsebenzisi wamanzi lokuthi kube neziphazamiso zilungiswe b qapha ukuhamba kwenqubo ezovumela abasebenzisi bamanzi endaweni lapho lesi sivumelwano sisebenza khona ukuba babambe iqhaza ekubhaleni idokhumenti yamalungelo abasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kufanele kuhlelwe ukuthi i kube nemihlangano nemiphakathi lapho, uma ibanjwe, kubhekwa ulimi abathanda noma olukhuluma abantu bendawo lapho lesi sivumelwano sisebenza khona; bese ii kube nendlela yokwamukela, ukuhlaziya, nokubheka imibono neziphakamiso zabantu abasebenzisa amanzi ezethulwe mayelana nedokhumenti yamalungelo ephakanyisiwe. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi ikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi izokwazi kanjani ukuqapha ukusebenza komhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi ukuze ihambisane nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 27 seMthetho. Lesi sivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi uhlinzeka ngolwazi olungase lwenziwe yikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuze uqaphe ukuhambisana nesivumelwano ukuze ikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zayo zokubika kuMphathiswa kanye nohulumeni wesifunda ukuthi umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi uyahambisana nomthetho kanye nalezi ziqondiso. a lungisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi ezimali nezitatimende ngokulandela incwadi yemithetho ethathwa njengokufanele kwezindaba zezimali futhi yamukelwe Ngokuvamile Yamukelwe Ukubalwa Kwezimali eNingizimu Afrika noma uma kukhona ezingeni elithile likahulumeni, landela umthetho ofanele wokubalwa kwezimali; futhi b ivumele ikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuthola wonke amarekhodi nezitatimende zezimali ezidingekayo ukuze zihlolwe futhi zibhalwe phansi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano. a qopha bonke abantu abasebenzisa amanzi nalabo abake bawasebenzisa ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano b uhlu lwezimpahla nezakhiwo zezinsizakalo zamanzi kuhlanganise nezimo zazo nezindawo zazo futhi c qopha imisebenzi, ukugcinwa kwemishini nezinsiza, ukuhlolwa, nokucubungula kwezimo zemishini. Umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi kumele ngaphansi kwesivumelwano uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo ngabantu abasebenzisa amanzi kanye nalabo abangase bawasebenzise
Kubahlonishwa kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu azi ukuthi iKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ngaphansi kweSahluko 11 seMthetho weKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 46 ka-1997) ifundwa kanye neSahluko 196 (f) (ii) yoMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) isungule imithetho ebhalwe kuSheduli 1 lapha. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi omunye umqashi, ummeleli noma isisebenzi sebhizinisi esamukelekayo ubambe iqhaza. Ukuphathwa noma ukusingathwa kwezinkinga kufanele kube ngokushesha, kungakhethi, futhi kube nokuqonda, kube nobudlelwano obuqinile endaweni yokusebenza, nokuxazululwa kwezinkinga zomuntu ngamunye ezingeni eliphansi lelo department. Inkinga kufanele ixazululwe ngumqashi lapho ivela khona noma ezingeni eliseduze. Umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi izinkinga zixazululwa ngendlela efanele, engakhethi, futhi ngaphandle kokucwasa, futhi ukuthi izimiso zobulungiswa zilandelwa. Le nqubo kufanele isize futhi ivumele umqashi nomqashi ukuthi baxazulule ukunganeliseki. Akekho umqashi okufanele abhekane nokuhlukunyezwa noma ukuhlukumezeka ngqo noma ngokuqondile ngenxa yokuthi baphakamisile inkinga. Uma umqashi ebhekene nesinyathelo sokuziphatha, ukusetshenziswa kwale nqubo ngumqashi ukuze abhekane nendaba ephathelene nesinyathelo sokuziphatha ngeke kube yinqubo yokuziphatha. Inkinga kufanele ibhalwe phansi lapho ithunyelwa, futhi zonke izinqumo ezenziwe kule nqubo kufanele zibhale. Uma kubhekwa izikhathi ezinqunyiwe, lokhu kufanele kubalwe ngokukhipha usuku lokuqala bese kubalwa usuku lokugcina. Ababandakanyekayo kufanele bahloniphe izikhathi ezibekwe kule nqubo, ngaphandle uma bevuma ukwandisa isikhathi. Inkinga kufanele ithunyelwe kumqashi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-90 kusukela ngosuku umqashi waqaphela ngalo isenzo esamphazamisayo noma ukungasebenzi. Umqashi angacela ukuthi inkinga yakhe ithunyelwe kuKomishini phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 ngemuva kokuthola isinqumo kusuka kumphakathi ofanele. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umqashi ulwazi oludingekayo oludingekayo ukuze aphakamise futhi alandele inkinga, uma kuceliwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kwalolu lwazi kuncike kunoma yiziphi izithiyo zomthetho. Umqashi kufanele aziswe ngesimo senkinga yakhe nokuthi isiphumelele kangakanani ekuxazululweni ngosuku oluhlelwe. Umqashi kufanele anikeze umqashi ikhophi yefomu lenkinga ngemuva kwazo zonke izigaba lapho inkinga ibhekwa khona ngumphakathi. Umqashi angathumela inkinga yakhe kumqashi oqokiwe noma umxhumanisi enqubweni yokuxazulula izinkinga kulelo department. Ifomu elibekwe ku-Anexure A kufanele lisetshenziswe lapho kuthunyelwa inkinga. Umqashi oqokiwe kufanele axhumane nomphakathi ofanele kulelo department ukuzama ukuxazulula inkinga. Inkinga ingaxazululwa noma yimuphi umuntu kulowo mkhakha ofanele onegunya lokwenza njalo. Umqashi ophakamisile inkinga uzokwaziwa ngumqashi oqokiwe ngesimo nokuqhubeka kwenziwa ekuxazululeni inkinga. Uma inkinga ixazululwe ngendlela efanelekile, umqashi ophakamisile inkinga uzothola ukuqinisekiswa okubhaliwe ngalokhu kumqashi oqokiwe. Uma inkinga ingaxazululwa, umphakathi ofanele kufanele wazise umqashi ophakamisile inkinga. Idepartment (kuhlanganise nomphakathi ofanele) inezinsuku eziyi-30 zokubhekana nenkinga. Le nkathi ingandiswiswa ngenkontileka ebhaliwe. Umphakathi kufanele, ngokweSahluko 35 (1) seMthetho weZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ka-1994, uthumele inkinga nemibhalo efanele kuKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ukuze enze iziphakamiso phakathi nezinsuku ezinhlanu zokuxhumana nomqashi onezinkinga. Uma inkinga ihlanganisa ukuhweba okungafanele njengokuchazwe kuMthetho Wezokuhweba ka-1995, umqashi angazisa umphakathi ofanele ukuthi ufuna ukusebenzisa inqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano esunguliwe kuMthethosisekelo weBhodi yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi, noma yisiphi isibalo esihambisanayo (noma yisiphi isikhungo esihambisanayo) futhi ukuthi iKomishini yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi ayikwazi ukubheka le nkinga. a ngqo kuKomishini; noma b uma kuyinkinga yokuhweba neBhodi yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi noma yisiphi isibalo esihambisanayo noma yisiphi isikhungo esihambisanayo mayelana nenqubo yokuxazulula izingxabano. Uma iKomishini isitholile lonke ulwazi oluvela kumphakathi ofanele, kufanele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30, ibheke le nkinga futhi ibhale kumphakathi ofanele ngeziphakamiso zayo nezizathu zesenzo sayo. Ngemuva kokuthola iziphakamiso zeKomishini, umphakathi ofanele kufanele, phakathi kwezinsuku ezinhlanu, ubhale kumqashi kanye neKomishini ngesinqumo saso. a thumele inkinga yayo kuMongameli uma iyinhloko ye department kazwelonke; noma b thumele inkinga yayo kumphakathi ofanele uma iyinhloko ye department yesifunda. UMongameli noma uMholi weSifunda unezinsuku eziyi-30 zokubhekana nenkinga. Le nkathi ingandiswiswa ngokuvumelana. Imithetho F9 noF10 ifundwa nezichibiyelo ezidingekayo futhi izosebenza kuzo zonke izinkinga zezinhloko ze department. Inhloko ye department kufanele iqinisekise ukuthi izixazululo zezingxabano ziqashwa ngokugcina amarekhodi enani lezinkinga ezixazululiwe kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka ngamunye nokubika kuKomishini ngalokhu njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. IKomishini kufanele ibike kwiPhalamende okungenani kanye ngonyaka mayelana nokuphathwa kwezinkinga nokusebenza kahle kwenqubo yokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nezisebenzi zayo, ePhalamende lesifunda. Uma inkinga ithunyelwe ngaphansi kwale nqubo, umqashi ophakamisile inkinga kufanele akhulume uma efuna ukusebenzisa ezinye izinqubo. Inkinga ephakanyisiwe ngaphambi kokukhululwa kweMithetho Yesikhashana, ngaphambi kosuku luka-1 kuJulayi 1999, izophathwa futhi iphethwe ngokweMithetho Yesikhashana yokuxazulula izinkinga ekhishwe ngaphansi kokukhululwa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni No. 20231 ka-1999. Usuku lokusebenza kwale mithetho ngu-19 kuZibandlela 2003, ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe kuMthetho K. Le fomu kufanele isetshenziswe ukuze kuphakanyiswe inkinga (ukukhishwa kwezinsolo zokukhishwa okungalungile) uma unganelisekile ngesenzo noma ukungasebenzi futhi ungakwazi ukuxazulula le ndaba ngenkulumo engafanele ngokomthetho. Ungasizwa noma umelelwe omunye umqashi noma ummeleli noma isisebenzi esivela enhlanganweni esamukelekayo. Kubalulekile ukugcwalisa yonke imininingwane ngokunembile. Uma ifomu liphothuliwe, kufanele linikezwe kumqashi oqokiwe ukuze alawule noma abe umxhumanisi enqubweni yokuxazulula izinkinga kulelo centre. Idepartment izobophela le fomu kumanye amadokhumenti ezinkinga futhi izosetshenziswa kuzo zonke izigaba zenqubo yokuxazulula izinkinga. Kuwo wonke amazinga lapho umuntu emkhakheni ofanele womphakathi ezama ukuxazulula inkinga,
UMphathiswa weMvula neMithi, ngaphansi kwemvume enikezwe yizigaba ezingu-26 (a) no (g), kanye nesigaba esingu-116 esifundwe ndawonye nesigaba esingu-21(k) seMthetho weMvula Kazwelonke, 1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998), ubonisa ukufuna ukwenza imithetho kuSheduli. Uma ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kuhambisana nesu elivunyelwe lokusebenzisa amanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, okuyisu lokwenza imisebenzi ngokuhambisana nomgomo 5 lapho kufanelekile; futhi futhi kuhambisana nezidingo zanyanyiso esithokozisayo sokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, lapho kudingeka. Futhi izindlela ezifanele zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; kanye nendawo lapho kukhona izindawo ezithintekayo noma ezivikela uma kungekho isu elivunyelwe lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi. Umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngendlela enomthelela omkhulu noma ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo yokuzijabulisa kufanele afake isicelo sokuvunyelwa kwesu lokwenza imisebenzi mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamanzi okunomthelela omkhulu noma ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 zokuthola isaziso ngendlela efanele ukuze enze kanjalo. Ngokuhambisana nanoma yiziphi izinqubo ezilawulayo eziphathelene nezinsiza kanye nezindawo; nokuvikela nokwandisa izimfanelo namasiko aphathelene nomthombo wamanzi. Lokhu kuhambisana nezidingo zomgomo 2; futhi noma yimuphi umfaki-sicelo obonisile ukuthi angakwazi, noma uzokwazi ukuphatha nokulawula imithelela emibi kumthombo wamanzi njengoba kuhlonishwa kumgomo 2g. Umgomo wokulawula ungase ucele olunye ulwazi kumuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, njengendaba yomgomo 2 futhi ungase ubonise ukuthi isu eliphakanyisiwe lokwenza imisebenzi lishintshiwe njengoba kudingeka umgomo wokulawula. Uma umgomo wokulawula uvumele isu lokwenza imisebenzi, umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa kufanele ahambisane nezinhlinzeko zalesi sikhathi esivunyelwe sokwenza imisebenzi. Isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi kufanele lithuthukiswe ngumgomo ofanele futhi lezi zinhlinzeko kufanele zethulwe umgomo wokulawula ukuze kuvunyelwe ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kulowo mthombo wamanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, kuhlanganise namanzi angaphezulu emisebenzi kahulumeni, ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-180 kusukela ngosuku umgomo ofanele watshelwa umgomo wokulawula ukuze enze kanjalo. Isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi, njengoba lichazwe kumgomo 1, kufanele libhalwe ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zeMnyango mayelana ne-Integrated Water Resource Management Strategy, ephathelene Nokusetshenziswa Kwamanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa, eprintwe ngoMsombuluko 2005. Kufanele kusungulwe umgomo wokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; futhi kufanele kuvumeleke ukuthi kube nezimvo ezibhaliwe ezithunyelwa ngesicelo esiphakanyisiwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokushicilelwa kwesaziso; futhi kufanele kubhekwane nazo zonke izimvo ezamukelekayo. Kungase kushintshwe umgomo wokuphatha imithombo yamanzi; futhi ngokuhambisana nomgomo 3, kushicilelwe isu lokuphatha imithombo yamanzi ezincwadini nasemithonjeni eminingi ephathelene nomthombo wamanzi othintekayo. Noma yimuphi umuntu osebenzisa amanzi ngenhloso yokuzijabulisa kufanele abhekane nezidingo zokugcina amarekhodi okusetshenziswa kwamanzi afanele futhi anikeze umgomo wokulawula ngalolo lwazi. Akekho omunye umuntu, ngaphandle kokuba enevumelekile ebhaliwe yoMphathiswa, ongafinyelela kunoma yisiphi isici semisebenzi yamanzi kahulumeni, lapho kungekho indawo yokufinyelela esemthethweni. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo yokuzijabulisa akuvunyelwe kunoma yisiphi isici semisebenzi yamanzi kahulumeni ngaphandle kokuba uMphathiswa evumelekile ngobufakazi obubhaliwe. Akukho imisebenzi yokuzijabulisa ezindaweni zokuphepha zomjaho wamanzi kanye nomlomo wemisebenzi noma ekuphumelelweni kwayo ngaphandle kokuba uMphathiswa akhiphe imvume ebhaliwe; futhi kuphela izimoto ezihamba ngesivinini esingaphazamisi kuphela ezivunyelwe ezindaweni ezibekwe ngaphandle kokuzijabulisa. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophula noma ongahambisani nezinhlinzeko zalemithetho ubhekwa njengomphangi futhi, uma ebanjwa, ubhekene necebo noma ukuvalelwa isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu. Lezi zinhlinzeko zingabizwa ngokuthi Imithetho Yokusetshenziswa Kwamanzi Ngenhloso Yokuzijabulisa. Ingxenye yokuqala ibeka izimo nezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ngesikhathi sezigaba zokuqala zokwenza umsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process ngaphakathi komnyango wesifunda. Ingxenye yesibili ibeka izimo ezizokwenziwa ekupheleni kwesigaba sokuhlola ukuze kugcinwe inqubo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, lokhu kunikeza abasebenzi ithuba lokufaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa kokusebenza kwabo ngenkathi ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhuluma ngokuqhuba nokubuyekezwa kwezinhlelo ezibekwe kanye nokwethembeka kwazo. Inqubo yokuhlola iwumphumela wesivumelwano seSouth African Local Government Bargaining Council (SALGBC) sokuthi kukhona isidingo sokuthi kube nendlela efanayo yokuhlola ukusebenza ngaphakathi komnyango wombuso wendawo. Kubonwa ukuthi le uniformity ibalulekile ezicini ezihlukahlukene zokuhweba njengezinkulumo zokuhola, ukuqonda okwanele kwezikhundla zabasebenzi kanye nezimo zenhlangano, ukuhlela kwezobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa. Lo mbhalo wezinyathelo kufanele ufundwe ngokuhlanganyela nomsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process, ama-Job Evaluation Training Manuals, kanye namarekhodi omnyango wesifunda mayelana nomsebenzi we-Job Evaluation Process. Uhloswe ukuhlela inqubo ukuze kugwenywe ukubambezeleka ekwenzeni ukuhlola ngenxa yokungavumelani okungadingekile nokuphikisana. Kuqondiswe ukuqeda isigaba sokuqala senqubo yokuhlola ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingangama-18 months. Kubalulekile ukuthi le nqubo ibe nekhono elikhulu ngangokunokwenzeka futhi ivunyelwe kubasebenzi. Akukho umsebenzi ozosala esimweni sokusebenza okungafanele kunalokho okukhona okwamanje okukhona ngenxa yokuhlolwa kokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasebenzi akufanele balindele ukuthi isigaba sokuhlola sizohlinzeka ngenkonzo yokwaneliseka kubo bonke. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi ukuxoxisana ngokwenyuka kwemiholo nezibuyekezo ezintsha akusho ukuthi kukhona ukukhuphuka kwemiholo kubo bonke abasebenzi kodwa kuwukuguqulwa kwenqubo yokuhlola esivele ikhona ibe yindlela eyodwa. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le ndlela iyasetshenziswa. Ngemuva kwalokho, wonke umuntu uzoba nethuba lokufaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa kwesikhundla sabo uma bezwa ukuthi isigaba sabo asikhombisi kahle umqondo womsebenzi wabo noma uma bezwa ukuthi umsebenzi wabo ushintshile ngemuva kokuhlolwa kokuqala kwezikhundla. Izindawo zokuhlola ziwumkhawulo osemthethweni obekwe ukuze kusungulwe amaKomidi Wokuhlola Imisebenzi (PJECs) kuze kube yilapho inqubo yokuhlola iphelile. Zonke izinkantolo zendawo zizoba Izindawo Zokuhlola Imisebenzi. Ezinye Izindawo Zokuhlola Imisebenzi zizokwenziwa yiKomidi Eliphezulu le-SALGBC ngokusekelwe eziphakamiso ezenziwe yiMnyango we-SALGBC. Ngokuhambisana neMithetho Emisha neThuthukiswa, phakathi neminyaka eyishumi nambili yokuqala kuhulumeni wenkululeko, sigxile emizamweni yokwenza ushintsho emphakathini. Sifake ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengesisekelo sokuhola inqubo yemithetho kanye nesakhiwo sokwehlisa amazinga obuphofu, kanye nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zokuhlalisana emphakathini kubantu abampofu nabaphethwe yizinkinga. Ngenxa yokuzinikela kweSikhungo sethu kuThuthukiswa Komphakathi, eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, kube nokugxila okukhulu ezinsizakalweni zokuhlalisana, ngokuhambisana nemizamo eqhubekayo yokulinganisa izinzuzo nokufinyelela kwabantu ezinsizakalweni zokuhlalisana. Izidingo ebhajethi yokuhlalisana zikhombisile ukuthi ibiyingxenye yokuthola izinsiza zokweseka izidingo eziyisisekelo, njengokuvikela izinsizakalo zokuhlalisana, ukugcina amakhono abalulekile abasebenzi bezokuhlalisana, kanye nokubandakanywa komphakathi kwezinhlangano zokuhlalisana. Njengomphumela, kwasungulwa iHhovisi lezeMali leZokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, futhi uMnyango weZokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ube nomqondo omkhulu kulezi zidingo ezibalulekile. Ngokwesibonelo, eminyakeni yamuva, uMnyango weZokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi waqala isikhungo semithetho mayelana neMali Yabakhi (PFA). Uhlobo lwezwe ludinge ukuthi uhulumeni ubuyekeze ukuthi usebenzisa kanjani izinsiza zawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zabelwa ngokulinganayo kulabo ababephathwe kabi emphakathini wethu. I-PFA iyisicwangciso esibalulekile sokusiza ushintsho lomphakathi nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ngokuxhasa ngempahla abakhi. Njengoba kuvunyelwene ngazo zonke izigaba emphakathini eMhlanganweni Wokukhula Nokuthuthukiswa, kulindeleke ukuthi zonke izigaba zisebenze ndawonye ekuxazululeni izinselelo zomnotho emphakathini wethu. Uhulumeni wedwa akakwazi ukunqoba lezi zinselelo. Ngakho-ke, uMnyango uqhubeka nokuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukubambisana okukhulayo phakathi kwezinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo (NGOs), Izinhlangano Zenkolo (FBOs), Izinhlangano Zomphakathi (CBOs), kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ukuze siphumelele kule mthethweni, izicwangciso zathuthukiswa ukuze kubalwe izindleko zokubhekana nayo yonke into ehambisana nokuphumeza le mthethweni. Ukuze abakhi bakwazi ukusebenza, kumele baxhaswe kahle, futhi izinga lokukhokha labakhi kumele limiswe kuyo yonke imiphakathi. Ngokufanayo, izicwangciso zokubala izindleko zohlelo lwezokuhlalisana zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izinga elibekiwe nezinsiza zabelwa ngokulinganayo. Iziphakamiso mayelana nokuxhaswa kwezimali kwezinhlelo ezichazwe ku-PFA zizokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zifika kulawo miphakathi nezinhlelo ezidinga kakhulu, nokuthi uhulumeni uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezingezona eziphansi. UMnyango uphinde wathuthukisa Izikhombisi-ndlela zeMithetho neZinqubo Ezivunyelwe, okumele zifundwe kanye nesakhiwo semithetho seMali Yabakhi. Uhulumeni uyabonga umsebenzi onzima nezikhumbuzo zalabo abathintekayo emphakathini ekuletheni izinsizakalo zokuhlalisana. Iphrojekthi efana noHlelo Lokusebenza Olwandisiwe (EPWP) iyisibonelo sokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bethu nohulumeni. Ngenxa yale moya yokubambisana, simema bonke abantu bethu ukuba baqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke. Siphinde sikhuthaze futhi sithokozise umsebenzi nezikhumbuzo zabazithandayo, abakhi abazimele, kanye nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi. Ndawonye, sakha umphakathi kanye nezwe elihloniphekile ezinganeni zethu nakubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Inqubo yokuthuthukisa isikhungo semali yokuxhasa yaqala ngo-1996 kodwa yaphazanyiswa ngo-2000. UNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi wasungula iKomidi ukuze kwenziwe uphenyo ngezinkinga eziphathelene nesikhungo semithetho, kwathi ngemuva kwalokho wanikeza iziphakamiso kuMphakathi Wezokuthuthukiswa (MINMEC). I-MINMEC yanquma ukuthi isikhungo semali yokuxhasa kufanele sibuyekezwe. Lokhu kwenziwa yiqembu elisebenzayo, futhi umphumela walolu work, iMithetho yeMali Yabakhi, yamukelwa futhi yavunywa ngo-2004 ngemuva kokwethulwa ezikhundleni zeZinsizakalo Zokuhlalisana (HSWS), iKomidi Eliphezulu (EXCO), kanye ne-MINMEC. UMnyango uphinde uthande ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwabantu nezikhungo ezithintekayo ekuthuthukiseni le mthethweni, iminyango yesifunda, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nomphakathi uqobo ngezibopho zabo nezikhumbuzo. Ukubambisana phakathi koMnyango nezinhlangano zomphakathi kuzohlala kuyisici esiyinhloko emizamweni yokufeza impumelelo nokugcwalisa izibopho.
