Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imihlahlandlela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi abanelungelo lokuthola izinzuzo zokudlulisela ngesikhathi belindele umsebenzi bakwazi ukuzifinyelela. Iqondiswe ngokwezisebenzi ezithile ezikhiqizwayo, hhayi ngokusekelwe endimeni noma osayizi. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusiza ngezindleko abasebenzi abahlangabezana nazo uma bengaseduze nezindawo zabo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Ukubuyiselwa okufanele kunikezwa yiphakheji uma abasebenzi bekhuphuka emsebenzini, okuzothokozisa futhi umnyango. Kuyacaca ukuthi lezi zinzuzo zifana kubasebenzi bazo zonke izinga ngaphakathi komnyango. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikhefu linikezwa kuphela kubasebenzi abaphakathi kwezimo ezivumela ukuthi bakwenze, futhi ukuthi kubasiza ngokungabi khona emsebenzini. Izinhlinzeko zenziwe ngezikhathi zokuhlola, ukuya ezifundweni, ukuhamba ukusuka lapho umuntu ehlala khona, ucwaningo, nezemidlalo, uma umuntu engumrepresentative wabasebenzi ezinkulumweni, uma umuntu eya ukuzobamba iqhaza emkhandlwini yedolobha, nokunye. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusetha izibopho zomnyango uma kudluliswa umsebenzi ukusuka endaweni eyodwa kuya kwenye. Umnyango uzokhokhela izindleko zokuhamba, kungakhathaliseki izinga noma isikhundla. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula umhlahlandlela wokubuyisela abasebenzi abahamba ukuze kuzuzwe umnyango, kanye nalabo abasebenzi abakhishwe emsebenzini, noma labo abashonile. Kubalulekile lapha ukuthi kuphela abasebenzi abaphakathi kwezindima ezithile bazosebenzisa lezi zinhlinzeko. Kucacisiwe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izothola izinzuzo ezifanele kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma ubulili. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imihlahlandlela nezinhlinzeko mayelana nokuphela komsebenzi womuntu emnyangweni. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuvula uhlelo oluzoba nolungile nolucacile kubo bonke abasebenzi emnyangweni. Ngokufanayo, noma iyiphi indlela yokucwaswa eyenzekile esikhathini esedlule kufanele isuswe. Ukugxila kugxile kakhulu emsebenzini othile okumele wenziwe ezingeni elithile lohlelo lomsebenzi. Ukukhokha kuzohambisana nemali eyenziwa ngumsebenzi, futhi ukukhokha akwenziwe ngamahora. Ukukhokha kwe-ovetime kulawulwa ukutholakala kwemithombo yezimali. Ukukhokha kwe-ovetime akufanele kudlule ku-30% yemali eyenziwa ngumsebenzi. Lo mthetho ubheka ukuthi umuntu kufanele enze ini mayelana nomsebenzi, bese ucabanga ngesikhundla sabo. Bonke abasebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi babhale izivumelwano zabo ezihlobene nokuphathwa komsebenzi wabo nezindlela ezizosebenza lapho kuhlolwa ukusebenza kwabo. Lo mthetho unikeza uhlaka oluphatha umsebenzi kanye nezinga lalo ngendlela yokubambisana, futhi usetha okulindelwe kubantu mayelana nomsebenzi wabo. Ekupheleni, umthetho ophatha izinga lomsebenzi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono abantu asetshenziswa ngokuphelele futhi ezinye izinsiza zithinte kahle imiphumela yomsebenzi, okuyimizamo yokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuguqula kuMnyango Wezamanzi Nezinkuni. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bahambisana nohlelo lokuguqula umsebenzi futhi iphinde ibheke ukuthi izinguquko ezivela ezimfundisweni zomthetho ziphathwa kanjani. Iphinde inikeze uhlaka lokuhlola uma kukhona izinguquko futhi ibeke umthetho. Ikhuthaza futhi ikhuthaza ukuvuleka nokucacile, futhi ukuze abasebenzi babambe iqhaza ukuze baqinise ubudlelwano bokwethembana, ukubambisana, nokwethembeka kubaphathi, kanye nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinhlelo zabasebenzi ezizoba yisisekelo salolu hlelo. Ukususwa kwezinyathelo zokucwaswa ezihlobene nobuhlanga, ubulili, nezinye izici... Abasebenzi abanokucela ukuhlolwa komsebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa komsebenzi wabo, kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwesimo sabo, futhi kungenzeka futhi ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwabo kungancishiswa. Uma kudingeka ukunciphisa isikhundla somsebenzi, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo yokuvimbela lokho ngokwenza izinguquko ezithile kulowo msebenzi. Izinqubo zokuhola kufanele ziqinisekise ubulungiswa, ukungacwaswa, nokufinyelela kumathuba, kanye nokuba nesigaba esisebenzela umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Zonke izikhala kufanele zivuleke kubo bonke abafakizicelo, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, inkolo, ubuzwe, izinkolelo zezombusazwe, isiko, ubudala, ulimi, ukungasebenzi, isimo somshado, nezinye izimo ezihlukahlukene. Izikhangiso kufanele zicacise kahle ukuthi iSikhungo Sezikhungo Zomphakathi sizibophezele ekungacwasweni emsebenzini, ekuvumelaneni kwabasebenzi, futhi ukuthi izicelo ezivela ezindaweni ezithile zomphakathi ezake zaba nezinselelo zikhuthazwa. Izinga elisetshenzisiwe lapho kukhethwa abasebenzi kufanele libe nolungile futhi lihlobene nezidingo zomsebenzi futhi kufanele lisetshenziswe ngokuqhubekayo ngezikhathi zonke. Inqubo yokuhola izobandakanya wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nalabo abavela ezindaweni eziphansi nezomphakathi, futhi nakuba bamenywa ukuba bafake izicelo zemisebenzi, akufanele bacwaswe futhi kufanele baphathwe ngendlela efanele futhi enhlonipho. Uma umuntu engenayo imfundo edingekayo, iziqu, noma amakhono olimi, noma ufunde ngaphezu kwezidingo zomsebenzi, noma usebenze isikhathi eside, zonke lezi zinto ezingahlangene nomsebenzi akufanele zibe izizathu zokukhetha umuntu ophuma emphakathini owake waba nezinselelo, futhi ngenxa yalokho, amathuba abantu abavela ezindaweni eziphansi akufanele ancishiswe.
Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemiphakathini yabo. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kuqhutshwa kakhulu ngamaKhothama noma Abaholi Bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaKhosi nababusi futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulukazi ngezindlela zomthetho wendabuko. Ngaphansi kweSigaba 211 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wendabuko uyavunyelwa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho eziphila ndawonye nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wendabuko njengoba bekunjalo ngaphambi kokuba kudalwe iMthethosisekelo omusha, kodwa lo mthetho kufanele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuvumelana nemithetho ekhona kanye neMthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhiwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yeSigaba 16 seSheduli 6 seMthethosisekelo, enikeza ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neKhothama elikhona ngesikhathi sokuqala kweMthethosisekelo ziqhubeka nokusebenza futhi zisebenzise amandla azo omthetho njengoba kunikezwe. Ukusebenza kwezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ifaka phakathi eminye eyakhelwe ngaphambi kweMthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezaziyizindawo ezazikhona. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yakudala eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngokuqashelwa komthetho, uMongameli wezwe uthumele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuvumelana neSigaba 14 seSheduli 6 seMthethosisekelo. Bheka: Umbiko NgamaKhothama & Imisebenzi Yezomthetho Yabaholi Bendabuko: owabhalwa ngoJanuwari 21, 2003: iKomidi Lomthetho laseNingizimu Afrika ikhasi 1. Ububanzi bemandla bungachazwa njengamandla nokwaziswa kwekhosi yokuzwa udaba nokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Graafreinet Municipality v Van Ryneveld's Pass Irrigation Board 1950 SA 420 (A). Ngakho-ke, ububanzi bemandla busitshela ngamandla nemikhawulo enikezwe enkantolo. Isinqumo esikhishwe endabeni lapho inkantolo ingenamandla sithathwa njengokungasebenzi. Lapho sibheka umthetho okhona, imibono yobubanzi ivela ezindleleni nasezithethweni eziningi. Le mithetho ivela emthethweni ojwayelekile kodwa ingase yenziwe njengemithetho. Isibonelo sokwenziwa kwale mithetho nguMthetho Wezinkantolo Zasemadolobheni. Lo mthetho ungumthombo wemithetho eminingi ehlobene nobubanzi. Ngokuhambisana nalo mthetho ukuze inkantolo ibe nobubanzi, kufanele ikwazi ukukhipha imiyalo nokwenza izinqumo: Eckards 17. Inkantolo kufanele ibe nobubanzi phezu komuntu wephikiswa kanye nezimpahla zabo. Umqondo wemikhawulo uhambisana nomgomo wokusebenza ngendlela efanelekile. Umkhawulo wobubanzi uhambisana nomkhawulo wokusebenza. Bheka Polak 2. Umkhawulo wobubanzi wenkantolo uhambisana nendawo ethile noma indawo echazwe kahle. Le ngqondo ibonisa ngqo ukuthi umphikisi ulandela indawo lapho umphikisi ekhona. Uma umphikisi efuna ukuvula icala, umphikisi kufanele avule icala enkantolo enobubanzi phezu komphikisi kanye nezimpahla zabo. Kuvamise ukuba inkantolo yasendaweni lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, hhayi lapho umphikisi ehlala khona. Nokho, kunezimo ezihlukene ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho: isibonelo; inkantolo inobubanzi ngoba isizathu sokuphikiswa saphuma endaweni elawulwa yile nkantolo. Mayelana neSigaba 28(d) seMthetho Wezinkantolo ZamaMagistrate uMthetho No. 32 ka-1944, lesi sigaba sikhombisa ukuthi ukuze le nkantolo ibe nobubanzi, isizathu sokuphikiswa kufanele sibe sikhona ngokuphelele endaweni enikezwe le nkantolo. Ngenxa yemithetho yokuncintisana, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkantolo ezimbili zibe nobubanzi phezu kwendaba eyodwa. Njengoba umphikisi enelungelo lokulawula icala, bangakhetha inkantolo ezoyizwa indaba yabo. Ngokujwayelekile, umphikisi ukhetha inkantolo ehambelana nabo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi isimo sifaneleka kangakanani kumphikisi. Ububanzi buqinisekiswa ngesikhathi umuntu ethola imiyalo yenkantolo, hhayi ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha leyo miyalo. Uma inkantolo idlula ububanzi bayo, isebenza ngaphezu kwamandla ayo kuze kube icala liphothuliwe. Standard Credit Corporation Ltd v Bester and Others 1987 SA 812 (W) ku-819. Uma inkantolo yayinobubanzi ngesikhathi umuntu ethola imiyalo yenkantolo noma ngesikhathi inkantolo iqala icala, ushintsho ezimweni lungashintsha ububanzi benkantolo. Isibonelo: inkantolo inobubanzi ngoba ngesikhathi umphikisi ethola imiyalo yenkantolo, bephila endaweni yayo, iqhubeka nokuba nobubanzi phezu kwendaba noma ngabe ngemva kokunikeza imiyalo, umphikisi akasahlali endaweni yale nkantolo. Le ndawo ihambisana nomkhawulo wobubanzi. Kungumsebenzi wanoma iyiphi inhlangano ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inkantolo yayo inobubanzi ukuze iwulalele udaba oluphakanyisiwe phambi kwayo. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi mayelana nezimo ezithile zohlobo lwendaba kanye nenani elithintekayo. Kufanele kube sobala ukuthi ngokwezimiso zezimali, akukakabi khona umgomo okhona ophatha inani lemali. Ngisho nasekuntulekeni kwemikhawulo yemali, iKomidi Lomthetho mayelana Nezisebenzi Zomthetho Wendabuko lenza iziphakamiso zokuqala zemigomo ezizosiza ukucacisa nokuthuthukisa isimo somthetho wendabuko. Uma umphikisi evela phambi kwenkantolo engenamandla okuphikisa icala labo futhi engakwenzi ukwenqaba ukujolisa phambi kwenkantolo, inkantolo izoba namandla okuzwa udaba. Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuthi abhekelelwe yimithetho yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) seMthetho Wezinkantolo ZamaMagistrate uMthetho No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kuguquliwe. Nokho, uma umphikisi engenaleli, umphakathi ophakanyisiwe unomsebenzi wokubuza ngokwakhe (mero mutu) mayelana namandla obubanzi ukuze aphikise udaba kule nkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli womphikisi, umphakathi wenkantolo ngeke ubuze ngokwakhe mayelana namandla obubanzi benkantolo ukuze aphikise icala. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi inkantolo ingenamandla okuphikisa icala, umuntu owafaka kufanele alethe ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ifanele ukuphikisa icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weKomidi Lomthetho ngamaKhothama, ikhasi 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokuthi inkantolo ayinamalungelo okuphikisa icala ingabaphoqa ukuba baveze ubufakazi mayelana nokuthi kungani besho kanjalo. Umqondo wobubanzi uhambisana nokuhlukaniswa kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa amandla nemigomo yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lobubanzi nemikhawulo, inkantolo yomthetho ihlala njengenkantolo yokuqala noma njengenkantolo yokuphikisana. Inkantolo
Lo mbhalo awuqondwanga ukuthi ube ngumbhalo obanzi ongathathwa njengomthombo wolwazi kodwa usebenza njengethuluzi lokuhola ochwepheshe abasebenza emishadweni nasekuhlukaniseni ifa emthethweni wendabuko. Ngenxa yemithetho ephikisanayo, emishadweni ethile yabantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika ayizange ibonwe noma yaba buthakathaka ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Umthetho omusha okukhulunywa ngawo kulo mbhalo ulethe izinguquko ezinkulu kumasiko njengoba sizobona ebhalweni. Ngokufanayo, indlela yokuphathwa kwezindawo zabantu abamnyama abafa bengakhethanga abashadile yayiphikisana kakhulu nemthethosisekelo, ngakho-ke izigameko zomlando zaphoqelela uMnyango Wezobulungiswa ukuba ulungise imithetho ukuze ihambisane neMthethosisekelo. Kungaphinde kuthiwe umthetho omusha okukhulunywa ngawo kulo mbhalo awuhambisani namasiko abantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika kodwa asihlosile ukuphawula ngalokhu kulokhu okukhuluma. Uzoba ngumgibeli. Ngaphambi kokugxila kakhulu ekukhulumeni ngeMthethweni Wokushada Kwendabuko (owaziwa lapha njengoMthetho), kubalulekile ukuveza umfanekiso obanzi wesimo somthetho esithinta imishado yombuso "nasezihlanganisweni zendabuko" eziphethwe ngaphambi kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000, (lolu suku lapho lo Mthetho uqala khona). Nokho, ukufakwa kwezindawo kwaphumelela kuphela lapho indoda ishada omunye ngaphansi kwesihlanganiso sendabuko, ehlukile emshadweni wombuso. Ngomhla ka-1 kuNovemba 1984, uMthetho Wokushada 88 ka-1984 wakhishwa, phakathi kokunye, wakhansela amandla okushada anikezwa indoda phezu kwesifazane uma beshadile ngaphansi komthetho wombuso. Lesi sinqumo saholela ekutheni kusukela ngomhla ka-1 kuNovemba 1984, amandla okushada anikezwa indoda mayelana nesifazane sayo asathathwa esigabeni esikhanselwe 22. Ngoba labo abashade ngaphansi kwezihlanganiso zendabuko babengakhethwa njengabashadile ngokomthetho, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi omunye wabo ngaphansi kwalolo shado angabopha umshado wombuso nomunye umuntu. Umthelela walolo shado lombuso waholela ekuphelisweni komshado wendabuko okwakukhona. bheka uNkambula v Linda 1951 1 SA 377 A noMalaza v Mndaweni 1975 BAC C 45. Umkakhe ngaphansi kwalolo shado wendabuko wabhekwa njengomkakhe ophuthelwe. Umkakhe walolo shado wendabuko wayengashada nomunye umuntu ngaphansi komshado wombuso, ngakho-ke isihlanganiso esikhona saphuma. Umbuzo wokuthi "lo shado" uyavuselelwa yini nguMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko 120 ka-1998 isigaba 2, lo mbuzo kumele unqunywe yizinkantolo. Nokho, isigaba 22 soMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zabantu Abamnyama 38 ka-1927 sinikeza izama zokuvikela umndeni ophuthumayo uma indoda ifa. Ngokwenzela ukuphawula ngababheki, isimo somfelokazi nezingane zomshado wombuso sithathwa ngokufana nalabo bomshado wendabuko. Kucacile ukuthi isikhundla esingcono esinikezwa umkakhe oshadile ngaphansi komthetho wombuso nezingane zakhe sesiphenduke sehluleka futhi ziphathwa ngokufana nomkakhe nezingane eziphuthumayo. Ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushintsha Umshado 3 ka-1988 owawuqala ngomhla ka-2 kuZibandlela 1988, uMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zabantu Abamnyama ka-1927 waguqulwa. Umthetho wokuguqulwa ulethe lezi zinguquko ezilandelayo. Umthelela wokukhanselwa kwesigaba wawuchaza ukuthi yonke imishado eNingizimu Afrika yayifana futhi uMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zabantu Abamnyama 88 ka-1984 wawusebenza kumishado yabantu abamnyama eyenziwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-2 kuZibandlela 1988. Imishado eyenzeka ngemuva kosuku lwe-2 kuZibandlela 1988 ihlanganisa izindawo ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesivumelwano sokuhlukanisa izindawo futhi kubhaliswe ehhovisi lezincwadi ezithathu ezinyangeni ngaphambi komshado. Isici esisha nesibalulekile ukuthi "isihlanganiso sendabuko" asikwazi ukuphulwa ngomyalo wombuso. Isigaba 221 sivimbela indoda eshadile ngaphansi komthetho wendabuko ukuthi ingazibophezela emshadweni wombuso nomfazi ngenkathi isashadile ngaphansi komthetho wendabuko. bheka uThembisile v Thembisile 2002 2 SA 209 T noKwitshane v Magalela 1999 4 SA 610 TK. Ngeshwa, akukho mpendulo enikeziwe ngesimo lapho umshado wombuso wenziwa ngemuva komshado wendabuko. Kwamukelwa ukuthi umshado wombuso onjalo awunamsebenzi. Isigaba 3 soMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko 120 ka-1998 sivimbela omunye wabashadile abaphakathi komshado wendabuko obonwa ngokomthetho ukuthi ashade ngombuso ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushada 25 ka-1961. Umqondo ofanayo njengoba kukhulunywa esigabeni 2.3.2, futhi lapha akukho mpendulo enikeziwe yokwephula lo mthetho. UMsamo Wokushada eTranskei 21 ka-1978 uvumela indoda eshadile ngaphansi komshado wombuso ukuthi ithathe futhi ngaphansi komshado wendabuko, inqobo nje uma umshado wendabuko ungahlanganisi izindawo. Ngokufanayo, indoda eshadile ngaphansi kwesihlanganiso sendabuko ingashadisa ngaphansi komshado wombuso, ngaphandle kokuphula isihlanganiso sendabuko, inqobo nje uma umshado wombuso ungahlanganisi izindawo. Umthetho uqale ngomhla ka-15 kuNovemba 2000 futhi wathatha isinyathelo esibalulekile sokwamukela yonke imishado yendabuko evunywa ngokomthetho. Umthetho unomthelela wokubuyisela emuva futhi uzoxoxwa isigaba ngesigaba. Umthetho ubhekelela yonke imishado yendabuko eyenziwe ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wendabuko, amasiko, nezindlela zendabuko ezihlonishwa abantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika futhi iyinqubo eyingxenye yesiko labo. Ngakho-ke, kucacile ukuthi umthetho ubhekelela abantu abathile, ubhekelela kuphela abantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika, inqobo nje uma umshado wenziwa ngendlela echazwe ngamasiko noma izinhlelo zabantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika. Imishado yabantu ababili noma imishado yepholigami eyenziwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000. Imishado eyenziwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000 kumele ihambisane nezidingo zomthetho. Izidingo ezibekwe kuMthetho ziqinile futhi ukwehluleka ukuhambisana kunomthelela wokuthi umshado ungasebenzi. Bobabili abashadile kumele babe nesifiso sokushada ngaphansi komthetho wendabuko. Akekho phakathi kwabashadile okufanele abe yingxenye yomshado wendabuko omunye. Kumele kube nezingxoxo ngomshado futhi kwenziwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho wendabuko. Ukuze umshado wendabuko ube semthethweni, ngaphandle kwezidingo ezichazwe ngenhla, kumele kube nesivumelwano esinikezwe esigabeni 7 (ukuxoxwa okuphelele, bheka isigaba 5.2.2). Isigaba 4 soMthetho sikhuluma ukuthi ngemva kokuthi isicelo sith
Lena ucwaningo ejwayelekile mayelana nendlela isiko lokufundisa amalungelo abantu likhule ngayo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokusekelwe kumadokhumenti omhlaba wonke kanye nezivumelwano zendawo, umlando wamalungelo abantu uvela ezindaweni ezikude neziseduzane. Ngaphandle kwezinkinga eziphathelene nokufundisa okugcizelelwa yikhono lokuthi umqondo wamalungelo abantu uyinto eyamukelekayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika, le ngxenye ihlose ukuhlaziya izivumelwano zomhlaba wonke, zendawo, nezwe. Ubulili obubhekene nabantu ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili baholele ekutheni iZizwe Ezihlangene zenze isinqumo sokuzibophezela ngokomphakathi ekuhlonipheni nasekuvikeleni amalungelo abantu. Lesi sinyathelo saqala ngo-1946 lapho iZizwe Ezihlangene zakha khona iSikhumbuzo Esivamile SamaLungelo Abantu. ENingizimu Afrika, njengelungu lesimo, yadlala indima ebalulekile kulolu sikhumbuzo ngoba uMongameli wezwe, uJan Smuts, ubhale lesi sikhumbuzo. Ezinye zezindatshana zalesi sikhumbuzo ziqinisa iZizwe Ezihlangene ukuthi "ikhuthaze ukuhlonipha amalungelo abantu kanye nezimfanelo eziyisisekelo kubo bonke ngaphandle kokukhetha ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ulimi, noma inkolo." Indatshana 56 ifuna wonke amazwe elungu ukuthi ahambisane nezivumelwano. Nokho, kwavela ukuthi ENingizimu Afrika kuqhubekile nokwephula amalungelo abantu. Nakuba iZizwe Ezihlangene iqhubeka igcizelela isinqumo sokuthi umqondo wabantu uhlose ukuvimbela ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga, uhulumeni baseNingizimu Afrika waqhubeka nezinhlelo eziphula amalungelo abantu. Lo mbono ubekwe kuNdaba 2.7 yesikhumbuzo, evimbela iKhansela Lokuphepha ekungeneleleni "ezindabeni zangaphakathi" ezisetshenziswe kabi ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zokwephula amalungelo abantu. Ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga eNingizimu Afrika kubonakala kuphikisana nezibopho zesikhumbuzo, ngakho ngo-1982, iZizwe Ezihlangene yanquma ukusola iNingizimu Afrika. Indatshana 2.7 yakha impi phakathi kwamalungelo abantu nezibopho ezilindelekile kumazwe elungu ngoba le ngxenye yaqhubeka ibeka ukuthi akukho okukhuluma ngalesi sikhumbuzo okuzovumela iZizwe Ezihlangene ukuba ingenelele ezindabeni ezibalulekile zangaphakathi ezweni elikwazi ukuzilawula noma ezizodinga amazwe elungu ukuba alethe izindaba zokuxoxwa ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo, futhi le ndlela ngeke ibangele ukuphazamiseka kokusebenza kwemishini yokulungisa nokuphumelelisa ngaphakathi, ngokwezinganekwane zeNgxenye VII. Naphezu kwezinkinga, lesi sikhumbuzo sidlale indima ebalulekile ekukhuthazeni nasekuhleleni amazinga nezimiso zamalungelo abantu emhlabeni jikelele. Isibonelo salokhu yizikhungo eziningi ezasungulwa ngaphansi kokuphathwa kweZizwe Ezihlangene ukuze kuqedwe izibopho zesikhumbuzo. Lezi zifiso zafika ngendlela yezikhumbuzo noma imihlangano. Izikhumbuzo zemihlangano zawela emkhakheni obanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ubuqotho bezivumelwano. Isikhumbuzo sokuqala samukelwa ngo-1948, esaziwa njengeSikhumbuzo Esivamile SamaLungelo Abantu. Lo mbhalo waqala wamukelwa yizizwe eziyi-48 ezinemibuso engama-56 ngoba eziyi-8 zazihlangene neNingizimu Afrika, eyayiphika. Nokho, lo mbhalo wamukelwa yizikhungo eziningi ngaphakathi kwamazwe nakwamanye amazwe. Ukubaluleka kwesikhumbuzo kubonisa ukusebenza okujulile kwesikhumbuzo seZizwe Ezihlangene. Le mbono iboniswa embikweni wezindaba owaziswa kakhulu otholakala ehhovisi leZindaba Zomthetho lapho kuthiwa, "mayelana nokubaluleka nokubaluleka kwesikhumbuzo, kungabhekwa njengesenzo esinomthelela ezikhungweni ezamukelayo, ngakho kukhona izinkomba eziqinile zokuthi amazwe elungu azokuhlonipha. Ngakho-ke, uma lokho okulindelekile kuholela ekwephuleni okwenziwe ngamaZwe, lesi sikhumbuzo singakhombisa isimo sokwakha nokuqinisa imithetho ebophelelayo kumazwe." Ukukhuthaza ubuqotho bamalungelo abantu emhlabeni jikelele kumukelwa yiSivumelwano Somhlaba Ngamalungelo Okwakha Nezombusazwe kanye neSivumelwano Somhlaba Ngamalungelo Ezezimali, Ezenhlalo Nezamasiko ngenhloso ecacile yokuguqula isikhumbuzo esingabopheleli sibe izimiso zomthetho ezibophelelayo, lezi zivumelwano zibizwa ngokuthi "Amalungelo Abantu Emhlabeni Jikelele." Amalungelo Abantu Emhlabeni Jikelele aqala ukusebenza eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1962. Enye indlela yokuvikela amalungelo abantu yakhuthazwa ukwethulwa kwezivumelwano zendawo ezifana neSivumelwano SaseYurophu ngo-1950 esihloselwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu nezimfanelo zomuntu. ISivumelwano SaseYurophu saqala ukusebenza eNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwamalungelo abantu eBophuthatswana kodwa lo mbono waphulwa nguhulumeni wangaphambili baseNingizimu Afrika owawenamandla okulawula ohulumeni bendawo. Engxoxweni edlule, kubonakala ukuthi isiko lamalungelo abantu kufanele likhule ngokulandela izinhlinzeko zeSikhumbuzo seZizwe Ezihlangene. Isibonelo; Indatshana 56 ithi amalungu abophekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokubambisana ndawonye nangokuhlukana nenhlangano mayelana nokufeza izinhloso ezibekwe nguNdaba 55. ENingizimu Afrika, ukuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo abantu kwavinjwa inqubo yokucindezela, ngakho iZizwe Ezihlangene yaqala ukuphumelela ekuzameni ukuvusa izinguquko kumgomo wokuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga kuze kube yathumela izijeziso ngo-1982. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isiko lamalungelo abantu langena e-Afrika lapho iNgqungquthela Yobumbano Lwase-Afrika yasungula iCharta Yase-Afrika ngo-1961. Nakuba inqubo ibihamba kancane ngonyaka we-20, ngaphakathi komkhakha wokuqala wokwamukela isivumelwano ngo-1981 njengeBanjul Charter, lokhu bekuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwamukela umkhankaso wamazwe ngamazwe wamazwe e-Afrika. Indawo eyaziwa kakhulu yesivumelwano bekungukwamukela "amalungelo abantu" njengophawu lokuzibophezela ekukhuthazeni umqondo wamazwe ngamazwe wamazwe. Lezi zibopho zigcizelelwa yisingeniso esikhombisa ukuzibophezela okwenziwe ngamalungu "ukuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu base-Afrika." Lezi zibopho zaba inselelo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika ngoba ayikakabi nezibopho zokwamukela nokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Inkinga ibihlobene nokuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu anikezwa yiCharta Yase-Afrika nezimfanelo zomuntu ezifunwa yizivumelwano zamazwe. Ngakho-ke, kwavela ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika idinga ukuhlela ukuvuma amalungelo abantu ngaphambi kokuba kuqale iCharta Yase-Afrika lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Inselelo yakhuphuka iye kwenye izinga ngama-Advocates of the Human Rights Organization asungulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1979. Inhloso eyinhloko yenhlangano ukuvikela nokuqinisa amalungelo abantu ngokuhambisana nokuphathwa ngokuhlonipha ubulungiswa bezomthetho nokuv
Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemazweni abo. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kuphathwa kakhulu ngamaKhosi noma Abaholi Bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaKhosi nabaholi bendawo, futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulu ngokuqhuba imikhuba yendabuko. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 211 soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wendabuko uyavunywa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho ezihambisana nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wendabuko njengoba kwenzeka ngaphambi kokwethulwa komthethosisekelo omusha, kepha lo mthetho kufanele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona kanye nomthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhangwa ngaphansi kwento 16 yeSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo, enikeza ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neNkantolo Yendabuko eyayikhona ngesikhathi umthethosisekelo uqala iyaqhubeka nokusebenza futhi izisebenze amandla ayo omthetho njengoba anikeziwe. Ukusebenza kwalezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ihlanganiswe nezinye ezazishiwoyo ngaphambi komthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezazizimele. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yomlando eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngokuqinisekiswa komthetho, uMongameli wezwe udlulisele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuhambisana nento 14 yeSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo. Bheka: Umbiko obizwa ngokuthi "Umbiko NgamaKhosi Wendabuko & Imisebenzi Yezomthetho Yabaholi Bendabuko" owadalwa ngomhla ziyi-21 kuJanuwari, 2003: iKomidi Lomthetho laseNingizimu Afrika ekhasini 1. Ukuvinjelwa kwamandla kungachazwa njengamandla nokwaziswa kwenkantolo yokulalela icala nokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Graafreinet Municipality v Van Ryneveld's Pass Irrigation Board 1950 SA 420 (A). Ngakho, ukuvinjelwa kwamandla kusitshela ngamandla nemingcele enikezwe inkantolo. Isinqumo esikhishwe kulolu daba lapho inkantolo ingenawo amandla sithathwa njengokungasebenzi. Lapho sihlola umthetho okhona, imibono yokuvinjelwa kwamandla ivela kokubili emikhubeni yendabuko nasemithethweni eminingi. Le mithetho ivela kumthetho ojwayelekile kepha ingase ibhalwe njengomthetho. Isibonelo sokubhalwa kwale mithetho nguMthetho WamaKhosi Wendawo. Lo mthetho ungumthombo wemithetho eminingi ehlobene nokuvinjelwa kwamandla. Ngokuhambisana nalomthetho ukuze inkantolo ibe namandla, kufanele ikwazi ukukhipha imiyalo nokwenza izinqumo: Eckards 17. Inkantolo kufanele ibe namandla phezu komuntu ophathwayo kanye nezimpahla zabo. Umqondo wokuvinjelwa uhambisana nomgomo wokusebenza ngendlela efanele. Ukuvinjelwa kwamandla kuhambisana nomngcele wokusebenza. Bheka Polak 2. Ukuvinjelwa kwamandla enkantolo kuhambisana nendawo ethile noma indawo echaziwe. Le misho ibonisa ngqo ukuthi umphakeli ulandela indawo lapho umphikisi ekhona. Uma umphikisi efuna ukuvula icala, umphakeli kufanele avule icala enkantolo enegunya phezu komphikisi kanye nezimpahla zabo. Ngokuvamile, inkantolo yendawo lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, hhayi lapho umphakeli ehlala khona. Nokho, kunezimo ezahlukene ngaphansi kwalomthetho: ngokwesibonelo; inkantolo inegunya ngoba umthombo wenkohlakalo uvele endaweni elawulwa yinkantolo leyo. Mayelana nesigaba 28(d) soMthetho WamaKhosi Wendawo No. 32 ka-1944, lesi sigaba sithi ukuze le nkantolo ibe namandla okusebenza, umthombo wenkohlakalo kufanele uvele ngokuphelele endaweni elawulwa yinkantolo leyo. Ngenxa yemithetho yokuncintisana kwamandla, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkantolo ezimbili zibe namandla phezu kwendaba efanayo. Ngoba umphakeli unelungelo lokulawula icala, angakhetha inkantolo ezolalela udaba lwakhe. Ngokuvamile, umphakeli ukhetha inkantolo ehambelana naye ngaphandle kokucabangela ukuthi isimo sifanele kangakanani kumphikisi. Amandla okulawula akhonjiswa ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, hhayi ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha imiyalo. Uma inkantolo idlula amandla ayo, ingase iphume icala ngokuphelele. Standard Credit Corporation Ltd v Bester and Others 1987 SA 812 (W) ekhasini 819. Uma inkantolo yayinevinjelwa kwamandla ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo noma ngesikhathi inkantolo iqala icala, ushintsho lwesimo ngeke luguqule ukuvinjelwa kwamandla enkantolo. Ngokwesibonelo: inkantolo inegunya lokulawula ngoba ngesikhathi umphikisi enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, wayehlala ngaphakathi kwendawo yayo, iyaqhubeka nokuba namandla phezu kwendaba noma ngabe ngemuva kokukhipha imiyalo, umphikisi akasekho endaweni yenkantolo leyo. Indawo ehlobene nokuvinjelwa kwamandla. Inkantolo inegunya lokulalela udaba olukhulunywa phambi kwayo. Lokhu kuqondene kakhulu nezimo ezithile zohlobo lwendaba kanye nenani elithintekayo. Kufanele kube sobala ukuthi ngokwezakhamuzi zendabuko, kusekhona umgomo othile ophatha inani lemali. Noma ngabe akukho mgomo ophathelene nenani lemali, iKomidi Lomthetho ephathelene noMthetho Wendabuko yenze izincomo zokuqala zomgomo ozosiza ukucacisa nokuthuthukisa isimo soMthetho Wendabuko. Uma umphikisi evela phambi kwenkantolo ngaphandle kwamandla okukhuluma udaba lwakhe futhi engakwenzi ukwenqaba ukuba abhekane nenkantolo, inkantolo izoba namandla okulalela udaba. Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuba alawulwe yimithetho yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) soMthetho WamaKhosi Wendawo No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kuguqulwe. Nokho, uma umphikisi engenalo ummeli, igunya eliphethe linomsebenzi wokubuza ngakho (mero mutu) mayelana namandla okukhuluma udaba kulenkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli womphikisi, igunya eliphethe lenkantolo ngeke libuze ngakho ngempela mayelana namandla enkantolo okukhuluma icala. Uma kwenzeka kudaleke udaba lokuthi inkantolo ingenawo amandla okukhuluma icala, umuntu owafakile kufanele alethe ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ifanele ukukhuluma icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weKomidi Lomthetho ngamaKhosi Wendabuko, ekhasini 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokukhuluma ukuthi inkantolo ayinamalungelo okukhuluma icala ingamphoqelela ukuba alethe ubufakazi bokuthi kungani esho kanjalo. Umqondo wokuvinjelwa kwamandla uhambisana nokuhlelwa kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa ngamandla nemithetho yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lamandla okulawula nokuvinjelwa, inkantolo yombuso ihlala njengenkantolo eyinhloko elalela udaba noma njengenk
Ithuba lezingane liphethwe ngaphansi kohlelo oluphathwa uMphakathi weNkantolo Ephakeme. Lokhu kuyifund lezakhiwo eyakhelwe ukugcina nokuphatha izimali ezikhokhelwe kuMphakathi weNkantolo Ephakeme kubantu abaziwayo noma abangaziwayo, njengabantwana nabantu abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo, abalandeli abangenaminyaka, abantu abalahlekile, noma labo abangabandakanyeki ezindabeni zokuhlala, izinzuzo, noma ezihlobene. Lapho uthola noma yiziphi izimali, uMphakathi weNkantolo Ephakeme uvula ifund emarekhodini ezimali zabantu abanikwa igama lempahla kanye nomnikazi walezi zimali. Uma kungaziwa ukuthi lezi zimali zikhona kubani, ifund ivulwa egameni lomuntu owazilethela noma egameni lempahla echazwe ngaphakathi, kuye ngaleso simo. Imali egcinwe efundini yeziqinisekiso ifakwa kwiKomidi Lokutshalwa Kwezimali Kwamaphakheji, elihlolwa ngumhloli ozimele minyaka yonke. Intshisakalo ikhokhwa ngemali efakiwe efundini yeziqinisekiso, eyenzelwe abantwana abangakwazi ukuzimela, labo abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo, abalandeli abangenaminyaka, kanye nabantu abahilelekile ezimalini, ukuze kusetshenziswe ezindaweni, izimali ezishiywe kubo, kanye nezinzuzo ezihlobene. Intshisakalo ibalwa ngenyanga ngokuya ngesilinganiso esibekwe sonyaka, ngezilinganiso ezibuyekezwa ngezikhathi ezithile nguNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Intshisakalo ikhokhwa kanye ngonyaka ekupheleni kukaMashi 31 konyaka wezimali. Intshisakalo iyanda ngenyanga ngemva kokwamukela izimali kuze kube sekuqedile iminyaka emihlanu, ngaphandle uma izimali zikhishwa umnikazi ngaphambi kokuphela kwalolo suku. Umuntu obhaliswe efundini angafaka isicelo semali yokuphila efundini yeziqinisekiso. UMsunguli weNkantolo Ephakeme unelungelo lokukhokha yonke intshisakalo nezimali zifika ku-R100,000 ezimalini eziqoqiwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokuphila ezifana nezimali zesikole, imfundo ephakeme, izingubo, izindleko zezokwelapha, indawo yokuhlala esikoleni, nezinye izidingo ezichazwe esicelweni. Ukuphila kungacelwa ngumuntu ophethe ingane/umgibeli/umlandeli noma othile ophatha i-akhawunti yomuntu obhaliswe, kwenziwa ngokufaka isicelo usebenzisa ifomu J341 kanye nezinkokhelo nezitifiketi zedebhithi. Minyaka yonke ngoMeyi, uMsunguli weNkantolo Ephakeme uyakhangisa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni izimali ezingakafunwa ngabanikazi bazo. Izimali zingakhokhwa ngqo kumphakeli wesevisi, njengesikole, isikhungo semfundo ephakeme, isitolo sezincwadi, njll. Ingane engakwazi ukuzimela ingafaka isicelo sezimali ezitshalwe kanye nentshisakalo ethathwe uma ifika eminyakeni evumela ukuzimela, okuyiminyaka engu-21, umshado, noma umyalo wenkantolo owenza ukuba izimela. Nokho, umuntu obhala isivumelwano angachaza eminyakeni ethile lapho umlandeli enelungelo lokwamukela izimali zezakhamuzi. Izimali zingacelwa ngumuntu obhaliswe kwi-akhawunti uma uthole imvume yesicelo esibhaliwe kusebenzisa ifomu J251, elandela ikhophi yokukhomba/umbhalo wokuhamba/isitifiketi somshado noma umyalo wenkantolo oqinisekisiwe. Labo abanamalungelo entshisakalo bangathola intshisakalo eyandisiwe ekupheleni konyaka, ngemuva kukaMashi 31. Isicelo sezinzuzo sibhaliwe, kanti umceli uthola umthelela oholela ezizalweni noma imvelaphi yezithelo ezidliwayo (intshisakalo). Umnikazi we-akhawunti angafaka isicelo sezimali ezitshalwe uma enelungelo lokwenza kanjalo (ngokuvamile ngemuva kokufa komuntu oshiya impahla) ngokufaka isicelo esibhaliwe kusebenzisa ifomu J251 kanye nekhophi eqinisekisiwe yokukhomba noma umbhalo wokuhamba. Imali ikhokhwa kanjani? Imali/intshisakalo noma ukugcina ikhokhwa ngecheque ebhalwe egameni lomuntu ofanele. Le cheque ibhalwe ngolayini ukuvimbela ukudluliselwa komunye umuntu. Ngezinye izikhathi, imali ifakwa kwi-akhawunti yasebhange yomuntu ofanele. Kwenzekani ngemali uma ingafunwa ngesikhathi? Ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu yezimali ezingakafunwa, uMsunguli weNkantolo Ephakeme udlulisa lezi zimali ezingakafunwa kwiFund yeMali. Lokhu akusho ukuthi umnikazi ulahlekelwa ilungelo lokufuna lezi zimali kwiFundo yeZingane. Nokho, ekupheleni kweminyaka engamashumi amathathu, lezi zimali ezingakafunwa ziya kuhlinzekwa kuhulumeni. Minyaka yonke ngoMeyi, uMsunguli weNkantolo Ephakeme uyakhangisa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni izimali ezingakafunwa.
I-Fund ye-Competitiveness (CF) iyisikhwama sokwabelana ngezindleko esinikeza usizo lwezezimali ukuze kusekelwe osomabhizinisi abasungula amabhizinisi ukuze bafinyelele ku-50% yezindleko zabo. Osomabhizinisi abafanelekayo kumele bakhiqize imikhiqizo noma banikeze izinsizakalo kumabhizinisi anezici noma iziqu ezithile. Ukukhuthaza ngokwezimali amabhizinisi ukuba athuthukise izinga lawo lokusebenza, kanye nokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokwazi zangaphandle kanye namakhono. Ukuthuthukisa izinkampani (ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphatha noma lokuphathwa, ukuthola amazinga ajwayelekile), ukuqeqesha ukuze kwakhiwe amazinga okuncintisana. Ukwandisa izinsizakalo ze-NGOs, izinhlangano zamabhizinisi, nezimboni ezizama ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zezigaba/izimboni ezithile. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-grant ukuze kufinyelelwe ezingeni eliphezulu le-R600,000 emkhakheni nasemkhakheni ofanele. Ukusiza izimboni ukufinyelela amazinga aphezulu okuncintisana emakethe yangaphandle emkhakheni wemakethe yasekhaya nasezimakethe zokuthumela.
Ngiyacela/Ngiyavuma ukuthi ukhokhe inzuzo yami uma siphumelele ohlelweni lokufaka isicelo kule akhawunti yasebhange elandelayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukudluliswa kwemali okuvunyelwe lapha kwenziwa ngohlelo lwekhompyutha olwaziwa njenge-ACB, futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi akukho ulwazi lokukhokha olunikezwa ebhange lami kodwa ulwazi lokukhokha luzobhalwa esitatimendeni sebanga lami. (lokhu akusebenzi uma ibhange lingajwayele ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi noma izitatimende zebhange, njengokwesibonelo, i-akhawunti yokonga noma uhlobo olufanayo). Le mvume ingakhanselwa ngami ngokunika isaziso esibhalwe phansi sezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu. Qaphela: Ubufakazi obubhalwe phansi be-akhawunti yasebhange (njengokwesibonelo, isitatimende sebanga, iphepha elivela kwi-ATM, i-cheque ekhishiwe) kumele kuhlanganiswe. Igama lomnikazi we-akhawunti... Ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olukhululiwe ngenhla lungamanga kulolu suku futhi lugcwele ngazo zonke izindlela futhi uMphakathi Wokuhlinzeka Ngemali Yokungasebenzi akabandakanyeki kunoma yiziphi ukukhokha okungalungile okungavela ngenxa yolwazi olungaphelele noma olungalungile olunikezwe ngami. Unyaka wezezimali odlule ubungunyaka onzima kakhulu kuBhodi ekhona njengoba bekudingeka ukuthi baqedele izakhiwo nemigomo futhi babeke isisekelo seBhodi entsha ukuze ithathe izintambo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Le bekuyiqembu elisebenze iminyaka emihlanu, iPANSALB, kusukela ngoMsombuluko 24, 1996, kuze kube nguMsombuluko 25, 2001. Le mbiko ibonisa izenzakalo ezenzeke unyaka wezezimali odlule mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuphakanyiswa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezimiso zolimi ezweni. Le bekuyonyaka obalulekile kubalungu beBhodi njengoba bekungunyaka wabo wokugcina ezikhundleni zabo. Ibhodi igxile kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi zonke izinqubo, imigomo, nezakhiwo zizosekela iPANSALB ekufezeni izinhloso zayo. Iqedile ukusungulwa kweKomidi Yolimi Lwezifunda kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye, Imibutho Yolimi Kazwelonke, kanye Nezikhungo Zolimi Kazwelonke. Kulindeleke ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izogcina izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihloswe kubasebenzi kanye neBhodi Yabaphathi abazobamba iqhaza ezikhungweni zolimi kazwelonke. Amakomidi Olimi Kazwelonke kanye namalungu eZikhungo Zolimi Kazwelonke kufanele anikezwe iziqondiso eziphelele mayelana nokusebenza kwale mibutho futhi imisebenzi yabo kufanele yenziwe ngokuhambisana nezinqubo zemigomo ezibekiwe. Imibutho yokweluleka izosiza kokubili iBhodi kanye nezishayamthetho zezifunda ekutholeni ulwazi mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nolimi emiphakathini emelelwe yile mibutho. Le Bhodi ekhona iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi iziqondiso zihlala zifakwa kuzo zonke izigaba zokugxila ukuze kusekelwe iPANSALB emsebenzini wayo ophakanyisiwe. Imisebenzi eyenziwe unyaka wezezimali odlule, kuhlanganise nocwaningo nemikhankaso yokuthuthukisa, izosiza iPANSALB ukuqhubeka nokuhlola izinqubo zayo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuphakanyiswa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphansi kwezimiso zocwaningo zolimi mayelana "nokusetshenziswa nobudlelwano bezilimi eNingizimu Afrika," kusizile iBhodi ukuba iqonde kangcono isimo solimi futhi ihlanganise kahle iziqondiso nezinqubo zemigomo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kolimi nokubhekwa. Idokhumenti ejwayelekile yokuhola yashicilelwa ukusiza izikhungo ekuqhubekeni kokuthuthukisa imigomo yolimi. Ucwaningo oluxhaswe ngezimali ngalokhu, kanye nocwaningo oluqhubekayo, luzoba usizo eqenjini elisha njengoba lihlola izinqubo zeBhodi ukwenza izincomo ezihloswe kuhulumeni kanye nezikhungo zawo mayelana nemigomo yolimi. Nakuba bekungelula ukusungula ubudlelwano bokubambisana phakathi kweBhodi kanye neHhovisi likaNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo ngenkathi sisekhona, sithemba ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalolo budlelwano. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yocwaningo nemikhankaso eyaxhaswa ngaphansi kwezilimi mayelana nemfundo eminyakeni emihlanu edlule iyabelwana nalabo abaphakathi kwezikhundla zemfundo ezingeni lesizwe nasezifundeni. Kungenzeka ukuthi kuqhutshwe imikhankaso ezokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yolimi emfundweni ingasebenza ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindaphinda nokuphindaphinda kwendaba eyodwa ethinta umnotho, kanye nokukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemibutho. Mayelana nokuphakanyiswa kobuchwepheshe ekuhumusheni nasekuqondiseni, iPANSALB iphumelele ekukhiqizeni idokhumenti ezosetshenziswa ekubhaleni umthetho ozoba yisisekelo semigomo yobuchwepheshe. Lokhu sekuphakanyisiwe kuNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi, kanye neTekhnoloji ukuze kuqhubeke nalesi sici somthetho. Ibhodi entsha izodinga ukubambisana nomzimba ozosungulwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe inhlonipho yalolu shishino. Inselelo enkulu iPANSALB ebhekene nayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi ezake zaba nezehlakalo ezinzima, ikakhulukazi izilimi eziyisishiyagalolunye ezisemthethweni, zithuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzovumela lezi zilimi ukuthi zisebenze njengezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ukusungulwa kweZikhungo Zolimi kuyisinyathelo esisodwa salokho. Ezinye izindlela ezithathwe yiBhodi zifaka ukuqeqeshwa kwababhali be-TV, iradiyo, nevidiyo kulezi zilimi, kanye nokuxazulula izinqubo ezizosheshisa ukusakazwa kwezincwadi zendawo. Lokhu kuyisigaba esisodwa okufanele sigxile kuso ukuze kusekelwe izinqubo ezizosiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakanyiseni lezi zilimi, kanye nabanye ozakwethu abathintekayo ezinhlelweni ezifana nalezi. Ibhodi iphinde yenza uphenyo ngezikhalazo eziningi ezethulwe phambi kwayo. Ngeshwa, le msebenzi isadinga ukuhlela ukuze isetshenziswe kahle ukusiza ekuqapheleni izilimi nokukhuthaza izikhungo ukuba zithuthukise nezimiso zazo zolimi ezizokwazi ukubhekana nezimo ezingalingani zomlando. Kuyafunwa yiPANSALB ukubona abakhuluma izilimi zendawo bephila amalungelo abo olimi. Izinqubomgomo zokwenza ukuthi Amakomidi Olimi Lwezifunda aphakanyise ukuqwashisa ngezizilimi phakathi kwabakhuluma izilimi ezake zaphathwa kabi ziyaqhubeka. Impumelelo yayo izobonakala eminyakeni ezayo futhi izokwakhiwa, uma kudingeka, ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo. I-PANSALB iphinde yabambisana nemibutho ehlukahlukene ukuze ifinyelele impumelelo. Ubudlelwano obakhe nemibutho efana neNhlangano Yezobuciko Kazwelonke, iNhlangano Yezithombe Nevidiyo Kazwelonke, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi kukahulumeni kufanele bukhuliswe. Umsebenzi onikezwe iBhodi ungaphathwa kuphela yiBhodi; kufanele ibambisane neminye imibutho esebenzela izinhloso ezifanayo neBhodi. Le Bhodi ekhona izibophezele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nemibutho efana neSABC, abakhiqizi, kanye nezinye imibutho ezizimele. Nokho, sikhuthaza leli qembu elisha ukuthi liqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano bokubambisana nemibutho yalo. Ukuba nabasebenzi abaneziqu, isipiliyoni sokubambisana nokuxhumana kuzosisiza ukufezekisa le njongo. Ekuphetheni, ngiyabonga kuMphakathi Ohloniphekile uNkk. Zubeida Desai, bonke balungu beBhodi, uMphathi Omkhulu, uProfesa Cynthia Marivate, kanye nabasebenzi bakhe ngomsebenzi ophakeme abawenzayo kanye nokuzinikela kwabo ekuthuthukiseni izilimi nezilimi zendawo eNingizimu Afrika.
I-SARS iqukethe inani elikhulu lolwazi eliqoqwa ngesikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi wayo wansuku zonke wokuhlanganisa imali yentela kahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nezintela zebhizinisi ezisiza ekuqhubekeni kwalezi zikhangiso. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile kubantu abathintekayo ngqo, abangabakhokhi bentela, abathengisi, ababambiqhaza ebhizinisini, noma abasebenzi. Kubalulekile futhi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, kubaphikisi bebhizinisi, kubameli, nakubathengisi ngenhloso yokuthengisa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke inzuzo zibikwa ku-SARS ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi, umthetho we-SARS ophathelene nokuvikeleka kolwazi oluqoqwe yi-SARS uqinisekisa ukuthi lonke ulwazi mayelana nabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi luyimfihlo futhi alunakukhululwa ngaphandle kwezimo ezithile eziphoqelelayo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("umthetho") uqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kulolu lwazi, uhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuvikeleka kwalo ngokomthetho, ngaphandle kokuthi kube kumuntu onelungelo lokuluthola noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukuze athole lolwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ubhekana nokuvikeleka okuhlobene nokudluliswa kwebhizinisi le-SARS lapho lokhu kungase kube kubalulekile. Lezi ziqephu ezilandelayo zichaza i-SARS, izinqubo zokucela ulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti olwazi lwe-SARS, futhi, uma kudingeka, izinqubo zangaphakathi zokufaka izikhalazo ngaphansi komthetho. I-SARS yenze kube lula ukuphatha izicelo nezikhalazo emahhovisi ayo amakhulu ukuze kube lula ukulandela nokuphendula ngesikhathi njengoba kudingeka umthetho, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezingase zenzeke ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambisana nesiko le-SARS lokukhanya, njengoba kudingeka umthetho, kanye nokuhambisana kwe-SARS nezimiso zokubophela, ubuqotho, nokwethembeka kulabo abahlanganyela ne-SARS. UKomishana weNhlangano yezeMali yaseNingizimu Afrika nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali, uMnu. Pravin Gordhan. Ngaphansi kwakhe, kukhona abaphathiswa abane abaphatha izicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi olukhona ku-SARS njengoba kudingeka umthetho nsuku zonke. Omunye nomunye uMphathiswa unikezwa indawo ethile yokusebenza ngokuya ngolwazi lwabo kanye nesipiliyoni somsebenzi, futhi banikezwa le ndawo yokusebenza ngokuya ngolwazi lwabo nesipiliyoni. Uma ufuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi olukhona ku-SARS, kufanele ugcwalise ifomu lesicelo elitholakala kuSheduli 1 bese ulithumela kumphathiswa ofanele. Abaphathiswa basebenzisa ihhovisi elifanayo kanye nekheli leposi. Umpathiswa ofanele uzophendula phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 (izinsuku eziyi-60 kwezinye izimo) ukuze akwazise ukuthi isicelo sakho siye savunywa noma siye saphikiswa. Kwezinye izimo, ungase udinge ukukhokha imali ku-SARS ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe noma ufinyelele kumarekhodi owacelile. Uma ukuphathwa kwesicelo sakho kuthatha isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora ayisithupha, i-SARS izoqhubeka nokulungisa ulwazi oluceliwe ngemuva kokukhokha imali edingekayo. Isicelo sakho sizothunyelwa kuwe ngendlela oyicelile noma ngendlela ulwazi olugcinwe ngayo kumadokhumenti, uma kungekho ndlela ethile oyicelile. Lokhu kuyiphephandaba lokuqala lokwakhiwa komthetho we-SARS. Kuzothuthuka njengoba i-SARS nabaceli bolwazi behlola ukusebenza kahle kokusebenzisa lo mthetho, kanye nokulinganisa phakathi kwes right to access information and other rights protected by the Act, such as privacy, and the need to keep the State functioning effectively. Imigomo ngaphansi komthetho, amanothi achazayo, nokuningi. Ulwazi lokuxhumana nezikhulu zomnyango. Ulwazi olutholakala ngaphandle kwesicelo. Ukuqedela ifomu lesicelo. Ukwenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho. UKomishana weMihla Yezakhamuzi. ukuqoqa izintela; nokulawula ukufika kwezimpahla ezweni, ezithunyelwa ngaphandle kwezwe, ezikhiqizwayo, ezithwalwayo, ezigcinwayo, nezisetshenziswayo ezimpahleni ezithile ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo. Umthetho ophatha ukuqoqa izintela uma kudluliswa ubunikazi beMali ka-1949 noma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophakanyisiwe, isaziso sikahulumeni, noma umyalo ophume ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla noma yimuphi umvumelwano owenziwe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho noma uMthethosisekelo noma yimuphi umthetho ophathelene nokuhlawulwa kwentela noma ophatha ukukhululwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile ezingase zidluliselwe ku-SARS noma umvumelwano phakathi kwe-SARS nenhlangano kahulumeni noma igunya elihlobene (njengokuhlawulwa kwentela ngaphandle kokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinkokhelo ze-insurance yokungasebenzi). nakho konke okuhlobene nezintela; namandla anikezwa uNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla; nokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni mayelana nazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokulawula ukukhululwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile. Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuqoqa izintela ukuze kukhule izinzuzo ezibonakalayo, kusiza ukuhweba futhi kwandise abakhokhi bentela ngokuhlanganisa abakhokhi bentela abasha ezincwadini ngokukhuthaza ukuqwashisa ngentela ukuze abantu bazi futhi babhekane nesibopho sabo sokuxhasa lo mnyango nemithetho yentela nezohwebo yaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphezulu olungahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Nakuba i-SARS inomsebenzi wokubhala imithetho yentela, iyakwenza lokhu ngaphansi kokubhekwa nokuphathwa kukaNgqongqoshe wezeMali, futhi kwesinye isikhathi uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Ngakho-ke, amadokhumenti akhishwe uMnyango WezeMali kahulumeni kanye noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ngokuhambisana nalomthetho kufanele abhekwe mayelana nendima yomphakathi ekwakhiweni kwemigomo. Ngokwesimo nokuqina komthetho ophakanyisiwe, kungase kuqale ngokukhishwa kwedokhumenti yokuxoxisana echaza inqubo okufanele ilandelwe futhi imema umphakathi ukuba uphinde uphakamise umqondo. Njengoba iPhalamende njengamanje ingenamandla okwenza izinguquko kuMthethosisekelo WezeMali uma usukhululiwe, kuqaliswe uhlelo lokukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba uphakamise imibono futhi abambe iqhaza engxoxweni ngaphambi kokuba kuvezwe. Le nqubo iqala ngokukhishwa kwe-SARS kwesakhiwo somthetho ezinsukwini eziyishumi zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuhlangana kweKomidi lePhalamende. Kokubili i-SARS neKomidi lePhalamende baphinde bamema imibono yomphakathi ngesakhiwo somthetho, okungaqhutshelwa ngokuhanjiswa kwemibhalo ebhaliwe noma izingxoxo ezibukhoma. Uma umphakathi usukhulumiwe ngalesi, izingxoxo neKomidi lePhalamende ziba khona lapho imibono iboniswa. Ekupheleni kwalezi zingxoxo, i-SARS neMali Kazwelonke kulungiselela idokhumenti yokuphendula kulezi zingxoxo
Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imigomo yokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi abanelungelo lokuthola izinzuzo zokuhamba ngesikhathi belindele umsebenzi bakwazi ukuzifinyelela. Iqondiswe ngokuya ngomsebenzi othile owenziwayo, hhayi ngokuya ngesikhundla noma usayizi. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuxazulula izindleko ezibhekene nabasebenzi uma bengaseduze nezindawo zabo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile. Ukukhokhelwa okufanele kunikezwa ngumnyango uma abasebenzi bekhaya emsebenzini, okuzothokozisa nomnyango. Kuvele ukuthi lezi zinzuzo zifana kubasebenzi bazo zonke izigaba ngaphakathi komnyango. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhamba kunikezwa kuphela kubasebenzi abaphakathi kwezimo ezivumela ukuba bakwenze, futhi ukuthi kuzobasiza ngokungabi khona emsebenzini. Izinhlelo ziye zenziwa ngezikhathi zokuhlola, ukuya ezikoleni, ukuthuthwa ukusuka lapho umuntu ehlala khona, ucwaningo, nezemidlalo, uma umuntu engumamele abasebenzi ezinkulumweni, uma umuntu eya participating emkhandlwini wezamasipala, nokunye. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula izibopho zomnyango uma kudluliswa umsebenzi ukusuka endaweni eyodwa ukuya kwenye. Umnyango uzokhokhela izindleko zokuthutha, kungakhathaliseki izinga noma isikhundla. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula umhlahlandlela wokukhokhela abasebenzi abahambiswayo ukuze kuzuze umnyango, kanye nalabo abasebenzi abakhishwe emsebenzini, noma labo abashonile. Kugcizelelwa lapha ukuthi kuphela abasebenzi abaphakathi kwezindima ezithile bazosebenzisa lezi zinhlinzeko. Kucaciswe ukuthi yonke imisebenzi izothola izinzuzo ezifanele kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga noma ubulili. Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula imigomo nezinhlinzeko mayelana nokuphela komsebenzi womuntu emnyangweni. Inhloso yale mthetho ukuvula uhlelo oluzoba nolungile nolucacile kubo bonke abasebenzi emnyangweni. Ngokufanayo, noma iyiphi indlela yokucwasa eyenzekile esikhathini esedlule kufanele ikhawulwe. Ukugxila kukhulu emsebenzini othile okumele wenziwe ezingeni elithile lohlelo lomsebenzi. Ukukhokhelwa kuzohambelana nemholo yabasebenzi, futhi ukukhokha akwenziwe ngamahora. Ukukhokhelwa kwe-ovetime kulawulwa ukutholakala kwezinsiza zezimali. Ukukhokhelwa kwe-ovetime akufanele kudlule u-30% wemholo yabasebenzi. Lo mthetho uhlole ukuthi umuntu kufanele enze ini mayelana nomsebenzi, bese ucabangela isikhundla sabo. Bonke abasebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi babhale izivumelwano zabo ezihlobene nokuphathwa komsebenzi wabo nezicwangciso ezizosebenza lapho kuhlolwa ukusebenza kwabo. Lo mthetho unikeza uhlaka oluphatha umsebenzi kanye nezinga lalo ngendlela yokubambisana, futhi ubeka nezilindelo kubantu mayelana nomsebenzi wabo. Ekupheleni, umthetho ophatha izinga lomsebenzi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi amakhono abantu asetshenziswa ngokuphelele futhi ezinye izinsiza zithinte kahle imiphumela yomsebenzi, okuyisizathu sokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuguqula eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nezihlahla. Le mthetho ihlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphathi bahambisana nohlelo lokuguqulwa komsebenzi futhi iphinde ibheke ukuthi iziphambeko kumagugu omthetho ziphathwa kanjani. Iphinde inikeze uhlaka lokuhlola uma kukhona iziphambeko futhi ibeke umthetho. Ikhuthaza futhi iphakamisa ukuveza kahle nokuvuleka, futhi ukuze abasebenzi babambe iqhaza ukuze baqinise ubudlelwano bokwethembana, ukubambisana, nokwethembeka kubaphathi, kanye nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nezinhlelo zabasebenzi ezizoba isisekelo salolu hlelo. Ukususwa kwezinyathelo zokucwasa ezihlobene nobuhlanga, ubulili, nezinye izinto... Abasebenzi abanecebo lokuhlola umsebenzi kufanele bazi ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi ngesikhathi sokuhlola umsebenzi wabo, kungaholela ekuthuthukisweni kwesimo sabo, futhi kungenzeka futhi ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwabo kungancishiswa. Lapho kudingeka ukunciphisa isikhundla somsebenzi, kufanele kwenziwe imizamo yokuvimbela lokho ngokwenza izinguquko ezithile kulowo msebenzi. Izinqubo zokuhweba kufanele ziqinisekise ukuhamba kahle, ukungacwasi, nokufinyelela emathubeni, kanye nokuba nesigaba esisebenzela umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Zonke izikhala kufanele zivuleke kubo bonke abafakizicelo, kungakhathaliseki ubuhlanga, ubulili, inkolo, ubuzwe, izinkolelo zezombusazwe, isiko, ubudala, ulimi, ukukhubazeka, isimo sokushadile, nezinye izimo ezihlukahlukene. Izikhangiso kufanele zicacise kahle ukuthi iSikhungo Sezikhungo Sikamasipala sizibophezele ekungacwaseni emsebenzini, ekuvumelaneni kwabasebenzi, nokuthi izicelo ezivela ezindaweni ezithile zomphakathi ezake zaba phansi zikhuthazwa. Izimiso ezisetshenziselwa ukukhetha abasebenzi kufanele zibe neqiniso futhi zihlobene nezidingo zomsebenzi futhi kufanele zisetshenziswe ngokufanele ngaso sonke isikhathi. Inqubo yokuhweba izohlanganisa wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nalabo abavela ezindaweni eziphansi nezizinda, futhi ngenkathi belemukelwa ukuthi bafake izicelo zomsebenzi, akufanele bacwaswe futhi kufanele baphathwe ngendlela efanele nengxenye. Uma umuntu engenayo imfundo edingekayo, iziqu, noma amakhono olimi, noma ufunde ngaphezu kwezidingo zomsebenzi, noma usebenze isikhathi eside, zonke lezi zinto ezingahlangene nomsebenzi akufanele zibe izizathu zokukhetha umuntu ophuma emphakathini owake waba phansi, futhi ngenxa yalokho, amathuba abantu abavela ezindaweni eziphansi akufanele ancishiswe.
Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemiphakathini. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemakhaya kuphathwa kakhulu ngamaKhosi noma abaholi bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaKhosi nabaphathi futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulukazi ngezenzo zomthetho wendabuko. Ngaphansi kweSigaba 211 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wendabuko uyavunywa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho ezihambisana nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wendabuko njengoba kwenzeke ngaphambi kokuba kuqaliswe umthethosisekelo omusha, kodwa lo mthetho kufanele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona kanye nomthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhiwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yeSigaba 16 seSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo, eyenza ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neNkantolo Yendabuko ezazikhona ekuqaleni komthethosisekelo ziqhubeke nokusebenza futhi zisebenzise amandla azo omthetho njengoba kunikezwe. Ukusebenza kwalezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ifaka phakathi ethile eyakhiwe ngaphambi komthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezazikhona kanye nezigodi. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yangaphambilini eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngokubika komthetho, uMongameli wezwe udlulisele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuhambisana neSigaba 14 seSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo. Bheka: Umbiko ngeNkantolo Yendabuko & Imisebenzi Yezobulungiswa Yabaphathi Bendabuko: osuku lwe-21 kuJanuwari 2003: iSA Law Commission ikhasi 1. Umkhawulo wamandla ungachazwa njengamandla nokwaziswa kwenkantolo yokuzwa udaba nokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Graafreinet Municipality v Van Ryneveld's Pass Irrigation Board 1950 SA 420 (A). Ngakho-ke, umkhawulo wamandla usinika ulwazi ngamandla nemikhawulo enikezwe enkantolo. Isinqumo esikhishwe endabeni lapho inkantolo ingenawo umkhawulo sithathwa njengokungasebenzi. Uma sibheka umthetho okhona, imiqondo yomkhawulo ivela ezinhlelweni nasezithile zemithetho. Le mithetho ivela kumthetho ojwayelekile kodwa ingase ibhalwe njengezibopho. Isibonelo sokubhalwa kwalezi zinto umthetho wezinkantolo zamasipala. Lo mthetho ungumthombo wemithetho eminingi ehlobene nomkhawulo. Ngokuhambisana nalomthetho ukuze inkantolo ibe nomkhawulo, kufanele ikwazi ukukhipha imiyalo nokwenza izinqumo: Eckards 17. Inkantolo kufanele ibe nomkhawulo phezu komuntu wephikiso kanye nezimpahla zabo. Umqondo wemikhawulo uhambisana nomgomo wokusebenza ngendlela efanelekile. Umkhawulo wenkantolo uhambisana nomkhawulo wokusebenza. Bheka Polak 2. Umkhawulo wenkantolo uhambisana nendawo ethile noma indawo echaziwe. Le misho ibonisa ngqo ukuthi umphikisi ulandela indawo lapho umphikiswa ekhona. Uma umphikisi efuna ukuvula icala, umphikisi kufanele alivule enkantolo enomkhawulo phezu komphikisi kanye nezimpahla zabo. Kuvame ukuba yinkantolo yendawo lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, hhayi lapho umphikisi ehlala khona. Nokho, kunezimo ezahlukene ngaphansi kwalomthetho: ngokwesibonelo; inkantolo inemkhawulo ngoba umphumela wesenzo wenzeka ngaphakathi kwendawo elawulwa leyo nkantolo. Mayelana neSigaba 28(d) seMagistrates' Courts Act No. 32 ka-1944, lesi sigaba sikhombisa ukuthi ukuze le nkantolo ibe nomkhawulo, umphumela wesenzo kufanele uvele ngokuphelele ngaphakathi kwendawo enikezwe le nkantolo. Ngenxa yemithetho yokuncintisana, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkantolo ezimbili zibe nomkhawulo phezu kwendaba eyodwa. Njengoba umphikisi enelungelo lokulawula icala, bangakhetha inkantolo ezoyizwa indaba yabo. Ngokuvamile, umphikisi ukhetha inkantolo ehambelana nabo kungakhathaliseki ukuthi isimo sifanele kangakanani kumphikisi. Umkhawulo unqunywa ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, hhayi ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha leyo miyalo. Uma inkantolo idlula umkhawulo wayo, isebenza ngaphezu kwamandla ayo kuze kube icala liphothuliwe. Standard Credit Corporation Ltd v Bester and Others 1987 SA 812 (W) ku-819. Uma inkantolo yayinomkhawulo ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo noma ngesikhathi inkantolo iqala icala, ushintsho ezimweni aluzoshintshi umkhawulo wenkantolo. Ngokwesibonelo: inkantolo inemkhawulo ngoba ngesikhathi umphikisi enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo bephila ngaphakathi komkhawulo wayo, iqhubeka nokuba nomkhawulo phezu kwendaba noma ngabe emva kokunikeza imiyalo, umphikisi akasahlali endaweni yenkantolo. Le ndawo ihambisana nomkhawulo wenkantolo. Umsebenzi wazo zonke iziphathimandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inkantolo yayo inemkhawulo yokuzwa indaba ethulwa phambi kwayo. Lokhu kusebenza ikakhulukazi mayelana nezimo ezithile zohlobo lwenkambo kanye nenani elithintekayo. Kufanele kube sobala ukuthi ngokwezakhamuzi zendabuko, kusekhona umgomo okhona ophathelene nenani lemali. Ngisho nasekutheni kungekho umkhawulo wemali, iLaw Commission mayelana Nezisebenzi Zomthetho Wendabuko yenze izincomo zokuqala zamagugu azosiza ukucacisa nokuthuthukisa isimo somthetho wendabuko. Uma umphikisi evela phambi kwenkantolo engenawo amandla okuphikisa icala lakhe futhi engakwenzi ukuphikisa ngaphambi kwenkantolo, inkantolo izoba namandla okuzwa indaba. Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuba alawulwe yimithetho yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) seMagistrates' Courts Act No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kulungisiwe. Nokho, uma umphikisi engenalo ummeli, isiphathimandla esiphethe sinesibopho sokubuza ngokwabo (mero mutu) mayelana namandla omkhawulo okuphikisa indaba kule nkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli kumphikisi, isiphathimandla senkantolo ngeke sibuze ngokwabo mayelana namandla omkhawulo wenkantolo okuphikisa icala. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi inkantolo ingenawo amandla okuphikisa icala, umuntu owafaka kufanele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ilungile ukuphikisa icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weLaw Commission ngeNkantolo Yendabuko, ikhasi 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokukhuluma ukuthi inkantolo ayinayo ilungelo lokuphikisa icala ingabavusa ukuba baveze ubufakazi bokuthi kungani bekwenza njalo. Umqondo womkhawulo uhambisana nokuhlukaniswa kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa amandla nemigomo yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lomkhawulo nemikhawulo, inkantolo yomthetho ihlala njengenkantolo yokuqala noma njengenkantolo yokuphikisa. Inkantolo yeMthethosisekelo iyinkantolo ephezulu ezweni mayelana nezindaba zomthethosisekelo. In
Lo mbhalo awuhloselwe ukuba ube yidokhumenti ebanzi engathathwa njengomthombo wolwazi kodwa usebenza njengesinsiza sokuhola ochwepheshe abasebenza emshadweni nasekuhlukaniseni ifa emthethweni wamasiko. Ngenxa yemithetho ehlukumezayo, emishadweni ethile yabantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika, ayizange ibonwe noma yaphuma emhlabeni ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Umthetho omusha okukhulunywa ngawo kulo mbhalo ulethe izinguquko ezibalulekile kumasiko njengoba sizobona ebhalweni. Ngokufanayo, indlela yokuphathwa kwezimpahla zabantu abamnyama abashonile ngaphandle kokukhetha abathathi-ndaba yayiphikisana kakhulu nemthethosisekelo, ngakho-ke izigameko ezedlule zaphusha uMnyango Wezobulungiswa ukuba aguqule imithetho ukuze ihambisane neMthethosisekelo. Kungasho futhi ukuthi umthetho omusha okukhulunywa ngawo kulo mbhalo awuhambisani namasiko abantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika kodwa asihlosile ukuhlela lokhu kulokhu kuxoxwa. Uzoba yijaji. Ngaphambi kokugxila kakhulu ekuxoxweni kweMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko (owaziwa lapha njengomthetho), kubalulekile ukuveza umfanekiso obanzi wesimo somthetho esithinta imishado yamasiko "nemaqembu endabuko" aqediwe ngaphambi kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000, (lolu suku lapho lo mthetho uqala khona). Nokho, ukufakwa kwezimpahla kwaphumelela kuphela lapho indoda ishada omunye ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sendabuko, ehlukile emshadweni wezempi. Ngomhla ka-1 kuNovemba 1984, umthetho wokushada uMthetho 88 ka-1984 washicilelwa, phakathi kwezinye izinto, wakhansela amandla okushada anikezwa indoda phezu kwenkosikazi lapho beshadile ngaphansi komthetho wezempi. Lesi sinqumo saholela ekutheni kusukela ngomhla ka-1 kuNovemba 1984, amandla okushada anikezwa indoda mayelana nenkosikazi yakhe akhishwe esigabeni esikhanselwe 22. Ngoba labo abashadwe ngaphansi kwemishado yamasiko bangenakubhekwa njengabashadile ngokomthetho, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi omunye wabo ngaphansi kwalolo shado angabopha umshado wezempi nomunye umuntu. Umthelela walomshado wezempi waholela ekupheleni kwemishado yamasiko ekhona. bheka uNkambula v Linda 1951 1 SA 377 A noMalaza v Mndaweni 1975 BAC C 45. Inkosikazi ngaphansi kwalomshado wamasiko yayibhekwa njengenkosikazi enganakiwe. Inkosikazi yalolo shado lwamasiko ingashada nomunye umuntu ngaphansi komshado wezempi, ngaleyo ndlela umshado wamasiko ekhona waba sephumile. Umbuzo wokuthi "lo mqondo" uvuselelwa yini uMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko 120 ka-1998 isigaba 2, lo mbuzo kumele unqunywe yizinkantolo. Nokho, isigaba 22 seMthetho Wokuphatha kwabantu abamnyama 38 ka-1927 sinikeza imizamo yokuvikela umndeni onganakiwe uma indoda ifa. Ngokwenzela ukuphawula ngababheki, isimo sokuba yindodakazi kanye nezingane zomshado wezempi kusebenza ngokufana nalabo bomshado wamasiko. Kucacile ukuthi isimo esingcono esinikezwa enkosikazi eshadwe ngaphansi komthetho wezempi nezingane zayo sesiphumelele futhi zibhukwa ngokufana nenkosikazi nezingane ezinganakiwe. Ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushintsha Umshado 3 ka-1988 owawuqala ngomhla ka-2 kuZibandlela 1988, uMthetho Wokuphatha kwabantu abamnyama ka-1927 waguqulwa. Umthetho weshintsho ulethe lezi zinguquko ezilandelayo. Umthelela wokukhansela lesi sigaba wawuholela ekutheni yonke imishado eNingizimu Afrika ibe nefana futhi uMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwempahla Yabantu Abashadile 88 ka-1984 wawusebenza emishadweni yabantu abamnyama aqediwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-2 kuZibandlela 1988. Imishado eyenzeka ngemuva kosuku lwe-2 kuZibandlela 1988 ixuba izimpahla ngaphandle kokuthi kube nesivumelwano sokuhlukanisa izimpahla futhi ibhaliswe ehhovisi lemidlalelo ezinyangeni ezintathu ngaphambi komshado. Isici esisha nesibalulekile ukuthi "umshado wamasiko" awukwazi ukuxoshwa ngomyalo wezempi. Isigaba 221 sivimbela indoda eshadwe ngaphansi komthetho wamasiko ukuthi izibophezele emshadweni wezempi nenkosikazi ngesikhathi isashadile ngaphansi komthetho wamasiko. bheka uThembisile v Thembisile 2002 2 SA 209 T noKwitshane v Magalela 1999 4 SA 610 TK. Ngeshwa, akukho ukulungiswa okunikezwa kwesimo lapho umshado wezempi uvela ngemuva komshado wamasiko. Kwamukelwa ukuthi umshado wezempi onjalo awunamsebenzi. Isigaba 3 seMthetho Wokushada Kwendabuko 120 ka-1998 sivimbela omunye wababheki abakhona emshadweni wamasiko obonwa ngokomthetho ukuthi ashade ngokomthetho ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushada 25 ka-1961. Umqondo ofanayo njengoba kuxoxiwe esigabeni 2.3.2, futhi lapha akukho ukulungiswa okunikezwa kokwephula lo mthetho. UMthetho Wokushada eTranskei 21 ka-1978 uvumela indoda eshadwe ngaphansi komshado wezempi ukuthi ithathe futhi ngaphansi komshado wamasiko, inqobo nje uma umshado wamasiko ungafaki izimpahla. Ngokufanayo, indoda eshadwe ngaphansi komshado wamasiko ingashada futhi ngaphansi komshado wezempi, ngaphandle kokuxosha umshado wamasiko, inqobo nje uma umshado wezempi ungafaki izimpahla. Lo mthetho uqale ukusebenza ngomhla ka-15 kuNovemba 2000 futhi uthathile isinyathelo esibalulekile sokwamukela yonke imishado yamasiko ebhekwa ngokomthetho. Lo mthetho unomthelela wokubuyisela emuva futhi uzoxoxwa isigaba ngesigaba. Lo mthetho usebenza kuzo zonke imishado yamasiko eqediwe ngaphansi kohlelo lomthetho wamasiko, amasiko, nezindlela zendabuko ezihloniphekile ngabantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika futhi uyiqembu elingxenye yesiko labo. Ngakho-ke, kucacile ukuthi lo mthetho usebenza kubantu abathile, usebenza kuphela kubantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika, inqobo nje uma umshado wenziwa ngendlela ebekiwe ngamasiko noma ngezinhlelo zabantu bendabuko baseNingizimu Afrika. Imishado yabantu ababili noma imishado yepholigami eyenziwa ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000. Imishado eqediwe ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 kuNovemba 2000 kumele ihambisane nezidingo zomthetho. Izidingo ezibekiwe kulo mthetho ziqinile futhi ukungahambisani kuholela emshadweni ongenamsebenzi. Bobabili ababheki kumele babe nesifiso sokushada ngaphansi komthetho wamasiko. Akekho phakathi kwabashadile okufanele abe yingxenye yomshado wamasiko omunye. Kumele kube nezinkulumo ngomshado futhi zenziwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho wamasiko. Ukuze umshado wamasiko ube semthethweni, ngaphandle kwezidingo ezichazwe ngenhla, kumele kube nesivumelwano esinikezwa esigabeni 7 (ukuxoxwa okuphelele, bheka isigaba 5.2.2). Isigaba 4 seMthetho sikhombisa
Lena ucwaningo olujwayelekile mayelana nendlela isiko lokufundisa amalungelo abantu likhule ngayo eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokusekelwe kumadokhumenti omhlaba kanye nezivumelwano zendawo, umlando wamalungelo abantu uvela ezindaweni ezikude neziseduze. Ngaphandle kwezindaba eziphathelene nokufundisa okugcizelelwe yilesi simo sokuthi umqondo wamalandawo abantu ungumqondo osanda kwenziwa uphumelele lapha eNingizimu Afrika, le ngxenye ihlose ukuhlaziya izivumelwano zomhlaba, zendawo, nezwe. Ubulungiswa obubhekene nabantu ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili buholele ekwenzeni isinqumo seZizwe Ezihlangene sokuzibophezela ngokomphakathi ekuhlonipheni nasekuvikeleni amalungelo abantu. Lesi sinyathelo saqala ngo-1946 lapho iZizwe Ezihlangene yasungula iSitatimende Sokuhlonipha Amalungelo Abantu. ENingizimu Afrika, njengelungu lezwe, ibambe iqhaza elikhulu kulesi sitatimende ngoba uMongameli wezwe, uJan Smuts, wabhala lesi sitatimende. Ezinye zezindima zesitatimende ziqinisa ukuthi iZizwe Ezihlangene "kufanele ihloniphe amalungelo abantu nezikhala ezisemqoka kubo bonke ngaphandle kokuhlukanisa ngokobuhlanga, ngocansi, ngolimi, noma ngenkolo." I-athikili 56 ifuna ukuthi wonke amazwe amalungu ahambisane nalesi sivumelwano. Nokho, kwaba sobala ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika yaqhubeka nokwephula amalungelo abantu. Nakuba iZizwe Ezihlangene yayigcizelela njalo isinqumo sokuthi intshisekelo yabantu ibheke ekupheleni kokucwaswa ngokobuhlanga, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika waqhubeka nezinhlelo eziphula amalungelo abantu. Lo mbono uveza i-athikili 2.7 yesitatimende, evimbela iSishayamthetho sokuphepha ekungeneleleni "ezindabeni zangaphakathi" ezazisetshenziswe kabi ukuze kuzuzwe izinhloso zokwephula amalungelo abantu. Ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga eNingizimu Afrika kubonakala kuphikisana nezibopho zesitatimende, ngakho-ke ngo-1982, iZizwe Ezihlangene yanquma ukusola iNingizimu Afrika. I-athikili 2.7 yadala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwamalungelo abantu nezibopho ezilindelwe kumazwe amalungu ngoba le ngxenye yaqhubeka nokukhuluma ukuthi akukho okukhona kulesi sitatimende okuzovumela iZizwe Ezihlangene ukuthi ingenele ezindabeni ezisemqoka zangaphakathi ezweni elikwazi ukuziphatha kahle noma ezizodinga amazwe amalungu ukuthi kulethwe izindaba zokuxoxwa ngaphansi kwesitatimende, futhi le ndlela ngeke ibangele ukuphazamiseka kokusebenza kwemishini yokulungisa nokuphatha ngaphakathi, ngokwezinganekwane zeNgxenye VII. Naphezu kwezinkinga, lesi sitatimende sibe nendima ebalulekile ekukhuthazeni nasekuhleleni amazinga nemigomo yamalungelo abantu emhlabeni jikelele. Isibonelo salokhu yizikhungo eziningi ezasungulwa ngaphansi kwemibono yeZizwe Ezihlangene ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezibopho zesitatimende. Lezi zifiso zafika ngendlela yezitatimende noma imihlangano. Izitatimende zemihlangano zawela emgqeni obanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvuma kwezivumelwano. Isitatimende sokuqala samukelwa ngo-1948, esaziwa ngokuthi iSitatimende Sokuhlonipha Amalungelo Abantu. Leli dokhumenti laqala lamukelwa amazwe angama-48 ezweni elinamalungu angama-56 ngoba ama-8 axhumene neNingizimu Afrika, eyayiphika. Nokho, leli dokhumenti lamukelwa yizikhungo eziningi ngaphakathi kwamazwe nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukubaluleka kwesitatimende kubonisa ukusebenza okukhulu kwesitatimende seZizwe Ezihlangene. Le mbono iboniswa embikweni wezindaba ophumelele kakhulu otholakala ehhovisi leMisebenzi Yezomthetho lapho kuthiwa, "mayelana nomoya nokubaluleka kwesitatimende, kungabonakala njengesenzo esinethonya ezikhungweni ezamukelayo, ngakho-ke kukhona izinkomba eziqinile zokuthi amazwe amalungu azohlonipha." Ngakho-ke, uma okukhulunywa ngakho kuholela ekwephuleni okwenziwa ngamaZwe, lesi sitatimende singakhombisa isimo sokwakha nokuphatha imithetho ebophelelayo kumazwe." Ukukhuthaza ukuvuma kwamalungelo abantu emhlabeni wonke kuvamile kumthetho weZivumelwano Zomhlaba Ngamazwe Ngamalungelo Okwabelana Nezombusazwe kanye neZivumelwano Zomhlaba Ngamazwe Ngamalungelo Okwabelana Nezomnotho, Ezokuxhumana Nezamasiko ngenhloso ecacile yokuguqula isitatimende esingabopheleli sibe yizimiso zomthetho ezibophelelayo, lezi zivumelwano zibizwa ngokuthi "Amandla Abantu Emhlabeni Wonke." Amandla Abantu Emhlabeni Wonke aqala ukusebenza eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1962. Enye indlela yokuvikela amalungelo abantu yakhuthazwa ngokwethulwa kwezivumelwano zendawo ezifana neSivumelwano saseYurophu ngo-1950 esihloselwe ukuvikela amalungelo abantu nezikhala zomuntu. ISivumelwano saseYurophu saqala ukusebenza eNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwamalungelo abantu eBophuthatswana kodwa lo mbono waphulwa nguhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika owayenamandla okulawula ohulumeni bezifunda. Engxoxweni edlule, kubonakala ukuthi isiko lamalungelo abantu bekufanele likhule ngokulandela izinhlinzeko zeSitatimende seZizwe Ezihlangene. Isibonelo; I-athikili 56 ithi amalungu abophekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokubambisana ndawonye nangokwehlukana nenhlangano mayelana nokufeza izinhloso ezibekwe nguMthetho 55. E-Ningizimu Afrika, ukuthuthukiswa kwamalungelo abantu kwavinjwa inqubo yokucindezela, ngakho-ke iZizwe Ezihlangene yaqala ukuwa empumelelweni yayo yokukhuthaza izinguquko kumthetho wobuhlanga kuze kube yathumela izijeziso ngo-1982. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isiko lamalungelo abantu langena e-Afrika lapho iMibutho ye-African Unity yasungula iSivumelwano sase-Afrika ngo-1961. Nakuba inqubo ibihamba kancane iminyaka engama-20, ngaphakathi komgomo wokuqala wokwamukela isivumelwano ngo-1981 njengeSivumelwano saseBanjul, lokhu kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwamukeleni umkhankaso wamalandawo abantu e-Afrika. Into eyaziwayo kakhulu ngesivumelwano kwakuwukwamukelwa "kwamalungelo abantu" njengokukhombisa ukuzibophezela ekukhuthazeni umqondo wamalandawo abantu. Lezi zikhumbuzo ziqiniswa ngesiqalo esikhombisa ukuzibophezela okwenziwe ngamalungu "ukuzibophezela ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu base-Afrika." Lezi zikhumbuzo zaba inselelo enkulu eNingizimu Afrika ngoba kwakungekho ukuzibophezela ekwamukeleni nasekuvikeleni amalungelo abantu. Inkinga ibihlobene nokuhlanganisa amalungelo abantu anikezwa yiSivumelwano sase-Afrika kanye namalungelo umuntu afuna ngazo izivumelwano zamazwe. Ngakho-ke, kwaba sobala ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika idinga ukubambisana ekwamukeleni amalungelo abantu ngaphambi kokuqala kweSivumelwano sase-Afrika lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Le nselelo yakhuphuka kwelinye izinga ngamaAdvocate weMibutho Yamalungelo Abantu asungulwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1979. Inhloso eyinhloko yalesi sikhungo wukugcina nokuqinisa amalungelo abantu ngokuh
Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemazweni abo. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kuphathwa kakhulu ngamaKhothama noma Abaholi Bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaNkosi nabakhulumeli, futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulu ngokuqhuba imikhuba yokwenziwa kwemithetho. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 211 seMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wesiko uyavunywa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho ezihambisana nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wesiko njengokwakunjalo ngaphambi kokwethulwa kwemithethosisekelo emisha, kodwa lo mthetho kumele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona kanye nemthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhiwe ngaphansi kwento 16 yeSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo, ethula ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neKhothama eyayikhona ngesikhathi sokwethulwa kwemthethosisekelo ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza futhi zisebenzise amandla azo omthetho njengoba kunikezwe. Ukusebenza kwalezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ixhumene nezinye ezaziphumelele ngaphambi kwemthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezazizimele. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yomlando eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngomlayezo wezomthetho, uMongameli wezwe udlulisele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuhambisana nento 14 yeSheduli 6 yeMthethosisekelo. Bheka: Umbiko obizwa ngokuthi "Umbiko NgamaKhothama & Imisebenzi Yezobulungiswa Yabakhulumeli Bendabuko" odwetshwe ngomhla kaJanuwari 21, 2003: IKomidi Lezomthetho laseNingizimu Afrika ekhasini 1. Ukuncipha kwamandla kungachazwa njengamandla nokwaziswa kwenkantolo yokulalela icala nokwenza isinqumo phakathi kwezinsizwa ezithintekayo. Graafreinet Municipality v Van Ryneveld's Pass Irrigation Board 1950 SA 420 (A). Ngakho-ke, ukuncipha kwamandla kusitshela ngamandla nemikhawulo enikezwe enkantolo. Isinqumo esikhishwe kwicala lapho inkantolo ingenamandla sithathwa njengokungasebenzi. Uma sihlola umthetho okhona, imiqondo yokuncipha kwamandla ivela kokubili emikhubeni yesiko nasemithethweni eminingi. Le mithetho ivela kumthetho ojwayelekile kodwa ingase yenziwe njengomthetho. Isibonelo sokwenziwa kwale mithetho nguMthetho WamaKhothama Wasekhaya. Lo mthetho ungumthombo wemithetho eminingi ephathelene nokuncipha kwamandla. Ngokuvumelana nalomthetho ukuze inkantolo ibe namandla, kumele ikwazi ukukhipha imiyalo nokwenza izinqumo: Eckards 17. Inkantolo kumele ibe namandla phezu komuntu odefendwa kanye nezimpahla zabo. Umqondo wokuncipha ubandakanya umgomo wokusebenza ngendlela efanelekile. Ukuncipha kwamandla kuhambisana nomngcele wokusebenza. Bheka Polak 2. Ukuncipha kwamandla enkantolo kuhambisana nendawo ethile noma indawo echaziwe. Le misho ibonisa ngqo ukuthi umphakeli ulandela indawo lapho umphikisi ekhona. Uma umphikisi efuna ukuvula icala, umphakeli kumele alivule enkantolo enegunya phezu komphikisi kanye nezimpahla zabo. Kuvamile ukuba inkantolo yasendaweni lapho umphikisi ehlala khona, hhayi lapho umphakeli ehlala khona. Nokho, kunezimo ezihlukene ngaphansi kwalomthetho: isibonelo; inkantolo inegunya ngoba umthombo wenkinga uvele endaweni elawulwa leyo nkantolo. Mayelana nesigaba 28(d) soMthetho WamaKhothama Wasekhaya No. 32 ka-1944, lesi sigaba sithi ukuze le nkantolo ibe namandla okusebenza, umthombo wenkinga kumele uvele ngokuphelele endaweni elawulwa le nkantolo. Ngenxa yemithetho yokuncintisana kwamandla, kungenzeka ukuthi izinkantolo ezimbili zibe namandla phezu kwendaba efanayo. Njengoba umphakeli enelungelo lokulawula icala, angakhetha inkantolo ezolalela udaba lwakhe. Ngokuvamile, umphakeli ukhetha inkantolo ehambelana naye ngaphandle kokucabangela ukuthi isimo sikhona yini esifanele umphikisi. Amandla okulawula enziwa ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, hhayi ngesikhathi inkantolo ikhipha imiyalo. Uma inkantolo idlula amandla ayo, ingase iphumelele icala ngokuphelele. Standard Credit Corporation Ltd v Bester and Others 1987 SA 812 (W) ekhasini 819. Uma inkantolo yayinokuncipha kwamandla ngesikhathi umuntu enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo noma ngesikhathi inkantolo iqala icala, ushintsho ezimweni ngeke luguqule ukuncipha kwamandla enkantolo. Isibonelo: inkantolo inegunya lokulawula ngoba ngesikhathi umphikisi enikezwa imiyalo yenkantolo, wayehlala ngaphakathi kwendawo yayo yokulawula, iyaqhubeka nokuba namandla phezu kwendaba noma ngabe emva kokukhipha imiyalo, umphikisi akasekho endaweni yenkantolo. Indawo ephathelene nokuncipha kwamandla. Inkantolo inegunya lokulalela udaba olukhulunywa phambi kwayo. Lokhu kuqondene kakhulu nezimo ezithile zohlobo lwenkinga kanye nenani elithintekayo. Kumele kube sobala ukuthi ngokwezimali zendabuko, akukabi khona umgomo othile ophatha inani lemali. Noma ngabe akekho umgomo ophathelene nenani lemali, iKomidi Lezomthetho mayelana Nezomthetho Zendabuko lenza iziphakamiso zokuqala zemigomo ezizosiza ukucacisa nokuthuthukisa isimo seMithetho Yendabuko. Uma umphikisi evela phambi kwenkantolo ngaphandle kwamandla okukhuluma udaba lwakhe futhi engakwenzi ukungafuni ukuba abhekane phambi kwenkantolo, inkantolo izoba namandla okulalela udaba. Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuba alawulwe yimigomo yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) soMthetho WamaKhothama Wasekhaya No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kulungisiwe.
