Nokho, uma umphikisi engenalo ummeli, umphakathi ophakeme unomsebenzi wokubuza ngokwakhe (mero mutu) mayelana namandla okukhuluma udaba kule nkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli womphikisi, umphakathi ophakeme wenkantolo ngeke ubuze ngokwakhe mayelana namandla enkantolo okukhuluma icala. Uma kwenzeka udaba lokuthi inkantolo ingenamandla okukhuluma icala, umuntu owafakile kumele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ifanele ukukhuluma icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weKomidi Lezomthetho ngamaKhothama, ekhasini 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokukhuluma ukuthi inkantolo ayinamalungelo okukhuluma icala ingabaphoqa ukuba banikeze ubufakazi mayelana nokuthi kungani besho kanjalo. Umqondo wokuncipha kwamandla uphinde ubandakanye ukuhlela kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa ngamandla nemithetho yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lamandla okulawula nokuncipha, inkantolo yomthetho
Ithuba lezingane liphethwe ngaphansi kohlelo oluphathwa nguMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme. Lokhu kuyifundo edalwe ukuze ibambe futhi iphathise izimali ezikhokhelwe kuMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme zabantu abaziwayo noma abangaziwayo, ngokwesibonelo; izingane nabantu abangakwazi ukuphatha izinto zabo, abalandeli abangakazalwa, abantu abalahlekile, noma labo abangahlanganyeli ezindabeni zomhlaba, izinzuzo, noma ezihlobene. Lapho ithola noma yiziphi izimali, uMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme uvula ifundo kumarekhodi ezimali zabantu abaqokwe egameni lomnikazi wombuso kanye nomnikazi waleyo mali. Uma kungaziwa ukuthi izimali zikhona kubani, ifundo ivulwa egameni lomuntu owayilethe noma egameni lombuso ochazwe lapho, kuye ngemicimbi. Imali ebambekile efundweni ibhujiswa kwiKomidi Lezokutshalwa Kwezimali, elihlolwa umhloli ozimele minyaka yonke. Inzalo ikhokhwa ngemali efakwe efundweni, eyenzelwe izingane ezingakwazi ukuzimela, labo abangakwazi ukuphatha izinto zabo, abalandeli abangakazalwa, kanye nabantu abahlanganyela ezimalini, ukuze kusetshenziswe emhlabeni, ezimali ezishiwo kubo, nezinsizakalo ezihlobene. Inzalo ibalwa njalo ngenyanga ngokuya ngesilinganiso esibekwe sonyaka, ngezinga elibuyekezwa njalo nguNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Inzalo ikhokhwa kanye ngonyaka ekupheleni kukaMashi 31 konyaka wezomnotho. Inzalo iyanda ngenyanga ngemva kokuthola izimali kuze kube sekwedlule eminyakeni emihlanu, ngaphandle uma izimali zikhishwa umnikazi ngaphambi kokuphela kwaleso sikhathi. Umuntu obhaliswe efundweni angafaka isicelo semali yokunakekela efundweni. U-Mphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme unelungelo lokukhokha yonke inzalo nezimali kuze kufike ku-R100,000 ezimalini ezihlanganisiwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokunakekela ezifana nezimali zesikole nemfundo ephakeme, izingubo, izindleko zezokwelapha, indawo yokuhlala esikoleni, nezinye izidingo ezichazwe esicelweni. Ukunakekela kungacelwa umuntu ophethe ingane/umgibeli/ukulondoloza noma othile ophatha i-akhawunti yomuntu obhaliswe, kwenziwa ngokufaka isicelo usebenzisa ifomu J341 kanye nezinkokhelo kanye nobufakazi bezikweletu. Minyaka yonke ngo-April, uMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme umemezela kuGazethi Yombuso izimali ezingakafakwa. Izimali zingakhokhwa ngqo kumhlinzeki wesevisi, njengesikole, isikhungo semfundo ephakeme, isitolo sebhuku, njll. Izingane ezingakwazi ukuzimela zingafaka isicelo sezimali ezitshalwe kanye nezinsalo ezikhulile uma seziphumelele eminyakeni evumela ukuzimela, okuyiminyaka engu-21, umshado, noma umyalo wenkantolo owenza zibe nezimela. Nokho, umuntu obhala isivumelwano angachaza eminyakeni ethile lapho umlandeli enelungelo lokuthola izimali zomhlaba. Izimali zingacelwa ngumuntu obhaliswe ku-akhawunti uma kuvunyelwe ngesicelo esibhaliwe se-form J251, esihambisana kopi yokuhlonza/ithokheni lokuhamba/isitifiketi somshado noma umyalo wenkantolo oqinisekisiwe. Labo abanamalungelo enzalo bangathola inzalo eyandile ekupheleni konyaka, ngemuva kukaMashi 31. Isicelo sokwenza inzuzo sibhaliwe, kanti umceli sikhuluma ngempempe eholela ezizalweni noma imvelaphi yemivini edliwayo (inzalo). Umnikazi we-akhawunti angafaka isicelo sezimali ezitshalwe uma enelungelo lokwenza kanjalo (ngokuvamile ngemuva kokushona komuntu oshiya umhlaba) ngokufaka isicelo esibhaliwe se-form J251 kanye nekhophi eqinisekisiwe yokuhlonza noma ithokheni lokuhamba. Imali ikhokhwa kanjani? Imali/inzalo noma ukunakekelwa ikhokhwa ngecheque ebhalwe egameni lomuntu ofanele. Le cheque idwetshwe ngocingo ukuvimbela ukudluliselwa komunye umuntu. Ngamanye amahlandla, imali ifakwa ku-akhawunti yasebhange yomuntu ofanele. Kwenzekani uma imali ingafakwa ngesikhathi? Ngemuva kweminyaka emihlanu yezimali ezingakafakwa, uMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme udlulisa lezi zimali ezingakafakwa kuMali Yezimali. Lokhu akusho ukuthi umnikazi ulahlekelwa ilungelo lokufaka isicelo sezimali kuFundo Lezingane. Nokho, ekupheleni kweminyaka engamashumi amathathu, izimali ezingakafakwa ziya kwelinye izwe. Minyaka yonke ngo-April, uMphathiswa weNkantolo Ephakeme umemezela kuGazethi Yombuso izimali ezingakafakwa.
I-Fund ye-Competitiveness (CF) iyigxathu yokwabelana ngezindleko ehlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali ukuze kusekelwe osomabhizinisi abasungula amabhizinisi ukufinyelela ku-50% wezindleko zabo. Osomabhizinisi abafanelekile kumele bakhiqize imikhiqizo noma banikeze izinsizakalo kumabhizinisi anezici ezithile noma iziqu. Ukukhuthaza ngokwezimali amabhizinisi ukuba athuthukise amazinga awo okusebenza, kanye nokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokwazi zangaphandle nezifundo. Ukuthuthukisa izinkampani (ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphatha noma lokuphathwa, ukuthola amazinga ajwayelekile), ukuqeqesha ukuze kwakhiwe amazinga okuncintisana. Ukwandisa izinsizakalo ze-NGOs, izinhlangano zamabhizinisi, nezimboni ezizama ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zezigaba/izimboni ezithile. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-grant ukuze kufinyelelwe ezingeni eliphezulu le-R600,000 emkhakheni nasemkhakheni ofanele. Ukusiza izimboni ukuthi zifeze amazinga aphezulu okuncintisana emakethe zangaphandle emkhakheni wemakethe yasekhaya nasemakethe yokuthumela ngaphandle.
Ngicela/Ngivumela ukuthi ukhokhe inzuzo yami uma siphumelele esicelweni sokuhambisa imali kule akhawunti yasebhange elandelayo. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukudluliswa kwemali okukhishwe lapha kwenziwa ngohlelo lwekhompyutha olwaziwa ngokuthi i-ACB, futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi akukho ulwazi lokukhokha olunikezwa ebhange lami kodwa ulwazi lokukhokha luzobhalwa embikweni wami wasebhange. (lokhu akusebenzi uma ibhange lingajwayele ukuhlinzeka ngemicimbi noma imibiko yasebhange, ngokwesibonelo, i-akhawunti yokonga noma uhlobo olufanayo). Le mvume ingakhanselwa ngami ngokunika isaziso esibhaliwe sezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu. Qaphela: Ubufakazi obubhaliwe be-akhawunti yasebhange (ngokwesibonelo, umbiko wesikhwama, iphepha elivela kwi-ATM, i-check ekhishwe) kumele kuhlanganiswe. Igama lomnikazi we-akhawunti... Ngiyavuma ukuthi ulwazi olukhululiwe ngenhla luyiqiniso kuleli sikhathi futhi lugcwele ngazo zonke izindlela futhi uMphathiswa we-Inshurensi Yokungasebenzi akabhekiwe nganoma yiziphi ukukhokha okungalungile okungavela ngenxa yolwazi olungaphelele noma olungaqondile olunikezwe ngami. Ulwazi olukhululiwe: (Igama lomsebenzi webhange)...
Unyaka wezimali odlule bekuyinyanga enzima kakhulu kuBhodi ekhona njengoba bekudingeka baqedele izakhiwo nemigomo futhi babeke isisekelo seBhodi entsha ukuze ithathe izintambo ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Le bekuyiqembu elisebenze iminyaka emihlanu, iPANSALB, kusukela ngoMsombuluko 24, 1996, kuze kube uMsombuluko 25, 2001. Le mibiko ibonisa izenzakalo ezenzeke unyaka wezimali odlule mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuphakanyiswa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nomgomo wezilimi ezweni. Le bekuyinyanga ebalulekile kubabhalisi beBhodi njengoba bekuyonyaka wabo wokugcina ezikhundleni zabo. Ibhodi igxile kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi zonke izinqubo, imigomo, nezakhiwo zizosekela iPANSALB ekufezeni izinhloso zayo. Iqedele ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lezilimi ZaseMaphandleni kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye, Imibhalo Yezilimi Zesizwe, kanye Nezikhungo Zokubhala Ngemibhalo Yezilimi Zesizwe. Kulindeleke ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izogcina izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ezihloselwe abasebenzi kanye neBhodi Yabaqondisi abazobamba iqhaza ezikhungweni zokubhala ngolimi lwezizwe. Imikhosi Yezilimi Zesizwe kanye namalungu ezikhungo zokubhala ngolimi lwezizwe kufanele anikezwe imihlahlandlela ebanzi mayelana nokusebenza kwalezi zikhungo futhi ukusebenza kwazo kufanele kwenziwe ngokuhambisana nezinqubo zemigomo ezisunguliwe. Imibhalo yokweluleka izosiza kokubili iBhodi kanye nezishayamthetho zendawo ekutholeni ulwazi mayelana nezindaba ezihlobene nezilimi emiphakathini emelelwe lezi zikhungo. Le Bhodi ekhona iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi imihlahlandlela emkhakheni ngamunye igxilwe ukuze isekele iPANSALB emsebenzini wayo ophakanyisiwe. Imisebenzi eyenziwe unyaka wezimali odlule, kuhlanganise nocwaningo nemikhankaso yokuthuthukiswa, izosiza iPANSALB ukuqhubeka nokuhlola isu layo mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuphakanyiswa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphansi komgomo ocwaningweni lwezilimi mayelana "nokusetshenziswa nokuxhumana kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika," kusize iBhodi ukuba iqonde kangcono isimo sezilimi futhi iqinise imihlahlandlela nezinqubo zemigomo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi nokubheka. Idokhumenti ejwayelekile yemihlahlandlela yashicilelwa ukusiza izikhungo ekuthuthukiseni imigomo yezilimi. Ucwaningo oluxhaswe ngezimali ngalokhu, kanye nocwaningo oluqhubekayo, luzoba usizo eqenjini elisha njengoba lihlola izinhlelo zeBhodi ukuze lenze izincomo ezihloselwe uhulumeni kanye nezikhungo zawo mayelana nemigomo yezilimi. Nakuba bekungelula ukusungula ubudlelwano bokubambisana phakathi kweBhodi kanye neHhovisi likaNgqongqoshe weMfundo ngenkathi sisenkathini, sithemba ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izokwazi ukwakha lelo budlelwano. Lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yocwaningo nemikhankaso eyaxhaswa ngaphansi kwezilimi mayelana nemfundo eminyakeni emihlanu edlule iyabelwana nalabo abasezikhundleni zemfundo ezingeni likazwelonke nasezifundazweni. Kungenzeka ukwethula imikhankaso engaphumelela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imigomo yezilimi emfundweni ingasebenza ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindaphinda nokuqhubeka kwendaba eyodwa ethinta umnotho, kanye nokukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinhlaka. Mayelana nokuphakanyiswa kobuchwepheshe ekuguquleni nasekuhumusheni, iPANSALB iphumelele ekukhiqizeni idokhumenti ezosetshenziswa ekubhaleni umthetho ozoba umgomo wezobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi, kanye nobuchwepheshe ukuze kuqhubeke nalesi sici somthetho. Ibhodi entsha izodinga ukubambisana nomzimba ozosungulwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlonishwa kwalolu suku. Inselelo enkulu iPANSALB ebhekene nayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi ezake zaba nezehlakalo zomlando, ikakhulukazi izilimi eziyisishiyagalolunye ezisemthethweni, ziyaqhubeka zithuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzovumela lezi zilimi ukuba zisebenze njengezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ukusungulwa kweZikhungo Zokubhala Ngemibhalo Yezilimi kuyisinyathelo esisodwa. Ezinye izindlela ezithathwe yiBhodi zifaka ukuqeqesha ababhali bethelevishini, umsakazo, kanye nevidiyo kulezi zilimi, kanye nokuxazulula izinhlelo ezizosheshisa ukuhlinzeka ngencwadi yamasiko. Lokhu kuyisigaba esisodwa okufanele sigxilwe kuso ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo ezizosiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakanyiseni lezi zilimi, kanye nabanye abalingani abathintekayo ezinhlelweni ezifana nalezi. Ibhodi iphinde yenze uphenyo ngezikhalazo eziningi ezethulwe phambi kwayo. Ngeshwa, le misebenzi isadinga ukuthuthukiswa ukuze isetshenziswe kahle ukusiza ekubhekeni izilimi nokukhuthaza izikhungo ukuba ziqhubeke zithuthukisa imigomo yazo yezilimi ezizokwazi ukubhekana nezimbangi zomlando. Kuyinjongo yePANSALB ukubona abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu bephila amalungelo abo ezilimi. Isu lokuqinisekisa ukuthi amaKomidi Ezilimi ZaseMaphandleni aphakanyisa ukuqwashisa ngezilimi phakathi kwabakhuluma izilimi ezake zaba ngaphansi kwengcindezi liyasetshenziswa. Impumelelo yalo izobonakala eminyakeni ezayo futhi izokwakhiwa, uma kudingeka, ukuze kuthuthukiswe isimo. I-PANSALB iphinde yabambisana nezikhungo ezahlukene ukuze ifinyelele empumelelweni. Ubudlelwano obakhe nezikhungo ezifana neNhlangano Yezobuciko Yezwe, iNhlangano Yezithombe Nevidiyo Yezwe, kanye nezinhlangano ezizimele kufanele bukhuliswe. Umsebenzi owenziwe kuBhodi ungaphathwa kuphela yiBhodi; kufanele ibambisane nezinye izikhungo ezisebenza ngokuqondile kumigomo efana neBhodi. Le Bhodi ekhona izibophezele ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle nezikhungo ezifana neSABC, abashicileli, kanye nezinye izikhungo ezizimele. Nokho, sikhuthaza leli qembu elisha ukuba liqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano bokubambisana nezikhungo zazo. Ukuba nabasebenzi abanele, ulwazi lokubambisana nokuxhumana kuzosisiza ekufezeni le njongo. Ekuphetheni, ngiyabonga uMphakathi Okwesibili uNkk. Zubeida Desai, bonke ababhalisi beBhodi, uMphathi Omkhulu, uProfesa Cynthia Marivate, kanye nabasebenzi bakhe ngomsebenzi ophezulu abawenzayo nokuzinikela kwabo ekuthuthukiseni izilimi nezilimi zomdabu eNingizimu Afrika.
I-SARS iqukethe inani elikhulu lolwazi eliqoqa ngesikhathi ikwenza imisebenzi yayo yansuku zonke yokuhlanganisa imali yentela kahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nemali yentela yebhizinisi esiza ekuqhubekeni kwalezi zinhlelo. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile kubantu abathintekayo ngqo, okungabandakanya abakhokhi bentela, abathengisi, ababambiqhaza ebhizinisini, noma abasebenzi. Kubalulekile futhi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, abancintisana ngebhizinisi, abameli, kanye nabathengisi ngenjongo yokuthengisa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amaholo abika ku-SARS ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi, umthetho we-SARS ophathelene nokufihla ulwazi oluqoqwe yi-SARS uqinisekisa ukuthi lonke ulwazi ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi lufihliwe futhi alunakukhululwa ngaphandle kwezimo ezithile eziphoqelelwayo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("umthetho") uqinisekisa ukufihla kulolu lwazi, unikeza ukugcina kwalo njengolwazi olufihliwe ngokomthetho, ngaphandle komuntu onelungelo lokuluthola noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukuthola lolu lwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ubhekana nokufihla okuhlobene nokudluliselwa kwebhizinisi le-SARS lapho lokhu kungase kudingeke. Lezi ziqephu ezilandelayo zichaza i-SARS, izinqubo zokucela ulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti olwazi lwe-SARS, futhi, uma kudingeka, izinqubo zangaphakathi zokufaka izikhalazo ngaphansi komthetho. I-SARS yenze kube lula ukucubungula izicelo nezikhalazo emahhovisi ayo amakhulu ukuze kube lula ukulandela nokuphendula ngesikhathi njengoba kudingeka umthetho, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nezinguquko ezingase zenzeke ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambisana nesiko le-SARS lokuvuleka, njengoba kudingeka umthetho, kanye nokuhlonipha kwe-SARS izimiso zokubopheleka, ubuqotho, nokwethembeka kulabo i-SARS ibambisana nabo. Umkomishana weNkonzo yeZimali yaseNingizimu Afrika nguNgqongqoshe wezeMali, uMnu. Pravin Gordhan. Ngaphansi kwakhe, kukhona abaphathiswa abane abaphatha izicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe yi-SARS njengoba kudingeka umthetho nsuku zonke. Omunye nomunye uMphathiswa unikezwa indawo ethile yokusebenza kuye ngolwazi lwabo kanye nesipiliyoni somsebenzi, futhi banikezwa le ndawo yokusebenza ngokusekelwe kulwazi lwabo nesipiliyoni. Uma ufuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe yi-SARS, kufanele uqedele ifomu lesicelo elitholakala kuSheduli 1 bese ulithumela kumphathiswa ofanele. Abaphathiswa basebenzisa ihhovisi elilodwa kanye nekheli leposi. Umphathiswa ofanele uzophendula phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 (ezinsukwini eziyi-60 kwezinye izimo) ukuze akwazise ukuthi isicelo sakho sivunyelwe noma sitholakale. Kwezinye izimo, ungase udinge ukukhokha imali ku-SARS ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe noma uthole amarekhodi owacelile. Uma ukucubungula isicelo sakho kuthatha isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora ayisithupha, i-SARS izoqhubeka nokulungiselela ulwazi oluceliwe ngemuva kokukhokha imali edingekayo. Isicelo sakho sizothunyelwa kuwe ngendlela oyicelile noma ngendlela ulwazi olugcinwe kumadokhumenti, uma kungekho indlela ethile oyicelile. Lokhu kungukukhishwa kokuqala kwemibhalo yokuphumelelisa umthetho we-SARS. Kuzothuthuka njengoba i-SARS nabaceli bolwazi behlola ukusebenza kahle kwalesi sikhathi, kanye nokulinganisa phakathi kwes право sokufinyelela ulwazi nezinye izimfanelo ezivikelwe umthetho, njengokufihla, kanye nesidingo sokugcina uHulumeni usebenza kahle. Imithetho ngaphansi komthetho, amanothi achazayo, nokunye. Ulwazi lokuxhumana nabaphathi bezigaba. Ulwazi olutholakala ngaphandle kwesicelo. Ukuqedela ifomu lesicelo. Ukwenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho. Umkomishana weMihla Yezakhamizi. Ukuhlanganisa intela; kanye nokulawula ukungena kwemikhiqizo ezweni, ethunyelwa ezweni, ekhiqizwa, ethunyelwa, igcinwa, futhi isetshenziswa emikhiqizweni ethile ngendlela efanele futhi esebenzayo. Umthetho ophatha ukuhlanganiswa kwentela lapho kudluliswa ubunikazi bemikhiqizo ka-1949 noma yimuphi omunye umthetho ophakanyisiwe, isaziso sikahulumeni, noma umyalo owakhishwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho engenhla noma yisiphi isivumelwano esenziwe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho noma uMthethosisekelo noma yimuphi umthetho ophathelene nokuhlanganiswa kwentela noma ophatha ukukhululwa nokungeniswa kwemikhiqizo ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo, ukuthuthwa, ukugcina, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemikhiqizo ethile engase idluliselwe kwi-SARS noma isivumelwano phakathi kwe-SARS kanye nesikhungo sikahulumeni noma igunya elifanele (njengokuhlanganiswa kwentela ngaphandle kokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinkokhelo zokuqashwa okungasebenzi). kanye nazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nentela; kanye namandla anikezwa uNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nemithetho engenhla; kanye nokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha mayelana nazo zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokulawula ukukhululwa nokungeniswa kwemikhiqizo ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo, ukuthuthwa, ukugcina, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemikhiqizo ethile. Inhloso yayo ukuthi intela eqoqwe ikhiqize izinzuzo ezibonakalayo, isiza ukuhweba futhi ikhulise abakhokhi bentela ngokuhlanganisa abakhokhi bentela abasha ezincwadini ngokukhuthaza ukuqwashisa ngentela ukuze abantu bazi futhi babhekane nesibopho sabo sokuxhasa le ndawo kanye nemithetho yentela kanye nezohwebo yaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakeme olungenza izidingo zomphakathi. Nakuba i-SARS inomsebenzi wokubhala imithetho yentela, iyakwenza lokhu ngaphansi kokubhekelelwa kanye nenqubomgomo kaNgqongqoshe Wezomnotho, futhi kwesinye isikhathi uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha. Ngakho-ke, amadokhumenti akhishwa uMnyango WezeMali kahulumeni kanye noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezokwakha ngokuhambisana nalomthetho kufanele abhekelelwe mayelana nendima yomphakathi ekwakhiweni kwemigomo. Ngokwezimo nezinga lokuphazamiseka komthetho ophakanyisiwe, kungase kuqale ngokukhishwa kwemibhalo yokuxoxisana echaza inqubo okufanele ilandelwe futhi imema umphakathi ukuba uphinde uphonsa itshe emfuleni ngokuphendula. Njengoba iPhalamende njengamanje ingenamandla okushintsha iBhili LezeMali uma selikhishwe, uhlelo luqale ukwakhiwa ukuze kukhuthazwe umphakathi ukuba uphendule futhi uthinteke engxoxweni ngaphambi kokuba kube sekukhishweni. Le nqubo iqala ngokukhishwa kwe-SARS kwesakhiwo somthetho ezinsukwini eziyishumi zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuhlangana kweKomidi Lephalamende. Bobabili i-SARS kanye namakomidi ephalamende bese bamenza umphakathi ukuba abeke imibono ngesakhiwo somthetho, okungaqhutshelwa ngokuhanjiswa kwemibhalo ebhaliwe noma izingxoxo eziqondile. Uma umphakathi usukhulumiwe ngalokhu, izingxoxo namakomidi ephalamende zenzeka lapho imibono iboniswa. Ekupheleni kwalezi zingxoxo, i-SARS kanye neSikhungo Sezomnotho
Umthethosisekelo weRiphabliki yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi oluphathwa Hulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi oluphathwa omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zakhe, futhi umthetho wesizwe kumele uthathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu kulungelo. Umgibeli Wolwazi wasungulwa ukuze unikeze iseluleko kwiOfisi Yolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso ezenziwe nguMphakathi Wolwazi mayelana nezicelo zolwazi futhi usize iOfisi Yolwazi kanye nezikhungo ezifanele mayelana nokucubungula izikhalazo. AmaKhomidi Okubonisana Ngolwazi amancane (IAASC's) nawo asungulwa ukuze anikeze iseluleko kuMphakathi Wolwazi mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. IOfisi Yolwazi yeMnyango Wezokuvikela yasungulwa njengesisekelo sokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. IOfisi Yolwazi izosiza labo abathumela izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalungu omphakathi ukuba babone isithombe noma uhlobo lwezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi ifaka izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulwazi nezincwadi nokuthi zikhona noma azikho. Ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwasendaweni, ukuphepha kwezifunda nezindawo ngokulandela amandla nezobuchwepheshe zokuphepha ezithuthukile, zanamuhla nezitholakala kalula. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inesibopho sokuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule nephumelelayo kubo bonke. Iphinde isekele noma yimuphi umnyango wombuso ohloswe ngawo ukuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela iqukethe uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uMphakathi Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF). UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophethe, uMphakathi Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophathelene nezimali zeMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanti uMholi Wezokuvikela uphethe ukuhola nokuphatha iNhlangano Yezokuvikela. IOfisi Yolwazi yeMnyango Wezokuvikela izophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Umgibeli wezincwadi nomlando weMnyango Wezokuvikela unesibopho sokugcina izincwadi nomlando. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali kuMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zomphakathi (PFMA), kanye nemigomo ethile, nezikhombisi ezithunyelwe kuzo zonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwezokuphepha kwezwe nezindaba zokuhola umgomo weMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, ukuqapha, nokwamukela umgomo wezokuphepha, isu, ne-framework ngokuhambisana nomgomo wesizwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, okusebenzayo, nokuziphatha kahle kwezokuphepha. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. UMsunguli ungumholi wezindawo ezifanayo nezisekelo zabantu abahluphekayo. Ukuphatha nokubheka iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ukuze kusekelwe ukuvikelwa komhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabliki yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngemiyalo ngombono wokuvikelwa komhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwezempi nezisekelo ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ukuze kusekelwe nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula umgomo wezempilo yezempi kanye nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina usizo lwezokwelapha oluyisisekelo kubalungu beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezincikizi zabo noma labo abaxhaswa ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zokweseka nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuhlakanipha sokuvikela nolwazi lwezokuhlakanipha ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukwesekwa kokuhlakanipha emkhakheni wezokuvikela, usizo, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezokusebenza. Ukuhola umsebenzi wabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwezemfundo kubantu bezempi abakhathalela bonke abalungu beMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezincikizi zabo nokukhuthaza ukukhula kokomoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngemiyalo evela kwezempi. Ukusungula umgomo wokuxhumana wezokuvikela, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nomgomo weMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nomgomo wezokuxhumana wesizwe (GCIS) futhi isebenza njengesisekelo sokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okusebenzayo, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela nezithakazelo zayo. Ukuhlinzeka inhlangano ngosizo lwezomthetho olusemthethweni, olugunyaziwe, nolusekela ngokuhambisana nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukusiza iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngolwazi namakhono ezimbonini zangaphandle. Ukuhlinzeka ngamakhono nezimfundo zamaphoyisa kuMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngentuthuko yobungcweti ukuze kuvinjwe futhi kudalwe amathuba okufunda ngokusebenza. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphelele kubasebenzi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo okungahlangene nokulwa kumuntu ngamunye weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekudluliseni kolwazi nasekusekeleni iMnyango Wezokuvikela nasekusekeleni izinhloso zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Uhlu lwezincwadi (theses) ezigcinwe yiOfisi Yezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela (Uhlu lutholakala kwiOfisi Yezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela). Izincwadi ezikhona ezikhungweni zeMnyango Wezokuvikela ziqala ngo-1912 lapho i-Union Defence Force (UDF) yasungulwa. Izincwadi ezikhona ezikhungweni kusukela eminyakeni engu-1912 kuya ku-1969 zikhombisa imisebenzi eyinhloko yazo zonke izingxenye ze-UDF ne-SADF. Imisebenzi emikhulu ihlobene nokusungulwa, ukuphathwa, nezici zobuchwepheshe bezempi futhi iphinde ithinte izenzakalo ngesikhathi sokulwa nangesikhathi sokuthula. Izincwadi zokuthi kwenzekeni zifaka ulwazi ngokuqhathaniswa kweNingizimu Afrika kwiMpi Yezwe I (1914 - 1918) neMpi Yezwe II (1939 - 1945), iBerlin Airlift (1948 - 1949), neMpi yaseKorea (1950 - 1953) kanye nokusungulwa kwezempi nezivivinyo ngesikhathi sokuphazamiseka kwangaphakathi ezweni njengokuhlasela kwemisebenzi kusukela ngo-1914 kuya ku-1922, izinkulumo zokuphikisa kusukela ngo-1914 kuya ku-1915, nezinkinga kusukela ngo-1950 kuya ku-1960. Izincwadi zokuphatha ziqukethe ulwazi lokusungulwa, ukuhlela, nokusebenza kwazo zonke izingxenye ze-UDF ne-SADF, kanye nosizo lwabasebenzi, ukuhlela umsebenzi,
UMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi oluphathwa nguhulumeni nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluphathwa omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zakhe, futhi ukuthi umthetho kazwelonke kumele usungulwe ukuze ufeze leli lungelo. Ngokwezinhlinzeko zalo Mthetho kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela unqunyelwe njengomphathi wolwazi (IO), kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli ophakathi (RA) weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Abaphathi Bezesekeli Nabantu Bahlonishwa Njengabaphathi Bezimali (DIOs). Lezi zikhala zizohlinzeka ngosizo olwamukelekayo kumalunga omphakathi ekufinyeleleni kulwazi uma kudingeka amarekhodi avela eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. IKomidi Lezeluleko Lwemininingwane (IAAC) lisunguliwe ukuze linikeze izeluleko kumphathi wolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso ezenziwe ngababambiqhaza bezezimali mayelana nezicelo zolwazi nokusiza umphathi wolwazi kanye nomgibeli ophakathi mayelana nokucubungula izikhalazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaKomidi Amancane Ezeluleko Lwemininingwane (IAASC) nawo asunguliwe ukuze anikeze izeluleko kubaphathi bezezimali mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. I-Centre Yemininingwane yeMnyango Wezokuvikela isunguliwe njengendawo yokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. I-Centre Yemininingwane izosiza labo abathumele izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalunga omphakathi ukuba babone uhlobo noma uhlobo lwezikhumbuzo eziphathwa yiMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi kufaka phakathi izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulwazi nezikhumbuzo nokuthi bangazithola kanjani ngqo noma ngokuqondile. Ulwazi ngokweSahluko 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000). Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwezwe, futhi ikhuthaza ukuphepha ezingeni lesizwe, lesifunda, kanye nezwe jikelele ngokulandela amandla avikelekile, anamuhla, anokufinyelela kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphambili. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inikezwa ukuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, kanye nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule futhi ethuthukayo kubo bonke. Iphinde ibheke noma iyiphi iminyango kahulumeni ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela ihlanganisa uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF). UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli onamandla, uNobhala Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophathisa ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nomphathi weMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanti umphathi weMpi unomsebenzi wokuyala nokulawula iMpi. Ukuba yi-Centre Yemininingwane yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ezophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali lukamasipala kuMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphatha Izimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), Izimiso Zesikhwama, nezikhangiso ezithunyelwe kubo bonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba zezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kwazwelonke nokuhola indlela yepholisi yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, nokubhekelela izinqubomgomo zokuvikela, isu, kanye nesakhiwo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zikazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, okucophelela, nokuphumelelayo komsebenzi wokuvikela. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungisa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Umdidiyeli ungumphathi Wethuba Elilinganayo Nokwesekwa Kwabantu Abandile. Ukuphatha nokulawula iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ahlobene nokuvikela umhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa kwezokuphepha komhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwempi ngosizo oluhlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ahlobene nokwesekwa nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula isikhungo sezinqubomgomo zokwesekwa kwezempilo ezimisweni zempi nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukwesekwa kwezempilo okubalulekile kubalungu beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezincike zabo noma labo abaxhaswe ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zokwesekwa nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezobuhlakani ekuphathweni nasekuphathweni kolwazi lwezokuphepha ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina uxhaso lwezobuhlakani kwiMpi, ukusiza ekusekeleni, nakwezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezinto zokusebenza. Ukuhlela umsebenzi wezisebenzi zeNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezemfundo kubo bonke amalunga eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela kanye nezincike zabo nokukhuthaza ukukhula komoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuqondisa okuvela enhlanganweni yempi. Ukusungula inqubomgomo yokuxhumana kwezokuphepha, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nepolitiki yeMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nenqubomgomo yokuxhumana kazwelonke (GCIS) futhi ibe yindawo yokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okucophelela, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela nezithakazelo zayo. Ukuhlinzeka inhlangano ngosizo lwezomthetho olukhethekile, usizo olugunyaziwe nolusekela ngokuhambisana nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukusiza iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngolwazi namakhono mayelana nezokuxhumana kwangaphandle nezinsiza ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo yezenhlalakahle kuMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngentuthuko yezobuchwepheshe ukuvimbela nokwakha amathuba okufunda ngokuqashwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphelele kubasebenzi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo olungahlangene nokulwa kumalunga eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekudluliseni kolwazi nezinsiza ezihlobene kuMnyango Wezokuvikela nokweseka lokho okwenziwa yiMnyango Wezokuvikela. Inhloso yale Mthetho ukuveza ilungelo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi oluphathwa uMbuso noma olunye ulwazi oluphathwa nganoma yimuphi umuntu oludingekayo ukuze lusetshenziswe noma luvikelwe nganoma yiluphi ilungelo. Inhloso ukuhlela isiko lokukhanya nokubopheleka ezikhungweni zomphakathi nezizimele futhi ukukhuthaza umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinye
I-SARS iqukethe inani elikhulu lolwazi eliqoqwa ngesikhathi yenziwa imisebenzi yayo yansuku zonke yokuhlanganisa imali yentela kuhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nezintela zebhizinisi ezisiza ekuqhubekeni kwalezi zinhlelo. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile kubantu abathintekayo ngqo, abangabakhokhi bentela, abathengisi, ababambiqhaza ebhizinisini, noma abasebenzi. Kubalulekile futhi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, abancintisana namabhizinisi, abameli, kanye nabathengisi ngenhloso yokuthengisa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke amaphrofithi akhishwa kwi-SARS ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi, umthetho we-SARS ophathelene nokugcina ubufihlo bolwazi obuphethwe yi-SARS uqinisekisa ukuthi lonke ulwazi mayelana nabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi luyimfihlo futhi alukwazi ukukhululwa ngaphandle kwezimo ezithile eziphuthumayo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("umthetho") uqinisekisa ubufihlo balolu lwazi, unikeza ukugcina kwalo njengobufihlo ngokuqondile, ngaphandle komuntu onelungelo lokuluthola noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe ukufinyelela kulolo lwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ubhekana nobufihlo obuhlobene nokudluliswa kwebhizinisi le-SARS lapho lokhu kungase kudingeke. Lezi ziqephu ezilandelayo zichaza i-SARS, izinqubo zokucela ulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti olwazi lwe-SARS, futhi uma kudingeka, izinqubo zangaphakathi zokufaka izikhalazo ngaphansi komthetho. I-SARS isungule umnyango owodwa wezicelo nezikhalazo emahhovisi ayo amakhulu ukuze kube lula ukulandela nokuphendula ngaphakathi kwezikhathi ezibekwe umthetho, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nanoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingase zenzeke ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambisana nesiko eligcizelelwa yi-SARS lokwenza izinto ngokucacile, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, kanye nokuziphatha kwe-SARS ngokuhlonipha, ubuqotho, nokwethembeka kulabo i-SARS ibambisana nabo. Umphakathi we-SARS nguMphakathi weMali yaseNingizimu Afrika, uMnu. Pravin Gordhan. Ngaphansi kwakhe kukhona abaphathi abane be-SARS, abaphatha izicelo zokufinyelela kulwazi oluphethwe yi-SARS njengokwenziwa komthetho nsuku zonke. Umphathi ngamunye unikezwe indawo ethile yokusebenza kuye ngokuqonda kwabo nolwazi lomsebenzi, futhi banikezwa le ndawo yokusebenza ngezinga labo nolwazi. Uma ufuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti aphethwe yi-SARS, kufanele uqedele ifomu eliku-Anexure 1 bese ulithumela kumphathi ofanele. Abaphathi basebenzisa ikheli le-ofisi kanye neposi elifanayo. Umphathi ofanele uzophendula phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 (60 ezimweni ezithile) ukuze akwazise ukuthi isicelo sakho siye savunywa noma saphikiswa. Ezinye izimo, ungase udinge ukukhokha imali ku-SARS ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe noma ufike kumarekhodi owacelile. Uma ukucubungula isicelo sakho kungadlula amahora ayisithupha, i-SARS izoqhubeka nokulungiselela ulwazi oluceliwe ngemva kokukhokha imali edingekayo. Isicelo sakho sizothunyelwa kuwe ngendlela ocela ngayo noma ngendlela ulwazi olugcinwa ngayo kumadokhumenti, uma kungekho enye indlela ocela ngayo. Lokhu kuyiphephandaba lokuqala lemibhalo mayelana nokusebenza komthetho we-SARS ngokomthetho. Kuzothuthuka futhi kukhule njengoba i-SARS nabaceli bolwazi bephawula ngempumelelo yalomthetho, kanye nokulinganisa ilungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi namalungelo amanye anikezwa umthetho, njengokufihla, kanye nesidingo sokugcina uMbuso usebenza kahle. Imithetho ngaphansi kokuhlanganiswa kokuqala, amanothi achazayo, nezinye. Ulwazi lokuxhumana nabaphathi bomnyango. Ulwazi olutholakalayo ngaphandle kwesicelo. Ukuqedela ifomu lesicelo. Ukwenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho. Umhlahlandlela weKomishini Yamalungelo Abantu. Ukuqoqa izintela; nokulawula ukufika kwezimpahla ezweni, ezithunyelwa ngaphandle kwezwe, ezikhiqizwayo, ezithunyelwa, ezigcinwayo, futhi zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo. Umthetho ophatha intela yokuthengiswa kwezabelo (stocks), ka-1948. Umthetho ophatha ukuqoqa intela uma kudluliswa ubunikazi beMali ka-1949. Umthetho wokuhlanganisa intela kumali yokufela, ka-1955. Umthetho wokuhlanganisa intela kumholo nezindleko, ka-1962. Umthetho wokuhlanganisa intela ezimpahleni ezifaka nokuphuma ezweni, ka-1964. Umthetho wokuhlanganisa intela ngenani, ka-1991. Imithetho ehlukene ebhalwe kuSheduli 1 yomthetho ophatha i-South African Revenue Service, ka-1997. noma yimaphi umthetho, isikhumbuzo somthetho, isaziso sikahulumeni, noma umyalo ophumelele ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla noma yimuphi umthetho ophathelene nokuhlanganiswa kwentela noma ophatha ukuthunyelwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile ezingase zidluliselwe kwi-SARS ngokomthetho noma isivumelwano phakathi kwe-SARS nomnyango kahulumeni noma ibhodi efanele (njengokuhlanganiswa kwentela ngaphandle kokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinkokhelo ze-inshurensi yokungasebenzi). kanye konke okuhlobene nentela; namandla anikezwa uNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla; nokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha mayelana konke okuhlobene nokulawula ukuthunyelwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile. Inhloso yayo ukuhlinzeka ngentela eqoqiwe ukuze ikhiqize izinzuzo ezibonakalayo, ukusiza ukuhweba nokwengeza kubakhokhi bentela ngokwethula abakhokhi bentela abasha ezincwadini ngokukhuthaza ukuqwashisa ngentela ukuze abantu bazi futhi babhekane nezibopho zabo zokweseka lo mnyango nemithetho yentela nezohwebo yaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakeme olungakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Nakuba i-SARS inomsebenzi wokubhala imithetho yentela, iyakwenza lokhu ngaphansi kokubhekwa nokuphathwa koNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, futhi kwesinye isikhathi uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezokwakha. Ngakho-ke, amadokhumenti akhishwe uMnyango Wezezimali kanye noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezokwakha ngokuhambisana nalomthetho kufanele abhekwane nokubhekwa komphakathi ekwakhiweni kwemigomo. Ngokwesimo nokuqina komthetho ophakanyisiwe, kungaqala ngokukhishwa kwemibhalo yokuxoxisana echaza inqubo okufanele ilandelwe nokumema umphakathi ukuba nawo athumele iziphakamiso. Njengoba iPhalamende njengamanje ingenawo amandla okushintsha iFinance Bill uma isethulwe, uhlelo luqale ukwakhiwa ukuze kukhuthazwe umphakathi ukuba uphawule futhi ube yingxenye yokuxoxisana ngaphambi kokuthi isethulwe. Lolu hlelo luqala ngokuthi i-SARS ikhiphe uhlaka lwezomthetho ezinsukwini eziyishumi zomsebenzi ngaphambi kokuhlangana kweKomidi lePhalamende. Kokubili i-SARS kanye nekomidi lePhalamende baphinde bameme imic
Le ncwadi iqukethe ulwazi olujwayelekile mayelana nezifundo zokuhlola. Ulwazi oluthile mayelana nezifundo zokuhlola ofuna ukuhlanganyela kuzo noma okukhuthazwa ukuba uhambisane nazo kumele lunikezwe yilabo abahola uphenyo lwezifundo. Uphenyo lwezokwelapha luyisifundo sokucwaninga esihloselwe ukuhlola ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, nokusebenza kwemithi emisha noma ekhona, izindlela zokwelapha, noma amadivayisi wezokwelapha, usebenzisa abahlanganyeli. Ukuphepha kubhekisela ekutheni indlela yokwelapha noma umuthi ingase ibe nezingozi noma ibangele umonakalo empilweni yomuntu. Ukusebenza kahle kusho ukuthi kukhona umphumela ekuhloleni, ekwelapheni, ekuvimbeleni, noma ekwelapheni isifo. Lokhu kungase kudinge ukufanisa imiphumela phakathi kwemithi/emithini emibili. Ikhwalithi ibhekisela ekuqinisekiseni okuphelele komuthi noma indlela yokwelapha, noma ukungenelela kwezokwelapha okuvumela ukuthi kusebenze kahle nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kulezo zimo ezilindelekile ngesikhathi sokwelashwa komuntu ogulayo, ngaphandle kokubeka engcupheni umsebenzisi womuthi. Igama elithi "umuthi" libhekisela kumithi esetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo (imithi yokwelapha), ukuvimbela izifo (imithi yokuvimbela, efana nezivithamini), kanye nemithi esetshenziselwa izifundo ezithile (imithi yokuhlola, efana naleyo esetshenziswa kuma-X-ray ukuze kutholakale izitho zomzimba). Ngaphambi kokuthi umuthi noma indlela yokwelapha ihlolwe kubantu, kuqala ifundwa isikhathi eside emalabhorethri nakweminye imfuyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwayo nokusebenza kahle. Ukuhlola imithi emisha, izivithamini, nezindlela zokwelapha kubantu kuvame ukudlula ezinyathelweni eziningi njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Isigaba sokuqala: Lesi yisigaba sokuqala lapho umuthi, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ihlolwa eqenjini elincane labazithandayo abaphilile. Izifundo zokuhlola isigaba sokuqala zihloselwe ukuhlola ukuphepha okuphelele, umthamo ophephile, kanye nemiphumela engase ibe khona yomuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha. Isigaba sesibili: Esigabeni sesibili, umuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ihlolwa eqenjini elikhulu labantu, imvamisa amahlandla amakhulu abavolontiya abaphilile kanye nalabo abanesifo okufanele silashwe ngalesi sikhathi. Inhloso yezifundo zesigaba sesibili wukuhlola okwengeziwe ukuphepha nokusebenza kahle komuthi, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iyasebenza. Isigaba sesithathu: Kulesi sigaba, umuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ihlolwa ezinkulungwaneni zabantu abanesifo okufanele silashwe ngalesi sikhathi. Inhloso yezifundo zesigaba sesithathu wukuhlola okwengeziwe ukusebenza kahle kanye nemiphumela engase ibe khona yomuthi, isivithamini, noma enye indlela yokwelapha emisha uma kuqhathaniswa nomuthi, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ekhona (enelayisensi). Isigaba sesine: Kulesi sigaba, ukuhlolwa kwenziwa ngemuva kokuthi umuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha ibhaliswe yi-MCC, okusho ukuthi ngemuva kokubhaliswa, itholelayisensi yokuthengiswa. Ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nemiphumela emide ibhekwa kumuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo njengabantwana, abadala, abantu abanezinselelo zomzimba, nezifo zezinso, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa (izinkomba) umuthi omusha, isivithamini, noma indlela yokwelapha. Izigaba zonke zalesi sifundo zinezinhloso zazo ezithile kanye nezinzuzo, izingozi, nezingozi. Kuwo wonke amazinga okuhlola, abahlanganyeli ocwaningweni bavame ukukhokhelwa nganoma yiziphi imiphumela emibi abangase bayihlangabezane nayo noma nganoma yiziphi imiphumela engalindelekile. Imiphumela emibi ingabandakanya noma yisiphi uhlobo lwezimpawu ezimbi nezingenalindelekile, izimpawu, noma izifo ezihlobene nomuthi/ukwelashwa okukhuluma ngakho. Umuthi ophenywayo ungumuthi omusha noma osanda kutholakala (ukwelashwa) okwamanje kusemkhakheni. Umuthi othengiswayo ungumuthi osevele ubhaliswe nezinhlaka zokulawula (MCC) futhi ungasebenzisa njengendlela yokwelapha yezifo ezithile. Lo muthi udlule esigabeni sokuthuthukiswa, futhi ikhwalithi yawo, ukuphepha, nokusebenza kahle sekuvele kwaziwa. Imithi ethengiswayo ibizwa nangokuthi imithi enelayisensi noma imithi ebhalisiwe. Umkhiqizo ophenywayo ungumuthi (ukwelashwa)/isivithamini (izivithamini)/noma indlela yokwelapha (imikhiqizo yezokwelapha) ethwetshulwa ukuze kuhlolwe ikhwalithi, ukuphepha, kanye/noma ukusebenza kahle ngesikhathi kuqhutshelwa phambili isifundo sokuhlola esithile. Kungase kube nemikhiqizo engaphezu kweyodwa esifundweni esithile. Imikhiqizo ephenywayo ingabandakanya imithi, izivithamini, noma imikhiqizo yezokwelapha ezibhalisiwe noma ezingabhaliswanga noma imikhiqizo esaphenywa. Umxhaso ungumuntu, inkampani, isikhungo, noma inhlangano enesibopho sokusungula, ukuphatha, kanye nokuxhasa isifundo sokuhlola. Abaxhasi bavame ukuba abakhiqizi bemithi, izikhungo zikamasipala, izikhungo zocwaningo, iHhovisi leMhlaba leZempilo, uhulumeni bezwe, njll. Umphenyi ungumuntu ofanelekile onobungcweti obuphathelene nokuhlela, ukuqhuba, ukuhlaziya, kanye/noma ukubika ngesifundo esithile. Abaphenyisi bavame ukusebenza ndawonye njengethimba. Umphenyi ophambili ubizwa ngokuthi uMphenyi Ophambili (PI). U-PI unesibopho sezinyathelo ezihilela umxhaso kanye nezikhungo zokulawula. Abaphenyisi bangabandakanya odokotela abelapha, ososayensi bezokwelapha, abaphenyi bemithi, ochwepheshe bezempilo yengqondo, noma amalungu omkhakha wezokwelapha, njll. Noma ubani othanda ukuhamba phambili noma osevele uhambisile ocwaningweni (okufanele kubo) esifundweni sokuhlola unelungelo lokuhlinzeka ngovuma okwaziwayo. Umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika inombolo 108 ka-1996: Isigaba 12 sisho ukuthi "wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhlonishwa kokwakhiwa komzimba nangokwengqondo, okuhlanganisa nelungelo - (c) lokungasetshenziswanga ocwaningweni lwezokwelapha noma lwezesayensi ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngovuma okwaziwayo kuqala." Yini evuma okwaziwayo? Ukuvuma okwaziwayo kuyinqubo ekhona mayelana (futhi ethinta) ukuhamba phambili ocwaningweni okuhlobene nokufunda ngamaqiniso abalulekile mayelana nesifundo sokuhlola esithile esizokwenziwa ukuze umuntu akwazi ukwenza isinqumo sokuthi aqhubeke noma cha futhi ahlanganyele kulolo suku lokuhlola. Ukuvuma okwaziwayo akusona nje ukusaina ifomu lokuvuma futhi akusona isivumelwano, kodwa kuyisigaba sokuvuma somuntu ozohlanganyela ocwaningweni. Ukuvuma kwakho okwaziwayo kuyisidingo esibalulekile ocwaningweni esihambisana nezindinganiso zokuziphatha nezocwaningo lwezesayensi. Ulwazi kumele lunikezwe ngendlela elula necacile usebenzisa ulimi lwakho. Isinqumo sakho sokuhlangany
Ukusebenza komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi. B. Uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng ubonisile ukuthi kudingeka isu lokusiza amabhizinisi amancane elidlula izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezikhona kanye nezikhungo zezezimali ukuze kusekelwe amabhizinisi amancane ngokwezezimali nangokunye. "Ibhodi" ibhekisela ebhodini le-GEP elisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba sesixhenxe somthetho. "Umnyango" ubhekisela kumnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba esifundeni. "Inhloko yoMnyango" ibhekisela enhlokweni yomnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Umthetho" uveza umthetho wesifunda. "MEC" uveza ilungu lekhansela elibhekene nezindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Kwenziwe" kusho okwenziwe ngumlomo. "Isifunda" sisho isifunda saseGauteng. "Umthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi" ubhekisela kumthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi, Umthetho 1 ka-1999. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa uhlu neminye imithetho ephathelene nayo. Ukusebenza komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi. Ezezimali njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 492 a somthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi, b I-MEC iyinhlangano yeKhansela njengokuhlinzekwa kwesigaba esiyishumi nambili somthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi c Noma yini eyenziwe yiBhodi mayelana nomthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi kumele ihambisane nalokho okukhuluma ngesigaba esiyishumi nesithupha salo mthetho. Akukho okukhona kulomthetho okunezikhali zokukhipha imithetho esunguliwe yi-GEP ngaphansi komthetho wezokuphathwa kwezezimali zomphakathi. d Ukuqala nokuqhubeka kohlu lokwesekwa ukuze kukhule indima edlalwa amabhizinisi amancane emnothweni waseGauteng. e Ukuqhubeka nokukhula komnotho, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, kanye nokulingana. f Ukuhlanganisa bonke abasebenzi abahlinzeka ngosizo kumabhizinisi amancane asekelwe nguhulumeni ngokwezezimali eGauteng. g Ukuqinisa amandla alabo abahlinzeka ngosizo kumabhizinisi amancane. a Ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokweseka osomabhizinisi ngokwezezimali, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulokhu. Usizo lokubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi, izindaba zezezimali nezomthetho. Ukuqeqeshwa ngezakhono ze-computer nezinye izakhono. v Ikhono lokufinyelela ulwazi oluvela kuhulumeni kanye nezikhuthazo. Ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ngezohwebo ezingenayo nezokuphuma. Ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ngezobudlelwano bezinhlaka, ukumaketha, kanye nocwaningo. b Ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokweseka osomabhizinisi ngokwezezimali, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulokhu. i Ngokusho kwesigaba sesine, bahlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa. Futhi bahlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali lwezimali. c Ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokweseka labo abahlinzeka ngosizo nezinye izinhlaka kulokhu. d Ukuhlinzeka ngesitolo esisodwa sokweseka osomabhizinisi. Kuzosiza ukuthuthukisa ukusungulwa kwabo, ukuqhubeka, nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo zokweluleka amabhizinisi amancane. Ukuqala izindlela ezizolandela ukuze kuthuthukiswe amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwenza izinhlelo ezisifundeni, ezweni, nasezindaweni zomhlaba ukuze kudonswe labo abafuna ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda. Ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi nezinye izinhlobo zokubambisana nezinhlangano zomphakathi nezinye izinhlangano kulesi sifunda, eRiphabhulikhi, nasemazweni angaphandle. Ukuhlanganisa, ukusiza, nokubambisana nezithakazelo nezikhungo ezifunayo ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukuhlanganyela ezinhlakeni ezikhuthaza futhi zikhulisa amabhizinisi amancane. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda. a Ukwakha amabhizinisi aqinile futhi ancintisanayo, b Ukukhuthaza osomabhizinisi. c Ukudala indawo efanele yokusebenza kwamabhizinisi amancane. d Ukufinyelela okulula kumabhizinisi amancane ukuze bathole usizo lwezezimali nezinye izinsiza, nokuthi basebenzise kanjani nokuthi benza kanjani. e Ukufinyelela okulula kumabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda nakwamanye amazwe. Ukukhuthaza, ukuhlanganisa, nokukhuthaza uhulumeni bendawo, izinhlangano ezizimele, nezinye izithakazelo ukuba babambisane ukuze i-GEP ifinyelele izinhloso zayo. Ukuhola nokuhlela ucwaningo oluhambisana nezinhlelo ezisiza amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwandisa ukuqwashisa komphakathi mayelana nendima yamabhizinisi amancane ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, nokuphila kahle jikelele. Ukuqala izakhiwo zomphakathi nezasezindaweni ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinhloso zayo ngempumelelo. Ukwenza eminye imithetho ephathelene nalomthetho. Umthetho uyisisekelo seBhodi nokukhethwa kwamalungu. Ngaphambi kokukhetha amalungu eBhodi, i-MEC kumele ixhumane ngazwi ngezaziso ku-Gazette yesifunda, ukhetho lwamalungu afanele okukhethwa. a Representa ingxenye ebalulekile yabantu baseGauteng, egxile kumasiko, ubulili, ukungasebenzi, ukusabalala kwezindawo, nezinhlelo ezikwiindawo zokuhweba. Umthetho wezomthetho ophathelene namabhizinisi amancane. I-MEC ingasungula noma yiziphi izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ekukhetheni amalungu. I-CEO iyilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla esibambayo. Bonke amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwe-CEO, bakhethwa ngasikhathi sinye. a Ilungu leBhodi njengomholi. b Elinye ilungu njengomphakathi ophakeme ukuze abambe indawo yomholi weBhodi uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza leyo msebenzi. b Ilungu leziphathimandla, iziphathimandla zesifunda, ikhansela likamasipala, noma umholi wesiko osunguliwe ngaphansi komthetho kazwelonke. c Umuntu okhishwe. d Umuntu onokukhubazeka kwengqondo noma onedokhumenti esemthethweni ekhombisa ukuthi umuntu unengqondo engalungile noma unokukhubazeka. f Umuntu okhishwe emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi. g Umuntu okhishwe eBhodi ngenxa yokwephula imithetho yayo. Ilungu leBhodi kumele likhishwe esikhundleni uma lelo lungu lenze noma iyiphi yalezi ezishiwo esigabeni sokuqala. a Ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi, ukungabi nolwazi, nokungafaneleki. b Ngenxa yokungawulandeli isigaba 8 2 noma 151. c Uma ilungu ingakwazi ukuya emihlanganweni yeBhodi ngokulandelanayo ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele, d Noma ngenye imbangela efanele. Ibhodi ingakhipha ilungu ngemva kokumnika ithuba lokuchaza iziphazamiso zayo. Isikhathi lapho amalungu eBhodi kufanele asebenze. a Kungaba iminyaka emithathu, b Kungase kube ngaphansi kwemithetho ebekwe yi-MEC kanye naleyo ebhalwe emqulwini wokukhetha ilungu. Uma ilungu ikhipha noma iyashiya esikhundleni, i-MEC ingakhetha omunye umuntu endaweni yalelo lungu kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi noma
Siyabonga kakhulu ukwethula le ncwadi. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni wethu wasayinela iSivumelwano seZizwe Ezihlangene Sokwaziswa Kwezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sivumelene ukuhlonipha imithetho ekhethekile mayelana nokuthi izingane kufanele ziphathwe kanjani emhlabeni jikelele. Uma singahloniphi le mithetho, sizobe sisesimweni esinzima neZizwe Ezihlangene! Kodwa okukhathazayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi, nakuba iSivumelwano ikhuluma ngezingane, ayibhaliwe ngendlela yokuthi izingane zikwazi ukuyiqonda kalula. Sazibuza, yini inzuzo yale nto? Ngempela, ingabe izingane akufanele zikwazi ukuqonda amalungelo azo? Yingakho sithathe isinqumo sokukubhalela le ncwadi. Amalungelo akule ncwadi akuwe. Ayizakhamuzi zonke eNingizimu Afrika kanye neningi lezingane emhlabeni jikelele. Akekho ongathatha lawa malungelo kuwe. Ngakho qiniseka ukuthi uyawazi! Siyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe lethu! Futhi qiniseka ukuthi uyakujabulela kakhulu! Nginezingane ezingezami. Ngakho ngiyazi ukuthi okubaluleke kakhulu enganeni ukujabula nokuvikeleka. Le ncwadi ikhuluma ngamalungelo ezingane zokuba zibe nokuvikeleka nokuphepha ezweni lethu. Ngizibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi uyazi amalungelo akho nokuthi bonke abaphakathi kwami basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuvikela wena, imindeni yakho, nabangane bakho. Ngiyabona futhi ukuthi njengokuthi niyizingane, kufanele nizizwe niphephile, nivikelwe, nikhunjulwa, futhi nikhathalelwe. Ngiyazi ngoba ngangiyingane futhi. Ngakho umsebenzi wami ukuqinisekisa ukuthi labo abenza ubugebengu ezingeni lezingane baboshwa futhi bajeziswa ngendlela efanele. Ngithatha umsebenzi wami ngokungathí sina futhi ngizibophezele ekuvikeleni wena. Le ncwadi ikuwe futhi izokusiza wazi ukuthi yiziphi izenzo ezingamukeleki nokuthi ungabika kanjani labo abadala nezingane abaphula amalungelo akho. Zonke izingane emhlabeni kufanele zijabulele lawa malungelo. Sonke singamalungu omndeni omkhulu wabantu. Sinezakhamizi nezizalwane zonke emhlabeni. Eminyakeni edlule, ngaphambi kokuba uzalwe, ohulumeni bomhlaba bahlangana ukuze bakhe uhulumeni womhlaba obizwa ngeZizwe Ezihlangene. Labo bahulumeni bavumelana ukuthi wonke amalungu omndeni wethu wabantu unelungelo lokukhululeka, ubulungiswa, nokuthula emhlabeni. Umuntu ngamunye kusho umuntu wonke ngempela. Akukhathalekile ukuthi siphuma kuphi noma ukuthi singobani. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi sicebile noma sihluphekile noma sisesimweni esiphakathi. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umbala wethu wesikhumba, ubuzwe, noma inkolo yethu iyini. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi singamadoda, abesifazane, amantombazane, noma abafana. Kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi izingane zidinga ukunakekelwa nokusizwa kakhulu kunabantu abadala. Yingakho iSivumelwano Sokwaziswa Kwezingane samukelwa yiZizwe Ezihlangene ngomhla ka-20 Novemba, 1989. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuthi iZizwe Ezihlangene ikhuluma kakhulu ngezingane futhi ikholelwa ukuthi amalungelo akhethekile adingeka. Okokuqala, iZizwe Ezihlangene ikholelwa ngokuqinile ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle kakhulu emndenini noma ekhaya lapho zingajabula, zithandwa, futhi zikhuluma khona. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imindeni nalabo abakhathalela izingane kufanele ivikelwe ukuze bakwazi ukunakekela izingane zabo futhi bazisize zikhule. Okwesibili, izingane zidinga ukukhula ngendlela ezokwenza zibe ngabantu abadala abakwazi ukubhekana nezinto ezidinga ukuzenza futhi zibe amalungu emiphakathini yazo. Kufanele zifundiswe ukuhlala emhlabeni ngokuthula, ngebhongo, ngokuqina, ngokukhululeka, ngokulingana, nangokuhlanganyela. Okwesithathu, imibhalo eminingi ehlukene yomhlaba nezikhangiso zicela ukunakekelwa okukhethekile, inhlalakahle, ukuphathwa, nokuvikelwa kwezingane. Kubalulekile ukubhala konke phansi kwi-document eyodwa - i-document yeziNgane kuphela. Okwesine, nakuba wonke umuntu efuna zonke izingane zikhule zijabule futhi zifezekile, iZizwe Ezihlangene iyazi ukuthi, ezweni lonke, izingane eziningi zihlala ezimeni ezinzima kakhulu. Ngenxa yalezi nezinye izizathu, kubalulekile ukuba neSivumelwano esikhethekile Sokwaziswa Kwezingane. Le Sivumelwano ikhuluma ngazo zonke izinkinga nezinkinga ezingane ezihlangabezana nazo emhlabeni jikelele kanye nawo wonke amalungelo akhethekile okufanele abe nawo izingane. Le yisivumelwano sakho futhi kubalulekile ukuthi wazi ngakho nokuthi ikhuluma ngani. Iqukethe izingxenye ezahlukene (iZizwe Ezihlangene ziyibiza ngokuthi "izigaba"). Ibhalwe ngolimi lwezomthetho ukuze ingasetshenziswa ezinkantolo ukuvikela wena. Kodwa lokhu kwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuyiqonda. Yingakho sibhale lokhu kuwe ngolimi olulula kule ncwadi. Nokho, kuqala, sifuna ukukuchazela ukuthi iSivumelwano iyini, njengoba isetshenziswa lapha, nokuthi yafika kanjani. Njengoba sikhulume, iZizwe Ezihlangene iyindlela yokuphatha umhlaba. Lo hulumeni uhambela endlini enkulu esakhiweni seZizwe Ezihlangene eNew York. Lapha baxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile zomhlaba ezifana neSivumelwano Sokwaziswa Kwezingane. Khumbula ukuthi le Sivumelwano iyisivumelwano esenziwe phakathi kohulumeni bomhlaba. Uma isivumelwano sitholakele, wonke amazwe kufanele aye kwiPhalamende lawo avumelane neSivumelwano lapho. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukwamukela iSivumelwano. IPhalamende kufanele livote ukuthi lizohlonipha imithetho yeSivumelwano. Uma iPhalamende lezwe livumelene ukwamukela iSivumelwano, uhulumeni walowo mzwe kufanele uhloniphe imithetho yawo. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi hhayi wonke amazwe avumelana nazo zonke izivumelwano. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wavuma (wamukela) iSivumelwano Sokwaziswa Kwezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele uhloniphe imithetho yeSivumelwano. IZizwe Ezihlangene zinekomidi ekhethekile yabantu okufanele ibuze amazwe ukuthi yiziphi izinto abahamba phambili ngazo ukuze bahloniphe le mithetho. Ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika yasayina iSivumelwano, benza promises ekhethekile ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izingane zizobekwa phambili kukho konke abakwenza. I-Sivumelwano ibalula ukuthi ingane iy umuntu ongekho eminyakeni engu-18. Kodwa kwesinye isikhathi, izwe lingaba nemithetho evumela ukuthi ingane ibhekwane njengomuntu omdala ngaphambi kwaleyo minyaka. Ungase ucabangele isizathu sokuthi kungani izwe lingavumela ingane ibhekwane njengomuntu omdala ngaphambi kweminyaka engu-18. Ngokwesibonelo, kwamanye amazwe, abantu abangenaminyaka engu-18 bavunyelwe ukuba bashade. Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi umuntu ongekho eminyakeni engu-18 kufanele aphathwe njengengane? Wonke umhlaba kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi wonke amalungelo akulesi Sivumelwano akhuluma ngawo athinta zonke izingane kulelo zwe. Akekho ingane okufanele ishiywe ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ungowesifazane, umbala, ubulili, ulimi, noma inkolo. Akekho ingane okufanele ishiywe ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ucabanga noma uthi noma uvela kuphi. Ak
R50.00 kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka ka-2003 bese kuba R70. Abanikazi bezindawo zokuhweba kumele bathenge ugesi bona. Imali yokurenta ikhokhwa ngenyanga ngaphambi kosuku lweshumi lwanyanga ngayinye. Isikhala sokuhweba esinikezwe umuntu sizosetshenziswa ukuthengisa nokukhangisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zemikhiqizo njengoba kuvunyelwe yiBhodi yabaPhathi ngezikhathi ezithile. Umqashi kumele anikeze umninimzi ikheli lakhe lokuhlala, ikheli leposi, kanye nenombolo yefoni. Umqashi kumele abe ngumuntu ongasebenzi, futhi kuzoqokwa labo abaxhasa imindeni yabo bodwa. Zonke izinto kumele zibe sesimweni esifanele sokuthengiswa ezivakashi futhi zibe nekhwalithi ephezulu nezinhlobonhlobo. Isikhala sokuhweba kumele sibe niphephile, futhi umqashi kumele ahambisane nemigomo ebekwe kuMthetho Wokuphepha Nokuphila Kwezisebenzi No. 85 ka-1993. Isikhala sokuhweba asikwazi ukuqashwa komunye umuntu ngumqashi. Abaqashi abathathu bazovunyelwa ngaphansi kwaleli sivumelwano. Abaqashi bazokhuthazwa ukuthengisa imikhiqizo yabanye abantu abasebenza ekhaya. Ukulahla udoti/ukuphuma akuvunyelwe, futhi udoti akumele uqoqeke ezindaweni zokuhweba. Ukuphuza utshwala ezindaweni zokuhweba akuvunyelwe, futhi umqashi akumele afinyelele emsebenzini ethwele umthelela utshwala noma eminye imishanguzo. Ukulwa noma ukusebenzisa ulimi olubi ezindaweni zokuhweba akuvunyelwe. Umsindo ophakeme noma umculo ezindaweni zokuhweba akuvunyelwe. Umqashi unomthwalo wokugcina isikhala sakhe sokuhweba nezindawo ezizungezile zihlanzekile. Abaqashi bazothatha izikhathi zokuhlanza igumbi lokugeza nezinye izindawo ezivamile. Imikhiqizo ingakhiqizwa kuphela ezindaweni zokuhweba uma kuvunyelwe ngaphambi kumninimzi. Umqashi unomthwalo wokuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngoshintsho. Kuzosetshenziswa kuphela izinto zikagesi ezivunyelwe ngumqashi. Akukho shintsho okungafakwa ezindaweni zokuhweba mayelana nezifaki zikagesi, uphahla, noma okunye. Abaqashi kumele bathathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvimbela ukuvinjelwa noma ukuphazamiseka kwemithombo yamanzi, amapayipi, kanye namapayipi okuphakelwa kwamanzi lapha ezindaweni zokuhweba. Abaqashi kuzodingeka bakhokhe ugesi ngokuya ngezidingo zabo. Izindawo zokuhweba kumele zivuleke kusukela ngo-9:00 AM kuya ku-5:00 PM kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuMgqibelo. Imakethe izovalwa ngeSonto. Izindawo zokuhweba zingavulwa ngezikhathi ezinde ngokuthanda komninimzi. Uma umqashi, noma abalingani bakhe noma abasebenzi baphula noma yiziphi zalezi zimo ngenhloso ethile, futhi baqhubeka benza kanjalo ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyishumi zokwaziswa ukuze balungise, lesi sivumelwano sokurenta sizopheliswa ngokushesha, futhi umqashi kuzodingeka aphume kulolo sikhala sokuhweba ngokushesha. Kuzonikezwa isaziso esisheshayo uma kwenzeka isenzo sobugebengu noma ukuphulwa kokuziphatha. Uma kutholakala ukuthi umqashi unikeze ulwazi olungelona iqiniso ukuze athole lesi sikhala sokuhweba, iBhodi izosebenzisa amandla ayo uma ikhetha ukuphelisa lesi sivumelwano ngokushesha. Uma umqashi ethola umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, lesi sivumelwano sizopheliswa, futhi umqashi kuzodingeka aphume esikhala sokuhweba ezinsukwini eziyisixhenxe. Uma umqashi efela, lesi sivumelwano sizopheliswa ngokuhambisana nemigomo yeMthetho Jikelele. Umninimzi unelungelo lokukhokhisa umqashi ngemali nezijeziso.
Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwethula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika isu lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kazwelonke. Lokhu kuyingxenye yemiphumela yokucwaninga okukhulu kanye nezinkulumo phakathi kweMnyango Wezabasebenzi kanye neSikhungo Samakhono Kazwelonke. NgoNovemba 2000, kwakhulunywa kabanzi ngohlelo olwakhiwe. IBhodi Yezamakhono Kazwelonke isiqinisekisile iziphakamiso eziningi ezaziphakanyiswe kulokhu kukhuluma. NgoJanuwari 2001, le Bhodi yethule kimi iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqala zezwe lethu ezisekela isu elibanzi lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Lezi ziphakamiso nezincazelo zakhuphula umoya wami ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, leli su selivele laqaphela izindawo ezibalulekile ezihamba phambili ekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono, futhi sihlinzeke ngezinkomba esizozilinganisa ngazo impumelelo nentuthuko esiyenzile. Ngakho-ke, leli su lihola umnyango wami, uMnyango Wezemfundo, nezinye izigaba zokuqeqesha. Okwesibili, leli su libonisa kahle ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuzothinta kanjani umkhankaso kazwelonke wokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Uhulumeni uzibophezele ekuthuthukiseni abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke izigaba zikahulumeni zisebenza ndawonye ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu bathola imfundo neziqu ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Isibonelo, uMnyango Wezemfundo uzibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi kube nezinguquko emfundweni ejwayelekile nasezifundweni eziphakeme. Ngokufanayo, uMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono afanele. Isu Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ligcizelela indima edlalwa umnyango wami enqubweni yokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi - ikakhulukazi ngezindlela ezizotholwa ngazo impumelelo yaleyo ndima. Iphinde ihlinzeke nezinye izigaba zikahulumeni ngohlaka lokusebenza njengoba zithuthukisa amakhono ezindaweni zazo. Okwesithathu, nginikezwe igunya lokusekela lokho esikutholile ngesikhathi sibhala futhi sihlela leli su. Nakuba kube nokuvumelana mayelana nezindlela zokuhlola ukusebenza kahle kwecebo nokukala izinhloso, impumelelo yalesi sihloko ixhaswe ngaphandle kokungabaza. Mayelana nendaba yokusetha izinkomba ezizokhombisa impumelelo nokuhlola indima esiyidlalayo ekufezeni leli su, kwavunyelwana, futhi le nhloso iyinkomba eyengeziwe yokuthi umnyango wami uzibophezele ekusebenzeni komphakathi nasekubikeni umphakathi ngakho konke okwenziwayo. Inselelo enkulu ukuwenza lo msebenzi ube yimpumelelo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uqhubeka nokusiza umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhuthaza abaqashi, izinyunyana, abasebenzi, izigaba zikahulumeni, nomphakathi ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo. Umnyango wami uzibophezele ekuqapheleni ukuthi leli su lisebenza kahle futhi liya phambili. Zonke izindlela ezifanele kumele zenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngempumelelo futhi kube nezincwadi ezibhalwe ngokusemthethweni mayelana nentuthuko yalesi si. Ngithembela kakhulu kwiBhodi Yezamakhono Kazwelonke ukuze ibuyekeze imibiko ebhalwe umnyango wami, futhi uma kudingeka, iqale uphenyo lwayo, inginikeze izeluleko nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezidinga ukubuyekezwa kwezinhlelo nezinguquko ekwenzeni. Impumelelo nokwehluleka kumele kubhalwe ukuze sonke sikwazi ukufunda kulokhu futhi silungise amaphutha ethu. Isu kumele ngempela libe sezingeni eliphezulu. Ngizokwenza njalo ngilindele imibiko yentuthuko evela emnyangweni wami, nakwiBhodi ephethe ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ngiphinde ngemukele iBhodi ukuba iqhubeke ibuyekeza izinhloso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziqhubeka zixazulula izidingo ezibalulekile zezwe lethu. Ngifuna ukuveza ukubonga kwami okujulile kubantu abangujajayo nabesilisa abangujajayo abake baba nesandla ekuthuthukiseni leli su elihloniphekile. Izinhloso engizibekile zisezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu, kodwa akukho okungenzeka uma sinesibindi. Ngokufanayo, umdlandla esinawo wokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ungafezwa. Inselelo kithi manje ukuwenza amaphupho ethu abe yiqiniso. Masivule izandla zethu futhi siqale ukusebenza! Kukhona okwaziwa kahle ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayikakabi namakhono adingekayo ukuze ithuthukise ngokwezimali, ngokwezokuxhumana, nangokwemisebenzi. Ukuze sifinyelele kulolo zinga, sineMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, kanye neMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, owamukelwa ngonyaka ka-1998 no-1999 ngokulandelana. Lezi zimiso zinika uNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi umthwalo wokwenza amalungiselelo eNational Skills Development Strategy, ngokubambisana neSkills Development Council. ISkills Development Council yasungulwa nguMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998. Amalungu ayo amele amabhizinisi, abasebenzi, uhulumeni, nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngemva kokucwaninga okukhulu kanye nezinkulumo phakathi kweMnyango Wezabasebenzi neBhodi ephethe Amakhono, kwenziwa amalungiselelo okuphila kwalesi su. NgoNovemba, kwahlinzekwa amakhophi aleli su kumabamba-ndaba wonke. Imihlangano yokukhuluma ngalesi su yabanjwa kuzo zonke izifunda. Ibhodi ithole iziphakamiso eziningi mayelana nale pilot. Kwabe sekwenziwa ukuhlola, futhi izinkomba zokuphumelela zashintshwa. Izinkomba zokuphumelela ezibekwe kulolu su zizobuyekezwa minyaka yonke futhi zishintshwe uma kudingeka. Ziyindlela esebenzayo yokuhlola izindaba ezibalulekile nokuphumelela, kodwa izindlela zokuhlanganisa ulwazi zingathuthukiswa, njengoba nezindlela zokuhlola umthelela walesi su. Ngasikhathi sinye, lezi zinkomba ziye zavezwa izenzo ezithile kunokukhombisa imiphumela yalezo zenzo. Nokho, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkomba zingashintshwa ukuze zikhombise kangcono imiphumela. Ngesikhathi esibekwe, uMnyango Wezabasebenzi uzophatha imibiko ngazinye izinkomba. IBhodi Yezamakhono izobuyekeza le mibiko. Lokhu kuzokwenza uNgqongqoshe abe nolwazi oluqhubekayo nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezingavela. Uma kudingeka, uNgqongqoshe angakwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze ahlangabezane nezidingo zamakhono ezwe ngaleso sikhathi. UMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998, kanye noMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezibhekisela kubasebenzi nentuthuko yabo. Lezi zimiso ezimbili zethula imibono emisha mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezihloselwe ukugcina nokukhuthaza uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Kukhona izindaba ezimbili ezibalulekile ezibhekwa yilezi zimiso. Okokuqala, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho womhlaba kanye nokuncintisana kwemikhakha yethu nezinye izizwe. Okwesibili, ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nokususa ubuphofu. Imithetho yokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono seiqalile ukusebenza. NgoAprili 1999, iSkills Development Council yasungulwa. Ngomhla kaM
Ithimba ligxile ekuxazululeni izidingo zabantu ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphakathi komphakathi ophuhlayo mayelana nezindaba ezikhombisa izindawo ezifana nokuphatha, imfundo, nomnotho, phakathi kwezinye, ngenkathi liphinde lihambe phakathi kokuhlukana nokugcina intuthuko yeziqhingi emkhakheni wezindaba kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Ithimba lihlose ukusungula uhlelo oluzoba nendima ebalulekile ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezinkulu ezweni lonke futhi luzokwenza imicimbi ehloselwe ukukhuthaza lezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Imfundo nababambiqhaza bakhulise ucwaningo, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwakhiwa kokufinyelela nokusebenza kwabantu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezilimi. Ithimba libona ukuthuthukiswa komkhakha we-HLT eNingizimu Afrika okufana nalokho eYurophu ngezilimi ezihlukahlukene, kodwa kulungiswe ukuze kuhambisane nezidingo zendawo. Ithimba lizozenzela ukwethula ngo-2002. Ithimba lihlangana kaningi futhi lizobamba iqhaza nababambiqhaza abafanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Noma ubani onentshisekelo uyamenywa ukuthi axhumane nomqondisi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ukuze athole olunye ulwazi. Ukusekelwa kwalesi sikhungo kuyamukeleka kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuvela kuphi.
I-Child Protection Register iqukethe uhlu lwabantwana abadinga ukuvikelwa, abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-18, abafuna ukuvikelwa. I-Register igcinwa ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana osebenza ngaphakathi kweSikhungo Sezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi sendawo. Ulwazi olukhona kule Register luyimfihlo futhi lungabelwana kuphela nalabo abaphakathi kweqembu le-Child Protection (isibonelo, othisha, ab nurse, odokotela, abakhathalela/ozinikele/abameli, nabanye). Kuhlu lwabantwana abadinga usizo lwezenhlalakahle lugcinwa. Umntwana uxhumeke nomndeni wakhe kanye nezinsizakalo zomphakathi ngokushesha (lezo ezinikeza leyo nsizakalo). Isigameko ngasinye sihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zomndeni nomntwana ziyahlinzekwa. Ngokusho komthetho ophathelene nokunakekelwa kwezingane (Inombolo 74 ka-1983), lezi zikhungo ezilandelayo zinomsebenzi wokubika noma yiziphi izinsolo zokuthi kungase kube nezimpawu zokuhlukumeza noma ukunganaki umntwana: udokotela wamazinyo, udokotela jikelele, um nurse, umphakathi wezokuxhumana, uthisha, nanoma ubani osebenza noma ophatha i-Child Care Home noma indawo yokuphepha yezingane. Uma, ngesikhathi sokuhlola, ubhekene, noma usindisa umntwana, kukhona izinsolo zokuthi bangahlukumezeka, lokhu kufanele kubikwe kumsebenzi wezokuxhumana oseduzane lapho umntwana ehlala khona. Noma yiliphi ilunga lomphakathi noma umuntu onomthwalo mayelana nalolu daba angakwazi ukukhomba ukuhlukumeza noma ukunganaki umntwana futhi angabika lokhu kuzinsizakalo zomphakathi. Amagama abo abamba iqhaza azogcinwa njengemfihlo. Ulwazi lokukhomba umntwana. Ulwazi ngababazi bomntwana/abakhathaleli bomntwana. Ikheli lapho umntwana ehlala khona, uma engahlali nabazali bakhe, ikheli labazali bakhe. Izinsuku lapho izigameko zibikwa khona kanye nohlobo lwezigameko. Ulwazi ngezimo ezaholela ezinsolweni. Noma iyiphi imbali yezigameko ezedlule. Noma yiluphi ulwazi lokuxhumana nabanye abantu abangahlinzeka ngobufakazi mayelana nalezi zinsolo. Ulwazi lokuxhumana efayilini lubalulekile, uma izinsizakalo zomphakathi zidinga ukufinyelela mayelana nezinye izindaba eziphathelene nalolu daba. Izinkomba zokuhlukumeza: Lokhu kungabandakanya ama-bruises, izibazi, ukushisa, ukuhlinzwa, nokunye. Ukuhlukumeza kwemizwa: Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomntwana zokuthanda, ukunakwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuxhumana ngendlela yokunakekela, ukubanqanda, ukubathukutheleza ngokuqinile, noma imizamo yokubakhathaza. Ukunganaki: Lokhu kuwukwehluleka ukuvikela umntwana ezinsongweni noma kunoma yini, ezimweni ezibandayo, indlala, nokwehluleka ukwenza okudingekayo ukuze baphathwe, nokunye. Izinsizakalo zomphakathi zizovakashela umntwana nomndeni wakhe ukuze zihlaziye isimo futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi umntwana udinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa. Uma umhlukumezi ophakanyisiwe ehlala endlini efanayo nomntwana, bangacelwa ukuba bashiye bahlale kwenye indawo. Uma lokhu kungatholakali, umntwana angahlala nabakhelwane, abangane, izihlobo, noma endaweni yokuphepha yezingane okwesikhashana. Nokho, kuphela uma impilo yomntwana isengozini. Umgomo wokugcina umntwana nomndeni wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu. Uma kuthathwa isinqumo, kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi yini ebaluleke kakhulu kumntwana ukuze athole inzuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Imindeni nezingane zingxenye yanoma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwayo mayelana nesimo abhekene naso. Nokho, ukuhluza kuphela kulolu daba akuthinti amalungelo abazali bomntwana noma abakhathaleli. Ilungelo lithinteka kuphela uma kudingeka kuthathwe isinyathelo somthetho (isibonelo: ukususa umntwana).
UMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe nguHulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezilungelo zakhe, futhi umthetho kazwelonke kufanele udalwe ukuze ulethe umphumela kulolu lungelo. I-Information Regulator yasungulwa ukuze inikeze izeluleko kuMphathi Wolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso ezenziwe nguMphathi Osenhliziyweni mayelana nezicelo zolwazi futhi ikwazi ukusiza uMphathi Wolwazi kanye nezikhungo ezifanele mayelana nokucubungula izikhalazo. Amakomidi amancane okweluleka ngolwazi (IAASC's) nawo asungulwa ukuze anikeze izeluleko kuMphathi Osenhliziyweni mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. Ihhovisi lolwazi leMnyango Wezokuvikela lasungulwa njengesisekelo sokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Ihhovisi lolwazi lizosisiza labo abathumele izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalungu omphakathi ukuthi abone isithombe noma uhlobo lwezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi ifaka izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulwazi nezincwadi nokuthi zikhona yini. Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwenhlangano, ukuphepha kwezifunda nezendawo ngokulandela amakhono nezobuchwepheshe bokuphepha abukhali, besimanje futhi abafinyeleleka kalula. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inezibopho zokuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, kanye nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule nenempumelelo kubo bonke. Iphinde isekele noma yisiphi isikhungo sikahulumeni esihloselwe ukuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela iqukethe uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uMphathiswa Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF). UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumlawuli ophakeme, uMphathiswa Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophethe ukusebenza kwezezimali zeMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanti uMphathi Wezokuvikela unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha nokuphatha iNhlangano Yezokuvikela. Ihhovisi lolwazi leMnyango Wezokuvikela lizophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Umgcinim records kanye nehistori yeMnyango Wezokuvikela unomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina amarekhodi nehistori. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), kanye nemithetho ethile, nezikhombisi ezithunyelwe kuzo zonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphathelene nezokuphepha kwenhlangano kanye nokuhola umkhombandlela wenqubomgomo yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, ukuqapha, nokwamukela inqubomgomo, isu, nezinhlelo zokuphepha ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo kazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuphezulu, okuphumelelayo, nokuziphatha kahle kwezokuphepha. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. UMsunguli ungumholi weMisebenzi efanayo kanye nosizo lwabantu abahluphekayo. Ukuphatha nokubheka iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ukuze kusekelwe ukuvikelwa komhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngemicibisholo mayelana nenqubomgomo yokuvikelwa komhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwezempi ngokuhambisana nosizo oluhambisanayo. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ukuze kusekelwe nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula umkhombandlela wenqubomgomo yokwelashwa kwezempi nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina usizo lwezempilo olubalulekile kubalimi beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezincwadi zabo noma labo abaxhaswe ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zosizo nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe lokuvikela nolwazi lwezobuchwepheshe ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina usizo lwezobuchwepheshe emkhakheni wezokuvikela, usizo, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezokusebenza. Ukuhola umsebenzi wabasebenzi kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezemfundo kubantu bezempi abakhathalela bonke amalungu eMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezincwadi zabo futhi kuthuthukiswe ukukhula kokomoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngemicibisholo evela kwezempi. Ukuhlinzeka nginqubomgomo yokuxhumana kwezokuvikela, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nenqubomgomo yeMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nenqubomgomo yokuxhumana kazwelonke (GCIS) futhi isebenza njengesisekelo sokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuphumelelayo, okuphumelelayo, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nababambiqhaza bawo. Ukuhlinzeka inhlangano ngosizo lwezomthetho olusemthethweni, olugunyaziwe, nolusekela ngokuhambisana nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukusiza iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngolwazi namakhono kwezobudlelwano bamazwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngamakhono nezindlela zamaphoyisa kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngentuthuko yobungcweti ukuze kuvinjwe futhi kudalwe amathuba okufunda ngokusebenza. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphelele kubasebenzi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo okungahlangene nokulwa kumuntu ngamunye weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekuthumeleni kolwazi nezinsiza ezihlobene kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi kusekela izinhloso zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Uhlu lwezincwadi (theses) ezigcinwe yiHhovisi Lezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela (Uhlu lutholakala eHhovisi Lezincwadi zeMnyango Wezokuvikela). Amarekhodi akhona ezinqolobaneni zeMnyango Wezokuvikela aqala ngo-1912 lapho i-Union Defence Force (UDF) yasungulwa. Amarekhodi akhona ezinqolobaneni kusukela eminyakeni ka-1912 kuya ku-1969 akhombisa imisebenzi eyinhloko yezingxenye zonke ze-UDF kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SADF). Imisebenzi emikhulu ihlobene nokusungulwa, ukuphathwa, kanye nezici zobuchwepheshe bezokusebenza kwezempi futhi iphinde ibheke ezimweni ngesikhathi sokulwa nangesikhathi sokuthula. Amarekhodi okwenziwa afaka ulwazi mayelana nokubamba kwaseNingizimu Afrika kwiMpi Yezwe I (1914 - 1918) kanye neMpi Yezwe II (1939 - 1945), iBerlin Airlift (1948 - 1949), kanye neMpi yaseKorea (1950 - 1953) kanye nokusungulwa kwempi nezivivinyo ngesikhathi sokuphazamiseka kwangaphakathi ezweni njengeziteleka
UMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nguhulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimali zakhe, futhi ukuthi umthetho kazwelonke kumele usungulwe ukuze uthuthukise leli lungelo.
