Ngokwezinhlinzeko zalesi sikhathi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela unqunyelwe njengomphakathi wezolwazi (IO), kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli ophakathi (RA) weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Abaphathi Bokwesekwa Nabantu Bokuqashwa bamenywa njengezikhonzi eziphakeme zezindaba (DIOs). Lezi zikhonzi zizohlinzeka ngosizo olwamukelekayo kubalaleli bomphakathi ekufinyeleleni ulwazi uma kwenziwa izicelo zokurekhoda ezivela eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Ikomidi Lezokwelulekwa Kolwazi (IAAC) lisunguliwe ukuze lihlolisise umphakathi wezolwazi ngeziphakamiso ezenziwe ngababambiqhaza bezindaba eziphezulu mayelana nezicelo zolwazi futhi linciphise umphakathi wezolwazi kanye nomgibeli ophakathi mayelana nezinqubo zokuphikisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaKhomidi Amancane Ezokwelulekwa Kolwazi (IAASC's) asunguliwe ukuze ahlinzeke ngokuqonda kwabaphakanyisi bezindaba mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. Isikhungo Solwazi seMnyango Wezokuvikela sisunguliwe njengendawo yokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Isikhungo Solwazi sizosiza labo abathumele izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalungu omphakathi ukuthi abone uhlobo noma uhlobo lwezincwadi ezigcinwe eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela futhi kufaka phakathi izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani ulwazi nezincwadi nokuthi bangazithola kanjani ngqo noma ngqo. Ulwazi ngokweSigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000). Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwazwelonke, futhi ikhuthaza ukuphepha ezingeni lesizwe, lesifunda, kanye nezwe jikelele ngokulandela amakhono avikelekile, anamuhla, atholakalayo kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphambili. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inikezwa ukuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule futhi ethuthukayo kubo bonke. Iphinde ibheke noma yimuphi umnyango kahulumeni ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela iqukethe uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF). UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli onamandla, uNobhala Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophethe ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nomphakathi weMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanti umphakathi weMpi unomsebenzi wokuyala nokulawula iMpi. Ukuba Isikhungo Solwazi seMnyango Wezokuvikela esizophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali lukamasipala eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), nemithetho yeTreasury, kanye nezikhumbuzo ezithunyelwe kubo bonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda kwezokuphepha kwazwelonke nezindaba zokuhola indlela yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, ukubheka, nokwamukela umthetho, isu, kanye nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nemigomo kazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, okucophelela, nokuphumelelayo kwemisebenzi yokuvikela. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungiswa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Umsunguli ungumHead of Equal Opportunities and Support for the previously Discriminated. Ukuphatha nokulawula iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ahlobene nokuvikela umhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa mayelana nenqubomgomo yokuvikela umhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwempi ngosizo oluhlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ahlobene nokwesekwa nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula umkhankaso wezokwelapha wokwesekwa kwezempilo ezinhlelweni zempi kanye nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukwesekwa kwezempilo okubalulekile kubalaleli beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezixhaso zabo noma labo abaxhaswa ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zokwesekwa nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezobuhlakani ekuzivikeleni nasekulawuleni ulwazi lwezobuhlakani mayelana nokuphikisana ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina uxhaso lwezobuhlakani lweMpi, ukusiza ekwesekeni, nakwezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezinto ezisebenzayo. Ukuhlela umsebenzi wabasebenzi beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezemfundo kubo bonke abalaleli beMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezixhaso zabo futhi kukhuthaze ukukhula kokomoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuqondisa okuvela enhlanganweni yempi. Ukusungula umthetho wokuxhumana wezokuvikela, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nemigomo yeMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nemigomo yokuxhumana kazwelonke (GCIS) futhi kube isikhungo sokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okucophelela, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nezithakazelo zayo. Ukuhlinzeka inhlangano ngosizo lwezomthetho olukhethekile, usizo oluqinisekisiwe nolusekelayo ngokuhambisana nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngolwazi namakhono mayelana nezinsiza zokuvikela zangaphandle nezinsiza ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezobupolisa kuMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngentuthuko yezobuchwepheshe ukuvimbela nokwakha amathuba okufunda ngokuqashwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphelele kubasebenzi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo olungahlangene nokulwa kumuntu ngamunye weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekudluliseni kolwazi nezinsiza ezihlobene kuMnyango Wezokuvikela nokweseka lokho okwenziwa nguMnyango Wezokuvikela. Inhloso yalolu mthetho ukuveza ilungelo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela noma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe uMbuso noma olunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze lusetshenziswe noma luvikelwe nganoma yiluphi ilungelo. Inhloso ukuhlela isiko lokuvuleka nokubopha emiphakathini yomphakathi nezizinda ezizimele futhi ukukhuthaza umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika
I-SARS iqukethe inani elikhulu lolwazi eliqoqwa ngesikhathi ikwenza imisebenzi yayo yansuku zonke yokuhola imali yokuthola intela kuhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke kanye nezintela zebhizinisi ezisiza ekuqhubekeni kwalezi zinhlelo. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile kubantu abathintekayo ngqo, okubandakanya abakhokhi bentela, abathengisi, ababambiqhaza ebhizinisini, noma abasebenzi. Kubalulekile futhi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, abakhuphukeli bezebhizinisi, abameli, kanye nabathengisi ngenhloso yokuthengisa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi yonke inzuzo iboniswa kwi-SARS ngabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi, umthetho we-SARS ophathelene nokuvikelwa kolwazi olugcinwe yi-SARS uqinisekisa ukuthi lonke ulwazi mayelana nabakhokhi bentela nabathengisi luyimfihlo futhi alunakukhululwa ngaphandle kwezimo ezithile eziphuthumayo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 ("umthetho") uqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kwalolu lwazi, uhlinzeka ngokuqhubeka kokuba imfihlo ngaphansi kwemvume yomthetho, ngaphandle komuntu onelungelo lokuyithola noma kumuntu onemvume yokuthola lolu lwazi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthetho ubhekisela ekuvikelweni kokudluliswa kwebhizinisi le-SARS lapho lokhu kungase kube kubalulekile. Lezi zihloko ezilandelayo zichaza i-SARS, izinqubo zokucela ulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti e-SARS, futhi uma kudingeka, izinqubo zangaphakathi zokufaka izikhalazo ngaphansi komthetho. I-SARS isungule umnyango owodwa wezicelo nezikhalazo emahhovisi ayo amakhulu ukuze kube lula ukulandelela nokuphendula ngaphakathi kwezikhathi ezibekiwe umthetho, kanye nokuzivumelanisa nanoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingenzeka ngokushesha. Lokhu kuhambelana nesiko eliphakanyiswa yi-SARS lokwenza izinto ngokusobala, njengoba umthetho uhlinzeka, kanye nokuhlonipha izimiso zokubopha, ubuqotho, kanye nokwethembeka kulabo i-SARS ihlanganyela nabo. Umphathiswa we-SARS nguMphathiswa weMali yaseNingizimu Afrika, uMnu. Pravin Gordhan. Phansi kwakhe kukhona abaphathiswa abane be-SARS, abaphatha izicelo zokufinyelela kolwazi olugcinwe yi-SARS njengoba umthetho ubhala njalo. Umpathiswa ngamunye unendawo ethile yomsebenzi ngokuya ngokuqonda kwabo nolwazi lomsebenzi, futhi banikezwa le ndawo ukuze basebenze ngayo ngokwazi kwabo kanye nesipiliyoni. Uma ufuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi olukhona kumadokhumenti agcinwe yi-SARS, kufanele uqedele ifomu eliku-Anexure 1 bese ulithumela kumphathiswa ofanele. Abaphathiswa basebenzisa ihhovisi elifanayo kanye neposi. Umphathiswa ofanele uzophendula ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-30 (60 ezimweni ezithile) ukukwazisa ukuthi isicelo sakho sivunyelwe noma sikhishwe. Ezinye izimo, ungase udinge ukukhokha imali ku-SARS ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho samukelwe noma ufike kumarekhodi owacelile. Uma ukucubungula isicelo sakho kungadlula amahora ayisithupha, i-SARS izoqhubeka nokulungiselela ulwazi oluceliwe ngemuva kokuthi ukhokhe imali edingekayo. Isicelo sakho sizothunyelwa kuwe ngendlela oyicelile noma ngendlela ulwazi olugcinwe kumadokhumenti, uma kungekho indlela oyicelile. Lokhu kuyikhasi lokuqala lokushicilelwa kwedokhumenti mayelana nokusebenza komthetho we-SARS ngokomthetho. Kuzokhula futhi kukhule njengoba i-SARS nabaceli bolwazi behlola ukusebenza kahle kwalomthetho, kanye nokulinganisa ilungelo lokufinyelela kolwazi nezinye izimfanelo ezinikwe umthetho, njengokuphila, kanye nesidingo sokugcina uMbuso usebenza kahle. Imithetho ngaphansi kokuhlanganiswa kokuqala, amanothi achazayo, nezinye. Ulwazi lokuxhumana nezikhulu zomnyango. Ulwazi olutholakalayo ngaphandle kwesicelo. Ukuqedela ifomu lesicelo. Ukwenza isinqumo mayelana nesicelo sakho. Umhlahlandlela Womphakathi Wezobuntu. Ukuqoqa izintela; nokulawula ukungena kwezimpahla ezweni, ezithunyelwa ngaphandle kwezwe, ezikhiqizwayo, ezithunyelwa, ezigcinwayo, futhi zisetshenziswe ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo. Umthetho ophatha intela yokuthengiswa kwezabelo (stocks), ka-1948. Umthetho ophatha ukuqoqa intela lapho kudluliswa ubunikazi bezakhiwo ka-1949. Umthetho wokuqoqa intela kwemali yokuhlala, ka-1955. Umthetho wokuqoqa intela ngemali engenayo nezindleko, ka-1962. Umthetho wokuqoqa intela ngezimpahla ezingena nangaphandle kwezwe, ka-1964. Umthetho wokuqoqa intela ngentengo, ka-1991. Imithetho ehlukene ebhalwe kuSheduli 1 yomthetho ophatha i-South African Revenue Service, ka-1997. noma yimuphi umthetho, ithuluzi elisemthethweni, isaziso sikahulumeni, noma umyalo owenziwe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla noma noma yisiphi isivumelwano esenziwe ngokulandela le mithetho noma umthethosisekelo noma yimuphi umthetho ophathelene nokuhweba intela noma ophatha ukuthunyelwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile ezingadluliselwa kwi-SARS ngokomthetho noma isivumelwano phakathi kwe-SARS nezinhlaka zikahulumeni noma ibhodi efanele (njengokuhweba intela ngaphandle kokuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nezinkokhelo zomshuwalense wokungasebenzi). kanye konke okuphathene nentela; namandla anikezwe uNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nale mithetho engenhla; nokunikeza izeluleko kuNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni mayelana konke okuphathene nokulawula ukuthunyelwa nokungeniswa kwezimpahla ezweni, ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, ukuthuthwa, ukugcinwa, noma ukusetshenziswa kwezimpahla ezithile. Inhloso yayo wukuthi intela eqoqwe ikhiqize izinzuzo ezibonakalayo, isiza ukuhweba futhi yengeze kubakhokhi bentela ngokwethula abakhokhi bentela abasha ezincwadini ngokukhuthaza ukuqwashisa ngentela ukuze abantu bazi futhi babhekane nesibopho sabo sokuxhasa lo mnyango nemithetho yentela nezohwebo yaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakeme olwakhelwe ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Nakuba i-SARS inomsebenzi wokubhala imithetho yentela, iyakwenza ngaphansi kokubhekwa nokuphatha kukaNgqongqoshe Wezemali, futhi kwesinye isikhathi uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Ngakho-ke, amadokhumenti akhishwe uMnyango WezeMali noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ngokuhambisana nalomthetho kufanele abhekwe mayelana nendima yomphakathi ekwakhiweni kwemigomo. Ngokwesimo nasenhlosweni yomthetho ophakanyisiwe, kungase kuqale ngokukhishwa kwedokhumenti yokuxoxisana echaza inqubo okufanele ilandelwe nokumema umphakathi ukuba uphinde uphonsa itshe emfuleni ngokuphawula. Njengoba iPhalamende njengamanje ingenawo amandla okushintsha i-Finance Bill uma isethuliwe, uhlelo luqale ukugqugquzela umphakathi ukuba uphawule futhi ube yingxenye yokuxoxisana ngaphambi kokuthi isethulwe. Lolu hlelo luqala ngokukhishwa kwe-SARS komthetho wezomthetho ezinsukwini eziyishumi zokusebenza ngaphambi kokuh
Le ncwadi iqukethe ulwazi olujwayelekile mayelana nezifundo zokuhlola. Ulwazi oluthile mayelana nezifundo zokuhlola ozohlanganyela kuzo noma okukhuthazwa ukuba uhlanganyele kuzo kumele lunikezwe yilabo abahola uphenyo lwezifundo. Uphenyo lwezokwelapha luyisifundo sokucwaninga esihloselwe ukuhlola ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, nokusebenza kwemithi emisha noma ekhona, izindlela zokwelapha, noma amadivayisi ezokwelapha, usebenzisa ababambiqhaza. Ukuphepha kubhekisela ekutheni ukwelashwa noma imithi kungase kube nezingozi noma umonakalo empilweni yomuntu. Ukusebenza kahle kusho ukuthi kukhona umphumela ekutholeni, ekwelapheni, ekugwemeni, noma ekwelapheni isifo. Lokhu kungase kudinge ukuqhathanisa imiphumela phakathi kwemithi/izindlela zokwelapha ezimbili. Ikhwalithi ibhekisela ekwethembekeni okuphelele kwemithi noma ukwelashwa, noma ukungenelela kwezokwelapha okuvumela ukuba kusebenze kahle nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kulezo zimo ezilindelekile ngesikhathi sokwelashwa komuntu ogulayo, ngaphandle kokubeka engcupheni umsebenzisi wemithi. Igama elithi "imithi" libhekisela emithini esetshenziselwa ukwelapha izifo (imithi yokwelapha), ukuvimbela izifo (imithi yokuvimbela, efana nezivithamini), kanye nemithi esetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuhlola okuthile (imithi yokuhlola, efana naleyo esetshenziswa kuma-X-ray ukuthola izitho zomzimba). Ngaphambi kokuthi imithi noma ukwelashwa kuhlolwe kubantu, kuqala kufundwa isikhathi eside ezikhungweni zokucwaninga nasemathunjini ahlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokusebenza kahle kwayo. Ukuhlola imithi emisha, izivithamini, nezindlela zokwelapha kubantu kuvame ukuhamba ngezinyathelo eziningi njengoba kuchazwe ngezansi. Isigaba sokuqala: Lesi yisigaba sokuqala lapho imithi, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kuhlolwa eqenjini elincane labazithandayo abaphilile. Izifundo zokuhlola isigaba sokuqala zihloselwe ukuhlola ukuphepha okuphelele, umthamo ophephile, nemiphumela emibi engase ibe khona yemithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa. Isigaba sesibili: Esigabeni sesibili, imithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kuhlolwa eqenjini elikhulu labantu, ngokuvamile amakhulu abantu abaphilile kanye nalabo abane sifo okufanele silashwe ngemithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa. Inhloso yezifundo zesigaba sesibili wukuhlola okwengeziwe ukuphepha nokusebenza kahle kwemithi, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kusebenza. Isigaba sesithathu: Kulesi sigaba, imithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kuhlolwa kumakhulu kuya ezinkulungwaneni zabantu abane sifo okufanele silashwe ngemithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa. Inhloso yezifundo zesigaba sesithathu wukuhlola okwengeziwe ukusebenza kahle nemiphumela emibi engase ibe khona yemithi, izivithamini, noma enye indlela yokwelapha emisha uma kuqhathaniswa nemithi, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa okukhona (okunevumelekile). Isigaba sesine: Kulesi sigaba, ukuhlolwa kwenziwa ngemuva kokuthi imithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kube kuqoshwe yi-MCC, okusho ukuthi ngemuva kokuthi imithi, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa kube kuqoshwe, ithole ne-licence yokuthengisa. Ukuphepha, ukusebenza kahle, nemiphumela emibi yesikhathi eside kuhlolwa emithini emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo njengezingane, abantu abadala, abantu abanezinselelo zezinso, nezifo zezinso, kanye nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa (izinkomba) imithi emisha, izivithamini, noma ukwelashwa. Izigaba zalesi sikhathi ngasinye zinezinhloso zazo ezithile nezinsiza ezithile, izingozi, nemiphumela emibi. Kuwo wonke amazinga ezifundo, ababambiqhaza ocwaningweni bavame ukukhokhelwa nganoma yiziphi imiphumela emibi abangase bayihlangabezane nayo noma nganoma yiziphi imiphumela engalindelekile. Imiphumela emibi ingabandakanya noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezimpawu ezimbi nezingenalindelekile, izimpawu, noma izifo ezihlobene nemithi/ukwelashwa okukhuluma ngakho. Imithi yokuhlola iyimithi emisha noma etholelwa muva (imithi) esaqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa. Imithi ethengiswayo iyimithi esivele iqoshwe nezinhlaka ezilawulayo (MCC) futhi ingasetshenziswa njengokwelashwa kwezinhlobo ezithile zezifo. Le mithi idlule esigabeni sokuthuthukiswa, futhi ikhwalithi yayo, ukuphepha, nokusebenza kahle sekwaziwa. Imithi ethengiswayo ibizwa nangokuthi imithi enevumelekile noma imithi eqoshiwe. Umkhiqizo wokuhlola ungumuthi (imithi)/izivithamini (izivithamini)/noma ukwelashwa (imikhiqizo yezokwelapha) okukhuluma ngakho ukuze kuhlolwe ikhwalithi, ukuphepha, nokusebenza kahle uma kwenziwa isifundo sokuhlola esithile. Kungase kube nemikhiqizo engaphezu kweyodwa esifundweni esithile. Imikhiqizo yokuhlola ingabandakanya imithi, izivithamini, noma imikhiqizo yezokwelapha ezibhalisiwe noma ezingabhaliswanga noma imikhiqizo esaphenywa. Umxhaso ungumuntu, inkampani, isikhungo, noma inhlangano enesibopho sokwakha, ukuphatha, nokuxhasa isifundo sokuhlola. Abaxhasi bavame ukuba abakhiqizi bezokwelapha, izikhungo zikamasipala, izikhungo zocwaningo, iHhovisi leMhlaba leMpilo, ohulumeni baphesheya, njll. Umphenyi ungumuntu onemfundo efanelekile onenhloso yokuhlela, ukwenza, ukuhlaziya, nokubika ngalesi sifundo esithile. Abaphenyisi bavame ukusebenza ndawonye njengeqembu. Umphenyi ophambili ubizwa nge-Principal Investigator (PI). I-PI inenhloso yokuphatha izenzo ezihilela umxhaso kanye nezikhungo ezilawulayo. Abaphenyisi bangabandakanya odokotela abelapha, ososayensi bezokwelapha, abaphenyi bemithi, ochwepheshe bezempilo yengqondo, noma amalungu omkhakha wezokwelapha, njll. Noma ubani okhetha ukuhlanganyela noma osevele wahlanganyela ocwaningweni (okuhambisana nabo) esifundweni sokuhlola unelungelo lokuhlinzeka ngovuma olunembile. Umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika inombolo 108 ka-1996: Isigaba 12 sithi "wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhlonishwa kokuphila kwabo komzimba nangokwengqondo, okuhlanganisa nelungelo - (c) lokungasetshenziswa ocwaningweni lwezokwelapha noma lwezesayensi ngaphandle kokuhlinzeka ngovuma olunembile kuqala." Yini ukuvuma okunembile? Ukuvuma okunembile kuyinqubo ekhona mayelana (futhi efanele) ukuhlanganyela ocwaningweni okuhlanganisa ukufunda ngamaqiniso abalulekile mayelana nesifundo sokuhlola esithile esizokwenziwa ukuze umuntu akwazi ukwenza isinqumo sokuthi aqhubeke noma cha futhi ahlanganyele kulolo phiko lokuhlola. Ukuvuma okunembile akukhona nje ukusayina ifomu lokuvuma futhi akuyona inkontileka, kodwa kuyisendlalelo sokuvuma kumuntu ozohlanganyela ocwaningweni. Ukuvuma kwakho okunembile kuyidingo ebalulekile ocwaningweni ehambisana nezindinganiso zokuziphatha nezocwaningo lwe
Ukusebenza komthetho weMali yoMphakathi. B. Uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng ubonisile ukuthi kukhona isidingo sokuba necebo lokusiza amabhizinisi amancane elidlula izinhlelo zikahulumeni ezikhona kanye nezikhungo zezimali ukuze kusekelwe amabhizinisi amancane ngezimali nangokunye. "Ibhodi" ibhekisela ebhodini le-GEP elisunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba sesikhombisa somthetho. "Umnyango" ubhekisela kumnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba esifundeni. "Inhloko yoMnyango" ibhekisela enhlokweni yomnyango ophathe izindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Umthetho" ubonisa umthetho wesifunda. "MEC" kusho ilungu lekhansela elibhekene nezindaba zokuhweba kulesi sifunda. "Kwenziwe" kusho okwenziwe ngumlomo womthetho. "Isifunda" kusho isifunda saseGauteng. "Umthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi" ubhekisela kumthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi, Umthetho 1 ka-1999. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa uhlu nezinye izinqubo ezihlobene. Ukusebenza komthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi. Ezimali njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 492 a somthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi, b I-MEC iyinhlangano yeKhabhinethi njengoba kubhalwe esigabeni esiyimfihlo somthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi c Noma yini eyenziwe yiBhodi mayelana nomthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi kumele ihambisane nalokho okukhuluma ngakho esigabeni esiyimfihlo somthetho. Akukho lutho kulomthetho olunamandla okukhansela imithetho esunguliwe yi-GEP ngaphansi komthetho wokuphathwa kwezimali zomphakathi. d Ukuqaliswa nokuqhubeka komjikelezo wezinsizakalo zokukhulisa indima edlalwa amabhizinisi amancane emnothweni waseGauteng. e Ukuqhubeka nokukhula komnotho, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, nokulingana. f Ukuhlanganisa bonke abasebenzi abasukuma amabhizinisi amancane asekelwe nguhulumeni ngezimali eGauteng. g Ukuqinisa amandla alabo abahlinzeka ngosizo kumabhizinisi amancane. a Ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokweseka osomabhizinisi ngezimali, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulokhu. Usizo lokubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi, izindaba zezimali nezomthetho. Ukuqeqeshwa ngezakhono zekhompyutha nezinye izakhono. v Ikhono lokufinyelela ulwazi oluvela kuhulumeni nezikhuthazo. Izeluleko zokuhweba okungena nokuphuma. Izeluleko ngezobudlelwano bezithakazelo, ukumaketha, nocwaningo. b Ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokweseka osomabhizinisi ngezimali, kodwa hhayi kuphela kulokhu. i Ngokwesigaba sesine, bahlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa. Futhi bahlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezikweletu. c Ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokweseka labo abahlinzeka ngosizo nezinye izithakazelo kulokhu. d Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo eyodwa yokusiza osomabhizinisi. Kuzosiza ukuqinisa ukusungulwa kwayo, ukuqhubeka, nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo zokweluleka amabhizinisi amancane. Ukuqaliswa kwezindlela ezizolandela ukuze kuthuthukiswe amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwenza izinhlelo ezingeni lesifunda, lezwe, kanye nezamazwe omhlaba ukuze kudonswe labo abafuna ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda. Ukuthuthukisa izindlela zokubambisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi nezinye izinhlobo zokubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi nezinye izinhlangano kulesi sifunda, eRiphabhulikhi, nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuhlanganisa, ukusiza, nokubambisana nezithakazelo nezikhungo ezifuna ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ukubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezikhuthaza futhi zikhulisa amabhizinisi amancane. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezimali ezinhlelweni ezithuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kulesi sifunda. a Ukwakha amabhizinisi aqinile futhi akhangayo, b Ukukhuthaza osomabhizinisi. c Ukudala indawo efanele yokusebenza yamabhizinisi amancane. d Ukufinyelela kalula kumabhizinisi amancane ukuze bathole usizo lwezimali nezinye izinsiza, nokuthi basebenzise kanjani lokho. e Ukufinyelela kalula kumabhizinisi amancane kuleli nakwamanye amazwe. Ukukhuthaza, ukuhlanganisa, nokukhuthaza uhulumeni bendawo, izinhlangano ezizimele, nezinye izithakazelo ukuba zisebenzisane ukuze i-GEP ifinyelele imigomo yayo. Ukuhola nokuhlela ucwaningo oluhlobene nezinhlelo ezisiza amabhizinisi amancane. Ukwandisa ukuqwashisa komphakathi mayelana nendima yamabhizinisi amancane ekukhuleni komnotho wendawo, ukudalwa kwemisebenzi, nokuphila kahle. Ukuqaliswa kwezakhiwo zendawo nezifunda ukuze kuzuze imigomo yayo ngempumelelo. Ukwenza eminye imithetho ephathelene nalomthetho. Umthetho uyisisekelo seBhodi nokukhethwa kwamalungu. Ngaphambi kokukhetha amalungu eBhodi, i-MEC kumele ixhumane ngezaziso kwiGazethi yesifunda, iziphakamiso zamakhandidethi afanelekayo ukuze akhethwe. a Representa ingxenye ebalulekile yokuhlala kweGauteng, igxile kumasiko, ubulili, ukungakwazi, ukusabalalisa kwezindawo, nezikhungo ezikwiindawo zokuhweba. Umthetho osebenzayo kumabhizinisi amancane. I-MEC ingasungula noma yiziphi izinqubo ezizolandela ekukhetheni amalungu. I-CEO iyilungu leBhodi ngenxa yesikhundla asibamba. Bonke amalungu eBhodi, ngaphandle kwe-CEO, bakhethwa ngasikhathi sinye. a Ilungu leBhodi njengomholi. b Elinye ilungu njengomphakathi ophakeme ukuze enze njengomholi weBhodi uma umholi engakwazi ukwenza le msebenzi. b Ilungu lezigungu, izigungu zesifunda, umkhandlu wesifunda, noma umholi wesiko osunguliwe ngaphansi komthetho kazwelonke. c Umuntu ophoqelekile. d Umuntu onezinkinga zengqondo noma onedokhumenti esemthethweni ethi lowo muntu unengqondo engalungile noma ungenakho. f Umuntu osuswe emsebenzini ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi. g Umuntu osuswe eBhodi ngenxa yokwephula imithetho yayo. Ilungu leBhodi kumele likhishwe esikhundleni uma lelo lungu lenze noma yiziphi zezinto ezishiwo esigabeni sokuqala. a Ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi, ukungabi nolwazi, nokungafaneleki. b Ngenxa yokwehluleka ukuhambisana nesigaba 8 2 noma 151. c Uma ilungu ingahambeli emihlanganweni yeBhodi ngokulandelana ngaphandle kwesizathu esifanele, d Noma ngenye imbangela efanelekile. IBhodi ingakhulula ilungu ngemuva kokunikeza ithuba lokuchaza izinkinga zayo. Isikhathi sokusebenza kwamalungu eBhodi. a Kungaba iminyaka emithathu, b Kungaba ngaphansi kwemithetho ebekwe yi-MEC kanye naleyo ebhalwe emqulwini wokukhetha ilungu. Uma ilungu likhishwa noma lishiya esikhundleni, i-MEC ingakhetha omunye umuntu esikhundleni salo lolu lungu kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi noma kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi esibekwe yi-MEC ngokwesigaba. Ngokwesigaba 8, umuntu angakhethwa futhi isikhathi sokusebenza kwabo singaqiniswa uma bengakhethwanga ezikhathini ezimbili ezilandelanayo. I-MEC kumele ihlukanise ukuthi malini amalungu
Siyabonga kakhulu ukwethula le ncwadi. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni wethu wasayina iMvumelwano yeZizwe Ezihlangene Ngamalungelo Ezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sivumelene ukuhlonipha imithetho ekhethekile mayelana nokuthi izingane kufanele ziphathwe kanjani emhlabeni jikelele. Uma singahloniphi le mithetho, sizoba nenkinga enkulu neZizwe Ezihlangene! Kodwa okukhombisile lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi, nakuba iMvumelwano ikhuluma ngezingane, ayibhaliwe ngendlela yokuthi izingane zikwazi ukuyiqonda kalula. Sazibuza, yini inzuzo yale nto? Ngempela, ingabe izingane akufanele zikwazi ukuqonda amalungelo azo? Yingakho sathatha isinqumo sokukubhalela le ncwadi. Amalungelo akule ncwadi akho. Ayahlonishwa yizingane zonke eNingizimu Afrika nakuzo zonke izingane emhlabeni jikelele. Akekho ongakuthatha la malungelo. Ngakho qiniseka ukuthi uyawazi! Siyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe lethu! Futhi qiniseka ukuthi uyakujabulela kakhulu! Nginezingane ezingezami. Ngakho ngiyazi ukuthi into ebaluleke kakhulu kumntwana ukujabula, uthole uthando, futhi uzwe. Le ncwadi ikhuluma ngamalungelo ezingane zokuzizwa ziphephile futhi zivikela ezweni lethu. Ngizibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi uyazi amalungelo akho nokuthi bonke abantu abaphakathi kwami basebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuvikela wena, imindeni yakho, nabangane bakho. Ngiyabona futhi ukuthi njengamanje, njengengane, udinga ukuzizwa uphephile, uvikelwe, uqashelwe, futhi unakekelwe. Ngiyazi ngoba ngangiyingane futhi. Ngakho umsebenzi wami ukuqinisekisa ukuthi labo abenza ubugebengu ezinganeni baboshwa futhi bajeziswe ngendlela efanele. Ngithatha umsebenzi wami ngok serious futhi ngizimisele ukuvikela wena. Le ncwadi ikuwe futhi izokusiza ukuthi wazi ukuthi yikuphi ukuziphatha okungamukeleki nokuthi ungabika kanjani labo abadala nezingane abaphula amalungelo akho. Zingane zonke emhlabeni kufanele zijabulele la malungelo. Sonke singamalungu omndeni omkhulu wabantu. Sinezingane nezizalwane emhlabeni wonke. Eminyakeni edlule, ngaphambi kokuba uzalwe, ohulumeni bomhlaba bahlangana ukuze bakhe uhulumeni womhlaba obizwa ngeZizwe Ezihlangene. Labo bahulumeni bavumelana ukuthi wonke umuntu emndenini wethu wabantu unelungelo lokukhululeka, ubulungiswa, nokuthula emhlabeni. Wonke umuntu kusho wonke umuntu ngempela. Akukhathalekile ukuthi siqhamuka kuphi noma ukuthi singobani. Noma ngabe sicebile noma sicebile noma sitholakala phakathi. Noma ngabe umbala wesikhumba sethu, ubuzwe, noma inkolo yethu iyini. Noma ngabe singamadoda, abesifazane, amantombazane, noma abafana. Kodwa kuyacaca ukuthi izingane zidinga ukunakekelwa nokusizwa kakhulu kunabantu abadala. Yingakho iMvumelwano Ngamalungelo Ezingane yamukelwa yiZizwe Ezihlangene ngomhla ka-20 Novemba 1989. Kunezizathu eziningi ezikwenza iZizwe Ezihlangene ikhathazeke kakhulu ngezingane futhi ikholelwa ukuthi amalungelo akhethekile adingeka. Okokuqala, iZizwe Ezihlangene ikholelwa ngokuqinile ukuthi izingane zikhula kahle kakhulu emndenini noma ekhaya lapho zingajabula, zithandwa, futhi zizwa zikhuluma. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imindeni nalabo abanakekela izingane kufanele ivikelwe ukuze bakwazi ukunakekela izingane zabo futhi bazisize zikhule. Okwesibili, izingane zidinga ukukhula ngendlela ezokwenza zibe ngabantu abadala abangakwazi ukubhekana nezinto abazidingayo futhi babe amalungu emiphakathini yabo. Kufanele zifundiswe ukuphila emhlabeni ngokuthula, ngenhlonipho, ngesineke, ngokukhululeka, ngokulingana, nangobumbano. Okwesithathu, imibhalo eminingi ehlukene yomhlaba nezimemezelo zicela ukunakekelwa okukhethekile, inhlalakahle, ukuphathwa, nokuvikelwa kwezingane. Kwenza kube kuhle ukubhala konke phansi kumqulu owodwa - umqulu wezingane kuphela. Okwesine, nakuba wonke umuntu efuna zonke izingane zikhule zijabule futhi zifezekile, iZizwe Ezihlangene iyazi ukuthi, ezweni jikelele, izingane eziningi zihlala ezimweni ezinzima kakhulu. Ngenxa yalezi nezinye izizathu, kuhle ukuba neMvumelwano ekhethekile Ngamalungelo Ezingane. Le Mvumelwano ikhuluma ngazo zonke izinkinga nezinkinga ezingane emhlabeni jikelele ezingase zibe nazo kanye nawo wonke amalungelo akhethekile okufanele abe nawo izingane. Le yimizamo yakho futhi kubalulekile ukuthi wazi ngayo nokuthi ikhuluma ngani. Iqukethe izingxenye ezahlukene (iZizwe Ezihlangene ziyibiza ngokuthi "izindatshana"). Ibhalwe ngolimi lwezomthetho ukuze ikwazi ukusetshenziswa ezinkantolo ukuvikela wena. Kodwa lokhu kwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuyiqonda. Yingakho sibhale lokhu kuwe ngolimi olulula kule ncwadi. Nokho, kuqala, sifuna ukukuchazela ukuthi iMvumelwano iyini, njengoba isetshenziswa lapha, nokuthi yafika kanjani. Njengoba sikhulume, iZizwe Ezihlangene iyinhlobo yohulumeni womhlaba. Lo hulumeni uhlangana endlini enkulu esakhiweni seZizwe Ezihlangene eNew York. Lapha baphawula ngezindaba ezibalulekile zomhlaba ezifana neMvumelwano Ngamalungelo Ezingane. Khumbula ukuthi le Mvumelwano iyisivumelwano esenziwe phakathi kohulumeni bomhlaba. Uma isivumelwano sesifinyelelwe, izwe ngalinye kufanele liye kwiPhalamende lazo futhi livumelane neMvumelwano lapho. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuvuma iMvumelwano. IPhalamende kufanele livote ukuthi lizohlonipha imithetho yeMvumelwano. Uma iPhalamende yezwe ivumile ukuvuma iMvumelwano, uhulumeni walowo mzabalazo kufanele uhloniphe imithetho yayo. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi hhayi wonke amazwe avuma zonke iMvumelwano. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wavuma (wavuma) iMvumelwano Ngamalungelo Ezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele uhloniphe imithetho yeMvumelwano. IZizwe Ezihlangene inekomidi ekhethekile yabantu okufanele ibuze amazwe ukuthi yini abakwenzayo ukuhlinzeka ngale mithetho. Ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika isayina iMvumelwano, benza promises ekhethekile ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izingane zizobekwa phambili kukho konke abakwenza. IMvumelwano ibala ukuthi umntwana ungumuntu oneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-18. Kodwa kwesinye isikhathi izwe lingase libe nemithetho evumela umntwana ukuba abhekwane njengomuntu omdala ngaphambi kwaleyo minyaka. Ungase ucabangele isizathu sokuthi kungani izwe lingavumela umntwana ukuba abhekwane njengomuntu omdala ngaphambi kweminyaka engu-18. Ngokwesibonelo, kwamanye amazwe, abantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 bavunyelwe ukushada. Ucabanga ukuthi umuntu ongenaminyaka engu-18 kufanele aphathwe njengomntwana? Izwelonke kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi wonke amalungelo akule Mvumelwano apply kuwo wonke umntwana kulowo mzabalazo. Akekho umntwana okufanele ashiywe ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ungowasendaweni ethile, umbala, ubulili, ulimi, noma inkolo. Akekho umntwana okufanele ashiywe ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ucabanga noma uthi noma uvela kuphi. Akekho umntwana okufanele ashiywe ngaphandle ngenxa yokuthi ungenamali noma ucebe noma unokukhubazeka ngan
R50.00 kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka ka-2003 bese kuba R70. Abanikazi bezindawo zokuhweba kumele bathenge ugesi bona. Imali yokurenta ikhokhwa ngenyanga kusenesikhathi ngosuku lweshumi lwanyanga ngayinye. Indawo yokuhweba enikezwa umuntu izosetshenziswa ukuthengisa nokukhangisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zezimpahla njengoba kuvunyelwe yiBhodi yabaPhathi ngezikhathi ezithile. Umqashi kumele anikeze umninimzi ikheli lakhe lokuhlala, ikheli leposi, kanye nenombolo yefoni. Umqashi kumele abe ngumuntu ongasebenzi, futhi kuzonikezwa ithuba labo abaxhasa imindeni yabo bodwa. Zonke izimpahla kumele zibe sesimweni esifanele ukuthengiswa ezivakashi futhi zibe nekhwalithi ephezulu kanye nezinhlobonhlobo. Indawo yokuhweba kumele iphephile, futhi umqashi kumele ahambisane nemithetho efakwe kwiMthetho Wokuphepha Nokunakekelwa Kwezempilo No. 85 ka-1993. Indawo yokuhweba ayivunyelwe ukuthi iqashwe komunye umuntu ngumqashi. Abangane abathathu bazovunyelwa ngaphansi kwalolu xhaso. Abangane bazokhuthazwa ukuthi bathengise izimpahla eziphathelene nabanye abantu abasebenza ekhaya. Ukulahla udoti/ukuhlanzwa akuvunyelwe, futhi udoti akumele uqokeleleke ezindaweni zemakethe. Ukuphuza utshwala ezindaweni zemakethe akuvunyelwe, futhi umqashi akumele afinyelele emsebenzini ethwele umphumela wotshwala noma ezinye izidakamizwa. Ukulwa noma ukusebenzisa ulimi oluphambene ezindaweni zemakethe akuvunyelwe. Umsindo omkhulu noma umculo ezindaweni zemakethe akuvunyelwe. Umqashi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina indawo yakhe yokuhweba nezindawo ezizungezile zihlanzekile. Abangane bazothatha izikhathi zokuhlanza igumbi lokugezela nezinye izindawo ezijwayelekile. Izimpahla zingakhiqizwa kuphela ezindaweni zemakethe uma imvume ngaphambi itholiwe kumninimzi. Umqashi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlinzeka amakhasimende ngezimali ezishintshwayo. Izimpahla zikagesi kuphela ezivunyelwe kumninimzi zingasetshenziswa. Akukho shintsho okumele kwenziwe ezindaweni zemakethe mayelana nezifaki zagesi, uphahla, noma ezinye. Abangane kumele bathathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvimbela ukuvinjwa noma ukuphazamiseka kwemithombo yamanzi, amapayipi, kanye namapayipi okuphakelayo amanzi lapha ezindaweni zemakethe. Abangane kuzodingeka bakhokhe ugesi ngokusekelwe ekusetshenzisweni kwabo. Izindawo zokuhweba kumele zivuleke kusukela ngo-9:00 AM kuya ku-5:00 PM kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuMgqibelo. Imakethe izovalwa ngoMsombuluko. Izindawo zokuhweba zingavulwa ngezikhathi ezinde ngokuthanda komninimzi. Uma umqashi, noma ozakwabo noma abasebenzi bawo ngasikhathi sinye, baphula noma yiziphi zalezi zimo futhi baqhubeke nokwenza kanjalo ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyishumi zokunikezwa isaziso sokulungisa, lesi sivumelwano sokurenta sizophela ngokushesha, futhi umqashi kuzodingeka aphume kule ndawo yokuhweba ngokushesha. Isaziso esisheshayo sizonikezwa uma kwenzeka isenzo sobugebengu noma ukuphulwa kokuziphatha. Uma kutholakala ukuthi umqashi unikeze ulwazi olungelona iqiniso ukuze athole le ndawo yokuhweba, iBhodi izosebenzisa amandla ayo uma ikhetha ukuvala lesi sivumelwano ngokushesha. Uma umqashi ethola umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, lesi sivumelwano sizophela, futhi umqashi kuzodingeka aphume endaweni yokuhweba ezinsukwini eziyisixhenxe. Uma umqashi efile, lesi sivumelwano sizophela ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho Jikelele. Umninimzi ugcina ilungelo lokukhokhisa umqashi ngezibopho nezijeziso.
Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwethula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika isu leSizwe Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. Lokhu kuyingxenye yemiphumela yokucwaninga okuningi kanye nezinkulumo phakathi kweMnyango Wezemisebenzi kanye neSikhungo Sezakhono. NgoNovemba 2000, kwakhuluma kakhulu ngohlelo olwakhiwe. IKhansela Lezakhono selibuyekeze iziphakamiso eziningi neziphakamiso phakathi kwalolu daba. NgoJanuwari 2001, leli Khansela langethula kimi iziphakamiso mayelana nezinhlelo zokuqala zezwe lethu ezisekela isu elibanzi lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Lezi ziphakamiso nezincazelo zakhuphula umoya wami kakhulu ngezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, leli su sekuvele lazi izindawo ezibalulekile ezihamba phambili ekuthuthukisweni kwamakhono, futhi siqoke izinkomba ezizokwenza sikwazi ukukala impumelelo nentuthuko esiyenzile. Ngakho-ke, leli su lihola umnyango wami, uMnyango Wezemfundo, nezinye izigaba zokuqeqesha. Okwesibili, leli su libonisa kahle ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuzothinta kanjani umkhankaso wesizwe wokuthuthukisa abasebenzi. Uhulumeni uzibophezele ekuthuthukiseni abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Yonke iminyango kahulumeni iyasebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bethu bathola imfundo neziqu ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Isibonelo, uMnyango Wezemfundo uzibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi kukhona izinguquko emfundweni ejwayelekile nasemfundo ephakeme. Ngokufanayo, uMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono afanele. Isu Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ligcizelela indima edlalwa uMnyango wami enqubweni yokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi - futhi ikakhulukazi izindlela ezizokala impumelelo yaleyo ndima. Iphinde inikeze eminye iminyango kahulumeni uhlaka lokusebenza njengoba bethuthukisa amakhono ezindaweni zabo. Okwesithathu, ngithole umyalo wokweseka lokho esikutholile ngenkathi sibhala futhi sihlela leli su. Nakuba kube nokuvumelana mayelana nezindlela zokuhlola ukusebenza kahle kwecebo nokukala izinhloso, umqondo walesi simo wawusekelwa ngaphandle kokungabaza. Mayelana nendaba yokusetha izinkomba ezizokhombisa impumelelo nokuhlola indima esiyidlalayo ekufezeni leli su, kwavunyelwene, futhi le nhloso iyinkomba enye yokuthi uMnyango wami uzibophezele ekusebenzeni emphakathini nasekubikeni umphakathi ngakho konke okwenziwayo. Inselelo enkulu ukuwenza lo msebenzi ube nempumelelo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uqhubeka nokusiza umphakathi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kubandakanya ukukhuthaza abaqashi, izinyunyana, abasebenzi, iminyango kahulumeni, nomphakathi ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo. Umyango wami uzibophezele ekuqapheleni ukuthi leli su lisebenza kahle futhi liya phambili. Yonke imizamo efanele kumele yenziwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngempumelelo futhi kube nezibalo ezikhona mayelana nentuthuko yecebo, ngokusemthethweni. Ngithemba kakhulu kwiKhansela Lezakhono ukuze ibuyekeze imibiko ebhalwe uMnyango wami, futhi uma kudingeka, iqale uphenyo lwayo, inginikeze izeluleko nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezingase zidinge ukubuyekezwa kwenqubomgomo nezinguquko ekwenzeni. Impumelelo nokwehluleka kumele kubhalwe ukuze sonke sikwazi ukufunda kuso futhi silungise amaphutha ethu. Lecebo kumele kube sesimweni esiphezulu. Ngizokwenza njalo ngilindele imibiko yentuthuko evela kumnyango wami, nasemkhankasweni ophathelene nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ngiyamema futhi iKhansela ukuba ibuyekeze njalo izinhloso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ziqhubeka zixazulula izidingo ezibaluleke kakhulu zezwe lethu. Ngifuna ukuveza ukubonga kwami okujulile kubantu abangu-1000 besifazane nabesilisa ababe nomthelela ekuthuthukisweni kwaleli su elihle. Izinhloso engizibekile zisezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu, kodwa akukho okungenzeki uma sinesifiso. Ngokufanayo, umdlandla esinawo wokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ungafezwa. Inselelo kithi manje ukuwenza amaphupho ethu abe yiqiniso. Masivule izandla zethu siqale ukusebenza! Kuyaziwa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ayikakabi namakhono adingekayo ukuze ithuthukise ngokwezimali, ngokwenhlalo, nasemsebenzini. Ukuze sifinyelele kulolo level, sinesiMthetho Sokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, kanye neMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, owamukelwa ngo-1998 no-1999 ngokulandelana. Le mithetho inika uNgqongqoshe Wezemisebenzi umthwalo wokwenza amalungiselelo eSizwe Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono, ngokubambisana neKhansela Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono. IKhansela Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono lasungulwa nguMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998. Amalungu alo amele amabhizinisi, abasebenzi, uhulumeni, nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngemuva kocwaningo olunzulu nezinkulumo phakathi kweMnyango Wezemisebenzi neKhansela elibhekelele Amakhono, amalungiselelo okuphila kwecebo akwenziwe. NgoNovemba, amakhophi aleli cezo aphakanyisiwe kubo bonke ababambiqhaza. Imihlangano yokukhuluma ngepilothi yabanjwa kuzo zonke izifunda. IKhansela ithole iziphakamiso eziningi mayelana nepilothi. Kwabe sekwenziwa ukubuyekezwa, futhi izinkomba zempumelelo zashintshwa. Izinkomba zempumelelo ezibekwe kulolu su zizobuyekezwa minyaka yonke futhi zishintshwe uma kudingeka. Ziyindlela ephumelelayo yokuhlola izindaba ezibalulekile nempumelelo, kodwa izindlela zokuhlanganisa ulwazi zingathuthukiswa, njengoba nezindlela zokuhlola umthelela wecebo. Ngesinye isikhathi, lezi zinkomba ziveze izenzo ezithile kunokukhombisa imiphumela yalezo zenzo. Nokho, ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkomba zingashintshwa ukuze zikhombise kangcono imiphumela. Ngezikhathi ezibekwe, uMnyango Wezemisebenzi uzokwenza imibiko ngazinye izinkomba. IKhansela Lezakhono izobuyekeza le mibiko. Lokhu kuzovumela uNgqongqoshe ukuba ahlale ethola ulwazi nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezingase zivele. Uma kudingeka, uNgqongqoshe angakwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze ahlangabezane nezidingo zamakhono ezwe ngaleso sikhathi. UMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ka-1998, kanye neMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono ubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo ezithinta abasebenzi nokuthuthukiswa kwabo. Le mithetho emibili iletha imibono emisha mayelana nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezakhiwe ukuze ziqhubeke futhi zikhuthaze uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Kukhona izindaba ezimbili ezibalulekile ezibhekwa yile mithetho. Okokuqala, ukuthuthukiswa komnotho womhlaba kanye nokuncintisana kwemikhakha yethu neyezwe elinye. Okwesibili, ukubhekana nezinselelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nokususa ubuphofu. Imithetho yokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono seyiqala ukusebenza. NgoAprili 1999, iKhansela Lokuthuthukiswa Kwamakhono lasungulwa. Ngomhla kaM
Ithimba ligxile ekuxazululeni izidingo zabantu ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphakathi komphakathi ophuhlayo mayelana nezincwadi ezikhombisa izindawo ezifana nokuphatha, imfundo, kanye nomnotho, phakathi kokunye, ngenkathi kudlula ekwehlukaniseni nasegcineni intuthuko ye-Afrika emkhakheni wezincwadi nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana. Ithimba lihlose ukusungula uhlelo oluzodlala indima ebalulekile ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezinkulu ezweni lonke futhi luzokwenza imicimbi ehlose ukukhuthaza lezi zindaba ezibalulekile. Imfundo nabathintekayo baphumelelisile ucwaningo, ukuthuthukiswa, nokwakhiwa kokufinyeleleka nokusebenza kwabantu emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bezilimi. Ithimba libona ukuthuthukiswa komkhakha we-HLT eNingizimu Afrika okufana nalokho eYurophu ngezilimi ezihlukene, kodwa kulungiswe ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zendawo. Ithimba lizokwenza isethulo ngo-2002. Ithimba lihlangana kaningi futhi lizobamba iqhaza nabathintekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Noma ubani onentshisekelo uyamenywa ukuba axhumane nomqondisi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ukuze athole olunye ulwazi. Ukusekelwa kwalesi sikhungo kuyamukelwa kungakhathalekile ukuthi kuvela kuphi.
I-Child Protection Register iqukethe uhlu lwezingane ezidinga ukuvikelwa, ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-18, ezidinga ukuvikelwa. I-Register igcinwa ngumsebenzi wezokuxhumana osebenza ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi wendawo. Ulwazi olukhona kule Register luyimfihlo futhi lungabelwana kuphela nalabo abaphakathi kweqembu lokuvikela izingane (isb. othisha, odokotela, ab nurse, abaphethe/abaphathiswa, nabanye). Uhlu lwezingane ezidinga usizo lomphakathi lugcinwa. Ingane ixhunywe emndenini wayo nasezinkampanini zomphakathi ngokushesha (ezihlinzeka ngalolo suzi). Izenzakalo zihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zomndeni nengane zikhona. NgokweMthetho ophatha ukunakekelwa kwezingane (Inombolo 74 ka-1983), lezi zisebenzi ezilandelayo zinesibopho sokubika noma yiziphi izinsolo zokuthi kungase kube nezimpawu zokuhlukunyezwa noma ukunganakwa kwezingane: udokotela wamazinyo, udokotela ojwayelekile, um nurse, umphakathi wezokuxhumana, uthisha, kanye nanoma yimuphi umuntu oqashwe noma ophatha i-Child Care Home noma indawo yokuphepha kwezingane. Uma, ngesikhathi sokuhlola, ubhekene, noma usindisa ingane, kukhona izinsolo zokuthi ingane ingase ihlukunyezwe, lokhu kufanele kubikwe kumsebenzi wezokuxhumana oseduzane lapho ingane ihlala khona. Noma imuphi umphakathi noma umuntu onomuzwa ngalesi simo angakwazi ukubona ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane noma ukunganakwa futhi angabika lokhu ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi. Amagama abo abambisene kuzogcinwa imfihlo. Ulwazi lokukhomba ingane. Ulwazi ngababheki bezingane/abazali bomntwana. Ikheli lapho ingane ihlala khona, uma ingahlali nabazali bayo, ikheli labazali bayo. Izinsuku lapho izenzakalo zibikwa khona kanye nohlobo lwezenzakalo. Ulwazi ngezimo ezaholela ezinsolweni. Noma iyiphi umlando wezinsuku ezedlule. Noma iyiphi ulwazi lokuxhumana nabanye abantu abangahlinzeka ngobufakazi mayelana nalezi zinsolo. Ulwazi lokuxhumana efayilini luyadingeka, uma izinsizakalo zomphakathi zidinga ukufinyelela mayelana nezinye izindaba ezihlobene nalolu daba. Izinkomba zokuhlukunyezwa: Lokhu kungabandakanya ama-bruises, izibazi, ukushiswa, ukuwa, nabanye. Ukuhlukunyezwa kwemizwa: Lokhu kungabandakanya ukwehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zengane zokuthandwa, ukunakwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuxhumana ngendlela yokukhulisa, ukuzishiya, ukuzisola ngocansi, noma ukuzama ukuzisola. Ukunganakwa: Lokhu kuwukwehluleka ukuvikela ingane ezinsongweni noma kunoma yini, ezimweni ezibandayo, indlala, nokwehluleka ukwenza okudingekayo ukuze bayinakekele, nabanye. Izinsizakalo zomphakathi zizovakashela ingane nomndeni wayo ukuze zihlaziye isimo futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi ingane idinga ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa. Uma umhlukunyezwa ophawulwayo ehlala endlwini efanayo nengane, bangacelwa ukuba bashiye bahlale kwenye indawo. Uma lokhu kungakwenzi, ingane ingahlala nabakhelwane, abangane, izihlobo, noma endaweni yokuphepha kwezingane okwethula. Nokho, kuphela uma impilo yengane ibhekene nengcuphe. Umgomo wokugcina ingane nomndeni wayo ubalulekile kakhulu. Uma kuthathwa isinqumo, kufanele kubhekwane nokuthi yini ebaluleke kakhulu ukuze ingane ithole inzuzo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Imindeni nezingane ziyingxenye yanoma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwayo mayelana nesimo abhekene naso. Nokho, ukuhluza kuphela kule ndaba akuthinti amalungelo abazali bengane noma abaphethe. Ilungelo lithinteka kuphela uma kudingeka kuthathwe izinyathelo zomthetho (isb.: ukususa ingane).
ukuxhasa imizamo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle ezindaweni zokusebenza kuhulumeni. Ukuqinisa ukuhlonipha phakathi kwabasebenzi nasezikhungweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaqashi nabasebenzi banokuqonda okujwayelekile mayelana nokuziphatha okungafanele nokuziphatha okufanele. Ukukhuthaza indlela evumelekile yokuphatha. Ukuhlinzeka abaqashi nabasebenzi ngezwi elisheshayo nelilula lokubika ukuziphatha okungafanele. Futhi ukuvimbela ukungabheki umthetho noma ukuhlukumeza abasebenzi ngokuqashwa. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyisinyathelo sokulungisa, hhayi sokujezisa. Ukuziphatha okufanele kufanele kwenziwe ngesikhathi, ngendlela evumelekile, ehambisanayo, futhi ethuthukayo. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuy umsebenzi wokuphatha. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemithetho kuyadingeka ukuze kuxazululwe izinkinga ngokushesha nokwelashwa okufanele kwabantu, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi: a. banethuba elifanayo lokukhuluma ngezinhlelo ezihlelwe nezingeziwe. b. bahlale bekwazi ngemicimbi yokuziphatha okungafanele eyenzeka kubo. c. bathole izizathu ezibhaliwe zokuphathwa kwanoma yisiphi isinqumo esibhaliwe, futhi d. banelungelo lokuphikisa noma yisiphi isinqumo. Yonke imizamo izokwenziwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imihlahlandlela yokuziphatha okungafanele iyenzeka endaweni yokusebenza futhi ixhumeke kubo bonke abasebenzi. Uma umphakathi uphatha kabi, lokho kungaba icala, icala elibucayi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyathelo zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele zizokwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isinyathelo sokudlulisa icala ngokwezinhlelo zokusebenza akuphazamisi inqubo yomthetho. Lezi zisho nezindlela ziyizikhombisi kuphela futhi zingashintshwa ngokuya ngezimo ezifanele. Lokhu kusebenza kuyo yonke imiphakathi ephathelene nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, noma okukhuluma ngazo emthethweni noma ezinqubomgomo. Imithetho, imiyalelo, nezindinganiso zokuziphatha. Ukuziphatha okungafanele okungase kudinge ukuthi umphakathi abhekane nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala kuboniswa ku-Anexure A. Lezi zinto aziphelele. Umpheki angahola umphakathi mayelana nokuziphatha kwabo, uma nje beqonda, noma kufanele baqonde ukuthi lokho kuziphatha kudinga isinyathelo sokudlulisa icala. a. ukuveza izinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele kunomthelela omkhulu emsebenzini kahulumeni, emnyangweni wezabasebenzi, nasekukhulumeni. Izindlela zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele. Izeluleko zokulungisa ukuziphatha okungafanele. Ezimweni lapho kubalulekile ukusungula ukubaluleka kokuziphatha okungafanele, umphakathi kufanele akwenze lokhu. a. wazisa umphakathi ngokuqondile ngokuqhubeka kwakhe. b. Chaza kumphakathi icala elibhekene naye, bese umnika ithuba lokukhuluma ngaleso cala abhekene naso. d. Thatha isinyathelo sokulungisa esivumelwene ngaso. Isixwayiso somlomo. Uma umphakathi odabukile edinga isixwayiso, isixwayiso singanikezwa ngomlomo. Umphakathi kufanele wazise umphakathi ukuthi uma eqhubeka nokuziphatha kabi, angase abhekane nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala, futhi isixwayiso sizobhalwa phansi. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Uma umphakathi ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso esibhaliwe, umphakathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo ezidingekayo uma unikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. b. umphakathi kufanele anikeze umphakathi ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele siyisigne. Uma bephika ukusigna, umphakathi kufanele anikeze omunye umphakathi ukusigna njengofakazi wokuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi. d. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe sithobela umthetho iminyaka eyisithupha. Ekupheleni kweminyaka eyisithupha, kufanele sikhishwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi futhi sibhujiswe. e. Uma umphakathi utholakala enecala phakathi kweminyaka eyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala okufanele azithole. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. Uma umphakathi ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe, umphakathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo ezidingekayo uma unikeza isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. b. umphakathi kufanele anikeze umphakathi ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele siyisigne. Uma bephika ukusigna, umphakathi kufanele anikeze omunye umphakathi ukusigna njengofakazi wokuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi. d. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe sithobela umthetho iminyaka eyisithupha. Ekupheleni kweminyaka eyisithupha, kufanele sikhishwe kufayela labantu bomphakathi futhi sibhujiswe. e. Uma umphakathi utholakala enecala phakathi kweminyaka eyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokudlulisa icala okufanele azithole. Imicimbi efanayo ephathelene nabasebenzi kufanele ithole izixwayiso ezifanayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe indlela ehambisanayo yokuphatha noma yokubhekana nokuziphatha okungafanele. Uma icala elibhekene nomphakathi libalulekile kakhulu, kudinga isijeziso esinzima kunezikhumbuzo ezikhuluma ngalesi sikhathi, umqashi angase aqale uphenyo mayelana nesijeziso. Umqashi kufanele akhethe ummeleli ukuze aqale uphenyo, okumele kube umphakathi. Isaziso sokuphenya a. umphakathi kufanele anikezwe isaziso okungenani ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela. b. Umphakathi kufanele asigne isaziso esiqinisekisa usuku lokulalela. Uma bephika ukusigna, kufanele banikezwe omunye umphakathi ozosigna ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi odabukile uthole isaziso. Incazelo ephelele yokuziphatha okungafanele, ubufakazi umqashi ozowethemba. Ulwazi ngamalungelo omphakathi, abamele abaphathi noma abamele inhlangano yezabasebenzi evunyelwe, kanye nalabo abazohlinzeka ngobufakazi. a. umqashi angase abambe umphakathi noma amukele imali ngokuphelele, noma amtransfer kuMnyango omunye wenhlangano. Ngaphansi kwalezi zimo; uma umphakathi uthola icala noma uphatha icala elibucayi, futhi umqashi ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela komphakathi emsebenzini kungaphazamisa uphenyo lwecala elibhekene naye, noma kube yingozi empilweni yomuntu noma impahla kahulumeni. c. Uma umphakathi ebhujiswa noma edluliselwa, umqashi kufanele abambe ukulalela phakathi kwenyanga. Umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela uzokwenza isinqumo sokuthi icala lizophumelela. a. Ukulalela kufanele kubanjwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokunikezwa isaziso kumphakathi. b. Umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela kufanele abe sezingeni eliphezulu kunommeleli womphakathi. Uma umphakathi obhekene necala engumholi wesigaba, umphakathi ozobamba ukulalela kufanele kube yisiphathimandla esisebenzayo noma umuntu onolwazi olwaneleyo futhi oqokwe nguMbuso noma umkhandlu wesifunda omkhulu. c. A.1 Lezi ziqondiso zizobizwa ngokuthi iMithetho Yezinsizakalo Zikamasipala ka-2001 futhi zizothatha umthelela kusukela ngo-1 Januwari 2001, ngaphandle kweziqondiso III B.2 (b) kanye ne-III F(b) yeSahluko-1, ezizothatha umthelela ngosuku oluthile oluzokwenziwa nguNgqongqoshe ngokusebenzisa isaziso kuGazethi. B.1 Lezi ziqondiso zizofundwa ndawonye neMthetho. c "I-Core" isifinyezo seSikhodi seMiholo, njengoba kuchaziwe kuziqondiso III 1.3 kuya ku-1. r "I-SMS" ibhekisela kubasebenzi abanikwe igama kuziqondiso- l B. v "Iziqondiso Zezezimali" zisho Iziqondiso Zezezimali ezashicilelwa kuSaziso Sokuhulumeni Inombolo R.556 ka-31 Meyi 2000 njengoba kuhlelwe ngezikhathi ezithile futhi kwenziwa ngaphansi kwesigaba -76 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zikamasipala; futhi noma iyiphi enye igama izobhekisela kulokho okukhuluma kuMthetho. Isigaba -41 seMthetho sikhuthaza lezi ziqondiso. a kubo bonke abantu abaqashwe kanye nakuzo zonke izikhungo ezilawulwa nguMthetho; futhi b ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho, kubantu abaqashwe ezinsizakalweni, ezikhungweni noma ezikhungweni zemfundo zikamasipala, kodwa kuphela lapho zingaphikisi nemithetho elawula ukuqashwa kwabo. E.1 Iziqondiso Zezinsizakalo Zikamasipala zika-1999 (ezashicilelwa kuSaziso Sokuhulumeni Inombolo R.679 ka-1 Julayi 1999), kuhlanganise nazo zonke izichibiyelo ezenziwe nazo zonke iziqondiso ezenziwe futhi ezisebenza ngaphansi koMthetho, zikhanselwa lapha. E.2 Noma iyiphi isenzo esithathwe ngaphansi kweziqondiso zeZinsizakalo Zikamasipala zika-1999 futhi esingaqhutshwa ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zalezi ziqondiso sizobhekwa sengathi senziwe ngaphansi kwaleyo nhlinzeko. E.3 Nakuba Iziqondiso Zezinsizakalo Zikamasipala zika-1999 zikhanselwa ngaphansi kweziqondiso- l E.1, izinhlelo zokudlulela phambili zizokwenziwa kuZinsizakalo Zikamasipala- 1. Umthetho Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi kanye nezivumelwano ezihlangene zizolawula izinto ezithinta bobabili phakathi kweZinsizakalo kanye noMbuso njengomqashi. Uma kwenzeka izimo zivumela ukuphambuka ezinhlinzekweni nasezithombeni zesiqondiso esithile kulezi ziqondiso mayelana nezimo zokusebenza emsebenzini wombuso, uNgqongqoshe angathatha izinqumo, akhiphe imiyalo noma avume ezinye izimiso ngaphansi kwezimo ezichaziwe futhi azisebenzise. a xhumana naye ngeMenenja-Jikelele: Izinhlaka Zikamasipala kanye Nezokuphathwa; futhi b bhala ngolimi olusemthethweni lezi ziqondiso ezashicilelwa ku. H.2 Umsebenzi uzokhombiswa nganoma yimuphi umbuzo ophathelene nezindaba ngaphansi kwamandla nezibopho zikaNgqongqoshe ophambili emnyangweni wakhe. H.3 Umphathi wengxenye uzokwethula kuMenenja-Jikelele: Izinhlaka Zikamasipala kanye Nezokuphathwa, kusenesikhathi ngokuxoxisana, noma iyiphi imingcele yomthetho noma imingcele yokubhaliswa ethinta amandla noma izibopho zikaNgqongqoshe. H.4 Umphathi wengxenye uzokwakha inqubomgomo mayelana nokuthi abasebenzi bengingxenye yakhe bangasebenzisana kanjani nezindaba zomphakathi nezinye izikhungo zezindaba. H.5 Umsebenzi, emsebenzini wakhe, akavunyelwe ukuhlabela umthetho wombuso endaweni yomphakathi noma emaphephandabeni noma ezindabeni noma kunoma iyiphi imithombo yezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuze anikeze umphathi wengxenye amandla okuphatha ingxenye yakhe ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo, umphakathi omkhulu uzohlinzeka umphathi wengxenye ngamandla adingekayo nezithunywa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphathi wengxenye uzovuma abasebenzi bangaphakathi ngokwabelana ngamandla afanele nezithunywa lapho kudingeka. a bangase babele amandla kubasebenzi noma bavume abasebenzi ukuthi benze lelo thask; futhi b bazokwenze futhi izinqumo mayelana nokusebenzisa lawo mandla noma ukwenza lelo thask. B.2 Umphakathi omkhulu uzobhalela ukwenziwa kwamandla noma izithunywa ngokubhala futhi lokhu kungafakwa nasekutholeni umsebenzi komphathi wengxenye, njengoba kuchaziwe kuziqondiso -VII B.2.1. B.3 Ukudluliswa kwamandla ngumphakathi omkhulu noma umphathi wengxenye akuvimbele ukuthi basebenzise lawo mandla bona. C.2 Umphakathi omkhulu akavunyelwe ukuphazamisa noma ukuvumela umphathi wengxenye noma noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi ukuba abambe iqhaza kunoma iyiphi indaba noma enze isinqumo esiphula lezi ziqondiso. a uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bengingxenye yakhe bayahambisana nalezi ziqondiso, izivumelwano ezihlangene kanye nanoma yimiphi imithwalo yomthetho; futhi b uzobhekana ngokushesha nangendlela efanele nanoma yiziphi iziphazamiso ezingaba khona. C.4 Umphakathi omkhulu noma umphathi wengxenye uzosebenzisa amandla abo, enze imisebenzi yabo futhi bahlangabezane nezibopho zabo ngaphansi kwezi ziqondiso ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi kanye nezivumelwano ezihlangene ezisebenzayo. C.5 Umphakathi omkhulu nomphathi wengxenye bazokuqinisekisa ukuthi uMnyango Wezezimali uvuma ngaphambi kokuthi benze isinqumo esihilela ukusetshenziswa kwemali evela emalini. D.1 Lapho kungase kube nokuphikisana kokuthakazelela uma kwenziwa noma yisiphi isinqumo mayelana nokuqashwa, umphakathi omkhulu noma umsebenzi onamandla uzokwenza lelo thask noma enze isinqumo kuphela ngemuva kokucabangela isiphakamiso esivela kwi-panel ezimele equkethe okungenani abantu ababili. D.3 Umphakathi omkhulu noma umsebenzi akavunyelwe ukuthola noma ukufuna noma iyiphi imivuzo ethile emsebenzini noma kumuntu ongase abe ngumsebenzi ngokwenza okuthile noma enza isinqumo mayelana nokuqashwa. Umsebenzi akavunyelwe ukuveza emphakathini noma iyiphi imininingwane esemthethweni ngaphandle kwamandla adingekayo. Umphakathi omkhulu uzokwakha imigomo eyilinganiselwe yengxenye yakhe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsizakalo zinikezwa ngokubuyiselwa kwemali esetshenzisiwe, kusetshenziswa ngokuphelele izinsiza zengxenye kuhlanganise nabasebenzi, futhi futhi kusetshenziswa ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi njengoba kudingeka. Ngokusebenzisa imali etholakalayo futhi eyabelwe ezinjongo nasezibopho zengxenye kanye nohulumeni ukuze kuhanjiswe, umphakathi omkhulu uzohlela ukwenza imisebenzi ngendlela ehlelekile, efanelekile nephumelelayo ngaphakathi kwenhlangano nasemigomeni yokuphathwa kwabasebenzi. Ukuze kuvumeleke ukubekwa obala nokucacile, umphakathi omkhulu uzoshicilela umbiko wonyaka onikeza imininingwane ebalulekile ngengxenye yakhe. ukuxhasa ukuhambisana nezidingo zokubika kuziqondiso III J kanye neziqondiso zeMali Zikamasipala eziphakanyisiwe ezisezingeni eliphansi ezivunyelwe ukuze Zaziwe, futhi ezikhombisa kuziqondiso- VII H; futhi g ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezisezingeni- 5.1 kanye no-5.2 zeziqondiso zeMali.
Ukugcinwa kwemibhalo ngokomthetho kuyisibopho somthetho esidinga bonke abashicileli (nabakhiqizi) eNingizimu Afrika bazo zonke izinhlobo zemibhalo, kuhlanganise naleyo eshicilelwe ngokuqondile, ukuthi bathumele inani elithile lemikhono yalokho abakushicilelile ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ezibekwe ukuze kugcinwe ngokuphepha. Kuyisiko emhlabeni jikelele ukuthi uhulumeni badinge abakhiqizi bezinhlobo zonke zemibhalo, kuhlanganise namavidiyo nezinsiza ezirekhodiwe, ukuthi bahlinzeke ngenani elithile lemikhiqizo yabo kulezi zindawo ezisemthethweni ezibekwe. Okwamanje, amazwe emhlabeni jikelele ayabuyekeza futhi aguqule imithetho yawo ephathelene nokuthunyelwa kwemibhalo ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze kuhambisane nokwanda kwemibhalo eshicilelwe ngokuqondile efana namavidiyo, ama-CD, nama-DVD. Inhloso yokugcinwa kolwazi endaweni esemthethweni ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokuhlinzeka abasebenzisi balo msebenzi, kokubili ngesikhathi samanje nakusasa, ngolwazi nemibhalo equkethe imisebenzi nesiko elibalulekile kulomphakathi. Ukugcinwa kwemibhalo ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kwaqala ngo-1842 ngokwethulwa kokuqala kweMithetho ye-Copyright yaseBrithani, evikela ilungelo lombhali lokuba ngumthombo wemibhalo kuyo yonke iMpumalanga yaseBrithani. Kwakukhona futhi izichibiyelo emthethweni phakathi kweMithetho ye-Copyright ka-1965 kanye neMithetho ye-Legal Deposit of Published Documents ka-1982. Okwamanje, iMithetho ye-Legal Deposit of Documents (Umthetho 54 ka-1997) yamenyezelwa ngoJulayi 1, 1998. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwemibhalo, izincwadi, neminye imithombo equkethe ulwazi olufana namafilimu, amavidiyo, ama-CD omculo, nama-DVD, wonke ashicilelwe noma akhiqizwe eNingizimu Afrika. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngesisekelo esibanzi somthetho mayelana nenani lemikhono okumele igcinwe, isimo sokufika kwayo, ulwazi oludingekayo kubashicileli nabakhiqizi, isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwemikhono, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo uma abashicileli nabakhiqizi behluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho. Imibhalo iyinto ethile ehlelelwe ukugcinwa noma ukudluliswa njengolwazi olubhalwe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi luyimibhalo, izithombe, noma irekhodi elenzelwe ukulalelwa, futhi kunoma iyiphi enye ifomethi eqondakalayo nangemithombo ethile. Lokhu kubhekisela kwimibhalo eyakhiwe ukuze isetshenziswe emphakathini, ehlelelwe ukukhiqizwa nokusabalalisa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, egcina noma idlulisa ulwazi olubhalwe, ulwazi lwezithombe, ulwazi olurekhodiwe lokulalela, olufundwa ngama-mishini, noma lwethulwa kunoma iyiphi enye ifomethi ehlolwe noma esanda kushicilelwa ehlukile kakhulu kulokho okwakukhona ngaphambili ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi luhlukile noma indlela nesimo sokuthi luthunyelwe kulolu shicilelo eNingizimu Afrika noma ehlelelwe ukusetyenziswa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcinwa kwemfihlo ebhalwe phansi kanye nemvelaphi ye-rekhodi kusiza ukufinyelela kwabantu emisebenzini yonke eshicilelwe eyakhiqizwa ezweni labo. Ngakho-ke, ukugcinwa kolwazi ngokomthetho kuyisici esisodwa semigqa yokukhululeka kolwazi. Kusiza izwe lethu ukuba ligcine izibopho zayo ezimbili zokwethembeka kubantu bonke, kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wombhali awulahleki futhi uyatholakala ukuze uphenywe esikhathini esizayo, kuvumela indawo yokugcina ukuba ikhulise ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabantu bonke balo msebenzi mayelana nalokho okukhishwe nokushicilelwe njengesisekelo sokwakhiwa kwemibhalo kazwelonke nezinye iziqoqo zolwazi ezazisa abasebenzisi-bokugcina nalabo abazozisebenzisa ezwenikazi nasemhlabeni jikelele ngezincwadi ezikhona neminye imibhalo, ngaleyo ndlela kukhuthaza ukusabalala kwayo nokuthengwa, kuba isisekelo sokuhlanganiswa kwezibalo ezikhiqizwa yi-UNESCO emhlabeni jikelele, okuyinsiza ewusizo yolwazi emsebenzini wezincwadi nezohwebo. Lokhu kungase kube nenzuzo nakwezinye izindlela.
Amagama agqokwe ahlola izichibiyelo ezenziwe emthethweni olemukelekile. Kubandakanya ukuphathwa kukamasipala ngokuphumeza ukuqoqa intela yezindlu; ukuhlela umthetho weMiphakathi: Umthetho Wamasipala ka-2000, ukuze kuqhubeke nokwakha izigaba zokuthi amamasipala athumele izaziso; ukuhlela noma ukususa eminye imithetho; nokubhekana nezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene. Isihloko esifingqiwe kanye nokuqala komthetho. Umphakathi omkhulu noma umphakathi wendawo ungakha intela yezindlu ezindaweni ezibekwe yibo. Umphakathi wesifunda awukwazi ukuklama intela yezindlu ngaphandle kokuthi indawo ibe ngaphakathi kwesifunda esibekwe kulowo maphakathi. Ezinye izigaba zomthetho; kanye nenqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu okufanele amamasipala ayamukele ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 3. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele yamukele inqubomgomo ehambisana nomthetho mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu ezindaweni noma ezindaweni ezibophelelwe intela yezindlu kumamasipala. Ivumela amamasipala ukuba akhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo; futhi kulandela ukuhlaziywa okujulile mayelana nezindleko nezinhlelo zokubuyisela, zonke izakhiwo noma izimpahla ezingase zingafakwa ngaphansi kwesistimu yokuhlola ngenhloso yokwakha intela yezindlu. Noma iyiphi imali yokubuyiselwa, yokubuyiselwa, noma yokunciphisa okukhulunywe ngesigaba 2 futhi kubhekwa enhlanganweni yenqubomgomo eyamukelwe ngumasipala kufanele ihambisane nezinga likazwelonke elingase lilawulwe ukuze lisetshenziswe. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele lihlole zonke iziphakamiso ezamukelwe nezibhalwe ezithunyelwe kulo ngesikhathi sokucubungula isikhala senqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele ibuyekeze unyaka nonyaka, futhi uma kudingeka, ihlele inqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. Izigaba 3 no-4, zifundwe ndawonye nezichibiyelo ezidingekayo njengoba kuxoxiwe, zisetshenziselwa noma yiziphi izinguquko zenqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. Umphakathi wendawo kufanele wamukele ukuthi imithetho yamasipala ibamba iqhaza ekusebenzeni nasekuphumezeni inqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. a ngezizinda ezahlukene zezakhiwo nezindawo; futhi b ngezizinda ezahlukene zabaphathi abaphethekile ukukhokha intela yezindlu. Uma umphakathi unquma ukuklama intela yezindlu, kufanele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1, akhe intela yezindlu kuzo zonke izakhiwo noma ezindaweni ezibophelelwe intela yezindlu ngaphakathi komphakathi noma endaweni ngaphansi kokuphathwa komphakathi wendawo obophelelwe intela yezindlu. i uma umphakathi uqobo noma omunye umphakathi ungumnikazi; noma ii njengoba kuxoxiwe esigabeni b encazelweni yendawo noma impahla esigabeni 1; noma iii lapho ilungelo lokuba umnikazi lendawo lingavikelwa ngokomthetho ngenxa yemithetho yokucwasa edlule noma ezinye izizathu ezenza kube nzima noma kungenzeki ukuthola inani; noma b ukuvimbela umphakathi ekunikezeni amalungelo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14 mayelana nezimali zokubuyiselwa, noma ukukhokha okweqile noma ukunciphisa ekukhokheni intela yezindlu ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1. b ukusetshenziswa okukhuthazwayo kwempahla noma indawo; noma c indawo lapho impahla ikhona. Inani lentela yezindlu ohlelweni lwendawo lapho yakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela endaweni eyodwa kufanele iklanywe ngendlela ehlukile ngokuya ngosayizi waleyo ndawo okufanele ibophelelwe yalesi sistimu futhi hhayi iklanywe njengemali eyodwa ehlanganisa yonke indawo. a kufanele kube inani elisekelwe ekuthuthukisweni kwenani lentela yezindlu yaleyo mpahla njengoba kuboniswe ephepheni lokuhlola lezakhamuzi ngaleso sikhathi; noma b intela efanayo empahleni noma endaweni esigabeni esithile esibekwe, kuye ngokuthi leyo ndawo ingaphansi kwenani lokuhlola elisemthethweni. Inani lentela yezindlu elifanayo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1 b akufanele lidlule inani okufanele likhokhwe empahleni noma emhlabeni ezingeni eliphansi lokuhlola ngokuhambisana nokuhlola ukuthi inani lakhiwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1 a. Intela yezindlu ingaklanywa ngamasipala ngaphezu kweminyaka eyodwa yezezimali ngaphandle kokuba ivunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe wezamasipala. a iqala ekuqaleni kweminyaka yezezimali noma ngosuku olukhuluma ngalo njengoba lokhu kungase kubonise isinqumo esixoxiwe esigabeni 13 mayelana nokwakhiwa kwenani lentela yezindlu; futhi b ayikwazi ukuklanywa ukuba ibuyiselwe emuva. Inani lentela yezindlu liklanywa ngamasipala kulandela isinqumo esithathwe yibhodi lezakhamuzi esekelwa ukuvota kwenqwaba yamalungu ale bhodi. i ukuthi ibhodi lamukele isinqumo sokwakha inani lentela yezindlu; futhi ii ikhophi yesinqumo kufanele itholakale ukuze icubungulwe emphakathini phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza ehhovisi elikhulu lokuphatha lelo masipala nakwezinye izindawo ezichaziwe kulolu chungechunge. a uhlu lwabo bonke abanikazi abathole ukubuyiselwa, labo ababuyelelwe, kanye nalabo abathole ukuncipha ngonyaka odlule ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1; futhi b isitatimende esibonisa imali etholelwe umphakathi odlule ngemuva kokubuyiselwa, ukubuyiselwa, nokuncipha. b imisebenzi yezomnotho engapheli kulowo maphakathi; noma c ukuhamba kwezimpahla ngaphakathi kwelizwe, ukuthumela kwezidingo, imali, noma abasebenzi. h Okungenani inani lokuqala le-R15,000 lenani lezakhiwo zonke lapho zakhiwe futhi zihlala khona, ngaphandle kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi uNgqongqoshe, ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali, angakhulisa le mali ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ukuze ihambisane nezinga lezomnotho ngaleso sikhathi; futhi i Impahla/umhlaba noma izigaba zezakhiwo/umhlaba njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 3, noma inani lentela yezindlu elibekwe enanini elibekwe njengemikhawulo empahleni/indawo noma esigabeni sezakhiwo noma indawo. i izindawo zomnotho ii izindawo zezimboni; noma iii izindawo zokulima izinga elikhulunywe esigabeni 1 b lingashicilelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali nangesaziso, abeke umkhawulo kumaphesenti lapho inani lentela yezindlu kufanele likhuphuke unyaka nonyaka. a kanye nezinhlobo zamamasipala angase, kulandela lesi sigaba, achazwe esazisweni njengokuhambelana nezigaba noma izinhlobo zamamasipala ngaphansi kokuchazwa komthetho wezakhiwo zamamasipala nakwezinye izindlela; noma b izinhlobo zomphakathi/izigaba uma kukhona isizathu esihle, uNgqongqoshe angavuma ukubuyiselwa kumamasipala ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ebekwe kulandela isigaba 1.
