Khuluma ulimi lwakho. Kuyilungelo lakho. Yisiphi usizo olunikezwayo? I-TISSA inikeza usizo lokuhumusha ngefoni ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni usebenzisa izilimi zendabuko ezisemthethweni ukuze kufinyelelwe kusizo lukahulumeni. Kungani lokhu kusizo kunikezwa? Ngokusebenzisa i-TISSA, uhulumeni ufeza umgomo wakhe wombuso ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezisebenzayo zokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zendabuko ezisemthethweni. Ingabe umphakathi ungacela usizo kuhulumeni ngolimi lwabo lwesizalo? Yebo, inqobo nje uma lolimi luwulimi olusemthethweni. Ingabe ulimi lwezandla lwabantu abaphefumula luhlanganisiwe? Uma ilungu lomphakathi nomsebenzi kahulumeni bengakwazi ukuqonda ulimi lomunye, umsebenzi kahulumeni angashayela i-TISSA call center. E-call center, umsebenzisi uzoxhuma umsebenzi kahulumeni nelungu lomphakathi kumhumushi okhuluma kokubili izilimi. Umsebenzi kahulumeni uzoba ne-call yokubambisana ukuze yena nelungu lomphakathi bakwazi ukulalela umhumushi. Umhumushi uzohumusha kokubili abantu. Lokhu kungathatha imizuzwana embalwa kuphela. Ngizokwazi kanjani uma umnyango kahulumeni uzokunikeza usizo lokuhumusha? Uma ihhovisi likahulumeni lingakhombisi uphawu lwe-TISSA, ngingakucela lokhu kusizo lokuhumusha? Cha, lokhu kusizo kutholakala kuphela ezindaweni lapho uphawu lwe-TISSA lukhonjiswe khona. Nokho, izindawo ezahlukene zizofakwa esikhathini esizayo. Uzokwazi ukufinyelela kusizo lukahulumeni ngolimi lwakho.
Kubhalwe kahle ukuthi kubalulekile kunoma iyiphi INKONTILEKA YOKUSEKELWA KWEMIBHIKISHO/INKONTILEKA ESIYINQOPHISO ukuthi le nkontileka kumele ibe ngaphansi kwenkampani ye-insurance ebhaliswe isikhathi eside. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ilungu linikezwa izimali zokusekela uma ziceliwe uma kwenzeka okuthile okudingayo i-insurance (ukufa). UMNIKAZI WENKONTILEKA/ILUNGU kumele anikezwe ISITIFIKETHE SOKUBA ILUNGU. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise kahle igama lenkampani enikeza le nkontileka; inani elizokhokhwa; izinzuzo ezizokhokhwa; izinqubo zokufaka izicelo zezimali nezinye izinto ezibalulekile mayelana ne-INKONTILEKA ESIYINQOPHISO. I-INKONTILEKA ESIYINQOPHISO kumele icacise ukuthi abaphathi bemibhikisho noma abasebenzi abaqashwe yinkampani ye-inkontileka abawukhokhi le nkontileka. Kubalulekile kumanikazi benkontileka ukuba bazi ukuthi bangakhetha ukuthola izinzuzo zen kontileka njengenzuzo yokusebenza kwemibhikisho noma ukuthola imali. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise zonke izincazelo ezidingekayo kumnikazi wenkontileka/ilungu ezifana nezikhathi lapho ukukhokha kuqala futhi kwenziwa; okukhokhwayo nokungakhokhwayo; izikhathi zokulinda, njll. Idokhumenti esemthethweni ekhishwe yinkampani kumele ibe nezinhlaka zezinzuzo, izimali, imithetho, nezimo futhi ibe nenombolo ye-insurance, okumele ibonakale esitifiketini sokuba ilungu. I-Friendly Society iyisikhungo sezimali esakhiwe ngamaqembu abantu abanezidingo ezithile, abahlanganisa imali futhi bagcine ndawonye ukuze basizane ngokwezimali ezidingweni ezithile, njengemibhikisho. Izinzuzo eziyinhloko ngu-R5000. I-Friendly Society ayiyona ibhizinisi elenzayo inzuzo, kodwa inzuzo eyenziwa ngemali egcinwe ngamalungu iyabelwana phakathi kwabo. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthola lesi sitifiketi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungumuntu oyi ilungu. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise zonke izincazelo zen kontileka yakho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi inkampani evunyelwe yinkampani ye-insurance ithengisa i-insurance ngegama layo. Inkampani ye-insurance ebhaliswe neBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali ithola imali oyikhokhayo ngenyanga futhi ibhekelele ukukhokha izinzuzo uma kwenzeka ukufa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi wena njengelungu ufaka imali ekhokhwa kubantu abakhethile ku-inkontileka. Imali oyikhokhayo uma uthola i-insurance ngenyanga. Lokhu kuyindoda ezimele ongayithinta uma ungajabuli ngempendulo evela lapho uthole khona i-insurance. Imininingwane yokuxhumana iboniswa esikhangisweni esisemthethweni nasemuva kwaleli phephandaba. Inkampani ye-insurance izohlola izimo noma izifo eziku-inkontileka ezingaholela ekufeni komuntu okukhanyisiwe ku-inkontileka, futhi akukho zinzuzo ezizokhokhwa. Qaphela: Ubufakazi kumele bunikezwe kumuntu othengisa i-insurance futhi kumele bube kufomu lesicelo nasestifiketini sokuba ilungu esikhishwe. Qaphela: Le mali ozoyikhokha ifaka zonke izindleko ezizokhokhwa kuwe nezimali. Lezi zimali ozokhokhwa kumele zicaciswe kahle. Umbuzo: Ngiyakhokha ngenyanga, ngenyanga ephindwe kabili, noma ngonyaka? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ukuthi uzodinga ukukhokha nini. Umbuzo: Ngiyakhokha ngaphambi noma ngiyaboleka? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ukuthi kudingeka ukukhokha ekuqaleni kwenyanga noma ekupheleni kwenyanga. Umbuzo: Uma ngikhokha ngempahla, ngizothola isitifiketi? Impendulo: Yebo, kufanele kube isitifiketi esisemthethweni. Umbuzo: Ingabe le mali ezokhokhwa ngenyanga izokhula esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Inani elizokhokhwa lingakhula uma kukhona izicelo eziningi kule nkontileka. Umbuzo: Le mali ezokhokhwa iqinisekisiwe isikhathi esingakanani? Umbuzo: Nini i-insurance yami iqala? Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma ukufa kudalwe yengozi? Impendulo: Ezimweni eziningi, isikhathi sokulinda asisebenzi uma umuntu efela engozini. Umbuzo: Ingabe kukhona okukhishwayo? Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma ngiphuthelwa ukukhokha noma ngiyeka ukukhokha? Impendulo: Awusoze ube ngaphansi kwe-insurance futhi uma uqala ukukhokha futhi, isikhathi sokulinda singase sibe khona futhi. Umbuzo: Ingabe ukuba ngaphansi kwe-insurance kusebenza kumuntu ngamunye kuphela? Umbuzo: Ngizothola ubufakazi bokuba ilungu? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole Isitifiketi Sokuba Ilungu, isifinyezo sokuthi ubani okukhanyisiwe ngaleyo insurance, inani elizokhokhwa, zonke izikhathi zokulinda, nokuthi yini ekhanyisiwe ku-inkontileka. Impendulo: Yebo, ungakhulisa inzuzo ku-inkontileka yakho uma i-INKONTILEKA ESIYINQOPHISO ivumela, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, lokhu kuzokhuphula nenani okhokhayo ngenyanga. Izinzuzo nezikhathi zokulinda zingase zisebenze ezinuzweni ezikhulisiwe. Umbuzo: Ngizofaka kanjani isicelo sezimali uma othile efile? Impendulo: Inqubo yokufaka isicelo sezimali kufanele iphakelwe ngokuphelele kuwe emithethweni nasezimweni zen kontileka. Impendulo: Ungakhansela i-inkontileka yakho phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokukhokha ukukhokha kwakho kokuqala futhi uthole yonke imali yakho ngaphandle kokuthi usuwafake isicelo sezimali zemibhikisho. Ngemuva kwalokho, i-inkontileka ingakhanselwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kodwa imali oyikhokhayo ngenyanga ngeke ibuyiswe. Impendulo: Lokhu kungaqhutshwa, kodwa kufanele uqinisekiswe futhi wazi ukuthi kuthinta kanjani abantu ababe ku-inkontileka leyo esikhathini esedlule, mayelana nazo zonke lezi zinto. Inkampani entsha kumele ikunikeze isitifiketi sokuba ilungu. Uma uzwa ukuthi awukho esimweni esifana noma esingcono, kufanele uxhumane nenkampani ekhona ngokushesha. Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma unok complaint noma umbuzo? QAPHELA: Imininingwane ye-Ombudsman kanye ne-FSB kumele ibe ku- Membership Certificate nasemuva kwephephandaba lolwazi.
Ngalesi sikhathi sokuqala sokuphatha (1994-1999), uMnyango Wezobumbano Nezokuphatha Zasendaweni (dplg) wawubalulekile ekusebenziseni isivumelwano esisha somthethosisekelo sokudlondlobala. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo emisha kanye nezisekelo zomthetho zokuphatha kwendawo eNingizimu Afrika. Lo msebenzi obenhla uveze imithetho yokuphatha kwendawo, iMthetho Wezinhlelo Zasemakhaya, iMthetho Wamasu Wasemakhaya, iMthetho Wokuhlawula Izindlu Zasemakhaya, kanye neMthetho Wokuhlela Izinhlelo Zasemakhaya phakathi nalesi sikhathi. Ukuqapha okuqondile ngesikhathi sokuqala somsebenzi kwakuwukwakha isikhungo esisha sezepolitiki esibalulekile kuhulumeni odlalayo ezingeni lesizwe nasezindaweni. Ukuqala kwesikhathi sesibili sokuphatha ngo-1999 kwalethe ushintsho egameni lalesi sikhungo, okwaholela emisebenzini yayo emisha. Umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa umthethosisekelo wathunyelwa kuMnyango Wezobulungiswa, owabe usubizwa kabusha ngokuthi uMnyango Wezobumbano Nezokuphatha Zasendaweni (dplg). Amandla amasha e-dplg aba yisisekelo ekuthuthukiseni ukuphathwa, kwandisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, futhi kwavumela ukuthuthukiswa. Ngenxa yalokho, amandla e-dplg aguquka ukusuka ekubeni umgcini womthethosisekelo kuya ekuqineni izikhungo zokuphatha nokwandisa ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa iminyango nokwakha uhlelo olusha lokuphatha kwendawo. Ngokwakhiwa komgomo wezokuphatha kwendawo, ukuqapha kwayo okuqondile kwaba ukusungulwa kwamamunicipality kanye nezinhlelo zawo njengesisekelo nokweseka isimo sokusebenzisa amandla awo omthethosisekelo. Izinhlelo Zokuphatha Ezibanzi: Lezi ziqinisekiso zihlanganisa ukukala ukusetshenziswa kweHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni Ezihlala Zihlala (isrdp), uHlelo Lokuvuselela Izindawo (urp), Izinsizakalo Zesisekelo Mahhala (fbs), ukuphatha izimo zokuphazamiseka, kanye nokwakha umgomo wokuphatha izimo zokuphazamiseka kanye nezisekelo zomthetho, kanye nokushintsha imithetho enegunya lezi zikhungo zokuhola ezindaweni zokuphatha nasemiphakathini ebandakanya ezinye izikhungo zikahulumeni. Uhulumeni Wesifunda: Ukuqapha okuqondile phakathi nesikhathi esiningi se-term kusekela izifunda ukuze zikwazi ukusebenzisa ukwesekwa kwazo kanye nemisebenzi egcizelelwe mayelana namamunicipality. Uhulumeni Wendawo: Omunye umqondo wokuphepha okuqondile nguMnyango mayelana nohulumeni bendawo wawukusebenza kwemigomo emisha kanye nemithetho yokuphatha kwendawo, usekela ukusungulwa kokuphatha kwamamunicipality kuzo zonke izingxenye zawo futhi uqedela yonke imithetho yawo yokuphatha efana neMthetho Wokuhlawula Izinsizakalo Zasemakhaya (Mthetho Wezintela Zasemakhaya). NgoDisemba 2000, amakhandidethi akhethwe okokuqala aqala ukusebenza ngaphansi kwesakhiwo somthetho esisha. Okufakiwe kule ndawo yemisebenzi kwakuwukuphatha izimo zokuphazamiseka, ukusungulwa kwesakhiwo somthetho sokuphatha izimo zokuphazamiseka kwazulu, kanye nokwethulwa kwezinyathelo zokuvikela ezimweni ze-Y2K. Ingxenye yesibili yalomsebenzi yayiqondiswe ngokuqondile ekulethweni kwezinsiza zokwakha kanye nezibonelelo ezilinganiselwe kumamunicipality. Lezi zinsiza zemali zakhula unyaka nonyaka, zakhokhela ukusungulwa kwemali yokuqala kumamunicipality kanye nokwandiswa kwezimo zokuhlinzeka ukuze kuqedwe okwakuhamba kancane ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Kusukela ngo-1994, isimo esisebenza njengemishini ye-apartheid saguqulwa saphenduka sibe ngama-1200 ezikhungo zomphakathi ezisekelwe ebuzweni, izifunda ezine zokuphatha, kanye nezindawo eziyi-10, saguqulwa sibe ngama-284 amamunicipality akhethwe, izifunda eziyi-9, kanye nohulumeni wesizwe onamandla. Ukhetho oluthule kanye nedemokhrasi ephelele kwenziwa ngo-1994, ngo-1999, nase-2004 kuhulumeni wesizwe, wesifunda, kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Uhulumeni kuzo zonke lezi zinkalo uphumelele ezinhlelweni ezahlukene zokuhlukumeza ubuphofu nokungathuthukiswa ngokuphelele. Izinhlelo nezinhlelo zafezekiswa ezindaweni ezifana nokudla nokudla okuyisisekelo, amanzi nezinsizakalo, ugesi nokuhlinzekwa kwamandla, izindlu nezindawo zokuhlala, ukulungiswa komhlaba, ukuthutha, imfundo, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ama-SMME, kanye nokuhlanganiswa komphakathi. Ububanzi bezifunda ukuze ziqhubeke zithola izinsiza ezikhululiwe ezivela ku-fiscus zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nakho kwaba yimpumelelo yangempela. Ukuhlolwa okuphelele kwezifunda kukhombise ukuthi zikwazi ukusebenzisa izabelomali eziguquliwe ngempumelelo futhi zakhombisa imiphumela ebonakalayo ekuphathweni kokusetshenziswa kwezimali. Izinhlelo zamamunicipality njengesisekelo zisetshenziswe futhi zakhuliswa ukuze ziqondise ngokuqondile ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi, ukuhlanganiswa kokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, kanye nokuphathwa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwesekwa kwezimali kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi kusebenze ekuxazululeni okwakuhamba kancane kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi ezindaweni ezazingenakuphila ngokuphelele. I-MIG iyindlela yokudlulisela izinsiza ezintsha ezihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ukudluliswa kwezimali kumamunicipality ngendlela ecacile futhi eqondile. Imigomo yayo iyashintsha, ihloselwe ukweseka izabelomali zamamunicipality, futhi ilungiselela uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. I-MIG ngeke ikhokhele ezinye izinhlelo, kodwa ihloselwe ukuvumelanisa nezabelomali zamamunicipality (efana ne-grant yokwakha yesifunda). Ukubika ngokusetshenziswa kwezimali kuzobe kuhamba kuyo yonke ibhajethi yamamunicipality, okumele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kukhona izabelomali zokusebenza esikhathini esizayo ukuze kusekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ezabelwe. Iminyango yombuso kazwelonke izoqhubeka ihola futhi isekele ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ezinhlelweni futhi ithuthukise izinhloso ezicacile. I-isrdp iyisinyathelo sikahulumeni, esihlinzekwa nguMnyango Wezobumbano Nezokuphatha Zasendaweni. Iqala ukusebenza ngo-Okthoba 2000, emva kokuvunywa nguMkhandlu. Le nhlelo ihlose ukulwa nobuphofu, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo labantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, intsha, nabantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Inhloso eyinhloko yohlelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni usebenza ngokubambisana nemiphakathi nabanye abathintekayo ukuze kulwe nobuphofu futhi kuthuthukiswe izinga lempilo ezindaweni zasemakhaya. I-isrdp ihloselwe ukufezekisa ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi kanye nomphakathi osezingeni eliphezulu onomnotho ophilayo futhi oqinile ongagcina isithunzi semiphakathi yasemakhaya. Ukuthuthukiswa kwasemakhaya kuhlose okungenani ukugqiba ukuhamba phambili kwabantu basemakhaya eminyakeni eminingi ngokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo kanye nokufinyelela okuphelele ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi ezifana nemidlalo nezokuzijabulisa, izikole, ama-clinic, nj
Ukuqapha nokuhlola ikhwalithi yemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka kwazo ezindaweni ezahlukene ezisebenzisa amanzi. Uhlelo olubanzi lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha (NCMP), oluphathwa nguMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla waseNingizimu Afrika, lukhona kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1970. Izibonelo zalolu hlelo ziqoqwa ngezikhathi ezithile ezijwayelekile eziteshini zokuhlola ezweni lonke futhi zihlaziywa ezlabhoratri zomnyango ukuze kutholakale izinto ezingcolisayo kokubili eziphilayo nezingenamoya emvelweni. Ulwazi oluqoqiwe oluvela kuhlelo lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha lusetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda ngesimo se-ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha emanzini esiwasebenzisayo ezweni lonke kubaphathi bezinsiza zamani, ososayensi, abathathi bezinqumo, kanye nomphakathi ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda. I-ikhwalithi yamanzi ihlolwa ukuze ibone ukufaneleka kwayo kokusetshenziswa kwasekhaya kanye nokunisela kwezolimo, kanti izici eziphezulu ze-ikhwalithi yamanzi ezihlanganiswe kulolu cwaningo zazikhawulelwe kulabo abathathwa njengokufaneleka kulezi zindawo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Izinkinga ezinkulu ze-ikhwalithi yamanzi kubasebenzisi bamanzi asekhaya zifaka izinga eliphezulu le-Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) futhi, kwezinye izindawo, izinga eliphezulu le-fluoride. Ububanzi bokumuncwa kwe-sodium, ukwakheka kukagesi, pH, nezinga le-chloride zingaba izinkinga ezingenzeka ezolimo ezinelanga. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinamanzi ambalwa ngoba likhona ezindaweni ezihlala zinezimo ezinzima nezomhlaba, ezinezimo zezulu ezihlukene ukusuka emathafeni kuya kumathafa aphakathi nendawo engxenyeni esentshonalanga yezwe kuya ezindaweni eziseduze nolwandle olusempumalanga. Ukwehla kwemvula okuphakathi nendawo ezweni kungu-500 mm (Joubert, 2003), okuphansi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinga lokwehla kwemvula emhlabeni elingama-860 mm (DWF, 2002). Nakuba amanzi angaphansi komhlaba ebalulekile ekuhlinzekeni ngezindawo zasemaphandleni ezingxenyeni zalesi sizwe, ngenxa yokwakheka kwejiyoloji okuphezulu kweNingizimu Afrika, kunezintaba ezinkulu ezingasetshenziswa ukuhambisa inani elikhulu lamanzi ezindaweni ezinkulu (DWAF, 2002). Ukwehla kwemvula namanzi aphansi kuhanjiswa ngendlela engalingani futhi ngezikhathi ezithile, nezikhathi zokwehla kwemvula ezinzima zenzeka ezindaweni ezinkulu zalesi sizwe. Ngakho-ke, ukuhamba kwamanzi okunokugeleza okukhulu kuvame ukwenzeka, okungaholela ekwandeni kwamanzi ezindaweni eziphansi, ukuthuthukiswa kwedolobha, kanye nemisebenzi yezimboni eyenzeka ezindaweni ezikude nemifula emikhulu - ngenxa yezinsimbi kulezi zindawo nezinye izizathu - kuholela ekudingeni ukuhamba kwamanzi okukhulu kakhulu isikhathi esiningi (DWAF, 2002). Imifula emine emikhulu eNingizimu Afrika ihlukaniswe namanye amazwe, okwenza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi kube umsebenzi obucayi futhi obalulekile. Ukuze kuphathwe izinsiza zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika, izwe lihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye eziyi-19 zokuphathwa kwamanzi (WMA) (DWAF, 2002). Inhloso yalokhu, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuvumela abasebenzisi bamanzi nezinye izithakazelo ukuba babambe iqhaza kahle ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Ezinye zalezi zikhungo kuzodingeka ukuthi zisungulwe kanti ezinye (kuhlanganisa noMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla) kuzodingeka ziguqulwe ukuze zikhombise imisebenzi emisha noma ethuthukisiwe njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho Wamanzi (Umthetho 36 ka-1998) (DWAF, 2002). Ngenxa yezidingo ezibekwe ezinsizeni zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika, imithombo yemvelo yamanzi ithintekile kakhulu kulezi zinhlelo zokulawula ezinjengemifula nezindonga zokugcina amanzi ezakhiwe emifuleni, kanye nemisebenzi yabantu efana nokukhipha amanzi, amanzi abuyela emifuleni, kanye nemiphumela yokusebenzisa umhlaba (DWAF, 2002). Njalo, lokhu kuholele ekwehliseni ikhwalithi yamanzi aphezulu futhi kube nemiphumela emibi ezinhlelweni zokuphila kwezitshalo nezilwane zasemanzini. I-ikhwalithi yamanzi ingase ibe mibi kwezinye izindawo ngenxa zezizathu zemvelo. Izinto ezingaphili ezakha lapho izendlalelo zezitshalo zidalwa, izinto ezisele zokusebenzisa umhlaba, kanye nezinye izinto eziphilayo ezihamba emvelweni, njengezitshalo nezinsalela zezilwane. Izilwane ezincane eziphilayo ezifana namagciwane, ama-virus, nezilwane ezidla igazi, ezivela emhlabathini nasemvelweni, zingase zifake futhi izinsalela zezilwane nabantu. Izinto ezikhulula ukukhanya okuqinile ngokuvamile zenzeka kuphela ngezinga elincane ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo. Ukutholakala kwezamanzi ngendlela efanele, lokho, ibhalansi ekufinyeleleni ezinsizeni zamanzi, ekusetshenzisweni kwezidingo zamanzi nezinzuzo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuqhubekayo, ngokwenza izinguquko ezincane ekusetshenzisweni kwamanzi ukuze kufinyelelwe ebhalansini phakathi kokutholakala kwamanzi nezidingo zomthetho zamanzi, nokuthi kuqale ukwenziwa izindlela zokulondoloza amanzi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle ukuze kufinyelelwe ezinzuzweni ezinkulu zomphakathi nezomnotho. Ukuze lezi zinhloso zifezeke, umthetho weMthetho Wamanzi (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998) wasungulwa. Lona ngumsebenzi obalulekile wezomthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika. Lo Mthetho uthi "amanzi ayinsiza yemvelo eyabelwe abantu bonke." Umehluko omkhulu owethulwe yilomthetho uma kuqhathaniswa nemithetho yamanzi yangaphambilini ukuthi ilungelo lokufinyelela emanzini alisancikile ekubeni nomhlaba, ukuthi abantu bonke banelungelo elifanayo lokufinyelela emanzini afanele izidingo eziyisisekelo zomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okokuqala, imvelo iyavuma ukuthi inelungelo lomthetho lokufinyelela emanzini. Ukuqapha nokuhlola ikhwalithi yemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ze-NWA nezinye izidingo zokuhlola ikhwalithi yamanzi. Uhlelo olubanzi lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi, oluphathwa nguMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla eNingizimu Afrika, lukhona kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1970. Izibonelo zalolu hlelo ziqoqwa ngezikhathi ezimfushane ezijwayelekile eziteshini zokuhlola ezweni lonke futhi zihlaziywa ezlabhoratri zomnyango ukuze kutholakale izinto ezingcolisayo nezinto ezingaphili neziphilayo. Inhloso yocwaningo olwakhiwe kule ndatshana kwakuwukuhlinzeka ngolwazi ngezinto ezinkulu ezingaphili ze-ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha emanzini asetshenziswe eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso kwakuwukuhlinzeka ngencazelo emfushane ngesimo se-ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha esetshenziswa ngokuya ngezidingo ze-ikhwalithi yamanzi zabasebenzisi bamanzi abakhulu, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi asekhaya kanye nokunisela kwezolimo. Ulwazi luphinde lwethulwe ezingeni elihlinzeka ngemininingwane eyengeziwe lapho kukhona idatha eqoqiwe eyanele ezindaweni ezihambelanayo. Lolu lwazi luhambelana kakhulu nalabo abahlanganyela ngekhwalithi yamanzi
Ingcebo/ifundo yesizwe iyingxenye ebalulekile noma umqondo owenza ubunikazi bayo. Ihlanganisa umlando wesizwe nendlela okukhuluma ngayo noma okulandela ngayo abanikazi bayo, amasiko, ubuciko, [ubuningi] nolimi, izinhlobo zokudla abazithokozisayo, umculo abawuthandayo, nokuthi bakha kanjani futhi bahlobisa izakhiwo zabo. Ukuhlanganiswa okunRich kwezingcebo ezahlukene kweNingizimu Afrika kwenza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahluke kwabanye abantu emhlabeni. Ingcebo yethu isihlukile kwabanye izizwe futhi isenza sibe nezimfanelo ezihlukile njengokufana nesikhumbuzo seprincess. Akukho ndawo enye lapho ubunikazi balo mzansi buhlangene kahle futhi bukhanyiswe kahle njengasemibhalweni yalesi sizwe - iflegi yesizwe, i-anthem yesizwe, kanye ne-emblem yesizwe. Wonke umuntu oseNingizimu Afrika, izingane, abadala, izikole, abasebenzi, abaqashi, izikhungo ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (NGOs), izikhungo zomphakathi (CBOs), kanye nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni bangakwazi ukwazi, ukuqonda, futhi bazigcine ngokwethula lezi zimpawu kanye nalokho okuqukethwe. UNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi, kanye Nobuchwepheshe. Izimpawu zesizwe sethu yilezi zibonakalayo nezizwakalayo ezichaza ubunikazi besizwe. Izimpawu zesizwe zichazwe nguMthethosisekelo futhi ziqondwa njengokukhuthaza ukuvuselelwa kanye nokwakha isizwe. Ilungelo lokuvota linikezwa wonke umuntu omdala, uhlu lwabavoti lwesizwe olulodwa, ukhetho okuvamile, kanye nohulumeni owenziwe ngezikhungo ezahlukene ukuqinisekisa ukubekwa phambili, ukuphendula, nokucacisa. I-anthem yesizwe esiyilalelayo idlalwa noma iculetshwa emicimbini ebalulekile yesizwe futhi ifundiswa ezikoleni noma emicimbini yezemidlalo. I-emblem yesizwe ibonakala ezakhiweni zikahulumeni, emadokhumenti, nasezimotweni zikahulumeni, phakathi kokunye. Iflegi entsha yesizwe yaseNingizimu Afrika yaqala ukusetshenziswa ngoMgqibelo 27, 1994. Yamukelwa masinyane ngemuva kokuphuma kwemini/nokuphuma kokuhlwa njengoba isizwe esisha sikhula. Ukuklama nemibala ye-flag kuyisithombe semibala ebalulekile emlandweni weflegi yaseNingizimu Afrika, kusukela ezikhathini zakudala kuze kube manje. Imibala ebomvu, emhlophe, kanye ne-blue yavulwa kusenesikhathi emlandweni weflegi yaseNingizimu Afrika; kuyilapho imibala emnyama, eluhlaza, kanye negolide yaqala ukuvela eflegi yethu yesizwe ngekhulu le-19. Imibala emithathu yonke isanda kuba yinhle kakhulu eflejeni yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuphathelene nalokho le mibala imela, kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi umbala ngamunye ungaba nencazelo noma uchaze izinto ezahlukene kubantu abahlukene. Ngalesi sizathu, asizokhiphi umbala onguye owodwa incazelo ethile. Noma ubani ukhululekile ukuba ne-interpretation yabo yokuthi umbala othile umela noma umele ini. Lokhu kwavunyelwene ngesikhathi kuxoxwa ngovoti lwezikhulu ngonyaka ka-1994. Ukwakhiwa kwengxenye ephakathi kweflegi, eboniswe njenge "V," kuhlanganisa phakathi kweflegi, kuqhubeka njengomugqa oqondile ukuya emaphethelweni, kukhombisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene yaseNingizimu Afrika, ibamba indlela phambili ndawonye njengento eyodwa. Le mbono ixhumene nomqondo we-emblem yesizwe, ebizwa nge-!ke e:/xarra//ke, okuyilimi leKhoisan (/Xam San people), okusho "abantu abahlukahlukene bahlangana." Lokhu kuklama kweflegi kuhlukile kodwa uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye iflegi. Iflegi yesizwe izoba nezingxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo ububanzi nezindandatho ezintathu; ingxenye ephakanyisiwe, umugqa obomvu phezulu, kanye nomugqa oluhlaza phansi, kanye ne-triangle emnyama lapho izokwenyuswa, kanye nemigqa ehlukanisa umugqa oluhlaza ozoba ingxenye eyodwa yesihlanu yobubanzi, nomhlanga oseduze nobomvu noluhlaza; kanye ne-triangle yegolide endaweni emnyama lapho izokwenyuswa; kanti ububanzi nokuphakama kuzoba ingxenye eyodwa yesithathu yobubanzi beflag. Iflegi kufanele ithathwe ngokuhlonipha. Akufanele idonswe emhlabathini noma kube nezinto ezifakwe kuyo. Iflegi iyafana nencwadi - ukusuka phezulu iye phansi nangakwesokunxele ukuya kwesokudla. Uma iboniswa ngokuhlanganyela, ukuhamba kufanele kube ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli kanti umugqa obomvu uphakathi. Uma iflegi iboniswa ngokuvundlile, lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi isizwe sisesimweni esinzima noma sithwele kanzima. Uma iboniswa kahle, kufanele ihlale ihlanzekile nomugqa obomvu ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli kanti ukuhamba kwayo kusemkhakheni. Uma iboniswa eduze noma ngemuva komkhulumeli, kufanele ibekwe ngakwesokudla kwalowo mkhulumeli. Ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli, uma iboniswa kumkhankaso, umkhankaso wayo kufanele ube phambi kwemikhankaso yezinye iflegi. Uma ibhujiswa eduze kwezinye iflegi noma nezinye iflegi, kufanele ibe ngakwesokudla. Kufanele futhi ibe ngakwesokudla uma iboniswa nezinye iflegi zezinye izizwe noma kwamanye amazwe (zonke kufanele zibe zilinganayo ngosayizi nokuphakama). I-Emblem Yesizwe noma i-Emblem Yombuso iyisithombe esiphakeme esibonakalayo. Thatha isikhashana ucabange ngezikhathi ezibalulekile empilweni yakho - ukuzalwa, umshado, ukufa, nezitifiketi zesikole, ipasipoti yakho, zonke lezi ziqashelwa ngokomthetho yi-Emblem Yombuso. I-denomination encane yemali inemfanekiso wale emblem ngakolunye uhlangothi. Uma ukude kwelinye izwe, ukubona le emblem ezakhiweni zezikhungo zokumisa kuyisithombe sasekhaya noma ungakabi ekhaya. I-Emblem Yombuso iyingxenye ebalulekile yeSeal Elikhulu, ngokwesiko ibhekwa njengophawu oluyinhloko lweMphakathi. Noma iyiphi idokhumenti enesiginesha ye-Emblem Yombuso inikezwa amandla aphelele, njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ivunyelwe nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika. Umgwaqo wezokulungisa ulethe umthetho ozovumela umphakathi nezinye izithakazelo ezifana noMnyango wezobuJustice kanye neSikhungo sePolisi saseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babe nezwi ezinqumweni eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwabanjwa ngaphambi kokuphela kwezinsuku zabo. Ngesikhathi esizayo, abathintekayo emaphutheni bazovunyelwa ukwenza iziphakamiso kwiBhodi yeParole ezibhekelele izinsizakalo zokulungisa nokuhlanganyela emihlanganweni yeBhodi mayelana nezimo ezinzima. Kungani kudingeka ushintsho? Uhlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi luhlala lukhala kakhulu ngenxa yokubona ukuthi abaphathi bezokulungisa bayaphazamisa ezinqumweni ezenziwa yizinkantolo. Nakuba uhlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi lukhona emhlabeni jikelele futhi luhloselwe ukuhlela ukuziphatha kwabaphuli bomthetho ngokukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle nokubambisana, kanye nokunciphisa umehluko phakathi kokuphila ejele nokuphila okujwayelekile emphakathini. E-Ningizimu Afrika, lolu hlelo lukhala ngenxa yokuntuleka kokucaciswa nokuzimela ngesikhathi sokwenza izinqumo. Lezi zimo kanye nethuba lokubamba iqhaza komphakathi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuholele ekushintsheni komthetho nasekuthumeleni umthetho ngo-1998 owayevumela ukusungulwa kohlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi olucacile nolungakhethi, oluhlanganisa izithakazelo zangaphandle ekwenzeni izinqumo. Kukhona izinselelo ezinkulu ezivimbe ukwamukelwa kwalesi sigaba (isigaba 74) somthetho wezokulungisa, Umthetho 11 ka-1998. Lo mthetho waguqulwa ngo-2001 ukuze ubhekane nalezi zinkinga. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuphumelelisa lolu hlelo ukuze kuqedwe maduze engxenyeni yesibili ka-2004. Yini indima yeBhodi yeParole? AmaBhodi eParole abhekelele ukuhlela izindaba eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwabanjwa kanye nokubhekwa kwabo. Kuze kube manje, lawa mabhodi awanawo amandla okwenza izinqumo eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Okwamanje, amaBhodi enza kuphela iziphakamiso ezihambisana nenqubomgomo ekhona yokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi izinqumo zenziwa ngabasebenzi abaphethe ngqo, isibonelo; abaphathi bezikhungo zokulungisa, abaphathiswa bendawo, abaphathiswa bezifunda, kanye noNgqongqoshe wezokulungisa, kuye ngokuthi ubukhulu balesi simo nokubuhlungu kwesigwebo. Umthetho omusha unikeza iBhodi amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kwabanjwa abathathwa njengobungozi nalabo abathathwa njengobungozi uma amaBhodi enza iziphakamiso ezithunyelwa enkantolo eyayinikile isigwebo, engase iyaphika futhi iguqule isigwebo. Okokuqala, umthetho omusha unikeza amaBhodi eParole amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kwabanjwa abathathwa njengobungozi ngokwesigaba 286A soMthetho Wokuphatha Kwecala futhi aguqule izigwebo ezibekwe ngesigaba 276(A) soMthetho Wokuphatha Kwecala mayelana nabanjwa abakukhululwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ezimweni ezishiwo ngenhla, iziphakamiso zithunyelwa ezinkantolo ezanikela isigwebo ekuqaleni bese kwenziwa isinqumo. Okwengeziwe, isinqumo sokuvumela ukukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kubanjwa ngosuku noma ezikhungweni ezithathwa njengobungozi. Kwezizimo, iziphakamiso zithunyelwa ezinkantolo ezanikela isigwebo bese kwenziwa isinqumo. AmaBhodi angama-52 azosungulwa ezweni lonke azoba namalungu akhishwe emphakathini. Amalungu azoba ngabantu abanokwethembeka nokuhlonipheka phakathi kwemiphakathi yabo abamele. Kumele babe ngabantu abakhulile abaqonda impilo futhi belungele ukumelwa izintshisekelo zomphakathi ngokuhlonipha nangokungakhethi. Izihlalo kumele zibe ngabantu abanemfundo efanele ehlanganiswe nesipiliyoni sokuphatha. Ngaphandle kwesihlalo, amalungu amabili angeziwe azothunyelwa kwiBhodi. Izikhala zePhini leSihlalo noMphakathi zigcinwe kubasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe boMnyango wezokulungisa. Ibhodi izophinde ifake abamele abavela kuSikhungo sePolisi saseNingizimu Afrika kanye noMnyango wezobuJustice. Le miphumela nokumelwa akuyona imfuneko njengoba lezi zinsizakalo zingakhetha ngesikhathi esizothunyelwa noma cha. Ezimweni ezihilela amacala anzima, ummeleli ovela kuMnyango wezobuJustice udinga ukuhlinzeka ngombiko kwiBhodi. Ibhodi ngalinye izosizwa ngamalungu amabili avela emnyangweni wezokulungisa ukuze kube nezinhloso zokuphatha nokweseka. Kwesinye isinyathelo esihlukile emsebenzini wendabuko kanye nomzamo wokunikeza amandla kubantu abathintekayo, abathintekayo beziphambeko ezithile bazoba nelungelo lokwenza iziphakamiso kwiBhodi futhi baphathe imihlangano yeBhodi kuphela uma bexoxa ngezindaba eziphathelene nabantu abashushumbiswa kubo. Lokhu kubhekwa njengesenzo esibalulekile sokwakha nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa obubuyiswayo njengendlela evunywayo, yokwakha nokuhlanganisa. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba amaBhodi amasha eParole azokwenza izicelo ezivela ezikhungweni ezahlukene zabanjwa ezethulwe kubo, izimo ezintsha ezithinta isikhathi esizokhululwa khona umphakathi ngaphambi kokucabangela i-parole zizosebenza kuphela kulabo abathole isigwebo ngemuva kokuthi izinhlinzeko ezithile zomthetho ziqale ukusebenza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bonke abanjwa abathole isigwebo ngaphambi kokuthi umthetho omusha uqale ukusebenza bazophathwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho okhona (Umthetho 8 ka-1959). Ngamanye amazwi, abanjwa abathole isigwebo esikhathini esedlule ngaphambi kokuthi umthetho omusha uqale ukusebenza akufanele balindele ukuthi umthetho omusha uzoba nomthelela omubi esikhathini esizokhululwa ngaphambi kokucabangela i-parole. Abantu abakhonjwa njengabaphuli bomthetho abavame: Ngemuva kokusebenza okungenani iminyaka eyisikhombisa. Umthetho omusha uvumela ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokubhekelela iParole ezobhekelela amacala adluliselwa kuyo ukuze ibuyekezwe nguMphathiswa noma uNgqongqoshe wezokulungisa uma bekholelwa ukuthi isinqumo sokuqala seBhodi Yokubhekelela iParole siphikisana noma sithinta inqubomgomo ekhona yokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Ibhodi Yokubuyekeza izoba nezimfanelo futhi ibanjwe ngamalungu avela kwiNational Council of Correctional Services, uMphathi noma uMphathi oPhindayo wezokuphatha, kanye namamele ababili emphakathini. Isihlalo seBhodi Yokubuyekeza sizoba uJaji weNkantolo Ephakeme, futhi isinqumo seBhodi sizothathwa njengomthetho obophelelayo kumaBhodi Yokubhekelela iParole. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu aqonde izinguquko ezilethwe umthetho omusha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu, uMnyango uqale umkhankaso wokwazisa ophakanyiswe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane kubanjwa, abasebenzi bezokulungisa, kanye nomphakathi mayelana nomthelela womthetho omusha. Izikhangiso ezihlosiwe ukuheha amalungu omphakathi ukuba basebenze njengezihlalo zamaBhodi noma amalungu angeziwe ziz
ukusekela imizamo yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle ezindaweni zokusebenza zikamasipala. Ukuqinisa ukuhlonipha phakathi kwabantu abasebenzayo kanye phakathi kwabaphethe nabantu abasebenzayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abaphethe nabantu abasebenzayo banokuqonda okuvumelekile mayelana nokuziphatha okungalungile nokuziphatha okufanele. Ukukhuthaza indlela evumelekile yokuphatha. Ukuhlinzeka abaphethe nabantu abasebenzayo ngomsindo osheshayo nolula wokubika ukuziphatha okungalungile. Futhi ukuvimbela ukungabheki umthetho noma ukucwasa abantu abasebenzayo ngabaphathi. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuyindlela yokulungisa, hhayi eyokuhlukumeza. Ukuziphatha okufanele kufanele kwenziwe ngesikhathi, okuvumelekile, okujwayelekile, nokuthuthuka. Ukuziphatha okufanele kuy umsebenzi wobuphathi. Ukuhlanganiswa kwemithetho kuyadingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe izinkinga ngokushesha nokwelashwa okufanele kwabantu, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasebenzayo: a. banethuba elilinganayo lokukhuluma ngezinhlelo ezihlelwe nezingeziwe. b. bagcinwa beqaphele ngezimo zokuziphatha okungalungile ezenzakalayo kubo. c. bathola izizathu ezibhaliwe zazo zonke izinqumo ezibhaliwe, futhi d. banelungelo lokuphikisa noma iyiphi inqumo. Yonke imizamo izokwenziwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imihlahlandlela yokuziphatha okungalungile iyenzeka ezindaweni zokusebenza futhi ibikwe kubo bonke abantu abasebenzayo. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ephatha kabi, lokho kungaba yicala, icala elibi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinyathelo zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungalungile zizokwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Isinyathelo sokuhlukanisa ngokwezindlela zokusebenza ezindaweni zokusebenza asithinti inqubo yomthetho. Lezi zimo nezindlela ziyizikhombandlela kuphela futhi zingashintshwa ngokuya ngezimo ezifanele. Lokhu kuyasebenza kuwo wonke amakhansela ahlobene nezinsizakalo zomphakathi, noma aqukethwe emthethweni noma ezinqubweni. Imithetho, izinqubo, nezindinganiso zokuziphatha. Ukuziphatha ezindaweni zokusebenza okungase kudinge ukuthi umuntu osebenzayo abhekane nezinyathelo zokuhlukanisa kuchazwe ku-Anneksure A. Lezi zihloko aziphelele. Ubuphathi bungahola umuntu osebenzayo mayelana nokuziphatha kwabo, inqobo nje uma beqaphele, noma kufanele baqaphele ukuthi lokho kuziphatha kudinga isinyathelo sokuhlukanisa. a. izinsolo zokuziphatha okungalungile zinefuthe elikhulu emsebenzini kahulumeni, emnyangweni wezabasebenzi, nasekukhuleni. Izindlela zokubhekana nokuziphatha okungalungile. Izeluleko zokulungisa ukuziphatha okungalungile. Ezimweni lapho kubalulekile ukusungula ukubaluleka kokuziphatha okungalungile, umphathi kufanele akwenze lokhu. a. azise umuntu osebenzayo ngokuziphatha kwabo okungalungile. b. Chaza kumuntu osebenzayo icala elibhekiswe kubo, bese unika ithuba lokukhuluma ngale cala abhekene nakho. d. Thatha isinyathelo sokulungisa esivumelwene. Isixwayiso sokukhuluma. Uma umuntu owonile edinga isixwayiso, isixwayiso singanikezwa ngokukhuluma. Umphathi kufanele azise umuntu osebenzayo ukuthi uma eqhubeka nokuziphatha kabi, bangabhekana nezinyathelo zokuhlukanisa, futhi isixwayiso sizobhaliswa. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso esibhaliwe, umphathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo okufanele zilandelwe uma kukhishwa isixwayiso esibhaliwe. b. umphathi kufanele anikeze umuntu osebenzayo ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele basayine. Uma bengavumi ukusayina, umphathi kufanele anikeze omunye umuntu osebenzayo ukuze asayine njengofakazi wokuthi umuntu owonile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela lempilo yomuntu osebenzayo. d. Isixwayiso esibhaliwe sithintwa umthetho isikhathi esiyizinyanga eziyisithupha. Ekupheleni kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, kufanele kususwe kufayela lempilo futhi kuqedwe. e. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ethola icala phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokuhlukanisa okufanele athole. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ophathe kabi edinga isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe, umphathi anganikeza isixwayiso esibhaliwe. Lezi yizimo okufanele zilandelwe uma kukhishwa isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe. b. umphathi kufanele anikeze umuntu osebenzayo ikhophi yesixwayiso, futhi kufanele basayine. Uma bengavumi ukusayina, umphathi kufanele anikeze omunye umuntu osebenzayo ukuze asayine njengofakazi wokuthi umuntu owonile uthole isixwayiso. c. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe kufanele sigcinwe kufayela lempilo yomuntu osebenzayo. d. Isixwayiso sokugcina esibhaliwe sithintwa umthetho isikhathi esiyizinyanga eziyisithupha. Ekupheleni kwezinyanga eziyisithupha, kufanele kususwe kufayela lempilo futhi kuqedwe. e. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ethola icala phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha, isixwayiso singasetshenziswa ekwenzeni isinqumo mayelana nezinyathelo zokuhlukanisa okufanele athole. Izigameko ezifanayo ezihlobene nabantu abasebenzayo kufanele zithole izixwayiso ezifanayo ukuqinisekisa indlela ejwayelekile yokuhlukanisa noma yokubhekana nokuziphatha okungalungile. Uma icala elibhekiswe kumuntu osebenzayo libaluleke kakhulu, kudinga ukuthi kube nepenalty ehlukile kunalezo ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni esingu-15, umphathi angase aqale uphenyo mayelana nepenalty. Umphathi kufanele aqoke ummeli ukuze aqale uphenyo, okumele kube umphathi. Isaziso sokuphenya a. umuntu osebenzayo kufanele anikezwe isaziso okungenani ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela. b. Umuntu osebenzayo kufanele asayine isaziso esiqinisekisa usuku lokulalela. Uma bengavumi ukusayina, kufanele banikezwe omunye umuntu osebenzayo ozosayina ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umuntu owonile uthole isaziso. Incazelo ephelele yokuziphatha okungalungile, ubufakazi umphathi ozosebenzisa. Ulwazi mayelana namalungelo abantu abasebenzayo, abamele abantu abasebenzayo noma abamele inhlangano yezabasebenzi eyamukelekayo, kanye nalabo abazobeka ubufakazi. a. umphathi angamphumula umuntu osebenzayo noma amukele imali yakhe ngokuphelele, noma amtransfer kuMnyango omunye wenhlangano. Ngaphansi kwalezi zimo; uma umuntu osebenzayo ebhekene noma enza icala elibi, futhi umphathi ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlela komuntu osebenzayo emsebenzini kungaphazamisa uphenyo lwecala elibhekiswe kubo, noma kube yingozi empilweni yomuntu noma impahla kahulumeni. c. Uma umuntu osebenzayo ephumuliwe noma ethunyelwe, umphathi kufanele abambe ukulalela phakathi kwenyanga. Umphathi wokulalela uzokwenza isinqumo sokuthi icala lizophumelela yini. a. Ukulalela kufanele kwenziwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokuthi isaziso sinikezwe kumuntu osebenzayo. b. Umphathi wokulalela kufanele abe sezingeni eliphezulu kunommeleli womuntu osebenzayo. Uma umuntu osebenzayo obhekiswe icala engumholi womnyango, umphathi wokulalela kufanele abe yisikhulu esip
A.1 Lezi ziqondiso zizobizwa ngokuthi Izimiso Zesevisi Yomphakathi zika-2001 futhi zizothatha umthelela kusukela ngo-1 Januwari 2001, ngaphandle kwezikhombisi III B.2 (b) kanye ne-III F(b) yeSahluko-1, ezizothatha umthelela ngosuku olukhulunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngalesi sikhangiso esisemthethweni. B.1 Lezi zimiso zizofundwa ndawonye neMthetho. c "I-Core" iyisifinyezo seKhowudi yeMiholo, njengoba kuchazwe esikhombisweni III 1.3 kuya ku-1. r "I-SMS" ibhekisela kubasebenzi abanikwe igama esikhombisweni- l B. v "Izimiso Zezimali" zisho Izimiso Zezimali ezishicilelwe kuSaziso SoHulumeni Inombolo R.556 ka-31 Meyi 2000 njengoba kuguqulwe ngezikhathi ezithile futhi kwenziwa ngaphansi kwesigaba -76 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi; futhi noma iyiphi enye igama izobhekisela kulokho okukhulunywe kwiMthetho. Isigaba -41 seMthetho sikhuthaza lezi zimiso. a kubo bonke abantu abaqashwe kanye nakuzo zonke izikhungo eziphethwe nguMthetho; futhi b ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho, kubantu abaqashwe ezinsizeni, ezikhungweni noma ezikhungweni zemfundo zendawo, kodwa kuphela lapho zingaphikisi nemithetho ephethe ukuqashwa kwabo. E.1 Izimiso Zesevisi Yomphakathi zika-1999 (ezashicilelwa kuSaziso SoHulumeni Inombolo R.679 ka-1 Julayi 1999), kuhlanganise nazo zonke izinguquko ezenziwe kanye nazo zonke izimiso ezenziwe futhi ezisebenza ngaphansi kweMthetho, zikhanselwa lapha. E.2 Noma iyiphi isenzo esithathwe ngaphansi kweZimiso Zesevisi Yomphakathi zika-1999 futhi esingaqhutshelwa ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zalezi zimiso sizobhekwa njengokwenziwa ngaphansi kwaleyo nhlinzeko. E.3 Nakuba Izimiso Zesevisi Yomphakathi zika-1999 zikhanselwa ngaphansi kwesikhombisi- l E.1, izinhlelo zokudlulela phambili zizokwenziwa kuSevisi Yomphakathi- 1. Umthetho Wobudlelwano Bezemisebenzi kanye nezivumelwano ezihlangene zizophatha izindaba ezithinta bobabili phakathi kweZinsizakalo kanye noMbuso njengomqashi. Uma kwenzeka izimo zivumela ukweqa ezinhlinzekweni nasezikhombisweni zendlela ethile kulezi zimiso mayelana nezimo zokusebenza ku-sevisi yomphakathi, uNgqongqoshe angathatha izinqumo, akhiphe iziqondiso noma avume ezinye izimiso ngaphansi kwezimo ezichaziwe futhi azisebenzise. a xhumana naye ngeMenenja-Jikelele: Isevisi Yomphakathi kanye Nokuphathwa; futhi b bhala ngolimi olusemthethweni lezi zimiso ezashicilelwa ku. H.2 Umsebenzi uzokhombiswa nganoma yimuphi umbuzo ophathelene nezindaba ngaphansi kwamandla nezibopho zikaNgqongqoshe ophakathi kweminyango yakhe. H.3 Umphathi wombutho uzokwethula kuMenenja-Jikelele: Isevisi Yomphakathi kanye Nokuphathwa, kusenesikhathi ngokuxoxisana, noma iyiphi ifreyimu esemthethweni noma ifreyimu yokwethula umthetho noma idokhumenti yepholisi ethinta amandla noma izibopho zikaNgqongqoshe. H.4 Umphathi wombutho uzokwakha ipholisi mayelana nokuthi abasebenzi bomnyango wakhe bangabambisana kanjani nezindaba nezikhungo zezindaba. H.5 Umsebenzi, emsebenzini wakhe, akavunyelwe ukuhlabela umqondo wepholisi kahulumeni endaweni yomphakathi noma emaphephandabeni noma ezindaweni zezindaba noma kunoma iyiphi imithombo yezindaba zomphakathi. Ukuze avumele umphathi wombutho ukuphatha umnyango wakhe ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo, umphakathi omkhulu uzohlinzeka umphathi wombutho ngamandla adingekayo kanye namandla. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphathi wombutho uzovuma abasebenzi emnyangweni ngokudlulisa amandla afanele nezimvume lapho kudingeka. a bangadlulisa amandla kubasebenzi noma bavume abasebenzi ukwenza lelo thaskh; futhi b bazokwenza izinqumo mayelana nokusebenzisa la mandla noma ukwenza lelo thaskh. B.2 Umphakathi omkhulu uzobhalela phansi ukudluliswa kwamandla noma izimvume ngokubhala futhi lokhu kungafakwa futhi esivumelwaneni sokuqashwa somphathi wombutho, njengoba kuchaziwe esikhombisweni -VII B.2.1. B.3 Ukudluliswa kwamandla nguMphakathi omkhulu noma umphathi wombutho akuvimbeli ukuba basebenzise la mandla bona. C.2 Umphakathi omkhulu akavunyelwe ukuqinisa noma ukuvumela umphathi wombutho noma noma yimuphi omunye umsebenzi ukuba abambe iqhaza kunoma iyiphi indaba noma athathe isinqumo esiphula lezi zimiso. a uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bomnyango wakhe bayahambisana nalezi zimiso, izivumelwano ezihlangene kanye nanoma yiziphi izibopho zomthetho; futhi b uzobhekana ngokushesha nangokwanelisayo nanoma yiziphi iziphazamiso ezingenzeka. C.4 Umphakathi omkhulu noma umphathi wombutho bazosebenzisa amandla abo, benze imisebenzi yabo futhi baqede izibopho zabo ngaphansi kwezi zimiso ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezemisebenzi nezivumelwano ezihlangene ezisebenzayo. C.5 Umphakathi omkhulu nomphathi wombutho bazokuqinisekisa ukuthi uMnyango Wezezimali uvuma ngaphambi kokuthi benze isinqumo esihilela ukusetshenziswa kwemali evela emalini engenayo. D.1 Lapho kungase kube nokungqubuzana kwesithakazelo uma kwenziwa noma iyiphi inqumo mayelana nokuqashwa, umphakathi omkhulu noma umsebenzi onamandla uzokwenza lelo thaskh noma athathe isinqumo kuphela ngemva kokucabangela isiphakamiso esivela kuphaneli ezimele equkethe okungenani abantu ababili. D.3 Umphakathi omkhulu noma umsebenzi akavunyelwe ukuthola noma ukufuna noma iyiphi imbuyiselo yemali kunoma iyiphi indlela emsebenzini noma kumuntu ongase abe ngumsebenzi ngokwenza okuthile noma ukuthatha isinqumo mayelana nokuqashwa. Umsebenzi akavunyelwe ukuveza emphakathini noma iyiphi imininingwane esemthethweni ngaphandle kwamandla adingekayo. Umphakathi omkhulu uzokwakha imigomo ebonakalayo yomnyango wakhe ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhishwa ngokubuyiselwa kwemali esebenzisiwe, kugcwaliswa ngokuphelele izinsiza zomnyango kuhlanganise nabasebenzi, futhi futhi kusetshenziswa ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi njengoba kudingeka. Ngokusebenzisa imali ethokozisayo futhi echazwe ngezinhlinzeko nemiyalelo yomnyango kanye nohulumeni ukuze ahlinzeke, umphakathi omkhulu uzohlela ukwenza imisebenzi ngendlela ehlelekile, eyanelisayo futhi ephumelelayo ngaphakathi kwenhlangano nezinqubo zokuphatha abasebenzi ezakhiwe. Ukuze kuvumeleke ukubhekelela umphakathi nokukhanya, umphakathi omkhulu uzoshicilela umbiko wonyaka ohlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nomnyango wakhe. ukusekela ukuhambisana nezidingo zokubika esikhombisweni III J kanye neziMiso zezeMali eMnyangeni ophansi avunyelwe ngemininingwane, futhi kukhombiswe esikhombisweni- VII H; futhi g ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezikhishwe ezigabeni- 5.1 no-5.2 zeziMiso zezeMali. c sichaza izikhundla ezidingekayo ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi ethile ngaphakathi kokuhlinzekwa kwemali okukhona kanye neSikhungo Sokusetshenziswa Kweze
Ukugcina imibhalo ngokomthetho kuyisibopho somthetho esidinga bonke abashicileli (nokukhiqiza) eNingizimu Afrika bazo zonke izinhlobo zemibhalo, kuhlanganise naleyo eshicilelwe ngobuchwepheshe, ukuthi bathumele inani elithile lezi zinkampani abazishicilelile ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ezibekwe ukuze zigcinwe. Kuyisiko emhlabeni wonke ukuthi uhulumeni badinge abakhiqizi bezinhlobo zonke zemibhalo, kuhlanganise namavidiyo namathrekhi abhalwe, ukuthi bahlinzeke ngenani elithile lemikhiqizo yabo kulezi zindawo ezisemthethweni ezibekwe. Okwamanje, amazwe emhlabeni jikelele abuyekeza futhi aguqule imithetho yabo ephathelene nokuhanjiswa kwemibhalo ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuze kuhlangabezane nokwanda kwemibhalo eshicilelwe ngobuchwepheshe efana namavidiyo, ama-CD, nama-DVD. Inhloso yokugcina ulwazi endaweni esemthethweni ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokuhlinzeka abasebenzisi balo msebenzi, kokubili ngesikhathi samanje nakusasa, ngolwazi nemibhalo equkethe imisebenzi namagugu amasiko abalulekile kuzwelonke. Ukugcina ulwazi ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kwaqala ngo-1842 ngokwethulwa kokuqala kweMthetho Wamalungelo Ababhali waseBrithani, ovikela ilungelo lombhali lokuba ngumthombo wemibhalo kuyo yonke iMpire yaseBrithani. Kwakukhona futhi izinguquko emthethweni ngesikhathi seMthetho Wamalungelo Ababhali ka-1965 kanye neMthetho Yokugcina Imibhalo Eseshicilelwe ka-1982. Okwamanje, iMthetho Yokugcina Imibhalo (Umthetho 54 ka-1997) yakhishwa ngomhla kaJulayi 1, 1998. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwemibhalo, izincwadi, neminye imithombo equkethe ulwazi olufana namafilimu, amavidiyo, ama-CD omculo, nama-DVD, wonke ashicilelwe noma akhiqizwe eNingizimu Afrika. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngesisekelo somthetho esibanzi mayelana nenani lezi zinkampani okufanele zigcinwe, isimo sokufika kwazo, ulwazi oludingekayo kubashicileli nabakhiqizi, isikhathi sokuhanjiswa kwezinkampani, kanye nezinyathelo okufanele zithathwe uma abashicileli nabakhiqizi behluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho. Imibhalo iyinto enzelwe ukugcina noma ukudluliselwa njengolwazi olubhalwe, kungaba kokubhaliwe, kokubukwayo, noma okurekhodiwe ukuze kulalelwe, nangendlela ethile ebonakalayo nangeminye imithombo ebonakalayo. Lokhu kubhekisela kwimibhalo ekhiqizwe ukuze isetshenziswe emphakathini, ehlelelwe ukukhiqizwa nokusabalalisa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, egcina noma idlulisa ulwazi olubhalwe, ulwazi lokubukwayo, ulwazi olurekhodiwe ukuze kulalelwe, olufundwa ngama-mishini, noma lwethulwa nganoma iyiphi enye ifomethi ehlolwe noma esanda kushicilelwa eyahluka kakhulu kulokho okwakukhona ngaphambili ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi luhlukile noma indlela nesimo sokuthi luthunyelwe kulokhu kushicilelwa eNingizimu Afrika noma ehlelelwe ukusetyenziswa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcina ifa elibhalwe nelirekhodiwe kusiza ukufinyelela kwabantu emisebenzini yonke eshicilelwe eyakhiqizwe ezweni labo. Ngakho-ke, ukugcina ulwazi ngokomthetho kuyisici esibalulekile sokukhululeka kolwazi. Kusiza izwe lethu ukuba ligcine izibopho zakhona zokwethembeka kubantu bonke, kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wombhali awulahlekile futhi uyatholakala ukuze ucwaningwe esikhathini esizayo, kuvumela indawo yokugcina ukuba ikhulume ngokuqwashisa kubo bonke abasebenzisi balemisebenzi mayelana nalokho okukhishwe nokushicilelwe njengesisekelo sokwakhiwa kwezincwadi zendawo nezinye iziqoqo zolwazi ezazisa abasebenzisi-bokugcina nalabo abazozisebenzisa ezwenikazi nasemhlabeni jikelele ngencwadi ezikhona neminye imibhalo, ngaleyo ndlela kukhuthaza ukusabalala kwayo nokuthengwa, kuba isisekelo sokuhlanganiswa kwezibalo ezikhiqizwe yi-UNESCO emhlabeni jikelele, okuyinsiza ewusizo yolwazi emsebenzini wezincwadi nezohwebo. Kungase futhi kusebenze le njongo kwezinye izindlela.
Amagama akhanyisiwe achaza izichibiyelo ezenziwe emthethweni osekhona. Kubandakanya ukuphathwa kukamasipala ngokuphumeza ukuqoqa intela yezindlu; ukulungisa umthetho weMiphakathi: Umthetho Wokwakhiwa Kwamakhaya ka-2000, ukuze kuqhubeke futhi kuqinisekiswe izinhlinzeko zokuthi amakhaya athumele izaziso; ukulungisa noma ukususa eminye imithetho; kanye nokubhekana nezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene. Isihloko esifingqiwe kanye nokuqala komthetho. Imetropolitan municipality noma i-local municipality ingakha intela yezindlu ezindaweni ezibekwe yibo. I-district municipality ayikwazi ukuklama intela yezindlu ngaphandle uma indawo ingaphakathi kwedolobha elibekwe yilolo dolobha. Ezinye izinhlinzeko zalo mthetho; kanye nenqubomgomo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu okumele amakhaya avume ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sesi-3. Ikhansela likamasipala kumele ivume inqubomgomo ehambisana nalomthetho mayelana nokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu ezindlini noma ezindaweni ezibhekene nentela yezindlu kumakhaya. Ivumela amakhaya ukuba akhuthaze intuthuko yendawo; futhi kulandela ukuhlaziywa okujulile mayelana nezindleko nezinhlelo zenzuzo, zonke izindlu noma impahla ezingase zingafakiwe ngaphansi kohlelo lokuhlola ngenhloso yokwakha intela yezindlu. Noma iyiphi imali ebuyisiwe, ukulungiswa, noma ukuncishiswa okukhulunywa ngesigaba sesi-2 futhi kucatshangelwa enqubweni yenqubomgomo evunyelwe kumasipala kumele ihambisane nezinga likazwelonke elingase lilawulwe ukuze lisetshenziswe. Ikhansela likamasipala kumele libheke zonke iziphakamiso ezamukelwe nezibhalwe ezithunyelwe kulo ngesikhathi sokucubungula izinga lenqubomgomo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu. Ikhansela likamasipala kumele lihlaziye minyaka yonke, futhi uma kudingeka, lishintshe inqubomgomo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu. Izigaba ezi-3 nezingu-4, ezifundwa ndawonye nezichibiyelo ezidingekayo njengoba kuxoxiwe, zisetshenziselwa noma yiziphi izinguquko zenqubomgomo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu. I-local municipality kumele ivume ukuthi imithetho yamasipala ifaka isandla ekusebenzeni nasekuphumezeni inqubomgomo yayo yokuqoqwa kwentela yezindlu. a ngezigaba ezihlukene zezakhiwo nezindawo; futhi b ngezizinda ezihlukene zabaphathi abaphethe ukukhokha intela yezindlu. Uma i-municipality inquma ukuklama intela yezindlu, kumele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala, iklame intela yezindlu kuzo zonke izakhiwo noma ezindaweni okufanele zibe nezibopho zokukhokha intela yezindlu ngaphakathi kwamasipala noma endaweni engaphansi komthetho we-local municipality efanele ukukhokha intela yezindlu. i uma i-municipality uqobo noma enye i-municipality ingum sahibi; noma ii njengoba kuxoxiwe esigabeni b encazelweni yomhlaba noma impahla esigabeni sokuqala; noma iii lapho ilungelo lokuba nomhlaba lingavikelwe ngokomthetho ngenxa yemithetho eyayiphikisana nezinhlelo noma ezinye izizathu ezenza kube nzima noma kungenzeka ukuba kutholakale inani; noma b ukuvimbela i-municipality ekunikezeni amalungelo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sika-14 mayelana nezimali ezibuyisiwe, noma ukukhokha okweqile noma ukuncishiswa ekukhokheni intela yezindlu ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala. b ukusetshenziswa okugunyaziwe kwempahla noma indawo; noma c indawo lapho impahla ikhona. Imali yentela yezindlu ohlelweni lwendawo lapho yakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela empahleni eyodwa kumele iklanywe ngokuhlukile ngokuhambisana nosayizi walowo mhlaba okufanele ube nezibopho zalolu hlelo hhayi iklanywe njengemali eyodwa ehlanganisa yonke indawo. a kufanele kube yimali esekelwe ekuthuthukisweni kwenani lentela yezindlu yaleyo mpahla njengoba kuboniswe ephepheni lokuhlola likamasipala ngaleso sikhathi; noma b intela efanayo empahleni noma endaweni emkhakheni okhethekile, kuye ngokuthi leyo ndawo ingaphansi kwesilinganiso sokuhlola esisemthethweni. Imali efanayo yentela yezindlu ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala b akufanele idlule imali okufanele ikhokhwe empahleni noma emhlabeni ezingeni eliphansi lokuhlonza ngokuhambisana nokuhlola ukuthi le mali iklanywe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala a. Intela yezindlu ingaklanywa ngamasipala ngaphezu kweminyaka eyodwa yezezimali ngaphandle kokugunyazwa nguNgqongqoshe wezokuphatha. a iqala ekuqaleni kweminyaka yezezimali noma ngosuku olukhulunywe njengoba lokhu kungase kubonise isinqumo esixoxiwe esigabeni sika-13 mayelana nokwakhiwa kwenani lentela yezindlu; futhi b ayikwazi ukuklanywa ukuba ibuyiselwe emuva. Imali yentela yezindlu iklanywa ngamasipala kulandela isinqumo esithathwe ikhansela likamasipala esekelwa ukhetho olunengi lwamalungu ale khansela. i ukuthi ikhansela lamukele isinqumo sokwakha inani lentela yezindlu; futhi ii ikhophi yesinqumo kumele itholakale ukuze icubungulwe emphakathini phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza ehhovisi elikhulu lokuphatha le municipality nezinye izindawo ezichaziwe kule nsiza. a uhlu lwabo bonke abathola imali ebuyisiwe, labo abakhokhelwe, nalabo abathole ukuncishiswa ngonyaka odlule ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sokuqala; futhi b isitatimende sikhombisa imali ethole i-municipality yangaphambili ngemuva kwemali ebuyisiwe, ukulungiswa, kanye nokuncishiswa. b imisebenzi yezomnotho engagciniwe kulolo masipala; noma c ukuthuthwa kwezimpahla ngaphakathi kwelizwe, ukuthumela izidingo, imali, noma abasebenzi. h Okungenani inani lokuqala le-R15,000 lenani lezindlu zonke lapho zakhiwe khona futhi zihlala khona, ngaphandle kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi uNgqongqoshe, ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali, angakhuphula le mali ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ukuze ihambisane nezinga lezomnotho ngaleso sikhathi; futhi i Impahla/umhlaba noma izigaba zezakhiwo/umhlaba njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni sika-3, noma inani lentela yezindlu elibekwe enanini elibekwe njengemkhawulo empahleni/indawo noma emkhakheni wezindlu noma indawo. i izindawo zomnotho ii izindawo zezimboni; noma iii izindawo zokulima isilinganiso esixoxiwe esigabeni sika-1 b singashicilelwa kuphela ngokusemthethweni ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali nangesaziso, abeke umkhawulo kumaphesenti okukhuphuka kwenani lentela yezindlu ngonyaka. a kanye nezinhlobo zamakhaya angase, kulandela lesi sigaba, achazwe esazisweni njengokuhambelana nezigaba noma izinhlobo zamakhaya ngaphansi kohlobo lomthetho wezakhiwo zikamasipala nangokunye; noma b izinhlobo zezakhiwo/izigaba uma kukhona isizathu esihle, uNgqongqoshe angavuma ukubuyiselwa kumakhaya ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ebekwe kulandela isigaba sokuqala.
