Khuluma ulimi lwakho. Kuyilungelo lakho. Yisiphi usizo olunikezwayo? I-TISSA inikeza usizo lokuhumusha ngocingo ukuze kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni usebenzisa izilimi zomdabu ezisemthethweni ukuze ufike emathubeni ohulumeni. Kungani lokhu kusizo kunikezwa? Ngokusebenzisa i-TISSA, uhulumeni ufeza umgomo wakhe wombuso ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezisebenzayo zokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zomdabu ezisemthethweni. Ingabe umphakathi ungacela usizo kuhulumeni ngolimi lwabo lokukhuluma? Yebo, inqobo nje uma leli limi lingelinye lamalimi asemthethweni. Ingabe ulimi lwezimpawu lwabantu abaphefumula luhlanganisiwe? Uma ummember womphakathi kanye nomsebenzi kahulumeni bengakwazi ukuqonda ulimi lomunye, umsebenzi kahulumeni angabiza isikhungo sokushayela se-TISSA. Esikhungweni sokushayela, umsebenzisi uzoxhuma umsebenzi kahulumeni nommember womphakathi kumhumushi okhuluma kokubili lezi zilimi. Umsebenzi kahulumeni uzoba nengxoxo yokubili ukuze yena nommember womphakathi bakwazi ukulalela umhumushi. Umhumushi uzohumusha kokubili abantu. Lokhu kungathatha imizuzwana embalwa kuphela. Ngizokwazi kanjani uma umnyango kahulumeni uzokunikeza usizo lokuhumusha? Uma ihhovisi likahulumeni lingakhombisi uphawu lwe-TISSA, ngingakucela lokhu kusizo lokuhumusha? Cha, lokhu kusizo kutholakala kuphela ezindaweni lapho uphawu lwe-TISSA lukhonjiswe khona. Nokho, izindawo ezahlukene zizofakwa esikhathini esizayo. Uzokwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni ngolimi lwakho.
Kubhalwe kahle ukuthi kubalulekile ukuthi noma iyiphi INKONZO YOKUXHUMANA NEMFUNDO/IMIGOMO YOKUXHUMANA ibe ngaphansi kwenkampani ye-inshurensi ebhalisiwe yesikhathi eside. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ummember uthola izimali zokuxhaswa uma efuna ngesikhathi senzeka okuthile okudingayo inshurensi (ukufa). UMHLOBO WEMIGOMO/UMMEMBER kumele anikezwe ISITIFEKETI SOMMEMBER. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise ngokucacile igama lenkampani enikeza le migomo; inani elizokhokhwa; izinzuzo ezizokhokhwa; izinqubo zokufaka izicelo zezimali nezinye izinto ezibalulekile mayelana ne-MASTER POLICY. I-MASTER POLICY kumele ibonise ngokucacile ukuthi abaphathi bezemihlangano noma abasebenzi abaqashwe yinkampani yemigomo abawukhokhi le migomo. Kubalulekile kubanikazi bemigomo ukuthi bazi ukuthi bangakhetha ukuthola izinzuzo zemigomo njengenzuzo yesevisi yokungcwaba noma ukuthola imali. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise zonke izincazelo ezidingekayo kumHLOBO WEMIGOMO/UMMEMBER ezifana nezikhathi zokuqala zokukhokha nokuthi yini ekhokhwayo nokuthi yini ENGAKHOKHIWE; izikhathi zokulinda, njll. Idokhumenti esemthethweni ethunyelwe yinkampani kumele ibe nezinhlaka zezinzuzo, izimali, imithetho, neziqondiso futhi ibe nenombolo ye-inshurensi, okufanele ibonakale esitifiketini sommembership. I-Friendly Society iyisikhungo sezezimali esakhelwe ngamaqembu abantu abanezidingo ezithile, abahlanganisa imali futhi bagcine ndawonye ukuze basizane ngokwezimali ezidingweni ezithile, njengokungcwaba. Inzuzo eyinhloko ngu-R5000. I-Friendly Society ayiyona ibhizinisi elenzela inzuzo, kodwa inzuzo ethathwa emalini egcinwe ngamalungu iyabelwa phakathi kwabo. Kufanele uqiniseke ukuthi uthola lesi sitifiketi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ungummember. Lesi sitifiketi kumele sikhombise zonke izincazelo zemigomo yakho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi inkampani evunyelwe yinkampani ye-inshurensi ithengisa inshurensi ngegama layo. Inkampani ye-inshurensi yesikhathi eside ebhaliswe neBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali ithola imali oyikhokhayo ngenyanga futhi ibhekele ukukhokha izinzuzo uma kwenzeka ukufa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi wena njengommember ufaka imali ekhokhwayo kubantu abakhethile emigomweni. Imali oyikhokhayo uma uthola inshurensi njalo ngenyanga. Lokhu kuy umuntu ozimele ongaxhumana naye uma ungajabule ngempendulo evela lapho uthole khona inshurensi. Imininingwane yokuxhumana iboniswa esikhangisweni esisemthethweni nasemuva kwaleli phephandaba. Inkampani ye-inshurensi izohlola izimo noma izifo ezisemigomweni ezingaholela ekufeni komuntu ophethwe yimigomo, futhi akukho zinzuzo ezizokhokhwa. Qaphela: Kufanele kube nobufakazi obuhlinzekwe kumuntu othengisa inshurensi futhi kufanele kube kufomu lesicelo nasemagunyeni akhishwe. Qaphela: Le mali oyikhokhayo ibonisa zonke izindleko ezizokhokhwa kuwe nezimali. Lezi zimalini ozokhokhwa kufanele zikhonjiswe ngokucacile. Umbuzo: Ngiyakhokha ngenyanga, ngenyanga yesithathu, noma ngonyaka? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ukuthi uzodinga ukukhokha nini. Umbuzo: Ngiyakhokha ngaphambi noma ngabe ngikweletile? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ukuthi udinga ukukhokha ekuqaleni kwenyanga noma ekupheleni kwenyanga. Umbuzo: Uma ngikhokha ngempahla, ngizothola isitifiketi? Impendulo: Yebo, kufanele kube isitifiketi esisemthethweni. Umbuzo: Le mali ekhokhwa ngenyanga izokhula esikhathini esizayo? Impendulo: Imali ekhokhwa ingakhula uma kukhona izicelo eziningi kule migomo. Umbuzo: Le mali ekhokhwa iqinisekisiwe isikhathi esingakanani? Umbuzo: Nini kuqala inshurensi yami? Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma ukufa kubangelwa yengozi? Impendulo: Ezimweni eziningi, isikhathi sokulinda asisebenzi uma umuntu efile ngenxa yengozi. Umbuzo: Ingabe kukhona okukhishwayo? Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma ngiphuthelwa ukukhokha noma ngiyeka ukukhokha? Impendulo: Awusoze ube ngaphansi kwenshuro futhi uma uqala ukukhokha futhi, isikhathi sokulinda singase sibe khona futhi. Umbuzo: Ingabe ukuba ngaphansi kwenshuro kuyokwenziwa kumuntu ngamunye kuphela? Umbuzo: Ngizothola ubufakazi bokuba ngummember? Impendulo: Kufanele uthole ISITIFEKETI SOMMEMBER, isifinyezo sokuthi ubani ophathwe yile inshurensi, inani elizokhokhwa, zonke izikhathi zokulinda, nokuthi yini ephathwe yimigomo. Impendulo: Yebo, ungakhulisa inzuzo yemigomo yakho uma i-Master Policy ivumela, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, lokhu kuzokhulisa nenani ozokhokha ngenyanga. Izinzuzo nezikhathi zokulinda zingase zisebenze ezinuzweni ezandisiwe. Umbuzo: Ngizofaka kanjani isicelo sezimali uma othile efile? Impendulo: Inqubo yokufaka isicelo sezimali kufanele ihlinzekwe ngokuphelele kuwe emithethweni naseziqondisweni zemigomo. Impendulo: Ungakhansela imigomo yakho phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 zokukhokha ukukhokha kwakho kokuqala futhi uthole yonke imali yakho ngaphandle kokuthi usuhambisile isicelo sezimali zokungcwaba. Ngemuva kwalokho, imigomo ingakhanselwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, kodwa imali oyikhokhayo ngenyanga ngeke ibuyiswe. Impendulo: Lokhu kungakwenziwa, kodwa kufanele uqinisekiswe futhi uqondiswe ngendlela okuthinta ngayo abantu ababephakathi kwemigomo leyo esikhathini esedlule, mayelana nalokhu okukhuluma ngenhla. Inkampani entsha kumele ikuhlinzeke ngesitifiketi sommembership. Uma uzwa ukuthi awusekho esimweni efanayo noma engcono, kufanele uxhumane nenkampani ekhona ngokushesha. Umbuzo: Kwenzekani uma unok complaint noma umbuzo? QAPHELA: Imininingwane ye-Ombudsman kanye ne-FSB kumele kube esikhangisweni sommembership nasemuva kwephephandaba lolwazi.
Ngexesha lokuqala leMisebenzi yoMphakathi (1994-1999), iSebe leMisebenzi yeSifunda neYezeMidlalo (dplg) lwalubalulekile ekuphumezeni isivumelwano esisha somthethosisekelo sokudlula. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo emisha kanye nezinsiza zomthetho zokuphatha ezindaweni zendawo eNingizimu Afrika. Lo msebenzi obenhla uveze iMithetho YezeMidlalo, iMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi, iMthetho Wezakhiwo Zomphakathi, iMthetho Wezindleko Zempahla Zomphakathi, kanye neMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi ngesikhathi salo. Ukuqapha okuqondile ngesikhathi sokuqala somsebenzi kwakuwukwakha isikhungo esisha sezepolitiki esibalulekile kuhulumeni obusayo ezimweni zendawo nezifunda. Ukuqala kwesikhathi sesibili soMphakathi ngo-1999 kwethule ushintsho egameni lesi sebhizinisi, okuholele emisebenzini yayo emisha. Umsebenzi wokuthuthukisa umthethosisekelo wathunyelwa kuSebe lezeMthetho, elashintshwa igama laba yiSebe leMisebenzi yeSifunda neYezeMidlalo (dplg). Igunya elisha le-dplg laba yisisekelo sokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa, ukwandisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, nokwenza ukuthuthukiswa. Njengomphumela, igunya le-dplg lashintsha lisuka ekubeni umgibeli wombuso wempilo yabe lukhuni ukuphucula izikhungo zokuphatha nokwandisa ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa izigaba nokwakha uhlelo olusha lokuphatha ezindaweni. Ngokwakhiwa komgomo wezeMidlalo, ukuqapha kwayo okuqondile kwaba ukusungulwa kwezindawo zokuhlala nezinhlelo zazo njengesisekelo nokusekela isimo sokusebenzisa igunya layo lezeMidlalo. Izinhlelo Zokuphatha Ezibanzi: Lezi ziqinisekiso zifaka phakathi ukukala ukusetshenziswa kweHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezentengiselwano Okubambisene (isrdp), uHlelo Lokuvuselela Izindawo (urp), Izinsizakalo Eziyisisekelo Ezikhululekile (fbs), ukuphatha izimo zokuhlupheka, nokwakha umgomo wokuphatha izimo zokuhlupheka kanye nezinsiza zomthetho, kanye nokushintsha imithetho ngempela yamaqabane ezokuphatha ezindaweni. Uhulumeni Wezifunda: Ukuqapha okuqondile ngesikhathi esiningi somsebenzi kusekela izifunda ukuze zikwazi ukusebenzisa ukwesekwa kwazo nemisebenzi ekhombisa mayelana nezindawo zokuhlala. Uhulumeni Wendawo: Omunye umqondo wokuphenya okuqondile ngesigaba sokuphatha izindawo kwakuwukuphumeza imigomo emisha kanye nemithetho yokuphatha, kusekela ukusungulwa kokuphathwa kwezimali zezakhamuzi kuzo zonke izingxenye zayo nokuphothula yonke imithetho yayo yokuphatha efana neMthetho Wezindleko Zomphakathi (Mthetho Wezintela Zomphakathi). NgoDisemba 2000, amajaji okuhweba akhethwe aqala ukusebenza ngaphansi komgomo omusha wezomthetho. Okufakiwe kule ndawo yemisebenzi kwakuwukuphatha izimo zokuhlupheka, ukusungulwa komgomo wezomthetho wokuphatha izimo zokuhlupheka, nokwethulwa kwezinyathelo zokuvikela ze-Y2K. Ingxenye yesibili yale misebenzi yayiqondiswe ngqo ekulethweni kokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza kanye nezinsiza ezilinganiselwe ezindaweni. Lezi zinsiza zemali zakhula unyaka nonyaka, zakhokelela ekwabeleni izinsiza zokuqala ezindaweni zokuhlala kanye nokwandisa izimo zokuhlinzeka ukuze kuxazululwe lokho okwakuhamba kancane ngesikhathi sobandlululo. Kusukela ngo-1994, isimo esisebenza njengemishini yokubandlulula saguqulwa sithathe izikhungo ezingu-1200 ezisekelwe ebuzweni, izifunda ezine zokuphatha, kanye nezindawo eziyi-10 zokuhlala zaba izindawo ezingu-284 ezikhethwe, izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye, kanye nohulumeni wezwe onamandla. Ukhetho olunokuthula kanye nedemokhrasi ephelele kwabanjwa ngo-1994, 1999, no-2004 kuhulumeni wezwe, wezifunda, kanye nohulumeni bendawo. Uhulumeni kuzo zonke lezi zindawo uphumeze izinhlelo ezahlukene zokubhubhisa ubuphofu nokungathuthuki ngokuphelele. Izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zaphumelelwa ezindaweni ezifana nokudla nokudla okuyisisekelo, amanzi nezinsiza, ugesi nokuhlinzekwa kwamandla, izindlu nezindawo zokuhlala, ukulungiswa komhlaba, ukuthutha, imfundo, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ama-SMME, kanye nokuhlangana kwezenhlalo. Ukuthi izifunda ziqhubeke nokuthola izinsiza ezikhululiwe ezivela kwi-fiscus zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nakho kwaba yimpumelelo yangempela. Ukuhlola okujulile kwezifunda kukhombisile ukuthi zikwazi ukusebenzisa izabelomali eziguquliwe kahle futhi zakhombisa imiphumela ebonakalayo ekuphatheni ukusetshenziswa kwezimali. Izinhlelo zokuphatha njengesisekelo ziqalile futhi zakhuliswa ukuze ziqondise ngqo ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi, ukuhlela ukuhlanganiswa kokuthuthukiswa, ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo, nokuphathwa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwesekwa kwezimali kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi kuqedile ukuhamba kancane komlando wokuhlinzekwa kukagesi ezindaweni ezikade zingekho ugesi. I-MIG iyindlela entsha yokudlulisa izinsiza ezihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ukudluliswa kwezimali ezindaweni zokuhlala ngendlela ecacile neqoqa. Izimo zayo zishintsha kakhulu, zenzelwe ukweseka izabelomali zezakhamuzi, nokulungiselela uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe. I-MIG ngeke ikhokhele eminye imisebenzi, kodwa ihloselwe ukuvumelanisa nezabelomali zezakhamuzi (efana ne-grant ye-infrastructure yesifunda). Ukuveza ukusetshenziswa kwezimali kuzoba kuyo yonke ibhajethi yezindawo, okumele kuqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izabelomali ezisebenzayo esikhathini esizayo ukuze kusekelwe ukusetshenziswa kwezimali ezabelwe. Izigaba zomnyango kazwelonke zizoqhubeka nokuhola nokweseka ukusetshenziswa kwezimali emisebenzini futhi ziqhube izinjongo ezicacile. I-isrdp iyisiphakamiso somphakathi, esihlinzekwa yiSebe leMisebenzi yeSifunda neYezeMidlalo. Iqala ukusebenza ngo-Okthoba 2000, ngemuva kokuvunywa nguMkhuzi. Le nhlelo ihlose ukulwa nobuphofu, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo labantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi abesifazane, intsha, kanye nabantu abakhubazekile. Inhloso enkulu yohlelo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni usebenzisana ngokubambisana nemiphakathi nabanye abathintekayo ukuze kubhujiswe ubuphofu nokuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokuphila ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. I-isrdp ihloselwe ukufezekisa ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi kanye nomphakathi onempilo oqhubekayo onomnotho osebenzayo futhi ophucukile ongagcina udumo lwezindawo zasemaphandleni. Ukuthuthukiswa kwasemaphandleni kuhlose okungenani ukususa ukwehlukaniswa kwabantu basemaphandleni eminyakeni eminingi ngokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo nokufinyelela okuphelele ezinsizakalweni zomphakathi ezifana nemidlalo nezokuzijabulisa, izikole, ama-clinic, njll. Ukuhlinzeka ngesesekeli kumaphrojekthi nezinto ezisemaphandleni kuyinselelo enkulu kuhulumeni, ngakho-ke kudingeka ukusebenza kahle nabanye abathintekayo ukuze ku
Ukuqapha nokuhlola ikhwalithi yemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kutholakale ukufaneleka kwazo ezindaweni ezahlukene ezisebenzisa amanzi. Uhlelo oluphelele lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha (NCMP), oluphathwa yiMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla eNingizimu Afrika, lukhona kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1970. Izibonelo zalolu hlelo ziqoqwa ngezikhathi ezithile ezijwayelekile eziteshini zokuhlola ezweni lonke futhi zihlolwe emalabhorethri omnyango ukuze kutholakale izinto ezingcolisayo kokubili eziphilayo nezingenamandla emvelweni. Ulwazi oluqoqwe kulolu hlelo lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha lusetshenziswa ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda ngesimo sekhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha ezweni esisebenzisa amanzi, kubaphathi bezinsiza zamanzi, ososayensi, abathathi bezinqumo, kanye nomphakathi ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda. Ikhwalithi yamanzi ihlolwa ukuze ibonakale ifaneleka ukusetshenziswa kwasekhaya kanye nokunisela kwezolimo, kanti izingxenye eziphakeme zekhwalithi yamanzi ezihlanganiswe kulesi sifundo zazigxile kulokho okucatshangwa ukuthi kufanelekile kulezi zindawo zokusebenzisa amanzi. Izinkinga ezinkulu zekhwalithi yamanzi kubasebenzisi bamanzi abakhaya zihlanganisa amazinga aphezulu e-Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) futhi, kwezinye izindawo, amazinga aphezulu e-fluoride. Ukuhlola kokumuncwa kwe-sodium, ukuxhumana kukagesi, pH, kanye namazinga e-chloride kuyizinkinga ezingaba khona ezolimo ezinomoya. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinamanzi ambalwa ngoba likhona ezindaweni ezikahle kakhulu ezinomoya opholile nezomoya, ezinomoya ohlukahlukene ukusuka emathafeni kuya kumathafa apholile engxenyeni esentshonalanga yelizwe kuya ezindaweni eziseduze nekhasi elisha. Ukwehla kwemvula okuphakathi nendawo ezweni kungama-500 mm (Joubert, 2003), okuphansi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinga lokwehla kwemvula emhlabeni elingu-860 mm (DWF, 2002). Nakuba amanzi aphansi ebalulekile ekunikezeni izindawo zasemaphandleni ezingxenyeni zelizwe, ngenxa yesimo sejeoloji esiphakeme eNingizimu Afrika, kunezinto ezinkulu zezitini ezingasetshenziselwa ukuhambisa inani elikhulu lamanzi ngezindawo ezinkulu (DWAF, 2002). Imvula namanzi aphansi ahlukaniswe ngokungafani nangokwenziwa, ngokwezimvula ezinzima ezenzeka ezindaweni ezinkulu zelizwe. Ngakho-ke, ukuhamba kwamanzi okuqukethe ukuhamba okukhulu kuvame ukwenzeka, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezimvula ezindaweni eziphansi, ukuthuthukiswa kwedolobha, kanye nemisebenzi yezimboni eyenzeka ezindaweni ezikude nezifundeni ezinkulu - ngenxa yezinsiza ezisemhlabeni kanye nezinye izizathu - kuholele ekudingekeni kokwandiswa kwezinhlelo zokuhamba kwamanzi ezinkulu kakhulu kakhulu (DWAF, 2002). Imifula emine emikhulu eNingizimu Afrika ihlukaniswe nezinye izizwe, okwenza ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi kube umsebenzi onzima futhi obalulekile. Ukuze kuphathwe izinsiza zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika, izwe lehlukaniswe ngeziqu eziyi-19 zokuphathwa kwamanzi (WMA) (DWAF, 2002). Inhloso yalokhu, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuvumela abasebenzisi bamanzi nezinye izithakazelo ukuba babambe iqhaza kahle ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Ezinye zalezi zikhungo kuzodingeka ziqalwe kanti ezinye (kuhlanganiswe noMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla) kuzodingeka ziguqulwe ukuze zibonise imisebenzi emisha noma eshintshile njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wamanzi (Umthetho 36 ka-1998) (DWAF, 2002). Ngenxa yezidingo ezibekwe ezinsizeni zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika, imithombo yemvelo yamanzi ithintekile kakhulu ngalezi zinhlelo zokulawula ezifana nezinqaba nezindonga zokugcina amanzi ezakhiwe emifuleni, kanye nemisebenzi yabantu efana nokukhipha amanzi, amanzi abuyela emifuleni, kanye nemithelela yokusetshenziswa komhlaba (DWAF, 2002). Ngokuvamile, lokhu kuholele ekwehliseni ikhwalithi yamanzi aphezulu futhi kube nemiphumela emibi ezinhlelweni zokuphila kwezitshalo nezilwane ezisemanzini. Ikhwalithi yamanzi ingase ibe yimbi kwezinye izindawo ngenxa zezizathu zemvelo. Izinto ezingaphili ezakha lapho izendlalelo zezitini zakhiwa, izinto ezisele zokusetshenziswa komhlabathi, nezinto eziphilayo ezithululwa emvelweni, njengokhula nezinsalela zezilwane. Izinhlayiya ezincane kakhulu eziphilayo ezifana namagciwane, ama-virus, nezilwane ezidla igazi, ezivela emhlabathini nasemvelweni, zingase zifake nezinsalela zezilwane nabantu. Izinto ezikhipha ukukhanya okuqinile ngokuvamile zenzeka kuphela ngamaphesenti amancane ngaphansi kwezimo zemvelo. Ukutholakala kokulinganiselwa kwamanzi, okusho, ibhalansi ekutholeni izinsiza zamanzi, ekusetshenzisweni kwemithombo yamanzi nezinsiza zokusebenzisa amanzi. Ukusebenzisa amanzi okuqhubekayo, ngokwenza izinguquko ezincane ekusetshenzisweni kwamanzi ukuze kufezwe ibhalansi phakathi kokutholakala kwamanzi nezidingo zomthetho zamanzi, nokuqalisa ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokugcina amanzi. Ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kahle ukuze kufezwe izinzuzo ezinkulu zomphakathi nezomnotho. Ukuze lezi zinjongo zifezeke, umthetho weMvelo Wamanzi (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998) waphakanyiswa. Lona ngumthetho obalulekile ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi eNingizimu Afrika. Umthetho uthi "amanzi ayinsiza yemvelo ephethwe bonke abantu." Ukuhluka okukhulu okwenziwa yilo mthetho uma kuqhathaniswa nemithetho yamanzi yangaphambili ukuthi ilungelo lokufinyelela emanzini alisekelwe ekubeni nomhlaba, ukuthi bonke abantu banelungelo elilinganayo lokufinyelela emanzini afanele izidingo eziyisisekelo zomuntu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okokuqala, imvelo iyavuma njengokuthi inelungelo lezomthetho lokufinyelela emanzini. Ukuqapha nokuhlola ikhwalithi yemithombo yamanzi kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinjongo ze-NWA nezinye izidingo zokuhlola ikhwalithi yamanzi. Uhlelo oluphelele lokuqapha ikhwalithi yamanzi, oluphathwa yiMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla eNingizimu Afrika, lukhona kusukela ngeminyaka yama-1970. Izibonelo zalolu hlelo ziqoqwa ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile ezimfushane eziteshini zokuhlola ezweni lonke futhi zihlolwe emalabhorethri omnyango ukuze kutholakale izinto ezingcolisayo nezinto ezingaphili neziphilayo. Inhloso yocwaningo olwakhiwe kule ndatshana kwakuwukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezinto ezinkulu ezingaphili zekhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha emanzini asetshenziswa eNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso kwakuwukuhlinzeka ngencazelo emfushane ngesimo sekhwalithi yamanzi kemikhakha asetshenziswa ngokuhambisana nezidingo zekhwalithi yamanzi zabasebenzisi bamanzi abakhulu, okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi abakhaya kanye nokunisela kwezolimo. Ulwazi luphinde luhlinzekwe ezingeni elihlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile lapho kukhona idatha eqoqwe eyanele ezindaweni ezifanele. Lolu lwazi luyathakazelisa ikakhulukazi kulabo abaphatha ikhwalithi yamanzi esifundazweni kunokwenziwa kwenhlangano. Iglossary yezisho ibonakala ekuphe
Ingcebo/ukuhlomula kwesizwe yindawo eyisisekelo noma umqondo owenza ubunikazi bayo. Ihlanganisa umlando wesizwe nendlela olandelwa ngayo noma olandelwa ngabanikazi bayo, amasiko, ubuciko, [ukwehluka] nolimi, izinhlobo zokudla abazijabulelayo, umculo abawuthandayo, nendlela abakha futhi bahlobisa ngayo izakhiwo zabo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezimali ezicebile kweNingizimu Afrika kwenza abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahluke kwabanye abantu emhlabeni. Ingcebo yethu isihlukanisa kwabanye amazwe futhi isenza sibe nezehlakalo ezihlukile njengefa lempumlo. Akukho ndawo enye lapho ubunikazi baleli zwe buhlanganiswe kahle futhi bukhanyiswe njengemifanekiso yaleli zwe - ifulegi lesizwe, ingoma yesizwe, kanye ne-emblem yesizwe. Wonke umuntu ongumZulu, izingane, abadala, izikole, abasebenzi, abaqashi, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (NGOs), izinhlangano ezisekelwe emphakathini (CBOs), kanye neminyango kahulumeni bangakwazi ukwazi, ukuqonda, futhi bezwe bejabulile ukuthwala lesi sikhumbuzo nokuthi yini esikuyona. UNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi, kanye Nobuchwepheshe. Imifanekiso yesizwe sethu yilezi zimpawu ezibonakalayo nezingenamazwi ezichaza ubunikazi besizwe. Imifanekiso yesizwe ichazwa nguMthethosisekelo futhi iqondwa njengokukhuthaza ukuvumelana nokwakha isizwe. Ilungelo lokuvota linikezwa kumuntu wonke omdala, uhlu lwabavoti lwesizwe olulodwa, ukhetho okuvamile, kanye nohulumeni owenziwe ngizinhlangano ezahlukene ukuqinisekisa ukubekwa obala, ukuphendula, nokukhanya. Ingoma yesizwe esiyilalelayo idlalwa noma icula emicimbini ebalulekile yesizwe futhi ifundiswa ezikoleni noma emicimbini yezemidlalo. I-emblem yesizwe ibonakala ezakhiweni zikahulumeni, kumadokhumenti, nakuma-vehikhali kahulumeni, phakathi kokunye. Ifulegi lesizwe elisha laseNingizimu Afrika laqala ukusetshenziswa ngomhla ka-27 kuMbasa, 1994. Lwamukelwa ngokushesha ngemuva kokuphuma kokusa/nokuphuma kokuphuma njengoba isizwe esisha sikhula. Ukuklama nemibala yefulegi kuyisithombe semibala ebalulekile emlandweni wefulegi laseNingizimu Afrika, kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo kuze kube manje. Imibala ebomvu, emhlophe, noluhlaza yasungulwa ekuqaleni emlandweni wefulegi laseNingizimu Afrika; kanti imibala emnyama, eluhlaza, negolide yaqala ukuvela efulegini lethu lesizwe ngekhulu le-19. Wonke umbala wesithupha usanda kuba yinto ebonakalayo efulegini laseNingizimu Afrika. Mayelana nalokho le mibala emelela, kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi umbala ngamunye ungachaza noma ubonise izinto ezihlukene kubantu abahlukahlukene. Ngalesi sikhathi, asizokwenza umqondo othile kumuntu ngamunye. Noma ubani ukhululekile ukuba nezehlakalo zabo zokuthi umbala othile umele yini noma ubonisa ini. Lokhu kwavumelana ngesikhathi kuxoxwa ngovoti lwezinkulungwane ngonyaka ka-1994. Ukwakhiwa kwengxenye ephakathi yefulegi, ebukeka njenge "V," kuhlanganiswa phakathi kwefulegi, kuqhubeka njengomugqa oqondile ukuya emaphethelweni, kukhombisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemiphakathi ehlukene yaseNingizimu Afrika, ibamba indlela phambili ndawonye njengento eyodwa. Le mbono ixhumene nomqondo we-emblem yesizwe, obizwa nge-!ke e:/xarra//ke, okuyilimi leKhoisan (/Xam San abantu), okusho ukuthi "abantu abahlukahlukene bahlangana." Lokhu kuklama kwefulegi kuyahluka kodwa uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye ifulegi. Ifulegi lesizwe lizoba nesisekelo esilinganayo esinengxenye ezimbili ezilinganayo nobude obuthathu; ingxenye ephakanyisiwe, umugqa obomvu ophakeme, nomugqa oluhlaza ophansi, kanye ne-triangle emnyama lapho izophakanyiswa khona, nale migqa ihlukanisa umugqa oluhlaza ozoba ingxenye eyodwa kwezihlanu zobubanzi, nomhlophe ohlangene nobomvu noluhlaza; kanye ne-triangle yegolide kwi-triangle emnyama lapho izophakanyiswa khona; kanti ububanzi nokuphakama kuzoba ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu zobubanzi befulegi. Ifulegi kufanele lithathwe ngenhlonipho. Akufanele lidonswe emhlabathini noma kube nezinto ezibekwe phezu kwalo. Ifulegi ngokuyinhloko lifana nencwadi - ukusuka phezulu ukuya phansi nasekhohlo kuya kwesokudla. Uma likhombiswa ngokuqondile, ukuphakanyiswa kufanele kube ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli kanti umugqa obomvu uphakathi. Uma ifulegi likhombiswa ngokuqondile, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi isizwe sisesimweni sokudabuka noma sokuhlupheka. Uma likhombiswa likhuphuka, kufanele lihambisane nomugqa obomvu ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli kanti ukuphakanyiswa kukhulu. Uma likhombiswa eduze noma ngemuva komkhulumeli, kufanele libekwe ngakwesokudla kwalowo mkhulumeli. Ngakwesokunxele kwababukeli, uma likhombiswa kumphakanyisi, umphakanyisi kufanele ube phambi kwamaphakanyisi ezinye ifulegi. Uma likhuphuka eduze kwezinye ifulegi noma nezinye ifulegi, kufanele kube ngakwesokudla. Kufanele kube ngakwesokudla uma likhombiswa nezinye ifulegi zamazwe noma kwamanye amazwe (konke kufanele kube kulingana ngosayizi nobude). I-emblem yesizwe noma i-emblem yeState iyisithombe esibonakalayo esiphezulu. Thatha isikhathi sokucabanga ngezenzakalo ezibalulekile empilweni yakho - ukukhula, umshado, ukufa, nezitifiketi zesikole, ipasipoti yakho, konke lokhu kuyamukelwa ngokomthetho yi-emblem yeState. I-denomination encane yemali ithwala le emblem ngakolunye uhlangothi. Uma ukude kwelinye izwe, ukubona le emblem ezakhiweni zezimboni kuyisithombe sasekhaya noma ngabe awukhona ekhaya. I-emblem yeState iyingxenye ebalulekile yeGreat Seal, evame ukubhekwa njengophawu oluyinhloko lweState. Noma iyiphi idokhumenti ethwele isikhumbuzo seState Emblem inikezwa igunya eliphelele, njengoba lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ikhokhelwe nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika. Umqondo - okungowengxenye yesigubhu esiluhlaza: !ke e:/xarra //ke. kubhalwe ngolimi lweKhoisan futhi ukuhumusha okuqondile kusho: "abantu abahlukahlukene bahlangana." Kubiza isizwe ukuba sihlangane ngokubambisana nokuzigqaja - Ukuhlanganyela ekwehlukaneni. I-tusk yehlathi - iyisithombe sokuhlakanipha, amandla, nokuphila okungapheli. Ukuklama okuphakathi - kuyisithombe esakhiwe kusuka kumatshumi ehlathi - iyisithombe sokwaneliseka, ukukhula, nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, kukhuthaza abantu nezici zokulima zomhlaba. Ukumelwa/kubukeka kwabantu - kuthathwe kumakhono eKhoisan - kuthathwe ezithombeni ezidumile ezifana nitshe leLinton - lokhu kuyisibonelo esiyinhloko samakhono ezitsha zaseNingizimu Afrika, manje sekuhlinzekwa eMnyangweni Wezokuhlala eNingizimu Afrika - kuyisithombe sesiko sokubingelela nokuhlangana, kukhombisa: ukuhlanganiswa ekwehlukaneni. I-spear ne-shield - ziyizimpawu ezimbili ezimele ukuvikelwa nokuphatha - futhi zikhombisa imilenze eqinile
Umnyango Wezokulungiswa Uthumele umthetho ozovumela umphakathi nabanye ababambiqhaza njengomnyango wezobulungiswa kanye neSikhungo Sezokuphepha Kwezempi eNingizimu Afrika ukuba babe nezwi ezinqumweni eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwabanjwe ngaphambi kokuphothulwa kwezinsuku zabo. Esikhathini esizayo, izisulu zobugebengu zizovunyelwa ukuba zenze iziphakamiso kumaBhodi Okukhululwa okuhlola izinsizakalo zokulungiswa futhi zibe khona emihlanganweni yeBhodi mayelana nezimo ezinzima. Kungani kudingeka ushintsho? Uhlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi luhlale lukhala kakhulu ngenxa yokubona ukuthi abaphathi bezokulungiswa baphazamisa izinqumo ezenziwe yizinkantolo. Nakuba uhlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi lukhona emhlabeni jikelele futhi luhlose ukuhlela ukuziphatha kwabaphula umthetho ngokukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle nokubambisana, kanye nokunciphisa umehluko phakathi kokuphila ejele nokuphila okujwayelekile emphakathini. ENingizimu Afrika, lolu hlelo lukhala ngenxa yokungabi sobala nokuzimela ngesikhathi sokwenza izinqumo. Lezi zimo kanye namathuba okuthatha ingxenye yomphakathi lapha eNingizimu Afrika kuholele ekushintsheni komthetho nasekuthumeleni umthetho ngo-1998 owavumela ukusungulwa kohlelo lokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi olucacile nolungakhethi, oluhilela ababambiqhaza bangaphandle ekwenzeni izinqumo. Kunobunzima obukhulu obuphazamisayo ukwamukelwa kwalesi sigaba (isigaba 74) seMthetho Wezokulungiswa, Umthetho 11 ka-1998. Umthetho waguqulwa ngo-2001 ukuze ubhekane nalezi zinkinga. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokuphothulwa kohlelo ukuze kuphumelele masinyane engxenyeni yesibili ka-2004. Yini indima yeBhodi Yokukhululwa? AmaBhodi Okukhululwa abhekelele ukucubungula izindaba eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kwabanjwe kanye nokubhekwa kwabo. Kuze kube manje, lawa mabhodi awanawo amandla okwenza izinqumo eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Okwamanje, amaBhodi enza kuphela iziphakamiso ezihambisana nenqubomgomo ekhona yokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi izinqumo zenziwa ngababhekelele ngqo, isibonelo; abaphathi bezikhungo zokulungiswa, abaphathiswa bendawo, abaphathiswa bezifunda, kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokulungiswa, kuye ngokuthi ubukhulu balesi simo nokuthi ubukhulu balesi sijeziso. Umthetho omusha unika iBhodi amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaphandle kokuhileleka kwabanjwe abathathwa njengobungozi nalabo abathathwa njengokubeka engcupheni uma amaBhodi enza iziphakamiso ezithunyelwa enkantolo eyafaka isijeziso, engase iyiphikise futhi iyiphule. Okokuqala, umthetho omusha unika amaBhodi Okukhululwa amandla okwenza izinqumo ngaphandle kokuhileleka kwabanjwe abathathwa njengobungozi ngokwesigaba 286A seMthetho Wokuphatha Kwezigwegwe futhi ukuguqula izijeziso ezibekwe ngesigaba 276(A) seMthetho Wokuphatha Kwezigwegwe mayelana nabantu abakhululiwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ezimeni ezishiwo ngenhla, iziphakamiso zithunyelwa ezinkantolo ezafaka isijeziso ekuqaleni bese kwenziwa isinqumo. Omunye umehluko uwukuthi isinqumo sokunikeza ukukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kumuntu ongosuku noma ezikhungweni ezithathwa njengokubeka engcupheni. Kulezi zimo, iziphakamiso zithunyelwa ezinkantolo ezafaka isijeziso bese kwenziwa isinqumo. AmaBhodi angama-52 azosungulwa ezweni lonke azoba namalungu akhishwe emiphakathini. Amalungu azoba ngabantu abahloniphekile nabathembekile ngaphakathi kwemiphakathi yabo abaphuma kuyo, okuzokwenza amaBhodi aqinise. Kumele babe ngabantu abadala abaqonda ukuphila futhi balungele ukuveza izintshisekelo zomphakathi ngenhlonipho nangokungakhethi. Abaphathi kufanele babe ngabantu abanemfundo efanele ehlanganiswe nesipiliyoni sokuphatha. Ngaphezu komphathi, amalungu amabili angeziwe azothunyelwa kwiBhodi. Izikhala zePhini leMphathi kanye noSekela zigcinwe kubasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe boMnyango Wezokulungiswa. Ibhodi izophinde ifake abamele abavela kuSikhungo Sezokuphepha Kwezempi kanye noMnyango Wezobulungiswa. Le nhlanganisela nokumelwa akuyona imfuneko njengoba lezi zinsizakalo zingakhetha isikhathi sokuba zikhona noma cha. Ezimeni eziphathelene nezono ezinzima, ummeleli ovela kuMnyango Wezobulungiswa udingeka ukuthi ulethe umbiko kwiBhodi. Ibhodi ngalinye izosizwa ngamalungu amabili avela emnyangweni wezokulungiswa ukuze kube nokuphathwa kahle nokwesekwa. Kwezinye izinguquko ezivela enqubweni ejwayelekile kanye nomzamo wokwandisa amandla ezisulu zobugebengu, izisulu zezinye izono zizoba nelungelo lokwenza iziphakamiso kwiBhodi futhi zibe khona emihlanganweni yeBhodi kuphela uma bezobhekana nezindaba eziphathelene nabantu abashushisiwe. Lokhu kubhekwa njengenyathelo elibalulekile ekwakheni nasekukhuthazeni ubulungiswa obubuyiswayo njengomsebenzi owamukelekayo, ukwakha nokuhlanganisa. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba amaBhodi amasha okukhululwa azocubungula izicelo ezivela ezihlotsheni ezahlukene zabantu abanjwe ezethulwe kubo, izimo ezintsha ezithinta isikhathi umuntu okufanele akhululwe ngaphambi kokubhekwa kokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi zizosebenza kuphela kulabo abajeziswe ngemuva kokuthi izinhlinzeko ezithile zomthetho ziqalile ukusebenza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi bonke abantu abajeziswe ngaphambi kokuphathwa komthetho omusha bazobhekwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho okhona (Umthetho 8 ka-1959). Ngamanye amazwi, abantu abajeziswe esikhathini esedlule ngaphambi kokuphathwa komthetho omusha akufanele balindele ukuthi umthetho omusha uzoba nomthelela omubi esikhathini okufanele bakhululwe ngaphambi kokubhekwa kokukhululwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Abantu abachazwa njengabaphula umthetho abavame ukuphindaphinda: Ngemuva kokusebenza okungenani eminyakeni eyisixhenxe. Umthetho omusha uvumela ukusungulwa kweBhodi Yokubhekelela Ukukhululwa ezobheka izimo ezithunyelwe kuyo ukuze ibuyekezwe nguMphathiswa noma uNgqongqoshe Wezokulungiswa uma bekholelwa ukuthi isinqumo sokuqala seBhodi Yokubhekelela Ukukhululwa siphikisana noma siphula inqubomgomo ekhona yokukhululwa. Ibhodi yokubuyekeza izoba nezimfanelo ezizimele futhi ibanjwe ngamalungu avela kwiNational Council of Correctional Services, uMphathi noma uPhini loMphathi Wokushushiswa Kwezimali, kanye nabamele ababili bomphakathi. Umphathi weBhodi yokubuyekeza uzoba nguJaji weNkantolo Ephakeme, futhi isinqumo seBhodi sizothathwa njengenqubomgomo eqinile kumaBhodi Yokubhekelela Ukukhululwa. Kubalulekile ukuthi wonke umuntu aqonde izinguquko ezilethwe umthetho omusha. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe lokhu, uMnyango uqale umkhankaso wokwazisa ophumelelayo ophathelene nokuhlinzeka ngemin
A. Hey, Umshayeli weTaxi! B. Bheka amawheels akho! b. Bangane, amaTaxi ahlinzeka ngosizo olubalulekile kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Sithembele kini ukusihambisa ngokuphepha ezindaweni zethu. Nokho, amaTaxi enu aphapheme kangakanani? Bheka amawheels akho! Amawheels akho abalulekile kakhulu. Khumbula ukuthi yibo kuphela oxhumana phakathi komgwaqo, itaxi, kanye nabagibeli. Amawheels akho angakwenza umehluko phakathi kokuphila nokufa. Uyalungile. Ngiyabonga ngokusikhumbuza. Esikhathini esedlule, sithukile ukuphepha. Kodwa sizimisele ukuphakamisa amazinga embonini yethu! Ukuphepha kwabagibeli bethu kuphakathi kokubalulekile. Ngemuva kokukhuluma nawe, siyazi kahle ukuthi sizoqala kuphi - ngokunakekela amawheels! Yebo! Njengabagibeli, ukuphila kwethu kusezandleni zenu! Khumbula lokho - imindeni yethu ikudinga! Imindeni yenu ikudinga, sidinga nina, nezwe lenu lidinga nina. Asikwazi ukuhamba sishiywe umuntu oyedwa ngenxa yokunganaki nokungakhathaleli. Abagibeli kufanele bathuthwe ngokuphepha! Amawheels afanele + abashayeli abafanele = ukuphepha emigwaqweni. Ngiyabonga ngokuthatha le ndaba ngokungathi sína! a. Ingabe lokho ungukuthi? b. Woza, woza! Sinokuhamba okude phambili. Cha, Mama, ungakhathazeki! Ngiyethemba ukuthi ubheke amawheels akho. Onke amawheels akho - okuqala, kwesibili, kwesithathu, nokwesine. Yebo! Ingabe amawheels alungile? Unayo i-spare? Yini ehamba! Udlala nokufa! Lo mshayela ubukeka engazi lutho ngama-wheels aphephile! Uyalungile! Noma ubani ophuthelwa amawheels akhe udlala nokufa. Ngisho, amawheels angaphephile angabangela izingozi! Izikhathi eziningi amawheels afakwa ngendlela engalungile, noma awanekhwalithi ephansi! Kufana nokuba nama-wheels ahlanzekile! Amawheels angaphephile angasithatha ukuphila kwethu! Uma kuphela bonke abashayeli bengafunda ngokuqinisa nokunakekela amawheels. Uyalungile. Emini edlule ngashaywa yitayari, ngiyabonga, akekho owathinteka, kodwa ama-tire amasha abiza imali eningi. Ngakho! Uthole inhlanhla. Abantu bafa njalo ngesonto ngoba abashayeli kanye nabanikazi bamaTaxi abafaki amawheels ngendlela efanele futhi abathathi isikhathi sokunakekela. Ingabe ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awuwona umthombo wezingozi - ngisho nokufa? Ingabe ufuna ukusindisa imali? Uma ufuna ukuhlole amawheels akho! Funda ukunakekela amawheels akho? Kufanele sazi amawheels ethu, sizijwayeze ukuwabheka, silungise lokho okungalungile ngokushesha, futhi sigcine zisesimweni esihle, esanelisayo - amawheels agugile, amadala, kanye nezinto ezingazinzile zibanga izingozi! Amawheels akho afana nezinyawo zezikibha zakho. Uma izinyawo zakho zihlanzekile, zibhujiswe, ungakhalipha futhi uzitholele ubuhlungu. Amawheels awakwazi ukukhuluma. Ngakho-ke, kusezandleni zethu, abanikazi bamaTaxi, kanye nabashayeli ukuqinisekisa ukungabikhona kokulimala nokukulungisa ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinkinga! Amawheels ezimoto asetshenziswa ahluke kuma-wheels ajwayelekile. Amawheels ajwayelekile awanakhono lokuthwala abagibeli bamaTaxi. Iwheel ye-vehicle inencwadi C ngemuva kwenombolo yesisindo. Uma iwheel incane kakhulu noma inkulu kakhulu, ingaphuma emgqeni wewheel. Kumele kube usayizi ofanele. Buza umthengisi wakho wetayari ukuze uthole usayizi ofanele we-vehicle yakho, noma ufunde incwadi yakho. Uma iwheel incane kakhulu, ingaphuma emgqeni wewheel. Ungazifaki engcupheni yokuphuma okungaba yingozi. Njalo uma ufaka itayari entsha, faka nevalvu ye-air entsha. Ivalvu ze-air azibizi kakhulu, zishibhile. Qinisekisa ukuthi umgqomo wewheel usesimweni esihle. Uma umgqomo wewheel ulimele, ungabangele itayari ukuthi ilahlekelwe umoya ngokushesha noma iphume emgqeni. Bheka umgqomo wewheel we-vehicle yakho njalo. Uma kukhona ukulimala, shintsha noma buza omunye onolwazi ukuze akulungise. Umoya ongafanele ubangela itayari yakho ukuthi igugule ngokungafani futhi ingagugula ngokushesha. Ukuhlola umoya njalo uma ugcwalisa uphethiloli nokufaka umoya ofanele kukunika ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi itayari yakho izohlala isikhathi esifanele - okwenza ukusindisa imali! Itayari yakho ingagugula ngokushesha esontweni lokuqala uma ingafakiwe kahle noma uma i-valve ivuleka umoya. Bheka umoya kumatayi akho nsuku zonke esontweni lokuqala ngemuva kokufaka ama-tire amasha. Ngemuva kwalokho, hlola umoya kumatayi akho njalo. Njalo umshayeli kufanele abe ne-gauge ye-air pressure yakhe. Ama-gauges e-air atholakala kumagaraji angase angasebenzi. Umoya ongafanele we-tire ungumthombo wezingozi eziningi zemaTaxi. Thola umkhuba wokuhlola umoya kumatayi akho. Qinisa ama-bolts kumawheels akho. Izingxenye eziningi zenzeka ngoba umshayeli ucabanga ukuthi bazohamba noma ama-bolts aphukile. Ungazami ukuhamba ngebhasi eline-bolts eziphukile noma ezikhishiwe. Ingabe lokhu akukhona nje ukunakekela itayari okuyisisekelo? Ungafaka ama-tire ashibhile futhi ungawakhathaleli - kodwa lokhu kungakubiza ukuphila kwakho. Lokhu kubiza kakhulu kunezintela ezinhle ezinakekelwe kahle. Ungacabangi ukuthi ashibhile kungcono! Ama-tire ashibhile - njengezintela eziphindwe kabili, noma ezivuselelwe noma ezibuyisiwe - angakubiza ukuphila kwakho kanye nabagibeli bakho. Ungazami ukufaka ama-tire aphindwe kabili noma avuselelwe. Ama-tire ashibhile abiza kakhulu ekugcineni - ngoba adinga ukunakekelwa okuningi futhi awahlali isikhathi eside njengezintela ezintsha. Ama-tire anekhwalithi ephezulu angase abize kakhulu kodwa abiza kancane ekugcineni ngoba kulula ukuwakhathalela futhi ahlale isikhathi eside. Ukulayisha kakhulu imoto kubangela ukuguguleka kwetayari futhi kungabangela ukuphuma, okuholela ezingozi nasekufeni. Ungacabangi ngentengo ye-tire. Cabanga ngokulondoloza kumatayi nasekuphepheni kwabagibeli bakho. Cabanga ngokulondoloza kumatayi? Ububanzi be-tread kufanele bube ngu-1.6 mm kuyo yonke indawo. 1.6mm ilingana nobubanzi be-20-cent coin. Uma itayari yakho inobubanzi be-tread obungaphansi kuka-1.6mm noma kuphi. Ukulayisha kakhulu imoto kuyingozi! I-taxi ngayinye ivunyelwe ukuthwala inani elithile labagibeli. Uma uthwala abagibeli abaphezulu kwenani elivunyelwe, ulimele umgwaqo nemoto. Uphula umthetho futhi ubeka ukuphila kwakho engozini! Ngizokwehlisa isikhwama ngenxa yokulayisha kakhulu imoto! Ungangikhombisa ilayisense yakho yokushayela? Ukephuzile? Ungaphuma emotweni yakho ukuze ngihlole ukuthi iyasebenza? Cishe konke kudinga ukunakekelwa uma ufuna ukuthi kuhlale noma kuhambisane isikhathi eside. Akusizi ukuba nemoto enhle kanye nama-tire amahle uma ungawakhathaleli. Futhi ufuna ukuthutha abagibeli bakho ngokuphepha. Ukunake
Kungenzeka ukuthi izinhlayiya ezincane eziphilayo zingadala izifo, futhi izinhlayiya ezincane ezilimazayo zitholakala kabanzi emhlabathini, emanzini, ezilwaneni, nasezimpilweni zabantu. Lezi zinhlayiya ezincane zidluliselwa ngezandla, ezindwangu zokuhlanza, nezinsiza zokudla, ikakhulukazi eziphethwe ezikhaleni zokusika, futhi ukuxhumana okuncane kungazidlulisela kokudla, kuholele ezimweni zokudla ezitholakala emathunjini. Ukudla okungaphekiwe, ikakhulukazi inyama, izinkukhu, nezilwane zasemanzini, kanye nemijimba yazo, kungaba nezinhlayiya ezincane ezilimazayo ezingangcolisa ezinye izidlo ngesikhathi sokulungisa nokugcina. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukudla okufana nezitsha zokuphuza nezitsha zokupheka kuphume kahle ukuze kufinyelele ku-700C. Qinisekisa ukuthi awekho amanzi enyama nezinkukhu, futhi akufanele kube nombala ompunga. Ngokuyinhloko, sebenzisa i-thermometer. Ukupheka kahle kubulala cishe zonke izinhlayiya ezincane ezilimazayo. Izifundo zocwaningo zikhombisile ukuthi ukupheka ukudla ku-700C kungasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphephile ukudla. Ukudla okudingayo ukunakwa okukhethekile kufaka phakathi inyama eqoshiwe, inyama efakwe emanzini, izingcezu ezinkulu zenyama, kanye nezinkukhu eziphelele. Izinhlayiya ezincane zingakhula ngokushesha uma ukudla kugcinwa ezingeni lokushisa lendawo. Ngokugcina izinga lokushisa ngaphansi kuka-50C noma ngaphezulu kuka-600C, ukukhula kwezinhlayiya ezincane kuyancipha noma kuyama. Ezinye izinhlayiya ezincane ziyaqhubeka nokukhula ngaphansi kuka-50C. Izinto zokwakha, ikakhulukazi lezo eziqukethe amanzi neqhwa, zingangcoliswa ngama-organisms amancane alimazayo kanye nezinto ezikhemikhali. Izinto ezingenakubangela umonakalo zingakha ezindaweni ezonakele nezibola. Ukunakekela ekukhetheni izinto zokwakha kanye nezindlela ezilula zokuhlola ezifana nokuhlanza nokuhlanza kunganciphisa izinga lesingo.

Yini ukuhlela umphakathi? Lokhu kuyindlela elula, lapho indawo eqashwayo ihlukaniswa yaba izingxenye ezincane ezilula ukuziqapha ezaziwa ngokuthi ukuhlela umphakathi. Umphakathi ophathwayo ubekwa ukuze aqaphe umphakathi othile futhi ungumuntu osebenza ngokubambisana nezakhamuzi nakuzo zonke izithakazelo ekuvimbeleni ubugebengu obuvamile kulolo mphakathi. Bonke ababamba iqhaza bangaqhamuka nezidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha ezithile zomphakathi wabo futhi bazame ukuthola umthombo wobugebengu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubugebengu buyaphathwa kulolo mphakathi. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela niqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buyaphathwa emiphakathini yenu. Ukubamba kwenu kuzokhipha imiphumela, futhi ngeke nibe nokwesaba ubugebengu emphakathini wenu futhi nithole izixazululo kubugebengu obujolile endaweni yenu uma ninenhlangano zomphakathi zokulwa nobugebengu, ninikeza amaphoyisa ngemininingwane mayelana nezenzo zobugebengu ezenzakalayo emphakathini wenu ukuze basebenzise izindlela ezihloniphekile nezisuselwe emphakathini ekutholeni izixazululo zobugebengu emphakathini wenu; futhi lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwenu nomphakathi ophathwayo ovela kwiSikhungo Sezokuphepha Kwamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela niqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buyaphathwa emiphakathini yenu.
Ushintsho kuMthetho 1. Ukuqonda kahle i-GNSS kusho ukuthi izinga lokuhambisana phakathi kokulinganiswa okulinganisiwe, kokutholakele, noma isimo esidingekayo noma ikhono lesistimu ngaleso sikhathi kanye nesimo sangempela noma amandla, kuvame ukuvezwa ezilinganisweni zephutha ezitholakala ohlelweni futhi kuchazwa njengento engalindelekile, ephindaphindekayo ngokusebenzisa umaqhuzu. Umgwaqo wesigaba se-C4 kanye namandla okulawula indiza akhona kuphela uma umshini udinga uhlelo lokulawula indiza oluqondile ukuze lunikeze izinga lobuchwepheshe be-GPS elilingana nalolo olukhona ku-RAIM. Qaphela: Uhlelo lwe-GNSS lwesigaba se-C luzofakwa kuphela ezindizeni ezinkulu ezivunyelwe ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwelizwe nasezindizeni zomhlaba. Inqubo yokuhamba kwefu ichaza izindlela ezahlukene ezithinta ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokundiza ezihlobene nokuvikelwa okukhomba ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ngesikhathi sokusebenza kuze kube yilapho indiza ixhumana ngempela nomhlaba lapho wonke uhlelo lokugcina umhlaba noma ukuqala kwenqubo yokundiza kuphothuliwe ngenxa yokwehluleka ukugcina iphethini ejwayelekile; uma indiza yehluleka ukugcina ngendlela ejwayelekile, ibuyela esimweni lapho ingakhokha khona emoyeni noma ilinde isimo sokugcina esifanele. I-GNSS ichaza uhlelo lwe-Global Navigation Satellite System olusetshenziselwa ukubeka izindiza endaweni. Uhlelo nesikhathi esichazwe endaweni kufaka phakathi ubuchwepheshe noma ukuqeqeshwa kwabo okuhamba phakathi nendawo, izithuthukisi zokundiza, kanye namandla okuhamba okwenza kube lula ukweseka ukuhlola nokubona izimoto ezihamba phakathi nendawo. Umcimbi we-GNSS uchaza umcimbi onjengalowo kanye nezimo ezifanayo nokuphazamiseka komshini, izinkomba, noma iphutha labantu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Uhlelo lokuhola indiza lwesigaba sokuqala luchaza uhlelo lokuhola umoya oluvunyiwe yiKhomishini yokusebenza ethile noma isikhathi sokundiza esithembekile nesiqondile kodwa akusho ukuthi lihlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala nokusebenza ngendlela engaphazamiseki. Ukwamukela, Ukuqapha, kanye Nokwethembeka KweMiyalezo Etholakele Ngobuchwepheshe Bezinkanyezi (RAIM) kuchaza isu lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS lunquma khona ukwethembeka kwezimpawu zokulawula indiza nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakale ngokukhalipha. "I-RVSM" ichaza umehluko okhona phakathi kwezinga lokundiza elingaphezu kuka-290 kuya ku-1000 feet uma kubhekwa ohlangothini lokuphuma kule ndlela kanye no-1000 feet ubheke lapho indiza iqonde khona." "I-RVSM airspace" ichaza indawo yomoya phakathi kwezinga lokundiza le-290 kanye ne-410." "I-RVSM authorization certificate" ichaza isitifiketi esibonisa ukuhambisana kwendiza kanye nekhono leqembu lokundiza lokusebenzisa i-RVSM airspace." Ukuhola indiza okukhombisa phezulu kuchaza isu lokulawula indiza elivumela indiza ukuthi ibheke phezulu isebenzisa izinsiza zokulinganisa ezisemhlabeni, ibheka imigwaqo ngaphandle kwendiza noma inhlanganisela yalezi. Ukusebenzisa amehlo kuchaza isu lokundiza le-IFR lapho ingxenye ethile noma inqubo yesixhobo ephelele ingaphothulwa futhi ukugcina kwenziwa ngokubheka indlela yokundiza. Ushintsho kuMthetho 1.00. Ushintsho kuMthetho 12.02. b Iqembu labantu bezindiza; noma c Isiteshi samaphoyisa esiseduze, uma kwenzeka icala elithintekayo. Ushintsho kuMthetho 12.02. b kuQembu Lendiza; noma c esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze, mayelana nalelo cala. Ushintsho kuMthetho 21.08. Umthetho olandelayo uzojoliswa emva koMthetho 21.08. A Ezindizeni ezilindeleke ukuthi zisebenze endaweni yomoya edinga i-RVSM authorization, isitifiketi sokuvunywa sidingeka. Isigaba 8 seSigaba 6 njengoba sichazwe sinikeza noma yisiphi ushintsho noma ukuguqulwa okulandela isimo sokuqala lapho i-RVSM Authorization ikhishwe. Noma yisiphi isicelo sokuvunywa kwe-RVSM certificate sizothunyelwa kwiKhomishini njengoba kuchazwe nguMthetho 91.07. Ushintsho kuMthetho 43.02. Umthetho olandelayo uzoshintshwa emva koMthetho 43.02. Ushintsho kuMthetho 91.02. ukuthi umshini olindeleke mayelana nokugcina ukuphakama kanye nohlelo kufakiwe futhi kusebenze ngokuqondile uhlelo lokuxwayisa; ngaleyo ndlela iii akukho mthetho noma izithiyo zokuvimbela ukusebenza endaweni ye-RVSM. i ukuthi uhlelo lwe-GNSS lwenziwe ukuze luhambisane nokukhombisa kwesimo uma kudlula emgwaqweni we-CD: ngaleyo ndlela ii indlela yokundiza endaweni ibhalwe emqulwini wokundiza. Ushintsho kuMthetho 121.03. Umthetho olandelayo uzoshintshwa emva koMthetho 121.03. A Umnikazi wendiza enkulu yokuhweba efuna ukusebenza le ndiza endaweni ye-RVSM uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu lokundiza liphothulile ukuqeqeshwa njengoba kudingwa nguMqulu SA-CATS-OPS 121. Ushintsho kuMthetho 121.04. a ukubhala kabusha izinombolo zomthetho ochazwe njengomthetho 121.04. Qaphela: Izinga lokubekezelela ingozi yokuphazamiseka endaweni yomoya lizodlula uma abasebenzi behlangabezana neziphuthumayo. Ushintsho kuMthetho 121.07. a ukubhala kabusha izinombolo zeMthetho 121.07.2 ukuze kube nguMthetho 121.07. Ushintsho kuMthetho 135.03. Umthetho olandelayo uzoshintshwa emva koMthetho 135.03. A Umshayeli wendiza encane yokuhweba efuna ukusebenza le ndiza ngaphakathi kwemingcele ye-RVSM uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi iqembu lokundiza liphothulile ukuqeqeshwa njengoba kuchazwe nguMqulu SA-CATS-OPS 135. Ushintsho kuMthetho 135.04. a ukubhala kabusha izinombolo zeMthetho 135.04.4 ukuze kube nguMthetho 135.04. Qaphela: Izinga lokubekezelela ingozi yokuphazamiseka endaweni yomoya ngeke lidlule uma abasebenzi beqhubeka behlangabezana neziphuthumayo. Ushintsho kuMthetho 135.07. a ukubhala kabusha izinombolo zeMthetho 135.07.2 njengomthetho 135.07. Ushintsho kuMthetho 145.01. Umthetho olandelayo uzoshintshwa emva koMthetho 145.01. Umnikazi wesitifiketi sokulungisa indiza esikhishwe ngaphansi kwalesi Sigaba uzobeka futhi agcine uhlelo lokuqeqesha oluhambelana nabasebenzi bokugcina izindiza abaqashwe
Imali yokwesekwa komphakathi iyimali edluliselwa kuhulumeni kubantu abangakwazi ukuzisekela. Ikhokhwa kubantu abampofu ukusiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo eziyisisekelo nokuxazulula izinto ezincane kodwa ezibalulekile zokuphila. Imali yokwesekwa komphakathi inikezwa ukweseka imigomo eyinhloko yeMnyango, okuyi ukuvuselela abampofu nokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu abadinga usizo. Uma ufaka isicelo sokwesekwa, isimo sezimali somfaki-sicelo kanye nalabo abahlangene nabo noma abathintekayo sihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lowo muntu uyafaneleka ukuthola usizo kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlolwa kwezimali." Inqubo yokufaka isicelo sokwesekwa akufanele ithathe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili kusukela ngesikhathi isicelo sithunyelwe. Qaphela: Imali yokwesekwa ikhokhwa kubamukeli njalo ngenyanga. Usizo lwezingane ezikhuliswa ngabazali abangabazali bazo ikhokhwa kulabo bazali mayelana nengane efakwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabo ngokweMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezingane, 1983 (Umthetho No. 74 ka-1983). Umfaki-sicelo/ingane kumele abehlala eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Umyalelo wenkantolo kumele uthunyelwe ubonisa isimo sokunakekelwa kwabazali ngaphansi kokuthi ingane ifakwe. Ingane ethathwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabazali abangabazali bayo kumele ihlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlolwa kwezimali, okuyi R 12,720 ngonyaka. Sithumela ehhovisi lezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi eliseduze lapho umfaki-sicelo ehlala khona. Uma abafaki-sicelo bekhulile kakhulu noma bephilile kakhulu ukuze bafake isicelo ngokwabo ehhovisi, ilunga lomndeni kumele lifake isicelo ngabo. Ifomu lesicelo lizogcwaliswa phambi komphakathi. Uma ifomu lesicelo ligcwaliswe, umfaki-sicelo uzonikezwa i-receipt. Le receipt kumele igcinwe - iyasiza njengobufakazi bokufaka isicelo. Akufanele kukhokhwe imali ukuze kufakwe isicelo. Uma isicelo esithunyelwe singavunywa yiHhovisi LezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi, umfaki-sicelo kumele waziswe ngokubhala ngezizathu zokwenqatshwa kwesicelo. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokuphikisa ngokubhala kuNgqongqoshe WezeMisebenzi Yomphakathi esifundazweni sabo, echaza ukuthi kungani bengavumelani nesinqumo. Le mpikiswano kumele ithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokwaziswa ngemiphumela yesicelo esithunyelwe. Uma imali yokwesekwa ivunywa, umfaki-sicelo uzokhokhwa kusukela ngosuku isicelo sathunyelwa. Umfaki-sicelo kumele waziswe ngokubhala ngezizathu zokwenqatshwa kanye nenani losizo, kanye nelungelo labo lokuphikisa phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokwaziswa. Qaphela: Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukuhoxisa imali, umuntu ophathiswe ngokomthetho angabekwa ukuze ahoxise imali egameni lomfaki-sicelo. Isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwemali yokwesekwa kumele sithunyelwe phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokumiswa. Umfaki-sicelo akumele abe seRiphabhulikhi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyisithupha. Umfaki-sicelo kumele akhombise noma iyiphi imali ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kuzoba yisisekelo esizosebenza nguMnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inani losizo kumele libuyekezwe. Umfaki-sicelo uzonikezwa izinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyekezwa noma usuku lapho kudingeka khona isitifiketi sezempilo. Imali yokwesekwa kwezingane ikhokhwa kumuntu onakekela ingane engaphansi kweminyaka eyi-11. Umuntu onakekela angaba noma ubani ophatha izidingo zansuku zonke zengane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhambisana noma cha. Umfaki-sicelo kanye nomuntu abahlangene naye kumele bahlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlolwa kwezimali, okuyi R9,600 ngonyaka ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kanye no R13,200 ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ingane kanye nomuntu onakekela kumele babe ngababambiqhaza baseNingizimu Afrika futhi bahlale lapho. Umfaki-sicelo kumele abe ngumuntu onakekela ophambili wengane leyo. Ingane kumele ibe ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-11. Umuntu onakekela angafaka isicelo sezingane ezingaphezu kwezingu-6 ezingazange zibe zabo. Umfaki-sicelo akumele abe ngumuntu onakekela ophambili wengane; noma isikhungo sikhokhelwa ukunakekela ingane. Le mali yokwesekwa ikhokhwa kubazali, abazali bomntwana ongaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabo, kubantu onakekela izingane ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-1 no-18, ngenxa yokukhubazeka okukhulu kwengqondo nokuqhubekayo okudingayo ukunakekelwa okugcwele. Umfaki-sicelo kumele abe ngumuntu onobuzwe baseNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kwendaba yabazali abahlala nengane engayibo. Umfaki-sicelo nengane kumele bahlale eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlolwa kwezempilo okuqinisekisa ukukhubazeka kumele kuthunyelwe. Umfaki-sicelo, umuntu abahlangene naye, nengane kumele bahlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlolwa kwezimali, okuyi R48,000 ngonyaka kubazali no R17,760 nengane. Ingane ephila ngokuncika ekunakekelweni inganakekelwa ngokuqhubekayo yisikhungo sikahulumeni.
Le mhlahlandlela ubhalwe ngenhloso yokuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Akukhona ukuhlinzeka ngesikhundla seMthetho Wempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993. Inhloso eyinhloko yale mhlahlandlela ukusho lo mthetho ngezindlela ezilula, usebenzisa ulimi oluqondile ukuze kucaciswe kubo bonke abantu abathintekayo empilweni nasekuphepheni endaweni yokusebenza lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wababheki bezempilo nokuphepha eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi uchazwe. Amalungelo nezibopho zabasebenzi, njengoba kuchazwe emthethweni, ahlaziywa. Imisebenzi nezibopho zabaphathi, abakhiqizi, abaqashi, abangenisi, abahlinzeki, nabathengisi ekuqinisekiseni impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi nakho kugqanyisiwe. Ekugcineni, imisebenzi yabalobi bezempilo nokuphepha kanye nezinhlelo ezihambisanayo icaciswa. Umthetho Wempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993 udinga ukuthi umqashi aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza iphephile, ingenazo izingozi ezimpilweni zabasebenzi, futhi ugcizelela ukuthi umqashi kufanele enze lokhu ngezinga elingcono kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ayinazo izinto eziyingozi, ezifana nebenzene, izidakamizwa, nezinto eziyingozi, imishini, nezindlela zokusebenza ezingaphephile. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi kufanele axwayise abasebenzi ngalezi zingozi, indlela yokuzigwema, ukusebenza ngokuphepha, futhi enze izinyathelo zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi akukhona kuphela umqashi onenhloso yokufeza le msebenzi wezempilo nokuphepha. Umthetho ususelwa kumgomo wokuthi izingozi endaweni yokusebenza kufanele zixazululwe ngokwakha umgudu wokuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi nomqashi. Abasebenzi nabaphathi kufanele babelane ngalesi sabelo sokuphepha nempilo endaweni yokusebenza. Bobabili kufanele bahlaziye izingozi ezingaba khona futhi baphakamise izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze benze indawo yokusebenza iphephile. Ngale ndlela, umqashi nabasebenzi basebenza ndawonye ezinhlelweni lapho ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha bengahlola njalo indawo yokusebenza futhi banikeze imibiko kwiKomidi Lezempilo Nokuphepha. Le komidi ingase iphakamise iziphakamiso kumqashi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le sistimu isebenza kahle, bonke abasebenzi kufanele bazi amalungelo nezibopho zabo njengoba kushiwo emthethweni. Kukhona izinhlinzeko eziningi ezikhuluma ngezihloko ezithile ezihlanganiswe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Umthetho noma izinhlinzeko zitholakala kwiHhovisi Lezokuphrinta, noma kwiGazethi noma ezikhiqizwe abanye abashicileli. Umthetho Wempilo Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi uphathwa yiSikhungo Esikhulu Sezempilo Nokuphepha ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi, amahhovisi asunguliwe kuzo zonke izifunda. Okwamanje, ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza kanye nalabo abakhokhelwe ezifundeni benza ukuhlola nokuhlola lapho kudingeka khona ezindaweni zokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuhlola ziqhutshwa ngokulandela izinkomba ezithile esingazibona; ukuvela kwezinto eziyingozi, ukusetshenziswa kwebenzene lapho imikhiqizo iphumelelwa, noma ezindaweni lapho imishini eyingozi ikhona. Kukhona nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezingenziwa ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke, ezifana nezicelo ezenziwe, izikhalazo zabasebenzi, abaqashi, noma amalungu omphakathi. Lezi zikhalazo noma izicelo zigcinwa zifihliwe. Uma umbhali ethola okuthile okungaba yingozi noma okungenzeka kube yingozi endaweni yokusebenza, angabeka imiqathango ethile kumqashi. Ezimeni ezikhombisa ingozi engaba khona, umbhali angavimbela isenzo, inqubo, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemishini ngokukhishwa kwesaziso esifanele ukuze kuvinjwe. Akekho umuntu ovunyelwe ukuhoxisa ukubaluleka kwalolo xwayiso; umlayezo ophumelele kufanele ulandelwe ngokushesha. Uma kukhona umthetho othile ophuliwe, umbhali angakhupha isaziso sokuphulwa kumabasebenzi noma kumqashi. Ukuphula umthetho kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuphathwa ngokushesha. Uma inqubo ethile iphuliwe, umqashi anganikezwa ithuba lokulungisa iphutha phakathi nesikhathi esithile, ngokuvamile izinsuku eziyi-60. Uma umbhali ethola ukuthi izimo zempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi azaneliseki, umbhali angalayisha umqashi ukuba athuthukise le ndawo. Isaziso sokuthuthukisa sikhishwa kumqashi, sichaza indlela elindelekile yokuthuthukisa okungamukeleki kumbhali. Ukuze kubhekwane kakhulu, bavunyelwe ukungena kunoma iyiphi indawo noma izakhiwo lapho imishini, izinto eziyingozi, noma lapho zisetshenziswa khona, futhi banephuzu lokubuza imibuzo nokucela abantu abathile ukuba bavele phambi kwabo. Umphakathi ungacela noma yiziphi imibhalo ukuba izethule, ahlolisise, futhi enze amakopi yale mibhalo, futhi afune ukucaciswa ngokuqukethwe kwabo. Umphakathi ungahlola isimo noma impahla, athathe amasampula ale nto, noma abambe impahla engase ibe ubufakazi. Umqashi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthini ngokuqinisekisa ukuphepha nendawo engaphephile emsebenzini nasezimpilweni zabasebenzi? Umqashi kufanele agcine imishini nezinsiza zokusebenza ezifanele, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo ezidingekayo ukuze umsebenzi wenziwe, esimweni esingaphazamisi impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imishini nezinsiza zokuphepha, umqashi kufanele kuqala akhiphe noma akhiphe noma yiziphi izingozi ezingase zibe nomthelela omubi empilweni nasekuphepheni kwabasebenzi. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi angasebenzisa izinsiza zokuvikela nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngabasebenzi. Umqashi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvikela impilo nokuphepha ezingozeni ezingase zivele ekukhiqizeni, ekwenzeni umsebenzi, ekusetshenzisweni, ekuphathweni, ekugcinweni, noma ekuthuthweni kwemikhiqizo noma izinto. Ngamanye amazwi, noma yini engase ibonakale kumsebenzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, ukuqeqesha, nokuphatha abasebenzi kuqinisekiswe njengokuhlangenwe nakho kwabo emsebenzini. Ngamanye amazwi, lokho okufanele bakwenze nokuthi yini okufanele bangayenzi. Akekho umuntu ovunyelwe ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphambi kokuthatha zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abaphansi komqashi balandela umthetho futhi baphoqelelwe ukuthatha izindlela ezifanele zokugwema izingozi ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umgomo wokuphepha nempilo enhle. Ukuqonda ukuthi umsebenzi nemishini zisetshenziswa umuntu ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu oqeqeshiwe kulolo msebenzi noma imishini ukuze aqonde izingozi ezihambisana nalolo msebenzi noma imishini. Lo msebenzi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi imizamo yokuvikela iyalandelwa futhi igcinwa. Bonke abasebenzi banelungelo lokwaziswa. Abaphathi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi futhi baqonde ngokuphelele izingozi zempilo nokuphepha ezihambisana nomsebenzi ngamunye abawenzayo, imikhiqizo ekhiqizwayo, ephumelelwayo, egcinwayo, ephathwayo, noma ethuthwayo, kanye nemishini noma amathuluzi asetshenziswayo. Umqashi kufanele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane mayelana nemizamo
Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000 ("umthetho") wawusungulwa ngomhla kaMashi 9, 2001, ufeza ilungelo lesi simiso lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe ngamasimu omphakathi noma ezizimele uma kudingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikwe amalungelo. Uma kwenziwa isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, inhlangano ethunyelwe isicelo kuyo iphoqelekile ukuba inikeze lokho kulwazi ngaphandle uma umthetho ucacisa ngokucacile ukuthi lokho kulwazi kufanele kukhishwe noma cha. Umthetho uphinde uhlele izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sithunyelwa. Lo mbhalo uhlose ukukhuthaza isiko lokucacisa nokubhekelela ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezohwebo Nezomnotho ("DTI") ngokufeza ilungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi ukuze abantu noma izikhungo ezithile zingakusebenzisa futhi zivikela amalungelo azo. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambisana okungokoqobo nezikhungo zikamasipala, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ufundisiwe futhi unolwazi ukuze aqonde amalungelo akhe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Ngendlela efaka leli lungelo eduze kwamanye amalungelo, ifaka amalungelo afana nalawo atholakala kuBill of Rights kwiSivumelwano. Ingxenye 14 yomthetho ibeka imfuneko yokuthi izikhungo zomphakathi zibhale idokhumenti yokusebenza, ezosiza abantu abafuna ulwazi oluthile kulowo mnyango, futhi ibeka izimfuneko okufanele zifezwe yilezi zedokhumenti. I-DTI ibike ukuthi izoqhubeka nokuzama ukusebenza ngokucacile futhi izohlinzeka ngolwazi emphakathini nasemabhizinisini ngokuqhubekayo ngeziphakamiso ze-DTI, izaziso, iwebhusayithi, kanye nesikhungo sokubiza. Lo mbhalo uhlose ukuhlinzeka ummangali wolwazi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ngemininingwane yokuxhumana, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola ulwazi oluthile kwi-DTI. Lo Mhlahlandlela uphinde uhlose ukuhlinzeka ummangali ngencazelo ecacile yesakhiwo, imisebenzi, izinsizakalo, kanye neziqondiso zolwazi lwe-DTI ukuze ummangali akwazi kalula ukuthola lapho ulwazi lutholakala khona. Lo mbhalo uphinde uhlanganise amafomu adingekayo kanye nezinkokhelo ezihambisana nezicelo zolwazi. Izinhloso ze-DTI ukuhola nokweseka uhlelo lokufinyelela kulwazi ngendlela ekhuthaza ukuhlala komnotho nokuvula amathuba emisebenzi kubo bonke abakha lo mnotho, ngokwandisa amazinga wokutshalwa kwezimali, kuthuthukiswa nokwandiswa kokuthunyelwa kwamikhiqizo yaseNingizimu Afrika kwamanye amazwe, nokwakha imakethe efanelekile nephikisanayo yemikhiqizo phakathi kwamabhizinisi endawo kanye namakhasimende aphesheya. Ngale ndlela, i-DTI isebenza ukuze ibeke umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika endaweni yokukhula nokuphumelela. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe umkhakha wokukhiqiza ohlanganisayo ophakamisa ukwandiswa kwamathuba okukhula komnotho okuzinzile kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze wandiswe futhi kuthuthukiswe isikali semakethe yokukhiqiza nezinsizakalo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kukhuthazwe amazinga aphezulu wokutshalwa kwezimali kwasekhaya nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuze kudaleke imakethe enezinketho, enezinga lokuncintisana lemikhiqizo eNingizimu Afrika kubo bonke abathengisi bendawo nakwamanye amazwe, kanye namakhasimende. Izikhungo zokweseka zinikeza usizo kumabhizinisi asebenzela ukusiza izigaba ezahlukene zomnyango. Izikhungo zokwenza imigomo zigxile ekwakheni izimo ezinhle ngaphansi komnotho. Izikhungo zokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zixhumanisa ngqo amabhizinisi namakhasimende ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Isikhungo sokumaketha siphatha ukumaketha kwemikhiqizo ye-DTI (izinhlelo nezinsiza) futhi siqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi endawo namakhasimende aqonda amalungelo awo omnotho. Ukuze kwandiswe ukuqwashisa nokufinyelela emikhiqizweni nasensizakalweni ye-DTI. Ulwazi lwezinkampani okungukuthi, umqondisi, abanikazi bezabelo, ikheli lenkampani, njll. Ukuphathwa Kwezezimali Nezinsiza Zomuntu okungukuthi Umthetho Wamabhizinisi 71 ka-1991: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuhoxisa nokulungisa ezinye izinqubo ezihlobene nokukhishwa kwemvume yokusebenza kwamabhizinisi, izikhathi zokuvula nezokuphela, nokwenza kube sobala ukuthi ukukhishwa kwemvume yokusebenza kwamabhizinisi kanye nokusebenza kwazo, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izindaba ezihlobene, zixazululwe. Umthetho Wokuncintisana 89 ka-1998: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukusungula iKomidi Lokuncintisana elizophenya, lilawule, futhi lilungiselele inqubo yemigomo, izinqubo ezingafanele, kanye nezindlela zokuziphatha zamabhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lokuncintisana kuqondisiwe ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo ngalezi zindaba, kanye nokusungulwa kweNkantolo Yokubuyisela. Umthetho Wesibili Wokulungisa 39 ka-2000: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuhlela Umthetho Wokuncintisana ka-1998 ukuze kucaciswe amagama athile, kuguqulwe incazelo, futhi kususwe ezinye izincazelo. Umthetho Wokuvikela Abathengi 75 ka-1980: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuvikela abathengi abathenga imikhiqizo ngokuthengisa, ukuqashwa, noma ngezikweletu kanye nalabo abathola ezinye izinsizakalo ngezikweletu. Umthetho Wokutholakala Kwezimpahla Zasendaweni 89 ka-1970: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukunikeza amandla kuNgqongqoshe Wezomnotho ukuze akhiqize, athole, aqashe, noma athole izimpahla ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Umthetho Wokuhweba Nezinsizakalo 25 ka-1964: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukusungula ukulawula ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo kanye nokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezakhiwo Zokuhlala Zokuthatha Umhlalaphansi 65 ka-1988: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuhlela ukudluliswa kwezindlu nezinye izindaba ezihlobene ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu zabathatha umhlalaphansi, kanye nokusungula ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokulawula Nezindinganiso Zokwakha Zikazwelonke 103 ka-1977: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukuthuthukisa ukuvumelana nezinye izinqubo ezihlobene nokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezindaweni zomphakathi, kanye nokuchaza ukuthi yiziphi izindinganiso zokwakha okufanele zibe khona, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokugembula Kwamazwe 33 ka-1996: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukusungula ukulawula nokulawulwa kwezindaba ezihlobene nezikhangiso zokugembula, futhi ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukiswe izindinganiso nezindlela ezivumelanayo ezilandelwa kuyo yonke iRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokusungula iBhodi Yokugembula Kwamazwe, nokubhekelela zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokugembula. Umthetho Wokulawula Izikhali 87 ka-1993: Inhloso yalo mthetho ukusungula ukulawula zonke izikhali, nokusungula iBhodi ezolawula izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezikhali lezi eRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokuchaza izinhloso nemisebenzi yalezi zikhali, nokuchaza izindlela ezizolawulwa ngazo, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Isigaba 32 seMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) ("imthethosisekelo") sinikeza amalungelo omphakathi okuthola ulwazi olugcinwe yinoma iyiphi inhlangano yangasese noma yomphakathi. Lo mthetho uhlose ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kolwazi. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuqinisekisa isiko lokucacisa nokubambisana ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezasekhaya ("DHA") ngokusebenzisa ilungelo lolwazi okungenzeka abantu noma izinhlangano zidinge ukukwenza nokuvikela noma yiziphi zezimali zabo. Ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olunikezwa umthetho kufanele lusetshenziswe ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo evunyelwe umthetho njengoba kunikezwa esigabeni 9 soMthetho (kubandakanya, kodwa kungagcini lapho, imikhawulo eqondiswe ekuvikeleni ubumfihlo, ubuchwepheshe bokuhweba, kanye nokuphathwa kahle, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokuphathwa kahle) nangendlela elinganisa lelo lungelo namanye amalungelo, kubandakanya lawo akwiBill of Rights emthethosisekelo. Ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho, izikhungo zomphakathi ezifana neDHA kufanele ziqoqe ibhukwana ukusiza abantu ukuthola ulwazi oluvela kule nhlangano. Isigaba 14 sichaza kahle izidingo ezincane zaleli bhukwana. Ngokuhambisana nemthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho, iDHA iletha le bhukwana ngenhloso yokuqinisa isiko lokucacisa nokuphathwa kahle. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuhlinzeka abafuna ulwazi ngezindlela nezindlela zokuxhumana ezidingekayo ukuze bathole ulwazi ngqo kwiDHA. Le bhukwana iphinde ihlinzeke incazelo ecacile yokwakheka, amandla, nemisebenzi yeDHA, kanye nokuhlelwa kolwazi lwabo ngezigaba, ukuze abafuna ulwazi bakwazi ukubona kalula ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo lutholakala kuphi. Isigaba 10 soMthetho sidinga iKomidi Lezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ("SAHRC") ukuba iqoqe umhlahlandlela wokuthi kusebenza kanjani lo Mthetho, ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni nangendlela elula ukuyifunda, ngaphambi kukaJulayi 2003. Ngesikhathi le bhukwana ibhalwa, umhlahlandlela weSAHRC wawungakatholakali. Ulwazi lokuxhumana lwabo bonke ofisa ulwazi kanye nezikhonzi zabo kuzo zonke izikhungo zomphakathi. Ulwazi lokuthi ungafaka kanjani izicelo zamarekhodi ezikhungweni zomphakathi nezangasese. Usizo olutholakalayo oluvela kumfundi wolwazi wesikhungo somphakathi ngokomthetho. Izixazululo zomthetho ezitholakalayo uma inhlangano yomphakathi noma eyangasese ingahambisani noMthetho, kubandakanya indlela yokufaka isikhalazo sangaphakathi nokufaka isicelo enkantolo (okuyindlela yokugcina uma uzama ukusebenzisa noma yiziphi izimfanelo ezishiwo kuMthetho). Ulwazi lokuthi izikhungo zomphakathi nezangasese ziqoqe kanjani amarekhodi, nokuthi abafuna ulwazi bangawathola kanjani amarekhodi, kanye nokukhulula ezinye izinhlobo zamarekhodi ngokuzithandela. Incazelo yezimiso zomthetho ezisunguliwe. Le bhukwana yokuhola izobuyekezwa ngolwazi olusha futhi iphinde iphumeze eminyakeni emibili. Izincwadi ezikhethiwe kuzo zonke izifunda, ezibizwa ngokuthi "izindawo zokugcina ezisemthethweni," ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokugcina Osemthethweni (Umthetho No. 54 ka-1997). Zonke izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezisunguliwe ngokusemthethweni. Zonke ofisi zezikhungo zomphakathi, kubandakanya zonke izikhungo zomkhandlu kanye nazo zonke izikhungo zeMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi kutholakale emahhovisi eSAHRC nasemakhasini ewebhu eSAHRC ku-http://www.sahrc.org.za. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izophrintwa kwiGazethi Yomphakathi. Ingafinyelelwa mahhala ezikhungweni ezishiwo ngenhla, nakuba kungase kube nezindleko zokukopisha. Izicelo zokufinyelela kumarekhodi eDHA kumele zenziwe kufomu esemthethweni ephezulu kuMthetho Wokubika No. R. 187 owashicilelwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuFebhuwari 2002. Lo Mthetho ubonisa kabanzi ofisa ulwazi njengomuntu okufanele wamukele futhi aphehle izicelo, kodwa kufanele kucatshangelwe ukuthi isigaba 17 sivumela abantu abaningi ukuba bahlonishwe ukuze basize ofisa ulwazi. Lezi zikhonzi ezichaziwe zibizwa ngokuthi abasisekeli bofisa ulwazi. Le fomu kulula ukuyigcwalisa, kodwa uma kudingeka, ungabiza umphakathi ofisa ulwazi ukuze akusize. Uma umfuna ulwazi engakwazi ukwenza isicelo esibhaliwe, umphakathi ofisa ulwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu futhi unikeze umfuna ulwazi ikhophi. Abafuna ulwazi kufanele bazi ukuthi yimaphi amarekhodi abafuna. Uma umfuna ulwazi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana namarekhodi adingekayo ukuze kube lula ukuwafaka, iDHA izokwazi ukusiza umfuna ulwazi ngokushesha. Abafuna ulwazi kufanele bathole ukuthi ubani ophethe amarekhodi. Kumele basebenzise uhlu lwezihloko nezigaba zolwazi olugcinwe ngofisa ulwazi ukuze bathole ukuthi ubani ofisa ulwazi onamarekhodi, bese bethumela izicelo zabo kulowo ofisa ulwazi. Umfisa ulwazi ngamunye unomthwalo wokuthola ukuthi kufanele anikeze imvume yokufinyelela kumarekhodi ngaphansi kokulawula kwabo. Amafomu okucela atholakala kunoma iyiphi ofisa ulwazi. Angasetshenziswa futhi ngekopya yefomu. Ifomu lokucela eligcwaliswe lingaba nolwazi oluningi kangangokuthi umfuna ulwazi angase angakwazi ukulithumela. Kuzokwenywa kuphela imali, ama-oda eposi, kanye nezinkokhelo ezivunyelwe yibhange. Ukukhokha kungakwenziwa ehhovisi leDHA eliseduze (uma le ofisi ingenayo imali, izothumela umfuna ulwazi ehhovisi leDHA elinayo) futhi ikhophi eqinisekisiwe ye-receipt kufanele ixhunywe kufomu lokucela. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukukhokha kwakho kungahambisana nefomu lokucela kanye ne-receipt oyitholile. Ngemuva kokuthi ifomu igcwaliswe, kufanele ithunyelwe kumphakathi ofisa ulwazi ofanele. Akudingeki ukuthi ithunyelwe ngokuqondile; empeleni, lokhu kungase kwenzeke kuphela uma izivumelwano zenzekile ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa. Idokhumenti egcwalisiwe ingafakswa, ithunyelwe nge-imeyili, ithunyelwe, noma ithunyelwe nge-courier kumphakathi ofisa ulwazi ofanele. Uma umfuna ulwazi engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma ukuphazamiseka kumvimbela ekwenzeni isicelo, umfuna ulwazi angacela usizo kumphakathi ofisa ulwazi. Kuvame ukuba ngcono ukuhlela kusenesikhathi ukuze wenze isicelo somlomo futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani lokhu kubalulekile. Ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana ngezinkinga, umphakathi ofisa ulwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu lokucela kumfuna ulwazi futhi unikeze ikhophi yefomu eligcwaliswe. Abafisa ulwazi eDHA bazokwazi ukusiza abafuna amarekhodi eDHA. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasisekeli bofisa ulwazi balo mnyango bazosiza abafuna ulwazi abafuna ukufaka isicelo kumunye umnyango noma inhlangano ezimele. Nokho, izicelo zingase z
Kukhona isisho esivela kwezinye izilimi zomdabu esithi: "Umkhonto awakhi indlu." Ulwazi lwethu embonini ye-taxi luveze iqiniso lalo misho kaningi. Ngaphambi kuk governo elikhethwe ngentando yeningi, abantu abaningi embonini ye-taxi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokufa nokulimala kwabashayeli nabagibeli. Lezi zinselelo nezimpi zazivela kakhulu ngenxa yokungavumelani phakathi kwabo bonke embonini ye-taxi mayelana nezindlela, imali ethathwa ngabagibeli, nokunye. Ukuze kususwe izingxabano ezingadingekile embonini ethathwa kakhulu ngababantu abamnyama futhi ethokozisa kakhulu abasebenzi abangemthetho, uhulumeni, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuthutha YaseNingizimu Afrika (Santaco), bakhiphe incwadi yokuvumelana (MOU) ehlose ukudala ukuthula kule mboni. I-MOU yalandelwa yimithetho eminingi ekhiphwe yiphalamende ngenhloso yokuletha induduzo embonini ye-taxi. Umthetho Wokuhamba Ngezinsiza Zomhlaba (NLTTA) ungomunye wale mithetho. Uzokhombisa ulwazi lwakho nge-NLTTA. Uzokuqonda inqubo yokubuyekezwa kwezokuthutha kanye nezinsiza zayo. Uzokwazi ukuthi inqubo yokubuyekezwa kwezokuthutha ihlanganisa ini. Uzobe wazi izimiso ezilindelwe emotweni entsha ye-taxi. Uzokwazi inqubo elandelwayo yokuguqula imboni ye-taxi yamanje ibe imboni yokuthutha yomphakathi. Uzokuqonda izibopho zabaphethe izimoto ze-taxi mayelana nezinkokhelo zentela nezinsiza zakho. Isici esibalulekile sempilo ukuxhumana. Ungacabanga ukuthi umhlaba ungaba kanjani ngaphandle kokukhuluma? Kukhona amagama nezimpawu ezivame ukusetshenziswa ngamaqembu athile abantu, futhi ngokuvamile bangabantu kuphela abaqonda incazelo yazo. Ukukhuluma ngale ndlela kufana nokusebenzisa abantu embonini ye-taxi ngoba nabo banendlela ethile yokukhuluma. Singabala "ulimi" (izimpawu) ezisetshenziswa ngabashayeli nabagibeli uma besichaza izindawo abafuna ukuya kuzo, ezaziwa kuphela kulolu grupo, futhi kufanele kuchazwe kwabanye abangazi lolu limi noma lezi zimpawu. Lezi zimpawu zisetshenziswa ukuze kudluliselwe imiyalezo kalula. Abantu bavame ukufushane amagama ukuze kudluliselwe umyalezo kalula. Empeleni, abanye bathi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathanda ukwenza izinto zibe lula kubo, yingakho bekhetha ukusebenzisa amagama afushane (amagama afushane) akhuluma futhi abhalwe. Ngamanye amahlandla, ifomu elifushane legama liba lidume kakhulu kunegama eliphelele uqobo. Isibonelo yisisho esithi "HIV noma i-Anti Immune Deficiency Syndrome," esinamagama afushane adumile futhi aqondwa kalula uma abhalwe noma akhulunywa ngalesi sikhathi esifushane. Uyiqonda ukuthi kusho ukuthini? Njengakwamanye amasekeli emisebenzi, labo abathintekayo embonini ye-taxi basebenzisa amagama afushane ukuze baxhumane. Amanye awade kanti amanye anzima ukukhumbula. Nokho, la magama kufanele akhunjulwe futhi aqondwe ngabo bonke embonini ngoba athinta ibhizinisi labo ngendlela ethile. La magama afushane angatholakala emibikweni, ku-MOUs, nasemithethweni ekhiphwe yiphalamende. Ku-NLTTA (qaphela leli gama elifushane), kukhona amagama afushane okumele sazi. La magama achazwe encwadini ye-NLTTA. Empeleni, kungani sidinga i-NLTTA? Lapho sibheka umlando wethu, sithola ukuthi kube nezimiso ezihlala zikhona ezibekwe futhi eziphathelene nezindawo ezithile zabakhosi nabaphathi. Emihlanganweni yabo, lezi zimiso zazihloselwe ukugcina umthetho nokuhleleka kulezi zindawo. Namuhla, kusekhona izindawo lapho amadoda (mhlawumbe nabesifazane, ukuze kube nokushintsha) behlangana ezindaweni zobukhosi njalo evikini ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izindawo zilandela umthetho njengoba uphumelelwe. Le ndlela enhle yokuphatha isetshenziswa ezakhiweni zikamasipala nasemaphandleni kahulumeni. Abadala bethu baqonda ukuthi indawo engaphathwanga izoletha ukudideka futhi ibhubhise imiphakathi yethu; babekubona lokhu isikhathi eside. Izwe ngalinye eliphila ngaphansi kwenkqubo yokhetho efana neNingizimu Afrika linemithetho ebekwe yiphalamende eqinisekisa amalungelo abantu kanye namalungelo abo njengoba abhalwe emthethweni wethu kazwelonke. Lezi ziqondiso zibizwa ngemithetho. Iphalamende ngalinye linemithetho esiza ukuxazulula izinkinga ezahlukene umphakathi obhekana nazo mayelana nezindaba ezithinta le phalamende. Isibonelo, umnyango wezempilo unemithetho echaza ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kufanele baphathe kanjani abaguli babo. Ngokufanayo, uMnyango Wezokuthutha unemithetho eqondisa labo abathintekayo emsebenzini wezokuthutha mayelana nalokho okufanele bakwenze ukuze kulethwe ukuthula embonini. Omunye wabo ngu-NLTTA. Ukuhlela isimo samanje semboni yokuthutha kube yindlela ephilayo enezinga elikhulu lokuthuthukisa ukuthutha komphakathi. Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabagibeli. Abantu abaningi abazalwe ngaphambi kuka-1994 bayazi ngezinkinga ezazibhekene nabo bonke abantu abamnyama ngenxa yokucindezelwa nguhulumeni ongekho emthethweni. Babengenayo imvo yokuthi izwe liphathwa kanjani ngoba bebengavunyelwe ukuvota kuhulumeni abafuna. Kwakungekho ntando yeningi. Njengomphumela wentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika, manje sekukhona ukhetho ezingeni lendawo nasemazweni. Ngokukhethwa, izakhamuzi manje zingakhetha abantu abafuna ukuba yiphalamende! Ngoba siyazi ukuthi kuwukuthi ukuphila ezweni elinotando yeningi, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izindawo ezithinta ukuphila kwethu zisebenze ngokuvumelana nenhloso yabantu. Cabanga ngohlelo lwezikole (okuhlanganisa amakhansela akhethwe abafundi), uhulumeni bendawo (ohlanganiswe namakhansela), nokunye. Lokhu kusebenze ngendlela efanayo embonini ye-taxi - kudingeka sisebenze ngentando yeningi nohulumeni bendawo, ezingeni lesifunda nasemazweni kuzo zonke izakhiwo zethu. Kubuhlungu, Bhuti, awukho umvuzo! Singakwenza kanjani? Enye yemihlangano yeKomidi Elikhethekile Lezokwakha Ezikhaleni Zomphakathi ngoJuni 2002, uMongameli we-SANTACO, uMnu. Moufhe, wathi: "Ngaphambi kuka-1994, imboni ye-taxi yayiyibhizinisi eliholela kahle. Kodwa uhulumeni wobandlululo waphula imboni ngokuqhubeka nokukhipha izimvume eziningi." Wathi bayazi ukuthi ama-taxi carry abantu abaphezulu kuka-3.7 million njalo ekuseni. Lezi zazikakhulukazi abantu abasebenza - lokhu kusho ukuthi imboni ye-taxi ifaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wezwe nakuba ingakakabhalwa njengemboni yokuthutha yomphakathi? Ukushintsha uhlobo lwe-taxi oludlulelwe, ezintsha zifike lapha futhi zikhokha abantu abaneminyaka engu-18 kuya kwe-35. Ukuhweba kahle abanikazi be-taxi nababambiqhaza ngokwesekela nezimali zokuphuma ezimotweni. Ukwakha izinhlelo ze-taxi ukuze kuhlangany
