Kufanele sazi amawheels ethu, sithole ukujwayela ukuwabheka, silungise lokho okungahambi kahle ngokushesha, futhi sigcine kahle, esimeme, esidala, nasezindaweni ezingazinzile amawheels angabangela izingozi! Amawheels akho afana nezinyawo zezimoto zakho. Uma izinyawo zakho zihlanzekile, zihlala, ungaziphonsa phansi futhi uzilimaze. Amawheels awakwazi ukukhuluma. Ngakho, kuncike kithi, abanikazi beTaxi, nabashayeli ukuba sihlolisise ukulimala futhi silungise ngaphambi kokuthi kubangele izinkinga! Amawheels ezimoto asetshenzisiwe ahluke kuma-wheels ajwayelekile. Amawheels ajwayelekile awaqinile ngokwanele ukuthwala abagibeli beTaxi. I-wheel ye-vehicle inencwadi C emva kwenombolo yesisindo. Uma i-wheel incane kakhulu noma inkulu kakhulu, ingaphuma emgibeni we-wheel. Kumele ibe nosayizi ofanele. Buza umthengisi wakho we-tire ngosayizi ofanele we-vehicle yakho, noma ufunde incwadi yakho. Uma i-wheel incane kakhulu, ingaphuma emgibeni we-wheel. Ungazifaki engcupheni yokuphuma okungaba yingozi. Njalo uma ufaka itayi elisha, futhi ufake ne-air valve entsha. Ama-air valves awabizi kakhulu, ayabiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi umgibeli we-wheel uphila kahle. Uma umgibeli we-wheel ulimele, ungabangela itayi ukuthi ilahleke umoya ngokushesha noma iphume emgibeni. Hlola ama-wheel rims e-vehicle yakho njalo. Uma kukhona ukulimala, shintsha noma buza othile onolwazi ukuthi alungise. Umoya ongafanele ubangela itayi yakho ukuthi igqoke ngokungafanele futhi ingagqoka ngokushesha. Ukuhlola umoya njalo uma ugcwalisa uphethiloli nokufaka umoya ofanele kukunika ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi itayi yakho izohlala isikhathi esifanele - okwenza ukusindisa imali! Itayi yakho ingagqoka ngokushesha esontweni lokuqala uma ingafakwe kahle noma uma i-valve igxuma umoya. Hlola umoya kuma-tires akho nsuku zonke esontweni lokuqala ngemuva kokufaka ama-tires amasha. Ngemuva kwalokho, hlola umoya kuma-tires akho njalo. Njalo umshayeli kufanele abe ne-air pressure gauge yakhe. Ama-air gauges atholakala ezigaraji angase angasebenzi. Umoya ongafanele we-tire ungumthombo wezingozi eziningi zeTaxi. Faka umkhuba wokuhlola umoya kuma-tires akho. Qinisa ama-bolts kuma-wheels akho. Izingxenye eziningi zezingozini zenzeka ngoba umshayeli ucabanga ukuthi bazodlula noma ama-bolts aphukile. Ungazami ukuhamba ngemoto enama-bolts aphukile noma alahlekile. Ingabe lokhu akukhona nje ukugcinwa kwe-tire okuyisisekelo? Ungafaka ama-tires abiza kancane futhi ungawagcini - kodwa lokhu kungakubiza ukuphila kwakho. Lokhu kubiza kakhulu kunezithayi ezinhle ezigcinwe kahle. Ungacabangi ukuthi okuncane kungcono! Ama-tires abiza kancane - njengezithayi eziphindwe kabili, noma eziphindwe kabili noma ezibuyisiwe - angakubiza ukuphila kwakho kanye nabagibeli bakho. Ungazami ukufaka ama-tires aphindwe kabili noma abuyisiwe. Ama-tires abiza kancane ekugcineni - ngoba adinga ukugcinwa okuningi futhi awahlali isikhathi eside njengama-tires amasha. Ama-tires anekhwalithi ephezulu angabiza kakhulu kodwa abiza kancane ekugcineni ngoba kulula ukuwagcina futhi ahlala isikhathi eside. Ukulayisha ngokweqile kwe-vehicle kubangela ukugqoka kwe-tire futhi kungabangela ukuphuma, okuholela ezingozi nasekufeni. Ungacabangi ngentengo ye-tire. Cabanga ngokusindisa kuma-tires nasekuphepheni kwabagibeli bakho. Cabanga ngokusindisa kuma-tires? Ububanzi be-tread kufanele bube ngu-1.6 mm yonke indawo. U-1.6mm ufana nobubanzi be-20-cent coin. Uma itayi yakho inobubanzi be-tread obungaphansi kuka-1.6mm noma kuphi. Ukulayisha ngokweqile kwe-vehicle kuyingozi! I-taxi ngayinye ivunyelwe ukuthwala inani elithile labagibeli. Uma uthwala abagibeli abaphezulu kwenani elivunyelwe, ulimele umgwaqo kanye ne-vehicle. Uphula umthetho futhi ubeka ukuphila kwakho engozini! Ngizokwehlisa isijeziso sokulayisha ngokweqile i-vehicle! Ungangikhombisa yini ilayisense yakho yokushayela? Uthole yini utshwala? Ungaphuma kwi-vehicle yakho ukuze ngihlolisise ukuthi iyasebenza emgwaqweni? Cishe konke kudinga ukugcinwa uma ufuna ukuthi kuhlale isikhathi eside noma kuhamba isikhathi eside. Akusizi ukuba nemoto enhle nezithayi ezinhle uma ungazigcini. Futhi ufuna ukuthutha abagibeli bakho ngokuphepha. Ukugcinwa kusindisa imali. Ukunganaki ama-vehicles kuyimbangela enkulu yezingozi emgwaqweni. Ungavumeli ukuba ube wena
Kungenzeka ukuthi izilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziningi zingadala izifo, futhi izilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziyingozi zitholakala kabanzi emhlabathini, emanzini, ezilwaneni, nakubantu. Lezi zilwane ezincane zidluliselwa ngezandla, ezikhipha, nasezisetshenziswayo zokudla, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokusika, futhi ukuxhumana okuncane kungazidlulisa kokudla, kuholele ezimweni zokudla ezitholakala. Ukudla okungaphekiwe, ikakhulukazi inyama, izinkukhu, kanye nezilwane zasemanzini, kanye nezikhupha zazo, kungaba nezilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziyingozi ezingangcolisa ezinye izidlo ngesikhathi sokulungiselela nokugcina. Qiniseka ukuthi ukudla okufana nezisawoti nezitsha kuphuzwa ukuze kufinyelele ku-700C. Qiniseka ukuthi awekho amanzi enyama nenkukhu, futhi akufanele kube nombala ophuzi. Ngokujwayelekile, sebenzisa ithermometha. Ukupheka kahle kubulala cishe zonke izilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziyingozi. Izifundo zocwaningo zikhombisile ukuthi ukupheka ukudla ku-700C kungasiza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphephile ukudla. Ukudla okudinga ukunakwa okukhethekile kufaka phakathi inyama eqoshiwe, inyama efakwe emanzini, iziqeshana ezinkulu zenyama, kanye nezinkukhu eziphelele. Izilwane ezincane eziphilayo zingakhula ngokushesha uma ukudla kugcinwa ezingeni lokushisa lekhaya. Ngokugcina izinga lokushisa ngaphansi kwe-50C noma ngaphezulu kwe-600C, ukukhula kwezilwane ezincane eziphilayo kuyancipha noma kuyama. Ezinye izilwane ezincane eziphilayo ziqhubeka nokukhula ngaphansi kwe-50C. Izinto ezingavuthiwe, ikakhulukazi lezo eziqukethe amanzi neqhwa, zingangcoliswa ngezilwane ezincane eziphilayo eziyingozi nezinto zokwakha. Izinto ezingalimazi zingakha ezidleni ezonakele nezibola. Ukunakekela ekukhetheni izinto ezingavuthiwe kanye nezindlela ezilula zokuhlola ezifana nokuhlanza nokuphelisa kunganciphisa izinga lesixaka.

Yini ukuhweba komphakathi? Le yindlela elula, lapho indawo eqashisayo ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezincane ezilula ukuzilawula ezaziwa ngokuthi ukuhweba komphakathi. Umphakathi umphathi ubekwa ukuze abheke umphakathi othile futhi ungumuntu osebenzisana ngokubambisana nezakhamuzi kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo ekuvimbeleni ubugebengu obujwayelekile kulowo mphakathi. Bonke ababambiqhaza bangenela ekutholeni izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha ezithile zomphakathi wabo futhi bazame ukuthola umthombo wobugebengu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle kulowo mphakathi othile. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle emphakathini wenu. Ukubamba kwenu kuzokhiqiza imiphumela, futhi ngeke nibe nesaba sobugebengu emphakathini wenu futhi nithole izixazululo kubugebengu obujikelezayo endaweni yenu uma ninenhlangano zomphakathi zokulwa nobugebengu, ninikeza amaphoyisa ulwazi ngemicimbi yobugovu eyenzeka emphakathini wenu ukuze basebenzise izindlela ezinhle nezisuselwa emphakathini ekutholeni izixazululo zobugebengu emphakathini wenu; futhi lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwenu nomphathi wenu wombuso wezepolitiki waseNingizimu Afrika. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle emphakathini wenu.
Ushintsho kuMthetho 1. Ukuqonda kahle i-GNSS kusho ukuthi izinga lokuhambisana phakathi kokulinganiselwa okucatshangwa, ukukala okutholakele, noma isimo esidingekayo noma ikhono lesistimu ngesikhathi esithile kanye nesimo sangempela noma amandla, kuvame ukuvezwa ezilinganisweni zephutha zezibalo ohlelweni futhi kuchazwa njengento engalindelekile, ephindaphindwayo ngokusebenzisa ukuqhathanisa. Umgwaqo we-C4 nezinga lokulawula ukuhamba kuphela uma umshini udinga uhlelo lokulawula ukuhamba oluqondile ukuhlinzeka ngezinga lobuchwepheshe be-GPS elilingana nalokho okukhona ku-RAIM. Qaphela: Uhlelo lwe-GNSS lwezinga C luzofakwa kuphela ezindizeni ezinkulu ezivunyelwe ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwelizwe nangaphandle. Inqubo yokunyakaza kwefu ichaza amasu ahlukahlukene athinta ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokundiza ezihlobene nezivikelo ezitholakele ukuze kugwenywe ukuphazamiseka ngesikhathi sokusebenza kuze kube yilapho indiza ixhumana ngempela nomhlaba lapho yonke insiza yokubamba umhlaba noma ukuqala kabusha komjikelezo wokundiza kuqedile ngenxa yokwehluleka ukugcina iphethini ejwayelekile; uma indiza yehluleka ukugcina kahle, ibuyela esimweni lapho ingakhokha khona emoyeni noma ilinde isimo sokubamba esifanele. I-GNSS ichaza uhlelo lwe-Global Navigation Satellite System olusetshenziselwa ukubeka izindiza endaweni. Uhlelo nesikhathi esichaziwe endaweni kufaka phakathi ubuchwepheshe noma ukuqeqeshwa kwabo okuhamba phakathi kwezinkanyezi, izithuthukisi zokundiza, kanye namakhono okuqapha asiza ekusekeleni ukuhlola nokubona izimoto ezihamba phakathi kwezinkanyezi. Umcimbi we-GNSS uchaza umcimbi onjengalowo kanye nezimo ezifanayo nezokuphazamiseka komshini, izinkomba, noma iphutha lomuntu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Uhlelo lokuhola indiza lwezinga lokuqala luchaza uhlelo lokuhola umoya oluvunyiwe yiKhomishini yokusebenza ethile noma isikhathi sokundiza esithembekile nokuqondile kodwa akusho ukuthi ihlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala nokusebenza ngendlela engaphazamiseki. Ukwamukela, Ukuhlola, Nokwethembeka Kolwazi Olutholakele Ngobuchwepheshe Bezinkanyezi (RAIM) kuchaza isu lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS lunquma ukwethenjelwa kwezimpawu zokulawula indiza nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakala ngosayizi ukuya ezinkanyezini. "I-RVSM" ichaza umehluko okhona phakathi kwezinga lokundiza elingaphezu kuka-290 kuya ku-1000 amaphakethe uma kubhekwa ohlangothini lokuphuma ngalolu suku kanye no-1000 amaphakethe ubheka lapho indiza ihamba khona." "I-RVSM airspace" ichaza indawo yomoya phakathi kwezinga lokundiza le-290 kanye ne-410." "I-RVSM authorization certificate" ichaza isitifiketi esikhombisa ukuhambisana kwendiza kanye nekhono leqembu lokundiza ukusebenzisa indawo yomoya ye-RVSM." Ukuhola indiza okuhamba phezulu kuchaza isu lokulawula indiza elivumela indiza ukuthi ibheke phezulu isebenzisa izinsiza zokulinganisa ezisemhlabeni, ibheka imigwaqo ngaphandle kwendiza noma ukuhlanganisa lokhu. Ukusebenzisa amehlo kuchaza isu lokundiza le-IFR lapho ingxenye ethile noma inqubo yokusebenza yonke ingaqedwa futhi ukubamba kwenziwa ngokubheka indlela yokundiza. Ushintsho kuMthetho 1.00. Imali yokweseka emphakathini iyizimali ezithunyelwa kuhulumeni kubantu abangakwazi ukuzisekela. Ikhokhwa kubantu abampofu ukusiza ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezibalulekile nokubhekana nezici ezincane kodwa ezibalulekile zempilo. Imali yokweseka iphakanyiswa ukuze kusekelwe imigomo eyinhloko yeSikhungo, okuyinto yokuphakamisa abampofu nokuthuthukisa ukuphila kwalabo abadinga usizo. Lapho ufaka isicelo sokwesekwa, isimo sezimali somfaki-sicelo kanye nalabo abahlanganyela nabo noma abathintekayo sihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umuntu uyafaneleka ukusizwa kuhulumeni. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlola kwezomnotho." Inqubo yokufaka isicelo sokwesekwa akufanele ithathe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili kusukela ngesikhathi isicelo sithunyelwa. Qaphela: Izimali zokwesekwa zikhokhwa kubamukeli njalo ngenyanga. Usizo lwezingane ezikhuliswa ngabazali abangabazali bazo lukhokhwa kulabo abazali mayelana nengane ebekwe ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabo ngokweMthetho Wokunakekelwa Kwezingane, 1983 (Umthetho No. 74 ka-1983). Umfaki-sicelo/ingane kumele ahlale eNingizimu Afrika ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. I-oda leNkantolo kumele lithunyelwe libonisa isimo sokunakekelwa kwabazali ngaphansi kokuthi ingane ibekwe. Ingane ethwele abazali abangabazali bayo kumele ihlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola kwezomnotho, okuyi-R 12,720 ngonyaka. Sithumela ehhovisi lezeMphakathi eliseduze lapho umfaki-sicelo ehlala khona. Uma abafaki-sicelo bephakathi kweminyaka eminingi kakhulu noma bephila kahle ukuze bafake isicelo sokwesekwa ngokwabo ehhovisi, ilunga lomndeni kufanele lifake isicelo ngabo. Ifomu lesicelo sizogcwaliswa phambi kwenhlangano yezeMphakathi. Uma ifomu lesicelo ligcwaliswe, umfaki-sicelo uzonikezwa isiqinisekiso. Lesi siqinisekiso kumele sigcinwe - sikhombisa ubufakazi bokufakwa kwesicelo. Akufanele kukhokhwe imali yokufaka isicelo. Uma isicelo esithunyelwe singavunyelwa yiHhovisi lezeMphakathi, umfaki-sicelo kufanele aziswe ngokubhaliwe ngezizathu zokwenqatshwa kwesicelo. Umfaki-sicelo unelungelo lokuphikisa ngokubhala kwiNgqongqoshe yezeMphakathi esifundazweni sabo, echaza ukuthi kungani bengavumelani nesinqumo. Le mpikiswano kumele ithunyelwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokwaziswa ngemiphumela yesicelo esithunyelwe. Uma imali yokwesekwa ivunywa, umfaki-sicelo uzokhokhwa kusukela ngosuku isicelo sithunyelwe. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele aziswe ngokubhaliwe ngezizathu zokwenqatshwa kanye nenani losizo, kanye nelungelo labo lokuphikisa ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokwaziswa. Qaphela: Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukuqoqa imali, umuntu ophathisiwe ngokomthetho angabekwa ukuqoqa imali egameni lomfaki-sicelo. Isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwemali yokwesekwa kumele sithunyelwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-90 zokuphakanyiswa. Umfaki-sicelo akufanele abe seRiphabhulikhi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyisithupha. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhombise noma iyiphi imali engenayo ngesikhathi sokufaka isicelo. Lokhu kuzoba yisisekelo esizosebenzisa yiSikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inani losizo kufanele libuyekezwe. Umfaki-sicelo uzonikezwa izinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyekezwa noma usuku lapho kudingeka khona isitifiketi sezempilo. Imali yokwesekwa kwezingane ikhokhwa kumgcinimafa ophakathi mayelana nengane engaphansi kweminyaka eyi-11. Umgcinimafa angaba yiluphi uhlobo lomuntu ophatheka ezidingweni zansuku zonke zengane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubandakanyeka noma cha. Umfaki-sicelo kanye nomuntu ophathelene naye kufanele bahlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola kwezomnotho, okuyi-R9,600 ngonyaka ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kanye ne-R13,200 ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ingane nomgcinimafa wabo kufanele babe ngababumbi baseNingizimu Afrika futhi bahlale lapho. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele abe ngumgcinimafa ophakathi waleyo ngane. Ingane kufanele ibe ngaphansi kweminyaka eyi-11. Umgcinimafa angafaka isicelo sezingane ezingaphezu kwezingu-6 ezingazange zibe zabo. Umfaki-sicelo akufanele abe ngumgcinimafa ophakathi kwengane; noma isikhungo sikhokhelwa ukunakekela ingane. Le mali yokwesekwa ikhokhwa kubazali, abazali bempela bengane ngaphansi kokunakekelwa kwabo, kubagcinimafa bezingane ezineminyaka ephakathi kuka-1 no-18, ngenxa yokukhubazeka okukhulu kwengqondo noma okwenyama okudingayo ukunakekelwa okugcwele. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele abe ngummeli waseNingizimu Afrika, ngaphandle kwemibandela yabazali abahlala nengane engayibo. Umfaki-sicelo nengane kufanele bahlale eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha okuqinisekisa ukukhubazeka kumele kuthunyelwe. Umfaki-sicelo, umuntu ophathelene naye, nengane kufanele bahlangabezane nezidingo zokuhlola kwezomnotho, okuyi-R48,000 ngonyaka kubazali kanye ne-R17,760 nengane. Ingane ephila ngokuncika kokunakekelwa inganakekelwa ngokuphakade yisikhungo sikahulumeni.
Le mhlahlandlela ubhalwe ngenhloso yokuphila kahle nokuphepha kwabasebenzi eNingizimu Afrika. Akukhona ukujolisa ukushintsha uMthetho Wokuphila Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993. Inhloso enkulu yale mhlahlandlela ukuhlinzeka ngencazelo yalomthetho ngamagama alula, usebenzisa ulimi oluqondile ukuze kucaciswe kubo bonke abantu abathintekayo empilweni nasekuphepheni endaweni yokusebenza lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi wababheki bezempilo nokuphepha eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi uchazwe. Amalungelo nemithwalo yabasebenzi, njengoba kuchazwe emthethweni, kubhalwe phansi. Imisebenzi nemithwalo yabanikazi bamabhizinisi, abakhiqizi, abaqashi, abangenisi, abahlinzeki, nabathengisi ekuqinisekiseni impilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi nayo ibalwe. Ekugcineni, imisebenzi yabamele bezempilo nokuphepha kanye nezinkomiti ezihambisanayo icacisiwe. UMthetho Wokuphila Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi ka-1993 udinga ukuthi umqashi aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza iphephile, ingenazo izingozi eziphazamisa impilo yabasebenzi, futhi ugcizelela ukuthi umqashi kumele akwenze lokhu ngendlela engcono kakhulu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ayinazo izinto eziyingozi, ezifana nebenzene, izidakamizwa, nezinto eziyingozi, imishini, nezindlela zokusebenza ezingaphephile. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi kumele axwayise abasebenzi ngalezi zingozi, indlela yokuzigwema, ukusebenza ngokuphepha, futhi asebenzise izinyathelo zokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi akukhona kuphela umqashi onemithwalo yokufeza le msebenzi wezempilo nokuphepha. Umthetho usekelwe emgomeni wokuthi izingozi endaweni yokusebenza kumele zixazululwe ngokwakha umgudu wokuxhumana phakathi kwabasebenzi nomqashi. Abasebenzi nabanikazi bamabhizinisi kumele babelane ngemithwalo yokuphila kahle nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza. Bobabili kumele bahlaziye izingozi ezingaba khona futhi baphakamise izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze benze indawo yokusebenza iphephile. Ngale ndlela, umqashi nabasebenzi basebenza ndawonye ezinhlelweni lapho ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha bengahlola njalo indawo yokusebenza futhi banikeze imibiko kwinkomiti yezempilo nokuphepha. Le nkampani ingase iphakamise iziphakamiso kumqashi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi le nkqubo isebenza kahle, bonke abasebenzi kumele bazi ngamalungelo nemithwalo yabo njengoba kuchazwe emthethweni. Kukhona izinhlinzeko eziningi ezikhuluma ngezihloko ezithile ezifakiwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Umthetho noma izinhlinzeko zitholakala kwiGovt Printer, kungaba kwiGazette noma zikhishwe abanye abashicileli. UMthetho Wokuphila Nokuphepha Kwezisebenzi uphethwe yiChief Directorate of Health and Safety ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nempilo yabasebenzi, amahhovisi asunguliwe kuzo zonke izifunda. Okwamanje, ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha endaweni yokusebenza nalabo abahlala ezifundeni benza ukuhlola nokuhlola lapho kudingeka khona ezindaweni zokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuhlola ziqhutshwa ngokulandela izinkomba ezithile esingazibona; ukuvela kwezinto eziyingozi, ukusetshenziswa kwebenzene lapho imikhiqizo ihlaziywa, noma ezindaweni lapho imishini eyingozi ikhona. Kukhona nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezingenziwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, njengokufaka izicelo, izikhalazo zabasebenzi, abaqashi, noma amalungu omphakathi. Lezi zikhalazo noma izicelo zigcinwa zifihliwe. Uma umbhali ethola okuthile okuyingozi noma okungaba yingozi endaweni yokusebenza, angabeka imithetho ethile kumqashi. Ezimweni ezikhombisa ingozi engaba khona, umbhali angavimbela isenzo, inqubo, noma ukusetshenziswa kwemishini ngokukhishwa kwesaziso esifanele sokuvimbela. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuhoxisa ukubaluleka kwalolo xwayiso; umyalezo owakhiwe kumele ulandelwe ngokushesha. Uma kukhona umthetho othile ophulwe, umbhali angakhupha isaziso sokwephula umthetho kubasebenzi noma kumqashi. Ukwephula umthetho kungaholela ekutheni kube nokuphathwa ngokushesha. Uma inqubo ethile iphuliwe, umqashi anganikezwa ithuba lokulungisa iphutha ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo, ngokuvamile ezinsukwini ezingama-60. Uma umbhali ethola ukuthi izimo zempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi azaneliseki, umbhali angayala umqashi ukuthi athuthukise le ndawo. Isaziso sokuthuthukisa sikhishwe kumqashi, sichaza indlela elindelekile yokuthuthukisa okungamukeleki kumbhali. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ababheki bezempilo nokuphepha bahlala benza kahle, bavunyelwe ukungena kunoma iyiphi indawo noma imiphakathi lapho imishini, izinto eziyingozi, noma lapho zisetshenziswa zigcinwa, futhi banephuzu lokubuza imibuzo nokucela abantu abathile ukuba bavele phambi kwabo. Umphakathi ungacela noma yiziphi imibhalo ukuthi ithunyelwe kubo, bahlola, futhi benze amakhophi ale mibhalo, futhi bacela ukucaciswa ngokuqukethwe kwabo. Umphakathi ungahlola isimo noma impahla, athathe amasampula ale nto, noma athathe impahla engase ibe ubufakazi. Umqashi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukuphepha nokungabi khona kwezingozi endaweni yokusebenza nasempilweni yabasebenzi? Umqashi kumele agcine imishini nezinsiza zokusebenza ezifanele, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izinhlelo ezidingekayo ukuze umsebenzi wenziwe, esimweni engakwenzi kube yingozi empilweni nasekuphepheni kwabasebenzi. Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa imishini nezinsiza zokuphepha, umqashi kumele kuqala akhiphe noma asuse noma yiziphi izingozi ezingase zibe nomthelela omubi empilweni nasekuphepheni kwabasebenzi. Uma lokhu kungenzeki, umqashi angasebenzisa izinsiza zokuvikela nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngabasebenzi. Umqashi unomthwalo wokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukuvikela impilo nokuphepha ezingozeni ezingase zivele ekukhiqizeni, ekwenzeni umsebenzi, ekusetshenzisweni, ekuphathweni, ekugcinweni, noma ekuthuthweni kwemikhiqizo noma izinto. Ngamanye amazwi, noma yini engase ibonakale kumsebenzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile, ukuqeqesha, nokuphatha abasebenzi kubonakale njengendlela yabo yokusebenza. Ngamanye amazwi, lokho okufanele bakwenze nokungafanele bakwenze. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuqhubeka nokusebenza ngaphambi kokuthatha zonke izinyathelo zokuphepha ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abaphansi komqashi balandela umthetho futhi baphoqelelwe ukuba bathathe izindlela ezifanele zokugwema izingozi ngenhloso yokuhlonipha umgomo wokuphepha nempilo enhle. Ukuqaphela ukuthi umsebenzi nemishini zisetshenziswa umuntu ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu oqeqeshiwe kulowo msebenzi noma imishini ukuze aqonde izingozi ezihambisana nalowo msebenzi noma imishini. Lo msebenzi kumele aqinisekise ukuthi imizamo yokuvikela iyalandelwa futhi igcinwa. Bonke abasebenzi banelungelo lokwazi. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi kumele baqinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bayazi futhi baqonde kahle izingozi zempilo nokuphepha ezihambisana nomsebenzi ngamunye abawenzayo, imikhiqizo ekhiqizwayo, ehlelwa, igcinwa, iphathwa, noma ithuthwa, kanye nemishini noma amathuluzi asetshenziswayo
Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KweMibhalo, 2000 ("umthetho") wawusungulwa ngoMsombuluko 9, 2001, ufeza ilungelo lemthethosisekelo lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe ngama- body omphakathi noma ezizimele uma kudingeka ukuze kuqhutshekwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo. Uma kwenziwa isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, isikhungo esithunyelwe kuso lesi sicelo sinesibopho sokunika lokho kulwazi ngaphandle uma umthetho ucacisa ngokusobala ukuthi lokho kulwazi kufanele kukhishwe noma cha. Umthetho uphinde uveze izinqubo ezizolandela uma isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi sithunyelwa. Le ncwadi ihlose ukukhuthaza isiko lokucacisa nokubhekelela ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezohwebo Nezomnotho ("DTI") ngokufeza ilungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi ukuze abantu noma izikhungo ezithile zikwazi ukukusebenzisa futhi zivikele amalungelo awo. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuxhumana kweqiniso nezikhungo zikamasipala, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ufundisiwe futhi unolwazi ukuze aqonde amalungelo akhe ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Ngendlela efaka leli lungelo eduze kwamanye amalungelo, ifaka amalungelo afana nalawo atholakala kuBill of Rights kuMthethosisekelo. Isigaba 14 somthetho sinikeza ama- body omphakathi ukuba abhale idokhumenti yokusebenza, ezosiza abantu abafuna ulwazi oluthile kulowo mnyango, futhi sichaza izidingo okufanele zifezekiswe yilezi zedokhumenti. I-DTI ibike ukuthi izoqhubeka nokuzama ukusebenza ngokucacile futhi izohlinzeka ngolwazi emphakathini nasemabhizinisini ngokuqhubekayo ngama-publishing e-DTI, izaziso, iwebhusayithi, kanye ne-call center. Le ncwadi ihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ummangali wolwazi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ngemininingwane yokuxhumana, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola ulwazi oluthile ku-DTI. Le Manual iphinde ihlose ukuhlinzeka ummangali ngencazelo ecacile yesakhiwo, imisebenzi, izinsizakalo, kanye nenxusa yolwazi ye-DTI ukuze ummangali akwazi kalula ukuthola lapho ulwazi lukhona. Le ncwadi iphinde ifake amafomu adingekayo kanye nezinkokhelo ezihambisana nezicelo zolwazi. I-DTI inhloso yayo ukuhola nokweseka uhlelo lokufinyelela kulwazi ngendlela ekhuthaza ukusimama komnotho futhi ivule amathuba emisebenzi kubo bonke abakha lo mnotho, ngokwandisa amazinga okutshalwa kwezimali, ukuthuthukisa nokwandisa ukuthunyelwa kwemikhiqizo yaseNingizimu Afrika ezweni langaphandle, nokwakha imakethe efanele futhi eyinhlangano yokuncintisana kwemikhiqizo phakathi kwamabhizinisi endawo kanye namakhasimende. Ngale ndlela, i-DTI isebenza ukusiza umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ukuba ube nendlela esheshayo yokukhula nokuphumelela. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe umkhakha wokukhiqiza ophumelelayo nowokubambisana okukhuthaza ukwandiswa kwamathuba okukhula komnotho okusimeme kubo bonke abanye baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze wandise futhi uthuthukise isikali somkhakha wokukhiqiza nezinsizakalo zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze ukhuthaze amazinga aphezulu okutshalwa kwezimali kwasekhaya nakwamanye amazwe. Ukuze udale imakethe enezindlela, enezinga lokuncintisana lemikhiqizo eNingizimu Afrika kubo bonke abathengisi bendawo nakwamanye amazwe, kanye namakhasimende. Izikhungo zokweseka zinikeza usizo kumabhizinisi asebenza ukusiza izigaba ezahlukene zomnyango. Izikhungo zokwenza izinqumo zigxile ekwakheni izimo ezithokozisayo ngaphakathi komnotho. Izikhungo zokwethula izinsizakalo zixhumanisa ngqo amabhizinisi namakhasimende nemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo. Isikhungo sokumaketha siqapha ukumaketha kwemikhiqizo ye-DTI (ohlelo nezinsiza) futhi siqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi endawo namakhasimende aqonda amalungelo awo emnothweni. Ukuze wandise ukuqwashisa nokufinyelela kumikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ze-DTI. Ulwazi lwenkampani, isibonelo, umqondisi, abanikazi, ikheli lenkampani, njll. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali Nezinsizakalo Zabasebenzi, isibonelo, Umthetho Wamabhizinisi 71 ka-1991: Inhloso yale mthetho ukuhoxisa nokuhlela imithetho ethile ephathelene nokukhishwa kwemvume yokusebenza kwamabhizinisi, isikhathi sokuvula nokuvala izitolo, nokwenza kube nokuqinisekiswa kokukhishwa kwemvume yamabhizinisi kanye nokusebenza kwazo, kanye nazo zonke ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokuncintisana 89 ka-1998: Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula iKomidi Lokuncintisana elizophenya, lilawule, futhi lihlole inqubo yezinqubomgomo, izindlela ezingafanele, kanye nokuziphatha kwamakampani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lokuncintisana kuyalawulwa ukuze kwenziwe izinqumo kulezi zindaba, kanye nokusungulwa kweNkantolo Yokufaka Izikhalazo. Umthetho Wesibili Wokulungisa 39 ka-2000: Inhloso yale mthetho ukuhlela Umthetho Wokuncintisana ka-1998 ukuze kucaciswe amagama athile, kulungiswe incazelo, futhi kususwe ezinye incazelo. Umthetho Wokuvikela Abathengi 75 ka-1980: Inhloso yale mthetho ukuvikela abathengi abathenga imikhiqizo ngokuthengisa, ukuqashwa, noma ukukhokha, kanye nalabo abathola ezinye izinsizakalo ngezikweletu. Umthetho Wokutholakala Kwezimpahla Zomphakathi 89 ka-1970: Inhloso yale mthetho ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe Wezomnotho ukuba akhiqize, athole, aqashe, noma athole imikhiqizo ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Umthetho Wokuhweba Nezinsizakalo 25 ka-1964: Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula ukulawulwa kokuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo nokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokwakha Izindlu Zababhalisile 65 ka-1988: Inhloso yale mthetho ukuhlela ukudluliswa kwezindlu nezinye izindaba ezihlobene ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo zokwakha izindlu zabathintekayo, kanye nokusungula ezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokwakha Izindlu Nezindinganiso 103 ka-1977: Inhloso yale mthetho ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondanisa neminye imithetho ephathelene nokwakhiwa kwezindlu ezindaweni zezakhamuzi, kanye nokuchaza ukuthi izindinganiso zokwakha kufanele zibe kanjani, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokugembula 33 ka-1996: Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula ukulawulwa nokulawulwa kwezindaba ezihlobene nezikhangiso nezokugembula, ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukiswe izindinganiso nezindlela ezivamile ezilandelwa kulo lonke elaseRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokusungula iBhodi Yokugembula Yezwe, nokuphatha zonke izindaba ezihlobene nokugembula. Umthetho Wokulawula Izikhali 87 ka-1993: Inhloso yale mthetho ukusungula ukulawulwa kwezikhali zonke, nokusungula iBhodi ezolawula izindaba ezihlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezikhali kuleRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokuchaza izinhloso nemisebenzi yalezi zikhali, nokuchaza izindlela ezizolawulwa ngazo, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umthetho Wokushukela 9 ka-1978: Inhloso yale mthetho ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela imithetho ephathelene nomkhakha wokushukela, nezinye izindaba ezingavela ezihlobene nawo. Umthetho Wokulawula Ukushintsh

Isigaba 32 somthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996) ("umthethosisekelo") unikeza amalungelo omphakathi ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nganoma iyiphi inhlangano yangasese noma yomphakathi. Umthetho uhlose ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kolwazi. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuqinisa isiko lokucacisa nokubhekelela ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezangaphakathi ("DHA") ngokusebenzisa ilungelo lolwazi abantu noma izinhlangano ezidinga ukulisebenzisa nokulivikela noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zabo. Ilungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olunikezwa umthetho kufanele lusetshenziswe ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo evunyelwe umthetho njengoba kunikezwa esigabeni 9 soMthetho (kuhlanganise, kodwa kungagcini lapho, imikhawulo ehlose ukuvikela ubumfihlo, ubufihlo bezentengiselwano, kanye nokuphathwa kahle, ukusebenza kahle, nokuphathwa kahle) nangendlela elinganisa lelo lungelo nezinye izimfanelo, kuhlanganise nalabo abakwiBill of Rights kumthethosisekelo. Ngokusho kwesigaba 14 soMthetho, izinhlangano zomphakathi ezifana ne-DHA kumele ziqoqa ibhukwana ukusiza abantu ekutholeni ulwazi oluvela kule nhlangano. Isigaba 14 sichaza kahle izidingo ezincane zaleli bhukwana. Ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo nomthetho, i-DHA iletha le bhukwana ngenhloso yokuphakamisa isiko lokucacisa nokuphathwa kahle. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuhlinzeka abafuna ulwazi ngezindlela nemininingwane yokuxhumana edingekayo ukuze bathole ulwazi ngqo kwi-DHA. Le bhukwana iphinde ihlinzeke incazelo ecacile yesakhiwo, amandla, nemisebenzi ye-DHA, kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi lwabo ngezigaba, ukuze abafuna ulwazi bakwazi ukubona kalula ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo lutholakala kuphi. Isigaba 10 soMthetho sidinga iKomidi leMithetho Yomuntu waseNingizimu Afrika ("SAHRC") ukuthi siqoqe umhlahlandlela wokuthi ungawusebenzisa kanjani umthetho, kuzo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni nangendlela elula ukuyifunda, ngaphambi kukaJulayi 2003. Ngesikhathi le bhukwana ibhalwa, umhlahlandlela we-SAHRc wawungakatholakali. Ulwazi lokuxhumana lwabo bonke ofisa ulwazi kanye nabasizi babo kuzo zonke izinhlangano zomphakathi. Ulwazi lokuthi ungafaka kanjani izicelo zezimfihlo ezivela ezikhungweni zomphakathi nezangasese. Usizo olukhona oluvela kumfisa ulwazi wenhlangano yomphakathi ngokomthetho. Izixazululo zomthetho ezitholakalayo uma inhlangano yomphakathi noma eyangasese ingahambisani nomthetho, kuhlanganise nokuthi ungafaka kanjani isikhalazo sangaphakathi nokufaka isicelo enkantolo (okuyindlela yokugcina uma uzama ukuvula noma yiziphi izimfanelo ezishiwo kumthetho). Ulwazi lokuthi izinhlangano zomphakathi nezangasese ziqoqa kanjani izimfihlo, nokuthi abafuna ulwazi bangazithola kanjani izimfihlo, kanye nokudalula ezinye izinhlobo zezimfihlo ngokuzithandela. Incazelo yezimiso zomthetho ezisunguliwe. Le bhukwana yokuhola izobuyekezwa ngemininingwane emisha futhi iphinde iphumelele njalo eminyakeni emibili. Izincwadi ezikhethiwe kuzo zonke izifunda, ezibizwa "njengamaphuzu okugcina asemthethweni," ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokugcina Osemthethweni (Umthetho No. 54 ka-1997). Zonke izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezisemthethweni. Zonke amahhovisi ezikhungo zomphakathi, kuhlanganise nawo wonke amahhovisi omkhandlu nezamahhovisi eMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa KweMithetho. Kufanele futhi kube khona emahhovisi e-SAHRc nasematheni e-SAHRc ku-http://www.sahrc.org.za. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izophrintwa kuGazethi yoHulumeni. Ingafinyelelwa mahhala kulezi zikhungo ezishiwo ngenhla, nakuba izindleko zokukopisha zingase zikhokhwe. Izicelo zokufinyelela ezimfihlo ze-DHA kumele zenziwe ngofomu olusemthethweni olushicilelwe kuMnotice weHulumeni No. R. 187 owadlalwa ngomhla zingu-15 kuFebhuwari 2002. Umthetho ubhekisela kabanzi kumfisa ulwazi njengomuntu okufanele wamukele futhi abheke izicelo, kodwa kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi isigaba 17 sivumela abantu abaningi ukuba baphakanyiswe ukuze basize umfisa ulwazi. Lezi zinsizwa eziphakanyisiwe zibizwa ngokuthi abasizi bomfisa ulwazi. Le fomu kulula ukuyigcwalisa, kodwa uma kudingeka, kungabizwa umphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ukuze asize umfisa ulwazi. Uma umfisa ulwazi engakwazi ukwenza isicelo esibhaliwe, umphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu futhi anikeze umfisa ulwazi ikhophi. Abafuna ulwazi kufanele bazi ukuthi yiziphi izimfihlo abafuna ukuzithola. Uma umfisa ulwazi engakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezimfihlo ezidingekayo ukuze kube lula ukuzithola, i-DHA izokwazi ukusiza umfisa ulwazi ngokushesha. Abafuna ulwazi kufanele bathole ukuthi ubani ophethe izimfihlo. Kumele basebenzise uhlu lwezihloko nezigaba zolwazi olugcinwe ngumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ukuze bazi ukuthi yimuphi umfisa ulwazi ongena nezimfihlo, bese bethumela izicelo zabo kumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi. Umphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ngamunye unomsebenzi wokunquma ukuthi avumele ukufinyelela ezimfihlo ngaphansi kokulawula kwabo. Amafomu okufaka izicelo atholakala kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi yomphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi. Angasetshenziswa futhi ngekopya yefomu. Ifomu lokufaka eligcwalisiwe lingaba nolwazi oluningi kangangokuthi umfisa ulwazi angase angakwazi ukulithumela. Kuzokwamukelwa kuphela imali, ama-oda eposi, kanye nezinkokhelo ezivunyelwe yibhange. Ukukhokha kungafakwa ehhovisi le-DHA eliseduze (uma le hhovisi ingenayo i-cashier, izothumela umfisa ulwazi ehhovisi le-DHA elinayo) futhi ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesikweletu kufanele ifakwe kufomu lokufaka isicelo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ukukhokha kwakho kungahambisana nefomu lokufaka isicelo kanye nesikweletu ositholile. Ngemuva kokuthi ifomu igcwaliswe, kufanele ithunyelwe kumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ofanele. Akudingeki ukuthi ithunyelwe mathupha; empeleni, lokhu kungenzeka kuphela uma izinhlelo zangaphambi kokuthunyelwa zenzekile. Idokhumenti egcwalisiwe ingathunyelwa nge-fax, nge-imeyili, ngeposi, noma ithunyelwe nge-courier kumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi ofanele. Uma umfisa ulwazi engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala noma ukungasebenzi kahle kumvimbela ekwenzeni isicelo, umfisa ulwazi angacela usizo kumphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi. Kuvame ukuba ngcono ukuhlela kusenesikhathi ukuze ube nesicelo sokukhuluma futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani lokhu kubalulekile. Ngesikhathi sokuxoxisana ngezinkinga, umphakanyisi womfisa ulwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu lokufaka isicelo kumfisa ulwazi futhi anikeze ikhophi yefomu eligcwalisiwe. Ab
Kukhona isisho esivela kwezinye izilimi zomdabu esithi: "Ithambo alakhi indlu." Ulwazi lwethu embonini ye-taxi lukhombisile iqiniso lalo misho kaningi. Ngaphambi kukahulumeni wenkolo, abantu abaningi embonini ye-taxi babhekana nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokufa nokulimala kwabashayeli nabagibeli. Lezi zinselelo nezimpi zazivela kakhulu ngenxa yokungavumelani phakathi kwabo bonke embonini ye-taxi mayelana nezindlela, imali ethathwa ngabagibeli, njalonjalo. Ukuze kususwe izingxabano ezingadingekile embonini ephethwe ikakhulu abantu abamnyama futhi ethola inzuzo enkulu kubasebenzi abaningi abangekho emsebenzini, uhulumeni, kanye ne-South African National Taxi Council (Santaco), bashicilela incwadi yokuvumelana (MOU) ehloswe ukudala ukuthula kule mboni. I-MOU yalandelwa yimithetho eminingi eshicilelwe yiphalamende ngenhloso yokuletha induduzo embonini ye-taxi. I-National Land Transport Transitional Act (NLTTA) ingenye yale mithetho. Uzokhombisa ulwazi lwakho nge-NLTTA. Uzokuqonda inqubo yokubuyekezwa kwemigudu ye-taxi kanye nezinzuzo zayo. Uzokwazi ukuthi inqubo yokubuyekezwa kwemigudu ye-taxi ifaka ini. Uzobe wazi izimiso ezilindelekile emotweni entsha ye-taxi. Uzokwazi inqubo elandelwayo ukuze kushintshwe imboni ye-taxi yamanje ibe imboni yokuhamba yomphakathi. Uzokuqonda izibopho zabaphathi be-taxi mayelana nezinkokhelo zentela nezinzuzo zakho. Isici esibalulekile sempilo ukuxhumana. Ungacabanga ukuthi umhlaba uzobukeka kanjani ngaphandle kokukhuluma? Kukhona amagama nezimpawu ezisetshenziswa kakhulu ngamaqembu athile abantu, futhi bavame ukuba yibo kuphela abaqonda incazelo yazo. Ukukhuluma ngaleyo ndlela kufana nokusebenzisa abantu embonini ye-taxi ngoba nabo banendlela ethile yokukhuluma. Singabala "ulimi" (izimpawu) ezisetshenziswa ngabashayeli nabagibeli lapho bechaza izindawo abazohamba kuzo, ezaziwa kuphela yilolu grupo, futhi okumele kuchazwe kwabanye abangazi lolu limi noma izimpawu. Lezi zimpawu zisetshenziswa ukuze kudluliselwe imiyalezo kalula. Abantu bavame ukufingqa amagama ukuze kudlule imiyalezo kalula. Empeleni, abanye bathi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bathanda ukwenza izinto zibe lula kubo, yingakho bekhetha ukusebenzisa amagama afingqiwe (amagama afushane) akhuluma futhi abhalwe. Kwesinye isikhathi ifomu elifingqiwe legama liba lidume kakhulu kunegama eliphelele uqobo. Isibonelo yisisho esithi "HIV noma Anti Immune Deficiency Syndrome," esinamagama afushane aziwa kakhulu futhi aqondwa kalula uma abhalwe noma akhulunywa ngendlela efingqiwe. Uyazi ukuthi kusho ukuthini? Njengakwamanye amagatsha omsebenzi, labo abathintekayo embonini ye-taxi basebenzisa amagama afingqiwe ukuze baxhumane. Ezinye zinde kanti ezinye zihluleka ukukhumbula. Nokho, la magama kufanele aziwe futhi aqondwe ngabo bonke embonini ngoba athinta ibhizinisi labo ngandlela thile. Lawa magama afushane angatholakala emibikweni, kuma-MOU, nasemithethweni eshicilelwe yiphalamende. Ku-NLTTA (qaphela leli gama elifingqiwe), kukhona amagama afingqiwe okumele sazi. Lawa magama achazwa encwadini ye-NLTTA. Empeleni, kungani sidinga i-NLTTA? Uma sibheka umlando wethu, sithola ukuthi kube khona imithetho esunguliwe futhi eqiniswa ezindaweni ezithile zamakhosi nabaphathi. Emikhandlwini yabo, le mithetho yayihloselwe ukugcina umthetho nokulawula kulezi zindawo. Namuhla, kusekhona izindawo lapho amadoda (mhlawumbe nabesifazane, ukuze kube nokushintsha) behlangana ezindaweni zobukhosi njalo ngesonto ukuze baqinise imithetho. Baphinde basebenzise le platform ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izindawo zilandela umthetho njengoba uqinisekisiwe. Le ndlela enhle yokuphatha isetshenziswa ezakhiweni zikamasipala nasemaphakathini kahulumeni. Omdala bethu baqonda ukuthi indawo engaphathwa kahle izoletha ukudideka futhi ibhubhise imiphakathi yethu; babekubone lokhu isikhathi eside. Izwe ngalinye eliphila ngaphansi kwesistimu yokhetho efana neNingizimu Afrika linezomthetho ezisunguliwe yiphalamende ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu kanye namalungelo abo njengoba kubhalwe emthethweni wethu kazwelonke. Lezi ziqondiso zibizwa ngamalungelo. Iphakheji ngalinye linezimiso ezisiza ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihlukahlukene umphakathi obhekana nazo mayelana nezindaba ezithinta le phakheji. Isibonelo, umnyango wezempilo unamalungelo achaza ukuthi abezempilo kufanele bakhathalele kanjani abaguli babo. Ngokufanayo, uMnyango Wezokuthutha unamalungelo aqondisa labo abathintekayo ebhizinisini lokuhamba mayelana nalokho okufanele bakwenze ukuze kulethwe ukuthula embonini. Omunye wabo ngu-NLTTA. Ukuguqula isimo samanje semboni yokuhamba sibe uhlelo oluphilayo olunomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthumeni komphakathi. Ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabagibeli. Abantu abaningi abazalwe ngaphambi kuka-1994 bayazi ngezinselelo ezabhekana nazo bonke abantu abamnyama ngenxa yokucindezelwa nguhulumeni ongafanele. Babengenayo imvo ngendlela izwe eliphethwe ngayo ngoba babengavunyelwe ukuvota kuhulumeni abawafunayo. Kwakungekho ndaba. Njengomphumela wokhetho eNingizimu Afrika, manje sekukhona ukhetho ezingeni lendawo nakwenkolo. Ngendlela yokhetho, izakhamuzi manje zingakhetha abantu abazifunayo ephalamende! Njengoba sazi ukuthi kuyini ukuphila ezweni elinokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izindawo ezithinta ukuphila kwethu zisebenze ngokuhambisana nezifiso zabantu. Cabanga ngohlelo lwezikole (okusebenza kumakhandla akhethwe abafundi), uhulumeni bendawo (ohlanganiswe ngababonisi), njalonjalo. Lokhu kusebenza ngendlela efanayo embonini ye-taxi - sidinga ukusebenza ngokhetho nohulumeni bendawo, ezingeni lesifunda nasezingeni lesizwe kuyo yonke imikhakha yethu. Kubuhlungu, Bhuda, asikabi nenzuzo! Singakwenza kanjani? Enye yezinkulumo zeKomidi Especial kuMsebenzi Womphakathi ngoJuni 2002, uMongameli we-SANTACO, uMnu. Moufhe, wathi: "Ngaphambi kuka-1994, imboni ye-taxi yayiyibhizinisi elinzuzo. Kodwa uhulumeni we-apartheid wahlela ngokucophelela ukuhlinzeka ngemboni ngokukhishwa kwezincwadi eziningi kakhulu." Wathi bazi ukuthi ama-taxi aphethe abantu abangaphezu kwe-3.7 million njalo ekuseni. Laba babephmostly abantu abasebenzayo - lokhu kusho ukuthi imboni ye-taxi inika umnotho wezwe umthelela omkhulu nakuba ingakabhalwa njengemboni yokuhamba yomphakathi? Ukushintsha uhlobo lwezithuthi ezindala, ezintsha zifake lapha futhi zithwele abantu abaneminyaka engu-18 kuya ku-35. Ukuhlangabezana nezinga eliphezulu lokuphepha elidingekayo ezithuthwini zokuhamba zomphakathi (izithuthi kumele zifake izici ezifana nohlelo lokumisa izithuthi oluvimbela ukugcwala). Ukuthola inzuzo kubanikazi be-taxi nababambiqhaza ngokuxhaswa kanye nezimali zokuphuma ezithuthwini. Ukusungula izinhlangano ze-taxi ukuze zixhumane nabaxhasi ukuze zabelane ngezithuthi ezintsha. Ubulili obuphakathi kwemindeni noma ukucwaswa kubhekwa nguMthetho Wokulwa Nobudlova Emndenini futhi kusebenza nasekubhekaneni nobudlova obuphakathi kwabantu abanobudlelwano ekhaya. Omunye onengane futhi. Noma yimuphi omunye umthetho wokucindezela noma ukucwaswa ongabangela umonakalo empilweni yakho, ukuphila, noma inhlalakahle. Vula icala lobugebengu emaphoyiseni futhi ufake isicelo sokuvikelwa. Lokhu kuyisiyalo esikhishwe yinkantolo ngesicelo sakho sokucindezela umuntu othile onobudlelwano obuphakathi, ukuba ayeke ukucwaswa futhi avimbele lowo muntu ekutholeni usizo komunye ukuze enze lowo msebenzi wokucwaswa. Isiyalo sokuvikelwa sesikhashana singakhishwa phakathi nosuku noma ebusuku ukuze sikuvikele engcupheni. Uzokwaziswa ngamalungelo akho nezinyathelo ongazithatha. Sizogcina ikhophi yesiyalo sokuvikelwa futhi sigcine amarekhodi wezehlakalo zonke zokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya ezizokwenzeka kamuva. Sizobhala ukukhala kwakho kwi-Register yezehlakalo esiteshini njengengxenye yobufakazi bokuthi ubike le ndaba - lokhu kuzoba ubufakazi obengeziwe ukusisiza lapho sibika ngenqubekela phambili yecala. Sizophenya ekhaya lakho, sithathe noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezikhali ezingatholakala kumuntu ophoxa ukukubulala noma ukukulimaza. Sizokwenze lokhu uma kuqinisekiswa ukuthi umqondo noma ukuziphatha komuntu ohlukunyezayo, ukugqugquzela ubudlova, utshwala, noma imishanguzo kungaholela ekulimaleni komunye umuntu. Futhi sicebisa umuntu ohlukunyezwayo. Futhi ngezikhathi lapho le nsizakalo echazwe itholakala. Sizokuqinisekisa ukuthi insizakalo yokusiza iqoqe futhi ibhalise wonke ubufakazi bokuphila obuzoba yingxenye yokweseka noma yisiphi isicelo sobugebengu esingase sibe khona. Sizokuhambela lapho uhamba ekhaya ukuthatha izinto zakho, uma isiyalo sokuvikelwa esikhishwe sihlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi. Uma amaphoyisa engalandeli lezi zobulungiswa, bika le ndaba kumphathi wesiteshi samaphoyisa. Sizothumela imibiko yenyanga yokukhala ethunyelwe ngamalungu enhlangano yamaphoyisa eqondiswe kwiHhovisi leMaphoyisa. Uma uphakathi kwengozi esheshayo, lowo ohlukunyezayo uzoboshwa. Uma kungekho engcupheni, lowo ohlukunyezayo uzonikezwa isaziso sokuvakasha enkantolo ngosuku olulandelayo. Uma kwenzeka, qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zakho ezisele (nengane) zifakwe zibe ziqinile futhi zigcinwe endaweni ephephile (isibonelo, kwabanye abahlali). Qinisekisa ukuthi uthathe wonke amadokhumenti abalulekile afana nezikhwama, ikhadi lakho leklinikhi, ikhadi lebhange, njll.

Yini ekhuthaza abanikeli ukuba banikele? Ukukhuthaza izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali ukuba zamukele izibopho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakwa okufanele nokugcinwa kwezinga eliphezulu ezinqubweni: ukwenza umsebenzi ngokwethembeka; ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele; ukuhweba ngempumelelo; ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nohulumeni, imiphakathi ethintekile, abanikeli, abaxhasi, kanye nomphakathi; ukuphatha ihhovisi lenhlangano ngokucophelela; nokuziphatha ngokuhlonipha. IPhiko Lezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi lisungule umgomo ohambisana nezidingo zeMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti ka-1997, ngokuxoxisana nezinhlangano eziningi kanye namalungu azo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinqubomgomo ziwumphumela wombono ophumelelayo wokuthi yini ebhekwa njengokusebenza kahle ekuholeni nasekuphathekeni kwezinhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali, kungakhathaliseki usayizi wenhlangano. Ukugxila kugxile kakhulu ezicini ezifana nokusebenza ngokulingana, ukugcina izindaba zokuphatha, ukuhweba, nokucabangela umphakathi othintekile. Kulindeleke ukuthi ngalezi ziqondiso, zonke izinhlangano ezibhaliswe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti zamukele lezi ziqondiso, zisebenzisa ukuze zithuthukise futhi zikhuthaze lesi sikhala lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona izindawo ezintathu ezicacile nezihlelwe kahle kulo mthetho wokuziphatha, ezihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwedokhumenti eyodwa. Kucacile ukuthi inhlangano engaphansi kwemali ephumelelayo izuza ezisebenzisaneni phakathi kwabanikeli, abahwebi, kanye nalabo abaphatha izinsiza nezenzo zenhlangano. Umthetho wokuziphatha ubalulekile, kodwa awukhombisi kahle izinga elibekiwe lokuziphatha. Ababhekele izikhundla zenhlangano ezingekho phansi kwemali banemithwalo yokubheka nokuphatha inhlangano ngendlela efanele futhi ephumelelayo ngenkathi behlonipha imithetho elawulwa umthethosisekelo wenhlangano. Ngokucabangela ukuthi lo mthetho uzosetshenziswa yizinhlangano ezahlukene ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, le dokhumenti ivulekile futhi ibhalwe ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda nokuyisebenzisa. Umphakathi - umuntu owenziwe ukuba aqaphe isimo sezimali zenhlangano nsuku zonke. Lokhu kungaba umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele noma wesikhathi esithile, unikezwa umuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle, noma kwenziwa ngokuzithandela, kuye ngosayizi nobukhulu bezenzo zenhlangano, inani lemali eliqoqiwe, noma leyo ekhishwayo. Umphathi wehhovisi - umuntu onikezwe umsebenzi wokubheka ihhovisi nsuku zonke ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Le ndima ingaba isikhathi esigcwele noma esithile, noma kwenziwe ngokuzithandela, kuye ngosayizi nobukhulu bezenzo zenhlangano. Umphathi - umuntu onikezwe ukuba abe yisikhulu senhlangano ngokuphelele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. Lo muntu uqashwe yibhodi elawulayo ye-NPO futhi ubika kulowo msebenzi ngakho konke okwenzekayo enhlangano nsuku zonke. Umeluleki - izinhlangano eziningi ezingekho phansi kwemali azinazo izinsiza nezimali zokuhola bonke abantu abadingekayo kanye nobuchwepheshe ukuze ziqhube izinhlelo, zenze umsebenzi, futhi ziqoqe imali. Ezinye zalezi zabelo zinganikezwa kubeluleki bangaphandle abaziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngalolo buchwepheshe. Lezi zinqumo zingase zibe ngqo ezicini zalezi zabelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zifushane noma zaphakathi. Abanikeli - umuntu noma isikhungo noma inhlangano enikela ngezinsiza ngokuzithandela izikhathi eziningi, ezingaba yimali, emva kokucela okuningana okwenziwe yinhlangano, ukuze kusekelwe izinhlelo nezindleko zansuku zonke. Umhwebi - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, enhlangano engaphansi kwemali ukuze athole izinsiza noma imali ukuze ahlangabezane nezinhlelo, izenzo ezihlosiwe, nezindleko zokusebenza. Le ndima inganikezwa kumuntu noma kumuntu wangaphandle noma ibhizinisi elizobhekana nokuhweba. Ibhodi elawulayo - iqoqo lamalungu enhlangano engaphansi kwemali akhethwe noma anikezwe ukuba abe abaholi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Ibhodi elawulayo lingabizwa ngokuthi iBhodi, Ibhodi Labaphathi, Ikhansela, noma Ikhansela Lokuphatha. Isitatimende somsebenzi - isitatimende esifushane esichaza inhloso nezinto ezihlosiwe zenhlangano engaphansi kwemali, sichaza isizathu sokuba khona kwenhlangano. Isitatimende somsebenzi kufanele sihlolwe njalo. Umphakathi - umuntu onikezwe igunya lokubamba isikhundla futhi abe namandla okuphatha nokubhekelela ngaphakathi kwenhlangano noma i-NPO. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke ngokukhonza ngenhloso yokuhola inhlangano nokuhola ngokuziphatha kahle noma ngokuphatha; njengomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. I-NPO yamukela izimiso zokuzilawula ezimweni ezibalulekile ezidinga ukucaciswa. Iziqu zikhomba izindinganiso ezisemqoka zenhlangano futhi zisebenza njengemiyalezo eyisisekelo yesitatimende somsebenzi wenhlangano. Lezi zinciphisa imibuzo mayelana nokuthi inhlangano isebenza kanjani ezingeni elihlukene futhi zikhombisa ukuthi izosetshenziswa kanjani esikhathini esizayo. Umphathi wephrojekthi - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, kwi-NPO njengomphathi noma uhlelo olwakhiwe ukuze kufezwe izinhloso. Akuvamile ukuthi le mthwalo unikezwe kumuntu wangaphandle noma ibhizinisi. Umhwebi - umuntu noma isikhungo esisekela i-NPO ngokuqondile, noma izenzo zayo noma imicimbi, kuvame ukukhuthaza abaxhasi noma imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zabaxhasi. Imali noma ezinye izinsiza zinikezwa kwi-NPO ngethemba lokuthi kuzotholwa okuthile emuva. Le mvume iyaziwa ngokuqondile kokukhuthaza. Umuntu ozithandela - umuntu osiza i-NPO ezinhlelweni zayo, ezinhlelweni zehhovisi, noma ekutholeni imali, ngaphandle kokufuna ukukhokhelwa noma ukukhokhelwa. Izindleko ezikhokhwe yile muntu ozithandela ngokuvamile zikhokhelwa yi-NPO, futhi kungenzeka ukuthola izipho ezincane zokubonga. Izigaba ezintathu ezihlukene ziba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika nasemdemokhrasini. Iqembu lokuqala nguHulumeni, lapho wonke umuntu engakhuluma khona ngemibono yabo mayelana nezinto eziphathelene nezepolitiki nokuphathwa kwezempilo komphakathi. Uhulumeni ukhethwa ngama-elections, uletha izidingo zomphakathi, futhi lezi zenzakalo nezidingo zixhaswa ngababhalisile bezimali kanye nezikhungo ezahlukene. Lokhu kukhuthazwa kwengezwa ngosizo oluvela ezweni langaphandle, ngendlela yezikweletu noma uxhaso lwezimali. Iqembu lesibili yisigaba esizimele noma amabhizinisi. Umthelela emphakathini ubonakala lapho izidingo nezifiso zomuntu zifezwa ngokuhlinzekwa kwemikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ngentengo ethile. Impendulo kulolu suku ikhokhelwa ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezenziwa ngokuzithandela, futhi le nsiza ivela emphakathini ivumela amabhizinisi ukuba aqhubeke nokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, ngaleyo ndlela ivumela ukuthi akhiqize inzuzo. Abantu abanokukhubazeka banelungelo lokuthola ukwesekwa okungama-R25,580 nangaphezulu ngenxa yezidingo ezengeziwe ezifana nezitini zokwakha ezisemaphandleni nasezindaweni zokungena endlini, izithiyo, nezindawo zokugeza; imihlahlandlela eholela emnyango ngebhodi lokushaya elingaboni. Lokhu kusekela kutholakala kubantu abafuna ukuthenga indlu noma indawo ehlanganisa nokwesekwa kwemakethe okukhona. Lolu hlobo lokwesekwa lutholakala ngokuhamba phambili. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abahlanganisiwe abavumelekile, abangaba ngabantu noma amaqembu akhiwe ngokomthetho angakha futhi aphathe isakhiwo sokuhlala esihlanganisiwe. Lolu hlobo lokwesekwa luvumela u-R23,100.00 kumuntu ngamunye noma emndenini ophuma ngaphansi kuka-R3,500.00 ngenyanga. Le nhlelo yokubolekwa isebenza ngendlela yokuphula. Le ndlela yokuphula iphethwe ngqo ngumphakathi, futhi uhlelo lokubolekwa lusekela lezo zindlu ezinezinga eliphansi ukuze lusize ekwakheni, ekugcineni, nasekukhuthazeni ukwakhiwa kwabo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala ngaleso sikhathi esithile. Kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezineziphumo ezithengiswa nguhulumeni, unelungelo lokuthola le nsizakalo echazwe. Lezi zindlu zakhiwe ngababambiqhaza abaqashwe nguhulumeni wesifunda noma ohulumeni bendawo kulezi ziqembu ezivumelekile. Esifundazweni saseLimpopo, ukwesekwa okungama-5 okuqhubekayo kuvela kuhlelo lokweseka izindlu zendawo, kuhlukanisa abanikazi bezimali be-Angishana, okuhambisana nemali yokonga yomndeni obolekayo. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abafuna ukwakha izindlu zabo. Le nhlelo ihluke kulena ehambisana nezinye izinhlelo lapho abaqashi bakha izindlu zabantu abaningi, kuyilapho le nhlelo yabantu ivumela abantu ukuba bakhe noma balungise futhi bakhe izindlu zabo. Abantu banikezwa amathuba okwakha izindlu zabo, bese besizwa inhlangano esekelayo, ngokukhokha le nhlangano esekelayo ngokusekelwa. Uhulumeni uveze ukuthi umamukeli kumele akhokhe ukuze afinyelele kuhlelo lokwesekwa. Inhloso yale nto iwukuthi umamukeli naye abe nengxenye ekuxazululeni inkinga yezidingo zezindlu, ukukhuthaza isiko lokonga, nokuthi umamukeli akwazi ukuqonda le nsizakalo evumelekile kusukela ngomhlaka-1 kuMbasa 2002, abamukeli kulindeleke ukuthi babe nengxenye futhi. Abadala, abakhubazekile, kanye nalabo abanesimo sempilo esingesihle kodwa abahola ngaphansi kuka-R3,500 ngenyanga. Lokhu kusekela kuhlelwe kulabo abanamalungelo endawo abawasebenzisayo kodwa bengawatholi. Le ndawo ayikathathi hlangothi ngaphansi kokulawula kukahulumeni ngaphansi komthetho wezihlonipho. Lokhu kusekela kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngezinye zezinhlelo lapho kukhona abaxhasi noma izinhlangano ezisizayo. Umamukeli unenketho yokukhetha ukuthi ukwesekwa kuzokwenza kube nezithakazelo. Uma kukhulunywa ngokuqashwa kwemali, noma ekwakheni indlu noma inhlanganisela yombili. Phambilini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezimnyama ezifana neSoweto, eMamelodi, nakwezinye, uhulumeni wangaphambili wakha izindlu zokuhlala. Abahlali ababeqashwe kulezi zindlu ngaphambi kukaMashi 15, 1991, bangafaka isicelo sokuthola isaphulelo ekuthengeni lezi zindlu kuze kube ngu-R7,500.00. Ngokuvamile lezi zindlu zinikezwa mahhala ngenxa yesaphulelo esingu-R7,500.00 esedlula inani langempela lendlu. Izinga langaphambilini lokwesekwa elingu-R579.00 lingasetshenziswa ezingeni eliphansi lobuchwepheshe bokwakha. Imali esele engu-R12,521.00 ingasetshenziswa ekwakheni okuphezulu, bese okungena ngaphansi kwemitha eyisikwele engama-30 (30m) yendawo ephelele yendlu. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu kumele bakhokhe kuqala imali engu-R2,479.00. Uhlelo lwezindlu ezizimele, uhlelo lokukhipha amanzi, kanye nohlelo lokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kuyizidingo ezibalulekile. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu zabantu kumele bafake imali yabo. Abalingani bethu ohlelweni lokwakha izindlu nokuqhuba umsebenzi? Uhlelo lokususa ezindlini luhloselwe ukuba lube yindlela yokulungisa izimo ezifanele zalezi zindlu, le nhlelo yenziwa ngokubambisana nezinkampani zebhange nohulumeni ukuze kuhlanganyelwe ekusebenziseni uhlelo lokwakha ukuze kulungiswe izimo ezifanele zezindlu. Isidingo solwazi nemininingwane mayelana nezindlu ezidingekayo ngentengo efanele. I-Servcon izoqhubeka nokuhlinzeka i-Thubelisha Homes ngemininingwane ejulile mayelana nezindlu ezihambile esivumelwaneni esifanele. Le mininingwane izosetshenziswa yi-Thubelisha Homes ukuze iqhathanise futhi ihlaziye isimo sendawo nokuthi kukhona yini amakhono akhona uma kubhekwa inani, imvelo, kanye nekhadi lezindlu ezidingekayo. I-NURHA inegunya lokuhlola ukutholakala kwemali kulezi zindawo ezihluphekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zabantu abahola kancane. Futhi ibhekelele uhlelo lokonga imali yokwakha izindlu. Ukwakha nokuthuthukisa amakhono ezakhiwo zezindlu. Ukukhuthaza nokusabalalisa kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwelizwe, ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa noma ukuhlanganisa bonke ababambiqhaza ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene zenhlangano, ukuze babelane ngolwazi namakhono futhi basebenze ngokubambisana. I-NHBRF inegunya lokumela amalungu ohlelo lokwakha izindlu ngokuhlinzeka ngesiqinisekiso sokuvikela izakhiwo eziphukile ezindlini ezintsha, nokuvikela abanikazi bezindlu, abaqashi, labo abavumelekile ngezidingo, kanye nezibopho lapho kungase kube nezinkinga, ukuze kulungiswe ngaphansi kwalesi simiso. Izwe elakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile sezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle.

URobertson Colleens unikeza incazelo ebanzi futhi yobuciko ohlwini lwezenzo ezihambelana nesigaba somlando wesizwe. Umlandvo wesizwe uwuhlu lwezindaba zansuku zonke namasiko amakhulu, izici zomphakathi, imibala, nezinkolo. Wakhiwa ngesikhathi nasemcabangweni, okungase kufake umqondo owodwa, uhlobo oluhlukile olungakaze luphindwe, futhi, oluyinselele ukukopishwa, izakhiwo, izindawo zokukhulekela, izindawo zokwakha, nezinto zomlando. Kodwa ngaphezu kwezakhiwo, ngaphezu kwezinto, sithola ulwazi oluhlelwe noma olungahlelwanga lokuphila, imizwa, ukuhamba kwenhliziyo, imibala, iphunga, nezwi endleleni. Uhlelo lwezinkolelo, ukudla, izixazululo, nezindlela; indlela abantu abahloniphana ngayo, bathandana ngayo, bazonda ngayo, bashadile, futhi bageza. Yimakethe zabo nezimpahla zemakethe zabo. Imali nokuthi bayithola kanjani, bayibala kanjani, futhi bayisebenzisela ini. Indlela abantu abagqoka ngayo, baqhuba, baphuza, badansa, bafa, bahlupheka, babonga, futhi baphinde bangenise empini ngayo. Yizinkunkuma zabo ezitaladini, izithandazo zabo ezindaweni zokukhulekela, nezinkanyezi zabo ezindaweni zokudlala. Yimidlalo, abadlali, nezinkundla zemidlalo. Indlela izingane ezifunda ngayo ukufunda nokubhala. Yizikhali, amathuluzi, izindwangu, amadoli, izindawo zokungena, umculo, amathuluzi, imask, amabhokisi, amabhola, amakhofi, amabhodlela, izikhali, izimpahla zokwazisa, ukudla, amaposta, amahloni, ukukhetha, amakhanda, nezindlela zokuhweba. Yizihlahla, amatshe, izindlela, amaqhuqhuva, ubuciko bezindlu, izindlu zomlando, nokuhlola izinto zakudala. Yimvelo nomqondo wabahlali besikhathi, umuzwa wabo wesikhala, kanye nendaba yabo yemvelo.
Sicela ubike zonke izifo ezibulalayo ezithinta abesifazane ezweni lakho. Xhumana nekliniki, isibhedlela, noma inhlangano eseduze nawe esigxile empilweni yabesifazane. Emhlabeni jikelele, cishe abesifazane abangu-600,000 bafa ngenxa yezizathu ezihlobene nokukhulelwa unyaka nonyaka. Iphesenti elingu-99% (99%) yalezi zifo zenzeka ezweni elithuthukayo noma elingathuthukanga. Ukufa kwabafazi abakhulelwe kuyindaba edabukisayo ngoba iningi layo lingavikeleka. Izimo abesifazane abakhulelwe ababenezona ngaphambi kokukhulelwa, ikakhulukazi izifo zenhliziyo, zingaholela ezinkingeni. Wonke umfazi okhulelwe angahlangabezana nezinkinga ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma sokubeletha. Nokho, izimo namathuba ahluka. Abesifazane abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-34 kufanele baqale ukubonisana nomthandazi noma udokotela ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Labo abaphethe iminyaka yokubeletha kufanele bacabangele ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela noma ukwenza abalingani babo (oyise) bazise. Abesifazane abakhulelwe izikhathi ezinhlanu noma ngaphezulu kufanele bahlale bebona umthandazi noma udokotela ukuze benze ukuhlolwa okujulile ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Abesifazane abanezinhliziyo eziphukile kufanele babonane nochwepheshe bezinhliziyo mayelana nesimo sabo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Omama abathinteka kakhulu yizifo zenhliziyo bakhuthazwa ukuba bacabangele izindlela zokuvikela. Omama abakhulelwe abake benza izinqubo kufanele bahlale bebeletha esibhedlela esingahlinzeka ngempilo yokuhlinzwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi sosuku, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemorning noma kusebusuku. Abesifazane abakhulelwe abahlangabezana nezinhlungu ezinzima, ukuvuza, ubuhlungu obuqhubekayo besisu, ukuphefumula okunganele, noma ukuhamba okukhukhumezayo kufanele babike ngokushesha emkliniki noma esibhedlela esiseduze. Hlela ukukhulelwa kwakho uma kungenzeka, futhi kufanele ubhekelwe umuntu onolwazi nolufundisiwe ekubeletheni. Vakashela eklinikini yendawo noma kudokotela uma uphuthuma isikhathi sakho kabili ukuze uhlole. Iya eklinikini noma kudokotela uma ungafuni ukuqhubeka nokukhulelwa futhi ufune usizo. Hlale usebenzisa ikhondomu ngesikhathi sokwenza uthando uma ungafuni ukukhulelwa noma uma usukhulelwe. Sekela umuntu okhulelwe ekhaya ngenkathi ekhulelwe, ngesikhathi sokubeletha, noma ngemuva kokubeletha. Khuthaza ukuvakashela eklinikini yokuhlolwa kwabakhulelwe (ukunakekelwa kwangaphambi kokukhulelwa) futhi uhlela imisebenzi ukuze umuntu okhulelwe akwazi ukuhamba. Sekela ikliniki yakho yendawo ukuze ihlinzeke ngosizo olusezingeni eliphezulu.

Ingabe ifomu lokuvuma mayelana nomndeni lamukelwe futhi lasayinwa / Lamukelwe kodwa lasayinwa ngumfakeli noma Laphikiswa? Le mvume iyefaneleka kumphenduli oyedwa emndenini okhethiwe. Uma uneminyaka engu-18 kuya kwengu-49, sikukhetha ngaphandle kwemigomo phakathi kwamalungu omndeni abuye abe nethuba elifanayo lokukhethwa, futhi sikumema ukuba ubambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Uma uneminyaka engu-50 noma ngaphezulu, sithanda ukukumema wena nabanye abantu emndenini wakho abahlangene nawe ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Ukhethiwe ukuba ube yingxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga, yingakho sithanda ukuxoxa nawe. Le mininingwane elandelayo izochaza inhloso yocwaningo, lokho ozobuzwa khona, kanye nobuhlungu nezinsiza ongazilindela. Kuzochazeka futhi ukuthi awudingi ukujoyina lolu cwaningo. Kufanele ubuze imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi ufuna ukujoyina, noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi phakathi nenqubo yokubuza. I-Human Sciences Research Council ifuna ukuxoxa nawe njengengxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngababonisi abaqeqeshiwe [njengami] ababuya kwi-Human Sciences Research Council. Lolu cwaningo lukhona okwamanje ezweni lonke nasemazweni ambalwa. Unemukelekile ukukhuluma nomfakeli [mna], umcwaningi ophambili, noma noma ubani ofuna ukukhuluma naye ngalolu cwaningo uma unquma ukuthi uzobamba iqhaza noma cha. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama omphenduli... Umfakeli [mna] uzokunikeza ulwazi oluthile oluhambisana nalolu cwaningo - olungase luhlanganise nezinye izincazelo, amagama, noma imibono ongase ungayiqondi. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, uzizwe ukhululekile ukuveza imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi sizokunikeza ithuba lokuphendula. Uma uvuma ukuba ube yingxenye yalolu cwaningo, ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqondwe kangcono izinkinga ezibalulekile ezithinta impilo emphakathini wakho nasemhlabeni - ikakhulukazi impilo nokuphila kahle kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka uhulumeni ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphila nezokuxhasa. Lolu cwaningo ngeke lunikeze izinzuzo eziqondile kuwe. Ukujoyina kwakho kulolu cwaningo kuzohlanganisa ukuphendula imibuzo ngawe, kuhlanganise nempilo yakho nokuphila kahle, isimo sakho sokuxhumana, isimo sakho somnotho nomphakathi, kanye nokusebenzisa kwakho izinsiza zempilo. Sizokwenza kuphela ukuqoqa ulwazi oludingekayo kulolu cwaningo. Le ngxenye ye-questionnaire izothatha cishe imizuzu engu-90. kanye nemibuzo ehambisana nomndeni wakho, umlando wakho wokusebenza, isimo sakho somnotho, impilo yakho kanye nokufinyelela kwakho kwezokwelapha, kanye nemibono yakho ngempilo yakho kanye nesimo sakho sempilo. Siphinde sikumeme ukuba ubambe iqhaza ekuhloleni ukuphefumula kwakho, ukubona, amandla, ukuhamba, kanye nezinkumbulo. Sizokala ingcindezi yegazi lakho, ukuphakama, isisindo, kanye nesilinganiso somgogodla wakho nezinqe. Enye ifomu yokuvuma izosetshenziselwa ukukumema ukuba unikeze isampula encane yegazi, lapho sifinyelela kule ngxenye yocwaningo. Ezinye zezimibuzo ozobuzwa ngazo zingahambisana ngqo nawe futhi zingadala ukungakhululeki noma ukungakhululeki. Ungacela ukubona imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi uzobamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo noma cha. Ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luyimfihlo futhi luyimfihlo futhi ngeke lukhululwe kumuntu. Luzosetshenziswa kuphela ezinhlelweni zokucwaninga nasekucwangcweni. Igama lakho, ikheli, kanye nezinye imininingwane yakho yomuntu zizokhishwa ku-questionnaire, futhi kuzosebenza kuphela amakhodi ukuze kuhlanganiswe igama lakho nezimpendulo zakho ngaphandle kokukhombisa ubunikazi bakho. Iqembu Locwaningo lingase likuthinte futhi uma kudingeka ukuze kuqedwe ulwazi locwaningo noma ukuqoqa ulwazi olwengeziwe esikhathini esizayo. Uma kudingeka lokhu, kuzokwenzeka ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ezilandelayo. Lolu cwaningo luzoqhubeka isikhathi eside, futhi sizobuyela kule ndawo cishe ezinyangeni ezimbili. Sizozama ukuthinta lo mndeni futhi, futhi sithanda ukukhuluma nawe futhi. Le mininingwane iwukwazisa kuphela futhi ayidingi imvume yakho. Ukusayina le mvume kukhombisa ukuthi uqonda ukuthi kuzolindelwa kuwe futhi uyavuma ukujoyina lolu cwaningo. Awudingi ukujoyina lolu cwaningo uma ungafuni. Unesikhathi sokuhoxa kulolu cwaningo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uzizwe ukhululekile ukuveza imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uma ufuna ukuveza imibuzo kamuva, ungathintana nanoma ubani kulabo abalandelayo: uProfesa Nancy Phaswana-Mafuya (Ucingo: 021-4667914), uProfesa Karl Peltzer (Ucingo: 012-3022000), noma uMargie Schneider (Ucingo: 012-3022000) be-Human Sciences Research Council. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama omphenduli... Ngifunde ulwazi olukhona kule fomu yokuvuma, noma lufundwe kimi. Nginethuba lokubuza imibuzo, futhi noma yimiphi imibuzo engiyibuzile iphendulwe kahle. Ngiyavuma ngokuzithandela ukuba ngibe umphenduli kulolu cwaningo futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi nginela ilungelo lokuhoxa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kulolu cwaningo. Kubaphenduli abangafundile: Kumele kusayinwe ngumfakeli ongakwazi ukufunda nokubhala (uma kudingeka, le ndoda kumele ikhethwe ukuba ibe umphenduli futhi ingaxhunyiwe neqembu locwaningo). Umfakeli kumele abeke "X" ebhokisini elingezansi. Ngibone ngempela ukuthi ifomu yokuvuma ifundwe ngokucophelela kumphenduli ongase abe khona, futhi banikezwe ithuba lokubuza imibuzo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi le ndoda inikeze imvume yayo ngokuzithandela. Ngifunde noma ngibone ngempela ukuthi ifomu yokuvuma ifundwe ngokucophelela kumphenduli ongase abe khona, futhi banikezwe ithuba lokubuza imibuzo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi le ndoda inikeze imvume yayo ngokuzithandela. Umfakeli: Usuku: / ... /... Siyacela imvume yakho eyengeziwe kanye ne-authorization yokuthatha isampula yegazi kuwe. Sizothatha inani elincane legazi elivela engalweni yakho. Isampula yakho yegazi izogcinwa elabhorethri, futhi olunye ulwazi ngalokhu lunikezwa ngezansi. Njengengxenye yalolu cwaningo, sifuna ukuhlola noma yiziphi izimpawu ongase ube nazo zokungabi ne-gazi, isifo sikashukela, isifo senhliziyo, nezinye izifo ezinzima. Ubulungiswa bezomthetho bokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya buqondiswa uMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwasekhaya futhi busebenza nasekukhulumeni okukhona phakathi kwabantu abahlala ndawonye. Omunye onengane futhi. Noma iyiphi enye indlela yokucindezela noma yokuhlukunyezwa engase ibangele umonakalo empilweni yakho, ukuphila, noma inhlalakahle. Vula icala lobugebengu emaphoyiseni futhi ufake isicelo sokuvikelwa. Lokhu kuyisiyalo esikhishwe yinkantolo ngesicelo sakho sokucindezela umuntu othile onobudlelwano obuseduze nawe, ukuba ayeke ukuhlukunyezwa futhi avimbele lowo muntu ukuthola usizo kwabanye ukuze enze lo msebenzi wokuhlukunyezwa. Isiyalo sokuvikelwa esikhashana singakhishwa phakathi nosuku noma ebusuku ukuze sikuvikele engozini. Uzokwaziswa ngamalungelo akho nezinyathelo ongazithatha. Sizogcina ikhophi yesiyalo sokuvikelwa futhi sigcine amarekhodi azo zonke izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwasekhaya ezizokwenzeka kamuva. Sizobhala ukukhala kwakho kwi-Register yeZigameko esiteshini njengengxenye yobufakazi bokuthi ubike le ndaba - lokhu kuzoba ubufakazi obengeziwe ukusiza thina lapho sibika ngentuthuko yecala. Sizophanda ekhaya lakho, sithathe noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezikhali ezingase zibe khona kumuntu ophazamisa ukuphila kwakho. Sizokwenze lokhu uma kutholakala ukuthi umqondo noma ukuziphatha komhlukunyezwa, umqondo wokuhlukumeza, utshwala, noma imithi kungaholela emonakalweni komunye umuntu. Futhi sicebisa umuntu ohlukunyezwayo. Futhi ngezikhathi lapho le nsizakalo echazwe itholakala. Sizokuqinisekisa ukuthi insizakalo yokusiza iqoqe futhi ibhalise bonke ubufakazi bokuphila obuzoba yingxenye yokweseka noma yisiphi isimo sobugebengu esingase sibe khona. Sizokuhambisana uma uhamba ekhaya ukuze uthathe izinto zakho, uma isiyalo sokuvikelwa esikhishwe sikhombisa lokhu. Uma amaphoyisa engawalandeli la msebenzi, bika le ndaba kumphathi wesiteshi samaphoyisa. Sizothumela imibiko yenyanga yokukhala ethunyelwe ngamalungu enhlangano yamaphoyisa eqondiswe kwiHhovisi Elikhulu Lamaphoyisa. Uma uphakathi kwengozi esheshayo, umhlukunyezwa uzoboshwa. Uma kungelona peligro, umhlukunyezwa uzonikezwa isaziso sokuthi kufanele avele enkantolo ngosuku olulandelayo. Uma kwenzeka, qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zakho (nengane) ziphakanyiswe futhi zigcinwe endaweni ephephile (isibonelo, kubakhelwane). Qinisekisa ukuthi uthathe wonke amadokhumenti abalulekile afana nokukhombisa, ikhadi leklinikhi, ikhadi lebhange, njll.

Yini ekhuthaza abanikeli ukuba banikele? Ukukhuthaza izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kokwenza imali ukuba zamukele izibopho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakwa okufanele nokugcinwa kwamazinga aphezulu ezinqubweni: ukwenza umsebenzi ngenhlonipho; ukusebenzisa izinsiza ngendlela efanele; ukuhweba kahle; ukugcina ubudlelwano obuhle nohulumeni, imiphakathi ethintekayo, abanikeli, abaxhasi, kanye nomphakathi; ukuphatha ihhovisi lenhlangano ngokuzikhandla; nokuziphatha ngenhlonipho. Iphondo Lezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi lisebenze umthetho ohambisana nezidingo zeMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti ka-1997, ngokuxoxisana nezinhlangano eziningi kanye namalungu azo lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinqubomgomo ziwumphumela wombono ophumelelayo wokuthi yini ebhekwa njengokwenza kahle ekuphatheni nasekuphatheni izinhlangano ezingekho phansi kokwenza imali, kungakhathaliseki usayizi wenhlangano. Ukugxila kugxile kakhulu ezicini ezifana nokusebenza ngokufanele, ukugcina izindaba zokuphatha, ukuhweba, nokucabangela umphakathi othintekayo. Kukholelwa ukuthi ngalezi ziqondiso, zonke izinhlangano ezibhaliswe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokusebenza Kwezinhlangano Ezingenzi Profiti zizokwamukela lezi ziqondiso, zisebenzisa lokhu ukuze zithuthukise futhi zikhuthaze umkhakha lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Kunemikhakha emithathu ecacile neqhondile kule mthetho yokuziphatha, ehlanganiswe ngaphansi kwedokhumenti eyodwa. Kubonakala ukuthi inhlangano engaphansi kokwenza imali ephumelelayo izuza ezisebenzisanayo phakathi kwabantu abanikela, abahlinzeki bezimali, nalabo abaphatha izinsiza nezisebenzi zenhlangano. Umthetho wokuziphatha ubalulekile, kodwa awukhiphi kahle izindinganiso ezibekiwe zokuziphatha. Ababhekele i-ofisi yezenhlangano ezingekho phansi kokwenza imali banemithwalo yokubheka nokuphatha inhlangano ngendlela efanele futhi esebenzayo ngenkathi behlonipha imithetho ephethwe umthethosisekelo wenhlangano. Njengoba le mthetho izosetshenziswa yizinhlangano ezahlukene ngaphansi kwezimo ezahlukene, le dokhumenti ivulekile futhi ibhalwe ngendlela elula ukuyiqonda nokuyisebenzisa. Umphakathi - umuntu ophethe ukulandelela isimo sezezimali senhlangano nsuku zonke. Lokhu kungaba umsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele noma wesikhathi esithile, unikezwa umuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle, noma kwenziwa ngokuzithandela, kuye ngusuku nosayizi nezinga lezinsiza zenhlangano, inani lemali eliqoqiwe, noma lokho okukhokhiwe. Umphathi we-ofisi - umuntu ophethe ukuhlela i-ofisi nsuku zonke ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Le ndima ingaba isikhathi esigcwele noma esithile, noma kwenziwa ngokuzithandela, kuye ngusuku nosayizi nezinga lezinsiza zenhlangano. Umphathi - umuntu ophethe ukuba umphathi wenhlangano ngokuphelele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. Lo muntu uqashwa yinkampani ephethe ye-NPO futhi ubika kule nkampani konke okwenzekayo enhlangano nsuku zonke. Umeluleki - izinhlangano eziningi ezingekho phansi kokwenza imali azinazo izinsiza nezimali zokuhola bonke abantu abadingekayo kanye nobuchwepheshe bokuphatha izinhlelo, ukwenza umsebenzi, nokuhweba. Ezinye zalezi zinto zinganikezwa kubacebisi bangaphandle abaziwa ngokuhlinzeka ngalobo buchwepheshe. Lezi zinqumo zingase zihlobane ngqo nalezi zinto, kungakhathaliseki uma zifushane noma zisezingeni eliphakathi. Abanikeli - umuntu noma isikhungo noma inhlangano ethanda ukunikela ngezinsiza kaningi, okungaba kwezimali, ngemuva kokucela okukhulunywe yinhla, ukuze kusekelwe izinhlelo nezindleko zansuku zonke. Umhlinzeki wezinsiza - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, enhlangano engaphansi kokwenza imali ukuze athole izinsiza noma imali ukuze ahlangabezane nezinhlelo, imisebenzi ehleliwe, nezindleko zokusebenza. Le ndima inganikezwa kubantu noma kumuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle elizophatha ukuhweba. Umzimba ophathelekile - iqoqo lamalungu enhlangano engaphansi kokwenza imali akhethwe noma aqokwe ukuba abe ngabaholi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano. Umzimba ophathelekile ungabizwa ngokuthi iBhodi, iBhodi Labaphathi, iSishayamthetho, noma iKomidi Lokuphatha. Isitatimende somsebenzi - isitatimende esifushane esichaza inhloso nezinto ezihlosiwe zenhlangano engaphansi kokwenza imali, sichaza isizathu sokuba khona kwenhlangano. Isitatimende somsebenzi kufanele sihlolwe njalo. Umphathi we-ofisi - umuntu ogunyaziwe ukuba abambe isikhundla futhi abe namandla okuphatha nokubhekela ngaphakathi kwenhlangano noma i-NPO. Lokhu kungase kwenzeke ngokusebenza ngenhloso yokuhola inhlangano nokuphatha ngendlela efanele noma nje ukuphatha; njengomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela. I-NPO yamukela izimiso zokuzilawula ezimweni ezibalulekile ezidinga ukucaciswa. Izinqumo zikhomba ezindabeni ezibalulekile zenhlangano futhi zisebenza njengokubhalwa okuyisisekelo kwesitatimende somsebenzi wenhlangano. Lezi zimiso ziphendula imibuzo mayelana nokuthi inhlangano isebenza kanjani ezingeni elihlukene futhi zikhombisa ukuthi izosetshenziswa kanjani esikhathini esizayo. Umphathi wehlelo - umuntu osebenza isikhathi esigcwele, isikhathi esithile, noma njengomuntu ozithandela, kwi-NPO njengomphathi noma uhlelo olwakhiwe ukuze kufezwe izinhloso. Akuvamile ukuthi le mithwalo inikezwe kumuntu noma ibhizinisi langaphandle. Umhlinzeki wezinsiza - umuntu noma isikhungo esisekela i-NPO ngokuqondile, noma imisebenzi yayo noma imicimbi, kuvame ukukhuthaza abaxhasi noma imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zabaxhasi. Izimali noma ezinye izinsiza zinikezwa kwi-NPO ngenhloso yokuthola okuthile empeleni. Le miphumela ibonakala ngokukhuthaza okwenziwe ngenhloso. Umuntu ozithandela - umuntu osiza i-NPO emisebenzini yayo, ezinhlelweni ze-ofisi, noma ekuhwebeni, ngaphandle kokufuna ukukhokhelwa noma ukukhokhwa. Izindleko ezibangelwa yilowo muntu ozithandela zivame ukukhokhelwa yi-NPO, futhi kungenzeka ukuthola izipho ezincane zokubonga. Izigaba ezintathu ezihlukene zinefuthe elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika nasemdemokhrasini. Iqembu lokuqala nguhulumeni, lapho wonke umuntu angaveza imibono yabo mayelana nezombusazwe nokuphathwa kwezempilo komphakathi. Uhulumeni ukhethwa ngokuqhuba ukhetho, kuletha izidingo zomphakathi, futhi lezi zenzakalo nezidingo zixhaswa ngababhalisile ngabanye kanye nezikhungo ezahlukene. Lezi zixhaso zengezwa ngosizo oluvela kwamanye amazwe, ngendlela yokubolekwa kwemali noma uxhaso lwezimali. Iqembu lesibili nguhlelo lwabantu abathengisa noma amabhizinisi. Umthelela emphakathini uyabonakala uma izidingo nezifiso zomuntu zihlangatshezwa ngokuhlinzekwa kwemikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ngentengo ethile. Impendulo kulezi zimo ukukhokha ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo okwenziwa ngenhloso, futhi le nsiza ivela emphakathini ivumela amabhizinisi ukuthi aqhubeke ahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, ngaleyo ndlela evumela ukuthi akhiqize inzuzo.
