Abantu abanezikhalazo bangathola ukwesekwa kwe-R25,580 nangaphezulu ngenxa yezidingo ezengeziwe ezifana nezitini zokwakha engadini nasemgwaqweni oya emnyango wendlu, izithiyo, nezindawo zokugeza; imigudu eya emnyango kanye nebhokisi lesignali labantu abaphefumula. Lokhu kusekela kutholakala kubantu abafuna ukuthenga indlu noma ipulazi exhunywe nokwesekwa kwemakethe okukhona. Le ndlela yokusekela itholakala ngokokuqala, okokuqala. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abahlanganisiwe izakhiwo ezikhethwe, ezingaba kubantu noma amaqembu akhiwe ngokomthetho angakha futhi aphathe isakhiwo esihlanganisiwe sokuhlala. Le ndlela yokusekela ivumela i-R23,100.00 kumuntu ngamunye noma emndenini ophuma ngaphansi kwe-R3,500.00 ngenyanga. Le nkqubo yokubolekwa isebenza ngendlela yokuphuka. Le ndlela yokuphuka iphethwe ngqo umphakathi, futhi le nkqubo yokubolekwa isekela lezo zihlobo ezineholo eliphansi ukuze zikusize ekwakheni, ukonga, nokukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwazo nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala ngaleso sikhathi esithile. Kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinezindawo ezithengwe nguhulumeni, ungathola le nkxaso echazwe. Lezi yizindlu ezakhiwe ngababambiqhaza abaqashwe nguhulumeni wesifunda noma uhulumeni bendawo kulezi ziqephu ezihambisana nokwesekwa. Esifundazweni saseLimpopo, ukwesekwa okukhona okuhlelwe kuvela kuhlu lwezinhlelo zokwesekwa kwezindlu, kuhlukanisa abanikazi bezimali be-Angishana, okuhambisana nezinsiza zokonga zomndeni obolekayo. Lokhu kusekela kunikezwa kulabo abafuna ukwakha izindlu zabo. Le nkqubo ihluke kulena ehambisana nezinye izinhlelo lapho abaqashi bekha izindlu zabantu abaningi, kuyilapho le nkqubo yabantu ivumela abantu ukuba bakhe noma balungiselele futhi bakhe izindlu zabo. Abantu banikezwa amathuba okwakha izindlu zabo, bese besizwa ngohlangothi olusekela, ngokukhokha kulolu hlangothi olusekela ngokuya ngamandla okusekela. Uhulumeni uthe umnqobi kufanele akhokhe ukuze afinyelele kwi-program yokweseka. Inhloso yale nto iwukuthi umnqobi aphinde abe nesandla ekuxazululeni inkinga yezidingo zezindlu, ukukhuthaza isiko lokonga, nokuthi umnqobi akwazi ukuqonda le nkxaso evumelekile kusukela ngomhla ka-1 kuNdasa 2002, umnqobi kulindeleke ukuthi abambe iqhaza futhi. Abadala, abanezikhalazo, kanye nalabo abahluphekayo kodwa abaneholo elingaphansi kwe-R3,500 ngenyanga. Lokhu kusekela kuhlelwe kulabo abanezimvume zendawo abazisebenzisayo kodwa abangazitholi. Le ndawo ayikakabhalwa ngaphansi kokulawula kukahulumeni ngaphansi komthetho wezikhulu zendabuko. Lokhu kusekela kungafezwa kuphela ngezinye zezinhlelo lapho kukhona abaxhasi noma izinhlangano ezisiza. Umnqobi unenketho yokukhetha ukuthi ukwesekwa kuzoba nomthelela. Uma kukhuluma ngempumelelo yokubolekwa, noma ekwakheni indlu noma ukuhlanganisa kokubili. Phambilini, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezimnyama ezifana neSoweto, eMamelodi, nakwezinye, uhulumeni wangaphambilini wakha izindlu zokuhlala. Abahlali ababeqashwe kulezi zindlu ngaphambi kosuku lukaMashi 15, 1991, bangafaka isicelo sokwehliswa kwentengo yokuthenga lezi zindlu zibe ku-R7,500.00. Njengoba isikhathi sihamba, lezi zindlu zivame ukunikezwa mahhala ngenxa yokwehliswa kwentengo kwe-R7,500.00 okudlula inani langempela lendlu. Izinga langaphambilini lokwesekwa le-R579.00 lingasetshenziswa ezingeni eliphansi lobuchwepheshe bokwakha. Imali esele ye-R12,521.00 ingasetshenziswa ekwakheni okuphakeme, bese okungena ngaphansi kwemitha eziyi-30 (30m) yendawo yokuhlala. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu kumele kuqala bakhokhe imali engu-R2,479.00. Uhlelo lwezindlu ezizimele, uhlelo lokukhipha amanzi, kanye nohlelo lokuhlinzeka ngamanzi kuyizidingo ezibalulekile. Labo abafuna ukwesekwa kokwakha izindlu zabantu kumele bafake izimali zabo. Ozakwethu ohlelweni lokwakhiwa kwezindlu nokuqhubeka kwenziwa? Uhlelo lokususa ezindlini luya kuba isu lokulungisa izimo ezifanele zalezi zindlu, le nkqubo yenziwa ngokubambisana nezinkampani zebhange nohulumeni ukuze kuhlanganyelwe ekusebenziseni uhlelo lokwakha ukuze kulungiswe izimo ezifanele zezindlu. Isidingo solwazi nemininingwane mayelana nezindlu ezidingekayo ngaphezu kwenani elijwayelekile. I-Servcon izoqhubeka nokuhlinzeka i-Thubelisha Homes ngemininingwane ejulile mayelana nezindlu ezihambile esivumelwaneni esijwayelekile. Le mininingwane izosetshenziswa yi-Thubelisha Homes ukuze iqhathanise futhi ihlaziye isimo sendawo nokuthi kukhona yini amakhono akhona uma kucatshangwa inani, indawo, kanye nekhadi lezindlu ezidingekayo. I-NURHA igunyaziwe ukuba ihlole ukutholakala kwemali kulezi zindawo ezihluphekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukwakhiwa kwezindlu zabantu abaneholo eliphansi. Futhi ibheke uhlelo lokonga imali yokwakhiwa kwezindlu. Ukwakha nokuthuthukisa amakhono ezakhiwo zezindlu. Ukukhuthaza nokusabalalisa kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwelizwe, ubudlelwano ngokuhlanganisa noma ukuhlanganisa bonke ababambiqhaza ngezindlela ezahlukene zokuhlanganyela, ukuze babelane ngolwazi namakhono futhi basebenze ngokubambisana. I-NHBRF igunyaziwe ukumelwa kwamalungu ohlelo lokwakhiwa kwezindlu ngokuhlinzeka ngesiqinisekiso sokuvikela izakhiwo eziphukile ezindlini ezintsha, nokuvikela abanikazi bezindlu, abaqashi, labo abakhethwe ngezidingo, kanye nezibopho lapho kungase kube nezinkinga, ukuze kulungiswe ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Izwe elakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo esiqinile sezindawo zokuhlala ezinhle.

URobertson Colleens unikeza incazelo ebanzi nephakathi kwezobuciko ohlwini lwezenzo ezihlobene ezisemqoka ezihlanganiswa nesiko lesizwe. Isiko lesizwe iyiqoqo lolwazi lwansuku zonke namasiko amakhulu, izici zomphakathi, imibala, nezinkolo. Yakhiwa ngesikhathi nasemcabangweni, okungase kufake isikhathi esisodwa, uhlobo oluhlukile olungakaze luphindwe, futhi, olunzima ukukopisha, izakhiwo, izindawo zokukhulekela, izindawo zokwakha, izinto zomlando. Kodwa ngaphezu kwezakhiwo, ngaphezu kwezinto, sithola ulwazi oluhlelwe noma olungahlelwanga lwezimpilo, imizwa, ukuvuka kwenhliziyo, imibala, amakhambi, nezwi endleleni. Iyiqoqo lezimiso, ukudla, izixazululo, nezindlela zokuziphatha; indlela abantu ababingelelana ngayo, bathandana ngayo, bazonda ngayo, bashadile ngayo, futhi babhujiswa ngayo. Iziphuzo zabo nezimpahla zemakethe yabo. Imali nendlela abayitholayo, bayibala, futhi bayisebenzisa. Indlela abantu abagqoka ngayo, bahamba ngayo, baphuza ngayo, badansa ngayo, bafa ngayo, bahlupheka ngayo, babonga ngayo, futhi ngisho bangenela impi ngayo. Iphunga labo emigwaqweni, izithandazo zabo ezindlini zokukhulekela, nezinkanyezi zabo ezindaweni zokudlala. Imidlalo, abadlali, nezinkundla zezemidlalo. Indlela izingane ezifunda ukuyifunda nokubhala. Izikhali, amathuluzi, amafabrics, amadoli, izindawo zokungena, umculo, amathuluzi, imaski, amabhokisi, amabhidi, imithwalo, izimbiza, izikhali, ama-charm anenhlanhla, ukudla, amaposta, ama-veil, ukukhetha, amakhanda, nezindlela zokuhweba. Imithi, amatshe, izindlela, izintaba, ubuciko bezindlu, izindlu zomlando, kanye nocwaningo lwezinto zakudala. Iyiwo umhlaba nomqondo wabahlali besikhathi, umuzwa wabo wesikhala, kanye nendaba yabo yemvelo.
Sicela ubike zonke izifo zokukhulelwa ezibulalayo ezenzeka endaweni yakho. Xhumana neklinikhi, isibhedlela, noma inhlangano eseduze ehlinzeka ngempilo yabesifazane esifundazweni sakho. Emhlabeni jikelele, cishe abesifazane abangu-600,000 bafa ngenxa yezizathu ezihlobene nokukhulelwa unyaka nonyaka. Iphesenti elingu-99% (99%) yalezi zifo zenzeka ezweni elithuthukayo noma elingakathuthukiswa. Ukufa kwabafazi abakhulelwe kuyindaba edabukisayo ngoba iningi layo lingavikeleka. Izimo umama okhulelwe azibhekene nazo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa, ikakhulukazi isifo senhliziyo, zingaholela ezinkingeni. Umama okhulelwe angabhekana nezinkinga ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa noma sokubeletha. Nokho, izimo namathuba ahluka. Abesifazane abaneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-34 kufanele baqale ukubonisana nomthandazi noma udokotela ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Labo abaqedile ukukhulisa izingane kufanele bacabangele ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela noma ukwenza abalingani babo (obaba) bazise. Abesifazane abakhulelwe izikhathi eziyisihlanu noma ngaphezulu kufanele bahlale bebona umthandazi noma udokotela ukuze bahlolwe kahle ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Abesifazane abanesifo senhliziyo kufanele baphendule udokotela wezifo zenhliziyo mayelana nesimo sabo ngaphambi kokukhulelwa. Omama abathinteka kakhulu yisifo senhliziyo bencike ekucabangeni izindlela zokuvikela. Omama abakhulelwe abake benza ukuhlinzwa kufanele bahlale bebeletha esibhedlela esingahlinzeka ngempilo yokuhlinzwa ngaso sonke isikhathi sosuku, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusemva kwemini noma ebusuku. Abesifazane abakhulelwe abahlangabezana nezinhlungu ezinzima, ukuvuza, ubuhlungu obuqhubekayo besisu, ukuphefumula okuphuthumayo, noma ukukhishwa okukhukhumezayo kufanele babike ngokushesha esikhungweni esiseduze noma esibhedlela. Hlela ukukhulelwa kwakho uma kungenzeka, futhi kufanele uphathwe umuntu onolwazi nolufundisiwe ekubeletheni. Vakashela iklinikhi yendawo noma udokotela uma uphumelele izinsuku zakho ezimbili ukuze uhlolwe. Iya ekilinikhi noma kudokotela uma ungafuni ukuqhubeka nokukhulelwa futhi ufune usizo. Hlale usebenzisa ikhondomu ngesikhathi sokwenza uthando uma ungafuni ukukhulelwa noma uma usukhulelwe. Sekela umuntu okhulelwe ekhaya ngenkathi ekhulelwe, ngesikhathi sokubeletha, noma ngemuva kokubeletha. Khuthaza ukuvakashela iklinikhi yokuhlinzeka ngaphambi kokukhulelwa (ukunakekelwa kwangaphambi kokukhulelwa) futhi uhlela imisebenzi ukuze umuntu okhulelwe akwazi ukuhamba. Sekela iklinikhi yendawo yakho ukuze inikeze usizo oluphakeme.
lebhokisi elingezansi. Ngibone ngempela ukuthi ifomu lokuvuma lifundwe ngokucophelela kumphenduli ongase abe khona, futhi banikezwa ithuba lokubuza imibuzo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lo muntu unikeze imvume yakhe ngokuzithandela. Ngifunde noma ngibone ngempela ukuthi ifomu lokuvuma lifundwe ngokucophelela kumphenduli ongase abe khona, futhi banikezwa ithuba lokubuza imibuzo. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lo muntu unikeze imvume yakhe ngokuzithandela. Umxhumanisi: Usuku: / ... /... Q0453. Ingabe ifomu lokuvuma mayelana nomndeni lamukelwe futhi lasayinwa / Lamukelwe kodwa lasayinwa ngumfakazi noma Laphikiswa? Le mvume iyimvume yokuphendula eyodwa emndenini okhethiwe. Uma uneminyaka engu-18 kuya kwengu-49, sikukhetha ngaphandle kwemigomo phakathi kwamalungu omndeni abuye abe nethuba elilinganayo lokukhethwa, futhi sikumema ukuba ubambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Uma uneminyaka engu-50 noma ngaphezulu, sifuna ukukumema wena nabanye abantu emndenini wakho abaxhumene nawe ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Ukhethwe ukuba ube yingxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga, yingakho sifuna ukukhuluma nawe. Le mininingwane elandelayo izochaza inhloso yocwaningo, lokho okuzokwenziwa, kanye nokuzwela nezins benefits ongazilindela. Kuzochaza futhi ukuthi awubopheleki ukuba ubambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Kufanele ubuze imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi ufuna ukubamba iqhaza, noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi phakathi nenqubo yokubuza. I-Human Sciences Research Council ifuna ukukhuluma nawe njengengxenye yalolu cwaningo mayelana nempilo nokuguga. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngababonisi abangochwepheshe [njengami] abaphinde babuyela kwi-Human Sciences Research Council. Lolu cwaningo lukhona njengamanje ezweni lonke nasemazweni ambalwa. Uyamukelwa ukukhuluma nomxhumanisi [mimi], umcwaningi ophambili, noma noma ubani ofuna ukukhuluma naye ngalolu cwaningo lapho unquma ukuthi ubambe iqhaza noma cha. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama abaphenduli... Umxhumanisi [mimi] uzokunikeza ulwazi oluthile oluhambisana nalolu cwaningo - okungase kufake ezinye amagama, imisho, noma imibono ongayiqondi. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, uzizwe ukhululekile ukuvula imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi sizokunikeza ithuba lokuphendula. Uma uvuma ukubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo, ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqondwe kangcono izindaba ezibalulekile eziphathelene nempilo emphakathini nasemhlabeni - ikakhulukazi impilo nokuphila kahle kwabantu abadala. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka uhulumeni ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo zokuphila kahle nezokuxhaswa. Lolu cwaningo ngeke lunikeze izinzuzo ezinqala kuwe. Ukubamba iqhaza kwakho kulolu cwaningo kuzohilela ukuphendula imibuzo ngawe, kuhlanganise nempilo yakho nokuphila kahle, isimo sakho sokuxhumana, isimo sakho sezomnotho nomphakathi, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zempilo. Sizokwenza kuphela ukuqoqa ulwazi oludingekayo kulolu cwaningo. Le ngxenye ye-questionnaire izothatha cishe imizuzu engu-90. kanye nemibuzo ephathelene nomndeni wakho, umlando wakho wokusebenza, isimo sakho sezomnotho, impilo yakho kanye nokufinyelela kwakho kwezempilo, kanye nemibono yakho mayelana nokuphila kahle kwakho kanye nesimo sakho sempilo. Siphinde sikumeme ukuba ubambe iqhaza ekuhloleni ukuphefumula kwakho, ukubona, amandla, ukuhamba, kanye nezinkumbulo. Sizokala ingcindezi yegazi lakho, ukuphakama, isisindo, kanye ne-circumference ye-waist ne-hips zakho. Enye ifomu lokuvuma izosetshenziselwa ukukumema ukuba uhlinzeke ngesampula encane yegazi, lapho sifinyelela kulolu hlobo locwaningo. Ezinye zezimibuzo ozobuzwa zingase zibe ngqo ngawe futhi zingadala ukudideka noma ukungakhululeki. Ungacela ukubona imibuzo ngaphambi kokuthi unqume ukuthi uzobamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo noma cha. Ulwazi oluhlinzekayo luyimfihlo futhi luyimfihlo futhi ngeke lukhululwe kumuntu. Luzosetshenziswa kuphela ngocwaningo nasekucwangcweni. Igama lakho, ikheli, neminye imininingwane yakho siqu izosuswa ku-questionnaire, futhi kuzosebenza kuphela amakhodi ukuze kuhlanganiswe igama lakho nezimpendulo zakho ngaphandle kokukhombisa ubunikazi bakho. Iqembu locwaningo lingase likuthinte futhi uma kudingeka ukuze kuqedwe ulwazi locwaningo noma ukuqoqa olunye ulwazi esikhathini esizayo. Uma kudingeka lokhu, kuzokwenzeka ezinsukwini ezingu-14 ezilandelayo. Lolu cwaningo luzoqhubeka isikhathi eside, futhi sizobuyela kule ndawo cishe ezinyangeni ezimbili ezizayo. Sizozama ukuthinta lo mndeni futhi, futhi sifuna ukukhuluma nawe futhi. Le mininingwane iyokwakha futhi ayidingi imvume yakho. Ukusayina le mvume kukhombisa ukuthi uqonda ukuthi kuzolindelwa kuwe futhi ukulungele ukubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Awubopheleki ukubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo uma ungafuni ukwenza kanjalo. Unesikhala sokuhoxa kulolu cwaningo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uzizwe ukhululekile ukuvula imibuzo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Uma ufuna ukuvula imibuzo kamuva, ungathintana nanoma ngubani kulokhu okulandelayo: uProfesa Nancy Phaswana-Mafuya (Ucingo: 021-4667914), uProfesa Karl Peltzer (Ucingo: 012-3022000), noma uMargie Schneider (Ucingo: 012-3022000) bevela kwi-Human Sciences Research Council. Izincwadi zokuqala zamagama abaphenduli... Ngifunde ulwazi olukhona kule fomula yokuvuma, noma ifundwe kimi. Ngibe nethuba lokubuza imibuzo, futhi noma yimiphi imibuzo engiyibuzile iphendulwe ngokwanelisayo. Ngivuma ngokuzithandela ukubamba iqhaza njengomphenduli kulolu cwaningo futhi ngiyakuqonda ukuthi nginela ilungelo lokuhoxa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kulolu cwaningo. Imvelo yamanje ukuthi kune-28. Ngemva kokuhlangana kweMasingana ngo-2002, uMnyango weZobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi neTekhnoloji wakhuthazwa ukuba wethule isu leSizwe lokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa. Le nqubomgomo izoba yisihluthulelo ekukhuleni komnotho futhi ixhase ezinye izinqubomgomo ezifana neNqubomgomo Yokuthuthukiswa Kwabantu, iNqubomgomo Yezimboni Ezisebenzayo, kanye neNqubomgomo Yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika. Ukwehla okubonakalayo kokutshalwa kwezimali kwezobuchwepheshe (isibonelo; ukugxila kakhulu ekuvikeleni nasekw independence kwezidingo zamandla) okwakuvamile kuhulumeni odlule phakathi kuka-1990 no-1994. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kokuxhaswa kwehlelo lokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa kwazulu kusuka ku-1.1% ngo-1990 kuya ku-0.7% ngo-1994. Lokhu kwehla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uHlelo lweZinqubomgomo Ezintsha Zesizwe lwaludinga ukukhula ukuze lihlangabezane nezidingo zabantu abangu-40 million uma kuqhathaniswa nabantu abangu-6.5 million. Ukubhekana nezinkinga zesikhathi eside, ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu, ezomnotho nezokuphepha. Imibono efanele ephathelene nezifo ezintsha nezifo ezindala, noma lezi zifo zithinta abantu noma izilwane, kufanele iphathelwe ngezinhlelo zocwaningo zangakini. Uma sicabangela ukuphepha, ngisho nomthengi onolwazi ngotekhnoloji ekhona engakabi phezulu udinga abacwaningi abaningi abenza ucwaningo ezindaweni ezifanele. Izindaba zomsebenzi nabantu. Umkhakha wethu wabacwaningi nezobuchwepheshe awuphucukile kahle noma ngokwanele. Iningi labacwaningi abamhlophe, abesilisa, nabadala abahambeli phambili nabantu abasha ngendlela ebonisa isithombe esifanele sokuhlanganiswa kwabantu bezwe. Iziphakamiso ezilula zithonywa kakhulu yizinguquko ekubambisaneni kwamazwe omhlaba eziholela ekwehleni kwezinga lokutshalwa kwezimali nasemsebenzini wezimboni ezizimele zokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokulawula ngaphakathi kwesisekelo solwazi esibalulekile empumelelweni yezinkampani zethu ezincintisanayo. Imithetho efanele ephethe impahla yengqondo nezinsiza. Ukuthuthukiswa okusha kwezobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha kukhulise ingozi yokuhlukunyezwa kocwaningo emkhakheni wezokwelapha, kuyilapho izinqubomgomo zokucwaninga ezisekelwa uhulumeni zingavikelwe futhi zingaphathwa kahle. Izakhiwo zokwahlulela ezihlukanisiwe. Nakuba izikhungo zocwaningo zibuyekezwe futhi izinkomba eziyisisekelo zisetshenziswe, indima yezigaba ezithile zokwahlulela nokubeka izindinganiso ezilindelekile ezikhungweni zocwaningo zikahulumeni ayikacaci. Uma sibheka ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali, awekho umbono obanzi wokuchitha kukahulumeni kwezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe. Ukwakha uhlelo oluqinile lwezocwaningo nezobuchwepheshe lukahulumeni. Iphuzu lezi zinhlelo ezintsha liqukethe ukusungulwa nokutshalwa kwezimali ezinhlelweni ezahlukene zobuchwepheshe ezibalulekile ekukhuthazeni ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nasemphakathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amapulatifomu amabili abalulekile ezobuchwepheshe esikhathini samanje, ahlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuthinta imithi nolwazi. Enye inisiative yokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokukhiqiza nobuchwepheshe obwenza izinguquko ezinsizakalweni ezisuselwa emithonjeni noma ezisemvelweni. Ekugcineni, sizokwakha inisiative, ubuchwepheshe bokunciphisa ubuphofu obuzobhekana nezinselelo esihlangabezana nazo njengamanje. Le nqubomgomo izophathwa yisikhungo esisha esaziwa ngokuthi iSikhungo Seziqinisekiso Zobuchwepheshe Ezintsha (FTI) esizosebenza njengendawo yokutshalwa kwezimali egxile kulwazi, le ndawo izogxila kakhulu ezinhlelweni ezintsha ngaphakathi kwazo zonke izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe. I-FTI izotshala imali ezinhlelweni ezintsha kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi nasemkhakheni wezizimele kanye nasezikhathini ezahlukene kusukela ekwakhiweni kwesu kuya ekwethulweni komkhiqizo emphakathini ngenkathi igxila kakhulu esigabeni sokuthuthukiswa kwesu esinezimali eziphezulu nokwamukelwa komkhiqizo emphakathini uma uthengiswa, ulethelwa, noma usatshalaliswa. Indlela esihamba ngayo yokuthuthukisa abantu ibekwe ngakolunye uhlangothi ngokudinga ukwanda okusheshayo kwenani labantu abakhululekile ezithombeni ezedlule, abesifazane abangena emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe ukuze bahlale kuwo, kuyilapho ngakolunye uhlangothi sihlose ukwakha isu lokuhlangabezana nezinselelo zokuhweba nokubambisana nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba. Ukuqonda okujulile komphakathi mayelana Nezinhlelo Zesayensi kungaba yimpumelelo ekwandiseni lezi zibalo kuphela uma intsha ingabona amathuba akhangayo futhi ajabulisayo emisebenzini elindelekile. Ngeminyaka yama-1970 kanye nama-1980, lezi zikhala zomsebenzi zaziningi ngenxa yezinselelo zendawo ezikhona ngaleso sikhathi - nakuba zazihloselwe kakhulu uhlangothi oluthile lomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, iphuzu labantu libalulekile kakhulu ukuba lihlangene nephuzu lobuchwepheshe. Emhlabeni jikelele, indlela yokukhiqiza abacwaningi abaphezulu abakwazi ukudlulela kwezinye izigaba ibandakanya ukugxila okuqinile emandleni okusebenza kahle emsebenzini. Enye indlela ephezulu ezingeni lesizwe iwukugxila kakhulu ezidingweni zezinga eliphansi lesayensi ezindaweni lapho sinesikhala esihle sokuphumelela ngenxa yokuba khona kwemithombo yemvelo nolwazi olukhona. E-Ningizimu Afrika, lezi zindawo zihlanganisa ulwazi lwezulu nolwazi lwezemvelo. Isikhungo esihamba phambili uma kukhulunywa ngalesi sikhathi, esikhuthaza isayensi, yiNational Research Organization esebenza ngokubambisana nomkhakha wezokufunda ophakeme ngeNational Higher Education Program. Nakuba umsebenzi kahulumeni wangaphakathi waphinde wahlelwa ngo-1994, izibopho ezinamandla zeNational New Strategies Program zaphazamiseka. Ukuqonda indima yezigaba ezithile ezibekwe emisebenzini efana neMnyango Wezolimo Nezempilo okukhombisa izinhlelo ezithile emikhakheni ethile kanye neMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe (DACST) kufanele idlale indima ethile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezilindelekile emhlabeni jikelele mayelana nokutshalwa kwezimali kwezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe zilandelwa, ikakhulukazi imisebenzi yokucwaninga ethuthukisiwe (ukukhiqiza ulwazi), izinqubomgomo ezintsha (amabhizinisi amasha, imikhiqizo, nemisebenzi) kanye nokwakhiwa kwamabhizinisi. Indima ye-DACST izoba ukuhlela uhlelo oluhlangene lokubheka umnikelo wezokusebenza zezimboni ezibanjwe nguhulumeni futhi ibe nesibopho esiqondile ezikhungweni ezinhlanu ezigxile, ezifana neNational Research Center, iScience Promotion Center (eyayaziwa njengeFEST), iCenter for New Technological Strategies, iCouncil for Scientific Research and Industry, kanye neCouncil for Human Science. Izigaba ezihlobene zizoba nezibopho zokuhlonza izikali nezabelomali zezikhungo eziphansi kwazo. Ucwaningo lwesig

Bangase baphathe izimo ezihlobene nalolu Mthetho mayelana nemvume, igunya, ukwamukela, noma amalungelo anikezwe igunya lokulawula, futhi leyo mfuneko ingaqedwa noma ihlaziywe. IFinancial Markets Advisory Council esunguliwe ngengxenye 3 yeMthetho Wokuhweba Ezimakethe Zezimali ka-1989 (Umthetho No. 55 ka-1989) isasebenza nakuba lo Mthetho uhlehlisiwe ngengxenye 117. Abanye amalungu, kuhlanganise nezimeya zemboni, amakhasimende anikezwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokubonisana neBhodi. Igunya lokulawula liyilungu lebhodi yokweluleka ngenxa yesikhundla sawo kodwa alikwazi ukuvota ngezindaba ezidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngeluleko lebhodi yokweluleka. Ilungu lebhodi yokweluleka lihlala esikhundleni isikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngesikhathi sokunikezwa kwalo. Izindleko zemali ezisetshenziswe yilungu ekwenzeni imisebenzi enikezwe lona. Umholi weBhodi yokweluleka kumele abize umhlangano wokuqala weBhodi yokweluleka ngemuva kokuqala kwalolu Mthetho, kulandela lokho, iBhodi yokweluleka izohlangana ngesikhathi nendawo ethile ethunyelwe yiBhodi yokweluleka. Umholi ubiza umhlangano olandelayo ngemuva kwalowo odlule uma inani elidingekayo lamalungu ebhodi lingaphumelelanga ukuhlangana. Inani elidingekayo lamalungu ukuze umhlangano uqhubeke kuzoba inani lamalungu eBhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi yokweluleka ingathatha kumself noma iceliwe nguNgqongqoshe noma igunya lokulawula ukuba ihlole futhi ilethe umbiko noma iseluleko ngezindaba zokuphathwa noma ubuchwepheshe ngabantu abasebenza embonini noma mayelana nokwethulwa kwamathuluzi okuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Singacela usizo kumuntu noma sihlole izindaba eziphathelene nabantu abasebenza kule mboni noma imisebenzi yokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Igunya lokulawula lingathumela kuBhodi noma yiluphi ulwazi oluhambelana nendaba ethathwa yibhodi yokweluleka. Igunya lokulawula linomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha umsebenzi ohambelana kakhulu nemisebenzi yeBhodi yokweluleka kanye nekomidi elincane leBhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi kumele ikhokhe izindleko ezihlobene nemisebenzi yeBhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi yokweluleka kumele ithole ukuvunywa kweBhodi ngaphambi kokuthi ikhokhe lezo zindleko. Imithetho yeKomidi Yocwaningo ka-1947 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1947) ephathelene nokusungulwa kwekomidi, ukuhlolwa kwabantu, nokwenza imisebenzi yokuthatha izifungo, ukukhipha imibhalo, amarekhodi, nezinto ezithile kanye nokwephula umthetho okwenziwa ngabafakazeli abahlanganyela nezinguquko ezidingekayo ocwaningweni olwenziwa yiBhodi yokweluleka noma ikomidi
Kufanele ugweme izenzo ezingaphazamisa isithombe noma igama lemakethe. Sebenzisa ulimi olufanele futhi ugweme ukusebenzisa izinsolo. Kufanele ugweme ukusebenzisa amagama abantu abanye ngaphandle kwemvume yabo. Gwema zonke izinhlobo zokucwasa. Gwema zonke izinhlobo zokukhwabanisa futhi ugweme ukuhlukumeza ngokocansi, impi, nokuhlukumeza ngokwengqondo. Khuthaza ubumbano futhi ugweme ukusabalalisa ukungezwani. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezidingekayo zithathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabanye. Gwema ukuzithokozisa, ukuphatha, noma ukuhlukumeza izidakamizwa ezithokozisayo. Khuthaza indawo ehlelekile yokusebenza. Gxila emsebenzini wakho. Hlonipha isikhathi sokusebenza uma wenza imisebenzi yakho. Landela iziteshi ezifanele uma uphakamisa izikhalazo. Ziphatha ngendlela ethuthukisa noma ikhulisa isithombe/sigama esihle emakethe. Khuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende/izivakashi ngokuba nobungane, ukuthobeka, nokusiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezithengiswa kumakhasimende zisezingeni eliphezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezithengiwe zifinyelelwa ngesikhathi. Phendula izikhalazo zamakhasimende ngokushesha futhi wamukele impendulo. Yamukela ukubaluleka kwamakhasimende ngokuvulekile nangokwethembeka. Qinisekisa ukuthi intengo yezinto zakho ilungile futhi iyamukeleka. Khuthaza ukuphathwa okufanayo kwabo bonke osomabhizinisi. Ukuze kube nokwaziswa, ubambisene nebhodi ngendlela engcono kakhulu oyikwazi. Hlonipha izibopho zenkontileka yakho. Hlonipha izinqumo zebhodi. Landela umthetho wokuziphatha kanye nenqubo yokuhola izikhalazo ezibekwe yibhodi. Kuzoba nezindlela ezimbili zokuphatha izikhalazo, ezisemthethweni nezingenamthetho/ezingalawulwa. Iphathwa ngamalungu amane osomabhizinisi. Iphatha ukuphulwa okukhulu komthetho wokuziphatha. Iphathwa ngamalungu amahlanu, amathathu awo ebaqhamuka ebhodini kanti amabili abekwa osomabhizinisi. Iphatha ukuphulwa okukhulu kakhulu komthetho wokuziphatha. Iqinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa uphenyo uma kukhona izinsolo zokuphulwa komthetho wokuziphatha. Ikhetha amalungu amabili ukuze aphenyi izinsolo. Iqhuba ukuhlolela izikhalazo. Iyiwona ophakamisa ukuthi izinsolo zokuphulwa komthetho wokuziphatha kufanele zilandele inqubo esemthethweni noma eyingxenye engalawulwa ngumthetho. Noma ubani onenkinga angafaka isikhalazo mayelana nokuphulwa komthetho, futhi kunconywa ukuba kube okubhaliwe. Abantu ababili bazokhethwa ukuze baphenyi ukuphulwa komthetho. Ithimba lokuphenya lizohlanganisa ubufakazi obufanele mayelana nezinsolo. Osomabhizinisi abasolwayo ngokuphula umthetho kufanele banikezwe ithuba lokuphendula kulolo sikhathi. Uma ikomidi lezikhalazo lithola ukuthi kukhona ubufakazi obucacile, lizokhipha izijeziso ezibhekiswe kosomabhizinisi abasolwayo ngokuphula umthetho.
Izinyathelo ezizolandela uma iziphathimandla zezimoto zifaka isandla ezinyathelweni eziphikisana nomncintiswano. Ukuphathwa nokugcina kweMthetho Wamaphothi Kazwelonke kuyresponsibility yeZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke. Ibhodi ibhekisela ebhodini labaphathi beMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke osunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 6. Iziphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke zibhekisela kumphakathi wamaphothi eNingizimu Afrika. "Abasebenzisi bamaphothi" babhekisela kulabo abaqondile abasebenzisa iphothi (abanikazi bezikebhe), nalabo abangasebenzisi iphothi ngqo (abangenisi bezimpahla ezivela phesheya nabaqhamukeli bezimpahla kwezinye izizwe), kanye nabaphakathi ezisebenzelaneni zamaphothi (ababambisene) nabasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphothi (abakhiqizi nabasebenzisi). Abasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphothi bangabantu abakhokha ngezinsizakalo zamaphothi. Ngakho-ke abakhiqizi nabasebenzisi bezwe bangabantu bokugcina bamaphothi. "Amaphothi" abhekisela kumaphothi ezohwebo akhishwe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wamaphothi Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Kuzokwakhiwa isikhungo esisemthethweni esizophathwa yiMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke, esizoba nebhodi, umkomishana, nabasebenzi. Ukuvikela ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele kwamandla nokwenza kube nokuqinisekiswa kokuthi amaphothi asetshenziswa ngendlela efanele ngokulandela izimo zokusebenzisa amaphothi. Ukuhlola nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele, uma kudingeka, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iTransnet ayihlanganyeli ezimweni zokuphikisana nomncintiswano ezihlanganyela neZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke nokuthi imali eqoqiwe yiZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke isetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka iziphathimandla, abasebenzisi, futhi ibe nomthelela ezinhlelweni zezezimali nezokuxhumana zomphakathi. Ukuhlela iZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke ekwenzeni imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Ukuqondisa izinyathelo ezifanele ezizolandela uma kukhona okukhuluma ngokuziphatha okuphikisana nomncintiswano. Silawula futhi sihlola iMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wamaphothi Kazwelonke. Sivikela futhi senze njengendawo yokudlulisa izikhalazo nokunganeliseki okuqondiswe kuZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke. IMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ihlola, ihlaziye, futhi ithatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukusiza ekwenzeni lo mthetho kanye nezinye izinqubomgomo ezihlobene. Sivikela ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele kwamandla futhi siqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanele kumaphothi nokutholakala kwezinsizakalo zamaphothi, sihlola futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele uma kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ayitholi izinzuzo ezingafanele phezu kwezinye izinkampani zokuthutha nokuthi imali eqoqiwe ngamaphothi isetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka nokuthuthukisa isakhiwo sezamaphothi nezisebenzi ukuze kube nomthelela kubasebenzisi bamaphothi. Siqinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuphathwa kweMthetho Wamaphothi Kazwelonke yiZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke. Siqapha futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele uma kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphothi ayatholakala, nokuthi izinsiza zamaphothi ziyatholakala ngaphandle kokucwaswa, ngempumelelo, nangokucacile. Ukwandisa ukuphepha; ukuvikeleka kwezimali, kanye nokusebenza kahle kwamaphothi. Ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kwesikhathi esifanele nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezisetshenziswa kumaphothi ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo nezilindelo zabasebenzisi bamaphothi, ukuqinisekisa ukuhlela kahle kwezohwebo phakathi kwalabo abenza ezamaphothi nalabo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kumaphothi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke zinikeza usizo olufanele futhi zilandela izindinganiso zamazwe omhlaba ezamukelekayo, ukuxhumana nezinsizakalo zikamasipala nezinye izithakazelo ezibalulekile emkhakheni wamaphothi, nokuhlanganisa nokugcina ulwazi mayelana nemisebenzi yeZiphathimandla Zamaphothi Kazwelonke. Sisebenzisa noma yiziphi amandla, sihlangabezana nanoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe kithi ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho, noma ezibekwe kithi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano somhlaba. IMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke izoba namalungu angaphansi kuka-5 nangaphezulu kuka-13 abekwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze bisebenze isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu, futhi la malungu angaphinde abekwa kabusha. Kumele babe nolwazi olwaneleyo lwezomthetho, lobuchwepheshe, lwezohwebo, lwezimali, lokuthuthukiswa, nolunye ulwazi olufanele oluhambelana nomkhakha wezokuthutha kwezilwandle. Kumele bakhethwe noma bathathe indawo yabanye ngendlela ekhuthaza intuthuko nokwakhiwa kwamakhono. UNgqongqoshe angabeka isikhundla eMnyangweni Wezokuthutha ukuba kube nguMongameli weMphakathi Wamaphothi Ozimele. Uma ilungu leBhodi yeMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ngaphandle kwaleli lungu elibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3 ngezizathu ezithile lishiya ukuba ilungu, uNgqongqoshe angabeka noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ukuze agcwalise le ndawo esele. Ilungu leBhodi yeMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke lingathola umholo ngenxa yokusebenza kwalo, ngemiholo ethathwa nguNgqongqoshe ngezikhathi ezithile. Ilungu elinokuphikisana nezithakazelo noma elingase libe nokuphikisana nezithakazelo ezingase zifake engcupheni isikhundla sawo njengelungu kumele lidlulise izithakazelo zawo kuBhodi yeMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke. Bonke amalungu kumele baveze izithakazelo zabo kuBhodi yeMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zikhona ezomuntu, ezobuchwepheshe, noma ezihlobene nezohwebo, futhi baziwe uMongameli nganoma yiziphi izinguquko. Noma yisiphi isiphulwa senkohlakalo esibekwe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho singase singahlangabezani nezidingo ezibekwe esigabeni 6. Bangakhokhelwa umholo futhi bangakhokhela abasebenzi imiholo, izinzuzo, nezinye izinzuzo ezamukelwe nguNgqongqoshe. Umkomishana kumele aqaphe zonke izinkulumo zokukhala nezikhalazo ezilethwa phambi kweMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke. Kumele abhale futhi athumele umbiko wonyaka mayelana nokusebenza kweMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke. IMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke ingabamba imihlangano uma kudingeka ukuze iqhube imisebenzi yayo. Uma ithola isicelo esibhaliwe esivela kumalungu amane, uMongameli angabiza umhlangano ozobanjwa phakathi kwesonto kusukela ngosuku alutholayo lesicelo. Izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe emihlanganweni kumele zisetshenziswe. Inani lamalungu okumele abe khona emhlanganweni weMphakathi Wamaphothi Kazwelonke kumele kube iningi lamalungu. Izinhlelo ziyaqhutshwa ukuze kusungulwe iNational Ports Authority; kanye nezindaba ezihlobene nalokho. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukwandiswa kobudlelwano emhlabeni jikelele, kanye nokwenza kube nokuqinisekisa ukulondolozwa, ukuphathwa, nokusebenza kwezikhumulo zezikebhe njengoba zikhona. I-buoy ibizwa njengomthombo osebenzela ukusiza lapho umkhumbi uhamba emanzini ukuze uxwayise umkhumbi ngezingozi emanzini noma i-radio buoy esiza umkhumbi uma uhamba olwandle. I-"buoy" ibhekisela kumshini omncane ophumile emanzini, ohlangene emaphethelweni omfula, obonisa noma oxwayisa izikebhe ngezingozi, izikebhe ezidliwe, noma ezinye izithiyo. "Umthwalo okulindelwe," ubhekisela kumthwalo okulindelwe ongcarrywa izikhumulo zezikebhe zaseNingizimu Afrika. Abasebenzisi bezikhumulo zifaka phakathi abasebenzisi abaqondile (abanikazi bezikebhe), abasebenzisi abangaqondile (abangenisi bezimpahla zangaphandle kanye nabathumeli bezimpahla zendawo), abasebenzisi abangekho emkhakheni wezohwebo (abathumeli), kanye nabasebenzisi bokugcina bezohwebo (abakhiqizi nabathengi). Usizo ekunyakazeni kwezikebhe lubhekisela kunoma iyiphi indlela esetshenziselwa ukulawula noma ukuhlela ukuhamba kwezikebhe ukuze kuvikelwe imvelo. a Ukuhlukanisa imisebenzi yokusebenza njengomnikazi wendawo b Ukukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babambe iqhaza, ukuze bagqugquzele abaphathi nabasebenzi c Ukulungiselela ukudluliswa kwamakhono nobuchwepheshe, ulwazi, nokuphathwa ngokubambisana nokuhlanganisa umkhakha ozimele ongaphansi kukahulumeni. a I-National Ports Authority iphethwe ngokuhambisana nePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zalesi sikhumbuzo, uNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokusungula futhi abhalise iNational Ports Authority njengenkampani yomphakathi engathengisa amasheya noma izitokwe futhi ikhishwe isitifiketi sokwakhiwa, ngokuhambisana neCompanies Act kanye nePFMA. Ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhuluma esigabeni 2 seCompanies Act okungahambisani nalokhu, kuzosebenza kule National Ports Authority. UNgqongqoshe njengomnikazi, ngokusekelwe eziphakamiso ezenziwe yiNational Ports Authority angase athumele izeluleko kuNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuthi akhombise ukuthi ezinye izinhlinzeko noma izingxenye zeCompanies Act azisebenzi kule National Ports Authority. Isicelo esikhuluma esigabeni 1 kumele sibe nokwesekwa okuphelele nolwazi oluhambelana nalokhu kwesicelo kumele kudalulwe nguSekela seNkampani, kanye nalokho, ngokushicilela isaziso kwi-gazette kahulumeni. Kulesi saziso, uSekela seNkampani kufanele abize abantu ukuba bathumele iziphakamiso zabo nezikhalazo kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kulesi saziso ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichazwe kulesi saziso. Unyaka wezezimali weNational Ports Authority uzohamba kusukela ku-1 kuMbasa kuya ku-31 kuNdasa wonyaka olandelayo, kokubili izinsuku zifakiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma nganoma iyiphi umthetho, iNational Ports Authority ngeke ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu ophathwe yinkantolo noma ngaphansi kwenqubo yokuhlanza inkampani engakhokhi izikweletu, ngaphandle kokugunyazwa nguMthetho othile wePhalamende. m ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, ukwethembeka, kanye nezindleko zabelungu, ngokuhambisana nezinga elamukelekayo emhlabeni jikelele nezidingo zomphakathi. I-National Ports Authority kufanele yenze konke okudingekayo ukuze iphathwe kahle nangokuphumelelayo, ihlele futhi ilawule izikhumulo. a ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwezikhumulo ezihweba b ukuqinisekisa ukuqapha kahle kwezikhumulo c ukulungiselela ukwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi d ukunciphisa ukuphindaphinda kwalezi zisebenzi nezinhlelo mayelana nokwenziwa kwalezi zisebenzi. e ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwemisebenzi efanayo. a nesikhathi nenqubo, kuhlanganisa nenqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi nezindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga, mayelana nokusayinwa kwezivumelwano zokubambisana ezikhuluma esigabeni 2. k ukukhuthaza izinyathelo zokuphepha ezikhumulweni. Akukho okukhuluma esigabeni 1 kuzovimba iNational Ports Authority ekwenzeni noma yini edingekayo ukuze iphathwe kahle nangokuphumelelayo, ihlele futhi ilawule izikhumulo. I-National Ports Authority yaseNingizimu Afrika inamandla afana nalawo enkampani njengoba kuxoxwa esigabeni 34 seCompanies Act, ngaphandle kokukhishwa noma ukuncishiswa ngokubhalwe ngalesi sikhumbuzo. e Ukukhokha kokukhishwa kwamalayisense kanye nokudluliswa kokukhokha kwezinsizakalo nezinsiza ezisetshenziselwa izikhumulo ezihlinzekwa yiNational Ports Authority ngokuthanda kwayo ngokuhambisana nokuvunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokuxoxisana noNgqongqoshe Wezezimali f Ukungena ezivumelwaneni zokudluliswa kwemali nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni nomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi bezikhumulo abaqeqeshiwe ukuze banikeze usizo ezikhumulweni futhi basize ukuphatha umthwalo ukuze basungule amazinga okusebenza, ikhwalithi yomsebenzi, futhi bagcizelele ukuhambisana nomthetho. Ngaphezu kokunciphisa amandla akhuluma esigabeni 1, le nkampani izoba namandla okukhokha emithonjeni eminingi ngaphandle kwezintela, ukukhokha okuhlanganisa noma okungahlanganisi kuphela amandla okuphatha ukuhambisana nezivumelwano mayelana nezindlela zokuthola imali ngokubolekwa kuzokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 66 sePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA). I-National Ports Authority izophatha futhi ilawule ngokuhambisana nalesi sikhumbuzo ngophiko lwezikhulu. Izikhulu kufanele, ekusebenziseni amandla azo, zenze ngokuhambisana nezinhloso zenkampani ngokulandela uhlelo lwebhizinisi lwesikhashana kanye nohlelo lwezikhathi ezide oluthunyelwe noluvunywe nguNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi futhi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 52 sePublic Finance Management Act njengoba kuguqulwe nguMthetho No. 29 ka-1999. j ukuvuma ukuqashwa kwabanye abasebenzi abawumsebenzi weNational Ports Authority; kanye kokuqhuba umgomo kaHulumeni mayelana nezohwebo zezikhumulo. Ibhodi lezikhulu lizokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi. UNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi angakhetha amalungu angaphezu kwezingu-7 ngokubiza abantu abavela ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuze benze iziphakamiso. ezohwebo, ezimali, ezomthetho nezomnotho; noma v ulwazi oluthile olungasiza inkampani ekwenzeni umsebenzi wayo 4 Amalungu ebhodi akufanele amele iqembu elithile kodwa kufanele akhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhumulo ukuze kube nenzuzo kubo bonke abasebenzisi bezikhumulo. b ukuhlela imibono nezikhalazo ezitholakele ngenxa yesaziso. h ukuba yilungu lePhalamende laseNingizimu Afrika, noma ube yilungu leZigaba zendawo noma ube yilungu lekhansela lezakhamuzi, okuzobavimbela ekubeni yisikhulu ngaphansi kweCompanies Act No. 61 ka-1973. Umgibeli angabamba isikhundla isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu kusukela ngosuku lokukhethwa kwakhe. Lelo lungu lingabamba isikhundla isikhathi esinqunyiwe nguNgqongqoshe ongumnikazi singadluli eminyakeni emithathu. Izinhlelo ze-apartheid kanye nekoloni zidalile ngokuqondile izimo lapho iningi labantu bezwe lalingekho kuphela emaphethelweni kodwa beliphathwa kabi kakhulu. Lokhu kuholele ekuhlukaniseni lapho isiNgisi nesiBhunu banikezwa isimo esisemthethweni futhi baqhutshwa ngokuqhubekayo kuyilapho izilimi zomdabu zezwe zishiywa zinganakiwe. Uhlelo lwezokuphatha lwezilimi lweGauteng lwenziwe njengomphumela oqondile weNgqungquthela yeMthethosisekelo yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, kanye noHlelo lweZilimi lwezwe (olwamukelwa futhi lwashicilelwa ngoMsombuluko 2003) oluhlinzeka ngamalungelo emthethweni mayelana nokusetshenziswa nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi. Uhlelo lweZilimi lwezwe lufuna zonke izifunda ukuthi ziqhube izinqubomgomo zazo zezilimi ngokuhambisana nalo. Uhlelo lweGauteng lwenziwe ngemva kokuxhumana nabathintekayo abahlukene ezingeni lendawo, lesifunda, kanye nezwe. Lezi zikhungo zifaka phakathi iNational Language Centre yeMnyango wezobuChwepheshe neZamasiko, uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng (GPG), iminyango kanye nokugxilwa okukhulu okuvela kuMnyango wezeMfundo waseGauteng, iSouth African Languages Board, iGauteng Language Committee, izindawo zokuhlala, iLegislative Assembly, kanye nabaphathi bezilimi. Le nqubo yokuxhumana yaphathwa nguMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuhamba, Ubuciko kanye Nezamasiko ngosizo lwabaculi abahlukene emikhakheni yezilimi. Lo mcimbi, ohambisana nokuxhumana okuhlakaniphile (futhi kwesinye isikhathi okukhathazayo kakhulu) phakathi kwabaphathi bezilimi nabaphakanyisi, uveza inselelo ejabulisayo kuhlelo lweZilimi lweGauteng, olufuna ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango ejulile yokuphumeza uhlelo olusebenzayo lwezilimi eziningi. Ubuye bukhulume ngemiphumela ebalulekile yokuhlola uhlelo lwezilimi nezilimi ezamukelwe yiSouth African Languages Board ngo-2001, lapho kuthathwa isampula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 naphezulu abahlolwe kuzo zonke izigaba zomphakathi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Izindawo ezigxilwe kakhulu zifaka phakathi ulimi lwasekhaya nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi emikhakheni eyimfihlo neyomphakathi, izimo zomphakathi nezokufunda, ulimi lomsebenzi kanye nemfundo, izimo ezithathwa kuhlelo lwezilimi, kanye nokukwazi ukushintsha izilimi kanye nezilimi eziningi. Umthethosisekelo ubheka imfundo njengengxenye ebalulekile yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi. Uhlelo lweZilimi lweGauteng luphinde luthathe izinhlinzeko zeSouth African Schools Act ka-1996 mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezikoleni nokuthi uhlelo lweZilimi emfundweni luhambisana kanjani nesimo semfundo. Inhloso yeGauteng Language Policy Framework ukuhlinzeka nokuqinisa izilimi zomdabu eGauteng ezake zashiywa emaphethelweni esikhathini esedlule. Isigaba 29 sithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthola imfundo ezilimini ezisemthethweni abazincomayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi lapho imfundo ingatholakala khona. Umthetho wePANSALB ka-1995 njengoba ushintshiwe, kanye nezinye izinhlinzeko, uhlinzeka ngokuqashelwa, ukusetshenziswa, nokukhuthazwa kwezilimi eziningi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezake zashiywa emaphethelweni. Ubuye ugcizelele ukusungulwa kwamakomidi ezilimi ezifundeni okumele akhuthaze izilimi eziningi ezweni. Uhulumeni wesifunda saseGauteng, ngeMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuhamba, Ubuciko kanye Nezamasiko, usungule iGauteng Language Committee. Nakuba umthetho weSouth African Schools Act (SASA) uhlinzeka ngenqubo yokushintsha ezindaweni ezithile, okwamanje unika uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo nangemva kokuxoxisana neKhansela leMinisters, amandla okwakha izindinganiso zohlelo lwezilimi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Ubuye ucacise ukuthi umzimba ophatha isikole somphakathi ungakhetha uhlelo lwezilimi ngokulandela umthethosisekelo, lo mthetho (SASA), nezinye izinqubomgomo ezifanele zesifunda. Izinhloso zeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi kumele zihlinzeke ngokuqinisekiswa kwesizathu somthethosisekelo sokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguHulumeni, emizimbeni ezimele, noma kubantu ngabanye ngaphansi kwemikhawulo efanele. Ukufinyelela akumele kube nje ukuthola ulwazi ngempela kodwa kufanele futhi, lapho kungenzeka, kube ngolimi olukhethwe ummangali. Njengoba uSheduli 4 weMthethosisekelo uthi, ulimi luwumkhakha osebenzayo wokwakha nokusabalalisa ulwazi ngaphakathi kwesifunda, uHlelo lweZilimi lwezwe lukhuluma ukuthi zonke izikhungo zikaHulumeni (ezingeni lendawo, lesifunda, kanye nezwe) nezinye izikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma ezenza imisebenzi yomphakathi zibophelelekile kulo hlelo. Izifunda kulindeleke ukuthi ziqhube izinhlinzeko zazo zezilimi ezihambisana noHlelo lweZilimi lwezwe ngenkathi zicabangela izimo zesifunda, izidingo, kanye nezintandokazi zomphakathi wazo. Le nqubo izodluliselwa kuhulumeni bendawo abazokwakha izinqubomgomo zabo zezilimi ngokuhambisana noHlelo lwezokuphatha lwezifunda. Uhulumeni uphinde ukhuthazwe, lapho kudingeka, ukweseka umkhankaso ozimele wokuthuthukisa nokuphumeza izinqubomgomo zabo zezilimi ngokuhambisana nalo hlelo. Uhlelo lweZilimi emfundweni luwuhlelo lwezilimi lwezwe olusebenza ngaphakathi kwesimo semfundo. Inhloso eyinhloko ukuhlinzeka ngoxhumano ngokuxhumanisa izigaba, amasiko, izilimi, nezinkolo ngasikhathi sinye kudalwe indawo lapho ukuhlonishwa kwezilimi ezingezona ezomuntu kuhlonishwa. Ukuxhumana kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni kuzokhuthazwa futhi kuhlonishwe. Njengengxenye yezimiso zayo, uHlelo lweZilimi emfundweni lukhuthaza ukuthi bonke abafundi kumele bafundiswe okungenani ulimi olulodwa lwemvelo, wonke umkhakha wezilimi uzonikezwa isikhathi nezinsiza ezilinganayo, futhi iziphathimandla ezifanele ezingeni lesifunda zizothola iziqondiso zezinqubomgomo mayelana nezidingo zokukhuthaza izilimi njengezifundo, ngokuhambisana nemithetho kazwelonke. Umkhakha weHlelo lweZilimi uzobheka iminyango yeGPG, iGauteng Legislature, izindawo zokuhlala ezinakekela ukusetshenziswa kwazo kwezilimi zesifunda kanye nezinketho, kanye nezikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifunda ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma ezenza imisebenzi yomphakathi. Amabhizinisi azimele kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni nazo zizokhuthazwa ukuba ziqhube izinqubomgomo zazo ngokuhambisana nalo hlelo. Lezi zibalo zikhombisa ukuthi isiZulu yisilimi sasekhaya esikhuluma ngaphezu kuka-20% wabantu ezingeni lesifunda nasezwenikazi. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba isiNgisi sisetshenziswa kabanzi njengolimi lwezohwebo nesayensi, sithola indawo yesine nesezithupha
Umthetho we-apartheid nokucindezelwa wadala isimo lapho zonke izilimi ngaphandle kwezimbili zingazange kuphela ziqhutshekwe kodwa futhi zaphathwa ngendlela ephakeme kakhulu. IsiNgisi nesiAfrikaans banikezwa isimo esisemthethweni futhi bathuthukiswa ngendlela ehlelekile, kodwa lokhu kwalimaza izilimi zomdabu zaseNingizimu Afrika. Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ka-1996, unikeza ukusetshenziswa okufanayo kwezilimi ezisemthethweni zonke ezweni futhi uthuthukisa futhi uthuthukisa izilimi ezaziphathwa njengokungafanele. Ngaphezu kwezilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11, umthethosisekelo ubona ezinye izilimi ezifana neNama, Khoi, kanye neSan, kanye nolimi lwezimpawu, okumele futhi kuthuthukiswe. IGauteng iyidolobha elinokuhlanganiswa kwezizwe futhi iyisifundazwe lapho kuphela izilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 zaseNingizimu Afrika (iSepedi, iSesotho, iSetswana, isiSwati, iVenda, iTsonga, isiAfrikaans, isiNgisi, iNdebele, iXhosa, kanye nesiZulu) ezingakhuluma, kodwa iyikhaya lezilimi eziningi. Odiplomate, abokufika, ababaleki, nabantu bezohwebo abavela emhlabeni jikelele abahlala eGauteng benze le ndawo yaba yikhaya lezilimi eziningi zangaphandle. I-Gauteng Language Policy Framework (GLPF), ehloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela ebanzi yokuphumeza uhlelo lokusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi, yasungulwa ngezizathu ezihlobene ngqo nezidingo zomthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-National Language Policy Framework (eyavunywa futhi yethulwa ngoMashi 2003) ethinta amalungelo omthethosisekelo ahlobene nokusetshenziswa nokuthuthukiswa kolimi. I-National Language Policy Framework ifuna ukuthi zonke izifundazwe zisungule imithetho yazo ezidinga ukuhambisana nayo. I-GLPF iyumphumela wezinkulumo ezihlelwe nabathintekayo abahlukene ezingeni lendawo, lesifundazwe, kanye lesizwe. Lezi zinkulumo zifaka iNational Language Institute yeMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, iGauteng Provincial Government (GPG), iminyango enegxile enkulu kwiGauteng Department of Education, iSouth African Languages Board, iGauteng Language Committee, izindawo zokwakha, iGauteng Legislature, kanye nochwepheshe bezilimi abaningana. Le nqubo yokuxoxisana yakhuthazwa yiMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuhamba, Ubuciko, kanye namasiko, osizile ngochwepheshe bezilimi abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Imiphumela yokuqala yocwaningo lwezenhlalo nokusetshenziswa kolimi olwenziwa yiPanSALB ngo-2001 yahlaziywa. Lolu cwaningo lusebenzisa indlela yokuhlanganisa okuhloswe ngayo abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 naphezulu, abathathwe ezigabeni ezahlukene zokuphila, emiphakathini yasemakhaya nasemadolobheni. Izindawo ezigxilwe kuzo zazizilimi zasekhaya nezilimi ezisetshenziswa ezindaweni ezizimele, emphakathini, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, emfundweni, izilimi ezindaweni zokusebenza, kanye nokuqonda umthetho wezilimi, ukusetshenziswa kolimi komuntu siqu, kanye nenani lezilimi ezikhuluma ngabantu. Umthethosisekelo uphinde ubone imfundo njengendawo ebalulekile yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi. I-GLPF iphinde ibheke izidingo ze-South African Schools Act ka-1996 ngokuhlola ukuthi izilimi zisetshenziswa kanjani ezikoleni nokuthi kanjani ulimi kuMthetho Wezemfundo luhambisana nesimo semfundo samanje. Ihloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa kwezilimi okuhle okuthinta ukufaka abantu, kuphendula kahle izidingo zomphakathi; futhi igcizelela futhi ikhuthaza isizwe esikhulayo, ikhulisa ukuzigqaja kwesizwe kanye nokuhlanganyela phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zolimi namasiko eGauteng. Icala lesi-29 lithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthola imfundo ngolimi olusemthethweni alukhethayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi, lapho le mfundo itholakala. I-PanSALB Act ka-1995 iphinde inikeze ukuvunywa, ukukhuthazwa, nokusabalalisa isiko elinokuhlanganiswa kwezilimi eziningi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphathwa njengokungafanele. Iphinde iphakamise ukusungulwa kwezinkomiti zolimi ezingeni lesifundazwe. I-Gauteng Provincial Government, ngeMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuhamba, Ubuciko, kanye namasiko, isungule iGauteng Provincial Language Committee. Nakuba iSouth African Schools Act (SASA) isaqhuba ukuhlolwa, okwamanje inikeza uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, ngemuva kokuxoxisana neBhodi YabaNgqongqoshe, ukuba athathe izinga nezindinganiso zomthetho wezilimi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Iphinde icacise ukuthi ibhodi yokuphatha yesikole somphakathi ingathatha umthetho wayo wezilimi ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, lo Mthetho (SASA), kanye neminye imithetho efanele yesifundazwe. Izinhloso zeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi kufanele ziholele ekuthobeleni umthethosisekelo ovumela ukufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olunikezwe uMbuso, ezikhungweni ezizimele, noma ngabantu, ngokuhambisana nezilinganiso ezithile ezamukelekayo. Lokhu kufinyelela akukhona kuphela mayelana nokuthola ulwazi olufanele kodwa kufanele kube ngolimi olukhethwe umfakisicelo, lapho kusebenza khona. Njengoba uhlu lwe-4 lomthethosisekelo lukhombisa ukuthi ulimi luwumkhakha wokubambisana phakathi kukamasipala kazwelonke kanye nesifundazwe, i-NLPF ibeka ukuthi zonke izikhungo zomphakathi (kazwelonke, zesifundazwe, nezendawo) kanye nezikhungo ezisebenzisayo amandla omphakathi noma imisebenzi zibophelelwe yilolu hlelo. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuhlanganiswa kwezilimi, kulindeleke ukuthi izifundazwe zithuthukise imithetho yazo yezilimi ngokusekelwe ku-NLPF, lapho zizobhekana nezimo zendawo, izidingo, nezintandokazi zomphakathi. Ngemuva kwalokho, ohulumeni bendawo bazothuthukisa imithetho yabo yezilimi ngokuhambisana neProvincial Policy Framework. Uma kudingeka, ohulumeni bendawo bakhuthazwa ukuba basekele umkhakha ozimele ekusunguleni nasekuthuthukiseni umthetho wabo ngendlela ehambisana nale Policy Framework. Ulimi kuMthetho Wezemfundo luwumthetho wezilimi kazwelonke osebenza ngaphakathi komkhakha wemfundo. Inhloso eyinhloko igcizelela ukuxhumana okungaphazamiseki phakathi kwemikhawulo yamasiko, ezilimini, kanye nezinkolo ngasikhathi sinye kudala indawo ehlonipha izilimi ezikhuluma abanye. Indlela yokuxhumana ngomlomo izohlonishwa futhi ikhuthazwe kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Umthetho Wezilimi Zokufunda uthi bonke abafundi kufanele bafundiswe okungenani ulimi olulodwa lomdabu, zonke izigaba zolimi zizothola isikhathi nezinsiza ezilinganayo, futhi iziphathimandla zesifundazwe kufanele ziqinisekise imithetho mayelana nezidingo zokuthuthukisa amazinga ezilimi afanele kanye nezifundo, ngokuhambisana nekurikulum kazwelonke. Umkhakha wePolicy Framework uhlanganisa iminyango ye-GPG, iGauteng Legislature, izindawo zokwakha (ezibhekele ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendawo nezintandokazi), kanye nezikhungo ngaphakathi
Inhloso yalolu cwaningo ukuqoqa imicabango nemibono evela kubalaleli nabasebenzi beMnyango Wezokuvikela (DOD) mayelana nezinguquko, ukwesekwa kokuthula, ukuhlukahluka, amandla, kanye nekhono lokuzilawula kweSikhungo Sezokuvikela SaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF)/DOD kanye nesidingo sokufunda ngesiNgisi. Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo izosisiza ukuhlaziya ukusebenza kahle kwezinguquko ezenzakalayo kuDOD futhi ilandele umthelela wezindlela zokusebenza ezibekwe ngemuva kocwaningo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uphendule ngokuqotho emibuzweni nasezimpahleni ezikwi-questionnaire. Lokhu akusikho ukuhlolwa, ngakho akukho mpendulo efanele noma engafanele. Umbono wakho uwumphendulo ofanele. I-Center for Impact Analysis izogcina ulwazi oluhlinzekiwe luyimfihlo. Uzohlala ungaziwa ngoba i-Center for Impact Analysis izohlaziya ulwazi oluqoqiwe ngokuhlanganyela okuhlobene neqembu ngalinye, isibonelo, abesifazane nabesilisa ngokwehlukana. Imvelo yamanje ukuthi kukhona abangu-28. Ngemuva kokuhlangana kweMasingana ngo-2002, iKabinet yayala uNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe ukuba presents isicwangciso seSizwe sokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa. Le ndlela izoba yisihluthulelo ekukhuleni komnotho futhi isekela ezinye izicwangciso ezifana neStrateji Yokuthuthukiswa Komuntu, iStrateji Yezimboni Ezisebenzayo, kanye neStrateji Yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika. Ukwehla okubonakalayo kokutshalwa kwezimali kwezobuchwepheshe (isibonelo; ukugxila kakhulu ekuvikeleni nasekuzimeleni kwezidingo zamandla) okwakuvamile kuhulumeni ophakathi kuka-1990 no-1994. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kokuxhaswa kohlelo lokucwaninga nokuthuthukiswa kwezizwe kusuka ku-1.1% ngo-1990 kuya ku-0.7% ngo-1994. Lokhu kwehla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uhlelo lweZizwe Zokwakha Ezintsha lwaludinga ukukhula ukuze luhlangabezane nezidingo zabantu abangu-40 million uma kuqhathaniswa nabangu-6.5 million. Ukubhekana nezinkinga zesikhathi eside, ukuthuthukiswa komuntu, ezomnotho nezokuphepha. Izimpendulo ezifanele ezihlobene nezifo ezintsha nezindala, noma lezi zifo zithinta abantu noma izilwane, kufanele ziphathwe ngohlelo lokucwaninga lendawo. Uma sicabanga ngezokuphepha, ngisho nomthengi onolwazi wezobuchwepheshe obukhona obungakabi phezulu udinga abacwaningi abaningi abenza ucwaningo ezindaweni ezifanele. Izindaba zomsebenzi nabantu. Umkhakha wethu wabacwaningi nezobuchwepheshe awuqinile kahle noma awuqinile. Inani elikhulu labacwaningi abamhlophe, abesilisa, nabadala abahambisani nabantu abancane ngendlela ebonisa isithombe esifanele sokuxubana kwabantu bezwe. Iziphakamiso ezilula zithonywe kakhulu yizinguquko ekubambisaneni kwamazwe omhlaba eziholela ekwehleni kwezinga lokutshalwa kwezimali nasekusebenzeni komkhakha wezobuchwepheshe nezokuthuthukiswa ezizimele eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokulawula ngaphakathi kwesisekelo solwazi esiyisisekelo esibalulekile empumelelweni yezinkampani zethu ezincintisanayo. Imithetho efanele ephathelene nezimpahla zengqondo nezinsiza. Ukuthuthukiswa okusha kwezobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha kukhuphule ingozi yokuhlukumezeka kokucwaninga emkhakheni wezokwelapha, kuyilapho izicwangciso zokucwaninga ezisekelwa uhulumeni ezintsha zingavikelwe futhi aziphathwa ngendlela efanele. Izakhiwo zokwahlulela ezihlukene. Nakuba izikhungo zokucwaninga zibe sezibuyekeziwe futhi izinkomba eziyisisekelo zisetshenzisiwe, indima yamapharamitha ekwahluleleni nasekufakeni izindinganiso ezilindelekile ezikhungweni zokucwaninga kukahulumeni ayikacacile. Uma sibheka ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali, akukho mbono obanzi wokuchitha kukahulumeni kwezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe. Ukudala uhlelo oluqinile lwezobuchwepheshe nezocwaningo kukahulumeni. Iphuzu lezindlela ezintsha libandakanya ukusungulwa nokutshalwa kwezimali ezinhlelweni ezihlukahlukene zobuchwepheshe ezibalulekile ekukhuthazeni ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nasemphakathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amapulatifomu amabili abalulekile ezobuchwepheshe esikhathini samanje, ahlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obuthinta imithi nolwazi. Enye indlela yokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokukhiqiza nobuchwepheshe obwenza izinguquko ezinsizeni ezisekelwe noma ezinsizeni zemvelo. Ekugcineni, sizobumba indlela, ubuchwepheshe bokwehlisa ubuphofu obuzobhekana nezinselelo esihlangabezana nazo manje. Le ndlela izophathwa yisikhungo esisha esaziwa njengeSikhungo Sezindlela Ezintsha Zobuchwepheshe (FTI) esizosebenza njengendawo yokutshalwa kwezimali egxile kulwazi, le ndawo izogxila kakhulu ezicwangcweni ezintsha ngaphakathi kwazo zonke izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe. I-FTI izotshala imali ezicwangcweni ezintsha kuwo wonke imikhakha yomphakathi nasekhanda elizimele kanye nasezikhathini ezihlukahlukene kusukela ekwakhiweni kwesicwangciso kuya ekwethulweni komkhiqizo emphakathini ngenkathi igxila kakhulu esigabeni sokuthuthukiswa kwesicwangciso esinezimali eziphezulu kanye nokwamukelwa komkhiqizo emphakathini lapho uthengiswa, ulethelwa, noma usatshalaliswa. Indlela esihamba ngayo ukuze sithuthukise abantu ibonwa ngakolunye uhlangothi ngokudingeka kokukhuphuka okusheshayo kwenani labantu abakhishwa kumathuba esikhathini esedlule, abesifazane abangena emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe ukuze bahlale kuwo, kuyilapho ngakolunye uhlangothi sithumele umgomo wokwakha isicwangciso sokuhlangabezana nezinselelo zokuhweba nokubambisana nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba. Ukuqonda okujulile komphakathi mayelana Nezinhlelo ZeSayensi kungaphumelela ekwandiseni lezi zibalo kuphela uma intsha ingabona amathuba akhangayo futhi ajabulisayo emisebenzini elindelekile. Ngeminyaka yama-1970 kanye ne-1980, lezi zindawo zomsebenzi zaziningi ngenxa yezinselelo zendawo eyayikhona ngaleso sikhathi - nakuba zazivame ukugxilwa ohlangothini oluthile lomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, iphuzu labantu libaluleke kakhulu ukuba lihlangane nephuzu lezobuchwepheshe. Emhlabeni jikelele, indlela yokukhiqiza abacwaningi abaphezulu abakwazi ukudlulela kwezinye izikhala ibandakanya ukugxila kakhulu emandleni okwenza kahle emsebenzini. Enye indlela ephezulu ezingeni likazwelonke iwukugxila kakhulu ezidingweni zomsebenzi ophansi kwezobuchwepheshe ezindaweni lapho sinesikhathi esihle sokuphumelela ngenxa yokuba khona kwezinsiza zemvelo nolwazi olutholakalayo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, lezi zindawo zifaka ulwazi lwezulu nolwazi lwezemvelo. Isikhungo esihamba phambili uma kukhulunywa ngalesi sicwangciso, esikhuthaza isayensi, yiNational Research Organization esebenza ngokubambisana nomkhakha wezokufunda ophakeme ngohlelo lweZokufunda Oluphakeme Lwenhlangano. Nakuba umsebenzi kahulumeni wangaphakathi waba nesakhiwo esisha ngo-1994, izibopho eziningi ezinamandla zeNational New Strategies Program zaphazamiseka. Ukuqonda indima yamapharamitha anikezwe imisebenzi efana neMnyango Wezolimo Nezempilo ophakamisa izinhlelo ezimkhakheni ethile kanye neMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe (DACST) kufanele udlale indima ethile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ezilindelekile emhlabeni jikelele mayelana nokutshalwa kwezimali kwezobuchwepheshe nezobuchwepheshe zilandelwa, ikakhulukazi imisebenzi yokucwaninga ethuthukile (ukukhiqiza ulwazi), izicwangciso ezintsha (amabhizinisi amasha, imikhiqizo, nemisebenzi) kanye nokwakhiwa kwamabhizinisi. Indima ye-DACST izoba ukuhlela uhlelo oluhlangene lokubheka umnikelo wezokusebenza zezilabhulali eziphethwe uhulumeni futhi ibe nesibopho esiqondile ezikhungweni ezinhlanu ezigxilile, njengeNational Research Center, iScience Promotion Center (eyaziwa ngaphambili njengeFEST), iCenter for New Technological Strategies, iCouncil for Scientific Research and Industry, kanye neCouncil for Human Science. Imikhakha efanele izoba nezibopho zokun
Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela imithetho ephathelene nokubhekelela nokubhekelela izikhungo zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali, ukuhlela nokubhekelela abaphathi bezinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali, ukugcina nokuphatha izinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali, nokuvimbela imikhuba yokuhweba ngaphakathi kwenkampani; ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwedepartment ye-clearing house nokukhokha izimali zokuhweba nokwamukela abantu abanikeziwe; ukuhlinzeka ngenkambiso yokuziphatha kwabantu abavunyelwe nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalezi zenzakalo. Umphenyi-akhawunti uchaza umphenyi-akhawunti emkhakheni weMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi ka-1991 njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wokubhanga ka-1990 (Umthetho No. 94 ka-1990), kanye nebhange elingabi nalungelo lokwabelana ngenzuzo phakathi kwamalungu alo njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wokubhanga ongabi nalungelo lokwabelana ngenzuzo ekupheleni konyaka ka-1993 (Umthetho No. Ibhodi lichaza iMboni Yezinsizakalo Zezimali eyasungulwa ngengxenye 2 yoMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zezimali ka-1990. Imithetho ichaza imithetho eyenziwe ngumnikazi wezinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali ngokulandela lo Mthetho. Umbiko ophumelelwe ngubani uhambisana nohlobo olusunguliwe, olurekhodiwe, oluthunyelwe, noma olugcinwe ngombhalo noma ngendlela engabonakali kodwa ebukekayo. Noma iyiphi inhlangano yephenshiyali ebhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinhlelo Zepenshiyali ka-1956 Umthetho No. noma noma iyiphi inhlangano yokubambisana ebhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezizinda Zokubambisana ka-1956 Umthetho No. noma noma yiluphi uhlobo lwezinhlelo zokutshalwa kwezimali ezichazwe engxenyeni 1 yoMthetho Wokulawulwa Kwezinhlelo Zokutshalwa Kwezimali ka-2000 Umthetho No. noma noma ubani obhaliswe njengomthengisi we-inshurensi yesikhathi eside noma yesikhathi esifushane ebhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinhurensi Yesikhathi Eside ka-1998 Umthetho No. 52 ka-1998, noma uMthetho Wezinhurensi Yesikhathi Esifushane ka-1998 Umthetho No. noma ubani ophakathi kokwenza imisebenzi echazwe engxenyeni 721d yoMthetho Wezinhurensi Yesikhathi Eside ka-1998, noma engxenyeni 70e yoMthetho Wezinhurensi Yesikhathi Esifushane ka-1998; kanye nebhange. Ama-shares, ubufakazi bokugcina imali enkampanini ebhaliswe ezimakethe zezimali nezinye izinhlobo zokuhweba ngemali ezimakethe zezimali ngaphandle kwehlobo otshala imali enkampanini ethengisa ama-shares ngama-bonds njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Olawulayo Wokuthengisa KweShares Ngama-Bonds ka-1980 Umthetho No. imali yokuhweba ichaza isivumelwano noma umcimbi wokuthenga nokuthengisa izinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa nokukhula kwemisebenzi yokuhweba ngezinsiza zezimali emakethe yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ezenzakalweni ezilawulwa noma ngaphansi koMthetho Wezokweluleka Nokuqondisa Izinsizakalo ka-2002 Umthetho No. Noma yimuphi umthetho ophathelene nokugembula noma ukubheja awusebenzi ezimweni ezilawulwa noma ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uma umuntu enegunya lokusebenza, emelela izinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali ngaphandle kokuthi lowo muntu ahambisane nemithetho yesikhungo elawula ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Abanalo ilungelo lokuba yisikhungo, njengomnikazi wezinsiza zokuhweba, umnyango wokukhokha izimali zokuhweba, ukubamba iqhaza noma ukuba neziqu zokwenza le msebenzi ngokuvumelana nesimo esivela, noma ukuziphatha ngendlela, sebenzisa igama noma incazelo ekhombisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabo nesikhungo, njengomnikazi wezinsiza zokuhweba emakethe, umnyango wokukhokha izimali, ukubamba iqhaza noma ukuvunyelwa ukuba basebenze, ngokuhambisana nesimo njengoba sivelayo. Umthetho Wezokweluleka Kwezimali ka-1990 ngababhalisile nabaPhakanyiswa Bezimali Zezimakethe Zokuhweba Ngemali ngezinga labo. Igunya lokulawula kufanele lenze imisebenzi enikezwe igunya lokulawula noma liqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho uyahambisana. Bangafaka izimo ezihlobene nalolu Mthetho mayelana nevunyelwa, igunya, ukwamukela, noma amalungelo akhishwe ngogunyaziwe lokulawula, futhi lezo zimo zingakhanselwa noma zishintshwe. Ibhodi Lezokweluleka Kwezimali ezasungulwa ngengxenye 3 yoMthetho Wokuhweba Kwezimali ka-1989 (Umthetho No. 55 ka-1989) isasebenza nakuba lo Mthetho ukhubazekile ngengxenye 117. Abanye amalungu, kuhlanganise nezithunywa zomkhakha, amakhasimende anikezwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuxoxisana neBhodi. Igunya lokulawula liyilungu lebhodi yokweluleka ngenxa yomsebenzi walo kodwa alikwazi ukuvota ezindabeni lapho kudingeka khona ukuhlinzekwa ngeluleko lebhodi yokweluleka. Ilungu lebhodi yokweluleka lihlala emsebenzini isikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngesikhathi sokunikezwa kwalo. Izindleko zemali ezisetshenziswa ilungu ekwenzeni imisebenzi enikezwe lona. Umholi weBhodi Yokweluleka kufanele abize umhlangano wokuqala weBhodi Yokweluleka ngemuva kokuqala kwalolu Mthetho, kulandela, ibhodi yokweluleka izohlangana ngesikhathi nendawo eyinqunywe yibhodi yokweluleka. Umholi ubiza umhlangano olandelayo ngemuva kwalowo odlule lapho inani elidingekayo lamalungu ebhodi lingaphumelelanga ukuhlangana. Inani elidingekayo lamalungu ukuze umhlangano uqhubeke kuzoba inani lamalungu ebhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi yokweluleka ingathatha isinyathelo noma iceliwe nguNgqongqoshe noma igunya lokulawula ukuze ihlole futhi ilethe umbiko noma eluleko ezindabeni zokuphathwa noma ubuchwepheshe ngabantu abasebenza embonini noma mayelana nokwethulwa kwezinsiza zokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Singacela usizo kunoma ubani noma sihlole izindaba eziphathelene nabantu abasebenza kule mboni noma imisebenzi yokuhweba ezimakethe zezimali. Igunya lokulawula lingahlinzeka ebhodini nganoma yiluphi ulwazi oluhambelana nendaba ehlolelwayo yibhodi yokweluleka. Igunya lokulawula linomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphatha umsebenzi ohlobene kakhulu nemisebenzi yebhodi yokweluleka kanye nekomidi elincane lebhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi kufanele ikhokhe izindleko ezihlobene nemisebenzi yebhodi yokweluleka. Ibhodi yokweluleka kufanele ithole ukuvunywa kwebhodi ngaphambi kokuchitha lezo zindleko. Imithetho yeKomidi Yocwaningo ka-1947 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1947) ephathelene nokusungulwa kwekomidi, ukuhlolwa kwabantu, nokwenza imisebenzi yokuthatha izifungo, ukukhipha imibhalo, amarekhodi, nezinto ezithile nokwephulwa komthetho okwenziwa ngabafakazeli abahlanganyela nezinguquko ezidingekayo ocwaningweni olwenziwe yibhodi yokweluleka
Kufanele ugweme izenzo ezingase zibe nomthelela omubi emfanekisweni noma egameni lemakethe. Sebenzisa ulimi olufanele futhi ugweme ukusebenzisa izinsolo. Kufanele ugweme ukusebenzisa amagama abantu abanye ngaphandle kwemvume yabo. Gwema zonke izinhlobo zokucwaswa. Gwema zonke izinhlobo zokuhlambalaza futhi ugweme ukuhlukunyezwa ngokocansi, impi, nokuhlukunyezwa kwengqondo. Khuthaza ubumbano futhi ugweme ukusabalalisa ukungaboni ngaso linye. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezidingekayo ziyaqhutshwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabanye. Gwema ukuzithokozisa, ukuphatha, noma ukuhlukunyezwa kwezinto ezithokozisayo. Khuthaza indawo ehlanzekile yokusebenza. Gxila emsebenzini wakho. Hlonipha isikhathi sokusebenza uma wenza imisebenzi yakho. Landela izindlela ezifanele uma uphakamisa izikhalazo. Ziphatha ngendlela ethuthukisa noma ekhuthaza umfanekiso/igama elihle emakethe. Khuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende/izivakashi ngokuba nobungane, ukuthobeka, nokusiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengiswa kumakhasimende iyakhwalithi ephezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo ethengwe ilethwa ngesikhathi. Phendula izikhalazo zamakhasimende ngokushesha futhi wamukele impendulo. Yamukela ukubaluleka kwamakhasimende ngokuvulekile nangokwethembeka. Qinisekisa ukuthi intengo yemikhiqizo yakho ilungile futhi iyamukeleka. Khuthaza ukwelashwa okufanayo kwabo bonke osomabhizinisi. Ukuze kube sobala, ubambisane nebhodi ngangokunokwenzeka. Hlonipha izibopho zenkontileka yakho. Hlonipha izinqumo zebhodi. Landela ikhodi yokuziphatha kanye nenqubo yokuhola izikhalazo ezibekwe yibhodi. Kuzoba nezindlela ezimbili zokuphikisana, ezisemthethweni nezingenamthetho. Lokhu kuqhutshelwa ngamalungu amane osomabhizinisi. Kubhekana neziphazamiso ezinzima zekhodi yokuziphatha. Lokhu kuqhutshelwa ngamalungu amahlanu, amathathu awo evela ebhodini kanti amabili anikezwe osomabhizinisi. Kubhekana neziphazamiso ezinzima kakhulu zekhodi yokuziphatha. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa uphenyo uma kukhona izinsolo zokwephula ikhodi yokuziphatha. Kuthunyelwa amalungu amabili ukuze kuphenywe lezi zinsolo. Kuqhutshelwa icala lokuhola izikhalazo. Yena okhetha ukuthi izinsolo zokwephula ikhodi yokuziphatha kufanele zilandele inqubo esemthethweni noma eyingenamthetho. Noma ubani onenkinga angafaka isikhalazo mayelana nokwephula ikhodi, futhi kunconywa ukuba kube okubhalwe phansi. Abantu ababili bazothunyelwa ukuze baphenye ukwephula ikhodi. Ithimba lokuphenya lizohlanganisa ubufakazi obufanele mayelana nalezi zinsolo. Osomabhizinisi abasolwa ngokwephula ikhodi kumele banikezwe ithuba lokuphendula kulezi zinsolo. Uma ikomidi lezikhalazo lithola ukuthi kukhona ubufakazi obucacile, lizokhipha izijeziso ezibhekiswe kosomabhizinisi abasolwa ngokwephula ikhodi.
Izinyathelo ezizolandela uma iziphathimandla zezimboni zikhona ezinyathelweni eziphikisana nokuncintisana. Ukuphathwa nokugcinwa kweMthetho Wamazwe Wamaphakheji kuyingxenye yemisebenzi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Ibhodi ibhekisela ebhodini labaphathi beZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ezakhelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 6. IZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ibhekisela kumphakathi wamaphakheji eNingizimu Afrika. "Abasebenzisi bamaphakheji" babhekisela kulabo abaqondile abasebenzisa iphakheji (abanikazi bezikebhe), nalabo abangasebenzisi iphakheji ngqo (abangenisi bezimpahla ezivela phesheya nezithunyelwe zezimali kwezinye izizwe), kanye nabaphakathi emisebenzini yamaphakheji (abamele) kanye nabasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphakheji (abakhiqizi nabathengi). Abasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphakheji bangabantu abakhokha ngezinsizakalo zamaphakheji. Ngakho-ke abakhiqizi nabathengi bezwe yibo abasebenzisi bokugcina bamaphakheji. "Amaphakheji" abhekisela kumaphakheji ezentengiselwano akhishwe ngaphansi kweMthetho Wamaphakheji eNingizimu Afrika. Kuzokwakhiwa isikhungo esizophathwa yiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji, esizoba nebhodi, umkomishana, nabasebenzi. Ukuvikela ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele kwamandla nokwenza kube nezehlakalo ezilungile zokusebenzisa amaphakheji. Ukuqapha nokuthatha izinyathelo ezifanele, uma kudingeka, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iTransnet ayihlanganyeli ekuziphatheni okuphikisana nokuncintisana emisebenzini yayo yokuhweba neZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji futhi ukuthi imali eqoqwe yiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji isetshenziswa ukuze izuze iziphathimandla, abathengi, futhi ibe nomthelela ezimweni zezimali nezokuxhumana zomphakathi. Ukuhlela iZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ekwenzeni imisebenzi ebekwe kuyo ngaphansi kwalomthetho. Ukuphatha izinyathelo ezifanele ezizolandela uma kukhona izinsolo zokuziphatha okuphikisana nokuncintisana. Siqapha futhi silawula iZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wamaphakheji. Sivikela futhi sithatha njengendawo yokudluliselwa kwezikhalazo nokunganeliseki okuqondiswe kwiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. IZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji iqapha, ihlola, futhi ithatha izinyathelo ezifanele ukusiza ekwenzeni lo mthetho kanye nezinye izinqubo ezihlobene. Sivikela ekusetshenzisweni okungafanele kwamandla futhi siqinisekisa ukufinyelela okulinganayo kumaphakheji nokutholakala kwezinsizakalo zamaphakheji, siqapha futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele uma kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ayitholi izinzuzo ezingafanele phezu kwezinye izinkampani zokuhamba nokuthi imali eqoqwe ngamaphakheji isetshenziswa ukuze izuze futhi ithuthukise izakhiwo nezinhlelo zamaphakheji ukuze kuzuze abasebenzisi bamaphakheji. Siqinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuphathwa kweMthetho Wamaphakheji yiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Siqapha futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele uma kudingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphakheji atholakala, nokuthi izinsiza zamaphakheji zikhona ngaphandle kokubandlululwa, kahle, nangokucacile. Ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha; ukuvikeleka kwezomnotho, kanye nokusebenza kahle kwamaphakheji. Ukukhuthaza ukutholakala kwesikhathi esifanele nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezisetshenziswa kumaphakheji ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo nezilindelo zabasebenzisi bamaphakheji, siqinisekisa ukuhlela kahle kwezohwebo phakathi kwalabo abenza emaphakheji nalabo abahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kumaphakheji, siqinisekisa ukuthi iZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji inikeza usizo olufanele futhi ihambisana nezindinganiso zamazwe omhlaba ezamukelekayo, ibambisane nezinsizakalo zikamasipala nezinye izithakazelo ezibalulekile emkhakheni wamaphakheji, futhi iqoqe futhi igcine ulwazi mayelana nemisebenzi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Sisebenzisa noma yiziphi amandla, siqedela noma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe kithi ngaphansi kwalomthetho, noma ezibekwe kithi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano somhlaba. IZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji izoba namalungu angaphansi kuka-5 futhi angaphezu kuka-13 abekwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze bisebenze isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu, futhi la malungu angaphinde abekwe. Kumele babe nolwazi olwaneleyo lwezomthetho, lobuchwepheshe, lobuholi, lwezomnotho, lokuthuthukiswa, nolunye ulwazi olufanele olusebenza embonini yokuhamba kwezokuthutha. Kumele bakhethwe noma bathathe indawo yabanye ngendlela ekhuthaza intuthuko nokwakhiwa kwamakhono. UNgqongqoshe angabeka isikhundla eMnyangweni Wezokuthutha ukuze kube nguSihlalo weZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ezizimele. Uma ilungu leBhodi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji ngaphandle kwalungu elibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3 ngezizathu ezithile lishiya ukuba ilungu, uNgqongqoshe angabeka noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ukuze agcwalise le ndawo engatholakali isikhathi esisele. Ilungu leBhodi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji lingakhokhelwa ngenkonzo yalo, ngemali ethathwa nguNgqongqoshe ngezikhathi ezithile. Ilungu elinokungqubuzana kwezithakazelo noma elingase libe nokungqubuzana kwezithakazelo okungase kuphazamise isikhundla sako njengelungu kumele likhombise izithakazelo zalo kwiBhodi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. Bonke amalungu kumele akhombise izithakazelo zawo kwiBhodi yeZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zikhona ezomuntu, ezobuchwepheshe, noma ezihlobene nezohwebo, futhi azise uSihlalo nganoma yiziphi izinguquko. Noma yisiphi isiphazamiso kunoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalomthetho singase singafezekisi izidingo ezibekwe esigabeni 6. Bangakhokhelwa umholo futhi bangakhokhela abasebenzi imiholo, izinzuzo, nezinye izinzuzo ezamukelwe nguNgqongqoshe. Umkomishana kumele aqaphe zonke izinkulumo zokukhala nezikhalazo ezilethwa kwiZiphathimandla ZamaPhakheji. I-buoy ibhekisela kumthombo osebenzayo ukusiza lapho imikhumbi ihamba emanzini ukuwazisa ngemiphumela emibi emanzini noma i-radio buoy esiza imikhumbi ngesikhathi ihamba olwandle. I-"buoy" ibhekisela kumshini omncane ophakeme ogxilile emaphethelweni emanzini, okhombisa noma owazisa imikhumbi ngezingozi, imikhumbi ebiwe, noma ezinye izithiyo. "Imithwalo elindelekile," ibhekisela kumthwalo olindelekile ongathwalwa izikhumulo zezindiza zaseNingizimu Afrika. Abasebenzisi bezikhumulo zifaka phakathi abasebenzisi abaqondile (abanikazi bemikhumbi), abasebenzisi abangaqondile (abangenisi goods zangaphandle kanye nabathumeli goods bendawo), abasebenzisi abangekho emhlabeni (abathumeli), kanye nabasebenzisi bokugcina abathengisayo (abakhiqizi nabathengi). Usizo ekunyakazeni kwemikhumbi lubhekisela kunoma iyiphi indlela esetshenziselwa ukulawula noma ukuhlela ukuhamba kwemikhumbi ukuvikela imvelo. a Ukuhlukanisa imisebenzi yokusebenza njengomnikazi wendawo b Ukukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba babambe iqhaza, ukuze bagqugquzele abaphathi nabasebenzi c Ukulungiselela ukudluliswa kwamakhono nolwazi, ulwazi, nokuphathwa ngokubambisana futhi kubandakanya umkhakha ozimele ongaphansi kukahulumeni. a I-National Ports Authority iphethwe ngokuhambisana neMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zomphakathi (PFMA). Ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zalo Mthetho, uNgqongqoshe ongumthengisi kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokwakha nokubhalisa iNational Ports Authority njengenkampani yomphakathi engathengisa amasheya noma izitokwe futhi ikhiphe isitifiketi sokwakhiwa, ngokuhambisana neMthetho Wamakampani kanye ne-PFMA. Ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywa esigabeni 2 seMthetho Wamakampani okungahambisani nalolu Mthetho, kuzosebenza kule National Ports Authority. UNgqongqoshe njengomthengisi, ngokusekelwe eziphakamweni ezenziwe yiNational Ports Authority angase abelane ngezixwayiso kuNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni ukuze akhombise ukuthi ezinye izinhlinzeko noma izigaba zeMthetho Wamakampani azisebenzi kule National Ports Authority.
