Kuleso saziso, uSekela Senkampani kumele abize abantu ukuthi bathumele izikhalazo zabo neziphakamiso kumuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kuleso saziso ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe kuleso saziso. Unyaka wezimali weNational Ports Authority uzophuma kusukela ku-April 1 kuya ku-March 31 wonyaka olandelayo, kokubili izinsuku zifakiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywa nganoma yimuphi umthetho, iNational Ports Authority ngeke ibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa komuntu okhethwe yinkantolo noma ngaphansi kwenqubo yokupheliswa kwenkampani engakhokhi izikweletu, ngaphandle uma kuvunyelwe umthetho othile wePhalamende. m ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle, ukwethembeka, kanye nezindleko ngale ndlela ezithola amalayisense, ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ezamukelekayo zomhlaba jikelele nezidingo zomphakathi. I-National Ports Authority kumele yenze konke okudingekayo ukuze iphathwe kahle nangempumelelo, ihlele futhi ilawule izikhumulo zezindiza. a ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwezikhumulo zokuhweba b ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba kahle kwezikhumulo c ukulungiselela ukuhlinzekwa kwalezo msebenzi d ukunciphisa ukuphindaphindwa kwalezo msebenzi nezinqubo mayelana nokuphathwa kwalezo msebenzi. e ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwemisebenzi efanayo. a nesikhathi nezinqubo, kuhlanganisa nenqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi nezindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga, mayelana nokusayinwa kwezivumelwano zokubambisana ezikhulunywa esigabeni 2. k ukukhuthaza izinyathelo zokuphepha ezikhumulweni. Akukho okukhulunywa esigabeni 1 kuzovimba iNational Ports Authority ekwenzeni noma yini edingekayo ukuze iphathe izikhumulo kahle nangempumelelo, ihlele futhi ilawule izikhumulo. I-National Ports Authority yaseNingizimu Afrika inamandla afana nalawo enkampani njengoba kuxoxwa esigabeni 34 seMthetho Wamakampani, ngaphandle uma kuxoshwa noma kuncishiswa ngokubhala ngalo Mthetho. e Ukukhokha kokukhishwa kwamalayisense nokudluliswa kokukhokha kwezinsizakalo nezinsiza ezisetshenziswa ezikhumulweni ezihlinzekwa yiNational Ports Authority ngokuthanda kwayo ngokuhambisana nokuvunywa koNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokubonisana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali f Ukungena ezivumelwaneni zokudluliswa kwemali nokubambisana phakathi kukahulumeni nomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi bezikhumulo abaqeqeshiwe ukuze banikeze usizo ezikhumulweni nasemphathweni wokuphatha imithwalo ukuze kusungulwe izindinganiso zokusebenza, ikhwalithi yomsebenzi, futhi kugcizelelwe ukuhambisana nomthetho. Ngaphezu kokunciphisa amandla akhulunywa esigabeni 1, le nkampani izoba namandla okukhokha kwezinye izinsiza ngaphandle kwentela, ukukhokha okuhlanganisa noma okungahlanganisi kuphela amandla okuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nezivumelwano mayelana nezindlela zokuthola imali ngokubolekwa kuzokwenziwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 66 seMthetho Wokuphathwa KwezeMali Zomphakathi (PFMA). Izinkambiso ze-apartheid kanye nekoloni zazihlosiwe ukudala izimo lapho iningi labantu bezwe lingagcinwanga kuphela kodwa laphinde lahlukunyezwa kakhulu. Lokhu kuholele ekungalinganeni lapho isiNgisi nesiAfrikaans kwanikezwa isimo esisemthethweni futhi kwakhuthazwa ngendlela ehlelekile kuyilapho izilimi zomdabu zezwe zashiywa zinganakiwe. I-Gauteng Provincial Language Policy Framework ithuthukiswe njengomphumela oqondile we-Constitional Assembly yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, kanye ne-National Language Policy Framework (evunyelwe futhi yashicilelwa ngoMashi 2003) ethuthukisa amalungelo emthethweni mayelana nokusetshenziswa nokuthuthukiswa kolimi. I-National Language Policy Framework ifuna zonke izifundazwe ukuthi zithuthukise izinqubomgomo zazo zolimi ngokuhambisana nayo. I-Gauteng Provincial Policy Framework iyimiphumela yokubambisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene ezingeni lendawo, lesifundazwe, kanye lesizwe. Lezi zithakazelo zifaka phakathi i-National Language Centre yeMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, i-Gauteng Provincial Government (GPG), iminyango kanye nokugxila okukhulu okuvela kuMnyango Wezokufunda waseGauteng, iSouth African Languages Board, iGauteng Language Committee, izikhungo, iLegislative Assembly, kanye nabaphathi bezilimi. Le nqubo yokubambisana yakhuthazwa nguMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukujabulisa, Ubuciko namasiko ngosizo lwabaculi abahlukene emikhakheni yolimi. Lo mcimbi, ohambisana nokubambisana okuhlakaniphile (futhi kwesinye isikhathi okukhulu) phakathi kwabaphathi bezilimi nabavukeli, ubonisa inselelo ejabulisayo ku-Gauteng Language Policy Framework, efuna ukuhlinzeka ngemigomo ebanzi yokuphumeza uhlelo oluphumelelayo lwezilimi eziningi. Iphinde ibhekane nemiphumela ebalulekile yocwaningo lwezizwe nolimi oluvunyelwe yiSouth African Languages Board ngo-2001, lapho kwathathwa isampula kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanezinyanga eziyi-16 naphezulu abahlolwe kuyo yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Imikhakha egcizelelwe ifaka phakathi ulimi lwasekhaya nokusetshenziswa kolimi emikhakheni yomphakathi neyomphakathi, izimo zomphakathi nezikhungo, ulimi lomsebenzi kanye nezemfundo, izimo ezicatshangelwa ezinqubweni zolimi, kanye nekhono lokushintsha izilimi nokukhuluma izilimi eziningi. Umthethosisekelo ubheka imfundo njengengxenye ebalulekile yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kolimi. I-Gauteng Language Policy Framework iphinde ibheke izinhlinzeko zeSouth African Schools Act ka-1996 mayelana nokusetshenziswa kolimi ezikoleni nokuthi kanjani iLanguage Policy in Education ihlangana nesimo semfundo. Inhloso ye-Gauteng Language Policy Framework ukuhlinzeka nokuthuthukisa izilimi zomdabu eGauteng ezake zashiywa ngaphandle. Isigaba 29 sithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthola imfundo ezilimini ezisemthethweni azikhethile ezikhungweni zomphakathi lapho imfundo ingatholakala khona. I-PANSALB Act ka-1995 njengoba ilungisiwe, kanye nezinye izinhlinzeko, ihlinzeka ngokuqashelwa, ukusetshenziswa, nokukhuthazwa kokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezake zashiywa ngaphandle. Iphinde igcizelele ukusungulwa kwamakomidi ezilimi zesifundazwe okumele akhuthaze ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi ezweni. I-Gauteng Provincial Government, ngeMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukujabulisa, Ubuciko namasiko, isungule iGauteng Language Committee. Nakuba iSouth African Schools Act (SASA) ihlinzeka ngenqubo yokuthi ilungiswe kwezinye izindawo, okwamanje inikeza uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo nangemva kokuxoxisana neKhansela leMinisters, igunya lokubeka izindinganiso zezinqubomgomo zolimi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Iphinde icacise ukuthi umzimba ophatha isikole somphakathi ungakhetha izinqubomgomo zolimi ngokulandela umthethosisekelo, lo mthethosisekelo (SASA), nezinye izinqubomgomo zesifundazwe ezihambelana. Izinhloso ze-Promotion of Access to Information Act kufanele zihlinzeke ngokuqinisekiswa kwesikhala somthethosisekelo sokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso, imiphakathi ezimele, noma abantu ngabanye ngaphansi kwemikhawulo efanele. Ukufinyelela akumele kube kuphela ukuthola ulwazi ngempela kodwa kufanele futhi, lapho kungenzeka, kube ngolimi olukhethiwe ngumfaki-sicelo. Njengoba iSheduli 4 yomthethosisekelo ibhala, ulimi luwumkhakha osebenzayo wokwakha nolwazi phakathi kwesifundazwe, iNational Language Policy Framework ibeka ukuthi zonke izikhungo zombuso (ezingeni lendawo, lesifundazwe, kanye lesizwe) nezinye izikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma ezisebenza emisebenzini yomphakathi zibophelelekile nguMthetho. Izifundazwe kulindeleke ukuthi zithuthukise izinqubomgomo zazo zolimi ezihambisana neNational Language Policy Framework ngenkathi zicabangela izimo zesifundazwe, izidingo, kanye nezinto ezikhethwa yimiphakathi yazo. Le nqubo izodluliselwa kuzinhlelo zendawo ezizothuthukisa izinqubomgomo zazo zolimi ngokuhambisana neProvincial Policy Framework. Uhulumeni uphinde ukhuthazwe, lapho kudingeka, ukuxhasa umkhankaso ozimele wokuthuthukisa nokuphumeza izinqubomgomo zawo zolimi ngokulandela lezi zinqubomgomo. I-Language Policy in Education iyinqubomgomo yolimi yesizwe esebenza ngaphakathi kwesimo semfundo. Inhloso eyinhloko ukuhlinzeka ngoxhumano ngokuhlanganisa ubuhlanga, amasiko, izilimi, kanye nezinkolo ngasikhathi sinye kudalwe indawo lapho ukuhlonishwa kwezilimi ezingezona ezomuntu siqu kukhuthazwa. Ukuxhumana ezilimini eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zesizwe kuzohlonishwa futhi kukhuthazwe. Njengengxenye yezimiso zayo, i-Language Policy in Education ikhuluma ukuthi bonke abafundi kumele bafundiswe okungenani ulimi olulodwa lomdabu, zonke izikhala zolimi zizothola isikhathi nezinsiza ezilinganayo, futhi iziphathimandla ezihlobene ezingeni lesifundazwe zizothola iziqondiso zezinguquko ezidingekayo zokukhuthaza izilimi njengemikhakha, ngokuhambisana nemithetho yesizwe. Umkhakha we-Language Policy Framework uzobheka iminyango ye-GPG, iGauteng Legislature, izikhungo ezinakekela ukusetshenziswa kwazo kolimi lwesifundazwe nokukhetha, nezikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifundazwe ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma ezisebenza emisebenzini yomphakathi. Amabhizinisi azimele kanye nezinhlangano ezingezona ezikahulumeni nazo zizokhuthazwa ukuba zithuthukise izinqubomgomo zazo ngokuhambisana nalezi zinqubomgomo. Lezi zibalo zikhombisa ukuthi isiZulu yisilimi sasekhaya esikhuluma ngaphezu kuka-20% wabantu ezingeni lesifundazwe nasemhlabeni jikelele. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela ukuthi nakuba isiNgisi sisetshenziswa kabanzi njengolimi lwezohwebo nesayensi, sithola indawo yesine neshumi ezingeni lesifundazwe nasemhlabeni jikelele ngokulandelana. Lokhu kuqhubeka kukhombisa ukuthi akukho silimi esisodwa esiphakeme kakhulu esikhuluma emkhakheni wesifundazwe kodwa kunokukhuluma izilimi eziningi lapho izilimi eziphezulu ezinhlanu zikhuluma ngaphezu kuka-10% wabantu, okuhlanganiswe
Umthetho we-apartheid nokucindezelwa wadala isimo lapho zonke izilimi ngaphandle kwezimbili zingazange zicatshangelwe kuphela kodwa zaphinde zaphathwa kabi kakhulu. IsiNgisi nesiAfrikaans banikezwa isikhundla esisemthethweni futhi bathuthukiswa ngendlela ehlelekile, kodwa lokhu kwalimaza izilimi zomdabu zaseNingizimu Afrika. Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ka-1996, unikeza ukusetshenziswa okufanayo kwezilimi ezisemthethweni zonke ezweni futhi uthuthukisa izilimi ezaziphathwe kabi ngaphambili. Ngaphezu kwezilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11, umthethosisekelo uqaphela ezinye izilimi ezifana neNama, Khoi, kanye neSan, kanye nolimi lwezimpawu, okufanele futhi kuthuthukiswe. IGauteng iyidolobha elihlanganisa izizwe futhi iyisifunda lapho kuphela izilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 zaseNingizimu Afrika (iSepedi, iSesotho, iSetswana, isiSwati, iVenda, iTsonga, isiAfrikaans, isiNgisi, isiNdebele, isiXhosa, nesiZulu) ezingakhuluma, kodwa iyikhaya lezilimi eziningi. Odiplomate, abokufika, ababaleki, nabantu bezamabhizinisi abavela emhlabeni jikelele abahlala eGauteng benze le ndawo ibe yikhaya lezilimi eziningi zangaphandle. I-Gauteng Language Policy Framework (GLPF), ehloswe ukuhlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela ebanzi yokusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenzisa izilimi eziningi, yasungulwa ngezizathu ezihlobene ngqo nezidingo zomthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-National Language Policy Framework (eyamukelwa futhi yethulwa ngoMashi 2003) ethinta amalungelo omthethosisekelo ahlobene nokusetshenziswa nokuthuthukiswa kolimi. I-National Language Policy Framework ifuna ukuthi zonke izifunda zisungule imithetho yazo ezimele ezidinga ukuhambisana nayo. I-GLPF iyimiphumela yokuxoxisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene ezingeni lendawo, lesifunda, kanye nezinga lesizwe. Lezi zithakazelo zifaka iNational Language Institute yeMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, iGauteng Provincial Government (GPG), iminyango enegxile enkulu kwiGauteng Department of Education, iSouth African Languages Board, iGauteng Language Committee, izindawo zokuhlala, iGauteng Legislature, kanye nochwepheshe bezilimi abaningi. Le nqubo yokuxoxisana yaphathwa nguMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuzijabulisa, Ubuciko, kanye namasiko, osizayo nochwepheshe bezilimi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Imiphumela yokuqala yocwaningo lwezenhlalo nolimi olwenziwe yiPanSALB ngo-2001 yahlaziywa. Lolu cwaningo lwasebenzisa indlela yokuhlanganisa egxile kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaneminyaka engu-16 naphezulu, abathathwe ezigabeni ezahlukene zokuphila, emiphakathini yasemakhaya nasezindaweni zasemadolobheni. Izindawo ezigxilwayo zazizilimi zasekhaya nezilimi ezisetshenziswa ezindaweni ezizimele, ezokuxhumana, ezemiphakathi, ezikhungweni zomphakathi, emfundweni, izilimi ezindaweni zokusebenza, kanye nombono wemithetho yolimi, ukusetshenziswa kolimi komuntu siqu, kanye nenani lezilimi ezikhuluma ngabantu. Umthethosisekelo uphinde uqaphele imfundo njengendawo ebalulekile yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi. I-GLPF iphinde ibheke izidingo zeSouth African Schools Act ka-1996 ngokuhlola ukuthi izilimi zisetshenziswa kanjani ezikoleni nokuthi ulimi kuMthetho Wezemfundo luhambisana kanjani nezimo zemfundo zamanje. Ihloswe ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa kahle kwezilimi okuthinta ukufakwa, ikhuluma ngezidingo zomphakathi; futhi igcizelela futhi ikhuthaza isizwe esikhulayo, ikhulisa ukuz pride nesibopho phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene zolimi namasiko eGauteng. Ic Section 29 ithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthola imfundo ngolimi olusemthethweni alukhethayo ezikhungweni zomphakathi, lapho le mfundo itholakala. I-PanSALB Act ka-1995 iphinde ihlinzeke ngokwamukelwa, ukukhuthazwa, nokusabalalisa isiko eliningi lwezilimi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphathwe kabi ngaphambili. Iphinde iphakamise ukusungulwa kwamakomidi ezilimi ezingeni lesifunda. I-Gauteng Provincial Government, ngeMnyango Wezemidlalo, Ukuzijabulisa, Ubuciko, kanye namasiko, isungule iGauteng Provincial Language Committee. Nakuba iSouth African Schools Act (SASA) isaqhuba ukuhlolwa, okwamanje ihlinzeka ngemininingwane yeNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo, ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, ngemuva kokuxoxisana neBhodi Yezangqongqoshe, ukuze ichaze amazinga nezindinganiso zomthetho wolimi ezikoleni zomphakathi. Iphinde icacise ukuthi ibhodi yokuphatha yesikole somphakathi ingathola umthetho wayo wolimi ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo, lo Mthetho (SASA), kanye neminye imithetho efanele yesifunda. Izinhloso zeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi kufanele ziqhube ukuhambisana nomthethosisekelo okuvumela ukufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe yiState, imizamo ezimele, noma abantu, ngokuhambisana nezimo ezithile ezamukelekayo. Lokhu ukufinyelela akukhona nje kuphela ukuthola ulwazi olufanele kodwa kufanele kube ngolimi olukhethwe ummangali, lapho kungenzeka. Njengoba uhlu lwe-4 lomthethosisekelo lukhuluma ukuthi ulimi luwumkhakha wokubambisana phakathi kukamasipala kazwelonke kanye nezifunda, i-NLPF ibeka ukuthi zonke izikhungo zikamasipala (kazwelonke, zesifunda, nezendawo) kanye nezikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla omphakathi noma imisebenzi zibophelelekile ngokuhambisana nomkhankaso. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izilimi eziningi, kulindeleke ukuthi izifunda zisebenzise imithetho yazo yokusebenzisa izilimi ezisekelwe kwi-NLPF, lapho zizobhekana nezimo zendawo, izidingo, nezintandokazi zomphakathi. Ngemuva kwalokho, ohulumeni bendawo bazothuthukisa imithetho yabo yokusebenzisa izilimi ngokuhambisana neProvincial Policy Framework. Uma kudingeka, ohulumeni bendawo bayakhuthazwa ukuthi basekele umkhakha ozimele ekusunguleni nasekukhuliseni umthetho wabo ngendlela ehambisana nalolu mthetho. Ulimi kuMthetho Wezemfundo luwumthetho wolimi kazwelonke osebenza ngaphakathi komkhakha wemfundo. Inhloso eyinhloko igcizelela ukuxhumana okungaphazamiseki phakathi kwemikhawulo yamasiko, ezilimini, kanye nezinkolo ngasikhathi sinye kudala indawo ehlonipha izilimi ezikhuluma abanye. Indlela yokuxhumana ngomlomo izohlonishwa futhi ikhuthazwe kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Uhlelo lweMthetho Wokusebenzisa Izilimi kuMfundo luthi bonke abafundi kufanele bafundiswe okungenani ulimi lomdabu olulodwa, zonke izigaba zolimi zizothola isikhathi nezinsiza ezilinganayo, futhi iziphathimandla zesifunda kufanele ziqonde imithetho mayelana nezidingo zokuthuthukisa amazinga ezilimi afanele kanye nezifundo, ngokuhambisana nohlelo olujwayelekile lwezizwe. Umkhakha weMithetho Womkhankaso uhlanganisa iminyango ye-GPG, iGauteng Legislature, izindawo zokuhlala (ezibhekele ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendawo nezintandokazi), nezikhungo ngaphakathi kwesifunda ezisebenzisa amandla okuqhuba nokuphatha imisebenzi yomphakathi. Uhlelo Lokweseka Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezamabhizinisi Kwabezizwe Abamnyama (BBSDP) luhlelo lokwabelana ngezindleko ngengxenye engu-80:20%, olweseka amabhizinisi owned by abantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo lunikeza lezi zinkampani indlela yokufinyelela ezinsizeni zokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ukuze kuthuthukiswe amakhono abo, kuthuthukiswe amakhono okuphatha, futhi kuhlelwe kabusha ukuze kube nokuncintisana okwengeziwe. Imikhakha eminingi inamabhizinisi owned by abantu abamnyama (ane-shareholding engu-50+1), futhi kukhona nezinye izinkampani eziningi eziphethwe abantu abamnyama. Izinkampani zingathola usizo oluvela ku-BBSDP grant olungafika ku-R12 million ngonyaka. Isimo esibalulekile sokufaneleka ukuze uthole usizo ukuthi inkampani kumele ibe sebenza okungenani unyaka owodwa futhi ibambe iqhaza ekuthengiseni. I-BBSDP ihlose ukukhulisa amabhizinisi owned by abantu abamnyama ngokuwaxhumanisa nezinkampani ezincane eziphethwe abantu abamnyama (SMMEs) futhi ihlanganise nezinkampani ezinkulu kanye nomkhakha wezohwebo wombuso. I-BBSDP ibambisana futhi ixhumanisa nohlelo lokwabiwa kwezinsiza kulabo abake babhekana nezinkinga zokuthi bangenamathuba, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zokuphuma, ezihlinzekwa yizinkampani ezinkulu nezomphakathi. Inhloso wukuthi imikhakha ithole ukwabiwa okumele kuxoshwe ekutholeni izikhwama ezivela ezinkampanini ezinkulu kanye nezohwebo zombuso kanye namathuba okuphuma emsebenzini. Inani eliphezulu le-grant elingatholwa yimikhakha ngayinye lingafika ku-R100,000 (izinkulungwane eziyishumi rand). Inkampani eyodwa ingavunyelwa ukufaka izicelo zephrojekthi ezahlukene, kodwa inani eliphelele le-grant alinakudlula ku-R100,000. Zonke izindleko ezihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo zamabhizinisi, kuhlanganise nezokuhamba nezinye izindleko zokuphila, zizokwenziwa ngokuqhathaniswa kwezindleko. Izindleko zokushicilela izinto kanye nezindleko ezihlobene nekhompyutha, kuhlanganise nezindleko zokuqala zephrojekthi, nazo zizohlinzekwa, uma zingadluli ku-50% wezindleko zephrojekthi eziphelele. Izinkampani zingakhetha ukuthi zizosebenzisa kanjani abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kulandela isimo sokuthi okungenani abathathu kumele babe khona ekukhetheni kulabo abathumele izikhwama. Iphrojekthi ezihlosiwe ukuthuthukisa inqubo yokuphatha ephumelelayo, ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wendawo kanye nokuhlela ukukhiqiza ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ze-ISO 9000 ne-ISO 14000, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zebhizinisi zesikhathi eside, phakathi kokunye. Ukusekelwa ngokwabelana ngezindleko kuzotholakala lapho kudingeka kwezidingo ezihlobene nekhompyutha nezifanekiso noma ama-brochure asekelayo inqubo yokuphatha ephezulu nephumelelayo. Iphrojekthi ezihlosiwe ukusiza ithimba lokuphatha lenkampani ngokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuqeqesha emikhakheni ehlukene, ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa kwabaphathi abaphezulu, izinhlelo zokuphatha noma ukuphathwa kwezimali, ama-workshop wokulungiselela izikhwama ezivela ezinkampanini zombuso nezinkampani ezinkulu, phakathi kokunye. Iphrojekthi ezihlosiwe ukusiza inkampani ukuthi ingene emkhakheni othile wemakethe, ngokwesibonelo, ucwaningo lwemakethe nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokumaketha, izifanekiso, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinto zokumaketha, njengezinhlelo zewebhusayithi, phakathi kokunye. Ukwabiwa kwezindleko ezithile kuzohlinzekwa ukusiza ekushicileleni ama-brochure alwazi nezinto ezihlobene ezizosebenza ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokumaketha.
Ukungenisa izinsizakalo zomphakathi ezweni kuzohlale kuba yük enkulu. Uhlaka lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ludinga uhlelo lokwethula izidingo zomphakathi ezihlobene, okuhlanganisa imikhakha futhi kuhlukanise iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni kanye nemikhakha yabo. Le nhlanganisela nokubambisana kungenzeka kuphela uma kwakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo sokusebenza kanye nezindinganiso zenqubo yokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kugcizelela isidingo sobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke, zendawo, nezasekhaya. Emdlalweni weminyaka eyishumi edlule, ingxoxo ngezinto ezakha umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ibibe phambili ezingxoxweni, ivame ukuba nencazelo engacacile futhi engaziwa kahle. Kusukela ngo-1994, sibe nengxoxo ezingeni elihlukene ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zethu zifinyelela ezingeni elifanele ukuze sikhuthaze imikhakha ethukile futhi enezimo ezinzima zomphakathi. Indlela entsha emlandweni wezwe ibonisa ushintsho enqubweni yokuthuthukiswa komphakathi okuhlose ukufinyelela ezigidini zabantu abaphila ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka, ukungabi nezinsiza, nokungatholakali kwezinsiza. Le shintsho yakhiwe phezu kokubona ukuthi abantu kufanele bathuthukiswe ukuze baqonde lokho abakufunayo empilweni yabo. Le shintsho, ehlukile endleleni yokuphakela abampofu, ihlose ukuthuthukisa nokuhlinzeka ngamathuba kubantu, amaqembu, kanye nemiphakathi ukuze ibe nekhono lokuzimela, okuzosiza umnyango futhi kubambisane nabo ekubhekaneni nezinselelo zomphakathi nezomnotho ezibhekene nomnyango kanye nezwe lethu. Sizokwenza lokhu ngoba sikholwa ukuthi lezi zifiso zizokwandisa uhlelo lapho izidingo zethulwa khona futhi inhlalakahle jikelele ithuthukiswe, kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu bethu. Uhlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi lucacisa kahle imizamo yethu eqhubekayo yokwethula kahle isimo sezidingo zomphakathi kubantu abahluphekayo kakhulu kanye nemiphakathi ethukile. Ngasikhathi sinye, siqoqe idatha nezinkomba zezidingo zezinsiza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka kahle. Sithemba ukuthi le Nqubo izosiza wonke umuntu ekubhekaneni ngezinkinga esihlangabezane nazo eminyakeni eyishumi edlule mayelana nokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, sithemba ukuthi uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi luzokwandisa futhi luqinisekise ukubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izigaba zokuthuthukisa ubulungiswa bomphakathi nokubambisana okuhlose ukufezekisa umgomo owodwa othi "Impilo Engcono Kubo Bonke." Umnyango ufisa ukuveza ukubonga okukhulu kwiThimba Lezabelo elizinikele kuShintsho elinikeze kakhulu ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi. Le thimba ihlanganisa amalungu avela ezingeni likazwelonke nasephakathini, kanti uMongameli wabo nguNksz. N. Kela, uMphakathi-Jikelele Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zokuhlala (ezingeni likazwelonke). Kungokubambisana kwaleli thimba ukuthi singenza ngokuzithoba sithi sakhe isisekelo esedlula izinselelo ezikhona ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi indima edlalwa ikhulisa ngempela izigidi zabantu abahluphekayo eNingizimu Afrika abakulindele ngokulangazela umsebenzi wethu. Umnyango ufisa futhi ukuqaphela iminikelo eyenziwe abanye ababambiqhaza kuyo yonke imiphakathi eyisishiyagalolunye, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, iBhodi Yezokusebenza Komphakathi, izinhlangano zabasebenzi, ama-NGOs, ama-FBOs, ama-CBOs, nezinye izikhungo ezathatha ingxenye ngesikhathi senqubo yokubonisana futhi zabelane ngemibono yazo kulolu documet. Ukubambisana nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi kuzohlale kuba yinto ebalulekile emizamweni kahulumeni nasemsebenzini wawo wokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo nokufeza lokho okuzinikele. Umqondo woHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi... Inhloso yoHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi... Umbiko wezinto ezilindelekile... Izindlela ezilindelekile nezindinganiso zoHlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi... Izinqumo zezinqubomgomo nezimfanelo zeMthethosisekelo... Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi olukhombisa izidingo ezigxile ekuthuthukisweni... Uhlobo nobuningi bokuthuthukiswa komphakathi... Abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo/Izindlela zezikhungo... Ukuxhasa uHlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi... Izindlela zokuphumeza umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokuphatha izinguquko... Umnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ubonisa izidingo ezihlanganiswe ezintweni ezintathu ezibanzi: inhlalakahle yomphakathi, izidingo zokuhlala zomphakathi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lezi zinhlelo kufanele zihlelwe futhi zisebenzisane nemiphakathi eqondiwe ekubhekaneni nazo zonke izinkinga zomphakathi nezimo ezifana nempilo yengqondo, ukuhlupheka okukhulu, ukungabi nokudla, nezimo zokuphila ezinzima. Lezi zimo zidalile isidingo sokugxila ekuthuthukisweni okuhlose ukukhuthaza abantu, amaqembu, noma imiphakathi, futhi kuqaphele amandla abo okukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuqaphela isidingo sokukhuthaza imigomo yokuthuthukiswa ngenkathi kubhekwa ukungalingani kwhistorical, umkhakha wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi uthathile indlela yokuthuthukiswa njengendlela yokwethula izidingo ezihlose ukuhlela izinhlelo zomphakathi nezokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Eminyakeni yamuva, abathuthukisi bomphakathi baphoqelekile ukuba bamukele izinyathelo zesikhashana eziphakanyiswe yizinkinga zezinsiza ezikhona, noma lezi zibe izidingo eziphuthumayo, izidingo zomthetho, noma izibopho ezichazwe ezingeni lomhlaba. Ngakho-ke, umgomo ophakeme woHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi kuMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uwukwethula uhlaka olubanzi lukazwelonke oluchaza kahle uhlobo, ububanzi, ubuningi, kanye nezinga lomsebenzi okwakha uhlelo lokwethulwa kwezidingo zomphakathi emnyangweni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi futhi luzosebenza njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa izindlela ezijwayelekile nezinga elifanele lokwethula izidingo zomphakathi. Umphumela olindelekile woHlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi uwukwethula nokuphumeza uhlelo olubanzi, olusebenza kahle ngendlela eqondiwe futhi esezingeni eliphezulu elizuzisa umphakathi ozimela onobudlelwano nezindlela ezibekwe kuMqulu Omhlophe Womnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi kanye nezimiso zeBatho Pele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lugxile ezimisweni zomthethosisekelo, emthethweni, nasezindinganisweni zomhlaba, ezibalulekile kumnyango uma kwethulwa izidingo zomphakathi. Uhlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi lweMisebenzi Yokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi lukhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisebenzi emikhulu yomnyango, efana nokuqinisekisa inhlalakahle, izidingo zokuhlala zomphakathi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lunikeza uhlaka lokuhlela imisebenzi phakathi kwezinhlelo ezihlukene zomnyango. Nokho, izinkinga zomphakathi ziyinkimbinkimbi futhi zihlanganisiwe, zidinga ukuhlela nabanye abahlinzeki, ngaleyo ndlela kugcizelelwa
Uhulumeni uqale uhlelo lokwabiwa kwezinsiza zokudla ezindlini ezihluphekayo. Malini okukhishwayo uhulumeni kulolu hlelo lokudla? Kukhona imali eyabelwe u-R230 million kulo nyaka ukuze kusizakale imindeni engama-200,000 ebhekene nezinkinga zokuphila ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka ezinzima. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imindeni enezingane. Okwamanje, kunezimuli eziyi-12,000 ezithola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Imindeni eminingi izothola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo oluzoqala ngoMashi 2003. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ingathola ukudla okunempilo okugcwele ama-vithamini nezinto ezidingekayo (ukuphuculwa kokudla). Iminyango yezeMidlalo, Ezolimo, Ezempilo, Imfundo, uHulumeni Wezokuxhumana nolwazi (GCIS), iNational Development Agency, kanye ne-Independent Development Trust baphathe izivumelwano nezinhlelo zokukhulekela, amaqembu ezabasebenzi, umkhakha wezebhizinisi, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imindeni ehluphekayo inakho ukudla. Enhlanganweni enkulu, kungenzeka ukuthi abasebenzi bahlangabezane nezinkinga zomuntu siqu ngezikhathi ezithile, okungathinta kabi ukusebenza kwabo nokuphila kwabo kahle. Le ngqikithi yokubuza ihloselwe ukuhlaziya izidingo zabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezamanzi (DWAF) nokuthola izindlela zokubhekana nalezi zidingo. Le ngqikithi yokubuza iyimfihlo. Ikhethwe ngendlela evulekile futhi engakhethi njengengxenye ye-10% yabasebenzi bonke beMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, ePhondweni Elisenyakatho. Awudingi ukufaka igama lakho kule ngqikithi yokubuza. Inhloso yethu ukuqoqa imibono nemicabango evela esampulini yabasebenzi eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, mayelana nezidingo zabo, hhayi ukukhomba izinkinga zomuntu siqu. Ucelwa ukuthi ufunde imibuzo ngokucophelela bese uphonsa ibhokisi elingezansi komphumela ocabanga ukuthi ufanele kakhulu kuwe. Ukhuthazwa ukuba uzame ukuphendula yonke imibuzo. Ngiyabonga ngokubamba iqhaza kulolu cwaningo. Sithemba ukuthi imiphumela nemiphumela izoba usizo kuwe nakwabanye ozakwethu emsebenzini. Uneminyaka emingaki? Ungumfana noma ungumfazi? Yini isimo sakho somshado? Qaphela: "Ushadile" kufaka phakathi umshado wesintu, wesonto, kanye nomshado wombuso. Yini ulimi lwakho lwasekhaya? Yini izinga lakho lokusebenza? Sicela uphonsa okukodwa. Ususebenze isikhathi esingakanani eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF? Yini izinga eliphezulu lemfundo olitholile? Uma kunjalo, sicela ubhale igama le-fund yokusiza kwezempilo. Okwamanje, uma wena noma ilunga lomndeni ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, kukhona yini umuntu noma usizo phakathi kwalokhu okulandelayo okungakufaka lezi zinkinga? Akekho; ngizixazulula mina. Uthanda ukuya emhlanganweni wokufunda mayelana nanoma yiziphi zalezi zihloko? Ungaphonsa ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo. Ukuphathwa kwezimali noma ukubhajethi, izikweletu, njll. Ukudlulisela emnyangweni omunye, ukulahleka komsebenzi, noma ukuhamba emsebenzini. I-HIV/AIDS, ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa, njll. Angifuni ukuya kunoma yiziphi zalezi zifundo. Ucabanga ukuthi kungaba ngcono ukuba uthole izeluleko ezivela kubasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe beMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, noma kulabo abaqashwe okwamanje, abazimele, futhi basendaweni eziseduze nalapho usebenza khona? Abasebenzi be-DWAF noma beMnyangweni Wezamanzi. Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kungathuthukisa kanjani impilo yabantu eMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF, uma bethola izeluleko ngezinkinga zabo ezizokhokhelwa yi-DWAF? (Lokhu kubhekisela kuhlobo lwezeluleko olukhethwe kuMbuzo 12 ngenhla). Yisiphi ulimi noma izilimi ozikhethayo ukuthi zisetshenziswe uma uthola izeluleko (Ungaphonsa ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo)? Uma iMnyango Wezamanzi, DWAF, inganikeza izeluleko zomuntu siqu ezimfihlo (usebenzisa uhlobo lwezeluleko olwakhethile), ubani ozosisebenzisa le sevisi? Amalunga omndeni wakho. Angizukuyisebenzisa nhlobo. Uma iMnyango Wezamanzi, DWAF, inenombolo yocingo etholakala ngaso sonke isikhathi, engadingi umuntu ukuba aveze igama lakhe, ukuze isetshenziswe abantu uma bezizwa bengaphilile, ubani ozosisebenzisa le sevisi? Amalunga omndeni wakho. Angizukuyisebenzisa nhlobo. Uthola kangaki ukuthi unenkinga yezempilo noma ukhathele (hhayi i-HIV/AIDS noma i-AIDS)? Uthola kangaki ukuthi unenkinga nomkakho, umlingani, noma omunye obalulekile? Uthola kangaki ukuthi unenkinga nezingane zakho? Uthola kangaki ukuthi unenkinga nezinye izinkinga zomndeni? Uthola kangaki ukuthi uzwa umzimba wakho ungenamandla noma ukhathele? Uthola kangaki ukuthi uzwa ukhathazekile ngokuba ne-HIV noma i-AIDS uqobo? Uthanda ulwazi mayelana ne-HIV/AIDS ephathelene nanoma yiziphi zalezi zihloko? Ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okukhona kwabantu abane-HIV noma i-AIDS. Ukuphila impilo ephelele uma unayo i-HIV noma umphumela ophumelelayo. Ukuphila nolwazi lwemiphumela ephumelelayo ekhombisa ukuthi unayo i-HIV. I-stigma yemiphumela ephumelelayo kulabo abaseduze kwakho, abangane, nomndeni. Isithunzi sakho emsebenzini namalungelo akho njengomsebenzi one-HIV. Angidingi ulwazi nganoma yiziphi zalezi zihloko. Uthola ukhathazekile ngokuqedwa kwemisebenzi? Kungenzeka yini ukuba ukhathazeke ngokulahleka komsebenzi? Unenkinga ngotshwala noma ngezidakamizwa ezihlobene ngqo nawe noma nelunga lomndeni eliseduze? Unenkinga zomthetho? Unenkinga zezimali noma zezimali? Uke waba yisigameko sokuhlukumezeka? Kungenzeka yini ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi uzwe ungaphansi noma ukhathele ngenxa yomsebenzi ngenxa yezizathu ezilandelayo (Ungakhetha ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo)? Ukukhathazeka ngokuqokwa noma ukwesaba ukuphepha komsebenzi ngokulandela umthetho we-Employment Equity Act. Imali, ukuqokwa, noma izinkinga ezihlobene nohlelo oluphatha ukuhlolwa kwendawo yokusebenza. Uzwa kanjani uma udluliselwa kwenye indawo (Isibonelo, eMnyangweni, eBhodi Lezamanzi, noma eMnyangweni Wokuphathwa Kwamanzi)? Ingabe kukhona omunye umbono noma isiphakamiso ofuna ukusho mayelana nosizo olungadingeka ngabantu baseMnyangweni Wezamanzi, DWAF? Ngiyabonga ngokuphothula le ngqikithi yokubuza. Izakhamuzi zomphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele zimenywa ukuba zifake iziphakamiso zabantu ukuze kube neBhodi leMnyuziyamu yaseRobben Island. Ibhodi izoba namalungu ayisixhenxe, azokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe wezobuDlelwano neMisebenzi. Okungenani ilungu elilodwa kumele libe nolwazi ngezindaba zezimali. Ngesikhathi sokukhetha abantu, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi abakhethiweyo kumele babe nolwazi olunzulu ngezakhamuzi kazwelonke, ubuchwepheshe obubanzi bezimali nokuphathwa, ulwazi lwezomthetho, nolwazi lokumaketha nokubambisana nezithakazelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe uxhaso lwezocwaningo lwezesayensi, kanye nokuzibophezela ekuhlinzekeni ngezinsiza zomphakathi kanye nobuchwepheshe obukhethekile emkhakheni wokusebenza kweMnyuziyamu yaseRobben Island. Iphaneli yokuhlola izokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe ukuze idale uhlu lwabaphakanyisi abafanele/abakhethiweyo ukuze kucatshangelwe. Indima yephaneli yokuhlola izoba ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhamba kokugcina kuhlanganisa abantu abanobuchwepheshe obuphakeme noma ulwazi oluhlukile noma uthando emkhakheni ofanele, futhi ukuthi bamele abantu abahlukene, kahle, emiphakathini nakubantu bobulili, futhi ukuthi ukukhethwa okuphelele kutholakala kungokwephezulu kakhulu. c Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngumuntu ophakanyisiwe, siqinisekisa ukwamukela isiphakamiso; kanye d Amagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabantu abathathu abakwazi ukuqinisekisa umuntu ophakanyisiwe. Iziphakamiso ngeke zicatshangelwe uma konke okukhulunywe ngenhla kungafakiwe.
Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi kuyigama elivunywa emhlabeni jikelele. Yini "ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni"? Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kuyisibopho somthetho sabashicileli bezinhlobo zonke zezincwadi ukufaka inani elithile lamakhophi alokhu kubhaliswa ezindaweni ezithile lapho lezi zincwadi zibhaliswa khona ngokusemthethweni. Izincwadi kumele zithunyelwe ezindaweni ezisemthethweni ngokwezimali zomshicileli, futhi lokhu kumele kwenziwe phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 zokushicilelwa. Inhloso yokubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokwenza kube khona ulwazi namagugu amasiko ezwe, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela mahhala kuzo zonke izincwadi ezitholakalayo. Umthetho ophathelene nalokhu wawukhuliswa nguMthetho Wamalungelo Okushicilela ka-1965 kanye noMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni ka-1982, kuze kube umthetho wamanje, uMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni washicilelwa ngo-1997, obandakanya ukufakwa kwezincwadi ze-elektroniki naleyo ebonakalayo. Incwadi iyinto enezinto ezihlosiwe zokugcina noma ukudlulisa umlayezo ngombhalo, isithombe, umsindo, noma iyiphi indlela yokuxhumana enokuqukethwe okucabangayo. Yini okufanele ifakwe? Amakhadi ezimali noma ama-check. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kuzo zonke izincwadi ezishicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika. Kuyisikhumbuzo sezincwadi zonke ezikhiqizwe yizwe. Kuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yemisebenzi yonke eshicilelwe igcinwa futhi itholakala ukuze ibolekwe. Igcina umsebenzi wababhali nabashicileli ukuze usebenze ngocwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo. Ikha umgogodla wokuhlanganisa Umlando Kazwelonke weNingizimu Afrika, okwenza abathengi bayo bazi ngezincwadi ezikhona, ngaleyo ndlela kuthuthukiswe ukusabalalisa nokumaketha kwazo. Inombolo yokuxhumana yokusiza itholakala eMnyangweni Wezincwadi weNingizimu Afrika ukuze kucaciswe izinto eziphathelene nokubhaliswa okusemthethweni.
Inhloso yeKomidi ukuhlanganisa nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kweMthetho Wokufaka Izincwadi ka-1997. Umsebenzi oyinhloko weKomidi ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuNgqongqoshe ngezindaba ezihlobene nalesi Mthetho, ukwenza izincomo kuNgqongqoshe mayelana nanoma yiziphi iziqondiso uNgqongqoshe angazikhupha ngaphansi kwaleli Mthetho, ukuhlela imisebenzi eyenziwa izikhungo zokufaka izincwadi, ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko ezikhungweni zokufaka izincwadi ngezindaba ezihlobene nalesi Mthetho, nokwakha amaqembu amancane noma amaqembu okusebenza uma kudingeka ukuze kuhlolwe noma yiziphi imisebenzi ehambelana nokuphumeleliswa kwaleli Mthetho. Ababhalisile kumele temsilise abathintekayo abaneziqu emkhakheni wezincwadi futhi benze izinzuzo kulwazi; umkhakha wezokushicilela; ukuphathwa, ezemali, nezindaba zomnotho; kanye/noma ulwazi kanye/noma uthando lwezincwadi ezishicilelwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukunikela ngomuntu ozokhonza kwiKomidi Lezincwadi kumele aqedele futhi athumele ifomu elisemthethweni lokunikeza iziphakamiso eMnyangweni Wezobuciko neZamasiko. A: Incwadi enikeza amagama aphelele nemininingwane yokuxhumana yomuntu ophakanyisiwe, echaza iziqu zabo zokubekwa ngokusekelwe ezicini ezishiwo ngenhla, kanye namagama nemininingwane yokuxhumana kwabantu abathathu abaqinisekisa lowo ophakanyisiwe. B: Incwadi yokwamukela isiphakamiso ebhalwe lowo ophakanyisiwe. a Isihloko namagama aphelele g Ulwazi lwezempilo oluhambelana b Inombolo yokukhomba h Izigaba zamakhono c Ubuzwe i Ukubhaliswa ezinhlanganweni, d Imininingwane yokuxhumana ephelele amabhodi njll. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi lokhu akusikhangiso somsebenzi. Imiholo yamalungu eKomidi Lezincwadi izobe ikhawulelwe ekubuyiseleni izindleko zokuhamba nezokuhlala uma behlangana kabili ngonyaka (ePitoli noma kwezinye izindawo).
Umthetho Wokuphatha Abantu Abamnyama 38 ka-1927, isigaba 11 (b): Wonke owesifazane oshade ngokwenkolo yesiko (ngaphandle kwabesifazane eKwaZulu-Natal) uzobhekwa njengengane. Isimo sowesifazane silingana nesengane ngaphandle kwamalungelo omuntu omdala (ongakafiki eminyakeni engu-21). Owesifazane akanaso isithunzi sokugcina ingane ngoba ubhekwa ngumuntu. Owesifazane akakwazi ukusaina isivumelwano somthetho ngaphandle kosizo lwem husband noma uyise. Owesifazane akakwazi ukufaka amalungelo kodwa ungumfanekiso okumele wenziwe yilowo onelungelo. Umthetho wesiko uthinta kanjani igunya lokugcina ingane? Ngaphansi komthetho wesiko, ukugcina ingane kuyilungelo elinikezwa umuntu nempilo yakhe ngokushada. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umuntu ekhokhele lobola/umshado, yena nomndeni wakhe bathola amalungelo aphelele okuba abazali ezinganeni ezazalwe kulowo mshado. Umthwalo wokugcina izingane emshadweni uphakathi komuntu, umkakhe, nomndeni wakhe. Umthwalo wokugcina izingane zowesifazane ongashadile uphakathi kukhulu wokhokho bezingane nomndeni wakhe. Uma intombazane ishada futhi ibe nengane ekhaya, igunya lokugcina le ntombazane nezingane zayo lidluliselwa kumuntu okhokhele lobola nomndeni wakhe omusha. Ngakho-ke, umthwalo wokugcina ingane ngokwenkolo yesiko ushintsha izandla kuphela emgibeni wesilisa (emshadweni), futhi izingane ziba yingxenye yomndeni wesilisa. Ukugcina ingane kwenziwa ngumuntu egameni lomndeni wakhe. Ingane noma izingane ezazalwe ekhaya azibhekwa ngaphansi komthetho wesiko ngoba ingane yayihlala ekhaya, kwesinye isikhathi ihlala nabokhokho bayo besifazane (ngaphambi komshado) noma ihlala nomndeni omusha wombuso lapho umama wayo eshada, okuthathwe kokukhuluma okuthi "inkunzi ithengwa ngethanga layo." Kukhona isidingo sokucacisa uhlobo lomshado owesifazane angaba kuwo. Izingane ezazalwe ngaphakathi komshado: Lezi zingane zomuntu nomndeni wakhe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ngempela uyise. Kulindeleke ukuthi ukhulu wokhokho bezingane wamukele lezi zingane njengokwakhe futhi agcwalise yonke imithwalo yokuba abazali nezinhloso ezihlobene nazo. Ukufa komuntu akusho ukuphela kobudlelwano bomshado. Izingane zomfelokazi zihlukaniswa kanje: (i) izingane zomuntu oshade nomfelokazi. Ngaphansi kwesiko lokushada komfelokazi, umshado okhona uqhubeka nomfelokazi nomuntu entering esikhundleni somufi futhi uqhubeka ngamalungelo akhe. Umfelokazi nezingane zakhe zikhuliswa ngumuntu entering empilweni yomfelokazi. Umuntu entering umfelokazi uvame ukuba omunye wabazali bomndeni womufi. Umndeni womufi unomthwalo wokunakekela umfelokazi impilo yakhe yonke nokuzibophezela ekuzaleni izingane ezizobanjwa ngumuntu entering futhi onikezwe yona. Izingane ezazalwe kumfelokazi nomuntu entering umfelokazi zizohlala zibhekwa njengokhulu bomufi. Ngisho nasezikhathini lapho umuntu engena kumkakhe, uma umfelokazi ezala izingane, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ngempela uyise noma abezayo, zizohlala zibhekwa njengokhulu bomufi nomndeni wakhe. Ngemuva kokuhlukana, izingane zivame kushiywa nomndeni womuntu. Imithetho eminingi yesiko ayivumeli owesifazane ukuthi aphinde ashade ngenkathi esaphila ngaphansi komndeni wendoda yakhe. Kumele abuyele emndenini wakhe uma efuna ukuphinda ashade. Uma ephinda ashade, ingane ezalwe kumfazi ohlukanisiwe emshadweni wakhe wesibili ibhekwa njengengane yomshado, ngakho-ke belonging kumndeni womuntu wesibili. Umuntu womshado wesibili ungumgibeli noma umgibeli walezi zingane. Emshadweni wesibili, umfazi ohlukanisiwe akamukelwa ngumuntu womshado wesibili ukuba alethe izingane zakhe emshadweni wabo. (okukhuluma ukuthi izingane zikhula zikhuliswa uyise emva kokubuyela kubo ngemuva kokuhlukana), ngaphansi kwalesi simo, umuntu womshado omusha uletha izingane zakhe emshadweni. Imigomo yesigaba 11 (b) yeMthetho Wokuphatha Abantu Abamnyama yayihloselwe ukuphatha isimo lapho owesifazane ezohlala engane ngenkathi umuntu ezoba umgibeli wakhe. Umphumela walesi sigaba uthi: abesifazane abangashadile babhekwa njengabantu abadala (baphezulu kweminyaka engu-21) ngenkathi abesifazane abamnyama abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 abashadile ngokwenkolo yesiko bebhekwa njengengane. Owesifazane omnyama oshade ngaphansi komthetho wesiko unamalungelo akhe omdala aphansi ngenxa yomshado noma uma engaphansi kweminyaka engu-21, ngokwemigomo yeMthetho Wokufika Kwezimali Nezikhala. Isimo sabo sinciphisa ikhono labo lokungena ezivumelwaneni zomthetho, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bodwa noma uma befuna temsilise izingane zabo. Ngakho-ke, umthetho wesiko lwama-Afrika awuqinisekisi abesifazane base-Afrika isithunzi esifanele nokwelashwa ngaphansi komthetho ngendlela eyasungulwa nguMthethosisekelo kazwelonke. Ngakho-ke, lesi sigaba sikhuthaza ukwehlukaniswa kwabantu besifazane okukhuluma ngohlobo, ngakho-ke kuhambisana noMthethosisekelo. Lesi sigaba siqinisa isiko lokulawula elinika amandla wonke kumadoda ukulawula impilo nezimpahla zabesifazane. Umthetho wokugcina izingane unika bobabili abazali amandla okugcina izingane. Umuntu ubhekwa njengoyise bezingane futhi akakwazi ukuziphika. Ngenxa yemvelo yokukhulelwa kwabo nokuzalwa, abakwazi ukuhlukaniswa futhi abakwazi ukuhlukaniswa nezinye izingane ezazalwe emshadweni. Umuntu ungumgibeli nomgibeli wezingane, enomthwalo wokuzamukela njengokunye izingane ezazalwe ngemuva kokwakhiwa kwesibopho somshado. Lezi zingane zingamalunga omndeni womuntu. Uyise wezingane akanaso isithunzi noma amalungelo ngazo. Ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, izingane ezazalwe ngemuva kokungena komkakhe nazo zifakiwe. Ngale ndlela, umthetho wesiko uhambisana nesigaba 8 soMthethosisekelo futhi awukwehlukanisi izingane ngokusekelwe kumthombo wazo nokuzalwa. Z belonging kumndeni wakwabo. Uma owesifazane eshada nomama wakhe, yena nomyeni wakhe bazogcina lezi zingane. Umuntu uthola igunya lokuba abazali bezingane ezazalwe ngokuhambisana nesisho esithi "inkunzi ihamba ngethanga layo." Akukho ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwalezi zingane nezingane zomshado. Ngakho-ke, akukho ukwehlukaniswa phakathi kwezingane ngendlela engase ihlasele uMthethosisekelo. Uma umama eshiya umndeni womuntu, ushiyela izingane. Uma efuna ukuphikisa lesi simo, yena nomgibeli wakhe kumele bathathe izinyathelo zokukhombisa ukuthi umuntu akafaneleki futhi akafaneleki ukuhlala nezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi njalo kukhona uphawu lokukhetha umuntu nomndeni wakhe njengabantu okufanele banakekele izingane. Banikezwa igunya elingaphikiswa lokugcina izingane. Ezinye izimo lapho izingane zingashiywa ekunakekelweni kwabomama bazo zenzeka lapho zisakhuliswa (zithola ubisi). Lokhu kuyisibonelo esisodwa lapho izidingo zengane ziba phezulu kunegunya elingaphikiswa likayise lokugcina izingane.
Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) yisiphetho esenziwe ngabaholi base-Afrika, esisekelwe embonweni yabo yokuhlanganyela kanye nokukholwa okuqinile ukuthi banomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphelisa ubumpofu nokufaka amazwe abo, ngokwehlukana noma ngokuhlanganyela, endleleni yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa ngenkathi bebamba iqhaza emnothweni nasemphakathini womhlaba. Le nqubo isekelwe ekuzimiseleni kwabantu base-Afrika ukukhulula abazimele kanye nalesi siqhingi ezinselelweni zokungathuthukiswa nokuhlukumezeka emhlabeni. Ubumphofu nokuhlukumezeka e-Afrika kuphikisana nempumelelo yezizwe ezithuthukile. Ukuqhubeka kokuhlukumezeka kwe-Afrika emhlabeni jikelele kanye nokuhlukumezeka kwezobuhlanga nezomnotho kuletha ukwesaba nokungazinzi emhlabeni. Ukukhula komphakathi womhlaba, ukubolekwa kwezimali, kanye nosizo phakathi kwamazwe amabili (okubili) kube yisisekelo somqondo wokuthuthukisa i-Afrika. Ukubolekwa kuholele ekuqoqweni okukhulu kwezinsiza, okukhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokukhokha ngama-inthanethi noma ukulibazisa isikhathi esizayo, futhi kuhlala kuyisithiyo esikhulu ekukhuleni kwamazwe ase-Afrika. Isikhumbuzo sokuzimela sesifinyelelwe. Mayelana nezinye izici zosizo lwamazwe amabili - sibona ukwehla kosizo lwabantu abathile kanye nokuncipha okukhulu kwenani eliphelele losizo, eliwela phansi kwezinga elibekwe ngawo ngeminyaka yama-1970. E-Afrika, cishe abantu abayizigidi eziyi-340 noma ingxenye yokuhlala kwabantu emhlabeni baphila ngaphansi kuka-$1 ngosuku. Ukufa kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu kungalinganiswa ku-140 ngezingane eziyi-1,000, kuyilapho ukuphila okuphakade ekuzalweni kungama-54 kuphela. Kukhona kuphela u-58% wabantu abathola amanzi aphephile. Abantu abangenalo imfundo abangaphezu kweminyaka engu-15 bangalinganiswa ku-41%. Kukhona kuphela imigqa yocingo eyi-18 kubantu abayi-1,000 e-Afrika, uma kuqhathaniswa no-146 emhlabeni jikelele no-567 ezwenikazi elinengeniso ephezulu. Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) ibiza umhlaba ukuthi uphendule kule ndaba ekhathazayo ngokushintsha ubudlelwane obubalulekile kulokhu. Abantu base-Afrika abaceli ukuqhubeka nokuthembele osizini noma ezandleni zezimali. Bajabule ukuthi leli thuba lomlando lizophela ubumpofu bokungathuthukiswa obujolile e-Afrika. Ingcebo, ehlanganisa imali, ubuchwepheshe, amakhono abantu, adingekayo ukuze balwe nobumpofu nokungathuthukiswa, manje isiyatholakala futhi iyatholakala kalula. Lokhu okukhona manje kudinga abaholi abanesibindi kanye nokuzimisela okuvela enhliziyweni ekuthuthukiseni abantu nasekuphumeleleni ubumpofu, nokubamba iqhaza emhlabeni omusha osuselwa ekuzimiseleni kwabo bonke nasekuzuzweni komphakathi. Kulo lonke isiqhingi, abantu base-Afrika bathembisa ukuthi abasoze bavumele ukuba baphathwe njengezimo. Sizokwakha ikusasa lethu futhi sicele umhlaba ukusiza emizamweni yethu. Sekukhona izimpawu zempumelelo ngethemba. Inani lezikahulumeni ezilawulayo ezibophezele ekuvikelweni kwamalungelo abantu, ukuthuthukiswa okubhekiswe kubantu, kanye nezomnotho ezinikeza amathuba ezohwebo kuyanda. Abantu base-Afrika sebevele baqala ukukhombisa ukuthi abasoze bavumele abaholi bezomnotho nezepolitiki ukuthi babaphoshe. Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) igxile ekuqineni nasekusheshiseni lezi zimpumelelo. Kuyisixwayiso sokubambisana okusha phakathi kwe-Afrika nomhlaba, ikakhulukazi lezi zizwe ezinezimboni, ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nesikhala sokuthuthukiswa esiqhubekayo iminyaka eminingi ngenxa yobudlelwane obungalingani noma obuhlukumezayo. Indawo ye-Afrika emphakathini womhlaba ichazwa njengendawo lapho umhlaba unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze ube usizo ngempela kubo bonke abantu iminyaka eminingi. Izindawo zezilwane nezinsiza zakudala ezibonisa uguquko lomhlaba, ukuphila, nomndeni womuntu. Ingxenye I iyindawo eyaziwa kakhulu. Ingxenye II isanda kuvela, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwezindaba zemvelo. Ingxenye III iphinde ivele yona, ibonakala njengento efanele ukunakwa hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wesayensi noma kulabo abathanda ukuvikelwa kwemithombo (izikhumbuzo) nalabo abakubuka. Lokhu kuyingxenye IV, ebonisa amandla abantu base-Afrika, angasetshenziswa noma athuthukiswe ngokuphelele ngezindlela eziningi. Kucacile ukuthi, ngaphandle kokuthi imiphakathi eyakhiwe ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphezulu okushisa ingaguqulwa, ezinye izindlela zokuphila zizobamba iqhaza ekubhujiseni izihlahla. Njengoba ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kuzothokozisa bonke abantu, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Afrika ibekwe endleleni yokuthuthukiswa futhi ingabeki izinsiza zayo engcupheni. Isayensi yesimanje yamukela ukuthi i-Afrika iyisikhungo somuntu. Njengengxenye yokwakha nokuqinisa isithunzi nokuzethemba kwabantu base-Afrika, kubalulekile ukuthi le mnikelo yomuntu ibonwe noma iqashelwe futhi ithathwe njengengcebo ngabo bonke abantu base-Afrika. Isikhundla se-Afrika njengesisekelo somuntu kufanele sibhakanyiswe umhlaba wonke njengomlando wabantu bayo bonke. Ngakho-ke, Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika kufanele igcine leli thongo futhi isebenzise ukuze yakhe ukuqwashisa ngalolu shintsho oluphuthumayo lokuphelisa ukungathuthukiswa nokuhlukumezeka kulolu siqhingi. I-Afrika inendima ebalulekile yokudlondlobala uxhumano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo emhlabeni. Ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe kugcizelela indima edlalwa abantu ekukhiqizeni, belwa nendawo yabo enqubweni yokukhiqiza besebenzisa amathuluzi abo leso sikhathi noma esizayo. I-flora, fauna, nezilwane ezihlukile ezitholakala kuphela e-Afrika zinikeza abantu ithuba lokugcina uxhumano lwabo nemvelo. I-Afrika isivele idlale indima ebonakalayo emasikweni omhlaba, ezincwadini zizwe, emculweni, emculweni, nasemkhakheni wezamasiko, kodwa amandla ayo awakaze asetshenziswe ngokuphelele ngenxa yokungabi khona kokuhlanganiswa ngokuphelele emnothweni womhlaba. Ibhodi Elisha Elisha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika izovumela i-Afrika ukuba ikhulise indima yayo esayensini, emasikweni, nasobuchwepheshe. Kulesi sikhathi esisha, njengoba abantu befuna indlela entsha yokwakha umhlaba ongcono, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlanganise ukuhlukahluka kanye nezifiso zabantu ukuze sibe nalesi siqhingi esikhuluma ngezinga elilinganayo lokubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukisweni kwes civilization yomuntu. Ukuncipha kwalolu siqhingi lwe-Afrika kugcizelelwe ukuphathwa kwalesi siqhingi ngamazwe amanye, impi engenemikhonto, ukuhlukumezeka kwesistimu yomnotho yomhlaba, kanye nokwehluleka noma ukunganeliseki kwemigomo elandelwe ngamanye amazwe ngemuva kokuthola uzibuse. Iminyaka eminingi, i-Afrika ibambe iqhaza emnothweni womhlaba njengomthombo wezisebenzi ezishibhile nezinto ezibonakalayo. Lokhu kuholele ekunciphiseni kwezingcebo ze-Afrika esikhundleni sokuthi kusetshenziswe ukuthuthukisa leli siqhingi. Umfutho ngaleso sikhathi wokusebenzisa izinto ezibonakalayo nezinto zokwakha ukuthuthukisa imboni yokukhiqiza
Ukuze kubusiswe ngendlela ehlelekile futhi ngokuhambisana nemithetho yeNhlangano Yezempilo Yezwe leRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nokuhambisana nezibopho zomthetho nezomthethosisekelo zikamasipala, izifunda, kanye nohulumeni bendawo mayelana nosizo lwezempilo; ukuze kuthuthukiswe kahle amalungelo nezibopho zabasebenzisi beNhlangano Yezempilo Yezwe kanye nalabo abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo abasebenza ngaphansi kwalesi sisetshenziswa; ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvuma okwaziwayo kwabathengi bohlelo kanye nokufihlwa kolwazi lwabathengi; ukuze kuphathwe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zezempilo zendawo ukuze uMnyango Wezempilo WaseNingizimu Afrika ukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yawo kahle; ukuze kusungulwe izisekelo zendawo ezizokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zezempilo ezizweni futhi kunikezwe izeluleko kuNgqongqoshe Wezempilo Wasezifundazweni mayelana nezinhlelo zezempilo nezicwangciso zezempilo zendawo; ukuze kuphathwe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zezempilo zendawo ukuze kuhlangane nezicwangciso zezempilo zendawo; ukuze kusungulwe uHlelo Lwezempilo Lwasezifundazweni oluzohlukanisa iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ngezifunda zezempilo; ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa nokubhekwa kwezindawo zezempilo kanye nezindawo zazo ezincane ngenkathi kunikezwa usizo lwezempilo lwezifunda ngezikhungo; ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulungiswa kwezicwangciso zezempilo zendawo; ukuze kulawulwe izikhungo zezempilo ngokuhambisana nohlelo lokuthola imvume nezidingo futhi kuqhutshwe izicwangciso zokuhambisana nokulandela umthetho; ukuze kuphathwe futhi kulawulwe ukwethulwa kwemicimbi ezikhungweni zezempilo zikamasipala nezizimele, ezikhungweni zezempilo kanye nasemaphandleni angaphansi kwezempilo; ukuze kubhekwane nezibopho ezithile ezikhungweni zezempilo ezizimele; ukuze kuthuthukiswe izicwangciso nezindlela zokwakha izidingo nezinga eliphakeme; ukuze kuphathwe ukuthuthukiswa nokwabiwa kwemithombo yezinsiza zabantu ngaphakathi kweNhlangano Yezempilo Yezwe; ukuze kusungulwe ikomidi elisemthethweni labachwepheshe bezempilo kanye nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo zokwelapha nezokufundisa, amaqembu awo okuxhumanisa kanye nekhomidi kazwelonke yezikhungo zokwelapha nezokufundisa; ukuze kuhanjiswe uhlelo lokuhlinzeka ngogazi lwaseNingizimu Afrika; ukuze kulawulwe ukutholakala, ukugcinwa, nokusetshenziswa kwezicubu, igazi, imikhiqizo yegazi, kanye nezinto zokuzala zomuntu, kanye nokunikezwa nokuhlinzekwa kwezitho nezicubu; ukuze kuvinjwe ukwakhiwa komuntu futhi kulawulwe ucwaningo oluhambisana nezicubu zomuntu nezizalo; ukuze kuphathwe ukuhlolwa kwezidumbu nokuphathwa kwazo zonke izinto ezihlobene nezicubu, izitho, igazi, imikhiqizo yegazi, kanye nezinto zokuzala; ukuze kusungulwe Ikomidi Lokucwaninga Ngempilo Kazwelonke nezindlela zokunquma amaphuzu abalulekile ocwaningo; ukuze kusungulwe Ikomidi Lokuphatha elibhekelela izinga eliphakeme kanye nehhovisi elibhekelela ukuhambisana nezinga elibekwe; ukuze kusungulwe Ikomidi Lokuphatha elibhekelela ubuqotho bocwaningo lwezempilo nokubhekelela uhlelo lokwazisa ngezempilo kazwelonke; ukuze kuqondiswe imisebenzi nezibopho zabaphathi bezempilo nezinga lokuhlola; ukuze kuphathwe izimiso nezinhlelo ezihlobene nezempilo; futhi ukuze kuphathwe izindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. Ukugcina, ukuhlola, ukusebenzisa, ukuphuma, ukuhlukanisa, noma ukuhlinzeka noma ukuqubuka kwanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwegazi elithathwe kumuntu noma igazi elitholwe kwamanye amazwe, ukuze lisetshenziswe, njengoba likhona, ingxenye yalo noma ngendlela yomkhiqizo wegazi kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi izingxenye ezitholakala kubantu. Ukukhiqizwa, ukupakisha, ukuvalwa, nokubhala kwanoma yimuphi umkhiqizo wegazi noma ukuhlinzeka ngawo, noma ukuwuphuma nganoma iyiphi indlela, kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi izingxenye ezikhona. Ukuthatha noma ukugcina igazi elithathwe kumuntu ukuze lisetshenziswe futhi ngaleyo ndlela. Ukuphathwa kwezwi, kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi ukuphathwa kwezempilo yomphakathi, ukuphathwa kwemfucumfucu yezokwelapha, nokuphathwa kwezinto eziyingozi. Igama elithi "ukukhulisa" libhekisela emiphumeleni yokuhlangana kweqanda lesifazane ne-sperm yomfana (ukukhulisa). Ngokwesigaba -146 seMthethosisekelo, lapho kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi kwalokho okukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi nalokho okukhuluma ngeminye imithetho yezempilo, ngaphandle kwemithetho ethinta ngqo lesi sikhathi, lokho okukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi kuzosebenza. Izingane zithola izinhlelo eziqondile ezihlobene nosizo lwezempilo; futhi zibuye zibhekane nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umnyango kahulumeni kufanele uhlinzeke ngezinsiza zezempilo njengokubaluleka okukhulu futhi uhlole izidingo zezempilo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinsiza ezikhona. Umnyango kazwelonke kanye nazo zonke izifunda nezikhungo zomphakathi kufanele zisungule izinsiza ezifanele zezempilo kanye nosizo lwezempilo lwezikhungo ngokuhambisana nalolu hlelo, futhi zonke izikhungo, zonke izikhungo zezempilo zikamasipala kanye nabahlinzeki bezinsiza zezempilo kufanele bahlinzeke ngezinsiza zezempilo ngokwezinga lokukwazi kwabo nezinsiza. UMnyango Wezempilo Kazwelonke, umnyango wezifunda, izikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nalabo abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo kufanele benze ngokuhambisana nalolu hlelo lapho bephatha amandla athile nemisebenzi ethile ehlobene nezempilo. UNgqongqoshe unelungelo lokukhetha, ngaphansi kwezimo ezivumela abantu abathile noma amaqembu abantu ukuthola izinsiza zezempilo zamahhala ezikhungweni zezempilo zikamasipala. Umthelela walezi zimo ekutholakaleni kosizo oluvela kubahlinzeki bezinsiza zezempilo. Izingxenye zikazwelonke nezifunda, amakomidi wezempilo ezifundazweni, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi olwaneleyo nolugcwele ludluliselwa ezinsizeni zezempilo ezibhekelele. Abahlinzeki bezinsiza zezempilo nezikhungo zezinsiza zezempilo abakwazi ukuvimbela umuntu ukufinyelela ekwelashweni okuphuthumayo. Wonke umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo yabo nokwelashwa. Uma umsebenzisi engakwazi ukubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo yabo nokwelashwa, noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ophephethe ngokuqondile ngumthetho noma umyalelo wenkantolo ukuze amele umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo nokwelashwa komsebenzisi. Uhlelo Lokuxhaswa Kwezokuthuthukiswa Kwebhizinisi Labaqashi Abamnyama (BBSDP) uhlelo lokwabelana ngezindleko ngesisekelo se-80:20%, oluxhasa amabhizinisi aphethwe ngabantu abamnyama eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo lunikeza lezi zinkampani indlela yokufinyelela ezinsizeni zokuthuthukiswa kwebhizinisi ukuze zandise amakhono azo, zithuthukise amandla okuphatha, futhi zihlukanise ukuze zibe nomncintiswano omkhulu. Izinhlaka eziningi zinezimboni eziphethwe ngabantu abamnyama (ngokubambisana okungama-50+1), futhi kukhona nezinkampani eziningi eziphethwe ngabantu abamnyama. Izinkampani zingathola usizo oluvela ku-BBSDP olungafika ku-R12 million ngonyaka. Isimo esibalulekile sokufaneleka ukuze uthole usizo ukuthi inkampani kumele ibe sebenza okungenani unyaka owodwa futhi ibambe iqhaza kwezohwebo. I-BBSDP ihlose ukukhulisa amabhizinisi aphethwe ngabantu abamnyama ngokuwaxhumanisa nezinkampani ezincane eziphethwe ngabantu abamnyama (SMMEs) futhi ixhumanise nezinhlangano ezinkulu kanye nomkhakha wezohwebo wombuso. I-BBSDP ibambisana futhi ixhumanisa nohlelo lokwabiwa kwemithombo yokuthenga kulabo abake babhekana namathuba alinganiselwe, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngamathuba okuphuma emsebenzini, okuhlinzekwa yizinkampani ezinkulu kanye nomkhakha wezohwebo wombuso. Inhloso wukuthi izimboni zithole ukwabiwa okumele kukhishwe ekutholeni imithombo yokuthenga ezinkampanini ezinkulu kanye nezinkampani zomphakathi kanye namathuba okuphuma emsebenzini. Inani elikhulu lokuxhaswa okungatholwa yizimboni ngalinye lingafika ku-R100,000 (izinkulungwane eziyi-100 rand). Inkampani eyodwa ingavunyelwa ukufaka izicelo zamaphrojekthi ahlukene, kodwa inani eliphelele lokuxhaswa alinakudlula u-R100,000. Zonke izindleko ezihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo zebhizinisi, kuhlanganise nezokuhamba nezinye izindleko zokuphila, zizokwenziwa ngokwabelana ngezindleko. Izindleko zokushicilela izinto kanye nezindleko ezihlobene nekhompyutha, kuhlanganise nezindleko zokuqala zamaphrojekthi, nazo zizohlinzekwa, uma zingadluli ku-50% yezindleko eziphelele zamaphrojekthi. Izinkampani zingakhetha ukuthi zizosebenzisa kanjani abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, kulandela isimo sokuthi okungenani abathathu kumele babe khona ekukhetheni kulabo abaphakamisile imithombo yokuthenga. Amaphrojekthi ahloselwe ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokuphatha ezisebenzayo, ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wendawo jikelele nasekuhleleni ukukhiqiza ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ze-ISO 9000 ne-ISO 14000, kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo zebhizinisi zesikhathi eside, phakathi kokunye. Ukuxhaswa ngokwabelana ngezindleko kuzotholakala lapho kudingeka kwezidingo ezihlobene nekhompyutha nezifanekiso noma amabhroshuru asekelayo inqubo yokuphatha ezingeni eliphezulu futhi esebenza kahle. Amaphrojekthi ahloselwe ukusiza ithimba lokuphatha lenkampani ngokuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuqeqesha emikhakheni ehlukene, ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa kwezokuphatha eziphakeme, izinhlelo zokuphatha noma zokuphatha kwezezimali, ama-workshop okuhlela imithombo yokuthenga ezinkampanini zomphakathi kanye nezinhlangano ezinkulu, phakathi kokunye. Amaphrojekthi ahloselwe ukusiza inkampani ukuthi ingene emkhakheni othile, ngokwesibonelo, ucwaningo lwemakethe nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokumaketha, izifanekiso, nokuthuthukiswa kwezinto zokumaketha, njengezinhlelo zewebhusayithi, phakathi kokunye. Ukwabiwa kwezindleko zokwabelana emikhakheni ethile kuzohlinzekwa ukuze kusizwe ekushicileleni amabhroshuru alwazi nezinto ezihlobene ukuze zisetshenziswe ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokumaketha.
Ukungenisa izinsizakalo zomphakathi ezweni kuzohlale kuyisithwathwa esinzima. Uhlaka lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ludinga uhlelo lokwethula izidingo zomphakathi ezihlobene, oluhlanganisa imikhakha futhi luhlukanise iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni nemikhakha yazo. Le nhlanganisela nokubambisana kungenzeka kuphela uma kwakhiwe phezu kwesisekelo semikhuba nemigomo yokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kugcizelela isidingo sobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke, zendawo, nezifundazwe. Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule, ingxoxo ngezinto ezakha umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ibibe phambili ezinkulumweni, ngokuvamile ingacacile futhi ingaqondakali kahle. Kusukela ngo-1994, sibe nengxoxo ezingeni elihlukene ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zethu zifinyelela ezingeni elifanele ukuze sikhuthaze imikhakha ethukile futhi ehluphekayo yomphakathi. Indlela entsha emlandweni wezwe ibonisa ushintsho emsebenzini wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi obheke emcabangweni ophumelelayo wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi okukhomba abantu abayizigidi abahlala ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka, ukuntuleka, kanye nokungabi nokufinyelela kwezinsiza. Lo shintsho wakhiwe embonweni yokuthi abantu kufanele bakhuthazwe ukuba baqonde lokho abakufunayo ezimpilweni zabo. Lo mbono, ohlukile endleleni yesiko yokupha kwabampofu, uhlose ukuthuthukisa nokuhlinzeka ngamathuba abantu, amaqembu, nemiphakathi ukuze ibe nokuzimela, okuzosiza umnyango futhi kubambisane nawo ekubhekaneni nezinselelo zomphakathi nezomnotho ezibhekene nomnyango nezwe lethu. Sizokwenza lokhu ngoba sikholwa ukuthi lezi zifiso zizokwenza kube namandla uhlelo lapho izidingo zethulwa khona futhi inhlalakahle jikelele ithuthukiswe, kuthuthukiswe ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu bethu. Uhlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi luveza kahle imizamo yethu eqhubekayo yokwethula isimo sezidingo zomphakathi kubantu abahluphekayo kakhulu nemiphakathi ethukile. Ngasikhathi sinye, siqoqa idatha nezinkomba zezidingo zezinsiza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka ngendlela efanele. Sithemba ukuthi lolu hlelo luzosiza wonke umuntu ekubhekaneni nezinselelo esihlangabezane nazo eminyakeni eyishumi edlule mayelana nokwethulwa kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Okubaluleke kakhulu, sithemba ukuthi uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi luzokwenza kube namandla futhi luqinisekise ukubambisana nazo zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ekuthuthukiseni ubulungiswa bomphakathi nokubambisana okuhloswe ukufezekisa umgomo owodwa "Impilo Engcono Kubo Bonke." Umnyango ufisa ukuveza ukubonga okujulile kwiThimba Lezabelo elizinikele ekuShintsheni elithumele kakhulu ekwenzeni isinqumo sokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi. Leli thimba liqukethe amalungu avela ezingeni likazwelonke nezifundazwe, kanti uMongameli walo nguNksz. N. Kela, uMphakathi-Jikelele Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zokuphila (ezingeni likazwelonke). Kungenxa yokuhlanganyela kwaleli thimba ukuthi singakujabulela ukusho ukuthi sakhe isisekelo esedlula ezinselelweni ezikhona ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi indima edlalwa iyasiza izigidi zabantu abahluphekayo eNingizimu Afrika abakulindele umsebenzi wethu. Umnyango uphinde ufise ukuqaphela iminikelo eyenziwe abanye ababambiqhaza kuyo yonke imiphakathi eyisishiyagalolunye, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, iSikhungo Sobungcweti Bokusebenza Komphakathi, izinyunyana, ama-NGO, ama-FBO, ama-CBO, nezinye izikhungo ezathatha ingxenye ngesikhathi senqubo yokubonisana futhi zabelane ngemibono yazo kulolu documeti. Ukubambisana nezinye izikhungo zomphakathi kuzohlale kuyinto ebalulekile emizamweni kahulumeni nasemsebenzini wawo wokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo nokwenza lokho okuzinikele. Umqondo woHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi... Inhloso yoHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi... Umbiko wezithelo ezilindelekile... Imikhuba nezindinganiso ezilindelekile zoHlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi... Izinqumo zezinqubomgomo nemiyalo yeMthethosisekelo... Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi olukhombisa izidingo ezigxile ekuthuthukisweni... Uhlobo nobuningi bokuthuthukiswa komphakathi... Abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo/Izindlela zezikhungo... Ukusekela uHlelo Lokwethulwa Kwezidingo Zomphakathi... Izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi oqhubekayo nokuphatha izinguquko... Umnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi ubonisa izidingo ezihlukene ezintathu ezibanzi: inhlalakahle yomphakathi, izidingo zokuphila komphakathi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lezi zinhlelo kufanele ziqhutshelwe phambili futhi zisize imiphakathi eqondile ekubhekaneni nazo zonke izinkinga zomphakathi nezimo ezifana nempilo yengqondo, ubumpofu obukhulu, ukungabi nokudla, nezimo zomphakathi ezinzima. Lezi zimo zidalile isidingo sokugcizelela indlela yokuthuthukiswa egxile ekukhuthazeni abantu, amaqembu, noma imiphakathi futhi ibonise amandla abo okukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ukuqaphela isidingo sokukhuthaza imigomo yokuthuthukiswa ngenkathi kubhekwa ukungalingani komlando, umkhakha wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi uthathile indlela yokuthuthukiswa njengendlela yokwethula izidingo ezihlosiwe zokuhlanganisa izinhlelo zomphakathi kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Eminyakeni yamuva, abathuthukisi bomphakathi baphoqelekile ukuba bamukele izinyathelo zesikhashana ezibekwe yizinkinga zezinsiza ezikhona, noma lezi zidingo eziphuthumayo, izidingo zomthetho, noma izibopho ezichazwe ezingeni lomhlaba. Ngakho-ke, umgomo oyinhloko woHlelo lweZidingo Zomphakathi kuMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uwukwethula uhlaka olukhulu lukazwelonke oluchaza kahle uhlobo, ububanzi, ubuningi, nezinga lomsebenzi olwakha uhlelo lokwethulwa kwezidingo zomphakathi emnyangweni wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi futhi luzosebenza njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa imikhuba ejwayelekile nezinga elifanele lokwethula izidingo zomphakathi. Umphumela olindelekile woHlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi uwukwethula nokwenza uhlelo olukhulu, olusebenza kahle ngendlela eqondile nenhle eluthuthukisa umphakathi ozimela, oluhambisana nemikhuba esunguliwe kwiWhite Paper yoMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi kanye nezimiso zeBatho Pele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lugxile ezimisweni zomthethosisekelo, emthethweni, nasezindinganisweni zamazwe omhlaba, ezibalulekile kumnyango lapho kwethulwa khona izidingo zomphakathi. Uhlelo lwezidingo zomphakathi emsebenzini wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi lukhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemisebenzi emikhulu yomnyango, efana nezokuphepha komphakathi, izidingo zokuphila komphakathi, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Ngakho-ke, uhlelo lunikeza uhlaka lokuhlanganisa imisebenzi phakathi kwezinhlelo ezahlukene zomnyango. Nokho, izinkinga zomphakathi zixakile futhi zixhumene, zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngokubambisana nezinye izigaba, ngaleyo ndlela kugc
Uhulumeni uqale uhlelo lokwabelana ngama-parcel okudla emindenini ehluphekayo kakhulu. Kubalwe ukuthi uhulumeni uzosebenzisa u-R230 million kulo nyaka ukusiza emindenini engu-200,000 ebhekene nezinkinga zokuphila ukuze ifinyelele ekudleni okunempilo ngenkathi iphila ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka ezinzima. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imindeni enezingane. Okwamanje, kunezimuli eziyi-12,000 ezithola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Iminye imindeni izothola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo oluzoqala ngoMashi 2003. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ekudleni okunempilo okugcwele ama-vitamini nezinto ezidingekayo (ukuthuthukiswa kokudla). Ucelwa ukuthi ufunde imibuzo ngokucophelela futhi uphinde uphinde umaka ibhokisi elingaphansi kokuphendula okucabanga ukuthi kulungile kuwe. Uxhaswe ukuba uzame ukuphendula zonke imibuzo. Akekho; ngiyaxazulula izinkinga zami. Uthanda ukuya emhlanganweni wokufunda ngezihloko ezilandelayo? Ungamaka ibhokisi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu uma uphendula le mibuzo. Ukuhlukunyezwa komphumela ophumelelayo kulabo abakuzungezile, abangane, nomndeni. Isithunzi sakho emsebenzini kanye namalungelo akho njengomsebenzi one-HIV. Angidingi ulwazi ngalokhu. Izakhamuzi zomphakathi wez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele zimenyelwa ukuba zihlomule amalungu eBhodi leMnyuziyamu yaseRobben Island. Ibhodi izoba namalungu ayisixhenxe, azokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe wezobuDlelwano neMiphakathi. Okungenani elilodwa lamalungu kumele libe nolwazi ngezindaba zezimali. Uma kukhethwa abantu, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi abakhethiweyo kumele babe nolwazi olunzulu ng heritage kazwelonke, ubuchwepheshe obubanzi bezimali nokuphathwa, ulwazi lwezomthetho, nolwazi lokumaketha nokubambisana nezithakazelo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe uxhaso lwezocwaningo lwezesayensi, kanye nezibopho zokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zomphakathi kanye nobuchwepheshe obukhethekile emkhakheni wezokusebenza kweMnyuziyamu yaseRobben Island. Ukufakwa ngeke kucatshangelwe uma konke okukhuluma ngenhla kungafakiwe.
Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi kuyigama elaziwa emhlabeni jikelele. Yini "ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni"? Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kuyisibopho somthetho sabashicileli bazo zonke izinhlobo zeziphakamiso ukufaka inani elithile lezi zikhumbuzo ezindaweni ezithile lapho lezi zikhumbuzo zibhaliswe khona ngokusemthethweni. Izincwadi kumele zithunyelwe ezindaweni ezibekwe ngokusemthethweni ngezindleko zomshicileli, futhi lokhu kumele kwenziwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 zokushicilelwa. Inhloso yokubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokwenza kube khona ulwazi nolwazi lwamasiko ezizweni, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela mahhala kuzo zonke izincwadi ezitholakalayo. Umthetho ophathelene nalokhu wakhululwa nguMthetho Wamalungelo Okushicilela ka-1965 kanye noMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni ka-1982, kuze kube umthetho wamanje, uMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni washicilelwa ngo-1997, okukhuluma ngokufakwa kwezincwadi zedijithali nezo ezihambisana nomsindo. Iziphakamiso ziwumkhiqizo noma iyiphi impahla ehlose ukugcina noma ukudlulisa umyalezo ngombhalo, isithombe, umsindo, noma iyiphi indlela yokuxhumana enokuqukethwe okucabangekayo. Yini okufanele ifakwe? Amakhadi ezinkampani noma ama-check. Iqinisekisa ukufinyelela kuzo zonke izincwadi ezishicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika. Iyi-pillar eyodwa yolwazi olukhululekile. Iyi-rekhodi yezincwadi zonke ezikhiqizwe yizwe. Iqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yezisebenzi ezishicilelwe igcinwa futhi itholakala ukuze ibolekwe. Igcina umsebenzi wababhali nabashicileli ukuze usebenze ngocwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo. Isetha isisekelo sokuhlanganisa iNgqungquthela Yomlando YaseNingizimu Afrika, ethumele abasebenzisi bayo kulo lonke izwe ngama-ziphakamiso akhona, ngaleyo ndlela ithuthukisa ukusatshalaliswa kwabo kanye nokumaketha. Inombolo yokuxhumana yokusiza itholakala eMnyangweni Wezincwadi ZaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze icacise izinto eziphathelene nokubhaliswa okusemthethweni.
Inhloso yeKomidi ukuhlanganisa nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kweMthetho Wokufaka Izincwadi ka-1997.
