Umthetho Wokuphatha Omdala 38 ka-1927, isigaba 11 (b): Wonke umkakhe owenziwe ngokwesiko (ngaphandle kwabesifazane eKwaZulu-Natal) uzobhekwa njengesiguli. Isimo somkakhe silingana nesomntwana ngaphandle kwamalungelo omuntu omdala (ongakafiki eminyakeni engama-21). Umkakhe akanalo ilungelo lokugcina umntwana ngoba ubhekwa ngumuntu. Umkakhe akakwazi ukusayina isivumelwano somthetho ngaphandle kosizo lwemshado wakhe noma uyise. Umkakhe akakwazi ukufakazela amalungelo kodwa ungumfanekiso okumele wenziwe yilowo onelungelo. Umthetho wesiko unethonya kanjani emandleni okugcina umntwana? Ngaphansi komthetho wesiko, ukugcina umntwana kungelungelo elinikezwa umuntu nempilo yakhe ngokushada. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umuntu esehleli lobola/umshado, yena nomndeni wakhe bathola amalungelo aphelele okuba abazali phezu kwabantwana abavela kulomshado. Umthwalo wokugcina abantwana emshadweni uphakathi komuntu, umkakhe, nomndeni wakhe. Umthwalo wokugcina abantwana bomama abangashadile uphakathi kukayise wombala wabantwana nomndeni wakhe. Uma intombazane ishada futhi ibe nomntwana ekhaya, amandla okugcina le ntombazane kanye nabantwana bayo transferwa kumuntu ohlawule lobola nomndeni wakhe omusha. Ngakho-ke, umthwalo wokugcina umntwana ngokwesiko ushintsha ezandleni zomuntu kuphela (emshadweni), futhi abantwana baba yingxenye yomndeni womuntu. Ukugcina umntwana kwenziwa ngumuntu egameni lomndeni wakhe. Umntwana noma abantwana abavela ekhaya abavunyelwe ngaphansi komthetho wesiko ngoba umntwana bekukhona ekhaya, kwesinye isikhathi ehlala nabazali bomama babo (ngaphambi komshado) noma ehlala nomndeni omusha wombala lapho umama wakhe eshade, okukhuluma ngenye yezisho ethi "inkunzi ithengwa ngebhubezi". Kukhona isidingo sokucacisa uhlobo lomshado umkakhe angaba kuwo. Abantwana abavela emshadweni: Laba ngabantwana bomuntu nomndeni wakhe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ngempela uyise. Kulindeleke ukuthi uyise wombala wabantwana wamukele laba bantwana njengabomdabu wakhe futhi agcwalise zonke izibopho zomzali eziphathelene nabo. Ukufa komuntu akusho ukuphela kobudlelwano bomshado. Abantwana bomama abashadile bahlukaniswa kanje: (i) abantwana bomuntu oshade nomama. Ngaphansi komkhuba wokushada kwe-levirate, umshado okhona uqhubeka nomama nomuntu ofaka esikhundleni somufi futhi uqhubeke ngezizathu zakhe. Umama nabantwana bakhe banakekelwa ngumuntu ofaka empilweni yomama. Umuntu ofaka kumama uvame ukuba omunye wabangane bomndeni womufi. Umndeni womufi unomthwalo wokunakekela umama impilo yakhe yonke nokuzibophezela ekuthwaleni abantwana abazofakwa emntwaneni ohlanganyela naye. Abantwana abavela kumama nomuntu ofaka kumama bazobhekwa njalo njengabantwana bomuntu omufi. Ngisho nasemikhubeni lapho umuntu efaka umkakhe, uma umama ethwala abantwana, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani ngempela umama noma abantwana babo, bazobhekwa njalo njengabantwana bomuntu omufi kanye namalunga omndeni wakhe. Ngemuva kokuhlukana, abantwana bavame ukusala nomndeni womuntu. Imithetho eminingi yesiko ayivumeli umkakhe ukuba ashade futhi esaphila ngaphansi komndeni womuntu. Kumele abuyele emndenini wakhe uma efuna ukushada. Uma eshade, umntwana ophuma kumama ophumile emshadweni wakhe wesibili ubhekwa njengomntwana wombango, ngakho-ke ungowomndeni womuntu wesibili. Umuntu wesibili umphathi noma umgibeli walaba bantwana. Emshadweni wesibili, umama ophumile akamukelwa ngumuntu wesibili ukuba aze nabantwana bakhe emshadweni wabo. (okukhuluma ukuthi abantwana baphuma ngesikhathi benakekelwa ubaba babo ngemuva kokubuyela kubo ngemuva kokuhlukana), ngaphansi kwalolu suku, umuntu omusha ufaka abantwana bakhe emshadweni. Imithetho yesigaba 11 (b) yeMithetho Yezokuphatha Omdala yayihloselwe ukuphatha isimo lapho umkakhe ezohlala engumntwana kuyilapho umuntu ezoba umphathi wakhe. Umphumela walolu sigaba uthi: Abesifazane abangashadile babhekwa njengabantu abadala (okudlula eminyakeni engama-21) kuyilapho abesifazane abamnyama abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 abashadile ngokwesiko babhekwa njengabantwana. Umkakhe omnyama oshade ngaphansi komthetho wesiko unamalungelo akhe omdala aphazanyiswa ngenxa yomshado noma uma engaphansi kweminyaka engu-21, ngokwezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuphakama Kwezimali Nokukhululwa. Isimo sabo sikhawulela ikhono labo lokungena ezivumelwaneni zomthetho, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bodwa noma uma befuna temsilwa abantwana babo. Ngakho-ke, umthetho wesiko lwama-Afrika awuqinisekisi abesifazane base-Afrika isithunzi esifanele nokuphathwa ngaphansi komthetho ngendlela eyasungulwa nguMthethosisekelo wesizwe. Ngakho-ke, lesi sigaba sikhuthaza ukwehlukaniswa kwabantu besifazane ngokugxila ebudlelwaneni, ngakho-ke kuhlangana noMthethosisekelo. Lesi sigaba siqinisa isiko elilawula elinika amandla wonke abantu ukuba balawule izimpilo nezimpahla zabesifazane. Umthetho wokugcina abantwana unika bobabili abazali amandla okugcina abantwana. Umuntu ubhekwa njengoyise babantwana futhi akakwazi ukubaphika. Ngenxa yemvelo yokukhulelwa kwabo nokuzalwa, abakwazi ukuhlukaniswa futhi abakwazi ukuhlukaniswa nabanye abantwana abavela emshadweni. Umuntu ungumgibeli nomphathi wabantwana, enomthwalo wokubamukela njengabanye abantwana abavela ngemuva kokuthi umshado uqinisekiswe. Laba bantwana bangamalunga omndeni womuntu. Uyise wombala akanakho izwi noma amalungelo phezu kwabo. Ngaphansi kwesigaba esifanayo, abantwana abavela ngemuva kokufika komkakhe nabo bayafakwa. Ngale ndlela, umthetho wesiko uhambisana nesigaba 8 soMthethosisekelo futhi awuhlukanisi phakathi kwabantu abantwana ngokusekelwe emvelweni yabo nasekuzalweni. Bahlale emndenini wombala. Uma umkakhe eshade nomama wakhe, yena nomyeni wakhe bazogcina labo bantwana. Umuntu uthola amandla okuba abazali ngabantwana abavela ngokuhambisana nalesi sisho esithi "inkunzi ihamba ngebhubezi." Akuzokwenziwa ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwalezi zinsizwa nabantwana bomshado. Ngakho-ke, akukhona ukuhlukaniswa phakathi kwabantu abantwana ngendlela engase ihlasele uMthethosisekelo. Uma umama eshiya umndeni womuntu, ushiya abantwana. Uma efuna ukuphikisa lesi simo, yena nomphathi wakhe kufanele bathathe izinyathelo zokukhombisa ukuthi umuntu akafaneleki futhi akafaneleki ukuba aphile nabantwana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi njalo kukhona ukukhombisa okhetha umuntu nomndeni wakhe njengabantu okufanele banakekele abantwana. Banikezwa amandla angaphikiswa okugcina abantwana. Ezinye izimo lapho abantwana bangashiywa ezandleni zomama babo zenzeka lapho besaphila (bephuza). Lokhu kuyisibonelo esisodwa lapho izidingo zomntwana ziba phambili kunamandla angaphikiswa ayise okugcina abantwana. Ngakho-ke, izinkantolo zendabuko zinika uyise wombwana
Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) yisiphetho esenziwe ngabaholi base-Afrika, esisekelwe embonini yabo ehlangene kanye nokuqiniseka okuqinile ukuthi banomthwalo wemfanelo wokuphelisa ubumpofu nokubeka amazwe abo, ngazinye noma ndawonye, endleleni yokukhula nokuthuthukiswa ngenkathi bebamba iqhaza emnothweni nasemphakathini wezwe. Le nqubo isekelwe ekuzinikeleni kwabantu base-Afrika ukuze bazikhulule kanye nendawo yabo ezinkingeni zokungathuthuki nokuhlukumezeka ekubambeni kwenhlalo yomhlaba. Ubumpofu nokuhlukumezeka e-Afrika kuphikisa impumelelo yezizwe ezithuthukile. Ukuqhubeka kokuhlukumezeka kwe-Afrika ekubambeni kwenhlalo yomhlaba kanye nokuhlukumezeka kobudlelwano bayo bezomnotho kanye nezokuxhumana kuletha ukwesaba nokungazinzi emhlabeni. Ukukhula komphakathi womhlaba, ukwezimali, kanye nosizo phakathi kwamazwe amabili (okubili) kube yisisekelo somqondo wokuthuthukisa i-Afrika. Ukwezimali kuholele ekuqoqweni okukhulu kwesikweletu, okuphinde kuhlawulwe ngezikhawu noma kuxoshwe kwesinye isikhathi, futhi kuhlala kuyisithiyo esikhulu ekukhuleni kwamazwe ase-Afrika. Iphuzu lokuzimela selifinyelelwe. Mayelana nezinye izici zosizo lwamazwe amabili - sibona ukwehla kosizo lwabantu siqu kanye nokuncipha okukhulu kosizo lwesamba, okwehlele ngaphansi kwezinga elibekwe ngama-1970. E-Afrika, cishe abantu abangu-340 million noma ingxenye yokuhlala komhlaba baphila ngaphansi kwe-USD $1 ngosuku. Ukufa kwezingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu kungalinganiswa ku-140 ngama-1,000 izingane, kanti ukuphila okuhlele emhlabeni kungama-54 kuphela. Kukhona kuphela u-58% wabantu abathola amanzi aphephile. Abantu abangafundile abangaphezulu kweminyaka engu-15 bangalinganiswa ku-41%. Kukhona kuphela imigqa yocingo engu-18 kubantu abangu-1,000 e-Afrika, uma kuqhathaniswa no-146 emhlabeni jikelele kanye no-567 ezweni elinengeniso ephezulu. Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) bucela umhlaba ukuba uphendule kulolu suku olukhathazayo ngokushintsha ubudlelwano obubalulekile kulokhu. Abantu base-Afrika abaceli ukuqhubeka nokuncika kosizo noma ukusiza kwezezimali. Banokwaneliseka ukuthi leli thuba lesikhathi eshistorical lizophela ubumpofu bokungathuthuki obujolile e-Afrika. Ubuqotho, okuhlanganisa imali, ubuchwepheshe, amakhono abantu, adingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe impi yokulwa nobumpofu nokungathuthuki, manje sekukhona kakhulu futhi kutholakale kalula. Okudingekayo manje ukuze kuqoqwe lezi zinsiza futhi zisetshenziswe kahle abaholi abanamandla nokuzinikela enhliziyweni ekuthuthukiseni abantu nasekupheliseni ubumpofu, kanye nokubambisana nomhlaba omusha osuselwa ekuzinikeleni kwabo bonke nasekuzuzeni okuphumelelayo. Kulo lonke izwekazi, abantu base-Afrika bayazibophezela ukuthi ngeke baphinde bavumele ukuba bahlukunyezwe yizimo. Sizokwakha ikusasa lethu futhi sicele umhlaba ukusiza emizamweni yethu. Sekukhona izimpawu zokuphumelela ngethemba. Inani leziphathimandla ezizimele ezizibophezele ekukhuseleni amalungelo abantu, ukuthuthukiswa okujolile kubantu, kanye nezomnotho ezinikeza amathuba okuthengiselana kuyanda. Abantu base-Afrika sebekhombisile ukuthi ngeke bavumele abaholi bezomnotho nabepolitiki ukuthi babaphose. Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika (NEPAD) buhlose ukuqinisa nokusheshisa lezi zimpumelelo. Kuyisicelo sokubambisana okusha phakathi kwe-Afrika nomhlaba, ikakhulukazi lezi zizwe ezinomnotho, ukuze kudlulelwe emgqeni wokuthuthukiswa obuphumelele iminyaka eminingi ngenxa yobudlelwano obungalingani noma obuhlukumezayo. Indawo ye-Afrika emphakathini womhlaba ichazwa njengendawo lapho umhlaba unazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze uqinisekise ukusiza wonke umuntu iminyaka eminingi. Izindawo zezilwane nezinsiza zakudala ezikhombisa ukuguqulwa komhlaba, impilo, nomndeni wabantu. Ingxenye I iyindawo eyaziwa kakhulu. Ingxenye II isanda kuvela, njengoba abantu beqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwezindaba zemvelo. Ingxenye III iphinde ivele yodwa, ibonakala njengefanele ukunakwa hhayi kuphela emkhakheni wesayensi noma kulabo abathanda ukugcina heritage (iminyuziyamu) kanye nalabo abawubona. Lokhu kuyIngxenye IV, ebonisa amandla abantu base-Afrika, angasetshenziswa noma athuthukiswe ngokuphelele ngezindlela eziningi. Kucacile ukuthi, ngaphandle kokuthi imiphakathi eyakhiwe ezindaweni ezinomoya ophakeme ingaguqulwa, ezinye izindlela zokuphila zizobamba iqhaza ekubhujiseni izihlahla. Njengoba ukugcina imvelo kuzothokozisa bonke abantu, kubalulekile ukuthi i-Afrika ibekwe endleleni yokuthuthukiswa futhi ingabeki izinsiza zayo engcupheni. Isayensi yanamuhla iyavuma ukuthi i-Afrika iyisikhumbuzo somuntu. Njengengxenye yokwakha nokubuyisela isithunzi nokuzethemba kwabantu base-Afrika, kubalulekile ukuthi le nhloso yokuba ngumuntu iqondwe noma ibonwe futhi ithathwe njengengcebo yibo bonke abantu base-Afrika. Isikhundla se-Afrika njengezikhumbuzo zomuntu kufanele sibhakanyiswe umhlaba wonke njengomlando wabantu bayo bonke. Ngakho-ke, Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika kufanele lugcine leli thongo futhi lusetshenziswe ukuze kwakhiwe ukuqwashisa ngalesi sidingo esiphuthumayo sokuphelisa ukungathuthuki nokuhlukumezeka kuleli zwe. I-Afrika inendima ebalulekile yokudlulisela ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nemvelo emhlabeni. Ukuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe kugcizelela indima edlalwa ngabantu ekukhiqizeni, belwa nendawo yabo enqubweni yokukhiqiza besebenzisa amathuluzi abo ngaleso sikhathi noma esikhathini esizayo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane, izitshalo, nezilwane ezitholakala kuphela e-Afrika zinikeza abantu ithuba lokugcina ubudlelwano babo nemvelo. I-Afrika isivele idlale indima ebonakalayo emasikweni omhlaba, ezincwadini zelizwe, emculweni, emculweni, nakwezinye izindlela zamasiko, kodwa amandla ayo awakaze asetshenziswe ngokuphelele ngenxa yokungabi khona kokuhlanganiswa ngokuphelele emnothweni womhlaba. Ubumbano Olusha Lokuthuthukiswa Kwe-Afrika luzovumela i-Afrika ukuthi wandise indima yayo esayensi, emasikweni, nasezobuchwepheshe. Kule millennium entsha, njengoba abantu befuna indlela entsha yokwakha umhlaba ongcono, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlanganise ukuhlukahluka kanye nenhloso yabantu ukuze sithumele leli zwe ezingeni elifanayo lokubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni isivilizashoni yabantu. Ukuncipha kwalesi zwe lase-Afrika kugcizelelwe ukuphathwa kwalesi zwe ngabanye, impi engenemikhonto, ukuhlukumezeka kohlelo lwezomnotho lwezwe, kanye nokwehluleka noma ukungafaneleki kwemigomo elandelwa ezinye izizwe ngemuva kokuthola uzibuse. Iminyaka eminingi, i-Afrika ibambe iqhaza emnothweni womhlaba njengomthombo wezisebenzi ezishibhile nezinto ezingavuthiwe. Lokhu kuholele ekunciphiseni kwempahla ye-Afrika esikhundleni sokuthi isetshenziswe ukuze kuthuthukiswe leli zwe. Umfutho ngaleso sikhathi wokusebenzisa izinto ezingavuthiwe nezinto zokwakha ukuze kuthuthukiswe imboni yokukhiqiza kanye nezisebenzi ezinobuchwepheshe ukuze kufezwe ukukhula komnotho nok

ukuze kuthuthukiswe kahle amalungelo nezibopho zabathengi beSistimu Yezempilo Yezwe kanye nalabo abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo abasebenza ngaphansi kwalesi sistimu; ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvuma okwaziwayo kwabathengi bohlelo kanye nokugcina ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabathengi; ukuze kusungulwe izinqubo zizwe ezizothuthukisa futhi ziqinise ukusebenza futhi kuqinisekiswe izinga eliphezulu lezi zinhlelo zosizo lwezempilo futhi kunikezwe izeluleko uNgqongqoshe mayelana nezinqubomgomo zezempilo nezinhlelo zezempilo zizwe; ukuze kubhekwane nokuphumeleliswa kwezinhlelo zezempilo zizwe ukuze uMnyango Wezempilo WaseNingizimu Afrika ukwazi ukwenza kahle imisebenzi yawo; ukuze kusungulwe izinqubo zezifunda ezizosisiza ekuthuthukiseni ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo ezizweni futhi kunikezwe izeluleko kuNgqongqoshe Wezempilo Wezifunda mayelana nezinqubomgomo zezempilo nezinhlelo zezempilo zizwe; ukuze kubhekwane nokuphumeleliswa kwezinhlelo zezempilo zezifunda ukuze kuhlangane nezinhlelo zezempilo zizwe; ukuze kusungulwe uhlelo lwezeMpilo lwezifunda oluzohlukanisa iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ibe yizifunda zezempilo; ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa nokubhekwa kwezifunda zezempilo kanye nezindawo zazo ezincane ngenkathi kuhanjiswa usizo lwezempilo ngezakhamizi; ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlela kwezinhlelo zezempilo zezifunda; ukuze kulawulwe izikhungo zezempilo ngokuhambisana nohlelo lokugunyazwa nezidingo futhi kuqinisekiswe izinhlelo zokuhambisana nokulandela umthetho; ukuze kubhekwane nokulawulwa kokwethulwa kwemicimbi ezikhungweni zezempilo zomphakathi nezizimele, eziklinikhi nasezindaweni zezempilo zomphakathi kanye nasemazweni angaphandle kwezikhungo zezempilo; ukuze kubhekwane nezibopho ezithile ezikhungweni zezempilo ezizimele; ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinhlelo nezindlela zokusungula izidingo nezinga eliphezulu; ukuze kubhekwane nokuthuthukiswa nokusakazwa kwemithombo yomsebenzi phakathi kweSistimu Yezempilo Yezwe; ukuze kusungulwe ikomidi elisemthethweni labachwepheshe bezempilo kanye nokusungulwa kwezikhungo zezokwelapha nezokufundisa, amaqembu awo alawulayo kanye nekhansela kazwelonke lezi zikhungo ezihlanganyelwe; ukuze kuhanjiswe uhlelo lokudluliswa kwegazi lwezwe; ukuze kulawulwe ukutholakala, ukugcina, nokusetshenziswa kwemithambo, igazi, imikhiqizo yegazi, kanye nezinto zokuzala zabantu, kanye nokuphakela nokuhlinzeka ngama-organs nemithambo; ukuze kuvinjelwe ukukhiqizwa kwabantu nokulawula ucwaningo oluhlobene nemithambo yabantu kanye nezitho; ukuze kubhekwane nokuhlolwa kwezidumbu kanye nokuphathwa kwazo zonke izinto ezihlobene nemithambo, izitho, igazi, imikhiqizo yegazi, nezinto zokuzala; ukuze kusungulwe ikomidi lezeMpilo leZwe elibhekelele izinga eliphezulu kanye nehhovisi elibhekelele ukuhambisana nezindinganiso ezisunguliwe; ukuze kusungulwe ikomidi lezeMpilo leZwe elibhekelele ubuqotho bocwaningo lwezempilo futhi libhekelele uhlelo lokwazisa ngezempilo lwezwe; ukuze kuqondiswe imisebenzi nezibopho zabaphathi bezempilo nezindinganiso zokuhlola; ukuze kubhekwane nezimiso nezinhlelo ezihlobene nezempilo; futhi ukuze kubhekwane nezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. Ukugcina, ukuhlola, ukusebenzisa, ukulahla, ukuhlukanisa, noma ukuhlinzeka noma ukuchitha noma yiluphi uhlobo lwegazi elithathwe kumuntu noma igazi elitholwe kwamanye amazwe, ukuze lisetshenziswe, njengoba likhona, ingxenye yalo noma ngendlela yemikhiqizo yegazi kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi izingxenye ezitholakala kubantu. Ukukhiqizwa, ukupakishwa, ukuvalwa, nokubhalwa kwanoma iyiphi imikhiqizo yegazi noma ukuhlinzeka ngayo, noma ukuyilahla nganoma iyiphi indlela, kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi izingxenye ezitholakala. Ukuthatha noma ukugcina igazi elithathwe kumuntu ukuze lisetshenziswe kabusha kulowo muntu. Ukuphathwa kwezingxoxo, kodwa lokhu akuhlanganisi ukuphathwa kwezempilo yomphakathi, ukuphathwa kwemfucumfucu yezokwelapha, nokuphathwa kwezinto eziyingozi. Igama elithi "ukukhulelwa" libhekisela emiphumeleni yokuhlangana kweqanda lesifazane ne-sperm yendoda (ukukhulelwa). Ngokwesigaba -146 seMthethosisekelo, lapho kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi kwalokho okukhuluma kulolu mthetho nokukhuluma kwezinye izinqubomgomo zezempilo, ngaphandle kwemithetho ethinta ngqo lo mthetho, lokho okukhuluma kulolu mthetho kuzosebenza. Izingane zithola izinhlelo eziqondile ezihlobene nosizo lwezempilo; futhi zibhale nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Umnyango kahulumeni kufanele uhlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zezempilo njengokubaluleka futhi ucabangele izidingo zezempilo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinsiza ezikhona. Umnyango kazwelonke kanye nawo wonke amanyuvesi nezikhungo zomphakathi kufanele basungule izinsizakalo ezifanele zezempilo kanye nosizo lwezempilo lwezakhamizi ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho, futhi wonke umphakathi, zonke izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zezempilo kufanele bahlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zezempilo ngokuhambisana namandla nezinsiza zabo. UMnyango Wezempilo, umnyango wezifunda, izikhungo zomphakathi, nezikhungo zezempilo, kanye nalabo abahlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo kufanele basebenze ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho lapho besebenzisa amandla athile nemisebenzi ethile ehambelana nezempilo. UNgqongqoshe unegunya lokukhetha, ngaphansi kwezimo ezivumela abantu abathile noma amaqembu abantu ukuthi athole izinsizakalo zezempilo zamahhala ezikhungweni zezempilo zikahulumeni. Umthelela walezi zimo ekutholakaleni kosizo oluvela kubahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zezempilo. Amanyuvesi kazwelonke nezifunda, amakhansela wezempilo ezifunda, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi olwaneleyo noluphelele ludluliselwa ezinsizakalweni zezempilo ezibhekelelwe. Abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zezempilo nezikhungo zezempilo azinakwenqaba umuntu ukufinyelela ekwelashweni okuphuthumayo. Wonke umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo yakhe nokwelashwa. Uma umsebenzisi engakwazi ukubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo yakhe nokwelashwa, noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ophephile ngokomthetho noma umyalelo wenkantolo ukuze amele umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo esithinta impilo nokwelashwa komsebenzisi. UMnyango Wokuhumusha Nokuhlela WeNkonzo YeziLimba Zesizwe (NLS) uhlukaniswe ngezigaba zezilimi ezilandelayo: Afrikaans, IsiNgisi, Izilimi Zangaphandle, IsiZulu, IsiXhosa, IsiNdebele, IsiSepedi, IsiSesotho, IsiSetswana, IsiSwati, IsiTshivenda, neIsiXitsonga. Uhulumeni omusha uhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, ngokuhambisana neSigaba 6 seMthethosisekelo, uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi "uHulumeni WaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nohulumeni bezifunda basebenzisa noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni ngezizathu zohulumeni, kubhekwa ukusetshenziswa, ukufinyeleleka, izindleko, nesimo sezifunda kanye nezinye izintandokazi zabantu." Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala indawo lapho iminyango kahulumeni ixhumana kahle, phakathi kwezinye izinto, nabo bonke amalungu omphakathi ngezilimi zabo ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. INkonzo YeziLimba Zesizwe (NLS) isebenza njengengqalasizinda yokweseka ulimi kwezobuchwepheshe kuhulumeni. Kukhona uhlelo lokuthola ulwazi ngocingo. Izinhlobo zemibhalo ehunyushwayo ikakhulukazi zifaka phakathi lezo eziqondiswe emphakathini, ezifana namaphepha amhlophe, amaphepha aluhlaza, umthetho ophakanyisiwe owashicilelwa ukuze uthole imibono yomphakathi, izaziso zikahulumeni, imithetho, imibiko yonyaka yeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni, imibiko yeziKomidi nemikhandlu, izivumelwano zomhlaba, izinkulumo zomongameli, izinkulumo zabaminisitiri, kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikahulumeni, imibhalo yezinkontileka, amaphepha alwazi nezikhangiso, ulwazi lwezindaba, njll. Uma umbhalo kufanele uhunyushwe ube ngezilimi ezingaphezu kweyodwa, kuyasiza ukuhlela ngaphambi kokuhumusha ukuze kugcinwe umoya nobungako bawo. Umbhalo ohuqhuqhiwe uqhathaniswa nomthombo ukuze kuhlolwe ukusetshenziswa nendawo yolimi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukubhalwa ngokucophelela nokuphelele kombhalo, kanye nokuhlelwa kahle kwemibhalo yezomthetho nezaziso zikahulumeni, njll. Iminyango esebenzisana nohulumeni, izinhlangano, nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ithola izinsizakalo zeNkonzo YeziLimba Zangaphandle, futhi zisebenza ngemibhalo efana nezivumelwano zomhlaba, imibiko yeDivayisi yeInterpol, izincwadi ezibhaliwe ngababhalisile, njll. Uhlelo lwocingo lunikezwa ukuze kuqedwe ngokushesha izinselelo zokusebenzisa, ukupela, nokufaka lezi zilimi ezisemthethweni ngochwepheshe bezilimi bomnyango abaphatha lezo zinkinga. Lapho kudingeka, ucwaningo lwenziwa. Nokho, akukho ukuhumusha okuzokwenziwa ngocingo. Uma kubonakala ukuthi umsebenzi okhona uphuthumayo futhi unomthamo omkhulu futhi isikhathi esidingekayo siseduze, ngeke silinde ochwepheshe abasebenza kuMnyango Wezilimi; kuzothunyelwa ngaphandle ukuze kwenziwe ngokushesha. Umthamo omkhulu womsebenzi ovela kwiDivayisi YeziLimba Zangaphandle uthunyelwe ngaphandle kubachwepheshe bangaphandle njengoba isidingo eNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe siqhubeka sikhula ngokushesha. Ngokuhambisana nezigaba 3, 6, kanye no-31 weMthethosisekelo, izinsizakalo zokuhumusha nokuhlela zeNLS zisiza uHulumeni ekufezeni izibopho zawo kubantu ngokuhambisana neMthethosisekelo. Abathengi abakhulu balolu mnyango wokuhumusha nokuhlela yizinyango zikahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni ezinomsebenzi nezinyanga zikahulumeni. Kukhona iminyango kahulumeni enezinsizakalo zayo zezilimi, futhi ihumusha yona, njengeMnyango Wezokulungisa, iMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanye neSevisi yePolisa. Nokho, iNLS isiza lezi zinyango uma zikhathazekile ngomsebenzi noma uma kudingeka ubuchwepheshe obuthile, njengokuthi uma kukhona imibhalo edinga ukuhunyushwa ezilimini zangaphandle noma ukususwa ezilimini zangaphandle. Ezinye izifunda zinezinsizakalo zazo zezilimi, kodwa zibuye zifune usizo kuNLS uma kudingeka. I-NLS ingancoma izifunda ngababhalisi abathembekile bezilimi ezithile abangazisebenzisa. Ukuze kusebenze ngendlela ezokhiqiza imiphumela esezingeni eliphezulu nephumelelayo, ihhovisi lezilimi kumele libe nokuqonda ngezidingo zalo ukuze abahumushi nabahleli bakwazi ukugxila emsebenzini wabo ngenkathi abasebenzi behhovisi besiza ngemisebenzi yokuphatha. Umbhalo kanye nomdwebo kulandela indlela futhi kudlula ezigabeni ezithile, ezinye zazo zingase zibe zokuphatha kanti ezinye zixhumene nokuhumusha nokuhlela. a. Umbhalo utholwa kuRegistry bese kufakwa uphawu ekhasini langaphandle okukhombisa usuku owatholwe ngalo futhi uthunyelwa kumqondisi walowo Mnyango ukuze processing kanye nesinqumo sokuthi kufanele usebenze. b. Uma umbhalo kufanele uhunyushwe ube ngezilimi ezisemthethweni ezingaphezu kweyodwa, labo abaphethe umsebenzi wehhovisi benza amakhophi ezilimi lapho kucelwa khona ukuhunyushwa. c. Amakhophi athunyelwa kumaphoyisa alezo zigaba zezilimi ezidingekayo ukuze kuhunyushwe lowo mbhalo. d. Umqondisi waleyo zigaba yezilimi ubuyekeza umbhalo, uxhumana nabanye, bese ethatha isinqumo sokuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle. e. Umbhalo uthunyelwa kubabhalisi noma kumuntu osebenza ezilimini ogcina incwadi yokurekhoda lapho bezobhala khona zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo ezifana nosuku umbhalo utholiwe, inani lamakhasi, igama leMnyango elivela noma umthengi, kanye nalowo ozokwenza umsebenzi wokuhumusha noma wokuhlela. f. Umbhalo uthathwa umgibeli we-rekhodi bese uthunyelwa kumuntu ozosebenza kuwo, futhi uma kufanele uthunyelwe ngaphandle, uthunyelwa kumqondisi ukuze uthole imvume yokuthi umbhalo uthunyelwe ngaphandle. g. Ngemuva kokuthola le mvume, umbhalo uthunyelwa ehhovisi lokuphatha ukuze unikezwe inombolo efanele bese uthunyelwa kumhumushi wangaphandle, ozobe esekwenze amalungiselelo ngaphambi kokukhuluma njengoba kushiwo emgqeni (d) ngenhla. Umuntu osebenza ehhovisi lokuphatha wenza amakhophi emsebenzini ohunyushiwe futhi uthumele eyodwa kumthengi kanti enye iya esigabeni lapho umsebenzi ophelile ugcinwa khona, bese kuthi incwadi ecela ukukhokhwa kumhumushi ibhekelelwe ukuze kulungiselelwe lokho okufanele kubo. Ngokulandela le nqubo, umsebenzi wehhovisi lezilimi wenziwa ngendlela ehlelekile kakhulu ngoba isinyathelo ngasinye esithathwa ngombhalo siyaziwa njengoba kubhalwa. Ngaso sonke isikhathi, izikhathi ezahlukene kumele zilandelwe ukuze kuhunyushwe imibhalo yezinyanga ezidingekayo ngaphakathi kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ezingama-20 nezilimi ezahlukene zangaphandle, okuy umsebenzi onzima, kodwa kwenziwa kube lula ngosizo nolwazi lehhovisi lezilimi. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi ezivela, amalungu eNLS azinikele ekukhiqizeni umsebenzi osezingeni eliphezulu. Kulokhu, kuvamile ukuthi basebenze ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezijwayelekile noma uma becelwa ukuthi benze kanjalo noma uma kudingeka ukuthi benze kanjalo. Abathengi balolu mnyango bababheka njengomthombo wokuba khona kwehhovisi lezilimi labo. Njengoba laba bathengi bengabalingani, njengabanye bonke abasebenza kuhulumeni
Ukushayela ngesivinini esidlula leso esibekwe kumaphuzu emgwaqo kuyimbangela yokuhlaselwa kwemoto okuholela ekulimazeni okukhulu noma ekufeni kwabantu ngaphezu kwama-50% eNingizimu Afrika. Ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kuyingozi ngoba kwenza ukuba yonke imoto ibe yingozi kakhulu. Uma ushaya ngesivinini, kuba nzima ukumisa noma ukulawula imoto yakho. Unesikhathi esincane sokuphendula uma ubhekene nesimo esibucayi. Imikhawulo yesivinini ibekwe ngokwakhiwa nokuhlala kwabantu emgwaqweni. Imigwaqo yasemadolobheni, lapho kunokuhlala kwabantu okuningi, inemikhawulo yesivinini ephansi kunezindlela zasemaphandleni ezinezithuthi ezincane. Imigwaqo eduze kwezikhungo zemfundo nezinye izindawo ezinezigidi zabantu ingase ibe nemikhawulo yesivinini ephansi. Abahamba ngezinyawo: Hamba uqaphele abahamba ngezinyawo. Izikhathi zokuhlala kwabantu: Nciphisa isivinini futhi uqaphele. Iphutha labantu liyimbangela enkulu yokuhlaselwa kwemoto. Isimo sezulu esimanzi: Uma umgwaqo unamanzi, ibanga lokumisa liyanda. Isivinini kumele sincishiswe kakhulu. Isimo sezulu esifudumele kanye nokushayela ebusuku: Nciphisa isivinini uma ukubonakala kungesihle. Khumbula ukuvula izibani zakho zokukhanya ebusuku, hhayi kuphela izibani zokumisa. Izimo zomgwaqo ezimbi: Ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo nezindlela ezimbi kwehlisa amazinga okuphepha. Qaphela izindawo ezingozi emgwaqweni. Ukushayela ngesivinini kuyingozi ngisho nasemigwaqweni emihle futhi ephephile ngokuphelele. Umshayeli oshayelayo ngesivinini uphazamisa ukuhamba kwezithuthi futhi angabeka abanye abashayeli engcupheni. UMthetho AWUVUMELI NOMA YUBANI UKUDLULA IMIKHULULO YESIVININI EBUKWE. Umkhawulo we-alcohol emzimbeni wabashayeli ungama-0.05 g/100 ml. Ngisho noma ungaphansi komkhawulo, ungase ubhekane nezinsolo zokushayela uphuzile uma kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwakho kwe-alcohol kuphazamise ukushayela kwakho. Ngakho-ke, kungcono ukuhamba ngomthetho omuhle: Ungazami ukuhamba uma uphuzile!! I-alcohol iphazamisa yonke imisebenzi edingekayo yokushayela ngokuphepha. Iphazamisa ukuqaphela kwakho, ukuhlaziya, ukubona, ukuhlela, ukuzwa, ukuqapha, nesikhathi sokuphendula. Awukwazi ukulawula imoto yakho kahle. I-alcohol ikwenza uzizwe ungaphazamiseki futhi ungazi ngezinto ozenzayo. Ungalahlekelwa ukuphila kwakho, noma ubulale noma ulimele abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Ungabhekana necebo elingama-R24,000 NOMA ubhekane neminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ejele. Ilayisense yakho ingavinjwa izinyanga ezintathu uma wephula umthetho okokuqala, unyaka uma wephula okwesibili, neminyaka emihlanu uma wephula okwesithathu. Ukuze kube lula, isivinini ne-alcohol kuyisixazululo esibulalayo. Ungaphuzi uhambe.
Izakhamuzi zomphakathi ezihlobene namagugu kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele zimenywa ukuthi zikhethe abantu abazoba amalungu eBhodi leMnyuziyamu iLuthuli. Ibhodi lizoba namalungu alinganiselwa ezinsukwini eziyisixhenxe okungenani, athunywe nguNgqongqoshe wezobuciko, amasiko, isayensi, kanye nobuchwepheshe. Omunye wamalungu kumele abe nolwazi oluthile lwezezimali. Ulwazi olunzulu ngamagugu kazwelonke, ulwazi olunzulu lokuphatha nezimali, ulwazi lwezomthetho, nolwazi lokumaketha nokuxhumana, ulwazi lokuqoqa imali, imfundo, kanye nocwaningo lwesayensi, kanye nenhloso yokusebenza komphakathi nolwazi oluthile ngomsebenzi weMnyuziyamu iLuthuli kudingeka. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha ithimba elizokwakha uhlu lwabafanelekayo kusuka kumagama abanikela ngawo. Imiyalelo yeqembu izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kufaka abantu abaneziqu ezifanele zemfundo noma ulwazi olukhethekile noma labo abanothando ngezindawo ezithile ezihlobene, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi othile abe ngomunye wamalungu. Imiyalelo yeqembu izophinde iqinisekise ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kufaka abantu bazo zonke izindawo zomphakathi nobulili bobabili, nokuthi ukukhethwa konke kusezingeni eliphezulu. Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngowanikela, lapho bevuma ukuthi igama labo linikwe, kanye namagama abantu abathathu abangaxhumana nabo abazi owanikela futhi abangahlinzeka ngereferensi ngabo. Akuzukuba nokushoda kwamagama abantu abakhethiwe, kodwa hhayi konke lokhu kulotshiwe ngenhla.
Indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu ifaka indawo ezizungezile kanye nendawo uqobo, futhi inganwebeka ibe yindawo enkulu. Kulolu suku olungcwele, abacwaningi baqoqana ubufakazi ngenhloso yokukhombisa ukuthi ubugebengu bukhona, befuna izimpawu futhi baxhumanise lezi zimpawu nendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu. Uma ubugebengu benzeka, ababi bleave izimpawu endaweni ngokungena noma ukuphuma ngendlela ethile. Le ndlela iba yingxenye yendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu futhi iyindlela ehlangene ngqo nendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu. Lapho amaphoyisa efika endaweni, awanalo uqiniseko oluphelele ngalokho okwenzekile. Ungasiza ukuhlole le ndawo engcwele ngokubheka zonke izindlela ezisetshenziswe ngababi. Ukuhlola ubugebengu kuhilela ukuqoqwa kobufakazi bokwazi kanye nezimpawu ezibonakalayo. Ubufakazi obubonakalayo bungaba impahla noma izinto ezithile ezingasetshenziswa ngamaphoyisa ukuze axazulule icala. Amaphoyisa asebenzisa isibonelo sokuthi uma izinto ezimbili zihlangana, kukhona izinto ezingajwayelekile ezifana nezinwele, ushokoledi, umswakama, uthuli, nezimpawu zokuthinta. Lezi yizinto zobufakazi okufanele zihlolwe ngamaphoyisa. Ubufakazi bungaba bukhona, njengokuphrinta kwezicathulo, noma bungabonakala kahle ngaphansi kwe-microscope, njengamafibha noma izimpawu zegazi. Ubuchwepheshe besimanje buwenza kube lula kumaphoyisa ukuhlanganisa abantu nendawo kanye nezinto. Ukuze kusebenze ubuchwepheshe, izindawo zokwenziwa kobugebengu kufanele zigcinwe futhi zivikelwe ekuhlanganyeleni okungadingekile okungaphazamisa ubufakazi. Ngokugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, amaphoyisa azokwazi ukuqoqwa ubufakazi obuqondile. Ukuphazamisa indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu kudala isimo lapho ubufakazi obungatholwa futhi obusebenziseka buyehliswa. Ukugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, "indawo engcwele," kuyisibopho esibalulekile. Ungathinti noma ususe izinto endaweni, ezifana nezinto zokuhlala, izingubo, noma ukudla. Ungasebenzisi noma ifoni yakho; okungenani cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane wakho. Sebenzisa enye indlela, hhayi leyo esetshenziswa ngababi. Uma kungenzeka, buyela ekhaya. Cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane noma enye indawo ukuze ubike lesi sehlakalo. Linda amaphoyisa. Lapho ubika ubugebengu, nikeza ulwazi oluphelele mayelana nendawo ongatholakala kuyo, uma amaphoyisa edinga olunye ulwazi ngaphambi kokufika endaweni. Khombisa indlela noma umgwaqo owawusebenzisa. Bonke abakwi ndawo noma eduze bangaba ngofakazi. Tshela amaphoyisa konke okwaziyo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukubona kwakho kubonakala kungabalulekile. Bhala konke phambi kokuxoxa nabanye ngoba ungakhohlwa noma uphazamiseke.
uChristopher, ophakathi kwekhasi langaphandle, wazalwa enenhliziyo nepalate ehlukanisiwe. Ipalate yakhe yavuselelwa ngesikhathi enezinyanga ezinhlanu, futhi uphumelele kahle kulokho. Ihlombe lakhe lizovuselelwa cishe eminyakeni eyodwa. Izingane ezazalwa nepalate ehlukanisiwe ngokuvamile ziba nezinkinga lapho zifaka emathunjini ngoba umlomo awuhlukanisiwe nezindebe. Ngakho-ke, ingane ayikwazi ukusutha kahle, okuholela ezinkingeni zokufaka emathunjini kusuka emathunjini noma ebhodleni. Ukungenelela kanye nohlobo lwephutha, oluhlukahluka phakathi kwezingane, kuyizinkomba zokuthi ingane ingadliwa kanjani. Uma ingane inepalate ehlukanisiwe kuphela, ngokuvamile akukhona ukuhamba okukhulu kokufaka emathunjini. Ukuba khona kwehlombe ehlukanisiwe kubalulekile enhlanganisweni yokusutha. Inqubo yokufaka emathunjini ihilela ubisi obukhishwe emathunjini (kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusebhodleni noma emathunjini), inhliziyo edala amakhasi obisi (amakhasi amancane ajikelezayo), kanye nokunyakaza kwalezi zikhasi kusuka phambili komlomo kuya emuva, lapho zingadliwa khona. Ngokomlando, ingane kufanele ikwazi ukuphefumula ngenhliziyo ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini. Lapho inhliziyo ibekwe emlonyeni, izindebe ziyivala, futhi ulwimi luphakanyiswa ukuze luthathe inhliziyo ngokumelene nepalate eqinile. Ulwimi luphinde luphume, kudalwa isikhala esikhulu phakathi kwezindebe, futhi ulwimi/ipalate ivala umoya ukuze ungene esikhathini. Ngale ndlela, kudalwa umoya, futhi ubisi bukhishwa emlonyeni. Umoya uvimbela inhliziyo ukuba ingaphumi emlonyeni futhi uphinde usize ingane igcine ukubamba inhliziyo. Izindebe, ulwimi, izindebe, nezinsini zithola ubisi emathunjini. Inqubo yokufaka emathunjini ifana kungakhathaliseki ukuthi indlela yokudla (emathunjini noma ebhodleni). Nokho, isenzo esihilelekile ekutholeni ubisi emathunjini sihluke kulokho kokuthola ubisi ebhodleni. Inhliziyo yebhodlela ayisebenzisi izindebe, imisipha yobuso, ulwimi, izinsini, nezindebe zengane ngendlela efanele. Ngokuvamile, ukuhamba kobisi kusuka ebhodleni kuyashesha kunokukhishwa kusuka emathunjini; kodwa, lokhu kuthonywa yizinto eziningi zomzimba, njengehlobo lebhodlela nenhliziyo kanye nosayizi wenhliziyo. Ukuhamba kobisi ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini kusuka emathunjini kulawulwa amandla omlomo okukhulisa ubisi, kuyilapho ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlinzekwa kobisi kukamama kukhula njengoba ingane isutha kakhulu. Ubisi lwamathunjini luwumzimba olungasoze lwakha ukuphazamiseka emzimbeni njengokudla kwezinye izingane. I-oral mucosa yengane enenhliziyo ehlukanisiwe ivulekile, futhi ubisi lwamathunjini ngeke lube yiphazamiseko kuyo. Ukufaka emathunjini kubonakala kungakha izinga elifanayo lok pressure emathunjini njengokudla ebhodleni, njengoba izingane ezinepalate ehlukanisiwe zisesimweni esikhulu sokuba nezinhlungu zomlomo. Ukufaka emathunjini kudala isimo esihle emathunjini, okunciphisa amathuba okuthola izifo zomlomo. Ubisi lwamathunjini lunamandla okuvikela kuma-bacteria. Luhlanganisa i-lactoferrin kanye ne-immunoglobulins ezisiza ukuvimbela izifo. Izingane ezinepalate ehlukanisiwe ezifakwayo ziba nezimo ezimbalwa ezibikiwe zokuthola izifo. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ingane ifakwe emathunjini noma ebhodleni, kufanele inikezwe ukudla okunempilo okunene. Ukusutha kusiza njengoba kukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemisipha edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhuluma okujwayelekile (ukuthuthukiswa kwezwi). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindlela zokudla ingane encane zibalulekile kakhulu. Ingane enempilo ithatha cishe imizuzu engama-20-30 ukuze ifake emathunjini ngendlela efanele, okuvumela ukukhula nokudla okufanele. Izingane ezinepalate ehlukanisiwe ngokuvamile ziba nezinkinga zokufaka emathunjini ngenxa yokusutha okungasebenzi kahle kanye nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo lapho bezama ukuhlanganisa inhliziyo. Izingane ezinehlombe ehlukanisiwe kuphela ngokuvamile azinazo izinkinga zokufaka emathunjini. Nokho, i-palate ehlukanisiwe iphazamisa ukwakheka kwe-seal evikela inhliziyo. Lokhu kubi kakhulu uma ingane isebenzisa ingxenye yangemuva yolwimi kanye nengxenye yezinsini (ingxenye ephezulu yezinsini ezibamba amazinyo) ukuze kwakhe i-seal ezungeze inhliziyo. Ukungabi khona kwaleyo seal kungaholela ekutheni ubisi luphume ku-cleft. Ukubamba ohlangothini lwehlombe lezingane ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini kusiza ukuvimbela ubisi ekuphumeni. Nokho, ingane enepalate ehlukanisiwe ayikwazi ukwenza i-seal emuva komlomo ngoba umlomo nezindebe azihlukanisiwe. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba i-seal edingekayo yokuphuma ayikwazi ukwenzeka ngesikhathi sokusutha. Ukuze kudaleke i-seal emuva, umoya kufanele wakhe emlonyeni ukuze kudaleke umoya. Kubantwana abane-palate ehlukanisiwe, ukuzama ukudala umoya kufana nokuzama ukuvuselela ibhaluni eliphukile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngaphandle kokusutha, ingane ngeke ikwazi ukuthola ubisi emathunjini. Nakuba kungaphumeleli ukudala umoya odingekayo, uma inhliziyo ibekwe emlonyeni wengane, ukusutha ngokudonsa emuva kuzokwenza ingane iphakamise ulwimi lwayo ukuze ilungise inhliziyo ngokumelene nepalate ukuze ithole ubisi. Ukungabi khona kwepalate eqinile kusho ukuthi inhliziyo izopushwa ku-cleft. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezimbili. Okokuqala, inhliziyo ayicindezelwa ngokuphelele ngokumelene nepalate, uma ikhona, futhi ulwimi luphuma, futhi okwesibili, uma inhliziyo ikwi-cleft, uma ubisi kudonswa, kuzodliwa ngqo emlonyeni kunokudlula emlonyeni nasezindebeni. Ukuhamba kobisi emlonyeni kuholela ekutheni ubisi obunganele budliwe, ngakho-ke inqubo yokufaka emathunjini ingathatha isikhathi eside. Ukusutha kungaba yinkinga engane enenhliziyo ehlukanisiwe, engase ibe nokukhathala ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini futhi ingase ingadli yonke ubisi bayo. Uma ingane ingadli ubisi obuningi ngesikhathi sokufaka emathunjini, ngeke ikhulise isisindo esanele. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma ingane ithatha isikhathi eside ukufaka emathunjini, ibhujiswa amakhilojoule ngesikhathi sokusutha kunokuthola amakhilojoule okufanele ithole. Ngemuva kokufaka emathunjini, kuvamile ukuthi ingane iphumule. Ngesikhathi sokuphumula, ukudliwa kokudla kwengane ngokuvamile kwehla, okuholela ekukhuleni kwesisindo. Ngakho-ke, uma ingane enenhliziyo ehlukanisiwe ivuka kaningi ngoba kuthatha isikhathi eside ukufaka emathunjini, lokhu kungaba enye yezizathu ezivimbela ingane ekukhuleni isisindo ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi ukufaka emathunjini kungathathi isikhathi eside kunesikhathi esijwayelekile (okungaba imizuzu engama-20 kuya
Kukhona izifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma akukho okungakwenziwa ukuze sigweme lezi zifo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena ezimpilweni zethu. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwa yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuze ugweme lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho-ke, qaphela wena. Le bhukwana ebizwa ngokuthi "Ukuba Active ukuze Ube Nezempilo" iyinhlangano yezi bhukwana. Uma sinakekela thina, sizohlala siphilile emqondweni nasemzimbeni. Ukuze sigcine umzimba wethu nomqondo wethu uphilile, sidinga ukuhlala sikhona. Abaningi bethu baphila impilo esheshayo futhi enezinkinga, okushiya isikhathi esincane sokuphumula. Le ndlela yokuphila isenza sibe nokukhathala nokukhathazeka, okwenza imizimba yethu ibhekane nezinkinga. Kule bhukwana: "Ukuba Active ukuze Ube Nezempilo," sibheka ukuthi ukuzivocavoca nokuba active kungasisiza kanjani ukuba sibe abantu abaphilile. Le ndwangu ikufanele kahle, Fezile, futhi ikwenza ubonakale unamandla. Ngempela, angizizwa nginamandla nhlobo kulezi zinsuku; ngisebenza kanzima. Ngifisa ukuthi ngangingafiki kule mpikiswano namuhla. Kodwa uma uqala ukuzivocavoca, uzoba nomuzwa ohlukile. Ungathola indoda ezokuthanda futhi ozoyiphupha njalo. Yebo, Fezile, unethuba lokungabi nenkinga enkulu yomzimba njengami, njengoba ngisebenza ehhovisi futhi ngihlezi usuku lonke, ngiyazibona ngikhuluphala. Yebo, kunjalo, wonke umuntu angazigcina ephilile futhi ebukeka kahle. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuzivocavoca, ngizizwa ngcono futhi ngizizwa nginamandla. Nina bobabili anifuni ukuthi sifike sehluleka emcimbini. Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalokho okwenzekayo futhi kuyindlela yokuzivocavoca; ngizizwa ngcono kakhulu! Ukuzivocavoca kusiza abantu ukukhulula lezo zinto ezibakhathazayo ngempilo. Ngithathe isinqumo sokuthi impilo yami iyisibopho sami. Ngihamba amakhilomitha amahlanu nsuku zonke, kwesinye isikhathi ngihamba ngokushesha ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi umzimba wami uthola ukuhamba kahle. Ukudansa kuyindlela enhle yokuzivocavoca, futhi ngivame ukuzizwa umzimba wami uthola ukukhanya ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa. Kumele ngiqhubeke ngenza lokhu. Ngake ngiya kudokotela owangihlola wathi ukuzivocavoca kusiza umuntu ukuvimbela izifo eziningi. Yingakho kufanele sonke sizivocavoce ndawonye. Singakhetha ukuzivocavoca ngezindlela ezahlukene ngeviki, njengokuhamba, ukuhamba ngamanzi, ukuhamba, nokudansa. Uma sizivocavoca ndawonye, kuzosisiza sikhuthazane. Ngizokwenza ngokuchaza okwenzeka emzimbeni wakho uma uzivocavoca nokuthi ukuzivocavoca kungakusiza kanjani. Uma uzivocavoca njalo, uzoba nehlukile emzimbeni wakho ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa. Umzimba womuntu uhlelwe ngendlela engalula ukuyiqonda. Uqukethe amathambo, izicubu, ubuchopho, uhlelo lwezitho, uhlelo lokugaya, nokunye okuningi. Ukuze imizimba yethu isebenze kahle, sidinga ukuyinakekela. Ukuzivocavoca kuyindlela eyodwa yokunakekela umzimba. Uma sizivocavoca imizuzu engamashumi amathathu nsuku zonke, ngeke sibe noshukela futhi sizohlala sibukeka futhi sizizwe siphilile. Ake sithole ukuthi kungani lokho. Igazi iletha umoya-mpilo namandla ezicubwini zomzimba. Izicubu zidinga umoya-mpilo namandla ukuze zisebenze kahle. Kukhona izinto ezahlukene ezenzeka emizimbeni yethu uma sizivocavoca. Igazi liphonsa ngokushesha, livumela umoya-mpilo namandla ukufinyelela ezicubwini ngokushesha. Izinga lokusebenza kwezinhliziyo nezitho zokuphefumula liphinde lenyuke, lithumele umoya-mpilo ngokushesha. Umzimba wakho udinga umoya-mpilo ukuze usebenze kahle. Ukuzivocavoca kuqinisa izicubu, kwenza kube lula ukuthi zifeze ezinye izinyathelo. Izicubu ezinamandla zisebenzisa umoya-mpilo kahle. Uma sizivocavoca, ubuchopho bukhulula amahormone akhulula ubuhlungu futhi anciphisa ingcindezi okuthiwa ama-endorphins. Lezi hormone zisebenza njengezinto zemvelo ezithulula ingcindezi. Zikwenza uzizwe unempilo futhi unamandla. Umzimba onempilo uphinde wenze umqondo onempilo! Zivocavoce ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho! Ukuzivocavoca nokuba active kuzokwenza impilo yakho ibe ngcono. Ukukhathala nokukhathazeka kungaholela kalula ekucindezelweni kwengqondo nasekuntulekeni kokuzethemba, ukucindezeleka kwegazi, isifo sikashukela, izifo zezinhliziyo, kanye nokukhuluphala okweqile okuthinta ukusebenza kwakho kwengqondo nokuphila kahle. Ngizizwa ngihle ngoba ngibe ngumuntu active impilo yami yonke. Abantu abadala bavame ukuthola kunzima ukuhamba izindawo ezinde nokuphakamisa izinto ezincane. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi imizimba yabo isibe buthaka (kunzima kubo ukujolisa). Ukuhlala active kungasiza ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abadala. Labo ababe active ngesikhathi sokukhula bavame ukuphila kahle njengoba bephila. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kukhona izinto eziningi abangazenza. Futhi kulabo abashiyile ukuzivocavoca ngesikhathi besencane, akusho ukuthi baphuthelwe ithuba; banganqoba futhi baqale ukuzivocavoca ngokuhamba, ukuphakama ezitebhisini, njll. I-Osteoporosis ("isifo sokuncipha kwamathambo") yenzeka uma amathambo emzimbeni wakho eba buthaka, ephuka kalula, futhi athatha isikhathi eside ukuwaphola. Kwenza kube nzima ukuhamba uma uthinteka yile nkinga. Ukuhlala active nokudla ukudla okunempilo yizindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokukusiza ugweme i-osteoporosis. Ukucindezeleka kwegazi kuyisimo esivamile kakhulu esithinta abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Uma inhliziyo yakho iphilile, iphonsa igazi nge-arteries ngesivinini esifanele nangengcindezi efanele emzimbeni. Uma ama-arteries akho eqinisa noma evimba, kuba nzima ukuphonsa igazi kuwo. Lokhu okubizwa ngokuthi ukucindezeleka kwegazi. Ukuzivocavoca, ukudla ukudla okunempilo, ukuphatha isisindo somzimba wakho, nokuthatha imishanguzo njengoba kudokotela kungakusiza ukuphatha ukucindezeleka kwegazi. Ukezwile isisho esithi: "Umzimba onempilo uhamba ndawonye nomqondo onempilo"? Udinga ukudla ukudla okunempilo, ukuhlala active, ukuxoxa nabantu, nokuzinika isikhathi esanele sokuphumula uma ufuna ukuba nomqondo onempilo? Abantu abambalwa bakhuluma ngempilo yengqondo ngoba kuyinto enzima ukuyiqonda. Akekho ofuna ukubizwa ngokuthi "uyaphazamiseka," "uphazamisekile," noma "uphazamisekile." Ungase ube nezingcindezi uqobo. Ungase ube nezingcindezi uma uzithola usemkhakheni okwenza ube nezingcindezi. Lokhu kungase kube ngenxa yomsebenzi noma izimo zasemakhaya. Ungase ube nezinkinga zokwenza umsebenzi wakho kahle noma mhlawumbe awunayo imali eyanele yokudla izingane zakho.
Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma akukho esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Ngisho noma sithatha ukunakekela umzimba wethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwa yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isandleni sakho. Ngakho-ke, qaphela. Uma ungashisi, ngeke ube nezinkinga zempilo. Abantu abaningi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bayazi lokho. Ngakho-ke, abashisi izigubhu noma amaphepha, futhi abakhwabanisi itshwala noma bashise isikhumba (itshwala esiphumayo). Le bhukwana contains amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana nokuphila impilo enempilo. Into engcono kakhulu umuntu angayenza ukuvuma ukuthi angakhethi ukuqalisa ukushisa noma ayeke uma eseshisa. Sithemba ukuthi uzokhetha ukuphila kahle ngokungasondeli ezigubhu noma ekushiseni. Funda indaba kaDudu... Um husband wakho uyakhwehlela kakhulu, Gugu. (Pic.1). Kuzoba ngcono uma engayeki ukushisa! (Pic.1). Uyazi ukuthi sengishise iminyaka eminingi futhi akukho okwakuhambile kimi! (Pic.2). Ubonile uDudu, le yimpilo yami ngakho nginela ukushisa ngendlela engifuna ngayo! (Pic.3). Kulungile, uyakhumbula ukuthi uDkt. Zondi, udokotela ophakanyisiwe, uthi abantu abaningi abafika esibhedlela ukuze bathole ukwelashwa banezifo ezidalwe ukushisa? (Pic.3). Umonakalo odalwe ukushisa itshwala ngaphakathi emzimbeni wakho usuku nosuku uyalimaza inhliziyo yakho, amathambo, imithambo yegazi, nezinye izingxenye zomzimba wakho. Ekugcineni, impilo yakho yonke iyahluleka. Ukushisa itshwala kubulala izigidi zabantu emhlabeni wonke unyaka nonyaka! (Pic.3). Lokhu akusho lutho ngoba sonke sizofela ekugcineni. Angiboni inkinga uma ngibulawa yinto engiyithokozelayo. (Pic.4). Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukushisa itshwala kuphinde kufakwe ngabantu abakuzungezile futhi kubenza babe sengozini efanayo nezifo ezithinta umshisi. (Pic.5). Futhi khumbula njalo uma ushisa isigubhu ukuthi ungase ungafi masisha ngenxa yokushisa, kodwa ungase ube nezifo eziholela ekuchithweni kweminyaka eminingi ubuhlungu, noma ungase ufe ubuhlungu ngenxa yesifo sezinhliziyo. Cabanga ngalokhu ngenkathi usenethuba lokuyeka ukushisa okwamanje! (Pic.6). Igama lami nguDudu. Ngifuna sikhulume ngokuqhuba itshwala. Ake siqale ngokubheka amaphuzu ahlobene nokushisa itshwala. Unyaka nonyaka, abantu abangu-12,000 eNingizimu Afrika bafa ngenxa yesifo senhliziyo, umdlavuza wezinyembezi, nezinye izinhlobo zomdlavuza, kanye nesifo se-bronchitis esiqhubekayo. Ukushisa itshwala kufaka isandla ekutheni umuntu abe sengozini yalezi zifo. Emazweni athile, ukushisa kubulala abantu abaningi kunenani elihlanganisiwe labafayo ngenxa ye-HIV/AIDS, utshwala, nezidakamizwa ezifana ne-heroin ne-cocaine, kanye nezingozi zomgwaqo. Umshisi angabuyela esimweni esijwayelekile sempilo uma eyeka ukushisa, kuye ngempilo yakhe, isisindo somzimba, ezinye izimo zempilo, nokuthi usushise isikhathi esingakanani. Ngonyaka olandelayo kokuyeka ukushisa, kunezikhathi ezincane zokuthola izifo ezifana ne-bronchitis. Ngemva kweminyaka eyishumi, bafeza umphakathi onjengomuntu ongakaze ashise. Izigubhu nezitshalo ziqukethe inhlanganisela yezinto eziyingozi ezifana ne-carbon monoxide, itshalo, kanye ne-nicotine. Lezi yizona ezenza abashisi bahlupheke. Ukushisa itshwala kuphinde kubangele abathintekayo. Uma usondelene nomshisi, qaphela ukuthi lowo muntu uyaphula impilo yakho ngendlela efanayo abaphula ngayo impilo yabo. Itshwala liyingozi empilweni yakho ngoba liqukethe izinto eziyingozi ezingaphezu kwama-200. Lezi zinto zilimaza amathambo. Uma uqhubeka nokushisa, umonakalo uyaqhubeka. Lezi zinto zingadala ukuhamba komoya okungasebenzi kahle kanye nomdlavuza. I-nicotine iyidroga. Ungase uthole ukuthi unokuxhomeka kwe-nicotine noma uthinteka yinto ethile egazini lakho. Uma uxhomeke kwi-nicotine, kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho nomqondo wakho kudinga i-nicotine njalo. Uzizwa sengathi uyayidinga nsuku zonke. Uma uthinteka yinto ethile egazini lakho, kuba nzima ukuyeka. Yingakho abantu abaningi bethola kunzima ukuyeka ukushisa. Kuthiwani ngesikhumba (itshwala esiphumayo)? Isikhumba siqukethe zonke izinto eziyingozi ezitholakala ezigubhu. Abantu abashisa isikhumba bangathinteka yizifo ezithile, ezifana nezifo zomlomo, zomlomo, nezifo zomgudu. Kuthiwani nge-marijuana? Odokotela bathole ukuthi i-marijuana ilimaza umzimba wakho ngendlela efanayo yokushisa itshwala. Uma uxhomeke ekushiseni i-marijuana, uzogcina ungakwazi ukusebenza, ukufunda, ukudlala, noma ukujabulela. Kukhona izinhlobo zetshezi ezingalimalanga? Cha, azikho. Izigubhu, ama-cigar, amaphepha, kanye nesikhumba zonke ziyingozi empilweni yakho. Uma umuntu eshisa izigubhu ezimbalwa ngosuku, lokho kungamphazamisa? Ngisho nokushisa isigubhu esisodwa ngosuku kungaba yingozi! Ungaqali ukushisa! Umonakalo emzimbeni wakho uqala lapho uqala ukushisa. Ungase ubukeke unempilo iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokuthi izimpawu zesifo ziqale ukuvela. Ingabe kuyingozi ukuhlinza itshwala elishiswa abanye? Yebo, ungathola izifo eziningi uma uphila noma usebenza nomshisi. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba uhlinza itshwala labo nsuku zonke. Izingane ezazalwe kubazali abashisayo zivame ukuhamba nezifo zokuphefumula ezifana ne-bronchitis ne-pneumonia, okungajwayelekile ezinganeni ezingenabo abazali abashisayo. Kuyilungelo lakho ukuphefumula umoya ohlanzekile! Abashisi kumele bahloniphe leli lungelo. Abashisi abaningi bayalwela ukuyeka ngoba abazi ukuthi ukushisa kuthinta kanjani impilo yabo. Ake sikhulume ngezinye zalezi zifo. Ukushisa kudala izifo eziningi ezahlukene. Eziyinhloko ezingozi yizifo zamathambo, umdlavuza, izifo zenhliziyo, nezifo zokuphefumula. Abantu abanezinye izifo zamathambo bangahlupheka iminyaka eminingi bekhwehlela nokushoda komoya. Izinhlobo eziningi zomdlavuza, ezifana nomdlavuza wezinyembezi, zidalwa ukushisa. Akukho ukwelashwa komdlavuza wezinyembezi. Ukushisa kungadala nomdlavuza kwezinye izingxenye zomzimba, ezifana nomlomo, ibhodlela, izitho zomzimba, ulimi, nezinye. Igazi emzimbeni wethu lihamba ngezitshalo ezincane esibiza ngemicabango yegazi. Ukushisa kudala ukuthi lezi zikhala zibe mncane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi igazi alikwazi ukuhamba, okungumngani omkhulu. Uma igazi lingafiki endaweni ethile yomzimba, leyo ndawo iyafa. Lokhu kwenzeka lapho umuntu ehlushwa yisifo se-stroke noma ukuhamba komoya. Abantu abaningi bafa kulezi zifo. Uma bephila
Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungelona lutho esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Nokho, kukhona nezifo ezivela endleleni esiphila ngayo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, singathola lezi zifo. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwe yindlela yethu yokuphila. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isandleni sakho. Ngakho-ke, unakekele. Kumele sithathe ukunakekela thina. Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika lidla utshwala obungaphezu kwabantu kwamanye amazwe emhlabeni. Abantu abaningi baphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye baphuza kakhulu kanti abanye baphuza njalo. Lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi. Abanye abantu bayakhishwa emsebenzini ngenxa yokuzibophezela kwabo kutshwala. Abanye bathi bangaba nodlame uma bephuzile futhi balwe namalungu omndeni, abangane, nabangane. Kwabanye, utshwala bungaba yingozi, futhi ukuqhubeka nokuphuza kungaholela ekufeni. Kungcono ukungaphuzi utshwala nhlobo ngoba contains ama-toxins ayingozi angaphazamisa impilo yakho. Ukuphuza utshwala kungaba nemiphumela emibi emndenini wakho. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile uma ungumuntu ophuzayo, uphuze ngokuziphatha kahle. Funda le bhukwana ukuze ufunde ukuthi ungaphuza kanjani ngokuziphatha kahle. Bheka uDudu, laba bantu sebesesaba utshwala obusele emshadweni wokuqala. Pic. UBongi uthatha yonke imali anayo ukuze athenge utshwala kanti umndeni wakhe uyalila ngoba le mali kufanele ibe isetshenziselwa ukudla, izingubo, nokukhokhela izifundo zezingane. Uyazi sengilahlekelwe ukuhlonipha yena. Pic. Kungenzeka ukuthi udinga usizo kunokugxekwa. Pic. Inkinga yokuphuza ngokweqile iyinkinga evamile eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sifunde futhi sifundise izingane zethu ukuthi utshwala luphazamisa kanjani imizimba yethu nemiqondo yethu. Kumele sikwazi ukujwayela ukuphuza kwethu futhi sifunde ukuphuzisa ngendlela efanele. Pic. Empeleni, uBongi ubukeka njengomuntu ogulayo futhi uvame ukubonakala ejabule. Uyazi abantu benza iphutha lokucabanga ukuthi utshwala lwenza umuntu ajabule, kodwa empeleni, lwenza ube nokukhathazeka kakhulu ngemuva kwesikhathi futhi kungaholela ekukhathazekeni okweqile emqondweni wakho. (Pic. 5). Abantu abanjengoBongi banenkinga yokuphuza ngokweqile, inkinga abangayilawuli futhi badinga ukufuna usizo ngokushesha, ngaphandle kwalokho utshwala luzobabulala. (Pic. 6). Ngiyabonga, kunezinhlangano ezisizile abantu abaningi abanezinselelo zokuphuza utshwala, zibasiza baphinde baphile impilo ejwayelekile. (Pic. 7). Ngakho umndeni nozakwethu kaBongi kumele bazame ukufuna usizo olufanayo ukuze basindise impilo yakhe futhi baphinde baphile njengobaba onesibopho. (Pic. 7). UBongi, woza, masikuthathe uye ekhaya. (Pic. 8). INingizimu Afrika kumele ibhekane ngokuphuthumayo nalesi simo sokuphuza utshwala, mhlawumbe ulwazi lokuphuza kufanele lungene ezikoleni nakho. (Pic. 8). Igama lami nguDudu. Sizokhuluma ngokuphuza utshwala. Ukuze sikusize wenze isinqumo sokuthi utshwala luhle noma lubi, masikhulume ngemiphumela yalo kumuntu. Utshwala lungaphazamisa impilo yakho kakhulu. Ukuphuza ngokweqile isikhathi eside kungalimaza umzimba wakho futhi ungase ungabuyeli esimweni sokuqala. Ukudla okungaphansi: Kukhona okuncane okukhona kutshwala. Ngakho-ke, ukuphuza utshwala kakhulu kungakwenza ungakudli. Lokhu kudala ukuthi ugule futhi uzizwe ungenamandla. Ukuphazamiseka kwengqondo: Utshwala lwenza ubuchopho buphazamiseke. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside, utshwala lungaphazamisa ukusebenza kwengqondo yakho. Isifo senhliziyo: Ukuphuza kungase kwenze inhliziyo yakho isebenze kanzima futhi ungase ube nesifo senhliziyo. Umhlola: Utshwala lungadala umhlola womlomo. Ukulimala kwesibindi: Uma uphuza njalo, kungadala ukulimala kwesibindi. Utshwala lungalimaza ne-pancreas futhi uma unegciwane. Ukungasebenzi kahle kokuphuma: I-organ yesilisa ayisebenzi kahle futhi ubhekana nezinkinga zokufinyelela ekuphuzweni. Izenzakalo eziningi zokudlame nokuhlukumeza zenzeka ngoba abantu baphuza ngokweqile. Abantu abakwazi ukuzilawula uma bephuza. Ezinhlungwini eziningi zomgwaqo eziholela ekufeni, kuvame ukutholakala ukuthi abashayeli abaningi baphuze ngaphezu komkhawulo ofanele. Iningi labagibeli abafa ezinhlelweni baphuze. Ukufa nezifo ezidalwe utshwala kubiza uhulumeni imali eningi unyaka nonyaka. Le mali ingasetshenziswa kangcono emfundweni, empilweni, nasemakhaya. Khumbula ukuthi iziphuzo ezahlukene zineziphuzo ezihlukene. Ungakhetha ukuthi iyiphi ofuna ukuyiphuza phakathi kwalezi ziphuzo. Akufanele uphuze lutho ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi utshwala bungakanani obukhona. Lokhu kungaba yingozi kakhulu! Ukuphuza nje ukuze ujabule nokweqa umkhawulo wezinyanga ezimbili zoshukela nsuku zonke, ngenye indlela, akufanele kube yisiko lakho ukuphuza ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa iziphuzo zakho. Phuza uhlobo olulodwa lutshwala ngasikhathi sinye futhi ungaphuzi ngaphambi kokushayela noma ukuhamba emgwaqweni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyodwa kuya kwezimbili: Uxoxa kakhulu futhi awumisi, isivinini senhliziyo yakho sikhuphuka. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu: Ukushayela kwakho kuba kubi kakhulu, awukwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungase uzizwe unokukhathazeka. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezinhlanu: Ungase ungaboni kahle; uma ukhuluma, uyaphazamiseka; awukwazi ukwenza izinto ngokushesha. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili: Awukwazi ukuhamba ngqo futhi kubonakala sengathi uyawela; ubona izinto kabili. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-15 kuya kwezingu-20: Uyaqandwa kakhulu futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungase uphume. Lokhu kukhombisa kahle ukuthi akufanele uphuze ngokweqile ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili. Izinyanga ezintathu zidalela ushintsho em behavior yakho futhi awukwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo. Ungakuphuzanga utshwala uma... Ungavumeli abantu bagcwalise iglasi yakho ngaphambi kokuyiqeda. Uzophela ungazi ukuthi uphuze kangakanani. Ungahlanganisi utshwala obuphuza. Phuza kancane. Ngaphambi kokuphuza iglasi elandelayo yotshwala, phuza iglasi yamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwehlisa izinga lakho lokuphuza. Qinisekisa ukuthi udle ngaphambi kokuphuza. Ungaphuzi utshwala uma ungakudlanga lutho. Ungashayi noma uhamba. Zama ukuthola indlela yokubuyela ekhaya. Ungavumeli muntu ukuba akuphoqe ukuphuza uma ungafuni. Impilo yabantu abasha ingashintsha futhi ibe nezinkinga ngenxa yokuphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye bangase bathole abazali abane-alkoholi. Abantu abasha bangase bathole ukuthi abanye babo baphuza. Lokhu akudala umndeni ojabulayo. Kumele sivikele
Kukhona izifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabazali babezali bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma akukho esingakwenza ukuze sigweme lezi zifo. Singadla ukudla okunempilo, futhi ngisho naleso sikhathi, uma singanakekeli imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwa indlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuze ugweme lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho-ke, nakekela wena. Ukunakekela thina siqu kuyisibopho sethu. Ukudla kuyidingo ebalulekile empilweni. Ukudla kusenza sijabulele ukuphila. Cabanga nje ukuthi sithokozisa kangakanani ukudla okunambitheka kahle nemindeni yethu nokuthi kubi kanjani emihlanganweni uma kungekho ukudla okunambitheka kahle. Ngenkathi sijabulela ukudla okunambitheka kahle, kubalulekile ukudla ngokuhlakanipha. Funda le bhukwana ukuze uthole ukuthi kungani ukudla kubalulekile nokuthi kufanele sidle kangakanani. Funda indaba kaDudu... Qedela i-milkshake yakho, izingane, isikhathi sokuthi niye esikoleni. Ukudla okunempilo kusiza ukufunda kahle. Imizimba nemiqondo yezingane ezikhulayo idinga inani elifanele lokudla nsuku zonke ukuze zikhule kahle. UDudu uthi, ungakuthola kanjani konke okudingayo njengemfene enkulu efana nelanga emathafeni? Umzimba womuntu usebenza ngendlela ehlukile. Sidinga ukudla okunempilo okuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla ukuze sihlale sikhulile futhi siqinile. Woza uphuze itiye, Dudu, kukhona futhi ikhekhe elinambitheka kahle esilethele udadewethu edolobheni lapho esebenza khona. Ngizokucela ukuthi ungiphe ingxenye yekhekhe, ngiyabonga. Kodwa ukuba nolwazi lokuthi kufanele sidle ini kungasiza ukuvikela ingozi yokukhuluphala, kugcine isisindo esinempilo ngokudla ukudla okufanele nokwanele. Lezi yizithombe zomjaho wesokisi wendodana yami. Ungumlandeli omkhulu weBafana Bafana. Lapha ungabona umehluko wokuthi lezi zinsizwa zidinga ukudla okuhlukile ngoba ukudlala kubenza bahlale bephilile, hhayi njengodadewethu osebenza ehhovisi. Kule bhukwana, sikhuluma ngakho ukudla ngendlela enempilo. Ukudla yikho esikudlayo noma esikuphuza ukuze siphile. Kufanele udle ukudla okufanele ukuze uhlale unempilo, usebenze kahle, futhi uphile isikhathi eside. Konke ukudla kunezinto ezimbili ezisigcinayo siphile: amandla nezinto eziphilayo. Imoto kumele ibe nefuela ukuze ikwazi ukuhamba. Ngendlela efanayo, ukudla kukunika umzimba wakho amandla okunyakaza nokwenza izinto ofuna ukuzikwenza. Izinto eziphilayo yizinto ezitholakala ekudleni. Lezi zinto eziphilayo zinegama elihlukile futhi zenze imisebenzi ehlukene emzimbeni wethu. Izinto eziphilayo ezakhiwa umzimba wakho futhi zigcine uqine zibizwa ngama-proteins. Izinto eziphilayo ezivikela ekuguleni zibizwa ngama-vitamins kanye nezinsimbi. Lokhu kudla kunezinto eziningi ezivikela, ama-vitamins, nezinsimbi. Khumbula njalo ukuhlanza izithelo nemifino ngaphambi kokuzidla. Lokhu kudla kukunika amandla. Ezinye izidlo ezihambisana nalokhu zifaka ama-nuts nezimbewu. Ukudla kusho ukudla okudlayo nsuku zonke. Ukuze uthole zonke izinto eziphilayo namandla odinga, kufanele udle ukudla okuhlukile nsuku zonke. Ukuze ukudla kwakho kube nempilo, kufanele ufake okukodwa noma okungaphezulu kokudla okukhona ezitheni eziphilayo nezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezivikela kuzo zonke izidlo ozidlayo. Zama ukukhetha ukudla okuhlukile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ezinye zalezi zinto kufanele zidle kabili noma kathathu ngosuku. Ezinye zalezi zinto kufanele zidle ekuseni. Izingane kufanele zibe nezibiliboco ngaphambi kokuhamba esikoleni. Khumbula ukuthi izingane kufanele zibe nezibiliboco phakathi nezidlo ngoba izibiliboco zazo zincane futhi azikwazi ukudla okuningi ngasikhathi sinye. Ukudla kwethu kuleli lizwe kufanelekile ukudla okunempilo. Empeleni, ukudla kwendabuko kwabazali bethu (okulandwa abantu abaningi) ukudla okunempilo. Ukudla okunempilo okudliwayo nsuku zonke njenge-maize, irayisi, ama-cereals, ubhontshisi, kanye nepapa kubizwa ngokuthi ukudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu kudla kukunika amandla, kwakha umzimba wakho, futhi kuvikele futhi. Lokhu kudla kugcwalisa. Ngoba akucutshunguliwe, kukunika izinto ezidingekayo umzimba wakho. Into embi ukuthi abanye abantu bayakhohlwa ukudla okuyisisekelo. Bathi bangakwazi ukukhokhela ukudla okudlayo. Abantu bavame ukufaka iziphuzo nezithako ekudleni (njengokukhukhula, usawoti, uphizi, noshukela) ukuze kudle kahle. Iningi lezi zinto nezithako azinazo izinto eziphilayo zokunikeza umzimba. Nakuba umzimba wakho udinga usawoti, kufanele kube ngezinga elincane kakhulu nsuku zonke; ingxenye yesipuni ngosuku. Ngokuvamile, gwema ukudla okunoshukela njengezikhukhukazi nezimbewu ezifakwe amafutha. Izibiliboco yizidlo ezilula ezidliwayo phakathi nezidlo. Ukudla izibiliboco phakathi nezidlo kusiza ukugcina umzimba wakho usempilweni kahle usuku lonke. Izingane zidinga ukuba nezibiliboco phakathi nezidlo. Ukudla izibiliboco kubalulekile kodwa kufanele uqaphele ngezinhlobo zokudla ozisebenzisayo kulokhu. Abantu abaningi badla ukudla okufana nezimbewu ezifakwe amafutha, izithako, ama-chocolates, iziphuzo ezibandayo, ama-kekhe, ama-biscuits, itiye, kanye nekhofi. Into embi ukuthi zonke lezi zinhlobo zokudla azikho ukudla okunempilo. Futhi zikhokha kakhulu. Khuthaza ingane yakho ukuthi ithenge izithelo kuphela kubathengisi. Khumbula ukuthi izibiliboco akufanele zishintshe ezinye izidlo eziphilayo. Cishe u-2/3 wombono womuntu wenziwe ngamanzi futhi zonke izinto zomzimba ziqukethe amanzi. Amanzi awanazo izinto eziphilayo ezitholakala ezithelweni ezahlukene kodwa adingeka emzimbeni. Empeleni, zonke izinto eziphilayo kuhlanganise nezilwane nezitshalo zidinga amanzi ukusiza umzimba ukhiphe udoti ngaphakathi. Umuntu udinga ukuphuza okungenani izinkomishi eziyisithupha zamafutha ngosuku ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umzimba unamanzi anele. Umzimba wakho ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi uma kushisa, ngokuphuma kokushisa nangisho lapho uphumeza. Uma kushisa, uzwa umuzwa wokuphuma amanzi, lokhu kungenxa yokuthi umzimba wakho udinga amanzi. Impilo yethu incike kulokho esikudlayo. Ukudla okunempilo kuzokunikeza amandla anele futhi lezi zinto eziphilayo zizosisiza ekukhuleni, zigcine umzimba wakho unempilo ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza, ukudlala, nokwenza ezinye izinto ofuna ukuzikwenza. Lezi zinsizwa zidinga amandla amaningi. Yini inani elifanele lokudla elinika umuntu "amandla" okufanele adle? Ake sibheke inani lokudla okufanele udle. Kangakanani (ikakhulukazi ukudla okunika amandla) okudlayo kuzoncika kulokho okudingayo. Abantu abahlukene banemithwalo ehlukene yamandla. Izingane zidle inani elanele lokudla okunika amandla uma zikhula kahle. Khuluma nomhlengikazi wesikhungo ukuze uthole ukuthi ingane yakho ikhula kahle. Umuntu omdala udla inani elifanele lokudla okunika amandla uma egcina is
Imfundo eyisisekelo yomsebenzi wezokwelapha ihlose ukuhlinzeka bonke osomthetho ngolwazi oludingekayo nokuqonda ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda imibono yabanye kanye nezimo zabo ezihlukahlukene ukuze izinqubo zabo zibe neqiniso futhi zifanele umphakathi abahlala kuwo. Ezinye izinkolelo zifaka phakathi ukuhlola isici esithile umuntu anaso ngokukwenza uma kuqhathaniswa nezici ezifunwa noma ezingafunwa yithimba elithile. Angiphakamisi ukuthi abantu basebenzise izinkolelo ezithile ezingafanele ngenhloso, kodwa empeleni, ezinye izinkolelo zomdabu nezobulili zikhona ezingqondweni zethu, zigcwele izimo zomphakathi futhi ziqhutshwa yisiko elidumile kanye nezindaba. Ngezinye izikhathi zigxile ezikhungweni zethu. Sijwayele ukuzamukela njengamaqiniso. Uma sibhekene nenkinga, sithatha lokhu ngokuzenzakalelayo ngoba kuyinto yemvelo futhi kulula - kulula kakhulu kunokuhlola ngempela udaba ukuze sithole isiphetho esifanele ngokucabanga nokulalela nokuhlola. Ukufana phakathi kweqembu nezinto ezihlukile phakathi kwezigaba kuvame ukuncishiswa noma kugxilwe. Umsebenzi wokubuka amalungu eqembu langaphandle njengokufana kakhulu noma njengokufana namalungu eqembu langaphakathi. Izifundo zesayensi zikhombisile "ukuthanda okujwayelekile kokubona amadoda njengokwethembeka kakhulu kunabesifazane." Emaphuzwini, inkolelo iyinsiza ebalulekile kakhulu engase ibe khona kumuntu, noma umuntu enegunya njengommeleli, umbonisi, umphikisi, noma umphikisi, futhi ngenxa yalokho, le ndlela yokucwasa ingaba nomthelela omubi emiphumeleni yabo nakuqiniso. Ngokufanayo, abahluleli bangaphuthelwa ububanzi obuthembekile obungaphazamisa isenzo esibalulekile sokubiza (abantu abathile) ngamagama abo noma ukusebenzisa amagama aqukethe uthando. Ukucwasa kungase kusebenze kunoma iyiphi iqembu, kodwa ngokuhambisana nomqondo we-metaphorical "okwehlukahlukene," ikakhulukazi mayelana nodaba noma umuntu, kusala kube inselele enqubweni yokwenza izinqumo, lapho kungenzeka khona ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo zizosebenza. Nansi uhlu lwezindlela zokulalela ezisezingeni eliphansi kanye neziphakamiso ezithile zokuthi lezi zindlela zingalungiswa kanjani. Ukulalela Okutholakalayo kungase kungabi khona: Le ndlela engasebenzi kahle ivela emaphuzwini okuthi abantu abaningi bacabanga isikhathi eside kakhulu kunesikhathi sokukhuluma somuntu ojwayelekile. Ngakho-ke, umlaleli uneminithi emithathu yemicabango emaminithini alalelwayo. Ngezinye izikhathi umlaleli usebenzisa lesi sikhathi esengeziwe ukuze acabange ngezinkinga zabo, izithakazelo, nezinkinga esikhundleni sokulalela, ukuhambisana, nokufingqa lokho okukhuluma okufanele kukhulumwe. Ukulalela Okunemibhoshongo: Kubantu abathile, amagama afana nesikhumbuzo sebhokisi elibomvu akhuthaza anger nokwenza bame ukulalela. La magama ahluka ukusuka kwelinye inhlangano kuya kwelinye. Kubantu abathile, amagama afana "nobunzima," "ukuvuleka," "intsha yamanje," njll., yizici esiphendula kuzo ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma izimpawu zivele, sithatha umkhulumeli. Siphula uxhumano nabo futhi siphumelele ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela ngezindlebe ezivulekile nokuvala ingqondo: Ngezinye izikhathi sithatha isinqumo esisheshayo sokuthi umlaleli noma umkhulumeli uhlinzeka ngokuqhuba, nokuthi lokho okukhulunywayo akunamqondo. Njalo sithatha isinqumo sokuthi singakhuphula lokho esikwaziyo noma lokho abazokukhuluma - futhi baphakamisa ukuthi akukho sizathu sokulalela ngoba akukho okusha okuzokhuluma. Kungcono ukulalela futhi ngempela sithole ukuthi lokhu kuyikho noma cha. Ukulalela ngamehlo agcwele: Ngezinye izikhathi sibheka umuntu ngqo njengoba sikhuluma ngenkathi izingqondo zethu zikhona kwenye indawo noma ezindaweni ezikude. Sifaka endaweni ethokozisayo izinkolelo zethu. Ukukhombisa amehlo agcwele (uma kungelona iphupho) kubonakala ebusweni bethu. Singakutshela uma abantu besibheka kanje. Ngokufanayo, bangase babone okufanayo kithi - sithatha noma ubani njengomphikisi. Transfer daydreaming to them sometimes. Ukulalela okujulile kimi: Uma silalela imibono eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu, kufanele siziphoqe ukuba silandele ingxoxo ngensiza yokuzama ukuqonda. Kungenzeka ukuthi sithole umkhulumeli kanye nesihloko okukhulunywa ngaso kuyajabulisa uma silalela futhi siqonda lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela okuhlobene nesihloko esingaphezu kokucabanga: Abaningi bethu abathandi ukuba nemibono ngezilwane ezihlanganyela, ukucwasa, nezikhalazo zethu neziphetho zethu zikhathazeke. Ngakho-ke, uma umkhulumeli ekhuluma ngento ephikisana nalokho esikucabangayo, ukukholwa, nokugcina - sithatha isinqumo sokumisa ukulalela noma sizame ukuzivikela ngokulungiselela ukuhlasela. Noma sifuna ukwenza lokhu noma cha, kungcono ukuthola ukuthi bacabangani, uthole enye icala lombuzo ukuze wenze umsebenzi ongcono wokuqonda nokuphendula. Uma bekhuluma ngakho, sifuna ukuthi bazame ukubona izimbangela nezizathu zezingqinamba zabo futhi bazame ukubona ukuthi yini engase yenziwe ngakho. Sibonisa ukunakwa, sihamba nomunye umuntu, sikhombisa ukunakekela nokuqonda, sikhupha inkinga uma ikhona, silalela ukuze sithole izimbangela zenkinga, sisize umkhulumeli ukuthi aphathe inkinga nezimbangela, sikhuthaze umkhulumeli ukuthi athuthukise ikhono lokwenza futhi simkhuthaze ukuba axazulule izinkinga zabo, sifunda ukuba sithule uma kudingeka ukuthula. Abantu abaphumelelayo ngezinye izikhathi bayazi ukuthi kufanele bathule futhi bagcine ukuzola kwabo. Ukuphikisana nezithiyo ukuze unikeze isinqumo ngokushesha nangokuphuthumayo ukuze unikeze iseluleko. Siphila nezinkinga eziningi ezinzima ezihlanganisa abantu nezimo. Isidingo sokulalela ukuze siqonde sibaluleke kakhulu. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda abantu uma singabalaleli. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda isimo uma sibona ingxenye kuphela yesimo, sisiza kancane. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda izinkinga zabantu uma sinolwazi oluphakeme nolwakhiwo, kuyilapho empeleni, sibhekene nezimpawu, hhayi izimbangela. Kufanele sibone ukuthi ukulalela kuyisici esiyinhloko kulwazi nokuqonda. LENA YINDODA ENYE ETHATHA ISINYATHELO. Uvumela ukuba bakuholele engxoxweni; awubasheshisi ngokushesha ukuze bathathe indlela abafuna ukuyithatha. Lokhu kuhlobene nehlonipho nokuqonda kwabo. LENA YINDODA ENYE EPHUMILE UKUBA NEMVELO. Lokhu kuyithuba elijabulisayo kubantu abaningi, futhi bazothatha leli thuba ngokuthobeka futhi baziphathe ngendlela ejwayelekile futhi nangenhlonipho. Uma ubonisa ukuthi ungathembeka, abanye bazizwa bekhululekile ukwabelana ngezinkinga zabo, izimfihlo, nezibopho. Umphumela uwukuthi - bayakuthola kangcono. ABANTU ABANINGI BAHLOLA INKINGA. Ukulalela okusebenzayo kusiza abantu ukuba babhekane nalabo abakhathalelayo nezinkinga. Bangakwazi ukuhambisa isimo esingasithokozisa ngqo, siqonde kangcono, bese sichaza inkinga ngokucacile nangokufanele. ENYE INDODA
UMnyango Wokuhumusha Nokuhlela weSevisi Yezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) uhlukaniswe ngezindawo ezilandelayo zolimi: Afrikaans, English, Izilimi Zangaphandle, isiZulu, isiXhosa, isiNdebele, isiSepedi, isiSesotho, isiSetswana, isiSwati, isiTshivenda, nesiXitsonga. Uhulumeni omusha uhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene eNingizimu Afrika, ngokuhambisana neSigaba 6 seMthethosisekelo, uhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi "uhulumeni wesizwe nohulumeni bezifunda basebenzisa noma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni ngenhloso zohulumeni, kubhekwa ukusetshenziswa, ukufinyeleleka, izindleko, kanye nesimo sezifunda kanye nezinye izintandokazi zabahlali." Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala indawo lapho iminyango kahulumeni ixhumana ngempumelelo, phakathi kwezinye izinto, nabo bonke abantu bomphakathi ngolimi lwabo olusemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. ISevisi Yezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) isebenza njengengqalasizinda yokwesekwa kwezilimi kwezobuchwepheshe kuhulumeni. Kukhona uhlelo lokuthola ulwazi ngocingo. Izinhlobo zedokhumenti ezihumushwayo ikakhulukazi zifaka lezo eziqondiswe emphakathini, njengezincwadi ezimhlophe, izincwadi eziluhlaza, umthetho ophakanyisiwe ophumeleleke ukuze uthole imibono yomphakathi, izaziso zohulumeni, imithetho, imibiko yonyaka yeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni, imibiko ye-commission kanye nezinkomiti, izivumelwano zomhlaba, izinkulumo zomongameli, izinkulumo zabaminisitiri, kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikaHulumeni, amadokhumenti ezinkontileka, amaphephandaba nemikhankaso, ulwazi lwezindaba, njll. Uma idokhumenti kufanele ihumushwe ngaphezu kolimi olulodwa, kuyakhethwa ukuthi ihlelwe ngaphambi kokuhumusha ukuze igcine umqondo wayo nomyalezo. Umbhalo ohumushiwe uqhathaniswa nomthombo ukuze kuhlolwe ukusetshenziswa nokubekwa kolimi nokuqinisekisa ukubhalwa ngokucophelela nokugcwalisa umbhalo, kanye nokuhlelwa kahle kwamadokhumenti ezomthetho nezaziso zohulumeni, njll. Iminyango esebenza nohulumeni, izinhlangano, nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ithola izinsizakalo zeSevisi Yezilimi Zangaphandle, futhi basebenza namadokhumenti afana nezivumelwano zomhlaba, imibiko yeMnyango Wezokuphepha, izincwadi ezibhaliwe ngababhalisile, njll. Uhlelo lwefoni lunikezwa ukuze kuxazululwe ngokushesha izinselelo zokusebenzisa, ukubhala, nokufaka lezi zilimi ezisemthethweni ngochwepheshe bezilimi bomnyango abaphatha lezi zinkinga. Uma kudingeka, ucwaningo lwenziwa. Nokho, akukho ukuhumusha okuzokwenziwa ngocingo. Uma kubonakala ukuthi umsebenzi okhona uphuthumayo futhi unomthamo omkhulu futhi isikhathi esidingekayo siseduze, ngeke silinde ochwepheshe abasebenzela uMnyango Wezilimi; kuzothunyelwa ngaphandle ukuze kwenziwe ngokushesha. Umthamo omkhulu womsebenzi ovela kuMnyango Wezilimi Zangaphandle uthunyelwe ngaphandle kubachwepheshe bangaphandle njengoba isidingo eNingizimu Afrika nakwamanye amazwe siqhubeka sikhula ngokushesha. Ngokuhambisana nezihloko 3, 6, kanye no-31 zeMthethosisekelo, izinsizakalo zokuhumusha nokuhlela zeNLS ziyasiza uhulumeni ekufezeni izibopho zawo kubantu ngokweMthethosisekelo. Abathengi abakhulu balolu mnyango wokuhumusha nokuhlela bangeminyango kahulumeni nezinye izikhungo ezisemthethweni ezinomsebenzi nezinyathelo nohulumeni bezwe. Kukhona iminyango kahulumeni enezinsizakalo zayo zolimi, futhi zihumusha zodwa, njengeMnyango Wezokulungiswa, iMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanye neSevisi Yezobulungiswa. Nokho, iNLS iyasiza le minyango lapho ibhujiswa umsebenzi noma uma kudingeka ubuchwepheshe obuthile, njengokuthi uma kukhona amadokhumenti adinga ukuhumushwa ezilimini zangaphandle noma akhishwe ezilimini zangaphandle. Ezinye izifunda zinezinsizakalo zazo zolimi, kodwa zifuna usizo ku-NLS uma kudingeka. I-NLS ingancoma izifunda ngababhalisile abathembekile bezilimi ezithile abangasebenzisa. Ukuze kusebenze ngendlela ezokhiqiza imiphumela esezingeni eliphezulu nephumelelayo, ihhovisi lezilimi kumele libheke izidingo zayo ukuze abahumushi nabahleli bakwazi ukugxila emsebenzini wabo ngenkathi abasebenzi behhovisi besiza ngemisebenzi yokuphatha. Idokhumenti kanye nesampula kulandela indlela futhi kudlula ezinyathelweni ezithile, ezinye zazo zingase zibe zokuphatha kanti ezinye zixhumene nokuhumusha nokuhlela. a. Idokhumenti yamukelwa kwiRegistry bese ibekwa uphawu ekhasini langaphandle elikhombisa usuku lokwamukelwa kwayo bese ithunyelwa kumqondisi walowo Mnyango ukuze iphathwe kanye nesinqumo sokuthi kufanele isebenze. b. Uma idokhumenti kufanele ihumushwe ngaphezu kolimi olulodwa, labo abaphethe umsebenzi wehhovisi benza amakhophi olimi lapho kudingeka ukuhumusha. c. Amakhophi athunyelwa kumakhanda alezo zindawo zolimi ezidingekayo ukuze kuhunyushwe leyo dokhumenti. d. Umphathi waleyo ndawo yolimi ubuyekeza idokhumenti, uxoxisana nabanye, bese ethatha isinqumo sokuthi umsebenzi uzokwenziwa ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle. e. Idokhumenti ithunyelwa kumakhalekhukhwini noma kumuntu osebenza ngolimi ophatha incwadi yokurekhoda lapho ezobhala khona zonke izincwadi ezidingekayo ezifana nosuku idokhumenti yamukelwa, inani lamakhasi, igama leminyango ethumele idokhumenti noma umthengi, kanye nalowo ozokwenza umsebenzi wokuhumusha noma wokuhlela. f. Idokhumenti ithathwa umgibeli wombhalo wokurekhoda bese ithunyelwa kumuntu ozosebenza kuyo, futhi uma kufanele ithunyelwe ngaphandle, ithunyelwa kumqondisi ukuze uthole imvume yokuthi idokhumenti ithunyelwe ngaphandle. g. Ngemuva kokuthola le mvume, idokhumenti ithunyelwa ehhovisi lokuphatha ukuze inikezwe inombolo efanele bese ithunyelwa kumhumushi wangaphandle, osevele enze amalungiselelo ngaphambi kokukhuluma njengokukhuluma esigabeni (d) ngenhla. Umuntu osebenza ehhovisi lokuphatha wenza amakhophi omsebenzi ohumushiwe bese ethumela eyodwa kumthengi kanti enye iya esigabeni lapho umsebenzi ophelile ugcinwa khona, bese incwadi ecela ukukhokhelwa kumhumushi ibhekwa ukuze kulungiswe okuthile okufanele kubo. Ngokulandela le nqubo, umsebenzi wehhovisi lezilimi wenziwa ngendlela ehlelekile kakhulu ngoba zonke izinyathelo ezithathwayo ngedokhumenti zaziwa njengoba zirekhodwa. Ngaso sonke isikhathi, izikhathi ezihlukene kumele zilandelwe ukuze kuhunyushwe amadokhumenti eminyangweni ezodinga ngaphakathi kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ezingama-20 nezilimi ezahlukene zangaphandle, okuyinto enzima, kodwa kulula kakhulu ngosizo nokwesekwa kwehhovisi lezilimi. Naphezu kwezinkinga eziningi ezivela, amalungu e-NLS azinikele ekukhiqizeni umsebenzi osezingeni eliphezulu. Kulokhu, kuvamile ukuthi basebenze ngaphezu kwezikhathi ezijwayelekile noma uma becelwa ukuthi benze njalo noma uma kudingeka ukuba benze njalo.
