Ukushayela ngejubane elidlula lezo ezibekwe ezimpahleni zomgwaqo kuyimbangela yokwenzeka kwezingozi zemoto eziholela ekulimazeni okukhulu noma ekufeni kwabantu ngaphezu kuka-50% eNingizimu Afrika. Ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kuyingozi ngoba kwenza konke ukuhamba kube yingozi kakhulu. Uma ushaya ngesivinini, kuba nzima ukumisa noma ukulawula imoto yakho. Unesikhathi esincane sokuphendula uma ubhekene nesimo esibalulekile. Imikhawulo yesivinini ibekwe ngokwakheka kanye nokuhlala kwabantu emgwaqweni. Imigwaqo yasemadolobheni, lapho kukhona khona abantu abaningi, inemikhawulo yesivinini ephansi kunezindlela zasemakhaya ezinezimoto ezincane. Imigwaqo eduze kwezikhungo zemfundo nezinye izindawo ezinabantu abaningi ingase ibe nemikhawulo yesivinini ephansi. Abahamba ngezinyawo: Hamba uhlale ubheke abahamba ngezinyawo. Izikhathi zokuhlala kwabantu: Nciphisa isivinini futhi uqaphele. Iphutha labantu liyimbangela enkulu yokwenzeka kwezingozi zemoto. Isimo sezulu esimanzi: Uma umgwaqo umanzi, ibanga lokumisa liyanda. Isivinini kumele sincishiswe kakhulu. Isimo sezulu esinefu kanye nokushayela ebusuku: Nciphisa isivinini uma ukubonakala kungesihle. Khumbula ukuvula izibani zakho zebhasi ebusuku, hhayi nje izibani zokumisa. Izimo zomgwaqo ezimbi: Ukwakhiwa kwemigwaqo kanye nemigwaqo embi kunciphisa izinga lokuphepha. Bheka izindawo ezimbi emgwaqweni. Ukushayela ngesivinini esikhulu kuyingozi noma emigwaqweni emihle futhi ephephile ngokuphelele. Umshayeli oshayelayo ngesivinini esikhulu uphazamisa ukuhamba kwemoto futhi angase abangele ingozi kwezinye izimoto. UMTHETHO AWUVUMELI NABANI NA UKUDLULA IMIKHULULO YESIVININI EBUKELWE. Umkhawulo we-alcohol emzimbeni wezinyathelo zomshayeli ngu-0.05 g/100 ml. Noma ngabe uphansi komkhawulo, ungase uphathwe icala lokushayela uphuzile uma kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi ukuphuza kwakho kuthinte ukuhamba kwakho. Ngakho-ke, kungcono ukulandela umthetho omuhle: Ungazami ukuhamba uphuzile!! I-alcohol ithinta zonke izisebenzi ezidingekayo zokuhamba ngokuphepha. Iphazamisa ukuqaphela kwakho, ukuhlela, ukubona, ukuhlela, ukulalela, ukuqapha, kanye nesikhathi sokuphendula. Awukwazi ukulawula imoto yakho kahle. I-alcohol ikwenza uzizwe ungathinteki futhi ungazi ngezinto ozihlayo. Ungalahlekelwa yimpilo yakho, noma ubulale noma ulimele abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Ungabhekana necebo elingafika ku-R24,000 NOMA ubhekane neminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ejele. Ilayisensi yakho ingavinjwa isikhathi esingama-3 ezinyangeni uma uphula umthetho okokuqala, unyaka wesibili, kanye neminyaka emihlanu wesithathu. Ngamafuphi, isivinini ne-alcohol kuyinhlanganisela ebhubhisa. Ungaphuzi futhi ushaye.
Ozakwethu bomphakathi bez heritage kazwelonke kanye nomphakathi jikelele bamukelekile ukukhetha abantu abazokhonzela njengoMphakathi weMnyuziyamu uLuthuli. Lo Mphakathi uzoba namalungu angaphezu kweziyi-7 aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wezobuciko, isiko, isayensi, kanye nobuchwepheshe. Omunye wamalungu kumele abe nolwazi oluthile lwezezimali. Ulwazi olujulile nge-heritage kazwelonke, ulwazi olujulile lokuphatha kanye nezimali, ulwazi lwezomthetho, nolwazi lokumaketha nokuxhumana, ulwazi lokuthola uxhaso, imfundo, kanye nocwaningo lwesayensi, kanye nomdlandla wokusebenza komphakathi nolwazi oluthile ngemicimbi yeMnyuziyamu uLuthuli kuyadingeka. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha ithimba elizokwakha uhlu lwabafanele abavela ezithakazelweni ezikhethiweyo. Imiyalelo yeqembu izoqinisekisa ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kuhlanganisa abantu abaneziqu ezifanele zemfundo noma ulwazi olukhethekile noma labo abanomdlandla ezindaweni ezithile ezihlobene, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi othile abe ngomunye wamalungu. Imiyalelo yeqembu izophinde iqinisekise ukuthi ukukhethwa kokugcina kuhlanganisa abantu bazo zonke izindawo zomphakathi nobulili obubili, nokuthi ukukhethwa konke kuhamba kahle. Isitatimende esifushane esisayiniwe ngumuntu okhethiweyo, lapho bevuma ukuthi igama labo likhethwe; kanye namagama abantu abathathu abangaxhumana nabo abazi lowo muntu okhethiweyo futhi banganikeza izinkomba ngabo. Awukho umkhawulo wamagama abantu abakhethiweyo, kodwa hhayi konke lokhu kubhalwe ngenhla.
Indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu ifaka indawo ezungezile kanye nendawo uqobo, futhi ingaqhubeka ibe nendawo enkulu. Kulendawo engcwele, abacwaningi baqoqe ubufakazi ngenhloso yokukhombisa ukuthi ubugebengu bukhona, befuna imikhondo futhi bayihlanganise nendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu. Uma ubugebengu benzeka, ababulali bleave imikhondo endaweni ngokungena noma ukuphuma ngendlela ethile. Le ndlela iba ingxenye yendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu futhi iyindlela eqondile yokuxhuma nendawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu. Lapho amaphoyisa efika endaweni, awanalo uqiniseko oluphelele ngalokho okwenzekile. Ungasiza ekutholeni le ndawo engcwele ngokubheka zonke izindlela ezisetshenziswa ababulali. Ukuhlola ubugebengu kuhilela ukuqoqa ubufakazi bokwazi kanye nezimpawu ezibonakalayo. Ubufakazi obubonakalayo bungaba impahla noma izinto ezithile ezingasetshenziswa ngamaphoyisa ukuze axazulule icala. Amaphoyisa asebenzisa isibonelo sokuthi uma izinto ezimbili zihlangana, kukhona imiphumela engajwayelekile efana nezinwele, ushokoledi, ukuhamba komlomo, uthuli, nezimpawu zokuthinta. Lezi yizinto ezidinga ukuhlolwa ngamaphoyisa. Ubufakazi bungaba obubonakalayo, njengephuzu lesikhwama, noma bungabonakala kahle ngaphansi kwemicroscope, njengezintambo noma imikhondo yegazi. Ubuchwepheshe besimanje buwenza kube lula kumaphoyisa ukuhlanganisa abantu nendawo kanye nezinto. Ukuze kusebenze ubuchwepheshe, izindawo zokwenziwa kobugebengu kumele zigcinwe futhi zivikelwe ekungeneleleni okungadingekile okungaphazamisa ubufakazi. Ngokugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, amaphoyisa azokwazi ukuqoqa ubufakazi obuqondile. Ukuphazamiseka endaweni yokwenziwa kobugebengu kudala isimo lapho ubufakazi obungatholakala futhi obuwusizo buncipha. Ukugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, "indawo engcwele," kuyinto ebalulekile ozoyenza. Ungawuthinti noma ukhiphe izinto endaweni, njengezinto zokuhlala, izingubo, noma ukudla. Ungasebenzisi nefonini yakho; okungenani cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane wakho. Sebenzisa enye indlela, hhayi leyo esetshenziswa ababulali. Uma kungenzeka, buyela ekhaya. Cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane noma enye indawo ukuze ubike lesi sehlakalo. Linda amaphoyisa. Lapho ubika ubugebengu, nikeza ulwazi oluphelele lokuthi ungatholakala kuphi, uma amaphoyisa edinga olunye ulwazi ngaphambi kokufika endaweni. Khombisa indlela noma indlela oyisebenzisile. Bonke abakwi ndawo noma eduze bangaba ngofakazi. Tshela amaphoyisa konke owazi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukubona kwakho kubonakala kungabalulekile. Bhala konke phambi kokuxoxa nabanye ngoba ungakhohlwa noma uphazamiswe.
uChristopher, ophakathi kwekhasi langaphandle, wazalwa enomlomo ophukile nohlanga. Uhlanga lwakhe lwalulungisiwe ngesikhathi eneminyaka emithathu, futhi uphumelele kahle kulokho. Umlomo wakhe uzolungiswa cishe eminyakeni eyodwa. Izingane ezazalwe nohlu ophukile zivame ukuba nezinkinga lapho zikhuluma ngoba umlomo awuhlukanisiwe nezindebe. Ngakho-ke, ingane ayikwazi ukususa kahle, okuholela ezinkingeni zokukhuluma emlonyeni noma ebhodweni. Ukungenelela kanye nohlobo lwephukile, oluhluka phakathi kwezingane, kuyizinkomba zokuthi ingane ingadliwa kanjani. Uma ingane inohlu ophukile kuphela, ngokuvamile akukhona ukuhlaselwa okukhulu kokukhuluma. Ukukhona komlomo ophukile kubalulekile enqubweni yokususa. Inqubo yokukhuluma ihilela ubisi obukhishwe emlonyeni (kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kusebhodweni noma emlonyeni), isitho esikhiqiza amaphuzu obisi (amaphuzu amancane ajikelezayo), kanye nokunyakaza kwalawa maphuzu kusuka phambili komlomo kuya emuva, lapho angagwinya khona. Ngokomlando, umntwana kumele akwazi ukuphefumula ngempela ngesikhathi sokukhuluma. Lapho isitho sikh placed emlonyeni, izindebe zivaliwe, futhi ulimi luphakanyiswa ukuze luphakamise isitho emlonyeni ophukile. Ulimi luphinde luphakanyiswe, kudala indawo enkulu phakathi kwezindebe, futhi ulimi/uhlanga luvalela umoya ukuthi ungene endaweni. Ngale ndlela, kudalwa isikhala, futhi ubisi lukhishwa emlonyeni. Isikhala sivimba isitho ukuthi singaphumi emlonyeni futhi siza ingane ukuba igcine ukuthola isitho. Izindebe, ulimi, izindebe, nezinsini zikhupha ubisi emlonyeni. Inqubo yokukhuluma ifana noma ngabe iyiphi indlela yokudla (emlonyeni noma ebhodweni). Nokho, isenzo esihilelekile ekukhuphukeni ubisi emlonyeni sihlukile kulokho kokukhuphuka ubisi ebhodweni. Isitho sebhodweni asisebenzisi izindebe, imisipha yobuso, ulimi, izinsini, nezindebe zengane ngendlela efanele. Ngokuvamile, ukuhamba kobisi ebhodweni kushesha kunokukhuluma emlonyeni; nokho, lokhu kuthonywa yizinto eziningi zomzimba, njengohlobo lwebhodweni nesitho kanye nosayizi wesitho. Ukuhamba kobisi ngesikhathi sokukhuluma emlonyeni kulawulwa yikhono lomlomo lokukhiqiza ubisi, kanti ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlinzekwa kobisi kukamama kuyanda njengoba ingane ikhipha kakhulu. Ubisi lwemlomo luwumkhiqizo womzimba ongasoze udale ukuphazamiseka emzimbeni njengokudla kwezinye izingane. I-mucosa yomlomo yengane enomlomo ophukile ivulekile, futhi ubisi lwemlomo ngeke lube yiphazamiseko kuyo. Ukukhuluma kubonakala kungakhiqizi izinga elifanayo lok pressure emathunjini njengokudla ebhodweni, njengoba izingane ezinephukile zisebenza kakhulu ezinkingeni zokutheleleka kwezindebe. Ukukhuluma kudala isimo esifanele emathunjini, okunciphisa amathuba okuthola ukutheleleka kwezindebe. Ubisi lwemlomo lunezici zokuvikela ezimelene namagciwane. Luhlanganisa i-lactoferrin kanye ne-immunoglobulins ezisiza ukuvimbela ukutheleleka. Izingane ezinephukile ezikhuluma zinezinkinga ezincane ezibikiwe zokutheleleka. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ingane ikhuluma noma ibhodwe, kufanele ihlinzekwe ngokudla okunempilo okwanele. Ukukhuluma kusiza njengoba kukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwemisipha edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhuluma okujwayelekile (ukuthuthukiswa kwezwi). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izindlela zokudla ingane encane zibalulekile kakhulu. Ingane enempilo ithatha cishe imizuzu engama-20-30 ukuze ikhulume kahle, okuvumela ukukhula okufanele nokudla okunempilo. Izingane ezinephukile zivame ukuba nezinkinga zokukhuluma ngenxa yokukhuluma okungasebenzi kahle nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo lapho bezama ukuhlinzeka isitho. Izingane ezinephukile kuphela azivamile ukuba nezinkinga zokukhuluma. Nokho, iphukile ihlula ekwakheni isivalo esivala isitho. Lokhu kuphazamiseka ngenxa yokuthi ingane isebenzisa ingxenye yangemuva yolimi kanye nengxenye yezinsini (ingxenye ephezulu yezinsini ezibamba amazinyo) ukuze idale isivalo esingaphandle kwesitho. Ukungabi khona kwalolu suku kungaholela ekutheni ubisi luphume ephukile. Ukubamba ohlangothini lwengane enomlomo ophukile ngesikhathi sokukhuluma kusiza ukuvimbela ubisi ukuthi lungaphumi. Nokho, ingane enophukile ayikwazi ukudala isivalo ngemuva komlomo ngoba umlomo nezindebe azihlukanisiwe. Lokhu kuyinkinga ngoba isivalo esidingekayo sangemuva asikwazi ukwenzeka ngesikhathi sokukhuluma. Ukuze kudalwe isivalo sangemuva, kufanele kwakhiwe umoya ophakeme emlonyeni ukuze kudaleke ukuhlinzeka. Kubantwana abanephukile, ukuzama ukudala ukuhlinzeka kufana nokuzama ukuvula ibhaluni eliphukile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngaphandle kokukhuluma, ingane ngeke ikwazi ukuthola ubisi emlonyeni. Nakuba kungaphumeleli ukudala umoya ophakeme, uma isitho sikh placed emlonyeni wengane, ukukhuluma ngokudonsa emuva kuzokwenza ingane iphakamise ulimi lwayo ukuze luphakamise isitho emlonyeni ophukile ukuze kudaleke ubisi. Ukungabi khona kwehlanga eliqinile phezulu kusho ukuthi isitho sizopushwa ephukile. Lokhu kuholela ezinkingeni ezimbili. Okokuqala, isitho asicindezelwa ngokuphelele emlonyeni, uma sikhona, futhi ulimi luphakanyiswa emuva, futhi okwesibili, uma isitho sikhona ephukile, uma ubisi lukhishwa, luzogwinya ngqo emlonyeni esikhundleni sokudlula emlonyeni nasemoyeni. Ukuhamba kobisi emlonyeni kuholela ekutheni ubisi bungekho kahle, ngakho-ke inqubo yokukhuluma ingathatha isikhathi eside. Ukukhuluma kungaba yinkinga engane enomlomo ophukile, ongase ube nokukhathala ngesikhathi sokukhuluma futhi angase angadli wonke ubisi lwakhe. Uma ingane ingadli ubisi obuningi ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, ngeke ikwazi ukuthola isisindo esanele. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma ingane ithatha isikhathi eside ukuze ikhulume, ibhujiswa ama-calories ngesikhathi sokukhuluma esikhundleni sokuthola ama-calories okufanele ithole. Ngemuva kokukhuluma, kuvamile ukuthi ingane iphumule. Ngesikhathi sokuphumula, ukudliwa kokudla kwengane kuvame ukwehla, okuholela ekutholeni isisindo. Ngakho-ke, uma ingane enomlomo ophukile ivuka njalo ngoba ithatha isikhathi eside ukuze ikhulume, lokhu kungaba enye yezizathu ezivimbela ingane ekutholeni isisindo ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi ukukhuluma kungathathi isikhathi eside kunesikhathi esivamile (okungaba imizuzu engama-20 kuya kwengama-30). Uma inqubo yokukhuluma ibonisa ukuthi ithatha isikhathi eside, kusho ukuthi abazali nabo bchitha isikhathi eside. Izikhathi ezinde ezichithwa ngesikhathi sokukhuluma, nokungaphumeleli kuholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka kwabazali. Uhlobo lwephukile luzothinta impumelelo yokukhuluma. Ukukhuluma ingane enom
Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungatheni esingakwenza ukuze sigweme lezi zifo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena ezimpilweni zethu. Lezi zifo kuthiwa zidalwa yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuze ugweme lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho, nakekela wena. Le bhukwana enesihloko esithi "Ukuhlala Usebenza Ukuze Uphile Kahle" ingenye yezi bhukwana eziningi. Uma sithatha isikhathi sokunakekela thina, sizohlala siphilile emqondweni nasemzimbeni. Ukuze sigcine umzimba wethu nomqondo wethu uphilile, kudingeka sihlale sisebenza. Abaningi bethu baphila impilo esheshayo nephithizelayo, okushiya isikhathi esincane sokuphumula. Le ndlela yokuphila isenza sibe nokukhathala nokukhathazeka, okwenza imizimba yethu ibhekane nezinkinga. Kule bhukwana: "Ukuhlala Usebenza Ukuze Uphile Kahle," sibheka ukuthi ukuzivocavoca nokuhlala usebenza kungasisiza kanjani ukuba sibe abantu abaphilile. Le ngubo ikufanele kahle, Fezile, futhi ikwenza ubonakale unamandla. Ngempela, angizizwa nginamandla nhlobo kulezi zinsuku; ngisebenza kanzima. Ngifisa ngabe ngingangena kule mpilo namhlanje. Kodwa uma uqala ukuzivocavoca, uzozizwa uhlukile kakhulu. Ungase uthole indoda ezokuthanda futhi ozoyiphupha njalo. Yebo, Fezile, unethuba lokungabi nenkinga enkulu yomzimba njengami, njengoba ngisebenza ehhovisi futhi ngihlezi usuku lonke, ngiyazibona ngikhuluphala. Yebo, kunjalo, wonke umuntu angagcina ephilile futhi ebukeka kahle. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa zokuzivocavoca, ngizizwa ngcono futhi ngizizwa nginamandla. Nina bobabili anifuni ukuthi sifike sephukile emcimbini. Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngalokho okwenzekayo futhi kuyindlela yokuzivocavoca; ngizizwa ngcono kakhulu! Ukuzivocavoca kusiza abantu ukukhulula lezo zinto ezibabamba ngempilo. Ngithathe isinqumo sokuthi impilo yami iyisibopho sami. Ngihamba amakhilomitha amahlanu nsuku zonke, kwesinye isikhathi ngihamba ngokushesha ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi umzimba wami uthola ukuhamba kahle. Ukudansa kuyindlela enhle yokuzivocavoca, futhi ngivame ukuzizwa umzimba wami uthola ukukhanya ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa. Kumele ngiqhubeke ngenza lokhu. Ngake ngaya kudokotela ongihlole wathi ukuzivocavoca kusiza umuntu ukuvimbela izifo eziningi. Yingakho kufanele sonke sizivocavoce ndawonye. Singakhetha ukuzivocavoca ngezindlela ezahlukene ngeviki ngayinye, njengokuhamba, ukuhamba ngebhasi, ukuhamba, nokudansa. Uma sizivocavoca ndawonye, kuzosisiza sikhuthazane. Ngizokwenza ngokuchaza okwenzekayo emzimbeni wakho uma uzivocavoca nokuthi ukuzivocavoca kungakusiza kanjani. Uma uzivocavoca njalo, uzoba nezehlakalo ezithile emzimbeni wakho ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa. Umzimba womuntu uhlelwe ngendlela engalula ukuyiqonda. Uqukethe amathambo, izicubu, ubuchopho, uhlelo lwezitho, uhlelo lokugaya, nokunye okuningi. Ukuze imizimba yethu isebenze kahle, kudingeka sithathe isikhathi sokunakekela. Ukuzivocavoca kuyindlela eyodwa yokunakekela umzimba. Uma sizivocavoca imizuzu engamashumi amathathu nsuku zonke, ngeke sithole izifo futhi sizohlala sibukeka futhi sizizwe siphilile. Masithole ukuthi kungani lokho. Igazi iletha umoya-mpilo namandla ezicubwini zomzimba. Izicubu zidinga umoya-mpilo namandla ukuze zisebenze kahle. Kunezinto ezahlukene ezenzeka emizimbeni yethu uma sizivocavoca. Igazi lishaywa ngokushesha, livumela umoya-mpilo namandla ukufinyelela ezicubwini ngokushesha. Izinga lokusebenza kwezinhliziyo nezitho lishintsha, kuthumela umoya-mpilo ngokushesha. Umzimba wakho udinga umoya-mpilo ukuze usebenze kahle. Ukuzivocavoca kuqinisa izicubu, kube lula ukuthi zifeze izinyathelo ezithile. Izicubu eziqinile zisebenzisa umoya-mpilo kahle. Uma sizivocavoca, ubuchopho bukhulula ama-hormone akhulula ubuhlungu futhi anciphise ingcindezi okubizwa nge-endorphins. Lezi hormone zisebenza njengemithi yemvelo yokukhulula ingcindezi. Zikwenza uzizwe uphilile futhi unamandla. Umzimba ophilile uphinde wenze umqondo ophilile! Zivocavoca ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho! Ukuzivocavoca nokuhlala usebenza kuzokwenza impilo yakho ibe ngcono. Ukukhathala nokukhathazeka kungaholela kalula ekucindezelweni kwengqondo nasekuntulekeni kokuzethemba, ingcindezi yegazi ephezulu, isifo soshukela, izifo zezinhliziyo, kanye nokukhuluphala okweqile okuthinta ukusebenza kwakho kwengqondo nempilo yakho yokuphila. Ngizizwa ngcono ngoba ngibe ngumuntu osebenza kanzima impilo yami yonke. Abantu abadala bavame ukuthola kunzima ukuhamba izindawo ezinde nokuphakamisa izinto ezincane. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi imizimba yabo isibe buthaka (kunzima kubo ukujolisa). Ukuhlala usebenza kungasiza ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abadala. Labo ababe sebenza ngesikhathi sokukhula bavame ukuphila kahle njengoba behlukanisa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kunezinto eziningi abangazenza. Futhi kulabo abashiyile ukuzivocavoca ngesikhathi besencane, lokhu akusho ukuthi baphuthelwe ithuba; bangaqala ukuzivocavoca ngokuhamba, ukwenyuka izitebhisi, njll. I-osteoporosis ("isifo sokuncipha kwamathambo") yenzeka uma amathambo emzimbeni wakho eba buthaka, ephuka kalula, futhi athatha isikhathi eside ukuphola. Kube nzima ukuhamba uma uthintekile yile nkinga. Ukuhlala usebenza nokudla ukudla okunempilo yizindlela ezimbili eziyinhloko zokukusiza ugweme i-osteoporosis. Ingcindezi yegazi ephezulu iyisimo esivamile kakhulu esithinta abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Uma inhliziyo yakho iphilile, iyashaya igazi ngejubane elifanele nangengcindezi efanele emzimbeni. Uma izitho zakho ziqinile noma zivaliwe, kube nzima ukuphumpa igazi ngazo. Lokhu okubizwa ngokuthi ingcindezi yegazi ephezulu. Ukuzivocavoca, ukudla ukudla okunempilo, ukuphatha isisindo somzimba wakho, nokuthatha imithi njengoba kudingwa udokotela wakho kungasiza ukuphatha ingcindezi yakho yegazi. Ukeve ukuthi: "Umzimba ophilile uhamba ndawonye nomqondo ophilile"? Udinga ukudla ukudla okunempilo, uhlale usebenza, uxoxe nabantu, futhi unikeze isikhathi esanele sokuphumula uma ufuna ukuba nomqondo ophilile? Abantu abambalwa bakhuluma ngempilo yengqondo ngoba kuyinto enzima ukuyiqonda. Akekho ofuna ukubizwa ngokuthi "uyahlanya," "uphazamisekile," noma "uphazamisekile." Ungase ube nezingcindezi uqobo. Ungase ube nezingcindezi uma uthola ukuthi usemhlabeni okwenza ube nezingcindezi. Lokhu kungase kube ngenxa yomsebenzi noma izimo zokuhlala. Ungase ube nezinkinga zokwenza umsebenzi wakho
Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungelona lutho esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Nokho, noma sithatha ukunakekela imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwe yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana innehla ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho uwakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho, qaphela wena. Uma ungashisi, ngeke ube nezinkinga zempilo. Abantu abaningi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bayazi lokho. Ngakho, abashisi izigubhu noma amathuluzi, futhi abakhwabanisi utshwala noma bashise i-snuff (utshwala obungena emathunjini). Le bhukwana innehla amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana nokuphila impilo enempilo. Into engcono kakhulu umuntu angayenza ukuvuma ukuthi angashisi noma ayeke uma eseshisa. Sithemba ukuthi uzokhetha ukuphila kahle ngokungabheki izigubhu noma ukushisa. Funda indaba kaDudu... Um husband wakho uyakhwehlela kakhulu, Gugu. (Pic.1). Kungcono uma engashisi! (Pic.1). Uyazi ukuthi ngishise iminyaka eminingi futhi akukho okwakuhambile kimi! (Pic.2). Uyakubona uDudu, le yimpilo yami ngakho nginamalungelo okushisa ngendlela engiyifisayo! (Pic.3). Kulungile, uyakhumbula ukuthi uDkt. Zondi, udokotela ophakeme, uthi abantu abaningi abafika esibhedlela ukuze bathole ukwelashwa banezifo ezidalwe ukushisa? (Pic.3). Umonakalo odalwe ukushisa utshwala ngaphakathi emzimbeni wakho usuku nosuku ubonisa umonakalo enhliziyweni yakho, emaphashini, emithanjeni yegazi, nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba wakho. Ekugcineni, impilo yakho yonke iyashintsha. Ukushisa utshwala kubulala izigidi zabantu emhlabeni wonke unyaka nonyaka! (Pic.3). Lokhu akusho lutho ngoba sonke sizofela ekugcineni. Angiboni inkinga uma ngibulawa yinto engiyithokozelayo. (Pic.4). Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukushisa utshwala kuphinde kuhlanganyele nabantu abakuzungezile futhi kubenza babe sengozini yezifo ezifanayo ezithinta umshisi. (Pic.5). Futhi njalo khumbula uma ushisa isigubhu ukuthi ungase ungafeli ngokushesha ngenxa yokushisa, kodwa ungase uhlupheke ngesifo esiholela ekuchithweni kweminyaka eminingi ubuhlungu, noma ungase ufe ubuhlungu ngenxa yesifo samaphaphu. Cabanga ngalokhu ngenkathi usenethuba lokuyeka ukushisa okwamanje! (Pic.6). Igama lami nguDudu. Ngifuna sikhulume ngokuqhuba utshwala. Ake siqale ngokubheka amaphuzu ahlobene nokushisa utshwala. Unyaka nonyaka, abantu abangu-12,000 eNingizimu Afrika bafa ngenxa yezifo zenhliziyo, umdlavuza wamaphaphu, nezinye izinhlobo zomdlavuza, kanye ne-bronchitis. Ukushisa utshwala kukhuthaza umuntu ukuba abe sengozini yalezi zifo. Ezinye izindawo, ukushisa kubulala abantu abaningi kunezibalo ezihlanganisiwe zabantu abafa ngempela ngenxa ye-HIV/AIDS, utshwala, nezidakamizwa ezifana ne-heroin ne-cocaine, kanye nezingozi zomgwaqo. Umshisi angabuya esimweni esijwayelekile sempilo uma eyeka ukushisa, kuye ngempilo yakhe, isisindo somzimba, nezinye izimo zempilo, kanye nesikhathi esithathwe eseshisa. Ngonyaka olandelayo kokuyeka ukushisa, kunezinga eliphansi lokuthola izifo ezifana ne-bronchitis. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyishumi, bafeza okufana nomuntu ongakaze ashise. Izigubhu nezitshalo zinezingxenye ezixubile ezilimazayo ezifana ne-carbon monoxide, i-tar, kanye ne-nicotine. Lezi yizinto ezenza abashisi bahlupheke. Ukushisa utshwala kuphinde kulimaze labo abawuphefumulayo. Uma usondelene nomshisi, qonda ukuthi lowo muntu uyaphula impilo yakho ngendlela efanayo abaphula ngayo impilo yabo. Utshwala buphazamisa impilo yakho ngoba bukhona phezu kwezinto ezingama-200 ezilimazayo. Lezi zinto zilimaza amaphaphu. Uma uqhubeka nokushisa, umonakalo uyanda. Lezi zinto zingadala ukuhamba kwenhliziyo nokuhlupheka. I-nicotine iyidrog. Ungase uzithole ufinyelela emathubeni e-nicotine noma ube nephutha elithinta igazi lakho. Uma ufinyelela ku-nicotine, kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho nomqondo wakho kudinga i-nicotine ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uzizwa udinga lokhu nsuku zonke. Uma uthinteka yinto ethile egazini lakho, kuba nzima ukuyeka. Yingakho abantu abaningi behluleka ukuyeka ukushisa. Kuthiwani nge-snuff (utshwala obungena emathunjini)? I-snuff iqukethe zonke izinto ezilimazayo ezitholakala ezigubhu. Abantu abashisayo i-snuff bangathinteka ngezifo ezithile, ezifana nezifo zomlomo, umphimbo, nezifo ezithinta umoya. Kuthiwani nge-marijuana? Odokotela bathole ukuthi i-marijuana ilimaza umzimba wakho ngendlela efanayo nokushisa utshwala. Uma ufinyelela ekushiseni i-marijuana, uzogcina ungakwazi ukusebenza, ukufunda, ukudlala, noma ukujabulela. Kukhona izinhlobo zembewu ezingalimazi? Cha, azikho. Izigubhu, ama-cigar, amathuluzi, kanye ne-snuff konke kulimaza impilo yakho. Uma umuntu eshisa izigubhu ezimbalwa ngosuku, ingabe lokho kungamphazamisa? Nokho, ukushisa isigubhu esisodwa ngosuku kungalimaza! Ungaqali ukushisa! Umonakalo emzimbeni wakho uqala lapho uqala ukushisa. Ungase ubukeke unempilo iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokuthi izimpawu zesifo ziqale ukuvela. Ingabe kubi ukufaka umoya ophuma kubantu abanye? Yebo, ungathola izifo eziningi uma uphila noma usebenza nomshisi. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba uphefumulayo umoya wabo nsuku zonke. Izingane ezizalwa kubazali abashisayo zihlala zihlupheka ngezifo zokuphefumula ezifana ne-bronchitis ne-pneumonia, okungajwayelekile ezinganeni ezingenabazali abashisayo. Kulungile ukuba uphefumulayo umoya ohlanzekile! Abashisi kufanele bahloniphe leli thuba. Abashisi abaningi bayala ukuyeka ngoba abazi ukuthi ukushisa kuphazamisa impilo yabo. Ake sikhulume ngezifo ezithile. Ukushisa kudala izifo eziningi ezahlukene. Eziwubukhali kakhulu yizifo zamaphaphu, umdlavuza, izifo zenhliziyo, nezifo zokuphefumula. Abantu abanezinhliziyo ezilimele bangahlupheka iminyaka eminingi bekhwehlela nokuqina komoya. Izinhlobo eziningi zomdlavuza, ezifana nomdlavuza wamaphaphu, zidalwe ukushisa. Akukho ukwelashwa komdlavuza wamaphaphu. Ukushisa kungadala umdlavuza kwezinye izingxenye zomzimba, ezifana nomlomo, i-bladder, amankonyana, ulimi, nezinye. Igazi emzimbeni wethu lihamba ngeziteshi ezincane esibiza ngokuthi imithambo yegazi. Ukushisa kudala ukuthi lezi zithambo zibe mncane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi igazi alikwazi ukuhamba, okuyingozi enkulu. Uma igazi lingafiki engxenyeni ethile yomzimba, le ngxenye iyafa. Lokhu kwenzeka uma umuntu ehlupheka ngesifo sokuhlaselwa yizitho zenhliziyo noma ukuhamba kwenhliz
Kukhona izifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma akukho okungakwenziwa ukuvikela lezi zifo. Nokho, kukhona nezifo ezivela endleleni esiphila ngayo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, singathola lezi zifo. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwe yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isandleni sakho. Ngakho-ke, nakekela wena. Kumele sithathe ukunakekela thina. Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika lidla utshwala kakhulu kunabantu kwamanye amazwe emhlabeni. Abantu abaningi baphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye baphuza kakhulu kanti abanye baphuza njalo. Lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi. Abanye abantu bayakhishwa emsebenzini ngenxa yokuzinikela kwabo kutshwala. Abanye bathi bangaba nodlame uma bephuzile futhi balwe namalungu omndeni, abangane, nabangane. Kwabanye, utshwala bungaba yingozi, futhi ukuqhubeka kuphuzile kungaholela ekufeni. Kungcono ukungaphuzi utshwala nhlobo ngoba contains ama-toxins ayingozi angaphazamisa impilo yakho. Ukuphuza utshwala kungaba nemiphumela emibi emndenini wakho. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile uma ungumuntu ophuzayo, uphuze ngokucophelela. Funda le bhukwana ukuze ufunde ukuthi ungaphuza kanjani ngokucophelela. Bheka uDudu, lezi zinsizwa seziqalile ukufuna utshwala olusele emshadweni wansuku ezedlule. Pic. UBongi uthatha zonke izinsimbi anazo ukuze athenge utshwala ngenkathi umndeni wakhe uthola ubuhlungu ngoba lelo mali kufanele ibisetshenziswe ukuthenga ukudla nezimpahla nokukhokhela izikole zezingane. Uyazi sengilahlekelwe ukuhlonipha yena. Pic. Kungenzeka ukuthi udla utshwala kakhulu. Kulokhu engikubona, kungenzeka adinge usizo esikhundleni sokugxekwa. Pic. Inkinga yokuphuza kakhulu iyinkinga evamile eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sifunde futhi sifundise izingane zethu ukuthi utshwala buhlupha kanjani imizimba nemiqondo yethu. Kumele sikwazi ukujwayela ukuphuza kwethu futhi sifunde ukuphuzela ngokucophelela. Pic. Empeleni, uBongi ubukeka njengomuntu ogulayo futhi uvame ukuvela engaphansi. Uyazi abantu benza iphutha lokucabanga ukuthi utshwala benza umuntu ajabule, kodwa empeleni, kukwenza uzizwe ungakhululeki ngemuva kwesikhathi futhi kungaholela ekukhathazekeni okukhulu emqondweni wakho. (Pic. 5). Abantu abafana noBongi banenkinga yokuphuza kakhulu, inkinga abangayilawulwa futhi badinga ukufuna usizo ngokushesha, ngaphandle kwalokho utshwala luzobabulala. (Pic. 6). Ngiyabonga, kukhona izinhlangano ezisize abantu abaningi ngezinkinga zokuphuza, zibasiza ukuthi babuyele empilweni ejwayelekile. (Pic. 7). Ngakho umndeni nozakwabo kaBongi kumele bazame ukufuna usizo olufana nalolu ukuze basindise impilo yakhe futhi baphinde bamphinde abe uyise onesibopho. (Pic. 7). UBongi, woza, masikuthathe ekhaya. (Pic. 8). INingizimu Afrika kumele ibhekane ngokuphuthumayo nalesi simo sokuphuza utshwala, mhlawumbe ulwazi lokuphuza kufanele lungethulwa ezikoleni futhi. (Pic. 8). Igama lami nguDudu. Sizokhuluma ngokuphuza utshwala. Ukuze sikusize wenze isinqumo sokuthi utshwala luhle noma lubi, ake sixoxe ngemiphumela yalo kumuntu. Utshwala lungaphazamisa kakhulu impilo yakho. Ukuphuza kakhulu isikhathi eside kungalimaza umzimba wakho futhi kungenzeka ungabuyeli esimweni sokuqala. Ukudla okunganele: Kukhona ukudla okuncane okutholakala kutshwala. Ngakho, ukuphuza utshwala kakhulu kungakwenza ungadli. Lokhu kudala ukuthi ube negciwane futhi uzizwe ungenamandla. Ukuhluleka kwengqondo: Utshwala lwenza ubuchopho buphazamiseke. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside, utshwala lungaphazamisa ukusebenza kwengqondo yakho. Izifo zenhliziyo: Ukuphuza kungakwenza inhliziyo yakho isebenze kanzima futhi ungase ube nezifo zenhliziyo. Umhlola: Utshwala lungadala umhlola emlonyeni. Ukulimala kwezinso: Uma uphuza njalo, kungadala ukulimala kwezinso. Utshwala lungalimaza futhi i-pancreas uma unegciwane. Ukuhluleka kokwakha: I-organ yesilisa ayisebenzi kahle futhi ubunzima bokufinyelela ekwakheni. Izenzakalo eziningi zokuhlukumeza nokuhlukumeza zenzeka ngoba abantu baphuza kakhulu. Abantu abakwazi ukuzilawula uma bephuza. Ezimweni eziningi zokushayisana kwemoto eziholela ekufeni, kuvame ukutholakala ukuthi abashayeli abaningi baphuze ngaphezu komkhawulo onemvume wabashayeli. Iningi labagibeli abafa ezimeni zengozi baphuze. Ukufa nokugula okubangelwa utshwala kubiza uhulumeni imali eningi minyaka yonke. Le mali ingasetshenziselwa ukufundisa, impilo, nezindlu. Khumbula ukuthi iziphuzo ezihlukene zinezingxenye ezihlukene zoshukela. Ungakhetha ukuthi iyiphi ofuna ukuyiphuzela phakathi kwalokhu. Akufanele uphuze noma yini ungazi ukuthi ingakanani utshwala obukhona. Lokhu kungaba yingozi kakhulu! Ukuphuza nje ukuze ujabule nokweqa umkhawulo wezinyanga ezimbili zoshukela nsuku zonke, ngenye indlela, akufanele kube yindlela yakho yokuphila ukuphuza ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa iziphuzo zakho. Phuza uhlobo olulodwa lutshwala ngesikhathi esisodwa futhi ungaphuzi ngaphambi kokushayela noma ukuhamba emgwaqweni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyodwa kuya kwezimbili: Ukhuluma kakhulu futhi awumemezi, umphumela wenhliziyo yakho uyanda. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu: Ukushayela kwakho kuba kubi kakhulu, awukwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungazizwa udinwa. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezinhlanu: Ungase ungaboni kahle; uma ukhuluma, uyabhalisa; awukwazi ukwenza izinto ngokushesha. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili: Awukwazi ukuhamba ngqo futhi kubonakala sengathi uyawa; ubona izinto kabili. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-15 kuya kwezingu-20: Uyakhipha kakhulu futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungase ube phansi. Lokhu kukhombisa kahle ukuthi akufanele uphuze kakhulu ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili. Izinyanga ezintathu zenza ushintsho ekuziphatheni kwakho futhi awuphumelelanga ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo. Ungakaze uphuze utshwala uma... Ungavumeli abantu bagcwalise iglasi yakho ngaphambi kokuyiqeda. Uzophela ungazi ukuthi uphuze kangakanani. Ungahlanganisi utshwala obuphuza. Phuza kancane. Ngaphambi kokuphuza iglasi elandelayo yotshwala, phuza iglasi yamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwehlisa izinga lakho lokuphuza. Qiniseka ukuthi udle ngaphambi kokuphuza. Ungaphuzi utshwala uma ungakudlanga okuthile. Ungashayi noma uhamba. Zama ukuthola indlela yokubuyela ekhaya. Ungavumeli muntu ukuthi akuphoqe ukuphuza uma ungafuni. Impilo yentsha ingashintsha ibe nezinkinga ngenxa yokuphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye bangase bathole abazali abathanda utshwala. Intsha ingase ibone ukuthi abanye babo baphuza. Lokhu akwakhi
Kukhona izifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungathí sina esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Singadla ukudla okunempilo, futhi noma kunjalo, uma singanakekeli imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwa indlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho-ke, nakekela wena. Ukunakekela thina kuyisibopho sethu. Ukudla kuyisidingo esibalulekile empilweni. Ukudla kusenza sijabulele ukuphila. Cabanga nje ukuthi sithokozisa kangakanani ukudla okunambitheka kahle nemindeni yethu nokuthi kubi kangakanani emihlanganweni uma kungekho ukudla okunambitheka kahle. Ngesikhathi sijabulela ukudla okunambitheka kahle, kubalulekile ukudla ngokuhlakanipha. Funda le bhukwana ukuze uthole ukuthi kungani ukudla kubalulekile nokuthi kufanele sidle kangakanani. Funda indaba kaDudu... Qedela i-milkshake yakho, bantwana, sekuyisikhathi sokuthi niye esikoleni. Ukudla okunempilo kusiza ukufunda kahle. Imizimba nemiqondo yezingane ezikhulayo idinga inani elifanele lokudla nsuku zonke ukuze ikhululeke kahle. UDudu uthi, umphakathi omkhulu njengemvubu uthola kanjani zonke izidingo zawo emathafeni? Umzimba womuntu usebenza ngendlela ehlukile. Sidinga ukudla okunempilo okuhlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla ukuze sihlale sikhona futhi siqinile. Woza uphuze itiye, Dudu, kukhona nekhukhi elimnandi esilethe kwi sisi sethu edolobheni lapho esebenza khona. Ngizokucela nje ungiphe ingxenye yekhukhi, ngiyabonga. Kodwa ukuba nolwazi lokuthi kufanele sidle ini kungasiza ukuvikela ingozi yokukhuluphala, kugcine isisindo esinempilo ngokudla okulungile nokwanele. Lezi yizithombe zomjaho wezemidlalo wendodana yami. Ungumlandeli omkhulu weBafana Bafana. Lapha ungabona umehluko wokuthi lezi zinto zidinga ukudla okuhlukile ngoba ukudlala kubenza bahlale bephila, ngokungafani nosisi wakho osebenza ehhovisi. Kule bhukwana, sikhuluma ngokuqondile ngokudla. Ukudla yikho esikudlayo noma esikuphuza ukuze siqhubeke siphila. Kufanele udle ukudla okufanele ukuze uhlale unempilo, usebenze kahle, futhi uphile isikhathi eside. Konke ukudla kunezinto ezimbili eziqinisekisa ukuphila kwethu: amandla nezithako. Imoto kumele ibe nefuels ukuze ikwazi ukuhamba. Ngendlela efanayo, ukudla kunikeza umzimba wakho amandla okunyakaza nokwenza izinto ofuna ukuzifeza. Izithako yizinto ezitholakala ekudleni. Lezi zithako zinegama elihlukile futhi zisebenza ngezindlela ezihlukene emizimbeni yethu. Izithako ezakhiweyo zomzimba wakho futhi zigcine uqine zibizwa ngokuthi ama-proteins. Izithako ezivikela ekuguleni zibizwa ngama-vitamins kanye nama-minerals. Lokhu kudla kuqukethe izithako eziningi ezivikela, ama-vitamins, kanye nama-minerals. Khumbula njalo ukuhlanza izithelo nemifino ngaphambi kokukudla. Lokhu kudla kunikeza amandla. Ezinye izidlo ezihambisana nalokhu zifaka ama-nuts nezithelo. Ukudla kusho ukudla okudlayo nsuku zonke. Ukuze uthole zonke izithako namandla owadingayo, kufanele udle ukudla okuhlukile nsuku zonke. Ukuze ukudla kwakho kube kuhle, kufanele ufake okukodwa noma ngaphezulu kokudla okunezithako nezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezivikela ekudleni ngakunye odlayo. Zama ukukhetha ukudla okuhlukile ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ezinye zalezi zinto kufanele zidle kabili noma kathathu ngosuku. Ezinye zalezi zinto kufanele zidle ekuseni. Izingane kumele zithole iziphuzo ngaphambi kokuhamba esikoleni. Khumbula ukuthi izingane kufanele zibe neziphuzo phakathi kokudla ngoba izimbobo zazo zincane futhi azikwazi ukudla okuningi ngasikhathi sinye. Ukudla kwethu kuleli lizwe kufanelekile ekudleni okunempilo. Empeleni, ukudla kwendabuko kwabokhokho benu (okulandwa abantu abaningi) kudla okunempilo. Ukudla okunempilo okudliwayo nsuku zonke njengokhukhamba, irayisi, ama-cereals, ubhontshisi, kanye nezitambu kubizwa ngokuthi ukudla okuyisisekelo. Lokhu kudla kunikeza amandla, kwakha umzimba wakho, futhi kuvikele futhi. Lokhu kudla kuhlangene. Ngoba akuphathwanga, kunikeza izithako ezidingekayo umzimba wakho. Okubi ukuthi abanye abantu bayakhohlwa ukudla okuyisisekelo. Bathi bangakwazi ukuthenga ukudla okudlula. Abantu bavame ukufaka iziphuzo nezithako ekudleni (njenge-curry, usawoti, uphizi, noshukela) ukuze kudle kube mnandi. Iningi lezi zinto nezithako azinazo izithako zokunikeza umzimba. Nakuba umzimba wakho udinga usawoti, kufanele kube ngezinga elincane kakhulu nsuku zonke; ingxenye ye-teaspoon ngosuku. Ngokuvamile, gwema ukudla okunoshukela njengama-chips nezitambu ezifakwe uwoyela. Iziphuzo yizidlo ezilula ezidliwayo phakathi kokudla. Ukuphuzisa phakathi kokudla kusiza ukugcina umzimba wakho uhlelekile usuku lonke. Izingane zidinga ukuba neziphuzo phakathi kokudla. Ukuphuzisa kubalulekile kodwa kufanele uqaphele ngezinhlobo zokudla ozisebenzisayo kulokhu. Abantu abaningi baphuza ukudla njengama-potatoes afakwe uwoyela, ama-sweets, ama-chocolates, iziphuzo ezibandayo, ama-cakes, ama-biscuits, itiye, kanye nekhofi. Okubi ukuthi zonke lezi zinto azikona ukudla okunempilo. Futhi zibhakabhaka kakhulu. Khuthaza ingane yakho ukuthi ithenge izithelo kuphela kubathengisi. Khumbula ukuthi iziphuzo akufanele zifake ezinye izidlo eziphilayo. Cishe u-2/3 wombili womuntu wenziwe ngamanzi futhi zonke izicubu zomzimba ziqukethe amanzi. Amanzi awanazo izithako ezitholakala ezinhlotsheni ezahlukene zokudla kodwa adingeka emzimbeni. Empeleni, zonke izinto eziphilayo kuhlanganise nezilwane nezitshalo zidinga amanzi ukusiza umzimba ukuthi ukhiphe udoti ngaphakathi kwawo. Umuntu udinga ukuphuza okungenani izinkomishi eziyisithupha zamanzi ngosuku ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi umzimba unamanzi anele. Umzimba wakho ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi uma kushisa, ngokukhathazeka nangokuthi uma uphumeza. Uma kushisa, uzwa umunyu wamanzi, lokhu kungenxa yokuthi umzimba wakho udinga amanzi. Impilo yethu incike kulokho esikudlayo. Ukudla okunempilo kuzokunikeza amandla anele kanti lezi zinto eziphilayo zizokusiza ekukhuleni, zigcine umzimba wakho unempilo ukuze ukwazi ukusebenza, ukudlala, nokwenza ezinye izinto ofuna ukuzifeza. Lezi zinto zidinga amandla amaningi. Iyini inani elifanele lokudla elinikeza umuntu "amandla" okufanele adle? Ake sibheke inani lokudla okufanele udle. Uthola kangakanani (ikakhulukazi ukudla okunikeza amandla) kuzoncika kulokho okudingayo. Abantu abahlukene banezidingo zamandla ezihlukene. Izingane zidle inani elanele lokudla okunikeza amandla uma zikhula kahle. Khuluma nomhlengikazi wesikhungo ukuze uthole ukuthi ingane yakho ikhula kahle. Umuntu omdala udla inani elifanele lokudla okunikeza amandla uma egcine isisindo somzimba esinempilo. Khuluma nomhlengikazi wesikhungo ukuze akusize ngesisindo esifanele somzimba wakho. Uma umuntu edla ukudla
Imfundo eyisisekelo yomsebenzi wezokwelapha ihlose ukuhlinzeka bonke osomthetho ngolwazi oludingekayo nolwazi ukuze baqonde imibono yabanye kanye nezimo zabo ezihlukahlukene ukuze izinqubo zabo zibe nezinhlonipho futhi zifanele umphakathi abahlala kuwo. Ezinye izinkolelo zihlanganisa ukuhlola isici esithile umuntu anaso ngokusilinganisa nezinhloso noma izici ezingafunwa zeqembu elithile. Angiphakamisi ukuthi abantu basebenzise izinkolelo ezithile ezingafanele ngenhloso, kodwa empeleni, ezinye izinkolelo zobuzwe nezocansi zikhona ezingqondweni zethu, zigcwele izimo zomphakathi futhi ziqhutshwa yisiko elidumile nezindaba. Ngezinye izikhathi zigxile ezikhungweni zethu. Sijwayele ukuzamukela njengamaqiniso. Uma sibhekene nenkinga, sithatha lokhu ngokuzenzakalelayo ngoba kuyinto yemvelo futhi kulula - kulula kakhulu kunokuhlola ngempela inkinga ukuze sithole isixazululo esinengqondo ngokucabanga, ukulalela, nokuhlola. Ukufana phakathi kweqembu nezinto ezihlukile phakathi kwezigaba kungase kube phansi noma kugqanyiswe. Umsebenzi wokubheka amalungu eqembu langaphandle njengokufana kakhulu noma okufana namalungu eqembu langaphakathi. Izifundo zesayensi zikhombisile "ukuthandwa okujwayelekile kokubona amadoda njengokwethembeka kakhulu kunezintombi." Emaphutheni, ukukholwa kuyinsiza ebalulekile kakhulu engase ibe kumuntu, noma ngabe umuntu unegunya njengommeleli, ufakazi, ummangaleli, noma ummangali, futhi ngenxa yalokho, le ndlela yokucwasa ingaba yingozi emiphumeleni yabo nakuqiniso. Ngokufanayo, abahluleli bangase baphuthelwe ububanzi bokwethembeka obungaphazamisa isenzo esibalulekile sokubiza (abantu abathile) ngegama labo noma ukusebenzisa amagama aqukethe uthando. Ukucwasa kungase kusebenze kunoma yisiphi isigaba, kodwa ngokuhambisana nomqondo wezithombe "zokuhlukahluka," ikakhulukazi mayelana nenkinga noma umuntu, kusala kube inselelo enqubweni yokwenza izinqumo, lapho kungenzeka khona ukuthi ezinye izinhlobo zizosebenza. Nansi uhlu lwezindlela zokulalela eziphansi neziphakamiso ezithile zokuthi lezi zindlela zingashintshwa kanjani. Ukulalela Okukhona kungase kungabi khona: Le ndlela engasebenzi ivela kumqondo wokuthi abantu abaningi bacabanga isikhathi eside kakhulu kunesikhathi sokukhuluma somuntu ojwayelekile. Ngakho-ke, umlaleli uneminithi emithathu yokucabanga emaminithini ngayinye yokulalela. Ngezinye izikhathi umlaleli usebenzisa lesi sikhathi esengeziwe ukuhlela izinkinga zabo, izintshisekelo, nezinkinga esikhundleni sokulalela, ukuhambisana, nokufingqa lokho okukhuluma okufanele kukhulumiswe. Ukulalela Okubomvu: Kubantu abathile, amagama afana nesikhumbuzo sebhokisi elibomvu akhuthaza anger futhi abenze bame ukulalela. La magama ahluka ukusuka kwelinye inhlangano kuya kwelinye. Kubantu abathile, amagama afana "nobunzima," "ukuvuleka," "intsha yamanje," njll., yizici esijwayele ukuziphendulela. Ngesikhathi izimpawu zivele, sithola umkhulumeli. Silahlekelwa uxhumano nabo futhi siphumelele ekuthuthukiseni ukuqonda lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela ngezindlebe ezivulekile nokuvala ingqondo: Ngezinye izikhathi sithatha isinqumo esisheshayo sokuthi umlaleli noma umkhulumeli uhlinzeka ngokuphoxeka, nokuthi lokho okukhuluma akukwazi. Njalo sithatha isinqumo sokuthi singakhuluma ngakho okukhuluma noma lokho abazokukhuluma - futhi bakhetha ukuthi akukho sizathu sokulalela ngoba akukho okusha okuzokhuluma. Kungcono ukulalela bese uthola ngempela ukuthi lokhu kuyiqiniso noma cha. Ukulalela ngezinyembezi ezikhanyayo: Ngezinye izikhathi sibheka umuntu ngqo sengathi silalela kanti izingqondo zethu zikhona kwenye indawo noma ezindaweni ezikude. Sifaka endaweni ethanda kahle imicabango yethu. Ukukhanya kwezinyembezi (uma kungelona iphupho) kubonakala ebusweni bethu. Singakwazi ukusho uma abantu besibheka ngalendlela. Ngokufanayo, bangase babone okufanayo kithi - sithatha noma ubani njengomhlanya. Phendulela amaphupho kubo ngezinye izikhathi. Ukulalela Okujulile kimi: Uma silalela imibono edidayo nezinkinga ezinzima kakhulu, kumele siziphoqe ukuba silandele ingxoxo ngensizakalo yokuzama ukuqonda. Kungenzeka ukuthi sithole umkhulumeli nesihloko esikhuluma ngaso sithokozisa uma silalela futhi siqonde lokho abakukhulumayo. Ukulalela okuxhumene nesihloko ngaphezu kokucabanga: Abaningi bethu abathandi ukuba nemibono mayelana nezilwane ezihlangene, ukucwasa, nezikhalazo zethu nezixazululo. Ngakho-ke, uma umkhulumeli esho okuphambene nalokho esikucabangayo, ukukholwa, nokugcina - sithatha isinqumo sokumisa ukulalela noma sizame ukuzivikela ngokulungiselela ukuhlasela. Nokho, uma sifuna ukwenza lokhu noma cha, kungcono ukuthola ukuthi bacabangani, thola enye icala lombuzo ukuze sithole umsebenzi ongcono wokuqonda nokuphendula. Uma bekhuluma ngakho, sifuna ukuthi bazame ukubona imbangela nezizathu zezingqinamba zabo futhi bazame ukubona ukuthi yini engakwenziwa ngakho. Sibonisa ukunaka, sihamba nomunye umuntu, sikhombisa ukunakekela nokwazisa, sikhulula inkinga uma ikhona, silalela ukuze sithole imbangela yenkinga, sisize umkhulumeli ukuba athwale inkinga nezimbangela, sikhuthaze umkhulumeli ukuba athuthukise ikhono lokwenza futhi simkhuthaze ukuba axazulule izinkinga zabo, sifunda ukuba sithule uma kudingeka ukuthula. Abantu abaphumelelayo ngezinye izikhathi bayazi ukuthi kufanele bathule futhi bagcine ukuzola kwabo. Ukuvimbela ukuphazamiseka ukuze banikeze isinqumo ngokushesha nangokuphuthumayo ukuze banikeze izeluleko. Siphila nezinkinga eziningi ezinzima ezihlanganisa abantu nezimo. Isidingo sokulalela ukuze siqonde sibaluleke kakhulu. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda abantu uma singabalaleli. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda isimo uma sibona ingxenye kuphela yesimo, sisiza kancane. Sicabanga ukuthi siqonda izinkinga zabantu uma sinolwazi oluphansi kuphela nezici zayo, kuyilapho empeleni, sibhekene nezimpawu, hhayi imbangela. Kumele sibone ukuthi ukulalela kuyisici esiyisisekelo kulwazi nokuqonda. LENA YINDODA ENYE ETHATHA ISINYATHELO. Uvumela ukuthi bakuholele engxoxweni; awuphuthumi kubo ngokushesha ukuze bathathe indlela abafuna ukuyiya. Lokhu kuhlobene nenhlonipho yabo nokwethembeka. LENA YINDODA ENYE EHLANGANISWA NEZIMFUNDO. Lokhu kuyithuba elingajwayelekile kubantu abaningi, futhi bazothatha leli thuba ngokuzithoba futhi baziphatha ngendlela ejwayelekile futhi ngale okwakungokwabo. Uma ukhombisa ukuthi ungathembeka, abanye bazizwa bekhululekile ukwabelana ngezinkathazo zabo, izimfihlo, nezibopho. Umphumela uwukuthi - baziwa kangcono. ABANTU ABANINGI BAHLAZAYO INKINGA. Ukulalela okusebenzayo kusiza abantu ukuba babhekane nalabo abababhekelayo nezinkinga. Bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesimo esingasibheka ngqo, siqonde kangcono, bese sichaza inkinga ngokucacile nangokufanele. ENYE INDODA IHLAZ
IPhalamende lePan-African Parliament libambe umhlangano walo wokuqala e-Addis Ababa ngoMashi 2004, futhi ngoJulayi walowo nyaka, kwanqunywa ukuthi i-PAP izoba seNingizimu Afrika. IPhalamende selokhu libambe imihlangano yalo yesibili neyokuthathu ngokuqhubekayo eMidrand, eNingizimu Afrika. Umhlangano wesibili wawugxile kakhulu ekwamukeleni imithetho nezindlela ze-PAP kanye nezinkampani zayo, kanye nezinkulumo ngemicabango, ingxoxo, nezinhlelo ze-African Union. IPhalamende lePan-African Parliament okwamanje lisasezingeni lokushintsha noma likhunjuzwa okwamanje, isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu eGallagher Estate eMidrand. INingizimu Afrika, ngokusebenzisa iMnyango Wezangaphandle, iPhalamende Lesifunda, ibambe iqhaza elibalulekile empumelelweni yemihlangano yesibili neyokuthathu yePhalamende. INingizimu Afrika igcine ukuzibophezela kwayo ngaphansi kweSivumelwano sokuba yizwe elamukelayo futhi iphinde yanikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe, ngokwesibonelo, ekhirelweni, njengoba iPhalamende lePan-African Parliament lalingakasebenzi ngokuphelele, njengokuhirela abasebenzi. IPhalamende lePan-African Parliament langena emahhovisi awo amasha nomhlangano wesithathu. I-Economic, Social and Cultural Council (ECOSOCC) yamukelwa yi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi 2004, kulandela inqubo yokubonisana ende nezifunda namakhaya. Abamele imiphakathi yase-Afrika bahlangane ehhovisi le-African Union e-Addis Ababa, e-Ethiopia, kusukela ngoMashi 27 kuya kuMashi 30, 2005, ukuze bazise i-Economic, Social and Cultural Council ye-African Union (ECOSOCC). Lo mcimbi obalulekile waphawula ukuqala kwesigaba esisha somsebenzi we-Union mayelana nokwakhiwa kwezindlela zokusebenza ze-ECOSOCC nokwakhiwa kwenqubo yokukhetha amalungu e-ECOSOCC General Assembly. Komitishi yesikhashana yeminyaka emibili yakhethwa ukuze iqhube le nqubo. Ukuze kuhlangabezane nezakhiwo zezomthetho zezinhlelo zomthetho ze-African Union, i-AU Assembly ngoJulayi yanquma ukuthi i-African Court on Human and Peoples' Rights kanye ne-African Union's Court of Justice kufanele ihlanganiswe ibe yinkantolo eyodwa. Idokhumenti yesakhiwo somthetho ehlobene nokwakhiwa kwenkantolo ehlanganisiwe kumele iphothulwe ukuze icatshangelwe yi-Assembly kanye ne-Executive Council ngoJanuwari 2006. Nokho, lokhu ngeke kuvingele ukuqala ngokushesha kwe-African Court on Human Rights, okukhona okwamanje kulandela ukuvulwa kweSivumelwano se-African Charter on Human Rights ngokwakhiwa kwe-African Court on Human Rights eqale ukusebenza ngoJanuwari 25, 2004. I-AU Commission yanikezwa amandla yi-Executive Committee ukuze iqhube ucwaningo okuhloswe ngalo ukwenza kube lula ukuvulwa kwe-STC. Ukungakuthandi kwe-AU Commission ukukhulula umbiko walolu cwaningo kube nomphumela wokuthi oNgqongqoshe balolu siko baphumeze imihlangano bodwa. INingizimu Afrika ibibe yizwe elamukelayo emihlanganweni yamaNgqongqoshe eMisebenzi, Ezokuxhumana, Izindlu, Isevisi Yomphakathi kanye Nezokuphathwa, Imboni kanye Nezokuthutha ngoJulayi. Nokho, i-AU Commission kulindeleke ukuthi ilethe umbiko ocwaningweni ku-AU Assembly ngoJanuwari 2006. Izinhlelo ze-AU zamukele i-Vision and Policy Statement ye-African Union kanye ne-AU Commission's Action Plan okuhloswe ngalo ukuhola ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Afrika nokuphumeza i-NEPAD. Njengomphumela, uxhaso oluhlinzekwe ngezinhlelo eziphambili ze-AU luhlolwe emhlanganweni okhethekile we-Executive Committee, obubanjwe ngo-6-7 Septhemba 2004. Lo mhlangano wamukela ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$158,384 unyaka wezezimali ka-2005/2006. Ukusabalalisa okuphelele kwezimali kuqukethe ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$63 million kweMisebenzi kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$95,384 kweZinhlelo. INingizimu Afrika ibambelela ku-8.25% wezinsiza ezabelwe iMisebenzi ngokwesikali sokuhlola. INingizimu Afrika, njengomholi weKomidi lamaNgqongqoshe, ibambe iqhaza elibalulekile enhlanganweni yokubhaliswa kweSikali Sokuhlola esiphakanyisiwe. Isikali Sokuhlola esisha samukelwa yi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi 2005, futhi kwavumelana ukuthi sizohlala ku-15% ngaphandle kokuthi kwenziwe okunye. Lesi sikhala esisha sizothatha umthelela ngoJanuwari 2006. INingizimu Afrika, ngokuxhasa ngezimali ucwaningo olwenziwe ngu-Ernest & Young okuhloswe ngalo ukuqinisa izindlela zezimali nezimpendulo emsebenzini we-AU, ibone umbiko ocwaningweni ukhululwa, futhi INingizimu Afrika izoxhasa ukuhlinzekwa okuphelele nokusebenza kahle kweziphakamiso ezenziwe ngu-Ernest & Young ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-AU Commission isebenzisa izindlela eziphumelelayo zezimali nezokusebenza futhi ukuthi izakhiwo ze-Information and Communication Technology (ICT) zeKomishini zihlaziywa. Uma lezi ziphakamiso zamukelwa, kulindeleke ukuthi zisebenze kancane kancane, kuqala kulabo abathinta ukusebenza kwezimali noma abasebenzi. Ukuqaliswa kwesinqumo mayelana nezakhiwo ezathathwa ngo-2003 e-AU Assembly eMaputo, ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi kuqhubeka. INingizimu Afrika izosasebenzisa ingxenye yayo eyabelwe abasebenzi. Kuze kube manje, kube nabantu ababili baseNingizimu Afrika abaqashwe yiKomishini, okungukuthi uDr. B Tema (ovela kwiMnyango Wezesayensi Nezobuchwepheshe) njengoMphathi: Izinsiza Zabantu, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe, noMs. F Lortan (ovela emphakathini) njengomphathi wezombusazwe eSigabeni Sezindaba Zomphakathi Nezokuhlala - esaziwa ngaphambili njenge-CSSDCA. Isifungo sokubhaliswa sinikeza wonke amazwe amalungu ithuba lokuqinisekisa ibhalansi yobulili ekubambeni iqhaza. Amazwe amalungu adingeka ukuthi aqoqe umbiko obonisa imizamo eyenziwe noma ukuwa kwezimali ukuze kuthuthukiswe ibhalansi yobulili. Umbiko wezwe kumele uthunyelwe ku-AU Assembly ngoJulayi yi-AU Commission. INingizimu Afrika iphethe futhi ithumele umbiko wayo ngo-2005 kuKomishini ngaphambi kwe-AU Assembly ebibanjwe eSirte, eLibya ngoJulayi 2005. Kwakukhona nezinguquko ezenziwe kumadokhumenti mayelana nezikweletu ezibophelelwe amazwe ase-Afrika ezweni elithuthukile kanye nezikhungo ezahlukene, kanye nezohwebo lwamazwe, uxhaso lokuthuthukiswa, ulwazi, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana (ICT) kanye ne-HIV/AIDS. I-NEPAD iphinde yahlela izingxoxo nemihlangano emikhulu nemiphakathi kanye nomkhakha ongahleleki. Izinhloso ezisemqoka nemiyalezo ye-NEPAD: Afrika ithatha umnikelo nomthwalo wemfanelo wokuthuthukiswa kwezwe; ukukhuthaza nokuqhubekisela phambili ubudlelwano, amalungelo abantu, ukuphathwa kahle, kanye nobuholi obubhekelele, kanye nokuthuthukiswa okungaguquguquki ukuze kuncishiswe ukuncika ezisizini; ukwakha amandla ezikhungo zase-Afrika; ukukhuthaza ukuhweba nokutshalwa kwezimali phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika; ukusheshisa ukuhlanganiswa komnotho wesifunda; ukuphakamisa amandla abesifazane; ukuqina kwezwi lase-Afrika ezinkundleni zomhlaba
Umkhiqizo kufanele uncike emakethe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uthole ukuthi abathengi bafuna ini (izidingo), bese ukhiqiza (ukuhlinzeka) lowo mkhiqizo ukuze uthengise ukuze uthole inzuzo. Uma intengo ikhula, abathengi bazothenga kancane, kodwa uma intengo yehlile, bazothenga okuningi noma izinhlobo ezahlukene zemikhiqizo. Thola izidingo nezintandokazi zabathengi ngokwenza ucwaningo lwemakethe. Ikhwalithi ibalulekile kakhulu. Kumele ibe mnandi futhi ibukeke kahle! Intengo ibalulekile kakhulu. Kufanele ube nenqwaba yokuthengisa. Ukuhlinzeka kubalulekile kakhulu. Kumele ngithole njalo futhi ngesikhathi. Thola ukuthi yiziphi zalezi zimpahla ezifanele ukukhiqiza. Hlela ukukhiqizwa komkhiqizo. Phanda isivuno bese uthola uma sesilungele ukuvuna. Khetha umjikelezo wokumaketha osebenza kahle kakhulu futhi lapho ungathola khona inzuzo enkulu. Uhlelo lokuthengisa lunezinto ezihambisana nezinyathelo ezithatha umkhiqizo usuka kumlimi ufinyelele kumthengi. Ungazuza ngokwengeza inani emikhiqizweni ukuze wandise intshisekelo yakho ngokubandakanyeka ekucwengezeni, ukupakisha, ukugcina, ukucubungula, nokuhweba. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi imbewu, umanyolo, ama-pesticides, amathuluzi, imishini, uphethiloli, umsebenzi, njll. Izindleko zokuhweba zifaka phakathi ukuthuthwa, ukukhangisa, nokugcina. Izindleko zokupakisha zifaka phakathi ukuphawula, izinto zokupakisha, umsebenzi, ukugcina, umshwalense, njll. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi izinto, ukuthuthwa, ukupakisha, ukuhlanganisa, umsebenzi, ugesi, njll. Ukuze unciphise izindleko emjikelezweni wokuthengisa, ungasebenzisa umjikelezo omfushane ngokuthengisa ngqo kumthengi. Ukwengeza inani ngokupakisha nokugcina amanani ukuze kube nentshisekelo kukhiqiza imali eningi. Ukwengeza inani ngokucubungula kukhuphula inani ngomkhiqizo futhi kukhuphula imali engenayo... Abalimi bathengisa imikhiqizo ngqo kubathengi. Abalimi bathengisa kubathengi noma abantu abathenga ukuze bathengise. Ukuthengiswa kwenziwa ngababambiqhaza bemakethe abathengisa kumlimi futhi bathola ikhomishini. Ikhwalithi, ukupakisha, nokubukeka kubalulekile kakhulu, futhi umkhiqizo kufanele uhambisane nezindinganiso zokwakhiwa kwekhwalithi ezamukelekayo nezindinganiso zokupakisha. Izindawo ezivaliwe zokukhiqiza izinkomo zinikeza umsebenzi wokuthengisa kubalimi. Umlimi uthengisa ngqo kumthengisi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sokuhweba. Ikhwalithi, intengo, nokulethwa kubalulekile kakhulu. Inhlangano yabalimi ithengisa isivuno ngokuhlanganyela emakethe esemthethweni. U relationship phakathi kwezindleko nentengo = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa.
Umlando: Le ngqungquthela inikeza ithuba eliyingqayizivele kithi sonke lokho okukhuthaza ukuthi sithathe izinqumo futhi siqinisekise ukuthi singabantu abahloniphekile, futhi sonke singabamba iqhaza ezinyathelweni ezibonakalayo, sithuthukise amasu nezinhlelo ezizosisiza ukuthi sibe nempilo ehambisana neNingizimu Afrika entsha enedemokhrasi (Esekela uMongameli uJacob Zuma). I-MRM iyinhlangano esekelwe ezizindeni ezingafanele ukusetshenziswa ngababusi abaphezulu kodwa ngumphakathi uqobo. Inhloso yayo ukuhlanganisa zonke izindaba eziphathelene nomphakathi ezihlobene nokuhlonipha. Ukuziphatha okuhle kubonakala kuzo zonke izinkolo, futhi abantu bafisa ukuguqula zonke izindlela ezingamukeleki emiphakathini nasezenzweni eziphazamisa izwe lethu. I-MRM izogcizelela umgomo wokuthi umuntu ngamunye kufanele anakekele ukuphila kwabanye, kuqala ekuqondeni ukuthi sikhululeka ezicindezelweni ze-apartheid futhi kufanele sikhululeke emiphumeleni ye-apartheid - uMongameli uThabo Mbeki. I-MRM iyisakhiwo sokukhuthaza, ukweseka, ukwazisa, nokuxhumanisa zonke izimvo ezivela emiphakathini ehlukene. Igxile emphakathini othembekile onemigomo emihle. Inhloso yale nhlangano ukuvivisa umoya we-Ubuntu/Botho, sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo kuhulumeni nasemphakathini. I-MRM izibophezele ekwakheni amazinga amahle okuziphatha ngokusekelwe kumthetho-sisekelo wezwe, "okuyisisekelo esichaza izimiso esizibophezele kuzo futhi sifisa zonke izizwe zomhlaba zikusibone." Ukuhlinzeka ngama-ithuba okucabangela okwenzeka esikhathini esedlule, okwamanje mayelana nezimiso eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuveza amasu nemizamo yokwakha izimiso zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika entsha enedemokhrasi. Ukusiza ekwakheni inhlangano enkulu yokweseka uhulumeni nomphakathi emizamweni yokuhlela izinhlelo ezizovuselela imiphakathi ngokomoya. Ukwakha izinhlelo ezizinzile zokuvuselela izimiso. Ukwandisa imizamo kazwelonke yokukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngokuqinisekisa umphakathi onemigomo emihle, onakekelayo futhi ongenacala. Ukuqinisa izisekelo zenkululeko yethu esiyitholile ngokwakha umphakathi onemigomo emihle ogxile ekuziphatheni okuhle nasekuhlonipheni. Ukwethula uhlelo lwesizwe oluzolandelwa, luzoqala ngezinhlelo zesizwe nezasezifundazweni ngokubheka izilinganiso ezijwayelekile. Ukusebenzisa isu elivumela izincwadi neziteshi zomsakazo ukuba zibambe iqhaza ekusakazeni imibiko mayelana neMoral Regeneration Movement (MRM) kulo lonke izwe. Ukwakha uhlelo lokubambisana oluhlanganisa umphakathi wonke, abantu bezamabhizinisi, nohulumeni. Ukwakha amasu ajulile asebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene angahlinzeka ngesisombululo sokukhulula umphakathi ekucaleni. Ukwethulwa kwe-MRM kube umcimbi oyingqayizivele ngoba kuhlanganise abantu abangu-1,300 abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zelizwe, befika ngezindiza, ngebhasi, nasemotweni, befuna izindlela zokwakha umphakathi onobuntu. Kukhona abaphathiswa, abaphakanyisiwe, amalungu omphakathi, abaholi bezepolitiki, intsha, abaholi bezinkolo, izinhlangano ezizimele, abantu bezamabhizinisi, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Baveze ukuzibophezela kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo lokwakha isisekelo sokuvuselelwa kwezomoya kuleli. Ukwethulwa kunikeze ithuba kubantu baleli zwe ukuba beme ndawonye ekuholeni nasekukhulumeni ngolimi olulodwa ngezindaba eziphathelene nokuvuselelwa kwezomoya. Umongameli we-MRM, uMnu. Smangaliswa Mkhatshwa, wamukela bonke ababekhona, kulandela inkulumo ethulwe ukuze kusekelwe uMongameli uMnu. Jacob Zuma, owavula ukwethulwa kwalesi sikhathi futhi kamuva waxolisa kuMnu. Thabo Mbeki, owayengumongameli owayesohambweni. UMnu. Cedric Mayson wanikeza isithombe esibanzi sezindaba ezibhekene nezwe ngaphansi kwesihloko: Yini inkinga? Ukubulala!, ukuhweba!, ukuhlukumeza!, izidakamizwa, ukucala, ubuhlanga, ubugebengu, ukwephulwa kwamalungelo abesifazane nezingane, umgaphezi phakathi kwabacebile nabampofu, ukungaboni ngasolinye kwezinkolo, ubuhlobo, ukucala kuhulumeni nomphakathi. Kungani konke lokhu kwenzeka kithi? Kufanele siqale ngokuhlola imbangela yokwenziwa kwale nkinga. Sihlangabezane nezinkinga ezivela eziphuthumayo, umthelela wokuphathwa kwangaphandle, kanye ne-apartheid, ethintile indlela esicabanga ngayo nendlela esibona ngayo izinto, isishiye nezinkinga ezinkulu. Futhi kukhona ukuphumelela okukhulu okwamanje. Inkululeko yenze kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo zokushintsha kusuka ekucindezelweni kwamandla angaphandle kuya esikweni ledemokhrasi elihambisana nezibopho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nendlela entsha yokubhekana nokuphila kusukela ngo-1994. Abaningi bayagxeka ezindaba, bavame ukugcizelela lokho esingakufuna ukuphucula: ukuhluleka kwamaphoyisa ukubamba abaphula umthetho, izinkantolo, kanye nalabo abaphethe ukugxila ezimisweni, noma bagxeke uhulumeni. Kodwa kufanele sizibuze. Ukuba nefa namandla kuhlambalaza umbono wezwe elisha lokuphatha ukucela amandla amaningi nokuzidela kulolu hlanga. Singabuyisela kanjani ukugxila kwethu ebantwini - uma imali iba unkulunkulu abaninzi abayikhonzile, uma izinqubo zethu zenza abaningi bahlupheke, futhi uma umoya wobuntu nezimiso ezinhle uqhubeka uncipha? Ithemba lethu lokuphendula kulezi zindaba likhulu. Izinhlanga eziningi zinezinselelo ezifanayo, kodwa izindlela esizibophezele kuzo ukuphendula kulezi zindaba zihluke. Amandla ethu ukuthi izinkolo zethu zibophezele ekuphileni okuhle kithi sonke. Izimpande zethu zisezikhaleni zethu lapho abantu behlala, besebenza, futhi bedlala ndawonye. Singakha izwe elisha ngokubambisana kwabantu bonke baleli zwe. Inhloso yethu ukuvivisa izinhlangano zethu nezakhiwo, hhayi ukuqala kabusha. Ukuvuselelwa kwezomoya yikho lapho sikhona. Lapho sikhona nasezinhlanganweni, futhi thina sonke, singaphendula kulezi zindaba ngokubhekana nezinselelo zokuvuselelwa kwezomoya. Iseshini yasekuseni yaholwa nguMnu. Tim Modise, owabamba iqhaza elikhulu, okwenziwa ngokucula, ukudansa, namazwi agxile empumelelweni nakho okunye esingakwenza. Lokhu kuqinisekisa izimiso esinazo ngaphakathi, isithunzi, kanye nobuhle bomoya wobuntu. Labo ababephuza izidakamizwa, abaphila ne-HIV, amaqembu omculo asejele, amaqembu edansa entsha - bonke babonisa ngesenzo nasezobuciko umoya wethemba lapho ukungathembeki kukhula, ukuqina lapho kunenkinga, ukuzibophezela lapho kubhekene nokwehla kwezomoya. Bonke abafikayo bazibeka engcupheni ngokungena ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Wonke umuntu ongena ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala kumele aziphathe ngendlela ephephile futhi enhlonipho, ebheka abanye abantu abasebenzisa leli thafa. Kungase kubizwe imali ethile uma ufuna ukwenza imisebenzi ethile noma uma ufuna kuphela ukungena; kulokhu, uzonikezwa imvume ehlukile. Ukungena kuvunyelwe phakathi kuka-06:00 no-18:00 ezinsukwini ezithile, ngaphandle uma uvunyelwe ukuba uhambe, uhambe ebusuku, noma ezinye imisebenzi. Imicimbi ehambisana nokuzijabulisa, imfundo, isiko, noma ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokomoya ingabanjwa ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ngenhloso leyo. Izikhangiso nezimpawu kumele zihlonishwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Umphakathi awuvunyelwe ukungena ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala noma kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yayo, futhi ukuvutha kwezikhali ezindaweni ezikhethiwe akuvunyelwe ngezikhathi ezithile. Umsindo noma noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungaphazamisa abanye abasebenzisi bezindawo zezulu zikamasipala noma izilwane zasendle akuvunyelwe. Ukuvutha kwezikhali akuvunyelwe, ngaphandle ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ngenhloso leyo. Izikhali kumele zingashiywa zinganakekelwa, futhi kumele zicinywe ngemuva kokusetshenziswa. Akuvunyelwe ukungcolisa, noma ukususa udoti ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala, ngaphandle uma kudedelwa ezinkombeni ezikhethiwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa umngcele, udonga, izimpawu, noma noma yini enye ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuphazamisa imisebenzi yokuphatha ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala, futhi akekho ovunyelwe ukungena kunoma iyiphi indawo lapho abasebenzi benza khona umsebenzi noma lapho impahla yezulu isetshenziswa ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa, noma ukwenza uphawu oluthile emadwaleni, ezihlahleni, noma kunoma yimaphi amahlamvu ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Noma ubani otholakala ehamba noma edoba, ebulala, noma eqoqe izilwane, izinyoni, izinyoka, izinkanyezi, noma ezinye izilwane zasendle ngaphandle kwemvume noma enye imvume uphula umthetho. Ukudla izilwane ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala akuvunyelwe. Izibhamu, amaqanda, izikhali zokudoba, nezikhali zokuhlasela azivunyelwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala ngaphandle kwemvume yokudoba. Izinja, izilwane zasendlini, nezinye izilwane azivunyelwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala, ngaphandle kwamahhashi uma kuvunyelwe ukuhamba ezindleleni zamahhashi. Ukuhamba nokuqhuba akuvunyelwe ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ngenhloso leyo. Ukuhamba, uma kuvunyelwe, kumele kwenziwe kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethiwe ngenhloso leyo uma imali efanele ikhokhelwe. Ukusebenzisa noma ukuhamba ngeziqhamo, izindiza ezinamandla, ukuhamba ngezindiza, ama-ultralights, amabhola, nezindiza akuvunyelwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Ukusebenzisa noma ukuphatha izinto ezivuthayo akuvunyelwe ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala. Akukho mthwalo noma izindleko ezizothwalwa nguhulumeni ngenxa yokulimala kwempahla yabavakashi ezindaweni zezulu zikamasipala ezivela ezinyathelweni ezithathwe nguhulumeni noma ezenziwa egameni likamasipala noma ngenxa yanoma yisiphi isizathu, ngaphandle uma lokho kulimala kwenzeka ngenxa yokunganaki kwabasebenzi bakamasipala ngesikhathi benza imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Abavakashi bezindawo zezulu zikamasipala bazoba nemithwalo yokulimala okwenziwe ezinsizeni zezulu kanye nezinye impahla zikamasipala okungase kube ngenxa yezinyathelo zabo. Ezinye izimo, izimali, noma imvume zingadingeka emicimbini ethile, ezindaweni ezithile, nasezikhathini ezithile (buka izixhumanisi nezigaba zemicimbi).
Inhloso ukuhlela uhlaka lwesizwe lokulawulwa kwemigudu ye-petroleum, ukusungula iBhodi lokulawulwa kwemigudu ye-petroleum ezobheka futhi ilandele ukuhlinzekwa kohla lwesizwe neminye imibandela ephathelene nayo. Kubalulekile ukufaka isikhungo sokugcina kanye nanoma iyiphi isikhungo ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kokugcina i-petroleum. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa imiyalelo ethunyelwe nokwaziswa okuhlinzekwe ngaphansi kwawo; futhi "kungabopha" kusho isilinganiso esinqunywe yiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, hhayi njengoba kudingwa izibopho zokwenyama. Uthuthukisa ukufinyelela emikhiqizweni ye-petroleum engabizi. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum lisungulwa njengomuntu ophethe. Lingakwenza noma yini ephathelene nokusebenza kwemisebenzi yalo; futhi lisebenzise amandla noma lenze noma iyiphi umsebenzi oyiqondiso yokwenziwa yiBhodi ngaphansi komunye umthetho. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum izoba nezikhulu ezinhlanu ezithunywe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe kumele athumele omunye ummember ovela ezihlongozweni ezithunywe ngaphansi kwesigaba sokuqala ukuba abe ngumholi weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Uma ngasiphi isizathu umholi engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe, abanye ozakwabo bazokhetha omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo ukuba asebenze njengomholi kuze kube umholi ekwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe, noma kuze kube omunye umuntu ethunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Umuntu oyiSikhumbuzo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uzokwenza isikhathi seminyaka emine. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda athumele umuntu osevele ethunywe. Uma ummember weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum eshiya isikhundla sakhe, uNgqongqoshe angathumela omunye umuntu ukuze agcwalise leso sikhundla kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi okhethwe ngaso. Abamemezeli beBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele bakhokhelwe ngezinsiza zabo, futhi amaholo nezindleko zabo kuzovunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali. Akekho umuntu ongathunywa njengommember weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uma lowo muntu engowezwe laseNingizimu Afrika futhi engahlali eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uboshwe ngemuva kokuhlulelwa ngesikweletu futhi engakabuyiselwa, noma uma esekwe imisebenzi ngenxa yokungathembeki, noma uma kungase kube nokungqubuzana phakathi kwezithakazelo zakhe njengommember weBhodi nezithakazelo zakhe zomuntu, okuthinta umsebenzi wakhe noma amabhizinisi akhe. Kumele babe nolwazi olwaneleyo lwezomthetho, ulwazi lwezindlela zokusebenza, ulwazi lwezohwebo, ulwazi lwezomnotho, noma olunye ulwazi oluhlobene nokulawulwa kwemigudu ye-petroleum. Kumele temsilise izithakazelo zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wonke futhi kumele bangabi nokuqonda okungafanele noma ukungathembeki. Ngaphambi kokuthumela abamemezeli beBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, uNgqongqoshe uzokhipha isaziso kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, emema umphakathi ukuba wenze iziphakamiso zabantu. Bonke abamemezeli kumele, uma bethunywa kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, bazi uNgqongqoshe nganoma yimiphi imibandela engase ibathinte ngqo, umsebenzi wabo, izithakazelo zabo zebhizinisi, futhi kumele bazi uNgqongqoshe nganoma yiziphi izinguquko. UNgqongqoshe angathatha emuva ukuthunywa kommember kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uma lowo member ephatha ngendlela ephikisana nezimiso zesigaba 9. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ihlangane ngezikhathi nezindawo ezinqunywe ngumholi. Umholi kumele abize imihlangano yeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum njengoba kudingeka ukuze ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Umholi kumele, uma ecela nguMphathi Omkhulu noma ngabe abanye ababili, abize umhlangano ophuthumayo ukuze ubanjwe phakathi kweviki ezimbili ngemuva kosuku lokucela. Umholi wanoma yimuphi umhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele anqume izinqubo ezizolandela kulowo mhlangano, ngaphandle uma kukhona enye indlela ebekwe ukuba ilandelwe. Iquorum yomhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum iyinani elikhulu labamemezeli. Isinqumo esithathwe inani elikhulu labamemezeli abakhona emhlanganweni sizoba yisinqumo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezivoti nganoma yimuphi umbuzo ophakanyisiwe, umuntu ophatha umhlangano uzoba ne-vote yokugcina ngaphezu kokuvota kwakhe njengommember. Akukho sinqumo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum esizokwenziwa kube phambene ngenxa yokushiyeka kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum noma ngoba umuntu okwakufanele angathathwa njengommember ubekhona ngesikhathi sinqumo sithathwa, uma bonke abanye abamemezeli bebekhona emhlanganweni futhi benelungelo lokubamba iqhaza njengabamemezeli bequorum futhi isinqumo sithathwa inani elikhulu labamemezeli abakhona emhlanganweni futhi banelungelo lokuvota. UMphathi Omkhulu noma, uma engakabikho, ummember weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum okhethwe nguMphathi Omkhulu, uzophatha yonke imihlangano yeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, enelungelo lokukhuluma emhlanganweni kodwa enganelungelo lokuvota kulowo mhlangano. Noma yimuphi umhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uvulekile emphakathini ngaphandle uma kukhona ulwazi olunobungozi noluyimfihlo oluhambelana nokuba ngumnikazi noma ukuhweba okumele kuxoxwe, futhi kulokhu, umuntu ophathelene kufanele anikeze izizathu ezisemthethweni kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum zokuthi kungani lowo msebenzi ungafanele ukwenziwa emphakathini. Uma iBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ithatha isinqumo nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokuba emhlanganweni ohleliwe, leso sinqumo sithatha umthelela ngokushesha futhi kumele sibhale, signwe inani elikhulu labamemezeli, futhi sethulwe emhlanganweni wokuqala ohleliwe weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ngemuva kokwenziwa ukuze kufakwe kumarekhodi. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele iqinisekise ukuthi wonke amarekhodi ayo okusebenza agcinwa. Abamemezeli kumele baphendule futhi kumele bangabambisani ekuvoteni noma ekuxoxeni nganoma yimuphi umbuzo abazi ukuthi uzobathinta ngqo noma ngqo; futhi kumele benze ngendlela elindelekile kumuntu osebenza emphakathini. Wonke amaqiniso eBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum nezizathu zawo kumele zifinyeleleke emphakathini. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophathwe kabi nganoma iyiphi indlela ngesinqumo sathathwa yiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele anikeze le ndaba kwiNkantolo Ephakeme ukuze ibuyekezwe lelo sinqumo. IBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ithumele uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. UMphathi Omkhulu uzobheka ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kweBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum; futhi uzophatha izindaba ezihlobene nabasebenzi abathunywe ngaphansi kwesigaba 3.
Noma nini uma umsebenzi ubandakanyeka engozini ephathelene nomsebenzi wabo engaziwa, le ngozi ingaholela ekulimazweni noma ekufeni. Noma nini uma umsebenzi ebika ukulimala kwabo kumqashi wabo, uma ngesikhathi sokubika bephawula ukuthi le ngozi yenzeka ngenxa yomsebenzi ongaziwa. Uma le ngozi iholela ekufeni, ekulahlekelweni kokuzizwa, noma ekusikeni ingxenye ethile yomzimba futhi lapho umuntu olimele ebhekwa njengongenakusebenza okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14, umphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza kufanele futhi aziswe ngokuphuthumayo ngefeksi noma ngefoni. Qedela "Ingxenye A" yekhasi lokuqala le fomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele, ubhale igama, futhi ufake usuku lapho kukhonjiswa khona. Susa "Ingxenye B" efana kakhulu ne "Ingxenye A" ekhasini 1 ngokuyikweleta lapho kunezikhala, nikeza umsebenzi "Ingxenye B" bese umcela ukuthi ayinikeze kudokotela noma esibhedlela lapho baphathwa khona. Ezigamekweni ezinzima, "Ingxenye B" kufanele ithunyelwe kudokotela noma esibhedlela ngokushesha. Qedela "Ingxenye A" ekhasini lesibili le fomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele lapho. Thumela umbiko ophelele we-engozi kanye neMbiko Yezokwelapha Yokuqala W.CI. Qedela ifomu elisha mayelana nomsebenzi olimele. Le fomu akufanele ibambezeleke ngoba kulindeleke ukuthi umsebenzi uqale ukusebenza noma imibiko evela kudokotela ilindelwe. Umqashi ongaphenduli ngengozi kwiKomidi Lokukhokha usebenzisa le fomu ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 uzobhekwa njengonobungozi ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokukhokha Wezingozi Zomsebenzi Nezifo zika-1933, futhi angase abhekane nezindleko eziphelele zokukhokha eziphathelene nale ngozi. Umqashi ongaphenduli kumphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza ngefoni noma ngefeksi ngengozi eyaholela ekufeni, ekulahlekelweni kokuzizwa, noma ekusikeni ingxenye ethile yomzimba noma isimo lapho umsebenzi engakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo izinsuku eziyi-14 uzotholwa njengonobungozi ngaphansi kweMthetho Wempilo Nokuphepha ka-1993. Kufanele usebenzise ifomu elifanele ukuveza izifo ezitholakele ngenxa yomsebenzi owenziwayo W.CL.1. Uma umsebenzi olimele eyeka ukusebenza, gcina irekhodi le-adresi lapho angatholakala khona ukuze usize ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali evela kwiFundo Yokukhokha okufanele ikhokhwe ibanjwe kuye. Qedela ifomu elibhalwe ngamagama amakhulu futhi uphakamise (X) ezindaweni ezifanele. Ngiyavuma ukuthi le mbiko yokulimala ethi yenzeke emsebenzini, ngokwazi kwami, iyiqiniso.
