B Uma izindleko zingamukelwa yiKomidi Lokukhokha, iFundo Yokukhokha ngeke ikhokhe. C IMBIKO YEZOKWELAPHA YOKUQALA W.CL.4 kufanele igcwaliswe kabili
Imicimbi yokuphepha nemisebenzi ye-ofisi... Ukucubungula kwezezimali ngaphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamasiko. I-ofisi ephethe ukudalwa kwezimpawu. Ukuqonda okuphelele kokuhlanganiswa kwamasiko, isayensi, nobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukiseni, inhlalakahle yomphakathi ekuphakamiseni ubunikazi nasekuphakamiseni amanani ahlukahlukene ezwe lethu. Emculweni, ifa lesiko, kanye namagugu, ngokuhlonipha ukuhlukahluka, nokuxhasa izinhlelo zezimali. Ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ezweni lethu njengendlela yokuphakamisa wonke umZulu ukuba abe nengxenye empilweni yokuxhumana, yezepolitiki, nezomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa okulinganiselwe ukuze kugcinwe, kugcinwe, kuvikelwe, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando wethu, izimpawu zethu zenkululeko, ifa, namagugu kuyavunywa. Ukubheka emuva konyaka odlule, kube nempumelelo ebonakalayo ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe ngomhla we-DACST. Kusukela ekubonakaleni/nokufinyeleleka kwezinsiza zamasiko okuholela ekudaleni imisebenzi, kuya ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zocwaningo ezisezingeni lomhlaba. Indlela imiphakathi noma umkhakha wezobuciko ongashintshwa ngayo nokuthi singanikeza kanjani umnikelo ezinhlelweni eziholwa uhulumeni ngendlela yokubambisana futhi ehambisanayo, esibiza ngayo njengezinhlelo ze-cluster. Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kunezinkomba ezibalulekile okufanele sihlole kuzo ezingeni eliphakathi njengelizwe. Ibhajethi enkulu yonyaka yokwakha ubuchwepheshe edinga ukuxhaswa ibhajethi ye-R1.5 billion. Emkhakheni wezobuciko namasiko, kunezidingo eziphuthumayo zokuthi uhulumeni asihole. Isidingo sesithombe esisha sezobuciko, esisekelwe ekuxhumaneni kwezinsiza ezingashintshi. Ukuguqula imicabango ibe izenzo ngokwenza ukuthi imboni yamasiko idale amathuba emisebenzi. Mayelana nezilimi, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenkomba efanele ngokomthetho yokukala izilimi nokuhlukahluka kwazo, ngesikhathi umhlaba ungumkhiqizo owodwa futhi isimo sezimali sikhulu. Unyaka odlule wabona izinguquko ezinkulu ngendlela i-DACST eyibona ngayo. IyiSikhungo esisebenzisa okungenani ama-90% ebhajethi yayo (R1 billion) ezinhlelweni zangaphandle uma kuqhathaniswa nezinhlelo zangaphakathi, nezinsiza zangaphandle ezixhaswe yi-DACST zithola uxhaso kulolu-90%, okuhlanganisa nezinhlangano ezihola ucwaningo lwesayensi, amabhodi ahlobene nezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika, iminyuziyamu, nezinkalo ezihlobene nokuboniswa kobuciko. Ukwakha ubudlelwano emikhakheni enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze kuqale ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yokuphatha nokuphatha efanayo. E-Cabinet Lekgotla kaJanuwari 2001, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi esikhathini esizayo, izinsiza zamasiko ezifana nezandla, umculo, nezinkonzo, kanye namafilimu, zizofakwa ezinhlelweni zezimali ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuthuthukiswa/ukukhula nokudala imisebenzi. Sekucacile ukuthi izinsiza zamasiko zingadlala indima ebalulekile emnothweni ophumayo, okufana nezinsiza zemvelo ezifana nokumbiwa nokulima. Amazwe ahlukene afana neSweden neMexico anikeza ukuqinisekiswa okungaphikiswa ngalokhu. Ukuphakamisa imikhakha yocwaningo nokuthuthukiswa. Le ndawo kumele iphathwe ngokuhlonipha ukuphathwa kwayo nokubhekelela, ngokuya ngezidingo zendawo nezitayela zomhlaba ekubhekelweni nasekuthuthukisweni, ngokuya ngezidingo zendawo nezitayela zomhlaba. Ukuze kusizakale le nhlelo, kufanele kwenziwe ukuhlola nokuhlola okufanele (isibonelo, ukubheka phambili) ngokubambisana neNational Advisory Council for Development. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhajethi ehleliwe yonyaka ye-R2.5 billion kufanele ikwenze okungenani kabili ezinyangeni eziyishumi ezizayo. (Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi ayihambisani naleyo yezenhlalakahle). Okwamanje, sigcina uxhaso lwe-GDP kazwelonke ku-0.7%, okuyingxenye yesithathu ye- OECD average futhi encane uma kuqhathaniswa nenani elihambisanayo lamazwe athuthukile afana neNingizimu Korea neFinland. Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obuphambili kunezimpempe ezinkulu ekwehliseni izindleko emnothweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala izindlela ezizinzile zokudlulisela ulwazi nobuchwepheshe ezinkampanini (ikakhulukazi ku-SMMEs). Ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yamasiko. Izinhlelo zezimali zonyaka zalesi sikhungo zika-2000/2001 zifaka imicimbi ehlukahlukene ezindaweni zomphakathi. Singachaza ukuqwashisa komphakathi ngokwesayensi, ukusungulwa kohlelo lokubhekana ne-HIV/AIDS ekuthuthukiseni inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe, nokusungulwa kohlelo lweMlando Womlomo. Ukugcina nokuthuthukisa ifa. Ifa liyingxenye ebalulekile yobunikazi. Iningi leNingizimu Afrika linezakhiwo zefa ezithuthukiswe ngokwanele nakuba zingaxhaswanga kahle (njengeminyuziyamu, izinkalo zokulawula). Ukuguqulwa kwalezi zakhiwo kubalulekile emnothweni nasekultureni. Ukuhlanganiswa nokwandiswa kweminyuziyamu emihlanu yomlando wezimo nezithombe ezintathu eKapa: umlando wezimo, umlando wamasiko, nomlando wezempi, kubonise inzuzo enkulu. Sekuphakanyisiwe futhi kwethulwe kwiCabinet. Le ndlela iphakanyiswe njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi eziyi-11 zaseNingizimu Afrika njengoba kuqinisekiswe ngumthethosisekelo. Le ndlela inikeza indlela yokuhamba phakathi kwezilimi. Kulolu hlelo, isigaba ngesigaba, kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ukwengeza ukuphothulwa kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi. Ulwazi lwasekhaya/nolwakho olunye lungaba umthombo wokukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona ingozi yokuthi lolu lwazi lungasetshenziswa ngamasu angaphandle angabheki ulwazi lomphakathi njengolwakhe. I-ethnomedicine ne-ethnopharmacology iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo, ezilwane, kanye nefa lesiko nokuhlonipha izinkampani, imvelo yokudla kwezitshalo, indlela amasiko aphathwa ngayo, kanye nokwakhiwa/ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezithile. Kukhona imithombo yokuxhasa ucwaningo lwezokwazi imvelo nezinsiza ezibekwe ngaphansi kwe-Human Research Council ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuvikelwe ulwazi lwasekhaya/nolwakho. Ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba bokuthula nokuvikela imithombo. Lezi zicabango zashintsha zaba izenzo ngonyaka odlule? Lesi sikhungo sithuthukise indlela eqinile yokuphatha eholelwa ngumenzi, esekelwa ngumsizi nomqondisi-jikelele. Indlela yokuhlangana kwabaphathi kanye nendlela yokwethula iziphakamiso nokuphatha izinsiza zabantu ithole ukunakwa okukhulu ngenxa yomsebenzi weqembu elisha lokuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu. Njengoba umbiko wezinsiza zabantu uthi, zonke izinhloso zokwakhiwa kwabaphathi zifeziwe. Sikholelwa ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yezingxenye zonke ezixhaswe yi-DACST (isayensi, ubuciko, ifa, izilimi) ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokuphatha ezisekelwe emibonweni eyabelwana ngayo nentshisekelo yokuhlonipha nokwethembeka. Ulwazi kanye nesikhungo. Lezi zinkalo kufanele zithuthukise izinqubom
Ukuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena, kanye nabanye abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Umphakathi ungumuntu oqokwe nguMphakathi weNkantolo noma iNkantolo ukuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Izingane zibhekwa njengabantu abanokukhubazeka ngoba umthetho uthathe ukuthi azikwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Uma lezi zingane zine mpahla, kubalulekile ukuba kube nomuntu oqokwe ukuphatha ifa. Ngokuvamile, umntwana unabangane abaphethe impahla yabo nezindaba eziphathelene nabo, ngakho akukho sidingo sokubabiza njengoba bengabakhulumeli babo. Nokho, kungase kwenzeke ukuthi izingane zingabi nabakhulumeli noma abazali, futhi kudingeka ukuba kube nomphakathi wengane oqokwe ukuphatha ifa noma impahla. Noma umntwana enomphakathi wemvelo, iNkantolo inganquma ngokuhlukile. Uma impahla yomntwana ihlanganisa imali efakwe kwi-akhawunti yomphakathi, akudingeki ukuba kube nomphakathi ophathayo, nakuba umphakathi angase aqokwe. Ukuphathwa komphakathi ezindabeni zezingane kudlala izindima ezimbili ngaphansi kwalesi simo. Ukunakekela isimo nempilo yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Isimo eNingizimu Afrika siqonda ukuthi umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena ungumuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka engu-21 ongakhululiwe ngesimo somshado noma umyalo wenkantolo. Ukukhala kufakwa eNkantolo. Ifomu J243 lichaza impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Ukuphathwa komuntu ofanele njengomphakathi, oqokwe ngumndeni womntwana (ngokuvamile abantu abaqokwe baveza emhlanganweni obizwa nguMphakathi weNkantolo ngenhloso yokuxoxa ngale ndaba). Isicelo sokuphathwa njengomphakathi senziwa sisebenzisa ifomu J197. Ubaba ophilayo ongakakhululiwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela umntwana. Umama womntwana owazalwa ekhaya ongakakhululiwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela lowo mntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Ubaba onikwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Itestamente lapho kuthiwa umphakathi kufanele ibhaliswe kahle futhi yamukelwe nguMphakathi weNkantolo. Inani lesikhashana lempahla yomntwana kufanele liboniswe kufomu J243. Umbiko ochaza ukuthi umphakathi oqokwe ukhethwe ngumuntu onegunya emqulwini oqukethwe ku-testamente nokuthi umuntu obhale i-testamente wayenelungelo lokwenza kanjalo. Umsebenzi kanye neziqinisekiso zomphakathi oqokwe ziqukethwe kufomu J262 ngaphandle kokuthi umphakathi akhululwe yi-testamente ekwethuleni lezi ziqinisekiso. I-Nkantolo, njengomgibeli wezingane onamandla amaningi, ingaqoka umuntu njengomphakathi ukunakekela isimo nempilo yomntwana nokuphatha impahla yabo nefa. Kuvame ukuba ngumuntu onokukhathazeka ofaka isicelo eNkantolweni. Ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo, iNkantolo iqoka umgibeli wefa ukuvikela amalungelo omntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena ukuze ihlole isimo futhi ibone ukuthi isicelo sikhona kanjani. Umgibeli wefa noMphakathi weNkantolo kufanele baveze imibiko eNkantolweni. Uma iNkantolo isiqedile ukucubungula isicelo, iqoka umphakathi, futhi uMphakathi weNkantolo kufanele aqale isinqumo seNkantolo ngokukhishwa kweMibhalo Yomphakathi nokubavumela ukuba baqale njengomphakathi. Lo mbhalo ofanayo wesicelo seNkantolo ulandelana nemibiko ekhishwe ngumgibeli wefa noMphakathi weNkantolo. Isinqumo seNkantolo sokuphatha umphakathi. Ifomu J242 liqukethe inani lempahla nefa lomntwana. Umsebenzi kanye neziqinisekiso zomphakathi oqokwe ziqukethwe kufomu J262 ngaphandle kokuthi iNkantolo ikhulule ekwethuleni lezi ziqinisekiso. Ukuphatha ifa labantu abashonile abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Abantu abachazwe yiNkantolo njengokuphatha kabi impahla. Ukuphatha ifa labantu kanye nemali ethathwe ngokomthetho yiMnyango Wokuphatha Izimpahla ngomyalo wenkantolo. Ukuphatha ifa lomuntu okungasekho (umuntu ongaziwa ukuthi uphi futhi ongekho nommeli wakhe eNingizimu Afrika). Akuyona indawo yeMphakathi weNkantolo ukuhlela umuntu ukuba anakekele umntwana noma umuntu ophatha isimo nempilo yomntwana. INkantolo Ephakeme ingaqoka omunye umuntu ngaphandle komndeni womntwana njengomuntu ozosiza umntwana. Ngokufanayo, iNkantolo Ephakeme ingathathela lowo muntu osiza umntwana ilungelo lokuba umxhaso walo mntwana. Mayelana nokugcina umntwana ophazamisekile, iMthetho Wezingane No. 74 ka-1983 uveza ukuthi uMphakathi Wokunakekela Izingane endaweni lapho umntwana ehlala khona ungakwazi ukuhlela umuntu ukuze anakekele umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena, uma kutholakala ngemuva kokuhlola ukuthi umntwana udinga ukunakekelwa. Isigaba 14 seMthetho Wezingane sichaza izimo lapho umntwana ethathwa edinga ukunakekelwa, okuhlanganisa isimo somntwana ongenabo abazali noma abakhulumeli noma isimo lapho abazali babo bengatholakali. Umuntu oqokwe nguMphakathi Wokunakekela ungumuntu onakekela umntwana nsuku zonke. Nokho, umgibeli womntwana akanalungelo lokuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakabi nakho amandla okuphatha yena.
Omunye wezinkinga ezibalulekile eNingizimu Afrika ukuthola isixazululo ezimweni eziningi zokuhlaselwa kwezimboni ezithinta kabi umphakathi wezolimo. Senza konke okusemandleni ethu ukwenza umehluko obonakalayo mayelana nokuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuphepha kwabafuyi, amathuba angavela ukuze bagxile ekukhiqizeni imikhiqizo yezolimo esebenzayo. Ukuphakanyiswa kwemali okuvela kuMali ye-Agri Securitas kule bhukwana kukhombisa ukuzinikela kwethu ekuphakamiseni umphakathi wezolimo ukuba uthathe isikhundla sokuphepha kwawo. Kuyajabulisa kwiNhlangano Yezolimo eNingizimu Afrika ukubambisana neNhlangano Yezokuphepha yaseNingizimu Afrika kulolu hlelo olubalulekile lokuletha ulwazi kumphakathi wezolimo wonke. Khumbula: impilo yakho ibalulekile kithi; ndawonye singakwenza umehluko. Le bhukwana ihlelwe ukuze ithuthukise ukuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ikakhulukazi ukuphepha komphakathi wezolimo. IKomidi Lokuxhumana Lezifunda le-Eastern ne-Western Cape (POCOC) lithathe lesi sinyathelo sokwakha umhlahlandlela wokuphepha nokuwuhlanganisa kule bhukwana. IKomidi Lokuxhumana Lezizwe (NOCOC) linqume ukusabalalisa le bhukwana ezwenikazi futhi lisekele lokhu ngemali evela kwabanye ababambiqhaza. Le bhukwana iqukethe ulwazi mayelana neSikhungo Sezokuphepha SaseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS), iMpi Yezwe yaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF), kanye nezinyunyana zabafuyi. Ichaza ukuthi lezi zinhlangano ziqanjwa kanjani futhi zisebenza kanjani ukuze zilwe nokuhlaselwa kwezimboni. Iphinde ikhulume ngePhrojekthi Yokuvikela Izindawo Zasemaphandleni (RPP) nokuthi le phrojekthi ixhumene kanjani neMisebenzi ye-Akantus II, umkhankaso wokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezinsizakalo zokuphepha okukhomba ekuthuthukiseni ukuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Enye into ebalulekile yale bhukwana yizinhlelo zokuphepha ezikhona. Izinhlelo zokuphepha zibalulekile ngoba izinhlangano zokuphepha (SAPS neSANDF) zibheka ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini yezolimo njengomunye wemibuzo eyashiywa ngaphandle kwenhlelo zokuphepha zasemaphandleni (RPP). Uma zisetshenziswa kahle, izinhlelo zokuphepha zizothinta ukuphepha komphakathi wezolimo. Uhlelo lweMpi luwuhlelo olwenziwa ngenhloso yokuzithandela olungaphansi kweNhlangano Yezempi yaseNingizimu Afrika olusebenza ngendlela engaphelele. Umphathi ngamunye unesibopho sokwenza uqinisekise ukuphepha nokuvikeleka komphakathi othile (ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma ezidolobheni). Usizo abahlinzeka ngalo ngokuvamile lubizwa ngokuthi usizo lendawo. Usizo lendawo luhlanganisa umphakathi wonke wendawo, ngakho-ke ngisho nomuntu ong member wohlelo lweMpi angathola ukuvikelwa ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo, nakuba engatholi zonke izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuba member wohlelo. Ababamba iqhaza kulolu hlelo lweMpi abanaso isibopho sokuvikela ngaphandle kwemingcele yezindawo abenza kuzo; banelungelo lokuvikela nokwenza uqinisekise ukuphepha kwemiphakathi yabo kuphela. Lolu hlelo lungachazwa kafushane njengokuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zibe yizicucu ezincane, ezilawulwayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lezi zindawo ezincane zinezinombolo ezithile zezimboni noma izindlu, kuye ngosayizi wendawo kanye nokwabiwa kwezindawo abantu abahlala kuzo. Amalungu endawo axhumana ngefoni noma ngomsakazo njengohlelo lokuxhumana uma imigqa yehluleka. Ezinye izinhlelo zokuxhumana ziyingxenye ebalulekile yephrojekthi yokuphepha ezindaweni. Amalungu endawo axhumana nomholi wabo (okhethwe ngamalungu) onendlela yokuxhumana nesiteshi samaphoyisa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuphendula okusheshayo kwamaphoyisa uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa. Umholi wePhrojekthi angazisa umphathi waleso sikhathi uma kudingeka amandla aqinile. Inqubo yokuxhumana ingathatha isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke amalungu endawo kumele akwazi ukuvikela imikhaya yabo futhi athembe ozakwabo nabanye amalungu endawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula okusheshayo esimweni esiphuthumayo. Ngalesi sizathu, indawo kumele ilungiselele ukubhekana nezimo ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke. Umphathi Wendawo uzosiza le phrojekthi yendawo uma isungula uhlelo lokuphendula ezimweni. Ukubaluleka kokusebenza kahle kwalesi sihlelo kuncike ekubambisaneni okufanayo kwamalungu endawo. Bamba iqhaza - kuzokusiza! Kukhona ama-foramu amaphoyisa (CPF) nemiphakathi esiteshini, endaweni, nasezifundeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi wezolimo ukhuthazwa ukuba ujoyine iSouth African Rural Police Federation (SARPF) lapho bengafunda khona izindlela zokuzivikela nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuxhumana uma kunezingozi. Uma ujoyina i-CPF noma i-SARPF, umphakathi wezolimo uyaziswa ngamalungelo awo, njengelungelo lomuntu ophakathi komphakathi lokuthwala nokusebenzisa isibhamu. I-South African Rural Police Federation (SARPF) iyinhlangano yokuzithandela esebenza ngendlela engaphelele. Amalungu ale nhlangano ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezine, okuyi amaphoyisa asebenzayo, amaphoyisa asekelayo, amaphoyisa akhethekile, kanye namaphoyisa asezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezidolobheni. Amaphoyisa aphakathi kwezigaba zamaphoyisa asezindaweni zasemaphandleni nasezidolobheni yilezo eziseduze kakhulu nokuvikela izimboni. Labo abafuna ukuzinikela bangafaka isicelo esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze ukuze bafakwe ohlwini lwezizinda. Abazinikeli bakhethwa ngendlela efanayo nalabo abafaka izicelo zomsebenzi ophelele, kodwa akudingi ukuba ne-licence yokushayela. Izidingo ezivamile ezifana nezitifiketi zokushayela, izitifiketi zemfundo, nokuhlolwa kwezempilo zengqondo azisebenzi kulabo abafaka izicelo zokufakwa ohlwini lwezizinda emkhakheni wezindawo zasemaphandleni nasezidolobheni. NgokweSahluko 5 semithetho eyasungulwa nguMphathi Wezizwe noma uMphathi Wezifunda, bangabizwa ukuba basebenze kunoma iyiphi indawo ngosuku nesikhathi esinqunywe nguMphathi Wezizwe noma uMphathi Wezifunda futhi benze imisebenzi ephathelene namaphoyisa edolobheni noma endaweni yasemaphandleni ngesikhathi noma endaweni eyabelwe nguMphathi Wezizwe noma uMphathi Wezifunda ophathelene. Bangadluliselwa kwenye imikhakha uma behlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zaleyo mikhakha futhi beqeqeshwe noma befuna ukungena eqeqesheni leyo mikhakha; futhi ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe yoMphathi Wezizwe, abavumelekile ukwenza imisebenzi yenhlangano ekhethiwe, iSikhungo Sokuphepha, ezwenikazi, endaweni yokundiza, noma kunoma iyiphi enye igatsha. Umphathi ngamunye kumele anqume ngokwabelana kwamaphoyisa asezindaweni zasemaphandleni esiteshini sakhe, emkhakheni, noma kwezinye izikhungo zeNhlangano ngokwezidingo nezinto ezibalulekile zesiteshi, emkhakheni, noma kwezinye izikhungo. Ochwepheshe bezolimo baphakathi kwale phrojekthi yokuvikela izindawo zasemaphandleni (RPP) ezweni lonke. Lezi zinkampani zixhumene nezinyunyana zezolimo zezifunda.
Yini efinyelelwa yi-NEMA? Ubani ongafaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Ingabe isenzo noma isinyathelo esikhala ngaso singaphula amalungelo akho ezemvelo aphathelene ne-NEMA? Ingabe kukhona indlela yokulungisa izikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Kwenzekani ngemuva kokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amalungelo akho ezemvelo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Funda lapha kuqala. Ukusebenzisa iNational Environmental Management Act (NEMA) kungaba lula. Awudingi ukuba nommeli ukuze ufake isikhalazo kumuntu okwamanje odinga umonakalo emvelweni noma kumuntu okucatshangwa ukuthi angase enze umonakalo esikhathini esizayo. Awudingi nommeli uma ufuna ukujoyina njengomuntu wesigceme ezinqumweni eziphathelene nemvelo. Kuyasiza ukuhlela ukuhlangana nomuntu onolwazi nge-NEMA ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo. Umthetho ungaba nzima futhi ungadidanisa. Inkinga yakho ingase ibe nezimpande ezijulile. Kungase kube nezindlela ezingaphezu kweyodwa zokuyixazulula. Ungase udinge futhi ukubuza umuntu onolwazi ngalezi zindaba noma izinkinga ezingafakwanga kulolu hlelo. Ungase ufune ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi lokho okwenzayo kusemkhakheni ofanele. Uhlu lwamawebhusayithi kahulumeni nezinsiza zomthetho nolwazi olunomthelela lutholakala ekugcineni kwalolu hlelo. Bangakunika usizo mahhala ekuvikeleni imvelo yakho. Uma inkinga yakho ihilela ezinye izindaba, bangakudlulisela endaweni efanele yokusiza. Yini amalungelo ezemvelo? Ngonyaka ka-1994, umthethosisekelo omusha wasungula ilungelo lokuphila endaweni enempilo njengelungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Uma umthetho uthi into ethile iyilungelo eliyisisekelo, kusho ukuthi konke okwenziwa uhulumeni kufanele kuhambisane nalokho okukhulunywe ngalolo lungelo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imithetho, izinqubo, nezinyathelo ezithathwayo. Abantu, kanye nemiphakathi, izinkampani, nezinhlelo kufanele zenze ngokuhambisana nelungelo. INkantolo yeMithetho ingase ibeke eceleni imithetho ephikisana nalolu lungelo, futhi izinkantolo zingase ziqedele izenzo zikahulumeni noma zomphakathi eziphula lo mthetho. Ukubeka eceleni kusho ukungafaki emsebenzini noma ukushintsha. Ilungelo eliyisisekelo lemvelo lithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila endaweni engalimeleli empilweni yabo noma ekuphileni kwabo. Kukhona futhi ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezilungile nezilindelekile ukuvikela imvelo, njengokuvikela ukungcoliswa komoya, ukukhuthaza ukulondolozwa, nokuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli kwemiphakathi kanye nokukhula komnotho. Ngaphandle komthethosisekelo, kukhona eminye imithetho eminingi evikela imvelo, njengomthetho wokulondoloza, umthetho wamanzi, nomthetho wokungcoliswa komoya. Le mithetho ivikela eziningi izinto ezingalimaza imvelo. Ngisho noma kungabi nomthetho ovikela ingxenye ethile yemvelo, kukhona njalo ilungelo lemithetho ongakusebenzisa ukuvikela impilo yakho nokuphila kahle nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu benza ngendlela efanele ukuvikela imvelo. I-NEMA iyimthetho omusha osiza ukuvikela amalungelo akho ezemvelo kangcono. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokusungulwa kwemigomo yemvelo ekhombisa uhulumeni lokho okufanele akwenze. Ngokwesibonelo, ukwazisa uhulumeni ngalokho okubizwa ngokuthi "ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli," okusho ukuthi wena njengomphakathi noma njengomuntu wempahla kufanele ube nengxenye ezinqumweni ezithinta imvelo. Usiza ukuvikela imvelo ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni ucabangela zonke izimpawu (umthelela wemvelo) ezingase zivele ngenxa yokuthuthukiswa ngaphambi kokuvuma ukuthi kuqhubeke. Ukuvikela labo abasebenza abavuma ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezilimazayo emvelweni, kanye nababikeli (labantu abahlinzeka ngemininingwane) ngabaningi abalimaza imvelo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kithi ukusiza izinkinga nezinkinga (ukuxazulula ukungavumelani kwemibono nokuxazulula). Ekugcineni, kunciphisa ingozi yokuthi uzothola uzama ukuvikela amalungelo akho uma ezinye izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga zihluleka. I-NEMA ichaza imvelo njengendawo yemvelo nezemvelo, izici zamasiko, nezinto ezithile ezithinta impilo yomuntu noma ukuphila kahle. Le mikhombandlela isetshenziswa kanjani? Ibonisa ukuthi ungafaka kanjani isikhalazo, ufune indlela yokulungisa, noma uthathe isinyathelo somthetho mayelana nokuthile okungase kwenzeke noma okukhona okwenzekile futhi kulimaza imvelo. Ichaza ukuthi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emizamweni yokuthinta izinqumo ezizothinta imvelo nezindlela zokuvikela imvelo ngokuvumelana nohulumeni. Uma ufuna ukufunda kabanzi nge-NEMA, funda lezi ziqondiso. Uma ufuna ukufaka isikhalazo mayelana nomonakalo wemvelo okwenzekile noma ongase wenze esikhathini esizayo, kunezinyathelo ezinhlanu kulolu hlelo. Lezi zinyathelo zizokukhombisa ukuthi ungayisebenzisa kanjani i-NEMA. Uma ungazi impendulo yombuzo noma udinga olunye ulwazi, bheka isigaba kulolu hlelo lapho kukhona inombolo efanayo nalowo mbuzo bese ufunda. Buyela futhi ubheke lombuzo. Uma ungakwazi ukuphendula yebo kulombuzo, qhubeka komunye. Uma uqhubeka ungakuqondi kahle impendulo yombuzo, noma ufunde le ndatshana, noma ufuna olunye ulwazi, xhumana neMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha, bheka Isigaba 10 lapho uzothola khona ikheli. Uma uphendule ngempela kuyo yonke imibuzo, funda Izigaba 8 no-9 ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nokwenzekayo uma uthatha isinyathelo. Ukuthatha isinyathelo somthetho. Uma ungazi impendulo yombuzo noma ucabanga ukuthi impendulo ingeyiyo, ungawulahli ithemba. Funda lesi sigaba seziqondiso futhi uxhumane neMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha wesifunda sakho noma kazwelonke. Umbuzo 2: Ungafaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 3. Umbuzo 3: Ingabe isikhalazo sithinta ukuphulwa kwamalungelo ezemvelo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Yebo, bheka Umbuzo 4. IPhalamende lePan-African Parliament libambe umhlangano walo wokuqala e-Addis Ababa ngoMashi 2004, futhi ngoJulayi walo nyaka, kwanqunywa ukuthi i-PAP izoba seNingizimu Afrika. IPhalamende selokhu libambe imihlangano yalo yesibili neyokuthathu ngokulandelana eMidrand, eNingizimu Afrika. Umhlangano wesibili wawugxile kakhulu ekwamukeleni imithetho nezindlela ze-PAP kanye nezikhalazo zayo, kanye nezinkulumo ngamasu, ingxoxo, kanye nezinhlelo ze-African Union. IPhalamende lePan-African okwamanje lisasezingeni lokushintsha noma lilawulwa okwamanje, lineminyaka emihlanu eGallagher Estate eMidrand. INingizimu Afrika, ngeMnyango Wezangaphandle, iPhalamende Lesifunda, idlale indima ebalulekile empumelelweni yemihlangano yesibili neyokuthathu yePhalamende. INingizimu Afrika igcine ukuzibophezela kwayo ngaphansi kweSivumelwano sokuba yizwe elamukela futhi iphinde yanikeza ukwesekwa okwengeziwe, njengokuhlinzeka ngabasebenzi, njengoba iPhalamende lePan-African lalingakasebenzi ngokuphelele, njengokuhola abasebenzi. IPhalamende lePan-African langena emahhovisi awo amasha nomhlangano wesithathu. IKomidi Lezomnotho, Lezenhlalo Nezamasiko (ECOSOCC) lamukelwe yi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi 2004, kulandela inqubo yokubonisana ende namazwe amalungu nemiphakathi. Abamele imiphakathi yase-Afrika bahlangane ehhovisi le-African Union e-Addis Ababa, e-Ethiopia, kusukela ngoMashi 27 kuya kuMashi 30, 2005, ukuze baqale iKomidi Lezomnotho, Lezenhlalo Nezamasiko le-African Union (ECOSOCC). Le ngxenye yomlando ibonisa ukuqala kwesigaba esisha somsebenzi we-Union mayelana nokwakhiwa kwezindlela zokusebenza ze-ECOSOCC nokwakhiwa kwenqubo yokukhetha amalungu e-ECOSOCC General Assembly. Ikhompiyutha yesikhashana yeminyaka emibili yakhethwa ukuze iqhube le nqubo. Ukuze kuhlangabezane nezinhlelo zokwakha zezimali ze-African Union, i-AU Assembly ngoJulayi yanquma ukuthi iNkantolo yase-Afrika Yamalungelo Abantu Nezizinda kanye neNkantolo ye-African Union kufanele zihlanganiswe zibe yinkantolo eyodwa. Idokhumenti yesakhiwo sezomthetho ephathelene nokwakhiwa kwale nkantolo ehlanganisiwe kufanele iqedwe ukuze icatshangelwe yi-Assembly kanye ne-Executive Council ngoJanuwari 2006. Nokho, lokhu ngeke kuvimbe ukuqala ngokushesha kweNkantolo yase-Afrika Yamalungelo Abantu, esele ikhona kulandela ukusebenza kweSivumelwano se-African Charter on Human Rights ngokwakhiwa kweNkantolo yase-Afrika Yamalungelo Abantu eqala ukusebenza ngoJanuwari 25, 2004. IKomidi le-AU lenziwe umyalelo yiKomidi Eliphezulu ukuze lenze ucwaningo oluhlosiwe lokwenza kube lula ukusebenza kwe-STC. Ukungafuni kweKomidi le-AU ukukhulula umbiko walolu cwaningo kube sekuphoqelela oNgqongqoshe balolu siko ukuba babambe imihlangano ngokwabo. INingizimu Afrika ibibe yindawo yokwamukela imihlangano yoNgqongqoshe Bezemisebenzi, Ezokuhlaliswa, EzeMisebenzi Yomphakathi Nezokuphathwa, EzeMboni Nezokuthutha ngoJulayi. Nokho, iKomidi le-AU kulindeleke ukuthi likhombise umbiko ocwaningweni kwi-AU Assembly ngoJanuwari 2006. Izinhlelo ze-AU zamukele iVision and Policy Statement ye-African Union kanye nohlelo lwezenzo lweKomidi le-AU oluhlosiwe ukuhola ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Afrika nokusebenza kwe-NEPAD. Njengomphumela, uxhaso oluhlinzekwe ezinhlelweni eziphambili ze-AU luhlolwe emhlanganweni okhethekile weKomidi Eliphezulu, obambelekile ngoSepthemba 6-7, 2004. Lo mhlangano wamukela ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$158,384 konyaka wezezimali ka-2005/2006. Ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okuhlangene kuqukethe ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$63 million kwezemisebenzi kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwezimali okungama-US$95,384 kwezinhlelo. INingizimu Afrika yathumela u-8.25% wezinsiza ezabelwe zemisebenzi ngokwehlukaniswa kokuhlola. INingizimu Afrika, njengekhanda leKomidi yoNgqongqoshe, idlale indima ebalulekile enhlanganweni yokubhaliswa kweSikali Sokuhlola esiphakanyisiwe. Lesi Sikali Sokuhlola esisha samukelwa yi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi 2005, futhi kwavunyelwana ukuthi sizohlala ku-15% ngaphandle kokuthi kwenziwe okunye. Lesi sikhala esisha sizosebenza ngoJanuwari 2006. INingizimu Afrika, ngokuxhasa ngempahla ucwaningo olwenziwa ngu-Ernest & Young oluhlosiwe ukuqinisa izindlela zezimali nezimpendulo emsebenzini we-AU, ibone umbiko ocwaningweni ukhishwa, futhi INingizimu Afrika izosekela ukusebenza okuphelele nokuphumelelayo kweziphakamiso ezenziwe ngu-Ernest & Young ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iKomidi le-AU lisebenzisa izindlela ezinhle zezimali nezimpendulo zokusebenza nokuthi izakhiwo ze-Information and Communication Technology (ICT) zeKomidi zibe sezikhathini. Uma lezi ziphakamiso zamukelwa, kulindeleke ukuthi zisetshenziswe kancane kancane, kuqala ngalezo ezithinta ukusebenza kwezimali noma abasebenzi. Ukwenziwa kwesinqumo mayelana nezakhiwo ezathathwa ngo-2003 kwi-AU Assembly eMaputo, ukuqashwa kwabasebenzi kuqhubeka. INingizimu Afrika izosebenzisa futhi ingxenye yayo eyabelwe yabasebenzi. Kuze kube manje, abantu ababili kuphela baseNingizimu Afrika bayeqashwa yiKomidi, okungukuthi uDr. B Tema (ovela eMnyangweni Wezesayensi Nezobuchwepheshe) njengomqondisi: Izinsiza Zomuntu, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe, noMs. F Lortan (ovela emphakathini) njengomphathi wezinhlelo kwiSahluko Sezokuhlaliswa Nezokuphila - esaziwa ngaphambili njenge-CSSDCA. Isifungo sokuziphendulela sinikeza wonke amazwe amalungu ithuba lokuqinisekisa ibhalansi yezenhlalo ekubambeni iqhaza. Amazwe amalungu adingeka ukuthi aqoqe umbiko obonisa imizamo eyenziwe noma ukwehluleka ukukhuthaza ukulingana kwezobulili. Umbiko wezwe kufanele uthunyelwe kwi-AU Assembly ngoJulayi yiKomidi le-AU. INingizimu Afrika iphethe futhi yathumela umbiko wayo ngo-2005 kwiKomidi ngaphambi kwe-AU Assembly ebibanjelwe eSirte, eLibya ngoJulayi 2005. Kwakukhona nezinguquko ezenziwe kumadokhumenti mayelana nezikweletu ezikhokhwayo amazwe ase-Afrika kumazwe athuthukile nezikhungo ezahlukene, kanye nezohwebo lwamazwe ngamazwe, uxhaso lokuthuthukisa, ulwazi, nezobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana (ICT) kanye ne-HIV/AIDS. I-NEPAD iphinde yahlela izingxoxo nezinkulumo ezinkulu nemiphakathi kanye nesigaba esingahlangani. Umkhiqizo kufanele uncike emakethe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele uthole ukuthi abathengi bafuna ini (izidingo), bese ukhiqiza (uhlinzeka) lowo mkhiqizo ukuze uthengise ukuze uthole inzuzo. Uma intengo ikhula, abathengi bazothenga kancane, kodwa uma intengo yehlile, bazothenga kakhulu noma izinhlobo ezahlukene zemikhiqizo. Thola izidingo nezintandokazi zabathengi ngokwenza ucwaningo lwemakethe. Ikhwalithi ibaluleke kakhulu. Kufanele ibe mnandi futhi ibukeke kahle! Intengo ibalulekile kakhulu. Kufanele ube nenqwaba yokuthengisa. Ukuhlinzeka kubalulekile kakhulu. Kufanele ngithole njalo futhi ngesikhathi. Thola ukuthi yiziphi zalezi zimpahla ezifanele ukukhiqiza. Hlela ukukhiqizwa komkhiqizo. Phanda isivuno bese uyivuna uma isilungele ukuvuna. Khetha umgudu wokumaketha osebenza kahle kakhulu futhi lapho ungathola khona inzuzo eningi. Uchungechunge lokuthengisa lunezinto ezihambayo ezithatha umkhiqizo usuka kumlimi uye kumthengi. Ungazuza ngokwengeza inani kumikhiqizo ukuze wandise intshisekelo yakho ngokubandakanya ukuwashwa, ukupakisha, ukugcina, ukucubungula, nokuhweba. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi imbewu, umanyolo, ama-pesticides, amathuluzi, imishini, uphethiloli, umsebenzi, njll. Izindleko zokuhweba zifaka phakathi ukuthuthwa, ukukhangisa, nokugcina. Izindleko zokupakisha zifaka phakathi ukwehlukanisa, izinto zokupakisha, umsebenzi, ukugcina, umshwalense, njll. Izindleko zokukhiqiza zifaka phakathi izinto, ukuthuthwa, ukupakisha, ukuhlanganisa, umsebenzi, ugesi, njll. Ukuze unciphise izindleko emugqeni wokuthengisa, ungasebenzisa umgudu omfushane ngokuthengisa ngqo kumthengi. Ukwengeza inani ngokupakisha nokugcina izintengo ukuze zenze zibe nentshisekelo kukhiqiza imali eningi. Ukwengeza inani ngokucubungula kukhuphula inani lomkhiqizo ngamunye futhi kukhuphula imali engenayo... Abalimi bathengisa imikhiqizo ngqo kubathengi. Abalimi bathengisa kubathengi noma abantu abathenga ukuze bathengise. Ukuthengiswa kwenziwa ngababambiqhaza bemakethe abathengisa kumlimi futhi bathola ikhomishini. Ikhwalithi, ukupakisha, nokubukeka kubalulekile kakhulu, futhi umkhiqizo kufanele uhambisane nezindinganiso zokwakhiwa kwekhwalithi ezamukelekayo nezindinganiso zokupakisha. Izikhungo ezivalwe zokukhiqiza izilwane zinikeza umsebenzi wokuthengisa kubalimi. Umlandeli uthengisa ngqo kumhwebi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sokwakha. Ikhwalithi, intengo, nokulethwa kubalulekile kakhulu. Inhlangano yababalimi ithengisa isivuno ngokuhlanganyela emakethe esemthethweni. Urelationship phakathi kwezindleko nentengo = inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa.
Umlando: Le ngqungquthela inikeza ithuba eliyingqayizivele kithi sonke lokho okwenza sikhulume futhi siqinise ubukhona bethu njengabantu abanolwazi, futhi sonke singabamba iqhaza ezinyathelweni ezibonakalayo, ezitholakalayo futhi sithuthukise amasu nezinhlelo ezizosisiza ukuthi siphile impilo ehambisana neNingizimu Afrika entsha enedemokhrasi (Esekela uMongameli uJacob Zuma). I-MRM iyinhlangano esekelwe emiphakathini engafanele isetshenziswe ngababusi abaphezulu kodwa ngumphakathi uqobo. Inhloso yayo ukuhlanganisa zonke izindaba eziphathelene nomphakathi ezithinta ubuqotho. Ukuziphatha okuhle kuboniswa kuzo zonke izinkolo, futhi abantu bafuna ukuguqula zonke izindlela ezingamukeleki emiphakathini nezinyathelo eziphazamisa izwe lethu. I-MRM izogcizelela umgomo wokuthi umuntu ngamunye kufanele anakekele impilo yabanye, kuqala ngokuqonda ukuthi sikhululeka ezicindezelweni ze-apartheid futhi kufanele sikhululeke emiphumeleni ye-apartheid - uMongameli uThabo Mbeki. I-MRM iyisakhiwo sokukhuthaza, ukusekela, ukwazisa, nokuxhumanisa zonke imibono evela emiphakathini ehlukene. Igxile emphakathini onokwethenjelwa onemigomo emihle. Inhloso yale nhlangano ukuvuselela umoya we-Ubuntu/Botho, sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo ezivela kuhulumeni nasemphakathini. I-MRM izibophezele ekwakheni amazinga amahle okuziphatha ngokusekelwe kumthethosisekelo wezwe, "okuyisisekelo esichaza izimiso esizibophezele futhi sifisa zonke izizwe zomhlaba zibe nathi." Ukuhlinzeka ngama-ithuba okucabangela okwedlule, okwamanje mayelana nezimiso eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuveza amasu nemizamo yokwakha izimiso zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika entsha enedemokhrasi. Ukusiza ekwakheni inhlangano enkulu yokweseka uhulumeni nomphakathi emizamweni yokuhlela izinhlelo ezingavuselela imiphakathi ngokwezimiso. Ukwakha izinhlelo ezizinzile zokuvuselela izimiso. Ukwandisa imizamo kazwelonke yokwakha ukuqwashisa ngokuqinisa umphakathi onemigomo emihle, onakekelayo futhi okhululekile ekukhwabaneni. Ukuqinisa izisekelo zenkululeko yethu esiyitholile kanzima kanye nedemokhrasi ngokwakha umphakathi onemigomo emihle ogxile ekuziphatheni okuhle nasekukhulumeni. Ukuveza uhlelo lwezwe oluzolandela, oluzosuka ezinhlelweni zenkululeko nezasezifundazweni ngokubheka izilinganiso ezijwayelekile. Ukusebenzisa isu elivumela amaphephandaba nabakhangisi ukuba babambe iqhaza ekusakazeni imibiko mayelana neMoral Regeneration Movement (MRM) kulo lonke izwe. Ukwakha uhlelo lokubambisana oluhlanganisa umphakathi wonke, abantu bezamabhizinisi, nohulumeni. Ukwakha amasu ajulile asebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene anganikeza izixazululo zokukhwabanisa emiphakathini. Ukwethulwa kwe-MRM kube umcimbi oyingqayizivele ngoba kuhlanganise abantu abangu-1,300 abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zezwe, befinyelela ngezindiza, amabhasi, nezimoto, befuna izindlela zokwakha umphakathi onobuntu. Kwakukhona othisha, abaphathiswa, amalungu ePhalamende, abaholi bamaphele, intsha, abaholi bezinkolo, izinhlangano ezizimele, abantu bezamabhizinisi, nezinhlelo zomsebenzi. Bakhombisa ukuzinikela kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo lokwakha isisekelo sokuvuselela izimiso kulesi sizwe. Ukwethulwa kuhlinzeke ithuba kubantu baleli zwe ukuba bahlale behlangene ekuphatheni nasekukhulumeni ngolimi olulodwa ezindabeni eziphathelene nokuvuselelwa kwezimo. Umphakathi we-MRM, uMnu. Smangaliswa Mkhatshwa, wamukela bonke abahlanganyeli, kulandela inkulumo ethulwe ukweseka uMongameli uMnu. Jacob Zuma, owavula ukwethulwa waphinde waxolisa kuMnu. Thabo Mbeki, owayengumongameli owayesohambweni. UMnu. Cedric Mayson wanikeza isithombe esibanzi sezindaba ezibhekene nezwe ngaphansi kwesihloko: Yini inkinga? Ukubulawa!, ukuhweba!, ukuhlukunyezwa!, izidakamizwa, ukukhwabanisa, ubuhlanga, ubugebengu, ukwephula amalungelo abesifazane nezingane, umehluko phakathi kwabacebile nabampofu, ukungaboni ngasese, ubuhlobo, ukukhwabanisa kuhulumeni nomphakathi. Kungani konke lokhu kwenzeka kithi? Kufanele siqale ngokuhlola imbangela yephutha. Siphathwe kabi ngenxa yokwehluleka kwedlule, umthelela wokuphathwa kwamanye amazwe, kanye ne-apartheid, ebulala umcabango wethu nendlela esibona ngayo izinto, isishiya nezinkinga ezinkulu. Futhi kukhona ukwehluleka okuningi okwamanje. Inkululeko yenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinselelo zokushintsha kusuka ekucindezelweni kwamandla angaphandle kuya esikweni ledemokhrasi elihambisana nezibopho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nendlela entsha yokubhekana nokuphila kusukela ngo-1994. Abaningi bayagxeka imidiya, ngokuvamile begcizelela lokho esingakufuni ukuthuthukisa: ukuhluleka kwamaphoyisa ukubamba abaphula umthetho, izinkantolo, nababhekele izimiso, noma bagxeka uhulumeni. Kodwa kufanele sizibuze. Ukuba nefa namandla kuyaphambanisa umbono wezwe elisha ngokuqondiswe ekuphathweni kokufuna amandla amaningi nokuhlukumeza kuleli zwe. Singabuyisela kanjani umqondo wethu kubuntu - uma imali iba unkulunkulu abaninzi abamkhonzile, uma izinqubo zethu zenza abaningi bahlupheke, futhi uma umoya wobuntu nezimiso ezinhle uqhubeka nokuncipha? Ithemba lethu lokuphendula kulezi zindaba ligxile kahle. Ezinye izizwe zinezinselelo ezifanayo, kodwa izindlela esizibophezele ekuphenduleni kulezi zindaba zihluke. Amandla ethu ukuthi izinkolo zethu zibophezele ekuphileni okuhle kithi sonke. Izimpande zethu zisesigodini sethu lapho abantu bahlala, basebenza, futhi badlala ndawonye. Singakha isizwe esisha ngokubambisana kwabantu bonke baleli zwe. Inhloso yethu ukuvuselela izinhlangano zethu nezakhiwo zethu, hhayi ukuqala kabusha. Ukuvuselelwa kwezimo kuyindawo esikuyo. Lapho sikhona nasezinhlakeni, futhi thina sonke, singaphendula kulezi zindaba ngokubhekana nezinselelo zokuvuselelwa kwezimo. Iseshini yasekuseni yayiholwa nguMnu. Tim Modise, owabandakanya izithameli, okwenziwa ngokucula, ukudansa, namazwi agxile empumelelweni nakho okunye esingakwenza. Lokhu kuqinisa izimiso esinazo ngaphakathi, isithunzi, kanye nobuhle bomoya wobuntu. Labo ababephuza izidakamizwa, baphila ne-HIV, amaqembu omculo ejele, amaqembu edansa entsha - bonke bakhombisa ngesenzo nasezobuciko umoya wethemba lapho ukudangala kukhula, ukuzimisela lapho kunenkinga, ukuzibophezela uma bebhekene nokwehla kwezimo. Bonke ababukeli bazibeka engozini ngokungena ezihlahleni zik governo. Wonke umuntu ongene esihlahleni zik governo kumele aziphathe ngendlela ephephile nephakeme, ecabangela abanye abantu abasebenzisa le ndawo. Imali ethile ingakhokhiswa uma ufuna ukwenza imisebenzi ethile noma uma ufuna nje ukungena; kulokhu, uzonikezwa imvume ehlukile. Ukungena kuvunyelwe phakathi kuka-06:00 no-18:00 ezinsukwini ezichaziwe, ngaphandle uma uvunyelwe ukuba uhambe, uhambe ebusuku, noma ezinye imisebenzi. Imicimbi ehlobene nokuzijabulisa, imfundo, isiko, noma ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokomoya ingabanjwa ezindaweni ezibekiwe ngenhloso leyo. Amabhodi wezaziso nezimpawu kumele ahlonishwe ezihlahleni zik governo. Umphakathi awuvunyelwe ukungena ezihlahleni zik governo noma kunoma yisiphi isigaba saso, futhi ukuvutha imililo ezindaweni ezibekiwe akuvunyelwe ngezikhathi ezithile. Umsindo noma noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungaphazamisa abanye abasebenzisi bezihlahleni zik governo noma izilwane zasendle akuvunyelwe. Ukuvutha imililo akuvunyelwe, ngaphandle ezindaweni ezibekiwe ngenhloso leyo. Imililo kumele ingashiywa inganakekelwa, futhi kumele icinywe ngemva kokusetshenziswa. Akuvunyelwe ukuhlekisa, noma ukususa udoti ezihlahleni zik governo, ngaphandle uma kudedelwa ezitolo ezibekiwe. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa umngcele, udonga, amabhodi ezaziso, noma noma yini enye ezihlahleni zik governo ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukuphazamiseka kwemisebenzi yokuphatha ezihlahleni zik governo, futhi akekho ovunyelwe ukungena kunoma iyiphi indawo lapho abasebenzi benza khona umsebenzi noma lapho impahla yesihlahla isetshenziswa ngaphandle kwemvume. Akekho ovunyelwe ukulimaza, ukususa, noma ukwenza uphawu oluthile ezitini, ezihlahleni, noma kunoma yiziphi izitshalo ezihlahleni zik governo. Noma ubani otholakala ethanga noma efinyelela, ebulala, noma eqoqela izilwane, izinyoni, izimpukane, izinhlanzi, noma ezinye izilwane zasendle ngaphandle kwemvume noma enye imvume uphula umthetho. Ukudla izilwane ezihlahleni zik governo akuvunyelwe. Izibhamu, ama-bows, ama-crossbows, nezinye izikhali zokuthunga akuvunyelwe ezihlahleni zik governo ngaphandle kwemvume yokuthunga. Izinja, izilwane zasekhaya, nezinye izilwane azivunyelwe ezihlahleni zik governo, ngaphandle kwamahhashi uma kuvunyelwe ukuhamba ezindleleni zamahhashi. Ukugeza nokuthanga kuvunyelwe kuphela ezindaweni ezibekiwe ngenhloso leyo. Ukukh campa, uma kuvunyelwe, kumele kwenziwe kuphela ezindaweni ezibekiwe ngenhloso leyo uma imali efanele ikhishwe. Ukusebenzisa noma ukusebenza ngama-drones, izindiza ezinamandla, ukuhamba nge-paragliding, ama-ultralights, amabhola, kanye ne-parachutes akuvunyelwe ezihlahleni zik governo. Ukusebenzisa noma ukuphatha ama-explosives akuvunyelwe ezihlahleni zik governo. Akukho mthelela noma izindleko ezizothwalwa nguhulumeni ngenxa yokulimala kwempahla yababukeli ezihlahleni zik governo ngenxa yezenzo ezithathwe nguhulumeni noma ezenziwa egameni likahulumeni noma ngenxa yanoma yisiphi isizathu, ngaphandle uma lokho kulimala kwenzeka ngenxa yokunganaki kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni ngesikhathi benza imisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke. Ababukeli bezihlahleni zik governo bazoba nesibopho sokulimala okwenziwe ezinsizeni zesihlahla nezinye impahla zik governo okungase kube nemiphumela ngenxa yezenzo zabo. Izimo, izimali, noma izimvume ezithile zingadingeka emicimbini ethile, ezindaweni ezithile, nasemazweni athile (buka izixhumanisi nezindawo zemicimbi).
Inhloso wukwakha uhlaka lwesizwe lokulawula imigudu ye-petroleum, ukuze kwakhiwe iBhodi yokulawula imigudu ye-petroleum ezobheka futhi iqaphe ukwenziwa kohla lwesizwe nezindaba ezihlobene. Isikhungo sokugcina sikhuluma ngaso kanye nanoma iyiphi indawo ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kokugcina i-petroleum. Le mthetho ifaka phakathi iziqondiso ezikhishwe kanye nezaziso ezikhishwe ngaphansi kwayo; futhi "ingabopha" kusho izinga elinqunywe yiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, hhayi njengoba kudingwa yizibopho zenkontileka. Iphromotha ukufinyelela kumikhiqizo ye-petroleum engabizi. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum lisungulwa njengomuntu ophakathi kwezomthetho. Lingakwenza noma yini ehambisana nokwenza imisebenzi yalo; futhi lisebenzise amandla noma lenze noma yimuphi umsebenzi oqondiswe ukuba wenziwe yiBhodi ngaphansi komthetho omunye. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum lizokwakhiwa ngamalungu amahlanu akhethwe nguNgqongqoshe. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhethe ilungu elilodwa kulamalungu akhethwe ngaphansi komsubsection 1 ukuze kube ngumholi weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Uma ngenxa yanoma iyiphi imbangela umholi engakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yakhe, amalungu amanye azokhetha omunye umuntu phakathi kwabo ukuba abambe indawo yomholi kuze kube umholi ekwazi ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi yakhe, noma kuze kube omunye umuntu ekhethwe nguNgqongqoshe. Ilungu leBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum lizokwenza isikhathi seminyaka emine. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda akhethe umuntu owake wakhethwa. Uma ilungu leBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum likhuphuka endaweni yalo, UNgqongqoshe angakhetha omunye umuntu ukuze agcwalise le ndawo kuze kube sekupheleni kwesikhathi akhethwe ngaso. Amalungu eBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele akhokhelwe ngezinsizakalo zawo, futhi amaholo nezinsizakalo zabo azovunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali. Akekho umuntu ongakhethwa njengelungu leBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uma lowo muntu engakaze abe ngumuntu ophila eNingizimu Afrika futhi engahlali eRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uvalelwe ngenxa yesikweletu futhi engakabuyiselwa, noma ubephunyukile ekubeni nelungelo lokubamba isikhundla ngenxa yokungathembeki, noma uma kungaba nokungqubuzana phakathi kwezithakazelo zalo muntu njengelungu lebhodi nezithakazelo zabo siqu, kuthinta umsebenzi wabo noma amabhizinisi abo. Kumele babe nolwazi olwaneleyo lwezomthetho, ulwazi lwezindlela zokusebenza, ulwazi lwezebhizinisi, ulwazi lwezezimali, noma olunye ulwazi oluhambisana nokulawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Kumele temsilise izithakazelo zomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wonke futhi kumele bangabi nenkohlakalo noma ukungathembeki. Ngaphambi kokukhetha amalungu eBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, UNgqongqoshe uzokhipha izaziso kuGazethi yoHulumeni, emema umphakathi ukuba wenze iziphakamiso zabantu. Wonke amalungu kumele, uma sebekhethwe kwiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, baziqinisekise kuNgqongqoshe nganoma yiziphi izindaba ezingabathinta ngqo, umsebenzi wabo, izithakazelo zabo zebhizinisi, futhi kumele baziqinisekise kuNgqongqoshe nganoma yiziphi izinguquko. UNgqongqoshe angakhipha ukhetho lwamalungu eBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uma ilungu lelo liphatha ngendlela ephikisana nezimiso zesigaba sika-9. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ihlangane ngezikhathi nezindawo ezinqunywe ngumholi. Umholi kumele abize imihlangano yeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum njengoba kudingeka ukuze ikwazi ukusebenza kahle. Umholi kumele, uma ecela nguMphathi Omkhulu noma ngamalungu amabili, abize umhlangano ophuthumayo ozobanjwa phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili ngemuva kosuku lokucela. Umholi wanoma yimuphi umhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele anqume izinqubo ezizolandela kulowo mhlangano, ngaphandle uma kukhona enye indlela ebekiwe yokulandela. I-quorum yomhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ingama-majority amalungu. Isinqumo esithathwe yizigidi zamalungu akhona emhlanganweni sizoba yisinqumo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana kwezivoti nganoma iyiphi indaba ethathwayo, umuntu ophatha umhlangano uzoba ne-vote ebonakalayo ngaphezu kokuvota kwakhe njengelungu. Akukho isinqumo seBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum esizokwenziwa kube sephuliwe ngenxa yokukhala kweBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum noma ngenxa yokuthi umuntu okumele angakhethwa njengelungu ubekhona ngesikhathi isinqumo sithathwa, uma wonke amalungu amanye abekhona emhlanganweni futhi enelungelo lokubamba iqhaza njengamalungu e-quorum futhi isinqumo sithathwa yizigidi zamalungu akhona emhlanganweni futhi anelungelo lokuvota. UMphathi Omkhulu noma, uma engakabikho, ilungu leBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum elinikezwe nguMphathi Omkhulu, uzophatha yonke imihlangano yeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum, enelungelo lokukhuluma emhlanganweni kodwa engelungelo lokuvota kulowo mhlangano. Noma yimuphi umhlangano weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum uvulekile kumphakathi ngaphandle uma kukhona ulwazi oluyimfihlo noluyimfihlo oluhambisana nokuphathwa noma ukuhweba okumele kuxoxwe, futhi kulokhu, umuntu ophazamisekile kumele anikeze izizathu ezisemthethweni kuBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum zokuthi kungani lelo ulwazi lungakhishwa emphakathini. Uma iBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ithatha isinqumo nganoma iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokuba emhlanganweni ohlelwe, leso sinqumo sizoqala ukusebenza ngokushesha futhi kumele sibhale phansi, sigcwaliswe yizigidi zamalungu, futhi sikhonjiswe emhlanganweni wokuqala ohlelwe weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum ngemuva kokwenziwa ukuze sifakwe kumarekhodi. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele iqinisekise ukuthi wonke amarekhodi ayo okusebenza agcinwa. Amalungu kumele axolise futhi kumele bangabambi iqhaza ekuvoteni noma ekuxoxeni nganoma iyiphi indaba abayazi ukuthi izothinta ngqo noma ngqo; futhi kumele benze ngendlela elindelekile kumuntu osebenza emphakathini. Wonke amaqembu ezinqumo zeBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum nezizathu zawo kumele zifinyeleleke emphakathini. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophazamisekile nganoma iyiphi indlela ngesinqumo esithathwe yiBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ilethe le ndaba phambi kweNkantolo Ephakeme ukuze ibuyekezwe leso sinqumo. Ibhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum kumele ikhethe uMphathi Omkhulu weBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum. UMphathi Omkhulu uzobheka ukusebenza kwansuku zonke kweBhodi elilawula imigudu ye-petroleum; futhi uzophatha izindaba ezihlobene nabasebenzi abakhethwe ngaphansi komsubsection 3. UMphathi Omkhulu angakhetha abasebenzi noma angene esivumelwaneni esinokuhamba kwesikhathi nomuntu onjengokwenza ukuze
Noma ngabe umphakathi uyabandakanyeka emcimbini ophathelene nomsebenzi wabo ongenakuhlonishwa, lowo mcimbi ungaholela ekulimazweni noma ekufeni. Noma ngabe umphakathi ubika ukulimala kwabo kumqashi wabo, uma ngesikhathi sokubika bephawula ukuthi umcimbi ubangelwe umsebenzi ongenakuhlonishwa. Uma umcimbi uholela ekufeni, ekulahlekelweni kokwazi, noma ekusikeni ingxenye ethile yomzimba futhi lapho umuntu okhuniwe ethathwa njengokungakwazi ukusebenza okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14, umphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza kufanele futhi aziswe ngokuphuthumayo ngefeksi noma ngefoni. Qedela "Ingxenye A" yekhasi lokuqala lefomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele, udayise, futhi ufake usuku lapho kuboniswe khona. Susa "Ingxenye B" efana kakhulu ne "Ingxenye A" ekhasini 1 ngokuyikhipha lapho inebhokisi, nikeza umphakathi "Ingxenye B" bese ubacela ukuthi bayinikeze kudokotela noma esibhedlela lapho belashwa khona. Ezimeni ezinzima, "Ingxenye B" kufanele ithunyelwe kudokotela noma esibhedlela ngokushesha. Qedela "Ingxenye A" ekhasini lesibili lefomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele lapho. Thumela umbiko ophelele wemcimbi kanye neMbiko Yezokwelapha Yokuqala W.CI. Qedela ifomu elisha mayelana nomphakathi okhuniwe. Le fomu akufanele ibambezeleke ngoba kulindeleke ukuthi umphakathi uqale ukusebenza noma imibiko evela kudokotela ilindelwe. Umqashi ongeke abike umcimbi kwiKomidi Lokukhokha usebenzisa le fomu phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-7 uzoba nesibopho ngaphansi kweMthetho Wokukhokha Izingozi Zomsebenzi Nezifo zika-1933, futhi angase abhekane nezindleko eziphelele zokukhokha ezihlobene nalowo mcimbi. Umqashi ongeke abike kumphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza ngefoni noma ngefeksi umcimbi obangele ukufa, ukulahlekelwa kokwazi, noma ukusika ingxenye ethile yomzimba noma isimo lapho umphakathi engakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo ezinsukwini eziyi-14 uzotholwa enesibopho ngaphansi kweMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha ka-1993. Kufanele usebenzise ifomu efanele ukubika izifo ezitholakele ngenxa yomsebenzi owenziwayo W.CL.1. Uma umphakathi okhuniwe eba nezehlakalo zokungasebenzi, gcina irekhodi le-adresi lapho bengatholakala khona ukuze kusizwe ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izimali ezivela kwiFundi Lokukhokha okufanele zikhokhelwe ziya kubo. Qedela ifomu elibhalwe ngezinhlamvu ezinkulu bese uphakamisa (X) ezindaweni ezifanele. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lo mbiko wokulimala okukhuluma ngawo ukuthi kwenzeka emsebenzini, ngokwazi kwami, uqotho. C IMBIKO YEZOKWELAPHA YOKUQALA W.CL.4 kufanele igcwaliswe kabili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane yomqashi nom
Izenzakalo zokuphepha nemisebenzi ye-ofisi... Ukuhlela kwezimali ngaphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamasiko. I-ofisi ephethe ukudalwa kwezimpawu. Ukuqonda okuphelele kokuhlanganiswa kwesiko, isayensi, nobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukiseni, inhlalakahle yokuxhasa ubunikazi nasekukhuthazeni amanani ahlukahlukene ezwe lethu. Emculweni, ifa lesiko, kanye namavalue, ngokuhlonipha ukuhlukahlukana, nangezinhlelo zokuxhasa umnotho. Ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ezweni lethu njengendlela yokuphakamisa wonke umZulu ukuba athathe ingxenye empilweni yokuxhumana, yezepolitiki, kanye nomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa okulinganiselwe ukuze kugcinwe, kugcinwe, kuvikelwe, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando wethu, izimpawu zethu zomhlaba, ifa, namavalue kuyavunywa. Ukubheka emuva konyaka odlule, kube nempumelelo ebonakalayo ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe ngomhla we-DACST. Kusukela ekubonakaliseni/ukufinyeleleka kwezinsiza zamasiko okuholela ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi, kuya ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zocwaningo ezisezingeni lomhlaba. Indlela imiphakathi noma umkhakha wezobuciko ongakhelwa ngayo nokuthi singanikeza kanjani emaphakathini aholelwa uhulumeni ngezinhlelo zokubambisana nezihlanganisiwe, esibiza ngokuthi izinhlelo ze-cluster. Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kunezinkomba ezibalulekile okufanele sizibandakanye nazo ezingeni eliphakathi njengelizwe. Ibhajethi enkulu yonyaka yokwakha ubuchwepheshe edinga ukuxhaswa ibhalwe phansi ngama-R1.5 billion. Emkhakheni wezobuciko namasiko, kunezidingo eziphuthumayo zokuthi uhulumeni asihole. Isidingo sesithombe esisha sezobuciko, esisekelwe ekuxhumaneni kwezinsiza ezingashintshi. Ukuguqula imicabango ibe izenzo ngokwenza izimboni zamasiko zidalwe amathuba emisebenzi. Mayelana nezilimi, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenkomba efanele ngokomthetho yokukala izilimi nokuhlukahluka kwazo, ngesikhathi lapho umhlaba ungumuntu owodwa futhi isimo sezimali siba sikhulu. Unyaka odlule wabona izinguquko ezibalulekile ekubukeni kwe-DACST. Iphakathi elisebenzisa okungenani ama-90% wezimali zayo (ama-R1 billion) ezinhlelweni zangaphandle uma kuqhathaniswa nezinhlelo zangaphakathi, nezinsiza zangaphandle ezixhaswe yi-DACST zithola uxhaso kule 90%, okuhlanganisa nezinhlangano ezisebenza ocwaningweni lwesayensi, amabhodi ahlobene nezilimi zesiZulu, iminyango, nemikhakha ehambelana nokuboniswa kobuciko. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezihlangene emikhakheni enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze kuqale ukuthuthukisa inqubo yokuphatha nokuphatha efanayo. E-Cabinet Lekgotla kaJanuwari 2001, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi esikhathini esizayo, izinsiza zamasiko ezifana nezandla, umculo, nezinkonzo, kanye nezithombe, zizofakwa ezinhlelweni zomnotho ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuthuthukiswa/ukukhula nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi. Sekucacile ukuthi izinsiza zamasiko zingadlala indima enkulu emnothweni ophumayo, okufana nezinsiza zemvelo ezifana nokumbiwa nokulima. Amazwe ahlukene afana neSweden neMexico anikeza ukuqinisekiswa okungaphikiswa ngalokhu. Ukuthuthukisa imikhakha yocwaningo nokuthuthukiswa. Le ndawo idinga ukunakekelwa ngokuphathwa kwayo nokubhekwa, ngokwezidingo zendawo nezitayela zomhlaba ekubhekeni nasekuthuthukiseni, ngokwezidingo zendawo nezitayela zomhlaba. Ukuze kusizakale le nhlelo, kufanele kwenziwe ukuhlola okufanele nokuhlola (isibonelo, ukubheka phambili) ngokubambisana neNational Advisory Council for Development. Ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi ibhajethi eyinhloko yonyaka ye-R2.5 billion kufanele ibe okungenani kabili eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo. (Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi ayihambisani naleyo yeziqukathi ezizimele). Okwamanje, sigcina uxhaso lwe-GDP kazwelonke ku-0.7%, okuyingxenye yesithathu se-OECD average futhi encane uma kuqhathaniswa nenani eliphelele lamazwe athuthukile afana neSouth Korea neFinland. Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obuphambili kunezimpempe ezinkulu zokunciphisa izindleko emnothweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala izindlela ezizinzile zokudlulisa ulwazi nobuchwepheshe ezinkampanini (ikakhulukazi kuma-SMMEs). Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamasiko. Izinhlelo zezimali zomnyango zonyaka ka-2000/2001 zifaka izenzakalo ezahlukene ezindaweni zomphakathi. Singachaza ukuqwashisa komphakathi ngocwaningo, ukusungulwa kohlelo lokubhekana ne-HIV/AIDS ekuthuthukiseni inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe, nokusungulwa kohlelo lweMlando Wokhuluma. Ukugcina nokuthuthukisa ifa. Ifa liyingxenye ebalulekile yobunikazi. Iningi leNingizimu Afrika linemigomo yefa eyathuthukiswa ngokwanele nakuba ingaxhaswanga kahle (njengeminyango, imikhakha yokulawula). Ukuguqulwa kwalezi zinsiza kubalulekile emnothweni nasemasikweni. Ukuhlanganiswa nokwakha izimnyango ezinhlanu zomlando ezimnyangweni ezithile nezithombe ezintathu eKapa: umlando wemvelo, umlando wesiko, kanye nomlando wezempi, kubonise inzuzo enkulu. Kuphakanyiswe futhi kwethulwa kwiCabinet. Le ndlela iphakanyiswa njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi eziyi-11 zesiZulu njengoba kuqinisekiswe ngumthethosisekelo. Le ndlela ihlinzeka ngendlela yokuhamba phakathi kwezilimi. Kule nhlelo, isigaba ngesigaba, kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ukwandisa ukwaneliseka kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi. Ulwazi lwasekhaya/olwakazwelonke ngakolunye uhlangothi lungaba umthombo wokukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona ingozi yokuthi kuzochithwa ngamandla angaphandle angabheki ulwazi lomphakathi njengolwakhe. I-ethnomedicine ne-ethnopharmacology iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo, izilwane, nokuhlukahluka kwamasiko kanye nokuhlonipha izinkampani, imvelo yokudla kwezitshalo, indlela amasiko aphathwa ngayo, nokwakhiwa/ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezithile. Kukhona ifa lokukhuthaza ucwaningo lwezokwazi imvelo nezimiso ezisunguliwe ngaphansi kwe-Human Research Council ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuvikelwe ulwazi lwasekhaya/olwakazwelonke. Ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba bokuthula nokuvikela iziqoqo. Lezi zicabango zashintsha zaba izenzo ngonyaka odlule? Umnyango usungule indlela eqinile yokuphatha eholelwa ngumenzi, ixhaswe ngumsizi wemenzi kanye noMphakathi-Jikelele. Indlela yokuhlangana kwabaphathi nendlela yokwethula iziphakamiso nokuphatha izinsiza zabantu ithole ukunakwa okukhulu ngenxa yomsebenzi weqembu elisha lokuphatha izinsiza zabantu. Njengoba umbiko wezinsiza zabantu uthi, zonke izinhloso zokwakhiwa kwabaphathi zifeziwe. Sikholelwa ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yezinhlaka zonke ezixhaswe yi-DACST (isayensi, ubuciko, ifa, izilimi) ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokuphatha ezisekelwe kumbono owabelwana ngawo nentshisekelo yokuhloniphana nokwethembeka. Ulwazi nomnyango. Lezi zinsimu kufanele zithuthukise izinqubomgomo ezizokwamukela futhi zithuthuk
Ukuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena futhi abanye abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Umphakathi ungumuntu oqokwe uM master weNkantolo noma iNkantolo ukuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Izingane zicatshangwa njengezizathu ezinamakhono ngenxa yokuthi umthetho uthathe ukuthi azikwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Uma lezi zinto zine impahla, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nomuntu oqokwe ukuphatha ifa. Ngokuvamile, umntwana unababheki abaphatha impahla yabo nezindaba eziphathelene nabo, ngakho-ke akudingeki ukuba baqokwe njengoba bengababheki babo. Nokho, kungase kwenzeke ukuthi izingane zingabi nababheki noma abazali, futhi kudingeka ukuqokwa komphakathi wengane ukuphatha ifa noma impahla. Nokho, uma umntwana enomgibeli wemvelo, iNkantolo inganquma ngenye indlela. Uma impahla yomntwana ifaka imali ebekwe ku-akhawunti yomgibeli, akudingeki ukuqokwa komphakathi wezimpahla, nakuba umphakathi angase aqokwe. Ukuqokwa komphakathi ezindabeni zezingane kudlala izindima ezimbili ngaphansi kwalesi simo. Ukunakekela isimo nempilo yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Isimo eNingizimu Afrika siqonda ukuthi umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena ungumuntu ongenaminyaka engama-21 ubudala ongakhululiwe yisimo sokushada noma umyalo wenkantolo. Ukukhala kufakwa eNkantolo. Ifomu J243 lichaza impahla yomntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Ukuqokwa komuntu ofanele njengomphakathi, oqokwe ngumndeni womntwana (ngokuvamile abantu abaqokwe baveza emhlanganweni obizwa nguM master weNkantolo ngenhloso yokuxoxa ngale ndaba). Isicelo sokuba umphakathi sihlinzekwa ngefomu J197. Umzali ophilayo ongakakhululiwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela umntwana. Umama womntwana owazalwa ekhaya ongakakhululiwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela lowo mntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Umzali onikezwe yinkantolo unelungelo lokunakekela umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena. Itestamente uma iqoka umphakathi kufanele ibhaliswe kahle futhi yamukelwe nguM master weNkantolo. Inani lesikhashana lempahla yomntwana kufanele liboniswe kufomu J243. Umbiko ochaza ukuthi umphakathi oqokiwe wakhethwa ngumuntu onegunya emqulwini oqukethwe ku-testamente futhi lowo muntu obhale i-testamente unelungelo lokwenza kanjalo. Umsebenzi nesiqinisekiso somphakathi oqokiwe esiqukethwe kufomu J262 ngaphandle kokuthi umphakathi ukhululiwe yi-testamente ekwethuleni leso siqinisekiso. I-Nkantolo, njengomgibeli wezingane onamandla amaningi, ingaqoka umuntu njengomphakathi ukunakekela isimo nempilo yomntwana futhi aphathe impahla yabo nefa. Kuvame ukuba ngumuntu onokukhathazeka ofaka isicelo kwiNkantolo. Ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo, iNkantolo iqoka umgibeli wefa ukuvikela amalungelo omntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena ukuze ihlole isimo futhi inqume ukuthi isicelo sifaneleka kangakanani. Umgibeli wefa noM master weNkantolo kufanele babonise imibiko kwiNkantolo. Uma iNkantolo isiqedile ukucubungula isicelo, iqoka umphakathi, futhi uM master weNkantolo kufanele aqale isinqumo senkantolo ngokukhishwa kweMibhalo Yomphakathi nokuwagunyaza ukuba aqale njengomphakathi. Umbhalo ofanayo wesicelo senkantolo uhambisana nemibiko ekhishwe ngumgibeli wefa noM master weNkantolo. Isinqumo senkantolo sokuba umphakathi. Ifomu J242 liqukethe inani lempahla nefa lomntwana. Umsebenzi nesiqinisekiso somphakathi oqokiwe esiqukethwe kufomu J262 ngaphandle kokukhululwa yinkantolo ekwethuleni leso siqinisekiso. Ukuphatha ifa labantu abashonile abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Abantu abachazwa yinkantolo njengokuphatha kabi impahla. Ukuphatha ifa labantu kanye nemali ethathwe ngokomthetho yiMnyango Wokuphathwa Kwezimali ngomyalo wenkantolo. Ukuphatha ifa lomuntu okhoyo (umuntu ongaziwa ukuthi uphi futhi ongenalo ummeli eNingizimu Afrika). Akusiyo indawo kaM master weNkantolo ukuqoka umuntu ukuba anakekele umntwana noma umuntu ophatha isimo nempilo yomntwana. INkantolo Ephakeme ingaqoka omunye umuntu ngaphandle komndeni womntwana njengomuntu ozosiza umntwana. Ngokufanayo, iNkantolo Ephakeme ingawathathela lowo muntu osiza umntwana ilungelo lokuba ngumsekeli walowo mntwana. Mayelana nokugcina umntwana ophazamisekile, iMthetho Wezingane No. 74 ka-1983 uveza ukuthi uMphakathi Wokunakekela Izingane endaweni lapho umntwana ehlala khona ungakwazi ukuqoka umuntu ukunakekela umntwana ongakwazi ukuphatha yena, uma kutholakala ngemuva kokuhlola ukuthi umntwana udinga ukunakekelwa. Isigaba 14 seMthetho Wezingane sichaza izimo lapho umntwana ethathwa njengodinga ukunakekelwa, okubandakanya isimo somntwana ongenabazali noma ababezi, noma isimo lapho abazali babo bengatholakali. Umuntu oqokwe nguMphakathi Wokunakekela ungumuntu onakekela umntwana nsuku zonke. Nokho, umgibeli womntwana akanalo ilungelo lokuphatha impahla yomntwana ongakabi nakho amandla okuphatha yena.
Enye yezinkinga ezibalulekile eNingizimu Afrika ukuthola isixazululo sezimo eziningi zokuhlaselwa kwezimboni ezithinta kabi umphakathi wezolimo. Senza konke okusemandleni ethu ukwenza umehluko obonakalayo mayelana nokuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Ngokwenza kube nokuphepha kwabafuyi, amathuba angavela ukuze bagxile ekukhiqizeni imikhiqizo yezolimo ekhangayo. Umnikelo wezezimali owenziwe nguMfundisi we-Agri Securitas kulencwadi ubufakazi bokuzinikela kwethu ekwakheni amandla komphakathi wezolimo ukuba uphathe ukuphepha kwawo. Kuyajabulisa iZinyunyana Zolimo eNingizimu Afrika ukubambisana neNhlangano Yezokuphepha yaseNingizimu Afrika kulolu hlelo olubalulekile lokuletha ulwazi kumphakathi wezolimo wonke. Khumbula: impilo yakho ibalulekile kithi; ndawonye singakwenza umehluko. Le ncwadi ihloselwe ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ikakhulukazi ukuphepha komphakathi wezolimo. IKomidi Lokuxhumana Lwezifunda leMpumalanga neNtshonalanga (POCOC) lithathe lesi sinyathelo sokwakha umhlahlandlela wokuphepha nokuhlanganisa lokhu kulencwadi. IKomidi Lokuxhumana Kazwelonke (NOCOC) linqume ukusabalalisa le ncwadi ezweni lonke futhi lisekele lokhu ngeminikelo evela kwabanye abathintekayo. Le ncwadi iqukethe ulwazi mayelana neSikhungo Sezokuphepha saseNingizimu Afrika (SAPS), iMpi Yezwe yaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF), kanye nezinyunyana zabafuyi. Ichaza ukuthi lezi zinhlangano zimi kanjani futhi zihlelwe kanjani ukuze zilwe nohlu lokuhlaselwa kwezimboni. Iphinde ixoxe ngePhuzu Lokuvikela Izindawo Zasemaphandleni (RPP) nokuthi leli phuzu lixhumene kanjani neMisebenzi ye-Akantus II, umkhankaso wokubambisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa nezinsizakalo zokuphepha ohlose ukuthuthukisa ukuphepha ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Enye into ebalulekile kule ncwadi yizindlela zokuphepha ezikuyona. Izindlela zokuphepha zidingeka ngoba izinhlangano zokuphepha (SAPS neSANDF) zibheka ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini yezolimo njengenye yezinkinga ezishiywe ngaphandle ohlelweni lokuphepha kwezindawo zasemaphandleni (RPP). Uma zisetshenziswa kahle, izindlela zokuphepha zizothinta ukuphepha komphakathi wezolimo. Uhlelo lweMpi uhlelo olwenziwa ngokuzithandela oluhlanganyela neNhlangano Yezempi yaseNingizimu Afrika olusebenza ngasikhathi sinye. Umphathi ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza kube nokuphepha nokuvikela umphakathi othile (ezindaweni zasemaphandleni noma ezidolobheni). Usizo abahlinzekayo ngokuvamile lubizwa ngokuthi usizo lendawo. Usizo lendawo luhlanganisa umphakathi wonke, ngakho-ke noma ilungu lomphakathi elingelona ilungu loHlelo lweMpi lungathola ukuvikelwa ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo, nakuba kungenzeka bangatholi zonke izinzuzo ezihambisana nokuba ilungu lohlelo. Labo abahlanganyela kulolu Hlelo lweMpi abanakho umthwalo wemfanelo wokuvikela ngaphandle kwemingcele yezindawo abasebenza kuzo; banomthwalo wemfanelo kuphela wokuvikela nokwenza kube nokuphepha kwemiphakathi yabo. Lolu hlelo lungachazwa ngokufushane njengokuhlukaniswa kwezindawo zibe yizicucu ezincane, ezilawulekayo. Ngamunye walezi zindawo ezincane inani elithile lezindawo zokulima noma izindlu, kuye ngesisindo sendawo kanye nokwabiwa kwezindawo lapho abantu behlala khona. Amalungu endawo axhumana ngefoni noma ngomsakazo njengohlelo lokuxhumana uma imigqa yehluleka. Ezinye izinhlelo zokuxhumana zibalulekile ohlelweni lokuphepha ezindaweni. Amalungu endawo axhumana nomholi wabo (okhethwe ngamalungu) onendlela yokuxhumana nesiteshi samaphoyisa. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuphendula ngokushesha kwamaphoyisa uma kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa. Umholi wohlelo angazisa umphathi waleso sithangami uma kudingeka amandla amakhulu. Inqubo yokuxhumana ingathatha isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke amalungu endawo kumele akwazi ukuvikela futhi athembe ozakwabo nabanye amalungu endawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphendula ngokushesha esimweni esiphuthumayo. Ngalesi sizathu, indawo kumele ilungiselele ukubhekana nezimo ngaphambi kokuba zenzeke. Umphathi Wendawo uzosiza lolu hlelo lendawo uma lwakha uhlelo lokuphendula ezimeni. Ukubaluleka kokusebenza kahle kwalolu hlelo kukhona ekubambisaneni okufanayo kwamalungu endawo. Bamba iqhaza - kuzokusiza! Kukhona ama-foramu amaphoyisa (CPF) nemiphakathi esiteshini, endaweni, nasezifundazweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi wezolimo ukhuthazwa ukuba ujoyine iNhlangano Yezokuphepha Yezolimo yaseNingizimu Afrika (SARPF) lapho bengafunda khona izindlela zokuzivikela nokuthuthukisa izindlela zokuxhumana uma kunezingozi. Uma ujoyina i-CPF noma i-SARPF, umphakathi wezolimo uyaziswa ngamalungelo awo, njengelungelo leli lungu lomphakathi lokuthwala nokusebenzisa isibhamu. I-South African Rural Police Federation (SARPF) iyinhlangano yokuzithandela esebenza ngasikhathi sinye. Amalungu ale nhlangano ahlukaniswe ngezigaba ezine, okuyiziphathimandla zamaphoyisa, amaphoyisa asekelayo, amaphoyisa akhethekile, kanye namaphoyisa ezolimo nasezidolobheni. Labo abaphakathi kwesigaba samaphoyisa ezolimo nasezidolobheni bangama phoyisa asondelene kakhulu nokuvikela izimboni. Labo abafuna ukuzinikela bangafaka isicelo esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduze ukuze bafakwe ohlwini lwezizinda. Abazinikeli bakhethwa ngendlela efanayo nalabo abafaka izicelo zomsebenzi wesikhathi esigcwele, kodwa akudingeki ukuba ne-licence yokushayela. Izidingo ezivamile ezifana neziqu zokushayela, izitifiketi zemfundo, kanye nezilinganiso zempilo yengqondo azisebenzi kulabo abafaka izicelo zokufakwa ohlwini lwezizinda emkhakheni walezo ezibhekene nezindawo zasemaphandleni nasezidolobheni. Ngokwenkambo 5 yemithetho esungulwe nguMphathi Kazwelonke noma uMphathi Wezifunda, bangabizwa ukuba basebenze kunoma iyiphi indawo ngosuku nesikhathi esinqunywe nguMphathi Kazwelonke noma uMphathi Wezifunda futhi benze imisebenzi ephathelene namaphoyisa edolobheni noma endaweni yasemaphandleni ngesikhathi noma endaweni eyinikezwe nguMphathi Kazwelonke noma uMphathi Wezifunda ophathelene. Bangadluliselwa kwenye imikhakha uma behlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo zalo mkhakha futhi baqeqeshwe noma befuna ukungena eqeqesheni lelo khakha; futhi ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe kaMphathi Kazwelonke, abakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yenhlangano ekhethiwe, iSikhungo Sokuphepha, ezweni lonke, esikhumulweni sezindiza, noma kunoma iyiphi enye ingxenye. Umphathi ngamunye kumele enze isinqumo sokuthumela amaphoyisa ezolimo esiteshini sabo, emnyangweni, noma kwezinye izikhungo zeNhlangano ngokuya ngezidingo nezinto ezibalulekile zaleso sithangami, umnyango, noma kwezinye izikhungo. Ochwepheshe bezolimo kulo lonke izwe babamba iqhaza kulolu hlelo lokuvikela izindawo zasemaphandleni (RPP). Lezi zinsizakalo zixhumene nezinyunyana zezolimo zezifunda. Izinyunyana zezolimo zezif
Yini efakwe ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Ubani ongafaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Ingabe isenzo noma isinyathelo esikhala ngaso singaphula amalungelo akho emvelo afakwe ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Ingabe kukhona isixazululo ngezinkinga eziphakanyisiwe ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Kwenzekani ngemuva kokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amalungelo akho emvelo ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? Funda lapha kuqala. Ukusebenzisa iNational Environmental Management Act (NEMA) kungaba lula. Awudingi ukuba nommeli ukuze ufake isikhalazo kumuntu okwamanje ebulala imvelo noma kumuntu okukholelwa ukuthi angase abulale imvelo esikhathini esizayo. Awudingi futhi uma ufuna ukubamba iqhaza njengomuntu wesifunda ezinqumweni eziphathelene nemvelo. Kuyisicwangciso esihle ukufuna usizo kumuntu onolwazi nge-NEMA ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo. Umthetho ungaba nzima futhi udidekile. Inkinga yakho ingase ibe nezimpande ezijulile. Kungase kube nezindlela ezingaphezu kwesisodwa zokuyixazulula. Ungase futhi udinge ukubuza umuntu onolwazi ngalezi zindaba noma izinkinga ezingafakwanga kulolu hlelo. Ungase ufune ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi lokho okwenziwayo kusemthethweni. Uhlu lwezizinda zikahulumeni nezinsiza zomthetho kanye nolwazi olunomthelela lutholakala ekugcineni kwalolu hlelo. Bangakunika usizo mahhala ekuvikeleni imvelo yakho. Uma inkinga yakho ihilela ezinye izindaba, bangakudlulisela endaweni efanele yokusiza. Yini amalungelo emvelo? Ngo-1994, umthethosisekelo omusha wasungula ilungelo lokuba nemvelo enempilo njengelungelo eliyisisekelo labantu. Lapho umthetho uthi into ethile iyilungelo eliyisisekelo, kusho ukuthi konke okwenziwa uhulumeni kufanele kuhambisane nalokho okuchazwe ngalolo lungelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imithetho, izinqubo, nezinyathelo ezithathwayo. Abantu, kanye nemiphakathi, izinkampani, nezinhlelo kufanele zenze ngokuhambisana nelungelo. INkantolo yeZwe ingaqeda imithetho ephikisana nalolu lungelo, futhi izinkantolo zingaqeda izinyathelo zikaHulumeni noma zomphakathi eziphula lo mthetho. Ukuqeda kusho ukungabambeleli noma ukuguqula. Ilungelo eliyisisekelo lemvelo lithi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuba nemvelo engalimeleli empilweni yabo noma ekuphileni kwabo. Futhi lithi uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezilungile nezilindelekile ukuvikela imvelo, njenge ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa komoya, ukukhuthaza ukugcinwa kwemvelo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa okuzinzile kokukhula komphakathi nezomnotho. Ngaphandle komthethosisekelo, kunezinye izinqubo eziningi ezivikela imvelo, njenge mthetho wokugcinwa, umthetho wamanzi, nomthetho wokungcoliswa komoya. Le mithetho ivikela eziningi izinto ezingalimaza imvelo. Noma ngabe akukho mthetho ovikela ingxenye ethile yemvelo, kukhona njalo ilungelo lempilo elingasetshenziswa ukuvikela impilo yakho nokuphila kahle nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu benza kahle ukuvikela imvelo. I-NEMA iyimthetho omusha osiza ukuvikela amalungelo akho emvelo kangcono. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokusungulwa kwemigomo yemvelo ehola uhulumeni kulokho okufanele akwenze. Isibonelo, ukwazisa uHulumeni ngalokho okubizwa ngokuthi "ukuthuthukiswa okuzinzile," okusho ukuthi wena njengomphakathi noma njengomuntu walo kufanele ubambe iqhaza ezinqumweni ezithinta imvelo. Usiza ukuvikela imvelo ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uhulumeni ucabangela zonke izimpawu (ukuthonya kwemvelo) ezingavela ekuthuthukisweni ngaphambi kokuvuma ukuthi kuqhubeke. Ukuvikela labo abasebenza abaphikisa ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezilimazayo emvelweni, kanye nababika (labantu abahlinzeka ngemininingwane) ngabaningi abalimaza imvelo. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kithi ukusiza izinkinga nezimpikiswano (ukuxazulula ukuphikisana kwemibono nokuphatha). Ekugcineni, kunciphisa ingozi yokuthi uzothola ukuthi uphakathi kwenkantolo ukuvikela amalungelo akho uma ezinye izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga zihluleka. I-NEMA ichaza imvelo njengendawo yemvelo nezomzimba, izici zamasiko, nezinto ezithile ezithinta impilo yomuntu noma ukuphila kahle. Lolu hlelo lusetshenziswa kanjani? Luchaza ukuthi ungafaka kanjani isikhalazo, ufune isixazululo, noma uthathe isinyathelo somthetho mayelana nento engase yenzeke noma esivele yenzekile futhi ilimaze imvelo. Luchaza ukuthi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emizamweni yokuthonya izinqumo ezizothinta imvelo nezicwangciso zokuvikela imvelo ngokuqhamuka nezivumelwano noHulumeni. Uma ufuna ukufunda kabanzi nge-NEMA, funda lezi ziqondiso. Uma ufuna ukufaka isikhalazo mayelana nokulimala kwemvelo okwenzekile noma okungenzeka kube khona esikhathini esizayo, kunezinyathelo ezinhlanu kulolu hlelo. Lezi zinyathelo zizokukhombisa ukuthi ungayisebenzisa kanjani i-NEMA. Uma ungazi impendulo yombuzo noma udinga olunye ulwazi, bheka isigaba kulolu hlelo lapho kukhona inombolo efanayo nalowo mbuzo bese ufunda. Buyela bese ubheka lombuzo. Uma ungaphendula ngempela, qhubeka nembuzo elandelayo. Uma uqhubeka ungakuqondi ukuphendula kombuzo, noma ufundile le ndatshana, noma ufuna olunye ulwazi, xhumana neMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha, bheka Isigaba 10 lapho uzothola khona ikheli. Uma uphendule ngempela kuyo yonke imibuzo, funda Amakhasi 8 no-9 ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nalokho okwenzeka uma uthatha isinyathelo. Ukuthatha isinyathelo somthetho. Uma ungazi impendulo yombuzo noma ucabanga ukuthi impendulo ayikho, ungawulahli ithemba. Funda lesi sigaba selolu hlelo futhi uxhumane neMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha wesifunda sakho noma ngesizwe.
