Umbuzo 8: Kwenzekani uma uthatha isinyathelo? ISIGABA 1: Yini efakwe ngaphansi kwe-NEMA? I-NEMA yasungulwa ngomhla kaJanuwari 29, 1999. Ingasetshenziswa ezinkingeni ezizovela noma lezo ezenzekile ngemuva kosuku lukaJanuwari 29, 1999. Ayisizi ukuxazulula izinkinga ezenzekile ngaphambi kwalolu suku ngaphandle kwezinkinga eziqhubekayo. I-NEMA yenza kube lula ukuvikela amalungelo akho emvelo kunakuqala. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakudingeka ukuthi uye enkantolo kuphela uma impilo yakho
Sawubona bafana, niyaphi? O, cha, thina siphinde siye ePolokwane! O, phuma. Le nhlangano ikhohliwe ukushintsha amagama ezindawo ngaphandle kwesizathu. Bafana! Ngalmost ngilahlekelwe ithuba lokuthola ukuhamba ngenxa yalokho. Angikuthandi nakancane. Leli zwe lidinga imali yokwakha izindlu nokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS, kodwa esikhundleni salokho, siphuma ezivakashi ezweni lethu. Asazi ukuthi siphuma kuphi! Bangobani laba bantu abashintsha amagama ezwe lethu? Vuka mfana, ukushintsha amagama akukhona nje ukuhamba. Kuye ngenhloso yokunikeza igama elihle ezweni lethu, umlando wethu, kanye nesiko lethu. Singakwenza kanjani ukukhuthaza izwe lethu emphakathini wamazwe omhlaba uma sisasebenzisa amagama athathiwe kwamanye amazwe? Sidinga ukukhuthaza izwe lethu, ukuze sikhombise ubunikazi bethu bokwenyani. Sidinga ukuveza emphakathini wamazwe omhlaba ukuthi singobani ngempela! Lokhu kushintshwa kwamagama ezindawo zezwe kuyindaba ethinta kakhulu! Bheka lapha kule ndatshana, uma usuwenze lokho, sizoxoxa ngalolu daba. Siphakathi kokuphuma lapho siya khona, ngakho sinesikhathi sokuxoxa ngakho. Ngamagama ezici zemvelo, ezenziwe noma ezishintshiwe ngabantu, zingaba nezakhamuzi noma zingabi nazo. I-SAGNC yasungulwa nguMthetho weSishayamthetho seGeographical Names Council (Umthetho No. 111 ka-1998) njengomgomo ophatha ukushintshwa kwamagama ezindawo eNingizimu Afrika. Yasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Nezamasiko. I-SAGNC ifaka ochwepheshe kumagama ezindawo, izilimi ezisemthethweni, umlando wesiko, ummeleli ovela kwisifunda ngasinye, abamele bonke osifundeni, kanye nabamele uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Nezinguquko Zomhlaba, iPosi, iBhodi Lezilimi ZaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezinye izikhungo ezihlobene. Umgomo ophatha i-SAGNC usebenza ngezinhlelo zePhondo zokuphatha amagama ezindawo kanti izinga lezakhamuzi lisebenza ngezinhlelo Zasekhaya Nezasezifundeni. Kufanele ukwazi ukufinyelela lezi zinhlelo endaweni yakho. Ukuze kube lula, kuhlobene namagama ezici zemvelo zezinhlobonhlobo zezinto ezweni. Ngamagama abhaliswe ngummthetho. Isibonelo, igama lezwe, amagama ezifunda, namagama ezindawo zokuhlala kanye nezinto eziphathwa ngababheki bendawo ezifana nezindlela, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izikhala, amapaki, nezindela. Bese kuba nezakhiwo nezivini eziphethwe ngabantu ngabanye. Ngokufanayo, amagama ezici zemvelo asetshenziselwa ukubhaliswa komhlaba azaziwa njengezindawo zeCadastral. Nokho, wonke amagama asemthethweni kufanele ahambisane nemigomo yokubiza ye-SAGNC. Abantu bavame ukuhlinzeka ngamagama afanayo ezindaweni ezahlukene noma amagama akhangayo noma afana kakhulu njengoba kubhalwe kwenye indawo. Ezweni elinamagama amaningi njengeNingizimu Afrika, izindawo zivame ukuba namagama amaningi. Lezi zimo zikhokelela ekuqondeni okungafanele nasekudidekeni. Ukuze kuvinjelwe lokho, emhlabeni jikelele, amagama ezindawo alawulwa ngababheki. Kubalulekile ukuhlela amagama ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando nezimpawu zezwe ziyaziwa ngokwezizwe nezohwebo, ukuthuthwa, ukuxhumana, ukuhlela izifunda nezemvelo, imisebenzi yomphakathi, isayensi nobuchwepheshe, ukhetho nezibalo, ezokuvakasha, ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlonza nokusiza. I-SAGNC yenze isinqumo sokugcina sokuthi yiziphi noma yiziphi amagama okufanele anconywe kuNgqongqoshe. Uma igama liqinisekisiwe nguNgqongqoshe, lelo gama liyaqashelwa ngokusemthethweni. Libhalwa kwiGazethi yoMnyango ukuze libe semthethweni futhi limemezelwe. Ibhodi ihlangana kathathu ngonyaka. Njengoba ukuhamba kwenzeka ngenxa yokungaphelele noma ulwazi olungalungile kufomu lesicelo, abafakizicelo kufanele bazi ukuthi ukuvunywa kwegama kungaba inqubo ende. Lokhu kufanele kubhekwe lapho kuhlelwa ukuthi isikhathi sokulinda singathatha okungenani ezinyangeni ezintathu futhi kufanele kuqinisekiswe lapho kugcwaliswa ifomu ukuthi kugcwaliswe kahle ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuhamba okude. Noma ngubani angathola ifomu lesicelo kwiwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko ku-www.dac.gov.za, emahhovisi kazwelonke, esifundeni, nasezindaweni zomphakathi ezisebenza namagama ezindawo, noma ungafaka isicelo ku-www.sagns.gov.za. Ngaphambi kokugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, kufanele ulifunde kahle futhi ugweme lokhu... Amagama abantu abaphilayo kufanele futhi agwenywe. Izici zemvelo ezibizwa ngamagama abantu kufanele zihambisane nobuhlakani balo muntu. Ngokukhuluma kalula, kubonisa okuthile okubalulekile ngomuntu odumile ezweni lonke. Kulungile, ngiyaphendukela lapha. I-Polokwane ikhulu elingu-15 phambili. Jabulela ukuvakashela kwakho! Ngiyabonga ngokusihamba. Ngempela, ngiyabonga, uhamba ngokuphepha.
Inkululeko isifinyelelwe, manje sekuyisikhathi sokuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babambe iqhaza ekuguquleni izwe lethu kube yilokho esilwe ngakho. Okokuqala emlandweni wethu nasezweni lethu, abantu bethu banikezwe ithuba lokuba nezwi ekubizeni izindawo. Ngale ndlela, kumele sikhombise ukuthi izinto zishintshile, ukuthi sesihambile phesheya kwesikhathi sobandlululo. Kumele sishintshe isithombe sezwe lethu ukuze singaveli njengengxenye yeYurophu kodwa kube njenge-Afrika. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezizoholela ekushintsheni lezo ziqu ezaziyisikhumbuzo nezicaphuna, amagama ezizwe atholakala kwamanye amazwe kanye nalawo abhalwe ngokungalungile. Lokhu kuyimfanelo eqondiswe kuNgqongqoshe wethu Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye Nobuchwepheshe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngempela. Kuyimfanelo yethu njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka. Impumelelo yalokhu izoba uphawu lokuguqulwa kweqiniso ezweni lethu elisebuhleni bokushintsha. INingizimu Afrika inohulumeni obalulekile futhi kumele ibonise lokhu kushintsha kulabo abavotele yona nalabo abaseduze kwayo. Kumele isebenze ngokushesha njengamazwe angomakhelwane asevele akhombisile le mfuno ngokususa konke okwakukhumbuza ngezikhathi zokucindezelwa nobandlululo. Bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezinhlangano ezikhona zikhululekile ukufaka iziphakamiso zisebenzisa amafomu atholakalayo eHhovisi Elikhulu, iGeographical Names Unit, esekelwe eMnyangweni Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye Nobuchwepheshe, P/Bag X894, Pretoria, 0001. Kulawa mafomu, abantu banelungelo lokuphakamisa amagama amasha kanye nezinguquko kumagama akhona, uma kuphela iziphakamiso zikhona nezizathu ezihambisana nazo. Le mibiko ilungiselelwe kusukela ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kweBhodi kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka wokuqala wokuhlinzekwa kwezimali. Ukusekelwa komsebenzi wehhovisi kuBhodi kuvela eMnyangweni Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye Nobuchwepheshe (DACTS). Ekuqaleni, bekungaphansi kweNational Language Body yale Mnyango. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kudluliselwe kwiNational Heritage Body yalolu Mnyango. Izinqumo zeBhodi ziqinisekiswa futhi ziqashelwa nguNgqongqoshe. Abantu nezikhungo ezingahambisani nezinqumo ezenziwe yiBhodi bangabhekana nezinyathelo zomthetho. UNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye Nobuchwepheshe wamukela iziphakamiso zokunqoba abantu abalandelayo, abakhethwe yiKomidi Lokukhetha. Abanqobi bazosebenza kwiNingizimu Afrika Council for Naming Places. Ibhodi ithathe indawo yeNational Names Committee eyayicebisa uhulumeni ngokuqinisekiswa kwamanye amagama ezindawo kusukela ngo-1940. Omunye umehluko obalulekile phakathi kweBhodi kanye nomnyango owasebenza esikhathini esedlule ukuthi le Bhodi inikezwe amandla amaningi ukuze ibhekane nazo zonke izinhlobo zezindawo kuhlanganise; ukufuna lezo zindawo ezidinga ukwenziwa kabusha noma ziqanjwe okokuqala futhi ukuthi izinqumo zayo zizobopha, uma kuphela zamukelwa nguNgqongqoshe. Ibhodi isungule umgomo nezindlela, kulandela izinqumo nezindlela zeZizwe Ezihlangene. Ibhodi inegunya phezu kwazo zonke izindawo namagama nezinto kanye nezakhiwo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeNingizimu Afrika nasezindaweni lapho leli zwe liphatha khona, noma lezo zindawo ezitholakala ngezinkulumo ezithile. Ezinye izizathu ezisemthethweni zingatholakala futhi kumagama abantu abaphilayo. Ukunquma igama noma amagama endaweni kudinga ukuqhathaniswa ngokucophelela phakathi komlando nesidingo solimi, ukuhamba kalula kokuxhumana, umphakathi kanye nenhloso yezwe. Ukuhweba ngolwazi mayelana nezinzuzo zezimali kanye nokuhlangana komphakathi ngenxa yokufana kwamagama ezindawo. Ukuveza isu lokususa, ezinye izindawo ezabizwa ngaphansi kokucindezelwa kufanele zifakwe. Ukuze kube lula, ukusabalalisa ulwazi nokudlulisa ulwazi ngenqubo ehlelekile lapho amagama ezindawo akhiwa, angashicilelwa ezincwadini noma ngezingxenyekazi ze-computer. Ukusungula amaqembu wezindawo ezihlukahlukene (PGNC's), ngaphansi komthetho weNingizimu Afrika Place Names Act kanye nemithetho ephathelene nokufana kwamagama ezindawo. Ibhodi ikhethile amaqembu amancane alandelayo. Ngaphezu kwalabo abakhethwe ekuqaleni, kukhona abanye kanye namalungu angasetshenziswa ngezikhathi ezithile. Umsebenzi wayo ukuhola nokwakha ukufana ekubizeni izindawo: ukuhlola amagama amaningi; lawo asevele ekhona kodwa angamukelekile ngokomthetho, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene ezingenziwa yiBhodi. Ikhono layo: ukusungula isisekelo sokubamba iqhaza; ukuhlela izifundo zokufundisa nezokubuyisela kubafundi; ukuqopha imibhalo yokufundisa nokwakha ithimba ezingeni lesizwe nezasezifundazweni. Emhlanganweni obubanjwe ngomhla ziyi-7 kuNdasa, 2000, kwanqunywa ukusungula ikomidi lokuxhumana nezindaba zomphakathi, ukusabalalisa, nokwazisa umphakathi. Isizathu salokhu ukuhlela nokwabelana ngomsebenzi phakathi kwalezi ziqembu. Ekuqaleni kuka-2001, kwasungulwa ikomidi elincane elisha ngenhloso elandelayo, kanti uNkk. Dichabe wakhethwa njengomphakathi walo. Ukuze usebenze ngesicwangciso sebhodi; ukuya emcimbini wokwethulwa kosuku lwezindawo zezwe; ukuthola imikhakha nezixhumanisi zokuxhumana nezikhungo ezingekho phansi kwemali kanye namathimba akhethiweyo. Ukuqopha ikhodi yokuziphatha; ukukhuthaza indlela iBhodi ebambisana ngayo nezinye izikhungo, ezingeni lezifundazwe nezifunda; ukuhlola imithetho nezindlela eziphathelene nokufana kokubiza izindawo. Le mibhalo iyisisekelo nesingeniso esichaza indlela nezinto iBhodi ehlose ukuzenza. Iphatha izinto ezifana nenhloso yokusungula iBhodi, lokho ikhokhelwa ukukwenza, imisebenzi elindelekile, indawo yegunya, izinqubo nemigomo, isu elikhulu lebhodi, kanye nezimali ezihlinzekwayo. Ngokwemithetho, enye yezinto ezisemqoka zeBhodi ukukhuthaza ukusungulwa kwamakhamphani wezindawo eziphakeme. Lezi zikhungo kufanele zisungulwe nguMnyango Wezifundazwe ophatha Ezobuciko neZamasiko, ngemva kokubonisana neBhodi. Ibhodi ibhalile uhlu lwezikhombisi zemigomo yalezi zikhungo. Lezi zikhombisi zikhombisa izakhiwo eziphakanyisiwe futhi zinikeza isibonelo sokuthi ingxube yeziqu ingakhiwa kanjani, iziphakamiso zokusebenza kwamalungu nezilindelo, kanye neziphakamiso zokwakha amakhamphani ezindawo ezizokwenziwa ngabasebenzi bezikhungo. Lezi zikhombisi zizophatha umsebenzi weBhodi ngokuhlola amagama alindile nalawo angakakhethwa yiBhodi. Emhlanganweni ngamunye, iBhodi ihlola uhlu lwamagama athunyelwe ukuze aqinisekiswe ezivela kumasipala, eziphakanyisiwe, abathuthukisi bezwe, nezinye izigidi ezithakazelisayo. Kukhona ugqozi oluqinile lokuthi igama libhalwe ngokuhambisana nomthombo wolimi olukhuluma ngalo, kanye nokucabangela izinto ezifana nomlando wokubiza le nto, indawo
Ekusungulweni kwe-NER (Umphakathi Wezokuhlinzeka Ngamandla) ngoMsombuluko 1995, i-NER yazibophezela ekwenzeni izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi (ESI). Izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zabe seziqokonyiswa futhi zafaneleka nguMphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abahlinzeki bamanzi bagcina abathengi bethola izinga elamukelekayo lezinsizakalo. Enye indima esebenza ngayo i-NER okwamanje ukuqapha iminikelo yabahlinzeki bamanzi ngokubabeka uma kuqhathaniswa nezindinganiso ezibekwe. Umphakathi uphinde uqaphele ukuthi abathengi banendima yokudlala ohlelweni lokulawulwa. Kukholwa ukuthi uma abathengi beqonda izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhona, bazokwazi ukuvusa izinkinga kubahlinzeki bamanzi futhi babe nezwi ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngakho-ke, abathengi kufanele bazi ngezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka abazifanele. Kuze kube manje, i-NER isungule idokhumenti elula ukufundwa futhi eyamukelekayo kubathengi. Le dokhumenti isekelwe kulokho okukhona ngaphandle kokushintsha umqondo wayo. I-National Electricity Regulator (NER) isivele yaqaphela isidingo sokusungula izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi; izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zingalindelwa ngabathengi bempahla ehlukahlukene kanye nezinga okufanele lihlangabezane nalokho okukhona. Abahlinzeki bamanzi kufanele babike ku-NER ngezinga labo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nezindinganiso ezibekwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bayalandela izindinganiso. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuveza kubathengi abakhokha ngogesi ngezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ezilindelekile abangazilindela kubahlinzeki bamanzi futhi ukuze inikeze abathengi ukuqonda okungcono kwekholomu ye-NRS 047 ngendlela ethinta ngayo. Ukukala ugesi okhokhelwayo kuvumela abathengi ithuba lokuthenga ugesi ngamanani abawakwazi ukukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi abangahlangabezani nezikweletu zabo zogesi ekupheleni kwenyanga bangase baphuthelwe ukukhokha. Le bhukwana iphinde ichaze izindlela ezitholakalayo kubathengi uma kwenzeka izinkinga phakathi kwabahlinzeki bamanzi nabo mayelana nezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER ilindele ukuthi abathengi nabahlinzeki abathintekayo bazame ukusombulula izinkinga zabo ngaphambi kokufaka isikhalazo ku-NER. Ngokuvamile, i-NER ngeke ingenelele ngaphandle kokuthi leyo nkinga ingaxazululwa ezingeni lendawo. Ezinye izisho zisetshenziswa kakhulu embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi kubalulekile kubathengi bamanzi ukuba bazi ngencazelo yalezi zisho. Ukuhlukaniswa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi: ukuhlinzekwa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okuhlelwe phambili okwenziwa ngumbhlinzeki wogesi lapho kwenziwa umsebenzi wokugcinwa noma uxhumana nezintambo zikagesi. Ukuhlukaniswa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okwenziwe ngokuqinile: ukuhlinzekwa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okwenzeka ngenxa yephutha elithile ezintanjeni zikagesi noma ngenxa yokungasebenzi kahle kwemishini kagesi. Izintambo zikagesi zasemaphandleni: izintambo zikagesi ezihlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezikude, njengezindawo zasemaphandleni nezifunda, ezivame ukungabi nezinsiza ezinhle ezifana nezindlela. Izintambo zikagesi zasemadolobheni: izintambo zikagesi ezihlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezihlotshiswe kahle ezivame ukuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kwangaleso sikhathi: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kubathengi ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kungase kungahambisani nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Ugesi ophansi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekuhlinzekeni abathengi bezindlu noma amabhizinisi amancane. Ugesi ophakathi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekusabalaliseni ugesi nasekuhlinzekeni izimboni noma abathengi abangathengisi. I-voucher yegesi: Lokhu kuwufakazi lokukhokha (ibhilidi) elitholakala ngemva kokukhokha ugesi futhi livumela umthengi ukuthi asebenzise inani elithile legesi. Isebenza ngokuthi ilayishwe kumitha yegesi ekhokhelwayo. Umitha yegesi ekhokhelwayo: idivayisi yokukala ugesi ekhokhelwayo. Izimali ezahlukene zogesi ezithengwe zifakwa kule mithathu. Isikhungo sokuhweba nokuqasha ugesi: imishini exhunywe ezindaweni zebhizinisi esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amanani kagesi athengwe ngababhalisile ugesi ekhokhelwayo. Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngogesi: izinga elilindelekile lokuhlinzeka ngogesi, njengezinga lamandla kagesi, ukuhoxiswa, ukwehla, nokwenyuka kwamandla, njll., njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 2 se-NRS 048. Ikhredi/Abathengi abasebenzisa ama-voucher kagesi ekhokhelwayo: laba ngabathengi abasebenzisa ugesi ngekhredi futhi umhlinzeki kagesi uza ukufunda inani legesi elisetshenzisiwe. Izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezichazwe ngaphansi kwe-NRS 047 esigabeni 1 yilezo okufanele umhlinzeki kagesi azame ukuzihlangabeza, kodwa abahlinzeki bamanzi bencitshwa ukuba baphumelele izindinganiso eziphakeme ezibekwe. Ezimweni lapho umhlinzeki kagesi ehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezinga elilindelekile ngenxa yezizathu ezingaphansi kokulawula kwabo, ngeke babhekelele ukwehluleka ukusebenza ezingeni elibekwe. Lezi zimo zifaka phakathi izenzo zokulwa, ukuhweba, nokuvukela, izingozi zemoto, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Lezi zimo ezibalwe ngenhla aziphelele kodwa ziqondwa njengezibonelo zalokho okufanele kulawule isimo. Uma kwenzeka impikiswano nomthengi mayelana nezinga lokuhlinzeka elikhonjisiwe, umthwalo wokuzama ukusombulula le nkinga usemuhlinzeki kagesi usebenzisa izindlela ezifanele zokubonisana. Ngale ndlela, uma isikhalazo sesifakiwe, umhlinzeki kagesi kufanele azise inkantolo, isikhathi, nendawo lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukuzama ukusombulula udaba. Kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER izongena kuphela uma izingxoxo zokuxazulula zingaphumelelanga. Kubalulekile kubathengi ukuhamba ngezimo ezibekwe ngabahlinzeki bamanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, ukuqedela yonke imibhalo edingekayo, nokukhokha zonke izindleko ezibekwe. Uma kwenzeka impikiswano mayelana nezinga lezinsizakalo, ngokwesibonelo, ukunemba komitha yegesi ekhokhelwayo, kubalulekile kumthengi ukukhokha imali ebekwe ngaphambi kokuba udaba luhlolwe. Le mali izobuyiselwa uma kutholakala ukuthi ukunemba kokufunda kwemitha akulungile. Umthengi kufanele aqale ngokunikeza umhlinzeki kagesi ithuba lokuxazulula noma iyiphi inkinga. Kumele baphakamise udaba ku-NER uma kwenzeka ukuphumelela kokufinyelela esivumelwaneni. Izinsuku eziyishumi uma izintambo ezikhona zingasetshenziswa noma ikhebuli exhuma kwinethiwekhi yangaphakathi engadini. Inyanga eyodwa uma ugesi oph
Kubhalwe kahle ukukhokha izindleko zakho zikagesi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ungaphuthelwa. Njalo, amakhasimende akhokha ingxenye yebhili elizokhokhwa ngoba acabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzovimbela ugesi wabo ekuphunyukeni. Uma ingxenye oyiphuthumayo ingakhokhwa ngenyanga ezayo, uzokhula kakhulu futhi ungase ungakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Qaphela ukuthi ukukhokha njalo kuphela izingxenye zenani okufanele ukhokhe kungaholela ekuphunyukeni kukagesi wakho. Uma ubona ukuthi uphuthumile kakhulu emathubeni akho, xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uxoxe ngendlela yokulungisa lesi simo. Kuzokwenziwa izintshisakalo ngenani olikhokhayo uma ikhasimende lingakhokhi ngokuphelele noma likhokha ngamanani amancane noma likhokha ngemuva kosuku lokugcina. Le simo sokungakhokhi kahle kuholela ekwandeni kwenani lokukhokha njalo ngenyanga. Uma usayine isivumelwano sokukhokha nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi, gcina leso sivumelwano. Uma uphumelela, ugesi wakho uzophunyukiswa. Kodwa uma isimo sakho siba sibi kakhulu ngemuva kokusayina isivumelwano, kufanele uqinisekise umhlinzeki wakho kagesi ngokushesha. Ungase udinge ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi besimo sakho esishintshile. Uma unemitha kagesi yokukhokha ngaphambi, qaphela ngenani likagesi olisebenzisayo. Kuwo wonke amabhili, kufanele kube nenani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga kanye nenani lokuvala ekupheleni kwenyanga. Lokhu kukunika ithuba lokwazi inani eliphelele olisebenzisile kule nyanga. Kufanele uhlole ukuthi inani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga lihambisana nenani lokuvala elivela enyangeni edlule. Uma lezi zilinganiso zingahambisani, funa ukucaciselwa kumhlinzeki wakho kagesi. Ngezinye izikhathi, labo abafunda imitha kagesi benza amaphutha. Qaphela ngenani leyunithi ngayinye. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umhlinzeki wakho kagesi kufanele akukhokhise malini ngeyunithi (Kwh) kagesi oyisebenzisayo. Uma ungazi, kufanele ubuze umhlinzeki wakho kagesi noma iNational Energy Regulator. Ukuze uqonde ukuthi ukhokhisiwe kanjani kule nyanga, udinga ukuthatha inani eliphelele okufanele ukhokhe (ngama-rand) bese ulibamba ngenani likagesi olisebenzisile kule nyanga. Umphumela uzoba yintengo ngeyunithi (I-unit). Uma unenketho yokukhetha, ungashintsha uhlelo olusebenzisa ikhadi lapho uthenga inani elithile likagesi. Khumbula ukuthi uzokhokhwa imali yokusetha leli hlelo. Intengo yalezi zinguquko iyahluka ngokusekelwe kukagesi owawusebenzisile. Ulwazi lokulawula inani likagesi olisetshenzisile. Uma udinga ukukhokha, ungase udinge ukukhokha le ngxenye ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokushintsha kuhlelo lwekhadi. Izinzuzo zohlelo oluchazwe ngenhla zihlula izinselelo zokuqala okufanele ubhekane nazo ngaphambi kokushintsha (njengemali yokuqala okufanele uyikhokhe). Thola kumhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuthi yiziphi izimo nemigomo abahamba ngaphansi kwayo. Ngokuvamile, abanye abahlinzeki bagesi badinga amakhasimende ukuthi asayine isivumelwano sokukhokha isikweletu sabo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngokucophelela kuzokusiza unciphise ukusetshenziswa kwakho nezindleko zanyanga zonke. Ungakwenza kanjani lokhu? Amashubhu, izifudumezi zamanzi (ama-gizmos), kanye nezifudumezi (ama-radiators) ziwabathengi bagesi abakhulu futhi zandisa ibhili lakho likagesi. Uma unesi fudu seziwasha, qiniseka ukuthi i-thermostat ayibekwe phezulu. Ungabeka i-thermostat cishe kuma-60 degrees. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uthole izeluleko ngalokhu. Ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi esifudumezini zamanzi: uma unamandla, unganciphisa izinga likagesi eliya esifudumezini zamanzi, futhi lokhu kungaphinde kwenziwe kumapayipi ahambisa amanzi. Le ndlela inciphisa izindleko zikagesi kakhulu kodwa kuza nemali ethile uma ufuna ukuyisebenzisa. Isitofu: qiniseka ukuthi awuvuli wonke amaplethi esitofu ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izeluleko zithi unciphise ukushisa ephethe uma iphunga lakho liphume. Ungasebenzisi i-oven njengendlela yokufudumeza ngoba i-oven isebenzisa ugesi omningi. Izifudumezi: izifudumezi zikagesi zisebenzisa ugesi omningi. Uma unesi fudu sikagesi, kunconywa ukuthi uvule kuphela isifudumezi esisodwa. Kodwa uzokwazi ukuthi lokhu kuzokwandisa isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba indlu yakho ifudumale. Ukuvala amawindi: enye indlela yokunciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa ukuvala amawindi endlini yakho. Ukukhanya: ilambu elivaliwe ngengilazi linika ukukhanya okuningi kanti lisetshenziswa kagesi okuncane. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi. Yini umthetho oyisho ngokuphunyukiswa kukagesi? Umthetho ohlongozwayo wegesi ka-1987 unika umhlinzeki kagesi igunya lokuphunyukisa uma ibhili lingakhokhiwe noma uma ikhasimende lingahambisani nemigomo yokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Nokho, umthetho ufunela umhlinzeki kagesi ukuba unikeze ikhasimende isixwayiso semihla engu-14 ngaphambi kokuphunyukiswa kukagesi kwabo. Le nkathi iqala ngosuku olubhalwe encwadini. Isixwayiso embhalweni wanyanga zonke sikwamukelekile. Amakhasimende acelwa ukuthi ahlole umbhalo embhalweni. Khumbula ukuthi umuntu wokuqala okufanele ukhalaze kuye umhlinzeki wakho wendawo. Ikhasimende linelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo mayelana nezinga lenkonzo elihlinzekwa umhlinzeki wendawo. Umhlinzeki wendawo kagesi unomsebenzi wokulalela nokuxazulula isikhalazo. Uma wena njengomthengi unganelisekile ngemiphumela noma ngendlela isikhalazo sakho esiphathwe ngayo, udaba lungathunyelwa kuNational Energy Regulator (NER) ukuze luxazululwe.
Ingxenye -14 yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ibeka ukuthi, phakathi kokunye, ilunga lomphakathi kumele libhale incwadi ethile enhlangano yomphakathi abakhona kuyo phakathi nezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ekuqaleni kwale ngxenye. Le mfuneko ithobela ukuvunywa kokwandiswa kwesikhathi nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ngenhloso yokuhlanganisa nokushicilela le ncwadi kuGazethi yoHulumeni. Ukushicilelwa kwale ncwadi kuGazethi esemthethweni kunika amandla iziphakamiso ez contained in Section -14 kanye nokunika umuntu ilungelo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe yinhlelo yomphakathi efanele ukuze kufezwe noma kuvikelwe noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zabo. I-ICD iyingxenye yenhlangano ngaphansi komkhakha kaHulumeni. I-ICD iyisigaba soHulumeni saseNingizimu Afrika futhi ihlelwe ezingeni likazwelonke nasephakathini. Ezingeni likazwelonke, umphakathi wayo nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi, bese kuba noMphathi wePhakathi ezingeni lephakathini. Abaphathi bezifunda ze-ICD bathumela imibiko futhi baphathwa nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi. UMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kulandela inqubo ethile eyakhelwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokubambisana neKomidi Lezomthetho. Ingxenye ethile yabasebenzi be-ICD yakhiwe ngamalunga aqokwe nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho. Lokhu kwenzeka kulandela imithetho ephethe insizakalo yomphakathi kanye nabantu abathile abathunyelwa kwezinye izigaba ngenhloso yokusiza noma ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwi-ICD. Umsebenzi oqala ngalokho okukhulunywe ngumthetho (ngokwezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wesevisi Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika, iMthetho No. 68 ka-1965) we-ICD ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokungafaneleki nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe amalunga eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) kanye neMuni Police Service (MPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe. Lapha umthetho ubonisa kahle ukuthi u-ICD unikezwa umthwalo nomsebenzi wokubheka umphakathi mayelana ne-SAPS njengoba kuboniswe kuNgxenye -222 yeMthethosisekelo Wokushintsha ka-1993. Le ngxenye ibeka ukuthi "Kuzoba khona indlela ezimele, esunguliwe futhi ephethwe nguMthetho Wezomthetho ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokungafaneleki nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okukhulunywa ukuthi kwenziwe amalunga eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe." a ngokuthanda kwakhe noma ngemva kokuthola isikhalazo, uhlola noma yisiphi isenzo esingafanele noma ukuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe yilunga le-SAPS noma le-MPS. c ingahlola noma yisiphi isimo esiqondiswe kuyo nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho noma ngaphakathi komkhandlu wesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywe ngenhla, imisebenzi nezibopho ze-ICD zanda ngokwengeziwe nguMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwasekhaya (DVA), ka-1998 (iMthetho No. 112 ka-1998). Lo mthetho uthi uma ilunga le-SAPS lingahambisani nezibopho ezichazwe kuMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwasekhaya (DVA) noma imiyalo yeZwe eyakhishwa ngokomthetho (DVA), le nto ibhekwa njengokungafaneleki ngokuhumusha kweMthetho we-SAPS. Ngakho-ke, i-ICD kumele ibhunyulwe ngalesi sikhala esibikwe kwi-SAPS. Umqondo ocacile wale mfuneko ukuthi i-ICD kumele isebenzise amandla nemisebenzi yayo ukuze ibheke umphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zikhalazo zokungafaneleki zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangobuchwepheshe yi-SAPS. I-DVA iphinde ibeke ukuthi i-SAPS kumele ithathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene nalunye ilunga le-SAPS olukhulunywa ukuthi aluhambisani nezibopho ezilawulwa yi-DVA, ngaphandle uma i-ICD ikhetha okuphambene ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Umqondo wale mfuneko ukuthi i-ICD kumele ithathe umsebenzi owengeziwe wokuphatha izikhalazo ezicela ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene namalunga e-SAPS. Ngokwenza lokhu, i-ICD iqhuba umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo zokulungisa azigxiliwe yi-SAPS ezimweni lapho kudingeka ukuthathwa lezo zinyathelo zokulungisa ezifanele. a I-ICD ayingxenye futhi ayiwela ngaphansi koMnyango WezeMthetho, ihlala ikhululekile, icacile ingxenye yenhlangano yokusebenza komphakathi nakuba ixhunywe kumNgqongqoshe oyedwa - uNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho - kanye ne-SAPS. b I-ICD inebhajethi yayo eyabelwe nguMphathi Osenza Imisebenzi kanye nebajethi yonyaka ehambisana nayo. Le bhajethi inefund yokuhlukile eyabelwe nguMthetho. Abasebenzi be-ICD bachaza futhi bahlanganisa wonke umuntu ophatha isikhundla esichazwe ngenhla. Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi agcinwe yi-ICD kumele senziwe ngombhalo lapho ummangali egcwalisa ifomu A, elaziwa ngokuthi: "Isicelo Sokufinyelela Kumarekhodi Enhlangano Yomphakathi." a ehhovisi leMenenja Yolwazi elinokuxhumana okukhulunywe kuNgxenye 2.2 ngenhla; noma b ehhovisi lesifunda le-ICD elichazwe kuNgxenye 1.1 yale ncwadi. f Uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye, ubufakazi bokwakhiwa kommangali kumele buphakanyiswe ngendlela ethokozisa uMenenja Yolwazi. a Thumela noma phakamisa isicelo esibhaliwe kuMenenja Yolwazi njengoba kuchazwe kuNgxenye -2.2 yale ncwadi. Isicelo kumele sithunyelwe kule ndawo yeMenenja Yolwazi noma ku-nombolo ye-fax, noma kwe-imeyili; noma b Thumela isicelo ngqo ehhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze nezinsuku ezichazwe kuNgxenye -1.1 yale ncwadi. Kulokhu, ihhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze lizohlinzeka ummangali ngerekhodi eqinisekisa ukuthi isicelo sitholiwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD njengoba kuchazwe kuNgxenye -4.1.2 kanye -4.1.2 yale ncwadi kodwa ongakwazi ukwenza kanjalo ngenxa yokungafundi noma ukungasebenzi, unelungelo lokwenza isicelo somlomo. a Emenenja Yolwazi echazwe; noma b KuMphathi wesifunda noma ehhovisi lesifunda elinikezwe lapho isicelo somlomo senziwa. Umenenja Yolwazi uzobhala isicelo somlomo futhi anikeze ummangali kopi yalolo suku. Uma ummangali efika kuMphathi wesifunda okukhulunywe kuNgxenye -4.1.4(b) yale ncwadi, uMphathi wesifunda ofanele uzobhalela isicelo somlomo futhi anikeze ummangali kopi yalolo suku. Uma ummangali ezisa uMenenja Yolwazi noma uMphathi wesifunda / umphathi osethekwini ngentshisekelo yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD, uMenenja Yolwazi uzohlinzeka ngalolu sizo mahhala ngoba kubalulekile ukuthi ummangali ahambisane ngokuphelele nezinhlinzeko -4.
Ukuhlinzekwa kolwazi lwemvelo kwezomnotho. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinye izinhlelo zolwazi, isibonelo, ulwazi lwemvelo lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nobuchwepheshe bamanje emikhakheni yezokwelapha nezinye izindawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe amazinga obuchwepheshe. I-National IKS Fund isebenza njengomphakathi wezimpahla zengqondo lapho kufanelekile, futhi futhi njengomxhumanisi nomhlinzeki wezinsiza zomthetho ezidingweni zokugcina zomphakathi wendabuko nezinye izithakazelo ezibambe ulwazi. Uhulumeni weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika uzinikele ekuqapheliseni, ekukhuthazeni, ekuthuthukiseni, ekuvikeleni, nasekuqinisekiseni i-IKS. Le nqubomgomo iyimiphumela yokuxoxisana okuningi, ukucwaninga, ukuxhumana, nokubamba iqhaza kwabathintekayo abaningi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabachwepheshe nabaphathi be- Indigenous Knowledge (IK) kubalulekile. Lokhu kuqhutshwa yizimiso ezijwayelekile zezimfanelo zomuntu futhi kufaka phakathi imibono ebalulekile yase-Afrika efana ne-ubuntu kanye ne-batho-pele. Le msebenzi ifaka phakathi ukulwa nokucwaswa futhi kumele iqhubeke nokukhuthaza inkululeko ngezinhlelo zolwazi ezivela ekuqinisekiseni nasekufihleni. Izinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo ezakhiwe futhi zigcinwe abantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika zibonisa izinhlelo zezempilo nezokukholelwa kwengxenye enkulu yomphakathi. Lokhu kulwazi lwemvelo kubonakala ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene kusukela emicimbini yesiko nezokukholelwa kuya ezindleleni zokulima nasekuhloleni kwezempilo. "Ulwazi lwemvelo" (IK) lusetshenziswa ngokufanayo no "ulwazi lwesiko" kanye "nolwazi bendawo" ukuze kuhlukaniswe phakathi kokuthuthukiswa kolwazi nemiphakathi yendabuko ebonakalayo ephuma ezinhlelweni zolwazi "zamazwe omhlaba" ezivela ezikhungweni zemfundo, ezikhungweni zokucwaninga zikahulumeni, nasemikhakheni eyizimboni ezizimele, kwesinye isikhathi kubizwa ngokungafanele njengezinhlelo zolwazi "zaseNtshonalanga". Ngaphansi kokucwaswa, Izinhlelo Zolwazi (IKS) eNingizimu Afrika kanye nezobuchwepheshe ngaphakathi kwalezi zinhlelo zikhawulelwe futhi zihlukunyezwa. Lokhu kunezimpempe ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho nasemphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, kube nemiphumela yokuphulukisa ekuthuthukiseni komphakathi, isiko, nomnotho kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlola ngakunye kwezinga lezenhlalo nezomnotho kanye nezinkomba zempilo kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bendabuko bakwi sikhala esinzima. Izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo zinekhono lokwandisa futhi ziqhubeke nokufaka ubuhlobo obungafani phakathi kwabantu bendabuko nezinye izingxenye zomphakathi eminyakeni ezayo ngaphandle kokuthi kwenziwe imizamo ebalulekile manje ukuze kubhekwe ukungalingani okuqhubekayo, okungatholakali ngaphandle kokuhlonipha izinhlelo zolwazi zomphakathi wendabuko kanye nolwazi lwesiko olucacile phakathi kwazo, njengemikhakha yabadokotela bendabuko nolwazi lwesiko olubanjwe ngabesifazane emphakathini. Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlonipha imibono yase-Afrika ezinhlelweni zolwazi eNingizimu Afrika akukhona nje kuphela udaba lokulungisa. Kungasiza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezintsha zokucwaninga nezakhiwo zokuqonda, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwamanje. Ukusungulwa kweminyaka eyinkulungwane yokucindezelwa, ekhona emnothweni ongekho emgibeleni we-IK owenziwe ngempela kwezinye izimo, kukhuphukile phakathi kwemiphakathi nabasebenzi. Iningi le-IK liqinisekisile ukuphila kwalo futhi liphinde lihlinzeke ngolwazi emicabangweni yase-Afrika mayelana nezindaba ezinjengobuciko, umculo, ukukholelwa, nemfundo, ubuholi, ubulungiswa, impilo, kanye nezolimo. Ukuziqonda nokuba nesiko, okubandakanya izinhlelo zokuphila komphakathi, kuqhubekile kukhulu futhi kuqinisiwe ngokuhlola okuqhubekayo kwe-IK, ngaphandle kokuthi indawo ngayinye ibe yük yokuhlupheka kwezokuhlalisana nezepolitiki kanye nezinkumbulo zokukoloni nokucwaswa. Ngokuvamile, abesifazane bangabavikeli balolu hlobo lwezinhlelo zolwazi. Ukuphumelela kokhetho lwezombusazwe ngaphezu kwezinselelo zokucwaswa kudinga ukuthi sakhe uhlaka lwesizwe lokuthuthukiswa okuphumelelayo kwezinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo. Lolu hlaka oluvumela luzoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukufeza ngokuphelele amandla abo emphakathini futhi bakhe isisekelo sokuphumelela ukufezekisa zonke izinhloso nezifiso zesizwe. Ukusebenzisa ezinye izinhlelo zolwazi, isibonelo, ulwazi lwemvelo lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nobuchwepheshe bamanje emikhakheni yezokwelapha nezinye izindawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe amazinga obuchwepheshe. Le nqubomgomo ifaka phakathi iminyango ehlukene yoHulumeni ehlangene nezibopho ezibalulekile zokusebenza ukuhlinzeka ngethuba eliphumelelayo ezinqubomgomeni nasezinhlelweni ezihlukene. Inani lezi zinhlelo ezintsha eziphumelelayo emkhakheni (emnyangweni wezempilo, isibonelo, noma mayelana nocwaningo lwe-IK, usebenzisa i-NRF) litholakele. Isidingo sehlaka elibanzi lezinqubomgomo elisekela isisekelo sikhonjiswe njengokusebenza kahle okwenziwa ngenkathi kuqhuba iKomidi Elibambisene eliholwa yi-DST. Ngakho-ke, le nqubomgomo iqhubeka ngesisekelo sokuthi izinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo, ngokwemvelo yazo, zidinga indlela "ehlanganisayo". Imisebenzi eqhubekayo neyaqala emikhakheni ehlukene kumele imele ukuqonda okuphelele kwe-IKS eNingizimu Afrika. Inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe isendaweni futhi uhlaka lwezomthetho lwasungulwa. Ukukhuthazwa nokuhlinzekwa kwamalungelo okushicilela umculo wendabuko nezindlela zobuciko eziveza umsebenzi owenziwayo. Umlandvo wezomthetho wezobuchwepheshe bezamasiko usunguliwe futhi ukhuthaza ukusungulwa komzimba ophakathi ozobizwa ngokuthi iNational Health Professionals Council, ozobhekelela imisebenzi yabantu abangu-200,000 eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuqinisekile, ngeke kube khona ithuba lokukhetha ngokuphelele kulolu hlaka lwezinqubomgomo ukukhetha abenzi bezinqubomgomo emikhakheni enezici zayo ezihlukile. Nokho, kuzodingeka ukudala eminye imisebenzi emisha ukuze kusekelwe ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwe-IKS eNingizimu Afrika. Le ngxenye ebalulekile yepharamitha yezenqubomgomo idinga ukusungulwa kwezinkundla eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisiwe, kuthuthukiswe, futhi kubanjwe i-IKS, kanye nokwakha umqondo womphakathi ukuze kuhlanganiswe izinhlobo ezahlukene zabaqeqeshi. Umphakathi osekela, ongase ube uhlobo lwezinkampani, ukusiza imiphakathi ukufinyelela, ukuvikela, nokuhlinzeka ng rewards ezivela emiphakathini ephethe impahla yengqondo nezinye izimfanelo zomphakathi ngaphandle kokwazi ulwazi lwemvelo. Kwezinye izimo, imiphakathi noma izinhlangano zingakhetha ukusungula izimali zazo ukuze zifinyelele kule njongo, lapho intshisekelo ecacile noma ukubuyiselwa kudingeka. Isici esiyinhloko senqubomgomo sizoba ukusungulwa kohlelo lokurekhoda olusemthethweni lwe-IK. Uma iNingizimu Afrika ikhetha ukufaka i-IK emphakathini obanzi noma izama ukuvikela uhlobo lokuvikela, uhlelo lokurekhoda luy
Umgomo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho 8 ka-1996 uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nguhulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zakhe, futhi umthetho kazwelonke kufanele udalwe ukuze unikeze amandla kulolu lungelo. UMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 (uMthetho 2 ka-2000), ophumelele kulolu lungelo, waqala ukusebenza ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa 2001. Inhloso eyinhloko yalolu mthetho ukukhuthaza isiko lokukhanya nokubhekelela ezikhungweni zomphakathi nezizimele futhi ukhuthaze umphakathi ukufinyelela ulwazi oluwusizo ukuze bakwazi ukusebenzisa ngokuphelele amalungelo abo. Ngokusho kwalolu mthetho, uMphathiswa-Jikelele weMnyango Wezangaphandle ungumsebenzi wolwazi wale Mnyango. UMphathiswa-Jikelele uqoka oMsebenzi Ababambisene Nabo kulowo Mnyango. Ihhovisi leMphathiswa-Jikelele lizoba yisisekelo sokwamukela izicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale ndatshana ukujwayelisa amalungu omphakathi nezinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kutholakale amadokhumenti agcinwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle. Umbono weMnyango Wezangaphandle uwukwakha i-Afrika ehambisana, ethule, enedemokhrasi, engakhethi, ehlanganisiwe futhi ukubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umhlaba onobulungiswa nowenelisayo. UMnyango Wezangaphandle uzinikele ekukhuthazeni izintshisekelo nezimiso zaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuvuselela i-Afrika, nokwakha umhlaba ongcono kubantu bonke. Ukwakha nokuphatha ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba baseNingizimu Afrika nokukhuthaza izinhloso zezinqubomgomo zangaphandle. Ukuqapha intuthuko yamazwe omhlaba nokunikeza izeluleko kuhulumeni ngezinhlelo zangaphandle nezindaba zendawo ezihlobene nazo. Noma yiluphi ulwazi olubhaliwe olugcinwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle lungacelwa. Gcwalisa ifomu elibekiwe le-Fomu A elikhishwe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni inombolo R187 edlulelwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuFebhuwari 2002 (bona isheduli 2); futhi ukhokhe imali ebekiwe ekhombisa eshedulini 1 yale ndatshana. Nokho, umceli ofuna ukuboniswa amadokhumenti aqukethe ulwazi lwakhe siqu akadingeki ukukhokha imali yokucela. Lo mcela kufanele akhombise ukuthi isicelo sikhona ezithombeni zezincwadi ezigcinwe noma ukuthi ufuna ukubona amadokhumenti uqobo ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Ukutholakala kwalolu lwazi kuzothunyelwa kumceli ngendlela abacelile ukuba kuboniswe, ngaphandle uma le ndlela eceliwe izophazamisa kakhulu ukusebenza nokusebenza kweMnyango Wezangaphandle noma ibangele umonakalo noma umonakalo kumadokhumenti noma iphule amalungelo edokhumenti. Uma, ngezizathu zokusebenza, amadokhumenti angatholakala ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngenye indlela, imali yokuthola amadokhumenti izobala ngokuya ngendlela umceli acelile ukuba aboniswe. Uma umceli engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma enokukhubazeka, angacela ngomlomo, lapho umphakathi wolwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu ngaye futhi umnike ifomu eliphelile. Uma efuna ukwaziswa ngempumelelo yesicelo ngefoni noma ngenye indlela. Isikhundla esisetshenziselwa ukufaka isicelo, uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye umuntu. Umceli kufanele athumele isicelo sakhe ehhovisi elibekiwe lokwamukela izicelo njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, elizobe likhuphula leso sicelo. Ngemuva kokuba umphakathi wolwazi wenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umceli kufanele waziswe ngalokho isinqumo ngendlela abathanda ngayo ukuba baziwe. Uma, ngemuva kokulandela zonke izidingo zokusebenza ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni 4. Uma umceli efuna ukufaka isikhalazo, ifomu lesikhalazo elibekiwe elikhishwe ngokwaziswa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni inombolo R187 edlulelwa ngomhla ziyi-15 kuFebhuwari 2002 kufanele igcwaliswe. Uma umceli enganelisekile ngesinqumo somphakathi wolwazi okukhuluma ngaso esigabeni 4.3.1 ngenhla, isikhalazo singathunyelwa kuNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Umceli angathatha le ndaba enkantolo uma enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Bona Isheduli 1. Ngokusho komthetho, amanye ama-rekhodi angatholwa ngaphandle kokwenza isicelo ngokomthetho. Lezi zinkampani zingafinyelelwa ku-inthanethi yeMnyango Wezangaphandle kule ndawo: www.dfa.gov. UMnyango Wezangaphandle ugcina ulwazi ngezihloko ezilandelayo okumele zicelwe ngokusemthethweni ngokwesigaba 4.2. Imiklomelo, amagama, imiklomelo, nezinye. Le ndatshana izovuselelwa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14 soMthetho, okungenani ngezikhathi ezingaphezu konyaka.
