"Umthetho" ubhekisela kuMthetho Wabaphathi Bezempilo Zendabuko, 2004 (Umthetho No. 35 ka-2004); futhi "umphakathi" ubhekisela kumuntu ophila ngokwelashwa kwezendabuko njengoba kuchazwe nguMthetho. Ngokomgomo wokukhetha amalungu abhekiswe ezahlukanisweni c, e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yomthetho, uNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe isaziso kwiGovernment Gazette nakuma-phepha abhalwe okungenani amabili adluliselwa ezwenikazi nasemaphandleni, emema abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abafuna ukuwafaka njengamalungu eBhodi. Isaziso esibhekiswe kule Mthethosisekelo 2 kumele sichaze ulwazi oluzobhekwa uma kufakwa isiphakamiso njengelungu kanye nesikhathi sokufaka amagama aphakanyisiwe. a ye-subsection 7c yomthetho kumele ifakwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma elungu leBhodi elibhekelele impilo lapho umphakathi ophakanyisiwe esebenza khona; futhi b imisebenzi e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yomthetho kumele ifakwe kuNgqongqoshe weSizwe. Elungu leBhodi noma uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kumele athumele amagama abaphathi abathathu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze abheke ukufaneleka kokukhethwa ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7c yomthetho. Uma uNgqongqoshe engatholi amagama aphakanyisiwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlobo noma uma amagama aphakanyisiwe enganele njengoba kuchaziwe kulolu mema, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha inani elanele labantu abafanele ukukhethwa ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7 yomthetho noma acela ukuthi amagama engeziwe aphakanyiswe ukuze kufezwe le njongo. Umuntu ogama lakhe lifakwe ngaphansi kweMthethosisekelo 5 ukuze akhethwe ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7i yomthetho kumele abe esebenza ngempumelelo kulolu mkhakha okungenani iminyaka emihlanu ngaphambi kosuku angakhethwa njengelungu. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe kwiGovernment Gazette amagama abantu abakhululiwe njengamalungu eBhodi kanye nosuku abazoqala ngalo imisebenzi yabo njengamalungu eBhodi. Ngiyafunga ukuthi ngifuna ukwamukela isiphakamiso segama lami futhi ngiyazimisela ukserva kwiBhodi Yabaphathi Bezempilo Zendabuko uma uNgqongqoshe engikhetha kulendawo. Mina (igama eliphelele lomuntu ophakanyisiwe kanye nesikhundla sabo) ngiyafunga ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwe lapha luyiqiniso, futhi ukuthi kusemthethweni kuNgqongqoshe ukukhetha mina njengelungu leBhodi Yabaphathi Bezempilo Zendabuko.
Isaziso sikhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c), (e), (h) kanye (i) somthetho wezobungcweti bezempilo (Umthetho No. 35 ka-2004) ("okuzobizwa ngokuthi Umthetho"), sithi uNgqongqoshe wezempilo uyamema abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abazokhethwa njengamalungu weBhodi Yesikhashana Yezempilo (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "iBhodi"). Isigaba 7 somthetho sithi iBhodi izokwakhiwa ngamalungu angama-22 akhethwe nguNgqongqoshe. Isigaba h sesigaba 7 somthetho sithi abantu abathathu abamele umphakathi kufanele bakhethwe njengamalungu eBhodi; kuyilapho isigaba i sesigaba 7 sithi ummember oyedwa kufanele akhethwe emkhakheni wezempilo, okungukuthi: umthandazi, umphakathi wezokwelapha ngezinto zemvelo, kanye nodokotela. Umuntu okhethwe njengelungu leBhodi ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(c) kanye (i) zomthetho kufanele abe sebenza njengochwepheshe bezempilo okungenani iminyaka engu-5 emkhakheni wezempilo ofanele. Ukukhethwa kwabantu abazokhethwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c) somthetho kufanele kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma kumuntu oyiLungu leBhodi ophathelene nezempilo esifundeni lapho umphakathi usebenza khona, ngokukhethekile. Ukukhethwa kwabantu abazokhethwa ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(e), (h) kanye (i) zomthetho kufanele kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wezempilo. Ukukhethwa kufanele kuthunyelwe ngendlela echazwe emqulwini ohlangene ophathelene nokukhethwa kwamalungu eBhodi ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho.
UMphathiswa Wezempilo Nokuhamba Uhambo wenze imithetho ebekiwe kulolu hlu ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24 esifundwa nesigaba 44 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezemvelo Kwamazwe, 1998 (Umthetho No. 107 ka-1998). KuMemezelo Kahulumeni No. R. 386 kanye No. R. Uma ngokuhambisana nale mithetho izinsuku kufanele zibhalwe kusukela noma ngemuva kosuku oluthile kulandela usuku oluthile kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku lokugcina lesikhathi, kodwa uma usuku lokugcina lesikhathi luhlangana neMgqibelo, uSonto, noma usuku lokuphumula, leso sikhathi kufanele sandiswe kuze kube sekupheleni kosuku olulandelayo olungelona uMgqibelo, uSonto, noma usuku lokuphumula. Inhloso yale mithetho ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo nezindlela njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 5 seMthetho mayelana nokwethulwa, ukucutshungulwa, nezinqumo eziphathelene nezicelo zokuthola izimvume zemvelo nezindaba ezihlobene. Zonke izicelo ngaphansi kwale mithetho kufanele zinqunywe ngempela ngabasemthethweni abafanele. Abasemthethweni abafanele okufanele bacabangele futhi benze isinqumo ngesicelo mayelana nomsebenzi othile kufanele baphathwe ngokuhambisana noMemezelo Kahulumeni No. R. 386 kanye No. R. 387 ka-2006, kuhlanganise nezinye izimemezelo ezingase zikhishwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24D seMthetho. Noma yisiphi ukungqubuzana noma ukungavumelani mayelana nokuthi iyiphi imithombo efanele yokuhambisana nanoma yisiphi isicelo esithile kufanele ixazululwe nguMphathiswa kanye nomphathi wephalamende elihlobene noma nguMphathiswa kanye nelungu likamasipala elinikeziwe ukuphatha lokho, okukhona. Uma uMphathiswa engumthombo ofanele wesicelo esithile, isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kwiSikhungo Sezempilo Nokuhamba. Uma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene engumthombo ofanele, isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kwiSikhungo sephalamende esiphathelene nezindaba zemvelo kulolo phalamende. Uma uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene esebenzisile noma yiziphi amandla noma imisebenzi yomthombo ofanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 42 seMthetho mayelana nomsebenzi okukhulunywa ngawo esicelweni, kufanele ithunyelwe kumuntu ofanele kukamasipala ophumelele. Singase sihlinzeke umceli noma i-EAP ukufinyelela kunoma yiziphi iziqondiso nolwazi mayelana nezindlela ezibekiwe noma nolwazi olunikezwe umthombo ofanele oluhlobene nesicelo; noma b sicele umceli noma i-EAP, ngokubhala noma ngengxoxo, mayelana nohlobo nobubanzi bezindlela okufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezinhlinzeko zale mithetho. Lapho isicelo sokusebenza okudingayo izimvume zemvelo ngaphansi kwale mithetho kufanele senziwe ngokuhambisana neminye imithetho futhi le mthetho edinga ukuthi ulwazi kufanele luthunyelwe noma izinqubo kufanele zilandelwe njengokugcwele nolwazi noma izinqubo ezidingekayo ngaphansi kwale mithetho, uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene, ngokuhlinzeka ngesiqondiso sesi-3 seMthethosisekelo kanye nesigaba 24(g) seMthetho, kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokungena esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe nomthombo ophathelene nokuphathwa komthetho ophathelene nokulethwa kwezidingo zepolitiki nezimfuno zale mithetho ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindaphinda ekuwethuleni kwalolo lwazi noma ekwenzeni lezo zindlela. Umthombo ofanele kufanele uthole lonke ulwazi oluhambelana noma olungase luthinteke mayelana nanoma yisiphi isinqumo ngesicelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi lokho ulwazi lukhushelwe ngumthetho, umceli noma i-EAP noma noma yimuphi omunye umuntu onalo ulwazi, uma kuceliwe umthombo ofanele, kufanele aveze lokho ulwazi kumthombo ofanele, noma ngabe lokho ulwazi lubeka umceli endaweni ethokozisayo noma engathokozisi. viii noma yiziphi izimvo ezivela kulungu lukamasipala olunamandla alinganiselwe emthethweni mayelana nengxenye ethile yomsebenzi okukhulunywa ngawo esicelweni; kanye ix noma yiziphi iziqondiso ezihlobene nesicelo. Umthombo ofanele kufanele uzame ukuhlangabezana nezinsuku ezibekwe ezithile kubasomthetho abafanele ngaphansi kwale mithetho. Uma umthombo ofanele engumuntu lukamasipala ophatha amandla anikezwe kuwo kanye nemisebenzi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 42 noma 42A seMthetho futhi leli lungu likamasipala lingakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinsuku ezibekwe kule mithetho, leli lungu elinikeziwe kufanele libike uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene. b sihlinzeka umceli ngezizathu zesinqumo; futhi c sikwazisa umceli ngendawo yokuthi isinqumo singaphikiswa ngokuhambisana neSahluko 7 sale mithetho, uma leyo mfuneko yokuphikisa ikhona emkhakheni walolo suku. i mayelana nesinqumo ngesicelo; futhi ii mayelana nezizathu zesinqumo; futhi b sikwazisa ngendawo yokuthi isinqumo esenziwe singaphikiswa ngokuhambisana neSahluko 7 sale mithetho, uma leyo mfuneko yokuphikisa ikhona emkhakheni walolo suku. a sigcina irekhodi lezicelo zonke ezamukelwe umthombo ofanele ngaphansi kwale mithetho; futhi b sibhala zonke izinqumo eziphathelene nezimvume zemvelo. Umthombo ofanele akabhekiwe ngezindleko ezithintekayo ezikhokhelwe umceli ngokuhambisana nale mithetho. Isicelo sokuthola izimvume zemvelo zomsebenzi kufanele senziwe kumthombo ofanele okukhulunywa ngawo ngokuhambisana nomthetho 3. i kanye nesivumelwano esibhaliwe esiqondiswe kumthetho 161 noma ubufakazi bokuthi umthetho 163 ulandelwe, uma umceli engumuntu ongenayo indawo lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa; futhi ii imali yesicelo ebekiwe, uma kufanele. b sihlinzeke nganoma yimaphi imibiko, ezinye izincwadi, nezimali ezidingekayo ngaphansi kwale mithetho; futhi c sibe nolwazi nganoma yiziphi iziqondiso ezisebenzayo ekwethuleni izicelo. a sivuma ukuthi sithole isicelo, uma isicelo siqhubeka kahle, noma b sithi asivumi isicelo, uma singaqhubeki kahle. I-EAP ephethe isinqumo ingashintsha leso sicelo futhi isithumele kabusha kumthombo ofanele. Ukushintsha nokuthunyelwa kabusha kwesicelo eshintshiwe kufanele kuthunyelwe kumthombo ofanele ngokuhambisana nokushintsha. Uma umceli efuna ukwenza imisebenzi emibili noma ngaphezulu njengengxenye yephrojekthi efanayo, ifomu lesicelo elilodwa kufanele lithunyelwe kuyo yonke le misebenzi. Uma umceli efuna ukwenza imisebenzi engaphezu kweyodwa yohlobo olufanayo ezindaweni ezihlukene, izicelo ezihlukene kufanele zithunyelwe ezindaweni ezihlukene ngaphakathi kwephalamende efanayo, kodwa umthombo ofanele ungavuma ukuhlinzeka ngovumelelo ngokususelwa efomini elilodwa elibhaliwe elenziwe umceli, ukuze kube nesicelo esisodwa kuyo yonke le misebenzi, noma ngabe isicelo sithunyelwe efomini elilodwa noma kumafomu amaningi. Uma umthombo ofanele unika imvume ngokuhambisana nezinguquko 2, isicelo kufanele siphathwe njengokuhlanganyela kwenqubo kuyo yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nesicelo, kodwa umthelela wemvelo ongase ube khona walowo msebenzi kufanele ucabangele mayelana nendawo
Sawubona bafana, niyaphi? O, cha, thina siphinde siye ePolokwane! O, phuma. Le nkampani ibhadiwe, forget ukushintsha amagama ezindawo ngaphandle kwesizathu. Bafana! Ngalmost ngilahlekelwe ithuba lokuthola ukushayela ngenxa yalokho. Angikuthandi nhlobo. Leli zwe lidinga imali yokwakha izindlu nokulwa ne-HIV/AIDS, kodwa esikhundleni salokho, siphuma ezivakashi ezweni lethu. Asazi ukuthi siya kuphi! Bangobani laba bantu abashintsha amagama ezwe lethu? Vuka mfana, ukushintsha amagama akukhona nje ukuthola ukushayela ukuya endaweni ethile. Kuqondene nokunikeza igama elihle ezweni lethu, umlando wethu, kanye nesiko lethu. Singakuthuthukisa kanjani izwe lethu emphakathini wamazwe omhlaba uma sisasebenzisa amagama athathwe kwamanye amazwe? Sidinga ukuthuthukisa izwe lethu, sikhombise ubunikazi bethu bangempela. Sidinga ukwazisa umphakathi wamazwe omhlaba ukuthi singobani ngempela! Lokhu kushintshwa kwamagama ezindawo zomhlaba kuyindaba ebucayi kakhulu! Bheka lapha kulolu doc, uma usuwenze lokho, sizoxoxa ngalolu daba. Sikude lapho siya khona, ngakho sinesikhathi sokuxoxa ngakho. Ngamagama ezici zomhlaba ezisemthethweni, ezenziwe noma ezishintshwe abantu, zingase zibe nezakhamuzi noma zingabi nazo. I-SAGNC yasungulwa nguMthetho weSouth African Geographical Names Council (Umthetho No. 111 ka-1998) njengesisekelo sokubhekelela ukushintshwa kwamagama ezindawo zomhlaba eNingizimu Afrika. Yasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Nezamasiko. I-SAGNC ifaka ochwepheshe kumagama ezindawo, izilimi ezisemthethweni, umlando wesiko, ummeleli ovela kwiphondo ngalinye, abamele bonke amaprovinsi, kanye nabamele uMnyango Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Nezinguquko Zomhlaba, iPosi, iSouth African Languages Board, nezinye izikhungo ezihlobene. Isisekelo sokuphatha se-SAGNC sisebenza ngeKomidi Lezindawo Zomhlaba ZasePhondweni kanti izinga likamasipala lisebenza ngeKomidi Lezindawo Zasekhaya Nezasezindaweni. Kufanele ukwazi ukufinyelela lezi zakhiwo endaweni yakho. Ukuze kube lula, kuhlobene namagama ezici zomhlaba zezinye izinto ezweni. Ngamagama abhaliswe ngokomthetho. Isibonelo, igama lezwe, amagama amaprovinsi, namagama emiphakathi kanye nezinto eziphethwe ngamasipala ezifana nezindlela, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izikwele, amapaki, nezindela. Bese kuba nezakhiwo nezindawo eziphethwe ngabantu abazimele. Ngendlela efanayo, amagama ezici zomhlaba asetshenziselwa ukubhaliswa komhlaba aziwa njengezamaCadastral. Nokho, wonke amagama asemthethweni kumele ahambisane nemigomo yokubiza ye-SAGNC. Abantu bavame ukunikeza igama elilodwa ezindaweni ezahlukene noma amagama alingana noma afana kakhulu njengoba abhalwe kwenye indawo. Ezweni elinamagama amaningi njengeNingizimu Afrika, izindawo zivame ukuba namagama amaningi. Lezi zimo zikhokelela ekuqondeni okungalungile nasekudidekeni. Ukuze kugwenywe lokho, emhlabeni jikelele, amagama ezindawo alawulwa ngababusi. Kubalulekile ukuhlela amagama ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando nezimpawu zezwe ziyaqashelwa ngokwezwekazi nezohwebo, ukuthuthwa, ukuxhumana, ukuhlela izifunda nezemvelo, imisebenzi yomphakathi, isayensi nobuchwepheshe, ukhetho nezibalo, ezokuvakasha, ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezokuhlonza nokuhlenga. I-SAGNC yenze isinqumo sokugcina sokuthi amagama azophakanyiswa kuNgqongqoshe. Uma igama liqinisekiswe nguNgqongqoshe, lelo gama libonwa ngokofficial. Lishicilelwa kwiGazethi yoHulumeni ukuze libe semthethweni futhi limemezelwe. Ikhansela ihlangana kathathu ngonyaka. Ngoba ukuhamba kwesikhathi kuvame ukwenzeka ngenxa yolwazi olungaphelele noma olungalungile efomini yokufaka, abafakizicelo kufanele bazi ukuthi ukuvunywa kwegama kungaba yinqubo ende. Kumele kubhekwane nakho lapho kuhlelwa ukuthi isikhathi sokulinda singathatha okungenani ezinyangeni ezintathu futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe lapho kugcwaliswa ifomu ukuthi igcwaliswe kahle ukuze kugwenywe ukuhamba kwesikhathi okude. Noma ubani angathola ifomu lokufaka kwiwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko ku-www.dac.gov.za, emahhovisi kazwelonke, amaprovinsi, kanye namahhovisi endawo asebenza namagama ezindawo, noma ungafaka isicelo ku-www.sagns.gov.za. Ngaphambi kokugcwalisa ifomu lokufaka, kufanele ulifunde kahle futhi ugweme lokhu... Amagama abantu abaphilayo kufanele futhi agwenywe. Izici zomhlaba ezibizwa ngamagama abantu kufanele zihambisane nobungcweti balowo muntu. Ngokulula, kukhombisa okuthile okubucayi ngomuntu ophakeme ezweni lonke. Kulungile, ngiyaphendukela lapha. I-Polokwane ikhulu elingu-15 phambili. Jabulela ukuvakashela kwakho! Ngiyabonga ngokusipha uhambo. Impela, ngiyabonga, uhamba ngokuphumelelayo.
Inkululeko isitholile, manje sekuyisikhathi sokuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babe nesandla ekuguquleni izwe lethu libe yilokho esilwe ngakho. Okokuqala emlandweni wethu nasezweni lethu, abantu bethu banikezwe ithuba lokuba nezwi ekubizeni izindawo. Ngale ndlela, kumele sikhombise ukuthi izinto zishintshile, ukuthi sesidlule esikhathini sokwahlukaniswa. Kumele sishintshe umfanekiso wezwe lethu ukuze ungaveli njengengxenye yeYurophu kodwa njengaseAfrika. Kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezizoholela ekushintsheni lezo ziqu ezaziyisikhumbuzo nezihlambalazayo, amagama ezizwe atholakala kwamanye amazwe kanye nalawo abhalwe ngendlela engalungile. Lokhu kuyimfanelo eqondiswe kuNgqongqoshe wethu Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye neTekhnoloji ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka ngempela. Kuyimfanelo yethu njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kwenzeka. Impumelelo yalesi sizathu izoba uphawu lokuguqulwa kweqiniso ezweni lethu elisebuhlungu bokushintsha. INingizimu Afrika inohulumeni obumbene futhi kufanele ibonise le shintsho kubantu abavotele yona nakwabanye abaseduze kwayo. Kumele isebenze ngokushesha njengamazwe asendaweni angakazisa le mizwa ngokususa konke okukhumbuza ngeminyaka yokucindezelwa nokwahlukaniswa. Bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezinhlangano ezikhona zikulungele ukufaka iziphakamiso zisebenzisa amafomu atholakala ehhovisi elikhulu, iGeographical Names Unit, esekela uMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye neTekhnoloji, P/Bag X894, Pretoria, 0001. Kulezi zifomu, abantu banelungelo lokuphakamisa amagama amasha kanye nezinguquko kumagama akhona, uma iziphakamiso zilandela nezizathu. Le mibiko ilungiswe kusukela ngesikhathi sokwakhiwa kweBhodi kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka wokuqala wokwabiwa kwemali. Ukuxhaswa kwemisebenzi ehhovisi leBhodi kuvela kuMnyango Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye neTekhnoloji (DACTS). Ekuqaleni, bekuphansi kweBhodi Yezilimi Yezwe yalolu Mnyango. Ngemva kwesikhathi, kudluliselwe kwiBhodi Yezifundo Zomlando yalolu Mnyango. Izinqumo zeBhodi ziqinisekiswa futhi ziqinisekiswa nguNgqongqoshe. Abantu nezinhlangano ezingahambisani nezinqumo ezenziwe yiBhodi bangase babhekane nezinyathelo zomthetho. UNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko, Isiko, Isayensi kanye neTekhnoloji wamukela iziphakamiso zokunikezwa kwabantu abalandelayo, abakhethwe yiKomidi Lokukhetha. Abanikezwayo bazosebenza kwiBhodi Yezwe Yezindawo Zokubiza. Ibhodi ithathe indawo yeKomidi Lezindawo Zokubiza elaleluleka uhulumeni ngokuqinisekiswa kwamanye amagama ezindawo kusukela ngo-1940. Omunye umehluko obalulekile phakathi kweBhodi kanye nomnyango owasebenza esikhathini esedlule ukuthi le Bhodi inikezwe amandla amaningi ukuze ibhekane nazo zonke izinhlobo zezindawo kuhlanganise; ukufuna lezo zindawo ezidinga ukubizwa kabusha noma ukubizwa okokuqala futhi ukuthi izinqumo zayo zizoba namandla, uma ziqashelwa nguNgqongqoshe. Ibhodi isungule umgomo nezindlela, kulandela izinqumo nezindlela zeZizwe Ezihlangene. Ibhodi inegunya phezu kwazo zonke izindawo zokubiza nezinto kanye nezakhiwo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeNingizimu Afrika nasezindaweni lapho leli zwe lilawula, noma lezo zindawo ezitholakala ngokuqhubekayo. Ezinye izizathu ezisemthethweni zingatholakala namagama abantu abaphilayo. Ukunquma igama noma amagama endaweni kudinga ukuqhathaniswa ngokucophelela phakathi komlando nesidingo solimi, ukuhamba kalula kokuxhumana, umphakathi kanye nenhloso kazwelonke. Ukukhuthaza ulwazi mayelana nezinzuzo zomnotho kanye nokuhlangana komphakathi ngenxa yokufana kwamagama ezindawo. Ukuze kuvezwe isu lokususa, ezinye izindawo ezabizwa ngaphansi kokucindezelwa kufanele zifakwe. Ukuze kube lula, ukusabalalisa ulwazi nokudlulisa ulwazi ngohlelo oluhlelwe kahle lapho amagama ezindawo akhiwa, angashicilelwa ezincwadini noma ngombiko wekhompyutha. Ukusungula amaKomidi ezindawo zendawo (PGNC's), ngaphansi komthetho weMthetho Wamagama Ezindawo ZaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemithetho ephathelene nokufana kwamagama ezindawo. Ibhodi ikhethile amaKomidi amancane alandelayo. Ngaphezu kwalabo abakhethwe ekuqaleni, kukhona abanye kanye namalungu angasetshenziswa ngezikhathi ezithile. Umsebenzi wayo ukuhola nokwakha ukufana ekubizeni izindawo: ukuhlola amagama amaningi; lawo asevele ekhona kodwa engamukelekile ngokomthetho, nezinye izindaba ezihlobene ezingenziwa yiBhodi. Iphakanyiswa ukuba iqoqe uhlelo lokwakha nokugcina ulwazi nolwazi; ukuqoqa ulwazi; ukunquma isu lokuvuselela ulwazi, njalo ugcine lukhona; ukuxhumana nezinye izikhungo ezigcina ulwazi; nokunquma izidingo zabathengi belabhulali. Umsebenzi wayo: ukusungula isisekelo sokubamba iqhaza; ukuhlela izifundo zokufundisa nezokuvuselela abafundi; ukuqopha imibhalo yokuqeqesha nokwakha ithimba ezingeni lesizwe nasezindaweni. Emhlanganweni obubanjwe ngomhla ka-7 kuApril 2000, kwanqunywa ukusungulwa kwekomidi lokuxhumana nemidiya, ukusabalalisa, kanye nokwazisa umphakathi. Isizathu salokhu ukuhlela nokwabelana ngempilo phakathi kwalezi zinkampani. Ekuqaleni kuka-2001, kwasungulwa ikomidi elincane elisha ngenhloso elandelayo, futhi uNkk. Dichabe wakhethwa njengomphakathi wayo. Ukuze usebenze kuhlelo lwecebo leBhodi; ukuhamba emcimbini wokwethulwa kosuku lwamagama ezindawo zikaZwelonke; ukuthola imikhakha nezixhumanisi zokuxhumana nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi kanye namathimba akhethiwe. Ukuze uqophe ikhodi yokuziphatha; ukukhuthaza indlela iBhodi ibambisana ngayo nezinye izikhungo, ezingeni lesifunda nezokuphathwa; ukuhlola imithetho nezindlela eziphathelene nokufana kokubiza izindawo. Lokhu kuyidokhumenti eyisisekelo neyokuqala echaza indlela nezinto iBhodi ehlose ukuzenza. Iphatha izinto ezifana nenhloso yokusungula iBhodi, lokho ikhokhelwe ukukwenza, imisebenzi elindelekile, indawo yegunya, izinqubo nemigomo, uhlelo olukhulu lwecebo leBhodi, kanye nokwabiwa kwemali. Ngokwemthetho, enye yemisebenzi yeBhodi ukukhuthaza ukusungulwa kwamakomidi ezindawo zendawo. Lezi zinkampani kufanele zisungulwe nguMnyango Wesifunda ophathelene Nezobuciko kanye Nezamasiko, ngemva kokubonisana neBhodi. Ibhodi ibhalile uhlu lwezikhombisi eziphathelene nalezi zinkampani. Lezi zikhombisi ziveza izakhiwo eziphakanyisiwe futhi zinikeze isibonelo sokuthi ungakha kanjani ukuhlanganiswa kwamalungu, iziphakamiso zemisebenzi yamalungu nezilindelo, kanye neziphakamiso zokwakha amakomidi ezindawo zendawo ezizoxhaswa ngabasebenzi bamakomidi. Lezi zikhombisi zizophatha umsebenzi weBhodi ngokuhlola amagama alindelekile nalawo angakakhethwa yiBhodi. Emhlanganweni ngamunye, iBhodi ihlaziya uhlu lw
Ekusungulweni kwe-NER (Umphakathi Wezokukhanyisa Kazwelonke) ngoMashi 1995, i-NER yazibophezela ekwenzeni izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emkhakheni wezokukhanyisa (ESI). Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo laqokwa futhi lavunywa nguMlawuli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abahlinzeki bokukhanyisa baqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bathola izinga elamukelekayo lezinsizakalo. Omunye umsebenzi okwamanje owenziwa yi-NER ukuhloleka iminikelo yabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa ngokubabheka ngezinga elibekwe. Umphakathi uphinde uqaphele ukuthi abathengi banendima okufanele bayidlale ohlelweni lokulawula. Kukholwa ukuthi uma abathengi beqonda izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo elikhona, bazokwazi ukuphikisa abahlinzeki bokukhanyisa futhi babe nezwi ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngakho-ke, abathengi kufanele bazi ngezinga lezinsizakalo abaneleyo. Kuze kube manje, i-NER isungule idokhumenti elula ukuyifunda futhi eyamukelekayo kubathengi. Le dokhumenti isekelwe kulokho okukhona ngaphandle kokushintsha umqondo wayo. Umphakathi Wezokukhanyisa Kazwelonke (NER) usuku olude uqaphele isidingo sokusungula izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emkhakheni wezokukhanyisa; izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zagesi lingalindelwa ngabathengi bempahla ehlukene yokusetshenziswa kagesi kanye nezinga okufanele lihlangabezane nalo ngabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa. Abahlinzeki bokukhanyisa kufanele babike ku-NER ngezinga labo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinga elibekwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bayagcina izinga. Le bhukwana ihlose ukwazisa abathengi abakhokhayo ngezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo abangalindela kubahlinzeki bokukhanyisa futhi inikeze abathengi ukuqonda okungcono kwekholomu ye-NRS 047 ngendlela ethinta ngayo. Ukulinganiswa kukagesi okwenziwayo kuvumela abathengi ithuba lokuthenga ugesi ngamanani abawakwazi ukukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi abangahlangabezani nezikweletu zabo zagesi ekupheleni kwenyanga bangase baphumelele ukukhokha. Le bhukwana iphinde ichaze izindlela ezitholakalayo kubathengi lapho kuvela izingxabano phakathi kwabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa nabo mayelana nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER ilindele ukuthi abathengi nabahlinzeki abafanele bazame ukusombulula izingxabano zabo ngaphambi kokufaka isikhalazo ku-NER. Ngokuvamile, i-NER ngeke ingenelele ngaphandle kokuthi le ngxabano ingaxazululwa ezingeni lendawo. Imithetho ethile ivame ukusetshenziswa emkhakheni wezokukhanyisa, futhi kubalulekile kubathengi bokukhanyisa ukuba bazi ngemisho yale mithetho. Ukuhlukaniswa kukagesi okuhleliwe: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi okuhleliwe okwenziwa ngabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa ngesikhathi besebenza. Ukuhlukaniswa kukagesi okwenziwe ngenkani: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi okwenziwa ngenxa yokuphazamiseka okuthile emigqeni kagesi noma ngenxa yokuphazamiseka kwezinsiza kagesi. Imigqa kagesi yasemakhaya: imigqa kagesi ehlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezikude, ezifana nemiphakathi yasemakhaya namafamu, avame ukungabi nezinsiza ezinhle ezifana nezindlela. Imigqa kagesi yasemadolobheni: imigqa kagesi ehlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezinamakhaya amaningi ezivame ukuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi okwesikhashana: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kumthengi ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kungase kungahambisani nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo elibekwe. Ugesi ophansi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekuhlinzekeni abathengi bezindlu noma amabhizinisi amancane. Ugesi ophakathi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekuhlinzekeni ugesi nasekuhlinzekeni imboni noma abathengi abangathengisi. I-voucher yagesi: Lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokukhokha (ithikithi) esitholakala ngemuva kokukhokha ugesi futhi sivumela umthengi ukuthi asebenzise inani elithile legesi. Isebenza ngokulayishwa kumitha yagesi ekhokhelwayo. Umitha yagesi ekhokhelwayo: idivayisi yokulinganisa ugesi ekhokhelwayo. Izilinganiso ezahlukene zagesi ezithengwe zifakwa kulomitha. Isikhungo sokuhweba nokuqasha ugesi: Umshini oxhunywe ezindaweni zebhizinisi osetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amanani kagesi athengwe ngababhalisile bagesi ekhokhelwayo. Izinga Lokuhlinzekwa Kagesi: izinga elilindelekile lokuhlinzekwa kagesi, njengamandla kagesi, ukuhlinzekwa, ukwehla, nokwenyuka kwamandla, njll., njengoba kuchazwe kuSigaba 2 se-NRS 048. Ikhredithi/Abathengi abasebenzisa ama-voucher kagesi ekhokhelwayo: laba ngabathengi abasebenzisa ugesi ngekhredithi futhi umhlinzeki kagesi uza ukufunda inani legesi elisetshenzisiwe. Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo elichazwe ngaphansi kwe-NRS 047 kuSigaba 1 yilezo ezincane okungenani umhlinzeki kagesi okufanele azame ukuzihlangabezana nazo, kodwa abahlinzeki bokukhanyisa bencitshwa ukuba bedlule ezingeni elincane elibekwe. Ezimweni lapho umhlinzeki kagesi ehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezinga elilindelekile ngenxa yezizathu ezingaphansi kokulawula kwabo, ngeke babhekiswe icala lokuhluleka ukusebenza ezingeni elibekwe. Lezi zimo zifaka phakathi izenzo zempi, ubugebengu nokuhlukumeza, iziteleka zezimboni, izingozi zemoto, nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Lezi zimo ezishiwo ngenhla aziphelele kodwa ziqondwa njengemibono yokuthi kufanele kube nenqubo ethile. Uma kwenzeka ingxabano nomthengi mayelana nezinga lokuhlinzeka okukhuluma ngalo, umthwalo wemfanelo uphakathi komhlinzeki kagesi ukuzama ukusombulula le nkinga ekhona ngama ndlela afanele zokubonisana. Ngale ndlela, uma isikhalazo sesifakiwe, umhlinzeki kagesi kufanele azise inkantolo, isikhathi, nendawo lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukuzama ukusombulula udaba. Kufanele kuqokonyiswe ukuthi i-NER izongena kuphela uma izingxoxo zokuxazulula zihluleka. Kubalulekile kubathengi ukulandela imithetho ebekwe ngabahlinzeki bokukhanyisa, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, ukuqedela yonke imibhalo edingekayo, nokukhokha zonke izindleko ezibekiwe. Uma ingxabano ivela mayelana nezinga lezinsizakalo, ngokwesibonelo, ukunemba komitha ekhokhelwayo yomthengi, kubalulekile kumthengi ukukhokha imali ebekiwe ngaphambi kokuba udaba luhlolwe. Le mali izobuyiselwa uma kutholakala ukuthi ukunemba kokufundwa komitha akulungile. Umthengi kufanele aqale ngokunikeza umhlinzeki kagesi ithuba lokuxazulula noma iyiphi inkinga. Kufanele baphakamise udaba ku-NER uma bengahlangabezani nesivumelwano. Izinsuku eziyishumi uma imigqa ekhona ingasetshenziswa noma ikhebuli exhuma kunethiwekhi yangaphakathi engadini. Izinyanga eziyodwa uma ugesi ophansi udingeka (amandla kagesi ahlinzeka ngezindlu zokuhlala namabhizinisi amancane) noma
Kubhalwe kahle ukukhokha izindleko zakho zikagesi. Ukwenza njalo kuqinisekisa ukuthi awuphuthumi. Njengoba kuvamile, amakhasimende akhokha ingxenye yebhili elibhalwe ukuthi kufanele likhokhe ngoba acabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzovimbela ugesi wabo ekusikeni. Uma ingxenye oyiphuthumayo ingakhokhwa ngenyanga ezayo, umthwalo wakho uzokhula kakhulu futhi ungase ungakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Qaphela ukuthi ukukhokha njalo kuphela izingxenye zenani okufanele ukhokhe kungaholela ekusikeni kukagesi wakho. Uma ubona ukuthi uphuthumile kakhulu emthwalweni wakho, xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ukuze uxoxe ngendlela yokulungisa isimo. Kuzokwenziwa izintshisakalo kulokho okukhokhwayo uma umthengi engakhokhi ngokuphelele noma ekhokha ngezindleko ezincane noma ekhokha ngemva kosuku lokugcina. Lesi simo sokungakhokhi kahle kuholela ekwandeni kwenani elikhokhwayo njalo ngenyanga. Uma usayine isivumelwano sokukhokha nomhlinzeki wakho kukagesi, gcina leso sivumelwano. Uma wehluleka, ugesi wakho uzosikwe. Kodwa uma isimo sakho siba sibi kakhulu ngemuva kokusayina isivumelwano, kufanele uqinisekise umhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ngokushesha. Ungase udinge ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi besimo sakho esishintshile. Uma unemitha yokukhokha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, qaphela ngenani likagesi olisebenzisayo. Kuwo wonke umbhalo, kufanele kube nenani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga kanye nenani lokuvala ekupheleni kwenyanga. Lokhu kukunika ithuba lokwazi inani eliphelele olisebenzisile le nyanga. Kufanele uhlole ukuthi inani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga lihambisana nenani lokuvala elivela enyangeni edlule. Uma lezi zilinganiso zingahambisani, funa ukucaciselwa kumhlinzeki wakho kukagesi. Ngezinye izikhathi, labo abafunda imitha kagesi benza amaphutha. Qaphela ngenani lenyanga ngayinye. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi umhlinzeki wakho kukagesi kufanele akukhokhise malini ngeyunithi (Kwh) yegesi oyisebenzisayo. Uma ungazi, kufanele ubuze umhlinzeki wakho kukagesi noma iNational Energy Regulator. Ukuze uqonde ukuthi ubhajwe kanjani le nyanga, udinga ukuthatha inani eliphelele okufanele ukhokhe (ngemali) bese ulibala ngenani likagesi olisebenzisile le nyanga. Umphumela uzoba yintengo ngeyunithi (I-unit). Uma unenketho yokukhetha, ungashintsha uhlelo olusebenzisa ikhadi lapho uthenga khona inani elithile likagesi. Khumbula ukuthi uzokhokhwa imali yokusetha leli hlelo. Intengo yalezi zinguquko iyahluka ngenani likagesi elisetshenzisiwe. Ulwazi lokulawula inani likagesi elisetshenzisiwe. Uma umthwalo wakho uphuthumile, ungase udinge ukukhokha le ngxenye ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokushintsha kuhlelo lwekhadi. Izinzuzo zalesi sitembu esichazwe ngenhla zikhuluma kakhulu kunobunzima bokuqala obumele ubhekane nabo ngaphambi kokushintsha (njengemali yokuqala okufanele uyikhokhe). Thola kumhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ukuthi yiziphi izimo nemigomo abahamba ngayo. Ngokuvamile, abanye abahlinzeki bakagesi badinga amakhasimende ukuthi asayine isivumelwano sokukhokha umthwalo wabo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngokucophelela kuzokusiza unciphise ukusetshenziswa kwakho nezindleko zanyanga. Ungakwenza kanjani lokhu? Izitofu, izifudumezi zamanzi (gizmos), kanye nezifudumezi (radiators) yizona ezisebenzisa ugesi kakhulu futhi zandisa ibhili lakho likagesi. Uma unesi fudumezi samanzi, qiniseka ukuthi i-thermostat ayibekwe phezulu. Ungabeka i-thermostat cishe kuma-60 degrees. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ukuze uthole izeluleko ngalokhu. Ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi esifudumezini samanzi: uma unamandla, unganciphisa izinga likagesi eliya esifudumezini samanzi, futhi lokhu kungaphinde kwenziwe emaphuzini aphatha amanzi. Le ndlela inciphisa kakhulu izindleko zikagesi kodwa ifika nemali ethile uma ufuna ukuyisebenzisa. Isitofu: qiniseka ukuthi awuvuli zonke izitofu ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izeluleko zithi unciphise ukushisa ephepheni uma ipani lakho liqala ukuvutha. Ungasebenzisi i-oveni njengendlela yokufudumeza ngoba i-oveni isebenzisa ugesi omningi. Izifudumezi: izifudumezi zikagesi zisebenzisa ugesi omningi. Uma unesi fudumezi sikagesi, kunconywa ukuthi uvule kuphela isifudumezi esisodwa. Kodwa uzokuqonda ukuthi lokhu kuzokwandisa isikhathi ngaphambi kokuthi indlu yakho ifudumale. Ukuvala amawindi: enye indlela yokunciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa ukuvala amawindi endlini yakho. Ukukhanyisa: ilambu elivaliwe elinengilazi linikeza ukukhanya okuningi ngenkathi lisebenzisa ugesi omncane. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kukagesi ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi. Yini umthetho okukhuluma ngayo mayelana nokusikwe kukagesi? Umthetho ohlaziywe weMithetho Yezokukhanyisa ka-1987 unikeza umhlinzeki kukagesi igunya lokusika uma ibhili ingakhokhiwe noma uma umthengi engahambisani nezimo zokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Nokho, umthetho ufuneka ukuthi umhlinzeki kukagesi unikeze umthengi isaziso sezinsuku eziyi-14 ngaphambi kokusika ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Le nkathi iqala ngosuku olubhalwe encwadini. Isaziso embhalweni wanyanga nanyanga siphinde samukelwe. Amakhasimende acelwa ukuba ahlole umbhalo embhalweni. Khumbula ukuthi umuntu wokuqala okufanele ukhalaze kuye umhlinzeki wakho wendawo. Umthengi unelungelo lokufaka isikhalazo mayelana nezinga lenkonzo elinikezwa umhlinzeki wendawo. Umhlinzeki wendawo unecala lokulalela nokubhekana nesikhalazo. Uma wena njengomthengi unganelisekile ngemiphumela noma ngendlela isikhalazo sakho esiphathwe ngayo, udaba lungathunyelwa kwiNational Energy Regulator (NER) ukuze lutholakale isixazululo.
Ingxenye -14 yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ibeka ukuthi, phakathi kokunye, ilungu lomphakathi kumele libhale incwadi ethile enhlangano yomphakathi abakhona kuyo ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kusukela ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi. Le mfuneko ihlale iphansi kwemvume yokwandiswa kwesikhathi evela kuNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo ngenhloso yokuhlanganisa nokushicilela le ncwadi kwiGazethi yoHulumeni. Ukushicilelwa kwale ncwadi kwiGazethi esemthethweni kunika amandla iziphakamiso ezitholakala kuNgxenye -14 kanye nokunika umuntu ilungelo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe yinhla yomphakathi efanele ukuze kufezwe noma kuvikelwe noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zabo. I-ICD iyingxenye yenhlangano ngaphansi komkhakha kaHulumeni. I-ICD iyisigaba sikaHulumeni sesifunda futhi ihlelwe ezingeni lesizwe nasezindaweni. Ezingeni lesizwe, umphakathi wayo nguMphathi Osebenzayo bese kuba noMphathi Wesifunda ezingeni lesifunda. Abaphathi bezifunda ze-ICD bathumela imibiko futhi baphathwa nguMphathi Osebenzayo. UMphathi Osebenzayo uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho kulandela inqubo ethile eyenziwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokuxhumana neKomidi Lezomthetho. Ingxenye ethile yabasebenzi be-ICD yakhiwe ngamalungu aqokwe nguMphathi Osebenzayo ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho. Lokhu kwenzeka kulandela imithetho ephethe isevisi yomphakathi kanye nabantu abathile abathunyelwa kwezinye izigaba ngenhloso yokusiza noma ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwi-ICD. Umsebenzi oqala ngalokho okuchazwe umthetho (ngokwezimfuneko zeMthetho Wesevisi Yezepolitiki yaseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho No. 68 ka-1965) we-ICD ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokuziphatha okungafanele nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe amalungu eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) kanye neMuni Police Service (MPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangokprofessional. Lapha umthetho ubona kahle ukuthi uhlose ukunikeza i-ICD umthwalo nomsebenzi wokubheka umphakathi mayelana ne-SAPS njengoba kuchaziwe kuNgxenye -222 yeMthethosisekelo Wokushintsha ka-1993. Le ngxenye ibeka ukuthi "Kuzoba khona indlela ezimele, eyakhelwe futhi ephethwe ngokuqondile nguMthetho Wezomthetho ehlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhalazo ezihlobene nokuziphatha okungafanele nokuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okukhuluma ngamalungu eNingizimu Afrika Police Service (SAPS) zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangokprofessional." a ngokuthanda kwabo noma ngemva kokuthola isikhalazo, bahlola noma yisiphi isenzo esingafanele noma ukuziphatha okungekho emthethweni okwenziwe yilungu leNingizimu Afrika Police Service noma i-MPS. c bangahlola noma iyiphi indaba eyayiqondiswe kubo nguNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho noma ngaphakathi komkhandlu wesifunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma ngenhla, imisebenzi nemithwalo ye-ICD yanda kakhulu ngokuqhubeka kweMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwezakhamizi (DVA), ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 112 ka-1998). Lo mthetho uveza ukuthi uma ilungu leNingizimu Afrika Police Service lingahambisani nemithwalo echazwe kuMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwezakhamizi (DVA) noma iMiyalo Yezwe ekhishwe ngokomthetho (DVA), le nqubo ibhekwa njengokuziphatha okungafanele ngokokuchazwa kweMthetho we-SAPS. Ngakho-ke, i-ICD kumele ibhiyozwe ngalokhu okungahambi kahle okubikwe kwi-SAPS. Ukuqonda okuqondile kwalokhu kuhlelwe ukuthi i-ICD kumele isebenzise amandla nemisebenzi yayo ukuze ibheke umphakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zinsolo zokuziphatha okungafanele zihlolwa ngendlela efanele nangokprofessional yi-SAPS. I-DVA iphinde ibeke ukuthi i-SAPS kumele ithathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene naliphi ilungu le-SAPS elisoliswa ngokungahambisani nemithwalo ephethwe yi-DVA, ngaphandle uma i-ICD inquma okuphambene ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Ukuchaza kwalokhu kuhlelwe ukuthi i-ICD kumele ithathe umsebenzi owengeziwe ukuze iphumeze izikhalazo ezicela ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokulungisa ngokumelene namalungu e-SAPS. Ngokwenza lokhu, i-ICD iqhuba umsebenzi wokwenza ukuthi izinyathelo zokulungisa zingagwenywa yi-SAPS ezimweni lapho kubalulekile ukuthatha lezo zinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa. a I-ICD ayingxenye futhi ayihlangene noMnyango WezeMthetho, ihlale izimele, icacile ingxenye yenhlangano yesikhungo somphakathi nakuba ixhunyiwe kumNgqongqoshe oyedwa - uNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho - kanye ne-SAPS. b I-ICD inendawo yayo yokubalwa kwezimali evela kuMphathi Osebenzayo kanye nebajethi yonyaka ehambisana nayo. Le bajethi inefund ehlukile ehlukaniswe nguMthetho. Abasebenzi be-ICD bachaza futhi bahlanganisa bonke abaphethe isikhundla esichazwe ngenhla. Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi agcinwe yi-ICD kumele senziwe ngokubhalwe phansi lapho umfaki-sicelo egcwalisa Ifomu A, eyaziwa ngokuthi: "Isicelo Sokufinyelela Kumarekhodi Ezinhlangano Zomphakathi." a ehhovisi leMenenja Yolwazi enemininingwane yokuxhumana echazwe kuNgxenye 2.2 ngenhla; noma b ehhovisi le-ICD lesifunda elichazwe kuNgxenye 1.1 yale ncwadi. f Uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye, ubufakazi bokuthunyelwa komfaki-sicelo kumele bukhishwe ngendlela ejabulisa iMenenja Yolwazi. a Thumela noma udlulisele isicelo esibhaliwe kwiMenenja Yolwazi njengoba kuchaziwe kuNgxenye -2.2 yale ncwadi. Isicelo kumele sithunyelwe kule ndawo yeMenenja Yolwazi noma kunombolo ye-fax, noma ngabe ngqo kwi-imeyili; noma b Thumela isicelo ngqo ehhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze nemininingwane echazwe kuNgxenye -1.1 yale ncwadi. Kulokhu, ihhovisi le-ICD lesifunda eliseduze lizohlinzeka umfaki-sicelo ngerekhodi eqinisekisa ukuthi isicelo sitholiwe. Noma ubani ofuna ukufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD njengoba kuchaziwe kuNgxenye -4.1.2 kanye -4.1.2 yale ncwadi kodwa engakwazi ukwenza kanjalo ngenxa yokungafundi noma ukungasebenzi, unelungelo lokwenza isicelo somlomo. a KuMenenja Yolwazi okhethwe; noma b KuMphathi Wesifunda noma ehhovisi lesifunda elikhethiwe lapho isicelo somlomo senziwa. I-Menenja Yolwazi izobhala isicelo somlomo futhi inikeze umfaki-sicelo kopi yalolo suku. Uma umfaki-sicelo efika kuMphathi Wesifunda okukhulunywe ngaye kuNgxenye -4.1.4(b) yale ncwadi, uMphathi Wesifunda ofanele uzobhala isicelo somlomo futhi anikeze umfaki-sicelo kopi yalolo suku. Uma umfaki-sicelo ezisa iMenenja Yolwazi noma uMphathi Wesifunda/umsebenzi okhethiwe ngenhloso yokufaka isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi e-ICD, le Menenja Yolwazi izohlinzeka ngaleyo
Ukuhlinzekwa kolwazi lwemvelo kwezomnotho. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinye izinhlelo zolwazi, isibonelo, ulwazi lwemvelo lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nezobuchwepheshe eziphilayo zamanje emikhakheni yezokwelapha nezinye izindawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga leziqhamo ezintsha. I-National IKS Fund isebenza njengomphakathi wezimpahla zokuqonda lapho kufanelekile, futhi futhi njengomxhumanisi nomhlinzeki wezinsiza zomthetho ezidingekayo zokugcina zomphakathi wemvelo nezinye izithakazelo ezibambe ulwazi. Uhulumeni weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika uzibophezele ekwaziseni, ekukhuthazeni, ekuthuthukiseni, ekuvikeleni, nasekuqinisekiseni i-IKS. Le nhlinzeko iyimiphumela yokuxoxisana okuningi, ucwaningo, ingxoxo, nokubamba iqhaza kwabathintekayo abaningi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwabachwepheshe nabaphathi boLwazi Lwemvelo (IK) kubalulekile. Lokhu kuqhutshwa yizimiso ezivamile zezimfanelo zomuntu futhi kufaka imibono ebalulekile yase-Afrika efana ne-ubuntu kanye ne-batho-pele. Le miphumela ifaka phakathi ukulwa nokucwaswa futhi kufanele iqhubeke ikhuthaza inkululeko ngezinhlelo zolwazi ezivela ekwakheni amandla nasekufihleni. Izinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo ezakhiwe nezibhekelelwe abantu bendabuko eNingizimu Afrika zibonisa izinhlelo zezempilo nezokukholelwa kwengxenye enkulu yomphakathi. Lokhu kulwazi lwemvelo kubonakala ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene kusukela emicimbini yamasiko nezokukholelwa kuya ezindleleni zokulima nasezinyathelweni zezempilo. "Ulwazi lwemvelo" (IK) lusetshenziswa ngendlela efanayo "nolwazi lwamasiko" kanye "nolwazi bendawo" ukuze kuhlukaniswe phakathi kokuthuthukiswa kolwazi nezindawo ezibukekayo zomphakathi wemvelo ezivela ezinhlelweni zolwazi "zamazwe omhlaba" ezivela ezikhungweni zemfundo, ezikhungweni zocwaningo lukahulumeni, kanye nezimboni ezizimele, kwesinye isikhathi ezibizwa ngokungafanele "izinhlelo zolwazi zaseNtshonalanga." Ngaphansi kokucwaswa, Izinhlelo zolwazi (IKS) eNingizimu Afrika kanye nezobuchwepheshe ngaphakathi kwezinhlelo ezinjalo zikhawulelwe futhi zihlukaniswe. Lokhu kunomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni komnotho nasemphakathini eNingizimu Afrika, kunomphumela opholile ekuthuthukiseni komphakathi, kwezamasiko, nakwezomnotho kubantu bayo abaningi. Ukuhlolwa ngakunye kwezinga lezenhlalo nezomnotho nezinkomba zezempilo kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bendabuko bakwi sikhala esinzima. Izinselelo ababhekana nazo zinezinga lokukhulisa futhi ziqhubeke ziqinisa ukungalingani phakathi kwabantu bendabuko nezinye izingxenye zomphakathi eminyakeni ezayo ngaphandle kokuthi kube nemizamo emikhulu manje yokubhekana nokungalingani okuqhubekayo, okungafinyelelwa ngaphandle kokuhlonipha izinhlelo zolwazi zomphakathi wemvelo kanye nolwazi lwamasiko olucacile phakathi kwazo, njengemikhakha yezinyanga zendabuko nolwazi lwamasiko olubanjwe ngabesifazane emphakathini. Ukuhlanganisa nokugubha imibono yase-Afrika ezinhlelweni zolwazi eNingizimu Afrika akukhona nje udaba lokulungisa. Kungasiza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo zokucwaninga ezintsha nezakhiwo zemibono, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi lwamanje. Ukusungulwa kweminyaka eyinkulungwane yokucindezelwa, ekhona emnothweni we-IK ongaphikiswa, kukhuphukile phakathi kwemiphakathi kanye nezakhamuzi. Iningi le-IK liqhubekile liqinisekisa ubukhona bayo futhi liqhubekile lihlinzeka ngolwazi emicabangweni yase-Afrika mayelana nezindaba ezifana nobuciko, umculo, ukholo, nemfundo, ubuholi, ubulungiswa, impilo, nokulima. Ukuzazi nokuhlonipha isiko, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlomula, kuqhubekile kukhulu futhi kuqinisiwe ngokubhekisiswa okuqhubekayo kwabaphethe i-IK, ngaphandle kokuthi indawo ngayinye ibe yük yokuhlupheka kwezokuxhumana nezombusazwe kanye nezinkumbulo zokucindezelwa nokucwaswa. Ngokuvamile, abesifazane bangama-vanguard walezi zinhlelo zolwazi. Impumelelo yedemokhrasi ngaphezu kwezinselelo zokucwaswa idinga ukuba sakhe isakhiwo sikazwelonke sokuthuthukiswa okuphumelelayo kwezinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo. Lesi sakhiwo esivumela sizokwenza ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ngokuphelele amandla abo emphakathini futhi bakhe ibhlogo eliyisisekelo lokufeza zonke izinhloso nezifiso zikazwelonke ngempumelelo. Ukusebenzisa ezinye izinhlelo zolwazi, isibonelo, ulwazi lwemvelo lusetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela nezobuchwepheshe eziphilayo zamanje emikhakheni yezokwelapha nezinye izindawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga leziqhamo ezintsha. Le nhlinzeko ifaka phakathi iminyango ehlukahlukene kaHulumeni ehlotshaniswa nezibopho ezinomthelela ukuze kuhanjiswe izethulo eziphumelelayo ezinqubomgomeni nasezinhlelweni ezihlukene. Inani leziqhamo ezintsha ezinhlelweni (emnyangweni wezempilo, isibonelo, noma mayelana nocwaningo lwe-IKS, usebenzisa i-NRF) sefinyelelwe. Isidingo sesakhiwo sezinqubomgomo esibanzi esisekela isizinda sesikhumbuzo sikhonjiswe njengokwenziwa kwezinyathelo ezisebenzayo ezithathwa ngokuqondile yiKomidi Elijwayelekile eliholwa yi-DST. Ngakho-ke, le nhlinzeko iqhubeka ngesisekelo sokuthi izinhlelo zolwazi lwemvelo, ngokwemvelo yazo, zidinga indlela "eyihlanganisayo." Imisebenzi eqhubekayo nokwakha kwezinye izinkalo kufanele imele ukuqonda okuphelele kwe-IKS eNingizimu Afrika. Inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe isendaweni futhi isakhiwo somthetho sesisunguliwe. Ukukhuthaza nokuhlinzeka ngamalungelo okushicilela umculo wendabuko nezindlela zobuciko ezikhombisa umsebenzi owenziwayo. Umthetho wezobuchwepheshe bezempilo bezamasiko usunguliwe futhi ukhuthaza ukusungulwa komzila wokulawula ozobizwa ngokuthi iNational Health Professionals Council, ezobhekelela imisebenzi yabantu abalinganiselwa ku-200,000 eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuqinisekile, ngeke kube nokwenzeka ukukhetha ngokuphelele kulolu hlelo lwezinqubomgomo ukukhetha abenzi bezinqubomgomo emikhakheni enezici zayo ezihlukile. Nokho, kuzodingeka ukudala eminye imisebenzi emisha ukuze kusekelwe ukusebenza okuphelele kwe-IKS eNingizimu Afrika. Le ngxenye ebalulekile yesakhiwo sezinqubomgomo idinga ukusungulwa kwezinkundla eNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinise, kuthuthukiswe, futhi kubandakanyeke kwi-IKS, kanye nokwakha umqondo womphakathi ukuze kuhlanganiswe izinhlobo ezahlukene zabachwepheshe. Umphakathi osekelayo, ongase ube uhlobo lwezinkampani, ukusiza imiphakathi ukufinyelela, ukuvikela, nokuhlinzeka ng rewards ezivela emiphakathini ephethe izimpahla zokuqonda nezinye izimfanelo zomphakathi ngaphandle kolwazi lwemvelo. Kwezinye izimo, imiphakathi noma izinhlangano zingakhetha ukusungula izimali zabo ukuze zisebenzise le njongo, lapho kudingeka khona inzuzo ecacile noma ukubuyiselwa. Isici esiyinhloko senqubomgomo sizoba ukusungulwa kohlelo lokurekhoda olusemthethweni lwe-IK. Uma iNingizimu Afrika ikhetha ukufaka i-IK emphakathini obanzi noma izama ukugcina uhlobo lokuvikela, uhlelo lokurekhoda lunomthelela omkhulu.
Umthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho 8 ka-1996 uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nguhulumeni kanye nolunye ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezilungelo zakhe, futhi umthetho kazwelonke kumele wenziwe ukuze kuphumelele leli lungelo. Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi ka-2000 (Umthetho 2 ka-2000), ophumelelisa leli lungelo, waqala ukusebenza ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa 2001. Inhloso eyinhloko yalomthetho ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okucacisa nokubika ezikhungweni zomphakathi nasemiphakathini yangasese nokukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ufinyelele ulwazi oluwusizo ukuze bakwazi ukuwasebenzisa ngokuphelele amalungelo abo. Ngokusho kwalomthetho, uMphakathi-Jikelele weMnyango Wezangaphandle ungumsebenzi Wolwazi walowo Mnyango. UMphakathi-Jikelele uqoka oMsebenzi Baphakade beMnyango. Ihhovisi leMphakathi-Jikelele lizoba yisisekelo sokwamukela izicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yalo mbhalo ukuhlinzeka amalungu omphakathi ngokuqonda izinqubo ezidingekayo ukuze bathole imibhalo egcinwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle. Umbono weMnyango Wezangaphandle ukuhlela i-Afrika eyandile, ethule, enedemokhrasi, engabandakanyi ubuhlanga, eyodwa futhi nokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni umhlaba ofanele futhi onobulungiswa. UMnyango Wezangaphandle uzinikele ekukhuthazeni izintshisekelo nezindinganiso zaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuvuselela i-Afrika, nokwakha umhlaba ongcono kubantu bonke. Ukwakha nokuphatha ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba baseNingizimu Afrika nokukhuthaza izinhloso zomthetho wezangaphandle. Ukuqapha intuthuko yamazwe omhlaba nokunikeza izeluleko kuhulumeni ngezinhlelo zezangaphandle nezindaba zangaphakathi ezihlobene nazo. Noma yiluphi ulwazi olubhaliwe olugcinwe nguMnyango Wezangaphandle lungacelwa. Gcwalisa ifomu elichazwe kuGov Gazette inombolo R187 enedethi ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2002 (bona isheduli 2); futhi ukhokhe imali echazwe eshedulini 1 yalombhalo. Nokho, umceli ofuna ukuboniswa imibhalo equkethe ulwazi lwakhe lomuntu akadingeki akhokhe imali yokufaka isicelo. Lo mcela kumele akhombise ukuthi isicelo sikhona ezithombeni zemibhalo egcinwe noma ukuthi ufuna ukubona imibhalo uqobo ehhovisi leMnyango Wezangaphandle. Ukutholakala kwalolu lwazi kuzothunyelwa kumceli ngendlela abacela ngayo ukuba kuboniswe, ngaphandle uma le ndlela eceliwe ingaphazamisa ngokungamukeleki ukusebenza nokusebenza kweMnyango Wezangaphandle noma idale umonakalo noma ibhidlize imibhalo noma iphule amalungelo emibhalo. Uma, ngezizathu zokusebenza, imibhalo ingatholakala ngendlela eceliwe kodwa ngenye indlela, imali yokuthola imibhalo izobalwa ngokwezinga lokuthi umceli ufisa kanjani ukuboniswa. Uma umceli engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma engakhubazekile, angabeka isicelo somlomo, lapho-ke uMsebenzi Wolwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu ngaye futhi amnikeze ifomu eliphelile. Uma efuna ukwaziswa ngempumelelo yesicelo ngefoni noma ngenye indlela. Isikhundla esisetshenziselwa ukufaka isicelo, uma isicelo senziwa egameni lomunye umuntu. Umceli kumele athumele isicelo sakhe ehhovisi elinikezwe ukwamukela izicelo njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, elizobe lenza lelo sikhathi sokucubungula leso sicelo. Ngemuva kokuba uMsebenzi Wolwazi enze isinqumo ngesicelo, umceli kumele waziswe ngalolo suku ngendlela akhethe ukuyaziswa. Uma, ngemuva kokulandela zonke izidingo zenqubo ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni 4. Uma umceli efuna ukufaka isikhalazo, ifomu lesikhalazo elichazwe nguMthetho kuGov Gazette inombolo R187 enedethi ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2002 kumele ligcwaliswe. Uma umceli enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaMsebenzi Wolwazi okukhuluma ngaso esigabeni 4.3.1 ngenhla, isikhalazo singathunyelwa kuNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Umceli angathatha le ndaba enkantolo uma enganelisekile ngesinqumo sikaNgqongqoshe Wezangaphandle. Bona Isheduli 1. Ngokusho komthetho, eminye imibhalo ingatholwa ngaphandle kokwenza isicelo ngokomthetho. Le mibhalo ingafinyelelwa kuwebhusayithi yeMnyango Wezangaphandle kule ndawo: www.dfa.gov. UMnyango Wezangaphandle ugcina ulwazi ngezihloko ezilandelayo ezidinga ukufakwa ngokusemthethweni ngokwesigaba 4.2. Imiklomelo, amagama, imiklomelo, nezinye. Lo mbhalo uzovuselelwa ngokwezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14 soMthetho, okungenani ngezikhathi ezedlula unyaka. Futhi kuwebhusayithi yephakathi yomphakathi, njengoba kuchaziwe kule ndawo: www.dfa.gov. Imali yokufaka isicelo ingu-R 35. noma ingxenye yayo 0.60 cents. "Umthetho" ubhekisela kuMthetho Wabaphathi Bezempilo Yendabuko, 2004 (Umthetho No. 35 ka 2004); kanti "umphakathi" ubhekisela kumuntu ophakathi kokwenza imithi yendabuko njengoba kuchaziwe nguMthetho. Ukuze kukhethwe amalungu abhekiswe ezahlukweni c, e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yoMthetho, uNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe isaziso kwiGazethi yoHulumeni nasezincwadini ezimbili okungenani ezithunyelwa emhlabeni wonke nasemaphandleni, emema abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abafuna ukuwafaka njengamalungu eBhodi. Isaziso esibhekiswe kule Mthethosisekelo 2 kumele sichaze ulwazi oluzobhekwa uma kukhethwa njengelungu kanye nesikhathi sokuthumela amagama akhethiwe. a ye-subsection 7c yoMthetho kumele ithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma kumuntu oyiLungu leBhodi ophatheka kwezempilo lapho umphakathi okhethiwe enza khona; b izindima e, h, kanye i ye-subsection 7 yoMthetho kumele zithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe kazwelonke. Ilungu leBhodi noma uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kumele lithumele amagama abaphathi abathathu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kubhekwe mayelana nokukhethwa ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7c yoMthetho. Uma uNgqongqoshe engatholi amagama akhethiwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlobo noma uma amagama akhethiwe enganele njengoba kuchaziwe kule mema, uNgqongqoshe angakhetha inani elanele labantu abafanelekayo ukuze bakhethwe ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7 yoMthetho noma acela ukuthi amagama engeziwe akhethwe ukuze kuzuzwe le njongo. Umuntu ogama lakhe lithunyelwe ngaphansi kweMthethosisekelo 5 ukuze akhethwe ngaphansi kwe-subsection 7i yoMthetho kumele abe esebenza ngempela kulolo mkhakha okungenani iminyaka emihlanu ngaphambi kosuku lapho angakhethwa khona njengelungu. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni amagama abantu abakhethwe njengamalungu eBhodi kanye nosuku abazoph开始a imisebenzi yabo njengamalungu eBhodi. Ngiyafunga ukuthi ngifuna ukuvuma ukukhethwa kwegama lami futhi ngiyavuma ukuba ngisebenze kwiBhodi Yabaphathi Bezempilo Yendabuko uma uNgqongqoshe engikhetha kulolu sikhundla. Mina (igama eliphelele lomuntu okhethiweyo kanye nesikhundla sabo) ngiyafunga ukuthi ulwazi olunikeziwe lapha lungamanga, futhi ukuthi kusemandleni kaNgqongqoshe ukukhetha mina njengelungu leBhodi Yabaphathi Bezempilo Yendabuko.
Isaziso sikhishwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c), (e), (h) kanye (i) soMthetho Wezobuchwepheshe Bezempilo (Umthetho No. 35 ka-2004) ("okuzobizwa ngokuthi Umthetho"), sisho ukuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uyamenywa abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abazobekwa njengezithunywa zeBhodi Yesikhashana Yezempilo (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "iBhodi"). Isigaba 7 soMthetho sisho ukuthi iBhodi izokwakhiwa ngamalungu angama-22 abekwe nguNgqongqoshe. Isigaba h sesigaba 7 soMthetho sisho ukuthi abantu abathathu abamele umphakathi kumele babekwe njengezithunywa zeBhodi; kanti isigaba i sesigaba 7 sisho ukuthi ummember owodwa kumele abekwe emkhakheni wezempilo ngamunye, okungukuthi: umthandazi, umphakathi wezokwelapha ngempahla yemvelo, kanye nodokotela. Umuntu obekwe njengezithunywa zeBhodi ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(c) kanye (i) zoMthetho kumele ube sebenza njengochwepheshe bezempilo okungenani iminyaka engu-5 emkhakheni wezempilo ofanele. Iziphakamiso zabantu abazobekwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c) zoMthetho kumele zithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma ilungu leBhodi elibhekelele ezempilo esifundeni lapho umphakathi usebenza khona, ngokukhethekile. Iziphakamiso zabantu abazobekwa ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(e), (h) kanye (i) zoMthetho kumele zithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Iziphakamiso kumele zithunyelwe ngendlela echazwe emqulwini ofakwe ohlobene nokubekwa kwamalungu eBhodi ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho.

Uma uMphathiswa engumgibeli ofanele wesicelo esithile, isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kwiSikhungo Sezimo Zomhlaba Nezokuvakasha. Uma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene engumgibeli ofanele, isicelo kufanele sithunyelwe kwiSikhungo sephalamende esibhekele izindaba zemvelo kulolo phalamende. Uma uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene esebenzise noma yiziphi amandla noma imisebenzi ye-Authority efanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 42 soMthetho mayelana nomsebenzi obhalwe esicelweni, kufanele kuhanjiswe kumuntu ofanele weziphathimandla onikezwe amandla. Lapho isicelo sokusebenza kwezimo zemvelo ngaphansi kwale mithetho kufanele senziwe ngokuhambisana neminye imithetho futhi le mithetho eminye ifuna ukuthi ulwazi lunikezwe noma izinqubo zilandelwe njengokugcwele kanye nolwazi noma izinqubo ezidingekayo ngaphansi kwale mithetho, uMphathiswa noma umphathi wephalamende elihlobene, ngokuhlinzeka ngeSahluko 3 seMthethosisekelo kanye nesigaba 24(g) soMthetho, kufanele athathe izinyathelo zokungena esivumelwaneni sokubhala ne-Authority enesibopho sokuphatha umthetho ophathelene nokulethwa kwezidingo zepolitiki nezimiso zalesi sikhumbuzo ukuze kugwenywe ukuphindaphinda ekuthumeleni kwalolo lwazi noma ekwenzeni lezi zinqubo. I-Authority efanele kufanele ithole lonke ulwazi oluhambelanayo noma olunomthelela olungase lube khona mayelana nanoma yisiphi isinqumo ngesicelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi lelo lwazi livikelwe ngumthetho, umceli noma i-EAP noma noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ophatha lelo lwazi, uma ucelwa yi-Authority efanele, kufanele aveze lelo lwazi kwi-Authority efanele, noma ngabe lelo lwazi libeka umceli endaweni ethokozisayo noma engathokozisi. viii noma yimiphi imibono evela kulungu lweziphathimandla olunamandla alinganiselwe emthethweni mayelana nengxenye ethile yomsebenzi ophathelene nesicelo; kanye ix noma yimiphi iziqondiso ezihlobene nesicelo. Ukuphikiswa kufanele kuveze wonke amaqiniso nezizathu zokufaka ukuphikiswa. Ingabe ufaka leli phikiso njengomuntu siqu noma egameni lomphakathi/organisasi? Uma ufaka egameni lomphakathi noma organisasi, sicela unikeze ubufakazi obuvumela ukuthi wenze kanjalo. Ingabe ukuphikiswa kwakho kusekelwe ezindaweni ezihlobene nenqubo eyalandelwa umfaki-sicelo wokuvuma? Ingabe ukuphikiswa kwakho kusekelwe ezindaweni ezihlobene nemiphumela yemvelo engamukeleki eyangaphathwa umnyango ngesikhathi wenqaba noma evuma isicelo? Ingabe uqinisekile ukuthi uyaphikisa ukuqhutshelwa kwalomsebenzi endaweni okwenziwa kuyo? Ingabe ukuphikiswa kwakho kuqukethe ulwazi olusha olungazange lunikezwe umeluleki wezokuphepha kwemvelo noma umnyango ngaphambi kokuthi umnyango ucabangele isicelo sakho? Uma impendulo yakho phezulu ingu-yi, sicela uchaze ukuthi kungani umphathiswa engafanele ukukucabangela nokuthi kungani lokhu kungazange kunikezwe umeluleki wezokuphepha kwemvelo noma umnyango ngesikhathi senqubo yesicelo. Ngaphezu kwalesi sikhundla seMnyango Wezimpawu, lo Mnyango onesikhungo sokusiza umphakathi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhuthaza izimpawu zendawo, ukwenza izimpawu zibe ne-Afrika ngokwenza ucwaningo, nokuvikela Izimpawu Zesizwe njengempahla eyasungulwa nguMbuso. Impumelelo yale Mnyango Wezimpawu ibonakala ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhishweni kwezihlonipho zesizwe; ngeflegi entsha yeSizwe, iEmblem yeSizwe, kanye neNgoma yeSizwe. I-Archive Yesizwe ivulekile emphakathini kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-8:00 kuya ku-16:00, nangeMgqibelo wesithathu wanoma yisiphi isinyanga kusukela ngo-9:00 kuya ku-13:00. I-Archive Yesizwe isebenza ukuqoqa; igcine futhi ikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwamarekhodi omphakathi nakwabo abangawona omphakathi njengempahla engabalulekile; igcina uhlelo lwekhompyutha olugcina ulwazi ngezimangalo kanye nas heritage yesizwe; ukusungula izindinganiso zokweseka izinsizakalo zokugcina umlando kanye neheritage ezindaweni. Ukuqoqa ulwazi ngempahla yesizwe kanye nomlando kuyinto ebalulekile empahleni yesizwe, futhi kusebenza njengendlela yokusiza uhlelo lokukhomba njengombuso, ukwakha isizwe, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo ezweni. Ukuqoqa ama-documents heritage kanye nomlando kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthi ohulumeni bagcine ukubhekelela umphakathi. Njengoba ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi kuthuthukiswa kancane kancane kumphakathi, kubonisa kakhulu imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ngakho-ke, i-archive ye-heritage yesizwe contains zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo zokuvikela izakhamuzi kanye nezinhlangano. Ingxenye enkulu ye-Archive ye-heritage yesizwe ayibonisi izipiliyoni zezingxenye eziningi zamaNingizimu Afrika abhekane nezinselelo. Ngokwesibonelo, labo abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika ababephathwa kabi ngaphansi kobandlululo, abesifazane, njll. I-Archive Yesizwe ingene kulolu hlelo lokuqoqa umlando ngokuxhumana nabantu abakholwa ukuthi banezincwadi zokurekhoda nokugcina, ngaleyo ndlela babamba iqhaza enqubweni yokwakha inkumbulo yabahlali abahlukahlukene baseNingizimu Afrika. I-Archive Yesizwe ye-heritage yesizwe igcina amarekhodi ezizwe ezisemthethweni kanye nalawo angase abe nentshisekelo futhi adinge ukugcinwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikhuthaza ukubambisana nokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo eziqoqa futhi zigcine amarekhodi angawona omphakathi. Ngesikhungo sokusiza umphakathi, i-Archive Yesizwe ye-heritage yesizwe ihlose ukufinyelela kubantu bomphakathi abangazi ngokuqhubeka kwalesi sikhungo nemisebenzi yaso. Le nqubo igxile ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwalezi ziqoqo "ngokuzilethela kubantu" ngokuvakashela ezikhungweni zemfundo nasemiphakathini eNingizimu Afrika nangokuhlanganyela, izinsuku zokwazisa, nokusebenza kokufinyelela. I-Archive Yesizwe idala futhi igcina uhlelo oluphakeme lwezokuxhumana oluzokhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo ezihlukahlukene zokweseka ukuthuthukiswa okuphelele komphakathi. Umthetho Wokufaka Izincwadi uqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yomsebenzi ngamunye ophelile eNingizimu Afrika ithunyelwa mahhala ezikhungweni ezichazwe nguMthetho kulo lonke izwe. Ngalesi sikhumbuzo, i-heritage ebhaliwe eNingizimu Afrika igcinwa futhi iyatholakala emphakathini lapho kudingeka.
Iyini umehluko phakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye neMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi? Kungani kubizwa ngokuthi iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998? Ubani onesibopho ngezinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke? Le mhlahlandlela ihlobene neMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). Njengomthetho, iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibhalwe ngolimi olusemthethweni olungaqondakali kalula. Le mhlahlandlela ichaza ukuthi umthetho uthi ini nokuthi kusho ukuthini. Isimiso esiyisisekelo seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ekuphathweni kwamanzi. Inhloso yale mhlahlandlela ukusiza abasebenzisi bezinsiza zamanzi (izifunda, imifula, amanzi edamu, amanzi aphansi, njll.) baqonde umthetho ukuze bakwazi ukubamba iqhaza ngendlela enenzuzo ezinqumweni ezihlobene nezindaba zamanzi ezithinta bona. Ubani okufanele afunde le mhlahlandlela? Noma ubani ofuna ukuba yingxenye yokuphathwa kwamanzi. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi olunembile ngezihloko ezithile, kufanele uxhumane neHhovisi Lesifunda eliseduzane leMnyango Wezamanzi Nezinkuni. Imininingwane yokuxhumana ibhalwe ekhasini lokugcina. Ikhophi yeMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ingatholakala ku-inthanethi ku-www.dwaf.gov. Le mhlahlandlela iqukethe ini? Le mhlahlandlela ayifaki lutho ngaphakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Ilinikeza ukubuka okujwayelekile komthetho nokuhlaziya okucacile mayelana nezindawo ezibalulekile zomthetho, eziklanyelwe ukusiza abasebenzisi bamanzi babambe iqhaza ezindabeni zezinsiza zamanzi. Izikhungo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi ziyasungulwa. Kungani iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ubalulekile? I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibalulekile ngoba ibeka izindaba ezihlobene namanzi emcontext efanele ngaphakathi komthethosisekelo. Amanzi abalulekile empilweni yonke. Ngaphandle kwamanzi, akukho muntu, isilwane, noma into ephilayo engaphila. Ihlwanyela amasimu abelusi, inikeza izinkomo nezindawo zasemakhaya; inikeza ukuhamba, isekela izindawo zokuhlala; isekela amadolobha namadolobhana amakhulu, imayini, imboni, futhi ikhiqiza ugesi. Abantu badinga amanzi ukuze baphuze, bahlabe, bakhe ukudla, bathandaze, futhi baphile. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinomkhuhlane omncane. Iminyakazo eminingi yeziqu zamanzi zethu isetshenziswa kakhulu. Njalo ngosuku, abantu namabhizinisi baphuma kakhulu emifuleni nasezizindeni zethu, emanzini aphansi, nakumazinga amanzi. Izindawo eziningi ezweni zibhekene nokushoda kwamanzi, lapho sidinga khona amanzi amaningi kunalokho esinakho. Kulokhu, izindawo esihlala kuzo zingase zibe ngaphansi kwengcindezi futhi abanye abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile (okuphuza) noma abatholi ingxenye yabo efanele yamanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibalulekile ngoba inikeza uhlaka lokuvikela izinsiza zamanzi ekusetshenzisweni ngokweqile futhi iqinisekisa amanzi ukuze kuthuthukiswe kwezomnotho nasemiphakathini ezayo. Kubalulekile futhi ngoba uthi amanzi awokubantu bonke ezweni ukuze kube nenzuzo kubo bonke. Yiziphi izinsiza zamanzi? Izinsiza zamanzi ziwumzimba wamanzi njengezifunda, imifula, amanzi, izindawo ezinamahlathi, kanye namanzi aphansi. 'Amanzi aphakeme' abhekisela emanzini aphezulu. 'Amanzi aphansi' abhekisela emanzini aphansi (isibonelo, ama-aquifer). Iyini umehluko phakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye neMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi? Kungani kubizwa ngokuthi iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998? 'Kazwelonke' kusho ukuthi umthetho uhlose wonke amazwe. 'Umthetho' ubhekisela kumthetho owamukelwa yiPhalamende. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibonisa ukuthi kuyimthetho ophathelene namanzi, okwenziwe kuzo zonke iNingizimu Afrika. Yamukelwa yiPhalamende ngo-1998. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi amanzi ayinsiza yemvelo eth belong to all South Africans. Ithi amanzi kumele ahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo nangokufanele. Ithi amanzi adingeka njengokudingeka kwabantu (njengamanzi okuphuza, ukulungisa ukudla, nezidingo ezihlobene nempilo) futhi ukuthi amanzi endaweni kumele ahlukaniswe ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye izicelo zabelwe. Njengoba amanzi ebalulekile kubantu, iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi abantu kumele babambe iqhaza ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Iphromotha ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi. Ithuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngokukwenza kube seduze kwabantu ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusungula izikhungo ezisha zesifunda nezendawo, njengezikhungo zokuphathwa kweziqu. Lezi zikhungo ezintsha zizoba nezikhulumi zomphakathi futhi zizosisiza umphakathi ukuba ubambe iqhaza ezinqumweni ezihlobene namanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ikhipha zonke izimiso zokucwasa mayelana nokufinyelela kwabanye abantu. Iphromotha ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ukuze kube nenzuzo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Iwandisa ukutholakala kwamanzi ukuze kuthuthukiswe okuqhubekayo. Iyini inhloso yeMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke? Iqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi avikelwe, asetshenziswe, athuthukiswe, agcinwe, aphathwe, futhi aqashelwe ngendlela eqhubekayo futhi efanele (ngokufanele) ukuze kube nenzuzo kubo bonke. Ubani onesibopho ngezinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke? Uhulumeni kazwelonke (iMnyango Wezamanzi Nezinkuni) osebenza ngaphansi komphakathi wezamanzi nezinkuni ungumgibeli wezinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke. Umphakathi wezamanzi nezinkuni unesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi uMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke uhlelwe. Le nqubo kumele iboniswe kuGazethi yoHulumeni. Inqubo yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke ibophela zonke izikhungo zamanzi kanye nabasebenzisi bamanzi. Umphakathi kumele abuyekeze futhi abuyisele inqubo yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke njalo eminyakeni emihlanu. Iyini inhloso yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke? Inhloso yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke ziphathwa ngendlela efanele kulo lonke izwe. Iphinde ihlinzeke ngemigomo yokuthi amanzi kumele aphathwe kanjani ezindaweni zokuphathwa kwamanzi ezibekwe. Ithi mangaki amanzi kumele 'agcinwe' ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo eziyisisekelo zabantu kanye nezindawo zokuhlala. Inqubo yeMithombo Yamanzi Kazwelonke kumele iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona amanzi esikhathini esizayo nasemsebenzini okhethekile njengezinsiza zamanzi zikaZwelonke. Isetha amazinga okuhlukaniswa kwamanzi. Iphinde ithi izikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi (njengezikhungo zokuphathwa kweziqu) kumele zisungulwe. Uhulumeni kazwelonke uhlukanisile izwe lonke laba izindawo eziyi-19 zokuphathwa kwamanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi le nqubo ithuthukiswe kuyo yonke indawo yokuphathwa kwamanzi. Thina kule Ndawo sithanda ukusungula lezi "Izimiso Zokuqala Abantu" emsebenzini ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. Sizokhuthaza ukufezwa komsebenzi ofinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza okwamukelekayo nezimo ezifanele ngokushesha. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ukuxoxisana kwenziwa njalo nangendlela ehlelekile ukuze ihhovisi lakho likwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zamakhasimende akho. Abantu kufanele baziqhenye ngezinga nesimo esifanele sezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abathola zona ukuze bazi lokho okulindelwe. Kufanele ubeke kahle izimiso zokwandisa ukufinyelela okuqhubekayo kulabo abangakaze bakuthole, isibonelo, abantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izithiyo zokufinyelela ziyasuswa. Abantu kufanele bahlonishwe futhi banakekelwe. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha yeNdawo ifaka izindinganiso zokuthi amakhasimende kufanele aphathwe kanjani. Abantu kufanele banikezwe ulwazi oluphelele nolucacile ngezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abanelungelo lokufinyelela kuzo. Ekusebenzisa leli thuba lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezifanele, amahhovisi kufanele ahlinzeke ngolwazi oluphelele nolucacile, futhi kufanele luhlaziywe mayelana nezinsizakalo abazinikezayo. Abantu kufanele bazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhishwa kanjani emahhovisi kaZwelonke nasezindaweni, ukuthi zikhokhwa malini, nokuthi ubani ophatha lezi zinsizakalo. Amakhasimende angaphandle akuwona kuphela okufanele afinyelele kulolu lwazi; abasebenzi bangaphakathi kufanele baphinde bathole. Inqubo yokuphatha akufanele ibe yimfihlo. Kufanele unikeze ulwazi ngomsebenzi wakho mayelana nezindinganiso zokusebenza ezibekwe, ukuphathwa kwezimali, nokusetshenziswa okufanele. Imininingwane yabasebenzi kanye namalungu aphatha akufanele ibe yimfihlo. Uma izindinganiso ezithembisiwe zingafezeki, kufanele kube nokuxolisa kubantu, kubanikeze incazelo ephelele futhi kuphinde kunikezwe isixazululo esisheshayo nesisebenzayo, futhi uma kukhishwa izikhalazo, abantu kufanele bathole impendulo enobubele nenhle. Amandla nezifiso zokuthatha isinyathelo uma izinto zingahambi kahle akuwona umphakathi omkhulu enqubweni yokubeka izindinganiso. Kufanele ukhuthaze impendulo ehhovisi lakho. Izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kufanele zikhishwe ngendlela efanele futhi efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola ukusebenza kwezimali. Kufanele uqaphele izindawo lapho kudingeka khona ukonga futhi uthuthukise ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezizoletha ukonga.

Ukuguqulwa kweMthetho 13.00. b Ukufaka lesi sihloko ngemuva kwef yeMthetho ngaphambi kokuthi isimo: okungase kuhlolwe futhi kuqinisekiswe isijeziso semali esikhuluma ngaso nguMqulu 85.00.3 "futhi c ukufaka igama "futhi" ngemuva kwesikhala ekupheleni kwef yeMthetho. c izidingo zokuqeqesha zabasebenzi abathintekayo ekuphathweni kwemithwalo yomoya; futhi d ezinye izinto eziphathelene nokuphepha kwemithwalo yomoya. Noma ubani othintekayo ekwamukeleni/ukugcina/ukudlulisela nokuphatha imithwalo ezothunyelwa ngomoya ngosizo lokuthutha komoya kumele ahambisane nezinhlinzeko zokuphepha ezibekwe kule ngxenye. Akekho umuntu ongase abe ngumsebenzi wokuthutha komoya ukuze athwale imithwalo engaziwa. Noma yimuphi umphakathi ophathwayo osebenza ukuze wamukele/gcine/dlulisela nokuphatha imithwalo ezothunyelwa ngomoya kumele abe necebo lokuvuma elikhishwe nguMphathiswa. Kudingeka ukuthi noma ubani osebenzela umphakathi ophathwayo futhi othintekayo ekuphathweni kwemithwalo eyaziwayo aqede ukuqeqeshwa okukhuluma ngakho kumthetho 108.06.1 futhi abe necebo lokwazi elifanele ukuze athole lokho ukuqeqeshwa. Umphakathi ophathwayo uzokwakha incwadi yokuphepha equkethe lonke ulwazi nemithwalo ethunyelwa ngomoya equkethe lonke ulwazi olukhuluma ngalo kuSaziso I-SA-CATS-aCS nokuthi ikhuluma kanjani ezokusebenza. Le ncwadi izonikezwa kuMphathiswa ukuze yamukelwe. Noma ubani ofaka isicelo sokuba umphakathi onemvume noma oqinisekisiwe njengomthumeli wemithwalo owaziwayo uzovumela umuntu onegunya, umhloli noma umphakathi onegunya obonakaliswe nguMphathiswa ukuba enze uphenyo olufanele nolwazi ngenhloso yokuhlola ukuthi iziqondiso zokuphepha eziphathelene nokuphathwa, ukuthuthwa nokugcina kwemithwalo eyaziwayo zihambisana nezidingo zalesi sikhathi. Labo abanecwecwe lokuvuma noma isiqinisekiso sokugunyazwa bazovumela umphakathi onegunya, umhloli noma umuntu ogunyaziwe nguMphathiswa ukuba ahlole noma iyiphi imithwalo ethunyelwa ukusuka noma ngaphezu komphakathi ophathwayo noma umuntu ogunyaziwe ngenhloso yokuhlola ukuhambisana noma ukungahambisani nale ngxenye. UMphathiswa angakhishwa iziqondiso zokuphepha eziphathelene nokukhululwa kwemithwalo ethunyelwa ngomoya lapho kudingeka ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokuphepha lokuthutha komoya. a ngokushesha enze izinguquko encwadini yokuphepha ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi-ndlela zokuphepha futhi athumele lezi zinguquko kuMphathiswa ukuze zamukelwe; futhi b Ngemuva kokwamukelwa kwezinguquko encwadini yokuphepha, enze lezi zinguquko zibe zatholakala kubo bonke abantu abenza umsebenzi wokwamukela, ukudlulisela noma ukuphatha imithwalo ethunyelwa ngomoya. b Qinisekisa ukuthi ngemuva kokwamukela imithwalo eyaziwayo futhi ngenkathi imithwalo isesandleni sabo igcinwa iphephile ekufinyeleleni okungagunyaziwe ngokuhambisana nezinyathelo zokuphepha ezib
UMphathiswa Wezokuthutha, ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 seMthetho Wokusebenza Kwamakhaza, 1962 (Umthetho 74 ka-1962), usungule izinqubomgomo ngokuhambisana nesheduli yayo. Kulesi sheduli, ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ukhombise okuphambene, "izinqubomgomo" ibhekisela ezinqubomgomeni zokusebenza kwamabhayisikili omphakathi, 1997, ezikhishwe nguHulumeni ngaphansi kwenombolo yesaziso R.1219 edlulelwa ngomhla kaSepthemba 26, 1997, kanye ne-R.1255 edlulelwa ngomhla ka-Okthoba 17, 1997, njengoba kushintshwe ngumasipala wesaziso R.1735 edlulelwa ngomhla kaDisemba 24, 1997, umyalezo kaHulumeni R.1041 edlulelwa ngomhla ka-Agasti 14, 1998, umyalezo kaHulumeni R.1148 edlulelwa ngomhla kaSepthemba 18, 1998, umyalezo kaHulumeni R.1664 edlulelwa ngomhla kaDisemba 14, 1998, umyalezo kaHulumeni R.1701 edlulelwa ngomhla kaDisemba 31, 1998, umyalezo kaHulumeni R.639 edlulelwa ngomhla kaMeyi 21, 1999, umyalezo kaHulumeni R.170 edlulelwa ngomhla kaFebhuwari 17, 2000, umyalezo kaHulumeni R.171 edlulelwa ngomhla kaFebhuwari 18, 2000, umyalezo kaHulumeni R.558 edlulelwa ngomhla kaJuni 22, 2001, kanye nomyalezo kaHulumeni R.559 edlulelwa ngomhla kaJuni 22, 2001.
