A.1 Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubomgomo nezinhlinzeko zoMthethosisekelo zisebenza kahle, bonke abasebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi baphatheke futhi balandele lo Mthetho Wokuziphatha. A.2 Lo Mthetho uzoba umhlahlandlela kubasebenzi mayelana nezilindelo zokuziphatha kwabo ngokwethembeka kanye nobudlelwano abanabo nabanye abasebenzi. Ukuhambisana nalo Mthetho kulindeleke ukuthi kuthuthukise izinga lobuchwepheshe endaweni yokusebenza futhi kusize ekuqinisekiseni ukwethenjwa nokuzigqaja eMnyangweni Wezokuthutha. A.3 Umsebenzi ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuzilawula nokulandela imithetho ebekwe yilo Mthetho. Ngokufanayo, abaphathi nabaphathi banelungelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi lo Mthetho uyalandelwa, futhi lokhu kufanele kwenzeke ngaphandle kokukhetha. A.4 Lo Mthetho Wokuziphatha awuhloselwe ukuvimbela ukukhula komsebenzi kodwa ukuvikela amalungelo eMnyango kanye nomsebenzi. B.1 Lo Mthetho ungezelelwa kuMthetho Wokuziphatha okukhulunywa ngawo esigabeni 2 soMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni ka-2001, okukhuluma ngabo bonke abasebenzi boHulumeni. Kuye kwengezwa ukuthi ubhekana ngqo nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuthutha. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi koMthetho Wokuziphatha WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni, njengokutholakala kuMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni ka-2001, lo Mthetho uzolandelwa. B.2 Kukhona isidingo sokufundisa abasebenzi mayelana nobudlelwano babo nomthetho, kanye nababusi bamandla ezepolitiki, abanye abasebenzi, nomphakathi, futhi kufanele bafundiswe umoya lapho abasebenzi kufanele basebenze, nokuthi yini okufanele bayenze ukuze bagweme ukungqubuzana nezithakazelo, nokuthi yini elindelwe kubo mayelana nezindlela zabo zomphakathi, ezimpilweni zabo zangasese nasekusebenzeni. B.3 Nakuba lo Mthetho Wokuziphatha ubhalwe ukuze uhlanganise konke, awuyona yonke imithetho elawula izindinganiso zokuziphatha. Nokho, uMphakathi-Jikelele, ngokuya ngamalungelo esigaba 7 (b) soMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni ka-1994, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle kweMnyango nokugcina umthetho, phakathi kwezinye izinto, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza kube nokuqondana kwezindlela zokuziphatha kwabantu bakhe nezindinganiso ezilawula amahhovisi kaHulumeni kanye nezinqubomgomo ezifanele nezindlela ezishiwo kulo Mthetho. B.4 Inhloso enkulu yalo Mthetho ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle. Ngakho-ke, umsebenzisi angatholakala enecala lokuziphatha kabi futhi abhekane nenqubo yokuthola isijeziso ngokuhambisana nezindlela zohulumeni uma izenzo zabo ziphikisana noMthetho Wokuziphatha noma uma kutholakala ukuthi baphule ezinye zezidingo zalo Mthetho. C.1.7 akuphuli noma iyiphi ingxenye yoMthetho Wokuziphatha obekwe kubasebenzi boHulumeni. C.2.11 ingaxhumana namalungu omphakathi ngolimi olusemthethweni inqobo nje uma kukhethwe ngumphakathi. C.2.14 akungavumeli ukubeka impilo yabanye noma eyabo engcupheni ngokungalandeli imithetho yokuphepha noma ngokuyigxeka. C3.17 akungavumeli ukuba babambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuphikisana eziphikisana nezindinganiso zokusebenza futhi ezingekho emthethweni. C.4.6 ingacela ukuthi ingabambiqhaza ezinqumweni noma ezinyathelweni ezisemthethweni emsebenzini uma lokhu kungabakhokhela inzuzo engafanele ngendlela engalungile, engakhethi, futhi ehlukanisayo. C 4.16 ezimeni eziphuthumayo ingacelwa uMphakathi-Head ukuba enze imisebenzi ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi, noma uma kungesikhathi esijwayelekile sokusebenza kodwa kuyisimo esingaphansi kokulawulwa kukaMphakathi-Head futhi sinezimo eziphuthumayo ezidinga isenzo esisheshayo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni. C.4.31 akungavumeli ukuphula umthetho ezindaweni zokwakha zikaHulumeni. C.5.3 akungavumeli ukusebenzisa isikhundla sabo emsebenzini ukuze bathole izipho nokukhwabanisa umphakathi nezinye izinzuzo futhi akungavumeli ukuthola noma yini uma kubonakala kuyiphoyisa. Zonke izipho kufanele zikhulunywe futhi zibhale kwi-rejista yezipho. C.6.1 ngezizathu zokuxhumana ngaphakathi, kufanele usebenzise isiNgisi njengolimi lokuxhumana futhi lokhu kufanele kubonakale kuzo zonke izenzo zomsebenzi ngaphakathi (okungukuthi, imibhalo, imihlangano, njll.). C 6.5 kufanele ahambisane nezindinganiso zobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana ngekhompyutha njengoba kuchaziwe. C.7.11 kufanele ukhuthaze isiko lokwethembana ngokuhlala wazisa futhi usekela. D.1. Bonke abaphathi nabasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazi kahle uMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni ka-2001, Isahluko II, uMthetho 108 ka-1994, mayelana nezinqubomgomo nezindlela zokuthola isijeziso emahhovisi kaHulumeni. Umkhakha Wokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi uzosiza abaphathi nabasebenzi ngezinhlelo zokwazisa kanye nezinto ezisetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa kubasebenzi. E.1 Abaphathi kufanele bahlale bezama ukuvimbela ukuvela kokunganeliseki nezikhalazo mayelana nezinhlelo zokuphatha nezokuhola ezilungile. Bonke abaphathi nabasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazi izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe uma kukhona inkinga edinga ukuxazululwa. Iplatifomu Yokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi izodlala indima yokwesekwa ngokwazisa abaphathi nabasebenzi ngamalungelo nezibopho zabo. F.1 Zonke imibhalo ephathelene nezinyathelo zokuthola isijeziso kufanele ibekwe esigabeni esiphethe ukuphathwa kwabantu, esizokuqinisekisa ukugcina kahle. F.2 Iplatifomu Yokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi izobhekelela ukugcina amarekhodi wezibalo nokubhaliswa kwemibiko ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho WamaHhovisi kaHulumeni. F.3 IMnyango, abasebenzi bawo, kanye nezinyunyana kufanele zobopheleke ekugcineni nasekuthobeleni okuqukethwe kwalolu Mthetho Wokuziphatha.
Imithetho ngeke isebenze kumkhumbi othile kanye nezinye. Isahluko sokuqala - Ababambiqhaza embonini yezokuthutha olwandle badinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Imikhumbi esebenza eNingizimu Afrika akufanele ivimbele noma ibambelele ekuphumezeni izinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. UMsunguli-Jikelele angayala ababambiqhaza ukuba baphinde bahlaziye izinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Ukususwa kwezinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle kuyadingeka. Abasebenzi bemikhumbi bangahlaziya izinhlelo zokuphepha zemikhumbi. Ibhodi ingayala abasebenzi bemikhumbi ukuba bahlaziye izinhlelo zokuphepha zemikhumbi. Le mithetho izobizwa ngokuthi Imithetho Yokuhweba Ngomkhumbi (Ubumfihlo Bezokuthutha Olwandle) ka-2004. Lezi ezinye zezimiso ezizothatha umthelela ngosuku lokushicilelwa kwiGovinda Gazette. Ukuze kufezwe le njongo, le mithetho isungula uhlaka oluhlosiwe lokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha zemikhumbi nezinye izinyathelo zokuphepha zokuthutha olwandle. Ukusetshenziswa kwalolu hlaka kuzovumela iRiphabhulikhi ukuba ihlangabezane nezibopho zayo ngaphansi kweSahluko IX - 2 seSivumelwano Sokuphepha Kwezokuthutha Olwandle kanye ne-ISPS Code. Umkhumbi wezimpahla ubhekisela kunoma yimuphi umkhumbi ongumkhumbi wezivakashi, futhi ufaka... umphakathi wokuphatha impahla ubhekisela kumuntu osebenza nempahla esetshenziswa emkhumbini... I-ISSC esemthethweni uma ibhekisela kumikhumbi ngesikhathi esithile ibhekisela ku-ISSC yomkhumbi osebenza ngaleso sikhathi. Ngemigomo yale mithetho, umkhumbi uhlobo olukhuluma ngalo emthethweni-10 1 uthathwa njengokuthi usetshenziswa ukuze uthuthwe olwandle uma usetshenziswa njengomkhumbi walolo hlobo. Iphothi ephethwe ukuze iphephe, noma ingxenye yaleyo phothi noma nanoma yisiphi isikhathi lapho le phothi, noma ingxenye yaleyo phothi iphethwe noma iphethwe kuphela nguMnyango Wezokuphepha Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha komkhumbi osengozini ngokudlulisela ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Iphothi iyindawo yamanzi, umhlaba namanzi (kuhlanganisa nezakhiwo, imishini exhunywe futhi esebenzayo etholakala kulawo manzi noma umhlaba) ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kuyo yonke noma ingxenye yayo ephathelene nokuhamba, ukulayisha, ukuhambisa, ukugcinwa noma ukuhlinzekwa kwemikhumbi. Indawo evulekile yamanzi ehlelelwe ukusekela noma ukubamba imikhumbi ngaphambi kokuthi ingene endaweni yamanzi ebhekiswe esigabeni a; futhi c indawo evulekile yamanzi phakathi kwezindawo zamanzi ezichazwe ezigabeni a no-b. a ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kuyo yonke noma ingxenye yayo ephathelene nokuhamba, ukulayisha noma ukuhambisa, ukulungisa noma ukuhlinzeka ngemikhumbi ephethwe ngokuphepha; futhi b echazwe ngokuhlanganyela 1. UMsunguli-Jikelele ngokukhishwa kwesaziso kwiGovinda Gazette, angakhetha umuntu ukuze asebenze ephothini ephethwe ukuze iphephe. c imibono yomuntu, abantu abahilelekile ekuphathweni kokusebenza kwephothi. b umkhumbi ophathwe kwelinye izwe. c indawo yokuwela ehlala noma ekuthuthweni emanzini aseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kugwenywe ukudideka, indawo yokuwela ehlala ebhekiswe emthethweni-1 c ithathwa njengomkhumbi ngemigomo yale mithetho. Umkhumbi ungumkhumbi ophathwe kwelinye izwe uma lowo mkhumbi... omunye umkhumbi; noma v iphothi, esetshenziswa ephothini noma ngokuhlanganyela nephothi; futhi d isenzo sibalulekile kulolo suku. a umuntu udingeka ukuba alandele imiyalelo yokuphepha; futhi b ukulandela imiyalelo kusho ukuthi lowo muntu uphule umthetho ngokwephula leyo mfuneko noma ukuphula umthetho noma le mithetho, lowo muntu, uma elandela imiyalelo yokuphepha, uthathwa njengokungaphuli umthetho noma ukuphula okudingekayo. Umuntu, uma elandela imiyalelo yokulawula, uthathwa njengokungaphuli umthetho noma ukuphula okudingekayo. Ngemigomo yale mithetho, umuntu anganikeza isaziso noma imiyalelo noma axhumane nokusebenza komkhumbi ngokunikeza lowo muntu isaziso noma imiyalelo noma axoxe nommeleli walowo mkhumbi. c iphothi ephethwe ukuze iphephe; futhi d ababambiqhaza embonini yezokuthutha olwandle. e Imisebenzi eyenziwa yilabo ababamba iqhaza embonini yezokuthutha olwandle ephathelene noma ngokuhambisana nezindawo eziphethwe ukuze ziphephe. UMsunguli-Jikelele ngokubhala angakhipha futhi izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle-2 noma izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle-3 elisebenzayo kumikhumbi esebenza kwezinye izizwe. a ngemuva kokubonisana ne-NICOC; futhi b kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ilungile ukuze kwakhiwe ukuphepha okuphezulu kulowo mkhumbi, indawo noma ababambiqhaza ngenxa yokuphazamiseka okukhulu kokuthutha olwandle okungafanele. b uma isikhumbuzo sikhanselwa ngokubhala nguMsunguli-Jikelele. b noma yisiphi isenzo esithathwe ngumuntu ophakathi embonini yezokuthutha olwandle. Uhlelo lokuphepha lwalesi sikhumbuzo alunakulandelwa ngaphandle uma izinyathelo ezikhuluma ngazo kulolo hlelo lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle zisetshenziswa. Imiyalelo yokuphepha inikezwa mayelana nephothi, umkhumbi, indawo, ababambiqhaza noma ukusebenza, amazinga okuphepha akhona aqhubeka nokusebenza. Uma uMsunguli-Jikelele ekhansela ukuthi izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle lisebenza ephothini ethile, uMsunguli-Jikelele angazisa ngokushesha... i ukulawula indawo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle ii ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. i ukulawula indawo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle; noma ii ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi ephethwe ukuze iphephe; futhi b umphathi womkhumbi ophathwe ukuze iphephe kule phothi noma mayelana nokungena kule phothi. Uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kwehluleka ukulandela imithetho-3, kuzoba icala elizokwenziwa, uma kutholakala icala, kuzokwenziwa inhlawulo noma kuboshwe isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Umthetho 3 awusebenzi uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kunezizathu ezivumelekile. a ukusebenza kwalowo mkhumbi; noma b umphathi womkhumbi. Uma uMsunguli-Jikelele ezisa ukusebenza komkhumbi njengoba kushiwo emthethweni 1 ngenhla, ukusebenza komkhumbi kufanele kuhanjiswe ngokushesha leso saziso kumphathi ofanele womkhumbi. Uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kwehluleka ukulandela okukhuluma emthethweni 2 ngenhla, kuzoba icala, elizokwenziwa, uma kutholakala icala, kuzokwenziwa inhlawulo noma kuboshwe isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Umthetho 3 awusebenzi uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kunezizathu ezivumelekile. a ababambiqhaza embonini yezokuthutha olwandle abaphethe le ndawo; futhi b Uma ababambiqhaza bengasebenzi njengokusebenza komkhumbi, baziise ukusebenza komkhumbi. a ababambiqhaza; futhi b uma ababambiqhaza benza isenzo esikhuluma ngaso emshweni ophathelene nephothi ephethwe ukuze ip
Isinqumo somnyango sikhonjiswa encwadini yokuvuma noma yokwenqaba. Imigomo yokuvuma itholakala kumarekhodi wesinqumo (ROD), okufaka phakathi encwadini yokuvuma. Isicelo sokuphikisa kumele sihambisane nawo wonke amadokhumenti afanele noma amakhophi aqinisekisiwe wale midokhumenti athunyelwe kumkomishana ophakanyisiwe. Isicelo sokuphikisa kumele sikhombise wonke amaqiniso nezizathu zokufaka isicelo sokuphikisa. Ingabe ufaka lesi sicelo sokuphikisa njengomuntu siqu noma egameni lomphakathi/isenzo? Uma ufaka egameni lomphakathi noma inhlangano, sicela unikeze ubufakazi obuvumela ukuthi wenze kanjalo. Ingabe isicelo sakho sokuphikisa sincike ezindaweni ezihlobene nenqubo eyalandelwa umfaki-sicelo wokuvuma? Ingabe isicelo sakho sokuphikisa sincike ezindaweni ezihlobene nemiphumela yemvelo engamukeleki eyayingenakucwaswa umnyango ngesikhathi wenqaba noma uvuma isicelo? Ingabe uyavuma ukuqhubeka nale msebenzi uma ukukhathazeka kwakho kungaxazululwa ngokuhlela kabusha uhlelo noma ngokucacisa noma ukususa okukhona njengomphumela walomsebenzi? Ingabe uqinisekile ukuthi uphikisa ukuhlinzekwa kwalomsebenzi endaweni eyenziwa kuyo? Ingabe isicelo sakho sokuphikisa siqukethe ulwazi olusha olungazange lunikezwe umxhumanisi wemvelo noma umnyango ngaphambi kokuba umnyango ucabangele isicelo sakho? Uma impendulo yakho phezulu iyavuma, sicela uchaze ukuthi kungani umphathiswa engafanele ukukubheka nokuthi kungani lokhu kungazange kunikezwe umxhumanisi wemvelo noma umnyango ngesikhathi senqubo yesicelo. Angiphikisi ukuthi lesi sicelo sokuphikisa sithunyelwe yiliphi iqembu lesithathu elithakazelisayo nelithintekayo kanye/noma ilungu lomphakathi, njengoba ngiqonda ukuthi inqubo ye-EIA iyinzuzo yomphakathi.

Noma iyiphi uhlelo noma umsebenzi odinga imvume noma igunyazo ngaphansi komthetho ophatha ukukhululwa kokukhishwa, ukungcoliswa, odoti, noma ukulahla futhi ongakhulumiwe kuMbiko Wezombusazwe No. R. Ibhodi efanele yezimisebenzi ezibalwe kule ngxenye yesheduli iyinhlangano yemvelo endaweni lapho umsebenzi uzokwenziwa khona ngaphandle kokuthi kube isicelo sephrojekthi njengoba kuboniswe esigabeni 24C seMthetho, lapho ibhodi iyinhloko noma ilungu likamasipala elithunywe njengokunjalo ngokwesigaba 42 seMthetho njengoba kushintshiwe.
Ukuze kwenziwe eminye imisebenzi efana nalena eyalelwe nguNgqongqoshe, iBhunga Lezimpawu, iKomidi Lezimpawu ngokuhambisana nale mthetho. Ngaphezu kwalolu hlelo lweMnyango Wezimpawu, lo Mnyango onehlelo lokusiza umphakathi unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhuthaza izimpawu zesiNtu, ukwenza izimpawu zibe ne-Afrika ngokwenza ucwaningo, nokuvikela Izimpawu Zesizwe njengempahla eyasungulwa nguMbuso. Impumelelo yale Mnyango Wezimpawu ibonakala ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhishweni kwemiklomelo yesizwe; ngeflegi yesizwe entsha, iEmblem yesizwe, kanye neNgoma yesizwe. Inhloso yokugcina nokugcina ama-akhawunti iwukwenza kube nokufinyelela komphakathi kumarekhodi angaphezu kweminyaka engamashumi amabili. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe ivulekile emphakathini kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu kusukela ngo-8:00 kuya ku-16:00, futhi ngosuku lwesithathu lwesabatha ngenyanga yonke kusukela ngo-9:00 kuya ku-13:00. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe isebenza ukuqoqa; igcine futhi ikhuthaze ukusetshenziswa kwamarekhodi omphakathi nalawo angawomphakathi njengempahla engabalulekile; igcina uhlelo lwekhompyutha olugcina ulwazi ngezimo nezimpawu zesizwe; ukusungula izindinganiso zokweseka izinsizakalo zokugcina umlando nezimpawu ezindaweni. Ukuqoqa ulwazi ngempahla yesizwe nomlando kubalulekile empahleni yesizwe, futhi kusebenza njengendlela yokusiza uhlelo lokukhomba njengombuso, ukwakha isizwe, nokuthuthukisa izinga lempilo ezweni. Ukuqoqa izincwadi zezakhamuzi nezomlando kuyindlela ebalulekile yokuthi ohulumeni bagcine ukuziphendulela emphakathini. Njengoba ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi kuthuthuka kancane kancane emphakathini, kubonisa kakhulu imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ngakho-ke, i-archive yempahla yesizwe innehla yonke imininingwane edingekayo yokuvikela izakhamuzi nezinsizwa. Ingxenye enkulu ye-Archive Yempahla Yesizwe ayikhombisi iziphetho zezingxenye eziningi zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlangabezane nezinselelo. Ngokwesibonelo, labo abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika ababephathwa kabi ngezikhathi ze-apartheid, abesifazane, nokunye. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe ingene emkhankasweni wokuhlanganisa umlando ngokuxhumana nabantu abakholelwa ukuthi banolwazi lokurekhoda nokulondoloza, ngaleyo ndlela beparticipate emsebenzini wokwakha inkumbulo yezakhamuzi ezihlukahlukene zaseNingizimu Afrika. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe Yempahla Yesizwe igcina amarekhodi kazwelonke ezincwadi zomphakathi nalawo angase abe nenzuzo futhi adingeka ukugcinwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikhuthaza ukubambisana nokusebenzisana phakathi kwezikhungo eziqoqa futhi zigcine amarekhodi angawomphakathi. Ngehlelo lwayo lokusiza umphakathi, i-Akhawunti Yesizwe Yempahla Yesizwe ihlose ukufinyelela ezakhamuzini ezingazi ngokuqhamuka kwalolu akhawunti nezinhlelo zayo. Lolu hlelo lugxile ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwalokhu kuqoqa "ngokukhipha kubantu" ngokuvakashela ezikhungweni zemfundo nasezindaweni zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika nangokusebenzisa imikhosi, izinsuku zokwazisa, nezinhlelo zokufinyelela. I-Akhawunti Yesizwe idala futhi igcina uhlelo lolwazi oluphakeme oluzokhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo ezahlukene zokweseka ukuthuthukiswa okuphelele komphakathi. Umthetho Wokugcina Umthetho uqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yomsebenzi owashicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika ithunyelwa mahhala ezikhungweni ezichazwe nguMthetho kulo lonke izwe. Ngalesi sikhathi, impahla ebhaliwe eNingizimu Afrika igcinwa futhi iyatholakala emphakathini uma kudingeka.
Iyini umehluko phakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye noMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi? Kungani kubizwa ngokuthi iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998? Ubani ophethe izinsiza zamanzi kazwelonke? Le mhlahlandlela ihlobene neMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). Njengomthetho, iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibhalwe ngolimi olusemthethweni olungelula ukuqonda. Le mhlahlandlela ichaza ukuthi umthetho uthi ini nokuthi kusho ukuthini. Isimiso esiyisisekelo seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke sithi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele bakwazi ukuthatha parte ekuphathweni kwamanzi. Inhloso yale mhlahlandlela ukusiza abasebenzisi bezinsiza zamanzi (imifula, imifula emincane, amanzi edamu, amanzi aphansi, njll.) baqonde umthetho ukuze bakwazi ukuthatha parte ezinqumweni ezihlobene nezindaba zamanzi ezithinta bona. Ubani okufanele afunde le mhlahlandlela? Noma ubani ofuna ukuba neqhaza ekuphathweni kwamanzi. Ukuze uthole ulwazi olunembile ngezihloko ezithile, kufanele uxhumane neHhovisi Lesifunda eliseduze leMnyango Wezindaba Zamanzi Nezinkuni. Imininingwane yokuxhumana ibhalwe ekhasini lokugcina. Ikhophi yeMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ingatholakala ku-inthanethi ku-www.dwaf.gov. Le mhlahlandlela iqukethe ini? Le mhlahlandlela ayifaki lutho ngaphakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke. Ihlinzeka ngombono ojwayelekile weMthetho kanye nolwazi olucacile ngezindawo ezibalulekile zomthetho, okuhloswe ukusiza abasebenzisi bamazwe ukuthi bathathe parte ezindabeni zezinsiza zamanzi. Kukhona izikhungo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi ezisunguliwe. Kungani iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ubalulekile? I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibalulekile ngoba ibeka izindaba ezihlobene namanzi endaweni efanele ngaphakathi komthethosisekelo. Amanzi abalulekile empilweni yonke. Ngaphandle kwamanzi, akukho muntu, isilwane, noma into ephilayo engaphila. Amanzi akhulisa izivini zabafuyi, anikeza izilwane nezindawo zasemakhaya; anikeza ukujabulisa, asekele izindawo zokuhlala; asekele amadolobha namadolobhana amakhulu, imayini, imboni, futhi akhiqize ugesi. Abantu badinga amanzi ukuze baphuze, bahlale, bakhe ukudla, bathathe izipho, futhi baphile kahle. INingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinomswakama omncane. Iningi lezinsiza zethu zamanzi zisetshenziswa ngokweqile. Njalo ngosuku, abantu nezinkampani bathatha kakhulu emifuleni nasemifuleni emincane, emanzini aphansi, nasemanzini. Izindawo eziningi ezweni zibhekene nokushoda kwamanzi, lapho sidinga khona amanzi amaningi kunalokho esinakho. Kulokhu, izindawo esihlala kuzo zingase zibe ngaphansi kwengcindezi futhi abanye abantu abakwazi ukufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile (okuphuza) noma abatholi ingxenye yabo efanele yamanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibalulekile ngoba ihlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuvikela izinsiza zamanzi ekusetshenzisweni ngokweqile futhi iqinisekisa amanzi okuthuthukiswa kwezokuxhumana nezomnotho kanye nezizukulwane ezizayo. Kubalulekile futhi ngoba uthi amanzi ayingxenye yabantu bonke ezweni ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke. Yini ezinsizeni zamanzi? Izinsiza zamanzi ziwumthombo wamanzi njengezindlela, imifula, amanzi, izindawo ezinamahlathi, kanye namanzi aphansi. 'Amanzi aphezulu' abhekisela kumanzi phezulu komhlaba. 'Amanzi aphansi' abhekisela kumanzi ngaphansi komhlaba (isibonelo, ama-aquifer). Yini umehluko phakathi kweMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke kanye noMthetho Wesevisi Zamanzi? Kungani kubizwa ngokuthi iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998? 'Kazwelonke' kusho ukuthi umthetho uhlose wonke amazwe. 'Umthetho' ubhekisela kumthetho odlulisiwe yiPhalamende. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ibonisa ukuthi umthetho mayelana namanzi, owakhelwe wonke uNingizimu Afrika. Wavunywa yiPhalamende ngo-1998. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi amanzi ayinsiza yemvelo eyinhloko yabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Ithi amanzi kumele ahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo nangokufanele. Ithi amanzi adingeka njengokudla okuyisisekelo komuntu (njengamanzi okuphuza, ukulungiselela ukudla, nezidingo ezihlobene nempilo) futhi ukuthi amanzi endawo kumele abekwe eceleni ngaphambi kokuthi ezinye izicelo zihlukaniswe. Njengoba amanzi ebalulekile kubantu, iMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi abantu kumele bathathe parte ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zamanzi. Iphromotha ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamanzi. Iqinisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngokuzilethela eduze kwabantu ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusungula izikhungo ezintsha zesifunda nezendawo, njengezikhungo Zokuphathwa Kwamafutha. Lezi zikhungo ezintsha zizoba nezithunywa zomphakathi futhi zizosisiza umphakathi ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ezinqumweni ezihlobene namanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke isusa yonke imibono yokucwasa mayelana nokufinyelela kwabanye abantu. Iphromotha ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Iwandisa ukutholakala kwamanzi ukuze kuthuthukiswe. Yini inhloso yeMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke? Iqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi avikelwe, asetshenziswe, athuthukiswe, agcinwe, aphathwe, futhi aqashwe ngendlela esheshayo futhi efanele (ngokufanele) ukuze kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke. Ubani ophethe izinsiza zamanzi kazwelonke? Uhulumeni kazwelonke (UMnyango Wezindaba Zamanzi Nezinkuni) osebenza ngaphansi kukaNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zamanzi Nezinkuni ungumgibeli wezinsiza zamanzi kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe Wezindaba Zamanzi Nezinkuni unomsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi Inqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke isunguliwe. Le nqubo kumele iboniswe kuGazethi Yombuso. Inqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke ibophela zonke izikhungo zamanzi kanye nabasebenzisi bamazwe. UNgqongqoshe kumele abuyekeze futhi avuselele Inqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke njalo eminyakeni emihlanu. Yini inhloso yeNqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke? Inhloso yeNqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zamanzi kazwelonke ziphathwa kahle kulo lonke izwe. Iphinde ihlinzeke ngezikhombisi zokuthi amanzi kufanele aphathwe kanjani ezindaweni ezibekwe ukuphathwa kwamanzi. Ithi mangaki amanzi kumele 'agcinwe' ezidingweni eziyisisekelo zabantu nasezindaweni zokuhlala. Inqubo Yezinsiza Zamanzi Kazwelonke kumele iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona amanzi esikhathini esizayo nasezidingweni ezikhethekile ezifana nokuhlinzekwa kwamanzi kazwelonke. Ibeka amazinga okuhlukaniswa kwamanzi. Iphinde ithi izikhungo zokuphathwa kwamanzi (njengezikhungo Zokuphathwa Kwamafutha) kumele zisungulwe. Uhulumeni kazwelonke uhlukanisile izwe lonke libe izindawo eziyi-19 zokuphathwa kwamanzi. I-Mthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ithi le nqubo ithuthukiswa kuyo yonke indawo yokuphathwa kwamanzi. Le nqubo ibizwa ngokuthi isu lokuphathwa kwemifula (CMS). Ubani ophakamisayo isu lok
Sithanda ukusungula lezi "Izimiso Zokuqala Kubantu" emsebenzini ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. Sizokhuthaza ukwenziwa komsebenzi ofinyelela ezingeni eliphezulu lokusebenza okufanele nezimo ezifanele ngokushesha. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izixoxiswano zenzeka njalo futhi ngendlela ehlelekile ukuze ihhovisi lakho likwazi ukubhekana nezidingo zamakhasimende akho. Izakhamizi kufanele zazi ngezinga nezimo ezifanele zezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abazitholayo ukuze zazi lokho okufanele kulindelwe. Kufanele ubeke phambili izimiso zokwandisa ukufinyelela okuqhubekayo kulabo abangakaze bakuthole, isibonelo, abantu abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izithiyo zokufinyelela ziyasuswa. Izakhamizi kufanele zihlonishwe futhi zikhathalelwe. Kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi ikhodi yokuziphatha yeSikhungo ifaka izindinganiso zokuthi amakhasimende kufanele aphathwe kanjani. Izakhamizi kufanele zinikezwe ulwazi oluphelele nolucacile ngezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abazikhethayo. Ekusebenziseni leli thuba lokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni ezifanele, amahhovisi kufanele anikeze ulwazi oluphelele nolucacile, futhi kufanele luhlaziywe mayelana nezinsizakalo abazihlinzekayo. Izakhamizi kufanele zazi ukuthi izinsizakalo zinikezwa kanjani emahhovisi omphakathi nasezindaweni, ukuthi zishoda malini, nokuthi ubani ophatha lezo zinsizakalo. Amakhasimende angaphandle akuwona kuphela okufanele afinyelele kulolu lwazi; abasebenzi bangaphakathi kufanele baphinde bathole. Inqubo yokuphatha akufanele ibe secretive. Kufanele unikeze ulwazi ngomsebenzi wakho mayelana nezindinganiso zokusebenza ezibekiwe, ukuphathwa kwezimali, nokusetshenziswa okufanele. Imininingwane yabasebenzi kanye namalungu aphatha akufanele ibe secretive. Uma izindinganiso ezithembisiwe zingahlangatshezwa, kufanele kwenziwe uxolo ezakhamizini, kubanikeze incazelo ephelele futhi kuphinde kunikezwe isixazululo esisheshayo nesisebenzayo, futhi uma kukhona izikhalazo, izakhamizi kufanele zithole impendulo enomusa futhi ewusizo. Amandla nokufuna ukwenza isenzo uma izinto zingahambi kahle akuwona umsebenzi obalulekile ekubekeni izindinganiso. Kufanele ukhuthaze impendulo ehhovisi lakho. Izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kufanele zinikezwe kahle futhi ngendlela efanele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamizi zithola ukusebenza kwezimali. Kufanele uqaphele izindawo lapho kudingeka khona ukonga futhi uthuthukise ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezizoholela ekongeni.

A.1 Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kahle nokusebenza kwezinhlinzeko kanye nemigomo yeMthethosisekelo mayelana nokusebenza kukahulumeni, bonke abasebenzi kulindeleke ukuthi bahloniphe futhi balandele le Khodi Yokuziphatha. A.2 Le Khodi izoba umhlahlandlela kubasebenzi mayelana nezilindelo zokuziphatha kwabo ngokwethembeka kanye nezixhumanisi abanezona nabanye abasebenzi. Ukuhlonipha le Khodi kulindeleke ukuthi kuthuthukise izinga lobuchwepheshe endaweni yokusebenza futhi kusize ekuqinisekiseni ukwethembana nokuqhakambisa uMnyango Wezokuthutha. A.3 Umsebenzi ngamunye unomthwalo wemfanelo wokuzilawula nokulandela imithetho ebekwe le Khodi. Ngokufanayo, abaphathi nabaphathiswa banomsebenzi wokwenza ukuthi le Khodi ilandelwe, futhi lokhu kufanele kwenzeke ngaphandle kokubandlululwa. A.4 Le Khodi Yokuziphatha ayihlosile ukuvimba intuthuko yomsebenzi kodwa ukuvikela amalungelo kaMnyango kanye nomsebenzi. B.1 Le Khodi iyengezo kuKhodi Yokuziphatha ebhekiswe esigabeni 2 seMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-2001, ehlanganisa bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kuhlanganiswa ukuthi ibhekisela ngqo ezidingweni zikaMnyango Wezokuthutha. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi kweKhodi Yokuziphatha YamaHhovisi Kahulumeni, njengale etholakala kuMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-2001, neKhodi Yokuziphatha kaMnyango, le yokugcina izolandela. B.2 Kunomneed wokufundisa abasebenzi mayelana nezixhumanisi zabo nomthetho, kanye nabaphethe amandla ezepolitiki nabaphathiswa, abanye abasebenzi, kanye nomphakathi, futhi kufanele bafundiswe nomoya okumele abasebenzi basebenze ngawo, nokuthi yini okufanele bayenze ukuze bagweme ukungqubuzana nezithakazelo, nokuthi yini elindelekile kubo mayelana neziziphatha zomphakathi nasempilweni yabo yangasese nasekusebenzeni. B.3 Nakuba le Khodi Yokuziphatha ibhalwe ukuhlanganisa konke, ayiyona iqoqo eliphelele lemigomo elawula izinga lokuziphatha. Nokho, uMphathi-Jikelele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7 (b) seMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-1994, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle koMnyango kanye nokugcina umthetho, phakathi kwezinye izinto, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza ukuthi ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi bakhe kuhambisane nokwethembeka nezimiso ezilawula amahhovisi kahulumeni kanye nemigomo efanele kanye nezinqubo njengoba kushiwo kulo Mthetho. B.4 Inhloso enkulu yale Khodi ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle. Ngakho-ke, umsebenzi angatholakala enecala lokuziphatha okungafanele futhi abhekane nenqubo yokwethulwa kwezinyathelo zokudinga uma izenzo zabo zingahambisani neKhodi Yokuziphatha noma uma kutholakala ukuthi baphule ezinye zezidingo zale Khodi. C.1.7 akuphuli noma iyiphi ingxenye yeKhodi Yokuziphatha ebekwe kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. C.2.11 ingaxhumana namalungu omphakathi nganoma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni uma nje kukhethwe umphakathi. C.2.14 akumele ibeke impilo yabanye noma eyayo engcupheni ngokungalandeli imithetho yokuphepha noma ngokuyigwema. C3.17 akumele ithathe ingxenye emibuthanweni ephikisana nezinga lokusebenza futhi engemthethweni. C.4.6 ingacela ukuthi ingathathi ingxenye ezinqumweni noma ezinyathelweni emsebenzini ezisemthethweni uma lokhu kungaholela ekutholeni inzuzo engafanele ngendlela engalungile, engakhethi, futhi ebandlululayo. C 4.16 ezimeni eziphuthumayo ingacelwa nguMphathi woMnyango ukuba enze imisebenzi ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi, noma uma kungesikhathi esijwayelekile sokusebenza kodwa kuyisimo esingaphansi kokulawulwa koMphathi woMnyango futhi sinesidingo esidinga isinyathelo esisheshayo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni. C.4.31 akumele iphule umthetho ezindaweni zomphakathi. C.5.3 akumele isebenzise isikhundla sayo emsebenzini ukuze ithole imiklomelo nokukhwabanisa umphakathi nezinye izinzuzo futhi ayikwazi ukwamukela noma yini uma kubonakala sengathi iyikhwabaniso. Yonke imiklomelo kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi ifakwe kwi-rejista yemiklomelo. C.6.1 ngezizathu zokuxhumana ngaphakathi, kufanele usebenzise isiNgisi njengolimi lokuxhumana futhi lokhu kufanele kube sobala kuzo zonke izenzo zomsebenzi zangaphakathi (okungukuthi, imibhalo, imihlangano, njll.). C 6.5 kufanele ihambisane nezindinganiso zobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana ngekhompyutha njengoba kushiwo. C.7.11 kufanele ikhuthaze isiko lokwethembana ngokwazisa njalo nokuqinisa. D.1. Bonke abaphathi nabasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazi kahle uMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-2001, Isahluko II, Umthetho 108 ka-1994, mayelana nemigomo nezinqubo zokuthatha izinyathelo zokudinga emahhovisi kahulumeni. Umkhakha Wokuphathwa Kwezabasebenzi uzosiza abaphathi nabasebenzi ngezinhlelo zokwazisa kanye nezinto ezisakazwa kubasebenzi. E.1 Abaphathi kufanele bahlale bezama ukuvimbela ukuvela kokunganeliseki nezikhalazo mayelana nokuphathwa nezinqubo zokuhola ezilungile. Bonke abaphathi nabasebenzi kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bayazi izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe uma kukhona inkinga edinga ukuxazululwa. Iph platform yokuphathwa kwezabasebenzi izodlala indima ekusekeleni ngokwazisa abaphathi nabasebenzi ngamalungelo nezibopho zabo. F.1 Zonke imibhalo ehlobene nezinyathelo zokudinga kufanele ibekwe endaweni ephethe ukuphathwa kwabantu, ezokuqinisekisa ukugcinwa kwazo ngokuphepha. F.2 Iph platform yokuphathwa kwezabasebenzi izobheka ukugcinwa kwemibiko yezibalo kanye nokubhaliswa kwemibiko ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni. F.3 UMnyango, abasebenzi bawo, kanye nezinyunyana kufanele bazibophezele ekugcineni nasekukhulumeni okuqukethwe kule Khodi Yokuziphatha.
Imithetho ngeke isebenze kumakhono athile nakwabanye. Isahluko 1 - Ababambiqhaza embonini yezeMkhumbi badinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Amakhono asebenza eNingizimu Afrika awavunyelwe ukuvimbela noma ukuhlinzeka ngokuphumelelayo kwezinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. UMsizi-Jikelele angayala ababambiqhaza ukuba baphinde bahlolisise izinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Ukususwa kwezinhlelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle kuyadingeka. Abasebenzi bemikhumbi bangahlola izinhlelo zokuphepha zamakhono. IBhodi ingayala abasebenzi bemikhumbi ukuba bahlolisise izinhlelo zokuphepha zamakhono. Le mithetho izobizwa ngokuthi Imithetho Yezokuthutha Kwezokuthutha (Ukwelapha Kwezokuphepha Kwezokuthutha) ka-2004. Lezi yizinye zezimiso ezizothatha umthelela ngosuku lokushicilelwa kwiGazethi Yombuso. Ukuze kufezwe le njongo, le mithetho isungula uhlaka oluhlose ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha zamakhono kanye nezinye izinyathelo zokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. Ukusetshenziswa kwalolu hlaka kuzovumela iRiphabhulikhi ukuba ihlangabezane nezibopho zayo ngaphansi kwesahluko IX - 2 seSivumelwano Sokuphepha Kwezokuthutha Olwandle kanye ne-ISPS Code. Umkhumbi wezimpahla ubhekisela kunoma iyiphi imikhumbi engesiyo imikhumbi yabagibeli, futhi ifaka... umqashi wezimpahla ubhekisela kumuntu osebenza nezimpahla ezisetshenziswa emkhumbini... I-ISSC esemthethweni uma ibhekisela kumakhono ngaleso sikhathi ibhekisela ku-ISSC yomkhumbi osebenza ngaleso sikhathi. Ngokwenzela le mithetho, umkhumbi uhlobo olubhekiswe ku-regulation-10 1 uthathwa njengokuthi usetshenziswe kwezokuthutha olwandle uma usetshenziswa njengomkhumbi waleso sikhathi. Iphothi elilawulwa ukuze kuphumelele ukuphepha, noma ingxenye yaleyo phothi noma noma yisiphi isikhathi lapho le phothi, noma ingxenye yaleyo phothi ilawulwa kuphela nguMnyango Wezokuphepha Kazwelonke waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha komkhumbi osengozini ngokudlulisa ulwazi olungelona iqiniso. Iphothi iyindawo yamanzi, umhlaba namanzi (kuhlanganise nezakhiwo, imishini ehlobene futhi esebenzayo etholakala kulowo mhlaba noma emanzini) ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kwazo zonke noma ingxenye yayo ephathelene nokunyakaza, ukulayisha, ukuhlinzeka, ukugcinwa noma ukuhlinzekwa kwemikhumbi. Indawo yamanzi evulekile ehlelelwe ukuxhasa noma ukubamba imikhumbi ngaphambi kokuthi ingene endaweni yamanzi ebhekiswe esigabeni a; futhi c indawo yamanzi evulekile phakathi kwezindawo zamanzi ezichazwe ezigabeni a no-b. a ehlelelwe ukusetshenziswa kwazo zonke noma ingxenye yayo ephathelene nokunyakaza, ukulayisha noma ukuhlinzeka, ukulungisa noma ukuhlinzeka ngemikhumbi elawulwa ukuphepha; futhi b echazwe ngokuxhumana 1. UMsizi-Jikelele ngokuphuma kwesaziso kwiGazethi Yombuso, angakhetha umuntu ukuze asebenze ephothini elawulwa ukuphepha. c imibono yomuntu, abantu abathintekayo ekuphathweni kokusebenza kwephothi. b umkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe. c indawo yokuwela ehlala noma ekuthuthweni emanzini aseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kugwenywe ukudideka, indawo yokuwela ehlala ebhekiswe ku-regulation-1 c ithathwa njengomkhumbi ngenhloso yale mithetho. Umkhumbi ungumkhumbi olawulwa kwelinye izwe uma lowo mkhumbi... omunye umkhumbi; noma v iphothi, esetshenziswa ephothini noma ngenye indlela ixhumene nephothi; futhi d isenzo sibalulekile kulolu simo. a umuntu udinga ukuhambisana nemiyalo yokuphepha; futhi b ukuhambisana nemiyalo kusho ukuthi lowo muntu uphule umthetho ngokwephula leyo mfuneko noma ukuphula umthetho noma le mithetho, lowo muntu, uma ehambisana nemiyalo yokuphepha, uthathwa njengokungakwenzi icala noma ukuphula okudingekayo. Umuntu, uma ehambisana nemiyalo yokulawula, uthathwa njengokungakwenzi icala noma ukuphula okudingekayo. Ngokwenzela le mithetho, umuntu anganikeza isaziso noma imiyalo noma axhumane nokusebenza komkhumbi ngokunikeza lowo muntu isaziso noma imiyalo noma axoxe nommeleli walowo mkhumbi. c iphothi elawulwa ukuphepha; futhi d ababambiqhaza embonini yezeMkhumbi. e Imisebenzi eyenziwa yilabo ababambiqhaza embonini yezeMkhumbi ephathelene noma ngokuhambisana nezindawo ezilawulwa ukuphepha. UMsizi-Jikelele ngokubhala angakhipha umthetho futhi izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle-2 noma izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle-3 elisebenza kumakhono asebenza kwezinye izizwe. a ngemuva kokubonisana ne-NICOC; futhi b kuqinisekiswa ukuthi ilungile ukuze kwakhiwe ukuphepha okuphezulu kule phothi, umkhumbi, indawo noma ababambiqhaza ngenxa yokuphazamiseka okuphezulu kokuthutha olwandle okungavunyelwe okungase kubonakale. b uma isikhumbuzo sikhanseliwe ngokubhala nguMsizi-Jikelele. b noma yisiphi isenzo esithathwe ngumuntu ophakathi embonini yezeMkhumbi. Uhlelo lokuphepha lwalesi sikhumbuzo lungalandelwa uma kuphela izinyathelo ezibhekiswe kulolo hlelo lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle zisetshenziswa. Imiyalo yokuphepha inikezwa mayelana nephothi, umkhumbi, indawo, ababambiqhaza noma ukusebenza, amazinga okuphepha akhona aqhubeka nokusebenza. Uma uMsizi-Jikelele ekhuluma ukuthi izinga lokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle elisebenzayo ephothini ethile, uMsizi-Jikelele angazisa ngokushesha... i ukulawula indawo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle ii ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle. i ukulawula indawo ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi yokuphepha kwezokuthutha olwandle; noma ii ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwemingcele yephothi elawulwa ukuphepha; futhi b umphathi womkhumbi olawulwa ukuphepha kule phothi noma mayelana nokungena kule phothi. Uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kwehluleka ukuhambisana ne-regulation-3, kuzoba icala elizokwenziwa uma kutholakala icala, kuzofanele kube necebo noma baphathwe isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili. I-regulation 3 ayisebenzi uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kunesizathu esifanele. a ukusebenza kwalowo mkhumbi; noma b umphathi womkhumbi. Uma uMsizi-Jikelele ezisa ukusebenza komkhumbi njengoba kuchaziwe ku-regulation 1 ngenhla, ukusebenza komkhumbi kumele ngokushesha kudlulise leso saziso kumphathi ofanele womkhumbi. Uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kwehluleka ukuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe ku-regulation 2 ngenhla, kuzoba icala, uma kutholakala icala, kuzofanele kube necebo noma baphathwe isikhathi esingaphansi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili. I-regulation 3 ayisebenzi uma ukusebenza komkhumbi kunesizathu esifanele. a ababambiqhaza embonini yezeMkhumbi abaphethe le ndawo; futhi b Uma ababambiqhaza engesiyo ukusebenza komkhumbi, azise ukusebenza komkhumbi. a ababambiqhaza; futhi b uma ababambiqhaza benza isenzo esikhulunywe esikhaleni ngaphakathi kwephothi elawulwa ukuphepha futhi engesiyo ukusebenza komkhumbi,

"isici esingamukeleki" sisho okuthile okungcolile ngokwezincazelo zomthetho ngaphansi koMthetho Womkhiqizo Wezinsiza, uMthetho Wokuhlobisa Nezibulali-zinambuzane, kanye "nezimo zokudla eziphakanyisiwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezempilo" kuchaza izimo ezijwayelekile zezindawo zokudla ezithile kanye nezokuthutha kwakho njengoba kushicilelwe kuGazethi Yesaziso No. izinkomo eziyishumi noma izinkunzi eziyisithupha; noma izinkomo ezincane ezine noma izinkomo ezimbili ezibhalwe noma inkunzi eyodwa. Ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwezikhungo zokubulala, udwebo lwesakhiwo esiphakanyisiwe kumele lunikezwe kumphakathi wesifunda ukuze luhlolwe futhi lwamukelwe. b iyisethi ephelele yezithombe zesakhiwo sesikhungo, uma kungesakhiwo esifanayo nalokho okukhulunywe ngakho ku-21 ngenhla. b kufanele kuthunyelwe kuleli bhokisi; noma c kufanele kuthunyelwe ngekhoriyeli, i-imeyili noma ezinye izindlela eziphuthumayo kum owner, uma nje idokhumenti yokuqala ithunyelwa kum owner phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe zokuthumela isaziso. q uma kungekho izinsiza zokunakekela izilwane ezilindele ukuhlolwa ezikhungweni zokubulala, lezo zinsiza kufanele zitholwe kwenye indawo, ngokuvunywa komphakathi wesifunda. ukuze kuhlanzeke futhi kuhlanzeke imishini esetshenzisiwe z kufanele kube nendawo yokuhlanza imoto ethutha inyama. gg akukho facility yokuhlanza imoto enikeziwe yokuthutha inyama. k akukho zinsiza ezitholakalayo zokumunca ukuze kulawulwe ukuhamba. ivikelwe ngezinyathelo eziyisisekelo zokuvikela ukungena kwezinto eziyingozi noma ukungcoliswa, igesi, ukuhamba, iphunga, umusi, uthuli, umswakama, izinyoni, nezinye izinto noma ukuphazamiseka kwenyama, amakhemikhali, noma okunye okukhuluma ngokungcoliswa. Zonke izindawo zangaphandle kufanele zibe zihlanzekile futhi zingabi nothuli. Akukho mfula namanzi okukhukhuleka anikeziwe. Izikhungo zokubulala kufanele zibe nohlelo oluvinjelwe lwamanzi nezinsiza zokulahla odakeni ukuze kungene endaweni efanele yamapayipi amanzi angcolile. Izindawo zokulayisha nokukhipha izimoto kufanele zivikela, ziqinile, futhi zibe nephiko. d ukugcina inyama ethunjiwe nokuhlolwa kwayo kufanele kwenziwe ngaphandle kokungcolisa leyo nyama. n yonke imishini, izakhiwo, nezinsiza ezibekwe odongeni kufanele zibe okungenani 50mm kude. c akufanele kube ne-oyili yenyama. iziqukathi zokugcina inyama kufanele zihambisane nesigaba 1, uma phezulu naphansi kunezikhala kufanele zenzelwe ukuthi inyama ingaphumi ezikhala noma ithinte phansi. Amathoyilethi nezindawo zokuhlala kufanele akhiwe endaweni ehlukile enikeza emnyango ehlukile ezindaweni zokushintsha. wonke amathoyilethi kufanele ahlome ngezikhwama zokubeka iphepha lokuhlanza, izikhwama zokuhlanza izandla, izikhwama zokuphakela ugesi ezibulala amagciwane, nezinsiza zokomisa izandla. Izindawo zokushintsha nezitho zokuhlala akufanele zifinyelele ngqo endaweni noma igumbi lapho inyama igcinwa khona. Abasebenzi kufanele bahlinzekwe nendawo yokuvula izinto zabo lapho begcina izinto zabo zomuntu zihluke kwezokusebenza, lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto zomuntu nezokusebenza zihlanzekile azihlanganisi. Abasebenzi kufanele bahlinzekwe ngezinto ezivikela ezivela ezinyonini lapho begcina ukudla. b gwema ukungcoliswa nezinsiza zokuhlanza ngokupheka imishini nezinsiza zokusebenza, okungabandakanya amahhashi namabhakede, kuzohlanza ngamanzi afudumele ku-82°C ngesikhathi sokubulala. c kufanele kube ne-oyili yokufaka nokuphuma kanye ne-pipe yokukhipha eholela endaweni evulekile, amanzi akhishwe kule ndawo akufanele aphume endaweni edlule izimoto. Noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuhlanza ngokupheka kufanele ivunywe umphakathi wesifunda. f kufanele bahlinzekwe ngebhakede elibamba ugesi obulala amagciwane kanye nezinsiza zokomisa izandla ngaphandle kokuthi kungekho mfuneko yokomisa izandla endaweni lapho kukhona isikhwama sokuhlanza izandla. Amakabine okugeza adingekayo ezikhungweni zokubulala ezikhiqiza ngaphansi nangaphezulu kufanele abekwe eduzane nezindawo zokusebenza ukuze kuvinjwe ukuhamba kwamanzi lapho abasebenzi behlanza ama-apron abawasebenzisayo futhi la makabine kufanele avumele ukuhamba kwamanzi ngqo endaweni efanele yephunga elingcolile noma umfula. Amanzi kufanele abe namandla futhi ahambisane okungenani neKholomu II esunguliwe ku-SANS 241 yokuphuza. c isondo eligcina ama-pipes akufanele lihlale phansi ngaphandle kwamapayipi abekwe odongeni. Izinsiza zokugcina ukuvikela ukuhweba nezinto ezingabuyiswanga ezihambisana nezikhwama ezivala ngokuqinile futhi zihambisane ne-clause-14 kufanele zikhishwe ukuze zigcine futhi zithuthe izinto eziphukile futhi kufanele zibe nokubhalwa "AKUSIYONA IMISEBENZI". Kumele kube nezikhwama zokuhlanganisa nokugcina izinto eziphukile ezidinga ukulahleka. Kumele kube nendawo yokuhlanganisa nokugcina igazi ngaphambi kokuthi ilahleke. Isikhwama sokulahla kumele sikwazi ukuhamba udoti ezindaweni ezahlukene ngaphakathi kwezindawo. Izindawo zokugcina udoti nezikhwama zodoti ngaphambi kokukhipha kumele zibe zihlanzekile, zikhukhuleke, futhi zingabi namanzi futhi kumele zivalwe noma zibe nezikhwama eziqinile. g kufanele kube nokukhanya okwanele uma izilwane zikhishwa ebusuku. d kufanele kube nezimo ezingaphansi kuka-1m ezisetshenziselwa ukubeka izilwane ezitholakele kufanele zakhiwe ngodonga oluqinile kanye nesango futhi akumele kuvunyelwe ukuba zixubane nezinye izikhala noma kudaleke ingozi yokungcolisa ezinye izilwane. c ukudla kwezilwane kufanele kugcinwe endaweni evikelwe yokugcina ezinyonini futhi eyenzelwe lokhu, uma ukudla kufanele kugcinwe ngaphakathi kwezindawo. c 0.50m² inkunzi encane, imbuzi noma ingane. Izikhala kufanele zibe nezaziso ezikhombisa inani lezinhlobo ezithile ezingangena esikhala noma endaweni. c akufanele kube ngaphansi kuka-1. d kufanele kugcinwe kahle futhi kungabi nezinto eziphakanyisiwe. Izindawo zokudla kufanele zibe zihlanzekile futhi zingabi nezinto eziphakanyisiwe. kufanele kube ngendlela egcina indawo yaphansi nezikhala zokukhipha amanzi aziphume. Indawo yokudla izinkomo phakathi kwesikhala nendawo lapho zibulawa khona kufanele ibe nobubanzi obungaphezu kuka-0.9m. Indawo yokudla kufanele ihlelwe ngendlela efihlekile endaweni yokubulala. Ingxenye yendawo yokudla eholela ebhokisini lokubulala kufanele ibe nez sides eziqinile. d noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuvimbela evunywe umphakathi wesifunda. c enye ithuluzi elivunywe ngumbuso. Izindawo zokubulala ezibekwe kahle kufanele zikhonjiswe ezindaweni zokubulala izilwane noma endaweni ethile. Imishini kufanele ihlinzeke ngokuqinisa nokuphakamisa izilwane ezibekwe kahle ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwegazi. Kumele kube nezinto zokuhlanganisa nokugcina igazi ezikhwameni ezivaliwe ngaphambi kokuthi kukhishwe. a mayelana nokuphuma kwegazi kwezinkomo, ukusuka emfuleni phansi, ngama-4.8 meters
Ukuba nomqondo ophumelelayo, ukusebenza kahle, nokugxila ekuthuthukiseni ngokukhula kungaba umphumela wezinyathelo zabantu abadala ngokwabo, ngokukhula kwenani labo kanye nomthelela wabo. Ulwazi oluqoqwe ndawonye mayelana nokuguga, njengomqondo wokuhlanganisa emphakathini, lungaba yinto enhle (Uhlelo Lwamazwe Ngamazwe Lokusebenza Ngokuqhubeka Nokuguga 1/para. 32). Inani elikhulayo lemindeni ethintwe yisifo se-HIV/AIDS lithinta impilo yabantu abadala. Imiphumela yezenzakalo ze-HIV/AIDS iphula imindeni. Inani elikhulayo lezingane ezingenabazali ngenxa yokufa kwabazali ngenxa yezifo ezihlobene ne-HIV/AIDS kusho ukuthi kuphela abantu abadala abasala ukuze banakekele lezi zingane. Abantu abadala emindenini ethintwe yisifo se-HIV/AIDS bathola ukuthi babhekene nomthwalo omkhulu wokunakekela umuntu ogulayo noma ophumile emndenini kanye nokunakekela abazukulu babo ababe sebezingeni lezingane ezingenabazali. Kuvame ukucatshangwa ukuthi imindeni ethintwe yisifo se-HIV/AIDS inganakekela amalungu ayo agulayo. Abantu abane-HIV/AIDS badinga impilo, amandla, izinsiza zezimali, kanye nokuzinikela okuqinile ukuze bazame kakhulu ukuthola lezi zinto. Izitifiketi zokuzalwa zezizukulwane zabo. (Lokhu kuyinkinga evamile kubantu abadala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ikakhulukazi kulabo abantwana babo bahlala emadolobheni noma ezweni elizungezile). I-stigma ehambisana ne-HIV/AIDS ibangela abantu abadala ukuba babe nokukhathazeka kakhulu njengoba bezama ukubhekana nokufa kwamalungu omndeni. Njengoba abantu abadala kufanele babhekane nokusiza izingane zifanele ukujwayela indawo entsha ngaphandle kwabazali bazo. Abantu abadala bangaba abakhathaleli bemvelo futhi kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okuyisisekelo abakudingayo ukuze babhekane nomthwalo owengeziwe wokunakekela amalungu omndeni agulayo kanye nezizukulwane zabo ezingenabazali, ikakhulukazi ngenxa ye-HIV/AIDS. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela abantu abadala ngomsebenzi wabo emnothweni wezwe ngezandla zabo futhi banakekele abazukulu babo uma abazali babo besebenza noma befile ngenxa yesifo se-HIV/AIDS. Izinsizakalo zokwelulekwa kwezempilo yengqondo zemindeni ethintwe yisifo se-HIV/AIDS. Lokhu kwenziwa futhi ngamaqembu omphakathi asebenzisanayo, abhekana nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo nezemizwa zamalungu omndeni athintekile. Ulwazi olusakazwa ngezinhlaka ezichazayo mayelana nokuthi ungathola kanjani usizo lomphakathi nokwazi amalungelo akho njengomfana kubalulekile. Umkhakha wezebhizinisi, izwe, izinhlangano zenkolo, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni nazo ziye zanceda ngokunikeza usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi ezidinga usizo zithola lokho.
Isinqumo seNkantolo yeMithetho mayelana necala 'Bhe nabanye v Magistrate Khayelitsha nabanye Inombolo yeCala 49/03, isinqumo esakhishwa ngomhla ka-15 Novemba 2004, sathola ukuthi ingxenye 23 yeMthetho Wokuphatha Omdala WamaNtu 38 ka-1927 kanye neSaziso soMphakathi R200 semithetho ekhishwe kuSaziso soMphakathi 10601 sika-6 February 1987 ayihambisani nemthethosisekelo. Ngokuhambisana nomongo wesinqumo seBhe, uMnyango wezeMthetho kanye Nokuthuthukiswa KweMithetho kufanele uthuthukise futhi usebenzise uhlelo oluhlangene lokubheka ukuphathwa kwezindlu ezishonile ngendlela ehambelana nezidingo zomphakathi zamaNingizimu Afrika bonke ngaphandle kokucwasa ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ubudala, noma ukuzalwa. UJaji Omkhulu kufanele athathe ukulawula ukuhlela zonke izindlu ezishonile. Zonke izindlu kufanele ziphathwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphatha Izindlu 66 ka-1965 njengoba kuguqulwe. Zonke izindlu zabantu abashonile abangakabeki ukuthi bafuna ukuphathwa kanjani kufanele ziphathwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle 81 ka-1987, njengoba kuguqulwe. UMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle uthola ulwazi esinqumweni seBhe ukuhlinzeka ngalesi simo lapho umufi wayeshade ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Abaholi bendabuko bayalahlekelwa amandla abo okuphatha nokubheka izindlu zabantu abashonile. Nokho, kuzodingeka baqedele izindaba ezibikwe kubo ngaphambi komhla ka-15 Novemba 2004 noma ngaphambi kwalolo suku. Kumele baqedele zonke lezi zindlu ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle. Ngemuva kwesinqumo seBhe, phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kosuku lwe-6 December 2002, lapho isinqumo sikaMoseneke sathatha amandla, umthwalo wokubheka ukuphathwa kwezindlu ezishonile wawugxile kakhulu kubuholi bendabuko. UJaji Omkhulu wabheka ukuphathwa kwezindlu zabamhlophe, abamnyama, amaHindi, nabantu abamnyama abangakabeki abalandeli. Amandla kaJaji Omkhulu kanye namandla akhe (okstill asebenza) abekwe kuMthetho Wokuphatha Izindlu 66 ka-1965 njengoba kuguqulwe. Umphakathi endaweni lapho umufi wayehlala khona wayenobungozi bokubheka ukuphathwa kwempahla yomuntu omnyama oshonile ngaphandle kokubeka abalandeli kanye nokuphathwa kwempahla yakhe. Umphakathi wathola amandla esigabeni 23 seMthetho Wokuphatha Omdala WamaNtu 38 ka-1927 kanye nemithetho ekhishwe kuSaziso soMphakathi R200 kuGazethi yoMphakathi 10601 ka-6 February 1987. Impahla yomuntu omnyama ngemuva kokushona kwakhe ayiphathwanga nguMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle 81 ka-1987. Lokhu kwenzeka ezimweni ezimbili. Esimweni sokuqala, lapho umufi akhombisa ngesikhathi ephila ukuthi akafuni ukuphila ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wesiko. NgokweSaziso soMphakathi R200, le mfuno iboniswe ngezindlela ezimbili: lapho umufi efaka isicelo sesitifiketi sokukhululwa ekusebenzeni komthetho wamaZulu, ngaphansi kwesigaba 31 seMthetho Wokuphatha Omdala WamaNtu, kanye lapho ebeka umshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiNgisi ngaphandle kokubanjwa ubuholi bendabuko. Okwesibili, impahla yomufi ayikwazi ukuphathwa nguMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle uma uNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho wayenombono wokuthi kuzoba kubi kwezinye izimo ukusabalalisa impahla ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wesiko. Izithakazelo ezithintekayo zizokwenza uNgqongqoshe athole isinqumo ngalesi. Esikhathini sesibili, phakathi kosuku lwe-6 December 2002 no-15 November 2004, uJaji Omkhulu wayenamandla okuphatha zonke izindlu zabantu abashonile ngokulandela izimiso zomthetho wesiNgisi kanti umphakathi wayenamandla okuphatha izindlu zabantu abashonile ngokulandela umthetho wesiko. UJaji Omkhulu wayebamba amandla akhe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Izindlu kanti abaphakanyisi babebamba amandla ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphatha Omdala WamaNtu kanye nemithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalolo mthetho. Esikhathini sesithathu, ngemuva kosuku lwe-15 November 2004, uJaji Omkhulu uzobheka ukuphathwa kwezindlu zonke zabantu abashonile ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle. Zonke izindlu ezishiywe ngabantu ngaphandle kokubhala izifiso zabo zizophathwa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle ezihambelana nezinguquko ezidingekayo ukuhlinzeka ngoshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinguquko ezilethwe yisinqumo seBhe zinefekthini yokubuyisela isimo emuva ku-27 March 1994 mayelana nezindlu ezingakaze ziphothulwe. Impumelelo yohlelo olusha izoqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baphathwa ngokufanayo futhi inhlonipho yabo iyahlonishwa. Ngokubheka isimo sangempela mayelana nabantu abashonile ngaphambi kosuku lwe-27 March 1994 kanye nezimo ezingabikiwe, lezi zindlu kufanele ziqondiswe kuJaji Omkhulu. UJaji Omkhulu (ofisi kaJaji Omkhulu kanye nezikhungo zikaJaji Omkhulu) kufanele aphathe zonke izindlu lapho umufi ashona ngemuva kosuku lwe-27 March 1994. Impahla izophathwa futhi iphathwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuphatha Izindlu. Uma umufi eshona ngaphandle kokubeka abalandeli noma ekhuluma izifiso zabo, impahla kufanele ihlukaniswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhlala Ngaphandle. Lezi yizindaba okufanele ziphothulwe umphakathi ngokuhambisana nesinqumo seBhe. Isimo lapho umufi ebhala izifiso zabo zokwabelana ngempahla yabo (umbhalo). Inani lempahla (noma inani elilinganisiwe) lidlula u-R50,000. Impahla iyisikhala esingenalutho (izikweletu zidlula impahla). Omunye noma abaningi bezinzuzo kufanele babe ngaphansi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili nanye futhi basizwe ngummeleli wabo. Omunye noma abaningi bezinzuzo kufanele babe ngaphansi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili nanye futhi impahla inenani eliphelele noma elingxenye elidlula u-R20,000. Uma noma iyiphi yezizathu ezishiwo ngenhla ifaneleka, impahla kufanele idluliselwe kwiOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu endaweni umufi ayekhona. Bonke abatholi kufanele babe namandla okusebenza ngokuzimela noma omunye noma abaningi balabo abatholi kufanele babe ngabantwana futhi basizwe ngummeleli wabo, kanti impahla yezezimali ibalwe ku-R20,000 noma ngaphansi. Isikhungo sokusiza sizoba namandla phezu kwempahla yomuntu owayengumuntu ojwayelekile ngesikhathi sokushona ngaphakathi kwemingcele yeOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu lapho Isikhungo Sokwesiza sitholakala khona. Lapho isicelo siqedile ngokuphelele futhi akukho ezinye izimfuneko ezidingekayo ukuze kukhishwe isitifiketi sokubekwa. Lapho isicelo singaqedelwa ngenxa yezinye izimfuneko ezidingekayo futhi kukhona Isikhungo Sokwesiza esiseduzane neOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu yomfaki-sicelo, uJaji Omkhulu kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ngalesi simo. Amandla okubeka iOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu ngalolu sizo akhishwa kumuntu onolwazi owafakile isicelo. Uma ethumela ummeleli wakhe ngaphansi kwesigaba 18, uJaji
Kwakhiwa umhlahlandlela ukuze kuthuthukiswe amandla omnotho abantu abamnyama; ukuze kuqinisekiswe uNgqongqoshe ukuthi akhiphe imithetho futhi ahlukanise uhlaka lokuguqulwa; ukuze kwakhiwe ikomidi lehlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Kwabantu Abamnyama; nokulungiselela izinto ezihlobene nalokhu. NGOKUQHUBEKA ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhala somthetho sokulingana, ukuze kwandiswe ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abamnyama emnothweni nokukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho okuphezulu, ukuze kwandiswe amathuba emisebenzi nokwabiwa okufanele kwemiholo. "okunqunywe" kubhekisela kulokho okunqunywe umthetho ophakanyisiwe; futhi lo Mthetho uhlanganisa imithetho noma izinhlinzeko zomthetho ezikhishwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uxhaso lwenziwa ezinhlelweni ezizoholela ekwandiseni ukubamba iqhaza komnotho kwabantu abamnyama ukuze kufezwe intuthuko nokuqhubeka; nokuthi imiphakathi yasemakhaya ithuthukiswe futhi imiphakathi yasendaweni igqugquzelwe ukufinyelela emisebenzini yezomnotho, umhlaba, izakhiwo, ubunikazi, nezakhono. a ngendlela ehambisana nezinhloso zayo eziyisisekelo; futhi b ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo. Ikomidi lehlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Kwabantu Abamnyama liyakhiwa. Ikomidi kumele linikeze uNgqongqoshe izeluleko ngokuqhubeka komnotho kwabantu abamnyama. Ikomidi lizoba noMongameli namanye amalungu ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo le Ikomidi. UMongameli uzoba ngumholi we Ikomidi. Ikomidi ngokwalo lingakha emthethweni walo izimo zokubekwa kwemalungu alo, inani lamalungu emhlanganweni, izinqubo, nezinye izinto ezithinta umgomo walo wokusebenza. UNgqongqoshe, ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe WezeMali, anganquma izimali ezizokhokhela izindleko ezibangelwa amalungu e Ikomidi. iziqondiso zezakhamuzi zonke nezindawo ezihlobene ukuze zibhale uhlaka lokuguqulwa kulolo mkhakha. a ikha izinqubo zokukhetha uma izimvume zikhishwe, noma noma iyiphi enye imvume eyenziwe ngaphansi kwanoma yiluphi umthetho; futhi b ithuthukisa futhi iqhube izinqubo zokukhetha uma kuqokwa. Iphalamende Lezohwebo Nezimboni kumele linikeze Ikomidi usizo oludingekayo nokuxhaswa kwezezimali okuhlinzekwe yiPhalamende ngenhloso le. a ukuze kwakhiwe futhi kusebenze Ikomidi; futhi b ukuthuthukisa nokuphumeza uhlelo lokwazisa umphakathi. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe imithetho ethile mayelana nanoma yisiphi isihloko okufanele anqume ngaso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufezeka kahle kwalolu Mthetho. Lo Mthetho uzobizwa ngokuthi iBroad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act ka-2003, futhi uzongena emthethweni ngosuku oluzonqunywa uMongameli ngokuqhamuka kokwaziswa kwiGazethi. Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika awukwazi ukusebenza ngokuphelele ngoba iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika lithola imiholo ephansi futhi lisalokhu lihlukaniswe ekubeni ngabanikazi bezimpahla ezingaphatheki kahle nezakhono. Lokhu kubangela umonakalo kuwo wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokwandisa ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika emnothweni. Umthetho ophakanyisiwe wehlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Kwabantu Abamnyama (obizwa ngokuthi "umthetho ophakanyisiwe" lapha) ungomunye wezinyathelo eziphumelelayo ezithathwe nguhulumeni ukuze abhekane nalolu daba. Ikomidi Lezeluleko Lehlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Kwabantu Abamnyama (obizwa ngokuthi "ikomidi" lapha) iyinhlangano yokweluleka ephakanyisiwe. Usizo nokuxhaso kuzohlinzekwa yiPhalamende Lezohwebo Nezimboni (obizwa ngokuthi "DTI" lapha) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukugcina amabhizinisi abamnyama futhi aphathwe ngabantu abamnyama. ukuze kugqugquzelwe imiphakathi yasemakhaya nezasekhaya. Kulindeleke ukuthi amalungu e Ikomidi angakhokhelwa izindleko zawo futhi ukuthi ukusungulwa nokusebenza kwe Ikomidi kuzoxhaswa ngombono ohloswe kuPhalamende Lezohwebo Nezimboni (DTI). Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi i-GCIS (Uhlelo Lokuxhumana Nokwazisa Hulumeni) kanye ne-DTI kuthuthukiswe uhlelo oluphelele mayelana nokuthuthukiswa komnotho kwabantu abamnyama jikelele kanye nalolu mthetho ophakanyisiwe ngokukhethekile.
Ukufika kuk governo elikhethwe ngentando yabantu kuletha imithetho eminingi emphakathini wethu, imithetho efana nelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi, ukuba negunya, nokuba ngum citizen. Ukuze lokhu kube nencazelo futhi ukuze uhulumeni wethu omusha okhethwe ngentando yabantu ukhule, ukufinyelela ulwazi kubalulekile. Ukufinyelela ulwazi kuyilungelo eliyisisekelo elivumela abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezicacile futhi kubavumela ukuba bafinyelele ezinsizeni ezihlinzekwa ngabeziHulumeni. I-Department of Social Development inezibopho zokukhuthaza amalungelo abantu. Yingakho sidale futhi siqhubeke nokugcina i-manifesto, esebenza njengethuluzi lokukhuthaza ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe yiDepartment. "Ukuthuthukisa ukuphela kobuphofu": kuyisihloko esibekwe nguMongameli Thabo Mbeki, kuyisithembiso sethu njenge-Department of Social Development futhi sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu akukwazi ukwenzeka ngaphandle kokuthi abantu babe nokufinyelela ulwazi esizimisele ukusihlinzeka ngakho ngokuqinile. Inhloso yethu ukuthi le manifesto ifinyeleleke kuzo zonke izigaba ezihlelwe ngohlanga, ubuzwe, nolimi ngokusebenzisa zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye kuhlanganise ne-braille nezinye izinhlobo zokuxhumana ukuze kubhekwe zonke izinhlobo zokukhubazeka. Nokho, le manifesto izoshicilelwa kuqala ngesiZulu, isiSetswana, isiTshivenda, nesiSepedi. Sithemba ukuthi ukushicilelwa kwesibili kuzohlanganisa nezinye izilimi kuze kube zonke izingxenye zomphakathi zimele kahle. Ngiyethemba futhi ngilungelo lokwethula kini i-manifesto ka-2002/2003 ye-Department of Social Development, ezokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ngezinsizakalo esihlinzekayo. Ngiyethemba futhi ngilungelo lokwethula le manifesto kini - abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yale manifesto ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekile ukufinyelela kalula kolwazi olugcinwe yi-Department of Social Development ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe ngakho emthethweni, ikakhulukazi isigaba 32, esithi "Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe nguHulumeni." Le manifesto yakhiwe ngokuhambisana neMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, (Umthetho No.-2 ka-2000). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimiso ze-Batho-Pele zivumela ukufinyelela okufanayo ezinsizeni, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinsizakalo zomphakathi okuyilungelo lenu lokuthola. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uzothola le manifesto iyasiza futhi iyazisa. I-National Department of Social Development - Umthetho No. 3 Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi. Imininingwane ngaphansi kwesigaba 14 seMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, No. I-Department of Social Development inezibopho zokuthuthukisa imigomo kazwelonke nemithetho, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwazwelonke nezindinganiso, ukweseka umsebenzi oqhubekayo kwi-Provincial Departments of Social Development, ukuqaphela nokuhlola izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinqubo zokuthuthukiswa. Ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuyinqubo eqhubekayo ehambisana nesithembiso semiphakathi ehlukene ehlose ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emphakathini okuyisibopho esikhaleni seziHulumeni zendawo. Ukubuyisela ubuntu bokukhathalela nokuthuthukisa abantu kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha kabusha imindeni nemiphakathi. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa amasu aqondile ukuze kuphumelelwe ukunciphisa ubuphofu obuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithile kulabo abadinga usizo, ngokususelwa emandleni nasekuthuthukiseni umphakathi. Ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokuphepha komphakathi oluyinhloko oluhlanganisa imizamo yokuhlinzeka nokungahlinzeki ngoxhaso nokuphakamisa imindeni ethintwe kakhulu. Ukubhekana nemiphumela yezenzo zokuhlukumeza ezihlasela abesifazane nezingane, kanye namasu okuphatha abahlaseli. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lokuthanda nokukhathalela abantu abaphila ne-HIV/AIDS noma i-AIDS uqobo kanye nalabo abathintekayo, njengabantu abangenamakhaya be-AIDS. Ukuthuthukisa isu lesizwe lokunciphisa ubugebengu bezinsizwa nokungasebenzi ngaphansi kweNational Framework for Crime Prevention. Ukwenza umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ufinyeleleke futhi utholakale kubantu abaphila ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ezindaweni ezikude nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kanye nokuqinisekisa ukulingana ekufinyeleleni usizo. Ukusekela umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ngokuzibophezela ekubambeni uhulumeni okuhlanganisa umsebenzi wezinhlelo ezahlukene zabeziHulumeni nemiphakathi. Ukuqeqesha, ukufundisa, ukuhlela kabusha, nokuhlinzeka ngabasebenzi abasha. I-Department of Social Development igcina imibhalo enezihloko ezahlukene. Wonke ulwazi oluhambelana nokwembulwa luhlelwa ngohlelo lwezinhlaka njengoba kuchaziwe etafuleni elingezansi. Imibhalo ihlelwa ngendlela yethebula. Ezinye imibhalo ithunyelwa ezinhlelweni ezithile, kanti ezinye zisezingeni eliphezulu, kanti ezinye ziseNhliziyweni. "Imibhalo" ithunyelwa ezinsizakalweni ezahlukene, ngokwesibonelo. Imibhalo egxile noma ethathwe kumarekhodi, imibhalo egcinwe ezinsizeni zezimali noma kumabhroshuru wokukhangisa kwamakhompyutha. Uhlelo: Njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla embhalweni, kube nezinguquko ohlelweni lwezinhlaka. Ucelwa ukuthi uxhumane noJaco Victor ukuze uthole incazelo mayelana nezinguquko zakamuva ezizokwenziwa ngokucacile nangokufanele ngezansi. Imibhalo yocwaningo eshicilelwe enezibalo zabantu nezindaba zokuthuthukiswa, ezikhiqizwe yi-HSRC, MRC, DBSA, izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, njll. Le mibhalo egcinwe ihlelwa ngalezi zigaba ezilandelayo, ngokwesibonelo: ezomthetho, ezimali, ezokuphatha, izindaba zomsebenzi, nezinye. Imihlangano Imizuzu, njll. Imibhalo yokuphatha, imibhalo egcinwe ezindaweni, njll. Ukuze ucele ulwazi, gcwalisa ifomu elihlanganiswe neFomu-C bese ulithumela kumuntu ohambisana naye kwi-Department of Social Development. Umfanekiso wesicelo nenqubo yokulandela lapho uthumela khona ukukhala ulandela iFomu-C. Qaphela: Isifinyezo "S" kulesi sithombe sikhuluma ngesigaba esihlobene neMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi. Umfakisicelo ofuna ukufinyelela kumibhalo egcinwe equkethe ulwazi lomuntu ngaye akadingeki ukukhokha leyo sicelo. Noma ubani omunye ofaka isicelo solwazi olungahlangene naye kufanele akhokhe imali yesicelo efanele ukuze kuhlolwe ukukhokha, bheka iGovernment Notice R. 187 kuGovernment Gazette etholakala ngomhla ka-15 kuMashi 2002. Ukuze unikeze ubufakazi bokuthi unegunya lokufaka isicelo, uma ufaka isicelo egameni lomunye umuntu. Uma umfakisicelo engazi indawo noma incazelo ethile yombhalo oceliwe, umemukelwa ukuthi axhumane noMphathi: Information Management, ozosiza ekutholeni umbhalo ofanele. B. Ngokukhethekile mayelana ne-GNSS, ibhekisela ezingeni lokuhambisana kokulinganiswa, noma indawo ethile noma isivinini salo msebenzi ngesikhathi esithile noma endaweni ethile, kanye nesivinini sangempela esivame ukuvezwa njengokulinganiswa kwezibalo kwephutha lemishini, futhi kuboniswa njengokulinganiswa okujwayelekile nokuhambisanayo. a Uhlobo A1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, endaweni yokundiza, emgwaqweni ongawuhlangani ngqo nomhloli ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. a Uhlobo B1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, endaweni yokundiza, emgwaqweni ongawuhlangani ngqo nomhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. b Uhlobo B2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezindaweni zokundiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. "Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C" uveza umshini we-GNSS onama-sensors okulandela i-GNSS ahlinzeka ngemininingwane ngomgwaqo ohlanganisiwe wokuhamba kwezindiza futhi uphinde usize ngokukhombisa indlela yokuhamba lapho iqhutshwa ngumshayeli noma umphathi wezokuhamba emoyeni ukuze kuncishiswe amaphutha ezobuchwepheshe emaphutheni e-FTE. a Uhlobo C1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, endaweni yokundiza, emgwaqweni ongawuhlangani ngqo nomhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. b Uhlobo C2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezindaweni zokundiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. Qaphela: Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C uzofakwa kuphela ezindizeni ezivunyelwe ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwelizwe nasemakhaleni okuthutha abantu emoyeni. Inqubo yokundiza efwini ibhekisela ezicwangcweni ezihlelwe zokusebenzisa amathuluzi okundiza athile ukuvikela ukuhamba kokundiza ezitheni ezingase zibe khona emgudwini wayo wokuqala kuze kube yilapho ifika endaweni lapho izinhlelo zokuxhumana zomhlaba zingasungulwa khona futhi zisize ekubambeni noma ekuzungezeleni kokundiza, bese, ngemuva kwalokho, ingabamba endaweni lapho uhlelo lokuphatha izithiyo zendawo noma izithiyo zomgwaqo zisebenza. I-GNSS ibhekisela kuHlelo Lokuhamba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe lwezindiza. Uhlelo lokuhlonza indawo nezikhathi emhlabeni wonke oluhilela ubuchwepheshe bokubona obukude noma ukuhlanganiswa kwabo, ama-receiver ezindiza, kanye nohlelo lokulandela olusekela ukuqapha nokuhlola izindiza emoyeni. Umcimbi we-GNSS ubhekisela ezimweni nasezimo ezifanayo neziphazamiseko zemishini, izinkomba, noma iphutha lomuntu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Ukuqina mayelana ne-GNSS kubhekisela ekwazini kwemishini ukukhipha izaziso kulabo abawasebenzisayo uma ukusebenza kwayo kudlula imikhawulo yokuphepha esunguliwe futhi akufanele kusetshenziswe ekulandeleni. Ukuhamba kwe-Edge/Side kubhekisela ezindleleni zokuhola ukuhamba ngaphandle kwezinkomba ezijulile ezihlobene nezindlela zokulandela ukuhamba ngendlela engawuhlangani ngqo nomhloli noma yokufuna uma idlula. Uhlelo lokuhamba lwezindiza oluyinhloko lubhekisela ohlelweni lokuhamba emoyeni olwamukelwe nguMphathi wezokuhamba noma ngesikhathi esithile sokuhamba, okuhlangabezana nezidingo zokuhlonza ezijulile nezokuqina, kodwa akusho ukuthi luhlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala noma ukuqhubeka. Ukuqina kolwazi olutholakalayo (RAIM) kubhekisela kuhlelo lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS luhlola ukuqina kwezimpawu zokulawula ukuhamba nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakala ngokukhalipha. "RVSM" kusho umehluko okhona phakathi kwezinga lokundiza le-290 kuya ku-1000 feet uma kubhekwa ohlangothini olulodwa futhi ama-2000 feet uma kubhekwa ngokuqondile kokundiza. "RVSM airspace" kusho indawo yomoya phakathi kwezinga lokundiza le-290 no-410 feet. "I-RVSM authorization certificate" ibhekisela esiqinisekisweni esikhombisa ukuthi ukuhamba kanye neqembu lezakhamizi kuhambisana nezidingo zokusebenza ze-RVSM. Ukuhola ukuhamba okuphakeme noma phezulu kubhekisela kuhlu lokulawula ukuhamba okuvumela ukuhlela okujule usebenzisa izinsiza zokulinganisa ezisemhlabeni, ukubheka imigwaqo ngaphandle kokuhamba noma ukuhlanganisa lezi. Ukuqapha okuvele kubonisa isu le-IFR lokuhamba lapho ingxenye ethile noma isethi ephelele yezinsiza zokuhamba ingase ingasebenzi kahle lapho umshayeli esebenzisa umgwaqo lapho ukuhamba kukhona. b Umnyango Wezokuhamba Komoya; noma c Isiteshi Samaphoyisa Esiseduze, kulokhu. b Umnyango Wezokuhamba Komoya; noma c Isiteshi Samaphoyisa Esiseduze, mayelana nalolu sehlakalo.
