Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, No. 2 ka-2000 ("umthetho") waqala ukusebenza ngo-9 Mashi 2001, unikeza ilungelo leziqondiso lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olunikezwe noma yiliphi ibhodi elisemthethweni noma elizimele elidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo. Uma kwenziwa isicelo ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ibhodi lapho isicelo senziwe khona kumele ikhulule lokho kulwazi, ngaphandle uma umthetho ucacisa ukuthi ulwazi lungakhululwa noma lungakhululwa. Umthetho uchaza izimo eziphathelene nezinqubo ezidingekayo ezihlobene nalolo suku. Lo mbhalo uhlose ukukhuthaza ukuveza nokuvuleka ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (DTI) ngokunikeza ilungelo lolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe futhi kuvikelwe amalungelo abantu noma izinhlangano. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuphathwa kahle kwamabhodi omphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi futhi ufundiswe ukuze aqonde amalungelo akhe mayelana nomthetho. Ngendlela elinganisa lelo lungelo namanye amalungelo, kuhlanganise nalawo atholakala kuBill of Rights kuMthethosisekelo. Isigaba 14 somthetho sidinga amabhodi omphakathi ukuthi athuthukise umhlahlandlela ukusiza ekufinyeleleni kulwazi olunikezwe amabhodi omphakathi futhi sethe izidingo ezincane okufanele umhlahlandlela ulandele. I-DTI izibophezele, nokho, ekusebenzeni ngokukhanya, ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi inikeza ulwazi olukhululekile emphakathini wezohwebo, amakhasimende, kanye nomphakathi ngokusebenzisa imibhalo, izaziso, iwebhusayithi, kanye nesikhungo solwazi. Lo mhlahlandlela uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngesicelo, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ngemininingwane edingekayo yokuxhumana, kanye nezinyathelo zokuthola ulwazi oluthile oluvela kwi-DTI. Umhlahlandlela uphinde uzibophezele ukuhlinzeka ngesithombe esiphelele mayelana nesakhiwo, imisebenzi, izinsizakalo, kanye nenhlangano yolwazi ngaphakathi kwe-DTI ukusiza isicelo ekutholeni lapho ulwazi lungatholakala khona. Umhlahlandlela uphinde uhlinzeke ngamafomu adingekayo kanye nezimali ezisebenzayo zokucela ulwazi. Okungenani u-40% wesabelomali se-DTI unikezwa inethiwekhi yezikhungo ezisemthethweni ezakha ithimba le-DTI. I-Council of Trade and Industry Institutions (COTII) yasungulwa, ifaka phakathi iBhodi Labaphathi be-DTI, Abaphathi Abaphezulu, kanye Nezikhulumi zendawo ngayinye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle kweqembu le-DTI kanye nezinhloso zeMnyango. Lo mhlahlandlela uhlinzeka kuphela ngerekhodi ze-DTI, hhayi zeqembu le-DTI (COTII). Noma yiziphi izicelo zolwazi, kunoma yiziphi izikhungo ze-DTI, kufanele ziqondiswe ehhovisi lolwazi lelo bhodi. I-Competition Commission kanye ne-Competition Tribunal ikhuthaza ukuncintisana, ihlola futhi ibhekane nezindlela eziphikisana nokuncintisana, futhi ithuthukisa ukugxila kwezomnotho emakethe ezihlobene ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuncintisana ka-1998. Yasungulwa ngo-1945, manje isiphathwa nguMthetho Wokucwaninga Kazwelonke ka-1998, iNational Research Council izibophezele ekuhlinzekeni ngezixazululo zobuchwepheshe nolwazi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nezomnotho. Inhloso yenhlangano ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele oluzohlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngamasu obuchwepheshe adingekayo, kanye nokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ukufundwa kwesayensi nobuchwepheshe. I-Council izibophezele ekuholeni ukuqwashisa ngobuchwepheshe nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabasebenzi nobuchwepheshe. I-Industrial Development Corporation, ephethwe nguhulumeni, ihlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali olukhuthaza ukudalwa kwamabhizinisi ngokwakha imboni nezinkampani ezisebenza ngokuncintisana ngokusekelwe ezimisweni ezinhle zebhizinisi. Le nkundla iphethwe ngezinhlinzeko zomthetho we-Industrial Development Corporation Act ka-1940 njengoba kuguqulwe kanye nezinye izingxenye zomthetho wezinkampani. I-Khula yasungulwa ngo-1996 futhi igxile ekuqinisekiseni ukufinyelela okulula ezikweletini nasekuxhaseni amabhizinisi amancane nezaphakathi nezincane. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondile ngezikhwama zokwazisa nezimali zokusebenza kumabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezincane. I-Khula ibhaliswe njengomshuwalense ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushuwalense futhi iphethwe ngezikhombisi-ndlela zeBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali. Iwings yayo yokwazisa izikweletu ibuyekezwa minyaka yonke ngokwezimali njengoba kucacisiwe yiBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali ukuze kutholakale izinga eliphezulu lezimali ezingabolekiswa. I-National Framework for the Integration of Product Advisory Institutions ihlinzeka ngemikhakha yokukhiqiza ngolwazi nezinsizakalo zokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezincane. IBhodi yasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokugembula Kazwelonke ka-1996 ukuze ilawule ukugembula, ihlinzeka ngeluleko lesizwe. Umthetho omusha we-Liquor ka-1998 wadlula kwiZikhungo Zombuso ngonyaka ka-1998 kodwa wathunyelwa kwiNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo nguMongameli ngenxa yemibuzo ephathelene nokuba semthethweni kwawo. Umthetho uhlose ukuhlela imboni ye-licor ngokwethula umhlahlandlela wezokugunyazwa ohlukanisa izimvume zibe izingxenye ezintathu; ukusungula iNational Liquor Advisory Committee, iNational Liquor Regulatory Authority, iNational Liquor Tribunal, izikhungo eziyisishiyagalolunye zokulawula i-licor, kanye nezikhungo eziyisishiyagalolunye zokubuyekeza; nokuhlinzeka ngohlelo lokulawula ukuze kutholakale ukufinyelela nokuthola izinzuzo ngenkathi kubhekwa nezindaba zomphakathi, ezomnotho, nezempilo. IFoundation yasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane ka-1996 njengenkampani yesigaba 21 ukuze ihlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zokuxhasa ezingezona ezemali kumabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezincane. IFoundation ihlinzeka ukufinyelela ekuqeqesheni, ulwazi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, ukumaketha, nobuchwepheshe. I-Standards Organization ilawula uMthetho Wamazinga, No. 29 ka-1993, ophakamisa ukujolisa emandleni nasekuphathweni kwekhwalithi embonini nasezohwebeni futhi uphinde ulandelele izilinganiso nezindinganiso zezimboni. Iphakela ubuholi emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngokuwuqonda, ulwazi lwawo lwamathuba nezinto ezingaba khona, nokubheka ikusasa. Iphromotha uguquko nokuthuthukiswa komnotho futhi ibhekana nezinselelo namathuba kubantu abathintekayo emnothweni, ukuze kusekelwe izinhloso zikahulumeni zokuthuthukisa umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa. Iphendula izinselelo namathuba emnothweni nasemphakathini. Iphakela indawo elindelekile esebenzisanayo, efanelekile, futhi elungile ukuze kube nokutshalwa kwezimali, imisebenzi, nezohwebo. Ngokwandisa umnikelo wamabhizinisi amancane ku-GDP. Ukwandisa izinga lokutshalwa kwezimali okuqondile emnothweni nasemikhakheni ebekwe phambili
Umbhalo wesiNgisi otyikitywe nguMongameli uhlinzeka ngezinyathelo zokukhuthaza ukuphepha kwemikhiqizo yenyama nezilwane; ukuhlela nokugcina izindinganiso ezibalulekile zendawo eziphathelene nokubulala; ukulawula ukuthengwa nokungeniswa kwenyama evela kwamanye amazwe; ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha kwenyama nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ephathelene. Umsebenzi wombutho uchaza umuntu osebenza ngaphansi kwesigaba 11 soMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994, okungase kuqinisekise ukuthi ezinye izingxenye zalesi sikhumbuzo azisebenzi ezilwaneni ezithile ezichazwe kuSheduli -1. UNgqongqoshe kufanele akhethe umqashi wombutho ofunde ezokwelapha izilwane ukuba abe yisikhungo sombuso. Isikhungo sombuso sizokwenza imisebenzi efanele namandla anikezwe kuwo futhi sizokwenza imisebenzi ebekiwe ngaphansi kwalesi sikhumbuzo, ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nemigomo ekhishwe nguNgqongqoshe. Singabambezela, sithumele kwelinye ilanga, noma samukele isicelo ngendlela esikubona ifanele kuyo yonke isimo. Uma kukhona isicelo, isikhungo sombuso singase sithathe isinqumo sokwandisa ngokubhala isikhathi esichazwe esigabeni - (a). Isicelo sokwandisa isikhathi kufanele sibhale futhi sikhulume ngezizathu zesicelo. Isikhungo sombuso kufanele sikwazise ngokubhala ummangali ngesinqumo esithathiwe kanye nezizathu zokwenqaba kwesicelo uma sithulelwe. Uma ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo isikhungo sithola ulwazi oluthile olungashintsha isimo sesinqumo saso uma belukhona ngesikhathi sokucubungula isicelo noma olungaholela ekwenqabeni kwesicelo noma ekufakweni kwezimo ezithile eziphathelene ne-permit, isikhungo singakhupha isaziso esibhaliwe kummangali simazise ngokuqhuba kwesicelo lapho sithulwe noma sikhanseliwe noma ngaphansi kwezimo ezintsha, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Isikhungo sombuso kufanele sinikeze izizathu zokuthi kungani sithathe isinqumo sokukhansela isinqumo sangaphambilini noma izinguquko ezenziwe ngokuvuma koNgqongqoshe ofanele ophathelene nesikhungo sombuso. Ukudluliswa kwamandla noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba (a)(ii) kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngokuvuma koNgqongqoshe. Amandla noma imisebenzi edlulisiwe noma enikeziwe yisikhungo sombuso ingadluliselwa futhi yisikhungo sombuso kumqashi omunye ophathwayo noma kumuntu onelayisense. Isikhungo sombuso kufanele sinikeze umqashi, umuntu onelayisense, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi ezichaziwe ngegunya elibhaliwe elichaza ukuthi umuntu ochazwe uthola amandla okwenza imisebenzi echazwe lapho ephathelene nendawo ethile. Uma kwenziwa amandla noma kwenziwa imisebenzi enikezwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, umqashi, umuntu onelayisense, noma isikhungo sombuso kufanele sikhombise igunya elichazwe esigabeni (a), uma siceleke omunye umuntu. Isikhungo sombuso esithumele amandla noma imisebenzi enikezwe kuwo noma edluliselwe kumuntu omunye, endaweni yokusebenza noma ezikhungweni zomphakathi ngenxa yokudluliselwa kwalawo mandla noma imisebenzi, ngaphandle kokuthi isizathu esihambelana nalowo muntu sithunyelwe kuwo futhi lapho isinqumo singashintshwa noma sikhanselwa kuphela uma ushintsho noma ukukhansela kuzuza lowo muntu noma uma lowo muntu evuma ushintsho noma ukukhansela. UNgqongqoshe angabeka isicelo sokusebenza kwalesi sikhumbuzo noma izingxenye ezithile zalo kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika noma ezindaweni ezithile kuphela ukuze kuhlobane nomuntu othile onolwazi noma ulwazi oluthile mayelana nenyama noma ukuphepha kwenyama leyo. Imisebenzi echaziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba kufanele ivule amandla nemisebenzi yomuntu okufanele enze umsebenzi ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo yesikhungo sombuso. Ngaphandle kokuthi uNgqongqoshe athathe isinqumo esihlukile emcimbini othile, umuntu onikezwe imisebenzi akakwazi ukuxoxisana noMbuso mayelana nanoma yiziphi izindleko ezitholakele mayelana nokusebenzisa amandla noma ukwenza imisebenzi ethile. Ngokubhala, kufanele baphathe amandla noma badlulisele kumqashi omunye onikwe igunya noma noma yiziphi amandla okufanele asetshenziswe noma imisebenzi okufanele yenziwe ngaphansi kwalesi sikhumbuzo noma ngokubhala bavume noma baphumele izisebenzi ezinjalo ukuba zisebenzise lawo mandla noma zenze leyo msebenzi. Amandla asetshenziswe noma imisebenzi eyenziwe ngumqashi ochazwe esigabeni kufanele ibhekwa njengokwenziwa noma ukwenziwa ngaphezu kwamandla amakhulu, umholi, noma omunye umuntu ophathayo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Umholi omkhulu, umholi, noma omunye umuntu ophathayo angashintsha noma akhansele noma isiphi isinqumo esithathiwe noma imiyalelo ekhishwe yilowo mqashi ngaphandle kokuthi isinqumo sithunyelwe kumuntu ophazamisekile ngesinqumo, futhi lapho isinqumo singashintshwa noma sikhanselwa kuphela uma ushintsho noma ukukhansela kuzuza lowo muntu noma ukukhansela kuzuza lowo muntu noma lowo muntu evuma ushintsho noma ukukhansela. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba, imisebenzi edlulisiwe ngokuxhumana nesikhungo sombuso ingaqinisekisa ukukhokhwa okwenziwa ngumnikazi wezindawo zokubulala ukuze kwenziwe amandla nemisebenzi enikezwe kuwo ngaphansi kwalesi sikhumbuzo. Uma umuntu odlulisiwe engahambisani nezimo zalesi sikhumbuzo noma nemiyalelo yesikhungo sombuso, isikhungo sombuso singaqeda noma suspende imisebenzi yalowo muntu. Ngokuhambisana nezigaba, kanye nesigaba 6, imisebenzi ebekwe ezigabeni 7, 8, 9, 10, 15, no-16 idluliselwa kuyo yonke isikhungo sombuso. Bonke oNgqongqoshe bezifunda ezihlobene kufanele bakhethe umqashi ofanele kuyo yonke ifunda ophakathi kwezilwane ukuba abe yisikhungo sombuso. Isikhungo sombuso kufanele sisebenzise amandla futhi senze imisebenzi enikezwe isikhungo sombuso ngaphansi kwesigaba. Kufanele sinikeze isikhungo sombuso imibiko ephathelene nokuhambisana nezimo ezichazwe esigabeni ngendlela edingekayo yisikhungo sombuso. Isikhungo sombuso kufanele siqaphe ukuhamba kwemisebenzi edlulisiwe ngalesi sigaba kuyo yonke ifunda ukuze kuqinisekiswe izindinganiso ezifanayo zisetshenziswa kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kwezikhathi ezithile, isikhungo sombuso kufanele sihlole imibiko yemisebenzi eyenziwe ngendlela echazwe esigabeni (a) futhi sinikeze umbiko ofanayo esikhungweni sombuso. Ngokubhala, igunya lingacela esikhungweni sombuso noma kumuntu omunye onemininingwane edingekayo yisikhungo sombuso imininingwane ethile eceliwe yisikhungo sombuso ngenhloso yokulandela imisebenzi eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, le mininingwane kufanele ilethwe esikhungweni sombuso ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichazwe esazisweni. Uma kwenzeka nganoma yisiphi isikhathi isikhungo sombuso sinombono wokuthi isenzo noma ukungaphumeleli okuthile kunemiphumela yokwephula izindinganiso zokusebenza, kufanele sikwazise isikhungo sombuso esihlobene ukuze sicela ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa isimo esonakele. Isikhathi noma ngaphansi kwezimo ezichazwe nguNgqongqoshe. Uma kukhona ukuvinjelwa, isikhungo sombuso kufanele silandele izindinganiso ezifanele zomphakathi nezinye izimo ezisebenzayo ngaphansi kwalesi sikhumbuzo endaweni ethintekayo kuze kube isikhathi esichazwe sokuh

Ngaphambi kokwakhiwa kwezindawo zokubulala, umdwebo wesakhiwo esiphakanyisiwe kumele uthunyelwe kubaphathi bendawo ukuze uhlole futhi uvunywe. b iyisethi ephelele yemidwebo yesakhiwo esiphakathi, uma singesakhiwo esifanayo nalokho okukhulunywe ngakho ku-21 ngenhla. b kufanele ithunyelwe kumakhelwane wabanikazi; noma c kufanele ithunyelwe nge-courier, i-imeyili noma ezinye izindlela eziphuthumayo kumnikazi, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi idokhumenti yokuqala ithunyelwa kumnikazi phakathi nezinsuku eziyisixhenxe zokuthumela isaziso. q uma kungasekho izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezilwane ezilindele ukuhlolelwa ezindaweni zokubulala, lezo zinsiza kumele zitholwe kwenye indawo, ngokuvunywa kwabaphathi bendawo. ukuze kuhlanzwe futhi kuhlanzeke imishini esetshenzisiwe z kumele kube nendawo yokuhlanza imoto ethutha inyama. gg akukho facility yokuhlanza imoto eyinikezelwe yokuthutha inyama. k akukho zinsiza ezinikezelwe zokumunca ukuze kulawulwe ukuhamba. ivikelwe ngezinyathelo eziyisisekelo zokuvikela ukungena kwezinto eziyingozi noma ukungcoliswa, igesi eziyingozi, ukuhamba, iphunga, umusi, umswakama, izinyoni, nezinye izinto noma ukuphazamiseka kwenyama, amakhemikhali, noma okunye okuthinta ukungcoliswa. Zonke izindawo zangaphandle kumele zibe zihlanzekile futhi zingenadaka. Akukho mfula nezokukhipha amanzi anikezelwe. Izindawo zokubulala kumele zibe nohlelo lokuvalela amanzi nokuqeda udoti ukuze kungene endaweni efanele yamapayipi amanzi angcolile. Izindawo zokulayisha nokukhulula izimoto kumele zivikela, zibe nezindlela ezinhle, futhi zibe nephepha. d ukugcina inyama ethunjiwe kanye nokuhlolwa kwayo kumele kwenziwe ngaphandle kokungcolisa leyo nyama. n yonke imishini, izakhiwo, nezinsiza ezibekwe odongeni kumele zibe okungenani ku-50mm kude. c akufanele kube ne-oyela wenyama. iziqukathi zokugcina inyama kumele zihambisane nesigaba 1, uma phansi nangaphezulu kunezikhala kumele zenziwe ngendlela yokuthi inyama ingaphumi ezikhala noma ithinte umhlaba. Amathoyilethi nezindawo zokuhlanza kumele akhiwe endaweni ehlukile enikeza iminyango ehlukene ezindlini zokushintsha. zonke amathoyilethi kumele abe nezikhwama zokubeka iphepha lokuhlanza, izindawo zokuhlanza izandla, izikhwama zokuphakela ugesi ezibulala amagciwane, nezinsiza zokomisa izandla. Izindawo zokushintsha nezamathoyilethi akufanele zingeze ngqo endaweni noma igumbi lapho inyama igcinwa khona. Abasebenzi kumele banikezwe indawo yokuvula izinto zabo lapho begcina izinto zabo zomuntu zihlukaniswe nezinto zomsebenzi, lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto zomuntu nezokusebenza ezihlanzekile azixubeki. Abasebenzi kumele banikezwe izinto ezivikelayo ezivela ezinyoni lapho begcina ukudla. b gwema ukungcoliswa nezinsiza zokuhlanza ngokupheka imishini nezinsiza zokusebenza, okungabandakanya imikhono nezinsiza, kuzohlanzwa ngamanzi afudumele ku-82°C ngesikhathi sokubulala. c kufanele kube nehole yokungena nokuphuma kanye nephayiphu yokukhipha ethinta umhole, amanzi athathwa emholeni akufanele aphume endaweni edlule izimoto. Noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuhlanza ngokupheka kumele ivunywe ngabaphathi bendawo. f kufanele banikezwe isikhwama esibamba ugesi obulala amagciwane kanye nezinsiza zokomisa izandla ngaphandle uma kungekho mfuneko yokomisa izandla endaweni lapho kukhona isikhala sokuhlanza izandla. Amakamelo okugeza adingekayo ezindaweni zokubulala ezikhiqiza kancane nangaphezulu kumele abekwe eduze kwezindawo zokusebenza ukuze kugwenywe ukuvuza kwamanzi lapho abasebenzi behlanza ama-apron abawasebenzisayo futhi lawa makamelo kumele avumele ukuhamba kwamanzi ngqo emholeni ofanele wokungcolile. Amanzi kumele abe namandla futhi ahambisane okungenani neKholomu II eyasungulwa ku-SANS 241 yokuphuza. c iwheel eligcina ama-pipes kumele ingaphumuli phansi ngaphandle kokuthi kube nama-pipes odongeni. Izinsiza zokugcina ukuvikela ukuhweba nokungabuyiswanga okukhona nezikhwama ezivaliwe kahle kumele zinikezelwe ukuze kugcinwe futhi kuthuthwe izimpahla eziphukile futhi kumele zibhale kahle "AKUFANELE". Kumele kube nezikhwama zokuhlanganisa nokugcina izimpahla eziphukile ezidinga ukulahleka. Kumele kube nendawo yokuhlanganisa nogazi ngaphambi kokuba ilahlwe. Isikhwama sodoti kumele sikwazi ukuhlanganisa udoti ezindaweni ezihlukene ngaphakathi kwezindawo. Izindawo zokugcina udoti nezikhwama zodoti ngaphambi kokukhipha kumele zihlanzeke, zikhishwe, futhi zibe zingenamanzi futhi kumele zivalwe noma zifakwe izikhwama ezivaliwe kahle. g kumele kube nokukhanya okwanele lapho izilwane zikhululwa ebusuku. d kumele kube nezimo ezingaphansi kuka-1m ezisetshenziselwa ukufaka izilwane eziphawulwe kumele zakhiwe ngodonga oluqinile kanye nesango futhi akumele kuvunyelwe ukuhlanganiswa nezinye izinkomo noma kudaleke ingozi yokungcolisa ezinye izilwane. c ukudla kwezilwane kumele kugcinwe endaweni yokugcina evikelwe ezinyoni futhi ebekelwe le njongo, uma ukudla kuzogcinwa ngaphakathi kwezindawo. c 0.50m² impungushe, imbuzi noma ingane. Izinkomo kumele zibe nezaziso ezikhombisa ukuthi zingabantu bangaki abangaqhamuka endaweni yokuhlala. c akumele kube ngaphansi kuka-1. d kumele kugcinwe kahle futhi kungabi nezinto eziphakanyisiwe. Izindawo zokudlela kumele zibe zihlanzekile futhi zingabi nezinto eziphakanyisiwe. kumele kube ngendlela yokugcina indawo yaphansi nezikhala zokukhipha amanzi azingavuli. Indawo yokudla izinkomo phakathi kwezinkomo nezindawo lapho zibhujiswa khona kumele ibe nobubanzi obungaphezu kuka-0.9m. Indawo yokudlela kumele ihlelwe ngendlela efihlekile endaweni yokubulala. Ingxenye yendawo yokudlela eholela ebhokisini lokubulala kumele ibe nezihlalo eziqinile. d noma iyiphi enye indlela yokuvikela evunywe ngabaphathi bendawo. c enye ithuluzi elivunywe ngumbuso. Izindawo zokubulala ezibekelwe kumele zikhonjiswe ezindaweni zokubulala izilwane noma endaweni ebekelwe. Imishini kumele ihlinzeke ngokuqinisa nokuphakamisa izilwane ezibekelwe kahle ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwegazi. Ukuba nomqondo ophumelelayo, ukusebenza kahle, nokugxila ekuthuthukisweni ngokukhula kungaba umphumela wezinyathelo zabantu abadala uqobo, ngokukhula kwenani labo kanye nomthelela wabo. Ulwazi oluhlanganisiwe mayelana nokuguga, njengomqondo wokuhlanganisa emphakathini, lungaba yinto enhle (Uhlelo Lomhlaba Lokusebenza Ngokuqhubekela Phambili 1/para. 32). Inani elandayo lemindeni ethinteke yiHIV/AIDS libangela umthelela ezimpilweni zabantu abadala. Imiphumela yeHIV/AIDS iphula imindeni. Inani elikhulayo lezingane ezingenabazali ngenxa yokufa kwabazali ngenxa yezifo ezihlobene neHIV/AIDS kusho ukuthi abantu abadala kuphela abashiyekile ukuze banakekele lezingane. Abantu abadala emindenini ethinteke yiHIV/AIDS bathola ukuthi baphakathi komthwalo omkhulu wokunakekela ilunga lomndeni elinokugula noma elisondela ekufeni, kanye nokunakekela abazukulu babo ababe sebezingeni. Kuvame ukucabanga ukuthi imindeni ethinteke yalesi simo inganakekela amalunga ayo agulayo. Abantu abaneHIV/AIDS badinga impilo, amandla, izinsiza zezimali, kanye nezibopho eziqinile zokuzama ngokwengeziwe ukuthola lezi zinto. Amadokhumenti okuzalwa ezizukulwaneni zabo. (Lokhu kuyinkinga evamile kubantu abadala ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ikakhulukazi kulabo abantwana babo bahlala emadolobheni noma ezweni elizungezile). I-stigma ehambisana neHIV/AIDS ibangela abantu abadala ukuba babe nezinselelo ezinkulu njengoba bezama ukubhekana nokufa kwamalunga omndeni. Njengoba abantu abadala kufanele babhekane nokusiza izingane zifunde ukujwayela indawo entsha ngaphandle kwabazali bazo. Abantu abadala bangaba abanikeli bemvelo futhi kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okuyisisekelo abakudingayo ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nomthwalo owengeziwe wokunakekela amalunga omndeni agulayo kanye nezizukulwane zabo ezingenabazali, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS. Kubalulekile ukubona abantu abadala ngendima yabo emnothweni wezwe ngezandla zabo futhi banakekele izizukulwane zabo lapho abazali babo besebenza noma befileyo ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS. Izinsizakalo zokwelulekwa kwezempilo yengqondo zemindeni ethinteke yiHIV/AIDS. Lokhu kwenziwa futhi ngamaqembu omphakathi asiza, ebhekana nezinkinga zengqondo nezomzwelo zamalunga omndeni athintekile. Ulwazi olusabalalisiwe ngama-brochure anolwazi mayelana nokuthi ungafinyelela kanjani usizo lomphakathi nokwazi amalungelo akho njengomthwalo kubalulekile. Umkhakha wezebhizinisi, izwe, izinhlangano zenkolo, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni ziye zasiza ngokunikeza usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abadinga usizo bayawuthola.
Isinqumo seNkantolo yeMithetho mayelana necala 'Bhe nabanye v Magistrate Khayelitsha nabanye Inombolo yecala 49/03, isinqumo esakhishwa ngomhla ka-15 Novemba 2004, sathola ukuthi isigaba 23 seBlack Administration Act 38 ka-1927 kanye neGovernment Notice R200 yemigomo eyashicilelwa kuGovernment Notice 10601 ka-6 February 1987 ayihambisani nemthethosisekelo. Ngokuhambisana nomongo wesinqumo seBhe, uMnyango wezeMthetho kanye nentuthuko yeMithetho kufanele uthuthukise futhi uqinisekise uhlelo oluhlangene lokubheka ukuphathwa kwezindawo ezishonelwe ngendlela ehambelana nezidingo zomphakathi zabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika ngaphandle kokucwasa ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, iminyaka, noma ukuzalwa. UJaji Omkhulu kufanele athathe ukuphathwa kokubheka zonke izindawo ezishonelwe. Zonke izindawo kufanele ziphathwe ngokuhambisana ne-Administration of Estates Act 66 ka-1965 njengoba kuguqulwe. Zonke izindawo zabantu abashonile abangakabeki ukuthi bafuna ziphathwe ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act 81 ka-1987, njengoba kuguqulwe. I-Intestate Succession Act ithintwa yisinqumo seBhe ukuhlinzeka ngezimo lapho umufi wayeshade ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Abaholi bendabuko bayalahlekelwa amandla okuphatha nokubheka izindawo zabantu abashonile. Nokho, kuzodingeka baqedele izindaba ezibikwe kubo ngomhla ka-15 Novemba 2004 noma ngaphambi kwalolo suku. Kumele baqedele zonke lezi zindawo ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act. Ngemuva kwesinqumo seBhe, phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kosuku luka-6 December 2002, lapho isinqumo seMoseneke sathatha umthelela, umthwalo wokubheka ukuphathwa kwezindawo ezishonelwe wawugxile kakhulu kubuholi bendabuko. UJaji Omkhulu wabheka ukuphathwa kwezindawo zabantu abamhlophe, abamnyama, abamnyama, nabantu abamhlophe abangakabeki abathwali. Amandla kaJaji Omkhulu kanye namandla akhe (okstill asebenza) achazwe ku-Administration of Estates Act 66 ka-1965 njengoba kuguqulwe. Umagistrate endaweni lapho umufi ahlala khona wayenomsebenzi wokubheka ukuphathwa kwendawo yomuntu omnyama oshonile ngaphandle kokubeka abathwali kanye nokuphathwa kwendawo yakhe. Umagistrate uthole amandla kusuka esigabeni 23 seBlack Administration Act 38 ka-1927 kanye nemigomo eyashicilelwa ku-Government Notice R200 ku-Government Gazette 10601 ka-6 February 1987. Indawo yomuntu omnyama ngemuva kokushona kwakhe ayiphathwanga nge-Intestate Succession Act 81 ka-1987. Lokhu kwenzeka ezimweni ezimbili. Esimweni sokuqala, lapho umufi ekhombisa ngesikhathi ephila ukuthi akafuni ukuphila ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wesiko. Ngokuhambisana ne-Government Notice R200, le mfuneko yakhonjiswa ngezindlela ezimbili: lapho umufi efaka isicelo sesitifiketi esikhulula yena ekusebenzeni komthetho wesiZulu, ngaphansi kwesigaba 31 seBlack Administration Act, nokuthi lapho ebeka umshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiNgisi ngaphandle kokubanjwa ubuholi bendabuko. Okwesibili, indawo yomufi ayikwazi ukuphathwa nge-Intestate Succession Act uma uNgqongqoshe wezeMthetho enombono wokuthi kuzoba nomthelela omubi kwezinye izimo ukusabalalisa indawo ngaphansi kwesistimu yomthetho wesiko. Izithakazelo ezithintekayo zizokwenza uNgqongqoshe athole isinqumo ngalesi. Ngesikhathi sesibili, phakathi kosuku luka-6 December 2002 no-15 November 2004, uJaji Omkhulu wayenamandla okuphatha zonke izindawo zabantu abashonile ngokuhambisana nemigomo yomthetho wesiNgisi ngenkathi umagistrate enamalungelo okuphatha izindawo zabantu abashonile ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesiko. UJaji Omkhulu wayebhujiswa amandla akhe ngaphansi kwe-Administration of Estates Act ngenkathi omagistrate bephatha amandla ngaphansi kwe-Black Administration Act kanye nemigomo eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalolo mthetho. Ngesikhathi sesithathu, ngemuva kosuku luka-15 November 2004, uJaji Omkhulu uzobheka ukuphathwa kwezindawo zonke zabantu abashonile ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act. Zonke izindawo ezishiywe ngabantu ngaphandle kokubeka izifiso zabo zizophathwa ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-Intestate Succession Act ehambelana nezinguquko ezidingekayo ukuhlinzeka ngoshado ngaphansi komthetho wesiko. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi izinguquko ezilethwe yisinqumo seBhe zinefekthi yokubuyisela isimo emuva ku-27 March 1994 mayelana nezindawo ezingakazeki. Impumelelo yohlelo olusha izokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika baphathwa ngokulinganayo nokuthi isithunzi sabo siyahlonishwa. Ngokubheka isimo sangempela mayelana nabantu abashonile ngaphambi kosuku luka-27 March 1994 nezimo ezingabikiwe, lezi zindawo kufanele ziqondiswe kuJaji Omkhulu. UJaji Omkhulu (ofisi kaJaji Omkhulu kanye nezikhungo zikaJaji Omkhulu) kufanele aphathe zonke izindawo lapho umufi eshonile ngemuva kosuku luka-27 March 1994. Indawo izophathwa futhi iphathwe ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-Administration of Estates Act. Uma umufi eshonile ngaphandle kokubeka abathwali noma ekhombisa izifiso zabo, indawo kufanele ihlukaniswe ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act. Lezi yizindaba okufanele ziqedwe ngumagistrate ngokuhambisana nesinqumo seBhe. Isimo lapho umufi ebhala izifiso zabo zokwabiwa kwendawo yabo (isivumelwano). Inani lendawo (noma inani elilinganisiwe) lidlula R50,000. Indawo iyisikhwama esingenalutho (izikweletu zidlula indawo). Omunye noma abaningi babatholi kufanele babe ngaphansi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili nanye futhi basizwe ngumameli wabo. Omunye noma abaningi babatholi kufanele babe ngaphansi kweminyaka engamashumi amabili nanye futhi indawo inenani eliphelele noma elingxenye elidlula R20,000. Uma noma yiziphi zezizathu ezishiwo ngenhla zisebenza, indawo kufanele idluliselwe kwiOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu endaweni umufi ahlala khona. Bonke abatholi kufanele babe namandla okusebenza ngokuzimela noma omunye noma abaningi babatholi kufanele babe ngabantwana futhi basizwe ngumameli wabo, futhi indawo yezezimali ibalwe ku-R20,000 noma ngaphansi. Isikhungo sokusiza sizoba namandla phezu kwendawo yomuntu owayengumuntu ojwayelekile ngesikhathi sokushona ngaphakathi komthetho weOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu lapho isikhungo sokusiza sitholakala khona. Lapho isicelo siqediwe ngokuphelele futhi akukho ezinye izidingo ezidingekayo ukuze kukhishwe isitifiketi sokuhlonza. Lapho isicelo singaqediwe ngenxa yezinye izidingo ezidingekayo ezidinga ukwenziwa futhi kukhona isikhungo sokusiza esiseduze neOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu yomfaki-sicelo, uJaji Omkhulu kufanele azise umfaki-sicelo ngalokhu. Amandla okuphatha iOfisi kaJaji Omkhulu ngalolu sizo akhishwa kumuntu onolwazi owafakile isicelo. Uma ethumela umphakathi wakhe ngaphansi kwesigaba 18, uJaji Omkhulu kufanele azise Isikhungo Sokwesiza ngamandla afanayo ukuze enze lokhu. Kwakhiwa umhlahlandlela ukuze kuthuthukiswe amandla omnotho abantu abamnyama; ukuze kuqinisekiswe uNgqongqoshe ukuthi akhiphe imithetho futhi ahlukanise uhlaka lokuguqulwa; ukuze kwakhiwe ikomidi leNhlelo Yezomnotho Yabantu Abamnyama; nokulungiselela izindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. UKUZE kuthuthukiswe ukwenzeka kwesithakazelo somthethosisekelo sokulingana, ukuze kukhuphuke ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abamnyama emnothweni futhi kukhuthazwe ukukhula okukhulu komnotho, ukuze kwandiswe amathuba emisebenzi nokwabiwa okufanelekile kwemiholo. "ukukhuluma" kubhekisela kulokho okukhulunywa umthetho ophakanyisiwe; futhi lo Mthetho uhlanganisa imithetho noma izinhlinzeko zomthetho ezikhishwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uxhasa izinhlelo ezizoholela ekwandeni kokubamba iqhaza komnotho kwabantu abamnyama ukuze kufezwe ukuthuthukiswa nentuthuko; futhi ukuthi imiphakathi yasemaphandleni ithuthukiswe futhi imiphakathi yasendaweni ikwazi ukufinyelela emisebenzini yezomnotho, umhlaba, izinsiza, ubunikazi, nezakhono. a ngendlela ehambisana nezinhloso zayo eziyisisekelo; futhi b ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo. Ikomidi leNhlelo Yezomnotho Yabantu Abamnyama liyakhiwa. Ikomidi kumele linikeze uNgqongqoshe izeluleko mayelana namandla omnotho abantu abamnyama. Ikomidi lizoba neMongameli namalungu amanye ngokuhambisana nomthethosisekelo leKomidi. IMongameli izoba ngumholi weKomidi. Ikomidi ngokwalo lingakha emthethweni walo izimo zokubekwa kwezikhala zamalungu alo, inani lamalungu emhlanganweni, izinqubo, nezinye izindaba ezithinta umyalo walo wokusebenza. UNgqongqoshe, ngokuvumelana noNgqongqoshe wezeMali, angakwazi ukuhlela izimali zokuhlawula izindleko ezithathwe amalungu eKomidi. e iziqondiso zezakhamuzi zonke nezindawo ezithintekayo ukuze zibhale izinhlelo zokuguqulwa zalolo suku. a isungula inqubo yokukhetha lapho izimvume zikhishwa, noma yisiphi esinye isikhungo esenziwe ngaphansi kwanoma yimuphi umthetho; futhi b ithuthukisa futhi iqhube izinqumo zokukhetha lapho kuqashwa. IPhalamende lezeMali nezeMisebenzi kumele linikeze iKomidi usizo oludingekayo nokuxhaswa kwezimali okwenziwe nguPhalamende ngenhloso le. a ukusungula nokusebenza kweKomidi; futhi b ukuthuthukisa nokuphumeza uhlelo lokwazisa umphakathi. UNgqongqoshe kumele akhiphe imithetho ethile mayelana nanoma yini okufanele ayinqume ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwenziwa kahle kwalolu Mthetho. Lo Mthetho uzobizwa ngokuthi iBroad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act ka-2003, futhi uzongena esikhathini ngosuku oluzokwenziwa nguMongameli ngokuqhamuka kokukhishwa kweGazethi. Umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika awukwazi ukusebenza ngokuphelele ngoba iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika lithola imiholo ephansi futhi lisabhekwa ngaphandle kokuba ngabanikazi bezimpahla ezinzima nezakhono. Lokhu kubangela umonakalo kuwo wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokwandisa ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika emnothweni. Umthetho ophakanyisiwe weNhlelo Yezomnotho Yabantu Abamnyama (okubizwa ngokuthi "umthetho ophakanyisiwe" lapha) ungomunye wemisebenzi ethathwe nguHulumeni ukuze ubhekane nalolu daba. IKomidi Lezeluleko leNhlelo Yezomnotho Yabantu Abamnyama (okubizwa ngokuthi "ikomi" lapha) iyisiphakamiso somzamo wokweluleka. Usizo nokuxhaswa kuzohlinzekwa yiMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (okubizwa ngokuthi "DTI" lapha) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukugcina amabhizinisi abamnyama futhi aphathwe abantu abamnyama. ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiphakathi yasemaphandleni nezasekhaya. Kulindeleke ukuthi amalungu eKomidi awatholi ukukhokhelwa izindleko zawo futhi ukuthi ukusungulwa nokusebenza kweKomidi kuzoxhaswa ngombono owenziwe kwiMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (DTI). Kuphakanyiswa ukuthi i-GCIS (Uhlelo Lokuxhumana Nokwazisa KweHulumeni) kanye ne-DTI kuthuthukiswe uhlelo oluphelele mayelana namandla omnotho abantu abamnyama jikelele nalolu mthetho ophakanyisiwe ikakhulukazi.
Ukufika kuk governo ye-democratic kulethile imithetho eminingi emphakathini wethu, imithetho efana nelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi, ukuba namandla, nokuba ngum citizen. Ukuze lokhu kube nencazelo futhi ukuze uhulumeni wethu omusha we-democratic ukhule, ukufinyelela ulwazi kubalulekile. Ukufinyelela ulwazi kuyilungelo eliyisisekelo elivumela abahlali ukuba benze izinqumo ezicacile futhi kubavumela ukuba bafinyelele ezinsizeni ezihlinzekwa yizigaba zikahulumeni. I-Department of Social Development ibhekele ukukhuthaza amalungelo abantu. Ngalesi sizathu, sakhe futhi siqhubeke nokugcina i-manifesto, ephendula njengethuluzi lokukhuthaza ukufinyelela ulwazi olunikezwe yi-Department. "Ukuqhubekisela phambili ukuphela kobuphofu": kuyisihloko esibekwe nguMongameli Thabo Mbeki, kuyisibopho sethu njenge-Department of Social Development futhi sikholelwa ukuthi lokhu akukwazi ukwenzeka ngaphandle kokuthi abahlali babe nokufinyelela ulwazi esizibophezele ekunikezeni ngokuzikhandla. Inhloso yethu ukuthi le manifesto ifinyeleleke kuzo zonke izinhlangano ezihlelwe ngohlanga, ubuzwe, nolimi ngokusebenzisa zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye kuhlanganise ne-braille nezinye izindlela zokuxhumana ukuze kubhekwe zonke izinhlobo zokukhubazeka. Nokho, le manifesto izoshicilelwa kuqala ngesiZulu, isiSetswana, isiTshivenda, nesiSepedi. Sithemba ukuthi ukushicilelwa kwesibili kuzohlanganisa nezinye izilimi kuze kube zonke izingxenye zomphakathi zikhululekile. Ngithemba futhi ngilungelo lokwethula kini i-manifesto ye-2002/2003 ye-Department of Social Development, ezokwazi ukwazisa ngensizakalo esihlinzekayo. Ngithemba futhi ngilungelo lokwethula le manifesto kini - abahlali baseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yale manifesto ukukhuthaza ukufinyelela kwenu kalula kulwazi olunikezwe yi-Department of Social Development ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe ngakho emthethweni, ikakhulukazi isigaba 32, esithi "Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela ulwazi olunikezwe uMbuso." Le manifesto yakhiwe ngokulandela umthetho wokukhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi, (Umthetho No.-2 ka-2000). Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimiso ze-Batho-Pele zivumela ukufinyelela okufanayo ezinsizweni, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinsizakalo zomphakathi okuyilungelo lenu lokuthola. Ngithemba ukuthi niyozithola le manifesto iyasiza futhi iyazisa. I-National Department of Social Development - Umthetho No. 3 Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi. Imininingwane ngaphansi kwesigaba 14 somthetho wokukhuthaza ukufinyelela kulwazi, No. I-Department of Social Development ibhekele ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo nezimiso zikazwelonke, izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezwe nezindinganiso, ukusekela umsebenzi oqhubekayo ezigabeni ze-Department of Social Development, ukuqaphela nokuhlola izinhlobo ezahlukene zezinqubomgomo zokuthuthukiswa. Ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi kuyinqubo eqhubekayo ehambisana nesibopho sezinhlelo ezahlukene ezihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo emphakathini okuyisibopho ezikhwameni zezigaba. Ukubuyisela ubuntu bokunakekela nokuthuthukisa abantu kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuvuselela imindeni nemiphakathi. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa amasu aqondile ukuze kuqedwe ubuphofu ahlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziqondile kulabo abadinga usizo, ngokusekelwe kumandla kanye nokwabelana kokuthuthukiswa emphakathini. Ukuthuthukisa uhlelo lokuphepha komphakathi oluyisisekelo oluhlanganisa imizamo yokuhlinzeka nokungahlinzeki ngosizo nokuphakamisa imindeni ethintekile kakhulu. Ukubhekana nemiphumela yezinhlobo zonke zokuhlukunyezwa okukhuluma ngabantu besifazane nezingane, kanye namasu okuphatha abahlaseli bokuhlukunyezwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lokuthanda nokunakekela abantu abahlala ne-HIV/AIDS noma i-AIDS uqobo kanye nalabo abathintekile, isibonelo, abantwana abashonile be-AIDS. Ukuthuthukisa isu lesizwe lokunciphisa ubugebengu bes youth nokungasebenzi ngaphansi kwe-National Framework for Crime Prevention. Ukwenza umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ufinyeleleke futhi utholakale kubantu abahlala ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, ezindaweni ezikude nasezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kanye nokuqinisekisa ubulungiswa ekufinyeleleni usizo. Ukusekela umsebenzi wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi ngokuzibophezela ekubambeni uhulumeni okuhlanganisa umsebenzi wezikhungo zikahulumeni ezahlukene nemiphakathi. Ukuqeqesha, ukufundisa, ukuhlela kabusha, nokuhlinzeka ngabasebenzi abasha. I-Department of Social Development igcina imibhalo enezihloko ezahlukene. Lonke ulwazi olufanele lokukhululwa luhlukaniswe ngesisekelo sezikhungo njengoba kuchaziwe etafuleni elingezansi. Imibhalo ihlelwe ngendlela yethebula. Ezinye imibhalo ziqondiswe ezinhlelweni ezithile, kanti ezinye zisezingeni eliphezulu, kanti ezinye zisesikhungweni. "Imibhalo" iqondiswe kumithombo yezindaba ezehlukene, isibonelo. Imibhalo egxile noma ethathwe kumarekhodi, imibhalo egcinwe emithonjeni yemishini noma kumabhrosha okukhangisa kwamakhompyutha. Isakhiwo: Njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla embhalweni, kube nezinguquko kwesakhiwo senhlangano. Ucelwa ukuba uxhumane noJaco Victor ukuze uthole incazelo ngeziququlweni zakamuva ezizokhombisa kahle futhi ngendlela efanele ngezansi. Imibhalo yokucwaninga eshicilelwe ngezibalo zabantu nezindaba zokuthuthukiswa, ezikhiqizwe yi-HSRC, MRC, DBSA, Izikhungo Zokufunda Eziphezulu, njll. Le mibhalo egcinwe ihlukaniswe ngezigaba ezilandelayo, isibonelo: ezomthetho, ezimali, ezokuphathwa, izindaba zomsebenzi, nezinye. Imizuzu yemihlangano, njll. Ngokukhethekile mayelana ne-GNSS, ibhekisela ezingeni lokuhambisana kwepharamitha elilinganisiwe, noma indawo ethile noma ijubane lelo ndlela ngesikhathi esithile noma endaweni ethile, kanye nejubane langempela elivame ukuhlinzekwa njengokulinganiswa kwezibalo kokwephutha kwemishini, futhi kuboniswa njengokuhlola okuphindaphindiwe futhi okungafani. uType A1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. uType B1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba. b Type B2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezikhumulweni sezindiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. "Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C" ubonisa umshini we-GNSS onama-sensors okulandela i-GNSS ahlinzeka ngemininingwane ngohlelo oluhlanganisiwe lokuhamba kwezindiza futhi uphinde usize ngokukhombisa indlela yokuhamba lapho iphathwa ngumshayeli noma umphathiswa wezindiza ukuze kuncishiswe amaphutha wezobuchwepheshe ezindizeni ze-FTE. uType C1 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, esikhumulweni sezindiza, endleleni engashayi ngqo umhloli, ngaphandle kokunquma ukuthi kuphi ukuhamba, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. b Type C2 - ikhono lokuthola umkhondo emoyeni, nasezikhumulweni sezindiza kuphela, ukuhlinzeka nge-RAIM. Qaphela: Umshini we-GNSS uhlobo C uzofakwa kuphela ezindizeni ezivunyelwe ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwelizwe nasezindizeni zokuhamba kwezindiza zomhlaba jikelele. Inqubo yokuhamba kwefu ibhekisela ezicwangcweni ezihlelwe zokusebenzisa amathuluzi athile okundiza ukuze kuvikelwe ukuhamba kwezindiza ezithintwa yizithiyo ezingaba khona kumkhondo wayo wokuqala kuze kube kufinyelelwa endaweni lapho izinhlelo zokuxhumana zomhlaba zingasungulwa futhi zibe usizo ekubambeni noma ekujikelezeni kwehamba, bese-ke, ngemuva kwalokho, ingabamba endaweni lapho uhlelo lokuphatha izithiyo zendawo noma izithiyo zendlela zisebenza. I-GNSS ibhekisela kuHlelo Lokuhamba Kwamazwe Ngamazwe lwezindiza ukuze kuhlonishwe isikhundla sezindiza esikhaleni. Uhlelo lokuhlonza indawo nesikhathi emhlabeni wonke oluhilela ubuchwepheshe bezithombe bokuhlola kude noma ukuqoqa kwazo, ama-receivers ezindiza, kanye nohlelo lokulandela olusekela ukuqapha nokuhlola izindiza emoyeni. Umcimbi we-GNSS ubhekisela ezenzekeni nasezimo ezifanayo nezinkinga zemishini, izinkomba, noma amaphutha abantu ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-GNSS. Ukuqina mayelana ne-GNSS kubhekisela ekwazini kwemishini ukuhlinzeka ngezixwayiso kulabo abasebenzisa yona uma ukusebenza kwayo kudlula imikhawulo yokuphepha esunguliwe futhi akufanele isetshenziswe ekulandeleni. Ukuhamba kwe-Side/edge kubhekisela ezindleleni zokuhola ukuhamba ngaphandle kwezinkomba ezithile ezivertical ezihlobene nezindlela zokulandela ukuhamba ngendlela engashayi ngqo umhloli noma yokuyifuna lapho idlula. Uhlelo lokuhamba lwezindiza oluyinhloko lubhekisela ohlelweni lokuhamba emoyeni olwamukelwa nguMphathiswa wezokuhamba noma ngesikhathi esithile sokuhamba, okuhlangabezana nezidingo zezinkomba ezivertical ezithile kanye nokuqina, kodwa akusho ukuthi kuhlangabezana ngokuphelele nezidingo zokutholakala noma ukuqhubeka. Ukuqina kolwazi olutholakalayo lwezobuchwepheshe (RAIM) kubhekisela kwisicwangciso lapho uhlelo lwe-GNSS luthola ukuqina kwezimpawu zokulawula ukuhamba nge-GNSS usebenzisa kuphela izimpawu ze-GNSS ezisizakale ngezinga lokuphuma. "RVSM" ibhekisela ekuhlukaniseni okukhona phakathi kwezinga lokuhamba elingu-290 kuya ku-1000 feet uma kubhekwa ohlangothini olulodwa futhi ama-2000 feet uma kubhekwa ngokuqondile kokuhamba. "Isikhala se-RVSM" sisho isikhala somoya phakathi kwezinga lokuhamba elingu-290 no-410 feet. "Isitifiketi sokuvunywa kwe-RVSM" sisho isitifiketi esibonisa ukuthi ukuhamba kanye nethimba kuhlangabezana nezidingo zokusebenza ze-RVSM. Ukuhola kokuhamba okuqondile noma phezulu kubhekisela kwisicwangciso sokulawula ukuhamba okuvumela ukuhlela okuqondile kusetshenziswa izinsiza zokulinganisa ezisemhlabeni, kubhekwa izindlela ezingaphandle kokuhamba noma ukuhlanganiswa kwalezi. Ukuqapha okuvele kubonisa isu le-IFR lokuhamba lapho ingxenye ethile noma yonke imithombo yokusebenza yokuhamba ingase ingasebenzi kahle uma umshayeli esebenzisa indlela lapho ukuhamba kukhona. b Umnyango Wezokuhamba Kwezimoto; noma c Isiteshi Sezokuphepha Esiseduze, kulokhu. b Umnyango Wezokuhamba Kwezimoto; noma c Isiteshi Sezokuphepha Esiseduze, mayelana nalolo mcimbi. Ukufaka Umthetho 21.08. Umthetho olandelayo ufakiwe ngemuva komthetho 21.08. A Ezindizeni ezilindelekile ukusebenza esikhumulweni somoya elind
Umthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kumininingwane, No. 2 ka-2000 ("umthetho") waqala ukusebenza ngomhla ziyi-9 kuNdasa 2001, unika ilungelo lemthethosisekelo lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe yinoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi noma eyaziwayo edingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo. Uma kwenziwa isicelo ngokuhambisana nomthetho, inhlangano ethunyelwa isicelo iphoqeleka ukukhulula lelo ulwazi, ngaphandle uma umthetho ucacisa ngokusobala ukuthi ulwazi lungakhululwa noma lungakhululwa. Umthetho uchaza izimo eziphathelene nezinqubo ezidingekayo ezihlobene nalelo sikhathi. Le ncwadi ihlose ukukhuthaza ukuveza kahle nokuvuleka ngaphakathi kweSikhungo Sokuhweba Nezimboni (DTI) ngokuhlinzeka ngelungelo lolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe futhi kuvikelwe amalungelo abantu noma izinhlangano. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuphathwa kahle kwezikhungo zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi futhi ufundiswe ukuze aqonde amalungelo akhe mayelana nomthetho. Ngendlela elungisa lelo lungelo namanye amalungelo, kuhlanganise nalawo atholakala kuBill of Rights kuMthethosisekelo. Isigaba 14 somthetho sidinga izikhungo zomphakathi ukuthi ziqambe imanuwali ukusiza ekufinyeleleni kulwazi olugcinwe izikhungo zomphakathi futhi zibeke izidingo ezincane okufanele imanuwali ihambisane nazo. I-DTI izibophezele, nokho, ekusebenzeni ngokukhanya, ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi ihlinzeka ngolwazi olukhululekile emphakathini wezohwebo, amakhasimende, kanye nomphakathi ngokusebenzisa imibhalo, izaziso, iwebhusayithi, kanye nesikhungo solwazi. Le manuwali ihloselwe ukuhlinzeka umceli, ngokusebenzisa umthetho, ngemininingwane edingekayo yokuxhumana, kanye nezinqubo zokuthola ulwazi oluthile ku-DTI. Imanuwali iphinde ibophezele ukuhlinzeka umceli ngombono ophelele mayelana nesakhiwo, imisebenzi, izinsizakalo, kanye nenhlangano yolwazi ngaphakathi kwe-DTI ukusiza umceli ekutholeni lapho ulwazi lungatholakala khona. Imanuwali iphinde ihlinzeke ngezifomu ezidingekayo nezimali ezifanele zokucela ulwazi. Okungenani u-40% wombuso we-DTI uhlinzekwa ngenethiwekhi yezikhungo ezisemthethweni ezakha ithimba le-DTI. IKhansela Lezikhungo Zokuhweba Nezimboni (COTII) lasungulwa, lifaka phakathi iBhodi Yabaqondisi be-DTI, Abaphathi Abaphakanyisiwe, kanye Nezikhulumi zendawo ngayinye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle kweqembu le-DTI kanye nezinhloso zeSikhungo. Le manuwali ihlinzeka kuphela ngerekhodi ze-DTI, hhayi lezo zeqembu le-DTI (COTII). Noma yiziphi izicelo zolwazi, kunoma yiziphi izikhungo ze-DTI, kumele ziqondiswe ehhovisi lolwazi lelo nhlangano. IKomidi Lokuncintisana kanye neTribunal Yokuncintisana kukhuthaza ukuncintisana, kuhlola futhi kubhekane nezindlela ezingalungile zokuncintisana, futhi kuthuthukisa ukugxila kwezomnotho ezimakethe ezihlobene ngaphansi komthetho wokuncintisana ka-1998. Lasungulwa ngo-1945, manje liphathwa nguMthetho Wenkampani Yezocwaningo Kazwelonke ka-1998, iNational Research Council izibophezele ekuhlinzekeni ngezixazululo zobuchwepheshe nolwazi ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi nezomnotho. Inhloso yenhlangano ukuhlela ulwazi olufanele oluzohlinzeka iNingizimu Afrika ngamakhono obuchwepheshe adingekayo, kanye nokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ukufunda kwesayensi nobuchwepheshe namakhono. IKhansela lizibophezele ekuholeni ukuqwashisa ngobuchwepheshe nasekuphakamiseni ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabasebenzi nobuchwepheshe. I-Industrial Development Corporation, ephethwe nguhulumeni, ihlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali olukhuthaza ukudalwa kwamabhizinisi ngokusungulwa kwemikhakha nezinkampani ezisebenza ngokuncintisana ngokusekelwe ezimisweni ezinhle zebhizinisi. Isikhungo siphathwa ngezinhlinzeko ze-Industrial Development Corporation Act ka-1940 njengoba kuguqulwe kanye nezinye izingxenye zeMthetho Wenkampani. I-Khula yasungulwa ngo-1996 futhi igxile ekuqinisekiseni ukufinyelela kalula ezikweletini nasekuxhaseni amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo kanye nezinkampani ezincane. Ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondile ngezivumelwano nezimali zokusebenza kumabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezincane. I-Khula ibhaliswe njengomshuwalense ngaphansi koMthetho Wokushuwalense futhi iphathwa ngezikhombisi zeBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali. Iphiko layo lokuqinisekisa izikweletu lihlolwa minyaka yonke ngokwezimali njengoba kucacisiwe yiBhodi Yezinsizakalo Zezezimali ukuze kutholakale izinga eliphezulu lezimali ezingabolekwa. I-National Framework for the Integration of Product Advisory Institutions ihlinzeka ngemikhakha yokukhiqiza ngolwazi nezinsizakalo zokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo ezahlukene zokweseka amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi, kanye nezinkampani ezincane. Ibhodi lasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokugembula Kazwelonke ka-1996 ukuze ilawule ukugembula, ihlinzeka ngeluleko likazwelonke. I-Bill entsha yeLiqour ka-1998 yaphasiswa nguMphakathi Kazwelonke ngo-1998 kodwa yathunyelwa kwiNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo nguMongameli ngenxa yemibuzo ephathelene nokuba semthethweni kwayo. I-Bill ihlose ukuhlela imboni yeLiqour ngokwethula uhlaka lokuthola amalayisense olwakha amalungiselelo amathathu; ukusungula iNational Liquor Advisory Committee, iNational Liquor Regulatory Authority, iNational Liquor Tribunal, izikhungo eziyisishiyagalolunye zokulawula i-liquor, kanye nezikhungo eziyisishiyagalolunye zokubuyisela; nokuhlinzeka ngohlaka lokulawula ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela nokuthola izinzuzo ngenkathi kuhlonishwa izindaba zomphakathi, ezomnotho, nezempilo. I-Foundation yasungulwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wamabhizinisi Amancane Kazwelonke ka-1996 njengenkampani yesigaba 21 ukuze ihlinzeke ngezinsizakalo zokweseka ezingezona zezimali kumabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo kanye nezinkampani ezincane. I-Foundation ihlinzeka ukufinyelela ekuqeqesheni, ulwazi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, ukumaketha, kanye nobuchwepheshe. I-Standards Organization ilawula i-Standards Act, No. 29 ka-1993, ekhuthaza ukujwayeleka nokulawulwa kwekhwalithi embonini nasemakethe futhi ibheka futhi ilandele izilinganiso nezindinganiso zemboni. Iphakela ubuholi emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngokuwuqonda, ulwazi lwawo ngezithuba nezinto ezikhona, nokucabangela ikusasa. Iphromotha uguquko nokuthuthukiswa komnotho futhi ibhekana nezinselelo nezithuba zabantu abathintekayo emnothweni, ukuze kusekelwe izinhloso zohulumeni zokuthuthukisa umnotho, ukudala amathuba emisebenzi, nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa. Iphatha izinselelo nezithuba emnothweni nasemphakathini. Iphakela indawo elindelekile ethokozisayo, elinganayo, futhi enobulungiswa ukuze kube lula ukutshalwa kwemali, imisebenzi, nokuhweba. Ngokwandisa umnikelo wamabhizinisi am
Umbhalo wesingisi osayinwe nguMongameli ubonisa izinyathelo zokukhuthaza ukuphepha kwemikhiqizo yenyama nemikhiqizo yezilwane; ukuhlela nokugcina izindinganiso ezisemqoka zizwe eziphathelene nokubulawa; ukuhlela ukuthengwa nokungeniswa kwenyama evela kwamanye amazwe; ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha kwenyama nokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ephathelene nalokho. Umsebenzi wesigaba uchaza umuntu osebenza ngaphansi kwesigaba 1l seMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994, okungase kuqinisekise ukuthi ezinye izingxenye zalo Mthetho azisebenziseki ezilwaneni ezithile ezichazwe kuSheduli -1. UNgqongqoshe kumele aqashe umsebenzi wesigaba ofunde imithi yezilwane ukuba abe yisikhungo esikhulu. Isikhungo esikhulu sizokwenza imisebenzi ehambisana namandla anikezwe lona futhi sizokwenza imisebenzi echazwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi nezimfuneko ezikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe. Singase sithathe isikhathi, sithumele eminye imihla, noma samukele isicelo ngendlela esikubona kufanelekile kwesimo ngasinye. Uma kukhona isicelo, isikhungo esikhulu singase sithathe isinqumo sokwandisa ngokubhala isikhathi esichazwe esigabeni - (a). Isicelo sokwandisa isikhathi kumele sibhale futhi sikhombise izizathu zesicelo. Isikhungo esikhulu kumele sikwazise ngokubhala ummangali ngesinqumo esithathwe kanye nezizathu zokwenqatshwa kwesicelo uma sikhishwa. Uma ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo isikhungo sithola ulwazi oluthile olungashintsha isimo sesinqumo saso uma lwalukhona ngesikhathi sokucubungula isicelo noma olungaholela ekwenqatshweni kwesicelo noma ekufakweni kwezimo ezithile eziphathelene ne-licence, isikhungo singakhishwa isaziso esibhaliwe kummangali sibazise ngokuqhuba isicelo lapho sikhishwa noma sikhanselwa noma ngaphansi kwezimo ezintsha, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Isikhungo esikhulu kumele sinikeze izizathu zazo zonke izinqumo zokukhansela isinqumo sangaphambili noma izinguquko ezenziwe ngokuqinisekiswa nguNgqongqoshe ofanele ophathelene nesikhungo sesifunda. Ukudluliswa kwamandla noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba (a)(ii) kungaqhutshwa kuphela ngokuvuma kukaNgqongqoshe. Amandla noma imisebenzi edlulisiwe noma anikezwe isikhungo sesifunda angadluliselwa phambili yilokho isikhungo sesifunda kumunye umsebenzi ophathwe yilo noma kumuntu ogunyaziwe. Isikhungo esikhulu kumele sinikeze umsebenzi, umuntu ogunyaziwe, kanye nezikhungo zesifunda ezichaziwe ngempela isikhumbuzo esibhaliwe esichaza ukuthi umuntu ochazwe uthola amandla okwenza imisebenzi echazwe lapho ephathelene nendawo ethile. Uma usebenzisa amandla noma wenza imisebenzi anikezwe yona ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, umsebenzisi, umuntu ogunyaziwe, noma isikhungo sesifunda kumele sikhombise isikhumbuzo esichaziwe esigabeni (a), uma sicele umuntu omunye. Isikhungo esikhulu esithumele amandla noma imisebenzi anikezwe lona noma adluliselwa kumuntu omunye, emsebenzini noma ezikhungweni zesifunda ngenxa yokudluliswa kwalawo mandla noma imisebenzi, ngaphandle kokuthi isizathu esihlobene nalowo muntu sithunyelwe kubo futhi lapho isinqumo singashintshwa noma sikhanselwa kuphela uma ushintsho noma ukukhanselwa kuzuza lowo muntu noma uma lowo muntu evuma ushintsho noma ukukhanselwa. UNgqongqoshe angase abeke isicelo sokusebenza kwalo Mthetho noma izingxenye ezithile zawo kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika noma ezindaweni ezithile kuphela ukuze zixhase umuntu othile onolwazi noma ulwazi oluthile mayelana nenyama noma ukuphepha kwaleyo nyama. Imisebenzi echazwe ngaphansi kwesigaba kumele iveze amandla nemisebenzi yomuntu okumele enze umsebenzi ngokuhambisana nezikhombisi zesikhungo esikhulu. Ngaphandle kokuthi uNgqongqoshe athathe isinqumo esihlukile kwenzeka, umuntu onikezwe imisebenzi akakwazi ukuxoxisana noMbuso mayelana nanoma yiziphi izindleko ezitholakele mayelana nokusebenzisa amandla noma ukwenza imisebenzi echazwe. Ngokubhala, kumele badlulisele amandla noma bathumele kumunye umsebenzi onikezwe amandla noma noma yiziphi amandla okumele asebenze noma imisebenzi okumele yenziwe ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho noma ngokubhala bavume noma baqondise noma yimuphi umsebenzi onjalo ukuba asebenze lawo mandla noma enze leyo misebenzi. Amandla asebenze noma imisebenzi eyenziwe ngumsebenzi ochazwe esigabeni kumele ibhekwane njengokwenziwa noma ukuphathwa nguMphakathi ophakeme, usihlalo, noma omunye umuntu ophathayo, kuye ngesimo ngasinye. Umphakathi ophakeme, usihlalo, noma omunye umuntu ophathayo angashintsha noma akhansela noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe noma isikhombisi esikhishwe yilowo msebenzi ngaphandle kokuthi isinqumo sithunyelwe kumuntu ophazamisekile ngesinqumo, futhi lapho isinqumo singashintshwa noma sikhanselwa kuphela uma ushintsho noma ukukhanselwa kuzuza lowo muntu noma ukukhanselwa kuzuza lowo muntu noma lowo muntu evuma ushintsho noma ukukhanselwa. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba, imisebenzi edlulisiwe ngokuxhumana nesikhungo esikhulu ingase iqinisekise ukukhokha okwenziwa ngumnikazi wezindawo zokubulala ukuze kuqhutshekwe namandla nemisebenzi anikezwe kubo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. Uma umuntu odlulisiwe engahambisani nezimo zalo Mthetho noma nesikhombisi sesikhungo esikhulu, isikhungo esikhulu singase sikhansela noma suspende imisebenzi yalowo muntu. Ngokuhambisana nezigaba, kanye nesigaba 6, imisebenzi efakwe ezigabeni 7, 8, 9, 10, 15, kanye ne 16 idluliselwa kuyo yonke isikhungo sesifunda. Bonke oNgqongqoshe besifunda abathintekayo kumele baqashe umsebenzi ofanele esifundeni ngasinye ongu-veterinarian ukuba abe yisikhungo sesifunda. Isikhungo sesifunda kumele sisebenzise amandla futhi senze imisebenzi anikezwe isikhungo sesifunda ngaphansi kwesigaba. Kumele sinikeze isikhungo esikhulu imibiko ephathelene nokuhambisana nezimo ezichazwe esigabeni ngendlela edingekayo ngesikhungo esikhulu. Isikhungo esikhulu kumele sibe nesibopho sokubheka ukuqhutshekiswa kwemisebenzi edlulisiwe ngalesi sigaba kuyo yonke imiphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe izindinganiso ezifanayo zisetshenziswa kuyo yonke iNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kwezikhathi ezithile, isikhungo esikhulu kumele sihlole imibiko yemisebenzi eyenziwe ngendlela echazwe esigabeni (a) futhi sinikeze umbiko ofanayo esikhungwini sesifunda. Ngokubhala, isikhungo singacela kusuka esikhungweni sesifunda noma kumuntu omunye onolwazi oludingekayo ngesikhungo esikhulu imininingwane ethile eceliwe ngesikhungo esikhulu ngenhloso yokulandelela imisebenzi eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, leyo mininingwane kumele ilethwe esikhungweni esikhulu ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichazwe esazisweni. Uma kwenzeka noma nini isikhungo esikhulu sinombono wokuthi isenzo noma ukuphuthelwa okuthile kunemiphumela yokwephula izindinganiso zokusebenza, kumele sikwazise isikhungo sesifunda esihlobene ukuze sicela ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezifanele zokulungisa isimo esonakele. Isikhathi noma ngaphansi kwezimo ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe. Uma kukhona ukuphakanyiswa, isikhungo esikhulu kumele silandele izindinganiso ezisemqoka nezimo ezihambelanayo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho endaweni ethintwayo kuze kube isikhathi esichazwe sokuhambisana nalolu sigaba siphelile. Uku
Imikhawulo ekubonakalisweni nasekufundiseni kwezilwane ezisetshenziselwa imisebenzi kanye nezinja ezisetshenziselwa ukuvikelwa. Isigaba 1 soMthetho Inombolo 7 ka-1991 sishintsha isigaba 1. UMagistrate angakhupha ilayisense yokubonakalisa nokufundisa izilwane ezibandakanyeka ezindleleni zokusebenza noma ukusebenzisa izinja ukuze ziqaphe. - Noma ubani ofuna ukubonakalisa noma ukufundisa isilwane ukuze sibe nombukiso, noma usebenzisa inja ukuze iqaphe, angafaka isicelo ngokubhala esebenzisa le fomu ebekiwe kumagistrate wesifunda lapho lowo muntu ehlala khona, edlala, noma enza ibhizinisi, efuna ilayisense yokwenza kanjalo, futhi uMagistrate uzokhipha ilayisense. c UMagistrate angaphika ukuvuselela isicelo seleyisense uma kungekho isizathu esihle nesifanele; futhi d UNgqongqoshe, ngokukhupha imithetho, angakhetha ifomu elizosebenzisa ukufaka isicelo seleyisense, imiqathango ehambisana nale layisense, kanye nezimali ezikhokhwayo zeleyisense noma yokuvuselela. Isitifiketi mayelana nezilwane ezineleyisense. - Umuntu onelayisense okukhulunywa ngayo esigabeni 2 akavunyelwe ukubonakalisa noma ukufundisa noma iyiphi isilwane noma ukwenza ukuthi ibonakaliswe noma ifundiswe ukuze kube nombukiso noma ukusebenzisa inja ukuze iqaphe ngaphandle kokuba bane sitifiketi esivumela ukuba babonakalise, bafundise, noma basebenzise lezo zilwane ezineleyisense. Isitifiketi okukhulunywa ngaso esigabeni 1 sizokhishwa nguMagistrate esebenzisa ifomu elibekiwe ngemva kokuthi umnikazi weleyisense ethumele ulwazi kubo. Isitifiketi sizochaza ukuthi ukufundiswa, ukubonakaliswa, nokusebenzisa kwesilwane noma izilwane ez covered by the certificate kuzokwenziwa kanjani. UMagistrate uzoba namandla okushintsha leso sitifiketi uma umnikazi weleyisense efaka isicelo sokushintsha isitifiketi... Ilungelo lokungena. - Ngaphezu kwamandla anikezwe emaphoyiseni ngaphansi komthetho noma yimuphi omunye, amaphoyisa ang... b ahlole lezo zilwane, izinja, noma izindawo, noma izimoto futhi angahlola ngokuphelele izinyathelo nezindlela ezisetshenziselwa ukulawula, ukufundisa lezo zilwane noma izinja nokuthi zondliwa kanjani lezo zilwane nezinja; futhi c ngesikhathi sokubonakaliswa kwezilwane ezifundisiwe noma ngenkathi usebenzisa izinja ukuze ziqaphe noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, angangena ezindlini, endaweni, noma emotweni noma engxenye yayo ephathelene nalokho okubukwayo noma ukusetshenziswa ukuze ahlole lezo zindawo, indawo, noma imoto noma izilwane noma izinja ezikhona kulowo mkhakha kanye nesimo lapho zigcinwa, zilawulwa, noma zondliwa ngesikhathi sokubonakaliswa noma ukusetshenziswa noma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ukuvinjwa kwamaphoyisa. - Noma ubani ovimbela, delay, noma ngokuhlosiwe uphazamise umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo noma ekusebenziseni amandla anikezwe kubo lapha noma afihla isilwane ngenhloso yokuphazamisa ukusetshenziswa kwalawo mandla, noma ophazamisa noma uphazamisa ukusetshenziswa kwalawo mandla uzoba necala futhi uma ebanjwa uzokhokha imali engaphezu kuka-R4000 noma uboshwe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyishumi ngaphezu kwanoma iyiphi enye inhlawulo efakwe ngenxa yokwephula lo Mthetho noma imithetho eyenziwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. kanye nokuphathwa kahle kwezizathu nezinhlelo zalolu Mthetho jikelele. Inhlawulo. - Noma ubani ophula noma iyiphi ingxenye yalolu Mthetho noma yimuphi umthetho owenziwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho ophakamisa inhlawulo noma yimiphi imiqathango yeleyisense noma isitifiketi uzoba necala futhi uma ebanjwa uzokhokha imali engaphezu kuka-R4000 noma uboshwe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyishumi. Ukugcina. - Akukho okukhulunywa ngalo Mthetho okuzosebenza ekugcineni noma ekufundiseni kwezilwane ezisetshenziselwa izinjongo zempi, amaphoyisa, noma ezemidlalo noma ezokuboniswa kwezolimo, imibukiso yezinyathi, imibukiso yezinja, imibukiso yezinyoni ezitholakala emakhaya, noma noma iyiphi imibukiso yomphakathi mayelana nokuphila kwezilwane, emjaho noma emncintiswaneni wezempilo noma amaphoyisa noma noma iyiphi imibukiso efanayo noma yokuboniswa kwezilwane noma ukusetshenziswa kwezilwane ezibhekwa ngesevisi yokuphepha yaseNingizimu Afrika, noma isevisi yamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika noma uMnyango Wezokulungisa. Umthetho okufanele ufundwe noMthetho Inombolo 71 ka-1962. - Lo Mthetho uzofundwa njengomunye noMthetho Wokuvikela Izilwane ka-1962 (Umthetho Inombolo 71 ka-1962), futhi amandla anikezwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho azosiza amandla anikezwe yilowo Mthetho ngaphandle uma inhloso iphikisana nalokhu. Ukuhumusha kwamagama asetshenzisiwe. ukuvikelwa kusho ukufundisa, ukusebenzisa, noma ukuhlinzeka ngenhloso yokuthola noma ukusebenzisa inja ngenhloso yokuvikela abantu noma impahla. Isihloko esifushane. - Lo Mthetho uzobizwa ngokuthi uMthetho Wokuvikela Izilwane Zokusebenza zika-1935.
Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhamuka, ukukhombisa, nokusebenzisa impahla yezenzakalo zezilwane ngokweqile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhiqizwa nokuphila kwezilwane ngothando lweRiphabhulikhi; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. Lo Mthetho uhlanganisa iziqondiso; futhi ingxenye 'udokotela wezilwane' ibhekisela kumuntu obhaliswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobuchwepheshe Bezilwane kanye noMthetho Wempilo Yezilwane, 1982 (Umthetho 19 ka-1982), ukuze prepares for veterinarians njengoba kuchazwe engxenyeni 1 yoMthetho. Lo mthetho uzosebenza kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezilwane, noma isilwane esihlukile ngokwenkolo yalolo hlobo njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakhangisa ngomyalezo kwiGazethi ukuthi isilwane sikhona ngenhloso yalo Mthetho. Mayelana nohlobo olusha lwezilwane noma uhlobo olusha lwalesi silwane okufanele lungene ezweni noma lukhulunywe eRiphabhulikhi, uNgqongqoshe uzokwenza isimemezelo ngemva kokubheka isicelo, futhi ephinde acabangele umthetho wamazwe omhlaba, futhi ngemva kokuthola imibono ukuze aphendule isaziso somphakathi okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngaphambi kokuba kube nesimemezelo esinjalo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane noma izizukulwane zalolu hlobo lwezilwane zingamenyezelwa njengokuhambisana nezimo zalo Mthetho: Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isilwane noma impahla yezenzakalo njengoba kubhekiswe engxenyeni 17 izomenyezelwa kuphela ngemva kokuthi isicelo sithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe ngenhlangano efanele yokukhulisa izilwane. a endaweni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu eRiphabhulikhi; noma b ezweni elilodwa noma ngaphezulu elichaziwe. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha umphakathi kwiSikhungo, onemfundo efanele ephezulu ekuthuthukiseni izilwane, njengomphakathi Wokuthuthukisa Izilwane, ozosebenzisa amandla futhi enze imisebenzi ethunyelwe kuye noma ethunyelwe kuye ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho. a Umqondisi angadlulisa amandla noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwengxenye 1 ngokubhala kumphakathi onemfundo efanele namakhono, noma anganika amandla noma aqondise umphakathi ngokubhala kubo ukuze basebenzise lawo mandla noma benze leyo misebenzi. c Noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe noma umyalo onikezwe umphakathi osebenzisa amandla ngaphansi kwengxenye a singaqedwa noma sishintshwe nguMqondisi, futhi njengoba kukhishwe nguMqondisi kuze kube sekuphelweni noma kuguqulwa ngaphandle kokuhlosiwe kwalesi sihloko. Amandla kaMqondisi okusebenzisa isinqumo a Noma yiziphi amandla okuthola anikezwe uMqondisi ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ngaphandle kwalawo anikezwe ngengxenye 16 noma 17, awazukusetshenziswa ukuze aphikise noma yimuphi ummangali noma omunye umuntu ophuma phambi koMqondisi njengothando, ngaphandle kokunikeza lowo mmangali noma umuntu ithuba lokuzwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingase sikhishwe noma, uma isikhathi singakukhishwanga, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esifanele njengoba kuzokhombiswa nguMqondisi. b Ummangali noma omunye umuntu osebenzisa amandla ngaphansi kwengxenye a angakhipha leli thuba lokuzwa. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ngokuhambisana nalolu Mthetho isikhathi sikhishwe lapho noma yini kufanele yenziwe, uMqondisi angakwandisa leso sikhathi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuphela kwaso. UMqondisi uzogcina uhlu lwabakhulisi bezilwane, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezinhlamvu, abathumeli bezinhlamvu, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulisi, imiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe noma ezivunyelwe futhi ulwazi olurekhodiwe mayelana nalezi zikhungo, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezinhlamvu, abathumeli bezinhlamvu, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulisi, imiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe kuzobhalwa. Uhlu luzovuleka, ngemva kokukhokhwa kwezindleko ezikhishwe, ukuze luhlolwe ehhovisi likaMqondisi phakathi nezinsuku zomsebenzi. UMqondisi uzohlinzeka nganoma yimuphi umuntu, uma ecela futhi ngemva kokukhokhwa kwezindleko ezikhishwe, ikhophi yolwazi oluthile olurekhodiwe kuhlu noma isitifiketi esihlobene nakho. Uhlu luzoba ubufakazi obuqinile bazo zonke izindaba ezihlosiwe noma ezinikezwe amandla ngalo Mthetho okufanele zibhalwe lapho. Isitifiketi esithi sibhaliwe nguMqondisi sizoba nomthelela wokuthi ubhaliso kuhlu alwenziwanga noma ukuthi noma iyiphi enye indaba enikezwe amandla ngalo Mthetho ukuba yenziwe, yenziwe noma ingakwenziwanga izoba ubufakazi obuqinile bezindaba ezichaziwe kulolo sitifiketi. Ikhophi yokufakwa kuhlu noma ukukhipha kuhlu, ethi iqinisekiswe nguMqondisi, izokwamukelwa njengobufakazi nanoma yisiphi isikhungo somthetho ngaphandle kokwengeza ubufakazi noma ukukhipha okwakungukuphela. b umkhulisi obhaliswe nguMqondisi ngenhloso leyo uqinisekisile ngendlela ethile enikezwe nguMqondisi ukuthi umkhulisi, umhlinzeki, umqoqi wezinsalela, kanye nomthumeli wezinsalela, unayo, ngaso sonke isikhathi, ulwazi olwaneleyo, okuhlangenwe nakho, kanye nobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuqoqwa kwemikhono, izinsalela, noma mayelana nokuqoqwa kwezinsalela, izinsalela, noma izinsalela zomfazi ezitholakele, zihlolwe, zisetshenziswe, zifakwe, noma zigcinwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho, futhi ukuthi ezilwaneni, mayelana nomkhulisi, umhlinzeki wezinsalela, noma umqoqi wezinsalela, kungase kube ukuthi izinsalela zikhishwe noma, mayelana nomqoqi wezinsalela noma umthumeli wezinsalela, zingeniswe ngensalela yomfazi noma izinsalela; futhi c ukuhambisana nezinye izidingo ezithile ezikhishwe. Umthumeli kufanele futhi abhaliswe uma ethatha isinqumo sokubhalisela uMqondisi ukuthi uzosebenzisa ama-laboratories namalungelo okukhulula izintela ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezikhishwe zezimali zezenzakalo ezingeniswe nguye ezweni noma ezingeniswe komunye umuntu. b abasebenzisi bezobuchwepheshe kule ndawo, mayelana nokunakekela izilwane ezigcinwe lapho, bangase baqoqe, bahlolisise, basebenzise, bafake, benze amalebula, futhi bagcine impahla yezenzakalo, kubhekwa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwale ndawo kwenziwa ngumuntu olandela izidingo ezikhishwe; futhi c le ndawo kufanele ilandele lezo zidingo ezikhishwe. b izilwane zalezi zinhlobo zilandele ezinye izidingo ezikhishwe njengokuhambisana. a le ndawo ibhaliswe njengendawo; noma ii isilwane sivunyelwe njengempahla yezenzakalo yohlobo oluthile, kufanele ifake isicelo ngendlela ezohlinzekwa nguMqondisi nangendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe nezehlakalo ezikhishwe zohlobo lokubhaliswa noma ukuvunywa okufunwa. Iqembu labantu elifuna ukubhalisela njengemiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane kufanele lifake isicelo kuMqondisi ngendlela ezohlinzekwa nguMqondisi nangendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe nezinye izimiso zomphakathi wabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezindleko zokufaka isicelo ezikhishwe. Imiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane noma iqembu lemiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane elifuna ukubhalisela njengemphakathi ebhalisiwe kufanele lifake is
Ukuhlinzeka ngokukhulisa, ukuveza, nokusebenzisa impahla yezenzakalo zezilwane ngaphezu kwabanye ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhiqizwa nokulima izilwane ngenhloso yokuthanda iRiphabhulikhi; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nezinto ezitholakele. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa imiyalelo; futhi igama elithi 'udokotela wezilwane' libhekisela kumuntu obhaliswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobungcweti Bezilwane kanye noMthetho Wempilo Yezilwane, 1982 (Umthetho 19 ka-1982), ukuze kulungiselelwe odokotela bezilwane njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 salo mthetho. Lo mthetho uzosebenza kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezilwane, noma izilwane ezihlukile ngempela zalolo hlobo njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakhangisa ngokuqaphela esikhangisweni. Ngokuphathelene nohlobo olusha lwezilwane noma uhlobo olusha lwezilwane oludingekayo ukuba lungene ezweni noma lukhuliswe kwiRiphabhulikhi, uNgqongqoshe uzokwenza isikhangiso ngemuva kokucabangela isicelo, futhi ethatha kakhudlwana umthetho wamazwe omhlaba, futhi ngemuva kokuthola imibono yokuphendula esikhangisweni somphakathi okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngaphambi kokwenziwa kwalolo sikhangiso. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane noma izilwane zalolo hlobo zingabekwa njengokunjalo ngokuhambisana nezimo zalo mthetho: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isilwane noma impahla yezenzakalo njengoba kukhulunywa esigabeni 17 izokwenziwa kuphela ngemuva kwesicelo esibhaliwe sikaNgqongqoshe esivela enhlanganweni efanele yokukhulisa izilwane. a endaweni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kwiRiphabhulikhi; noma b ezweni elilodwa noma ngaphezulu elichaziwe. UNgqongqoshe uzokhetha umphakathi kwiSigaba, onemfundo efanelekile ephezulu ekuthuthukiseni izilwane, njengomphakathi Wokuthuthukisa Izilwane, ozosebenzisa amandla futhi enze imisebenzi enikezwe kubo noma edlulisiwe kubo ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. a URegistrar angadlulisela amandla noma imisebenzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 1 ngokubhalela umphakathi onemfundo efanelekile namakhono, noma anganikeza amandla noma adlulisele umphakathi ngokubhalela kubo ukuze basebenzise lawo mandla noma benze lezo zisebenzi. c Noma yisiphi isinqumo esithathwe noma umyalo onikezwe umphakathi ngaphansi kwesigaba a singaqedwa noma sishintshwe nguRegistrar, futhi njengoba kuhlelwe nguRegistrar kuze kube sekuphelweni noma kushintshwe ngaphandle kokuhlosiwe kwalolu sigaba. Amandla okusebenzisa isinqumo sikaRegistrar a Noma yiziphi amandla okuthatha isinqumo anikezwe uRegistrar ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho, ngaphandle kwalawo anikezwe ngezinsuku 16 noma 17, awavunyelwe ukuba asetshenziswe ukuze ahlukanise noma yimuphi ummangali noma omunye umuntu ophakathi kukaRegistrar njengomthandi, ngaphandle kokunikeza lowo mmangali noma lowo muntu ithuba lokuzwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingasetshenziswanga noma, uma isikhathi singasetshenziswanga, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esifanele njengoba kuzokhombiswa nguRegistrar. b Ummangali noma omunye umuntu ophathelene ngaphansi kwesigaba a angakwazi ukwehlisa leli thuba lokuzwa. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kulandela lo mthetho isikhathi esichaziwe lapho noma yisiphi umthetho noma okuthile kufanele kwenziwe, uRegistrar angathuthukisa leso sikhathi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuphela kwaso. URegistrar uzogcina irekhodi labakhulisi bezilwane, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezinhlaka, abahlukanisi bezinhlaka, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulisi, imiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe noma ezivunyelwe, futhi ulwazi olunikeziwe mayelana nalaba bakhulisi bezilwane, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezinhlaka, abahlukanisi bezinhlaka, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulisi, imiphakathi yabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo zokulawula kuzobhaliswa. Irekhodi lizovulwa, ngemuva kokukhokha imali ethile, ukuze lihlole ehhovisi likaRegistrar phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza. URegistrar uzohlinzeka noma yimuphi umuntu, uma efuna futhi ngemuva kokukhokha imali ethile, ngekopya yalolu lwazi olubhaliswe kwi rekhodi noma isitifiketi esihlobene nalokho. Irekhodi lizoba yisibonakaliso esiqinile sezozinto zonke ezikhulunywe noma ezinamandla ngalesi sikhathi ukuze zibhaliswe khona. Isitifiketi esithi sigunyazwe nguRegistrar sizoba nomthelela wokuthi ukubhaliswa akwenziwanga noma ukuthi noma yini enye enikezwe amandla ngalesi sikhathi ukuze kwenziwe, kwenziwe noma kungakwenziwanga kuzoba yisibonakaliso esiqinile sezinto ezichaziwe kulolo sitifiketi. Ikhopya yokungena kwi rekhodi noma isiqeshana esivela kwi rekhodi, esithi siqinisekiswe nguRegistrar, sizothathwa njengobufakazi kunoma iyiphi inkantolo ngaphandle kokwengeza ubufakazi noma ukukhipha okwakudala. b njengomkhulisi obhaliswe ngenhloso ethile uqinisekisile ngendlela enikezwe nguRegistrar ukuthi umqoqi wezilwane, umhlinzeki, umqoqi wezinsalela, kanye nomhlukanisi wezinsalela, ngazo zonke izenzakalo, bangase, ngokubona kwabo, babe nolwazi olunembile nolwazi mayelana nokuqoqwa kwezilwane, i-sperm, noma mayelana nokuqoqwa kwe-embryos, ama-embryos, noma izinsalela zabesifazane ezihlanganisiwe, zihlolwe, zisetshenziswe, zipakishwe, noma zigcinwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho, futhi ukuthi ezilwaneni, mayelana nomqoqi wezilwane, umhlinzeki we-embryos, noma umqoqi wezinsalela, kungase kube ukuthi bahlinzekwa ngokusebenzisa noma, mayelana nomqoqi we-embryo noma umhlukanisi, bangangeniswa ngensalela yomfazi noma i-embryo; futhi c ukuhambisana nezinye izidingo ezithile ezingenziwa. Umthumeli kufanele futhi abhaliswe uma ethanda ukubhalisela uRegistrar ukuthi uzosebenzisa ama-laboratories namalungelo okukhulula izintela ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezibekwe zokuhlola zonke impahla yezenzakalo ezingeniswe ngabo ezweni noma ezingeniswe komunye umuntu. b abasebenzisi bezobuchwepheshe kule ndawo, mayelana nokunakekela izilwane ezigcinwe lapho, bangase futhi baqoqe, bahlola, basebenzise, bapakishe, baphawule, futhi bagcine impahla yezenzakalo, kubhekwa njengokwenziwa ngumuntu okulandela izidingo ezibekwe; futhi c le ndawo kufanele ilandele lezo zidingo ezithile ezingenziwa. b lezo zilwane zilandela ezinye izidingo ezibekwe njengokunjalo. i indawo ibhaliswe njengendawo; noma ii isilwane sivunyelwe njengensalela yezenzakalo, kufanele sifake isicelo ngendlela ezonikezwa nguRegistrar nangendlela ebekwe, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe nezezimali ezibekwe zokubhaliswa noma ukuvunywa okufunwa. Iqembu labantu elifuna ukubhalisela njengomphakathi wabakhulisi bezilwane kufanele lifake isicelo kuRegistrar ngendlela ezonikezwa nguRegistrar nangendlela ebekwe, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe nezinqumo zomphakathi wabakhulisi bezilwane, kanye nezimali zokufaka isicelo. Umphakathi wabakhulisi bezilwane noma iqembu lomphakathi wabakhulisi bezilwane elifuna ukubhalisela njengomphakathi obhalisiwe kufanele lifake isicelo kuRegistrar ngendlela enikezwe nguRegistrar ngendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sibe nezinqumo
Ekuhloleni kwemikhiqizo, noma lezo ezithengiswa njengeziphuzo eziphuzwayo uma ziqukethe ngaphezulu kwephesenti elilodwa le-alcohol ngokwemboni; noma lezo ezikhulunywe ngazo njengeziphuzo eziphuzwayo ngaphansi kwesigaba 5(2). Ukwabiwa kubhekisela ekuthengiseni noma ekuletheni iziphuzo eziphuzwayo kumntwana noma umthengisi othengisa ngengilazi. "Umntwana" ubhekisela kumuntu ongakafiki eminyakeni engu-18, noma omdala kunalokho njengoba kuchazwe ngumthetho wesifunda ofanele. Noma yisiphi isenzo noma ukuziphatha okuphazamisa ukuthula noma okubangela udlame emphakathini kufakwa futhi. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa noma iyiphi isheduli nemigomo ekhishwe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Uhlanga lokuphathwa komnotho embonini; nomoya wokuzinikela kwabantu kule ndawo. Umuntu obhalisiwe noma ibhizinisi elithenga kwamanye amazwe noma elikhiqiza noma elipakisha noma elithengisa iziphuzo eziphuzwayo ngaphezu kwenani elichaziwe, noma umuntu noma ibhizinisi ofuna ukubhaliswa, futhi ebona ukuthi ngemuva kokubhaliswa, kuzothengwa kwamanye amazwe noma kukhiqizwe noma kupakishwe noma kuthengiswe iziphuzo eziphuzwayo ngaphezu kwenani elichaziwe.
