Ngaphambi kokuba uMqondisi anikeze ilayisensi yokuhlanza kumfakisicelo welayisensi, kufanele akhokhe imali ethile. Ilayisensi yokuhlanza iphela kulandela imigomo nemibandela ngaphansi kwazo ikhishwe. Umnikazi welayisensi yokuhlanza angase enze noma iyiphi imisebenzi evunyelwe yile layisensi noma kunoma iyiphi enye indawo noma indawo yokusebenza echazwe kule layisensi noma echazwe imvume eyengeziwe kule layisensi ngokuhambisana nesigaba 6, futhi umnikazi welayisensi akavunyelwe ukutholakala ebamba noma enensimbi eyigugu kunoma iyiphi indawo ngaphandle kwendawo yakhe yokusebenza noma indawo echazwe ngaphandle uma ethutha insimbi eyigugu engathuthukisiwe ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhuluma esigabeni 11. a Uma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kudingeka umnikazi welayisensi yokuhlanza ukuthi adlulisele noma andise imisebenzi okukhuluma ngazo esigabeni 5 kuye kunoma iyiphi indawo yokusebenza noma indawo engachazwanga kule layisensi, uMqondisi, ngemuva kokuxhumana okukhuluma esigabeni 1, angabhala kule layisensi yomuntu le ndawo eyengeziwe futhi kufanele asheshise ukuwazisa uMnyango Wezezimali kanye noMphathiswa Wezizwe ngaleyo ndawo eyengeziwe. b Imvume eyengeziwe okukhuluma ngayo esigabeni a ayivumeli umnikazi welayisensi yokuhlanza ukuba enze umsebenzi wakhe kule ndawo eyengeziwe noma ngaphansi kwegama elihlukile kunalelo lendawo esebenza kuyo. c Uma umnikazi welayisensi yokuhlanza efuna ukwenza umsebenzi kunoma iyiphi enye indawo ngaphansi kwegama elihlukile kunalelo asetshenziswa endaweni akhona, kufanele afake isicelo seleyisensi entsha ngokuhambisana nendawo noma indawo entsha. a Ngemuva kokuxhumana okukhuluma esigabeni 1, uMqondisi angavuselela ilayisensi yokuhlanza kanye kuphela ngesikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka engama-30, ngokukhokha imali ethile minyaka yonke uma isicelo sokuvuselela sithunyelwa okungenani ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ngaphambi kokuphela kwelayisensi. b Isigaba 2 sizosebenza, izinguquko ezidingekayo zizokwenziwa, mayelana nokwenqatshwa noma ukuc
Lungisa umthetho weGauteng Constitution Amendment Act ka-2001 mayelana nezinsiza zokuhamba, ukuze ubuyekezwe futhi uhlanganise incazelo ethile; ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo adingekayo wokusebenzisa umhlaba mayelana neziteshi kanye namandla adingekayo kuMEC ukuze angene ezivumelwaneni zokwakha izivumelwano zomgwaqo nezokuhamba ngezitimela; ukuhlela inqubo mayelana nokumemezela umgwaqo; ukwenza ucwaningo lwesibili endaweni esigabeni somgwaqo wokuqala noma umgwaqo wezitimela lapho umbuso ungathola ukuthi ucwaningo endaweni kuleli gumbi lokumemezela luyadingeka; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezincane. Igama elithi 'umgwaqo wezitimela' libhekisela kumathuluzi omgwaqo asetshenziselwa umgwaqo onzima noma olula, futhi lapho isimo sikhombisa njalo, ilungelo lokuhamba, [lapho umgwaqo onzima noma olula usebenza, njengoba kukhombisiwe noma kumiswa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho] noma phezulu noma phansi komhlaba futhi kufaka phakathi umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nokuphambukiswa kwawo okwethenjelwe. Ekuthatheni umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela, ukulungiswa okukhishwe komgwaqo ngokwesigaba noma okucatshangwa ukuthi kukhishwe ngokwesigaba, noma ukulungiswa komgwaqo wesifunda okukhona, uMEC kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo omgwaqo wokuqala enziwe, ngokuhambisana nebhuku elibhalwe njengoba kuchaziwe futhi kuhlanganise nezincomo mayelana nomgwaqo, bese uMEC kufanele alandele inqubo echazwe kulolu sigaba. Ngaphambi kokuthatha umgwaqo noma umgwaqo oguquliwe, uMEC kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lendawo kanye nebika kwenziwa njengoba kubhekwa umbuso owaziwe ngomsebenzi esigabeni 22 se-ECA, noma umbuso obheka izigaba ezihlobene ze-NEMA uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, ungathola. kanye nokumemezela kwezinyathelo zokulawula eziqala ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 11. UMEC kufanele axhumane nayo yonke imiphakathi lapho umgwaqo uzoba khona futhi acela, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe, ukuthi bathumele imibono ebhaliwe ngombiko wokuqala womgwaqo nendawo ekhombisa umthelela umgwaqo ophakanyisiwe ozoba nawo kunoma iyiphi ifreyimu noma enye uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi oluhlelwe kahle lwezindawo ezithintekayo. a ibhekisela kumgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela; noma b ngokufaka izigaba 6 kuya ku-9, thumela udaba noma izinkinga ezivela emibikweni ethile noma imibono kwiKomishini ukuze kwenziwe ukuxoxisana komphakathi okunikeza izeluleko ngalokho okukhuluma ngqo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe nguMEC futhi, emva kokucabangela lezi zincomo, kumemeze umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela. h umuntu angaba yisikhumbuzo esinokufaneleka okufanele kube omunye walabo abakhuluma ngezikhala a kuya ku-g; futhi i isikhumbuzo kanye namalungu amane kufanele akhe i-quorum ngenjongo yokusebenza kweKomishini. e usuku nendawo yalokho kuxoxisana komphakathi; futhi f ukumemezela kwezinyathelo zokulawula eziqala ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 12. futhi b phatha ukuxoxisana ngokuhambisana nenqubo echazwe. Ngemuva kokwenza ukuxoxisana, iKomishini kufanele ihlanganise umbiko obhaliwe wokuxoxisana, ibhekisela, uma kusebenza, ezinqubweni zepolitiki ezichazwe esigabeni 3 se-Development Facilitation Act, 1995 Umthetho No. 67 ka-1995 nasezinhlelweni zokuhlela zesifunda. UMEC, ngokuxhumana nelungu leBhodi yezeMisebenzi elibhekelele ukuhlela ukuthuthukiswa, kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ukumemezela komgwaqo ngaphansi kwesigaba 5a noma b kuhambisana kangangokuthi kungenzeka nanoma iyiphi ifreyimu noma enye uhlelo lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa kwesifunda olwenziwe ngaphansi komthetho wokuhlela wesifunda. isaziso sokuthi izizathu zisenzo sikaMEC mayelana nokuthathwa komgwaqo zingacelwa ezindabeni ezithintekayo nezithintekayo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30 kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa kwesaziso. Ngokusho kwesigaba 82, umgwaqo noma isigaba singashintshwa kuphela nguMEC ngemva kokuhlanganisa izinqubo ezichazwe ezigabeni 81 kuya ku-8 futhi izinguquko zomgwaqo kufanele zikhishwe esigabeni 11. Isigaba 7 soMthetho oyinhloko sishintshwa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". a ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 1 noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 611". b ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 2 noma kuphi lapho amagama "isigaba 611" futhi ukufaka amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "61 kuya ku-11". a umbiko wendawo obhekiswe esigabeni 4b noma isigaba 63a, uma kusebenza; futhi f ngokufaka esigabeni 8 amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "isigaba 611." Isigaba 10 soMthetho oyinhloko sishintshwa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" kunoma yisiphi isigaba lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". f ukuhlanganiswa kohlelo lwezitimela, umgwaqo wezitimela nezinye izinsizakalo ezihlobene kuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo zezikhumulo zezindiza, kanye nendawo ezungezile yomphakathi nezinye izinsiza zokuhamba. UMEC unamandla, ngaphandle kokulimaza eminye imithetho, ukuhamba noma ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba, lokho akwenza egameni lezinye izinhlangothi noma eziningi zalabo abathintekayo esivumelwaneni esishiwo esigabeni 1, noma noma ilungelo lokuhamba emhlabeni womunye noma elinye ilungelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi libhalisiwe noma alibhaliswanga, kodwa ezandleni zikaMEC noma zePhondo, ngenjongo noma mayelana nanoma yisiphi isivumelwano njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1 nangokuhambisana nesikhathi salo sivumelwano.
Amagama abhalwe ngokuqinile akhombisa lokho okukhishwe emthethweni osekhona. Amagama agqokwe ngocingo oluqinile akhombisa lokho okubandakanywe emthethweni osekhona. Ukuze kuqaliswe uhlaka lwesizwe lokulawula umkhakha kagesi, ukudala umphakathi wezeMali wezeMali, umgibeli nomshayeli wohla lokulawula kagesi wesizwe; ukuhlinzeka ngamalayisense nokubhaliswa njengendlela yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, ukusabalalisa, ukuhweba, nokwamukela nokuthumela ugesi ukuze kulawulwe; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. Ukudluliswa kusho ukuhanjiswa kukagesi ngohlelo lokudlulisa, kanye nokuhamba nokuhanjiswa kukagesi ngezinkolelo ezihlobene. Futhi umthetho uhlanganisa amagama noma iziqondiso ezenziwe noma ezinikeziwe mayelana nakho. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza kanye nokusebenza kahle kukagesi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuncintisana nokukhetha kwamakhasimende; nokukhuthaza ukukalwa okuhle ngaphakathi kokuthanda kwamakhasimende, abanikazi bamalayisense, abakhiqizi embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kanye nomphakathi. Umphakathi wezeMali wezeMali owasungulwa ngengxenye 3 yoMthetho Wokulawula ugesi ungumgibeli nomgibeli wohla oluhlinzekwe ngalo Mthetho. Ukuze uthole noma uqashe impahla ethile esuswe noma eyashiywa ukuze wenze imisebenzi yayo; nokuthatha noma yisiphi isinyathelo esiyingozi emisebenzini yabo. Umphakathi ungase uthethe izinkomidi eziqukethe amalungu amaningi omphakathi, abasebenzi bomphakathi, nabanye abantu njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze iseluleko kumphakathi ngokujwayelekile noma ngezindaba ezithile. Umphakathi ungase uthethe ama-foramu amakhasimende nabahwebi aqukethe amalungu amaningi omphakathi, abasebenzi bomphakathi, kanye nezikhulumi zamakhasimende nabathengi njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze iseluleko kumphakathi ngezindaba ezihlobene namakhasimende noma abathengi ngokujwayelekile, noma ingxenye ethile yamakhasimende noma abathengi. Umphakathi kumele ucele ilayisense ukuze uqale futhi uhlinzeke ngemali kumphakathi noma foramu yabathengi ngendlela echazwe kumalayisense abanjwe yilowo muntu. Ngaphandle kokubheka isigaba 1, umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okukhulunywe ngakho kuSheduli II okudingayo ukufaka isicelo noma ukuba nelayisense enikezwe umphakathi akufanele abe nalutho kulomthetho olukhishwe kubo ukuze bahlale beyi-licensee ekuxoxeni ngokuqalisa nokusebenza kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka, ukuhweba, noma noma iyiphi imisebenzi ehambisanayo, ngaphambi kokuphothula isicelo selayisense kumphakathi. Umphakathi kumele uhlinzeke kumfaki-sicelo okukhulunywe ngakho esigabeni a ngemininingwane edingekayo ukuze kube lula ukufaka izicelo zamalayisense. Akukho sicelo sokuhlala kwemininingwane, izaziso, noma izingxoxo ezihlobene esigabeni 3 ezingase zithathwe njengokuthinta noma yisiphi ilungelo noma okulindelwe komfaki-sicelo. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi, athole imininingwane kuGazethi mayelana nanoma iyiphi imisebenzi esigabeni 8 edinga ilayisense kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywe kulokhu kuziswa. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi, athole izaziso kuGazethi mayelana nanoma yimuphi umuntu ophakathi kwalesi sikhathi sokuhweba noma ukukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungadingi ilayisense ngaphansi kwesigaba 8 kufanele bhaliswe nomphakathi. Noma yimuphi umuntu odinga ukubhaliswa nomphakathi kumele akwenze ngendlela kanye nokulandela izinqubo ezibekwe, kanye nesicelo esibekwe esidinga ukuhambisana nezimali zokubhaliswa ezibekwe: uma noma yimuphi umuntu onelayisense ngosuku olukhulunywe esigabeni 9 kufanele anikezwe isitifiketi sokubhaliswa ngaphandle kokulandela izinqubo ezibekwe. Ngemuva kokuthola isicelo ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba 2, umphakathi kumele ubhalise umfaki-sicelo wemisebenzi echazwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa ezonikezwa kulowo muntu. Uma isicelo singafakiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekwe noma singaqhubeki nezimali zokubhaliswa ezibekwe; noma uma isicelo siphikisana nenhloso yalomthetho. Ubufakazi bokulandela uhlelo olufanele lokuhlanganiswa kwamandla ngaleso sikhathi; kanye neminye imininingwane evela kuNgqongqoshe njengoba kuchaziwe. UNgqongqoshe kumele achaze izidingo ezizolandelwa abafaki-sicelo ngaphambi kokuba umphakathi ucabangele isicelo selayisense. Uma ilayisense iceliwe kumphakathi, kufanele icela umfaki-sicelo ukuthi azise isicelo ephephandabeni elifanele noma ezinkundleni ezihlobene nendawo yokusebenza ngolimi oluphakathi kwezilimi ezisemthethweni ezimbili. Umfaki-sicelo kumele ahlinzeke umfaki-sicelo ngazo zonke izixhaso ukuze avumele umfaki-sicelo ukuthi aphendule kulokhu; futhi angafaka eminye imininingwane njengoba kudingeka ukuze umphakathi ucabangele isicelo ngendlela efanele. Ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka; ukuhweba nokuthumela ugesi; noma ukuhweba. Umphakathi akufanele uphoqelelwe ukuthi usebenzise ilayisense futhi kufanele inikeze kuphela ilayisense eyodwa yesicelo esisodwa semisebenzi echazwe esigabeni 3. Isikhathi sokusebenza kumele sihlanganise ukusebenza; nokunye okukhulunywe. Umphakathi ungase, njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense ezibekwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, avimbe umnikazi welayisense ekwenzeni noma uphoqele umnikazi welayisense ukuba enze noma yisiphi isinyathelo esichazwe kulayisense. Umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukukhokha noma iyiphi imali kumakhasimende futhi abeke izimo ezivela ezivumelwaneni ezilawulwa noma ezibekwe umphakathi njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense. UNgqongqoshe kumele achaze inqubo ezizolandelwa ekukhanselweni, ekuphakamiseni okwethulwa, ekususweni, noma ekubekweni kwanoma iyiphi isimo selayisense. Noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ofuna ukukhombisa ukuthi angathatha amalungelo namandla omnikazi walelayisense ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalomthetho, futhi ilayisense entsha inikezwa kulowo muntu; noma isimo selayisense asihlonishwanga. Umnikazi welayisense kumele, ezimweni ezichazwe ezigabeni 1a no-b, anikeze umphakathi okungenani izinyanga eziyi-12 izaziso ebhalwe phansi ngenhloso yabo yokumisa ukusebenza, ngaphandle kokuthi umphakathi ubonge okunye. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akalandelanga noma wehluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho, izimo, noma noma yiziphi izinhlinzeko zalomthetho, umphakathi ungahlala emkhandlwini ukwenza isinqumo ngaleyo miphumela. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akalandelanga izaziso eziphathelene nesigaba 2, umphakathi ungahlala emkhandlwini ukwenza isinqumo ngaleyo miphumela. Uma umkhandlu uthola ukuthi izinsolo ngaphansi kwesigaba 3 ziyiqiniso, bangase babeke imali engaphansi kuka-R2,000,000.00 ngosuku uma le miphumela engahambisani iqhubeka. Ukuhlela kabusha umthetho wezwe wezemigwaqo ukuze kuqondiswe amagama futhi kuhlelwe kabusha incazelo ethile ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi olungafakwa ezinhlinzweni ezitholakala kumgomo wezwe wezemigwaqo; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lokuhlela; ukunciphisa inani lezinqubo ezidingekayo ngumthetho; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukukhetha iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhamba eziboardini ezifanele; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezokuhamba lwezwe kanye nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezokuhamba zamaphondo; ukususa izimo eziphathelene nezikhumbuzo zomphakathi zamanje; izindlela zokulawula ezisebenzayo, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngemicabango ethile nezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe; ukwengeza izikhathi ezithile; ukuhlinzeka ngamacategori amasha ezimoto angasetshenziswa ezinsizeni zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukwengeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemvume yokusebenza, ukwengeza imisebenzi yeziphathimandla zokulawula ukusebenzisa izimvume; ukujula ezimotweni ezingasetshenziswa ohambweni olude; ukuhlinzeka ngoshintsho lwezimvume zokusebenza; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukusetha izindinganiso zamamitha ezitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha nokuvumela amaMEC ukuthola izakhiwo zokukhokha izitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha, ukudala izimo zokwabelana ngemvume yokusebenza kwezinsizakalo zabavakashi; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yesikhashana yezimoto ezithile; ukudala amacala amasha; nokwenza izinguquko kumadokhumenti; ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. "Ibhasi" lisho imoto eyakhelwe, noma eyakhelwe ngokomthetho ukuze ifanele, ngumkhiqizi obhalisiwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1989 Umthetho No. 29 ka-1989; "Umimporter" ubonisa umuntu obhalisiwe ukuze athumele ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Umkhiqizi" ubonisa umkhiqizi [umimporter noma umakhi wezimoto] obhalisiwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Izinsuku ezihlosiwe" zokuhlela kabusha ikilasi lezimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi. "Ukuhlanganiswa kwezithuthi nokusetshenziswa kwelizwe ngaphakathi komqondo weMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezokuhamba ka-1995 Umthetho No. 67 ka-1995 noma noma yimuphi umthetho wesifunda ofana nalokhu. "Usuku lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe zeqembu elithintekayo esigabeni 1(c) kuya (g) kumele lixhunywe kumgomo wezokuhamba wesifunda futhi kumele uvunywe ngamaMEC." Okuqukethwe kwemigomo nezinhlelo ezithintekayo esigabeni (c) kuya (g) kumele, njengoba kudingwa yile mthetho, kodwa uNgqongqoshe angase, ngokuxhumana noMEC ofanele noma amaMEC, ahambise izidingo zalezi zinhlelo, ngendlela ethile, mayelana nezindawo zasemaphandleni ezindaweni ezithile. URegister uzogcina irekhodi labakhulumi bezilwane, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezitshalo, abahlinzeki bezitshalo, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulumi, imiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe noma ezivunyelwe futhi ulwazi olurekhodiwe mayelana nalezi zikhungo zabakhulumi bezilwane, abahlinzeki, abaqoqi bezitshalo, abahlinzeki bezitshalo, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabakhulumi, imiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe kuzobhalwa. Irekhodi lizovuleka, ngemva kokukhokhwa kwemali efanele, ukuze libonwe ehhovisi likaRegister phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza. URegister uzohlinzeka nganoma yimuphi umuntu, uma ecela futhi ngemva kokukhokhwa kwemali efanele, ikhophi yalolu lwazi olubhaliswe kwi-rekhodi noma isitifiketi esihlobene nakho. Irekhodi lizoba ubufakazi obuqinile bezinto zonke ezihlelwe noma ezinamandla ngalesi mthetho okufanele zibhalwe lapho. Isitifiketi esikhuluma ukuthi sibhaliwe nguRegister sizoba nomthelela wokuthi ubhaliso kwi-rekhodi alwenziwanga noma ukuthi noma yini enye enikezwe ngalesi mthetho ukuba yenziwe, yenziwe noma ingakwenziwe izoba ubufakazi obuqinile bezinto ezichazwe kulolo sitifiketi. Ikhophi yokungena kwi-rekhodi noma ukwehliswa kwi-rekhodi, okukhuluma ukuthi kuqinisekiswe nguRegister, kuzokwamukelwa njengobufakazi kunoma iyiphi inkantolo ngaphandle kokwengeza ubufakazi noma ukukhipha okwenziwayo. b umkhulumi obhaliswe nguRegister ngenhloso leyo uqinisekisile ngendlela ehlinzekwe nguRegister ukuthi umkhulumi, umhlinzeki, umqoqa wezithako, kanye nomhlinzeki wezithako, unolwazi olwaneleyo, isipiliyoni, kanye nezakhono mayelana nokuqoqwa kwezithako, izithako, noma mayelana nokuqoqwa kwezithako, izithako, noma izithako zabesifazane ezitholiwe, zihlolwe, zisetshenziswe, ziphakanyiswe, noma zigcinwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho, futhi ukuthi ezilwaneni, mayelana nomkhulumi, umhlinzeki wezithako, noma umqoqa wezithako, kungase kube ukuthi izithako zikhishwe noma, mayelana nomqoqa wezithako noma umhlinzeki wezithako, zingeniswe ngezithako zabesifazane noma izithako; futhi c ukuhambisana nezinye izidingo ezingase zikhishwe. Umhlinzeki kufanele futhi abhaliswe uma ethatha isinqumo sokubhalisela uRegister ukuthi uzosebenzisa amalabhorethri namalungelo okukhansela izintela ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezikhishwe zezo zonke impahla yezenzakalo ezingeniswe ngu yena ezweni noma ezingeniswe kwabanye. b abasebenzisi bezobuchwepheshe kule ndawo, mayelana nokunakekelwa kwezilwane ezigcinwe lapho, bangaqoqwa, bahlolwe, basebenzise, baphakanyiswe, baphakanyiswe, futhi bagcine impahla yezenzakalo, kubhekwa ukuthi kulawulwa ngumuntu olandela izidingo ezikhishwe; futhi c ukuthi le ndawo kufanele ilandele lezo zidingo ezikhishwe. b izilwane zalezi zinhlobo zilandele ezinye izidingo ezikhishwe njengokuhambisana. a le ndawo ibhaliswe njengendawo; noma ii isilwane sivunyelwe njengempahla yezenzakalo nganoma iyiphi indlela, kufanele sithunyelwe ngendlela ezohlinzekwa nguRegister nangendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sihlangane nemali efanele yokubhaliswa noma ukuvunyelwa okufunwa. Iqembu labantu elifuna ukubhaliswa njengemiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane kufanele lithumele isicelo kuRegister ngendlela ezohlinzekwa nguRegister nangendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sihlangane nemigomo yemiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane, kanye nemali yokufaka isicelo efanele. Imiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane noma iqembu lemiphakathi yabakhulumi bezilwane elifuna ukubhaliswa njengemvume ebhalisiwe kufanele lithumele isicelo kuRegister ngendlela ehlinzekwe nguRegister ngendlela efanele, futhi leso sicelo kufanele sihlangane nemigomo yokubhaliswa, kanye nemali
Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhamuka, ukuveza, nokusebenzisa impahla yezenzakalo zezilwane ngaphezu kwabanye ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukukhiqizwa kanye nokulima izilwane ngenhliziyo yeRiphabhulikhi; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene kanye nezinto ezitholakele. Lo mthetho uhlanganisa imiyalelo; futhi igama elithi 'udokotela wezilwane' libhekisela kumuntu obhaliswe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wobuchwepheshe Bezilwane kanye noMthetho Wempilo Yezilwane, 1982 (Umthetho 19 ka-1982), ukuze kulungiswe odokotela bezilwane njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 1 somthetho. Lo mthetho uzosebenza kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lwezilwane, noma izilwane ezihlukile ngokwezakhi zofuzo zalolo hlobo njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakhangela ngomyalezo kwiGazethi ukuthi lezilwane zenzelwe izinjongo zalo mthetho. Mayelana noluhlobo olusha lwezilwane noma uhlobo olusha lwezilwane oludingekayo ukuba lungene ezweni noma lwenziwe eRiphabhulikhi, uNgqongqoshe uzokwenza isimemezelo ngemuva kokucabangela isicelo, futhi ephinde acabangele umthetho wamazwe omhlaba, futhi ngemuva kokuthola imibono yokuphendula emyalezweni womphakathi okungenani ezinsukwini ezingama-30 ngaphambi kokwenza leso simemezelo. Izinhlobo ezahlukene zezilwane noma imikhakha yalezi zilwane zingamenyezelwa njengokuhambisana nezimo zalo mthetho: Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isilwane noma impahla yezenzakalo njengoba kuthiwa esigabeni 17 izomenyezelwa kuphela ngemuva kwesicelo esibhaliwe sikaNgqongqoshe ngohlangothi lwezokulima ezilwaneni ezihlobene. a endaweni eyodwa noma ngaphezulu eRiphabhulikhi; noma b ezweni elilodwa noma ngaphezulu elichaziwe. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uma kulandela lo mthetho isikhathi esichaziwe lapho noma yisiphi umthetho noma okuthile kufanele kwenziwe, uMsizi angathuthukisa leso sikhathi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuphela kwaso. UMsizi uzogcina uhlu lwezikhumbuzo, abahlinzeki, abaklami bezinhlamvu, abahlinzeki bezinhlamvu, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabazali, imiphakathi yabazali bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezibhalisiwe noma ezivunyelwe ezilawulayo futhi ukuthi ulwazi olunikezwe mayelana nalezi zikhumbuzo, abahlinzeki, abaklami bezinhlamvu, abahlinzeki bezinhlamvu, abangenisi, izikhungo, izilwane ezingabazali, imiphakathi yabazali bezilwane, kanye nezikhungo ezilawulayo kuzobhaliswa. UMsizi uzohlinzeka nganoma yimuphi umuntu, uma efuna futhi ngemuva kokukhokha imali ethile, ikhophi yanoma yiluphi ulwazi olubhaliswe kuhlu noma isitifiketi esihlobene nalokho. Iphutha lokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane engaqondakali yokubhaliswa nokufaka imininingwane engaqondakali kulolu hlu noma ukulingisa omunye umuntu. Ikhodi yokuziphatha ibhekisela kukhodi yokuziphatha, ukwenza kahle, nanoma yiziphi ezinye izinqubo zokuziphatha ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalesi sikhumbuzo. Iphromotha futhi igcine izinga eliphezulu lobungcweti nezimiso zokuziphatha phakathi kwabahlengikazi; futhi ikhuthaza izinhloso ezihlelwe zeBhodi. Iqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zezimali zabelwa ngokuhambisana nezinsika 23 no-24 futhi ukuthi iBhodi ayiphambuki kulokho kwabelwa; futhi ikwenza nezinye izisebenzi ezithile ezingabhalwa. Iphakamisa iziphakamiso kumPhathiswa mayelana nanoma yiziphi izindaba ezingabhalwa ngaphansi kwalesi sikhumbuzo; futhi ngokujwayelekile, ikwenza konke okucabanga ukuthi kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zalesi sikhumbuzo. (a) Ibhodi kufanele ibe nezithunywa ezingaphezu kuka-25, ezine-14 kufanele zibe zibhaliswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 31 (a) no (b), ezibekwe nguMphathiswa ngokubheka iziqu zabo kwezemfundo yokuhlanganyela, ukuhlinzeka, impilo yomphakathi, usizo lokuqala, impilo yomsebenzi, kanye nempilo yengqondo. Izithunywa kufanele zibe zibekwe nguMphathiswa ngemuva kokuthi amagama aphakanyisiwe yilabo abathintekayo, nangemva kokuthi isaziso sishicilelwe emaphephandabeni kahulumeni sikhuthaza iziphakamiso zamagama ezithunywa ezintsha. (b) Uma uMphathiswa engatholi amagama noma amagama aphakanyisiwe engawanele ngesikhathi esichaziwe sokumema iziphakamiso zamagama, uMphathiswa angabeka inani elidingekayo labantu abafanele ukuba babekwe njengezithunywa ngaphansi kwesigaba 1. Umuntu uzobamba le ndawo isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu kusukela ngosuku lokubekwa. Amagama ezithunywa zeBhodi, usuku abazibekwe ngalo, nesikhathi abazohlala emsebenzini kufanele ashicilelwe nguMphathiswa esazisweni emaphephandabeni kahulumeni ngokushesha ngemva kokubekwa kwabo. UMphathiswa angabeka kabusha umuntu osukwini lwakhe lokugcina, abekwe isikhathi esengeziwe esingaphezu kweminyaka emihlanu. Lo muntu kufanele, lapho engena emsebenzini, aqhubeke nokulandela isithembiso sokulandela okukhulunywe kulolu sikhumbuzo kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha. (a) UMphathiswa angase abhubhise iBhodi uma ingawuqondi kahle noma iyiphi imithetho yalolu sikhumbuzo. (b) Zonke izisebenzi zeBhodi zizobe zisesimweni somPhathiswa kuze kube iBhodi entsha ibekwe. UMphathiswa angabeka umuntu oyedwa noma abaningi ukuze baphenyise iBhodi futhi babike ngemva kokuphenya uma kukhona ukungabaza ukuthi iBhodi yehlulekile ukuhambisana nemithetho yalolu sikhumbuzo kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha. (i) ilungu leBhodi yeMuni, umphakathi wesifunda, noma iPhalamende likazwelonke; noma (ii) umuntu ophatha isikhundla esifundeni noma kwezizwe noma ungumsebenzi wenhlangano noma iqembu lezombusazwe. (d) umngcwabo ubonakala ngendlela yokuthi abakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo njengezithunywa zeBhodi; noma (e) abanaso isiqinisekiso esidingekayo sokubekwa njengezithunywa zeBhodi. (f) ilungu livumela noma lingena ezindlekweni ezingavunyelwe noma ezingafanele noma ezindlekweni ezingabuyiswanga noma ezichithwa; noma (g) ukuphela kwalelo thuba kuzoba inzuzo noma kuzosisiza umphakathi. Noma iyiphi indawo evulekile kuBhodi izogcwaliswa njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 7 noma isigaba 8 noma indawo eyadalwa ngokufa komuntu izogcwaliswa nguMphathiswa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 5, futhi ilungu elibekwe kufanele liqedele isikhathi esingakagcwaliswa yilungu abelithathele indawo. UMphathiswa, ngemuva kokubonisana neBhodi, kufanele abeke elinye lamalungu eBhodi abekwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 5 (a) njengomholi weBhodi. (b) Emhlanganweni wokuqala weBhodi, amalungu azokhetha umphakathi ophakathi kwalezi zihloko ezikhuluma ngesigaba 31 (1) (a) no (b). (c) UMphathiswa angakhansela ukubekwa komuntu njengomholi noma umphakathi ophakathi uma lokho kuzothokozisa umphakathi noma uma ilungu ingakwazi noma yehlulekile ukwenza imisebenzi yayo njengomholi isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu. Umholi nomphakathi ophakathi bazobamba le ndawo isikhathi esifana nesikhathi ababekwa ngaso njengezithunywa zeBhodi ngaphandle kokuthi umholi noma umphakathi ophakathi abashiya noma bengasekho njengamalungu eBhodi ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokusebenza noma bakhanselwa emsebenzini nguMphathiswa ngaphansi kwesigaba 8. Uma kungekho mholi noma nganoma yisiphi isizathu bengakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo njengomholi, umphakathi ophakathi, ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe esigabeni 1, unegunya lokwenza zonke izisebenzi nokusebenzisa amandla omholi. Uma bobabili umholi nomphakathi ophakathi behluleka emhlanganweni, amalungu akhona emhlanganweni angakhetha elinye ilungu ukuze liphumelele emhlanganweni, lenze zonke izisebenzi zomholi, futhi lisebenzise amandla omholi kuze kube umholi noma umphakathi ophakathi baphinde baqale imisebenzi yabo. Uma isikhundla somholi singenalutho, uMphathiswa kufanele abeke, ngokuthanda kwakhe, noma yimuphi umuntu ovela kumalungu asele eBhodi, noma omunye umuntu ngokuhambisana nesigaba 5 (1) no (2), futhi lowo muntu obekwe kufanele abambe isikhundla isikhathi esisele somuntu abathathe indawo. Uma isikhundla somphakathi ophakathi singenalutho, amalungu kufanele emhlanganweni wabo wokuqala ngemuva kokuba isikhala sikhona noma ngokushesha ngemva kokuba isikhala sikhona bakhethe omunye wabo njengomphakathi ophakathi futhi le ndawo ekhethwe izoba isikhathi esisele somuntu owabe esebekwe kulowo msebenzi. (d) ngokujwayelekile, qinisekisa ukuthi iBhodi iyawenza umsebenzi wayo futhi ifezekise izinhloso zayo ngaphansi kwalesi sikhumbuzo futhi ukuthi ilandela noma yiziphi izinhlinzeko zalesi sikhumbuzo; futhi (e) qinisekisa ukuthi izimali ezabelwe iBhodi zisetshenziswa njengoba kuchaziwe futhi ukuthi iBhodi ayiphambuki kulokho kwabelwa. Ukulungiselela kwenziwa ukuze kutholwe, kubanjwe, kuphume, kuhlanzwe, kunikezwe kulabo abanelungelo, kusetshenziswe, futhi kudayiswe insimbi eyigugu; kanye nokubhekana nezinye izindaba ezihlobene. Insimbi eyigugu ichazwa njengensimbi engahlanzwanga ehlanganisa ukuhlanganiswa nokuhlanganiswa, noma ihlanzwa kuze kube sezingeni elingaphansi kwe-99.9% futhi ingakafakwa emsebenzini wokwakha noma wokukhiqiza ngaphandle kokuhlanzwa noma ukwenza insimbi kodwa hhayi insimbi yokuphosa, ama-ingots, ama-nuggets, amabhathini, intambo, amaphakethe, i-sponge, amasampula, okusanhlamvu, ngaphandle kokusanhlamvu okwenziwe ngensimbi eyigugu ehlanzwe kuze kube sezingeni le-99.9% noma ngaphezulu, kanye nesilinganiso segolide ehlanzekile; noma njengoba kuchaziwe njengengxenye, into ethile noma umkhiqizo walesi sikhathi, into ethile noma umkhiqizo ohlwini lwesigaba a; noma iyiphi into noma ingxenye equkethe noma enensimbi eyigugu njengoba kuxoxwe esigabeni a kodwa ayifaki noma iyiphi into enekhono lokufunda ngempahla yendabuko noma eyenziwe noma ikhiqizwe ukuze isetshenziswe emisebenzini eyodwa noma eminingi yezimboni, ezobuchwepheshe, noma ezobuciko. Ukukhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa okufanele kwamabhizinisi ensimbi eyigugu eRiphabhulikhi; futhi ukuze kuqondwe izinhloso zokwakha umnotho kanye nokwakha umphakathi njengoba kuchaziwe. Umphathiswa unesibopho nganoma yisiphi isihloko esihlobene noma esixoxwa ngalesi sikhathi njengoba kubhekiswe kumphathiswa; futhi ngokujwayelekile, ukwenza yonke imisebenzi edingekayo noma ebalulekile ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zayo. Ngesikhathi esithile, ukwenza iziphakamiso kumphathiswa mayelana nanoma yisiphi isihloko esihlobene nalesi sikhathi; futhi ukuqoka noma yimuphi umuntu osebenza kuye njengomhloli ukuze enze imisebenzi ebekwe ukuba yenziwe ngumhloli. Le nsimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga akufanele idlule isisindo esishiwo futhi kufanele itholwe kulandela imvume ekhishwe nguMqondisi ngenhloso yokuzuza noma izinjongo zesayensi noma ngezizathu zobuciko; noma ukubamba noma ukuba nelayisense yokubamba insimbi eyigugu futhi uhambisane nemigomo nemibandela yelayisense yakhe. UMqondisi angakhipha kuphela isitifiketi esikhulunywe ngaso esigabeni 1 d kumuntu ngokuxhumana nezezimali zendawo, futhi uma kuhlobene negolide, kanye noMphathiswa Kazwelonke. a lowo muntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 1; noma b unensimbi eyigugu ngokuhlangabezana noma ukuhambisana nezivumelwano zokusebenza nomunye umuntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 1. Akekho umuntu ongenza noma kuletha insimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga ukuze akhokhe isikweletu sakhe, noma sokanye omunye umuntu noma mayelana nensizakalo ayinikezile noma ezokwenziwa ngaye noma omunye umuntu. Kungumuntu kuphela okukhulunywe ngaye kulezi zigaba 1 a, c, e, noma f ongakwazi ukwenza, ukuphuma, noma ukuguqula noma iyiphi insimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga anayo kulandela okukhulunywe kulezi zigaba. f ngelayisense yokuthola insimbi eyigugu; noma g ngovumelekile ukuba umkhiqizi wensimbi eyigugu. a okukhulunywe ngaso esigabeni 1; noma b ubamba le nsimbi eyigugu ngokuhlangabezana nezivumelwano zokusebenza nomunye umuntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 1. b kufanele akhumbule izidingo zeBroad Economic Empowerment Charter eyasungulwa kulandela izinhlinzeko zesigaba 100 seMineral and Petroleum Resources Development Act ka-2002 uMthetho No. 28 ka-2002; futhi c angahola uphenyo mayelana nesicelo uma ecabanga ukuthi kubalulekile. Noma yisiphi inqubo yokuphatha ethathwe noma isinqumo esithathwe ngokuhambisana nalesi sikhathi kumele senziwe noma sithathwe kulandela iPromotion of Administrative Justice Act ka-2000 uMthetho No. 3 ka-2000, ngaphandle uma lesi sikhathi sisho okuphambene. i kulandela imigomo nemibandela yelayisense yakhe futhi njengoba kushiwo yilesi sikhathi kumkhiqizi wensimbi eyigugu eNingizimu Afrika noma noma yimuphi umuntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 4 1 a, b, d, e, noma f; noma ii ngendlela yesakhiwo esiphelele kumuntu okukhulunywe ngaye esigabeni 5 1 a, b, d, e, f, noma g. e ukuthenga noma ukuthola kusuka kumhlanzisi onelayisense noma umkhiqizi onelayisense wensimbi eyigugu, umthengisi onegunya noma umkhiqizi noma noma iyiphi insimbi eyigugu ethengwe noma ehlanzwe ngokomthetho, umthengisi onegunya, noma umkhiqizi wensimbi eyigugu futhi ukudayisa le nsimbi noma insimbi eyigugu ehlanzwe bese uyilahla noma uyidayisa ngokuhambisana nemigomo nemibandela yelayisense yakhe futhi njengoba kushiwo yilesi sikhathi; noma f ukuhweba kwensimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga noma engahlanzwanga akulethanga lapha eRiphabhulikhi ngaphansi kwemigomo nemibandela yelayisense yakhe. b angayala uMqondisi ukuba anikeze lowo muntu ilayisense, ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe ngezansi kulolu hlaka; noma c enze noma yisiphi isinqumo abona sifanele. Ngaphambi kokuba uMqondisi anikeze ilayisense yokuhlanzwa kumfaki-sicelo welayisense, kufanele akhokhe imali ethile. Ilayisense yokuhlanzwa iphela kulandela imigomo nemibandela ngaphansi kwazo ikhishwe. Umnikazi welayisense yokuhlanzwa angasebenza noma iyiphi imisebenzi evunyelwe ngelayisense kunoma yisiphi esinye isikhungo noma indawo yokusebenza echazwe ngelayisense noma echazwe ngovumelekile okwengeziwe elayisense ngokuhambisana nesigaba 6, futhi umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukutholakala ebamba noma ephethe insimbi eyigugu kunoma yisiphi isikhungo ngaphandle kwendawo yakhe yokusebenza noma indawo echaziwe ngaphandle uma ethutha insimbi eyigugu engahlanzwanga ngokuhambisana nalokho okukhulunywe esigabeni 11. a Uma nganoma yisiphi isikhathi kudingeka ukuthi umnikazi welayisense yokuhlanzwa athumele noma akhulise imisebenzi ekhulunywe ngayo esigabeni 5 kunoma yisiphi isikhungo noma indawo engachazwanga elayisense yakhe, uMqondisi, ngemuva kokuxhumana okukhulunywe ngaso esigabeni 1, angabhala kulayisense yalowo muntu le ndawo eyengeziwe entsha futhi kufanele azise ngokushesha iNational Treasury kanye noMphathiswa Kazwelonke ngale ndawo eyengeziwe entsha. b Imvume eyengeziwe ekhulumayo esigabeni a ayivumeli umnikazi welayisense yokuhlanzwa ukuba enze imisebenzi yakhe kule ndawo eyengeziwe entsha noma ngaphansi kwegama elihlukile kunalelo lendawo ekhona. c Uma umnikazi welayisense yokuhlanzwa efisa ukwenza imisebenzi kunoma yisiphi esinye isikhungo ngaphansi kwegama elihlukile kunalelo asetshenziswa endaweni akhona, kufanele afake isicelo seleyisense entsha ngokuhambisana nendawo entsha yokusebenza noma indawo. a Ngemuva kokuxhumana okukhulunywe ngaso esigabeni 1, uMqondisi angavuselela ilayisense yokuhlanzwa kube kanye ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingadluli eminyakeni engamashumi amathathu, ngokukhokha imali ethile minyaka yonke
Lungisa umthetho weGauteng Constitution Amendment Act ka-2001 ophathelene nezinsiza zokuhamba, ukuze ubuyekezwe futhi ufake incazelo ethile; ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo adingekayo okusebenzisa umhlaba mayelana neziteshi kanye namandla adingekayo nguMEC ukuze angene ezivumelwaneni zokwakha izinhlelo zomgwaqo nezemizila; lungisa inqubo ephathelene nokumemezela umgwaqo; ukwenza ucwaningo lwesibili endaweni esigabeni somgwaqo wokuqala noma umgwaqo wezitimela lapho umphakathi ungathola ukuthi ucwaningo endaweni kuleli gumbi lokumemezela luyadingeka; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezincane. Igama elithi 'umgwaqo wezitimela' libhekisela ezinsizeni zomgwaqo ezisetshenziselwa umgwaqo onzima noma olula, futhi lapho isimo sikhombisa njalo, ilungelo lokuhamba, [lapho umgwaqo onzima noma olula usebenza, njengoba kukhombisiwe noma kwasungulwa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho] noma phezulu noma phansi komhlaba futhi kufaka phakathi umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nokuphambuka kwawo okwesikhashana. Ekuthatheni umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela, ukulungiswa okushicilelwe komgwaqo ngokwesigaba noma okucatshangwa ukuthi kukhishwe ngokwesigaba, noma ukulungiswa komgwaqo wesifunda osevele ukhona, uMEC kumele aqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo omgwaqo wokuqala enziwa, ngokuhambisana nebhukwana elibhaliwe njengoba kuchaziwe futhi kufake iziphakamiso eziphathelene nomgwaqo, bese uMEC emva kwalokho kumele alandele inqubo echazwe kulolu sigaba. Ngaphambi kokuthi athathe umgwaqo noma umgwaqo ophumelele, uMEC kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lendawo kanye nebika kwenziwa njengoba kubhekwa umphakathi owazi ngemisebenzi esigabeni 22 ye-ECA, noma umphakathi obheka izigaba ezihlobene ze-NEMA uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, angakwazi ukuhlela. kanye nokumemezela izinyathelo zokulawula ezisungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 11. UMEC kumele axhumane nazo zonke izifunda lapho umgwaqo uzobe khona futhi acela, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe, ukuthi zithumele imibono ebhaliwe ngombiko wokuqala womgwaqo nendawo ekhombisa umthelela ozoba khona umgwaqo ophakanyisiwe kunoma iyiphi isikhala noma enye uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi oluhlelekile lwezinhlelo zomphakathi ezithintekayo. a ibhekisela kumgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela; noma b ngokusebenzisa izigaba 6 kuya ku-9, thumela udaba noma izinkinga ezivela kumabhuku okukhuluma noma imibono kwi-commission ukuze kwenziwe ukuxhumana komphakathi okukhuthaza lezi zindaba ngqo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe nguMEC futhi, ngemva kokubheka lezi ziphakamiso, kumemezele umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela. h umuntu angaba ngumholi onemfundo efanele ongaba omunye walabo abakhuluma ezigabeni a kuya ku-g; futhi i umholi kanye namalungu amane kufanele benze i-quorum ngenhloso yokusebenza kwe-commission. e usuku nendawo yokuxhumana komphakathi; futhi f ukumemezela izinyathelo zokulawula ezisungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 12. futhi b phatha ukuxhumana ngokuhambisana nenqubo echaziwe. Ngemuva kokwenza ukuxhumana, i-commission kumele ihlanganise umbiko obhaliwe wokuxhumana, ibheke, uma kudingeka, ezinqubweni zezinqubomgomo ezibekwe esigabeni 3 se-Development Facilitation Act, 1995 Act No. 67 ka-1995 nasemthethweni wokuhlela wesifunda. UMEC, ngokuxhumana nom member we-Executive Council ophathelene nokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa, kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ukumemezela komgwaqo ngaphansi kwesigaba 5a noma b kuhambisana kakhulu nanoma iyiphi isikhala noma enye uhlelo lokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa kwesifunda olwenziwe ngaphansi komthetho wokuhlela wesifunda. ukun Notice ukuthi izizathu zesenzo sikaMEC mayelana nokuthathwa komgwaqo zingacelwa ezindabeni ezithintekayo nezithintekayo ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-30 kusukela ngosuku lokukhishwa kwesaziso. Ngokusho kwesigaba 82, umgwaqo noma isigaba singashintshwa kuphela nguMEC ngemuva kokuhlanganisa izinqubo ezibekwe ezigabeni 81 kuya ku-8 futhi izinguquko zomgwaqo kufanele zishicilelwe esigabeni 11. Isigaba 7 soMthetho oyinhloko silungiswa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". a ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 1 noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 611". b ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 2 noma kuphi lapho amagama "isigaba 611" futhi ukufaka amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "61 kuya ku-11". a umbiko wendawo obhekiswe esigabeni 4b noma isigaba 63a, uma kudingeka; futhi f ngokufaka esigabeni 8 amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "isigaba 611." Isigaba 10 soMthetho oyinhloko silungiswa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" kunoma yisiphi isigaba lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". f ukuhlanganiswa kohlelo lwezitimela, umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nezinye izinsizakalo ezihlobene kuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo zezikhumulo zezindiza, kanye nendawo ezungezile yedolobha nezinye izinsiza zokuhamba. UMEC unamandla okuthi, ngaphandle kokuthinta eminye imithetho, adlulisele noma ahlinzeke ngokuqashwa, lokho akwenza egameni lesinye isigaba noma abaningi balabo abahileleke esivumelwaneni esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 1, noma noma ilungelo lokuhamba emhlabeni womunye noma elinye ilungelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi libhalisiwe noma alibhalisiwe, kodwa ezandleni zikaMEC noma zePhondo, ngenhloso noma mayelana nanoma yisiphi isivumelwano njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1 nangokuhambisana nesikhathi salo sivumelwano.
Amagama abhalwe ngaphezulu akhombisa lokho okukhishwe emthethweni osezingeni. Amagama aphakanyiswe ngentambo ephakeme akhombisa lokho okuhlanganiswe emthethweni osezingeni. Ukuze kusungulwe uhlaka lwesizwe lokulawula imboni kagesi, ukudala uMlawuli weZizwe zeNgesi, umgibeli nomgibeli wendlela yokulawula ugesi kazwelonke; ukuhlinzeka ngamalayisense nokubhaliswa njengendlela yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, ukusabalalisa, ukuhweba, nokwamukela nokuthumela ugesi ukuze kulawulwe; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. Ukudluliswa kusho ukuhanjiswa kukagesi ngohlelo lokudlulisa, kanye nokuhamba nokuhanjiswa kukagesi ngezincazelo ezihlobene. Futhi lo Mthetho uhlanganisa amagama noma imiyalo enziwa noma inikezwa mayelana nakho. Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza nokusebenza kahle kukagesi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuncintisana nokukhetha kwamakhasimende; futhi ukuthuthukisa ukulinganisa okuhle phakathi kokuthandwa kwamakhasimende, abanikazi bamalayisense, abakhiqizi embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, nomphakathi. U-Mlawuli weZizwe zeNgesi osunguliwe ngengxenye 3 yeMthetho Wokulawulwa Kagesi ungumgibeli nomgibeli wendlela yokulawula ethile ethile. Ukuze uthole noma uqashe impahla ethile esuswe noma eyashiywa ukuze wenze imisebenzi yawo; futhi ukuthatha noma iyiphi isinyathelo esilimazayo emisebenzini yabo. U-Mlawuli angasungula amakomidi aqukethe amalungu amaningi kaMlawuli, abasebenzi kaMlawuli, nabanye abantu njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze uMlawuli izeluleko ngokujwayelekile noma ngezindaba ezithile. U-Mlawuli angasungula ama-foramu abathengi nabathengisi aqukethe amalungu amaningi kaMlawuli, abasebenzi kaMlawuli, kanye nezikhulumi zamakhasimende nabathengi njengoba kudingeka ukuze banikeze uMlawuli izeluleko ngezindaba ezihlobene namakhasimende noma abathengi ngokujwayelekile, noma ingxenye ethile yamakhasimende noma abathengi. U-Mlawuli kufanele afune ilayisense ukuze asungule futhi ahlinzeke ngempahla kumaforamu abathengi noma abathengi ngendlela echazwe ngelayisense ephethwe yilowo muntu. Ngaphandle kokubheka ingxenye 1, umuntu ophakathi kokusebenza okukhulunywe ngakho kuSheduli II okudingayo ukufaka isicelo noma ukuba nelayisense enikezwe uMlawuli akufanele abe nalutho kulomthetho olukhubazayo ekuxoxeni ngokuqaliswa nokusebenza kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka, ukungenisa nokukhipha ugesi, ukuhweba, noma yimuphi umsebenzi ophathelene, ngaphambi kokuphothula isicelo selayisense noMlawuli. U-Mlawuli kufanele ahlinzeke umceli wezicelo okukhulunywe ngaye engxenyeni a ngazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kube lula ukufakwa kwezicelo zamalayisense. Akukho sicelo sokuhlala kwemininingwane, izaziso, noma izingxoxo ezihlobene engxenyeni 3 ezingabhekwa njengokuthinta noma ilungelo noma okulindelwe komceli wezicelo. UNgqongqoshe angathola, ngemva kokuxhumana noMlawuli, ulwazi kuGazethi mayelana nanoma iyiphi imisebenzi engxenyeni 8 edinga ilayisense kusukela ngosuku olukhulunywe kulolu shicilelo. UNgqongqoshe angathola, ngemva kokuxhumana noMlawuli, izaziso kuGazethi mayelana nanoma yimuphi umuntu ophakathi kwalesi sikhathi sokuhweba noma sokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi okungadingi ilayisense ngaphansi kwengxenye 8 kufanele bhaliswe noMlawuli. Noma yimuphi umuntu odinga ukubhaliswa noMlawuli kufanele enze kanjalo ngendlela nasemigomeni echazwe, kanye nesicelo esidingekayo esidinga ukuhambisana nezimali zokubhaliswa ezichaziwe: uma umuntu onelayisense ngosuku olukhulunywe engxenyeni 9 kufanele anikezwe isitifiketi sokubhaliswa ngaphandle kokulandela izinqubo ezichaziwe. Ngemuva kokwamukela isicelo ngaphansi kwemigomo yeengxenye 2, uMlawuli kufanele abhalise umceli wezicelo ngemisebenzi echazwe esitifiketini sokubhaliswa ezonikezwa kulowo muntu. Uma isicelo singafakiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe noma singaqhubeki nezimali zokubhaliswa ezichaziwe; noma uma isicelo siphikisana nenhloso yalomthetho. Ubufakazi bokulandela uhlelo olufanele lokuhlanganiswa kwamandla ngaleso sikhathi; kanye nolwazi olunye oluvela kuNgqongqoshe njengoba kuchaziwe. UNgqongqoshe kufanele achaze izidingo ezidingekayo ezidingeka ukuba zilandwe ngabaceli ngaphambi kokuba uMlawuli acabangele isicelo selayisense. Uma ilayisense iceliwe kuMlawuli, kufanele ifune umceli wezicelo ukuthi azise isicelo ezincwadini ezisemthethweni noma ezinkundleni ezihlobene nendawo yokusebenza ngolimi olusemthethweni okungenani ezimbili. Umceli wezicelo kufanele ahlinzeke umceli wezicelo ngazo zonke izinsiza ukuze avumele umceli wezicelo ukuphendula lokhu; futhi angafaka olunye ulwazi olungase lube luyadingeka ukuze uMlawuli acabangele isicelo kahle. Ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, ukudlulisa, nokuhlinzeka; ukungenisa nokukhipha ugesi; noma ukuhweba. U-Mlawuli akafuneki ukuthi asebenzise ilayisense futhi kufanele anikeze kuphela ilayisense eyodwa yesicelo esisodwa semisebenzi echazwe engxenyeni 3. Isikhathi kufanele sihlanganise ukusebenza; kanye nanoma yisiphi esinye isimo esichaziwe. U-Mlawuli angavuma, njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense ezibekwe ngaphansi kwengxenye 1, ukuvimbela umnikazi welayisense ekwenzeni noma ukuvusa umnikazi welayisense ukuba enze noma iyiphi isenzo esichazwe ngelayisense. Umnikazi welayisense akavunyelwe ukukhokha noma iyiphi imali kumakhasimende futhi abeke izimo ezivunyelwe noma ezibekwe nguMlawuli njengengxenye yezimo zelayisense. UNgqongqoshe kufanele achaze inqubo ezolandwa ekukhanselweni, ekuphakamiseni okwesikhashana, ekususweni, noma ekubekweni kwanoma iyiphi isimo selayisense. Noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ofuna ukukhombisa ukuthi angathatha amalungelo namandla omnikazi waleyo layisense ngokuhambisana nezidingo zalo mthetho, futhi ilayisense entsha inikezwa kulowo muntu; noma isimo selayisense asihlonishwanga. Umnikazi welayisense kufanele, ezimeni ezichazwe ezingxenyeni 1a no-b, anikeze uMlawuli okungenani izinyanga eziyi-12 zokwazisa ngokubhalwe phansi ngenhloso yabo yokuyeka ukusebenza, ngaphandle kokuthi uMlawuli achaze okunye. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akazange alandele noma wehluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho, izimo, noma yimiphi imithetho yalomthetho, uMlawuli angahlala ebhodi ukwenza isinqumo ngalezi zinsolo. Uma kukhona izinsolo zokuthi umnikazi welayisense akazange alandele izaziso mayelana nengxenye 2, uMlawuli angahlala ebhodi ukwenza isinqumo ngalezi zinsolo. Uma ibhodi ithola ukuthi izinsolo ngaphansi kwengxenye 3 ziqinile, bangabeka isijeziso esingadluli ku-R2,000,000.00 ngosuku uma lokhu kungahambisani kuqhubeka. U-Mlawuli kufanele acabangele ukungahambisani ukuze enze isinqumo ngezijeziso noma yimiphi. UNgqong

"IBhasi" kusho imoto eyenzelwe, noma eyakhiwe ngokomthetho ukuze ifanele, ngumkhiqizi obhalisiwe ngokuhambisana neMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1989 Umthetho No. 29 ka-1989; "Umimporter" kusho umuntu obhalisiwe ukuze athumele ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 seMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Umkhiqizi" kusho umkhiqizi [umimporter noma umakhi wezithuthi] obhalisiwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 seMthetho Wezokuhamba Kwamazwe, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Izinsuku eziqondiwe" zokuhlela isigaba sezithuthi zokuhamba zomphakathi. "Ukuhlanganiswa kwezithuthi nokusetshenziswa kwezwe ngaphakathi komqondo weMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezimoto ka-1995 Umthetho No. 67 ka-1995 noma noma yimuphi umthetho wesifunda ofana nalokhu. "Usuku lwezinhlelo zokuhlanganiswa kwezokuhamba kumuntu ngamunye ophazamisekile esigabeni 1(c) kuya (g) kumele kuhlanganyelwe nesakhiwo sokuhamba kwezifundazwe futhi kumele kuqinisekiswe ngamaMEC." Okuqukethwe kwezinhlelo nezinhlelo ezithintekayo esigabeni (c) kuya (g) kumele, njengoba kudingwa yilomthetho, kodwa uNgqongqoshe angase, ngokuxoxisana namaMEC afanele, ahlukanise izidingo zalezi zinhlelo, ngendlela ethile, mayelana nezindawo zasemaphandleni ezindaweni ezithile. Iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezitholakele nguMEC ukuze zenze lokhu kumele zibe nezinhlelo ezifanele zokuhamba kumabhodi futhi zenze iziphakamiso kulowo mbhodi mayelana nezichibiyelo zemvume yokusebenza, njengoba kudingwa nguSahluko 9.; futhi ukususa isigaba 6. (a) UNgqongqoshe kumele, minyaka yonke ngosuku oluzokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokuxoxisana noMEC, azise umphakathi kuGazethi Yombuso, ukuze ahlukanise isakhiwo sokuhamba komphakathi sezwe isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu esihambisana nesikhathi sezimali seminyaka emihlanu seMnyango, ngokuhlonza kahle isigaba (b). UNgqongqoshe kumele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ebuyekeziwe esakhiweni sokuhamba komphakathi sezwe njalo eminyakeni emibili. I-MEC ngayinye kumele [minyaka yonke] ihlukanise isakhiwo sokuhamba komphakathi wesifunda isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezibekwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokuxoxisana nawo wonke amaMEC futhi kumele kuphume njengomlayezo kuGazethi Yombuso ngosuku olukhululiwe nguNgqongqoshe. U-MEC okukhulunywa ngaye esigabeni (a) kumele, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 211(b), ahlukanise imininingwane esakhiweni sokuhamba kwamazwe okungenani njalo eminyakeni emibili. Uma uhlela isakhiwo sokuhamba kwezifundazwe, i-MEC kumele ihlale ihambisana nesakhiwo sokuhamba kwamazwe."; futhi ukufaka isigaba 3 ngemuva kwesigaba g kulandela isigaba: "gA ukusungula umgomo wokuphatha izidingo zokuhamba esifundeni;". ukufaka esigabeni elandelayo: "Iziphathimandla zokuhamba, zamadolobha amakhulu nezinye izikhungo ezidingwa nguMEC ukuze zenze lokhu, kumele zilungise futhi zithumele kuMEC minyaka yonke ngosuku olukhululiwe nguMEC, izinhlelo zokuhlanganiswa kwezokuhamba ezihlobene nezindawo zazo isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu siqala ngosuku lokuqala lwemali." b izimiso nezinhlelo zesifunda eziphathelene nezokuhamba ngokuhlanganisa imingcele yezindawo zeziphathimandla zokuhlela, c ukuhlanganiswa kwezokuhamba kwezifunda d nanoma yini ethinta izimo ngaphakathi kwemithetho yesifunda efanele. Umuntu akavunyelwe ukuhamba ngezinto ezingozi ezikhulunywa esigabeni 21 seMthetho Wezinto Ezingalungile, 1973 Umthetho No. 15 ka-1973, ngaphakathi kwezindawo zeziphathimandla zokuhlela, ngaphandle [kwendlela etholelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba h sokuhlukaniswa 2, lapho le ndlela itholakele futhi iphume ngaphansi kwesigaba 291 futhi noma yimuphi umuntu owenza njalo ubopheleke] endleleni evinjelwe ekhombisa uhlelo lokuhlanganiswa kwezokuhamba okukhulunywa esigabeni 291, elandela umgomo noma uhlelo olujwayelekile olukhulunywa esigabeni 223l. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophula noma ongahambisani nesigaba 5 ubopheleke. Kuze kube yilapho izithuthi zokuhamba zomphakathi zibuyiselwa ezweni ukuya kwenye isigaba sikamasipala, isakhiwo nezinhlelo ezikhulunywe esigabeni 19 (b) [ku] kanye (g), ngokwehlukana, kumele kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe isakhiwo nezinhlelo zezithuthi zokuhamba zomphakathi, ngendlela efanele futhi ethile. Ngemuva kokuvunywa kwesakhiwo sokuhamba kwamazwe, isakhiwo sokuhamba kwezifundazwe, uhlelo lokuhamba komphakathi noma uhlelo lokuhlanganiswa kwezokuhamba, uNgqongqoshe noma isiphathimandla esifanele, njengoba kudingeka, kumele kushicilelwe kuGazethi Yesifunda, noma mayelana nesakhiwo sokuhamba kwamazwe, kuGazethi Yombuso imininingwane ethile yalezi zinhlelo, okumele kufake imininingwane yemizila yokuthola imvume ngaphansi kwesigaba 27 (h) 27. b ukufaka esigabeni 2 sokuhlukaniswa d kwesigaba elandelayo: "d akukho okungahlelwa okuzohole
Ukuchaza amalungelo nezibopho zezingane; ukuchaza izibopho namalungelo abazali; ukwakha izinqubomgomo nemihlahlandlela yokuvikela izingane nokukhuthaza impilo yazo; ukuhlela izindaba eziphathelene nokuvikelwa nokuphila kwezingane, ikakhulukazi lezo ezisemngciphekweni omkhulu; ukuhlela imithetho ephathelene nezinsizakalo zokuphila nokuvikela izingane nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezixhomekeke. Izindlu zokunakekela izingane ezikhona zikahulumeni, izindawo eziphephile, izikhungo zokunakekela, izikole zezimboni, kanye nezinye zokulungisa ukuziphatha. Umprofessionali ophakathi kwenqubo yokuthola izingane ezamukelwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wochwepheshe Bezenhlalakahle, uMthetho ka-1978 No. 110 ka-1978, isivumelwano sokusebenza nezingane ezamukelwe, ngokuhambisana nenhloso yesigaba sika-17, sikhuluma ngalesi sivumelwano esibhalwe phansi esisayiniwe yinhlangano ebhalisiwe yokuvikela izingane eNingizimu Afrika kanye nenye inhlangano efana nayo evela kwezinye izizwe ngenhloso yokukhuthaza umsebenzi wokugcina izingane ezamukelwe phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezinye izizwe ezithintekayo. I-High Court, ngokuhambisana nenhloso yeSahluko 20. d ukuqinisekisa umsebenzi noma uhlobo olubi lokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane okuvinjelwe yendaba yesigaba sika-141. UMthetho Wokuxazulula Ezinye Izindaba Zokuhlukanisa uchaza uMthetho olawula ukuxazulula izindaba eziphathelene nokuhlukaniswa kwabantu abashadile ka-1987 uMthetho No. 70 ka-1987, udokotela, uchaza uchwepheshe wezempilo obhalisiwe noma ophawulwe njengobhalisiwe ukuze enze umsebenzi wezokwelapha ngaphansi koMthetho Wochwepheshe Bezempilo, uMthetho Wezokwelapha Nezempilo ka-1974 uMthetho No. 56 ka-1974, umkhandlu, uchaza umkhandlu wesifunda, isifunda noma indawo eyasungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba sika-12 soMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwendawo: Uhlelo Lwemikhandlu ka-1996 uMthetho No. 117 ka-1996. Uchwepheshe wezempilo yengqondo uchaza umuntu obhalisiwe osebenza emkhakheni wezempilo yengqondo noma ophawulwe njengobhalisiwe kulolu work ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho Wezokwelapha, uMthetho Wezokwelapha Nezempilo ka-1974 uMthetho No. 56 ka-1974. Ukuxwayisa ngalesi sikhumbuzo, incwadi, noma enye inqubo ngokuhambisana nalolu mthetho, kuchaza ukwethulwa kwalolo sikhumbuzo, incwadi, noma enye inqubo ngokuhambisana nenqubo enikeziwe yokwethula inqubo ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wamajaji ka-1944 uMthetho No. 32 ka-1944. I-Foundation of the United Nations Convention Against Trafficking in Persons ichaza ukuthi i-United Nations Convention izovimbela, icindezele futhi iphathe ukuhweba ngababantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nezingane, izokweseka i-2000 United Nations Convention against Transnational Organized Crime, umbhalo ofanayo we-English utholakala ku-Schedule 4. Kulolu mthetho, igama noma isigaba esithathwe egameni noma isigaba esichazwe esigabeni sika-1 sihambisana nencazelo efanayo ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ukhombise okuphambene. e ukubheka izithelo zezimfanelo zeNingizimu Afrika eziphathelene nokuphila kwezingane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zezinsiza zomhlaba nezibopho zeNingizimu Afrika; ngaleyo ndlela f ngokujwayelekile, ukukhuthaza izinga lokuvikela, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuphila kwezingane. c nemithetho yasemakhaya ephathelene nokuvikela nokuphila kwezingane, ukungqubuzana kufanele kuqedwe ngokulandela isigaba sika-156 soMthethosisekelo. c nemithetho yasemakhaya, ukungqubuzana kufanele kuqedwe ngokulandela isigaba sika-156 soMthethosisekelo. Ngokwenzela ukuhlela kahle isigaba sika-2, ngokuhambisana nesigaba sika-1466 soMthethosisekelo, uNgqongqoshe kufanele wethule zonke izimo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho ezithinta le ndawo kwiNational Council of Provinces ukuze kuvunyelwe. b umthetho ophatha inqubo eyenzeka ezinkantolo zezingane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba sika-521. Lo mthetho kufanele ufezwe yizakhiwo zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke, ezifundazweni, uma kwenzeka ezakhiweni zokuphatha zendawo ngokuhambisana nesigaba esihambelanayo salolu mthetho nezimo ezazihilelekile ngokwehlukana nezibopho. Ngokucabangela ukuthi kukhona izidingo zokuphila nezomnotho ezikhona, ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwalolu mthetho, uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezifanele ezihambisana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze athole izindlela zokufinyelela nokufeza izinhloso zawo. c zonke izinqubo, izenzo, nezinsizakalo ezithathwe yizakhiwo zikahulumeni mayelana nanoma iyiphi indaba ethinta ingane noma izingane jikelele. Wezindaba zonke ezithinta ingane, izinga elikhuluma ngalesi sigaba sika-282 soMthethosisekelo ukuthi ilungelo nezidingo zengane zibalulekile kufanele kulandelwe. Izindaba ezibalulekile eziphathelene nengane kufanele ziqukethwe ngokubhekisela esigabeni sika-6 salolu mthetho. d ukuvikela ingane ekuhlukunyezweni nganoma iyiphi imbangela ephathelene nesimo sayo sezempilo noma izimo zomndeni. Uma indaba ethinta ingane ibandakanya ukukhetha phakathi kwabazali abathile nomunye, noma phakathi komgibeli wayo noma omunye umuntu, akufanele kube nokuhlukumeza kubazali, umgibeli, noma umuntu ngenxa yobulili babo. Uma isenzo esithile sizothuthukisa kakhulu ingane, umndeni wengane kufanele unikezwe ithuba lokukhuluma ngemibono yabo nganoma iyiphi indaba ethinta ingane. b imibono nezinto ezikhethwa yizingane kufanele zicatshangelwe ngokuhambisana nobudala bazo, ubukhulu, nesigaba sokuthuthukiswa. b ukungabheki ukwenza noma ukwenza isinqumo okumele sithathwe kufanele kugwenywe ngazo zonke izindlela. Umuntu onemithwalo nezibopho zokuba ngumzali mayelana nengane, uma ecabanga ngempela, ubukhulu, nesigaba sokuthuthukiswa kwengane, uma kudingeka, kufanele aziswe ngalolo sebenza noma isinqumo esithathwe mayelana nendaba ethinta ingane. Kulesi sigaba, "umzali" kubandakanya noma ubani onemithwalo nezibopho mayelana nengane. Amalungelo engane njengoba enikezwe kulesi Sahluko engeza kulawa malungelo engane atholakala ngaphansi kweBill of Rights. Zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni kuzo zonke izigaba zayo kanye nabasebenzi, abaphathi, kanye nezimeya zalezi zigaba kufanele bahloniphe, bavikele, futhi bakhuthaze amalungelo ezingane aqukethwe kulesi Sahluko. Isimo ngaphansi kwalesi Sahluko sishaya umuntu kanye nezakhiwo ezisunguliwe ngomyalo, kuye ngaleso simo lapho uhlobo lwamalungelo nomsebenzi owenziwa ngalolo lungqondongqondo. a uma lowo mthetho wenza noma ungase uhumushe njengokunciphisa ukufaka isandla ekusebenzeni kwalesi simo esidingekayo futhi okulindelekile emphakathini wabaningi, kusukela ekuqaleni, ekulungeni nasekw freedom uma kubhekwa zonke izindawo, kanye nalabo abhalwe esigabeni sika-36 1 a kuya
Izindawo ezikhombisa isilinganiso seziqinisekiso eziyisithupha zikhombisa izinhlinzeko ezithile ezizofakwa kuMthetho Wezobulungiswa Wezingane. Lo Mthetho uzoxoxwa ngokulandela indlela echazwe ngesigaba 76 seMthethosisekelo - ngendlela echazwe esigabeni 1 seMemorandum ephathelene Nezinhloso zeMthetho. Uchaza amalungelo nezibopho zezingane njengoba ziqukethwe kuMthethosisekelo; uchaza umgomo ophathelene nokunakekelwa nokuvikelwa kwezingane; uchaza amalungelo nezibopho zabazali; ufaka nezinye izimo ezihlobene nezinkantolo zezingane; unikeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemiyalelo yokunakekela; unikeza uhlelo lwezingane ezidingayo; unikeza izingane ezitholwe kwamanye amazwe; uqala iHague Convention ephathelene Nokwamukelwa Kwezingane Ezivela Kwamanye Amazwe; uvimbela ukuhweba ngezingane futhi uqala iHague Convention ephathelene Nokuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Emhlabeni; unikeza isimo somama ongumzali wempilo; udala nezinye izinhlinzeko ezihlelwe njengamacala aphathelene nezingane futhi unikeza izindaba ezihlobene. NGAKWAZI, iZizwe Ezihlangene zikhangisile ngalesi sikhathi ngeMvumelwano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Ngamalungelo Abantu ukuthi izingane zinekhono lokunakekelwa nokusizwa ngendlela ehlukile. Iqoqe ulwazi mayelana nesicelo esiphakanyisiwe sokuthola ingane ngendlela echazwe esigabeni 237; kanye ne-rapothi echazwe esigabeni 2391. Ngaphezu kokuchazwa okunikezwe ezichazweni "ukubheka", "ukufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho kanye nomthetho ojwayelekile, lezi zisho "ukubheka nokufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho kufanele zithathwe njengokuchazwa "ukunakekela nokuxhumana ngendlela echazwe kulesi Mthetho. Kulolu Mthetho, igama noma igama elithathwe egameni noma ngogama echazwe esigabeni 1, linencazelo efanayo ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ubonise ukuthi kukhona enye incazelo ehleliwe. Noma yisiphi isenzakalo esiqhubekayo esivela ngemuva kokusebenza koMthetho Wezobulungiswa Wezingane ka-1929 uMthetho 9 ka-1929, uMthetho Wokuhlukanisa, uMthetho Wokunakekela, uMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwendlu ka-1998 uMthetho 116 ka-1998 kanye noMthetho Wokushada Ngokwenkolo ka-1998 uMthetho 120 ka-1998, lapho lezi zMthetho eziphathelene nezingane zingakhulunywa ezinkantolo zezingane. Umthetho ojwayelekile, ukhuthaza isimo sokuvikela nokuthuthukiswa kwezingane lezi. Umthetho wezakhamuzi, izingxabano kufanele zixazululwe ngokulandela isigaba 156 seMthethosisekelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi umthetho ulandele indlela efanele yokuphatha isigaba 2b, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1466 seMthethosisekelo, uNgqongqoshe kufanele akhombise zonke izimo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho ezithinta isifunda kwiNational Council of Provinces ukuze kuvunywe. Umthetho ophathelene nenqubo eyenzeka ezinkantolo zezingane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 52. Lo Mthetho kufanele uqhutshwe ngamasu kahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke, ezingeni lesifunda, uma kukhona izakhiwo zikamasipala ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ezithile zalesi Mthetho nezimo ezazihilelekile ngokwehlukana nezibopho. Ngokubheka ukuthi kukhona izidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ezikhona, ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwalolu Mthetho, uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezifanele ngokuhambisana nezinsiza ezikhona ukuze athole izindlela zokufinyelela nokufeza izinhloso zalesi Mthetho. Ukuqhubeka koMthetho ngendlela eqondiswe esigabeni 4, zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke, ezingeni lesifunda nasezikhungweni zikamasipala ezihilelekile ekunakekelweni, ukuvikelwa kanye nenhlalakahle yalezi zingane kufanele zisebenze ngokubambisana ekuthuthukiseni indlela ehlelekile nehlanganisiwe kwezinsiza ezethulwe kuZingane. Zonke izinqubo, izenzo nezinsizakalo ezithathwe ngamasu kahulumeni kuyo yonke indaba ephathelene nengane noma izingane ngokujwayelekile. Ukwamukela isimo sokukhubazeka kwengane nokwakha isimo esihlangabezana nezidingo ezihlukene zengane. Uma izintshisakalo zengane zifezekisiwe, umndeni wengane kufanele unikezwe ithuba lokukhuluma ngemibono nganoma yisiphi isimo esiphathelene nengane. Ngokubheka iminyaka, ukuthuthuka kwengqondo nesigaba sokuthuthuka komuntu onemithwalo nemalungelo ephathelene nengane kufanele aziswe ngezinyathelo noma isinqumo esithathwe ezindabeni ezithinta futhi okungenzeka zikhathaze kakhulu.
