Ukuhlinzeka ngenhlonipho ngezindlela zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu; umthelela emthethweni ophathelene nobudlelwano bomuntu; ukuqashelwa ngokusemthethweni kobudlelwano baphakathi kwasekhaya; ukusebenza komthetho ebudlelwaneni baphakathi kwasekhaya; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. UKUQAPHELA ukuthi ukwenziwa komthetho wezomndeni ngemuva kokuqala kweMthethosisekelo akukwazanga ukusinika isimo samaqabane afanayo ukuze sibe namalungelo nezinsiza ezihlobene nomthwalo wokushada onikezwa ukuhlonishwa kwamaqabane abesilisa nabesifazane. a ukuhlela umcimbi wokuhlanganisa nokubhalisela ubudlelwano babantu; futhi b ukuhlinzeka ngemiphumela yomcimbi ngemicabango esemthethweni nokubhaliswa kobudlelwano babantu. Umphakathi wokushada angahola umcimbi wokuhlanganisa abantu abesilisa ababili ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zale ngxenye. Ngokuhambisana nale ngxenye, umphakathi wokushada unawo wonke amandla anikezwa nguMthetho Wokushada ukuze ahole umcimbi ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Noma iyiphi ikholi noma inhlangano ingabhalela uNgqongqoshe bese ifaka isicelo sokuba yisikhungo esingahola ubudlelwano babantu. UNgqongqoshe angase anikeze ikholi noma inhlangano amandla okuphatha imicimbi yokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwalomthetho, futhi kufanele, ngezikhathi ezithile, akhiphe imininingwane yazo zonke izikhungo ezinikwe la mandla kwiGazethi. UNgqongqoshe angase aphinde akhiphe amandla anikezwe kumuntu esigabeni 2, uma ikholi noma inhlangano icela ukuthi ikhiphe futhi lokhu kufanele kukhishwe kwiGazethi. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelele anganika umuntu ongumfundisi wenkolo ethile, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe, igunya lokuba umphakathi wokushada, ngokuthi umfundisi noma ubambe isikhundla esithile kuleyo kholi, amandla okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye nangokwezindlela zendabuko zaleyo nkolo. Wonke amandla omphakathi wokushada ngaphansi kwesigaba 4 kufanele abhaliswe emqulwini futhi kufanele afake usuku lokuqala kwala mandla kanye nezithiyo ezibekwe kuwo ezihlanganiswe kulo mqulu. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelele, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe kumuntu ophumelele ngaphansi kwesigaba 4, bangase baphinde bakhiphe igunya lalowo muntu lokushada ngokubhala mayelana namandla abo okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Le ngxenye, ngokuhambisana nesigaba, ayiphakamiseli umphakathi wokushada ukuba ahole umcimbi wokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu: Kukhona uma bekwazile ukwazisa uNgqongqoshe ngempela ukuthi umoya wabo uphikisana nokuhlanganisa amaqembu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Isigaba 1 asisebenzi kumaphoyisa okushada abekwa ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. a ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ohlanganisiwe ubonise ubunikazi bakhe obutholwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho weMazisi; noma b ukuthi umuntu ngamunye uhlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngombhalo ophakanyisiwe njengoba kuchaziwe; noma c ukuthi omunye wamaqabane abafuna ukuhlanganiswa ubonise ubunikazi obukhuluma ngesigaba a kumphakathi wokushada ngenkathi omunye ehlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngombhalo ophakanyisiwe njengoba kuchaziwe ngesigaba b. Umuntu angaba umlingani kuphela kubudlelwano obubhalisiwe ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umuntu oshadile akakwazi ukubhalisela ubudlelwano. Umuntu ozoba umlingani kubudlelwano babantu obekeshadile ngaphambili noma obekangumlingani kwelinye ubudlelwano kufanele kuqala akhombise ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yeshadi lokuhlukanisa noma isitifiketi sokufa somuntu abeshadile naye noma owayengumlingani wakhe, njengoba kufanelekile, kumphakathi wokushada njengobufakazi bokuthi ubudlelwano buphelile. Umphakathi wokushada angaqhubeka nomcimbi futhi abhalise ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokuthi kuqala anikezwe imibhalo echazwe ngesigaba 3. Ubudlelwano babantu bangabhaliswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uma, ngaphandle kokuthi baphumelele, kungekho ezinye izithiyo zomthetho ezivimbela ukujola. Noma ubani ofuna ukuveza ukuphikiswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa njengabangane kufanele akhiphe lokho ngokubhala kumphakathi wokushada ozohola umcimbi walolo budlelwano. Kufanele kube ukuthi uma umphakathi wokushada ethola lokho ukuphikiswa, kufanele afune izizathu zakhona ukuze aphikise inhlangano kuze kube sekukhona ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi akukho ukuphikiswa komthetho kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa, bese engase aqhubeke nokuhola umcimbi wobudlelwano. Uma futhi enganelisekile, kufanele aphikise ukuhlanganisa ubudlelwano futhi abhale ngezizathu zakhona. Umphakathi wokushada angahola umcimbi futhi abhalise nganoma yisiphi isikhathi nangezinsuku ezithile zeviki, kodwa akuphakamiseli ukuba ahole umcimbi nganoma yisiphi esinye isikhathi ngaphandle kokuthi phakathi kuka-8 a.m. no-4 p.m. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele ahole umcimbi futhi abhalise emnyangweni wombuso noma endlini yangasese noma endaweni ethile enikezwe le njongo, ngezicabha zivulekile futhi amaqembu akhona kanye nezinsizwa ezimbili ezingaqinisekisa, kodwa lezi zimo ezandulelayo kule ngxenye azivimbi umphakathi wokushada ekwenzeni ubudlelwano babantu kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuluma lapha, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwendawo echazwe, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngenxa yokugula okukhulu noma ukuhamba isikhathi eside, noma uma kukhona ukulimala komunye wamaqabane, noma kulabo abesilisa ababili abafuna ukuhlanganiswa. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungena esivumelwaneni sobudlelwano ngaphansi kwale ngxenye egameni lomunye umuntu emcimbini. Mayelana nobudlelwano noma umshado ngesikhathi sokufunda amagama okuhlanganisa. Uma amaqembu engavumelani, umphakathi wokushada kufanele, uma efunda inqubo, akhulume ngombono wezomthetho. Uthembisa, A.B., ukuthi ngokwazi kwakho akukho zithiyo zomthetho ezivimbela ukuba ube nobudlelwano obusemthethweni/umshado no-C.D. okhona phambi kwakho naphambi kwalabo abakule ndawo nabeli ofuna ukuba ngofakazi ukuthi uthatha u-C.D. ukuba kube umlingani wakho/womkakho noma umyeni? Kodwa ubudlelwano obusemthethweni/umshado kufanele buqhutshekwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zale ngxenye, lokho kubudlelwano obusemthethweni/umshado kuzoba, uma kungabikho zithiyo zomthetho, kusemthethweni futhi kubophelelekile. Amaqembu kufanele abhale phansi futhi athembise ukuthi afuna ukusungula ubudlelwano obusemthethweni phakathi kwabo bobabili ngokusayina emqulwini ochazwe futhi uyisayine phambi kwabafakazi ababili. Umphakathi wokushada kanye nabafakazi ababili kufanele futhi basayine emqulwini ochazwe ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi isifungo esenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 112 senziwe phambi kwabo. Lesi sitifiketi esikhishwe sikhombisa ubufakazi bokuthi kukhona ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu ababili abanesiginesha esikulesi sitifiketi. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele agcine amarekhodi wezenzakalo zonke abahole. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele ngaleso sikhathi abhalise futhi agcine lezi zikhumbuzo futhi azethule kumphakathi wokush
Imemorandamu Yomthetho 136 yeMithetho Yesifunda yaseGauteng. Incazelo entsha ye "isitshalo" ifakiwe ukuze ifake indawo esetshenziselwa imisebenzi ehambisana ngqo nokusebenza nokuphathwa kohlelo lwezitimela kanye nokuhamba kwabagibeli abafika nabephuma esiteshini. Isiteshi sizofaka izindawo zokupaka, ama-garage okupaka, izindawo zokulahla nokuphatha abagibeli, izimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi, kanye nezinsiza ezifana nalokho. Kuphakanyiswe kakhulu ngokuvumelana nezikhulu zomphakathi ezithintekayo ngemva kokuxoxisana ukuthi ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okuthile endaweni yesiteshi akufanele kulawulwe yizinhlelo zokwakha edolobheni futhi akufanele kube ngaphansi komthetho, okungavimbela izinqubo ezithatha isikhathi eside ekushintsheni izinhlelo zokwakha edolobheni. Lokhu kufaka imisebenzi ethile yezezimali ehambisana ngqo nokuphathwa kahle kwabagibeli, kuhlanganise nokukhangisa, ukuthengiswa kokudla neziphuzo, amaphephandaba nezincwadi, imishini yokuthengisa ethengisa izinto ezithengwe, izingcingo zomphakathi, kanye nemishini yokubhanga (lezo ezamukela amakhadi futhi zikhokhe imali). Nokho, kubhekwa ukuthi ezindaweni eziningi, kungase kube nesidingo semisebenzi yezezimali ezindaweni eziseduze nesiteshi. Njengoba le misebenzi yezezimali ingase ithinte izindawo eziseduze neziteshi futhi ingase iphinde ithinte isakhiwo sedolobha, kunesidingo sokuthi amalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba ahambisane nokusetshenziswa kwawo kwezezimali alawulwe uhlelo olusebenzayo ngaphakathi komkhakha wezokwakha edolobheni. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba nomthelela emphakathini walesi sikhathi, kanye nesinqumo somkhandlu, ngaphambi kokuthi la malungelo anikezwe ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokwakha yalesi sikhathi. Le misebenzi izokwenziwa esiteshini, futhi kufanele yenziwe ngokuhambisana namalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba endaweni kanye nemithetho yokwakha efanele. Ngokuphathelene nokukhuluma ngendlela entsha yesifunda yomgwaqo nezitimela, ingxenye 4 yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubulungiswa Bokuphatha, 2000 (Umthetho No. 3 ka-2000) ibhekisela ezinqubweni ezimbili ezishintshashintshayo lapho umphathi wehhovisi kufanele akhiphe isinqumo esingase sithinte kahle noma kabi amalungelo omphakathi, ngokukhuluma nje ngocwaningo lomphakathi noma inqubo yokuphendula. Ingxenye 6 ekhona ikhetha inqubo yokubuyekezwa komphakathi. Le nqubo ingaba nenkinga futhi ithathe isikhathi eside futhi ingase iphinde ikopishe isidingo solwazi olufanele ekwenzeni izinqumo okukhulunywe ngakho kahle ngokuhambisana nenqubo ethinta ukuhlola indawo kanye nebika elibhekiwe engxenyeni 6(a) yeMthetho oyinhloko. Ngalezi zimo, inqubo yokwazisa nokuphendula njengoba kuboniswe engxenyeni 4 yeMthetho 3 ka-2000 izosebenza futhi izosebenza kahle uma umbiko wendawo usuhlanganisiwe, kuyilapho inqubo yokubuyekezwa komphakathi ingagcinwa kulokhu lapho izinkinga zivele ngqo eningizimu yokwazisa kanye nemibiko emibili eminye, engase idinge ukubuyekezwa nokuphendula okwengeziwe. Ngakho-ke, ingxenye 6 iyashintshwa ukuze isetshenziswe inqubo yokwazisa nokuphendula ukuze i-MEC yenze isinqumo, futhi isetshenziswe kuphela enezinkinga ezithile. Ngakho-ke, ubulungiswa bokuphatha obufinyelelwe buphakeme kunalokho okudingekayo nguMthetho 3 ka-2000 ngokuthi kokubili izinqubo zilandelwa. Umthetho okhona awuqondi kahle ngokuphelele isivumelwano okumele senziwe nguNgqongqoshe mayelana nokwakha, ukwakha, ukusebenza, ukuphatha, nokubhekelela uhlelo lweGautrain Rapid Rail Link oluphakanyisiwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-MEC igunyazwe, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho, ukuqedela izivumelwano ezifana nesivumelwano esikhona sokwakha ngokuhambisana ne-MEC enesibopho sezimali. Lokhu kungasetshenziswa ngumthengisi ophumelelayo noma i-MEC egameni lakhe, okwenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe amandla nokusetshenziswa kwawo ezingeni lokuzimela nakhulu. Ukusetshenziswa kwala mandla uma kunikezwa ukuze kuzuze umphakathi kungase kuphinde kube nezithiyo noma kuthinteke ekupheleni kwezivumelwano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kube nesidingo sokwakha ingxenye ebhekisela ekudlulisweni kwamalungelo phezu komhlaba womunye noma amalungelo abanjwe yi-MEC adluliselwa kumthengisi ophumelelayo. Amalungelo phezu komhlaba womunye kanye namalungelo abantu awakwazi ukusetshenziswa ngokomthetho noma adluliselwe kumuntu wesithathu, futhi kube nesidingo sokuhleleka okukhuluma ngqo ngalokhu. Enye inhloso yeBhili ukuhlela isimo mayelana nezilinganiso zezakhiwo ezithathwayo. Izilinganiso ezimbili zokuqala zanikwa ngoba ngasikhathi sinye kungathatha isikhathi eside phakathi kwesigaba sokunquma izindlela kanye nesigaba sokuqala sokwakha. Nokho, ukuhlola kwesibili akudingekile uma lezi zilinganiso ezimbili kufanele zenzeke ngasikhathi sinye noma ngesikhathi esifanayo, njengoba kuzoba khona ukuhlola kwemigwaqo yeRapid Rail Link. Ngakho-ke, iBhili iyashintsha ingxenye 8(b) yeMthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akudingeki ukuhlola indawo uma umphakathi onekhono lokwenza lo msebenzi ubona ukuthi akudingekile. Ezinye izinguquko ezincane ezenziwe ngalolu shintsho zenziwe kule ngxenye. Ingxenye 5 yeBhili iyashintsha ingxenye 10 yeMthetho ukuze ilungiselele ukuhambisana nengxenye entsha 6. Ingxenye 7 yeBhili iyashintsha ingxenye 51 yeMthetho ukuze ilungise iphutha elenzekile ekubhaleni. Ingxenye 8 yeBhili iletha ingxenye entsha 51A kuMthetho ukuze ibhekisele ezivumelwaneni ezingaqedwa zokwakha, ukwesekwa kwezimali, ukusebenza, ukuphatha, ukulawula, nokubhekelela uhlelo lwezindlela nezitimela eziphakanyisiwe, njengoba kukhulunywe ngenhla, ngokuhambisana noNgqongqoshe wesifunda onobulungiswa bezimali. Ingxenye 9 yeBhili inikeza isihloko esifushane.
Lo mthetho uhlose ukuthuthukisa futhi wenze ukuhamba komphakathi kube yimpumelelo kubagibeli eGauteng. Uhloswe ukudala uhlelo oluhlonipha amalungelo abantu abasebenza ezokuthutha zomphakathi; nokukhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane, ikakhulukazi lawo amancane kakhulu, kanye nabaphathi abaphucukile ngenxa yokucwaswa okwakukhona esikhathini esedlule. Lo Mthetho ufaka esikhundleni iSahluko 3 seMthetho Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke ngokwezimiso ezitholakala kule Mthetho. Abasebenzisi babhekene nezindleko zokuhamba ezikhokhwa ngabagibeli, futhi lapho abagibeli bekhokha imali encishisiwe, futhi lapho umphathi wesivumelwano evuselela isivumelwano nomsebenzisi; futhi lapho labo abasebenza ezokuthutha bengatholi uxhaso noma usizo lwezimali kunoma yiliphi ilungu noma ingxenye yohulumeni, ngakho-ke ngokwalolu hlaka, ukuvuselelwa okwenziwe kulabo abasebenza ezokuthutha ngokusekelwe ezindlekweni ezikhokhwayo ngeke kubhekwane njengoxhaso noma enye indlela yokusiza kwezimali. Izinhlelo kumele ziphakanyiswe ukuze kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwezindlela, ukuthutha okutholakala kalula kulabo abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile, ukushintsha nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kanye nabantu abathole amathuba alinganiselwe ngenxa yokucwaswa okungafanele. Kumele babe nezimvume ezifanele, izitifiketi zokusebenza, noma igunya lesikhashana; futhi kumele babhaliswe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho mayelana nezimoto ze-taxi, ama-taxi akhokhelwayo, amabhasi, kanye nezimoto zokuzijabulisa ngokwezigaba 69, 77, kanye no-81. Inhlangano ayikwazi ukuba nezitifiketi zokusebenza noma imvume. Noma iyiphi imoto ingathola kuphela isitifiketi sokusebenza esisodwa. Ukuthutha abantu emhlanganweni wokwabelana ngezithuthi, lapho amalungu ehlangana ukuze wabelane ngezithuthi noma ahlele ukwabelana ngezithuthi nabanye amalungu noma labo abaqokwe ngabo ukuya nokuqhubeka ezindaweni ezithile ngenhloso ethile futhi lapho kungekho uhlelo noma noma iyiphi indlela yokukhokha yokwabelana ngezithuthi. Bangaba abashayeli; futhi kumele bazi kahle indawo abahamba kuyo. Isigaba 1 ngeke sibe khona kubaphathi abasebenza lapho kucacile ukuthi akuhambisani. I-MEC ingakha imithetho yokuthi bonke abashayeli bezimoto zokuthutha zomphakathi kumele baqeqeshwe ngento ethile. Ummeleli wehhovisi angacela ummangali wesitifiketi ukuthi athumele imoto ukuze ibuyekezwe uma becabanga ukuthi ayifanele ukuhamba, noma ngabe le moto yayine sitifiketi esivumelekile sokuba emgwaqweni; futhi bangaphika ukukhipha isitifiketi sokusebenza uma bebona ukuthi imoto ayifanele ukuhamba. Izimoto ezisetshenziselwa ukuthutha komphakathi kumele zishiye isizinda zihlanzekile, ngaphakathi nangaphandle, ngokwezimiso eziholwa, uma kukhona isivumelwano, njengoba kuchaziwe esivumelwaneni. Ngokwemiqondo yeMthetho Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke, izimoto ezisetshenziselwa ukuthutha komphakathi kumele zibe sesimweni esihle ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Imoto esebenza ukuthutha abagibeli bomphakathi kumele ibe ne-fire extinguisher esebenzayo okungenani eyodwa kanye ne-first aid kit enezinto zayo. I-fire extinguisher kanye ne-first aid kit kumele zibekwe noma zifakwe ngendlela ethile nendawo ethile emotweni, futhi ama-fire extinguishers kumele ashintshwe ngezikhathi ezifanele. Izinsizakalo zokuzijabulisa kumele zihlale zifakwe njengoba kukhonjisiwe esigabeni 16. Izigaba zezinsizakalo ezibhalwe esigabeni 1 mayelana nemithetho ekhombisa esigabeni 3 esikhathini esizayo zikhonjiswe esikhathini B, kanti lezo zokushintsha isikhathi zikhonjiswe esikhathini C. Imoto kumele ikhombe ukuthi iyitaxi ngendlela echaziwe. Ibhodi ingabeka imali ephezulu noma ephansi yokuhamba kwama-taxi akhokhelwayo okufanele ikhokhwe kumgibeli. I-taxi ayikwazi ukuthwala umuntu; noma kumele ikwenze ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano esivunywe yiBhodi. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, i-taxi ekhokhelwayo ingasebenza ngentengo engakhonjiswa kumitha uma intengo yokuhamba ethile ivunyelwe ngaphambi kokuhamba. Izimoto ze-taxi zingasebenzisa kuphela izimoto ezincane, ama-minibus, amabhasi amancane, noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshiwe ukuze zisebenze. Isitifiketi sokusebenza esikhiphwe se-taxi kumele sikhombise ukuthi ukusebenza kwaleyo taxi kulandela indlela noma imephu, ngaphandle uma isimo esihlukile sivunyelwe ngalo Mthetho. Mayelana namabhasi noma ama-train, iBhodi inganciphisa ukusebenza kwesitifiketi ezindaweni ezithile noma ezindaweni. Amabhasi kumele ahlelwe ukuze asebenze ezindaweni ezithile noma ezindleleni ezithile ngokukhokha intengo ekhombisiwe futhi asebenze ngezikhathi ezihlelwe, ezidinga uxhaso, kumele kuvunywe ngombuso ophakela uxhaso. Ukuthutha kwezemfundo kumele kuhlinzekwe ukuthutha abafundi besikole, abafundi bezifundo eziphakeme, abafundi abadala, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi phakathi kwezindawo zabo zokuhlala nezikhungo zemfundo, kodwa kungabandakanya ukuhamba okungahlelwanga ezikhungweni zemfundo uma lezi zinhlelo zixhumene kuphela nezindaba zemfundo. Ukuthutha kwezemfundo kungasebenzisa izimoto ezincane, ama-minibus, amabhasi amancane, amabhasi ajwayelekile, amabhasi okushuttle, noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshiwe ngenhloso ethile. Ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka ngesicelo sokwabelana, ukuvuselela, ukushintsha, noma ukudlulisa isitifiketi sokusebenza sokuthutha kwezemfundo, iBhodi kumele ithumele isicelo esikoleni esithintekayo noma kwezinye izikhungo zemfundo ukuze izwe imibono yabo noma iziphakamiso ngendlela echaziwe, futhi kumele ibheke lezi zibonelo noma iziphakamiso ezitholiwe. Ukuthutha kwabavakashi kumele kuhlinzekwe ukuze kube lula ukuhamba kwabavakashi lapho izivakashi ziqhutshwa ngumhlahlandlela obhalisiwe ngokwezigaba 21 zeMthetho Wokuvakasha. Akukho sitifiketi esivumela ukusebenza kokuthutha kwabavakashi esingakhiphwa ngaphandle uma iBhodi ithole futhi ihlinzeke ngeziphakamiso ezivela kumphakathi wezokuthutha ngokuvumelana ne-MEC, kodwa iBhodi ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kwalokhu kuziphakamiso lapho umphakathi ungakhiphi iziphakamiso ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe esicelweni seBhodi. Ekukhipheni isitifiketi sokusebenza kwabavakashi, iBhodi ingabeka izimo zokuthi imoto kumele ibe nepolisi, izinhlelo zokwakha umculo noma imiyalezo, amathuluzi okupheka, kanye nanoma yini enye engase ibekwe yiBhodi, noma izindawo zokuphumula lapho uhambo ludlula kumakhilomitha angama-200, noma ezinye izimo. Ibhodi ingabeka inani eliphezulu labagibeli abakwazi ukuthwala imoto esetshenziselwa ukuthutha kwabavakashi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi usayizi wemoto udlula lelo nani elichaziwe. Uma kudingeka, iBhodi inganikeza izindawo ezithile noma izindlela zokusebenza kokuthutha kwabavakashi. Umshayeli wemoto esetshenziselwa ukuthutha kwabavakashi kumele ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho lezi zinsizakalo zisebenza ahlale ehambisana nemigomo ebekwe umthetho wezokuthutha njengoba kuchaziwe. Ukuthutha kwabav
Yini ukuphathwa kolwazi? Ukuphathwa kolwazi kuwumkhuba wezindawo ezahlukene osiza iminyango nezinhlelo ukuthuthukisa, ukwandisa, ukusabalalisa, ukuthola, ukuguqula, nokugcina ulwazi ukuze kufezwe izinhloso zazo ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Yini inzuzo enkulu yokuphathwa kolwazi? Izinhlangano zizuza ngokushesha ukufezekisa izifiso nezinhlelo zazo, okuholela ekwandeni kokukhiqiza, ukusungula, ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo ezintsha, ukuncintisana, nokwandiswa kwezindlela ezintsha zesayensi; kanti labo abasebenza nolwazi bathuthukisa umbono wabo nokukhuthazeka. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyisixazululo esisheshayo kuphela? Ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyinqubo eqhubekayo hhayi isixazululo esisheshayo. Emhlabeni wonke, imikhankaso nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi ziqalisiwe, futhi akukho ukuhamba emuva. Imikhankaso yokuphathwa kolwazi iyindlela eya ikusasa eliphumelelayo. Yini ubudlelwano phakathi kokuphathwa kolwazi neSikhathi Solwazi? Ikhompyutha encane, i-Internet, kanye nezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwe emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi eMelika, kuholele ekwakhiweni kwegama elithi "Isikhathi Solwazi," kodwa kubonakala futhi ukuthi kuzobizwa ngokwengeziwe ngokuthi "Isikhathi Solwazi." Njengoba abantu bedlulela esikhathini seMboni ukuya esikhathini Solwazi, ezingeni eliphansi, ukuphathwa kolwazi kuvele kwathuthuka kakhulu ukuze kubhekwe izinguquko. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyinto entsha? Izinqubo nezimiso zokuphathwa kolwazi azizintsha, njengoba kuboniswa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kolwazi okwenziwe ngabantu kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo (izibonelo zifaka phakathi izindlela ezisetshenziswe emlilweni, insimbi, ngebhontshisi) ezadluliselwa ezizukulwaneni futhi zakhula emhlabeni jikelele. Indlela ehlelekile yokuphatha ulwazi njengendawo yokugcina iyinsimu entsha futhi ethuthukayo, eyakhiwe yizinguquko ezisheshayo nezithuthuke kakhulu zobuchwepheshe nokuxhumana, kanye nokubheka ulwazi njengomthombo obalulekile wokusetshenziswa kwesu. Ulwazi luyindawo yokugcina ebalulekile njengezinsiza zemvelo, izinsiza zabantu, kanye nezezimali. Indlela imboni nezinhlelo ezisebenzisa ngayo ulwazi nezindlela ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zolwazi, kanye nokuthi ulwazi lwenziwa kanjani, konke kungafezwa ngempumelelo ngokusebenzisa isikhali esiyimfihlo sempumelelo, okuyiPhathwa Kolwazi. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuhlukile kwiTekhnoloji Yolwazi? Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyitekhnoloji noma isenzo? Ukuphathwa kolwazi akusiyona nje itekhnoloji noma isenzo esilula; kuyisistimu kanye neziqoqo zezitshalo ezisekela ukwabelana ngolwazi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano ethile ukuze kuqhutshwe izinhlelo nemikhankaso yokusungula. Ukuphathwa kolwazi (KM) kuhlobene kanjani nabantu? Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuphathwa kolwazi yizisebenzi ezibhekene nolwazi, abathintekayo abasebenza enhlangano ethile, kanye nalabo abaziwa ngolwazi futhi kulindeleke ukuthi basize amaklayenti ale nhlangano. Ngakho-ke, ukuphathwa kolwazi kuhlobene nabantu nokuphatha ukuphila kwabo, hhayi uhlelo oluphatha ngendlela yokulawula. Ukushintsha indlela yokwenza izinto kudinga ukushintsha indlela abantu abacabanga ngayo kanye nenqubo endaweni yokusebenza eguqulwa ibe eyokwethembana nokwethembeka. Ukwabelana ngolwazi kuzosisiza abasebenzi benhlangano basebenzise ulwazi olukhona esikhundleni sokuzama ukudala okuthile okusha. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ngokucacile nangempumelelo ukusetshenziswa kwesikhathi, okuholela ekusunguleni, okuyimiphumela yolwazi olusha. Yini umthelela wokuphathwa kolwazi ezicini zokusebenza zenhlangano? Enye iphuzu elibalulekile lokuphathwa kolwazi ukuxhumana kwalo nezinqubo nezinhlelo zokusebenza ngaphakathi kwenhlangano, okubeka inhlangano kanye nesikhungo ezingeni lokuncintisana nezinye. Yini umehluko phakathi kwedatha, ulwazi, nolwazi? Idatha imelela izinto ezibonakalayo noma eziqinile ezingaqhathaniswa nokuthile, ngakho-ke ayinani ngaphandle komongo. Ulwazi luwumphumela wokuhlela idatha ngendlela enengqondo nephathelene, imvamisa ethumela umlayezo. Ulwazi yilokho esikholwa ukuthi sinesikhathi esithile sokubaluleka ngemva kokuhlela nokwakha imiyalezo ngendlela eqondakalayo ngokusekelwe kumava ethu, ukuhlangana, noma ukuxhumana okuqondisiwe. Ulwazi lungabhekwa njengento engagcinwa bese isetshenziswa njengoba kudingeka, kanye nenqubo eqhubekayo yokwazi ehlanganisa ukuqonda nokwenza - inqubo evula ubuchule. Ulwazi luwuqoqo lwezinkolelo ezithathwa njengangempela, futhi le nkolelo ingabekwa ngumuntu okungenani oyedwa, ngendlela yemiyalezo nolwazi olwaneleyo olungaqondwa futhi lusetshenziswe omunye umuntu. Kumele kube nezindawo ezithile ezibonakalayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwamukelwa njengolwazi. Ingabe kukhona indlela yokukala nokuhlola izinga kanye quality yolwazi? Yebo, ngokubona ukuthi kusiza inhlangano noma umuntu ukufinyelela kalula izinhloso zabo. Ingabe kukhona iwebhusayithi noma ipulatifomu yokuphathwa kolwazi? Ipulatifomu yokuphathwa kolwazi isunguliwe ukuze inikeze umgudu wokuxhumana ukuze kube nokubambisana ngaphakathi kweSikhungo Sokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzoba yindawo yokugcina yokuphathwa kolwazi, inikeza ulwazi mayelana nokuphathwa kolwazi futhi isetshenziswe njengendawo yokuxoxa ngokuqhubekayo ngePhathwa Kolwazi eNingizimu Afrika.
Ngiyajabula ukukwethulela umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika umthetho ophakanyisiwe wezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa. Lo mthetho ophakanyisiwe umele izinkolelo zokudlala nezokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa kudlala indima ekuphumeleleni kwabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyindlela enhle yokubandakanya intsha emicimbini ezokwakha imiphakathi. Eminyakeni emihlanu edlule, umgomo wokuqala wezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa washicilelwa okokuqala emthethweni ophakanyisiwe lapho izinselelo, izinqubomgomo, nezinto ezibalulekile zavezwa ngokucacile. Kwenziwe okuningi ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nalezi zinkinga nezinto ezibalulekile, kodwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwesikhathi esanele nezinsiza, indlela phambili isalinde isikhathi eside. Ngemva kokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zikamasipala, kubalulekile ukuthi izinto ezibalulekile kwezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa zihlolwe futhi zishintshwe. Ukuze kufezwe umgomo wezinqubomgomo zikamasipala wokuphila kahle kwabantu bonke, futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi udlala, ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lezokudlala Nezokuzijabulisa laseNingizimu Afrika kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile esizokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukudlala kufinyelela zonke izingxenye zeNingizimu Afrika. Izinhlangano ezivela kubaxhasi abafana nePoverty Relief, Ukwakhiwa Kwezinsiza, izinkokhelo ezitholwe kwiJob Summit, nezezimali ezivela kwiNational Lottery zokuthuthukisa ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa ezindaweni ezazishiywe ngaphandle uhulumeni bangaphambili kuzoba yindlela efanele yokwenza ukudlala kufinyeleleke kubantu abaningi baleli. UMbutho Wezokudlala Nezokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) ubeke lezi zinto ezilandelayo, ezisemqoka kumgomo othi "siyenza umphakathi udlale." a) ukukhulisa ukubamba iqhaza emicimbini yokudlala nezokuzijabulisa b) ukukhuthaza umlando wezokudlala naphezu kwezinto eziphikisanayo c) ukwandisa amathuba okuphumelela emicimbini emikhulu d) ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezibalulekile emizamweni yokubhekana nezinto ezibalulekile zizwe. Zonke izinto ezibalulekile zithatha indlela yokuguqula futhi le ncwadi ibhekana kahle nalomsebenzi, njengoba singashintshi emsebenzini wethu ohlelweni lwezinqubomgomo zikamasipala. Ukwenza umphakathi udlale kuyisisekelo/sihloko salomthetho ophakanyisiwe. Ukufeza le njongo kudinga imizamo nokuzinikela kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni (NGOs), umkhakha ozimele, kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo ezibandakanyekayo ekwakheni isisekelo sesiko lokudlala nezokuzijabulisa. Umthwalo wokwakha izinsiza nezindawo zokudlala nezokuzijabulisa uphonsa ezikhwameni zoMnyango Wezokudlala Nezokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) kanye neKomidi Lezokudlala laseNingizimu Afrika (SASC). Ukungalingani phakathi kwemiphakathi ethola izinsiza kahle, evame ukuba emadolobheni, kanye nemiphakathi eshiywe ngaphandle, ikakhulukazi leyo emaphandleni, kubonakala. Intsha yaleli nalesi simo sokuthuthukiswa kwezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa kubalulekile. Kukhona isidingo sokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ithathe indawo yayo efanele emphakathini wezokudlala womhlaba. Izinhlangano (IFs). Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yezepolitiki, ezokuxhumana, nezomnotho, njengendima nomthelela wokubambisana kwamazwe, kanye nokuhweba kwezokudlala nokukhula komkhakha wezindaba, akufanele kuphuthunyiswe. Kwenziwe imizamo eminingi yokuchaza kahle ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa. Nokho, ukusondelana kulokhu akukakafinyeleli. Ngokusho komgomo walomthetho ophakanyisiwe, incazelo elandelayo iyanele. UKUDLALA kungachazwa njengomsebenzi noma imisebenzi ethile edinga umzamo womzimba, futhi labo abathatha inxaxheba kufanele balandele indlela ethile noma engathathwa, ngenhloso yokufeza umnqobi noma umphumela ophumelelayo, noma ngenye indlela; noma ngenhloso yokuphumula, ukujabula, impilo yomzimba, ukukhula komoya, nokuthuthukiswa. Nokho, mhlawumbe okubaluleke kakhulu, indima yokudlala iwukuzama ukwakha ubunye bezwe. Umthelela wezokudlala nezokuzijabulisa awugcinanga kulabo abathatha inxaxheba noma abahilelekile. Uhlanga lwezokudlala lukhuluma emikhakheni eminingi yokuphila efana nempilo; imfundo; umnotho; ukuziphatha okungahambisani nokuphila kahle; ukwakha isizwe kanye nezokuxhumana kwamazwe. Kulindeleke ukuthi uMbutho Wezokudlala Nezokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika uzohlinzeka ngezidingo zabantu bonke, usebenzisa inani lezezimali elifanele elalingasetshenziswa ngaphambili ukuhlinzeka ngama-20% abantu ngesikhathi sokuphatha kukahulumeni wangaphambili. Nakuba indlela esibheka ngayo ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa kufanele kusekelwe ezimweni nasezinkolelweni zaseNingizimu Afrika, isimo sezwe, imiphakathi yalo, umlando walo, ifa lalo, kanye nezinqubomgomo zikamasipala zokudlala nezokuzijabulisa kufanele kuhlangane nezimo zomhlaba. Kutholakale ukuthi kunokuntuleka kokwazi indima edlalwa ukudlala nezokuzijabulisa kuleli. Abaholi beqembu leHulumeni leCommonwealth ababeHarare bathole okulandelayo mayelana nomthelela wezokudlala emphakathini: Isikhathi sesifikile sokuthi indima ebalulekile edlalwa ukudlala ekwakheni isizwe ibonakale ngokuphelele. Ukudlala kungagcina. Okokuqala, kungagcina impilo, ubude bokuphila, kanye nokukhiqiza kwabantu, noma kudale umsebenzi ophawulekayo kubantu. Okwesibili, kungagcina ikusasa. Izinzuzo ezitholakala ekuphathweni kahle zifaka phakathi impilo engcono yomzimba, engqondweni, kanye nokukhula komoya kubantu bonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abadlali abaphumelelayo baba izibonelo ezinhle zentsha yaleso sizwe, njengabantu abavelele, noma ngabe abanakho ukukhethwa nguhulumeni, futhi njengabantu abazinikela ekubambisaneni okulinganayo nokwamukelekayo. Izifo eziningi ezifana ne-hypertension zixhomeke ekwelashweni noma emisebenzini yomzimba okufanele ilandelwe. Emazweni athuthukayo, kukhona ukukholwa ukuthi wonke rand osetshenziswe ekudlaleni nasekuzijabuliseni kunciphisa izindleko zempilo ngama-rand ayikhulu. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ukudlala kuqeqesha ingane ngezindlela zokuphila ngendlela engadlula nganoma iyiphi enye imisebenzi. Kukhona futhi ubufakazi bokuthi imfundo yomzimba iholela ekusebenzeni kahle ezifundweni. Njengoba zinegqugquzela elihle empilweni, imisebenzi yomzimba inemiphumela emihle ezingeni lokukhiqiza. Ukwehla kwezinga lempazamo emsebenzini kuhambisana nempilo engcono yomzimba, eyingxenye ye-23% eholela ekulondolozeni izinsuku nezindawo zonyaka. Ngokuphikisana nalesi sisho sokuthi umdali uthola umsebenzi wezandla ezingenamsebenzi, lesi sisho sithi ingane edlalayo ingane engakathwali. Ukuziphatha njengokuhamba kancane kuhambisana nokuntuleka kokuzethemba, kanti impumelelo emidlalweni nezokuzijabulisa ithuthukisa ukuzethemba. Labo abakhombisa izibonelo ezinhle emidl
Lo mbhalo uveza ukuthi umthetho weziMvelo Zasendle eNingizimu Afrika we-1998 uhlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okungapheli nokuvikelwa kwezimila zasendle eNingizimu Afrika ngokuphathwa kokulondolozwa. Umthetho wenhlalakahle eNingizimu Afrika wavela ngesikhathi sokubusa kwenani elincane labamhlophe ngaphansi kwe-apartheid, futhi inqubo enzima yokufaka umthetho wenhlalakahle kanye nezinguquko iphinde yathinta izimila, lapho abantu abaningi abamnyama benqatshelwa izinzuzo zokusebenzisa kwazo. Imithetho emisha yokulima izihlahla izama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bangafinyelela ezimilaneni ngenkathi kukhuthazwa ukusetshenziswa okungapheli kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Isisekelo salokhu nguMthetho Wezihlahla Zasendle, ophawula izimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye okufanele zihlale zikhunjulwa lapho kwenziwa izinqumo ezithinta izimila. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye njengesiqondiso, umthetho uhlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okungapheli, ubuholi obubambisene, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabo bonke ababambiqhaza. Nokho, izikhungo zomphakathi ezingeni lendawo azikazitholi izinguquko ezifanayo nezepolitiki: okwamanje, inselelo wukufaka izinqubomgomo ezigxile esikhathini esizayo kanye nemithetho ezingeni lokuphathwa kwendawo. Ukhetho: Ngonyaka ka-1994, ukhetho lokuqala lwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika lwenza ukuba kube nohulumeni omusha. NgoMashi 1995, umhlangano kazwelonke wabhala ingxenye yokuqala yomthetho ophakanyisiwe, owawusetshenziselwa ukuxoxisana nabo bonke ababambiqhaza. Ingxenye yokuqala yomthetho ophakanyisiwe yaba yisisekelo senqubomgomo ethathwe ngokusemthethweni ekhishwe ngoDisemba 1997, ingxenye yesibili yomthetho ophakanyisiwe. Lokhu kwasetshenziselwa ukuhlela uMthetho Wezihlahla Zasendle. Kusukela ngo-1998, ngosizo lukahulumeni wase-UK, uMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla ubambe iqhaza ekufakweni kwalo mthetho. Ingxenye 24 ithi: "Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuba nendawo engalimazi impilo yabo noma inhlalakahle, ukuze benze inzuzo ekusetshenzisweni okungapheli kwezinsiza zemvelo, futhi ukuba nendawo evikelwe ukuze kube nezinzuzo zezigidi zamanje nezizayo ngokusebenzisa izinyathelo ezisemthethweni nezinye ezikhuthaza ukulondolozwa nokuvikela ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli kwezemvelo nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo ngenkathi kukhuthazwa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho kanye nezokuhlalisana. Izihlahla zasendle akufanele zilimale ngaphandle uma kunezimo ezikhethekile, futhi ngokombono weNgqongqoshe, ukusetyenziswa kwalelo thafa kungcono uma kubhekwa izinzuzo zomnotho, zomphakathi, nezemvelo. Indawo encane yezihlahla kufanele igcinwe. Khuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwazo nokuphila kwazo isikhathi eside. Gcina izinsiza zomlando futhi ukhuthaze amanani obuhle, isiko, nesipirituality; kanye nokuphakamisa abantu noma imiphakathi ehluphekayo eyayishiywe ngaphandle ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Umthetho ubeka ngqo izimiso zokuphatha izihlahla ngokungapheli, okufanele zisetshenziswe kuzo zonke izinqumo ezithinta izihlahla, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngaphansi koMthetho Wezihlahla Zasendle noma eminye imithetho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezimila okungapheli kufanele kuhambisane noma kuhlanganiswe nokuvikelwa kwezihlahla nezihlahla. Abaphathi bezihlahla kanye nezikhulu zezihlahla (ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezihlahla noma ezinye izinhlangano ezifana nezinhlelo zokulondoloza) banesibopho sokufaka le nhlanganisela, besebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izindlela, nezindlela zikaMnyango. Akuvumelekile ukususa noma ukwabela izihlahla kuzo zonke izihlahla zasendle ngaphandle kwemvume. Izihlahla ezithile nezindawo zezimila zingamenyezelwa njengendawo evikelwe. Isihlahla, noma iqembu lezihlahla, indawo yezihlahla, noma uhlobo lwezihlahla lungamenyezelwa njengokuvikelwa. Amalungelo okusebenzisa, ukuphatha, nokulawula izihlahla zikahulumeni nemikhiqizo yazo akhishwa ezandleni zeNgqongqoshe Yamanzi Nezihlahla. Nokho, ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe kuMthethosisekelo, angavuma izinhlobo ezahlukene zokusebenzisa ezisunguliwe kulo mthetho: ngempumelelo, ukukhululwa, (bona ibhokisi) amalungelo okusebenzisa, ukuqashwa, izivumelwano, kanye Nezivumelwano Zomphakathi Wezihlahla. Ivumela imisebenzi efana nokudoba, ukwakha izakhiwo, noma ukuhweba. Ikhishwa ngaphansi kwezimo. Umthetho uyavuma ukuthi imiphakathi yasemakhaya incike ezinsizeni ezitholakala ezimilaneni futhi ifuna ukukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza kwabantu abashiywe ngaphandle ngesikhathi se-apartheid kuzo zonke izinhlelo ezithinta izimila. INgqongqoshe isebenzisile iSahluko 24 ukukhulula amalungu emiphakathini eduze kwezimila zikahulumeni ekudingekeni kokuthola imvume uma beqoqa izinkuni noma ezinye izinsiza ezitholakala ezimilaneni ezifana nomhluzi, izithelo, utshani bokwakha, noma izitshalo zokwelapha zemindeni, ngokwesiko noma ngokomoya. Akukho zinkokhelo ezidingekayo. INgqongqoshe ingavuma ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo yezihlahla (njengomhluzana) noma eminye imikhiqizo (njengezinkuni) ezithathwe ezimilaneni zikahulumeni ukuze zithengiswe kwabanye. Imiphakathi ingangena ezivumelwaneni neNgqongqoshe ukuze iphathise noma ibambisane neNgqongqoshe ekuphatheni izihlahla zikahulumeni. INgqongqoshe ingaqasha izihlahla zikahulumeni noma izingxenye zazo kunoma ubani. Umthetho unika noma ubani ilungelo elamukelekayo lokungena ezimilaneni zikahulumeni ngezizathu ezine ezingalimazi noma ezingaphuli: ukufundisa, ukujabulisa, ngokwesiko, nangokomoya. Ukwenza umthetho omusha kuyisinyathelo sokuqala enqubweni ende. Izimiso, izindlela, nezindlela kufanele zisungulwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe umthetho. Thuthukisa uhlelo oluzosetshenziswa kwezombusazwe kanye nomthetho. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni, abaphathi bezihlahla, kanye nezinye izithakazelo kufanele baqeqeshwe ukuze baqonde futhi bakwazi ukufaka umthetho omusha, izindlela, nezindlela futhi basebenzise ulwazi lwabo namakhono ngendlela efanele futhi elungile. Uma begcina izindlela ezikhona, kufanele bazame ukuthola ibhalansi noma ukuhlanganisa ushintsho nalokho okukhona.
Umkhakha Wezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) ukhuthaza futhi uhlanganisa ukuxhumana ngezilimi ezahlukene. Njengomzamo wokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, i-NLS iphethe ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi emphakathini wethu futhi inesibopho sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilimi zonke zabantu baleli zwe ngokusebenzisa lokho okukhulunywe kumgomo ophakanyisiwe wokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi lezi, kanye nazo zonke izilimi ezakhelwe emuva emlandweni waleli zwe. Umsebenzi ophambili we-NLS ukuhambisana nezidingo zomthethosisekelo ngokwenza kube lula, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlinzeka ngensiza yokuhumusha nokuhlela kuzo zonke izilimi ezamukelwa ngokomthetho nokuphatha ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ngokuhlela izilimi nemigomo ezinhlelweni ezithile. I-NLS isebenza njengengxenye yoHulumeni wezazi zezizimi ngokuhumusha imibhalo ebhalwe ngolimi oluthile olwamukelwa ngokomthetho iye kwezinye izilimi ezamukelwa ngokomthetho. Iqembu layo lemigomo linikeza usizo ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphuculeni izilimi ezamukelwa ngokomthetho ngezisho zobuchwepheshe. Umsebenzi wabo wokuhlela izilimi uhilela ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuhulumeni ekuthuthukiseni umgomo wezilimi nasekutholeni izindlela zokuwusebenzisa. Umsebenzi omkhulu weMkhakha Wezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) mayelana Nokuhlelwa Kwezilimi ukuhlinzeka ngolimi oluningi nokuhlonipha zonke izilimi ezikhona lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba ukuhlela izilimi eNingizimu Afrika kwenzeka ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa komphakathi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezakhelwe emuva kuzobekwa phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa komgomo wezilimi ngokwakha amasu, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezingasetshenziswa ukuze kufezwe lo msebenzi. Ukuqaliswa komgomo wezilimi kuhilela ukuhlinzeka (i) ukufinyelela nokuphathwa (ii) nokukhuthaza ukuhlinzekwa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlola ukusetshenziswa komgomo ukuze kutholakale ukusebenza kwawo kubalulekile. Lo mkhakha wokuhlela izilimi wasungulwa ngo-1993 ukuze unikeze uHulumeni ngeluleko ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphumeleliseni umgomo wezilimi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 6 soMthethosisekelo. Ukuvuleka nokuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke izigaba kule nqubo kugcizelelwe. Umsebenzi ophambili nokuqala walomkhakha kwakuwukuphatha inqubo ende yokusungula iBhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South African. Le nqubo yaqala ngo-1994 ngephakheji yokubonisana kazwelonke ebizwa ngeSithangami Sezilimi Sabantu Bonke, kwalandelwa yizingxoxo eziningi nemiphakathi ezweni, okuholele ekubhalweni kweBill yeBhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South African ngo-1995. Ibhodi yezilimi yasePan South African yasungulwa ngo-1996. Umgomo wezilimi kanye nezisekelo zeNingizimu Afrika zathuthukiswa ngokuhambisana neziphakamiso ezenziwe yiLangtag nezinye izingxoxo nezifundo ezenziwe. NgoDisemba 1999, uNgqongqoshe wathumela ithimba lokweluleka ukuze liphothule umgomo wezilimi nezisekelo zeNingizimu Afrika, owethulwe kubo bonke ababambiqhaza eSithangamini Sezilimi esabanjwa ngoMashi 2000. Ngemuva kweziphakamiso ezenziwe yilabo ababekhona eSithangamini, ithimba lokweluleka labuyekeza umgomo wezilimi nezisekelo zeNingizimu Afrika. Ngemuva kweziphakamiso lezi, kwenziwa ucwaningo olunzulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala nasemaphandleni ukuze kutholakale ubukhona bezinsiza zezizimi. Okwamanje, inani lemali elidingekayo ukuze kuqaliswe umgomo ophakanyisiwe liyacatshangelwa, ngokubambisana neMali Yezwe. Le nqubo iyingxenye yokuphumelelisa izinqubo ezisunguliwe emgomweni wezilimi ophakanyisiwe. Izithiyo zolimi zisasebenza njengokuphazamisayo kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu, ukuze bakwazi ukuxhumana nohulumeni. Usizo lokuhumusha eNingizimu Afrika lungakwenza kube lula kubo bonke ukuxhumana neziphathimandla ngolimi lwabo, njengasemathuneni, eziteshini zamaphoyisa, nasezikhungweni zikahulumeni. Lokhu kusizo kulindeleke ukuthi kuhlolwe ngonyaka ka-2000/2001 ezindaweni ezikhethiwe amahora angama-12 ngosuku, kusukela ngo-07:00 ekuseni kuya ku-19:00, ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngesonto. Lo msebenzi wenziwa ngokubambisana nePANSLAB ukuze kube lula ukuthuthukiswa nokuphumelelisa izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Isisekelo esihle sokwakha emkhakheni wezilimi zomdabu zobuchwepheshe sidingeka ukuze kuhlelwe kahle imizamo yocwaningo ezwenikazi lonke futhi kwakhiwe amandla noma izinsiza zezilimi zonke zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ikhompiyutha yokuphatha yasungulwa ukuze ibhale idokhumenti ezophakamisa inqubo engasetshenziswa ukuze kusungulwe imboni ye-HLT ezothuthuka futhi ikhuthaze izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Kuqinisekiswa ukuthi bonke abantu bayazi ngamalungelo abo njengoba ebhalwe emthethweni mayelana nezilimi; futhi ukuthi ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi kuyakhuthazwa ukuze abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babone ukuthi ukwazi izilimi eziningi kuyinzuzo. Umkhakha wokuqala walolu shintsho wagxila ekusebenzeni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanti umkhakha wesibili wagxila emphakathini wonke. Umphumela walolu shintsho uhlanganisa amakhalenda ezilimi, amaposta, amabhrosha ezilimi (anezibingelelo ngolimi eziyi-11), namavidiyo, kanye nokuphumeleliswa kolimi lwakho lokukhuluma ezikhungweni. I-UNESCO okwamanje ilungiselela umbiko wezIzilimi Zomhlaba ophakanyiswe ukuze uchaze ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi emhlabeni jikelele, ukufunda ngempande zezizimi nendawo yazo yamanje, nokuhlonza izinkinga ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni. Ngalesi sithangami, i-UNESCO ihlose ukukhombisa isidingo sokuphatha noma ukuhlela ubukhona bezilimi emhlabeni jikelele. Umkhakha Wezilimi Zesizwe (NLS) wacelwa yi-UNESCO ukuba ibambe iqhaza ocwaningweni lokuqoqa ulwazi lombiko ngazo zonke izilimi ezamukelwa ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kanye nezilimi zeKhoisan neNama. Njengoba ulwazi olunzulu ngalezi zilimi lwaludingeka kulolu cwaningo, imibuzo yathunyelwa ezazi zezizimi ezidumile ukuze zinikeze ulwazi. Ulwazi olunothile luqoqwe ezimkhakheni ezahlukene mayelana nezilimi eNingizimu Afrika, njengolwazi ngendawo, ukuhlukahluka, inani labantu abakhuluma ulwimi oluthile, ulwazi lokuhamba, umnotho wephakathi ngalinye elikhuluma ulwimi oluthile, indlela okuthathwa ngayo noma okwamukelwa ngayo, imizimba ephethe umgomo wezilimi, nezinhlelo ezihlobene nalolu limi nezindlela zokufunda nokubhala. Umbiko wezIzilimi Zomhlaba we-UNESCO uzokhishwa ngo-2001 futhi uzophakamisa uchungechunge lweziphakamiso mayelana nokuvikela nokukhuthaza ubukhona bezilimi zomphakathi.
Umphakathi uyaziswa ukuthi uMongameli uvumile umthetho olandelayo owashicilelwa lapha ukuze wazise umphakathi wonke. Amagama akhanyiswe ngokuqinile abonisa izinguquko emthethweni osekhona. Lokhu kuhlobene nokukhishwa kwemiyalo mayelana nokuvikelwa kwabantu ezimweni zokuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya nezindaba ezihlobene. Mayelana nalokho okuphathwa yile mthetho, kubikwa ukuthi isimo sizimisele ukuvimbela ukuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya. Amalunga omndeni angabandakanya ubudlelwano ngokwenkolo, umshado, noma ukuthola, kodwa akukhona ubudlelwano uma bengakabambisani, bengahambelani, bengahlangani noma bengashadile, futhi bengahlangani ngokocansi; noma bangahlala ndawonye noma bahlale ndawonye. "Ukuhlukunyezwa" kusho ukulimala okuqhubekayo; "lo mthetho" uhlanganisa imithetho. Uma kudingeka, kumele kuhanjiswe isaziso esiqukethe ulwazi mayelana nomlamli ngolimi olusemthethweni olukhethwe ngumlamli; futhi uma kudingeka, umlamli kumele aziswe ngokuqondile okuqukethwe kulesi saziso, kuhlanganise nezixazululo ezingamsiza ngaphansi kwalomthetho kanye nelungelo lokufaka icala uma kusebenza. Amaphoyisa angabamba ngaphandle kweziqinisekiso noma imvume noma yimuphi ophendulayo endaweni lapho ukuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya kwenzekile noma lapho ophendulayo kuthiwa wenze isenzo noma icala elihlobene nokuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya ngokumelene nomlamli. Noma yimuphi umlamli angafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuvikelwa ngendlela efanele. a ngosizo olutholakalayo ngaphansi kwalomthetho; futhi b nelungelo lokukhala uma icala lenziwa ngumlamli. Naphezu kwemigomo yomthetho, noma yimuphi umuntu ongakwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela, noma yimuphi umuntu omele umuntu ongakwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela, angafaka isicelo sokuvikelwa enkantolo ngaphandle kosizo lwezihlobo, umgibeli, noma noma yimuphi omunye umuntu ogunyaziwe ukusiza lowo muntu ongakwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela. Isicelo esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni-1 singafakwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ngosuku olungahambelani nezinsuku zokusebenza zenkantolo, inqobo nje uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi umlamli angalimala uma lesi sicelo singabhekwa ngokuphuthumayo. Ama-affidavit enziwe abantu abanolwazi ngalesi sihloko angafakwa kulesi sicelo. Isicelo nama-affidavit angathunyelwa kumlobi wenkantolo, ozothumela konke lokhu enkantolo. I-inkantolo kumele ibheke isicelo esithunyelwe kuyo ngokuphuthumayo uma ingakwenza lokho ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba-4 futhi ingase icabangele ubufakazi obungeziwe balesi sihloko uma ibona ukuthi kuhle ukwenza kanjalo, kuhlanganise ubufakazi obukhuluma noma ama-affidavit, azoba yingxenye yobufakazi ezosetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa enkantolo. a ophendulayo wenze icala noma ubambe iqhaza ekuhlukumezekeni kwasekhaya; futhi b kungaba khona ukulimala kumlamli ngenxa yokuhlukumezeka kwale ndlela uma umyalo wokuvikela ungakhishwanga ngokuphuthumayo, inkantolo kumele, naphezu kokuthi ophendulayo akazange aziswe ngemigomo echazwe esigabeni-1, ikhiphe umyalo wesikhashana wokuvikela ophendulayo ngendlela efanele. a umyalo wesikhashana ophume enkantolo kumele unikezwe ophendulayo ngendlela efanele futhi ophendulayo kumele abuzwe ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezingavimbela inkantolo ekukhishweni kwalowo myalo. b Ikhophi yesicelo esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni-4 1 kanye nobufakazi obubhalwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- kumele inikezwe ophendulayo ngokuhambisana nomyalo wesikhashana ophume enkantolo. Uma inkantolo ingakhishi umyalo wesikhashana ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- inkantolo kumele iyale umlobi wenkantolo ukuthi athumele ophendulayo ikhophi egunyaziwe yalesi sicelo kanye nanoma yisiphi ubufakazi bama-affidavit asekelayo lesi sicelo, kuhlanganise nesaziso esiphakamisayo ophendulayo ukuthi anikeze izizathu zokuthi kungani engafaneleki ukuba anikezwe umyalo wokuvikela wenkantolo ngokumelene nomlamli. Izinsuku zokuphendula ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni-3 a no-4 akumele zibe ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokuthi ophendulayo ethole umyalo wenkantolo; ngaphandle uma izinsuku zokuphendula ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni-3 a zingalindelwa ku ophendulayo ngaphansi kwezinsuku ezingaphansi kwamashumi amabili nane amahora esaziso esibhaliwe yinkantolo ku ophendulayo. a kumele icabangele noma yisiphi ubufakazi obutholwe ngaphambili ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba-5 1; futhi b kumele futhi icabangele ama-affidavit noma ubufakazi obukhuluma obuzoba yingxenye yokuhlolwa. a akumele abuze ngqo noma yimuphi umuntu obandakanyeka nabo ngempela; futhi b kuzobuzwa abafakazeli balesi sihloko ngokubhekisela imibuzo yabo enkantolo, futhi inkantolo izobuyisela umbuzo kubo. I-inkantolo kumele, ngemuva kokulalela icala njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni-2, ikhiphe umyalo wokuvikela ngendlela efanele uma ithola ukuthi ophendulayo wenze icala futhi ubambe iqhaza ekuhlukumezekeni kwasekhaya. a qinisekisa ukuthi umyalo onjalo unikezwa ophendulayo; futhi b wenze ikhophi egunyaziwe yalowo myalo, kanye nomyalelo wokubamba okukhuluma ngawo esigabeni -8 1 a, okumele unikezwe umlamli. Umlobi wenkantolo kumele athumele ikhophi egunyaziwe yomyalelo wokuvikela nanomyalelo wokubamba okukhuluma ngawo esigabeni -8 1 a kumaphoyisa. Ngokwemigomo yesigaba-7 7, umyalo wokuvikela ophume ngaphansi kwemigomo yalesi sigaba uhlala usemthethweni kuze kube ususwa, futhi ukuhlinzekwa kwalowo myalo ngeke kuqedwe kuphela ngenxa yesicelo sokukhuluma sokudluliselwa kwecala. g ukuvimbela umlamli ophila noma owayephezu kwabo endaweni efanayo njengokuchazwe esigabeni -c ekungeni noma ekuhlala endaweni abahlala kuyo; noma h ukwenza noma iyiphi enye into njengokuchazwe kumyalo wokuvikela. a ukuthatha ku ophendulayo noma iyiphi impahla noma impahla eyingozi njengokuchazwe esigabeni 9; futhi b amaphoyisa kumele ahambisane nomlamli endaweni ethile ukuze asize ngezinhlelo zokubuyisa impahla yabo. I-inkantolo ingalalela ukuthi ophendulayo akhokhe izidingo, kodwa ikwenza lokhu ngokucabangela izidingo nezinsiza zezimali zomlamli kanye nophendulayo nokuthi umyalo onjalo ungenela ekwenzeni isinqumo secala lesi sivilayezwe enkantolo ye-magistrate. a ikheli lapho umlamli ehlala khona kumele likhishwe kumyalo wokuvikela, ngaphandle uma okukhuluma ngawo kumyalo kudinga ukuthi ikheli lomlamli lifakwe. b inkantolo ingakhipha noma yisiphi isinqumo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikheli lapho umlamli ehlala khona alikhululwa nganoma iyiphi indlela engase ibangele ingozi empilweni yomlamli. a ingavimbela ophendulayo ukuba ahlangane nalowo mngane; noma b ilungise ukuhweba nophenyo nomntwana ukuze kube ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. i ukukhipha um
Ngokwesistimu yezenzo zokubuyisela, evimbela ubugebengu, izenzo ezinjalo zixazululwa ngohlelo lwesiko lokwahlulela. Uma kutholakale ukuthi umsolwa unecala enkantolo, abasolwa bahlawuliswa ngokubekwa ohlelweni lokubhekwa eMnyangweni Wezokulungisa, bethola isigwebo sokuhlala ejele, ukukhokha inhlawulo, noma inhlanganisela yalezi zijeziso. UMnyango Wezokulungisa uthathe isinqumo sokwakha isu elaziwa ngokuthi iRestorative Justice njengomnikelo ophambili. Le nqubo isekelwe ekuqondeni ukuthi ubugebengu yisenzo esiqondiswe kumvictim nakumphakathi, futhi ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezikhona ngaphakathi kohlelo lwezobulungiswa. Akukhona ukujolisa ekwahluleleni abasolwa kodwa kunalokho ukuqinisa uhlelo lwezobulungiswa jikelele. Iyini iRestorative Justice? Ngokwemibhalo yeMnyango Wezokulungisa, iRestorative Justice ingachazwa njengesenzo esiqinisa umvictim noma abavictim abahluphekile ngenxa yobubi. Le nqubo igcizelela ukubaluleka kokuba nabantu abathintekayo, imindeni, kanye namalungu omphakathi behlanganyela ohlelweni lwezobulungiswa. Ihlose ukubeka abasolwa phambi kwemiphumela yokulimala abenze, futhi ibavumele ukuthi babhekane nalabo abawalimazile futhi benze imizamo yokubabuyisela esimweni sabo sangaphambili, kuhlanganise nokubhekana nezindleko nezingozi ezitholakele. Iphakela ithuba lokuxazulula, ukuxhumana, ukuxoxisana, nokuxazulula izinkinga okungaholela ekwelapheni, esimweni esingcono sokuphepha, futhi kukhuthaze indlela elula yokubuyisela abasolwa emiphakathini. IRestorative Justice igcizelela ukubaluleka kokuphakamisa indima yabantu abathintekayo nomphakathi ngokubenza babe yingxenye yephrosesi yezobulungiswa, ivumela abasolwa ukuthi babhekane ngqo nalabo abawalimazile futhi idale amathuba okuxoxisana, ukuxhumana, nokuxazulula izinkinga. IRestorative Justice ihluke kakhulu kusistimu yokwahlulela. Iyi-justice enikela umnikelo obalulekile futhi inikeza ithemba lekusasa, hhayi kuphela kulokho okudlule. Le justice igcizelela lokho okudingeka ukuba kuphumelele, lokho okudingeka ukukhokhelwa noma ukuvunyelwana, nokuthi yini okufanele ibe yisifundo uma ubugebengu benzeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le justice ibheka lokho okudingeka ukuqiniswe uma sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi akuphindi kwenzeke esikhathini esizayo. Ukuqinisa umphakathi ukuvimbela ukulimala okwengeziwe. Ukubuyisela izimiso - umthelela wokunciphisa ubugebengu nokuphindaphinda, ukwandisa inani labantu abangena ezinhlelweni zokubuyisela, nokuphakamisa izinga lokubandakanyeka komphakathi. Ukwamukelwa nokwethenjwa okwakhiwe ngokuvuma iziphambeko nezenzo zokuzithoba nokuvunyelwana. Ukwehla kwezinga lokwesaba. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokuzwelana nokwamukela labo abasolwa. Yiziphi izinhlelo ezilindelekile ngaphansi kweRestorative Justice? Njengoba uhlelo lweRestorative Justice lugxile ekuqondeni ukuthi ubugebengu buholela ekulimazeni kwabantu abathintekayo, imiphakathi, kanye nababukeli, kuyiqiniso ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi ezithintekayo kufanele zifakwe lapho kuxazululwa umthelela wobubi. Okulandelayo kubhekwa njengabathintekayo futhi kufanele babambe iqhaza: izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nabazithandayo. Kukhona izinkomba zokuthi iRestorative Justice iyathuthuka emhlabeni jikelele. Izinhlaka zikamasipala zixhasile uhlelo lweRestorative Justice. Ngo-1999, iKomidi Labaphathiswa leBhodi leYurophu lamukela iziphakamiso zokusebenzisa izixazululo zokubuyisela mayelana nezimo. IRestorative Justice Handbook for Victims yeZizwe eziManyeneyo iyavuma ukuthi "ukwakheka kweRestorative Justice kuhlanganisa umsolwa, umvictim, kanye nomphakathi wonke ukuze kudaleke inqubo enobubele eqondiswe kumsolwa, ngenkathi ngesikhathi esifanayo kubhekwa umvictim." Ukukhokhelwa komvictim kuyisisekelo sohlelo lweRestorative Justice ezweni eliningi elithuthukayo. Izinyathelo zomthetho zinciphise izithiyo ekuphumezeni izinhlelo zokubuyisela. Zikhuthaze izinyathelo zomthetho zokuphumeza izinhlelo zokubuyisela, ukuhlela izinqubo, nokuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokubuyisela ngenkathi kuvikelwa amalungelo abavictim nababukeli. Inani lezinhlelo zeRestorative Justice emhlabeni jikelele liyanda. Kukhona ngaphezu kwe-500 yezinhlelo zokubuyisela eYurophu nakakhulu kwe-300 eMelika. Ucwaningo ngezinhlelo zeRestorative Justice nezinto ezifanayo eCanada kuholele ekuqoshweni kwezinhlelo eziyi-100. Isu leRestorative Justice alisha lapha eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kukhona izimo lapho lezi zimiso seziqalile ukusetshenziswa ngendlela ethile. IKomidi elidumile leziqinisekiso neZokubuyisela, elagxila kakhulu ezinhlekelweni ezenziwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, bekungumsebenzi weRestorative Justice. Kubonisa isidingo sokuthi abavictim bakhulume ngezwi labo futhi bafune izixazululo ezimweni zabo njengabavictim. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenqubo yokwethula ubufakazi bezinto abazihlangabezane nazo nokuhlinzeka ithuba lokulalela lokho labo abawalimazile ababe nakho. UMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uhola uhlelo lokwakha amandla abavictim. Le nqubo ihlose ukuhlanganisa abavictim ohlelweni lwezobulungiswa. Isu leZokuvimbela ubugebengu leNingizimu Afrika lichaza lokhu njengokuthi "ukuphendula emthelelweni wobubi kubantu abathintekayo." Nakuba le nqubo ingathinti ngqo ukunciphisa ubugebengu, umgomo wayo omkhulu ukuwulalela lokho abavictim abahlangabezana nakho. Kuyiqiniso elamukelekayo ukuthi ukuvuselela nokuqinisa abavictim kunciphisa eminye imithelela, kukhuthaza ukubambisana nohlu lwezobulungiswa, kuphinde kuphinde kuhlangane nezindlela zomphakathi, kuphinde kuvimbele abasolwa abangaba khona, futhi kukhuthaze ukwesekwa kohlelo lwezobulungiswa. Isu lokuphonsa abasolwa ukuba benze umsebenzi womphakathi liyaqhubeka nokwenziwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi womphakathi uyasiza futhi wenziwa emphakathini othintekile ngamalungu atholwe enecala elithile. Lesi sigwebo singabekwa kubasolwa nakubantu abahlawuliswa ukuba baphathwe yizinsizakalo zokulungisa. Ngemuva kwezinguquko kuMthetho weRestorative Justice ngo-1995, kwasungulwa ikomidi elihlanganisa abaphathiswa ukuze lilawule izinguquko ohlelweni lokubuyisela izingane nentsha eNingizimu Afrika. Ngesikhathi kudalwa uhlaka lwezombusazwe lokubuyisela izingane nentsha, le komidi laphakamisa ukuthi: "indlela yokubhekana nengane enenkinga nomthetho kufanele ibe yinhla: ukuxazulula izinkinga ezikhona, ukufaka imindeni nomphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo, nokwamukela nokubeka eceleni indima yomphakathi." Ukubhekana nesimo sabasolwa kuyindaba ejulile engakwazi ukuxazululwa ngokuphelele kuphela ngohlelo lweRestorative Justice. Ukuze kuphumelele izilonda zobubi, kumele kube nohlelo oluhlin
Izindawo ezikhombisa isilinganiso seziqinisekiso ezinhlanu zikhombisa izinhlinzeko ezithile ezizofakwa kuMthetho Wezobulungiswa Wezingane. Lo Mthetho uzoxoxwa ngemuva kokuhlelwa okwenziwe ngesisekelo somthetho 76 weMthethosisekelo - ngendlela echazwe emthethweni 1 weMemorandum ephathelene Nezinhloso zeMthetho. Uchaza amalungelo nezibopho zezingane njengoba ziqukethwe kuMthethosisekelo; uchaza inqubomgomo ephathelene nokunakekelwa nokuvikelwa kwezingane; uchaza amalungelo nezibopho zabazali; ungeza nezinye izimo ezihlobene nezinkantolo zezingane; unikeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemiyalelo yokunakekela; unikeza uhlelo lwezingane ezidinga usizo; unikeza izingane ezitholwe kwamanye amazwe; uqala iHague Convention ephathelene Nokwamukelwa Kwezingane Ezivela Kwamanye Amazwe; uvimbela ukuhweba ngezingane futhi uqala iHague Convention ephathelene Nokuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Emhlabeni Wonke; unikeza isimo somama ongumzali wezingane; udala ezinye izinhlinzeko ezihlelwe njengezindaba eziphathelene nezingane futhi unikeza izindaba ezihlobene. NGAKO, iZizwe Ezihlangene zikhulume ngeMvumelwano Yomhlaba Ngamalungelo Abantu ukuthi izingane zinegunya lokunakekelwa nokusizwa ngendlela ehlukile. Iqoqe ulwazi mayelana nesicelo esiphakanyisiwe sokuthola ingane ngendlela echazwe emthethweni 237; kanye nembiko echazwe emthethweni 2391. Umprofessionali emkhakheni wokuthola izingane obhaliswe ngaphansi koMthetho Wezisebenzi Zokusebenza Komphakathi, 1978 Umthetho No. yisivumelwano sokusebenza nezingane ezitholiwe, ngokuhambisana nenhloso yeSahluko 16, ibhekisela esivumelwaneni esibhaliwe esisayiniwe yinhlangano ebhaliswe ukuze ivikele izingane ngaphansi komthetho 259 weMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezinye ezilinganayo ezivela kwezinye izindawo ngenhloso yokukhuthaza umsebenzi wokugcina izingane ezitholiwe phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika nezinye izindawo ezithintekayo. Ingane ephila emndenini ongahlangene ngokomzimba nengane lapho ingane eyinhloko ibamba iqhaza njengomnakekeli. Emaphutheni kahulumeni kazwelonke noma emaphutheni omphakathi; noma b enhlangano eyasungulwa ukuvikela izingane; noma c emkhandlwini. Umthetho Wokuxazulula Izingxabano Ezithile Zokuhlukanisa uchaza umthetho ophatha ukuxazulula izindaba eziphathelene nokuhlukaniswa kwabantu abashadile bo-1987 Umthetho No. udokotela, uchaza umthengisi wezempilo obhalisiwe noma omunye obhekwa njengobhalisiwe ukwenza umsebenzi wezokwelapha ngaphansi koMthetho Wezempilo Wochwepheshe ka-1974 Umthetho No. ukwazisa mayelana nanoma yisiphi isaziso, incwadi noma enye inqubo ephathelene nezinhlinzeko zalo Mthetho, uchaza ukuvezwa kwalolo saziso, incwadi noma enye inqubo ngokuhambisana nenqubo ehlinzekwe yokwethulwa kwenqubo ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinkantolo Zabasebenzi ka-1944 Umthetho No. umprofessionali wezokusebenza komphakathi uhlanganisa abasebenzi abaphethe umuntu ongagciniwe, abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa, abasebenzi abaphethe izingane nentsha kanye nezisebenzi zokuphepha komphakathi ezibhaliswe ngalendlela ngaphansi koMthetho Wezisebenzi Zokusebenza Komphakathi ka-1978 Umthetho No. Isisekelo seMvumelwano Yezizwe Ezihlangene Sokuvikela Ukuhweba Ngabantu sichaza inqubo yeZizwe Ezihlangene evimbela, yehlisa futhi iphonsela inselelo Ukuhweba Ngabantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nezingane, isekela iMvumelwano Yezizwe Ezihlangene ka-2000 ephikisana Nobugebengu Obuhlelwe emazweni, umbhalo ofanayo weSiNgisi otholakala kuSheduli 3. Ngaphezu kokuchazwa okunikeziwe kumagama "ukubheka", "ukufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho nasemthethweni ojwayelekile, amagama "ukubheka nokufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho kufanele athathwe njengokuchazwa "ukunakekela nokuxhumana ngendlela echazwe kulomthetho. Kulomthetho, igama noma igama elithathwe egameni noma ngaphansi kwegama elichazwe emthethweni 1, linencazelo efanayo ngaphandle uma umongo ukhombisa ukuthi kukhona enye incazelo ehleliwe. Noma yisiphi isenzakalo esiqhubekayo esivela ngemuva kokusebenza koMthetho Wezobulungiswa Wezingane ka-1929 Umthetho 9 ka-1929, Umthetho Wokuhlukanisa, Umthetho Wokunakekela, Umthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwendlu ka-1998 Umthetho 116 ka-1998 kanye noMthetho Wokushadiswa Kwamasiko ka-1998 Umthetho 120 ka-1998, lapho lawa Mthetho aphathelene nezingane engazoxoxwa ezinkantolo zezingane. Umthetho ojwayelekile, ukhuthaza isimo sokuvikela nokuthuthukiswa kwezingane lezi. Umthetho wezakhamuzi, izingxabano kufanele zixazululwe ngokulandela umthetho 156 weMthethosisekelo. Ngokuqondene nokuhlelwa kahle komthetho 2b, ngokuhambisana nomthetho 1466 weMthethosisekelo, uNgqongqoshe kufanele akhombise zonke izimo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalomthetho ezithinta le ndawo kuBhunga Lezifunda Zasendaweni ukuze kuvunyelwe. Umthetho ophatha inqubo eyenzeka ezinkantolo zezingane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho 52. Lo Mthetho kufanele ufezekiswe ngamasu kahulumeni ezingeni lesizwe, ezingeni lezifunda, uma kukhona izakhiwo zomphakathi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ezithile zalo Mthetho nezimo ezihilelekile ngokwehlukana nezibopho. Ukuqaphela ukuthi kukhona izidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ezikhona, ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwalomthetho, uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezifanele ngokuhambisana nezinsiza ezikhona ukuze athole izindlela zokufinyelela nokufeza izinhloso zalo Mthetho. Ukuqhubeka komthetho ngendlela eyalelwe emthethweni 4, zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni ezingeni lesizwe, ezingeni lezifunda nezakhiwo zomphakathi ezihilelekile ekunakekelweni, ukuvikela nokunakekelwa kwezingane lezi kufanele zisebenze ndawonye ekuthuthukiseni indlela ehlelekile nehlanganisiwe yokusebenzisa izinsiza ezethulwe kuZingane. Zonke izinqubo, izenzo nezinqumo ezithathwe ngamasu kahulumeni kuyo yonke indaba ephathelene nengane noma izingane ngokujwayelekile. Ukwamukela isimo sokukhubazeka kwengane nokwakha isimo esihlangabezana nezidingo ezihlukahlukene zengane. Uma izithakazelo zengane zifezekiswa, umndeni wengane kufanele unikezwe ithuba lokukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta ingane. Ukuqaphela iminyaka, ukuthuthukiswa kwengqondo nesigaba sokuthuthuka komuntu onemithwalo kanye namalungelo athinta ingane kufanele aziswe ngezinyathelo noma izinqumo ezithathwe ezindabeni ezithinta futhi ezingase zibe nomthelela omkhulu kubo. Kulomthetho "umzali" uhlanganisa noma ubani onemithwalo kanye namalungelo athinta ingane.
