Ukubeka ukuhlonipha izinqubo zokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu; umthelela emthethweni ophathelene nobudlelwano bomuntu; ukuqashelwa ngokusemthethweni kobudlelwano bezindlu; ukusebenza komthetho ebudlelwaneni bezindlu; nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. UKUBONISA ukuthi ukwethulwa komthetho wezomndeni ngemuva kokuqala kweMthethosisekelo akukwazanga ukusinika isimo samaqabane afanayo ukuze sibe namalungelo nezinsiza ezihlobene nomthwalo wokushada onikezwa ukuhlonishwa kwamaqabane abhekelelayo. a ukuhlela umcimbi wokuhlanganisa nokubhalisa ubudlelwano babantu; nokub b ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo yomcimbi ngamagama omthetho nokubhaliswa kobudlelwano babantu. Umphakathi wokushada angahola umcimbi wokuhlanganisa abantu abesilisa nabesifazane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zale ngxenye. Ngokuhambisana nale ngxenye, umphakathi wokushada unazo zonke amandla anikezwe nguMthetho Wokushada ukuze ahole umcimbi ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Noma iyiphi ibandla noma inhlangano ingabhala kuNgqongqoshe bese ifaka isicelo sokuba yisikhungo esingahola ubudlelwano babantu. UNgqongqoshe angawagcizelela ibandla noma inhlangano ukuba ihole imicimbi yokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho, futhi kufanele, ngezikhathi ezithile, iphumelele imininingwane yazo zonke izikhungo ezinikezwe lawa mandla kuGazethi. UNgqongqoshe angawathathela emuva amandla anikezwe kumuntu esigabeni 2, uma ibandla noma inhlangano icela ukuthi ikhululwe futhi lokhu kufanele kushicilelwe kuGazethi. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelelwe anganika umuntu ongumfundisi wenkolo, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe, igunya lokuba umphakathi wokushada, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi ungumfundisi noma unendawo ethile kulelo bandla, amandla okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye nangokuhambisana nezindlela zokwenkolo zaleyo nkolo. Zonke amandla omphakathi wokushada ngaphansi kwesigaba 4 kufanele abhalwe emqulwini futhi kufanele ahlanganise usuku lokuqala kwala mandla kanye nemikhawulo enikezwe kuyo efakiwe kulolo mqulu. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelelwe, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe kumuntu ophumelelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 4, bangathathela emuva igunya lalo muntu lokushada ngokubhalela mayelana nekhono labo lokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Le ngxenye, ngokuhambisana nesigaba, ayiphoqeleli umphakathi wokushada ukuba ahole umcimbi wokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu: Kuqinisekiswa ukuthi bamenyezelile kuNgqongqoshe ngencwadi ukuthi imizwa yabo iyaphikisana nokuhlanganisa amaqembu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Isigaba 1 asisebenzi kubaphakathi bokushada ab placed ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. a ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ohlanganiswayo uveze ubunikazi bakhe obutholwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho weMazisi; noma b ukuthi umuntu ngamunye uhlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngesitatimende esifungwayo njengoba kuchaziwe; noma c ukuthi omunye wamaqabane abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uveze ubunikazi obukhuluma ngesigaba a kumphakathi wokushada kanti omunye uhlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngesitatimende esifungwayo njengoba kuchaziwe ngesigaba b. Umuntu angaba ngumlingani kuphela kubudlelwano obubhalisiwe ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umuntu oshadile akakwazi ukubhalisa ubudlelwano. Umuntu ozoba ngumlingani kubudlelwano babantu obekade eshadile noma obekade eyingxenye yobudlelwano obunye kufanele kuqala uveze ikhophi eqinisekisiwe ye-decree yokuhlukanisa noma isitifiketi sokufa somuntu abeshade naye noma owayengumlingani wakhe, njengoba kufanelekile, kumphakathi wokushada njengobufakazi bokuthi ubudlelwano buphelile. Umphakathi wokushada angaphumelela emcimbini futhi abhalise ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokuthi kuqala anikezwe imibhalo ethile ekhulumayo ngesigaba 3. Ubudlelwano babantu bungabhaliswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uma, ngaphandle kokuthi babe ngabesilisa nabesifazane, kungekho ezinye izithiyo zomthetho ezivimbela ukujola. Noma ubani ofuna ukuveza ukuphikiswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa njengabangane kufanele akhiphe lokho ebhalwe phansi kumphakathi wokushada ozohola umcimbi walobo budlelwano. Kumele kube ukuthi uma umphakathi wokushada ethola lokho ukuphikiswa, kufanele afune izizathu zalo ukuphikiswa ngokuphikisana nenhlangano kuze kube athola ukwaneliseka ukuthi awekho amaphikiso omthetho kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa, bese angaphumelela ukuhlela umcimbi wobudlelwano. Uma futhi enganeliseki, kufanele aphikise ukuhlanganiswa kobudlelwano futhi abhale phansi izizathu zalo. Umphakathi wokushada angahola umcimbi futhi abhalise nganoma yisiphi isikhathi futhi ngosuku oluthile lwesonto, kodwa akaphoqelekile ukuhlela umcimbi nganoma yisiphi esinye isikhathi ngaphandle kokuphakathi kuka-8 a.m. no-4 p.m. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele ahole umcimbi futhi abhalise endaweni yomphakathi noma endlini yangasese noma endaweni ebekwe phansi ngalokho, ngezicabha zivulekile kanye nezinsizwa zikhona kanye nezifakazelo ezimbili ezingafakaza, kodwa lezi zimo zangaphambilini kule ngxenye azivimbi umphakathi wokushada ukuba ahole ubudlelwano babantu kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwalokhu okukhuluma lapha, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwalesi sikhala esikhuluma ngaso, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngenxa yokugula okukhulu noma ukungabikhona okude, noma uma kukhona ukulimala komunye wamaqabane, noma kulabo abesilisa nabesifazane abafuna ukuhlanganiswa. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungena esivumelwaneni sobudlelwano ngaphansi kwale ngxenye egameni lomunye umuntu emcimbini. Mayelana nobudlelwano noma umshado ngesikhathi sokufunda amazwi okuhlanganisa. Uma amaqembu engavumelani, umphakathi wokushada kufanele, uma efunda inqubo, akhulume ngobudlelwano bomthetho. Uyakufunga, A.B., ukuthi ngokwazi kwakho awekho amaphikiso omthetho avimbela ukuba ube nobudlelwano bomthetho / umshado no-C.D. okukhona lapha phambi kwakho nakubantu abakhona lapha kanye nalabo obamema ukuba babe izifakazelo ukuthi uthatha u-C.D. ukuba abe ngumlingani wakho / umkakho noma umyeni? Kodwa ubudlelwano bomthetho / umshado kufanele buhweba ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zalesi sahluko, lokho kubudlelwano bomthetho / umshado kuzoba, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi awekho amaphikiso omthetho, kuyiqiniso futhi kuyabopha. Amaqembu kufanele afunge futhi abhale phansi ukuthi afuna ukusungula ubudlelwano bomthetho phakathi kwabo bobabili ngokusayina idokhumenti ethile futhi bayisayine phambi kwezifakazelo ezimbili. Umphakathi wokushada kanye nezifakazelo ezimbili kufanele nazo zisayine idokhumenti ethile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isifungo esenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 112 senziwe phambi kwabo. Lesi sitifiketi esikhishwe sikhonza njengobufakazi bokuthi kukhona ubudlelwano phakathi kwababhalisile ababili esitatimendeni. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele agcine amarekhodi wezigameko zonke aziholile. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele ngaleso sikhathi abhalise futhi agcine la marekhodi futhi awethule kumphakathi wokush
I-Memorandum yeMthetho 136 yeMithetho Yesifunda saseGauteng. Incazelo entsha ye-"isiteshi" ifakiwe ukuze ibandakanye indawo esetshenziselwa imisebenzi ehambisana ngqo nokusebenza nokuphathwa kohlelo lwezitimela kanye nokuthuthwa kwabagibeli abafika nabahamba esiteshini. Isiteshi sizobandakanya izindawo zokupaka, ama-garage okupaka, izindawo zokulahla nokuthola abagibeli, izimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi, nezinsiza ezifanayo. Kubonakale ukuthi kuvunyelwene nezinsizakusebenza zomphakathi ezifanele ngemva kokuxoxisana ukuthi ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okuthile endaweni yesiteshi akufanele kulawulwe yizinhlelo zokwakha ezisemadolobheni futhi akufanele kube ngaphansi koMthetho, okungavimbela izinqubo ezithatha isikhathi eside ekushintsheni izinhlelo zokwakha ezisemadolobheni. Lokhu kubandakanya imisebenzi ethile yezohwebo ehambisana ngqo nokuphathwa kahle kwabagibeli, kubandakanya ukukhangisa, ukuthengiswa kokudla neziphuzo, amaphephandaba nezincwadi, imishini yokuthengisa ethengisa izinto ezithengiwe, izingcingo zomphakathi, nemishini yokubhanga (lezo ezamukela amakhadi futhi zikhokhe imali). Nokho, kubhekwa ukuthi ezindaweni eziningi zesiteshi, kungase kube nesidingo semisebenzi yezohwebo ezindaweni eziseduze nesiteshi. Njengoba le misebenzi yezohwebo ingase ithinte izindawo eziseduze neziteshi futhi ingase iphinde ithinte izakhiwo zomphakathi, kudingeka ukuthi amalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba ahlotshaniswe nokusetshenziswa kwawo kwezomnotho kulawulwe ngohlelo olusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokwakha esisemadolobheni. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kubhekwane nomnikelo womphakathi walesi sikhala, kanye nesinqumo somasipala, ngaphambi kokuthi la malungelo anikezwe ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokwakha yalesi sikhala. Le misebenzi izokwenziwa esiteshini, futhi kumele yenziwe ngokuhambisana namalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba endaweni kanye nemithetho efanele yokwakha. Mayelana nokukhuluma ngendlela entsha yephakathi kanye nomgwaqo wezitimela, isigaba 4 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubuqotho Bezemisebenzi, 2000 (Umthetho No. 3 ka-2000) ubhekisisa izinqubo ezimbili ezishintshashintshayo lapho umphathi wehhovisi kumele akhiphe isinqumo esingase sithinte amalungelo omphakathi kahle noma kabi, eshilo nje ukuhlohla komphakathi noma inqubo yokuphendula. Isigaba esikhona 6 sikhetha inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi. Le nqubo ingaba nezinkinga futhi ithathe isikhathi eside futhi ingase iphinde idlulele isidingo solwazi olufanele ekwenzeni izinqumo okukhulunywe ngakho kahle ngale nqubo ehambisana nokuhlolwa kwesayithi kanye nebhuku elihlongozwayo esigabeni 6(a) soMthetho oyinhloko. Ngalesi simo, inqubo yokuhlohla nokuphendula njengoba kubonisiwe esigabeni 4 soMthetho 3 ka-2000 izosebenza futhi izosebenza kahle uma umbiko wendawo usuphothuliwe, kuyilapho inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi ingagcinwa kulezi zimo lapho izinkinga zivelayo ngqo enanini lokuhlohla futhi emibikweni emibili eminye, engase idinge ukuhlolwa nokuphendulwa okwengeziwe. Ngakho-ke, isigaba 6 sishintshwa ukuze kusetshenziswe inqubo yokuhlohla nokuphendula ukuze i-MEC yenze isinqumo, futhi kusebenze inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi kuphela ezindabeni ezihlobene nezinkinga ezithile. Ngakho-ke, ubuqotho bezemisebenzi obuphumelele buhamba phambili kunalokho okudingekayo nguMthetho 3 ka-2000 ngokuthi zombili izinqubo zilandelwa. Umthetho okhona awubheki kahle isivumelwano esidingekayo nguNgqongqoshe mayelana nokwakha, ukwakha, ukusebenza, ukuphathwa, nokubhekwa kweGautrain Rapid Rail Link ephakanyisiwe. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi i-MEC ikwaziwa, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho, ukuqeda izivumelwano ezifana nesivumelwano esikhona sokwakha ngokuhambisana ne-MEC ephethe ezomnotho. Lokhu kungasetshenziswa umthengisi ophumelele noma i-MEC ngaye, okwenziwa ukuze kuvikelwe amandla nokusetshenziswa kwawo ezingeni lokuzimela nokuphakeme. Ukusetshenziswa kwala mandla uma kunikezwa ukuze kuzuze umphakathi kungase kuphinde kube nezithiyo noma kuphazamise ekupheleni kwezivumelwano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kube nesidingo sokwakha isigaba esibhekisisa ukudluliswa kwamalungelo phezu komhlaba komunye noma amalungelo abanjwe yi-MEC adluliselwa kumthengisi ophumelele. Amalungelo phezu komhlaba komunye kanye namalungelo abantu awakwazi ukusetshenziswa ngokomthetho noma adluliselwe kumuntu wesithathu, futhi kube nesidingo sokuhleleka okukhuluma ngqo ngalokhu. Enye inhloso yeBhili ukuhlela isimo mayelana nokuhlolwa kwezindawo okwenziwayo. Ukuhlolwa kokuqala okubili kwanikezwa ngoba ngasikhathi sinye kungathatha isikhathi eside phakathi kwesigaba sokunquma izindlela nalokho kokwakhiwa kokuqala. Nokho, ukuhlolwa kwesibili akudingekile uma lezi zihlolo ezimbili zenzeka ngesikhathi esifanayo noma ngokuhambisana, njengoba kuzoba khona nokuhlolwa komgwaqo weRapid Rail Link. Ngakho-ke, iBhili ilungisa isigaba 8(b) soMthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akudingeki ukuhlolwa kwesayithi kwenziwe esigabeni sokwakha uma umphakathi onamandla okwenza umsebenzi ubona ukuthi akudingekile. Ezinye izichibiyelo ezincane ezenziwe ngalolu shintsho zenziwe kulolu sigaba. Isigaba 5 seBhili silungisa isigaba 10 soMthetho ukuze silungiselelwe ukuhambisana nesigaba esisha 6. Isigaba 7 seBhili silungisa isigaba 51 soMthetho ukuze silungise iphutha elenzeka ekubhaleni. Isigaba 8 seBhili singenisa isigaba esisha 51A kuMthetho ukuze kubhekwe izivumelwano ezingase ziphothulwe zokwakha, ukwesekwa kwezimali, ukusebenza, ukuphathwa, ukulawula, nokubhekwa kwezisekelo zomgwaqo nezitimela eziphakanyisiwe, njengoba kushiwo ngenhla, ngokuhambisana noNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nezimali. Isigaba 9 seBhili sinikeza isihloko esifushane.
Lo mthetho uhlose ukuthuthukisa futhi wenze ukuba ukuthutha komphakathi kube yimpumelelo kubagibeli eGauteng. Uhloswe ukudala uhlelo oluhlonipha amalungelo abantu abasebenza ekuthutheni komphakathi; futhi ukukhuthaza amabhizinisi amancane, ikakhulukazi lawo ancane kakhulu, kanye nabaphathi abaphumelele ngenxa yokucwaswa kwangaphambili. Lo Mthetho ufaka esikhundleni seSahluko 3 soMthetho Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke ngokwezinhlinzeko ezitholakala kulomthetho. Abasebenzisi babhekene nezindleko zokuhamba ezikhokhwa ngabagibeli, futhi lapho abagibeli bekhokha imali encishisiwe, futhi lapho umphathi wesivumelwano evuselela isivumelwano nomsebenzisi; futhi lapho labo abasebenza ekuthutheni bengatholi uxhaso noma usizo lwezezimali kunoma yiliphi ilungu noma ingxenye yohulumeni, ngakho-ke ngokwesigaba lesi, ukuvuselelwa okwenziwe kulabo abasebenza ekuthutheni ngokusekelwe emalini ekhokhwayo ngeke kubhekwane njengoxhaso noma olunye uhlobo losizo lwezezimali. Izinhlelo kumele ziphakanyiswe ukuze kube lula ukuhlanganiswa kwemizila, ukuthutha okutholakala kalula kulabo abanokukhubazeka, ukushintsha nokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi amancane kanye nabantu ababe nezinketho ezilinganiselwe ngenxa yokucwaswa okungafanele. Kumele babe nezimvume ezifanele, amalayisense okusebenza, noma igunya lesikhashana; futhi kumele babhaliswe ngaphansi kwalomthetho mayelana nezimoto ze-taxi, ama-taxi akhishwe ngemitha, amabhasi, nezimoto zokuzijabulisa ngokwezihloko 69, 77, no-81. Inhlangano ayikwazi ukuba ne-layisense yokusebenza noma imvume. Noma iyiphi imoto ingathola kuphela i-layisense yokusebenza eyodwa. Ukuthutha abantu emkhakheni wokwabelana ngezithuthi, lapho amalungu eshintshana ngezithuthi noma ehlela ukwabelana ngezithuthi namanye amalungu noma labo abanikwe wona ukuze bahambe baye futhi babuye ezindaweni ezithile ngenhloso ethile futhi lapho kungekho uhlelo noma olunye uhlobo lokukhokha lokwabelana ngezithuthi. Bangaba abashayeli; futhi kumele bazi kahle indawo abenza kuyo. Isigaba 1 ngeke sibe khona kubaphathi abasebenza lapho kucacile ukuthi akusikho. I-MEC ingakha imithetho yokuthi bonke abashayeli bezimoto zokuthutha komphakathi kumele baqeqeshelwe okuthile. Ummeleli wehhovisi ungacela ummangali welayisense ukuthi athumele imoto ukuze ihlolwe futhi uma bekungathiwa ayikahle emgwaqweni, noma ngabe le moto yayine-layisense evumelekile yokuba emgwaqweni; futhi bangaphika ukuhlinzeka nge-layisense yokusebenza uma bebona ngokwabo ukuthi imoto ayikahle emgwaqweni. Izimoto ezisetshenziswa ekuthutheni komphakathi kumele zishiye isizinda sazo sihlanzekile, ngaphakathi nangaphandle, ngokwezindinganiso ezihambisanayo, uma kukhona isivumelwano, njengoba kuchaziwe esivumelwaneni. Ngokwezinhlinzeko zoMthetho Wezokuthutha Kazwelonke, izimoto ezisetshenziswa ekuthutheni komphakathi kumele zibe sesimweni esihle ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Imoto esebenza ukuthutha abagibeli bomphakathi kumele ibe ne-fire extinguisher eyodwa esebenzayo okungenani kanye ne-first aid kit enezinto zayo. I-fire extinguisher kanye ne-first aid kit kumele zibekwe noma zifakwe ngendlela ethile nendawo ethile emotweni, futhi ama-fire extinguishers kumele ashintshwe ngezikhathi ezithile ezifanele. Izinsizakalo zokuzijabulisa kumele zihlale zikhona njengoba kukhonjisiwe esigabeni 16. Izigaba zezinsizakalo ezishiwo esigabeni 1 mayelana nemithetho ekhombisa esigabeni 3 esikhathini esizayo zikhonjiswe ohlwini B, kuyilapho lezo zokushintsha kwesikhathi zikhonjiswe ohlwini C. Imoto kumele ikhombe ukuthi iyitaxi ngendlela echaziwe. Ibhodi ingasetha imali ephezulu noma ephansi yokuhamba kwamataxi akhishwe ngemitha okumele ikhokhwe kumgibeli. I-taxi ayikwazi ukuthwala umuntu; noma kumele ikwenze ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano esivunywe yiBhodi. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, i-taxi ekhishwe ngemitha ingasebenza ngentengo engakhonjiswa kumitha uma intengo yokuhamba ethile ivunyelwe ngaphambili. Izimoto ze-taxi zingasebenzisa kuphela izimoto ezincane, ama-minibus, amabhasi amancane, noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshiwe ukuze zisebenze. I-layisense yokusebenza ekhishwe ye-taxi kumele ikhombe ukuthi ukusebenza kwaleyo taxi kulandela umzila noma imephu, ngaphandle uma isimo esihlukile sivunyelwe kulomthetho. Mayelana namabhasi noma ezitimeleni, iBhodi inganciphisa ukusebenza kwe-layisense ezindaweni ezithile noma emizileni ethile. Amabhasi kumele ahlelwe ukuze asebenze ezindaweni ezithile noma emizileni ethile ngokukhokha intengo ekhombisiwe futhi asebenze ngezikhathi ezihlelwe, okungukuthi, uma kukhona uxhaso, kumele kuvunywe nguMnyango ophakamisayo uxhaso. Ukuthutha kwezemfundo kumele kuhlinzekwe ukuze kuthuthwe abafundi bezikole, abafundi bezifundo eziphakeme, abafundi abadala, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi phakathi kwezindawo zabo zokuhlala nezikhungo zemfundo, kodwa kungabandakanya ukuhamba okungahlelwanga ezikhungweni zemfundo uma lezi zinhlelo zihlobene kuphela nezindaba zemfundo. Ukuthutha kwezemfundo kungasebenzisa izimoto ezincane, ama-minibus, amabhasi amancane, amabhasi ajwayelekile, amabhasi okushuttle, noma izimoto ezincane ezishintshiwe ukuze zisetshenziswe ngezinhloso ezithile. Ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka ngesicelo sokwabelana, ukuvuselela, ukushintsha, noma ukudlulisa i-layisense yokusebenza yokuthutha kwezemfundo, iBhodi kumele ithumele isicelo esikoleni esithintekayo noma kwezinye izikhungo zemfundo ukuze izwe imibono yabo noma iziphakamiso ngendlela echaziwe, futhi kumele ibhekise kulezi zibonelo noma iziphakamiso ezitholakele. Ukuthutha kwezivakashi kumele kuhlinzekwe ukuze kube lula ukuhamba kwabavakashi lapho izivakashi zikh accompanied by a registered tour guide ngokuhambisana nesigaba 21 soMthetho Wezokuvakasha. Akukho layisense evumela ukusebenza kokuthutha kwezivakashi okungakhishwa ngaphandle kokuthi iBhodi ithole futhi ihlinzeke ngeziphakamiso ezivela kumphakathi wezokuthutha ngokuvumelana noMEC, kodwa iBhodi ingaqhubeka ngaphandle kwalokhu kuhlola uma umphakathi ungakakhishanga iziphakamiso ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe esicelweni seBhodi. Ekukhishweni kwe-layisense yokusebenza kwezivakashi, iBhodi ingabeka izimo zokuthi imoto kumele ibe nenqubomgomo, izinhlelo zokukhuluma zokudlulisa umculo noma imiyalezo, amathuluzi okupheka, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izinto ezitholakala yiBhodi, noma izindawo zokuphumula uma uhambo ludlula amakhilomitha angama-200, noma ezinye izimo. Ibhodi ingasetha inani eliphezulu labagibeli imoto esetshenziselwa ukuthutha izivakashi engathwala, noma ngabe usayizi wemoto udlula lelo nani elichaziwe. Uma kufanelekile, iBhodi inganikeza izindawo ezithile noma imizila yokusebenza kokuthutha kwezivakashi. Umshayeli wemoto esetshenziselwa ukuthutha izivakashi kumele ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho lezi zinsizakalo
Yini ukuphathwa kolwazi? Ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyindlela yokusebenza kwezindawo ezahlukene ezisiza iminyango nezinhlelo ukuthuthukisa, ukwandisa, ukusabalalisa, ukubamba, ukuguqula, nokugcina ulwazi ukuze zifeze izinhloso zazo ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Yini inzuzo enkulu yokuphathwa kolwazi? Izinhlangano zithola inzuzo ngokugcwalisa ngokushesha izifiso nezinto ezihlosiwe, okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kokukhiqiza, ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukusungulwa kwezindlela ezintsha, ukuncintisana, nokwandiswa kwezindlela zesayensi ezintsha; kuyilapho labo abasebenza nolwazi bethuthukisa umbono wabo nokuzimisela. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyisixazululo esisheshayo? Ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyinqubo eqhubekayo hhayi isixazululo esisheshayo. Emhlabeni jikelele, imikhankaso nemihlangano yokuphathwa kolwazi iyasungulwa, futhi akukho ukuhamba emuva. Imikhankaso yokuphathwa kolwazi iyindlela eya ikusasa eliphumelelayo. Yini ubudlelwano phakathi kokuphathwa kolwazi nesikhathi solwazi? Ikhompyutha encane, i-Internet, kanye nezinto ezithuthukisiwe zobuchwepheshe, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwe emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi eMelika, kuholele ekusungulweni kwelithi "Isikhathi Solwazi," kodwa kubonakala futhi ukuthi kuzobizwa kakhulu ngokuthi "Isikhathi Solwazi." Njengoba abantu bedlulela esikhathini seMboni besuka esikhathini solwazi, ezingeni eliphansi, ukuphathwa kolwazi sekuthuthuke kakhulu ukuze kubhekwe izinguquko. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyinto entsha? Izinqubo nezimiso zokuphathwa kolwazi azikabi zintsha, njengoba kukhombisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kolwazi okwenziwe ngabantu kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo (izibonelo zifaka phakathi izindlela ezisetshenziswe emlilweni, insimbi, ngebhontshisi) ezadluliselwa ezizukulwaneni futhi zanda emhlabeni jikelele. Indlela ehlelekile yokuphatha ulwazi njengendawo yokugcina iyinsimu entsha futhi ethuthukayo, eyakhiwe yizinguquko ezisheshayo nezithuthukisi zobuchwepheshe nokuxhumana, nokubheka ulwazi njengemithombo ebalulekile yokusetshenziswa kwezicwangciso. Ulwazi luyindawo ebalulekile njengalezo zemithombo yemvelo, imithombo yabantu, kanye nezezimali. Indlela imboni nezinhlelo ezisebenzisa ngayo ulwazi nezindlela ezisetshenziselwa ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zolwazi, kanye nendlela lokho ulwazi lwasabalaliswa ngayo, kungafezwa ngempumelelo kusetshenziswa isikhali es secret sokuphumelela, okuyi ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuhlukile kwiTekhnoloji Yolwazi? Ingabe ukuphathwa kolwazi kuyitekhnoloji noma isenzo? Ukuphathwa kolwazi akusiyo nje itekhnoloji noma isenzo esilula; kuyisistimu kanye neziqoqi zobuchwepheshe ezisekela ukwabelana kolwazi ngaphakathi kwenhlangano ethile ukuze kuqhutshwe izicwangciso nemikhankaso yokusungula. Ukuphathwa kolwazi (KM) kuhlobene kanjani nabantu? Indlela ebaluleke kakhulu yokuphathwa kolwazi ngabantu abasebenza nolwazi, abathintekayo abasebenza enhlangano ethile, kanye nalabo abaziwa ngolwazi futhi kulindeleke ukuthi basize amakhasimende ale nhlangano. Ngakho-ke, ukuphathwa kolwazi kuphathelene nabantu kanye nokuphathwa kokuphila kwabo, hhayi uhlelo oluphatha ngendlela yokuphatha. Ukushintsha indlela yokwenza izinto kudinga ukushintsha kokuthi abantu bacabange kanjani kanye nenqubo endaweni yokusebenza eguqulwa ibe eyokwethembana nokwethembeka. Ukwabelana ngolwazi kuzosisiza abasebenzi benhlangano basebenzise ulwazi olukhona kunokuzama ukudala okuthile okusha. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ngokubonakalayo nangempumelelo ukusetshenziswa kwesikhathi, okuholela ekusungulweni, okuyimiphumela yolwazi olusha. Yini umthelela wokuphathwa kolwazi ezicini zokusebenza zenhlangano? Enye into ebalulekile yokuphathwa kolwazi ukuxhumana kwayo nezinqubo nezicwangciso zokusebenza ngaphakathi kwaleyo nhlangano, okwenza inhlangano ibe sezingeni lokuncintisana nabanye. Yini umehluko phakathi kwedatha, ulwazi, nolwazi? Idatha imelela izinto ezibonakalayo noma eziyiqiniso ezingaqhathaniswa nalokho, ngakho-ke ayinani ngaphandle komongo. Ulwazi luwumphumela wokuhlela idatha ngendlela enencazelo futhi efanele, kuvame ukudlulisa umlayezo. Ulwazi yilokho esikholwa ukuthi sinakho sithole ukubaluleka okuthile ngemva kokuhlela nokwakha imiyalezo ngendlela eqondakalayo ngokuya ngezinto esizihlangabezane nazo, ukuhlangana, noma ukuxhumana okuqondisiwe. Ulwazi lungabhekwa njengento engagcinwa bese isetshenziswa njengoba kudingeka, kanye nenqubo eqhubekayo yokwazi ehlanganisa ukuqonda nokwenza - inqubo ekhombisa ubuchule. Ulwazi luwuqoqo lwezinkolelo ezithathwa njengezempela, futhi le nkolelo ingabekwa ngumuntu okungenani oyedwa, ngendlela yemiyalezo nolwazi olwaneleyo olungaqondwa futhi lusetshenziswe omunye umuntu. Kumele kube nezindawo ezithile ezibonakalayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwamukelwa njengolwazi. Ingabe kukhona indlela yokukala nokuhlola izinga kanye quality yolwazi? Yebo, ngokubona ukuthi kusiza inhlangano noma umuntu ukufinyelela kalula izinhloso zabo. Ingabe kukhona iwebhusayithi noma ipulatifomu yokuphathwa kolwazi? Iphulatifomu yokuphathwa kolwazi isunguliwe ukuhlinzeka ngesiteshi sokuxhumana sokubambisana ngaphakathi kweSahluko Sokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzoba yindawo yokugcina yokuphathwa kolwazi, kuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokuphathwa kolwazi futhi kusetshenziswe njengendawo yokuxoxa ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokuphathwa kolwazi eNingizimu Afrika.
Ngiyajabula ukukwazisa umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ngomyalo ophakanyisiwe mayelana nezemidlalo nokuzijabulisa. Lo myalo ophakanyisiwe umele ukukholwa kwezokudlala nokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi imidlalo nokuzijabulisa kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu bonke baseNingizimu Afrika. Kuyindlela enhle yokubandakanya intsha emicimbini ezokwakha imiphakathi. Eminyakeni emihlanu edlule, umgomo wokuqala wezokudlala nokuzijabulisa washicilelwa okokuqala emyalo ophakanyisiwe lapho izinselelo, izinqubomgomo, nezinto ezibalulekile zaphawulwa ngokucacile. Kwenziwe okuningi ukuhlangabezana nalezi zinselelo nezinto ezibalulekile, kodwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwesikhathi esanele nezinsiza, indlela phambili isasele nde. Ngemuva kokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo zikamasipala kazwelonke, kubalulekile ukuthi izinto ezibalulekile kwezokudlala nokuzijabulisa zibuyekezwe futhi zishintshwe. Ukuze kufezwe umgomo kahulumeni wokuthuthukisa impilo engcono kubo bonke, nokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi isizwe sidlala, ukusungulwa kweKomidi Lezemidlalo Nokuzijabulisa laseNingizimu Afrika kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile esizokuqinisekisa ukuthi imidlalo ifinyelela zonke izingxenye zeNingizimu Afrika. Iminikelo evela kubaxhasi abafana nePoverty Relief, Ukwakhiwa Kwezakhiwo, iminikelo eqoqiwe eMhlanganweni Wezemisebenzi, nemali evela kuMphakathi Wezokudlala ukuze kuthuthukiswe imidlalo nokuzijabulisa ezindaweni ezazishiywe ngemuva kuhulumeni ophakeme kuzoba yindlela efanele yokwenza imidlalo ifinyeleleke kubantu abaningi baleli. Ibhodi Lezemidlalo Nokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) limi ngalezi zinto ezilandelayo, ezisekelwe kumgomo othi "siyenza isizwe sidlale." a) ukwandisa ukubamba iqhaza emicimbini yezemidlalo nokuzijabulisa b) ukukhuthaza umlando wezokudlala naphezu kwezinto eziphikisanayo c) ukwandisa amathuba okuphumelela emicimbini emikhulu d) ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezibalulekile emizamweni yokubhekana nezinto ezibalulekile zesizwe. Zonke izinto ezibalulekile zithatha indlela yokuguqula futhi le ncwadi ibhekana kahle nalolu work, njengoba singashintshi emsebenzini wethu ohlelweni lukamasipala. Ukwenza isizwe sidlale kuyisithako/umqondo walolu myalo ophakanyisiwe. Ukufeza le njongo kudinga imizamo nokuzinikela kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (NGOs), umkhakha ozimele, kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo ezibandakanyekayo ekwakheni isisekelo sesiko lokudlala nokuzijabulisa. Umthwalo wokwakha izikhungo nezindawo zokudlala nokuzijabulisa uthwalwe ezicathulweni zeBhodi Lezemidlalo Nokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika (SRSA) kanye neKomidi Lezemidlalo laseNingizimu Afrika (SASC). Ukungalingani phakathi kwemiphakathi ethola izinsiza ezinhle, evame ukuba emadolobheni, kanye nemiphakathi eshiywe, ikakhulukazi leyo emakhaya, kuyacaca. Intsha yaleli zwe kanye nenqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezokudlala nokuzijabulisa ibaluleke kakhulu. Kukhona isidingo sokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ithathe indawo yayo efanele emiphakathini yezemidlalo yomhlaba. Amafedereshini (IFs). Ngaphezu kwalokho, imiphumela yezepolitiki, yokuxhumana, nezomnotho, njengendima nomthelela wokubambisana kwamazwe, kanye nokuthengiswa kwemidlalo nokukhula komkhakha wezokuxhumana, akufanele kudlulelwe. Kwenziwe imizamo eminingi yokuchaza kahle imidlalo nokuzijabulisa. Nokho, ukuvumelana ngalokhu akukakafiki. Ngokwezinhloso zalo myalo ophakanyisiwe, incazelo elandelayo iyanele. IMIDLALO ingachazwa njengazo zonke izenzo ezidinga ukuzikhandla ngokomzimba, futhi labo abathatha ingxenye kufanele balandele indlela ethile noma engathile yokwenziwa kwayo, ngenhloso yokuzuza umnqobi noma umphumela ophumelelayo, noma ngenye indlela; noma ngenhloso yokuphumula, ukujabula, impilo yomzimba, ukukhula komoya, kanye nokuthuthukiswa. Nokho, mhlawumbe okubaluleke kakhulu, indima yemidlalo iwukuzama ukwakha ubunye besizwe. Umthelela wemidlalo nokuzijabulisa awuphephile kulabo abathatha ingxenye noma abahlanganyela. Uhlanga lwezempilo; imfundo; umnotho; ukuziphatha okungahambisani nokuphila kahle; ukwakha isizwe kanye nezokuxhumana zamazwe. Kulindeleke ukuthi iBhodi Lezemidlalo Nokuzijabulisa eNingizimu Afrika ihlinzeke ngezidingo zabantu bonke, isebenzisa inani lemali elilinganayo nalelo elalisebenzisa ngaphambili ukuhlinzeka ngama-20% abantu ngesikhathi kuhulumeni ophakeme. Nakuba indlela esibheka ngayo imidlalo nokuzijabulisa kufanele isekelwe ezimisweni nasekukholelweni kwaseNingizimu Afrika, isimo sezwe, imiphakathi yalo, umlando walo, ifa lalo, nenqubomgomo yezemidlalo nokuzijabulisa kumele kuhambisane nezehlakalo zomhlaba. Kutholakale ukuthi kukhona ukungazi kahle ngendima edlalwa yimidlalo nokuzijabulisa kuleli. Abaholi beqembu leHulumeni leCommonwealth ababeHarare bathole okulandelayo mayelana nomthelela wemidlalo emphakathini: Isikhathi sesifikile sokuthi indima ebalulekile edlalwa yimidlalo ekwakheni isizwe ivumelekile ngokuphelele. Imidlalo ingagcina. Okokuqala, zingagcina impilo, ukuphila isikhathi eside, kanye nokukhiqiza kwalezi zinsizwa noma zakha umsebenzi omuhle kubantu. Okwesibili, zingagcina ikusasa. Izinzuzo ezitholakala ekuphumeleleni zihlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemizwa, yokucabanga, kanye nokukhula komoya kubantu bonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abadlali abaphumelelayo baba izibonelo ezinhle zentsha yaleso sizwe, njengabantu abavelele, noma ngabe abavunyelwe kuhulumeni, futhi njengabantu abazinikela ekubambisaneni okulinganayo nokwamukelekayo. Izifo eziningi ezifana ne-hypertension zixhomeke ekwelashweni noma ekuzivocavoceni okufanele kulandelwe. Emazweni asathuthuka, kukhona ukholelwa ukuthi wonke i-rand echithwa emidlalweni nasekuzijabuliseni yehlisa izindleko zempilo ngama-rand amakhulu. Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi imidlalo ifaka ingane ngamakhono okuphila ngendlela engathathwa ngenye imisebenzi. Kukhona futhi ubufakazi bokuthi imfundo yomzimba iholela ekusebenzeni kahle ezifundweni. Njengoba zinefuthe elihle empilweni, imisebenzi yomzimba inefuthe elihle ezingeni lokukhiqiza. Ukwehla kwezinga lephutha emsebenzini kuhambisana nokuphila kahle, okuyingxenye ye-23% eholela ekulondolozeni izinsuku nezinsuku zomnyaka. Ngokuphikisana nesisho esithi uSathane uthola umsebenzi ezandleni ezingenalutho, leso sisho sithi ingane emidlalweni ingane engakaboshwa. Ukuziphatha njengomjolo kuhambisana nokuntuleka kokuzethemba, kanti impumelelo emidlalweni nokuzijabulisa kuthuthukisa ukuzethemba. Labo ababa izibonelo ezinhle emidlalweni baphakathi kwabo abavela ezwenikazi eziningi ezinecebo eliphumelelayo lemidlalo efana ne-rugby, ibhola, kanye nebhokisi, kuholela ekwehliseni izigameko zokucwasa ngokobuhlanga kuleli. Impumelelo emidlalweni ilethe ukuhlonishwa, noma eziz
Lo mbhalo uveza ukuthi umthetho weZihlahla Zasenyakatho Afrika ka-1998 uhlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okungaguquguquki nokuvikelwa kwezihlahla zaseNingizimu Afrika ngokuphathwa kokongiwa. Umthetho wokubusa kwenani elikhulu eNingizimu Afrika wavela ngesikhathi sokubusa kwenani elincane labamhlophe ngaphansi kwe-apartheid, futhi inqubo enzima yokufaka umthetho wokubusa kwenani elikhulu kanye nezinguquko iphinde yathinta izihlahla, lapho abantu abaningi abamnyama benqatshelwa izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izihlahla. Imithetho emisha yokulima izihlahla izama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bangafinyelela ezihlahleni ngenkathi kukhuthazwa ukusetshenziswa okungaguquguquki nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Isisekelo salokhu nguMthetho weZihlahla Zasenyakatho Afrika, ophawula izimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye okufanele zihlale zikhunjulwa lapho kuthathwa izinqumo ezithinta izihlahla. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zimiso eziyisishiyagalolunye njengemihlahlandlela, umthetho uhlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okungaguquguquki, ubuholi obubambisene, nokubambisana phakathi kwazo zonke izithakazelo. Nokho, izikhungo zomphakathi ezingeni lendawo azikaze zibe nezinguquko ezifanayo nezokupolitiki: okwamanje, inselelo wukufaka izinqubomgomo ezigxile esikhathini esizayo kanye nemithetho ezingeni lokuphatha lendawo. Ukhetho: Ngo-1994, ukhetho lokuqala lwezokhetho olukhululekile eNingizimu Afrika lukhuthaze uhulumeni omusha. NgoMashi 1995, ingqungquthela kazwelonke yabhala ingxenye yokuqala yomthetho ophakanyisiwe, owawusetshenziselwa ukuxoxisana nazo zonke izithakazelo. Ingxenye yokuqala yomthetho ophakanyisiwe yaba yisisekelo senqubomgomo esamukelwa ngokusemthethweni esikhishwe ngoDisemba 1997, ingxenye yesibili yomthetho ophakanyisiwe. Lokhu kwasetshenziselwa ukubhala uMthetho weZihlahla Zasenyakatho Afrika. Kusukela ngo-1998, ngosizo lukahulumeni wase-UK, uMnyango Wamanzi Nezihlahla ubebandakanyeka ekufakweni kwalo mthetho. Ingxenye 24 ibhala: "Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuba nendawo engalimazi impilo yabo noma inhlalakahle yabo, ukuze benze inzuzo ekusetshenzisweni okungaguquguquki kwezinsiza zemvelo, futhi ukuba nendawo evikelwe ukuze kube nezinzuzo zezizukulwane zamanje nezizayo ngokusebenzisa izinyathelo ezilungile zomthetho nezinye ezikhuthaza ukongiwa nokuvikela ukuthuthukiswa okungaguquguquki kwezinsiza zemvelo ngenkathi kukhuthazwa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho nokwenhlalo okungakhethi. Izihlahla zemvelo akufanele zilimale ngaphandle kokuba kube nezimo ezikhethekile, futhi ngokombono kaNgqongqoshe, ukusetshenziswa okuhlinzekwayo kwalelo thafa kungcono uma kubhekwa izinzuzo zomnotho, zenhlalo, nezemvelo. Indawo encane yezihlahla kufanele igcinwe. Khuthaza ukuvuselelwa kwazo nokuphila kwazo isikhathi eside. Gcina izinsiza zomlando futhi ukhuthaze amanani obuhle, isiko, nokukholelwa; kanye nokuphakamisa abantu noma imiphakathi ebhujiswe ngesikhathi se-apartheid. Umthetho ubeka ngqo izimiso zokuphatha izihlahla ngendlela eqhubekayo, okufanele zisetshenziswe kuzo zonke izinqumo ezithinta izihlahla, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngaphansi koMthetho weZihlahla Zasenyakatho Afrika noma eminye imithetho. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezihlahla okungaguquguquki kufanele kuhambisane noma kuhlanganiswe nokuvikelwa kwezihlahla nezihlahla. Abaphathi bezihlahla kanye nezikhulu zokulima izihlahla (ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezihlahla noma emaphakathini anjengezinhlelo zokongiwa) banesibopho sokufaka le nhlanganisela, besebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izindlela, nezindlela zikaMnyango. Akukhuthazwa ukususa noma ukuhlinzeka ngezihlahla kuzo zonke izihlahla zemvelo ngaphandle kwemvume. Izihlahla ezithile nezindawo zezimila zingamenyezelwa njengezindawo ezivikelwe. Isihlahla, noma iqembu lezihlahla, indawo yezihlahla, noma uhlobo lwezihlahla lungamenyezelwa njengezivikelwe. Amalungelo okusebenzisa, ukuphatha, nokulawula izihlahla zikahulumeni nemikhiqizo yazo akhona ezandleni zikaNgqongqoshe Wamanzi Nezihlahla. Nokho, ngokuhambisana nezidingo zokuthuthukiswa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe kwiMthethosisekelo, angavuma izinhlobo ezahlukene zokusetshenziswa ezimiswe kulomthetho: ngokuvuma, ukukhulula, (bona ibhokisi) amalungelo okusebenzisa, ukuqashwa, izivumelwano, nezivumelwano zeMiphakathi Yezihlahla. Ivumela imisebenzi efana nokudoba, ukwakha izakhiwo, noma ukulima. Ikhishwa ngaphansi kwezimo. Umthetho uyavuma ukuthi imiphakathi yasemaphandleni ixhomeke ezinsizeni ezitholakala ezihlahleni futhi ifuna ukukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza kwalabo abashiywe ngaphandle ngesikhathi se-apartheid kuzo zonke izinhlelo ezithinta izihlahla. UNgqongqoshe usebenzisile Ingxenye 24 ukukhulula amalungu emiphakathi eduze kwezihlahla zikahulumeni ekudingekeni kokuthola imvume uma beqoqa ukhuni noma ezinye izinsiza ezitholakala ezihlahleni ezifana nojamu, izithelo, utshani bokwakha, noma izitshalo zokwelapha zemindeni, ngokwenkolo noma ngokomoya. Akukho zindleko ezidingekayo. UNgqongqoshe angavuma ukuthengiswa kwemikhiqizo yezihlahla (njengojamu) noma eminye imikhiqizo (njengemithi) ethathwe ezihlahleni zikahulumeni ukuba ithengiswe kwabanye. Imiphakathi ingangena ezivumelwaneni noNgqongqoshe ukuze iphathise noma ibambisane noNgqongqoshe ekuphatheni izihlahla zikahulumeni. UNgqongqoshe angaqasha izihlahla zikahulumeni noma izingxenye zazo kunoma ubani. Umthetho unika noma ubani ilungelo elamukelekayo lokungena ezihlahleni zikahulumeni ngezizathu ezine ezingalimazi noma ezingaphuli: ukufundisa, ukuzijabulisa, ngokwenkolo, nokomoya. Ukwenza umthetho omusha kuyisinyathelo sokuqala engozini ende. Izimiso, izindlela, nezindlela kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe umthetho. Hlanganisa uhlelo oluzosetshenziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe inqubomgomo nomthetho. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni, abaphathi bezihlahla, kanye nezinye izithakazelo kufanele baqeqeshwe ukuze baqonde futhi bakwazi ukufaka umthetho omusha, izindlela, nezindlela futhi basebenzise ulwazi lwabo namakhono ngendlela efanele futhi elungile. Uma behlale benza imikhuba ekhona, kufanele bazame ukuhlela noma ukuhlanganisa ushintsho nalokho okusebenzayo.
Umkhakha Wamazwi Kazwelonke (NLS) ukhuthaza futhi uqhuba ukuxhumana ngezilimi ezahlukene. Njengengxenye yokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, i-NLS ilawula ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi emphakathini wethu futhi inesibopho sokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezilimi zethu kulolu suku, ngokusebenzisa lokho okukhuluma ngakho emthethweni ophakanyisiwe wokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi, kanye nazo zonke izilimi ezishiywe ngaphandle emlandweni waleli lizwe. Umsebenzi omkhulu we-NLS ukuhambisana nezidingo zomthethosisekelo ngokwenza kube lula, ukukhuthaza, nokuhlinzeka ngosizo lokuhumusha nokuhlela kuzo zonke izilimi ezamukelwe ngokomthetho, kanye nokuphatha ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ngokuhlela izilimi nezincazelo ezinhlelweni ezithile. I-NLS isebenza njengengxenye yoHulumeni bezazi zelizwi ngokuhumusha imibhalo ebhalwe ngolimi olulodwa olwamukelwe ngokomthetho iye kwezinye izilimi ezamukelwe ngokomthetho. Isevisi yayo yokuhumusha ihlinzeka ngosizo ekuthuthukiseni nasekuthuthukiseni izilimi ezamukelwe ngamagama obuchwepheshe. Umsebenzi wabo wokuhlela izilimi ubandakanya ukuhlinzeka ngeluleko kuhulumeni mayelana nokuthuthukisa umthetho wezilimi nezindlela zokuwusebenzisa. Umsebenzi omkhulu weMkhakha Wamazwi Kazwelonke (NLS) mayelana noHlelo lwezilimi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqonda okukhululekile nokuhlonipha zonke izilimi ezikhona lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Njengoba uhlelo lwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika lwenziwa ngesikhathi sokuguqulwa komphakathi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezishiywe ngaphandle kuzobekwa phambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa komthetho wezilimi ngokwakha amasu, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezizokwazi ukusiza ekufezeni lo msebenzi. Ukuqaliswa komthetho wezilimi kuhilela ukuhlinzeka (i) ukufinyelela nokuthonya (ii) nokukhuthaza ukuhlinzekwa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlola ukusetshenziswa komthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kwawo kubalulekile. Lo mkhakha weHlelo lwezilimi wasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1993 ukuze unikeze uHulumeni izeluleko mayelana nokuthuthukiswa nokuhlinzekwa komthetho wezilimi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 6 somthethosisekelo. Ukuveza nokufaka bonke abathintekayo kulolu hlelo kugcizelelwe. Umsebenzi omkhulu nokuqala walomkhakha kwakuwukuphatha inqubo ende yokusungula iBhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South Africa. Le nqubo yaqala ngonyaka ka-1994 ngengqungquthela yokubonisana kazwelonke ebizwa ngokuthi iNgqungquthela Yezilimi Zabo Bonke, kulandela uchungechunge lwezingxoxo nemiphakathi ezweni, okuholele ekubhaleni kweBill yeBhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South Africa ngonyaka ka-1995. Ibhodi Yezilimi ZasePan South Africa yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-1996. Umthetho wezilimi kanye nomqondo weNingizimu Afrika kwathuthukiswa ngokuhambisana neziphakamiso ezenziwe nguLangtag nezinye izingxoxo nezifundo ezithathwe. Ngomhlaka 1999, uNgqongqoshe wathumela ithimba lezinsizakusebenza ukuze liqedele umthetho wezilimi nomqondo weNingizimu Afrika, owawethulwa kubo bonke abathintekayo eNgqungqutheleni Yezilimi eyabanjwa ngoMashi 2000. Ngemva kweziphakamiso ezenziwe yilabo ababekhona eNgqungqutheleni, ithimba lezinsizakusebenza laphinde laphinde lathola umthetho wezilimi nomqondo weNingizimu Afrika. Ngemva kweziphakamiso lezi, kwenziwa ucwaningo olunzulu ezikhungweni zikamasipala nasemaphandleni ukuze kutholakale ubukhona bezinsiza zolimi. Okwamanje, inani lemali elidingekayo ukuze kuqaliswe umthetho ophakanyisiwe liyahlolwa, ngokubambisana neMali Kazwelonke. Le nqubo iyingxenye yokuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo ezisunguliwe kumthetho wezilimi ophakanyisiwe. Izithiyo zolimi zisathinta abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu, ekubeni bekhulumisana nohulumeni. Usizo lokuhumusha eNingizimu Afrika lungakwenza kube lula kubo bonke ukukhulumisana nezikhulu ngolimi lwabo, isibonelo, ezindaweni ezifana nezibhedlela, eziteshini zamaphoyisa, kanye namahhovisi kahulumeni. Lokhu kusizo kulindeleke ukuthi kuhlolwe ngonyaka ka-2000/2001 ezindaweni ezikhethiwe amahora angama-12 ngosuku, kusukela ngowe-07:00 ekuseni kuze kube ngu-19:00, ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngesonto. Lo msebenzi wenziwa ngokubambisana ne-PANSLAB ukuze kuqhutshwe ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlinzekwa kwezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Umqondo ohlelekile emkhakheni wezilimi zomdabu ubalulekile ukuze kuhlelwe kahle imizamo yokucwaninga ezweni lonke nokwakha amandla noma izinsiza zezilimi zonke zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ikhompiyutha yokuphatha yasungulwa ukuze ibhale umbhalo ozophakamisa inqubo engasetshenziswa ukusungula imboni ye-HLT ezothuthuka futhi ikhuthaze izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Kuqinisekiswa ukuthi bonke abantu bayazi ngamalungelo abo njengokubhalwe emthethweni mayelana nolimi; futhi ukuthi ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi kuyakhuthazwa ukuze abantu baseNingizimu Afrika babone ukuthi ukwazi izilimi eziningi kuyinzuzo. Umkhakha wokuqala walolu shintsho wagxila ekusebenzeni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi, kanti umkhakha wesibili wagxila emphakathini wonke. Umphumela walolu shintsho uhlanganisa amakhalenda ezilimi, amaposta, amabhroshwana ezilimi (anezibingelelo ngolimi lwezizathu eziyi-11), namavidiyo, kanye nokuhlinzekwa kolimi lwakho olukhuluma ezikhungweni. I-UNESCO okwamanje ilungiselela umbiko weZilimi Zomhlaba okukhuluma ngokuqonda ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi emhlabeni jikelele, ukufunda ngemvelaphi yezilimi kanye nesimo sazo samanje, nokuhlonza izinkinga ezithinta izindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-UNESCO ihlose ukuveza isidingo sokuphatha noma ukuhlela ubukhona bezilimi emhlabeni jikelele. Umkhakha Wamazwi Kazwelonke (NLS) wacelwa yi-UNESCO ukuba ibambe iqhaza ocwaningweni lokuqoqa ulwazi ukuze kudalwe umbiko ngazo zonke izilimi ezamukelwe ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kanye nezilimi zamaKhoisan kanye neNama. Njengoba ulwazi olunzulu ngalezi zilimi lwaludingeka kulolu cwaningo, imibuzo yathunyelwa kubachwepheshe bezilimi abaziwayo ukuze banikeze ulwazi. Ulwazi olunothile luqoqwe ezimkhakheni ezahlukene mayelana nezilimi eNingizimu Afrika, njengolwazi ngendawo, ukuhlukahluka, inani labantu abakhuluma ulimi oluthile, ulwazi ngokuqhuba, umnotho wempilo yomphakathi okhuluma ulimi oluthile, indlela okuthathwa ngayo noma ukuvunyelwa, imizamo yokuphatha umthetho wezilimi, kanye nezinhlelo ezihlobene nalolo limi nezindlela zokufunda nokubhala. Umbiko weZilimi Zomhlaba we-UNESCO uzokhishwa ngonyaka ka-2001 futhi uzophakamisa uchungechunge lweziphakamiso mayelana nokuvikela nokukhuthaza ubukhona bezilimi zomphakathi.
Umphakathi uyaziswa ukuthi uMongameli uvumile umthetho olandelayo owashicilelwa lapha ukuze wazise umphakathi wonke. Amagama akhanyisiwe ngokuqinile akhombisa izichibiyelo kumthetho osekhona. Lokhu kuhlobene nokukhishwa kwemiyalo mayelana nokuvikelwa kwabantu ezimeni zokuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya nezindaba ezihlobene. Ngokuhambisana nalokho okuphathwa yile mthetho, kubikwe ukuthi isimo sihlose ukugcina ukuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya kuphumelele. Amalungu omndeni angabandakanya ubudlelwano bokhokho, umshado, noma ukujola, kodwa akukho budlelwano uma bengakaze babe nobudlelwano obuqinile, bengahambisani, bengahlangani noma bengashadile, futhi bengahlangani ngokocansi; noma bangahlala ndawonye noma babe sebekhulile ndawonye. "Ukuhlukunyezwa" kusho ukulimala okuphindaphindiwe; "lo mthetho" ufaka phakathi imithetho. Uma kudingeka, kufanele kube nesaziso esiqukethe ulwazi mayelana nomlamli ngolimi olusemthethweni olukhethwe ngumlamli; futhi uma kudingeka, umlamli kufanele aziswe ngalezi zinhlinzeko, kuhlanganise nezixazululo ezingamsiza ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho kanye nelungelo lokufaka icala uma kudingeka. Amaphoyisa angabamba ngaphandle kwecala noma yimuphi ophendulayo endaweni lapho ukuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya kwenzeka khona noma lapho ophendulayo kuthiwa wenze isenzo noma icala elihlobene nokuhlukumezeka kwasekhaya kumlamli. Noma yimuphi umlamli angafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuthola i-oda lokuvikela ngendlela efanele. a ngosizo olukhona ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho; futhi b nelungelo lokukhala uma icala elibhalwe nguMlamli lenziwa. Naphezu kwemigomo yomthetho, noma ubani ongakwazi ukwenza ngokuzimela, noma ubani omele omunye ongakwazi ukwenza ngokuzimela, angafaka isicelo sokuthola i-oda lokuvikela enkantolo ngaphandle kosizo lwabazali, umgadi, noma omunye umuntu ogunyaziwe ukusiza lowo ongakwazi ukwenza ngokuzimela. Isicelo esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni-1 singafakwa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ngosuku olungahlangani nezinsuku zokusebenza zenkantolo, inqobo nje uma inkantolo ikholwa ukuthi umlamli angalimala uma lesi sicelo singaphathwa ngokuphuthumayo. Amafidi avunyelwe abantu abanolwazi ngalesi sihloko angangezwa kulolu sicelo. Isicelo namafidi angathunyelwa kumlobi wenkantolo, ozothumela konke lokhu enkantolo. Inkantolo kumele iphathe isicelo esithunyelwe kuyo ngokuphuthumayo uma ingakwenza lokho ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba-4 futhi ingase icabangele ubufakazi obengeziwe balesi simo uma ibona kufanelekile, kuhlanganise nobufakazi bukhuluma noma amafidi, azoba yingxenye yobufakazi ezosetshenziswa ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa enkantolo. a ophendulayo wenze icala noma ubambe iqhaza ekuhlukumezekeni kwasekhaya; futhi b kungase kube nokulimala kumlamli ngenxa yokuhlukumezeka kwale ndlela uma i-oda lokuvikela lingakhishwa ngokuphuthumayo, inkantolo kufanele, naphezu kokuthi ophendulayo akazange aziswe ngezindlela ezichazwe esigabeni-1, ikhiphe i-oda lokuvikela lesikhashana eliqondiswe ophendulayo ngendlela efanele. a i-oda lokuvikela lesikhashana elikhiphwe yinkantolo kufanele lathunyelwa ophendulayo ngendlela efanele futhi ophendulayo kufanele abuzwe ukuthi yiziphi izizathu ezingavimbela inkantolo ekukhisheni lelo oda. b Ikhophi yesicelo esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni-4 1 kanye nobufakazi obubhalwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- kufanele kunikezwe ophendulayo ngokuhambisana ne-oda lokuvikela lesikhashana elikhiphe yinkantolo. Uma inkantolo ingakhishi i-oda lokuvikela lesikhashana ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- inkantolo kufanele iyale umlobi wenkantolo ukuthi athumele ophendulayo ikhophi egunyaziwe yalolu sicelo nanoma yisiphi ubufakazi bama-affidavit asekelayo lolu sicelo, kuhlanganise nesaziso esiphakamisayo ophendulayo ukuthi anikeze izizathu zokuthi kungani engafanele athole i-oda lokuvikela lenkantolo eliqondiswe kumlamli. Izinsuku zokuphendula ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni-3 a no-4 akufanele zibe ngaphansi kwezinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kokuthi ophendulayo ethole i-oda lenkantolo; ngaphandle uma izinsuku zokuphendula ezikhuluma ngazo esigabeni-3 a zingalindelwa ophendulayo ngaphansi kwezinsuku ezingaphansi kwamashumi amabili nesine. a kufanele icabangele noma yisiphi ubufakazi obutholwe ngaphambilini ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba-5 1; futhi b kufanele futhi icabangele amafidi noma ubufakazi bukhuluma obuzoba yingxenye yenkqubo yokuhlolwa. a akumele abuze ngqo noma yimuphi umuntu obandakanyeka naye ngempela; futhi b uzobuza abafakazeli balesi simo ngokuhambisa imibuzo yabo enkantolo, futhi inkantolo izobuyisela umbuzo kubo. Inkantolo kufanele, ngemuva kokulalela icala njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni-2, ikhiphe i-oda lokuvikela ngendlela efanele uma ithola ukuthi ophendulayo wenze icala futhi ubambe iqhaza ekuhlukumezekeni kwasekhaya. a qinisekisa ukuthi i-oda yale ndlela ithunyelwa ophendulayo; futhi b yenze ikhophi egunyaziwe yale oda, kanye necebo lokubamba elikhuluma ngaso esigabeni -8 1 a, okufanele ithunyelwe kumlamli. Umlobi wenkantolo kufanele athumele ikhophi egunyaziwe ye-oda lokuvikela nanoma yisiphi isikhumbuzo sokubamba esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni -8 1 a emaphoyiseni athunyelwe nguMlamli. Ngokusho kwemigomo yesigaba-7 7, i-oda lokuvikela elikhiphwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yalesi sigaba lihlala lisebenza kuze kube sikhanselwa, futhi ukuhlinzekwa kwalesi sikhumbuzo ngeke kukhanselwe kuphela ngenxa yesicelo sokukhuluma. g ukuvimbela umlamli ophila noma owayephezu kwabo endaweni efanayo njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni -c ukuthi angangeni noma ahlale endlini abahlala kuyo noma kunoma iyiphi ingxenye yendlu abahlala kuyo; noma h ukwenza noma iyiphi enye into njengoba kuchazwe ku-oda lokuvikela. a ukuthatha kumphenduli noma iyiphi impahla noma impahla engcuphe njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 9; futhi b amaphoyisa kufanele ahambisane nomlamli endaweni ethile ukusiza ngezinhlelo zokubuyisa izinto zabo. Inkantolo ingalayisha ukuthi ophendulayo akhokhe izidingo, kodwa yenze lokhu ngokucabangela izidingo nezinsiza zezimali zomlamli kanye nophendulayo nokuthi leli oda linomthelela ekwenzeni isinqumo se-civil case enkantolo ye-magistrate. a ikheli lapho umlamli ehlala khona kufanele likhishwe ku-oda lokuvikela, ngaphandle uma okukhuluma ngakho ku-oda kudinga ukuthi ikheli lomlamli lifakwe. b inkantolo ingakhipha noma iyiphi i-oda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikheli lapho umlamli ehlala khona alikwazi ukuvezwa ngendlela engase ibangele impilo yomlamli. a ingavimbela ophendulayo ukuthi ahlangane nalowo mngane; noma b ilawule ukuxhumana ophendulayo nengane ukuze kube ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. i ukukhipha i-oda lokuvikela; noma ii ukuqinisekisa
Ngokwehlelo lokubuyisela ubulungiswa oluvimbela ubugebengu, izenzo ezinjalo zixazululwa ngohlelo lwendabuko lokwahlulela. Uma kutholakala ukuthi umsolwa unecala yinkantolo, abasolwa bahlawuliswa ngokubekwa ngaphansi kohlelo lokubhekwa kwiMnyango Wezokulungiswa, bathola isigwebo senhlawulo, bakhokhe inhlawulo, noma inhlanganisela yalezi zijeziso. IMnyango Wezokulungiswa iphinde yanquma ukusungula isu elaziwa ngokuthi iRestorative Justice njengomnikelo oyinhloko. Lolu hlelo lusekelwe ekuqondeni ukuthi ubugebengu kuyisenzo esiqondiswe kumvictim nasemphakathini, futhi luhloselwe ukubhekana nezinselelo ezikhona ngaphakathi kohlelo lobulungiswa. Aluhloselwe ukufaka esikhundleni sokwahlulela okuphikisanayo kumsolwa kodwa kunalokho ukuqinisa uhlelo lobulungiswa jikelele. Yini iRestorative Justice? NgokweMnyango Wezokulungiswa, iRestorative Justice ingachazwa njengesenzo esiqinisa umvictim noma abavictim abahluphekayo ngenxa yobugebengu. Lolu hlelo lugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuba nezindima zabavictim, imindeni, kanye nezakhamuzi zomphakathi ngokubenza babe yingxenye yenqubo yokwahlulela. Luhloselwe ukubamba abasolwa baphendule, ngenkathi bevumela ukuthi babhekane nalabo abalimazile futhi benze imizamo yokubabuyisela esimweni sabo sangaphambili, kuhlanganise nokubhekana nezindleko nezingozi ezitholakele. Lunikeza ithuba lokuxazulula, ukuxhumana, ukubonisana, nokuxazulula izinkinga okungaholela ekwelapheni, esimweni sokuphepha esingcono, futhi kukhuthaze indlela elula yokuhlanganisa labo ababephakathi kokuhlala ejele emiphakathini. IRestorative Justice igcizelela ukubaluleka kokuphakamisa indima yabavictim kanye nomphakathi ngokubenza babe yingxenye yenqubo yokwahlulela, ivumela abasolwa ukuba babhekane ngqo nalabo abalimazile futhi idala amathuba okuxhumana, ukuxhumana, nokuxazulula izinkinga. IRestorative Justice ihluke kakhulu kuhulumeni wokwahlulela. Ibuye ibe ubulungiswa obwenza umnikelo obalulekile futhi ibonelela ngethemba lesikhathi esizayo, hhayi kuphela ngalokho okudlulelwe. Lolu bulungiswa lugcizelela ukuthi yini okufanele ilapheke, yini okufanele ikhokhwe noma ibuyiselwe, nokuthi yini okufanele ibe isifundo uma ubugebengu bukhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lolu bulungiswa lubheka ukuthi yini okufanele iqinisiwe uma sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu akuphindi kwenzeke esikhathini esizayo. Ukuqinisa umphakathi ukuze kugwenywe ukulimala okwengeziwe. Ukubuyisela izimiso - umthelela wokunciphisa ubugebengu nokuphindaphinda, ukwandisa inani labantu abangena ezinhlelweni zokubuyiselwa, nokuphakamisa izinga lokubandakanywa komphakathi. Ukwamukelwa kanye nethemba okwakhiwe ngokwamukela amaphutha nezinyathelo zokuzithoba nokubuyisana. Ukwehla kwezinga lokwesaba. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinga lokuzwelana nokwamukela labo abasolwa. Yiziphi izinhlelo ezilindelekile ngaphansi kweRestorative Justice? Njengoba uhlelo lweRestorative Justice lugxile ekuqondeni ukuthi ubugebengu buholela ekulimazeni kwabavictim, emiphakathini, nasezikhumbuzweni, kuyiqiniso ukuthi zonke izingxenye ezithintekayo kufanele zifakwe lapho kubhekwa umthelela wobugebengu. Okulandelayo kubhekwa njengabathintekayo futhi kufanele babambe iqhaza: izinhlangano ezingekho ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo, izinhlangano zomphakathi, kanye nabazithandayo. Kukho izinkomba zokuthi iRestorative Justice iyanda emhlabeni jikelele. Izikhungo zikahulumeni ezihlanganisiwe zamukela uhlelo lweRestorative Justice. Ngo-1999, iKomidi Labaphathiswa leBhodi yeYurophu lamukela izincomo zokusebenzisa izixazululo zokubuyisela mayelana nezimo. IRestorative Justice Handbook for Victims yeZizwe Ezihlangene iyavuma ukuthi "ukwakheka kweRestorative Justice kuhilela umsolwa, umvictim, nomphakathi wonke emizameni yokwakha inqubo enomusa eqondiswe kumsolwa, ngenkathi ngesikhathi esifanayo ibheka umvictim." Ukubuyiselwa komvictim kuyisisekelo sohlelo lweRestorative Justice ezweni eliningi elithuthukayo. Izinyathelo zomthetho zinciphise izithiyo ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokubuyisela. Zikhuthaze izinyathelo zomthetho zokwenza izinhlelo zokubuyisela, ukunciphisa izinqubo, nokuhlela kahle izinhlelo zokubuyisela ngenkathi kuvikelwa amalungelo abavictim nezikhumbuzo. Inani lezinhlelo zokubuyisela emhlabeni jikelele liyanda. Kukhona ngaphezu kwe-500 yezinhlelo zokubuyisela eYurophu futhi ngaphezu kwe-300 eMelika. Ucwaningo ngezinhlelo zokubuyisela nezinto ezifanayo eCanada kuholele ekubhaliseni kwezinhlelo eziyi-100. Isu leRestorative Justice alikabi lisha lapha eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kukhona izimo lapho lezi zimiso seziye zafakwa ngendlela ethile. IKomidi elaziwa kakhulu leziNhlangano Zokwethembeka Nokubuyisana, elagxila kakhulu ezinhlekeleleni ezenziwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kwakuwumsebenzi weRestorative Justice. Kukhombisa isidingo sokuthi abavictim bakhulume ngezwi labo futhi bafune izixazululo ezimweni zabo njengabavictim. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenkathi kwethulwa ubufakazi bezinto abazihlangabezane nazo futhi kunikezwa ithuba lokulalela lokho abakubhalile labo abalimazile. IMnyango Yentuthuko Yomphakathi ihola uhlelo lokwakha amandla abavictim. Lolu hlelo luhloselwe ukuhlanganisa abavictim ohlelweni lobulungiswa. Isu leSizwe Lokuvimbela Ubugebengu lichaza njengokuthi "ukuphendula emthelelweni wobugebengu kubavictim." Nakuba leli isu lingahlanganyeli ngqo ekunciphiseni ubugebengu, umgomo walo omkhulu uwukulalela lokho abavictim abanokukhuluma. Kuyiqiniso elamukelwe ukuthi ukwakha amandla nokwengeza abavictim kunciphisa eminye imithelela, kukhuthaza ukubambisana nohulumeni, kubuyisela emuva ukuziphatha komphakathi, kuvimba abasolwa abangaba khona, futhi kukhuthaza ukwesekwa kohlelo lobulungiswa. Isu lokuphoqa abasolwa ukuba benze umsebenzi womphakathi liyaqhubeka nokwenziwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Umsebenzi womphakathi uyasiza futhi wenziwa emphakathini owathintekayo ngamalungu atholwe enecala lokwephula umthetho othile. Lesi sigwebo singafakwa kubasolwa nakubantu abathole isigwebo sokubhekwa ngensizakalo zokulungiswa. Ngemuva kwezinguquko kwiRestorative Justice Act ngo-1995, kwasungulwa ikomidi elihlanganisiwe labaphathiswa ukuze lilawule izinguquko ohlelweni lokubuyisela izingane nentsha eNingizimu Afrika. Ngesikhathi kudalwa uhlaka lwezombusazwe lokubuyiselwa kwezingane nentsha, ikomidi lancoma ukuthi: "indlela yokubhekana nengane ephikisana nomthetho kufanele ibe yinhlinzeko: ukuxazulula izingxabano ezikhona, ukuhlanganisa umndeni nomphakathi ekwenzeni izinqumo, ukwamukela nokubeka eceleni indima yomphakathi." Ukubhekana nokuziphatha kwabasolwa kuyindaba ejulile engakwazi ukuxazululwa ngokuphelele kuphela ngohlelo lweRestorative Justice. Ukuze kuphumelele ukulapha izilonda zobugebengu, kumele kube nohlelo olunikeza amathuba okuxazulula, ukuxhumana,
Inhloso yokubuyekeza umthetho ophathelene nekhwalithi yomoya ukuvikela, ukubuyisela, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika, kubhekwa isidingo sokuthuthukiswa okungaguquguquki; ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sezwe nezindinganiso zokwamukelwa kwezinga lekhwalithi yomoya, ukuphathwa, nokulawulwa kuyo yonke imikhakha yomphakathi; isisekelo esithile sokuzama ikhwalithi yomoya; nokubheka zonke izindaba ezihambelanayo ngalokhu. Izinyathelo zomthetho ezintsha nezicabangelayo zidingeka ukuvikela, ukubuyisela, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika. Noma iyiphi inqubomgomo ethathwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 46 noma 47; nezinye izinhlinzeko ezincane ezithathwe ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi. Kulesi sikhathi, igama noma isigaba esithathwe egameni noma isisho esichazwe esigabeni 1 sinezincazelo ezifanayo ngaphandle uma umongo ukhombisa incazelo ehlukile. Inhloso yalesi sikhathi ukuvikela, ukubuyisela, nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika, kubhekwa isidingo sokuthuthukiswa okungaguquguquki. a ngezinhlelo zomphakathi ezisebenza kulesi sikhathi, uhulumeni kufanele avikele, abuyisele, futhi athuthukise ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika; noma b uhulumeni kufanele asebenzise lesi sikhathi ukuze afinyelele empumelelweni yalezo zikhala. b kuzo zonke izenzo ezithinta ikhwalithi yomoya eNingizimu Afrika. a emikhakheni kahulumeni kazwelonke nendawo; kanye b emkhakheni kahulumeni wesifunda, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 146 seMthethosisekelo. b kufanele kuhumusheke futhi kusebenza ngokuhambisana nesisekelo esichazwe esigabeni 2 salesi sikhathi. e ukuphatha ulwazi lwekhwalithi yomoya. d kungashintshwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isisekelo sezwe noma noma yisiphi isichibiyelo kulesi sikhathi, uNgqongqoshe kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isigaba 4 asidingi ukusetshenziswa lapho kukhona isichibiyelo esincane esisekelweni. i mayelana nekhwalithi yemvelo yomoya, ehlanganiswe nenani elamukelekayo noma ukugxiliswa kwalezo zingxenye noma inhlanganisela yazo ezitholakala emoyeni; noma ii njengento eyakhiwe emoyeni lapho umthombo wayo waziwa noma endaweni lapho umthombo ungatholakali. mayelana nomsebenzi owenziwa yizifunda mayelana nokuhambisana nalesi sikhathi. v ngokuhambisana nezibopho zeNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwezivumelwano zomhlaba. i kanye nekhwalithi yemvelo yomoya, ehlanganiswe nenani elamukelekayo noma ukugxiliswa kwalezo zingxenye noma inhlanganisela yazo ezitholakala emoyeni; noma ii izingxenye ezakhiwe emoyeni ezivela endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda noma kunoma iyiphi indawo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Uma amazinga kazwelonke estabalwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7 ukuze kube nezingxenye ezithile noma inhlanganisela yezingxenye, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathe lesi sikhathi akakwazi ukushintsha lelo zinga kazwelonke ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqinile kulolo sifunda noma endaweni ethile ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba, isaziso singahlukanisa phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene ezibekwe ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, noma yisiphi isichibiyelo esenziwe esazisweni, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isigaba 4 asidingi ukusetshenziswa ezichibiyelweni ezincane esazisweni. b kungasungula amazinga endawo ahlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezinto ezivela endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda, ngezingxenye ezithile noma inhlanganisela yazo. Uma amazinga kazwelonke noma wesifunda estabalwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 noma 9 ukuze kube nezingxenye ezithile noma inhlanganisela yezingxenye, isifunda asikwazi ukushintsha lawo mazingas kazwelonke noma wesifunda ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqinile esifundeni. Ngaphambi kokuba isifunda sithathe umthetho wangaphakathi esifundeni esikhulunywa ngaso esigabeni 1, kufanele silandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana neSahluko 4 seMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi. a ezizokwenziwa ngokuqhathaniswa nekhwalithi yomoya ezizungezile, b ezizokwenziwa ngento eyakhiwe yindawo ngayinye ebonakalayo noma engabonakali. Ngosaziso kuGazethi, uNgqongqoshe angasungula iKomidi Lezokweluleka LeKhwalithi Yomoya Yezwe ukuze eluleka uNgqongqoshe ngokuqhathaniswa nokuphathwa kwalesi sikhathi. e noma iyiphi indaba ephathelene neKomidi. UNgqongqoshe kufanele aqoke isikhungo kwiSikhungo esizokwenza njengomphakathi ophathelene nekhwalithi yomoya lapho izokwenza ukuhlela izindaba ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwekhwalithi yomoya ezingeni likamasipala. UNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathe ikhwalithi yomoya esifundeni kufanele aqoke isikhungo kwiKhansela lesifunda esizokwenza ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi yomoya nokuhlela izindaba ezihlobene nekhwalithi yomoya esifundeni. Isifunda ngasinye kufanele siqoke isikhungo sekhwalithi yomoya esizokwenza umsebenzi wokuhlela izindaba zokuphathwa kwekhwalithi yomoya esifundeni. Isikhungo sekhwalithi yomoya kufanele senze imisebenzi noma sisebenzise amandla anikezwe ngaphansi kwalesi sikhathi. Isikhungo sekhwalithi yomoya singakwazi ukuhoxisa amandla noma imisebenzi ethile eshiwo esigabeni 4 kumuntu osebenza ehhovisi leso sikhungo, kuphela ngaphansi kwezimo nezimo ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 46. Izikhungo zeqhwalithi yomoya kufanele zihlele imisebenzi yazo ngendlela ethile eyinqunywe ngesikhungo sezwe noma nguNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 46. Isifunda ngasinye noma umnyango wesifunda ophathelene nokuthuthukiswa kwesakhiwo somthetho noma isu lokuphathwa kwemvelo ngaphansi kweSahluko 3 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezokuphila Kwendawo kufanele ifake njengengxenye yesu layo, uhlelo lokuphatha ikhwalithi yomoya. KuHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe olukhonjiswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 25 seMthetho Wezinhlelo Zomphakathi, isifunda ngasinye kufanele sifake isu lokuphatha ikhwalithi yomoya. c ngokuhambisana nanoma yisiphi esinye isimo esingase sikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi komthetho ophakanyisiwe esigabeni 46. d Imisebenzi yokuhlola ikhwalithi yomoya. b indawo idinga isenzo esithile sokuphatha ikhwalithi yomoya ukuze ilungise isimo esikhona. b indawo extends beyond the boundary of another province; or c indawo if falls under the province where that province has requested the Minister to declare that area as a priority area. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathe ikhwalithi yomoya esifundeni angabiza indawo ngaphakathi kwesifunda njenge ndawo ebalulekile.
