Thatha isinqumo sokuthi yiziphi izilwane ozothengisa nokuthi uzothengisa ngani. Ukuhlela lezi zilwane ngokuhlukanisa kuqondwa ngokweminyaka, isisindo, impilo, ukulimala, kanye nobulili. Umuntu osiza ngezokuthengisa angakusiza ukuhlukanisa lezi zilwane. Xhumana nomthengisi ukuze ubuze ngamanani nezindlela zokuthengisa. Nikeza ulwazi olufanele mayelana nekhwalithi nokuhlukaniswa, isimo sokuwela, isisindo, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, inani lemali lemfuyo yakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imfuyo yakho inophawu lokukhomba olusemthethweni. Hlela ukuhamba. Thola isitifiketi sokuhamba esivela kwiSigaba Sokweba Imfuyo sendawo. Ngaphandle kwalezi zimpapasho, ungase uthole isijeziso noma imfuyo yakho ingase ibanjwe. Gcwalisa ifomu lokwamukela ngegama lakho, ikheli, indawo, kanye nemininingwane yokukhomba imfuyo. Qonda ukuthi imfuyo yakho isekhaya lakho futhi unomthwalo wemfanelo ngayo. Ukuhweba kuphela uma uthi "ithengisiwe." Qedela inqubo yokuthengisa. Yenza isitatimende sokukhulula imfuyo futhi uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane ilungile. Ukukhokha kungaba ngemali noma ngecheki. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane ku-cheki ilungile. Indlela ephephile wukuthi imali yakho ibhange kwi-akhawunti yakho yasebhange. Umthengi udinga incwadi yokukhulula etholakala kwiSigaba Sokweba Imfuyo ukuze athwale imfuyo. Kuyaqondakala ukuya esigabeni ngaphambi kokuthengisa imfuyo yakho okokuqala. Noma hamba nomuntu oseke waya khona. Khuluma ngesilinganiso esifanele sesilwane ngaphambi kokuhamba uye esigabeni. Indawo yokuphawu lokukhomba olusemthethweni. I-tattoo ibekwe endlebeni yesobunxele noma yesokudla. Ukubhalwa kwenziwa enyameni yangemuva nasemahlombe.
Uma uhlela ukuthengisa izinkomo zakho emakethe, zibuze le mibuzo elandelayo: Kungani ngifuna ukuthengisa izinkomo zami kulobu sikhathi? Izilwane zikulungele ukuya emakethe futhi zikhulisiwe kahle ukuze zibe yizinkomo ezizokhishwa. Zineminyaka efanele yokuthengwa kulabo abafuna ukuzikhulisa ukuze zikhulise. Izilwane azikwazi ukukhiqiza inzuzo, ikakhulukazi uma zikhuluma ngezinkomo zokukhulisa ezindala ezingasakhiqizi. Akukho okukhulayo okukhona epulazini ukuze kudle izinkomo. Khetha umhlambi oneminyaka yokukhulisa bese uthengisa abanye ngaphambi kokuba babe bashaywe yizindleko eziphezulu zokugcina. Izinkomba zokuhlela zitholwa ngokulandela iminyaka, ukwanda kwesisindo, isimo, ukujolisa, kanye nobulili. Ungalindela kuphela intengo enhle yezilwane ezinempilo enhle, ikakhulukazi uma ziku-A nase-B, zingabi mncane kakhulu noma zibe zikhulu kakhulu futhi ziqondiswe kahle (zihlosiwe). I-AB inikeza inani lentengo eliphansi kanti i-C iyona ephansi kakhulu. Ukuze kulandelwe imithetho, isimo se-carcass yezilwane sihlolwe futhi sichaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwenyama nezinsika. Isimo sokuhlola senziwa ngokuhlola ukujolisa kwezinkomo. Ikhathalogi ibonwa ngokuhlola amazinyo. Ubulili bezilwane busemqoka kakhulu ezilwaneni zokukhulisa nasezicathulweni zezimvu ezikumaqembu eminyaka A, B, kanye ne-C. Ukuhlola: Ukuhlola iminyaka yezinkomo ngokuhlola amazinyo. Ikhathalogi B: Kusukela eminyakeni engu-2½ kuya kwengu-3 (kuhlonishwa ngokuba khona kwe-incisor nokuba namazinyo okwakha angu-3 kuya kwangu-6). Ikhathalogi C: Amazinyo abuhlungu futhi aphukile ezilwaneni ezindala.
Phakathi kwehlelo eliphelele lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo, uhulumeni uzohlinzeka ngosizo ezixhweni ezibuthakathaka ezingakwazi ukufinyelela ukudla okwanele nokunempilo ngenxa yobumpofu kanye nokwenyuka kwezindleko zokudla. Uhulumeni ubeke eceleni u-R1.2 billion eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Inani le-R400 million selivele labekwa ukuze lisetshenziswe ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2002/3, kanti u-R170 million usetshenziswe ukusiza abadinga usizo ezweni elizungezile. U-R230 million ubekwe eceleni ukuze kuzuze imindeni engama-200,000 ebuthakathaka ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo. Izikhwama zokudla zizohlukaniswa emakhaya angenayo imali naleso esingakwazi ukukhokhela ukudla okungafika ku-R200 ngenyanga. Le mikhankaso eqhubekayo ibonwa ngokuxoxisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlangano zokukholelwa, amaqembu ezabasebenzi, izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni, kanye nohulumeni uqobo. Inhloso enkulu yale hlelo wukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu bonke ngokwandisa amandla angaphakathi emindeni ebuthakathaka ukuze ibhekane nobumpofu nokuhlupheka, ukufinyelela ukudla okunempilo, nokuthola ukuvikelwa ezindlekweni zokudla eziphakeme. Usizo lokudla luzohlinzekwa ngokuhlinzeka ngezikhwama zokudla emakhaya abuthakathaka phakathi nezinyanga ezintathu. Ukuhlinzekwa kokuqala kwezithombo kuzohlinzekwa ukusiza le midlalo ikhulise ukudla kwabo futhi ithuthukise izimpilo zabo. Kuzohlinzekwa ukwesekwa kwemisebenzi yokwenza imali. Ukuqinisa umnikelo wohlelo lokudla ezikoleni. Ukubhalisela usizo lokudla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ukudla okunempilo okugcwele ama-vithamini namaminerali. Izingane, ikakhulukazi lezo eziyizikhonzi zemakhaya: amafutha nezinsizwa ezithintekile yi-HIV/AIDS nemindeni yazo zizothola kakhulu. Kwamanye amazwe, ezindaweni nasemakhaya, lezi zinsizakalo ezilandelayo zisebenzisana; uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, uMnyango Wezempilo, uMnyango Wezolimo, uMnyango Wezemfundo, iBhodi Yocwaningo Ngezokwakha Nezobuchwepheshe (CSIR), uMnyango Wezibalo eNingizimu Afrika, iNational Development Agency (NDA), kanye ne-Independent Development Trust (IDT). Izinhlangano ezahlukene zokukholelwa, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izinhlangano zabasebenzi, nezinkampani zisebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bathola ukuphepha kokudla. Imisebenzi eminingi ihlelwe ukuze kuqwashiswe ngohlelo lwezokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo kuyo yonke imiphakathi. Ubumpofu buyisitha esiyinhloko sabantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sisebenze ndawonye njengababusi bezombusazwe, abakhokheli bendabuko, izinhlangano zokukholelwa, amaqembu ezabasebenzi, imiphakathi, nezinkampani uma sifuna ukuphumelela. Ukuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwezingxenye ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze kufezwe impumelelo. Le Comprehensive Food and Nutrition Security Program ilethwa nguHulumeni.
Umkhandlu wendawo waseMatjhabeng kanye nezinkomiti zawo zendawo zinikeze ulwazi olubalulekile nemifundiso esekelwe kule bhukwana. Umxhumanisi wase-Australia uNkk. Pauline Peel usebenze ngokubambisana nomphakathi noMnu. George Moahloli ophakathi komkhandlu, kanye nomlobi womkhandlu uMnu. TV Matsepe, ezinyangeni eziyi-10 ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezinqubomgomo ezingathuthukisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ngezikomiti zendawo. Amalungu ezinkomiti zendawo nawo abambe iqhaza ekwakhiweni nokuqukethwe kwaleli bhukwana. Ngesikhathi sokuqala uhlelo olusha lukamasipala ngonyaka ka-2000, sakhombisa ukuthi lokhu bekuyisici esibalulekile sokuphatha futhi sikhuluma ngokuqondile nangokucacile ngokuqinisekisa ukuzibophezela kwesisekelo sezombusazwe, okungukuthi abantu bazobusa. Saxwayisa abantu bethu ukuthi ndawonye nohulumeni bendawo, sizoletha ubumbano endaweni ohlala kuyo. Embonini yethu yokuphatha endaweni, saphakanyiswa ukubhekana nalezi zinselele eziyisisekelo ezifana nokuthuthukiswa okunganele, ukungasebenzi, ukuhamba kancane, kanye nobuphofu. Izinkomiti ezisanda kusungulwa zomkhandlu zidlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Njengemikhakha yomphakathi kanye nezakhamizi, kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi umkhandlu uyazi ngezifiso, amakhono, nezinkinga zabantu. Futhi kufanele zakhe ibhuloho ngokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwekhansela nomphakathi abawumelwa. Umthetho wokuphatha wasekhaya unikeza ukusungulwa kwezinkomiti zendawo ezizoba yinxenye ehlanganisa abantu nohlelo lwethu lokuphatha. Izinkomiti zendawo zidlala indima ebalulekile ekubambeni nasekuqondeni uhlelo oluyisisekelo lomkhandlu, njengohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlangene, ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali zomkhandlu, kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu. Ngaphandle kwazo, uhlelo lwethu lokuphatha olwenziwa ngababambiqhaza kanye nokuthuthukiswa kukamasipala ngeke lubonakale njengomsebenzi obhekiswe kubantu. Izinkomiti zendawo zisetshenziswe ezindaweni ezingaphezu kwama-80%. Lezi zinkomiti zinezinga elihlukahlukene lokusebenza. Ngokuhlola amazinga okusebenza kwezinkomiti zendawo kanye nomsebenzi wokwakha ubulungiswa phakathi kwalabo abasala, sizokwandisa lokho okutholakala ezakhamizini ukuze sifikise nakakhulu kubantu bethu. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango esebenzayo, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zendawo. Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zomkhandlu uma lezi zinkomiti zisebenza kahle. Isinyathelo 17 Yini uHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlangene? Ukwethulwa kufanele kube neqhaza ezifundweni ezibalulekile ezifana nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokweseka nokwakha uhulumeni bendawo, kuhlanganise nezinkomiti zendawo. Lezi zinkomiti azisebenzi kuphela; zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuxhumana okufanele phakathi kwabantu nezikhungo zethu zokuphatha. Isici esibaluleke kakhulu kulokhu kuzodingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkomiti zendawo zihlangana njalo futhi zisebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe. Le bhukwana ihlinzeka ngemicabango esebenzayo, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zendawo. Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zomkhandlu uma lezi zinkomiti zisebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, le bhukwana izokwandisa ekubambeni iqhaza ezinqumweni ezithathwa ngababambiqhaza nomkhandlu. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngababambiqhaza kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zendawo ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe uma besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ngababambiqhaza kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zendawo ukuhlinzeka ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe uma besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi ezindabeni zikamasipala. Isixwayiso: Qiniseka njalo ukuthi ucabangela izinto eziphilayo zomkhandlu kanye nendawo yakho uma usebenzisa imibono neziphakamiso ezitholakala kule bhukwana. Ezinye zezinto eziphakanyisiwe zingadinga ukulungiswa noma ukuguqulwa ukuze ziqondise umongo othile womkhandlu wakho nendawo yakho. Nansi uhlu lokuhlola lokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe nokuthi yini esivele yenziwe mayelana nezici ezibalulekile zomthetho okufanele uqonde ukuze wazi ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze njengelungu lekomidi lendawo. Le mithetho nemihlahlandlela izosiza futhi uqonde izinhlobo zezinto ezinkomiti zendawo ezingazenza ukusiza imiphakathi kanye nabababambiqhaza bazo. Ukuze ukusize uqaphe lokho okufundile, sebenzisa amabhokisi ukuze umake lapho uqedile ukufunda. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 - Isahluko 7 Isigaba 152 - Imisebenzi yokuphatha yendawo. Isinqumo esithathwe umkhandlu wakho sokusungula uhlelo lwezinkomiti zendawo. Ihhovisi lakho lomlobi womkhandlu lingakuhlinzeka ngamakhophi wezimiso nemihlahlandlela yonke ekhishwe. Uma usuthole ikhophi yedokhumenti ngayinye, ungayifaka kule bhukwana. Inhloso yeKomidi lendawo ukuqinisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuphathweni kwendawo. Izinkomiti zendawo zingezinye zezimpendulo zokukhombisa ukukhathazeka ngezindaba zendawo kumkhandlu wendawo, ukuze kube nezwi ezinqumweni, ukuhlela, nasezenzweni ezithathwa ngummeli noma umkhandlu ezizothinta indawo. Umkhandlu wendawo ungumholi wekomidi lendawo, ngakho-ke ungumuntu obalulekile kule komidi. Umkhandlu umele izintshisekelo zendawo futhi unegunya elivela emkhandlweni lokudlala indima ekusekeleni umkhandlu wendawo kule ndawo. Izinkomiti zendawo zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwezindawo ezikhethiwe ezinqumweni ezithathwa emkhandleni, njengoba yibo abakwazi ukuxhumana nomkhandlu ngqo noma ngokuqondile njengabamele indawo abaxhasa iqembu lezombusazwe kufanele babambe iqhaza ezindabeni ezifana nenqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe, ukuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu, isabelomali sonyaka, imisebenzi yomkhandlu, nezinye izici ezibalulekile nezinhlelo njengoba zonke lezi zinto zithinta umphakathi wendawo ukuze babone futhi baqale imisebenzi eqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu endaweni ngenkathi besekela umkhandlu ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nezokusebenza zomkhandlu, nokubhekana nezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nezinsalela, amanzi, nokuhlanzeka, ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo njengoba amalungu azi imiphakathi yawo nezidingo zayo. Khumbula ukuthi umkhandlu wendawo kufanele abhalanse lokho okulindelekile endaweni yakhe nalokho okulindelekile ngohlelo lwakhe lwezombusazwe. Lokhu kwenza indima yabo ibalulekile. Kubalulekile ukwazi lokhu nokucacisa indima yomkhandlu ukuze ukwazi ukuza nomqondo omuhle wokukhombisa imibono yakho kule komidi. Uma indima yomkhandlu icacile, uzokwazi ukuvikela ukuncintisana nokuphikisana nalowo muntu kule ndawo. Umkhandlu ok
Ukhetho lokuqala lwezokhetho olukhululekile ezweni lethu lwenzeka ngoMsombuluko 27, 1994, futhi manje sesisondele emcimbini wokugubha iminyaka eyishumi yalolu suku. Ilungelo lokuphila emphakathini okhululekile lingathathwa kalula ngoba abaningi benu babancane kakhulu ngo-1994 futhi bazi kuphela okwenzeka ngesikhathi samanje. Ukulwa ukuze kube nokukhululeka kwezepolitiki nokulingana komphakathi, lapho kukhona indawo ngaphansi kwelanga kubo bonke abanye abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, kungakhathaliseki ubuzwe, ubulili, inkolo, ulimi, noma yimuphi omunye uphawu lokwehluka, akukaze kube lula. Akuthathanga izinyanga, iminyaka, noma ngisho neminyaka eyishumi ukufezekisa, kodwa okwenyani ukuthi kuthathe amahlandla amakhulu eminyakeni ahlanganisa umlando weNingizimu Afrika. Ilungelo kanye nenhlanhla yazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele kuqondwe ngokuqinile, futhi nina njengentsha yalesi sizwe ninamandla abalulekile okufanele nibambe. Ilungelo eliyisisekelo emphakathini okhululekile yilungelo lokuvota. Ilungelo lokuvota linika imvume yokuba yingxenye yenqubo ethatha isinqumo sokuthi iyiphi iqembu lezepolitiki noma amaqembu aphatha izwe. Ukhetho lwezokuphatha bendawo kuthinta ngqo nangaphandle izinqubomgomo nemithetho ephatha umphakathi wethu, okugcina kuthinta impilo yomuntu ngamunye wenu. Umuntu ngamunye kumele enze izinqumo ngokwakhe, izinqumo abenza ngesisekelo somphakathi abahlala kuwo - futhi ngokuvota kwabo ezikhethweni zokuphatha bendawo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, bangakwazi ukwakha uhlobo lomphakathi. Ukuze ukwazi ukuvota, kumele ubhaliswe njengomvoti. Bonke abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kweyi-16 abanedokhumenti yokuhlonza enebhakhodi bangafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengabavoti. Konly labo abaneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu ngosuku lokhetho bazofakwa ohlwini lwabavoti. Labo abasathola ngaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ngosuku lokhetho lwezokuphatha bendawo nolwezwe bazofakwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ohlwini lwabavoti ngosuku lwabo lokuzalwa lweminyaka engu-18. Lokhu kuzobavumela ukuba babambe iqhaza ezikhethweni ezizayo zamaphathi endawo njengoba zizokwenzeka ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi ngesikhathi sokhetho lwemiphakathi olujwayelekile luka-2005/6. Abanye benu bafuna ukuvota futhi bazi ukuthi iyiphi iqembu abafuna ukuyisekela. Lokhu kuyimfihlo yenu. Nokho, abaningi benu bangase bazizwe bengaqiniseki ngokuvota ngempela noma ukuthi bangavota kuphi. Lokhu kuyavuma uma ukhumbula ukuthi uzoba nesithunzi kulokhu kuphela uma ubhalisile njengomvoti. Ukuba umvoti obhalisile kuzokunika ithuba lokubamba iqhaza noma ungabambi iqhaza ekhethweni, kukushiya nezinye izinketho zokuthi iyiphi iqembu ozoyisekela. Futhi kumele uhlale ukhumbula ukuthi ungowodwa kuphela ozokwazi ukuthi iyiphi iqembu oyisekela - ukuvota kwakho kuyimfihlo ngempela. Intsha ibuza ukuthi ngabe ukuvota kwabo kubalulekile ngempela futhi ngabe kudala umehluko. Ngaphezu kokukwazi kwenu ukuwenza umthelela njengomvoti obhalisile, kumele kube sobala ukuthi noma uvota noma ungavoti. INingizimu Afrika inohlelo lokhetho olulinganiselwe. Lolu hlelo lokhetho, njengasezinye izindawo, lapho ophumelelayo ekhethweni ethatha konke. Uhlelo lwethu lunesisekelo lapho amaqembu amancane nalawo anokwesekwa okuncane athola ukumela ngokulandela ukwesekwa kwawo. Okufanele ukhumbule ukuthi ohlelweni nasekumeleleni, ukuvota kwakho akukhulisi kuphela ingxenye yokuvota kwabo bonke abavoti abavota iqembu olisekelayo, kodwa futhi kunciphisa ngokufanele ingxenye yazo zonke ezinye amaqembu abamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuyiqiniso lemathematics ongakuhlola ngempela nomthelela wentsha eyizigidi ezi-6 ezingaphansi kweminyaka engu-25 ezingaba nomthelela eziphumeleni zokhetho. Konke okukhuluma ngenhla kuncike ekubhaliseni kwakho njengomvoti. Ukubhaliswa kwakho kukunika amandla okwenza umthelela futhi kukwenza ufaneleke. Uma ungabhalisile njengomvoti, kubi ngoba ngeke ukwazi ukwenza umthelela futhi uzokwenza ungafaneleki ezinqubweni zethu zokhetho ezikhululekile. Nokho uvota nokuthi uzovota kanjani kuyisinqumo ongakwenza esikhathini esizayo, kodwa okwamanje, ungazithuthukisa ngokubhaliswa. Izinsuku zokubhaliswa zinguJanuwari 24 noJanuwari 25, 2004, futhi kumele ubhaliswe endaweni okukhona kuyo. Uyanxusa ukuba ukhuthaze amalungu omndeni wakho nabangane bakho ukuba babhalise ngaphambi kokuthi ukhetho kwenzeke.
Uhlaka lokuguqula ubuciko, isiko, kanye nezinsiza zomlando wezwe luboniswe kuMthetho Wokwenziwa KwezeMisebenzi, Isiko Nezinsiza Zomlando Wonyaka ka-1996. Umthwalo wokuphumeza lezi zinqubomgomo unikezwa uMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, owawuqala ukuwuphumeza ngoMgqibelo 1, 2002. Inhloso enkulu ukuhlela nokwandisa ibhajethi yobuciko nezamasiko ukuze kusizakale ngezidingo zobuciko nezamasiko kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwenhlangano nakho kubalulekile, futhi ekuqaleni, kubhekiswe ngqo ezikhungweni zokwenza ubuciko ezazincike kakhulu ekuxhasweni ngaphambili. Ubuciko nezamasiko kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuqedeni, ubunye, kanye nokubuyisana. Iqembu leMiphakathi Yezobuciko Nezamasiko lilungiselela ukweseka amasu ezikhungo zobuciko nezinhlangano zomphakathi. Zihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kobuciko kodwa futhi zidlala indima ebalulekile mayelana nezinselelo zomphakathi. Zifuna ukuxazulula izinkinga ezihlobene nokufakwa nokuhlanganiswa nokukhipha ukungalingani emkhakheni wobuciko nezamasiko ekunikezeni izinsiza. Inqubo edingekayo ifaka phakathi ukufaka amaqembu aphansi njengabakhubazekile, intsha, abesifazane, nezingane. Baphinde banikeze ukunakwa okukhethekile ezinkingeni zokuguqulwa kwemigomo ukuze kulethe ubulungiswa ekunikezeni izinsiza nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni. Izikhungo zobuciko nezamasiko, izikhungo zokuxhasa, nezikhungo zobuciko zomphakathi zithola izibonelelo zonyaka ukuze zifeze izinhlelo futhi zithuthukise ubuciko nezamasiko. Uhlanga lwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika lusekelwa ngokomthetho ukuze kuvikelwe amalungelo ezilimi nokukhuthaza izilimi zomdabu. Ngo-2003, ikhabhinethi yamukela uHlahlo-lwabiwo lwezilimi, oluhlanganisa isitatimende sezinqubomgomo, uhlelo lokuphumeza, kanye nenqubo yokuziphatha yezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi ezisemthethweni eziyi-11 futhi luqinisekisa ukulungiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphansi ngaphambili. Le nqubomgomo isebenza kuzo zonke izakhiwo zikamasipala, futhi iqhubeka nokukhuthaza inani lezilimi emibhalweni esemthethweni eyenziwe, okuzothuthukisa futhi kuqondise izinsizakalo zomphakathi kahle ngokusebenzisa imibhalo efanele yezilimi. Izifunda zizothuthukisa izinqubomgomo ngokusekelwe ezimweni zendawo. Izinqubomgomo zizokwethulwa kancane kancane. Ukusungulwa kweSouth African National Heritage Resources Centre njengomuntu ophakathi kwemithetho ngo-2002 kanye neNational Heritage Council ngo-2003 kwenze ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomlando wezwe kanye nokuguqulwa komkhakha kube yimpumelelo. Iphrojekthi eyinhloko kule ndawo yiMnyuziyamu kaAlbert Luthuli eKwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal. Ngo-1998, ikhabhinethi yamukela amaphrojekthi ayisishiyagalolunye okuqala okwakuhloswe ukuhlinzeka ngezinto ezithile zendaba yomlando wezwe, ukukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwesizwe, nokufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni ezokuvakasha. Kuze kube manje, amaphrojekthi ayisithupha aqalile, kuhlanganise neMnyuziyamu Yokukhumbula Abesifazane kanye neMnyuziyamu Yokukhumbula Ibhola LaseNgilandi eNingizimu Afrika. Umnyango uzobambisana nePhalamende ukuze ufune imvume yamaphrojekthi ayisishiyagalombili ezomlando wezwe. Ukuxhaswa okuvela ebhajethini ekhethekile elinikezwe izikhungo kuhlose ukuthuthukisa amathuba okuguqulwa ngokwandisa ububanzi bokuxhaswa kwezezimali ezikhungweni. Umnyango uqale uhlelo lwezinyathelo zokuqala ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2002/03 ukuze wandise ukufinyelela ezikhungweni ngokuthuthukisa izakhiwo zeminyuziyamu kanye nezinsiza. Ukugxila okukhulu kuzobekwa nasekuphathweni kwezinto eziqoqiwe kanye nokwenza ucwaningo ngempahla yomlando wezwe kuzo zonke izikhungo zomlando wezwe (iminyuziyamu nezinye izikhungo) ukuze kuzame ukunciphisa imisebenzi yokwephula umthetho, kuhlanganise nokuhweba kwamanye amazwe kanye nokukhwabanisa. I-National Archives and Records Services of South Africa ithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni imigomo yayo yokuphathwa kahle, ukuguqulwa, ukufinyelela ezidingweni zolwazi lomphakathi, nokukhuthaza ukubuyisana kwesizwe ngokuguqulwa kwezimpawu zomlando nezinye. Intuthuko yenziwe nohlelo lwezifunda lokuthatha izinsiza njengokugcina amarekhodi nezindawo zomlando. IWestern Cape okwamanje ikwi ndlela yokudlulisa lezi zindawo esifundazweni. Usizo ekuvikeleni impahla yeNepad nakho kubalulekile ohlwini lwezindaba ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho emithathu emisha yezwe isunguliwe. Omininistru basayine iSitatimende Sokugcina Amarekhodi Omhlaba, Ukuhlelwa Kwezimali, kanye Namalungelo Abantu avela emazweni ayishumi ase-Afrika abethulwe ukuze wamukelwe njengomsebenzi weNepad. NgoNovemba 2003, iNational Council for Library and Information Services (NCLIS) yasungulwa, nomhlangano wokuqala ubuhlelwe ngoMsombuluko 2004. Ochwepheshe bokwakha nokuklama banikezwe imisebenzi yokubheka ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo esisha sePretoria branch yeNational Library of South Africa ngoJanuwari 2004. I-Cultural Industries Growth Strategy ihlose ukuhweba amandla omnotho wobuciko, imisebenzi yezandla, umculo, ifilimu, ukuphrinta, kanye nezimboni zokuklama. Ukuxhaswa komnyango kuhilela ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano nokwakha izinto ezintsha nemiphakathi/abazimele, besebenzisa isiko njengensiza yokuvuselela idolobha kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlanganisa lezi zimboni. Kukhona ukugxila okukhulayo kumandla embonini ye-filimu. Ingxenye ekhethekile yokunciphisa ubuphofu ihlose ukufinyelela kubabazi bezandla kanye nabathengisi njengensiza yokuvuselela idolobha, ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemakhaya, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Amaphrojekthi enziwa ngokubambisana nohulumeni bezifunda nezindawo, kanye nohulumeni nezinhlangano ezingekho phansi. Imizamo yokuthuthukisa iWild Coast, Lebombo, kanye neMaputo Corridor izindawo ezibhekelele ukukhuthaza ezokuvakasha kwezamasiko okuhlobene nokwabiwa kwalokhu. Le mizamo izoqhubeka ngokunikeza imali kumaphrojekthi abizwa ngokuthi "Investing in Culture." "Investing in Culture" izozama ukuqhakambisa zonke izici ezihlobene nesiko ukuze kufezwe lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni "izindawo eziphilayo." Umnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko uxhasa ukuthi imiphakathi eminingi engekho emthethweni ngaphakathi kwemingcele yethu ingaba ngabaphathi bezinsiza, kuhlanganise nezidingo zemvelo nezabantu, impahla yamasiko, amakhono, nolwazi lwesiko, izinto zokwenziwa, nezamasiko angasiza ekuqedeni ukuguqulwa komphakathi kanye nomnotho. Imiphakathi yethu igcwele ulwazi lwesiko, amakhono, kanye nemiphumela yobuciko evela kubantu abanamakhono aphezulu abawathathile baphumelele emfundweni esemthethweni nasebucikweni. Umnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko
Hamba emgwaqweni. Uma kungekho umgwaqo, sebenzisa uhlangothi olufanele lomgwaqo kude nomgwaqo. Uma uhamba emgwaqweni, qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ohlangothini olufanele kude nomgwaqo, ngamagama amanye, ubheke ezimotweni ezisondela. Izimoto eziningi zihamba ngezikhathi ezahlukene emigwaqweni ehlukene, ngakho kubi kakhulu ukuba izingane zidlale emgwaqweni/ohlwini lomgwaqo. Uma ingane idlala emgwaqweni, umshayeli osondela angase angakwazi ukuhamba noma ukumisa ngokushesha. Lokhu kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Hamba njalo ubheke ezimotweni ozihlangabezana nazo ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezisondela ngesikhathi. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 azinakho ukukala ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze imoto ifike kuzo. Konlya cross emgwaqweni uma kuphephile ukwenza njalo. Ungagijimi. Ungacross emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezifihlekile ezifana nezikwele nezintaba ngoba kunzima kubashayeli ukubona ngesikhathi. Abahambi ngezinyawo abavunyelwe EMIGWQWENI ENGAMAKHANDA. Linda ibhasi/taxi ukuba ime ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuphuma. Linda ibhasi/taxi ukuba ihambe ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezivela kokubili ohlangothini lomgwaqo. Le bhasi/taxi ophumayo ingakushaya. Ungashaywa/ushaywe imoto edlula lapho ibhasi/taxi ophumayo likhona. Konlya cross uma uphakamisa isignali yomphakathi eluhlaza futhi kuphephile ukwenza njalo. Uma isignali yomphakathi ishintsha ivela eluhlaza iye kubomvu ngesikhathi uhamba, qhubeka ubheke emuva nasemaphakathini ukuze ubone izimoto ezisondela. Uma isibani somgwaqo esibomvu sishintsha sibe luhlaza, izimoto ezivela phambili nasezandleni nazo zinegunya lokuhamba manje. Qiniseka ukuthi abashayeli bakubona futhi bame ngaphambi kokuthi udlule. Umgwaqo uhlinzekwa ukuze usebenze wonke umuntu; ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhamba ngokushesha ukuze abashayeli baqhubeke. Ukuhamba emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezingekho ezibekwe kahle kuyingozi futhi kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Abashayeli balindele ukukubona ezindaweni ezibekwe kahle zokudlula: njengokudlula kwabantu okuhlinzekwe ngama-block, lapho kukhona izimpawu zokumisa noma izibani zomgwaqo, nokho, kufanele uhamba ngokushesha ukuze abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo baqhubeke. Lokhu kubizwa ngokwabelana ngomgwaqo nokuhlonipha abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Gwema ukusebenzisa umgwaqo ngemuva kokuphuza utshwala/nokwelapha ngoba kuthinta ukubona kwakho nokulinganisa, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, cross umgwaqo ngokushesha. Ukuhamba uphuzile kuyingozi njengokushayela uphuzile. Yini ukugcwalisa? Ukugcwalisa kuwukwenza komuntu onebhizinisi lokuhamba usebenzisa umgwaqo, umshayeli noma umgibeli, ukudlula umkhawulo wezimpahla ezisemthethweni zemoto, kungaba ngenhloso noma ngengozi. Ukugcwalisa nezimpahla ezingalungile kuholela ekufeni nasekukhathazekeni emigwaqweni yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo ofika kumamili ama-rand emigwaqweni nasezimotweni ezigcwele. Imoto egcwele ithatha isikhathi eside ukumisa uma kwenzeka ukuphuthuma. Uma ufuna ukuhamba ukuze ugweme ingozi, isikhathi sokwenza lokho sandele ngenxa yokugcwalisa. Kunzima ukulawula imoto egcwele futhi ngeke ukwazi ukwandisa kalula njengoba ungakwenza emoto ejwayelekile, okwenza kube yingozi ukudlula ezinye izimoto. Amathayi emoto egcwele afudumala futhi abe bushelelezi - lokhu kungabangela ukuthi amathayi aphuke. Ukugcwalisa kubangela ukuthi imoto yakho ibhujiswe, okwenza kube nzima kuwe ukubona izimbobo noma ezinye izithiyo emgwaqweni. Ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo emgwaqweni ngakho ungase ujeziswe kakhulu. Abantu abaningi bathuthwa emsebenzini noma ezindaweni ezahlukene behlezi ngemuva kwezithuthi nezivharo ezivulekile nsuku zonke - behlezi phezu kwezimpahla. Abanakho izikhwama zokuhlala, abanakho izihlalo nhlobo. Ngaphandle kokuthi lokhu kuthinta kakhulu inani eliphezulu lempilo nezingozi emigwaqweni yethu. Umthetho 247 uthi abantu bangathuthwa kuphela ngemuva kwemoto yezimpahla uma le ndawo abahamba kuyo ivikelwe ngezinto eziqinile ukuze ivimbele ukuwa kwabo. Abashayeli bezinhlaka nezithuthi bavame ukugcwalisa izimoto zabo. Sivame ukuzwa ezindabeni "I-taxi noma ibhasi elalilodwa eligcwele libe nengxabano". Kumele kube nesaziso ebhasini/taxi esikhombisa inani labagibeli abavunyelwe ukuhlala nokuma emotweni. Umshayeli othuthwa abantu nezimpahla kufanele ahlolwe ngalolo msebenzi futhi kufanele afundiswe ukuthi angashayela kanjani. Abashayeli kufanele basebenzise lesi saziso ukuze balahle imoto zabo. Ungayibona kanjani imoto egcwele? Ihamba kancane uma ihamba phezulu. Yini enye ongayibona ukuthi igcwele emotweni? Isimo sayo esiyisisekelo. Londoloza isikhathi: Akukho ukulibaziseka, ngokwesibonelo, uma ulayisha noma udayisa impahla. Izinkinga ze-inshurensi uma ubandakanyeka engxabanweni futhi kutholakala ukuthi imoto igcwele. Ukuhamba ngebhayisikili sekuphenduke umkhuba ophumelelayo nendlela yokuhamba eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abaningi bayajabulela ukuphumula okuvela ekugibeleni ezimpilweni zabo zansuku zonke. Kubantu abaningi, ibhayisikili iyindlela ehlukile yokuhamba kunemoto yokuhamba nsuku zonke. Ibhayisikili iyindlela yokuhamba njengemoto. Nokho, ibhayisikili ayifani nezinye izinhlobo zezimoto, ibhayisikili iphakathi kwamandla abantu. Unamalungelo, imithwalo, nemisebenzi efanayo nabanye abashayeli. Khumbula, abagibeli abavunyelwe emigwaqweni engamakhanda. Ngaphambi kokuhamba ngebhayisikili emgwaqweni womphakathi, kufanele uqonde imithetho eyisisekelo yomgwaqo futhi ube nekhono lokuhamba ngebhayisikili ngokuphepha emgwaqweni. Kufanele ulandele zonke izimpawu zomgwaqo nezimpawu zezimoto. Kufanele ube nesineke kubahambi ngezinyawo. Shiya ibanga eliphephile uma ulandela ezinye izimoto ukuze uvumele umshayeli ophakathi kwakho ukumisa ngokushesha uma kudingeka. Ungahambi ngebhayisikili ngendlela engalungile futhi engafanele. Bheka izimoto; yenza eye contact nabashayeli ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bakubona. Qaphela izinja ezingakuphosa. Lokhu kuyingozi ngoba izinja zingagijima ziye emgwaqweni ophumayo futhi zidalule ingozi. Qaphela ezindaweni ezithambile uma kunenhlanga enkulu noma uma kuqhubeka nokuna isikhathi eside. Gqoka i-helmet eyenzelwe ukuvikela ikhanda lakho uma kwenzeka ingozi. Gwema ukubheka ngqo ezibani ezikhanyayo zezimoto ezisondela, njengoba lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima ukubona ngesikhathi ebusuku. Ungahambi ngebhayisikili ngokumelene nomgwaqo. Umthetho ulindele ukuthi abahamba ngebhayisikili bahambe nomgwaqo. Akufanele bahambe ezihlahleni. Ungathwali abagibeli ngaphandle kokuthi ibhayisikili ikwaziwa ngenye isihlalo somgibeli. Ingabe ukuphuza kukhulu kahle kimi? Ngidinga ukususa ibhokisi lami lempendulo. Kubaluleke kangakanani ukuyeka ukuphuza? Kungani kufanele uyeke ukuphuza? Yini ekubambezela? Ingabe ufuna ukuyeka ukuphuza kodwa awazi ukuthi uqale kuphi? Uma kunjalo, le bhukwana izokusiza. Sizokusiza ukuthi uyeke ukuphuza unomphela - ngokuchaza ukuthi kwenzekani uma uyeka ukuphuza, nokuthi kungani kwenzeka, futhi sizophinde sichaze ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nezinkinga ongahlangabezana nazo. Usebenza ekungathinteni izigarette futhi. Ngabe ngabe ngiyesaba ukuyeka ukuphuza. Ngazitshela: "Nginepressure enkulu, ngiyesaba, angiboni ukuthi ngingakwenza kanjani. Konke kubonakala njengomthwalo omkhulu. Ngazama ukuyeka, futhi manje ngisazibuza ukuthi yini eyangikhathaza." (Umuntu ophuzayo izigarette ezingama-30 ngosuku iminyaka eyi-12). Abanye abantu bathola kulula ukuyeka ukuphuza. Abanye bathola kunzima kakhulu. Kodwa kubaningi, ukuyeka ukuphuza akuyona into elula noma engatholakali. Ngikhethe usuku futhi ngagcina kulolo suku. Ngazama izikhathi ezintathu. Ngagcina nginophakethe. Umngani wami kanye nami sanquma ukuyeka ndawonye. Ngizizwa ngijabule futhi ngikhululekile. Babesho ngama-40 million amaMelika abaye bayeka ukuphuza unomphela, ama-11 million amaBrithani, kanye nezinkulungwane lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Izinyathelo zalaba bantu zikhombisa ukuthi uma uzitshela ukuthi ufuna ukuyeka ukuphuza, kuyinto ongayenza. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokuyeka ukuphuza. Kukhona ithuba elihle lokuthi uzophila isikhathi eside futhi uvikele wena kokubuhlungu kanye nokuqhamuka kwezifo. Ukuqeda umkhuba wokuphuza kuzokwenza uzizwe ujabule ngokuba nguye. Nansi eminye yemisebenzi emihle yokuyeka ukuphuza. Beka phansi lezo ozicabangayo ukuthi zibalulekile kuwe. Cabanga nje ngempilo yakho, ungayeka ukuphuza futhi uphile kahle. Manje qeda lesi sitatimende ngokubhala phansi izizathu ezibalulekile zokuyeka ukuphuza. Nginqume ukuyeka ukuphuza ngoba... ENingizimu Afrika, izifo ezibangelwa ukuphuza zibulala abantu abangu-25,000 ngonyaka. Le nombolo ifana nokuhlasela kweJumbo jet nokubulala wonke umuntu ophakathi kwayo nsuku zonke. Kungani ukuphuza kuyingozi enkulu? Ngaphezu kwalokho, izingane ezizalwa kumama abaphuzayo zinekhono eliphezulu lokuzalwa zincane, zifile emhlabeni, noma zife ngaphambi kosuku lokuzalwa. Ngilahlekelwe yintombi yami yokuqala ngosuku olufanayo engiqala ukuphuza. Abaphuzi baqala ukuba nezinkinga lapho besendaweni yabo ye-30s ne-40s, kodwa futhi, umphuzi oneminyaka engu-18 akaphili kahle njengabalingani bakhe abangaphuzi. Umndeni nabangane bangase benze kahle uma uyeka ukuphuza. Izingane ezikhula ezindlini ezinezingane eziphuzayo zinekhono eliphezulu lokuthola i-asthma noma zifakwe esibhedlela ngenxa ye-pneumonia ne-bronchitis. Umvuzo wokuyeka ukuphuza ubona wena, umndeni wakho, nabangane bakho uma uqala ukuyeka ukuphuza. Umoya ophuma ezigarette ungumxube wezinto eziyi-4,500 eziyingozi. Ngezinye izikhathi ngihlala phambi kwesibuko ngibuka ngiziphuzisa lo moya onobuthi. Ngaphakathi kwamahora amabili, akukho nicotine esesimeni sakho. Ngaphakathi kwamahora ayisithupha, izinga lenhliziyo yakho lehla futhi ingcindezi yegazi iyancipha. Kungathatha izinsuku ezi-3 kuya kweziyi-30 ukuze ingcindezi yegazi ibuyisele ezingeni elijwayelekile. Phakathi kwamahora ayi-12 kuya kweziyi-24, i-carbon monoxide iyakhishwa emzimbeni wakho. Umsebenzi wezimpaphe uthuthuka. Awuzukuba nenkinga yokuphefumula uma wenza umsebenzi onzima, futhi ukuzimisela kwakho ukuyeka ukuphuza kuzothuthuka. Ezinsukwini ezimbalwa, uzothola uzizwa uhlanzekile futhi unuka kahle. Izithako zakho zokunambitha zizovuselelwa njengoba kuzothuthuka nomuzwa wakho wokunuka. Ungazizwa ujabule kakhulu ngokukwazi ukwenza okuthile obukholwa ukuthi awukwazi ukukwenza. Ezinsukwini ezimbalwa, umswakama ophumile emaphashini akho uzothola ukuqala ukuthamba, bese uzokhwehlela lokho ezinsukwini ezilandelayo. I-cilia, okuyisistimu yokuhlanza yomzimba, izoveza ukuthuthuka. Kungathatha izinyanga ezintathu ukuze uhlelo lwe-cilia luthuthuke ngokuphelele ukuze lungahlanza kahle izimpaphe. Ezinsukwini ezintathu, izimpaphe zakho zizosebenza kangcono. Kuzoba lula futhi ukwenza umthambo. Ngaphansi kwezinyanga ezimbili, kuzoba nokuthuthuka kokuhamba kwegazi ezindaweni ezahlukene zomzimba wakho. Uzoba namandla amaningi (uzozizwa ujabule futhi uzithokozisa). Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu, inqubo yokuhlanza izimpaphe zakho izosebenza ngokujwayelekile. Uma ungumuntu, i-sperm yakho izobuyela ejwayelekile futhi inani layo lizokhula. Kancane kancane, ukwakheka kwegazi lakho kuzobuyela ejwayelekile njengoba kuzobuyela nezicubu ezihlangene nezimpaphe zakho. Lokhu kungathatha isikhathi eside. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-12, ubungozi bezifo zenhliziyo buyehliswa ngempela uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abaqhubeka nokuphuza. Ngaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu, ubungozi be-cancer yezimpaphe buyehliswa ngempela. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyi-15, ubungozi bezifo zenhliziyo buphuma cishe buphuma njengalabo abangaphuzi. Ake sithathe lokhu "ukujabula." Ukuphuza kukwenza ukwehla, kukhathaza ithambo lakho, kushiya imivimbo ezandleni zakho, kudala imihuzuko, kunuka kabi, kuyingozi yomlilo, futhi ngemuva kokujabula kwakho, awutholi ukwaneliseka futhi udinga ukukwenza futhi. Ukuphuza kubonakala njengomkhuba omuhle, kodwa kuyabheda. Kuthatha isikhathi sakho, amandla akho, nemali yakho. Okubi kakhulu, kungathatha impilo yakho. Uhlobo luni lwesithandwa lokho? Iqiniso ukuthi u-pressure okhululiwe yi-cigarette kuyisifiso sokuthola enye i-cigarette. Kukhona izindlela ezingcono empilweni yokubhekana nengcindezi kunokuthembela ezigarette. Akukho umkhawulo weminyaka yokuyeka ukuphuza. Nokho, uma ungumuntu omdala, ubungozi bokuthola izifo ezibangelwa ukuphuza buyehla uma uyeka ukuphuza. Yebo, kuba ngcono uma uyeka ngokushesha. Futhi akukho umkhawulo weminyaka yokuyeka. Le possibility ingahluka. Ungathola usizo ngokwenza ucingo. Izeluleko kule bhukwana zisize izinkulungwane zabantu ukuthi bayeke ukuphuza. Funda eziphuthumayo zakho ukuze uphumelele kulokhu. Khetha usuku ozoyeka ukuphuza. (Ungazami ukuyeka, kodwa YEKELA UKUPHUZA). Khetha usuku olungakubekeli ingcindezi, kodwa ungasebenzisi lokho ukuthola izizathu zokulibazisa usuku ozoyeka ukuphuza. Beka usuku olungaphezu kwesonto ukuze ukwazi ukuzilungiselela ngengqondo. Amalungu omndeni, abangane, nabalingani bangaba usizo olukhulu kumuntu ofuna ukuyeka ukuphuza. Ngiyacela ungixolele uma ngikhombisa izimpawu zokwehla ezinsukwini ezimbalwa ngemuva kokuyeka ukuphuza. Okokuqala, umthengi kufanele athumele ukukhala uma enikezwa usizo. Uma enganeliseki ngendlela ukukhala kwakhe kukhishwe ngayo noma umphumela, angakhuphula ukukhala kwakhe kumphathi weposi. Thumela ukukhala kwakho ehhovisi lempathi yeposi kanye nawo wonke amadokhumenti. Abathengi/abasebenzisi bezinsizakalo zezimali bangathumela ukukhala kwabo ngefoni, ngefeksi, ngeposi, noma ngokukuthumela ngogesi. Iyiphi iposi noma inkampani ethutha amaphakheji? Ubani owakhuluma naye ephepheni? Uma kukhuluma ngokukhala okuhambisana nezicelo zokulandela nokutholakala kwephakheji noma into ebhalisiwe, nikeza inombolo yephakheji noma into ebhalisiwe. Umphathi weposi uhlose ukuthuthukisa usizo nokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngenkxaso ethembekile ebonakalayo kubo bonke abathengi. Umphathi weposi uyinxenye yoMnyango Wezokuxhumana. Umphathi weposi wasungulwa ngaphansi kweSigaba 3 soMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zeposi No. 124 ka-1998. Inhloso yokulawula umkhakha wezeposi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bathola izinsizakalo zezimali ezithembekile nezisezingeni. Umphathi weposi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo ezisemqoka zezimali zikhona kubo bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Phendula ukukhala kwabathengi mayelana nezokusebenza kweposi. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bezeposi bayahambisana noma bayavuma umthetho, kanye nemigomo nemibandela ye-licence kanye ne-sertifikat yesikhumbuzo. Faka isandla ekufezeni ngempumelelo nasekuzikhandleni ekufezeni imigomo yokusebenza yokusiza ngenkxaso ngenkathi ubhekana nezidingo zabantu kuzo zonke izigaba. Lungisa kokubili usizo lweposi olwalulawulwa nolungelulawulwa. Bheka futhi ugcine ukuhambisana nemigomo ye-licence kanye ne-sertifikat yokubhaliswa. Khuthaza intshisekelo yokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezimali mayelana nezimali, inqubekela phambili, nezinga lenkonzo. Khuthaza usizo olujwayelekile oluqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanayo kubo bonke abantu. Inkonzo embi. Ngokwakha amazinga enkonzo okukhuluma ngezikhala. Ukuhamba nokuphothula iposi. Ngokubuyekeza nokwakha kabusha izinsiza zezimali ngokususwa kwezinye izikhungo zezimali ezindaweni eziningi ezineposi ezithunyelwe ezindaweni ezingenayo noma ezincane. Ukulethwa kweziphakamiso ezindlini. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izindlu emkhandlwini zinikezwa izinombolo zokuthola iziphakamiso. Ukukhokha ngezikhwama zezimali. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izikhwama zezimali zithathwa njenge ndawo eyinhloko yokuthola iziphakamiso - azikhokhiwe. Indlela yokuthumela ukukhala. Ukulethwa kwesikhathi. Ukulibazisa ukuthumela, ngokwakha ivolumu yeziphakamiso okufanele iqoqwe ngosuku olwandulela lokuthi zithunyelwe kulabo okufanele bazithathe. Amaphakheji anesisindo esingaphezu kuka-30 kg. Ukuthumela iposi kuyisibopho somuntu othumelayo. Iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe umuntu ongasebenzi enkonzweni yokuthumela iziphakamiso. Yiziphi izimfanelo zomthengi? Ukuthola usizo oluyisisekelo lokuthumela iziphakamiso. Ilungelo lokuthola usizo olwakhiwe kahle nolufinyeleleka ngesikhathi. Ukuthembeka nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zezimali ngesikhathi. Ukutholakala kosizo nezinsiza ezifanele abantu abakhubazekile. Ilungelo lokuthumela ukukhala.
Inhloso yokubuyekeza umthetho ophathelene nezinga lomoya ukuvikela, ukuvuselela, nokuthuthukisa izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika, kubhekwa isidingo sokuthuthukiswa okungapheli; ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sezwe nezindinganiso zokwamukelwa kwezinga lomoya, ukuphathwa, nokulawulwa kuwo wonke amasekela kahulumeni; isisekelo esithile sokuzama ukuthuthukisa izinga lomoya; nokucabangela zonke izindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. Izinyathelo zomthetho ezintsha nezizayo zidingeka ukuvikela, ukuvuselela, nokuthuthukisa izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika. Noma iyiphi inqubomgomo eyenziwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 46 noma 47; nezinye izinhlinzeko ezincane ezenziwe ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Kulo mthetho, igama noma isigaba esithathwe egameni noma isigaba esichazwe esigabeni 1 sinezincazelo ezifanayo ngaphandle uma umongo ukhombisa incazelo ehlukile. Inhloso yalolu mthetho ukuvikela, ukuvuselela, nokuthuthukisa izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika, mayelana nesidingo sokuthuthukiswa okungapheli. Ngohulumeni osebenza ngalolu mthetho, uhulumeni kumele uvikele, uvuselele, futhi uthuthukise izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika; noma b uhulumeni kumele asebenzise lo mthetho ukuze afinyelele empumelelweni yalezo ziqu. b kuzo zonke izenzo ezithinta izinga lomoya eNingizimu Afrika. a emkhakheni kahulumeni kazwelonke nasezindaweni; futhi b emkhakheni kahulumeni wesifunda, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 146 seMthethosisekelo. b kumele kuhumusheke futhi kusebenze ngokuhambisana nesisekelo esichazwe esigabeni 2 salolu mthetho. e ukuphathwa kolwazi lwezinga lomoya. d kungashintshwa ngezikhathi ezithile. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isisekelo sezwe noma noma iyiphi inguquko esisekelweni, uNgqongqoshe kumele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isigaba 4 asidingi ukufakwa lapho kukhona inguquko encane esisekelweni. i mayelana nezinga lemoya lemvelo, lihlanganiswe nenani elamukelekayo noma ukugxiliswa kwalawo makhompiyutha noma inhlanganisela yawo atholakala emoyeni; noma ii njengento eyenziwe emoyeni lapho umthombo wayo waziwa noma esimweni lapho umthombo ungatholakali. mayelana nomsebenzi owenziwa ngamasipala mayelana nokuhambisana nalolu mthetho. v ngokuhambisana nezibopho zikaNingizimu Afrika ngaphansi kwezivumelwano zamazwe omhlaba. i kanye nezinga lemoya lemvelo, lihlanganiswe nenani elamukelekayo noma ukugxiliswa kwalawo makhompiyutha noma inhlanganisela yawo atholakala emoyeni; noma ii imikhakha eyenziwe emoyeni eqhamuka endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda noma noma iyiphi indawo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Uma amazinga kazwelonke esungulwa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7 sokwakha umkhakha othile noma inhlanganisela yemikhakha, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nalolu msebenzi akakwazi ukushintsha lowo mzila kazwelonke ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqinile kulelo sifunda noma endaweni ethile ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngokwalolu sigaba, isaziso singahlukanisa phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene ezisunguliwe ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, noma iyiphi inguquko eyenziwe esazisweni, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda kumele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Isigaba 4 asidingi ukufakwa ezinguqukweni ezincane esazisweni. b kungasungula amazinga endawo ahlobene nokukhiqizwa kwezinto ezivela endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda, kumkhakha ngamunye noma inhlanganisela yawo. Uma amazinga kazwelonke noma wesifunda esunguliwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 noma 9 sokwakha umkhakha othile noma inhlanganisela yemikhakha, isifunda asikwazi ukushintsha lawo mazigaba kazwelonke noma wesifunda ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqinile esifundeni. Ngaphambi kokuthi isifunda sithathe umthetho wangaphakathi esifundeni esikhuluma ngaso esigabeni 1, kumele silandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana neSahluko 4 seMthetho Wamasipala. a ezokwenziwa ngezinga lemoya elizungezile, b ezokwenziwa ngento eyenziwe yindawo ngayinye ebonakalayo noma engabonakali. Ngosaziso kuGazethi, uNgqongqoshe angasungula iKomidi Lezokweluleka Ngokuqhubeka Kwezinga Lomoya ukuze eluleka uNgqongqoshe mayelana nokuphathwa kwalolu mthetho. e noma iyiphi indaba ephathelene neKomidi. UNgqongqoshe kumele aqoke umphakathi eMnyangweni ozoba ngumqondisi wezinga lomoya kazwelonke lapho uzohlela khona izindaba ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwezinga lomoya ezingeni likahulumeni kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nezinga lomoya esifundeni kumele aqoke umphakathi kwiKhansela lesifunda elizophatha ukuphathwa kwezinga lomoya futhi uhlele izindaba ezihlobene nezinga lomoya esifundeni. Isifunda ngasinye kumele siqoke umphakathi wezinga lomoya ozophatha umsebenzi wokuhlela izindaba zokuphathwa kwezinga lomoya esifundeni. Umphakathi wezinga lomoya kumele wenze imisebenzi noma usebenzise amandla anikezwe wona ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho. Umphakathi wezinga lomoya ungadlulisa amandla noma imisebenzi ekhulumayo esigabeni 4 kumuntu osebenza ehhovisi lalo mphakathi, kuphela ngaphansi kwezimo nezimo ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe, ngokulandela isigaba 46. Amaphoyisa ezinga lomoya kumele ahlele imisebenzi yawo ngendlela ethile ethunyelwe ngesisekelo sezwe noma nguNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nesigaba 46. Isigaba ngasinye sokuphathwa kweMithetho Yezemvelo eNingizimu Afrika kumele sihlanganise njengengxenye yesu, uhlelo lokuphatha izinga lomoya. KuHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe olukhuluma ngaso esigabeni 25 seMthetho Wamasipala, isifunda ngasinye kumele sifake isu lokuphatha izinga lomoya. c ngokuhambisana nanoma yisiphi esinye isimo esingase sithathwe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphansi komthetho ophakanyisiwe esigabeni 46. d Imisebenzi yokuhlola izinga lomoya. b indawo idinga isenzo esithile sokuphatha izinga lomoya ukuze kulungiswe isimo esikhona. b indawo ibheke ngaphandle kwemingcele yesifunda esinye; noma c indawo ingaphansi kwesifunda lapho leso sifunda sicela uNgqongqoshe ukuba akhombise le ndawo njengendawo ebalulekile. Ngokwesigaba 1, uNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nezinga lomoya esifundeni angakhombisa indawo ngaphakathi kwesifunda njengendawo ebalulekile. UNgqongqoshe wesifunda ophathelene nezinga lomoya ezifundeni ezimbili noma ngaphezulu angakhetha ngesikhathi esisodwa ukukhombisa indawo ngaphakathi kwalawo masifunda njengemisebenzi ebalulekile. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngaphansi kwesigaba 1, uNgqongqoshe kazwelonke noma wesifunda kumele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngokuhambisana nezigaba 49 no-50. Ukukhombisa indawo njengendawo ebalulekile kumele kwenzi
Khetha izilwane ozothengisa nokuthi uzothengisa ngani. Ukuhlela lezi zilwane ngokuzihlukanisa kuncike eminyakeni, isisindo, ukujabulisa, ukulimala, kanye nobulili. Umuntu osiza ngezokuthengisa angakusiza ukuhlukanisa lezi zilwane. Xhumana nomthengisi ukuze ubuze ngamanani nezindlela zokuthengisa. Nikeza ulwazi olufanele mayelana nekhwalithi nokuhlukaniswa, isimo sokuw weighing, isisindo, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, inani lemali lezilwane zakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izilwane zakho zinephuzu lokuhlonza elisemthethweni. Hlela ukuhamba. Thola isitifiketi sokuhamba kwiMnyango Wokweba Izilwane Zomdabu. Ngaphandle kwalawa madokhumenti, ungakhokhiswa noma izilwane zakho zingathathwa. Gcwalisa ifomu lokwamukela ngegama lakho, ikheli, indawo, kanye nemininingwane yokuhlonza izilwane. Qonda ukuthi izilwane zakho zisekhaya futhi unomthwalo wemfanelo ngazo. Ukuhweba kuzoqedwa uma uthi "kuthengisiwe." Qedela inqubo yokuthengisa. Yenza isitatimende sokukhulula izilwane futhi uqinisekise ukuthi yonke imininingwane ilungile. Ukukhokha kungaba ngemali noma ngecheki. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane ku-cheki ilungile. Indlela ephephile wukuthi imali yakho ibhange kwi-akhawunti yakho yasebhange. Umthengi udinga incwadi yokukhululwa etholakala kwiMnyango Wokweba Izilwane ukuze ahambe nezilwane. Kuyaqondakala ukuvakashela emnyangweni ngaphambi kokuthengisa izilwane zakho okokuqala. Noma hamba nomuntu osevele eya lapho. Khuluma ngesilinganiso esifanele sezilwane ngaphambi kokuhamba emnyangweni. Indawo yokuhlonza esemthethweni. I-tattoo ibekwe endlebeni yesobunxele noma yesokudla. Ukubhalwa kwenziwa emlenzeni ongemuva nasemathangeni.
Uma uhlela ukuthengisa izinkomo zakho emakethe, zibuze lo mbuzo: Kungani ngifuna ukuthengisa izinkomo zami kulolu suku? Izilwane zilungile ukuhamba emakethe futhi zikhulisiwe kahle ukuze zihlabe. Zineminyaka efanele yokuthengwa yilabo abafuna ukuzikhulisa ukuze zihlabe. Izilwane azikwazi ukwenza inzuzo, ikakhulukazi uma zingama-nyama amadala okuzala angasakhiqizi. Akukho ukudla okukhona epulazini ukuze kudle izinkomo. Khetha umhlambi oneminyaka yokuzala bese uthengisa abanye ngaphambi kokuba babe sebekhulile kakhulu noma baphathe izindleko eziphezulu. Izinkomba zokuhlela zitholakala ngokulandela iminyaka, ukukhula kwesisindo, isimo, ukujolisa, kanye nobulili. Ungalindela kuphela intengo enhle yezilwane eziphilile, ikakhulukazi uma zisezigabeni A noB, zingabi mncane kakhulu noma zibe nkulu kakhulu futhi ziqondiswe kahle. I-AB inikeza inani lentengo eliphansi kanti i-C iyona ephansi kakhulu. Ngokulandela imithetho, isimo se-carcass yezilwane sihlolwe futhi sichaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwenyama namathambo. Isimo sokuhlola senziwa ngokuhlola ukujolisa kwezinkomo. Izigaba ziqukethwe ngokuhlola amazinyo. Ubulili bezilwane buwumqondo obalulekile ezilwaneni zokuzala nasemathanjeni ezinkomo ezisemazingeni AB, B, kanye ne-C. Ukuhlola: Ukuhlola iminyaka yezinkomo ngokuhlola amazinyo. Izigaba B: Kusukela eminyakeni engu-2½ kuya kwengu-3 (kuhlonishwa ngokuba khona kwemazinyo okukhanda nokuba namazinyo okukhanda angu-3 kuya kwangu-6). Izigaba C: Amazinyo aphukile futhi aphukile ezilwaneni ezindala.
Ngaphansi kwehlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo, uhulumeni uzohlinzeka ngosizo ezixukwini ezithintekayo ezingakwazi ukufinyelela ukudla okwanele nokunempilo ngenxa yobuphofu nokwenyuka kwamanani okudla. Uhulumeni ubeke imali engu-R1.2 billion eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Imali engu-R400 million isivele yabelwe unyaka wezezimali ka-2002/3, lapho u-R170 million usetshenzisiwe ukusiza abadinga usizo ezweni elizungezile. U-R230 million ubekwe eceleni ukuze kusebenze imindeni engama-200,000 ethintekayo ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo. Izikhwama zokudla zizophakanyiswa emakhaya angenayo imali nokuthi lawo angakwazi ukukhokhela ukudla okungafika ku-R200 ngenyanga. Le mikhankaso eqhubekayo ibonwa ngokuxoxisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlangano zenkolo, amaqembu emisebenzi, izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni, kanye nohulumeni uqobo. Inhloso enkulu yale hlelo ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu bonke ngokwandisa amakhono angaphakathi emindenini ethintekayo ukuze ibhekane nobumpofu nokungabi nokudla, ukufinyelela ukudla okunempilo, nokuthola ukuvikelwa ezindleleni eziphakeme zokudla. Usizo lokudla luzohlinzekwa ngokusabalalisa izikhwama zokudla emakhaya athintekayo phakathi nezinyanga ezintathu. Ukwabelana kwezimpande kuzohlinzekwa ukusiza le mideni ikhulise ukudla kwabo futhi ithuthukise izimpilo zayo. Kuzohlinzekwa ukwesekwa kwemisebenzi yokwenza imali. Ukuqinisa umnikelo weHlelo Lokudla Esikoleni. Ukuze ubhalise ukuze uthole usizo lokudla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ukudla okunempilo okunothile ngamavithamini nezimayini. Izingane, ikakhulukazi ezikhokhelayo emakhaya: amajazi nezinsizwa ezithintekayo yi-HIV/AIDS nemindeni yazo zizothola kakhulu. Kwamanye amazwe, ezindaweni nasemakhaya, lezi zinsiza zisebenzisana; uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, uMnyango Wezempilo, uMnyango Wezolimo, uMnyango Wezemfundo, iKhansela Lokucwaninga Ngezobuchwepheshe Nezimboni (CSIR), uMnyango Wezibalo eNingizimu Afrika, iNational Development Agency (NDA), kanye ne-Independent Development Trust (IDT). Izinhlangano ezahlukene zenkolo, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izinhlangano zomsebenzi, nezinkampani zisebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bathola ukuphepha kokudla. Imisebenzi eminingi ihlelwe ukuze kwandiswe ukuqwashisa ngehlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo kuzo zonke izifunda. Ubuphofu buyisitha esiyinhloko sabantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sisebenze ndawonye njengabaholi bezepolitiki, abaholi bendabuko, izinhlangano zenkolo, amaqembu emisebenzi, imiphakathi, nezinkampani uma sifuna ukuphumelela. Ukuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwezimboni ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze siphumelele. Le hlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo lwenziwa nguHULUMENI.
Umkhandlu wendawo weMatjhabeng kanye nezinkomiti zawo zezakhamuzi ziye zanikela ngemininingwane ebalulekile nezifundo eziyisisekelo le bhukwana elakhiwe ngazo. Umxhumanisi wase-Australia uNkk. Pauline Peel usebenze ngokubambisana nomphakathi nomphakathi uMnu. George Moahloli ophuma kumkhandlu, kanye nomkhulumeli wombuso uMnu. TV Matsepe, iminyaka eyishumi ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezimiso ezingathuthukisa ukuzibandakanya komphakathi ngezikomiti zezakhamuzi. Amalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi uqobo nawo abambe iqhaza ekuqulweni naku ukuthuthukiswa kwaleli bhukwana. Ngesikhathi sokuqala uhlelo olusha lukamasipala ngo-2000, sakhombisa ukuthi lokhu kwakuyisici esibalulekile sokuphatha futhi sikhona ukuze sinikeze incazelo ecacile nephumelelayo yokuzibophezela esisekelweni sezepolitiki, okungukuthi, abantu bazokhulumela. Sabatshela abantu bethu ukuthi ndawonye nohulumeni bendawo, sizoletha ubuhlakani lapho uhlala khona. Embonini yethu yokuhulumeni bendawo, saphakanyiswa ukubhekana nalezi zinkinga ezisemqoka ezifana nokuthuthukiswa okunganele, ukungasebenzi, ukuhamba kancane, kanye nobuphofu. Izinkomiti ezisunguliwe zomkhandlu zidlala indima ebalulekile ekufezeni lezi zinhloso ezishiwo ngenhla. Njengemikhakha yomphakathi kanye nezakhamuzi, kumele zixwayise umkhandlu ngezifiso, amakhono, nezinkinga zabantu. Kumele futhi zakhe umgwaqo ngokwenza kube lula ukuxhumana phakathi kwecouncil nomphakathi abawumelwa. Umthetho wombuso wendawo unikeza ukusungulwa kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ezizoba yinxenye ehlanganisa abantu nohlelo lwethu lokuphatha. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zidlala indima ebalulekile ekubambeni nasekuthatheni izinqumo ezisemqoka zomkhandlu, njengeHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe, ukusatshalaliswa kwezimali zomkhandlu, kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu. Ngaphandle kwazo, uhlelo lwethu lokuphatha ngokobuhlakani kanye nokuthuthukiswa kukamasipala ngeke lube nomthelela wokubheka abantu. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi seziqhamuke ezindaweni ezingaphezu kuka-80% zezakhamuzi. Lezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi zinekhono elihlukene lokusebenza. Ngokuhlola amazinga okusebenza kwalezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi kanye nomsebenzi wokwakha ubulungiswa phakathi kwalabo abasala, sizokwandisa lokho okutholakalayo kubahlali ukuze sifikise nakakhulu kubantu bethu. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuhlinzeka ngamasu anembile, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zezinkantolo uma lezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi zisebenza kahle. Isinyathelo 17 Yini iHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Okuhlanganisiwe? Ukwethulwa kufanele kube nokuqhubeka ngezindaba ezibalulekile ezifana nokuthuthukisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zokuxhasa kanye nokuqinisa uhulumeni bendawo, kuhlanganise nezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Lezi zinkomiti azikona nje amalungu abasebenzi; zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuxhumana okufanele phakathi kwabantu nezikhungo zethu zohulumeni. Isici esibaluleke kakhulu kulokhu kuzodingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zihlangana njalo futhi zisebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe. Le bhukwana ihlinzeka ngamasu anembile, imibono ecacile, kanye nosizo ekulethweni kwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Imiphakathi izokwazi ukubamba iqhaza kakhulu ezinqumweni zezinkantolo uma lezi zinkomiti zezakhamuzi zisebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, le bhukwana izokwandisa ekugqugquzeleni ukubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni ezithathwa ngababusi nezomkhandlu. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngababusi kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe lapho besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Le bhukwana yakhelwe ngababusi kanye namalungu ezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuhlinzeka ngochungechunge lwezinyathelo okufanele bazithathe lapho besebenza ezindaweni zabo. Ukuze kugqugquzelwe ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi ezindabeni zikamasipala. Isixwayiso: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlola izinto ezisemqoka zomkhandlu nendawo yakho uma usebenzisa imibono neziphakamiso ezitholakala kule bhukwana. Ezinye zezinto eziphakanyisiwe zingase zidinge ukulungiswa noma ukuguqulwa ukuze zihlangabezane nesimo esithile somkhandlu wakho nendawo yakho. Nansi uhlu lokuhlola lokuthi yini okufanele yenziwe nokuthi yini esivele yenziwe mayelana nezinto ezibalulekile zomthetho okufanele uqonde ukuze wazi ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze njengomuntu osemkhandlwini. Le mithetho nemiyalelo izosiza futhi uqonde izinhlobo zezinto ezizokwenziwa izinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuze zisekele imiphakathi kanye nababusi bazo. Ukuze ukusiza ukuba ulandele lokho okufundile, sebenzisa amabhokisi ukuze umake lapho usuphelile ukufunda. Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 - Isahluko 7 Ingxenye 152 - Imisebenzi yokuphatha kwendawo. Isinqumo esithathwe umkhandlu wakho sokusungula uhlelo lwezinkomiti zezakhamuzi. Ihhovisi lakho lokukhulumela umkhandlu lingakuhlinzeka ngama kopi wonke wemithetho nemiyalelo ephumile. Uma usuthole ikhophi yedokhumenti ngayinye, ungayifaka kule bhukwana. Inhloso yezinkomiti zezakhamuzi ukuqinisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuphathweni kukamasipala. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi ziyi ndlela yokukhombisa ukukhathazeka ngezindaba zomphakathi kumabusi wezindawo, ukuze kube nevozhi ezinqumweni, ukuhlela, nasezenzweni ezithathwa ngumbusi noma umkhandlu ezizothinta indawo. Umphakathi wezindawo ungumholi wezinkomiti zezakhamuzi, ngakho-ke ungumuntu obalulekile kule komidi. Umphakathi umela izintshisekelo zendawo futhi unegunya elivela kumkhandlu lokudlala indima ekusekeleni umphakathi wezindawo kule ndawo. Izinkomiti zezakhamuzi zenzelwe ukwenza kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwabahlali bendawo ezinqumweni ezithathwa kumkhandlu, njengoba bengabo abakwazi ukuxhumana nekhansela ngqo noma ngokuqondile njengabamele indawo bendawo abaxhasa iqembu lezepolitiki kumele babambe iqhaza ezindabeni ezifana nenqubo yokuhlela ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisiwe, ukuphathwa kokusebenza komkhandlu, isabelomali sonyaka, imisebenzi yephalamende, nezinye izisebenzi ezibalulekile nezinhlelo njengoba zonke lezi zinto zithinta umphakathi ukuze ubone futhi uqale imisebenzi eqondiswe ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu endaweni ngenkathi usekela umphakathi ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nokusebenza komkhandlu, nokubhekana nezinkinga zomphakathi ezifana nezinsalela, amanzi, nokuhlanzeka, ukukhokha ngezinsizakalo njengoba amalungu azi imiphakathi yabo nezidingo zayo. Khumbula ukuthi umphakathi wezindawo kumele abheke lokho okulindelwe yindawo yabo kanye nokuthi kulindelwe yinhla yabo yezepolitiki. Lokhu kwenza indima yabo ibaluleke kakhulu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda lokhu futhi ucacise indima yomphakathi ukuze ukwazi ukuza nemibono emihle yokukh
Ukhetho lokuqala lwezokhetho olukhululekile ezweni lethu lwenzeka ngomhla ziyi-27 kuMbasa, ngonyaka ka-1994, futhi manje sesiseduze nokugubha iminyaka eyishumi yalolu suku. Ilungelo lokuphila emphakathini okhululekile lingathathwa kalula ngoba abaningi benu babancane ngo-1994 futhi bazi kuphela okwenzeka ngesikhathi samanje. Ukulwa ukuze kube nokukhululeka nokulingana komphakathi, lapho kukhona isikhala phansi kwelanga kubo bonke abanye abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, kungakhathaliseki ubuzwe, ubulili, inkolo, ulimi, noma yimuphi omunye umehluko, akuzange kube lula. Akuthathanga izinyanga, iminyaka, noma ngisho neminyaka eyishumi ukufezekisa, kodwa okungukuthi, kuthathe amahlandla amakhulu eminyaka ahlanganisa umlando weNingizimu Afrika. Ilungelo kanye nenhlanhla yazo zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika okufanele ikwaziwa ngokuqinile, futhi nina njengentsha yalesi sizwe ninamandla abalulekile okumele nibambe. Ilungelo eliyisisekelo emphakathini okhululekile yilungelo lokuvota. Ilungelo lokuvota linika imvume yokuba yingxenye yenqubo ethatha isinqumo sokuthi iyiphi iphathi yezenkolo noma amaphathi aphatha izwe. Ukhetho lwezokuphatha bendawo kuthinta ngqo nangokungaqondile izinqubomgomo nemithetho ephatha umphakathi wethu, okugcina kuthinta impilo yomuntu ngamunye. Umuntu ngamunye kumele enze izinqumo ngokwakhe, izinqumo ezenziwa ngesisekelo somphakathi abahlala kuwo - futhi ngokuvota kwabo ezikhethweni zokuphatha bendawo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, bangashintsha uhlobo lomphakathi. Ukuze ukwazi ukuvota, kumele ubhaliswe njengomvoti. Bonke abantu abaneminyaka engaphezu kwengu-16 abanencwadi yokuhlonza enebhakhodi bangafaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengabavoti. Kulabo abaneminyaka engu-18 noma ngaphezulu ngosuku lokhetho bazofakwa ohlwini lwabavoti. Abasasele ngaphansi kweminyaka engu-18 ngosuku lokhetho lwezindawo nezwe bazofakwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ohlwini lwabavoti ngosuku lwabo lokuzalwa lwe-18. Lokhu kuzobavumela ukuba babambe iqhaza ezikhethweni ezizayo zamaphathi omasipala njengoba kuzokwenzeka ngesikhathi esihlelwe futhi ngesikhathi sokhetho olujwayelekile lwamasipala lwango-2005/6. Abanye benu banelisa ukuvota futhi bayazi ukuthi iyiphi iphathi enizimisele ukuyisekela. Lokhu kuyimfihlo yenu. Nokho, abaningi benu bangase bazizwe bengaqiniseki ngokuvota ngempela noma ukuthi bangavota ngubani. Lokhu kuyavuma uma ukhumbula ukuthi uzoba nesithakazelo kulolu daba kuphela uma ubhaliswe njengomvoti. Ukubhaliswa njengomvoti kuzokunika ithuba lokubamba iqhaza noma ungabambi iqhaza ekhethweni, kukushiya nezinye izinketho zokuthi iyiphi iphathi yokuyisekela. Futhi kumele uhlale ukhumbula ukuthi ungowodwa owaziyo ukuthi iyiphi iphathi oyisekelayo - ukuvota kwakho kuyimfihlo empeleni. Intsha iyazibuza ukuthi ukuvota kwabo kubalulekile yini futhi ukuthi kwenza umehluko. Ngaphezu kokukwazi kwakho ukufaka umthelela njengomvoti obhalisiwe, kumele kube sobala ukuthi uvota noma ungavoti. INingizimu Afrika inohlelo lokhetho oluphakathi kokwakhiwa. Lolu hlelo lokhetho, njengasezinye izizwe, lapho ophumelelayo ekhethweni ethatha konke. Uhlelo lwethu lunesisekelo lapho amaphathi amancane nalawo anokwesekwa okuncane athola ukuveza ngokulandela ukwesekwa kwawo. Okumele ukhumbule ukuthi ohlelweni nasekuvezeni, ukuvota kwakho akukhuphuli kuphela ingxenye yokuvota kwazo zonke izinkanyezi zephathi oyisekelayo, kodwa futhi kwehlisa ngokufanayo ingxenye yazo zonke ezinye amaphathi abamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuyiqiniso lemathematics ongakuhlola ngempela nomthelela wentsha eyizigidi eziyisithupha ezingaphansi kweminyaka engama-25 ezingaba nomthelela emiphumeleni yokhetho. Konke okukhuluma ngenhla kuncike ekubhaliseni kwakho njengomvoti. Ukubhaliswa kwakho kukunika amandla okufaka umthelela futhi kukwenza ufaneleke. Uma ungabhaliswanga njengomvoti, kubi ngoba ngeke ukwazi ukufaka umthelela futhi uzokwenza ungafaneleki ezinqubweni zethu zokukhululeka. Nokho, ukuthi uvota kanjani nokuthi uzovota kanjani kuyisinqumo ongakwenza esikhathini esizayo, kodwa okwamanje, ungazithuthukisa ngokubhaliswa. Izinsuku zokubhaliswa ziyi-24 kuJanuwari no-25 kuJanuwari, 2004, futhi kumele ubhaliswe endaweni okhulele kuyo. Uyanxusa ukuthi ukhuthaze amalungu omndeni wakho nabangane ukuba babhaliswe ngaphambi kokhetho.
Uhlaka lokuguqula ubuciko, isiko, kanye nezimpahla zomnotho kazwelonke lubhalwe kuMthetho Wezobuciko, Isiko Nezimpahla Zomlando ka-1996. Umthwalo wokuphumeza lezi zinqubomgomo uqinisekiswa nguMnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, owawuqala ukuphumeza lokhu ngo-Agasti 1, 2002. Inhloso eyinhloko ukuhlela nokwandisa ibhajethi yezobuciko nezamasiko ukuze kusizakale izidingo zobuciko nezamasiko kulo lonke izwe. Ukuhlelwa kabusha kwenhlangano nakho kubalulekile, futhi ekuqaleni, kubhekiswe ngqo ezikhungweni zokwenza ubuciko ezazincike kakhulu ekuxhaseni esikhathini esedlule. Ubuciko nezamasiko kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuvuselelweni, ubunye, nokubuyisana. Iqembu leMiphakathi Yezobuciko Nezamasiko lilungiselela ukusekela amasu ezikhungo zobuciko nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Zihlobene nokuthuthukiswa kobuciko kodwa futhi zidlala indima ebalulekile mayelana nezinselelo zomphakathi. Zifuna ukubhekana nezinkinga ezihlobene nokufakwa nokuhlanganiswa futhi ukususa ukungalingani emkhakheni wezobuciko nezamasiko ekunikezeni izinsiza. Inqubo ephoqelelwe ifaka phakathi ukufaka amaqembu aphansi njengabakhubazekile, intsha, abesifazane, nezingane. Baphinde banika ukunakwa okukhethekile ezinkingeni zokuguqulwa kwezigaba ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubulungiswa ekunikezeni izinsiza futhi kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni. Izikhungo zobuciko nezamasiko, izikhungo zokuxhasa, nezikhungo zobuciko zomphakathi zithola izibonelelo zonyaka ukuze zifeze izinhlelo nokuthuthukisa ubuciko nezamasiko. Uhlanga lwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika lusekelwa ngokomthetho ukuvikela amalungelo ezilimi nokukhuthaza izilimi zomdabu. Ngo-2003, ikhabhinethi yamukela uHlelo lweMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke, oluhlanganisa isitatimende senqubomgomo, uhlelo lokuphumeza, kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha yezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni futhi luqinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kwezilimi zomdabu ezazikhishwa phansi. Le nqubomgomo isebenza kuzo zonke izakhiwo zik gouvernement, futhi iqhubeka nokukhuthaza inani lezilimi emibhalweni esemthethweni eyenziwe, okuzokwenza kube lula futhi kube nempumelelo ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo zomphakathi kusetshenziswa imibhalo yezilimi efanele. Izifunda zizokwakha izinqubomgomo ngokusekelwe ezimweni zendawo. Izinqubomgomo zizokwethulwa kancane kancane. Ukwakhiwa kweNhlangano Yezinsiza Zomlando Kazwelonke yaseNingizimu Afrika njengomuntu ophakathi ngo-2002 kanye neBhodi Yezimpahla Zomlando Kazwelonke ngo-2003 kwenze ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zomlando kazwelonke kanye nokuguqulwa komkhakha kube yimpumelelo. Iphrojekthi eyinhloko kule ndawo nguMnyuziyamu kaAlbert Luthuli ophakanyiswe eKwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal. Ngo-1998, ikhabhinethi yamukela amaphrojekthi ayisishiyagalolunye okuqala kwezimpahla zomlando okuhloswe ngakho ukubhekana nezici ezithile zendaba yomlando wezwe, ukukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwesizwe, nokufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni ezokuvakasha. Kuze kube manje, amaphrojekthi ayisithupha aqalile, kuhlanganise neMnyuziyamu Yabesifazane kanye neMnyuziyamu yeMpi YamaNgisi neBhora eNingizimu Afrika. Umnyango uzobambisana nePhalamende ukuze ufune ukuvunywa kwamaphrojekthi ayisishiyagalombili wezimpahla zomlando kazwelonke. Ukuxhaswa okuvela ebhajethini ekhethekile elinikezwe izikhungo kuhlose ukukhulisa amathuba okuguqulwa ngokwandisa ububanzi bokuxhasa kwezezimali ezikhungweni. Umnyango uqale uhlelo lwesigaba sokuqala ngonyaka wezezimali ka-2002/03 ukuze wandise ukufinyelela ezikhungweni ngokuthuthukisa izakhiwo zamamnyuziyamu nezinsiza. Ukugxila okukhulu kuzobekwa nasekuphathweni kwezinto ezitholakele nasekucwaningeni ngezimpahla zomlando kuzo zonke izikhungo zomlando kazwelonke (amamnyuziyamu nezinye izikhungo) ukuze kuzame ukunciphisa imisebenzi yobugebengu, kuhlanganise nokuhweba kwamanye amazwe nokukhwabanisa. I-Archives and Records Services yaseNingizimu Afrika ithole intuthuko enkulu ekufezeni imigomo yayo yokuphathwa kahle, uguquko, ukufinyelela ezidingweni zolwazi zomphakathi, nokukhuthaza ukubuyisana kwenhlalakahle ngokuguqulwa kwezimpawu zomlando nezinye. Intuthuko yenziwe nohlelo lwezifunda ukuze kuthathwe izinsiza njengezindawo zokugcina amarekhodi nezimpahla zomlando. IWestern Cape yamanje isesikhathini sokudlulisa lezi zindawo kufunda. Usizo ekugcineni impahla yeNepad nakho kubalulekile ohlwini lwezindaba ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithetho emithathu emisha kazwelonke isiyamukelwe. Omininisteri basayine isitatimende sokugcina amarekhodi ezimpahla, ukuphathwa kahle, namalungelo abantu avela ezweni elingu-10 lase-Afrika abethulwe ukuze amukelwe njengomsebenzi weNepad. NgoNovemba 2003, iNational Council for Library and Information Services (NCLIS) yasungulwa, nomhlangano wokuqala ubanjwe ngoMashi 2004. Ochwepheshe bokwakha nokwakhiwa bamenywa ukuze baphathe ukwakhiwa kwesakhiwo esisha sePretoria seNational Library of South Africa ngoJanuwari 2004. I-Cultural Industries Growth Strategy ihlose ukuhlanganisa amandla omnotho wezobuciko, imisebenzi yezandla, umculo, ifilimu, ukuphrinta, nokwakhiwa. Ukusekela komnyango kuhlanganisa ukuthuthukisa ubudlelwano nokwakha izinto ezintsha nemiphakathi/abazimele, besebenzisa isiko njengendlela yokuvuselela idolobha nokuzama ukuhlanganisa lezi zinkampani. Kukho ukugxila okukhulayo emandleni omkhakha wefilimu. Ingxenye ekhethekile yokunciphisa ubuphofu ihlose ukufinyelela kubabhalisi nezitolo njengendlela yokuvuselela idolobha, ukuthuthukisa izindawo zasemaphandleni, nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Amaphrojekthi enziwa ngokubambisana nohulumeni bezifunda nabezindawo, kanye nohulumeni nezikhungo ezingezona ezikahulumeni. Imizamo yokuthuthukisa iWild Coast, iLebombo, neMaputo Corridor iyizindawo ezibhekelele ukukhuthaza ezokuvakasha ngezamasiko ezihlobene nale mikhankaso. Le mizamo izoqhubeka ngokwabela imali kumaphrojekthi abizwa ngokuthi "Investing in Culture". "Investing in Culture" izozama ukuqinisekisa zonke izici ezihlobene nesiko ukuze kufezwe lezi zinjongo ezishiwo ngenhla. Ukufaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni "imiphakathi" ehlanzekile. Umnyango Wezobuciko Nezamasiko uxhasa ukuthi imiphakathi eminingi enezimo zomnotho ezinzima ngaphakathi kwemingcele yethu ingaba ngabanikazi bezinsiza, kuhlanganise nezidingo zemvelo nezomuntu, impahla yamasiko, amakhono, nolwazi lwesiko, izinto ezivamile, namasiko angasiza ekuguqulweni kwenhlalo kanye nomnotho. Hamba emgwaqweni. Uma kungekho emgwaqweni, sebenzisa uhlangothi olufanele lomgwaqo, kude nomgwaqo. Uma uhamba emgwaqweni, qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ohlangothini olufanele, kanti ubheke izimoto ezisondelayo. Izimoto eziningi zihamba ngezikhathi ezahlukene emigwaqweni ehlukene, ngakho-ke kub dangerous kakhulu ukuba izingane zidle emgwaqweni/noma ohlangothini lomgwaqo. Uma ingane idlala emgwaqweni, umshayeli osondelayo angase angakwazi ukuyigwema noma ukumisa ngokushesha. Lokhu kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Hamba njalo ubheke izimoto ozihlangabezana nazo ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezisondelayo ngesikhathi. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 azinakho ukukwazi ukukala ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze imoto ifike kuzo. Ngaphandle kokuba kuphephile, ungaweli emgwaqweni. Ungagijimi. Ungaweli emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezifihlekile ezifana nezikwele noma izintaba ngoba kubi kakhulu kumashayeli ukubona wena ngesikhathi. Abahambi ngezinyawo abavunyelwe EMIGWAQWENI ENGAMAKHANDA. Linda ibhasi/taxi liqede ukuhamba ngaphambi kokuphuma. Linda ibhasi/taxi lihambe ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezivela kokubili ohlangothini lomgwaqo. Le bhasi/taxi oyiphumayo ingakushaya. Ungashaywa/ushaywe imoto edlula lapho ibhasi/taxi okuphume kuyo likhona. Wela kuphela uma uphakathi kokukhanya kwabahambi ngezinyawo okukhanyayo futhi kuphephile ukukwenza. Uma ukukhanya kwabahambi ngezinyawo kushintsha kusuka kokuhlaza kuya kokubomvu ngenkathi uwela, qhubeka ubheke emuva naphambili ukuze ubone izimoto ezisondelayo. Uma ukukhanya kokuhamba kukhanya kokubomvu kushintsha kube kokuhlaza, izimoto ezivela phambili nasekhaleni nazo zinegunya lokuhamba manje. Qiniseka ukuthi abashayeli bayakubona futhi bame ngaphambi kokuwela. Umgwaqo uhlinzekelwa bonke; ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukuwela ngokushesha ukuze abashayeli baqhubeke. Ukwela emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezingekho emthethweni kubi kakhulu futhi kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Abashayeli balindele ukukubona ezindaweni zokuwela ezibekwe: njengezindawo zokuwela zabahambi ngezinyawo ezinezithiyo, lapho kukhona izimpawu zokumisa noma ukukhanya kwemigwaqo, nokho, kufanele uhamba ngokushesha ukuze abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo baqhubeke. Lokhu kubizwa ngokwabelana ngomgwaqo nokuhlonipha abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Gwema ukusebenzisa umgwaqo ngemuva kokuphuza utshwala/nokwelapha ngoba kuthinta ukubona kwakho nokulinganisela kwakho, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, wela emgwaqweni ngokushesha. Ukuhamba uphuzile kubi njengokushayela uphuzile. Yini ukugcwalisa? Ukugcwalisa kuwukwenza komuntu onebhizinisi lokuhamba asebenzisa umgwaqo, umshayeli noma umgibeli, ukudlula umkhawulo wokukhwabanisa wemoto, kungaba ngenhloso noma ngokungafanele. Ukugcwalisa nezimpahla ezingafanele zenza kube nokufa nokulimala emigwaqweni yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo onguzigidi zamaRandi emigwaqweni nasezimotweni ezigcwele. Imoto egcwele ithatha isikhathi eside ukuyeka uma kwenzeka okuphuthumayo. Uma ufuna ukuhamba ukuze ugweme ingozi, isikhathi sokwenza lokho sandele ngenxa yokugcwalisa. Kunzima ukuphatha imoto egcwele futhi ngeke ukwazi ukujula kalula njengoba ungakwenza emoto ejwayelekile, okwenza kube kubi ukuhamba phambili kwezinye izimoto. Amathayi emoto egcwele afudumala futhi abe mncane - lokhu kungabangela amathayi ukuba aphume. Ukugcwalisa kubangela ukuthi imoto yakho ibhujiswe, okwenza kube nzima ukukubona izimbobo noma ezinye izithiyo emgwaqweni. Ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo emgwaqweni ngakho ungase uphumelele kakhulu. Abantu abaningi bathuthwa emsebenzini noma ezindaweni ezahlukene behlezi ngemuva kwamathrekhi nezivande ezivulekile nsuku zonke - behlezi phezulu kwezimpahla. Abanayo imishayo, abanakho ukuhamba. Ngaphandle kwalokho, lokhu kuthinta kakhulu inani eliphezulu lokufa nokulimala emigwaqweni yethu. Umthetho 247 uthi abantu bangathuthwa kuphela ngemuva kwemoto yezimpahla uma le ndawo abahamba kuyo ivikelwe ngezinto eziqinile ukuze ivimbele ukuwa kwabo. Abashayeli bamabhasi nezitaxi bavame ukugcwalisa izimoto zabo. Sivame ukuzwa ezindabeni "I-taxi noma ibhasi elagcwalisa kakhulu libe nengxenye." Kumele kube nesaziso ebhasini/itaxi esikhombisa inani labagibeli abavunyelwe ukuhamba nokuma emotweni. Umshayeli othuthwa abantu nezimpahla kumele ahlolwe ngalolo msebenzi futhi kumele afundiswe indlela yokushayela. Abashayeli kumele basebenzise lesi saziso ukuze balahlekelwe ukugcwalisa izimoto zabo. Ungayithola kanjani imoto egcwele? Ihamba kancane uma ihamba phezulu. Yini enye ongayibona ukuthi igcwele emotweni? Isimo sayo esiyisisekelo. Gcina isikhathi: Akukho ukuhamba kancane, isibonelo, uma uthutha noma uthulula impahla. Izinkinga ze-inshurensi uma ubamba ingozi futhi kutholakala ukuthi imoto igcwele. Ukuhamba ngebhayisikili sekube yinto ethokozisayo futhi indlela yokuhamba eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abaningi bayakujabulela ukuhamba ngebhayisikili empilweni yabo yansuku zonke. Kubantu abaningi, ibhayisikili iyindlela yokuhamba ehlukile kunemoto yokuhamba nsuku zonke. Ibhayisikili iyindlela yokuhamba efana nanoma iyiphi imoto. Nokho, ibhayisikili ayifani nezinye izinhlobo zemoto, ibhayisikili iphathwa amandla abantu. Unamalungelo, imithwalo, nemisebenzi efana nabashayeli abanye. Khumbula, abahambi ngebhayisikili abavunyelwe emigwaqweni engamakhanda. Ngaphambi kokuhamba ngebhayisikili emgwaqweni omphakathi, kumele uqonde imithetho eyisisekelo yomgwaqo futhi ube nekhono lokuhamba ngebhayisikili ngokuphepha emgwaqweni. Kumele uhambisane nazo zonke izimpawu zomgwaqo nezikhumbuzo zemoto. Kumele unikeze abahambi ngezinyawo ithuba. Shiya ibanga eliphephile uma ulandela ezinye izimoto ukuze uvumele umshayeli ophambi kwakho ukuba akwazi ukumisa ngokushesha uma kudingeka. Ungahambi ngebhayisikili ngendlela engafanele futhi engalungile. Bheka izimoto; yenza iso elibukhali nabashayeli ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bayakubona. Qaphela izinja ezingakuphonsela. Lokhu kubi ngoba izinja zingase zikhuphuke emgwaqweni ophumayo futhi zibe nengozi. Qaphela ezindaweni ezibunjiwe uma kube nezikhukhula ezinzima noma kube nezikhukhula isikhathi eside. Gqoka i-helmet eyenzelwe ukuvikela ikhanda lakho uma kwenzeka ingozi. Gwema ukubheka ngqo ezikhanyisweni ezikhanyayo zezimoto ezisondelayo, njengoba lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima ukubona ngesikhathi ebusuku. Ungahambi ngokumelene nomgwaqo. Umthetho ulindele ukuthi abahambi ngebhayisikili bahambe nomgwaqo. Akufanele bahambe ezindaweni zokuhamba ngezinyawo. Ungathwali abagibeli ngaphandle uma ibhayisikili ifakwe esihlalweni esengeziwe somgibeli. Ungangeni emjaho wama bhayisikili emgwaqweni omphakathi ongavunyelwe nguhulumeni noma eziphathimandla. Okokuqala, umthengi kumele athumele ukukhalaza uma enikwa usizo. Uma enganelisekile ngendlela okukhalazo kwakhe okwenziwe ngayo noma umphumela, angakwazi ukwandisa ukukhalaza kwakhe kumphathi weposi. Thumela ukukhalaza kwakho ehhovisi lomphathi weposi kanye nazo zonke izincwadi ezisemthethweni. Abathengi/abasebenzisi bezinsizakalo zeposi bangathumela ukukhalaza kwabo ngefoni, ngefeksi, ngencwadi, noma ngokukuthumela ngogesi. Iyiphi iposi noma inkampani ethumela amaphakheji? Ubani okhulume naye ephepheni? Uma kukhulunywa ngokukhalaza okuhlobene nezicelo zokulandelela kanye nokutholakala kwamaphakheji noma into ebhalisiwe, nikeza inombolo yalokho kuphakheji noma into ebhalisiwe. Umphathi weposi uhlose ukuthuthukisa usizo nokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ethembekile evulekile kubo bonke abathengi. Umphathi weposi ungowesigaba seZokuxhumana. Umphathi weposi wasungulwa ngaphansi kweSigaba 3 soMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zeposi No. 124 ka-1998. Inhloso yokulawula umkhakha wezeposi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu bathola izinsizakalo zeposi ezithembekile nezingcono. Umphathi weposi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo eziyisisekelo zeposi zikhona kubo bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika. Bhekisisa ukukhalaza kwabathengi mayelana nezinsizakalo zeposi. Qinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi beposi bayavuma noma bayahambisana nomthetho, kanye nemigomo nemibandela yeziqu nezitifiketi zokubhaliswa. Faka isandla empumelelweni nasekuzinikeleni ekufezeni izinhloso zokusebenza zokweseka izinsizakalo zeposi ngenkathi ubhekisisa izidingo zabantu kuzo zonke izigaba. Lungisa kokubili usizo lweposi olwalawulwa nolungelawulwa. Bheka futhi ugcine ukuhambisana nemigomo yeziqu nezitifiketi zokubhaliswa. Khuthaza intshisekelo yokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zeposi mayelana nezindleko, inqubekelaphambili, nezinga lenkonzo. Khuthaza usizo olujwayelekile oluqinisekisa ukufinyelela okufanayo kubo bonke abantu. Insiza engalungile. Ngokwakha amazinga enkonzo okukhuluma ngezinsizakalo. Ukuthutha nokuvala iPosi. Ngokubuyekeza nokwakha kabusha izakhiwo zeposi ngokususa ezinye izikhungo zeposi ezindaweni ezineziphakamiso eziningi zeposi zathuthelwa ezindaweni ezingenazo noma ezineziphakamiso ezincane. Ukulethwa kwezincwadi emakhaya. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi wonke amakhaya emiphakathini anikezwa izinombolo zokwamukela izincwadi. Ukukhokha ngezikhwama zeposi. Ngokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi izikhwama zeposi zibhekwa njengendawo eyinhloko yokwamukela izincwadi - azikhokhiswa. Indlela yokuthumela ukukhalaza. Ukulethwa kwephutha. Ukuhamba phambili kokuthumela, ngokwakha ivolumu yezincwadi ezidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngosuku olwandulela lokuthi zifike kulabo okufanele bazithole. Amaphakheji anweight engaphezu kuka-30 kg. Ukuthumela incwadi kuwumthwalo womuntu othumelayo. Izincwadi ezithunyelwa umuntu ongasebenzi enkonzweni yokuthumela izincwadi. Yiziphi izimfanelo zomthengi? Ukuthola usizo oluyisisekelo lokuthumela izincwadi. Ilungelo lokuthola usizo olufinyeleleka nolwakhelwe kahle. Ukuqina nokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo yeposi ngesikhathi. Ukutholakala kosizo nezinsiza ezifanele abantu abaneziphene. Ilungelo lokuthumela ukukhalaza.
Fika ekhaya ngokuphepha. Le bhukwana iyisikhumbuzo sokukusiza ukuthi ugcine impilo enhle ngesikhathi uhamba. Bafuna ukuphendula noma yimiphi imibuzo onayo mayelana nempilo yakho. Uma uqasha abashayeli bezinqola, ubhekene nabo. Ingabe ugcina umthetho wezempilo kubo bonke abasebenzi? Ingabe unikeza ulwazi lwezempilo nezikhwama zokuvikela? Ingabe uvumela abashayeli ukuthi bathathe ukuphumula ukuze bazikhulule uma behamba ibanga elide? Ingabe unikeza abashayeli bakho izigqoko zokugqoka uma besiza abalimele? Thatha isikhashana ukuphendula imibuzo elandelayo. Ingabe nginama- sores noma amanxeba ezindaweni zami ezizimele? Kuthiwani ngothandekayo wami? Ingabe kukhona okukhishwayo, ukuvuvukala, noma ukuhamba kahle? Ingabe othandekayo wami unokukhishwayo? Uma uphendula ngempela, yisiphi isinyathelo osithathayo? Izimoto ezakhiwe ngemuva kuka-1996 - Sebenzisa uphethiloli ongahlanganisiwe onenani elifanele le-RON.
