Ubani uMlawuli Wezandla Kagesi (NER)? Ukulawula umkhakha wamandla kagesi ngokuhambisana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, nezindlela ezinhle zokuqhuba ezingeni lesizwe nelamazwe omhlaba ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa okuzinzile. Ukuba umholi emhlabeni jikelele ekulawuleni amandla kagesi. U-National Energy Regulator angakusiza kanjani? Umthetho Wamandla Kagesi No. 41 ka-1987, njengoba ushintshiwe, unika amandla uMlawuli Wezandla Kagesi, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ukuxazulula izinkinga phakathi kwabathengisi bamandla kagesi nabathengi, kanye phakathi kwabathengisi bamandla kagesi uqobo. Uma ungathanda ukuxoxa ngendlela umthengisi wakho wamandla kagesi abhekane ngayo nezikhalazo zakho, uMlawuli Wezandla Kagesi angakusiza. Yiziphi izinhlobo zezinkinga uMlawuli Wezandla Kagesi angakusiza ngazo? Hlinzeka ngemininingwane ebalulekile mayelana nezikhalazo. Bonke abathengisi bendawo kumele babe nelayisense etholelwe ku-NER. Akekho umthengisi wamandla kagesi wendawo onelungelo lokuhlinzeka noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kubathengi ngaphandle kokugunyazwa ngu-NER. Umthengisi wamandla kagesi wendawo akakwazi ukudlulisa ilayisense yakhe yokufaka ugesi kumthengisi wamandla kagesi wendawo ngaphandle kwemvume ye-NER. Umthengisi wamandla kagesi wendawo akanaso isikhala sokukhokhisa amakhasimende nganoma iyiphi imali engagunyaziwe ngu-NER noma ukuguqula ukufakwa ngaphandle kwemvume ye-NER. Amakhasimende asaqhubeka nelungelo lokukhokha izimali ezivunyelwe ngisho noma umthengisi wendawo eqala ukuhlinzeka ngentela entsha. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngogesi kumuntu noma ohlwini olungama-tent endaweni okufanele ihlinzekwe kuyo uma umthengi ekwazi ukukhokha insizakalo enikeziwe nokuthi baphinde bakhokhe. Umthengisi wendawo kumele anikeze umthengi isakhiwo nezinga lokukhokha elifanele uma umthengi efaka isicelo sokuhlinzekwa kwensizakalo futhi uma kucelwa. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokwazisa amakhasimende abo ngezikhuphukisi ezikhokhwayo, ngezinketho ezahlukene zokukhokha ukuze kuhlinzekwe ngogesi, nokuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezicacile uma befaka izicelo zokuhlinzekwa ngogesi. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathengi banelungelo lokubuza ngemali yokukhokha ezohlangabezana kangcono nezidingo zabo. Uma umthengi ebhilled, ibhili kumele ibonise lokhu, futhi noma iyiphi imali ekhokhisiwe ngaphezu kokufaneleka komthengi ngesikhathi esithile kumele ibuyiselwe ku-akhawunti yomthengi. Uma umthengi enezinkinga, bangacela umthengisi ukuthi ahlole ukunemba kwe-mita ngokukhokha umthengi imali ethile, ezobuyiselwa umthengisi uma kutholakala ukuthi imitha ayisebenzi kahle. Ikhophi yeSicelo seMikhakha iyatholakala kubakhiqizi bak gouvernement noma uMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Iyini injongo yeSicelo seMikhakha? Siphinde sithathe izinga elincane lemiholo okufanele ikhokhwe ngabaphathi. Bonke abahlwanyela izihlahla; abakhiqizi abavamile; abakhiqizi abachitha isikhathi esiningi emsebenzini wemithi; bonke abathutha embonini yemithi; umsebenzi wasekhaya oqashwe endaweni lapho izihlahla zihlwanyelwa; umgibeli oqashwe emithini kodwa engaphansi kwenkampani yokuphepha yangasese. Ubani ongeyena ohlangene nalokhu? Abaphathi abangahlanganisi imikhakha yokuhlwanyela; imithi yomphakathi; imithi yokuvikela imvelo; noma umuntu ongena noma obamba iqhaza emsebenzini wemithi ngaphansi kwesicelo seMikhakha noma ngaphansi kwesivumelwano esihlangene nebhodi labasebenzi njengoba kuchaziwe eMthethweni Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi ka-1995, njengomthetho ophatha ngaphansi kweBhodi Labasebenzi Bezokuthutha kanye nomsebenzi wokusika nokuguqula izihlahla zibe omunye umkhiqizo, ngokuhlanganyela nemboni ye timber kanye nephepha, njalonjalo. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi bemithi bathola iholo elifanayo? Bonke abasebenzi bemithi kufanele bathole okungenani iholo elichazwe etafuleni 1. Nokho, abasebenzi bemithi abathola ngaphezulu kwentengo ebekiwe bazoqhubeka bethola amaholo aphezulu. Umphathi kufanele akhokhele umsebenzi ongezansi kweminyaka engu-15 noma phezulu kodwa engakafiki eminyakeni engu-18 osebenza amahora angama-35 ngesonto okungenani intengo yehora echazwe etafuleni 1. Ngemuva konyaka owodwa lokusebenza kwesicelo seMikhakha, amaholo azonyuka ngentengo engu-2% ye-CPI (Consumer Price Index). Umphathi nomsebenzi wemithi bangavuma ngokubhala ukuthi umsebenzi wemithi uqedele umsebenzi wezimpahla ngezikhathi ezichaziwe. Umphathi kufanele akhokhele umsebenzi wemithi oqashwe ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo, ukukhokha akufanele kube ngaphansi kweholo elincane kanye nenani elisebenzayo ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo. Noma yini ebalulekile ukuqinisekisa izinga lokuphepha nempilo. Umphathi angakhipha imali kuphela ngezizathu ezihlinzekwe yiSicelo seMikhakha. Abasebenzi bemithi kufanele bavume ngokubhala ekukhipheni. Akufanele kukhishwe imali yokuhlala engaphezu kwamaphesenti ayishumi eholo lomsebenzi wemithi. Ukukhishwa kokudla akufanele kudlule amaphesenti ayishumi eholo lomsebenzi wemithi. Uma kukhona abasebenzi bemithi abaphezulu kwemibili abahlala endaweni yokusebenza, inani eliphelele lemali elingakhishwa kubo bonke abasebenzi bemithi abahlala kufanele lingadluli amaphesenti angama-25 athathwe ezingeni eliphansi leholo lomuntu ophila emithini. Ngamanye amazwi, uma kukhona abasebenzi bemithi abahlanu abahlala ngaphakathi kwenkampani, inani eliphezulu elingakhishwa kumuntu ngamunye lingaba amaphesenti amahlanu. Indlu kufanele ibe nekhono elikhulu elingama-30 square meters okungenani. Abasebenzi bemithi banesibopho sokubheka impahla yomphathi wabo. Impahla yomphathi ifaka imishini noma ezinye izinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngabo ngesikhathi beqashwe. Uma umphakathi wemithi engaphatheki kahle ekuhloleni impahla yabo, umphathi angakhipha imali ngenxa yokulahleka noma ukulimala. Kumele banikeze umsebenzi wemithi ithuba lokukhombisa ukuthi kungani imali kumele ingakhishwa eholo labo. Qinisekisa ukuthi inani elikhishwayo alidluli ingxenye eyodwa ye-quarters eholo lomsebenzi wemithi. Amalungelo nezibopho zabaphathi nabantu abasebenza emithini emkhakheni wemithi akhishwa ngendlela efuna ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zombili izinhlangothi. Uhlelo olungakanani umphakathi wemithi angasebenza ngesonto? Amahora ayisishiyagalolunye ngosuku, uma umphakathi wemithi usebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu noma ngaphansi kwesonto; noma amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku, uma umphakathi wemithi usebenza ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezinhlanu ngesonto. Umsebenzi akufanele asebenze isikhathi esengeziwe esidlula amahora angama-12 ngosuku. Ngenxa yokuthi umphakathi wemithi akufanele asebenze isikhathi esengeziwe esidlula amahora angama-45 ngesonto, umphakathi wemithi osebenza amahora ayishumi ezinsukwini ezine akufanele asebenze amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku lwesihlanu. Isikhathi esengeziwe kufanele sikhokhelwe ngentengo ejwayelekile yansuku zonke ehambisana nengxenye yeholo ejwayelekile yomsebenzi. Isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo kufanele sinikezelwe ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga kusukela ngosuku oluthola ilungelo lokuphumula. Nokho, isivumelwano esibhaliwe singakhulisa lesi sikhathi sibe yizinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Isivumelwano esibhaliwe singadinga noma sivumele umphakathi wemithi ukuthi asebenze amahora ayishumi ngosuku ngokuhlanganyela nezikhathi zokuphuma kokudla ngaphandle kokukhokhwa kwesikhathi esengeziwe. Ngaphezulu kwezinsuku ezinhlanu ngesonto. Uma iholidi liphakathi nosuku olujwayele ukujwayelekile lwabantu abasebenza emithini, umphathi kufanele akhokhele labo abangasebenzi okungenani iholo elijwayelekile elilinganayo nosuku. Umphathi kufanele akhokhele umphakathi wemithi noma yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakele ngokusebenza ngosuku lweholidi ngosuku lokukhokha olujwayelekile. Abaphathi kufanele baziqhenye ngabasebenzi bemithi abajwayele ukuhamba ebusuku mayelana nezimo ezibucayi ezihambisana nomsebenzi kanye nelungelo labantu ukuba bahlolwe uma bebuza njalo lapho izindleko zikhokhwa umphathi. Umphathi kufanele akhokhele umphakathi wemithi elindile ubenefit yokulinda. Le benefit kufanele ibe okungenani elingana namaphesenti ayishumi eholo lomsebenzi. Isivumelwano singasusa isikhathi sokuphuma kokudla kumphakathi wemithi osebenza ngaphansi kwamahora ayisithupha ngosuku. Isivumelwano esibhaliwe singahlinzeka okungenani amahora angama-60 wesikhathi sokuphumula njalo ngesonto lesibili noma sinciphise izikhathi zokuphumula ngesonto ukufinyelela amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngesonto, uma isikhathi sokuphumula sikhuliswa ngokufanele ngesonto elilandelayo. Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuhamba umphakathi wemithi angazithatha? Uphi umphakathi wemithi ongathatha ezinsukwini ezingu-365? Umphakathi wemithi unelungelo lokuthatha izinsuku ezintathu ezinyangeni. Kwenzekani uma iholidi lihambisana nezinsuku zokuhamba? Iyini ebalulekile mayelana nezinsuku zokugula? Ukusekelwa noma isikhathi esibaliwe ngokusekelwe kulungelo lokuhamba sikhokhelwa izinyanga eziyi-36 ezithathwe kusukela ekubhaleni kwezinsuku ezisebenze phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisithupha. Umphakathi wemithi usebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu ngesonto. Izinsuku zokuhamba ngaphakathi kulungelo lokuhamba zilinganiselwa ku-5 x 6 (inani lezinsuku) = 30 izinsuku phakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-36. Umphathi angacela isitifiketi sezokwelapha uma umphakathi wemithi engasebenzi ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili noma
Le ncwadi isekelwe kulwazi olunikezwe yizikhungo ezifanele, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ngokuqondile noma ngamawebhusayithi azo. Abacwaningi bacabange ukuthi lonke ulwazi lunikezwa ngenhloso enhle futhi luyiqiniso. Asikwazi ukubekwa icala ngokunembile nangokuphelele kolwazi olunikezwe kithi. Uma ufuna ukuthi inhlangano yakho ifakwe ezibuyekezeni ezizayo zalesi sithombe, sicela uthumele i-imeyili ku: kmosweu@deat.gov. Iziphakamiso ezincane, eziphakathi, nezinkulu (SMMEs) ziyizinjini zokuthuthukiswa. Zifaka isandla ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi nasemnotfweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi ama-SMME ezokuvakasha asungulwe ukuze azimele futhi akhule. Ukuze kusizwe ngalokhu, uMnyango Wezemvelo Nezokuvakasha, ngokuqhuba iBhange Lezokuvakasha, uthuthukise iqoqo lezinsiza ezihloselwe ukusiza osomabhizinisi bezokuvakasha bakhuphule amabhizinisi abo futhi babe nezinzuzo. Le ncwadi ibalulekile kakhulu njengoba inikeza indawo eyodwa, efanele yokufinyelela ulwazi, ikakhulukazi kubasomabhizinisi bezokuvakasha, ngoxhaso lwamabhizinisi olukhona kubo. Lapho iqalwa, le ncwadi izotholakala nakwezinye izilimi ezisemthethweni, okungukuthi isiZulu, isiSetswana, nesiAfrikaans. Sizokwenza ukuqhubeka nokubuyekeza le ncwadi minyaka yonke futhi sihunyushe nakwezinye izilimi eziningi. Anginankinga yokuthi uzothola le ncwadi iyinsiza ewusizo emizamweni yakho yebhizinisi, futhi ngifisa ngenhliziyo ukuthi uphumelele ekusunguleni ibhizinisi lezokuvakasha elizinzile nelinenzuzo. Nginecebo elihle! Ngaphi engingathola khona uxhaso lokuqala ibhizinisi lami? Imibuzo - Yini engangenza ngibe umthengisi? Yisiphi isakhiwo sebhizinisi okufanele ngikhethe? Wamukelekile kulo mhlaba omuhle wezokuvakasha. Sithemba ukuthi uzothola le ncwadi ewusizo. Le ncwadi izokunikeza ulwazi oluwusizo ukusiza emizamweni yakho yokusungula ibhizinisi elihlobene nezokuvakasha. Ihlanganisa izihloko ezivela ekubhaleni kwezinhlelo zebhizinisi kuya ekufuna uxhaso lwezezimali nasekunikezeni ulwazi olubalulekile lokuxhumana. Sicela ukhumbule ukuthi le yindlela ejwayelekile, ngakho-ke siphakamisa kakhulu ukuthi ubheke emithonjeni yolwazi ehlukene. Enye yezici ezibalulekile zalesi sithombe ukuthi inikeza ulwazi ngazo zonke iziqalo ezikhona ukusiza ukusungula ibhizinisi elisha noma ukukhulisa elikhona. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuze uthole ukuthi ubani ongcono kuwe futhi uxhumane nabo ngqo. Khumbula ukuthi izikhungo eziningi zinikeza izinsizakalo ezahlukene nokuxhaso. Ukuze sigcine isikhala kule ncwadi, asiphindaphindi imininingwane yabo kodwa sikunikeza ikhasi elihambelana nalokho ukuze ubheke. Izifundazwe eziningi zineziqalo zazo kanye nezincwadi eziphezulu ezishicilelwe. Xhumana nabo ngqo usebenzisa ulwazi lokuxhumana olunikezwe eMkhakheni 5. Ukusungula ibhizinisi lakho akuyona into elula futhi kudinga umsebenzi onzima nokuzinikela. Izokuvakasha zihluke futhi zisebenza ngendlela ehlukile kunezinye izimboni kulokhu. Sifake imibuzo ejabulisayo eMkhakheni 5 ukuze sikunikeze umqondo wokuthi unakho yini okudingekayo ukuze ungene ebhizinisini. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuqoqa ulwazi oluhambelana kakhulu. Funda ngokusemandleni akho - lokhu kuhlanganisa amaphephandaba, amajornali, kanye namawebhusayithi. Kubalulekile ukubheka le ncwadi njengendawo yokuqala, hhayi njengomhlahlandlela oqinile wokuba nebhizinisi lezokuvakasha eliphumelelayo. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuze uthole ulwazi olungeziwe futhi ungamisi ukufunda ngempilo yakho yebhizinisi nezokuvakasha. Ithuluzi Lezebhizinisi. Siphakamisa ukuthi ufike kulolu lwazi ukuze uthole ulwazi olunzulu, uma kudingeka. Sikufisela inhlanhla futhi sikwamukela kulo mhlaba omuhle wezokuvakasha! Kube nokuxoxisana okuthile mayelana nokuchazwa kwesisho "umtraveller" nokuthi yiziphi izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngempilo kubavakashi. Umtraveller ungumuntu ovakashela futhi ohlala ngaphandle kwendawo ehlukile kulokho akujwayelekile isikhathi esithile futhi angaba umtraveller "wendawo" - umuntu ophila eNingizimu Afrika kodwa ovakashele ingxenye ehlukile yelizwe nomndeni nabangane ukuze ajabulele; umtraveller "webhizinisi" ohamba evela kwelinye izwe noma ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika ukuze enze imisebenzi yebhizinisi noma umtraveller "wamazwe omhlaba" ovakashela eNingizimu Afrika evela kwelinye izwe ukuze abone lokho esingakunikela. Izokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika zihlanganisa zonke izigaba ezisebenza ukwenza ulwazi lomtraveller ezweni lethu lujabulise futhi lukhumbuleke. Ukuhlinzeka ngamaTravellers (ukuhlala) kuhilela ukunikeza indawo yokuhlala, isibonelo, ukuphumula nokudla kwasekuseni, izindlu zokwamukela, izikhungo zokuzihlalela, amaholo amasha, izindawo zokuhlala, amahhotela, njll. I-MICE (Imihlangano, Izikhuthazo, Imicimbi, Nezenzakalo) iyisigaba esihloselwe ikakhulukazi ukuhlela nokuphatha imihlangano nezinye izenzakalo ezifana nemibukiso nokwenza ukuthi abamele abakhethiwe bathole itiye nelunch. Ndawonye sizokwakha umkhiqizo wezokuvakasha ongathengiswa emhlabeni jikelele ngama-exhibitions omhlaba, sikhuthaza izivakashi ukuba zize zibone lokho ezweni lethu elihle elinokunikeza, isibonelo, amabhishi amahle, izikhumbuzo zomlando, abantu abahle, izindawo zokuthenga, nezindawo eziningi ezihlukile nezithokozisayo eNingizimu Afrika. Izokuvakasha zihlobene cishe nazo zonke ezinye izenzo ezweni ngendlela ethile. Kodwa isebenzisa eyodwa noma ngaphezulu (umuntu ophakathi). Ndawonye nokuthi konke kusebenze ndawonye, kuletha abavakashi kusuka ezindaweni zabo emhlabeni jikelele beze eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthola ukuqonda okuhlakaniphile kokuthi ubani ozosebenzisa imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho ekugcineni, nobani okufanele uxhumane nabo ohambweni lwakho lokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi. Sifake umdwebo ngezansi ukuze sikhombise ukuthi le nqubo ingasebenza kanjani kumhlinzeki wezokwamukela nokuthi ubani ozothola izinzuzo kule nqubo. Uzobona ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi zithola izinzuzo kumhlinzeki wezokwamukela - empeleni, bangaba abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo kumphakathi wezokuhlala. Khuluma neNhlangano Yezokuvakasha yendawo ukuze uthole izeluleko zokukhulisa ibhizinisi lakho. Ulwazi olungeziwe luhlanganiswe esigabeni Sokumaketha seMkhakheni 4. Uhlelo luzosungulwa kanjani futhi umsebenzisi uzothenga kanjani iholidi? Kube nolwazi oluningi muva nje mayelana nezimboni zezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, futhi sithokozisa kakhulu ukwanda kwenani labavakashi abavakashela ezweni lethu elihle. Izenzakalo ezibalulekile ezifana neMidlalo yeFIFA ye-2010 nayo izoba nomthelela omkhulu embonini yethu, futhi kufanele kube namathuba okuthi abathengisi bakwazi ukukhombisa izinsiza zabo. Ngokuvamile
Umnyango Wezabasebenzi usungule umthetho omusha, ikakhulukazi kwiSikhungo Sokuthengisa Nokuthengisa Ngaphandle. Ikhophi yeSikhungo Sokuhlola itholakala kubathengisi bephepha eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi futhi iyatholakala ku-inthanethi: www.labour.gov. Yini inhloso yale Ndlela Yokuhlola? Le Ndlela Yokuhlola iqukethe izimo zokusebenza zabasebenzi kwiSikhungo Sokuthengisa Nokuthengisa Ngaphandle ezifana nezinsuku zokusebenza, izikhathi zokuphumula, imininingwane, kanye nokupheliswa kwezinkontileka zomsebenzi. Iphinde iphakamise ngemiholo elindelekile nokuthi kufanele ikhokhwe ngababambiqhaza. Ubani othintekayo kule Ndlela Yokuhlola? Noma iyiphi imisebenzi ethinta lowo msebenzi, hhayi kuphela ukuthengisa, ukugcina impahla, noma ukusabalalisa, noma imisebenzi ethuthukisa ibhizinisi lommeli noma imisebenzi eyenziwa ezindaweni zalolo bhizinisi ezihambisana nezidingo zomsebenzi ez covered by this Sectoral Determination. Ubani ongathinteki kule Ndlela Yokuhlola? Abasebenzi abenza amahora angama-24 noma ngaphansi ngenyanga abathinteki. Uma kukhona udaba olungakhulunywanga kule Ndlela Yokuhlola, izinhlinzeko zeMthethosisekelo Wokusebenza Okuyisisekelo (BCEA) zizosebenza kubabambiqhaza nabasebenzi kule Ndawo. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nemiholo? Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi kufanele bathole okungenani imiholo ekhombisa kumaThebula 1 kuya ku-3. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi kwiSikhungo Sokuthengisa Nokuthengisa Ngaphandle bazothola imiholo efanayo? Abasebenzi kwiSikhungo Sokuthengisa Nokuthengisa Ngaphandle kufanele bathole okungenani izimali ezikhonjiswe kumaThebula akhuluma ngazo ngenhla. Nokho, abasebenzi abathola imiholo ephezulu kunezikhombisiwe bazoqhubeka bethola lezozikhombisi ngoba imigomo yokusebenza ayinakushintshwa nganoma iyiphi indlela. Noma okungenani inani ngehora njengoba kuchazwe kumaThebula 1 kuya ku-3 ngehora noma ingxenye yohora eyenziwe ngabasebenzi. Uma lowo msebenzi ekhiqiza noma ethengisa ngaphansi kwemiholo encane ebekwe ngenxa yezizathu ezibangelwa umqashi, kufanele athole imiholo ekhombisiwe. Ibalwa usebenzisa amahora enziwe aphelele ngosuku/ama hora = imiholo ngehora aphelele evikini/ama hora evikini = imiholo ngehora aphelele evikini/izinsuku ezisebenze = imiholo ngosuku aphelele ngenyanga/4. Imiholo yabasebenzi evikini lapho ukukhokha kungabalwa ngokubheka isikhathi noma lapho bethola imiholo eguquguqukayo ibalwa ngokususelwa enanini eliphelele elilinganisiwe ezinyangeni eziyi-13 uma uhlukanisa ngama-13. I-slip yemiholo iyimpahla yabasebenzi. Imiholo izonyuka ngesilinganiso se-index yokuphila esihlanganiswe nephesenti elilodwa ezinyangeni zokuqala eziyishumi. Imiholo izonyuka ngesilinganiso se-index yokuphila esihlanganiswe nephesenti elilodwa eminyakeni yesibili ngemuva kokuqala kwale Ndlela Yokuhlola. Uma i-CPIX ingama-10% noma ngaphezulu, imiholo ekhombisiwe izonyuka ngesilinganiso se-CPIX. Ukuhlinzekwa kokuhambisana nezindinganiso zempilo nokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nezikweletu ezivela emiholweni? Kucacile ukuthi le mpilo ye-HIV/AIDS izothinta zonke izindawo zokusebenza, lapho abasebenzi bahlupheka ngezifo zesikhathi eside, behluleka ukuya emsebenzini, abanye befa, ukukhiqiza kwehla, nezinsizakalo zabasebenzi zithinteka, kanye nempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini, izindleko zokukhiqiza, kanye nokukhuthazeka emsebenzini. I-HIV ayinabubanzi; ibhujiswa noma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi, kungakhathaliseki ubulili, ubudala, noma isizwe; nokho, manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi isimo sezomnotho sabantu sinefuthe ekuqhamukeni nasekuhlaleni kwalesi sifo. I-HIV iba yinkinga enkulu ezindaweni nasezindaweni ezijolise ebuphofwini, lapho kushintsha ngokushesha, njengokwethulwa kwezindlela zokuphila zasemadolobheni nezindlela, kanye lapho udlame nokungazinzi kukhula. Ukuhamba kwalesi sifo kukhuthazwa ukuhamba kwabantu besuka ezindaweni zasemakhaya beya ezikhungweni zasemadolobheni. Abesifazane, ikakhulukazi, bakhula kakhulu engozini yokuthola leli gciwane ngenxa yezindlela zamasiko nokuthembela kwezomnotho okwenza bangathathi izinyathelo zokulawula ukuphila kwabo. Enye yezindlela ezisebenzayo zokunciphisa nokuphatha umthelela we-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo nolwazi lwe-HIV/AIDS. Ukubhekisisa izinkinga ezithile ze-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza kuzokwenza abasebenzi, amaqembu, kanye nohulumeni babe nethuba lokwenza umnikelo obonakalayo emizamweni yasendaweni, kazwelonke, nasemhlabeni jikelele yokuvimbela nokulawula i-HIV/AIDS. Ngakho-ke, le Nqubomgomo ihloselwe ukuhlela abakhiqizi, amaqembu, kanye nabasebenzi ngendlela yokulinganisa amalungelo nemithwalo yemfanelo yazo zonke izindawo; kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezibopho zesiRepublic ezindaweni, njengoba iyilungu le-Southern African Development Community (SADC). Inhloso eyinhloko yeNqubomgomo ukuhlinzeka abakhiqizi namaqembu ngokuqondisa kokuyisebenzisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abane-HIV bayahluleka ukucwaswa endaweni yokusebenza futhi kubhekwe ukuhoxiswa kwabasebenzi; kanye nokuphatha izinqubo zokukhala. Inhloso elandelayo yenqubomgomo ukuhlinzeka abakhiqizi, abasebenzi, kanye namaqembu ngokuqondisa kokuphatha i-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza. Njengoba i-HIV/AIDS ithinta izindawo zokusebenza kanye nabantu ezingeni elihlukile, kudingeka ibhekwe ngendlela ethatha lezi zinto zonke zibe yinto eyodwa. Ngakho-ke, le Nqubomgomo ibandakanya izimiso ezixoxwe kabanzi ngaphansi kwemithetho ebhalwe esigabeni 5. ukuthuthukisa amasu enqubomgomo ukuze kuhlolwe isimo nokunciphisa umnikelo walolu sifo endaweni yokusebenza; kanye nokweseka labo baphila ne-HIV/AIDS nabathintekayo ukuze baqhubeke nokusebenza ngokukhiqiza isikhathi eside. phakathi kwabakhokhi, abasebenzi, kanye namaqembu endaweni yokusebenza; kanye phakathi kwendawo yokusebenza nabanye abathintekayo ezingeni lesigaba, emiphakathini, ezifundazweni, nakazwelonke. Ukwakhiwa kwendawo yokusebenza esekelayo kubasebenzi abaphila ne-HIV ukuze baqhubeke nokusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile kubalulekile lapho bezwa ukuthi bangakwazi ukuphatha isimo sabo sempilo. I-HIV/AIDS ithinta abesifazane ngendlela ehlukile kunabesilisa, ngakho lokhu kufanele kubhekwe lapho kuthuthukiswa izinqubo zenqubomgomo nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ukubonisana, okubandakanya bonke, nokukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza okuphelele kwazo zonke izindawo kuyisisekelo sezinqubo zonke zenqubomgomo nezinhlelo ze-HIV/AIDS. Bonke abakhiqizi nabasebenzi, kanye nezikhungo zabo, bayakhuthazwa ukuthi basebenzise le Nqubomgomo, ukuthuthukisa, ukuyisebenzisa, nokuyithuthukisa izinqubomgomo nezinhlelo zabo ze-HIV/AIDS ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zabo zokusebenza. Ngokusho kwezinhlelo zalesi Sifundo, igama 'indawo yokusebenza' kufanele liqondwe kabanzi kunencazelo enikezwe kwiMthetho Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi, Umthetho 66 ka-1995, isigaba 213, ukufaka noma iyiphi indawo lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, hhayi kuphela kulabo abaphansi kokubambisana kokusebenza kodwa futhi kulabo abasebenza ezindaweni ezingalandeli uhlelo nalabo abazimele. Nokho, le Nqubomgomo ayifaki imithwalo yemfanelo yomthetho ngaphezu kwalokho okukhona kwiMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi kanye neMthetho Wezobudlelwano Bezabasebenzi, noma yimuphi omunye umthetho okukhulunywa ngawo kule Nqubomgomo. Ukungahambisani akubeki umqashi endaweni yokubhekana nezinqubo zomthetho ezithile ngaphandle uma le Nqubomgomo ikhombe imithwalo ebekwe ngumthetho. Le Nqubomgomo kufanele ifundwe ndawonye nezinye izikhombisi ezinhle zokuziphatha ezingase zikhishwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi. Okuqukethwe kwale nqubomgomo kufanele kubhekwe lapho kuthuthukiswa, kuphathwa, noma kubuyekezwa noma yiziphi izinqubo zenqubomgomo nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nalolu hlelo lwezomthetho olukhulunywe ngenhla. Okulandelayo yizigaba ezikhethiwe, ezihlobene nezinye zezimiso ezikhulunywe ngenhla. Lezi kufanele zifundwe ndawonye nezinye izimiso. Le Nqubomgomo ikhululwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 54(a) seMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi, No 55 ka-1998, futhi isisekelo sayo siwumgomo wokuthi akekho umuntu okufanele acwaswe ngendlela engafanele ngoba ungena i-HIV. Ukuze kusizakale abakhiqizi nabasebenzi ekusebenziseni lo mgomo ngokungaguquguquki endaweni yokusebenza, le Nqubomgomo ihlolisise ezinye iziqondiso ezihlobene. Isigaba 6 seMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi sithi kunoma iyiphi inqubo yenqubomgomo nakuwo wonke amaphuzu, akekho umuntu, ophumelele, noma ofaka isicelo sokusebenza, okufanele acwaswe ngoba ungena i-HIV. Uma kukhona noma yiziphi izinqubo zomthetho eziphathelene nezinsolo zokucwaswa okungafanele ngumqashi, umqashi kumele anikeze ubufakazi bokuthi leyo mikhuba yokucwaswa noma yokwelashwa ngokwehlukana yayifanele. Akukho msebenzi noma umfakisicelo wokusebenza okufanele uphathwe ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ungena i-HIV. Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV kungaqhutshelwa ngumqashi noma ngabo, kuphela uma iNkantolo Yezabasebenzi ivumile leyo mikhuba njengokufanele nokufanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7 seMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24(e) seMthetho Wokwelashwa, No 131 ka-1998, uhlelo lwezokwelapha akufanele luhlukumeze ngqo noma ngokuqondile amalungu alo ngokusekelwe "esimweni sempilo" yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 67, izinhlelo zokulawula zingase zisetshenziswe ezidinga zonke izinhlelo zokwelapha ukuthi zibe nezinga elincane lezinsizakalo okufanele zibe khona kubo bonke amalungu okungenani. Akukho mqashi ovunyelwe ukusho ukuthi umqashi, noma umfakisicelo, kufanele ahlale ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi unayo noma cha. Ngokuhambisana neMthetho Wezokulingana Kwezemisebenzi, abakhiqizi bangasondela kwiNkantolo Yezabasebenzi ukuze
Noma iMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 ungumthetho. Manje, uMphakathi-Jikelele weMnyango weMvula neZihlahla, njengomholi wehhovisi lolwazi kulo Mnyango, ukhishile incwadi yolwazi yomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kulwazi olugcinwe nguMnyango njengoba kudingwa ngengxenye 14 yoMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi. Le ncwadi iyincwadi yeMnyango weMvula neZihlahla ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi, 2000 (Umthetho 2 ka-2000) [lo Mthetho]. Incazelo yesimo seMnyango nemisebenzi yawo. UMnyango, umholi wehhovisi lolwazi, kanye nazo zonke izinsizakusebenza zawo. Ulwazi olunembile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguMnyango. Isaziso sakamuva ngokwesigaba 15 soMthetho, esiqukethe lonke ulwazi, olugcinwe nguMnyango futhi olufinyeleleka kalula kubo bonke ngaphandle kwesidingo sokufaka isicelo kuMnyango. Incazelo yezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo emphakathini nokuthi lezi zinsizakalo zingafinyelelwa kanjani. Ukulandela izinhlelo ezihlosiwe zokunciphisa isidingo semvula, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukongiwa kwemvula ngokuphatha isidingo sayo. Ukukhuthaza ukusabalalisa okufanele, ukusetshenziswa okuhle, kanye nokuphathwa okunokuphelela kwezinsiza zamanzi nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha ezikhangayo. Izinsizakalo Zamanzi a Ukungenelela ngokuthatha izinyathelo zokutshala imali ekunikezeni insizakalo yokuletha amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nokuhambisa udoti kulawo maphuzu angakaze athole le nsizakalo b Ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kwehlelo lezinsizakalo zamanzi elibanjwe nguMnyango ukuze wabelane ngezinsika zezinsizakalo zamanzi c Ukuphatha nokuhola izenzo zamabhodi emvula d Ukusekela iziphathimandla zendawo ekuqaliseni inqubo yokuthatha umthwalo wokunikeza amanzi, nokuthuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zamanzi e Ukwakha nokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zamanzi nezinsizakalo zolwazi f Ukuhlola indlela yokunikeza izinsizakalo zokuhambisa udoti ngenhloso yokufeza ukuzinza, ukwaneliseka, ukungabizi kwezinsizakalo, nokuphakamisa umkhankaso kazwelonke wokuhlaziya inqubekela phambili ethile yokuhambisa udoti g Ukwakha uMnyango njengomthuthukisi wenqubomgomo yezinsizakalo zamanzi, isisekelo sokusekela, ukuphatha, nokuletha. Ngokusho koMthetho, uMphakathi-Jikelele ungumholi wehhovisi lolwazi lwe-DWAF. U-Mphakathi-Jikelele, ngokweMthetho, unegunya nemisebenzi edluliselwe ezinsizakalweni zeHhovisi Lolwazi ukuze akhuthaze uMthetho Wokufinyelela Kulwazi. Amagama abo kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana itholakala etafuleni elingezansi. Umphakathi-Jikelele: Imininingwane Yokuphathwa Kwelwazi. Ngokusho kwesigaba 1 sesigaba 10 soMthetho, uMphakathi weMikhakha Yezokwahlukanisa kumele, phakathi nezinyanga eziyi-18 ngemuva kokuqala kwalesi sigaba, akhiqize idokhumenti equkethe lolu lwazi ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni, ngendlela elula neyiqondakalayo, njengoba kungadingeka ngumuntu ofuna ukuzisebenzisa noma yiluphi ilungelo elinikezwe nguMthetho. Umfaki-sicelo kumele futhi achaze ukuthi ngabe ufuna ikhophi ephrintiwe yedokhumenti eqoshiwe noma ufuna ukuza ukuyibona edokhumenti eqoshiwe ehhovisi lomphakathi. Noma uma idokhumenti eqoshiwe ingeyona incwadi, ingabukwa ngendlela edingekayo, lapho isigaba 292 singasebenza khona. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela ngendlela ethile, umfaki-sicelo kumele anikezwe ukufinyelela ngendlela efunwayo, ngaphandle uma lokho kungaphazamisa ngokungafanele ukusebenza kwehhovisi elithintekayo, noma kulimaze idokhumenti eqoshiwe, noma kuvinjezele ukuhlinzekwa kwedokhumenti engemthethweni. Uma ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngendlela efunwayo ngenxa yezizathu ezinzima kodwa kunganikezwa ngenye indlela, imali yokufinyelela kumele ibalwe ngendlela umfaki-sicelo afuna ukufinyelela esigabeni 29 cha. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo ngendlela ehlukile, isibonelo, ngefoni, lokhu kumele kukhunjulwe esigabeni 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ulwazi egameni lomunye umuntu, izimo lapho isicelo senziwa kumele zicaciswe esigabeni 18 2f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma enokukhubazeka, angafaka isicelo sokukhuluma ukuze athole idokhumenti eqoshiwe. Umphakathi-Jikelele weHhovisi Lolwazi kumele aqedele ifomu lomfaki-sicelo futhi amnikeze ikhophi ngokwesigaba 18 3. Usizo lweHhovisi Lolwazi kumele lunikeze umfaki-sicelo (ngaphandle kwabafaki-sicelo abazenzela) izidingo zokukhokha imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuthi kuqhubeke nesicelo. Imali yesicelo ethathwa yihhovisi lomphakathi ingu-R35. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka isikhalazo phakathi, lapho kufanelekile, noma afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze aphikise isikhangiso noma akhokhe imali yesicelo. Ngemuva kokuthi Usizo lweHhovisi Lolwazi lwenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umfaki-sicelo kumele waziswa ngalesi sinqumo ngendlela umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngayo. Uma isicelo samukelwa, imali yokufinyelela kumele ikhokhwe ukuze kuhlolwe, kulungiswe, futhi kukhiqizwe, kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhathi esedlula amahora abekwe ukuze kuhlolwe nokulungiselela idokhumenti eqoshiwe ukuze ikhululwe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimiso zoMthetho ezibanjwe nguMnyango ziyagcinwa, ngokulandela nokuhlanganisa ulwazi. Isikhalazo singafakwa kuNgqongqoshe weMvula neZihlahla. Isicelo senkantolo singafakwa ngemuva kokuthi ihhovisi elinganeliseki lidlule zonke izinqubo zokukhala ngaphakathi, kodwa akukho okwenziwayo mayelana nesikhalazo sakhona. Ngokwethu, ulwazi olukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 14 (i) lungakakhanjiswa nguNgqongqoshe wezobuLungisa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Le ncwadi izobuyekezwa futhi iphume njalo ngonyaka ukuze ibikele umphakathi nganoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingase zenzeke kwi-DWAF. Izinqubo ezilandelwayo ukuze kwenziwe le ncwadi itholakale zizogcinwa ekubuyekezweni kwencwadi. Uma imisebenzi ye-DWAF ixhumene kakhulu nemisebenzi yezinye izigaba, uNgqongqoshe, uma efisa noma ngabe ngabe, angacela lezo zigaba ukuthi zikhulise incwadi eyodwa. I-DWAF kanye nezinye izigaba ezingaphezu kweyodwa kumele zabelane ngezindleko zokukhiqiza incwadi nokuyitholisa njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakucacisa. Uma imisebenzi ye-DWAF ingahlangene nanoma iyiphi isigaba somphakathi, zonke izindleko ezitholakele zokukhiqiza incwadi nokuyitholisa zizokwenziwa yi-DWAF. UNgqongqoshe wezobuLungisa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo angakhulula i-DWAF ekunikezeni ngaphansi kwesigaba 14 soMthetho, nganoma yisiphi isizathu sokuvikela, ukuphatha
Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwethula isu lokusebenza leMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke ethulwe nguNgqongqoshe. IMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke iwumphumela wezinkulumo eziningi ezazenzeka kusukela ngo-1995 lapho kwanikezwa khona iQembu Lezindaba Zolimi (LANGTAG). Isu lokusebenza linikeza iziqondiso ezizosebenza ekufezeni kahle leMithetho Yezilimi, kuthuthukiswe izakhiwo ezizoba nzima ekusebenzeni kwayo nasekuzameni ukuthuthukisa nokuqhakambisa izilimi zethu zendabuko zase-Afrika. Uhulumeni uyaziqonda izinselelo zokuphatha ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungakho isu lokusebenza ligcizelela inqubo ethokozisayo yokwamukela ushintsho futhi ibheke phambili. Njengoba ukuthuthukiswa nokukhuthazwa kwezilimi zethu kubhekwa njengesisekelo seMithetho Yezilimi, isu lokusebenza lihlose ukusungula izakhiwo zolimi nezinhlelo ezifanele zokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi kwiMisebenzi Yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ukubambisana esikubandakanya khona ezingeni likazwelonke, ezindaweni, nasemaphandleni kuzodlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi leMithetho Yezilimi isebenza kahle. Uma sicabanga ngezinselelo ezibhekene nohulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamizi zithola izinsizakalo ngokushesha futhi ukuthi ulimi luwumkhiqizo wokuxhumana nomphakathi, kubonakala ukuthi leMithetho Yezilimi kumele iqale ukusebenza ngokuphuthumayo. Ngale ndlela, ngifuna ukucela bonke abanye esibambisene nabo, kuhlanganise nezakhiwo nohulumeni kanye nezinsizakalo, kanye neBhodi Yezilimi Zendabuko yaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le Isu Lokusebenza lishintsha ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene kube yinto eqondile kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Le Isu Lokusebenza iyingxenye yeMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke (NLPF) eyenza ukuba kube namandla ezinhlinzeko zolimi njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 6 soMthethosisekelo ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996). Uma sekuqediwe, yonke leli phakethe izohlanganisa iMibiko yeMithetho Yezilimi, isu lokusebenza, uMthethosivivinywa wezilimi ophakanyisiwe kanye nezinhlinzeko zawo, kanye noMthethosivivinywa ophakanyisiwe weBhodi Yezazi Zezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Isu lokusebenza lihlinzekwa njengophakanyiso olwamukela ushintsho futhi lungashintshwa ngezakhiwo ezithile nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza izilimi ezahlukene. I-NLPF Policy Report yamemezelwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko Nezamasiko, Isayensi Nezobuchwepheshe ngomhla ka-3 kuZibandlela 2002. IBhodi yePhalamende yathola le mibiko ngomhla ka-12 kuNdasa 2003. Le mithetho ihlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanelekile kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni ukuze kukhuthazwe ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikahulumeni, ulwazi, nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Lezi zinhloso zixhomeke empumelelweni yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zendabuko ezisengcupheni. Njengoba ulimi luwumkhiqizo wokuxhumana ezimpilweni nasezindaweni zomphakathi, kubalulekile ukudala izinhlelo zokubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona. Isu lokusebenza lichaza izakhiwo ezidingekayo nezinhlelo zokwenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leMithetho Yezilimi kanye nezinsizakalo zezimali ezikhokhelwa ezikhungweni zikazwelonke nezasezifundazweni zisebenza kahle. Le mithetho icacile mayelana nesikhala salolu suku oluqondile. Zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni (kazwelonke, zasezifundazweni, nezasekhaya) zibophelelekile ezinhlinzekweni zalesi simiso kanye nanoma yiziphi izikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla noma ezisebenza emsebenzini womphakathi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho. Umnyango noma isifunda ngasinye singakhetha ulimi lwabo lokusebenza. Nokho, kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi akekho ophoqelelwe ukuthi asebenzise ulimi lwakhe. Uma kudingeka ukuhumusha noma ukuchaza idokhumenti ethile ngolimi oluthile, lokhu kuzokwenziwa. Mayelana nokuxhumana okubhalwe phansi, kufanele kulandelwe uhlelo lokushicilela oluqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene (kubhekwa izethameli, umlayezo, kanye nomongo) kulokhu okungadingi ukuhunyushwa kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11. Uma isikhungo esithile sikahulumeni sifuna ukuveza ulwazi ngokuqondile, kufanele shicilele ulwazi kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni. Ngaphansi kwezimo lapho imibhalo kahulumeni ingatholakali kuzo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni, izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kazwelonke kufanele zishicilele idokhumenti ngesikhathi esifanayo, okungenani ngolimi lwezingu-6. Umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngamathuba kufanele usebenze uma kukhethwa izilimi ezihlangene neNguni kanye neSotho. Isimo esithile esidingekayo ukuthi silandelwe ukuthi okungenani izinsizakalo zikahulumeni kazwelonke zikhawulelwa ekushicileleni imibhalo esemthethweni ngolimi lwezingu-6 noma ngaphezulu. Umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngamathuba awusebenzi ezifundazweni ngoba zinegunya lokusebenzisa izilimi abazikhethayo. Izinsizakalo zikahulumeni zasekhaya zizokwenza isinqumo sokusebenzisa ulimi njengoba kufunwa umphakathi kulandela umgomo wezilimi owakhiwe esifundeni. Ngemuva kokunquma ulimi oluzosetshenziswa futhi olucelwe umphakathi, uhulumeni wasekhaya kufanele uthuthukise, ushicilele, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umthetho wezilimi ezahlukene uyasebenza, okumele kwenziwe ngokuxhumana eduze nomphakathi. Emibhalweni esemthethweni, ulimi olukhethwe yisakhamuzi kufanele lusetshenziswe. Zonke izindlela zokuxhumana kufanele zenzeke ngolimi olusemthethweni olukhethwe yilabo abantu noma indawo. Uma kudingeka, zonke izindlela kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kusebenze izinsiza zolimi ezifana nokuhumusha (ukulandela ukukhuluma, ukuhumusha ngesikhathi esifanayo, ukuhumusha ngefoni, noma ukuhumusha ngomsindo) uma kukhona indlela. Lokhu kusebenza ezinsizakalweni zikahulumeni ezingeni lesifunda nakwazwelonke. Inqubo yokwenza lokhu okwenziwe ibhizinisi iqondiswa yizinhloso nezifiso ezibekwe kule mithetho. Lezi zindawo ezilandelayo zizogxilwa kuzo: a Ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zendabuko kuhambisana nokwakha izakhiwo nokuthuthukisa imikhiqizo efana nezichazamazwi nezincazelo zolimi. b Ukukhulisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinzuzo zezinqubomgomo zomphakathi zabelwa ngokufanele ngokuhlinzeka zonke izakhamizi ithuba lokufinyelela kuzo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yisiphi ulimi abakusebenzisa, inqobo nje uma kukhuthazwa ukubamba iqhaza kwabo nezwi ematsheni kahulumeni. c Ukuphathwa kwezilimi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni zine-ithuba lokusebenza nokukhulisa isithunzi soHulumeni. d Ukukhuthaza ukufunda izilimi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezidingo zeMisebenzi Yomphakathi, ukuthuthukisa ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi nokubonisa kahle izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izilimi ezahlukene. e Ukukhuthaza ukuvikelwa okuqinile ngokuhlanganyela kwezilimi
Umthetho ophathelene nezinkambiso usuthinteke kakhulu yisinqumo esithathiwe emcimbini kaBhe, owashintsha indlela yokwabiwa kokuhlala kwabafileyo. Ubuye washintsha indlela uMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Komthethosisekelo uphatha ngayo ukuphathwa kwezindlu zabafileyo. Kwakutheni esinqumweni sikaBhe? Ngesikhathi esaphila, umufi wayehlala noNkk. Bhe kanye nengane yabo eyodwa kwezimbili eKhayelitsha. Kwakukhona ukungabaza ukuthi uBhe noNkk. Bhe babashadile noma cha. Indodakazi yabo yesibili yayihlala noyise umufi eBerlin, okuyindawo eseMpumalanga Kapa. Umufi washona ngaphandle kokubhala ifa, ngakho-ke impahla yakhe yabiwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nezinkambiso. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uyise umufi wayezothola yonke impahla, ngaphandle kukaNkk. Bhe nezingane zabo. Impahla yayiqukethe ishayela nomhlaba owawakhiwe phezu kwawo. Uyi sebenzisa umhlaba ukuze akhokhe umngcwabo wendodana yakhe. Uma eqhubeka kanje, uNkk. Bhe nezingane bazoshiywa bengenalutho. UNkk. Bhe ufake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi izingane zakhe ezimbili ziqashelwe njengezizokwazi kuphela ukufaka ifa likayise. INkantolo yoMthethosisekelo yanquma ukuthi indlela yokwabiwa kwezakhamuzi ngaphansi komthetho wezinkambiso ibekwe emkhakheni 23 weMthetho Wokuphatha Wabantu Abamnyama, ngakho-ke ayihambisani nezinselelo zokushintsha kwezimo zomphakathi ezazisunguliwe kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngakho-ke, bekungasasebenzi kahle futhi bekungahambisani nezidingo zangempela zezindawo zasemadolobheni nezinguquko eziphakathi kwemindeni. Isimo samanje sikhombisa ukuthi asihambisani nendlela yeqembu elikhulu ngoba sikhubaza ngokobulili nasemzini. Ubani uMphakathi Wamandla (NER)? Ukulawula imboni yamandla ngokuhambisana nemithetho, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezindlela ezinhle zokusebenza zik gouvernement ezingeni lesizwe nakwamanye amazwe ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa okukhuthazayo. Ukuba ngumholi emhlabeni jikelele ekulawuleni ugesi. U-National Energy Regulator angakusiza kanjani? Umthetho Wokufaka Ugesi No. 41 ka-1987, njengoba ushintshiwe, unika amandla i-National Energy Regulator, phakathi kokunye, ukuxazulula izingxabano phakathi kwabathengisi bagesi nabathengi, kanye phakathi kwabathengisi bagesi uqobo. Uma ungathanda ukuxoxa ngendlela umthengisi wakho kagesi abhekane ngayo nezikhalazo zakho, i-National Energy Regulator ingakusiza. Yiziphi izinhlobo zezikhala i-National Energy Regulator engakusiza ngazo? Nikeza yonke imininingwane efanele yesikhalazo. Bonke abathengisi bendawo kumele babe nelayisense etholelwe ku-NER. Akukho mthengisi wendawo onelungelo lokuhlinzeka noma ukuhlinzeka ngogesi kubathengi ngaphandle kokuba unikezwe igunya yi-NER. Umthengisi wendawo akakwazi ukudlulisa ilayisense yakhe yokufaka ugesi kumthengisi wendawo omunye ngaphandle kwemvume ye-NER. Umthengisi wendawo akanalo ilungelo lokukhokhisa amakhasimende nganoma iyiphi imali engavunyelwe yi-NER noma ukuguqula ukufakwa ngaphandle kwemvume ye-NER. Amakhasimende asenalo ilungelo lokuqhubeka nokukhokha izimali ezivunyelwe noma ngabe umthengisi wendawo uqala ukusebenzisa imali entsha. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngogesi kumuntu noma umthengisi osemthethweni endaweni okufanele kuhlinzekwe kuyo uma umthengi ekwazi ukukhokha insizakalo enikeziwe nokuthi uma efuna ukukhokha. Umthengisi wendawo kumele anikeze umthengi isakhiwo nezinga lokukhokha elifanele uma umthengi efaka isicelo sokuhlinzekwa kwensizakalo nangokucelwa. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokwazisa amakhasimende abo ngokuqhuba izinga lokukhokha, izinketho ezihlukene zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, nokuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile uma befaka izicelo zokuhlinzekwa ngogesi. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ngakolunye uhlangothi, abathengi banelungelo lokubuza ngemali yokukhokha ezohlangabezana kangcono nezidingo zabo. Kulabo abathengi abasebenzisa ugesi we-prepaid, umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokubavulela indawo yokuthengisa lapho bangathenga khona ama-voucher. Lezi zindawo zokuthengisa kumele zibe ezitholakala kalula. Uma umthengi ebhila, ibhili kufanele ibonise lokhu, futhi noma iyiphi imali edlulelwe umthengi ngesikhathi esithile kufanele ibuyiselwe ku-akhawunti yomthengi. Uma umthengi enza isikhalazo, bangacela umthengisi ukuba ahlole ukunemba kwemitha ngokukhokha umthengi imali ethile, ezobuyiselwa umthengisi uma kutholakala ukuthi imitha iyaphuka. Umthengi unomsebenzi wokwazisa umthengisi wendawo uma ethuthela kwenye indlu, efuna ukuvalela ukuhlinzekwa ngogesi, noma efuna ukudlulela endaweni entsha. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokufundisa kubathengi mayelana nokusebenzisa ugesi ngokuphepha, kahle, nangempumelelo noma yini ehlobene nokuhlinzekwa kagesi okungathuthukisa ukuqonda kwabathengi mayelana nokusetshenziswa kagesi. Umthengisi wendawo unomsebenzi wokwazisa abathengi ngama-charges ahlukene, indlela yokufaka izicelo, umthelela wabo, kanye nokufaneleka. Ikhophi yeSikhumbuzo seSikhungo itholakala kubakhiqizi boMnyango noma uMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Yini inhloso yeSikhumbuzo seSikhungo? ISikhumbuzo seSikhungo sichaza izimo zokusebenza zabasebenzi bezihlahla kanye nabanye abasebenzi bezihlahla, kuhlanganise nezinto ezifana nezinsuku zokusebenza, izikhathi zokuphumula, imininingwane yokusebenza, kanye nokupheliswa kokusebenza. Iphinde ichaze nemiholo encane okufanele ikhokhwe ngabaphathi. Bonke abahlwanyela izihlahla; abaqashi bezikhathi ezithile; abaqashi abachitha isikhathi esiningi emsebenzini wezihlahla; bonke abahamba embonini yezihlahla; umsebenzi wasekhaya oqashwe endaweni lapho kuhlwanyelwa khona izihlahla; umgibeli oqashwe ehlathini kodwa engaphansi kwenkampani yokuvikela eyimfihlo. Ubani ongengxenye yalezi? Abaphathi abangahlanganisi izigaba zokuhlwanyela; amahlathi omphakathi; amahlathi okugcina imvelo; noma noma ubani oqashwe noma obandakanyeka emsebenzini wezihlahla ngaphansi kwesikhumbuzo seSikhungo noma ngaphansi kwesivumelwano esivumelanayo nebhodi labasebenzi njengoba kuchazwe kuMthetho Wezobudlelwano Babasebenzi ka-1995, isibonelo, umthetho ophatha ngaphansi kweBhodi Labashayeli Bezokuthutha kanye nomsebenzi wokusika nokuguqula izihlahla zibe omunye umkhiqizo, ngokuhlanganyela nomkhakha wezinkuni nephepha, nokunye. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nemiholo? Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bakhokhelwe okungenani imiholo efana naleyo echazwe etafuleni elingezansi. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla bathola imiholo efanayo? Bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bathole okungenani imiholo echazwe etafuleni 1. Nokho, abasebenzi bezihlahla abathola ngaphezu kwemali ebekiwe bazoqhubeka bethola imiholo ephezulu. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi ongenaminyaka engu-15 noma ngaphezulu kodwa engakafiki eminyakeni engu-18 osebenza amahora angama-35 ngesonto okungenani imali ethile echazwe etafuleni 1. Ngemuva konyaka owodwa sokuthi iSikhumbuzo seSikhungo sibe semthethweni, imiholo izonyuka ngama-2% we-CPI (Consumer Price Index). Umphathi nomsebenzi wezihlahla bangavuma ngokubhala ukuthi umsebenzi wezihlahla uqedela umsebenzi wezimpahla ngezikhathi ezichaziwe. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla oqashwe ngaphansi kwalesi simo, ukukhokha akufanele kube ngaphansi kwemiholo encane kanye nezinga elisebenzayo ngaphansi kwalesi simo. Noma yini ebalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe izinga lokuphepha nempilo. Umphathi angakhipha imali kuphela ngezizathu ezihlinzekwe yiSikhumbuzo seSikhungo. Abasebenzi bezihlahla kumele bavume ngokubhala ukuncishiswa. Akukho ukuncishiswa kokuhlala okufanele kudlule ama-10% emiholweni yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Ukuncishiswa kokudla akufanele kudlule ama-10% emiholweni yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Uma kukhona abasebenzi bezihlahla ababili noma ngaphezulu abahlala endaweni yokusebenza, inani eliphelele lemali elingancishiswa kubo bonke abasebenzi bezihlahla abahlala kufanele lingadluli ku-25% ethathwe ezingeni lemiholo eliphansi kumuntu osebenza ehlathini. Ngamanye amazwi, uma kukhona abasebenzi bezihlahla abahlanu abahlala ngaphakathi kwenkampani, inani eliphezulu elingancishiswa kumuntu ngamunye lingama-5%. Indlu kumele ibe nekhono elikhulu elingama-30 square meters okungenani. Abasebenzi bezihlahla banesibopho sokubheka impahla yomphathi wabo. Impahla yomphathi ifaka imishini noma ezinye amathuluzi asetshenziswa ngabo ngesikhathi besebenza. Uma umsebenzi wezihlahla engaziphathi kahle ekubhekeni impahla yabo, umphathi angancisha imali ngenxa yokulahleka noma ukonakala. Kumele banikeze umsebenzi wezihlahla ithuba lokukhombisa ukuthi kungani imali ingancishiswa emiholweni yabo. Qinisekisa ukuthi inani elincishisiwe alidluli ingxenye eyodwa ye-quarters yemiholo yomsebenzi wezihlahla. Amalungelo nezibopho zabaphathi kanye nabasebenzi bezihlahla emkhakheni wezihlahla akhishwa ngendlela efuna ukuxazulula izidingo zombili izinhlangothi. Kungaki amahora ongawasebenza umsebenzi wezihlahla ngesonto? Amahora ayisishiyagalolunye ngosuku, uma umsebenzi wezihlahla esebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu noma ngaphansi kwesonto; noma amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku, uma umsebenzi wezihlahla esebenza ezinsukwini ezingaphezu kwezihlanu ngesonto. Umsebenzi akufanele asebenze amahora angaphezu kwama-12 ngosuku. Ngenxa yokuthi umsebenzi wezihlahla akufanele asebenze amahora angaphezu kwama-45 ngesonto, umsebenzi wezihlahla osebenza amahora ayishumi ezinsukwini ezine akufanele asebenze amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku lwesihlanu. Amahora angaphezu kwenqubo kumele akhokhelwe ngentengo ejwayelekile yansuku zonke ehambisana nengxenye yemiholo ejwayelekile yomsebenzi. Isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo kumele sinikezwe ngaphambi kokuphela kwenyanga kusukela ngosuku lokuqala umsebenzisi athola ilungelo lokuphumula. Nokho, isivumelwano sokubhala singakhulisa lesi sikhathi sibe yizinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Isivumelwano sokubhala singacela noma sivumele umsebenzi wezihlahla ukuba asebenze amahora ayishumi ngosuku ngokuhlanganyela nezikhathi zokuphumula zokudla ngaphandle kokukhokhelwa amahora angaphezu kwenqubo. Ngaphezu kwezinsuku eziyisihlanu ngesonto. Uma usuku lokuphumula luhlangana nosuku olujwayelekile lokusebenza kwabantu bezihlahla, umphathi kumele akhokhele labo abanganqikazi okungenani imiholo ejwayelekile efana nosuku. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla noma yiziphi izinzuzo ezitholakele zokusebenza ngosuku lokuphumula ngosuku lokukhokhela ejwayelekile. Abaphathi kumele baziqhenye ngabasebenzi bezihlahla abajwayele ukuba basebenze ebusuku mayelana nezimo ezibucayi ezihambisana nomsebenzi kanye nelungelo labasebenzi ukuba bahlolwe uma bebuza njalo lapho izindleko zikhokhelwa umphathi. Umphathi kumele akhokhele umsebenzi wezihlahla olindele umcalla inzuzo yokulinda. Le nzuzo kumele ibe okungenani u-10% wemiholo ejwayelekile yomsebenzi. Isivumelwano singasusa isikhathi sokuphumula sokudla kumsebenzi wezihlahla osebenza ngaphansi kwamahora ayisithupha ngosuku. Isivumelwano sokubhala singanikeza okungenani amahora angama-60 wesikhathi sokuphumula njalo ngesonto lesibili noma sinciphise isikhathi sokuphumula ngesonto ukuze sifinyelele amahora ayisishiyagalombili ngesonto, uma isikhathi sokuphumula sikhuliswa ngokulinganayo ngesonto elilandelayo. Yiziphi izinhlobo zokuphuma ezingathathwa ngumsebenzi wezihlahla? Kungaki izinsuku ezingathathwa ngumsebenzi wezihlahla ngonyaka? Umsebenzi wezihlahla unelungelo lokuthatha izinsuku ezintathu zokuphumula unyaka nonyaka. Kwenzekani uma usuku lokuphumula luhlangana nezinsuku zokuphumula? Yini ebalulekile mayelana nezinsuku zokuphumula? Ukusekelwa noma isikhathi esibaliwe ngokusekelwe kumalungelo okuphuma siyi-36 izinyanga ezithathwe ekubhaleni kwezinsuku ezisebenze phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisithupha. Umsebenzi wezihlahla use
Le ncwadi isekelwe kulwazi olunikezwe yizikhungo ezifanele, noma ngqo noma ngamawebhusayithi azo. Abacwaningi bacabange ukuthi lonke ulwazi lunikezwa ngenhloso enhle futhi luyiqiniso. Asikwazi ukubekwa icala ngokunembile nangokuphelele kolwazi olunikezwe kithi. Uma ufuna ukuthi inhlangano yakho ifakwe ezibuyekezeni ezizayo zalesi sithombe, sicela uthumele i-imeyili ku: kmosweu@deat.gov. Izinhlangano ezincane, eziphakathi, nezinkulu (SMMEs) ziyizinjini zokuthuthukiswa. Zifaka isandla ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi nasekuphakamiseni umnotho. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi ama-SMMEs ezokuvakasha asungulwe ukuze azimele futhi akhule. Ukuze sithole usizo ngalokhu, uMnyango Wezindaba Zemvelo Nezokuvakasha, ngokuqhuba iSigaba Sawo Sezokuvakasha, uthuthukise iqoqo lezinsiza ezihloselwe ukusiza osomabhizinisi bezokuvakasha bathuthukise amabhizinisi abo futhi babe nenzuzo. Le ncwadi ibaluleke kakhulu njengoba ihlinzeka ngendawo eyodwa efanele yokufinyelela ulwazi, ikakhulukazi kubasomabhizinisi bezokuvakasha, ngoxhaso lwamabhizinisi olukhona kubo. Lapho iqala, le ncwadi izotholakala nangezinye izilimi ezisemthethweni, okungukuthi isiZulu, isiSetswana, nesiBhunu. Sizophinde sithuthukise le ncwadi minyaka yonke futhi siyihumushe ngezilimi eziningi. Anginankinga yokuthi uzothola le ncwadi iyinsiza ewusizo emizamweni yakho yokwakha ibhizinisi elizinzile nelinenzuzo. Nginecebo elihle! Ngaphi engingathola khona uxhaso lokuqala ibhizinisi lami? Imibuzo - Yini engingayenza ukuze ngibe umthengisi? Yilapho ungene kule ndawo enhle yezokuvakasha. Sithemba ukuthi uzothola le ncwadi ewusizo. Le ncwadi izokunikeza ulwazi oluwusizo ukusiza emizamweni yakho yokwakha ibhizinisi elihlobene nezokuvakasha. Iqukethe izihloko ezivela ekubhaleni kwezinhlelo zebhizinisi ukuya ekutholeni uxhaso lwezezimali nasekunikezeni ulwazi olubalulekile lokuxhumana. Sicela ukhumbule ukuthi le yindlela ejwayelekile, ngakho-ke siphakamisa kakhulu ukuthi ubheke emithonjeni yolwazi ehlukene. Omunye wemisebenzi ebalulekile yale ncwadi ukuthi ihlinzeka ngolwazi ngazo zonke iziqalo ezikhona ukusiza ukwakha ibhizinisi elisha noma ukukhulisa elikhona. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuze uthole ukuthi ubani ongaba ngcono kuwe futhi uxhumane nabo ngqo. Khumbula ukuthi izikhungo eziningi zinikeza izinsizakalo ezahlukene nokuxhaso. Ukuze sigcine isikhala kule ncwadi, asiphindi imininingwane yabo kodwa sikunikeze ikhasi elihambelana nalokho okufanele ubheke kulo. Izifunda eziningi zinezikhungo zazo ezizimele nezincwadi ezinhle ezishicilelwe. Xhumana nabo ngqo usebenzisa ulwazi lokuxhumana olunikezwe eMkhakheni 5. Ukusungula ibhizinisi lakho akulula futhi kudinga umsebenzi onzima nokuzinikela. Izokuvakasha zihluke futhi zisebenza ngendlela ehlukile kwezinye izimboni kulokhu. Sifake imibuzo ejabulisayo eMkhakheni 5 ukuze sikunikeze umbono wokuthi unakho yini okudingekayo ukuze ungene ebhizinisini. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuqoqa ulwazi olunembile ngangokunokwenzeka. Funda ngendlela engcono kakhulu ongayenza - lokhu kufaka phakathi amaphephandaba, izincwadi, namawebhusayithi. Kubalulekile ukubheka le ncwadi njengendawo yokuhlanganisa, hhayi njengomhlahlandlela oqinile wokuba nebhizinisi lezokuvakasha eliphumelelayo. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuthola olunye ulwazi futhi ungayeki ukufunda ngibhizinisi lakho nezokuvakasha. Ithuluzi Lebhizinisi. Siphakamisa ukuthi ufike kulolu lwazi ukuze uthole ulwazi olujulile, uma kudingeka. Sikufisela inhlanhla futhi siyakwamukela kule ndawo enhle yezokuvakasha! Kube nokuxoxisana okuthile mayelana nencazelo yegama elithi "umvakashi" nokuthi yiziphi izinkampani ezihlinzeka ngempilo kubavakashi. Umvakashi ungumuntu ovakashela futhi ohlala ngaphandle kwendawo ehlukile kulokho abajwayele ukukwenza isikhathi esithile futhi angaba "umvakashi wendawo" - othile ophila eNingizimu Afrika kodwa uvakashele esinye isifunda sezwe nomndeni nabangani ukuze ajabulele; "umvakashi wezebhizinisi" ohamba evela kwezinye izindawo noma ngaphakathi eNingizimu Afrika ukuze aqhube imisebenzi yebhizinisi noma "umvakashi wamazwe omhlaba" ovakashela eNingizimu Afrika evela kwezinye izindawo ukuze abone lokho esingakuhlinzeka. Izokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika ifaka zonke izigaba ezisebenzela ukwenza isipiliyoni somvakashi ezweni lethu sibe mnandi futhi sikhumbulekayo. Ukuhlinzeka Ngabavakashi (ukuhlala) kuhilela ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, isibonelo, ukulala nokudla kwasekuseni, izindlu zokwamukela izivakashi, izinsiza zokuzikhethela, amahostela amasha, ama-lodges, amahhotela, njll. I-MICE (Imihlangano, Izikhuthazo, Imicimbi, Nezikhathi) iyisigaba esihloselwe ikakhulukazi ukuhlela nokuphatha imihlangano nezinye izenzakalo ezifana nezinkomfa nokwenza kube nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abameleli abakhethiwe bathola itiye nelunch. Ndawonye sizokwakha umkhiqizo wezokuvakasha ongathengiswa emhlabeni jikelele ngokusebenzisa izinkomfa zamazwe omhlaba, sikhuthaza izivakashi ukuthi zize zibone lokho ezweni lethu elihle elinokuhamba, izindawo ezinhle, izikhumbuzo zomlando, abantu abahle, izindawo zokuthenga, nezindawo eziningi ezihlukile nezithokozisayo eNingizimu Afrika. Izokuvakasha ihlobene nezalmost zonke ezinye izenzo ezweni ngendlela ethile. Kodwa isebenzisa eyodwa noma ngaphezulu (umuntu ophakathi). Ndawonye nokuthi zonke lezi zisebenza kanjani ndawonye, ziletha abavakashi ezindaweni zabo emhlabeni jikelele eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthola ukuqonda okucacile kokuthi ubani ozosebenzisa imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho ekugcineni, ubani okufanele uxhumane naye ohambweni lwakho lokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi. Sifake isithombe ngezansi ukuze sikhombise ukuthi le nqubo ingasebenza kanjani kumhlinzeki wezokwamukela nokuthi ubani ozothola izinzuzo kulolu hlelo. Uzobona ukuthi zonke izinhlangothi zithola izinzuzo kumhlinzeki wezokwamukela - empeleni, bangaba abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo kumphathi wendawo yokuhlala. Xhumana neNhlangano Yezokuvakasha yendawo ukuze uthole izeluleko zokuthi ungakha kanjani ibhizinisi lakho. Ulwazi oluningi lufakwe esigabeni Sokumaketha seMkhakheni 4. Uhlelo lwecebo luzosungulwa kanjani futhi umsebenzisi uzothenga kanjani iholidi? Kube nolwazi oluningi muva nje mayelana nezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, futhi siyaziqhenya kakhulu ngokwanda kwenani labavakashi abavakashela ezweni lethu elihle. UMnyango Wezabasebenzi usungule umthetho omusha, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo. Ikhophi yokuhlonza umkhakha iyatholakala kubathengisi bezincwadi eMnyangweni Wezabasebenzi futhi iyatholakala ku-inthanethi: www.labour.gov. Yini inhloso yokuhlonza umkhakha? Ukuhlonza umkhakha contains izimo zokusebenza zabasebenzi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo ezifana nezikhathi zokusebenza, izikhathi zokuphumula, imininingwane, kanye nokuphela kwemigomo yokusebenza. Iphinde ibheke emiholweni elindelekile nokuthi yini okufanele ikhokhwe ngabaqashi. Ubani ophazamisekile yile mthetho? Noma yimuphi umsebenzi ophazamisa lowo mqashi, ongagcini ekuthengiseni, ukugcina impahla, noma ukusabalalisa, noma yimuphi umsebenzi osiza ibhizinisi lomqashi noma noma yimuphi umsebenzi owenziwa ezindaweni zalesi bhizinisi okungaphansi kwesisekelo somsebenzi esihlanganiswe nale mthetho. Ubani ongaphazamiseki yile mthetho? Abasebenzi abawasebenzeli amahora angama-24 noma ngaphansi ngenyanga abaphazamiseki. Uma kukhona udaba olungakhulunywanga kulolu hlelo, izinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wezimo Eziyisisekelo Zokusebenza (BCEA) zizosebenza kubaqashi nabasebenzi kule mkhakha. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nemiholo? Umthetho uthi bonke abasebenzi kumele bathole okungenani imiholo ekhombisa kumathebula 1 kuya ku-3. Ingabe bonke abasebenzi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo bazothola imiholo efanayo? Abasebenzi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo kumele bathole okungenani izimali ezikhuluma kumathebula akhuluma ngenhla. Nokho, abasebenzi abathola imiholo ephezulu kunezikhombisa bazoqhubeka nokuthola lezo zikhombisa ngoba imigomo yokusebenza ayinakushintshwa nganoma iyiphi indlela. Noma okungenani inani ngamahora njengoba kucacisiwe kumathebula 1 kuya ku-3 ngamahora noma ingxenye yayo esebenziswe ngumsebenzi. Uma lowo msebenzi ukhiqiza noma uthengisa ngaphansi kwemiholo encane ebekwe ngenxa yezizathu ezibangelwa umqashi, kumele athole imiholo ekhombisayo. Babalwa ngokusebenzisa amahora asebenze aphelele ngosuku/amahora = imiholo ngamahora aphelele evikini/amahora evikini = imiholo ngamahora aphelele evikini/izinsuku ezisebenze = imiholo ngosuku aphelele ngenyanga/4. Imiholo yabasebenzi evikini lapho ukukhokha kungabalwa ngokubheka isikhathi noma lapho bethola imiholo eguquguqukayo ibalwa ngokusekelwe enanini eliphelele elihlanganiswe ezinsukwini eziyi-13 uma uhlukanisa ngama-13. I-slip yemiholo iyimpahla yomsebenzi. Imiholo izonyuka ngesilinganiso sokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila esihlanganiswe nephesenti elilodwa ezinyangeni zokuqala ezingu-12. Imiholo izonyuka ngesilinganiso sokukhuphuka kwezindleko zokuphila esihlanganiswe nephesenti elilodwa eminyakeni yesibili ngemuva kokuqala kwalolu hlelo. Uma i-CPIX ingama-10% noma ngaphezulu, imiholo ekhombisayo izonyuka ngesilinganiso se-CPIX. Ukuhlinzekwa kokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokuphepha nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Umthetho uthi ini mayelana nezikhwama ezikhishwayo emiholweni? Umqashi akufanele akhumbuze umsebenzi ukuthi asayine imali eyengeziwe. Qaphela: Amahora achazwe ngenhla awasebenzi kubaphathi abaphezulu, abathengisi abahamba, noma abasebenzi abathola ngaphezulu kwe-R115,572. Amahora okusebenza kubasebenzi awangaphansi kwamahora angama-27. Ngoba umsebenzi akufanele asebenze ngaphezu kwamahora angama-45 evikini, umsebenzi osebenza amahora ayishumi ezinsukwini ezine akufanele asebenze ngaphezu kwamahora ayisishiyagalombili ngosuku lwesihlanu. Isivumelwano esibhaliwe akufanele sidlule ezinyangeni ezi-2 phakathi nesikhathi esiyishumi. Isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo kumele sinikezwe kungakapheli inyanga eyodwa ngemuva kokuthola imvume yesikhathi. Nokho, isivumelwano esibhaliwe singakhulisa lesi sikhathi sibe yizinyanga eziyi-12. Ngaphezu kwamahora angama-45 ajwayelekile evikini ngosuku oluthile lwamahora ayishumi okungeziwe evikini; noma ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezinhlanu evikini. Isivumelwano sizophela ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-12. Umsebenzi kumele akhokhelwe kuphela ingxenye yesikhathi sokuphumula, edlula imizuzu engamashumi ayisikhombisa. Isikhathi sokuphumula evikini kumele kube okungenani ngemuva kwamahora angama-36 alandelanayo ngaphandle uma kukhona esinye isivumelwano, okukhuluma ngeSonto. Isivumelwano esibhaliwe singahlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokuphumula okungenani ngemuva kwamahora angama-60 alandelanayo, njalo ngemuva kwesonto lesibili. Ukukhokha ngomsebenzi ngeSonto. Isivumelwano singavumela umqashi ukuba anikeze umuntu osebenza ngeSonto isikhathi sokuphumula esikhokhelwayo esilingana nomphumela phakathi kwenani elitholwe ngumsebenzi ngokusebenza ngeSonto kanye nezinkokhelo ezivunyelwe ukuba zitholwe ngalowo msebenzi. Kumele bazi ngezimo zokuphepha nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kanye namalungelo abo okuhlolwa kwezempilo. Umsebenzi osebenza ngosuku lwezinsuku zomphakathi oluhlangana nosuku oluvamile lokusebenza komsebenzi kumele athole ukukhokhelwa kabili ngokuya ngomsebenzi wabo. Yimiphi imikhakha yokuphumula engathathwa ngumsebenzi? Kukhona izinsuku ezingaki ezitholwa ngumsebenzi ngonyaka? Abasebenzi banelungelo lokuphumula izinsuku ezintathu ngonyaka. Kwenzekani uma usuku lwezinsuku zomphakathi luhlangana nesikhathi sokuphumula sonyaka? Yini okufanele ibhekwe mayelana nezinsuku zokugula? Isikhathi sokugula sikhuluma ngenyanga ezingama-36 futhi sibalwa ngokusekelwe enanini lezinsuku ezisebenze ezinsukwini eziyisithupha. Abasebenzi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa nezokuthengisa ngempumelelo basebenza ezinsukwini ezinhlanu evikini. Isikhathi sokugula sibalwa ngokuthatha izinsuku ezinhlanu zaphindwe ngama-6 (5x6) okukhombisa izinsuku ezingama-30 phakathi nesikhathi seminyaka emithathu. Umqashi angacela isitifiketi sezokwelapha uma umsebenzi engasebenzi izinsuku ezimbili ezilandelanayo noma kabili ezinsukwini eziyisithupha. Yini isikhathi sokuphila komndeni? Lokhu kuyisikhathi esinikezwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile ezithinta umndeni. Ubani onelungelo lesi sikhathi sokuphila? Abasebenzi abaqashwe ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezine futhi abasebenza okungenani ezinsukwini ezine evikini bangathatha izinsuku ezine zesikhathi sokuphila komndeni ngonyaka. Nini lesi sikhathi singathathwa? Lesi sikhathi singathathwa uma kukhulelwa ingane, uma ingane igula, noma uma umkakhe, umkhulu, ingane, umndeni, noma umfowethu womsebenzi eshona. Yiziphi izinto ezithinta isikhathi sokubeletha? Umsebenzi angabuyela emsebenzini ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ngemuva kokubeletha ingane ngaphandle uma udokotela noma umphakathi unikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi umsebenzi angabuyela emsebenzini. Kulokhu, isaziso sosuku lokuhamba nokubuyela emsebenzini kumele sinike
Kucacile ukuthi le mpilo ye-HIV/AIDS izothinta zonke izindawo zokusebenza, lapho abasebenzi behlupheka ngezifo zesikhathi eside, behluleka ukuya emsebenzini, abanye befa, ukukhiqiza kwehla, nezinsiza zabasebenzi zithinteka, kanye nempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini, izindleko zokukhiqiza, kanye nokukhuthazeka emsebenzini. I-HIV ayinazikhala; ibhujiswa kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi, kungakhathaliseki ubulili, iminyaka, noma ubuzwe; kodwa manje sekuyaziwa ukuthi isimo somnotho sabantu sinomthelela ekusabalaleni nasekuqhamukeni kwalesi sifo. I-HIV iba yinhlekelele kakhulu ezindaweni nasemiphakathini ezungezwe ubuphofu, lapho kushintsha okusheshayo kwenzeka, njengokwethulwa kwezindlela zokuphila zasemadolobheni nezindlela, kanye nokwanda kokuhlukumezeka nokungazinzi. Ukusabalala kwalesi sifo kuphuthumisa ukuhamba kwabantu besuka ezindaweni zasemakhaya baye ezikhungweni zasemadolobheni. Abesifazane, ikakhulukazi, bahlala besengozini enkulu yokuthola leli gciwane ngenxa yezindlela zamasiko nezincithakalo zomnotho ezivimbela ukuba bathathe ukulawula izimpilo zabo. Enye yezindlela ezisebenza kahle zokunciphisa nokuphatha umthelela we-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza wukusebenzisa umthetho kanye nohlelo lwe-HIV/AIDS. Ukubhekana nezindaba ezithile ze-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza kuzokwenza abasebenzi, amaqembu, kanye nohulumeni babe nethuba lokwenza umnikelo ophawulekayo emizamweni yasendaweni, kazwelonke, nasemhlabeni jikelele yokuvimbela nokulawula i-HIV/AIDS. Ngakho, umthetho uhlose ukuhlela abaqashi, amaqembu, kanye nabasebenzi ngendlela yokulinganisa amalungelo nezibopho zazo zonke izithakazelo; kanye nokuphumelelisa izibopho zeRiphabhulikhi ezindaweni, njengoba iyilungu leNhlangano Yentuthuko YaseNingizimu Afrika (SADC). Inhloso eyinhloko yomthetho ukuhlinzeka abaqashi namaqembu ngemihlahlandlela yokuyisebenzisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi labo abane-HIV bayahlulelwa ngokungafanele endaweni yokusebenza futhi kubhekwe ukuhoxiswa kwabasebenzi; kanye nokuphatha izinqubo zokukhala. Inhloso elandelayo yomthetho ukuhlinzeka abaqashi, abasebenzi, kanye namaqembu ngemihlahlandlela yokuphatha i-HIV/AIDS endaweni yokusebenza. Njengoba i-HIV/AIDS ithinta izindawo zokusebenza kanye nabantu ezingeni elihlukene, kudingeka ibhekwe ngendlela ethatha lezi zinto zonke zicabangele. Ngakho-ke, umthetho uhlanganisa izimiso ezikhuluma kabanzi ngaphansi kwemithetho ebhalwe esigabeni 5. ukuthuthukisa amasu omthetho ukuze kuhlolwe isimo nokunciphisa umnikelo walolu sifo endaweni yokusebenza; kanye nokusekela labo abaphila ne-HIV/AIDS nalabo abathintekayo ukuze baqhubeke nokusebenza ngokukhiqiza isikhathi eside. phakathi kwabaphathi, abasebenzi, kanye namaqembu endaweni yokusebenza; kanye phakathi kwendawo yokusebenza nabanye abathintekayo ezingeni lezigaba, emphakathini, ezifundazweni, nakazwelonke. Ukwakhiwa kwendawo yokusebenza esekela abasebenzi abaphila ne-HIV ukuze baqhubeke nokusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile kubalulekile lapho bezizwa bekulungele ukuphatha isimo sabo sezempilo. I-HIV/AIDS ithinta abesifazane ngendlela ehlukile kunabesilisa, ngakho lokhu kumele kubhekwe lapho kuthuthukiswa izinqubo zomthetho nezinhlelo zendawo yokusebenza. Ukubonisana, okuhlanganisa wonke umuntu, nokukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza okuphelele kwazo zonke izithakazelo kuyisisekelo sezinqubo zomthetho zonke nezinhlelo ze-HIV/AIDS. Bonke abaqashi nabasebenzi, kanye nezikhungo zabo, bayakhuthazwa ukuthi basebenzise lo mthetho, ukuthuthukisa, ukuwusebenzisa, nokuhlanza izinqubo zabo ze-HIV/AIDS ukuze zihlangabezane nezidingo zabo endaweni yokusebenza. Ngokwezinhlelo zalesi simiso, igama elithi 'indawo yokusebenza' kufanele liqondwe kabanzi kunencazelo enikezwe kwiMithetho Yezokuhweba, Umthetho 66 ka-1995, isigaba 213, ukufaka noma yisiphi isikhala lapho umsebenzi wenziwa, hhayi kuphela kulabo abaphansi kokuhlangana komsebenzi kodwa futhi kulabo abasebenza ezindaweni ezingalandeli uhlelo nalabo abazimele. Nokho, lo mthetho awubeki izibopho zomthetho ezingaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma ngakho kwiMithetho Yezokuhweba kanye neMithetho Yezokuhweba, noma yimuphi omunye umthetho okukhulunywa ngawo emthethweni. Ukwehluleka ukuhamba kahle akubeki abaqashi endaweni yokuhlangabezana nezinqubo zomthetho ezithile ngaphandle uma umthetho uqondisa izibopho ezibekwe ngumthetho. Umthetho kufanele ufundwe ndawonye nezinye izikhombisi ezinhle zokuziphatha ezingenziwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi. Okuqukethwe kwalesi simiso kufanele kubhekwe lapho kuthuthukiswa, kuqhutshwa, noma kubuyekezwa noma yiziphi izinqubo zomthetho nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nalolu hlelo lwezomthetho olukhuluma ngenhla. Okulandelayo yizigaba ezikhethiwe, ezihlobene nezinye zezimiso ezikhulunywe ngenhla. Lezi kufanele zifundwe ndawonye nezinye izimiso. Umthetho unikezwa ngokuhambisana nesigaba 54(a) seMithetho Yezokuhweba, No 55 ka-1998, futhi isisekelo saso siwumgomo wokuthi akukho muntu okufanele ahlulelwe ngokungafanele ngoba ungena kwi-HIV. Ukuze kusizakale abaqashi nabasebenzi ekusebenziseni lo mgomo ngokuqhubekayo endaweni yokusebenza, umthetho uthole ezinye izinqubo ezihlobene. Isigaba 6 seMithetho Yezokuhweba sithi kunoma iyiphi inqubo yomthetho kanye nenqubo, akukho muntu, ophumelele, noma ofaka isicelo somsebenzi, okufanele ahlulelwe ngoba ungena kwi-HIV. Uma kukhona izinqubo zomthetho mayelana nezinsolo zokuhlulelwa ngokungafanele ngummeli, umqashi kufanele ahlinzeke ubufakazi bokuthi lezi zihlulelo noma ukwelashwa okuhlukile kwaba khona. Akukho msebenzi noma ofaka isicelo somsebenzi okufanele aphoqelelwe ukuba ahlole i-HIV ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi unayo noma cha. Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV kungaqhutshwa ngumqashi noma egameni lakhe, kuphela uma iNkantolo Yezabasebenzi ivumele ukuhlole lokhu njengokufanele nangokufanele ngokuhambisana nesigaba 7 seMithetho Yezokuhweba. Ngokuhambisana nesigaba 24(e) seMithetho Yezokwelapha, No 131 ka-1998, uhlelo lwezokwelapha akufanele luhlulele ngqo noma ngokuqondile amalungu alo ngokusekelwe "esimweni sabo sezempilo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 67, izinhlelo zokulawula zingasungulwa ezidinga zonke izinhlelo zezokwelapha ukuba ziqinisekise izinga elincane lezinsiza okufanele zibe khona kuwo wonke amalungu okungenani. Akukho mqashi ovunyelwe ukusho ukuthi umqashi, noma ofaka isicelo somsebenzi, kufanele ahlole i-HIV ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi unayo noma cha. NgokweMithetho Yezokuhweba, abaqashi bangathintana neNkantolo Yezabasebenzi ukuze bafune imvume yokuhlola umqashi. Nokho, uma isigaba 7 seMithetho Yezokuhweba sivimbela abahlinzeki bezempilo abaqashwe ngumqashi ekuhloleni umqashi, uma umqashi efuna ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV, kuncike ek
Noma iMthetho weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 ungumthetho. Manje, uMphathi-Jikelele woMnyango weMvula neZinkuni, njengomholi wehhovisi lolwazi kulo Mnyango, ukhishile incwadi yolwazi yomphakathi ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kolwazi oluphethwe lo Mnyango njengoba kudingwa isigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi. Le ncwadi iyincwadi yoMnyango weMvula neZinkuni ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, 2000 (UMthetho 2 ka-2000) [lo Mthetho]. Incazelo yesimo soMnyango nemisebenzi yawo. UMnyango, umholi wehhovisi lolwazi, kanye nazo zonke izinsizakusebenza zawo. Ulwazi olunembile ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi oluphethwe loMnyango. Isaziso sakamuva ngokwesigaba 15 soMthetho, esiqukethe lonke ulwazi, oluphethwe loMnyango futhi olutholakala kalula kubo bonke ngaphandle kwesidingo sokufaka isicelo kuMnyango. Incazelo yezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo emphakathini nendlela lezi zinsizakalo ezitholakala ngayo. Ukulandela izinqubomgomo ezihlosiwe zokunciphisa isidingo semvula, ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukonga amanzi ngokuphatha isidingo sayo. Ukukhuthaza ukusabalalisa okufanele, ukusetshenziswa okwenziwayo, kanye nokuphathwa okunempilo kwezinsiza zamanzi nokwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha ezikhangayo. Izinsizakalo Zamanzi a Ukungenelela ngokuthatha izinyathelo zokutshala imali ekuhlinzekeni ngensizakalo yokuletha amanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nokuthutha udoti kulezi zindawo ezazingenayo le nsizakalo b Ukukhuthaza ukudluliswa kohlelo lwezinsizakalo zamanzi oluphethwe loMnyango ukuze kwabelwane ngesisekelo sezinsizakalo zamanzi c Ukuphatha nokuhola izenzo zamabhodi amanzi d Ukuxhasa iziphathimandla zendawo ekuqaleni kwenqubo yokuthatha umthwalo wokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, nokuthuthukisa Izinhlelo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwezinsizakalo Zamanzi e Ukusungula nokwandisa ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zamanzi nezinsizakalo zolwazi f Ukuhlola indlela yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuthutha udoti ngenhloso yokufeza ukuhlala, ukwaneliseka, ukungabizi kwezinsizakalo, nokuphakamisa umkhankaso wezwe wokuhlaziya inqubekela phambili ethambile yezinsizakalo zokuthutha udoti g Ukusungula uMnyango njengomthuthukisi wenqubomgomo yezinsizakalo zamanzi, isisekelo sokuxhaswa, ukuphathwa, nokulethwa. Ngokwesigaba soMthetho, uMphathi-Jikelele ungumholi wehhovisi lolwazi lwe-DWAF. U-Mphathi-Jikelele, ngokwesigaba soMthetho, unikeze amandla nemisebenzi kubasizi behhovisi lolwazi ukuze kuthuthukiswe lo Mthetho Wokufinyelela Kolwazi. Amagama abo nemininingwane yokuxhumana ibhalwe etafuleni elingezansi. Umphakathi oPhakathi: Imininingwane Yokuphathwa Kwezinsizakalo Zolwazi. Ngokwesigaba 1 sesigaba 10 soMthetho, uMkomishana Wezamalungelo Abantu kufanele, ngaphakathi kwezinyanga eziyi-18 ngemuva kokuqala kwalesi sigaba, akhiqize idokhumenti equkethe le mininingwane ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni, ngendlela elula nephumelelayo, njengoba kungadingeka ngumuntu ofuna ukusebenzisa noma yiliphi ilungelo elinikezwe ngalo Mthetho. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele futhi achaze ukuthi ngabe ufuna ikhophi ephrintiwe yedokhumenti eqoshiwe noma ufuna ukuza ukuyibona edokhumenti eqoshiwe ehhovisi lomphakathi. Noma uma idokhumenti eqoshiwe ingeyona incwadi, ingabukwa ngendlela edingekayo, lapho isigaba 292 singase sisebenze. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela ngendlela ethile, umfaki-sicelo kufanele anikezwe ukufinyelela ngendlela efunwayo, ngaphandle kokuthi lokho kuzophazamisa ngokungafanele ukusebenza kwehhovisi elithintekayo, noma kulimaze idokhumenti eqoshiwe, noma kuvinjeze ukusatshalaliswa kwedokhumenti engemthethweni. Uma ukufinyelela kunganikezwa ngendlela efunwayo ngenxa yezizathu ezilungile kodwa kunganikezwa ngenye indlela, imali kufanele ibalwe ngendlela umfaki-sicelo afuna ukufinyelela esigabeni 29 cha. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngesinqumo ngenye indlela, isibonelo, ngefoni, lokhu kufanele kuboniswe esigabeni 182e. Uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ulwazi ngombono womunye umuntu, izimo lapho isicelo senziwa kufanele zicaciswe esigabeni 18 2f. Uma umfaki-sicelo engakwazi ukufunda noma ukubhala, noma unezithiyo, bangafaka isicelo sokuphendula ngolimi olukhuluma. Umphakathi oPhakathi weHhovisi Lolwazi kufanele aqedele ifomu lomfaki-sicelo futhi anikeze ikhophi kubo ngokwesigaba 18 3. Usizi loMphathi weHhovisi Lolwazi kufanele lukhumbuze umfaki-sicelo (ngaphandle kwabafaki-sicelo abazimele) ngezidingo zokukhokha imali ethile (uma ikhona) ngaphambi kokuphumelela kwesicelo. Imali yesicelo ethathwa yihhovisi lomphakathi ingama-R35. Umfaki-sicelo angafaka ukukhala ngaphakathi, lapho kufanelekile, noma afake isicelo enkantolo ukuze aphikise isiphakamiso noma akhokhe imali yesicelo. Ngemuva kokuthi Usizi loMphathi weHhovisi Lolwazi lwenze isinqumo ngesicelo, umfaki-sicelo kufanele waziswe ngalesi sinqumo ngendlela umfaki-sicelo efuna ukwaziswa ngayo. Uma isicelo samukelwa, imali yokufinyelela kufanele ikhokhwe ukuze kuhlolwe, kulungiswe, futhi kukhiqizwe, kanye nanoma yisiphi isikhathi esedlula amahora abekwe ukuze kuhlolwe nokulungiselela idokhumenti eqoshiwe ukuze ikhululwe. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimiso zoMthetho ophathwe loMnyango ziyagcinwa, ngokulandela nokuqoqwa kolwazi. Ukukhala kungafakwa kuNgqongqoshe weMvula neZinkuni. Isicelo senkantolo singafakwa ngemuva kokuthi ihhovisi elinganeliseki lidlule zonke izinqubo zokukhala ngaphakathi, kodwa akukho okwenziwayo mayelana nokukhala kwalo. Ngokwazi kwethu, ulwazi okukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 14 (i) asikakafiki kuNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo. Le ncwadi izobuyekezwa futhi iphumelele minyaka yonke ukuze ibike umphakathi nganoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingase zenzeke ku-DWAF. Izinqubo ezilandelwayo ukuze kwenziwe le ncwadi itholakale zizogcinwa ekuhloleni le ncwadi. Uma imisebenzi ye-DWAF ixhumene kakhulu nemisebenzi yezinye izigaba, uNgqongqoshe, uma efisa noma ngokwakhe, angacela lezi zigaba ukuthi zikhulume incwadi eyodwa. I-DWAF kanye nezinye izigaba ezimbili noma ngaphezulu kufanele zabelane ngezindleko zokukhiqiza incwadi nokuyenza itholakale njengoba uNgqongqoshe angakuthola. Uma imisebenzi ye-DWAF ingahlangene nanoma iyiphi isigaba yomphakathi, zonke izindleko ezithintekayo zokukhiqiza incwadi nokuyenza itholakale zizokwenziwa yi-DWAF. UNgqongqoshe wezobuLungiswa nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo angakhulula i-DWAF ekunikezeni ngaphansi kwesigaba 14 soMthetho, nganoma yisiphi isizathu sokuvikela, ukuphathwa, noma kwezezimali uma becabanga ukuthi kubalulekile ukwenza kanjalo.
