Ngiyajabula kakhulu ukwethula isu lokusebenza leMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke eyethulwe nguNgqongqoshe. IMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke iwumphumela wezixoxiswano ezibanzi ezathatha ukuqala ngonyaka ka-1995 lapho kwabekwa khona iQembu Lezabelo Zolimi (LANGTAG). Isu lokusebenza linikeza imihlahlandlela ezosetshenziswa ukuze kufezwe kahle iMithetho Yezilimi, kukhuthazwe izakhiwo ezizodingeka ekusebenzeni kwayo nasekuzameni ukuthuthukisa nokukhuthaza izilimi zethu zomdabu zase-Afrika. Uhulumeni uyawazi umthelela wokuphatha ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kungakho isu lokusebenza ligcizelela inqubo ethokozisa ushintsho futhi ibheke phambili. Njengoba ukukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu kubhekwa njengesisekelo seMithetho Yezilimi, isu lokusebenza lihlose ukusungula izakhiwo zolimi kanye nezinhlelo ezifanele zokwandisa ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi kwiMisebenzi Yomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, ukubambisana esikwenza ezingeni likazwelonke, ezindaweni, kanye nohulumeni bendawo kuzodlala indima ebalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi iMithetho Yezilimi isebenza kahle. Uma sicabanga ngenselelo ehambisana nohulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamuzi zithola izinsizakalo ngokushesha futhi ukuthi ulimi luwumsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi, kubonakala ukuthi iMithetho Yezilimi kufanele iqale ukusebenza ngokuphuthumayo. Ngale ndlela, ngifisa ukucela bonke abahlanganyeli esibambisene nabo, kuhlanganise nezakhiwo nohulumeni kanye nezinsizakalo kanye neBhodi Yezilimi Zomdabu yaseNingizimu Afrika, ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi le Nqubomgomo Yokusebenza iguqula ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene kube yinto eqinile kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Le Nqubomgomo Yokusebenza ingxenye yeMithetho Yezilimi Kazwelonke (NLPF) evumela amandla ezinhlinzeko zolimi njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 6 seMthethosisekelo ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996). Uma sekuqediwe, yonke le mikhakha izohlanganisa iMibiko yeMithetho Yezilimi, isu lokusebenza, umthetho wezilimi ophakanyisiwe nezinhlinzeko zawo, kanye nomthetho ophakanyisiwe weBhodi Yezilimi Zochwepheshe baseNingizimu Afrika. Isu lokusebenza lenziwa njengokuphakanyiswa okujolise ekushintsheni futhi kungashintshwa ngezakhiwo ezithile nezinhlelo zokukhuthaza izilimi ezahlukene. Umbiko weNqubomgomo ye-NLPF wamenyezelwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezobuciko namasiko, Isayensi nobuchwepheshe ngomhla ka-3 kuZibandlela 2002. IBhodi yePhalamende ithole lo mbiko ngomhla ka-12 kuNdasa 2003. Le nqubomgomo ihlose ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanele kwezilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni ukuze kukhuthazwe ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikahulumeni, ulwazi, nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Lezi zinjongo zixhomeke empumelelweni yokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zomdabu eziphucukile. Njengoba ulimi luwumsebenzi wokuxhumana ezimpilweni nasezindaweni zabantu, kubalulekile ukusungula izinhlelo zokubhekana nezinkinga ezikhona. Isu lokusebenza lichaza izakhiwo ezidingekayo nezinhlelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iMithetho Yezilimi kanye nezinsizakalo zezimali ezihlinzekwa ezikhungweni zikazwelonke nezasezifundazweni zisebenza kahle. Le nqubomgomo icacile mayelana nomkhakha walolu suku olwenziwe. Zonke izakhiwo zikahulumeni (kazwelonke, ezifundazweni, nezasekhaya) zibophelelekile ezinhlinzekweni zenqubomgomo kanye nanoma yiziphi izikhungo ezisebenzisa amandla noma ezihlinzeka ngensizakalo yomphakathi ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zomthetho. Iphakheji ngayinye noma isifunda ingakhetha ulimi lwayo lokusebenza. Nokho, kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi akekho ophoqelelwe ekusebenziseni ulimi lwakhe. Uma kudingeka ukuhumusha noma ukuhunyushwa kwedokhumenti ethile ngolimi oluthile, lokhu kuzokwenziwa. Mayelana nokuxhumana okubhalwe phansi, kufanele kulandelwe uhlelo lokushicilela oluqaphela ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezahlukene (kuqondwa izithameli, umyalezo, kanye nomongo) kulokhu okungadingi ukuhunyushwa kuzo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye. Uma isikhungo esithile sikahulumeni sifuna ukuveza ulwazi ngokujulile, kufanele shicilele ulwazi kuzo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni. Ngaphansi kwezimo lapho imibhalo kahulumeni ingatholakali kuzo zonke izilimi eziyishumi nanye ezisemthethweni, izikhungo zikahulumeni kazwelonke kufanele zishicilele idokhumenti ngesikhathi esifanayo, okungenani ezilimini eziyisithupha. Umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngamathuba kufanele usebenze lapho kukhethwa izilimi ezisemqoka zeNguni neSotho. Isimo esithile okufanele silandelwe ukuthi okungenani izikhungo zikahulumeni kazwelonke zikhawulelwe ekushicileleni imibhalo esemthethweni ezilimini eziyisithupha noma ngaphezulu. Umgomo wokuhlinzeka ngamathuba awusebenzi ezifundazweni ngoba zinegunya lokusebenzisa izilimi ezikhethiweyo. Izikhungo zikahulumeni bendawo zizokwenza isinqumo sokusebenzisa ulimi njengoba kuceliwe umphakathi kulandela isikhumbuzo senqubomgomo yolimi esisunguliwe esifundazweni. Ngemuva kokunquma ulimi oluzosetshenziswa futhi oluceliwe umphakathi, ohulumeni bendawo kufanele bathuthukise, bashicilele, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi inqubomgomo yezilimi ezahlukene iyasebenza, okumele kwenziwe ngokubambisana eduze nomphakathi. Emibhalweni esemthethweni, ulimi olwakhethwe yisakhamuzi kufanele lusetshenziswe. Zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana kufanele zenziwe ngolimi olusemthethweni olwakhethwe yilabo bantu noma indawo. Uma kudingeka, zonke izindlela kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kusebenze izinsizakalo zolimi ezifana nokuhumusha (ukulandela ukukhuluma, ukuhumusha ngesikhathi esifanayo, ukuhumusha ngocingo, noma ukuhumusha ngokuthula) uma kukhona indlela. Lokhu kusebenza ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni lesifunda nasezwenikazi. Inqubo yokusebenza komsebenzi ophakanyisiwe iqondiswa yizinhloso nezinhlelo ezibekwe enqubomgomeni. Lezi zindawo ezilandelayo zizogxilwa kuzo: a Ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu kuhambisana nokusungulwa kwezinsiza kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo efana nezikhangiso nezincazelo zolimi. b Ukuqinisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinzuzo zezinqubomgomo zomphakathi zabelwa ngendlela efanele ngokunika zonke izakhamuzi ithuba lokufinyelela kuzo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yisiphi ulimi abawusebenzisayo, inqobo nje uma kukhuthaza ukubamba iqhaza kwabo nezwi ematfubeni kaHulumeni. c Ukuphathwa kwezilimi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni zine ithuba lokusebenza futhi ziqinisa isithunzi soHulumeni. d Ukukhuthaza ukufunda izilimi, ikakhulukazi ezihlobene nezidingo zeMisebenzi Yomphakathi, ukuthuthukisa amandla okwenza imisebenzi yomphakathi nokukhombisa kahle izinzuzo zok
Umthetho ophathelene nezifiso uthintekile kakhulu ngesinqumo esithathwe emacaleni kaBhe, esashintsha indlela yokwabelana ngefa phakathi kwabafileyo. Lokhu kwashintsha nendlela uMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwenkolo ubheka ngayo ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabafileyo. Kwenzekeni esinqumweni sikaBhe? Ngesikhathi ephila, umufi wayehlala noNksz. Bhe kanye nengane yabo eyodwa ezinsaneni zabo ezimbili eKhayelitsha. Kwakukhona ukungabaza ukuthi umlingani kaBhe nomufi babashadile noma cha. Intombazane yabo yesibili yayihlala noyise womufi eBerlin, okuyindawo eseningizimu yeMpumalanga. Umufi washona ngaphandle kokwenza ifa, ngakho-ke impahla yakhe yabelwa ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene nezifiso. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uyise womufi uzothola yonke impahla, ngaphandle kukaNksz. Bhe nezingane zabo. Impahla yayiqukethe ishayela nomhlaba ophakanyiswe kuyo. Uyayise wayefuna ukuthengisa umhlaba ukuze akhokhele umngcwabo wendodana yakhe. Uma eqhubeka kanjalo, uNksz. Bhe nezingane bazoshiywa bengenalutho. UNksz. Bhe ufake isicelo enkantolo sokuthi izingane zakhe ezimbili zikhonjwa njengezizathu ezisemthethweni zokuthola ifa likayise. INkantolo Yomthethosisekelo yathatha isinqumo sokuthi indlela yokwabelana ngefa ngaphansi komthetho wezifiso ibingaphansi kwesigaba 23 seMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zabantu Abamnyama, ngakho-ke ayikufaneleka ukuhlangabezana nezinkinga zezimo zokuphila ezishintshashintshayo ezazisunguliwe kusukela ekuqaleni. Ngakho-ke, yayiphelelwe yisikhathi futhi ayikwazi ukuxhumana nezidingo zangempela zezindawo zasemadolobheni nezinguquko ezisemndenini. Isimo samanje sikhombisa ukuthi asihambisani nomkhondo wabaningi ngoba sithola ukwahlukaniswa ngokobulili nasokuzalwa. Zonke impahla yomuntu ofile izokwabiwa ngokomthetho womuntu ofile ongakhulumi ukuthi ufuna ukwabelwa kanjani. Uma umufi eshiya kuphela abashadikazi nezingane, abashadikazi bazokwabelana ngempahla phakathi kwabo. Uma impahla ingafinyeleli ku-R125,000 ngomshado, abashadikazi bazothola ingxenye efanayo yephahla, kanti izingane azizotholi lutho. Ngemuva kwesinqumo sikaBhe, impahla zabantu abafileyo manje ziqhutshelwa ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwefa Ngaphandle Kwefa ka-1965 (Umthetho 66 ka-1965, njengoba uguqulwe). Abagibeli ngeke baphathe ukuphathwa kwezimpahla zabantu abafileyo, kodwa lesi sabelo sishintshele kuMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme. UMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme akadingi ukuzibandakanya mathupha ekuphathweni kwezindaba zezimali zabafileyo. UMphakathi uzokhetha umuntu ofanele emsebenzini wokuphatha impahla yomuntu ofile. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela impahla, umuntu angasazisa ukuthi impahla izokwabiwa kanjani ngaphansi komthetho wezifiso. Lokhu kufanele kubhalwe kwiWill. UMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza ngcono umthetho ophathelene nezifiso. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngokuvumela umndeni ophumulelayo ukuvumelana ngendlela impahla yomufi kufanele ihlukaniswe. Nokho, uMphakathi Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme akufanele avumele amaqembu abuthakathaka afana nezingane nabesifazane ukuba aphathwe kabi ngenxa yezivumelwano zomndeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abantu eNingizimu Afrika baqonde lezi zinguquko ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela izimpahla zabo ngendlela efanele. UMsunguli Wokuphatha Wenkantolo Ephakeme usungule umshini wocingo lapho usizo lungatholakala khona.
Ikhodi yokuziphatha yamaphoyisa ifuna ukuthi, njengamaphoyisa eNingizimu Afrika, sithande abantu ngokuhlonipha nokubahlonipha ngenxa yokwehluka kwabo kanye nomthetho, ngaleyo ndlela sithuthukise futhi sithuthukise umsebenzi wethu ngendlela evunyelwe umphakathi. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa athatha iqiniso njengokubaluleke kakhulu kunakho konke. Ukuchaza: Thina, njengamaphoyisa, sizohlale sizama ukugcina inhloso, sibe nolwazi ngezindinganiso ze khodi yokuziphatha yamaphoyisa. Ukuziphatha kwethu kuzohambisana nalezi zindinganiso. Sizoziphatha ngenhlonipho nangokuzinikela noma ngempumelelo kuzo zonke izimo. Sizohlale sikhuluma iqiniso, senza imisebenzi yethu ngedumela, futhi sibe isibonelo emiphakathini esiyisebenzela. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa avuma ukuhlukahluka kwabantu ezweni lethu futhi abahloniphe bonke abantu ngokulinganayo. Ukuchaza: Ekwenzeni umsebenzi wethu, sizohlale sikhombisa ukuhlonipha sazi ukuthi imiphakathi ihlukahlukene, ezinkolweni nasemkhakheni. Sizobahlonipha bonke abantu futhi sihloniphe amalungelo abo njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Asizokwenza ukucwasa okungemthethweni kunoma ubani. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa azohlale ehlonipha futhi agcine umthetho. Ukuchaza: Umsebenzi wethu uhambisana kakhulu nokuphathwa komthetho, ngakho-ke sithi sizohlale sibe ngaphansi komthetho naseMthethweni wezwe lethu. Sizohlale sigwema ukuziphatha ngendlela ezosiholela ekwephuleni umthetho. Sizohlale sivikela abantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika ezinyathelweni ezingemthethweni. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa azama njalo ukwenza imisebenzi yabo kahle. Ukuchaza: Sizohlale, kuzo zonke izinzwa zethu, senza umsebenzi wethu ngamandla onke esinawo. Ukuziphatha kwethu kuzohlale kukhombisa ubuchwepheshe bomsebenzi wethu. Ukuziphatha kwethu nokubukeka kuzokwandisa ukuzinikela kwethu ekwenzeni kahle. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wamaphoyisa asebenza ndawonye nomphakathi ngoba afuna ukuvunyelwa nokwesekwa umphakathi. Ukuchaza: Sizosebenza ngenhloso enkulu yomphakathi, futhi ngazo zonke izinzwa ukuze sixhase umthetho, futhi sifuna ukuvunyelwa umphakathi wonke.
Ifomu iqukethe indlela yokubika ngezemisebenzi ezilungile emsebenzini ethulwe kuMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Le fomhu ifaka nezidingo zokubika abaqashi abakhethiwe, labo abasebenza ngaphansi kuka-150 noma ngaphezulu kuka-150. Ifomu iphinde ifake umbiko wokuqhubeka okumele uqedwe ngemuva kwesikhathi sokuqala sokubika. Bonke abaqashi abakhethiwe kumele bathumele umbiko njengoba kuchaziwe nguMthetho Wobudlelwano Bezemisebenzi u-55 ka-1998. Noma yisiphi isisebenzi esiqedela umbiko wezobulungiswa bezabasebenzi ngokuzithandela kumele sithumele umbiko wokuqala ngaphambi kosuku lukaJuni 1, 2000, bese kulandela omunye unyaka, ngosuku lokuqala luka-Okthoba 2001. Kumele baqedele zonke izingxenye zalesi formu ngaphandle kweG embikweni wokuqala. Kumele baqedele zonke izingxenye zalesi formu, kuhlanganise neG embikweni olandelayo. Kumele bathumele umbiko wokuqala ngaphambi kosuku lukaDisemba 1, 2000, bese kulandela abanye emva konyaka, ngosuku lokuqala lomsebenzi ngo-Okthoba, kuqala ngo-2002. Kumele baqedele izingxenye A, B, F, noH embikweni wokuqala. Kumele baqedele izingxenye A, B, F, G, noH embikweni olandelayo. Kumele baqedele umbuzo 8.2 (izigaba zendawo yokusebenza) kuwo wonke imibiko. Ngokuzithandela, kumele baqedele izingxenye C, D, noE kuwo wonke imibiko.
Khuluma ulimi lwakho. Kuyilungelo lakho. Yisiphi isevisi ethuthukisiwe? I-TISSA inikeza izinsizakalo zokuhumusha ngocingo ukuze kube lula kubo bonke obala ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikamasipala. Kungani i-TISSA ikwenza lo msebenzi? I-TISSA ikhuthaza amalungelo okuthuthukisa ulimi futhi ikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zendawo ezisemthethweni. Ingabe umphakathi ungacela izinsizakalo zikamasipala ngolimi lwabo lokuqala? Yebo, uma kuyilimi lesi siko esisemthethweni. Ingabe ulimi lwezimpawu lubandakanywa? Yebo, abantu abaphethekile bazothola izinga elifanayo le sevisi njengomuntu ophilayo. Izindawo zokusebenza zikhona ezikhungweni ezinkulu zizwe. Le sevisi isebenza kanjani? Le sevisi inikeza umhumushi ozohumusha isicelo sakho. Ngizokwazi kanjani uma umnyango kahulumeni ungisiza? Kuzoba nezimpawu ezikhombisa ehhovisi likamasipala ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuhumusha zikhona. Uma ihhovisi likamasipala lingakhombisi uphawu lwe-TISSA, ngingakucela le sevisi? Yebo, ungacela le sevisi, kuphela uma abasebenzi bekulungele ukuyinika. Le sevisi izongisiza kanjani? Umhumushi oqeqeshiwe uzokwenza kube lula kuwe nomsebenzi kahulumeni ukuba nemininingwane eqondile. Unelungelo lokukhuluma ulimi lwakho. Uhulumeni uzosiza ukuhlanganisa noma yiziphi izikhala zokuxhumana ezikhona. Khuluma ulimi lwakho, kuyilungelo lakho. Izinsizakalo zokuhumusha ngocingo zikhona lapha. Ukuhumusha ngocingo kuyatholakala lapha.
Kungani kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakanyisiwe? Ukujabula umuntu akuthola uma eqhathanisa ukusebenza noma ukusetshenziswa kwalokho akutholayo ngokulindelwe kwakhe. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphakanyisiwe ezingeni lomhlaba kuthuthukisa izinga lenkonzo esihlinzeka ngayo kumakhasimende ethu ngokushintsha umqondo wabasebenzi bethu ukusuka emcabangweni wesikhashana uye emcabangweni wokuzinza kumakhasimende - ngokwenza kanjalo, sizohlangabezana futhi sidlule kulokho abakulindele kulolu bhange kanye nezinsizakalo zalo. Ukusiza okuphakanyisiwe yikho esikufunayo ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngoba siyazi ukuthi ulindele ukusiza okuphakanyisiwe kulolu Bhange lwezeMali. Uma usizo olutholile namuhla lukujabulisile, sicela ubike kumngane. Uma ungenelisekile, sicela wazise umphathi wesikhungo. Ukubaluleka kokugxila ekugcineni amakhasimende kuye kwanda. Ubhange lwezeMali luzokwazi kuphela ukugcina amakhasimende alo uma luthuthukisa ekuhlangabezaneni nasekuthokoziseni izidingo zamakhasimende. Esikhathini esedlule, uBhange lwezeMali beluphakeme, futhi bekungadingeki ukuba lwenze imizamo ekhethekile yokugcina amakhasimende. Manje, uBhange lwezeMali luncintisana namakhasimende nabanye amabhange ezohwebo. Abantu manje bangakhetha ukuthi yimaphi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo abafuna. Amakhasimende anjengamanje afundile futhi ayahlola. Izinga lokulindela lamakhasimende lenyukile ngenxa yezinga lemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Uma uBhange lwezeMali luzinikele ekugcineni amakhasimende alo nasekugcineni isikhundla saso emkhakheni wezezimali, kudingeka imibono emisha noma imiqondo, ngoba izodlula izinkampani ezibeka amakhasimende azo phambili ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo ephezulu. Umsebenzi wokugcina amakhasimende awuwona umthwalo kuphela weMnyango Wokumaketha Nezokuthengisa. UMnyango Wokumaketha ungaphumelela kuphela uma uhambisana kahle nezinye izigaba nabasebenzi ukuze bahlele futhi bafeze amasu okuncintisana aphezulu nezinsiza ezibalulekile kumakhasimende. Yini ukusiza okuphakanyisiwe? Lokhu kusho ukwenza konke okusemandleni akho nangaphezulu ukuze uxazulule inkinga yekhasimende. Kubandakanya ukwenza "okungaphezu kokulindelwe." Ukwenza okungaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywe emsebenzini wakho, okungaphezu kokwenzelwa abanye. Konke kukhona NGAWE. Hlale ulindele izinto ezinhle, ube nomdlandla wokusebenza, ube nezinhliziyo ezishisayo nezisebenzayo. Hlale uzama ukwenza okungcono kakhulu. Lokhu kuhilela ukuthanda umsebenzi wakho nokuzigqaja ngalokho okwenziwayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuzigqaja ngokusebenza kuBhange lwezeMali. Yini uhlelo Lokusiza lweBhange leMali? Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi singahlinzeka kanjani ngosizo oluhlukile kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, uzokwakha isipiliyoni esijabulisayo nesithokozisayo kubo bobabili abasebenzi namakhasimende. Lolu hlelo Lokusiza luyisikhombandlela sokuhlinzeka ngosizo "kulabo abakubona phambi kwakho." Omunye wemigomo ehleliwe yeBhange leMali ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo ekuphatheni izinga lempilo kubo bonke. Wena, njengommeleli webhange, unethuba elikhulu lokuba yingxenye yokushintsha ikusasa labantu! Ungowokwenza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela amandla abo ngokuhlinzeka ngama-akhawunti abangawasebenzisa ukuze bafeze amaphupho abo. Asigxili kuphela ekuthuthukiseni abantu ngaphandle kwebhange kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu. Lolu hlelo luzosiza futhi ukuba ube ngumuntu onakekela abanye futhi unakekele usizo oluhlinzekwayo. Siyacela bonke abasebenzi beBhange leMali ukuthi babambe iqhaza noma basebenze ngokulandela amaphuzu alandelayo: Masikhuthazane futhi sikhuthazane nsuku zonke, hhayi kuphela ukwenza kahle ngezakhono zethu kodwa futhi ukusabalalisa injabulo ekuphatheni imisebenzi yethu nasekuphileni kwethu! Bhalisela amakhasimende ngokushesha ngokubabheka emehlweni. Uma ungakwazi ukusiza ikhasimende ngokushesha, wazise ukuthi uzobasiza masinyane. Bhalisela wonke amakhasimende endaweni yokulinda, noma uzobasiza noma cha, bese ubuza ukuthi baphumelele yini ukusizwa nokuthi ungabasiza kanjani. Uma usukulungele ukusiza ikhasimende, khumbula, bhalisela, uthi "sawubona," uxolise ngokulinda, futhi uzethule ngegama, isibonelo, "Sawubona, ngiyaxolisa ngokukugcina ulindile. Ngiyena Jane (noma uNkk. Smith), ngingakusiza kanjani namuhla?" Ulimi lwakho lomzimba kufanele lukhombise ukuzithoba, futhi izwi lakho kufanele libe nomusa. Thola ukuthi ubani ikhasimende futhi usebenzise igama labo phakathi kwengxoxo. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakhipha kahle igama labo. Xoxa nomuntu ngokuba nengxoxo emfushane nabo uma kungenzeka. "Kuyinsuku enhle namuhla, akunjalo?" Yiba nomusa, ungakhethi, ulindele izinto ezinhle, futhi ube nomuntu. Khombisa ubuchwepheshe emsebenzini wakho futhi uhlale ulindele izinto ezinhle. Ungavumeli amakhasimende ukuba azwe izingxoxo zakho ezizimele, noma uma ukhuluma ophikweni noma unengxoxo phakathi kwabasebenzi ababili. Phatha ngokwezimvo zakho. Ungaphenduli ifoni yakho ye-cell ngaphandle kokuxolisa ku ikhasimende kuqala bese uzithiba ngemva kokuphothula ucingo. Wazise ikhasimende ukuthi uhamba kuphi uma ushiya indawo yakho yokusebenza. Lalela ngokucophelela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubuza yonke imibuzo ezokwenza uthole yonke imininingwane efanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda konke abakukhulumayo, noma uma lokho kusho ukuthola umuntu ozokuhumusha. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda inkinga ethulwe kuwe ngaphambi kokuzama ukuyixazulula. Phatha bonke abantu ngenhlonipho enkulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babukeka kanjani. Phatha wonke umuntu sengathi uphatha igolide. Thatha isikhathi sokuchaza ikhasimende ukuthi kungani isicelo sabo sokwakha sitholakale. Uma ikhasimende lingakwazi ukuhlinzekwa ngenkokhelo ngokusekelwe ezicini zeBronze, Silver, noma Gold, ubabhekisele kwenye uhlobo lwezikweletu oluphansi (isikweletu seBronze singaba yisinyathelo sokuqala). Thatha isikhathi sokuzama ukuhlinzeka ikhasimende ngosizo olufanele kanye nezinsizakalo zezimali (ukuhlukaniswa kwezingozi) ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Ungagxeki amaphutha enziwe ngenye ibhange noma ibhange elikhulu. Yenza inkinga yakho futhi ungaboleka ikhasimende imali okwesikhashana uma isimo sivumela. Gwema ukwenza imisebenzi engahlangene nokusiza abantu uma bekuphambi kwakho. Qeda ingxoxo yakho nekhasimende ngokubabonga, ubabize ngegama, futhi ubafisele "usuku oluhle." Wazise umamukeli wezokuxhumana uma ungenayo isikhathi sokuthola izingcingo ngalolo suku. Ungakwenzi izingcingo lapho usebenza noma uyeke ukuba ibhange likhangele ngaphandle kokuphendulwa. Xolisa kumuntu uma ucingo lwakho lukhala isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuphendulwa. Umamukeli wezokuxhumana kuBhange leMali "Isikhungo," Sawubona, ngingakusiza kanjani?" ungakhetha ulimi ofuna ukulukhuluma. Sawubona, ngingu [Igama], ngingakusiza kanjani?
