I-NPI iyisisekelo somphakathi, ebhekwa njengokwesekwa kweSikhungo Sokuqashwa, ngenhloso yokuphatha kwezezimali zizwe. Ihloselwe ukuba ibe yisikhungo esihola phambili ekuthuthukiseni izindinganiso zomkhiqizo eziphelele, ngezindlela ezintsha nezisindayo zokuthi "kuwusizo kubo bonke ngendlela efanele emphakathini." I-National Product Foundation iyikhandidethi elinophiko oluthathu oluzinikele ekuthuthukiseni nasekuphakamiseni izinga lemikhiqizo eNingizimu Afrika ngokuchaza umoya we-triangle ngokucwaninga, ukusabalalisa ulwazi, ukuqeqesha, ukuvuselela, ukuxhumana, ukuhlola izincwadi, nokuphatha kuyo yonke imisebenzi yomkhiqizo kanye nenkinga yokuphakamisa izinga lokuphila kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Vakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nemisebenzi ye-NPI, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezinhlelo zayo. I-NPI ithuthukisile izinhlelo eziyisihlanu zokubhekana nezinkinga ezibalulekile, izinhlelo, nezinyathelo. Umphathi weZinhlelo ubheka zonke izinhlelo. Umthetho Wokuphakanyiswa Kwe-Access to Information, Umthetho 2 ka-2000 (lapha okuzobizwa ngokuthi "umthetho") uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngokufeza ilungelo lesi sikhungo lokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso kanye nolwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze uqhubeke noma uvikele noma yiziphi iz права, futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. IKomidi leMithetho Yabantu eNingizimu Afrika liphakathi kwemigomo yeSahluko 10 soMthetho, ukukhishwa kwesikhumbuzo esiqukethe ulwazi olungacelwa noma yimuphi umuntu (lapha okuzobizwa ngokuthi "umceli") ukuze umceli uthole ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso kanye/noma omunye umuntu, lapho ulwazi lolu ludingeka ukuze uqhubeke noma uvikele noma yiziphi iz права zomceli. I-NPI, uma kudingeka, izobuyekeza futhi ikhishwe izichibiyelo kulolu documeti oluchazayo uma noma uma kufanelekile, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingadluli unyaka. Akukho kuchazwa kulabo i-NPI inawo ulwazi ngabo noma amarekhodi wezincwadi ezitholakalayo mayelana nabo ukuze kusabalaliswe. Ngokwesimo somthetho, umceli kufanele anikezwe ukufinyelela kumarekhodi omphakathi uma umceli ehambisana nazo zonke izidingo zokusebenza zomthetho ezihlobene nokucela ukufinyelela kulolo rekodi, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi irekhodi elibhalwe alikhululiwe nganoma yiziphi izinkinga ezichazwe kulo mthetho. Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi abhalwe njengoba kuchaziwe emthethweni kufanele sibe nobudlelwano obubalulekile neFomu A yePolisi -187 edlulelwa ngomhla kaFebhuwari 15, 2002, ukushicilelwa kwayo kutholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI, noma kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi lwe-NPI kanye/noma noma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Uma umceli engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala, noma unenkinga ethile evimbela ekusebenziseni amalungelo akhe njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi abhalwe singaqhutshelwa ngokuqondile kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi kanye/noma noma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Idivayisi Yokuxhumana ye-NPI idlala indima ebalulekile ekuhloleni izenzo zomkhiqizo emkhakheni wezomnotho, wezohwebo, nezomphakathi kanye nezikhungo ezisekelwe emphakathini, futhi inikeza izeluleko zokuthi lokhu kungasetshenziswa kanjani. Iqembu lokuxhumana le-NPI linikeza ulwazi olunembile kanye nobuchwepheshe obuhlukahlukene obuqoqwe ngokwenza imisebenzi eminingi yomkhiqizo emakethe yasekhaya nasezwenikazi ngonyaka. Uhlelo luthumele izinsizakalo zalo ezindaweni ezine, okungukuthi, iTest Court, Izinqubo Zokufunda, Ukuphathwa Kokumaketha, kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezokusebenza. Ulwazi oluningi mayelana nalezi zinsizakalo lungatholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI, noma kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi kanye/noma noma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Ngokwezinye izikhungo zomphakathi, i-NPI ayinayo inqubo yangaphakathi yokufaka izikhalazo. Lapho umceli ekholelwa ukuthi i-NPI ayihambisanga noma yehlulekile ukulandela izibopho zayo ngaphansi komthetho, le ndaba izobhekwa ngamaqembu afanele abambe iqhaza, uma kuvunyelwene, noma noma yiliphi iqembu lingaxhumana nanoma yisiphi isikhungo esinamalungelo kulolu daba.
Icholera yisifo esitholwa umuntu ngokuphuza amanzi nokudla okungcolile nge-bacteria yecholera. I-bacteria ebangela icholera itholakala emfucumfucu yomuntu. Icholera spread kanjani? Ungasebenzisi umfula njengento yokuhlanza, kodwa sebenzisa indlu yangasese efanele. Geza izandla zakho ngamanzi aphekiwe noma insipho ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese nangaphambi kokuphatha ukudla. Ungamsiza kanjani umuntu ongocholera? Mnika amanzi amaningi ahlanganiswe noshukela/ukhala ukuze aphuze. Thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi aphekiwe, engeza ama-teaspoon ayisishiyagalombili noshukela kanye nohhafu we-teaspoon yokhala, bese uhlanganisa. Nika umuntu ogulayo le miphumela ukuze aphuze kancane futhi kaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Khumbula, qhubeka unikeza lo mshanelo noshukela/ukhala kumuntu ongocholera. Thutha lowo muntu ngokushesha uye esikhungweni sezempilo noma esibhedlela ngangokunokwenzeka. Uma udinga olunye ulwazi, noma uma ucabanga ukuthi ungase ube necholera, vakashela esikhungweni sezempilo, esibhedlela, kudokotela, noma kumsebenzi wezempilo oseduzane nawe.
Izindlela zokonga ngokusebenzisa nokwakha izakhiwo zomdabu ezifana nezinhlelo zokubhaka nez stokvels. Ukwakha umkhakha omncane osebenzayo wezezimali eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhaswa kwezezimali ukuze kwakhiwe amandla omthetho ezinhlelweni ezibamba iqhaza kanye namakhasimende azo ukuze kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwazo emisebenzini yezezimali ephumelelayo. Ukonga njalo nokuhlinzekwa kwemali kubalulekile kokubili izinhlelo kanye neziqu zezezimali (RFIs) njengendlela yokwandisa nokujulisa ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zezimali zabampofu nokuthuthukisa isimo sabo sezezimali ukuze baphile kahle. Ukwenza bazi ngokuqonda ukonga akuyona indlela yokukhetha, kodwa ukuqala nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ezisekelwe kulwazi lwempilo kuyakhuthazwa. I-Fund yeSikweletu Esincane: Le nkqubo ihlinzeka ngama-loan angafika ku-R10,000 kumakhaya kanye nabashintshi abanguye amalungu ezinkampanini ezincane ukuze baziphilise. Ikhredithi yebhizinisi elincane yezinkampani ezincane. I-fund yokunciphisa amazinga obuphofu kumakhasimende avela kumakhaya athola ngaphansi kwe-R1,500. Inhlangano ebamba iqhaza izosebenzisa ithuluzi lokuhlola ubuphofu. Ukwakha amandla omthetho: Ngaphansi kwalesi siphakamiso se-fund, uxhaso lunikezwa ukuze kuqiniswe isikhungo nokuqinisekisa ukwesekwa kwaso kwesikhathi eside. Ukonga njalo: Lokhu kusiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhuthazeni ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zezimali nezinye izikhungo zokonga zomdabu ezifana nezinhlelo zokubhaka nez stokvels ukuze kuqoqwe ingcebo yendawo. I-Apex ikwenza umsebenzi wayo ngezinhlelo ezibhalisiwe, ngakho-ke ukukhetha kwabo kubalulekile kakhulu futhi kuqhubeka. Ngalesi senzo, ihlinzeka ngamanani amaningi ezinhlelo ezibhalisiwe, izikhungo zebhizinisi lendawo, izikhungo zabazithandayo, kanye nemiphakathi efanele isebenzisa izici ezijwayelekile. Ekutholeni inani enhlangano, i-Apex ilandela imihlahlandlela ecacile engahlukaniswa ngezindawo ezilandelayo: inhlangano, umhleli, ukuphathwa, ubuholi, ubudlelwano bezabasebenzi, indawo yokusebenza, imisebenzi yesigaba, ukusebenza ngaphezu kokuhambisana, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamakhanda.
Ukweba ugesi kubhekisela kunoma yisiphi isenzo esingagunyaziwe sokuphazamisa amathuluzi, izinto, noma izinsiza ukuze uxhumane ngendlela ekhombisa noma engaholela emandleni kagesi angafundeki noma awedwa, noma ukuze uthole inzuzo engafanele kagesi. Ukweba ugesi kuyinselele edinga ukuxazululwa ukuze kugcinwe umkhakha wokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Kungani kubalulekile? Kuphikisana nomthetho: ukuhweba kubhekwa njengesenzo sobugebengu esingaphathwa ngumlomo. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngaphandle kwemvume yokuxhuma noma ukubhalisela njengomthengi endaweni yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kanye nokuphazamisa umgibeli kagesi, kuyisenzo sobugebengu. Ukuze ugweme lesi simo, kufanele uxhumane nomhlinzeki wakho wogesi bendawo bese ufaka isicelo. Kuzodingeka ukhokhe imali yokuxhuma ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho processing. Akukho justice kulabo abathengi abangakhokhi ugesi. Ukuhluleka kagesi: ukuxhumana okungekho emthethweni kuvame ukuholela ekwehlulekeni kwemigudu kagesi, okungase kuwe. Ukwehluleka kungase kuthinte nezindawo eziseduze. Lezi zinkinga zagesi azibangelwa umhlinzeki kagesi. Ukuhluleka kagesi kungaholela nasezingeni zamandla kagesi angalawulwa, okungase kubangele ukulimala kwezinsiza kagesi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abathengi abangakhokhi ugesi. Ingxenye enzima ukuthi abathengi abangenacala ngeke babe nendlela yokuphikisa kumhlinzeki kagesi, njengoba inkinga ingase ingabangelwa umhlinzeki noma ingase ibe ngenxa yokungakhathaleli kwabo. Abahlinzeki bagesi badinga ukuhweba ngenprofit efanelekile ukuze bakhokhe izindleko zagesi abathenga kubakhiqizi bagesi. Inzuzo evela ekuthengiseni ugesi isiza ukugcina ibhizinisi lokuhlinzeka ngogesi futhi ivumela umhlinzeki ukuthi aqhubeke nemisebenzi yabo. Ngakho-ke, ukuhweba ugesi kubeka engcupheni ikusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ukwehla kwemali engenayo kusho ukuthi imali encane iyahamba ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abangakatholi ugesi kuzodingeka balinde isikhathi eside. Ezimweni eziningi zokuxhumana okungekho emthethweni kagesi, ubungozi buvela ngoba ama-cables awavikelekile, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo zabantu. Ukulahlekelwa kwenzuzo ngenxa yokwehla kokuthengiswa kusho ukuthi kufanele kutholakale indawo ethile ukuze kugcwaliswe leli gabadi. Le simo sichaza ukwanda kwentengo kagesi. Ubani othintekayo kulokhu? Kuthinta labo abathengi abangakhokhi ugesi ngoba inzuzo elahlekile ibuyiselwa ngokukhuphula intengo? Xhumana nomakhelwane wakho mayelana nomthelela walokhu. Nika umakhelwane wakho iseluleko ngendlela efanele yokufaka isicelo sokuxhumana kagesi. Xhumana namakhelwane akho; bangase babe nesixazululo kulokhu. Phakamisa le ndaba emhlanganweni womphakathi noma nezinhlangano zendawo. Thumela le ndaba emnyangweni wezokuxhumana nabathengi. Xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho wogesi uma unemininingwane ngothile ophanga ugesi. Njengomthengi osebenzisa ugesi, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhokha insizakalo ethunyelwe kuwe. Uma unenkinga yokukhokha ibhili yakho ngesikhathi, mhlawumbe isixazululo singaba ukusetha uhlelo lokukhokha ugesi olwenziwe ngaphambi. Ngale ndlela, ungakwazi ukuphatha kangcono ugesi owusebenzisa. Ukweba ugesi kuphazamisa bonke abathengi, hhayi kuphela endaweni yakho kodwa kungase kube nomthelela omkhulu kwezinye izindawo. Njengokugcina, ungathumela ukul complaint kumlawuli wegesi. Abathengi bakhuthazwa ukuba baxhumane nomhlinzeki wogesi ngqo lapho bengakwazi ukufaka izikhalazo. Uma unganelisekile, ungaphakamisa le ndaba kumlawuli wegesi kazwelonke, ozophenya le ndaba ngokujulile. Ukulawula umkhakha wokuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokulandela izinqubomgomo nemithetho kuhlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamanje nezangomuso zababambiqhaza emkhakheni kagesi ngokusebenzisa amasu afanele aholela ekusimameni kwesikhathi eside. Umphakathi wegesi, ngokubambisana nomnyango wezinsizakalo zabathengi, uzinikele ekuthuthukiseni izinga lenkonzo emkhakheni wokuhlinzeka ngogesi futhi ugcine abathengi bekwaziswa ngezinkinga ezithinta ukuhlinzekwa kagesi.
Izimpawu ezintsha zomphakathi ziwuhlonzo oluphakeme, olunikezwa nguMongameli kubantu, kanye nakwabanye abantu abahloniphekile kakhulu abakwamanye amazwe. UMongameli ungumthombo (umgibeli, itheku, kanye nomthombo omkhulu) wokuhlonipha ezweni, yingakho uMongameli engumuntu ophakamisayo izihlonzo futhi enikeza izimpawu zokuhlonipha. INingizimu Afrika idlule endleleni ende yokuhlukanisa nesikhumbuzo sokukoloni esisekelwe ebudlelwaneni, umbala, kanye nokukholwa. Izwe lethu liqhubeka nokuqhubeka endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu nobukhulu kubantu bonke. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu babantu bonke, kukhona isiko elisha lamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonipha ubukhulu bomoya womuntu, okukhombisa ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Imithombo yezimpawu zokuhlukanisa nezikhathi ezedlule ibonakaliswa ngokuphakanyiswa kwefulegi elisha ngo-1994. Leso sikhathi saqinisa ukuzigqaja kwethu nobukhulu bezwe elijabulela ukuhlonishwa kwabantu bonke. Enye into ebalulekile kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwe-emblem yezenhlalakahle entsha, ehlanganisa umlando wabantu bonke bezwe, ngoMsombuluko 27, 2000. Ngokwenza kanjalo, lokhu kuhlinzeka ngakho konke ubuhle be-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuvuka nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Le emblem entsha yezenhlalakahle isekelwe emoyeni walolo vuselelo lwezizwe. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanamakhono aphezulu kwezobuciko nokwakha, futhi abafeze amazinga aphezulu empumelelo ngendlela engajwayelekile. IMapungubwe - Ubukhosi beMapungubwe babusemhlabeni ophakathi kwezwe lethu eminyakeni eyinkulungwane edlule. Lolu bukhosi lwalunohlelo oluhle lokuphatha, futhi lwaluphambili kakhulu kwezolimo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lolu bukhosi lwalunemigodi kanye nezimboni zensimbi. Lolu bukhosi lwathengiselana namazwe akude njengeChina. Ngesikhathi salolu bukhosi, babe nenhlonipho enkulu emkhakheni wokucabanga okujulile nokwakha. I-mapungubwe artifact - Sisiqalo nendawo, i-artifact iyingxenye yomhlaba enedwala efakwe ngothuli, endaweni eyomile nephakeme, engatholi imvula eningi yesikhathi sasehlobo, njengoba kuboniswe ngesikhathi sokuhlola okukhombisa ubuciko obukhulu obutholakele endaweni yemvelo kodwa ngezimo ezinzima. Iroyal staff yeMapungubwe - itholakele futhi emathuneni egolide kokubili - okuyinto eyodwa eyakhelwe futhi yatholakala ethuneni elahlwa ngababhalisi bendawo (indawo yokuhlola). I-vessel ehloniphekile yokungcwaba igolide - ifomu le-vessel elivela ku-vessel yokungcwaba igolide libonisa ubuciko obunothile, isayensi, kanye nekhono lokwakha, okukhombisa impumelelo yasendulo ekukhiqizeni insimbi. Ilanga eliphakamisayo - libonisa ukukhanya okusha e-Afrika. Isikhungo sokungcwaba insimbi - sihlambulula futhi sithuthukise impilo ngokuqhume, okusetshenziswe kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, kanye nempumelelo eqhubekayo nobuciko kuzo zonke izindawo. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngenxa yomsebenzi wabo ophakeme. Le misebenzi akufanele ibe imisebenzi ejwayelekile kuphela kodwa idlule emkhakheni ojwayelekile, futhi futhi yenziwe ngabantu hhayi kuphela ngenxa yokukhokhwa kodwa ukuze baphumelele kulokho okujwayelekile nokulindelekile. Ukukhuthazwa kubuchwepheshe, nokukhonza imiphakathi. Sisiqhamuka esihlahleni esibalulekile kwezolimo. Sihlinzeka ngama-fibers ezindwangu nezintambo, izithelo, nomlilo, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi ezisiza. I-Baobab (Baobab noma i-Adansonia Digitata) - iyaziwa ngamagatsha ayo nezimpande zayo zempilo ende. Sihlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala kanye nendawo yokwabelana, futhi sibuye sibe nesithakazelo esikhulu ekusekeleni imiphakathi lapho sitholakala khona. Ifomu leziqongo eziyisishiyagalolunye - ifomu eliyisishiyagalolunye leziqongo limele imikhakha eminingi ehlukene lapho imisebenzi ehlukene ingaqhutshelwa ukuze kwakhiwe izwe elizinzile nelithuthukayo. Le symbol ibuye imele izifunda eziyisishiyagalolunye zezwe lethu. Le emblem inikezwa kubahlonishwa abakwamanye amazwe (Abaholi bezwe kanye nohulumeni, nabanye abantu abahloniphekile abakwamanye amazwe) ukuze kubonakale ubudlelwano neNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho siba yisithonjana sokuthula, ukubambisana, kanye nesibonakaliso sokuhlanganyela nokusekela. Le emblem iyisithonjana esibalulekile sobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. Imiklomelo emibili yokuqala ihlanganisa izigaba ezine: iphendenti, ibhajethi yephimbo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel rosette. I-emblem yokugcina inezigaba ezintathu: ibhajethi yephimbo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel pin. Umjola (inyoka etholakala emathafeni) - Inyoka evakashela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Ayilimazi ingane noma amalunga omndeni, futhi indlela yokukhipha le nyoka iwukuthi umama wengane adle. Le nyoka ivakashela ingane ukuze iyilungiselele ikusasa elikhanyayo neliphephile ebuncaneni bayo. Iza njengomngane nomvikeli. Ubudlelwano obumele, obusekelwe ekubekezeleni okuhle, bukhona emoyeni wokukhombisa ukweseka nokufuna ukuphakamisa nokukhuthaza impumelelo yesikhathi esizayo yezenhlalakahle ezincane kanye namalunga omphakathi akhulayo. Le nyoka bekuwumlando wethu ngenxa yesikhathi esidumile esabhala kudala esibizwa ngokuthi: Uthukuthelo Lwabokhokho, obhalwe ngu-AC Jordan. Le ndaba iphikisa umqondo wokuthi le nyoka iyisidalwa esiyingozi nesilimazayo, kodwa ikhombisa umbono ocebile we-Afrika, iqonda le nyoka njengomngane kanye nelungu lemvelo okufanele liphila ndawonye. Umjola - indwangu eyakhelwe, eyenziwe ngama-fibers amnyama, isuka esihlahleni sase-Afrika, iyisithonjana sobungane ekusekeleni nasekubambisaneni okukhonjiswa ngabangane, futhi ibonisa nokuzibophezela ekusekeleni nasekuma nabantu abasisekelayo.
Lo mhlahlandlela uzokusiza ukuthi udle ukudla okunempilo, usebenzisa ukudla okutholakalayo. Uma unesifo esingapheli (njengesifo senhliziyo, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV), kubalulekile kakhulu ukudla okunempilo. Ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo kungakusiza ukuthi ulwe nezifo futhi kukusize uphumelele ekubhekaneni nesifo. Ukudla okunempilo akusho ukuthenga ukudla okukhethekile okudayiswa ngentengo ephezulu! Ukudla okunempilo kusho ukukhetha ngokuhlakanipha ukudla okuzohlinzeka umzimba wakho ngazo zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo. Le pamphlet izokusiza ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo okutholakalayo. Zama ukudla izinhlobonhlobo zokudla ngangokunokwenzeka. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuthi uthole zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Izakhamzimba yizinto ezitholakala ekudleni. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezakhamzimba ezitholakala ekudleni, okungukuthi amaprotheni, amakarbohayidrethi, amafutha, ama-vithamini, nezinsimbi. Zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho azitholakali kuphela kulolu hlobo lokudla, ngakho kufanele udle izinhlobonhlobo zokudla. Kubalulekile ukudla ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile. Zama ukudla okungenani kathathu ngosuku. Uma kungenzeka, zama futhi ukudla ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile, ikakhulukazi uma ungumuntu odla kancane. Ukudla okuyisisekelo kufanele kuphakwe kakhulu kunezinye izithako zokudla. Ukudla okuyisisekelo kungaba yiphuthu, ubhontshisi, irayisi, amaphuphu, noma noma iyiphi enye ukudla okune-starch okutholakalayo. Iningi kwalokhu kudla kulula ukukuthola. Ukuze wenze ukudla okunempilo, engeza ukudla okune-starch noma noma iyiphi enye ukudla okutholakalayo, njengezithelo, amabhontshisi, amaqanda, noma izithelo. Izitshalo nezithelo zinikeza ama-vithamini nezinye izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni ukuze kugcinwe isistimu yokuzivikela iqinile. Zama ukudla izinhlobo eziningi zezithako nezithelo nsuku zonke. Izitshalo ezijulile ezinemibala ephuzi, oranje, noma eluhlaza njenge-spinach, beetroot, ufulawa, amakaroti, kanye nepapa zine-vithamini A eningi. I-vithamini A isiza ukugcina isistimu yokuzivikela iqinile. Zama ukudla okungenani uhlobo olulodwa lwezitshalo noma izithelo ezine-vithamini A nsuku zonke. Ezinye izitshalo nezithelo zikhulisa i-vithamini C eningi, esiza ukulwa nezifo. Izibonelo zalokhu zifaka izithelo ezifana namagilebhisi, amatanjile, ipapa, namalimu, kanye nezitolo, ama-mango, ama-guava, ikhabhishi, namaphuphu. Zama ukudla izitshalo nezithelo ezine-vithamini C nsuku zonke. Zama ukudla okungenani izinhlobo ezinhlanu ezahlukene zezithako noma izithelo nsuku zonke. Ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zakho zamandla, qala manje ngokutshala imbewu yezitshalo nezihlahla ezimbili zezithelo. Awudingi isikhala esikhulu ukuze wenze lokhu, futhi ungasebenzisa nezitsha zokutshala ukuze ukhule izitshalo eziluhlaza ezinemiphumela emihle. Uma kungekho sikhala ekhaya, kungani ungahlanganyeli emkhankasweni wezolimo emphakathini, noma usize ukuqala umkhankaso wezolimo esikhungweni sakho? Ungaqala futhi ingadi yakho encane nabangani bakho. Uma izithelo zikhokha kakhulu, thenga izitshalo eziningi esikhundleni. I-pumpkin, amaphuphu, amaphuphu amsweet, amakaroti, i-spinach, nezitolo zinhle ngoba zinikeza ama-vithamini amaningi nezinsimbi ngaphandle kokuba zibe nezindleko eziphezulu. Phaka izitshalo ngamanzi ambalwa. Ngemuva kwalokho, lawa manzi angasetshenziswa ukwenza isobho noma isitshulu - noma uwaphuze ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izakhamzimba emanzini azichithwa. Izitshalo ezivundlile ezifana ne-amaranth noma i-spinach yasendle nazo zindlela ezinhle zokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi udla izitshalo ezanele. Abantu abaningi bathenga izitshalo nezithelo kubathengisi bezitaladi. Ngezinye izikhathi ziba nezindleko eziphansi kunezindawo zokuthenga futhi zitholakala kalula. Thenga izitshalo nezithelo ezigcinwa emthunzini ngoba ilanga lihlupha izakhamzimba eziningi ezibalulekile. Thenga izitshalo nezithelo ezikhona ngesikhathi, njengoba ziba nezindleko eziphansi. Ukudla okutholakala ezilwaneni njengezinkukhu, inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi, noma amaqanda kungadliwa nsuku zonke. Nokho, ezinye zalezi zinto, ikakhulukazi izinkukhu, inhlanzi, kanye nenyama, zivame ukuba nezindleko eziphezulu. Ukuze uthole izinkukhu, izimbuzi, izinkomo, noma ezinye izilwane ekhaya kungakunika inyama, amaqanda, futhi ngisho nobisi. Ungajabulela futhi ezinye izidlo ezine-protein eningi njengezitho, amaphaphu, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, izitho zomzimba, ama-tripe, kanye namaqanda. Thenga ubisi obusha esikhundleni sokuthenga izikhumbuzo zobisi, ama-creamer, kanye nobisi oluqinile. Lezi zindleko ziphezulu ngoba ziqukethe izakhamzimba ezincane kakhulu. Uma ungekho kahle futhi uzwa ubuthakathaka, engeza amafutha noma ushukela ekudleni kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukudla kube mnandi futhi kukusize uthole amandla ngaphandle kokudla kakhulu. Jabulela ukuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile futhi aphephile - akubizi futhi unempilo kuneti nekhofi. Uma ungazi ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile noma aphephile, phaka kuphela bese uvumela ukuba kuphole ngaphambi kokuphuza. Uthuli uphuca imali futhi uphuca umzimba wakho izakhamzimba. Esikhundleni salokho, sebenzisa imali yakho ukuthenga ukudla okunempilo. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukugwema ukuphuza utshwala ngenkathi uthatha imithi. Hlala usemsebenzini ngangokunokwenzeka uma uzwa kahle. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuthi ugcine imisipha yakho iqinile. Ukunyakaza komzimba wakho, njengokuhamba, ukusebenza engadini, noma ukuhlanza indlu, kuzokugcina uqine kodwa futhi kuthuthukise umoya wakho. Cabanga ngokunikeza isikhathi sakho noma ukwenza eminye imisebenzi ukuze uthole ukudla. Ungasiza esikoleni, esontweni, ekhitshini, noma ekhitshini lesobho ukuze uthole ukudla okunempilo noma ibhagi yokudla. Khetha ukudla okujabulisayo nokutholakalayo endaweni yakho. Lezi zibonelo ezilandelayo zingakusiza ngezinsiza zokupheka ukudla okulula, okunempilo okutholakala ngamanani aphansi. Phaka isitshulu samabhontshisi futhi uhlanganise ne-tomato kanye ne-onion stew. Ungangeza nezinsipho kule dish ukuze uyiqedele. Uma uzwa ungathandi ukudla kahle, phaka iphuthu elanelisayo. Ungakwenza lokhu kanje: Phaka ikomishi eyodwa ye-cornmeal. Engeza izipuni ezintathu ezincane ezigcwele ubisi oluphakeme, isipuni esisodwa se-oyela noma ibhotela, nezipuni ezimbili ezincane zoshukela kuphuthu bese uhlanganisa. Ukuze wenze isidlo esinempilo sonke umndeni, ungapheka ithini elikhulu le-sardines (khumbula ukusebenzisa amathambo) bese uhlanganisa nehhafu yekhasi lefulawa noma ama-breadcrumbs. Engeza amaqanda amathathu aphukile bese uhlanganisa kahle. Yenza ama-patties amancane bese uwafrya ngama-oyela ambalwa. Phaka ne-salad entsha, amaphuphu ap
Umthetho wezokuphepha ufaneleka ukuthi, njengabaphathi bezokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika, sithande abantu ngobuqotho nangokuhlonipha ukuhlukahluka kwabo kanye nomthetho, ngaleyo ndlela sithuthukise futhi sithuthukise umsebenzi wethu ngendlela evumelekile emphakathini. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha athatha iqiniso njengokubaluleka ngaphambi kwakho konke. Ukuze sichaze: Thina, njengabaphathi bezokuphepha, sizohlale sizama ukugcina inhloso, sibe nolwazi ngezimiso zomthetho wezokuphepha. Ukuziphatha kwethu kuzohambisana nalezi zimiso. Sizoziphatha ngobuqotho nokuzinikela noma ngabe yisiphi isimo. Sizohlale sikhuluma iqiniso, senza imisebenzi yethu ngenhlonipho, futhi sibe isibonelo emiphakathini esiyisebenzela. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha amukela ukuhlukahluka kwabantu ezweni lethu futhi ahloniphe bonke abantu ngokulinganayo. Ukuze sichaze: Ekufezeni umsebenzi wethu, sizohlale sikhombisa ukuhlonipha sikwazi ukuthi imiphakathi ihlukahlukene, ezamasiko nakwezinye izindlela. Sizobhekana nonke ngokuhlonipha futhi sihloniphe amalungelo abo njengabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Asizukwehlukanisa ngokungekho emthethweni noma yimuphi umuntu. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha azohlale ehonipha futhi agcine umthetho. Ukuze sichaze: Umsebenzi wethu uhambisana kakhulu nokuphathwa komthetho, ngakho-ke sithi sizohlale siba ngaphansi komthetho nasemthethweni wezwe lethu. Sizohlale sigwema ukuziphatha ngendlela ezosiholela ekuphuleni umthetho. Sizohlale sivikela abantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika ezinyathelweni ezingekho emthethweni. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha azama njalo ukwenza imisebenzi yabo kahle. Ukuze sichaze: Sizohlale, kuyo yonke imizamo yethu, senza umsebenzi wethu ngazo zonke izinsiza esinazo. Ukuziphatha kwethu kuzohlale kukhombisa ubuchwepheshe bomsebenzi wethu. Ukuziphatha kwethu nokubukeka kuzokwandisa ukuzinikela kwethu ekwenzeni kahle. Ukwenza: Amalungu omnyango wezokuphepha asebenza ndawonye nomphakathi ngoba afuna ukwamukelwa nokwesekwa emphakathini. Ukuze sichaze: Sizosebenza ngothando olukhulu lomphakathi, futhi ngazo zonke izizathu zokweseka umthetho, futhi sifuna ukwamukelwa komphakathi wonke.
Ifomu iqukethe indlela yokubika ngokuqondile emsebenzini obikwe kwiMnyango Wezabasebenzi. Le fomu ifaka phakathi nezidingo zokubika abaqashi abakhethiwe, labo abasebenza ngaphansi kuka-150 noma ngaphezulu kuka-150. Ifomu iphinde ifake umbiko wokuqhubeka okumele uqedwe ngemuva kwesikhathi sokuqala sokubika. Bonke abaqashi abakhethiwe kumele bathumele umbiko njengoba kuchaziwe nguMthetho Wobudlelwano Babasebenzi u-55 ka-1998. Noma ubani oqashiwe ophumelele ngokuzithandela ukuhlinzeka ngombiko wezobulungiswa bezabasebenzi kumele athumele umbiko wokuqala ngaphambi kosuku lukaJuni 1, 2000, bese elandela ngomunye unyaka, ngosuku lokuqala luka-Okthoba 2001. Kumele baqedele zonke izingxenye zefomu ngaphandle kwengxenye G embikweni wokuqala. Kumele baqedele zonke izingxenye zale fomu, kuhlanganise nengxenye G embikweni olandelayo. Kumele bathumele umbiko wokuqala ngaphambi kosuku lukaDisemba 1, 2000, bese elandela nabanye ngemva konyaka, ngosuku lokuqala lomsebenzi ngo-Okthoba, kuqala ngo-2002. Kumele baqedele izingxenye A, B, F, no-H embikweni wokuqala. Kumele baqedele izingxenye A, B, F, G, no-H emibikweni elandelayo. Kumele baqedele umbuzo 8.2 (izigaba zendawo yokusebenza) kuwo wonke imibiko. Ngokuzithandela, kumele baqedele izingxenye C, D, no-E kuwo wonke imibiko.
Khuluma ulimi lwakho. Kuyilungelo lakho. Yisiphi isevisi ethile enikezwa? I-TISSA inikeza izinsizakalo zokuhumusha ngefoni ukuze kube lula kubo bonke obala ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zikahulumeni. Kungani i-TISSA ikwenza lo msebenzi? I-TISSA ikhuthaza amalungelo okuthuthukisa ulimi futhi ikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwazo zonke izilimi zendabuko ezisemthethweni. Ingabe umphakathi ungacela izinsizakalo zikahulumeni ngolimi lwabo lokuzalwa? Yebo, uma nje kungulimi lwesizwe olusemthethweni. Ingabe ulimi lwezimpawu luhlanganiswe? Yebo, abantu abaphuphuthekayo bazothola izinga elifanayo le sevisi njengomuntu ophilayo. Izindawo zokusebenza zikhona ezikhungweni ezinkulu zendawo. Le sevisi isebenza kanjani? Le sevisi inikeza umhumushi ozohumusha isicelo sakho. Ngizokwazi kanjani uma umnyango kahulumeni ungisiza? Kuzoba nezimpawu ezikhombisa ehhovisi likahulumeni ukuthi izinsizakalo zokuhumusha zikhona. Uma ihhovisi likahulumeni lingakhombisi uphawu lwe-TISSA, ngingakwenza lokhu isicelo? Yebo, ungacela le sevisi, kuphela uma abasebenzi bekulungele ukuyinika. Le sevisi izongisiza kanjani? Umhumushi oqeqeshiwe uzokusiza wena nomsebenzi kahulumeni ukuba nemininingwane enembile. Unelungelo lokukhuluma ulimi lwakho. Uhulumeni uzosiza ukuhlanganisa noma yiziphi izikhala zokuxhumana ezikhona. Khuluma ulimi lwakho, kuyilungelo lakho. Izinsizakalo zokuhumusha ngefoni zikhona lapha. Ukuhumusha ngefoni kuyatholakala lapha.
Kungani kufanele sithathe isinqumo sokuhlinzeka ngosizo oluqondile? Ukwaneliseka umuntu akuthola uma eqhathanisa ukusebenza noma ukusetshenziswa kwalokho akutholayo nezilindelo zakhe. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluqondile ezingeni lomhlaba kuthuthukisa izinga lenkonzo esinikeza amakhasimende ethu ngokushintsha umqondo wabasebenzi bethu ukusuka emcabangweni wesikhashana uze ube sesimweni sokuzinza kumakhasimende - ngokwenza lokhu, sizohlangabezana futhi sithuthukise lokho amakhasimende alindele kulolu bhange kanye nezinsizakalo zalo. Ukusiza okuqondile yikho esikufunayo ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngoba siyazi ukuthi ulindele ukusiza okuqondile kulolu Bhange Lomhlaba. Uma usizo olutholile namuhla lukwazile ukujabulisa, sicela ubhale kumngane. Uma unganelisekile, sicela wazise umphathi wesigaba. Ukubaluleka kokugxila ekugcineni amakhasimende kuye kwanda. Ubhange Lomhlaba luzokwazi kuphela ukugcina amakhasimende alo uma luthuthukisa ekuhlangabezaneni nasekuthokoziseni izidingo zamakhasimende. Esikhathini esedlule, uBhange Lomhlaba wawungakhathazeki, futhi kwakungekho mfuneko yokwenza imizamo ekhethekile yokugcina amakhasimende. Manje, uBhange Lomhlaba luncintisana namakhasimende namanye amabhangqa ezohwebo. Abantu manje bangakhetha ukuthi yimaphi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo abafuna. Amakhasimende namuhla afundile futhi ayahlakanipha. Izinga lokulindela lamakhasimende lenyukile ngenxa yezinga lemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Uma uBhange Lomhlaba uzinikele ekugcineni amakhasimende alo nasekugcineni isikhundla sawo emkhakheni wezezimali, kudingeka imicabango emisha noma imibono, ngoba izodlula izinkampani ezibeka amakhasimende azo phambili ngokuhlinzeka ngensizakalo esezingeni eliphezulu. Umsebenzi wokugcina amakhasimende awuwona umthwalo kuphela weMnyango Wokumaketha Nezokuthengisa. IMnyango Yokumaketha ingaphumelela kuphela uma ixhumana kahle namanye amakhono kanye nabasebenzi ukuze ihlele futhi iqhube amasu okuncintisana aphezulu kanye nosizo olunenzuzo kumakhasimende. Yini ukusiza okuqondile? Lokhu kusho ukwenza konke okusemandleni akho nangaphezulu ukuze uxazulule inkinga yekhasimende. Kubandakanya ukwenza "okungaphezu kokulindelekile." Ukwenza okungaphezu kwalokho okukhuluma ngakho emsebenzini wakho, okungaphezu kwalokho abanye abangakwenza. Konke kukhulu ngawe. Qhubeka ulindele izinto ezinhle, ube nomdlandla wokusebenza, ube nezinhloso ezinhle nezikhuthazayo. Qhubeka uzame ukwenza okungcono kakhulu. Kukho uthando lomsebenzi wakho nokuzigqaja ngalokho okwenza. Kukho ukuzigqaja ngokusebenza kuBhange Lomhlaba. Yini uhlelo Lokusiza lweBhange Lomhlaba? Lolu hlelo lukhombisa ukuthi singahlinzeka kanjani ngosizo oluhlukile kubantu bethu. Ngokulandela lezi ziqondiso, uzokwakha isipiliyoni esijabulisayo nesijabulisayo kubasebenzi nakumakhasimende. Lolu hlelo Lokusiza lungumhlahlandlela wakho wokuhlinzeka ngosizo "kulabo abakufronti." Omunye wemigomo ehleliwe yeBhange Lomhlaba ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo impilo yabantu bonke. Wena, njengommeleli webhange, unethuba elikhulu lokuba yingxenye yokushintsha ikusasa labantu! Ungowokwenza abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela amandla abo ngokuhlinzeka ngama-funds abangawasebenzisa ukuze bafeze amaphupho abo. Asigxili kuphela ekuthuthukiseni abantu ngaphandle kwebhange kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi bethu. Lolu hlelo luzosiza futhi ukuba ukhule ube umuntu okhathalelayo kwabanye futhi uphathe kahle usizo oluhlinzekayo. Siphakamisa bonke abasebenzi beBhange Lomhlaba ukuba babambe iqhaza noma basebenze ngokulandela amaphuzu alandelayo: Masikhuthaze futhi sikhuthazane nsuku zonke, hhayi kuphela ukwenza kahle ngezakhono zethu kodwa futhi ukusabalalisa injabulo ekuphatheni umsebenzi wethu nasekuphileni kwethu! Bhalisela amakhasimende ngokushesha ngokubabheka emehlweni. Uma ungakwazi ukusiza ikhasimende ngokushesha, wazise ukuthi uzobasiza maduze. Bhalisela wonke amakhasimende endaweni yokulinda, noma uzobasiza noma cha, bese ubuza uma sebekwazile ukuthola usizo nokuthi ungabasiza kanjani. Uma usukulungele ukusiza ikhasimende, mushe, bhalisela, uthi "sawubona," uxolise ngokulinda, bese uzethula ngegama, isibonelo, "Sawubona, ngiyaxolisa ngokukugcina ulindile. NgiyiJane (noma uNkk. Smith), ngingakusiza kanjani namuhla?" Ulimi lomzimba wakho kufanele lukhombise ukuncipha, futhi izwi lakho kufanele libe nomoya opholile. Thola ukuthi ikhasimende ngubani bese usebenzisa igama labo kuyo yonke ingxoxo. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakhipha igama labo kahle. Xhumana nomuntu ngokuba nengxoxo emfushane nabo uma kungenzeka. "Kuyinsuku enhle namuhla, akunjalo?" Yiba nomusa, ungahlukanisi, ulindele izinto ezinhle, futhi ube nomuntu. Khombisa ubuchwepheshe emsebenzini wakho futhi njalo ulindele izinto ezinhle. Ungavumeli amakhasimende ukuba azwe izingxoxo zakho zangasese, noma uma ukhuluma ngefoni noma unenxoxo phakathi kwabantu ababili. Phatha ngokuhlonipha. Ungaphenduli ifoni yakho ye-cell ngaphandle kokuxolisa ku ikhasimende kuqala bese uzixolela ngemva kokuphothula ucingo. Wazise ikhasimende ukuthi uhamba kuphi uma ushiya indawo yakho yokusebenza. Lalela ngokucophelela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubuza yonke imibuzo ezoholela ekutholeni yonke imininingwane efanele. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda konke abakukhuluma, noma uma lokhu kusho ukuthola umuntu ozokhuluma ngesiNgisi. Qiniseka ukuthi uyakuqonda inkinga ethulelwe kuwe ngaphambi kokuzama ukuyixazulula. Phatha abantu bonke ngenhlonipho enkulu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi babukeka kanjani. Phatha wonke umuntu sengathi uthwele igolide. Thatha isikhathi sokuchaza ikhasimende ukuthi kungani isicelo sabo sesikweletu saphikiswa. Uma ikhasimende lingatholi isikweletu ngokusekelwe ezimfuneko zeBronze, Silver, noma Gold, ubabheke kwenye uhlobo lwesikweletu oluphansi (isikweletu seBronze singaba isinyathelo sokuqala). Thatha isikhathi sokuzama ukuhlinzeka ikhasimende ngosizo olufanele kanye nezinsiza zezezimali (ukuhlukaniswa kwezingozi) ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zabo. Ungagxeki amaphutha enziwe yibhange elinye noma ibhange eliyinhloko. Yenza inkinga ibe yakho futhi ungaboleka ikhasimende imali ngokwesikhashana uma isimo sivumela. Gwema ukwenza umsebenzi ongekho emthethweni wokuhlinzeka ngosizo lapho abantu bekufronti. Qedela ingxoxo yakho nekhasimende ngokubabonga, ubabize ngegama, futhi ubafisele "ubusuku obuhle." Wazise umamukeli wocingo uma ungakabi nesikhathi sokuthola izingcingo ngalolo suku. Ungakwenzi izingcingo lapho usebenza noma uyeke ifoni ibhange. Xolisa kumuntu uma ucingo lwakho luhamba isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokuphendulwa. Umamukeli wocingo kuBhange Lomhlaba "Isigaba," Sawubona, ngingakusiza kanjani?" ungakhetha ulimi ofuna ukhulume ngalo. Sawubona, ngiyi [Igama], ngingakusiza kanjani? Ungakhetha ukuthi yimaphi ulimi ofuna ukhulume ngalo. Thola ukuthi ikhasimende ngubani bese usebenzisa
I-NPI iyisisekelo somphakathi, ebhekwa njengokweseka uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, ngenhloso yokuphatha kwezezimali kwazulu. Ihloselwe ukuba yisikhungo esihamba phambili ekuthuthukiseni izindinganiso zomkhiqizo eziphelele, ngamasu amasha futhi aqhubekayo "okwenza kube nezinzuzo kubo bonke ngendlela efanele emphakathini." I-National Product Foundation iyinhlangano ye-triangle ezinikele ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhuthazeni izindinganiso zemikhiqizo eNingizimu Afrika ngokuchaza umoya we-triangle ngokucwaninga, ukusabalalisa ulwazi, ukuqeqesha, ukuvuselela, ukuxhumana, ukuhlola izincwadi, nokuphatha kuyo yonke imisebenzi yomkhiqizo kanye nezinselelo zokwandisa izinga lempilo kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Vakashela kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi mayelana nemisebenzi ye-NPI, ikakhulukazi mayelana nezinhlelo zayo. I-NPI ithuthukisile izinhlelo ezinhlanu zokubhekana nezinkinga ezibalulekile, amasu, nezinyathelo. Umphathi wehlelo ubheka yonke uhlelo. Umthetho Wokuphromotha Ukufinyelela Kolwazi, Umthetho 2 ka-2000 (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "umthetho") uhlose ukuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwesithakazelo somthethosisekelo sokufinyelela kunoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso nanoma yiluphi ulwazi olugcinwe omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo, nokuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene nalokhu. IKomidi Lezokuhlaliswa Kwamalungelo Abantu eNingizimu Afrika kudingeka, ngokwesigaba 10 somthetho, ukuthi likhiphe umhlahlandlela oqukethe ulwazi olungacelwa nganoma ubani (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "umceli") ukuze umceli athole ulwazi olugcinwe nguMbuso futhi/noma omunye umuntu, lapho ulwazi lolu ludingeka ukuze kuqhutshwe noma kuvikelwe amalungelo omceli. I-NPI, uma kudingeka, izobuyekeza futhi ikhiphe izichibiyelo kulolu documeti oluchazayo uma noma uma kufanelekile, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esingadluli unyaka owodwa. Akukho sichazamazwi salabo i-NPI inawo ulwazi ngabo noma amarekhodi wezincwadi ezitholakalayo mayelana nabo ukuze zisetshenziswe. Ngokwalolu mthetho, umceli kufanele anikezwe ukufinyelela kudokhumenti eqoshiwe yomzimba womphakathi uma umceli ehambisana nazo zonke izidingo zokusebenza zomthetho ezihlobene nokucela ukufinyelela kulowo dokhumenti eqoshiwe, inqobo nje uma le dokhumenti eqoshiwe ingakhululeki nganoma yiziphi zezinkinga ezikhulunywa kulomthetho. Isicelo sokufinyelela kudokhumenti eqoshiwe njengoba kuchaziwe kumthetho kufanele sibe nobudlelwano obubalulekile neFomu A yePolisi -187 edluleka ngomhla kaFebhuwari 15, 2002, ukushicilelwa kwayo kutholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI, noma kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi le-NPI kanye nanoma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Uma umceli engakwazi ukufunda nokubhala, noma enokukhubazeka okwenza kube nzima ukuqhuba amalungelo akhe njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, isicelo sokufinyelela kudokhumenti eqoshiwe singacelwa ngenkulumo kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi kanye/noma nanoma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Idivayisi Yokuxhumana ye-NPI ibamba indima ebalulekile ekuhloleni izenzo zomkhiqizo emkhakheni wezokukhiqiza, ezentengiselwano, nezomphakathi kanye nezinhlelo ezisekelwe emphakathini, futhi inikeza izeluleko zokuthi lokhu kungasetshenziswa kanjani. Iqembu lokuxhumana le-NPI linikeza ulwazi olunzulu kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zobuchwepheshe ezilungiselelwe ngokwenza imisebenzi eminingi yomkhiqizo ezimakethe zasekhaya nezamazwe ngamazwe minyaka yonke. Uhlelo luthumele izinsizakalo zalo ezindaweni ezine, okungukuthi, iNkantolo Yokuhlola, Izinqubo Zokufunda, Ukuphathwa Kwezimakethe, kanye Nokuphathwa Kwezemisebenzi. Ulwazi oluningi mayelana nalezi zinsizakalo lungatholakala kuwebhusayithi ye-NPI, noma kumphathi wehhovisi lolwazi kanye/noma nanoma yisiphi ukwesekwa komphathi wehhovisi lolwazi. Ngokwezinye izikhungo zomphakathi, i-NPI ayinayo inqubo yangaphakathi yokufaka izikhalazo. Lapho umceli ekholelwa ukuthi i-NPI ayihambisanga noma yehlulekile ukulandela izibopho zayo ngaphansi komthetho, le ndaba izobhekwa ngababambiqhaza abafanele, uma kuvunyelwene, noma noma iyiphi iphathi ingathintana nanoma iyiphi inkantolo enegunya kulolu daba.
Ikholera yisifo esitholwa umuntu ngokuphuza amanzi nokudla okuthintekile ngamagciwane eholera. Amagciwane adala ikholera atholakala emfucumfucu yomuntu. Ikholera isabalala kanjani? Ungasebenzisi umfula njengento yokuhlanza, kodwa sebenzisa indlu yangasese efanele. Geza izandla zakho ngamanzi ashisayo noma insipho ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese nangaphambi kokuphatha ukudla. Ungamsiza kanjani umuntu ongekholera? Mnike amanzi amaningi ahlanganiswe noshukela/usalty ukuze aphe. Thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi abilisiwe, ungeze izipuni eziyisishiyagalombili zoshukela nezinyanga eziyisithupha zosalty, bese uxuba. Nika umuntu ogulayo le ngxube ukuze aphuze kancane futhi kaningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Khumbula, qhubeka unikeza le ngxube yoshlanga/usalty kumuntu ongekholera. Thutha lowo muntu ngokushesha uye emtholampilo noma endaweni yokwelashwa ngokushesha okukhulu. Uma udinga olunye ulwazi, noma uma ucabanga ukuthi ungase ube nekholela, vakashela emtholampilo, esibhedlela, kudokotela, noma kumsebenzi wezempilo oseduzane nawe.
Izindlela zokonga ngokusebenzisa nokwakha izakhiwo zomdabu ezifana nezinkampani zokungcwaba nez stokvels. Ukwakha imboni yezezimali esebenzayo encane eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhaswa kwezezimali ukuze kwakhiwe amandla omthetho ezinhlelweni ezibamba iqhaza kanye namakhasimende azo ukuze kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwabo emisebenzini yezezimali ephumelelayo. Ukonga njalo nokuhlinzekwa kwemali kubalulekile kokubili izinhlangano kanye neziqu zezezimali ezithengiswayo (RFIs) njengendlela yokwandisa nokujulisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezezimali kubantu abampofu futhi kuthuthukise isimo sabo sezezimali ukuze baphile kahle. Ukubazi kahle ngokuqonga akusiyo ukukhethwa kokwakhiwa, kodwa ukuqala nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ezisekelwe kulwazi lwezimpilo kuyakhuthazwa. Imali yokubolekwa yezezimali encane: Le nqubo ihlinzeka ngemali yokubolekwa efika ku-R10,000 kumakhaya nakwabanye abaqalayo abanguye amalungu ezinkampani ezincane ukuze bazinakekele. Iziqu zezimali ezincane zezimboni ezincane. Imali yokwehlisa amazinga obuphofu kumakhasimende avela kumakhaya athola ngaphansi kwe-R1,500. Inhlangano ebamba iqhaza izosebenzisa ithuluzi lokuhlola ubuphofu. Ukwakha amandla omthetho: Ngaphansi kwalesi siphakamiso semali, kunikezwa ukwesekwa ukuze kuqiniswe isikhungo futhi kuqinisekiswe ukwesekwa kwaso kwesikhathi eside. Ukonga njalo: Lokhu kusiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhuthazeni ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zezezimali nezinye izikhungo zokonga zomdabu ezifana nezinkampani zokungcwaba nez stokvels ukuze kuqoqwe ingcebo yasendaweni. I-Apex yenza umsebenzi wayo ngezinhlangano ezibhalisiwe ezibamba iqhaza, ngakho-ke ukukhetha kwazo kubalulekile kakhulu futhi kuqhubeka. Ngalesi senzo, ihlinzeka ngezinsiza eziningi ezikhungweni ezibhalisiwe, ezikhungweni zebhizinisi lendawo, ezikhungweni zabazithandayo, kanye nemiphakathi efanele isebenzisa izici ezijwayelekile. Ekutholeni inani enhlangano, i-Apex ilandela imihlahlandlela ecacile engahlukaniswa ngezindawo ezilandelayo: inhlangano, umhleli, ukuphathwa, ukuphathwa, ubudlelwano bezabasebenzi, indawo yokusebenza, imisebenzi yesigaba, ukusebenza ngaphezu kokuhambisana, izinhlelo zokuphatha ulwazi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphatha ama-akhawunti.
Ukweba ugesi kubhekisela kunoma yisiphi isenzo esingagunyaziwe sokuphazamisa amathuluzi, izinto, noma izinsiza ukuze uxhumane ngendlela ekhombisa noma engaholela enanini legesi elingafundeki noma elibiwe, noma ukuze uthole inzuzo engafanele ngogesi. Ukweba ugesi kuyinselelo okufanele ibhekwe ukuze kugcinwe imboni yokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Kungani kubalulekile? Kulimaza umthetho: ukweba kubhekwa njengesenzo esiphula umthetho esingaphathwa ngenkatho. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngaphandle kokugunyazwa kokuxhuma noma ukubhalisela ukuba ikhasimende lesikhungo sokuhlinzeka ngogesi lendawo, kanye nokuphazamisa i-meter yogesi, kuyisenzo esiphula umthetho. Ukuze ugweme lesi simo, kufanele uxhumane nomhlinzeki wakho wogesi lendawo bese ufaka isicelo. Kuzodingeka ukuthi ukhokhe imali yokuxhuma ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho processing. Akukho ubulungiswa kulabo bakhasimende abangakhokhi ugesi. Ukuhluleka kukagesi: ukuxhumana okungekho emthethweni kuvame ukuholela ekwehlulekeni kwesakhiwo sikagesi, okungase kuwe. Ukuhluleka kungathinta nezindawo eziseduze. Lezi zinkinga zikagesi azibheki umhlinzeki wogesi. Ukuhluleka kukagesi kungaholela nasekuphakamiseni amazinga kagesi angalawulwa, okungalimaza izinto zikagesi, ikakhulukazi kulabo bakhasimende abangakhokhi ugesi. Ingxenye enzima ukuthi abakhasimende abangenacala ngeke babe nendlela yokukhala kumhlinzeki wogesi, njengoba inkinga ingase ingadalwanga umhlinzeki noma ingase ibe ngenxa yokunganaki kwabo. Abahlinzeki bagesi kufanele bathole inzuzo efanelekile emsebenzini wabo ukuze bakhokhe izindleko zogesi abathenga kubakhiqizi bagesi. Inzuzo evela ekuthengiseni ugesi isiza ukugcina ibhizinisi lokuhlinzeka ngogesi futhi ivumela umhlinzeki ukuba uqhubeke nemisebenzi yabo. Ngakho, ukweba ugesi kubeka engcupheni ikusasa lokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ukwehla kwemali engenayo kusho ukuthi imali encane iyangeniswa ohlelweni lokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abantu abangenayo ugesi kuzomele balinde isikhathi eside. Ezimweni eziningi zokuxhumana okungekho emthethweni, izingozi zikhona ngoba amakhebula awaphephile, okuholela ekulahlekelweni kwabantu. Ukulahlekelwa kwenzuzo ngenxa yokwehla kokuthengiswa kusho ukuthi kufanele kutholakale indawo ethile ukuze kugcwaliswe leli gap. Lesi simo sichaza ukwanda kwentengo yegesi. Ubani ophazamisekile ngalokhu? Kubathinte abakhasimende abangakhokhi ugesi ngoba inzuzo elahlekile iyakhokhelwa ngokwenyusa intengo? Xhumana nomakhelwane wakho mayelana nomthelela walokhu. Nika umakhelwane wakho iseluleko sokuthi kufanele afake isicelo sokuxhumana ngogesi ngendlela efanele. Xhumana nomakhelwane wakho; bangase babe nesixazululo kulolu daba. Phakamisa le ndaba emhlanganweni womphakathi noma nezinhlangano zendawo. Thumela udaba emnyangweni wezokuxhumana namakhasimende. Xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho wogesi uma unemininingwane mayelana nomuntu owebayo ugesi. Njengomthengi osebenzisa ugesi, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokukhokha insizakalo ethunyelwe kuwe. Uma unenkinga yokukhokha ibhili yakho ngesikhathi, mhlawumbe isixazululo singaba ukusisebenzisa uhlelo lwesistimu yokukhokha ugesi ngaphambi. Ngale ndlela, ungakwazi ukuphatha kangcono ugesi owusebenzisayo. Ukweba ugesi kuphazamisa bonke abakhasimende, hhayi kuphela endaweni yakho kodwa kungase kube nomthelela omkhulu kwezinye izindawo. Njengokugcina, ungathumela ukukhalaza kumlawuli wogesi. Abakhasimende bayakhuthazwa ukuba baxhumane nomhlinzeki wogesi ngqo lapho bengafaka khona izikhalazo. Uma unganelisekile, ungathumela udaba kumlawuli wezeMali Wogesi, ozophenya ngale ndaba ngaphezulu. Ukuhlela imboni yokuhlinzeka ngogesi ngokulandela izinqubomgomo nemithetho kuhlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamanje nezangomuso zabathintekayo emkhakheni wegesi usebenzisa amasu afanele aholela ekugcineni isikhathi eside. Umphakathi wegesi, ngokubambisana nomnyango wezinsizakalo zamakhasimende, uzinikele ekuthuthukiseni izinga lenkonzo emkhakheni wokuhlinzeka ngogesi nasekugcineni amakhasimende enolwazi ngezinkinga ezithinta ukuhlinzeka ngogesi.
Izimpawu ezintsha zalesi sizwe ziwuhlonzo oluphakeme, olunikezwa nguMongameli kubantu, kanye nakwabanye abantu abahlonishwa kakhulu abakwamanye amazwe. UMongameli ungumthombo (umgibeli, isibambiso, nomthombo omkhulu) wokuhlonipha ezweni, yingakho uMongameli engumuntu ophakamisayo imiklomelo futhi enikeza izimpawu zokuhlonipha. INingizimu Afrika idlulelwe uhambo olude lokuhlukanisa nesikhumbuzo sokukoloni esisekelwe ebudlelwaneni, umbala, nenkolo. Izwe lethu liya phambili ngokuzinzile endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu nobuqotho kubantu bonke. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu bonke, kukhona isiko elisha lemidlalelo yamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonishwa kobuqotho bomoya womuntu, okuyinto echaza ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Imithombo yezimpawu zokuhlukanisa nesikhathi esedlule ibonakaliswe ngokuphakanyiswa kweflegi entsha ngo-1994. Leso sikhathi saqinisa ukuzigqaja kwethu nobuqotho besizwe esijabulela ukuhlonishwa kwabantu bonke. Enye indlela yokuphumelela kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwe-emblem yesizwe entsha, ehlanganisa umlando wabantu bonke besizwe, ngoMgqibelo 27, 2000. Ngokwenza kanjalo, lokhu kuhlinzeka ngobuhle bonke base-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuvuka nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Le emblem yesizwe entsha isekelwe emoyeni walolu vuselelo lwesizwe. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanezakhono eziphakeme zobuciko nezokwakha, futhi abafeze amazinga aphezulu empumelelo ngendlela engajwayelekile. IMapungubwe - Ubukhosi beMapungubwe babutholakala engxenyeni enyakatho yezwe lethu eminyakeni eyinkulungwane edlule. Le nkosi yayinokuphathwa okuhle kakhulu, futhi yayithuthuke kakhulu kwezolimo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le nkosi yayina nezimayini nezimboni zensimbi. Le nkosi yathengiselana namazwe akude afana neChina. Ngesikhathi salo bukhosi, babe nezinga eliphezulu lokwazi ekucabangeni okujulile nasekuthuthukiseni. IMapungubwe artifact - Singumgogodla kanye neqholo, i-artifact iyingxenye yendawo eyakhiwe ngamatshana agcwele umhlaba, endaweni eyomile nephakathini, engatholi imvula eningi yehlobo, njengoba kuboniswe ngesikhathi sokuhlola okukhombisa ubuciko obukhulu obutholakala endaweni yemvelo kodwa enezimo ezinzima. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi leMapungubwe - lenziwe futhi labonwa emathunjini egolide ohlangothini lwezimbobo - okuyinto eyodwa yezinto ezenziwe futhi zatholakala emathunjini abacwaningi abawahlola kule ndawo (indawo yokuhlola). Ibhodwe elihlotshisiwe lokungcwaba igolide - isimo sebhodwe esibonakala ebhodweni lokungcwaba igolide sikhombisa ubuciko obunothile, isayensi, kanye nekhono lokuthuthukisa, okuyisibonakaliso sempumelelo yasendulo ekukhiqizeni insimbi. Ilanga eliphakamisayo - limele ukukhanya okusha e-Afrika. Isikhungo sokungcwaba insimbi - ukujabulisa nokuthuthukisa impilo ngokuqhuma, okusetshenziswe kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, kanye nempumelelo eqhubekayo nobuciko kuzo zonke izindawo. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngomsebenzi wabo ophakeme. Lezi zisebenzi akufanele zibe imisebenzi ejwayelekile kuphela kodwa zidlule ezijwayelekile, futhi zenzelwe abantu hhayi kuphela ukuze bakhokhelwe kodwa ukuze badlule kulokho okujwayelekile nokulindelekile. Ukukhuthazwa kwezobuchwepheshe, nokukhonza imiphakathi. Singomuthi obalulekile kwezolimo. Sihlinzeka ngama-fibers ezindwangu nezintambo, izithelo, nomlilo, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi ezisebenzisekayo. IBaobab (Baobab noma i-Adansonia Digitata) - iyaziwa ngamagatsha ayo nezimpande zayo ezinde. Sihlinzeka ngensimu nokuhlalisana, futhi siphinde sibe nomthelela omkhulu ekuxhaseni imiphakathi lapho sitholakala khona. Isimo sezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalolunye - isimo se-geometry sezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalolunye limele imikhakha eminingi ehlukene lapho imisebenzi ehlukahlukene ingaqhutshelwa ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esizinzile nesithuthuke. Le simbala iphinde imele izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye zezwe lethu. Le emblem inikezwa kubabusi bamazwe angaphandle (Amakhosi Wamazwe Nezikhungo, nabanye abantu abahlonishwa kakhulu abakwamanye amazwe) ukuze kubonakale ubudlelwano neNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho siba yisibonakaliso sokuthula, ukubambisana, kanye nesibonakaliso sokuhlanganyela nokuxhasana. Le emblem iyisibonakaliso esibalulekile sobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. Imiklomelo emibili yokuqala ihlanganisa izigaba ezine: iphendenti, ibhajethi yentamo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel rosette. I-emblem yokugcina inezigaba ezintathu: ibhajethi yentamo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel pin. Umjola (uthuli olutholakala ebusheni) - Uthuli oluvakashela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Alulimazi ingane noma amalungu omndeni, futhi indlela yokukhipha uthuli ukuthi umama wengane aphuze. Lolu thuli luvakashela ingane ukuze luyilungiselele ikusasa eliqhakazile neliphephile ebusheni bayo. Lufika njengesihlobo nomvikeli. Ubudlelwano obumele, obusekelwe emnqopheni omuhle, busekelwe emoyeni wokukhombisa ukweseka kanye nenhloso yokuphakamisa nokukhuthaza impumelelo yesikhathi esizayo yentsha kanye namalungu omphakathi akhulayo. Lolu thuli luhlale luwumlando wabantu ngenxa yesaga esidumile esibhaliwe kudala esibizwa ngokuthi: Uthukuthelo Lwabokhokho, obhalwe ngu-AC Jordan. Le ndaba iphikisa umbono wokuthi uthuli luyisidalwa esiyingozi futhi esilimazayo, kodwa ibonisa umbono ocebile we-Afrika, iqonda uthuli njengomngane nolwazi oludingekayo lokuhlala ndawonye. Umjola - indwangu eyakhelwe, eyenziwe ngama-fibers amnyama, ivela emthini wase-Afrika, iyisibonakaliso sobungane ekusekeleni nasekubambisaneni okuboniswayo ngabangane, futhi iphinde imele ukuzibophezela kokweseka nokuma nabantu abasisekelayo.
Lo mhlahlandlela uwusizo ukuze usize ukudla ukudla okunempilo, usebenzisa ukudla okutholakalayo. Uma unegciwane elingapheli (njengokugula kwenhliziyo, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV), kubalulekile kakhulu ukudla ukudla okunempilo. Ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo kungakusiza ukuthi ulwe nezifo futhi kukusize ukuthi ubhekane kahle nokugula. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo akusho ukuthenga ukudla okukhethekile okudayiswa ngentengo ephezulu! Ukudla okunempilo kusho ukukhetha ngokuhlakanipha ukudla okuzohlinzeka umzimba wakho ngazo zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo. Le pamphlet izokusiza ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo okutholakalayo. Zama ukudla izinhlobonhlobo zokudla ngangokunokwenzeka. Lokhu kuzokusiza uthole zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Izakhamzimba yizinto ezitholakala ekudleni. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezizakhamzimba ezitholakala ekudleni, okungukuthi ama-proteins, ama-carbohydrates, amafutha, ama-vitamins, kanye nezimayini. Zonke izakhamzimba ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho azitholakali kuphela kulowo mkhiqizo owodwa, ngakho-ke kudingeka ukuthi udle izinhlobonhlobo zokudla. Kuqondile ukudla ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile. Zama ukudla okungenani kathathu ngosuku. Uma kungenzeka, zama futhi ukudla ngezikhathi ezijwayelekile, ikakhulukazi uma ungumuntu odla kancane. Ukudla okuyisisekelo kufanele kuphumelele kakhulu kunezinye izithako ezihambisanayo. Ukudla okuyisisekelo kungaba yiphuthu, ubhontshisi, irayisi, amazambane, noma noma yisiphi isithako esine-starch ongakuthola. Iningi kwalokhu kudla kuyabiza. Ukuze wenze ukudla okunempilo, engeza ukudla okune-starch noma noma yisiphi esinye isithako ongakuthola, njengemifino, amabhontshisi, amaqanda, noma izithelo. Imifino nezithelo zinikeza ama-vitamins nezinye izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ukuze kugcinwe amandla omzimba. Zama ukudla izinhlobo eziningi zemifino nezithelo nsuku zonke. Imifino emnyama, ephuzi, noma eluhlaza efana ne-spinach, beetroot, u-pumpkin, amakaroti, kanye ne-papaya inama-vitamins A amaningi. I-Vitamin A isiza ukugcina amandla omzimba. Zama ukudla okungenani uhlobo olulodwa lwemifino noma izithelo ezine-vitamins A nsuku zonke. Eminye imifino nezithelo ikhiqiza i-vitamin C eningi, esiza ukulwa nezifo. Izibonelo zalokhu zifaka izithelo ezifana nama-oranges, ama-tangerines, i-papaya, nezilimo, kanye nezitolo, ama-mango, ama-guavas, ikhabhishi, namazambane. Zama ukudla imifino nezithelo ezine-vitamins C nsuku zonke. Zama ukudla okungenani izinhlobo ezinhlanu ezahlukene zemifino noma izithelo nsuku zonke. Ukuze ufinyelele ezidingweni zakho zamandla, qala manje ngokutshala imbewu yemifino nezihlahla ezimbili zezithelo. Awudingi isikhala esikhulu ukwenza lokhu, futhi ungasebenzisa neziphuzo zokutshala ukuze ukhule imifino eluhlaza enempilo. Uma kungekho sikhala ekhaya, kungani ungahlanganyeli emkhankasweni wokulima emphakathini, noma usize ukuqala umkhankaso wokulima esikhungweni sakho? Ungaqala futhi igadi encane nabangane bakho. Uma izithelo zikhokha kakhulu, thenga imifino eningi esikhundleni. U-pumpkin, amazambane, amazambane amnandi, amakaroti, i-spinach, kanye nezitolo zinhle ngoba zinikeza ama-vitamins amaningi nezimayini ngaphandle kokuba zibe nentengo ephezulu. Pheka imifino ngamanzi ambalwa. Bese le mansi ingasetshenziswa ukwenza isobho noma isitshulu - noma uyiphuze ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izakhamzimba emanzini azichithwa. Izitshalo ezivunyiwe ezifana ne-amaranth noma i-spinach yendalo nazo zindlela ezinhle zokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi udla imifino eyanele. Abantu abaningi bathenga imifino nezithelo kubathengisi bezitaladi. Ngezinye izikhathi ziba zishibhile kunezitolo futhi zitholakala kalula. Thenga imifino nezithelo ezigcinwe emthunzini ngoba ilanga lichitha izakhamzimba eziningi ezibalulekile. Thenga imifino nezithelo ezisemkhathini, njengoba ziba zishibhile. Ukudla okutholakala ezilwaneni ezifana ne-chicken, inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi, noma amaqanda kungadliwa nsuku zonke. Nokho, ezinye zalezi zinto, ikakhulukazi i-chicken, inhlanzi, kanye nenyama, zivame ukuba nentengo ephezulu. Ukukhulisa ama-chicken, izinkukhu, izimvu, izinkomo, noma noma yiziphi ezinye izilwane ekhaya kungakuhlinzeka ngenyama, amaqanda, futhi ngisho nobisi. Ungajabulela futhi ezinye zokudla ezine-protein eziningi ezifana ne-liver, ama-kidneys, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, izintso, i-tripe, kanye namaqanda. Thenga ubisi fresh esikhundleni sokuthenga izikhumbuzo zobisi, ama-creamer, kanye nobisi oluqinile. Lokhu kudayiswa ngentengo ephezulu ngoba kunokudla okuncane kakhulu. Uma ugula futhi uzizwa ungaphansi, engeza amafutha noma ushukela ekudleni kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukudla kube mnandi futhi kukusize uthole amandla ngaphandle kokudla kakhulu. Jabulela ukuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile futhi aphephile - akubizi futhi kunempilo kuneti nekhofi. Uma ungazi ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile noma aphephile, phosa nje uphise bese uvumela kuphole ngaphambi kokuphuza. I-alcohol ichitha imali futhi ikhiphe izakhamzimba emzimbeni wakho. Esikhundleni salokho, sebenzisa imali yakho ukuthenga ukudla okunempilo. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukugwema ukuphuza i-alcohol ngenkathi uthatha imithi. Hlala unempilo ngangokunokwenzeka uma uzizwa kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza ugcine imisipha yakho iqinile. Ukuhamba komzimba wakho, njengokuhamba, ukusebenza engadini, noma ukuhlanza indlu, akugcini ngokukugcina uqine kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa umoya wakho. Cabanga ngokunikela ngesikhathi sakho noma ukwenza ezinye izinsiza ukuze uthole ukudla. Ungasiza esikoleni, esontweni, ekhishini, noma esitsheni sokuphuza ukuze uthole ukudla okunempilo noma ibhagi yokudla. Khetha ukudla okunomdlandla nokutholakala endaweni yakho. Lezi zibonelo ezilandelayo zingakusiza ngezinsiza zokupheka ukudla okulula, okunempilo okutholakala ngentengo ephansi. Pheka isitshulu samabhontshisi futhi uhlanganise ne-tomato ne-onion stew. Ungase futhi ungeze iziphuzo kule dish ukuze uyicebise. Uma uzwa ukuthi awuthandi kahle ukudla, pheka iphuthu elanelisayo. Ungakwenza lokhu ngokulandelayo: Pheka ikomishi eyodwa ye-cornmeal. Engeza izipuni ezintathu ezincane ezigcwele ubisi oluphakeme, isipuni esisodwa se-oyili noma ibhotela, nezipuni ezimbili ezincane zoshukela kuphuthu bese uhlanganisa. Ukuze wenze ukudla okunempilo kwabo bonke, ungapheka ithini elikhulu le-sardines (khumbula ukusebenzisa amathambo) bese uhlanganisa nehhafu yekomishi yefulawa noma amakhukhi. Engeza amaqanda amathathu aphukile bese uhlanganisa kahle. Yenza ama-patties amancane bese uwafry ngama-oyili ambalwa. Phakela nesaladi esisha, amazambane aphekiwe, noma ubhontshisi kanye nemifino eluhlaza ethathwe engadini yakho. Fry onions, tomatoes
Umhlahlandlela onenzuzo ukusiza ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo okuzokugcina uqine ngesikhathi ugula. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kubalulekile kubo bonke, kodwa uma uneguli ethile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukukhetha izinhlobo zokudla ngokuhlakanipha! Ukudla okunempilo kusho ukudla okukhprovides umzimba wakho ngazo zonke izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze usebenze kahle futhi kusiza ukuvikela izifo. Izakhi ziyizinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala ekudleni. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukahlukene zezakhono ezitholakala ekudleni, okungukuthi ama-proteins, ama-carbohydrates, amafutha, ama-vitamins, kanye nezimayini. Uma uneguli elingapheli (njenge-asthma, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV), uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela luyancipha. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho awukwazi ukuvikela kahle ezifo njengokwakwenza phambilini. Uhlelo lokuvikela oluncishisiwe lungaholela ezifo emlonyeni, emaphashini, nasemathunjini. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuzohlinzeka umzimba wakho ngezithako eziqinisa uhlelo lokuvikela ukuze luphikise izifo, kukunikeze umuzwa wokuba nempilo; futhi kukusize ujabulele impilo engcono. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuzokusiza ukuphikisa izifo futhi kukuvumele ukuba ube nekhono elingcono uma uneguli. Izifo ezifana ne-asthma, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV zivame ukuholela emzimbeni ongenamafutha. Ukudla okungafanele kuholela ekunciphiseni uhlelo lokuvikela lomzimba, okwenza kube lula ukuba izifo zifake. Uma umuntu ebanjwe yi-virus ye-HIV, ukudla okungafanele kungaholela ngokushesha kwi-AIDS. Kukhona izinhlobo eziningi zokudla okunempilo ongakhetha kuzo. Umzimba wakho udinga ukudla okuhlukahlukene. Akukho ukudla okukodwa okuqukethe zonke izakhi ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Khetha futhi ujabulele ukudla okutholakala kalula, okungathengwa futhi okuthandayo. Qaphela kakhulu ngalokho okudlayo uma usuwazi ukuthi uneguli ethile. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kungakusiza ukuphikisa izifo futhi kuvinjeze ukulahleka kwesisindo. Ukuze uthole konke okudingayo ekudleni kwakho, dlala ukudla okuhlukahlukene okungatholakala. Ukudla okuhlukahlukene kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola zonke izakhi ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Uma uthola kunzima ukudla okuningi, zama ukudla okuncane kaningi ngosuku ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla okwanele. Ukudla okune-starch njenge-bread, ama-potato, ama-cereal, irayisi, ama-sweet potato, ufulawa, kanye ne-pasta kufanele kube ingxenye enkulu yanoma iyiphi im meal. Ukudla okune-starch kuhlinzeka umzimba ngamandla nezinye izakhi ukuze usebenze kahle. Faka noma yiziphi ezinye izidlo ezifana nemifino, amabele, inkukhu, noma amaqanda ezidleni ezine-starch ukuze wenze isidlo esinambithekayo. Ukudla esikuthola ezilwaneni kuhlinzeka emzimbeni wethu ngezithako eziningi ezahlukene. Omunye wabo ngu-protein, osiza ukuqinisa uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela futhi wakhe izicubu eziqinile. Uma ugula, udinga kakhulu lezi zinto zokudla. Ushukela namafutha nawo ayingxenye yokudla okunempilo. Anika amandla extra ukuze ubhekane neziguli futhi enze ukudla kube mnandi. Kufanele sonke sizame ukusebenzisa usawoti omncane, ngoba usawoti omningi ungaholela ekwandeni kwegazi. Nokho, uma unokuhlanza noma uphume emlonyeni, ulahlekelwa usawoti nomoya omningi. Ukuphuza amanzi kubalulekile kithi sonke. Phuza amanzi amaningi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubuyisela amanzi alahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhlanza, ukuphuma emlonyeni, noma ukuvuvukala ebusuku. Amanzi aphuma emthonjeni, emfuleni, noma emathunjini kufanele aphekwelwe ngaphambi kokuwuphuza. Ungaphuzi noma yiziphi iziphuzo zothando. Iziphuzo zothando zihlupha umphimbo futhi zenza umzimba ulahlekelwe ama-vitamins avikela emizameni. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi ungaphuzi utshwala ngesikhathi uthatha imithi ngoba kungalimaza umphimbo wakho. Hlala usebenza ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze ugcine izicubu zakho ziqinile. Ukunyakaza komzimba wakho, njengokuhamba, ukuhlanza indlu, nokulima, kuzothuthukisa umuzwa wakho wokuba nempilo. Hamba njalo ugeza izandla zakho ngensipho ngaphambi nangemva kokuphatha ukudla. Hlanza zonke izinsiza nezindawo lapho ulungisa khona ukudla. Faka ukudla ukuze uvikeleke ekuthintweni yizinyoni nezilwane. Bheka usuku lokusebenzisa ezicini ozithengayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awuthengi ukudla okudlulelwe usuku lokuphelelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi awudli inyama, inkukhu, inhlanzi, noma amaqanda angaphekiwe. Pheka ukudla kahle ukuze ubulale amagciwane. Uma unomshini opholile, gcina konke ukudla okusele emshinini opholile noma ugcine kukhishwe endaweni epholile. Ukudla okuphekiwe akufanele kugcinwe ngaphezulu kosuku olulodwa futhi kufanele kuphumelelwe ngaphambi kokudliwa. Gcina ukudla endaweni epholile ngangokunokwenzeka. Zama ukungavumeli ukudla okuphekiwe ukuthi kube ngaphandle kokupholiswa isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora amabili. Ukudla okunempilo kuyinzuzo kubo bonke! Uma ugula, kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukubuyisela ngokushesha ezifo kusiza izilonda ziphumelele ngokushesha. Ukuphatha kahle nokusebenzisa imithi nokwelashwa.
Ukukhetha ukudla okufanele kubalulekile kithi sonke, ikakhulukazi uma unegciwane elingapheli njenge-obesity, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV. Ukudla okufanele kuzokwenza kube ngcono uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela ukuze ulwe nezifo, kukhuphule amandla akho omzimba, futhi kukwenze uzizwe ungcono isikhathi eside. Ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa wesisindo abantu abaneziguli ezinzima ezifana nomdlavuza, i-obesity, kanye ne-HIV akufanele kuthathwe kalula. Ezinye izifo nemithi esetshenziselwa ukuwaphula ngokuvamile kuholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle nasekulahlekelweni isisindo. Lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo zizomsiza umuntu onegciwane elingapheli ukuthi abhekane kangcono nezimpawu zalesi simo futhi agweme ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo. Ubisi olungashaywanga, ikremu, nemikhiqizo yayo (ubisi oluphonswe, ushizi, i-yogurt) kungangezwa ezidleni ukuze kulethe amandla engeziwe kanye neprotein. Faka amafutha afana ne-margarine, ibhotela, kanye ne-mayonnaise ezidleni ukuze uthole amandla engeziwe futhi uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla. Uma uzwa ukungakhululeki noma ungakhululeki ngemuva kokwengeza amafutha engeziwe ezidleni zakho, zama ukuwanciphisa. Ake sihlolisise ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nezimpawu zesifo ezingakwenza ungafuni ukudla. Yini engiyenzayo uma ngizwa sengathi angifuni ukudla? Izifo, ukucindezeleka, kanye nokuhlukana kungakwenza ulahlekelwe isifiso sokudla. Zama lokhu okulandelayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele ukuze ugcine umzimba wakho uqine. Ukudla okufana noshukela, ubisi oluphonswe, kanye namafutha kunikeza amandla amaningi noma uma kudliwa ngezinga elincane. Uma kungenzeka, kufanele kuhlanganiswe nezinye izidlo. Zama ukudla nomunye umuntu - ukudla nabanye kukwenza ujabulele ukudla kakhulu. Dla izidlo zakho endaweni ekhululekile ukuze ujabulele kakhulu (dlala umculo, ngaphansi kwesihlahla, noma epaki). Ungabambeleli ezikhathini ezithile zokudla - dlani noma kunini uma uzizwa ufisa ukudla. Ukuzivocavoca okukhanyayo njengokuhamba kukhuphula isifiso sokudla. Phuza iziphuzo ezine-amandla phakathi nosuku, ezifana neziphuzo ezisekelwe kubisi, iziphuzo zefruthi ezinamashukela, nezisawoti eziphekiwe. Dla ukudla okuthandayo - kungenzeka udle kakhulu ngalendlela. Gwema ukudla okukhanya kakhulu okufana nekhabe kanye nekhofi uma kukwenza ulahlekelwe isifiso sokudla. Uma imithi oyithathayo ikwenza ulahlekelwe isifiso sokudla, buza umsebenzi wezempilo uma ungathatha imithi ngemuva kokudla. Ingabe uhlangabezana nokungakhululeki noma ukuhamba? Dla izidlo ezincane ezikhathi eziningi ukuze ugweme ukuzizwa ungakhululeki. Linda okungenani amahora amabili ngemuva kokudla ngaphambi kokulala. Gwema ukusmoka nokuphuza utshwala. Lokhu kungakhulisa ukungakhululeki futhi kubi empilweni yakho. Zama ukuphuza amanzi amaningi neziphuzo ezihlanzekile. Zama ukuphuza lezi ziphuzo ngezikhathi lapho ungadli noma ngaphambi kokudla, njengoba lokhu kungakwenza uzwe ukungakhululeki. Ukubhekana nokungakhululeki nokuhamba... Imithi yokwelapha ngokuvamile ibangela ukungakhululeki nokuhamba. Dla izidlo ezincane ezikhathi eziningi - ukungakhululeki kubi uma kungekho lutho esiswini. Linda kuze kube uzwa ungcono ngaphambi kokudla, kodwa ungaphuthelwa izidlo. Gwema ukudla okushisayo kakhulu kanye nokudla okunamafutha. Faka kancane uju lwe-lemon noma ingxenye ye-lemon eziphuzweni ezibandayo. Zama ukudla ukudla okupholile ukuze iphunga olithola ngesikhathi sokupheka lingakubangeli ukungakhululeki. Ngokuvamile, umzimba uthanda ukudla okubandayo. Gcina indawo yokuhlala ikhululekile. Hlala uqonde ngemuva kokudla - linda okungenani imizuzu engama-20 ngaphambi kokulala ukuze ugweme ukuhamba. Uma unomkhuhlane, udinga ukuvuselela amanzi alahlekile uma uphumeza. Phuza amanzi amaningi - ngaphezulu kwalokho okudingayo uma usuphumezile. Uma uzwa sengathi awufuni ukudla, ungakha isobho semibhede, amaphuphu, amakaroti, noma noma yimuphi omunye imifino onayo. Lokhu kunganika umzimba wakho amandla kanye nezinsiza. Ungazizwa unokukhathala uma kunzima futhi kunzima ukudlula udaka. Gwema ukusebenzisa ama-laxatives nanoma yimiphi imikhiqizo "yokucacisa isisu" efana ne-enemas. Ama-laxatives kanye ne-enemas abanga ukuthi umzimba wakho ulahlekelwe izinsiza eziningi ezibalulekile futhi kuyisixazululo esikahle esingasixazululi inkinga yangempela. Dla ukudla okungashaywanga futhi okuncane okwenziwe ngeziphuzo ezimhlophe (amakhekhe, ama-pastries, njll.). Hlala unempilo! Ukuhamba njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa isifiso sokuhamba. Ungazizwa unokungakhululeki uma unokuhamba kathathu ngosuku nezidakamizwa ezimanzi. Ukuhamba kungaholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle ngoba ukudla kudlula emzimbeni wakho ngokushesha kakhulu ukuze umzimba wakho ukwazi ukukwazi. Umuntu uphinde udle kancane ngoba ungenasifiso sokudla. Uma unokuhamba, umzimba wakho uzoba ne-dehydration ngoba ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi - lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-dehydration. I-dehydration ibi kakhulu futhi ingaba yingozi. Yini engiyenzayo uma nginokuhamba? Phuza amanzi amaningi neziphuzo ukuze uvuselele amanzi alahlekile emzimbeni wakho. Ukuze wenze isiphuzo sasekhaya sokubuyisela amanzi alahlekile, thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi aphekiwe bese uvumela kupholile. Faka ama-teaspoons ayisishiyagalombili noshukela kanye ne-teaspoon eyodwa yensipho. Hlanganisa le ngxube ngangokunokwenzeka. Ikhofi nezinye izidlo neziphuzo ezifana ne-cola ne-chocolate ziqukethe i-caffeine futhi zingakhulisa i-dehydration. Kunalokho, dlani kakhulu... Ukudla okufana nezithelo ezinjengezithelo ezinjengezithelo ezinjengezithelo; lezi zinto ziqukethe i-fiber esheshayo esiza ukugcina amanzi esiswini. Ukudla okufana namaphuphu nezithelo ziqukethe i-potassium, elahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba. Dla kaningi ukuze uvuselele isisindo alahlekile nezinsiza. Ukuntuleka kokuhlanzeka kungaholela ekuhambeni. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nosawoti ngaphambi kokuphatha, ukulungisa, ukupheka, noma ukugcina ukudla. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi nosawoti ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ngemuva kokushintsha i-diaper yomntwana. Uma inyama iphunga noma inambitha njengezinto zensimbi, dlani kuphela inkukhu, inhlanzi, imikhiqizo yobisi, imbewu ezomile ezingashaywanga, kanye nezinsimbi. Ukudla okubandayo noma okubandayo kuvame ukuba nenhliziyo engcono kunokudla okushisayo. Sebenzisa iziphuzo, izisawoti, noma uju lwe-lemon ukuze uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla kwakho. Dla ukudla kwakho kancane ngenkathi uphuza isiphuzo sakho. Kungasiza ukusebenzisa amanzi anensipho ukuze uhlanze umlomo wakho kaningi. Ukuphuza amanzi anenhliziyo ye-lemon ngaphambi kokudla kungas
G. Izeluleko Ebalulekile Mayelana Nokuphatha Izimpawu Zezifo Nokwandisa Ukudla Okunempilo. Impilo yethu, indlela esizizwa ngayo, umsebenzi, nokudlala, indlela esikhula ngayo futhi sithuthuka ngayo - konke kuthonywa ukudla esikudlayo. Ukudla kunikeza umzimba izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze ube nempilo futhi uqine. Izakhi zifaka phakathi ama-protein, ama-carbohydrate, amafutha, ama-vithamini, imithombo, namanzi. Le phampu ihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nendima ebalulekile ukudla okudlalayo ekuqineni uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba ukuze luphikise izifo futhi lusize ekubuyiseni. Inhloso iwukukhuthaza ukuthi unakekele isimo sokudla somguli ngamunye osesimweni sokugula okukhululekile futhi usebenzise ukudla okunempilo njengesisekelo esibalulekile ohlelweni lwakho lokwelapha. Kulolu documet, abantu abasemzimbeni wokugula okukhululekile bafaka bonke abaguli abaneziguli ezikhululekile abadinga ukwesekwa okwengeziwe kokudla ukuze bagweme ukulahlekelwa isisindo nokubola - ikakhulukazi abaguli abane-HIV, umdlavuza, i-tuberculosis, noma ezinye izinhlobo zomdlavuza. Enye yezindlela zokuphula leli cyclus eliyingozi ukudla ukudla okunempilo. Ukudla okunempilo kukhuphula amandla omzimba okuphikisa izifo nezifo, kukhuphula amandla, futhi kwenza umuntu azizwe eqinile futhi engcono. Lokhu kungasiza ukuhamba phambili kwesifo. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kungasiza ukugcina uhlelo lokuzivikela lusezingeni eliphezulu ukuze sikwazi ukuphikisa izifo. Wonke umuntu udinga ukudla ukudla okufanele ukuze ahlale enempilo. Nokho, kubantu abasemzimbeni wokugula okukhululekile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi badle ukudla okunempilo, njengoba besengozini enkulu yokuntula izakhi. Ukungadli okwanele, ukulahleka kwezakhi okweqile, kanye nokuntula izakhi kubantu abagulayo kuholela ekulahlekelweni isisindo nasekuboleni, kunciphisa uhlelo lokuzivikela futhi kukhuphula ubungozi bezifo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasemzimbeni wokugula okukhululekile badla ngendlela efanele. Ukuvimbela ukulahleka kwesisindo nokukhuthaza ukwanda kwesisindo. Ukubuyisela zonke izakhi ezilahlekile ngesikhathi sokugula nokuhlanza. Ukukhuthaza ukudla izinhlobonhlobo zokudla okunempilo (ukudla okunomsoco nokudla okunamandla emithini ngayinye) kunezindlela eziningi zokugcina uhlelo lokuzivikela lukhona. Ukulungisa ukudla komguli ukuze kuhambisane nezimpawu zabo zokugula. Ukuncoma umguli ngendawo efanele yokudla okufanele bacabangele ukuthi umguli angakuthola yini. Hlola isisindo somguli futhi ugcine irekhodi lesisindo kukhadi lekliniki. Buza umguli ukuthi udla ini ngokuvamile ukuze uthole ukuthi yikuphi ukudla abakudlayo, izimo zabo zomnotho, nokuthi yikuphi ukudla abangakuthola. Thola ukuthi kukhona amanzi aphephile kanye negesi etholakalayo. Thola umlando wezimpawu zokugula zomguli. Siza umguli ukuhlela ukudla kwabo, ucabangele isimo sabo sezomnotho nezinye izimfanelo ukuze kuhambisane nesimo somguli. Uma umguli elahlekile isisindo, nikeza iziphakamiso zokwandisa isisindo somzimba. Nikeza umguli izeluleko zokuphatha ukudla ngokuphepha. Hlela ukuhamba phambili ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zicebiso ziyalandelwa. Kunezindlela eziningi zokudla okunempilo. Ngamunye wethu udla ngendlela ehlukile ngenxa yezimo zethu zomnotho, ukukhetha ukudla, inkolo, isiko, njll. Kubalulekile ukukhetha lokhu uma uncoma abaguli ngokuqhubekayo kokudla okunempilo. Ukuze ugweme izifo, ukuntula ukudla, nokulahleka kwesisindo okungafuneki, khuthaza abaguli ukuthi bangalibali, baqale ukunaka kakhulu udaba lokudla okunempilo manje. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukulungisa ukuntula izakhi emzimbeni uma sebesebenzile kakhulu futhi begula kakhulu! Akukho uhlobo olulodwa lokudla olungasinika konke esikudingayo! Khuthaza abantu ukuthi badle izinhlobonhlobo zokudla - ukudla abangakuthola futhi abakutholayo kalula. Kunconywa ukuthi umuntu adle izinhlobo ezintathu zokudla ezahlukene nsuku zonke. Khuthaza abantu ukuthi baphuze phakathi kokudla (okuphuzwayo) njengoba lokhu kusiza kakhulu uma othile enezinkinga zokudla okwanele ngesikhathi sokudla. Nansi isithombe ongasebenzisa ukukhombisa abaguli ukuthi kulula kanjani ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo ezinkundleni ezahlukene zokudla. Ukudla okune-starch njenge-bread, porridge, cereals, rice, potatoes, yam, maize, pasta kufanele kube yingxenye enkulu yokudla kwabo. Ngokuvamile, lezi zinto azibizi kakhulu futhi zinikeza izakhi eziningi ngemali. Khuthaza abaguli ukuthi bafake ukudla okwengeziwe ezindaweni ezine-starch ukuze prepari ukudla okuxubile. Imifino nezithelo zinikeza umthombo wama-vithamini nemithombo ukusiza ukugcina uhlelo lokuzivikela lukhona. Khuthaza abaguli obakhathalelayo ukuthi badle izinhlobo eziningi zezithelo nemifino ngangokunokwenzeka. Imifino nezithelo ezinemibala efana ne-yellow, orange, red, noma dark green kufanele zidle nsuku zonke, isibonelo, spinach, pumpkin, carrots, apricots, papaya, kanye ne-mango. Izithelo ezifana ne-oranges, lemons, ne-guavas, kanye ne-mango kanye ne-tomato zinikeza i-vitamin C esiza ekuphikisaneni nezifo. Abaguli kufanele bahlosise ukudla izithelo nemifino/izinkonzo eziyisishiyagalombili zemifino ngosuku. Inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi, kanye namaqanda angadliwa nsuku zonke. Phakathi kwezinye izakhi ezitholakalayo, lezi zinto zinikeza umzimba ama-protein. Ngesikhathi sokugula, kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba umuntu abe ne-protein eyanele. Inyama yenkukhu, inyama yengulube, inyama yenkukhu, inhlanzi, umgudu, ikhala, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, i-tripe, izinyawo zenkukhu, amaqanda, ubisi, ushizi, i-yogurt, ubisi oluphothiwe (hhayi i-coffee creamer), ushizi, kanye nezinye izinyoni ezithile. Lapho zithengwa esitolo, lezi zinto zivame ukuba zibhakabhaka - khuthaza labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuba baphile izinkukhu, izinkomo, izimvu, izinkunzi, kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izilwane ekhaya ukuze bathole inyama, amaqanda, futhi ngisho ngebisi. Lezi zinto zisebenza ezitshalweni, futhi zinikeza ama-protein nezinye izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze uqine uhlelo lokuzivikela nomzimba. Khuthaza abaguli ukuthi badle kakhulu amabhontshisi, amabele, ama-lentils, kanye nama-soybeans angasetshenziswa njengokufaka inyama ukuze prepari ukudla okungabizi. Kulabo abangakwazi ukudla inyama emzimbeni wokugula okukhululekile, lezi zinto kufanele zibe yingxenye ebalulekile yohlelo lwabo lokudla okunempilo. Abaguli bangafaka ushukela kanye namafutha ohlelweni lwabo lokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kudla kukhuphula inani lamandla atholakalayo kokudla futhi kusiza ukwenza ukudla kube mnandi, ngaphezu kokukhuphula ukudla okutholakalayo. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu uma umguli engakwazi ukudla ukudla okuningi. Abaguli kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi amafutha amaningi angadala ukuhamba. Usawoti omningi ungakhuphula umfutho wegazi.
