Umphakathi ungaxhumana nalesi sikhungo ukuze uthole usizo ngokushayela inombolo engenamkhawulo: 0800 005 133. Lesi sikhungo sokuxhumana kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphezulu sinezisebenzi ezinganikeza umphakathi izeluleko nolwazi mayelana nezempilo nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi nemininingwane edingekayo kumshayeli. Njengoba kuhlobene nezempilo, uzothola usizo. Lesi sikhungo, esitholakala ebhizinisini iNatalia, okuyiHhovisi Elikhulu leMnyango Wezempilo e-uMgungundlovu, sinezisebenzi eziqeqeshiwe ezilungele ukusiza noma ubani oxhumana nazo. Inhloso yokwakha lesi sikhungo ukuhlinzeka umphakathi wonke ngosizo lwezempilo ngaso sonke isikhathi ngensiza zokuxhumana ezifana neradiyo, ithelevishini, i-imeyili, i-SMS, kanye nezinsizakalo zocingo. Uqhubekile wathi, "Lesi sikhungo sisiza kakhulu kithi ekusizeni uma kukhona okuphuthumayo ngoba uma umphakathi uvusa isixwayiso, singafika ngokushesha lapho kudingeka khona njengoba lesi sikhungo sinezixhumanisi ezisiza abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuba baqondiswe lapho usizo ludingeka khona ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi befuna lelo ndawo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sikhungo singathumela imiyalezo yokwazisa uma kwenzeka izimo zokuphuthuma, kuchaza uNtsobi. Ingxenye enkulu yezingcingo ezitholakala kulesi sikhungo ivela kubantu abafuna ulwazi nosizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, kanti abanye bafuna ulwazi mayelana nemithi. "Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi lesi sikhungo singasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi kubantu abafuna usizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, okusho ukuthi siphinde sibe nesandla ekufundiseni umphakathi. Lokhu esikubonile ukuthi abantu abaningi bafuna ukwazi ngesimo sezempilo kulesi sifunda ngoba befisa ukuvakashela futhi bathi sinesandla ezivakashi," kuchaza uNtsobi. Izinhlobo zezingcingo ezitholakala kulesi sikhungo zifaka phakathi lezo ezivela kubantu abafuna ukuveza izinkinga ezifana nokukhwabanisa, amacala okuhlukumeza, udlame lwasekhaya, abantu abalahlekile, imibiko yokwenzeka kwezehlakalo, izikhalazo ngezisebenzi, nokho nakuba abanye befaka izikhalazo. Zonke izikhalazo zilandelwa futhi zihlolwa. Njengoba sisondele isikhathi seholide, kubonakala ukuthi lesi sikhungo sizoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuhlinzekeni ngosizo lwezempilo kumphakathi nasekuletheni usizo lokuxhumana uma kwenzeka izimo zokuphuthuma ngalesi sikhathi. Khuluma nathi. Lalela nathi. Amahora angama-24 ngosuku. UKhuzwayo akazange abambezele njengoba athatha ithuba lokuba phakathi kwabokuqala kulesi sikhungo ukuthola imithi ye-antiretroviral ye-HIV. Nakuba impilo kaKhuzwayo kanye naleyo yabanye abavakashi abayi-506 kulesi sikhungo ibonisa umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabo kusukela baqala ukuthola imithi, ub faced with great difficulties at home as his husband does not want to hear anything about HIV. Ukephuleka ukuxoxa ngakho ngemva kokuthola ukuthi ungena, kodwa umyeni wakhe wenqaba ukulalela le ndaba. Indlela amadoda abheka ngayo amadoda. Ingabe lokhu kuyinkinga? Ngokusho kukaNzuza, lokhu kudalwa yizinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nendlela amadoda abheka ngayo wona ezimpilweni. UNzuza uthi kukhona izikhathi lapho iziphepho, ikakhulukazi amadoda, engafuni ukubonakala ethola imithi kuze kube sezingeni lokuthi banqume ukufihla imithi enikezwe abalingani babo. Omunye wabaguli bethu weza kithi ekhala ukuthi imithi yakhe ilahlekile. Ngesikhathi sokuhlola kwethu, sathola ukuthi umyeni wakhe ubebamba amaphilisi akhe. Sabe sesichaza kuye ukuthi kuyingozi kangakanani ukungalandeli imiyalelo uma usebenzisa imithi njengoba kungaholela ekutheni ingasebenzi, kuchaza uNksz. Nzuza. UMnyango Wezempilo ucele amadoda ukuthi asebenzise uhlelo lukamasipala lokuthola imithi yamahhala. Naphezu kwezinkinga ezikhona ohlelweni lokuthola imithi mayelana nokuhlonipha ukusetshenziswa kwemithi efanele, uhlelo lusebenza kahle kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zitholakala kuzo zonke izifunda eziyi-11 zalesi sifunda. Lezi zikhungo zinezimiso ezihlinzeka abantu abadala, izingane, kanye nabesifazane abakhululiwe. UNzuza uthi abantu abathola imithi ngabantu abanokuhlola kwe-CD4 okungaphansi kuka-200. Inani le-virus ye-HIV emzimbeni womuntu libizwa ngokuthi i-viral load. Odokotela bahlola i-viral load emzimbeni uma bephatha isiguli ngoba ukwehla kwayo kusho ukuthi imithi iyasebenza. Ukwanda kwe-viral load emuntwini osebenzisa imithi kungase kubonise ukuthi isiguli sinezinkinga lapho imithi ingasebenzi kahle noma ukuthi imithi ayithathwa kahle. Imithi isebenza kahle uma ithathwa njengoba kuyalwa udokotela noma um nurse. Ukushiya izikhathi zemithi kungaholela ekwandeni kwe-virus futhi kungase kubangele ukuthi ingasebenzi emzimbeni. Ngaqala ukusebenza eMnyangweni Wezempilo ngoJanuwari walonyaka ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami eStellenbosch University eWestern Cape. Okwamanje, ngisebenza e-Osindisweni hospital, lapho ngenza khona unyaka wami wezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ngalokho engikwenza. UDr. Suraya Naidoo weza ukuzongazisa ngenhloso eyinhloko yalolu hlelo futhi wakhombisa isifiso sokuthi ngibe yingxenye yalo njengoba sengiyisazi sokudla. Njengengxenye yomsebenzi wami, kufanele ngikwazi ukusiza labo abadinga ukudla nokusiza imindeni ekulweni nendlala ekhaya. Ngemuva kwalokho, njengengxenye yalolu hlelo, saqala uhlelo kulesi sikhungo ngoJulayi walonyaka, futhi ngiyena ophatha ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Abaguli engibabona bangabantu abathunyelwe kimi udokotela, um nurse, noma abanye abasebenzi bezempilo uma bebona isiguli sidinga usizo. Ngikwazile ukubona ubumpofu nokuhlupheka okukhona kulabo abahlala kule ndawo, futhi kuyadabukisa. Ngihlangane nezingane ezinomzimba ophansi ngoba kungekho ukudla ekhaya. Ngibona omama nabababa bephokophele ekuphatheni abantwana babo ababa yizintandane. Uma ngingasiza noma ngabe umuntu oyedwa, ngiyazi ukuthi ngizokwazi ukuqhubeka nalesi sikhungo. Ngiyajabula kakhulu uma ngibona othile owayengaphansi kokudla eqala ukuthola isisindo futhi ehleka ngoba uthole ukudla futhi ubeke okuthile esiswini sakhe. Yebo, kwesinye isikhathi kunzima ukubona ukuthi ubani odinga usizo ngempela nobani ongeyena. Kukhona labo abafikile nekhaya elinokudla kodwa beze bacele ukudla ngoba befuna ukuthola mahhala. Nokho, sizama konke okusemandleni ethu ukufinyelela kulabo abadinga usizo ngempela. Njengoba lolu hlelo luqhubeka, ngithemba ukuthi sizoletha usizo nempilo engcono kubaningi. Ngithanda ukuvakashela olwandle nokukhuluma nabangane bami. Abaguli banezimfanelo! Ngomhla kaMashi 21, sizokhumbula Usuku Lwamalungelo Abantu. Lolu suku lubalulekile emlandweni waseNingizimu Afrika ngoba lusikhumbuza ngezinkinga abantu ababhekana nazo bephikisana namalungelo abantu. Abaningi benu bangase bazi ukubaluleka kwalolu suku, kodwa kulabo abancane, nansi imlandvo. Ngomhla kaMashi 21, 1960, kwaba nokuphikisana okukhulu ezweni lonke ngokumelene nemithetho yokuphasa eyayidinga bonke abantu abamnyama abasebenza ezindaweni zasemadolobheni ukuba babe nemigomo ngaso sonke isikhathi. Labo abangazange balandele le mithetho bazoboshwa. Kulolo suku, abantu baya emaphoyiseni bengaphethe imigoqo futhi bekulungele ukuboshwa. Inhloso yabo kwakuwukuthi abantu abaningi bazo boshwa ukuze izinto zingahambi kahle ezweni ngalolo suku, okwakuzoholela ekupheleni kwemithetho yokuphasa. ESharpeville, eJohannesburg, lapho izinkulungwane ziqoqekile emaphoyiseni, kwaba nokuphikisana, futhi amaphoyisa avula umlilo. Cishe abantu abangama-70 babulawa, kanti abanye abangama-180 baphukile. Laba bantu babebhekene nemithetho engafanele futhi bephikisana namalungelo abo. Iningi lamaqembu lawo manje sekuhlanganiswe kwiBill of Rights esigabeni sesi-2 seSivumelwano sethu. Nokho, lawa malungelo awawona kuphela abantu abathile; awahlukanisi ngokuthi wenza muphi umsebenzi, futhi awabheki ukuthi ungumuntu ocebile noma omncane. Kukhona neBill of Rights yabaguli. Ukubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuze sibe nolwazi ngesimo sethu sezempilo. Ukukhetha uhlobo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo esifuna. Ukwamukelwa umuntu owaziwa emkhakheni wezempilo. Ukuze isimo sabo sezempilo sikhulunywe kubo bonke, futhi sigcinwe ngasese. Ukukhetha ukwelashwa kunikezwa yonke imininingwane mayelana nalokho okuzokwenziwa. Ukufuna umbono wesibili kudokhumenti noma esibhedlela uma singathembi lokho okukhuluma. Njengoba wonke umuntu enamalungelo abantu kusukela ekuzalweni, futhi akekho ongawathatha, abaguli akufanele baphatheke noma bacele amalungelo abo. Khumbula, kufanele futhi uhloniphe amalungelo abanye. Ukuntuleka kwez nurses ezibhedlela ezilawulwa uMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal kuyakhathaza, ikakhulukazi ngohlelo lokuqeqesha lwez nurses olunikezwa yile mnyango kulo nyaka. Lokhu kukhathazeka kuboniswa njengomphumela wezinqola ezinde nezikhathi zokulinda emaphoyiseni. Kuphinde kuboniswe njengomphumela wokuthi abaguli abatholi ukunakwa ngokushesha kuze kube baphuma ezihlalweni. Lezi zifundo zinez nurses zizokwenziwa ezikhungweni ezingu-25 ezizobe ziqhamuka kulo mnyango. Kuzodingeka ukuthi baqedele isivumelwano nomnyango zobuchwepheshe obuzobavuma ukuba basebenze ezikhungweni zezempilo ezilawulwa yile mnyango uma sekuqedile ukuqeqeshwa kwabo. "Lokhu yikho okuzokwenziwa ngababheki," kusho udokotela. Ngisebenza ezindaweni zokuhamba, ngiyajabula ukuba nethuba lokuzibophezela kulabo abazimisele ukusebenza kuMnyango, ngibona ukuthi kuhle ezindaweni zasemakhaya, inkinga ukuthi ukushiya ithimba eliqinile ukuze lisebenze kumnyango ngeke kusebenze kahle emphakathini. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abakhokhiwe ezindaweni zokuphatha lapha e-EMRS, sisebenze iminyaka. "Iz nurses ziyisisekelo sonke isisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa." Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngethimba elizokwenziwa ngalo mnyango. Uqhubekile wathi ukwelashwa kuyinto ethokozisayo ngoba kudinga ukuzinikela. UNgqongqoshe ukholelwa ukuthi labo abazinikela bazoqinisekisa ukuthi baqeqesha futhi bazibophezela kulabo abafuna abasebenzi bezempilo. Nakuba kunzima kimi kulo mnyango, NGIKHOLWA ukuthi abanye benu bezwe ngengubo emnyama eyashaya umndeni wami ngenkathi ngilahlekelwa ngendodana yami, uMonde. EKwaZulu-Natal, kanye nakuzo zonke eNingizimu Afrika, ngiyabonga ngenkxaso yenu ngesikhathi umndeni wami nami besesimweni esinzima. Ngakho-ke ngifuna ukuthatha leli thuba, engilithole kulolu shicilelo, ukubonga ngempela wonke umuntu ngama-akhawunti enu, ngokuthatha isikhathi sokungibona, kulabo abathumele izimbali, baphakamisela thina, nabanye abakhululekile kithi. Anginayo imishwana eyanele yokuchaza ukuthi kwangijabulisa kangakanani lokho enikwenze kimi, kubantu engingabazi, abangane, izihlobo, ozakwethu, nomphakathi wonke. Konke engingakusho ukuthi uNkulunkulu akubusise kakhulu. EKwaZulu-Natal, sijabule ukuqala unyaka omusha ngenjabulo enkulu ngokwamukela uMphakathi omusha. Ngingase ngiphazamiseke uma ngithi omusha ngoba akasiyena umusha kulo mnyango; ube yingxenye yawo iminyaka eminingi. UDr. Busi Nyembezi ungumuntu ozinikele, ophumelele kakhulu emfundweni, enolwazi lwezempilo aluthole lapha esifundazweni futhi wafinyelela nakwamanye amazwe. Ngiyamemukela kulo Mnyango ngempilo efudumele. Nginezithemba eziphakeme zokuthi uzohola lo mnyango ngendlela ezokwamukelwa ngabaguli kanye nemindeni yabo. Uzosebenza nethimba elihlanganisa othisha abasha nabanolwazi, okuzosiza ukuhamba phambili kulo mnyango ukuze ubhekane nezinhlelo zawo ezivunyelwe. Lo msebenzi ubalulekile kithi sonke kuMnyango. Isikhathi seHope, ukhuluma ngodokotela wezitho uma ethula inkulumo yakhe ekuvuleni kwePhalamende. UMnyango wethu ubeke izinto ezimbalwa okumele zigxilwe kuzo ngokushesha. Ukuqinisa izinhlelo ezibalulekile, kugxilwe kakhulu ezinhlelweni ze-tuberculosis (TB), ukuvimbela i-HIV, nokuphila kahle. Emihlanganweni yami elandelayo, ngizochaza ukuthi siphokophelele ukwenza kulawa makhaza engikhuluma ngawo. Okwamanje, kuhle ukusho ukuthi sizothola ukunakwa okuzoletha ushintsho ezimpilweni zabantu. Siyajabula ukuthi sizokwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinhloso zethu zokwenza abantu abangu-30,000 bathole ama-ARVs kule nyanga esiqala ngayo. Njengoba uMholi wesifunda uDr. Sbu Ndebele esho enkulumweni yakhe kwiLegislature, kukhona abantu abangaphezu kuka-28,000 okwamanje abathola ukwelashwa. Ngenkathi kuyibhizinisi lethu ukunakekela nokunakekela abaguli, kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sikhulume ngenkolo yokuvimbela, ukuze ngenkathi sikhathalela abaguli, sigcine nabantu abaphephile bephila kahle. Yingakho kule nyanga sikhona emkhankasweni wokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi kufanele bazinakekele futhi bavikele ezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Lokhu okukhuluma sikukhuluma kulula; kusho nje ukuthi impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Singakusiza ngemininingwane, sikusize ngokuqeqeshwa nokunakekelwa, kodwa ekugcineni, kuyena kuphela okufanele avikele impilo yakhe. Sizophinde sikhulume ngale nkolo ikakhulukazi ngosuku lweHIV, ekupheleni kukaMashi. Ekupheleni, ngifuna ukukhuthaza labo abafanele ukuvota ukuthi baphume en masse kusasa
Umhlahlandlela onenzuzo ukusiza ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo okuzokugcina uqine ngenkathi ugula. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kubalulekile kubo bonke, kodwa uma unegciwane elithile, kubaluleke kakhulu ukukhetha izinhlobo zokudla ngokuhlakanipha! Ukudla okunempilo kusho ukudla okuletha emzimbeni wakho zonke izakhi ezidingekayo ukuze usebenze kahle futhi kusiza ukuvusa izifo. Izakhi ziyizinto ezibalulekile ezitholakala ekudleni. Kukhona izinhlobo ezahlukene zezakhi ezitholakala ekudleni, okungukuthi ama-protein, ama-carbohydrate, amafutha, ama-vitamini, kanye nezinsimbi. Uma unegciwane elingapheli (njengokuphefumula, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV), uhlelo lwakho lokuzivikela luba buthaka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho awukwazi ukuvikela kahle ngokuphumelelayo ezifo njengoba wawenza ngaphambili. Uhlelo lokuzivikela oluphukile lungaholela ezifo emlonyeni, emaphashini, nasezithweni. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuzokunika umzimba wakho izakhi eziqinisa uhlelo lokuzivikela ukuze luphumelele ezifo, kukunike umuzwa wokuba nempilo; futhi kukusize ujabulele impilo engcono. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuzokusiza ukuvusa izifo futhi kukuvumele ukuthi uphumelele kangcono uma unegciwane. Izifo ezifana nokuphefumula, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV ngokuvamile zikhokelela emzimbeni ongenamafutha. Ukudla okungafanele kahle kuholela ekutheni uhlelo lokuzivikela lomzimba luphuke, okwenza kube lula ezifo ukuhlasela. Lapho umuntu ehlaselwe yi-HIV, ukudla okungafanele kahle kungaholela ngokushesha kwi-AIDS. Kukhona izinhlobo eziningi zokudla okunempilo ongakhetha kuzo. Umzimba wakho udinga izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla. Akukho ukudla okukodwa okuqukethe zonke izakhi ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho. Khetha futhi ujabulele ukudla okulula ukuthola, okungathengwa futhi okuthandayo. Qaphela kakhulu lokho okudlayo uma usuwazi ukuthi unegciwane elithile. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kungakusiza ukuvusa izifo futhi kuvikele ukulahleka kwesisindo. Ukuze uthole konke okudingayo ekudleni kwakho, dlala izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla ongazithola. Ukudla izinhlobo ezahlukene zokudla kuzokwenza uqinisekise ukuthi uthola zonke izakhi ezidingekayo emzimbeni wakho ekudleni kwakho. Uma uthola kunzima ukudla okuningi, zama ukudla izinkanyezi ezincane ngezikhathi eziningi ngosuku ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele. Ukudla okune-starch njengebhread, amaphilisi, ama-cereal, irayisi, amaphilisi amnandi, ufulawa, kanye ne-pasta kufanele kube ingxenye enkulu yanoma iyiphi imenyu. Ukudla okune-starch kunikeza umzimba amandla nezinye izakhi ukuze usebenze kahle. Faka noma yimiphi eminye imikhiqizo efana nezitshalo, amabhontshisi, inkukhu, noma amaqanda ekudleni okune-starch ukuze wenze ukudla okunambitheka kahle. Ukudla esikuthola ezilwaneni kunikeza emzimbeni wethu izakhi eziningi ezihlukahlukene. Omunye wabo ngu-protein, osiza ukuqinisa uhlelo lwakho lokuzivikela nokwakha izicubu eziqinile. Uma ugula, udinga kakhulu lokhu kudla. Ushukela namafutha nawo ayingxenye yokudla okunempilo. Anika amandla engeziwe ukuze ubhekane nezifo futhi enze ukudla kube mnandi. Sonke kufanele sizame ukusebenzisa usawoti omncane, njengoba usawoti omningi ungaholela ekucindezelweni kwegazi. Nokho, uma unokuhlanza noma uphumelele, ulahlekelwa usawoti nomoya omningi. Ukuphuza amanzi kubalulekile kithi sonke. Phuza amanzi amaningi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubuyisela amanzi alahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhlanza, ukuhamba, noma ukuvuka ebusuku. Amanzi aphuma emthonjeni, emfuleni, noma emgqonyeni kufanele aphekiwe ngaphambi kokuwaphuza. Ungaphuzi noma yiziphi iziphuzo ezine-alcohol. Iziphuzo ezine-alcohol ziwubhubhane emathunjini futhi zenza umzimba ulahlekelwe ama-vitamini avikela emizameni ezifo. Kubalulekile futhi ukungaphuzi i-alcohol ngenkathi uthatha imishanguzo ngoba kungalimaza umthambo wakho. Hlala usebenza kakhulu ukuze ugcine izicubu zakho ziqinile. Ukuhamba umzimba wakho, njengokuhamba, ukuhlanza indlu, nokulima, kuzothuthukisa umuzwa wakho wokuba nempilo. Ngaso sonke isikhathi geza izandla zakho ngensipho ngaphambi nangemva kokuphatha ukudla. Hlanza zonke izinsiza nezindawo lapho ulungiselela khona ukudla. Faka ukudla ukuze kuvinjelwe ukuthi kuthintwe yizinyoni nezilwane. Bheka usuku "lokusebenzisa" ezimpahleni ozithengayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi awuthengi ukudla okudlulelwe usuku lokuphelelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi awudli inyama eluhlaza, inkukhu, inhlanzi, noma amaqanda. Pheka ukudla kahle ukuze ubulale amagciwane. Uma unomshini opholile, gcina ukudla okusele emshinini opholile noma ugcine kuvalwe endaweni epholile. Ukudla okuphekiwe akufanele kugcinwe ngaphezu kosuku olulodwa futhi kufanele kuphumelelwe ngaphambi kokudliwa. Gcina ukudla endaweni epholile kakhulu. Zama ukungavumeli ukudla okuphekiwe ukuthi kube ngaphandle kokupholiswa ngaphezu kwamahora amabili. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kuhle kubo bonke! Uma ugula, kubaluleke kakhulu. Ukubuyisela ngokushesha ezifo kusiza izilonda zisheshe ziphole. Ukuphatha kahle nokusebenzisa imishanguzo nokwelashwa.
Ukukhetha ukudla okufanele kubalulekile kakhulu kithi sonke, ikakhulukazi uma unegciwane elingapheli njenge-obesity, umdlavuza, noma i-HIV. Ukudla kahle kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphucula uhlelo lwakho lokuvikela ukuze ulwe nezifo, kukhuphule amandla akho omzimba, futhi kukwenze uzizwe ungcono isikhathi eside. Ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo kubantu abaneziguli eziphakeme njengezifo zomdlavuza, obesity, kanye ne-HIV akufanele kuthathwe kalula. Ezinye izifo nemithi esetshenziselwa ukuwaphikisa ivame ukuholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo. Lezi ziqondiso ezilandelayo zizokusiza umuntu onegciwane elingapheli ukuthi abhekane kangcono nezimpawu zalesi simo futhi agweme ukuntuleka kokudla kahle nokulahlekelwa isisindo. Ubisi olungakawushintshi, ikhrimu, kanye nemikhiqizo yayo (ubisi oluphonswayo, ushizi, i-yogurt) kungangezwa ezidleni ukuze kuhanjiswe amandla engeziwe kanye nephrotheni. Faka amafutha afana ne-margarine, ibhotela, kanye ne-mayonnaise ezidleni ukuze uthole amandla engeziwe futhi uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla. Uma uzwa ukungakhululeki noma ungajabuli ngemva kokwengeza amafutha engeziwe ezidleni zakho, zama ukunciphisa. Ake sithole ukuthi ungabhekana kanjani nezimpawu zesifo ezingenza ungafuni ukudla. Yini engingayenza uma ngizwa sengathi angifuni ukudla? Izifo, ukudangala, nokuhlukumezeka kungakwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno wokudla. Zama lokhu okulandelayo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi udla ngokwanele ukuze ugcine umzimba wakho uqine. Ukudla okufana noshukela, ubisi oluphonswayo, kanye namafutha kuhlinzeka ngamandla amaningi nakuba kudliwa ngezinga elincane. Uma kungenzeka, kufanele kube kuhlanganiswe nezinye izidlo. Zama ukudla nomunye umuntu - ukudla nabanye kukwenza ujabulele ukudla kakhulu. Dla izidlo zakho endaweni ethokomele ukuze ujabulele kakhulu (dlala umculo, ngaphansi kwesihlahla, noma epakini). Ungabambeleli ezikhathini ezinqunyiwe zokudla - dlani noma nini uma uzizwa ufisa ukudla. Ukuhamba kancane kukhuphula umnqweno wokudla. Phuza iziphuzo ezinamandla phakathi nosuku, ezifana neziphuzo ezisekelwe kubisi, iziphuzo ezinamazambane, kanye nesobho esenziwe ekhaya. Dla ukudla okuthandayo - kungenzeka ukuthi uzodla kakhulu ngalendlela. Gwema ukudla okunokuthungwa okuqinile njengekhabhishi nekhofi uma kukwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno wokudla. Uma imithi oyithathayo ikwenza ulahlekelwe umnqweno, buza umhlinzeki wezempilo uma ungathatha imithi ngemuva kokudla. Ingabe uzwa ukungakhululeki noma ukuhamba? Dla izigaba ezincane zokudla ngezikhathi eziningi ukuze ugweme ukuzizwa ungaphilile. Linda okungenani amahora amabili ngemuva kokudla ngaphambi kokulala. Gwema ukuphuza nothuli. Bangathuthukisa ukungakhululeki futhi bahlukumeze impilo yakho. Zama ukuphuza amanzi amaningi njengezimpahla ezihlanzekile kanye netiye. Zama ukuphuza lezi ziphuzo ngezikhathi lapho ungadli noma ngaphambi kokudla, njengoba lokhu kungakwenza uzwe ukungakhululeki. Ukubhekana nokungakhululeki nokuhamba... Imithi yokwelapha ivame ukuholela ekungakhululekeni nasekuhambeni. Dla izigaba ezincane zokudla ngezikhathi eziningi - ukungakhululeki kuba kubi uma kungekho lutho esiswini. Linda kuze kube uzwa ungcono ngaphambi kokudla, kodwa ungashiyi izidlo. Gwema ukudla okushisayo kakhulu nokunamafutha. Faka kancane uju lwelemons noma ingxenye ye-lemon eziphuzweni ezibandayo. Zama ukudla ukudla okubandayo ukuze iphunga olithola ngesikhathi sokupheka lingakwenzi uzwe ukungakhululeki. Ngokuvamile, umzimba uthokozisa ukudla okubandayo kangcono. Gcina indawo yakho yokuhlala ivulekile kahle. Hlala uphakamile ngemuva kokudla - linda okungenani imizuzu engama-20 ngaphambi kokulala ukuze ugweme ukuhamba. Uma unomkhuhlane, udinga ukufaka amanzi alahlekile uma uphumeza. Phuza amanzi amaningi - ngaphezu kwalokho okudingayo uma ungatholi amanzi. Uma uzwa sengathi awufuni ukudla, ungakha isobho sezinhlanzi, ama-patato, amakharoti, noma noma yiziphi ezinye izitshalo onazo. Lokhu kunganikeza umzimba wakho amandla nezithako. Ungazizwa ungatholi kahle uma kunzima futhi kunzima ukudlula. Gwema ukusebenzisa ama-laxatives nanoma yiziphi ezinye "imikhiqizo yokuhlanzeka kwesisu" efana ne-enemas. Ama-laxatives ne-enemas enza ukuthi umzimba wakho ulahlekelwe izithako eziningi ezibalulekile futhi kuyisixazululo esikahle kuphela esingaxazululi inkinga yangempela. Dla ukudla okungakawushintshi futhi okuncane okwenziwe ngeziphuzo ezimhlophe (amakhukhi, ama-pastries, njll.). Hlala usebenza kakhulu! Ukuhamba njalo kuzokwenza kube lula ukunciphisa umnqweno wokuhamba. Ungazizwa ukungakhululeki uma unokuhamba kathathu ngosuku nezinkanyezi ezimanzi. Ukuhamba kungaholela ekuntulekeni kokudla kahle ngoba ukudla kudlula emzimbeni wakho ngokushesha kakhulu ukuze umzimba wakho ukwazi ukukwamukela. Umuntu uphinde udle kancane ngoba ungenamfuno. Uma unokuhamba, umzimba wakho uzoba ne-dehydration ngoba ulahlekelwa amanzi amaningi - lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi yi-dehydration. I-dehydration ibalulekile kakhulu futhi ingaba yingozi. Yini okufanele ngiyenze uma nginokuhamba? Phuza amanzi amaningi nezimpahla ukuze ubuyise amanzi alahlekile emzimbeni wakho. Ukuze wenze isiphuzo esenziwe ekhaya sokubuyisela amanzi alahlekile, thatha ilitha elilodwa lamanzi aphekiwe bese uvumela ukuba kuphume. Faka ama-teaspoons amane noshukela kanye ne-teaspoon eyodwa ye-salt. Hlanganisa le ngxube ngangokunokwenzeka. Ikhofi nezinye izidlo neziphuzo ezifana ne-cola ne-chocolate ziqukethe i-caffeine futhi zingathuthukisa i-dehydration. Esikhundleni salokho, dlani kakhulu... Ukudla okufana nama-apula noma ama-banana aphumile, ama-oats, noma ama-potato; lezi zinto ziqukethe i-fiber esheshayo esiza ukugcina amanzi esiswini. Ukudla okufana nama-potato nama-banana kuqukethe i-potassium, elahlekile ngesikhathi sokuhamba. Dla kaningi ukuze ubuyise isisindo esilahlekile nezithako. Ukuntuleka kokuhlanzeka kungaholela ekuhambeni. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi ngethusi ngaphambi kokuphatha, ukuhlela, ukupheka, noma ukugcina ukudla. Hlanza izandla zakho ngamanzi ngethusi ngemuva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese noma ngemuva kokushintsha umgibeli. Uma inyama iphunga noma inambitha i-metallic, dlani kuphela izinkukhu, izinhlanzi, imikhiqizo yobisi, ama-beans omisiwe angakawushintshi, kanye ne-peas ukuze uthole i-protein. Ukudla okubandayo noma okubandayo kuvame ukunambitha kahle kakhulu kunokudla okushisayo. Sebenzisa ama-spices, izobho, noma uju lwelemons ukuze uthuthukise ukunambitheka kokudla kwakho. Dla ukudla kwakho kancane ngenkathi uphuza isiphuzo sakho. Kungasiza ukusebenzisa amanzi anesawoti ukuwasha umlomo wakho njalo. Ukuphuza amanzi anama-lemon ngaphambi
G. Iziphakamiso Eziwusizo Zokuphatha Izimpawu Zokugula Nokwandisa Ukudla Okunempilo. Impilo yethu, indlela esizizwa ngayo, umsebenzi wethu, nokudlala, indlela esikhula ngayo futhi sithuthuka - konke kuthonywa yiz food esizidlayo. Ukudla kunikeza umzimba izithako ezidingekayo ukuze ube nempilo futhi uqine. Izithako zifaka phakathi amaprotheni, amakarbohayidrethi, amafutha, ama-vithamini, imithombo, namanzi. Le pamphlet yakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane mayelana nendima ebalulekile yokudla ekwandiseni uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba ukuze luphikise izifo futhi lukusize ekubuyiseni. Inhloso ukuheha ukuthi unake kakhulu isimo sokudla somguli ngamunye osesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo futhi usebenzise ukudla okunempilo njengendlela ebalulekile ohlelweni lwakho lokwelashwa. Kulolu doc, abantu abasesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo bafaka bonke abaguli abanezifo ezinzima abafuna ukwesekwa okungeziwe kokudla ukuze bagweme ukulahlekelwa isisindo nokuphazamiseka - ikakhulukazi abaguli abanokhulumeni, umdlavuza, i-tuberculosis, noma eminye imikhuhlane. Enye yezindlela zokuphula leli cycebe elibuhlungu ukusebenzisa ukudla okunempilo. Ukudla okunempilo kwandisa amandla omzimba okuphikisa izifo nezifo, kukhuphule amandla, futhi kwenza umuntu azizwe eqinile futhi engcono. Lokhu kungasiza ukuhamba phambili kwezifo. Ukudla ukudla okunempilo kungasiza ukugcina uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba lukhona ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze sikwazi ukuphikisa izifo. Wonke umuntu udinga ukudla ukudla okufanele ukuze ahlale enempilo. Nokho, kubantu abasesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo, kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi badle ukudla okunempilo, njengoba bephakeme kakhulu emiphumeleni yokuntuleka kwezithako. Ukungadli okwanele, ukulahlekelwa kwezithako okweqile, kanye nokuntuleka kwezithako kubantu abagulayo kuholela ekulahlekelweni isisindo nasekuphazamisekeni, kwehlisa uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba futhi kwandisa ubungozi bezifo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abasesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo badla ngendlela efanele. Ukuvimbela ukulahlekelwa isisindo nokukhuthaza ukukhula kwesisindo. Ukubuyisela zonke izithako ezilahlekile ngesikhathi sokugula nokuhlanza. Ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kokudla okunempilo okuhlukahlukene (ukudla okunothile ngezithako kanye nokudla okunamandla emathunjini) kunamacebo amaningi okugcina uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba lukhona. Ukulungisa ukudla komguli ukuze kuhambisane nezimpawu zabo zokugula. Ukuncoma umguli ngokudla okufanele acabangele ukuthi umguli angakufinyelela. Hlola isisindo somguli futhi ugcine irekhodi lesisindo kukhadi leklinikhi. Buza umguli ukuthi udla ini ngokuvamile ukuze uthole ukuthi uthola yisiphi isidlo, izimo zabo zomnotho, nokuthi yikuphi ukudla abangakufinyelela. Thola ukuthi kukhona amanzi aphephile kanye negesi atholakalayo. Thola umlando wezimpawu zokugula zomguli. Siza umguli ukuhlela ukudla kwabo, ucabangele isimo sabo somnotho nolunye ulwazi ukuze kuhlangabezane nesimo somguli. Uma umguli elahlekile isisindo, nikeza iziphakamiso zokwandisa isisindo somzimba. Nikeza umguli izeluleko zokuphatha ukudla ngokuphepha. Hlela ukuhamba phambili ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi lezi ziphakamiso zilandelwa. Kunezindlela eziningi zokudla okunempilo. Ngamunye wethu udla ngendlela ehlukile ngenxa yezimo zethu zomnotho, ukukhetha ukudla, inkolo, isiko, njll. Kubalulekile ukukhetha lokhu uma uncoma abaguli ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuze ugweme izifo, ukuntuleka kokudla, nokulahlekelwa isisindo okungafunwa, khuthaza abaguli ukuthi bangalibali, baqale ukunaka kakhulu udaba lokudla okunempilo manje. Kunzima kakhulu ukulungisa ukuntuleka kwezithako emzimbeni uma sebekhulile kakhulu futhi begula kakhulu! Akukho uhlobo olulodwa lokudla olungasinika konke esikudingayo! Khuthaza abantu ukuba badle ukudla okuhlukahlukene - ukudla abangakukwazi ukukhokhela futhi abakutholayo kalula. Kunconywa ukuthi umuntu adle izinhlobo ezintathu ezahlukene zokudla nsuku zonke. Khuthaza abantu ukuba baphuze phakathi kokudla (iziphuzo) njengoba lokhu kusiza kakhulu uma othile enezinkinga zokudla okwanele ngesikhathi sokudla. Nansi isithombe ongayisebenzisa ukukhombisa abaguli ukuthi kulula kanjani ukukhetha ukudla okunempilo ezinhlelweni ezahlukene zokudla. Ukudla okune-starch njengobhontshisi, iphalishi, amakhabe, irayisi, amazambane, yam, ummbila, ipasta kufanele kube ingxenye enkulu yokudla kwabo. Ngokuvamile, lezi zinto azibizi kakhulu futhi zikh提供a izithako eziningi ngemali. Khuthaza abaguli ukuba bafake ukudla okwengeziwe kokudla okune-starch ukuze balungise izidlo ezihlanganisiwe. Imifino nezithelo zikh提供a umthombo wama-vithamini nemithombo ukusiza ukugcina uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba lukhona. Khuthaza abaguli obakhathalelayo ukuba badle izithelo nemifino eminingi ngangokunokwenzeka. Imifino nezithelo ezinemibala efana nepinki, ophuzi, obomvu, noma oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kufanele zidle nsuku zonke, isibonelo, i-spinach, i-pumpkin, ama-carrots, ama-apricots, i-papaya, kanye ne-mango. Izithelo ezifana namawolintshi, amalimu, ne-guavas, kanye ne-mango kanye namatamatisi zikh提供a i-vitamin C esiza ekuphikisaneni nezifo. Abaguli kufanele baphokophele ukudla izithelo nemifino/izinkonzo ezinhlanu zemifino ngosuku. Inhlanzi, inyama, ubisi, namathanga angadliwa nsuku zonke. Phakathi kwezinye izithako ezitholakalayo, lezi zinto zikh提供a umzimba ngamaprotheni. Ngalesi sikhathi sokugula, kubalulekile kakhulu ukuba umuntu abe namaprotheni anele. Inyama yenkukhu, i-nyama yebhuku, i-nyama ye-pork, inhlanzi, umthondo, ikhala, inhliziyo, ubuchopho, imbuzi, izinyawo zenkukhu, amaqanda, ubisi, ushizi, i-yogurt, ubisi lwe-buttermilk, ubisi oluphakanyisiwe (hhayi i-coffee creamer), ushizi, kanye nezinyoni ezithile. Lapho kuthengwa esitolo, lezi zinto zivame ukuba zibhujiswe kakhulu - khuthaza labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuba baphile izinkukhu, amahlosi, izinkomo, izinkukhu, nezilwane ezithile ekhaya ukuze bathole inyama, amaqanda, futhi ngisho nobisi. Lezi zinto zikh提供a imikhiqizo esekelwe ezitshalweni, ezikh提供a futhi amaprotheni nezinye izithako ezidingekayo ukuze uqine uhlelo lokuvikela umzimba nezicubu. Khuthaza abaguli ukuba badle ama-beans, ama-peas, ama-lentils, kanye nama-soybeans angasetshenziswa njengezikhumbuzo zenhlanzi ukuze kulungiswe izidlo ezishibhile. Kubantu abangakwazi ukudla inyama esesimweni sokugula esiqhubekayo, lezi zinto kufanele zibe yingxenye ebalulekile yecebo labo lokudla okunempilo. Abaguli bangafaka ushukela namafutha ohlelweni lwabo lokudla okunempilo. Lokhu kudla kwandisa inani lamandla atholakalayo kokudla futhi kusiza ukwenza izidlo zibe mn
Umphakathi ungaxhumana nalesi sikhungo ukuze uthole usizo ngokushaya inombolo engakhokhiwe: 0800 005 133. Lesi sikhungo sokuxhumana nobuchwepheshe obuphezulu sinezisebenzi ezinganikeza umphakathi izeluleko nolwazi mayelana nempilo nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi nemininingwane edingwa umshayi. Zizwe ungathola usizo uma kukhulunywa ngempilo. Lesi sikhungo, esitholakala ebhizinisini iNatalia, okuyihhovisi elikhulu leMnyango Wezempilo e-uMgungundlovu, sinezisebenzi eziqeqeshiwe ezilungele ukusiza noma ubani oxhumana nabo. Inhloso yokwakha lesi sikhungo ukuhlinzeka umphakathi wonke ngosizo lwezempilo ngaso sonke isikhathi ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zokuxhumana ezifana neradiyo, ithelevishini, i-imeyili, i-SMS, nezinsiza zokushaya ucingo. Uqhubekile wathi, "Lesi sikhungo sisiza kakhulu kithi ekusizeni ngezimo eziphuthumayo ngoba uma umphakathi uphakamisa isixwayiso, singafika ngokushesha lapho kudingeka khona njengoba lesi sikhungo sinezixhumanisi ezisiza abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuba baqondiswe lapho usizo ludingeka khona ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi befuna le ndawo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sikhungo singathumela imiyalezo yokwazisa uma kunezimo zokuphanga, kuchaza uNtsobi. Ingxenye enkulu yezingcingo ezitholakala kuleli sikhungo ivela kubantu abafuna ulwazi nosizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, kanti abanye bafuna ulwazi ngamadawa. "Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi lesi sikhungo singasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi kubantu abafuna usizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, okusho ukuthi siphinde sibe nesandla ekufundiseni umphakathi. Okubukwayo ukuthi abantu abaningi bafuna ukwazi ngesimo sempilo kule ndawo ngoba befisa ukuvakashela futhi bathi sinesandla kwezokuvakasha," kuchaza uNtsobi. Izinhlobo zezingcingo ezitholakala kuleli sikhungo zifaka phakathi lezo ezivela kubantu abafuna ukubika izinkinga ezifana nokukhwabanisa, amacala okuhlukumeza, udlame lwasekhaya, abantu abalahlekile, imibiko yezingozi, izikhalazo ngezisebenzi, nokuthi abanye baphinde babeke izikhalazo. Zonke izikhalazo zilandelwa futhi zihlolwe. Njengoba sisondele isikhathi seholide, kubonakala ukuthi lesi sikhungo sizoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuhlinzekeni ngosizo lwezempilo emphakathini nasekuletheni usizo lokuxhumana uma kunezimo zokuphanga ngesikhathi lesi. Xhumana nathi. Lalela thina. Amahora angama-24 ngosuku. UKhuzwayo akazange abambezele njengoba athatha ithuba lokuba phakathi kwababokuqala kuleli sikhungo ukuthola imishanguzo ye-antiretroviral ye-HIV. Nakuba impilo kaKhuzwayo kanye naleyo yabanye abavakashi abangu-506 kuleli sikhungo ibonisa umehluko omkhulu ezimpilweni zabo kusukela baqala ukuthola imishanguzo, ubhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu ekhaya njengoba umyeni wakhe engafuni ukuzwa lutho ngempilo ye-HIV. Uzakwabo uzame ukukhuluma ngakho ngemva kokuthola ukuthi unomphumela oph positif, kodwa umyeni wakhe wenqaba ukulalela le ndaba. Indlela amadoda abheka ngayo amadoda. Ingabe lokhu kuyinkinga? Ngokusho kukaNzuza, lokhu kudalwa yizinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuthi amadoda azibona kanjani emphakathini. UNzuza uthi kukhona izikhathi lapho amaqembu, ikakhulukazi amadoda, engafuni ukubonakala ethola imishanguzo kuze kube phezulu kokuthi benqume ukufihla imishanguzo enikezwa ozakwabo. Omunye weziguli zethu waze wathi usikhumbuza ukuthi imishanguzo yakhe iyaphuma. Ngesikhathi sokuqhuba ucwaningo lwethu, sathola ukuthi umyeni wakhe ubebamba amaphilisi akhe. Sabe sesichaza kuye ukuthi kuyingozi kanjani ukungalandeli imiyalelo uma usebenzisa imishanguzo njengoba kungase kuphumelele kube nokungasebenzi kahle, kuchaza uNksz. Nzuza. IMnyango Wezempilo ukhuthaze amadoda ukuthi nawo asebenzise uhlelo lukamasipala lokuthola imishanguzo mahhala. Naphezu kwezinkinga ezikhona ohlelweni lwemishanguzo mayelana nokulandela imiyalelo efanele yokusebenzisa imishanguzo, uhlelo lusebenza kahle kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zitholakala kuzo zonke izifunda eziyi-11 zaleli phondo. Lezi zikhungo zineziqinisekiso ezihlinzeka kubantu abadala, izingane, nabesifazane abakhululiwe. UNzuza uthi abantu abathola imishanguzo bangabantu abanokubala kwe-CD4 ngaphansi kuka-200. Inani le-HIV virus emzimbeni womuntu libizwa ngokuthi i-viral load. Odokotela bahlola i-viral load emzimbeni ngesikhathi besebenzisa isiguli ngoba ukuncipha kwayo kusho ukuthi imishanguzo iyasebenza. Ukwanda kwe-viral load kumuntu osebenzisa imishanguzo kungase kube uphawu lokuthi isiguli sinezinkinga lapho imishanguzo ingasebenzi kahle noma ukuthi imishanguzo ayithathwa kahle. Imishanguzo iyasebenza kahle uma ithathwa njengoba kuqondiswe udokotela noma um nurse. Ukushiya isikhathi sokuthatha imishanguzo kungadala ukuthi i-virus ikhululeke futhi ingase ingasebenzi kahle emzimbeni. Abaguli banezimfanelo! Ngomhla kaMashi 21, sizobungaza Usuku Lwamalungelo Abantu. Lolu suku lubalulekile emlandweni weNingizimu Afrika ngoba lukhumbuza ngezinkinga abantu abahlangabezane nazo bephikisana namalungelo abantu. Abaningi benu bangase bazi ukubaluleka kwalolu suku, kodwa kulabo abancane, nansi imbali. Ngomhla kaMashi 21, 1960, kwaba nokuphikiswa okwenziwa emhlabeni wonke ngokumelene nemithetho yokuphasa eyayidinga ukuthi bonke abantu abamnyama abasebenza ezindaweni zasemadolobheni baphathe amaphepha ngaso sonke isikhathi. Labo abangaqondi balindele ukuboshwa. Kulolo suku, abantu bahamba baye eziteshini zamaphoyisa ngaphandle kokuphatha amaphepha futhi babefuna ukuboshwa. Inhloso yabo kwakuwukuthi kube nabantu abaningi ababoshwe ukuze izinto zingahambi kahle ezweni kulolo suku, okuzoholela ekupheleni kwemithetho yokuphasa. ESharpeville, eJohannesburg, lapho izinkulungwane ziqoqana eziteshini zamaphoyisa, kwaba nokuphikisana, futhi amaphoyisa avula umlilo. Cishe abantu abangu-70 babulawe, kanti abangu-180 baphukile. Labo bantu babebhekene nemithetho engafanele futhi bephikisana namalungelo abo. Iningi lalawa malungelo manje sehlanganiswe kuMthethosisekelo wethu kuSahluko 2. Nokho, lawa malungelo awawona kuphela abantu abathile; awahlukanisi ngokuthi wenza muphi umsebenzi, futhi awabheki ukuthi ungumuntu ocebile noma omncane. Kukho futhi uMthethosisekelo wamalungelo wabaguli. Ukubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuba nolwazi ngempilo yethu. Ukukhetha uhlobo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo esifuna. Ukwamukela ukwelashwa ngumuntu owaziwayo emkhakheni wezempilo. Ukuthi isimo sabo sezempilo kufanele sithunyelwe kubo bonke, futhi sigcinwe sithule. Ukukhetha ukwelashwa kunikezwa yonke imininingwane mayelana nokuthi kuzokwenziwa ini. Ukufuna umbono wesibili kudokodo noma esibhedlela uma singathembi lokho esikukhuluma. Njengoba wonke umuntu enamalungelo abantu kusukela ekuzalweni, futhi akekho ongawathatha, abaguli akufanele baphokophele noma bacele amalungelo abo. Khumbula, kufanele uhloniphe namalungelo abanye. Ukushoda kwez nurses ezibhedlela eziphethwe uMnyango Wezempilo eKwaZulu-Natal kuyakhathaza, ikakhulukazi ngohlelo lokuqeqesha lwez nurses olunikezwa yile mnyango kulo nyaka. Lokhu kushoda kwezisebenzi kuboniswa njengomphumela wokulinda isikhathi eside nemiphumela emibi emnyangweni wezokwelapha. Kuboniswa futhi njengomphumela wokuthi abaguli abatholi ukunakwa okusheshayo kuze kube sekupheleni kokuhlala ezihlalweni. Lezi zifundo zinez nurses zizofundiswa ezikhungweni eziyi-25 ezizobe zihlala kulo mnyango. Kuzodingeka baphathe isivumelwano nomnyango zobuchwepheshe bokusebenza ezikhungweni zezempilo eziphethwe yile mnyango uma seziphothule ukuqeqeshwa kwazo. "Lokhu kuyinto ez nurses ezibophezele ukuyenza," kusho udokotela. Ukusebenza ezindaweni zokunyakaza kwami, ngiyajabula ukuba nethuba lokuzibophezela kulabo abavuma ukusebenza kuMnyango, kubonakala ukuthi kuhle ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, inkinga ukuthi ukushiya ithimba eliqinile ukuze lisebenze kumnyango ngeke kusebenzele umphakathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abashodile ezindaweni zokuphatha lapha e-EMRS, sisebenze iminyaka. "Iz nurses ziyisisekelo sabasebenzi bonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa." Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngethimba elizofundiswa umnyango. Uqhubekile wathi ukwelashwa kuyimfuneko ngoba kudinga ukuzinikela. Unobhala ukholelwa ukuthi labo abazinikela bazokuqinisekisa ukuthi baqeqesha futhi bazibophezela kulabo abafuna abasebenzi bezempilo. Nakuba kunzima kimi kule ndawo, NGIKHOLWA ukuthi abanye benu sebethole izindaba ezimnyama ezashaya umndeni wami ngesikhathi ngilahlekelwa yindodana yami, uMonde. EKwaZulu-Natal, kanye naseNingizimu Afrika yonke, ngiyabonga ngenkxaso yenu ngesikhathi umndeni wami nami sikhathazekile. Ngakho-ke ngifuna ukuthatha leli thuba, engilitholile kule miphakathi, ukubonga wonke umuntu ngemicabango yenu yokuxhasa, ngokuthatha isikhathi sokungibona, kulabo abathumele izimbali, baphendula em prayers, nabanye abakhululelwe. Anginazo izwi ezanele ukuchaza ukuthi kwangithinta kanjani enhliziyweni yami lokho enikwenze kimi, kubantu engingabazi, abangane, izihlobo, ozakwethu, kanye nomphakathi wonke. Lokho engingakusho kuphela ukuthi uNkulunkulu ababusise kakhulu. EKwaZulu-Natal, sijabule ukuqala unyaka omusha ngenjabulo enkulu ngokwamukela uMphakathi Omusha. Ngabe ngiyaphutha uma ngithi omusha ngoba akuyena umuntu omusha kulo mnyango; ubelokhu engowakho iminyaka eminingi. UDkt. Busi Nyembezi ungumuntu ozinikele, ophumelele kakhulu emfundweni, enolwazi kwezempilo aluthole lapha esifundazweni futhi wafinyelela nakwamanye amazwe. Ngiyamemukela kulo Mnyango ngempilo efudumele. Nginezithemba eziphakeme zokuthi uzohola lo mnyango ngendlela ezokwamukelwa ngabaguli kanye nemindeni yabo. Uzosebenza nethimba elihlanganisa othisha abasha nabanolwazi, okuzosiza ukuhlela lo mnyango ukuze ubhekane nezinhlelo zawo ezamukelwe. Lo msebenzi ubalulekile kithi sonke kuMnyango. Isikhathi seHope, ukhuluma ngodokotela wezangoma uma ethula inkulumo yakhe ngesikhathi sokuvulwa kwePhalamende. UMnyango wethu ubeke izinto ezimbalwa ezidinga ukugxilwa kuzo ngokushesha. Ukuqinisa izinhlelo ezibalulekile, kugxilwe kakhulu ezinhlelweni ze-tuberculosis (TB), ukuvimbela i-HIV, nokuphila kahle. Emihlanganweni yami elandelayo, ngizochaza ukuthi sihlela ukwenza ini kulezi zindawo engikhulume ngazo. Okwamanje, kuhle ukusho ukuthi sizothola ukunakwa okuzoletha ushintsho ezimpilweni zabantu. Siyajabula ukuthi sizokwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinhloso zethu zokusiza abantu abangu-30,000 ukufinyelela i-ARVs kule nyanga esiqala ngayo. Njengoba uMphakathi wePhondo uDkt. Sbu Ndebele eqaphele ekhuluma kwiLegislature, kukhona abantu abangaphezu kuka-28,000 okwamanje abathola ukwelashwa. Nakuba kuwumsebenzi wethu ukunakekela nokunakekela abaguli, kubalulekile futhi ukuthi sikhulume ngenkolo yokuvimbela, ukuze ngesikhathi sikhathalela abaguli, siqhubeke nokugcina abaphilayo bephilile. Yingakho kule nyanga sikhona emkhankasweni wokukhuluma ngenkolo yokuthi abantu kufanele bakhathalele izimpilo zabo futhi bazivikele ezifo ezithathelwana ngocansi. Lolu msg esikhuluma ngalo lulula; lukhuluma nje ukuthi impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Singakusiza ngemininingwane, sikusize ngokuqeqeshwa nokunakekelwa, kodwa ekugcineni, kuwena okufanele uvikele impilo yakho.
